自序

自序

自序

Self-introduction我在年青时候也曾经做过许多梦，后来大半忘却了，但自己也并不以为可惜。所谓回忆者，虽说可以使人欢欣，有时也不免使人寂寞，使精神的丝缕还牵着已逝的寂寞的时光，又有什么意味呢，而我偏苦于不能全忘却，这不能全忘的一部分，到现在便成了《呐喊》的来由。
I also had many dreams when I was young, and then most of them were forgotten, but I didn't think it was a pity. The so-called reminiscence, although it can make people happy, sometimes it is inevitable to make people lonely, so that the threads of the spirit still lead to the lonely time that has passed, what is the meaning, and I am suffering from not being able to forget it all, this part of which cannot be completely forgotten has now become the origin of "The Scream".我有四年多，曾经常常，——几乎是每天，出入于质铺和药店里，年纪可是忘却了，总之是药店的柜台正和我一样高，质铺的是比我高一倍，我从一倍高的柜台外送上衣服或首饰去，在侮蔑里接了钱，再到一样高的柜台上给我久病的父亲去买药。回家之后，又须忙别的事了，因为开方的医生是最有名的，以此所用的药引也奇特：冬天的芦根，经霜三年的甘蔗，蟋蟀要原对的，结子的平地木，……多不是容易办到的东西。然而我的父亲终于日重一日的亡故了。
I have been in and out of the pawn shop and pharmacy almost every ,——day for more than four years, and I have forgotten my age, in short, the counter of the pharmacy is as high as me, and the pawn shop is twice as tall as me, I send clothes or jewelry from the counter that is twice as high, take the money in the insult, and then go to the counter at the same height to buy medicine for my long-term sick father. After returning home, I have to be busy with other things, because the doctor who prescribes the prescription is the most famous, and the medicine used in this is also peculiar: reed root in winter, sugarcane after three years of frost, crickets should be right, and flat wood with knots,...... It's not easy to do. However, my father finally died day by day.有谁从小康人家而坠入困顿的么，我以为在这途路中，大概可以看见世人的真面目；我要到N进K学堂去了，仿佛是想走异路，逃异地，去寻求别样的人们。我的母亲没有法，办了八元的川资，说是由我的自便；然而伊哭了，这正是情理中的事，因为那时读书应试是正路，所谓学洋务，社会上便以为是一种走投无路的人，只得将灵魂卖给鬼子，要加倍的奚落而且排斥的，而况伊又看不见自己的儿子了。然而我也顾不得这些事，终于到N去进了K学堂了，在这学堂里，我才知道世上还有所谓格致，算学，地理，历史，绘图和体操。生理学并不教，但我们却看到些木版的《全体新论》和《化学卫生论》之类了。我还记得先前的医生的议论和方药，和现在所知道的比较起来，便渐渐的悟得中医不过是一种有意的或无意的骗子，同时又很起了对于被骗的病人和他的家族的同情；而且从译出的历史上，又知道了日本维新是大半发端于西方医学的事实。
Who has fallen into hardship from a well-off family, I thought that on this road, I could probably see the true face of the world; I was going to N into K School, as if I wanted to take a different path, escape to a different place, and seek other people. My mother had no way to do it, so she paid eight yuan of Sichuan capital, saying that it was at my own discretion; However, Yi cried, which was reasonable, because at that time, studying and taking exams was the right way, and the so-called learning foreign affairs, the society thought that it was a desperate person, so he had to sell his soul to the devils, and he was doubly ridiculed and rejected, and he couldn't see his son. However, I didn't care about these things, and finally went to N to enter the K school, where I learned that there are still so-called styles, arithmetic, geography, history, drawing and gymnastics in the world. Physiology is not taught, but we have seen woodblock versions of "New Theory of All" and "Theory of Chemistry and Hygiene". I still remember the previous doctor's discussions and prescriptions, and compared with what I know now, I gradually realized that Chinese medicine is just an intentional or unintentional liar, and at the same time, I have a lot of sympathy for the deceived patient and his family; Moreover, from the translated history, we know that most of the Japanese Restoration originated from Western medicine.因为这些幼稚的知识，后来便使我的学籍列在日本一个乡间的医学专门学校里了。我的梦很美满，预备卒业回来，救治像我父亲似的被误的病人的疾苦，战争时候便去当军医，一面又促进了国人对于维新的信仰。我已不知道教授微生物学的方法，现在又有了怎样的进步了，总之那时是用了电影，来显示微生物的形状的，因此有时讲义的一段落已完，而时间还没有到，教师便映些风景或时事的画片给学生看，以用去这多余的光阴。其时正当日俄战争的时候，关于战事的画片自然也就比较的多了，我在这一个讲堂中，便须常常随喜我那同学们的拍手和喝采。有一回，我竟在画片上忽然会见我久违的许多中国人了，一个绑在中间，许多站在左右，一样是强壮的体格，而显出麻木的神情。据解说，则绑着的是替俄国做了军事上的侦探，正要被日军砍下头颅来示众，而围着的便是来赏鉴这示众的盛举的人们。
Because of this naïve knowledge, my student status was later listed in a medical school in the countryside of Japan. My dream was very happy, preparing to come back from graduation, treat the suffering of misplaced patients like my father, and become a military doctor during the war, which also promoted the Chinese people's belief in the Restoration. I don't know how to teach microbiology, but what kind of progress has been made now, in short, at that time movies were used to show the shape of microorganisms, so sometimes the handout was over, and before the time was up, the teacher showed some pictures of landscapes or current events to the students to use this extra time. At that time, during the Russo-Japanese War, there were naturally more pictures about the war, and I had to often applaud and applaud my classmates in this lecture hall. Once, I suddenly met many Chinese people I hadn't seen for a long time on the painting, one was tied in the middle, and many were standing on the left and right, all with strong physiques, and showed a numb look. According to the commentary, the people who were tied up were military detectives who had been military detectives for Russia, and were about to be beheaded by the Japanese army to show the public, and surrounded by people who came to appreciate this grand event.这一学年没有完毕，我已经到了东京了，因为从那一回以后，我便觉得医学并非一件紧要事，凡是愚弱的国民，即使体格如何健全，如何茁壮，也只能做毫无意义的示众的材料和看客，病死多少是不必以为不幸的。所以我们的第一要著，是在改变他们的精神，而善于改变精神的是，我那时以为当然要推文艺，于是想提倡文艺运动了。在东京的留学生很有学法政理化以至警察工业的，但没有人治文学和美术；可是在冷淡的空气中，也幸而寻到几个同志了，此外又邀集了必须的几个人，商量之后，第一步当然是出杂志，名目是取“新的生命”的意思，因为我们那时大抵带些复古的倾向，所以只谓之《新生》。
This academic year is not over, and I have already arrived in Tokyo, because since that time, I have felt that medicine is not an important matter, and all foolish and weak citizens, no matter how sound their physiques and how strong they are, can only be meaningless materials and spectators, and there is no need to think that death from illness is unfortunate. So our first priority is to change their spirit, and what is good at changing the spirit is that I thought that of course I had to tweet art, so I wanted to promote the literary and artistic movement. The international students in Tokyo are very knowledgeable in law, politics, and even the police industry, but there is no literature or art in the human world. But in the cold air, fortunately, I found a few comrades, and invited a few necessary people, and after discussion, the first step was of course to publish a magazine, which was named after "new life", because we probably had some retro tendencies at that time, so it was only called "New Life".《新生》的出版之期接近了，但最先就隐去了若干担当文字的人，接着又逃走了资本，结果只剩下不名一钱的三个人。创始时候既已背时，失败时候当然无可告语，而其后却连这三个人也都为各自的运命所驱策，不能在一处纵谈将来的好梦了，这就是我们的并未产生的《新生》的结局。
The publication date of "New Life" was approaching, but a few people in charge of the text were hidden first, and then the capital fled, leaving only three people who were not named. At the beginning of the beginning, there was no time to speak of it, and of course there was nothing to say when it failed, but then even these three people were driven by their own destinies and could not talk about the good dreams of the future in one place, which was the ending of our "New Life".我感到未尝经验的无聊，是自此以后的事。我当初是不知其所以然的；后来想，凡有一人的主张，得了赞和，是促其前进的，得了反对，是促其奋斗的，独有叫喊于生人中，而生人并无反应，既非赞同，也无反对，如置身毫无边际的荒原，无可措手的了，这是怎样的悲哀呵，我于是以我所感到者为寂寞。
I feel bored like I have never experienced before, and it has been since then. I didn't know why; Later, I thought that wherever a person's proposition is agreed upon, it is to promote it to move forward, to be opposed, to promote its struggle, and it is only shouted among the living, and the living does not react, neither agrees nor opposes, as if in an boundless wasteland, there is no way to do anything, what kind of sadness is this, so I think what I feel is loneliness.这寂寞又一天一天的长大起来，如大毒蛇，缠住了我的灵魂了。
This loneliness grew up day by day, like a poisonous snake, entangled my soul.然而我虽然自有无端的悲哀，却也并不愤懑，因为这经验使我反省，看见自己了：就是我决不是一个振臂一呼应者云集的英雄。
However, although I have my own unwarranted sorrow, I am not resentful, because this experience has made me reflect and see myself: that is, I am by no means a hero who raises my arms and responds.只是我自己的寂寞是不可不驱除的，因为这于我太痛苦。我于是用了种种法，来麻醉自己的灵魂，使我沉入于国民中，使我回到古代去，后来也亲历或旁观过几样更寂寞更悲哀的事，都为我所不愿追怀，甘心使他们和我的脑一同消灭在泥土里的，但我的麻醉法却也似乎已经奏了功，再没有青年时候的慷慨激昂的意思了。
It's just that my own loneliness must be dispelled, because it is too painful for me. I then used all kinds of methods to anesthetize my soul, so that I sank into the people, and made me return to ancient times, and later I also experienced or watched several more lonely and sad things, all of which I did not want to remember, and I was willing to let them be destroyed in the soil with my brain, but my anesthesia method seemed to have worked, and I no longer had the impassioned meaning of my youth.
S会馆里有三间屋，相传是往昔曾在院子里的槐树上缢死过一个女人的，现在槐树已经高不可攀了，而这屋还没有人住；许多年，我便寓在这屋里钞古碑。客中少有人来，古碑中也遇不到什么问题和主义，而我的生命却居然暗暗的消去了，这也就是我惟一的愿望。夏夜，蚊子多了，便摇着蒲扇坐在槐树下，从密叶缝里看那一点一点的青天，晚出的槐蚕又每每冰冷的落在头颈上。
There are three rooms in the S Hall, which are said to have strangled a woman on the locust tree in the yard in the past, and now the locust tree is unattainable, and this house is not yet inhabited; For many years, I have lived in this house to pay for the ancient monument. Few people came among the guests, and there were no problems and doctrines in the ancient monuments, but my life was actually secretly erased, which was my only wish. On summer nights, there were too many mosquitoes, so I sat under the locust tree shaking a cattail fan, looking at the blue sky little by little from the cracks in the dense leaves, and the late-emerging locust silkworms often fell coldly on their heads and necks.那时偶或来谈的是一个老朋友金心异，将手提的大皮夹放在破桌上，脱下长衫，对面坐下了，因为怕狗，似乎心房还在怦怦的跳动。
At that time, it was an old friend Jin Xinyi who put the big wallet he was carrying on the broken table, took off his robe, and sat down opposite, because he was afraid of dogs, and it seemed that his heart was still beating.“你钞了这些有什么用？”有一夜，他翻着我那古碑的钞本，发了研究的质问了。
"What's the use of you banknote?" One night, he flipped through the banknotes of my ancient stele and asked questions about research.“没有什么用。”
"It's useless."“那么，你钞他是什么意思呢？”
"So, what do you mean by banknote?"“没有什么意思。”
"It's not interesting."“我想，你可以做点文章……”
"I think you can do something about it......"我懂得他的意思了，他们正办《新青年》，然而那时仿佛不特没有人来赞同，并且也还没有人来反对，我想，他们许是感到寂寞了，但是说：
I understand what he means, they are running "New Youth", but at that time it seemed that not only did no one agree, but no one objected, I think they may have felt lonely, but they said:“假如一间铁屋子，是绝无窗户而万难破毁的，里面有许多熟睡的人们，不久都要闷死了，然而是从昏睡入死灭，并不感到就死的悲哀。现在你大嚷起来，惊起了较为清醒的几个人，使这不幸的少数者来受无可挽救的临终的苦楚，你倒以为对得起他们么？”
"If an iron house is windowless and is difficult to destroy, and there are many sleeping people in it, they will soon suffocate, but they will go from slumber to death, and they will not feel the sorrow of death. Now that you have shouted loudly, startled a few more sober people, and caused this unfortunate few to suffer irredeemably dying, do you think you are worthy of them? ”“然而几个人既然起来，你不能说决没有毁坏这铁屋的希望。”
"However, since a few people have risen, you can't say that there is no hope of destroying this iron house."是的，我虽然自有我的确信，然而说到希望，却是不能抹杀的，因为希望是在于将来，决不能以我之必无的证明，来折服了他之所谓可有，于是我终于答应他也做文章了，这便是最初的一篇《狂人日记》。从此以后，便一发而不可收，每写些小说模样的文章，以敷衍朋友们的嘱托，积久就有了十余篇。
Yes, although I have my own convictions, when it comes to hope, it cannot be erased, because hope lies in the future, and I must not be convinced by his so-called proof of what I must not have, so I finally agreed to him to make a fuss, which was the original "Diary of a Madman". Since then, it has been unacceptable, and every time I write some novel-like articles to perfunctory the instructions of my friends, there have been more than ten articles over time.在我自己，本以为现在是已经并非一个切迫而不能已于言的人了，但或者也还未能忘怀于当日自己的寂寞的悲哀罢，所以有时候仍不免呐喊几声，聊以慰藉那在寂寞里奔驰的猛士，使他不惮于前驱。至于我的喊声是勇猛或是悲哀，是可憎或是可笑，那倒是不暇顾及的；但既然是呐喊，则当然须听将令的了，所以我往往不恤用了曲笔，在《药》的瑜儿的坟上平空添上一个花环，在《明天》里也不叙单四嫂子竟没有做到看见儿子的梦，因为那时的主将是不主张消极的。至于自己，却也并不愿将自以为苦的寂寞，再来传染给也如我那年青时候似的正做着好梦的青年。
In myself, I thought that I was no longer a person who was urgent and could not speak, but perhaps I had not forgotten the sadness of my loneliness that day, so sometimes I still couldn't help but shout a few times to comfort the warrior who was running in loneliness, so that he was not afraid of the front. As for whether my cry is brave or sorrowful, abominable or ridiculous, it is beyond my consideration; But since it is a shout, of course I have to obey the order, so I often use a curved pen to add a wreath to the grave of Yu'er in "Medicine", and in "Tomorrow", I do not mention that the fourth sister-in-law did not achieve the dream of seeing her son, because the lord at that time did not advocate negativity. As for myself, I don't want to infect the loneliness I think is bitter to young people who are dreaming like I did when I was young.这样说来，我的小说和艺术的距离之远，也就可想而知了，然而到今日还能蒙着小说的名，甚而至于且有成集的机会，无论如何总不能不说是一件侥幸的事，但侥幸虽使我不安于心，而悬揣人间暂时还有读者，则究竟也仍然是高兴的。
In this way, the distance between my novels and art can be imagined, but to this day, I can still be covered with the name of novels, and even have the opportunity to complete an episode, in any case, I cannot help but say that it is a fluke, but although the fluke makes me uneasy, I am still happy to think that there are still readers in the world for the time being.所以我竟将我的短篇小说结集起来，而且付印了，又因为上面所说的缘由，便称之为《呐喊》。
So I actually collected my short stories and printed them, and because of the reasons mentioned above, I called them "The Scream".一九二二年十二月三日，鲁迅记于北京。
On December 3, 1922, Lu Xun recorded in Beijing.

狂人日记

狂人日记

狂人日记

Diary of a madman某君昆仲，今隐其名，皆余昔日在中学时良友；分隔多年，消息渐阙。日前偶闻其一大病；适归故乡，迂道往访，则仅晤一人，言病者其弟也。劳君远道来视，然已早愈，赴某地候补矣。因大笑，出示日记二册，谓可见当日病状，不妨献诸旧友。持归阅一过，知所患盖“迫害狂”之类。语颇错杂无伦次，又多荒唐之言；亦不著月日，惟墨色字体不一，知非一时所书。间亦有略具联络者，今撮录一篇，以供医家研究。记中语误，一字不易；惟人名虽皆村人，不为世间所知，无关大体，然亦悉易去。至于书名，则本人愈后所题，不复改也。七年四月二日识。
某君昆仲，今隐其名，皆余昔日在中学时良友；分隔多年，消息渐阙。 日前偶闻其一大病；适归故乡，迂道往访，则仅晤一人，言病者其弟也。 劳君远道来视，然已早愈，赴某地候补矣。 因大笑，出示日记二册，谓可见当日病状，不妨献诸旧友。 持归阅一过，知所患盖“迫害狂”之类。 语颇错杂无伦次，又多荒唐之言；亦不著月日，惟墨色字体不一，知非一时所书。 间亦有略具联络者，今撮录一篇，以供医家研究。 记中语误，一字不易；惟人名虽皆村人，不为世间所知，无关大体，然亦悉易去。 至于书名，则本人愈后所题，不复改也。 七年四月二日识。

狂人日记

一

狂人日记

One今天晚上，很好的月光。
Good moonshine tonight.我不见他，已是三十多年；今天见了，精神分外爽快。才知道以前的三十多年，全是发昏；然而须十分小心。不然，那赵家的狗，何以看我两眼呢？
I haven't seen him for more than 30 years; See you today, and I am very refreshed. Only then did I realize that the previous thirty years or so were all fainting; However, you have to be very careful. Otherwise, why would the Zhao family's dog look at me?我怕得有理。
I'm justified.

狂人日记

二

狂人日记

Two今天全没月光，我知道不妙。早上小心出门，赵贵翁的眼色便怪：似乎怕我，似乎想害我。还有七八个人，交头接耳的议论我，又怕我看见。一路上的人，都是如此。其中最凶的一个人，张着嘴，对我笑了一笑；我便从头直冷到脚跟，晓得他们布置，都已妥当了。
There is no moonlight today, I know it's not good. When he went out carefully in the morning, Zhao Guiweng's eyes were strange: he seemed to be afraid of me, and he seemed to want to harm me. There were also seven or eight people talking about me in their ears, but they were afraid that I would see them. This is true for people along the way. One of the most fierce of them, with his mouth open, smiled at me; I was cold from head to heel, knowing that they had arranged it properly.我可不怕，仍旧走我的路。前面一伙小孩子，也在那里议论我；眼色也同赵贵翁一样，脸色也铁青。我想我同小孩子有什么仇，他也这样。忍不住大声说，“你告诉我！”他们可就跑了。
I am not afraid, I still walk my way. A group of children in front of me were also talking about me; His eyes were the same as Zhao Guiweng's, and his face was also blue. I think I have a grudge against the child, and so does he. I can't help but say out loud, "You tell me!" "They just ran away.我想：我同赵贵翁有什么仇，同路上的人又有什么仇；只有廿年以前，把古久先生的陈年流水簿子，踹了一脚，古久先生很不高兴。赵贵翁虽然不认识他，一定也听到风声，代抱不平；约定路上的人，同我作冤对。但是小孩子呢？那时候，他们还没有出世，何以今天也睁着怪眼睛，似乎怕我，似乎想害我。这真教我怕，教我纳罕而且伤心。
I thought: What hatred do I have with Zhao Guiweng, and what hatred do I have with people on the same road; Only twenty years ago, Mr. Gu Jiu kicked Mr. Gu Jiu's old running water book, and Mr. Gu Jiu was very unhappy. Although Zhao Guiweng did not know him, he must have heard the news and was upset; The people on the road agreed to fight against me. But what about the little ones? At that time, they had not yet been born, so why did they open their eyes today, as if they were afraid of me and wanted to harm me. This really taught me to be afraid, taught me to be nahan and sad.我明白了。这是他们娘老子教的！
I understand. This is what their mother Lao Tzu taught!

狂人日记

三

狂人日记

Three晚上总是睡不着。凡事须得研究，才会明白。
I can't sleep at night. Everything must be studied to understand.他们——也有给知县打枷过的，也有给绅士掌过嘴的，也有衙役占了他妻子的，也有老子娘被债主逼死的；他们那时候的脸色，全没有昨天这么怕，也没有这么凶。
They - some have been shackled by the county magistrate, some have been slapped by the gentleman, some have taken his wife, and some have been forced to death by creditors; Their faces at that time were not as scary as yesterday, nor were they so fierce.最奇怪的是昨天街上的那个女人，打他儿子，嘴里说道，“老子呀！我要咬你几口才出气！”他眼睛却看着我。我出了一惊，遮掩不住；那青面獠牙的一伙人，便都哄笑起来。陈老五赶上前，硬把我拖回家中了。
The strangest thing is that the woman on the street yesterday beat his son and said, "Lao Tzu! I want to bite you a few bites before I get angry!" But his eyes looked at me. I was surprised and couldn't hide it; The group of people with green faces and fangs all laughed. Chen Laowu caught up and dragged me home.拖我回家，家里的人都装作不认识我；他们的眼色，也全同别人一样。进了书房，便反扣上门，宛然是关了一只鸡鸭。这一件事，越教我猜不出底细。
Drag me home, and everyone in the family pretends not to know me; Their eyes are all the same as others. When I entered the study, I knocked on the door, as if I was locked up with a chicken and duck. This matter, the more I teach me, the more I can't guess the details.前几天，狼子村的佃户来告荒，对我大哥说，他们村里的一个大恶人，给大家打死了；几个人便挖出他的心肝来，用油煎炒了吃，可以壮壮胆子。我插了一句嘴，佃户和大哥便都看我几眼。今天才晓得他们的眼光，全同外面的那伙人一模一样。
A few days ago, the tenants of Langzi Village came to report the famine and told my eldest brother that a big villain in their village had killed everyone; A few people dug out his heart and liver, fried it in oil, and ate it, which could strengthen his courage. I interjected, and the tenant and the eldest brother looked at me a few times. Only today did I know that their vision was exactly the same as the group outside.想起来，我从顶上直冷到脚跟。
Thinking about it, I was cold from top to heel.他们会吃人，就未必不会吃我。
They can eat people, so they may not eat me.你看那女人“咬你几口”的话，和一伙青面獠牙人的笑，和前天佃户的话，明明是暗号。我看出他话中全是毒，笑中全是刀。他们的牙齿，全是白厉厉的排着，这就是吃人的家伙。
Look at the woman's words of "biting you a few times", the smiles of a group of green-faced fanged people, and the words of the tenants the day before yesterday, they are obviously codes. I could see that his words were full of poison and his smile was full of knives. Their teeth are all lined up, this is the cannibal guy.照我自己想，虽然不是恶人，自从踹了古家的簿子，可就难说了。他们似乎别有心思，我全猜不出。况且他们一翻脸，便说人是恶人。我还记得大哥教我做论，无论怎样好人，翻他几句，他便打上几个圈；原谅坏人几句，他便说“翻天妙手，与众不同”。我那里猜得到他们的心思，究竟怎样；况且是要吃的时候。
In my own opinion, although he is not a villain, it is difficult to say since he kicked the ancient family's book. They seem to have other thoughts, I can't guess at all. Moreover, as soon as they turn their faces, they say that people are evil. I still remember that my eldest brother taught me to make a theory, no matter how good a person is, he will make a few circles after reading a few sentences from him; Forgive the bad guy for a few words, and he said, "It's a great way to turn the world around, and it's different." I can guess what their minds are doing; Besides, it's time to eat.凡事总须研究，才会明白。古来时常吃人，我也还记得，可是不甚清楚。我翻开历史一查，这历史没有年代，歪歪斜斜的每叶上都写着“仁义道德”几个字。我横竖睡不着，仔细看了半夜，才从字缝里看出字来，满本都写着两个字是“吃人”！
Everything must be studied to understand. Since ancient times, people have often been eaten, and I still remember it, but I don't know very well. I opened the history and found that this history has no age, and the words "benevolence, righteousness and morality" are written on each crooked leaf. I couldn't sleep horizontally and vertically, and after looking carefully in the middle of the night, I saw the words from the cracks, and the whole book was written with two words "cannibalism"!书上写着这许多字，佃户说了这许多话，却都笑吟吟的睁着怪眼睛看我。
There were so many words written in the book, and the tenants said so many words, but they all looked at me with strange eyes open with a smile.我也是人，他们想要吃我了！
I'm also human, and they want to eat me!

狂人日记

四

狂人日记

Four早上，我静坐了一会。陈老五送进饭来，一碗菜，一碗蒸鱼；这鱼的眼睛，白而且硬，张着嘴，同那一伙想吃人的人一样。吃了几筷，滑溜溜的不知是鱼是人，便把他兜肚连肠的吐出。
In the morning, I sat quietly for a while. Chen Laowu sent in rice, a bowl of vegetables, a bowl of steamed fish; The eyes of this fish are white and hard, and their mouths are open, just like the group of people who want to eat people. After eating a few chopsticks, he didn't know if it was a fish or a person, so he spit it out with his stomach and intestines.我说“老五，对大哥说，我闷得慌，想到园里走走。”老五不答应，走了；停一会，可就来开了门。
I said, "Fifth child, tell the eldest brother, I was so bored that I wanted to walk in the garden." The fifth child did not agree and left; After stopping for a while, he came to open the door.我也不动，研究他们如何摆布我；知道他们一定不肯放松。果然！我大哥引了一个老头子，慢慢走来；他满眼凶光，怕我看出，只是低头向着地，从眼镜横边暗暗看我。大哥说，“今天你仿佛很好。”我说“是的。”大哥说，“今天请何先生来，给你诊一诊。”我说“可以！”其实我岂不知道这老头子是刽子手扮的！无非借了看脉这名目，揣一揣肥瘠：因这功劳，也分一片肉吃。我也不怕；虽然不吃人，胆子却比他们还壮。伸出两个拳头，看他如何下手。老头子坐着，闭了眼睛，摸了好一会，呆了好一会；便张开他鬼眼睛说，“不要乱想。静静的养几天，就好了。”
I don't move, studying how they manipulate me; Knowing that they must not relax. Really! My eldest brother led an old man and walked slowly; His eyes were full of fierce light, afraid that I would see it, so he just lowered his head to the ground and secretly looked at me from the side of his glasses. The eldest brother said, "You seem to be very good today." I said, "Yes." The eldest brother said, "Please invite Mr. He to come today and give you a diagnosis." I said, "Yes!" "Actually, I don't know that this old man is dressed as an executioner! It is nothing more than borrowing the name of looking at the pulse to take a look at the fat: because of this credit, I also share a piece of meat to eat. I'm not afraid; Although they don't eat people, they are stronger than them. Stretch out two fists to see how he starts. The old man sat down, closed his eyes, touched for a while, and stayed for a while; Then he opened his ghost eyes and said, "Don't think about it." Just keep it quietly for a few days. ”不要乱想，静静的养！养肥了，他们是自然可以多吃；我有什么好处，怎么会“好了”？他们这群人，又想吃人，又是鬼鬼祟祟，想法子遮掩，不敢直捷下手，真要令我笑死。我忍不住，便放声大笑起来，十分快活。自己晓得这笑声里面，有的是义勇和正气。老头子和大哥，都失了色，被我这勇气正气镇压住了。
Don't think about it, raise it quietly! After fattening, they can naturally eat more; What good is it for me, how can it be "good"? Their group of people, who want to eat people, are sneaky, and don't dare to attack directly, which really makes me laugh to death. I couldn't help it, so I laughed out loud, very happy. I know that in this laughter, there is righteousness and righteousness. The old man and the eldest brother were both pale and suppressed by my courage and righteousness.但是我有勇气，他们便越想吃我，沾光一点这勇气。老头子跨出门，走不多远，便低声对大哥说道，“赶紧吃罢！”大哥点点头。原来也有你！这一件大发见，虽似意外，也在意中：合伙吃我的人，便是我的哥哥！
But I have the courage, and the more they want to eat me, the more they will stain this courage. The old man stepped out the door and didn't go far, so he whispered to the eldest brother, "Hurry up and eat!" The eldest brother nodded. So you too! This big discovery, although it seems to be an accident, is also in mind: the person who partners in eating me is my brother!吃人的是我哥哥！
It's my brother who cannibalizes people!我是吃人的人的兄弟！
I am the brother of the cannibal!我自己被人吃了，可仍然是吃人的人的兄弟！
I myself was eaten, but I am still the brother of the cannibal!

狂人日记

五

狂人日记

Five这几天是退一步想：假使那老头子不是刽子手扮的，真是医生，也仍然是吃人的人。他们的祖师李时珍做的“本草什么”上，明明写着人肉可以煎吃；他还能说自己不吃人么？
These days, I took a step back and thought: if the old man was not an executioner, he was really a doctor, and he was still a cannibal. On the "Materia Medica" made by their ancestor Li Shizhen, it is clearly written that human flesh can be fried; Can he still say that he doesn't eat people?至于我家大哥，也毫不冤枉他。他对我讲书的时候，亲口说过可以“易子而食”；又一回偶然议论起一个不好的人，他便说不但该杀，还当“食肉寝皮”。我那时年纪还小，心跳了好半天。前天狼子村佃户来说吃心肝的事，他也毫不奇怪，不住的点头。可见心思是同从前一样狠。既然可以“易子而食”，便什么都易得，什么人都吃得。我从前单听他讲道理，也胡涂过去；现在晓得他讲道理的时候，不但唇边还抹着人油，而且心里满装着吃人的意思。
As for my eldest brother, he did not wrongfully accuse him. When he told me, he personally said that he could "change his son and eat"; Another time he accidentally talked about a bad person, he said that he should not only be killed, but also "eat meat and sleep". I was still young at the time, and my heart beat for a long time. The tenants of Tianlangzi Village said that he was not surprised and nodded incessantly. It can be seen that the mind is as ruthless as before. Since it is possible to "change the child and eat", everything is easy to get and anyone can eat. I used to listen to him reason, and I also scribbled it up; Now I know that when he is reasoning, not only does he have human oil on his lips, but his heart is full of cannibalism.

六

狂人日记

Six黑漆漆的，不知是日是夜。赵家的狗又叫起来了。
It was pitch black, and I didn't know if it was day or night. The Zhao family's dog barked again.狮子似的凶心，兔子的怯弱，狐狸的狡猾，……
The fierceness of a lion, the cowardice of a rabbit, and the cunning of a fox,......

狂人日记

七

狂人日记

Seven我晓得他们的方法，直捷杀了，是不肯的，而且也不敢，怕有祸祟。所以他们大家连络，布满了罗网，逼我自戕。试看前几天街上男女的样子，和这几天我大哥的作为，便足可悟出八九分了。最好是解下腰带，挂在梁上，自己紧紧勒死；他们没有杀人的罪名，又偿了心愿，自然都欢天喜地的发出一种呜呜咽咽的笑声。否则惊吓忧愁死了，虽则略瘦，也还可以首肯几下。
I know their method, Zhijie killed, but he refused, and he didn't dare, for fear of disaster. So they all connected, covered with nets, and forced me to kill myself. Just look at the appearance of men and women on the street a few days ago, and what my eldest brother has done in the past few days, and you can realize eight or nine points. It is best to untie the belt, hang it on the beam, and strangle it tightly; They were not charged with murder, and they fulfilled their wishes, so naturally they all let out a whimpering laugh with joy. Otherwise, I will die of fright and sorrow, and although I am slightly thinner, I can still agree a few times.他们是只会吃死肉的！——记得什么书上说，有一种东西，叫“海乙那”的，眼光和样子都很难看；时常吃死肉，连极大的骨头，都细细嚼烂，咽下肚子去，想起来也教人害怕。“海乙那”是狼的亲眷，狼是狗的本家。前天赵家的狗，看我几眼，可见他也同谋，早已接洽。老头子眼看着地，岂能瞒得我过。
They will only eat dead meat! ——I remember what book said that there was a thing called "Hai Yina", which was ugly in terms of vision and appearance; He often eats dead meat, even the very large bones, chews them carefully, swallows them, and is scared when he thinks about them. "Hai Yina" is the wolf's relative, and the wolf is the dog's home. The day before yesterday, the Zhao family's dog looked at me a few times, and it showed that he was also complicit and had already contacted me. The old man looked at the ground, how could he hide it from me.最可怜的是我的大哥，他也是人，何以毫不害怕；而且合伙吃我呢？还是历来惯了，不以为非呢？还是丧了良心，明知故犯呢？
The most pitiful thing is my eldest brother, he is also a human being, why is he not afraid; And what about partnering to eat me? Or have you always been used to it and don't think it's wrong? Or do you lose your conscience and commit it knowingly?我诅咒吃人的人，先从他起头；要劝转吃人的人，也先从他下手。
I curse the cannibals, starting with him; If you want to persuade the cannibal, you should also start with him first.

狂人日记

八

狂人日记

Eight其实这种道理，到了现在，他们也该早已懂得，……
In fact, by now, they should have understood this truth,......忽然来了一个人；年纪不过二十左右，相貌是不很看得清楚，满面笑容，对了我点头，他的笑也不像真笑。我便问他，“吃人的事，对么？”他仍然笑着说，“不是荒年，怎么会吃人。”我立刻就晓得，他也是一伙，喜欢吃人的；便自勇气百倍，偏要问他。
Suddenly a person came; He is only about twenty years old, his appearance is not very clear, his face is full of smiles, and he nodded to me, and his smile didn't look like a real smile. I asked him, "Cannibalism, right?" He still smiled and said, "It's not a famine year, how can you eat people." "I knew at once that he was also a gang and liked to eat people; I was a hundred times more courageous, but I wanted to ask him.“对么？”
"Right?"“这等事问他什么。你真会……说笑话。……今天天气很好。”
"What do you ask him about this? You really ...... Tell jokes. …… The weather is good today. ”天气是好，月色也很亮了。可是我要问你，“对么？”
The weather is good and the moonlight is bright. But I want to ask you, "Right? ”他不以为然了。含含胡胡的答道，“不……”
He didn't think so. replied with a hint, "No......"“不对？他们何以竟吃？！”
"Isn't it? Why do they eat it?! ”“没有的事……”
"Nothing......"“没有的事？狼子村现吃；还有书上都写着，通红斩新！”
"Nothing? Wolf Village eats now; There are also books that say that it is red and new! ”他便变了脸，铁一般青。睁着眼说，“有许有的，这是从来如此……”
His face changed, as blue as iron. He opened his eyes and said, "Yes, this has never been ......"“从来如此，便对么？”
"It's always been like this, right?"“我不同你讲这些道理；总之你不该说，你说便是你错！”
"I don't agree with you these things; In short, you shouldn't say it, it's your fault if you say it! ”我直跳起来，张开眼，这人便不见了。全身出了一大片汗。他的年纪，比我大哥小得远，居然也是一伙；这一定是他娘老子先教的。还怕已经教给他儿子了；所以连小孩子，也都恶狠狠的看我。
I jumped up, opened my eyes, and the man was gone. There was a lot of sweat all over his body. He is much younger than my eldest brother, and he is actually a gang; This must have been taught by his mother Lao Tzu first. I am afraid that I have already taught it to his son; So even the children looked at me viciously.

狂人日记

九

狂人日记

Nine自己想吃人，又怕被别人吃了，都用着疑心极深的眼光，面面相觑。……
They want to eat people, but they are afraid of being eaten by others, so they all look at each other with extremely suspicious eyes. ……去了这心思，放心做事走路吃饭睡觉，何等舒服。这只是一条门槛，一个关头。他们可是父子兄弟夫妇朋友师生仇敌和各不相识的人，都结成一伙，互相劝勉，互相牵掣，死也不肯跨过这一步。
Go to this mind, rest assured to do things, walk, eat and sleep, how comfortable. It's just a threshold, a juncture. They are fathers, sons, brothers, husbands and wives, friends, teachers, students, enemies, and strangers, all of whom form a group, exhort each other, pull each other, and refuse to take this step even if they die.

Ten大清早，去寻我大哥；他立在堂门外看天，我便走到他背后，拦住门，格外沉静，格外和气的对他说，
early in the morning, go find my eldest brother; He stood outside the hall door looking at the sky, so I walked behind him, stopped the door, and said to him very quietly and kindly,“大哥，我有话告诉你。”
"Big brother, I have something to tell you."“你说就是，”他赶紧回过脸来，点点头。
"You said so," he quickly turned his face around and nodded.“我只有几句话，可是说不出来。大哥，大约当初野蛮的人，都吃过一点人。后来因为心思不同，有的不吃人了，一味要好，便变了人，变了真的人。有的却还吃，——也同虫子一样，有的变了鱼鸟猴子，一直变到人。有的不要好，至今还是虫子。这吃人的人比不吃人的人，何等惭愧。怕比虫子的惭愧猴子，还差得很远很远。
I only have a few words, but I can't say it. Big brother, about the barbaric people at the beginning, have eaten a little people. Later, because of different minds, some stopped eating people, and blindly wanted to be good, so they changed into people and real people. Some still eat ,—— are the same as insects, and some have changed into fish, birds and monkeys, all the way to people. Some are not good, they are still bugs. How ashamed this cannibal is compared to the non-cannibal. I'm afraid that the monkey is more ashamed than the bug, and it's far away.“易牙蒸了他儿子，给桀纣吃，还是一直从前的事。谁晓得从盘古开辟天地以后，一直吃到易牙的儿子；从易牙的儿子，一直吃到徐锡林；从徐锡林，又一直吃到狼子村捉住的人。去年城里杀了犯人，还有一个生痨病的人，用馒头蘸血舐。
Yi Ya steamed his son and gave it to Jie Zhou, which was still the same thing as before. Who knows that since Pangu opened up the world, he has been eating until Yi Ya's son; From Yi Ya's son, all the way to Xu Xilin; From Xu Xilin, he ate all the way to the people caught in Wolf Village. Last year, a prisoner was killed in the city, and there was a man with tuberculosis who dipped steamed buns in blood and licked them.“他们要吃我，你一个人，原也无法可想；然而又何必去入伙。吃人的人，什么事做不出；他们会吃我，也会吃你，一伙里面，也会自吃。但只要转一步，只要立刻改了，也就人人太平。虽然从来如此，我们今天也可以格外要好，说是不能！大哥，我相信你能说，前天佃户要减租，你说过不能。”
"They want to eat me, you alone, you can't imagine; However, why go to the team? Cannibals can't do anything; They will eat me, they will eat you, and they will eat themselves in a group. But as long as you take a step back, as long as you change it immediately, everyone will be peaceful. Although this has always been the case, we can also be extra good today, saying no! Big brother, I believe you can say that the tenant wanted to reduce the rent the day before yesterday, but you said no. ”当初，他还只是冷笑，随后眼光便凶狠起来，一到说破他们的隐情，那就满脸都变成青色了。大门外立着一伙人，赵贵翁和他的狗，也在里面，都探头探脑的挨进来。有的是看不出面貌，似乎用布蒙着；有的是仍旧青面獠牙，抿着嘴笑。我认识他们是一伙，都是吃人的人。可是也晓得他们心思很不一样，一种是以为从来如此，应该吃的；一种是知道不该吃，可是仍然要吃，又怕别人说破他，所以听了我的话，越发气愤不过，可是抿着嘴冷笑。
At first, he just sneered, and then his eyes became fierce, and when he revealed their secrets, his face turned blue. There was a group of people standing outside the gate, and Zhao Guiweng and his dog were also inside, all poking their heads in. some are invisible and seem to be covered with cloth; Some are still with blue faces and fangs, pursing their mouths and smiling. I know them as a gang, and they are all cannibals. But I also know that their minds are very different, one is to think that it has always been like this, and it should be eaten; One is that he knows he shouldn't eat, but he still wants to eat, and he is afraid that others will tell him out, so after listening to my words, he became more and more angry, but he pursed his lips and sneered.这时候，大哥也忽然显出凶相，高声喝道，
At this time, the eldest brother also suddenly showed a fierce appearance and shouted loudly,“都出去！疯子有什么好看！”
"Get out! What's so good about a madman! ”这时候，我又懂得一件他们的巧妙了。他们岂但不肯改，而且早已布置；预备下一个疯子的名目罩上我。将来吃了，不但太平无事，怕还会有人见情。佃户说的大家吃了一个恶人，正是这方法。这是他们的老谱！
At this time, I understood one of their ingenuity again. Not only do they refuse to change, but they have already arranged it; Prepare the name of the next madman to cover me. If you eat it in the future, not only will it be peaceful, but you may also be in love. The tenant said that everyone ate a wicked person, and this is exactly the method. This is their old score!陈老五也气愤愤的直走进来。如何按得住我的口，我偏要对这伙人说，
Chen Laowu also walked in angrily. How to hold my mouth, I want to say to this group,“你们可以改了，从真心改起！要晓得将来容不得吃人的人，活在世上。
"You can change, start from the heart! We must know that in the future, cannibals will not be allowed to live in the world.“你们要不改，自己也会吃尽。即使生得多，也会给真的人除灭了，同猎人打完狼子一样！——同虫子一样！”
"If you don't change, you will eat it all. Even if you give birth to a lot, you will be exterminated by real people, just like a hunter who kills a wolf! - Like a bug! ”那一伙人，都被陈老五赶走了。大哥也不知那里去了。陈老五劝我回屋子里去。屋里面全是黑沉沉的。横梁和椽子都在头上发抖；抖了一会，就大起来，堆在我身上。
That group of people was all driven away by Chen Laowu. The eldest brother didn't know where he went. Chen Laowu persuaded me to go back to the house. The inside of the house was all dark. The beams and rafters tremble on their heads; After shaking for a while, it grew big and piled up on me.万分沉重，动弹不得；他的意思是要我死。我晓得他的沉重是假的，便挣扎出来，出了一身汗。可是偏要说，
extremely heavy and unable to move; He meant to die. I knew that his heaviness was fake, so I struggled out and sweated. But I want to say,“你们立刻改了，从真心改起！你们要晓得将来是容不得吃人的人，……”
"You changed immediately, from the bottom of your heart! You must know that in the future you will not tolerate cannibalism,......"

狂人日记

Eleven太阳也不出，门也不开，日日是两顿饭。
The sun doesn't come out, the door doesn't open, and it's two meals a day.我捏起筷子，便想起我大哥；晓得妹子死掉的缘故，也全在他。那时我妹子才五岁，可爱可怜的样子，还在眼前。母亲哭个不住，他却劝母亲不要哭；大约因为自己吃了，哭起来不免有点过意不去。如果还能过意不去，……
I picked up my chopsticks and thought of my eldest brother; Knowing that the reason for the girl's death is all due to him. At that time, my sister was only five years old, and her cute and pitiful appearance was still in front of me. his mother couldn't stop crying, but he advised her not to cry; Probably because I ate it, I couldn't help but feel a little sorry when I cried. If you can still live without going,......妹子是被大哥吃了，母亲知道没有，我可不得而知。
The girl was eaten by her eldest brother, and my mother knew whether it was true, I don't know.母亲想也知道；不过哭的时候，却并没有说明，大约也以为应当的了。记得我四五岁时，坐在堂前乘凉，大哥说爷娘生病，做儿子的须割下一片肉来，煮熟了请他吃，才算好人；母亲也没有说不行。一片吃得，整个的自然也吃得。但是那天的哭法，现在想起来，实在还教人伤心，这真是奇极的事！
Mother wants to know; But when I cried, I didn't explain it, and I probably thought it was right. I remember when I was four or five years old, sitting in front of the hall to enjoy the shade, my eldest brother said that my grandparents were sick, and I had to cut off a piece of meat to be a son, and when it was cooked, I would treat him to eat, so that I could be considered a good person; My mother didn't say no. If you eat one piece, you can naturally eat the whole thing. But the way I cried that day, now that I think about it, it's really sad, which is really a strange thing!

twelve不能想了。

With 4,000 years of cannibalism, although I didn't know it at the beginning, I now understand that it is difficult to see real people!

孔乙己

孔乙己

孔乙己

Kong Yiji鲁镇的酒店的格局，是和别处不同的：都是当街一个曲尺形的大柜台，柜里面预备着热水，可以随时温酒。做工的人，傍午傍晚散了工，每每花四文铜钱，买一碗酒，——这是二十多年前的事，现在每碗要涨到十文，——靠柜外站着，热热的喝了休息；倘肯多花一文，便可以买一碟盐煮笋，或者茴香豆，做下酒物了，如果出到十几文，那就能买一样荤菜，但这些顾客，多是短衣帮，大抵没有这样阔绰。只有穿长衫的，才踱进店面隔壁的房子里，要酒要菜，慢慢地坐喝。
The layout of the hotel in Luzhen is different from other places: they are all large counters in the shape of a curved ruler on the street, and hot water is prepared in the cabinet, which can warm wine at any time. The worker, after working in the afternoon and evening, spent four copper coins to buy a bowl of wine,—— which was more than 20 years ago, and now each bowl has risen to ten cents,—— standing outside the cabinet, drinking hot and resting; If you are willing to spend a penny more, you can buy a plate of salt-boiled bamboo shoots, or fennel beans, and make wine, if you pay more than a dozen cents, then you can buy a meat dish, but these customers, most of them are short clothes, and they are probably not so generous. Only those wearing long gowns paced into the house next to the store, asked for wine and food, and sat down and drank slowly.我从十二岁起，便在镇口的咸亨酒店里当伙计，掌柜说，样子太傻，怕侍候不了长衫主顾，就在外面做点事罢。外面的短衣主顾，虽然容易说话，但唠唠叨叨缠夹不清的也很不少。他们往往要亲眼看着黄酒从坛子里舀出，看过壶子底里有水没有，又亲看将壶子放在热水里，然后放心：在这严重监督下，羼水也很为难。所以过了几天，掌柜又说我干不了这事。幸亏荐头的情面大，辞退不得，便改为专管温酒的一种无聊职务了。
Since I was twelve years old, I have been working as a clerk at the Xianheng Hotel in the town, and the shopkeeper said that he looked too stupid, and he was afraid that he would not be able to serve the patrons of the long gown, so he just did something outside. Although the short-clad patrons outside are easy to talk to, there are also a lot of nagging and entanglements. They often have to watch the rice wine scooped out of the jar, see if there is water at the bottom of the pot, and see if the pot is put in hot water, and then rest assured: under this serious supervision, the water is also very difficult. So a few days later, the shopkeeper said that I couldn't do this. Fortunately, the recommendation was so strong that he couldn't be dismissed, so he changed to a boring position in charge of warm wine.我从此便整天的站在柜台里，专管我的职务。虽然没有什么失职，但总觉得有些单调，有些无聊。掌柜是一副凶脸孔，主顾也没有好声气，教人活泼不得；只有孔乙己到店，才可以笑几声，所以至今还记得。
Since then, I have been standing at the counter all day long, in charge of my duties. Although there is no dereliction of duty, I always feel a little monotonous and boring. The shopkeeper has a fierce face, and the customer has no good voice, which makes people lively; Only when Kong Yiji arrived at the store could he laugh a few times, so he still remembers it.孔乙己是站着喝酒而穿长衫的唯一的人。他身材很高大；青白脸色，皱纹间时常夹些伤痕；一部乱蓬蓬的花白的胡子。穿的虽然是长衫，可是又脏又破，似乎十多年没有补，也没有洗。他对人说话，总是满口之乎者也，教人半懂不懂的。因为他姓孔，别人便从描红纸上的“上大人孔乙己”这半懂不懂的话里，替他取下一个绰号，叫作孔乙己。孔乙己一到店，所有喝酒的人便都看着他笑，有的叫道，“孔乙己，你脸上又添上新伤疤了！”他不回答，对柜里说，“温两碗酒，要一碟茴香豆。”便排出九文大钱。他们又故意的高声嚷道，“你一定又偷了人家的东西了！”孔乙己睁大眼睛说，“你怎么这样凭空污人清白……”“什么清白？我前天亲眼见你偷了何家的书，吊着打。”孔乙己便涨红了脸，额上的青筋条条绽出，争辩道，“窃书不能算偷……窃书！……读书人的事，能算偷么？”接连便是难懂的话，什么“君子固穷”，什么“者乎”之类，引得众人都哄笑起来：店内外充满了快活的空气。
Kong Yiji is the only person who stands and drinks and wears a long gown. He was very tall; pale face, often with some scars between wrinkles; A disheveled gray beard. Although he was wearing a long gown, it was dirty and torn, and it seemed that he had not been mended or washed for more than ten years. He speaks to people, always full of mouthfuls, teaching people who don't understand what they don't understand. Because his surname was Kong, others took a nickname for him from the half-incomprehensible words of "Master Kong Yiji" on the red paper, called Kong Yiji. As soon as Kong Yiji arrived at the store, everyone who drank looked at him and smiled, and some shouted, "Kong Yiji, you have a new scar on your face!" He didn't answer, and said to the cabinet, "Warm two bowls of wine and ask for a plate of fennel beans." Then he discharged nine cents of money. They deliberately shouted loudly, "You must have stolen something from someone else again!" Kong Yiji opened his eyes wide and said, "Why are you so innocent out of thin air...... "What innocence?" I saw with my own eyes the day before yesterday that you stole the He family's book and beat it up. Kong Yiji's face turned red, and the green veins on his forehead bloomed, and he argued, "Stealing books cannot be considered stealing...... Stealing books! …… Can the affairs of scholars be considered stealing? One after another, difficult words, such as "a gentleman is poor", "a gentleman", etc., caused everyone to laugh: the store was full of happy air inside and outside.听人家背地里谈论，孔乙己原来也读过书，但终于没有进学，又不会营生；于是愈过愈穷，弄到将要讨饭了。幸而写得一笔好字，便替人家钞钞书，换一碗饭吃。可惜他又有一样坏脾气，便是好喝懒做。坐不到几天，便连人和书籍纸张笔砚，一齐失踪。如是几次，叫他钞书的人也没有了。孔乙己没有法，便免不了偶然做些偷窃的事。但他在我们店里，品行却比别人都好，就是从不拖欠；虽然间或没有现钱，暂时记在粉板上，但不出一月，定然还清，从粉板上拭去了孔乙己的名字。
Listening to people talking behind their backs, Kong Yiji had also studied, but in the end he did not go to school, and he would not make a living; So I got poorer and poorer, and I was about to beg for food. Fortunately, if you write a good word, you will exchange money for others and exchange it for a bowl of rice. It's a pity that he has another bad temper, that is, he is lazy to drink. After sitting for a few days, people disappeared along with books, paper, pens and inkstones. After doing this several times, there was no one to call him a banknote. Kong Yiji has no way, so he will inevitably do some stealing by chance. But in our store, his conduct is better than others, that is, he never defaults; Although there was no cash from time to time, it was temporarily recorded on the powder board, but within a month, it was definitely paid off, and Kong Yiji's name was wiped off the powder board.孔乙己喝过半碗酒，涨红的脸色渐渐复了原，旁人便又问道，“孔乙己，你当真认识字么？”孔乙己看着问他的人，显出不屑置辩的神气。他们便接着说道，“你怎的连半个秀才也捞不到呢？”孔乙己立刻显出颓唐不安模样，脸上笼上了一层灰色，嘴里说些话；这回可是全是之乎者也之类，一些不懂了。在这时候，众人也都哄笑起来：店内外充满了快活的空气。
Kong Yiji drank half a bowl of wine, and his flushed face gradually returned to its original state, and others asked again, "Kong Yiji, do you really know words?" Kong Yiji looked at the person who asked him, showing a look of disdain. They continued, "Why can't you even get half a scholar?" Kong Yiji immediately showed a decadent and uneasy appearance, his face was covered with a layer of gray, and he said something in his mouth; This time it's all about the like, some don't understand. At this time, everyone also burst into laughter: the store was filled with a happy atmosphere inside and outside.在这些时候，我可以附和着笑，掌柜是决不责备的。而且掌柜见了孔乙己，也每每这样问他，引人发笑。孔乙己自己知道不能和他们谈天，便只好向孩子说话。有一回对我说道，“你读过书么？”我略略点一点头。他说，“读过书，……我便考你一考。茴香豆的茴字，怎样写的？”我想，讨饭一样的人，也配考我么？便回过脸去，不再理会。孔乙己等了许久，很恳切的说道，“不能写罢？……我教给你，记着！这些字应该记着。将来做掌柜的时候，写账要用。”我暗想我和掌柜的等级还很远呢，而且我们掌柜也从不将茴香豆上账；又好笑，又不耐烦，懒懒的答他道，“谁要你教，不是草头底下一个来回的回字么？”孔乙己显出极高兴的样子，将两个指头的长指甲敲着柜台，点头说，“对呀对呀！……回字有四样写法，你知道么？”我愈不耐烦了，努着嘴走远。孔乙己刚用指甲蘸了酒，想在柜上写字，见我毫不热心，便又叹一口气，显出极惋惜的样子。
At these times, I can echo and laugh, and the shopkeeper will never blame. And when the shopkeeper saw Kong Yiji, he often asked him like this, which made people laugh. Kong Yiji knew that he couldn't talk to them, so he had to talk to the children. Once he said to me, "Have you ever read a book? I nodded slightly. He said, "I have read books,...... I'll test you. How is the word fennel written for fennel beans? "I think, is a person like begging for food worthy of me? Then he turned his face and ignored it. Kong Yiji waited for a long time and said very earnestly, "Can't write?" …… I'll teach you, remember! These words should be remembered. When you become a shopkeeper in the future, you need to use it for accounting. "I thought to myself that I was still far from the shopkeeper's level, and our shopkeeper never listed fennel beans on the account; Funny and impatient, he replied lazily, "Who wants you to teach, isn't it a back-and-forth reply under the grass?" Kong Yiji looked extremely happy, knocked the long nails of his two fingers on the counter, nodded and said, "Yes, yes! …… There are four ways to write the word "reply", do you know? I became more and more impatient, and walked away with my mouth open. Kong Yiji had just dipped his fingernails in wine and wanted to write on the cabinet, but when he saw that I was not enthusiastic, he sighed again, showing a very regretful look.有几回，邻居孩子听得笑声，也赶热闹，围住了孔乙己。他便给他们茴香豆吃，一人一颗。孩子吃完豆，仍然不散，眼睛都望着碟子。孔乙己着了慌，伸开五指将碟子罩住，弯腰下去说道，“不多了，我已经不多了。”直起身又看一看豆，自己摇头说，“不多不多！多乎哉？不多也。”于是这一群孩子都在笑声里走散了。
A few times, the neighbor's children heard the laughter and rushed to the excitement and surrounded Kong Yiji. He gave them fennel beans to eat, one for each person. After the child finished eating the beans, he still didn't disperse, his eyes were looking at the plate. Kong Yiji panicked, stretched out his five fingers to cover the plate, bent down and said, "Not much, I don't have much left." He straightened up and looked at the beans again, shook his head and said, "No more, no more!" Is it too much? Not much. So the group of children was separated in laughter.孔乙己是这样的使人快活，可是没有他，别人也便这么过。

一件小事

一件小事

一件小事

A small thing我从乡下跑到京城里，一转眼已经六年了。其间耳闻目睹的所谓国家大事，算起来也很不少；但在我心里，都不留什么痕迹，倘要我寻出这些事的影响来说，便只是增长了我的坏脾气，——老实说，便是教我一天比一天的看不起人。
It has been six years since I ran from the countryside to the capital in the blink of an eye. During this period, I heard and witnessed a lot of so-called national events; But in my heart, there is no trace left, if I find the impact of these things, it will only increase my bad temper,—— to be honest, it is to teach me to look down on people day by day.但有一件小事，却于我有意义，将我从坏脾气里拖开，使我至今忘记不得。
But there was one small thing that meant something to me, dragged me away from my bad temper, and I still can't forget it.这是民国六年的冬天，大北风刮得正猛，我因为生计关系，不得不一早在路上走。一路几乎遇不见人，好容易才雇定了一辆人力车，教他拉到S门去。不一会，北风小了，路上浮尘早已刮净，剩下一条洁白的大道来，车夫也跑得更快。刚近S门，忽而车把上带着一个人，慢慢地倒了。
This is the winter of the sixth year of the Republic of China, the north wind is blowing fiercely, and I have to walk on the road early in the morning because of my livelihood. I almost didn't meet anyone along the way, so I hired a rickshaw and taught him to pull to the S door. After a while, the north wind was light, the dust on the road had already been blown away, and there was only a white avenue left, and the coachman ran faster. Just as I approached the S door, suddenly there was a person on the handlebar, and it slowly fell.跌倒的是一个女人，花白头发，衣服都很破烂。伊从马路边上突然向车前横截过来；车夫已经让开道，但伊的破棉背心没有上扣，微风吹着，向外展开，所以终于兜着车把。幸而车夫早有点停步，否则伊定要栽一个大斗，跌到头破血出了。
The one who fell was a woman with gray hair and tattered clothes. Yi suddenly crossed the road from the side of the road in front of the car; The coachman had already given way, but Yi's tattered cotton vest was not buttoned up, and the breeze was blowing, unfolding outward, so he finally put on the handlebars. Fortunately, the coachman had already stopped a little, otherwise Yi Ding would have planted a big bucket and fell to the point where he broke his head and bled.伊伏在地上；车夫便也立住脚。我料定这老女人并没有伤，又没有别人看见，便很怪他多事，要自己惹出是非，也误了我的路。
Ivo is on the ground; The coachman also stood still. I expected that this old woman was not injured, and no one else saw it, so I blamed him for being troublesome, wanting to cause trouble and misleading me.我便对他说，“没有什么的。走你的罢！”
I said to him, "Nothing." Let's go yours!" ”车夫毫不理会，——或者并没有听到，——却放下车子，扶那老女人慢慢起来，搀着臂膊立定，问伊说：
The coachman ignored ,—— or didn't hear it,—— but put down the car, helped the old woman to get up slowly, stood still with his arms crossed, and asked Yi:“您怎么啦？”
"What's wrong with you?"“我摔坏了。”
"I broke it."我想，我眼见你慢慢倒地，怎么会摔坏呢，装腔作势罢了，这真可憎恶。车夫多事，也正是自讨苦吃，现在你自己想法去。
I thought, I saw you slowly fall to the ground, how could it be broken, just pretending, this is really hateful. The coachman is troublesome, and he is asking for trouble, and now you think about it yourself.车夫听了这老女人的话，却毫不踌躇，仍然搀着伊的臂膊，便一步一步的向前走。我有些诧异，忙看前面，是一所巡警分驻所，大风之后，外面也不见人。这车夫扶着那老女人，便正是向那大门走去。
The coachman listened to the old woman's words, but did not hesitate, still held Yi's arm, and walked forward step by step. I was a little surprised, and I hurriedly looked ahead, it was a patrol police station, and after the strong wind, there was no one outside. The coachman helped the old woman and walked towards the gate.我这时突然感到一种异样的感觉，觉得他满身灰尘的后影，刹时高大了，而且愈走愈大，须仰视才见。而且他对于我，渐渐的又几乎变成一种威压，甚而至于要榨出皮袍下面藏着的“小”来。
At this time, I suddenly felt a strange feeling, feeling that his dusty shadow suddenly grew taller, and it got bigger and bigger, and I had to look up to see it. And he gradually became almost a kind of coercion towards me, even to the point of squeezing out the "small" hidden under the leather robe.我的活力这时大约有些凝滞了，坐着没有动，也没有想，直到看见分驻所里走出一个巡警，才下了车。
My vitality was about a little stagnant at this time, I sat without moving or thinking, until I saw a patrol officer walking out of the sub-station, and then I got out of the car.巡警走近我说，“你自己雇车罢，他不能拉你了。”
The patrol officer approached me and said, "You can hire a car yourself, he can't pull you anymore." ”我没有思索的从外套袋里抓出一大把铜元，交给巡警，说，“请你给他……”
Without thinking, I grabbed a large handful of copper dollars from my coat bag, handed it to the patrolman, and said, "Please give him ......."风全住了，路上还很静。我走着，一面想，几乎怕敢想到我自己。以前的事姑且搁起，这一大把铜元又是什么意思？奖他么？我还能裁判车夫么？我不能回答自己。
The wind has stopped, and the road is still very quiet. As I walked, I thought, almost afraid to think of myself. Putting aside the past, what does this big copper dollar mean? Reward him? Can I still judge the coachman? I can't answer myself.这事到了现在，还是时时记起。我因此也时时熬了苦痛，努力的要想到我自己。几年来的文治武力，在我早如幼小时候所读过的“子曰诗云”一般，背不上半句了。独有这一件小事，却总是浮在我眼前，有时反更分明，教我惭愧，催我自新，并且增长我的勇气和希望。
I still remember this incident from time to time. Because of this, I also endured pain from time to time, and I tried to think of myself. In the past few years, I have been able to memorize half a sentence, just like the "Ziyue Shiyun" I read when I was a child. This small thing is unique, but it always floats in front of my eyes, sometimes more clearly, teaches me shame, urges me to reform, and increases my courage and hope.一九二〇年七月。
July 1920.

头发的故事

头发的故事

头发的故事

The story of hair星期日的早晨，我揭去一张隔夜的日历，向着新的那一张上看了又看的说：
On Sunday morning, I took off an overnight calendar, looked at the new one again and again, and said:“阿，十月十日，——今天原来正是双十节。这里却一点没有记载！”
"Ah, October 10th,—— today turns out to be the Double Tenth Festival. There is no record here! ”我的一位前辈先生N，正走到我的寓里来谈闲天，一听这话，便很不高兴的对我说：
One of my senior gentlemen, Mr. N, was walking to my apartment to talk about leisure, and when he heard this, he said to me very unhappily:“他们对！他们不记得，你怎样他；你记得，又怎样呢？”
"They are right! They don't remember what you did to him; So what, you remember? ”这位N先生本来脾气有点乖张，时常生些无谓的气，说些不通世故的话。当这时候，我大抵任他自言自语，不赞一辞；他独自发完议论，也就算了。
This Mr. N was originally a bit perverse, often getting angry and saying things that didn't make sense. At this time, I mostly let him talk to himself and not say a word; He finished the discussion alone, and it was okay.他说：
He said:“我最佩服北京双十节的情形。早晨，警察到门，吩咐道‘挂旗！’‘是，挂旗！’各家大半懒洋洋的踱出一个国民来，撅起一块斑驳陆离的洋布。这样一直到夜，——收了旗关门；几家偶然忘却的，便挂到第二天的上午。
"I admire the situation of Beijing's Double Tenth Festival the most. In the morning, the police arrived at the door and ordered, 'Hang up the flag!' ''Yes, hang the flag!'' Most of the families lazily paced out a national, pouting up a mottled piece of foreign cloth. This continued until the night ,—— closed the flag; A few forgot by chance and hung it up until the next morning.“他们忘却了纪念，纪念也忘却了他们！
"They have forgotten the memorial, and the memorial has forgotten them!“我也是忘却了纪念的一个人。倘使纪念起来，那第一个双十节前后的事，便都上我的心头，使我坐立不稳了。
"I am also a person who has forgotten the commemoration. If I commemorate it, the events before and after the first Double Tenth Festival will come to my mind and make me uneasy.“多少故人的脸，都浮在我眼前。几个少年辛苦奔走了十多年，暗地里一颗弹丸要了他的性命；几个少年一击不中，在监牢里身受一个多月的苦刑；几个少年怀着远志，忽然踪影全无，连尸首也不知那里去了。——
"How many old faces are floating in front of my eyes. Several teenagers worked hard for more than ten years, and secretly a projectile killed him; Several teenagers missed a blow and suffered torture in prison for more than a month; A few young people had lofty ambitions, and suddenly there was no trace, and even the corpse did not know where it went. ——“他们都在社会的冷笑恶骂迫害倾陷里过了一生；现在他们的坟墓也早在忘却里渐渐平塌下去了。
"They all lived their lives in the sneering, persecution, and trap of society; Now their graves have gradually collapsed in oblivion.“我不堪纪念这些事。
"I can't bear to remember these things.“我们还是记起一点得意的事来谈谈罢。”
"Let's remember something proud to talk about."N忽然现出笑容，伸手在自己头上一摸，高声说：
N suddenly smiled, reached out and touched his head, and said loudly:“我最得意的是自从第一个双十节以后，我在路上走，不再被人笑骂了。
"What I am most proud of is that since the first Double Tenth Festival, I have been walking on the road and no longer being laughed at.“老兄，你可知道头发是我们中国人的宝贝和冤家，古今来多少人在这上头吃些毫无价值的苦呵！
"Dude, do you know that hair is the treasure and enemy of our Chinese, and how many people have suffered worthless suffering on it throughout history!“我们的很古的古人，对于头发似乎也还看轻。据刑法看来，最要紧的自然是脑袋，所以大辟是上刑；次要便是生殖器了，所以宫刑和幽闭也是一件吓人的罚；至于髡，那是微乎其微了，然而推想起来，正不知道曾有多少人们因为光着头皮便被社会践踏了一生世。
"Our very ancient people seem to take hair lightly. According to criminal law, the most important thing is naturally the head, so the death penalty is the punishment; the secondary is the genitals, so castration and confinement are also a terrifying punishment; As for the shaved head, it is very small, but when I think about it, I don't know how many people have been trampled by society for the rest of their lives because they are bare-scalped.“我们讲革命的时候，大谈什么扬州十日，嘉定屠城，其实也不过一种手段；老实说：那时中国人的反抗，何尝因为亡国，只是因为拖辫子。
"When we talk about the revolution, we talk about the ten days in Yangzhou and the massacre of Jiading, which is actually just a means; To be honest: At that time, the Chinese resistance was not because of the fall of the country, but only because of dragging braids.“顽民杀尽了，遗老都寿终了，辫子早留定了，洪杨又闹起来了。我的祖母曾对我说，那时做百姓才难哩，全留着头发的被官兵杀，还是辫子的便被长毛杀！
"The stubborn people have been killed, the old people have died, the braids have long been kept, and Hong Yang has made trouble again. My grandmother once told me that it was difficult to be a commoner at that time, and those with hair were killed by officers and soldiers, and those with braids were killed by long hair!“我不知道有多少中国人只因为这不痛不痒的头发而吃苦，受难，灭亡。”
"I don't know how many Chinese people have suffered, suffered, and perished just because of this painless hair."N两眼望着屋梁，似乎想些事，仍然说：
N looked at the beams, as if thinking about something, and still said:“谁知道头发的苦轮到我了。
"Who knows if it's my turn to suffer from hair.“我出去留学，便剪掉了辫子，这并没有别的奥妙，只为他不太便当罢了。不料有几位辫子盘在头顶上的同学们便很厌恶我；监督也大怒，说要停了我的官费，送回中国去。
"When I went out to study, I cut off my braids, which was not very mysterious, just because it was not convenient for him. Unexpectedly, a few students with braids coiled on top of their heads hated me; The supervisor was also furious, saying that he would stop my official fees and send me back to China.“不几天，这位监督却自己被人剪去辫子逃走了。去剪的人们里面，一个便是做《革命军》的邹容，这人也因此不能再留学，回到上海来，后来死在西牢里。你也早已忘却了罢？
A few days later, the supervisor was cut off and escaped. Among the people who went to cut it, one was Zou Rong, who did "Revolutionary Army", who could no longer study abroad, returned to Shanghai, and later died in the Western Prison. You have long forgotten?“过了几年，我的家景大不如前了，非谋点事做便要受饿，只得也回到中国来。我一到上海，便买定一条假辫子，那时是二元的市价，带着回家。我的母亲倒也不说什么，然而旁人一见面，便都首先研究这辫子，待到知道是假，就一声冷笑，将我拟为杀头的罪名；有一位本家，还预备去告官，但后来因为恐怕革命党的造反或者要成功，这才中止了。
"After a few years, my family situation was not as good as before, and I had to go hungry if I didn't do something, so I had to return to China. As soon as I arrived in Shanghai, I bought a fake braid, which was the market price of two yuan at that time, and took it home. My mother didn't say anything, but as soon as others met, they first studied the braid, and when they knew it was false, they sneered and accused me of beheading; There was a family member who was also ready to sue the officials, but later it was suspended because he was afraid that the revolutionary party would rebel or succeed.“我想，假的不如真的直截爽快，我便索性废了假辫子，穿着西装在街上走。
I thought that the fake was not as straightforward and refreshing as the real one, so I simply abandoned the fake braid and walked down the street in a suit.“一路走去，一路便是笑骂的声音，有的还跟在后面骂：‘这冒失鬼！’‘假洋鬼子！’
"All the way, there were laughter and scolding all the way, and some followed behind and scolded: 'This daredevil!' 'Fake foreign devil! ’“我于是不穿洋服了，改了大衫，他们骂得更利害。
"So I stopped wearing clothes and changed to big shirts, and they scolded even more.“在这日暮途穷的时候，我的手里才添出一支手杖来，拚命的打了几回，他们渐渐的不骂了。只是走到没有打过的生地方还是骂。
"At the end of this day, I only added a cane to my hand, and after beating it desperately a few times, they gradually stopped scolding. Just go to a raw place where you haven't been beaten or scold.“这件事很使我悲哀，至今还时时记得哩。我在留学的时候，曾经看见日报上登载一个游历南洋和中国的本多博士的事；这位博士是不懂中国和马来语的，人问他，你不懂话，怎么走路呢？他拿起手杖来说，这便是他们的话，他们都懂！我因此气愤了好几天，谁知道我竟不知不觉的自己也做了，而且那些人都懂了。……
"This incident made me very sad, and I still remember it from time to time. When I was studying abroad, I once saw a story in the daily newspaper about Dr. Hondo, who traveled to Nanyang and China; This doctor doesn't understand Chinese and Malay, and people ask him, how do you walk if you don't understand the language? He picked up his cane and said, these are their words, they all understand! I was angry for several days, but who knew that I did it myself without realizing it, and those people understood. ……“宣统初年，我在本地的中学校做监学，同事是避之惟恐不远，官僚是防之惟恐不严，我终日如坐在冰窖子里，如站在刑场旁边，其实并非别的，只因为缺少了一条辫子！
"In the early years of Xuantong, I was working as a supervisor in a local middle school, my colleagues were afraid that they would not be far away, and the bureaucrats were afraid of being lax in their defenses.“有一日，几个学生忽然走到我的房里来，说，‘先生，我们要剪辫子了。’我说，‘不行！’‘有辫子好呢，没有辫子好呢？’‘没有辫子好……’‘你怎么说不行呢？’‘犯不上，你们还是不剪上算，——等一等罢。’他们不说什么，撅着嘴唇走出房去；然而终于剪掉了。
"One day, a few students suddenly came into my room and said, 'Sir, we're going to cut our braids.' I said, 'No! ''What about having braids, but not having braids? ''It's good to have no braids......' ''How can you say no?'' ''If you can't commit it, you still don't cut it,—— just wait a minute. They said nothing, and went out of the room with their lips pursed; However, it was finally cut off.“呵！不得了了，人言啧啧了；我却只装作不知道，一任他们光着头皮，和许多辫子一齐上讲堂。
"Huh! It's amazing, people are talking; I just pretended not to know, and let them go to the lecture hall with many braids with their bare scalps.“然而这剪辫病传染了；第三天，师范学堂的学生忽然也剪下了六条辫子，晚上便开除了六个学生。这六个人，留校不能，回家不得，一直挨到第一个双十节之后又一个多月，才消去了犯罪的火烙印。
"But this braiding disease is contagious; On the third day, the students of the normal school suddenly cut off six braids, and six students were expelled in the evening. These six people could not stay in school or go home, and they suffered until more than a month after the first Double Tenth Festival, before erasing the fire brand of crime.“我呢？也一样，只是元年冬天到北京，还被人骂过几次，后来骂我的人也被警察剪去了辫子，我就不再被人辱骂了；但我没有到乡间去。”
"What about me? It's the same, it's just that when I went to Beijing in the winter of the first year, I was scolded a few times, and the person who scolded me later was also cut off by the police, so I was no longer insulted; But I didn't go to the countryside. ”N显出非常得意模样，忽而又沉下脸来：
N looked very proud, and suddenly sank his face again:“现在你们这些理想家，又在那里嚷什么女子剪发了，又要造出许多毫无所得而痛苦的人！
"Now you idealists, what kind of women are there to cut their hair, and you want to create many people who suffer without gaining!“现在不是已经有剪掉头发的女人，因此考不进学校去，或者被学校除了名么？
"Aren't there women who have cut their hair now, so they can't get into school, or are they removed from school?“改革么，武器在那里？工读么，工厂在那里？
"Reform, where are the weapons? Is it work-study, where is the factory?“仍然留起，嫁给人家做媳妇去：忘却了一切还是幸福，倘使伊记着些平等自由的话，便要苦痛一生世！
"Still keep it, marry someone else as a daughter-in-law: forget everything or be happy, if you remember some equality and freedom, you will suffer for the rest of your life!“我要借了阿尔志跋绥夫的话问你们：你们将黄金时代的出现豫约给这些人们的子孙了，但有什么给这些人们自己呢？
"I would like to borrow the words of Alzhiba Suifu to ask you: You have made a promise for the emergence of the Golden Age to the descendants of these people, but what do you give to these people themselves?“阿，造物的皮鞭没有到中国的脊梁上时，中国便永远是这一样的中国，决不肯自己改变一支毫毛！
"Ah, when the leather whip of creation does not reach the backbone of China, China will always be the same China, and it will never change a single hair by itself!“你们的嘴里既然并无毒牙，何以偏要在额上帖起‘蝮蛇’两个大字，引乞丐来打杀？……”
"Since you don't have poisonous fangs in your mouths, why do you want to put the word 'viper' on your forehead and lure beggars to kill you? ……”N愈说愈离奇了，但一见到我不很愿听的神情，便立刻闭了口，站起来取帽子。
The more N said, the more bizarre it became, but as soon as he saw my unwillingness to listen, he immediately closed his mouth and stood up to take his hat.我说，“回去么？”
I said, "Go back?" ”他答道，“是的，天要下雨了。”
He replied, "Yes, it's going to rain." ”我默默的送他到门口。
I silently sent him to the door.他戴上帽子说：
He put on his hat and said:“再见！请你恕我打搅，好在明天便不是双十节，我们统可以忘却了。”
"Goodbye! Please forgive me for disturbing me, but fortunately, tomorrow is not the Double Tenth Festival, and we can all forget about it. ”一九二〇年十月。
October 1920.

风波

风波

风波

Storm临河的土场上，太阳渐渐的收了他通黄的光线了。场边靠河的乌桕树叶，干巴巴的才喘过气来，几个花脚蚊子在下面哼着飞舞。面河的农家的烟突里，逐渐减少了炊烟，女人孩子们都在自己门口的土场上泼些水，放下小桌子和矮凳；人知道，这已经是晚饭的时候了。
On the earthen field near the river, the sun gradually took away his yellow light. The leaves of the black trees near the river on the sidelines were dry before they caught their breath, and a few flower-footed mosquitoes hummed and flew below. In the chimneys of the farmhouses facing the river, the smoke gradually decreased, and the women and children splashed some water on the dirt field in front of their doors, put down small tables and low stools; People know that it is already time for dinner.老人男人坐在矮凳上，摇着大芭蕉扇闲谈，孩子飞也似的跑，或者蹲在乌桕树下赌玩石子。女人端出乌黑的蒸干菜和松花黄的米饭，热蓬蓬冒烟。河里驶过文人的酒船，文豪见了，大发诗兴，说，“无思无虑，这真是田家乐呵！”
The old man sat on a low stool, shaking a big banana fan and chatting, and the child ran as if he were flying, or squatted under the black tree to gamble and play with stones. The woman brought out black steamed dried vegetables and pine flower yellow rice, hot and smoking. The literati's wine boat sailed past the river, and the literary hero saw it, and he was very excited and said, "Thoughtless, this is really a rural family!" ”但文豪的话有些不合事实，就因为他们没有听到九斤老太的话。这时候，九斤老太正在大怒，拿破芭蕉扇敲着凳脚说：
But the literary master's words were a bit untrue, because they didn't hear the words of the old lady Jiujin. At this time, the old lady of Jiujin was furious, and took a banana fan and knocked on the foot of the stool and said:“我活到七十九岁了，活够了，不愿意眼见这些败家相，——还是死的好。立刻就要吃饭了，还吃炒豆子，吃穷了一家子！”
"I have lived to be seventy-nine years old, I have lived enough, and I don't want to see these prodigal figures,—— or it is better to die. I'm going to eat right away, and I also eat fried beans, and I eat a poor family! ”伊的曾孙女儿六斤捏着一把豆，正从对面跑来，见这情形，便直奔河边，藏在乌桕树后，伸出双丫角的小头，大声说，“这老不死的！”
Yi's great-granddaughter Liu Jin was holding a handful of beans and was running from the opposite side, and when she saw this situation, she went straight to the river, hid behind the black tree, stretched out her small head with two corners, and said loudly, "This old man is not dead!" ”九斤老太虽然高寿，耳朵却还不很聋，但也没有听到孩子的话，仍旧自己说，“这真是一代不如一代！”
Although the old lady of Jiujin lived a long life, her ears were not very deaf, but she did not hear the child's words, and still said to herself, "This is really not as good as a generation!" ”这村庄的习惯有点特别，女人生下孩子，多喜欢用秤称了轻重，便用斤数当作小名。九斤老太自从庆祝了五十大寿以后，便渐渐的变了不平家，常说伊年青的时候，天气没有现在这般热，豆子也没有现在这般硬：总之现在的时世是不对了。何况六斤比伊的曾祖，少了三斤，比伊父亲七斤，又少了一斤，这真是一条颠扑不破的实例。所以伊又用劲说，“这真是一代不如一代！”
The habits of this village are a bit special, women give birth to children, and they like to weigh them with scales, so they use the number of pounds as a nickname. Since the old lady Jiujin celebrated her 50th birthday, she has gradually changed into an unhappy family, often saying that when Yi was young, the weather was not as hot as it is now, and the beans were not as hard as they are now: in short, the current times are not right. What's more, six pounds is three pounds less than Yi's great-grandfather, and seven pounds less than Yi's father, and one pound less, this is really an unbreakable example. So Yi said vigorously, "This is really not as good as a generation!" ”伊的儿媳七斤嫂子正捧着饭篮走到桌边，便将饭篮在桌上一摔，愤愤的说，“你老人家又这么说了。六斤生下来的时候，不是六斤五两么？你家的秤又是私秤，加重称，十八两秤；用了准十六，我们的六斤该有七斤多哩。我想便是太公和公公，也不见得正是九斤八斤十足，用的秤也许是十四两……”
Yi's daughter-in-law, Qijin's sister-in-law, was walking to the table with a rice basket, so she threw the rice basket on the table and said indignantly, "Your old man said that again." When Liu Jin was born, wasn't it six pounds and five taels? Your scale is also a private scale, weighted scale, eighteen taels of scale; Using sixteen, our six pounds should be more than seven pounds. I think it's Taigong and father-in-law, and it's not necessarily nine pounds and eight pounds, and the scale used may be fourteen taels......"“一代不如一代！”
"A generation is not as good as a generation!"七斤嫂还没有答话，忽然看见七斤从小巷口转出，便移了方向，对他嚷道，“你这死尸怎么这时候才回来，死到那里去了！不管人家等着你开饭！”
Qijin's sister-in-law hadn't answered yet, and suddenly saw Qijin turning out of the alley, so she moved her direction and shouted to him, "Why did you come back at this time, and you died there!" No matter what people are waiting for you to eat! ”七斤虽然住在农村，却早有些飞黄腾达的意思。从他的祖父到他，三代不捏锄头柄了；他也照例的帮人撑着航船，每日一回，早晨从鲁镇进城，傍晚又回到鲁镇，因此很知道些时事：例如什么地方，雷公劈死了蜈蚣精；什么地方，闺女生了一个夜叉之类。他在村人里面，的确已经是一名出场人物了。但夏天吃饭不点灯，却还守着农家习惯，所以回家太迟，是该骂的。
Although Qijin lives in the countryside, he has already had some meaning of prosperity. From his grandfather to him, three generations have not pinched the handle of the hoe; He also helped people to support the ship as usual, once a day, from Luzhen in the morning to the city, and returned to Luzhen in the evening, so he knew some current affairs very well: for example, where the thunder god killed the centipede spirit; Where is the girl giving birth to a yaksha or something? He is indeed a character among the villagers. But in summer, they don't light up when eating, but they still keep the habits of farmers, so they go home too late, and they should be scolded.七斤一手捏着象牙嘴白铜斗六尺多长的湘妃竹烟管，低着头，慢慢地走来，坐在矮凳上。六斤也趁势溜出，坐在他身边，叫他爹爹。七斤没有应。
Qijin held the ivory-mouthed cupronickel bucket of Xiangfei bamboo pipe more than six feet long in one hand, lowered his head, walked slowly, and sat on a low stool. Liu Jin also took advantage of the situation to slip out, sat next to him, and called him Daddy. Seven pounds did not respond.“一代不如一代！”九斤老太说。
"A generation is not as good as a generation!" Mrs. Jiujin said.七斤慢慢地抬起头来，叹一口气说，“皇帝坐了龙庭了。”
Qijin slowly raised his head, sighed and said, "The emperor has sat in the dragon court." ”七斤嫂呆了一刻，忽而恍然大悟的道，“这可好了，这不是又要皇恩大赦了么！”
Qijin's sister-in-law was stunned for a moment, and suddenly realized, "This is good, isn't this going to be amnesty by the emperor again!" ”七斤又叹一口气，说，“我没有辫子。”
Qijin sighed again and said, "I don't have braids." ”“皇帝要辫子么？”
"Does the emperor want braids?"“皇帝要辫子。”
"The emperor wants braids."“你怎么知道呢？”七斤嫂有些着急，赶忙的问。
"How do you know?" Qijin's sister-in-law was a little anxious and hurriedly asked.“咸亨酒店里的人，都说要的。”

故乡

hometown我冒了严寒，回到相隔二千余里，别了二十余年的故乡去。
I braved the cold and returned to my hometown, which was more than 2,000 miles away, after more than 20 years.时候既然是深冬；渐近故乡时，天气又阴晦了，冷风吹进船舱中，呜呜的响，从篷隙向外一望，苍黄的天底下，远近横着几个萧索的荒村，没有一些活气。我的心禁不住悲凉起来了。
Since it is the depths of winter; As we approached our hometown, the weather was gloomy again, the cold wind blew into the cabin, whining, looking out from the gap in the canopy, under the pale sky, there were several desolate deserted villages near and far, and there was no vitality. My heart couldn't help but feel sad.阿！这不是我二十年来时时记得的故乡？

"There is nothing left in winter. This dried green beans are dried there at home, please ......我问问他的景况。他只是摇头。
I asked him how he was doing. He just shook his head.“非常难。第六个孩子也会帮忙了，却总是吃不够……又不太平……什么地方都要钱，没有定规……收成又坏。种出东西来，挑去卖，总要捐几回钱，折了本；不去卖，又只能烂掉……”
"It's very difficult. The sixth child will also help, but he always can't eat enough...... It's not peaceful...... Money is required everywhere, and there are no rules...... The harvest was also bad. When you grow something and pick it to sell, you always have to donate money several times and lose money; If you don't sell it, you can only rot......"他只是摇头；脸上虽然刻着许多皱纹，却全然不动，仿佛石像一般。他大约只是觉得苦，却又形容不出，沉默了片时，便拿起烟管来默默的吸烟了。
He just shook his head; Although there are many wrinkles engraved on his face, he is completely motionless, like a stone statue. He probably just felt bitter, but he couldn't describe it, and after a moment of silence, he picked up the pipe and smoked silently.母亲问他，知道他的家里事务忙，明天便得回去；又没有吃过午饭，便叫他自己到厨下炒饭吃去。
His mother asked him, knowing that he was busy with family affairs and had to go back tomorrow; He hadn't eaten lunch, so he asked him to go to the kitchen to eat fried rice.他出去了；母亲和我都叹息他的景况：多子，饥荒，苛税，兵，匪，官，绅，都苦得他像一个木偶人了。母亲对我说，凡是不必搬走的东西，尽可以送他，可以听他自己去拣择。
He went out; My mother and I both lamented his situation: many children, famine, harsh taxes, soldiers, bandits, officials, and gentry, all of whom suffered so much that he was like a puppet. My mother told me that anything that didn't have to be moved could be given to him, and he could choose for himself.下午，他拣好了几件东西：两条长桌，四个椅子，一副香炉和烛台，一杆抬秤。他又要所有的草灰（我们这里煮饭是烧稻草的，那灰，可以做沙地的肥料），待我们启程的时候，他用船来载去。
In the afternoon, he picked out a few things: two long tables, four chairs, a pair of incense burners and candlesticks, and a scale. He also asked for all the grass ash (we cook here by burning straw, and the ash can be used as fertilizer for the sand), and when we set off, he took it by boat.夜间，我们又谈些闲天，都是无关紧要的话；第二天早晨，他就领了水生回去了。
At night, we talk about some idle days, but they are all irrelevant words; The next morning, he took the water back.又过了九日，是我们启程的日期。闰土早晨便到了，水生没有同来，却只带着一个五岁的女儿管船只。我们终日很忙碌，再没有谈天的工夫。来客也不少，有送行的，有拿东西的，有送行兼拿东西的。待到傍晚我们上船的时候，这老屋里的所有破旧大小粗细东西，已经一扫而空了。
Nine days later, it was the date of our departure. The morning of the intercalary soil arrived, and the water did not come with him, but only took a five-year-old daughter to manage the boat. We were very busy all day long, and we didn't have time to talk anymore. There are also many guests, some see off, some take things, and some see off and take things. By the time we boarded the boat in the evening, all the dilapidated and thick things in the old house had been swept away.我们的船向前走，两岸的青山在黄昏中，都装成了深黛颜色，连着退向船后梢去。
Our boat moved forward, and the green mountains on both sides of the river were dressed in dark colors in the dusk, and they retreated to the back of the boat.宏儿和我靠着船窗，同看外面模糊的风景，他忽然问道：
Hong'er and I leaned against the boat window, looking at the blurry scenery outside, and he suddenly asked:“大伯！我们什么时候回来？”
"Uncle! When will we be back? ”“回来？你怎么还没有走就想回来了。”
"Come back? Why do you want to come back before you leave." ”“可是，水生约我到他家玩去咧……”他睁着大的黑眼睛，痴痴的想。
"But, Shui Shui asked me to go to his house to play......" He opened his big black eyes and thought foolishly.我和母亲也都有些惘然，于是又提起闰土来。母亲说，那豆腐西施的杨二嫂，自从我家收拾行李以来，本是每日必到的，前天伊在灰堆里，掏出十多个碗碟来，议论之后，便定说是闰土埋着的，他可以在运灰的时候，一齐搬回家里去；杨二嫂发见了这件事，自己很以为功，便拿了那狗气杀（这是我们这里养鸡的器具，木盘上面有着栅栏，内盛食料，鸡可以伸进颈子去啄，狗却不能，只能看着气死），飞也似的跑了，亏伊装着这么高底的小脚，竟跑得这样快。
My mother and I were also a little confused, so we brought up Runtu again. The day before yesterday, Yi took out more than ten dishes in the ash pile, and after discussing it, he decided that it was buried in the leap soil, and he could move it home together when transporting the ashes; Yang Ersao found out about this, and she thought it was a great achievement, so she took the dog to kill (this is the utensil we use to raise chickens here, there is a fence on the wooden plate, which contains food, and the chicken can reach into its neck to peck, but the dog can't, so it can only watch to death), and it ran away as if flying, but it was a pity that he had such a high-soled little foot, and he ran so fast.老屋离我愈远了；故乡的山水也都渐渐远离了我，但我却并不感到怎样的留恋。我只觉得我四面有看不见的高墙，将我隔成孤身，使我非常气闷；那西瓜地上的银项圈的小英雄的影像，我本来十分清楚，现在却忽地模糊了，又使我非常的悲哀。
The old house is getting farther away from me; The mountains and rivers of my hometown have gradually drifted away from me, but I don't feel any nostalgia. I only felt that I had invisible walls on all sides, separating me from myself and making me very depressed; I was very clear about the image of the little hero with a silver collar on the watermelon ground, but now it suddenly blurred, which made me very sad.母亲和宏儿都睡着了。
Mother and Hong'er fell asleep.我躺着，听船底潺潺的水声，知道我在走我的路。我想：我竟与闰土隔绝到这地步了，但我们的后辈还是一气，宏儿不是正在想念水生么。我希望他们不再像我，又大家隔膜起来……然而我又不愿意他们因为要一气，都如我的辛苦展转而生活，也不愿意他们都如闰土的辛苦麻木而生活，也不愿意都如别人的辛苦恣睢而生活。他们应该有新的生活，为我们所未经生活过的。
I lay down, listening to the murmuring water at the bottom of the boat, knowing that I was walking my way. I thought: I have been isolated from Runtu to this point, but our juniors are still in the same breath, isn't Hong'er missing Shui Shui. I hope they don't look like me anymore, and everyone is separated again...... However, I don't want them to live like my hard work because they want to be in one breath, nor do I want them to live like the hard work of the leap soil, nor do I want them to live like the hard work of others. They deserve a new life for what we have not lived.我想到希望，忽然害怕起来了。闰土要香炉和烛台的时候，我还暗地里笑他，以为他总是崇拜偶像，什么时候都不忘却。现在我所谓希望，不也是我自己手制的偶像么？只是他的愿望切近，我的愿望茫远罢了。
I thought of hope and suddenly became scared. When Runtu asked for an incense burner and a candlestick, I secretly laughed at him, thinking that he always worshipped idols and never forgot them. Isn't my so-called hope now also my own handmade idol? It's just that his wish is close, and my wish is far away.我在朦胧中，眼前展开一片海边碧绿的沙地来，上面深蓝的天空中挂着一轮金黄的圆月。我想：希望是本无所谓有，无所谓无的。这正如地上的路；其实地上本没有路，走的人多了，也便成了路。
In the haze, I saw a green sandy area on the beach, with a golden full moon hanging in the deep blue sky. I think: hope is indifferent, it doesn't matter if there is nothing. This is like the road on earth; In fact, there is no road on the ground, and if there are more people walking, it will become a road.一九二一年一月。
January 1921.
