Chapter 1 Preface我要给阿Q做正传，已经不止一两年了。但一面要做，一面又往回想，这足见我不是一个“立言”的人，因为从来不朽之笔，须传不朽之人，于是人以文传，文以人传——究竟谁靠谁传，渐渐的不甚了然起来，而终于归结到传阿Q，仿佛思想里有鬼似的。
I'm going to make a biography for Ah Q, and it's been more than a year or two. But while doing it, I think about it again, which shows that I am not a person who "makes a statement", because the immortal pen must be passed on to immortal people, so people pass it on with literature, and people pass it on by people - who relies on whom to pass on, gradually it becomes less clear, and finally it comes down to passing on Ah Q, as if there is a ghost in the mind.然而要做这一篇速朽的文章，才下笔，便感到万分的困难了。第一是文章的名目。孔子曰，“名不正则言不顺”。这原是应该极注意的。传的名目很繁多：列传，自传，内传，外传，别传，家传，小传……，而可惜都不合。“列传”么，这一篇并非和许多阔人排在“正史”里；“自传”么，我又并非就是阿Q。说是“外传”，“内传”在那里呢？倘用“内传”，阿Q又决不是神仙。“别传”呢，阿Q实在未曾有大总统上谕宣付国史馆立“本传”——虽说英国正史上并无“博徒列传”，而文豪迭更司也做过《博徒别传》这一部书，但文豪则可，在我辈却不可的。其次是“家传”，则我既不知与阿Q是否同宗，也未曾受他子孙的拜托；或“小传”，则阿Q又更无别的“大传”了。总而言之，这一篇也便是“本传”，但从我的文章着想，因为文体卑下，是“引车卖浆者流”所用的话，所以不敢僭称，便从不入三教九流的小说家所谓“闲话休题言归正传”这一句套话里，取出“正传”两个字来，作为名目，即使与古人所撰《书法正传》的“正传”字面上很相混，也顾不得了。
However, it is extremely difficult to write this fast-decaying article. The first is the title of the article. Confucius said, "If the name is not correct, then the words will not be smooth." This should have been paid close attention to. There are many names of biographies: biographies, autobiographies, internal biographies, external biographies, other biographies, family traditions, short biographies, ......, but unfortunately they are not compatible. "Biography", this one is not ranked in the "official history" with many broad people; "Autobiography", I'm not Ah Q. It is said to be "external transmission", where is the "internal transmission"? If you use "internal transmission", Ah Q is definitely not a god. As for the "other biography", Ah Q has never had a president decree to the National History Museum to establish a "biography" - although there is no "biography of the gambler" in the official history of the United Kingdom, and the literary hero Diegensi has also made the book "The Biography of the Gambler", but the writer is fine, but not in our generation. The second is "family heirloom", then I don't know if I am of the same clan as Ah Q, nor have I been asked by his descendants; Or "small biography", then Ah Q has no other "big biography". All in all, this one is also the "main biography", but from the perspective of my article, because the style is humble, it is the words used by the "flow of the pulp seller", so I dare not overstep the title, so I never entered the novelist's so-called "gossip and return to the main biography", and took out the word "main biography" as a name, even if it was literally confused with the "main biography" of the "main biography" written by the ancients, I couldn't take care of it.第二，立传的通例，开首大抵该是“某，字某，某地人也”，而我并不知道阿Q姓什么。有一回，他似乎是姓赵，但第二日便模糊了。那是赵太爷的儿子进了秀才的时候，锣声镗镗的报到村里来，阿Q正喝了两碗黄酒，便手舞足蹈的说，这于他也很光采，因为他和赵太爷原来是本家，细细的排起来他还比秀才长三辈呢。其时几个旁听人倒也肃然的有些起敬了。那知道第二天，地保便叫阿Q到赵太爷家里去；太爷一见，满脸溅朱，喝道：
Second, the general rule of the biography should probably start with "so-and-so, the character so-and-so, a certain place", and I don't know what Ah Q's surname is. Once, he seemed to have the surname Zhao, but the next day it was blurred. That was when Mr. Zhao's son entered the scholar's house, and he reported to the village with a gong, and Ah Q was drinking two bowls of rice wine, so he danced and said, this is also very glorious to him, because he and Mrs. Zhao turned out to be their own family, and he was three generations older than the scholar in a fine row. At that time, several observers were also a little awe-inspiring. Knowing that the next day, the land protector asked Ah Q to go to Mr. Zhao's house; When the grandfather saw it, his face was splashed with vermilion, and he shouted:“阿Q，你这浑小子！你说我是你的本家么？”
"Ah Q, you bastard! Do you think I am your family? ”阿Q不开口。
Ah Q did not speak.赵太爷愈看愈生气了，抢进几步说：“你敢胡说！我怎么会有你这样的本家？你姓赵么？”
The more Mr. Zhao looked at it, the more angry he became, and he took a few steps forward and said, "You dare to talk nonsense!" How could I have a family like yours? Is your surname Zhao? ”阿Q不开口，想往后退了；赵太爷跳过去，给了他一个嘴巴。
Ah Q didn't speak, he wanted to step back; Mrs. Zhao jumped over and gave him a mouth.“你怎么会姓赵！——你那里配姓赵！”
"How can you be surnamed Zhao! ——You deserve the surname Zhao! ”阿Q并没有抗辩他确凿姓赵，只用手摸着左颊，和地保退出去了；外面又被地保训斥了一番，谢了地保二百文酒钱。知道的人都说阿Q太荒唐，自己去招打；他大约未必姓赵，即使真姓赵，有赵太爷在这里，也不该如此胡说的。此后便再没有人提起他的氏族来，所以我终于不知道阿Q究竟什么姓。
Ah Q did not defend that his surname was Zhao, he only touched his left cheek with his hand and withdrew; Outside, he was reprimanded by the land insurance again, and thanked the land insurance for 200 wen of wine money. People who know say that Ah Q is too ridiculous and will recruit himself; He probably may not be surnamed Zhao, even if his real surname is Zhao, with Mrs. Zhao here, he shouldn't be so nonsense. After that, no one mentioned his clan again, so I finally didn't know what Ah Q's surname was.第三，我又不知道阿Q的名字是怎么写的。他活着的时候，人都叫他阿Quei，死了以后，便没有一个人再叫阿Quei了，那里还会有“著之竹帛”的事。若论“著之竹帛”，这篇文章要算第一次，所以先遇着了这第一个难关。我曾经仔细想：阿Quei，阿桂还是阿贵呢？倘使他号叫月亭，或者在八月间做过生日，那一定是阿桂了；而他既没有号——也许有号，只是没有人知道他，——又未尝散过生日征文的帖子：写作阿桂，是武断的。又倘若他有一位老兄或令弟叫阿富，那一定是阿贵了；而他又只是一个人：写作阿贵，也没有佐证的。其余音Quei的偏僻字样，更加凑不上了。先前，我也曾问过赵太爷的儿子茂才先生，谁料博雅如此公，竟也茫然，但据结论说，是因为陈独秀办了《新青年》提倡洋字，所以国粹沦亡，无可查考了。我的最后的手段，只有托一个同乡去查阿Q犯事的案卷，八个月之后才有回信，说案卷里并无与阿Quei的声音相近的人。我虽不知道是真没有，还是没有查，然而也再没有别的方法了。生怕注音字母还未通行，只好用了“洋字”，照英国流行的拼法写他为阿Quei，略作阿Q。这近于盲从《新青年》，自己也很抱歉，但茂才公尚且不知，我还有什么好办法呢。
Third, I don't know how Ah Q's name is written. When he was alive, people called him Ah Quei, and after he died, no one called him Que again, and there would be "bamboo and silk" things there. If we talk about "writing on bamboo and silk", this article is the first time, so it encountered this first difficulty. I once thought carefully: Ah Quei, Ah Gui or Ah Gui? If he was called Yueting, or had a birthday in August, it would be Agui; And he has neither a number - maybe he has a number, but no one knows that he ,—— and has never distributed a birthday essay post: writing Agui is arbitrary. and if he has an old brother or brother named Ah Fu, it must be Ah Gui; And he is just a person: writing Agui, there is no evidence. The remote words of the rest of the sound Quei are even more difficult to make. Previously, I also asked Mr. Maocai, the son of Mr. Zhao, who would have thought that Liberal arts would be so public, and he was at a loss, but according to the conclusion, it was because Chen Duxiu ran "New Youth" to advocate foreign characters, so the quintessence of the country fell and there was no way to check it. My last resort was to ask a fellow villager to check the case file of Ah Q's crime, and eight months later, I received a reply saying that there was no one in the case file who was similar to Ah Quei's voice. Although I don't know if it's true or not, or if I haven't checked, there is no other way. I was afraid that the phonetic alphabet was not yet popular, so I had to use "foreign characters", and write him as Que according to the popular spelling in the UK, abbreviated as Ah Q. This is close to blindly following "New Youth", and I am also very sorry, but Mao Cai Gong still doesn't know, what else can I do?第四，是阿Q的籍贯了。倘他姓赵，则据现在好称郡望的老例，可以照《郡名百家姓》上的注解，说是“陇西天水人也”，但可惜这姓是不甚可靠的，因此籍贯也就有些决不定。他虽然多住未庄，然而也常常宿在别处，不能说是未庄人，即使说是“未庄人也”，也仍然有乖史法的。
Fourth, it is Ah Q's place of origin. If his surname is Zhao, then according to the old example of calling the county wang, it can be said that he is "Longxi Tianshui people" according to the annotation on the "Hundred Family Surnames of County Names", but unfortunately this surname is not very reliable, so the place of origin is somewhat uncertain. Although he lived in Weizhuang a lot, he often stayed elsewhere, and he could not be said to be a Weizhuang person, even if he was a "Weizhuang person", he still had a good historical law.我所聊以自慰的，是还有一个“阿”字非常正确，绝无附会假借的缺点，颇可以就正于通人。至于其余，却都非浅学所能穿凿，只希望有“历史癖与考据癖”的胡适之先生的门人们，将来或者能够寻出许多新端绪来，但是我这《阿Q正传》到那时却又怕早经消灭了。
What I am talking about to comfort is that there is also a very correct word "A", which has no shortcomings of attachment and borrowing, and it can be quite correct for people. As for the rest, they are not something that shallow knowledge can penetrate, and I only hope that Mr. Hu Shizhi's disciples, who have a "historical fetish and research fetish", may be able to find many new clues in the future, but my "The True Biography of Ah Q" is afraid that it will be eliminated by the time of death.以上可以算是序。
The above can be regarded as a preface.

Chapter 2 Victory Summary阿Q不独是姓名籍贯有些渺茫，连他先前的“行状”也渺茫。因为未庄的人们之于阿Q，只要他帮忙，只拿他玩笑，从来没有留心他的“行状”的。而阿Q自己也不说，独有和别人口角的时候，间或瞪着眼睛道：
Ah Q is not only a little vague in his name and place of origin, but also his previous "behavior". Because the people of Weizhuang are to Ah Q, as long as he helps, they only joke with him and never pay attention to his "behavior". And Ah Q himself didn't say anything, but when he was arguing with others, he occasionally stared and said:“我们先前——比你阔的多啦！你算是什么东西！”
"We were much wider than you! What are you! ”阿Q没有家，住在未庄的土谷祠里；也没有固定的职业，只给人家做短工，割麦便割麦，舂米便舂米，撑船便撑船。工作略长久时，他也或住在临时主人的家里，但一完就走了。所以，人们忙碌的时候，也还记起阿Q来，然而记起的是做工，并不是“行状”；一闲空，连阿Q都早忘却，更不必说“行状”了。只是有一回，有一个老头子颂扬说：“阿Q真能做！”这时阿Q赤着膊，懒洋洋的瘦伶仃的正在他面前，别人也摸不着这话是真心还是讥笑，然而阿Q很喜欢。
Ah Q has no home and lives in the Tugu Temple in Weizhuang; There is no fixed occupation, only short-term work for others, cutting wheat when cutting wheat, pounding rice when pounding rice, and supporting boats when supporting boats. When he worked for a little longer, he sometimes stayed in the house of the temporary master, but left as soon as he was done. Although Ah Q seemed to understand, he always felt that he couldn't stand still, so he couldn't help but squat down, and finally took advantage of the situation to kneel down.“奴隶性！……”长衫人物又鄙夷似的说，但也没有叫他起来。
"Slavery! ......" The man in the long shirt said contemptuously, but did not ask him to get up.“你从实招来罢，免得吃苦。我早都知道了。招了可以放你。”那光头的老头子看定了阿Q的脸，沉静的清楚的说。
"You recruit from the truth, so as not to suffer. I already knew. If you are recruited, you can be released. The bald old man looked at Ah Q's face and said calmly and clearly.“招罢！”长衫人物也大声说。

However, the old man winked, and Ah Q was caught in the fence gate again. The second time he grabbed the fence gate was the next morning.大堂的情形都照旧。上面仍然坐着光头的老头子，阿Q也仍然下了跪。

The old man asked kindly, "Do you have anything else to say?" ”阿Q一想，没有话，便回答说，“没有。”

So a man in a long shirt took a piece of paper and sent a pen to Ah Q, asking him to stuff the pen in his hand. He didn't know how to take it; The man pointed to a place to teach him to draw flower bets.“我……我……不认得字。”阿Q一把抓住了笔，惶恐而且惭愧的说。
"I...... I...... I can't recognize the words. Ah Q grabbed the pen and said fearfully and ashamedly.“那么，便宜你，画一个圆圈！”

However, he was not completely dazed, sometimes anxious, sometimes calm; Between his meanings, he seemed to feel that in the world of life, it was inevitable that he would be killed sometimes.他还认得路，于是有些诧异了：怎么不向着法场走呢？他不知道这是在游街，在示众。但即使知道也一样，他不过便以为人生天地间，大约本来有时也未免要游街要示众罢了。

But even if he knew it, he just thought that life was a world, and it was inevitable that he would sometimes have to parade the streets to show the public.他省悟了，这是绕到法场去的路，这一定是“嚓”的去杀头。他惘惘的向左右看，全跟着马蚁似的人，而在无意中，却在路旁的人丛中发见了一个吴妈。很久违，伊原来在城里做工了。阿Q忽然很羞愧自己没志气：竟没有唱几句戏。他的思想仿佛旋风似的在脑里一回旋：《小孤孀上坟》欠堂皇，《龙虎斗》里的“悔不该……”也太乏，还是“手执钢鞭将你打”罢。他同时想将手一扬，才记得这两手原来都捆着，于是“手执钢鞭”也不唱了。

In this moment, his thoughts swirled in his mind like a whirlwind. Four years ago, he met a hungry wolf at the foot of the mountain, and he would never follow him near or far to eat his meat. He was so frightened that he almost died, but fortunately he had a wood-chopping knife in his hand, so he had to rely on this courage to support Weizhuang; But I will always remember the wolf's eyes, fierce and timid, shining like two ghost fires, as if they were penetrating his flesh and skin from afar. "Help,......然而阿Q没有说。他早就两眼发黑，耳朵里嗡的一声，觉得全身仿佛微尘似的迸散了。

dragon boat festival方玄绰近来爱说“差不多”这一句话，几乎成了“口头禅”似的；而且不但说，的确也盘据在他脑里了。他最初说的是“都一样”，后来大约觉得欠稳当了，便改为“差不多”，一直使用到现在。
Henry Fang has recently liked to say the phrase "almost", which has almost become a "mantra"; And not only that, but it was indeed in his mind. He initially said "all the same", but later felt that it was unstable, so he changed it to "almost", and has been used until now.他自从发见了这一句平凡的警句以后，虽然引起了不少的新感慨，同时却也得到许多新慰安。譬如看见老辈威压青年，在先是要愤愤的，但现在却就转念道，将来这少年有了儿孙时，大抵也要摆这架子的罢，便再没有什么不平了。又如看见兵士打车夫，在先也要愤愤的，但现在也就转念道，倘使这车夫当了兵，这兵拉了车，大抵也就这么打，便再也不放在心上了。他这样想着的时候，有时也疑心是因为自己没有和恶社会奋斗的勇气，所以瞒心昧己的故意造出来的一条逃路，很近于“无是非之心”，远不如改正了好。然而这意见，总反而在他脑里生长起来。
Since he discovered this ordinary aphorism, although he has aroused a lot of new emotions, he has also received a lot of new comfort. For example, when he saw the elders oppressing the young man, he was indignant at first, but now he changed his mind and said that when the young man has children and grandchildren in the future, he will probably put on this shelf, and there will be no more injustice. If you see a soldier hitting a coachman, you will be indignant at first, but now you will change your mind, if this coachman becomes a soldier, this soldier pulls the car, and he will probably fight like this, and he will never take it to heart again. When he thinks like this, he sometimes suspects that it is because he does not have the courage to fight against the evil society, so he deliberately created an escape route by hiding his heart and ignoring himself, which is very close to "no right and wrong", and it is far better to correct it. However, this opinion always grew in his mind.他将这“差不多说”最初公表的时候是在北京首善学校的讲堂上，其时大概是提起关于历史上的事情来，于是说到“古今人不相远”，说到各色人等的“性相近”，终于牵扯到学生和官僚身上，大发其议论道：
When he first announced this "almost" in the lecture hall of Beijing Shoushan School, he probably mentioned things in history, so he said that "ancient and modern people are not far apart", and when he talked about the "sexual similarity" of all kinds of people, he finally involved students and bureaucrats, and made a big fuss:“现在社会上时髦的都通行骂官僚，而学生骂得尤利害。然而官僚并不是天生的特别种族，就是平民变就的。现在学生出身的官僚就不少，和老官僚有什么两样呢？‘易地则皆然’，思想言论举动丰采都没有什么大区别……便是学生团体新办的许多事业，不是也已经难免出弊病，大半烟消火灭了么？差不多的。但中国将来之可虑就在此……”
"Nowadays, it is fashionable in society to scold bureaucrats, and students are particularly vicious. However, bureaucrats are not born with a special race, they are made by civilians. Now there are many bureaucrats from students, what is the difference between them and old bureaucrats? 'The same is true for changing places', and there is no big difference in thoughts, remarks and actions...... It is the many new undertaking of the student body, and it is inevitable that there will be problems, and most of them have been extinguished? Almost. But China's future is worrying about this......"散坐在讲堂里的二十多个听讲者，有的怅然了，或者是以为这话对；有的勃然了，大约是以为侮辱了神圣的青年；有几个却对他微笑了，大约以为这是他替自己的辩解：因为方玄绰就是兼做官僚的。
Some of the more than 20 listeners scattered in the lecture hall were stunned, or thought this was right; some were furious, probably thinking that they had insulted the holy youth; A few smiled at him, probably thinking that this was his justification for himself: because Fang Xuanchuo was also a bureaucrat.而其实却是都错误。这不过是他的一种新不平；虽说不平，又只是他的一种安分的空论。他自己虽然不知道是因为懒，还是因为无用，总之觉得是一个不肯运动，十分安分守己的人。总长冤他有神经病，只要地位还不至于动摇，他决不开一开口；教员的薪水欠到大半年了，只要别有官俸支持，他也决不开一开口。不但不开口，当教员联合索薪的时候，他还暗地里以为欠斟酌，太嚷嚷；直到听得同寮过分的奚落他们了，这才略有些小感慨，后来一转念，这或者因为自己正缺钱，而别的官并不兼做教员的缘故罢，于是也就释然了。
But in fact, it is all wrong. This is just a new injustice for him; Although it is unfair, it is just an empty theory of his peace. Although he himself didn't know if it was because of laziness or uselessness, in short, he felt that he was a person who refused to exercise and kept to himself. The chief complained that he had a mental illness, and as long as his status was not shaken, he would never open his mouth; The instructor's salary has been owed for more than half a year, and as long as he has no official salary support, he will never open his mouth. Not only did he not speak, but when the teachers jointly demanded salaries, he secretly thought that he was not considerate and too shouting; It wasn't until I heard my colleagues ridicule them excessively, that I felt a little emotional, and then I changed my mind, maybe because I was short of money, and other officials didn't also serve as teachers, so I was relieved.他虽然也缺钱，但从没有加入教员的团体内，大家议决罢课，可是不去上课了。政府说“上了课才给钱”，他才略恨他们的类乎用果子耍猴子；一个大教育家说道“教员一手挟书包一手要钱不高尚”，他才对于他的太太正式的发牢骚了。
Although he was also short of money, he never joined the faculty group, and everyone decided to go on strike, but he stopped going to class. The government said that "you will only give money after taking classes", so he hates them for playing monkeys with fruit; A great educator said, "It is not noble for a teacher to ask for money with a schoolbag in one hand and a hand", and he officially complained to his wife.“喂，怎么只有两盘？”听了“不高尚说”这一日的晚餐时候，他看着菜蔬说。
"Hey, why are there only two plates?" After listening to "Not Noble Saying" at dinner that day, he looked at the vegetables and said.他们是没有受过新教育的，太太并无学名或雅号，所以也就没有什么称呼了，照老例虽然也可以叫“太太”，但他又不愿意太守旧，于是就发明了一个“喂”字。太太对他却连“喂”字也没有，只要脸向着他说话，依据习惯法，他就知道这话是对他而发的。
They have no new education, and the wife has no scientific name or elegant name, so there is no name, although it can also be called "wife" according to the old practice, but he does not want to be old, so he invented the word "feed". The wife did not even say "hey" to him, as long as he spoke to him with his face, according to customary law, he knew that it was addressed to him.“可是上月领来的一成半都完了……昨天的米，也还是好容易才赊来的呢。”伊站在桌旁，脸对着他说。
"But the 10% and a half I received last month was finished...... Yesterday's rice was still easy to get on credit. Yi stood at the table and turned his face to him.“你看，还说教书的要薪水是卑鄙哩。这种东西似乎连人要吃饭，饭要米做，米要钱买这一点粗浅事情都不知道……”
"You see, it's despicable to say that teaching people ask for a salary. This kind of thing seems to not even know the superficial things that people want to eat, rice is cooked, and rice is paid for......"“对啦。没有钱怎么买米，没有米怎么煮……”
"That's right. How to buy rice without money, how to cook rice without rice......"他两颊都鼓起来了，仿佛气恼这答案正和他的议论“差不多”，近乎随声附和模样；接着便将头转向别一面去了，依据习惯法，这是宣告讨论中止的表示。
His cheeks bulged, as if he was annoyed that the answer was "almost" to his discussion, almost echoing the sound; Then he turned his head to the other side, which according to customary law was a sign of the suspension of discussion.待到凄风冷雨这一天，教员们因为向政府去索欠薪，在新华门前烂泥里被国军打得头破血出之后，倒居然也发了一点薪水。方玄绰不费一举手之劳的领了钱，酌还些旧债，却还缺一大笔款，这是因为官俸也颇有些拖欠了。当是时，便是廉吏清官们也渐以为薪之不可不索，而况兼做教员的方玄绰，自然更表同情于学界起来，所以大家主张继续罢课的时候，他虽然仍未到场，事后却尤其心悦诚服的确守了公共的决议。
On this day of cold and rain, the teachers were beaten to the head by the national army in the mud in front of Xinhua Gate because they asked the government for unpaid wages, but they actually paid a little salary. Henry Fang took the money without any effort, and paid off some old debts, but he was still short of a large amount of money, because the official salary was also quite arrear. At that time, even the honest officials and honest officials gradually thought that the salary must be asked, and Fang Xuanchuo, who was also a teacher, naturally showed more sympathy for the academic community, so when everyone advocated continuing the strike, although he was not present, he was especially happy afterwards and did abide by the public resolution.然而政府竟又付钱，学校也就开课了。但在前几天，却有学生总会上一个呈文给政府，说“教员倘若不上课，便不要付欠薪。”这虽然并无效，而方玄绰却忽而记起前回政府所说的“上了课才给钱”的话来，“差不多”这一个影子在他眼前又一幌，而且并不消灭，于是他便在讲堂上公表了。
However, the government paid again, and the school opened. But a few days ago, a student union submitted a document to the government, saying, "If teachers do not attend classes, they should not pay unpaid wages." Although this was ineffective, Henry Fang suddenly remembered what he had said in the previous government that "pay only after class", and the shadow of "almost" was in front of his eyes, and it was not eliminated, so he announced it in the lecture hall.准此，可见如果将“差不多说”锻炼罗织起来，自然也可以判作一种挟带私心的不平，但总不能说是专为自己做官的辩解。只是每到这些时，他又常常喜欢拉上中国将来的命运之类的问题，一不小心，便连自己也以为是一个忧国的志士：人们是每苦于没有“自知之明”的。
Based on this, it can be seen that if the "almost said" exercise is woven up, it can naturally be judged as a kind of selfish injustice, but it cannot be said that it is a justification for being an official for oneself. It's just that at these times, he often likes to pull up questions such as China's future fate, and if he is not careful, even he thinks he is a man who cares about the country: people often suffer from not having "self-knowledge".但是“差不多”的事实又发生了，政府当初虽只不理那些招人头痛的教员，后来竟不理到无关痛痒的官吏，欠而又欠，终于逼得先前鄙薄教员要钱的好官，也很有几员化为索薪大会里的骁将了。惟有几种日报上却很发了些鄙薄讥笑他们的文字。方玄绰也毫不为奇，毫不介意，因为他根据了他的“差不多说”，知道这是新闻记者还未缺少润笔的缘故，万一政府或是阔人停了津贴，他们多半也要开大会的。
But the "almost" fact happened again, although the government only ignored the instructors who caused headaches, but later ignored the innocuous officials, owed and owed again, and finally forced the good officials who had previously despised the teachers to ask for money, and many of them turned into brave generals in the salary conference. Only a few daily newspapers published some words that were contemptuous and ridiculed them. Henry Fang was not surprised and didn't mind, because according to his "almost said", he knew that this was because the news reporters had not yet lacked pens, and in case the government or the broad people stopped the allowance, they would most likely have to hold a conference.他既已表同情于教员的索薪，自然也赞成同寮的索俸，然而他仍然安坐在衙门中，照例的并不一同去讨债。至于有人疑心他孤高，那可也不过是一种误解罢了。他自己说，他是自从出世以来，只有人向他来要债，他从没有向人去讨过债，所以这一端是“非其所长”。而且他最不敢见手握经济之权的人物，这种人待到失了权势之后，捧着一本《大乘起信论》讲佛学的时候，固然也很是“蔼然可亲”的了，但还在宝座上时，却总是一副阎王脸，将别人都当奴才看，自以为手操着你们这些穷小子们的生杀之权。他因此不敢见，也不愿见他们。这种脾气，虽然有时连自己也觉得是孤高，但往往同时也疑心这其实是没本领。
He had expressed sympathy for the teacher's salary claim, and naturally agreed with the salary claim of his colleagues, but he still sat in the yamen and did not go to collect debts together as usual. As for some people suspecting that he is arrogant, it is just a misunderstanding. He himself said that since he was born, only people have come to him to ask for debts, and he has never asked anyone to collect debts, so this end is "not his strength". And he dares not see the person who holds the power of the economy the most, this kind of person is also very "amiable" when he holds a copy of the "Mahayana Theory of Faith" and lectures on Buddhism after losing power, but when he is still on the throne, he always has the face of Yama, treating others as slaves, thinking that he holds the power of life and death for you poor boys. Therefore he did not dare to see them, nor did he want to see them. This kind of temper, although sometimes even I feel that I am lonely, but at the same time, I often suspect that this is actually incompetent.大家左索右索，总算一节一节的挨过去了，但比起先前来，方玄绰究竟是万分的拮据，所以使用的小厮和交易的店家不消说，便是方太太对于他也渐渐的缺了敬意，只要看伊近来不很附和，而且常常提出独创的意见，有些唐突的举动，也就可以了然了。到了阴历五月初四的午前，他一回来，伊便将一叠账单塞在他的鼻子跟前，这也是往常所没有的。
Everyone searched left and right, and finally passed by section by section, but compared to before, Henry Fang was extremely tight, so it goes without saying that the small servant used and the store that traded with him gradually lacked respect, as long as it was seen that Yi had not been very agreeable recently, and often put forward original opinions, some abrupt actions, it would be clear. At noon on the fourth day of the fifth lunar month, as soon as he returned, Yi stuffed a stack of bills in front of his nose, which was also unusual.“一总总得一百八十块钱才够开消……发了么？”伊并不对着他看的说。
"It takes a total of 180 yuan to dispense...... Did you send it? He didn't say to him.“哼，我明天不做官了。钱的支票是领来的了，可是索薪大会的代表不发放，先说是没有同去的人都不发，后来又说是要到他们跟前去亲领。他们今天单捏着支票，就变了阎王脸了，我实在怕看见……我钱也不要了，官也不做了，这样无限量的卑屈……”
"Hmph, I won't be an official tomorrow. The check for the money was received, but the representatives of the salary meeting did not issue it, first saying that it was not distributed to anyone who did not go with them, and then saying that it was going to them to collect it in person. Mrs. Fang was a little stunned when she saw this rare righteous indignation, but she calmed down.“我想，还不如去亲领罢，这算什么呢。”伊看着他的脸说。

"But what's the good if you don't send it...... Oh, I forgot to say it last night, the children said that the tuition fee has been urged several times in the school, saying that if it is not paid again......“胡说！做老子的办事教书都不给钱，儿子去念几句书倒要钱？”

Yi felt that he was no longer very scrupulous about reason, and seemed to be going to use himself as the principal to vent his anger.两个默默的吃了午饭。他想了一会，又懊恼的出去了。
The two had lunch silently. He thought for a while, and then went out in annoyance.照旧例，近年是每逢节根或年关的前一天，他一定须在夜里的十二点钟才回家，一面走，一面掏着怀中，一面大声的叫道，“喂，领来了！”于是递给伊一叠簇新的中交票，脸上很有些得意的形色。谁知道初四这一天却破了例，他不到七点钟便回家来。方太太很惊疑，以为他竟已辞了职了，但暗暗地察看他脸上，却也并不见有什么格外倒运的神情。

white light陈士成看过县考的榜，回到家里的时候，已经是下午了。他去得本很早，一见榜，便先在这上面寻陈字。陈字也不少，似乎也都争先恐后的跳进他眼睛里来，然而接着的却全不是士成这两个字。他于是重新再在十二张榜的圆图里细细地搜寻，看的人全已散尽了，而陈士成在榜上终于没有见，单站在试院的照壁的面前。
Chen Shicheng looked at the county examination list, and when he returned home, it was already afternoon. He went very early, and as soon as he saw the list, he first looked for the word Chen on it. There were also a lot of Chen characters, and they all seemed to be scrambling to jump into his eyes, but what followed was not the word Shicheng. He then searched carefully in the circle chart of the twelve lists, and all the people who looked at it had dispersed, and Chen Shicheng finally did not see it on the list, standing alone in front of the wall of the examination court.凉风虽然拂拂的吹动他斑白的短发，初冬的太阳却还是很温和的来晒他。但他似乎被太阳晒得头晕了，脸色越加变成灰白，从劳乏的红肿的两眼里，发出古怪的闪光。这时他其实早已不看到什么墙上的榜文了，只见有许多乌黑的圆圈，在眼前泛泛的游走。
Although the cool breeze blew his short gray hair, the early winter sun still came to bask in him very gently. But he seemed to be dizzy from the sun, his face turned grayer and whiter, and a strange flash flashed from his red and swollen eyes. Jun Xiucai, go to the provincial examination, and go to the victory,...... 兔和猫

Rabbit and cat住在我们后进院子里的三太太，在夏间买了一对白兔，是给伊的孩子们看的。
The third wife, who lives in our back yard, bought a pair of white rabbits in the summer for her children to see.这一对白兔，似乎离娘并不久，虽然是异类，也可以看出他们的天真烂熳来。但也竖直了小小的通红的长耳朵，动着鼻子，眼睛里颇现些惊疑的神色，大约究竟觉得人地生疏，没有在老家时候的安心了。这种东西，倘到庙会日期自己出去买，每个至多不过两吊钱，而三太太却花了一元，因为是叫小使上店买来的。
This pair of white rabbits seems to have been away from their mothers not long ago, although they are outliers, they can also see their innocence. But he also erected his small red long ears, moved his nose, and showed some suspicion in his eyes. This kind of thing, if you go out to buy it on the day of the temple fair, each is no more than two hanging coins, but the third wife spent one yuan, because it was bought by the little envoy in the store.孩子们自然大得意了，嚷着围住了看；大人也都围着看；还有一匹小狗名叫S的也跑来，闯过去一嗅，打了一个喷嚏，退了几步。三太太吆喝道，“S，听着，不准你咬他！”于是在他头上打了一掌，S便退开了，从此并不咬。
The children were naturally very proud and shouted to look around; The adults also looked around; Another puppy named S also ran over, sniffed it, sneezed, and took a few steps back. The third wife shouted, "S, listen, you are not allowed to bite him!" So he slapped him on the head, and S retreated and never bit again.这一对兔总是关在后窗后面的小院子里的时候多，听说是因为太喜欢撕壁纸，也常常啃木器脚。这小院子里有一株野桑树，桑子落地，他们最爱吃，便连喂他们的波菜也不吃了。乌鸦喜鹊想要下来时，他们便躬着身子用后脚在地上使劲的一弹，砉的一声直跳上来，像飞起了一团雪，鸦鹊吓得赶紧走，这样的几回，再也不敢近来了。三太太说，鸦鹊倒不打紧，至多也不过抢吃一点食料，可恶的是一匹大黑猫，常在矮墙上恶狠狠的看，这却要防的，幸而S和猫是对头，或者还不至于有什么罢。
This pair of rabbits is always locked in the small yard behind the back window, and I heard that it is because they like to tear wallpaper too much, and often gnaw on wooden feet. There is a wild mulberry tree in this small yard, and when the mulberry falls, they love to eat it the most, so they don't even eat the spinach that feeds them. When the crows and magpies wanted to come down, they bowed down and flicked the ground with their hind feet, and jumped up with a clatter, like a cloud of snow flying, and the crows and magpies were so frightened that they hurriedly left, and they never dared to come close again. The third wife said that the crows and magpies didn't matter, at most they just grabbed a little food, and the hateful thing was a big black cat, which often looked viciously on the low wall, but this had to be guarded against, but fortunately, S and the cat were opposites, or it wasn't anything.孩子们时时捉他们来玩耍；他们很和气，竖起耳朵，动着鼻子，驯良的站在小手的圈子里，但一有空，却也就溜开去了。他们夜里的卧榻是一个小木箱，里面铺些稻草，就在后窗的房檐下。
children catch them to play with from time to time; They were very kind, pricked up their ears, moved their noses, and stood docilely in the circle of little hands, but as soon as they were free, they slipped away. Their bed at night was a small wooden box with straw laid inside, just under the eaves of the back window.这样的几个月之后，他们忽而自己掘土了，掘得非常快，前脚一抓，后脚一踢，不到半天，已经掘成一个深洞。大家都奇怪，后来仔细看时，原来一个的肚子比别一个的大得多了。他们第二天便将干草和树叶衔进洞里去，忙了大半天。
After a few months like this, they suddenly dug the soil by themselves, digging very quickly, grabbing the front foot and kicking the back foot, and in less than half a day, they had dug a deep hole. Everyone was puzzled, but when they looked closely, it turned out that one had a much bigger belly than the other. They carried hay and leaves into the hole the next day and were busy for most of the day.大家都高兴，说又有小兔可看了；三太太便对孩子们下了戒严令，从此不许再去捉。我的母亲也很喜欢他们家族的繁荣，还说待生下来的离了乳，也要去讨两匹来养在自己的窗外面。
Everyone was happy and said that there was another rabbit to see; The third wife imposed martial law on the children and was not allowed to catch them again. Social drama我在倒数上去的二十年中，只看过两回中国戏，前十年是绝不看，因为没有看戏的意思和机会，那两回全在后十年，然而都没有看出什么来就走了。

Our daily work is probably to dig earthworms, dig them on small hooks made of copper wire, and lie down on the river to catch shrimp. This shrimp is for me as usual. In the hurry to stop the boat, I saw a black bearded man on the platform with four flags on his back, holding a spear, and fighting with a group of shirtless people. Shuangxi said that it was a famous iron-headed old man who could do eighty-four somersaults in a row, which he personally counted in the day.我们便都挤在船头上看打仗，但那铁头老生却又并不翻筋斗，只有几个赤膊的人翻，翻了一阵，都进去了，接着走出一个小旦来，咿咿呀呀的唱。双喜说，“晚上看客少，铁头老生也懈了，谁肯显本领给白地看呢？”我相信这话对，因为其时台下已经不很有人，乡下人为了明天的工作，熬不得夜，早都睡觉去了，疏疏朗朗的站着的不过是几十个本村和邻村的闲汉。乌篷船里的那些土财主的家眷固然在，然而他们也不在乎看戏，多半是专到戏台下来吃糕饼水果和瓜子的。所以简直可以算白地。
We all huddled on the bow of the boat to watch the battle, but the iron-headed old man didn't somersault, only a few shirtless people turned over, turned over for a while, all went in, and then came out of a small dan and babbled. Shuangxi said, "There are few spectators at night, and the iron-headed old man is also slack, who is willing to show his skills to show Bai Di?" "I believe this is right, because there were not many people in the audience at that time, and the countrymen couldn't stay up late for tomorrow's work, so they went to bed early, and the only people standing sparsely and cheerfully were dozens of idlers from the village and neighboring villages. Of course, the families of the rich people in the black canopy boat are there, but they don't care about watching the play, most of them go down the stage to eat cakes, fruits and melon seeds. So it's just a blank slate.然而我的意思却也并不在乎看翻筋斗。我最愿意看的是一个人蒙了白布，两手在头上捧着一支棒似的蛇头的蛇精，其次是套了黄布衣跳老虎。但是等了许多时都不见，小旦虽然进去了，立刻又出来了一个很老的小生。我有些疲倦了，托桂生买豆浆去。他去了一刻，回来说，“没有。卖豆浆的聋子也回去了。日里倒有，我还喝了两碗呢。现在去舀一瓢水来给你喝罢。”
However, I don't care about watching somersaults. What I would most like to see is a snake spirit covered with a white cloth and holding a stick-like snake's head on his head in both hands, followed by a tiger jumping in a yellow cloth. But after waiting for a long time and not seeing him, although Xiao Dan went in, a very old student immediately came out. I was a little tired, so I asked Guisheng to buy soy milk. He went for a moment, came back and said, "No." The deaf man who sold soy milk also went back. I drank two bowls during the day. Now go scoop a scoop of water for you to drink. ”我不喝水，支撑着仍然看，也说不出见了些什么，只觉得戏子的脸都渐渐的有些稀奇了，那五官渐不明显，似乎融成一片的再没有什么高低。年纪小的几个多打呵欠了，大的也各管自己谈话。忽而一个红衫的小丑被绑在台柱子上，给一个花白胡子的用马鞭打起来了，大家才又振作精神的笑着看。在这一夜里，我以为这实在要算是最好的一折。
I didn't drink water, I still watched, and I couldn't say what I saw, I just felt that the actor's face was gradually a little strange, and the facial features gradually became less obvious, and it seemed that there was no higher or lower in the fusion. The younger ones yawned more, and the older ones also talked to themselves. Suddenly, a clown in a red shirt was tied to a pillar and beaten with a riding whip to a white-bearded man, and everyone cheered up and smiled again. On this night, I thought it was really the best discount.然而老旦终于出台了。老旦本来是我所最怕的东西，尤其是怕他坐下了唱。这时候，看见大家也都很扫兴，才知道他们的意见是和我一致的。那老旦当初还只是踱来踱去的唱，后来竟在中间的一把交椅上坐下了。我很担心；双喜他们却就破口喃喃的骂。我忍耐的等着，许多工夫，只见那老旦将手一抬，我以为就要站起来了，不料他却又慢慢的放下在原地方，仍旧唱。全船里几个人不住的吁气，其余的也打起呵欠来。双喜终于熬不住了，说道，怕他会唱到天明还不完，还是我们走的好罢。大家立刻都赞成，和开船时候一样踊跃，三四人径奔船尾，拔了篙，点退几丈，回转船头，驾起橹，骂着老旦，又向那松柏林前进了。
However, Lao Dan finally came out. Lao Dan was originally what I was most afraid of, especially when he sat down to sing. At this time, I saw that everyone was also very disappointed, and I realized that their opinions were in line with mine. The old man was just pacing around singing, but later he sat down on a chair in the middle. I was worried; Double happiness and the others muttered and scolded. I waited patiently, and after a lot of effort, I saw the old man raise his hand, I thought he was about to stand up, but he slowly put it down in the same place and still sang. A few people in the whole ship couldn't stop sighing, and the rest also yawned. Shuangxi finally couldn't stand it anymore, and said, I'm afraid he won't finish singing until dawn, so it's better for us to go. Everyone immediately agreed, as enthusiastic as when the boat was sailing, three or four people rushed straight to the stern, pulled out the pole, retreated a few feet, turned the bow of the boat, drove the oars, scolded Lao Dan, and advanced towards the pine cylindrical again.月还没有落，仿佛看戏也并不很久似的，而一离赵庄，月光又显得格外的皎洁。回望戏台在灯火光中，却又如初来未到时候一般，又漂渺得像一座仙山楼阁，满被红霞罩着了。吹到耳边来的又是横笛，很悠扬；我疑心老旦已经进去了，但也不好意思说再回去看。
The moon hasn't set yet, as if it's not been a long time since I've been watching a play, and when I left Zhao Zhuang, the moonlight looked particularly bright. Looking back at the stage in the lights, it was as if it had not yet arrived when it first came, and it was like a fairy mountain pavilion, covered with red clouds. the flute that came to the ear was very melodious; I suspected that Lao Dan had already gone in, but I was embarrassed to say that I would go back and look at it again.不多久，松柏林早在船后了，船行也并不慢，但周围的黑暗只是浓，可知已经到了深夜。他们一面议论着戏子，或骂，或笑，一面加紧的摇船。这一次船头的激水声更其响亮了，那航船，就像一条大白鱼背着一群孩子在浪花里蹿，连夜渔的几个老渔父，也停了艇子看着喝采起来。
Not long after, the pine berlin was already behind the boat, and the boat was not slow, but the surrounding darkness was only thick, and it was late at night. While talking about the actors, or scolding, or laughing, they stepped up the rocking boat. This time, the sound of the water at the bow of the boat was even louder, and the boat was like a big white fish carrying a group of children on its back in the waves, and several old fishermen who had been fishing overnight also stopped their boats and watched and applauded.离平桥村还有一里模样，船行却慢了，摇船的都说很疲乏，因为太用力，而且许久没有东西吃。这回想出来的是桂生，说是罗汉豆正旺相，柴火又现成，我们可以偷一点来煮吃的。大家都赞成，立刻近岸停了船；岸上的田里，乌油油的便都是结实的罗汉豆。
There is still a mile away from Pingqiao Village, but the boat is slow, and the people who rock the boat say that they are very tired because they are too hard and have nothing to eat for a long time. This time I remembered that it was Gui Sheng, who said that Luo Han beans were in full swing, and the firewood was ready, so we could steal some to cook and eat. Everyone agreed, and immediately stopped the boat near the shore; In the fields on the shore, there are strong Luo Han beans.“阿阿，阿发，这边是你家的，这边是老六一家的，我们偷那一边的呢？”双喜先跳下去了，在岸上说。
"Ah, Ah Fa, this side belongs to your family, this side belongs to Lao Liu's family, which side do we steal?" Double happiness jumped down first and said on the shore.我们也都跳上岸。阿发一面跳，一面说道，“且慢，让我来看一看罢，”他于是往来的摸了一回，直起身来说道，“偷我们的罢，我们的大得多呢。”一声答应，大家便散开在阿发家的豆田里，各摘了一大捧，抛入船舱中。双喜以为再多偷，倘给阿发的娘知道是要哭骂的，于是各人便到六一公公的田里又各偷了一大捧。
We all jumped ashore too. Ah Fa jumped and said, "Slow, let me take a look," he then touched back and forth, straightened up and said, "Steal us, ours are much bigger." With a word of agreement, everyone dispersed in the bean field of the Afa family, each picked a large handful, and threw it into the cabin. Shuangxi thought that if he stole more, if he knew to Ah Fa's mother, he would cry and scold, so everyone went to the field of Liu Yi Father-in-law and stole a large handful of them.我们中间几个年长的仍然慢慢的摇着船，几个到后舱去生火，年幼的和我都剥豆。不久豆熟了，便任凭航船浮在水面上，都围起来用手撮着吃。吃完豆，又开船，一面洗器具，豆荚豆壳全抛在河水里，什么痕迹也没有了。双喜所虑的是用了八公公船上的盐和柴，这老头子很细心，一定要知道，会骂的。然而大家议论之后，归结是不怕。他如果骂，我们便要他归还去年在岸边拾去的一枝枯桕树，而且当面叫他“八癞子”。
A few of us were still slowly rocking the boat, a few went to the aft cabin to start a fire, and the younger ones and I were peeling beans. Soon the beans were ripe, and they let the boat float on the water, and they all gathered around and ate it with their hands. After eating the beans, we sailed the boat again, washing the utensils, and the pod shells were all thrown into the river, and there was no trace. What Shuangxi was worried about was the use of salt and firewood on the Eight Dukes ship, this old man was very careful, he must know, he would scold. However, after everyone talked, it came down to not being afraid. If he scolds, we will ask him to return a dead tree he picked up on the shore last year, and call him a "leper" in person.“都回来了！那里会错。我原说过写包票的！”双喜在船头上忽而大声的说。
"It's all back! It would be wrong there. I originally said that I would write a package ticket! Shuangxi suddenly said loudly on the bow of the boat.我向船头一望，前面已经是平桥。桥脚上站着一个人，却是我的母亲，双喜便是对伊说着话。我走出前舱去，船也就进了平桥了，停了船，我们纷纷都上岸。母亲颇有些生气，说是过了三更了，怎么回来得这样迟，但也就高兴了，笑着邀大家去吃炒米。
I looked at the bow of the boat and saw a flat bridge in front of me. There was a person standing at the foot of the bridge, but it was my mother, and Shuangxi was talking to him. I walked out of the front cabin, and the boat entered the flat bridge, stopped the boat, and we all went ashore. My mother was a little angry, saying that it was past midnight, why did she come back so late, but she was happy, and invited everyone to eat fried rice with a smile.大家都说已经吃了点心，又渴睡，不如及早睡的好，各自回去了。
Everyone said that they had eaten snacks and were thirsty for sleep, so it was better to go to bed early, so they went back.第二天，我向午才起来，并没有听到什么关系八公公盐柴事件的纠葛，下午仍然去钓虾。
The next day, I got up at noon, and I didn't hear anything related to the Hachiko salt and firewood incident, and I still went shrimp fishing in the afternoon.“双喜，你们这班小鬼，昨天偷了我的豆了罢？又不肯好好的摘，踏坏了不少。”我抬头看时，是六一公公棹着小船，卖了豆回来了，船肚里还有剩下的一堆豆。
"Double happiness, you little ghosts, you stole my beans yesterday? And he refused to pick it properly, and he trampled on it a lot. When I looked up, it was my father-in-law who was rowing a boat and selling beans and came back, and there was still a bunch of beans left in the belly of the boat.“是的。我们请客。我们当初还不要你的呢。你看，你把我的虾吓跑了！”双喜说。
"Yes. We treat you. We didn't want you in the first place. Look, you scared my shrimp away! Shuangxi said.六一公公看见我，便停了楫，笑道，“请客？——这是应该的。”于是对我说，“迅哥儿，昨天的戏可好么？”
When Father-in-law Liu Yi saw me, he stopped and said with a smile, "Treat? - This is how it should be. So he said to me, "Brother Xun, was yesterday's play good?" ”我点一点头，说道，“好。”
I nodded and said, "Okay." ”“豆可中吃呢？”
"Can you eat beans in the middle?"我又点一点头，说道，“很好。”
I nodded again and said, "Very good." ”不料六一公公竟非常感激起来，将大拇指一翘，得意的说道，“这真是大市镇里出来的读过书的人才识货！我的豆种是粒粒挑选过的，乡下人不识好歹，还说我的豆比不上别人的呢。我今天也要送些给我们的姑奶奶尝尝去……”他于是打着楫子过去了。
Unexpectedly, the father-in-law of Liuyi was very grateful, raised his thumbs up, and said proudly, "This is really a person who has read in a big city!" My bean seeds are selected grain, and the countrymen don't know what to do, and they say that my beans are not as good as others. I'm going to give some to our aunt to try today......" He then paddled over.待到母亲叫我回去吃晚饭的时候，桌上便有一大碗煮熟了的罗汉豆，就是六一公公送给母亲和我吃的。听说他还对母亲极口夸奖我，说“小小年纪便有见识，将来一定要中状元。姑奶奶，你的福气是可以写包票的了。”但我吃了豆，却并没有昨夜的豆那么好。
When my mother asked me to go back for dinner, there was a large bowl of cooked Luo Han beans on the table, which my father-in-law gave to my mother and me. I heard that he also praised me to my mother, saying, "I have knowledge at a young age, and I will definitely win the championship in the future." Auntie, your blessing is that you can write a package ticket. "But I ate beans, but they weren't as good as last night's beans.真的，一直到现在，我实在再没有吃到那夜似的好豆，——也不再看到那夜似的好戏了。
Really, until now, I really haven't eaten the good beans like that night,—— and I don't see the good show that night again.一九二二年十月。

October 1922.

祝福

祝福

祝福

blessing旧历的年底毕竟最像年底，村镇上不必说，就在天空中也显出将到新年的气象来。灰白色的沉重的晚云中间时时发出闪光，接着一声钝响，是送灶的爆竹；近处燃放的可就更强烈了，震耳的大音还没有息，空气里已经散满了幽微的火药香。我是正在这一夜回到我的故乡鲁镇的。虽说故乡，然而已没有家，所以只得暂寓在鲁四老爷的宅子里。他是我的本家，比我长一辈，应该称之曰“四叔”，是一个讲理学的老监生。他比先前并没有什么大改变，单是老了些，但也还未留胡子，一见面是寒暄，寒暄之后说我“胖了”，说我“胖了”之后即大骂其新党。但我知道，这并非借题在骂我：因为他所骂的还是康有为。但是，谈话是总不投机的了，于是不多久，我便一个人剩在书房里。
After all, the end of the old calendar is most like the end of the year, and not to mention the villages and towns, there is also a weather in the sky that will come to the New Year. The gray and white heavy evening clouds flashed from time to time, followed by a dull sound, which was a firecracker for the stove; The nearby fireworks were even more intense, the deafening sound had not yet subsided, and the air was already filled with a faint fragrance of gunpowder. I was returning to my hometown of Luzhen this night. Although it is a hometown, there is no home, so I have to temporarily live in the house of Master Lu Si. He is my family, one generation older than me, and should be called "Fourth Uncle", an old student who lectures on science. He hasn't changed much from before, just a little older, but he hasn't grown a beard yet, and when he met, he greeted me, and after exchanging pleasantries, he said that I was "fat", and after saying that I was "fat", he scolded his new party. But I know that this is not an excuse to scold me: because he is still scolding Kang Youwei. However, the conversation was never speculative, so it didn't take long for me to be left alone in the study.第二天我起得很迟，午饭之后，出去看了几个本家和朋友；第三天也照样。他们也都没有什么大改变，单是老了些；家中却一律忙，都在准备着“祝福”。这是鲁镇年终的大典，致敬尽礼，迎接福神，拜求来年一年中的好运气的。杀鸡，宰鹅，买猪肉，用心细细的洗，女人的臂膊都在水里浸得通红，有的还带着绞丝银镯子。煮熟之后，横七竖八的插些筷子在这类东西上，可就称为“福礼”了，五更天陈列起来，并且点上香烛，恭请福神们来享用；拜的却只限于男人，拜完自然仍然是放爆竹。年年如此，家家如此，——只要买得起福礼和爆竹之类的，——今年自然也如此。天色愈阴暗了，下午竟下起雪来，雪花大的有梅花那么大，满天飞舞，夹着烟霭和忙碌的气色，将鲁镇乱成一团糟。我回到四叔的书房里时，瓦楞上已经雪白，房里也映得较光明，极分明的显出壁上挂着的朱拓的大“壽”字，陈抟老祖写的；一边的对联已经脱落，松松的卷了放在长桌上，一边的还在，道是“事理通达心气和平”。我又无聊赖的到窗下的案头去一翻，只见一堆似乎未必完全的《康熙字典》，一部《近思录集注》和一部《四书衬》。无论如何，我明天决计要走了。
I got up late the next day, and after lunch, I went out to see a few family and friends; The same goes for the third day. They haven't changed much, just they're older; But the family is busy, preparing "blessings". This is the year-end ceremony of Luzhen, paying tribute to the god of fortune, and praying for good luck in the coming year. Killing chickens, slaughtering geese, buying pork, and washing them carefully, the women's arms were soaked red in the water, and some even wore twisted silver bracelets. After cooking, insert some chopsticks horizontally and vertically on this kind of thing, which can be called "blessing gift", displayed on the fifth watch, and lit incense candles, and respectfully invite the gods of fortune to enjoy; Worship is limited to men, and after worshiping, firecrackers are naturally set off. This is the case every year,—— as long as you can afford blessings and firecrackers,—— this year is naturally the same. The sky became darker, and it snowed in the afternoon, and the snowflakes were as big as plum blossoms, flying all over the sky, sandwiched between smoke and busy complexion, making Lu Zhen a mess. When I returned to my fourth uncle's study, the corrugated tiles were already snow-white, and the room was brighter, and it was very clear that Zhu Tuo's big "Shou" character hanging on the wall was written by Chen Tuan's ancestor; The couplet on one side has fallen off, and it is loosely rolled up and placed on the long table, and the one on the other side is still there, saying "things are clear and peaceful". She just glanced at them and didn't answer a word.鲁镇永远是过新年，腊月二十以后就忙起来了。四叔家里这回须雇男短工，还是忙不过来，另叫柳妈做帮手，杀鸡，宰鹅；然而柳妈是善女人，吃素，不杀生的，只肯洗器皿。祥林嫂除烧火之外，没有别的事，却闲着了，坐着只看柳妈洗器皿。微雪点点的下来了。
Luzhen is always celebrating the New Year, and it will be busy after the 20th day of the lunar month. The fourth uncle's family had to hire a male short-term worker this time, but he was still too busy, so he asked Liu's mother to be a helper, killing chickens and slaughtering geese; However, Liu Ma is a good woman, a vegetarian, does not kill, and only washes utensils. Xianglin's sister-in-law had nothing else to do except burn the fire, but she was idle, sitting and only watching Liu's mother wash the utensils. The light snow is falling little by little.“唉唉，我真傻，”祥林嫂看了天空，叹息着，独语似的说。
"Oh, I'm so stupid," Xianglin's sister-in-law looked at the sky, sighed, and said to herself.“祥林嫂，你又来了。”柳妈不耐烦的看着她的脸，说。“我问你：你额角上的伤痕，不就是那时撞坏的么？”
"Sister-in-law Xianglin, you're here again." Liu's mother looked at her face impatiently and said. "Let me ask you: Isn't the scar on the corner of your forehead the one that was broken at that time?"“唔唔。”她含胡的回答。
"Hmm, no." She replied with a beard.“我问你：你那时怎么后来竟依了呢？”
"I ask you: Why did you follow it later?"“我么？……”
"Me? ……”“你呀。我想：这总是你自己愿意了，不然……。”
"You. I thought: This is always your own willingness, otherwise it ....... ”“阿阿，你不知道他力气多么大呀。”
"Ah, you don't know how strong he is."“我不信。我不信你这么大的力气，真会拗他不过。你后来一定是自己肯了，倒推说他力气大。”
"I don't believe it. I don't believe that you have such great strength, you really can't resist him." You must have been willing to do it yourself, and you pushed back to say that he was strong. ”“阿阿，你……你倒自己试试看。”她笑了。
"Aa, you...... Try it yourself. She smiled.柳妈的打皱的脸也笑起来，使她蹙缩得像一个核桃；干枯的小眼睛一看祥林嫂的额角，又钉住她的眼。祥林嫂似乎很局促了，立刻敛了笑容，旋转眼光，自去看雪花。
Liu's mother's wrinkled face also laughed, making her shrink like a walnut; The dry little eyes looked at the corner of Xianglin's forehead and nailed her eyes again. Xianglin's sister-in-law seemed to be very cramped, and immediately smiled, turned her eyes, and went to see the snowflakes.“祥林嫂，你实在不合算。”柳妈诡秘的说。“再一强，或者索性撞一个死，就好了。现在呢，你和你的第二个男人过活不到两年，倒落了一件大罪名。你想，你将来到阴司去，那两个死鬼的男人还要争，你给了谁好呢？阎罗大王只好把你锯开来，分给他们。我想，这真是……。”
"Sister-in-law Xianglin, you are really not worth it." Liu's mother said mysteriously. "It's good to be stronger, or simply hit one to death. Now, you have lived with your second man for less than two years, and you have fallen into a major crime. Do you think, you will go to the underworld, and those two dead men will still fight, who do you give it to? The King of Hell had no choice but to sawed you open and give it to them. I thought, this is really ....... ”她脸上就显出恐怖的神色来，这是在山村里所未曾知道的。
There was a terrifying look on her face, which was unknown in the mountain village.“我想，你不如及早抵当。你到土地庙里去捐一条门槛，当作你的替身，给千人踏，万人跨，赎了这一世的罪名，免得死了去受苦。”
"I think you might as well arrive early. You go to the land temple and donate a threshold as your stand-in, step on it for a thousand people, and cross it for ten thousand people, so as to atone for the sins of this life, so that you will not die and suffer. ”她当时并不回答什么话，但大约非常苦闷了，第二天早上起来的时候，两眼上便都围着大黑圈。早饭之后，她便到镇的西头的土地庙里去求捐门槛，庙祝起初执意不允许，直到她急得流泪，才勉强答应了。价目是大钱十二千。
She didn't answer anything at the time, but she was probably very distressed, and when she got up the next morning, her eyes were surrounded by big black circles. After breakfast, she went to the land temple at the west end of the town to ask for a donation, but the temple priest insisted on not allowing it at first, until she was so anxious that she burst into tears, and reluctantly agreed. The price is 12,000 yuan.她久已不和人们交口，因为阿毛的故事是早被大家厌弃了的；但自从和柳妈谈了天，似乎又即传扬开去，许多人都发生了新趣味，又来逗她说话了。至于题目，那自然是换了一个新样，专在她额上的伤疤。
She hasn't talked to people for a long time, because Ah Mao's story has long been abandoned by everyone; But since talking to Liu's mother, it seems to have spread again, and many people have had new interests and come to tease her again. As for the title, it was naturally a new look, focusing on the scar on her forehead.“祥林嫂，我问你：你那时怎么竟肯了？”一个说。
"Sister-in-law Xianglin, let me ask you: Why did you agree at that time?" One said.“唉，可惜，白撞了这一下。”一个看着她的疤，应和道。
"Alas, it's a pity, I hit this in vain." One looked at her scar and responded.她大约从他们的笑容和声调上，也知道是在嘲笑她，所以总是瞪着眼睛，不说一句话，后来连头也不回了。她整日紧闭了嘴唇，头上带着大家以为耻辱的记号的那伤痕，默默的跑街，扫地，洗菜，淘米。快够一年，她才从四婶手里支取了历来积存的工钱，换算了十二元鹰洋，请假到镇的西头去。但不到一顿饭时候，她便回来，神气很舒畅，眼光也分外有神，高兴似的对四婶说，自己已经在土地庙捐了门槛了。
She probably knew from their smiles and tone that they were laughing at her, so she always stared at her, didn't say a word, and then didn't even look back. She kept her lips closed all day long, with the scars on her head that everyone thought was a mark of shame, running the streets silently, sweeping the floor, washing vegetables, and washing rice. It was almost a year before she withdrew the wages she had accumulated from her fourth aunt, converted it into twelve yuan Yingyang, and took leave to go to the west end of the town. But before a meal, she came back, looking very comfortable, with a very good vision, and happily told the fourth aunt that she had donated the threshold in the land temple.冬至的祭祖时节，她做得更出力，看四婶装好祭品，和阿牛将桌子抬到堂屋中央，她便坦然的去拿酒杯和筷子。
During the ancestor worship season on the winter solstice, she worked harder, watching the fourth aunt prepare the sacrifices, and lifting the table to the center of the hall, she calmly went to get the wine glass and chopsticks.“你放着罢，祥林嫂！”四婶慌忙大声说。
"You let it go, Sister-in-law Xianglin!" The fourth aunt hurriedly said loudly.她像是受了炮烙似的缩手，脸色同时变作灰黑，也不再去取烛台，只是失神的站着。直到四叔上香的时候，教她走开，她才走开。这一回她的变化非常大，第二天，不但眼睛窈陷下去，连精神也更不济了。而且很胆怯，不独怕暗夜，怕黑影，即使看见人，虽是自己的主人，也总惴惴的，有如在白天出穴游行的小鼠；否则呆坐着，直是一个木偶人。不半年，头发也花白起来了，记性尤其坏，甚而至于常常忘却了去淘米。
She shrank her hands as if she had been burned, her face turned gray and black at the same time, and she no longer went to get the candlestick, but just stood in a daze. It wasn't until the fourth uncle offered incense that he taught her to walk away, and she walked away. This time she changed a lot, and the next day, not only did her eyes sink, but her spirit was even worse. And very timid, not only afraid of the dark night, afraid of dark shadows, even if you see people, even if you are your own master, you are always anxious, like mice parading out of the cave during the day; Otherwise, he would be a puppet. In less than half a year, his hair turned gray, and his memory was particularly bad, and he often forgot to go to wash rice.“祥林嫂怎么这样了？倒不如那时不留她。”四婶有时当面就这样说，似乎是警告她。
"Xianglin's sister-in-law is like this? It's better not to keep her at that time. The fourth aunt sometimes said this in person, as if to warn her.然而她总如此，全不见有怜悧起来的希望。他们于是想打发她走了，教她回到卫老婆子那里去。但当我还在鲁镇的时候，不过单是这样说；看现在的情状，可见后来终于实行了。然而她是从四叔家出去就成了乞丐的呢，还是先到卫老婆子家然后再成乞丐的呢？那我可不知道。
However, she was always like this, and there was no hope of pity. They wanted to send her away and teach her to go back to Mrs. Wei. But when I was still in Luzhen, I just said this; Looking at the current situation, it can be seen that it was finally implemented. However, did she become a beggar when she went out of her fourth uncle's house, or did she go to Mrs. Wei's house first and then become a beggar? Then I don't know.
我给那些因为在近旁而极响的爆竹声惊醒，看见豆一般大的黄色的灯火光，接着又听得毕毕剥剥的鞭炮，是四叔家正在“祝福”了；知道已是五更将近时候。我在蒙胧中，又隐约听到远处的爆竹声联绵不断，似乎合成一天音响的浓云，夹着团团飞舞的雪花，拥抱了全市镇。我在这繁响的拥抱中，也懒散而且舒适，从白天以至初夜的疑虑，全给祝福的空气一扫而空了，只觉得天地圣众歆享了牲醴和香烟，都醉醺醺的在空中蹒跚，豫备给鲁镇的人们以无限的幸福。
I woke up to the loud sound of firecrackers because I was nearby, saw the yellow lights as big as beans, and then heard the peeling firecrackers, which was the fourth uncle's family "blessing"; I know it's almost the fifth watch. In the haze, I vaguely heard the sound of firecrackers in the distance, which seemed to be a thick cloud of sound for a day, sandwiched by flying snowflakes, embracing the whole town. In this loud embrace, I was also lazy and comfortable, from the day to the beginning of the night, all the doubts were swept away by the air of blessing, only to feel that the saints of heaven and earth enjoyed the sacrificial wine and cigarettes, and were all drunk and waddled in the air, preparing to give infinite happiness to the people of Lu Town.一九二四年二月七日。
February 7, 1924.

在酒楼上

在酒楼上

在酒楼上

In the restaurant我从北地向东南旅行，绕道访了我的家乡，就到S城。这城离我的故乡不过三十里，坐了小船，小半天可到，我曾在这里的学校里当过一年的教员。深冬雪后，风景凄清，懒散和怀旧的心绪联结起来，我竟暂寓在S城的洛思旅馆里了；这旅馆是先前所没有的。城圈本不大，寻访了几个以为可以会见的旧同事，一个也不在，早不知散到那里去了；经过学校的门口，也改换了名称和模样，于我很生疏。不到两个时辰，我的意兴早已索然，颇悔此来为多事了。
I traveled from the north to the southeast, took a detour to visit my hometown, and arrived in S City. This city is only thirty miles away from my hometown, and I took a small boat to get there, and I worked as a teacher in a school here for a year. After the deep winter snow, the scenery is desolate, and the laziness and nostalgia are connected, and I actually temporarily live in the Los Hotel in S City; This hotel was not like anything before. The city circle was not big, and I searched for a few old colleagues who thought I could meet, but none of them were there, and I didn't know where they had gone; Passing by the gate of the school, the name and appearance were also changed, which was very unfamiliar to me. In less than two hours, my interest has already faded, and I regret that I have come here for a long time.我所住的旅馆是租房不卖饭的，饭菜必须另外叫来，但又无味，入口如嚼泥土。窗外只有渍痕班驳的墙壁，帖着枯死的莓苔；上面是铅色的天，白皑皑的绝无精采，而且微雪又飞舞起来了。我午餐本没有饱，又没有可以消遣的事情，便很自然的想到先前有一家很熟识的小酒楼，叫一石居的，算来离旅馆并不远。我于是立即锁了房门，出街向那酒楼去。其实也无非想姑且逃避客中的无聊，并不专为买醉。一石居是在的，狭小阴湿的店面和破旧的招牌都依旧；但从掌柜以至堂倌却已没有一个熟人，我在这一石居中也完全成了生客。然而我终于跨上那走熟的屋角的扶梯去了，由此径到小楼上。上面也依然是五张小板桌；独有原是木棂的后窗却换嵌了玻璃。
The hotel I stayed in was rented and did not sell food, and the food had to be called separately, but it was tasteless and the entrance was like chewing dirt. Outside the window, there are only stained walls, covered with dead berry moss; There was a lead-colored sky above, white and unspicious, and the light snow was flying again. I wasn't full for lunch, and I didn't have anything to do, so I naturally thought of a very familiar small restaurant called Yishiju, which was not far from the hotel. So I immediately locked the door and went out to the restaurant. In fact, it is nothing more than trying to escape the boredom of the guests, not just to get drunk. Yishiju is there, the small and damp storefront and dilapidated signboard are still the same; But there was no acquaintance from the shopkeeper to the cousin, and I became a stranger in this stone residence. However, I finally stepped onto the escalator in the familiar corner of the house and went straight to the small building. There are still five small board tables on it; The back window, which was originally a wooden lattice, was replaced with glass.“一斤绍酒。——菜？十个油豆腐，辣酱要多！”
"A pound of Shao wine. ——Dishes? Ten fried tofu, more hot sauce! ”我一面说给跟我上来的堂倌听，一面向后窗走，就在靠窗的一张桌旁坐下了。楼上“空空如也”，任我拣得最好的坐位：可以眺望楼下的废园。这园大概是不属于酒家的，我先前也曾眺望过许多回，有时也在雪天里。但现在从惯于北方的眼睛看来，却很值得惊异了：几株老梅竟斗雪开着满树的繁花，仿佛毫不以深冬为意；倒塌的亭子边还有一株山茶树，从暗绿的密叶里显出十几朵红花来，赫赫的在雪中明得如火，愤怒而且傲慢，如蔑视游人的甘心于远行。我这时又忽地想到这里积雪的滋润，著物不去，晶莹有光，不比朔雪的粉一般干，大风一吹，便飞得满空如烟雾。……
As I told the cousin who came up with me, I walked towards the back window and sat down at a table by the window. Upstairs is "empty", and I can choose the best seat: I can overlook the abandoned garden downstairs. This garden probably does not belong to a restaurant, and I have looked at it many times before, sometimes in the snow. But now, from the eyes accustomed to the north, it is very surprising: a few old plum trees are blooming with flowers all over the snow, as if they do not care about the depths of winter; There was also a camellia tree next to the collapsed pavilion, showing more than a dozen red flowers from the dark green leaves, shining brightly like fire in the snow, angry and arrogant, as if they were willing to travel far away with contempt for tourists. At this time, I suddenly thought of the nourishment of the snow here, it didn't go away, it was crystal clear, not as dry as the powder of Shuo Xue, and when the wind blew, it flew all over the sky like smoke. ……“客人，酒。……”
"Guest, wine. ……”堂倌懒懒的说着，放下杯，筷，酒壶和碗碟，酒到了。我转脸向了板桌，排好器具，斟出酒来。觉得北方固不是我的旧乡，但南来又只能算一个客子，无论那边的干雪怎样纷飞，这里的柔雪又怎样的依恋，于我都没有什么关系了。我略带些哀愁，然而很舒服的呷一口酒。酒味很纯正；油豆腐也煮得十分好；可惜辣酱太淡薄，本来S城人是不懂得吃辣的。
The cousin said lazily, put down the cups, chopsticks, wine jug and dishes, and the wine arrived. I turned my face to the table, arranged the utensils, and poured out the wine. I feel that the north is not my hometown, but I can only be regarded as a guest from the south, no matter how the dry snow over there is, and what kind of attachment the soft snow here is, it has nothing to do with me. I was a little sad, but I took a sip of wine comfortably. The taste of the wine is very pure; The fried tofu is also cooked very well; It's a pity that the hot sauce is too thin, and the people of S City don't know how to eat spicy food.大概是因为正在下午的缘故罢，这虽说是酒楼，却毫无酒楼气，我已经喝下三杯酒去了，而我以外还是四张空板桌。我看着废园，渐渐的感到孤独，但又不愿有别的酒客上来。偶然听得楼梯上脚步响，便不由的有些懊恼，待到看见是堂倌，才又安心了，这样的又喝了两杯酒。
Probably because it was in the afternoon, although it was a restaurant, there was no restaurant atmosphere, I had already drunk three glasses of wine, and there were still four empty tables besides me. I looked at the abandoned garden and gradually felt lonely, but I didn't want other drinkers to come up. Accidentally hearing footsteps on the stairs, I couldn't help but feel a little annoyed, and when I saw that it was a cousin, I felt relieved again, and drank two more glasses of wine.我想，这回定是酒客了，因为听得那脚步声比堂倌的要缓得多。约略料他走完了楼梯的时候，我便害怕似的抬头去看这无干的同伴，同时也就吃惊的站起来。我竟不料在这里意外的遇见朋友了，——假如他现在还许我称他为朋友。那上来的分明是我的旧同窗，也是做教员时代的旧同事，面貌虽然颇有些改变，但一见也就认识，独有行动却变得格外迂缓，很不像当年敏捷精悍的吕纬甫了。
I think it must be a drinker this time, because the footsteps are much slower than those of the cousin. When he finished walking the stairs, I looked up at this idle companion as if I was afraid, and at the same time stood up in surprise. I unexpectedly met a friend here,—— if he still allows me to call him a friend. The person who came up was clearly my old classmate and my old colleague when I was a teacher, although his appearance had changed a little, but he knew it at first sight, but his unique actions became particularly slow, very different from the agile and shrewd Lu Weifu back then.“阿，——纬甫，是你么？我万想不到会在这里遇见你。”
"Ah ,—— Weifu, is it you? I never thought I would meet you here. ”“阿阿，是你？我也万想不到……”
"Ah, it's you? I can't even think of ......"我就邀他同坐，但他似乎略略踌蹰之后，方才坐下来。我起先很以为奇，接着便有些悲伤，而且不快了。细看他相貌，也还是乱蓬蓬的须发；苍白的长方脸，然而衰瘦了。精神很沉静，或者却是颓唐；又浓又黑的眉毛底下的眼睛也失了精采，但当他缓缓的四顾的时候，却对废园忽地闪出我在学校时代常常看见的射人的光来。
I invited him to sit with me, but he seemed to hesitate a little before sitting down. I was surprised at first, then I was a little sad and unhappy. Looking closely at his appearance, he still has disheveled beard and hair; The pale rectangular face, however, is thin. The spirit is very calm, or it is decadent; The eyes under his thick and dark eyebrows also lost their brilliance, but when he slowly looked around, the shooting light that I often saw in the abandoned garden suddenly flashed out.“我们，”我高兴的，然而颇不自然的说，“我们这一别，怕有十年了罢。我早知道你在济南，可是实在懒得太难，终于没有写一封信。……”
"We," I said happily, but unnaturally, "we have been separated for ten years. I knew you were in Jinan, but I was too lazy to write a letter. ……”“彼此都一样。可是现在我在太原了，已经两年多，和我的母亲。我回来接她的时候，知道你早搬走了，搬得很干净。”
"It's the same for each other. But now I'm in Taiyuan, it's been more than two years, with my mother. When I came back to pick her up, I knew that you had moved away long ago, and it was very clean. ”“你在太原做什么呢？”我问。
"What are you doing in Taiyuan?" I asked.“教书，在一个同乡的家里。”
"Teaching, in a fellow townsman's home."“这以前呢？”
"What about before?"“这以前么？”他从衣袋里掏出一支烟卷来，点了火衔在嘴里，看着喷出的烟雾，沉思似的说：“无非做了些无聊的事情，等于什么也没有做。”
"Was this before?" We walked out of the store together, and the hotel he was staying in was in the opposite direction from mine, and we parted ways at the door. I walked alone towards my hotel, and the cold wind and snowflakes hit my face, which felt very refreshing. Seeing that it was already dusk, the houses and streets were woven into the pure white and indefinite net of dense snow.一九二四年二月一六日。

幸福的家庭

Happy family——拟许钦文
——Proposed Xu Qinwen“……做不做全由自己的便；那作品，像太阳的光一样，从无量的光源中涌出来，不像石火，用铁和石敲出来，这才是真艺术。那作者，也才是真的艺术家。——而我，……这算是什么？……”他想到这里，忽然从床上跳起来了。以先他早已想过，须得捞几文稿费维持生活了；投稿的地方，先定为幸福月报社，因为润笔似乎比较的丰。但作品就须有范围，否则，恐怕要不收的。范围就范围，……现在的青年的脑里的大问题是？……大概很不少，或者有许多是恋爱，婚姻，家庭之类罢。……是的，他们确有许多人烦闷着，正在讨论这些事。那么，就来做家庭。然而怎么做做呢？……否则，恐怕要不收的，何必说些背时的话，然而……。他跳下卧床之后，四五步就走到书桌面前，坐下去，抽出一张绿格纸，毫不迟疑，但又自暴自弃似的写下一行题目道：《幸福的家庭》。
“…… Whether you do it or not is up to you; That work, like the light of the sun, gushes out from an infinite source of light, unlike stone fire, knocked out with iron and stone, this is true art. The author is also the real artist. ——And I,...... What is this? ......" He thought of this and suddenly jumped up from the bed. He had already thought that he would have to earn a few manuscript fees to make a living; The place of submission was first set as Happiness Monthly Newspaper, because the writing seems to be relatively rich. Old Master Gao这一天，从早晨到午后，他的工夫全费在照镜，看《中国历史教科书》和查《袁了凡纲鉴》里；真所谓“人生识字忧患始”，顿觉得对于世事很有些不平之意了。而且这不平之意，是他从来没有经验过的。
On this day, from morning to afternoon, he spent all his time looking in the mirror, reading the "Chinese History Textbook" and checking the "Yuan Lifan Gangjian"; The so-called "literacy and worries in life begin", I suddenly feel a little unfair about the world. And this injustice is something he has never experienced.首先就想到往常的父母实在太不将儿女放在心里。他还在孩子的时候，最喜欢爬上桑树去偷桑椹吃，但他们全不管，有一回竟跌下树来磕破了头，又不给好好地医治，至今左边的眉棱上还带着一个永不消灭的尖劈形的瘢痕。他现在虽然格外留长头发，左右分开，又斜梳下来，可以勉强遮住了，但究竟还看见尖劈的尖，也算得一个缺点，万一给女学生发见，大概是免不了要看不起的。他放下镜子，怨愤地吁一口气。
First of all, I thought that ordinary parents really don't take their children to heart. When he was a child, he liked to climb the mulberry tree to steal mulberries to eat, but they didn't care at all, and once he fell down the tree and broke his head, and he didn't treat it properly, and he still has a pointed scar on his left eyebrow that will never be erased. Although he now has extra long hair, parted left and right, and combed diagonally, it can barely be covered, but it is also a disadvantage to see the sharp split, and if it is discovered by female students, it is probably inevitable to look down on it. If that person did not finish talking about the Three Kingdoms, his preparations would never be so difficult. He is most familiar with the Three Kingdoms, such as Taoyuan Sanyi, Kong Ming borrowing arrows, Sanqi Zhou Yu, Huang Zhongdingjun Shan killing Xiahou Yuan and all kinds of others, full of belly, may not be able to finish talking in one semester. Lonely people一
One我和魏连殳相识一场，回想起来倒也别致，竟是以送殓始，以送殓终。
I met Wei Lianshu once, and in retrospect, it was quite chic, it started with the funeral and ended with the funeral.那时我在S城，就时时听到人们提起他的名字，都说他很有些古怪：所学的是动物学，却到中学堂去做历史教员；对人总是爱理不理的，却常喜欢管别人的闲事；常说家庭应该破坏，一领薪水却一定立即寄给他的祖母，一日也不拖延。此外还有许多零碎的话柄；总之，在S城里也算是一个给人当作谈助的人。有一年的秋天，我在寒石山的一个亲戚家里闲住；他们就姓魏，是连殳的本家。但他们却更不明白他，仿佛将他当作一个外国人看待，说是“同我们都异样的”。
At that time, I was in S City, and I heard people mention his name from time to time, and they all said that he was a bit eccentric: he studied zoology, but went to middle school to work as a history teacher; He always ignores people, but often likes to meddle in other people's affairs; It is often said that the family should be destroyed, but as soon as he receives a salary, he must immediately send it to his grandmother without delay for a day. In addition, there are many fragmentary words; In short, in S City, he can be regarded as a person who gives people talk to help. One autumn, I was idle at a relative's house in Hanshi Mountain; Their surname is Wei, which is Lian Shu's family. This is not surprising, although it has been 20 years since China established schools, Hanshi Mountain does not even have a primary school. Two months ago, Erliang asked him to buy shoes, and he kowtowed three times, hey, he is still wearing it, not broken. ”一个穿白长衫的人出来了，她就住了口。我打听连殳的病症，她却不大清楚，只说大约是早已瘦了下去的罢，可是谁也没理会，因为他总是高高兴兴的。到一个多月前，这才听到他吐过几回血，但似乎也没有看医生；后来躺倒了；死去的前三天，就哑了喉咙，说不出一句话。十三大人从寒石山路远迢迢地上城来，问他可有存款，他一声也不响。十三大人疑心他装出来的，也有人说有些生痨病死的人是要说不出话来的，谁知道呢……。
A man in a white robe came out, and she stopped. I inquired about Lian Shu's condition, but she didn't know much, only saying that she had already lost weight, but no one paid attention to it, because he was always happy. It wasn't until more than a month ago that I heard him vomit blood several times, but he didn't seem to see a doctor; Later he lay down; Three days before his death, he had a hoarse throat and couldn't say a word. The thirteenth lord came all the way to the city from Hanshi Mountain Road and asked him if he had any savings, but he didn't make a sound. The thirteenth lord was suspicious of what he pretended to have, and some people said that some people who died of tuberculosis were speechless, who knew .......“可是魏大人的脾气也太古怪，”她忽然低声说，“他就不肯积蓄一点，水似的化钱。十三大人还疑心我们得了什么好处。有什么屁好处呢？他就冤里冤枉胡里胡涂地化掉了。譬如买东西，今天买进，明天又卖出，弄破，真不知道是怎么一回事。待到死了下来，什么也没有，都糟掉了。要不然，今天也不至于这样地冷静……。
"But Master Wei's temper is too strange," she suddenly whispered, "He refuses to save a little and turn money like water." The thirteenth lord still doubts what benefits we have gained. What are the benefits of farts? He was wronged and dissolved. For example, if you buy something, buy it today, sell it tomorrow, and break it, I really don't know what's going on. When you die, there is nothing, everything is bad. Otherwise, I wouldn't be so calm ...... today.“他就是胡闹，不想办一点正经事。我是想到过的，也劝过他。这么年纪了，应该成家；照现在的样子，结一门亲很容易；如果没有门当户对的，先买几个姨太太也可以：人是总应该像个样子的。可是他一听到就笑起来，说道，‘老家伙，你还是总替别人惦记着这等事么？’你看，他近来就浮而不实，不把人的好话当好话听。要是早听了我的话，现在何至于独自冷清清地在阴间摸索，至少，也可以听到几声亲人的哭声……。”
"He just messed around and didn't want to do anything serious. I have thought about it and persuaded him. At such an age, you should start a family; As it is now, it is easy to get married; If you don't have the right one, you can buy a few aunts first: people should always look like this. But when he heard it, he laughed and said, 'Old guy, do you still always think about things like this for others?' You see, he has been superficial and unrealistic lately, and he doesn't take people's good words as good words. If I had listened to my words, why would I be groping alone in the underworld now, at least, I could hear a few cries of my relatives ....... ”一个店伙背了衣服来了。三个亲人便检出里衣，走进帏后去。不多久，孝帏揭起了，里衣已经换好，接着是加外衣。这很出我意外。一条土黄的军裤穿上了，嵌着很宽的红条，其次穿上去的是军衣，金闪闪的肩章，也不知道是什么品级，那里来的品级。到入棺，是连殳很不妥帖地躺着，脚边放一双黄皮鞋，腰边放一柄纸糊的指挥刀，骨瘦如柴的灰黑的脸旁，是一顶金边的军帽。
A shopkeeper came with clothes on his back. The three relatives checked out their underwear and walked into the back of the curtain. Not long after, the filial piety curtain was lifted, the underwear had been changed, and then the coat was added. It was a surprise to me. A pair of earthy yellow military pants were put on, with a wide red stripe embedded in them, and the second one was a military uniform, golden epaulettes, and I don't know what grade it was or where it came from. When he entered the coffin, Lian Shu was lying very inappropriately, with a pair of yellow leather shoes at his feet, a papier-mâché command knife at his waist, and a gold-rimmed military hat next to his skinny gray and black face.三个亲人扶着棺沿哭了一场，止哭拭泪；头上络麻线的孩子退出去了，三良也避去，大约都是属“子午卯酉”之一的。
Three relatives cried while holding the edge of the coffin, stopping crying and wiping tears; The children with twine, on their heads, withdrew, and Sanliang also avoided them, which were probably one of the "Meridian and Maoyou".粗人扛起棺盖来，我走近去最后看一看永别的连殳。
The rough man carried the coffin lid, and I approached to take a last look at the farewell Lian Shu.他在不妥帖的衣冠中，安静地躺着，合了眼，闭着嘴，口角间仿佛含着冰冷的微笑，冷笑着这可笑的死尸。
He lay quietly in his inappropriate clothes, his eyes closed, his mouth closed, and the corners of his mouth seemed to have a cold smile, sneering at this ridiculous corpse.敲钉的声音一响，哭声也同时迸出来。这哭声使我不能听完，只好退到院子里；顺脚一走，不觉出了大门了。潮湿的路极其分明，仰看太空，浓云已经散去，挂着一轮圆月，散出冷静的光辉。
As soon as the sound of knocking on the nails sounded, the cry burst out at the same time. I couldn't finish this cry, so I had to retreat to the yard; As soon as I walked away, I didn't realize I was out of the gate. The damp road was extremely distinct, and looking up at the space, the thick clouds had dispersed, and a full moon hung with a calm brilliance.我快步走着，仿佛要从一种沉重的东西中冲出，但是不能够。耳朵中有什么挣扎着，久之，久之，终于挣扎出来了，隐约像是长嗥，像一匹受伤的狼，当深夜在旷野中嗥叫，惨伤里夹杂着愤怒和悲哀。
I walked briskly, as if I was about to break out of something heavy, but I couldn't. There was something struggling in the ears, and after a long time, it finally struggled out, vaguely like a long howl, like a wounded wolf, howling in the wilderness late at night, with anger and sorrow mixed in the misery.我的心地就轻松起来，坦然地在潮湿的石路上走，月光底下。
My heart relaxed, and I walked calmly on the damp stone road, under the moonlight.一九二五年十月十七日毕。
Completed October 17, 1925.

Died of injuries——涓生的手记
——Juansheng's notes如果我能够，我要写下我的悔恨和悲哀，为子君，为自己。
If I could, I would write down my regrets and sorrows, for my son and for myself.会馆里的被遗忘在偏僻里的破屋是这样地寂静和空虚。时光过得真快，我爱子君，仗着她逃出这寂静和空虚，已经满一年了。事情又这么不凑巧，我重来时，偏偏空着的又只有这一间屋。依然是这样的破窗，这样的窗外的半枯的槐树和老紫藤，这样的窗前的方桌，这样的败壁，这样的靠壁的板床。深夜中独自躺在床上，就如我未曾和子君同居以前一般，过去一年中的时光全被消灭，全未有过，我并没有曾经从这破屋子搬出，在吉兆胡同创立了满怀希望的小小的家庭。
The forgotten dilapidated houses in the guild hall are so silent and empty. Time flies so fast, I love Zijun, and it has been a year since I escaped from this silence and emptiness with her. Things are so unfortunate, when I come back, this room is the only one empty. It is still such a broken window, such a half-dead locust tree and old wisteria outside the window, such a square table in front of the window, such a broken wall, such a wooden bed against the wall. Lying alone in bed in the middle of the night, just like before I lived with Zijun, the past year has been wiped out, never, I have never moved out of this broken house and founded a small family full of hope in Jizhao Hutong.不但如此。在一年之前，这寂静和空虚是并不这样的，常常含着期待；期待子君的到来。在久待的焦躁中，一听到皮鞋的高底尖触着砖路的清响，是怎样地使我骤然生动起来呵！于是就看见带着笑涡的苍白的圆脸，苍白的瘦的臂膊，布的有条纹的衫子，玄色的裙。她又带了窗外的半枯的槐树的新叶来，使我看见，还有挂在铁似的老干上的一房一房的紫白的藤花。
Not only that. A year ago, this silence and emptiness were not like this, often with anticipation; Looking forward to the arrival of Zijun. In the long-awaited anxiety, when I heard the sound of the high-soled tips of leather shoes touching the brick road, how did it suddenly make me vivid! So I saw a pale round face with a swirl of laughter, pale thin arms, a striped shirt, and a dark skirt. She brought the new leaves of the half-dead locust tree outside the window, so that I could see the purple and white vine flowers hanging from the iron-like old trunk one by one.然而现在呢，只有寂静和空虚依旧，子君却决不再来了，而且永远，永远地！……
However, now, only silence and emptiness remain, but Zijun will never come again, and forever, forever! ……
子君不在我这破屋里时，我什么也看不见。在百无聊赖中，顺手抓过一本书来，科学也好，文学也好，横竖什么都一样；看下去，看下去，忽而自己觉得，已经翻了十多页了，但是毫不记得书上所说的事。只是耳朵却分外地灵，仿佛听到大门外一切往来的履声，从中便有子君的，而且橐橐地逐渐临近，——但是，往往又逐渐渺茫，终于消失在别的步声的杂沓中了。我憎恶那不像子君鞋声的穿布底鞋的长班的儿子，我憎恶那太像子君鞋声的常常穿着新皮鞋的邻院的搽雪花膏的小东西！
When Zijun is not in my dilapidated house, I can't see anything. In the midst of boredom, grab a book, whether it is science or literature, everything is the same; Looking on, looking on, I suddenly felt that I had turned more than ten pages, but I didn't remember what was said in the book. It's just that the ears are extraordinarily spiritual, as if they can hear all the footsteps outside the gate, from which there is Zijun's, and the baggage is gradually approaching,—— but it is often gradually faint, and finally disappears into the chaos of other footsteps. I hate the son of the long shift who wears cloth-soled shoes that doesn't sound like Zijun's shoes, and I hate the little thing in the neighbor's yard who often wears new leather shoes that sounds too much like Zijun's shoes!莫非她翻了车么？莫非她被电车撞伤了么？……
Could it be that she overturned the car? Could it be that she was hit by a tram? ……我便要取了帽子去看她，然而她的胞叔就曾经当面骂过我。
I was going to take my hat to see her, but her uncle once scolded me to my face.蓦然，她的鞋声近来了，一步响于一步，迎出去时，却已经走过紫藤棚下，脸上带着微笑的酒窝。她在她叔子的家里大约并未受气；我的心宁帖了，默默地相视片时之后，破屋里便渐渐充满了我的语声，谈家庭专制，谈打破旧习惯，谈男女平等，谈伊孛生，谈泰戈尔，谈雪莱……。她总是微笑点头，两眼里弥漫着稚气的好奇的光泽。壁上就钉着一张铜板的雪莱半身像，是从杂志上裁下来的，是他的最美的一张像。当我指给她看时，她却只草草一看，便低了头，似乎不好意思了。这些地方，子君就大概还未脱尽旧思想的束缚，——我后来也想，倒不如换一张雪莱淹死在海里的记念像或是伊孛生的罢；但也终于没有换，现在是连这一张也不知那里去了。
Suddenly, the sound of her shoes approached, and when she greeted her, she had already walked under the wisteria shed, with smiling dimples on her face. She was probably not angry at her uncle's house; My heart was at peace, and after looking at each other silently for a while, the dilapidated house was gradually filled with my voice, talking about family autocracy, breaking old habits, talking about equality between men and women, talking about Ibson, talking about Tagore, and talking about Shelley ....... She always smiled and nodded, her eyes filled with a childish and curious luster. A bust of Shelley nailed to the wall is a copper plate, cut from a magazine, and is his most beautiful portrait. When I pointed it out to her, she just looked at it hastily and lowered her head, as if she was embarrassed. In these places, Zijun probably hasn't escaped the shackles of old thoughts,—— and I later thought that it would be better to change to a memorial statue of Shelley drowning in the sea or Ibson's; But in the end, it was not changed, and now I don't even know where this one went.
“我是我自己的，他们谁也没有干涉我的权利！”
"I am my own, and none of them have the right to interfere with me!"这是我们交际了半年，又谈起她在这里的胞叔和在家的父亲时，她默想了一会之后，分明地，坚决地，沉静地说了出来的话。其时是我已经说尽了我的意见，我的身世，我的缺点，很少隐瞒；她也完全了解的了。这几句话很震动了我的灵魂，此后许多天还在耳中发响，而且说不出的狂喜，知道中国女性，并不如厌世家所说那样的无法可施，在不远的将来，便要看见辉煌的曙色的。
This is what we have been talking about for half a year, and when we talked about her uncle here and her father at home, she meditated for a while, and then said it clearly, resolutely, and quietly. At that time, I had already said all my opinions, my life experience, and my shortcomings, which I rarely hid; She also fully understood. These words shook my soul very much, and it was still ringing in my ears for many days afterwards, and I was indescribably ecstatic, knowing that Chinese women were not as powerless as the world-weary people said, and in the near future, they would see the dawn of glory.送她出门，照例是相离十多步远；照例是那鲇鱼须的老东西的脸又紧帖在脏的窗玻璃上了，连鼻尖都挤成一个小平面；到外院，照例又是明晃晃的玻璃窗里的那小东西的脸，加厚的雪花膏。她目不邪视地骄傲地走了，没有看见；我骄傲地回来。
Sending her out, as usual, is more than ten steps away; As usual, the face of the old catfish beard was pressed against the dirty window glass, and even the tip of his nose was squeezed into a small plane; When I arrived at the outer courtyard, as usual, it was the face of the little thing in the bright glass window, thickened alabaster paste. She walked away proudly without evil eyes, and did not see it; I came back proudly.“我是我自己的，他们谁也没有干涉我的权利！”这彻底的思想就在她的脑里，比我还透澈，坚强得多。半瓶雪花膏和鼻尖的小平面，于她能算什么东西呢？
"I am my own, and none of them have the right to interfere with me!" This thorough thought is in her head, much clearer and stronger than me. What can half a bottle of alabaster paste and a small plane at the tip of her nose be to her?
我已经记不清那时怎样地将我的纯真热烈的爱表示给她。岂但现在，那时的事后便已模胡，夜间回想，早只剩了一些断片了；同居以后一两月，便连这些断片也化作无可追踪的梦影。我只记得那时以前的十几天，曾经很仔细地研究过表示的态度，排列过措辞的先后，以及倘或遭了拒绝以后的情形。可是临时似乎都无用，在慌张中，身不由己地竟用了在电影上见过的方法了。后来一想到，就使我很愧恧，但在记忆上却偏只有这一点永远留遗，至今还如暗室的孤灯一般，照见我含泪握着她的手，一条腿跪了下去……。
I can't remember how I showed her my innocent and passionate love at that time. Not only now, but I am confused afterwards, and when I think back at night, there are only a few fragments left; After living together for a month or two, even these fragments turned into untraceable dreams. I only remember that in the past ten days or so, I had carefully studied the attitude expressed, arranged the order of the wording, and the situation after being rejected. But it seemed useless temporarily, and in a panic, I couldn't help but use the method I had seen in the movie. Later, when I thought about it, I was very ashamed, but in my memory, this is the only thing that will remain forever, and it is still like a lone lamp in a dark room, and I see me holding her hand with tears in my eyes, kneeling down on one leg .......不但我自己的，便是子君的言语举动，我那时就没有看得分明；仅知道她已经允许我了。但也还仿佛记得她脸色变成青白，后来又渐渐转作绯红，——没有见过，也没有再见的绯红；孩子似的眼里射出悲喜，但是夹着惊疑的光，虽然力避我的视线，张皇地似乎要破窗飞去。然而我知道她已经允许我了，没有知道她怎样说或是没有说。
Not only my own, but also Zijun's words and actions, I didn't see it clearly at that time; Only know that she has allowed me. But I still seem to remember that her face turned pale, and then gradually turned to crimson,—— which she had never seen or seen again; There was joy and sorrow in his childlike eyes, but there was a suspicious light, and although he tried to avoid my sight, he seemed to be about to break the window and fly away. However, I knew she had allowed me, not knowing what she said or didn't say.她却是什么都记得：我的言辞，竟至于读熟了的一般，能够滔滔背诵；我的举动，就如有一张我所看不见的影片挂在眼下，叙述得如生，很细微，自然连那使我不愿再想的浅薄的电影的一闪。夜阑人静，是相对温习的时候了，我常是被质问，被考验，并且被命复述当时的言语，然而常须由她补足，由她纠正，像一个丁等的学生。
But she remembered everything: my words were so good that they could be recited as if they were familiar with them; My actions are like a film hanging in front of me that I can't see, narrated vividly and subtly, and naturally even a flash of the shallow movie that makes me want to think about it again. I was often questioned, tested, and ordered to repeat the words of that time, but I often had to be supplemented and corrected by her, like a student of the Ding class.这温习后来也渐渐稀疏起来。但我只要看见她两眼注视空中，出神似的凝想着，于是神色越加柔和，笑窝也深下去，便知道她又在自修旧课了，只是我很怕她看到我那可笑的电影的一闪。但我又知道，她一定要看见，而且也非看不可的。
This review gradually became thinner later. But as long as I saw her eyes staring into the air, contemplating in a daze, her expression became softer and her smile deepened, and I knew that she was studying her old lesson again, but I was afraid that she would see a flash of my ridiculous movie. But I also know that she must see it, and she must see it.然而她并不觉得可笑。即使我自己以为可笑，甚而至于可鄙的，她也毫不以为可笑。这事我知道得很清楚，因为她爱我，是这样地热烈，这样地纯真。
However, she didn't find it ridiculous. Even if I thought it was ridiculous, or even contemptible, she didn't think it was ridiculous. I know this very well, because she loves me so passionately and so innocently.
去年的暮春是最为幸福，也是最为忙碌的时光。我的心平静下去了，但又有别一部分和身体一同忙碌起来。我们这时才在路上同行，也到过几回公园，最多的是寻住所。我觉得在路上时时遇到探索，讥笑，猥亵和轻蔑的眼光，一不小心，便使我的全身有些瑟缩，只得即刻提起我的骄傲和反抗来支持。她却是大无畏的，对于这些全不关心，只是镇静地缓缓前行，坦然如入无人之境。
Last year's late spring was the happiest and busiest time. My mind calmed down, but another part of me was busy with my body. We were only on the road at this time, and we had been to the park several times, most of which were looking for a place to live. I feel that I often encounter exploring, ridicule, obscene and contemptuous eyes on the road, and if I am not careful, my whole body will shrink a little, and I have to immediately mention my pride and resistance to support it. She was fearless, she didn't care about these at all, she just moved forward calmly and slowly, as if she were in a no-man's land.寻住所实在不是容易事，大半是被托辞拒绝，小半是我们以为不相宜。起先我们选择得很苛酷，——也非苛酷，因为看去大抵不像是我们的安身之所；后来，便只要他们能相容了。看了二十多处，这才得到可以暂且敷衍的处所，是吉兆胡同一所小屋里的两间南屋；主人是一个小官，然而倒是明白人，自住着正屋和厢房。他只有夫人和一个不到周岁的女孩子，雇一个乡下的女工，只要孩子不啼哭，是极其安闲幽静的。
Finding a place to live is not easy, most of them are rejected on excuses, and the other half are unsuitable for us. At first, we chose very harshly,—— not harshly, because it probably didn't look like our place to stay; Later, as long as they were compatible. After looking at more than 20 places, I got a place that could be temporarily perfunctory, which were two south houses in the same hut of Jizhao Hutong; The master is a small official, but he is an understanding person, and he lives in the main house and the side room.
