"Who knows. In short, it's just dead. ”我已经忘却了怎样辞别他，回到自己的寓所。我知道他是不说谎话的；子君总不会再来的了，像去年那样。她虽是想在严威和冷眼中负着虚空的重担来走所谓人生的路，也已经不能。她的命运，已经决定她在我所给与的真实——无爱的人间死灭了！
I had forgotten how to say goodbye to him and return to my apartment. I know he doesn't lie; Zijun will never come again, like last year. Although she wanted to carry the burden of emptiness in the face of strict authority and cold eyes to walk the so-called road of life, she couldn't do it anymore. Her fate has determined the truth I gave her - the love world she died!自然，我不能在这里了；但是，“那里去呢？”
Naturally, I can't be here anymore; But, "Where are you going?" ”四围是广大的空虚，还有死的寂静。死于无爱的人们的眼前的黑暗，我仿佛一一看见，还听得一切苦闷和绝望的挣扎的声音。
There is a vast emptiness all around, and there is a dead silence. I seemed to see the darkness in front of the eyes of those who died without love, and I could hear all the voices of distress and desperate struggle.
我还期待着新的东西到来，无名的，意外的。但一天一天，无非是死的寂静。
I was also looking forward to the arrival of something new, nameless, unexpected. But day by day, it is nothing more than the silence of death.我比先前已经不大出门，只坐卧在广大的空虚里，一任这死的寂静侵蚀着我的灵魂。死的寂静有时也自己战栗，自己退藏，于是在这绝续之交，便闪出无名的，意外的，新的期待。
I didn't go out much more than before, just sitting and lying in the vast emptiness, allowing the silence of death to erode my soul. The silence of death sometimes trembles and retreats by itself, so in this continuous friendship, there is a flash of nameless, unexpected, and new expectations.一天是阴沉的上午，太阳还不能从云里面挣扎出来，连空气都疲乏着。耳中听到细碎的步声和咻咻的鼻息，使我睁开眼。大致一看，屋子里还是空虚；但偶然看到地面，却盘旋着一匹小小的动物，瘦弱的，半死的，满身灰土的……。
It was a gloomy morning, and the sun couldn't struggle out of the clouds, and even the air was tired. I heard the sound of small footsteps and snorting in my ears, which opened my eyes. At a glance, the house was still empty; But when I happened to see the ground, there was a small animal, thin, half-dead, covered in dust .......我一细看，我的心就一停，接着便直跳起来。
When I looked closely, my heart stopped, and then it jumped up.那是阿随。它回来了。
That's Ah Sui. It's back.
我的离开吉兆胡同，也不单是为了房主人们和他家女工的冷眼，大半就为着这阿随。但是，“那里去呢？”新的生路自然还很多，我约略知道，也间或依稀看见，觉得就在我面前，然而我还没有知道跨进那里去的第一步的方法。
My departure from Jizhao Hutong was not only for the cold eyes of the homeowners and his female workers, but mostly for this Ah Sui. But, "Where are you going?" "There are naturally many new ways to live, I know a little about it, and sometimes I vaguely see it, and I feel that it is right in front of me, but I still don't know how to take the first step to get there.经过许多回的思量和比较，也还只有会馆是还能相容的地方。依然是这样的破屋，这样的板床，这样的半枯的槐树和紫藤，但那时使我希望，欢欣，爱，生活的，却全都逝去了，只有一个虚空，我用真实去换来的虚空存在。
After many times of thinking and comparison, only the guild hall is still a place that can be compatible. It was still such a dilapidated house, such a wooden bed, such a half-dead locust tree and wisteria, but what made me hope, rejoice, love, and live at that time was all gone, and there was only one void, the existence of the void that I exchanged for reality.
新的生路还很多，我必须跨进去，因为我还活着。但我还不知道怎样跨出那第一步。有时，仿佛看见那生路就像一条灰白的长蛇，自己蜿蜒地向我奔来，我等着，等着，看看临近，但忽然便消失在黑暗里了。
There are still many new ways to live, and I have to step in because I am still alive. But I don't know how to take that first step. Sometimes, as if I saw the road of life like a long gray snake, meandering towards me, I waited, waited, looked close, but suddenly disappeared into the darkness.初春的夜，还是那么长。长久的枯坐中记起上午在街头所见的葬式，前面是纸人纸马，后面是唱歌一般的哭声。我现在已经知道他们的聪明了，这是多么轻松简截的事。
The night of early spring is still so long. In the long sitting, I remembered the funeral I saw on the street in the morning, with paper people and paper horses in front and singing cries behind. I now know how smart they are, how easy and simple it is.然而子君的葬式却又在我的眼前，是独自负着虚空的重担，在灰白的长路上前行，而又即刻消失在周围的严威和冷眼里了。
However, Zijun's funeral was in front of my eyes, carrying the burden of the void alone, moving forward on the long gray road, and immediately disappeared into the majesty and cold eyes around him.我愿意真有所谓鬼魂，真有所谓地狱，那么，即使在孽风怒吼之中，我也将寻觅子君，当面说出我的悔恨和悲哀，祈求她的饶恕；否则，地狱的毒焰将围绕我，猛烈地烧尽我的悔恨和悲哀。
I am willing to really have so-called ghosts, there is really so-called hell, then, even in the roar of evil winds, I will find Zijun, express my regret and sorrow to my face, and pray for her forgiveness; Otherwise, the poisonous flames of hell will surround me, violently burning my remorse and sorrow.我将在孽风和毒焰中拥抱子君，乞她宽容，或者使她快意……。
I will embrace Zijun in the evil wind and poisonous flames, beg her for forgiveness, or make her happy .......
但是，这却更虚空于新的生路；现在所有的只是初春的夜，竟还是那么长。我活着，我总得向着新的生路跨出去，那第一步，——却不过是写下我的悔恨和悲哀，为子君，为自己。
However, this is more empty than a new way of life; Now all is the early spring night, and it is still so long. I am alive, I have to step out of a new way of life, but the first step ,—— just write down my regrets and sorrows, for my son and for myself.我仍然只有唱歌一般的哭声，给子君送葬，葬在遗忘中。
I still only cried like singing, burying Zijun in oblivion.我要遗忘；我为自己，并且要不再想到这用了遗忘给子君送葬。
I want to forget; I want to do it for myself, and I don't want to think about it anymore.我要向着新的生路跨进第一步去，我要将真实深深地藏在心的创伤中，默默地前行，用遗忘和说谎做我的前导……。
I want to take the first step towards a new path of life, I want to hide the truth deeply in the trauma of my heart, move forward silently, and use forgetting and lying as my leading .......一九二五年十月二十一日毕。
Completed October 21, 1925.

Call my father an 'old beast', call me a 'little beast' and a 'escapee'. ”“那个‘娘滥十十万人生’的叫你‘逃生子’？”爱姑回转脸去大声说，便又向着七大人道，“我还有话要当大众面前说说哩。他那里有好声好气呵，开口‘贱胎’，闭口‘娘杀’。自从结识了那婊子，连我的祖宗都入起来了。七大人，你给我批评批评，这……。”
"That 'mother who gave birth to 100,000 people' called you 'escape'?" Aunt Ai turned her face and said loudly, and then said to the seven masters, "I still have something to say in front of the public." He had a good voice and a good breath there, opening his mouth to say 'cheap fetus' and closing his mouth to 'mother killing'. Ever since I met that bitch, even my ancestors have come in. Seventh Lord, you give me criticism and criticism, this ....... ”她打了一个寒噤，连忙住口，因为她看见七大人忽然两眼向上一翻，圆脸一仰，细长胡子围着的嘴里同时发出一种高大摇曳的声音来了。
She shuddered and quickly stopped, because she saw that the seven adults suddenly rolled their eyes upwards, raised their round faces, and made a tall swaying sound from their mouths surrounded by slender beards at the same time.“来～～～～兮！”七大人说。
"Come on~~~~ Xi!" The seven adults said.她觉得心脏一停，接着便突突地乱跳，似乎大势已去，局面都变了；仿佛失足掉在水里一般，但又知道这实在是自己错。
She felt that her heart stopped, and then it beat abruptly, as if the general trend was gone and the situation had changed; It was as if he had slipped and fell into the water, but he knew that it was really his fault.立刻进来一个蓝袍子黑背心的男人，对七大人站定，垂手挺腰，像一根木棍。
Immediately, a man in a blue robe and a black vest came in, standing still in front of the seven adults, with his hands hanging down like a wooden stick.全客厅里是“鸦雀无声”。七大人将嘴一动，但谁也听不清说什么。然而那男人，却已经听到了，而且这命令的力量仿佛又已钻进了他的骨髓里，将身子牵了两牵，“毛骨耸然”似的；一面答应道：
The whole living room is "silent". The seven adults moved their mouths, but no one could hear what was said. However, the man had already heard it, and the power of this order seemed to have penetrated into his bone marrow again, and he pulled his body in two ways, as if it were "scorching"; One side agreed:“是。”他倒退了几步，才翻身走出去。
"Yes." He took a few steps back before turning over and walking out.爱姑知道意外的事情就要到来，那事情是万料不到，也防不了的。她这时才又知道七大人实在威严，先前都是自己的误解，所以太放肆，太粗卤了。她非常后悔，不由的自己说：
Aunt Ai knew that something unexpected was coming, and that thing was unexpected and could not be prevented. Only then did she know that the Seven Lords were really majestic, and it was her own misunderstanding before, so it was too presumptuous and too coarse. She regretted it very much and couldn't help but say to herself:“我本来是专听七大人吩咐……。”
"I originally listened to the orders of the Seven Lords......全客厅里是“鸦雀无声”。她的话虽然微细得如丝，慰老爷却像听到霹雳似的了；他跳了起来。
The whole living room is "silent". Although her words were as fine as silk, Master Wei felt like he heard a thunderbolt; He jumped.“对呀！七大人也真公平；爱姑也真明白！”他夸赞着，便向庄木三，“老木，那你自然是没有什么说的了，她自己已经答应。我想你红绿帖是一定已经带来了的，我通知过你。那么，大家都拿出来……。”
"Yes! The Seven are really fair; Aunt Ai really understands! He praised, and then said to Zhuang Musan, "Lao Mu, then naturally you have nothing to say, she herself has agreed." I think your red and green post must have been brought, and I informed you. So, everyone takes it out and ....... ”爱姑见她爹便伸手到肚兜里去掏东西；木棍似的那男人也进来了，将小乌龟模样的一个漆黑的扁的小东西递给七大人。爱姑怕事情有变故，连忙去看庄木三，见他已经在茶几上打开一个蓝布包裹，取出洋钱来。
When Aunt Ai saw her father, she reached into her belly pocket to take out things; The man who looked like a wooden stick also came in and handed a small black flat thing that looked like a little turtle to the seven adults. Aunt Ai was afraid that things would change, so she hurriedly went to see Zhuang Musan, and saw that he had opened a blue cloth package on the coffee table and took out foreign money.七大人也将小乌龟头拔下，从那身子里面倒一点东西在掌心上；木棍似的男人便接了那扁东西去。七大人随即用那一只手的一个指头蘸着掌心，向自己的鼻孔里塞了两塞，鼻孔和人中立刻黄焦焦了。他皱着鼻子，似乎要打喷嚏。
The seven adults also pulled out the little turtle's head and poured something from the body into the palm of their hands; The stick-like man took the flat thing. The seventh adult immediately dipped a finger of that hand in the palm of his hand and stuffed two plugs into his nostrils, and his nostrils and people were immediately yellow and scorched. He wrinkled his nose and seemed to sneeze.庄木三正在数洋钱。慰老爷从那没有数过的一叠里取出一点来，交还了“老畜生”；又将两份红绿帖子互换了地方，推给两面，嘴里说道：
Zhuang Mu San is counting foreign coins. Master Wei took out a little from the stack that he hadn't counted and handed it back to the "old beast"; The two red and green posts were swapped, pushed to both sides, and said:“你们都收好。老木，你要点清数目呀。这不是好当玩意儿的，银钱事情……。”
"You all put it away. Old Mu, you need to count the amount. This is not a good thing, money is ....... ”“呃啾”的一声响，爱姑明知道是七大人打喷嚏了，但不由得转过眼去看。只见七大人张着嘴，仍旧在那里皱鼻子，一只手的两个指头却撮着一件东西，就是那“古人大殓的时候塞在屁股眼里的”，在鼻子旁边摩擦着。
With a "uh-chirping" sound, Aunt Ai knew that it was the Seven Adults who sneezed, but she couldn't help but turn her eyes to look. I saw that the seven adults were still wrinkling their noses there, but the two fingers of one hand were pinching something, which was "stuffed into the buttocks and eyes of the ancients during the funeral", rubbing next to the nose.好容易，庄木三点清了洋钱；两方面各将红绿帖子收起，大家的腰骨都似乎直得多，原先收紧着的脸相也宽懈下来，全客厅顿然见得一团和气了。
It was easy, Zhuang Mu cleared the foreign money at three o'clock; Both sides put away the red and green posts, everyone's waist seemed to be much straighter, and the faces that were originally tightened also relaxed, and the whole living room suddenly saw a group of harmony.“好！事情是圆功了。”慰老爷看见他们两面都显出告别的神气，便吐一口气，说。“那么，嗡，再没有什么别的了。恭喜大吉，总算解了一个结。你们要走了么？不要走，在我们家里喝了新年喜酒去：这是难得的。”
"Okay! The thing is complete. "Master Wei saw that both of them showed a farewell look, so he exhaled and said. So, hum, nothing else. Congratulations, finally untied a knot. Are you leaving? Don't go, drink New Year's wine at our house: this is rare. ”“我们不喝了。存着，明年再来喝罢。”爱姑说。
"We don't drink anymore. Save it, come back next year to drink. Aunt Ai said.“谢谢慰老爷。我们不喝了。我们还有事情……。”庄木三，“老畜生”和“小畜生”，都说着，恭恭敬敬地退出去。
"Thank you, Master Wei. We don't drink anymore. We still have something to ....... Zhuang Musan, "Old Beast" and "Little Beast", all said, and exited respectfully.“唔？怎么？不喝一点去么？”慰老爷还注视着走在最后的爱姑，说。
"Hmm? How? Why don't you drink a little?" Master Wei also looked at his aunt who was walking at the end and said.“是的，不喝了。谢谢慰老爷。”
"Yes, don't drink it. Thank you, Master Wei." ”一九二五年十一月六日。
November 6, 1925.

序言

序言

序言

序言这一本很小的集子，从开手写起到编成，经过的日子却可以算得很长久了：足足有十三年。
This very small collection, from the beginning of writing to the compilation, can be counted as a long time: thirteen years.第一篇《补天》——原先题作《不周山》——还是一九二二年的冬天写成的。那时的意见，是想从古代和现代都采取题材，来做短篇小说，《不周山》便是取了“女娲炼石补天”的神话，动手试作的第一篇。首先，是很认真的，虽然也不过取了罗特说，来解释创造——人和文学的——的缘起。不记得怎么一来，中途停了笔，去看日报了，不幸正看见了谁——现在忘记了名字——的对于汪静之君的《蕙的风》的批评，他说要含泪哀求，请青年不要再写这样的文字。这可怜的阴险使我感到滑稽，当再写小说时，就无论如何，止不住有一个古衣冠的小丈夫，在女娲的两腿之间出现了。这就是从认真陷入了油滑的开端。油滑是创作的大敌，我对于自己很不满。
The first article, "Mending the Sky" - originally titled "Buzhou Mountain", was written in the winter of 1922. At that time, the opinion was to take the theme from ancient and modern times to make short stories, and "Buzhou Mountain" was the first to take the myth of "Nuwa refining stones to make up for the sky". First of all, it is very serious, although it is only taken from Roth's theory to explain the origin of creation—both human and literary. I don't remember how, I stopped writing halfway through, went to read the daily newspaper, and unfortunately I saw someone—now I have forgotten the name—criticism of Wang Jingzhijun's "Hui no Feng", he said that he would beg with tears, please stop writing such words. This poor insidiousness made me feel funny, and when I wrote the novel again, no matter what, I couldn't stop a little husband in ancient clothes from appearing between Nuwa's legs. This is the beginning of seriously falling into slippery. Oily slippery is the enemy of creation, and I am very dissatisfied with myself.我决计不再写这样的小说，当编印《呐喊》时，便将它附在卷末，算是一个开始，也就是一个收场。
I decided not to write such a novel again, and when I edited and printed "The Scream", I attached it to the end of the volume, which was a beginning and an end.这时我们的批评家成仿吾先生正在创造社门口的“灵魂的冒险”的旗子底下抡板斧。他以“庸俗”的罪名，几斧砍杀了《呐喊》，只推《不周山》为佳作，——自然也仍有不好的地方。坦白的说罢，这就是使我不但不能心服，而且还轻视了这位勇士的原因。我是不薄“庸俗”，也自甘“庸俗”的；对于历史小说，则以为博考文献，言必有据者，纵使有人讥为“教授小说”，其实是很难组织之作，至于只取一点因由，随意点染，铺成一篇，倒无需怎样的手腕；况且“如鱼饮水，冷暖自知”，用庸俗的话来说，就是“自家有病自家知”罢：《不周山》的后半是很草率的，决不能称为佳作。倘使读者相信了这冒险家的话，一定自误，而我也成了误人，于是当《呐喊》印行第二版时，即将这一篇删除；向这位“魂灵”回敬了当头一棒——我的集子里，只剩着“庸俗”在跋扈了。
At this time, our critic Mr. Cheng Fangwu was creating a board axe under the banner of "Soul's Adventure" at the entrance of the society. He slashed "Scream" with a few axes on the charge of "vulgarity", and only pushed "Buzhou Mountain" as a masterpiece,—— so naturally there are still bad things. Frankly, this is what not only made me unconvinced, but also despised this warrior. I am not "vulgar", and I am willing to be "vulgar"; For historical novels, it is thought that there must be evidence for extensive research, even if some people ridicule it as a "professor novel", it is actually difficult to organize. Moreover, "like a fish drinking water, knowing whether it is cold or warm", in vulgar terms, it is "knowing that you are sick": the second half of "Buzhou Mountain" is very sloppy and must not be called a masterpiece. If the reader believes the words of this adventurer, he must be mistaken, and I have also become a mistake, so when the second edition of "The Scream" was printed, this article was deleted; I paid tribute to this "soul" - in my collection, only "vulgarity" was domineering.直到一九二六年的秋天，一个人住在厦门的石屋里，对着大海，翻着古书，四近无生人气，心里空空洞洞。而北京的未名社，却不绝的来信，催促杂志的文章。这时我不愿意想到目前；于是回忆在心里出土了，写了十篇《朝华夕拾》；并且仍旧拾取古代的传说之类，预备足成八则《故事新编》。但刚写了《奔月》和《铸剑》——发表的那时题为《眉间尺》，——我便奔向广州，这事就又完全搁起了。后来虽然偶尔得到一点题材，作一段速写，却一向不加整理。
Until the autumn of 1926, he lived alone in a stone house in Xiamen, facing the sea, flipping through ancient books, surrounded by lifeless people, and empty in his heart. However, Beijing's Weiming Society has endless letters urging magazine articles. At this time, I don't want to think about the present; So the memories were unearthed in my heart, and I wrote ten "Morning and Evening Collections"; And still pick up ancient legends and the like, and prepare eight "New Stories". But as soon as I wrote "Running to the Moon" and "Casting a Sword" - when it was published, it was entitled "Ruler between the Eyebrows",—— I ran to Guangzhou, and this matter was completely put on hold. Later, although I occasionally got a little subject matter and made a sketch, I never organized it.现在才总算编成了一本书。其中也还是速写居多，不足称为“文学概论”之所谓小说。叙事有时也有一点旧书上的根据，有时却不过信口开河。而且因为自己的对于古人，不及对于今人的诚敬，所以仍不免时有油滑之处。过了十三年，依然并无长进，看起来真也是“无非《不周山》之流”；不过并没有将古人写得更死，却也许暂时还有存在的余地的罢。
Now it has finally been compiled into a book. Among them, there are still many sketches, which are not enough to be called "introduction to literature". The narrative sometimes has a little basis in old books, but sometimes it is just a lie. And because my respect for the ancients is not as good as that of today's people, I still can't help but be slippery from time to time. After thirteen years, there is still no progress, and it seems that it is really "nothing more than the likes of "Buzhou Mountain"; However, it did not write the ancients to be more dead, but perhaps there is still room for existence for the time being.一九三五年十二月二十六日，鲁迅。
December 26, 1935, Lu Xun.

补天

补天

补天

Mending the sky一
One女娲忽然醒来了。
Nuwa suddenly woke up.伊似乎是从梦中惊醒的，然而已经记不清做了什么梦；只是很懊恼，觉得有什么不足，又觉得有什么太多了。煽动的和风，暖暾的将伊的气力吹得弥漫在宇宙里。
He seemed to have woken up from a dream, but he could not remember what dream he had had; I was just very annoyed, feeling that there was something lacking, and I felt that there was too much. The incited breeze and warm blow his strength throughout the universe.伊揉一揉自己的眼睛。
Yi rubbed his eyes.粉红的天空中，曲曲折折的漂着许多条石绿色的浮云，星便在那后面忽明忽灭的眼。天边的血红的云彩里有一个光芒四射的太阳，如流动的金球包在荒古的熔岩中；那一边，却是一个生铁一般的冷而且白的月亮。然而伊并不理会谁是下去，和谁是上来。
In the pink sky, there were many stone-green floating clouds floating in twists and turns, and the stars flickered and disappeared behind them. In the blood-red clouds on the horizon, there is a radiant sun, like a flowing golden ball wrapped in ancient lava; On the other side, there was a cold and white moon as cold as pig iron. But he didn't care who went down and who came up.地上都嫩绿了，便是不很换叶的松柏也显得格外的娇嫩。桃红和青白色的斗大的杂花，在眼前还分明，到远处可就成为斑斓的烟霭了。
The ground is tender green, and even the pines and cypresses that do not change their leaves are particularly delicate. The peach and blue and white flowers are still clear in front of you, and they can become colorful smoke in the distance.“唉唉，我从来没有这样的无聊过！”伊想着，猛然间站立起来了，擎上那非常圆满而精力洋溢的臂膊，向天打一个欠伸，天空便突然失了色，化为神异的肉红，暂时再也辨不出伊所在的处所。
"Oh, I've never been bored like this!" Yi thought, suddenly stood up, raised his very round and energetic arm, yawned to the sky, and the sky suddenly lost its color and turned into a mysterious flesh red, and it was no longer possible to distinguish where he was for the time being.伊在这肉红色的天地间走到海边，全身的曲线都消融在淡玫瑰似的光海里，直到身中央才浓成一段纯白。波涛都惊异，起伏得很有秩序了，然而浪花溅在伊身上。这纯白的影子在海水里动摇，仿佛全体都正在四面八方的迸散。但伊自己并没有见，只是不由的跪下一足，伸手掬起带水的软泥来，同时又揉捏几回，便有一个和自己差不多的小东西在两手里。
Yi walked to the beach between this flesh-red heaven and earth, and the curves of his whole body melted into a sea of light like a pale rose, until the center of his body thickened into a pure white. The waves were amazed, and the ups and downs were very orderly, but the waves splashed on him. This pure white shadow swayed in the seawater, as if they were all scattering in all directions. But he didn't see it himself, but he couldn't help but kneel down, stretched out his hand to scoop up the ooze with water, and kneaded it a few times at the same time, and there was a small thing similar to himself in his hands.“阿，阿！”伊固然以为是自己做的，但也疑心这东西就白薯似的原在泥土里，禁不住很诧异了。
"Ah, ah!" Although he thought he made it himself, he also suspected that this thing was in the dirt like a white potato, and he couldn't help but be surprised.然而这诧异使伊喜欢，以未曾有的勇往和愉快继续着伊的事业，呼吸吹嘘着，汗混和着……
However, this surprise made him like, and he continued his career with unprecedented courage and joy, breathing and boasting, sweating and mixing......“Nga！nga！”那些小东西可是叫起来了。
“Nga！ nga！ "Those little things are screaming.“阿，阿！”伊又吃了惊，觉得全身的毛孔中无不有什么东西飞散，于是地上便罩满了乳白色的烟云，伊才定了神，那些小东西也住了口。
"Ah, ah!" Yi was surprised again, feeling that something was flying in the pores of his body, so the ground was covered with milky white smoke clouds, and he calmed down, and those little things also stopped.“Akon，Agon！”有些东西向伊说。
“Akon，Agon！” Something said to him.“阿阿，可爱的宝贝。”伊看定他们，伸出带着泥土的手指去拨他肥白的脸。

In the blood-red clouds on the horizon, there is a radiant sun, like a flowing golden ball wrapped in ancient lava; On the other side, there was a cold and white moon as cold as pig iron. But I don't know who goes down and who comes up. At this time, Edim, having exhausted all his body, lay down in the midst of it, and stopped breathing.上下四方是死灭以上的寂静。
The upper and lower four directions are silence above death.

补天

Three有一日，天气很寒冷，却听到一点喧嚣，那是禁军终于杀到了，因为他们等候着望不见火光和烟尘的时候，所以到得迟。他们左边一柄黄斧头，右边一柄黑斧头，后面一柄极大极古的大纛，躲躲闪闪的攻到女娲死尸的旁边，却并不见有什么动静。他们就在死尸的肚皮上扎了寨，因为这一处最膏腴，他们检选这些事是很伶俐的。然而他们却突然变了口风，说惟有他们是女娲的嫡派，同时也就改换了大纛旗上的科斗字，写道“女娲氏之肠”。
One day, it was very cold, but they heard a little noise, and it was the forbidden army that finally arrived, because they were waiting for the time when they could not see the fire and smoke, so they arrived late. They had a yellow axe on the left, a black axe on the right, and a very large and ancient flag behind them, dodging and attacking the side of Nuwa's corpse, but there was no movement. They built a camp on the belly of the corpse, because this place was the most fatty, and they were very clever in selecting these things. However, they suddenly changed their tone, saying that they were the only ones who were Nuwa's direct faction, and at the same time changed the word "Kedou on the big flag" and wrote "Nuwa's intestines".落在海岸上的老道士也传了无数代了。他临死的时候，才将仙山被巨鳌背到海上这一件要闻传授徒弟，徒弟又传给徒孙，后来一个方士想讨好，竟去奏闻了秦始皇，秦始皇便教方士去寻去。
The old Taoist priests who landed on the coast have also been passed down for countless generations. When he was dying, he passed on the news of the immortal mountain being carried to the sea by the giant turtle to his apprentice, and the apprentice passed it on to his apprentice, and later an alchemist wanted to please him, so he went to report to Qin Shi Huang, and Qin Shi Huang taught the alchemist to find it.方士寻不到仙山，秦始皇终于死掉了；汉武帝又教寻，也一样的没有影。
The alchemist could not find the immortal mountain, and Qin Shi Huang finally died; Emperor Wu of the Han Dynasty taught to search, and there was no shadow in the same way.大约巨鳌们是并没有懂得女娲的话的，那时不过偶而凑巧的点了点头。模模胡胡的背了一程之后，大家便走散去睡觉，仙山也就跟着沉下了，所以直到现在，总没有人看见半座神仙山，至多也不外乎发见了若干野蛮岛。
Probably the giant turtles didn't understand Nuwa's words, and they just nodded occasionally. After a long journey, everyone scattered to sleep, and the fairy mountain sank, so until now, no one had seen half of the fairy mountain, and at most they had found a few barbaric islands.一九二二年十一月作。

Water management一
One这时候是“汤汤洪水方割，浩浩怀山襄陵”；舜爷的百姓，倒并不都挤在露出水面的山顶上，有的捆在树顶，有的坐着木排，有些木排上还搭有小小的板棚，从岸上看起来，很富于诗趣。
At this time, it is "the soup and flood is cutting, and the vast mountains and tombs are being cut"; Shunye's people are not all crowded on the top of the mountain that is exposed to the water, some are tied to the top of the trees, some are sitting on wooden rafts, and some wooden rafts are also set up with small board sheds, which look very poetic from the shore.远地里的消息，是从木排上传过来的。大家终于知道鲧大人因为治了九整年的水，什么效验也没有，上头龙心震怒，把他充军到羽山去了，接任的好像就是他的儿子文命少爷，乳名叫作阿禹。
The news from afar came from the wooden raft. Everyone finally knew that Lord Gun had no effect because he had treated the water for nine whole years, and the dragon was furious, and he was conscripted into the army to Yushan, and it seemed that his son Wenming Shaoye was named Ayu.灾荒得久了，大学早已解散，连幼稚园也没有地方开，所以百姓们都有些混混沌沌。只在文化山上，还聚集着许多学者，他们的食粮，是都从奇肱国用飞车运来的，因此不怕缺乏，因此也能够研究学问。然而他们里面，大抵是反对禹的，或者简直不相信世界上真有这个禹。
The famine has been going on for a long time, the university has long been disbanded, and there is no place to open even a kindergarten, so the people are a little confused. Only on the Cultural Mountain, there are also many scholars, whose food is transported from the Qigong Kingdom by flying car, so they are not afraid of lack, so they can also study knowledge. However, among them, most of them are against Yu, or simply do not believe that there is such a Yu in the world.每月一次，照例的半空中要簌簌的发响，愈响愈厉害，飞车看得清楚了，车上插一张旗，画着一个黄圆圈在发毫光。离地五尺，就挂下几只篮子来，别人可不知道里面装的是什么，只听得上下在讲话：
Once a month, as usual, it will make a rustling sound in mid-air, the louder it gets, the louder it is, the flying car can be seen clearly, a flag is planted on the car, and a yellow circle is drawn to glow. Five feet off the ground, hang a few baskets, others don't know what is inside, they can only hear the speech:“古貌林！”
"Gu Mao Lin!"“好杜有图！”
"Good Du Youtu!"“古鲁几哩……”
"Guru ......“O．K！”
“O． K！ ”飞车向奇肱国疾飞而去，天空中不再留下微声，学者们也静悄悄，这是大家在吃饭。独有山周围的水波，撞着石头，不住的澎湃的在发响。午觉醒来，精神百倍，于是学说也就压倒了涛声了。
The speeding car flew towards the Qi Gong Kingdom, there was no longer a whisper left in the sky, and the scholars were quiet, this was everyone eating. The water waves around the unique mountain hit the stones, and they couldn't stop surging. When I woke up from a nap, I was a hundred times more energetic, so the doctrine overwhelmed the sound of the waves.“禹来治水，一定不成功，如果他是鲧的儿子的话，”一个拿拄杖的学者说。“我曾经搜集了许多王公大臣和豪富人家的家谱，很下过一番研究工夫，得到一个结论：阔人的子孙都是阔人，坏人的子孙都是坏人——这就叫作‘遗传’。所以，鲧不成功，他的儿子禹一定也不会成功，因为愚人是生不出聪明人来的！”
"Yu came to control the water, and he would not have succeeded, if he was Gun's son," said a scholar with a cane. "I have collected the genealogies of many princes and ministers and wealthy families, and I have done a lot of research and come to a conclusion: the descendants of the broad people are all the broad people, and the children and grandchildren of the bad people are all bad people - this is called 'heredity'. Therefore, if Gun is not successful, his son Yu will definitely not succeed, because fools cannot give birth to smart people! ”“O．K！”一个不拿拄杖的学者说。
“O． K！ A scholar who does not take a cane said.“不过您要想想咱们的太上皇，”别一个不拿拄杖的学者道。
"But you have to think about our Supreme Emperor," said another scholar who did not hold a cane.“他先前虽然有些‘顽’，现在可是改好了。倘是愚人，就永远不会改好……”
"Although he was a little 'stubborn' before, he has changed it now. If you are a fool, you will never change ......"“O．K！”
“O． K！ ”“这这些些都是费话，”又一个学者吃吃的说，立刻把鼻尖胀得通红。“你们是受了谣言的骗的。其实并没有所谓禹，‘禹’是一条虫，虫虫会治水的吗？我看鲧也没有的，‘鲧’是一条鱼，鱼鱼会治水水水的吗？”他说到这里，把两脚一蹬，显得非常用劲。
"These are all nonsense," another scholar said, immediately swollen the tip of his nose red. "You have been deceived by rumors. In fact, there is no so-called Yu, 'Yu' is a worm, can insects control water? I don't think Gun has it, 'Gun' is a fish, can fish control water? When he said this, he kicked his feet and seemed very hard.“不过鲧却的确是有的，七年以前，我还亲眼看见他到昆仑山脚下去赏梅花的。”
"But Gun does have it, seven years ago, I saw him go to the foot of Kunlun Mountain to enjoy the plum blossoms."“那么，他的名字弄错了，他大概不叫‘鲧’，他的名字应该叫‘人’！至于禹，那可一定是一条虫，我有许多证据，可以证明他的乌有，叫大家来公评……”
"Then, his name is wrong, he is probably not called 'Gun', his name should be 'Ren'! As for Yu, it must be a worm, I have a lot of evidence to prove that he is nothing, so I asked everyone to come to the public commentary......"于是他勇猛的站了起来，摸出削刀，刮去了五株大松树皮，用吃剩的面包末屑和水研成浆，调了炭粉，在树身上用很小的蝌蚪文写上抹杀阿禹的考据，足足化掉了三九廿七天工夫。但是凡有要看的人，得拿出十片嫩榆叶，如果住在木排上，就改给一贝壳鲜水苔。
So he stood up bravely, took out a sharpener, scraped off the bark of five large pine trees, ground it into a pulp with leftover breadcrumbs and water, mixed charcoal powder, and wrote a small tadpole text on the tree to erase Ayu's evidence, which took a full three or nine twenty-seven days. But anyone who wants to see it has to take out ten young elm leaves, and if they live on a wooden raft, they will be given a shell of fresh water moss.横竖到处都是水，猎也不能打，地也不能种，只要还活着，所有的是闲工夫，来看的人倒也很不少。松树下挨挤了三天，到处都发出叹息的声音，有的是佩服，有的是疲劳。但到第四天的正午，一个乡下人终于说话了，这时那学者正在吃炒面。
There is water everywhere, hunting cannot be hunted, the land cannot be planted, as long as it is alive, all is idle work, and there are many people who come to see. After three days of being crowded under the pine trees, there were sighs everywhere, some admiring, some being tired. But by noon on the fourth day, a countryman finally spoke, and the scholar was eating fried noodles.“人里面，是有叫作阿禹的，”乡下人说。“况且‘禹’也不是虫，这是我们乡下人的简笔字，老爷们都写作‘禺’，是大猴子……”
"Among the people, there is a man named Ayu," said the countryman. "Moreover, 'Yu' is not a worm, this is a stick figure of our countrymen, and the old men all write 'Yu', which is a big monkey......"“人有叫作大大猴子的吗？……”学者跳起来了，连忙咽下没有嚼烂的一口面，鼻子红到发紫，吆喝道。
"Is there a person called a big monkey? ......" The scholar jumped up, quickly swallowed a mouthful of noodles that had not been chewed, his nose was red to purple, and shouted.“有的呀，连叫阿狗阿猫的也有。”
"Yes, there are even those called dogs and cats."“鸟头先生，您不要和他去辩论了，”拿拄杖的学者放下面包，拦在中间，说。“乡下人都是愚人。拿你的家谱来，”他又转向乡下人，大声道，“我一定会发见你的上代都是愚人……”
"Don't debate with him, Mr. Birdhead," said the cane-wielding scholar, putting down his bread and stopping in the middle. "The countrymen are fools. Take your family tree," he said aloud, turning to the countryman, "I will surely find that your ancestors were fools......“我就从来没有过家谱……”
"I've never had a family tree......"“呸，使我的研究不能精密，就是你们这些东西可恶！”
"Bah, make my research not precise, it's you damn these things!"“不过这这也用不着家谱，我的学说是不会错的。”鸟头先生更加愤愤的说。“先前，许多学者都写信来赞成我的学说，那些信我都带在这里……”
"But this doesn't require a family tree, my doctrine will not be wrong." Mr. Birdhead said even more indignantly. "Previously, many scholars wrote letters in favor of my doctrines, and I brought those letters here......"“不不，那可应该查家谱……”
"No, no, then you should check the family tree......"“但是我竟没有家谱，”那“愚人”说。“现在又是这么的人荒马乱，交通不方便，要等您的朋友们来信赞成，当作证据，真也比螺蛳壳里做道场还难。证据就在眼前：您叫鸟头先生，莫非真的是一个鸟儿的头，并不是人吗？”
"But I don't have a family tree," said the "fool." "Now it's so chaotic and inconvenient, and it's really more difficult to wait for your friends to write in favor and use it as evidence, than to build a dojo in a snail shell. The evidence is right in front of you: your name is Mr. Bird's Head, is it really the head of a bird, not a human? ”“哼！”鸟头先生气忿到连耳轮都发紫了。“你竟这样的侮辱我！说我不是人！我要和你到皋陶大人那里去法律解决！如果我真的不是人，我情愿大辟——就是杀头呀，你懂了没有？要不然，你是应该反坐的。你等着罢，不要动，等我吃完了炒面。”
"Hmph!" Mr. Birdhead was so angry that even the earrings turned purple. "You insulted me like this! Say I'm not human! I want to go to Lord Gao Yao with you to settle it legally!" If I really wasn't human, I would rather be executed - just beheading, do you understand? Otherwise, you should sit back. You wait, don't move, wait until I finish eating fried noodles." ”“先生，”乡下人麻木而平静的回答道，“您是学者，总该知道现在已是午后，别人也要肚子饿的。可恨的是愚人的肚子却和聪明人的一样：也要饿。真是对不起得很，我要捞青苔去了，等您上了呈子之后，我再来投案罢。”于是他跳上木排，拿起网兜，捞着水草，泛泛的远开去了。看客也渐渐的走散，鸟头先生就红着耳轮和鼻尖从新吃炒面，拿拄杖的学者在摇头。
"Sir," replied the countryman numbly and calmly, "you are a scholar, and you should know that it is afternoon and others will be hungry too." The hateful thing is that the fool's stomach is the same as that of the wise: he will also be hungry. I'm really sorry, I'm going to fish for moss, and I'll surrender again after you submit the petition. So he jumped on the wooden raft, picked up the net bag, fished for aquatic plants, and drove away. The spectators gradually dispersed, and Mr. Bird Head ate fried noodles with red earrings and the tip of his nose, and the scholar with a cane was shaking his head.然而“禹”究竟是一条虫，还是一个人呢，却仍然是一个大疑问。
However, whether "Yu" is a worm or a person is still a big question.

理水

二

理水

Two禹也真好像是一条虫。
Yu really seems to be a worm.大半年过去了，奇肱国的飞车已经来过八回，读过松树身上的文字的木排居民，十个里面有九个生了脚气病，治水的新官却还没有消息。直到第十回飞车来过之后，这才传来了新闻，说禹是确有这么一个人的，正是鲧的儿子，也确是简放了水利大臣，三年之前，已从冀州启节，不久就要到这里了。
More than half a year has passed, and the speeding car of Qigong Kingdom has been here eight times, and nine out of ten of the wooden row residents who have read the words on the pine tree have beriberi, but there is no news about the new official who controls the water. It wasn't until after the tenth speeding car came that the news came that Yu did have such a person, it was Gun's son, and he was indeed the Minister of Water Resources, who had started the festival from Jizhou three years ago and would be here soon.大家略有一点兴奋，但又很淡漠，不大相信，因为这一类不甚可靠的传闻，是谁都听得耳朵起茧了的。
Everyone was a little excited, but they were very indifferent and didn't believe it, because everyone could hear this kind of unreliable rumor.然而这一回却又像消息很可靠，十多天之后，几乎谁都说大臣的确要到了，因为有人出去捞浮草，亲眼看见过官船；他还指着头上一块乌青的疙瘩，说是为了回避得太慢一点了，吃了一下官兵的飞石：这就是大臣确已到来的证据。这人从此就很有名，也很忙碌，大家都争先恐后的来看他头上的疙瘩，几乎把木排踏沉；后来还经学者们召了他去，细心研究，决定了他的疙瘩确是真疙瘩，于是使鸟头先生也不能再执成见，只好把考据学让给别人，自己另去搜集民间的曲子了。
However, this time it was like the news was very reliable, more than ten days later, almost everyone said that the minister was indeed coming, because someone went out to fish for floating grass and saw the official ship with their own eyes; He also pointed to a black pimple on his head, saying that in order to avoid it too slowly, he ate the flying stone of the officers and soldiers: this is evidence that the minister has indeed arrived. This man has been famous and busy since then, and everyone rushed to see the pimple on his head, almost trampling the wooden raft; Later, he was summoned by scholars to study carefully, and it was decided that his pimple was indeed a real pimple, so Mr. Birdhead could no longer hold on to prejudices, so he had to give up his research to others and collect folk songs by himself.一大阵独木大舟的到来，是在头上打出疙瘩的大约二十多天之后，每只船上，有二十名官兵打桨，三十名官兵持矛，前后都是旗帜；刚靠山顶，绅士们和学者们已在岸上列队恭迎，过了大半天，这才从最大的船里，有两位中年的胖胖的大员出现，约略二十个穿虎皮的武士簇拥着，和迎接的人们一同到最高巅的石屋里去了。
The arrival of a large group of canoes came about 20 days after the pimples on their heads, and on each boat, there were 20 officers and soldiers paddling, 30 officers and soldiers holding spears, and there were flags in front and behind; As soon as they reached the top of the mountain, the gentlemen and scholars had lined up on the shore to greet them, and after most of the day, two middle-aged fat men appeared from the largest ship, surrounded by about twenty warriors wearing tiger skins, and went to the stone house at the highest point with the people who welcomed them.大家在水陆两面，探头探脑的悉心打听，才明白原来那两位只是考察的专员，却并非禹自己。
Everyone inquired carefully on both land and water, and only then did they realize that the two were just commissioners for inspection, not Yu himself.大员坐在石屋的中央，吃过面包，就开始考察。
The senior sat in the center of the stone house, ate the bread, and began to investigate.“灾情倒并不算重，粮食也还可敷衍，”一位学者们的代表，苗民言语学专家说。“面包是每月会从半空中掉下来的；鱼也不缺，虽然未免有些泥土气，可是很肥，大人。至于那些下民，他们有的是榆叶和海苔，他们‘饱食终日，无所用心’，——就是并不劳心，原只要吃这些就够。我们也尝过了，味道倒并不坏，特别得很……”
"The disaster is not serious, and the food is perfunctory," said a representative of the scholars, an expert in Miao linguistics. "Bread falls from mid-air every month; There is no shortage of fish, although it is a little earthy, but it is very fat, adult. As for those servants, they have elm leaves and seaweed, and they 'eat all day long, with no intention',—— they just don't bother, just eat these. We have also tasted it, and it tastes not bad, very ......"“况且，”别一位研究《神农本草》的学者抢着说，“榆叶里面是含有维他命W的；海苔里有碘质，可医瘰疬病，两样都极合于卫生。”
"Moreover," another scholar who studies "Shennong's Materia Medica" rushed to say, "Elm leaves contain vitamin W; Seaweed contains iodine, which can treat scrofula, and both are very suitable for hygiene. ”“O．K！”又一个学者说。大员们瞪了他一眼。
“O． K！ Another scholar said. The members glared at him.“饮料呢，”那《神农本草》学者接下去道，“他们要多少有多少，一万代也喝不完。可惜含一点黄土，饮用之前，应该蒸馏一下的。敝人指导过许多次了，然而他们冥顽不灵，绝对的不肯照办，于是弄出数不清的病人来……”
"What about drinks," the scholar of "Shennong's Materia Medica" continued, "They want as much as they want, and they can't drink it for ten thousand generations." It's a pity that it contains a little loess, which should be distilled before drinking. We have guided many times, but they are stubborn and absolutely refuse to do so, so they have brought out countless patients to ......."“就是洪水，也还不是他们弄出来的吗？”一位五绺长须，身穿酱色长袍的绅士又抢着说。“水还没来的时候，他们懒着不肯填，洪水来了的时候，他们又懒着不肯戽……”
"It's a flood, isn't it made by them?" A gentleman with a long beard and a sauce-colored robe rushed to say again. "When the water didn't come, they were too lazy to fill it, and when the flood came, they were too lazy to ...... it."“是之谓失其性灵，”坐在后一排，八字胡子的伏羲朝小品文学家笑道。“吾尝登帕米尔之原，天风浩然，梅花开矣，白云飞矣，金价涨矣，耗子眠矣，见一少年，口衔雪茄，面有蚩尤氏之雾……哈哈哈！没有法子……”
"It's called losing its spirit," laughed the Fuxi Dynasty sketch writer sitting in the back row. "I once climbed the Pamir Plain, the wind was strong, the plum blossoms were blooming, the white clouds were flying, the price of gold was rising, and the rats were sleeping, and I saw a young man with a cigar in his mouth and a mist on his face...... Hahaha! There is no way......"“O．K！”
“O． K！ ”这样的谈了小半天。大员们都十分用心的听着，临末是叫他们合拟一个公呈，最好还有一种条陈，沥述着善后的方法。
We talked like this for a long time. The officials listened very attentively, and at the end of the day, they were asked to draft a public presentation, and it was best to have a statement that explained the method of aftermath.于是大员们下船去了。第二天，说是因为路上劳顿，不办公，也不见客；第三天是学者们公请在最高峰上赏偃盖古松，下半天又同往山背后钓黄鳝，一直玩到黄昏。第四天，说是因为考察劳顿了，不办公，也不见客；第五天的午后，就传见下民的代表。
So the officers got off the boat. the next day, he said that it was because he was tired on the road, did not work, and did not see guests; On the third day, scholars were invited to enjoy the ancient pines on the highest peak, and in the second half of the day, they went to the back of the mountain to fish for yellow eels until dusk. On the fourth day, it is said that it is because of the fatigue of the inspection, and there is no office, nor does it see guests; On the afternoon of the fifth day, it was rumored that representatives of the common people were heard.下民的代表，是四天以前就在开始推举的，然而谁也不肯去，说是一向没有见过官。于是大多数就推定了头有疙瘩的那一个，以为他曾有见过官的经验。已经平复下去的疙瘩，这时忽然针刺似的痛起来了，他就哭着一口咬定：做代表，毋宁死！大家把他围起来，连日连夜的责以大义，说他不顾公益，是利己的个人主义者，将为华夏所不容；激烈点的，还至于捏起拳头，伸在他的鼻子跟前，要他负这回的水灾的责任。他渴睡得要命，心想与其逼死在木排上，还不如冒险去做公益的牺牲，便下了绝大的决心，到第四天，答应了。
The representatives of the common people began to be elected four days ago, but no one was willing to go, saying that they had never seen an official. So most of them assumed that the one with the pimple on his head thought that he had the experience of seeing officials. The pimple that had calmed down suddenly hurt like a needle prick, and he cried and insisted: Be a representative, rather than die! Everyone surrounded him and blamed him for day and night, saying that he disregarded the public welfare and was a self-interested individualist who would be tolerated by China; The more intense ones were even clenched into fists and stretched out in front of his nose, asking him to take responsibility for the flood. He was so thirsty that he thought that instead of being forced to die on a wooden raft, it would be better to take the risk of making sacrifices for the public welfare, so he made great determination and agreed on the fourth day.大家就都称赞他，但几个勇士，却又有些妒忌。
Everyone praised him, but a few warriors were a little jealous.就是这第五天的早晨，大家一早就把他拖起来，站在岸上听呼唤。果然，大员们呼唤了。他两腿立刻发抖，然而又立刻下了绝大的决心，决心之后，就又打了两个大呵欠，肿着眼眶，自己觉得好像脚不点地，浮在空中似的走到官船上去了。
On the morning of the fifth day, everyone dragged him up early in the morning and stood on the shore listening to the call. Sure enough, the officials called. His legs trembled immediately, but he immediately made great determination, and after making up his mind, he yawned twice, his eyes were swollen, and he felt as if his feet were not touching the ground, and he walked to the official ship as if he were floating in the air.奇怪得很，持矛的官兵，虎皮的武士，都没有打骂他，一直放进了中舱。舱里铺着熊皮，豹皮，还挂着几副弩箭，摆着许多瓶罐，弄得他眼花缭乱。定神一看，才看见在上面，就是自己的对面，坐着两位胖大的官员。什么相貌，他不敢看清楚。
It was very strange that the officers and soldiers with spears and the warriors in tiger skins did not beat and scold him, and kept putting him in the middle cabin. The cabin was covered with bear skins, leopard skins, and a few pairs of crossbow arrows, and many bottles and cans, which dazzled him. When he looked at it carefully, he saw two fat officials sitting on the opposite side of him. He didn't dare to see what it looked like.“你是百姓的代表吗？”大员中的一个问道。
"Are you a representative of the people?" One of the senior members asked.“他们叫我上来的。”他眼睛看着铺在舱底上的豹皮的艾叶一般的花纹，回答说。

Four禹爷走后，时光也过得真快，不知不觉间，京师的景况日见其繁盛了。首先是阔人们有些穿了茧绸袍，后来就看见大水果铺里卖着橘子和柚子，大绸缎店里挂着华丝葛；富翁的筵席上有了好酱油，清炖鱼翅，凉拌海参；再后来他们竟有熊皮褥子狐皮褂，那太太也戴上赤金耳环银手镯了。

However, the news about Master Yu has also increased along with the entry of treasures into Beijing. In front of the eaves, under the trees on the side of the road, everyone is talking about his story; The most important thing is how he turned into a yellow bear at night, using his mouth and claws to dredge the nine rivers one arch after another, and how he invited heavenly soldiers and generals to catch the monster Wuzhi Qi who was making waves and was stationed at the foot of Turtle Mountain. The matter of Emperor Shun, but no one mentioned it anymore, at most, it was just talking about Prince Danzhu's lack of prospects.禹要回京的消息，原已传布得很久了，每天总有一群人站在关口，看可有他的仪仗的到来。并没有。然而消息却愈传愈紧，也好像愈真。一个半阴半晴的上午，他终于在百姓们的万头攒动之间，进了冀州的帝都了。前面并没有仪仗，不过一大批乞丐似的随员。临末是一个粗手粗脚的大汉，黑脸黄须，腿弯微曲，双手捧着一片乌黑的尖顶的大石头——舜爷所赐的“玄圭”，连声说道“借光，借光，让一让，让一让”，从人丛中挤进皇宫里去了。
The news that Yu was going to return to Beijing had been spread for a long time, and there was always a group of people standing at the pass every day to see the arrival of his honor guard. Nope. However, the news is getting tighter and more true. On a half-cloudy and half-sunny morning, he finally entered the imperial capital of Jizhou amidst the crowding of the people. There was no ceremonial guard in front, but a large number of beggar-like entourage. At the end of the day was a big man with rough hands and feet, with a black face and yellow beard, slightly bent legs, holding a large stone with a black spire in both hands - the "Xuan Gui" given by Shun Ye, and repeatedly said, "Borrow light, borrow light, let go, let go", and squeezed into the palace from the crowd.百姓们就在宫门外欢呼，议论，声音正好像浙水的涛声一样。
The people cheered and discussed outside the palace gate, and their voices were like the waves of Zhejiang River.舜爷坐在龙位上，原已有了年纪，不免觉得疲劳，这时又似乎有些惊骇。禹一到，就连忙客气的站起来，行过礼，皋陶先去应酬了几句，舜才说道：
Shun Ye sat on the dragon seat, he was already old, and he couldn't help but feel tired, and he seemed to be a little frightened at this time. As soon as Yu arrived, he quickly stood up politely and saluted, Gao Yao went to socialize a few words first, and Shun said:“你也讲几句好话我听呀。”
"You can also say a few good words to me."“哼，我有什么说呢？”禹简截的回答道。“我就是想，每天孳孳！”
"Hmph, what do I have to say?" Yu replied briefly. "I just want to work every day!"“什么叫作‘孳孳’？”皋陶问。
"What is called 'breeding'?" Gao Yao asked.“洪水滔天，”禹说，“浩浩怀山襄陵，下民都浸在水里。我走旱路坐车，走水路坐船，走泥路坐橇，走山路坐轿。到一座山，砍一通树，和益俩给大家有饭吃，有肉吃。放田水入川，放川水入海，和稷俩给大家有难得的东西吃。东西不够，就调有余，补不足。搬家。大家这才静下来了，各地方成了个样子。”
"The flood was monstrous," Yu said, "and the people were immersed in the water." I take a car on a dry road, a boat on a water road, a sled on a dirt road, and a sedan on a mountain road. Go to a mountain, cut down a tree, and give everyone food and meat. Put the field water into the river, put the river water into the sea, and give everyone rare things to eat. If there are not enough things, there is more than enough to make up for the deficiency. Uproot. Only then did everyone calm down, and the places became the same. ”“对啦对啦，这些话可真好！”皋陶称赞道。
"Yes, yes, these words are so good!" Gao Yao praised.“唉！”禹说。“做皇帝要小心，安静。对天有良心，天才会仍旧给你好处！”
"Alas!" Yu said. "Be careful and quiet as an emperor. If you have a conscience to the sky, the genius will still give you benefits! ”舜爷叹一口气，就托他管理国家大事，有意见当面讲，不要背后说坏话。看见禹都答应了，又叹一口气，道：“莫像丹朱的不听话，只喜欢游荡，旱地上要撑船，在家里又捣乱，弄得过不了日子，这我可真看的不顺眼！”
Shun Ye sighed and asked him to manage national affairs, and if he had any opinions, he would speak ill of them behind his back. Seeing that Yu agreed, he sighed again and said, "Don't be disobedient like Danzhu, he only likes to wander, he has to support a boat on dry land, and he makes trouble at home, so he can't get by, which is really not pleasing to the eye!" ”“我讨过老婆，四天就走，”禹回答说。“生了阿启，也不当他儿子看。所以能够治了水，分作五圈，简直有五千里，计十二州，直到海边，立了五个头领，都很好。只是有苗可不行，你得留心点！”
"I have asked for a wife and will leave in four days," Yu replied. "Giving birth to Ah Qi is not his son. Therefore, it is very good to be able to cure the water and divide it into five circles, which is simply five thousand miles, twelve states, and five leaders are set up until the seaside. It's just that seedlings can't be used, you have to be careful! ”“我的天下，真是全仗的你的功劳弄好的！”舜爷也称赞道。

So Gao Yao was also in awe with Shun Ye and bowed his head; After retiring from the court, he quickly issued a special order, asking the people to learn from Yu's behavior, otherwise, they would immediately be considered guilty.这使商家首先起了大恐慌。但幸而禹爷自从回京以后，态度也改变一点了：吃喝不考究，但做起祭祀和法事来，是阔绰的；衣服很随便，但上朝和拜客时候的穿著，是要漂亮的。所以市面仍旧不很受影响，不多久，商人们就又说禹爷的行为真该学，皋爷的新法令也很不错；终于太平到连百兽都会跳舞，凤凰也飞来凑热闹了。
This caused a big panic among merchants in the first place. But fortunately, since Master Yu returned to Beijing, his attitude has changed a little: he is not exquisite in eating and drinking, but he is generous when it comes to sacrifices and rituals; The clothes are very casual, but they should be beautiful when going to court and visiting guests. Therefore, the market was still not very affected, and not long after, the merchants said that Yu Ye's behavior should really be learned, and Gao's new decree was also very good; Finally, it was so peaceful that even the beasts could dance, and the phoenix flew in to join in the fun.一九三五年十一月作。

One这半年来，不知怎的连养老堂里也不大平静了，一部分的老头子，也都交头接耳，跑进跑出的很起劲。只有伯夷最不留心闲事，秋凉到了，他又老的很怕冷，就整天的坐在阶沿上晒太阳，纵使听到匆忙的脚步声，也决不抬起头来看。
In the past six months, somehow even the nursing home has not been very peaceful, and some old men have also listened to each other, running in and out very vigorously. Only Bo Yi was the least concerned about idle things, when the autumn coolness came, he was old and afraid of the cold, so he sat on the edge of the steps all day long to bask in the sun, even if he heard the sound of hurried footsteps, he would never raise his head to see.“大哥！”
"Big brother!"一听声音自然就知道是叔齐。伯夷是向来最讲礼让的，便在抬头之前，先站起身，把手一摆，意思是请兄弟在阶沿上坐下。
As soon as you hear the voice, you naturally know that it is Shu Qi. Bo Yi has always been the most courteous, so before looking up, he stood up and waved his hand, which meant asking his brother to sit down on the edge of the steps.“大哥，时局好像不大好！”叔齐一面并排坐下去，一面气喘吁吁的说，声音有些发抖。
"Big brother, the situation doesn't seem to be good!" Shu Qi sat down side by side, panting and saying, his voice trembling a little.“怎么了呀？”伯夷这才转过脸去看，只见叔齐的原是苍白的脸色，好像更加苍白了。
"What's wrong?" Bo Yi turned his face to look, only to see that Shu Qi's original pale face seemed to be even paler.“您听到过从商王那里，逃来两个瞎子的事了罢。”
"You have heard about two blind men escaping from the King of Shang."“唔，前几天，散宜生好像提起过。我没有留心。”
"Well, a few days ago, San Yisheng seemed to have mentioned it. I didn't pay attention. ”“我今天去拜访过了。一个是太师疵，一个是少师强，还带来许多乐器。听说前几时还开过一个展览会，参观者都‘啧啧称美’，——不过好像这边就要动兵了。”

"It is not in line with the way of the former kings to mobilize troops for musical instruments." Bo Yi said slowly.“也不单为了乐器。您不早听到过商王无道，砍早上渡河不怕水冷的人的脚骨，看看他的骨髓，挖出比干王爷的心来，看它可有七窍吗？先前还是传闻，瞎子一到，可就证实了。况且还切切实实的证明了商王的变乱旧章。变乱旧章，原是应该征伐的。不过我想，以下犯上，究竟也不合先王之道……”
"Not just for musical instruments. Haven't you heard that the Shang king is unreasonable, cutting the foot bones of people who cross the river in the morning and are not afraid of cold water, look at his bone marrow, dig out the heart of Prince Bigan, and see if it has seven orifices? It was still a rumor before, but as soon as the blind man arrived, it was confirmed. Moreover, it also truly proves the old chapter of the Shang king's chaos. Changing the old chapter should have been conquered. But I think the following is not in line with the way of the former kings......"“近来的烙饼，一天一天的小下去了，看来确也像要出事情，”伯夷想了一想，说。“但我看你还是少出门，少说话，仍旧每天练你的太极拳的好！”
"The pancakes have been getting smaller day by day, and it seems that something is going to happen," Bo Yi thought for a moment and said. "But I think you should go out less, talk less, and still practice your Tai Chi every day!"“是……”叔齐是很悌的，应了半声。
"Yes......" Shu Qi was very friendly and responded with half a voice.“你想想看，”伯夷知道他心里其实并不服气，便接着说。“我们是客人，因为西伯肯养老，呆在这里的。烙饼小下去了，固然不该说什么，就是事情闹起来了，也不该说什么的。”
"Think about it," Bo Yi knew that he was actually not convinced in his heart, so he continued. "We are guests because we are retired and stay here. The pancake is small, of course, I shouldn't say anything, even if things are in trouble, I shouldn't say anything. ”“那么，我们可就成了为养老而养老了。”
"Then, we will become pensioners for the sake of retirement."“最好是少说话。我也没有力气来听这些事。”
"It's better to talk less. I don't have the strength to listen to these things. ”伯夷咳了起来，叔齐也不再开口。咳嗽一止，万籁寂然，秋末的夕阳，照着两部白胡子，都在闪闪的发亮。
Bo Yi coughed, and Shu Qi stopped speaking. As soon as the cough stopped, everything was silent, and the sunset at the end of autumn was shining brightly on the two white beards.

After about one hundred and three or four flatbreads, the status quo has not changed, and the spectators have gradually dispersed. After a long time, two old men came limping with a door panel, and there was a layer of straw on the board: this is still the old rule of respecting the elderly set by King Wen. As soon as the board was placed on the ground, there was a snort, and Bo Yi suddenly opened his eyes: he woke up. Shu Qi shouted in surprise, helped the two people gently carry Bo Yi onto the door panel and carried him to the retirement hall; I was standing next to him and holding on to the hemp rope hanging from the door panel.走了六七十步路，听得远远地有人在叫喊：
After walking sixty or seventy steps, I heard someone shouting in the distance:“您哪！等一下！姜汤来哩！”望去是一位年青的太太，手里端着一个瓦罐子，向这面跑来了，大约怕姜汤泼出罢，她跑得不很快。
"You! Wait a minute! Ginger soup is coming! It looked like a young lady, holding a clay pot in her hand, ran towards this side, probably afraid that the ginger soup would spill out, and she didn't run fast.大家只得停住，等候她的到来。叔齐谢了她的好意。她看见伯夷已经自己醒来了，似乎很有些失望，但想了一想，就劝他仍旧喝下去，可以暖暖胃。然而伯夷怕辣，一定不肯喝。
Everyone had to stop and wait for her arrival. Uncle Qi thanked her for her kindness. She seemed a little disappointed to see that Bo Yi had woken up on her own, but after thinking about it, she persuaded him to still drink it to warm his stomach. However, Bo Yi was afraid of spicy food and would definitely refuse to drink it.“这怎么办好呢？还是八年陈的老姜熬的呀。别人家还拿不出这样的东西来呢。我们的家里又没有爱吃辣的人……”她显然有点不高兴。
"What should I do? It's still eight years old ginger. Other people can't come up with such a thing. We don't have anyone who loves spicy food in our family......" She was obviously a little unhappy.叔齐只得接了瓦罐，做好做歹的硬劝伯夷喝了一口半，余下的还很多，便说自己也正在胃气痛，统统喝掉了。眼圈通红的，恭敬的夸赞了姜汤的力量，谢了那太太的好意之后，这才解决了这一场大纠纷。
Shu Qi had to take the clay pot, and persuaded Bo Yi to take a sip and a half, and there were still a lot left, so he said that he was also having a stomach ache and drank them all. His eyes were red, and he respectfully praised the power of Jiang Tang, and after thanking the wife for her kindness, this big dispute was resolved.他们回到养老堂里，倒也并没有什么余病，到第三天，伯夷就能够起床了，虽然前额上肿着一大块——然而胃口坏。
They returned to the nursing home, but there were no other ailments, and by the third day, Bo Yi was able to get up, although there was a large lump on his forehead - but his appetite was bad.官民们都不肯给他们超然，时时送来些搅扰他们的消息，或者是官报，或者是新闻。十二月底，就听说大军已经渡了盟津，诸侯无一不到。不久也送了武王的《太誓》的钞本来。这是特别钞给养老堂看的，怕他们眼睛花，每个字都写得有核桃一般大。不过伯夷还是懒得看，只听叔齐朗诵了一遍，别的倒也并没有什么，但是“自弃其先祖肆祀不答，昏弃其家国……”这几句，断章取义，却好像很伤了自己的心。
The officials and the people refused to give them detachment, and sent some news that disturbed them from time to time, either official newspapers or news. At the end of December, I heard that the army had crossed Mengjin, and all the princes had arrived. Soon he also sent the banknote of King Wu's "Tai Oath". This is a special bill for the nursing home, for fear that their eyes will be dazzled, and every word is written as big as a walnut. However, Bo Yi was still too lazy to read, and only listened to Shu Qi recite it once, and there was nothing else, but the sentences "abandoning his ancestors and not answering, abandoning his family and country......" were taken out of context, but they seemed to hurt his heart very much.传说也不少：有的说，周师到了牧野，和纣王的兵大战，杀得他们尸横遍野，血流成河，连木棍也浮起来，仿佛水上的草梗一样；有的却道纣王的兵虽然有七十万，其实并没有战，一望见姜太公带着大军前来，便回转身，反替武王开路了。
There are also many legends: some say that when the Zhou army arrived in Muye, he fought with the soldiers of King Zhou, killing them so that their corpses were all over the field, blood flowed into rivers, and even wooden sticks floated, like grass stalks on the water; Some said that although King Zhou's soldiers numbered 700,000, they did not actually fight, and when they saw Jiang Taigong coming with a large army, they turned around and opened the way for King Wu.这两种传说，固然略有些不同，但打了胜仗，却似乎确实的。此后又时时听到运来了鹿台的宝贝，巨桥的白米，就更加证明了得胜的确实。伤兵也陆陆续续的回来了，又好像还是打过大仗似的。凡是能够勉强走动的伤兵，大抵在茶馆，酒店，理发铺，以及人家的檐前或门口闲坐，讲述战争的故事，无论那里，总有一群人眉飞色舞的在听他。春天到了，露天下也不再觉得怎么凉，往往到夜里还讲得很起劲。
These two legends, although slightly different, seem to be true after winning the battle. Since then, I have heard from time to time that the treasure of Lutai and the white rice of the bridge have been transported, which further proves that victory is indeed true. The wounded soldiers also came back one after another, as if they had fought a big battle. All the wounded soldiers who could barely move around usually sat idly in teahouses, hotels, barbershops, and in front of the eaves or doors of people's houses, telling the story of the war. When spring comes, it no longer feels cold in the open air, and it often talks very energetically at night.伯夷和叔齐都消化不良，每顿总是吃不完应得的烙饼；睡觉还照先前一样，天一暗就上床，然而总是睡不着。伯夷只在翻来覆去，叔齐听了，又烦躁，又心酸，这时候，他常是重行起来，穿好衣服，到院子里去走走，或者练一套太极拳。
Bo Yi and Shu Qi both have indigestion and always can't finish the pancakes they deserve at every meal; I slept as before, going to bed as soon as it got dark, but I always couldn't sleep. Bo Yi was only tossing and turning, Shu Qi listened, irritable and sad, at this time, he often got up again, got dressed, went for a walk in the yard, or practiced a set of Tai Chi.有一夜，是有星无月的夜。大家都睡得静静的了，门口却还有人在谈天。叔齐是向来不偷听人家谈话的，这一回可不知怎的，竟停了脚步，同时也侧着耳朵。
There was a night when there were stars and no moon. Everyone slept quietly, but there were still people talking at the door. Shu Qi has never eavesdropped on other people's conversations, but this time, somehow, he stopped and tilted his ears at the same time.“妈的纣王，一败，就奔上鹿台去了，”说话的大约是回来的伤兵。“妈的，他堆好宝贝，自己坐在中央，就点起火来。”
"Damn, King Zhou, as soon as he was defeated, he ran to Lutai," the person who spoke was about the wounded soldier who came back. "Damn, he piled up the treasure, sat in the center by himself, and lit a fire."“阿唷，这可多么可惜呀！”这分明是管门人的声音。
"Ah, what a pity!" This is clearly the voice of the gatekeeper.“不慌！只烧死了自己，宝贝可没有烧哩。咱们大王就带着诸侯，进了商国。他们的百姓都在郊外迎接，大王叫大人们招呼他们道：‘纳福呀！’他们就都磕头。一直进去，但见门上都贴着两个大字道：‘顺民’。大王的车子一径走向鹿台，找到纣王自寻短见的处所，射了三箭……”
"Don't panic! Only burned himself, the baby didn't burn. Our king took the princes and entered the Shang Kingdom. Their people greeted them in the outskirts, and the king called the adults to greet them and said, 'O Nafu! They all kowtowed. I went in, but I saw two big characters on the door: 'Shunmin'. The king's car went straight to Lutai, found the place where the king was short-sighted, and shot three arrows......"“为什么呀？怕他没有死吗？”别一人问道。
"Why? Are you afraid that he is not dead? Another person asked.“谁知道呢。可是射了三箭，又拔出轻剑来，一砍，这才拿了黄斧头，嚓！砍下他的脑袋来，挂在大白旗上。”
"Who knows. But after shooting three arrows, he pulled out a light sword and slashed it, and then took the yellow axe, huh! Cut off his head and hang it on the big white flag. ”叔齐吃了一惊。
Uncle Qi was taken aback.“之后就去找纣王的两个小老婆。哼，早已统统吊死了。大王就又射了三箭，拔出剑来，一砍，这才拿了黑斧头，割下她们的脑袋，挂在小白旗上。这么一来……”
After that, he went to find the two little wives of the king. Hmph, they have all been hanged. The king shot three more arrows, drew his sword, and slashed it, then took the black axe, cut off their heads, and hung them on the small white flag. In this way......“那两个姨太太真的漂亮吗？”管门人打断了他的话。
"Are those two aunts really beautiful?" The gatekeeper interrupted him.“知不清。旗杆子高，看的人又多，我那时金创还很疼，没有挤近去看。”
"I don't know. The flagpole was high, and there were many people watching, and I was still in pain at that time, so I didn't squeeze close to see it. ”“他们说那一个叫作妲己的是狐狸精，只有两只脚变不成人样，便用布条子裹起来：真的？”
They said that the one named Daji was a vixen, and only two feet became inhuman, so they wrapped them in cloth strips: Really?"“谁知道呢。我也没有看见她的脚。可是那边的娘儿们却真有许多把脚弄得好像猪蹄子的。”
"Who knows. I didn't see her feet either. But there are really many women over there who make their feet look like pig's trotters. ”叔齐是正经人，一听到他们从皇帝的头，谈到女人的脚上去了，便双眉一皱，连忙掩住耳朵，返身跑进房里去。伯夷也还没有睡着，轻轻的问道：
Shu Qi was a serious person, and as soon as he heard them talking about the woman's feet from the emperor's head, he frowned, quickly covered his ears, and turned around and ran into the room. Bo Yi was not asleep yet, and asked softly:“你又去练拳了么？”
"Have you gone to practice boxing again?"叔齐不回答，慢慢的走过去，坐在伯夷的床沿上，弯下腰，告诉了他刚才听来的一些话。这之后，两人都沉默了许多时，终于是叔齐很困难的叹一口气，悄悄的说道：
Shu Qi didn't answer, slowly walked over, sat on the edge of Bo Yi's bed, bent down, and told him some of the things he had just heard. After that, both of them were silent for a long time, and finally Shu Qi sighed with difficulty and said quietly:“不料竟全改了文王的规矩……你瞧罢，不但不孝，也不仁……这样看来，这里的饭是吃不得了。”
Unexpectedly, he changed all the rules of King Wen...... You see, not only is it unfilial, but it is also unkind...... In this way, the food here is inedible. ”“那么，怎么好呢？”伯夷问。
"So, what should I do?" Bo Yi asked.“我看还是走……”
"I think it's better to go......"于是两人商量了几句，就决定明天一早离开这养老堂，不再吃周家的大饼；东西是什么也不带。兄弟俩一同走到华山去，吃些野果和树叶来送自己的残年。况且“天道无亲，常与善人”，或者竟会有苍朮和茯苓之类也说不定。
So the two discussed a few words, and decided to leave the nursing home early tomorrow morning and no longer eat the Zhou family's flatbread; Bring nothing. The brothers walked to Huashan together and ate some wild fruits and leaves to send off their remaining years. Moreover, "the way of heaven has no relatives, often with good people", or there may be Cangshu and Poria and the like.打定主意之后，心地倒十分轻松了。叔齐重复解衣躺下，不多久，就听到伯夷讲梦话；自己也觉得很有兴致，而且仿佛闻到茯苓的清香，接着也就在这茯苓的清香中，沉沉睡去了。
After making up his mind, he felt very relaxed. Uncle Qi repeatedly undressed and lay down, and not long after, he heard Bo Yi talking in his sleep; I also felt very interested, and I seemed to smell the fragrance of Poria, and then I fell asleep in the fragrance of Poria.

采薇

四

采薇

Four第二天，兄弟俩都比平常醒得早，梳洗完毕，毫不带什么东西，其实也并无东西可带，只有一件老羊皮长袍舍不得，仍旧穿在身上，拿了拄杖，和留下的烙饼，推称散步，一径走出养老堂的大门；心里想，从此要长别了，便似乎还不免有些留恋似的，回过头来看了几眼。
The next day, the brothers woke up earlier than usual, freshened up, and didn't bring anything, in fact, there was nothing to bring, only an old sheepskin robe was reluctant, still wearing it, taking a cane, and the pancakes left behind, presuming to take a walk, and walking out of the door of the retirement hall; Thinking in his heart, he was going to say goodbye for a long time, so he seemed to be a little nostalgic, so he looked back and looked at it a few times.街道上行人还不多；所遇见的不过是睡眼惺忪的女人，在井边打水。将近郊外，太阳已经高升，走路的也多起来了，虽然大抵昂着头，得意洋洋的，但一看见他们，却还是照例的让路。树木也多起来了，不知名的落叶树上，已经吐着新芽，一望好像灰绿的轻烟，其间夹着松柏，在蒙胧中仍然显得很苍翠。
There are not many pedestrians on the streets; What I met was nothing more than a sleepy-eyed woman fetching water by the well. Near the suburbs, the sun has risen, and there are more people walking, although most of them hold their heads high and triumphant, but as soon as they see them, they still give way as usual. There are also more trees, and the unknown deciduous trees have spit out new shoots, which look like gray-green light smoke, with pines and cypresses in between, which still look very green in the haze.满眼是阔大，自由，好看，伯夷和叔齐觉得仿佛年青起来，脚步轻松，心里也很舒畅了。
The eyes are wide, free, and good-looking, and Bo Yi and Shu Qi feel as if they are young, their steps are relaxed, and their hearts are also very comfortable.到第二天的午后，迎面遇见了几条岔路，他们决不定走那一条路近，便检了一个对面走来的老头子，很和气的去问他。
By the afternoon of the next day, they encountered several forks in the road, and they were sure which road would be closer, so they checked an old man walking across and asked him very kindly.“阿呀，可惜，”那老头子说。“您要是早一点，跟先前过去的那队马跑就好了。现在可只得先走这条路。前面岔路还多，再问罢。”
"Oh, what a pity," said the old man. "If only you had run with the team that passed earlier. Now I have to go this way first. There are still many forks in the road ahead, so let's ask again. ”叔齐就记得了正午时分，他们的确遇见过几个废兵，赶着一大批老马，瘦马，跛脚马，癞皮马，从背后冲上来，几乎把他们踏死，这时就趁便问那老人，这些马是赶去做什么的。
Shu Qi remembered that at noon, they did meet a few useless soldiers, driving a large number of old horses, thin horses, lame horses, and leprosy horses, rushing up from behind and almost trampling them to death.“您还不知道吗？”那人答道。“我们大王已经‘恭行天罚’，用不着再来兴师动众，所以把马放到华山脚下去的。这就是‘归马于华山之阳’呀，您懂了没有？我们还在‘放牛于桃林之野’哩！吓，这回可真是大家要吃太平饭了。”
"Don't you know yet?" The man replied. "Our king has already 'carried out the punishment of heaven', and there is no need to mobilize troops again, so he put his horse at the foot of Mount Hua. This is 'returning to the sun of Mount Hua', do you understand?" We are still 'herding cattle in the peach forest'!" Scary, this time everyone really wants to eat a peaceful meal. ”然而这竟是兜头一桶冷水，使两个人同时打了一个寒噤，但仍然不动声色，谢过老人，向着他所指示的路前行。无奈这“归马于华山之阳”，竟踏坏了他们的梦境，使两个人的心里，从此都有些七上八下起来。
However, this was actually a bucket of cold water in the head, which made the two people shudder at the same time, but they remained calm, thanked the old man, and walked forward in the direction he instructed. Helplessly, this "returning to the sun of Huashan" actually ruined their dream, making the hearts of the two people a little up and down from then on.心里忐忑，嘴里不说，仍是走，到得傍晚，临近了一座并不很高的黄土冈，上面有一些树林，几间土屋，他们便在途中议定，到这里去借宿。
In the evening, they approached a not very high loess hill, with some woods and a few earthen houses, and they agreed on the way to stay here.离土冈脚还有十几步，林子里便窜出五个彪形大汉来，头包白布，身穿破衣，为首的拿一把大刀，另外四个都是木棍。一到冈下，便一字排开，拦住去路，一同恭敬的点头，大声吆喝道：
There were still more than ten steps away from the foot of the hill, and five burly men rushed out of the forest, wrapped in white cloth and wearing tattered clothes, the leader was holding a big knife, and the other four were wooden sticks. As soon as they arrived at the bottom of the hill, they lined up in a line, blocked the way, nodded respectfully together, and shouted loudly:“老先生，您好哇！”
"Old sir, hello!"他们俩都吓得倒退了几步，伯夷竟发起抖来，还是叔齐能干，索性走上前，问他们是什么人，有什么事。
Both of them were so frightened that they took a few steps back, and Bo Yi actually started to shake, but Shu Qi was capable, so he simply stepped forward and asked them who they were and what was going on.“小人就是华山大王小穷奇，”那拿刀的说，“带了兄弟们在这里，要请您老赏一点买路钱！”
"The villain is the king of Huashan, Xiao Qiongqi," the man with the knife said, "I brought my brothers here, and I want you to reward me with a little money to buy the road!" ”“我们那里有钱呢，大王。”叔齐很客气的说。“我们是从养老堂里出来的。”
"We have money there, my lord." Shu Qi said politely. "We came out of the nursing home."“阿呀！”小穷奇吃了一惊，立刻肃然起敬，“那么，您两位一定是‘天下之大老也’了。小人们也遵先王遗教，非常敬老，所以要请您老留下一点纪念品……”他看见叔齐没有回答，便将大刀一挥，提高了声音道：“如果您老还要谦让，那可小人们只好恭行天搜，瞻仰一下您老的贵体了！”
"Ah!" Xiao Qiongqi was taken aback and immediately awe-inspired, "Then, you two must be the 'great elders of the world'." The villains also follow the teachings of the former king and respect the elderly very much, so I would like to ask you to leave a little souvenir......" Seeing that Shu Qi did not answer, he waved his big knife and raised his voice: "If you are old and still have to be humble, then the villains have to search the sky and pay homage to your old noble body!" ”伯夷叔齐立刻擎起了两只手；一个拿木棍的就来解开他们的皮袍，棉袄，小衫，细细搜检了一遍。
Bo Yi Shu Qi immediately raised his two hands; A man with a wooden stick came to untie their leather robes, padded jackets, and shirts, and searched them carefully.“两个穷光蛋，真的什么也没有！”他满脸显出失望的颜色，转过头去，对小穷奇说。
"Two paupers, really nothing!" His face was full of disappointment, he turned his head and said to Xiao Qiongqi.小穷奇看出了伯夷在发抖，便上前去，恭敬的拍拍他肩膀，说道：
Xiao Qiongqi saw that Bo Yi was trembling, so he stepped forward, patted him on the shoulder respectfully, and said:“老先生，请您不要怕。海派会‘剥猪猡’，我们是文明人，不干这玩意儿的。什么纪念品也没有，只好算我们自己晦气。现在您只要滚您的蛋就是了！”
"Old sir, please don't be afraid. Shanghai will 'peel pigs and monkeys', we are civilized people, we don't do this thing. There are no souvenirs, so we have to count ourselves as bad luck. Now you just have to roll your balls! ”伯夷没有话好回答，连衣服也来不及穿好，和叔齐迈开大步，眼看着地，向前便跑。这时五个人都已经站在旁边，让出路来了。看见他们在面前走过，便恭敬的垂下双手，同声问道：
Bo Yi had nothing to answer, and he didn't even have time to put on his clothes, so he and Uncle Qi took big steps, and when they saw the ground, they ran forward. At this time, all five people were already standing beside them, making way out. Seeing them walking in front of them, he respectfully lowered his hands and asked in unison:“您走了？您不喝茶了么？”
"Are you gone? Don't you drink tea anymore? ”“不喝了，不喝了……”伯夷和叔齐且走且说，一面不住的点着头。
"Don't drink, don't drink......" Bo Yi and Shu Qi walked and said, nodding their heads incessantly.

采薇

五

采薇

Five“归马于华山之阳”和华山大王小穷奇，都使两位义士对华山害怕，于是从新商量，转身向北，讨着饭，晓行夜宿，终于到了首阳山。
"Returning to the sun of Huashan" and the king of Huashan, Xiao Qiongqi, both made the two righteous men afraid of Huashan, so they discussed it anew, turned north, begged for food, traveled in the morning and stayed overnight, and finally arrived at Shouyang Mountain.这确是一座好山。既不高，又不深，没有大树林，不愁虎狼，也不必防强盗：是理想的幽栖之所。两人到山脚下一看，只见新叶嫩碧，土地金黄，野草里开着些红红白白的小花，真是连看看也赏心悦目。他们就满心高兴，用拄杖点着山径，一步一步的挨上去，找到上面突出一片石头，好像岩洞的处所，坐了下来，一面擦着汗，一面喘着气。
This is indeed a good mountain. It is neither high nor deep, there are no big forests, no worries about tigers and wolves, and no need to guard against robbers: it is an ideal place to live. When the two went to the foot of the mountain, they saw that the new leaves were tender and green, the land was golden, and there were some red and white flowers blooming in the weeds, which was really pleasing to the eye. They were full of joy, pointed the trail with their canes, went up step by step, found a stone protruding from it, like a cave, and sat down, wiping their sweat and panting.这时候，太阳已经西沉，倦鸟归林，啾啾唧唧的叫着，没有上山时候那么清静了，但他们倒觉得也还新鲜，有趣。在铺好羊皮袍，准备就睡之前，叔齐取出两个大饭团，和伯夷吃了一饱。这是沿路讨来的残饭，因为两人曾经议定，“不食周粟”，只好进了首阳山之后开始实行，所以当晚把它吃完，从明天起，就要坚守主义，绝不通融了。
At this time, the sun had already set in the west, and the tired birds returned to the forest, chirping, not as quiet as when they went up the mountain, but they felt that it was still fresh and interesting. Before laying out the sheepskin robe and getting ready to go to bed, Uncle Qi took out two large rice balls and ate them with Bo Yi. This is the leftover food begged along the road, because the two had agreed that "not eating Zhou millet" had to be implemented after entering Shouyang Mountain, so after eating it that night, from tomorrow, we must stick to the principle and never be accommodating.他们一早就被乌老鸦闹醒，后来重又睡去，醒来却已是上午时分。伯夷说腰痛腿酸，简直站不起；叔齐只得独自去走走，看可有可吃的东西。他走了一些时，竟发见这山的不高不深，没有虎狼盗贼，固然是其所长，然而因此也有了缺点：下面就是首阳村，所以不但常有砍柴的老人或女人，并且有进来玩耍的孩子，可吃的野果子之类，一颗也找不出，大约早被他们摘去了。
They were woken up by the old crow early in the morning, and then fell asleep again, but when they woke up, it was already morning. Bo Yi said that his lower back hurts and his legs are sore, and he can't stand up; Shu Qi had to go for a walk alone to see if there was anything to eat. When he walked a little, he found that the mountain was neither high nor deep, and there were no tigers, wolves and thieves, which was certainly its strength, but it also had disadvantages: below was Shouyang Village, so not only were there often old people or women chopping wood, but there were also children who came in to play, and they couldn't find a single edible wild fruit, and they had picked it about a long time ago.他自然就想到茯苓。但山上虽然有松树，却不是古松，都好像根上未必有茯苓；即使有，自己也不带锄头，没有法子想。接着又想到苍朮，然而他只见过苍朮的根，毫不知道那叶子的形状，又不能把满山的草都拔起来看一看，即使苍朮生在眼前，也不能认识。心里一暴躁，满脸发热，就乱抓了一通头皮。
He naturally thought of Poria. But although there are pine trees on the mountain, they are not ancient pines, and they seem to have not necessarily Poria on the roots; Even if there is, I don't bring a hoe and I can't think about it. Then he thought of Cangshu, but he had only seen the roots of Cangshu, and he didn't know the shape of the leaves, and he couldn't pull up all the grass all over the mountain to take a look, even if Cangshu was born in front of him, he couldn't recognize it. As soon as he was irritable and his face was hot, he scratched his scalp.但是他立刻平静了，似乎有了主意，接着就走到松树旁边，摘了一衣兜的松针，又往溪边寻了两块石头，砸下松针外面的青皮，洗过，又细细的砸得好像面饼，另寻一片很薄的石片，拿着回到石洞去了。
But he immediately calmed down, seemed to have an idea, and then walked to the pine tree, picked a pine needle from his pocket, looked for two more stones by the stream, smashed the green skin on the outside of the pine needle, washed it, smashed it finely like a cake, and found another very thin stone chip, and took it back to the stone cave.“三弟，有什么捞儿没有？我是肚子饿的咕噜咕噜响了好半天了。”伯夷一望见他，就问。
"Third brother, is there anything to catch? I've been gurgling hungry for a long time. As soon as Bo Yi saw him, he asked.“大哥，什么也没有。试试这玩意儿罢。”
"Big brother, nothing. Just try this thing. ”他就近拾了两块石头，支起石片来，放上松针面，聚些枯枝，在下面生了火。实在是许多工夫，才听得湿的松针面有些吱吱作响，可也发出一点清香，引得他们俩咽口水。叔齐高兴得微笑起来了，这是姜太公做八十五岁生日的时候，他去拜寿，在寿筵上听来的方法。
He picked up two stones nearby, propped up the stone chips, put pine needles on them, gathered some dead branches, and lit a fire below. It took a lot of effort to hear that the wet pine needle surface creaked a little, but it also emitted a little fragrance, which made the two of them swallow. Shu Qi smiled happily, this is the method that Jiang Taigong heard at the birthday banquet when he went to pay his respects on his eighty-fifth birthday.发香之后，就发泡，眼见它渐渐的干下去，正是一块糕。叔齐用皮袍袖子裹着手，把石片笑嘻嘻的端到伯夷的面前。伯夷一面吹，一面拗，终于拗下一角来，连忙塞进嘴里去。
After the fragrance, it foamed, and seeing it gradually dry, it was a cake. Shu Qi wrapped his hands in the sleeves of his leather robe and brought the stone shards to Bo Yi with a smile. Bo Yi blew and twisted on the other, and finally twisted a corner and quickly stuffed it into his mouth.他愈嚼，就愈皱眉，直着脖子咽了几咽，倒哇的一声吐出来了，诉苦似的看着叔齐道：
The more he chewed, the more he frowned, swallowed a few times with his neck straight, and spat it out with a wow, looking at Uncle Qi as if complaining:“苦……粗……”
"Bitter ...... Thick ......"这时候，叔齐真好像落在深潭里，什么希望也没有了。抖抖的也拗了一角，咀嚼起来，可真也毫没有可吃的样子：苦……粗……
At this time, Shu Qi really seemed to have fallen into a deep pool, and there was no hope. The trembling one also twisted a corner, chewed it, but there was really nothing to eat: bitter ...... Coarse......叔齐一下子失了锐气，坐倒了，垂了头。然而还在想，挣扎的想，仿佛是在爬出一个深潭去。爬着爬着，只向前。终于似乎自己变了孩子，还是孤竹君的世子，坐在保姆的膝上了。这保姆是乡下人，在和他讲故事：黄帝打蚩尤，大禹捉无支祁，还有乡下人荒年吃薇菜。
Shu Qi suddenly lost his strength, sat down, and hung his head. However, still thinking, struggling, as if climbing out of a deep pool. Crawling and crawling, only forward. Finally, it seems that he has changed into a child, still the prince of Guzhujun, sitting on the lap of the nanny. This nanny was a countryman, telling him stories: the Yellow Emperor beat Chiyou, Dayu caught Wuzhiqi, and the countrymen ate Weicai in the famine.他又记得了自己问过薇菜的样子，而且山上正见过这东西。他忽然觉得有了气力，立刻站起身，跨进草丛，一路寻过去。
He remembered that he had asked about Wei Cai, and he had seen this thing on the mountain. He suddenly felt that he had strength, immediately stood up, stepped into the grass, and searched all the way.果然，这东西倒不算少，走不到一里路，就摘了半衣兜。
Sure enough, this thing is not small, and after walking less than a mile, he took off half of his pocket.他还是在溪水里洗了一洗，这才拿回来；还是用那烙过松针面的石片，来烤薇菜。叶子变成暗绿，熟了。但这回再不敢先去敬他的大哥了，撮起一株来，放在自己的嘴里，闭着眼睛，只是嚼。
He still washed it in the stream and then took it back; Or use the stone chips that have been baked with pine needle noodles to roast Weicai. The leaves turn dark green and ripe. "How is it?" Bo Yi asked anxiously.“鲜的！”
"Fresh!"两人就笑嘻嘻的来尝烤薇菜；伯夷多吃了两撮，因为他是大哥。
The two of them came to taste the roasted vegetables with a smile; Bo Yi ate two more pinches because he was the eldest brother.他们从此天天采薇菜。先前是叔齐一个人去采，伯夷煮；后来伯夷觉得身体健壮了一些，也出去采了。做法也多起来：薇汤，薇羹，薇酱，清炖薇，原汤焖薇芽，生晒嫩薇叶……
They have been picking weeds every day since then. Previously, Shu Qi went to pick alone, and Bo Yi cooked it; Later, Bo Yi felt that his body was a little stronger, so he went out to pick it. I moved home a few times, and then the result was the same. Shu Qi was afraid that Bo Yi would be too old and would accidentally have a stroke, so he tried his best to persuade him to sit at home, still serving as a cook, and let himself go to pick Wei alone.伯夷逊让了一番之后，倒也应允了，从此就较为安闲自在，然而首阳山上是有人迹的，他没事做，脾气又有些改变，从沉默成了多话，便不免和孩子去搭讪，和樵夫去扳谈。也许是因为一时高兴，或者有人叫他老乞丐的缘故罢，他竟说出了他们俩原是辽西的孤竹君的儿子，他老大，那一个是老三。父亲在日原是说要传位给老三的，一到死后，老三却一定向他让。他遵父命，省得麻烦，逃走了。不料老三也逃走了。两人在路上遇见，便一同来找西伯——文王，进了养老堂。又不料现在的周王竟“以臣弑君”起来，所以只好不食周粟，逃上首阳山，吃野菜活命……等到叔齐知道，怪他多嘴的时候，已经传播开去，没法挽救了。但也不敢怎么埋怨他；只在心里想：父亲不肯把位传给他，可也不能不说很有些眼力。

Shu Qi's prediction was not good: this result was very bad, not only did the village often talk about them, but there were also people who came up the mountain to see them. Some are celebrities, some are monsters, and some are antiques. Even follow how to pick, look around how to eat, point fingers, ask long and short questions, which is dizzying. And you have to be humble when dealing with it, if you are a little careless and frown, it is inevitable that some people will say that it is a "tantrum".不过舆论还是好的方面多。后来连小姐太太，也有几个人来看了，回家去都摇头，说是“不好看”，上了一个大当。

Later, even the young lady and several people came to see it, and when they went home, they all shook their heads, saying that it was "not good-looking", and they were fooled.终于还引动了首阳村的第一等高人小丙君。他原是妲己的舅公的干女婿，做着祭酒，因为知道天命有归，便带着五十车行李和八百个奴婢，来投明主了。可惜已在会师盟津的前几天，兵马事忙，来不及好好的安插，便留下他四十车货物和七百五十个奴婢，另外给予两顷首阳山下的肥田，叫他在村里研究八卦学。他也喜欢弄文学，村中都是文盲，不懂得文学概论，气闷已久，便叫家丁打轿，找那两个老头子，谈谈文学去了；尤其是诗歌，因为他也是诗人，已经做好一本诗集子。

He also liked to play literature, the village was illiterate, did not understand the introduction of literature, and had been depressed for a long time, so he asked the servants to take a sedan chair and find the two old men to talk about literature; Especially poetry, because he is also a poet, has already made a collection of poems.然而谈过之后，他一上轿就摇头，回了家，竟至于很有些气愤。他以为那两个家伙是谈不来诗歌的。第一、是穷：谋生之不暇，怎么做得出好诗？第二、是“有所为”，失了诗的“敦厚”；第三、是有议论，失了诗的“温柔”。尤其可议的是他们的品格，通体都是矛盾。于是他大义凛然的斩钉截铁的说道：

What is especially controversial is their character, which is full of contradictions. So he said righteously and decisively:“‘普天之下，莫非王土’，难道他们在吃的薇，不是我们圣上的吗！”

Wei, naturally I don't eat, I can't eat it, and I am shy even when I look at it, and I can't even raise my hand to move it away, I feel as if it weighs hundreds of pounds.

采薇

六

采薇

Six樵夫偶然发见了伯夷和叔齐都缩做一团，死在山背后的石洞里，是大约这之后的二十天。并没有烂，虽然因为瘦，但也可见死的并不久；老羊皮袍却没有垫着，不知道弄到那里去了。这消息一传到村子里，又哄动了一大批来看的人，来来往往，一直闹到夜。结果是有几个多事的人，就地用黄土把他们埋起来，还商量立一块石碑，刻上几个字，给后来好做古迹。
The woodcutter accidentally found that Bo Yi and Shu Qi were shrunk into a ball and died in the stone cave behind the mountain, about twenty days later. It is not rotten, although it is thin, but it can also be seen that death is not long in coming; The old sheepskin robe was not padded, and I don't know where it got it. As soon as the news reached the village, it stirred up a large number of people to come and go, coming and going, and made noise until night. As a result, a few meddlesome people buried them with loess on the spot, and also discussed erecting a stone monument and engraved a few words to make it a monument for the future.然而合村里没有人能写字，只好去求小丙君。
However, no one in Hecun could write, so he had to ask Xiao Bingjun.然而小丙君不肯写。
However, Xiao Bing refused to write.“他们不配我来写，”他说。“都是昏蛋。跑到养老堂里来，倒也罢了，可又不肯超然；跑到首阳山里来，倒也罢了，可是还要做诗；做诗倒也罢了，可是还要发感慨，不肯安分守己，‘为艺术而艺术’。你瞧，这样的诗，可是有永久性的：
"They didn't deserve me to write," he said. "They are all faint. running to the nursing home, it's okay, but he refuses to be detached; running to Shouyang Mountain, it's fine, but I still have to write poetry; It's okay to make poetry, but I still have to sigh, refuse to keep to myself, 'art for art'. You see, such a poem is permanent:上那西山呀采它的薇菜，Go up to the western mountain to pick its weeds, 
强盗来代强盗呀不知道这的不对。 The robbers come to replace the robbers, I don't know if this is wrong. 
神农虞夏一下子过去了，我又那里去呢？ Shennong Yuxia passed all of a sudden, where am I going? 
唉唉死罢，命里注定的晦气！ Alas, death is destined to be unlucky!
“你瞧，这是什么话？温柔敦厚的才是诗。他们的东西，却不但‘怨’，简直‘骂’了。没有花，只有刺，尚且不可，何况只有骂。即使放开文学不谈，他们撇下祖业，也不是什么孝子，到这里又讥讪朝政，更不像一个良民……我不写！……”
"Look, what is this? Gentle and honest is poetry. Their things are not only 'resentful', but simply 'scolded'. There are no flowers, only thorns, and it is not possible, let alone scolding. Even if literature is aside, they are not filial sons who leave their ancestral business, and they ridicule the government here, let alone a good citizen...... I don't write! ……”文盲们不大懂得他的议论，但看见声势汹汹，知道一定是反对的意思，也只好作罢了。伯夷和叔齐的丧事，就这样的算是告了一段落。
The illiterate people didn't understand his arguments, but when they saw the menacing momentum, they knew that it must mean opposition, so they had to give up. The funerals of Bo Yi and Shu Qi came to an end.然而夏夜纳凉的时候，有时还谈起他们的事情来。有人说是老死的，有人说是病死的，有人说是给抢羊皮袍子的强盗杀死的。后来又有人说其实恐怕是故意饿死的，因为他从小丙君府上的鸦头阿金姐那里听来：这之前的十多天，她曾经上山去奚落他们了几句，傻瓜总是脾气大，大约就生气了，绝了食撒赖，可是撒赖只落得一个自己死。
However, when they cool off on summer nights, they sometimes talk about them. Some say he died of old age, some say he died of illness, and some say he was killed by robbers who robbed sheepskin robes. Later, some people said that he was actually afraid that he starved to death on purpose, because he heard from Sister Ajin, the crow head of Xiao Bingjun's house: More than ten days ago, she had gone up the mountain to ridicule them a few words, and the fool was always tempered, and he was about angry and cut off the food of Sarai, but Sarai only ended up dying by himself.于是许多人就非常佩服阿金姐，说她很聪明，但也有些人怪她太刻薄。
So many people admire Sister Ah Jin very much, saying that she is very smart, but some people blame her for being too mean.阿金姐却并不以为伯夷叔齐的死掉，是和她有关系的。自然，她上山去开了几句玩笑，是事实，不过这仅仅是玩笑。那两个傻瓜发脾气，因此不吃薇菜了，也是事实，不过并没有死，倒招来了很大的运气。
Sister Ah Jin didn't think that Bo Yi Shuqi's death had something to do with her. Naturally, she went up the mountain and made a few jokes, which was true, but it was just a joke. It is also true that those two fools lost their temper and stopped eating Weicai, but they did not die, but they attracted a lot of luck.“老天爷的心肠是顶好的，”她说。“他看见他们的撒赖，快要饿死了，就吩咐母鹿，用它的奶去喂他们。您瞧，这不是顶好的福气吗？用不着种地，用不着砍柴，只要坐着，就天天有鹿奶自己送到你嘴里来。可是贱骨头不识抬举，那老三，他叫什么呀，得步进步，喝鹿奶还不够了。他喝着鹿奶，心里想，‘这鹿有这么胖，杀它来吃，味道一定是不坏的。’一面就慢慢的伸开臂膊，要去拿石片。可不知道鹿是通灵的东西，它已经知道了人的心思，立刻一溜烟逃走了。老天爷也讨厌他们的贪嘴，叫母鹿从此不要去。您瞧，他们还不只好饿死吗？那里是为了我的话，倒是为了自己的贪心，贪嘴呵！……”
"God's heart is good," she said. When he saw that their saliah was about to starve, he commanded the doe to feed them with its milk. Look, isn't this a great blessing? You don't need to farm, you don't need to chop wood, as long as you sit, deer milk will be delivered to your mouth every day. But the cheap bones don't know how to lift, the third child, what is his name, he has to make progress, drinking deer milk is not enough. He drank the deer milk and thought to himself, 'This deer is so fat, kill it to eat, it must not taste bad.' On the other hand, he slowly stretched out his arms and was going to get the stone chips. But I don't know that the deer is a psychic thing, it already knows people's minds, and immediately fled. God also hated their greedy mouths and told the doe not to go again. Look, don't they have to starve to death? It's for my words, but it's for my own greed, greedy! ……”听到这故事的人们，临末都深深的叹一口气，不知怎的，连自己的肩膀也觉得轻松不少了。即使有时还会想起伯夷叔齐来，但恍恍忽忽，好像看见他们蹲在石壁下，正在张开白胡子的大口，拚命的吃鹿肉。
People who heard this story sighed deeply at the end of the day, and somehow, even their shoulders felt a lot easier. Even if I sometimes think of Uncle Bo Yi coming together, I feel as if I see them squatting under the stone wall, opening their big mouths with white beards and eating venison desperately.一九三五年十二月作。
