Sword casting一
One眉间尺刚和他的母亲睡下，老鼠便出来咬锅盖，使他听得发烦。他轻轻地叱了几声，最初还有些效验，后来是简直不理他了，格支格支地径自咬。他又不敢大声赶，怕惊醒了白天做得劳乏，晚上一躺就睡着了的母亲。
As soon as he fell asleep with his mother, the mouse came out and bit the lid of the pot, making him annoyed. He scolded softly a few times, and at first it was somewhat effective, but then he simply ignored him and bit himself. He didn't dare to rush loudly, for fear of waking up his mother, who was tired during the day and fell asleep at night.许多时光之后，平静了；他也想睡去。忽然，扑通一声，惊得他又睁开眼。同时听到沙沙地响，是爪子抓着瓦器的声音。
After many times, it calmed down; He also wanted to sleep. Suddenly, with a plop, he opened his eyes again. At the same time, I heard a rustling sound, which was the sound of claws grasping the earthenware.“好！该死！”他想着，心里非常高兴，一面就轻轻地坐起来。
"Okay! Damn it! He thought, feeling very happy in his heart, and sat up gently.他跨下床，借着月光走向门背后，摸到钻火家伙，点上松明，向水瓮里一照。果然，一匹很大的老鼠落在那里面了；但是，存水已经不多，爬不出来，只沿着水瓮内壁，抓着，团团地转圈子。
He stepped out of bed, walked behind the door by the moonlight, touched the fire driller, lit a torch, and shone into the water urn. Sure enough, a big mouse landed on it; However, there is not much water stored in it, and it cannot be crawled out, so it only follows the inner wall of the water urn, grabbing it, and spinning in circles.“活该！”他一想到夜夜咬家具，闹得他不能安稳睡觉的便是它们，很觉得畅快。他将松明插在土墙的小孔里，赏玩着；然而那圆睁的小眼睛，又使他发生了憎恨，伸手抽出一根芦柴，将它直按到水底去。过了一会，才放手，那老鼠也随着浮了上来，还是抓着瓮壁转圈子。只是抓劲已经没有先前似的有力，眼睛也淹在水里面，单露出一点尖尖的通红的小鼻子，咻咻地急促地喘气。
"You deserve it!" He felt very happy when he thought that it was them that made him unable to sleep peacefully when he chewed furniture every night. He inserted the torch into the small hole in the earthen wall and enjoyed it; However, the small eyes that were round made him hate again, and he reached out and pulled out a reed firewood and pressed it straight to the bottom of the water. After a while, he let go, and the mouse also floated up, still holding on to the wall of the urn and spinning in circles. It's just that the grip is no longer as strong as before, and his eyes are also submerged in the water, revealing a little pointed red nose, panting rapidly.他近来很有点不大喜欢红鼻子的人。但这回见了这尖尖的小红鼻子，却忽然觉得它可怜了，就又用那芦柴，伸到它的肚下去，老鼠抓着，歇了一回力，便沿着芦干爬了上来。待到他看见全身，——湿淋淋的黑毛，大的肚子，蚯蚓似的尾巴，——便又觉得可恨可憎得很，慌忙将芦柴一抖，扑通一声，老鼠又落在水瓮里，他接着就用芦柴在它头上捣了几下，叫它赶快沉下去。
He has been a little disliking for people with red noses lately. But this time I saw this pointed little red nose, but I suddenly felt that it was pitiful, so I used the reed wood to reach its belly, the mouse grabbed it, took a break, and climbed up along the reed trunk. When he saw the wet black hair, big belly, and earthworm-like tail ,——all over his body,—— he felt hateful and hateful again, and hurriedly shook the reeds, plopped them, and the mouse fell into the water urn again.换了六回松明之后，那老鼠已经不能动弹，不过沉浮在水中间，有时还向水面微微一跳。眉间尺又觉得很可怜，随即折断芦柴，好容易将它夹了出来，放在地面上。老鼠先是丝毫不动，后来才有一点呼吸；又许多时，四只脚运动了，一翻身，似乎要站起来逃走。这使眉间尺大吃一惊，不觉提起左脚，一脚踏下去。只听得吱的一声，他蹲下去仔细看时，只见口角上微有鲜血，大概是死掉了。
After changing the torch six times, the mouse could no longer move, but it sank and floated in the water, sometimes jumping slightly towards the water. The ruler between the eyebrows felt very pitiful, and then broke the reeds, and finally picked it out and put it on the ground. The mouse did not move at first, and then breathed a little; Many times, the four feet moved, and when they turned over, they seemed to stand up and run away. This surprised the ruler between the eyebrows, and he lifted his left foot and stepped on it. He only heard a creak, and when he squatted down to take a closer look, he saw a little blood on the corner of his mouth, probably dead.他又觉得很可怜，仿佛自己作了大恶似的，非常难受。他蹲着，呆看着，站不起来。
He felt very pitiful, as if he had done a great evil, and it was very uncomfortable. He squatted, stared, and couldn't stand up.“尺儿，你在做什么？”他的母亲已经醒来了，在床上问。
"Chi'er, what are you doing?" His mother had woken up and asked in bed.“老鼠……。”他慌忙站起，回转身去，却只答了两个字。
"Mouse ......." He hurriedly stood up, turned around, but only answered two words.“是的，老鼠。这我知道。可是你在做什么？杀它呢，还是在救它？”
"Yes, mouse. I know this. But what are you doing? Kill it, or save it? ”他没有回答。松明烧尽了；他默默地立在暗中，渐看见月光的皎洁。
He didn't answer. The torch burned out; He stood silently in the dark, gradually seeing the brightness of the moonlight.“唉！”他的母亲叹息说，“一交子时，你就是十六岁了，性情还是那样，不冷不热地，一点也不变。看来，你的父亲的仇是没有人报的了。”
"Alas!" His mother sighed and said, "When you first met him, you were sixteen years old, and your temperament was still the same, lukewarm, and not at all. It seems that no one has avenged your father. ”他看见他的母亲坐在灰白色的月影中，仿佛身体都在颤动；低微的声音里，含着无限的悲哀，使他冷得毛骨悚然，而一转眼间，又觉得热血在全身中忽然腾沸。
He saw his mother sitting in the gray-white shadow of the moon, as if her body was trembling; In the low voice, there was infinite sadness, which made him feel creepy cold, and in the blink of an eye, he felt that his blood suddenly boiled in his body.“父亲的仇？父亲有什么仇呢？”他前进几步，惊急地问。
"Father's revenge? What hatred does my father have? He took a few steps forward and asked anxiously.“有的。还要你去报。我早想告诉你的了；只因为你太小，没有说。现在你已经成人了，却还是那样的性情。这教我怎么办呢？你似的性情，能行大事的么？”
"Yes. I still want you to report. I wanted to tell you a long time ago; Just because you are too young to say it. Now that you're an adult, you're still in that temperament. What does this teach me? Can you do great things with your temperament? ”“能。说罢，母亲。我要改过……。”
"Yes. After that, mother. I want to change ....... ”“自然。我也只得说。你必须改过……。那么，走过来罢。”
"Nature. I have to say it. You have to change ....... So, come here. ”他走过去；他的母亲端坐在床上，在暗白的月影里，两眼发出闪闪的光芒。
He walked over; His mother sat on the bed, her eyes shining brightly in the dark moonlight.“听哪！”她严肃地说，“你的父亲原是一个铸剑的名工，天下第一。他的工具，我早已都卖掉了来救了穷了，你已经看不见一点遗迹；但他是一个世上无二的铸剑的名工。二十年前，王妃生下了一块铁，听说是抱了一回铁柱之后受孕的，是一块纯青透明的铁。大王知道是异宝，便决计用来铸一把剑，想用它保国，用它杀敌，用它防身。不幸你的父亲那时偏偏入了选，便将铁捧回家里来，日日夜夜地锻炼，费了整三年的精神，炼成两把剑。
"Listen!" She said seriously, "Your father was originally a famous swordsmith, the best in the world." I have already sold all his tools to save the poor, and you can no longer see any relics; But he is a unique swordsmith in the world. Twenty years ago, the princess gave birth to a piece of iron, and I heard that she was conceived after hugging the iron pillar, and it was a piece of pure and transparent iron. The king knew that it was a rare treasure, so he decided to use it to cast a sword, wanting to use it to protect the country, use it to kill the enemy, and use it to defend himself. Unfortunately, your father was selected at that time, so he brought the iron back home, exercised day and night, and spent three years of energy to refine two swords.“当最末次开炉的那一日，是怎样地骇人的景象呵！哗拉拉地腾上一道白气的时候，地面也觉得动摇。那白气到天半便变成白云，罩住了这处所，渐渐现出绯红颜色，映得一切都如桃花。我家的漆黑的炉子里，是躺着通红的两把剑。你父亲用井华水慢慢地滴下去，那剑嘶嘶地吼着，慢慢转成青色了。这样地七日七夜，就看不见了剑，仔细看时，却还在炉底里，纯青的，透明的，正像两条冰。
"What a terrifying scene it was on the day of the last furnace opening! When a white gas rose with a loud noise, the ground also felt shaky. The white vapor turned into white clouds in the middle of the sky, covering the place, and gradually appeared a crimson color, reflecting everything like peach blossoms. In the dark stove of my house, there are two red swords lying. Your father slowly dripped down with well water, and the sword roared hissing, slowly turning blue. After seven days and nights like this, the sword was invisible, but when I looked closely, it was still at the bottom of the furnace, pure blue, transparent, just like two pieces of ice.“大欢喜的光采，便从你父亲的眼睛里四射出来；他取起剑，拂拭着，拂拭着。然而悲惨的皱纹，却也从他的眉头和嘴角出现了。他将那两把剑分装在两个匣子里。
"The brilliance of great joy shines out of your father's eyes; He picked up the sword and wiped it, wiped it. However, tragic wrinkles also appeared from the corners of his brow and mouth. He divided the two swords into two boxes.“‘你只要看这几天的景象，就明白无论是谁，都知道剑已炼就的了。’他悄悄地对我说。‘一到明天，我必须去献给大王。但献剑的一天，也就是我命尽的日子。怕我们从此要长别了。’
"'As long as you look at the scene of the past few days, you will understand that no matter who it is, you know that the sword has been refined.' He said to me quietly. 'Tomorrow I must go and offer it to the king.' But the day I offered my sword was the day my life ended. I'm afraid we will have to say goodbye from now on. ’“‘你……。’我很骇异，猜不透他的意思，不知怎么说的好。我只是这样地说：‘你这回有了这么大的功劳……。’
"'You .......' I was shocked, I couldn't guess what he meant, I didn't know how to say it. I just said, 'You have so much credit this time...... ’“‘唉！你怎么知道呢！’他说。‘大王是向来善于猜疑，又极残忍的。这回我给他炼成了世间无二的剑，他一定要杀掉我，免得我再去给别人炼剑，来和他匹敌，或者超过他。’
"'Alas! How do you know! He said. The king has always been suspicious and extremely cruel. This time I refined him into a sword that is unique in the world, and he must kill me, lest I go to refine the sword for others to match or surpass him. ’“我掉泪了。
"I burst into tears.“‘你不要悲哀。这是无法逃避的。眼泪决不能洗掉运命。我可是早已有准备在这里了！’他的眼里忽然发出电火似的光芒，将一个剑匣放在我膝上。‘这是雄剑。’他说。‘你收着。明天，我只将这雌剑献给大王去。倘若我一去竟不回来了呢，那是我一定不再在人间了。你不是怀孕已经五六个月了么？不要悲哀；待生了孩子，好好地抚养。一到成人之后，你便交给他这雄剑，教他砍在大王的颈子上，给我报仇！’”
"'Don't be sad. There is no escape. Tears must not wash away fate. I'm already ready here!" His eyes suddenly flashed like lightning, and he placed a sword box on my lap. 'This is a male sword. He said. You put it away. Tomorrow, I will only offer this female sword to the king. If I go and don't come back, then I must no longer be in the world. Aren't you pregnant for five or six months? Do not be sad; After giving birth, raise it well. As soon as you become an adult, you will give him this male sword and teach him to cut it on the king's neck and avenge me!" ’”“那天父亲回来了没有呢？”眉间尺赶紧问。
"Did my father come back that day?" The ruler between the eyebrows asked quickly.“没有回来！”她冷静地说。“我四处打听，也杳无消息。后来听得人说，第一个用血来饲你父亲自己炼成的剑的人，就是他自己——你的父亲。还怕他鬼魂作怪，将他的身首分埋在前门和后苑了！”
"Not back!" She said calmly. "I asked around, but there was no news. Later, I heard that the first person to feed your father's own sword with blood was himself, your father. I was afraid that he would be a ghost, so I buried his head in the front door and the back garden! ”眉间尺忽然全身都如烧着猛火，自己觉得每一枝毛发上都仿佛闪出火星来。他的双拳，在暗中捏得格格地作响。
The ruler between the eyebrows suddenly felt like a fierce fire, and he felt that every hair seemed to flash sparks. His fists were clenched in the dark.他的母亲站起了，揭去床头的木板，下床点了松明，到门背后取过一把锄，交给眉间尺道：“掘下去！”
His mother stood up, removed the wooden board at the head of the bed, got out of bed and lit a torch, went behind the door to take a hoe, handed it to the ruler between her eyebrows, and said, "Dig it down!" ”眉间尺心跳着，但很沉静的一锄一锄轻轻地掘下去。掘出来的都是黄土，约到五尺多深，土色有些不同了，似乎是烂掉的材木。
The ruler between his eyebrows was beating, but he dug down gently with a hoe and a hoe. What was dug out was loess, about five feet deep, and the color of the soil was a little different, and it seemed to be rotten wood.“看罢！要小心！”他的母亲说。
"Look! Be careful! His mother said.眉间尺伏在掘开的洞穴旁边，伸手下去，谨慎小心地撮开烂树，待到指尖一冷，有如触着冰雪的时候，那纯青透明的剑也出现了。他看清了剑靶，捏着，提了出来。
Lying down next to the dug cave, he stretched out his hand and carefully plucked the rotten tree, and when his fingertips were cold, as if touching ice and snow, the pure blue and transparent sword also appeared. He saw the sword target clearly, pinched it, and brought it out.窗外的星月和屋里的松明似乎都骤然失了光辉，惟有青光充塞宇内。那剑便溶在这青光中，看去好像一无所有。眉间尺凝神细视，这才仿佛看见长五尺余，却并不见得怎样锋利，剑口反而有些浑圆，正如一片韭叶。
The stars and moon outside the window and the torches in the house seemed to have suddenly lost their brilliance, but the blue light filled the world. The sword melted into this blue light, and it looked like there was nothing. The ruler between the eyebrows looked closely, and then it seemed to see that it was more than five feet long, but it was not necessarily so sharp, and the sword mouth was a little round, like a leek leaf.“你从此要改变你的优柔的性情，用这剑报仇去！”他的母亲说。
"From now on, you will change your gentle temperament and take revenge with this sword!" His mother said.“我已经改变了我的优柔的性情，要用这剑报仇去！”
"I have changed my indecisive temperament and want to take revenge with this sword!"“但愿如此。你穿了青衣，背上这剑，衣剑一色，谁也看不分明的。衣服我已经做在这里，明天就上你的路去罢。不要记念我！”她向床后的破衣箱一指，说。
"I hope so. You are wearing a green robe and carrying this sword on your back, and no one can see it clearly. I've already made the clothes here, and I'll go on your way tomorrow." Don't remember me! She pointed to the broken suitcase behind the bed and said.眉间尺取出新衣，试去一穿，长短正很合式。他便重行叠好，裹了剑，放在枕边，沉静地躺下。他觉得自己已经改变了优柔的性情；他决心要并无心事一般，倒头便睡，清晨醒来，毫不改变常态，从容地去寻他不共戴天的仇雠。
Take out the new clothes between your eyebrows and try on them, the length is just right. He folded it again, wrapped the sword, put it next to his pillow, and lay down quietly. He felt that he had changed his soft disposition; He was determined to have nothing to worry about, fell asleep, woke up in the morning, did not change his normality, and calmly went to find his sworn enemy.但他醒着。他翻来覆去，总想坐起来。他听到他母亲的失望的轻轻的长叹。他听到最初的鸡鸣；他知道已交子时，自己是上了十六岁了。
But he was awake. He tossed and turned, always wanting to sit up. He heard his mother's soft sigh of disappointment. He heard the first rooster's crow; When he knew that he had a son, he was sixteen years old.

The circle of people in front of them was shaken, and a black man squeezed in, with a black beard and black eyes, and was as thin as iron. He walked south; I thought to myself, the city is so lively, it is easy to get hurt by mistake, it is better to wait outside the south gate for him to come back and avenge his father, that place is sparsely populated, it is really easy to use. Lao Tzu sat in the center like a piece of wood, silent for a while, and then coughed a few times, and the lips inside the white beard were moving. Everyone immediately held their breath and listened with their ears sideways. I only heard him say slowly:“道可道，非常道；名可名，非常名。无名，天地之始；有名，万物之母。……”
"The Tao can be said, not the Tao; The name can be named, but it is not a name. Nameless, the beginning of heaven and earth; Famous is the mother of all things. ……”大家彼此面面相觑，没有抄。
Everyone looked at each other and did not copy.“故常无欲以观其妙，”老子接着说，“常有欲以观其窍。此两者，同出而异名。同，谓之玄，玄之又玄，众妙之门……”
“故常无欲以观其妙，”老子接着说，“常有欲以观其窍。 此两者，同出而异名。 同，谓之玄，玄之又玄，众妙之门……”大家显出苦脸来了，有些人还似乎手足失措。一个签子手打了一个大呵欠，书记先生竟打起磕睡来，哗啷一声，刀，笔，木札，都从手里落在席子上面了。
Everyone showed a bitter face, and some people seemed to be at a loss. A signer yawned, and the secretary fell asleep, and with a loud sound, the knife, pen, and wooden stick all fell on the mat from his hand.老子仿佛并没有觉得，但仿佛又有些觉得似的，因为他从此讲得详细了一点。然而他没有牙齿，发音不清，打着陕西腔，夹上湖南音，“哩”“呢”不分，又爱说什么“”：大家还是听不懂。可是时间加长了，来听他讲学的人，倒格外的受苦。
Lao Tzu didn't seem to feel it, but he seemed to feel a little more, because he talked a little more about it from then on. However, he has no teeth, his pronunciation is unclear, he plays in a Shaanxi accent, with a Hunan accent, "Li" and "Ni" are indistinguishable, and he likes to say what he likes to say "": everyone still can't understand. But as time went on, the people who came to listen to his lectures suffered extraordinarily.为面子起见，人们只好熬着，但后来总不免七倒八歪斜，各人想着自己的事，待到讲到“圣人之道，为而不争”，住了口了，还是谁也不动弹。老子等了一会，就加上一句道：
For the sake of face, people had to endure, but then they couldn't help but fall and slouch, everyone thought about their own affairs, and when they talked about "the way of the saints, for the sake of not fighting", they stopped, and no one moved. Lao Tzu waited for a while, and then added:“，完了！”
", it's over!"大家这才如大梦初醒，虽然因为坐得太久，两腿都麻木了，一时站不起身，但心里又惊又喜，恰如遇到大赦的一样。
Although they sat for too long, their legs were numb and they couldn't stand up for a while, but they were surprised and happy, just like encountering an amnesty.于是老子也被送到厢房里，请他去休息。他喝过几口白开水，就毫无动静的坐着，好像一段呆木头。
So Lao Tzu was also sent to the side room and asked him to rest. After drinking a few sips of plain water, he sat motionless like a piece of wood.人们却还在外面纷纷议论。过不多久，就有四个代表进来见老子，大意是说他的话讲的太快了，加上国语不大纯粹，所以谁也不能笔记。没有记录，可惜非常，所以要请他补发些讲义。
People are still talking about it outside. Not long after, four representatives came in to see Lao Tzu, to the effect that his words were spoken too quickly, and the Chinese was not very pure, so no one could take notes. There is no record, but unfortunately it is very good, so I want to ask him to reissue some handouts.“来笃话啥西，俺实直头听弗懂！”账房说。
"What are you talking about, I really don't understand!" The accountant said.“还是耐自家写子出来末哉。写子出来末，总算弗白嚼蛆一场哉啘。阿是？”书记先生道。
"It's still hard to write your own book. At the end of the book, I finally chewed maggots in vain. Ah? Mr. Secretary said.老子也不十分听得懂，但看见别的两个把笔，刀，木札，都摆在自己的面前了，就料是一定要他编讲义。他知道这是免不掉的，于是满口答应；不过今天太晚了，要明天才开手。
Lao Tzu didn't understand it very well, but when he saw the other two pens, knives, and wooden sticks in front of him, he expected that he would have to compile handouts. He knew that it was inevitable, so he agreed; But it's too late today, and we won't start until tomorrow.代表们认这结果为满意，退出去了。
The delegates were satisfied with the result and withdrew.第二天早晨，天气有些阴沉沉，老子觉得心里不舒适，不过仍须编讲义，因为他急于要出关，而出关，却须把讲义交卷。他看一眼面前的一大堆木札，似乎觉得更加不舒适了。
The next morning, the weather was a little gloomy, and Lao Tzu felt uncomfortable, but he still had to compile the handouts, because he was eager to leave the customs, and when he left the customs, he had to hand in the handouts. He glanced at the large pile of wooden slabs in front of him and seemed to feel even more uncomfortable.然而他还是不动声色，静静的坐下去，写起来。回忆着昨天的话，想一想，写一句。那时眼镜还没有发明，他的老花眼睛细得好像一条线，很费力；除去喝白开水和吃饽饽的时间，写了整整一天半，也不过五千个大字。
However, he remained calm, sat down quietly, and began to write. Recall yesterday's words, think about it, and write a sentence. At that time, glasses had not yet been invented, and his presbyopia eyes were as thin as a line, which was very laborious; Excluding the time spent drinking plain water and eating glutinous food, it took a whole day and a half to write, and it was only 5,000 big characters.“为了出关，我看这也敷衍得过去了。”他想。
"In order to get out of customs, I think this is perfunctory." He thought.于是取了绳子，穿起木札来，计两串，扶着拄杖，到关尹喜的公事房里去交稿，并且声明他立刻要走的意思。
So he took the rope, put on the wooden stick, counted two strings, held on the cane, went to Guan Yinxi's office to submit the manuscript, and declared that he was leaving immediately.关尹喜非常高兴，非常感谢，又非常惋惜，坚留他多住一些时，但看见留不住，便换了一副悲哀的脸相，答应了，命令巡警给青牛加鞍。一面自己亲手从架子上挑出一包盐，一包胡麻，十五个饽饽来，装在一个充公的白布口袋里送给老子做路上的粮食。并且声明：这是因为他是老作家，所以非常优待，假如他年纪青，饽饽就只能有十个了。
Guan Yinxi was very happy, very grateful, and very sorry, and insisted on keeping him for a longer time, but when he saw that he couldn't keep it, he changed his sad face, agreed, and ordered the patrol officer to saddle the green cow. While personally picking out a bag of salt, a pack of sesame, and fifteen dumplings from the shelf, he put them in a confiscated white cloth bag and gave them to Lao Tzu to make food on the road. And declared: This is because he is an old writer, so he is very preferential, if he is young, there can only be ten gluttony.老子再三称谢，收了口袋，和大家走下城楼，到得关口，还要牵着青牛走路；关尹喜竭力劝他上牛，逊让一番之后，终于也骑上去了。作过别，拨转牛头，便向峻坂的大路上慢慢的走去。
Lao Tzu thanked him again and again, put away his pockets, walked down the city tower with everyone, and when he reached the pass, he had to lead the green ox to walk; Guan Yinxi tried his best to persuade him to get on the cow, and after some concessions, he finally rode on it. After saying goodbye, he turned the bull's head and walked slowly towards the steep road.不多久，牛就放开了脚步。大家在关口目送着，去了两三丈远，还辨得出白发，黄袍，青牛，白口袋，接着就尘头逐步而起，罩着人和牛，一律变成灰色，再一会，已只有黄尘滚滚，什么也看不见了。
It didn't take long for the cow to let go. Everyone watched at the pass, went two or three feet away, and could still distinguish the white hair, yellow robe, green cow, white pocket, and then the dust gradually rose, covering people and cattle, all turning gray, and after a while, only yellow dust was rolling, and nothing could be seen.
大家回到关上，好像卸下了一副担子，伸一伸腰，又好像得了什么货色似的，咂一咂嘴，好些人跟着关尹喜走进公事房里去。
Everyone returned to the closing door, as if they had unloaded a burden, stretched their waists, and smacked their lips as if they had got some goods, and many people followed Guan Yinxi into the office.“这就是稿子？”账房先生提起一串木札来，翻着，说。“字倒写得还干净。我看到市上去卖起来，一定会有人要的。”
"This is the manuscript?" The accountant picked up a string of wooden sticks, flipped through them, and said. The words are written cleanly. I see it sold in the market, and someone will definitely want it. ”书记先生也凑上去，看着第一片，念道：
Mr. Secretary also leaned up, looked at the first piece, and read:“‘道可道，非常道’……哼，还是这些老套。真教人听得头痛，讨厌……”
"'Tao can be said, not very Tao'...... Hmph, it's still these clichés. It really gives people a headache and hates ......."“医头痛最好是打打盹。”账房放下了木札，说。

"Hahaha! …… I really had to take a nap. To be honest, I guessed that he was going to tell his love story, so I went to listen to it. If I had known that he was just talking so nonsense, I wouldn't have sat for so long and suffered at all......"“这可只能怪您自己看错了人，”关尹喜笑道。“他那里会有恋爱故事呢？他压根儿就没有过恋爱。”
"You can only blame yourself for seeing the wrong person," Guan Yinxi smiled. "Will he have a love story there? He has never been in love at all. ”“您怎么知道？”书记诧异的问。
"How do you know?" The secretary asked in surprise.“这也只能怪您自己打了磕睡，没有听到他说‘无为而无不为’。这家伙真是‘心高于天，命薄如纸’，想‘无不为’，就只好‘无为’。一有所爱，就不能无不爱，那里还能恋爱，敢恋爱？您看看您自己就是：现在只要看见一个大姑娘，不论好丑，就眼睛甜腻腻的都像是你自己的老婆。将来娶了太太，恐怕就要像我们的账房先生一样，规矩一些了。”
"This can only be blamed on you for snoozing off and not hearing him say 'do nothing and do nothing'. This guy is really 'his heart is higher than the sky, and his life is as thin as paper', and he wants to 'do everything', so he has to 'do nothing'. Once you love, you can't love everything, where you can still fall in love, dare to love? If you marry a wife in the future, I am afraid you will have to be more disciplined like our accountant. ”窗外起了一阵风，大家都觉得有些冷。
There was a gust of wind outside the window, and everyone felt a little cold.“这老头子究竟是到那里去，去干什么的？”书记先生趁势岔开了关尹喜的话。

"It doesn't matter," said Mr. Accountant, "there is always someone watching. Aren't there a lot of customs officials who have been handed over and hermits who have not yet become customs officials? ……”窗外起了一阵风，括上黄尘来，遮得半天暗。这时关尹喜向门外一看，只见还站着许多巡警和探子，在呆听他们的闲谈。

The people outside the door ran down. The people in the room didn't say anything anymore, and the accountant and secretary walked out. Guan Yinxi brushed the dust off the table with his robe sleeves, picked up two strings of wooden sticks, and placed them on the shelves piled with confiscated salt, sesame, cloth, soybeans, dumplings and other things.一九三五年十二月作。

Two墨子走进宋国的国界的时候，草鞋带已经断了三四回，觉得脚底上很发热，停下来一看，鞋底也磨成了大窟窿，脚上有些地方起茧，有些地方起泡了。他毫不在意，仍然走；沿路看看情形，人口倒很不少，然而历来的水灾和兵灾的痕迹，却到处存留，没有人民的变换得飞快。走了三天，看不见一所大屋，看不见一颗大树，看不见一个活泼的人，看不见一片肥沃的田地，就这样的到了都城。
When Mozi walked into the border of the Song Dynasty, the straw shoe laces had broken three or four times, and he felt that the soles of his feet were very hot, and when he stopped, the soles of his shoes had also been ground into big holes, and some places on his feet were calloused and blistered in some places. "Aren't you talking about some righteousness?" Gongshu said. "Hard work and hard work to help the crisis are the things of the cheap, and the adults do not take them. He's a king, fellow! ”“那倒也不。丝麻米谷，都是贱人做出来的东西，大人们就都要。何况行义呢。”
"That's not true. Silk, hemp, rice, and grain are all things made by bitches, and adults want them. Not to mention righteousness. ”“那可也是的，”公输般高兴的说。“我没有见你的时候，想取宋；一见你，即使白送我宋国，如果不义，我也不要了……”
"That's true," Gongshu said happily. "When I didn't see you, I wanted to take Song; When I see you, even if I send me to the Song Kingdom for nothing, if it is unjust, I don't want it......“那可是我真送了你宋国了。”墨子也高兴的说。“你如果一味行义，我还要送你天下哩！”
"That's why I really sent you to the Song Kingdom." Mozi also said happily. "If you blindly do righteousness, I will give you the world!"当主客谈笑之间，午餐也摆好了，有鱼，有肉，有酒。墨子不喝酒，也不吃鱼，只吃了一点肉。公输般独自喝着酒，看见客人不大动刀匕，过意不去，只好劝他吃辣椒：
While the host and guests were chatting and laughing, lunch was also set up, with fish, meat, and wine. Mozi did not drink or eat fish, but only a little meat. Gongshu was drinking alone, and when he saw that the guest did not use a knife and dagger, he was reluctant to go, so he had to persuade him to eat chili:“请呀请呀！”他指着辣椒酱和大饼，恳切的说，“你尝尝，这还不坏。大葱可不及我们那里的肥……”
"Please, please!" He pointed to the chili sauce and flatbread and said earnestly, "You try it, it's not bad." Green onions are not as fat as we have ......."公输般喝过几杯酒，更加高兴了起来。
After drinking a few glasses of wine, he became even happier.“我舟战有拒，你的义也有拒么？”他问道。
"I have  rejection in naval battles, and do you also have  rejection?" He asked.“我这义的拒，比你那舟战的拒好。”墨子坚决的回答说。“我用爱来，用恭来拒。不用爱，是不相亲的，不用恭拒，是要油滑的，不相亲而又油滑，马上就离散。所以互相爱，互相恭，就等于互相利。现在你用去人，人也用来你，你用拒去拒人，人也用拒来拒你，互相，互相拒，也就等于互相害了。所以我这义的拒，比你那舟战的拒好。”
"My righteous  refusal is better than your  rejection." Mozi replied resolutely. "I use love to , and I use respect to reject. You don't have to love , you don't have to go on a blind date, you don't need to be respectful, you have to be oily, you don't want to be close and smooth, and you will be separated immediately. Therefore, loving and respecting each other is equivalent to mutual benefit. Now you use  to  people, people use  to  you, you use rejection to reject people, people use rejection to reject you,  to each other, reject each other, which is equivalent to harming each other. So my righteous  rejection is better than your  rejection. ”“但是，老乡，你一行义，可真几乎把我的饭碗敲碎了！”公输般碰了一个钉子之后，改口说，但也大约很有了一些酒意：他其实是不会喝酒的。
"But, fellow man, you are righteous, but you really almost smashed my rice bowl!" After touching a nail like a gongshu, he changed his words, but he was also very drunk: he actually couldn't drink.“但也比敲碎宋国的所有饭碗好。”
"But it's better than smashing all the jobs in the Song Kingdom."“可是我以后只好做玩具了。老乡，你等一等，我请你看一点玩意儿。”
"But I have to make toys in the future. Fellow man, wait a minute, I'll ask you to see some things. ”他说着就跳起来，跑进后房去，好像是在翻箱子。不一会，又出来了，手里拿着一只木头和竹片做成的喜鹊，交给墨子，口里说道：
As he spoke, he jumped up and ran into the back room, as if he was rummaging through boxes. After a while, he came out again, holding a magpie made of wood and bamboo chips in his hand, handed it to Mozi, and said:“只要一开，可以飞三天。这倒还可以说是极巧的。”
"As long as it is opened, it can fly for three days. This can be said to be a great coincidence. ”“可是还不及木匠的做车轮，”墨子看了一看，就放在席子上，说。“他削三寸的木头，就可以载重五十石。有利于人的，就是巧，就是好，不利于人的，就是拙，也就是坏的。”
"But it's not as good as a carpenter's wheel," Mozi looked at it, put it on the mat, and said. "He can carry fifty stones of wood by cutting three inches of wood. What is beneficial to people is coincidence, which is good, and what is not conducive to people, is clumsy, that is, bad. ”“哦，我忘记了，”公输般又碰了一个钉子，这才醒过来。“早该知道这正是你的话。”
"Oh, I forgot," Gongshu touched another nail before waking up. "I should have known that this is exactly what you said."“所以你还是一味的行义，”墨子看着他的眼睛，诚恳的说，“不但巧，连天下也是你的了。真是打扰了你大半天。我们明年再见罢。”
"So you still blindly do righteousness," Mozi looked into his eyes and said sincerely, "Not only is it a coincidence, but the world is also yours." It really bothered you for most of the day. We'll see you next year. ”墨子说着，便取了小包裹，向主人告辞；公输般知道他是留不住的，只得放他走。送他出了大门之后，回进屋里来，想了一想，便将云梯的模型和木鹊都塞在后房的箱子里。
Mozi said, took the small package and said goodbye to the master; Gongshu knew that he couldn't keep him, so he had to let him go. After sending him out of the gate, he went back into the house, thought about it, and stuffed the model of the ladder and the wooden magpie into the box in the back room.墨子在归途上，是走得较慢了，一则力乏，二则脚痛，三则干粮已经吃完，难免觉得肚子饿，四则事情已经办妥，不像来时的匆忙。然而比来时更晦气：一进宋国界，就被搜检了两回；走近都城，又遇到募捐救国队，募去了破包袱；到得南关外，又遭着大雨，到城门下想避避雨，被两个执戈的巡兵赶开了，淋得一身湿，从此鼻子塞了十多天。
On the way home, Mozi walked slower, one was weak, the second was sore feet, the third was that the dry food had been eaten, and it was inevitable that he would feel hungry, and the fourth thing was done, not like the hurry when he came. However, it was more unlucky than when it came: as soon as it entered the Song border, it was searched twice; approaching the capital, he encountered the fundraising and national salvation team, and raised a burden; When I arrived outside the South Pass, it rained heavily, and I went to the city gate to take shelter from the rain, but I was driven away by two patrolmen with weapons, and I was soaked, and my nose was stuffed for more than ten days.一九三四年八月作。

Zhuangzi - Oh...... (thought about it,) Oh...... I understand. It must have been when you were the king of the Shang Dynasty, when you walked to this place alone, but you encountered a robber who broke the road, gave you a stuffy stick from behind, beat you to death, and snatched everything away. Now we are in the Zhou Dynasty, and it has been more than 500 years, and we are still looking for clothes there. Do you understand?汉子——（瞪了眼睛，看着庄子，）我一点也不懂。先生，你还是不要胡闹，还我衣服，包裹和伞子罢。我是有正经事，探亲去的，没有陪你玩笑的工夫！
Man - (staring, looking at Zhuangzi,) I don't understand at all. Sir, don't mess around, just return my clothes, packages and umbrellas. I have serious business, I went to visit relatives, and I don't have time to joke with you!庄子——你这人真是不明道理……
Zhuangzi - You are really unreasonable......汉子——谁不明道理？我不见了东西，当场捉住了你，不问你要，问谁要？（站起来。）
Man - who doesn't know the truth? I lost something, I caught you on the spot, I didn't ask you what you wanted, I asked who I wanted? (Stand up.) ）庄子——（着急，）你再听我讲：你原是一个髑髅，是我看得可怜，请司命大神给你活转来的。你想想看：你死了这许多年，那里还有衣服呢！我现在并不要你的谢礼，你且坐下，和我讲讲纣王那时候……
Zhuangzi - (anxious,) Listen to me again: You were originally a skeleton, I felt sorry for you, and asked the god of life to bring you back to life. Think about it: you have been dead for so many years, and there are still clothes there! I don't want your thank you now, sit down and tell me about the time when King Zhou was ......汉子——胡说！这话，就是三岁小孩子也不会相信的。我可是三十三岁了！（走开来，）你……
Man - nonsense! Even a three-year-old child would not believe this. I'm thirty-three years old! (Walk away,) you......庄子——我可真有这本领。你该知道漆园的庄周的罢。
Zhuangzi - I really have this ability. You should know Zhuang Zhou's in the lacquer garden.汉子——我不知道。就是你真有这本领，又值什么鸟？你把我弄得精赤条条的，活转来又有什么用？叫我怎么去探亲？包裹也没有了……（有些要哭，跑开来拉住了庄子的袖子，）我不相信你的胡说。这里只有你，我当然问你要！我扭你见保甲去！
Man - I don't know. If you really have this ability, what kind of bird is it worth? You made me naked, what's the use of being alive? How do you tell me to visit relatives? The package is gone...... (Some of them were about to cry, and ran away and grabbed Zhuangzi's sleeves.) I don't believe your nonsense. It's just you here, of course I ask you for it!" I'll twist you to see the Baojia!庄子——慢慢的，慢慢的，我的衣服旧了，很脆，拉不得。你且听我几句话：你先不要专想衣服罢，衣服是可有可无的，也许是有衣服对，也许是没有衣服对。鸟有羽，兽有毛，然而王瓜茄子赤条条。此所谓“彼亦一是非，此亦一是非”，你固然不能说没有衣服对，然而你又怎么能说有衣服对呢？……
Zhuangzi - Slowly, slowly, my clothes are old, very brittle, and I can't pull them. Listen to me: Don't just think about clothes, clothes are dispensable, maybe there are clothes, maybe no clothes. Birds have feathers, beasts have feathers, but the king melon and eggplant are red stripes. Of course, you can't say that there are no clothes, but how can you say that there are clothes? ……汉子——（发怒，）放你妈的屁！不还我的东西，我先揍死你！（一手捏了拳头，举起来，一手去揪庄子。）
Man - (angry,) Fart you! If you don't return my things, I will beat you to death first!" (Clenched a fist with one hand, raised it, and grabbed Zhuangzi with the other.) ）庄子——（窘急，招架着，）你敢动粗！放手！要不然，我就请司命大神来还你一个死！
Zhuangzi - (embarrassed, parrying,) You dare to be rough! Let go! Otherwise, I will ask the God of Destiny to give you a death!"汉子——（冷笑着退开，）好，你还我一个死罢。要不然，我就要你还我的衣服，伞子和包裹，里面是五十二个圜钱，斤半白糖，二斤南枣……
Man - (sneered and withdrew,) Okay, you give me back to death. Otherwise, I will ask you to return my clothes, umbrellas and packages, which contain fifty-two round coins, half a pound of sugar, and two pounds of southern jujubes......庄子——（严正地，）你不反悔？
Zhuangzi - (solemnly,) You don't regret it?汉子——小舅子才反悔！
Man - brother-in-law regrets it!庄子——（决绝地，）那就是了。既然这么胡涂，还是送你还原罢。（转脸朝着东方，拱两手向天，提高了喉咙，大叫起来：）
Zhuangzi - (Decisive,) That's it. Since it's so nonsense, I'll send you to restore it. (Turning his face to the east, arching his hands to the sky, raising his throat, and screaming :)至心朝礼，司命大天尊！
Sincere worship, the great Heavenly Lord!天地玄黄，宇宙洪荒。日月盈昃，辰宿列张。
Heaven and earth are dark and yellow, and the universe is vast and desolate. The sun and moon are full and waning, and the stars and stars are arranged in arrangements.赵钱孙李，周吴郑王。冯秦褚卫，姜沈韩杨。
赵钱孙李，周吴郑王。 冯秦褚卫，姜沈韩杨。太上老君急急如律令！敕！敕！敕！
太上老君急急如律令！敕！敕！敕！（毫无影响，好一会。）
（毫无影响，好一会。 ）天地玄黄！
天地玄黄！太上老君！敕！敕！敕！……敕！
太上老君！敕！敕！敕！…… 敕！（毫无影响，好一会。）
（毫无影响，好一会。 ）（庄子向周围四顾，慢慢的垂下手来。）
(Zhuangzi looked around and slowly lowered his hand.) ）汉子——死了没有呀？
Man - are you dead?庄子——（颓唐地，）不知怎的，这回可不灵……
Zhuangzi - (Decadent Tangdi,) Somehow, this time it doesn't work......汉子——（扑上前，）那么，不要再胡说了。赔我的衣服！
Man - (pounces forward,) Then, stop talking nonsense. Lose my clothes!庄子——（退后，）你敢动手？这不懂哲理的野蛮！
Zhuangzi - (step back,) Do you dare to do it? This is a barbarism that doesn't understand philosophy!汉子——（揪住他，）你这贼骨头！你这强盗军师！我先剥你的道袍，拿你的马，赔我……
Man - (grabbed him,) You thief bone! You robber military strategist!" I will first strip you of your Taoist robe, take your horse, and compensate me......（庄子一面支撑着，一面赶紧从道袍的袖子里摸出警笛来，狂吹了三声。汉子愕然，放慢了动作。不多久，从远处跑来一个巡士。）
(While supporting it, Zhuangzi quickly took out the siren from the sleeve of his Taoist robe and blew it three times.) The man was stunned and slowed down. Not long after, a patrol officer came running from a distance. ）巡士——（且跑且喊，）带住他！不要放！（他跑近来，是一个鲁国大汉，身材高大，制服制帽，手执警棍，面赤无须。）带住他！这舅子！……
Patrolman - (running and shouting,) Take him! Don't put it! (He ran closer, a big man from Lu State, tall, wearing a hat, holding a baton, and a red face and no beard.) Take him! This brother-in-law! ……汉子——（又揪紧了庄子，）带住他！这舅子！……
Man - (grabbed Zhuangzi again,) Hold him! This brother-in-law! ……（巡士跑到，抓住庄子的衣领，一手举起警棍来。汉子放手，微弯了身子，两手掩着小肚。）
(The patrolman ran over, grabbed Zhuangzi's collar, and raised his baton in one hand.) The man let go, bent slightly, and covered his belly with both hands. ）庄子——（托住警棍，歪着头，）l这算什么？
Zhuangzi - (holding the baton, tilting his head,) l What is this?巡士——这算什么？哼！你自己还不明白？
Inspector - what is this? Hum! You don't understand it yourself?庄子——（愤怒，）怎么叫了你来，你倒来抓我？
Zhuangzi - (angry,) Why did you call you here, and you came to arrest me?巡士——什么？
Inspector - what?庄子——我吹了警笛……
Zhuangzi - I blew the siren......巡士——你抢了人家的衣服，还自己吹警笛，这昏蛋！
Patrol - You robbed other people's clothes and blew the siren yourself, you fool!庄子——我是过路的，见他死在这里，救了他，他倒缠住我，说我拿了他的东西了。你看看我的样子，可是抢人东西的？
Zhuangzi - I was passing by, and when I saw him dying here, I saved him, but he pestered me and said that I had taken his things. Look at me, but I'm robbing people's things?巡士——（收回警棍，）“知人知面不知心”，谁知道。到局里去罢。
Patrol - (retract the baton,) "Know the face but not the heart", who knows. Go to the bureau.庄子——那可不成。我得赶路，见楚王去。
Zhuangzi - That's not possible. I have to hurry and see the King of Chu.巡士——（吃惊，松手，细看了庄子的脸，）那么，您是漆……
Patrol - (surprised, let go, looked at Zhuangzi's face carefully,) So, are you Qi ......庄子——（高兴起来，）不错！我正是漆园吏庄周。您怎么知道的？
Zhuangzi - (happy,) Not bad! I am Zhuang Zhou, a lacquer garden official. How do you know?巡士——咱们的局长这几天就常常提起您老，说您老要上楚国发财去了，也许从这里经过的。敝局长也是一位隐士，带便兼办一点差使，很爱读您老的文章，读《齐物论》，什么“方生方死，方死方生，方可方不可，方不可方可”，真写得有劲，真是上流的文章，真好！您老还是到敝局里去歇歇罢。
Inspector - Our director has often mentioned your old age in the past few days, saying that you are always going to Chu to make a fortune, maybe passing through here. Our director is also a hermit, with a little errand, I love to read your old articles, read "Qiwu Lun", what "Fang Sheng Fang Fang Fang, Fang, Fang Ke Fang Fang, Fang", really written vigorously, really a high-class article, really good! You should go to our bureau to rest.（汉子吃惊，退进蓬草丛中，蹲下去。）
(The man was surprised, retreated into the grass, and squatted down.) ）庄子——今天已经不早，我要赶路，不能耽搁了。还是回来的时候，再去拜访贵局长罢。
Zhuangzi - It's not early today, I'm on my way, I can't delay. Or when you come back, go visit your director again."（庄子且说且走，爬在马上，正想加鞭，那汉子突然跳出草丛，跑上去拉住了马嚼子。巡士也追上去，拉住汉子的臂膊。）
(Zhuangzi said and walked, climbed on the horse, and was about to whip when the man suddenly jumped out of the grass and ran up to grab the horse's chew.) The patrol officer also chased after him and grabbed the man's arm. ）庄子——你还缠什么？
Zhuangzi - what are you still pestering?汉子——你走了，我什么也没有，叫我怎么办？（看着巡士，）您瞧，巡士先生……
Man - you are gone, I have nothing, what should I do? (Looking at the inspector,) Look, Mr. Inspector......巡士——（搔着耳朵背后，）这模样，可真难办……但是，先生……我看起来，（看着庄子，）还是您老富裕一点，赏他一件衣服，给他遮遮羞……
Patrol - (scratching the back of his ears,) This kind of appearance is really difficult to handle...... But, sir...... I see, (looking at Zhuangzi,) It's better for you to be richer, reward him with a piece of clothing, and cover his shame......庄子——那自然可以的，衣服本来并非我有。不过我这回要去见楚王，不穿袍子，不行，脱了小衫，光穿一件袍子，也不行……
Zhuangzi - Of course, the clothes were not originally mine. But this time I want to see the King of Chu, I don't wear a robe, no, I take off my shirt, just wear a robe, I can't do it......巡士——对啦，这实在少不得。（向汉子，）放手！
Inspector - Yes, this is really indispensable. Let go!汉子——我要去探亲……
Man - I'm going to visit relatives......巡士——胡说！再麻烦，看我带你到局里去！（举起警棍，）滚开！
Inspector - nonsense! If it's troublesome, I'll take you to the bureau!" (Raise the baton,) Get away!（汉子退走，巡士追着，一直到乱蓬里。）
(The man retreated, and the patrolman chased after him until he reached the mess.) ）庄子——再见再见。
Zhuangzi - goodbye, goodbye.巡士——再见再见。您老走好哪！
Patrolman - goodbye, goodbye. How are you going!（庄子在马上打了一鞭，走动了。巡士反背着手，看他渐跑渐远，没入尘头中，这才慢慢的回转身，向原来的路上踱去。）
(Zhuangzi whipped the horse and walked around.) The patrol officer turned his back and watched him run farther and farther away, submerged in the dust, and then slowly turned around and paced towards the original road. ）（汉子突然从草丛中跳出来，拉住巡士的衣角。）
(The man suddenly jumped out of the grass and grabbed the corner of the patrolman's clothes.) ）巡士——干吗？
Patrol - what are you doing?汉子——我怎么办呢？
Man - what should I do?巡士——这我怎么知道。
Inspector - How do I know this?汉子——我要去探亲……
Man - I'm going to visit relatives......巡士——你探去就是了。
Inspector - You can go out.汉子——我没有衣服呀。
Man - I have no clothes.巡士——没有衣服就不能探亲吗？
Inspector - can't you visit relatives without clothes?汉子——你放走了他。现在你又想溜走了，我只好找你想法子。不问你，问谁呢？你瞧，这叫我怎么活下去！
Man - you let him go. Now that you want to slip away again, I have to find you to think of an idea. If you don't ask you, who do you ask? Look, how can I survive!巡士——可是我告诉你：自杀是弱者的行为呀！
Inspector - But let me tell you: suicide is the act of the weak!汉子——那么，你给我想法子！
Man - then, give me an idea!巡士——（摆脱着衣角，）我没有法子想！
Inspector - (getting rid of the corner of his clothes,) I have no way to think about it!汉子——（缒住巡士的袖子，）那么，你带我到局里去！
Man - (tie the patrolman's sleeve,) Then, you take me to the bureau!巡士——（摆脱着袖子，）这怎么成。赤条条的，街上怎么走。放手！
Inspector - (getting rid of his sleeves,) How can this be done. How to walk on the street. Let go!汉子——那么，你借我一条裤子！
Man - then, you lend me a pair of pants!巡士——我只有这一条裤子，借给了你，自己不成样子了。（竭力的摆脱着，）不要胡闹！放手！
Inspector - I only have these pants, I lent you them, and I don't look like myself. Don't mess around! Let go!汉子——（揪住巡士的颈子，）我一定要跟你去！
Man - (grabbed the patrolman's neck,) I must go with you!巡士——（窘急，）不成！
Inspector - (embarrassed,) No!汉子——那么，我不放你走！
Man - then, I won't let you go!巡士——你要怎么样呢？
Inspector - What do you want?汉子——我要你带我到局里去！
Man - I want you to take me to the bureau!巡士——这真是……带你去做什么用呢？不要捣乱了。放手！要不然……（竭力的挣扎。）
Inspector - This is really ...... What is it for you to take you for? Don't make trouble. Let go! Otherwise...... (Struggling hard.) ）汉子——（揪得更紧，）要不然，我不能探亲，也不能做人了。二斤南枣，斤半白糖……你放走了他，我和你拚命……
Man - (Pulling tighter,) Otherwise, I wouldn't be able to visit relatives or be a human being. Two pounds of southern dates, one and a half pounds of sugar...... You let him go, and I will fight with you......巡士——（挣扎着，）不要捣乱了！放手！要不然……要不然……（说着，一面摸出警笛，狂吹起来。）
Inspector - (struggling,) Don't make trouble! Let go! Otherwise...... Otherwise...... (As he spoke, he took out the siren and blew it wildly.) ）一九三五年十二月作。

小引

Small quote我常想在纷扰中寻出一点闲静来，然而委实不容易。目前是这么离奇，心里是这么芜杂。一个人做到只剩了回忆的时候，生涯大概总要算是无聊了罢，但有时竟会连回忆也没有。中国的做文章有轨范，世事也仍然是螺旋。前几天我离开中山大学的时候，便想起四个月以前的离开厦门大学；听到飞机在头上鸣叫，竟记得了一年前在北京城上日日旋绕的飞机。我那时还做了一篇短文，叫做《一觉》。现在是，连这“一觉”也没有了。
I often want to find a little leisure in the chaos, but it is not easy. At present, it is so bizarre, and my heart is so complicated. When a person only has memories, his career is probably boring, but sometimes he doesn't even have memories. China's writing is on a regular basis, and the world is still spiral. When I left Sun Yat-sen University a few days ago, I remembered that I left Xiamen University four months ago; Hearing the plane chirping over my head, I actually remembered the plane that circled in Beijing every day a year ago. I also wrote a short article called "One Sleep" at that time. Now, even this "sleep" is gone.广州的天气热得真早，夕阳从西窗射入，逼得人只能勉强穿一件单衣。书桌上的一盆“水横枝”，是我先前没有见过的：就是一段树，只要浸在水中，枝叶便青葱得可爱。看看绿叶，编编旧稿，总算也在做一点事。做着这等事，真是虽生之日，犹死之年，很可以驱除炎热的。
The weather in Guangzhou was so hot that the sunset came in through the west window, forcing people to barely wear a single coat. A pot of "water horizontal branches" on the desk is something I have never seen before: it is a tree, as long as it is immersed in water, the branches and leaves are green and cute. Look at the green leaves, compile old drafts, and finally do something. Doing such a thing is really a day of life, a year of death, and it is very good to drive away the heat.前天，已将《野草》编定了；这回便轮到陆续载在《莽原》上的《旧事重提》，我还替他改了一个名称：《朝花夕拾》。带露折花，色香自然要好得多，但是我不能够。便是现在心目中的离奇和芜杂，我也还不能使他即刻幻化，转成离奇和芜杂的文章。或者，他日仰看流云时，会在我的眼前一闪烁罢。
The day before yesterday, "Weeds" was compiled; This time it was the turn of "Revisiting Old Things" that were successively published in "Mangyuan", and I also changed the name for him: "Morning Flowers and Evening Pickups". Flowers with dew are naturally much better, but I can't. Even the bizarre and chaotic in my mind now, I can't make him immediately transform into bizarre and chaotic articles. Or, when I look up at the flowing clouds in the future, it will flicker in front of my eyes.我有一时，曾经屡次忆起儿时在故乡所吃的蔬果：菱角，罗汉豆，茭白，香瓜。凡这些，都是极其鲜美可口的；都曾是使我思乡的蛊惑。后来，我在久别之后尝到了，也不过如此；惟独在记忆上，还有旧来的意味留存。他们也许要哄骗我一生，使我时时反顾。

狗·猫·鼠

狗·猫·鼠

狗·猫·鼠

Dog, cat, mouse从去年起，仿佛听得有人说我是仇猫的。那根据自然是在我的那一篇《兔和猫》；这是自画招供，当然无话可说，——但倒也毫不介意。一到今年，我可很有点担心了。我是常不免于弄弄笔墨的，写了下来，印了出去，对于有些人似乎总是搔着痒处的时候少，碰着痛处的时候多。万一不谨，甚而至于得罪了名人或名教授，或者更甚而至于得罪了“负有指导青年责任的前辈”之流，可就危险已极。为什么呢？因为这些大脚色是“不好惹”的。怎地“不好惹”呢？就是怕要浑身发热之后，做一封信登在报纸上，广告道：“看哪！狗不是仇猫的么？鲁迅先生却自己承认是仇猫的，而他还说要打‘落水狗’！”这“逻辑”的奥义，即在用我的话，来证明我倒是狗，于是而凡有言说，全都根本推翻，即使我说二二得四，三三见九，也没有一字不错。这些既然都错，则绅士口头的二二得七，三三见千等等，自然就不错了。
Since last year, it seems that someone has heard someone say that I am a cat hater. That is based on nature in my article "The Rabbit and the Cat"; This is a self-drawn confession, of course, there is nothing to say,—— but I don't mind. This year, I am a little worried. I often can't help but play with pen and ink, write it down, print it out, for some people seem to always scratch the itch less often, touch the pain more often. If you are not careful, you will even offend a celebrity or a famous professor, or even offend the "seniors who are responsible for guiding young people", which can be extremely dangerous. Why? Because these big feet are "not easy to mess with". How can it be "not easy to mess with"? After being afraid of getting hot, he made a letter and published it in the newspaper, advertising: "Look! Aren't dogs cat-hating? Mr. Lu Xun admitted that he hated cats, and he also said that he would fight the 'drowning dog'! The secret of this "logic" is to use my words to prove that I am a dog, so everything that is said is fundamentally overturned, even if I say that two two get four, three three see nine, not a single word is good. Since these are all wrong, the gentleman's verbal two-two is seven, three-three is a thousand, etc., and so on, which is naturally good.我于是就间或留心着查考它们成仇的“动机”。这也并非敢妄学现下的学者以动机来褒贬作品的那些时髦，不过想给自己预先洗刷洗刷。据我想，这在动物心理学家，是用不着费什么力气的，可惜我没有这学问。后来，在覃哈特博士（Dr．O．Dähnhardt）的《自然史底国民童话》里，总算发见了那原因了。据说，是这么一回事：动物们因为要商议要事，开了一个会议，鸟，鱼，兽都齐集了，单是缺了象。大会议定，派伙计去迎接它，拈到了当这差使的阄的就是狗。“我怎么找到那象呢？我没有见过它，也和它不认识。”它问。“那容易，”大众说，“它是驼背的。”狗去了，遇见一匹猫，立刻弓起脊梁来，它便招待，同行，将弓着脊梁的猫介绍给大家道：“象在这里！”但是大家都嗤笑它了。从此以后，狗和猫便成了仇家。
So I occasionally pay attention to the "motives" of their hatred. This is not the fashion that dares to learn from the current scholars who praise and criticize their works with motives, but they want to wash themselves in advance. In my opinion, this does not require much effort for animal psychologists, but unfortunately I do not have this knowledge. Later, in Dr. O. Dähnhardt's "National Fairy Tales of Natural History", the reason was finally discovered. It is said that it is like this: the animals held a meeting because they wanted to discuss important matters, and the birds, fish, and beasts gathered, but the elephant was missing. The meeting decided to send a guy to greet it, and it was the dog who was the messenger. "How did I find the elephant? I have never seen it, and I don't know it. It asked. "It's easy," said the crowd, "and it's hunchbacked. The dog went, met a cat, and immediately arched its spine, and it entertained, walked together, and introduced the cat with the arched spine to everyone and said, "Like here! But everyone laughed at it. Since then, dogs and cats have become enemies.日耳曼人走出森林虽然还不很久，学术文艺却已经很可观，便是书籍的装潢，玩具的工致，也无不令人心爱。独有这一篇童话却实在不漂亮；结怨也结得没有意思。猫的弓起脊梁，并不是希图冒充，故意摆架子的，其咎却在狗的自己没眼力。然而原因也总可以算作一个原因。我的仇猫，是和这大大两样的。
Although the Germanic people have not been out of the forest for a long time, their academic literature and art are already considerable, even the decoration of books and the craftsmanship of toys are all lovely. This fairy tale is really not beautiful; Grudges are also boring. The cat's arched spine is not intended to be pretended to be a deliberate shelf, but the fault lies in the dog's own lack of eyesight. However, the reason can always be counted as a reason. My enemy cat is very different from this.其实人禽之辨，本不必这样严。在动物界，虽然并不如古人所幻想的那样舒适自由，可是噜苏做作的事总比人间少。它们适性任情，对就对，错就错，不说一句分辩话。虫蛆也许是不干净的，但它们并没有自鸣清高；鸷禽猛兽以较弱的动物为饵，不妨说是凶残的罢，但它们从来就没有竖过“公理”“正义”的旗子，使牺牲者直到被吃的时候为止，还是一味佩服赞叹它们。人呢，能直立了，自然是一大进步；能说话了，自然又是一大进步；能写字作文了，自然又是一大进步。然而也就堕落，因为那时也开始了说空话。说空话尚无不可，甚至于连自己也不知道说着违心之论，则对于只能嗥叫的动物，实在免不得“颜厚有忸怩”。假使真有一位一视同仁的造物主，高高在上，那么，对于人类的这些小聪明，也许倒以为多事，正如我们在万生园里，看见猴子翻筋斗，母象请安，虽然往往破颜一笑，但同时也觉得不舒服，甚至于感到悲哀，以为这些多余的聪明，倒不如没有的好罢。然而，既经为人，便也只好“党同伐异”，学着人们的说话，随俗来谈一谈，——辩一辩了。
In fact, the distinction between humans and animals does not have to be so strict. In the animal kingdom, although it is not as comfortable and free as the ancients imagined, Lu Su is always less artificialized than in the human world. They are adaptive and willful, right and wrong, and do not say a word of argument. Maggots may be unclean, but they are not self-explanatory; Fierce birds and beasts use weaker animals as bait, so it can be said that they are ferocious, but they have never raised the banner of "axioms" and "justice", so that the victims still blindly admire and admire them until they are eaten. As for people, being able to stand upright is naturally a great progress; being able to speak is naturally another big improvement; Being able to write and compose is naturally a big improvement. However, it also falls, because then it also begins to speak empty words. There is nothing wrong with empty words, and even if you don't know how to speak against your heart, you can't help but be "shy and embarrassed" for animals that can only howl. If there is really a creator who treats everyone equally, then for these little cleverness of human beings, we may think that it is troublesome, just like when we see monkeys somersaulting and mother elephants greeting each other in the Garden of All Life, although they often smile, but at the same time they also feel uncomfortable, and even feel sad, thinking that these superfluous cleverness is better than nothing. However, since he is a person, he has no choice but to "fight against the differences", learn from people's speech, talk about ,—— debate according to the world.现在说起我仇猫的原因来，自己觉得是理由充足，而且光明正大的。一，它的性情就和别的猛兽不同，凡捕食雀鼠，总不肯一口咬死，定要尽情玩弄，放走，又捉住，捉住，又放走，直待自己玩厌了，这才吃下去，颇与人们的幸灾乐祸，慢慢地折磨弱者的坏脾气相同。二，它不是和狮虎同族的么？可是有这么一副媚态！但这也许是限于天分之故罢，假使它的身材比现在大十倍，那就真不知道它所取的是怎么一种态度。然而，这些口实，仿佛又是现在提起笔来的时候添出来的，虽然也像是当时涌上心来的理由。要说得可靠一点，或者倒不如说不过因为它们配合时候的嗥叫，手续竟有这么繁重，闹得别人心烦，尤其是夜间要看书，睡觉的时候。当这些时候，我便要用长竹竿去攻击它们。狗们在大道上配合时，常有闲汉拿了木棍痛打；我曾见大勃吕该尔（P．Bruegel d．Ä）的一张铜版画Allegorie der Wollust上，也画着这回事，可见这样的举动，是中外古今一致的。自从那执拗的奥国学者弗罗特（S．Freud）提倡了精神分析说——Psychoanalysis，听说章士钊先生是译作“心解”的，虽然简古，可是实在难解得很——以来，我们的名人名教授也颇有隐隐约约，检来应用的了，这些事便不免又要归宿到性欲上去。打狗的事我不管，至于我的打猫，却只因为它们嚷嚷，此外并无恶意，我自信我的嫉妒心还没有这么博大，当现下“动辄获咎”之秋，这是不可不预先声明的。例如人们当配合之前，也很有些手续，新的是写情书，少则一束，多则一捆；旧的是什么“问名”“纳采”，磕头作揖，去年海昌蒋氏在北京举行婚礼，拜来拜去，就十足拜了三天，还印有一本红面子的《婚礼节文》，《序论》里大发议论道：“平心论之，既名为礼，当必繁重。专图简易，何用礼为？……然则世之有志于礼者，可以兴矣！不可退居于礼所不下之庶人矣！”然而我毫不生气，这是因为无须我到场；因此也可见我的仇猫，理由实在简简单单，只为了它们在我的耳朵边尽嚷的缘故。人们的各种礼式，局外人可以不见不闻，我就满不管，但如果当我正要看书或睡觉的时候，有人来勒令朗诵情书，奉陪作揖，那是为自卫起见，还要用长竹竿来抵御的。还有，平素不大交往的人，忽而寄给我一个红帖子，上面印着“为舍妹出阁”，“小儿完姻”，“敬请观礼”或“阖第光临”这些含有“阴险的暗示”的句子，使我不化钱便总觉得有些过意不去的，我也不十分高兴。
Now when it comes to the reason why I hate cats, I think it is enough reason, and it is open. First, its temperament is different from other beasts, whoever preys on sparrows and rats, always refuses to bite to death, must play with it to their heart's content, let it go, catch it, catch it, let it go, until they are tired of playing, and then eat it, which is quite the same as people's gloating, slowly torturing the bad temper of the weak. Second, isn't it of the same race as the liger? But there is such a coquettishness! But this may be limited to talent, if it is ten times larger than it is now, then I really don't know what kind of attitude it takes. However, these excuses seem to have been added when I picked up the pen now, although it also seemed to be the reason that came to my mind at that time. To be more reliable, or rather, because of their howls when cooperating, the procedures are so heavy that they upset others, especially when they have to read books and sleep at night. At these times, I will attack them with long bamboo poles. When the dogs cooperated on the road, there were often idle men who took wooden sticks and beat them; I have seen this on a copperplate engraving by P.Bruegel d.Ä on the Allegorie der Wollust, which shows that such a move is consistent between ancient and modern times at home and abroad. Since the stubborn Austrian scholar S. Freud advocated the theory of psychoanalysis - Psychoanalysis, I heard that Mr. Zhang Shizhao translated it as "heart understanding", although it is simple and ancient, but it is really difficult to understand - our famous professors have also vaguely applied it, and these things will inevitably return to sexual desire. I don't care about beating dogs, as for my beating cats, but only because they are shouting, and there is no malice, I am confident that my jealousy is not so broad, and it is necessary to declare in advance that it is the autumn of "being blamed at every turn". For example, when people cooperate, there are also some procedures, the new one is to write a love letter, as little as a bunch, as much as a bundle; Last year, Haichang Jiang held a wedding in Beijing, worshipped back and forth, and worshipped for three days, and also printed a red-faced "Wedding Festival", which was discussed in the "Preface": "To be fair, since it is called a ceremony, it must be heavy." If you want to be simple, why should you be polite? …… In this way, those in the world who aspire to propriety can thrive! We cannot retreat to the common people who do not obey the rites! "But I was not angry, because I didn't need to be there; Therefore, it can also be seen that my enemy cats are really simple for the sake of them shouting in my ears. I don't care about people's various etiquette, outsiders can see or hear, but if someone comes to order me to read a book or go to bed, it is for self-defense, and I have to use a long bamboo pole to resist. Also, people who don't usually interact with me suddenly sent me a red post, which was printed with "out of the cabinet for my sister", "the child is married", "please watch the ceremony" or "close the door" and other sentences containing "insidious hints", which made me always feel a little unhappy if I didn't turn money into money, and I was not very happy.但是，这都是近时的话。再一回忆，我的仇猫却远在能够说出这些理由之前，也许是还在十岁上下的时候了。至今还分明记得，那原因是极其简单的：只因为它吃老鼠，——吃了我饲养着的可爱的小小的隐鼠。
However, these are all recent words. In retrospect, my enemy cat was still around ten years old long before I could say these reasons. I still remember clearly that the reason was extremely simple: just because it ate mice,—— it ate the cute little hidden rat I raised.听说西洋是不很喜欢黑猫的，不知道可确；但Edgar Allan Poe的小说里的黑猫，却实在有点骇人。日本的猫善于成精，传说中的“猫婆”，那食人的惨酷确是更可怕。中国古时候虽然曾有“猫鬼”，近来却很少听到猫的兴妖作怪，似乎古法已经失传，老实起来了。只是我在童年，总觉得它有点妖气，没有什么好感。那是一个我的幼时的夏夜，我躺在一株大桂树下的小板桌上乘凉，祖母摇着芭蕉扇坐在桌旁，给我猜谜，讲故事。忽然，桂树上沙沙地有趾爪的爬搔声，一对闪闪的眼睛在暗中随声而下，使我吃惊，也将祖母讲着的话打断，另讲猫的故事了——
I heard that the West doesn't like black cats very much, I don't know if it's true; But the black cat in Edgar Allan Poe's novel is really a bit terrifying. It was a summer night when I was a child, lying on a small board table under a big laurel tree to cool off, and my grandmother sat at the table shaking a banana fan, guessing riddles and telling me stories. Under the glimmer of the soybean oil lamp in the centuries-old house, it is a world of rats jumping on beams, walking and squeaking, and the attitude is often more loud than that of "famous professors". Cats are raised, but they don't care about eating. Although my grandmother and the others often hated the rats for breaking the boxes and stealing food, I thought it was not a great sin, and it had nothing to do with me, and this kind of bad thing was probably done by the big mice, and I must not frame the mice I loved. This kind of mouse mouse mostly walks on the ground, only the size of a thumb, and is not very afraid of people, we call it "hidden mouse", and the great one that lives in the house is a different kind. There are two pieces of flower paper in front of my bed, one is "Bajie Recruitment", the paper is full of long mouths and big ears, I think it is not very elegant; The other "mouse marriage" is cute, from the bride and groom to the ministers, guests, and deacons, none of them are not pointed cheeks and thin legs, like scholars, but they are all wearing red shirts and green pants. I think the only thing that can hold such a big ceremony must be the hidden rats I like. Now it is vulgar, and the wedding ceremonial guard of human beings on the road is only seen as an advertisement for sexual intercourse, and it is not very careful; But at that time, I wanted to see the ceremony of "mouse marriage", but I was extremely fascinated, even if I worshipped for three nights like the Jiang family in Haichang, I was afraid that I might not be upset to see it. The night of the fourteenth day of the first month was the night when I refused to sleep easily and waited for their honor guard to come out from under the bed. However, I still only saw a few naked hidden rats parading on the ground, not like they were holding a happy event. Until I couldn't stand it anymore and fell asleep, when I opened my eyes, it was already dawn, and it was the Festival of Lights. Perhaps the wedding ceremony of the rat tribe, not only does not divide the invitation, but also comes to collect congratulatory gifts, although it is really a "viewing ceremony", it is absolutely not welcome, I think, this is their habit, and they cannot protest.老鼠的大敌其实并不是猫。春后，你听到它“咋！咋咋咋咋！”地叫着，大家称为“老鼠数铜钱”的，便知道它的可怕的屠伯已经光降了。这声音是表现绝望的惊恐的，虽然遇见猫，还不至于这样叫。猫自然也可怕，但老鼠只要窜进一个小洞去，它也就奈何不得，逃命的机会还很多。独有那可怕的屠伯——蛇，身体是细长的，圆径和鼠子差不多，凡鼠子能到的地方，它也能到，追逐的时间也格外长，而且万难幸免，当“数钱”的时候，大概是已经没有第二步办法的了。
The enemy of mice is not actually cats. After spring, you hear it "What! Oh no! The man who called it "the rat counts copper coins" knew that its terrible butcher had descended from the light. This voice is a sign of desperate horror, although it does not bark like this when it meets a cat. Cats are naturally scary, but as long as the mouse scurls into a small hole, it can't help it, and there are still many opportunities to escape. The only terrible butcher - the snake, the body is slender, the diameter is similar to that of a mouse, wherever the rat can go, it can also go, the chase time is also extraordinarily long, and it is inevitable, when "counting money", there is probably no second step.有一回，我就听得一间空屋里有着这种“数钱”的声音，推门进去，一条蛇伏在横梁上，看地上，躺着一匹隐鼠，口角流血，但两胁还是一起一落的。取来给躺在一个纸盒子里，大半天，竟醒过来了，渐渐地能够饮食，行走，到第二日，似乎就复了原，但是不逃走。放在地上，也时时跑到人面前来，而且缘腿而上，一直爬到膝髁。给放在饭桌上，便检吃些菜渣，舐舐碗沿；放在我的书桌上，则从容地游行，看见砚台便舐吃了研着的墨汁。这使我非常惊喜了。我听父亲说过的，中国有一种墨猴，只有拇指一般大，全身的毛是漆黑而且发亮的。它睡在笔筒里，一听到磨墨，便跳出来，等着，等到人写完字，套上笔，就舐尽了砚上的余墨，仍旧跳进笔筒里去了。我就极愿意有这样的一个墨猴，可是得不到；问那里有，那里买的呢，谁也不知道。“慰情聊胜无”，这隐鼠总可以算是我的墨猴了罢，虽然它舐吃墨汁，并不一定肯等到我写完字。
Once, I heard this kind of "counting money" sound in an empty house, pushed the door in, a snake was lying on the beam, looking at the ground, there was a hidden rat lying on the ground, the corners of the mouth were bleeding, but the two sides still fell together. I took it and lay it in a cardboard box, and after most of the day, I woke up, and gradually I was able to eat and walk, and by the next day, it seemed to be back to normal, but I didn't run away. When placed on the ground, it also ran in front of people from time to time, and climbed up along the legs until it reached the kneecap. put it on the dining table, then check some vegetable residue and lick the edge of the bowl; Put it on my desk, and I paraded calmly, and when I saw the inkstone, I licked the ink I was grinding. This was a great surprise to me. I heard my father say that there is a kind of ink monkey in China, which is only the size of a thumb, and the hair on its whole body is black and shiny. It slept in the pen holder, and as soon as it heard the grinding ink, it jumped out, waited, and when the person finished writing and put on the pen, it licked up the remaining ink on the inkstone and still jumped into the pen holder. I would very much like to have such an ink monkey, but I can't get it; Ask where it is, where it is bought, no one knows. "Comfort and talk about nothing", this hidden rat can always be regarded as my ink monkey, although it licks the ink, and does not necessarily want to wait until I finish writing.现在已经记不分明，这样地大约有一两月；有一天，我忽然感到寂寞了，真所谓“若有所失”。我的隐鼠，是常在眼前游行的，或桌上，或地上。而这一日却大半天没有见，大家吃午饭了，也不见它走出来，平时，是一定出现的。我再等着，再等它一半天，然而仍然没有见。
Now I can't remember clearly, so it's been about a month or two; One day, I suddenly felt lonely, as if I had lost something. My hidden mouse often parades in front of me, or on the table, or on the ground. But on this day, I didn't see it for most of the day, everyone had lunch, and I didn't see it come out, usually, it must appear. I waited for another half day, but still didn't see it.长妈妈，一个一向带领着我的女工，也许是以为我等得太苦了罢，轻轻地来告诉我一句话。这即刻使我愤怒而且悲哀，决心和猫们为敌。她说：隐鼠是昨天晚上被猫吃去了！
My eldest mother, a female worker who has always led me, may have thought that I had waited too hard, so she gently came to tell me a word. This immediately made me angry and sad, determined to fight the cats. She said: The hidden rat was eaten by a cat last night!当我失掉了所爱的，心中有着空虚时，我要充填以报仇的恶念！
When I lose the one I love and have emptiness in my heart, I want to fill it with evil thoughts for revenge!我的报仇，就从家里饲养着的一匹花猫起手，逐渐推广，至于凡所遇见的诸猫。最先不过是追赶，袭击；后来却愈加巧妙了，能飞石击中它们的头，或诱入空屋里面，打得它垂头丧气。这作战继续得颇长久，此后似乎猫都不来近我了。但对于它们纵使怎样战胜，大约也算不得一个英雄；况且中国毕生和猫打仗的人也未必多，所以一切韬略，战绩，还是全都省略了罢。
My revenge started with a flower cat raised at home, and gradually promoted, as for all the cats I met. The first is just chasing, attacking; Later, it became more and more ingenious, and it could hit their heads with flying stones, or lure them into an empty house, beating it dejectedly. This battle lasted for quite a long time, and it seemed that the cats did not come near me after that. But no matter how they are defeated, they are probably not a hero; Moreover, there may not be many people in China who have fought with cats all their lives, so all strategies and achievements are omitted.但许多天之后，也许是已经经过了大半年，我竟偶然得到一个意外的消息：那隐鼠其实并非被猫所害，倒是它缘着长妈妈的腿要爬上去，被她一脚踏死了。
But many days later, perhaps more than half a year later, I accidentally got an unexpected news: the hidden rat was not actually killed by the cat, but it was about to climb up along the leg of the eldest mother and was trampled to death by her.这确是先前所没有料想到的。现在我已经记不清当时是怎样一个感想，但和猫的感情却终于没有融和；到了北京，还因为它伤害了兔的儿女们，便旧隙夹新嫌，使出更辣的辣手。“仇猫”的话柄，也从此传扬开来。然而在现在，这些早已是过去的事了，我已经改变态度，对猫颇为客气，倘其万不得已，则赶走而已，决不打伤它们，更何况杀害。这是我近几年的进步。经验既多，一旦大悟，知道猫的偷鱼肉，拖小鸡，深夜大叫，人们自然十之九是憎恶的，而这憎恶是在猫身上。假如我出而为人们驱除这憎恶，打伤或杀害了它，它便立刻变为可怜，那憎恶倒移在我身上了。所以，目下的办法，是凡遇猫们捣乱，至于有人讨厌时，我便站出去，在门口大声叱曰：“嘘！滚！”小小平静，即回书房，这样，就长保着御侮保家的资格。其实这方法，中国的官兵就常在实做的，他们总不肯扫清土匪或扑灭敌人，因为这么一来，就要不被重视，甚至于因失其用处而被裁汰。我想，如果能将这方法推广应用，我大概也总可望成为所谓“指导青年”的“前辈”的罢，但现下也还未决心实践，正在研究而且推敲。
This was indeed unexpected. Now I can't remember how I felt at that time, but my relationship with the cat finally didn't melt; When he arrived in Beijing, because he hurt the children of the rabbit, he used new suspicions in the old gap and used a spicier hand. The word "hatred of cats" has also spread since then. But now, these are long in the past, and I have changed my attitude, and I am quite polite to the cats, and if it is a last resort, I will just drive them away, and I will never hurt them, let alone kill them. This is my progress in recent years. After a lot of experience, once you realize that cats steal fish, drag chicks, and scream late at night, people naturally hate nine out of ten, and this hatred is in cats. If I go out and drive out this abomination for people, and wound or kill it, it immediately becomes pitiful, and the abomination is reversed on me. Therefore, the current solution is that whenever the cats make trouble, as for someone who hates it, I will stand up and shout loudly at the door: "Shh! Get lost! "A little calm, that is, go back to the study, so that you can maintain the qualification to resist insults and protect your family for a long time. In fact, this method is often practiced by Chinese officers and soldiers, and they are always unwilling to wipe out bandits or extinguish the enemy, because in this way, they will not be taken seriously, or even eliminated because they are useless. I think that if this method can be popularized and applied, I will probably always hope to become a "senior" who so-called "guides young people", but I have not yet decided to put it into practice, and I am studying and deliberating.一九二六年二月二十一日。
February 21, 1926.

阿长与《山海经》

阿长与《山海经》

阿长与《山海经》

A Chang and the "Classic of Mountains and Seas"长妈妈，已经说过，是一个一向带领着我的女工，说得阔气一点，就是我的保姆。我的母亲和许多别的人都这样称呼她，似乎略带些客气的意思。只有祖母叫她阿长。我平时叫她“阿妈”，连“长”字也不带；但到憎恶她的时候，——例如知道了谋死我那隐鼠的却是她的时候，就叫她阿长。
My eldest mother, as I have said, is a female worker who has always led me, and to put it bluntly, she is my nanny. My mother and many others called her that way, with a little politeness. Only her grandmother called her Ah Chang. I usually call her "Mom", and I don't even have the word "long"; But when it comes to hating her,—— for example, when you know that it was her who murdered me, you call her Ah Chang.我们那里没有姓长的；她生得黄胖而矮，“长”也不是形容词。又不是她的名字，记得她自己说过，她的名字是叫作什么姑娘的。什么姑娘，我现在已经忘却了，总之不是长姑娘；也终于不知道她姓什么。记得她也曾告诉过我这个名称的来历：先前的先前，我家有一个女工，身材生得很高大，这就是真阿长。后来她回去了，我那什么姑娘才来补她的缺，然而大家因为叫惯了，没有再改口，于是她从此也就成为长妈妈了。
We don't have a long one there; She was born yellow and fat and short, and "long" is not an adjective. It's not her name, I remember she herself said what kind of girl her name was. What girl, I have forgotten now, in short, not the eldest girl; Finally, I don't know what her surname is. I remember that she also told me the origin of this name: Previously, there was a female worker in my family who was very tall, this is the real Ah Chang. Later, when she went back, I didn't come to make up for her shortcomings, but everyone didn't change their words because they were used to it, so she became a long-term mother from then on.虽然背地里说人长短不是好事情，但倘使要我说句真心话，我可只得说：我实在不大佩服她。最讨厌的是常喜欢切切察察，向人们低声絮说些什么事，还竖起第二个手指，在空中上下摇动，或者点着对手或自己的鼻尖。我的家里一有些小风波，不知怎的我总疑心和这“切切察察”有些关系。又不许我走动，拔一株草，翻一块石头，就说我顽皮，要告诉我的母亲去了。一到夏天，睡觉时她又伸开两脚两手，在床中间摆成一个“大”字，挤得我没有余地翻身，久睡在一角的席子上，又已经烤得那么热。推她呢，不动；叫她呢，也不闻。
Although it is not a good thing to say that the length of a person is not a good thing behind my back, if I were to tell the truth, I would have to say: I really don't admire her. What I hate the most is that I often like to cheek and chat, whisper something to people, and raise a second finger, shake it up and down in the air, or point the tip of my opponent or my own nose. There is a small turmoil in my family, and somehow I always suspect that it has something to do with this "Che Che Cha Cha". He didn't allow me to move around, pull out a grass, turn over a stone, and said that I was naughty and wanted to tell my mother to go. In the summer, when she slept, she stretched out her feet and hands, and placed a "big" in the middle of the bed, so that I had no room to turn over, and I slept on the mat in the corner for a long time, and it was already so hot. Push her, don't move; Call her, don't smell it.“长妈妈生得那么胖，一定很怕热罢？晚上的睡相，怕不见得很好罢？……”
"The eldest mother is so fat, she must be afraid of the heat? I'm afraid I won't see a good sleeping appearance at night, right? ……”母亲听到我多回诉苦之后，曾经这样地问过她。我也知道这意思是要她多给我一些空席。她不开口。但到夜里，我热得醒来的时候，却仍然看见满床摆着一个“大”字，一条臂膊还搁在我的颈子上。我想，这实在是无法可想了。
After hearing my complaints repeatedly, my mother once asked her like this. I also knew that this meant asking her to give me more empty seats. She didn't speak. But at night, when I woke up so hot, I still saw the word "big" all over the bed, and an arm was still resting on my neck. I think this is really unimaginable.但是她懂得许多规矩；这些规矩，也大概是我所不耐烦的。一年中最高兴的时节，自然要数除夕了。辞岁之后，从长辈得到压岁钱，红纸包着，放在枕边，只要过一宵，便可以随意使用。睡在枕上，看着红包，想到明天买来的小鼓，刀枪，泥人，糖菩萨……。然而她进来，又将一个福橘放在床头了。
But she knows many rules; These rules are probably what I am impatient. The happiest time of the year is naturally Chinese New Year's Eve. After resigning, you can get New Year's money from your elders, wrap it in red paper, put it next to your pillow, and use it at will as long as you spend one night. Sleeping on the pillow, looking at the red envelope, thinking of the small drums, knives and guns, clay figures, sugar bodhisattvas, ...... bought tomorrow. However, she came in and put another Fu orange on the head of the bed.“哥儿，你牢牢记住！”她极其郑重地说。“明天是正月初一，清早一睁开眼睛，第一句话就得对我说：‘阿妈，恭喜恭喜！’记得么？你要记着，这是一年的运气的事情。不许说别的话！说过之后，还得吃一点福橘。”她又拿起那橘子来在我的眼前摇了两摇，“那么，一年到头，顺顺流流……。”
"Brother, remember it firmly!" She said extremely solemnly. "Tomorrow is the first day of the first lunar month, and as soon as I open my eyes early in the morning, the first thing I have to say to me is: 'Mom, congratulations!' Do you remember? You have to remember that this is a matter of luck for a year. Don't say anything else! After saying that, I have to eat a little Fu orange. She picked up the orange again and shook it twice in front of my eyes, "Then, all year round, it will flow smoothly...... ”梦里也记得元旦的，第二天醒得特别早，一醒，就要坐起来。她却立刻伸出臂膊，一把将我按住。我惊异地看她时，只见她惶急地看着我。
I also remember New Year's Day in my dream, and I woke up very early the next day, and when I woke up, I had to sit up. But she immediately stretched out her arm and held me down. When I looked at her in amazement, I saw her looking at me anxiously.她又有所要求似的，摇着我的肩。我忽而记得了——
She shook my shoulders as if she was asking for something again. I suddenly remembered-“阿妈，恭喜……。”
"Mom, congratulations ......."“恭喜恭喜！大家恭喜！真聪明！恭喜恭喜！”她于是十分喜欢似的，笑将起来，同时将一点冰冷的东西，塞在我的嘴里。我大吃一惊之后，也就忽而记得，这就是所谓福橘，元旦辟头的磨难，总算已经受完，可以下床玩耍去了。
"Congratulations, congratulations! Congratulations! How smart! Congratulations! She smiled as if she liked it very much, and at the same time stuffed a little cold thing into my mouth. After I was surprised, I suddenly remembered that this was the so-called Fu Orange, and the ordeal of New Year's Day was finally over, and I could get out of bed and play.她教给我的道理还很多，例如说人死了，不该说死掉，必须说“老掉了”；死了人，生了孩子的屋子里，不应该走进去；饭粒落在地上，必须拣起来，最好是吃下去；晒裤子用的竹竿底下，是万不可钻过去的……。此外，现在大抵忘却了，只有元旦的古怪仪式记得最清楚。总之：都是些烦琐之至，至今想起来还觉得非常麻烦的事情。
She taught me many more truths, such as saying that when a person dies, he should not say that he is dead, but must say "old"; dead people, in the house where children have been born, should not be walked in; When the rice falls on the ground, it must be picked up, and it is best to eat it; Under the bamboo pole used to dry pants, it is a ...... that must not be drilled through. Moreover, it is now largely forgotten, and only the strange rituals of New Year's Day are remembered best. In short: they are all troublesome things, and I still feel very troublesome when I think about them.然而我有一时也对她发生过空前的敬意。她常常对我讲“长毛”。她之所谓“长毛”者，不但洪秀全军，似乎连后来一切土匪强盗都在内，但除却革命党，因为那时还没有。她说得长毛非常可怕，他们的话就听不懂。她说先前长毛进城的时候，我家全都逃到海边去了，只留一个门房和年老的煮饭老妈子看家。后来长毛果然进门来了，那老妈子便叫他们“大王”，——据说对长毛就应该这样叫，——诉说自己的饥饿。长毛笑道：“那么，这东西就给你吃了罢！”将一个圆圆的东西掷了过来，还带着一条小辫子，正是那门房的头。煮饭老妈子从此就骇破了胆，后来一提起，还是立刻面如土色，自己轻轻地拍着胸脯道：“阿呀，骇死我了，骇死我了……。”
However, I also had unprecedented respect for her for a while. She often said "long hair" to me. Her so-called "long-haired" people not only included Hong Xiu's entire army, but also seemed to include all the bandits and robbers later, but except for the revolutionary party, because there was no such thing at that time. She said that the long hair was so scary that they couldn't understand what they said. She said that when Changmao went to the city before, all my family fled to the beach, leaving only a concierge and an old cooking mother to watch over the house. Later, when Changmao came in, the old mother called them "King",—— and it was said that Changmao should be called this ,—— tell him about his hunger. Long Mao smiled and said, "Then, this thing will be eaten for you!" He threw a round thing over, with a small pigtail, which was the head of the concierge. The old mother who cooked was frightened from then on, and when she mentioned it later, her face was immediately like earth, and she gently patted her chest and said, "Ah, I was scared, I was scared...... ”我那时似乎倒并不怕，因为我觉得这些事和我毫不相干的，我不是一个门房。但她大概也即觉到了，说道：“像你似的小孩子，长毛也要掳的，掳去做小长毛。还有好看的姑娘，也要掳。”
I didn't seem to be afraid at the time, because I felt that these things had nothing to do with me, and I was not a concierge. But she probably felt it immediately and said, "A child like you has long hair to be captured, and captured to make small long hair." There are also good-looking girls who will also be captured. ”“那么，你是不要紧的。”我以为她一定最安全了，既不做门房，又不是小孩子，也生得不好看，况且颈子上还有许多灸疮疤。
"Well, it doesn't matter to you." I thought she must be the safest, she is neither a concierge, nor a child, and she is not good-looking, and she has many moxibustion scars on her neck.“那里的话？！”她严肃地说。“我们就没有用么？我们也要被掳去。城外有兵来攻的时候，长毛就叫我们脱下裤子，一排一排地站在城墙上，外面的大炮就放不出来；再要放，就炸了！”
"Words there?!" She said seriously. "Aren't we useless? We will also be taken captive. When soldiers attacked outside the city, Changmao told us to take off our pants and stand on the city wall in rows, so that the cannons outside could not be released; If you want to put it again, it will explode! ”这实在是出于我意想之外的，不能不惊异。我一向只以为她满肚子是麻烦的礼节罢了，却不料她还有这样伟大的神力。从此对于她就有了特别的敬意，似乎实在深不可测；夜间的伸开手脚，占领全床，那当然是情有可原的了，倒应该我退让。
This is really unexpected and I can't help but be surprised. I always thought that she was full of troublesome etiquette, but I didn't expect her to have such great divine power. Crying bamboo shoots" is suspicious, afraid that my sincerity may not move the world like this. But if you can't cry out of the bamboo shoots, it's just throwing your face, and when it comes to "lying on the ice and begging for carp", your life is in danger. The weather in my hometown is mild, in the harsh winter, the water surface is only a thin layer of ice, no matter how small the weight of the child is, lying on it, there must be a loud noise, the ice breaks and falls into the water, and the carp has not had time to swim over. Naturally, you must disregard your life, so that filial piety will be to the gods, and there will be unexpected miracles, but I was still young at that time and really didn't understand this.其中最使我不解，甚至于发生反感的，是“老莱娱亲”和“郭巨埋儿”两件事。
Among them, the ones that puzzled me the most, and even disgusted, were the two things of "Lao Lai Yuqin" and "Guo Ju buried his child".我至今还记得，一个躺在父母跟前的老头子，一个抱在母亲手上的小孩子，是怎样地使我发生不同的感想呵。他们一手都拿着“摇咕咚”。这玩意儿确是可爱的，北京称为小鼓，盖即鼗也，朱熹曰，“鼗，小鼓，两旁有耳；持其柄而摇之，则旁耳还自击，”咕咚咕咚地响起来。然而这东西是不该拿在老莱子手里的，他应该扶一枝拐杖。现在这模样，简直是装佯，侮辱了孩子。我没有再看第二回，一到这一叶，便急速地翻过去了。
I still remember how an old man lying in front of his parents and a child holding his mother's hands made me feel differently. They all held "shaking dong in one hand". This thing is indeed cute, Beijing is called a small drum, and the cover is also a drum, Zhu Xi said, "The drum, the small drum, there are ears on both sides; Hold the handle and shake it, and the side ear will hit itself," the gurgling sounded. However, this thing should not be in Lao Laizi's hands, he should hold on to a cane. Now this appearance is simply pretending and insulting the child. I didn't look at it a second time, and as soon as I reached this leaf, I quickly turned over.那时的《二十四孝图》，早已不知去向了，目下所有的只是一本日本小田海僊所画的本子，叙老莱子事云，“行年七十，言不称老，常著五色斑斓之衣，为婴儿戏于亲侧。又常取水上堂，诈跌仆地，作婴儿啼，以娱亲意。”大约旧本也差不多，而招我反感的便是“诈跌”。无论忤逆，无论孝顺，小孩子多不愿意“诈”作，听故事也不喜欢是谣言，这是凡有稍稍留心儿童心理的都知道的。
At that time, the "Twenty-Four Filial Piety Pictures" had long been gone, and all that was there was now a book drawn by Oda Kaiqiao in Japan, narrating the story of Lao Laizi, "Seventy years old, not old, often wearing colorful clothes, playing for the baby on his side." He often took water from the hall, pretended to fall to the ground, and cried like a baby to entertain his parents. "It's about the same as the old version, and what disgusts me is the "fake fall". No matter how disobedient or filial piety is, most children are unwilling to "cheat" and do not like rumors when listening to stories, which is known to anyone who pays a little attention to children's psychology.然而在较古的书上一查，却还不至于如此虚伪。师觉授《孝子传》云，“老莱子……常著斑斓之衣，为亲取饮，上堂脚跌，恐伤父母之心，僵仆为婴儿啼。”（《太平御览》四百十三引）较之今说，似稍近于人情。不知怎地，后之君子却一定要改得他“诈”起来，心里才能舒服。邓伯道弃子救侄，想来也不过“弃”而已矣，昏妄人也必须说他将儿子捆在树上，使他追不上来才肯歇手。正如将“肉麻当作有趣”一般，以不情为伦纪，诬蔑了古人，教坏了后人。老莱子即是一例，道学先生以为他白璧无瑕时，他却已在孩子的心中死掉了。
However, if you look it up in an older book, it is not so hypocritical. Shi Jue taught him the "Biography of the Filial Son", saying, "Lao Laizi...... He often wore colorful clothes to fetch water for his parents. If he fell in class, he might hurt his parents' hearts, and he would freeze and cry like a baby. (413 quotes from "Taiping Yulan") Compared with today's statement, it seems to be slightly closer to human feelings. Somehow, the gentleman of the later generation must change him to "deceive" in order to feel comfortable. Deng Bodao abandoned his son to save his nephew, thinking that it was just "abandonment", and the foolish man had to say that he tied his son to a tree so that he could not catch up before he was willing to stop. Just as "meat and hemp are regarded as fun", taking heartlessness as the discipline of ethics slanders the ancients and teaching future generations. Lao Laizi is an example, when Mr. Taoism thought he was flawless, he had died in the child's heart.至于玩着“摇咕咚”的郭巨的儿子，却实在值得同情。他被抱在他母亲的臂膊上，高高兴兴地笑着；他的父亲却正在掘窟窿，要将他埋掉了。说明云，“汉郭巨家贫，有子三岁，母尝减食与之。巨谓妻曰，贫乏不能供母，子又分母之食。盍埋此子？”但是刘向《孝子传》所说，却又有些不同：巨家是富的，他都给了两弟；孩子是才生的，并没有到三岁。结末又大略相像了，“及掘坑二尺，得黄金一釜，上云：天赐郭巨，官不得取，民不得夺！”
As for Guo Ju's son who plays "Shake Gu Dong", it is really worthy of sympathy. He was held in his mother's arms and smiled happily; His father was digging a hole and wanted to bury him. The explanation said, "Han Guo's family is poor, and he has a three-year-old son, and his mother has reduced his food to give it." Wei Ju said to his wife, "I am too poor to support my mother, and my son will share my mother's food." Why not bury this child? But what Liu Xiang said in "The Biography of Filial Sons" is a little different: the giant family is rich, and he gave it to his two younger brothers; The child was born and did not reach the age of three. The ending is roughly similar, "When the pit was dug two feet, a pot of gold was obtained, and it was said: God gave Guo Ju, the official cannot take it, and the people cannot take it!" ”我最初实在替这孩子捏一把汗，待到掘出黄金一釜，这才觉得轻松。然而我已经不但自己不敢再想做孝子，并且怕我父亲去做孝子了。家景正在坏下去，常听到父母愁柴米；祖母又老了，倘使我的父亲竟学了郭巨，那么，该埋的不正是我么？如果一丝不走样，也掘出一釜黄金来，那自然是如天之福，但是，那时我虽然年纪小，似乎也明白天下未必有这样的巧事。
At first, I really sweated for this child, and only then did I feel relaxed when I dug out a pot of gold. However, not only did I dare not want to be a filial son anymore, but I was afraid that my father would be a filial son. The family scenery is deteriorating, and I often hear my parents worrying about firewood; My grandmother is old again, if my father actually learns from Guo Ju, then isn't it me who should be buried? If you don't go out of shape at all, you can dig out a pot of gold, which will naturally be like a blessing from heaven, but although I was young at that time, I seemed to understand that there may not be such a coincidence in the world.现在想起来，实在很觉得傻气。这是因为现在已经知道了这些老玩意，本来谁也不实行。整饬伦纪的文电是常有的，却很少见绅士赤条条地躺在冰上面，将军跳下汽车去负米。何况现在早长大了，看过几部古书，买过几本新书，什么《太平御览》咧，《古孝子传》咧，《人口问题》咧，《节制生育》咧，《二十世纪是儿童的世界》咧，可以抵抗被埋的理由多得很。不过彼一时，此一时，彼时我委实有点害怕：掘好深坑，不见黄金，连“摇咕咚”一同埋下去，盖上土，踏得实实的，又有什么法子可想呢。我想，事情虽然未必实现，但我从此总怕听到我的父母愁穷，怕看见我的白发的祖母，总觉得她是和我不两立，至少，也是一个和我的生命有些妨碍的人。后来这印象日见其淡了，但总有一些留遗，一直到她去世——这大概是送给《二十四孝图》的儒者所万料不到的罢。
Now that I think about it, I really feel stupid. This is because these old things are now known, and no one would have practiced them in the first place. It is common to see a gentleman lying naked on the ice, and the general jumping out of the car to carry the meter. What's more, now that I have grown up, I have read a few ancient books, bought a few new books, what "Taiping Yulan", "The Biography of Ancient Filial Sons", "Population Issues", "Birth Control", "The Twentieth Century is a Children's World", there are many reasons to resist being buried. But at that time, at this time, I was really a little scared: dig a deep pit, don't see the gold, and bury it with "shaking and gurgling", cover it with soil, and step on it solidly, what can I think of? I think that although things may not come true, I have always been afraid of hearing that my parents are poor, afraid of seeing my gray-haired grandmother, and always feel that she is incompatible with me, at least, she is also a person who is a little in the way of my life. Later, this impression faded day by day, but there were always some legacies, until her death - this was probably unexpected by the Confucian scholars who gave it to the "Twenty-Four Filial Piety Diagram".五月十日。
May 10th.
