五猖会

五猖会

Five Rampant Society孩子们所盼望的，过年过节之外，大概要数迎神赛会的时候了。但我家的所在很偏僻，待到赛会的行列经过时，一定已在下午，仪仗之类，也减而又减，所剩的极其寥寥。往往伸着颈子等候多时，却只见十几个人抬着一个金脸或蓝脸红脸的神像匆匆地跑过去。于是，完了。
What the children are looking forward to is that in addition to the New Year's holidays, it is probably time to welcome the gods. But my home is very remote, and by the time the procession of the competition passes, it must have been in the afternoon, and the honor guards and the like have also been reduced and reduced, and there are extremely few left. Often stretched out their necks and waited for a long time, only to see more than a dozen people carrying a statue of a god with a golden face or a blue face and a red face running over in a hurry. So, it's over.我常存着这样的一个希望：这一次所见的赛会，比前一次繁盛些。可是结果总是一个“差不多”；也总是只留下一个纪念品，就是当神像还未抬过之前，化一文钱买下的，用一点烂泥，一点颜色纸，一枝竹签和两三枝鸡毛所做的，吹起来会发出一种刺耳的声音的哨子，叫作“吹都都”的，吡吡地吹它两三天。
I often have this hope that the competition I saw this time was more prosperous than the previous one. But the result is always "almost"; There is always only one souvenir left, that is, when the statue is not carried up, it is bought for a penny, made with a little mud, a little colored paper, a bamboo skewer and two or three chicken feathers, and it will make a harsh sound when it is blown, called "blowing Dudu", and it will be blown for two or three days.现在看看《陶庵梦忆》，觉得那时的赛会，真是豪奢极了，虽然明人的文章，怕难免有些夸大。因为祷雨而迎龙王，现在也还有的，但办法却已经很简单，不过是十多人盘旋着一条龙，以及村童们扮些海鬼。那时却还要扮故事，而且实在奇拔得可观。他记扮《水浒传》中人物云：“……于是分头四出，寻黑矮汉，寻梢长大汉，寻头陀，寻胖大和尚，寻茁壮妇人，寻姣长妇人，寻青面，寻歪头，寻赤须，寻美髯，寻黑大汉，寻赤脸长须。大索城中；无，则之郭，之村，之山僻，之邻府州县。用重价聘之，得三十六人，梁山泊好汉，个个呵活，臻臻至至，人马称娖而行。……”这样的白描的活古人，谁能不动一看的雅兴呢？可惜这种盛举，早已和明社一同消灭了。
Now looking at "Tao'an Dream Memory", I feel that the competition at that time was really extravagant, although the articles of the Ming people are probably a little exaggerated. There are still some to welcome the Dragon King because of praying for rain, but the method is already very simple, just more than ten people hovering around a dragon, and the village children pretending to be some sea ghosts. At that time, I still had to pretend to be a story, and it was really extraordinary. He remembered playing the characters in "Water Margin": "...... So they split their heads and went out in all directions, looking for the black dwarf, looking for the big man, looking for the head tuo, looking for the fat monk, looking for the strong woman, looking for the long woman, looking for the green face, looking for the crooked head, looking for the red beard, looking for the beautiful beard, looking for the black man, looking for the red face and long beard. Dasuo City; If there is none, then go to the city, the village, the mountain, the neighboring prefecture and county. They hired them at a high price, and thirty-six people were recruited, all of whom were heroes from Liangshanbo, all of whom were cared for and treated with utmost care, and the people and horses praised and walked together. ...... "Who can not look at the elegant interest of such a living ancient? It's a pity that this grand event has long been eliminated along with the Ming Society.赛会虽然不像现在上海的旗袍，北京的谈国事，为当局所禁止，然而妇孺们是不许看的，读书人即所谓士子，也大抵不肯赶去看。只有游手好闲的闲人，这才跑到庙前或衙门前去看热闹；我关于赛会的知识，多半是从他们的叙述上得来的，并非考据家所贵重的“眼学”。然而记得有一回，也亲见过较盛的赛会。开首是一个孩子骑马先来，称为“塘报”；过了许久，“高照”到了，长竹竿揭起一条很长的旗，一个汗流浃背的胖大汉用两手托着；他高兴的时候，就肯将竿头放在头顶或牙齿上，甚而至于鼻尖。其次是所谓“高跷”，“抬阁”，“马头”了；还有扮犯人的，红衣枷锁，内中也有孩子。我那时觉得这些都是有光荣的事业，与闻其事的即全是大有运气的人，——大概羡慕他们的出风头罢。我想，我为什么不生一场重病，使我的母亲也好到庙里去许下一个“扮犯人”的心愿的呢？……然而我到现在终于没有和赛会发生关系过。
Although the competition is not like the cheongsam in Shanghai now, and the discussion of state affairs in Beijing is prohibited by the authorities, women and children are not allowed to watch it, and scholars, the so-called scholars, are probably unwilling to rush to see it. Only idle people who are idle will go to the temple or yamen to watch the excitement; Most of my knowledge about the competition comes from their narratives, not the "eye science" that is valuable to researchers. However, I remember one time, I also saw a more prosperous competition in person. At the beginning, a child rode a horse first, called "Tang Bao"; After a long time, the "high light" arrived, and a long bamboo pole lifted a very long flag, held by a sweaty fat man with both hands; When he was happy, he was willing to put the head of the rod on the top of his head or on his teeth, and even the tip of his nose. followed by the so-called "stilts", "pavilion", and "horse head"; There are also prisoners, red shackles, and children inside. At that time, I thought that these were all glorious careers, and those who heard about them were all lucky people,—— probably envious of their limelight. I thought, why didn't I get seriously ill so that my mother would go to the temple to make a wish to "pretend to be a prisoner"? …… However, I have never had a relationship with the competition until now.要到东关看五猖会去了。这是我儿时所罕逢的一件盛事。因为那会是全县中最盛的会，东关又是离我家很远的地方，出城还有六十多里水路，在那里有两座特别的庙。一是梅姑庙，就是《聊斋志异》所记，室女守节，死后成神，却篡取别人的丈夫的；现在神座上确塑着一对少年男女，眉开眼笑，殊与“礼教”有妨。其一便是五猖庙了，名目就奇特。据有考据癖的人说：这就是五通神。然而也并无确据。神像是五个男人，也不见有什么猖獗之状；后面列坐着五位太太，却并不“分坐”，远不及北京戏园里界限之谨严。其实呢，这也是殊与“礼教”有妨的，——但他们既然是五猖，便也无法可想，而且自然也就“又作别论”了。
I want to go to Dongguan to see the Five Rampant Society. This was a rare event in my childhood. Because it was the most prosperous meeting in the county, Dongguan was far away from my home, and there were more than 60 miles of waterway out of the city, where there were two special temples. The first is the Meigu Temple, which is recorded in "Liao Zhai Zhi Yi", where the maid kept the festival and became a god after death, but usurped someone else's husband; Now there is indeed a pair of young men and women on the throne, smiling with their eyebrows open, which is particularly harmful to "etiquette". One of them is the Five Rampant Temple, which has a peculiar name. According to people with a fetish for research: This is the five gods. However, there is no conclusive evidence. the statue of five men, and there was no rampant appearance; There are five wives sitting in the back, but they are not "separated", which is far less strict than the strict boundaries in the Beijing Theater. In fact, this is also very harmful to "etiquette",—— but since they are five rampant, they cannot be imagined, and naturally they are "another story".因为东关离城远，大清早大家就起来。昨夜预定好的三道明瓦窗的大船，已经泊在河埠头，船椅，饭菜，茶炊，点心盒子，都在陆续搬下去了。我笑着跳着，催他们要搬得快。忽然，工人的脸色很谨肃了，我知道有些蹊跷，四面一看，父亲就站在我背后。
Because Dongguan is far from the city, everyone gets up early in the morning. The big boat with three bright tile windows booked last night has been moored at the river wharf, and the chairs, meals, samovar and snack boxes have been moved down one after another. I laughed and jumped, urging them to move fast. Suddenly, the worker's face became very serious, I knew something was strange, and when I looked around, my father was standing behind me.“去拿你的书来。”他慢慢地说。
"Go get your book." He said slowly.这所谓“书”，是指我开蒙时候所读的《鉴略》，因为我再没有第二本了。我们那里上学的岁数是多拣单数的，所以这使我记住我其时是七岁。
This so-called "book" refers to the "Jianlue" that I read when I was enlightened, because I don't have a second one. The age of our school there was odd, so it made me remember that I was seven years old.我忐忑着，拿了书来了。他使我同坐在堂中央的桌子前，教我一句一句地读下去。我担着心，一句一句地读下去。
I was apprehensive and brought the book. He made me sit at a table in the center of the hall and taught me to read sentence by sentence. I carried my heart and read it sentence by sentence.两句一行，大约读了二三十行罢，他说：
After reading about twenty or thirty lines in one sentence and one line, he said:“给我读熟。背不出，就不准去看会。”
"Read it to me. If you can't memorize it, you are not allowed to go to the meeting. ”他说完，便站起来，走进房里去了。
After he finished speaking, he stood up and walked into the room.我似乎从头上浇了一盆冷水。但是，有什么法子呢？自然是读着，读着，强记着，——而且要背出来。
I seem to pour a basin of cold water over my head. But what can be done? Naturally, read, read, memorize ,—— and memorize it.粤自盘古，生于太荒，Guangdong has been born in the Great Wilderness since Pangu, and 
首出御世，肇开混茫。 was the first to emerge from the world, starting from the chaos.
就是这样的书，我现在只记得前四句，别的都忘却了；那时所强记的二三十行，自然也一齐忘却在里面了。记得那时听人说，读《鉴略》比读《千字文》，《百家姓》有用得多，因为可以知道从古到今的大概。知道从古到今的大概，那当然是很好的，然而我一字也不懂。“粤自盘古”就是“粤自盘古”，读下去，记住它，“粤自盘古”呵！“生于太荒”呵！……
This is such a book, I only remember the first four sentences now, and I have forgotten everything else; The twenty or thirty lines that I had memorized at that time were naturally forgotten in it. I remember hearing people say that reading "Jianlue" is much more useful than reading "Thousand Character Text" and "Hundred Family Surnames", because you can know the general situation from ancient times to the present. Of course, it is good to know the general idea from ancient times to the present, but I don't understand a word. "Guangdong from Pangu" is "Guangdong from Pangu", read on, remember it, "Guangdong from Pangu" huh! "Born in the wilderness" Huh! ……应用的物件已经搬完，家中由忙乱转成静肃了。朝阳照着西墙，天气很清朗。母亲，工人，长妈妈即阿长，都无法营救，只默默地静候着我读熟，而且背出来。在百静中，我似乎头里要伸出许多铁钳，将什么“生于太荒”之流夹住；也听到自己急急诵读的声音发着抖，仿佛深秋的蟋蟀，在夜中鸣叫似的。

I suddenly seemed to be very sure, so I stood up, took the book and walked into my father's study, memorized it in one go, and finished memorizing it like a dream.“不错。去罢。”父亲点着头说。

impermanence迎神赛会这一天出巡的神，如果是掌握生杀之权的，——不，这生杀之权四个字不大妥，凡是神，在中国仿佛都有些随意杀人的权柄似的，倒不如说是职掌人民的生死大事的罢，就如城隍和东岳大帝之类，那么，他的卤簿中间就另有一群特别的脚色：鬼卒，鬼王，还有活无常。
The god who went out on the tour on the day of the Welcoming God Competition, if he is in control of the power of life and death,—— no, the four words of the right of life and death are not very appropriate, all gods, in China seem to have some authority to kill people at will, but it is better to say that they are in charge of the people's life and death events, such as the City God and the Dongyue Emperor, then, there is another group of special foot characters in the middle of his ceremonial procession: ghost soldiers, ghost kings, and living impermanence.这些鬼物们，大概都是由粗人和乡下人扮演的。鬼卒和鬼王是红红绿绿的衣裳，赤着脚；蓝脸，上面又画些鱼鳞，也许是龙鳞或别的什么鳞罢，我不大清楚。鬼卒拿着钢叉，叉环振得琅琅地响，鬼子拿的是一块小小的虎头牌。据传说，鬼王是只用一只脚走路的；但他究竟是乡下人，虽然脸上已经画上些鱼鳞或者别的什么鳞，却仍然只得用了两只脚走路。所以看客对于他们不很敬畏，也不大留心，除了念佛老妪和她的孙子们为面面圆到起见，也照例给他们一个“不胜屏营待命之至”的仪节。
These ghosts are probably played by rough people and country people. The ghost soldier and the ghost king are dressed in red, red and green, barefoot; Blue face, and some fish scales are drawn on it, maybe dragon scales or some other scales, I don't know. The ghost soldier held a steel fork, the fork ring vibrated loudly, and the devil was holding a small tiger head card. According to legend, the ghost king walked on only one foot; But he was a countryman, although he had painted some fish scales or other scales on his face, but he still had to walk on two feet. Therefore, the spectators were not very in awe of them, nor did they pay much attention, except for the old woman and her grandchildren who were round, they also gave them a "standing by" ceremony as usual.至于我们——我相信：我和许多人——所最愿意看的，却在活无常。他不但活泼而诙谐，单是那浑身雪白这一点，在红红绿绿中就有“鹤立鸡群”之概。只要望见一顶白纸的高帽子和他手里的破芭蕉扇的影子，大家就都有些紧张，而且高兴起来了。
As for us, I believe, I and many others, what we want to see most is living impermanence. He is not only lively and witty, but also has the idea of "standing out from the flock" in the red, red, green and green alone. As long as they saw the shadow of a tall hat on white paper and the broken banana fan in his hand, everyone was a little nervous and happy.人民之于鬼物，惟独与他最为稔熟，也最为亲密，平时也常常可以遇见他。譬如城隍庙或东岳庙中，大殿后面就有一间暗室，叫作“阴司间”，在才可辨色的昏暗中，塑着各种鬼：吊死鬼，跌死鬼，虎伤鬼，科场鬼，……而一进门口所看见的长而白的东西就是他。我虽然也曾瞻仰过一回这“阴司间”，但那时胆子小，没有看明白。听说他一手还拿着铁索，因为他是勾摄生魂的使者。相传樊江东岳庙的“阴司间”的构造，本来是极其特别的：门口是一块活板，人一进门，踏着活板的这一端，塑在那一端的他便扑过来，铁索正套在你脖子上。后来吓死了一个人，钉实了，所以在我幼小的时候，这就已不能动。
The people are the most familiar with ghosts, and they are the most intimate, and they can often meet him. For example, in the City God Temple or Dongyue Temple, there is a dark room behind the main hall, called the "Underworld Room", in the darkness where colors can be distinguished, all kinds of ghosts are sculpted: hanging ghosts, falling ghosts, tiger wounding ghosts, and science field ghosts,...... And the long, white thing he saw as soon as he entered the door was him. Although I had also admired this "underworld" once, I was timid and didn't understand it at that time. I heard that he was still holding an iron rope in one hand, because he was a messenger of seducing souls. According to legend, the structure of the "underworld" of the Dongyue Temple in Fanjiang was originally extremely special: the door was a trap, and as soon as a person entered the door, stepped on this end of the trap, he pounced on the sculpted at that end, and the iron cable was put around your neck. I still remember that when I was in my hometown, I often happily faced this ghost and human, reasonable and emotional, terrifying and lovely impermanence; And appreciate the crying or laughter on his face, the hard words and the ...... of humor.迎神时候的无常，可和演剧上的又有些不同了。他只有动作，没有言语，跟定了一个捧着一盘饭菜的小丑似的脚色走，他要去吃；他却不给他。另外还加添了两名脚色，就是“正人君子”之所谓“老婆儿女”。凡“下等人”，都有一种通病：常喜欢以己之所欲，施之于人。虽是对于鬼，也不肯给他孤寂，凡有鬼神，大概总要给他们一对一对地配起来。无常也不在例外。所以，一个是漂亮的女人，只是很有些村妇样，大家都称她无常嫂；这样看来，无常是和我们平辈的，无怪他不摆教授先生的架子。一个是小孩子，小高帽，小白衣；虽然小，两肩却已经耸起了，眉目的外梢也向下。这分明是无常少爷了，大家却叫他阿领，对于他似乎都不很表敬意；猜起来，仿佛是无常嫂的前夫之子似的。但不知何以相貌又和无常有这么像？吁！鬼神之事，难言之矣，只得姑且置之弗论。至于无常何以没有亲儿女，到今年可很容易解释了：鬼神能前知，他怕儿女一多，爱说闲话的就要旁敲侧击地锻成他拿卢布，所以不但研究，还早已实行了“节育”了。
The impermanence of welcoming the gods is a little different from acting. He only moved, no words, and walked like a clown holding a plate of food, and he was going to eat; But he didn't give it to him. In addition, two characters were added, the so-called "wives and children" of "upright gentlemen". All "inferior people" have a common problem: they often like to do what they want to others. Even for ghosts, they refuse to give him loneliness, and whenever there are ghosts and gods, they must probably be matched with them one-on-one. Impermanence is no exception. Therefore, one is a beautiful woman, but she looks like a village woman, and everyone calls her impermanent sister-in-law; From this point of view, impermanence is on the same level as us, so it's no wonder he doesn't put on the shelf of a professor. one is a child, a little top hat, and a little white dress; Although small, the shoulders are already raised, and the outer tips of the eyebrows are also down. This is clearly the impermanent young master, but everyone calls him Ah Ling, and they don't seem to show much respect for him; Guessing it, it seems to be the son of the ex-husband of the impermanence sister-in-law. But I don't know why it looks so similar to impermanence? Sigh! The matters of ghosts and gods are difficult to discuss, so I have to set aside them for now. As for why impermanence does not have children, it is easy to explain this year: ghosts and gods can foresee, he is afraid that there will be many children, and those who love to gossip will forge him into taking rubles, so he not only researched, but also practiced "birth control".这捧着饭菜的一幕，就是“送无常”。因为他是勾魂使者，所以民间凡有一个人死掉之后，就得用酒饭恭送他。至于不给他吃，那是赛会时候的开玩笑，实际上并不然。但是，和无常开玩笑，是大家都有此意的，因为他爽直，爱发议论，有人情，——要寻真实的朋友，倒还是他妥当。
This scene of holding a meal is "sending impermanence". Because he is a soul seduction messenger, whenever a person dies in the folk, he must be sent off with wine and food. As for not giving him food, it was a joke during the competition, but in fact it was not. However, joking with impermanence is something everyone has this intention, because he is straightforward, loves to talk, has favors,—— and wants to find real friends, but he is still appropriate.有人说，他是生人走阴，就是原是人，梦中却入冥去当差的，所以很有些人情。我还记得住在离我家不远的小屋子里的一个男人，便自称是“走无常”，门外常常燃着香烛。但我看他脸上的鬼气反而多。莫非入冥做了鬼，倒会增加人气的么？吁！鬼神之事，难言之矣，这也只得姑且置之弗论了。
Some people say that he is a living person who goes to the yin, that is, he was originally a human being, but he went to the underworld to work as an errand boy in his dream, so he has a lot of favors. I still remember a man who lived in a small house not far from my house, who called himself a "walking impermanence", and often burned incense candles outside the door. But I see that there is more ghostly energy on his face. Could it be that going into the underworld and becoming a ghost will increase his popularity? Sigh! 从百草园到三味书屋

从百草园到三味书屋

从百草园到三味书屋

From Baicao Garden to Sanwei Bookstore我家的后面有一个很大的园，相传叫作百草园。现在是早已并屋子一起卖给朱文公的子孙了，连那最末次的相见也已经隔了七八年，其中似乎确凿只有一些野草；但那时却是我的乐园。
There is a large garden behind my house, which is said to be called Baicao Garden. Now it has already been sold to Zhu Wengong's descendants along with the house, and even the last meeting has been separated by seven or eight years, and it seems that there are only some weeds in it; But it was my paradise then.不必说碧绿的菜畦，光滑的石井栏，高大的皂荚树，紫红的桑椹；也不必说鸣蝉在树叶里长吟，肥胖的黄蜂伏在菜花上，轻捷的叫天子（云雀）忽然从草间直窜向云霄里去了。单是周围的短短的泥墙根一带，就有无限趣味。油蛉在这里低唱，蟋蟀们在这里弹琴。翻开断砖来，有时会遇见蜈蚣；还有斑蝥，倘若用手指按住它的脊梁，便会拍的一声，从后窍喷出一阵烟雾。何首乌藤和木莲藤缠络着，木莲有莲房一般的果实，何首乌有拥肿的根。有人说，何首乌根是有像人形的，吃了便可以成仙，我于是常常拔它起来，牵连不断地拔起来，也曾因此弄坏了泥墙，却从来没有见过有一块根像人样。如果不怕刺，还可以摘到覆盆子，像小珊瑚珠攒成的小球，又酸又甜，色味都比桑椹要好得远。
Needless to say, the turquoise vegetable beds, the smooth stone well railing, the tall acacia trees, and the purple-red mulberries; Needless to say, the cicadas sang in the leaves, the fat wasps lay on the cauliflower, and the sky sky (lark) suddenly flew straight from the grass into the sky. Just the surrounding area of the short mud wall root is infinitely interesting. Oilflies sing here, and crickets play here. When you turn over the broken bricks, you will sometimes meet centipedes; There is also a cantharid, if you press its spine with your fingers, it will slap and spew out a burst of smoke from the back orifice. He Shou Wu vine and magnolia vine are intertwined, magnolia has lotus-like fruits, and He Shou Wu has swollen roots. Some people say that He Shou Wugen has a humanoid shape, and you can become an immortal if you eat it, so I often pulled it up, implicated and constantly pulled it up, and I have also broken the mud wall because of this, but I have never seen a root that looks like a human. If you are not afraid of thorns, you can also pick raspberries, like small balls made of small coral beads, sour and sweet, and the color and taste are far better than mulberries.长的草里是不去的，因为相传这园里有一条很大的赤练蛇。
It is not in the long grass, because it is said that there is a large red snake in this garden.长妈妈曾经讲给我一个故事听：先前，有一个读书人住在古庙里用功，晚间，在院子里纳凉的时候，突然听到有人在叫他。答应着，四面看时，却见一个美女的脸露在墙头上，向他一笑，隐去了。他很高兴；但竟给那走来夜谈的老和尚识破了机关。说他脸上有些妖气，一定遇见“美女蛇”了；这是人首蛇身的怪物，能唤人名，倘一答应，夜间便要来吃这人的肉的。他自然吓得要死，而那老和尚却道无妨，给他一个小盒子，说只要放在枕边，便可高枕而卧。他虽然照样办，却总是睡不着，——当然睡不着的。到半夜，果然来了，沙沙沙！门外像是风雨声。他正抖作一团时，却听得豁的一声，一道金光从枕边飞出，外面便什么声音也没有了，那金光也就飞回来，敛在盒子里。后来呢？后来，老和尚说，这是飞蜈蚣，它能吸蛇的脑髓，美女蛇就被它治死了。
My eldest mother once told me a story: Previously, a scholar lived in an ancient temple and worked hard, and at night, when he was cooling off in the yard, he suddenly heard someone calling him. Agreed, and when he looked around, he saw a beautiful woman's face exposed on the wall, smiled at him, and disappeared. He was happy; But he actually saw through the mechanism for the old monk who came to talk at night. said that he had a little demonic aura on his face, and he must have met a "beautiful snake"; This is a monster with a human head and a snake body, which can call people's names, and if they agree, they will come to eat this person's flesh at night. He was naturally scared to death, but the old monk said it was okay, gave him a small box, and said that as long as he put it next to his pillow, he could lie down with his pillow. Although he still did it, he always couldn't sleep,—— of course he couldn't sleep. In the middle of the night, it really came, rustling! Outside the door was like the sound of wind and rain. When he was shaking into a ball, he heard a sudden, a golden light flew out from the pillow, and there was no sound outside, and the golden light flew back and was hidden in the box. What happened later? Later, the old monk said that this was a flying centipede, which could suck the brain marrow of a snake, and the beautiful snake was killed by it.结末的教训是：所以倘有陌生的声音叫你的名字，你万不可答应他。
The final lesson is: So if a strange voice calls your name, you must not agree to him.这故事很使我觉得做人之险，夏夜乘凉，往往有些担心，不敢去看墙上，而且极想得到一盒老和尚那样的飞蜈蚣。走到百草园的草丛旁边时，也常常这样想。但直到现在，总还是没有得到，但也没有遇见过赤练蛇和美女蛇。叫我名字的陌生声音自然是常有的，然而都不是美女蛇。
This story makes me feel very dangerous to be a person, enjoying the shade on summer nights, often a little worried, not daring to look at the wall, and really wanting to get a box of flying centipedes like the old monk. When I walk to the grass in the Baicao Garden, I often think like this. But until now, I still haven't gotten it, but I haven't met the red snake and the beautiful snake. Unfamiliar voices calling my name are naturally common, but they are not beautiful snakes.冬天的百草园比较的无味；雪一下，可就两样了。拍雪人（将自己的全形印在雪上）和塑雪罗汉需要人们鉴赏，这是荒园，人迹罕至，所以不相宜，只好来捕鸟。薄薄的雪，是不行的；总须积雪盖了地面一两天，鸟雀们久已无处觅食的时候才好。扫开一块雪，露出地面，用一枝短棒支起一面大的竹筛来，下面撒些秕谷，棒上系一条长绳，人远远地牵着，看鸟雀下来啄食，走到竹筛底下的时候，将绳子一拉，便罩住了。但所得的是麻雀居多，也有白颊的“张飞鸟”，性子很躁，养不过夜的。
the grass garden in winter is relatively tasteless; Snow is the same. Shooting snowmen (printing their full form on the snow) and sculpting snow arhats need to be appreciated, this is a deserted garden, inaccessible to people, so it is not suitable, so they have to come to catch birds. Thin snow is not good; It is always good when the snow covers the ground for a day or two, and the birds have nowhere to forage for a long time. Sweep away a piece of snow, expose the ground, use a short stick to prop up a large bamboo sieve, sprinkle some chaff grain below, tie a long rope to the stick, people lead it from a distance, watch the birds come down to peck, and when they walk under the bamboo sieve, pull the rope and cover it. But most of the sparrows are obtained, and there are also white-cheeked "Zhang flying birds", which are very irritable and cannot be raised overnight.这是闰土的父亲所传授的方法，我却不大能用。明明见它们进去了，拉了绳，跑去一看，却什么都没有，费了半天力，捉住的不过三四只。闰土的父亲是小半天便能捕获几十只，装在叉袋里叫着撞着的。我曾经问他得失的缘由，他只静静地笑道：你太性急，来不及等它走到中间去。
This is the method taught by Runtu's father, but I can't use it. Obviously seeing them go in, I pulled the rope and ran to take a look, but there was nothing, and it took a long time to catch only three or four. Runtu's father was able to catch dozens of them in half a day, and put them in fork bags and screamed and bumped into them. I once asked him the reason for his gains and losses, and he only smiled quietly and said: You are too impatient to wait for it to go to the middle.我不知道为什么家里的人要将我送进书塾里去了，而且还是全城中称为最严厉的书塾。也许是因为拔何首乌毁了泥墙罢，也许是因为将砖头抛到间壁的梁家去了罢，也许是因为站在石井栏上跳了下来罢，……都无从知道。总而言之：我将不能常到百草园了。Ade，我的蟋蟀们！Ade，我的覆盆子们和木莲们！……
I don't know why my family sent me to a cram school, and it was called the strictest cram school in the city. Maybe it was because He Shou Wu destroyed the mud wall, maybe it was because he threw bricks at the Liang family, or maybe he jumped off while standing on the stone well railing,...... Go out to the east, less than half a mile, walk across a stone bridge, and you will find my husband's home. Entering through a black oil bamboo door, the third room is the study. There is a flat road hanging in the middle: Sanwei Bookstore; Below the flat is a painting depicting a very fat sika deer lying under an ancient tree. Without the Confucius tablet, we saluted the flat and the deer. The first time is to worship Confucius, and the second time is to worship Mr.第二次行礼时，先生便和蔼地在一旁答礼。他是一个高而瘦的老人，须发都花白了，还戴着大眼镜。我对他很恭敬，因为我早听到，他是本城中极方正，质朴，博学的人。
When he saluted for the second time, the gentleman kindly returned the salute on the side. He was a tall and thin old man with gray hair and big glasses. I have great respect for him, because I have heard that he is the most upright, simple, and erudite man in the city.不知从那里听来的，东方朔也很渊博，他认识一种虫，名曰“怪哉”，冤气所化，用酒一浇，就消释了。我很想详细地知道这故事，但阿长是不知道的，因为她毕竟不渊博。现在得到机会了，可以问先生。
I don't know where I heard it, Dongfang Shuo is also very knowledgeable, he knows a kind of insect, called "weird", the grievances are transformed, and they are dissolved when poured with wine. There is also a garden behind the Sanwei Bookstore, although small, but there you can also climb up the flower bed to fold wax plum blossoms and look for cicadas on the ground or osmanthus trees. I suspect this is an excellent article, because when I read this, he always smiles, and raises his head, shakes it, twists it backwards, twists it.先生读书入神的时候，于我们是很相宜的。有几个便用纸糊的盔甲套在指甲上做戏。我是画画儿，用一种叫作“荆川纸”的，蒙在小说的绣像上一个个描下来，像习字时候的影写一样。读的书多起来，画的画也多起来；书没有读成，画的成绩却不少了，最成片段的是《荡寇志》和《西游记》的绣像，都有一大本。后来，因为要钱用，卖给一个有钱的同窗了。他的父亲是开锡箔店的；听说现在自己已经做了店主，而且快要升到绅士的地位了。这东西早已没有了罢。

父亲的病

父亲的病

父亲的病

Father's illness大约十多年前罢，S城中曾经盛传过一个名医的故事：
About ten years ago, there was a story of a famous doctor in S City:他出诊原来是一元四角，特拔十元，深夜加倍，出城又加倍。有一夜，一家城外人家的闺女生急病，来请他了，因为他其时已经阔得不耐烦，便非一百元不去。他们只得都依他。待去时，却只是草草地一看，说道“不要紧的”，开一张方，拿了一百元就走。那病家似乎很有钱，第二天又来请了。他一到门，只见主人笑面承迎，道，“昨晚服了先生的药，好得多了，所以再请你来复诊一回。”仍旧引到房里，老妈子便将病人的手拉出帐外来。他一按，冷冰冰的，也没有脉，于是点点头道，“唔，这病我明白了。”从从容容走到桌前，取了药方纸，提笔写道：
His visit turned out to be one yuan and four corners, and he specially selected ten yuan, which was doubled late at night and doubled when he went out of the city. One night, a girl from an out-of-town family fell ill and came to invite him, because he was already impatient at that time, so he had to go for 100 yuan. They had to rely on him. When he went, he just looked at it hastily, said "it doesn't matter", opened a square, took 100 yuan and left. The patient seemed to be very rich, and he came to invite him again the next day. As soon as he arrived at the door, he saw the owner smiling and greeting, and said, "I took my husband's medicine last night, and it was much better, so I would like you to come for a follow-up consultation." Still led into the room, the old mother pulled the patient's hand out of the tent. He pressed, cold and had no pulse, so he nodded and said, "Well, I understand this disease." From calmly walked to the table, took the prescription paper, picked up a pen and wrote:“凭票付英洋壹百元正。”下面是署名，画押。
"Pay 100 yuan with the ticket." Below is the signature, drawn.“先生，这病看来很不轻了，用药怕还得重一点罢。”主人在背后说。
"Sir, this disease seems to be very serious, and I am afraid that the medication will be a little heavier." The master said behind his back.“可以。”他说。于是另开了一张方：
"Yes." He said. So I opened another square:“凭票付英洋贰百元正。”下面仍是署名，画押。
"Pay the British and Ocean two hundred yuan by the ticket." The following is still signed, drawn and signed.这样，主人就收了药方，很客气地送他出来了。
In this way, the master accepted the prescription and sent him out very politely.我曾经和这名医周旋过两整年，因为他隔日一回，来诊我的父亲的病。那时虽然已经很有名，但还不至于阔得这样不耐烦；可是诊金却已经是一元四角。现在的都市上，诊金一次十元并不算奇，可是那时是一元四角已是巨款，很不容易张罗的了；又何况是隔日一次。他大概的确有些特别，据舆论说，用药就与众不同。我不知道药品，所觉得的，就是“药引”的难得，新方一换，就得忙一大场。先买药，再寻药引。“生姜”两片，竹叶十片去尖，他是不用的了。起码是芦根，须到河边去掘；一到经霜三年的甘蔗，便至少也得搜寻两三天。可是说也奇怪，大约后来总没有购求不到的。
I had dealt with this doctor for two whole years, because he came to see my father every other day. Although it was already famous at that time, it was not so wide and impatient; But the consultation fee is already one yuan and four corners. In today's cities, it is not surprising that the consultation fee is ten yuan at a time, but at that time it was a huge amount of money, and it was not easy to spread it; Not to mention once every other day. He is probably indeed a little special, and according to public opinion, the use of medicine is different. I don't know about medicines, but what I think is that "medicine introduction" is rare, and once the new prescription is changed, you have to be busy a lot. Buy medicine first, then look for a drug license. Two pieces of "ginger" and ten bamboo leaves to remove the tip, he didn't use it. At least the reed roots must be dug up by the river; As soon as the sugarcane that has been frosted for three years arrives, it has to be searched for at least two or three days. But it's strange to say, probably there is nothing that can't be purchased later.据舆论说，神妙就在这地方。先前有一个病人，百药无效；待到遇见了什么叶天士先生，只在旧方上加了一味药引：梧桐叶。只一服，便霍然而愈了。“医者，意也。”其时是秋天，而梧桐先知秋气。其先百药不投，今以秋气动之，以气感气，所以……。我虽然并不了然，但也十分佩服，知道凡有灵药，一定是很不容易得到的，求仙的人，甚至于还要拚了性命，跑进深山里去采呢。
According to public opinion, the magic is in this place. There was a patient before, and all medicines were ineffective; When I met Mr. Ye Tianshi, I only added a medicine to the old recipe: sycamore leaves. After just one dose, he was cured. "Doctors are intentions." It was autumn, and the sycamore tree knew the autumn air. Previously, all drugs were not injected, but now they are moved by autumn energy, which is why they are ....... Although I don't know, I also admire it very much, knowing that wherever there is an elixir, it must be very difficult to obtain, and those who seek immortality even have to risk their lives to run into the mountains to pick them.这样有两年，渐渐地熟识，几乎是朋友了。父亲的水肿是逐日利害，将要不能起床；我对于经霜三年的甘蔗之流也逐渐失了信仰，采办药引似乎再没有先前一般踊跃了。正在这时候，他有一天来诊，问过病状，便极其诚恳地说：
After two years, we gradually became acquainted and almost became friends. My father's edema is a daily stake, and he will not be able to get up; I gradually lost faith in sugarcane and other things that had been frosted for three years, and it seemed that I was no longer as enthusiastic about purchasing medicine as before. At this time, he came to the clinic one day, asked about the condition, and said extremely sincerely:“我所有的学问，都用尽了。这里还有一位陈莲河先生，本领比我高。我荐他来看一看，我可以写一封信。可是，病是不要紧的，不过经他的手，可以格外好得快……。”
"All my knowledge has been exhausted. There is also a Mr. Chen Lianhe here, who is more skilled than me. I recommended him to take a look, and I could write a letter. However, it doesn't matter if the disease is good, but through his hands, it can be cured very quickly...... ”这一天似乎大家都有些不欢，仍然由我恭敬地送他上轿。进来时，看见父亲的脸色很异样，和大家谈论，大意是说自己的病大概没有希望的了；他因为看了两年，毫无效验，脸又太熟了，未免有些难以为情，所以等到危急时候，便荐一个生手自代，和自己完全脱了干系。但另外有什么法子呢？本城的名医，除他之外，实在也只有一个陈莲河了。明天就请陈莲河。
Everyone seemed to be a little unhappy on this day, and I still respectfully sent him into the sedan chair. When I came in, I saw that my father's face was very strange, and I talked to everyone, to the effect that my illness was probably hopeless; Because he had been watching it for two years, it was ineffective, and his face was too familiar, so he waited until the time was critical, so he recommended a new person to take his place and completely disconnected from himself. But what else can be done? In addition to him, there is really only one famous doctor in this city, Chen Lianhe. Tomorrow, please invite Chen Lianhe.陈莲河的诊金也是一元四角。但前回的名医的脸是圆而胖的，他却长而胖了：这一点颇不同。还有用药也不同，前回的名医是一个人还可以办的，这一回却是一个人有些办不妥帖了，因为他一张药方上，总兼有一种特别的丸散和一种奇特的药引。
Chen Lianhe's consultation fee is also one yuan and four corners. But the face of the famous doctor last time was round and fat, but he was long and fat: this is quite different. There is also a difference in the use of medicine, the famous doctor last time can be done by one person, but this time it is a person who is a little inappropriate, because he always has a special pill powder and a peculiar medicine guide on a prescription.芦根和经霜三年的甘蔗，他就从来没有用过。最平常的是“蟋蟀一对”，旁注小字道：“要原配，即本在一窠中者。”似乎昆虫也要贞节，续弦或再醮，连做药资格也丧失了。但这差使在我并不为难，走进百草园，十对也容易得，将它们用线一缚，活活地掷入沸汤中完事。然而还有“平地木十株”呢，这可谁也不知道是什么东西了，问药店，问乡下人，问卖草药的，问老年人，问读书人，问木匠，都只是摇摇头，临末才记起了那远房的叔祖，爱种一点花木的老人，跑去一问，他果然知道，是生在山中树下的一种小树，能结红子如小珊瑚珠的，普通都称为“老弗大”。
He has never used reed roots and sugarcane that has been frosted for three years. The most common is "a pair of crickets", with a small note on the sidelines: "To be the original match, that is, the one who is in a nest." It seems that insects also have to be chastity, renew their strings or remarry, and even lose their qualifications to make medicine. But this errand is not difficult for me, walking into the Baicao Garden, ten pairs are also easy to get, tie them with a thread, and throw them alive into the boiling water to finish the task. However, there are also "ten flat trees", no one knows what it is, ask the pharmacy, ask the countryman, ask the herb seller, ask the elderly, ask the scholar, ask the carpenter, they all just shook their heads, and at the end of the day, they remembered the distant uncle, the old man who loved to plant a little flowers and trees, ran to ask, he really knew that it was a kind of small tree born under the tree in the mountains, which can produce red seeds like small coral beads, and is usually called "Lao Fu Da".“踏破铁鞋无觅处，得来全不费工夫。”药引寻到了，然而还有一种特别的丸药：败鼓皮丸。这“败鼓皮丸”就是用打破的旧鼓皮做成；水肿一名鼓胀，一用打破的鼓皮自然就可以克伏他。清朝的刚毅因为憎恨“洋鬼子”，预备打他们，练了些兵称作“虎神营”，取虎能食羊，神能伏鬼的意思，也就是这道理。可惜这一种神药，全城中只有一家出售的，离我家就有五里，但这却不像平地木那样，必须暗中摸索了，陈莲河先生开方之后，就恳切详细地给我们说明。
"There is nowhere to find a place to step on the iron shoes, and it takes no effort to get it." The medicine was found, but there was also a special pill: the drum skin pill. This "defeated drum skin ball" is made of broken old drum skin; The edema is called bulge, and the broken drum skin can naturally subdue him. The fortitude of the Qing Dynasty was to fight them because of its hatred of the "foreign devils", and trained some soldiers called the "Tiger God Camp", which means that tigers can eat sheep and gods can subdue ghosts, which is the truth. It's a pity that this kind of miracle medicine is only sold in one store in the city, five miles away from my home, but this is not like flat wood, it must be groped secretly, after Mr. Chen Lianhe prescribed the prescription, he earnestly explained it to us in detail.“我有一种丹，”有一回陈莲河先生说，“点在舌上，我想一定可以见效。因为舌乃心之灵苗……。价钱也并不贵，只要两块钱一盒……。”
"I have a kind of pill," Mr. Chen Lianhe said once, "and I think it will definitely work on the tongue." Because the tongue is the spiritual seedling of the heart...... The price is not expensive, only two yuan a box ....... ”我父亲沉思了一会，摇摇头。
My father pondered for a while and shook his head.“我这样用药还会不大见效，”有一回陈莲河先生又说，“我想，可以请人看一看，可有什么冤愆……。医能医病，不能医命，对不对？自然，这也许是前世的事……。”
"I will not be effective if I use medicine like this," Mr. Chen Lianhe said once, "I think I can ask someone to take a look, but what is wrong...... Doctors can treat diseases, but they can't treat lives, right? Naturally, this may be a matter of the past life...... ”我的父亲沉思了一会，摇摇头。
My father pondered for a while and shook his head.凡国手，都能够起死回生的，我们走过医生的门前，常可以看见这样的扁额。现在是让步一点了，连医生自己也说道：“西医长于外科，中医长于内科。”但是S城那时不但没有西医，并且谁也还没有想到天下有所谓西医，因此无论什么，都只能由轩辕岐伯的嫡派门徒包办。轩辕时候是巫医不分的，所以直到现在，他的门徒就还见鬼，而且觉得“舌乃心之灵苗”。这就是中国人的“命”，连名医也无从医治的。
All national players can come back to life, and we can often see such a flat forehead when we walk in front of the doctor. Now it's time to make some concessions, and even the doctor himself said: "Western medicine is better than surgery, and traditional Chinese medicine is better than internal medicine." But S City not only did not have Western medicine at that time, but no one thought that there was a so-called Western medicine in the world, so no matter what, it could only be arranged by Xuanyuan Qibo's direct disciples. Xuanyuan was a witch doctor in his time, so until now, his disciples still saw ghosts and felt that "the tongue is the spiritual seedling of the heart". This is the "life" of the Chinese, and even famous doctors cannot cure it.不肯用灵丹点在舌头上，又想不出“冤愆”来，自然，单吃了一百多天的“败鼓皮丸”有什么用呢？依然打不破水肿，父亲终于躺在床上喘气了。还请一回陈莲河先生，这回是特拔，大洋十元。他仍旧泰然的开了一张方，但已停止败鼓皮丸不用，药引也不很神妙了，所以只消半天，药就煎好，灌下去，却从口角上回了出来。
Refusing to use the elixir on the tongue, and not being able to think of "injustice", naturally, what is the use of taking the "defeated drum skin pill" for more than a hundred days? Still unable to break the edema, my father finally lay on the bed and gasped. Please also go back to Mr. Chen Lianhe, this time it is special, ten yuan in the ocean. He still calmly prescribed a prescription, but he had stopped using the drum skin pills, and the medicine was not very mysterious, so it only took half a day for the medicine to be fried and poured, but it came back from the corner of his mouth.从此我便不再和陈莲河先生周旋，只在街上有时看见他坐在三名轿夫的快轿里飞一般抬过；听说他现在还康健，一面行医，一面还做中医什么学报，正在和只长于外科的西医奋斗哩。
Since then, I have no longer dealt with Mr. Chen Lianhe, and I have only sometimes seen him flying in the fast sedan chair of three sedan bearers on the street; I heard that he is still healthy, practicing medicine while also doing some journals of traditional Chinese medicine, and is struggling with Western medicine that is only good at surgery.中西的思想确乎有一点不同。听说中国的孝子们，一到将要“罪孽深重祸延父母”的时候，就买几斤人参，煎汤灌下去，希望父母多喘几天气，即使半天也好。我的一位教医学的先生却教给我医生的职务道：可医的应该给他医治，不可医的应该给他死得没有痛苦。——但这先生自然是西医。
There is indeed a little difference between Chinese and Western thinking. I heard that Chinese filial sons, when they were about to "bring great sins to their parents", bought a few pounds of ginseng and poured it into the soup, hoping that their parents would breathe a few more days, even if it was half a day. One of my teachers who taught medicine taught me the position of doctor: those who can be treated should be healed, and those who cannot be treated should be given to die painlessly. ——But this gentleman is naturally a Western doctor.父亲的喘气颇长久，连我也听得很吃力，然而谁也不能帮助他。我有时竟至于电光一闪似的想道：“还是快一点喘完了罢……。”立刻觉得这思想就不该，就是犯了罪；但同时又觉得这思想实在是正当的，我很爱我的父亲。便是现在，也还是这样想。
My father's breathing was quite long, and even I had a hard time listening, but no one could help him. Sometimes I even thought like a flash of lightning, "It's better to catch my breath quickly...... "Immediately thinking that this thought should not be done is to commit a sin; But at the same time, I feel that this idea is really justified, and I love my father very much. Even now, I still think so.早晨，住在一门里的衍太太进来了。她是一个精通礼节的妇人，说我们不应该空等着。于是给他换衣服；又将纸锭和一种什么《高王经》烧成灰，用纸包了给他捏在拳头里……。
In the morning, Mrs. Yan, who lived in a door, came in. She is a woman who is well known in etiquette and says that we should not wait in vain. So he changed his clothes; He also burned the paper ingots and some kind of "Gao Wang Jing" to ashes, wrapped them in paper and pinched them in his fists......“叫呀，你父亲要断气了。快叫呀！”衍太太说。
"Scream, your father is dying. Shout! Mrs. Yan said.“父亲！父亲！”我就叫起来。
"Father! Father! I screamed.“大声！他听不见。还不快叫？！”
"Loud! He couldn't hear. Why don't you scream?!" ”“父亲！！！父亲！！！”
"Father!! Father!!! ”他已经平静下去的脸，忽然紧张了，将眼微微一睁，仿佛有一些苦痛。
His face, which had calmed down, suddenly became nervous, and he opened his eyes slightly, as if he had some pain.“叫呀！快叫呀！”她催促说。
"Scream! Shout! She urged.“父亲！！！”
"Father !!"“什么呢？……不要嚷。……不……。”他低低地说，又较急地喘着气，好一会，这才复了原状，平静下去了。
"What? …… Don't shout. …… No....... He said in a low voice, panting more urgently, and after a while, he returned to his original state and calmed down.“父亲！！！”我还叫他，一直到他咽了气。
"Father !!" I called him until he took his breath.我现在还听到那时的自己的这声音，每听到时，就觉得这却是我对于父亲的最大的错处。
I still hear my voice at that time, and every time I hear it, I feel that this is my biggest mistake towards my father.十月七日。
October 7th.

Trivia衍太太现在是早经做了祖母，也许竟做了曾祖母了；那时却还年青，只有一个儿子比我大三四岁。她对自己的儿子虽然狠，对别家的孩子却好的，无论闹出什么乱子来，也决不去告诉各人的父母，因此我们就最愿意在她家里或她家的四近玩。
Mrs. Yan has now become a grandmother early, and may have become a great-grandmother; I was still young at that time, with only one son who was three or four years older than me. Although she is cruel to her son, she is good to other children, no matter what trouble occurs, she will never tell everyone's parents, so we are most willing to play in her house or near her house.举一个例说罢，冬天，水缸里结了薄冰的时候，我们大清早起一看见，便吃冰。有一回给沈四太太看到了，大声说道：“莫吃呀，要肚子疼的呢！”这声音又给我母亲听到了，跑出来我们都挨了一顿骂，并且有大半天不准玩。我们推论祸首，认定是沈四太太，于是提起她就不用尊称了，给她另外起了一个绰号，叫作“肚子疼”。
For example, in winter, when there is thin ice in the water tank, we eat ice as soon as we see it early in the morning. Once Mrs. Shen Si saw it and said loudly: "Don't eat, your stomach will hurt!" "This voice was heard by my mother again, and we were all scolded when we ran out, and we were not allowed to play for most of the day. We deduced that the culprit was Mrs. Shen Si, so we didn't need to use honorific titles when we mentioned her, and gave her another nickname, called "stomach pain".衍太太却决不如此。假如她看见我们吃冰，一定和蔼地笑着说，“好，再吃一块。我记着，看谁吃的多。”
Mrs. Yan would never do this. If she saw us eating ice, she would smile kindly and say, "Okay, eat another piece." I remember to see who eats more. ”但我对于她也有不满足的地方。一回是很早的时候了，我还很小，偶然走进她家去，她正在和她的男人看书。我走近去，她便将书塞在我的眼前道，“你看，你知道这是什么？”我看那书上画着房屋，有两个人光着身子仿佛在打架，但又不很像。正迟疑间，他们便大笑起来了。这使我很不高兴，似乎受了一个极大的侮辱，不到那里去大约有十多天。一回是我已经十多岁了，和几个孩子比赛打旋子，看谁旋得多。她就从旁计着数，说道，“好，八十二个了！再旋一个，八十三！好，八十四……”但正在旋着的阿祥，忽然跌倒了，阿祥的婶母也恰恰走进来。她便接着说道，“你看，不是跌了么？不听我的话。我叫你不要旋，不要旋……。”
But I am also dissatisfied with her. The first time was very early, I was still very young, and I happened to walk into her house, and she was reading a book with her man. I approached, and she stuffed the book in front of my eyes and said, "Look, do you know what this is?" "I saw that the book depicted houses, and there were two people naked as if they were fighting, but they didn't look alike. While they were hesitating, they burst into laughter. This made me very unhappy, as if I had been greatly insulted, and I had not been there for about ten days. Once I was in my teens, I competed with a few children to see who spun more. She counted from the side and said, "Okay, eighty-two!" Spin one more, eighty-three! Okay, eighty-four ......" But Ah Xiang, who was spinning, suddenly fell, and Ah Xiang's aunt also walked in. She continued, "Look, didn't you fall? Don't listen to me. I told you not to spin, not to spin ....... ”虽然如此，孩子们总还喜欢到她那里去。假如头上碰得肿了一大块的时候，去寻母亲去罢，好的是骂一通，再给擦一点药；坏的是没有药擦，还添几个栗凿和一通骂。衍太太却决不埋怨，立刻给你用烧酒调了水粉，搽在疙瘩上，说这不但止痛，将来还没有瘢痕。
Even so, the children always like to go to her. If you have a large lump of swelling on your head, go find your mother, and if you scold it, you can wipe some medicine; The bad thing is that there is no medicine, and a few chestnuts and a scolding are added. After my father passed away, I often went to her house, but instead of playing with the children, I was chatting with Mrs. Yan or her man. At that time, I felt that there were many things to buy, see and eat, but there was no money. One day when she talked about this, she said, "You can use your mother's money, isn't it yours?" "I said that my mother had no money, so she said that she could sell the jewelry; I said there was no jewelry, but she said, "Maybe you didn't pay attention." In the chef's drawer, if you go down to the corner and look for it, you can always find a little bead or something like that....... ”这些话我听去似乎很异样，便又不到她那里去了，但有时又真想去打开大厨，细细地寻一寻。大约此后不到一月，就听到一种流言，说我已经偷了家里的东西去变卖了，这实在使我觉得有如掉在冷水里。流言的来源，我是明白的，倘是现在，只要有地方发表，我总要骂出流言家的狐狸尾巴来，但那时太年青，一遇流言，便连自己也仿佛觉得真是犯了罪，怕遇见人们的眼睛，怕受到母亲的爱抚。
These words seemed strange to me, so I didn't go to her again, but sometimes I really wanted to open the chef and look for it carefully. About a month later, I heard a rumor that I had stolen things from my house and sold them, which really made me feel like I had fallen into cold water. I understand the source of the rumors, if it were now, as long as there was a place to publish, I would always scold the fox tail of the rumorist, but at that time I was too young, and when I encountered rumors, even I felt that I had really committed a crime, afraid of meeting people's eyes, and afraid of being caressed by my mother.好。那么，走罢！

But where to go? The faces of the people in S City have been familiar for a long time, and that's all, even the heart and liver seem to be a little clear. You have to find another type of people, to find people who are criticized by the people of S City, whether they are beasts or devils. At that time, a school that was ridiculed and scolded by the whole city for a short time was called the Chinese and Western School, which taught some foreign languages and arithmetic in addition to Chinese. However, it has become the target of public criticism; The scholars who were familiar with the books of the sages also collected the sentences of the "Four Books" and made an eight-strand to ridicule it, and this famous article spread throughout the city, and everyone regarded it as an interesting topic. I only remember that the beginning of the "speech" was:“徐子以告夷子曰：吾闻用夏变夷者，未闻变于夷者也。今也不然：舌之音，闻其声，皆雅言也。……”
“徐子以告夷子曰：吾闻用夏变夷者，未闻变于夷者也。 今也不然：舌之音，闻其声，皆雅言也。 ……”以后可忘却了，大概也和现今的国粹保存大家的议论差不多。但我对于这中西学堂，却也不满足，因为那里面只教汉文，算学，英文和法文。功课较为别致的，还有杭州的求是书院，然而学费贵。

Is it a rat？ "The whole day is reading Hanwen: "The gentleman said, Uncle Ying Kao can be described as pure filial piety, loving his mother, and giving to Duke Zhuang." Of course, when I first entered, I could only be a third-class student, and the bedroom was a table, a stool and a bed, and there were only two bed boards. The students in the first two classes are different, two tables, two stools or three stools and a bed, and there are as many as three bed boards. Not only did he carry a pile of thick and large foreign books when he went to the lecture hall, but he walked proudly, which was by no means only the third class students of "Po Lai Ma" and four "Zuo Zhuan" dared to face up; Even if he is empty-handed, he must stretch his elbow bend, like a crab, and the lower class can never get out of front of him. In the first four or five years, he actually found this posture on the broken leg lounge chair of the Ministry of Education, but this master was not from the Thunder and Lightning Academy, which shows that the crab attitude is also quite common in China.可爱的是桅杆。但并非如“东邻”的“支那通”所说，因为它“挺然翘然”，又是什么的象征。乃是因为它高，乌鸦喜鹊，都只能停在它的半途的木盘上。人如果爬到顶，便可以近看狮子山，远眺莫愁湖，——但究竟是否真可以眺得那么远，我现在可委实有点记不清楚了。而且不危险，下面张着网，即使跌下来，也不过如一条小鱼落在网子里；况且自从张网以后，听说也还没有人曾经跌下来。

The people who run the school are probably kind-hearted, so every year on the 15th of July, a group of monks are always invited to the playground on rainy days to set off the flames, and a big monk with a red nose and a fat monk wears a Pilu hat, pinches the spell, and recites a mantra: "Return the money, Pumiye!" Oh yes! Om! Yes! Bellow!!! ”我的前辈同学被关圣帝君镇压了一整年，就只在这时候得到一点好处，——虽然我并不深知是怎样的好处。所以当这些时，我每每想：做学生总得自己小心些。

“赫胥黎独处一室之中，在英伦之南，背山而面野，槛外诸境，历历如在机下。 乃悬想二千年前，当罗马大将恺彻未到时，此间有何景物？计惟有天造草昧……”哦！原来世界上竟还有一个赫胥黎坐在书房里那么想，而且想得那么新鲜？一口气读下去，“物竞”“天择”也出来了，苏格拉第，柏拉图也出来了，斯多噶也出来了。学堂里又设立了一个阅报处，《时务报》不待言，还有《译学汇编》，那书面上的张廉卿一流的四个字，就蓝得很可爱。

When school started, the coal mine had dismissed the original technician and replaced it with a person who didn't know much. The reasons are: 1. The salary of the previous technician is too expensive; Second, they think it is not difficult to open a coal mine. Since it is not profitable to open a mine, there is naturally no need to open a mining road, but somehow, it is not abolished. By the third year when we went down to the mine to see, the situation was really bleak, of course, the pumping machine was still turning, but the water in the mine was half a foot deep, and it was dripping down from above, and several miners were working like ghosts here.毕业，自然大家都盼望的，但一到毕业，却又有些爽然若失。爬了几次桅，不消说不配做半个水兵；听了几年讲，下了几回矿洞，就能掘出金银钢铁锡来么？实在连自己也茫无把握，没有做《工欲善其事必先利其器论》的那么容易。爬上天空二十丈和钻下地面二十丈，结果还是一无所能，学问是“上穷碧落下黄泉，两处茫茫皆不见”了。所余的还只有一条路：到外国去。

There is only one way left: to a foreign country.留学的事，官僚也许可了，派定五名到日本去。其中的一个因为祖母哭得死去活来，不去了，只剩了四个。日本是同中国很两样的，我们应该如何准备呢？有一个前辈同学在，比我们早一年毕业，曾经游历过日本，应该知道些情形。跑去请教之后，他郑重地说：
The bureaucrats also allowed them to study abroad and sent five people to Japan. One of them died because his grandmother cried and did not go, leaving only four. Japan is very different from China, how should we prepare? There is a senior classmate who graduated a year before us and has traveled to Japan, so he should know something. After running to ask for advice, he said solemnly:“日本的袜是万不能穿的，要多带些中国袜。我看纸票也不好，你们带去的钱不如都换了他们的现银。”
"Japanese socks must not be worn, bring more Chinese socks. I don't think paper tickets are good, so it's better to exchange the money you bring for their cash. ”四个人都说遵命。别人不知其详，我是将钱都在上海换了日本的银元，还带了十双中国袜——白袜。
All four of them said they would obey orders. Others don't know the details, I exchanged all my money in Shanghai for Japanese silver dollars, and also brought ten pairs of Chinese socks - white socks.后来呢？后来，要穿制服和皮鞋，中国袜完全无用；一元的银圆日本早已废置不用了，又赔钱换了半元的银圆和纸票。

Mr. Fujino东京也无非是这样。上野的樱花烂熳的时节，望去确也像绯红的轻云，但花下也缺不了成群结队的“清国留学生”的速成班，头顶上盘着大辫子，顶得学生制帽的顶上高高耸起，形成一座富士山。也有解散辫子，盘得平的，除下帽来，油光可鉴，宛如小姑娘的发髻一般，还要将脖子扭几扭。实在标致极了。

When the cherry blossoms in Ueno are in full bloom, they do look like crimson light clouds, but there are also groups of "Qing international students" under the flowers. There are also disbanded braids, flattened, and when the hat is removed, the oil shine is recognizable, just like a little girl's bun, and the neck has to be twisted a few times. It's really Peugeot.中国留学生会馆的门房里有几本书买，有时还值得去一转；倘在上午，里面的几间洋房里倒也还可以坐坐的。但到傍晚，有一间的地板便常不免要咚咚咚地响得震天，兼以满房烟尘斗乱；问问精通时事的人，答道，“那是在学跳舞。”
There are several books to buy in the concierge of the China International Student Association, and sometimes it is worth a visit; If it is in the morning, you can still sit in the few bungalows inside. But in the evening, the floor of one room often had to make a loud noise, and the room was full of smoke and dust; Ask someone who is well-versed in current affairs and they reply, "That's learning to dance." ”到别的地方去看看，如何呢？
How about going somewhere else?我就往仙台的医学专门学校去。从东京出发，不久便到一处驿站，写道：日暮里。不知怎地，我到现在还记得这名目。其次却只记得水户了，这是明的遗民朱舜水先生客死的地方。仙台是一个市镇，并不大；冬天冷得利害；还没有中国的学生。
I went to a medical school in Sendai. Departing from Tokyo, I soon arrived at a post station and wrote: Nippori. Somehow, I still remember the name. Secondly, I only remember Mito, which is the place where Mr. Zhu Shunshui, a remnant of the Ming Dynasty, died. Sendai is a municipality, not big; Winter is cold; There are no Chinese students yet.大概是物以希为贵罢。北京的白菜运往浙江，便用红头绳系住菜根，倒挂在水果店头，尊为“胶菜”；福建野生着的芦荟，一到北京就请进温室，且美其名曰“龙舌兰”。我到仙台也颇受了这样的优待，不但学校不收学费，几个职员还为我的食宿操心。我先是住在监狱旁边一个客店里的，初冬已经颇冷，蚊子却还多，后来用被盖了全身，用衣服包了头脸，只留两个鼻孔出气。在这呼吸不息的地方，蚊子竟无从插嘴，居然睡安稳了。饭食也不坏。但一位先生却以为这客店也包办囚人的饭食，我住在那里不相宜，几次三番，几次三番地说。我虽然觉得客店兼办囚人的饭食和我不相干，然而好意难却，也只得别寻相宜的住处了。于是搬到别一家，离监狱也很远，可惜每天总要喝难以下咽的芋梗汤。
It is probably because things are rare and precious. When cabbage from Beijing is shipped to Zhejiang, the roots of the vegetables are tied with a red-headed rope and hung upside down in the fruit store, which is revered as "glue vegetables"; Aloe vera, which is wild in Fujian, is invited into the greenhouse as soon as it arrives in Beijing, and it is beautifully called "agave". I also received such preferential treatment when I arrived in Sendai, not only did the school not charge tuition, but several staff members also worried about my food and accommodation. I first lived in an inn next to the prison, it was already quite cold in early winter, but there were still many mosquitoes, and then I covered my whole body with a quilt, wrapped my head and face with clothes, leaving only two nostrils to breathe. In this breathless place, the mosquitoes couldn't interject, and they actually slept peacefully. The food is not bad either. But one gentleman thought that this inn also arranged meals for prisoners, and it was not suitable for me to live there, so he said it several times, several times. Although I felt that the inn also served as a prisoner's meal had nothing to do with me, it was difficult to refuse good intentions, so I had to find a suitable place to live. So I moved to another house, which was also very far from the prison, but unfortunately I always had to drink taro stem soup that was difficult to swallow every day.从此就看见许多陌生的先生，听到许多新鲜的讲义。解剖学是两个教授分任的。最初是骨学。其时进来的是一个黑瘦的先生，八字须，戴着眼镜，挟着一叠大大小小的书。一将书放在讲台上，便用了缓慢而很有顿挫的声调，向学生介绍自己道：
Since then, I have seen many strange gentlemen and heard many fresh handouts. Anatomy is divided between two professors. Originally osteology. At that time, a black and thin gentleman came in, with a mustache, glasses, and a stack of books. As soon as he put the book on the podium, he introduced himself to the students in a slow and frustrated tone:“我就是叫作藤野严九郎的……。”
"I'm the ...... named Fujino Yankuro."后面有几个人笑起来了。他接着便讲述解剖学在日本发达的历史，那些大大小小的书，便是从最初到现今关于这一门学问的著作。起初有几本是线装的；还有翻刻中国译本的，他们的翻译和研究新的医学，并不比中国早。
A few people behind me laughed. He went on to tell the history of the development of anatomy in Japan, and those large and small books are works on this discipline from the beginning to the present. At first several were wire-bound; There are also those who reprint Chinese translations, and their translations and research of new medicine are not earlier than those in China.那坐在后面发笑的是上学年不及格的留级学生，在校已经一年，掌故颇为熟悉的了。他们便给新生讲演每个教授的历史。这藤野先生，据说是穿衣服太模胡了，有时竟会忘记带领结；冬天是一件旧外套，寒颤颤的，有一回上火车去，致使管车的疑心他是扒手，叫车里的客人大家小心些。
The one sitting in the back laughing was the repeater who failed last school year, and he had been in school for a year, and his palm story was quite familiar. They gave the freshmen a lecture on the history of each professor. This Mr. Fujino is said to be too foolish to wear clothes, and sometimes he forgets to tie a bow tie; In winter, it was an old coat, shivering with chills, and once I got on the train, which made the person in charge of the car suspicious that he was a pickpocket, and told the guests in the car to be careful.他们的话大概是真的，我就亲见他有一次上讲堂没有带领结。
Their words were probably true, and I saw him once in a lecture hall without a bow tie.过了一星期，大约是星期六，他使助手来叫我了。到得研究室，见他坐在人骨和许多单独的头骨中间，——他其时正在研究着头骨，后来有一篇论文在本校的杂志上发表出来。
A week later, about Saturday, he asked his assistant to call me. When I got to the laboratory, I saw him sitting between human bones and many individual skulls,—— he was studying the skull at the time, and a paper was later published in the journal of our school.“我的讲义，你能抄下来么？”他问。
"Can you copy my handouts?" He asked.“可以抄一点。”
"You can copy a little."“拿来我看！”
"Bring it to me!"我交出所抄的讲义去，他收下了，第二三天便还我，并且说，此后每一星期要送给他看一回。我拿下来打开看时，很吃了一惊，同时也感到一种不安和感激。原来我的讲义已经从头到末，都用红笔添改过了，不但增加了许多脱漏的地方，连文法的错误，也都一一订正。这样一直继续到教完了他所担任的功课：骨学，血管学，神经学。
I handed over the handouts I had copied, and he accepted them, returned them to me on the second or third day, and said that I would give them to him every week from now on. When I took it down and opened it, I was surprised, and at the same time I felt a sense of unease and gratitude. It turned out that my handouts had been corrected with a red pen from beginning to end, not only adding many omissions, but also correcting grammatical errors one by one. This continued until he finished teaching his homework: osteology, vascularism, neurology.可惜我那时太不用功，有时也很任性。还记得有一回藤野先生将我叫到他的研究室里去，翻出我那讲义上的一个图来，是下臂的血管，指着，向我和蔼的说道：
It's a pity that I was too tired and sometimes willful. I still remember one time Mr. Fujino called me to his laboratory, turned out a picture on my handout, which was a blood vessel in my lower arm, pointed to it, and said to me kindly:“你看，你将这条血管移了一点位置了。——自然，这样一移，的确比较的好看些，然而解剖图不是美术，实物是那么样的，我们没法改换它。现在我给你改好了，以后你要全照着黑板上那样的画。”
"Look, you've moved this vein a little bit. ——Naturally, it is indeed more beautiful to move like this, but the anatomical drawing is not art, the real thing is like that, and we can't change it. Now I've changed it for you, and in the future you will have to follow the same picture on the blackboard. ”但是我还不服气，口头答应着，心里却想道：
But I was still not convinced, and verbally agreed, but I thought in my heart:“图还是我画的不错；至于实在的情形，我心里自然记得的。”
"I still drew the picture well; As for the actual situation, I naturally remember it in my heart. ”学年试验完毕之后，我便到东京玩了一夏天，秋初再回学校，成绩早已发表了，同学一百余人之中，我在中间，不过是没有落第。这回藤野先生所担任的功课，是解剖实习和局部解剖学。
After the school year experiment, I went to Tokyo for a summer, and returned to school in early autumn, and the results had already been announced. This time, Mr. Fujino's homework was anatomy practice and local anatomy.解剖实习了大概一星期，他又叫我去了，很高兴地，仍用了极有抑扬的声调对我说道：
After about a week of anatomy practice, he called me again, and happily, still said to me in a very intonated tone:“我因为听说中国人是很敬重鬼的，所以很担心，怕你不肯解剖尸体。现在总算放心了，没有这回事。”
"I was worried because I heard that Chinese people respect ghosts very much, for fear that you would not dissect the corpse. Now I am finally relieved, there is no such thing. ”但他也偶有使我很为难的时候。他听说中国的女人是裹脚的，但不知道详细，所以要问我怎么裹法，足骨变成怎样的畸形，还叹息道，“总要看一看才知道。究竟是怎么一回事呢？”
But he also occasionally makes me feel embarrassed. He heard that Chinese women wrap their feet, but they didn't know the details, so he asked me how to wrap them and what kind of deformity my foot bones became, and sighed, "You have to take a look to know." What is going on? ”有一天，本级的学生会干事到我寓里来了，要借我的讲义看。我检出来交给他们，却只翻检了一通，并没有带走。但他们一走，邮差就送到一封很厚的信，拆开看时，第一句是：
One day, the student union officer at my level came to my apartment to borrow my handouts. I checked it out and handed it to them, but I only checked it and didn't take it away. But as soon as they left, the postman sent a very thick letter, and when he opened it, the first sentence was:“你改悔罢！”
"You repent!"这是《新约》上的句子罢，但经托尔斯泰新近引用过的。其时正值日俄战争，托老先生便写了一封给俄国和日本的皇帝的信，开首便是这一句。日本报纸上很斥责他的不逊，爱国青年也愤然，然而暗地里却早受了他的影响了。其次的话，大略是说上年解剖学试验的题目，是藤野先生在讲义上做了记号，我预先知道的，所以能有这样的成绩。末尾是匿名。
This is a sentence from the New Testament, but it was recently quoted by Tolstoy. At that time, it was the Russo-Japanese War, and Mr. Tuo Lao wrote a letter to the emperors of Russia and Japan, which began with this sentence. Japanese newspapers reprimanded him for his rudeness, and patriotic young people were also indignant, but secretly they had already been influenced by him. Secondly, the topic of the anatomy test last year was marked by Mr. Fujino in the handout, and I knew it in advance, so I was able to achieve such results. The end is anonymous.我这才回忆到前几天的一件事。因为要开同级会，干事便在黑板上写广告，末一句是“请全数到会勿漏为要”，而且在“漏”字旁边加了一个圈。我当时虽然觉到圈得可笑，但是毫不介意，这回才悟出那字也在讥刺我了，犹言我得了教员漏泄出来的题目。
I then remembered an incident from the other day. Because he was going to hold a meeting at the same level, the officer wrote an advertisement on the blackboard, and the last sentence was "Please attend the meeting without missing it", and added a circle next to the word "leak". Although I felt that the circle was ridiculous at the time, I didn't mind, and this time I realized that the word was also mocking me, and I still said that I had a topic leaked by the teacher.我便将这事告知了藤野先生；有几个和我熟识的同学也很不平，一同去诘责干事托辞检查的无礼，并且要求他们将检查的结果，发表出来。终于这流言消灭了，干事却又竭力运动，要收回那一封匿名信去。结末是我便将这托尔斯泰式的信退还了他们。
I told Mr. Fujino about this; A few classmates who were familiar with me were also very upset, and together they went to reprimand the officers for their rudeness in excusing the inspection and asked them to publish the results of the inspection. Finally, the rumor was eliminated, but the officer tried his best to withdraw the anonymous letter. In the end, I returned the Tolstoy-esque letter to them.中国是弱国，所以中国人当然是低能儿，分数在六十分以上，便不是自己的能力了：也无怪他们疑惑。但我接着便有参观枪毙中国人的命运了。第二年添教霉菌学，细菌的形状是全用电影来显示的，一段落已完而还没有到下课的时候，便影几片时事的片子，自然都是日本战胜俄国的情形。但偏有中国人夹在里边：给俄国人做侦探，被日本军捕获，要枪毙了，围着看的也是一群中国人；在讲堂里的还有一个我。
China is a weak country, so of course the Chinese are imbecile, and if the score is above 60 points, it is not their ability: no wonder they are confused. But then I visited the fate of shooting Chinese. In the second year, I added mycology, and the shape of bacteria was all shown in movies, and when a paragraph was over and before the end of class, I took a few films of current affairs, which were naturally the situation of Japan's victory over Russia. But there are Chinese people in it: they are detectives for the Russians, captured by the Japanese army, and are about to be shot, and there is also a group of Chinese people watching around; There was also me in the lecture hall.“万岁！”他们都拍掌欢呼起来。
"Hooray!" They all clapped and cheered.这种欢呼，是每看一片都有的，但在我，这一声却特别听得刺耳。此后回到中国来，我看见那些闲看枪毙犯人的人们，他们也何尝不酒醉似的喝采，——呜呼，无法可想！但在那时那地，我的意见却变化了。
This kind of cheer is present in every piece of film, but for me, this sound is particularly harsh. After returning to China, I saw those people who were idly watching the shooting of prisoners, and they didn't cheer as if they were drunk,—— alas, it's unimaginable! But then and there, my opinion changed.到第二学年的终结，我便去寻藤野先生，告诉他我将不学医学，并且离开这仙台。他的脸色仿佛有些悲哀，似乎想说话，但竟没有说。
At the end of the second academic year, I went to Mr. Fujino and told him that I would not study medicine and leave Sendai. His face seemed to be a little sad, as if he wanted to speak, but he didn't speak.“我想去学生物学，先生教给我的学问，也还有用的。”其实我并没有决意要学生物学，因为看得他有些凄然，便说了一个慰安他的谎话。
"I want to study biology, and the knowledge my teacher taught me is also useful." In fact, I didn't decide to study biology, because I saw that he was a little sad, so I told a lie to comfort him.“为医学而教的解剖学之类，怕于生物学也没有什么大帮助。”他叹息说。
"Anatomy taught for medicine and the like are probably not of much help to biology." He sighed.将走的前几天，他叫我到他家里去，交给我一张照相，后面写着两个字道：“惜别”，还说希望将我的也送他。但我这时适值没有照相了；他便叮嘱我将来照了寄给他，并且时时通信告诉他此后的状况。
A few days before I left, he asked me to go to his house and handed me a photo, with two words written on the back: "Farewell", and said that he hoped to give mine to him as well. But I didn't take pictures at this time; He told me to send him a photo in the future, and to keep in touch with him about the situation after that.我离开仙台之后，就多年没有照过相，又因为状况也无聊，说起来无非使他失望，便连信也怕敢写了。经过的年月一多，话更无从说起，所以虽然有时想写信，却又难以下笔，这样的一直到现在，竟没有寄过一封信和一张照片。从他那一面看起来，是一去之后，杳无消息了。
After I left Sendai, I hadn't taken a photo for many years, and because of the boring situation, it was nothing more than disappointing him, so I was afraid to write a letter. After a long time, there is no way to start, so although I sometimes want to write a letter, it is difficult to write, so until now, I have not sent a letter or a photo. From his side, it seems that after he left, there was no news.但不知怎地，我总还时时记起他，在我所认为我师的之中，他是最使我感激，给我鼓励的一个。有时我常常想：他的对于我的热心的希望，不倦的教诲，小而言之，是为中国，就是希望中国有新的医学；大而言之，是为学术，就是希望新的医学传到中国去。他的性格，在我的眼里和心里是伟大的，虽然他的姓名并不为许多人所知道。
But somehow, I always remember him, and among all the people I think of as my teacher, he is the one who makes me most grateful and encourages me. Sometimes I often think: his ardent hope for me, his tireless teachings, in a small way, for China, that is, for China, that is, for the hope that there will be new medicine in China; In a big way, it is for academics, that is, to hope that new medicine will spread to China. His character is great in my eyes and heart, although his name is not known to many.他所改正的讲义，我曾经订成三厚本，收藏着的，将作为永久的纪念。不幸七年前迁居的时候，中途毁坏了一口书箱，失去半箱书，恰巧这讲义也遗失在内了。责成运送局去找寻，寂无回信。只有他的照相至今还挂在我北京寓居的东墙上，书桌对面。每当夜间疲倦，正想偷懒时，仰面在灯光中瞥见他黑瘦的面貌，似乎正要说出抑扬顿挫的话来，便使我忽又良心发现，而且增加勇气了，于是点上一枝烟，再继续写些为“正人君子”之流所深恶痛疾的文字。
The handouts he corrected, which I once ordered into three thick editions, will be used as a permanent memorial. Unfortunately, when I moved seven years ago, I destroyed a bookcase and lost half a box of books, and it happened that this handout was also lost. The transport bureau was instructed to look for it, but there was no reply. Only his photo still hangs on the east wall of my Beijing residence, opposite the desk. Whenever I was tired at night and was about to be lazy, I caught a glimpse of his dark and thin face in the light, and it seemed that I was about to say the words of intonation, which made me suddenly find out in conscience and increase my courage, so I lit a cigarette and continued to write some words that were deeply hated by the "upright gentlemen".十月十二日。
October 12th.

范爱农

范爱农

范爱农

Fan Ainong在东京的客店里，我们大抵一起来就看报。学生所看的多是《朝日新闻》和《读卖新闻》，专爱打听社会上琐事的就看《二六新闻》。一天早晨，辟头就看见一条从中国来的电报，大概是：
In the inn in Tokyo, we usually read the newspaper together. Students mostly read the Asahi Shimbun and the Yomiuri Shimbun, and those who like to inquire about trivial matters in society read the "Erliu News". One morning, I saw a telegram from China, which was probably the following:“安徽巡抚恩铭被Jo Shiki Rin刺杀，刺客就擒。”
"Anhui Governor En Ming was assassinated by Jo Shiki Rin, and the assassin was captured."大家一怔之后，便容光焕发地互相告语，并且研究这刺客是谁，汉字是怎样三个字。但只要是绍兴人，又不专看教科书的，却早已明白了。这是徐锡麟，他留学回国之后，在做安徽候补道，办着巡警事务，正合于刺杀巡抚的地位。
After everyone was stunned, they told each other brightly, and studied who the assassin was and what the Chinese characters were. But as long as you are from Shaoxing and don't read textbooks, you have already understood. This is Xu Xilin, after he returned from studying abroad, he was working as an assistant in Anhui and doing patrol affairs, which was in line with the status of assassinating the governor.大家接着就预测他将被极刑，家族将被连累。不久，秋瑾姑娘在绍兴被杀的消息也传来了，徐锡麟是被挖了心，给恩铭的亲兵炒食净尽。人心很愤怒。有几个人便秘密地开一个会，筹集川资；这时用得着日本浪人了，撕乌贼鱼下酒，慷慨一通之后，他便登程去接徐伯荪的家属去。
Everyone then predicted that he would be sentenced to death and his family would be implicated. Soon, the news of Qiu Jin's murder in Shaoxing also came, and Xu Xilin was dug out of his heart and fried up for Enming's personal soldiers. People are angry. A few people secretly held a meeting to raise Sichuan funds; At this time, the Japanese ronin was needed, tore the squid fish and drank, and after being generous, he set off to pick up Xu Bosun's family.照例还有一个同乡会，吊烈士，骂满洲；此后便有人主张打电报到北京，痛斥满政府的无人道。会众即刻分成两派：一派要发电，一派不要发。我是主张发电的，但当我说出之后，即有一种钝滞的声音跟着起来：
As usual, there is also a hometown association to hang martyrs and scold Manchuria; Since then, some people have advocated sending telegrams to Beijing to denounce the inhumanity of the Manchu government. The congregation immediately split into two factions: one wanted to generate electricity, and the other did not. I am in favor of generating electricity, but as soon as I say it, a dull voice follows:“杀的杀掉了，死的死掉了，还发什么屁电报呢。”
"Kill it, kill it, die it, what kind of fart telegram do you send?"这是一个高大身材，长头发，眼球白多黑少的人，看人总像在渺视。他蹲在席子上，我发言大抵就反对；我早觉得奇怪，注意着他的了，到这时才打听别人：说这话的是谁呢，有那么冷？认识的人告诉我说：他叫范爱农，是徐伯荪的学生。
This is a tall person, with long hair, more white and less black eyeballs, and he always looks down on people. He squatted on the mat, and I generally objected to my speech; I had long thought it was strange, and I paid attention to him, and only then did I ask others: Who said this, is it so cold? Someone I knew told me that his name was Fan Ainong and he was a student of Xu Bosun.我非常愤怒了，觉得他简直不是人，自己的先生被杀了，连打一个电报还害怕，于是便坚执地主张要发电，同他争起来，结果是主张发电的居多数，他屈服了。其次要推出人来拟电稿。
I was very angry, thinking that he was not a human being, that his husband had been killed, and he was afraid that he would even make a telegram, so he insisted on generating electricity and fighting with him, but the result was that the majority of those who advocated power generation were the majority, and he gave in. Secondly, it is necessary to introduce people to draft the telegram.“何必推举呢？自然是主张发电的人啰。”他说。
"Why nominate? Naturally, it is the person who advocates power generation. He said.我觉得他的话又在针对我，无理倒也并非无理的。但我便主张这一篇悲壮的文章必须深知烈士生平的人做，因为他比别人关系更密切，心里更悲愤，做出来就一定更动人。于是又争起来。结果是他不做，我也不做，不知谁承认做去了；其次是大家走散，只留下一个拟稿的和一两个干事，等候做好之后去拍发。
I feel that his words are aimed at me again, and it is not unreasonable. But I advocate that this tragic article must be written by someone who knows the life of the martyr well, because he has a closer relationship than others, and his heart is more sad and angry, and it must be more moving. So they fought again. The result is that he didn't do it, and I didn't do it, I don't know who admitted to doing it; Secondly, everyone was separated, leaving only one drafter and one or two officers, waiting for the finished work to be filmed.从此我总觉得这范爱农离奇，而且很可恶。天下可恶的人，当初以为是满人，这时才知道还在其次；第一倒是范爱农。中国不革命则已，要革命，首先就必须将范爱农除去。
Since then, I have always felt that this Fan Ainong is bizarre and hateful. The hateful people in the world thought they were Manchus at first, but then they realized that they were secondary; The first is Fan Ainong. If China does not revolutionize, it is fine, and if it wants to revolutionize, it must first get rid of Fan Ainong.然而这意见后来似乎逐渐淡薄，到底忘却了，我们从此也没有再见面。直到革命的前一年，我在故乡做教员，大概是春末时候罢，忽然在熟人的客座上看见了一个人，互相熟视了不过两三秒钟，我们便同时说：
However, this opinion seemed to gradually fade, and we forgot about it, and we never met again. Until the year before the revolution, when I was a teacher in my hometown, about the end of spring, I suddenly saw a person at an acquaintance's guest seat, and we looked at each other for only two or three seconds, and we said at the same time:“哦哦，你是范爱农！”
"Oh, you're Fan Ainong!"“哦哦，你是鲁迅！”
"Oh, you are Lu Xun!"不知怎地我们便都笑了起来，是互相的嘲笑和悲哀。他眼睛还是那样，然而奇怪，只这几年，头上却有了白发了，但也许本来就有，我先前没有留心到。他穿着很旧的布马褂，破布鞋，显得很寒素。谈起自己的经历来，他说他后来没有了学费，不能再留学，便回来了。回到故乡之后，又受着轻蔑，排斥，迫害，几乎无地可容。现在是躲在乡下，教着几个小学生糊口。但因为有时觉得很气闷，所以也趁了航船进城来。

He was wearing a very old cloth robe and rag shoes, looking very humble. Talking about his own experience, he said that he later had no tuition fees and could no longer study abroad, so he came back. After returning to his hometown, he was despised, ostracized, and persecuted, and there was almost no place to tolerate. But because I sometimes feel very stuffy, I also took advantage of the boat to enter the city.他又告诉我现在爱喝酒，于是我们便喝酒。从此他每一进城，必定来访我，非常相熟了。我们醉后常谈些愚不可及的疯话，连母亲偶然听到了也发笑。一天我忽而记起在东京开同乡会时的旧事，便问他：

We often talk about stupid crazy things when we get drunk, and even my mother laughs when she hears it by chance. "Why don't you know. When we go to Yokohama, isn't it Ziying and you who come to pick us up? You looked down on us, shook your head, do you remember yourself? ”我略略一想，记得的，虽然是七八年前的事。那时是子英来约我的，说到横滨去接新来留学的同乡。汽船一到，看见一大堆，大概一共有十多人，一上岸便将行李放到税关上去候查检，关吏在衣箱中翻来翻去，忽然翻出一双绣花的弓鞋来，便放下公事，拿着子细地看。我很不满，心里想，这些鸟男人，怎么带这东西来呢。自己不注意，那时也许就摇了摇头。检验完毕，在客店小坐之后，即须上火车。不料这一群读书人又在客车上让起坐位来了，甲要乙坐在这位上，乙要丙去坐，揖让未终，火车已开，车身一摇，即刻跌倒了三四个。我那时也很不满，暗地里想：连火车上的坐位，他们也要分出尊卑来……。自己不注意，也许又摇了摇头。然而那群雍容揖让的人物中就有范爱农，却直到这一天才想到。岂但他呢，说起来也惭愧，这一群里，还有后来在安徽战死的陈伯平烈士，被害的马宗汉烈士；被囚在黑狱里，到革命后才见天日而身上永带着匪刑的伤痕的也还有一两人。而我都茫无所知，摇着头将他们一并运上东京了。徐伯荪虽然和他们同船来，却不在这车上，因为他在神户就和他的夫人坐车走了陆路了。
I thought about it for a moment, although it was seven or eight years ago. At that time, Ziying came to ask me to go to Yokohama to pick up my new compatriots who came to study abroad. As soon as the steamboat arrived, they saw a large pile of them, probably more than ten people in total, and as soon as they landed, they put their luggage on the tax customs to wait for inspection. I was very dissatisfied, thinking to myself, how can these bird men bring this thing? If you don't pay attention, you may shake your head at that time. After the inspection, after sitting in the inn, you must get on the train. Unexpectedly, this group of scholars gave up their seats on the bus again, A wanted B to sit on this, B wanted C to sit down, the bow was not over, the train was starting, the body shook, and immediately fell three or four. I was also very dissatisfied at the time, and secretly thought: Even the seats on the train must be divided into high and low, ....... If you don't pay attention, you may shake your head again. However, among the group of graceful and humble characters was Fan Ainong, but he didn't think of it until this day. In this group, there are also martyrs Chen Boping who died in Anhui and martyrs Ma Zonghan who were killed; There are also one or two people who were imprisoned in the black prison and did not see the light of day until after the revolution, and their bodies always bear the scars of banditry. Although Xu Bosun came in the same boat as them, he was not in this car, because he took a car with his wife in Kobe and took the overland route.我想我那时摇头大约有两回，他们看见的不知道是那一回。让坐时喧闹，检查时幽静，一定是在税关上的那一回了，试问爱农，果然是的。

"I really don't understand what you're doing with this thing? Whose is it? ”“还不是我们师母的？”他瞪着他多白的眼。

"Who knows? You ask her to go. ”到冬初，我们的景况更拮据了，然而还喝酒，讲笑话。忽然是武昌起义，接着是绍兴光复。第二天爱农就上城来，戴着农夫常用的毡帽，那笑容是从来没有见过的。
By the beginning of winter, our situation was even more difficult, but we still drank and told jokes. Suddenly there was the Wuchang Uprising, followed by the restoration of Shaoxing. We went to the street and walked around, and our eyes were full of white flags. However, despite the appearance, the inner bones are still the same, because it is still a military government organized by a few old gentry, the railway shareholder is the administrative director, and the money shopkeeper is the director of the ordnance department...... This military government didn't last long, a few teenagers shouted, Wang Jinfa led troops in from Hangzhou, but even if he didn't shout, he would come. After he came in, he was surrounded by many idlers and new revolutionary parties, and he became the governor of the king. The characters in the yamen came in plain clothes, and they probably changed into leather robes within ten days, and the weather was not cold yet.我被摆在师范学校校长的饭碗旁边，王都督给了我校款二百元。爱农做监学，还是那件布袍子，但不大喝酒了，也很少有工夫谈闲天。他办事，兼教书，实在勤快得可以。

After scolding like this for more than ten days, news came to my house, saying that the governor scolded him because you cheated his money, and wanted to send someone to kill you with a pistol.别人倒还不打紧，第一个着急的是我的母亲，叮嘱我不要再出去。但我还是照常走，并且说明，王金发是不来打死我们的，他虽然绿林大学出身，而杀人却不很轻易。况且我拿的是校款，这一点他还能明白的，不过说说罢了。
Others didn't care, the first one was my mother, who told me not to go out again. Besides, I am taking the school fund, which he can still understand, but it's just talking.果然没有来杀。写信去要经费，又取了二百元。但仿佛有些怒意，同时传令道：再来要，没有了！
Sure enough, he didn't come to kill him. I wrote a letter asking for funds, and took another 200 yuan. But Ainong got a new kind of news, but it made me very embarrassed. It turns out that the so-called "fraud" does not refer to school funds, but refers to a sum of money given to the newspaper. After a few days of scolding in the newspaper, Wang Jinfa asked someone to send 500 yuan. So our teenagers held a meeting, and the first question was: Do you accept it? The resolution is: Collect. The second question is: Do you scold after receiving it? The resolution is: scolding. The reason is: after receiving the money, he is a shareholder; If the shareholders are not good, they will naturally be scolded.我即刻到报馆去问这事的真假。都是真的。略说了几句不该收他钱的话，一个名为会计的便不高兴了，质问我道：
I immediately went to the newspaper to ask if this matter was true or false. It's all true. After saying a few words that he shouldn't have accepted money, a man named an accountant became unhappy and asked me:“报馆为什么不收股本？”

"What is not share capital?"我就不再说下去了，这一点世故是早已知道的，倘我再说出连累我们的话来，他就会面斥我太爱惜不值钱的生命，不肯为社会牺牲，或者明天在报上就可以看见我怎样怕死发抖的记载。

The newspaper case was concluded two or three weeks after I arrived in Nanjing, and was destroyed by a group of soldiers. I think this kind of photo may not be collected by anyone now, the size is too small, the knife wound has shrunk to almost nothing, if you don't explain, the person who sees it must think that it is a nude photo of some crazy romantic figures, if you meet Sun Chuanfang, you are afraid that you will be banned.我从南京移到北京的时候，爱农的学监也被孔教会会长的校长设法去掉了。他又成了革命前的爱农。我想为他在北京寻一点小事做，这是他非常希望的，然而没有机会。他后来便到一个熟人的家里去寄食，也时时给我信，景况愈困穷，言辞也愈凄苦。终于又非走出这熟人的家不可，便在各处飘浮。不久，忽然从同乡那里得到一个消息，说他已经掉在水里，淹死了。
When I moved from Nanjing to Beijing, the superintendent of Ainong was also removed by the president of the Confucius Church. He became a pre-revolutionary farmer again. Later, when I went back to my hometown, I learned some more detailed things. Ai Nong didn't have to do anything at first, because everyone hated him. He was difficult, but he also drank, and it was his friends who invited him. He had little contact with people, and only a few younger people he met later, but they didn't seem to want to listen to his complaints, thinking that it was not as interesting as telling jokes.“也许明天就收到一个电报，拆开来一看，是鲁迅来叫我的。”他时常这样说。

I still don't understand whether he stumbled or committed suicide.他死后一无所有，遗下一个幼女和他的夫人。有几个人想集一点钱作他女孩将来的学费的基金，因为一经提议，即有族人来争这笔款的保管权，——其实还没有这笔款，——大家觉得无聊，便无形消散了。
After his death, he had nothing, leaving behind a young daughter and his wife. A few people wanted to raise a little money for the fund for his girl's future tuition, because as soon as it was proposed, there were clansmen who came to fight for the custody of the money,—— in fact,—— everyone was bored, so it dissipated invisibly.现在不知他唯一的女儿景况如何？倘在上学，中学已该毕业了罢。
Now I don't know what the situation of his only daughter is? If you are in school, you should have graduated from middle school.十一月十八日。

postscript我在第三篇讲《二十四孝》的开头，说北京恐吓小孩的“马虎子”应作“麻胡子”，是指麻叔谋，而且以他为胡人。现在知道是错了，“胡”应作“祜”，是叔谋之名，见唐人李济翁做的《资暇集》卷下，题云《非麻胡》。原文如次：
At the beginning of the third article "Twenty-Four Filial Piety", I said that the "sloppy" who intimidated children in Beijing should be called "Ma Huzi", referring to Uncle Ma and treating him as a Hu person. Now I know that it is wrong, "Hu" should be "Hu", which is the name of Shu Mou, see the volume of "Leisure Collection" made by Li Jiweng of the Tang Dynasty, titled "Non Ma Hu". The original text is as follows:“俗怖婴儿曰：麻胡来！不知其源者，以为多髯之神而验刺者，非也。隋将军麻祜，性酷虐，炀帝令开汴河，威棱既盛，至稚童望风而畏，互相恐吓曰：麻祜来！稚童语不正，转祜为胡。只如宪宗朝泾将郝玭，蕃中皆畏惮，其国婴儿啼者，以玭怖之则止。又，武宗朝，闾阎孩孺相胁云：薛尹来！咸类此也。况《魏志》载张文远辽来之明证乎？”（原注：麻祜庙在睢阳。鄜方节度李丕即其后。丕为重建碑。）
“俗怖婴儿曰：麻胡来！不知其源者，以为多髯之神而验刺者，非也。 隋将军麻祜，性酷虐，炀帝令开汴河，威棱既盛，至稚童望风而畏，互相恐吓曰：麻祜来！稚童语不正，转祜为胡。 只如宪宗朝泾将郝玭，蕃中皆畏惮，其国婴儿啼者，以玭怖之则止。 又，武宗朝，闾阎孩孺相胁云：薛尹来！咸类此也。 况《魏志》载张文远辽来之明证乎？”（原注：麻祜庙在睢阳。 鄜方节度李丕即其后。 丕为重建碑。 ）原来我的识见，就正和唐朝的“不知其源者”相同，贻讥于千载之前，真是咎有应得，只好苦笑。但又不知麻祜庙碑或碑文，现今尚在睢阳或存于方志中否？倘在，我们当可以看见和小说《开河记》所载相反的他的功业。
It turns out that my insight is the same as that of the Tang Dynasty's "those who do not know its origin", and it was ridiculed thousands of years ago, and I really deserved it, so I had to smile bitterly. But I don't know if the Ma Hu temple stele or inscription is still in Suiyang or in the local chronicles? If he is, we should be able to see his achievements contrary to those recorded in the novel "The Opening of the River".因为想寻几张插画，常维钧兄给我在北京搜集了许多材料，有几种是为我所未曾见过的。如光绪己卯（1879）肃州胡文炳作的《二百卌孝图》——原书有注云：“卌读如习。”我真不解他何以不直称四十，而必须如此麻烦——即其一。我所反对的“郭巨埋儿”，他于我还未出世的前几年，已经删去了。序有云：
