娜拉走后怎样——一九二三年十二月二十六日在北京女子高等师范学校文艺会讲

娜拉走后怎样——一九二三年十二月二十六日在北京女子高等师范学校文艺会讲

娜拉走后怎样——一九二三年十二月二十六日在北京女子高等师范学校文艺会讲

What happened after Nala left - lectured at the Beijing Women's Higher Normal School Literary and Art Association on December 26, 1923我今天要讲的是“娜拉走后怎样？”
What I'm going to talk about today is "What happens after Nala leaves?" ”伊孛生是十九世纪后半的瑙威的一个文人。他的著作，除了几十首诗之外，其余都是剧本。这些剧本里面，有一时期是大抵含有社会问题的，世间也称作“社会剧”，其中有一篇就是《娜拉》。
Ibsen was a literati in Nauwei in the second half of the nineteenth century. His writings, except for dozens of poems, are scripts. Among these scripts, there is a period that mostly contains social problems, which is also called "social drama" in the world, and one of them is "Nala".《娜拉》一名Ein Puppenheim，中国译作《傀儡家庭》。但Puppe不单是牵线的傀儡，孩子抱着玩的人形也是；引申开去，别人怎么指挥，他便怎么做的人也是。娜拉当初是满足地生活在所谓幸福的家庭里的，但是她竟觉悟了：自己是丈夫的傀儡，孩子们又是她的傀儡。她于是走了，只听得关门声，接着就是闭幕。这想来大家都知道，不必细说了。
"Nala" is also known as Ein Puppenheim, which is translated into Chinese as "Puppet Family". But Puppe is not only a puppet of matchmaking, but also a human figure that children hold and play with; By extension, how others command, he does what he does. Nala was content to live in a so-called happy family, but she realized that she was her husband's puppet, and her children were her puppet. She then left, only to hear the sound of the door closing, and then the door closed. Everyone knows this, so there is no need to go into details.娜拉要怎样才不走呢？或者说伊孛生自己有解答，就是Die Frau vom Meer，《海的女人》，中国有人译作《海上夫人》的。这女人是已经结婚的了，然而先前有一个爱人在海的彼岸，一日突然寻来，叫她一同去。她便告知她的丈夫，要和那外来人会面。临末，她的丈夫说，“现在放你完全自由。（走与不走）你能够自己选择，并且还要自己负责任。”于是什么事全都改变，她就不走了。这样看来，娜拉倘也得到这样的自由，或者也便可以安住。
How can Nala not leave? Or Ibosheng himself has an answer, that is, Die Frau vom Meer, "The Woman of the Sea", which some Chinese people translate as "Lady of the Sea". This woman was already married, but she had a lover on the other side of the sea, and one day she suddenly came and asked her to go with her. She told her husband that she was going to meet with the outsider. At the end of her life, her husband said, "Now let you be completely free." You can choose for yourself and be responsible for yourself. So everything changed, and she didn't leave. In this way, if Nala also gets such freedom, she may be able to settle down.但娜拉毕竟是走了的。走了以后怎样？伊孛生并无解答；而且他已经死了。即使不死，他也不负解答的责任。因为伊孛生是在做诗，不是为社会提出问题来而且代为解答。就如黄莺一样，因为他自己要歌唱，所以他歌唱，不是要唱给人们听得有趣，有益。伊孛生是很不通世故的，相传在许多妇女们一同招待他的筵宴上，代表者起来致谢他作了《傀儡家庭》，将女性的自觉，解放这些事，给人心以新的启示的时候，他却答道，“我写那篇却并不是这意思，我不过是做诗。”
But Nala is gone after all. What happens after you leave? Ibsen did not answer; And he is dead. Even if he doesn't die, he doesn't take responsibility for answering. Because Ibosheng is making poetry, not asking questions for society and answering them on his behalf. Just like the yellow warbler, because he wants to sing himself, he sings, not to make it interesting and beneficial for people to hear. It is said that at the banquet where many women entertained him, the representative stood up to thank him for making "Puppet Family", liberating women's consciousness, these things, and giving people new inspiration, but he replied, "I didn't mean that when I wrote that poem, I just wrote poetry." ”娜拉走后怎样？——别人可是也发表过意见的。一个英国人曾作一篇戏剧，说一个新式的女子走出家庭，再也没有路走，终于堕落，进了妓院了。还有一个中国人，——我称他什么呢？上海的文学家罢，——说他所见的《娜拉》是和现译本不同，娜拉终于回来了。这样的本子可惜没有第二人看见，除非是伊孛生自己寄给他的。但从事理上推想起来，娜拉或者也实在只有两条路：不是堕落，就是回来。因为如果是一匹小鸟，则笼子里固然不自由，而一出笼门，外面便又有鹰，有猫，以及别的什么东西之类；倘使已经关得麻痹了翅子，忘却了飞翔，也诚然是无路可以走。还有一条，就是饿死了，但饿死已经离开了生活，更无所谓问题，所以也不是什么路。
What happened after Nala left? ——Others have also expressed their opinions. An Englishman once wrote a play about a new style of woman who walked out of the family, had no way out, and finally fell into a brothel. There is also a Chinese,—— what do I call him? The writer in Shanghai ,—— said that the "Nala" he saw was different from the current translation, and Nala finally returned. Unfortunately, no second person saw such a book, unless it was sent to him by Ibsen himself. But when I think about it, Nala may really have only two paths: either fall or come back. Because if it is a small bird, the cage is not free, but as soon as it comes out of the cage, there are eagles, cats, and other things outside; If you have closed your wings and forgot to fly, there is indeed no way to go. There is another one, that is, starving to death, but starvation has left life, and it doesn't matter what the problem is, so it's not a road.人生最苦痛的是梦醒了无路可以走。做梦的人是幸福的；倘没有看出可走的路，最要紧的是不要去惊醒他。你看，唐朝的诗人李贺，不是困顿了一世的么？而他临死的时候，却对他的母亲说，“阿妈，上帝造成了白玉楼，叫我做文章落成去了。”这岂非明明是一个诳，一个梦？然而一个小的和一个老的，一个死的和一个活的，死的高兴地死去，活的放心地活着。说诳和做梦，在这些时候便见得伟大。所以我想，假使寻不出路，我们所要的倒是梦。
The most painful thing in life is that there is no way to go when you wake up from a dream. Dreamers are happy; If you don't see the way to go, the most important thing is not to wake him up. Look, didn't the poet Li He of the Tang Dynasty be trapped all his life? And when he was dying, he said to his mother, "Mom, God created the White Jade Building and asked me to make a fuss." "Isn't this obviously a lie, a dream? However, a young one and an old man, a dead man and a living one, die happily and live with peace of mind. Lying and dreaming are great at these times. So I think if we can't find a way out, what we want is a dream.但是，万不可做将来的梦。阿尔志跋绥夫曾经借了他所做的小说，质问过梦想将来的黄金世界的理想家，因为要造那世界，先唤起许多人们来受苦。他说，“你们将黄金世界预约给他们的子孙了，可是有什么给他们自己呢？”有是有的，就是将来的希望。但代价也太大了，为了这希望，要使人练敏了感觉来更深切地感到自己的苦痛，叫起灵魂来目睹他自己的腐烂的尸骸。惟有说诳和做梦，这些时候便见得伟大。所以我想，假使寻不出路，我们所要的就是梦；但不要将来的梦，只要目前的梦。
However, do not dream about the future. Alzhiv once borrowed his novel and questioned the idealists who dreamed of the golden world of the future, because to create that world, many people must first be aroused to suffer. He said, "You have reserved the golden world for their descendants, but what do you have for yourself?" "There is something, it is the hope of the future. But the price is too great, and for this hope it is necessary to sensitize the senses to feel their pain more deeply, to call upon the soul to witness his own decaying corpse. Only by lying and dreaming can you see greatness at these times. So I think that if we can't find a way out, what we want is a dream; But don't dream of the future, just dream of the present.然而娜拉既然醒了，是很不容易回到梦境的，因此只得走；可是走了以后，有时却也免不掉堕落或回来。否则，就得问：她除了觉醒的心以外，还带了什么去？倘只有一条像诸君一样的紫红的绒绳的围巾，那可是无论宽到二尺或三尺，也完全是不中用。她还须更富有，提包里有准备，直白地说，就是要有钱。
However, since Nala woke up, it was not easy to return to the dream, so she had to leave; But after leaving, sometimes it is inevitable to fall or come back. Otherwise, you have to ask: What else does she take with her besides her awakened heart? If there is only a scarf with purple and red velvet rope like you, it is completely useless whether it is two feet wide or three feet. She still needs to be richer, and she has preparations in her bag, to put it bluntly, she wants to be rich.梦是好的；否则，钱是要紧的。
Dreams are good; Otherwise, money is important.钱这个字很难听，或者要被高尚的君子们所非笑，但我总觉得人们的议论是不但昨天和今天，即使饭前和饭后，也往往有些差别。凡承认饭需钱买，而以说钱为卑鄙者，倘能按一按他的胃，那里面怕总还有鱼肉没有消化完，须得饿他一天之后，再来听他发议论。
The word money is hard to hear, or it will be ridiculed by noble gentlemen, but I always feel that people's discussions are often different not only between yesterday and today, but even before and after meals. Whoever admits that money is needed to buy food, but thinks that money is despicable, if he can press his stomach, there may always be fish and meat that has not been digested, and he will have to starve him for a day before listening to his discussions.所以为娜拉计，钱，——高雅的说罢，就是经济，是最要紧的了。自由固不是钱所能买到的，但能够为钱而卖掉。人类有一个大缺点，就是常常要饥饿。为补救这缺点起见，为准备不做傀儡起见，在目下的社会里，经济权就见得最要紧了。第一，在家应该先获得男女平均的分配；第二，在社会应该获得男女相等的势力。可惜我不知道这权柄如何取得，单知道仍然要战斗；或者也许比要求参政权更要用剧烈的战斗。
So for Nala's plan, money ,—— elegantly said that the economy is the most important. Freedom is not something that money can buy, but it can be sold for money. Humans have a big shortcoming that they often starve. In order to remedy this shortcoming, in order not to be a puppet, in the current society, economic power is the most important. First, at home, men and women should be evenly distributed; Second, men and women should be given equal power in society. Unfortunately, I do not know how this authority is obtained, but I know that I still have to fight; Or perhaps it is more intense to fight than to demand suffrage.要求经济权固然是很平凡的事，然而也许比要求高尚的参政权以及博大的女子解放之类更烦难。天下事尽有小作为比大作为更烦难的。譬如现在似的冬天，我们只有这一件棉袄，然而必须救助一个将要冻死的苦人，否则便须坐在菩提树下冥想普度一切人类的方法去。普度一切人类和救活一人，大小实在相去太远了，然而倘叫我挑选，我就立刻到菩提树下去坐着，因为免得脱下唯一的棉袄来冻杀自己。所以在家里说要参政权，是不至于大遭反对的，一说到经济的平匀分配，或不免面前就遇见敌人，这就当然要有剧烈的战斗。
Asking for economic rights is certainly a very ordinary thing, but it may be more troublesome than demanding noble political suffrage and broad women's emancipation. There are small actions in the world that are more troublesome than big ones. For example, in winter like now, we only have this padded jacket, but we must rescue a suffering person who is about to freeze to death, otherwise we will have to sit under the Bodhi tree and meditate on the way to save all mankind. The size of saving all mankind and saving one person is too far apart, but if I were to choose, I would immediately go to the Bodhi tree and sit down, lest I take off my only padded jacket and freeze myself to death. Therefore, when it comes to the equal distribution of the economy, it is inevitable to meet the enemy in front of you, which of course requires fierce battles.战斗不算好事情，我们也不能责成人人都是战士，那么，平和的方法也就可贵了，这就是将来利用了亲权来解放自己的子女。中国的亲权是无上的，那时候，就可以将财产平匀地分配子女们，使他们平和而没有冲突地都得到相等的经济权，此后或者去读书，或者去生发，或者为自己去享用，或者为社会去做事，或者去花完，都请便，自己负责任。这虽然也是颇远的梦，可是比黄金世界的梦近得不少了。但第一需要记性。记性不佳，是有益于己而有害于子孙的。人们因为能忘却，所以自己能渐渐地脱离了受过的苦痛，也因为能忘却，所以往往照样地再犯前人的错误。被虐待的儿媳做了婆婆，仍然虐待儿媳；嫌恶学生的官吏，每是先前痛骂官吏的学生；现在压迫子女的，有时也就是十年前的家庭革命者。这也许与年龄和地位都有关系罢，但记性不佳也是一个很大的原因。救济法就是各人去买一本note-book来，将自己现在的思想举动都记上，作为将来年龄和地位都改变了之后的参考。假如憎恶孩子要到公园去的时候，取来一翻，看见上面有一条道，“我想到中央公园去”，那就即刻心平气和了。别的事也一样。
Fighting is not a good thing, and we can't blame everyone for being a warrior, so the peaceful method is also valuable, which is to use parental power to liberate one's children in the future. At that time, the property could be distributed evenly to the children, so that they could get equal economic rights peacefully and without conflict. Although this is also a dream that is quite far away, it is much closer than the dream of the golden world. But the first requires memory. Poor memory is beneficial to oneself and harmful to descendants. Because people can forget, they can gradually get rid of the pain they have suffered, and because they can forget, they often make the mistakes of their predecessors again. the abused daughter-in-law became a mother-in-law and still abused her daughter-in-law; officials who hate students are always students who have scolded officials before; What oppresses children now is sometimes the family revolutionaries of ten years ago. This may have something to do with age and status, but poor memory is also a big reason. The relief method is for everyone to buy a notebook and write down their current thoughts and actions as a reference after their age and status change in the future. If you hate your child when you want to go to the park, take it and see a road on it, "I want to go to Central Park", then you will immediately feel at ease. The same goes for other things.世间有一种无赖精神，那要义就是韧性。听说拳匪乱后，天津的青皮，就是所谓无赖者很跋扈，譬如给人搬一件行李，他就要两元，对他说这行李小，他说要两元，对他说道路近，他说要两元，对他说不要搬了，他说也仍然要两元。青皮固然是不足为法的，而那韧性却大可以佩服。要求经济权也一样，有人说这事情太陈腐了，就答道要经济权；说是太卑鄙了，就答道要经济权；说是经济制度就要改变了，用不着再操心，也仍然答道要经济权。
There is a scoundrel spirit in the world, and the essence is resilience. For example, if you move a piece of luggage for someone, he will ask for two yuan, he will tell him that the luggage is small, he will ask for two yuan, he will tell him that the road is close, he will ask for two yuan, he will tell him not to move, he will still ask for two yuan. The green skin is certainly not worth it, but its toughness is admirable. The same is true for economic rights, some people say that this matter is too trite, so they reply that they want economic rights; said it was too despicable, and replied that he wanted economic power; It is said that the economic system is about to change, so there is no need to worry about it, and it still answers that it wants economic power.其实，在现在，一个娜拉的出走，或者也许不至于感到困难的，因为这人物很特别，举动也新鲜，能得到若干人们的同情，帮助着生活。生活在人们的同情之下，已经是不自由了，然而倘有一百个娜拉出走，便连同情也减少，有一千一万个出走，就得到厌恶了，断不如自己握着经济权之为可靠。
In fact, now, a Nala runaway, or maybe not difficult, because this character is very special, his actions are fresh, and he can get the sympathy of several people and help life. Living under people's sympathy is no longer free, but if a hundred Nala run away, even sympathy will decrease, and if 10 or 10 thousand run away, they will be disgusted, and it is definitely not as reliable as holding economic power by themselves.在经济方面得到自由，就不是傀儡了么？也还是傀儡。无非被人所牵的事可以减少，而自己能牵的傀儡可以增多罢了。因为在现在的社会里，不但女人常作男人的傀儡，就是男人和男人，女人和女人，也相互地作傀儡，男人也常作女人的傀儡，这决不是几个女人取得经济权所能救的。但人不能饿着静候理想世界的到来，至少也得留一点残喘，正如涸辙之鲋，急谋升斗之水一样，就要这较为切近的经济权，一面再想别的法。
If you are free economically, aren't you a puppet? is still a puppet. It's just that the things that are involved by others can be reduced, and the puppets that you can lead can increase. Because in today's society, not only women often act as puppets of men, but also men and men, women and women, but also puppets of each other, and men often become puppets of women. But people can't wait hungry for the arrival of the ideal world, at least they have to leave a little breath, just like a crucian in a rut and a bucket of water, we need this more immediate economic power, and then think of other methods.如果经济制度竟改革了，那上文当然完全是废话。
If the economic system is reformed, then of course the above is complete nonsense.然而上文，是又将娜拉当作一个普通的人物而说的，假使她很特别，自己情愿闯出去做牺牲，那就又另是一回事。我们无权去劝诱人做牺牲，也无权去阻止人做牺牲。况且世上也尽有乐于牺牲，乐于受苦的人物。欧洲有一个传说，耶稣去钉十字架时，休息在Ahasvar的檐下，Ahasvar不准他，于是被了咒诅，使他永世不得休息，直到末日裁判的时候。Ahasvar从此就歇不下，只是走，现在还在走。走是苦的，安息是乐的，他何以不安息呢？虽说背着咒诅，可是大约总该是觉得走比安息还适意，所以始终狂走的罢。
However, the above is to treat Nala as an ordinary character, if she is very special and she is willing to break out and make sacrifices, it is another matter. We have no right to persuade people to make sacrifices, nor to prevent them from making sacrifices. Moreover, there are people in the world who are willing to sacrifice and suffer. There is a European legend that when Jesus went to be crucified, he rested under the eaves of Ahasvar, but Ahasvar did not allow him, so he was cursed so that he would never rest until the time of the Last Judgment. Ahasvar couldn't rest from then on, just walked, and is still walking. Walking is hard, rest is joyful, so why is he restless? Although he was carrying a curse, he probably always felt that walking was more comfortable than resting, so he always walked wildly.只是这牺牲的适意是属于自己的，与志士们之所谓为社会者无涉。群众，——尤其是中国的，——永远是戏剧的看客。牺牲上场，如果显得慷慨，他们就看了悲壮剧；如果显得觳，他们就看了滑稽剧。北京的羊肉铺前常有几个人张着嘴看剥羊，仿佛颇愉快，人的牺牲能给与他们的益处，也不过如此。而况事后走不几步，他们并这一点愉快也就忘却了。
It's just that the suitability of this sacrifice belongs to himself and has nothing to do with the so-called sociality of the people with lofty ideals. The masses,—— especially the Chinese ,——, are always spectators of the drama. sacrifice on the field, if it seems generous, they watch the tragic drama; If it seems to be a joke, they watch a burlesque. In front of the mutton shop in Beijing, there are often a few people with their mouths open to watch the sheep peeled, as if it is quite pleasant, and the benefits that human sacrifice can give them are nothing more than that. And after a few steps afterwards, they forgot that they were not happy.对于这样的群众没有法，只好使他们无戏可看倒是疗救，正无需乎震骇一时的牺牲，不如深沉的韧性的战斗。
There is no way for such a mass, so they have no drama to watch, but it is a cure, and there is no need for shocking sacrifices, it is better to fight with deep resilience.可惜中国太难改变了，即使搬动一张桌子，改装一个火炉，几乎也要血；而且即使有了血，也未必一定能搬动，能改装。不是很大的鞭子打在背上，中国自己是不肯动弹的。我想这鞭子总要来，好坏是别一问题，然而总要打到的。但是从那里来，怎么地来，我也是不能确切地知道。
Unfortunately, China is too difficult to change, even if you move a table and modify a stove, it almost costs blood; And even if there is blood, it may not necessarily be able to move and modify. It is not a big whip on the back, and China itself refuses to move. I think this whip will always come, whether it is good or bad is another matter, but it will always be hit. But I can't know exactly where it came from and how it came from.我这讲演也就此完结了。
This is the end of my speech.

未有天才之前——一九二四年一月十七日在北京师范大学附属中学校友会讲

未有天才之前——一九二四年一月十七日在北京师范大学附属中学校友会讲

未有天才之前——一九二四年一月十七日在北京师范大学附属中学校友会讲

Before the genius - on January 17, 1924, he gave a lecture at the Alumni Association of the Affiliated Middle School of Beijing Normal University我自己觉得我的讲话不能使诸君有益或者有趣，因为我实在不知道什么事，但推托拖延得太长久了，所以终于不能不到这里来说几句。
I myself feel that my speech cannot be useful or interesting to you, because I really don't know anything, but I have delayed it for too long, so I can't stop saying a few words here.我看现在许多人对于文艺界的要求的呼声之中，要求天才的产生也可以算是很盛大的了，这显然可以反证两件事：一是中国现在没有一个天才，二是大家对于现在的艺术的厌薄。天才究竟有没有？也许有着罢，然而我们和别人都没有见。倘使据了见闻，就可以说没有；不但天才，还有使天才得以生长的民众。
I think that among the demands of many people in the literary and artistic circles, the production of geniuses can also be regarded as very grand, which can obviously prove two things: one is that there is no genius in China now, and the other is everyone's disdain for the current art. Is there a genius? Maybe there is, but we and others have not seen it. If you see and hear, you can say no; Not only geniuses, but also people who make geniuses grow.天才并不是自生自长在深林荒野里的怪物，是由可以使天才生长的民众产生，长育出来的，所以没有这种民众，就没有天才。有一回拿破仑过Alps山，说，“我比Alps山还要高！”这何等英伟，然而不要忘记他后面跟着许多兵；倘没有兵，那只有被山那面的敌人捉住或者赶回，他的举动，言语，都离了英雄的界线，要归入疯子一类了。所以我想，在要求天才的产生之前，应该先要求可以使天才生长的民众。——譬如想有乔木，想看好花，一定要有好土；没有土，便没有花木了；所以土实在较花木还重要。花木非有土不可，正同拿破仑非有好兵不可一样。
Genius is not a monster that grows in the deep forest and wilderness, but is produced and nurtured by people who can make geniuses grow, so without this kind of people, there is no genius. Once Napoleon passed through the Alps and said, "I am higher than the Alps!" "How magnificent it is, but do not forget that he was followed by many soldiers; If there are no soldiers, he can only be caught or driven back by the enemy on the other side of the mountain, and his actions and words are out of the bounds of heroes and should be classified as a madman. So I think that before asking for the emergence of geniuses, we should first ask for people who can make geniuses grow. ——For example, if you want to have trees and flowers, you must have good soil; Without soil, there will be no flowers and trees; Therefore, the soil is really more important than the flowers and trees. Flowers and trees must have land, just like Napoleon must have good soldiers.然而现在社会上的论调和趋势，一面固然要求天才，一面却要他灭亡，连预备的土也想扫尽。举出几样来说：
However, the current social arguments and trends, on the one hand, require genius, but on the other hand, they want him to perish, and even the prepared soil wants to be swept away. To name a few:其一就是“整理国故”。自从新思潮来到中国以后，其实何尝有力，而一群老头子，还有少年，却已丧魂失魄的来讲国故了，他们说，“中国自有许多好东西，都不整理保存，倒去求新，正如放弃祖宗遗产一样不肖。”抬出祖宗来说法，那自然是极威严的，然而我总不信在旧马褂未曾洗净叠好之前，便不能做一件新马褂。就现状而言，做事本来还随各人的自便，老先生要整理国故，当然不妨去埋在南窗下读死书，至于青年，却自有他们的活学问和新艺术，各干各事，也还没有大妨害的，但若拿了这面旗子来号召，那就是要中国永远与世界隔绝了。倘以为大家非此不可，那更是荒谬绝伦！我们和古董商人谈天，他自然总称赞他的古董如何好，然而他决不痛骂画家，农夫，工匠等类，说是忘记了祖宗：他实在比许多国学家聪明得远。
One is to "sort out the national history". Since the new trend of thought came to China, it is actually powerful, and a group of old men, as well as young people, have come to talk about the country in despair, they said, "China has many good things, but they do not organize and preserve, but seek innovation, just like giving up the ancestral heritage." "Carrying out the ancestors to explain the Dharma, it is naturally extremely majestic, but I always don't believe that a new horse coat cannot be made until the old horse coat has been washed and folded. As far as the current situation is concerned, things are still at the discretion of each person, the old gentleman wants to sort out the national history, of course, he might as well go to bury himself under the south window to read dead books, as for the young people, but they have their own living knowledge and new art, and they do their own things, and there is no big hindrance, but if they take this flag to call, it is to cut China off from the world forever. If you think that everyone has to do this, it is even more ridiculous! When we talk to antique dealers, they naturally always praise how good his antiques are, but he never scolds painters, farmers, craftsmen, etc., saying that he has forgotten his ancestors: he is really far smarter than many Chinese scholars.其一是“崇拜创作”。从表面上看来，似乎这和要求天才的步调很相合，其实不然。那精神中，很含有排斥外来思想，异域情调的分子，所以也就是可以使中国和世界潮流隔绝的。许多人对于托尔斯泰，都介涅夫，陀思妥夫斯奇的名字，已经厌听了，然而他们的著作，有什么译到中国来？眼光囚在一国里，听谈彼得和约翰就生厌，定须张三李四才行，于是创作家出来了，从实说，好的也离不了刺取点外国作品的技术和神情，文笔或者漂亮，思想往往赶不上翻译品，甚者还要加上些传统思想，使他适合于中国人的老脾气，而读者却已为他所牢笼了，于是眼界便渐渐的狭小，几乎要缩进旧圈套里去。作者和读者互相为因果，排斥异流，抬上国粹，那里会有天才产生？即使产生了，也是活不下去的。
The first is "worship creation". On the surface, it seems that this is in line with the pace of requiring geniuses, but it is not. That spirit contains elements that reject foreign ideas and exotic moods, so it can isolate China from the world trend. Many people are tired of the names of Tolstoy, Dujieniev, and Dostovsky, but what are their works translated into China? The eyes are imprisoned in a country, and I get tired of hearing about Peter and John, and I must have Zhang San and Li Si, so the creator comes out, to be honest, the good is inseparable from the technology and expression of some foreign works, the writing or beautiful, the thought often can't catch up with the translation, and even add some traditional ideas, so that he is suitable for the old temper of the Chinese, but the reader has been imprisoned by him, so the vision is gradually narrowed, almost shrinking into the old trap. The author and the reader are causal to each other, reject the other, and carry up the quintessence of the country, where will geniuses be produced? Even if it arises, it will not survive.这样的风气的民众是灰尘，不是泥土，在他这里长不出好花和乔木来！
The people with such a atmosphere are dust, not soil, and they can't grow good flowers and trees here!还有一样是恶意的批评。大家的要求批评家的出现，也由来已久了，到目下就出了许多批评家。可惜他们之中很有不少是不平家，不像批评家，作品才到面前，便恨恨地磨墨，立刻写出很高明的结论道，“唉，幼稚得很。中国要天才！”到后来，连并非批评家也这样叫喊了，他是听来的。其实即使天才，在生下来的时候的第一声啼哭，也和平常的儿童的一样，决不会就是一首好诗。因为幼稚，当头加以戕贼，也可以萎死的。我亲见几个作者，都被他们骂得寒噤了。那些作者大约自然不是天才，然而我的希望是便是常人也留着。
There is also malicious criticism. Everyone has been asking critics for a long time, and there are many critics now. Unfortunately, many of them are unfair, unlike critics, as soon as the work arrives in front of them, they grind the ink hatefully, and immediately write a very clever conclusion, "Alas, it is very naïve." China wants geniuses! Later, even non-critics shouted like this, and he heard it. In fact, even if a genius cries at birth, it will never be a good poem like that of ordinary children. Because they are naïve, they can also wither if they kill them in the first place. I saw several authors with my own eyes, and they were all scolded by them. Those authors are probably not geniuses, but my hope is that ordinary people will also keep them.恶意的批评家在嫩苗的地上驰马，那当然是十分快意的事；然而遭殃的是嫩苗——平常的苗和天才的苗。幼稚对于老成，有如孩子对于老人，决没有什么耻辱；作品也一样，起初幼稚，不算耻辱的。因为倘不遭了戕贼，他就会生长，成熟，老成；独有老衰和腐败，倒是无药可救的事！我以为幼稚的人，或者老大的人，如有幼稚的心，就说幼稚的话，只为自己要说而说，说出之后，至多到印出之后，自己的事就完了，对于无论打着什么旗子的批评，都可以置之不理的！
It is of course very pleasant for malicious critics to gallop on the ground of young seedlings; However, it was the young seedlings that suffered—ordinary seedlings and genius seedlings. Childishness is to the old, just as children are to the elderly, there is no shame; The same goes for the work, which is naïve at first and not shameful. Because if he is not killed, he will grow, mature, and mature; Only old age and corruption are incurable! I think that if a naïve person, or an eldest person, has a childish heart, he will say childish things, just for what he wants to say, and after saying it, at most after it is printed, his own affairs will be over, and he can ignore criticism under any banner!就是在座的诸君，料来也十之九愿有天才的产生罢，然而情形是这样，不但产生天才难，单是有培养天才的泥土也难。我想，天才大半是天赋的；独有这培养天才的泥土，似乎大家都可以做。做土的功效，比要求天才还切近；否则，纵有成千成百的天才，也因为没有泥土，不能发达，要像一碟子绿豆芽。
Even the gentlemen here are expected to have geniuses nine out of ten, but the situation is like this, not only is it difficult to produce geniuses, but it is also difficult to have the soil to cultivate geniuses. I think most geniuses are talented; It seems that everyone can do this unique soil for cultivating geniuses. The effect of making soil is closer than requiring genius; Otherwise, even if there are thousands of geniuses, they cannot develop because there is no soil, and they must be like a plate of mung bean sprouts.做土要扩大了精神，就是收纳新潮，脱离旧套，能够容纳，了解那将来产生的天才；又要不怕做小事业，就是能创作的自然是创作，否则翻译，介绍，欣赏，读，看，消闲都可以。以文艺来消闲，说来似乎有些可笑，但究竟较胜于戕贼他。
To make soil to expand the spirit, that is, to accept the new trend, break away from the old set, be able to accommodate, and understand the genius that will be produced in the future; If you are not afraid of doing small business, you can naturally create, otherwise you can translate, introduce, appreciate, read, watch, and have fun. It seems a bit ridiculous to use literature and art to relax, but it is better than killing him.泥土和天才比，当然是不足齿数的，然而不是坚苦卓绝者，也怕不容易做；不过事在人为，比空等天赋的天才有把握。这一点，是泥土的伟大的地方，也是反有大希望的地方。而且也有报酬，譬如好花从泥土里出来，看的人固然欣然的赏鉴，泥土也可以欣然的赏鉴，正不必花卉自身，这才心旷神怡的——假如当作泥土也有灵魂的说。
Compared with clay and genius, of course, it is not enough, but it is not a hard worker, and I am afraid that it will not be easy to do; However, things are man-made, and geniuses with talents such as Bikong are sure. This is the great place of the soil, and it is also a place of great hope. And there is also a reward, for example, a good flower comes out of the soil, the viewer is certainly happy to appreciate it, and the soil can also be appreciated happily, and it is not necessary for the flower itself to be happy - if it is said that the soil also has a soul.

论雷峰塔的倒掉

论雷峰塔的倒掉

论雷峰塔的倒掉

On the fall of the Leifeng Pagoda听说，杭州西湖上的雷峰塔倒掉了，听说而已，我没有亲见。但我却见过未倒的雷峰塔，破破烂烂的映掩于湖光山色之间，落山的太阳照着这些四近的地方，就是“雷峰夕照”，西湖十景之一。“雷峰夕照”的真景我也见过，并不见佳，我以为。
I heard that the Leifeng Pagoda on Hangzhou West Lake has fallen, I have only heard of it, I have not seen it with my own eyes. But I have seen the unfallen Leifeng Pagoda, tattered and hidden between the lakes and mountains, and the setting sun shines on these nearby places, which is "Leifeng Sunset", one of the ten views of West Lake. I have also seen the real scene of "Leifeng Sunset", but it is not good, I thought.然而一切西湖胜迹的名目之中，我知道得最早的却是这雷峰塔。我的祖母曾经常常对我说，白蛇娘娘就被压在这塔底下！有个叫作许仙的人救了两条蛇，一青一白，后来白蛇便化作女人来报恩，嫁给许仙了；青蛇化作丫鬟，也跟着。一个和尚，法海禅师，得道的禅师，看见许仙脸上有妖气，——凡讨妖怪做老婆的人，脸上就有妖气的，但只有非凡的人才看得出——便将他藏在金山寺的法座后，白蛇娘娘来寻夫，于是就“水满金山”。我的祖母讲起来还要有趣得多，大约是出于一部弹词叫作《义妖传》里的，但我没有看过这部书，所以也不知道“许仙”“法海”究竟是否这样写。总而言之，白蛇娘娘终于中了法海的计策，被装在一个小小的钵盂里了。钵盂埋在地里，上面还造起一座镇压的塔来，这就是雷峰塔。此后似乎事情还很多，如“白状元祭塔”之类，但我现在都忘记了。
However, among all the famous places in West Lake, the earliest I know is this Leifeng Pagoda. My grandmother used to tell me that the White Snake Niangniang was crushed under this tower! A man named Xu Xian saved two snakes, one green and one white, and later the white snake turned into a woman to repay the favor and married Xu Xian; The green snake turned into a maid and followed. A monk, Fahai Zen Master, a Zen master who has attained enlightenment, saw Xu Xian's face with demonic energy,—— anyone who asks for a monster to be his wife has a demonic aura on his face, but only extraordinary people can see it - so after hiding him in the Dharma seat of Jinshan Temple, the White Snake Niangniang came to find a husband, so he was "full of water and golden mountains". My grandmother is much more interesting to talk about, probably because of a word called "The Legend of the Righteous Demon", but I haven't read this book, so I don't know if "Xu Xian" and "Fahai" are written like this. All in all, the White Snake Niangniang finally fell for Fahai's scheme and was put in a small bowl. The bowl was buried in the ground, and a tower of suppression was built on it, which was the Leifeng Pagoda. After that, it seems that there are still many things, such as the "White Champion Sacrifice Pagoda", but I have forgotten them all now.那时我惟一的希望，就在这雷峰塔的倒掉。后来我长大了，到杭州，看见这破破烂烂的塔，心里就不舒服。后来我看看书，说杭州人又叫这塔作保叔塔，其实应该写作“保俶塔”，是钱王的儿子造的。那么，里面当然没有白蛇娘娘了，然而我心里仍然不舒服，仍然希望他倒掉。
At that time, my only hope was the fall of this Leifeng Pagoda. Later, when I grew up and went to Hangzhou, I felt uncomfortable when I saw this tattered tower. Later, I read the book and said that the people of Hangzhou also called this tower Baoshu Pagoda, which should actually be written as "Baochu Pagoda", which was built by the son of King Qian. Then, of course, there is no White Snake Niangniang inside, but I still feel uncomfortable and still hope that he will fall out.现在，他居然倒掉了，则普天之下的人民，其欣喜为何如？
Now, if he has actually fallen, how happy are the people of the world?这是有事实可证的。试到吴越的山间海滨，探听民意去。凡有田夫野老，蚕妇村氓，除了几个脑髓里有点贵恙的之外，可有谁不为白娘娘抱不平，不怪法海太多事的？
This is proven by facts. Try to go to the mountain seaside of Wuyue and listen to public opinion. All the farmers and wild elders, silkworm women and villagers, except for a few who are a little noble in their brains, who doesn't hold grievances for Bai Niangniang and don't blame Fahai for having too many troubles?和尚本应该只管自己念经。白蛇自迷许仙，许仙自娶妖怪，和别人有什么相干呢？他偏要放下经卷，横来招是搬非，大约是怀着嫉妒罢，——那简直是一定的。
The monk should have just taken care of chanting scriptures himself. The white snake is fascinated by Xu Xian, and Xu Xian marries a monster, what does it have to do with others? He wants to put down the scriptures and move the right and wrong, probably out of jealousy,—— that is simply certain.听说，后来玉皇大帝也就怪法海多事，以至荼毒生灵，想要拿办他了。他逃来逃去，终于逃在蟹壳里避祸，不敢再出来，到现在还如此。我对于玉皇大帝所做的事，腹诽的非常多，独于这一件却很满意，因为“水满金山”一案，的确应该由法海负责；他实在办得很不错的。只可惜我那时没有打听这话的出处，或者不在《义妖传》中，却是民间的传说罢。
I heard that later the Jade Emperor blamed Fahai for being troublesome, so much so that he poisoned the living beings and wanted to deal with him. He fled around, and finally fled in the crab shell to avoid disaster, not daring to come out again, and still does. I have slandered a lot about what the Jade Emperor did, but I am very satisfied with this one, because the case of "water full of gold" should indeed be responsible for Fahai; He did a really good job. It's a pity that I didn't inquire about the source of this at that time, or it wasn't in "The Legend of the Righteous Demon", but it was a folk legend.秋高稻熟时节，吴越间所多的是螃蟹，煮到通红之后，无论取哪一只，揭开背壳来，里面就有黄，有膏；倘是雌的，就有石榴子一般鲜红的子。先将这些吃完，即一定露出一个圆锥形的薄膜，再用小刀小心地沿着锥底切下，取出，翻转，使里面向外，只要不破，便变成一个罗汉模样的东西，有头脸，身子，是坐着的，我们那里的小孩子都称他“蟹和尚”，就是躲在里面避难的法海。
In the autumn high rice ripening season, there are many crabs in Wu and Yue, and after cooking until they are red, no matter which one you take, open the back shell, there is yellow and paste inside; If it is female, there will be bright red seeds like pomegranate seeds. Eat these first, that is, a cone-shaped film must be exposed, and then carefully cut off along the bottom of the cone with a knife, take it out, turn it over, so that the inside is facing out, as long as it is not broken, it will become an Arhat-like thing, with a head, face, body, and sitting, and our children there call him "Crab Monk", which is the sea of law that hides in it.当初，白蛇娘娘压在塔底下，法海禅师躲在蟹壳里。现在却只有这位老禅师独自静坐了，非到螃蟹断种的那一天为止出不来。莫非他造塔的时候，竟没有想到塔是终究要倒的么？
At the beginning, the White Snake Niangniang was pressed under the tower, and Zen Master Fahai hid in the crab shell. Now only this old Zen master sits quietly alone, and he can't come out until the day the crab is cut off. Could it be that when he built the tower, he didn't think that the tower would eventually fall?活该。
Deserve.一九二四年十月二十八日。
October 28, 1924.

说胡须

说胡须

说胡须

Talk about beards今年夏天游了一回长安，一个多月之后，胡里胡涂的回来了。知道的朋友便问我：“你以为那边怎样？”我这才栗然地回想长安，记得看见很多的白杨，很大的石榴树，道中喝了不少的黄河水。然而这些又有什么可谈呢？我于是说：“没有什么怎样。”他于是废然而去了，我仍旧废然而住，自愧无以对“不耻下问”的朋友们。
I traveled back to Chang'an this summer, and more than a month later, I came back in a mess. A friend who knew asked me, "What do you think of that place?" I remembered seeing a lot of poplars, large pomegranate trees, and drinking a lot of Yellow River water on the road. But what is there to talk about? I said, "It's nothing." He then left in vain, and I still lived in abandonment, ashamed of my friends who were "not ashamed to ask".今天喝茶之后，便看书，书上沾了一点水，我知道上唇的胡须又长起来了。假如翻一翻《康熙字典》，上唇的，下唇的，颊旁的，下巴上的各种胡须，大约都有特别的名号谥法的罢，然而我没有这样闲情别致。总之是这胡子又长起来了，我又要照例的剪短他，先免得沾汤带水。于是寻出镜子，剪刀，动手就剪，其目的是在使他和上唇的上缘平齐，成一个隶书的一字。我一面剪，一面却忽而记起长安，记起我的青年时代，发出连绵不断的感慨来。长安的事，已经不很记得清楚了，大约确乎是游历孔庙的时候，其中有一间房子，挂着许多印画，有李二曲像，有历代帝王像，其中有一张是宋太祖或是什么宗，我也记不清楚了，总之是穿一件长袍，而胡子向上翘起的。于是一位名士就毅然决然地说：“这都是日本人假造的，你看这胡子就是日本式的胡子。”
After drinking tea today, I read a book, and the book was stained with a little water, and I knew that the beard on my upper lip had grown again. If you look at the "Kangxi Dictionary", the upper lip, the lower lip, the cheeks, and all kinds of beards on the chin probably have special names, but I don't have such leisure and chic. In short, this beard has grown again, and I want to cut him short as usual, so as not to get wet with water. So he found a mirror and scissors, and cut them with his hands, the purpose of which was to make him flush with the upper edge of the upper lip, into a clerical script. While I was cutting, I suddenly remembered Chang'an, remembered my youth, and let out continuous emotions. I don't remember the things in Chang'an very clearly, about the time I visited the Confucius Temple, there was a house with many seals and paintings, there were portraits of Li Erqu, there were portraits of emperors of the past dynasties, one of which was Song Taizu or what kind of sect, I can't remember clearly, in short, he was wearing a robe, and his beard was raised upwards. So a celebrity resolutely said: "This is all fake by the Japanese, you see this beard is a Japanese-style beard." ”诚然，他们的胡子确乎如此翘上，他们也未必不假造宋太祖或什么宗的画像，但假造中国皇帝的肖像而必须对了镜子，以自己的胡子为法式，则其手段和思想之离奇，真可谓“出乎意表之外”了。清乾隆中，黄易掘出汉武梁祠石刻画像来，男子的胡须多翘上；我们现在所见北魏至唐的佛教造像中的信士像，凡有胡子的也多翘上，直到元明的画像，则胡子大抵受了地心的吸力作用，向下面拖下去了。日本人何其不惮烦，孳孳汲汲地造了这许多从汉到唐的假古董，来埋在中国的齐鲁燕晋秦陇巴蜀的深山邃谷废墟荒地里？
It is true that their beards are indeed so upright, and they may not have forged portraits of Song Taizu or some sect, but if they forge the portrait of the Chinese emperor and look in the mirror, using their own beard as a French style, then their methods and ideas are bizarre and can be described as "unexpected". In the Qianlong period of the Qing Dynasty, Huang Yi dug up the stone carved portrait of the Han Wuliang Temple, and the man's beard was raised more; The statues of believers in the Buddhist statues from the Northern Wei Dynasty to the Tang Dynasty that we see now are mostly upturned up, and until the portraits of the Yuan and Ming dynasties, the beards are largely dragged down by the gravitation of the center of the earth. Why are the Japanese so unafraid and diligently made these many fake antiques from the Han to the Tang Dynasty to bury them in the ruins of the deep mountains and valleys of Qilu, Yan, Jin, Qin, Long, and Bashu in China?我以为拖下的胡子倒是蒙古式，是蒙古人带来的，然而我们的聪明的名士却当作国粹了。留学日本的学生因为恨日本，便神往于大元，说道“那时倘非天幸，这岛国早被我们灭掉了！”则认拖下的胡子为国粹亦无不可。然而又何以是黄帝的子孙？又何以说台湾人在福建打中国人是奴隶根性？
I thought the dragged beard was Mongolian, brought by the Mongols, but our smart celebrities regarded it as the quintessence of the country. The students studying in Japan were fascinated by the Great Yuan because they hated Japan, saying, "If it weren't for luck at that time, this island country would have been destroyed by us!" Then it is not impossible to recognize the dragged beard as the quintessence of the country. However, why is he a descendant of the Yellow Emperor? Why do you say that Taiwanese fighting Chinese in Fujian is a slave nature?我当时就想争辩，但我即刻又不想争辩了。留学德国的爱国者X君，——因为我忘记了他的名字，姑且以X代之，——不是说我的毁谤中国，是因为娶了日本女人，所以替他们宣传本国的坏处么？我先前不过单举几样中国的缺点，尚且要带累“贱内”改了国籍，何况现在是有关日本的问题？好在即使宋太祖或什么宗的胡子蒙些不白之冤，也不至于就有洪水，就有地震，有什么大相干。我于是连连点头，说道：“嗡，嗡，对啦。”因为我实在比先前似乎油滑得多了，——好了。
I wanted to argue, but I didn't want to argue anymore. Mr. X, a patriot studying in Germany,—— because I forgot his name, and replaced him with X,—— Isn't it because I slander China, because I married a Japanese woman, so I promoted the bad of my country for them? I only listed a few shortcomings of China before, and I still have to change my nationality with the "cheap country", not to mention that it is now a question about Japan? Fortunately, even if Song Taizu or the beard of any sect suffered some unjust injustice, there would be no floods, earthquakes, and anything to do with it. I nodded repeatedly and said, "Buzz, bum, right." "Because I really seem to be much more oily than before,—— it's better.我剪下自己的胡子的左尖端毕，想，陕西人费心劳力，备饭化钱，用汽车载，用船装，用骡车拉，用自动车装，请到长安去讲演，大约万料不到我是一个虽对于决无杀身之祸的小事情，也不肯直抒自己的意见，只会“嗡，嗡，对啦”的罢。他们简直是受了骗了。
I cut off the left tip of my beard, thinking, Shaanxi people take the trouble to prepare food and money, use cars, use boats, pull with mule carts, and use automatic cars to put them on, please go to Chang'an to give a speech. They were simply deceived.我再向着镜中的自己的脸，看定右嘴角，剪下胡子的右尖端，撒在地上，想起我的青年时代来——
I looked at my face in the mirror, looked at the corner of my right mouth, cut off the right tip of my beard, and scattered it on the ground, thinking of my youth——那已经是老话，约有十六七年了罢。
That's an old saying, about sixteen or seventeen years.我就从日本回到故乡来，嘴上就留着宋太祖或什么宗似的向上翘起的胡子，坐在小船里，和船夫谈天。
I returned to my hometown from Japan, with a beard raised upwards like Song Taizu or some kind of sect on my mouth, sitting in a small boat and chatting with the boatman.“先生，你的中国话说得真好。”后来，他说。
"Sir, you speak Chinese so well." Later, he said.“我是中国人，而且和你是同乡，怎么会……”
"I'm Chinese, and I'm from the same hometown as you, how could I ......"“哈哈哈，你这位先生还会说笑话。”
"Hahaha, your gentleman can still tell jokes."记得我那时的没奈何，确乎比看见X君的通信要超过十倍。我那时随身并没有带着家谱，确乎不能证明我是中国人。即使带着家谱，而上面只有一个名字，并无画像，也不能证明这名字就是我。即使有画像，日本人会假造从汉到唐的石刻，宋太祖或什么宗的画像，难道偏不会假造一部木版的家谱么？
I remember that I was helpless at that time, and it was indeed more than ten times more than seeing Mr. X's communication. I didn't have a family tree with me at that time, so I really couldn't prove that I was Chinese. Even if you have a family tree and there is only one name on it, and there is no portrait, it cannot prove that the name is me. Even if there are portraits, will the Japanese forge stone carvings from the Han to the Tang Dynasty, the portraits of Song Taizu or some sect, will they not forge a woodblock genealogy?凡对于以真话为笑话的，以笑话为真话的，以笑话为笑话的，只有一个方法：就是不说话。
There is only one way for those who take the truth as a joke, to take a joke as a joke, and to take a joke as a joke: not to speak.于是我从此不说话。
So I never spoke again.然而，倘使在现在，我大约还要说：“嗡，嗡，……今天天气多么好呀？……那边的村子叫什么名字？……”因为我实在比先前似乎油滑得多了，——好了。
However, if I were now, I would probably say, "Hum, hum,...... How nice is the weather today? …… What is the name of the village over there? ...... "Because I'm really much smoother than before,—— it's better."现在我想，船夫的改变我的国籍，大概和X君的高见不同。其原因只在于胡子罢，因为我从此常常为胡子受苦。
Now I think that the boatman's change of nationality is probably different from Mr. X's high opinion. The reason for this is only the beard, because I have always suffered for it since then.国度会亡，国粹家是不会少的，而只要国粹家不少，这国度就不算亡。国粹家者，保存国粹者也；而国粹者，我的胡子是也。这虽然不知道是什么“逻辑”法，但当时的实情确是如此的。
The country will perish, and there will be no fewer nationalists, and as long as there are many nationalists, the kingdom will not be dead. The national quintessence is the one who preserves the national essence; And the quintessence of the country is my beard. Although I don't know what kind of "logical" method this is, the truth at that time was indeed like this.“你怎么学日本人的样子，身体既矮小，胡子又这样，……”一位国粹家兼爱国者发过一篇崇论宏议之后，就达到这一个结论。
"How do you learn from the Japanese, your body is short and your beard is like this,...... "A nationalist and patriot came to this conclusion after posting a grand discussion.可惜我那时还是一个不识世故的少年，所以就愤愤地争辩。第一，我的身体是本来只有这样高，并非故意设法用什么洋鬼子的机器压缩，使他变成矮小，希图冒充。第二，我的胡子，诚然和许多日本人的相同，然而我虽然没有研究过他们的胡须样式变迁史，但曾经见过几幅古人的画像，都不向上，只是向外，向下，和我们的国粹差不多。维新以后，可是翘起来了，那大约是学了德国式。你看威廉皇帝的胡须，不是上指眼梢，和鼻梁正作平行么？虽然他后来因为吸烟烧了一边，只好将两边都剪平了。但在日本明治维新的时候，他这一边还没有失火……。
Unfortunately, I was still an ignorant teenager at the time, so I argued indignantly. First, my body was originally only this tall, and I didn't deliberately try to compress it with some foreign devil's machine to make him short, and I wanted to pretend to be him. Second, my beard is indeed the same as that of many Japanese, but although I have not studied the history of their beard style changes, I have seen several portraits of the ancients, none of which are upward, but outward, downward, similar to our national essence. After the Restoration, it was upturned, and it was about learning the German style. Look at Emperor Wilhelm's beard, doesn't it point to the tip of the eye, parallel to the bridge of the nose? Although he later burned one side because of smoking, he had to cut both sides flat. But during the Meiji Restoration in Japan, there was no ...... fire on his side.这一场辩解大约要两分钟，可是总不能解国粹家之怒，因为德国也是洋鬼子，而况我的身体又矮小乎。而况国粹家很不少，意见又很统一，因此我的辩解也就很频繁，然而总无效，一回，两回，以至十回，十几回，连我自己也觉得无聊而且麻烦起来了。罢了，况且修饰胡须用的胶油在中国也难得，我便从此听其自然了。
This defense took about two minutes, but it could not relieve the anger of the nationalists, because Germany was also a foreign devil, and my body was short. Moreover, there are many nationalists, and their opinions are very unified, so my defenses are very frequent, but they are always ineffective, once, twice, or even ten times, or more than a dozen times, and even I myself find it boring and troublesome. That's all, and the glue used to modify the beard is rare in China, so I will let it go naturally.听其自然之后，胡子的两端就显出毗心现象来，于是也就和地面成为九十度的直角。国粹家果然也不再说话，或者中国已经得救了罢。
After listening to its nature, the two ends of the beard show the phenomenon of adjacency, so it becomes a right angle to the ground at a right angle of 90 degrees. The nationalists really don't speak anymore, or China has been saved.然而接着就招了改革家的反感，这也是应该的。我于是又分疏，一回，两回，以至许多回，连我自己也觉得无聊而且麻烦起来了。
However, it then attracted the disgust of the reformers, which is also right. So I was estranged again, once, twice, and even many times, and even I felt bored and troublesome.大约在四五年或七八年前罢，我独坐在会馆里，窃悲我的胡须的不幸的境遇，研究他所以得谤的原因，忽而恍然大悟，知道那祸根全在两边的尖端上。于是取出镜子，剪刀，即刻剪成一平，使他既不上翘，也难拖下，如一个隶书的一字。
About four or five or seven or eight years ago, I sat alone in the hall, secretly mourning the unfortunate condition of my beard, studying the reasons why he was slandered, and suddenly realized that the root of the bane was all on the tips of both sides. So he took out the mirror and scissors, and immediately cut it flat, so that he was neither upturned nor difficult to drag down, like a character in a clerical script.“阿，你的胡子这样了？”当初也曾有人这样问。
"Ah, what's wrong with your beard?" Someone asked this question at the beginning.“唔唔，我的胡子这样了。”
"Hmm, my beard is like this."他可是没有话。我不知道是否因为寻不着两个尖端，所以失了立论的根据，还是我的胡子“这样”之后，就不负中国存亡的责任了。总之我从此太平无事的一直到现在，所麻烦者，必须时常剪剪而已。
He had nothing to say. I don't know if I lost the basis for my thesis because I couldn't find the two tips, or if my beard was "like this", I would not be responsible for China's survival. In short, I have been peaceful since then, and the trouble is that I have to cut it from time to time.一九二四年十月三十日。
October 30, 1924.

On photography and the like一　材料之类
1. Materials我幼小时候，在S城，——所谓幼小时候者，是三十年前，但从进步神速的英才看来，就是一世纪；所谓S城者，我不说他的真名字，何以不说之故，也不说。总之，是在S城，常常旁听大大小小男男女女谈论洋鬼子挖眼睛。曾有一个女人，原在洋鬼子家里佣工，后来出来了，据说她所以出来的原因，就因为亲见一坛盐渍的眼睛，小鲫鱼似的一层一层积叠着，快要和坛沿齐平了。她为远避危险起见，所以赶紧走。
When I was young, in S City,—— the so-called childhood was thirty years ago, but from the perspective of the rapidly progressing talents, it was the first century; The so-called S City, I don't say his real name, why don't I say it, and I don't say it. In short, in S City, I often listen to men and women of all sizes talking about foreign devils gouging their eyes. It is said that the reason why she came out was because she saw a jar of salted eyes, layer by layer like a crucian carp, almost level with the edge of the altar. She hurried away to avoid danger.S城有一种习惯，就是凡是小康之家，到冬天一定用盐来腌一缸白菜，以供一年之需，其用意是否和四川的榨菜相同，我不知道。但洋鬼子之腌眼睛，则用意当然别有所在，惟独方法却大受了S城腌白菜法的影响，相传中国对外富于同化力，这也就是一个证据罢。然而状如小鲫鱼者何？答曰：此确为S城人之眼睛也。S城庙宇中常有一种菩萨，号曰眼光娘娘。有眼病的，可以去求祷；愈，则用布或绸做眼睛一对，挂神龛上或左右，以答神庥。所以只要看所挂眼睛的多少，就知道这菩萨的灵不灵。而所挂的眼睛，则正是两头尖尖，如小鲫鱼，要寻一对和洋鬼子生理图上所画似的圆球形者，决不可得。黄帝岐伯尚矣；王莽诛翟义党，分解肢体，令医生们察看，曾否绘图不可知，纵使绘过，现在已佚，徒令“古已有之”而已。宋的《析骨分经》，相传也据目验，《说郛》中有之，我曾看过它，多是胡说，大约是假的。否则，目验尚且如此胡涂，则S城人之将眼睛理想化为小鲫鱼，实也无足深怪了。
There is a habit in S City, that is, all well-off families must use salt to pickle a jar of cabbage in winter for a year's needs, and I don't know if the intention is the same as that of Sichuan mustard. However, the pickled eyes of foreign devils have other intentions, but the method is greatly influenced by the S City pickled cabbage method, and it is said that China is rich in assimilation to the outside world, which is also a proof. However, what does it look like a small crucian carp? Answer: This is indeed the eye of the people of S City. There is often a kind of Bodhisattva in the temple of S City, called the Lady of the Eye. those who have eye diseases can go to prayer; If it heals, make a pair of eyes out of cloth or silk and hang it on or on the left and right of the shrine to answer the gods. Therefore, just look at the number of eyes hanging to know whether the bodhisattva's spirit is effective. The Yellow Emperor and Qibo are still alive; Wang Mang killed Zhai Yidang, dismembered the limbs, and ordered the doctors to observe, whether they had been drawn or not, even if they had been drawn, they were now lost, and it was only "there was it in ancient times". Th. Lipps said this in his book "The Fundamental Questions of Ethics". Even any master is easy to become a slave, because he admits that he can be a master on the one hand, and of course he admits that he can be a slave on the other hand, so as soon as his power falls, he will give up and bow his head in front of the new master. From Mr. Chongxuan's correspondence (Beijing News Supplement in February), I know that he heard two passengers talking on the ship, saying that the reason why the Leifeng Pagoda in Hangzhou collapsed was because the countrymen were superstitious that the tower bricks were placed in their homes, and everything would be safe, wishful, and auspicious, so they dug this and that, and after digging for a long time, they fell. Now the ten views of West Lake are missing! "There are nine classics for all countries in the world", the nine classics have existed in ancient times, but the nine views are quite unfamiliar, so it is a needle for the ten scenery diseases, at least it can make the patient feel an unusual, knowing that his lovely old illness suddenly ran away one-tenth.但仍有悲哀在里面。

Even now, if you are an artist, do you dare to print in foreign languages?清顺治中，时宪书上印有“依西洋新法”五个字，痛哭流涕来劾洋人汤若望的偏是汉人杨光先。直到康熙初，争胜了，就教他做钦天监正去，则又叩阍以“但知推步之理不知推步之数”辞。不准辞，则又痛哭流涕地来做《不得已》，说道“宁可使中夏无好历法，不可使中夏有西洋人。”然而终于连闰月都算错了，他大约以为好历法专属于西洋人，中夏人自己是学不得，也学不好的。但他竟论了大辟，可是没有杀，放归，死于途中了。汤若望入中国还在明崇祯初，其法终未见用；后来阮元论之曰：“明季君臣以大统寖疏，开局修正，既知新法之密，而讫未施行。圣朝定鼎，以其法造时宪书，颁行天下。彼十余年辩论翻译之劳，若以备我朝之采用者，斯亦奇矣！……我国家圣圣相传，用人行政，惟求其是，而不先设成心。即是一端，可以仰见如天之度量矣！”（《畴人传》四十五）
During the Shunzhi period of the Qing Dynasty, the five words "according to the new Western law" were printed on the constitutional book, and it was the Han Yang Guangxian who cried bitterly to impeach the foreigner Tang Ruowang. Until the beginning of Kangxi, when he won the battle, he taught him to be the head of the Qin Tianjian, and then knocked on the door with the words "but know the principle of pushing steps, but not the number of pushes". If he was not allowed to leave, he would cry bitterly and do "Last Resort", saying, "It is better to have no good calendar in China than to have Westerners in China." However, in the end, even the leap month was miscalculated, and he probably thought that the good calendar was exclusive to Westerners, and the Chinese people themselves could not learn it, nor could they learn it well. But he was sentenced to death, but he was not killed, released, and died on the way. Tang Ruowang entered China in the early Ming Chongzhen period, and his method was never used; Later, Ruan Yuan commented: "In the late Ming Dynasty, the monarch and ministers were loose and revised, and they knew the secret of the new law, but it was not implemented. The Holy Dynasty established the Ding Dynasty and used this method to create the Constitution of the time, which was promulgated throughout the realm. It is truly remarkable that the work of debating and translating for more than ten years is used to prepare for our dynasty's adoption. …… In our country, the saints and sages have passed down the tradition of employing people and administration, only seeking the right things without first setting up a mindset. This is one end, and you can look up at the measurement of heaven. ("The Biography of the People" 45)现在流传的古镜们，出自冢中者居多，原是殉葬品。但我也有一面日用镜，薄而且大，规抚汉制，也许是唐代的东西。那证据是：一，镜鼻已多磨损；二，镜面的沙眼都用别的铜来补好了。当时在妆阁中，曾照唐人的额黄和眉绿，现在却监禁在我的衣箱里，它或者大有今昔之感罢。
Most of the ancient mirrors that are now circulating are from tombs and were originally burial goods. But I also have a daily mirror, thin and large, gauge the Han system, maybe something from the Tang Dynasty. The evidence is: first, the mirror nose has been worn a lot; Second, the trachoma on the mirror surface is repaired with other copper. At that time, in the makeup pavilion, I used to shine on the yellow forehead and green eyebrows of the Tang people, but now they are imprisoned in my closet, and it may have a sense of the past and present.但铜镜的供用，大约道光咸丰时候还与玻璃镜并行；至于穷乡僻壤，也许至今还用着。我们那里，则除了婚丧仪式之外，全被玻璃镜驱逐了。然而也还有余烈可寻，倘街头遇见一位老翁，肩了长凳似的东西，上面缚着一块猪肝色石和一块青色石，试伫听他的叫喊，就是“磨镜，磨剪刀！”
However, the supply of copper mirrors was still parallel to glass mirrors during the Daoguang Xianfeng period; As for the poor and remote areas, they may still be used today. Except for the wedding and funeral ceremonies, we were all expelled by the glass mirror. However, there are still remnants to be found, if you meet an old man on the street, with something like a bench on his shoulder, with a pig liver-colored stone and a cyan stone tied to it, try to listen to his shout, that is, "Sharpen the mirror, sharpen the scissors!" ”宋镜我没有见过好的，什九并无藻饰，只有店号或“正其衣冠”等类的迂铭词，真是“世风日下”。但是要进步或不退步，总须时时自出新裁，至少也必取材异域，倘若各种顾忌，各种小心，各种唠叨，这么做即违了祖宗，那么做又像了夷狄，终生惴惴如在薄冰上，发抖尚且来不及，怎么会做出好东西来。所以事实上“今不如古”者，正因为有许多唠叨着“今不如古”的诸位先生们之故。现在情形还如此。倘再不放开度量，大胆地，无畏地，将新文化尽量地吸收，则杨光先似的向西洋主人沥陈中夏的精神文明的时候，大概是不劳久待的罢。
I have never seen a good Song mirror, there is no decoration in the nineteenth of ten, only the store number or the inscription such as "correct its clothes", which is really "the world is declining". But to progress or not regress, you must always make new decisions from time to time, at least you must take foreign materials, if you have all kinds of scruples, all kinds of cautions, all kinds of nagging, doing so is against your ancestors, then doing it is like a barbarian, anxious for the rest of your life, trembling is too late, how can you make good things. So in fact, those who say "today is not as good as the ancients" are precisely because there are many gentlemen who nag that "today is not as good as the ancients". This is still the case now. But I have never met a person who rejects glass mirrors. I only know that during the Xianfeng period, Mr. Wang Yuezhen attacked in his masterpiece "Huya". After comparative research, he finally decided that the bronze mirror was better. 春末闲谈

春末闲谈

春末闲谈

Late spring chat北京正是春末，也许我过于性急之故罢，觉着夏意了，于是突然记起故乡的细腰蜂。那时候大约是盛夏，青蝇密集在凉棚索子上，铁黑色的细腰蜂就在桑树间或墙角的蛛网左近往来飞行，有时衔一支小青虫去了，有时拉一个蜘蛛。青虫或蜘蛛先是抵抗着不肯去，但终于乏力，被衔着腾空而去了，坐了飞机似的。
It was late spring in Beijing, and maybe I was too impatient, but I felt the summer, so I suddenly remembered the slender-waisted bees in my hometown. It was about midsummer, and the green flies were densely packed on the pergola ropes, and the iron-black slender-waisted bees flew back and forth between the mulberry trees or in the corners of the cobwebs, sometimes carrying a small green worm, and sometimes pulling a spider. The green worm or spider resisted at first and refused to go, but finally became weak and was carried away into the air, as if on a plane.老前辈们开导我，那细腰蜂就是书上所说的果蠃，纯雌无雄，必须捉螟蛉去做继子的。她将小青虫封在窠里，自己在外面日日夜夜敲打着，祝道“像我像我”，经过若干日，——我记不清了，大约七七四十九日罢，——那青虫也就成了细腰蜂了，所以《诗经》里说：“螟蛉有子，果负之。”螟蛉就是桑上小青虫。蜘蛛呢？他们没有提。我记得有几个考据家曾经立过异说，以为她其实自能生卵；其捉青虫，乃是填在窠里，给孵化出来的幼蜂做食料的。但我所遇见的前辈们都不采用此说，还道是拉去做女儿。我们为存留天地间的美谈起见，倒不如这样好。当长夏无事，遣暑林阴，瞥见二虫一拉一拒的时候，便如睹慈母教女，满怀好意，而青虫的宛转抗拒，则活像一个不识好歹的毛鸦头。
The old-timers enlightened me that the slender-waisted bee was the fruit cockroach mentioned in the book, pure male and female, and it had to catch the moth to be a stepson. She sealed the little green worm in the nest, and she beat it outside day and night, wishing "like me", after a few days,—— I can't remember, about seven days and forty-nine days,—— the green worm also became a slender-waisted bee, so the "Book of Songs" says: "The borer has a son, and the fruit is negative." "The moth is the little green worm on the mulberry. What about spiders? They didn't mention it. I remember that several researchers once made a different opinion, thinking that she could actually lay eggs on her own; The green worms are filled in the nest to feed the hatched young bees. But the seniors I met didn't adopt this statement, and they said they were pulling me to be their daughters. For the sake of preserving the beautiful talk between heaven and earth, it is not as good as this. When there is nothing to do in the long summer, in the shade of the forest, and when you catch a glimpse of the two insects pulling and rejecting, it is like seeing a loving mother and a daughter, full of good intentions, and the green worm's resistance is like a hairy crow head that does not know what to do.但究竟是夷人可恶，偏要讲什么科学。科学虽然给我们许多惊奇，但也搅坏了我们许多好梦。自从法国的昆虫学大家发勃耳（Fabre）仔细观察之后，给幼蜂做食料的事可就证实了。而且，这细腰蜂不但是普通的凶手，还是一种很残忍的凶手，又是一个学识技术都极高明的解剖学家。她知道青虫的神经构造和作用，用了神奇的毒针，向那运动神经球上只一螫，它便麻痹为不死不活状态，这才在它身上生下蜂卵，封入窠中。青虫因为不死不活，所以不动，但也因为不活不死，所以不烂，直到她的子女孵化出来的时候，这食料还和被捕当日一样的新鲜。
But what kind of science is it that the barbarians are hateful? Although science has given us many surprises, it has also ruined many of our good dreams. Since the careful observation of the French entomologist Fabre, it has been confirmed that food is used for young bees. Moreover, this slender-waisted bee is not only an ordinary murderer, but also a very cruel murderer, and an anatomist with extremely high knowledge and skills. She knew the nervous structure and function of the green worm, and used a magical needle to sting the motor nerve sphere, and it was paralyzed into an immortal state, and then gave birth to a bee egg on it and sealed it in the nest. The green worm does not move because it is not dead or alive, but it is also not rotten because it is not alive or dead, until her children hatch, the food is still as fresh as the day of the arrest.三年前，我遇见神经过敏的俄国的E君，有一天他忽然发愁道，不知道将来的科学家，是否不至于发明一种奇妙的药品，将这注射在谁的身上，则这人即甘心永远去做服役和战争的机器了？那时我也就皱眉叹息，装作一齐发愁的模样，以示“所见略同”之至意，殊不知我国的圣君，贤臣，圣贤，圣贤之徒，却早已有过这一种黄金世界的理想了。不是“唯辟作福，唯辟作威，唯辟玉食”么？不是“君子劳心，小人劳力”么？不是“治于人者食（去声）人，治人者食于人”么？可惜理论虽已卓然，而终于没有发明十全的好方法。要服从作威就须不活，要贡献玉食就须不死；要被治就须不活，要供养治人者又须不死。人类升为万物之灵，自然是可贺的，但没有了细腰蜂的毒针，却很使圣君，贤臣，圣贤，圣贤之徒，以至现在的阔人，学者，教育家觉得棘手。将来未可知，若已往，则治人者虽然尽力施行过各种麻痹术，也还不能十分奏效，与果并驱争先。即以皇帝一伦而言，便难免时常改姓易代，终没有“万年有道之长”;“二十四史”而多至二十四，就是可悲的铁证。现在又似乎有些别开生面了，世上挺生了一种所谓“特殊智识阶级”的留学生，在研究室中研究之结果，说医学不发达是有益于人种改良的，中国妇女的境遇是极其平等的，一切道理都已不错，一切状态都已够好。E君的发愁，或者也不为无因罢，然而俄国是不要紧的，因为他们不像我们中国，有所谓“特别国情”，还有所谓“特殊智识阶级”。
Three years ago, I met Mr. E in Russia, who was nervous, and one day he suddenly became worried that he wondered if the future scientist would not invent a wonderful drug and inject it into whom, and this person would be willing to be a machine of service and war forever? At that time, I frowned and sighed, pretending to be worried together, to show the sincerity of "seeing the same thing", but I didn't know that our country's holy kings, virtuous ministers, sages, and sages had already had this kind of golden world ideal. Isn't it "only the blessing, the only power, and the only jade food"? Isn't it "a gentleman labors, a villain labors"? Isn't it "those who govern people eat (remove the sound) people, and those who govern people eat people"? Unfortunately, although the theory has been outstanding, there is no good way to invent perfection. If you want to obey and dominate, you must not live, and if you want to contribute jade food, you must not die; To be governed, one must not live, and to support and heal others, one must not die. Human beings are naturally congratulated on their rise to the spirits of all things, but without the poisonous needle of the slender-waisted bee, it makes the holy kings, virtuous ministers, sages, sages, and even the current broad people, scholars, and educators feel tricky. The future is unknown, and if it has passed, although the healers have tried their best to perform various paralysis techniques, they have not yet been fully effective, and they are still ahead of the curve. That is, in the case of the emperor, it is inevitable to change the surname and change generations from time to time, and there is no "ten thousand years of longevity"; "Twenty-four histories" and as many as twenty-four are sad ironclad evidence. The results of research in the laboratory say that underdeveloped medicine is conducive to racial improvement, and the situation of Chinese women is extremely equal. Mr. E's worries may not be for no reason, but Russia doesn't matter, because unlike us in China, there are so-called "special national conditions" and so-called "special intellectual class".但这种工作，也怕终于像古人那样，不能十分奏效的罢，因为这实在比细腰蜂所做的要难得多。她于青虫，只须不动，所以仅在运动神经球上一螫，即告成功。而我们的工作，却求其能运动，无知觉，该在知觉神经中枢，加以完全的麻醉的。但知觉一失，运动也就随之失却主宰，不能贡献玉食，恭请上自“极峰”下至“特殊智识阶级”的赏收享用了。就现在而言，窃以为除了遗老的圣经贤传法，学者的进研究室主义，文学家和茶摊老板的莫谈国事律，教育家的勿视勿听勿言勿动论之外，委实还没有更好，更完全，更无流弊的方法。便是留学生的特别发见，其实也并未轶出了前贤的范围。
But this kind of work is afraid that it will not be very effective like the ancients, because it is really much more difficult than what the slender-waisted bee does. She only needs to be immovable in the green worm, so she only needs to sting the motor nerve bulb and she will succeed. Our work, on the other hand, requires movement and sensation, and should be completely anesthetized in the sensory nerve center. But once the perception is lost, the movement will lose its dominance, and it will not be able to contribute jade food, and it is respectfully appreciated and enjoyed from the "extreme peak" to the "special intellectual class". For now, I think that apart from the biblical teachings of the elderly, the study of scholars, the laws of writers and tea stall owners, and the theory of educators not to see, listen, speak, and act, there is no better, more complete, and less corrupt method. It is the special discovery of international students, but in fact, it is not beyond the scope of the predecessors.那么，又要“礼失而求诸野”了。夷人，现在因为想去取法，姑且称之为外国，他那里，可有较好的法子么？可惜，也没有。所有者，仍不外乎不准集会，不许开口之类，和我们中华并没有什么很不同。然亦可见至道嘉猷，人同此心，心同此理，固无华夷之限也。猛兽是单独的，牛羊则结队；野牛的大队，就会排角成城以御强敌了，但拉开一匹，定只能牟牟地叫。人民与牛马同流，——此就中国而言，夷人别有分类法云，——治之之道，自然应该禁止集合：这方法是对的。其次要防说话。人能说话，已经是祸胎了，而况有时还要做文章。所以苍颉造字，夜有鬼哭。鬼且反对，而况于官？猴子不会说话，猴界即向无风潮，——可是猴界中也没有官，但这又作别论，——确应该虚心取法，反朴归真，则口且不开，文章自灭：这方法也是对的。然而上文也不过就理论而言，至于实效，却依然是难说。最显著的例，是连那么专制的俄国，而尼古拉二世“龙御上宾”之后，罗马诺夫氏竟已“覆宗绝祀”了。要而言之，那大缺点就在虽有二大良法，而还缺其一，便是：无法禁止人们的思想。
Then, it is necessary to "lose etiquette and seek the wilderness". The barbarians, now because they want to take the law, let's call it a foreign country, is there a better way there? Unfortunately, no. The owner is still nothing more than not allowed to assemble, not to speak, etc., which is not very different from our China. However, it can also be seen that the best way is good, and people share this heart, and their hearts are the same, and there are no limits between the Chinese and the barbarians. The beasts are alone, and the cattle and sheep are grouped; The bison brigade will line up to resist the strong enemy, but if you pull one away, you will only be able to call it. The people are in the same flow as cattle and horses,—— as far as China is concerned, the barbarians have a different classification law,—— and the way to govern it should naturally prohibit gathering: this method is correct. Secondly, we must prevent talking. People can talk, which is already a disaster, and sometimes they have to make a fuss. Therefore, when Cangjie coined characters, there were ghosts crying at night. If the ghost opposes it, how much more so for the officials? Monkeys can't speak, the monkey world is to no trend,—— but there are no officials in the monkey world, but this is another matter,—— it is true that we should take the law with an open mind, return to simplicity, and then do not open our mouths, and the article will self-extinguish: this method is also correct. However, the above is only in theory, but as for the practical effect, it is still difficult to say. The most striking example is even such an autocratic Russia, and after Nicholas II's "dragon emperor guest", the Romanovs have been "extinguished". In short, the big drawback is that although there are two good laws, one is still missing, that is, it is impossible to prohibit people's thoughts.于是我们的造物主——假如天空真有这样的一位“主子”——就可恨了：一恨其没有永远分清“治者”与“被治者”；二恨其不给治者生一枝细腰蜂那样的毒针；三恨其不将被治者造得即使砍去了藏着的思想中枢的脑袋而还能动作——服役。三者得一，阔人的地位即永久稳固，统御也永久省了气力，而天下于是乎太平。今也不然，所以即使单想高高在上，暂时维持阔气，也还得日施手段，夜费心机，实在不胜其委屈劳神之至……。
So our Creator - if there really is such a "master" in the sky - is hateful: one hates that he has not always distinguished between "rulers" and "governed"; second, he hates that he does not give the healer a poisonous needle like a slender-waisted bee; 3. Hate that it does not make the governed, even if the head of the hidden ideological center is cut off, it can still move - serve. If you get one of the three, the position of the broad people will be permanently stable, and the command will permanently save energy, and the world will be peaceful. It's not like that now, so even if you just want to be high and temporarily maintain your generosity, you still have to use means every day and work hard at night, which is really ...... grieved and exhausting.假使没有了头颅，却还能做服役和战争的机械，世上的情形就何等地醒目呵！这时再不必用什么制帽勋章来表明阔人和窄人了，只要一看头之有无，便知道主奴，官民，上下，贵贱的区别。并且也不至于再闹什么革命，共和，会议等等的乱子了，单是电报，就要省下许多许多来。古人毕竟聪明，仿佛早想到过这样的东西，《山海经》上就记载着一种名叫“刑天”的怪物。他没有了能想的头，却还活着，“以乳为目，以脐为口”，——这一点想得很周到，否则他怎么看，怎么吃呢，——实在是很值得奉为师法的。假使我们的国民都能这样，阔人又何等安全快乐？但他又“执干戚而舞”，则似乎还是死也不肯安分，和我那专为阔人图便利而设的理想底好国民又不同。陶潜先生又有诗道：“刑天舞干戚，猛志固常在。”连这位貌似旷达的老隐士也这么说，可见无头也会仍有猛志，阔人的天下一时总怕难得太平的了。但有了太多的“特殊智识阶级”的国民，也许有特在例外的希望；况且精神文明太高了之后，精神的头就会提前飞去，区区物质的头的有无也算不得什么难问题。
If there is no head, but it can still be a machine for service and war, how striking the situation in the world is! At this time, there is no need to use any hat-making medals to indicate the wide and narrow people, as long as you look at the presence or absence of heads, you can know the difference between master and slave, officials and people, up and down, noble and lowly. And there will be no more revolutions, republics, conferences, etc., and the telegraph alone will save a lot. After all, the ancients were smart, as if they had thought of such a thing long ago, and there is a monster called "Xing Tian" recorded in the "Classic of Mountains and Seas". He has no head to think, but he is still alive, "with milk as his eyes, with the navel as his mouth",—— this point is very thoughtful, otherwise how he will see and eat,—— it is really worthy of being a teacher. If our people can do this, how safe and happy are the broad people? But he also "dances with a trunk", and it seems that he still refuses to settle down, which is different from my ideal good citizen who is specially designed for the convenience of broad people. Mr. Tao Qian also has a poem saying: "Xing Tian dances with relatives, and the fierce ambition is always there." Even this seemingly open-minded old hermit said so, it can be seen that there will still be fierce ambition without a head, and the world of broad people is always afraid of being too peaceful for a while. But with too many "special intellectual classes" of the people, there may be hope for exceptions; Moreover, after the spiritual civilization is too high, the spiritual head will fly away in advance, and the existence of a mere material head is not a difficult problem.一九二五年四月二十二日。
April 22, 1925.

灯下漫笔

Under the lamp, I wrote casually一
One有一时，就是民国二三年时候，北京的几个国家银行的钞票，信用日见其好了，真所谓蒸蒸日上。听说连一向执迷于现银的乡下人，也知道这既便当，又可靠，很乐意收受，行使了。至于稍明事理的人，则不必是“特殊知识阶级”，也早不将沉重累坠的银元装在怀中，来自讨无谓的苦吃。想来，除了多少对于银子有特别嗜好和爱情的人物之外，所有的怕大都是钞票了罢，而且多是本国的。但可惜后来忽然受了一个不小的打击。
For a while, in the second and third years of the Republic of China, the banknotes of several national banks in Beijing were getting better and better. I heard that even the countrymen who have always been obsessed with cash know that this is both convenient and reliable, and they are happy to accept and exercise it. As for those who are a little more reasonable, they do not have to be "special intellectual classes", and they have long since put heavy and burdensome silver dollars in their arms to ask for unnecessary hardships. Come to think of it, except for a few people who have a special hobby and love for silver, most of them are banknotes, and most of them are from their own country. But unfortunately, I suddenly suffered a big blow.就是袁世凯想做皇帝的那一年，蔡松坡先生溜出北京，到云南去起义。这边所受的影响之一，是中国和交通银行的停止兑现。虽然停止兑现，政府勒令商民照旧行用的威力却还有的；商民也自有商民的老本领，不说不要，却道找不出零钱。假如拿几十几百的钞票去买东西，我不知道怎样，但倘使只要买一枝笔，一盒烟卷呢，难道就付给一元钞票么？不但不甘心，也没有这许多票。那么，换铜元，少换几个罢，又都说没有铜元。那么，到亲戚朋友那里借现钱去罢，怎么会有？于是降格以求，不讲爱国了，要外国银行的钞票。但外国银行的钞票这时就等于现银，他如果借给你这钞票，也就借给你真的银元了。
It was the year when Yuan Shikai wanted to be emperor, and Mr. Cai Songpo slipped out of Beijing and went to Yunnan to revolt. One of the impacts here is the suspension of cash by China and Bank of Communications. Although the government stopped cashing, the power of the government to order the merchants to act as usual was still there; Merchants also have their own old skills, not saying no, but they can't find change. If I take dozens or hundreds of bills to buy something, I don't know how, but if I only buy a pen and a box of cigarettes, will I pay a one-dollar bill? Not only is it unwilling, but there are not so many votes. Then, change the copper dollar, change a few less, and they all say that there is no copper dollar. So, how can you borrow cash from relatives and friends? So I downgraded to seek no more patriotism, and asked for banknotes from foreign banks. But the banknotes of foreign banks are equivalent to cash at this time, and if he lends you this banknote, he will lend you real silver dollars.我还记得那时我怀中还有三四十元的中交票，可是忽而变了一个穷人，几乎要绝食，很有些恐慌。俄国革命以后的藏着纸卢布的富翁的心情，恐怕也就这样的罢；至多，不过更深更大罢了。我只得探听，钞票可能折价换到现银呢？说是没有行市。幸而终于，暗暗地有了行市了：六折几。我非常高兴，赶紧去卖了一半。后来又涨到七折了，我更非常高兴，全去换了现银，沉垫垫地坠在怀中，似乎这就是我的性命的斤两。倘在平时，钱铺子如果少给我一个铜元，我是决不答应的。
I still remember that I still had thirty or forty yuan in my arms, but suddenly I became a poor person, almost on a hunger strike, and I was a little panicked. After the Russian Revolution, the mood of the rich man who hid the paper ruble was probably like this; At most, it's just deeper and bigger. I have to ask, maybe the banknotes can be discounted for cash? It is said that there is no market. Fortunately, finally, there is a market in the dark: 60% off. I was so happy that I hurried to sell half of it. Later, it rose to 70% off, and I was even more happy, I exchanged it all for cash, and fell into my arms, as if this was the weight of my life. If the money shop gives me one less copper dollar in normal times, I will never agree."但我当一包现银塞在怀中，沉垫垫地觉得安心，喜欢的时候，却突然起了另一思想，就是：我们极容易变成奴隶，而且变了之后，还万分喜欢。
But when I stuffed a bag of cash into my arms and felt at ease and liked it, I suddenly had another thought, that is: it is very easy for us to become slaves, and after we change, we still like it very much.假如有一种暴力，“将人不当人”，不但不当人，还不及牛马，不算什么东西；待到人们羡慕牛马，发生“乱离人，不及太平犬”的叹息的时候，然后给与他略等于牛马的价格，有如元朝定律，打死别人的奴隶，赔一头牛，则人们便要心悦诚服，恭颂太平的盛世。为什么呢？因为他虽不算人，究竟已等于牛马了。
If there is a kind of violence, "treating people as people", not only is it not human, but it is not as good as cattle and horses, and it is nothing; When people envy cattle and horses, and sigh that "chaos is separated, not as good as a peaceful dog", and then give him a price slightly equal to the price of cattle and horses, just like the law of the Yuan Dynasty, killing other people's slaves and losing a cow, then people will be happy and sincerely convinced and praise the prosperity of peace. Why? Because although he is not a human being, he is already equal to a cow and a horse.我们不必恭读《钦定二十四史》，或者入研究室，审察精神文明的高超。只要一翻孩子所读的《鉴略》，——还嫌烦重，则看《历代纪元编》，就知道“三千余年古国古”的中华，历来所闹的就不过是这一个小玩艺。但在新近编纂的所谓“历史教科书”一流东西里，却不大看得明白了，只仿佛说：咱们向来就很好的。
We don't have to read the "Twenty-Four Histories of the Imperial Dynasty" or enter the research room to examine the superb of spiritual civilization. As long as the "Jianlue" read by the child is still too cumbersome ,——, then look at the "Chronicles of the Dynasties", and you will know that the China of "more than 3,000 years of ancient countries" has always been nothing more than this little trick. However, in the newly compiled so-called "history textbooks" first-class things, it is not very clear, as if to say: We have always been very good.但实际上，中国人向来就没有争到过“人”的价格，至多不过是奴隶，到现在还如此，然而下于奴隶的时候，却是数见不鲜的。中国的百姓是中立的，战时连自己也不知道属于那一面，但又属于无论那一面。强盗来了，就属于官，当然该被杀掠；官兵既到，该是自家人了罢，但仍然要被杀掠，仿佛又属于强盗似的。这时候，百姓就希望有一个一定的主子，拿他们去做百姓，——不敢，是拿他们去做牛马，情愿自己寻草吃，只求他决定他们怎样跑。
But in fact, the Chinese have never competed for the price of "people", at most they are just slaves, and they are still like this, but when they are inferior to slaves, it is not uncommon. The Chinese people are neutral, and even they don't know which side they belong to during wartime, but they belong to either side. When the robbers come, they belong to the officials, and of course they should be killed and plundered; When the officers and soldiers arrived, they should be their own families, but they still had to be killed and plundered, as if they belonged to the robbers again. At this time, the people hope to have a certain master, and they do not dare to use them as people,——, but they are willing to use them as cattle and horses, and they are willing to find grass to eat by themselves, just asking him to decide how they run.假使真有谁能够替他们决定，定下什么奴隶规则来，自然就“皇恩浩荡”了。可惜的是往往暂时没有谁能定。举其大者，则如五胡十六国的时候，黄巢的时候，五代时候，宋末元末时候，除了老例的服役纳粮以外，都还要受意外的灾殃。张献忠的脾气更古怪了，不服役纳粮的要杀，服役纳粮的也要杀，敌他的要杀，降他的也要杀：将奴隶规则毁得粉碎。这时候，百姓就希望来一个另外的主子，较为顾及他们的奴隶规则的，无论仍旧，或者新颁，总之是有一种规则，使他们可上奴隶的轨道。
If anyone could decide for them and set what slave rules would be established, it would naturally be "imperial grace". Unfortunately, no one can decide for the time being. For example, during the time of the Five Hu and Sixteen Kingdoms, the Huang Chao period, the Five Dynasties, and the end of the Song Dynasty and the end of the Yuan Dynasty, in addition to the old service and grain payment, they all suffered unexpected disasters. Zhang Xianzhong's temper is even more eccentric, those who do not serve and pay grain must be killed, those who serve and pay grain must be killed, the enemy must be killed, and those who surrender must also be killed: destroy the slave rules to pieces. At this time, the people hoped to come to another master, who would take more into account their slave rules, whether they were still old or newly enacted, in short, there was a rule that would enable them to get on the track of slavery.“时日曷丧，予及汝偕亡！”愤言而已，决心实行的不多见。实际上大概是群盗如麻，纷乱至极之后，就有一个较强，或较聪明，或较狡滑，或是外族的人物出来，较有秩序地收拾了天下。厘定规则：怎样服役，怎样纳粮，怎样磕头，怎样颂圣。而且这规则是不像现在那样朝三暮四的。于是便“万姓胪欢”了；用成语来说，就叫作“天下太平”。
"Time is gone, I will die with you!" It is only indignant, and it is rare to be determined to implement it. In fact, it was probably a group of bandits, and after the chaos reached its peak, a stronger, or smarter, or more cunning, or foreign figure came out and cleaned up the world in a more orderly manner. Determine the rules: how to serve, how to pay grain, how to kowtow, how to praise the saints. And this rule is not as chaotic as it is now. So it was "ten thousand surnames and joys"; In idioms, it is called "peace in the world".任凭你爱排场的学者们怎样铺张，修史时候设些什么“汉族发祥时代”、“汉族发达时代”、“汉族中兴时代”的好题目，好意诚然是可感的，但措辞太绕湾子了。有更其直捷了当的说法在这里——
No matter how extravagant the scholars who love to show off are and set up some good topics such as "the era of the birth of the Han nationality", "the era of the development of the Han nationality", and "the era of the revival of the Han nationality" when revising history, the good intentions are indeed palpable, but the wording is too roundabout. There is a more straightforward statement here-一，想做奴隶而不得的时代；
First, the era when you want to be a slave but can't;二，暂时做稳了奴隶的时代。
Second, the era of temporarily stabilizing slaves.这一种循环，也就是“先儒”之所谓“一治一乱”；那些作乱人物，从后日的“臣民”看来，是给“主子”清道辟路的，所以说：“为圣天子驱除云尔。”
This cycle is the so-called "one rule and one chaos" of the "former Confucians"; Those rebels, from the perspective of the "subjects" in the future, cleared the way for the "master", so they said: "Expel Yun'er for the Holy Son of Heaven." ”现在入了那一时代，我也不了然。但看国学家的崇奉国粹，文学家的赞叹固有文明，道学家的热心复古，可见于现状都已不满了。然而我们究竟正向着那一条路走呢？百姓是一遇到莫名其妙的战争，稍富的迁进租界，妇孺则避入教堂里去了，因为那些地方都比较的“稳”，暂不至于想做奴隶而不得。总而言之，复古的，避难的，无智愚贤不肖，似乎都已神往于三百年前的太平盛世，就是“暂时做稳了奴隶的时代”了。
Now that I have entered that era, I don't know. However, looking at the admiration of Chinese scholars, the admiration of writers for inherent civilization, and the enthusiasm of Taoists for retro, it can be seen that they are dissatisfied with the status quo. But which path are we heading? When the people encountered an inexplicable war, they moved into the concession if they were a little richer, and women and children took refuge in the church, because those places were relatively "stable", and they did not want to be slaves for the time being. All in all, the retro, the refuge, the ignorant, the foolish, the virtuous, and the unworthy all seem to have been fascinated by the peaceful and prosperous era three hundred years ago, which is "the era of temporarily stabilizing slaves".但我们也就都像古人一样，永久满足于“古已有之”的时代么？都像复古家一样，不满于现在，就神往于三百年前的太平盛世么？
But are we all like the ancients, forever satisfied with the era of "what exists in ancient times"? Are they all like retro families, dissatisfied with the present, and fascinated by the peaceful and prosperous era three hundred years ago?自然，也不满于现在的，但是，无须反顾，因为前面还有道路在。而创造这中国历史上未曾有过的第三样时代，则是现在的青年的使命！
Naturally, I am not satisfied with the present, but there is no need to look back, because there is still a road ahead. Creating this third era that has never existed in Chinese history is the mission of today's youth!
