灯下漫笔

Two但是赞颂中国固有文明的人们多起来了，加之以外国人。我常常想，凡有来到中国的，倘能疾首蹙额而憎恶中国，我敢诚意地捧献我的感谢，因为他一定是不愿意吃中国人的肉的！
However, there are more people who praise China's inherent civilization, plus foreigners. I often think that anyone who comes to China, if he can frown and hate China, I dare to sincerely give my thanks, because he must not want to eat Chinese meat!鹤见祐辅氏在《北京的魅力》中，记一个白人将到中国，预定的暂住时候是一年，但五年之后，还在北京，而且不想回去了。有一天，他们两人一同吃晚饭——
In "The Charm of Beijing", Yusuke Tsurumi remembers that a white man was about to go to China, and the scheduled temporary residence was for one year, but five years later, he was still in Beijing and did not want to go back. One day, the two of them had dinner together -“在圆的桃花心木的食桌前坐定，川流不息地献着山海的珍味，谈话就从古董，画，政治这些开头。电灯上罩着支那式的灯罩，淡淡的光洋溢于古物罗列的屋子中。什么无产阶级呀，Proletariat呀那些事，就像不过在什么地方刮风。
Sitting at the round mahogany dining table, the river endlessly offered the delicacies of the mountains and seas, and the conversation began with antiques, paintings, and politics. The electric lamps are covered with Chinese lampshades, and the faint light fills the room with antiquities. What the proletariat, Proletariat, those things are like the wind blowing somewhere.“我一面陶醉在支那生活的空气中，一面深思着对于外人有着‘魅力’的这东西。元人也曾征服支那，而被征服于汉人种的生活美了；满人也征服支那，而被征服于汉人种的生活美了。现在西洋人也一样，嘴里虽然说着Democracy呀，什么什么呀，而却被魅于支那人费六千年而建筑起来的生活的美。一经住过北京，就忘不掉那生活的味道。大风时候的万丈的沙尘，每三月一回的督军们的开战游戏，都不能抹去这支那生活的魅力。”
"While I was intoxicated by the air of life in China, I thought deeply about this thing that had a 'charm' to outsiders. The Yuan people also conquered China, and the life of the Han people was beautiful; The Manchus also conquered China, and the life of the Han people was beautiful. Nowadays, Westerners are the same, although they say Democracy, whatsoever, but they are fascinated by the beauty of the life that the Chinese people have spent 6,000 years to build. Once you live in Beijing, you can't forget the taste of life. The sand and dust in the windy season, and the war game of the overseers every three months, cannot erase the charm of this team. ”这些话我现在还无力否认他。我们的古圣先贤既给与我们保古守旧的格言，但同时也排好了用子女玉帛所做的奉献于征服者的大宴。中国人的耐劳，中国人的多子，都就是办酒的材料，到现在还为我们的爱国者所自诩的。西洋人初入中国时，被称为蛮夷，自不免个个蹙额，但是，现在则时机已至，到了我们将曾经献于北魏，献于金，献于元，献于清的盛宴，来献给他们的时候了。出则汽车，行则保护：虽遇清道，然而通行自由的；虽或被劫，然而必得赔偿的；孙美瑶掳去他们站在军前，还使官兵不敢开火。何况在华屋中享用盛宴呢？待到享受盛宴的时候，自然也就是赞颂中国固有文明的时候；但是我们的有些乐观的爱国者，也许反而欣然色喜，以为他们将要开始被中国同化了罢。古人曾以女人作苟安的城堡，美其名以自欺曰“和亲”，今人还用子女玉帛为作奴的贽敬，又美其名曰“同化”。所以倘有外国的谁，到了已有赴宴的资格的现在，而还替我们诅咒中国的现状者，这才是真有良心的真可佩服的人！
I still can't deny these words. Our ancient sages not only gave us the maxim of preserving the ancient and conservative, but also arranged a banquet for the conquerors made with their children and jade and silk. The hard work of the Chinese and the proud children of the Chinese are all materials for making wine, and they are still proud of our patriots. When Westerners first entered China, they were called barbarians, and they couldn't help but frown, but now the time has come, and it is time for us to dedicate to them the feast that was once dedicated to the Northern Wei Dynasty, to the Jin, to the Yuan, and to the Qing Dynasty. Cars are out, and protection is traveling: although the road is cleared, the passage is free; Although they may be robbed, they must be compensated; Sun Meiyao kidnapped them and stood in front of the army, and made the officers and soldiers dare not fire. Not to mention enjoying a feast in a splendid house? When it comes time to enjoy the feast, it is naturally the time to praise China's inherent civilization; But some of our optimistic patriots may be happy that they are about to begin to be assimilated by China. The ancients used women as castles for Gou'an, and deceived themselves with the name of "marriage", and now people also use their children and jade and silk as a tribute to slavery, and they also call it "assimilation". Therefore, if there is anyone from a foreign country who is qualified to attend the banquet and curses the status quo in China for us, this is a person with a real conscience and a real admiration!但我们自己是早已布置妥帖了，有贵贱，有大小，有上下。自己被人凌虐，但也可以凌虐别人；自己被人吃，但也可以吃别人。一级一级的制驭着，不能动弹，也不想动弹了。因为倘一动弹，虽或有利，然而也有弊。我们且看古人的良法美意罢——
But we ourselves have already been arranged, there are noble and lowly, large and small, up and down. I am abused by others, but I can also abuse others; You are eaten by others, but you can also eat others. I can't move and don't want to move. Because if you move, although it may be beneficial, it also has disadvantages. Let's look at the good laws and good intentions of the ancients——“天有十日，人有十等。下所以事上，上所以共神也。故王臣公，公臣大夫，大夫臣士，士臣皁，皁臣舆，舆臣隶，隶臣僚，僚臣仆，仆臣台。”（《左传》昭公七年）
“天有十日，人有十等。 下所以事上，上所以共神也。 故王臣公，公臣大夫，大夫臣士，士臣皁，皁臣舆，舆臣隶，隶臣僚，僚臣仆，仆臣台。 ”（《左传》昭公七年）但是“台”没有臣，不是太苦了么？无须担心的，有比他更卑的妻，更弱的子在。而且其子也很有希望，他日长大，升而为“台”，便又有更卑更弱的妻子，供他驱使了。如此连环，各得其所，有敢非议者，其罪名曰不安分！
But "Taiwan" has no ministers, isn't it too bitter? There is no need to worry, there is a wife who is lower than him, and a son who is weaker. And his son is also very hopeful, and when he grows up and rises to the "platform", he will have a humble and weaker wife for him to drive. Such a series of people, each in their own right, and anyone who dares to criticize it will be punished with restlessness!虽然那是古事，昭公七年离现在也太辽远了，但“复古家”尽可不必悲观的。太平的景象还在：常有兵燹，常有水旱，可有谁听到大叫唤么？打的打，革的革，可有处士来横议么？对国民如何专横，向外人如何柔媚，不犹是差等的遗风么？中国固有的精神文明，其实并未为共和二字所埋没，只有满人已经退席，和先前稍不同。
Although that is an ancient thing, and Zhao Gong's seven years are too far away from the present, the "retro family" does not need to be pessimistic. The scene of peace is still there: there are often wars, floods and droughts, but who hears the shouts? Fight, fight, revolution, can there be a recluse to discuss it? How domineering to the people and how to be gentle to outsiders, isn't it still a legacy of inferiority? China's inherent spiritual civilization has not actually been buried by the word republic, only the Manchus have withdrawn, which is slightly different from before.因此我们在目前，还可以亲见各式各样的筵宴，有烧烤，有翅席，有便饭，有西餐。但茅檐下也有淡饭，路傍也有残羹，野上也有饿莩；有吃烧烤的身价不资的阔人，也有饿得垂死的每斤八文的孩子（见《现代评论》二十一期）。所谓中国的文明者，其实不过是安排给阔人享用的人肉的筵宴。所谓中国者，其实不过是安排这人肉的筵宴的厨房。不知道而赞颂者是可恕的，否则，此辈当得永远的诅咒！
Therefore, we can also see all kinds of banquets in person, including barbecue, winged mats, light meals, and Western food. But there are light rice under the eaves, scraps on the roadside, and hunger in the fields; There are worthless wealthy people who eat barbecue, and there are children who are starving to death at eight cents per catty (see Modern Review No. 21). The so-called Chinese civilization is actually nothing more than a feast of human flesh arranged for the broad people to enjoy. The so-called Chinese is actually just the kitchen that arranges this feast of human flesh. Those who do not know and praise are forgivable, otherwise, this generation deserves to be cursed forever!外国人中，不知道而赞颂者，是可恕的；占了高位，养尊处优，因此受了蛊惑，昧却灵性而赞叹者，也还可恕的。可是还有两种，其一是以中国人为劣种，只配悉照原来模样，因而故意称赞中国的旧物。其一是愿世间人各不相同以增自己旅行的兴趣，到中国看辫子，到日本看木屐，到高丽看笠子，倘若服饰一样，便索然无味了，因而来反对亚洲的欧化。这些都可憎恶。至于罗素在西湖见轿夫含笑，便赞美中国人，则也许别有意思罢。但是，轿夫如果能对坐轿的人不含笑，中国也早不是现在似的中国了。
Among foreigners, those who do not know and praise are forgivable; Those who occupy high positions, are pampered, and are therefore bewitched, but are ignorant of spirituality and admire are also forgivable. But there are two kinds, one is that the Chinese are inferior, and they only deserve to be as they are, so they deliberately praise China's old things. One is to hope that people in the world will be different to increase their interest in traveling, to see braids in China, clogs in Japan, and hats in Goryeo. These are all abominations. As for Russell's smile when he saw the sedan chairman smiling at West Lake, he praised the Chinese, which may be interesting. However, if the bearer could not smile at the people in the sedan chair, China would no longer be the China it is now.这文明，不但使外国人陶醉，也早使中国一切人们无不陶醉而且至于含笑。因为古代传来而至今还在的许多差别，使人们各各分离，遂不能再感到别人的痛苦；并且因为自己各有奴使别人，吃掉别人的希望，便也就忘却自己同有被奴使被吃掉的将来。于是大小无数的人肉的筵宴，即从有文明以来一直排到现在，人们就在这会场中吃人，被吃，以凶人的愚妄的欢呼，将悲惨的弱者的呼号遮掩，更不消说女人和小儿。
This civilization not only intoxicated foreigners, but also made all people in China intoxicated and smiling. Because of the many differences that came from ancient times and still exist today, people are separated and can no longer feel the pain of others; And because they each have their own hopes of enslaving others and eating others, they forget that they also have a future where they will be enslaved and eaten. Thus, the feast of countless human flesh, large and small, has been arranged from the beginning of civilization to the present, in which people eat and are eaten, and with the foolish cheers of the murderer, the cries of the miserable weak, not to mention women and children.这人肉的筵宴现在还排着，有许多人还想一直排下去。扫荡这些食人者，掀掉这筵席，毁坏这厨房，则是现在的青年的使命！
This feast of human flesh is still lined up, and many people still want to keep lining up. Sweeping away these cannibals, tearing down this banquet, and destroying this kitchen is the mission of today's youth!一九二五年四月二十九日。
April 29, 1925.

Miscellaneous memories1
有人说G. Byron的诗多为青年所爱读，我觉得这话很有几分真。就自己而论，也还记得怎样读了他的诗而心神俱旺；尤其是看见他那花布裹头，去助希腊独立时候的肖像。这像，去年才从《小说月报》传入中国了。可惜我不懂英文，所看的都是译本。听近今的议论，译诗是已经不值一文钱，即使译得并不错。但那时大家的眼界还没有这样高，所以我看了译本，倒也觉得好，或者就因为不懂原文之故，于是便将臭草当作芳兰。《新罗马传奇》中的译文也曾传诵一时，虽然用的是词调，又译Sappho为“萨芷波”，证明着是根据日文译本的重译。
Some say that G. Byron's poems are mostly read by young people, and I think this is very true. As far as I am concerned, I still remember how to read his poems and be full of energy; Especially when I saw his floral cloth wrapped in a cloth to help Greece with its portrait at the time of independence. This is like it was only introduced to China from "Novel Monthly" last year. Unfortunately, I don't understand English, so all I read is the translation. Listening to today's discussions, translated poems are no longer worth a penny, even if they are not well translated. But at that time, everyone's vision was not so high, so I read the translation and felt good, or because I didn't understand the original text, I regarded the stinky grass as a fragrant orchid. The translation in the "New Roman Legend" was also recited for a while, although it used a tone, and Sappho was translated as "Sa Zhi Bo", proving that it was a retranslation from the Japanese translation.苏曼殊先生也译过几首，那时他还没有做诗“寄弹筝人”，因此与Byron也还有缘。但译文古奥得很，也许曾经章太炎先生的润色的罢，所以真像古诗，可是流传倒并不广。后来收入他自印的绿面金签的《文学因缘》中，现在连这《文学因缘》也少见了。
Mr. Su Manshu also translated a few poems, and at that time he had not yet made a poem "The Zheng Man", so he also had a connection with Byron. But the translation is very ancient, maybe it was once polished by Mr. Zhang Taiyan, so it is really like an ancient poem, but it is not widely circulated. Later, it was included in his self-printed "Literary Cause" with a green face and gold seal, and now even this "Literary Cause" is rare.其实，那时Byron之所以比较的为中国人所知，还有别一原因，就是他的助希腊独立。时当清的末年，在一部分中国青年的心中，革命思潮正盛，凡有叫喊复仇和反抗的，便容易惹起感应。那时我所记得的人，还有波兰的复仇诗人Adam Mickiewicz；匈牙利的爱国诗人Peöfi Sändor；飞猎滨的文人而为西班牙政府所杀的厘沙路，——他的祖父还是中国人，中国也曾译过他的绝命诗。Hauptmann，Sudermann，Ibsen这些人虽然正负盛名，我们却不大注意。别有一部分人，则专意搜集明末遗民的著作，满人残暴的记录，钻在东京或其他的图书馆里，抄写出来，印了，输入中国，希望使忘却的旧恨复活，助革命成功。于是《扬州十日记》，《嘉定屠城记略》，《朱舜水集》，《张苍水集》都翻印了，还有《黄萧养回头》及其他单篇的汇集，我现在已经举不出那些名目来。别有一部分人，则改名“扑满”“打清”之类，算是英雄。这些大号，自然和实际的革命不甚相关，但也可见那时对于光复的渴望之心，是怎样的旺盛。
In fact, there was another reason why Byron was known to the Chinese at that time, that is, he helped Greece become independent. At the end of the Qing Dynasty, in the hearts of some Chinese youth, revolutionary ideology was in full swing, and anyone who shouted revenge and resistance was prone to induction. The people I remember at that time were the Polish revenge poet Adam Mickiewicz; Hungarian patriotic poet Peöfi Sändor; Lishalu, a literati who fled to the shore and was killed by the Spanish government,—— his grandfather was still Chinese, and China also translated his desperate poems. Hauptmann, Sudermann, Ibsen, these people are famous, but we don't pay much attention. Some people devoted themselves to collecting the writings of the remnants of the late Ming Dynasty and the brutal records of the Manchus, copying them, printing them, and importing them into China, hoping to resurrect the forgotten old hatred and help the revolution succeed. So "Yangzhou Ten Diaries", "Jiading Massacre Records", "Zhu Shunshui Collection", "Zhang Cangshui Collection" have all been reprinted, as well as "Huang Xiaoyang Returns" and other collections of single articles, I can't name those names now. There are some people who change their names to "pounce full" and "clear up", which are considered heroes. These tubas are naturally not related to the actual revolution, but they also show how vigorous the desire for restoration was at that time.不独英雄式的名号而已，便是悲壮淋漓的诗文，也不过是纸片上的东西，于后来的武昌起义怕没有什么大关系。倘说影响，则别的千言万语，大概都抵不过浅近直截的“革命军马前卒邹容”所做的《革命军》。
Not only is it a heroic name, but it is also a tragic poem, but it is just a piece of paper, and it may not have much to do with the later Wuchang Uprising. If we talk about influence, then thousands of other words are probably not worth the "Revolutionary Army" made by the straightforward "Revolutionary Army Patrol Zou Rong".

杂忆

2
待到革命起来，就大体而言，复仇思想可是减退了。我想，这大半是因为大家已经抱着成功的希望，又服了“文明”的药，想给汉人挣一点面子，所以不再有残酷的报复。但那时的所谓文明，却确是洋文明，并不是国粹；所谓共和，也是美国法国式的共和，不是周召共和的共和。革命党人也大概竭力想给本族增光，所以兵队倒不大抢掠。南京的土匪兵小有劫掠，黄兴先生便勃然大怒，枪毙了许多，后来因为知道土匪是不怕枪毙而怕枭首的，就从死尸上割下头来，草绳络住了挂在树上。从此也不再有什么变故了，虽然我所住的一个机关的卫兵，当我外出时举枪立正之后，就从窗门洞爬进去取了我的衣服，但究竟手段已经平和得多，也客气得多了。
When the revolution broke out, the idea of revenge declined in general. I think this is mostly because everyone has the hope of success, and has taken the medicine of "civilization" and wants to earn a little face for the Han people, so there is no longer cruel retaliation. But the so-called civilization at that time was indeed a foreign civilization, not a national essence; The so-called republic is also a French-style republic in the United States, not a republic in Zhou Zhao Republic. The revolutionaries probably tried their best to add glory to their own people, so the troops did not loot much. Later, because he knew that the bandits were not afraid of being shot and were afraid of beheading, he cut off his head from the corpse and hung it on a tree with a grass rope. Although the guards of one of the agencies where I lived climbed in and took my clothes through the window and door opening after I stood up with my gun when I went out, the methods were much more peaceful and polite.南京是革命政府所在地，当然格外文明。但我去一看先前的满人的驻在处，却是一片瓦砾；只有方孝孺血迹石的亭子总算还在。这里本是明的故宫，我做学生时骑马经过，曾很被顽童骂詈和投石，——犹言你们不配这样，听说向来是如此的。现在却面目全非了，居民寥寥；即使偶有几间破屋，也无门窗；若有门，则是烂洋铁做的。总之，是毫无一点木料。
Nanjing is the seat of the revolutionary government, and of course it is particularly civilized. But when I went to see where the Manchus had been stationed, it was a piece of rubble; Only Fang Xiaoru's bloodstained stone pavilion is still there. This was originally the Forbidden City of the Ming Dynasty, and when I was a student, I rode a horse and was scolded and stoned by urchins,—— and I still said that you are not worthy of this, and I heard that it has always been like this. Now it is unrecognizable, with few residents; Even if there are a few dilapidated houses, there are no doors and windows; If there is a door, it is made of rotten iron. In short, there is no wood at all.那么，城破之时，汉人大大的发挥了复仇手段了么？并不然。知道情形的人告诉我：战争时候自然有些损坏；革命军一进城，旗人中间便有些人定要按古法殉难，在明的冷宫的遗址的屋子里使火药炸裂，以炸杀自己，恰巧一同炸死了几个适从近旁经过的骑兵。革命军以为埋藏地雷反抗了，便烧了一回，可是燹余的房子还不少。此后是他们自己动手，拆屋材出卖，先拆自己的，次拆较多的别人的，待到屋无尺材寸椽，这才大家流散，还给我们一片瓦砾场。——但这是我耳闻的，保不定可是真话。
So, when the city was breached, did the Han people greatly use their revenge methods? Not so. People who know the situation told me that there was naturally some damage during the war; As soon as the revolutionary army entered the city, some of the bannermen were bound to be martyred according to the ancient method, and the gunpowder exploded in the house of the ruins of the Ming Cold Palace to blow themselves up, and happened to kill several cavalrymen who happened to pass by. The revolutionary army thought that the mines had been buried and resisted, so they burned it once, but there were still many houses burned down. After that, they did it themselves, demolished the house materials and sold them, first demolished their own, and then demolished more others' ones, and when the house had no rafters, everyone dispersed and gave us a rubble field. ——But this is what I have heard, and it may be true.看到这样的情形，即使你将《扬州十日记》挂在眼前，也不至于怎样愤怒了罢。据我感得，民国成立以后，汉满的恶感仿佛很是消除了，各省的界限也比先前更其轻淡了。然而“罪孽深重不自殒灭”的中国人，不到一年，情形便又逆转：有宗社党的活动和遗老的谬举而两族的旧史又令人忆起，有袁世凯的手段而南北的交恶加甚，有阴谋家的狡计而省界又被利用，并且此后还要增长起来！
Seeing such a situation, even if you hang the "Ten Diaries of Yangzhou" in front of you, you won't be so angry. As far as I know, after the founding of the Republic of China, the evil feelings of Han Manchuria seemed to have been eliminated, and the boundaries of the provinces were lighter than before. However, the situation of the Chinese, who were "guilty and did not kill themselves", was reversed in less than a year: there were the activities of the Zongshe Party and the fallacies of the elderly, and the old history of the two ethnic groups was reminiscent, and the enmity between the north and the south intensified with Yuan Shikai's methods, and the cunning of conspirators and the provincial borders were used, and they will grow thereafter!

杂忆

3
不知道我的性质特别坏，还是脱不出往昔的环境的影响之故，我总觉得复仇是不足为奇的，虽然也并不想诬无抵抗主义者为无人格。但有时也想：报复，谁来裁判，怎能公平呢？便又立刻自答：自己裁判，自己执行；既没有上帝来主持，人便不妨以目偿头，也不妨以头偿目。有时也觉得宽恕是美德，但立刻也疑心这话是怯汉所发明，因为他没有报复的勇气；或者倒是卑怯的坏人所创造，因为他贻害于人而怕人来报复，便骗以宽恕的美名。
I don't know if my nature is particularly bad, or because I can't escape the influence of the environment in the past, but I always feel that revenge is not surprising, although I don't want to falsely accuse the non-resisters of being impersonal. But sometimes I also think: revenge, who will referee, how can it be fair? Then he immediately answered himself: judge by himself, execute by himself; Since there is no God to preside, people may as well pay their heads with their eyes, or they may as well pay their eyes with their heads. Sometimes he felt that forgiveness was a virtue, but at once he suspected that this word was invented by a coward, because he did not have the courage to retaliate; Or it is created by a cowardly bad person, because he is afraid of retaliation from others, so he deceives the reputation of forgiveness.因此我常常欣慕现在的青年，虽然生于清末，而大抵长于民国，吐纳共和的空气，该不至于再有什么异族轭下的不平之气，和被压迫民族的合辙之悲罢。果然，连大学教授，也已经不解何以小说要描写下等社会的缘故了，我和现代人要相距一世纪的话，似乎有些确凿。但我也不想湔洗，——虽然很觉得惭惶。
Therefore, I often admire the youth of today, although they were born in the late Qing Dynasty, but most of them grew up in the Republic of China, and breathe the air of the republic, so that there should be no more injustice under the yoke of different races and the sorrow of the union of the oppressed nation. Sure enough, even university professors don't understand why novels want to describe lower-class society, and it seems a bit conclusive that I am a century apart from modern people. But I don't want to wash ,—— although I feel very ashamed.当爱罗先珂君在日本未被驱逐之前，我并不知道他的姓名。直到已被放逐，这才看起他的作品来；所以知道那迫辱放逐的情形的，是由于登在《读卖新闻》上的一篇江口涣氏的文字。于是将这译出，还译他的童话，还译他的剧本《桃色的云》。其实，我当时的意思，不过要传播被虐待者的苦痛的呼声和激发国人对于强权者的憎恶和愤怒而已，并不是从什么“艺术之宫”里伸出手来，拔了海外的奇花瑶草，来移植在华国的艺苑。
I didn't know his name until he was expelled from Japan. It was not until he was banished that he looked at his works; Therefore, the situation of forced humiliation and exile is known because of an article by Mr. Huan Eguchi published in the "Yomiuri Shimbun". So he translated this, translated his fairy tales, and also translated his script "Peach Clouds". In fact, what I meant at the time was just to spread the pain of the abused and arouse the hatred and anger of the Chinese people against the powerful, not to reach out from some "palace of art" and pull out the strange flowers and Yao grass from overseas to transplant them to the art garden in China.日文的《桃色的云》出版时，江口氏的文章也在，可是已被检查机关（警察厅？）删节得很多。我的译文是完全的，但当这剧本印成本子时，却没有印上去。因为其时我又见了别一种情形，起了别一种意见，不想在中国人的愤火上，再添薪炭了。
When the Japanese version of "Peach Clouds" was published, Mr. Eguchi's article was also there, but it had been published by the inspection agency (National Police Agency?). A lot of abridgements. My translation was complete, but when the script was printed, it was not printed. Because at that time, I saw another situation and had a different opinion, and I didn't want to add fuel to the anger of the Chinese.

杂忆

4
孔老先生说过：“毋友不如己者。”其实这样的势利眼睛，现在的世界上还多得很。我们自己看看本国的模样，就可知道不会有什么友人的了，岂但没有友人，简直大半都曾经做过仇敌。不过仇甲的时候，向乙等候公论，后来仇乙的时候，又向甲期待同情，所以片段的看起来，倒也似乎并不是全世界都是怨敌。但怨敌总常有一个，因此每一两年，爱国者总要鼓舞一番对于敌人的怨恨与愤怒。
Mr. Kong Lao said: "Do not have friends who are inferior to yourself." In fact, there are many such snobbish eyes in the world now. If we look at the appearance of our own country, we will know that there will be no friends, not only no friends, but most of them have been enemies. However, when he hated A, he waited for public opinion from B, and later when he hated B, he expected sympathy from A, so the clip did not seem to be a grudge in the whole world. But there is always one enemy, so every year or two, patriots always have to encourage resentment and anger towards the enemy.这也是现在极普通的事情，此国将与彼国为敌的时候，总得先用了手段，煽起国民的敌忾心来，使他们一同去扞御或攻击。但有一个必要的条件，就是：国民是勇敢的。因为勇敢，这才能勇往直前，肉搏强敌，以报仇雪恨。假使是怯弱的人民，则即使如何鼓舞，也不会有面临强敌的决心；然而引起的愤火却在，仍不能不寻一个发泄的地方，这地方，就是眼见得比他们更弱的人民，无论是同胞或是异族。
This is also a very common thing now, when this country will be an enemy of another country, it must first use means to incite the hostility of the people, so that they can resist or attack together. But there is a necessary condition, that is, the people are brave. Because of bravery, we can move forward bravely, fight strong enemies hand-to-hand, and avenge our hatred. If it is a cowardly people, no matter how much they are encouraged, they will not have the determination to face a strong enemy; However, the anger aroused was there, and they still had to find a place to vent, which was to see the people who were weaker than them, whether they were compatriots or foreigners.我觉得中国人所蕴蓄的怨愤已经够多了，自然是受强者的蹂躏所致的。但他们却不很向强者反抗，而反在弱者身上发泄，兵和匪不相争，无枪的百姓却并受兵匪之苦，就是最近便的证据。再露骨地说，怕还可以证明这些人的卑怯。卑怯的人，即使有万丈的愤火，除弱草以外，又能烧掉甚么呢？
I think the Chinese have accumulated enough resentment, which is naturally caused by the ravages of the strong. But they do not resist the strong, but vent on the weak, soldiers and bandits do not fight, but the people without guns suffer from soldiers and bandits, which is the recent evidence. If you say it more explicitly, I am afraid it can also prove the cowardice of these people. Even if a cowardly person has a great anger, what can he burn except weak grass?或者要说，我们现在所要使人愤恨的是外敌，和国人不相干，无从受害。可是这转移是极容易的，虽曰国人，要借以泄愤的时候，只要给与一种特异的名称，即可放心剚刃。先前则有异端，妖人，奸党，逆徒等类名目，现在就可用国贼，汉奸，二毛子，洋狗或洋奴。庚子年的义和团捉住路人，可以任意指为教徒，据云这铁证是他的神通眼已在那人的额上看出一个“十”字。
In other words, what we want to make people hate now is foreign enemies, which have nothing to do with the Chinese people and cannot be harmed. But this transfer is extremely easy, although the Chinese people, when they want to vent their anger, as long as they are given a special name, they can rest assured to cut the blade. Previously, there were heretics, demons, traitors, traitors, traitors and other names, but now they can be used as national traitors, traitors, two hairy children, foreign dogs or foreign slaves. The Boxers in the year of Gengzi caught passers-by and could be arbitrarily referred to as believers, and it is said that this ironclad evidence is that his supernatural eyes have seen a "ten" on the man's forehead.然而我们在“毋友不如己者”的世上，除了激发自己的国民，使他们发些火花，聊以应景之外，又有什么良法呢。可是我根据上述的理由，更进一步而希望于点火的青年的，是对于群众，在引起他们的公愤之余，还须设法注入深沉的勇气，当鼓舞他们的感情的时候，还须竭力启发明白的理性；而且还得偏重于勇气和理性，从此继续地训练许多年。这声音，自然断乎不及大叫宣战杀贼的大而闳，但我以为却是更紧要而更艰难伟大的工作。
However, in a world where "no friends are inferior to ourselves", what good way is there other than stimulating our own people, making them spark some sparks, and chatting about the situation? But on the basis of the above reasons, I hope to go a step further and hope for the young people who are igniting the fire, that in addition to arousing their public indignation, we must also try to inject deep courage into them, and when stirring up their feelings, we must also strive to inspire clear reason; And you have to focus on courage and reason, and continue to train for many years. This voice is naturally not as loud and loud as shouting war to kill thieves, but I thought it was a more important and difficult and great work.否则，历史指示过我们，遭殃的不是什么敌手而是自己的同胞和子孙。那结果，是反为敌人先驱，而敌人就做了这一国的所谓强者的胜利者，同时也就做了弱者的恩人。因为自己先已互相残杀过了，所蕴蓄的怨愤都已消除，天下也就成为太平的盛世。
Otherwise, history has shown us that it is not our enemies who suffer but our own compatriots and descendants. The result is that he is the forerunner of the enemy, and the enemy becomes the victor of the so-called strong of this country, and at the same time the benefactor of the weak. Because they have killed each other before, the resentment they have accumulated has been eliminated, and the world will become a peaceful and prosperous era.总之，我以为国民倘没有智，没有勇，而单靠一种所谓“气”，实在是非常危险的。现在，应该更进而着手于较为坚实的工作了。
In short, I think that if the people have no wisdom or courage, and rely only on a so-called "qi", it is really very dangerous. Now, it is time to go further and start with more solid work.一九二五年六月十六日。

It is true that we must dare to face up to it, so that we can dare to think, dare to speak, dare to do, and dare to be. If you don't dare to face it, what kind of climate can it become? However, the pain caused by one's own contradictions or social defects, although not faced head-on, has to be suffered. It seems that some people have long been dissatisfied with whether literati are sensitive figures, but when the crisis is about to reveal their flaws, they always say "nothing happens" and close their eyes at the same time. This closed eye sees that everything is complete, and the current pain is nothing more than "the great responsibility of heaven will be given to people, and they will first suffer their minds, work their muscles and bones, starve their bodies, empty their bodies, and mess up their actions." So there are no problems, no defects, no injustices, no solutions, no reforms, no resistance. Because everything must be "reunited", we don't need to be anxious; Drink tea with confidence and sleep well. If you talk nonsense, you will be blamed for being "out of place" and will inevitably be corrected by university professors. Bah!我并未实验过，但有时候想：倘将一位久蛰洞房的老太爷抛在夏天正午的烈日底下，或将不出闺门的千金小姐拖到旷野的黑夜里，大概只好闭了眼睛，暂续他们残存的旧梦，总算并没有遇到暗或光，虽然已经是绝不相同的现实。中国的文人也一样，万事闭眼睛，聊以自欺，而且欺人，那方法是：瞒和骗。
I have not experimented, but sometimes I think: if an old lady who has been dormant in the bridal chamber for a long time is left under the scorching sun at noon in summer, or if the daughter who does not leave the boudoir is dragged into the dark night of the wilderness, I will probably have to close my eyes and temporarily continue their remaining old dreams, and finally I will not encounter darkness or light, although it is already a reality that is by no means the same. The Chinese literati are the same, closing their eyes in everything, talking about self-deception, and deceiving others, that method: concealment and deception.中国婚姻方法的缺陷，才子佳人小说作家早就感到了，他于是使一个才子在壁上题诗，一个佳人便来和，由倾慕——现在就得称恋爱——而至于有“终身之约”。但约定之后，也就有了难关。我们都知道，“私订终身”在诗和戏曲或小说上尚不失为美谈（自然只以与终于中状元的男人私订为限），实际却不容于天下的，仍然免不了要离异。明末的作家便闭上眼睛，并这一层也加以补救了，说是：才子及第，奉旨成婚。“父母之命媒妁之言”经这大帽子来一压，便成了半个铅钱也不值，问题也一点没有了。假使有之，也只在才子的能否中状元，而决不在婚姻制度的良否。
The flaws of the Chinese marriage method have long been felt by the writer of talented and beautiful novels, so he made a talented man inscribe a poem on the wall, and a beautiful woman came to reconcile, from admiration - now it must be called love - and to a "lifelong contract". But after the agreement, there were difficulties. We all know that "private engagement for life" is still a beautiful talk in poetry, opera or novels (naturally only limited to private engagement with a man who finally won the championship), but in reality, it is not tolerated by the world, and divorce is still inevitable. The writers of the late Ming Dynasty closed their eyes and remedied this layer as well, saying: The talent passed the exam and was ordered to get married. "The words of the matchmaker of the parents' life" are pressed by this big hat, and it becomes half a lead coin that is not worth it, and the problem is gone at all. If there is, it is only in the ability of the talent to win the championship, and by no means in the quality of the marriage system.（近来有人以为新诗人的做诗发表，是在出风头，引异性；且迁怒于报章杂志之滥登。殊不知即使无报，墙壁实“古已有之”，早做过发表机关了；据《封神演义》，纣王已曾在女娲庙壁上题诗，那起源实在非常之早。报章可以不取白话，或排斥小诗，墙壁却拆不完，管不及的；倘一律刷成黑色，也还有破磁可划，粉笔可书，真是穷于应付。做诗不刻木板，去藏之名山，却要随时发表，虽然很有流弊，但大概是难以杜绝的罢。）
(Recently, some people think that the publication of poetry by new poets is in the limelight and attracting the opposite sex; And he vented his anger on the excessive publication of newspapers and magazines. As everyone knows, even if there is no newspaper, the wall is actually "ancient and existent", and it has long been a publishing organ; According to the "Romance of the Gods", King Zhou has inscribed poems on the wall of the Nuwa Temple, and the origin is very early. Newspapers can not take the vernacular, or reject small poems, but the walls cannot be dismantled, and they cannot be controlled; If they are all painted black, there are still magnetism to scratch and chalk to write, which is really difficult to cope with. Writing poetry without carving wooden boards, going to hidden famous mountains, but publishing at any time, although it is very corrupt, it is probably difficult to eliminate. ）《红楼梦》中的小悲剧，是社会上常有的事，作者又是比较的敢于实写的，而那结果也并不坏。无论贾氏家业再振，兰桂齐芳，即宝玉自己，也成了个披大红猩猩毡斗篷的和尚。和尚多矣，但披这样阔斗篷的能有几个，已经是“入圣超凡”无疑了。至于别的人们，则早在册子里一一注定，末路不过是一个归结：是问题的结束，不是问题的开头。读者即小有不安，也终于奈何不得。然而后来或续或改，非借尸还魂，即冥中另配，必令“生旦当场团圆”，才肯放手者，乃是自欺欺人的瘾太大，所以看了小小骗局，还不甘心，定须闭眼胡说一通而后快。赫克尔（E. Haeckel）说过：人和人之差，有时比类人猿和原人之差还远。我们将《红楼梦》的续作者和原作者一比较，就会承认这话大概是确实的。
The small tragedy in "Dream of Red Mansions" is a common thing in society, and the author dares to write it truthfully, and the result is not bad. No matter how the Jia family business revitalizes, Lan Gui Qifang, that is, Baoyu himself, has also become a monk wearing a gorilla felt cloak. There are many monks, but there are only a few who wear such a wide cloak, and there is no doubt that they are already "saints and extraordinary". As for other people, it is predestined one by one in the booklet, and the end is just a conclusion: it is the end of the problem, not the beginning of the problem. Even if the reader is a little uneasy, he can't help it in the end. However, later it was continued or changed, either borrowing the corpse to return to the soul, that is, another match in the underworld, and it must be "reunited on the spot", so those who were willing to let go were too addicted to self-deception, so after watching a small scam, they were not reconciled, and they had to close their eyes and talk nonsense. E. Haeckel) said: The difference between humans and humans is sometimes farther than the difference between great apes and primitive humans. If we compare the sequel to "Dream of Red Mansions" with the original author, we will admit that this is probably true.“作善降祥”的古训，六朝人本已有些怀疑了，他们作墓志，竟会说“积善不报，终自欺人”的话。但后来的昏人，却又瞒起来。元刘信将三岁痴儿抛入纸火盆，妄希福祐，是见于《元典章》的；剧本《小张屠焚儿救母》却道是为母延命，命得延，儿亦不死了。一女愿侍痼疾之夫，《醒世恒言》中还说终于一同自杀的；后来改作的却道是有蛇坠入药罐里，丈夫服后便全愈了。凡有缺陷，一经作者粉饰，后半便大抵改观，使读者落诬妄中，以为世间委实尽够光明，谁有不幸，便是自作，自受。
The people of the Six Dynasties were already a little suspicious of the ancient motto of "doing good deeds and bringing good fortune", and when they wrote epitaphs, they would actually say "accumulate good deeds and never repay them, and eventually deceive others". But the faint people who came later hid it again. Yuan Liu Xin threw the three-year-old fool into the paper brazier, hoping for blessings, which is seen in the "Yuan Dianzhang"; The script "Xiao Zhang Slaughtered and Burned the Child to Save His Mother" said that it was to prolong his mother's life, and his life was extended, and the child did not die. A woman is willing to serve her husband with a chronic illness, and it is said in "Awakening the World" that they finally committed suicide together; Later, it was changed to say that a snake fell into the medicine jar, and the husband was completely healed after taking it. Whenever there are flaws, once the author whitewashes them, the second half of them will largely change, making the reader fall into the delusion, thinking that the truth in the world is bright enough, and whoever has misfortune is self-inflicted and self-inflicted.有时遇到彰明的史实，瞒不下，如关羽岳飞的被杀，便只好别设骗局了。一是前世已造夙因，如岳飞；一是死后使他成神，如关羽。定命不可逃，成神的善报更满人意，所以杀人者不足责，被杀者也不足悲，冥冥中自有安排，使他们各得其所，正不必别人来费力了。
Sometimes when encountering clear historical facts, they can't hide it, such as the killing of Guan Yu and Yue Fei, so they have to set up a scam. First, the previous life has created the cause of the past, such as Yue Fei; One is to make him a god after death, such as Guan Yu. There is no escape from fate, and the good reward of becoming a god is more satisfactory, so the murderer is not to blame, and the killed are not sad.中国人的不敢正视各方面，用瞒和骗，造出奇妙的逃路来，而自以为正路。在这路上，就证明着国民性的怯弱，懒惰，而又巧滑。一天一天的满足着，即一天一天的堕落着，但却又觉得日见其光荣。在事实上，亡国一次，即添加几个殉难的忠臣，后来每不想光复旧物，而只去赞美那几个忠臣；遭劫一次，即造成一群不辱的烈女，事过之后，也每每不思惩凶，自卫，却只顾歌咏那一群烈女。仿佛亡国遭劫的事，反而给中国人发挥“两间正气”的机会，增高价值，即在此一举，应该一任其至，不足忧悲似的。自然，此上也无可为，因为我们已经借死人获得最上的光荣了。沪汉烈士的追悼会中，活的人们在一块很可景仰的高大的木主下互相打骂，也就是和我们的先辈走着同一的路。
Chinese people do not dare to face up to all aspects, and use concealment and deception to create wonderful escape routes, but think they are the right way. On this road, it proves that the national character is timid, lazy, and slippery. Day by day, I am satisfied, that is, I am falling day by day, but I feel that I am seeing its glory day by day. In fact, once the country was destroyed, several martyred loyal ministers were added, and later they did not want to restore the old things, but only praised those loyal ministers; After being robbed, he often did not think about punishing the murderer and defending himself, but only sang about the group of martyrs. It seems that the subjugation of the country and the robbery of the country has given the Chinese the opportunity to play the "two righteousness" and increase the value, that is, in this move, it should be left to its own devices, as if there is no need to worry or be sad. Naturally, there is nothing to be done about this, because we have already obtained the highest glory through the dead. At the memorial service for the martyrs of Shanghai and Han, the living people beat and scolded each other under a tall wooden master that was very admirable, that is, they walked the same path as our ancestors.文艺是国民精神所发的火光，同时也是引导国民精神的前途的灯火。这是互为因果的，正如麻油从芝麻榨出，但以浸芝麻，就使它更油。倘以油为上，就不必说；否则，当参入别的东西，或水或硷去。中国人向来因为不敢正视人生，只好瞒和骗，由此也生出瞒和骗的文艺来，由这文艺，更令中国人更深地陷入瞒和骗的大泽中，甚而至于已经自己不觉得。世界日日改变，我们的作家取下假面，真诚地，深入地，大胆地看取人生并且写出他的血和肉来的时候早到了；早就应该有一片崭新的文场，早就应该有几个凶猛的闯将！
Literature and art are the fire emitted by the national spirit, and it is also the light that guides the future of the national spirit. This is mutually causal, just as sesame oil is squeezed out of sesame seeds, but soaking sesame seeds makes it more oily. If oil is the best, there is no need to say it; Otherwise, it should be mixed with something else, either water or alkali. Chinese people have always had to hide and deceive because they did not dare to face up to life, which also gave birth to the literature and art of concealment and deception, and this literature and art made the Chinese fall deeper into the great marsh of concealment and deception, and even did not feel it themselves. The world is changing day by day, and the time has come for our writer to take off his mask, look at life sincerely, deeply, boldly and write about his flesh and blood; There should have been a brand new literary field a long time ago, and there should have been a few fierce breakers!现在，气象似乎一变，到处听不见歌吟花月的声音了，代之而起的是铁和血的赞颂。然而倘以欺瞒的心，用欺瞒的嘴，则无论说A和O，或Y和Z，一样是虚假的；只可以吓哑了先前鄙薄花月的所谓批评家的嘴，满足地以为中国就要中兴。可怜他在“爱国”的大帽子底下又闭上了眼睛了——或者本来就闭着。
Now, the weather seems to have changed, and the sound of singing flowers and moons can no longer be heard everywhere, replaced by the praise of iron and blood. However, if you use a deceitful heart and a deceitful mouth, then whether you say A and O, or Y and Z, it is false; It can only scare the mouths of the so-called critics who previously despised Hua Yue, and contentedly think that China is about to revive. It's a pity that he closed his eyes again under the big hat of "patriotism" - or he was closed.没有冲破一切传统思想和手法的闯将，中国是不会有真的新文艺的。
Without breaking through all traditional ideas and techniques, China will not have real new literature and art.一九二五年七月二十二日。
July 22, 1925.

从胡须说到牙齿

From beards to teeth1
一翻《呐喊》，才又记得我曾在中华民国九年双十节的前几天做过一篇《头发的故事》；去年，距今快要一整年了罢，那时是《语丝》出世未久，我又曾为它写了一篇《说胡须》。实在似乎很有些章士钊之所谓“每况愈下”了，——自然，这一句成语，也并不是章士钊首先用错的，但因为他既以擅长旧学自居，我又正在给他打官司，所以就栽在他身上。当时就听说，——或者也是时行的“流言”，——一位北京大学的名教授就愤慨过，以为从胡须说起，一直说下去，将来就要说到屁股，则于是乎便和上海的《晶报》一样了。为什么呢？这须是熟精今典的人们才知道，后进的“束发小生”是不容易了然的。因为《晶报》上曾经登过一篇《太阳晒屁股赋》，屁股和胡须又都是人身的一部分，既说此部，即难免不说彼部，正如看见洗脸的人，敏捷而聪明的学者即能推见他一直洗下去，将来一定要洗到屁股。所以有志于做gentleman者，为防微杜渐起见，应该在背后给一顿奚落的。——如果说此外还有深意，那我可不得而知了。
When I flipped through "The Scream", I remembered that I had done a "Hair Story" a few days before the Double Tenth Festival of the Republic of China; Last year, almost a whole year ago, not long after the birth of "Yusi", I wrote a "Talking Beard" for it. It really seems that there is a lot of Zhang Shizhao's so-called "deterioration",—— Naturally, this idiom was not the first thing Zhang Shizhao used wrong, but because he claims to be good at old learning, and I am fighting a lawsuit for him, so I planted it on him. At that time,—— I heard that it was also Shixing's "rumor",—— a famous professor at Peking University was indignant, thinking that if you start with a beard and keep talking, you will talk about the buttocks in the future, so it will be the same as Shanghai's "Jingbao". Why? This must be known to people who are proficient in modern classics that it is not easy to understand the "bundled hair". Because there was an article in the "Crystal News" called "The Sun Bass the Buttocks", the buttocks and beard are both part of the human body, and it is inevitable not to talk about the other part, just as when he sees a person washing his face, an agile and intelligent scholar can infer that he has been washing his buttocks and must wash his buttocks in the future. Therefore, those who aspire to be gentlemen should be ridiculed behind their backs in order to prevent minor changes. ——If there is a deeper meaning, then I don't know.昔者窃闻之：欧美的文明人讳言下体以及和下体略有渊源的事物。假如以生殖器为中心而画一正圆形，则凡在圆周以内者均在讳言之列；而圆之半径，则美国者大于英。中国的下等人，是不讳言的；古之上等人似乎也不讳，所以虽是公子而可以名为黑臀。讳之始，不知在什么时候；而将英美的半径放大，直至于口鼻之间或更在其上，则昉于一千九百二十四年秋。
In the past, I heard that civilized people in Europe and the United States avoided talking about the lower body and things that had something to do with the lower body. If a regular circle is drawn with the genitals as the center, then everything within the circumference is included in the taboo; The radius of the circle is larger in the United States than in the United Kingdom. China's inferior people are not shy about it; In ancient times, the upper class did not seem to be hidden, so even though he was a young man, he could be called a black buttock. The beginning of the taboo, I don't know when; The radius of Britain and America was enlarged to the area between the mouth and nose or even above it, in the autumn of 1924.文人墨客大概是感性太锐敏了之故罢，向来就很娇气，什么也给他说不得，见不得，听不得，想不得。道学先生于是乎从而禁之，虽然很像背道而驰，其实倒是心心相印。然而他们还是一看见堂客的手帕或者姨太太的荒冢就要做诗。我现在虽然也弄弄笔墨做做白话文，但才气却仿佛早经注定是该在“水平线”之下似的，所以看见手帕或荒冢之类，倒无动于中；只记得在解剖室里第一次要在女性的尸体上动刀的时候，可似乎略有做诗之意，——但是，不过“之意”而已，并没有诗，读者幸勿误会，以为我有诗集将要精装行世，传之其人，先在此预告。后来，也就连“之意”都没有了，大约是因为见惯了的缘故罢，正如下等人的说惯一样。否则，也许现在不但不敢说胡须，而且简直非“人之初性本善论”或“天地玄黄赋”便不屑做。遥想土耳其革命后，撕去女人的面幕，是多么下等的事？呜呼，她们已将嘴巴露出，将来一定要光着屁股走路了！
Literati and writers are probably too sensitive, and they have always been very squeamish, and they can't tell him anything, see, hear, or think. Mr. Taoism thus banned it, although it was very similar to going against the way, but in fact it was heart-to-heart. However, they still want to write poetry as soon as they see the handkerchief of the guest or the desolate tomb of the aunt. Although I am now also playing with pen and ink to write vernacular texts, my talent seems to be destined to be below the "horizon line", so when I see handkerchiefs or deserted graves, I am not moved; I only remember that when I was going to use the knife on a woman's corpse for the first time in the dissection room, it seemed to have a slight meaning of poetry,—— but it was just a "meaning", there was no poem, readers should not misunderstand, thinking that I had a collection of poems that was going to be published in hardcover, and I would pass it on to him, so I will announce it here first. Later, there was not even a "meaning", probably because of the habit of seeing it, just as the lower class people were used to. Otherwise, maybe not only do I dare not talk about beards now, but I simply disdain to do it if it is not "the theory of the original goodness of human nature" or "the mysterious yellow fu of heaven and earth". Thinking about how despicable it is to tear off women's faces after the Turkish Revolution? Oh, they have already exposed their mouths, and they must walk barefoot in the future!

虽然有人数我为“无病呻吟”党之一，但我以为自家有病自家知，旁人大概是不很能够明白底细的。倘没有病，谁来呻吟？如果竟要呻吟，那就已经有了呻吟病了，无法可医。——但模仿自然又是例外。即如自胡须直至屁股等辈，倘使相安无事，谁爱去纪念它们；我们平居无事时，从不想到自己的头，手，脚以至脚底心。待到慨然于“头颅谁斫”，“髀肉（又说下去了，尚希绅士淑女恕之）复生”的时候，是早已别有缘故的了，所以，“呻吟”。而批评家们曰：“无病。”我实在艳羡他们的健康。
Although there are people who say that I am one of the "moaning without illness" party, I think that I know that I am sick, and others probably cannot understand the details. If you are not sick, who will moan? If you want to moan, you already have a moaning disease that cannot be treated. ——But imitation is an exception. That is, from the beard to the buttocks, if there is nothing to do, who loves to commemorate them; When we have nothing to do, we never think about our heads, hands, feet or even the soles of our feet. When it comes to "who cut off the head" and "the thigh meat (and the gentlemen and ladies forgive it) are resurrected", there is already another reason, so "moaning". But critics said, "It's not a problem." "I really envy their health.譬如腋下和胯间的毫毛，向来不很肇祸，所以也没有人引为题目，来呻吟一通。头发便不然了，不但白发数茎，能使老先生揽镜慨然，赶紧拔去；清初还因此杀了许多人。民国既经成立，辫子总算剪定了，即使保不定将来要翻出怎样的花样来，但目下总不妨说是已经告一段落。于是我对于自己的头发，也就淡然若忘，而况女子应否剪发的问题呢，因为我并不预备制造桂花油或贩卖烫剪：事不干己，是无所容心于其间的。但到民国九年，寄住在我的寓里的一位小姐考进高等女子师范学校去了，而她是剪了头发的，再没有法可梳盘龙髻或S髻。到这时，我才知道虽然已是民国九年，而有些人之嫉视剪发的女子，竟和清朝末年之嫉视剪发的男子相同；校长M先生虽被天夺其魄，自己的头顶秃到近乎精光了，却偏以为女子的头发可系千钧，示意要她留起。设法去疏通了几回，没有效，连我也听得麻烦起来，于是乎“感慨系之矣”了，随口呻吟了一篇《头发的故事》。但是，不知怎的，她后来竟居然并不留长，现在还是蓬蓬松松的在北京道上走。
For example, the hair between the armpits and the crotch has never caused much trouble, so no one has cited it as a topic to moan. The hair is not like that, not only a few white hairs, but also a few strands of white hair, which can make the old gentleman look in the mirror and quickly pull it out; In the early Qing Dynasty, many people were killed because of this. At this time, I realized that although it was the ninth year of the Republic of China, some people were jealous of women who cut their hair, and they were the same as the men who were jealous of cutting their hair at the end of the Qing Dynasty; Although the principal, Mr. M, was robbed by the heavens and the top of his head was almost bald, he thought that the woman's hair could be tied up, and signaled her to keep it. Solid wall purification of the wilderness新近，我在中国社会上发现了几样主义。其一，是坚壁清野主义。
Recently, I have discovered several doctrines in Chinese society. First, it is a strong wall and a barbarism.“坚壁清野”是兵家言，兵家非我的素业，所以这话不是从兵家得来，乃是从别的书上看来，或社会上听来的。听说这回的欧洲战争时最要紧的是壕堑战，那么，虽现在也还使用着这战法——坚壁。至于清野，世界史上就有着有趣的事例：相传十九世纪初拿破仑进攻俄国，到了墨斯科时，俄人便大发挥其清野手段，同时在这地方纵火，将生活所需的东西烧个干净，请拿破仑和他的雄兵猛将在空城里吸西北风。吸不到一个月，他们便退走了。
"Strengthening the wall and clearing the wilderness" is the saying of the soldiers, and the soldiers are not my profession, so this word is not from the soldiers, but from other books or heard in society. I heard that the most important thing in this European war was trench warfare, so although this tactic is still used - strong walls. As for clearing the wilderness, there are interesting examples in world history: it is said that Napoleon attacked Russia at the beginning of the 19th century, and when he arrived in Mexico, the Russians used their means of clearing the wilderness, and at the same time set fire to this place to burn the things needed for life, and asked Napoleon and his soldiers to suck the northwest wind in the empty city. Within a month of smoking, they retreated.中国虽说是儒教国，年年祭孔；“俎豆之事，则尝闻之矣，军旅之事，丘未之学也。”但上上下下却都使用着这兵法；引导我看出来的是本月的报纸上的一条新闻。据说，教育当局因为公共娱乐场中常常发生有伤风化情事，所以令行各校，禁止女学生往游艺场和公园；并通知女生家属，协同禁止。自然，我并不深知这事是否确实；更未见明令的原文；也不明白教育当局之意，是因为娱乐场中的“有伤风化”情事，即从女生发生，所以不许其去，还是只要女生不去，别人也不发生，抑或即使发生，也就管他妈的了。
Although China is a Confucian country, it worships Confucius every year; "I have heard about the sacrificial vessels, but I have not learned about military affairs." But this art of war is used up and down; What led me to see was a news in this month's newspaper. It is said that the education authorities ordered all schools to prohibit female students from going to amusement parks and parks because of the frequent incidents of sexual misconduct in public casinos. And notify the girl's family to cooperate with the ban. Naturally, I don't know if this is true; There is no original text of the explicit order; I don't understand the meaning of the education authorities, because the "indecent" situation in the casino happens, that is, it happens from the girl, so it is not allowed to go, or as long as the girl does not go, others will not happen, or even if it happens, it will be fucked.或者后一种的推测庶几近之。我们的古哲和今贤，虽然满口“正本清源”，“澄清天下”，但大概是有口无心的，“未有己不正，而能正人者”，所以结果是：收起来。第一，是“以己之心，度人之心”，想专以“不见可欲，使民心不乱”。第二，是器宇只有这么大，实在并没有“澄清天下”之才，正如富翁唯一的经济法，只有将钱埋在自己的地下一样。古圣人所教的“慢藏诲盗，冶容诲淫”，就是说子女玉帛的处理方法，是应该坚壁清野的。
Or the latter kind of speculation is almost like that. Although our ancient philosophers and modern sages are full of "clarifying the source" and "clarifying the world", they are probably unintentional, "those who are not right, but can correct others", so the result is: put it away. First, it is to "measure people's hearts with one's own heart", and want to focus on "not seeing what is desired, so that the people's hearts are not confused". Second, the instrument is only so big, and there is really no talent to "clarify the world", just like the only economic law of the rich is to bury money in their own ground. The ancient sages taught "slow hiding and teaching theft, smiling and teaching lust", that is to say, the treatment of children's jade and silk should be firmly cleared.其实这种方法，中国早就奉行的了，我所到过的地方，除北京外，一路大抵只看见男人和卖力气的女人，很少见所谓上流妇女。但我先在此声明，我之不满于这种现象者，并非因为预备遍历中国，去窃窥一切太太小姐们；我并没有积下一文川资，就是最确的证据。今年是“流言”鼎盛时代，稍一不慎，《现代评论》上就会弯弯曲曲地登出来的，所以特地先行预告。至于一到名儒，则家里的男女也不给容易见面，霍渭厓的《家训》里，就有那非常麻烦的分隔男女的房子构造图。似乎有志于圣贤者，便是自己的家里也应该看作游艺场和公园；现在究竟是二十世纪，而且有“少负不羁之名，长习自由之说”的教育总长，实在宽大得远了。

Beijing does not imprison women much, and it is not a place to insult when walking outside, but this is contrary to the intention of our ancient philosophers and modern sages, or this atmosphere is imported by the Manchurians. To weather well is to liberate human nature and popularize education, especially sex education, which is exactly what educators should do. Moreover, things in society are not as simple as prisons, and after building the Great Wall, the Hu people still come in a steady stream, and the deep ditches and high walls are useless. Before the amusement park and park, the ladies did not go out, and the little girls also visited the temple fair and watched the festival, who can say that there are more "indecent" affairs than the high-ranking families?总之，社会不改良，“收起来”便无用，以“收起来”为改良社会的手段，是坐了津浦车往奉天。这道理很浅显：壁虽坚固，也会冲倒的。兵匪的“绑急票”，抢妇女，于风化何如？没有知道呢，还是知而不能言，不敢言呢？倒是歌功颂德的！
In short, if society is not improved, "putting away" is useless, and using "putting away" as a means of improving society is to take the Jinpu car to Fengtian. This principle is very simple: although the wall is strong, it will also be knocked down. How about the "tying of urgent tickets" and robbing women by soldiers and bandits? Don't know, or do you know but can't speak, dare not speak? It's a song of praise!其实，“坚壁清野”虽然是兵家的一法，但这究竟是退守，不是进攻。或者就因为这一点，适与一般人的退婴主义相称，于是见得志同道合的罢。但在兵事上，是别有所待的，待援军的到来，或敌军的引退；倘单是困守孤城，那结果就只有灭亡，教育上的“坚壁清野”法，所待的是什么呢？照历来的女教来推测，所待的只有一件事：死。
In fact, although "strengthening the wall and clearing the field" is a method of soldiers, this is a retreat, not an attack. Or because of this, it is suitable for ordinary people's infantism, so they see like-minded people. According to the historical female religion, there is only one thing to wait for: death.天下太平或还能苟安时候，所谓男子者俨然地教贞顺，说幽娴，“内言不出于阃”，“男女授受不亲”。好！都听你，外事就拜托足下罢。但是天下弄得鼎沸，暴力袭来了，足下将何以见教呢？曰：做烈妇呀！
When the world is peaceful or can still be peaceful, the so-called men teach chastity and obedience, saying that they are quiet, "inner words do not come from the gate", and "men and women are not close". Good! Listen to you, and leave foreign affairs to you. But the world is in turmoil, violence is coming, how will you teach me? He said: "Be a fierce woman!"宋以来，对付妇女的方法，只有这一个，直到现在，还是这一个。
Since the Song Dynasty, there has been only this one way to deal with women, and until now, it is still this one.如果这女教当真大行，则我们中国历来多少内乱，多少外患，兵燹频仍，妇女不是死尽了么？不，也有幸免的，也有不死的，易代之际，就和男人一同降伏，做奴才。于是生育子孙，祖宗的香火幸而不断，但到现在还很有带着奴气的人物，大概也就是这个流弊罢。“有利必有弊”，是十口相传，大家都知道的。
If this women's religion is really popular, then how many civil strife, how many external troubles, and frequent wars in China have were, and aren't women dead? No, there are those who are survived, and there are those who do not die, and when the era changes, they surrender with men and become slaves. 寡妇主义

寡妇主义

寡妇主义

Widowism范源廉先生是现在许多青年所钦仰的；各人有各人的意思，我当然无从推度那些缘由。但我个人所叹服的，是在他当前清光绪末年，首先发明了“速成师范”。一门学术而可以速成，迂执的先生们也许要觉得离奇罢；殊不知那时中国正闹着“教育荒”，所以这正是一宗急赈的款子。半年以后，从日本留学回来的师资就不在少数了，还带着教育上的各种主义，如军国民主义，尊王攘夷主义之类。在女子教育，则那时候最时行，常常听到嚷着的，是贤母良妻主义。
Mr. Fan Yuanlian is admired by many young people now; Everyone has their own opinions, and of course I can't infer those reasons. But what I personally admire is that in the late years of Guangxu in the current Qing Dynasty, he first invented the "Crash Normal School". An academic subject that can be achieved quickly, and pedantic gentlemen may find it bizarre; As everyone knows, China was experiencing an "education shortage" at that time, so this was an urgent relief fund. Half a year later, there were not a few teachers who came back from studying in Japan, and they still brought with them various doctrines in education, such as military nationalism, respect for the king and barbarianism. In women's education, it was the most popular at that time, and what was often heard was the doctrine of good mothers and good wives.我倒并不一定以为这主义错，愚母恶妻是谁也不希望的。然而现在有几个急进的人们，却以为女子也不专是家庭中物，因而很攻击中国至今还钞了日本旧刊文来教育自己的女子的谬误。人们真容易被听惯的讹传所迷，例如近来有人说：谁是卖国的，谁是只为子孙计的。于是许多人也都这样说。其实如果真能卖国，还该得点更大的利，如果真为子孙计，也还算较有良心；现在的所谓谁者，大抵不过是送国，也何尝想到子孙。这贤母良妻主义也不在例外，急进者虽然引以为病，而事实上又何尝有这么一回事；所有的，不过是“寡妇主义”罢了。
I don't necessarily think that this doctrine is wrong, no one wants a foolish mother and a bad wife. However, there are now a few radical people who think that women are not exclusively part of the family, so they attack the fallacy that China has still copied old Japanese publications to educate its own women. People are really easy to be fascinated by the rumors they are used to, such as recently someone has said: Who is a traitor and who is only for his descendants. So many people say the same. In fact, if you can really betray the country, you should get a greater profit, and if you really plan for your descendants, you are still more conscientious; The so-called who is now is probably just sending the country, and he has never thought of his descendants. This good mother and good wife doctrine is no exception, although the radical is sick, in fact there is no such thing; All of them are just "widowhood".这“寡妇”二字，应该用纯粹的中国思想来解释，不能比附欧，美，印度或亚剌伯的；倘要翻成洋文，也决不宜意译或神译，只能译音：Kuofuism。
The word "widow" should be interpreted in pure Chinese thought, and cannot be compared with those of Europe, the United States, India or Arabia; If it is translated into foreign language, it is definitely not suitable for free translation or divine translation, but can only be translated: Kuofuism.我生以前不知道怎样，我生以后，儒教却已经颇“杂”了：“奉母命权作道场”者有之，“神道设教”者有之，佩服《文昌帝君功过格》者又有之，我还记得那《功过格》，是给“谈人闺阃”者以很大的罚。我未出户庭，中国也未有女学校以前不知道怎样，自从我涉足社会，中国也有了女校，却常听到读书人谈论女学生的事，并且照例是坏事。有时实在太谬妄了，但倘若指出它的矛盾，则说的听的都大不悦，仇恨简直是“若杀其父兄”。这种言动，自然也许是合于“儒行”的罢，因为圣道广博，无所不包；或者不过是小节，不要紧的。
I didn't know what it was like before I was born, but after I was born, Confucianism was already quite "mixed": there were people who were ordered by their mother to make a dojo, there were those who "set up a religion in Shinto", and there were those who admired the "Wenchang Emperor's Meritorious Demerits", and I still remember that the "Meritorious Demerits" was a great punishment for those who "talked about people's boudoirs". Sometimes it is too absurd, but if you point out its contradictions, you will be very unhappy, and the hatred is simply "if you kill your father and brother". Even if it is a good mother and a good wife, even if it is in the Eastern way, it cannot be said that there is no love for husbands and children. Although love is a gifted thing, if there is no considerable thorn and halberd, it will not be developed. For example, if a sitting person compares himself with a blacksmith porter, he will understand it very clearly. The priests of the Middle Ages in Europe, the palace girls (female servants) before the Japanese Restoration, and the eunuchs of the Chinese dynasties, who were ruthless and dangerous, were many times more than ordinary people. 二　论“落水狗”有三种，大都在可打之列

2. There are three types of "reservoir dogs", most of which are among the ones that can be beaten今之论者，常将“打死老虎”与“打落水狗”相提并论，以为都近于卑怯。我以为“打死老虎”者，装怯作勇，颇含滑稽，虽然不免有卑怯之嫌，却怯得令人可爱。至于“打落水狗”，则并不如此简单，当看狗之怎样，以及如何落水而定。考落水原因，大概可有三种：（1）狗自己失足落水者，（2）别人打落者， （3）亲自打落者。倘遇前二种，便即附和去打，自然过于无聊，或者竟近于卑怯；但若与狗奋战，亲手打其落水，则虽用竹竿又在水中从而痛打之，似乎也非已甚，不得与前二者同论。
Today's commentators often compare "killing a tiger" with "beating a water dog", thinking that they are close to cowardice. I think the person who "killed the tiger" pretends to be timid and brave, which is quite funny, although it is inevitable that he will be cowardly, but he is cutely scared. As for "hitting the drowning dog", it is not so simple, it depends on what the dog is like and how it falls into the water. There are probably three reasons for falling into the water: (1) the dog itself falls into the water, (2) others fall down, and (3) the person who is knocked down by himself. If you encounter the first two, you will immediately agree to fight, which is naturally too boring, or close to cowardice; However, if you fight with a dog and hit it into the water with your own hands, even if you use a bamboo pole and hit it hard in the water, it seems that it is not too much, and it cannot be discussed in the same way as the first two.听说刚勇的拳师，决不再打那已经倒地的敌手，这实足使我们奉为楷模。但我以为尚须附加一事，即敌手也须是刚勇的斗士，一败之后，或自愧自悔而不再来，或尚须堂皇地来相报复，那当然都无不可。而于狗，却不能引此为例，与对等的敌手齐观，因为无论它怎样狂嗥，其实并不解什么“道义”；况且狗是能浮水的，一定仍要爬到岸上，倘不注意，它先就耸身一摇，将水点洒得人们一身一脸，于是夹着尾巴逃走了。但后来性情还是如此。老实人将它的落水认作受洗，以为必已忏悔，不再出而咬人，实在是大错而特错的事。
I heard that the brave boxer will never fight the opponent who has fallen to the ground, which is enough to make us a role model. But I think there is one more thing that needs to be added, that is, the opponent must also be a brave fighter, and after a defeat, he may feel ashamed and regret and not come back, or he must take revenge on each other in a dignified manner, of course. Yu Gou, on the other hand, cannot take this as an example to look at his equal rivals, because no matter how wild it howls, it actually does not understand any "morality"; Moreover, the dog can float on the water, and it must still climb to the shore, if it does not pay attention, it will first shake its body and sprinkle water on people's faces, and then run away with its tail between its legs. But then the temperament was still like this. It is a great mistake for an honest person to think that he has repented and will not come out again to bite someone.总之，倘是咬人之狗，我觉得都在可打之列，无论它在岸上或在水中。
In short, if it is a biting dog, I think it is among the fightable, whether it is on the shore or in the water.

This is also a kind of national light. But aren't dogs and cats enemies? 五　论塌台人物不当与“落水狗”相提并论

论“费厄泼赖”应该缓行

5. The figures of the collapsed platform should not be compared with the "drowning dog"“犯而不校”是恕道，“以眼还眼以牙还牙”是直道。中国最多的却是枉道：不打落水狗，反被狗咬了。但是，这其实是老实人自己讨苦吃。
"Violating without proofreading" is forgiveness, and "an eye for an eye and a tooth for a tooth" is a straight path. The most common thing in China is that it is in vain: if you don't hit the water dog, you will be bitten by the dog. However, this is actually the honest person himself.俗语说：“忠厚是无用的别名，”也许太刻薄一点罢，但仔细想来，却也觉得并非唆人作恶之谈，乃是归纳了许多苦楚的经历之后的警句。譬如不打落水狗说，其成因大概有二：一是无力打；二是比例错。前者且勿论；后者的大错就又有二：一是误将塌台人物和落水狗齐观，二是不辨塌台人物又有好有坏，于是视同一律，结果反成为纵恶。即以现在而论，因为政局的不安定，真是此起彼伏如转轮，坏人靠着冰山，恣行无忌，一旦失足，忽而乞怜，而曾经亲见，或亲受其噬啮的老实人，乃忽以“落水狗”视之，不但不打，甚至于还有哀矜之意，自以为公理已伸，侠义这时正在我这里。殊不知它何尝真是落水，巢窟是早已造好的了，食料是早经储足的了，并且都在租界里。虽然有时似乎受伤，其实并不，至多不过是假装跛脚，聊以引起人们的恻隐之心，可以从容避匿罢了。他日复来，仍旧先咬老实人开手，“投石下井”，无所不为，寻起原因来，一部分就正因为老实人不“打落水狗”之故。所以，要是说得苛刻一点，也就是自家掘坑自家埋，怨天尤人，全是错误的。
As the saying goes: "Loyalty is a useless alias," maybe it's a bit too mean, but if you think about it carefully, I also feel that it is not a statement that incites people to do evil, but an aphorism after summarizing many painful experiences. For example, if you don't hit the water dog, there are probably two causes: one is the inability to fight; Second, the proportion is wrong. Let's not talk about the former; There are two big mistakes in the latter: one is to mistakenly view the collapsed characters and the drowning dogs together, and the other is to not distinguish between the collapsed characters and good and bad, so they are regarded as the same, and the result is to indulge evil. That is, in the present, because of the instability of the political situation, it is really like a spinning wheel, bad people rely on icebergs, act recklessly, once they stumble, suddenly beg for mercy, and the honest people who have seen or been bitten by it suddenly regard them as "reservoir dogs", not only do not fight, but even have the meaning of pity, thinking that justice has been done, and chivalry is here with me at this time. As everyone knows, it really fell into the water, the nest has already been built, the food has been stored in sufficient preparation, and they are all in the concession. Although it sometimes seems to be injured, in fact, it is not, at most it is just pretending to be lame, chatting to arouse people's compassion, and can calmly hide. When he came back one day, he still bit the honest man first, "throwing stones into the well", doing everything, and finding out the reason, part of it was because the honest man did not "hit the water dog". Therefore, if you put it harshly, that is, digging a pit and burying it yourself, complaining about others, it is all wrong.

论“费厄泼赖”应该缓行

六　论现在还不能一味“费厄”

论“费厄泼赖”应该缓行

6. Theory cannot be blindly "Fayre" now仁人们或者要问：那么，我们竟不要“费厄泼赖”么？我可以立刻回答：当然是要的，然而尚早。这就是“请君入瓮”法。虽然仁人们未必肯用，但我还可以言之成理。土绅士或洋绅士们不是常常说，中国自有特别国情，外国的平等自由等等，不能适用么？我以为这“费厄泼赖”也是其一。否则，他对你不“费厄”，你却对他去“费厄”，结果总是自己吃亏，不但要“费厄”而不可得，并且连要不“费厄”而亦不可得。所以要“费厄”，最好是首先看清对手，倘是些不配承受“费厄”的，大可以老实不客气；待到它也“费厄”了，然后再与它讲“费厄”不迟。
Humane people may ask: So, don't we want to "pay for it"? I can answer immediately: Of course I do, but it's still early. This is the "please enter the urn" method. Although benevolent people may not be willing to use it, I can still make sense. Don't local or foreign gentlemen often say that China has its own special national conditions, foreign equality and freedom, etc., which cannot be applied? I think this "Feierprei" is one of them. Otherwise, he will not "Fei" to you, but you will go to him "Fei", and the result will always be a loss for yourself, not only "Fei" but also not "Fei". Therefore, to "Fae", it is best to first see the opponent clearly, if it is not worthy of bearing "Fae", you can be honest and unceremonious; It is not too late to talk to it about "Fayre" until it is "Fei".这似乎很有主张二重道德之嫌，但是也出于不得已，因为倘不如此，中国将不能有较好的路。中国现在有许多二重道德，主与奴，男与女，都有不同的道德，还没有划一。要是对“落水狗”和“落水人”独独一视同仁，实在未免太偏，太早，正如绅士们之所谓自由平等并非不好，在中国却微嫌太早一样。所以倘有人要普遍施行“费厄泼赖”精神，我以为至少须俟所谓“落水狗”者带有人气之后。但现在自然也非绝不可行，就是，有如上文所说：要看清对手。而且还要有等差，即“费厄”必视对手之如何而施，无论其怎样落水，为人也则帮之，为狗也则不管之，为坏狗也则打之。一言以蔽之：“党同伐异”而已矣。
This seems to be a suspicion of advocating double morality, but it is also out of necessity, because if this is not the case, China will not have a better path. China now has many dual morals, master and slave, man and woman, all have different morals, and they are not uniform. If the "drowning dog" and "overboard man" are treated equally, it is too biased and too early, just as the so-called freedom and equality of gentlemen are not bad, but in China it is slightly too early. So if anyone wants to universally implement the spirit of "Fae E Prey", I think it must at least wait until the so-called "reservoir dog" becomes popular. But now it is naturally not impossible, that is, as mentioned above: to see the opponent clearly. And there must be a difference, that is, "Fayette" must depend on how the opponent is used, no matter how he falls into the water, if he is a person, he will help him, if he is a dog, he will not care about it, and if he is a bad dog, he will beat him. In a word, it is just "the same party fights against the difference".满心“婆理”而满口“公理”的绅士们的名言暂且置之不论不议之列，即使真心人所大叫的公理，在现今的中国，也还不能救助好人，甚至于反而保护坏人。因为当坏人得志，虐待好人的时候，即使有人大叫公理，他决不听从，叫喊仅止于叫喊，好人仍然受苦。然而偶有一时，好人或稍稍蹶起，则坏人本该落水了，可是，真心的公理论者又“勿报复”呀，“仁恕”呀，“勿以恶抗恶”呀……的大嚷起来。这一次却发生实效，并非空嚷了：好人正以为然，而坏人于是得救。但他得救之后，无非以为占了便宜，何尝改悔；并且因为是早已营就三窟，又善于钻谋的，所以不多时，也就依然声势赫奕，作恶又如先前一样。这时候，公理论者自然又要大叫，但这回他却不听你了。
The famous sayings of gentlemen who are full of "politics" and "axioms" are put aside for the time being, even if the axioms shouted by sincere people cannot save good people in today's China, or even protect bad people. Because when a bad person succeeds and abuses a good person, even if someone shouts about justice, he will never listen. However, once in a while, the good guys might rise up a little, and the bad guys should have fallen into the water, but the sincere public theorists "don't retaliate", "forgive", "don't fight evil with evil"...... shouted. This time it worked, not in vain: the good guys thought so, and the bad guys were saved. But after he was saved, he thought he had taken advantage of it, so he repented; And because he had already set up three caves and was good at strategizing, he was still strong and did the same evil as before. At this time, the public theorist naturally wanted to shout again, but this time he didn't listen to you.但是，“疾恶太严”，“操之过急”，汉的清流和明的东林，却正以这一点倾败，论者也常常这样责备他们。殊不知那一面，何尝不“疾善如仇”呢？人们却不说一句话。假使此后光明和黑暗还不能作彻底的战斗，老实人误将纵恶当作宽容，一味姑息下去，则现在似的混沌状态，是可以无穷无尽的。
However, "the evil is too strict" and "too hasty", the clear streams of the Han Dynasty and the Donglin of the Ming Dynasty are failing with this, and commentators often blame them in this way. As everyone knows, why not "hate good like hatred"? People don't say a word. If light and darkness cannot fight thoroughly after this, and honest people mistakenly regard indulgence as tolerance and blindly tolerate it, then the current state of chaos can be endless.

七　论“即以其人之道还治其人之身”

论“费厄泼赖”应该缓行

七 论“即以其人之道还治其人之身”中国人或信中医或信西医，现在较大的城市中往往并有两种医，使他们各得其所。我以为这确是极好的事。倘能推而广之，怨声一定还要少得多，或者天下竟可以臻于郅治。例如民国的通礼是鞠躬，但若有人以为不对的，就独使他磕头。民国的法律是没有笞刑的，倘有人以为肉刑好，则这人犯罪时就特别打屁股。碗筷饭菜，是为今人而设的，有愿为燧人氏以前之民者，就请他吃生肉；再造几千间茅屋，将在大宅子里仰慕尧舜的高士都拉出来，给住在那里面；反对物质文明的，自然更应该不使他衔冤坐汽车。这样一办，真所谓“求仁得仁又何怨”，我们的耳根也就可以清净许多罢。
Chinese people either believe in Chinese medicine or Western medicine, and now there are often two types of medicine in larger cities, so that they can get their place. I thought it was a great thing. If it can be expanded, there must be much less complaints, or the world can actually reach Zhi Zhi. For example, the common etiquette of the Republic of China is to bow, but if someone thinks it is wrong, he will kowtow alone. The law of the Republic of China does not include flogging, and if someone thinks corporal punishment is good, the person will be spanked when he commits a crime. Bowls, chopsticks, and rice are for today's people, and those who wish to be the people before the Suiren clan invite him to eat raw meat; rebuild thousands of thatched huts, pull out the high scholars who admire Yao Shun in the big mansion and live in them; Those who oppose material civilization should naturally not let him sit in a car with injustice. In this way, the so-called "what is there to complain about seeking benevolence and benevolence", our ear roots will be much cleaner.但可惜大家总不肯这样办，偏要以己律人，所以天下就多事。“费厄泼赖”尤其有流弊，甚至于可以变成弱点，反给恶势力占便宜。例如刘百昭殴曳女师大学生，《现代评论》上连屁也不放，一到女师大恢复，陈西滢鼓动女大学生占据校舍时，却道“要是她们不肯走便怎样呢？你们总不好意思用强力把她们的东西搬走了罢？”殴而且拉，而且搬，是有刘百昭的先例的，何以这一回独独“不好意思”？这就因为给他嗅到了女师大这一面有些“费厄”气味之故。但这“费厄”却又变成弱点，反而给人利用了来替章士钊的“遗泽”保镳。
But unfortunately, everyone is unwilling to do this, but they have to discipline others with themselves, so the world is troubled. "Fei E Prey" is especially corrupt, and can even become a weakness and give advantage to evil forces. For example, Liu Baizhao beat female college students, and the "Modern Review" didn't even fart, and when the Women's Normal University recovered, Chen Xiying encouraged female college students to occupy the school building, but said, "What if they refuse to leave?" Are you embarrassed to move their things away with force?" "Beating and pulling, and moving, there is a precedent for Liu Baizhao, why is it "embarrassing" this time? This is because he smelled a bit of "Faye" on the side of the Women's Normal University. But this "Fei" has become a weakness again, and has been used as a bodyguard for Zhang Shizhao's "legacy".
