八　结末

论“费厄泼赖”应该缓行

8. Conclusion或者要疑我上文所言，会激起新旧，或什么两派之争，使恶感更深，或相持更烈罢。但我敢断言，反改革者对于改革者的毒害，向来就并未放松过，手段的厉害也已经无以复加了。只有改革者却还在睡梦里，总是吃亏，因而中国也总是没有改革，自此以后，是应该改换些态度和方法的。
Some people doubt that what I said above will provoke a dispute between the old and the new, or some kind of conflict between the two factions, deepen the sense of evil, or make the stalemate more intense. But I dare to assert that the poison of counter-reformers against reformers has never been relaxed, and the power of their methods has been unparalleled. Only the reformers are still asleep and always suffer losses, so China has always had no reforms, and since then, some attitudes and methods should be changed.一九二五年十二月二十九日。
December 29, 1925.

写在《坟》后面

写在《坟》后面

写在《坟》后面

Written behind "The Tomb"在听到我的杂文已经印成一半的消息的时候，我曾经写了几行题记，寄往北京去。当时想到便写，写完便寄，到现在还不满二十天，早已记不清说了些甚么了。今夜周围是这么寂静，屋后面的山脚下腾起野烧的微光；南普陀寺还在做牵丝傀儡戏，时时传来锣鼓声，每一间隔中，就更加显得寂静。电灯自然是辉煌着，但不知怎地忽有淡淡的哀愁来袭击我的心，我似乎有些后悔印行我的杂文了。我很奇怪我的后悔；这在我是不大遇到的，到如今，我还没有深知道所谓悔者究竟是怎么一回事。但这心情也随即逝去，杂文当然仍在印行，只为想驱逐自己目下的哀愁，我还要说几句话。
When I heard the news that half of my essay had been printed, I wrote a few lines of inscription and sent it to Beijing. At that time, I thought of writing it, and I sent it after writing, but it has been less than twenty days, and I can't remember what I said. The surroundings were so quiet tonight, and there was a glimmer of wild fire at the foot of the mountain behind the house; Nanputuo Temple is still doing a string puppet show, and the sound of gongs and drums is heard from time to time, and in each interval, it becomes even more silent. The electric light was naturally brilliant, but somehow a faint sadness suddenly hit my heart, and I seemed to regret printing my essay. I am curious about my regrets; I don't have much of an encounter with this, and until now, I still don't know what the so-called repentant is. But this mood also passed away, and of course the essays were still being printed, just to expel my current sorrow, I still have to say a few words.记得先已说过：这不过是我的生活中的一点陈迹。如果我的过往，也可以算作生活，那么，也就可以说，我也曾工作过了。但我并无喷泉一般的思想，伟大华美的文章，既没有主义要宣传，也不想发起一种什么运动。不过我曾经尝得，失望无论大小，是一种苦味，所以几年以来，有人希望我动动笔的，只要意见不很相反，我的力量能够支撑，就总要勉力写几句东西，给来者一些极微末的欢喜。人生多苦辛，而人们有时却极容易得到安慰，又何必惜一点笔墨，给多尝些孤独的悲哀呢？于是除小说杂感之外，逐渐又有了长长短短的杂文十多篇。其间自然也有为卖钱而作的。这回就都混在一处。我的生命的一部分，就这样地用去了，也就是做了这样的工作。然而我至今终于不明白我一向是在做什么。比方做土工的罢，做着做着，而不明白是在筑台呢还在掘坑。所知道的是即使是筑台，也无非要将自己从那上面跌下来或者显示老死；倘是掘坑，那就当然不过是埋掉自己。总之：逝去，逝去，一切一切，和光阴一同早逝去，在逝去，要逝去了。——不过如此，但也为我所十分甘愿的。
I remember saying earlier: This is just a little bit of a relic in my life. If my past can also be counted as life, then it can be said that I have also worked. But I don't have fountain thoughts, great and beautiful articles, neither doctrine to propagate nor any movement. However, I have tasted that disappointment, no matter how big or small, is a bitter taste, so for several years, some people have wanted me to start writing, as long as the opinions are not very opposite, my strength can support it, I always have to try to write a few words to give the visitor some minimal joy. Life is so hard, and people are sometimes very easy to be comforted, so why spare a little pen and ink to give more sadness of loneliness? So in addition to the miscellaneous feelings of the novel, there were gradually more than ten essays of length and shortness. Naturally, there are also those who make money to sell. This time they were all mixed together. A part of my life was used like this, that is, I did this kind of work. However, I still don't understand what I have always been doing. For example, a person who does earthwork is doing it, but he doesn't understand that he is building a platform and is still digging a pit. What we know is that even if you build a platform, you have nothing more than to fall from it or show that you are old and dead; If you dig a pit, of course, you are just burying yourself. In short: gone, gone, everything, and time have passed away early, in the passing, about to pass. ——But that's it, but it's also very willing for me.然而这大约也不过是一句话。当呼吸还在时，只要是自己的，我有时却也喜欢将陈迹收存起来，明知不值一文，总不能绝无眷恋，集杂文而名之曰《坟》，究竟还是一种取巧的掩饰。刘伶喝得酒气熏天，使人荷锸跟在后面，道：死便埋我。虽然自以为放达，其实是只能骗骗极端老实人的。
However, this is probably just a sentence. When the breath is still there, as long as it is my own, I sometimes like to store the relics, knowing that it is not worth a penny, I can never be without attachment, and the collection of essays and the name "Grave" is still a clever cover-up. Liu Ling was so drunk that he made people follow him with a shovel, and said: If you die, bury me. Although they think they are open-minded, they can only deceive extremely honest people.所以这书的印行，在自己就是这么一回事。至于对别人，记得在先也已说过，还有愿使偏爱我的文字的主顾得到一点喜欢；憎恶我的文字的东西得到一点呕吐，——我自己知道，我并不大度，那些东西因我的文字而呕吐，我也很高兴的。别的就什么意思也没有了。倘若硬要说出好处来，那么，其中所介绍的几个诗人的事，或者还不妨一看；最末的论“费厄泼赖”这一篇，也许可供参考罢，因为这虽然不是我的血所写，却是见了我的同辈和比我年幼的青年们的血而写的。
So the printing of this book is like this for me. As for others, I remember that I have said before that I wish to give a little favor to my patrons who prefer my words; Things that hate my words get a little vomit,—— I know that I am not generous, and I am happy that those things vomit because of my words. It doesn't mean anything else. If you insist on talking about the benefits, then you might as well take a look at the affairs of the poets introduced in it; The last article on "Feierprei" may be useful for reference, because although it was not written in my blood, it was written in the blood of my peers and young people younger than me.偏爱我的作品的读者，有时批评说，我的文字是说真话的。这其实是过誉，那原因就因为他偏爱。我自然不想太欺骗人，但也未尝将心里的话照样说尽，大约只要看得可以交卷就算完。我的确时时解剖别人，然而更多的是更无情面地解剖我自己，发表一点，酷爱温暖的人物已经觉得冷酷了，如果全露出我的血肉来，末路正不知要到怎样。我有时也想就此驱除旁人，到那时还不唾弃我的，即使是枭蛇鬼怪，也是我的朋友，这才真是我的朋友。倘使并这个也没有，则就是我一个人也行。但现在我并不。因为，我还没有这样勇敢，那原因就是我还想生活，在这社会里。还有一种小缘故，先前也曾屡次声明，就是偏要使所谓正人君子也者之流多不舒服几天，所以自己便特地留几片铁甲在身上，站着，给他们的世界上多有一点缺陷，到我自己厌倦了，要脱掉了的时候为止。
Readers who prefer my work sometimes criticize that my words tell the truth. This is actually an overstatement, and the reason is because he prefers it. Naturally, I didn't want to deceive people too much, but I didn't say everything in my heart, probably as long as I could read it. I do dissect others from time to time, but more often I dissect myself more ruthlessly, expressing a little bit of warmth, the characters who love warmth already feel cold, if I expose all my flesh and blood, I don't know what the end will be. Sometimes I want to drive away others, and at that time I don't spit on me, even if it is a snake or ghost, it is my friend, this is really my friend. If there is no such thing, then I can do it alone. But now I don't. Because, I am not so brave yet, and that is because I still want to live in this society. There is also a small reason, which I have repeatedly stated before, that is, to make the so-called righteous gentlemen and gentlemen uncomfortable for a few more days, so I specially left a few pieces of iron armor on my body, standing, and giving them a little more flaws in the world, until I got tired of it and wanted to take it off.倘说为别人引路，那就更不容易了，因为连我自己还不明白应当怎么走。中国大概很有些青年的“前辈”和“导师”罢，但那不是我，我也不相信他们。我只很确切地知道一个终点，就是：坟。然而这是大家都知道的，无须谁指引。问题是在从此到那的道路。那当然不只一条，我可正不知那一条好，虽然至今有时也还在寻求。在寻求中，我就怕我未熟的果实偏偏毒死了偏爱我的果实的人，而憎恨我的东西如所谓正人君子也者偏偏都矍铄，所以我说话常不免含胡，中止，心里想：对于偏爱我的读者的赠献，或者最好倒不如是一个“无所有”。我的译著的印本，最初，印一次是一千，后来加五百，近时是二千至四千，每一增加，我自然是愿意的，因为能赚钱，但也伴着哀愁，怕于读者有害，因此作文就时常更谨慎，更踌躇。有人以为我信笔写来，直抒胸臆，其实是不尽然的，我的顾忌并不少。我自己早知道毕竟不是什么战士了，而且也不能算前驱，就有这么多的顾忌和回忆。还记得三四年前，有一个学生来买我的书，从衣袋里掏出钱来放在我手里，那钱上还带着体温。这体温便烙印了我的心，至今要写文字时，还常使我怕毒害了这类的青年，迟疑不敢下笔。我毫无顾忌地说话的日子，恐怕要未必有了罢。但也偶尔想，其实倒还是毫无顾忌地说话，对得起这样的青年。但至今也还没有决心这样做。
It is even more difficult to lead the way for others, because even I myself do not know how to go. There are probably many "seniors" and "mentors" of young people in China, but that's not me, and I don't believe in them. I only know exactly one end, that is: the grave. However, this is known to everyone and does not need to be guided by anyone. The problem is the road from here to there. Of course, there is more than one, I don't know which one is good, although I am still looking for it sometimes. In my search, I was afraid that my unripe fruit would poison those who favored my fruit, and that the things that hated me, such as the so-called righteous gentlemen, were all fierce, so I often spoke with a beard, stopped, and thought to myself: For the reader who prefers me, it is better to be a "nothing". The printed version of my translation, at first, was printed for 1,000 at a time, then added 500, and recently it was 2,000 to 4,000. Some people think that I write it with a pen and express my heart directly, but in fact it is not entirely true, and I have many scruples. I myself knew that I was not a warrior after all, and I couldn't be considered a pioneer, so I had so many scruples and memories. I still remember three or four years ago, a student came to buy my book, took money out of his pocket and put it in my hand, and the money was still with body temperature. This body temperature has imprinted my heart, and when I want to write, I often make me afraid of poisoning such young people, and I hesitate to write. I'm afraid that the days when I speak without scruples may not be there. But I also occasionally think that in fact, I still speak without scruples, worthy of such a young man. But so far there is no determination to do so.今天所要说的话也不过是这些，然而比较的却可以算得真实。此外，还有一点余文。
That's all I want to say today, but the comparison can be considered true. In addition, there is a little bit of remainder.记得初提倡白话的时候，是得到各方面剧烈的攻击的。后来白话渐渐通行了，势不可遏，有些人便一转而引为自己之功，美其名曰“新文化运动”。又有些人便主张白话不妨作通俗之用；又有些人却道白话要做得好，仍须看古书。前一类早已二次转舵，又反过来嘲骂“新文化”了；后二类是不得已的调和派，只希图多留几天僵尸，到现在还不少。我曾在杂感上掊击过的。
I remember when I first advocated the vernacular, I was violently attacked from all sides. Later, the vernacular gradually became popular and unstoppable, and some people turned to it as their own merit, calling it the "New Culture Movement". some people advocate that the vernacular may be used for popular purposes; Some people say that to do well in the vernacular, you still need to read ancient books. The former category has already turned the rudder for the second time, and in turn has ridiculed the "new culture"; The latter two categories are the last resort conciliators, who only want to keep zombies for a few more days, and there are still quite a few. I have struck it with mixed senses.新近看见一种上海出版的期刊，也说起要做好白话须读好古文，而举例为证的人名中，其一却是我。这实在使我打了一个寒噤。别人我不论，若是自己，则曾经看过许多旧书，是的确的，为了教书，至今也还在看。因此耳濡目染，影响到所做的白话上，常不免流露出它的字句，体格来。但自己却正苦于背了这些古老的鬼魂，摆脱不开，时常感到一种使人气闷的沉重。就是思想上，也何尝不中些庄周韩非的毒，时而很随便，时而很峻急。孔孟的书我读得最早，最熟，然而倒似乎和我不相干。大半也因为懒惰罢，往往自己宽解，以为一切事物，在转变中，是总有多少中间物的。动植之间，无脊椎和脊椎动物之间，都有中间物；或者简直可以说，在进化的链子上，一切都是中间物。当开首改革文章的时候，有几个不三不四的作者，是当然的，只能这样，也需要这样。他的任务，是在有些警觉之后，喊出一种新声；又因为从旧垒中来，情形看得较为分明，反戈一击，易制强敌的死命。但仍应该和光阴偕逝，逐渐消亡，至多不过是桥梁中的一木一石，并非什么前途的目标，范本。跟着起来便该不同了，倘非天纵之圣，积习当然也不能顿然荡除，但总得更有新气象。以文字论，就不必更在旧书里讨生活，却将活人的唇舌作为源泉，使文章更加接近语言，更加有生气。至于对于现在人民的语言的穷乏欠缺，如何救济，使他丰富起来，那也是一个很大的问题，或者也须在旧文中取得若干资料，以供使役，但这并不在我现在所要说的范围以内，姑且不论。
Recently, I saw a journal published in Shanghai, and it also said that to do a good job in vernacular, you must read ancient texts well, and one of the names of the people who gave examples is me. This really made me shudder. I don't care about others, if it is myself, I have read many old books, yes, I am still reading them in order to teach. Therefore, it affects the vernacular it does, and its words and physique are often revealed. But I am suffering from carrying these ancient ghosts, and I can't get rid of it, and I often feel a kind of heaviness that makes people feel stuffy. Even ideologically, it is not poisoned by Zhuang Zhou Hanfei, sometimes very casual, sometimes very urgent. I read Confucius and Mencius's books the earliest and most familiar with them, but they seem to have nothing to do with me. Most of them are also lazy, and they often let go of themselves, thinking that there are always some intermediate things in the transformation of everything. There are intermediates between animals and plants, invertebrates and vertebrates; Or it can simply be said that on the chain of evolution, everything is an intermediary. When the reform article begins, there are several authors, of course, but this can only be done and needs to be like this. His task is to shout a new voice after being a little alert; And because it came from the old fortifications, the situation was more clear, and it was easy to control the death of a strong enemy with a counterattack. But it should still pass with time and gradually die out, at most it is just a piece of wood and a stone in the bridge, not a future goal, a model. If it is not the saint of heaven, of course, the accumulated habits cannot be eliminated immediately, but there must be a new atmosphere. In terms of words, there is no need to beg for life in old books, but use the lips and tongues of living people as the source to make the article closer to language and more lively. As for the poverty of the language of the people now, how to relieve and enrich them is also a big question, or it is necessary to obtain some information from the old texts for use, but this is not within the scope of what I am going to say now, so let's leave it alone.我以为我倘十分努力，大概也还能够博采口语，来改革我的文章。但因为懒而且忙，至今没有做。我常疑心这和读了古书很有些关系，因为我觉得古人写在书上的可恶思想，我的心里也常有，能否忽而奋勉，是毫无把握的。我常常诅咒我的这思想，也希望不再见于后来的青年。去年我主张青年少读，或者简直不读中国书，乃是用许多苦痛换来的真话，决不是聊且快意，或什么玩笑，愤激之辞。古人说，不读书便成愚人，那自然也不错的。然而世界却正由愚人造成，聪明人决不能支持世界，尤其是中国的聪明人。现在呢，思想上且不说，便是文辞，许多青年作者又在古文，诗词中摘些好看而难懂的字面，作为变戏法的手巾，来装潢自己的作品了。我不知这和劝读古文说可有相关，但正在复古，也就是新文艺的试行自杀，是显而易见的。
I thought that if I worked very hard, I would probably be able to adopt colloquial language to reform my writing. But because I was lazy and busy, I haven't done it so far. I often suspect that this has something to do with reading ancient books, because I feel that the hateful thoughts written by the ancients in books are often in my heart, and I am unsure whether I can suddenly work hard. I often curse this thought of mine, and I hope that it will not be seen again in the youth of later generations. Last year, I advocated that young people read less, or not read Chinese books at all, but the truth exchanged for a lot of pain, and it was by no means a joke or indignation. The ancients said that if you don't read, you will become a fool, and that is naturally not bad. However, the world is being created by fools, and smart people must not support the world, especially the smart people in China. Now, not to mention ideologically, it is literary words, and many young authors have picked some beautiful and incomprehensible words in ancient texts and poems as handkerchiefs for juggling to decorate their works. I don't know if this has anything to do with persuading people to read ancient texts, but it is obvious that they are committing suicide in retro, that is, new literature and art.不幸我的古文和白话合成的杂集，又恰在此时出版了，也许又要给读者若干毒害。只是在自己，却还不能毅然决然将他毁灭，还想借此暂时看看逝去的生活的余痕。惟愿偏爱我的作品的读者也不过将这当作一种纪念，知道这小小的丘陇中，无非埋着曾经活过的躯壳。待再经若干岁月，又当化为烟埃，并纪念也从人间消去，而我的事也就完毕了。上午也正在看古文，记起了几句陆士衡的吊曹孟德文，便拉来给我的这一篇作结——
Unfortunately, my collection of ancient texts and vernacular was published at this time, and it may be poisonous to readers. It's just that in myself, I can't resolutely destroy him, and I want to take this opportunity to temporarily see the traces of my lost life. I hope that readers who prefer my work will also regard this as a kind of memorial, knowing that in this small hill, there is nothing more than a shell buried in the past. After a few more years, it will turn into smoke and dust, and the commemoration will be erased from the world, and my affairs will be finished. I was also reading ancient texts in the morning, and I remembered a few sentences of Lu Shiheng's hanging Cao Meng Dewen, so I pulled this article to end with me——既睎古以遗累，信简礼而薄葬。既睎古以遗累，信简礼而薄葬。 
彼裘绂于何有，贻尘谤于后王。 彼裘绂于何有，贻尘谤于后王。 
嗟大恋之所存，故虽哲而不忘。 嗟大恋之所存，故虽哲而不忘。 
览遗籍以慷慨，献兹文而凄伤！ 览遗籍以慷慨，献兹文而凄伤！
一九二六，一一，一一，夜。鲁迅。

1926, 11, 11, night. Lu Xun.

题记

题记

题记

Inscription现在有谁经过西长安街一带的，总可以看见几个衣履破碎的穷苦孩子叫卖报纸。记得三四年前，在他们身上偶而还剩有制服模样的残余；再早，就更体面，简直是童子军的拟态。
Nowadays, anyone who passes by the area of West Chang'an Street can always see a few poor children with broken clothes selling newspapers. I remember that three or four years ago, there were occasional remnants of uniforms left on them; Earlier, it would be more decent, simply a mimicry of a Boy Scout.那是中华民国八年，即西历一九一九年，五月四日北京学生对于山东问题的示威运动以后，因为当时散传单的是童子军，不知怎的竟惹了投机家的注意，童子军式的卖报孩子就出现了。其年十二月，日本公使小幡酉吉抗议排日运动，情形和今年大致相同；只是我们的卖报孩子却穿破了第一身新衣以后，便不再做，只见得年不如年地显出穷苦。
It was the eighth year of the Republic of China, that is, in 1919 AD, after the demonstration of Beijing students on the Shandong issue on May 4, because it was the Boy Scouts who distributed leaflets at that time, somehow attracted the attention of speculators, and Scout-style newspaper selling children appeared. In December of that year, the Japanese minister Obata Yukichi protested against the anti-Japanese movement, which was roughly the same as this year; It's just that our newspaper children don't do it anymore after wearing their first new clothes, only to see that they are not as poor as they are every year.我在《新青年》的《随感录》中做些短评，还在这前一年，因为所评论的多是小问题，所以无可道，原因也大都忘却了。但就现在的文字看起来，除几条泛论之外，有的是对于扶乩，静坐，打拳而发的；有的是对于所谓“保存国粹”而发的；有的是对于那时旧官僚的以经验自豪而发的；有的是对于上海《时报》的讽刺画而发的。记得当时的《新青年》是正在四面受敌之中，我所对付的不过一小部分；其他大事，则本志具在，无须我多言。
I made some short comments in "New Youth"'s "Impressions", and the year before that, because most of the comments were minor problems, there was nothing to say, and most of the reasons were forgotten. But as far as the current text is concerned, except for a few general theories, some are for supporting women, sitting quietly, and punching; some are issued for the so-called "preservation of the quintessence of the country"; some are proud of the experience of the old bureaucrats at that time; Some were sent in response to the satirical paintings of the Shanghai Times. I remember that at that time, "New Youth" was under attack from all sides, and I only dealt with a small part of it; As for other important matters, the original intention is here, so there is no need for me to say more.五四运动之后，我没有写什么文字，现在已经说不清是不做，还是散失消灭的了。但那时革新运动，表面上却颇有些成功，于是主张革新的也就蓬蓬勃勃，而且有许多还就是在先讥笑，嘲骂《新青年》的人们，但他们却是另起了一个冠冕堂皇的名目：新文化运动。这也就是后来又将这名目反套在《新青年》身上，而又加以嘲骂讥笑的，正如笑骂白话文的人，往往自称最得风气之先，早经主张过白话文一样。
After the May Fourth Movement, I didn't write anything, and now I can't tell whether I didn't do it or lost it. But at that time, the reform movement was quite successful on the surface, so those who advocated innovation were also vigorous, and many people were still ridiculing and ridiculing the "New Youth" first, but they came up with another high-sounding name: the New Culture Movement. This is why this name was later put on "New Youth", and it was ridiculed and ridiculed, just as people who laugh and scold vernacular literature often claim to be the first to gain popularity, and have long advocated vernacular literature.再后，更无可道了。只记得一九二一年中的一篇是对于所谓“虚无哲学”而发的；更后一年则大抵对于上海之所谓“国学家”而发，不知怎的那时忽而有许多人都自命为国学家了。
After that, there is nothing more to say. I only remember that one in 1921 was published on the so-called "philosophy of nihilism"; In the following year, it was mostly about the so-called "Chinese scholars" in Shanghai, and somehow many people suddenly called themselves Chinese scholars.自《新青年》出版以来，一切应之而嘲骂改革，后来又赞成改革，后来又嘲骂改革者，现在拟态的制服早已破碎，显出自身的本相来了，真所谓“事实胜于雄辩”，又何待于纸笔喉舌的批评。所以我的应时的浅薄的文字，也应该置之不顾，一任其消灭的；但几个朋友却以为现状和那时并没有大两样，也还可以存留，给我编辑起来了。这正是我所悲哀的。我以为凡对于时弊的攻击，文字须与时弊同时灭亡，因为这正如白血轮之酿成疮疖一般，倘非自身也被排除，则当它的生命的存留中，也即证明着病菌尚在。
Since the publication of "New Youth", everything has been ridiculed for reform, later in favor of reform, and later ridiculed for reformers. Therefore, my shallow words should also be ignored and destroyed; But a few friends thought that the current situation was not much different from that time, and it could still be kept and edited for me. This is exactly what I am sad about. I think that any attack on the evils of the times must be destroyed at the same time as the evils of the times, because this is like the boil caused by the white blood wheel, if it is not excluded by itself, then when it is in its life, it is proved that the germs are still there.但如果凡我所写，的确都是冷的呢？则它的生命原来就没有，更谈不到中国的病证究竟如何。然而，无情的冷嘲和有情的讽刺相去本不及一张纸，对于周围的感受和反应，又大概是所谓“如鱼饮水冷暖自知”的；我却觉得周围的空气太寒冽了，我自说我的话，所以反而称之曰《热风》。
But what if everything I write is indeed cold? Then its life is not in the first place, let alone what the symptoms are in China. There is a story in Chen Zhengmin's "Dun Zhai Leisure" (not seen in the original book, according to the "Compendium of Materia Medica", but this is all a rumor fabricated by Taoist priests, not a fact, now only used as a metaphor) is well said——“杨勔中年得异疾；每发语，腹中有小声应之，久渐声大。有道士见之，曰：此应声虫也！但读《本草》取不应者治之。读至雷丸，不应，遂顿服数粒而愈。”
“杨勔中年得异疾；每发语，腹中有小声应之，久渐声大。 有道士见之，曰：此应声虫也！但读《本草》取不应者治之。 读至雷丸，不应，遂顿服数粒而愈。 ”关于吞食病菌的事，我上文所说的大概也是错的，但现在手头无书可查。也许是Koch博士发见了虎列拉菌时，Pfeffer博士以为不是真病菌，当面吞下去了，后来病得几乎要死。总之，无论如何，这一案决不能作“精神能改造肉体”的例证。
What I said above about swallowing germs is probably wrong, but there are no books at hand. Perhaps when Dr. Koch discovered Tigerella, Dr. Pfeffer thought it was not a real germ and swallowed it in person, and later became almost deadly of illness. In short, in any case, this case must not be an example of "the spirit can transform the body".一九二五年九月二十四日补记。
Supplement on September 24, 1925.

一九一八年

三十五

一九一八年

thirty-five从清期末年，直到现在，常常听人说“保存国粹”这一句话。
From the end of the Qing Dynasty to the present, I often hear people say the phrase "preserve the essence of the country".前清末年说这话的人，大约有两种：一是爱国志士，一是出洋游历的大官。他们在这题目的背后，各各藏着别的意思。志士说保存国粹，是光复旧物的意思；大官说保存国粹，是教留学生不要去剪辫子的意思。
There are about two types of people who said this at the end of the Qing Dynasty: one is a patriot, and the other is a high-ranking official who has traveled abroad. Behind this topic, they each have other meanings. The aspirant said that preserving the essence of the country means to restore the old things; The high official said that preserving the quintessence of the country means teaching international students not to cut their braids.现在成了民国了。以上所说的两个问题，已经完全消灭。所以我不能知道现在说这话的是那一流人，这话的背后藏着什么意思了。
Now it has become the Republic of China. The two problems mentioned above have been completely eliminated. So I can't know which first-class person is saying this now, and what is the meaning behind these words.可是保存国粹的正面意思，我也不懂。
But I don't understand the positive meaning of preserving the essence of the country.什么叫“国粹”？照字面看来，必是一国独有，他国所无的事物了。换一句话，便是特别的东西。但特别未必定是好，何以应该保存？
What is the "quintessence of the country"? Literally, it must be something unique to one country and not in other countries. In other words, it is something special. But it may not be good, so why should it be preserved?譬如一个人，脸上长了一个瘤，额上肿出一颗疮，的确是与众不同，显出他特别的样子，可以算他的“粹”。然而据我看来，还不如将这“粹”割去了，同别人一样的好。
For example, a person has a tumor on his face and a sore on his forehead, which is indeed different, showing his special appearance, which can be regarded as his "essence". However, in my opinion, it is better to cut off this "essence", as good as others.倘说：中国的国粹，特别而且好；又何以现在糟到如此情形，新派摇头，旧派也叹气。
If you say: China's national essence is special and good; Why is it so bad now, the new school shook its head, and the old school also sighed.倘说：这便是不能保存国粹的缘故，开了海禁的缘故，所以必须保存。但海禁未开以前，全国都是“国粹”，理应好了；何以春秋战国五胡十六国闹个不休，古人也都叹气。
If you say: This is because the quintessence of the country cannot be preserved, and the sea ban has been opened, so it must be preserved. But before the sea ban was opened, the whole country was the "quintessence of the country", which should be good; Why did the Five Hu and Sixteen Kingdoms of the Spring and Autumn Warring States period make endless troubles, and the ancients sighed.倘说：这是不学成汤文武周公的缘故；何以真正成汤文武周公时代，也先有桀纣暴虐，后有殷顽作乱；后来仍旧弄出春秋战国五胡十六国闹个不休，古人也都叹气。
If you say: This is because you don't learn Tang, Wenwu, and Zhou Gong; How to really become the era of Tang, Wenwu and Duke of Zhou, there was first the tyranny of Jie and Zhou, and then there was the stubborn rebellion; Later, it still made a lot of trouble in the Spring and Autumn Warring States Five Hu and Sixteen Kingdoms, and the ancients sighed.我有一位朋友说得好：“要我们保存国粹，也须国粹能保存我们。”
A friend of mine said it well: "If we want to preserve the essence of the country, we must also be able to preserve us." ”保存我们，的确是第一义。只要问他有无保存我们的力量，不管他是否国粹。
Saving us is indeed the first meaning. Just ask him if he has preserved our strength, whether he is the quintessence of the country or not.

一九一八年

三十六

一九一八年

thirty-six现在许多人有大恐惧；我也有大恐惧。
Now many people have great fear; I also have great fears.许多人所怕的，是“中国人”这名目要消灭；我所怕的，是中国人要从“世界人”中挤出。
What many people fear is that the name "Chinese" will be eliminated; What I am afraid of is that the Chinese will be squeezed out of the "people of the world".我以为“中国人”这名目，决不会消灭；只要人种还在，总是中国人。譬如埃及犹太人，无论他们还有“国粹”没有，现在总叫他埃及犹太人，未尝改了称呼。可见保存名目，全不必劳力费心。
I thought that the name "Chinese" would never be eliminated; As long as the race is still there, it will always be Chinese. For example, Egyptian Jews, whether they still have "national essence" or not, now always call him Egyptian Jew, and the name has not changed. It can be seen that there is no need to work hard to save the name.但是想在现今的世界上，协同生长，挣一地位，即须有相当的进步的智识，道德，品格，思想，才能够站得住脚：这事极须劳力费心。而“国粹”多的国民，尤为劳力费心，因为他的“粹”太多。粹太多，便太特别。太特别，便难与种种人协同生长，挣得地位。
But if you want to grow together and earn a position in today's world, you must have considerable progress in intellect, morality, character, and thought, in order to be able to stand firm: this is a matter of great labor and effort. Nationals with a lot of "national essence" are particularly labor-intensive because they have too much "essence". Too much essence is too special. If it is too special, it will be difficult to grow with all kinds of people and earn status.有人说：“我们要特别生长；不然，何以为中国人！”
Some people say: "We must grow specially; Otherwise, how can you be Chinese? ”于是乎要从“世界人”中挤出。
Therefore, it is necessary to squeeze out from the "people of the world".于是乎中国人失了世界，却暂时仍要在这世界上住！——这便是我的大恐惧。
So the Chinese lost the world, but they still have to live in this world for the time being! - This is my great fear.

一九一八年

三十七

一九一八年

thirty-seven近来很有许多人，在那里竭力提倡打拳。记得先前也曾有过一回，但那时提倡的，是满清王公大臣，现在却是民国的教育家，位分略有不同。至于他们的宗旨，是一是二，局外人便不得而知。
Recently, there have been many people who are trying to promote boxing there. I remember that there was a time before, but at that time, it was the princes and ministers of the Manchu Qing Dynasty, but now it is the educators of the Republic of China, and the position is slightly different. As for their purpose, whether it is one or two, outsiders do not know.现在那班教育家，把“九天玄女传与轩辕黄帝，轩辕黄帝传与尼姑”的老方法，改称“新武术”，又是“中国式体操”，叫青年去练习。听说其中好处甚多，重要的举出两种来，是：
Now the group of educators have renamed the old method of "Nine Heavens Xuan Nu to Xuanyuan Huangdi, Xuanyuan Huangdi to Nuns" to "New Martial Arts", and "Chinese gymnastics", asking young people to practice. I heard that there are many benefits, and the two important ones are:一，用在体育上。据说中国人学了外国体操，不见效验；所以须改习本国式体操（即打拳）才行。依我想来：两手拿着外国铜锤或木棍，把手脚左伸右伸的，大约于筋肉发达上，也该有点“效验”。无如竟不见效验！那自然只好改途去练“武松脱铐”那些把戏了。这或者因为中国人生理上与外国人不同的缘故。
First, it is used in sports. It is said that the Chinese learned foreign gymnastics, but it was not effective; Therefore, it is necessary to change to national gymnastics (that is, boxing). According to my opinion, holding a foreign copper hammer or wooden stick in both hands, stretching out my hands and feet to the left and right, should also be a bit "effective" in terms of muscle development. It's better not to see the effect! Naturally, I had to change my path to practice the tricks of "Wu Song unhandcuffing". This may be because Chinese people are physiologically different from foreigners.二，用在军事上。中国人会打拳，外国人不会打拳：有一天见面对打，中国人得胜，是不消说的了。即使不把外国人“板油扯下”，只消一阵“乌龙扫地”，也便一齐扫倒，从此不能爬起。无如现在打仗，总用枪炮。枪炮这件东西，中国虽然“古时也已有过”，可是此刻没有了。籐牌操法，又不练习，怎能御得枪炮？我想（他们不曾说明，这是我的“管窥蠡测”）：打拳打下去，总可达到“枪炮打不进”的程度（即内功？）。这件事从前已经试过一次，在一千九百年。可惜那一回真是名誉的完全失败了。且看这一回如何。
Second, it is used in military affairs. Chinese can punch, foreigners can't box: one day they will meet and fight, and the Chinese will win, needless to say. Even if the foreigners are not "ripped off", they will only be swept down for a while, and they will not be able to get up from then on. There is no such thing as fighting now, always using guns. Although China "has had it in ancient times", it is not there at the moment. If you don't practice rattan cards, how can you resist guns? I think (they didn't explain it, this is my "tube peeping"): if you keep punching, you can always reach the level of "guns can't enter" (i.e., internal strength?). ）。 This has been tried once before, in 1,900 years. It's a pity that it was a complete failure of reputation. Let's see how this time goes.

一九一八年

三十八

一九一八年

thirty-eight中国人向来有点自大。——只可惜没有“个人的自大”，都是“合群的爱国的自大”。这便是文化竞争失败之后，不能再见振拔改进的原因。
Chinese people have always been a bit arrogant. ——It's a pity that there is no "personal arrogance", it is all "gregarious patriotic arrogance". This is the reason why after the failure of cultural competition, there can be no improvement.“个人的自大”，就是独异，是对庸众宣战。除精神病学上的夸大狂外，这种自大的人，大抵有几分天才，——照Nordau等说，也可说就是几分狂气，他们必定自己觉得思想见识高出庸众之上，又为庸众所不懂，所以愤世疾俗，渐渐变成厌世家，或“国民之敌”。但一切新思想，多从他们出来，政治上宗教上道德上的改革，也从他们发端。所以多有这“个人的自大”的国民，真是多福气！多幸运！
"Personal arrogance" is unique, and it is a declaration of war on mediocrity. In addition to psychiatric exaggeration, this kind of arrogant people are probably a bit of genius,—— according to Nordau and others, it can also be said to be a bit of madness, they must feel that their ideology and insight are higher than the mediocre, and they are not understood by the mediocre, so they are cynical, and gradually become misanthropic, or "enemies of the people". But all new ideas mostly come from them, and political, religious, and moral reforms also start from them. So how blessed it is to have such a "personal arrogance" of the people! How lucky!“合群的自大”，“爱国的自大”，是党同伐异，是对少数的天才宣战；——至于对别国文明宣战，却尚在其次。他们自己毫无特别才能，可以夸示于人，所以把这国拿来做个影子；他们把国里的习惯制度抬得很高，赞美的了不得；他们的国粹，既然这样有荣光，他们自然也有荣光了！倘若遇见攻击，他们也不必自去应战，因为这种蹲在影子里张目摇舌的人，数目极多，只须用mob的长技，一阵乱噪，便可制胜。胜了，我是一群中的人，自然也胜了；若败了时，一群中有许多人，未必是我受亏：大凡聚众滋事时，多具这种心理，也就是他们的心理。他们举动，看似猛烈，其实却很卑怯。至于所生结果，则复古，尊王，扶清灭洋等等，已领教得多了。所以多有这“合群的爱国的自大”的国民，真是可哀，真是不幸！
"gregarious arrogance" and "patriotic arrogance" are the party's unity against differences and the declaration of war on a small number of geniuses; ——As for declaring war on other civilizations, it is still secondary. They have no special talents and can boast to others, so they use this country as a shadow; They held the customary system in the country very high and praised it greatly; Their national essence, since they are glorious, they naturally have glory! If they encounter an attack, they don't have to fight on their own, because there are a lot of people squatting in the shadows, and they only need to use the long skills of mobs and make a noise to win. If I win, I am a person in a group, so naturally I will win; If I lose, there are many people in the group, and I may not be at a loss: when gathering people to cause trouble, most people have this kind of mentality, that is, their psychology. Their actions seem violent, but they are actually very cowardly. As for the results, they have learned a lot about retro, respecting the king, supporting the Qing and destroying the ocean, etc. So it is really sad and unfortunate that there are so many people who are "gregarious and patriotic"!不幸中国偏只多这一种自大：古人所作所说的事，没一件不好，遵行还怕不及，怎敢说到改革？这种爱国的自大家的意见，虽各派略有不同，根柢总是一致，计算起来，可分作下列五种：
Unfortunately, China only has this kind of arrogance: none of the things the ancients did or said were bad, and they were afraid of not being able to follow them, so how dare they talk about reform? Although the opinions of this kind of patriotic self-respect are slightly different from each faction, the roots are always the same, and when calculated, they can be divided into the following five types:甲云：“中国地大物博，开化最早；道德天下第一。”这是完全自负。
Jia Yun: "China is vast and has a lot of resources, and it is the earliest of enlightenment; Morality is the best in the world. "This is complete conceit.乙云：“外国物质文明虽高，中国精神文明更好。”
Yi said: "Although foreign material civilization is high, Chinese spiritual civilization is better. ”丙云：“外国的东西，中国都已有过；某种科学，即某子所说的云云”，这两种都是“古今中外派”的支流；依据张之洞的格言，以“中学为体西学为用”的人物。
Bing Yun: "Foreign things, China has already done; a certain science, that is, what a certain son said", both of which are tributaries of "ancient and modern Chinese and foreign schools"; According to Zhang Zhidong's maxim, the character who "uses middle school as the body and Western learning".丁云：“外国也有叫化子，——（或云）也有草舍，——娼妓，——臭虫。”这是消极的反抗。
Ding Yun: "There are also foreign countries called Huazi ,—— (or clouds) There are also grass huts,—— prostitutes,—— and bed bugs. "This is negative resistance.戊云：“中国便是野蛮的好。”又云：“你说中国思想昏乱，那正是我民族所造成的事业的结晶。从祖先昏乱起，直要昏乱到子孙；从过去昏乱起，直要昏乱到未来。……（我们是四万万人，）你能把我们灭绝么？”这比“丁”更进一层，不去拖人下水，反以自己的丑恶骄人；至于口气的强硬，却很有《水浒传》中牛二的态度。
Wu Yun: "China is barbaric." He also said: "You say that China's thinking is confused, which is the crystallization of the cause caused by our nation." From the confusion of the ancestors, it will be confused to the descendants; From the past to the future. …… (We are 40 million people,) Can you exterminate us? This is one level higher than "Ding", not dragging people into the water, but proud of his ugliness; As for the toughness of the tone, it has the attitude of Niu Er in "Water Margin".五种之中，甲乙丙丁的话，虽然已很荒谬，但同戊比较，尚觉情有可原，因为他们还有一点好胜心存在。譬如衰败人家的子弟，看见别家兴旺，多说大话，摆出大家架子；或寻求人家一点破绽，聊给自己解嘲。这虽然极是可笑，但比那一种掉了鼻子，还说是祖传老病，夸示于众的人，总要算略高一步了。
Among the five types, A, B, C, and D are ridiculous, but compared with E, they still feel that they are excusable, because they still have a little competitive spirit. For example, the children of declining families, when they see other families prospering, talk more and put on everyone's show; Or seek a little flaw in others and talk about ridicule for yourself. Although this is extremely ridiculous, it is always a little higher than the kind of person who has dropped his nose and said that it is an ancestral old disease, and boasts to the public.戊派的爱国论最晚出，我听了也最寒心；这不但因其居心可怕，实因他所说的更为实在的缘故。昏乱的祖先，养出昏乱的子孙，正是遗传的定理。民族根性造成之后，无论好坏，改变都不容易的。法国G．Le Bon著《民族进化的心理》中，说及此事道（原文已忘，今但举其大意）——“我们一举一动，虽似自主，其实多受死鬼的牵制。将我们一代的人，和先前几百代的鬼比较起来，数目上就万不能敌了。”我们几百代的祖先里面，昏乱的人，定然不少：有讲道学的儒生，也有讲阴阳五行的道士，有静坐炼丹的仙人，也有打脸打把子的戏子。所以我们现在虽想好好做“人”，难保血管里的昏乱分子不来作怪，我们也不由自主，一变而为研究丹田脸谱的人物：这真是大可寒心的事。但我总希望这昏乱思想遗传的祸害，不至于有梅毒那样猛烈，竟至百无一免。即使同梅毒一样，现在发明了六百零六，肉体上的病，既可医治；我希望也有一种七百零七的药，可以医治思想上的病。这药原来也已发明，就是“科学”一味。只希望那班精神上掉了鼻子的朋友，不要又打着“祖传老病”的旗号来反对吃药，中国的昏乱病，便也总有全愈的一天。祖先的势力虽大，但如从现代起，立意改变：扫除了昏乱的心思，和助成昏乱的物事（儒道两派的文书），再用了对症的药，即使不能立刻奏效，也可把那病毒略略羼淡。如此几代之后待我们成了祖先的时候，就可以分得昏乱祖先的若干势力，那时便有转机，Le Bon所说的事，也不足怕了。
The patriotism of the Wu faction came out the latest, and I was the most chilled when I heard it; This is not only because of his terrible intentions, but also because what he said is more real. The confused ancestors and the breeding of confused descendants are the theorem of heredity. After the national roots are created, it is not easy to change, for better or for worse. In the French G.Le Bon book "The Psychology of National Evolution", he said about this matter (the original text has been forgotten, but now I will give the general idea) - "Although our every move seems to be autonomous, it is actually mostly constrained by the dead ghosts. Compared with the ghosts of the previous hundreds of generations, we are invincible in number. "Among our ancestors for hundreds of generations, there must be many people who are confused: there are Confucian scholars who preach Taoism, Taoist priests who talk about yin and yang and the five elements, immortals who sit quietly and refine alchemy, and actors who slap their faces. So although we want to be a good "person" now, it is difficult to ensure that the confused elements in the blood vessels will not cause trouble, and we can't help but change into a person who studies the face of the dantian: this is really chilling. But I always hope that the scourge of this inheritance of confused thoughts will not be as violent as syphilis, and it will be inevitable. Even if it is the same as syphilis, now six hundred and six have been invented, and physical diseases can be cured; I hope there is also a seven hundred and seven medicine that can cure the disease of the mind. This medicine has also been invented, which is "science". I just hope that those friends who have lost their noses mentally will not oppose taking medicine under the banner of "ancestral old disease", and China's comatose disease will always be cured one day. Although the power of the ancestors is great, if from modern times, the intention has changed: to sweep away the confused mind, and to help the confusion (the documents of Confucianism and Taoism), and then use the right medicine, even if it does not work immediately, it can slightly fade the virus. In this way, when we become ancestors after a few generations, we can divide some of the forces that confuse our ancestors, and then there will be a turnaround, and what Le Bon said is not to be feared.以上是我对于“不长进的民族”的疗救方法；至于“灭绝”一条，那是全不成话，可不必说。“灭绝”这两个可怕的字，岂是我们人类应说的？只有张献忠这等人曾有如此主张，至今为人类唾骂；而且于实际上发生出什么效验呢？但我有一句话，要劝戊派诸公。“灭绝”这句话，只能吓人，却不能吓倒自然。他是毫无情面：他看见有自向灭绝这条路走的民族，便请他们灭绝，毫不客气。我们自己想活，也希望别人都活；不忍说他人的灭绝，又怕他们自己走到灭绝的路上，把我们带累了也灭绝，所以在此着急。倘使不改现状，反能兴旺，能得真实自由的幸福生活，那就是做野蛮也很好。——但可有人敢答应说“是”么？The above is my treatment method for the "nation that does not grow"; As for the "extinction", it is completely unspeakable, but it goes without saying. How can the terrible word "extinction" be said by us humans? Only Zhang Xianzhong and others have made such a claim, and they are still scolded by mankind; And what effect does it actually have? But I have a sentence to persuade the gentlemen of the Wu faction. The phrase "extinction" can only frighten people, but it cannot frighten nature. He was ruthless: when he saw a people who were going to exterminate themselves, he asked them to exterminate them unceremoniously. We want to live ourselves, and we also hope that others will live; I can't bear to talk about the extinction of others, and I'm afraid that they will go to extinction on their own, and they will tire us and become extinct, so I'm anxious here. If you don't change the status quo, you can prosper, and you can live a true and free happy life, then it is good to be savage. ——But does anyone dare to say "yes"?

四十二

一九一九年

forty-two听得朋友说，杭州英国教会里的一个医生，在一本医书上做一篇序，称中国人为土人；我当初颇不舒服，子细再想，现在也只好忍受了。土人一字，本来只说生在本地的人，没有什么恶意。后来因其所指，多系野蛮民族，所以加添了一种新意义，仿佛成了野蛮人的代名词。他们以此称中国人，原不免有侮辱的意思；但我们现在，却除承受这个名号以外，实是别无方法。因为这类是非，都凭事实，并非单用口舌可以争得的。试看中国的社会里，吃人，劫掠，残杀，人身卖买，生殖器崇拜，灵学，一夫多妻，凡有所谓国粹，没一件不与蛮人的文化（？）恰合。拖大辫，吸鸦片，也正与土人的奇形怪状的编发及吃印度麻一样。至于缠足，更要算在土人的装饰法中，第一等的新发明了。他们也喜欢在肉体上做出种种装饰：剜空了耳朵嵌上木塞；下唇剜开一个大孔，插上一支兽骨，像鸟嘴一般；面上雕出兰花；背上刺出燕子；女人胸前做成许多圆的长的疙瘩。可是他们还能走路，还能做事；他们终是未达一间，想不到缠足这好法子。……世上有如此不知肉体上的苦痛的女人，以及如此以残酷为乐，丑恶为美的男子，真是奇事怪事。
I heard from a friend that a doctor in the Church of England in Hangzhou wrote a preface to a medical book, calling Chinese natives; I was quite uncomfortable at first, but after thinking about it carefully, I have to endure it now. The word native, originally only said people born in the local area, without any malice. Later, because most of them were barbaric peoples, a new meaning was added, as if it had become synonymous with barbarians. They call themselves Chinese in this way, which is inevitably insulting; But now, we have no other way but to bear this name. Because this kind of right and wrong is based on facts, not by words alone. Try to look at Chinese society, cannibalism, looting, killing, human trafficking, genital worship, spiritualism, polygamy, all the so-called national essence, there is no culture that is not with the culture of barbarians (?). Just right. Dragging big braids and smoking opium are the same as the strangely shaped braided hair of the natives and eating Indian hemp. As for foot binding, it is even more considered a first-class new invention in the decoration method of the natives. They also like to make various decorations on the flesh: hollowing out the ears and inserting wooden plugs; A large hole was cut out on the lower lip, and an animal bone was inserted, like a bird's beak; orchids are carved on the face; swallows pierced on their backs; The woman's chest is made into many round long pimples. But they can still walk and do things; They have not yet reached one room, and they can't think of a good way to bind their feet. …… It is really strange that there are women in the world who do not know physical pain, and men who take pleasure in cruelty and ugliness as beauty.自大与好古，也是土人的一个特性。英国人乔治葛来任纽西兰总督的时候，做了一部《多岛海神话》，序里说他著书的目的，并非全为学术，大半是政治上的手段。他说，纽西兰土人是不能同他说理的。只要从他们的神话的历史里，抽出一条相类的事来做一个例，讲给酋长祭师们听，一说便成了。譬如要造一条铁路，倘若对他们说这事如何有益，他们决不肯听；我们如果根据神话，说从前某某大仙，曾推着独轮车在虹霓上走，现在要仿他造一条路，那便无所不可了。（原文已经忘却，以上所说只是大意）中国十三经二十五史，正是酋长祭师们一心崇奉的治国平天下的谱，此后凡与土人有交涉的“西哲”，倘能人手一编，便助成了我们的“东学西渐”，很使土人高兴；但不知那译本的序上写些什么呢？
Arrogance and antiquity are also a characteristic of the natives. When the Englishman George Graham came to New Zealand as governor of New Zealand, he made a "Myth of the Archipelago Sea", in which he said that the purpose of his book was not all academic, but mostly political means. He said that the natives of New Zealand cannot reason with him. Just take a similar thing from the history of their mythology and make an example, tell the chieftain shamans, and it will be done. For example, if you want to build a railway, they will not listen to it if you tell them how it is beneficial; If we say that in the past, a certain immortal used to push a wheelbarrow on a rainbow, and now we want to imitate him to build a road, then everything is possible. (The original text has been forgotten, the above is just the general idea) The Thirteen Classics and Twenty-Five Histories of China are the genealogy of governing the country and pacifying the world wholeheartedly worshipped by the chieftains and shamans. But I don't know what is written in the preface of the translation?

一九一九年

四十三

一九一九年

forty-three进步的美术家，——这是我对于中国美术界的要求。
Progressive artists,—— this is my requirement for the Chinese art world.美术家固然须有精熟的技工，但尤须有进步的思想与高尚的人格。他的制作，表面上是一张画或一个雕像，其实是他的思想与人格的表现。令我们看了，不但欢喜赏玩，尤能发生感动，造成精神上的影响。
Artists must certainly have skilled craftsmen, but they must especially have progressive ideas and noble personalities. His production, on the surface, is a painting or a statue, but in fact it is an expression of his thoughts and personality. It makes us not only enjoy it, but also be moved, causing a spiritual impact.我们所要求的美术家，是能引路的先觉，不是“公民团”的首领。我们所要求的美术品，是表记中国民族知能最高点的标本，不是水平线以下的思想的平均分数。
The artist we are looking for is a foresight that can lead the way, not the leader of the "civic group". The artwork we request is a specimen that represents the highest point of Chinese national knowledge, not the average score of ideas below the horizontal line.近来看见上海什么报的增刊《泼克》上，有几张讽刺画。他的画法，倒也模仿西洋；可是我很疑惑，何以思想如此顽固，人格如此卑劣，竟同没有教育的孩子只会在好好的白粉墙上写几个“某某是我而子”一样。可怜外国事物，一到中国，便如落在黑色染缸里似的，无不失了颜色。美术也是其一：学了体格还未匀称的裸体画，便画猥亵画：学了明暗还未分明的静物画，只能画招牌。皮毛改新，心思仍旧，结果便是如此。至于讽刺画之变为人身攻击的器具，更是无足深怪了。
Recently, I saw several satirical paintings in the supplement "Poke" of Shanghai Newspaper. His painting style also imitates the West; But I was very puzzled as to why my thoughts were so stubborn and my personality was so despicable, just like an uneducated child who would only write a few "so-and-so is my son" on a good white powder wall. Poor foreign things, as soon as they arrive in China, are like falling into a black dye vat, and they all lose their color. Art is also one of them: after learning nude painting with an unproportionate physique, he paints obscene paintings: after learning still life paintings with not yet clear light and dark, he can only paint signs. The fur is renewed, the mind is still the same, and this is the result. As for the transformation of caricature into a tool for personal attacks, it is even more surprising.说起讽刺画，不禁想到美国画家勃拉特来（L．D．Bradley 1853—1917）了。他专画讽刺画，关于欧战的画，尤为有名；只可惜前年死掉了。我见过他一张《秋收时之月》（《The Harvest Moon》）的画。上面是一个形如骷髅的月亮，照着荒田；田里一排一排的都是兵的死尸。唉唉，这才算得真的进步的美术家的讽刺画。我希望将来中国也能有一日，出这样一个进步的讽刺画家。
When it comes to satirical paintings, I can't help but think of the American painter L.D. Bradley (1853-1917). He specializes in satirical paintings, especially paintings about the European War; It's a pity that he died the year before last. I have seen one of his paintings "The Harvest Moon". above is a skull-shaped moon, shining on the barren fields; The rows in the fields were filled with the corpses of soldiers. Alas, this is a satirical painting of a really progressive artist. I hope that in the future, China will one day produce such a progressive satirical painter.

一九一九年

四十六

一九一九年

forty-six民国八年正月间，我在朋友家里见到上海一种什么报的星期增刊讽刺画，正是开宗明义第一回；画着几方小图，大意是骂主张废汉文的人的；说是给外国医生换上外国狗的心了，所以读罗马字时，全是外国狗叫。但在小图的上面，又有两个双钩大字“泼克”，似乎便是这增刊的名目；可是全不像中国话。我因此很觉这美术家可怜：他——对于个人的人身攻击姑且不论——学了外国画，来骂外国话，然而所用的名目又仍然是外国话。讽刺画本可以针砭社会的锢疾；现在施针砭的人的眼光，在一方尺大的纸片上，尚且看不分明，怎能指出确当的方向，引导社会呢？
In the first month of the eighth year of the Republic of China, I saw a weekly supplementary caricature of a newspaper in Shanghai at a friend's house, which was the first time in the founding of the school; draw a few small pictures, to the effect that they are scolding those who advocate the abolition of Chinese; It is said that it is to change the heart of a foreign dog for a foreign doctor, so when reading Roman characters, it is all foreign dog barking. But on the top of the small picture, there are two double-hook big characters "Poke", which seems to be the name of this supplement; But it doesn't sound like Chinese at all. Therefore, I feel very pitiful about this artist: he - regardless of personal attacks - has learned foreign paintings and scolded foreign languages, but the names he uses are still foreign languages. satirical paintings can acupuncture the ills of society; Now the eyes of the needle and needle are still unclear on a piece of paper the size of a foot, so how can they point out the correct direction and guide the society?这几天又见到一张所谓《泼克》，是骂提倡新文艺的人了。大旨是说凡所崇拜的，都是外国的偶像。我因此愈觉这美术家可怜：他学了画，而且画了“泼克”，竟还未知道外国画也是文艺之一。他对于自己的本业，尚且罩在黑坛子里，摸不清楚，怎能有优美的创作，贡献于社会呢？
In the past few days, I have seen another so-called "Pock", which is scolding those who advocate new literature and art. The main idea is that everything worshipped is a foreign idol. Because of this, I feel more and more pitiful about this artist: he learned to paint and painted "Pock", but he didn't know that foreign painting was also one of the literary arts. He is still covered in a black jar for his own business, and he can't figure it out, so how can he create beautiful creations and contribute to society?但“外国偶像”四个字，却亏他想了出来。
But the four words "foreign idol" were thought of by him.不论中外，诚然都有偶像。但外国是破坏偶像的人多；那影响所及，便成功了宗教改革，法国革命。旧像愈摧破，人类便愈进步；所以现在才有比利时的义战，与人道的光明。那达尔文易卜生托尔斯泰尼采诸人，便都是近来偶像破坏的大人物。
Whether at home or abroad, there are indeed idols. But there are many people in foreign countries who destroy idols; The influence was successful, and the Reformation and the French Revolution were successful. The more the old image is destroyed, the more humanity progresses; That's why there is now a Belgian righteous war and the light of humanity. Darwin, Ibsen, Tolstony, and others are all major figures in recent idolatry.在这一流偶像破坏者，《泼克》却完全无用；因为他们都有确固不拔的自信，所以决不理会偶像保护者的嘲骂。易卜生说：
In this class of idol destroyers, "Pock" is completely useless; Because they all have unwavering self-confidence, they will never pay attention to the ridicule of the idol protector. Ibsen said:“我告诉你们，是这个——世界上最强壮有力的人，就是那孤立的人。”（见《国民之敌》）
"I tell you, it's this—the strongest and most powerful person in the world, the isolated one." (See "Enemy of the Nation")但也不理会偶像保护者的恭维。尼采说：
But ignore the compliments of idol protectors. Nietzsche said:“他们又拿着称赞，围住你嗡嗡的叫：他们的称赞是厚脸皮。他们要接近你的皮肤和你的血。”（《札拉图如是说》第二卷《市场之蝇》）
They took the compliments and buzzed around you: their praise was cheeky. They are to be close to your skin and your blood. ("Thus Says Zaratu", Volume 2, "The Fly of the Market")这样，才是创作者。——我辈即使才力不及，不能创作，也该当学习；即使所崇拜的仍然是新偶像，也总比中国陈旧的好。与其崇拜孔丘关羽，还不如崇拜达尔文易卜生；与其牺牲于瘟将军五道神，还不如牺牲于Apollo。
In this way, you are the creator. ——Even if our generation is not talented enough and cannot create, we should still learn; Even if the worship is still a new idol, it is better than the old Chinese one. Instead of worshiping Confucius and Guan Yu, it is better to worship Darwin Ibsen; Instead of sacrificing to the Plague General Five Gods, it is better to sacrifice to Apollo.

一九一九年

四十七

一九一九年

forty-seven有人做了一块象牙片，半寸方，看去也没有什么；用显微镜一照，却看见刻着一篇行书的《兰亭序》。我想：显微镜的所以制造，本为看那些极细微的自然物的；现在既用人工，何妨便刻在一块半尺方的象牙板上，一目了然，省却用显微镜的工夫呢？
Someone made an ivory piece, half an inch square, and it looked nothing; When I looked at it with a microscope, I saw the "Orchid Pavilion Preface" engraved with a running script. I think: the reason why microscopes are made is to look at those extremely subtle natural objects; Now that it is manual, why not engrave it on a half-foot square ivory board, which is clear at a glance and saves the time of using a microscope?张三李四是同时人。张三记了古典来做古文；李四又记了古典，去读张三做的古文。我想：古典是古人的时事，要晓得那时的事，所以免不了翻着古典；现在两位既然同时，何妨老实说出，一目了然，省却你也记古典，我也记古典的工夫呢？
Zhang San and Li Si are contemporaries. Zhang San memorized the classics to make ancient texts; Li Si memorized the classics again and went to read the ancient texts made by Zhang San. I think: the classics are the current affairs of the ancients, and we must know what happened at that time, so it is inevitable to turn to the classics; Now that the two of you are at the same time, why don't you say it honestly, at a glance, save you from remembering the classics, and I also remember the classics?内行的人说：什么话！这是本领，是学问！
The insider said: What are you talking about! This is skill, it is knowledge!我想，幸而中国人中，有这一类本领学问的人还不多。倘若谁也弄这玄虚：农夫送来了一粒粉，用显微镜照了，却是一碗饭；水夫挑来用水湿过的土，想喝茶的又须挤出湿土里的水：那可真要支撑不住了。
I think fortunately, there are not many people in Chinese who have this kind of skill and knowledge. If anyone makes this mystery: the farmer sent a grain of powder, which was illuminated with a microscope, but it was a bowl of rice; The sailor picks up the soil that has been wet with water, and those who want to drink tea have to squeeze out the water from the wet soil: that really can't be supported.

一九一九年

四十八

一九一九年

forty-eight中国人对于异族，历来只有两样称呼：一样是禽兽，一样是圣上。从没有称他朋友，说他也同我们一样的。
Chinese people have always had only two names for foreign races: the same is a beast, and the other is a saint. He never called him a friend, saying that he was the same as us.古书里的弱水，竟是骗了我们：闻所未闻的外国人到了；交手几回，渐知道“子曰诗云”似乎无用，于是乎要维新。
The weak water in the ancient book actually deceived us: unheard of foreigners have arrived; After fighting a few times, I gradually realized that "Ziyue Shiyun" seemed useless, so I wanted to renovate it.维新以后，中国富强了，用这学来的新，打出外来的新，关上大门，再来守旧。
After the Restoration, China became rich and strong, and used this new learning, played the new outside, closed the door, and then came to the old.可惜维新单是皮毛，关门也不过一梦。外国的新事理，却愈来愈多，愈优胜，“子曰诗云”也愈挤愈苦，愈看愈无用。于是从那两样旧称呼以外，别想了一样新号：“西哲”或曰“西儒”。
Unfortunately, the Restoration is just a superficial thing, and closing the door is just a dream. There are more and more new things in foreign countries, and the more they are superior, the more they are squeezed and the more they are looked, the more useless they are. So in addition to those two old names, I thought of a new name: "Western Philosophy" or "Western Confucianism".他们的称号虽然新了，我们的意见却照旧。因为“西哲”的本领虽然要学，“子曰诗云”也更要昌明。换几句话，便是学了外国本领，保存中国旧习。本领要新，思想要旧。要新本领旧思想的新人物，驼了旧本领旧思想的旧人物，请他发挥多年经验的老本领。一言以蔽之：前几年谓之“中学为体，西学为用”，这几年谓之“因时制宜，折衷至当”。
Although their titles are new, our opinions are the same. Because although the ability of "Western philosophy" has to be learned, "Ziyue Shiyun" is also more prosperous. In other words, it is to learn foreign skills and preserve old Chinese habits. Skills should be new, and thoughts should be old. If you want a new person with new skills and old ideas, you can hump the old person with old skills and old ideas, and ask him to give full play to his old skills with many years of experience. In a word, it was said that in the past few years, it was called "middle school as the body, Western learning as the application", and in recent years, it has been called "adapting to the situation and compromising to the appropriate".其实世界上决没有这样如意的事。即使一头牛，连生命都牺牲了，尚且祀了孔便不能耕田，吃了肉便不能搾乳。何况一个人先须自己活着，又要驼了前辈先生活着；活着的时候，又须恭听前辈先生的折衷：早上打拱，晚上握手；上午“声光化电”，下午“子曰诗云”呢？
In fact, there is no such thing as a satisfactory thing in the world. Even if a cow sacrifices its life, it cannot cultivate the field if it is sacrificed, and it cannot milk if it eats meat. What's more, a person must live by himself first, and he must live by his predecessors first; When you are alive, you must listen to the compromises of your predecessors: arching in the morning and shaking hands at night; What about "sound, light, chemical and electricity" in the morning and "Ziyue Shiyun" in the afternoon?社会上最迷信鬼神的人，尚且只能在赛会这一日抬一回神舆。不知那些学“声光化电”的“新进英贤”，能否驼着山野隐逸，海滨遗老，折衷一世？
The most superstitious people in society can only carry the shrine once on the day of the competition. I wonder if those "new heroes" who learn "sound, light, chemistry and electricity" can hunch over the mountains and fields, the old people on the seaside, and compromise for a lifetime?“西哲”易卜生盖以为不能，以为不可。所以借了Brand的嘴说：“All or nothing！”
"Western philosopher" Ibsen probably thought it was impossible, thought it was impossible. So he borrowed Brand's mouth and said, "All or nothing!" ”

一九一九年

四十九

一九一九年

forty-nine凡有高等动物，倘没有遇着意外的变故，总是从幼到壮，从壮到老，从老到死。
All higher animals, if they do not encounter unexpected changes, will always go from young to strong, from strong to old, from old to dead.我们从幼到壮，既然毫不为奇的过去了；自此以后，自然也该毫不为奇的过去。
We have passed from childhood to adulthood, since it is not surprising; Since then, it should be no surprise that the past should not be surprising.可惜有一种人，从幼到壮，居然也毫不为奇的过去了；从壮到老，便有点古怪；从老到死，却更奇想天开，要占尽了少年的道路，吸尽了少年的空气。
It's a pity that there is a kind of person who has passed from childhood to adulthood without surprise; from strong to old, it is a bit strange; From old age to death, but it is even more whimsical, and it wants to occupy the path of the teenager and suck up the air of the teenager.少年在这时候，只能先行萎黄，且待将来老了，神经血管一切变质以后，再来活动。所以社会上的状态，先是“少年老成”；直待弯腰曲背时期，才更加“逸兴遄飞”，似乎从此以后，才上了做人的路。
At this time, the teenager can only chlorosis first, and wait until he is old in the future and all the nerves and blood vessels are deteriorated before he can move. Therefore, the state of society is first "young and mature"; It was not until the period of bending over that he became more "prosperous", and it seemed that from then on, he embarked on the road of being a human being.可是究竟也不能自忘其老；所以想求神仙。大约别的都可以老，只有自己不肯老的人物，总该推中国老先生算一甲一名。
But in the end, you can't forget your old age; So I want to ask for immortals. Probably everything else can be old, only the characters who refuse to grow old should always be pushed to be the first in the world.万一当真成了神仙，那便永远请他主持，不必再有后进，原也是极好的事。可惜他又究竟不成，终于个个死去，只留下造成的老天地，教少年驼着吃苦。
In case he really becomes a god, then he will always be asked to preside, and there is no need to have any backwards, which is also an excellent thing. It's a pity that he didn't succeed in the end, and finally died one by one, leaving only the old world he caused, teaching the young man to hump and endure hardship.这真是生物界的怪现象！
This is really a strange phenomenon in the biological world!我想种族的延长，——便是生命的连续，——的确是生物界事业里的一大部分。何以要延长呢？不消说是想进化了。但进化的途中总须新陈代谢。所以新的应该欢天喜地的向前走去，这便是壮，旧的也应该欢天喜地的向前走去，这便是死；各各如此走去，便是进化的路。
I think the extension of race ,—— is the continuity of life,—— which is indeed a large part of the cause of the biological world. Why do you want to extend it? Needless to say, I want to evolve. But metabolism is always required in the process of evolution. Therefore, the new should move forward joyfully, which is strong, and the old should also move forward joyfully, which is death; If everyone goes like this, it is the path of evolution.老的让开道，催促着，奖励着，让他们走去。路上有深渊，便用那个死填平了，让他们走去。
The old man gave way, urged, rewarded, and let them go. There was an abyss on the road, so he filled it with that death and let them go.少的感谢他们填了深渊，给自己走去；老的也感谢他们从我填平的深渊上走去。——远了远了。
Thank you for filling the abyss and walking for yourself; The old ones also thanked them for walking from the abyss I filled. - Far away.明白这事，便从幼到壮到老到死，都欢欢喜喜的过去；而且一步一步，多是超过祖先的新人。
Understanding this, they will go through happily from childhood to old age to death; And step by step, most of them are newcomers who surpass their ancestors.这是生物界正当开阔的路！人类的祖先，都已这样做了。
This is the right way for the biological world! The ancestors of mankind have done this.

一九一九年

五十三

一九一九年

fifty-three上海盛德坛扶乩，由“孟圣”主坛；在北京便有城隍白知降坛，说他是“邪鬼”。盛德坛后来却又有什么真人下降，谕别人不得擅自扶乩。
Shanghai Shengde Altar is supported by "Mengsheng"; In Beijing, there is a city god Bai Zhijiang altar, saying that he is an "evil ghost". Later, Shengde Altar had some real people descending, instructing others not to help them without authorization.北京议员王讷提议推行新武术，以“强国强种”；中华武士会便率领了一班天罡拳阴截腿之流，大分冤单，说他“抑制暴弃祖性相传之国粹”。
Beijing lawmaker Wang Ne proposed to promote new martial arts to "strengthen the country and strengthen the species"; The Chinese Samurai Association led a group of Tiangang Quan Yin Leg Amputation and others, and said that he "suppressed the abandonment of the national essence of ancestral inheritance".绿帜社提倡“爱世语”，专门崇拜“柴圣”，说别种国际语（如Ido等）是冒牌的。
The Green Flag Society advocates "love the world", specially worships "Chai Sheng", and speaking other international languages (such as Ido, etc.) is counterfeit.上海有一种单行的《泼克》，又有一种报上增刊的《泼克》；后来增刊《泼克》登广告声明要将送错的单行《泼克》的信件撕破。
In Shanghai, there is a single line of "Poke", and there is also a kind of "Poke" in the newspaper; Later, the supplement "Pop" advertised that it would tear up the wrong single line of "Pop" letter.上海有许多“美术家”；其中的一个美术家，不知如何散了伙，便在《泼克》上大骂别的美术家“盲目盲心”，不知道新艺术真艺术。
There are many "artists" in Shanghai; One of the artists, who didn't know how to break up, scolded other artists for being "blind and blind" in "Pock" and didn't know what Art Nouveau was true art.以上五种同业的内讧，究竟是什么原因，局外人本来不得而知。但总觉现在时势不很太平，无论新的旧的，都各各起哄：扶乩打拳那些鬼画符的东西，倒也罢了；学几句世界语，画几笔花，也是高雅的事，难道也要同行嫉妬，必须声明鱼目混珠，雷击火焚么？
Outsiders did not know what the reasons for the above five types of infighting among peers were. But I always feel that the current situation is not very peaceful, whether it is new or old, everyone is coaxing: Fu Yi punches those ghostly talismans, it's okay; Learning a few words of Esperanto and drawing a few strokes of flowers is also an elegant thing, do you have to be jealous of your peers, must you declare that the eyes of the fish are mixed with pearls, and the lightning strikes and fire?我对于那“美术家”的内讧又格外失望。我于美术虽然全是门外汉，但很望中国有新兴美术出现。现在上海那班美术家所做的，是否算得美术，原是难说；但他们既然自称美术家，即使幼稚，也可以希望长成：所以我期望有个美术家的幼虫，不要是似是而非的木叶蝶。如今见了他们两方面的成绩，不免令我对于中国美术前途发生一种怀疑。
I was particularly disappointed with the infighting of the "artist". Although I am a layman in art, I hope that new art will emerge in China. It is difficult to say whether what the artists in Shanghai are doing now is considered art; But since they call themselves artists, even if they are naïve, they can still hope to grow up: so I hope that there will be an artist's larvae, not a plausible Konoha butterfly. Now that I have seen their achievements in both aspects, I can't help but have doubts about the future of Chinese art.画《泼克》的美术家说他们盲目盲心，所研究的只是十九世纪的美术，不晓得有新艺术真艺术。我看这些美术家的作品，不是剥制的鹿，便是畸形的美人，的确不甚高明，恐怕连十“八”世纪，也未必有这类绘画：说到底，只好算是中国的所谓美术罢了。但那一位画《泼克》的美术家的批评，却又不甚可解：研究十九世纪的美术，何以便是盲目盲心？十九世纪以后的新艺术真艺术，又是怎样？我听人说：后期印象派（Postimpressionism）的绘画，在今日总还不算十分陈旧；其中的大人物如Cézanne与Van Gogh等，也是十九世纪后半的人，最迟的到一九〇六年也故去了。二十世纪才是十九年初头，好像还没有新派兴起。立方派（Cubism）未来派（Futurism）的主张，虽然新奇，却尚未能确立基础；而且在中国，又怕未必能够理解。在那《泼克》上面，也未见有这一派的绘画；不知那《泼克》美术家的所谓新艺术真艺术，究竟是指着什么？现在的中国美术家诚然心盲目盲，但其弊却不在单研究十九世纪的美术，——因为据我看来，他们并不研究什么世纪的美术，——所以那《泼克》美术家的话，实在令人难解。
The artists who painted "Pock" said that they were blind and blind, and only studied the art of the 19th century, and did not know that there was art nouveau and true art. I see that the works of these artists, either taxidermy deer or deformed beauties, are indeed not very clever, and I am afraid that even in the 18th century, there may not be such paintings: in the final analysis, they can only be regarded as so-called Chinese art. But the criticism of the artist who painted "Pock" is not very understandable: why is it blind to study nineteenth-century art? What about the new art and true art after the 19th century? I have heard people say that Postimpressionist painting is not very old today; Among them, big figures such as Cézanne and Van Gogh were also from the second half of the nineteenth century, and died as late as 1906. The twentieth century is the beginning of the nineteenth century, and it seems that there is no new school rising. The ideas of Cubism and Futurism, although novel, have not yet been able to establish a foundation; And in China, I am afraid that it may not be understandable. There is no painting of this school on the "Pock"; I don't know what the so-called Art Nouveau true art of the artist "Pock" refers to? It is true that Chinese artists today are blind and blind, but their disadvantage is not only in studying the art of the 19th century,—— because in my opinion, they do not study the art of any century,—— so the words of the artist "Pock" are really incomprehensible.《泼克》美术家满口说新艺术真艺术，想必自己懂得这新艺术真艺术的了。但我看他所画的讽刺画，多是攻击新文艺新思想的。——这是二十世纪的美术么？这是新艺术真艺术么？
The artist of "Pop" is full of words about art nouveau and true art, and he must understand this new art and true art. But I see that most of the satirical paintings he paints attack new literature and new ideas. ——Is this the art of the twentieth century? Is this art nouveau real art?

一九一九年

五十四

一九一九年

fifty-four中国社会上的状态，简直是将几十世纪缩在一时：自油松片以至电灯，自独轮车以至飞机，自镖枪以至机关炮，自不许“妄谈法理”以至护法，自“食肉寝皮”的吃人思想以至人道主义，自迎尸拜蛇以至美育代宗教，都摩肩挨背的存在。
The state of Chinese society is simply shrinking dozens of centuries into a moment: from pine chips to electric lights, from wheelbarrows to airplanes, from dartsguns to machine guns, from "talking nonsense" to protecting the law, from the cannibalistic ideology of "eating meat and sleeping on the skin" to humanitarianism, from welcoming corpses and worshiping snakes to aesthetic education and religion, they are all rubbing shoulders with each other.这许多事物挤在一处，正如我辈约了燧人氏以前的古人，拼开饭店一般，即使竭力调和，也只能煮个半熟；伙计们既不会同心，生意也自然不能兴旺，——店铺总要倒闭。
These many things are crowded in one place, just like the ancients before we made an appointment with the Suiren clan and opened a restaurant, even if we tried our best to reconcile, we could only cook it half-cooked; The guys will not be united, and the business will naturally not prosper,—— the store will always close.黄郛氏做的《欧战之教训与中国之将来》中，有一段话，说得很透澈：
In Huang Feng's "Lessons from the European War and China's Future", there is a passage that says it very clearly:“七年以来，朝野有识之士，每腐心于政教之改良，不注意于习俗之转移；庸讵知旧染不去，新运不生：事理如此，无可勉强者也。外人之评我者，谓中国人有一种先天的保守性，即或迫于时势，各种制度有改革之必要时，而彼之所谓改革者，决不将旧日制度完全废止，乃在旧制度之上，更添加一层新制度。试览前清之兵制变迁史，可以知吾言之不谬焉。最初命八旗兵驻防各地，以充守备之任；及年月既久，旗兵已腐败不堪用，洪秀全起，不得已，征募湘淮两军以应急：从此旗兵绿营，并肩存在，遂变成二重兵制。甲午战后，知绿营兵力又不可恃，乃复编练新式军队：于是并前二者而变成三重兵制矣。今旗兵虽已消灭，而变面换形之绿营，依然存在，总是二重兵制也。从可知吾国人之无澈底改革能力，实属不可掩之事实。他若贺阳历新年者，复贺阴历新年；奉民国正朔者，仍存宣统年号。一察社会各方面，盖无往而非二重制。即今日政局之所以不宁，是非之所以无定者，简括言之，实亦不过一种‘二重思想’在其间作祟而已。”
“七年以来，朝野有识之士，每腐心于政教之改良，不注意于习俗之转移；庸讵知旧染不去，新运不生：事理如此，无可勉强者也。 外人之评我者，谓中国人有一种先天的保守性，即或迫于时势，各种制度有改革之必要时，而彼之所谓改革者，决不将旧日制度完全废止，乃在旧制度之上，更添加一层新制度。 试览前清之兵制变迁史，可以知吾言之不谬焉。 最初命八旗兵驻防各地，以充守备之任；及年月既久，旗兵已腐败不堪用，洪秀全起，不得已，征募湘淮两军以应急：从此旗兵绿营，并肩存在，遂变成二重兵制。 甲午战后，知绿营兵力又不可恃，乃复编练新式军队：于是并前二者而变成三重兵制矣。 今旗兵虽已消灭，而变面换形之绿营，依然存在，总是二重兵制也。 从可知吾国人之无澈底改革能力，实属不可掩之事实。 他若贺阳历新年者，复贺阴历新年；奉民国正朔者，仍存宣统年号。 一察社会各方面，盖无往而非二重制。 即今日政局之所以不宁，是非之所以无定者，简括言之，实亦不过一种‘二重思想’在其间作祟而已。 ”此外如既许信仰自由，却又特别尊孔；既自命“胜朝遗老”，却又在民国拿钱；既说是应该革新，却又主张复古：四面八方几乎都是二三重以至多重的事物，每重又各各自相矛盾。一切人便都在这矛盾中间，互相抱怨着过活，谁也没有好处。
In addition, if you allow freedom of belief, you will be particularly respectful; not only calls himself a "victorious old man", but also takes money in the Republic of China; It is said that it should be innovated, but it also advocates retro: almost all directions are two, three or more things, and each layer is contradictory. Everyone is in the middle of this contradiction, complaining to each other and living without benefiting anyone.要想进步，要想太平，总得连根的拔去了“二重思想”。因为世界虽然不小，但彷徨的人种，是终竟寻不出位置的。
If you want to make progress and want peace, you must uproot the "double thinking". Because although the world is not small, the hesitant race will never find a place.

一九一九年

五十六　“来了”

一九一九年

56 "Here it comes"近来时常听得人说，“过激主义来了”；报纸上也时常写着，“过激主义来了”。
Recently, I often hear people say, "Extremism is coming"; Newspapers often say, "Extremism is coming."于是有几文钱的人，很不高兴。官员也着忙，要防华工，要留心俄国人；连警察厅也向所属发出了严查“有无过激党设立机关”的公事。
So the people who had a few pennies were very unhappy. Officials are also busy, to guard against Chinese workers and to pay attention to the Russians; Even the National Police Department issued an official order to strictly investigate "whether there are any extremist party establishments".着忙是无怪的，严查也无怪的；但先要问：什么是过激主义呢？
There is nothing strange about being busy, and there is nothing strange about strict investigation; But first, let's ask: what is extremism?这是他们没有说明，我也无从知道，我虽然不知道，却敢说一句话：“过激主义”不会来，不必怕他；只有“来了”是要来的，应该怕的。
This is something they didn't explain, and I have no way of knowing, although I don't know, I dare to say one sentence: "Extremism" will not come, don't be afraid of him; Only "coming" is coming, and it should be feared.我们中国人，决不能被洋货的什么主义引动，有抹杀他扑灭他的力量。军国民主义么，我们何尝会同别人打仗；无抵抗主义么，我们却是主战参战的；自由主义么，我们连发表思想都要犯罪，讲几句话也为难；人道主义么，我们人身还可以买卖呢。
We Chinese must not be attracted by the doctrine of foreign goods, and have the power to erase him and extinguish him. military-nationalism, why would we fight with others; There is no resistance, but we are the main battle and participate in the war; Liberalism, we even have to commit a crime to express our thoughts, and it is difficult to say a few words; Humanitarian, we can still buy and sell our lives.所以无论什么主义，全扰乱不了中国；从古到今的扰乱，也不听说因为什么主义。试举目前的例，便如陕西学界的布告，湖南灾民的布告，何等可怕，与比利时公布的德兵苛酷情形，俄国别党宣布的列宁政府残暴情形，比较起来，他们简直是太平天下了。德国还说是军国主义，列宁不消说还是过激主义哩！
Therefore, no matter what doctrine it is, it cannot disturb China; From ancient times to the present, I have not heard of anythingism. To give the current example, such as the announcement of the Shaanxi academic circles and the announcement of the victims of Hunan, how terrible it is, compared with the harsh situation of the German soldiers announced in Belgium and the brutality of the Lenin government announced by the Russian party, they are simply peaceful. Germany also said that it was militarism, and Lenin was still extremist!这便是“来了”来了。来的如果是主义，主义达了还会罢；倘若单是“来了”，他便来不完，来不尽，来的怎样也不可知。
This is "coming". If it is a doctrine, it will be done when the doctrine is reached; If it is just "coming", he will not be able to come, he will not be exhausted, and it is impossible to know how he will come.民国成立的时候，我住在一个小县城里，早已挂过白旗。有一日，忽然见许多男女，纷纷乱逃：城里的逃到乡下，乡下的逃进城里。问他们什么事，他们答道，“他们说要来了。”
When the Republic of China was founded, I lived in a small county and had already flown the white flag. One day, I suddenly saw many men and women fleeing one after another: those in the city fled to the countryside, and those in the countryside fled into the city. Ask them what they are doing, and they answer, "They say they are coming." ”可见大家都单怕“来了”，同我一样。那时还只有“多数主义”，没有“过激主义”哩。
It can be seen that everyone is afraid of "coming", just like me. At that time, there was only "majoritarianism" and no "radicalism".

一九一九年

五十七　现在的屠杀者

一九一九年

57 The current slayer高雅的人说，“白话鄙俚浅陋，不值识者一哂之者也。”
Elegant people said, "The vernacular is vulgar and shallow, and it is not worth the sake of those who know it." ”中国不识字的人，单会讲话，“鄙俚浅陋”，不必说了。“因为自己不通，所以提倡白话，以自文其陋”如我辈的人，正是“鄙俚浅陋”，也不在话下了。最可叹的是几位雅人，也还不能如《镜花缘》里说的君子国的酒保一般，满口“酒要一壶乎，两壶乎，菜要一碟乎，两碟乎”的终日高雅，却只能在呻吟古文时，显出高古品格；一到讲话，便依然是“鄙俚浅陋”的白话了。四万万中国人嘴里发出来的声音，竟至总共“不值一哂”，真是可怜煞人。
Chinese illiterate people can only speak, "vulgar and shallow", needless to say. "Because I don't understand, I advocate the vernacular and write my own ugliness" People like me are "vulgar and shallow", and it is not a problem. The most lamentable thing is that a few elegant people cannot be like the bartenders of the country of Junzi mentioned in "Mirror Flower Edge", full of "wine needs one pot, two pots, food needs one plate, two plates" all day long, but can only show ancient character when moaning ancient texts; As soon as it comes to speech, it is still a "vulgar and shallow" vernacular. The voices that come out of the mouths of 40 million Chinese people are really pitiful.做了人类想成仙；生在地上要上天；明明是现代人，吸着现在的空气，却偏要勒派朽腐的名教，僵死的语言，侮蔑尽现在，这都是“现在的屠杀者”。杀了“现在”，也便杀了“将来”。——将来是子孙的时代。
I want to become an immortal as a human being; Be born on earth and go to heaven; Obviously modern people, sucking the air of the present, but they want to send rotten famous religions, dead language, and insult the present, these are all "current slaughterers". If you kill the "now", you will also kill the "future". ——The future is the era of children and grandchildren.
