五十八　人心很古

一九一九年

五十八 人心很古慷慨激昂的人说，“世道浇漓，人心不古，国粹将亡，此吾所为仰天扼腕切齿三叹息者也！”
慷慨激昂的人说，“世道浇漓，人心不古，国粹将亡，此吾所为仰天扼腕切齿三叹息者也！”我初听这话，也曾大吃一惊；后来翻翻旧书，偶然看见《史记》《赵世家》里面记着公子成反对主父改胡服的一段话：
When I first heard this, I was also surprised; Later, when I flipped through the old books, I happened to see a passage in the "Historical Records" and "Zhao Family" that recorded Gongzi Cheng's opposition to the lord's father's change to Hu clothes:“臣闻中国者，盖聪明徇智之所居也，万物财用之所聚也，贤圣之所教也，仁义之所施也，《诗》《书》礼乐之所用也，异敏技能之所试也，远方之所观赴也，蛮夷之所义行也；今王舍此而袭远方之服，变古之教，易古之道，逆人之心，而怫学者，离中国，故臣愿王图之也。”
“臣闻中国者，盖聪明徇智之所居也，万物财用之所聚也，贤圣之所教也，仁义之所施也，《诗》《书》礼乐之所用也，异敏技能之所试也，远方之所观赴也，蛮夷之所义行也；今王舍此而袭远方之服，变古之教，易古之道，逆人之心，而怫学者，离中国，故臣愿王图之也。 ”这不是与现在阻抑革新的人的话，丝毫无异么？后来又在《北史》里看见记周静帝的司马后的话：
Isn't this no different from the words of those who are currently blocking innovation? Later, in the "History of the North", I saw the words of Empress Sima who recorded Emperor Jing of Zhou:“后性尤妒忌，后宫莫敢进御。尉迟迥女孙有美色，先在宫中，帝于仁寿宫见而悦之，因得幸。后伺帝听朝，阴杀之。上大怒，单骑从苑中出，不由径路，入山谷间三十余里；高颎杨素等追及，扣马谏，帝太息曰，‘吾贵为天子，不得自由。’”
“后性尤妒忌，后宫莫敢进御。 尉迟迥女孙有美色，先在宫中，帝于仁寿宫见而悦之，因得幸。 后伺帝听朝，阴杀之。 上大怒，单骑从苑中出，不由径路，入山谷间三十余里；高颎杨素等追及，扣马谏，帝太息曰，‘吾贵为天子，不得自由。 ’”这又不是与现在信口主张自由和反对自由的人，对于自由所下的解释，丝毫无异么？别的例证，想必还多，我见闻狭隘，不能多举了。但即此看来，已可见虽然经过了这许多年，意见还是一样。现在的人心，实在古得很呢。
Isn't this no different from the interpretation of freedom given by those who advocate freedom and oppose freedom now? There must be many other examples, but I am too narrow to give more. But from this point of view, it can be seen that although many years have passed, the opinion is still the same. Today's people's hearts are really old.中国人倘能努力再古一点，也未必不能有古到三皇五帝以前的希望，可惜时时遇着新潮流新空气激荡着，没有工夫了。
If the Chinese can work hard to be a little more ancient, they may not be able to have hope from ancient times to the Three Sovereigns and Five Emperors, but unfortunately there is no time to encounter new trends and new air all the time.在现存的旧民族中，最合中国式理想的，总要推锡兰岛的Vedda族。他们和外界毫无交涉，也不受别民族的影响，还是原始的状态，真不愧所谓“羲皇上人”。
Among the existing old ethnic groups, the most Chinese ideal is always the Vedda tribe of Ceylon. They have no negotiations with the outside world, nor are they influenced by other ethnic groups, and they are still in a primitive state, which is truly worthy of the so-called "Xihuang Master".但听说他们人口年年减少，现在快要没有了：这实在是一件万分可惜的事。
But I heard that their population is decreasing year by year, and now it is almost gone: this is a great pity.

一九一九年

五十九　“圣武”

一九一九年

59 "Shengwu"我前回已经说过“什么主义都与中国无干”的话了；今天忽然又有些意见，便再写在下面：
I have already said last time that "any doctrine has nothing to do with China"; Today, I suddenly have some opinions, so I will write them below:我想，我们中国本不是发生新主义的地方，也没有容纳新主义的处所，即使偶然有些外来思想，也立刻变了颜色，而且许多论者反要以此自豪。我们只要留心译本上的序跋，以及各样对于外国事情的批评议论，便能发见我们和别人的思想中间，的确还隔着几重铁壁。他们是说家庭问题的，我们却以为他鼓吹打仗；他们是写社会缺点的，我们却说他讲笑话；他们以为好的，我们说来却是坏的。若再留心看看别国的国民性格，国民文学，再翻一本文人的评传，便更能明白别国著作里写出的性情，作者的思想，几乎全不是中国所有。所以不会了解，不会同情，不会感应；甚至彼我间的是非爱憎，也免不了得到一个相反的结果。
I think that China is not a place where neologism occurs, nor is there a place for newism, and even if there are occasional foreign ideas, they immediately change color, and many commentators are proud of this. As long as we pay attention to the preface on the translation and all kinds of criticism and discussion on foreign affairs, we can find that there are indeed several iron walls between our thoughts and those of others. They are talking about family problems, but we think he advocates war; They write about social shortcomings, but we say he tells jokes; What they think is good is bad for us. If you pay attention to the national character and literature of other countries, and then look at the commentaries of writers, you can better understand that the temperament and thoughts written in the writings of other countries are almost all not owned by China. So they won't understand, sympathize, or sense; Even the right and wrong between us and ourselves will inevitably lead to the opposite result.新主义宣传者是放火人么，也须别人有精神的燃料，才会着火；是弹琴人么，别人的心上也须有弦索，才会出声；是发声器么，别人也必须是发声器，才会共鸣。中国人都有些不很像，所以不会相干。
Are the propagandists of the new doctrine arsonists, and they also need the spiritual fuel of others to catch fire; Is it a piano player, and other people's hearts must also have strings to make a sound; Is it a sounder, others must also be a sounder to resonate. Chinese people are a little different, so they don't matter.几位读者怕要生气，说，“中国时常有将性命去殉他主义的人，中华民国以来，也因为主义上死了多少烈士，你何以一笔抹杀？吓！”这话也是真的。我们从旧的外来思想说罢，六朝的确有许多焚身的和尚，唐朝也有过砍下臂膊布施无赖的和尚；从新的说罢，自然也有过几个人的。然而与中国历史，仍不相干。因为历史结帐，不能像数学一般精密，写下许多小数，却只能学粗人算帐的四舍五入法门，记一笔整数。
Several readers were afraid of getting angry and said, "There are often people in China who sacrifice their lives for otherism, and since the Republic of China, how many martyrs have died because of doctrine, why do you erase them in one stroke?" Scare! This is also true. Let's talk about the old foreign thinking, there were indeed many monks who burned themselves in the Six Dynasties, and there were also monks who cut off their arms to give to scoundrels in the Tang Dynasty; From the new point of view, there have naturally been several people. However, it is still irrelevant to Chinese history. Because historical settlement cannot be as precise as mathematics, write down many decimals, but can only learn the rounding method of rough people and record an integer.中国历史的整数里面，实在没有什么思想主义在内。这整数只是两种物质，——是刀与火，“来了”便是他的总名。
There is really no ideology in the whole number of Chinese history. This integer is just two substances,—— knife and fire, and "coming" is his general name.火从北来便逃向南，刀从前来便退向后，一大堆流水帐簿，只有这一个模型。倘嫌“来了”的名称不很庄严，“刀与火”也触目，我们也可以别想花样，奉献一个谥法，称作“圣武”，便好看了。
The fire fled from the north to the south, the knife retreated from the front, and there was only this one model. If you think that the name of "coming" is not very solemn, and "knife and fire" is also eye-catching, we can also think of tricks and dedicate a posthumous name, called "Shengwu", which will be good-looking.古时候，秦始皇帝很阔气，刘邦和项羽都看见了；邦说，“嗟乎！大丈夫当如此也！”羽说，“彼可取而代也！”羽要“取”什么呢？便是取邦所说的“如此”。“如此”的程度，虽有不同，可是谁也想取；被取的是“彼”，取的是“丈夫”。所有“彼”与“丈夫”的心中，便都是这“圣武”的产生所，受纳所。
In ancient times, Qin Shi Huang was very generous, and Liu Bang and Xiang Yu both saw it; Bang said, "Oh! A man should be like this! Yu said, "He can be replaced!" What does "Yu" take? It is what the state said "so". Although the degree of "so" is different, everyone wants to take it; It is "he" that is taken, and it is taken as "husband". In the hearts of all "he" and "husband", it is the place where this "holy martial arts" are born and received.何谓“如此”？说起来话长；简单地说，便只是纯粹兽性方面的欲望的满足——威福，子女，玉帛，——罢了。然而在一切大小丈夫，却要算最高理想（？）了。我怕现在的人，还被这理想支配着。
What does "so" mean? It's a long story; To put it simply, it is just the satisfaction of pure animal desires - power, children, jade and silk,—— However, in all husbands, it is the highest ideal (?) It's over. I am afraid that people today are still dominated by this ideal.大丈夫“如此”之后，欲望没有衰，身体却疲敝了；而且觉得暗中有一个黑影——死——到了身边了。于是无法，只好求神仙。这在中国，也要算最高理想了。我怕现在的人，也还被这理想支配着。
After the husband is "like this", his desire does not decline, but his body is exhausted; And I feel that there is a dark shadow - death - that is close to me. So I had no choice but to ask for immortals. This is also the highest ideal in China. I am afraid that people today are still dominated by this ideal.求了一通神仙，终于没有见，忽然有些疑惑了。于是要造坟，来保存死尸，想用自己的尸体，永远占据着一块地面。这在中国，也要算一种没奈何的最高理想了。我怕现在的人，也还被这理想支配着。
I asked for an immortal, but finally I didn't see it, and suddenly I was a little confused. So he wanted to build a grave to preserve the dead body, and wanted to use his own body to occupy a piece of the ground forever. In China, this is also a helpless highest ideal. I am afraid that people today are still dominated by this ideal.现在的外来思想，无论如何，总不免有些自由平等的气息，互助共存的气息，在我们这单有“我”，单想“取彼”，单要由我喝尽了一切空间时间的酒的思想界上，实没有插足的余地。
In today's foreign thinking, no matter what, there is inevitably some atmosphere of freedom and equality, the atmosphere of mutual assistance and coexistence, and there is really no room for intervention in our ideological circle, where we only have "me", only want to "take the other", and only want to drink all the wine of space and time.因此，只须防那“来了”便够了。看看别国，抗拒这“来了”的便是有主义的人民。他们因为所信的主义，牺牲了别的一切，用骨肉碰钝了锋刃，血液浇灭了烟焰。在刀光火色衰微中，看出一种薄明的天色，便是新世纪的曙光。
Therefore, it is enough to guard against the "coming". Looking at other countries, it is the people who resist this "coming". Because of the doctrine they believed in, they sacrificed everything else, dull the blade with their flesh and blood, and extinguish the flames with their blood. In the fading color of the sword and fire, a thin sky is seen, which is the dawn of the new century.曙光在头上，不抬起头，便永远只能看见物质的闪光。
The dawn is on the head, and if you don't raise your head, you can only see the flash of matter forever.

一九一九年

六十一　不满

一九一九年

61 Dissatisfied欧战才了的时候，中国很抱着许多希望，因此现在也发出许多悲观绝望的声音，说“世界上没有人道”，“人道这句话是骗人的”。有几位评论家，还引用了他们外国论者自己责备自己的文字，来证明所谓文明人者，比野蛮尤其野蛮。
When the European war was just over, China had a lot of hopes, so now it is also making many pessimistic and desperate voices, saying that "there is no humanity in the world" and "the word humanity is a lie". Several critics also quoted their own reproach of foreign theorists to prove that the so-called civilized man is more barbaric than barbarism.这诚然是痛快淋漓的话，但要问：照我们的意见，怎样才算有人道呢？那答话，想来大约是“收回治外法权，收回租界，退还庚子赔款……”现在都很渺茫，实在不合人道。
This is indeed a cheerful statement, but we have to ask: in our opinion, what is humane? The answer is, I think, "recovering extraterritoriality, recovering the concession, and returning the Gengzi reparation......" is now very slim and really inhumane.但又要问：我们中国的人道怎么样？那答话，想来只能“……”。对于人道只能“……”的人的头上，决不会掉下人道来。因为人道是要各人竭力挣来，培植，保养的，不是别人布施，捐助的。
But I have to ask: How is our humanity in China? That answer can only be "......". Humanity will never fall on the heads of people who can only "......" humanity. Because humanity requires everyone to earn, cultivate, and maintain with all their might, not by others to give or donate.其实近于真正的人道，说的人还不很多，并且说了还要犯罪。若论皮毛，却总算略有进步了。这回虽然是一场恶战，也居然没有“食肉寝皮”，没有“夷其社稷”，而且新兴了十八个小国。就是德国对待比国，都说残暴绝伦，但看比国的公布，也只是囚徒不给饮食，村长挨了打骂，平民送上战线之类。这些事情，在我们中国自己对自己也常有，算得什么希奇？
In fact, it is close to true humanity, and there are not many people who say it, and they will commit crimes. When it comes to fur, it's finally a slight improvement. Although this time it was a fierce battle, there was no "eating meat and sleeping skin", there was no "razing the state", and eighteen small countries were emerging. Even Germany treated Belgium and said that it was extremely brutal, but looking at the announcement of Belgium, it was only that prisoners were not given food, village chiefs were beaten and scolded, and civilians were sent to the front line. These things are common to us in China, what is the surprise?人类尚未长成，人道自然也尚未长成，但总在那里发荣滋长。我们如果问问良心，觉得一样滋长，便什么都不必忧愁；将来总要走同一的路。看罢，他们是战胜军国主义的，他们的评论家还是自己责备自己，有许多不满。不满是向上的车轮，能够载着不自满的人类，向人道前进。
Human beings have not yet grown up, and humanity has not yet grown, but it always flourishes and grows there. If we ask our conscience and feel that it is the same, we will not have to worry about anything; In the future, we will always follow the same path. After all, they have overcome militarism, and their critics still blame themselves and have many grievances. Dissatisfaction is an upward wheel that can carry dissatisfied humanity and move towards humanity.多有不自满的人的种族，永远前进，永远有希望。
There are many races of dissatisfied people, always moving forward, always hopeful.多有只知责人不知反省的人的种族，祸哉祸哉！
There are many races that only know how to blame others and do not reflect on themselves, which is a disaster!

一九一九年

六十二　恨恨而死

一九一九年

62 Die with hatred古来很有几位恨恨而死的人物。他们一面说些“怀才不遇”“天道宁论”的话，一面有钱的便狂嫖滥赌，没钱的便喝几十碗酒，——因为不平的缘故，于是后来就恨恨而死了。
There have been several characters who died of hatred in ancient times. While they said some words of "talent is not encountered" and "heaven is peaceful", on the other hand, those who had money prostituted and gambled, and those who had no money drank dozens of bowls of wine,—— because of injustice, so they later died of hatred.我们应该趁他们活着的时候问他：诸公！您知道北京离昆仑山几里，弱水去黄河几丈么？火药除了做鞭爆，罗盘除了看风水，还有什么用处么？棉花是红的还是白的？谷子是长在树上，还是长在草上？桑间濮上如何情形，自由恋爱怎样态度？您在半夜里可忽然觉得有些羞，清早上可居然有点悔么？四斤的担，您能挑么？三里的道，您能跑么？
We should ask him while they are alive: Gentlemen! Do you know how many miles Beijing is from Kunlun Mountain, and how many feet are weak water to the Yellow River? In addition to making whiplash explosions, what is the use of the compass except for looking at feng shui? Is cotton red or white? Does millet grow on trees or grass? What is the situation in Sangjian Pu, and what is the attitude towards free love? You suddenly feel a little ashamed in the middle of the night, but do you actually regret it in the morning? Can you pick a four-pound load? Sanli Dao, can you run?他们如果细细的想，慢慢的悔了，这便很有些希望。万一越发不平，越发愤怒，那便“爱莫能助”。——于是他们终于恨恨而死了。
If they think carefully and slowly regret it, there is some hope. If you become more and more unfair and angry, then "love can't help". ——So they finally died of hatred.中国现在的人心中，不平和愤恨的分子太多了。不平还是改造的引线，但必须先改造了自己，再改造社会，改造世界；万不可单是不平。至于愤恨，却几乎全无用处。
There are too many unpeaceful and resentful elements in the hearts of people in China now. Injustice is still the lead of transformation, but we must first transform ourselves, then transform society, and transform the world; It must not be just unfair. As for resentment, it is almost completely useless.愤恨只是恨恨而死的根苗，古人有过许多，我们不要蹈他们的覆辙。
Resentment is just the root of hatred and death, the ancients had many, let's not follow their mistakes.我们更不要借了“天下无公理，无人道”这些话，遮盖自暴自弃的行为，自称“恨人”，一副恨恨而死的脸孔，其实并不恨恨而死。
Let alone borrow the words "there is no justice in the world, no humanity" to cover up the behavior of self-abandonment, calling ourselves "hating people", with a face that dies of hatred, but in fact does not die of hatred.

一九一九年

六十三　“与幼者”

一九一九年

63 "With the Young"做了《我们现在怎样做父亲》的后两日，在有岛武郎《著作集》里看到《与幼者》这一篇小说，觉得很有许多好的话。
Two days after I made "How We Are Fathers Now", I saw the novel "With the Young" in Takero Arishima's "Collected Works" and felt that there were many good words.“时间不住的移过去。你们的父亲的我，到那时候，怎样映在你们（眼）里，那是不能想像的了。大约像我在现在，嗤笑可怜那过去的时代一般，你们也要嗤笑可怜我的古老的心思，也未可知的。我为你们计，但愿这样子。你们若不是毫不客气的拿我做一个踏脚，超越了我，向着高的远的地方进去，那便是错的。
Time kept moving. It is unimaginable how I, your father, will be reflected in your eyes at that time. Just as I am now mocking and pitiful the past times, you will also laugh at my ancient thoughts, which is unknown. I plan for you, I hope so. If you don't unceremoniously use me as a stepping stone, surpass me, and go high and far, then you are wrong.“人间很寂寞。我单能这样说了就算么？你们和我，像尝过血的兽一样，尝过爱了。去罢，为要将我的周围从寂寞中救出，竭力做事罢。我爱过你们，而且永远爱着。这并不是说，要从你们受父亲的报酬，我对于‘教我学会了爱你们的你们’的要求，只是受取我的感谢罢了……像吃尽了亲的死尸，贮着力量的小狮子一样，刚强勇猛，舍了我，踏到人生上去就是了。
"The world is very lonely. Can I just say this? You and I have tasted love like beasts that have tasted blood. Go, in order to rescue my surroundings from loneliness, do my best. I have loved you and always will love. This does not mean that I am to receive my father's remuneration from you, my request for 'you who taught me to love you' is just to receive my thanks...... Like a little lion that has eaten all the corpses of its relatives and stores strength, it is strong and brave, giving up me and stepping into life.“我的一生就令怎样失败，怎样胜不了诱惑；但无论如何，使你们从我的足迹上寻不出不纯的东西的事，是要做的，是一定做的。你们该从我的倒毙的所在，跨出新的脚步去。但那里走，怎么走的事，你们也可以从我的足迹上探索出来。
"My life has made me fail, how I can't overcome temptation; But in any case, the things that cause you to find nothing impure in my footsteps are to be done, and must be done. You should take a new step from where I died. But you can also explore from my footsteps about going there and how to go.“幼者呵！将又不幸又幸福的你们的父母的祝福，浸在胸中，上人生的旅路罢。前途很远，也很暗。然而不要怕。不怕的人的面前才有路。
"Young man! Soak the blessings of your unfortunate and happy parents in your hearts and embark on the journey of life. The future is long and bleak. However, fear not. There is a way in front of those who are not afraid.“走罢！勇猛着！幼者呵！”
"Let's go! Be brave! Young people! ”有岛氏是白桦派，是一个觉醒的，所以有这等话；但里面也免不了带些眷恋凄怆的气息。
The Arishima clan is a birch sect, an awakened one, so there are such words; But it is inevitable that there will be some nostalgia and sadness inside.这也是时代的关系。将来便不特没有解放的话，并且不起解放的心，更没有什么眷恋和凄怆；只有爱依然存在。——但是对于一切幼者的爱。
This is also the relationship of the times. In the future, not only will there be no words of liberation, and there will be no heart of liberation, let alone nostalgia and sadness; Only love remains. ——But love for all young people.

一九一九年

六十四　有无相通

一九一九年

64 Existence and non-existence are connected南北的官僚虽然打仗，南北的人民却很要好，一心一意的在那里“有无相通”。
Although the bureaucrats of the north and south are at war, the people of the north and south are very good, and they are wholeheartedly there to "communicate with each other".北方人可怜南方人太文弱，便教给他们许多拳脚：什么“八卦拳”“太极拳”，什么“洪家”“侠家”，什么“阴截腿”“抱桩腿”“谭腿”“戳脚”，什么“新武术”“旧武术”，什么“实为尽美尽善之体育”，“强国保种尽在于斯”。

六十五　暴君的臣民

一九一九年

65 Subjects of tyrants从前看见清朝几件重案的记载，“臣工”拟罪很严重，“圣上”常常减轻，便心里想：大约因为要博仁厚的美名，所以玩这些花样罢了。后来细想，殊不尽然。
In the past, I saw the records of several major cases in the Qing Dynasty, and the crimes of "ministers" were very serious, and the "emperor" was often mitigated, so I thought to myself: Probably because I want to have a good reputation for benevolence, I just play these tricks. Later, when I thought about it carefully, it was not entirely so.暴君治下的臣民，大抵比暴君更暴；暴君的暴政，时常还不能餍足暴君治下的臣民的欲望。
The subjects under the tyrant are generally more violent than the tyrant; The tyranny of tyrants often fails to satisfy the desires of their subjects under tyrants.中国不要提了罢。在外国举一个例：小事件则如Gogol的剧本《按察使》，众人都禁止他，俄皇却准开演；大事件则如巡抚想放耶稣，众人却要求将他钉上十字架。
China should not mention it. From the "spared", sacrifices are selected to supply the bloodthirsty desires of the subjects under the tyrant, but no one understands. The dead said "Ah", and they were happy to live.

六十六　生命的路

一九一九年

66 The road of life想到人类的灭亡是一件大寂寞大悲哀的事；然而若干人们的灭亡，却并非寂寞悲哀的事。
Thinking about the demise of mankind is a great loneliness and sadness; However, the demise of some people is not a lonely and sad thing.生命的路是进步的，总是沿着无限的精神三角形的斜面向上走，什么都阻止他不得。
The path of life is progressive, always going up the slope of the infinite spiritual triangle, and nothing can stop him.自然赋与人们的不调和还很多，人们自己萎缩堕落退步的也还很多，然而生命决不因此回头。无论什么黑暗来防范思潮，什么悲惨来袭击社会，什么罪恶来亵渎人道，人类的渴仰完全的潜力，总是踏了这些铁蒺藜向前进。
There are still many discords between nature and people, and there are still many people who shrink and degenerate themselves, but life will never turn back. No matter what darkness to guard against ideological trends, what tragedy attacks society, what evil desecrates humanity, human beings yearn for full potential, always step on these thistles.生命不怕死，在死的面前笑着跳着，跨过了灭亡的人们向前进。
Life is not afraid of death, it laughs and dances in the face of death, and moves forward beyond the people who perished.什么是路？就是从没路的地方践踏出来的，从只有荆棘的地方开辟出来的。
What is Road? It is trampled out of a place where there is no road, and it is opened up from a place where there are only thorns.以前早有路了，以后也该永远有路。
There was a road before, and there should always be a road in the future.人类总不会寂寞，因为生命是进步的，是乐天的。
Human beings will never be lonely, because life is progressive and optimistic.昨天，我对我的朋友L说，“一个人死了，在死者自身和他的眷属是悲惨的事，但在一村一镇的人看起来不算什么；就是一省一国一种……”
Yesterday I said to my friend L, "It is tragic for a person to die for the deceased himself and his family, but it seems nothing to a person in a village or town; It is one province, one country, one ......"L很不高兴，说，“这是Natur（自然）的话，不是人们的话。你应该小心些。”
L was very upset and said, "These are the words of Natur (nature), not the words of people. You should be careful. ”我想，他的话也不错。I think his words are also good.

智识即罪恶

一九二一年

Wisdom is sin我本来是一个四平八稳，给小酒馆打杂，混一口安稳饭吃的人，不幸认得几个字，受了新文化运动的影响，想求起智识来了。
I was originally a person who was stable, doing odd jobs in taverns and eating a stable meal, but unfortunately I recognized a few words, and was influenced by the New Culture Movement, so I wanted to seek wisdom.那时我在乡下，很为猪羊不平；心里想，虽然苦，倘也如牛马一样，可以有一件别的用，那就免得专以卖肉见长了。然而猪羊满脸呆气，终生胡涂，实在除了保持现状之外，没有别的法。所以，诚然，智识是要紧的！
At that time, I was in the countryside, and I was very unfair to pigs and sheep; I thought to myself, although it is bitter, if it is like cattle and horses, it can have another use, so that it will not be good at selling meat. However, pigs and sheep are full of dumb faces, and there is really no other way but to maintain the status quo. So, it is true that knowledge is important!于是我跑到北京，拜老师，求智识。地球是圆的。元质有七十多种。X＋y＝z。闻所未闻，虽然难，却也以为是人所应该知道的事。
So I went to Beijing to pay respects to my teacher and ask for knowledge. The Earth is round. There are more than 70 types of primordial materials. X＋y＝z。 It is unheard of, although it is difficult, but I also think that it is something that people should know.有一天，看见一种日报，却又将我的确信打破了。报上有一位虚无哲学家说：智识是罪恶，赃物……。虚无哲学，多大的权威呵，而说道智识是罪恶。我的智识虽然少，而确实是智识，这倒反而坑了我了。我于是请教老师去。
One day, I saw a kind of daily newspaper, but it broke my conviction again. There is a nihilistic philosopher in the newspaper who said: Wisdom is sin, and stolen goods ....... Nihilism is a philosophy, how much authority is there, and it is a sin to say that wisdom is a sin. Although my knowledge is small, it is indeed intelligence, which has pitted me. So I asked the teacher to go.老师道：“呸，你懒得用功，便胡说，走！”
The teacher said: "Bah, you are too lazy to work hard, so you talk nonsense, let's go!" ”我想：“老师贪图束脩罢。智识倒也还不如没有的稳当，可惜粘在我脑里，立刻抛不去，我赶快忘了他罢。”
I thought, "The teacher is greedy for the bundle." Wisdom is not as stable as nothing, but unfortunately it stuck in my head and I couldn't throw it away immediately, so I quickly forgot about him. ”然而迟了。因为这一夜里，我已经死了。
However, it was too late. Because on this night, I was dead.半夜，我躺在公寓的床上，忽而走进两个东西来，一个“活无常”，一个“死有分”。但我却并不诧异，因为他们正如城隍庙里塑着的一般。然而跟在后面的两个怪物，却使我吓得失声，因为并非牛头马面，而却是羊面猪头！我便悟到，牛马还太聪明，犯了罪，换上这诸公了，这可见智识是罪恶……。我没有想完，猪头便用嘴将我一拱，我于是立刻跌入阴府里，用不着久等烧车马。
In the middle of the night, I was lying on the bed in my apartment, and suddenly two things came into me, one was "living impermanently" and the other was "dead". But I wasn't surprised, because they were just like the ones in the City God Temple. However, the two monsters following me were so frightened that I was stunned, because it was not a bull head or a horse face, but a sheep's face and a pig's head! I realized that the cattle and horses were still too smart, and if they committed a crime, they would be replaced by these gentlemen, which shows that wisdom is ...... sin. Before I finished thinking, the pig's head arched me with his mouth, and I immediately fell into the underworld, and I didn't have to wait for a long time to burn the carriage and horses.到过阴间的前辈先生多说，阴府的大门是有匾额和对联的，我留心看时，却没有，只见大堂上坐着一位阎罗王。希奇，他便是我的隔壁的大富豪朱朗翁。大约钱是身外之物，带不到阴间的，所以一死便成为清白鬼了，只是不知道怎么又做了大官。他只穿一件极俭朴的爱国布的龙袍，但那龙颜却比活的时候胖得多了。
Senior gentlemen who have been to the underworld often say that there are plaques and couplets at the gate of the underworld, but when I paid attention, I didn't, I saw a King of Hell sitting in the lobby. Hitch, he is the rich man Zhu Langweng next door to me. Probably money is something outside the body and cannot be taken to the underworld, so he became an innocent ghost when he died, but he didn't know how to become a high official again. He only wore a dragon robe made of extremely frugal patriotic cloth, but his dragon face was much fatter than when he was alive.“你有智识么？”朗翁脸上毫无表情的问。
"Do you have intelligence?" Lang Weng asked expressionlessly.“没……”我是记得虚无哲学家的话的，所以这样答。

At that time, he fell into a city, which were all houses with green bricks and green doors, and the top of the door was probably two so-called lions made of foreign gray, and a sign was hung outside the door. If in the Yang world, there are always five or six cards hanging outside each organ, but there is only one here, which shows the abundance of land. When I entered it, it was an endless flat ground, covered with white beans mixed with tung oil. I saw countless people falling and getting up on this, getting up and falling again. I also fell twelve times in a row, and many pimples grew on my head. But there were also people who were sitting and lying at the door, not wanting to get up, although they were soaked in oil, but there was not a single pimple, but unfortunately when I asked him, they all stared at him and did not speak. I don't know if they don't hear or don't understand, or if they don't want to say it, or if they don't want to say it, they still have nothing to say.我于是跌上前去，去问那些正在乱跌的人们。其中的一个道：
So I went forward and asked the people who were falling. One of them said:“这就是罚智识的，因为智识是罪恶，赃物……。我们还算是轻的呢。你在阳间的时候，怎么不昏一点？……”他气喘吁吁的断续的说。
"This is the punishment of knowledge, because knowledge is sin, and stolen goods ....... We're still light. When you are in the human world, why don't you faint? ......," he said pantingly and intermittently.“现在昏起来罢。”
"Get up now."“迟了。”
"It's too late."“我听得人说，西医有使人昏睡的药，去请他注射去，好么？”
"I heard that Western medicine has a medicine that makes people sleepy, so go and ask him to inject it, okay?"“不成，我正因为知道医药，所以在这里跌，连针也没有了。”
"No, I fell here because I knew medicine, and I didn't even have a needle."“那么……有专给人打吗啡针的，听说多是没智识的人……我寻他们去。”
"So...... There are people who give morphine injections, and I heard that most of them are unintelligent people...... I will look for them. ”在这谈话时，我们本已滑跌了几百交了。我一失望，便更不留神，忽然将头撞在白豆稀薄的地面上。地面很硬，跌势又重，我于是胡里胡涂的发了昏……
At the time of this conversation, we had already slipped and slipped hundreds of times. When I was disappointed, I was even more careless and suddenly hit my head on the thin ground of white beans. Pander to! Freely! I was suddenly on the plain, behind me was the city, and I could see the apartments in front of me. I was still walking around, thinking: My wife and son must have gone to Beijing, and they are crying around my dead body. 一九二二年

“以震其艰深”

一九二二年

"To shake its hardships"上海租界上的“国学家”，以为做白话文的大抵是青年，总该没有看过古董书的，于是乎用了所谓“国学”来吓呼他们。
The "Chinese scholars" in the Shanghai Concession thought that most of the people who wrote vernacular texts were young people who had never read antique books, so they used the so-called "Chinese studies" to scare them.《时报》上载着一篇署名“涵秋”的《文字感想》，其中有一段说：
The Times published a "Text Impression" signed "Han Qiu", which has a passage that says:“新学家薄国学为不足道故为钩辀格磔之文以震其艰深也一读之欲呕再读之昏昏睡去矣”
“新学家薄国学为不足道故为钩辀格磔之文以震其艰深也一读之欲呕再读之昏昏睡去矣”领教。我先前只以为“钩辀格磔”是古人用他来形容鹧鸪的啼声，并无别的深意思；亏得这《文字感想》，才明白这是怪鹧鸪啼得“艰深”了，以此责备他的。但无论如何，“艰深”却不能令人“欲呕”，闻鹧鸪啼而呕者，世固无之，即以文章论，“粤若稽古”，注释纷纭，“绛即东雍”，圈点不断，这总该可以算是艰深的了，可是也从未听说，有人因此反胃。呕吐的原因决不在乎别人文章的“艰深”，是在乎自己的身体里的，大约因为“国学”积蓄得太多，笔不及写，所以涌出来了罢。
Leading. I only thought that "hook and twist" was the ancients used to describe the cry of partridges, and it had no other deep meaning; Thanks to this "Written Impressions", I realized that this was the partridge crying "hard", so I blamed him. But in any case, "difficult" cannot make people "nauseous", those who hear the partridge crying and vomit, there is no such thing in the world, that is, in terms of articles, "Yue Ruo Ji Gu", the annotations are diverse, "Jiang is Dongyong", the circle is constant, this should always be regarded as difficult, but I have never heard of it, some people are sick of it. The reason for vomiting is by no means the "difficult" of other people's articles, but about one's own body, probably because "Chinese studies" have accumulated too much and the pen is not enough to write, so it gushes out.“以震其艰深也”的“震”字，从国学的门外汉看来也不通，但也许是为手民所误的，因为排字印报也是新学，或者也不免要“以震其艰深”。
The word "Zhen" in "to shake its hardship" does not make sense from the layman of Chinese studies, but it may be mistaken by the hands, because typesetting printing is also a new school, or it is inevitable to "shake its difficulty".否则，如此“国学”，虽不艰深，却是恶作，真是“一读之欲呕”，再读之必呕矣。
Otherwise, such a "Chinese studies", although not difficult, is a prank, it is really "disgusting to read", and it will vomit if you read it again.国学国学，新学家既“薄为不足道”，国学家又道而不能亨，你真要道尽途穷了！
Chinese studies, new scholars are not only "thin enough", and Chinese scholars are also unable to succeed, you really want to run out of roads!九月二十日。

一九二二年

所谓“国学”

一九二二年

The so-called "Chinese studies"现在暴发的“国学家”之所谓“国学”是什么？
What is the so-called "Chinese studies" of the "Chinese scholars" that are now erupting?一是商人遗老们翻印了几十部旧书赚钱，二是洋场上的文豪又做了几篇鸳鸯蝴蝶体小说出版。

The printing of books by the old merchants is the antique of books, and its emphasis is not on books but on antiques. The old man is rich, or just for his own amusement, and the businessman makes a big profit by blowing it up. There are also tea merchants and salt dealers, who originally despised the "scholars", but now they also take advantage of the turmoil between the old and the new, in the name of engraving books, and want to enter the "Shilin" of the old and the young. The books they engraved do not have the date of the Republic of China, and they cannot tell whether they are Yuan editions or Qing editions, they are all antiques, at least two or three yuan each, continuous, brocade, antique, and students cannot afford to buy them. This is what they call "Chinese studies".然而巧妙的商人可也决不肯放过学生们的钱的，便用坏纸恶墨别印什么“菁华”什么“大全”之类来搜括。定价并不大，但和纸墨一比较却是大价了。至于这些“国学”书的校勘，新学家不行，当然是出于上海的所谓“国学家”的了，然而错字叠出，破句连篇（用的并不是新式圈点），简直是拿少年来开玩笑。这是他们之所谓“国学”。
However, clever businessmen would never let go of the students' money, so they used bad paper and bad ink to print "essence" or "encyclopedia" to collect them. The price is not big, but compared with paper and ink, it is a big price. This is what they call "Chinese studies".洋场上的往古所谓文豪，“卿卿我我”“蝴蝶鸳鸯”诚然做过一小堆，可是自有洋场以来，从没有人称这些文章（？）为国学，他们自己也并不以“国学家”自命的。现在不知何以，忽而奇想天开，也学了盐贩茶商，要凭空挨进“国学家”队里去了。然而事实很可惨，他们之所谓国学，是“拆白之事各处皆有而以上海一隅为最甚（中略）余于课余之暇不惜浪费笔墨编纂事实作一篇小说以饷阅者想亦阅者所乐闻也”。（原本每句都密圈，今从略，以省排工，阅者谅之。）

"The Doctrine of One"我从《学灯》上看见驳吴宓君《新文化运动之反应》这一篇文章之后，才去寻《中华新报》来看他的原文。

It creates the doctrine of one is. Integrating the essence of China and the West. It is believed to be for the sake of a country and a temporary situation. "Xueheng", 7. "Xiangjun".此外便是吴君对于这七种书报的“平情衡理”的批评（？）了。例如《民心周报》，“自发刊以至停版。除小说及一二来稿外。全用文言。不用所谓新式标点。即此一端。在新潮方盛之时。亦可谓砥柱中流矣。”至于《湘君》之用白话及标点，却又别有道理，那是“《学衡》本事理之真。故拒斥粗劣白话及英文标点。《湘君》求文艺之美。故兼用通妥白话及新式标点”的。总而言之，主张偏激，连标点也就偏激，那白话自然更不“通妥”了。即如我的白话，离通妥就很远；而我的标点则是“英文标点”。

一九二二年

不懂的音译

一九二二年

I don't understand transliteration一
One凡有一件事，总是永远缠夹不清的，大约莫过于在我们中国了。
There is always one thing that can never be clarified, probably more than in our China.翻外国人的姓名用音译，原是一件极正当，极平常的事，倘不是毫无常识的人们，似乎决不至于还会说费话。然而在上海报（我记不清楚什么报了，总之不是《新申报》便是《时报》）上，却又有伏在暗地里掷石子的人来嘲笑了。他说，做新文学家的秘诀，其一是要用些“屠介纳夫”“郭歌里”之类使人不懂的字样的。
Transliterating the names of foreigners is originally a very legitimate and common thing, and if it weren't for people with no common sense, it seems that they would never talk nonsense. However, on the poster (I can't remember what newspaper, in short, it was either "New Declaration" or "Times"), there were people who were lying in the dark and throwing stones to laugh. He said that one of the secrets of being a new writer is to use some words that people don't understand, such as "Tu Jie Nafu" and "Guo Ge Li".凡有旧来音译的名目：靴，狮子，葡萄，萝卜，佛，伊犁等……都毫不为奇的使用，而独独对于几个新译字来作怪；若是明知的，便可笑；倘不，更可怜。
All the names that have been transliterated in the past: boots, lions, grapes, turnips, Buddhas, Ili, etc...... It is not surprising that it is used, but it is strange to a few new translations; If you know it, it's ridiculous; If not, it's even more pitiful.其实是，现在的许多翻译者，比起往古的翻译家来，已经含有加倍的顽固性的了。例如南北朝人译印度的人名：阿难陀，实叉难陀，鸠摩罗什婆……决不肯附会成中国的人名模样，所以我们到了现在，还可以依了他们的译例推出原音来。不料直到光绪末年，在留学生的书报上，说是外国出了一个“柯伯坚”，倘使粗粗一看，大约总不免要疑心他是柯府上的老爷柯仲软的令兄的罢，但幸而还有照相在，可知道并不如此，其实是俄国的Kropotkin。那书上又有一个“陶斯道”，我已经记不清是Dostoievski呢，还是Tolstoi了。
In fact, many translators today are twice as stubborn as those of the past. For example, the people of the Northern and Southern Dynasties translated Indian names: Ananda, Shichananda, Kumarashva...... We will never attach to the appearance of Chinese people's names, so we can still follow their translation examples to introduce the original sound. Unexpectedly, until the end of Guangxu, in the books and newspapers of international students, it was said that a "Ke Bojian" was produced by a foreign country, and if you look at it roughly, you will probably have to suspect that he is the brother of Ke Zhongruan, the master of the Ke family, but fortunately, there are still photos, but you know that this is not the case, in fact, it is Kropotkin in Russia. There is another "Taos Road" in the book, and I can't remember whether it was Dostoievski or Tolstoi.这“屠介纳夫”和“郭歌里”，虽然古雅赶不上“柯伯坚”，但于外国人的氏姓上定要加一个《百家姓》里所有的字，却几乎成了现在译界的常习，比起六朝和尚来，已可谓很“安本分”的了。然而竟还有人从暗中来掷石子，装鬼脸，难道真所谓“人心不古”么？
Although this "Tu Jie Nafu" and "Guo Ge Li" are not as quaint as "Ke Bojian", they must add a word in the "Hundred Family Surnames" to the surnames of foreigners, but it has almost become a common practice in the translation world. However, there are still people who come from the dark to throw stones and pretend to grimace, is it really the so-called "people's hearts are not ancient"?我想，现在的翻译家倒大可以学学“古之和尚”，凡有人名地名，什么音便怎么译，不但用不着白费心思去嵌镶，而且还须去改正。即如“柯伯坚”，现在虽然改译“苦鲁巴金”了，但第一音既然是K不是Ku，我们便该将“苦”改作“克”，因为K和Ku的分别，在中国字音上是办得到的。
I think that today's translators can learn from the "ancient monks", and all the names of people and places can be translated as they are, not only do they not need to spend time to emblay them, but they also have to be corrected. For example, "Ke Bo Jian", although it has now been translated as "Ku Lu Ba Jin", since the first sound is K instead of Ku, we should change "Ku" to "Ke", because the difference between K and Ku can be done in Chinese pronunciation.而中国却是更没有注意到，所以去年Kropotkin死去的消息传来的时候，上海《时报》便用日俄战争时旅顺败将Kuropatkin的照相，把这位无治主义老英雄的面目来顶替了。
China, on the other hand, did not notice it, so when the news of Kropotkin's death came last year, the Shanghai Times used a photo of Kuropatkin, a defeated general of Lushun during the Russo-Japanese War, to replace the face of this old anarchist hero.十一月四日。
November 4th.二
Two自命为“国学家”的对于译音也加以嘲笑，确可以算得一种古今的奇闻；但这不特显示他的昏愚，实在也足以看出他的悲惨。
The self-proclaimed "Chinese scholar" also ridiculed the translation, which can indeed be regarded as a kind of anecdote in ancient and modern times; But this not only shows his foolishness, but also shows his misery.倘如他的尊意，则怎么办呢？我想，这只有三条计。上策是凡有外国的事物都不谈；中策是凡有外国人都称之为洋鬼子，例如屠介纳夫的《猎人日记》，郭歌里的《巡按使》，都题为“洋鬼子著”；下策是，只好将外国人名改为王羲之唐伯虎黄三太之类，例如进化论是唐伯虎提倡的，相对论是王羲之发明的，而发见美洲的则为黄三太。
What if it is his will? I think there are only three plans. The best policy is not to talk about anything that is foreign; The middle policy is that all foreigners call them foreign devils, such as Tu Jie Nafu's "Hunter's Diary" and Guo Geli's "Inspector", all of which are titled "Foreign Devils"; For example, the theory of evolution was advocated by Tang Bohu, the theory of relativity was invented by Wang Xizhi, and the one who discovered America was Huang Santai.倘不能，则为自命为国学家所不懂的新的音译语，可是要侵入真的国学的地域里来了。
If not, it is a new transliteration that the self-proclaimed Chinese scholars do not understand, but it is going to invade the territory of real Chinese studies.中国有一部《流沙坠简》，印了将有十年了。要谈国学，那才可以算一种研究国学的书。开首有一篇长序，是王国维先生做的，要谈国学，他才可以算一个研究国学的人物。而他的序文中有一段说，“案古简所出为地凡三（中略）其三则和阗东北之尼雅城及马咱托拉拔拉滑史德三地也”。
There is a "Quicksand Falling Slip" in China, which has been printed for nearly ten years. If you want to talk about Chinese studies, it can be regarded as a book on Chinese studies. There is a long preface at the beginning, which was written by Mr. Wang Guowei, and he can be regarded as a person who studies Chinese studies if he wants to talk about Chinese studies. And there is a passage in his preface that says, "According to the ancient slips, there are three places (omitted), three of which are the city of Niya and the three places of Mazan Torabala and Huashide in the northeast of Khotan."这些译音，并不比“屠介纳夫”之类更古雅，更易懂。然而何以非用不可呢？就因为有三处地方，是这样的称呼；即使上海的国学家怎样冷笑，他们也仍然还是这样的称呼。当假的国学家正在打牌喝酒，真的国学家正在稳坐高斋读古书的时候，沙士比亚的同乡斯坦因博士却已经在甘肃新疆这些地方的沙碛里，将汉晋简牍掘去了；不但掘去，而且做出书来了。所以真要研究国学，便不能不翻回来；因为真要研究，所以也就不能行我的三策：或绝口不提，或但云“得于华夏”，或改为“获之于春申浦畔”了。
These translations are no more quaint and understandable than "Tu Jie Nafu" and the like. But why must it be used? Just because there are three places, it is called like this; No matter how much the Chinese scholars in Shanghai sneered, they still called it that. When fake Chinese scholars are playing cards and drinking, and real Chinese scholars are sitting firmly in Gaozhai reading ancient books, Shakespeare's fellow countryman Dr. Stein has already dug up the Han and Jin bamboo slips in the deserts of these places in Xinjiang, Gansu Province; Not only did he dig it up, but he also made a book. Therefore, if you really want to study Chinese studies, you have to turn it over; Because I really want to study, I can't do my three strategies: either never mention it, or just say "obtained from China", or change it to "obtained from Chunshenpu".而且不特这一事。此外如真要研究元朝的历史，便不能不懂“屠介纳夫”的国文，因为单用些“鸳鸯”“蝴蝶”这些字样，实在是不够敷衍的。所以中国的国学不发达则已，万一发达起来，则敢请恕我直言，可是断不是洋场上的自命为国学家“所能厕足其间者也”的了。
And not only this thing. In addition, if you really want to study the history of the Yuan Dynasty, you must understand the Chinese language of "Tu Jie Nafu", because using the words "mandarin ducks" and "butterflies" alone is really not perfunctory enough. Therefore, if China's Chinese studies are not developed, if they do, I dare to ask for my forgiveness, but it is definitely not the self-proclaimed Chinese scholars in the foreign field who "can fill the gap".但我于序文里所谓三处中的“马咱托拉拔拉滑史德”，起初却实在不知道怎样断句，读下去才明白二是“马咱托拉”，三是“拔拉滑史德”。
But in the preface, I really didn't know how to break the sentence at first, and after reading it, I understood that the second was "Mazan Tora" and the third was "Bala Slippery Stone".所以要清清楚楚的讲国学，也仍然须嵌外国字，须用新式的标点的。
Therefore, to clearly explain Chinese studies, it is still necessary to embed foreign characters and use new punctuation.十一月六日。

一九二二年

对于批评家的希望

一九二二年

Hope for critics前两三年的书报上，关于文艺的大抵只有几篇创作（姑且这样说）和翻译，于是读者颇有批评家出现的要求，现在批评家已经出现了，而且日见其多了。
In the first two or three years, there were only a few creations (let's say so) and translations about literature and art, so readers had a lot of demands for critics to appear, and now critics have appeared, and there are more and more of them.以文艺如此幼稚的时候，而批评家还要发掘美点，想扇起文艺的火焰来，那好意实在很可感。即不然，或则叹息现代作品的浅薄，那是望著作家更其深，或则叹息现代作品之没有血泪，那是怕著作界复归于轻佻。虽然似乎微辞过多，其实却是对于文艺的热烈的好意，那也实在是很可感谢的。
When literature and art are so naïve, and critics still have to discover the beauty and want to fan the flame of literature and art, that kind intention is really very touchable. That is, if not, or sigh at the shallowness of modern works, that is, to look deeper at the writer, or to sigh that there is no blood or tears in modern works, that is, for fear that the writing industry will return to frivolity. Although it seems to be too much micro-words, it is actually a warm goodwill for literature and art, which is really grateful.独有靠了一两本“西方”的旧批评论，或则捞一点头脑板滞的先生们的唾余，或则仗着中国固有的什么天经地义之类的，也到文坛上来践踏，则我以为委实太滥用了批评的权威。试将粗浅的事来比罢：譬如厨子做菜，有人品评他坏，他固不应该将厨刀铁釜交给批评者，说道你试来做一碗好的看：但他却可以有几条希望，就是望吃菜的没有“嗜痂之癖”，没有喝醉了酒，没有害着热病，舌苔厚到二三分。
Only relying on one or two old commentaries of "Western", or fishing for a little bit of spitting gentlemen, or relying on some of China's inherent righteousness, etc., also trampled on the literary world, I think that the authority of criticism has been abused too much. Try to compare superficial things: for example, if a chef cooks and someone judges him badly, he should not hand over the kitchen knife and iron cauldron to the critic and say, "You try to make a good bowl of goodness": but he can have a few hopes, that is, he does not have a "scab habit", is not drunk, does not suffer from a fever, and his tongue coating is as thick as two or three points.我对于文艺批评家的希望却还要小。我不敢望他们于解剖裁判别人的作品之前，先将自己的精神来解剖裁判一回，看本身有无浅薄卑劣荒谬之处，因为这事情是颇不容易的。我所希望的不过愿其有一点常识，例如知道裸体画和春画的区别，接吻和性交的区别，尸体解剖和戮尸的区别，出洋留学和“放诸四夷”的区别，笋和竹的区别，猫和老虎的区别，老虎和番菜馆的区别……。更进一步，则批评以英美的老先生学说为主，自然是悉听尊便的，但尤希望知道世界上不止英美两国；看不起托尔斯泰，自然也自由的，但尤希望先调查一点他的行实，真看过几本他所做的书。
My hopes for literary critics are even smaller. I don't dare to expect them to dissect the referee with their own spirit before dissecting other people's works, to see if there is anything shallow, despicable, and absurd, because this matter is not easy. What I hope is that he has a little common sense, such as knowing the difference between nude painting and spring painting, the difference between kissing and sexual intercourse, the difference between dissection and corpse killing, the difference between studying abroad and "putting it in the barbarians", the difference between bamboo shoots and bamboo, the difference between cats and tigers, and the difference between tigers and fan restaurants, ....... furthermore, the criticism is based on the doctrine of the old gentleman of Britain and the United States, which is naturally listened to and respected, but especially wants to know that there are more than two countries in the world; I look down on Tolstoy, and I am naturally free, but I especially hope to investigate his facts first, and I have really read a few books he has made.还有几位批评家，当批评译本的时候，往往诋为不足齿数的劳力，而怪他何不去创作。创作之可尊，想来翻译家该是知道的，然而他竟止于翻译者，一定因为他只能翻译，或者偏爱翻译的缘故。所以批评家若不就事论事，而说些应当去如此如彼，是溢出于事权以外的事，因为这类言语，是商量教训而不是批评。现在还将厨子来比，则吃菜的只要说出品味如何就尽够，苦于此之外，又怪他何以不去做裁缝或造房子，那是无论怎样的呆厨子，也难免要说这位客官是痰迷心窍的了。
There are also several critics who, when criticizing translations, often discredit them as insufficient labor and blame him for not creating. The creation is respectable, and the translator should know it, but he is only a translator, and it must be because he can only translate, or prefers translation. Therefore, if a critic does not discuss the matter on the matter, but says something that should be done this or that, it is beyond his authority, because this kind of speech is to discuss lessons rather than criticism. Now comparing the chef, it is enough for the person who eats the food to say how he tastes, and in addition to this, he blames why he doesn't work as a tailor or build a house.十一月九日。
November 9th.

一九二二年

反对“含泪”的批评家

一九二二年

Critics against "tears"现在对于文艺的批评日见其多了，是好现象；然而批评日见其怪了，是坏现象，愈多反而愈坏。
Nowadays, there are more and more criticisms of literature and art, which is a good phenomenon; However, criticism is becoming more and more strange, and it is a bad phenomenon, and the more it is, the worse it gets.我看了很觉得不以为然的是胡梦华君对于汪静之君《蕙的风》的批评，尤其觉得非常不以为然的是胡君答复章鸿熙君的信。
What I disagreed with was Hu Menghuajun's criticism of Wang Jingzhijun's "Hui Zhi Feng", and I especially felt very dissatisfied with Hu Jun's reply to Zhang Hongxijun's letter.一，胡君因为《蕙的风》里有一句“一步一回头瞟我意中人”，便科以和《金瓶梅》一样的罪：这是锻炼周纳的。《金瓶梅》卷首诚然有“意中人”三个字，但不能因为有三个字相同，便说这书和那书是一模样。例如胡君要青年去忏悔，而《金瓶梅》也明明说是一部“改过的书”，若因为这一点意思偶合，而说胡君的主张也等于《金瓶梅》，我实在没有这样的粗心和大胆。我以为中国之所谓道德家的神经，自古以来，未免过敏而又过敏了，看见一句“意中人”，便即想到《金瓶梅》，看见一个“瞟”字，便即穿凿到别的事情上去。然而一切青年的心，却未必都如此不净；倘竟如此不净，则即使“授受不亲”，后来也就会“瞟”，以至于瞟以上的等等事，那时便是一部《礼记》，也即等于《金瓶梅》了，又何有于《蕙的风》？
First, Hu Jun was sentenced to the same sin as "Jin Ping Mei" because there is a sentence in "Hui Wind" that "look back at my favorite person step by step": this is to exercise Zhou Na. It is true that there are three words "the person in mind" at the beginning of "Jin Ping Mei", but just because there are three words the same, it cannot be said that this book and that book are the same. For example, Hu Jun asked young people to repent, and "Jin Ping Mei" is also clearly said to be a "book of reform", if because of this meaning, and Hu Jun's proposition is also equal to "Jin Ping Mei", I really do not have such carelessness and boldness. I think that the nerves of the so-called moralists in China have been allergic and allergic since ancient times, and when they see a sentence of "the person they like", they think of "Jin Ping Mei", and when they see the word "glance", they immediately go to other things. However, the hearts of all young people may not be so impure; If it is so impure, then even if it is "not close to giving and receiving", it will be "glanced" later, so that it will be a "Book of Rites" at that time, which is equivalent to "Jin Ping Mei", so how can there be "Hui no Feng"?二，胡君因为诗里有“一个和尚悔出家”的话，便说是诬蔑了普天下和尚，而且大呼释迦牟尼佛：这是近于宗教家而且援引多数来恫吓，失了批评的态度的。其实一个和尚悔出家，并不是怪事，若普天下的和尚没有一个悔出家的，那倒是大怪事。中国岂不是常有酒肉和尚，还俗和尚么？非“悔出家”而何？倘说那些是坏和尚，则那诗里的便是坏和尚之一，又何至诬蔑了普天下的和尚呢？这正如胡君说一本诗集是不道德，并不算诬蔑了普天下的诗人。至于释迦牟尼，可更与文艺界“风马牛”了，据他老先生的教训，则做诗便犯了“绮语戒”，无论道德或不道德，都不免受些孽报，可怕得很的！
Second, because there is a sentence in the poem "a monk repents of becoming a monk", he said that he slandered the monks of the world, and shouted Shakyamuni Buddha: this is close to a religious person and invokes the majority to intimidate, losing the attitude of criticism. In fact, it is not strange for a monk to regret becoming a monk, but if none of the monks in the world regret becoming a monk, it is a big strange thing. Isn't there often a monk in China, and a monk who is still a vulgar monk? What if it is not "regret becoming a monk"? If those are bad monks, then the poem is one of the bad monks, so why slander the monks of the whole world? This is just like Hu Jun said that a collection of poems is immoral, and it is not a slander for poets all over the world. As for Shakyamuni, he is even more "windy and cow" with the literary and artistic circles, according to the lessons of his old gentleman, he has committed the "precept of beautiful words" when making poetry, whether moral or immoral, he is not immune to some evil retribution, which is very terrifying!三，胡君说汪君的诗比不上歌德和雪利，我以为是对的。但后来又说，“论到人格，歌德一生而十九娶，为世诟病，正无可讳。然而歌德所以垂世不朽者，乃五十岁以后忏悔的歌德，我们也知道么？”这可奇特了。雪利我不知道，若歌德即Goethe，则我敢替他呼几句冤，就是他并没有“一生而十九娶”，并没有“为世诟病”，并没有“五十岁以后忏悔”。而且对于胡君所说的“自‘耳食’之风盛，歌德，雪利之真人格遂不为国人所知，无识者流，更妄相援引，可悲亦复可笑！”这一段话，也要请收回一些去。
Third, Hu Jun said that Wang Jun's poems are not as good as Goethe and Shirley, and I think he is right. But later he said, "When it comes to personality, Goethe married nineteen in his life, which is criticized by the world, which is undeniable." However, the reason why Goethe is immortal is Goethe, who repents after the age of fifty, do we know? "This is strange. Shirley I don't know, if Goethe is Goethe, then I dare to say a few words for him, that is, he did not "marry nineteen in his life", did not "criticize the world", and did not "repent after the age of fifty". And for what Hu Jun said, "Since the 'ear eating' is popular, Goethe and Shirley's true personality is not known to the Chinese people, and the ignorant are even more arrogantly quoted, which is sad and ridiculous!" "Please take back some of this paragraph.我不知道汪君可曾过了五十岁，倘没有，则即使用了胡君的论调来裁判，似乎也还不妨做“一步一回头瞟我意中人”的诗，因为以歌德为例，也还没有到“忏悔”的时候。
I don't know that Wang Jun has passed the age of fifty, and if not, even if Hu Jun's argument is used to judge, it seems that he might as well make a poem of "looking back at my favorite person step by step", because taking Goethe as an example, it is not yet time for "repentance".临末，则我对于胡君的“悲哀的青年，我对于他们只有不可思议的眼泪！”“我还想多写几句，我对于悲哀的青年底不可思议的泪已盈眶了”这一类话，实在不明白“其意何居”。批评文艺，万不能以眼泪的多少来定是非。文艺界可以收到创作家的眼泪，而沾了批评家的眼泪却是污点。胡君的眼泪的确洒得非其地，非其时，未免万分可惜了。
At the end of my life, I only have incredible tears for Hu Jun's "sad youths!" "I want to write a few more sentences, I have tears in my eyes for the sad youth", I really don't understand "what does it mean". Criticizing literature and art must not be judged by the number of tears. The literary and artistic circles can receive the tears of creators, but the tears of critics are stained. Hu Jun's tears did fall out of place, and it was a pity that it was not the right time.起稿已完，才看见《青光》上的一段文章，说近人用先生和君，含有尊敬和小觑的差别意见。我在这文章里正用君，但初意却不过贪图少写一个字，并非有什么《春秋》笔法。现在声明于此，却反而多写了许多字了。
After the draft was finished, I saw an article in "Qingguang", saying that the use of Mr. and Jun by neighbors contains different opinions of respect and contempt. I am using Jun in this article, but the original intention is just to write one less word, not any "Spring and Autumn" penmanship. Now that it is declared here, many more words have been written.十一月十七日。
November 17th.

一九二二年

即小见大

一九二二年

That is, the small sees the big北京大学的反对讲义收费风潮，芒硝火焰似的起来，又芒硝火焰似的消灭了，其间就是开除了一个学生冯省三。
Peking University's opposition to the handout fee trend rose like a mirabilite flame, and then disappeared like a mirabilite flame, during which a student Feng Shengsan was expelled.这事很奇特，一回风潮的起灭，竟只关于一个人。倘使诚然如此，则一个人的魄力何其太大，而许多人的魄力又何其太无呢。
This matter is very peculiar, once the rise and fall of the trend is only about one person. If this is the case, then how much courage is one person, and how little courage is there for many people.现在讲义费已经取消，学生是得胜了，然而并没有听得有谁为那做了这次的牺牲者祝福。
Now that the handout fee has been canceled, the students are victorious, but no one has heard of the blessing of the victims who did this time.即小见大，我于是竟悟出一件长久不解的事来，就是：三贝子花园里面，有谋刺良弼和袁世凯而死的四烈士坟，其中有三块墓碑，何以直到民国十一年还没有人去刻一个字。
That is, I realized something that I couldn't understand for a long time, that is: in the Sanbeizi Garden, there are the graves of the four martyrs who plotted to assassinate Liangbi and Yuan Shikai, and there are three tombstones, why no one has carved a word until the eleventh year of the Republic of China.凡有牺牲在祭坛前沥血之后，所留给大家的，实在只有“散胙”这一件事了。
After the sacrifice in front of the altar, all that is left for everyone is the "scattering".十一月十八日。November 18th.

一九二四年

一九二四年

一九二四年

1924

一九二四年

望勿“纠正”

一九二四年

I hope it will not be "corrected"汪原放君已经成了古人了，他的标点和校正小说，虽然不免小谬误，但大体是有功于作者和读者的。谁料流弊却无穷，一班效颦的便随手拉一部书，你也标点，我也标点，你也作序，我也作序，他也校改，这也校改，又不肯好好的做，结果只是糟蹋了书。
Wang Yuanfangjun has become an ancient, and although his punctuation and correction of novels are inevitably small fallacies, they are generally credited to the author and readers. Who would have thought that the corruption was endless, and a group of imitators casually pulled a book, you also punctuated, I also punctuated, you also made a preface, I also made a preface, and he also corrected it, which was also corrected, and he refused to do it well, and the result was just a ruin of the book.《花月痕》本不必当作宝贝书，但有人要标点付印，自然是各随各便。这书最初是木刻的，后有排印本；最后是石印，错字很多，现在通行的多是这一种。至于新标点本，则陶乐勤君序云，“本书所取的原本，虽属佳品，可是错误尚多。余虽都加以纠正，然失检之处，势必难免。……”我只有错字很多的石印本，偶然对比了第二十五回中的三四叶，便觉得还是石印本好，因为陶君于石印本的错字多未纠正，而石印本的不错字儿却多纠歪了。
"Flower Moon Traces" does not have to be regarded as a baby book, but if someone wants to punctuate and print, it is naturally as they please. The book was originally woodcut and later typeset; Finally, there are stone seals, there are many typos, and this is the most common one now. As for the new punctuation version, Tao Leqinjun said in the preface, "Although the original taken in this book is a good product, there are still many errors." Although I have corrected everything, it is inevitable that there will be mistakes. ...... "I only have a lithograph with a lot of typos, and I accidentally compared the three or four leaves in the twenty-fifth chapter, and I think it is better to have a lithograph, because Tao Junyu has not corrected many typos in the lithograph, but the good words in the lithograph are more crooked."“钗黛直是个子虚乌有，算不得什么。……”
"Chai Dai is just a nothing, nothing. ……”这“直是个”就是“简直是一个”之意，而纠正本却改作“真是个”，便和原意很不相同了。
This "straight one" means "simply one", but the correction version is changed to "really one", which is very different from the original meaning.“秋痕头上包着绉帕……突见痴珠，便含笑低声说道，‘我料得你挨不上十天，其实何苦呢？’
"Qiu Hen has a crepe handkerchief wrapped around his head...... Suddenly seeing the foolish pearl, he smiled and whispered, 'I expected you to not last ten days, so why bother?' ’“……痴珠笑道，‘往后再商量罢。’……”
“…… Foolish pearl smiled and said, 'Let's discuss it later.' ’……”他们俩虽然都沦落，但其时却没有什么大悲哀，所以还都笑。而纠正本却将两个“笑”字都改成“哭”字了。教他们一见就哭，看眼泪似乎太不值钱，况且“含哭”也不成话。
Although both of them fell, they didn't have any great sorrow at that time, so they both laughed. However, the correction version changed both "laugh" words to "crying". Teach them to cry at first sight, and tears seem too worthless, and "crying" is not a word.我因此想到一种要求，就是印书本是美事，但若自己于意义不甚了然时，不可便以为是错的，而奋然“加以纠正”，不如“过而存之”，或者倒是并不错。
Therefore, I thought of a requirement, that is, printing books is a good thing, but if you don't know the meaning very well, you should not think that it is wrong, and strive to "correct it", it is better to "live and keep it", or it is not bad.我因此又起了一个疑问，就是有些人攻击译本小说“看不懂”，但他们看中国人自作的旧小说，当真看得懂么？
Therefore, I have another question, that is, some people attack the translated novel for "not understanding", but do they really understand the old novels written by the Chinese?一月二十八日。
January 28th.这一篇短文发表之后，曾记得有一回遇见胡适之先生，谈到汪先生的事，知道他很康健。胡先生还以为我那“成了古人”云云，是说他做过许多工作，已足以表见于世的意思。这实在使我“诚惶诚恐”，因为我本意实不如此，直白地说，就是说已经“死掉了”。可是直到那时候，我才知这先前所听到的竟是一种毫无根据的谣言。现在我在此敬向汪先生谢我的粗疏之罪，并且将旧文的第一句订正，改为：“汪原放君未经成了古人了。”一九二五年九月二十四日，身热头痛之际，书。After this short article was published, I remember meeting Mr. Hu Shizhi once, talking about Mr. Wang, and knowing that he was very healthy. Mr. Hu also thought that my "became an ancient" cloud meant that he had done a lot of work, which was enough to show the meaning of the world. This really made me "sincerely afraid", because I didn't mean to do so, to put it bluntly, I was "dead". But it wasn't until then that I realized that what I had heard before was an unfounded rumor. Now I would like to apologize to Mr. Wang for my sloppy sins, and corrected the first sentence of the old text to read: "Wang Yuan Fangjun has not become an ancient." "On September 24, 1925, when I had a fever and headache, I wrote.

Inscription当我沉默着的时候，我觉得充实；我将开口，同时感到空虚。
When I was silent, I felt fulfilled; I will open my mouth and feel empty at the same time.过去的生命已经死亡。我对于这死亡有大欢喜，因为我借此知道它曾经存活。死亡的生命已经朽腐。我对于这朽腐有大欢喜，因为我借此知道它还非空虚。
Past lives are dead. I rejoice in this death because I know that it was alive. The life of death has decayed. I rejoice in this decay, because I know that it is not empty.生命的泥委弃在地面上，不生乔木，只生野草，这是我的罪过。
The mud of life is abandoned on the ground, and it is my sin that it does not grow trees, but only weeds.野草，根本不深，花叶不美，然而吸取露，吸取水，吸取陈死人的血和肉，各各夺取它的生存。当生存时，还是将遭践踏，将遭删刈，直至于死亡而朽腐。
Weeds are not deep at all, and the flowers and leaves are not beautiful, but they absorb dew, water, and the blood and flesh of the dead, each taking its survival. When it is alive, it will still be trampled on, it will be cut off, until it dies and rots.但我坦然，欣然。我将大笑，我将歌唱。
But I am calm and happy. I will laugh, I will sing.我自爱我的野草，但我憎恶这以野草作装饰的地面。
I love my weeds, but I hate the ground decorated with weeds.地火在地下运行，奔突；熔岩一旦喷出，将烧尽一切野草，以及乔木，于是并且无可朽腐。
The earth fire runs underground, rushing; Once the lava erupted, it would burn all the weeds and trees, so it would be incorruptible.但我坦然，欣然。我将大笑，我将歌唱。
But I am calm and happy. I will laugh, I will sing.天地有如此静穆，我不能大笑而且歌唱。天地即不如此静穆，我或者也将不能。我以这一丛野草，在明与暗，生与死，过去与未来之际，献于友与仇，人与兽，爱者与不爱者之前作证。
The world is so quiet that I can't laugh and sing. If heaven and earth were not so quiet, I might not be able to. I use this bush of weeds to testify in front of friends and enemies, humans and beasts, lovers and unloved at the moment of light and darkness, life and death, past and future.为我自己，为友与仇，人与兽，爱者与不爱者，我希望这野草的死亡与朽腐，火速到来。要不然，我先就未曾生存，这实在比死亡与朽腐更其不幸。
For myself, for friends and enemies, between people and beasts, between lovers and unloved, I hope that the death and decay of this weed will come soon. Otherwise, I would not have survived, which is more unfortunate than death and decay.去罢，野草，连着我的题辞！
Go, weeds, with my inscription!一九二七年四月二十六日，鲁迅记于广州之白云楼上。
On April 26, 1927, Lu Xun was recorded on the Baiyun Tower in Guangzhou.

秋夜

秋夜

秋夜

Autumn night在我的后园，可以看见墙外有两株树，一株是枣树，还有一株也是枣树。
In my back garden, I can see two trees outside the wall, one is a jujube tree and the other is also a jujube tree.这上面的夜的天空，奇怪而高，我生平没有见过这样的奇怪而高的天空。他仿佛要离开人间而去，使人们仰面不再看见。然而现在却非常之蓝，闪闪地着几十个星星的眼，冷眼。他的口角上现出微笑，似乎自以为大有深意，而将繁霜洒在我的园里的野花草上。
The night sky above here is strange and high, and I have never seen such a strange and high sky in my life. He seems to be going out of the world, so that people can no longer see when they look up. But now it is very blue, shining with id_0000 the eyes of dozens of stars, cold eyes. A smile appeared on the corner of his mouth, as if he thought he had a deep meaning, and sprinkled frost on the wildflowers and grasses in my garden.我不知道那些花草真叫什么名字，人们叫他们什么名字。我记得有一种开过极细小的粉红花，现在还开着，但是更极细小了，她在冷的夜气中，瑟缩地做梦，梦见春的到来，梦见秋的到来，梦见瘦的诗人将眼泪擦在她最末的花瓣上，告诉她秋虽然来，冬虽然来，而此后接着还是春，胡蝶乱飞，蜜蜂都唱起春词来了。她于是一笑，虽然颜色冻得红惨惨地，仍然瑟缩着。
I don't know what the names of those flowers and plants really are, and what people call them. I remember that there was a very small pink flower that bloomed, and it is still blooming, but it is even smaller, she dreamed in the cold night air, shrinking and dreaming, dreaming of the arrival of spring, dreaming of the arrival of autumn, dreaming of the thin poet wiping tears on her last petals, telling her that although autumn is coming, although winter is coming, and then it is still spring, butterflies fly around, and bees are singing spring words. She smiled, and although her color was red and miserable, she still shrank.枣树，他们简直落尽了叶子。先前，还有一两个孩子来打他们别人打剩的枣子，现在是一个也不剩了，连叶子也落尽了。他知道小粉红花的梦，秋后要有春；他也知道落叶的梦，春后还是秋。他简直落尽叶子，单剩干子，然而脱了当初满树是果实和叶子时候的弧形，欠伸得很舒服。但是，有几枝还低亚着，护定他从打枣的竿梢所得的皮伤，而最直最长的几枝，却已默默地铁似的直刺着奇怪而高的天空，使天空闪闪地鬼眼；直刺着天空中圆满的月亮，使月亮窘得发白。
Jujube trees, they simply lost all their leaves. Previously, there were one or two children who came to beat the dates left over by others, but now there is not a single one left, and even the leaves have fallen. He knew the dream of the little pink flower, and there would be spring after autumn; He also knows the dream of falling leaves, spring or autumn. He simply lost all the leaves, leaving only the dried seeds, but he took off the arc shape when the tree was full of fruits and leaves, and yawned very comfortably. However, a few branches were still low, protecting the skin wounds he had obtained from the tips of the jujube poles, and the straightest and longest branches had silently pierced the strange and high sky like a subway, making the sky sparkle with ghostly eye id_0000 s. It pierced the full moon in the sky, making the moon embarrassed and white.鬼眼的天空越加非常之蓝，不安了，仿佛想离去人间，避开枣树，只将月亮剩下。然而月亮也暗暗地躲到东边去了。而一无所有的干子，却仍然默默地铁似的直刺着奇怪而高的天空，一意要制他的死命，不管他各式各样地着许多蛊惑的眼睛。
The sky in the eyes of the ghost  became more and more very blue, and he was uneasy, as if he wanted to leave the world, avoid the jujube trees, and only leave the moon. However, the moon also secretly hid in the east. And the god who had nothing still silently stabbed the strange and high sky like a subway, determined to control his life, no matter how many bewitching eyes he had.哇的一声，夜游的恶鸟飞过了。
With a wow, the evil birds of the night roaming flew by.我忽而听到夜半的笑声，吃吃地，似乎不愿意惊动睡着的人，然而四围的空气都应和着笑。夜半，没有别的人，我即刻听出这声音就在我嘴里，我也即刻被这笑声所驱逐，回进自己的房。灯火的带子也即刻被我旋高了。
I suddenly heard laughter in the middle of the night, eating and drinking, as if I didn't want to alarm the sleeping people, but the air around me responded with laughter. In the middle of the night, when there was no one else, I immediately heard the sound in my mouth, and I was immediately expelled by the laughter and went back to my room. The strap of the light was immediately turned up by me.后窗的玻璃上丁丁地响，还有许多小飞虫乱撞。不多久，几个进来了，许是从窗纸的破孔进来的。他们一进来，又在玻璃的灯罩上撞得丁丁地响。一个从上面撞进去了，他于是遇到火，而且我以为这火是真的。两三个却休息在灯的纸罩上喘气。那罩是昨晚新换的罩，雪白的纸，折出波浪纹的叠痕，一角还画出一枝猩红色的栀子。
The glass of the rear window was tinkling, and there were many small flying insects bumping into each other. Not long after, a few came in, probably through the hole in the window paper. As soon as they came in, they bumped into the glass lampshade again. One crashed into it from above, and he got into the fire, and I thought it was real. Two or three of them rested on the paper cover of the lamp to gasp. The cover was newly changed last night, snow-white paper, folded with wavy overlapping marks, and a scarlet gardenia was drawn in one corner.猩红的栀子开花时，枣树又要做小粉红花的梦，青葱地弯成弧形了……。我又听到夜半的笑声；我赶紧砍断我的心绪，看那老在白纸罩上的小青虫，头大尾小，向日葵子似的，只有半粒小麦那么大，遍身的颜色苍翠得可爱，可怜。
When the scarlet gardenia blooms, the jujube tree has to dream of small pink flowers again, and the green bends into an arc ....... I heard the laughter of the night again; I hurriedly cut off my mind and looked at the little green worm on the white paper cover, with a big head and a small tail, like sunflower seeds, only the size of half a grain of wheat, and the color of the whole body was so green and cute, pitiful.我打一个呵欠，点起一支纸烟，喷出烟来，对着灯默默地敬奠这些苍翠精致的英雄们。
I yawned, lit a cigarette, spewed out the smoke, and silently paid tribute to these green and exquisite heroes in front of the lamp.一九二四年九月十五日。
September 15, 1924.

影的告别

影的告别

影的告别

Farewell to the shadow人睡到不知道时候的时候，就会有影来告别，说出那些话——
When people sleep until they don't know the time, there will be shadows to say goodbye and say those words -
有我所不乐意的在天堂里，我不愿去；有我所不乐意的在地狱里，我不愿去；有我所不乐意的在你们将来的黄金世界里，我不愿去。
There are things in heaven that I do not like, and I do not want to go; There are things in hell that I don't like, and I don't want to go; There are things I don't want to go to in your future golden world.然而你就是我所不乐意的。
But you are what I don't like.朋友，我不想跟随你了，我不愿住。
Friend, I don't want to follow you anymore, I don't want to live.我不愿意！
I don't want to!呜乎呜乎，我不愿意，我不如彷徨于无地。
Oh no, I don't want to, I might as well wander in nothingness.我不过一个影，要别你而沉没在黑暗里了。然而黑暗又会吞并我，然而光明又会使我消失。
I am just a shadow, and I will leave you and sink into the darkness. But the darkness will swallow me up, and the light will make me disappear.然而我不愿彷徨于明暗之间，我不如在黑暗里沉没。
However, I don't want to wander between light and dark, I might as well sink in the dark.
然而我终于彷徨于明暗之间，我不知道是黄昏还是黎明。我姑且举灰黑的手装作喝干一杯酒，我将在不知道时候的时候独自远行。
However, I finally wandered between light and dark, and I didn't know if it was dusk or dawn. I will raise my gray and black hand and pretend to have a glass of wine, and I will travel alone when I don't know the time.呜乎呜乎，倘若黄昏，黑夜自然会来沉没我，否则我要被白天消失，如果现是黎明。
Woohoo, if it is dusk, the night will naturally come to sink me, otherwise I will disappear by the day, if it is dawn.
朋友，时候近了。
Friend, the time is near.我将向黑暗里彷徨于无地。
I will wander into the darkness and be nothing.你还想我的赠品。我能献你甚么呢？无已，则仍是黑暗和虚空而已。但是，我愿意只是黑暗，或者会消失于你的白天；我愿意只是虚空，决不占你的心地。
You still want my giveaway. What can I offer you? There is no end, but it is still darkness and emptiness. But I would like to be just dark, or disappear into your daylight; I am willing to be just empty and never take your heart.
我愿意这样，朋友——
I would like this, friend—我独自远行，不但没有你，并且再没有别的影在黑暗里。只有我被黑暗沉没，那世界全属于我自己。
I traveled alone, not only without you, but also without other shadows in the darkness. Only I was sunk by darkness, and the world belonged to me.一九二四年九月二十四日。
September 24, 1924.

求乞者

求乞者

求乞者

Beggars我顺着剥落的高墙走路，踏着松的灰土。另外有几个人，各自走路。微风起来，露在墙头的高树的枝条带着还未干枯的叶子在我头上摇动。
I walked along the peeling wall, stepping on the gray soil of the pines. There were a few other people, each walking. The breeze rose, and the branches of the tall trees exposed on the wall swayed on my head with leaves that had not yet dried up.微风起来，四面都是灰土。
The breeze rises, and the surroundings are gray.一个孩子向我求乞，也穿着夹衣，也不见得悲戚，而拦着磕头，追着哀呼。
A child begged for me, also wearing a jacket, and was not necessarily sad, but stopped kowtowing and chasing and wailing.我厌恶他的声调，态度。我憎恶他并不悲哀，近于儿戏；我烦厌他这追着哀呼。
I disgust his tone, his attitude. I hate him not sad, almost child's play; I am tired of him chasing and crying.我走路。另外有几个人各自走路。微风起来，四面都是灰土。
I walk. A few others walked separately. The breeze rises, and the surroundings are gray.一个孩子向我求乞，也穿着夹衣，也不见得悲戚，但是哑的，摊开手，装着手势。
A child begged me, also wearing a jacket, not necessarily sad, but dumb, spread his hands, and gestured.我就憎恶他这手势。而且，他或者并不哑，这不过是一种求乞的法子。
I hate his gesture. Moreover, he may not be dumb, this is just a way to beg.我不布施，我无布施心，我但居布施者之上，给与烦腻，疑心，憎恶。
I don't give, I don't have the heart to give, I just sit above the giver, giving trouble, suspicion, and hatred.我顺着倒败的泥墙走路，断砖叠在墙缺口，墙里面没有什么。微风起来，送秋寒穿透我的夹衣；四面都是灰土。
I walked along the collapsed mud wall, and the broken bricks were stacked in the gaps in the wall, and there was nothing in the wall. The breeze rises, sending the autumn cold through my jacket; It was covered with gray soil on all sides.我想着我将用什么方法求乞：发声，用怎样声调？装哑，用怎样手势？……
I thought about how I would beg: vocalize, what tone? Pretending to be dumb, what gesture to use? ……另外有几个人各自走路。
A few others walked separately.我将得不到布施，得不到布施心；我将得到自居于布施之上者的烦腻，疑心，憎恶。
I will not receive generosity, nor will I be able to receive the heart of giving; I will get the annoyance, doubt, and hatred of those who are above generosity.我将用无所为和沉默求乞……
I will beg with inaction and silence......我至少将得到虚无。
I will at least get nothingness.微风起来，四面都是灰土。另外有几个人各自走路。
The breeze rises, and the surroundings are gray. A few others walked separately.灰土，灰土，……
Gray soil, gray soil,......………………
灰土……
Lime soil......一九二四年九月二十四日。
September 24, 1924.

复仇

revenge人的皮肤之厚，大概不到半分，鲜红的热血，就循着那后面，在比密密层层地爬在墙壁上的槐蚕更其密的血管里奔流，散出温热。于是各以这温热互相蛊惑，煽动，牵引，拚命地希求偎倚，接吻，拥抱，以得生命的沉酣的大欢喜。
The thickness of human skin is probably less than half, and the bright red blood follows behind it, rushing through the blood vessels denser than the locust silkworms crawling densely on the wall, radiating warmth. So each of them bewitched, incited, and pulled each other with this warmth, desperately hoping to snuggle, kiss, and hug each other, so as to get the great joy of life.但倘若用一柄尖锐的利刃，只一击，穿透这桃红色的，菲薄的皮肤，将见那鲜红的热血激箭似的以所有温热直接灌溉杀戮者；其次，则给以冰冷的呼吸，示以淡白的嘴唇，使之人性茫然，得到生命的飞扬的极致的大欢喜；而其自身，则永远沉浸于生命的飞扬的极致的大欢喜中。
But if you use a sharp blade to penetrate this peachy, thin skin with just one blow, you will see the bright red bloody arrow directly irrigating the killer with all the warmth; secondly, it gives cold breath and pale lips, so that it is humane and dazed, and gets the ultimate joy of life; And it itself will always be immersed in the ultimate joy of the flying of life.这样，所以，有他们俩裸着全身，捏着利刃，对立于广漠的旷野之上。
In this way, there are two of them naked, pinching sharp blades, opposing the vast wilderness.他们俩将要拥抱，将要杀戮……
They are going to hug and kill......路人们从四面奔来，密密层层地，如槐蚕爬上墙壁，如马蚁要扛鲞头。衣服都漂亮，手倒空的。然而从四面奔来，而且拚命地伸长颈子，要赏鉴这拥抱或杀戮。他们已经豫觉着事后的自己的舌上的汗或血的鲜味。
Passers-by came from all sides, densely layered, like locust silkworms climbing the wall, like horse ants carrying the head. The clothes are beautiful, and the hands are empty. Yet they came from all directions, and stretched their necks desperately, wanting to appreciate the embrace or kill. They already have a sense of the sweat or the umami of blood on their tongues afterwards.然而他们俩对立着，在广漠的旷野之上，裸着全身，捏着利刃，然而也不拥抱，也不杀戮，而且也不见有拥抱或杀戮之意。
However, the two of them were opposite, naked in the vast wilderness, holding sharp blades, but they did not hug, did not kill, and did not have the intention of hugging or killing.他们俩这样地至于永久，圆活的身体，已将干枯，然而毫不见有拥抱或杀戮之意。
Their permanent, round bodies are dry, yet there is no intention of embracing or killing.路人们于是乎无聊；觉得有无聊钻进他们的毛孔，觉得有无聊从他们自己的心中由毛孔钻出，爬满旷野，又钻进别人的毛孔中。他们于是觉得喉舌干燥，脖子也乏了；终至于面面相觑，慢慢走散；甚而至于居然觉得干枯到失了生趣。
Passers-by are bored; They feel bored getting into their pores, they feel boredom coming out of their own hearts, crawling all over the wilderness, and into other people's pores. They felt that their mouthpieces were dry and their necks were tired; In the end, they looked at each other and slowly separated; It even feels so dry that it is boring.于是只剩下广漠的旷野，而他们俩在其间裸着全身，捏着利刃，干枯地立着；以死人似的眼光，赏鉴这路人们的干枯，无血的大戮，而永远沉浸于生命的飞扬的极致的大欢喜中。
So only the vast wilderness remained, and the two of them stood naked, pinching sharp blades, and dry; With a dead eye, appreciate the dryness and bloodless slaughter of these people, and forever immerse yourself in the ultimate joy of the flying of life.一九二四年十二月二十日。
December 20, 1924.

复仇（其二）

Revenge (Part 2)因为他自以为神之子，以色列的王，所以去钉十字架。
Because he thought he was the Son of God, the King of Israel, he went to be crucified.兵丁们给他穿上紫袍，戴上荆冠，庆贺他；又拿一根苇子打他的头，吐他，屈膝拜他；戏弄完了，就给他脱了紫袍，仍穿他自己的衣服。

希望

希望

wish我的心分外地寂寞。
My heart was extremely lonely.然而我的心很平安：没有爱憎，没有哀乐，也没有颜色和声音。
Yet my heart is at peace: there is no love or hate, no sorrow or joy, no color or sound.我大概老了。我的头发已经苍白，不是很明白的事么？我的手颤抖着，不是很明白的事么？那么，我的魂灵的手一定也颤抖着，头发也一定苍白了。
I'm probably old. My hair is already pale, isn't it very clear? My hands trembled, didn't I understand it? Then, my soul's hands must also tremble, and my hair must be pale.然而这是许多年前的事了。
However, this was many years ago.这以前，我的心也曾充满过血腥的歌声：血和铁，火焰和毒，恢复和报仇。而忽而这些都空虚了，但有时故意地填以没奈何的自欺的希望。希望，希望，用这希望的盾，抗拒那空虚中的暗夜的袭来，虽然盾后面也依然是空虚中的暗夜。然而就是如此，陆续地耗尽了我的青春。
Before this, my heart was also filled with bloody songs: blood and iron, fire and poison, restoration and vengeance. And suddenly these are empty, but sometimes deliberately filled with helpless self-deceptive hopes. Hope, hope, use this shield of hope to resist the attack of the dark night in the void, although behind the shield is still the dark night in the void. However, this is the case, which has exhausted my youth one after another.我早先岂不知我的青春已经逝去了？但以为身外的青春固在：星，月光，僵坠的胡蝶，暗中的花，猫头鹰的不祥之言，杜鹃的啼血，笑的渺茫，爱的翔舞……。虽然是悲凉漂渺的青春罢，然而究竟是青春。
Didn't I know earlier that my youth had passed? But I think that the youth outside the body is fixed: stars, moonlight, stiff butterflies, flowers in the dark, ominous words of owls, cuckoos' crying blood, laughter is faint, love is dancing ....... Although it is a sad and ethereal youth, it is youth in the end.然而现在何以如此寂寞？难道连身外的青春也都逝去，世上的青年也多衰老了么？
But why is it so lonely now? Isn't even the youth outside the body gone, and how old are the young people in the world?我只得由我来肉薄这空虚中的暗夜了。我放下了希望之盾，我听到Petfi Sándor（1823—49）的“希望”之歌：
I have to come to the dark night in the emptiness of thinness. I put down the shield of hope, and I heard the song "Hope" by Petfi Sándor (1823-49):希望是甚么？是娼妓：
What is hope? It's a prostitute:她对谁都蛊惑，将一切都献给；
She bewitches everyone and gives everything to her;待你牺牲了极多的宝贝——
When you sacrifice a lot of treasures——你的青春——她就弃掉你。
Your youth - she abandoned you.这伟大的抒情诗人，匈牙利的爱国者，为了祖国而死在可萨克兵的矛尖上，已经七十五年了。悲哉死也，然而更可悲的是他的诗至今没有死。
It has been seventy-five years since this great lyric poet, a Hungarian patriot, died for the Motherland on the tip of the spear of the Cossack soldiers. It is a sad death, but what is even sadder is that his poems have not died so far.但是，可惨的人生！桀骜英勇如Petfi，也终于对了暗夜止步，回顾着茫茫的东方了。他说：
However, what a miserable life! Unruly and heroic like Petfi, he finally stopped in the dark night and looked back at the vast east. He said:绝望之为虚妄，正与希望相同。
Despair is false, just like hope.倘使我还得偷生在不明不暗的这“虚妄”中，我就还要寻求那逝去的悲凉漂渺的青春，但不妨在我的身外。因为身外的青春倘一消灭，我身中的迟暮也即凋零了。
If I still have to live in this "illusion" that is unknown and undark, I will still seek the sad and ethereal youth that has passed, but it might as well be outside my body. Because if the youth outside my body is destroyed, the twilight in my body will wither.然而现在没有星和月光，没有僵坠的胡蝶以至笑的渺茫，爱的翔舞。然而青年们很平安。
However, now there are no stars and moonlight, no stiff butterflies, and even the vagueness of laughter and the soaring dance of love. However, the young people were safe.我只得由我来肉薄这空虚中的暗夜了，纵使寻不到身外的青春，也总得自己来一掷我身中的迟暮。但暗夜又在那里呢？现在没有星，没有月光以至笑的渺茫和爱的翔舞；青年们很平安，而我的面前又竟至于并且没有真的暗夜。
I have to come to the dark night in the emptiness of thinness, even if I can't find the youth outside me, I have to throw the twilight in my body by myself. But where is the dark night again? Now there are no stars, no moonlight and even the vagueness of laughter and the dance of love; The young people are safe, and there is no real dark night in front of me.绝望之为虚妄，正与希望相同！
绝望之为虚妄，正与希望相同！一九二五年一月一日。

雪

雪

雪暖国的雨，向来没有变过冰冷的坚硬的灿烂的雪花。博识的人们觉得他单调，他自己也以为不幸否耶？江南的雪，可是滋润美艳之至了；那是还在隐约着的青春的消息，是极壮健的处子的皮肤。雪野中有血红的宝珠山茶，白中隐青的单瓣梅花，深黄的磬口的蜡梅花；雪下面还有冷绿的杂草。胡蝶确乎没有；蜜蜂是否来采山茶花和梅花的蜜，我可记不真切了。但我的眼前仿佛看见冬花开在雪野中，有许多蜜蜂们忙碌地飞着，也听得他们嗡嗡地闹着。
The rain in a warm country has never changed into a cold, hard, and brilliant snowflake. Knowledgeable people think he is monotonous, and he himself thinks it is unfortunate. The snow in Jiangnan is moist and beautiful; It was the news of youth that was still vague, and it was the skin of a very strong virgin. There are blood-red pearl camellias, white and blue single-petal plum blossoms, and dark yellow wax plum blossoms; There are also cold green weeds under the snow. Hu Die really didn't; I can't really remember whether the bees came to collect nectar from camellias and plum blossoms. But I seemed to see winter flowers blooming in the snowy fields, and many bees were busy flying, and I could hear them buzzing.孩子们呵着冻得通红，像紫芽姜一般的小手，七八个一齐来塑雪罗汉。因为不成功，谁的父亲也来帮忙了。罗汉就塑得比孩子们高得多，虽然不过是上小下大的一堆，终于分不清是壶卢还是罗汉；然而很洁白，很明艳，以自身的滋润相粘结，整个地闪闪地生光。孩子们用龙眼核给他做眼珠，又从谁的母亲的脂粉奁中偷得胭脂来涂在嘴唇上。这回确是一个大阿罗汉了。他也就目光灼灼地嘴唇通红地坐在雪地里。
The children were red from the cold, and their small hands like purple bud ginger came together to sculpt the snow arhat. Because it was unsuccessful, someone's father also came to help. The arhat is much taller than the children, although it is just a small and large pile, and finally it is impossible to tell whether it is Hulu or Arhat; However, it is very white and bright, bonded with its own moisture, and the whole ground shines brightly. The children used longan kernels to make eyeballs for him, and stole rouge from someone's mother's powder box to apply to his lips. This time he was indeed a great arhat. He also sat in the snow with burning eyes and red lips.第二天还有几个孩子来访问他；对了他拍手，点头，嘻笑。但他终于独自坐着了。晴天又来消释他的皮肤，寒夜又使他结一层冰，化作不透明的水晶模样；连续的晴天又使他成为不知道算什么，而嘴上的胭脂也褪尽了。
Several more children came to visit him the next day; He clapped his hands, nodded, and laughed. But he finally sat alone. The sunny day melted his skin again, and the cold night made him form a layer of ice, turning into an opaque crystal; The continuous sunny days made him feel like he didn't know what to do, and the rouge on his mouth faded.但是，朔方的雪花在纷飞之后，却永远如粉，如沙，他们决不粘连，撒在屋上，地上，枯草上，就是这样。屋上的雪是早已就有消化了的，因为屋里居人的火的温热。别的，在晴天之下，旋风忽来，便蓬勃地奋飞，在日光中灿灿地生光，如包藏火焰的大雾，旋转而且升腾，弥漫太空，使太空旋转而且升腾地闪烁。
However, after the snowflakes in Shuo Fang flew away, they were always like powder, like sand, they would never stick, and they would be scattered on the roof, on the ground, and on the dry grass, that's it. The snow on the house has already been digested because of the warmth of the fire of the people in the house. Otherwise, under a sunny day, a whirlwind suddenly comes, and it flies vigorously, shining brightly in the daylight, like a mist containing flames, rotating and rising, spreading space, making space rotate and flicker upwards.在无边的旷野上，在凛冽的天宇下，闪闪地旋转升腾着的是雨的精魂……
In the boundless wilderness, under the cold sky, it was the spirit of rain that was spinning and rising......是的，那是孤独的雪，是死掉的雨，是雨的精魂。
Yes, it is lonely snow, dead rain, and the spirit of rain.一九二五年一月十八日。
January 18, 1925.

风筝

风筝

风筝

kite北京的冬季，地上还有积雪，灰黑色的秃树枝丫叉于晴朗的天空中，而远处有一二风筝浮动，在我是一种惊异和悲哀。
In winter in Beijing, there is still snow on the ground, gray-black bald branches are crossed in the clear sky, and one or two kites are floating in the distance, which is a kind of surprise and sadness to me.故乡的风筝时节，是春二月，倘听到沙沙的风轮声，仰头便能看见一个淡墨色的蟹风筝或嫩蓝色的蜈蚣风筝。还有寂寞的瓦片风筝，没有风轮，又放得很低，伶仃地显出憔悴可怜模样。但此时地上的杨柳已经发芽，早的山桃也多吐蕾，和孩子们的天上的点缀相照应，打成一片春日的温和。我现在在那里呢？四面都还是严冬的肃杀，而久经诀别的故乡的久经逝去的春天，却就在这天空中荡漾了。
The kite season in my hometown is spring and February, if you hear the rustling of wind wheels, you can look up and see a light ink crab kite or a tender blue centipede kite. There are also lonely tile kites, without wind wheels, and they are set very low, showing a haggard and pitiful appearance. But at this time, the willows on the ground have sprouted, and the early mountain peaches have also sprouted more buds, which corresponds to the children's heavenly embellishments, making it a gentle spring day. Where am I now? It is still the harsh winter on all sides, but the long-lost spring of the long-lost hometown is rippling in this sky.但我是向来不爱放风筝的，不但不爱，并且嫌恶他，因为我以为这是没出息孩子所做的玩艺。和我相反的是我的小兄弟，他那时大概十岁内外罢，多病，瘦得不堪，然而最喜欢风筝，自己买不起，我又不许放，他只得张着小嘴，呆看着空中出神，有时至于小半日。远处的蟹风筝突然落下来了，他惊呼；两个瓦片风筝的缠绕解开了，他高兴得跳跃。他的这些，在我看来都是笑柄，可鄙的。
But I have never loved flying kites, not only do I not love it, but I hate him, because I think this is a play done by a promising child. The opposite of me was my little brother, who was about ten years old at the time, sickly, and thin, but he liked kites the most, and he couldn't afford to buy them, and I was not allowed to put them down, so he had to open his mouth and watch the air in a daze, sometimes for half a day. The crab kite in the distance suddenly fell, and he exclaimed; The two tile kites were untangled, and he jumped with joy. These of his, in my opinion, are all laughing stocks and contemptible.有一天，我忽然想起，似乎多日不很看见他了，但记得曾见他在后园拾枯竹。我恍然大悟似的，便跑向少有人去的一间堆积杂物的小屋去，推开门，果然就在尘封的什物堆中发见了他。他向着大方凳，坐在小凳上；便很惊惶地站了起来，失了色瑟缩着。大方凳旁靠着一个胡蝶风筝的竹骨，还没有糊上纸，凳上是一对做眼睛用的小风轮，正用红纸条装饰着，将要完工了。我在破获秘密的满足中，又很愤怒他的瞒了我的眼睛，这样苦心孤诣地来偷做没出息孩子的玩艺。我即刻伸手折断了胡蝶的一支翅骨，又将风轮掷在地下，踏扁了。论长幼，论力气，他是都敌不过我的，我当然得到完全的胜利，于是傲然走出，留他绝望地站在小屋里。后来他怎样，我不知道，也没有留心。
One day, I suddenly remembered that I hadn't seen him for many days, but I remembered seeing him picking up dead bamboo in the back garden. As if I suddenly realized, I ran to a small hut where few people went to a pile of debris, opened the door, and sure enough, I found him in the dusty pile of things. He sat on a small stool facing a large square stool; He stood up in panic, losing his color and shrinking. Next to the large stool is a bamboo bone of a butterfly kite, which has not yet been pasted with paper, and on the stool is a pair of small wind wheels for the eyes, decorated with red strips of paper, and is about to be completed. In the satisfaction of cracking the secret, I was very angry that he hid from my eyes, so painstakingly came to steal the play of a promising child. I immediately reached out and broke one of Hu Die's wing bones, threw the wind wheel on the ground, and flattened it. In terms of age and strength, he was no match for me, and of course I was completely victorious, so I walked out proudly, leaving him standing in the cabin in despair. I don't know what happened to him later, and I didn't pay attention.然而我的惩罚终于轮到了，在我们离别得很久之后，我已经是中年。我不幸偶而看了一本外国的讲论儿童的书，才知道游戏是儿童最正当的行为，玩具是儿童的天使。于是二十年来毫不忆及的幼小时候对于精神的虐杀的这一幕，忽地在眼前展开，而我的心也仿佛同时变了铅块，很重很重的堕下去了。
However, my punishment finally came, and I was middle-aged long after we parted. Unfortunately, I occasionally read a foreign book on children, and then I realized that play is the most legitimate behavior of children, and toys are children's angels. So the scene of the spiritual abuse of my childhood, which I had not remembered for twenty years, suddenly unfolded in front of my eyes, and my heart seemed to have turned into a block of lead at the same time, and it fell very heavily.但心又不竟堕下去而至于断绝，他只是很重很重地堕着，堕着。
But the mind does not fall and is cut off, it just falls very heavily, falls.我也知道补过的方法的：送他风筝，赞成他放，劝他放，我和他一同放。我们嚷着，跑着，笑着。——然而他其时已经和我一样，早已有了胡子了。
I also know how to make up for it: give him a kite, approve of him to fly, persuade him to fly, and I will fly it with him. We shouted, ran, laughed. - But he was already bearded like me.我也知道还有一个补过的方法的：去讨他的宽恕，等他说，“我可是毫不怪你呵。”那么，我的心一定就轻松了，这确是一个可行的方法。有一回，我们会面的时候，是脸上都已添刻了许多“生”的辛苦的条纹，而我的心很沉重。我们渐渐谈起儿时的旧事来，我便叙述到这一节，自说少年时代的胡涂。“我可是毫不怪你呵。”我想，他要说了，我即刻便受了宽恕，我的心从此也宽松了罢。
I also know that there is another way to make amends: to ask for his forgiveness, and when he says, "I don't blame you." "Then my heart must be at ease, and this is indeed a feasible method. Once, when we met, there were many "raw" hard stripes engraved on our faces, and my heart was very heavy. We gradually talked about the old things of our childhood, and I recounted this section, talking about the nonsense of my youth. "I don't blame you." I thought he was going to say it, and I was immediately forgiven, and my heart was relaxed from then on.“有过这样的事么？”他惊异地笑着说，就像旁听着别人的故事一样。他什么也不记得了。
"Has there ever been such a thing?" He smiled in amazement, as if he were listening to someone else's story. He remembers nothing.全然忘却，毫无怨恨，又有什么宽恕之可言呢？无怨的恕，说谎罢了。
Completely forgetful, without resentment, what forgiveness is there? Forgiveness without complaint is just a lie.我还能希求什么呢？我的心只得沉重着。
What more could I ask for? My heart had to be heavy.现在，故乡的春天又在这异地的空中了，既给我久经逝去的儿时的回忆，而一并也带着无可把握的悲哀。我倒不如躲到肃杀的严冬中去罢，——但是，四面又明明是严冬，正给我非常的寒威和冷气。
Now, the spring of my hometown is in the air of this foreign place again, which not only gives me long-lost childhood memories, but also carries an uncertain sadness. I might as well hide in the harsh winter,—— but it is obviously a harsh winter on all sides, which is giving me a very cold and cold air.一九二五年一月二十四日。
January 24, 1925.
