Good story灯火渐渐地缩小了，在预告石油的已经不多；石油又不是老牌，早熏得灯罩很昏暗。鞭爆的繁响在四近，烟草的烟雾在身边：是昏沉的夜。

I closed my eyes, leaned back, and leaned back on the back of my chair; The hand holding the "Beginner's Record" rested on the knee condyle.我在蒙胧中，看见一个好的故事。

This story is beautiful, elegant and interesting. The bottom of the blue sky in the water, everything is intertwined on it, woven into a piece, always vivid, always unfolding, I can't see the end of this article.河边枯柳树下的几株瘦削的一丈红，该是村女种的罢。大红花和斑红花，都在水里面浮动，忽而碎散，拉长了，如缕缕的胭脂水，然而没有晕。茅屋，狗，塔，村女，云，……也都浮动着。大红花一朵朵全被拉长了，这时是泼剌奔迸的红锦带。带织入狗中，狗织入白云中，白云织入村女中……。在一瞬间，他们又将退缩了。但斑红花影也已碎散，伸长，就要织进塔，村女，狗，茅屋，云里去。

死火

死火

死火

Dead fire我梦见自己在冰山间奔驰。
I dreamed that I was running between icebergs.这是高大的冰山，上接冰天，天上冻云弥漫，片片如鱼鳞模样。山麓有冰树林，枝叶都如松杉。一切冰冷，一切青白。
This is a tall iceberg, connected to the ice sky, the sky is filled with frozen clouds, and the pieces look like fish scales. There is an ice forest at the foot of the mountain, and the branches and leaves are like pines and firs. Everything is cold, everything is blue and white.但我忽然坠在冰谷中。
But I suddenly fell into the ice valley.上下四旁无不冰冷，青白。而一切青白冰上，却有红影无数，纠结如珊瑚网。我俯看脚下，有火焰在。
The upper and lower sides are all cold, blue and white. And on all the blue and white ice, there are countless red shadows, tangled like coral nets. I looked down at my feet, and there was a flame.这是死火。有炎炎的形，但毫不摇动，全体冰结，像珊瑚枝；尖端还有凝固的黑烟，疑这才从火宅中出，所以枯焦。这样，映在冰的四壁，而且互相反映，化为无量数影，使这冰谷，成红珊瑚色。
This is a dead fire. There is a fiery shape, but it does not shake, and the whole is frozen, like a coral branch; There was also solidified black smoke at the tip, which was suspected to have come out of the fire house, so it was scorched. In this way, they are reflected on the four walls of the ice, and they reflect each other, turning into countless shadows, making this ice valley red coral.哈哈！
Ha ha!当我幼小的时候，本就爱看快舰激起的浪花，洪炉喷出的烈焰。不但爱看，还想看清。可惜他们都息息变幻，永无定形。虽然凝视又凝视，总不留下怎样一定的迹象。
When I was young, I loved to watch the waves caused by the fast ship and the flames spewed out by the furnace. Not only do I love to watch, but I also want to see clearly. It's a pity that they are all constantly changing and never fixed. Although he stared and stared, he never left any certain signs.死的火焰，现在先得到了你了！
Dead flame, now I got you first!我拾起死火，正要细看，那冷气已使我的指头焦灼；但是，我还熬着，将他塞入衣袋中间。冰谷四面，登时完全青白。我一面思索着走出冰谷的法子。
I picked up the dead fire and was about to take a closer look, but the cold air had burned my fingers; However, I still held on and stuffed him in the middle of my pocket. The ice valley was completely blue and white at that time. I thought about how to get out of the ice valley.我的身上喷出一缕黑烟，上升如铁线蛇。冰谷四面，又登时满有红焰流动，如大火聚，将我包围。我低头一看，死火已经燃烧，烧穿了我的衣裳，流在冰地上了。
A wisp of black smoke erupted from my body, rising like a wire snake. On all sides of the ice valley, red flames flowed like fire, surrounding me. I looked down and saw that the dead fire had burned, burned through my clothes, and flowed on the ice.“唉，朋友！你用了你的温热，将我惊醒了。”他说。
"Alas, friend! You used your warmth to wake me up. He said.我连忙和他招呼，问他名姓。
I hurriedly greeted him and asked for his name.“我原先被人遗弃在冰谷中，”他答非所问地说，“遗弃我的早已灭亡，消尽了。我也被冰冻冻得要死。倘使你不给我温热，使我重行烧起，我不久就须灭亡。”
"I was abandoned in the valley of ice," he replied, "and the abandonment of me is long gone, and it has disappeared." I was also frozen to death. If you do not give me warmth, and make me burn again, I will soon perish. ”“你的醒来，使我欢喜。我正在想着走出冰谷的方法；我愿意携带你去，使你永不冰结，永得燃烧。”
"Your awakening makes me happy. I was thinking of a way out of the ice valley; I will take you with me, so that you will never freeze and burn forever. ”“唉唉！那么，我将烧完！”
"Alas! Then, I'll burn it out! ”“你的烧完，使我惋惜。我便将你留下，仍在这里罢。”
"Your burning makes me feel sorry for it. I will leave you here and stay here. ”“唉唉！那么，我将冻灭了！”
"Alas! Then, I will freeze to death! ”“那么，怎么办呢？”
"So, what to do?"“但你自己，又怎么办呢？”他反而问。
"But what about yourself?" Instead, he asked.“我说过了：我要出这冰谷……。”
"I said: I want to get out of this ice valley ......."“那我就不如烧完！”
"Then I might as well burn it out!"他忽而跃起，如红彗星，并我都出冰谷口外。有大石车突然驰来，我终于碾死在车轮底下，但我还来得及看见那车就坠入冰谷中。
He suddenly jumped up, like a red comet, and I was out of the mouth of the ice valley. A big stone cart suddenly came and I finally ran under the wheels, but I didn't have time to see the car fall into the ice valley.“哈哈！你们是再也遇不着死火了！”我得意地笑着说，仿佛就愿意这样似的。
"Haha! You will never meet a dead fire again!" I smiled proudly and said, as if I wanted to.一九二五年四月二十三日。

狗的驳诘

The dog's rebuttal我梦见自己在隘巷中行走，衣履破碎，像乞食者。
I dreamed that I was walking in a narrow alley, my clothes and shoes torn, like a beggar.一条狗在背后叫起来了。
A dog barked behind his back.我傲慢地回顾，叱咤说：
I looked back arrogantly and shouted:“呔！住口！你这势利的狗！”
"Oh! Shut up! You snobbish dog! ”“嘻嘻！”他笑了，还接着说，“不敢，愧不如人呢。”
"Hehe!" He smiled and continued, "I don't dare, I'm ashamed of being inferior to others." ”“什么！？”我气愤了，觉得这是一个极端的侮辱。
"What!?" I was angry and felt that this was an extreme insult.“我惭愧：我终于还不知道分别铜和银；还不知道分别布和绸；还不知道分别官和民；还不知道分别主和奴；还不知道……”
"I am ashamed: I do not know the difference between copper and silver; I don't know how to distinguish between cloth and silk; I don't know the distinction between officials and people; I don't know the difference between master and slave; I don't know ...... yet."我逃走了。
I ran away.“且慢！我们再谈谈……”他在后面大声挽留。
"Slow down! Let's talk about ......" he shouted behind him.我一径逃走，尽力地走，直到逃出梦境，躺在自己的床上。
I ran away, and walked as hard as I could, until I escaped from the dream and lay down in my bed.一九二五年四月二十三日。

失掉的好地狱

失掉的好地狱

Good hell to lose我梦见自己躺在床上，在荒寒的野外，地狱的旁边。一切鬼魂们的叫唤无不低微，然有秩序，与火焰的怒吼，油的沸腾，钢叉的震颤相和鸣，造成醉心的大乐，布告三界：地下太平。
I dreamed that I was lying in bed, in the wilderness, next to hell. The calls of all the ghosts are all low, but orderly, and the roar of the flames, the boiling of oil, and the trembling of the steel forks harmonize with the great joy of intoxication, announcing the three realms: peace underground.有一伟大的男子站在我面前，美丽，慈悲，遍身有大光辉，然而我知道他是魔鬼。
There was a great man standing in front of me, beautiful, merciful, with great brilliance, yet I knew he was the devil.“一切都已完结，一切都已完结！可怜的鬼魂们将那好的地狱失掉了！”他悲愤地说，于是坐下，讲给我一个他所知道的故事——

墓碣文

墓碣文

Tomb inscription我梦见自己正和墓碣对立，读着上面的刻辞。那墓碣似是沙石所制，剥落很多，又有苔藓丛生，仅存有限的文句——
I dreamed that I was facing the tombstone, reading the inscription on it. The tomb seems to be made of sand and stone, peeling off a lot, and there are mosses, and only a limited sentence remains——……于浩歌狂热之际中寒；于天上看见深渊。于一切眼中看见无所有；于无所希望中得救。……
…… In the midst of the frenzy of Hao Ge, it is cold; I saw the abyss in the sky. see nothing in all eyes; Saved from hopelessness. …………有一游魂，化为长蛇，口有毒牙。不以啮人，自啮其身，终以殒颠。……
…… 有一游魂，化为长蛇，口有毒牙。 不以啮人，自啮其身，终以殒颠。 …………离开！……
…… 离开！……我绕到碣后，才见孤坟，上无草木，且已颓坏。即从大阙口中，窥见死尸，胸腹俱破，中无心肝。而脸上却绝不显哀乐之状，但蒙蒙如烟然。
I walked around to the back of the stone tablet and saw a solitary grave, with no grass or trees on it, and it had already collapsed. He then peeked through the mouth of the large gate and saw a corpse, with his chest and abdomen shattered, and there was no heart or liver inside. But his face never showed any signs of sadness or joy, but it was hazy like smoke.我在疑惧中不及回身，然而已看见墓碣阴面的残存的文句——
I didn't have time to turn around in my doubts, but I had already seen the remaining sentences on the dark side of the tomb——……抉心自食，欲知本味。创痛酷烈，本味何能知？……
…… Eat your own heart, and want to know the original taste. The pain is so intense; how can one know the true taste? …………痛定之后，徐徐食之。然其心已陈旧，本味又何由知？……
…… After the pain is calmed, eat slowly. However, his heart has become outdated, and how can he know his true taste? …………答我。否则，离开！……
…… Answer me. Otherwise, leave! ……我就要离开。而死尸已在坟中坐起，口唇不动，然而说——
I'm leaving. And the dead body had sat up in the grave, without moving his lips, but he said—“待我成尘时，你将见我的微笑！”
"When I turn to dust, you will see my smile!"我疾走，不敢反顾，生怕看见他的追随。
I walked quickly, not daring to look back, for fear of seeing his following.一九二五年六月十七日。

颓败线的颤动

颓败线的颤动

The trembling of the line of decay我梦见自己在做梦。自身不知所在，眼前却有一间在深夜中紧闭的小屋的内部，但也看见屋上瓦松的茂密的森林。
I dreamed that I was dreaming. I didn't know where I was, but in front of me was the inside of a hut closed in the middle of the night, but I could also see the dense forest of tiles on the roof.板桌上的灯罩是新拭的，照得屋子里分外明亮。在光明中，在破榻上，在初不相识的披毛的强悍的肉块底下，有瘦弱渺小的身躯，为饥饿，苦痛，惊异，羞辱，欢欣而颤动。弛缓，然而尚且丰腴的皮肤光润了；青白的两颊泛出轻红，如铅上涂了胭脂水。
The lampshade on the board table was freshly wiped, illuminating the room very brightly. In the light, on the broken bed, under the strong flesh of the fur that I had never known before, there were thin and small bodies, trembling with hunger, pain, astonishment, humiliation, and joy. Relaxed, but still plump skin is glossy; The pale and white cheeks were light red, like lead coated with rouge water.灯火也因惊惧而缩小了，东方已经发白。
The lights also shrank with fear, and the east was already white.然而空中还弥漫地摇动着饥饿，苦痛，惊异，羞辱，欢欣的波涛……。

"It's still early, let's sleep for a while." She said, raising her eyes and looking at the sky above the dilapidated rooftops without telling anything.空中突然另起了一个很大的波涛，和先前的相撞击，回旋而成旋涡，将一切并我尽行淹没，口鼻都不能呼吸。
Suddenly, another big wave rose in the air, colliding with the previous one, swirling into a vortex, submerging everything and me, and I couldn't breathe.我呻吟着醒来，窗外满是如银的月色，离天明还很辽远似的。

我自身不知所在，眼前却有一间在深夜中紧闭的小屋的内部，我自己知道是在续着残梦。可是梦的年代隔了许多年了。屋的内外已经这样整齐；里面是青年的夫妻，一群小孩子，都怨恨鄙夷地对着一个垂老的女人。

The inside and outside of the house are already so neat; Inside were young couples, a group of children, all resentful and contemptuous at an aging woman.“我们没有脸见人，就只因为你，”男人气忿地说。“你还以为养大了她，其实正是害苦了她，倒不如小时候饿死的好！”

"You're still tired of me!" The man said.“还要带累他们哩！”女的说，指着孩子们。
"I still have to tire them!" The woman said, pointing at the children.最小的一个正玩着一片干芦叶，这时便向空中一挥，仿佛一柄钢刀，大声说道：
The youngest one was playing with a dried reed leaf, and then he waved it into the air, like a steel knife, and said loudly:“杀！”
"Kill!"那垂老的女人口角正在痉挛，登时一怔，接着便都平静，不多时候，她冷静地，骨立的石像似的站起来了。她开开板门，迈步在深夜中走出，遗弃了背后一切的冷骂和毒笑。
The old woman's horns were spasming, and she was startled, and then she calmed down, and after a while, she stood up calmly, like a stone statue. She opened the door and walked out of the middle of the night, abandoning all the scolding and poisonous laughter behind her.她在深夜中尽走，一直走到无边的荒野；四面都是荒野，头上只有高天，并无一个虫鸟飞过。她赤身露体地，石像似的站在荒野的中央，于一刹那间照见过往的一切：饥饿，苦痛，惊异，羞辱，欢欣，于是发抖；害苦，委屈，带累，于是痉挛；杀，于是平静。……又于一刹那间将一切并合：眷念与决绝，爱抚与复仇，养育与歼除，祝福与咒诅……。她于是举两手尽量向天，口唇间漏出人与兽的，非人间所有，所以无词的言语。
She walked in the middle of the night, all the way to the boundless wilderness; There was wilderness on all sides, only the sky was high above, and not a single insect or bird flew by. She stood naked in the middle of the wilderness like a stone statue, and in an instant saw everything that had passed: hunger, pain, astonishment, humiliation, rejoicing, and trembling; Suffering, grievance, and tiredness, so spasms; Kill, then calm. …… And in an instant, everything is combined: love and determination, caresses and revenge, nurturing and annihilation, blessing and curse....... She then raised her hands to the sky as much as possible, and the words of humans and beasts leaked out from her lips, not in the world, so there were no words.当她说出无词的言语时，她那伟大如石像，然而已经荒废的，颓败的身躯的全面都颤动了。这颤动点点如鱼鳞，每一鳞都起伏如沸水在烈火上；空中也即刻一同振颤，仿佛暴风雨中的荒海的波涛。
When she spoke the wordless words, her greatness, however, the whole of her abandoned, decadent body trembled. This trembling bit is like fish scales, and each scale rises and falls like boiling water on the fire; The air immediately trembled, like the waves of the desolate sea in a storm.她于是抬起眼睛向着天空，并无词的言语也沉默尽绝，惟有颤动，辐射若太阳光，使空中的波涛立刻回旋，如遭飓风，汹涌奔腾于无边的荒野。
She then raised her eyes to the sky, and her words were silent, only trembling, radiating like sunlight, causing the waves in the air to immediately swirl like a hurricane, surging in the boundless wilderness.我梦魇了，自己却知道是因为将手搁在胸脯上了的缘故；我梦中还用尽平生之力，要将这十分沉重的手移开。
I had a nightmare, but I knew it was because I put my hand on my chest; In my dream, I used all my strength to remove this very heavy hand.一九二五年六月二十九日。

立论

Argument我梦见自己正在小学校的讲堂上预备作文，向老师请教立论的方法。
I dreamed that I was preparing an essay in a lecture hall in a primary school and asked the teacher for advice on how to write an argument.“难！”老师从眼镜圈外斜射出眼光来，看着我，说。“我告诉你一件事——
"Difficult!" The teacher shot out his eyes from outside the glasses circle, looked at me, and said. "Let me tell you one thing—“一家人家生了一个男孩，合家高兴透顶了。满月的时候，抱出来给客人看，——大概自然是想得一点好兆头。
"The family gave birth to a boy, and the whole family was overjoyed. When the moon is full, it is probably a good omen to take out to show the guests,—— which is probably a good omen.“一个说：‘这孩子将来要发财的。’他于是得到一番感谢。
"One said, 'This child will get rich in the future.' He was thanked.“一个说：‘这孩子将来要做官的。’他于是收回几句恭维。
"One said: 'This child will be an official in the future.' He then withdrew a few compliments.“一个说：‘这孩子将来是要死的。’他于是得到一顿大家合力的痛打。
"One said: 'This child is going to die.' He then got a beating from everyone.“说要死的必然，说富贵的许谎。但说谎的得好报，说必然的遭打。你……”
"Saying that death is inevitable, telling the lie of wealth. But those who lie will be rewarded, and they will inevitably be beaten. You ......"“我愿意既不谎人，也不遭打。那么，老师，我得怎么说呢？”
"I am willing to neither lie nor be beaten. So, teacher, what do I have to say? ”“那么，你得说：‘啊呀！这孩子呵！您瞧！多么……。阿唷！哈哈！Hehe！he，hehehehe！’”
"Well, you have to say, 'Ahhh! This kid! Lo and behold! How....... Ahh! Ha ha! Hehe！ he，hehehehe！ ’”一九二五年七月八日。
July 8, 1925.

死后

死后

死后

Died我梦见自己死在道路上。
I dreamed that I was dying on the road.这是那里，我怎么到这里来，怎么死的，这些事我全不明白。总之，待到我自己知道已经死掉的时候，就已经死在那里了。
This is there, how I got here, how I died, I don't understand these things at all. In short, by the time I knew I was dead, I was already dead there.听到几声喜鹊叫，接着是一阵乌老鸦。空气很清爽，——虽然也带些土气息，——大约正当黎明时候罢。我想睁开眼睛来，他却丝毫也不动，简直不像是我的眼睛；于是想抬手，也一样。
I heard a few magpie calls, followed by a burst of crows. The air is very refreshing,—— although it also has a bit of an earthy smell,—— about dawn. I wanted to open my eyes, but he didn't move at all, it didn't look like mine; So I wanted to raise my hand, and it was the same.恐怖的利镞忽然穿透我的心了。在我生存时，曾经玩笑地设想：假使一个人的死亡，只是运动神经的废灭，而知觉还在，那就比全死了更可怕。谁知道我的预想竟的中了，我自己就在证实这预想。
The terrifying arrowhead suddenly penetrated my heart. When I was alive, I once jokingly imagined that if a person's death was just the destruction of motor nerves and the perception remained, it would be more terrible than all death. Who knew that my prediction was correct, and I myself confirmed this expectation.听到脚步声，走路的罢。一辆独轮车从我的头边推过，大约是重载的，轧轧地叫得人心烦，还有些牙齿。很觉得满眼绯红，一定是太阳上来了。那么，我的脸是朝东的。但那都没有什么关系。切切嚓嚓的人声，看热闹的。他们踹起黄土来，飞进我的鼻孔，使我想打喷嚏了，但终于没有打，仅有想打的心。
Hear the footsteps and walk. A wheelbarrow pushed past my head, probably heavily loaded, screaming annoyingly, and some teeth. I feel that my eyes are full of crimson, and the sun must have come up. Well, my face is facing east. But it doesn't matter. Cut the human voice, watch the lively. They kicked up the loess and flew into my nostrils, making me want to sneeze, but in the end I didn't, only the heart I wanted to hit.陆陆续续地又是脚步声，都到近旁就停下，还有更多的低语声：看的人多起来了。我忽然很想听听他们的议论。但同时想，我生存时说的什么批评不值一笑的话，大概是违心之论罢：才死，就露了破绽了。然而还是听；然而毕竟得不到结论，归纳起来不过是这样——
One after another, there were footsteps, all stopping when they got closer, and there were more whispers: there were more people watching. I suddenly wanted to hear what they had to say. But at the same time, I thought that what criticism I said while I was alive was probably against my heart: just died, I revealed my flaws. Yet listen; However, after all, there is no conclusion, and it is just like this -“死了？……”
"Dead? ……”“嗡。——这……”
"Buzz. ——This ......"“哼！……”
"Hmph! ……”“啧。……唉！……”
"Tsk. …… Alas! ……”我十分高兴，因为始终没有听到一个熟识的声音。否则，或者害得他们伤心；或则要使他们快意；或则要使他们加添些饭后闲谈的材料，多破费宝贵的工夫；这都会使我很抱歉。现在谁也看不见，就是谁也不受影响。好了，总算对得起人了！
I was very happy because I never heard a familiar voice. otherwise, it may cause them to be sad; Or to make them happy; Or they have to add some materials for chatting after the meal, and spend more precious work; This makes me feel sorry. Now no one can see it, even no one is affected. Okay, finally worthy of people!但是，大约是一个马蚁，在我的脊梁上爬着，痒痒的。我一点也不能动，已经没有除去他的能力了；倘在平时，只将身子一扭，就能使他退避。而且，大腿上又爬着一个哩！你们是做什么的？虫豸！？
But, about a horse ant, crawling on my spine, tickling. I can't move at all, and I have no ability to get rid of him; If he was normal, just twisting his body could make him retreat. Moreover, there is another one crawling on his thigh! What do you do? Worm!?事情可更坏了：嗡的一声，就有一个青蝇停在我的颧骨上，走了几步，又一飞，开口便舐我的鼻尖。我懊恼地想：足下，我不是什么伟人，你无须到我身上来寻做论的材料……。但是不能说出来。他却从鼻尖跑下，又用冷舌头来舐我的嘴唇了，不知道可是表示亲爱。还有几个则聚在眉毛上，跨一步，我的毛根就一摇。实在使我烦厌得不堪，——不堪之至。
Things got worse: with a buzz, a green fly landed on my cheekbones, took a few steps, flew again, and licked the tip of my nose when it opened. I thought annoyedly: Feet, I am not a great man, you don't need to come to me to find materials for ....... But it can't be said. But he ran down from the tip of his nose and licked my lips with his cold tongue, I don't know if he was dear. A few others gathered on my eyebrows, and when I took a step, my hair roots shook. It really made me unbearably annoyed,—— unbearable.忽然，一阵风，一片东西从上面盖下来，他们就一同飞开了，临走时还说——
Suddenly, a gust of wind blew down, and a piece of something covered it from above, and they flew away together, and before leaving, they said -“惜哉！……”
"What a pity! ……”我愤怒得几乎昏厥过去。
I was so angry that I almost fainted.木材摔在地上的钝重的声音同着地面的震动，使我忽然清醒，前额上感着芦席的条纹。但那芦席就被掀去了，又立刻感到了日光的灼热。还听得有人说——
The dull sound of wood falling to the ground and the vibration of the ground made me suddenly wake up, and I felt the stripes of the reed mat on my forehead. But the reed mat was lifted, and I immediately felt the scorching heat of the sun. I also heard someone say -“怎么要死在这里？……”
"Why do you want to die here? ……”这声音离我很近，他正弯着腰罢。但人应该死在那里呢？我先前以为人在地上虽没有任意生存的权利，却总有任意死掉的权利的。现在才知道并不然，也很难适合人们的公意。可惜我久没了纸笔；即有也不能写，而且即使写了也没有地方发表了。只好就这样地抛开。
The voice was very close to me, and he was bending over. But where should people die? I used to think that although people do not have the right to live freely on earth, they always have the right to die at will. Only now do I know that this is not the case, and it is difficult to meet people's public opinion. It's a pity that I have lost my pen and paper for a long time; Even if there is, it cannot be written, and even if it is written, there is no place to publish it. I had to leave it like this.有人来抬我，也不知道是谁。听到刀鞘声，还有巡警在这里罢，在我所不应该“死在这里”的这里。我被翻了几个转身，便觉得向上一举，又往下一沉；又听得盖了盖，钉着钉。但是，奇怪，只钉了两个。难道这里的棺材钉，是只钉两个的么？
Someone came to carry me, but I don't know who it was. Hearing the sound of scabbards, and the patrol officers here, I shouldn't have "died here". I was turned over a few times, and then I felt that I lifted up and sank down; I heard the lid again, nailed it. But, strangely, only two were nailed. Is there only two coffin nails here?我想：这回是六面碰壁，外加钉子。真是完全失败，呜呼哀哉了！……
I thought: This time it hit the wall on six sides, plus nails. What a complete failure, alas! ……“气闷！……”我又想。
"Stuffy! ...... I thought again.然而我其实却比先前已经宁静得多，虽然知不清埋了没有。在手背上触到草席的条纹，觉得这尸衾倒也不恶。只不知道是谁给我化钱的，可惜！但是，可恶，收敛的小子们！我背后的小衫的一角皱起来了，他们并不给我拉平，现在抵得我很难受。你们以为死人无知，做事就这样地草率么？哈哈！
However, I was actually much quieter than before, although I didn't know if I was buried. I touched the stripes of the straw mat on the back of my hand, and I felt that this corpse quilt was not evil. I just don't know who gave me money, it's a pity! But, damn it, convergent boys! The corner of the shirt behind me was wrinkled, they didn't level me, and now it's hard for me. Do you think that dead people are ignorant and do things so hastily? Ha ha!我的身体似乎比活的时候要重得多，所以压着衣皱便格外的不舒服。但我想，不久就可以习惯的；或者就要腐烂，不至于再有什么大麻烦。此刻还不如静静地静着想。
My body seems to be much heavier than when I was alive, so it was particularly uncomfortable to press on the wrinkles of my clothes. But I think I will soon get used to it; Or it will rot so that there will be no more big trouble. At this moment, it is better to think quietly.“您好？您死了么？”
"Hello? Are you dead? ”是一个颇为耳熟的声音。睁眼看时，却是勃古斋旧书铺的跑外的小伙计。不见约有二十多年了，倒还是那一副老样子。我又看看六面的壁，委实太毛糙，简直毫没有加过一点修刮，锯绒还是毛毵毵的。
It is a rather familiar voice. When I opened my eyes, it was the young man running out of the old bookstore of Boguzhai. It's been about 20 years since I last saw him, but it's still the same. I looked at the walls on six sides again, they were too rough, and they didn't have any trimming, and the sawdust was still fluffy.“那不碍事，那不要紧。”他说，一面打开暗蓝色布的包裹来。“这是明板《公羊传》，嘉靖黑口本，给您送来了。您留下他罢。这是……。”
"That's not in the way, it doesn't matter." He said, opening the dark blue cloth package. "This is the Ming Plate "The Legend of the Ram", Jiajing Black Mouth, sent to you. You leave him alone. This is....... ”“你！”我诧异地看定他的眼睛，说，“你莫非真正胡涂了？你看我这模样，还要看什么明板？……”
"You!" I looked him in surprise and said, "Are you really foolish?" Look at me like this, what else do you want to see? ……”“那可以看，那不碍事。”
"That's okay, that's not in the way."我即刻闭上眼睛，因为对他很烦厌。停了一会，没有声息，他大约走了。但是似乎一个马蚁又在脖子上爬起来，终于爬到脸上，只绕着眼眶转圈子。
I immediately closed my eyes because I was tired of him. After a pause, there was no sound, and he was about gone. But it seemed that a horse ant got up on its neck again, and finally climbed onto its face, only circling around its eye sockets.
万不料人的思想，是死掉之后也还会变化的。忽而，有一种力将我的心的平安冲破；同时，许多梦也都做在眼前了。几个朋友祝我安乐，几个仇敌祝我灭亡。我却总是既不安乐，也不灭亡地不上不下地生活下来，都不能副任何一面的期望。现在又影一般死掉了，连仇敌也不使知道，不肯赠给他们一点惠而不费的欢欣。……
Unexpectedly, people's thoughts will change even after death. Suddenly, there was a force that broke through the peace of my heart; At the same time, many dreams are also in front of you. A few friends wish me peace, and a few enemies wish me destruction. But I am always unhappy, and I am not doomed to live up or down, and I cannot live up to the expectations of any side. Now he is dead like a shadow, and even his enemies do not want to know, and he refuses to give them a little joy without cost. ……我觉得在快意中要哭出来。这大概是我死后第一次的哭。
I feel like crying out in pleasure. This was probably the first time I cried since I died.然而终于也没有眼泪流下；只看见眼前仿佛有火花一闪，我于是坐了起来。
However, in the end, there were no tears; I saw a spark flashing in front of me, so I sat up.一九二五年七月十二日。
July 12, 1925.

这样的战士

这样的战士

这样的战士

Such a fighter要有这样的一种战士——
There must be such a kind of warrior -已不是蒙昧如非洲土人而背着雪亮的毛瑟枪的；也并不疲惫如中国绿营兵而却佩着盒子炮。他毫无乞灵于牛皮和废铁的甲胄；他只有自己，但拿着蛮人所用的，脱手一掷的投枪。
is no longer as ignorant as the African natives and carrying a shiny Mauser gun; They are not as tired as the Chinese green battalion soldiers, but they wear box cannons. He has no armor of cowhide or scrap iron; He only had himself, but he took the gun used by the barbarians and threw it away.他走进无物之阵，所遇见的都对他一式点头。他知道这点头就是敌人的武器，是杀人不见血的武器，许多战士都在此灭亡，正如炮弹一般，使猛士无所用其力。
He walked into the formation of nothingness and nodded to him all he met. He knew that this nod was the enemy's weapon, a weapon that killed without blood, and many warriors perished here, like cannonballs, making the warriors useless.那些头上有各种旗帜，绣出各样好名称：慈善家，学者，文士，长者，青年，雅人，君子……。头下有各样外套，绣出各式好花样：学问，道德，国粹，民意，逻辑，公义，东方文明……。
Those with all kinds of banners on their heads, embroidered with all kinds of good names: philanthropist, scholar, scribe, elder, youth, elegant, gentleman....... There are all kinds of coats under the head, embroidering all kinds of good patterns: knowledge, morality, national essence, public opinion, logic, justice, oriental civilization.......但他举起了投枪。
But he raised his throwing gun.他们都同声立了誓来讲说，他们的心都在胸膛的中央，和别的偏心的人类两样。他们都在胸前放着护心镜，就为自己也深信心在胸膛中央的事作证。
They all swore in unison that their hearts were in the center of their chests, just like other eccentric human beings. They all had goggles on their chests, and they testified to what they were confident in the center of their chests.但他举起了投枪。
But he raised his throwing gun.他微笑，偏侧一掷，却正中了他们的心窝。
He smiled and threw it sideways, but it hit their hearts.一切都颓然倒地；——然而只有一件外套，其中无物。无物之物已经脱走，得了胜利，因为他这时成了戕害慈善家等类的罪人。
Everything collapsed to the ground; - However, there is only one coat, and there is nothing in it. The nothingness has been taken off and victorious, because he has become a sinner who harms philanthropists and the like.但他举起了投枪。
But he raised his throwing gun.他在无物之阵中大踏步走，再见一式的点头，各种的旗帜，各样的外套……。
He strode in the formation of nothingness, nodded goodbye, all kinds of flags, all kinds of coats, .......但他举起了投枪。
But he raised his throwing gun.他终于在无物之阵中老衰，寿终。他终于不是战士，但无物之物则是胜者。
He finally died of old age in the battle of nothingness. He is not a warrior after all, but the thing without nothing is the winner.在这样的境地里，谁也不闻战叫：太平。
In such a situation, no one hears the cry of war: peace.太平……。
Taiping.......但他举起了投枪！
But he raised his gun!一九二五年十二月十四日。
December 14, 1925.

聪明人和傻子和奴才

聪明人和傻子和奴才

聪明人和傻子和奴才

Smart people and fools and minions奴才总不过是寻人诉苦。只要这样，也只能这样。有一日，他遇到一个聪明人。
Servants are always just looking for people to complain. As long as this is the case, it can only be like this. One day, he met a smart man.“先生！”他悲哀地说，眼泪联成一线，就从眼角上直流下来。“你知道的。我所过的简直不是人的生活。吃的是一天未必有一餐，这一餐又不过是高粱皮，连猪狗都不要吃的，尚且只有一小碗……。”
"Sir!" He said sadly, tears formed a line and flowed down from the corners of his eyes. "You know. What I am living is simply not a human life. There may not be one meal a day, and this meal is just sorghum skin, and even pigs and dogs don't want to eat it, and there is only a small bowl of ....... ”“这实在令人同情。”聪明人也惨然说。
"It's really sympathetic." The smart man said miserably.“可不是么！”他高兴了。“可是做工是昼夜无休息的：清早担水晚烧饭，上午跑街夜磨面，晴洗衣裳雨张伞，冬烧汽炉夏打扇。半夜要煨银耳，侍候主人耍钱；头钱从来没分，有时还挨皮鞭……。”
"Isn't it!" He was happy. "But the workmanship is day and night: carrying water in the morning and cooking rice in the evening, running on the street in the morning and grinding noodles at night, washing clothes in the sun and setting up umbrellas in the rain, burning steam stoves in winter and fanning in summer. In the middle of the night, you have to simmer white fungus and wait for the master to play with money; The first money is never divided, and sometimes he is whipped ....... ”“唉唉……。”聪明人叹息着，眼圈有些发红，似乎要下泪。
"Oh ......." The smart man sighed, his eyes were a little red, and he seemed to be about to cry.“先生！我这样是敷衍不下去的。我总得另外想法子。可是什么法子呢？……”
"Sir! I can't go on like this. I have to think of something else. But what is the method? ……”“我想，你总会好起来……。”
"I think you'll always get better......“是么？但愿如此。可是我对先生诉了冤苦，又得你的同情和慰安，已经舒坦得不少了。可见天理没有灭绝……。”
"Really? I hope so. But I complained to my husband, and I got your sympathy and comfort, and I was already a lot more comfortable. It can be seen that the principle of heaven has not ...... extinction. ”但是，不几日，他又不平起来了，仍然寻人去诉苦。
However, within a few days, he became unhappy again and still looked for someone to complain.“先生！”他流着眼泪说，“你知道的。我住的简直比猪窠还不如。主人并不将我当人；他对他的叭儿狗还要好到几万倍……。”
"Sir!" He said with tears in his eyes, "You know." I live worse than a pig nest. The master does not treat me as a person; He was tens of thousands of times better to his dog ...... his dog. ”“混帐！”那人大叫起来，使他吃惊了。那人是一个傻子。
"Bastard!" The man cried out, startling him. That man is a fool.“先生，我住的只是一间破小屋，又湿，又阴，满是臭虫，睡下去就咬得真可以。秽气冲着鼻子，四面又没有一个窗……。”
"Sir, I live in just a dilapidated hut, wet, shady, full of bed bugs, and I can bite you when you sleep. The foul smell rushed to the nose, and there was no window ...... on all sides. ”“你不会要你的主人开一个窗的么？”
"Won't you ask your master to open a window?"“这怎么行？……”
"How can this work? ……”“那么，你带我去看去！”
"Then, take me to see it!"傻子跟奴才到他屋外，动手就砸那泥墙。
The fool and the servant went to his house and smashed the mud wall.“先生！你干什么？”他大惊地说。
"Sir! What are you doing? He said in shock.“我给你打开一个窗洞来。”
"I'll open a window for you."“这不行！主人要骂的！”
"This is not good! The master wants to scold! ”“管他呢！”他仍然砸。
"What about him!" He still smashed.“人来呀！强盗在毁咱们的屋子了！快来呀！迟一点可要打出窟窿来了！……”他哭嚷着，在地上团团地打滚。
"People are coming! The robbers are destroying our houses!" Come on! I'm going to make a hole later!" ......" he cried and rolled on the ground.一群奴才都出来了，将傻子赶走。
A group of minions came out and drove the fool away.听到了喊声，慢慢地最后出来的是主人。
Hearing the shout, it was the owner who slowly came out at the end.“有强盗要来毁咱们的屋子，我首先叫喊起来，大家一同把他赶走了。”他恭敬而得胜地说。
"There are robbers who want to destroy our house, I shout first, and everyone drives him away together." He said respectfully and triumphantly.“你不错。”主人这样夸奖他。
"You're good." The master praised him like this.这一天就来了许多慰问的人，聪明人也在内。
On this day, many people came to offer condolences, including smart people.“先生。这回因为我有功，主人夸奖了我了。你先前说我总会好起来，实在是有先见之明……。”他大有希望似的高兴地说。
"Sir. This time, because of my meritorious service, the master praised me. You said before that I will always get better, and you really have a prescient ....... He said happily, as if he was hopeful.“可不是么……。”聪明人也代为高兴似的回答他。
"Isn't it...... The wise man also answered him happily.一九二五年十二月二十六日。
December 26, 1925.

腊叶

腊叶

腊叶

Waxed leaves灯下看《雁门集》，忽然翻出一片压干的枫叶来。
Watching "Yanmen Collection" under the lamp, a dried maple leaf suddenly came out.这使我记起去年的深秋。繁霜夜降，木叶多半凋零，庭前的一株小小的枫树也变成红色了。我曾绕树徘徊，细看叶片的颜色，当他青葱的时候是从没有这么注意的。他也并非全树通红，最多的是浅绛，有几片则在绯红地上，还带着几团浓绿。一片独有一点蛀孔，镶着乌黑的花边，在红，黄和绿的斑驳中，明眸似的向人凝视。我自念：这是病叶呵！便将他摘了下来，夹在刚才买到的《雁门集》里。大概是愿使这将坠的被蚀而斑斓的颜色，暂得保存，不即与群叶一同飘散罢。
This reminds me of the late autumn of last year. Frost fell at night, most of the leaves withered, and a small maple tree in front of the courtyard turned red. I used to wander around the tree, looking closely at the color of the leaves, and I never paid so much attention when he was green. He is not all red, the most is light crimson, and a few pieces are on the crimson ground, with a few clusters of rich green. A unique cavity, inlaid with black lace, stared at people like bright eyes in the mottled red, yellow and green. I thought to myself: This is a sick leaf! So he took him off and sandwiched it in the "Yanmen Collection" he had just bought. Probably because he wished to preserve the eroded and colorful colors that had fallen for the time being, or to disperse with the leaves.但今夜他却黄蜡似的躺在我的眼前，那眸子也不复似去年一般灼灼。假使再过几年，旧时的颜色在我记忆中消去，怕连我也不知道他何以夹在书里面的原因了。将坠的病叶的斑斓，似乎也只能在极短时中相对，更何况是葱郁的呢。看看窗外，很能耐寒的树木也早经秃尽了；枫树更何消说得。当深秋时，想来也许有和这去年的模样相似的病叶的罢，但可惜我今年竟没有赏玩秋树的余闲。
But tonight he was lying in front of me like yellow wax, and his eyes were no longer as burning as last year. If in a few years, the old colors will be erased from my memory, and I am afraid that even I will not know why he is sandwiched in the book. The colorful colors of the fallen sick leaves seem to be only relative in a very short time, let alone lush. Looking out the window, the hardy trees have long been bald; The maple tree is not to mention. When it was late autumn, I thought there might be sick leaves that looked similar to last year, but unfortunately I didn't have the leisure to enjoy the autumn trees this year.一九二五年十二月二十六日。
December 26, 1925.

淡淡的血痕中

淡淡的血痕中

淡淡的血痕中

In the faint bloodstains——记念几个死者和生者和未生者
- Remember the dead and the living and the unborn目前的造物主，还是一个怯弱者。
The current Creator is still a coward.他暗暗地使天变地异，却不敢毁灭一个这地球；暗暗地使生物衰亡，却不敢长存一切尸体；暗暗地使人类流血，却不敢使血色永远鲜秾；暗暗地使人类受苦，却不敢使人类永远记得。
He secretly changed the world, but he did not dare to destroy an earth; secretly causing the decay of living things, but not daring to keep all corpses for long; secretly causing human blood to bleed, but not daring to make blood forever bright; It secretly makes human beings suffer, but does not dare to make human beings remember forever.他专为他的同类——人类中的怯弱者——设想，用废墟荒坟来衬托华屋，用时光来冲淡苦痛和血痕；日日斟出一杯微甘的苦酒，不太少，不太多，以能微醉为度，递给人间，使饮者可以哭，可以歌，也如醒，也如醉，若有知，若无知，也欲死，也欲生。他必须使一切也欲生；他还没有灭尽人类的勇气。
He conceived for his kind, the cowards of mankind, using ruins and desolate graves to set off the splendid houses, and using time to dilute the pain and bloodstains; Pour out a cup of slightly sweet bitter wine every day, not too little, not too much, to be slightly drunk, and hand it over to the world, so that the drinker can cry, sing, as if sober, like drunk, if there is knowledge, if there is ignorance, it also wants to die, and it also wants to live. He must make all things live; He has not yet exhausted the courage of mankind.几片废墟和几个荒坟散在地上，映以淡淡的血痕，人们都在其间咀嚼着人我的渺茫的悲苦。但是不肯吐弃，以为究竟胜于空虚，各各自称为“天之僇民”，以作咀嚼着人我的渺茫的悲苦的辩解，而且悚息着静待新的悲苦的到来。新的，这就使他们恐惧，而又渴欲相遇。
Several ruins and several desolate graves are scattered on the ground, reflecting faint blood stains, and people are chewing on the vague misery of people and me. But they refused to spit it out, thinking that they were better than emptiness, and each of them called themselves "the people of heaven", in order to justify the misery of chewing on the faint misery of man and me, and waiting for the arrival of new misery. This makes them fearful and thirsty to meet.这都是造物主的良民。他就需要这样。
These are all good people of the Creator. He needs that.叛逆的猛士出于人间；他屹立着，洞见一切已改和现有的废墟和荒坟，记得一切深广和久远的苦痛，正视一切重叠淤积的凝血，深知一切已死，方生，将生和未生。他看透了造化的把戏；他将要起来使人类苏生，或者使人类灭尽，这些造物主的良民们。
Rebellious warriors come from the world; He stood tall, seeing all the changed and existing ruins and desolate graves, remembering all the deep, broad and long-standing pain, facing up to all the overlapping and accumulated blood congeals, and knowing that everything was dead, alive, and born and unborn. He saw through the tricks of nature; He will rise up and raise mankind, or destroy them, these good people of the Creator.造物主，怯弱者，羞惭了，于是伏藏。天地在猛士的眼中于是变色。
造物主，怯弱者，羞惭了，于是伏藏。 天地在猛士的眼中于是变色。一九二六年四月八日。
一九二六年四月八日。

一觉

一觉

一觉

一觉飞机负了掷下炸弹的使命，像学校的上课似的，每日上午在北京城上飞行。每听得机件搏击空气的声音，我常觉到一种轻微的紧张，宛然目睹了“死”的袭来，但同时也深切地感着“生”的存在。
The plane was tasked with dropping bombs, flying over Beijing every morning like a school class. Every time I hear the sound of the machine fighting the air, I often feel a slight nervousness, as if witnessing the attack of "death", but at the same time, I also deeply feel the existence of "life".隐约听到一二爆发声以后，飞机嗡嗡地叫着，冉冉地飞去了。也许有人死伤了罢，然而天下却似乎更显得太平。窗外的白杨的嫩叶，在日光下发乌金光；榆叶梅也比昨日开得更烂漫。收拾了散乱满床的日报，拂去昨夜聚在书桌上的苍白的微尘，我的四方的小书斋，今日也依然是所谓“窗明几净”。
After vaguely hearing one or two explosions, the plane hummed and flew away. Maybe someone was killed or injured, but the world seemed to be more peaceful. The young leaves of the poplar outside the window glow black gold in the sunlight; The elm leaf plum is also more blooming than yesterday. After cleaning up the scattered daily newspapers on the bed and brushing away the pale dust that had gathered on the desk last night, my small study in all directions is still the so-called "bright and clean windows" today.因为或一种原因，我开手编校那历来积压在我这里的青年作者的文稿了；我要全都给一个清理。我照作品的年月看下去，这些不肯涂脂抹粉的青年们的魂灵便依次屹立在我眼前。他们是绰约的，是纯真的，——阿，然而他们苦恼了，呻吟了，愤怒，而且终于粗暴了，我的可爱的青年们！
For one reason or another, I started editing the manuscripts of the young authors who had always been backlogged with me; I'm going to clean them all up. As I look at the years of the work, the souls of these young people who refuse to apply makeup stand in front of my eyes one after another. They are graceful, innocent ,——, yet they are distressed, moaning, angry, and at last rough, my lovely young men!魂灵被风沙打击得粗暴，因为这是人的魂灵，我爱这样的魂灵；我愿意在无形无色的鲜血淋漓的粗暴上接吻。漂渺的名园中，奇花盛开着，红颜的静女正在超然无事地逍遥，鹤唳一声，白云郁然而起……。这自然使人神往的罢，然而我总记得我活在人间。
The soul was hit roughly by the wind and sand, because this is the soul of a person, and I love such a soul; I am willing to kiss on the bloody roughness of the formless and colorless. In the ethereal garden, strange flowers are blooming, and the red-faced quiet girl is freeing freely and uneventfully, with a crane cry, and white clouds rise ....... This is naturally fascinating, but I always remember that I live in the world.我忽然记起一件事：两三年前，我在北京大学的教员预备室里，看见进来了一个并不熟识的青年，默默地给我一包书，便出去了，打开看时，是一本《浅草》。就在这默默中，使我懂得了许多话。阿，这赠品是多么丰饶呵！可惜那《浅草》不再出版了，似乎只成了《沉钟》的前身。那《沉钟》就在这风沙洞中，深深地在人海的底里寂寞地鸣动。
I suddenly remembered something: two or three years ago, I was in the faculty preparation room of Peking University, and I saw a young man I didn't know well, silently gave me a package of books, and went out. It was in this silence that I understood many words. Ah, how rich this gift is! Unfortunately, "Asakusa" is no longer published, and it seems to have only become the predecessor of "Shen Zhong". The "Shen Bell" is in this wind and sand  cave, ringing lonely deep in the sea of people.野蓟经了几乎致命的摧折，还要开一朵小花，我记得托尔斯泰曾受了很大的感动，因此写出一篇小说来。但是，草木在旱干的沙漠中间，拚命伸长他的根，吸取深地中的水泉，来造成碧绿的林莽，自然是为了自己的“生”的，然而使疲劳枯渴的旅人，一见就怡然觉得遇到了暂时息肩之所，这是如何的可以感激，而且可以悲哀的事！？
The wild thistle was almost fatally destroyed and had to bloom a small flower, and I remember that Tolstoy was very moved, so he wrote a novel. However, the grass and trees in the middle of the dry desert, desperately stretching their roots, absorbing the water and springs in the deep ground, to create a turquoise forest, naturally for their own "life", but the tired and thirsty traveler feels happy at first sight that he has encountered a temporary place to rest his shoulders, how grateful and sad is this!?《沉钟》的《无题》——代启事——说：“有人说：我们的社会是一片沙漠。——如果当真是一片沙漠，这虽然荒漠一点也还静肃；虽然寂寞一点也还会使你感觉苍茫。何至于像这样的混沌，这样的阴沉，而且这样的离奇变幻！”
"Untitled" of "Shen Zhong" - on behalf of the notice - said: "Some people say: Our society is a desert. ——If it is really a desert, although it is desert at all; Although loneliness can also make you feel empty. How can it be so chaotic, so gloomy, and so bizarre! ”是的，青年的魂灵屹立在我眼前，他们已经粗暴了，或者将要粗暴了，然而我爱这些流血和隐痛的魂灵，因为他使我觉得是在人间，是在人间活着。
Yes, the spirits of young men stand before my eyes, they have been and will be rough, but I love these bleeding and painful souls, because he makes me feel that they are on earth, on earth.在编校中夕阳居然西下，灯火给我接续的光。各样的青春在眼前一一驰去了，身外但有昏黄环绕。我疲劳着，捏着纸烟，在无名的思想中静静地合了眼睛，看见很长的梦。忽而惊觉，身外也还是环绕着昏黄；烟篆在不动的空气中上升，如几片小小夏云，徐徐幻出难以指名的形象。
In the editing, the sunset actually set, and the lights gave me continuous light. All kinds of youth rushed away one by one in front of my eyes, but there was a dim yellow surrounded by them. I was tired, holding a cigarette, quietly closing my eyes in my nameless thoughts, and seeing a long dream. Suddenly I woke up, and there was still a dim yellow outside my body; The smoke rose in the motionless air, like a few small summer clouds, slowly creating an image that was difficult to name.一九二六年四月十日。

April 10, 1926.

题记

题记

题记

Inscription在一年的尽头的深夜中，整理了这一年所写的杂感，竟比收在《热风》里的整四年中所写的还要多。意见大部分还是那样，而态度却没有那么质直了，措辞也时常弯弯曲曲，议论又往往执滞在几件小事情上，很足以贻笑于大方之家。然而那又有什么法子呢。我今年偏遇到这些小事情，而偏有执滞于小事情的脾气。
In the late night at the end of the year, I sorted out more miscellaneous feelings written in this year than I wrote in the four years of "Hot Wind". Most of the opinions are still like that, but the attitude is not so straightforward, the wording is often crooked, and the discussion is often fixated on a few small things, which is enough to be ridiculed by the generous family. But what can be done? I have encountered these small things this year, and I have a temper that is stuck in small things.我知道伟大的人物能洞见三世，观照一切，历大苦恼，尝大欢喜，发大慈悲。但我又知道这必须深入山林，坐古树下，静观默想，得天眼通，离人间愈远遥，而知人间也愈深，愈广；于是凡有言说，也愈高，愈大；于是而为天人师。我幼时虽曾梦想飞空，但至今还在地上，救小创伤尚且来不及，那有余暇使心开意豁，立论都公允妥洽，平正通达，像“正人君子”一般；正如沾水小蜂，只在泥土上爬来爬去，万不敢比附洋楼中的通人，但也自有悲苦愤激，决非洋楼中的通人所能领会。
I know that great people can see the three lifetimes, observe everything, experience great suffering, taste great joy, and have great compassion. But I also know that this must go deep into the mountains and forests, sit under the ancient trees, meditate and meditate, so that the eyes of heaven are opened, and the farther away from the world, the deeper and wider the world becomes; Therefore, wherever there is a word, it is higher and greater; Thus, he became a teacher to heaven and man. Although I dreamed of flying in the sky when I was young, I am still on the ground, and it is too late to save small wounds. Just like the water-dipping bee, it only crawls around on the soil, and it never dares to compare with the ordinary people in the attached western-style buildings, but it also has its own sorrow and anger, which is by no means comprehensible to the ordinary people in the western-style buildings.这病痛的根柢就在我活在人间，又是一个常人，能够交着“华盖运”。
The root of this illness lies in the fact that I live in the world, and I am an ordinary person, able to hand over the "canopy luck".我平生没有学过算命，不过听老年人说，人是有时要交“华盖运”的。这“华盖”在他们口头上大概已经讹作“镬盖”了，现在加以订正。所以，这运，在和尚是好运：顶有华盖，自然是成佛作祖之兆。但俗人可不行，华盖在上，就要给罩住了，只好碰钉子。我今年开手作杂感时，就碰了两个大钉子：一是为了《咬文嚼字》，一是为了《青年必读书》。署名和匿名的豪杰之士的骂信，收了一大捆，至今还塞在书架下。此后又突然遇见了一些所谓学者，文士，正人，君子等等，据说都是讲公话，谈公理，而且深不以“党同伐异”为然的。可惜我和他们太不同了，所以也就被他们伐了几下，——但这自然是为“公理”之故，和我的“党同伐异”不同。这样，一直到现下还没有完结，只好“以待来年”。
I have never studied fortune-telling in my life, but I heard from the elderly that people sometimes have to pay "canopy luck". This "canopy" has probably been misspelled as "pot cover" in their mouth, and it has now been corrected. Therefore, this luck is good luck for monks: with a canopy on top, it is naturally a sign of becoming a Buddha and an ancestor. But the layman can't do it, the canopy is on top, and it has to be covered, so I have to touch the nail. When I started working on miscellaneous feelings this year, I touched two big nails: one was for "Biting Texts and Chewing Words", and the other was for "Must-Read Books for Young People". The scolding letters of signed and anonymous heroes received a large bundle, which is still stuffed under the bookshelf. After that, I suddenly met some so-called scholars, scribes, righteous people, gentlemen, etc., who are said to be speaking public and talking about axioms, and they are deeply dissatisfied with "the party fights against differences". It's a pity that I am too different from them, so I was cut down by them a few times,—— but this is naturally for the sake of "axioms", which is different from my "party fighting differences". In this way, it has not been finished until now, so we have to "wait for the next year".也有人劝我不要做这样的短评。那好意，我是很感激的，而且也并非不知道创作之可贵。然而要做这样的东西的时候，恐怕也还要做这样的东西，我以为如果艺术之宫里有这么麻烦的禁令，倒不如不进去；还是站在沙漠上，看看飞沙走石，乐则大笑，悲则大叫，愤则大骂，即使被沙砾打得遍身粗糙，头破血流，而时时抚摩自己的凝血，觉得若有花纹，也未必不及跟着中国的文士们去陪莎士比亚吃黄油面包之有趣。
Some people also advised me not to make such short comments. I am very grateful for that kindness, and I am not unaware of the value of creation. Suddenly thought一
One做《内经》的不知道究竟是谁。对于人的肌肉，他确是看过，但似乎单是剥了皮略略一观，没有细考校，所以乱成一片，说是凡有肌肉都发源于手指和足趾。宋的《洗冤录》说人骨，竟至于谓男女骨数不同；老仵作之谈，也有不少胡说。然而直到现在，前者还是医家的宝典，后者还是检验的南针：这可以算得天下奇事之一。
I don't know who the person who made the "Neijing" is. He did see human muscles, but it seemed that he only peeled off the skin and took a quick look, without careful examination, so he was in a mess, saying that all muscles originate from the fingers and toes. Song's "Record of Washing Wrongs" said that human bones are different, and the number of bones of men and women is different; There is also a lot of nonsense in the old man's talk. However, until now, the former is still a treasure book for doctors, and the latter is still a southern needle for testing: this can be regarded as one of the wonders of the world.牙痛在中国不知发端于何人？相传古人壮健，尧舜时代盖未必有；现在假定为起于二千年前罢。我幼时曾经牙痛，历试诸方，只有用细辛者稍有效，但也不过麻痹片刻，不是对症药。至于拔牙的所谓“离骨散”，乃是理想之谈，实际上并没有。西法的牙医一到，这才根本解决了；但在中国人手里一再传，又每每只学得镶补而忘了去腐杀菌，仍复渐渐地靠不住起来。牙痛了二千年，敷敷衍衍的不想一个好方法，别人想出来了，却又不肯好好地学：这大约也可以算得天下奇事之二罢。
I don't know who started toothache in China? It is said that the ancients were strong, and the Yao and Shun era may not have it; It is now assumed that it started 2,000 years ago. I had a toothache when I was a child, and I tried various prescriptions, but only those with Xixin were slightly effective, but they were only numb for a moment, not a symptomatic remedy. As for the so-called "separation of bones" for tooth extraction, it is an ideal statement, but in fact it is not. As soon as the dentist in Spain arrived, it was fundamentally solved; However, it has been passed on repeatedly in the hands of the Chinese, and it has gradually become unreliable. After a toothache for two thousand years, perfunctory I didn't want a good way, and others came up with it, but they refused to learn it well: this can probably be regarded as the second wonder in the world.康圣人主张跪拜，以为“否则要此膝何用”。走时的腿的动作，固然不易于看得分明，但忘记了坐在椅上时候的膝的曲直，则不可谓非圣人之疏于格物也。身中间脖颈最细，古人则于此斫之，臀肉最肥，古人则于此打之，其格物都比康圣人精到，后人之爱不忍释，实非无因。所以僻县尚打小板子，去年北京戒严时亦尝恢复杀头，虽延国粹于一脉乎，而亦不可谓非天下奇事之三也！
Kang Shengren advocated kneeling, thinking that "otherwise this knee is of no use". The movement of the legs when walking is not easy to see clearly, but forgetting the curvature and straightness of the knees when sitting on the chair cannot be said to be the negligence of the saints. The neck in the middle of the body is the thinnest, the ancients cut it here, the buttocks are the fattest, the ancients beat it here, and its style is more refined than that of Kang Shengren, and the love of later generations is not without reason. Therefore, remote counties are still playing small boards, and last year when Beijing was under martial law, it was also restored to the head of the killing head.一月十五日。

Two校着《苦闷的象征》的排印样本时，想到一些琐事——
When proofreading the typesetting sample of "The Symbol of Distress", I thought of some trivial things -我于书的形式上有一种偏见，就是在书的开头和每个题目前后，总喜欢留些空白，所以付印的时候，一定明白地注明。但待排出寄来，却大抵一篇一篇挤得很紧，并不依所注的办。查看别的书，也一样，多是行行挤得极紧的。
I have a prejudice against the form of the book, that is, I always like to leave some blank space at the beginning of the book and before and after each topic, so when I print it, I must clearly indicate it. But when it was sent out, it was usually very crowded one by one, and it was not done according to the notes. Looking at other books, it is the same, most of them are extremely tight.较好的中国书和西洋书，每本前后总有一两张空白的副页，上下的天地头也很宽。而近来中国的排印的新书则大抵没有副页，天地头又都很短，想要写上一点意见或别的什么，也无地可容，翻开书来，满本是密密层层的黑字；加以油臭扑鼻，使人发生一种压迫和窘促之感，不特很少“读书之乐”，且觉得仿佛人生已没有“余裕”，“不留余地”了。
The better Chinese and Western books always have one or two blank subpages before and after each book, and the upper and lower parts are also very wide. Recently, most of the new books printed in China have no subpages, and the world is very short, and if you want to write a little opinion or something else, there is no place to accommodate it. In addition, the smell of oil makes people feel oppressed and embarrassed, not only has little "joy of reading", but also feels as if there is no "room" and "no room left" in life.或者也许以这样的为质朴罢。但质朴是开始的“陋”，精力弥满，不惜物力的。现在的却是复归于陋，而质朴的精神已失，所以只能算窳败，算堕落，也就是常谈之所谓“因陋就简”。在这样“不留余地”空气的围绕里，人们的精神大抵要被挤小的。
Or maybe it's just a simple thing. But simplicity is the "ugliness" of the beginning, full of energy, and sparing no material resources. Now it is a return to ugliness, and the simple spirit has been lost, so it can only be regarded as failure and depravity, which is the so-called "simple because of ugliness". Surrounded by such a "leave no room" air, people's spirits are probably squeezed out.外国的平易地讲述学术文艺的书，往往夹杂些闲话或笑谈，使文章增添活气，读者感到格外的兴趣，不易于疲倦。但中国的有些译本，却将这些删去，单留下艰难的讲学语，使他复近于教科书。这正如折花者，除尽枝叶，单留花朵，折花固然是折花，然而花枝的活气却灭尽了。人们到了失去余裕心，或不自觉地满抱了不留余地心时，这民族的将来恐怕就可虑。上述的那两样，固然是比牛毛还细小的事，但究竟是时代精神表现之一端，所以也可以类推到别样。例如现在器具之轻薄草率（世间误以为灵便），建筑之偷工减料，办事之敷衍一时，不要“好看”，不想“持久”，就都是出于同一病源的。即再用这来类推更大的事，我以为也行。
Foreign books that plain talk about academic literature and art are often mixed with gossip or jokes, which add vitality to the article, and readers feel extra interested and not easy to get tired. However, some Chinese translations have deleted these, leaving only difficult lectures, making him close to textbooks. This is like a flower folder, removing all the branches and leaves, leaving only the flowers, folding flowers is certainly folding flowers, but the vitality of the flower branches is extinguished. When people lose their leeway, or unconsciously embrace the mindset of not leaving room for them, the future of this nation may be worrying. The above two things are certainly smaller than cow hair, but they are one end of the manifestation of the spirit of the times, so they can also be inferred to other things. For example, the current equipment is light and sloppy (the world mistakenly thinks it is convenient), the construction cuts corners, and the perfunctory work is temporary, not "good-looking" and not "long-lasting", all of which are from the same source. Even if you use this analogy to infer bigger things, I think it will work.一月十七日。

Four先前，听到二十四史不过是“相斫书”，是“独夫的家谱”一类的话，便以为诚然。后来自己看起来，明白了：何尝如此。
Previously, when I heard that the twenty-four histories were just "mutual cutting books" and "genealogy of single husbands", I thought it was true. Later, I seemed to understand it: why not?历史上都写着中国的灵魂，指示着将来的命运，只因为涂饰太厚，废话太多，所以很不容易察出底细来。正如通过密叶投射在莓苔上面的月光，只看见点点的碎影。但如看野史和杂记，可更容易了然了，因为他们究竟不必太摆史官的架子。
History is written about the soul of China, indicating the future destiny, just because the decoration is too thick and there is too much nonsense, so it is not easy to detect the details. Just like the moonlight projected on the berry moss through the dense leaves, only a few fragments can be seen. But if you look at wild history and miscellaneous notes, it is easier to understand, because they don't have to put on the shelf of historians too much.秦汉远了，和现在的情形相差已多，且不道。元人著作寥寥。至于唐宋明的杂史之类，则现在多有。试将记五代，南宋，明末的事情的，和现今的状况一比较，就当惊心动魄于何其相似之甚，仿佛时间的流驶，独与我们中国无关。现在的中华民国也还是五代，是宋末，是明季。
The Qin and Han dynasties are far away, and they are much different from the current situation, and they are not good. The writings of the Yuan people are few. As for the miscellaneous histories of the Tang, Song and Ming dynasties, there are many now. Try to compare the events of the Five Dynasties, the Southern Song Dynasty, and the end of the Ming Dynasty with the current situation, and it will be thrilling to see how similar they are, as if the passage of time has nothing to do with our China. The current Republic of China is still the Five Dynasties, the end of the Song Dynasty, and the Ming Dynasty.以明末例现在，则中国的情形还可以更腐败，更破烂，更凶酷，更残虐，现在还不算达到极点。但明末的腐败破烂也还未达到极点，因为李自成张献忠闹起来了。而张李的凶酷残虐也还未达到极点，因为满洲兵进来了。
Taking the example of the end of the Ming Dynasty, the situation in China can be more corrupt, more tattered, more ferocious, and more cruel, and it has not yet reached its peak. But the corruption and rags at the end of the Ming Dynasty had not yet reached its peak, because Li Zicheng and Zhang Xianzhong made trouble. And Zhang Li's ferocity and cruelty have not yet reached the extreme, because the Manchurian soldiers came in.难道所谓国民性者，真是这样地难于改变的么？倘如此，将来的命运便大略可想了，也还是一句烂熟的话：古已有之。
Is the so-called national character really so difficult to change? If this is the case, the future fate can be roughly imagined, and it is still a familiar sentence: it has existed in ancient times.伶俐人实在伶俐，所以，决不攻难古人，摇动古例的。古人做过的事，无论什么，今人也都会做出来。而辩护古人，也就是辩护自己。况且我们是神州华胄，敢不“绳其祖武”么？
Clever people are really clever, so they will never attack the ancients and shake the ancient examples. What the ancients did, no matter what they did, the people of today will also do it. And defending the ancients is defending yourself. Moreover, we are the Chinese soldiers of China, dare not "rope their ancestral martial arts"?幸而谁也不敢十分决定说：国民性是决不会改变的。在这“不可知”中，虽可有破例——即其情形为从来所未有——的灭亡的恐怖，也可以有破例的复生的希望，这或者可作改革者的一点慰藉罢。
Fortunately, no one dared to make a decision to say: national character will never change. In this "unknowable", although there can be an exception - that is, the situation is unprecedented - there can be an exception to the horror of destruction, but there can also be an exception to the hope of resurrection, which may be a little comfort for the reformers.但这一点慰藉，也会勾消在许多自诩古文明者流的笔上，淹死在许多诬告新文明者流的嘴上，扑灭在许多假冒新文明者流的言动上，因为相似的老例，也是“古已有之”的。
But this consolation will also be erased in the pens of many self-proclaimed ancient civilizations, drowned in the mouths of many falsely accused of new civilizations, and extinguished in the words and deeds of many fake new civilizations, because similar old examples are also "already existed in ancient times".其实这些人是一类，都是伶俐人，也都明白，中国虽完，自己的精神是不会苦的，——因为都能变出合式的态度来。倘有不信，请看清朝的汉人所做的颂扬武功的文章去，开口“大兵”，闭口“我军”，你能料得到被这“大兵”“我军”所败的就是汉人的么？你将以为汉人带了兵将别的一种什么野蛮腐败民族歼灭了。
In fact, these people are a category, they are all clever people, and they all understand that although China is over, their spirit will not be bitter,—— because they can conjure up a suitable attitude. If you don't believe it, please read the articles praising martial arts made by the Han people of the Qing Dynasty, open their mouths to "big soldiers" and close their mouths to "our army", can you expect that it is the Han people who are defeated by this "big soldier" and "our army"? You will think that the Han people have brought troops to annihilate some other barbaric and corrupt nation.然而这一流人是永远胜利的，大约也将永久存在。在中国，惟他们最适于生存，而他们生存着的时候，中国便永远免不掉反复着先前的运命。
However, this class of people will always win, and will probably last forever. In China, they are the only ones who are most suitable for survival, and while they are alive, China will always be able to repeat its previous fate.“地大物博，人口众多”，用了这许多好材料，难道竟不过老是演一出轮回把戏而已么？
"The land is vast and the population is large", with so many good materials, is it just a reincarnation trick all the time?二月十六日。

In that issue, there was a talk about municipal affairs, which suddenly reminded me of an unrelated matter. I now live in a small alley, where there are so-called dirt trucks who charge a few hanging money a month to move coal ash and the like. What should I do if I move out? It is piled up on the street, and the street is getting taller every day. There are several old houses, only half of which are exposed on the street, and they are predicting the future of other houses. I don't know why, but seeing these people is like seeing the history of the Chinese.姓名我忘记了，总之是一个明末的遗民，他曾将自己的书斋题作“活埋庵”。谁料现在的北京的人家，都在建造“活埋庵”，还要自己拿出建造费。看看报章上的论坛，“反改革”的空气浓厚透顶了，满车的“祖传”，“老例”，“国粹”等等，都想来堆在道路上，将所有的人家完全活埋下去。“强聒不舍”，也许是一个药方罢，但据我所见，则有些人们——甚至于竟是青年——的论调，简直和“戊戌政变”时候的反对改革者的论调一模一样。你想，二十七年了，还是这样，岂不可怕。大约国民如此，是决不会有好的政府的；好的政府，或者反而容易倒。也不会有好议员的；现在常有人骂议员，说他们收贿，无特操，趋炎附势，自私自利，但大多数的国民，岂非正是如此的么？这类的议员，其实确是国民的代表。
I forgot the name, in short, he was a remnant of the late Ming Dynasty, and he once inscribed his study "Buried Alive". Unexpectedly, people in Beijing are building "buried alive nunnery" now, and they have to pay for the construction by themselves. Looking at the forums in the newspapers, the atmosphere of "counter-reform" is thick, and the cars full of "ancestral traditions", "old examples", "national quintessence", etc., all want to pile up on the road and completely bury all people alive. There will be no good parliamentarians; Nowadays, some people often scold parliamentarians, saying that they accept bribes, have no special conduct, tend to follow the flames, and are selfish, but isn't this the case for the majority of the people? When the warriors are developed, they will decide the outcome. I also think that my distant and vague opinion is lamentable, but I hope that what I hope for "Fierce Progress" will finally be an "ideological revolution".鲁迅。三月十二日。

popular small daily newspapers are naturally important; But this seems easy, but it is difficult to do. In the first three or four years, there was a school of thought that ruined a lot of things. Scholars often persuaded people to walk into the laboratory, and the literati said that it was best to move into the palace of art, but until now they have not come out, and I don't know what their situation is there. Although this is their own willingness, more than half of them are still caught up in the "old method" because of the new ideas. I only recently discovered this trap, that is, since the "Youth Must Read" incident, I have received a lot of letters of approval and ridicule, and those who agree are very honest and have no compliments. I realized that these titles are their clever schemes, spiritual shackles, deliberately designating you as "different", and using this to restrain your words and actions, so that you lose the danger of their old life. Unexpectedly, many people are imprisoned in some room or palace, isn't it a pity? The teacher's letter said: There are different forms of inertia, and the most common is the appointment of heaven, and the second is the golden mean. I think the root of these two attitudes is probably not just inertia, but actually cowardice. When he met a strong person, he did not dare to resist, so he used the words "moderation" to whitewash it and talk about masturbation. Therefore, if the Chinese have power, when they see that others cannot do anything to him, or when there is a "majority" as his talisman, they are mostly ferocious and arrogant, like a tyrant, and they are not mediocre; By the time the mouth is full of "moderation", it is time for the power to be lost, and it is time for the "golden mean" to be indispensable. When it comes to complete defeat, there is "fate" as a handle, even if you are a slave, you are calm, but you are always in line with the holy way. These phenomena can really lead to the downfall of the Chinese, regardless of whether there are foreign enemies or not. Lu Xun. March 29.鲁迅先生：
Mr. Lu Xun:你看出什么“踱进研究室”，什么“搬入艺术之宫”，全是“一种圈套”，真是一件重要的发现。我实在告诉你说：我近来看见自命gentleman的人就怕极了。看见玄同先生挖苦gentleman的话（见《语丝》第二十期），好像大热时候，吃一盘冰激零，不晓得有多么痛快。总之这些字全是一种圈套，大家总要相戒，不要上他们的当才好。
What you see "pacing into the research room" and "moving into the palace of art" is all "a kind of trap", which is really an important discovery. 战士和苍蝇

战士和苍蝇

战士和苍蝇

Warriors and fliesSchopenhauer说过这样的话：要估定人的伟大，则精神上的大和体格上的大，那法则完全相反。后者距离愈远即愈小，前者却见得愈大。
Schopenhauer once said: To measure the greatness of a person, the law is completely opposite to the great of the spirit and the great physique. The farther the latter is, the smaller it is, while the former is larger.正因为近则愈小，而且愈看见缺点和创伤，所以他就和我们一样，不是神道，不是妖怪，不是异兽。他仍然是人，不过如此。但也惟其如此，所以他是伟大的人。
It is precisely because the closer he gets, the smaller he is, and the more he sees shortcomings and traumas, he is the same as us, not a god, not a monster, not a strange beast. He is still human, but that's it. But that's why he's a great man.战士战死了的时候，苍蝇们所首先发见的是他的缺点和伤痕，嘬着，营营地叫着，以为得意，以为比死了的战士更英雄。但是战士已经战死了，不再来挥去他们。于是乎苍蝇们即更其营营地叫，自以为倒是不朽的声音，因为它们的完全，远在战士之上。
When a soldier dies in battle, the first thing the flies find is his shortcomings and scars, chattering, barking, thinking that they are more heroic than the dead soldiers. But the warriors were already dead and no longer came and went. So the flies cried out in a loud voice, thinking that it was an immortal voice, because their perfection was far above the warriors.的确的，谁也没有发见过苍蝇们的缺点和创伤。
Indeed, no one has ever seen the shortcomings and traumas of flies.然而，有缺点的战士终竟是战士，完美的苍蝇也终竟不过是苍蝇。
However, a warrior with flaws is a warrior after all, and a perfect fly is nothing more than a fly after all.去罢，苍蝇们！虽然生着翅子，还能营营，总不会超过战士的。你们这些虫豸们！
Go, flies! Although it has wings, it can still camp, and it will never surpass the warrior. You bugs!三月二十一日。
March 21.

夏三虫

夏三虫

Three insects in summer夏天近了，将有三虫：蚤，蚊，蝇。
Summer is approaching, and there will be three insects: fleas, mosquitoes, and flies.假如有谁提出一个问题，问我三者之中，最爱什么，而且非爱一个不可，又不准像“青年必读书”那样的缴白卷的。我便只得回答道：跳蚤。
If someone asks me a question and asks me what I love the most among the three, and I have to love one, and I am not allowed to submit a blank paper like "Youth Must Read". I had to answer: fleas.跳蚤的来吮血，虽然可恶，而一声不响地就是一口，何等直截爽快。蚊子便不然了，一针叮进皮肤，自然还可以算得有点彻底的，但当未叮之前，要哼哼地发一篇大议论，却使人觉得讨厌。如果所哼的是在说明人血应该给它充饥的理由，那可更其讨厌了，幸而我不懂。
The flea comes to suck blood, although it is hateful, but it is a mouthful without making a sound, how straightforward and refreshing. Mosquitoes are not like that, a needle into the skin can naturally be considered a bit thorough, but before the bite, it is annoying to hum a big discussion. If what you are humming is explaining the reason why human blood should satisfy its hunger, it is even more annoying, but fortunately I don't understand.野雀野鹿，一落在人手中，总时时刻刻想要逃走。其实，在山林间，上有鹰，下有虎狼，何尝比在人手里安全。为什么当初不逃到人类中来，现在却要逃到鹰虎狼间去？或者，鹰虎狼之于它们，正如跳蚤之于我们罢。肚子饿了，抓着就是一口，决不谈道理，弄玄虚。被吃者也无须在被吃之前，先承认自己之理应被吃，心悦诚服，誓死不二。人类，可是也颇擅长于哼哼的了，害中取小，它们的避之惟恐不速，正是绝顶聪明。
Wild birds and wild deer, once they fall into the hands of people, always want to escape. In fact, in the mountains and forests, there are eagles above and tigers and wolves below, which is safer than in human hands. Why didn't you escape to humans at the beginning, but now you want to escape to the eagle tiger and wolf? Or, eagles  tigers and wolves are to them what fleas are to us. If you are hungry, grab it and take a bite, never talk about reason, and make a mystery. The eaten do not need to admit that they deserve to be eaten before being eaten, and they are convinced and vow to die. Humans, however, are also quite good at humming, taking the lesser of harm, and they are afraid of being unhurried, which is extremely smart.苍蝇嗡嗡地闹了大半天，停下来也不过舐一点油汗，倘有伤痕或疮疖，自然更占一些便宜；无论怎么好的，美的，干净的东西，又总喜欢一律拉上一点蝇矢。但因为只舐一点油汗，只添一点腌臜，在麻木的人们还没有切肤之痛，所以也就将它放过了。中国人还不很知道它能够传播病菌，捕蝇运动大概不见得兴盛。它们的运命是长久的；还要更繁殖。
The flies buzzed for most of the day, and they only licked a little oil and sweat when they stopped, and if there were scars or boils, they would naturally take some advantage; No matter how good, beautiful, and clean things are, they always like to pull a little fly arrow. But because only a little oil sweat is licked, only a little pickled meat is added, and people who are numb do not have the pain of cutting their skin, so they let it go. Chinese people are not well aware that it can spread germs, and fly hunting is probably not necessarily prosperous. Their destiny is long-lasting; It is also necessary to reproduce more.但它在好的，美的，干净的东西上拉了蝇矢之后，似乎还不至于欣欣然反过来嘲笑这东西的不洁：总要算还有一点道德的。
But after pulling a fly arrow on something good, beautiful, and clean, it does not seem to be happy to laugh at the uncleanliness of this thing in turn: there must be a little morality.古今君子，每以禽兽斥人，殊不知便是昆虫，值得师法的地方也多着哪。
Gentlemen of ancient and modern times, every time they scold people with beasts, they don't know that they are insects, and there are many places worth learning from.四月四日。
April 4th.

忽然想到

Suddenly thought五
Five我生得太早一点，连康有为们“公车上书”的时候，已经颇有些年纪了。政变之后，有族中的所谓长辈也者教诲我，说：康有为是想篡位，所以他的名字叫有为；有者，“富有天下”，为者，“贵为天子”也。非图谋不轨而何？我想：诚然。可恶得很！
I was born a little early, and when Lian Kang Youwei "wrote on the bus", he was already quite old. After the coup, the so-called elders in the clan taught me, saying: Kang Youwei wanted to usurp the throne, so his name was Youwei; Possessing means "wealth in the world," while doing means "being noble as the Son of Heaven." What if it is not a conspiracy? I think: indeed. It's so hateful!长辈的训诲于我是这样的有力，所以我也很遵从读书人家的家教。屏息低头，毫不敢轻举妄动。两眼下视黄泉，看天就是傲慢，满脸装出死相，说笑就是放肆。我自然以为极应该的，但有时心里也发生一点反抗。心的反抗，那时还不算什么犯罪，似乎诛心之律，倒不及现在之严。
The teachings of my elders are so powerful to me, so I also follow the tutoring of scholars. Holding his breath and bowing his head, he did not dare to act rashly. Looking down at the underworld, looking at the sky is arrogant, pretending to be dead on his face, and laughing is presumptuous. I naturally thought it was very appropriate, but sometimes I also felt a little rebellious in my heart. The resistance of the heart was not a crime at that time, and it seemed that the law of punishing the heart was not as strict as it is now.但这心的反抗，也还是大人们引坏的，因为他们自己就常常随便大说大笑，而单是禁止孩子。黔首们看见秦始皇那么阔气，捣乱的项羽道：“彼可取而代也！”没出息的刘邦却说：“大丈夫不当如是耶？”我是没出息的一流，因为羡慕他们的随意说笑，就很希望赶忙变成大人，——虽然此外也还有别种的原因。
But this resistance of the heart is also bad for adults, because they often laugh casually, and only forbid children. The people saw Qin Shi Huang so generous, and the troublesome Xiang Yu said: "He can be replaced!" Liu Bang, who was unpromising, said: "Shouldn't a man be like this? "I'm a first-class person who has no prospects, because I envy their casual jokes, and I really want to become an adult in a hurry,—— although there are other reasons.大丈夫不当如是耶，在我，无非只想不再装死而已，欲望也并不甚奢。
A man shouldn't be like this, for me, it's just that I just want to stop pretending to be dead, and my desires are not too extravagant.现在，可喜我已经大了，这大概是谁也不能否认的罢，无论用了怎样古怪的“逻辑”。
Now, fortunately, I am older, which is probably something that no one can deny, no matter how strange "logic" is used.我于是就抛了死相，放心说笑起来，而不意立刻又碰了正经人的钉子：说是使他们“失望”了。我自然是知道的，先前是老人们的世界，现在是少年们的世界了；但竟不料治世的人们虽异，而其禁止说笑也则同。那么，我的死相也还得装下去，装下去，“死而后已”，岂不痛哉！
So I threw away the dead face and laughed with confidence, but I didn't expect to immediately touch the nail of a serious person again: saying that I had "disappointed" them. Naturally, I know that it was the world of the old people before, and now it is the world of the teenagers; But unexpectedly, although the people who ruled the world were different, their prohibition of jokes was the same. Then, my death appearance has to be pretended, pretended, "after death", isn't it painful!我于是又恨我生得太迟一点。何不早二十年，赶上那大人还准说笑的时候？真是“我生不辰”，正当可诅咒的时候，活在可诅咒的地方了。
I then hated that I was born a little too late. Why not catch up with the time when the adult is allowed to joke twenty years earlier? It's really "I was born at the wrong time", just when I can be cursed, I live in a cursed place.约翰弥耳说：专制使人们变成冷嘲。我们却天下太平，连冷嘲也没有。我想：暴君的专制使人们变成冷嘲，愚民的专制使人们变成死相。大家渐渐死下去，而自己反以为卫道有效，这才渐近于正经的活人。
John Mill said: Autocracy turns people into cynics. But we are at peace in the world, and there is not even cynicism. I think: the tyranny of tyrants turns people into cynicism, and the tyranny of the foolish people turns people into death. Everyone gradually died, but they thought that the defense was effective, and they gradually became closer to serious living people.世上如果还有真要活下去的人们，就先该敢说，敢笑，敢哭，敢怒，敢骂，敢打，在这可诅咒的地方击退了可诅咒的时代！
If there are people in the world who really want to live, they should dare to speak, laugh, cry, get angry, scold, and fight, and repel the cursed era in this cursed place!四月十四日。
April 14th.

六

忽然想到

Six外国的考古学者们联翩而至了。
Foreign archaeologists came one after another.久矣夫，中国的学者们也早已口口声声的叫着“保古！保古！保古！……”
For a long time, Chinese scholars have long been shouting "Preserve the ancients!" Hoko! Hoko! ……”但是不能革新的人种，也不能保古的。
But the race that cannot be reformed cannot be preserved in the past.所以，外国的考古学者们便联翩而至了。
Therefore, foreign archaeologists came one after another.长城久成废物，弱水也似乎不过是理想上的东西。老大的国民尽钻在僵硬的传统里，不肯变革，衰朽到毫无精力了，还要自相残杀。于是外面的生力军很容易地进来了，真是“匪今斯今，振古如兹”。至于他们的历史，那自然都没我们的那么古。
The Great Wall has become a waste for a long time, and weak water seems to be just an ideal thing. The people of the boss are trapped in rigid traditions, refusing to change, decaying to the point of having no energy, and killing each other. So the new forces outside came in easily, and it was really "bandits of the present, and the revitalization of the past is like this". As for their history, it is naturally not as ancient as ours.可是我们的古也就难保，因为土地先已危险而不安全。土地给了别人，则“国宝”虽多，我觉得实在也无处陈列。
But our ancient times are difficult to protect, because the land is already dangerous and unsafe. If the land is given to others, then although there are many "national treasures", I think there is really nowhere to display them.但保古家还在痛骂革新，力保旧物地干：用玻璃板印些宋版书，每部定价几十几百元；“涅槃！涅槃！涅槃！”佛自汉时已入中国，其古色古香为何如哉！买集些旧书和金石，是劬古爱国之士，略作考证，赶印目录，就升为学者或高人。而外国人所得的古董，却每从高人的高尚的袖底里共清风一同流出。即不然，归安陆氏的皕宋，潍县陈氏的十钟，其子孙尚能世守否？
However, the ancient family is still scolding innovation and trying to keep the old things dry: print some Song editions of books with glass plates, and each copy is priced at tens or hundreds of yuan; "Nirvana! Nirvana! Nirvana! "The Buddha has been in China since the Han Dynasty, how antique is it! Buying some old books and gold and stone, he is a patriot who works hard for the ancients, does a little research, prints the catalog, and is promoted to a scholar or a master. However, the antiques obtained by foreigners often flow out of the noble sleeves of the masters with the breeze. Otherwise, can the descendants of the Song Dynasty of the Anlu clan and the ten bells of the Chen clan in Weixian still be kept for generations?现在，外国的考古学者们便联翩而至了。
Now, foreign archaeologists are coming.他们活有余力，则以考古，但考古尚可，帮同保古就更可怕了。有些外人，很希望中国永是一个大古董以供他们的赏鉴，这虽然可恶，却还不奇，因为他们究竟是外人。而中国竟也有自己还不够，并且要率领了少年，赤子，共成一个大古董以供他们的赏鉴者，则真不知是生着怎样的心肝。
They have more than enough to live, so they use archaeology, but archaeology is acceptable, and it is even more terrible to help protect the ancients. Some outsiders hope that China will always be a big antique for their appreciation, which is hateful, but it is not surprising, because they are outsiders. And China actually has its own people who are not enough, and want to lead teenagers and children to form a big antique for their appreciation, I really don't know what kind of heart and liver it is.中国废止读经了，教会学校不是还请腐儒做先生，教学生读“四书”么？民国废去跪拜了，犹太学校不是偏请遗老做先生，要学生磕头拜寿么？外国人办给中国人看的报纸，不是最反对五四以来的小改革么？而外国总主笔治下的中国小主笔，则倒是崇拜道学，保存国粹的！
China has abolished the reading of the Bible, and the church schools have not invited corrupt Confucians to be teachers and teach students to read the "Four Books"? The Republic of China abolished kneeling, didn't the Jewish school invite the elderly to be teachers and ask students to kowtow to their birthdays? Isn't the newspaper run by foreigners for Chinese the most opposed to the small reforms since May Fourth? The Chinese chief writer under the rule of the foreign chief writer worships Taoism and preserves the essence of the country!但是，无论如何，不革新，是生存也为难的，而况保古。现状就是铁证，比保古家的万言书有力得多。
However, in any case, it is difficult to survive without innovation, let alone preserve the ancients. The status quo is ironclad evidence, much more powerful than the ten thousand words of the Bao Gu family.我们目下的当务之急，是：一要生存，二要温饱，三要发展。苟有阻碍这前途者，无论是古是今，是人是鬼，是《三坟》《五典》，百宋千元，天球河图，金人玉佛，祖传丸散，秘制膏丹，全都踏倒他。
Our immediate priorities are: first, to survive, second, to eat and drink, and third, to develop. If there is anyone who hinders this future, whether it is ancient or modern, human or ghost, it is the "Three Tombs", "Five Classics", a hundred songs and a thousand yuan, the Tianqiu River Map, the golden man and the jade Buddha, the ancestral pill powder, and the secret ointment, all of them will trample on him.保古家大概总读过古书，“林回弃千金之璧，负赤子而趋”，该不能说是禽兽行为罢。那么，弃赤子而抱千金之璧的是什么？
The Baogu family probably always read ancient books, "Lin Hui abandoned the jade of a thousand gold and went with a child", which should not be said to be beastly behavior. So, what is it that abandons the innocence and embraces the treasure of a thousand gold?四月十八日。
April 18th.

杂感

杂感

杂感

Mixed feelings人们有泪，比动物进化，但即此有泪，也就是不进化，正如已经只有盲肠，比鸟类进化，而究竟还有盲肠，终不能很算进化一样。凡这些，不但是无用的赘物，还要使其人达到无谓的灭亡。
People have tears, more evolved than animals, but there are tears, that is, they do not evolve, just as there is only an appendix, more evolved than birds, and there is still an appendix, which cannot be considered evolutionary after all. All of this is not only useless redundancy, but also leads to unnecessary destruction.现今的人们还以眼泪赠答，并且以这为最上的赠品，因为他此外一无所有。无泪的人则以血赠答，但又各各拒绝别人的血。
People today also give with tears, and this is the best gift, because he has nothing else. Those who do not shed tears give blood in return, but each rejects the blood of others.人大抵不愿意爱人下泪。但临死之际，可能也不愿意爱人为你下泪么？无泪的人无论何时，都不愿意爱人下泪，并且连血也不要：他拒绝一切为他的哭泣和灭亡。
Most people don't want their lovers to cry. But when you are dying, you may not want your lover to cry for you? A person without tears does not want his lover to weep at any time, and he does not even want blood: he refuses to weep and perish for him.人被杀于万众聚观之中，比被杀在“人不知鬼不觉”的地方快活，因为他可以妄想，博得观众中的或人的眼泪。但是，无泪的人无论被杀在什么所在，于他并无不同。
A person is happier to be killed in a crowd than to be killed in a place where "people are unaware", because he can fantasize and win the tears of the audience. However, no matter where the person without tears is killed, he is no different.杀了无泪的人，一定连血也不见。爱人不觉他被杀之惨，仇人也终于得不到杀他之乐：这是他的报恩和复仇。
If you kill someone without tears, you must not even see blood. The lover did not realize that he was killed tragically, and the enemy finally did not get the pleasure of killing him: this was his repayment and revenge.
死于敌手的锋刃，不足悲苦；死于不知何来的暗器，却是悲苦。但最悲苦的是死于慈母或爱人误进的毒药，战友乱发的流弹，病菌的并无恶意的侵入，不是我自己制定的死刑。
dying at the edge of the enemy's blade is not enough to be sad; Died from a hidden weapon that I don't know where it came from, but it was tragic. But the most tragic thing is that I died from the poison of my loving mother or lover, the stray bullets fired by my comrades-in-arms, and the malicious intrusion of germs, not the death penalty I formulated myself.
仰慕往古的，回往古去罢！想出世的，快出世罢！想上天的，快上天罢！灵魂要离开肉体的，赶快离开罢！现在的地上，应该是执着现在，执着地上的人们居住的。
Admire the ancients, go back to the ancients! If you want to be born, be born quickly! If you want to go to heaven, go to heaven quickly! If the soul wants to leave the body, leave quickly! The current earth should be inhabited by people who cling to the present and cling to the earth.但厌恶现世的人们还住着。这都是现世的仇仇，他们一日存在，现世即一日不能得救。
But the people who hate the present world still live. These are all enemies of this world, and if they exist for a day, they cannot be saved for a day in this world.先前，也曾有些愿意活在现世而不得的人们，沉默过了，呻吟过了，叹息过了，哭泣过了，哀求过了，但仍然愿意活在现世而不得，因为他们忘却了愤怒。
Previously, there were some people who were willing to live in this world but were silent, groaned, sighed, cried, and begged, but they were still willing to live in this world because they had forgotten their anger.勇者愤怒，抽刃向更强者；怯者愤怒，却抽刃向更弱者。不可救药的民族中，一定有许多英雄，专向孩子们瞪眼。这些孱头们！
The brave are angry and draw their blades against the stronger; The cowardly one was angry and drew his blade towards the weaker. Among the incorrigible nations, there must be many heroes who glared at the children. These bastards!孩子们在瞪眼中长大了，又向别的孩子们瞪眼，并且想：他们一生都过在愤怒中。因为愤怒只是如此，所以他们要愤怒一生，——而且还要愤怒二世，三世，四世，以至末世。
The children grow up staring, and then they stare at other children and think: they have lived their lives in anger. Because anger is just that, they will be angry for the rest of their lives,—— and they will be angry at the second, third, fourth, and even the last days.无论爱什么，——饭，异性，国，民族，人类等等，——只有纠缠如毒蛇，执着如怨鬼，二六时中，没有已时者有望。但太觉疲劳时，也无妨休息一会罢；但休息之后，就再来一回罢，而且两回，三回……。血书，章程，请愿，讲学，哭，电报，开会，挽联，演说，神经衰弱，则一切无用。
No matter what you love, ,—— food, the opposite sex, the country, the nation, the human beings,—— etc., only entanglement is like a poisonous snake, persistence is like a resentful ghost, and there is no hope for the time in the twenty-six hours. But when you feel too tired, it doesn't hurt to rest for a while; But after the break, just do it again, and twice, three times, ....... Blood letters, constitutions, petitions, lectures, crying, telegrams, meetings, elegiacs, speeches, nervous breakdowns, all are useless.血书所能挣来的是什么？不过就是你的一张血书，况且并不好看。至于神经衰弱，其实倒是自己生了病，你不要再当作宝贝了，我的可敬爱而讨厌的朋友呀！
What can be earned from blood books? It's just a blood book of yours, and it's not good-looking. As for the nervous breakdown, in fact, it is that you are sick, don't treat it as a treasure anymore, my dear and hated friend!我们听到呻吟，叹息，哭泣，哀求，无须吃惊。见了酷烈的沉默，就应该留心了；见有什么像毒蛇似的在尸林中蜿蜒，怨鬼似的在黑暗中奔驰，就更应该留心了：这在豫告“真的愤怒”将要到来。那时候，仰慕往古的就要回往古去了，想出世的要出世去了，想上天的要上天了，灵魂要离开肉体的就要离开了！……
We are not surprised to hear moans, sighs, crying, and begging. When you see the fierce silence, you should pay attention; When you see something meandering in the forest of corpses like a poisonous snake or running in the darkness like a ghost, you should pay more attention: this foretells that "real anger" is coming. At that time, those who admired the past had to go back to the ancients, those who wanted to be born would go to the world, those who wanted to go to heaven would go to heaven, and those whose souls wanted to leave the body would leave! ……五月五日。
May 5th.
