北京通信

Beijing Communications蕴儒，培良两兄：
Yunru, Peiliang's two brothers:昨天收到两份《豫报》，使我非常快活，尤其是见了那《副刊》。因为它那蓬勃的朝气，实在是在我先前的豫想以上。你想：从有着很古的历史的中州，传来了青年的声音，仿佛在豫告这古国将要复活，这是一件如何可喜的事呢？
Yesterday I received two copies of the "Yu News", which made me very happy, especially when I saw the "Supplement". Because its vigorous vitality is really above my previous expectations. You think: From Zhongzhou, which has a very ancient history, the voice of a young man came, as if predicting that this ancient country would be resurrected, how gratifying is this?倘使我有这力量，我自然极愿意有所贡献于河南的青年。但不幸我竟力不从心，因为我自己也正站在歧路上，——或者，说得较有希望些：站在十字路口。站在歧路上是几乎难于举足，站在十字路口，是可走的道路很多。我自己，是什么也不怕的，生命是我自己的东西，所以我不妨大步走去，向着我自以为可以走去的路；即使前面是深渊，荆棘，狭谷，火坑，都由我自己负责。然而向青年说话可就难了，如果盲人瞎马，引入危途，我就该得谋杀许多人命的罪孽。
If I have this strength, I am naturally very willing to contribute to the youth of Henan. But unfortunately I was unable to do so, because I myself was standing at a wrong path,—— or, to put it more hopefully, standing at a crossroads. It is almost difficult to stand at a crossroads, and there are many roads to walk when standing at a crossroads. I am not afraid of anything, life is my own thing, so I might as well stride towards the road I think I can go; Even if there is an abyss, thorns, valleys, fire pits, I am responsible for it. However, it is difficult to speak to young people, if a blind man leads a dangerous path, I should be guilty of murdering many lives.所以，我终于还不想劝青年一同走我所走的路；我们的年龄，境遇，都不相同，思想的归宿大概总不能一致的罢。但倘若一定要问我青年应当向怎样的目标，那么，我只可以说出我为别人设计的话，就是：一要生存，二要温饱，三要发展。有敢来阻碍这三事者，无论是谁，我们都反抗他，扑灭他！
Therefore, I finally do not want to persuade young people to follow the path I have taken; Our ages and circumstances are different, and the destination of our thoughts is probably not the same. But if I had to ask what kind of goals young people should pursue, then I could only say what I designed for others, that is: first, to survive, second, to eat and drink, and third, to develop. Whoever dares to hinder these three things, no matter who it is, we will resist him and extinguish him!可是还得附加几句话以免误解，就是：我之所谓生存，并不是苟活；所谓温饱，并不是奢侈；所谓发展，也不是放纵。
But I have to add a few sentences to avoid misunderstanding, that is: my so-called survival is not survival; The so-called food and clothing are not luxury; The so-called development is not indulgence.中国古来，一向是最注重于生存的，什么“知命者不立于岩墙之下”咧，什么“千金之子坐不垂堂”咧，什么“身体发肤受之父母不敢毁伤”咧，竟有父母愿意儿子吸鸦片的，一吸，他就不至于到外面去，有倾家荡产之虞了。可是这一流人家，家业也决不能长保，因为这是苟活。苟活就是活不下去的初步，所以到后来，他就活不下去了。意图生存，而太卑怯，结果就得死亡。以中国古训中教人苟活的格言如此之多，而中国人偏多死亡，外族偏多侵入，结果适得其反，可见我们蔑弃古训，是刻不容缓的了。这实在是无可奈何，因为我们要生活，而且不是苟活的缘故。
Since ancient China, it has always paid the most attention to survival, what "the one who knows his fate does not stand under the rock wall", what "the son of a daughter can't sit in the hall", what "the body and skin are affected by the parents dare not be damaged", there are parents who want their son to smoke opium, once he sucks, he will not go outside, there is a risk of bankruptcy. But this first-class family must not maintain their family business for a long time, because this is a survival. Survival is the initial stage of not being able to live, so later, he will not be able to live. If you are too cowardly with the intention of survival, you will die. With so many adages in ancient Chinese teachings that teach people to survive, and the Chinese die more and foreign tribes invade more, the result is counterproductive, it can be seen that we despise the ancient teachings, and it is urgent for us to ignore the ancient teachings. This is really helpless, because we have to live, and not to live.中国人虽然想了各种苟活的理想乡，可惜终于没有实现。但我却替他们发见了，你们大概知道的罢，就是北京的第一监狱。这监狱在宣武门外的空地里，不怕邻家的火灾；每日两餐，不虑冻馁；起居有定，不会伤生；构造坚固，不会倒塌；禁卒管着，不会再犯罪；强盗是决不会来抢的。住在里面，何等安全，真真是“千金之子坐不垂堂”了。但阙少的就有一件事：自由。
Although the Chinese thought of various utopias, unfortunately they did not realize them. But I found it for them, as you probably know, it is Beijing's No. 1 Prison. This prison is in the open space outside Xuanwu Gate, and it is not afraid of the fire of the neighbor; Two meals a day, not worrying about cold and hunger; The daily life is fixed, and it will not harm life; The structure is strong and will not collapse; The jailer will not sin again; Robbers will never come to rob. Living in it, how safe it is, it is really "the son of a daughter can't sit in the hall". But there is one thing missing: freedom.古训所教的就是这样的生活法，教人不要动。不动，失错当然就较少了，但不活的岩石泥沙，失错不是更少么？我以为人类为向上，即发展起见，应该活动，活动而有若干失错，也不要紧。惟独半死半生的苟活，是全盘失错的。因为他挂了生活的招牌，其实却引人到死路上去！
This is how the ancient teachings teach, teaching people not to move. If you don't move, of course, there will be fewer mistakes, but if you don't live in rock sediment, won't you make fewer mistakes? I think that human beings should move for the sake of upward, that is, for development, and it doesn't matter if there are some mistakes in activities. Only half-dead and half-alive survival is a complete mistake. Because he hung up the sign of life, it actually led people to death!我想，我们总得将青年从牢狱里引出来，路上的危险，当然是有的，但这是求生的偶然的危险，无从逃避。想逃避，就须度那古人所希求的第一监狱式生活了，可是真在第一监狱里的犯人，都想早些释放，虽然外面并不比狱里安全。
I think we have to lure young people out of prison, of course, there are dangers on the road, but this is an accidental danger of survival, and there is no way to escape. If you want to escape, you have to live the first prison-style life that the ancients longed for, but the prisoners in the first prison really want to be released early, although it is not safer outside than in prison.北京暖和起来了；我的院子里种了几株丁香，活了；还有两株榆叶梅，至今还未发芽，不知道他是否活着。
Beijing is warming up; I planted a few lilacs in my yard, and they were alive; There are also two elm-leaved plum trees, which have not yet sprouted, and I don't know if he is alive.昨天闹了一个小乱子，许多学生被打伤了；听说还有死的，我不知道确否。其实，只要听他们开会，结果不过是开会而已，因为加了强力的迫压，遂闹出开会以上的事来。俄国的革命，不就是从这样的路径出发的么？
Yesterday there was a small mess, and many students were injured; I heard that there are still dead, but I don't know if it's true. In fact, as long as they listen to their meeting, the result is just a meeting, because of the strong pressure, so there is more than a meeting. Didn't the Russian revolution start from such a path?夜深了，就此搁笔，后来再谈罢。
It's late at night, so I'll put down my pen and talk about it later.鲁迅。五月八日夜。
Lu Xun. On the night of May 8th.

导师

导师

导师

mentor近来很通行说青年；开口青年，闭口也是青年。但青年又何能一概而论？有醒着的，有睡着的，有昏着的，有躺着的，有玩着的，此外还多。但是，自然也有要前进的。
Recently, it is very common to talk about youth; Young people who open their mouths and close their mouths are also young people. But how can young people generalize? There are awake, asleep, faint, lying, playing, and many more. However, there is naturally something to move forward.要前进的青年们大抵想寻求一个导师。然而我敢说：他们将永远寻不到。寻不到倒是运气；自知的谢不敏，自许的果真识路么？凡自以为识路者，总过了“而立”之年，灰色可掬了，老态可掬了，圆稳而已，自己却误以为识路。假如真识路，自己就早进向他的目标，何至于还在做导师。说佛法的和尚，卖仙药的道士，将来都与白骨是“一丘之貉”，人们现在却向他听生西的大法，求上升的真传，岂不可笑！
Young people who want to move forward probably want to seek a mentor. But I dare say: they will never be found. It is luck that cannot be found; Do you really know the way to know yourself? Anyone who thinks he knows the way has passed the age of "standing", gray is palpable, old is picky, round and stable, but he mistakenly thinks he knows the way. If he truly knows the way, he will have advanced towards his goal early, so why should he still be a mentor. Monks who speak of Buddhism and Taoist priests who sell elixirs will all be "raccoons on a hill" with white bones in the future, but people are now listening to him about the Dafa of the West and asking for the true transmission of ascension, isn't it ridiculous?但是我并非敢将这些人一切抹杀；和他们随便谈谈，是可以的。说话的也不过能说话，弄笔的也不过能弄笔；别人如果希望他打拳，则是自己错。他如果能打拳，早已打拳了，但那时，别人大概又要希望他翻筋斗。
But I do not dare to erase all of these people; It's okay to talk to them casually. those who speak can only speak, and those who make pens can only make pens; If others want him to punch, it's his fault. If he could punch, he would have already punched, but at that time, others probably wanted him to somersault again.有些青年似乎也觉悟了，我记得《京报副刊》征求青年必读书时，曾有一位发过牢骚，终于说：只有自己可靠！我现在还想斗胆转一句，虽然有些杀风景，就是：自己也未必可靠的。
I remember that when the "Beijing News Supplement" solicited must-read books for young people, one of them complained, and finally said: Only he is reliable! I still want to dare to change my sentence, although there are some killing scenery, that is: I may not be reliable.我们都不大有记性。这也无怪，人生苦痛的事太多了，尤其是在中国。记性好的，大概都被厚重的苦痛压死了；只有记性坏的，适者生存，还能欣然活着。但我们究竟还有一点记忆，回想起来，怎样的“今是昨非”呵，怎样的“口是心非”呵，怎样的“今日之我与昨日之我战”呵。我们还没有正在饿得要死时于无人处见别人的饭，正在穷得要死时于无人处见别人的钱，正在性欲旺盛时遇见异性，而且很美的。我想，大话不宜讲得太早，否则，倘有记性，将来想到时会脸红。
None of us have a good memory. No wonder, there are too many painful things in life, especially in China. those with good memory are probably crushed to death by heavy pain; Only those with bad memories survive and can live happily. But we still have a little memory, looking back, what kind of "today is yesterday", what kind of "duplicity", what kind of "today's me and yesterday's me". We haven't seen other people's food in nowhere when we are hungry to death, we are seeing other people's money in no one when we are poor to death, and we are meeting the opposite sex when we are in high libido, and it is beautiful. I think it is not advisable to speak too early, otherwise, if you have a memory, you will blush when you think about it in the future.或者还是知道自己之不甚可靠者，倒较为可靠罢。
Or maybe you know that you are not very reliable, but you are more reliable.青年又何须寻那挂着金字招牌的导师呢？不如寻朋友，联合起来，同向着似乎可以生存的方向走。你们所多的是生力，遇见深林，可以辟成平地的，遇见旷野，可以栽种树木的，遇见沙漠，可以开掘井泉的。问什么荆棘塞途的老路，寻什么乌烟瘴气的鸟导师！
Why do young people need to look for a mentor with a golden sign? It is better to find friends, unite, and walk in a direction that seems to survive. What you have is vitality, and when you meet a deep forest, you can open up flat land, you will meet a wilderness, you will plant trees, you will meet a desert, you will dig wells and springs. Ask what thorny old road is blocked, and what kind of smoky bird tutor is looking for!五月十一日。
May 11th.

长城

长城

长城

The Great Wall伟大的长城！
The Great Wall!这工程，虽在地图上也还有它的小像，凡是世界上稍有知识的人们，大概都知道的罢。
This project, although it still has its small statue on the map, is probably known to anyone with a little knowledge in the world.其实，从来不过徒然役死许多工人而已，胡人何尝挡得住。现在不过一种古迹了，但一时也不会灭尽，或者还要保存它。
In fact, it has never been just a futile death of many workers, and the Hu people have never been able to stop it. Now it is just a monument, but it will not be extinguished for a while, or it will be preserved.我总觉得周围有长城围绕。这长城的构成材料，是旧有的古砖和补添的新砖。两种东西联为一气造成了城壁，将人们包围。
I always feel surrounded by the Great Wall. The composition of this Great Wall is old ancient bricks and new bricks. The two East and West are united to create a city wall that surrounds people.何时才不给长城添新砖呢？
When will we not add new bricks to the Great Wall?这伟大而可诅咒的长城！
This great and damned Great Wall!五月十一日。

忽然想到

忽然想到

Suddenly thought七
Seven大约是送报人忙不过来了，昨天不见报，今天才给补到，但是奇怪，正张上已经剪去了两小块；幸而副刊是完全的。那上面有一篇武者君的《温良》，又使我记起往事，我记得确曾用了这样一个糖衣的毒刺赠送过我的同学们。现在武者君也在大道上发见了两样东西了：凶兽和羊。但我以为这不过发见了一部分，因为大道上的东西还没有这样简单，还得附加一句，是：凶兽样的羊，羊样的凶兽。
It was probably because the newspaper delivery person was too busy, and I didn't see the newspaper yesterday, so I only made up for it today, but strangely, two small pieces had been cut off from the main sheet; Fortunately, the supplement is complete. There was a "Gentleman" by Warrior Jun on it, which reminded me of the past, and I remember that I had used such a sugar-coated stinger to give to my classmates. Now the warrior has also found two things on the road: fierce beasts and sheep. But I thought this was only part of the discovery, because the things on the road were not so simple, and I had to add a sentence: a beast-like sheep, a sheep-like beast.他们是羊，同时也是凶兽；但遇见比他更凶的凶兽时便现羊样，遇见比他更弱的羊时便现凶兽样，因此，武者君误认为两样东西了。
They are sheep and beasts at the same time; But when he met a fierce beast that was more fierce than him, he appeared like a sheep, and when he met a sheep weaker than him, he appeared like a fierce beast, so the warrior Jun mistook two things.我还记得第一次五四以后，军警们很客气地只用枪托，乱打那手无寸铁的教员和学生，威武到很像一队铁骑在苗田上驰骋；学生们则惊叫奔避，正如遇见虎狼的羊群。但是，当学生们成了大群，袭击他们的敌人时，不是遇见孩子也要推他摔几个觔斗么？在学校里，不是还唾骂敌人的儿子，使他非逃回家去不可么？这和古代暴君的灭族的意见，有什么区分！
I still remember that after the first May Fourth, the military and police policely used only the butt of their guns to beat the unarmed teachers and students, so powerful that they were like a team of iron horses galloping on the seedling fields; The students screamed and ran away, just like a flock of tigers and wolves. But when the students become a large group and attack their enemies, don't you push the child to throw a few fights? In school, didn't he scold the enemy's son, so that he had to flee home? What is the difference between this and the opinion of the ancient tyrant on the extermination of the clan!我还记得中国的女人是怎样被压制，有时简直并羊而不如。现在托了洋鬼子学说的福，似乎有些解放了。但她一得到可以逞威的地位如校长之类，不就雇用了“掠袖擦掌”的打手似的男人，来威吓毫无武力的同性的学生们么？不是利用了外面正有别的学潮的时候，和一些狐群狗党趁势来开除她私意所不喜的学生们么？而几个在“男尊女卑”的社会生长的男人们，此时却在异性的饭碗化身的面前摇尾，简直并羊而不如。羊，诚然是弱的，但还不至于如此，我敢给我所敬爱的羊们保证！
I still remember how Chinese women were suppressed, sometimes as good as sheep. Now that I have the blessing of the doctrine of foreign devils, I seem to be a little liberated. But as soon as she got a position where she could show off her power, such as the principal, didn't she hire a man like a thug to intimidate the students of the same sex who had no force? Didn't she take advantage of the fact that there were other student trends outside, and some fox and dog parties took advantage of the situation to expel the students she didn't like? And a few men who grew up in a society of "male superiority and female inferiority" wagged their tails in front of the incarnation of the opposite sex at this time, which was simply inferior to sheep. Sheep are indeed weak, but not yet, I dare to assure my beloved sheep!但是，在黄金世界还未到来之前，人们恐怕总不免同时含有这两种性质，只看发现时候的情形怎样，就显出勇敢和卑怯的大区别来。可惜中国人但对于羊显凶兽相，而对于凶兽则显羊相，所以即使显着凶兽相，也还是卑怯的国民。这样下去，一定要完结的。
However, before the golden world arrived, people were afraid that both qualities would inevitably be contained at the same time, and the difference between courage and cowardice would be revealed just by looking at the situation at the time of discovery. It's a pity that the Chinese show the appearance of a beast for sheep, and a sheep appearance for a beast, so even if they show a strong beast appearance, they are still cowardly citizens. If this continues, it must be over.我想，要中国得救，也不必添什么东西进去，只要青年们将这两种性质的古传用法，反过来一用就够了：对手如凶兽时就如凶兽，对手如羊时就如羊！
I think that if China wants to be saved, there is no need to add anything to it, as long as the young people use these two ancient traditions in reverse: when the opponent is like a beast, it is like a beast, and when the opponent is like a sheep, it is like a sheep!那么，无论什么魔鬼，就都只能回到他自己的地狱里去。
Then, no matter what the devil is, he can only go back to his own hell.五月十日。
May 10th.

忽然想到

八

忽然想到

Eight五月十二日《京报》的“显微镜”下有这样的一条——
There is such an article under the "microscope" of the "Beijing News" on May 12 -“某学究见某报上载教育总长‘’五七呈文，愀然曰：‘名字怪僻如此，非圣人之徒也，岂能为吾侪卫古文之道者乎！’”
“某学究见某报上载教育总长‘’五七呈文，愀然曰：‘名字怪僻如此，非圣人之徒也，岂能为吾侪卫古文之道者乎！’”因此想起中国有几个字，不但在白话文中，就是在文言文中也几乎不用。其一是这误印为“钉”的“钊”字，还有一个是“淦”字，大概只在人名里还有留遗。我手头没有《说文解字》，钊字的解释完全不记得了，淦则仿佛是船底漏水的意思。我们现在要叙述船漏水，无论用怎样古奥的文章，大概总不至于说“淦矣”了罢，所以除了印张国淦，孙嘉淦或新淦县的新闻之外，这一粒铅字简直是废物。
Therefore, I remember that there are several words in China, not only in the vernacular, but also in classical Chinese. One is the word "Zhao" that is mistakenly printed as "nail", and the other is the word "Gan", which is probably only left in the person's name. I don't have "Shuowen Jiezi" at hand, and I don't remember the explanation of the word Zhao at all, and Gan seems to mean that the bottom of the boat is leaking. We are now going to describe the leakage of the ship, no matter how ancient articles are used, probably not to say "Ganyi", so in addition to printing the news of Zhang Guogan, Sun Jiagan or Xingan County, this grain of lead is simply waste.至于“钊”，则化而为“钉”还不过一个小笑话；听说竟有人因此受害。曹锟做总统的时代（那时这样写法就要犯罪），要办李大钊先生，国务会议席上一个阁员说：“只要看他的名字，就知道不是一个安分的人。什么名字不好取，他偏要叫李大剑？！”于是乎办定了，因为这位“大剑”先生已经用名字自己证实，是“大刀王五”一流人。
As for "Zhao", it is just a small joke to turn it into a "nail"; I heard that some people were victimized because of this. When Cao Kun was president (at that time, it was a crime to write like this), to deal with Mr. Li Dazhao, a cabinet member at the State Council said: "Just look at his name, you know that he is not a safe person." What name is not easy to choose, he wants to be called Li Dajian?! Student marches and petitions have a long history. “碰壁”之后

“碰壁”之后

After "hitting the wall"我平日常常对我的年青的同学们说：古人所谓“穷愁著书”的话，是不大可靠的。穷到透顶，愁得要死的人，那里还有这许多闲情逸致来著书？我们从来没有见过候补的饿殍在沟壑边吟哦；鞭扑底下的囚徒所发出来的不过是直声的叫喊，决不会用一篇妃红俪白的骈体文来诉痛苦的。所以待到磨墨吮笔，说什么“履穿踵决”时，脚上也许早经是丝袜；高吟“饥来驱我去……”的陶征士，其时或者偏已很有些酒意了。正当苦痛，即说不出苦痛来，佛说极苦地狱中的鬼魂，也反而并无叫唤！
I often say to my young classmates: The so-called "poor and sorrowful books" of the ancients are not very reliable. People who are extremely poor and sorrowful to death, where are there so many leisure people who come to write books? We have never seen a waiting list starving by the ravine; What the prisoners under the whip made was nothing more than a straight cry, and they would never use a concubine's red and white parallel text to complain of pain. So when you grind ink and suck the pen and say something "shoes are worn on the heels", the feet may have been stockings; Tao Zhengshi, who chanted "Hunger drives me to ......", may have been a little drunk at that time. Just suffering, that is, indescribable pain, the Buddha said that the ghosts in hell are not calling!华夏大概并非地狱，然而“境由心造”，我眼前总充塞着重迭的黑云，其中有故鬼，新鬼，游魂，牛首阿旁，畜生，化生，大叫唤，无叫唤，使我不堪闻见。我装作无所闻见模样，以图欺骗自己，总算已从地狱中出离。
China is probably not hell, but "the realm is made by the heart", and my eyes are always filled with overlapping black clouds, including old ghosts, new ghosts, wandering souls, bull heads, beasts, metamorphosis, shouting, and no calling, which makes me unbearable. I pretended not to hear or see anything in an attempt to deceive myself, and finally I was out of hell.打门声一响，我又回到现实世界了。又是学校的事。我为什么要做教员？！想着走着，出去开门，果然，信封上首先就看见通红的一行字：国立北京女子师范大学。

I felt pain, but I didn't realize the reason for it.这时我所不识的教员和学生在谈话了；我也不很细听。但在他的话里听到一句“你们做事不要碰壁”，在学生的话里听到一句“杨先生就是壁”，于我就仿佛见了一道光，立刻知道我的痛苦的原因了。
At this time, the faculty and students I didn't know were talking; I don't listen very carefully. But when I heard the sentence "Don't hit the wall when you do things" in his words, and heard the sentence "Mr. Yang is the wall" in the students' words, I felt as if I saw a light and immediately knew the reason for my pain.碰壁，碰壁！我碰了杨家的壁了！
Hit the wall, hit the wall! I touched the wall of the Yang family!其时看看学生们，就像一群童养媳……。
At that time, looking at the students, it was like a group of child brides......这一种会议是照例没有结果的，几个自以为大胆的人物对于婆婆稍加微辞之后，即大家走散。我回家坐在自己的窗下的时候，天色已近黄昏，而阴惨惨的颜色却渐渐地退去，回忆到碰壁的学说，居然微笑起来了。
This kind of meeting was fruitless as usual, and after a few self-righteous figures said a little to their mother-in-law, everyone was separated. When I went home and sat under my window, it was almost dusk, but the gloomy colors gradually receded, and I actually smiled when I recalled the doctrine of hitting the wall.中国各处是壁，然而无形，像“鬼打墙”一般，使你随时能“碰”。能打这墙的，能碰而不感到痛苦的，是胜利者。——但是，此刻太平湖饭店之宴已近阑珊，大家都已经吃到冰其淋，在那里“冷一冷”了罢……。
There are walls everywhere in China, but they are invisible, like "ghosts hitting the wall", so that you can "touch" them at any time. Those who can hit this wall, who can touch it without feeling pain, are the winners. ——However, at this moment, the banquet at the Taiping Lake Hotel is nearing its end, and everyone has already eaten ice and ...... "cold" there.我于是仿佛看见雪白的桌布已经沾了许多酱油渍，男男女女围着桌子都吃冰其淋，而许多媳妇儿，就如中国历来的大多数媳妇儿在苦节的婆婆脚下似的，都决定了暗淡的运命。
I seemed to see that the snow-white tablecloth had been stained with a lot of soy sauce stains, men and women were eating ice around the table, and many daughters-in-law, just like most daughters-in-law in China who were at the feet of their mother-in-law, had decided their bleak fate.我吸了两支烟，眼前也光明起来，幻出饭店里电灯的光彩，看见教育家在杯酒间谋害学生，看见杀人者于微笑后屠戮百姓，看见死尸在粪土中舞蹈，看见污秽洒满了风籁琴，我想取作画图，竟不能画成一线。我为什么要做教员，连自己也侮蔑自己起来。但是织芳来访我了。
I smoked two cigarettes, and my eyes lit up, conjuring up the brilliance of the electric lights in the restaurant, seeing educators murdering students in the glass of wine, seeing murderers slaughtering people after smiling, seeing corpses dancing in the dung, and seeing filth sprinkled all over the wind and sound. Why should I be a teacher, even belittle myself. But Zhi Fang came to visit me.我们闲谈之间，他也忽而发感慨——
While we were chatting, he also suddenly sighed -“中国什么都黑暗，谁也不行，但没有事的时候是看不出来的。教员咧，学生咧，烘烘烘，烘烘烘，真像一个学校，一有事故，教员也不见了，学生也慢慢躲开了；结局只剩下几个傻子给大家做牺牲，算是收束。多少天之后，又是这样的学校，躲开的也出来了，不见的也露脸了，‘地球是圆的’咧，‘苍蝇是传染病的媒介’咧，又是学生咧，教员咧，烘烘烘……。”
"China is dark about everything, no one can do it, but you can't see it when there is nothing wrong. The instructors are busy, the students are busy, it's really like a school, when there is an accident, the teachers are gone, and the students slowly dodge; In the end, there are only a few fools left to make sacrifices for everyone, which is considered a restraint. How many days later, it was such a school again, those who avoided it came out, and those who didn't see it showed their faces, 'the earth is round', 'flies are the vector of infectious diseases', and the students again, the teachers, and the ....... ”从不像我似的常常“碰壁”的青年学生的眼睛看来，中国也就如此之黑暗么？然而他们仅有微弱的呻吟，然而一呻吟就被杀戮了！
From the eyes of young students who have never "hit a wall" like me, is China so dark? However, they only moaned faintly, and as soon as they moaned, they were killed!五月二十一日夜。
On the night of May 21st.

并非闲话

并非闲话

并非闲话

Not idle凡事无论大小，只要和自己有些相干，便不免格外警觉。即如这一回女子师范大学的风潮，我因为在那里担任一点钟功课，也就感到震动，而且就发了几句感慨，登在五月十二的《京报副刊》上。自然，自己也明知道违了“和光同尘”的古训了，但我就是这样，并不想以骑墙或阴柔来买人尊敬。三四天之后，忽然接到一本《现代评论》十五期，很觉得有些稀奇。这一期是新印的，第一页上目录已经整齐（初版字有参差处），就证明着至少是再版。我想：为什么这一期特别卖的多，送的多呢，莫非内容改变了么？翻开初版来，校勘下去，都一样；不过末叶的金城银行的广告已经杳然，所以一篇《女师大的学潮》就赤条条地露出。我不是也发过议论的么？自然要看一看，原来是赞成杨荫榆校长的，和我的论调正相反。做的人是“一个女读者”。
No matter how big or small everything is, as long as it has something to do with yourself, you can't help but be extra vigilant. Just like the trend of women's normal universities this time, I felt shocked because I was doing my homework there, and I posted a few words of emotion, which were published in the "Beijing News Supplement" on May 12. Naturally, I know that I have violated the ancient motto of "being with light and dust", but I am like this, and I don't want to buy respect by riding a wall or being feminine. Three or four days later, I suddenly received a fifteenth issue of "Modern Review", which I felt a little strange. This issue is newly printed, and the table of contents on the first page has been neatly arranged (the words of the first edition are uneven), which proves that it is at least a reprint. I thought: Why is this issue sold so much and given away, could it be that the content has changed? Open the first edition and proofread, it's the same; However, the advertisement of Jincheng Bank at the end of the year has disappeared, so an article "The Student Tide of Women's Normal University" was exposed. Didn't I also post a discussion? Naturally, I had to take a look, and it turned out that I was in favor of Principal Yang Yinyu, which was the opposite of my argument. The person who does it is "a female reader".中国原是玩意儿最多的地方，近来又刚闹过什么“琴心是否女士”问题，我于是心血来潮，忽而想：又捣什么鬼，装什么佯了？但我即刻不再想下去，因为接着就起了别一个念头，想到近来有些人，凡是自己善于在暗中播弄鼓动的，一看见别人明白质直的言动，便往往反噬他是播弄和鼓动，是某党，是某系；正如偷汉的女人的丈夫，总愿意说世人全是忘八，和他相同，他心里才觉舒畅。这种思想是卑劣的；我太多心了，人们也何至于一定用裙子来做军旗。我就将我的念头打断了。
China used to be a place with the most things, and recently there was a question of "whether the heart of the piano is a lady", so I had a whim and suddenly thought: What the hell are you messing with, what are you pretending? But I immediately stopped thinking about it, because then I had another thought, thinking that recently, some people, whoever they are good at sowing incitement in secret, often bite back at him as soon as they see others understand and incite straightforward words and actions, whether it is a certain party or a certain department; Just like the husband of a woman who steals a man, he is always willing to say that the world is all forgetful, and he feels comfortable in his heart. This kind of thinking is despicable; I have too much care, why do people have to use skirts to make military flags. I interrupted my thoughts.此后，风潮还是拖延着，而且展开来，于是有七个教员的宣言发表，也登在五月二十七日的《京报》上，其中的一个是我。
Since then, the trend has been delayed and unfolded, so the manifesto of seven teachers has been published, which was also published in the "Beijing News" on May 27, one of which is me.这回的反响快透了，三十日发行（其实是二十九日已经发卖）的《现代评论》上，西滢先生就在《闲话》的第一段中特地评论。但是，据说宣言是“《闲话》正要付印的时候”才在报上见到的，所以前半只论学潮，和宣言无涉。后来又做了三大段，大约是见了宣言之后，这才文思泉涌的罢，可是《闲话》付印的时间，大概总该颇有些耽误了。但后做而移在前面，也未可知。那么，足见这是一段要紧的“闲话”。
This time, the response was so fast that in the "Modern Review" released on the 30th (in fact, it was released on the 29th), Mr. Xi Ying specially commented in the first paragraph of "Gossip". However, it is said that the declaration was only seen in the newspaper "when "Gossip" was about to be printed, so the first half only talked about the academic trend and had nothing to do with the declaration. Later, I made three more paragraphs, about after seeing the declaration, and then the literary thought flowed in, but the time for the printing of "Gossip" should probably be delayed. But it is unclear whether it will be done later and moved to the front. Then, it shows that this is an important "gossip".《闲话》中说，“以前我们常常听说女师大的风潮，有在北京教育界占最大势力的某籍某系的人在暗中鼓动，可是我们总不敢相信。”所以他只在宣言中摘出“最精彩的几句”，加上圈子，评为“未免偏袒一方”；而且因为“流言更加传布得厉害”，遂觉“可惜”，但他说“还是不信我们平素所很尊敬的人会暗中挑剔风潮”。这些话我觉得确有些超妙的识见。例如“流言”本是畜类的武器，鬼蜮的手段，实在应该不信它。又如一查籍贯，则即使装作公平，也容易启人疑窦，总不如“不敢相信”的好，否则同籍的人固然惮于在一张纸上宣言，而别一某籍的人也不便在暗中给同籍的人帮忙了。这些“流言”和“听说”，当然都只配当作狗屁！
"Gossip" said, "In the past, we often heard about the trend of women's normal universities, and some people from a certain department who occupied the largest power in Beijing's education circles were secretly agitating, but we couldn't believe it. Therefore, he only picked out the "most wonderful sentences" in the manifesto, added circles, and rated them as "inevitably partial"; And because "the rumors are spreading more violently", he felt "pity", but he said, "I still don't believe that the people we usually respect will secretly pick on the trend." I think these words do have some wonderful insights. For example, "rumors" are weapons of animals and ghosts, and we really shouldn't believe them. Another example is to check the place of origin, even if it is pretending to be fair, it is easy to raise suspicions, it is better to "can't believe it", otherwise people of the same nationality will certainly be afraid to declare on a piece of paper, and it is inconvenient for people of other nationalities to secretly help people of the same nationality. These "rumors" and "hearsays" are of course only worthy of bullshit!但是，西滢先生因为“未免偏袒一方”而遂叹为“可惜”，仍是引用“流言”，我却以为是“可惜”的事。清朝的县官坐堂，往往两造各责小板五百完案，“偏袒”之嫌是没有了，可是终于不免为胡涂虫。假使一个人还有是非之心，倒不如直说的好；否则，虽然吞吞吐吐，明眼人也会看出他暗中“偏袒”那一方，所表白的不过是自己的阴险和卑劣。宣言中所谓“若离若合，殊有混淆黑白之嫌”者，似乎也就是为此辈的手段写照。而且所谓“挑剔风潮”的“流言”，说不定就是这些伏在暗中，轻易不大露面的东西所制造的，但我自然也“没有调查详细的事实，不大知道”。可惜的是西滢先生虽说“还是不信”，却已为我辈“可惜”，足见流言之易于惑人，无怪常有人用作武器。但在我，却直到看见这《闲话》之后，才知道西滢先生们原来“常常”听到这样的流言，并且和我偶尔听到的都不对。可见流言也有种种，某种流言，大抵是奔凑到某种耳朵，写出在某种笔下的。
However, Mr. Xiying sighed as "a pity" because he "inevitably took sides", and still quoted "rumors", but I thought it was a "pity". The county officials of the Qing Dynasty often blamed each for completing the case with 500 small boards, and the suspicion of "favoritism" was gone, but in the end, it was inevitable to be a Hu Tu worm. If a person still has a heart of right and wrong, it is better to speak directly; Otherwise, although he hesitated, a discerning person would also see that he was secretly "favoring" the other side, and what he confessed was only his own insidiousness and despicability. The so-called "if they are separated or combined, there is a suspicion of confusing black and white", seems to be a portrayal of the methods of this generation. Moreover, the so-called "rumors" of the "picky trend" may be created by these things that are hidden in the dark and do not show up easily, but naturally I "did not investigate the detailed facts, so I didn't know". It is a pity that although Mr. Xiying said "I still don't believe it", he has been "sorry" for our generation, which shows that rumors are easy to confuse, and it is no wonder that people often use them as weapons. But it wasn't until I saw this "gossip" that I realized that Mr. Xiying had heard such rumors "often", and it was not the same as what I occasionally heard. It can be seen that there are all kinds of rumors, and some rumors are probably rushed to some kind of ear and written in a certain pen.但在《闲话》的前半，即西滢先生还未在报上看见七个教员的宣言之前，已经比学校为“臭毛厕”，主张“人人都有扫除的义务”了。为什么呢？一者报上两个相反的启事已经发现；二者学生把守校门；三者有“校长不能在学校开会，不得不借邻近的饭店招集教员开会的奇闻”。但这所述的“臭毛厕”的情形还得修改些，因为层次有点颠倒。据宣言说，则“饭店开会”，乃在“把守校门”之前，大约西滢先生觉得不“最精彩”，所以没有摘录，或者已经写好，所以不及摘录的罢。现在我来补摘几句，并且也加些圈子，聊以效颦——
But in the first half of "Gossip", that is, before Mr. Xiying saw the declaration of the seven teachers in the newspaper, he had already compared the school to a "stinky toilet" and advocated that "everyone has the obligation to clean it". Why? One reported that two opposite notices had been discovered; second, students guard the school gate; The three include "the anecdote that the principal cannot hold a meeting at the school and has to use a nearby hotel to convene a meeting." But the situation of the "stinky toilet" mentioned in this article needs to be modified a bit, because the level is a bit reversed. According to the declaration, the "hotel meeting" was before "guarding the school gate", and Mr. Xiying felt that it was not "the most exciting", so he did not excerpt it, or it had already been written, so it was not as good as the excerpt. Now I will add a few sentences, and also add some circles to talk about the frown——“……迨五月七日校内讲演时，学生劝校长杨荫榆先生退席后，杨先生乃于饭馆召集校员若干燕饮，继即以评议会名义，将学生自治会职员六人揭示开除，由是全校哗然，有坚拒杨先生长校之事变。……”
“…… When the students persuaded the principal, Mr. Yang Yinyu, to leave the seat during the speech on May 7, Mr. Yang summoned a number of school members to drink in the restaurant, and then in the name of the council, he revealed and expelled six staff members of the Student Government Association. ……”《闲话》里的和这事实的颠倒，从神经过敏的看起来，或者也可以认为“偏袒”的表现；但我在这里并非举证，不过聊作插话而已。其实，“偏袒”两字，因我适值选得不大堂皇，所以使人厌观，倘用别的字，便会大大的两样。况且，即使是自以为公平的批评家，“偏袒”也在所不免的，譬如和校长同籍贯，或是好朋友，或是换帖兄弟，或是叨过酒饭，每不免于不知不觉间有所“偏袒”。这也算人情之常，不足深怪；但当侃侃而谈之际，那自然也许流露出来。然而也没有什么要紧，局外人那里会知道这许多底细呢，无伤大体的。
The reversal of this fact in "Gossip" looks like a nervous person, or it can also be considered a manifestation of "favoritism"; But I'm not here to provide evidence, I'm just interjecting. In fact, the word "favoritism" is annoying because I chose it at the right time, so it is annoying, and if I use other words, it will be very different. Moreover, even critics who think they are fair are inevitably "favored", such as being from the same place of origin as the principal, or being a good friend, or changing brothers, or having eaten and drinking, and they are inevitably "favored" unconsciously. This is also a common occurrence, not surprising; But when talking eloquently, it may naturally be revealed. However, it doesn't matter, outsiders will know these many details, it doesn't hurt the big picture.但是学校的变成“臭毛厕”，却究竟在“饭店召集教员”之后，酒醉饭饱，毛厕当然合用了。西滢先生希望“教育当局”打扫，我以为在打扫之前，还须先封饭店，否则醉饱之后，总要拉矢，毛厕即永远需用，怎么打扫得干净？而且，还未打扫之前，不是已经有了“流言”了么？流言之力，是能使粪便增光，蛆虫成圣的，打扫夫又怎么动手？姑无论现在有无打扫夫。
However, the school became a "stinky toilet", but after the "hotel called the teachers", the drunk and full of food, the toilet was of course suitable. Mr. Xiying hopes that the "education authorities" will clean, I think that before cleaning, the hotel must be sealed first, otherwise after getting drunk and full, there will always be a pull, and the wool toilet will always be used, how to clean it? Moreover, before cleaning, isn't there already a "rumor"? The power of rumors can make feces brighter and maggots sanctified, so how can the cleaner do it? Whether you have a cleaner or not.至于“万不可再敷衍下去”，那可实在是斩钉截铁的办法。正应该这样办。但是，世上虽然有斩钉截铁的办法，却很少见有敢负责任的宣言。所多的是自在黑幕中，偏说不知道；替暴君奔走，却以局外人自居；满肚子怀着鬼胎，而装出公允的笑脸；有谁明说出自己所观察的是非来的，他便用了“流言”来作不负责任的武器：这种蛆虫充满的“臭毛厕”，是难于打扫干净的。丢尽“教育界的面目”的丑态，现在和将来还多着哩！
As for "no more perfunctory", it is really a categorical method. That's exactly what it should be. However, although there are categorical methods in the world, there are few responsible declarations. What is more is that I am free in the shady scene, and I don't know; running for the tyrant, but thinking of himself as an outsider; full of ghostly fetuses, and pretending to be fair smiling; Whoever clearly states the right and wrong of what he observes, he uses "rumors" as an irresponsible weapon: this maggot-filled "stinky toilet" is difficult to clean. The ugliness of losing the "face of the education industry" is still and will be more!五月三十日。
May 30.

我的“籍”和“系”

我的“籍”和“系”

我的“籍”和“系”

My "Nationality" and "Department"虽然因为我劝过人少——或者竟不——读中国书，曾蒙一位不相识的青年先生赐信要我搬出中国去，但是我终于没有走。而且我究竟是中国人，读过中国书的，因此也颇知道些处世的妙法。譬如，假使要掉文袋，可以说说“桃红柳绿”，这些事是大家早已公认的，谁也不会说你错。如果论史，就赞几句孔明，骂一通秦桧，这些是非也早经论定，学述一回决没有什么差池；况且秦太师的党羽现已半个无存，也可保毫无危险。至于近事呢，勿谈为佳，否则连你的籍贯也许会使你由可“尊敬”而变为“可惜”的。
Although I had advised few people to read Chinese books, I was once given a letter from a young gentleman I didn't know to move out of China, but I didn't leave. And I am Chinese, I have read Chinese books, so I know some wonderful ways to live in the world. For example, if you want to drop your stationery, you can say "peach red and willow green", these things have long been recognized by everyone, and no one will say that you are wrong. If you talk about history, just praise a few words of Kongming and scold Qin Hui, these rights and wrongs have already been discussed, and there is no mistake in learning and narrative; Moreover, half of Qin Taishi's henchmen are now gone, and there is no danger. As for recent events, it is better not to talk about them, otherwise even your place of origin may make you change from "respectable" to "pitiful".我记得宋朝是不许南人做宰相的，那是他们的“祖制”，只可惜终于不能坚持。至于“某籍”人说不得话，却是我近来的新发见。也还是女师大的风潮，我说了几句话。但我先要声明，我既然说过，颇知道些处世的妙法，为什么又去说话呢？那是，因为，我是见过清末捣乱的人，没有生长在太平盛世，所以纵使颇有些涵养工夫，有时也不免要开口，客气地说，就是大不“安分”的。于是乎我说话了，不料陈西滢先生早已常常听到一种“流言”，那大致是“女师大的风潮，有北京教育界占最大势力的某籍某系的人在暗中鼓动”。现在我一说话，恰巧化“暗”为“明”，就使这常常听到流言的西滢先生代为“可惜”，虽然他存心忠厚，“自然还是不信平素所很尊敬的人会暗中挑剔风潮”；无奈“流言”却“更加传布得厉害了”，这怎不使人“怀疑”呢？自然是难怪的。
I remember that the Song Dynasty did not allow southerners to be prime ministers, which was their "ancestral system", but unfortunately it could not be adhered to in the end. As for the "certain nationality" people who can't speak, it is my recent discovery. It is still a trend at the Women's Normal University, and I said a few words. But I want to declare first, since I have said that I know some wonderful ways to live in the world, why do I speak again? That's because, I have seen people who made trouble in the late Qing Dynasty, and they did not grow up in a peaceful and prosperous era, so even if they have a lot of self-cultivation, sometimes they can't help but speak, to put it politely, they are not "settled". So I spoke, but unexpectedly, Mr. Chen Xiying had already heard a kind of "rumor" from time to time, which was roughly "the trend of women's normal universities, and there were people from a certain department who accounted for the largest power in Beijing's education circles secretly agitating it." Now as soon as I speak, I happen to turn "dark" into "light", which makes Mr. Xiying, who often hears rumors, "pity" on behalf of Mr. Xiying, although he is loyal, "naturally I still don't believe that people I usually respect will secretly pick on the trend"; Helplessly, the "rumors" are "more spreadable", how can this not make people "suspicious"? Naturally, it's no wonder.我确有一个“籍”，也是各人各有一个的籍，不足为奇。但我是什么“系”呢？自己想想，既非“研究系”，也非“交通系”，真不知怎么一回事。只好再精查，细想；终于也明白了，现在写它出来，庶几乎免得又有“流言”，以为我是黑籍的政客。
I do have a "nationality", and it is not surprising that everyone has a nationality. But what is "yes"? Think about it yourself, it is neither a "research department" nor a "transportation department", I really don't know what is going on. I had to check and think about it carefully; Finally, I understand, and now that I write it, I will almost avoid "rumors" that I am a black politician.因为应付某国某君的嘱托，我正写了一点自己的履历，第一句是“我于一八八一年生在浙江省绍兴府城里一家姓周的家里”，这里就说明了我的“籍”。但自从到了“可惜”的地位之后，我便又在末尾添上一句道，“近几年我又兼做北京大学，师范大学，女子师范大学的国文系讲师”，这大概就是我的“系”了。我真不料我竟成了这样的一个“系”。
Because of the entrustment of a certain country and a certain king, I am writing a little bit of my resume, the first sentence is "I was born in 1881 in a family surnamed Zhou in Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang Province", which explains my "nationality". But since I reached the status of "pity", I added a sentence at the end, "In recent years, I have also been a lecturer in the Department of Chinese Literature at Peking University, Normal University, and Women's Normal University", which is probably my "department". I really didn't expect me to become such a "department".我常常要“挑剔”文字是确的，至于“挑剔风潮”这一种连字面都不通的阴谋，我至今还不知道是怎样的做法。何以一有流言，我就得沉默，否则立刻犯了嫌疑，至于使和我毫不相干的人如西滢先生者也来代为“可惜”呢？那么，如果流言说我正在钻营，我就得自己锁在房里了；如果流言说我想做皇帝，我就得连忙自称奴才了。然而古人却确是这样做过了，还留下些什么“空穴来风，桐乳来巢”的鬼格言。可惜我总不耐烦敬步后尘；不得已，我只好对于无论是谁，先奉还他无端送给我的“尊敬”。
I often have to "criticize" the text to be true, but as for the "picky trend", a conspiracy that doesn't even make sense literally, I still don't know what kind of practice it is. Why do I have to be silent as soon as there are rumors, otherwise I will immediately be suspected, and as for making people who have nothing to do with me like Mr. Xiying also come to say "pity"? Then, if rumors say I'm drilling camp, I'll have to lock myself in the room; If rumors say I want to be emperor, I have to quickly call myself a servant. However, the ancients did do this, and left behind some ghost adage of "groundless wind, tung milk comes to nest". It's a pity that I am always impatient to follow in my footsteps; As a last resort, I had to return the "respect" he gave me for no reason, no matter who it was.其实，现今的将“尊敬”来布施和拜领的人们，也就都是上了古人的当。我们的乏的古人想了几千年，得到一个制驭别人的巧法：可压服的将他压服，否则将他抬高。而抬高也就是一种压服的手段，常常微微示意说，你应该这样，倘不，我要将你摔下来了。求人尊敬的可怜虫于是默默地坐着；但偶然也放开喉咙道“有利必有弊呀！”“彼亦一是非，此亦一是非呀！”“猗欤休哉呀！”听众遂亦同声赞叹道，“对呀对呀，可敬极了呀！”这样的互相敷衍下去，自己以为有趣。
In fact, today's people who "respect" to give and worship are all fooled by the ancients. Our poor ancients thought for thousands of years and came up with a clever way to control others: to suppress those who can subdue him, otherwise to raise him up. And lifting is also a means of subduing, often slightly signaling that you should do this, if not, I will throw you down. The poor wretched begging for respect sat silently; But accidentally let go of his throat and said, "There must be pros and cons!" "He is also right and wrong, and this is also right and wrong!" "Oh no! The audience also praised in unison, "Yes, yes, it's very respectable!" "This kind of perfunctory mutual perfunctory makes me think it's interesting.从此这一个办法便成为八面锋，杀掉了许多乏人和白痴，但是穿了圣贤的衣冠入殓。可怜他们竟不知道自己将褒贬他的人们的身价估得太大了，反至于连自己的原价也一同失掉。
Since then, this method has become an eight-faced front, killing many people and idiots, but wearing the clothes of sages and burial. It's a pity that they don't know that they have overestimated the value of those who praise and criticize him, and even their original price has been lost.人类是进化的，现在的人心，当然比古人的高洁；但是“尊敬”的流毒，却还不下于流言，尤其是有谁装腔作势，要来将这撒去时，更足使乏人和白痴惶恐。我本来也无可尊敬；也不愿受人尊敬，免得不如人意的时候，又被人摔下来。更明白地说罢：我所憎恶的太多了，应该自己也得到憎恶，这才还有点像活在人间；如果收得的乃是相反的布施，于我倒是一个冷嘲，使我对于自己也要大加侮蔑；如果收得的是吞吞吐吐的不知道算什么，则使我感到将要呕哕似的恶心。然而无论如何，“流言”总不能吓哑我的嘴……。
Human beings are evolving, and the current human heart is of course nobler than the ancients; But the poison of "respect" is no less than rumors, especially when someone pretends to spread it, it is enough to make the poor and idiots fearful. I was not respectable; I don't want to be respected, lest I be thrown down again when I am not satisfied. To put it more clearly: I hate too much, and I should get it myself, which is a bit like living in the world; If what I receive is the opposite of almsgiving, it is a cynicism to me, and I have to despise myself as well; If what I received was hesitation and I didn't know what it was, it made me feel nauseous as if I was about to vomit. However, in any case, "rumors" cannot scare my mouth .......六月二日晨。

咬文嚼字

Chew the words三
Three自从世界上产生了“须知学校犹家庭”的名论之后，颇使我觉得惊奇，想考查这家庭的组织。后来，幸而在《国立北京女子师范大学校长杨荫榆对于暴烈学生之感言》中，发见了“与此曹子勃谿相向”这一句话，才算得到一点头绪：校长和学生的关系是“犹”之“妇姑”。于是据此推断，以为教员都是杂凑在杨府上的西宾，将这结论在《语丝》上发表。“可惜”！昨天偶然在《晨报》上拜读“该校哲教系教员兼代主任汪懋祖以彼之意见书投寄本报”的话，这才知道我又错了，原来都是弟兄，而且现正“相煎益急”，像曹操的儿子阿丕和阿植似的。
Since the famous theory of "school is like a family" has emerged in the world, I am quite surprised and want to examine the organization of this family. Later, fortunately, in the "Speech of Yang Yinyu, President of National Beijing Women's Normal University, to the Violent Students", I found the sentence "Facing this Cao Ziboxi", and I got a little clue: the relationship between the principal and the students is "Like" and "mother-in-law". So based on this, it was inferred that the instructors were all Xi Bin mixed in the Yang Mansion, and published this conclusion in "Yusi". "It's a pity"! Yesterday, I happened to read in the "Morning Post" that "Wang Maozu, a teacher and acting director of the school's Department of Philosophy and Education, sent his opinion to this newspaper", and then I realized that I was wrong again, it turned out that they were all brothers, and now they were "boiling each other more and more", like Cao Cao's sons Ah Pi and Ah Zhi.但是，尚希原谅，我于引用的原文上都不加圈了。只因为我不想圈，并非文章坏。
However, I hope to forgive you, I have not circled the original text I quoted. Just because I don't want to circle, it's not that the article is bad.据考据家说，这曹子建的《七步诗》是假的。但也没有什么大相干，姑且利用它来活剥一首，替豆萁伸冤：
According to the researchers, Cao Zijian's "Seven Steps Poem" is fake. But it doesn't matter much, let's use it to peel a piece alive and seek justice for Dou Qi:煮豆燃豆萁，萁在釜下泣——Boiling beans and burning beans, Qi cried under the pot - 我烬你熟了，正好办教席！ I'm cooked, just in time to set up a teaching chair!

Suddenly thought十
Ten无论是谁，只要站在“辩诬”的地位的，无论辩白与否，都已经是屈辱。更何况受了实际的大损害之后，还得来辩诬。
No matter who stands in the position of "defense", whether it is defended or not, it is already a humiliation. What's more, after suffering great actual damage, they have to defend themselves.我们的市民被上海租界的英国巡捕击杀了，我们并不还击，却先来赶紧洗刷牺牲者的罪名。说道我们并非“赤化”，因为没有受别国的煽动；说道我们并非“暴徒”，因为都是空手，没有兵器的。我不解为什么中国人如果真使中国赤化，真在中国暴动，就得听英捕来处死刑？记得新希腊人也曾用兵器对付过国内的土耳其人，却并不被称为暴徒；俄国确已赤化多年了，也没有得到别国开枪的惩罚。而独有中国人，则市民被杀之后，还要皇皇然辩诬，张着含冤的眼睛，向世界搜求公道。
Our citizens were killed by the British patrols in the Shanghai Concession, and we did not fight back, but came first to clear the victims' names. said that we are not "red", because we are not incited by other countries; said that we are not "thugs" because we are all empty-handed and unweaponed. I don't understand why if the Chinese really turn China red and really riot in China, they have to listen to the British arrest and sentence them to death? I remember that the New Greeks also used weapons against the Turks in the country, but they were not called thugs; Russia has indeed been red for many years, and it has not been punished by other countries to shoot. Only the Chinese, after the citizens were killed, they still had to defend themselves, open their eyes with grievances, and seek justice from the world.其实，这原由是很容易了然的，就因为我们并非暴徒，并未赤化的缘故。
In fact, the reason for this is easy to understand, because we are not thugs and have not turned red.因此我们就觉得含冤，大叫着伪文明的破产。可是文明是向来如此的，并非到现在才将假面具揭下来。只因为这样的损害，以前是别民族所受，我们不知道，或者是我们原已屡次受过，现在都已忘却罢了。公道和武力合为一体的文明，世界上本未出现，那萌芽或者只在几个先驱者和几群被迫压民族的脑中。但是，当自己有了力量的时候，却往往离而为二了。
Therefore, we feel wronged and shout about the bankruptcy of pseudo-civilization. But civilization has always been like this, and it is not until now that the mask has been removed. Just because such damage was suffered by other ethnic groups before, we don't know, or we have suffered it many times, and now we have forgotten it. A civilization that integrates justice and force has never appeared in the world, and it may only be in the brains of a few pioneers and a few groups of forced nations. However, when you have strength, you are often separated.但英国究竟有真的文明人存在。今天，我们已经看见各国无党派智识阶级劳动者所组织的国际工人后援会，大表同情于中国的《致中国国民宣言》了。列名的人，英国就有培那特萧（Bernard Shaw），中国的留心世界文学的人大抵知道他的名字；法国则巴尔布斯（Henri Barbusse），中国也曾译过他的作品。他的母亲却是英国人；或者说，因此他也富有实行的质素，法国作家所常有的享乐的气息，在他的作品中是丝毫也没有的。现在都出而为中国鸣不平了，所以我觉得英国人的品性，我们可学的地方还多着，——但自然除了捕头，商人，和看见学生的游行而在屋顶拍手嘲笑的娘儿们。
But there are really civilized people in Britain. Today, we have seen the International Workers' Support Association, organized by non-partisan intellectual class workers in various countries, expressing their sympathy for China's "Declaration to the Chinese People". Among the people on the list, there is Bernard Shaw in the UK, and most people in China who pay attention to world literature know his name; In France, Henri Barbusse has also translated his works in China. His mother was British; In other words, he is therefore also rich in practical quality, and the hedonistic atmosphere that French writers often have is not at all present in his works. Now they are all complaining about China, so I think there is still a lot to learn from the character of the British,—— but naturally in addition to headcatchers, businessmen, and women who clap their hands and laugh at the students on the rooftops.我并非说我们应该做“爱敌若友”的人，不过说我们目下委实并没有认谁作敌。近来的文字中，虽然偶有“认清敌人”这些话，那是行文过火的毛病。倘有敌人，我们就早该抽刃而起，要求“以血偿血”了。而现在我们所要求的是什么呢？辩诬之后，不过想得点轻微的补偿；那办法虽说有十几条，总而言之，单是“不相往来”，成为“路人”而已。虽是对于本来极密的友人，怕也不过如此罢。
I am not saying that we should be people who "love enemies as friends", but I am saying that we do not recognize anyone as an enemy at the moment. In recent texts, although there are occasional words such as "recognize the enemy", it is a problem of excessive writing. If there is an enemy, we should have risen up long ago and demanded "blood for blood". And what are we asking for now? After the defense, I just want to get some slight compensation; Although there are more than a dozen methods, all in all, it is just "not communicating" and becoming a "passerby". Although it is for a close friend, I am afraid it is just like this.然而将实话说出来，就是：因为公道和实力还没有合为一体，而我们只抓得了公道，所以满眼是友人，即使他加了任意的杀戮。
However, to tell the truth, that is: because justice and strength have not yet been combined, and we can only catch justice, our eyes are full of friends, even if he kills arbitrarily.如果我们永远只有公道，就得永远着力于辩诬，终身空忙碌。这几天有些纸贴在墙上，仿佛叫人勿看《顺天时报》似的。我从来就不大看这报，但也并非“排外”，实在因为它的好恶，每每和我的很不同。然而也间有很确，为中国人自己不肯说的话。大概两三年前，正值一种爱国运动的时候罢，偶见一篇它的社论，大意说，一国当衰弊之际，总有两种意见不同的人。一是民气论者，侧重国民的气概，一是民力论者，专重国民的实力。前者多则国家终亦渐弱，后者多则将强。我想，这是很不错的；而且我们应该时时记得的。
If we always have only justice, we must always focus on defense and be busy for the rest of our lives. In the past few days, some paper has been pasted on the wall, as if telling people not to read the "Shuntian Times". I have never read this newspaper, but it is not "xenophobic", because its likes and dislikes are always very different from mine. However, there are also things that the Chinese themselves refuse to say. About two or three years ago, during the time of a patriotic movement, I occasionally saw an editorial of it, to the effect that when a country is in decline, there are always two people with different opinions. One is the popular spirit theorist, focusing on the spirit of the people, and the other is the people's power theory, focusing on the strength of the people. If there are more formers, the country will eventually become weaker, and if there are more latter, it will become stronger. I think this is very good; And we should always remember it.可惜中国历来就独多民气论者，到现在还如此。如果长此不改，“再而衰，三而竭”，将来会连辩诬的精力也没有了。所以在不得已而空手鼓舞民气时，尤必须同时设法增长国民的实力，还要永远这样的干下去。
Unfortunately, China has always had many popular people, and it is still the case. If this does not change for a long time, "then decline, three and exhausted", in the future there will be no energy to defend and slander. Therefore, when we have no choice but to boost the people's morale, we must try to increase the strength of the people at the same time, and we must continue to do this forever.因此，中国青年负担的烦重，就数倍于别国的青年了。因为我们的古人将心力大抵用到玄虚漂渺平稳圆滑上去了，便将艰难切实的事情留下，都待后人来补做，要一人兼做两三人，四五人，十百人的工作，现在可正到了试练的时候了。对手又是坚强的英人，正是他山的好石，大可以借此来磨练。假定现今觉悟的青年的平均年龄为二十，又假定照中国人易于衰老的计算，至少也还可以共同抗拒，改革，奋斗三十年。不够，就再一代，二代……。这样的数目，从个体看来，仿佛是可怕的，但倘若这一点就怕，便无药可救，只好甘心灭亡。因为在民族的历史上，这不过是一个极短时期，此外实没有更快的捷径。我们更无须迟疑，只是试练自己，自求生存，对谁也不怀恶意的干下去。
Therefore, the burden on Chinese youth is several times that of young people in other countries. Because our ancients mostly used their mental strength to the mysterious and mysterious and smooth and smooth, they left the difficult and practical things to be made up for by future generations, and one person had to do the work of two or three, four or five, ten or a hundred people, and now it was time to try. The opponent is a strong British, and he is a good stone in his mountain, which can be used to hone him. Assuming that the average age of today's enlightened youth is 20, and assuming that according to the calculation of Chinese prone to aging, they can at least resist, reform, and struggle together for 30 years. If it is not enough, it will be another generation, the second generation ....... Such a number seems terrible from the individual's point of view, but if this is fearful, there is no cure, and it has to perish willingly. Because in the history of the nation, this is only a very short period, and there is really no faster shortcut. We don't need to hesitate, just test ourselves, seek to survive, and do it without malice to anyone.但足以破灭这运动的持续的危机，在目下就有三样：一是日夜偏注于表面的宣传，鄙弃他事；二是对同类太操切，稍有不合，便呼之为国贼，为洋奴；三是有许多巧人，反利用机会，来猎取自己目前的利益。
But there are three things that are enough to break the ongoing crisis of this movement: first, day and night focus on superficial propaganda and despise other things; second, they are too rigid about their own kind, and if they disagree with each other, they will be called national thieves and foreign slaves; Third, there are many clever people who take advantage of opportunities to hunt for their current interests.六月十一日。

Eleven1　急不择言
1 Hurry up and don't say anything“急不择言”的病源，并不在没有想的工夫，而在有工夫的时候没有想。
The source of the disease of "haste and unscrupulousness" is not that there is no time to think, but that there is no time to think when there is time.上海的英国捕头残杀市民之后，我们就大惊愤，大嚷道：伪文明人的真面目显露了！那么，足见以前还以为他们有些真文明。然而中国有枪阶级的焚掠平民，屠杀平民，却向来不很有人抗议。莫非因为动手的是“国货”，所以连残杀也得欢迎；还是我们原是真野蛮，所以自己杀几个自家人就不足为奇呢？
After the British in Shanghai killed the citizens, we were shocked and shouted: The true face of the pseudo-civilized people has been revealed! Then, it shows that they thought they were some real civilization before. However, there has never been much protest against the burning and massacre of civilians by the gun class in China. 中国老例，凡要排斥异己的时候，常给对手起一个诨名，——或谓之“绰号”。这也是明清以来讼师的老手段；假如要控告张三李四，倘只说姓名，本很平常，现在却道“六臂太岁张三”，“白额虎李四”，则先不问事迹，县官只见绰号，就觉得他们是恶棍了。
In China, when you want to exclude dissidents, you often give your opponent a nickname,—— or a "nickname". This is also the old method of litigators since the Ming and Qing dynasties; If you want to sue Zhang San and Li Si, if you only say the name, it is very ordinary, but now you say "Six-armed Tai Sui Zhang San" and "Bai Frontal Tiger Li Si", then you don't ask about the deeds, and the county magistrate only sees the nickname, and thinks they are villains.月球只一面对着太阳，那一面我们永远不得见。歌颂中国文明的也惟以光明的示人，隐匿了黑的一面。譬如说到家族亲旧，书上就有许多好看的形容词：慈呀，爱呀，悌呀，……又有许多好看的古典：五世同堂呀，礼门呀，义宗呀，……至于诨名，却藏在活人的心中，隐僻的书上。最简单的打官司教科书《萧曹遗笔》里就有着不少惯用的恶谥，现在钞一点在这里，省得自己做文章——
The moon only faces the sun on one side, and we will never see that side. those who praise Chinese civilization only show people with light and hide the dark side. For example, when it comes to family relatives and friends, there are many beautiful adjectives in the book: kindness, love, brotherhood,...... There are also many beautiful classics: the five generations are in the same hall, the gate of ceremony, and the Yizong,...... As for the nickname, it is hidden in the hearts of the living, in hidden books. The simplest lawsuit textbook "Xiao Cao's Posthumous Writings" has a lot of customary bad posthumous titles, and now a little money is here, so you don't have to make a fuss about yourself——

There are no parents, which cannot be sued, because most of the dynasties have "ruled the world with filial piety".这一种手段也不独讼师有。民国元年章太炎先生在北京，好发议论，而且毫无顾忌地褒贬。常常被贬的一群人于是给他起了一个绰号，曰“章疯子”。其人既是疯子，议论当然是疯话，没有价值的了，但每有言论，也仍在他们的报章上登出来，不过题目特别，道：《章疯子大发其疯》。有一回，他可是骂到他们的反对党头上去了。那怎么办呢？第二天报上登出来的时候，那题目是：《章疯子居然不疯》。
This method is not unique to litigators. In the first year of the Republic of China, Mr. Zhang Taiyan was in Beijing, easy to discuss, and praised and criticized without scruples. A group of people who were often demoted gave him a nickname, called "Zhang Madman". Since he is a madman, of course the discussion is crazy and worthless, but every time he makes a statement, it is still published in their newspaper, but the title is special, saying: "Zhang Madman Goes Crazy". Once, he scolded their opposition party. So what to do? When it was published in the newspaper the next day, the title was: "Zhang Crazy Man is Not Crazy".往日看《鬼谷子》，觉得其中的谋略也没有什么出奇，独有《飞箝》中的“可箝而从，可箝而横，……可引而反，可引而覆。虽覆能复，不失其度”这一段里的一句“虽覆能复”很有些可怕。但这一种手段，我们在社会上是时常遇见的。
In the past, when I watched "Guiguzi", I felt that there was nothing surprising about the strategy, only the "can be clamped and followed, but can be clamped and horizontal,...... It can be reversed, and it can be overturned. Although it can be recovered, it does not lose its degree" The sentence "although it can be recovered" is a bit scary. But this is a means that we often encounter in society.
《鬼谷子》自然是伪书，决非苏秦张仪的老师所作；但作者也决不是“小人”，倒是一个老实人。宋的来鹄已经说，“捭阖飞箝，今之常态，不读鬼谷子书者，皆得自然符契也。”人们常用，不以为奇，作者知道了一点，便笔之于书，当作秘诀，可见禀性纯厚，不但手段，便是心里的机诈也并不多。如果是大富翁，他肯将十元钞票嵌在镜屏里当宝贝么？
"Guiguzi" is naturally a pseudo-book, and it was by no means written by Su Qin Zhang Yi's teacher; But the author is by no means a "villain", but an honest person. Song's Lai Hu has already said, "Shutting down and flying, the norm today, those who do not read Guiguzi's book, are all natural talismans." People often use it, not surprisingly, the author knows a little, so he writes it in the book as a secret, which shows that the innate nature is pure, not only the means, but also the cunning in the heart is not much. If he was a monopoly, would he be willing to embed a ten-dollar bill in the mirror screen as a treasure?鬼谷子所以究竟不是阴谋家，否则，他还该说得吞吞吐吐些；或者自己不说，而钩出别人来说；或者并不必钩出别人来说，而自己永远阔不可言。这末后的妙法，知者不言，书上也未见，所以我不知道，倘若知道，就不至于老在灯下编《莽原》，做《补白》了。
Guiguzi is not a conspirator after all, otherwise, he should have said hesitantly; or they don't say it themselves, but hook out others; Or you don't have to hook others out, and you will never be able to speak of yourself. This last wonderful method, those who know do not speak, and it is not seen in the book, so I don't know, if I knew, I would not always make up "Mangyuan" under the lamp and do "Supplement".但各种小纵横，我们总常要身受，或者目睹。夏天的忽而甲乙相打；忽而甲乙相亲，同去打丙；忽而甲丙相合，又同去打乙，忽而甲丙又互打起来，就都是这“覆”“复”作用；化数百元钱，请一回酒，许多人立刻变了色彩，也还是这顽意儿。然而真如来鹄所说，现在的人们是已经“是乃天授，非人力也”的；倘使要看了《鬼谷子》才能，就如拿着文法书去和外国人谈天一样，一定要碰壁。
But all kinds of small traits, we always have to experience or witness. In summer, A and B suddenly fight; Suddenly, A and B went on a blind date, and they went to play C together; Suddenly A and C are combined, and they go to fight B together, and suddenly A and C fight each other, which is the effect of "covering" and "repetition"; Hundreds of yuan, please drink, many people immediately change color, and they are still stubborn. However, as the true Tathagata said, people today are already "gifted by heaven, not by manpower"; If you want to read "Guiguzi", it is like taking a grammar book to talk to foreigners, you must hit a wall.七月一日。
July 1st.

补白

三

补白

Three离五卅事件的发生已有四十天，北京的情形就像五月二十九日一样。聪明的批评家大概快要提出照例的“五分钟热度”说来了罢，虽然也有过例外：曾将汤尔和先生的大门“打得擂鼓一般，足有十五分钟之久。”（见六月二十三日《晨报》）有些学生们也常常引这“五分热”说自诫，仿佛早经觉到了似的。
It has been 40 days since the May 30th Incident, and the situation in Beijing is the same as on May 29. The clever critic was probably about to come up with the usual "five-minute heat", although there were exceptions: he had beaten Mr. Tom's door "like a drum for fifteen minutes." (See the "Morning Post" on June 23) Some students often quote this "five-point fever" to admonish themselves, as if they have sensed it early.但是，中国的老先生们——连二十岁上下的老先生们都算在内——不知怎的总有一种矛盾的意见，就是将女人孩子看得太低，同时又看得太高。妇孺是上不了场面的；然而一面又拜才女，捧神童，甚至于还想借此结识一个阔亲家，使自己也连类飞黄腾达。什么木兰从军，缇萦救父，更其津津乐道，以显示自己倒是一个死不挣气的瘟虫。对于学生也是一样，既要他们“莫谈国事”，又要他们独退番兵，退不了，就冷笑他们无用。
But the old gentlemen of China—even those in their twenties—somehow always have a contradictory opinion that they think too low of women and children, and at the same time too high. Women and children can't be on the scene; However, on the one hand, he worships talented women, praises prodigies, and even wants to use this to get acquainted with a broad in-law, so that he can also soar. What Mulan joined the army, Ti Ying saved her father, and talked about it even more, to show that she was a plague who didn't get angry. The same is true for students, not only asking them to "don't talk about state affairs", but also asking them to withdraw the troops alone, and if they can't retreat, they sneer at them for being useless.倘在教育普及的国度里，国民十之九是学生；但在中国，自然还是一个特别种类。虽是特别种类，却究竟是“束发小生”，所以当然不会有三头六臂的大神力。他们所能做的，也无非是演讲，游行，宣传之类，正如火花一样，在民众的心头点火，引起他们的光焰来，使国势有一点转机。倘若民众并没有可燃性，则火花只能将自身烧完，正如在马路上焚纸人轿马，暂时引得几个人闲看，而终于毫不相干，那热闹至多也不过如“打门”之久。谁也不动，难道“小生”们真能自己来打枪铸炮，造兵舰，糊飞机，活擒番将，平定番邦么？所以这“五分热”是地方病，不是学生病。这已不是学生的耻辱，而是全国民的耻辱了；倘在别的有活力，有生气的国度里，现象该不至于如此的。外人不足责，而本国的别的灰冷的民众，有权者，袖手旁观者，也都于事后来嘲笑，实在是无耻而且昏庸！
If in a country where education is popular, nine out of ten citizens are students; But in China, it is naturally a special species. Although it is a special species, it is a "bundled hair", so of course there will be no great divine power with three heads and six arms. All they can do is give speeches, parades, propaganda, etc., just like a spark, ignite the hearts of the people, arouse their flames, and make the country turn around a little. If the people are not flammable, the spark can only burn itself, just like burning paper people and sedan chairs on the road, temporarily attracting a few people to watch, and finally it has nothing to do with it, and the excitement is at most like "knocking on the door" for a long time. No one moved, could the "little students" really come to shoot guns and cannons, build warships, paste airplanes, capture Fan generals alive, and pacify Fanbang by themselves? Therefore, this "five-point fever" is an endemic disease, not a student disease. This is no longer a shame for students, but a shame for the whole people; If it were in other vibrant and vibrant countries, the phenomenon would not be like this. Outsiders are not to blame, and other gray and cold people in their own country, those in power, and those who stand by and stand by, are also ridiculed after the incident, which is really shameless and mediocre!但是，别有所图的聪明人又作别论，便是真诚的学生们，我以为自身却有一个颇大的错误，就是正如旁观者所希望或冷笑的一样：开首太自以为有非常的神力，有如意的成功。幻想飞得太高，堕在现实上的时候，伤就格外沉重了；力气用得太骤，歇下来的时候，身体就难于动弹了。为一般计，或者不如知道自己所有的不过是“人力”，倒较为切实可靠罢。
However, smart people with other plans are not to mention, that is, sincere students, I think I have made a big mistake, that is, just as the bystanders hope or sneer: at the beginning they think they have great divine power and have the desired success. When the fantasy flies too high and falls into reality, the injury is particularly heavy; If you use too much strength, when you rest, it will be difficult for your body to move. For the sake of generality, it may be better to know that all you have is "manpower", which is more practical and reliable.现在，从读书以至“寻异性朋友讲情话”，似乎都为有些有志者所诟病了。但我想，责人太严，也正是“五分热”的一个病源。譬如自己要择定一种口号——例如不买英日货——来履行，与其不饮不食的履行七日或痛哭流涕的履行一月，倒不如也看书也履行至五年，或者也看戏也履行至十年，或者也寻异性朋友也履行至五十年，或者也讲情话也履行至一百年。记得韩非子曾经教人以竞马的要妙，其一是“不耻最后”。即使慢，驰而不息，纵令落后，纵令失败，但一定可以达到他所向的目标。
Now, from reading to "looking for friends of the opposite sex to talk about love", it seems to be criticized by some aspirants. But I think that being too strict with people is also a source of "five-point fever". For example, if you want to choose a slogan—for example, don't buy British and Japanese goods—to fulfill it, instead of not eating or drinking for seven days or crying bitterly for a month, it is better to read books for five years, or watch plays for ten years, or find friends of the opposite sex for fifty years, or talk about love for a hundred years. I remember that Han Feizi once taught people the secrets of horse racing, one of which is "not ashamed of the last". Even if he is slow and galloping, even if he falls behind or fails, he will definitely achieve his goal.七月八日。
July 8th.

Answer Mr. KSKS兄：
Brother KS:我很感谢你的殷勤的慰问，但对于你所愤慨的两点和几句结论，我却并不谓然，现在略说我的意见——
I am very grateful for your kind condolences, but I do not think so, and now I will briefly express my opinion -第一，章士钊将我免职，我倒并没有你似的觉得诧异，他那对于学校的手段，我也并没有你似的觉得诧异，因为我本就没有预期章士钊能做出比现在更好的事情来。我们看历史，能够据过去以推知未来，看一个人的已往的经历，也有一样的效用。你先有了一种无端的迷信，将章士钊当作学者或智识阶级的领袖看，于是从他的行为上感到失望，发生不平，其实是作茧自缚；他这人本来就只能这样，有着更好的期望倒是你自己的误谬。使我较为感到有趣的倒是几个向来称为学者或教授的人们，居然也渐次吞吞吐吐地来说微温话了，什么“政潮”咧，“党”咧，仿佛他们都是上帝一样，超然象外，十分公平似的。谁知道人世上并没有这样一道矮墙，骑着而又两脚踏地，左右稳妥，所以即使吞吞吐吐，也还是将自己的魂灵枭首通衢，挂出了原想竭力隐瞒的丑态。丑态，我说，倒还没有什么丢人，丑态而蒙着公正的皮，这才催人呕吐。但终于使我觉得有趣的是蒙着公正的皮的丑态，又自己开出帐来发表了。仿佛世界上还有光明，所以即便费尽心机，结果仍然是一个瞒不住。
First, Zhang Shizhao dismissed me, I am not as surprised as you are, and I am not as surprised as you are about his methods for the school, because I did not expect Zhang Shizhao to do better things than now. When we look at history, we can infer the future based on the past, and it is also effective to look at a person's past experience. You first have an unfounded superstition, seeing Zhang Shizhao as a scholar or the leader of the intellectual class, so you are disappointed in his behavior. He can only be like this, and it is your own mistake to have better expectations. What I find more interesting is that a few people who have always been called scholars or professors have gradually spoken softly, what kind of "political tide" and "party" are muddled, as if they are all gods, transcendent and very fair. Who knew that there was no such low wall in the world, riding and stepping on the ground with both feet, left and right, so even if he hesitated, he still beheaded his soul on the street and hung up the ugliness that he wanted to hide. Ugliness, I said, is not anything to be ashamed of, ugliness and covered with a fair skin, which makes people vomit. But what finally found interesting to me was the ugliness of covering the skin of justice, and he opened his own account and published it. It seems that there is still light in the world, so even if you try your best, the result is still one that cannot be hidden.第二，你这样注意于《甲寅周刊》，也使我莫明其妙。《甲寅》第一次出版时，我想，大约章士钊还不过熟读了几十篇唐宋八大家文，所以模仿吞剥，看去还近于清通。至于这一回，却大大地退步了，关于内容的事且不说，即以文章论，就比先前不通得多，连成语也用不清楚，如“每下愈况”之类。尤其害事的是他似乎后来又念了几篇骈文，没有融化，而急于挦撦，所以弄得文字庞杂，有如泥浆混着沙砾一样。即如他那《停办北京女子师范大学呈文》中有云，“钊念儿女乃家家所有良用痛心为政而人人悦之亦无是理”，旁加密圈，想是得意之笔了。但比起何栻《齐姜醉遣晋公子赋》的“公子固翩翩绝世未免有情少年而碌碌因人安能成事”来，就显得字句和声调都怎样陋弱可哂。何栻比他高明得多，尚且不能入作者之林，章士钊的文章更于何处讨生活呢？况且，前载公文，接着就是通信，精神虽然是自己广告性的半官报，形式却成了公报尺牍合璧了，我中国自有文字以来，实在没有过这样滑稽体式的著作。这种东西，用处只有一种，就是可以借此看看社会的暗角落里，有着怎样灰色的人们，以为现在是攀附显现的时候了，也都吞吞吐吐的来开口。至于别的用处，我委实至今还想不出来。倘说这是复古运动的代表，那可是只见得复古派的可怜，不过以此当作讣闻，公布文言文的气绝罢了。
Second, your attention to "Jiayin Weekly" also makes me confused. When "Jiayin" was first published, I thought that Zhang Shizhao had only read dozens of the eight major texts of the Tang and Song dynasties, so imitating and swallowing and peeling looked close to Qingtong. As for this time, it has taken a big step back, not to mention the content, that is, in terms of articles, it is much more unclear than before, and even idioms are not used clearly, such as "every time it gets worse". What is particularly harmful is that he seems to have read a few more parallel texts later, but did not melt, but was in a hurry to get rid of them, so he made the words complicated, like mud mixed with sand. As he said in his "Submission on the Suspension of Beijing Women's Normal University", "It is unreasonable for Zhao to think that his children are all good people in the family, and everyone likes them". But compared with He Shi's "Qi Jiang Drunken Jin Gongzi Fu", "Gongzi is a peerless young man who is inevitably affectionate, and he can do things because of people", it seems that the words and tone are so ugly and weak. He Mushi is much smarter than him, and he can't enter the forest of authors, so where can Zhang Shizhao's articles make a living? Moreover, the first official document, followed by the correspondence, although the spirit is its own advertising semi-official newspaper, the form has become a combination of the communiqué and the ruler. This kind of thing has only one use, that is, it can be used to see what kind of gray people are in the dark corners of society, thinking that it is time to cling to and manifest, and they all hesitate to speak. As for other uses, I can't think of anything else. If this is a representative of the retro movement, it is only the pity of the retro school, but it is just an obituary to publish classical Chinese.所以，即使真如你所说，将有文言白话之争，我以为也该是争的终结，而非争的开头，因为《甲寅》不足称为敌手，也无所谓战斗。倘要开头，他们还得有一个更通古学，更长古文的人，才能胜对垒之任，单是现在似的每周印一回公牍和游谈的堆积，纸张虽白，圈点虽多，是毫无用处的。
Therefore, even if it is really as you said, there will be a dispute between the literary and vernacular, I think it should be the end of the dispute, not the beginning of the dispute, because "Jiayin" is not enough to be called an opponent, and it doesn't matter if it is a battle. If they want to start, they must have a person who is more knowledgeable in ancient studies and longer ancient texts in order to win the confrontation, just like the current pile of printing official documents and talks once a week, although the paper is white, although there are many circles, it is useless.鲁迅。八月二十日。
Lu Xun. August 20th.

“碰壁”之余

“碰壁”之余

“碰壁”之余

In addition to "hitting the wall"女师大事件在北京似乎竟颇算一个问题，号称“大报”如所谓《现代评论》者，居然也“评论”了好几次。据我所记得的，是先有“一个女读者”的一封信，无名小，不在话下。此后是两个作者的“评论”了：陈西滢先生在《闲话》之间评为“臭毛厕”，李仲揆先生的《在女师大观剧的经验》里则比作戏场。我很吃惊于同是人，而眼光竟有这么不同；但究竟同是人，所以意见也不无符合之点：都不将学校看作学校。这一点，也可以包括杨荫榆女士的“学校犹家庭”和段祺瑞执政的“先父兄之教”。
The incident of the Women's Normal University seems to be quite a problem in Beijing, and the so-called "big newspapers" such as the so-called "Modern Review" have actually "commented" several times. I have always heard that Chinese people have the generosity of a large citizen, but now look at it, it is not necessarily so. But if we want to say it well, then let's say it is pure and ambitious.
