This and that一　读经与读史
1. Reading the Bible and Reading History一个阔人说要读经，嗡的一阵一群狭人也说要读经。岂但“读”而已矣哉，据说还可以“救国”哩。“学而时习之，不亦说乎？”那也许是确凿的罢，然而甲午战败了，——为什么独独要说“甲午”呢，是因为其时还在开学校，废读经以前。
A broad man said he wanted to read the scriptures, and a group of narrow people also said he wanted to read the scriptures. It's not just about "reading", it is said that it can also "save the country". "Isn't it good to learn and practice from time to time?" That may be conclusive, but after the defeat of the Jiawu War,—— why did he say "Jiawu" alone, because he was still opening a school at that time, and before the reading of the scriptures was abolished.我以为伏案还未功深的朋友，现在正不必埋头来哼线装书。倘其咿唔日久，对于旧书有些上瘾了，那么，倒不如去读史，尤其是宋朝明朝史，而且尤须是野史；或者看杂说。
I thought that friends who had not yet sat down at the desk did not have to bury their heads in humming the thread to bind the book. If you don't babble for a long time and are a little addicted to old books, then it is better to read history, especially the history of the Song and Ming dynasties, and especially wild history; Or read the miscellaneous stories.现在中西的学者们，几乎一听到“钦定四库全书”这名目就魂不附体，膝弯总要软下来似的。其实呢，书的原式是改变了，错字是加添了，甚至于连文章都删改了，最便当的是《琳琅秘室丛书》中的两种《茅亭客话》，一是宋本，一是四库本，一比较就知道。“官修”而加以“钦定”的正史也一样，不但本纪咧，列传咧，要摆“史架子”；里面也不敢说什么。据说，字里行间是也含着什么褒贬的，但谁有这么多的心眼儿来猜闷壶卢。至今还道“将平生事迹宣付国史馆立传”，还是算了罢。
Nowadays, Chinese and Western scholars are almost captivated by the name "The Complete Book of the Four Libraries of the Imperial Dynasty", and their knees are always soft. In fact, the original format of the book has changed, typos have been added, and even the article has been deleted, and the most convenient are the two "Maoting Hakka Words" in the "Linlang Secret Room Series", one is the Song version, and the other is the Siku version, which can be known as soon as you compare. The same is true for the official history of "official repair" and "imperial approval", not only the chronicles, but also the biographies, and the "historical shelf"; I didn't dare to say anything inside. It is said that there is something to praise and criticism between the lines, but who has so many hearts and eyes to guess the stuffy pot Lu. So far, he still said that he "announced his life deeds to the National History Museum to be established", or forget it.野史和杂说自然也免不了有讹传，挟恩怨，但看往事却可以较分明，因为它究竟不像正史那样地装腔作势。看宋事，《三朝北盟汇编》已经变成古董，太贵了，新排印的《宋人说部丛书》却还便宜。明事呢，《野获编》原也好，但也化为古董了，每部数十元；易于入手的是《明季南北略》，《明季稗史汇编》，以及新近集印的《痛史》。
Wild history and miscellaneous theories are naturally bound to have rumors and grievances, but looking at the past can be more clear, because it is not as pretentious as the official history. Looking at the Song Dynasty, the "Compilation of the Three Dynasties and the Northern Alliance" has become an antique and is too expensive, but the newly typeset "Song People's Commentary Series" is still cheap. As for the obvious thing, "Wild Harvest" is good, but it has also turned into an antique, tens of yuan per copy; The easy ones to start are the "Ming Dynasty North and South Strategy", "Compilation of the History of the Ming Dynasty", and the newly collected "History of Pain".史书本来是过去的陈帐簿，和急进的猛士不相干。但先前说过，倘若还不能忘情于咿唔，倒也可以翻翻，知道我们现在的情形，和那时的何其神似，而现在的昏妄举动，胡涂思想，那时也早已有过，并且都闹糟了。
The history books were originally the old account books of the past, and they had nothing to do with the radical warriors. But as I said before, if you can't forget your feelings about babbling, you can also turn over and know how similar our current situation is to that time, and the current foolish behavior and foolish thoughts have already existed at that time, and they have all made a mess.试到中央公园去，大概总可以遇见祖母带着她孙女儿在玩的。这位祖母的模样，就预示着那娃儿的将来。所以倘有谁要预知令夫人后日的丰姿，也只要看丈母。不同是当然要有些不同的，但总归相去不远。我们查帐的用处就在此。
Try to go to Central Park, and you can probably always meet a grandmother playing with her granddaughter. The appearance of this grandmother indicates the future of the baby. So if anyone wants to predict Mrs. Ling's future beauty, they only need to look at their mother-in-law. Of course, the difference is somewhat different, but it is not far apart. This is where our audit comes in.但我并不说古来如此，现在遂无可为，劝人们对于“过去”生敬畏心，以为它已经铸定了我们的运命。Le Bon先生说，死人之力比生人大，诚然也有一理的，然而人类究竟进化着。又据章士钊总长说，则美国的什么地方已在禁讲进化论了，这实在是吓死我也，然而禁只管禁，进却总要进的。
But I don't say that this has been the case in ancient times, and now there is nothing we can do, persuading people to be in awe of the "past", thinking that it has shaped our destiny. Mr. Le Bon said that it is true that the power of the dead is greater than that of the living, but human beings are evolving. According to President Zhang Shizhao, it is forbidden to talk about evolution somewhere in the United States, which really scares me to death.总之：读史，就愈可以觉悟中国改革之不可缓了。虽是国民性，要改革也得改革，否则，杂史杂说上所写的就是前车。一改革，就无须怕孙女儿总要像点祖母那些事，譬如祖母的脚是三角形，步履维艰的，小姑娘的却是天足，能飞跑；丈母老太太出过天花，脸上有些缺点的，令夫人却种的是牛痘，所以细皮白肉：这也就大差其远了。
In short: reading history, the more you can realize that China's reform cannot be delayed. Although it is a national character, it must be reformed if it is to be reformed, otherwise, what is written in the miscellaneous histories is the past. As soon as the reform is done, there is no need to be afraid that the granddaughter will always be like her grandmother, for example, the grandmother's feet are triangular and she is struggling, but the little girl's is heavenly and can fly; The old lady of the mother-in-law had smallpox and had some shortcomings on her face, but Mrs. Ling planted cowpox, so the skin and white flesh were fine: this is far from it.十二月八日。
December 8th.

这个与那个

二　捧与挖

这个与那个

2. Holding and digging中国的人们，遇见带有会使自己不安的朕兆的人物，向来就用两样法：将他压下去，或者将他捧起来。
When Chinese people encounter people with signs that will make them uneasy, they have always used two methods: to suppress him or to hold him up.压下去就用旧习惯和旧道德，或者凭官力，所以孤独的精神的战士，虽然为民众战斗，却往往反为这“所为”而灭亡。到这样，他们这才安心了。压不下时，则于是乎捧，以为抬之使高，餍之使足，便可以于己稍稍无害，得以安心。
If you suppress it, you will use old habits and morals, or rely on official power, so the lonely warriors, although they fight for the people, often perish because of this "action". At this point, they felt relieved. When you can't press down, you can hold it up, thinking that if you lift it high and eat it enough, you can feel a little more harmless to yourself and feel at ease.伶俐的人们，自然也有谋利而捧的，如捧阔老，捧戏子，捧总长之类；但在一般粗人，——就是未尝“读经”的，则凡有捧的行为的“动机”，大概是不过想免害。即以所奉祀的神道而论，也大抵是凶恶的，火神瘟神不待言，连财神也是蛇呀刺蝟呀似的骇人的畜类；观音菩萨倒还可爱，然而那是从印度输入的，并非我们的“国粹”。要而言之：凡是被捧者，十之九不是好东西。
Clever people naturally also have those who seek profit, such as praising the elderly, supporting actors, and praising the chief; However, if the average rough person ,—— has not tasted "reading the scriptures", then the "motive" of any behavior is probably just to avoid harm. Even in terms of the Shinto worshipped, it is probably vicious, the god of fire and the plague god needless to say, and even the god of wealth is a terrifying animal like a snake and a hedgehog; Guanyin Bodhisattva is still cute, but it was imported from India, not our "national essence". In short: 90% of all the people who are supported are not good things.既然十之九不是好东西，则被捧而后，那结果便自然和捧者的希望适得其反了。不但能使不安，还能使他们很不安，因为人心本来不易餍足。然而人们终于至今没有悟，还以捧为苟安之一道。
Since nine out of ten things are not good things, they are praised, and the result is naturally counterproductive to the hopes of the sponsors. Not only can it make them uneasy, but it can also make them very uneasy, because the human heart is not easy to be satisfied. However, people have not realized it so far, and they still regard it as a way to live in peace.记得有一部讲笑话的书，名目忘记了，也许是《笑林广记》罢，说，当一个知县的寿辰，因为他是子年生，属鼠的，属员们便集资铸了一个金老鼠去作贺礼。知县收受之后，另寻了机会对大众说道：明年又恰巧是贱内的整寿；她比我小一岁，是属牛的。其实，如果大家先不送金老鼠，他决不敢想金牛。一送开手，可就难于收拾了，无论金牛无力致送，即使送了，怕他的姨太太也会属象。象不在十二生肖之内，似乎不近情理罢，但这是我替他设想的法子罢了，知县当然别有我们所莫测高深的妙法在。
I remember a book that told jokes, the name of which I forgot, maybe it was "Laughing Forest Guangji", saying that when a county magistrate had a birthday, because he was born in the year of the child and was a rat, the members raised funds to cast a golden mouse as a congratulatory gift. After the county magistrate accepted it, he found another opportunity to say to the public: Next year happens to be the whole life of the cheap one; She is one year younger than me and is an ox. In fact, if everyone doesn't give the golden rat first, he will never dare to think about the golden bull. As soon as he gave it away, it was difficult to clean it up, no matter how hard Taurus could afford to send it, even if he did, he was afraid that his aunt would be an elephant. The elephant is not in the zodiac, it seems unreasonable, but this is just the method I envisioned for him, and of course the county magistrate has other wonderful methods that we cannot fathom.民元革命时候，我在S城，来了一个都督。他虽然也出身绿林大学，未尝“读经”（？），但倒是还算顾大局，听舆论的，可是自绅士以至于庶民，又用了祖传的捧法群起而捧之了。这个拜会，那个恭维，今天送衣料，明天送翅席，捧得他连自己也忘其所以，结果是渐渐变成老官僚一样，动手刮地皮。
During the Minyuan Revolution, I was in S City and came to a governor. Although he was also born in Green Forest University, he did not "read the scriptures" (?) But it is still considered to be the overall situation and listen to public opinion, but from the gentlemen to the common people, they have used the ancestral support of the Dharma to praise it. This visit, that compliment, today to send clothes, tomorrow to send wing mats, he even forgot about himself, and as a result, he gradually became like an old bureaucrat, scraping the ground.最奇怪的是北几省的河道，竟捧得河身比屋顶高得多了。当初自然是防其溃决，所以壅上一点土；殊不料愈壅愈高，一旦溃决，那祸害就更大。于是就“抢堤”咧，“护堤”咧，“严防决堤”咧，花色繁多，大家吃苦。如果当初见河水泛滥，不去增堤，却去挖底，我以为决不至于这样。
The strangest thing is that the rivers in the northern provinces are much higher than the roofs. At the beginning, it was naturally to prevent it from rupturing, so a little soil was blocked; Unexpectedly, the more congested it becomes, the more it collapses, and the disaster will be even greater. So they "grabbed the embankment", "berm", "strictly prevented the embankment from bursting", and there were many colors, and everyone endured hardships. If I had seen the river flooding and not increased the embankment, but dug the bottom, I thought it would never be like this.有贪图金牛者，不但金老鼠，便是死老鼠也不给。那么，此辈也就连生日都未必做了。单是省却拜寿，已经是一件大快事。
There are those who covet Taurus, not only golden rats, but also dead rats. Then, this generation may not even have a birthday. Just saving the birthday is already a great pleasure.中国人的自讨苦吃的根苗在于捧，“自求多福”之道却在于挖。其实，劳力之量是差不多的，但从惰性太多的人们看来，却以为还是捧省力。
The root of the Chinese's self-behaviour lies in holding it, but the way of "asking for more blessings" lies in digging. In fact, the amount of labor is about the same, but from the perspective of people who are too inert, they think that it is still labor-saving.十二月十日。
December 10th.

这个与那个

三　最先与最后

这个与那个

3. First and last《韩非子》说赛马的妙法，在于“不为最先，不耻最后”。这虽是从我们这样外行的人看起来，也觉得很有理。因为假若一开首便拚命奔驰，则马力易竭。但那第一句是只适用于赛马的，不幸中国人却奉为人的处世金鍼了。
"Han Feizi" says that the wonderful method of horse racing is to "not be the first, not ashamed of the last". Although this seems to be very reasonable from the perspective of laymen like us. Because if you run hard at the beginning, the horsepower will be easily exhausted. But the first sentence is only applicable to horse racing, but unfortunately the Chinese regard it as a golden needle for human life.中国人不但“不为戎首”，“不为祸始”，甚至于“不为福先”。所以凡事都不容易有改革；前驱和闯将，大抵是谁也怕得做。然而人性岂真能如道家所说的那样恬淡；欲得的却多。既然不敢径取，就只好用阴谋和手段。以此，人们也就日见其卑怯了，既是“不为最先”，自然也不敢“不耻最后”，所以虽是一大堆群众，略见危机，便“纷纷作鸟兽散”了。如果偶有几个不肯退转，因而受害的，公论家便异口同声，称之曰傻子。对于“锲而不舍”的人们也一样。
The Chinese are not only "not the leader of the war", "not the beginning of disaster", and even "not the first of fortune". Therefore, it is not easy to reform everything; Pioneers and breakers are probably afraid of anyone to do. However, human nature can really be as tranquil as Taoists say; But I want more. Since they didn't dare to take it directly, they had to use conspiracies and means. In this way, people are seeing their cowardice day by day, not only "not being the first", but naturally not daring to "be ashamed of the last", so although it is a large number of people, when they see a slight crisis, they "disperse as birds and beasts". If there are a few people who refuse to retreat and are victimized because of this, public opinion experts will call them fools in unison. The same is true for people who are "persevering".我有时也偶尔去看看学校的运动会。这种竞争，本来不像两敌国的开战，挟有仇隙的，然而也会因了竞争而骂，或者竟打起来。但这些事又作别论。竞走的时候，大抵是最快的三四个人一到决胜点，其余的便松懈了，有几个还至于失了跑完豫定的圈数的勇气，中途挤入看客的群集中；或者佯为跌倒，使红十字队用担架将他抬走。假若偶有虽然落后，却尽跑，尽跑的人，大家就嗤笑他。大概是因为他太不聪明，“不耻最后”的缘故罢。
I also occasionally go to the school sports day. This kind of competition is not like a war between two enemy countries, with enmity, but it will also be scolded because of the competition, or even fight. But these things are a different story. When racing, it is probably the fastest three or four people as soon as they reach the decisive point, and the rest relax, and a few even lose the courage to run the predetermined laps and squeeze into the crowd of spectators in the middle; Or feign a fall so that the Red Cross carries him away on a stretcher. If there is a person who is behind but runs and runs, everyone will laugh at him. Probably because he is too unsmart and "not ashamed of the last".所以中国一向就少有失败的英雄，少有韧性的反抗，少有敢单身鏖战的武人，少有敢抚哭叛徒的吊客；见胜兆则纷纷聚集，见败兆则纷纷逃亡。战具比我们精利的欧美人，战具未必比我们精利的匈奴蒙古满洲人，都如入无人之境。“土崩瓦解”这四个字，真是形容得有自知之明。
Therefore, China has always had few failed heroes, few resilient resistances, few warriors who dare to fight alone, and few mourners who dare to cry traitors; When they see the signs of victory, they gather, and when they see the signs of defeat, they flee. Europeans and Americans whose weapons are better than ours, and the Xiongnu, Mongolians, and Manchurians whose weapons may not be better than ours, are all like entering a no-man's land. The four words "collapse" are really self-aware.多有“不耻最后”的人的民族，无论什么事，怕总不会一下子就“土崩瓦解”的，我每看运动会时，常常这样想：优胜者固然可敬，但那虽然落后而仍非跑至终点不止的竞技者，和见了这样竞技者而肃然不笑的看客，乃正是中国将来的脊梁。
Every time I watch the Games, I often think like this: the winners are respectable, but the competitors who are behind but still do not run to the finish line, and the spectators who do not smile when they see such competitors, are the backbone of China's future.

这个与那个

四　流产与断种

这个与那个

4. Abortion and seed termination近来对于青年的创作，忽然降下一个“流产”的恶谥，哄然应和的就有一大群。我现在相信，发明这话的是没有什么恶意的，不过偶尔说一说；应和的也是情有可原的，因为世事本来大概就这样。
Recently, for the creation of young people, a bad posthumous title of "miscarriage" has suddenly been lowered, and there is a large group of people who respond in unison. I now believe that there was no malicious intention in inventing this word, but it is said occasionally; It is also forgivable to agree, because the world is probably like this.我独不解中国人何以于旧状况那么心平气和，于较新的机运就这么疾首蹙额；于已成之局那么委曲求全，于初兴之事就这么求全责备？
I don't understand why the Chinese are so calm about the old situation and frown so quickly in the newer situation; In the already established situation, so compromised, and in the initial matter, so blame?智识高超而眼光远大的先生们开导我们：生下来的倘不是圣贤，豪杰，天才，就不要生；写出来的倘不是不朽之作，就不要写；改革的事倘不是一下子就变成极乐世界，或者，至少能给我（！）有更多的好处，就万万不要动！……
The wise and far-sighted gentlemen enlighten us: if you are not a sage, a hero, or a genius, do not give birth; If what is written is not an immortal work, don't write it; If the reform does not suddenly become a paradise, or, at least it can give me (!) If there are more benefits, don't move! ……那么，他是保守派么？据说：并不然的。他正是革命家。惟独他有公平，正当，稳健，圆满，平和，毫无流弊的改革法；现下正在研究室里研究着哩，——只是还没有研究好。
So, is he a conservative? It is said: Not really. He was a revolutionary. Only he has a fair, just, steady, complete, peaceful, and free reform law; This is currently being studied in the laboratory,—— but it has not yet been studied.什么时候研究好呢？答曰：没有准儿。
When is it good to research? The answer is: There is no standard.孩子初学步的第一步，在成人看来，的确是幼稚，危险，不成样子，或者简直是可笑的。但无论怎样的愚妇人，却总以恳切的希望的心，看他跨出这第一步去，决不会因为他的走法幼稚，怕要阻碍阔人的路线而“逼死”他；也决不至于将他禁在床上，使他躺着研究到能够飞跑时再下地。因为她知道：假如这么办，即使长到一百岁也还是不会走路的。
A child's first step in toddlerhood is, in the eyes of adults, indeed childish, dangerous, unsightly, or simply ridiculous. But no matter what kind of foolish woman she is, she always watches him take this first step with a sincere hope, and will never "force" him to death because of his naïve way of walking, for fear of hindering the route of the broad man; Nor will he be confined to the bed, so that he can lie down and study until he can fly before going to the ground. Because she knew that if she did this, she would still not be able to walk even if she was a hundred years old.古来就这样，所谓读书人，对于后起者却反而专用彰明较著的或改头换面的禁锢。近来自然客气些，有谁出来，大抵会遇见学士文人们挡驾：且住，请坐。接着是谈道理了：调查，研究，推敲，修养，……结果是老死在原地方。否则，便得到“捣乱”的称号。我也曾有如现在的青年一样，向已死和未死的导师们问过应走的路。他们都说：不可向东，或西，或南，或北。但不说应该向东，或西，或南，或北。我终于发见他们心底里的蕴蓄了：不过是一个“不走”而已。
In ancient times, the so-called scholars were dedicated to the confinement of the newcomers or the transformation of the face. Recently, it is natural to be more polite, and whoever comes out will probably meet the scholars and literati who block the drive: Stay, please sit down. Then there is the reasoning: investigation, research, scrutiny, self-cultivation,...... The result is old death in the same place. Otherwise, you will get the title of "troublemaker". I have also asked my mentors, both dead and undead, like young people today, about the way to go. They all said, "Do not go east, or west, or south, or north." But it is not said that it should be east, or west, or south, or north. I finally discovered the accumulation in their hearts: it's just a "don't leave".坐着而等待平安，等待前进，倘能，那自然是很好的，但可虑的是老死而所等待的却终于不至；不生育，不流产而等待一个英伟的宁馨儿，那自然也很可喜的，但可虑的是终于什么也没有。

If you think that instead of getting an outstanding baby, it is better to cut off the seeds, then there is nothing to say. Not gossip (3)西滢先生这回是义形于色，在《现代评论》四十八期的《闲话》里很为被书贾擅自选印作品，因而受了物质上损害的作者抱不平。而且贱名也忝列于作者之列：惶恐透了。吃饭之后，写一点自己的所感罢。至于捏笔的“动机”，那可大概是“不纯洁”的。记得幼小时候住在故乡，每看见绅士将一点骗人的自以为所谓恩惠，颁给下等人，而下等人不大感谢时，则斥之曰“不识抬举！”我的父祖是读书的，总该可以算得士流了，但不幸从我起，不知怎的就有了下等脾气，不但恩惠，连吊慰都不很愿意受，老实说罢：我总疑心是假的。这种疑心，大约就是“不识抬举”的根苗，或者还要使写出来的东西“不纯洁”。
Mr. Xi Ying was righteous this time, and in the 48th issue of "Modern Review", he was very upset with the author who was selected and printed by the bookseller without authorization, so he suffered material damage. And my name is also worthy of being listed among the authors: I am terrified. After eating, write a little about your feelings. As for the "motive" of pinching the pen, it is probably "impure". I remember living in my hometown when I was a child, and every time I saw a gentleman giving a little deceptive self-proclaimed favor to the lower class, and the lower class did not thank him, he would scold him, "I don't know how to lift up!" "My father and grandfather were scholars, and they should always be considered scholars, but unfortunately from me, somehow I have a lowly temper, not only favors, but even condolences are not very willing, to be honest: I always suspect that it is false. This kind of suspicion is probably the root of "ignorance of lifting", or it also makes what is written "impure".我何尝有什么白刃在前，烈火在后，还是钉住书桌，非写不可的“创作冲动”；虽然明知道这种冲动是纯洁，高尚，可贵的，然而其如没有何。前几天早晨，被一个朋友怒视了两眼，倒觉得脸有点热，心有点酸，颇近乎有什么冲动了，但后来被深秋的寒风一吹拂，脸上的温度便复原，——没有创作。至于已经印过的那些，那是被挤出来的。这“挤”字是挤牛乳之“挤”；这“挤牛乳”是专来说明“挤”字的，并非故意将我的作品比作牛乳，希冀装在玻璃瓶里，送进什么“艺术之宫”。倘用现在突然流行起来了的论调，将青年的急于发表未熟的作品称为“流产”，则我的便是“打胎”；或者简直不是胎，是狸猫充太子。所以一写完，便完事，管他妈的，书贾怎么偷，文士怎么说，都不再来提心吊胆。但是，如果有我所相信的人愿意看，称赞好，我终于是欢喜的。后来也集印了，为的是还想卖几文钱，老实说。
I have no white blade in front and fire behind, or nail the desk, and I must write; Although we know that this impulse is pure, noble, and precious, it is noble. A few mornings ago, I was glared at by a friend, but I felt that my face was a little hot, my heart was a little sour, and I almost had some impulse, but then I was blown by the cold wind in late autumn, and the temperature on my face recovered,—— I didn't create. As for those that have already been printed, they are squeezed out. The word "squeeze" is the "milking" of milking; This "milking" is specifically to illustrate the word "milking", not to deliberately compare my work to milk, hoping to be put in a glass bottle and sent to some "palace of art". If I use the argument that has suddenly become popular now, and call the young people's eagerness to publish immature works "abortion", then mine is "abortion"; Or it is not a fetus at all, it is a civet cat as a prince. So as soon as I finished writing, it was over, no matter how the fuck, how the bookseller stole it, and what the scribe said, I no longer came to worry. However, if there are people I believe in who are willing to watch and praise it, I will finally rejoice. Later, it was also printed, in order to sell it for a few cents, to be honest.那么，我在写的时候没有虔敬的心么？答曰：有罢。即使没有这种冠冕堂皇的心，也决不故意耍些油腔滑调。被挤着，还能嬉皮笑脸，游戏三昧么？倘能，那简直是神仙了。我并没有在吕纯阳祖师门下投诚过。
So, did I not have a reverent heart when I wrote? The answer is: Yes, it is canceled. Even if you don't have this high-sounding heart, you will never deliberately play some oily tones. If you are squeezed, can you still have a hippie smile and play a game? If you can, it's simply a god. I have not surrendered under Patriarch Lu Chunyang.但写出以后，却也不很爱惜羽毛，有所谓“敝帚自珍”的意思，因为，已经说过，其时已经是“便完事，管他妈的”了。谁有心肠来管这些无聊的后事呢？所以虽然有什么选家在那里放出他那伟大的眼光，选印我的作品，我也照例给他一个不管。其实，要管也无从管起的。我曾经替人代理过一回收版税的译本，打听得卖完之后，向书店去要钱，回信却道，旧经理人已经辞职回家了，你向他要去罢；我们可是不知道。这书店在上海，我怎能趁了火车去向他坐索，或者打官司？但我对于这等选本，私心却也有“窃以为不然”的几点，一是原本上的错字，虽然一见就明知道是错的，他也照样错下去；二是他们每要发几句伟论，例如什么主义咧，什么意思咧之类，大抵是我自己倒觉得并不这样的事。自然，批评是“精神底冒险”，批评家的精神总比作者会先一步的，但在他们的所谓死尸上，我却分明听到心搏，这真是到死也说不到一块儿，此外，倒也没有什么大怨气了。
But after writing it, he didn't cherish the feathers very much, and there was the so-called meaning of "broom self-cherishing", because it has been said that it was already "it's over, fuck it". Who has the heart to take care of these boring funeral affairs? So although there are some selectors who show their great vision and choose to print my works, I will give him a leave of regard as usual. In fact, there is no way to manage it. I once acted as an agent for someone to recycle a translation of royalties, and after inquiring about the sale, I went to the bookstore to ask for money, but the reply said that the old manager had resigned and went home, so you can ask him to go; We don't know. This bookstore is in Shanghai, how can I take advantage of the train to ask him for a rope, or fight a lawsuit? First, the original typo, although he knew it was wrong at first sight, he was still wrong; second, every time they want to make a few grand statements, such as what doctrine and what they mean, I probably don't think this is the case. Naturally, criticism is a "spiritual adventure", and the spirit of the critic is always one step ahead of the author, but on their so-called dead body, I clearly hear the heartbeat, which is really impossible to say until death, and in addition, there is no big resentment.这虽然似乎是东方文明式的大度，但其实倒怕是因为我不靠卖文营生。在中国，骈文寿序的定价往往还是每篇一百两，然而白话不值钱；翻译呢，听说是自己不能创作而嫉妒别人去创作的坏心肠人所提倡的，将来文坛一进步，当然更要一文不值。我所写出来的东西，当初虽然很碰过许多大钉子，现在的时价是每千字一至二三元，但是不很有这样好主顾，常常只好尽些不知何自而来的义务。有些人以为我不但用了这些稿费或版税造屋，买米，而且还靠它吸烟卷，吃果糖。殊不知那些款子是另外骗来的；我实在不很擅长于先装鬼脸去吓书坊老板，然后和他接洽。我想，中国最不值钱的是工人的体力了，其次是咱们的所谓文章，只有伶俐最值钱。倘真要直直落落，借文字谋生，则据我的经验，卖来卖去，来回至少一个月，多则一年余，待款子寄到时，作者不但已经饿死，倘在夏天，连筋肉也都烂尽了，那里还有吃饭的肚子。

I think the least valuable thing in China is the physical strength of workers, followed by our so-called articles, only clever is the most valuable. If you really want to go straight and make a living through words, then according to my experience, sell it back and forth for at least a month, or more than a year, and when the money arrives, the author is not only starving to death, but if in the summer, even the muscles are rotten, and there is still a stomach to eat.所以我总用别的道儿谋生；至于所谓文章也者，不挤，便不做。挤了才有，则和什么高超的“烟士披离纯”呀，“创作感兴”呀之类不大有关系，也就可想而知。倘说我假如不必用别的道儿谋生，则心志一专，就会有“烟士披离纯”等类，而产生较伟大的作品，至少，也可以免于献出剥皮的狸猫罢，那可是也未必。三家村的冬烘先生，一年到头，一早到夜教村童，不但毫不“时时想政治活动”，简直并不很“干着种种无聊的事”，但是他们似乎并没有《教育学概论》或“高头讲章”的待定稿，藏之名山。而马克思的《资本论》，陀思妥夫斯奇的《罪与罚》等，都不是啜末加加啡，吸埃及烟卷之后所写的。除非章士钊总长治下的“有些天才”的编译馆人员，以及讨得官僚津贴或银行广告费的“大报”作者，于谋成事遂，睡足饭饱之余，三月炼字，半年锻句，将来会做出超伦轶群的古奥漂亮作品。总之，在我，是肚子一饱，应酬一少，便要心平气和，关起门来，什么也不写了；即使还写，也许不过是温暾之谈，两可之论，也即所谓执中之说，公允之言，其实等于不写而已。

booksellers, like other merchants, are profit-seeking; No one knows that his "motive" for publishing or publishing articles is "impure" and will never be on par with that of university professors. 我观北大

我观北大

I look at Peking University因为北大学生会的紧急征发，我于是总得对于本校的二十七周年纪念来说几句话。
Because of the emergency requisition of the Peking University Student Union, I have to say a few words about the 27th anniversary of our school.据一位教授的名论，则“教一两点钟的讲师”是不配与闻校事的，而我正是教一点钟的讲师。但这些名论，只好请恕我置之不理；——如其不恕，那么，也就算了，人那里顾得这些事。
According to a professor's famous theory, "a lecturer who teaches one or two o'clock" is not worthy of hearing about school affairs, and I am the lecturer who teaches one o'clock. But these famous theories have to be ignored by me; ——If they don't forgive, then forget it, people take care of these things.我向来也不专以北大教员自居，因为另外还与几个学校有关系。然而不知怎的，——也许是含有神妙的用意的罢，今年忽而颇有些人指我为北大派。我虽然不知道北大可真有特别的派，但也就以此自居了。北大派么？就是北大派！怎么样呢？
I have never regarded myself as a faculty member of Peking University, because I have connections with several other schools. However, somehow,—— maybe there is a mysterious intention, and this year some people suddenly called me Peking University faction. Although I didn't know that Peking University really had a special school, I took it upon myself. Peking University faction? It's the Peking University faction! How?但是，有些流言家幸勿误会我的意思，以为谣我怎样，我便怎样的。我的办法也并不一律。譬如前次的游行，报上谣我被打落了两个门牙，我可决不肯具呈警厅，吁请补派军警，来将我的门牙从新打落。我之照着谣言做去，是以专检自己所愿意者为限的。
However, some rumors should not misunderstand what I mean, thinking that if I am a rumor, I will be like that. My methods are not uniform. For example, in the last parade, there was a rumor that I had lost two front teeth, and I would never report it to the police department, and I called on the military and police to knock out my front teeth again. I follow the rumors and limit myself to what I want.我觉得北大也并不坏。如果真有所谓派，那么，被派进这派里去，也还是也就算了。理由在下面：
I don't think Peking University is bad either. If there is really a so-called faction, then it is still okay to be sent into this faction. The reasons are as follows:既然是二十七周年，则本校的萌芽，自然是发于前清的，但我并民国初年的情形也不知道。惟据近七八年的事实看来，第一，北大是常为新的，改进的运动的先锋，要使中国向着好的，往上的道路走。虽然很中了许多暗箭，背了许多谣言；教授和学生也都逐年地有些改换了，而那向上的精神还是始终一贯，不见得弛懈。自然，偶尔也免不了有些很想勒转马头的，可是这也无伤大体，“万众一心”，原不过是书本子上的冠冕话。
Since it is the 27th anniversary, the germination of this school naturally originated in the former Qing Dynasty, but I do not know the situation in the early years of the Republic of China. However, according to the facts of the past seven or eight years, first, Peking University is often the vanguard of the new and improved movement, and it is necessary to make China move towards a good and upward path. Although he was hit by many hidden arrows and memorized many rumors; Professors and students have also changed a little year by year, and the upward spirit is still consistent and not necessarily relaxed. Naturally, occasionally there are inevitably some people who want to turn the horse's head, but this doesn't hurt the whole thing, "all people are united", it turns out to be just a crown word in a book.第二，北大是常与黑暗势力抗战的，即使只有自己。自从章士钊提了“整顿学风”的招牌来“作之师”，并且分送金款以来，北大却还是给他一个依照彭允彝的待遇。现在章士钊虽然还伏在暗地里做总长，本相却已显露了；而北大的校格也就愈明白。那时固然也曾显出一角灰色，但其无伤大体，也和第一条所说相同。
Second, Peking University often fights against dark forces, even if it is only itself. Since Zhang Shizhao put forward the signboard of "rectifying the academic style" to "be a teacher" and distributing the money, Peking University still gave him a treatment according to Peng Yunyi. Now although Zhang Shizhao is still hiding in the shadows as the chief, his true nature has been revealed; And the school style of Peking University is becoming clearer. At that time, there was certainly a corner of gray, but it was harmless and the same as the first one.我不是公论家，有上帝一般决算功过的能力。仅据我所感得的说，则北大究竟还是活的，而且还在生长的。凡活的而且在生长者，总有着希望的前途。
I am not a public opinionator, and I have the ability to calculate merits and demerits like God. From what I can feel, Peking University is still alive and growing. Those who live and grow always have a hopeful future.今天所想到的就是这一点。但如果北大到二十八周年而仍不为章士钊者流所谋害，又要出纪念刊，我却要预先声明：不来多话了。一则，命题作文，实在苦不过；二则，说起来大约还是这些话。
That's what comes to mind today. But if Peking University is still not murdered by Zhang Shizhao and is going to publish a commemorative magazine on the 28th anniversary, I have to declare in advance: I won't say more. First, the proposition composition is really bitter; Second, it is still about these words.十二月十三日。
December 13th.

碎话

碎话

Broken words如果只有自己，那是都可以的：今日之我与昨日之我战也好，今日这么说明日那么说也好。但最好是在自己的脑里想，在自己的宅子里说；或者和情人谈谈也不妨，横竖她总能以“阿呀”表示其佩服，而没有第三者与闻其事。只是，假使不自珍惜，陆续发表出来，以“领袖”“正人君子”自居，而称这些为“思想”或“公论”之类，却难免有多少老实人遭殃。自然，凡有神妙的变迁，原是反足以见学者文人们进步之神速的；况且文坛上本来就“只许州官放火不准百姓点灯”，既不幸而为庸人，则给天才做一点牺牲，也正是应尽的义务。谁叫你不能研究或创作的呢？亦惟有活该吃苦而已矣！
If it's only yourself, it's okay: it's okay to fight today with yesterday's me, or to say that today is the day. But it is best to think in your own head and say it in your own house; Or talk to your lover, she can always express her admiration with "Ah", and there is no third party to hear about it. However, if you don't cherish yourself and publish them one after another, claiming to be "leaders" and "upright gentlemen", and call these "thoughts" or "public opinions", it is inevitable that many honest people will suffer. Naturally, whenever there are miraculous changes, it is enough to see the rapid progress of scholars and literati; Moreover, in the literary world, "only state officials are allowed to set fires and the people are not allowed to light lamps", which is unfortunate and mediocre, so it is also an obligation to make a little sacrifice for geniuses. Who says you can't study or create? It is only necessary to endure hardship!然而，这是天才，或者是天才的奴才的崇论宏议。从庸人一方面看起来，却不免觉得此说虽合乎理而反乎情；因为“蝼蚁尚且贪生”，也还是古之明训。所以虽然是庸人，总还想活几天，乐一点。无奈爱管闲事是他们吃苦的根苗，坐在家里好好的，却偏要出来寻导师，听公论了。学者文人们正在一日千变地进步，大家跟在他后面；他走的是小弯，你走的是大弯，他在圆心里转，你却必得在圆周上转，汗流浃背而终于不知所以，那自然是不待数计龟卜而后知的。
However, this is a grand discussion of genius, or a servant of genius. From the perspective of mediocre people, they can't help but feel that although this statement is reasonable and contrary to reason; Because "ants are still greedy for life", it is also an ancient admonition. So even though I am a mediocre person, I always want to live for a few days and have fun. Helpless nosyness is the root of their hardships, sitting at home is good, but they want to come out to find a mentor and listen to public opinion. Scholars and literati are making progress day by day, and everyone is following him; He walks a small bend, you walk a big bend, he turns in the center of the circle, but you have to turn around the circle, sweating profusely and finally not knowing why, that naturally does not wait for the number of turtles to know.什么事情都要干，干，干！那当然是名言，但是倘有傻子真去买了手枪，就必要深悔前非，更进而悟到救国必先求学。这当然也是名言，何用多说呢，就遵谕钻进研究室去。待到有一天，你发见了一颗新彗星，或者知道了刘歆并非刘向的儿子之后，跳出来救国时，先觉者可是“杳如黄鹤”了，寻来寻去，也许会在戏园子里发见。你不要再菲薄那“小东人嗯嗯！哪，唉唉唉！”罢：这是艺术。听说“人类不仅是理智的动物”，必须“种种方面有充分发达的人，才可以算完人”呀，学者之在戏园，乃是“在感情方面求种种的美”。“束发小生”变成先生，从研究室里钻出，救国的资格也许有一点了，却不料还是一个精神上种种方面没有充分发达的畸形物，真是可怜可怜。
Do everything, do it, do it! Of course, that is a famous saying, but if a fool really buys a pistol, he must deeply regret his past mistakes, and then realize that he must first study to save the country. Of course, this is also a famous saying, so why say more, just follow the instructions and drill into the research room. When one day, you find a new comet, or after knowing that Liu Xin is not Liu Xiang's son, when you jump out to save the country, the pre-enlightened person is "like a yellow crane", looking around, maybe you will find it in the theater. Don't be underestimating that" Xiaodong hmm! Hey, alas! "Stop: This is art. I heard that "human beings are not only rational animals", but must be "fully developed in all kinds of aspects to be considered a perfect person". The "bundled hair" became a gentleman, drilled out of the research room, and the qualifications to save the country may be a little, but unexpectedly it is still a deformity that is not fully developed in various aspects of spirit, which is really pitiful.那么，立刻看夜戏，去求种种的美去，怎么样？谁知道呢。也许学者已经出戏园，学说也跟着长进（俗称改变，非也）了。
So, how about watching night dramas immediately and seeking all kinds of beauty? Who knows. Perhaps scholars have left the theater, and their theories have also grown (commonly known as change, not also).叔本华先生以厌世名一时，近来中国的绅士们却独独赏识了他的《妇人论》。的确，他的骂女人虽然还合绅士们的脾胃，但别的话却实在很有些和我们不相宜的。即如《读书和书籍》那一篇里，就说，“我们读着的时候，别人却替我们想。我们不过反复了这人的心的过程。……然而本来底地说起来，则读书时，我们的脑已非自己的活动地。这是别人的思想的战场了。”但是我们的学者文人们却正需要这样的战场——未经老练的青年的脑髓。但也并非在这上面和别的强敌战斗，乃是今日之我打昨日之我，“道义”之手批“公理”之颊——说得俗一点：自己打嘴巴。作了这样的战场者，怎么还能明白是怎么一回事。
Mr. Schopenhauer was famous for his world-weariness, but recently Chinese gentlemen have appreciated his "Theory of Women". Indeed, although his scolding of women is still in line with the gentlemen's temperament, other words are really not suitable for us. For example, in the article "Reading and Books", it is said, "When we read, others think for us." We just repeat the process of this person's heart. …… However, to put it bluntly, when reading, our brains are no longer our own place of activity. This is the battlefield of other people's thoughts. "But our scholars and literati need such a battlefield - the brains of unexperienced youth. But it is not fighting with other strong enemies on this, but today I beat yesterday's me, and the hand of "morality" criticizes the cheek of "axioms" - to put it vulgarly: hit yourself in the mouth. How can a person who has been on such a battlefield understand what is going on.这一月来，不知怎的又有几个学者文人或批评家亡魂失魄了，仿佛他们在上月底才从娘胎钻出，毫不知道民国十四年十二月以前的事似的。女师大学生一归她们被占的本校，就有人引以为例，说张胡子或李胡子可以“派兵送一二百学生占据了二三千学生的北大”。如果这样，北大学生确应该群起而将女师大扑灭，以免张胡或李胡援例，确保母校的安全。但我记得北大刚举行过二十七周年纪念，那建立的历史，是并非由章士钊将张胡或李胡将要率领的二百学生拖出，然后改立北大，招生三千，以掩人耳目的。这样的比附，简直是在青年的脑上打滚。夏间，则也可以称为“挑剔风潮”。但也许批评界有时也是“只许州官放火不准百姓点灯”，正如天才之在文坛一样的。
In the past month, somehow a few scholars, literati or critics have lost their souls, as if they only got out of their mother's womb at the end of last month, as if they didn't know what happened before December of the fourteenth year of the Republic of China. As soon as the female normal college students returned to the school they occupied, some people cited it as an example, saying that Zhang Huzi or Li Huzi could "send troops to Peking University with two or two hundred students occupying two or three thousand students." If this is the case, Peking University students should indeed rise up to extinguish the female normal university, so as not to prevent Zhang Hu or Li Hu from citing examples to ensure the safety of their alma mater. But I remember that Peking University had just held its 27th anniversary, and the history of its establishment was not that Zhang Shizhao dragged out the 200 students that Zhang Hu or Li Hu were going to lead, and then changed Peking University to enroll 3,000 students to hide people's eyes. Such a comparison is simply rolling in the brains of young people. In summer, it can also be called a "picky trend". But perhaps the critics sometimes "only allow state officials to set fires and not allow the people to light lamps", just like geniuses in the literary world.学者文人们最好是有这样的一个特权，月月，时时，自己和自己战，——即自己打嘴巴。免得庸人不知，以常人为例，误以为连一点“闲话”也讲不清楚。
Scholars and literati should have such a privilege, month after month, all the time, fighting with themselves,—— that is, slapping their mouths. Lest the mediocre people don't know, taking ordinary people as an example, mistakenly thinking that they can't even say a little "gossip" clearly.十二月二十二日。

“公理”的把戏

“公理”的把戏

“公理”的把戏

The trick of "axiom"自从去年春间，北京女子师范大学有了反对校长杨荫榆事件以来，于是而有该校长在太平湖饭店请客之后，任意将学生自治会员六人除名的事；有引警察及打手蜂拥入校的事；迨教育总长章士钊复出，遂有非法解散学校的事；有司长刘百昭雇用流氓女丐殴曳学生出校，禁之补习所空屋中的事；有手忙脚乱，急挂女子大学招牌以掩天下耳目的事；有胡敦复之趁火打劫，攫取女大校长饭碗，助章士钊欺罔世人的事。女师大的许多教职员，——我敢特地声明：并不是全体！——本极以章杨的措置为非，复痛学生之无辜受戮，无端失学，而校务维持会之组织，遂愈加严固。我先是该校的一个讲师，于黑暗残虐情形，多曾目睹；后是该会的一个委员，待到女师大在宗帽胡同自赁校舍，而章士钊尚且百端迫压的苦痛，也大抵亲历的。当章氏势焰熏天时，我也曾环顾这首善之区，寻求所谓“公理”“道义”之类而不得；而现在突起之所谓“教育界名流”者，那时则鸦雀无声；甚且捧献肉麻透顶的呈文，以歌颂功德。但这一点，我自然也判不定是因为畏章氏有嗾使兵警痛打之威呢，还是贪图分润金款之利，抑或真以他为“公理”或“道义”等类的具象的化身？但是，从章氏逃走，女师大复校以后，所谓“公理”等件，我却忽而间接地从女子大学在撷英馆宴请“北京教育界名流及女大学生家长”的席上找到了。
Since the incident of opposition to President Yang Yinyu at Beijing Women's Normal University last spring, the president arbitrarily removed six student autonomy members after entertaining guests at the Taiping Lake Hotel; there are incidents of police and thugs swarming into the school; When the chief of education, Zhang Shizhao, came back, there was an illegal dissolution of the school; Liu Baizhao hired rogue female beggars to beat and drag students out of the school and banned them from doing things in the empty cram school; there are things that are in a hurry and hurriedly hang up the signboard of women's universities to cover the eyes and ears of the world; There is Hu Dunfu who took advantage of the fire to rob and seize the job of the female university principal, helping Zhang Shizhao deceive the world. Many faculty members of Women's Normal University,—— I dare to declare that not all! ——Benji believes that Zhang Yang's measures are wrong, and he is pained by the innocent killing of students and the unprovoked loss of school, and the organization of the school affairs maintenance association has become more and more strict. I was a lecturer at the school, and I had witnessed many dark and cruel situations; Later, he was a member of the association, and when the Women's Normal University rented a school building in Zongmao Hutong, Zhang Shizhao was still oppressed in various ways, and he probably experienced it firsthand. When Zhang's power was overwhelming, I also looked around this area of goodness, seeking the so-called "axioms" and "morality" but couldn't find it; The so-called "celebrities in the education industry" who are now emerging were silent at that time; He even presented a meat-hemp presentation to praise the merits. But at this point, I naturally can't judge whether it is because I am afraid that Zhang Shi will instigate the soldiers and police to beat him up, or is he greedy for the profit of sharing the money, or is he really regarded as a concrete embodiment of "axioms" or "morality"? However, after escaping from Zhang's family and the resumption of Women's Normal University, I suddenly and indirectly found the so-called "axioms" and other things from the banquet hosted by Women's University at the Xiying Pavilion to entertain "celebrities in the education circles and parents of female college students".据十二月十六日的《北京晚报》说，则有些“名流”即于十四日晚六时在那个撷英番菜馆开会。请吃饭的，去吃饭的，在中国一天不知道有多多少少，本不与我相干，虽然也令我记起杨荫榆也爱在太平湖饭店请人吃饭的旧事。但使我留心的是，从这饭局里产生了“教育界公理维持会”，从这会又变出“国立女子大学后援会”，从这会又发出“致国立各校教职员联席会议函”，声势浩大，据说是“而于该校附和暴徒，自堕人格之教职员，即不能投畀豺虎，亦宜屏诸席外，勿与为伍”云。他们之所谓“暴徒”，盖即刘百昭之所谓“土匪”，官僚名流，口吻如一，从局外人看来，不过煞是可笑而已。而我是女师大维持会员之一，又是女师大教员，人格所关，当然有抗议的权利。岂但抗议？“投虎”“割席”，“名流”的熏灼之状，竟至于斯，则虽报以恶声，亦不为过。但也无须如此，只要看一看这些“名流”究竟是什么东西，就尽够了。报上和函上有名单：
According to the "Beijing Evening News" on December 16, some "celebrities" held a meeting at the British restaurant at 6 p.m. on the 14th. Those who invite people to eat, those who go to eat, I don't know how much a day in China, it has nothing to do with me, although it also reminds me of the old story of Yang Yinyu also loving to invite people to dinner at the Taiping Lake Hotel. However, what makes me note is that from this dinner came the "Education Circle Axiom Maintenance Association", from which the "National Women's University Support Association" was formed, and from this meeting issued the "Letter to the Joint Conference of Faculty and Staff of National Universities", which was said to be "and the faculty and staff who echo the mob in the school and degenerate their personalities should not vote for the jackals, and should be kept out of the table and not be in the company of them." Their so-called "thugs" are Liu Baizhao's so-called "bandits", bureaucrats and celebrities, with the same tone, from the perspective of outsiders, but it is just ridiculous. And I am one of the maintenance members of the Women's Normal University, and I am also a faculty member of the Women's Normal University. Is it just a protest? The scorching scene of "throwing tigers", "cutting the mat", and "celebrities" has reached this point, so even if it is reported with a bad reputation, it is not an exaggeration. This time it was the trick of the "majority"《现代评论》五五期《闲话》的末一段是根据了女大学生的宣言，说女师大学生只有二十个，别的都已进了女大，就深悔从前受了“某种报纸的催眠”。幸而见了宣言，这才省悟过来了，于是发问道：“要是二百人（按据云这是未解散前的数目）中有一百九十九人入了女大便怎样？要是二百人都入了女大便怎样？难道女师大校务维持会招了几个新生也去恢复么？我们不免要奇怪那维持会维持的究竟是谁呢？他们的目的究竟是什么呢？”
The last paragraph of the 55th issue of "Gossip" of the "Modern Review" is based on the declaration of female college students, saying that there are only 20 female normal college students, and the others have entered women's universities, and they deeply regret that they have been "hypnotized by some kind of newspaper" in the past. Fortunately, after seeing the declaration, he realized it, so he asked: "What if one hundred and ninety-nine of the two hundred people (according to the number before the dissolution) enter the female feces?" What if 200 people have female feces? Could it be that the Women's Normal University School Affairs Maintenance Association has recruited a few freshmen to recover? We can't help but wonder who will maintain it? What is their purpose? ”这当然要为夏间并不维持女师大而现在则出而维持“公理”的陈源教授所不解的。我虽然是女师大维持会的一个委员，但也知道别一种可解的办法——
Of course, this is puzzled by Professor Chen Yuan, who did not maintain the Women's Normal University in the summer, but now he is out to maintain the "axioms". Although I am a member of the Women's Normal University Maintenance Committee, I also know another solution -二十人都往多的一边跑，维持会早该趋奉章士钊！
Twenty people are running to the side of the more, and the maintenance will be long gone to Zhang Shizhao!我也是“四五十岁的人爱说四五岁的孩子话”，而且爱学奴才话的，所以所说的也许是笑话。但是既经说开，索性再说几句罢：要是二百人中有二百另一人入了女大便怎样？要是维持会员也都入了女大便怎样？要是一百九十九人入了女大，而剩下的一个人偏不要维持便怎样？……
I am also "people in their forties and fifties love to speak the language of children of four or five years old", and I love to learn the words of servants, so what I say may be a joke. But after saying it, let's just say a few more words: What if another person out of 200 people enters the female stool? What if the members are also in the female stool? What if 199 people enter the women's university and the remaining one does not want to maintain it? ……我想这些妙问，大概是无人能答的。这实在问得太离奇，虽是四五岁的孩子也不至于此，——我们不要小觑了孩子。人也许能受“某种报纸的催眠”，但也因人而异，“某君”只限于“某种”；即如我，就决不受《现代评论》或“女大学生某次宣言”的催眠。假如，倘使我看了《闲话》之后，便抚心自问：“要是二百人中有一百九十九人入了女大便怎样？……维持会维持的究竟是谁呢？……”那可真要连自己也奇怪起来，立刻对章士钊的木主肃然起敬了。但幸而连陈源教授所据为典要的《女大学生二次宣言》也还说有二十人，所以我也正不必有什么“杞天之虑”。
I think these wonderful questions are probably unanswerable. This is really a bizarre question, even if it is a four or five-year-old child,—— let's not underestimate the child. Unfortunately, just like the flickering and flickering of "axioms", the market price of "few" is also different in four seasons. When Yang Yinyu was in power, the majority should not "oppress" the minority, but now the minority should obey the majority. postscript本书中至少有两处，还得稍加说明——
There are at least two places in this book, and I have to explain a little -一，徐旭生先生第一次回信中所引的话，是出于ZM君登在《京报副刊》（十四年三月八日）上的一篇文章的。其时我正因为回答“青年必读书”，说“不能作文算什么大不了的事”，很受着几位青年的攻击。ZM君便发表了我在讲堂上口说的话，大约意在申明我的意思，给我解围。现在就钞一点在下面——
First, the words quoted in Mr. Xu Xusheng's first reply are from an article by ZM Jundeng in the Beijing News Supplement (March 8, 14). At that time, I was attacked by several young people because I answered "young people must read" and said, "Not being able to write is a big deal". ZM Jun then expressed what I said in the lecture hall, probably to affirm my meaning and relieve me. Now a little bit of money is below-读了许多名人学者给我们开的必读书目，引起不少的感想；但最打动我的是鲁迅先生的两句附注，……因这几句话，又想起他所讲的一段笑话来。他似乎这样说：
I have read the must-read books given to us by many celebrities and scholars, which has aroused a lot of feelings; But what moved me the most were Mr. Lu Xun's two notes,...... Because of these words, I remembered a joke he had told. He seems to say this:“‘讲话和写文章，似乎都是失败者的征象。正在和运命恶战的人，顾不到这些；真有实力的胜利者也多不做声。譬如鹰攫兔子，叫喊的是兔子不是鹰；猫捕老鼠，啼呼的是老鼠不是猫……。又好像楚霸王……追奔逐北的时候，他并不说什么；等到摆出诗人面孔，饮酒唱歌，那已经是兵败势穷，死日临头了。最近像吴佩孚名士的“登彼西山，赋彼其诗”，齐燮元先生的“放下枪枝，拿起笔干”，更是明显的例了。’”
"'Speaking and writing articles seem to be signs of failure. those who are fighting against fate cannot take care of this; Most of the really powerful winners are silent. For example, when an eagle catches a rabbit, it shouts that the rabbit is not an eagle; Cats catch mice, crying out that mice are not cats....... It seems to be the overlord of Chu...... when chasing north, he didn't say anything; By the time he put on a poet's face, drank and sang, he was already defeated and dying. Recently, like Wu Peifu's "Climbing the West Mountain and Compose Poems", Mr. Qi Xieyuan's "Put down the gun and pick up the pen and drying" are obvious examples. ’”二，近几年来，常听到人们说学生嚣张，不单是老先生，连刚出学校而做了小官或教员的也往往这么说。但我却并不觉得这样。记得革命以前，社会上自然还不如现在似的憎恶学生，学生也没有目下一般驯顺，单是态度，就显得桀傲，在人丛中一望可知。现在却差远了，大抵长袍大袖，温文尔雅，正如一个古之读书人。我也就在一个大学的讲堂上提起过，临末还说：其实，现在的学生是驯良的，或者竟可以说是太驯良了……。武者君登在《京报副刊》（约十四年五月初）上的一篇《温良》中，所引的就是我那时所说的这几句话。我因此又写了《忽然想到》第七篇，其中所举的例，一是前几年被称为“卖国贼”者的子弟曾大受同学唾骂，二是当时女子师范大学的学生正被同性的校长使男职员威胁。我的对于女师大风潮说话，这是第一回，过了十天，就“碰壁”；又过了十天，陈源教授就在《现代评论》上发表“流言”，过了半年，据《晨报副刊》（十五年一月三十日）所发表的陈源教授给徐志摩“诗哲”的信，则“捏造事实传布流言”的倒是我了。真是世事白云苍狗，不禁感慨系之矣！
Second, in recent years, I often hear people say that students are arrogant, not only old gentlemen, but also those who have just left school and become minor officials or teachers. But I don't think so. I remember that before the revolution, the society was naturally not as bad as it is now, and the students were not as docile as they are now. Now it is far from it, mostly in a long robe and long sleeves, gentle and elegant, just like an ancient scholar. I also mentioned it in a university lecture hall, and at the end of the day, he said: In fact, today's students are tame, or it can be said that they are too tame...... In an article "Gentleness" in the "Beijing News Supplement" (about the beginning of May of the fourteenth year), the warrior Junden quoted these few sentences that I said at that time. Therefore, I wrote the seventh article of "Sudden Thought", in which the examples given are: firstly, the children of those who were called "traitors" were scolded by their classmates a few years ago, and secondly, the students of the Women's Normal University at that time were being threatened by male staff by the president of the same sex. This is the first time I have spoken about the trend of women's normal universities, and after ten days, I will "hit a wall"; Ten days later, Professor Chen Yuan published "rumors" in the "Modern Review", and half a year later, according to the letter from Professor Chen Yuan to Xu Zhimo "Shi Zhe" published in the "Morning Post Supplement" (January 30, 15), it was me who "fabricated facts and spread rumors". It's really a white cloud dog in the world, and I can't help but feel emotional!又，我在《“公理”的把戏》中说杨荫榆女士“在太平湖饭店请客之后，任意将学生自治会员六人除名”，那地点是错误的，后来知道那时的请客是西长安街的西安饭店。等到五月二十一日即我们“碰壁”的那天，这才换了地方，“由校特请全体主任专任教员评议会会员在太平湖饭店开校务紧急会议，解决种种重要问题。”请客的饭馆是那一个，和紧要关键原没有什么大相干，但从“所有的批评都本于学理和事实”的所谓“文士”学者之流看来，也许又是“捏造事实”，而且因此就证明了凡我所说，无一句真话，甚或至于连杨荫榆女士也本无其人，都是我凭空结撰的了。这于我是很不好的，所以赶紧订正于此，庶几“收之桑榆”云。
In addition, I said in "The Trick of "Axiom" that Ms. Yang Yinyu "arbitrarily removed six student autonomy members after entertaining guests at the Taiping Lake Hotel", and the location was wrong, and later I learned that the invitation at that time was the Xi'an Hotel on West Chang'an Street. It was not until May 21, the day we "hit the wall", that we changed places, "and the school specially invited all the members of the full-time faculty council to hold an emergency meeting on school affairs at the Taipinghu Hotel to solve various important problems." The restaurant where the guests were invited had nothing to do with the critical point, but from the perspective of the so-called "scribe" scholars who "all criticism is based on theory and facts", it may be "fabricating facts", and thus proves that everything I say is not a word of truth, or even Ms. Yang Yinyu, is not a person, I wrote it out of thin air. This is very bad for me, so I quickly corrected it here, hoping to "collect it".一九二六年二月十五日校毕记。仍在绿林书屋之东壁下。

February 15, 1926 End of School. It is still under the east wall of the Green Forest Bookstore.

小引

Small quote还不满一整年，所写的杂感的分量，已有去年一年的那么多了。秋来住在海边，目前只见云水，听到的多是风涛声，几乎和社会隔绝。如果环境没有改变，大概今年不见得再有什么废话了罢。灯下无事，便将旧稿编集起来；还豫备付印，以供给要看我的杂感的主顾们。
It's less than a whole year, and the weight of the miscellaneous feelings written is as much as last year. Qiu Lai lives by the sea, and currently only sees clouds and water, and hears mostly the sound of wind and waves, almost isolated from society. If the environment hadn't changed, there might not be any more nonsense this year. When there was nothing to do under the lamp, he compiled the old manuscripts; I will also prepare a seal for the patrons who want to see my miscellaneous feelings.这里面所讲的仍然并没有宇宙的奥义和人生的真谛。不过是，将我所遇到的，所想到的，所要说的，一任它怎样浅薄，怎样偏激，有时便都用笔写了下来。说得自夸一点，就如悲喜时节的歌哭一般，那时无非借此来释愤抒情，现在更不想和谁去抢夺所谓公理或正义。你要那样，我偏要这样是有的；偏不遵命，偏不磕头是有的；偏要在庄严高尚的假面上拨它一拨也是有的，此外却毫无什么大举。名副其实，“杂感”而已。
What is said here is still not the mystery of the universe and the true meaning of life. However, I wrote down everything I encountered, thought, and said, no matter how shallow or extreme it was, sometimes I wrote it down with a pen. To put it bluntly, it is like singing and crying in the joys and sorrows, which was nothing more than a way to relieve anger and lyricism, and now I don't want to snatch the so-called axiom or justice with anyone. If you want that, I want it this way. There are those who do not obey orders and do not kowtow; There are also cases where it is necessary to pluck it on the mask of solemnity and nobility, but there is no major action besides that. As the name suggests, it is just a "mixed feeling".从一月以来的，大略都在内了；只删去了一篇。那是因为其中开列着许多人，未曾，也不易遍征同意，所以不好擅自发表。
Since January, it has been roughly included; Only one article was deleted. That's because there are many people listed in it, who have not and are not easy to obtain consent, so it is not easy to publish without authorization.书名呢？年月是改了，情形却依旧，就还叫《华盖集》。然而年月究竟是改了，因此只得添上两个字：“续编”。
What about the title of the book? The years have changed, but the situation is still the same, so it is still called "Huagai Collection". However, the year and month have changed, so two words have to be added: "continuation".一九二六年十月十四日，鲁迅记于厦门。
On October 14, 1926, Lu Xun recorded in Xiamen.

杂论管闲事·做学问·灰色等

杂论管闲事·做学问·灰色等

杂论管闲事·做学问·灰色等

Miscellaneous discussions, such as meddling, doing knowledge, gray, etc1
听说从今年起，陈源（即西滢）教授要不管闲事了；这豫言就见于《现代评论》五十六期的《闲话》里。惭愧我没有拜读这一期，因此也不知其详。要是确的呢，那么，除了用那照例的客套说声“可惜”之外，真的倒实在很诧异自己之胡涂：年纪这么大了，竟不知道阳历的十二月三十一日和一月一日之交在别人是可以发生这样的大变动。我近来对于年关颇有些神经过钝了，全不觉得怎样。其实，倘要觉得罢，可是也不胜其觉得。大家挂上五色旗，大街上搭起几坐彩坊，中间还有四个字道：“普天同庆”，据说这算是过年。大家关了门，贴上门神，爆竹毕剥砰的放起来，据说这也是过年。要是言行真跟着过年为转移，怕要转移不迭，势必至于成为转圈子。所以，神经过钝虽然有落伍之虑，但有弊必有利，却也很占一点小小的便宜的。
I heard that from this year onwards, Professor Chen Yuan (i.e. Xi Ying) will not be idle; This prophecy is found in "Gossip" in the 56th issue of "Modern Review". I'm ashamed that I didn't read this issue, so I don't know the details. If it is true, then, in addition to saying "it's a pity" in the usual polite way, I am really surprised by my own nonsense: I am so old that I don't know that such a big change can occur in others at the turn of December 31st and January 1st of the solar calendar. I've been a little dull lately, and I don't think it's anything at all. In fact, if you want to feel it, you can't help it. Everyone hung up five-color flags, set up several color workshops on the street, and there were four words in the middle: "Universal celebration", it is said that this is the New Year. Everyone closed the door, put on the door god, and put the firecrackers on the ground, which is said to be the New Year. If the words and deeds really follow the New Year, I am afraid that if I don't change, it will inevitably become a circle. Therefore, although the gods are dull and have the concern of being outdated, there are disadvantages and benefits, but they also take a small advantage.但是，还有些事我终于想不明白：即如天下有闲事，有人管闲事之类。我现在觉得世上是仿佛没有所谓闲事的，有人来管，便都和自己有点关系；即便是爱人类，也因为自己是人。假使我们知道了火星里张龙和赵虎打架，便即大有作为，请酒开会，维持张龙，或否认赵虎，那自然是颇近于管闲事了。然而火星上事，既然能够“知道”，则至少必须已经可以通信，关系也密切起来，算不得闲事了。因为既能通信，也许将来就能交通，他们终于会在我们的头顶上打架。至于咱们地球之上，即无论那一处，事事都和我们相关，然而竟不管者，或因不知道，或因管不着，非以其“闲”也。譬如英国有刘千昭雇了爱尔兰老妈子在伦敦拉出女生，在我们是闲事似的罢，其实并不，也会影响到我们这里来。留学生不是多多，多多了么？倘有合宜之处，就要引以为例，正如在文学上的引用什么莎士比亚呀，塞文狄斯呀，芮恩施呀一般。
However, there are still some things that I finally can't figure out: that is, if there are idle things in the world, some people are nosy. I now feel that there is no such thing as idle things in the world, and if someone takes care of it, it has something to do with me; Even if you love humans, it is because you are human. If we know that Zhang Long and Zhao Hu are fighting on Mars, we will make a big difference, invite a drink, hold a meeting, maintain Zhang Long, or deny Zhao Hu, which is naturally quite nosy. However, since you can "know" what is happening on Mars, you must at least be able to communicate and have a close relationship, which is not idle. Because they can communicate, maybe in the future, they will finally fight over our heads. As for our earth, no matter where it is, everything is related to us, but those who don't care about it either because they don't know it, or because they can't control it, not because they are "idle". For example, Liu Qianzhao in the UK hired an Irish mother to pull out girls in London, which seems to be idle to us, but in fact, it is not, and it will affect us. Isn't there a lot of international students? If there is a place where it is appropriate, it should be cited as an example, just as Shakespeare, Severndis, and Reensch are quoted in literature.（不对，错了。芮恩施是美国的驻华公使，不是文学家。我大约因为在讲什么文艺学术的一篇论文上见过他的名字，所以一不小心便带出来了。合即订正于此，尚希读者谅之。）
(No, wrong.) Reinsch is the U.S. minister to China, not a writer. I probably saw his name in a paper on literature and art scholarship, so I accidentally brought it out. I hope readers will understand this. ）即使是动物，也怎能和我们不相干？青蝇的脚上有一个霍乱菌，蚊子的唾沫里有两个疟疾菌，就说不定会钻进谁的血里去。管到“邻猫生子”，很有人以为笑谈，其实却正与自己大有相关。譬如我的院子里，现在就有四匹邻猫常常吵架了，倘使这些太太们之一又诞育四匹，则三四月后，我就得常听到八匹猫们常常吵闹，比现在加倍地心烦。
How can even animals have nothing to do with us? There is a cholera bacterium on the feet of a green fly, and two malaria bacteria in the saliva of a mosquito, so it may burrow into someone's blood. When it comes to "neighboring cats giving birth", many people think it is a joke, but in fact it has a lot to do with themselves. For example, in my yard, there are now four neighboring cats who often quarrel, and if one of these wives gives birth to four, then after three or four months, I will often hear the eight cats making noise, and I will be doubly upset than now.所以我就有了一种偏见，以为天下本无所谓闲事，只因为没有这许多遍管的精神和力量，于是便只好抓一点来管。为什么独抓这一点呢？自然是最和自己相关的，大则因为同是人类，或是同类，同志；小则，因为是同学，亲戚，同乡，——至少，也大概叨光过什么，虽然自己的显在意识上并不了然，或者其实了然，而故意装痴作傻。
So I have a prejudice that the world doesn't matter, just because I don't have so many omnidirectional spirits and powers, so I have to grasp a little bit of it. Why do you grasp this alone? Nature is the most related to oneself, and it is largely because it is the same human being, or the same kind, comrades; Xiao Ze, because he is a classmate, relative, fellow townsman,—— at least, he has probably talked about something, although his consciousness is not clear, or he actually knows, and deliberately pretends to be stupid.但陈源教授据说是去年却管了闲事了，要是我上文所说的并不错，那就确是一个超人。今年不问世事，也委实是可惜之至，真是斯人不管，“如苍生何”了。幸而阴历的过年又快到了，除夕的亥时一过，也许又可望心回意转的罢。
But Professor Chen Yuan is said to have meddled his own business last year, and if what I said above is not good, then he is indeed a superman. This year, it is a pity that we do not care about the world, and it is really a pity that people do not care. Fortunately, the Chinese New Year of the lunar calendar is approaching, and once the pig hour of Chinese New Year's Eve passes, it may be possible to change your mind again.

杂论管闲事·做学问·灰色等

2
昨天下午我从沙滩回家的时候，知道大琦君来访过我了。这使我很高兴，因为我是猜想他进了病院的了，现在知道并没有。而尤其使我高兴的是他还留赠我一本《现代评论增刊》，只要一看见封面上画着的一枝细长的蜡烛，便明白这是光明之象，更何况还有许多名人学者的著作，更何况其中还有陈源教授的一篇《做学问的工具》呢？这是正论，至少可以赛过“闲话”的；至少，是我觉得赛过“闲话”，因为它给了我许多东西。
When I came home from the beach yesterday afternoon, I knew that Daqijun had visited me. This made me happy because I guessed that he was in the hospital, but now I know that he hasn't. And what made me particularly happy was that he also left me a copy of the "Supplement to the Modern Review", as soon as I saw a slender candle painted on the cover, I knew that this was a sign of light, not to mention the works of many famous scholars, not to mention Professor Chen Yuan's "Tools for Learning". This is the right theory, at least it can compete with "gossip"; At least, I feel like I've been "gossiping" because it has given me a lot of things.我现在才知道南池子的“政治学会图书馆”去年“因为时局的关系，借书的成绩长进了三至七倍”了，但他“家翰笙”却还“用‘平时不烧香，临时抱佛脚’十个字形容当今学术界大部分的状况”。这很改正了我许多误解。我先已说过，现在的留学生是多多，多多了，但我总疑心他们大部分是在外国租了房子，关起门来燉牛肉吃的，而且在东京实在也看见过。那时我想：燉牛肉吃，在中国就可以，何必路远迢迢，跑到外国来呢？虽然外国讲究畜牧，或者肉里面的寄生虫可以少些，但燉烂了，即使多也就没有关系。所以，我看见回国的学者，头两年穿洋服，后来穿皮袍，昂头而走的，总疑心他是在外国亲手燉过几年牛肉的人物，而且即使有了什么事，连“佛脚”也未必肯抱的。现在知道并不然，至少是“留学欧美归国的人”并不然。但可惜中国的图书馆里的书太少了，据说北京“三十多个大学，不论国立私立，还不及我们私人的书多”云。这“我们”里面，据说第一要数“溥仪先生的教师庄士敦先生”，第二大概是“孤桐先生”即章士钊，因为在德国柏林时候，陈源教授就亲眼看见他两间屋里“几乎满床满架满桌满地，都是关于社会主义的德文书”。现在呢，想来一定是更多的了。这真教我欣羡佩服。记得自己留学时候，官费每月三十六元，支付衣食学费之外，简直没有赢余，混了几年，所有的书连一壁也遮不满，而且还是杂书，并非专而又专，如“都是关于社会主义的德文书”之类。
I only now know that Nanchizi's "Political Science Society Library" "borrowed books three to seven times because of the current situation" last year, but his "Jia Hansheng" also "used the ten words 'usually do not burn incense, cramming' to describe most of the current situation in the academic world". This corrected many of my misunderstandings. As I said earlier, there are many international students now, but I always suspect that most of them rent houses in foreign countries and eat stewed beef behind closed doors, and I have seen them in Tokyo. At that time, I thought: Beef stew can be eaten in China, why go all the way to a foreign country? Although foreign countries pay attention to animal husbandry, or the parasites in the meat can be less, but if it is stewed, it doesn't matter if there are more. Therefore, when I saw a scholar who returned to China, wearing a suit for the first two years, and then wearing a leather robe, he always suspected that he was a person who had stewed beef in a foreign country for several years, and even if something happened, he might not even be willing to hug the "Buddha's feet". Now I know that this is not the case, at least not for "people who have returned from studying in Europe and the United States". But unfortunately, there are too few books in China's libraries, and it is said that Beijing has "more than 30 universities, whether national or private, but not as many books as our private ones." Among these "we", it is said that the first is "Mr. Johnston, Mr. Puyi's teacher", and the second is probably "Mr. Gutong", that is, Zhang Shizhao, because when he was in Berlin, Germany, Professor Chen Yuan saw with his own eyes that his two rooms were "almost full of beds and shelves, all German books on socialism". Now, I think there must be more. This really makes me envious. I remember when I was studying abroad, the official fee was thirty-six yuan a month, and there was no surplus except for paying for food and clothing, and after a few years, all the books were not even covered by a wall, and they were also miscellaneous books, not specialized and specialized, such as "all German books about socialism".但是很可惜，据说当民众“再毁”这位“孤桐先生”的“寒家”时，“好像他们夫妇两位的藏书都散失了”。想那时一定是拉了几十车，向各处走散，可惜我没有去看，否则倒也是一个壮观。
But unfortunately, it is said that when the people "destroyed" the "Han family" of this "Mr. Gutong", "it seems that the collection of books of the two of them has been lost". I think there must have been dozens of cars pulled and scattered everywhere, but unfortunately I didn't go to see it, otherwise it would have been a spectacle.所以“暴民”之为“正人君子”所深恶痛绝，也实在有理由，即如这回之“散失”了“孤桐先生”夫妇的藏书，其加于中国的损失，就在毁坏了三十多个国立及私立大学的图书馆之上。和这一比较，刘百昭司长的失少了家藏的公款八千元，要算小事件了，但我们所引为遗憾的是偏是章士钊刘百昭有这么多的储藏，而这些储藏偏又全都遭了劫。
Therefore, there is a reason why the "mob" is deeply hated by the "upright gentlemen", that is, the "loss" of the collection of "Mr. Gu Tong" and his wife this time has caused damage to China, which is the destruction of the libraries of more than 30 national and private universities. In comparison, Director Liu Baizhao's loss of 8,000 yuan of public funds from his family is a small incident, but what we regret is that Zhang Shizhao and Liu Baizhao have so much storage, and all of these reserves have been robbed.在幼小时候曾有一个老于世故的长辈告诫过我：你不要和没出息的担子或摊子为难，他会自己摔了，却诬赖你，说不清，也赔不完。这话于我似乎到现在还有影响，我新年去逛火神庙的庙会时，总不敢挤近玉器摊去，即使它不过摆着寥寥的几件。怕的是一不小心，将它碰倒了，或者摔碎了一两件，就要变成宝贝，一辈子赔不完，那罪孽之重，会在毁坏一坐博物馆之上。而且推而广之，连热闹场中也不大去了，那一回的示威运动时，虽有“打落门牙”的“流言”，其实却躺在家里，托福无恙。但那两屋子“关于社会主义的德文书”以及其他从“孤桐先生”府上陆续散出的壮观，却也因此“交臂失之”了。这实在也就是所谓“有一利必有一弊”，无法两全的。
When I was a child, an elder who was old and sophisticated warned me: Don't be embarrassed by a burden or stall that is not promising, he will fall by himself, but he will slander you, and he can't say it clearly, and he can't compensate for it. This seems to have an impact on me to this day, when I go to the temple fair of the Fire Temple in the New Year, I always dare not squeeze close to the jade stall, even if it only has a few pieces. What I am afraid of is that if I accidentally knock it over, or break one or two pieces, it will become a treasure, and I will not be able to pay it for a lifetime, and the weight of the sin will be on the destruction of a museum. And by extension, even the lively scene is not much, during that demonstration, although there were "rumors" that "knock out the front teeth", in fact, they were lying at home, and the TOEFL was unharmed. But the "German Documents on Socialism" and other spectacular things that emanated from the house of "Mr. Gu Tong" in those two rooms were also "lost". This is really the so-called "there must be one benefit and one disadvantage", and it is impossible to have both.现在是收藏洋书之富，私人要数庄士敦先生，公团要推“政治学会图书馆”了，只可惜一个是外国人，一个是靠着美国公使芮恩施竭力提倡出来的。“北京国立图书馆”将要扩张，实在是再好没有的事，但听说所依靠的还是美国退还的赔款，常年经费又不过三万元，每月二千余。要用美国的赔款，也是非同小可的事，第一，馆长就必须学贯中西，世界闻名的学者。据说，这自然只有梁启超先生了，但可惜西学不大贯，所以配上一个北大教授李四光先生做副馆长，凑成一个中外兼通的完人。然而两位的薪水每月就要一千多，所以此后也似乎不大能够多买书籍。这也就是所谓“有利必有弊”罢，想到这里，我们就更不能不痛切地感到“孤桐先生”独力购置的几房子好书惨遭散失之可惜了。
Now it is a wealth of foreign books, and the private sector is Mr. Johnston, and the public corporation is going to promote the "Political Science Society Library", but unfortunately one is a foreigner, and the other is advocated by the American minister Ryan Ensche. The "Beijing National Library" is about to expand, which is really a good thing, but I heard that it still relies on the reparations returned by the United States, and the annual budget is only 30,000 yuan, more than 2,000 yuan per month. It is not a trivial matter to use the reparations of the United States, first, the curator must be a world-renowned scholar who is well-versed in Chinese and Western languages. It is said that this is naturally only Mr. Liang Qichao, but unfortunately Western studies are not very popular, so with a Peking University professor Mr. Li Siguang as the deputy curator, he made up a perfect person who is both Chinese and foreign. This is the so-called "there must be pros and cons", thinking of this, we can't help but feel the pity that several good books purchased by "Mr. Gu Tong" alone were lost.总之，在近几年中，是未必能有较好的“做学问的工具”的，学者要用功，只好是自己买书读，但又没有钱。听说“孤桐先生”倒是想到了这一节，曾经发表过文章，然而下台了，很可惜。学者们另外还有什么法子呢，自然“也难怪他们除了说说‘闲话’便没有什么可干”，虽然北京三十多个大学还不及他们“私人的书多”。为什么呢？要知道做学问不是容易事，“也许一个小小的题目得参考百十种书”，连“孤桐先生”的藏书也未必够用。陈源教授就举着一个例：“就以‘四书’来说”罢，“不研究汉宋明清许多儒家的注疏理论，‘四书’的真正意义是不易领会的。短短的一部‘四书’，如果细细的研究起来，就得用得了几百几千种参考书”。
In short, in recent years, there may not be a better "tool for learning", and scholars have to work hard, so they have to buy books to read by themselves, but they have no money. 杂论管闲事·做学问·灰色等

finish现在不高兴写下去了，只好就此完结。总之：将《现代评论增刊》略翻一遍，就觉得五光十色，正如看见有一回广告上所开列的作者的名单。例如李仲揆教授的《生命的研究》呀，胡适教授的《译诗三首》呀，徐志摩先生的译诗一首呀，西林氏的《压迫》呀，陶孟和教授的要到二〇二五年才发表而必须我们的玄孙才能全部拜读的大著作的一部分呀……。但是，翻下去时，不知怎的我的眼睛却看见灰色了，于是乎抛开。
Now I'm not happy to write it, so I have to end it. In short: A slight flip through the "Supplement to the Modern Review" makes you feel colorful, just like seeing the list of authors listed in an advertisement once. For example, Professor Li Zhongkui's "Study of Life", Professor Hu Shi's "Three Translated Poems", Mr. Xu Zhimo's translated poem, Xilin's "Oppression", and Professor Tao Menghe's "Part of the great work that will not be published until 2025 and must be read by our great-grandchildren....... However, when I turned it over, somehow my eyes saw gray, so I put it away.现在的小学生就能玩七色板，将七种颜色涂在圆板上，停着的时候，是好看的，一转，便变成灰色，——本该是白色的罢，可是涂得不得法，变成灰色了。收罗许多著名学者的大著作的大报，自然是光怪陆离，但也是转不得，转一周，就不免要显出灰色来，虽然也许这倒正是它的特色。
Nowadays, primary school students can play with seven-color boards, paint seven colors on the round board, when it is stopped, it is good-looking, and when it turns, it turns gray,—— it should be white, but it is not painted properly, it becomes gray. The big newspaper, which contains the great works of many famous scholars, is naturally bizarre, but it cannot be turned, and after a week, it will inevitably appear gray, although perhaps this is its characteristic.一月三日。

有趣的消息

Interesting news虽说北京像一片大沙漠，青年们却还向这里跑；老年们也不大走，即或有到别处去走一趟的，不久就转回来了，仿佛倒是北京还很有什么可以留恋。厌世诗人的怨人生，真是“感慨系之矣”，然而他总活着；连祖述释迦牟尼先生的哲人勗本华尔也不免暗地里吃一种医治什么病症的药，不肯轻易“涅槃”。俗语说：“好死不如恶活”，这当然不过是俗人的俗见罢了，可是文人学者之流也何尝不这样。所不同的，只是他总有一面辞严义正的军旗，还有一条尤其义正辞严的逃路。真的，倘不这样，人生可真要无聊透顶，无话可说了。
Although Beijing is like a big desert, young people still run here; The elderly don't go much, even if they go to other places, they will soon turn back, as if there is still something to miss in Beijing. The world-weary poet's resentful life is really "tied to emotion", but he is always alive; Even the philosopher of Mr. Shakyamuni, Ben Wal, secretly took a medicine to treat any disease and refused to "nirvana" easily. As the saying goes: "It is better to die than to live evil", this is of course just a common view of ordinary people, but literati and scholars are not like this. The difference is that he always has a military flag that is strict and righteous, and there is a way out of escape. Really, if this is not the case, life will be really boring and there will be nothing to say.北京就是一天一天地百物昂贵起来；自己的“区区佥事”，又因为“妄有主张”，被章士钊先生革掉了。向来所遭遇的呢，借了安特来夫的话来说，是“没有花，没有诗”，就只有百物昂贵。然而也还是“妄有主张”，没法回头；倘使有一个妹子，如《晨报副刊》上所艳称的“闲话先生”的家事似的，叫道：“阿哥！”那声音正如“银铃之响于幽谷”，向我求告，“你不要再做文章得罪人家了，好不好？”我也许可以借此拨转马头，躲到别墅里去研究汉朝人所做的“四书”注疏和理论去。然而，惜哉，没有这样的好妹子；“女媭之婵媛兮，申申其詈予，曰：鲧婞直以亡身兮，终然殀乎羽之野。”连有一个那样凶姊姊的幸福也不及屈灵均。我的终于“妄有主张”，或者也许是无可推托之故罢。然而这关系非同小可，将来怕要遭殃了，因为我知道，得罪人是要得到报应的。
Beijing is becoming more expensive day by day; His own "mere assistant" was dismissed by Mr. Zhang Shizhao because of "arrogant claims". What has always been encountered, in Antref's words, is "no flowers, no poetry", only everything is expensive. However, it is still "arrogant" and there is no turning back; If there is a girl, like the family affairs of the "Mr. Gossip Talk" flamboyantly called in the "Morning News Supplement", she will shout: "Brother! The voice was like "the silver bell rings in the valley", begging me, "Don't offend others by making a fuss anymore, okay?" "I may be able to take this opportunity to turn my head and hide in the villa to study the annotations and theories of the "Four Books" made by the Han Dynasty. However, unfortunately, there is no such good girl; "The beautiful woman of the concubine, repeatedly scolding me, saying: Gun Cheng died in the wilderness of Yu." Even the happiness of having such a fierce sister is not as good as Qu Lingjun's. My finally "arrogant claims", or maybe there is no excuse. However, this relationship is not trivial, and I am afraid that I will suffer in the future, because I know that offending people will be retributed.话要回到释迦先生的教训去了，据说：活在人间，还不如下地狱的稳妥。做人有“作”就是动作（＝造孽），下地狱却只有“报”（＝报应）了；所以生活是下地狱的原因，而下地狱倒是出地狱的起点。这样说来，实在令人有些想做和尚，但这自然也只限于“有根”（据说，这是“一句天津话”）的大人物，我却不大相信这一类鬼画符。活在沙漠似的北京城里，枯燥当然是枯燥的，但偶然看看世态，除了百物昂贵之外，究竟还是五花八门，创造艺术的也有，制造流言的也有，肉麻的也有，有趣的也有……这大概就是北京之所以为北京的缘故，也就是人们总还要奔凑聚集的缘故。可惜的是只有一些小玩意，老实一点的朋友就难于给自己竖起一杆辞严义正的军旗来。
Going back to the lesson of Mr. Shakyamuni, it is said that living in the world is not as safe as going to hell. "doing" is action (= committing evil), but going to hell is only "retribution" (= retribution); Therefore, life is the reason for going to hell, and going to hell is the starting point of going out of hell. In this way, it really makes people want to be a monk, but this is naturally limited to the big people who have "roots" (it is said that this is "a sentence of Tianjin"), but I don't really believe in this kind of ghost painting. 学界的三魂

学界的三魂

学界的三魂

The three souls of the school world从《京报副刊》上知道有一种叫《国魂》的期刊，曾有一篇文章说章士钊固然不好，然而反对章士钊的“学匪”们也应该打倒。我不知道大意是否真如我所记得？但这也没有什么关系，因为不过引起我想到一个题目，和那原文是不相干的。意思是，中国旧说，本以为人有三魂六魄，或云七魄；国魂也该这样。而这三魂之中，似乎一是“官魂”，一是“匪魂”，还有一个是什么呢？也许是“民魂”罢，我不很能够决定。又因为我的见闻很偏隘，所以未敢悉指中国全社会，只好缩而小之曰“学界”。
From the "Beijing News Supplement", I know that there is a journal called "National Soul", and there was an article saying that Zhang Shizhao is not good, but the "student bandits" who oppose Zhang Shizhao should also be defeated. I don't know if the gist is really as I remember? But it doesn't matter, because it just reminds me of a topic that has nothing to do with the original text. This means that the old Chinese saying originally thought that people have three souls and six souls, or seven souls; The soul of the country should be like this. And among these three souls, it seems that one is the "official soul" and the other is the "bandit soul", what is the other one? Maybe it's the "soul of the people", I can't decide. And because my experience is very narrow, I did not dare to refer to the whole Chinese society, so I had to shorten it to "academic circles".中国人的官瘾实在深，汉重孝廉而有埋儿刻木，宋重理学而有高帽破靴，清重帖括而有“且夫”“然则”。总而言之：那魂灵就在做官，——行官势，摆官腔，打官话。顶着一个皇帝做傀儡，得罪了官就是得罪了皇帝，于是那些人就得了雅号曰“匪徒”。学界的打官话是始于去年，凡反对章士钊的都得了“土匪”，“学匪”，“学棍”的称号，但仍然不知道从谁的口中说出，所以还不外乎一种“流言”。
The Chinese are really addicted to officials, the Han Dynasty emphasized filial piety and carved wood, the Song Dynasty emphasized science and had high hats and broken boots, and the Qing and Zhong were "Qiefu" and "Ranze". All in all: the soul is doing official ,—— acting officially, putting on an official tone, and speaking official language. Being a puppet in front of an emperor, offending an official is offending the emperor, so those people are nicknamed "bandits". The official rhetoric in the academic circles began last year, and everyone who opposed Zhang Shizhao was awarded the titles of "bandit", "student bandit", and "student stick", but they still didn't know from whose mouth they said it, so it was nothing more than a "rumor".但这也足见去年学界之糟了，竟破天荒的有了学匪。以大点的国事来比罢，太平盛世，是没有匪的；待到群盗如毛时，看旧史，一定是外戚，宦官，奸臣，小人当国，即使大打一通官话，那结果也还是“呜呼哀哉”。当这“呜呼哀哉”之前，小民便大抵相率而为盗，所以我相信源增先生的话：“表面上看只是些土匪与强盗，其实是农民革命军。”（《国民新报副刊》四三）那么，社会不是改进了么？并不，我虽然也是被谥为“土匪”之一，却并不想为老前辈们饰非掩过。农民是不来夺取政权的，源增先生又道：“任三五热心家将皇帝推倒，自己过皇帝瘾去。”但这时候，匪便被称为帝，除遗老外，文人学者却都来恭维，又称反对他的为匪了。
But this also shows that last year's academic circles were bad, and there were unprecedented student bandits. Compared with the larger state affairs, there are no bandits in a peaceful and prosperous world; When the bandits are like hair, looking at the old history, it must be foreign relatives, eunuchs, traitors, and villains in power. Before this "oh sadness", the common people mostly became thieves, so I believe Mr. Genzeng's words: "On the surface, they are just bandits and robbers, but in fact they are the peasant revolutionary army." ("National News Supplement" 43) So, hasn't society improved? No, although I am also posthumously named one of the "bandits", I don't want to cover up the old-timers. The peasants did not come to seize power, and Mr. Yuan Zeng said: "Ren Sanwu enthusiasts pushed the emperor down and became addicted to the emperor himself. But at this time, the bandits were called emperors, and in addition to the old people, literati and scholars came to compliment, also known as bandits who opposed him.所以中国的国魂里大概总有这两种魂：官魂和匪魂。这也并非硬要将我辈的魂挤进国魂里去，贪图与教授名流的魂为伍，只因为事实仿佛是这样。社会诸色人等，爱看《双官诰》，也爱看《四杰村》，望偏安巴蜀的刘玄德成功，也愿意打家劫舍的宋公明得法；至少，是受了官的恩惠时候则艳羡官僚，受了官的剥削时候便同情匪类。但这也是人情之常；倘使连这一点反抗心都没有，岂不就成为万劫不复的奴才了？
Therefore, there are probably two kinds of souls in China's national soul: official soul and bandit soul. This is not to squeeze the soul of our generation into the soul of the country, and to be with the souls of professors and celebrities, just because the fact seems to be so. People of all kinds in society love to watch "Shuangguan Edict", but also love to watch "Sijie Village", hoping that Liu Xuande, who is biased towards Anbashu, will succeed, and Song Gongming, who is willing to rob his house, will get the law; At least, when they are favored by officials, they envy bureaucrats, and when they are exploited by officials, they sympathize with bandits. But this is also a common occurrence; If you don't even have this sense of resistance, won't you become an irreversible slave?然而国情不同，国魂也就两样。记得在日本留学时候，有些同学问我在中国最有大利的买卖是什么，我答道：“造反。”他们便大骇怪。在万世一系的国度里，那时听到皇帝可以一脚踢落，就如我们听说父母可以一棒打杀一般。为一部分士女所心悦诚服的李景林先生，可就深知此意了，要是报纸上所传非虚。今天的《京报》即载着他对某外交官的谈话道：“予预计于旧历正月间，当能与君在天津晤谈；若天津攻击竟至失败，则拟俟三四月间卷土重来，若再失败，则暂投土匪，徐养兵力，以待时机”云。但他所希望的不是做皇帝，那大概是因为中华民国之故罢。
However, the national conditions are different, and the national soul is also different. I remember when I was studying in Japan, some classmates asked me what was the most profitable trade in China, and I replied, "Rebellion." They were shocked. In the kingdom of the eternal lineage, we heard that the emperor could be kicked down, just as we heard that parents could be beaten to death with a stick. Mr. Li Jinglin, who is sincerely convinced by some men and women, knows this very well, if what is rumored in the newspaper is true. Today's "Beijing News" contains his conversation with a diplomat: "I expect that in the first month of the old calendar, I will be able to meet with you in Tianjin; If the attack on Tianjin fails, it is planned to make a comeback in March or April, and if it fails again, it will temporarily surrender to the bandits and slowly raise troops to wait for the opportunity." But what he wanted was not to be an emperor, it was probably because of the Republic of China.所谓学界，是一种发生较新的阶级，本该可以有将旧魂灵略加湔洗之望了，但听到“学官”的官话，和“学匪”的新名，则似乎还走着旧道路。那末，当然也得打倒的。这来打倒他的是“民魂”，是国魂的第三种。先前不很发扬，所以一闹之后，终不自取政权，而只“任三五热心家将皇帝推倒，自己过皇帝瘾去”了。
The so-called academic circle is a relatively new class, which should have the hope of washing away the old soul a little, but hearing the official language of "academic official" and the new name of "scholar bandit", it seems that it is still following the old path. In that case, of course, it has to be defeated. What came to overthrow him was the "people's soul", the third type of national soul. It was not very promoted before, so after a fuss, he did not take power for himself, but only "let the three or five enthusiasts push the emperor down and live the emperor's addiction by himself".惟有民魂是值得宝贵的，惟有他发扬起来，中国才有真进步。但是，当此连学界也倒走旧路的时候，怎能轻易地发挥得出来呢？在乌烟瘴气之中，有官之所谓“匪”和民之所谓匪；有官之所谓“民”和民之所谓民；有官以为“匪”而其实是真的国民，有官以为“民”而其实是衙役和马弁。所以貌似“民魂”的，有时仍不免为“官魂”，这是鉴别魂灵者所应该十分注意的。
Only the soul of the people is precious, and only when he carries it forward can China make real progress. However, when even the academic community goes backwards, how can it be easily exerted? In the miasma, there are the so-called "bandits" of the officials and the so-called bandits of the people; there are the so-called "people" of officials and the so-called people of the people; Some officials think they are "bandits" but are actually real citizens, and some officials think they are "people" but are actually yamen and horses. Therefore, what seems to be a "people's soul" is sometimes still an "official soul", which is something that those who identify souls should pay great attention to.话又说远了，回到本题去。去年，自从章士钊提了“整顿学风”的招牌，上了教育总长的大任之后，学界里就官气弥漫，顺我者“通”，逆我者“匪”，官腔官话的余气，至今还没有完。但学界却也幸而因此分清了颜色；只是代表官魂的还不是章士钊，因为上头还有“减膳”执政在，他至多不过做了一个官魄；现在是在天津“徐养兵力，以待时机”了。我不看《甲寅》，不知道说些什么话：官话呢，匪话呢，民话呢，衙役马弁话呢？……
Speaking of which, let's go back to the topic. Last year, since Zhang Shizhao put forward the signboard of "rectifying the academic style" and took up the post of chief of education, the academic circles have been filled with officialdom. But the academic community is fortunate to distinguish the colors; It's just that it is not Zhang Shizhao who represents the soul of the official, because there is still a "reduced meal" in power, and he is at most an official soul; Now it is time to "raise troops in Tianjin and wait for the opportunity". I don't read "Jiayin", I don't know what to say: what about the official language, what about the bandit language, what about the folk language, what about the yamen Ma Bian? ……一月二十四日。
