古书与白话

古书与白话

古书与白话

Ancient books and vernacular记得提倡白话那时，受了许多谣诼诬谤，而白话终于没有跌倒的时候，就有些人改口说：然而不读古书，白话是做不好的。我们自然应该曲谅这些保古家的苦心，但也不能不悯笑他们这祖传的成法。凡有读过一点古书的人都有这一种老手段：新起的思想，就是“异端”，必须歼灭的，待到它奋斗之后，自己站住了，这才寻出它原来与“圣教同源”；外来的事物，都要“用夷变夏”，必须排除的，但待到这“夷”入主中夏，却考订出来了，原来连这“夷”也还是黄帝的子孙。这岂非出人意料之外的事呢？无论什么，在我们的“古”里竟无不包函了！
I remember that when I advocated the vernacular, I was slandered by many rumors, and when the vernacular finally did not fall, some people changed their words and said: However, if you don't read ancient books, the vernacular will not be good. Naturally, we should forgive the painstaking efforts of these ancient preservation families, but we can't help but laugh at their ancestral law. Anyone who has read a little ancient book has this old method: the new idea, which is "heresy", must be annihilated, and after it struggles, it stands on its own, and only then can it find its original "holy religion"; Foreign things must be "used to change Xia", which must be excluded, but when this "Yi" entered the Central Xia, it was examined, and it turned out that even this "Yi" was still a descendant of the Yellow Emperor. Isn't this unexpected? No matter what, there is nothing in our "ancient" that is not included!用老手段的自然不会长进，到现在仍是说非“读破几百卷书者”即做不出好白话文，于是硬拉吴稚晖先生为例。可是竟又会有“肉麻当有趣”，述说得津津有味的，天下事真是千奇百怪。其实吴先生的“用讲话体为文”，即“其貌”也何尝与“黄口小儿所作若同”。不是“纵笔所之，辄万数千言”么？其中自然有古典，为“黄口小儿”所不知，尤有新典，为“束发小生”所不晓。清光绪末，我初到日本东京时，这位吴稚晖先生已在和公使蔡钧大战了，其战史就有这么长，则见闻之多，自然非现在的“黄口小儿”所能企及。所以他的遣辞用典，有许多地方是惟独熟于大小故事的人物才能够了然，从青年看来，第一是惊异于那文辞的滂沛。这或者就是名流学者们所认为长处的罢，但是，那生命却不在于此。甚至于竟和名流学者们所拉拢恭维的相反，而在自己并不故意显出长处，也无法灭去名流学者们的所谓长处；只将所说所写，作为改革道中的桥梁，或者竟并不想到作为改革道中的桥梁。
Naturally, those who use old methods will not grow, and it is still said that they cannot make good vernacular prose unless they "read through hundreds of volumes", so Mr. Wu Zhihui is taken as an example. But there will be "meat and hemp should be interesting", which is told with relish, and the things in the world are really strange. In fact, Mr. Wu's "use the speech style as a text", that is, "its appearance", is not the same as "what the yellow-mouthed child does". Isn't it "wherever the pen goes, there are thousands of words"? Among them, there are naturally classics, which are unknown to the "yellow-mouthed children", especially the new classics, which are not understood by the "bundled hair". At the end of the Qing Dynasty, when I first arrived in Tokyo, Japan, this Mr. Wu Zhihui was already fighting with the minister Cai Jun, and his war history was so long, so he saw and heard a lot, which was naturally beyond the reach of the current "yellow-mouthed children". Therefore, there are many places in his dictionary that can only be understood by characters who are familiar with large and small stories, and from the perspective of young people, the first is to be amazed by the peiness of the words. This may be what celebrities and scholars think is their strength, but life is not here. Even contrary to the compliments of celebrity scholars, and if they do not deliberately show their strengths, they cannot eliminate the so-called strengths of celebrity scholars; Only what is said and written is used as a bridge in the reform road, or it is not intended as a bridge in the reform road.愈是无聊赖，没出息的脚色，愈想长寿，想不朽，愈喜欢多照自己的照相，愈要占据别人的心，愈善于摆臭架子。但是，似乎“下意识”里，究竟也觉得自己之无聊的罢，便只好将还未朽尽的“古”一口咬住，希图做着肠子里的寄生虫，一同传世；或者在白话文之类里找出一点古气，反过来替古董增加宠荣。如果“不朽之大业”不过这样，那未免太可怜了罢。而且，到了二九二五年，“黄口小儿”们还要看什么《甲寅》之流，也未免过于可惨罢，即使它“自从孤桐先生下台之后，……也渐渐的有了生气了”。
The more boring and unpromising you are, the more you want to live a long life, the more you want to be immortal, the more you like to take pictures of yourself, the more you want to occupy the hearts of others, and the better you are at putting on a stinky show. However, it seems that "subconsciously", I also feel that I am bored, so I have to bite the "ancient" that has not yet decayed, hoping to be a parasite in the intestines and pass it on to the world together; Or find a little antiquity in the vernacular, which in turn increases the favor of antiques. If the "Great Cause of Immortality" is just like this, it will be too pitiful. Moreover, by 2925, it would be too miserable for the "yellow-mouthed children" to watch "Jiayin" and the like, even if it was "since Mr. Gutong stepped down,...... I gradually became angry."菲薄古书者，惟读过古书者最有力，这是的确的。因为他洞知弊病，能“以子之矛攻子之盾”，正如要说明吸雅片的弊害，大概惟吸过雅片者最为深知，最为痛切一般。但即使“束发小生”，也何至于说，要做戒绝雅片的文章，也得先吸尽几百两雅片才好呢。
It is true that only those who have read ancient books are the most powerful. Because he knows the shortcomings and can "attack the shield of the son with the spear of the son", just as to illustrate the disadvantages of smoking elegant films, it is probably the most deeply known and painful only for those who have smoked elegant films. But even if you are a "bundled hair", how can you say that if you want to make an article about quitting elegant films, you have to absorb hundreds of taels of elegant films first.古文已经死掉了；白话文还是改革道上的桥梁，因为人类还在进化。便是文章，也未必独有万古不磨的典则。虽然据说美国的某处已经禁讲进化论了，但在实际上，恐怕也终于没有效的。
The ancient text is dead; Vernacular is still a bridge on the road to reform, because humans are still evolving. Even if it is an article, it may not be unique to the eternal rules. Although it is said that evolution has been banned somewhere in the United States, in reality, it may not be effective at all.一月二十五日。

一点比喻

一点比喻

一点比喻

A little metaphor在我的故乡不大通行吃羊肉，阖城里，每天大约不过杀几匹山羊。北京真是人海，情形可大不相同了，单是羊肉铺就触目皆是。雪白的群羊也常常满街走，但都是胡羊，在我们那里称绵羊的。山羊很少见；听说这在北京却颇名贵了，因为比胡羊聪明，能够率领羊群，悉依它的进止，所以畜牧家虽然偶而养几匹，却只用作胡羊们的领导，并不杀掉它。
In my hometown, mutton is not widely eaten, and in the whole city, only a few goats are killed every day. Beijing is really a sea of people, the situation is very different, just the mutton shop is everywhere. Snow-white sheep often walk all over the streets, but they are all Hu sheep, which we call sheep. Goats are rare; I heard that this is quite famous in Beijing, because it is smarter than the Hu sheep, can lead the sheep, and follow its progress, so although the livestock herdsman occasionally raises a few horses, they only use them as leaders for the Hu sheep and do not kill it.这样的山羊我只见过一回，确是走在一群胡羊的前面，脖子上还挂着一个小铃铎，作为智识阶级的徽章。通常，领的赶的却多是牧人，胡羊们便成了一长串，挨挨挤挤，浩浩荡荡，凝着柔顺有余的眼色，跟定他匆匆地竞奔它们的前程。我看见这种认真的忙迫的情形时，心里总想开口向它们发一句愚不可及的疑问——
I have only seen such a goat once, and it is true that it walks in front of a herd of sheep, and there is a small bell around its neck as the insignia of the intellectual class. Usually, most of the leaders were shepherds, and the sheep became a long line, crowded one after another, mighty, with a soft eye, and they hurriedly rushed to their future. When I see this serious busy situation, I always want to ask them a foolish question——“往那里去？！”
"Where are you going?!"人群中也很有这样的山羊，能领了群众稳妥平静地走去，直到他们应该走到的所在。袁世凯明白一点这种事，可惜用得不大巧，大概因为他是不很读书的，所以也就难于熟悉运用那些的奥妙。后来的武人可更蠢了，只会自己乱打乱割，乱得哀号之声，洋洋盈耳，结果是除了残虐百姓之外，还加上轻视学问，荒废教育的恶名。然而“经一事，长一智”，二十世纪已过了四分之一，脖子上挂着小铃铎的聪明人是总要交到红运的，虽然现在表面上还不免有些小挫折。
There are also such goats in the crowd, who can lead the masses to walk safely and calmly until they are where they should go. Yuan Shikai understood a little bit of this kind of thing, but unfortunately he didn't use it very coincidentally, probably because he was not very well-read, so it was difficult to be familiar with the mysteries of using them. The later warriors were even more stupid, they would only beat and cut indiscriminately, making the sound of wailing and full of ears, and the result was that in addition to cruelizing the people, they also added the notoriety of despising learning and abandoning education. However, a quarter of the twentieth century has passed, and smart people with small bells around their necks always have to hand over red luck, although there are still some small setbacks on the surface.那时候，人们，尤其是青年，就都循规蹈矩，既不嚣张，也不浮动，一心向着“正路”前进了，只要没有人问——
At that time, people, especially young people, were following the rules, neither arrogant nor floating, and were bent on moving towards the "right path", as long as no one asked——“往那里去？！”
"Where are you going?!"
君子若曰：“羊总是羊，不成了一长串顺从地走，还有什么别的法子呢？君不见夫猪乎？拖延着，逃着，喊着，奔突着，终于也还是被捉到非去不可的地方去，那些暴动，不过是空费力气而已矣。”
If a gentleman says: "Sheep are always sheep, and if they don't become a long string of obedient people, what other way is there?" Don't you see the pig? Procrastinating, fleeing, shouting, rushing, and finally being caught in a place where he had to go, those riots were just a waste of effort. ”这是说：虽死也应该如羊，使天下太平，彼此省力。
This means that even if you die, you should be like a sheep, so that the world will be peaceful and save each other's efforts.这计划当然是很妥帖，大可佩服的。然而，君不见夫野猪乎？它以两个牙，使老猎人也不免于退避。这牙，只要猪脱出了牧豕奴所造的猪圈，走入山野，不久就会长出来。
This plan is of course very appropriate and admirable. However, don't you see the wild boar? With its two teeth, the old hunter is not immune to retreat. This tooth, as long as the pig gets out of the pigsty made by the pig slave and goes into the mountains, will soon grow out.
Schopenhauer先生曾将绅士们比作豪猪，我想，这实在有些失体统。但在他，自然是并没有什么别的恶意的，不过拉扯来作一个比喻。《Parerga und Paralipomena》里有着这样意思的话：有一群豪猪，在冬天想用了大家的体温来御寒冷，紧靠起来了，但它们彼此即刻又觉得刺的疼痛，于是乎又离开。然而温暖的必要，再使它们靠近时，却又吃了照样的苦。但它们在这两种困难中，终于发见了彼此之间的适宜的间隔，以这距离，它们能够过得最平安。人们因为社交的要求，聚在一处，又因为各有可厌的许多性质和难堪的缺陷，再使他们分离。他们最后所发见的距离，——使他们得以聚在一处的中庸的距离，就是“礼让”和“上流的风习”。有不守这距离的，在英国就这样叫，“Keep your distance！”
Mr. Schopenhauer once compared gentlemen to porcupines, which I think is a bit undecent. But in him, naturally there is no other malice, but it is pulled as a metaphor. In "Parerga und Paralipomena", there are words that mean this: There is a group of porcupines, who want to use everyone's body temperature to keep out the cold in winter, and they cling to each other, but they immediately feel the pain of each other's stings and leave. However, the need for warmth, when they were brought closer, suffered the same hardship. But in these two difficulties, they finally found a suitable distance between each other, and at this distance, they were able to live the most peacefully. People gather in one place because of the demands of socialization, and because of their many disgusting qualities and embarrassing flaws, they are separated. The distance they finally discovered ,—— the golden mean distance that allowed them to gather in one place, which was "courtesy" and "upper-class customs". Those who don't keep this distance are called in the UK, "Keep your distance!" ”但即使这样叫，恐怕也只能在豪猪和豪猪之间才有效力罢，因为它们彼此的守着距离，原因是在于痛而不在于叫的。假使豪猪们中夹着一个别的，并没有刺，则无论怎么叫，它们总还是挤过来。孔子说：礼不下庶人。照现在的情形看，该是并非庶人不得接近豪猪，却是豪猪可以任意刺着庶人而取得温暖。受伤是当然要受伤的，但这也只能怪你自己独独没有刺，不足以让他守定适当的距离。孔子又说：刑不上大夫。这就又难怪人们的要做绅士。
But even if it is called like this, I am afraid it can only be effective between porcupines and porcupines, because they keep a distance from each other, and the reason is the pain and not the barking. If the porcupines have something else in their hands and no thorns, they will always squeeze over no matter how they scream. Confucius said: Etiquette is no less than that of commoners. According to the current situation, it should not be that the common people are not allowed to approach the porcupine, but the porcupine can stab the common people at will to get warmth. Of course, injuries are injured, but this can only be blamed on yourself for not being thorny, which is not enough for him to keep an appropriate distance. Confucius also said: Punishment is not a doctor. It's no wonder that people want to be gentlemen.这些豪猪们，自然也可以用牙角或棍棒来抵御的，但至少必须拚出背一条豪猪社会所制定的罪名：“下流”或“无礼”。
These porcupines can naturally be resisted with teeth or sticks, but at least they must fight for the crime set by the porcupine society: "obscene" or "rude".一月二十五日。
January 25th.

不是信

不是信

不是信

It is not a letter一个朋友忽然寄给我一张《晨报副刊》，我就觉得有些特别，因为他是知道我懒得看这种东西的。但既然特别寄来了，姑且看题目罢：《关于下面一束通信告读者们》。署名是：志摩。哈哈，这是寄来和我开玩笑的，我想；赶紧翻转，便是几封信，这寄那，那寄这，看了几行，才知道似乎还是什么“闲话……闲话”问题。这问题我仅知道一点儿，就是曾在新潮社看见陈源教授即西滢先生的信，说及我“捏造的事实，传布的‘流言’，本来已经说不胜说”。不禁好笑；人就苦于不能将自己的灵魂砍成酱，因此能有记忆，也因此而有感慨或滑稽。记得首先根据了“流言”，来判决杨荫榆事件即女师大风潮的，正是这位西滢先生，那大文便登在去年五月三十日发行的《现代评论》上。我不该生长“某籍”又在“某系”教书，所以也被归入“暗中挑剔风潮”者之列，虽然他说还不相信，不过觉得可惜。在这里声明一句罢，以免读者的误解：“某系”云者，大约是指国文系，不是说研究系。那时我见了“流言”字样，曾经很愤然，立刻加以驳正，虽然也很自愧没有“十年读书十年养气的工夫”。不料过了半年，这些“流言”却变成由我传布的了，自造自己的“流言”，这真是自己掘坑埋自己，不必说聪明人，便是傻子也想不通。倘说这回的所谓“流言”，并非关于“某籍某系”的，乃是关于不信“流言”的陈源教授的了，则我实在不知道陈教授有怎样的被捏造的事实和流言在社会上传布。说起来惭愧煞人，我不赴宴会，很少往来，也不奔走，也不结什么文艺学术的社团，实在最不合式于做捏造事实和传布流言的枢纽。只是弄弄笔墨是在所不免的，但也不肯以流言为根据，故意给它传布开来，虽然偶有些“耳食之言”，又大抵是无关大体的事；要是错了，即使月久年深，也决不惜追加订正，例如对于汪原放先生“已作古人”一案，其间竟隔了几乎有两年。——但这自然是只对于看过《热风》的读者说的。
A friend suddenly sent me a copy of the Morning News Supplement, and I felt a little special because he knew that I was too lazy to read this kind of thing. But since it was specially sent, let's look at the title: "About the following bundle of correspondence to readers". The signature is: Shima. Haha, this was sent as a joke to me, I thought; Quickly flipped over, it was a few letters, this to that, that to send this, after reading a few lines, I realized that it seemed to be some "gossip...... gossip" question. I only know one thing about this issue, that is, I saw a letter from Professor Chen Yuan, Mr. Xi Ying, in the Xinchao Society, saying that I "fabricated facts and 'rumors' that have been spread beyond words." can't help but be funny; People suffer from not being able to cut their souls into sauce, so they can have memories, and because of this, they are emotional or funny. I remember that it was Mr. Xiying who first judged the Yang Yinyu incident, that is, the trend of women's teachers, based on "rumors", and the article was published in the "Modern Review" issued on May 30 last year. I shouldn't have grown up in a "certain place" and taught in a "certain department", so I was also included in the list of "secretly picky trends", although he said he didn't believe it, but I felt it was a pity. Just make a statement here to avoid readers' misunderstanding: "A certain department" probably refers to the Department of Chinese Literature, not the Department of Research. At that time, when I saw the word "rumor", I was very angry and immediately refuted it, although I was also ashamed that I did not have "ten years of studying and ten years of cultivating energy". Unexpectedly, after half a year, these "rumors" became spread by me, and I created my own "rumors", which is really digging a pit and burying myself, not to mention smart people, even fools can't figure it out. By the way, I would like to give a piece of advice to the enthusiastic and honest young people, that is, to hold a meeting without wine or food, don't hold it too long, if it's too late, then buy a few sesame cakes to eat. In this way, it is always easier to get results and end easily than discussions on an empty stomach.胶牙饧的强硬办法，用在灶君身上我不管它怎样，用之于活人是不大好的。倘是活人，莫妙于给他醉饱一次，使他自己不开口，却不是胶住他。中国人对人的手段颇高明，对鬼神却总有些特别，二十三夜的捉弄灶君即其一例，但说起来也奇怪，灶君竟至于到了现在，还仿佛没有省悟似的。
The tough method of glue tooth glue, I don't care what it is used on the kitchen lord, it is not good to use it on living people. If he is a living person, it is better to give him a drunken and full meal, so that he does not open his mouth, but it is not to glue him. The Chinese are quite clever in their methods towards people, but they are always a little special for ghosts and gods, and the teasing of the Stove Lord on the twenty-three nights is one of them, but it is strange to say that the Kitchen Lord still seems to have no enlightenment until now.道士们的对付“三尸神”，可是更利害了。我也没有做过道士，详细是不知道的，但据“耳食之言”，则道士们以为人身中有三尸神，到有一日，便乘人熟睡时，偷偷地上天去奏本身的过恶。这实在是人体本身中的奸细，《封神传演义》常说的“三尸神暴躁，七窍生烟”的三尸神，也就是这东西。但据说要抵制他却不难，因为他上天的日子是有一定的，只要这一日不睡觉，他便无隙可乘，只好将过恶都放在肚子里，再看明年的机会了。连胶牙饧都没得吃，他实在比灶君还不幸，值得同情。
The Taoist priests' deal with the "Three Corpse Gods" is even more beneficial. I have never been a Taoist priest, I don't know the details, but according to the "words of ear eating", the Taoist priests thought that there were three corpse gods in the human body, and one day, when they were asleep, they secretly went to heaven to play their own evils. This is really a spy in the human body itself, and the three corpse gods who often say in "The Romance of the Gods" that "the three corpse gods are irritable and the seven orifices are smoked" is this thing. But it is said that it is not difficult to resist him, because his days in heaven are certain, as long as he does not sleep on this day, he will have no opportunity to take advantage of it, so he has to put all the evils in his stomach and look at next year's opportunity. He is really more unfortunate than the Kitchen Lord, and he deserves sympathy.三尸神不上天，罪状都放在肚子里；灶君虽上天，满嘴是糖，在玉皇大帝面前含含胡胡地说了一通，又下来了。对于下界的情形，玉皇大帝一点也听不懂，一点也不知道，于是我们今年当然还是一切照旧，天下太平。
the three corpses do not go to heaven, and the crimes are all in the stomach; Although the Kitchen Lord went to heaven, his mouth was full of sugar, and he said it with a hint in front of the Jade Emperor, and then came down again. The Jade Emperor didn't understand the situation in the lower realm at all, and he didn't know anything at all, so of course we still did everything as usual this year, and the world was peaceful.我们中国人对于鬼神也有这样的手段。
We Chinese also have such methods against ghosts and gods.我们中国人虽然敬信鬼神；却以为鬼神总比人们傻，所以就用了特别的方法来处治他。至于对人，那自然是不同的了，但还是用了特别的方法来处治，只是不肯说；你一说，据说你就是卑视了他了。诚然，自以为看穿了的话，有时也的确反不免于浅薄。
Although we Chinese worship ghosts and gods; But he thought that ghosts and gods were always stupid than people, so he used a special method to deal with him. As for people, it is naturally different, but they still use special methods to deal with it, but they just refuse to say it; When you say it, it is said that you have despised him. It is true that if you think you have seen through it, sometimes it is indeed shallow.二月五日。

谈皇帝

谈皇帝

谈皇帝

Talking about the emperor中国人的对付鬼神，凶恶的是奉承，如瘟神和火神之类，老实一点的就要欺侮，例如对于土地或灶君。待遇皇帝也有类似的意思。君民本是同一民族，乱世时“成则为王败则为贼”，平常是一个照例做皇帝，许多个照例做平民；两者之间，思想本没有什么大差别。所以皇帝和大臣有“愚民政策”，百姓们也自有其“愚君政策”。
Chinese people deal with ghosts and gods, and the vicious thing is flattery, such as the plague god and the fire god, and the honest one must be bullied, such as the land or the stove lord. The treatment of the emperor has a similar meaning. The monarch and the people are originally the same people, and in troubled times, "if you succeed, you will be a king, if you lose, you will be a thief". There is no big difference in thought between the two. Therefore, the emperor and ministers have a "foolish policy", and the people also have their own "foolish policy".往昔的我家，曾有一个老仆妇，告诉过我她所知道，而且相信的对付皇帝的方法。她说——
In the past, there was an old servant woman in my family who told me what she knew and believed in dealing with the emperor. She said——“皇帝是很可怕的。他坐在龙位上，一不高兴，就要杀人；不容易对付的。所以吃的东西也不能随便给他吃，倘是不容易办到的，他吃了又要，一时办不到；——譬如他冬天想到瓜，秋天要吃桃子，办不到，他就生气，杀人了。现在是一年到头给他吃波菜，一要就有，毫不为难。但是倘说是波菜，他又要生气的，因为这是便宜货，所以大家对他就不称为波菜，另外起一个名字，叫作‘红嘴绿鹦哥’。”
"The emperor is very scary. He sits on the dragon throne, and if he is unhappy, he will kill; It's not easy to deal with. Therefore, you can't give him anything to eat, if it's not easy to do, he wants it again, and he can't do it for a while; ——For example, if he thinks of melons in winter and wants to eat peaches in autumn, but if he can't do it, he gets angry and kills people. Now I give him spinach all year round, and I have it as soon as I want it, and I don't have any difficulty. But if it is a spinach, he will be angry again, because it is a bargain, so everyone will not call him spinach, and give him another name, called 'Red-billed Green Parrot'. ”在我的故乡，是通年有波菜的，根很红，正如鹦哥的嘴一样。
In my hometown, there are spinach all year round, and the roots are very red, just like the mouth of a parrot.这样的连愚妇人看来，也是呆不可言的皇帝，似乎大可以不要了。然而并不，她以为要有的，而且应该听凭他作威作福。至于用处，仿佛在靠他来镇压比自己更强梁的别人，所以随便杀人，正是非备不可的要件。然而倘使自己遇到，且须侍奉呢？可又觉得有些危险了，因此只好又将他练成傻子，终年耐心地专吃着“红嘴绿鹦哥”。
In the eyes of such a foolish woman, he is also an unspeakable emperor, and it seems that he can not do it. However, no, she thought she had it, and she should let him do whatever he wanted. As for its usefulness, it seems that he is relying on him to suppress others who are stronger than himself, so killing people casually is an essential element. However, if you encounter it, you must serve? But he felt a little dangerous, so he had to train him into a fool again, and patiently ate the "red-billed green parrot" all year round.其实利用了他的名位，“挟天子以令诸侯”的，和我那老仆妇的意思和方法都相同，不过一则又要他弱，一则又要他愚。儒家的靠了“圣君”来行道也就是这玩意，因为要“靠”，所以要他威重，位高；因为要便于操纵，所以又要他颇老实，听话。
In fact, using his name to "threaten the emperor to command the princes" has the same meaning and method as my old servant, but one wants him to be weak, and the other wants him to be foolish. Confucianism relies on the "holy king" to practice the Tao, because it wants to "rely on", so it wants him to be dignified and high-ranking; Because it is easy to manipulate, he is also required to be honest and obedient.皇帝一自觉自己的无上威权，这就难办了。既然“普天之下，莫非皇土”，他就胡闹起来，还说是“自我得之，自我失之，我又何恨”哩！于是圣人之徒也只好请他吃“红嘴绿鹦哥”了，这就是所谓“天”。据说天子的行事，是都应该体帖天意，不能胡闹的；而这“天意”也者，又偏只有儒者们知道着。
Once the emperor realized his supreme authority, it was difficult to handle. Since "under the whole world, it is the imperial land", he started to fool around, and said that "I got it, I lost it, why do I hate it"! So the saint's disciples had to treat him to eat "red-billed green parrot", which is the so-called "sky". It is said that the actions of the Son of Heaven should be considerate of the will of heaven and should not be foolish; And this "providence" is also known only to Confucian scholars.这样，就决定了：要做皇帝就非请教他们不可。
In this way, it was decided: if you want to be emperor, you must consult them.然而不安分的皇帝又胡闹起来了。你对他说“天”么，他却道，“我生不有命在天？！”岂但不仰体上天之意而已，还逆天，背天，“射天”，简直将国家闹完，使靠天吃饭的圣贤君子们，哭不得，也笑不得。
However, the restless emperor started messing around again. Do you say "heaven" to him, but he said, "Do I have a life in heaven?!" Not only did he not look up to the will of heaven, but he also went against the sky, turned his back on the sky, and "shot at the sky", which simply made the country over, so that the sages and gentlemen who relied on the sky for food could not cry or laugh.于是乎他们只好去著书立说，将他骂一通，豫计百年之后，即身殁之后，大行于时，自以为这就了不得。
So they had no choice but to write a book and scold him, and after a hundred years, that is, after his death, it would be popular, thinking that this would be amazing.但那些书上，至多就止记着“愚民政策”和“愚君政策”全都不成功。
But those books only record that the "Foolish People's Policy" and the "Foolish Jun Policy" were all unsuccessful.二月十七日。

It's really a bad scenery, I hope I don't do this.

The British aristocracy of Bergen said: "Chinese students only know how to read English newspapers and forget the teachings of Confucius. Britain's great enemy is this kind of student who curses the empire and gloats over misfortune. …… China is the best venue for radical parties...... (London Reuters, June 30, 1925.) ）南京通信云：“基督教城中会堂聘金大教授某神学博士讲演，中有谓孔子乃耶稣之信徒，因孔子吃睡时皆祷告上帝。当有听众……质问何所据而云然；博士语塞。时乃有教徒数人，突紧闭大门，声言‘发问者，乃苏俄卢布买收来者’。当呼警捕之。……”（三月十一日《国民公报》。）
南京通信云：“基督教城中会堂聘金大教授某神学博士讲演，中有谓孔子乃耶稣之信徒，因孔子吃睡时皆祷告上帝。 当有听众…… 质问何所据而云然；博士语塞。 时乃有教徒数人，突紧闭大门，声言‘发问者，乃苏俄卢布买收来者’。 当呼警捕之。 ……”（三月十一日《国民公报》。 ）苏俄的神通真是广大，竟能买收叔梁纥，使生孔子于耶稣之前，则“忘却孔子之教”和“质问何所据而云然”者，当然都受着卢布的驱使无疑了。
The magical power of Soviet Russia is really vast, and it can buy Shu Lianghe and give birth to Confucius before Jesus, so those who "forget Confucius's teachings" and "question what is the basis for it" are of course driven by the ruble.

西滢教授曰：“听说在‘联合战线’中，关于我的流言特别多，并且据说我一个人每月可以领到三千元。‘流言’是在口上流的，在纸上到也不大见。”（《现代》六十五。）
Professor Xi Ying said: "I heard that there are a lot of rumors about me in the 'United Front', and it is said that I can receive 3,000 yuan a month alone. 'Rumors' are on the lips and are not common on paper. ("Modern" 65.) ）该教授去年是只听到关于别人的流言的，却由他在纸上发表；据说今年却听到关于自己的流言了，也由他在纸上发表。“一个人每月可以领到三千元”，实在特别荒唐，可见关于自己的“流言”都不可信。但我以为关于别人的似乎倒是近理者居多。
The professor only heard rumors about others last year, but he published them on paper; It is said that this year he heard rumors about himself, and he also published it on paper. "A person can receive 3,000 yuan a month" is really absurd, which shows that the "rumors" about oneself are not credible. But I think most of the people about others seem to be close to reason.

However, he became the secretary-general of the interim ruling government again, I wonder if "Jiayin" is still alive? If there is more, the official is still ...... done.

4
已不是写什么“无花的蔷薇”的时候了。
It's not the time to write about "flowerless roses".虽然写的多是刺，也还要些和平的心。
Although it is mostly written with thorns, it also requires some peaceful hearts.现在，听说北京城中，已经施行了大杀戮了。当我写出上面这些无聊的文字的时候，正是许多青年受弹饮刃的时候。呜呼，人和人的魂灵，是不相通的。
Now, I heard that a massacre has been carried out in Beijing. When I write these boring words, it is the time when many young people are shot. Alas, people and human souls are not connected.

5
中华民国十五年三月十八日，段祺瑞政府使卫兵用步枪大刀，在国务院门前包围虐杀徒手请愿，意在援助外交之青年男女，至数百人之多。还要下令，诬之曰“暴徒”！
On March 18, the fifteenth year of the Republic of China, Duan Qirui's government sent guards to surround and kill hundreds of young men and women in front of the State Council with rifles and knives, intending to assist hundreds of young men and women in diplomacy. He also ordered that he be falsely accused of being a "thug"!如此残虐险狠的行为，不但在禽兽中所未曾见，便是在人类中也极少有的，除却俄皇尼古拉二世使可萨克兵击杀民众的事，仅有一点相像。
Such cruel and dangerous behavior is not only unseen among beasts, but also very rare among humans, except for the fact that Emperor Nicholas II of Russia sent the Cossack soldiers to kill the people, which is only a little similar.

无花的蔷薇之二

6
中国只任虎狼侵食，谁也不管。管的只有几个年青的学生，他们本应该安心读书的，而时局漂摇得他们安心不下。假如当局者稍有良心，应如何反躬自责，激发一点天良？
China only allows tigers and wolves to erode, and no one cares. There are only a few young students in charge, who should have studied with peace of mind, but the current situation is so shaken that they are not at ease. If the authorities have a little conscience, how should they blame themselves and inspire a little conscience?然而竟将他们虐杀了！
However, they were tortured to death!

If such a young man is killed, you must know that the butcher is by no means a winner.中国要和爱国者的灭亡一同灭亡。屠杀者虽然因为积有金资，可以比较长久地养育子孙，然而必至的结果是一定要到的。“子孙绳绳”又何足喜呢？灭亡自然较迟，但他们要住最不适于居住的不毛之地，要做最深的矿洞的矿工，要操最下贱的生业……。
China will perish along with the demise of patriots. Although the butcher can raise his descendants for a longer period of time because of his accumulated money, the inevitable result must come. What is the joy of "descendants rope"? Naturally, they will perish later, but they will live in the most uninhabitable barren land, be the miners in the deepest mines, and work the lowest livelihood .......

8
如果中国还不至于灭亡，则已往的史实示教过我们，将来的事便要大出于屠杀者的意料之外——
If China does not perish, then past historical facts have taught us that the future will be beyond the expectations of the massacres-这不是一件事的结束，是一件事的开头。
This is not the end of one thing, but the beginning of something.墨写的谎说，决掩不住血写的事实。
The lies written in ink can never hide the fact that they are written in blood.血债必须用同物偿还。拖欠得愈久，就要付更大的利息！
Blood debts must be repaid with the same thing. The longer you are in arrears, the more interest you will have to pay!

What came out of the live ammunition was the blood of the youth. Blood not only does not hide the lies written in ink, but also does not get drunk on the elegy written in ink; The power can't suppress it, because it can't be deceived and can't be killed.三月十八日，民国以来最黑暗的一天，写。
March 18, the darkest day since the Republic of China, wrote.

“死地”

“死地”

“死地”

"Dead Ground"从一般人，尤其是久受异族及其奴仆鹰犬的蹂躏的中国人看来，杀人者常是胜利者，被杀者常是劣败者。而眼前的事实也确是这样。
From the perspective of ordinary people, especially the Chinese, who have long been ravaged by foreign races and their slaves and hawks, the murderer is often the winner, and the killed is often the inferior loser. And the fact in front of us is indeed the same.三月十八日段政府惨杀徒手请愿的市民和学生的事，本已言语道断，只使我们觉得所住的并非人间。但北京的所谓言论界，总算还有评论，虽然纸笔喉舌，不能使洒满府前的青年的热血逆流入体，仍复苏生转来。无非空口的呼号，和被杀的事实一同逐渐冷落。
The massacre of citizens and students who petitioned with their bare hands on March 18 has already been cut off, and it only makes us feel that we are not living in this world. However, the so-called speech circles in Beijing finally have comments, although the mouthpiece of paper and pen cannot make the blood of the young people sprinkled in front of the mansion flow back into the body, but it is still revived. It is nothing more than an empty call sign, and the fact that he was killed gradually fell out of the cold.但各种评论中，我觉得有一些比刀枪更可以惊心动魄者在。这就是几个论客，以为学生们本不应当自蹈死地，前去送死的。倘以为徒手请愿是送死，本国的政府门前是死地，那就中国人真将死无葬身之所，除非是心悦诚服地充当奴子，“没齿而无怨言”。不过我还不知道中国人的大多数人的意见究竟如何。假使也这样，则岂但执政府前，便是全中国，也无一处不是死地了。
But among the various comments, I think there are some that can be more thrilling than knives and guns. These are a few commentators who think that students should not have committed suicide and went to die. If you think that petitioning with bare hands is to die, and the front of your country's government is a place of death, then the Chinese will really die without a place to bury themselves, unless they are willing to act as slaves, "toothless and without complaints". But I don't know what the majority of Chinese people think. If this is the case, not only before the government, but also all of China, and there is no place that is not dead.人们的苦痛是不容易相通的。因为不易相通，杀人者便以杀人为唯一要道，甚至于还当作快乐。然而也因为不容易相通，所以杀人者所显示的“死之恐怖”，仍然不能够儆戒后来，使人民永远变作牛马。历史上所记的关于改革的事，总是先仆后继者，大部分自然是由于公义，但人们的未经“死之恐怖”，即不容易为“死之恐怖”所慑，我以为也是一个很大的原因。
People's pain is not easy to communicate. Because it is not easy to communicate, murderers take killing as the only way, and even regard it as happiness. However, because it is not easy to communicate, the "horror of death" shown by the murderer still cannot warn the future and turn the people into cattle and horses forever. Most of the things recorded in history about reform are always due to justice, but I think that people's lack of "terror of death", that is, not easy to be intimidated by "terror of death", is also a big reason.但我却恳切地希望：“请愿”的事，从此可以停止了。倘用了这许多血，竟换得一个这样的觉悟和决心，而且永远纪念着，则似乎还不算是很大的折本。
But I earnestly hope that the "petition" can be stopped from now on. If you use so much blood to get such a consciousness and determination, and remember it forever, it doesn't seem to be a big loss.世界的进步，当然大抵是从流血得来。但这和血的数量，是没有关系的，因为世上也尽有流血很多，而民族反而渐就灭亡的先例。即如这一回，以这许多生命的损失，仅博得“自蹈死地”的批判，便已将一部分人心的机微示给我们，知道在中国的死地是极其广博。
Of course, the progress of the world comes from bloodshed. But this has nothing to do with the amount of blood, because there are precedents in the world where a lot of blood is shed and the nation gradually perishes. That is, this time, with the loss of so many lives, only the criticism of "self-inflicted death" has shown us the subtleties of some people's hearts, knowing that the place of death in China is extremely extensive.现在恰有一本罗曼罗兰的《Le Jeu de L'Amour et de La Mort》在我面前，其中说：加尔是主张人类为进步计，即不妨有少许污点，万不得已，也不妨有一点罪恶的；但他们却不愿意杀库尔跋齐，因为共和国不喜欢在臂膊上抱着他的死尸，因为这过于沉重。
Now there is a copy of Romain Rolland's "Le Jeu de L'Amour et de La Mort" in front of me, which says: Gall advocates that human beings should be progressive, that is, they may have a little stain, and if necessary, they may also have a little sin; But they were reluctant to kill Kurbaqi because the Republic did not like to carry his dead body in his arms because it was too heavy.会觉得死尸的沉重，不愿抱持的民族里，先烈的“死”是后人的“生”的唯一的灵药，但倘在不再觉得沉重的民族里，却不过是压得一同沦灭的东西。
In a nation that feels the heaviness of the dead body and does not want to hold it, the "death" of the martyrs is the only elixir for the "life" of future generations, but if it is no longer heavy, it is just something that is crushed together.中国的有志于改革的青年，是知道死尸的沉重的，所以总是“请愿”。殊不知别有不觉得死尸的沉重的人们在，而且一并屠杀了“知道死尸的沉重”的心。
China's young people who aspire to reform know the weight of the dead body, so they always "petition". As everyone knows, there are other people who don't feel the heaviness of dead bodies, and they have slaughtered the hearts of "knowing the heaviness of dead bodies".死地确乎已在前面。为中国计，觉悟的青年应该不肯轻死了罢。
Death is indeed ahead. For the sake of China, enlightened young people should not die lightly.三月二十五日。
March 25th.

可惨与可笑

可惨与可笑

可惨与可笑

It's tragic and ridiculous三月十八日的惨杀事件，在事后看来，分明是政府布成的罗网，纯洁的青年们竟不幸而陷下去了，死伤至于三百多人。这罗网之所以布成，其关键就全在于“流言”的奏了功效。
The massacre on March 18, in hindsight, was clearly a net set up by the government, and the pure young people unfortunately fell into it, killing and injuring more than 300 people. The key to the establishment of this net lies in the effectiveness of "rumors".这是中国的老例，读书人的心里大抵含着杀机，对于异己者总给他安排下一点可死之道。就我所眼见的而论，凡阴谋家攻击别一派，光绪年间用“康党”，宣统年间用“革党”，民二以后用“乱党”，现在自然要用“共产党”了。其实，去年有些“正人君子”们称别人为“学棍”“学匪”的时候，就有杀机存在，因为这类诨号，和“臭绅士”“文士”之类不同，在“棍”“匪”字里，就藏着可死之道的。但这也许是“刀笔吏”式的深文周纳。
This is an old example in China, where a scholar probably has murderous intent in his heart, and always arranges a little way to die for dissidents. As far as I can see, whenever conspirators attack other factions, they used "Kang Party" during the Guangxu period, "Revolutionary Party" during the Xuantong period, and "Chaos Party" after Min Er, and now they naturally use "Communist Party". In fact, last year, when some "upright gentlemen" called others "school sticks" and "school bandits", there was a murderous intention, because this kind of nickname, unlike "stinky gentleman" and "scribe", in the words "stick" and "bandit", there is a way to die. But this may be a "knife and pen official" style of deep literary acceptance.去年，为“整顿学风”计，大传播学风怎样不良的流言，学匪怎样可恶的流言，居然很奏了效。今年，为“整顿学风”计，又大传播共产党怎样活动，怎样可恶的流言，又居然很奏了效。于是便将请愿者作共产党论，三百多人死伤了，如果有一个所谓共产党的首领死在里面，就更足以证明这请愿就是“暴动”。
Last year, in order to "rectify the academic style", the rumors about how bad the academic style was and how hateful the rumors were by the bandits actually worked. This year, in order to "rectify the academic style", the rumors about how the Communist Party was active and what hateful rumors were actually very effective. So the petitioner was labeled as a communist, and more than 300 people were killed and injured, and if a so-called Communist Party leader died in it, it would be more enough to prove that this petition was a "riot".可惜竟没有。这该不是共产党了罢。据说也还是的，但他们全都逃跑了，所以更可恶。而这请愿也还是暴动，做证据的有一根木棍，两支手枪，三瓶煤油。姑勿论这些是否群众所携去的东西；即使真是，而死伤三百多人所携的武器竟不过这一点，这是怎样可怜的暴动呵！
Unfortunately, there is none. This should not be the Communist Party. It is said that they are still there, but they all ran away, so it is even more hateful. And this petition was still a riot, and the evidence was a wooden stick, two pistols, and three bottles of kerosene. Not to mention whether these are things carried by the masses; Even if it is true, and the weapons carried by more than 300 dead and wounded are only this, what a pitiful riot!但次日，徐谦，李大钊，李煜瀛，易培基，顾兆熊的通缉令发表了。因为他们“啸聚群众”，像去年女子师范大学生的“啸聚男生”（章士钊解散女子师范大学呈文语）一样，“啸聚”了带着一根木棍，两支手枪，三瓶煤油的群众。以这样的群众来颠覆政府，当然要死伤三百多人；而徐谦们以人命为儿戏到这地步，那当然应该负杀人之罪了；而况自己又不到场，或者全都逃跑了呢？
But the next day, the wanted warrants of Xu Qian, Li Dazhao, Li Yuying, Yi Peiji, and Gu Zhaoxiong were published. Because they "gathered the masses", like last year's "howling boys" (Zhang Shizhao disbanded the Women's Normal University Chengwen), they "gathered" the masses with a wooden stick, two pistols, and three bottles of kerosene. To subvert the government with such a mass, of course, more than 300 people will be killed and injured; And Xu Qian and the others have taken human life as child's play to this point, so of course they should be guilty of murder; And what if you don't show up, or all run away?以上是政治上的事，我其实不很了然。但从别一方面看来，所谓“严拿”者，似乎倒是赶走；所谓“严拿”暴徒者，似乎不过是赶走北京中法大学校长兼清室善后委员会委员长（李），中俄大学校长（徐），北京大学教授（李大钊），北京大学教务长（顾），女子师范大学校长（易）；其中的三个又是俄款委员会委员：一共空出九个“优美的差缺”也。
The above is a political matter, I don't really understand. But from another point of view, the so-called "strict nailing" seems to be driving away; The so-called "strict" rioters seem to be just driving away the president of Beijing Sino-French University and chairman of the Qing Room Aftermath Committee (Li), the president of Sino-Russian University (Xu), the professor of Peking University (Li Dazhao), the provost of Peking University (Gu), and the president of Women's Normal University (Yi); Three of them are members of the Russian Funding Committee: a total of nine "beautiful vacancies" have been vacated.同日就又有一种谣言，便是说还要通缉五十多人；但那姓名的一部分，却至今日才见于《京报》。这种计画，在目下的段祺瑞政府的秘书长章士钊之流的脑子里，是确实会有的。国事犯多至五十余人，也是中华民国的一个壮观；而且大概多是教员罢，倘使一同放下五十多个“优美的差缺”，逃出北京，在别的地方开起一个学校来，倒也是中华民国的一件趣事。
On the same day, there was another rumor, that is, more than 50 people were wanted; But part of that name has only been seen in the "Beijing News" today. This kind of plan will indeed exist in the minds of Zhang Shizhao, the secretary-general of the Duan Qirui government. There are more than 50 state offenders, which is also a spectacle of the Republic of China; And most of them are teachers, so if they let go of more than 50 "beautiful shortcomings" together, escape from Beijing, and open a school elsewhere, it would be an interesting thing in the Republic of China.那学校的名称，就应该叫作“啸聚”学校。
The name of the school should be called "Xiaoju" School.三月二十六日。

记念刘和珍君

记念刘和珍君

记念刘和珍君

Remember Liu Hezhen一
One中华民国十五年三月二十五日，就是国立北京女子师范大学为十八日在段祺瑞执政府前遇害的刘和珍杨德群两君开追悼会的那一天，我独在礼堂外徘徊，遇见程君，前来问我道，“先生可曾为刘和珍写了一点什么没有？”我说“没有”。她就正告我，“先生还是写一点罢；刘和珍生前就很爱看先生的文章。”
On March 25, the fifteenth year of the Republic of China, the day when the National Beijing Women's Normal University held a memorial service for Liu Hezhen and Yang Dequn, who were killed in front of Duan Qirui's government on the 18th, I wandered alone outside the auditorium, met Cheng Jun, and came to ask me, "Sir, have you written anything for Liu Hezhen?" I said "no". She was telling me, "Sir, just write a little; Liu Hezhen loved to read Mr. Zhen's articles before his death. ”这是我知道的，凡我所编辑的期刊，大概是因为往往有始无终之故罢，销行一向就甚为寥落，然而在这样的生活艰难中，毅然预定了《莽原》全年的就有她。我也早觉得有写一点东西的必要了，这虽然于死者毫不相干，但在生者，却大抵只能如此而已。倘使我能够相信真有所谓“在天之灵”，那自然可以得到更大的安慰，——但是，现在，却只能如此而已。
This is what I know, all the journals I edit, probably because they often have a beginning and no end, and the sales have always been very sparse, but in such a difficult life, I resolutely booked "Mangyuan" for the whole year. I have long felt the need to write something, although it has nothing to do with the dead, but in the living, it is probably only like this. If I could believe that there was a so-called "spirit in heaven", I would naturally be able to get greater comfort,—— but for now, it can only be so.可是我实在无话可说。我只觉得所住的并非人间。四十多个青年的血，洋溢在我的周围，使我艰于呼吸视听，那里还能有什么言语？长歌当哭，是必须在痛定之后的。而此后几个所谓学者文人的阴险的论调，尤使我觉得悲哀。我已经出离愤怒了。我将深味这非人间的浓黑的悲凉；以我的最大哀痛显示于非人间，使它们快意于我的苦痛，就将这作为后死者的菲薄的祭品，奉献于逝者的灵前。
But I really have nothing to say. I just feel that I don't live in the world. The blood of more than forty young people overflowed around me, making it difficult for me to breathe and hear, what words could there be? When crying, it must be after painful confirmment. After that, the insidious arguments of several so-called scholars and literati made me feel particularly sad. I'm out of my anger. I will deeply savor the sadness of this dark darkness of this world; With my greatest sorrow shown to the non-human world, so that they may be pleased with my pain, I offer this as a meager sacrifice to the spirit of the deceased.

Two真的猛士，敢于直面惨淡的人生，敢于正视淋漓的鲜血。这是怎样的哀痛者和幸福者？然而造化又常常为庸人设计，以时间的流驶，来洗涤旧迹，仅使留下淡红的血色和微漠的悲哀。在这淡红的血色和微漠的悲哀中，又给人暂得偷生，维持着这似人非人的世界。我不知道这样的世界何时是一个尽头！
A real warrior dares to face a bleak life and dare to face up to the dripping blood. What kind of mourner and happy person is this? However, nature is often designed for the mediocre, and the passage of time washes the old relics, leaving only a pale red blood color and indifferent sadness. In this pale red blood and indifferent sadness, people have to live temporarily, maintaining this inhuman world. I don't know when such a world will come to an end!我们还在这样的世上活着；我也早觉得有写一点东西的必要了。离三月十八日也已有两星期，忘却的救主快要降临了罢，我正有写一点东西的必要了。
We still live in such a world; I also felt the need to write something. With two weeks to go until March 18, the forgotten Savior is coming, and I need to write something.

三

记念刘和珍君

Three在四十余被害的青年之中，刘和珍君是我的学生。学生云者，我向来这样想，这样说，现在却觉得有些踌躇了，我应该对她奉献我的悲哀与尊敬。她不是“苟活到现在的我”的学生，是为了中国而死的中国的青年。
Among the more than forty young people who were killed, Liu Hezhenjun was my student. Student Yunzhe, I have always thought like this, and now I feel a little hesitant, I should dedicate my sorrow and respect to her. She is not a student of "living to the present me", but a Chinese youth who died for China.她的姓名第一次为我所见，是在去年夏初杨荫榆女士做女子师范大学校长，开除校中六个学生自治会职员的时候。其中的一个就是她；但是我不认识。直到后来，也许已经是刘百昭率领男女武将，强拖出校之后了，才有人指着一个学生告诉我，说：这就是刘和珍。其时我才能将姓名和实体联合起来，心中却暗自诧异。我平素想，能够不为势利所屈，反抗一广有羽翼的校长的学生，无论如何，总该是有些桀骜锋利的，但她却常常微笑着，态度很温和。待到偏安于宗帽胡同，赁屋授课之后，她才始来听我的讲义，于是见面的回数就较多了，也还是始终微笑着，态度很温和。待到学校恢复旧观，往日的教职员以为责任已尽，准备陆续引退的时候，我才见她虑及母校前途，黯然至于泣下。此后似乎就不相见。总之，在我的记忆上，那一次就是永别了。
The first time I saw her name was when Ms. Yang Yinyu was the president of Women's Normal University at the beginning of last summer and expelled six student government association staff members in the school. One of them is her; But I don't know. It wasn't until later, perhaps after Liu Baizhao led the male and female generals to drag them out of school, that someone pointed to a student and told me, saying: This is Liu Hezhen. Only then can I unite the name and entity, but I am secretly surprised. I usually think that a student who can resist a wide range of winged principals without being succumbed to snobbery should always be a little unruly and sharp no matter what, but she often smiles and has a gentle attitude. After she settled in Zongmao Hutong and rented a house to teach, she began to listen to my handouts, so we met more often, and she was always smiling and very gentle. When the school regained its old outlook and the former faculty and staff thought that their responsibilities had been fulfilled and were about to retire one after another, I saw that she was worried about the future of her alma mater and cried. It seems that they haven't seen each other since then. In short, in my memory, that time was a farewell.

Four我在十八日早晨，才知道上午有群众向执政府请愿的事；下午便得到噩耗，说卫队居然开枪，死伤至数百人，而刘和珍君即在遇害者之列。但我对于这些传说，竟至于颇为怀疑。我向来是不惮以最坏的恶意，来推测中国人的，然而我还不料，也不信竟会下劣凶残到这地步。况且始终微笑着的和蔼的刘和珍君，更何至于无端在府门前喋血呢？
On the morning of the 18th, I learned that there were people petitioning the ruling government in the morning; In the afternoon, I got bad news that the guards actually fired, killing and wounding hundreds of people, and Liu Hezhenjun was among the victims. But I am quite skeptical of these legends. I have always been afraid to speculate on the Chinese with the worst malice, but I didn't expect it, and I didn't believe that it would be so bad and brutal. Moreover, the kind Liu Hezhenjun, who is always smiling, why is he bleeding in front of the mansion for no reason?然而即日证明是事实了，作证的便是她自己的尸骸。还有一具，是杨德群君的。而且又证明着这不但是杀害，简直是虐杀，因为身体上还有棍棒的伤痕。
However, it turned out to be true on the same day, and it was her own body that testified. There is also one that belongs to Yang Dequn. And it proves that this is not only killing, but simply torture, because there are still scars from sticks on the body.但段政府就有令，说她们是“暴徒”！
But the Duan government issued an order saying that they were "thugs"!但接着就有流言，说她们是受人利用的。
But then there were rumors that they were being used.惨象，已使我目不忍视了；流言，尤使我耳不忍闻。我还有什么话可说呢？我懂得衰亡民族之所以默无声息的缘由了。沉默呵，沉默呵！不在沉默中爆发，就在沉默中灭亡。
The tragic phenomenon has made me unbearable to look at it; Rumors are especially unbearable to hear. What else do I have to say? I understand the reason why the declining nation is silent. Silence, silence! If it does not break out in silence, it will perish in silence.

Zhang Jingshujun, who went with her, wanted to help her up, but was hit by four bullets, one of which was a pistol and stood up; Yang Dequnjun, who went with her, wanted to help her up again, but was also hit, and the bullet entered from the left shoulder, passed through the chest and went out to the right, and also fell down. But she was able to sit up, and a soldier slammed her twice in the head and chest, and she died.始终微笑的和蔼的刘和珍君确是死掉了，这是真的，有她自己的尸骸为证；沉勇而友爱的杨德群君也死掉了，有她自己的尸骸为证；只有一样沉勇而友爱的张静淑君还在医院里呻吟。当三个女子从容地转辗于文明人所发明的枪弹的攒射中的时候，这是怎样的一个惊心动魄的伟大呵！中国军人的屠戮妇婴的伟绩，八国联军的惩创学生的武功，不幸全被这几缕血痕抹杀了。
Liu Hezhenjun, who was always smiling and kind, was indeed dead, this is true, as evidenced by her own corpse; The brave and friendly Yang Dequn also died, as evidenced by her own body; Only Zhang Jingshujun, who is brave and friendly, is still moaning in the hospital. When the three women calmly turned around in the bullets invented by civilized people, what a thrilling greatness! The great achievements of the Chinese soldiers in the slaughter of women and babies, and the martial arts of the Eight-Nation Allied Forces in punishing students, unfortunately were all erased by these few strands of blood.但是中外的杀人者却居然昂起头来，不知道个个脸上有着血污……。
But the murderers at home and abroad actually raised their heads, not knowing that they all had blood on their faces......

One请愿的事，我一向就不以为然的，但并非因为怕有三月十八日那样的惨杀。那样的惨杀，我实在没有梦想到，虽然我向来常以“刀笔吏”的意思来窥测我们中国人。我只知道他们麻木，没有良心，不足与言，而况是请愿，而况又是徒手，却没有料到有这么阴毒与凶残。能逆料的，大概只有段祺瑞，贾德耀，章士钊和他们的同类罢。四十七个男女青年的生命，完全是被骗去的，简直是诱杀。
I have never taken the petition seriously, but not because I am afraid of a massacre like the one on March 18. I really didn't dream of such a massacre, although I have always used the meaning of "knife and pen official" to spy on us Chinese. I only know that they are numb, have no conscience, and are not worthy of words, let alone petitions, and they are unarmed hands, but I did not expect such viciousness and murder. The only ones who can go against the expectations are probably Duan Qirui, Jia Deyao, Zhang Shizhao and their kind. The lives of forty-seven young men and women were completely deceived, and they were simply booby-trapped.有些东西——我称之为什么呢，我想不出——说：群众领袖应负道义上的责任。这些东西仿佛就承认了对徒手群众应该开枪，执政府前原是“死地”，死者就如自投罗网一般。群众领袖本没有和段祺瑞等辈心心相印，也未曾互相钩通，怎么能够料到这阴险的辣手。这样的辣手，只要略有人气者，是万万豫想不到的。
Something—I can't think of what I call it—says that mass leaders have moral responsibility. These things seem to admit that unarmed people should be shot, and the ruling government is originally a "dead place", and the dead are like throwing themselves into a trap. The mass leaders did not have a heart-to-heart with Duan Qirui and others, nor did they connect with each other, so how could they expect this insidious hot hand. Such a hot hand, as long as he is slightly popular, is unexpected.我以为倘要锻炼群众领袖的错处，只有两点：一是还以请愿为有用；二是将对手看得太好了。
I think there are only two mistakes in training mass leaders: first, petitions are still useful; The second is to see the opponent too well.

Three改革自然常不免于流血，但流血非即等于改革。血的应用，正如金钱一般，吝啬固然是不行的，浪费也大大的失算。我对于这回的牺牲者，非常觉得哀伤。
Reform is often bloody, but bloodshed is not the same as reform. The application of blood, just like money, is certainly not stingy, and waste is also greatly miscalculated. I feel very sad for the victims this time.但愿这样的请愿，从此停止就好。
I hope such petitions will stop from now on.请愿虽然是无论那一国度里常有的事，不至于死的事，但我们已经知道中国是例外，除非你能将“枪林弹雨”消除。正规的战法，也必须对手是英雄才适用。汉末总算还是人心很古的时候罢，恕我引一个小说上的典故：许褚赤体上阵，也就很中了好几箭。而金圣叹还笑他道：“谁叫你赤膊？”
Although petitions are common in any country and will not die, we already know that China is an exception, unless you can eliminate the "rain of bullets". Regular tactics must also be applied only when the opponent is a hero. The end of the Han Dynasty was finally a time when people's hearts were very old, forgive me for quoting an allusion from a novel: Xu Chu went into battle naked, and he was hit by several arrows. And Jin Shengsian laughed at him and said, "Who told you to be shirtless? ”至于现在似的发明了许多火器的时代，交兵就都用壕堑战。这并非吝惜生命，乃是不肯虚掷生命，因为战士的生命是宝贵的。在战士不多的地方，这生命就愈宝贵。所谓宝贵者，并非“珍藏于家”，乃是要以小本钱换得极大的利息，至少，也必须卖买相当。以血的洪流淹死一个敌人，以同胞的尸体填满一个缺陷，已经是陈腐的话了。从最新的战术的眼光看起来，这是多么大的损失。
As for the era when many firearms were invented now, trench warfare was used in the battle. This is not to be stingy with life, but to refuse to waste life, because the life of a warrior is precious. Where there are not many soldiers, this life is more precious. The so-called precious thing is not "treasured at home", but to exchange a small capital for great interest, at least, it must be sold and bought equally. Drowning an enemy with a torrent of blood and filling a defect with the corpse of a compatriot is already a cliché. From the perspective of the latest tactics, what a loss this is.这回死者的遗给后来的功德，是在撕去了许多东西的人相，露出那出于意料之外的阴毒的心，教给继续战斗者以别种方法的战斗。
This time, the merit of the deceased to the later was to tear off the appearance of many things, reveal the unexpected and vicious heart, and teach the continuing fighters to fight in a different way.四月二日。

Such a "red attack"京津间许多次大小战争，战死了不知多少人，为“讨赤”也；执政府前开排枪，打死请愿者四十七，伤百余，通缉“率领暴徒”之徐谦等人五，为“讨赤”也；奉天飞机三临北京之空中，掷下炸弹，杀两妇人，伤一小黄狗，为“讨赤”也。
In many large and small wars between Beijing and Tianjin, an unknown number of people died in order to "fight for red"; The ruling government opened fire in front of the government, killing 47 petitioners and injuring more than 100, and wanted Xu Qian and five others who "led the rioters" for "fighting red"; Fengtian planes dropped bombs over Beijing three times, killing two women and injuring a small yellow dog, in a "fight against red".京津间战死之兵士和北京中被炸死之两妇人和被炸伤之一小黄狗，是否即“赤”，尚无“明令”，下民不得而知。至于府前枪杀之四十七人，则第一“明令”已云有“误伤”矣；京师地方检察厅公函又云“此次集会请愿宗旨尚属正当，又无不正之行为”矣；而国务院会议又将“从优拟恤”矣。然则徐谦们所率领的“暴徒”那里去了呢？他们都有符咒，能避枪炮的么？
Whether the soldiers who died in the battle between Beijing and Tianjin, the two women killed in the bombing in Beijing and a little yellow dog who was injured by the bombing, are "red", there is no "explicit order", and the people do not know. As for the 47 people shot dead in front of the government, the first "clear order" has already said that there were "accidental injuries"; The official letter of the Beijing District Procuratorate also said that "the purpose of this rally petition is still legitimate, and there is no improper act"; The State Council meeting will also "preferentially propose compensation." 积在天津的纸张运不到北京，连印书也颇受战争的影响，我的旧杂感的结集《华盖集》付印两月了，排校还不到一半。可惜先登了一个预告，以致引出陈源教授的“反广告”来——
The paper accumulated in Tianjin could not be transported to Beijing, and even the printing of books was quite affected by the war. It's a pity that a trailer was published first, which led to Professor Chen Yuan's "anti-advertising" -“我不能因为我不尊敬鲁迅先生的人格，就不说他的小说好，我也不能因为佩服他的小说，就称赞他其余的文章。我觉得他的杂感，除了《热风》中二三篇外，实在没有一读之价值。”（《现代评论》七十一，《闲话》。）
"I can't stop saying that Mr. Lu Xun's novels are good just because I don't respect his personality, and I can't praise his rest of his articles just because I admire his novels. I think his miscellaneous feelings, except for two or three chapters in "Hot Wind", are really not worth reading. (Modern Review, 71, "Gossip".) ）这多么公平！原来我也是“今不如古”了；《华盖集》的销路，比起《热风》来，恐怕要较为悲观。而且，我的作小说，竟不料是和“人格”无关的。“非人格”的一种文字，像新闻记事一般的，倒会使教授“佩服”，中国又仿佛日见其光怪陆离了似的，然则“实在没有一读之价值”的杂感，也许还要存在罢。
How fair! It turns out that I am also "not as good as the past"; The sales of "Canopy Collection" are probably more pessimistic than "Hot Wind". Moreover, my novel has nothing to do with "personality". A kind of "impersonal" text, like a news record, will make the professor "admire", and China seems to see its bizarre every day, so the miscellaneous feeling of "really not worth reading" may still exist.

2
做那有名的小说《Don Quijote》的M.de Cervantes先生，穷则有之，说他像叫化子，可不过是一种特别流行于中国学者间的流言。他说Don Quijote看游侠小说看疯了，便自己去做侠客，打不平。他的亲人知道是书籍作的怪，就请了间壁的理发匠来检查；理发匠选出几部好的留下来，其余的便都烧掉了。
Mr. M.de Cervantes, who wrote the famous novel "Don Quijote", said that he was called Huazi, but it was just a rumor that was particularly popular among Chinese scholars. He said that Don Quijote was crazy about reading ranger novels, so he became a chivalrous man himself, and he was unfair. His relatives knew that it was a monster made by the books, so they asked the barber in the wall to check it; The barber chose a few good ones to stay, and burned the rest.大概是烧掉的罢，记不清楚了；也忘了是多少种。想来，那些入选的“好书”的作家们，当时看了这小说里的书单，怕总免不了要面红耳赤地苦笑的罢。
It was probably burned, I can't remember clearly; I also forgot how many there are. Come to think of it, those writers who were selected for the "good books" were afraid that they would inevitably smile bitterly when they read the book list in this novel.中国虽然似乎日见其光怪陆离了。然而，乌乎哀哉！我们连“苦笑”也得不到。
Although China seems to be seeing its bizarre day by day. However, how sad it is! We can't even get a "bitter smile".

有人从外省寄快信来问我平安否。他不熟于北京的情形，上了流言的当了。
Someone sent me a letter from another province asking if I was okay. He was not familiar with the situation in Beijing and was fooled by rumors.北京的流言报，是从袁世凯称帝，张勋复辟，章士钊“整顿学风”以还，一脉相传，历来如此的。现在自然也如此。
Beijing's rumors have been passed down since Yuan Shikai became emperor, Zhang Xun was restored, and Zhang Shizhao "rectified the style of study". Naturally, this is the case now.第一步曰：某方要封闭某校，捕拿某人某人了。这是造给某校某人看，恐吓恐吓的。
The first step is: I am going to close down a certain school and arrest someone. This is made for someone in a certain school to see, intimidating and intimidating.第二步曰：某校已空虚，某人已逃走了。这是造给某方看，煽动煽动的。
The second step is: A certain school is empty, and someone has escaped. This is made for a certain party to see, incitement and incitement.又一步曰：某方已搜检甲校，将搜检乙校了。这是恐吓乙校，煽动某方的。
Another step is to say: "I have already searched for Grade A and will be searching for Grade B." This is to intimidate Officer B and incite a certain party.“平生不作亏心事，夜半敲门不吃惊。”乙校不自心虚，怎能给恐吓呢？然而，少安毋躁罢。还有一步曰：乙校昨夜通宵达旦，将赤化书籍完全焚烧矣。
"I don't do bad things in my life, and I don't be surprised when I knock on the door in the middle of the night." School B is not guilty, how can it intimidate? However, it is important not to be impatient. Another step is that Officer B stayed up all night last night and completely burned the red books.于是甲校更正，说并未搜检；乙校更正，说并无此项书籍云。
So Officer A corrected it, saying that it had not been searched; Correction B said there was no such book.

中华民国九年七月直皖战争开手；八月，皖军溃灭，徐树铮等九人避入日本公使馆。这时还点缀着一点小玩意，是有一些正人君子——不是现在的一些正人君子——去游说直派武人，请他杀戮改革论者了。终于没有结果；便是这事也早从人们的记忆上消去。但试去翻那年八月的《北京日报》，还可以看见一个大广告，里面是什么大英雄得胜之后，必须廓清邪说，诛戮异端等类古色古香的名言。
In July of the ninth year of the Republic of China, the Zhiwan War began; In August, the Anhui army was defeated, and Xu Shuzheng and nine others took refuge in the Japanese embassy. At this time, there are also a little gadget, there are some decent gentlemen - not some of the current decent gentlemen - to lobby the straight warriors and ask him to kill the reformists. Finally there was no result; Even this matter has long been erased from people's memory. But if you try to flip through the "Beijing Daily" in August of that year, you can also see a big advertisement in which a great hero must clear out heresies, kill heresies and other antique famous quotes after victory.那广告是有署名的，在此也无须提出。但是，较之现在专躲在暗中的流言家，却又不免令人有“今不如古”之感了。我想，百年前比现在好，千年前比百年前好，万年前比千年前好……特别在中国或者是确凿的。
The advertisement is signed and does not need to be mentioned here. However, compared with the current rumors who are hiding in the dark, it is inevitable that people will feel that "the present is not as good as the past". I think a hundred years ago is better than now, a thousand years ago is better than a hundred years ago, and ten thousand years ago is better than a thousand years ago...... Especially in China or conclusive.

新的蔷薇　——然而还是无花的

新的蔷薇New roses ——然而还是无花的 - yet still unflowered
因为《语丝》在形式上要改成中本了，我也不想再用老题目，所以破格地奋发，要写出“新的蔷薇”来。
Because "Yusi" is going to be changed to the middle version in form, I don't want to use the old title anymore, so I made an unusual effort to write a "new rose".——这回可要开花了？
——Is it going to bloom this time?——嗡嗡，——不见得罢。
- Buzz,—— not necessarily.
我早有点知道：我是大概以自己为主的。所谈的道理是“我以为”的道理，所记的情状是我所见的情状。听说一月以前，杏花和碧桃都开过了。我没有见，我就不以为有杏花和碧桃。
I already knew a little bit: I was probably self-centered. The truth talked about is the truth of "I think", and the situation recorded is the situation I saw. I heard that apricot blossoms and peaches bloomed a month ago. I didn't see it, so I didn't think there were apricot blossoms and peaches.——然而那些东西是存在的。——学者们怕要说。
– And yet those things exist. ——Scholars are afraid to say.——好！那么，由它去罢。——这是我敬谨回禀学者们的话。
——Okay! So, let it go. ——These are my respectful words to report to scholars.有些讲“公理”的，说我的杂感没有一看的价值。那是一定的。其实，他来看我的杂感，先就自己失了魂了，——假如也有魂。我的话倘会合于讲“公理”者的胃口，我不也成了“公理维持会”会员了么？我不也成了他，和其余的一切会员了么？我的话不就等于他们的话了么？许多人和许多话不就等于一个人和一番话了么？
Some people talk about "axioms" and say that my miscellaneous feelings are not worth seeing. That's for sure. In fact, when he came to see my miscellaneous feelings, he first lost his soul,—— if he also had a soul. If my words meet the appetite of the "Axiom" speaker, will I not also become a member of the "Axiom Maintenance Association"? Didn't I become him and all the rest of the members? Aren't my words the same as theirs? Isn't it the same as one person and many words?公理是只有一个的。然而听说这早被他们拿去了，所以我已经一无所有。
There is only one axiom. However, I heard that they had already taken it, so I had nothing.
这回“北京城内的外国旗”，大约特别地多罢，竟使学者为之愤慨：“……至于东交民巷界线以外，无论中国人外国人，那就不能借插用外国国旗，以为保护生命财产的护符。”
This time, the "foreign flags in Beijing" were probably particularly abolished, which made scholars indignant: "...... As for the boundary of Dongjiaomin Lane, regardless of Chinese foreigners, they cannot borrow the use of foreign flags as a talisman to protect life and property. ”这是的确的。“保护生命财产的护符”，我们自有“法律”在。
That's true. "The talisman to protect life and property", we have our own "law".如果还不放心呢，那么，就用一种更稳妥的旗子： 红卍字旗。介乎中外之间，超于“无耻”和有耻之外，——确是好旗子！
If you are still not at ease, then use a more secure flag: the red swastika flag. Between China and abroad, beyond "shameless" and shameful,—— is indeed a good flag!
从清末以来，“莫谈国事”的条子帖在酒楼饭馆里，至今还没有跟着辫子取消。所以，有些时候，难煞了执笔的人。
Since the end of the Qing Dynasty, the note "Don't talk about state affairs" has been posted in restaurants and restaurants, and it has not been canceled with the braids. Therefore, sometimes, it is difficult to discourage the person who writes.但这时却可以看见一种有趣的东西，是：希望别人以文字得祸的人所做的文字。
But at this time, we can see an interesting thing, which is the words made by people who hope that others will get into trouble with words.
聪明人的谈吐也日见其聪明了。说三月十八日被害的学生是值得同情的，因为她本不愿去而受了教职员的怂恿。说“那些直接或间接用苏俄的金钱的人”是情有可原的，因为“他们自己可以挨饿，老婆子女却不能不吃饭呵！”
The conversation of smart people is also becoming smarter. He said that the student who was killed on March 18 was sympathetic because she was instigated by the faculty and staff because she did not want to go. It is forgivable to say that "those who directly or indirectly use Soviet Russian money" because "they can starve themselves, but their wives and children cannot skip eating!" ”推开了甲而陷没了乙，原谅了情而坐实了罪；尤其是他们的行动和主张，都见得一钱不值了。
pushed A away and trapped B, forgave the love and confirmed the crime; In particular, their actions and ideas are worthless.然而听说赵子昂的画马，却又是镜中照出来的自己的形相哩。
However, when I heard that Zhao Ziang's painting of horses was his own image reflected in the mirror.
因为“老婆子女却不能不吃饭”，于是自然要发生“节育问题”了。但是先前山格夫人来华的时候，“有些志士”却又大发牢骚，说她要使中国人灭种。
Because "wives and children can't skip eating", so "birth control problems" will naturally occur. But when Mrs. Shanger came to China before, "some ambitious people" complained again, saying that she wanted to exterminate the Chinese.独身主义现今尚为许多人所反对，节育也行不通。为赤贫的绅士计，目前最好的方法，我以为莫如弄一个有钱的女人做老婆。
Celibacy is still opposed by many today, and birth control does not work. For the destitute gentleman, I think the best way at present is to get a rich woman as his wife.我索性完全传授了这个秘诀罢：口头上，可必须说是为了“爱”。
I simply taught this secret completely: verbally, it must be said that it is for "love".
“苏俄的金钱”十万元，这回竟弄得教育部和教育界发生纠葛了，因为大家都要一点。
"Soviet Russia's money" of 100,000 yuan, this time it actually caused entanglement between the Ministry of Education and the education community, because everyone wanted a little.这也许还是因为“老婆子女”之故罢。但这批卢布和那批卢布却不一样的。这是归还的庚子赔款；是拳匪“扶清灭洋”，各国联军入京的余泽。
This may be because of the "wife and children". But this ruble is not the same as that ruble. This is the returned Gengzi reparation; It is the remnants of the boxers "helping the Qing and destroying the ocean" and the coalition forces of various countries entering Beijing.那年代很容易记：十九世纪末，一九〇〇年。二十六年之后，我们却“间接”用了拳匪的金钱来给“老婆子女”吃饭；如果大师兄有灵，必将爽然若失者欤。
That era is easy to remember: the end of the 19th century, 1900. Twenty-six years later, we "indirectly" used the money of the boxers to feed the "wives and children"; If the senior brother had a spirit, he would definitely be refreshed as if he had lost it.还有，各国用到中国来做“文化事业”的，也是这一笔款……。
In addition, it is also the ...... of this money that countries use China for "cultural undertakings".五月二十三日。

再来一次

One more time去年编定《热风》时，还有绅士们所谓“存心忠厚”之意，很删削了好几篇。但有一篇，却原想编进去的，因为失掉了稿子，便只好从缺。现在居然寻出来了；待《热风》再版时，添上这篇，登一个广告，使迷信我的文字的读者们再买一本，于我倒不无裨益。但是，算了罢，这实在不很有趣。不如再登一次，将来收入杂感第三集，也就算作补遗罢。

"Heh, this is going to make a fuss:“公孙接仰天而叹曰，‘晏子，智人也，夫使公之计吾功者，不受桃，是无勇也。士众而桃寡，何不计功而食桃矣？接一搏猏而再搏虎，若接之功，可以食桃而无与人同矣。’援桃而起。

“古冶子曰，‘吾尝从君济于河，鼋衔左骖以入砥柱之流。 当是时也，冶少不能游，潜行逆流百步，顺流九里，得鼋杀之，左操骖尾，右挈鼋头，鹤跃而出。 津人皆曰，河伯也；若冶视之，则大鼋之首。 若冶之功，可以食桃而无与人同矣！二子何不反桃？’抽剑而起。 ”钞书太讨厌。总而言之，后来那二士自愧功不如古冶子，自杀了；古冶子不愿独生，也自杀了：于是乎就成了“二桃杀三士”。
Money is too annoying. Although we don't know whether these three scholars have any experience in the old culture, since the book says that they are "famous for their bravery", we cannot say that they are "scholars". If "Liang Fu Yin" says that it is "two peaches kill three warriors", it is naturally clearer, but unfortunately it is a five-character poem, and the words cannot be added, so it has to be "two peaches kill three scholars", so it also harmed Mr. Zhang Xingyan's interpretation as "two peaches killed three scholars".旧文化也实在太难解，古典也诚然太难记，而那两个旧桃子也未免太作怪：不但那时使三个读书人因此送命，到现在还使一个读书人因此出丑，“是亦不可以已乎”！
The old culture is too difficult to understand, and the classics are indeed too difficult to remember, and those two old peaches are too strange: not only did three scholars die at that time, but now they also make a scholar embarrassed because of this, "yes and can't stop"!去年，因为“每下愈况”问题，我曾经很受了些自以为公平的青年的教训，说是因为他革去了我的“签事”，我便那么奚落他。现在我在此只得特别声明：这还是一九二三年九月所作，登在《晨报副刊》上的。那时的《晨报副刊》，编辑尚不是陪过泰戈尔先生的“诗哲”，也还未负有逼死别人，掐死自己的使命，所以间或也登一点我似的俗人的文章；而我那时和这位后来称为“孤桐先生”的，也毫无“睚眦之怨”。那“动机”，大概不过是想给白话的流行帮点忙。
Last year, because of the problem of "getting worse every time", I was taught a lesson by some young people who thought they were fair, saying that it was because he removed my "signing", and I ridiculed him like that. In such an autumn of "disaster comes from the mouth", defend yourself thoughtfully. Giving a small blow to the "peach" can be the same as "hitting the water dog"? !但不知怎的，这位“孤桐先生”竟在《甲寅》上辩起来了，以为这不过是小事。这是真的，不过是小事。弄错一点，又何伤乎？即使不知道晏子，不知道齐国，于中国也无损。农民谁懂得《梁父吟》呢，农业也仍然可以救国的。但我以为攻击白话的豪举，可也大可以不必了；将白话来代文言，即使有点不妥，反正也不过是小事情。
But somehow, this "Mr. Gu Tong" actually argued on "Jia Yin", thinking that it was just a trivial matter. It's true, but it's a small thing. What harm is there in getting a little wrong? 为半农题记《何典》后，作

It was written after Bannon's inscription "He Dian"还是两三年前，偶然在光绪五年（1879）印的《申报馆书目续集》上看见《何典》题要，这样说：
Or two or three years ago, I accidentally saw the title of "He Dian" in the "Sequel to the Bibliography of the Declaration Hall" printed in the fifth year of Guangxu (1879), and said:“《何典》十回。是书为过路人编定，缠夹二先生评，而太平客人为之序。书中引用诸人，有曰活鬼者，有曰穷鬼者，有曰活死人者，有曰臭花娘者，有曰畔房小姐者：阅之已堪喷饭。况阅其所记，无一非三家村俗语；无中生有，忙里偷闲。其言，则鬼话也；其人，则鬼名也；其事，则开鬼心，扮鬼脸，钓鬼火，做鬼戏，搭鬼棚也。语曰，‘出于何典’？而今而后，有人以俗语为文者，曰‘出于《何典》’而已矣。”
“《何典》十回。 是书为过路人编定，缠夹二先生评，而太平客人为之序。 书中引用诸人，有曰活鬼者，有曰穷鬼者，有曰活死人者，有曰臭花娘者，有曰畔房小姐者：阅之已堪喷饭。 况阅其所记，无一非三家村俗语；无中生有，忙里偷闲。 其言，则鬼话也；其人，则鬼名也；其事，则开鬼心，扮鬼脸，钓鬼火，做鬼戏，搭鬼棚也。 语曰，‘出于何典’？而今而后，有人以俗语为文者，曰‘出于《何典》’而已矣。 ”疑其颇别致，于是留心访求，但不得；常维钧多识旧书肆中人，因托他搜寻，仍不得。今年半农告我已在厂甸庙市中无意得之，且将校点付印；听了甚喜。此后半农便将校样陆续寄来，并且说希望我做一篇短序，他知道我是至多也只能做短序的。然而我还很踌蹰，我总觉得没有这种本领。我以为许多事是做的人必须有这一门特长的，这才做得好。譬如，标点只能让汪原放，做序只能推胡适之，出版只能由亚东图书馆；刘半农，李小峰，我，皆非其选也。然而我却决定要写几句。为什么呢？只因为我终于决定要写几句了。
I suspected that it was quite chic, so I paid attention to it, but I couldn't find it; Chang Weijun knew many people from the second-hand bookstore, so he asked him to search for them, but still couldn't find them. This year, half of the farmers told me that I had accidentally obtained it in the factory temple market, and the officer ordered it to be printed; I was very happy to hear this. After that, Bannong sent proofs one after another, and said that he wanted me to make a short preface, and he knew that I could only do a short preface at most. However, I was still very hesitant, and I always felt that I didn't have this skill. I think that people who do many things must have this specialty to do it well. For example, punctuation can only be released by Wang, preface can only be pushed by Hu Shizhi, and publication can only be published by the Far Eastern Library; Liu Bannong, Li Xiaofeng, and I are not his choices. However, I decided to write a few sentences. Why? Just because I finally decided to write a few sentences.还未开手，而躬逢战争，在炮声和流言当中，很不宁帖，没有执笔的心思。夹着是得知又有文士之徒在什么报上骂半农了，说《何典》广告怎样不高尚，不料大学教授而竟堕落至于斯。这颇使我凄然，因为由此记起了别的事，而且也以为“不料大学教授而竟堕落至于斯”。从此一见《何典》，便感到苦痛，再也说不出一句话。
Before he started, he was in the midst of war, and in the midst of the sound of cannons and rumors, he was very restless and had no intention of writing. In addition, I learned that there were scholars who scolded Bannon in some newspaper, saying how noble the advertisement of "He Dian" was, but unexpectedly the university professor had fallen to such a point. This made me quite sad, because it reminded me of other things, and I also thought that "I didn't expect a university professor to fall to this". From then on, as soon as I saw "He Dian", I felt painful and could no longer say a word.是的，大学教授要堕落下去。无论高的或矮的，白的或黑的，或灰的。不过有些是别人谓之堕落，而我谓之困苦。我所谓困苦之一端，便是失了身分。我曾经做过《论“他妈的！”》早有青年道德家乌烟瘴气地浩叹过了，还讲身分么？但是也还有些讲身分。我虽然“深恶而痛绝之”于那些戴着面具的绅士，却究竟不是“学匪”世家；见了所谓“正人君子”固然决定摇头，但和歪人奴子相处恐怕也未必融洽。用了无差别的眼光看，大学教授做一个滑稽的，或者甚而至于夸张的广告何足为奇？就是做一个满嘴“他妈的”的广告也何足为奇？然而呀，这里用得着然而了，我是究竟生在十九世纪的，又做过几年官，和所谓“孤桐先生”同部，官——上等人——气骤不易退，所以有时也觉得教授最相宜的也还是上讲台。又要然而了，然而必须有够活的薪水，兼差倒可以。这主张在教育界大概现在已经有一致赞成之望，去年在什么公理会上一致攻击兼差的公理维持家，今年也颇有一声不响地去兼差的了，不过“大报”上决不会登出来，自己自然更未必做广告。
Yes, university professors are going to fall. Whether tall or short, white or black, or gray. But some are what others call depravity, and I call them misery. One of my so-called hardships is the loss of identity. I once wrote "On "Fuck! "" has long been a young moralist who sighed angrily, do you still talk about identity? But there is also some identity. Although I "hate and hate them" to those gentlemen wearing masks, I am not a "scholar bandit" after all; Although he decided to shake his head when he saw the so-called "upright gentleman", he may not get along well with crooked slaves. With an indiscriminate perspective, what is it that a university professor would do a funny, or even exaggerated advertisement? Even if it's a mouthful of "fucking" ads, what's so surprising? However, I was born in the nineteenth century, and I was an official for a few years, and I was in the same department as the so-called "Mr. Gu Tong". However, there must be a salary to live with, and part-time work is fine. This proposition is probably now unanimously supported by the education circles, and last year it unanimously attacked the axiom maintainers who worked part-time at what congregational meeting, and this year they have also gone to the part-time job quite silently, but they will never be published in the "big newspaper", and naturally they may not advertise.半农到德法研究了音韵好几年，我虽然不懂他所做的法文书，只知道里面很夹些中国字和高高低低的曲线，但总而言之，书籍具在，势必有人懂得。所以他的正业，我以为也还是将这些曲线教给学生们。可是北京大学快要关门大吉了；他兼差又没有。那么，即使我是怎样的十足上等人，也不能反对他印卖书。既要印卖，自然想多销，既想多销，自然要做广告，既做广告，自然要说好。难道有自己印了书，却发广告说这书很无聊，请列位不必看的么？说我的杂感无一读之价值的广告，那是西滢（即陈源）做的。——顺便在此给自己登一个广告罢：陈源何以给我登这样的反广告的呢，只要一看我的《华盖集》就明白。主顾诸公，看呀！快看呀！每本大洋六角，北新书局发行。
Bannon went to Germany and France to study phonology for several years, although I didn't understand the French books he made, I only knew that there were some Chinese characters and high and low curves in them, but all in all, the books are there, and someone is bound to understand. So I think he still teaches these curves to his students. But Peking University is about to close; He didn't have a part-time job. Then, no matter how superior I am, I cannot oppose him printing and selling books. If you want to print and sell, you naturally want to sell more, if you want to sell more, you must naturally advertise, and if you want to advertise, you must naturally say good. Is there anyone who prints a book by himself, but advertises that the book is boring, please don't read it? The advertisement that said that my miscellaneous feelings were worthless was made by Xi Ying (i.e. Chen Yuan). ——By the way, I put an advertisement for myself here: Why did Chen Yuan put such an anti-advertisement for me, just look at my "Huagai Collection" to understand. Lords, look! Look! Each Ocean Hexagon is published by Beixin Book Company.想起来已经有二十多年了，以革命为事的陶焕卿，穷得不堪，在上海自称会稽先生，教人催眠术以糊口。有一天他问我，可有什么药能使人一嗅便睡去的呢？我明知道他怕施术不验，求助于药物了。其实呢，在大众中试验催眠，本来是不容易成功的。我又不知道他所寻求的妙药，爱莫能助。两三月后，报章上就有投书（也许是广告）出现，说会稽先生不懂催眠术，以此欺人。清政府却比这干鸟人灵敏得多，所以通缉他的时候，有一联对句道：“著《中国权力史》，学日本催眠术。”
Thinking about it, it has been more than 20 years, Tao Huanqing, who is engaged in revolution, is so poor that he calls himself Mr. Kuaiji in Shanghai and teaches people hypnosis to make a living. One day he asked me, what medicine can make people fall asleep by smelling? I knew that he was afraid that the operation would not work, so he turned to medicine. In fact, experimenting with hypnosis in the public is not easy to succeed. I don't know the magic medicine he is seeking, and love can't help. Two or three months later, a letter (perhaps an advertisement) appeared in the newspaper, saying that Mr. Kuaiji did not understand hypnosis and deceived people. The Qing government was much more sensitive than this dry birdman, so when he was wanted, there was a couplet saying: "Write "History of Chinese Power" and learn Japanese hypnosis. ”《何典》快要出版了，短序也已经迫近交卷的时候。夜雨潇潇地下着，提起笔，忽而又想到用麻绳做腰带的困苦的陶焕卿，还夹杂些和《何典》不相干的思想。但序文已经迫近了交卷的时候，只得写出来，而且还要印上去。我并非将半农比附“乱党”，——现在的中华民国虽由革命造成，但许多中华民国国民，都仍以那时的革命者为乱党，是明明白白的，——不过说，在此时，使我回忆从前，念及几个朋友，并感到自己的依然无力而已。
"He Dian" is about to be published, and the short preface is approaching the time to hand over the volume. Night rain fell lightly, picked up the pen, and suddenly thought of Tao Huanqing, who was struggling to make a belt with hemp rope, and mixed with some thoughts that had nothing to do with "He Dian". But the preface was approaching the time to hand in the paper, so it had to be written and printed. Although the current Republic of China was created by the revolution,——, many people of the Republic of China still regard the revolutionaries of that time as a rebellious party,—— but at this time, it makes me think of the past, think of a few friends, and feel that I am still powerless.但短序总算已经写成，虽然不像东西，却究竟结束了一件事。我还将此时的别的心情写下，并且发表出去，也作为《何典》的广告。
But the short preface has finally been written, and although it doesn't look like a thing, it ends one thing. I also wrote down my other moods at this time and published them as an advertisement for "He Dian".五月二十五日之夜，碰着东壁下，书。
