Prelude在日记还未写上一字之前，先做序文，谓之豫序。
Before writing a word in the diary, make a preface, which is called a preface.我本来每天写日记，是写给自己看的；大约天地间写着这样日记的人们很不少。假使写的人成了名人，死了之后便也会印出；看的人也格外有趣味，因为他写的时候不像做《内感篇》外冒篇似的须摆空架子，所以反而可以看出真的面目来。我想，这是日记的正宗嫡派。
I used to write a diary every day, and I wrote it for myself; There are probably many people in the world who write such diaries. If the person who wrote it becomes a celebrity, it will be printed after death; The people who watch it are also particularly interesting, because when he writes, he doesn't have to put on an empty shelf like doing the "Inner Sense" outer chapter, so you can see the real face. I think this is the authentic branch of the diary.我的日记却不是那样。写的是信札往来，银钱收付，无所谓面目，更无所谓真假。例如：二月二日晴，得A信；B来。三月三日雨，收C校薪水X元，复D信。一行满了，然而还有事，因为纸张也颇可惜，便将后来的事写入前一天的空白中。总而言之：是不很可靠的。但我以为B来是在二月一，或者二月二，其实不甚有关系，即便不写也无妨；而实际上，不写的时候也常有。我的目的，只在记上谁有来信，以便答复，或者何时答复过，尤其是学校的薪水，收到何年何月的几成几了，零零星星，总是记不清楚，必须有一笔帐，以便检查，庶几乎两不含胡，我也知道自己有多少债放在外面，万一将来收清之后，要成为怎样的一个小富翁。此外呢，什么野心也没有了。
My diary is not like that. It is written that letters and letters are exchanged, and money is received and paid, regardless of appearance, and it does not matter whether it is true or false. For example: February 2 is sunny, and I get a letter A; B comes. On March 3rd, it rained, and C school salary X yuan was collected, and D letters were restored. The line was full, but there was still something to do, because the paper was also a pity, so I wrote what happened later in the blank of the previous day. In short: it is not very reliable. But I thought B came on February 1st or February 2nd, which actually doesn't matter much, even if I don't write it; In fact, there are often times when I don't write. My purpose is only to record who has a letter in order to reply, or when it has been replied, especially the school's salary, how many years and months have been received, sporadically, always I can't remember clearly, there must be an account, so that there is almost no Hu, and I also know how many debts I have outside, in case I will become a little rich man after it is paid off in the future. In addition, there is no ambition left.吾乡的李慈铭先生，是就以日记为著述的，上自朝章，中至学问，下迄相骂，都记录在那里面。果然，现在已有人将那手迹用石印印出了，每部五十元，在这样的年头，不必说学生，就是先生也无从买起。那日记上就记着，当他每装成一函的时候，早就有人借来借去的传钞了，正不必老远的等待“身后”。这虽然不像日记的正脉，但若有志在立言，意存褒贬，欲人知而又畏人知的，却不妨模仿着试试。什么做了一点白话，便说是要在一百年后发表的书里面的一篇，真是其蠢臭为不可及也。
Mr. Li Ciming from my hometown wrote in his diary, from the court chapters, to learning, to the scolding, all recorded in it. Sure enough, now someone has printed the handwriting with stone prints, fifty yuan each, in such a year, not to mention students, even teachers can't afford it. The diary recorded that when he made a letter, someone had already borrowed and borrowed money to pass on it, and he didn't have to wait far for "behind him". Although this is not like the main vein of the diary, if you are interested in making a statement, have praise and criticism, and want to be known but afraid of being known, you might as well try to imitate it. What does it do a little vernacular, that is, it is said that it is an article in a book to be published a hundred years later, which is really stupid and unattainable.我这回的日记，却不是那样的“有厚望焉”的，也不是原先的很简单的，现在还没有，想要写起来。四五天以前看见半农，说是要编《世界日报》的副刊去，你得寄一点稿。那自然是可以的喽。然而稿子呢？这可着实为难。看副刊的大抵是学生，都是过来人，做过什么“学而时习之不亦说乎论”或“人心不古议”的，一定知道做文章是怎样的味道。有人说我是“文学家”，其实并不是的，不要相信他们的话，那证据，就是我也最怕做文章。
My diary this time is not so "hopeful", nor is it very simple as before, and I don't have it yet, and I want to write it. Four or five days ago, I saw Bannong, who said that he was going to edit a supplement to the World Journal, and you had to send a little manuscript. That's naturally possible. But what about the manuscript? This is really difficult. Most of the students who read the supplement are people who have been there, and they must know what it is like to make an article if they have done something "learning and learning from time to time" or "people's hearts are not ancient discussions". Some people say that I am a "writer", but in fact it is not, don't believe their words, the evidence is that I am also most afraid of making a fool.然而既然答应了，总得想点法。想来想去，觉得感想倒偶尔也有一点的，平时接着一懒，便搁下，忘掉了。如果马上写出，恐怕倒也是杂感一类的东西。于是乎我就决计：一想到，就马上写下来，马上寄出去，算作我的画到簿。因为这是开首就准备给第三者看的，所以恐怕也未必很有真面目，至少，不利于己的事，现在总还要藏起来。愿读者先明白这一点。
However, since he agreed, he had to think of a way. After thinking about it, I feel that I occasionally have a little feeling, and I usually get lazy, so I put it aside and forget about it. If I write it right away, I'm afraid it's a miscellaneous feeling. So I decided: as soon as I thought of it, I would write it down immediately, send it out immediately, and count it as my painting in the book. Because this is prepared to be shown to a third party at the beginning, I am afraid that it may not be very true, at least, things that are not conducive to oneself must be hidden now. I hope the reader understands this first.如果写不出，或者不能写了，马上就收场。所以这日记要有多么长，现在一点不知道。
If you can't write it, or if you can't write it, it will end immediately. So how long this diary will be, I don't know at all now.一九二六年六月二十五日，记于东壁下。
On June 25, 1926, it was recorded under the east wall.

马上日记

六月二十五日

马上日记

June 25th晴。
Clear.生病。——今天还写这个，仿佛有点多事似的。因为这是十天以前的事，现在倒已经可以算得好起来了。不过余波还没有完，所以也只好将这作为开宗明义章第一。谨案才子立言，总须大嚷三大苦难：一曰穷，二曰病，三曰社会迫害我。那结果，便是失掉了爱人；若用专门名词，则谓之失恋。我的开宗明义虽然近似第二大苦难，实际上却不然，倒是因为端午节前收了几文稿费，吃东西吃坏了，从此就不消化，胃痛。我的胃的八字不见佳，向来就担不起福泽的。也很想看医生。中医，虽然有人说是玄妙无穷，内科尤为独步，我可总是不相信。西医呢，有名的看资贵，事情忙，诊视也潦草，无名的自然便宜些，然而我总还有些踌蹰。事情既然到了这样，当然只好听凭敝胃隐隐地痛着了。
Sick. ——Writing this today, as if it is a bit troublesome. Because this was ten days ago, it can be considered better now. However, the aftermath is not over yet, so I have to take this as the first chapter of the opening of the Ming Yi Chapter. According to the words of talented people, we must always shout about three major sufferings: poverty, illness, and social persecution. The result is the loss of a lover; If you use a special term, it is called a broken love. Although my founding intention is similar to the second greatest suffering, it is actually not, but because I received a few manuscript fees before the Dragon Boat Festival, and I ate badly, and I couldn't digest it and had stomach pain. My stomach is not good, and I have never been able to bear the blessings. I also want to see a doctor. Although some people say that traditional Chinese medicine is infinitely mysterious, internal medicine is particularly unique, but I always don't believe it. As for Western medicine, the famous one is expensive, the matter is busy, the diagnosis is also sloppy, and the nameless one is naturally cheaper, but I am always a little hesitant. Since things have come to this, of course, I have to listen to the faint pain in my stomach.自从西医割掉了梁启超的一个腰子以后，责难之声就风起云涌了，连对于腰子不很有研究的文学家也都“仗义执言”。同时，“中医了不得论”也就应运而起；腰子有病，何不服黄蓍欤？什么有病，何不吃鹿茸欤？但西医的病院里确也常有死尸抬出。我曾经忠告过G先生：你要开医院，万不可收留些看来无法挽回的病人；治好了走出，没有人知道，死掉了抬出，就哄动一时了，尤其是死掉的如果是“名流”。我的本意是在设法推行新医学，但G先生却似乎以为我良心坏。这也未始不可以那么想，——由他去罢。
Since Western medicine cut off one of Liang Qichao's waists, the voices of criticism have been surging, and even writers who are not very knowledgeable about waists have "spoken out righteously". At the same time, "traditional Chinese medicine is not to be discussed" has also emerged; If the waist is ill, why not take yellow yarrow? If you are sick, why not eat deer antler? But it is true that dead bodies are often carried out in Western medicine hospitals. I once advised Mr. G: If you want to open a hospital, you must not take in patients who seem irreparable; After being cured and walked out, no one knew, and if he died and carried out, he would be agitated for a while, especially if the dead were "celebrities". My intention was to try to promote a new medicine, but Mr. G seemed to think that I had a bad conscience. This is not something you can't think about,—— let him go.但据我看来，实行我所说的方法的医院可很有，只是他们的本意却并不在要使新医学通行。新的本国的西医又大抵模模胡胡，一出手便先学了中医一样的江湖诀，和水的龙胆丁几两日份八角；漱口的淡硼酸水每瓶一元。至于诊断学呢，我似的门外汉可不得而知。总之，西方的医学在中国还未萌芽，便已近于腐败。我虽然只相信西医，近来也颇有些望而却步了。
But in my opinion, there are many hospitals that implement the method I mentioned, but their original intention is not to make new medicine popular. The new Western medicine in the country is mostly mocking, and as soon as he makes a move, he first learns the same jianghu tricks as traditional Chinese medicine, and the gentian of water is a couple of days of star anise; The light boric acid water for rinsing your mouth is one yuan per bottle. As for diagnostics, I don't know if I am a layman. In short, Western medicine was close to corruption before it sprouted in China. Although I only believe in Western medicine, I have been a little discouraged recently.前几天和季茀谈起这些事，并且说，我的病，只要有熟人开一个方就好，用不着向什么博士化冤钱。第二天，他就给我请了正在继续研究的Dr.H.来了。开了一个方，自然要用稀盐酸，还有两样这里无须说；我所最感谢的是又加些Sirup Simpel使我喝得甜甜的，不为难。向药房去配药，可又成为问题了，因为药房也不免有模模胡胡的，他所没有的药品，也许就替换，或者竟删除。结果是托Fraeulein H.远远地跑到较大的药房去。
A few days ago, I talked to Ji Fu about these things, and said that my illness, as long as an acquaintance prescribes a prescription, there is no need to pay any doctor for wrongful money. The next day, he invited Dr. H., who was continuing his research, to come. If you open a prescription, you naturally need to use dilute hydrochloric acid, and there are two things that need not be said here; What I am most grateful for is that I added some Sirup Simpel to make it sweet, so I didn't have to worry about it. Dispensing medicine to the pharmacy has become a problem again, because the pharmacy is inevitably nonsense, and the medicine he does not have may be replaced, or even deleted. The result was that Fraeulein H. ran far away to the larger pharmacy.这样一办，加上车钱，也还要比医院的药价便宜到四分之三。
In this way, plus the car fare, it is also three-quarters cheaper than the hospital's drug price.胃酸得了外来的生力军，强盛起来，一瓶药还未喝完，痛就停止了。我决定多喝它几天。但是，第二瓶却奇怪，同一的药房，同一的药方，药味可是不同一了；不像前一回的甜，也不酸。我检查我自己，并不发热，舌苔也不厚，这分明是药水有些蹊跷。喝了两回，坏处倒也没有；幸而不是急病，不大要紧，便照例将它喝完。去买第三瓶时，却附带了严重的质问；那回答是：也许糖分少了一点罢。这意思就是说紧要的药品没有错。中国的事情真是稀奇，糖分少一点，不但不甜，连酸也不酸了，的确是“特别国情”。
The stomach acid got a new force from outside, and it became strong, and the pain stopped before a bottle of medicine was finished. I decided to drink it for a few more days. However, the second bottle is strange, the same pharmacy, the same prescription, the taste of the medicine is different; It's not as sweet as the last time, and it's not sour. I checked myself, I didn't have a fever, and the tongue coating was not thick, which was clearly a bit strange in the potion. I drank it twice, but there was no harm; Fortunately, it was not an emergency, so it didn't matter, so I drank it as usual. when I went to buy the third bottle, it was accompanied by serious questions; The answer is: maybe it's a little less sugar. This means that there is nothing wrong with important medicines. Things in China are really strange, less sugar, not only not sweet, not even sour, it is indeed a "special national condition".现在多攻击大医院对于病人的冷漠，我想，这些医院，将病人当作研究品，大概是有的，还有在院里的“高等华人”，将病人看作下等研究品，大概也是有的。不愿意的，只好上私人所开的医院去，可是诊金药价都很贵。请熟人开了方去买药呢，药水也会先后不同起来。
Nowadays, I attack the indifference of large hospitals to patients, I think that there are probably some of these hospitals that treat patients as research objects, and there are probably "higher Chinese" in the hospital who regard patients as inferior research objects. If you don't want to, you have to go to a private hospital, but the price of the consultation is very expensive. If you ask an acquaintance to prescribe a prescription to buy medicine, the potions will be different.这是人的问题。做事不切实，便什么都可疑。吕端大事不胡涂，犹言小事不妨胡涂点，这自然很足以显示我们中国人的雅量，然而我的胃痛却因此延长了。在宇宙的森罗万象中，我的胃痛当然不过是小事，或者简直不算事。
This is a human problem. If you don't do things practically, everything will be suspicious. Lu Duan doesn't mess around on big things, and he says that small things might as well be foolish, which is naturally enough to show the elegance of our Chinese, but my stomach pain has been prolonged. In the midst of all the universe, my stomach ache is of course nothing more than a trivial matter, or nothing at all.质问之后的第三瓶药水，药味就同第一瓶一样了。先前的闷胡卢，到此就很容易打破，就是那第二瓶里，是只有一日分的药，却加了两日分的水的，所以药味比正当的要薄一半。
The third bottle of potion after questioning tasted the same as the first bottle. The previous stuffy hulu is easy to break here, that is, in the second bottle, there is only one day's worth of medicine, but two days' worth of water is added, so the taste of the medicine is half thinner than the legitimate one.虽然连吃药也那么蹭蹬，病却也居然好起来了。病略见好，H就攻击我头发长，说为什么不赶快去剪发。
Although he was so hesitant to take medicine, his illness actually got better. When I got better, H attacked me for having long hair and said why don't you get a haircut quickly.这种攻击是听惯的，照例“着毋庸议”。但也不想用功，只是清理抽屉。翻翻废纸，其中有一束纸条，是前几年钞写的；这很使我觉得自己也日懒一日了，现在早不想做这类事。那时大概是想要做一篇攻击近时印书，胡乱标点之谬的文章的，废纸中就钞有很奇妙的例子。要塞进字纸篓里时，觉得有几条总还是爱不忍释，现在钞几条在这里，马上印出，以便“有目共赏”罢。其余的便作为换取火柴之助——
This kind of attack is accustomed to hearing, and it is "unnecessarily discussed" as usual. But I don't want to work hard, just clean the drawers. Rummaging through the waste paper, there was a bundle of notes, which were written by banknotes a few years ago; This makes me feel like I'm lazy every day, and I don't want to do this kind of thing now. At that time, I probably wanted to make an article that attacked the recent printing of books and the error of punctuation, and there were wonderful examples of banknotes in waste paper. When I stuffed it into the paper basket, I felt that there were a few that I still couldn't bear to let go, but now a few banknotes are here, and they are printed immediately so that they can be "appreciated by everyone". The rest is used as a match for help -“国朝陈锡路黄嬭余话云。唐傅奕考覈道经众本。有项羽妾。本齐武平五年彭城人。开项羽妾冢。得之。”（上海进步书局石印本《茶香室丛钞》卷四第二叶。）
Chen Xilu Huang Huanyu of the National Dynasty said. Tang Fu Yi examined the various foundations of the Taoist scriptures. He had a concubine named Xiang Yu. He was originally from Pengcheng in the fifth year of the reign of King Wuping of the Qi dy The tomb of Xiang Yu's concubine was opened. I got it. (Shanghai Progress Book Company's stone print "Tea Fragrance Room Congba" volume 4, second leaf.) ）“国朝欧阳泉点勘记云。欧阳修醉翁亭。记让泉也。本集及滁州石刻。並同诸选本。作酿泉。误也。”（同上卷八第七叶。）
“国朝欧阳泉点勘记云。 欧阳修醉翁亭。 记让泉也。 本集及滁州石刻。 並同诸选本。 作酿泉。 误也。 ”（同上卷八第七叶。 ）“袁石公典试秦中。后颇自悔。其少作诗文。皆粹然一出于正。”（上海士林精舍石印本《书影》卷一第四叶。）
Yuan Shigong tried Qinzhong. Later, he regretted it quite a bit. In his youth, he wrote poetry and prose. All of them are pure and come from the right path. (Shanghai Shilin Jingshe stone print "Book Shadow", volume 1, fourth leaf.) ）“考……顺治中，秀水又有一陈忱，……著诚斋诗集，不出户庭，录读史随笔，同姓名录诸书。”（上海亚东图书馆排印本《水浒续集两种序》第七叶。）
"Exam...... During the Shunzhi period, there was another Chen Chen in Xiushui,...... He is the author of a collection of poems by Chengzhai, and without leaving the courtyard, he transcribes historical essays and books with the same name. (The seventh leaf of the typesetting version of "Two Prefaces to the Sequel to Water Margin" by the Shanghai Far Eastern Library.) ）标点古文，确是一种小小的难事，往往无从下笔；有许多处，我常疑心即使请作者自己来标点，怕也不免于迟疑。但上列的几条，却还不至于那么无从索解。末两条的意义尤显豁，而标点也弄得更聪明。
Punctuating ancient texts is indeed a small difficulty, and it is often impossible to write; There are many places, and I often doubt that even if the author is asked to punctuate it himself, I am afraid that he will not hesitate. But the above few are not so incomprehensible. The meaning of the last two is particularly open, and the punctuation is also smarter.

马上日记

六月二十六日

马上日记

June 26晴。
Clear.上午，得霁野从他家乡寄来的信，话并不多，说家里有病人，别的一切人也都在毫无防备的将被疾病袭击的恐怖中；末尾还有几句感慨。
In the morning, De Jiye sent a letter from his hometown, which did not say much, saying that there were patients at home, and everyone else was in the horror of being attacked by the disease without defense; There are a few more emotions at the end.午后，织芳从河南来，谈了几句，匆匆忙忙地就走了，放下两个包，说这是“方糖”，送你吃的，怕不见得好。织芳这一回有点发胖，又这么忙，又穿着方马褂，我恐怕他将要做官了。
In the afternoon, Zhi Fang came from Henan, talked a few words, and left in a hurry, put down two bags, saying that this was a "sugar cube", and it was for you to eat, I was afraid it might not be good. Zhi Fang is a little fat this time, so busy, and wearing a square coat, I'm afraid he will become an official.打开包来看时，何尝是“方”的，却是圆圆的小薄片，黄棕色。吃起来又凉又细腻，确是好东西。但我不明白织芳为什么叫它“方糖”？但这也就可以作为他将要做官的一证。
When I opened the bag, it was "square", but it was a small round flake, yellowish-brown. It tastes cold and delicate, and it is indeed a good thing. But I don't understand why Zhi Fang calls it a "sugar cube"? But this can also be used as proof that he will be an official.景宋说这是河南一处什么地方的名产，是用柿霜做成的；性凉，如果嘴角上生些小疮之类，用这一搽，便会好。怪不得有这么细腻，原来是凭了造化的妙手，用柿皮来滤过的。可惜到他说明的时候，我已经吃了一大半了。连忙将所余的收起，豫备将来嘴角上生疮的时候，好用这来搽。
Jing Song said that this is a specialty of a place in Henan, which is made of persimmon frost; It is cool, if there are some small sores on the corners of the mouth, it will be good if you use this brush. No wonder it is so delicate, it turned out to be filtered with persimmon skin by the skillful hand of nature. Unfortunately, by the time he explained, I had already eaten more than half of it. Quickly put away the rest, preparing for the sores on the corners of the mouth in the future, so that it can be used to apply them.夜间，又将藏着的柿霜糖吃了一大半，因为我忽而又以为嘴角上生疮的时候究竟不很多，还不如现在趁新鲜吃一点。不料一吃，就又吃了一大半了。
At night, I ate more than half of the persimmon frost candy I hidden, because I suddenly thought that there weren't many sores on the corners of my mouth, so it was better to eat a little while it was fresh. Unexpectedly, as soon as I ate it, I ate more than half of it.

June 28晴，大风。
Sunny, strong wind.上午出门，主意是在买药，看见满街挂着五色国旗；军警林立。走到丰盛胡同中段，被军警驱入一条小胡同中。少顷，看见大路上黄尘滚滚，一辆摩托车驰过；少顷，又是一辆；少顷，又是一辆；又是一辆；又是一辆……。车中人看不分明，但见金边帽。车边上挂着兵，有的背着扎红绸的板刀；小胡同中人都肃然有敬畏之意。又少顷，摩托车没有了，我们渐渐溜出，军警也不作声。
When I went out in the morning, I thought about buying medicine and saw five-colored national flags hanging all over the streets; There are many military and police officers. Walking to the middle of Fengsheng Hutong, he was driven into a small alley by the military and police. After a while, I saw yellow dust rolling on the road, and a motorcycle galloped by; After a while, it was another one; After a while, it was another one; Another one; Another ....... The people in the carriage could not see clearly, only the gold-rimmed hat. There were soldiers hanging on the side of the car, some carrying knives tied with red silk; The people in the alley were in awe. After a while, the motorcycle was gone, and we gradually slipped out, and the military and police did not make a sound.溜到西单牌楼大街，也是满街挂着五色国旗，军警林立。一群破衣孩子，各各拿着一把小纸片，叫道：欢迎吴玉帅号外呀！一个来叫我买，我没有买。
Slipping to Xidan Pailou Street, the streets are also full of five-colored national flags, and there are many military and police. A group of children in tattered clothes, each holding a small piece of paper, shouted: Welcome Wu Yushuai! One came to ask me to buy it, but I didn't buy it.将近宣武门口，一个黄色制服，汗流满面的汉子从外面走进来，忽而大声道：草你妈！许多人都对他看，但他走过去了，许多人也就不看了。走进宣武门城洞下，又是一个破衣孩子拿着一把小纸片，但却默默地将一张塞给我，接来一看，是石印的李国恒先生的传单，内中大意，是说他的多年痔疮，已蒙一个国手叫作什么先生的医好了。
Approaching the gate of Xuanwu, a man in a yellow uniform and sweaty walked in from outside, and suddenly said loudly: Grass your mother! Many people looked at him, but when he walked over, many people stopped looking. Walking into the Xuanwumen City Cave, another child in ragged clothes was holding a small piece of paper, but silently stuffed one into me, and when I took a look, it was a leaflet of Mr. Li Guoheng with a stone seal, which was to the effect that his hemorrhoids for many years had been cured by a national master called Mr. He.到了目的地的药房时，外面正有一群人围着看两个人的口角；一柄浅蓝色的旧洋伞正挡住药房门。我推那洋伞时，斤量很不轻；终于伞底下回过一个头来，问我“干什么？”我答说进去买药。他不作声，又回头去看口角去了，洋伞的位置依旧。我只好下了十二分的决心，猛力冲锋；一冲，可就冲进去了。
When I arrived at the destination pharmacy, there was a group of people outside watching the quarrel between the two people; An old light blue umbrella was blocking the door of the pharmacy. When I pushed the umbrella, the weight was not light; Finally, he turned around under the umbrella and asked me, "What are you doing?" I replied that I would go in and buy medicine. He remained silent, turned back to look at the corner of his mouth, and the position of the umbrella was still the same. I had to make up my mind to charge fiercely; As soon as he rushed, he rushed in.药房里只有帐桌上坐着一个外国人，其余的店伙都是年青的同胞，服饰干净漂亮。不知怎地，我忽而觉得十年以后，他们便都要变为高等华人，而自己却现在就有下等人之感。于是乎恭恭敬敬地将药方和瓶子捧呈给一位分开头发的同胞。
There was only a foreigner sitting at the account table in the pharmacy, and the rest of the shopkeepers were young compatriots, dressed cleanly and beautifully. Somehow, I suddenly felt that ten years from now, they would all become high-class Chinese, but I now feel inferior. So he respectfully presented the prescription and bottle to a compatriot with parted hair.“八毛五分。”他接了，一面走，一面说。
"Eight cents and five cents." He took it and said as he walked.“喂！”我实在耐不住，下等脾气又发作了。药价八毛，瓶子钱照例五分，我是知道的。现在自己带了瓶子，怎么还要付五分钱呢？这一个“喂”字的功用就和国骂的“他妈的”相同，其中含有这么多的意义。
"Hey!" I couldn't stand it anymore, and my temper flares up again. The price of the medicine is eight cents, and the bottle is five cents as usual, I know. Now that I brought my own bottle, why do I have to pay five cents? The function of this word "feed" is the same as the "fucking" of the national scolding, which contains so many meanings.“八毛！”他也立刻懂得，将五分钱让去，真是“从善如流”，有正人君子的风度。
"Eight cents!" He also immediately understood that giving away five cents was really "good like a stream" and had the demeanor of a decent gentleman.我付了八毛钱，等候一会，药就拿出来了。我想，对付这一种同胞，有时是不宜于太客气的。于是打开瓶塞，当面尝了一尝。
I paid eight cents, waited for a while, and the medicine was taken out. I think it is sometimes not appropriate to be too polite to deal with this kind of compatriot. So I opened the cork and tasted it in person.“没有错的。”他很聪明，知道我不信任他。
"There's nothing wrong." He was smart and knew I didn't trust him.“唔。”我点头表示赞成。其实是，还是不对，我的味觉不至于很麻木，这回觉得太酸了一点了，他连量杯也懒得用，那稀盐酸分明已经过量。然而这于我倒毫无妨碍的，我可以每回少喝些，或者对上水，多喝它几回。所以说“唔”；“唔”者，介乎两可之间，莫明其真意之所在之答话也。
"Hmm." I nodded in agreement. In fact, yes, or not, my taste is not very numb, this time I feel a little too sour, he doesn't even bother to use the measuring cup, the dilute hydrochloric acid is clearly excessive. However, this does not hinder me, I can drink less each time, or drink it a few more times with water. So say "no"; "No" is an answer that is between the two and does not know where the true meaning lies.“回见回见！”我取了瓶子，走着说。
"See you again!" I took the bottle and walked away.“回见。不喝水么？”
"See you again. Don't drink water? ”“不喝了。回见。”
"Don't drink anymore. See you later. ”我们究竟是礼教之邦的国民，归根结蒂，还是礼让。让出了玻璃门之后，在大毒日头底下的尘土中趱行，行到东长安街左近，又是军警林立。我正想横穿过去，一个巡警伸手拦住道：不成！我说只要走十几步，到对面就好了。他的回答仍然是：不成！那结果，是从别的道路绕。
Whether we are citizens of the country of etiquette or courtesy, in the final analysis, is still courtesy. After giving up the glass door, he walked in the dust under the poisonous sun, and when he walked to the left side of East Chang'an Street, there were many military and police officers. I was about to cross over, but a patrol officer stretched out his hand to stop me and said: No! I said that just a dozen steps to the opposite side. His answer is still no! As a result, it was a detour from another road.绕到L君的寓所前，便打门，打出一个小使来，说L君出去了，须得午饭时候才回家。我说，也快到这个时候了，我在这里等一等罢。他说：不成！你贵姓呀？这使我很狼狈，路既这么远，走路又这么难，白走一遭，实在有些可惜。我想了十秒钟，便从衣袋里挖出一张名片来，叫他进去禀告太太，说有这么一个人，要在这里等一等，可以不？约有半刻钟，他出来了，结果是：也不成！先生要三点钟才回来哩，你三点钟再来罢。
When I went around to Mr. L's apartment, I knocked on the door and sent out a small messenger, saying that Mr. L was out and would not go home until lunch. I said, it's almost this time, I'll wait here. He said: No! Is your surname your surname? This made me very embarrassed, the road was so far, and it was so difficult to walk, it was a pity to walk in vain. I thought for ten seconds, then dug out a business card from my pocket and asked him to go in and report to his wife, saying that there was such a person, and he had to wait here, okay? After about half a quarter of an hour, he came out, and the result was: no! Sir, you won't be back until three o'clock; you can come back at three o'clock.又想了十秒钟，只好决计去访C君，仍在大毒日头底下的尘土中趱行，这回总算一路无阻，到了。打门一问，来开门的答道：去看一看可在家。我想：这一次是大有希望了。果然，即刻领我进客厅，C君也跑出来。我首先就要求他请我吃午饭。于是请我吃面包，还有葡萄酒；主人自己却吃面。那结果是一盘面包被我吃得精光，虽然另有奶油，可是四碟菜也所余无几了。
After thinking about it for another ten seconds, I had to decide to visit Mr. C, still walking in the dust under the poisonous sun, and this time I finally arrived all the way unhindered. When he knocked on the door and asked, the person who came to open the door replied: Go and take a look at it. I thought: this time there is a lot of hope. Sure enough, he immediately led me into the living room, and Mr. C also ran out. I first asked him to treat me to lunch. So I was invited to bread and wine; The owner himself eats noodles. The result was a plate of bread that I had eaten, and although there was butter, there was not much left for the four plates.吃饱了就讲闲话，直到五点钟。
When you are full, gossip until five o'clock.客厅外是很大的一块空地方，种着许多树。一株频果树下常有孩子们徘徊；C君说，那是在等候频果落下来的；因为有定律：谁拾得就归谁所有。我很笑孩子们耐心，肯做这样的迂远事。然而奇怪，到我辞别出去时，我看见三个孩子手里已经各有一个频果了。
Outside the living room is a large empty space with many trees. children often wander under a fruit tree; Mr. C said that he was waiting for the fruit to fall; Because there is a law: whoever finds it belongs to whoever it is. I laugh at the children's patience and willingness to do such a roundabout thing. However, strangely, when I said goodbye and went out, I saw that each of the three children had a frequency fruit in their hands.回家看日报，上面说：“……吴在长辛店留宿一宵。除上述原因外，尚有一事，系吴由保定启程后，张其锽曾为吴卜一课，谓二十八日入京大利，必可平定西北。二十七日入京欠佳。吴颇以为然。此亦吴氏迟一日入京之由来也。”因此又想起我今天“不成”了大半天，运气殊属欠佳，不如也卜一课，以觇晚上的休咎罢。但我不明卜法，又无筮龟，实在无从措手。后来发明了一种新法，就是随便拉过一本书来，闭了眼睛，翻开，用手指指下去，然后张开眼，看指着的两句，就算是卜辞。
When I went home and read the daily newspaper, it said, "...... Wu Sheng stayed overnight at Changxin Inn. In addition to the above reasons, there is another thing, after Wu set off from Baoding, Zhang Qiqiang once gave Wu a lesson, saying that entering Beijing on the 28th will definitely be able to pacify the northwest. On the 27th, I entered the capital and was not good. Wu Sheng thought this was quite reasonable. This is also the reason why Wu arrived in the capital a day late. Therefore, I remembered that I had "failed" for most of the day today, and my luck was very bad, so I might as well take a lesson to see what would happen in the evening. But I don't know how to divine, and I don't know how to divine, so I really can't do anything. Later, a new method was invented, that is, to pull a book casually, close your eyes, open them, point them down with your fingers, and then open your eyes to look at the two sentences pointed to, even if they are divination.用的是《陶渊明集》，如法泡制，那两句是：“寄意一言外，兹契谁能别。”详了一会，竟不知道是怎么一回事。
The two sentences are: "Outside the word, who can say goodbye." After a while, I didn't know what was going on.

Immediately pay for the diary前几天会见小峰，谈到自己要在半农所编的副刊上投点稿，那名目是《马上日记》。小峰怃然曰，回忆归在《旧事重提》中，目下的杂感就写进这日记里面去……。意思之间，似乎是说：你在《语丝》上做什么呢？——但这也许是我自己的疑心病。我那时可暗暗地想：生长在敢于吃河豚的地方的人，怎么也会这样拘泥？政党会设支部，银行会开支店，我就不会写支日记的么？因为《语丝》上须投稿，而这暗想马上就实行了，于是乎作支日记。
A few days ago, I met Xiaofeng and talked about how he wanted to submit a manuscript in the supplement edited by Bannong, which was called "Diary Immediately". Xiaofeng said sadly, the memories are returned to "Revisiting Old Things", and the current miscellaneous feelings are written into this diary to ....... Between the meanings, it seems to say: What are you doing on "Yusi"? - But this may be my own suspicion. At that time, I secretly thought: How could people who grew up in places that dared to eat puffer fish be so stubborn? Political parties will set up branches, banks will open branches, won't I write a diary? Because "Yusi" had to be contributed, and this secret thought was immediately implemented, so I wrote a diary.

六月二十九日

马上支日记

June 29th晴。
Clear.早晨被一个小蝇子在脸上爬来爬去爬醒，赶开，又来；赶开，又来；而且一定要在脸上的一定的地方爬。打了一回，打它不死，只得改变方针：自己起来。
In the morning, I was awakened by a small fly crawling around on my face, driving away, and coming again; drive away, come again; And be sure to crawl in a certain place on your face. After beating it once, it didn't die, so I had to change my policy: get up by myself.记得前年夏天路过S州，那客店里的蝇群却着实使人惊心动魄。饭菜搬来时，它们先追逐着赏鉴；夜间就停得满屋，我们就枕，必须慢慢地，小心地放下头去，倘若猛然一躺，惊动了它们，便轰的一声，飞得你头昏眼花，一败涂地。到黎明，青年们所希望的黎明，那自然就照例地到你脸上来爬来爬去了。但我经过街上，看见一个孩子睡着，五六个蝇子在他脸上爬，他却睡得甜甜的，连皮肤也不牵动一下。在中国过活，这样的训练和涵养工夫是万不可少的。与其鼓吹什么“捕蝇”，倒不如练习这一种本领来得切实。
I remember passing by S State last summer, but the fly swarm in the inn was really thrilling. When the food is brought in, they chase and appreciate it first; At night, the house is full, and we are pillows, we must put our heads down slowly and carefully, and if we lie down suddenly and alarm them, it will make you dizzy and defeated. By dawn, the dawn that young people hope for, they will naturally crawl around on your face as usual. But when I passed by the street, I saw a child asleep, five or six flies crawling on his face, but he slept sweetly, not even touching his skin. To live in China, such training and cultivation are indispensable. Instead of advocating some "fly catching", it is better to practice this skill.什么事都不想做。不知道是胃病没有全好呢，还是缺少了睡眠时间。仍旧懒懒地翻翻废纸，又看见几条《茶香室丛钞》式的东西。已经团入字纸篓里的了，又觉得“弃之不甘”，挑一点关于《水浒传》的，移录在这里罢——
I don't want to do anything. I don't know if it's because the stomach problem is not completely cured, or if there is a lack of sleep time. I was still lazily rummaging through the waste paper, and I saw a few "Tea Fragrance Room Banknotes" style. It has already been put into the word basket, and I feel that I am "unwilling to abandon it", so pick a little about "Water Margin" and transfer it here——宋洪迈《夷坚甲志》十四云：“绍兴二十五年，吴傅朋说除守安丰军，自番阳遣一卒往呼吏士，行至舒州境，见村民穰穰，十百相聚，因弛担观之。其人曰，吾村有妇人为虎衔去，其夫不胜愤，独携刀往探虎穴，移时不反，今谋往救也。久之，民负死妻归，云，初寻迹至穴，虎牝牡皆不在，有二子戏岩窦下，即杀之，而隐其中以俟。少顷，望牝者衔一人至，倒身入穴，不知人藏其中也。吾急持尾，断其一足。虎弃所衔人，踉而窜；徐出视之，果吾妻也，死矣。虎曳足行数十步，堕涧中。吾复入窦伺，牡者俄咆跃而至，亦以尾先入，又如前法杀之。妻冤已报，无憾矣。乃邀邻里往视，舆四虎以归，分烹之。”案《水浒传》叙李逵沂岭杀四虎事，情状极相类，疑即本此等传说作之。《夷坚甲志》成于乾道初（1165），此条题云《舒民杀四虎》。
宋洪迈《夷坚甲志》十四云：“绍兴二十五年，吴傅朋说除守安丰军，自番阳遣一卒往呼吏士，行至舒州境，见村民穰穰，十百相聚，因弛担观之。 其人曰，吾村有妇人为虎衔去，其夫不胜愤，独携刀往探虎穴，移时不反，今谋往救也。 久之，民负死妻归，云，初寻迹至穴，虎牝牡皆不在，有二子戏岩窦下，即杀之，而隐其中以俟。 少顷，望牝者衔一人至，倒身入穴，不知人藏其中也。 吾急持尾，断其一足。 虎弃所衔人，踉而窜；徐出视之，果吾妻也，死矣。 虎曳足行数十步，堕涧中。 吾复入窦伺，牡者俄咆跃而至，亦以尾先入，又如前法杀之。 妻冤已报，无憾矣。 乃邀邻里往视，舆四虎以归，分烹之。 ”案《水浒传》叙李逵沂岭杀四虎事，情状极相类，疑即本此等传说作之。 《夷坚甲志》成于乾道初（1165），此条题云《舒民杀四虎》。宋庄季裕《鸡肋编》中云：“浙人以鸭儿为大讳。北人但知鸭羹虽甚热，亦无气。后至南方，乃始知鸭若只一雄，则虽合而无卵，须二三始有子，其以为讳者，盖为是耳，不在于无气也。”案《水浒传》叙郓哥向武大索麦稃，“武大道：‘我屋里又不养鹅鸭，那里有这麦稃？’郓哥道：‘你说没麦稃，怎地栈得肥地，便颠倒提起你来也不妨，煮你在锅里也没气？’武大道：‘含鸟猢狲！倒骂得我好。我的老婆又不偷汉子，我如何是鸭？’……”鸭必多雄始孕，盖宋时浙中俗说，今已不知。然由此可知《水浒传》确为旧本，其著者则浙人；虽庄季裕，亦仅知鸭羹无气而已。《鸡肋编》有绍兴三年（1133）序，去今已将八百年。
宋庄季裕《鸡肋编》中云：“浙人以鸭儿为大讳。 北人但知鸭羹虽甚热，亦无气。 后至南方，乃始知鸭若只一雄，则虽合而无卵，须二三始有子，其以为讳者，盖为是耳，不在于无气也。 ”案《水浒传》叙郓哥向武大索麦稃，“武大道：‘我屋里又不养鹅鸭，那里有这麦稃？’郓哥道：‘你说没麦稃，怎地栈得肥地，便颠倒提起你来也不妨，煮你在锅里也没气？’武大道：‘含鸟猢狲！倒骂得我好。 我的老婆又不偷汉子，我如何是鸭？’……”鸭必多雄始孕，盖宋时浙中俗说，今已不知。 然由此可知《水浒传》确为旧本，其著者则浙人；虽庄季裕，亦仅知鸭羹无气而已。 《鸡肋编》有绍兴三年（1133）序，去今已将八百年。元陈泰《所安遗集》《江南曲序》云：“余童艸时，闻长老言宋江事，未究其详。至治癸亥秋九月十六日，过梁山泊，舟遥见一峰，嵲雄跨，问之篙师，曰，此安山也，昔宋江事处，绝湖为池，阔九十里，皆蕖荷菱芡，相传以为宋妻所植。宋之为人，勇悍狂侠，其党如宋者三十六人。至今山下有分赃台，置石座三十六所，俗所谓‘去时三十六，归时十八双’，意者其自誓之辞也。始予过此，荷花弥望，今无复存者，惟残香相送耳。因记王荆公诗云：‘三十六陂春水，白头想见江南。’味其词，作《江南曲》以叙游历，且以慰宋妻种荷之意云。（原注：曲因蠹损无存。）”案宋江有妻在梁山泺中，且植芰荷，仅见于此；而谓江勇悍狂侠，亦与今所传性格绝殊，知《水浒》故事，宋元来异说多矣。泰字志同，号所安，茶陵人，延祐甲寅（1314），以《天马赋》中省试第十二名，会试赐乙卯科张起岩榜进士第，由翰林庶吉士改授龙南令，卒官。至曾孙朴，始集其遗文为一卷。成化丁未，来孙铨等又并补遗重刊之。《江南曲》即在补遗中，而失其诗。近《涵芬楼秘笈》第十集收金侃手写本，则并序失之矣。“舟遥见一峰”及“昔宋江事处”二句，当有脱误，未见别本，无以正之。

马上支日记

七月一日

马上支日记

July 1st晴。
Clear.上午，空六来谈；全谈些报纸上所载的事，真伪莫辨。许多工夫之后，他走了，他所谈的我几乎都忘记了，等于不谈。只记得一件：据说吴佩孚大帅在一处宴会的席上发表，查得赤化的始祖乃是蚩尤，因为“蚩”“赤”同音，所以蚩尤即“赤尤”，“赤尤”者，就是“赤化之尤”的意思；说毕，合座为之“欢然”云。
In the morning, Kong Liu came to talk; All about what was written in the newspaper, the truth is indistinguishable. After a lot of work, he left, and I almost forgot what he said, which is equivalent to not talking about it. I only remember one thing: it is said that Marshal Wu Peifu announced at a banquet that the ancestor of Chihua was Chiyou, because "Chi" and "Chi" are homonymous, so Chiyou is "Chiyou", and "Chiyou" means "Chihua You"; After speaking, the audience was "happy."太阳很烈，几盆小草花的叶子有些垂下来了，浇了一点水。田妈忠告我：浇花的时候是每天必须一定的，不能乱；一乱，就有害。我觉得有理，便踌躇起来；但又想，没有人在一定的时候来浇花，我又没有一定的浇花的时候，如果遵照她的学说，那些小花可只好晒死罢了。即使乱浇，总胜于不浇；即使有害，总胜于晒死罢。便继续浇下去，但心里自然也不大踊跃。下午，叶子都直起来了，似乎不甚有害，这才放了心。
The sun was very strong, and the leaves of a few pots of small grass flowers were a little drooping, so I watered them a little. Tian Ma advised me: Watering flowers must be done every day, not messy; If it is chaotic, it will be harmful. I think it makes sense, so I hesitate; But I also thought that no one would come to water the flowers at a certain time, and I would not have a certain time to water the flowers, if I followed her doctrine, those little flowers would have to be sunburned to death. Even if it is watered indiscriminately, it is always better than not watering at all; Even if it is harmful, it is better than dying. So he continued to pour it, but naturally he was not very enthusiastic. In the afternoon, the leaves straightened up, and it didn't seem to be very harmful, so I was relieved.灯下太热，夜间便在暗中呆坐着，凉风微动，不觉也有些“欢然”。人倘能够“超然象外”，看看报章，倒也是一种清福。我对于报章，向来就不是博览家，然而这半年来，已经很遇见了些铭心绝品。远之，则如段祺瑞执政的《二感篇》，张之江督办的《整顿学风电》，陈源教授的《闲话》；近之，则如丁文江督办（？）的自称“书呆子”演说，胡适之博士的英国庚款答问，牛荣声先生的“开倒车”论（见《现代评论》七十八期），孙传芳督军的与刘海粟先生论美术书。但这些比起赤化源流考来，却又相去不可以道里计。今年春天，张之江督办明明有电报来赞成枪毙赤化嫌疑的学生，而弄到底自己还是逃不出赤化。这很使我莫明其妙；现在既知道蚩尤是赤化的祖师，那疑团可就冰释了。蚩尤曾打炎帝，炎帝也是“赤魁”。炎者，火德也，火色赤；帝不就是首领么？所以三一八惨案，即等于以赤讨赤，无论那一面，都还是逃不脱赤化的名称。
It was too hot under the lamp, so I sat in the dark at night, and the cool breeze moved slightly, and I didn't feel a little "happy". If people can "transcend the outside" and read the newspaper, it is also a kind of happiness. I have never been a reader of newspapers, but in the past six months, I have encountered some unforgettable masterpieces. In the distance, it is like Duan Qirui's "Two Senses", Zhang Zhijiang's "Rectification of Wind Power", and Professor Chen Yuan's "Gossip"; Closely, it is like Ding Wenjiang supervising (?) ) self-proclaimed "nerd" speech, Dr. Hu Shizhi's British Geng Q&A, Mr. Niu Rongsheng's "driving backwards" theory (see "Modern Review" No. 78), and Sun Chuanfang's discussion of art books with Mr. Liu Haisu. But these are not as far apart as the source of red. This spring, Zhang Zhijiang's supervisor clearly had a telegram in favor of shooting the suspected reddening students, but in the end, he still couldn't escape reddening. This is very confusing to me; Now that he knows that Chi You is the ancestor of Chihua, the suspicion can be solved. Chi You once fought the Yan Emperor, and the Yan Emperor was also a "Chi Kui". Flame is the virtue of fire, and the color of fire is red; Isn't the emperor the leader? Therefore, the 318 tragedy is equivalent to fighting red with red, and no matter which side, it still cannot escape the name of red.这样巧妙的考证天地间委实不很多，只记得先前在日本东京时，看见《读卖新闻》上逐日登载着一种大著作，其中有黄帝即亚伯拉罕的考据。大意是日本称油为“阿蒲拉”（Abura），油的颜色大概是黄的，所以“亚伯拉”就是“黄”。至于“帝”，是与“罕”形近，还是与“可汗”音近呢，我现在可记不真确了，总之：阿伯拉罕即油帝，油帝就是黄帝而已。篇名和作者，现在也都忘却，只记得后来还印成一本书，而且还只是上卷。但这考据究竟还过于弯曲，不深究也好。
I only remember that when I was in Tokyo, Japan, I saw a big work published in the Yomiuri Shimbun every day, which included the evidence of the Yellow Emperor, that is, Abraham. The gist is that Japan calls oil "Abura", and the color of the oil is probably yellow, so "Abura" is "yellow". As for the "emperor", whether it is close to "Han" or "Khan", I can't remember it really now, in short: Abraham is the Oil Emperor, and the Oil Emperor is the Yellow Emperor. The title and author of the article are now forgotten, only that it was later printed as a book, and it was only the first volume. But this evidence is still too crooked, so it's okay not to delve into it.

马上支日记

七月二日

马上支日记

July 2晴。
Clear.午后，在前门外买药后，绕到东单牌楼的东亚公司闲看。这虽然不过是带便贩卖一点日本书，可是关于研究中国的就已经很不少。因为或种限制，只买了一本安冈秀夫所作的《从小说看来的支那民族性》就走了，是薄薄的一本书，用大红深黄做装饰的，价一元二角。
In the afternoon, after buying medicine outside the front door, I went around to the East Asia Company in the Dongdan Archway to take a look. Although this is just a small sale of Japanese books, there is already a lot about studying China. Because of some restrictions, I only bought a copy of "Chinese Nationality from the Perspective of Novels" written by Hideo Yasuoka and left, which was a thin book, decorated with bright red and dark yellow, and priced at one yuan and two corners.傍晚坐在灯下，就看看那本书，他所引用的小说有三十四种，但其中也有其实并非小说和分一部为几种的。蚊子来叮了好几口，虽然似乎不过一两个，但是坐不住了，点起蚊烟香来，这才总算渐渐太平下去。
Sitting under the lamp in the evening, I looked at the book, there were thirty-four novels he cited, but some of them were not actually novels and were divided into several parts. The mosquitoes came to bite several times, although it seemed to be only one or two, but they couldn't sit still, lit the mosquito cigarette coils, and finally calmed down.安冈氏虽然很客气，在绪言上说，“这样的也不仅只支那人，便是在日本，怕也有难于漏网的。”但是，“一测那程度的高下和范围的广狭，则即使夸称为支那的民族性，也毫无应该顾忌的处所，”所以从支那人的我看来，的确不免汗流浃背。只要看目录就明白了：一，总说；二，过度置重于体面和仪容；三，安运命而肯罢休；四，能耐能忍；五，乏同情心多残忍性；六，个人主义和事大主义；七，过度的俭省和不正的贪财；八，泥虚礼而尚虚文；九，迷信深；十，耽享乐而淫风炽盛。
Although the Yasuoka clan was very polite, he said in the introduction, "This is not only the Chinese people, but also in Japan, and I am afraid that it will be difficult to escape the net." However, "once you measure the level of the degree and the breadth of the range, even if you exaggerate the national character of China, there is no place to worry about," so from my point of view as a Chinese person, I can't help but sweat. Just look at the table of contents to understand: one, always say; second, excessive emphasis on decency and appearance; third, be willing to give up with fate; fourth, be patient and patient; 5. Lack of compassion and cruelty; 6. Individualism and grandism; 7. Excessive frugality and improper greed for money; Eighth, mud and empty etiquette and empty text; 9. Superstition is deep; Ten, indulging in pleasure and lewdness.他似乎很相信Smith的《Chinese Characteristies》，常常引为典据。这书在他们，二十年前就有译本，叫作《支那人气质》； 但是支那人的我们却不大有人留心它。第一章就是Smith说，以为支那人是颇有点做戏气味的民族，精神略有亢奋，就成了戏子样，一字一句，一举手一投足，都装模装样，出于本心的分量，倒还是撑场面的分量多。这就是因为太重体面了，总想将自己的体面弄得十足，所以敢于做出这样的言语动作来。总而言之，支那人的重要的国民性所成的复合关键，便是这“体面”。
He seems to believe in Smith's Chinese Characteristies, often citing it as a reference. This book was translated by them twenty years ago, called "Chinese Temperament"; But we in China don't pay much attention to it. The first chapter is Smith saying that he thinks that the Chinese people are a people who smell a bit of drama, and their spirit is slightly excited, so they become like actors, word by word, every gesture, all pretend, out of the weight of their own hearts, but they still have a lot of weight to support the scene. This is because it is too decent, and I always want to make my own decency full, so I dare to make such words and actions. All in all, the key to the compound of the important national character of the Chinese people is this "decency".我们试来博观和内省，便可以知道这话并不过于刻毒。相传为戏台上的好对联，是“戏场小天地，天地大戏场”。大家本来看得一切事不过是一出戏，有谁认真的，就是蠢物。但这也并非专由积极的体面，心有不平而怯于报复，也便以万事是戏的思想了之。万事既然是戏，则不平也非真，而不报也非怯了。所以即使路见不平，不能拔刀相助，也还不失其为一个老牌的正人君子。
If we try to look at it and introspect, we can see that this is not too harsh. It is said to be a good couplet on the stage, which is "the small world of the theater, the big theater of heaven and earth". Everyone originally thought that everything was just a play, and anyone who was serious was a fool. But this is not just a positive decency, if you are unfair and afraid of retaliation, you will think that everything is a play. Since everything is a joke, it is not true that it is unfair, and it is not cowardly not to report it. Therefore, even if the road is unfair and cannot draw a sword to help, it is still a veteran and upright gentleman.我所遇见的外国人，不知道可是受了Smith的影响，还是自己实验出来的，就很有几个留心研究着中国人之所谓“体面”或“面子”。但我觉得，他们实在是已经早有心得，而且应用了，倘若更加精深圆熟起来，则不但外交上一定胜利，还要取得上等“支那人”的好感情。这时须连“支那人”三个字也不说，代以“华人”，因为这也是关于“华人”的体面的。
The foreigners I met, I don't know if they were influenced by Smith or experimented with them themselves, but a few of them paid attention to studying the so-called "decency" or "face" of Chinese. But I think they really have experience and apply it, and if they become more profound and mature, they will not only win diplomacy, but also obtain the good feelings of the superior "Chinese people". At this time, the word "Chinese" must not even be said, but replaced with "Chinese", because this is also about the dignity of "Chinese".我还记得民国初年到北京时，邮局门口的扁额是写着“邮政局”的，后来外人不干涉中国内政的叫声高起来，不知道是偶然还是什么，不几天，都一律改了“邮务局”了。外国人管理一点邮“务”，实在和内“政”不相干，这一出戏就一直唱到现在。
I still remember that when I arrived in Beijing in the early years of the Republic of China, the plaque at the door of the post office read "Post Office", and then the cry of outsiders not interfering in China's internal affairs became louder, I don't know if it was accidental or something, and within a few days, they were all changed to "Post Office". These words gave me a great inspiration. I have always been a little separated from this reason, but it was not until July 3rd, the night of the "Ma Factory Oath to Rebuild the Republic", that I realized that "long" is indeed valuable. The "Modern Review" prides itself on "theory and facts", and it can indeed be said and done.今天到我的睡觉时为止，似乎并没有挂国旗，后半夜补挂与否，我不知道。

closed the door, came back, lay down again, and seemed to be enjoying it. A pedestrian walked over singing a play, and the afterglow was lingering, saying, "Bab, bab, bab! This gentleman's study is called the Qiu Yi Zhai, and the content of the articles written in that study can be imagined. He himself said that he really didn't understand why a person was so bored that he wanted to write a novel and read a novel. But the verdict of Yu Gu's novel is lenient, because he is ancient, and the ancients have already written it.憎恶小说的也不只是这位强先生，诸如此类的高论，随在可以闻见。但我们国民的学问，大多数却实在靠着小说，甚至于还靠着从小说编出来的戏文。虽是崇奉关岳的大人先生们，倘问他心目中的这两位“武圣”的仪表，怕总不免是细着眼睛的红脸大汉和五绺长须的白面书生，或者还穿着绣金的缎甲，脊梁上还插着四张尖角旗。

Recently, it is true that the upper and lower levels are united in advocating loyalty and filial piety, and when you go to the temple market to see the New Year's paintings in the New Year, you can see many newly made pictures of this kind of virtue. 马上支日记

July 6th晴。
Clear.午后，到前门外去买药。配好之后，付过钱，就站在柜台前喝了一回份。其理由有三：一，已经停了一天了，应该早喝；二，尝尝味道，是否不错的；三，天气太热，实在有点口渴了。
In the afternoon, go to the front door to buy medicine. After matching, after paying, I stood in front of the counter and drank it. There are three reasons: first, it has been stopped for a day, so you should drink it early; second, taste the taste, whether it is good; Third, the weather is too hot, and I am really a little thirsty.不料有一个买客却看得奇怪起来。我不解这有什么可以奇怪的；然而他竟奇怪起来了，悄悄地向店伙道：
Unexpectedly, a buyer looked strange. I don't understand what's so strange about this; However, he became strange and quietly said to the shopkeeper:“那是戒烟药水罢？”
"That's a quit potion, right?"“不是的！”店伙替我维持名誉。
"No!" The shopkeeper maintains my reputation.“这是戒大烟的罢？”他于是直接地问我了。
"This is to quit smoking?" He then asked me directly.我觉得倘不将这药认作“戒烟药水”，他大概是死不瞑目的。人生几何，何必固执，我便似点非点的将头一动，同时请出我那“介乎两可之间”的好回答来：
I think if he doesn't recognize this medicine as a "quit smoking potion", he will probably die. How much life is geometric, why be stubborn, I moved my head as if I was a little wrong, and at the same time asked for my good answer "between the two":“唔唔……。”
"No, no, ......."这既不伤店伙的好意，又可以聊慰他热烈的期望，该是一帖妙药。果然，从此万籁无声，天下太平，我在安静中塞好瓶塞，走到街上了。
This neither hurts the shopkeeper's kindness, but can also comfort his warm expectations, which should be a wonderful medicine. Sure enough, from then on, everything was silent, the world was peaceful, I plugged the cork in the silence and walked out into the street.到中央公园，径向约定的一个僻静处所，寿山已先到，略一休息，便开手对译《小约翰》。这是一本好书，然而得来却是偶然的事。大约二十年前，我在日本东京的旧书店头买到几十本旧的德文文学杂志，内中有着这书的绍介和作者的评传，因为那时刚译成德文。觉得有趣，便托丸善书店去买来了；想译，没有这力。后来也常常想到，但总为别的事情岔开；直到去年，才决计在暑假中将它译好，并且登出广告去，而不料那一暑假过得比别的时候还艰难。今年又记得起来，翻检一过，疑难之处很不少，还是没有这力。问寿山可肯同译，他答应了，于是开手；并且约定，必须在这暑假期中译完。
When I arrived at Central Park, I walked to a secluded place as agreed, and Shoushan had already arrived first, and after a short rest, I started translating "Little John". This is a good book, but it is accidental. About twenty years ago, I bought dozens of old German literary magazines in a used bookstore in Tokyo, Japan, containing a description of the book and a review of the author, because it had just been translated into German. I thought it was interesting, so I asked Maruzen Bookstore to buy it; I want to translate, but I don't have this power. Later, I often thought about it, but I always diverged for other things; It wasn't until last year that I decided to translate it during the summer vacation and publish the advertisement, but that summer vacation was even more difficult than other times. This year, I remember again, after reviewing it, there are many difficulties, but I still don't have this strength. asked Shoushan if he could translate the same translation, and he agreed, so he started; And it was agreed that the translation must be completed during this summer vacation.晚上回家，吃了一点饭，就坐在院子里乘凉。田妈告诉我，今天下午，斜对门的谁家的婆婆和儿媳大吵了一通嘴。据她看来，婆婆自然有些错，但究竟是儿媳妇太不合道理了。问我的意思，以为何如。我先就没有听清吵嘴的是谁家，也不知道是怎样的两个婆媳，更没有听到她们的来言去语，明白她们的旧恨新仇。现在要我加以裁判，委实有点不敢自信，况且我又向来并不是批评家。我于是只得说：这事我无从断定。
I went home in the evening, ate a little food, and sat in the yard to enjoy the coolness. Tian's mother told me that this afternoon, the mother-in-law and daughter-in-law of the family diagonally opposite the door had a big quarrel. In her opinion, the mother-in-law is naturally a little wrong, but it is the daughter-in-law who is too unreasonable. Ask me what I mean, what do you think? I didn't hear who was arguing, I didn't know what kind of two mothers-in-law and daughters-in-law they were, let alone hear their words and understand their old hatred and new hatred. Now that I am asked to judge, I am a little afraid to be confident, and I have never been a critic. So I had to say: I can't say for sure.但是这句话的结果很坏。在昏暗中，虽然看不见脸色，耳朵中却听到：一切声音都寂然了。静，沉闷的静；后来还有人站起，走开。
But the result of this sentence is very bad. In the darkness, although I couldn't see the face, I heard in my ears: all voices were silent. quiet, dull quiet; Later, some people stood up and walked away.我也无聊地慢慢地站起，走进自己的屋子里，点了灯，躺在床上看晚报；看了几行，又无聊起来了，便碰到东壁下去写日记，就是这《马上支日记》。
I also stood up slowly out of boredom, walked into my room, lit the light, and lay on the bed to read the evening newspaper; After reading a few lines, I got bored again, so I ran into the east wall to write a diary, which is this "Diary of the Right Branch".院子里又渐渐地有了谈笑声，谠论声。
There was gradually laughter and chatter in the yard.今天的运气似乎很不佳：路人冤我喝“戒烟药水”，田妈说我……。她怎么说，我不知道。但愿从明天起，不再这样。
Today's luck seems to be very bad: passers-by wrongfully accused me of drinking "smoking cessation potions", and Tian's mother said that I ....... What she said, I don't know. I hope that from tomorrow onwards, this will not be the case again.

The second diary of the horse七月七日
July 7th晴。
Clear.每日的阴晴，实在写得自己也有些不耐烦了，从此想不写。好在北京的天气，大概总是晴的时候多；如果是梅雨期内，那就上午晴，午后阴，下午大雨一阵，听到泥墙倒塌声。不写也罢，又好在我这日记，将来决不会有气象学家拿去做参考资料的。
The daily clouds and sunny days really made me a little impatient to write, and I didn't want to write from now on. Fortunately, the weather in Beijing is probably always sunny; If it is during the rainy season, it will be sunny in the morning, cloudy in the afternoon, and heavy rain in the afternoon, and the sound of the mud wall collapsing will be heard. It's okay if I don't write it, but fortunately, my diary will never be used as a reference by meteorologists in the future.上午访素园，谈谈闲天，他说俄国有名的文学者毕力涅克（Boris Piliniak）上月已经到过北京，现在是走了。

In the past two years, as far as I have heard, four famous writers have come to China. The first one is naturally the most famous Tagore, that is, "Zhu Zhendan", but unfortunately he was made a mess by the Aurora wearing an Indian hat, and finally left inexplicably; Later, he fell ill in Italy and called Aurora "Shi Zhe" to go, but he didn't know "what the aftermath would be". Now I hear that someone is going to carry Gandhi to China, this great man who can only be born in India, and the great man who can live in India under British rule, will print his great footprints in Aurora. followed by Blasco Ibáez of Spain, which has long been introduced in China; But when he was in Europe, he sang about human love and cosmopolitanism, and judging from the bill of the National Education Federation this year, he was really not suitable for China, and of course no one paid attention to him, because our educators were going to advocate nationalism.还有两个都是俄国人。一个是斯吉泰烈支（Skitalez），一个就是毕力涅克。两个都是假名字。斯吉泰烈支是流亡在外的。毕力涅克却是苏联的作家，但据他自传，从革命的第一年起，就为着买面包粉忙了一年多。以后，便做小说，还吸过鱼油，这种生活，在中国大概便是整日叫穷的文学家也未必梦想到。
Two more are Russians. One is Skitalez, and the other is Bilinek. Both are pseudonyms. Skiterizhi is in exile. Bilinek was a Soviet writer, but according to his autobiography, from the first year of the revolution, he was busy buying bread flour for more than a year. In the future, he wrote novels and smoked fish oil, a life that even writers who are poor all day long may not dream of in China.他的名字，任国桢君辑译的《苏俄的文艺论战》里是出现过的，作品的译本却一点也没有。日本有一本《伊凡和马理》（《Ivan and Maria》），格式很特别，单是这一点，在中国的眼睛——中庸的眼睛——里就看不惯。文法有些欧化，有些人尚且如同眼睛里著了玻璃粉，何况体式更奇于欧化。悄悄地自来自去，实在要算是造化的。
His name appeared in the "Literary and Art Debate in Soviet Russia" compiled and translated by Ren Guozhenjun, but there was no translation of the work at all. There is a book in Japan called "Ivan and Maria", which has a very special format, which alone is not used to the Chinese eye, the average eye. The grammar is a bit Europeanized, and some people still feel like they have glass powder in their eyes, not to mention that the asana is even more Europeanized. Quietly going freely, it is really a matter of fate.还有，在中国，姓名仅仅一见于《苏俄的文艺论战》里的里培进司基（U.Libedinsky），日本却也有他的小说译出了，名曰《一周间》。他们的介绍之速而且多实在可骇。我们的武人以他们的武人为祖师，我们的文人却毫不学他们文人的榜样，这就可预卜中国将来一定比日本太平。
Also, in China, the name is only seen in "The Literary Debate of Soviet Russia" (U. Libedinsky), but in Japan there is also a translation of his novel called "Between the Week". The speed and number of their introductions are really shocking. Our warriors take their warriors as their ancestors, but our literati do not follow the example of their literati, which predicts that China will be more peaceful than Japan in the future.但据《伊凡和马理》的译者尾濑敬止氏说，则作者的意思，是以为“频果的花，在旧院落中也开放，大地存在间，总是开放”的。那么，他还是不免于念旧。然而他眼见，身历了革命了，知道这里面有破坏，有流血，有矛盾，但也并非无创造，所以他决没有绝望之心。这正是革命时代的活着的人的心。诗人勃洛克（Alexander Block）也如此。他们自然是苏联的诗人，但若用了纯马克斯流的眼光来批评，当然也还是很有可议的处所。不过我觉得托罗兹基（Trotsky）的文艺批评，倒还不至于如此森严。
However, according to Keizhi Oze, the translator of "Ivan and Mari", the author's meaning is that "the flowers of the frequent fruits are also open in the old courtyard, and the earth is always open in the existence of the earth". Then, he still can't help but be nostalgic. However, he saw that he had experienced the revolution and knew that there was destruction, bloodshed, and contradictions, but it was not without creation, so he had no despair. This is the heart of the living in the revolutionary era. The same goes for the poet Alexander Block. They are naturally Soviet poets, but if they are criticized from a pure Maxian perspective, of course, there is still a lot to discuss. However, I think Trotsky's literary criticism is not so strict.可惜我还没有看过他们最新的作者的作品《一周间》。
It's a pity that I haven't seen their latest author's work, "Between the Week".革命时代总要有许多文艺家萎黄，有许多文艺家向新的山崩地塌般的大波冲进去，乃仍被吞没，或者受伤。被吞没的消灭了；受伤的生活着，开拓着自己的生活，唱着苦痛和愉悦之歌。待到这些逝去了，于是现出一个较新的新时代，产出更新的文艺来。
In the revolutionary era, there will always be many writers and artists wilting, and many writers and artists will rush into the new landslide-like waves, but they will still be swallowed up or injured. The engulfed are destroyed; Living a wounded life, carving out his own life, singing songs of pain and joy. When these are gone, a relatively new era emerges, and newer literature and art are produced.中国自民元革命以来，所谓文艺家，没有萎黄的，也没有受伤的，自然更没有消灭，也没有苦痛和愉悦之歌。这就是因为没有新的山崩地塌般的大波，也就是因为没有革命。
Since the Minyuan Revolution in China, the so-called writers and artists have not been wilted, nor have they been injured, and naturally they have not been eliminated, nor have they sung songs of pain and joy. This is because there are no new landslides, that is, because there is no revolution.

In the afternoon, Mies Gao came, and there was no snack, so he had to put the treasured persimmon frost candy on a plate and take it out. I often have snacks, and when guests come, I invite them to have snacks; At first, "Mies" and "Miesde" were treated equally, but Mies De sometimes honestly ate the pros and cons, and often ate very thoroughly, leaving no one behind, but I myself had a sense of "corner". If you want to eat it, you have to go out and buy it. So I was very wary and had to change my policy, and when it was a last resort, I would replace it with peanuts. Since the invention of this peanut policy last summer, it has continued to be enforced. But the Mies were not like that, their stomachs seemed to be four-fifths smaller than theirs, or their digestion was as weak as eight-tenths, and a very small snack was probably left in half, and if it was a piece of sugar, there was only a corner left. Remember the conversation鲁迅先生快到厦门去了，虽然他自己说或者因天气之故而不能在那里久住，但至少总有半年或一年不在北京，这实在是我们认为很使人留恋的一件事。八月二十二日，女子师范大学学生会举行毁校周年纪念，鲁迅先生到会，曾有一番演说，我恐怕这是他此次在京最后的一回公开讲演，因此把它记下来，表示我一点微弱的纪念的意思。人们一提到鲁迅先生，或者不免觉得他稍微有一点过于冷静，过于默视的样子，而其实他是无时不充满着热烈的希望，发挥着丰富的感情的。在这一次谈话里，尤其可以显明地看出他的主张；那么，我把他这一次的谈话记下，作为他出京的纪念，也许不是完全没有重大的意义罢。我自己，为免得老实人费心起见，应该声明一下：那天的会，我是以一个小小的办事员的资格参加的。
Mr. Lu Xun is about to go to Xiamen, and although he himself said that he could not stay there for a long time or because of the weather, he was always absent from Beijing for at least half a year or a year, which is really a nostalgic thing that we think is very nostalgic. On August 22, the Student Union of Women's Normal University held the anniversary of the destruction of the school, and Mr. Lu Xun attended the meeting and gave a speech, which I am afraid was his last public speech in Beijing, so I wrote it down to express my faint sense of commemoration. When people mention Mr. Lu Xun, they may feel that he is a little too calm and too silent, but in fact, he is always full of warm hope and rich feelings. In this conversation, his proposition can be especially clearly seen; So, I will write down his conversation this time as a commemoration of his departure from Beijing, which may not be completely of great significance. Myself, in order not to bother honest people, should declare: I participated in that day's meeting as a small clerk.（培良）
(Peiliang)我昨晚上在校《工人绥惠略夫》，想要另印一回，睡得太迟了，到现在还没有很醒；正在校的时候，忽然想到一些事情，弄得脑子里很混乱，一直到现在还是很混乱，所以今天恐怕不能有什么多的话可说。
I was in school last night in "Workers Sui Hui Luofu", and I wanted to print it again, but I slept too late and still haven't woken up very much; When I was in school, I suddenly thought of something that made my mind very confused, and it is still very confusing until now, so I am afraid I can't say much today.提到我翻译《工人绥惠略夫》的历史，倒有点有趣。十二年前，欧洲大混战开始了，后来我们中国也参加战事，就是所谓“对德宣战”；派了许多工人到欧洲去帮忙；以后就打胜了，就是所谓“公理战胜”。中国自然也要分得战利品，——有一种是在上海的德国商人的俱乐部里的德文书，总数很不少，文学居多，都搬来放在午门的门楼上。教育部得到这些书，便要整理一下，分类一下，——其实是他们本来分类好了的，然而有些人以为分得不好，所以要从新分一下。——当时派了许多人，我也是其中的一个。后来，总长要看看那些书是什么书了。怎样看法呢？叫我们用中文将书名译出来，有义译义，无义译音，该撒呀，克来阿派忒拉呀，大马色呀……。每人每月有十块钱的车费，我也拿了百来块钱，因为那时还有一点所谓行政费。这样的几里古鲁了一年多，花了几千块钱，对德和约成立了，后来德国来取还，便仍由点收的我们全盘交付，——也许少了几本罢。至于“克来阿派忒拉”之类，总长看了没有，我可不得而知了。
It is a bit interesting to mention the history of my translation of "Workers Suihuiliov". Twelve years ago, the great melee in Europe began, and later we in China also participated in the war, which is the so-called "declaration of war on Germany"; sent many workers to Europe to help; In the future, it will be won, which is the so-called "axiom victory". China naturally wants to share the spoils,—— there is a German book in the club of German merchants in Shanghai, the total number is a lot, most of which are literature, all of which are moved to the gatehouse of the noon gate. When the Ministry of Education gets these books, they have to sort them out and classify them,—— in fact, they have already classified them, but some people think that they are not well divided, so they have to divide them anew. ——Many people were sent at that time, and I was one of them. Later, the chief wanted to see what kind of books those books were. What do you think? Let us translate the title of the book with Chinese, with meaning and without meaning, Caesar, Cleaethera, Damascus, ....... Each person had a fare of ten yuan a month, and I also took a hundred yuan, because there was also a little so-called administrative fee at that time. Such a few miles of guru for more than a year, spent thousands of dollars, and the peace treaty with Germany was established, and then Germany came to take it back, and we still delivered it in full,—— maybe a few copies were missing. As for "Creepella" and the like, I don't know if the chief has seen it.据我所知道的说，“对德宣战”的结果，在中国有一座中央公园里的“公理战胜”的牌坊，在我就只有一篇这《工人绥惠略夫》的译本，因为那底本，就是从那时整理着的德文书里挑出来的。
As far as I know, as a result of the "declaration of war on Germany", there is an archway of "axiom victory" in the Central Park in China, and I only have a translation of "Workers' Sui Huiliov", because that original copy was selected from the German books compiled at that time.那一堆书里文学书多得很，为什么那时偏要挑中这一篇呢？那意思，我现在有点记不真切了。大概，觉得民国以前，以后，我们也有许多改革者，境遇和绥惠略夫很相像，所以借借他人的酒杯罢。然而昨晚上一看，岂但那时，譬如其中的改革者的被迫，代表的吃苦，便是现在，——便是将来，便是几十年以后，我想，还要有许多改革者的境遇和他相像的。所以我打算将它重印一下……。
There are a lot of literary books in that pile of books, why did you choose this one at that time? I don't really remember that now. Probably, I feel that before and after the Republic of China, we also had many reformers, and the situation was very similar to that of Sui Huiliufu, so we borrowed other people's wine glasses. However, last night, I saw that not only at that time, for example, the forced reformers among them, the hardships they represented were now,—— in the future, and decades later, I think there would be many reformers in a situation similar to his. So I'm going to reprint it .......《工人绥惠略夫》的作者阿尔志跋绥夫是俄国人。现在一提到俄国，似乎就使人心惊胆战。但是，这是大可以不必的，阿尔志跋绥夫并非共产党，他的作品现在在苏俄也并不受人欢迎。听说他已经瞎了眼睛，很在吃苦，那当然更不会送我一个卢布……。总而言之：和苏俄是毫不相干。但奇怪的是有许多事情竟和中国很相像，譬如，改革者，代表者的受苦，不消说了；便是教人要安本分的老婆子，也正如我们的文人学士一般。有一个教员因为不受上司的辱骂而被革职了，她背地里责备他，说他“高傲”得可恶，“你看，我以前被我的主人打过两个嘴巴，可是我一句话都不说，忍耐着。究竟后来他们知道我冤枉了，就亲手赏了我一百卢布。”自然，我们的文人学士措辞决不至于如此拙直，文字也还要华赡得多。
The author of "Worker Suihuiliov" is Russian. Now when Russia is mentioned, it seems to be terrifying. However, this is unnecessary, Alzhiv is not a communist, and his works are not popular in Soviet Russia now. I heard that he was blind and was suffering, so of course he would not give me a ruble ....... All in all: it has nothing to do with Soviet Russia. But strangely, there are many things that are very similar to China, such as the suffering of reformers and representatives, needless to say; It is the old woman who teaches people to do their duty, just like our literati and scholars. A teacher was dismissed because she was not insulted by her superiors, and she reproached him behind her back, saying that he was "arrogant" and hateful, "You see, I was beaten in the mouth twice by my master before, but I didn't say a word, I endured." Later, when they knew that I had been wronged, they rewarded me with one hundred rubles with their own hands. "Naturally, our literati and scholars will never be so clumsy and straightforward, and the words will be much more gorgeous.然而绥惠略夫临末的思想却太可怕。他先是为社会做事，社会倒迫害他，甚至于要杀害他，他于是一变而为向社会复仇了，一切是仇仇，一切都破坏。中国这样破坏一切的人还不见有，大约也不会有的，我也并不希望其有。但中国向来有别一种破坏的人，所以我们不去破坏的，便常常受破坏。我们一面被破坏，一面修缮着，辛辛苦苦地再过下去。所以我们的生活，便成了一面受破坏，一面修补，一面受破坏，一面修补的生活了。这个学校，也就是受了杨荫榆章士钊们的破坏之后，修补修补，整理整理，再过下去的。
However, Sui Huiliufu's final thoughts were too terrifying. He first did things for society, but society persecuted him, and even wanted to kill him, so he turned into revenge on society, everything was hatred, everything was destroyed. There are no people like China who destroy everything, and there probably won't be, and I don't want them to have them. But China has always had another kind of saboteur, so if we don't destroy, we will often be destroyed. We were destroyed, repaired, and worked hard to get on again. Therefore, our life has become a life of being destroyed, repaired, destroyed, and repaired. This school, that is, after being destroyed by Yang Yinyu and Zhang Shizhao, was repaired, sorted out, and then lived.俄国老婆子式的文人学士也许说，这是“高傲”得可恶了，该得惩罚。这话自然很像不错的，但也不尽然。我的家里还住着一个乡下人，因为战事，她的家没有了，只好逃进城里来。她实在并不“高傲”，也没有反对过杨荫榆，然而她的家没有了，受了破坏。战事一完，她一定要回去的，即使屋子破了，器具抛了，田地荒了，她也还要活下去。她大概只好搜集一点剩下的东西，修补修补，整理整理，再来活下去。
The Russian wife-like literati may say that this is "arrogant" and deserves punishment. This is naturally a good thing, but it is not necessarily. There was still a countryman living in my house, and because of the war, her home was gone, so she had to flee into the city. She was really not "arrogant", nor did she oppose Yang Yinyu, but her home was gone and destroyed. As soon as the war is over, she must go back, even if the house is broken, the equipment is thrown away, and the fields are barren, she still has to live. She probably had to collect some of the leftovers, tinker with them, sort them out, and then come back to live.中国的文明，就是这样破坏了又修补，破坏了又修补的疲乏伤残可怜的东西。但是很有人夸耀它，甚至于连破坏者也夸耀它。便是破坏本校的人，假如你派他到万国妇女的什么会里去，请他叙述中国女学的情形，他一定说，我们中国有一个国立北京女子师范大学在。
This is how Chinese civilization has destroyed and repaired, destroyed and repaired tired, disabled and pitiful things. But there are many people who boast about it, even vandals. If you send him to a meeting of women from all over the world and ask him to describe the situation of Chinese women's schools, he will definitely say that we have a National Beijing Women's Normal University in China.这真是万分可惜的事，我们中国人对于不是自己的东西，或者将不为自己所有的东西，总要破坏了才快活的。杨荫榆知道要做不成这校长，便文事用文士的“流言”，武功用三河的老妈，总非将一班“毛鸦头”赶尽杀绝不可。先前我看见记载上说的张献忠屠戮川民的事，我总想不通他是什么意思；后来看到别一本书，这才明白了：他原是想做皇帝的，但是李自成先进北京，做了皇帝了，他便要破坏李自成的帝位。怎样破坏法呢？做皇帝必须有百姓；他杀尽了百姓，皇帝也就谁都做不成了。既无百姓，便无所谓皇帝，于是只剩了一个李自成，在白地上出丑，宛如学校解散后的校长一般。这虽然是一个可笑的极端的例，但有这一类的思想的，实在并不止张献忠一个人。
This is really a pity, we Chinese always have to destroy things that are not our own, or things that will not be owned by ourselves, to be happy. Yang Yinyu knew that he would not be able to be the principal, so he used the "rumors" of scribes in civil affairs and the mother of Sanhe in martial arts, and he had to drive out a group of "crows". I saw the record about Zhang Xianzhong's massacre of the Sichuan people, and I couldn't figure out what he meant; Later, when I saw another book, I understood: he originally wanted to be emperor, but Li Zicheng advanced to Beijing and became emperor, and he wanted to destroy Li Zicheng's throne. How to destroy the law? To be an emperor, you must have the people; He killed all the people, and the emperor couldn't do anyone. Since there are no people, there is no emperor, so there is only one Li Zicheng left, making a fool of himself on the white ground, like the principal after the school was disbanded. Although this is a ridiculous extreme example, Zhang Xianzhong is not the only one with this kind of thinking.我们总是中国人，我们总要遇见中国事，但我们不是中国式的破坏者，所以我们是过着受破坏了又修补，受破坏了又修补的生活。我们的许多寿命白费了。我们所可以自慰的，想来想去，也还是所谓对于将来的希望。希望是附丽于存在的，有存在，便有希望，有希望，便是光明。如果历史家的话不是诳话，则世界上的事物可还没有因为黑暗而长存的先例。黑暗只能附丽于渐就灭亡的事物，一灭亡，黑暗也就一同灭亡了，它不永久。然而将来是永远要有的，并且总要光明起来；只要不做黑暗的附着物，为光明而灭亡，则我们一定有悠久的将来，而且一定是光明的将来。
We are always Chinese, we always have to meet Chinese things, but we are not Chinese-style destroyers, so we live a life of being destroyed and repaired, destroyed and repaired. Many of our lives are in vain. What we can masturbate, thinking about it, is still the so-called hope for the future. Hope is attached to existence, there is hope, and hope is light. If the historian's words are not lies, there is no precedent for things in the world to last forever because of darkness. Darkness can only be attached to things that are gradually dying, and when they die, darkness will also perish, and it will not be permanent. However, the future will always be there, and it will always be bright; As long as we do not become attachments to darkness and perish for the light, we must have a long future, and it must be a bright future.我赴这会的后四日，就出北京了。在上海看见日报，知道女师大已改为女子学院的师范部，教育总长任可澄自做院长，师范部的学长是林素园。后来看见北京九月五日的晚报，有一条道：“今日下午一时半，任可澄特同林氏，并率有警察厅保安队及军督察处兵士共四十左右，驰赴女师大，武装接收。……”原来刚一周年，又看见用兵了。不知明年这日，还是带兵的开得校纪念呢，还是被兵的开毁校纪念？现在姑且将培良君的这一篇转录在这里，先作一个本年的纪念罢。
Four days after I went to this meeting, I left Beijing. I saw the daily in Shanghai and knew that the Women's Normal University had been changed to the normal department of the women's college, and the chief of education Ren Kecheng was the dean, and the senior of the normal department was Lin Suyuan. Later, I saw the evening news of Beijing on September 5, and there was a saying: "At half past one o'clock this afternoon, Ren Kecheng and Lin, along with about 40 soldiers from the National Police Department Security Team and the Military Inspection Department, rushed to the Women's Normal University to receive armed reception." ...... "It turns out that it has just been the first anniversary, and I have seen the use of troops again." I don't know if on this day next year, it will be a commemoration of the opening of the school by the soldiers, or a commemoration of the opening of the school by the soldiers? Now let's transcribe this article of Pei Liangjun here, and make a commemoration of this year.一九二六年十月十四日，鲁迅附记。

Shanghai Communications小峰兄：
Brother Xiaofeng:别后之次日，我便上车，当晚到天津。途中什么事也没有，不过刚出天津车站，却有一个穿制服的，大概是税吏之流罢，突然将我的提篮拉住，问道“什么？”我刚答说“零用什物”时，他已经将篮摇了两摇，扬长而去了。幸而我的篮里并无人参汤榨菜汤或玻璃器皿，所以毫无损失，请勿念。
The day after parting, I got on the bus and arrived in Tianjin that night. There was nothing on the way, but as soon as I left Tianjin Station, there was a man in uniform, probably a tax collector, who suddenly pulled my basket and asked, "What?" As soon as I replied "pocket items", he had already shaken the basket twice and walked away. Fortunately, there is no ginseng soup, mustard soup, or glassware in my basket, so there is no loss, so please don't read it.从天津向浦口，我坐的是特别快车，所以并不嚣杂，但挤是挤的。我从七年前护送家眷到北京以后，便没有坐过这车；现在似乎男女分坐了，间壁的一室中本是一男三女的一家，这回却将男的逐出，另外请进一个女的去。将近浦口，又发生一点小风潮，因为那四口的一家给茶房的茶资太少了，一个长壮伟大的茶房便到我们这里来演说，“使之闻之”。其略曰：钱是自然要的。一个人不为钱为什么？然而自己只做茶房图几文茶资，是因为良心还在中间，没有到这边（指腋下介）去！自己也还能卖掉田地去买枪，招集了土匪，做个头目；好好地一玩，就可以升官，发财了。然而良心还在这里（指胸骨介），所以甘心做茶房，赚点小钱，给儿女念念书，将来好好过活。……但，如果太给自己下不去了，什么不是人做的事要做也会做出来！我们一堆共有六个人，谁也没有反驳他。听说后来是添了一块钱完事。
From Tianjin to Pukou, I took a very fast train, so it was not noisy, but it was crowded. I haven't ridden this car since I escorted my family to Beijing seven years ago; Now it seems that the men and women are sitting separately, and the room on the wall was originally a family of one man and three women, but this time the man was expelled and another woman was invited. Near Pukou, there was another small trend, because the family of four gave too little tea to the tea room, and a long and great tea house came to us to give a speech, "so that it can be heard". The general idea is: money is naturally needed. Why is a person not for money? However, I only make tea room pictures and tea fees, because my conscience is still in the middle, and I didn't go here (referring to the armpit)! he can also sell his fields to buy guns, recruit bandits, and be a leader; If you play well, you can get promoted and get rich. However, the conscience is still here (referring to the sternum), so I am willing to make a tea room, earn some money, read to my children, and live a good life in the future. …… However, if you can't do it too much for yourself, you will do what you don't do! There were six of us in a bunch of people, and no one refuted him. I heard that it was done with a dollar later.我并不想步勇敢的文人学士们的后尘，在北京出版的周刊上斥骂孙传芳大帅。不过一到下关，记起这是投壶的礼义之邦的事来，总不免有些滑稽之感。在我的眼睛里，下关也还是七年前的下关，无非那时是大风雨，这回却是晴天。赶不上特别快车了，只好趁夜车，便在客寓里暂息。挑夫（即本地之所谓“夫子”）和茶房还是照旧地老实；板鸭，插烧，油鸡等类，也依然价廉物美。喝了二两高粱酒，也比北京的好。这当然只是“我以为”；但也并非毫无理由：就因为它有一点生的高粱气味，喝后合上眼，就如身在雨后的田野里一般。
I don't want to follow in the footsteps of brave literati and scholars and scold Sun Chuanfang in a weekly magazine published in Beijing. However, when I arrived at Xiaguan, I remembered that this was a country of propriety and righteousness for throwing pots, and I couldn't help but feel a little funny. In my eyes, Xiaguan was still seven years ago, it was nothing more than a stormy day, but this time it was a sunny day. I couldn't catch up with the particularly fast train, so I had to take advantage of the night train and take a break in the guesthouse. The porters (i.e., the local so-called "masters") and the tea room are still as honest as ever; Plate duck, roast, oil chicken and other types are still cheap and good. I drank two taels of sorghum wine, which was also better than Beijing's. It's of course just "I thought"; But not without reason: just because it has a little smell of raw sorghum, after drinking it, you close your eyes, just like in a field after the rain.正在田野里的时候，茶房来说有人要我出去说话了。出去看时，是几个人和三四个兵背着枪，究竟几个，我没有细数；总之是一大群。其中的一个说要看我的行李。问他先看那一个呢？他指定了一个麻布套的皮箱。给他解了绳，开了锁，揭开盖，他才蹲下去在衣服中间摸索。摸索了一会，似乎便灰心了，站起来将手一摆，一群兵便都“向后转”，往外走出去了。那指挥的临走时还对我点点头，非常客气。我和现任的“有枪阶级”接洽，民国以来这是第一回。我觉得他们倒并不坏；假使他们也如自称“无枪阶级”的善造“流言”，我就要连路也不能走。
When I was in the field, someone in the tea room said that someone wanted me to go out and talk. When I went out to see, there were a few people and three or four soldiers carrying guns, and I didn't count how many they were; In short, a large group. One of them said to look at my luggage. Ask him which one to look at first? He specified a leather case with a burlap cover. Untied the rope, unlocked it, and lifted the lid, before he squatted down and groped in the middle of his clothes. After groping for a while, he seemed to be discouraged, stood up and waved his hand, and a group of soldiers all "turned back" and walked out. The conductor nodded to me before leaving, very politely. I contacted the current "gun class", and this was the first time since the Republic of China. I don't think they're bad; If they are like the "rumors" that call themselves the "gunless class", I will not even be able to walk.向上海的夜车是十一点钟开的，客很少，大可以躺下睡觉，可惜椅子太短，身子必须弯起来。这车里的茶是好极了，装在玻璃杯里，色香味都好，也许因为我喝了多年井水茶，所以容易大惊小怪了罢，然而大概确是很好的。因此一共喝了两杯，看看窗外的夜的江南，几乎没有睡觉。
The night train to Shanghai departed at eleven o'clock, and there were few passengers, so you could lie down and sleep, but unfortunately the chair was too short and you had to bend over. The tea in this car is excellent, served in a glass, the color and fragrance are good, maybe because I have been drinking well water tea for many years, so it is easy to make a fuss, but it is probably very good. So I drank a total of two cups, looked at Jiangnan at night outside the window, and hardly slept.在这车上，才遇见满口英语的学生，才听到“无线电”“海底电”这类话。也在这车上，才看见弱不胜衣的少爷，绸衫尖头鞋，口嗑南瓜子，手里是一张《消闲录》之类的小报，而且永远看不完。这一类人似乎江浙特别多，恐怕投壶的日子正长久哩。
On this bus, I met students who were full of English, and only then did I hear words like "radio" and "undersea electricity". It was also in this car that I saw the weak young master, wearing a silk shirt and pointed shoes, eating pumpkin seeds, and holding a tabloid such as "Leisure Record" in his hand, and he could never finish reading it. This type of people seems to be very large in Jiangsu and Zhejiang, and I am afraid that the days of throwing pots are long.现在是住在上海的客寓里了；急于想走。走了几天，走得高兴起来了，很想总是走来走去。先前听说欧洲有一种民族，叫作“吉柏希”的，乐于迁徙，不肯安居，私心窃以为他们脾气太古怪，现在才知道他们自有他们的道理，倒是我胡涂。
Now I live in a guest house in Shanghai; Eager to leave. After walking for a few days, I was happy to walk and wanted to always walk around. I had heard that there was a people in Europe called "Gibbershi", who were willing to migrate and refused to settle down, and privately thought that their temper was too strange.这里在下雨，不算很热了。
It's raining here, not very hot.鲁迅。八月三十日，上海。

Brother H.M.我到此快要一个月了，懒在一所三层楼上，对于各处都不大写信。这楼就在海边，日夜被海风呼呼地吹着。海滨很有些贝壳，检了几回，也没有什么特别的。四围的人家不多，我所知道的最近的店铺，只有一家，卖点罐头食物和糕饼，掌柜的是一个女人，看年纪大概可以比我长一辈。
I've been here for almost a month, lazy on a three-story building, and don't write much about everywhere. This building is right by the sea, blowing by the sea breeze day and night. There are some shells on the beach, and after checking them a few times, there is nothing special. There are not many people around, and there is only one nearest store I know, selling canned food and pastries, and the shopkeeper is a woman, who is probably a generation older than me.风景一看倒不坏，有山有水。我初到时，一个同事便告诉我：山光海气，是春秋早暮都不同。还指给我石头看：这块像老虎，那块像癞虾蟆，那一块又像什么什么……。我忘记了，其实也不大相像。我对于自然美，自恨并无敏感，所以即使恭逢良辰美景，也不甚感动。但好几天，却忘不掉郑成功的遗迹。离我的住所不远就有一道城墙，据说便是他筑的。一想到除了台湾，这厦门乃是满人入关以后我们中国的最后亡的地方，委实觉得可悲可喜。台湾是直到一六八三年，即所谓“圣祖仁皇帝”二十二年才亡的，这一年，那“仁皇帝”们便修补“十三经”和“二十一史”的刻板。现在呢，有些国民巴不得读经；殿板“二十一史”也变成了宝贝，古董藏书家不惜重资，购藏于家，以贻子孙云。然而郑成功的城却很寂寞，听说城脚的沙，还被人盗运去卖给对面鼓浪屿的谁，快要危及城基了。有一天我清早望见许多小船，吃水很重，都张着帆驶向鼓浪屿去，大约便是那卖沙的同胞。
The scenery is not bad at first glance, there are mountains and waters. When I first arrived, a colleague told me: The mountains and seas are different in spring and autumn. He also pointed to the stone: this one looks like a tiger, that one looks like a toad, and that one looks like something...... I forgot, it's not much like it. I am not sensitive to natural beauty and self-hatred, so even if I encounter the beautiful scenery, I am not very moved. But for several days, I couldn't forget Zheng Chenggong's relics. Not far from my dwelling there is a wall that is said to have been built by him. When I think that in addition to Taiwan, this Xiamen is the last place where our China died after the Manchus entered the customs, I really feel sad and gratifying. Taiwan did not die until 1683, the twenty-second year of the so-called "Holy Ancestor Ren Emperor", and in this year, the "Ren Emperors" repaired the stereotypes of the "Thirteen Classics" and "Twenty-One Histories". Now, some people are eager to read the Bible; The "Twenty-One History" of the hall board has also become a treasure, and antique bibliophiles have spared no expense to buy it at home to leave it to their descendants. However, Zheng Chenggong's city was very lonely, and he heard that the sand at the foot of the city was also stolen and sold to someone on Gulangyu Island opposite, which was about to endanger the foundation of the city. One morning I saw many small boats, with a heavy draft, all sailing towards Gulangyu with their sails open, probably the compatriots who sold sand.周围很静；近处买不到一种北京或上海的新的出版物，所以有时也觉得枯寂一些，但也看不见灰烟瘴气的《现代评论》。这不知是怎的，有那么许多正人君子，文人学者执笔，竟还不大风行。
The surroundings are very quiet; I can't buy a new publication in Beijing or Shanghai nearby, so sometimes I feel a little bored, but I can't see the gray miasma of the "Modern Review". I don't know why, there are so many upright gentlemen, literati and scholars, but it is not very popular.这几天我想编我今年的杂感了。自从我写了这些东西，尤其是关于陈源的东西以后，就很有几个自称“中立”的君子给我忠告，说你再写下去，就要无聊了。我却并非因为忠告，只因环境的变迁，近来竟没有什么杂感，连结集旧作的事也忘却了。前几天的夜里，忽然听到梅兰芳“艺员”的歌声，自然是留在留声机里的，像粗糙而钝的针尖一般，刺得我耳膜很不舒服。于是我就想到我的杂感，大约也刺得佩服梅“艺员”的正人君子们不大舒服罢，所以要我不再做。然而我的杂感是印在纸上的，不会振动空气，不愿见，不翻他开来就完了，何必冒充了中立来哄骗我。我愿意我的东西躺在小摊上，被愿看的买去，却不愿意受正人君子赏识。世上爱牡丹的或者是最多，但也有喜欢曼陀罗花或无名小草的，朋其还将霸王鞭种在茶壶里当盆景哩。不过看看旧稿，很有些太不清楚了，你可以给我抄一点么？
These days, I want to make up my miscellaneous feelings for this year. Since I wrote these things, especially about Chen Yuan, there have been a few gentlemen who call themselves "neutral" to give me advice, saying that if you continue to write, it will be boring. I didn't feel any distractions recently, not because of advice, but because of the changes in the environment, and I forgot about the collection of old works. A few days ago, I suddenly heard Mei Lanfang's "artist" singing, which naturally remained in the gramophone, like a rough and blunt needle tip, which stabbed my eardrums very uncomfortable. So I thought of my miscellaneous feelings, and probably made the upright gentlemen who admired Mei's "artists" uncomfortable, so I asked them not to do it anymore. However, my miscellaneous feelings are printed on paper, they don't vibrate the air, I don't want to see them, and it's over if I don't turn them over, so why pretend to be neutral to coax me. I want my things to lie on the stall and be bought by those who want to see them, but I don't want to be appreciated by upright gentlemen. There are some people in the world who love peonies the most, but there are also those who like datura flowers or nameless grasses, and Pengqi also planted the overlord whip in the teapot as a bonsai. But looking at the old draft, it is very unclear, can you copy a little for me?此时又在发风，几乎日日这样，好像北京，可是其中很少灰土。我有时也偶然去散步，在丛葬中，这是Borel讲厦门的书上早就说过的：中国全国就是一个大墓场。墓碑文很多不通：有写先妣某而没有儿子的姓名的；有头上横写着地名的；还有刻着“敬惜字纸”四字的，不知道叫谁敬惜字纸。
At this time, the wind is blowing again, almost every day, like Beijing, but there is very little gray soil in it. I sometimes go for a walk in the mass burial, which is what Borel said in his book about Xiamen: the whole of China is a big cemetery. There are many incomprehensible tombstone texts: some write the name of the ancestor without the son; some have place names written horizontally on their heads; There are also those engraved with the words "Respect the Word Paper", I don't know who to call the Cherish Word Paper.这些不通，就因为读了书之故。假如问一个不识字的人，坟里的人是谁，他道父亲；再问他什么名字，他说张二；再问他自己叫什么，他说张三。照直写下来，那就清清楚楚了。而写碑的人偏要舞文弄墨，所以反而越舞越胡涂，他不知道研究“金石例”的，从元朝到清朝就终于没有了局。
These things don't work because of reading books. If you ask an illiterate person who is in the grave, he will say his father; asked him what his name was, and he said Zhang Er; When asked what his name was, he said Zhang San. Write it down straight, and it will be clear. The person who wrote the stele preferred to dance and ink, so the more he danced, the more foolish, he didn't know that the study of "gold and stone examples" was finally out of the game from the Yuan Dynasty to the Qing Dynasty.我还同先前一样；不过太静了，倒是什么也不想写。
I am still the same as before; But it's too quiet, and I don't want to write anything.鲁迅。九月二十三日。
Lu Xun. September 23.

《阿Q正传》的成因

《阿Q正传》的成因

《阿Q正传》的成因

The cause of "The True Biography of Ah Q"在《文学周报》二五一期里，西谛先生谈起《呐喊》，尤其是《阿Q正传》。这不觉引动我记起了一些小事情，也想借此来说一说，一则也算是做文章，投了稿；二则还可以给要看的人去看去。
In the 251st issue of "Literary Weekly", Mr. Xidi talked about "The Scream", especially "The True Biography of Ah Q". This unconsciously reminded me of some small things, and I also wanted to use this to talk about it, one of which can be regarded as making an article and submitting a manuscript; the other can also be seen by those who want to see it.我先要抄一段西谛先生的原文——
I want to copy a piece of Mr. Xidi's original text -“这篇东西值得大家如此的注意，原不是无因的。但也有几点值得商榷的，如最后‘大团圆’的一幕，我在《晨报》上初读此作之时，即不以为然，至今也还不以为然，似乎作者对于阿Q之收局太匆促了；他不欲再往下写了，便如此随意的给他以一个‘大团圆’。像阿Q那样的一个人，终于要做起革命党来，终于受到那样大团圆的结局，似乎连作者他自己在最初写作时也是料不到的。至少在人格上似乎是两个。”
"This thing deserves everyone's attention, and it is not without reason. But there are also a few points that are debatable, such as the final 'reunion' scene, when I first read this work in the "Morning Post", I didn't think so, and I still don't think so, it seems that the author is too hasty for Ah Q's ending; He didn't want to write any further, so he gave him a 'reunion' so casually. A person like Ah Q finally wants to start a revolutionary party and finally receive such a happy ending, which seems to be unexpected even by the author himself when he first wrote. At least in terms of personality, it seems to be two. ”阿Q是否真要做革命党，即使真做了革命党，在人格上是否似乎是两个，现在姑且勿论。单是这篇东西的成因，说起来就要很费功夫了。我常常说，我的文章不是涌出来的，是挤出来的。听的人往往误解为谦逊，其实是真情。我没有什么话要说，也没有什么文章要做，但有一种自害的脾气，是有时不免呐喊几声，想给人们去添点热闹。譬如一匹疲牛罢，明知不堪大用的了，但废物何妨利用呢，所以张家要我耕一弓地，可以的；李家要我挨一转磨，也可以的；赵家要我在他店前站一刻，在我背上帖出广告道：敝店备有肥牛，出售上等消毒滋养牛乳。我虽然深知道自己是怎么瘦，又是公的，并没有乳，然而想到他们为张罗生意起见，情有可原，只要出售的不是毒药，也就不说什么了。但倘若用得我太苦，是不行的，我还要自己觅草吃，要喘气的工夫；要专指我为某家的牛，将我关在他的牛牢内，也不行的，我有时也许还要给别家挨几转磨。如果连肉都要出卖，那自然更不行，理由自明，无须细说。倘遇到上述的三不行，我就跑，或者索性躺在荒山里。即使因此忽而从深刻变为浅薄，从战士化为畜生，吓我以康有为，比我以梁启超，也都满不在乎，还是我跑我的，我躺我的，决不出来再上当，因为我于“世故”实在是太深了。

As for the translation of "The True Biography of Ah Q", I have only seen two types.
