The English one seems to be translated very earnestly, but I don't understand English and can't say anything. I just happened to see two places that can be discussed: one is that "three hundred big money and nine two strings" should be translated as "three hundred big money, with ninety-two wen as one hundred"; Second, the "Persimmon Oil Party" is not as good as the translation, because it was originally a "Liberal Party", and the countrymen could not understand it, so it was misinterpreted as the "Persimmon Oil Party" that they could understand.十二月三日，在厦门写。

About "Tripitaka Scriptures" and so on阔别了多年的SF君，忽然从日本东京寄给我一封信，转来转去，待我收到时，去发信的日子已经有二十天了。但这在我，却真如空谷里听到跫然的足音。信函中还附着一片十一月十四日东京《国民新闻》的记载，是德富苏峰氏纠正我那《小说史略》的谬误的。
SF, who has been away for many years, suddenly sent me a letter from Tokyo, Japan, and when I received it, it had been twenty days since I sent the letter. But for me, it was like hearing the sound of footsteps in an empty valley. The letter also contained a record of the "National News" in Tokyo on November 14, which was corrected by Mr. Tokufu Sufeng's "Brief History of Novels".凡一本书的作者，对于外来的纠正，以为然的就遵从，以为非的就缄默，本不必有一一说明下笔时是什么意思，怎样取舍的必要。但苏峰氏是日本深通“支那”的耆宿，《三藏取经记》的收藏者，那措辞又很波俏，因此也就想来说几句话。
The author of a book obeys the correction from the outside and remains silent if he thinks it is wrong, and there is no need to explain what it means when writing and how to make a choice. But Su Feng is a senior who is deeply connected to "China" in Japan and a collector of the "Tripitaka Scriptures", and the wording is very fancy, so I want to say a few words.首先还得翻出他的原文来——
First of all, I have to turn out his original text -
鲁迅氏之《中国小说史略》　　苏峰生
Lu Xun's "Brief History of Chinese Novels" Su Fengsheng顷读鲁迅氏之《中国小说史略》，有云：
Recently, I read Lu Xun's "A Brief History of Chinese Novels", which says:《大唐三藏法师取经记》三卷，旧本在日本，又有一小本曰《大唐三藏取经诗话》，内容悉同，卷尾一行云“中瓦子张家印”，张家为宋时临安书铺，世因以为宋刊，然逮于元朝，张家或亦无恙，则此书或为元人所撰，未可知矣。……
The three volumes of "The Records of the Great Tang Tripitaka Master", the old version is in Japan, and there is a small book called "The Poems of the Tang Dynasty", the content is the same, and the last line of the volume says "Zhongwazi Zhang Jiayin", the Zhang family was a bookstore in Lin'an during the Song Dynasty, and the world thought it was a Song publication, but by the Yuan Dynasty, the Zhang family may have been fine, so this book may have been written by the Yuan people, and it is unknown. ……这倒并非没有聊加辩正的必要。
This is not without the need to defend and justify.《大唐三藏取经记》者，实是我的成篑堂的插架中之一，而《取经诗话》的袖珍本，则是故三浦观树将军的珍藏。这两书，是都由明慧上人和红叶广知于世，从京都栂尾高山寺散出的。看那书中的高山寺的印记，又看高山寺藏书目录，都证明着如此。
The "Tang Dynasty Tripitaka Scriptures" is actually one of my Cheng Basket Hall inserts, and the pocket book of "Classic Poems" is the collection of the late General Miura Kanshu. These two books were both widely known to the world by Master Minghui and Momiji, and were distributed from Tsugao Takayama Temple in Kyoto. Looking at the imprint of Gaoshan Temple in the book, and looking at the catalog of Gaoshan Temple's collection, it all proves this.这不但作为宋椠的稀本；作为宋代所著的说话本（日本之所谓言文一致体），也最可珍重的的罢。然而鲁迅氏却轻轻地断定道，“此书或为元人撰，未可知矣。”过于太早计了。
This is not only a rare copy of Song Yu; As a speech book written in the Song Dynasty (the so-called unity of language and literature in Japan), it is also the most precious. However, Lu Xun gently concluded, "This book may have been written for the Yuan people, but it is unknown." "It's too early.鲁迅氏未见这两书的原板，所以不知究竟，倘一见，则其为宋椠，决不容疑。其纸质，其墨色，其字体，无不皆然。不仅因为张家是宋时的临安的书铺。
Lu Xun has not seen the original plates of these two books, so he does not know the end, if he sees it, it is Song Zhen, and there is no doubt about it. The paper quality, the color of the ink, the font, everything is the same. Not only because the Zhang family was a bookstore in Lin'an during the Song Dynasty.加之，至于成篑堂的《取经记》，则有着可以说是宋版的特色的阙字。好个罗振玉氏，于此早已觉到了。
In addition, as for Cheng Xiangtang's "Record of Taking the Scriptures", it has a character that can be said to be a characteristic of the Song version. What a Luo Zhenyu clan, I have already realized this.皆（三浦本，成篑堂本）为高山寺旧藏。而此本（成篑堂藏《取经记》）刊刻尤精，书中驚字作，敬字缺末笔，盖亦宋椠也。（《雪堂校刊群书叙录》）
皆（三浦本，成篑堂本）为高山寺旧藏。 而此本（成篑堂藏《取经记》）刊刻尤精，书中驚字作，敬字缺末笔，盖亦宋椠也。 （《雪堂校刊群书叙录》）想鲁迅氏未读罗氏此文，所以疑是或为元人之作的罢。即使世间多不可思议事，元人著作的宋刻，是未必有可以存在的理由的。
I think Lu Xun has not read Luo's article, so I suspect it may have been written by the Yuan people. Even if there are many incredible things in the world, the Song engravings of the Yuan people's works may not have a reason to exist.
罗振玉氏对于此书，曾这样说。宋代平话，旧但有《宣和遗事》而已。近年若《五代平话》，《京本小说》，渐有重刊本。宋人平话之传于人间者，至是遂得四种。因为是斯学界中如此重要的书籍，所以明白其真相，未必一定是无用之业罢。
Luo Zhenyu once said this about this book. In the plain language of the Song Dynasty, there was only "Xuanhe Relics" in the past. In recent years, such as "Five Dynasties Plain Stories" and "Jingben Novels", there have been gradual reprints. The Song people's plain dialect spread to the world, and by this time, four types of dialect had been discovered. Because it is such an important book in the academic world, understanding its truth may not necessarily be useless.

总之，苏峰氏的意思，无非在证明《三藏取经记》等是宋椠。其论据有三——
In short, Su Feng's meaning is nothing more than proving that the "Tripitaka Scriptures" and others are Song Zhen. There are three arguments for this—一　纸墨字体是宋；
1. The paper and ink font is Song;二　宋讳缺笔；
2. Song Yu missing pen;三　罗振玉氏说是宋刻。
3. Luo Zhenyu said that it was a Song carving.说起来也惭愧，我虽然草草编了一本《小说史略》，而家无储书，罕见旧刻，所用为资料的，几乎都是翻刻本，新印本，甚而至于是石印本，序跋及撰人名，往往缺失，所以漏略错误，一定很多。但《三藏法师取经记》及《诗话》两种，所见的却是罗氏影印本，纸墨虽新，而字体和缺笔是看得出的。那后面就有罗跋，正不必再求之于《雪堂校刊群书叙录》，我所谓“世因以为宋刊”，即指罗跋而言。现在苏峰氏所举的三证中，除纸墨因确未目睹，无从然否外，其余二事，则那时便已不足使我信受，因此就不免“疑”起来了。
I'm ashamed to say that although I hastily compiled a "Brief History of Novels", I don't have a book at home, and it is rare to use old engravings, and almost all of the materials used as materials are reprints, new prints, and even stone prints, prefaces and authors' names are often missing, so there must be a lot of omissions. However, the two types of "Tripitaka Master's Scriptures" and "Poems" are photocopies of Luo's book, and although the paper and ink are new, the font and lack of pen can be seen. Then there is Luo Ba, and there is no need to ask for it in the "Xuetang School Magazine Group Books Narrative", what I mean by "the world is thought to be a Song publication", that is, it refers to Luo Ba. Now, among the three evidences cited by Su Feng, except for the paper and ink that I have not witnessed it, the other two things are no longer enough for me to believe at that time, so I can't help but "doubt".某朝讳缺笔是某朝刻本，是藏书家考定版本的初步秘诀，只要稍看过几部旧书的人，大抵知道的。何况缺笔的驚字的怎样地触目。但我却以为这并不足以确定为宋本。前朝的缺笔字，因为故意或习惯，也可以沿至后一朝。例如我们民国已至十五年了，而遗老们所刻的书，儀字还“敬缺末笔”。非遗老们所刻的书，寧字玄字也常常缺笔，或者以甯代寧，以元代玄。这都是在民国而讳清讳；不足为清朝刻本的证据。京师图书馆所藏的《易林注》残本（现有影印本，在《四部丛刊》中），恆字搆字都缺笔的，纸质，墨色，字体，都似宋；而且是蝶装，缪荃荪氏便定为宋本。但细看内容，却引用着阴时夫的《韵府群玉》，而阴时夫则是道道地地的元人。所以我以为不能据缺笔字便确定为某朝刻，尤其是当时视为无足重轻的小说和剧曲之类。
The absence of a pen in a certain dynasty is an engraved version of a certain dynasty, which is the preliminary secret of the bibliophile's examination version, as long as you have read a few old books, you probably know it. Not to mention how eye-catching the words of the lack of a pen are. But I thought this was not enough to determine the Song version. The lack of pen words in the previous dynasty, because of intention or habit, can also be traced back to the later dynasty. For example, our Republic of China has been in the past fifteen years, and the books engraved by the elderly are still "missing the last pen". In the books engraved by the intangible cultural heritage elders, the words Ning and Xuan often lack pens, or Ning instead of Ning, and Yuan instead of Xuan. This is all taboo in the Republic of China; It is not enough evidence for the Qing Dynasty engraving. The fragments of "Yi Lin Zhu" in the collection of the Beijing Library (existing photocopies, in the "Four Series"), the Hengzi and the characters are missing the pen, and the paper, ink color, and font are all like the Song Dynasty; And it is a butterfly costume, and Miao Quansun's family is set as the Song version. But if you look closely at the content, you can see that Yin Shifu's "Yunfu Qunyu" is quoted, and Yin Shifu is an authentic Yuan person. So I don't think it can be determined as a certain dynasty based on the lack of words, especially novels and operas that were considered insignificant at that time.罗氏的论断，在日本或者很被引为典据罢，但我却并不尽信奉，不但书跋，连书画金石的题跋，无不皆然。即如罗氏所举宋代平话四种中，《宣和遗事》我也定为元人作，但这并非我的轻轻断定，是根据了明人胡应麟氏所说的。而且那书是抄撮而成，文言和白话都有，也不尽是“平话”。
Luo's assertion may be cited as a classic in Japan, but I do not fully believe in it, not only in books, but also in calligraphy and painting. That is, among the four plain words of the Song Dynasty cited by Luo, I also set the "Xuanhe Relics" as a Yuan person, but this is not my light judgment, it is based on what the Ming people Hu Yinglin said. Moreover, the book is copied, both in classical Chinese and vernacular, and it is not all "plain words".我的看书，和藏书家稍不同，是不尽相信缺笔，抬头，以及罗氏题跋的。因此那时便疑；只是疑，所以说“或”，说“未可知”。我并非想要唐突宋椠和收藏者，即使如何廓大其冒昧，似乎也不过轻疑而已，至于“轻轻地断定”，则殆未也。
My reading is slightly different from that of bibliophiles, and I don't fully believe in the lack of pens, heads, and Roche's inscriptions. Therefore, I was suspicious then; It's just doubt, so I say "or" and "unknown". I don't want to abruptly criticize Song Yu and the collector, even if I try to exaggerate his presumptuousness, it seems to be just a suspicion, and as for "gently determine", it is probably not.但在未有更确的证明之前，我的“疑”是存在的。待证明之后，就成为这样的事：鲁迅疑是元刻，为元人作；今确是宋椠，故为宋人作。无论如何，苏峰氏所豫想的“元人著作的宋版”这滑稽剧，是未必能够开演的。
But until there is a more conclusive proof, my "doubt" exists. After it is proved, it becomes like this: Lu Xun is suspected of being a Yuan carved and made for the Yuan people; Now it is indeed Song Yu, so it was written for the Song people. In any case, the burlesque drama "Song version of the Yuan people's writings" that Su Feng envisioned may not be able to start.然而在考辨的文字中杂入一点滑稽轻薄的论调，每容易迷眩一般读者，使之失去冷静，坠入彀中，所以我便译出，并略加说明，如上。
However, the text of the examination is mixed with a little funny and frivolous argument, which is easy to confuse the general reader, make him lose his composure, and fall into the trap, so I translated it and explained it slightly, as above.十二月二十日。

所谓“思想界先驱者”鲁迅启事

所谓“思想界先驱者”鲁迅启事

所谓“思想界先驱者”鲁迅启事

The so-called "pioneer of ideology" Lu Xun noticed《新女性》八月号登有“狂飙社广告”，说：“狂飙运动的开始远在二年之前……去年春天本社同人与思想界先驱者鲁迅及少数最进步的青年文学家合办《莽原》……兹为大规模地进行我们的工作起见于北京出版之《乌合》《未名》《莽原》《弦上》四种出版物外特在上海筹办《狂飙丛书》及一篇幅较大之刊物”云云。我在北京编辑《莽原》，《乌合丛书》，《未名丛刊》三种出版物，所用稿件，皆系以个人名义送来；对于狂飙运动，向不知是怎么一回事：如何运动，运动甚么。今忽混称“合办”，实出意外；不敢掠美，特此声明。又，前因有人不明真相，或则假借虚名，加我纸冠，已非一次，业经先有陈源在《现代评论》上，近有长虹在《狂飙》上，迭加嘲骂，而狂飙社一面又锡以第三顶“纸糊的假冠”，真是头少帽多，欺人害己，虽“世故的老人”，亦身心之交病矣。只得又来特此声明：我也不是“思想界先驱者”即英文Forerunner之译名。此等名号，乃是他人暗中所加，别有作用，本人事前并不知情，事后亦未尝高兴。倘见者因此受愚，概与本人无涉。
The August issue of "New Woman" published an "Hurricane Club Advertisement", saying: "The Hurricane Movement began long ago two years ago...... Last spring, the Society co-organized "Mangyuan" with Lu Xun, a pioneer in the intellectual world, and a few of the most progressive young writers...... In order to carry out our work on a large scale, we have published four publications in Beijing: "Rabble", "Weiming", "Mangyuan" and "Xianshang", and specially prepared the "Hurricane Series" and a larger publication in Shanghai." I edited three publications in Beijing: "Mangyuan", "Rabble", and "Unnamed Series", and the manuscripts used were all sent in my personal name; For Hurricane Sports, I don't know what it is: how to exercise, what is exercise. Now it is suddenly called "co-organized", which is really unexpected; I dare not plunder the United States, and I hereby declare. In addition, because someone did not know the truth, or used a false name to add my paper crown, it was not once, and there was Chen Yuan in the "Modern Review", and recently Changhong in "Hurricane", repeatedly ridiculed, and the Hurricane Society gave a third "fake crown of paper paste", which is really less heads and more hats, deceiving others and harming oneself, although it is a "sophisticated old man", it is also a physical and mental illness. I have to come again to declare: I am not a "pioneer in the world of thought", that is, the translation of the English Forerunner. These names are secretly added by others, and they have a different effect, and I did not know about them beforehand, and I was not happy afterwards. If the witness is fooled by this, it has nothing to do with me.

I advertised several times (but I didn't post it), deceiving them from other schools, and the result was that I ran away, I'm really sorry. I regret that no one made shady notes in Beijing and stopped the students. The philosophy of "talking when you meet, fighting when you don't see each other" seems to be sometimes misleading.你大约还不知道底细，我最初的主意，倒的确想在这里住两年，除教书之外，还希望将先前所集成的《汉画象考》和《古小说钩沈》印出。这两种书自己印不起，也不敢请你印。因为看的人一定很少，折本无疑，惟有有钱的学校才合适。及至到了这里，看看情形，便将印《汉画象考》的希望取消，并且自己缩短年限为一年。其实是已经可以走了，但看着语堂的勤勉和为故乡做事的热心，我不好说出口。后来豫算不算数了，语堂力争；听说校长就说，只要你们有稿子拿来，立刻可以印。于是我将稿子拿出去，放了大约至多十分钟罢，拿回来了，从此没有后文。这结果，不过证明了我确有稿子，并不欺骗。那时我便将印《古小说钩沈》的意思也取消，并且自己再缩短年限为半年。语堂是除办事教书之外，还要防暗算，我看他在不相干的事情上，弄得力尽神疲，真是冤枉之至。
You probably don't know the details yet, my original idea was to live here for two years, in addition to teaching, I also hoped to print the previously integrated "Han Painting Elephant Examination" and "Ancient Novel Hook Shen". I can't afford to print these two books, and I don't dare to ask you to print them. Because there must be very few people to watch, there is no doubt that the loss is undoubted, and only rich schools are suitable. When he got here, looking at the situation, he canceled the hope of printing the "Han Painting and Elephant Examination" and shortened the period to one year. In fact, I can already leave, but looking at Yutang's diligence and enthusiasm for doing things for my hometown, I can't say it. Later, Yu Su did not count, and Yutang struggled; When I heard that the principal said, as long as you have a manuscript, you can print it immediately. So I took out the manuscript, put it on for about ten minutes at most, and got it back, and there was no further text from then on. This result, however, proves that I do have a manuscript and is not deceiving. At that time, I also canceled the meaning of printing "Ancient Novels Hook Shen", and shortened the period to half a year. In addition to doing things and teaching, Yutang also has to prevent conspiracies, and I think he is exhausted in irrelevant things, which is really unjust.前天开会议，连国学院的周刊也几乎印不成了；然而校长的意思，却要添顾问，如理科主任之流，都是顾问，据说是所以连络感情的。我真不懂厦门的风俗，为什么研究国学，就会伤理科主任之流的感情，而必用顾问的绳，将他络住？联络感情法我没有研究过；兼士又已辞职，所以我决计也走了。现在去放假不过三星期，本来暂停也无妨，然而这里对于教职员的薪水，有时是锱铢必较的，离开学校十来天也想扣，所以我不想来沾放假中的薪水的便宜，至今天止，扣足一月。昨天已经出题考试，作一结束了。阅卷当在下月，但是不取分文。看完就走，刊物请暂勿寄来，待我有了驻足之所，当即函告，那时再寄罢。
The day before yesterday, even the weekly magazine of the Chinese Academy could hardly be printed; However, the principal's intention is to add advisors, such as science directors, who are all consultants, and it is said that this is why they are emotionally connected. I really don't understand the customs of Xiamen, why does studying Chinese studies hurt the feelings of the director of science and the like, and must use the rope of the consultant to tie him up? I haven't studied the contact relationship method; The part-time scholar has resigned, so I decided to leave. Now it's only three weeks on vacation, and it's okay to pause, but the salary of the faculty and staff here is sometimes a must, and I want to deduct it after leaving school for more than ten days, so I don't want to take advantage of the salary during the holidays, and as of today, I will deduct a full month. Yesterday, the exam was already over. The review should be next month, but it will not be divided. After reading it, I left, please don't send the publication for the time being, when I have a place to stop, I will write to you immediately, and then send it again.临末，照例要说到天气。所谓例者，我之例也；怕有批评家指为我要勒令天下青年都照我的例，所以特此声明：并非如此。天气，确已冷了。草也比先前黄得多；然而我那门前的秋葵似的黄花却还在开着，山里也还有石榴花。苍蝇不见了，蚊子间或有之。
At the end of the day, we have to talk about the weather as usual. The so-called example is my example; I am afraid that some critics will accuse me of ordering all the young people of the world to follow my example, so I hereby declare that this is not the case. The weather is indeed cold. The grass is also much yellower than before; However, the okra-like yellow flowers in front of my door are still blooming, and there are pomegranate flowers in the mountains. Flies are gone, but mosquitoes may be there.夜深了，再谈罢。
It's late at night, let's talk about it again.鲁迅。十二月三十一日。
Lu Xun. December 31st.再：睡了一觉醒来，听到柝声，已经是五更了。这是学校的新政，上月添设，更夫也不止一人。我听着，才知道各人的打法是不同的，声调最分明地可以区别的有两种——
Again: When I woke up from a nap, I heard the sound of watches, and it was already five o'clock. This is a new policy for schools, which was added last month, and there is more than one shifter. As I listened, I realized that everyone's style of play is different, and there are two types of tones that can be most clearly distinguished -托，托，托，托托！
To, to, to, toto!托，托，托托！托。
To, to, toto! Torr.打更的声调也有派别，这是我先前所不知道的。并以奉告，当作一件新闻。
There are also factions in the tone of the night watch, which I didn't know before. And I will tell you that it will be a piece of news.

海上通信

Maritime communications小峰兄：
Brother Xiaofeng:前几天得到来信，因为忙于结束我所担任的事，所以不能即刻奉答。现在总算离开厦门坐在船上了。船正在走，也不知道是在什么海上。总之一面是一望汪洋，一面却看见岛屿。但毫无风涛，就如坐在长江的船上一般。小小的颠簸自然是有的，不过这在海上就算不得颠簸；陆上的风涛要比这险恶得多。
I received a letter the other day, and I can't reply immediately because I am busy finishing my work. Now I finally left Xiamen and sat on the boat. The ship was moving, and I didn't know what sea it was on. In short, one side is the ocean, but the other side is the island. But there are no winds and waves, just like sitting on a boat on the Yangtze River. There are naturally small bumps, but this is not a bump at sea; The winds and waves on land are much more sinister than this.同舱的一个是台湾人，他能说厦门话，我不懂；我说的蓝青官话，他不懂。他也能说几句日本话，但是，我也不大懂得他。于是乎只好笔谈，才知道他是丝绸商。我于丝绸一无所知，他于丝绸之外似乎也毫无意见。于是乎他只得睡觉，我就独霸了电灯写信了。
One of the people in the same cabin is Taiwanese, he can speak Xiamen dialect, I don't understand; He didn't understand what I said. He can also speak a few words of Japanese, but I don't know him very well. So I had to talk about it in writing, only to find out that he was a silk merchant. I know nothing about silk, and he seems to have no opinion about it. So he had to sleep, and I took control of the electric light and wrote letters.从上月起，我本在搜集材料，想趁寒假的闲空，给《唐宋传奇集》做一篇后记，准备付印，不料现在又只得搁起来。至于《野草》，此后做不做很难说，大约是不见得再做了，省得人来谬托知己，舐皮论骨，什么是“入于心”的。但要付印，也还须细看一遍，改正错字，颇费一点工夫。因此一时也不能寄上。
Since last month, I have been collecting materials, and I want to take advantage of the free time of the winter vacation to make an afterword for the "Collection of Tang and Song Legends", ready to be printed, but now I have to put it on hold. As for "Weeds", it is difficult to say whether it will be done or not after that, and it is probably not necessary to do it again, so that people can mistakenly rely on their confidants, lick their skin and talk about bones, what is "in the heart". But if you want to print it, you have to look at it carefully, correct the typo, and it takes a little effort. Therefore, it cannot be sent for a while.我直到十五日才上船，因为先是等上月份的薪水，后来是等船。在最后的一星期中，住着实在很为难，但也更懂了一些新的世故，就是，我先前只以为要饭碗不容易，现在才知道不要饭碗也是不容易的。我辞职时，是说自己生病，因为我觉得无论怎样的暴主，还不至于禁止生病；倘使所生的并非气厥病，也不至于牵连了别人。不料一部分的青年不相信，给我开了几次送别会，演说，照相，大抵是逾量的优礼，我知道有些不妥了，连连说明：我是戴着“纸糊的假冠”的，请他们不要惜别，请他们不要忆念。但是，不知怎地终于发生了改良学校运动，首先提出的是要求校长罢免大学秘书刘树杞博士。
I didn't get on the boat until the 15th, because first I was waiting for last month's salary, and then I was waiting for the boat. In the last week, it was really difficult to live, but I also understood some new sophistication, that is, I only thought it was not easy to get a job before, and now I know that it is not easy to get a job. When I resigned, I said that I was sick, because I felt that no matter what kind of tyrant I was, I would not forbid to get sick; If it is not a qi syncope, it will not implicate others. Unexpectedly, some young people didn't believe it, and held several farewell parties for me, speeches, and photos, probably excessive gifts, I knew something was wrong, and explained again and again: I am wearing a "fake crown of papier-mâché", please don't say goodbye, please don't remember. However, somehow the movement to improve the school finally took place, and the first thing was to demand that the president remove Dr. Liu Shuqi, the university secretary.听说三年前，这里也有一回相类的风潮，结果是学生完全失败，在上海分立了一个大夏大学。那时校长如何自卫，我不得而知；这回是说我的辞职，和刘博士无干，乃是胡适之派和鲁迅派相排挤，所以走掉的。这话就登在鼓浪屿的日报《民钟》上，并且已经加以驳斥。但有几位同事还大大地紧张起来，开会提出质问；而校长却答复得很干脆：没有说这话。有的还不放心，更给我放散别种的谣言，要减轻“排挤说”的势力。真是“天下纷纷，何时定乎？”如果我安心在厦门大学吃饭，或者没有这些事的罢，然而这是我所意料不到的。
I heard that three years ago, there was a similar trend here, and the result was that the students completely failed and established a Daxia University in Shanghai. I don't know how the principal defended himself at that time; This time it means that my resignation has nothing to do with Dr. Liu, but it was the Hu Shizhi faction and the Lu Xun faction that were excluded, so I left. This was published in Gulangyu's daily newspaper "People's Bell" and has been refuted. However, several colleagues were still very nervous and held a meeting to ask questions; But the principal replied very simply: I didn't say this. Some are not at ease, and even spread other rumors to me, to reduce the power of "exclusion theory". It's really "the world is in turmoil, when will it be decided?" "If I were to eat at Xiamen University with peace of mind, or there would be no such things, but this was what I didn't expect.校长林文庆博士是英国籍的中国人，开口闭口，不离孔子，曾经做过一本讲孔教的书，可惜名目我忘记了。听说还有一本英文的自传，将在商务印书馆出版；现在正做着《人种问题》。他待我实在是很隆重，请我吃过几回饭；单是饯行，就有两回。不过现在“排挤说”倒衰退了；前天所听到的是他在宣传，我到厦门，原是来捣乱，并非豫备在厦门教书的，所以北京的位置都没有辞掉。
The principal, Dr. Lin Wenqing, is a British Chinese, who has kept his mouth shut and never left Confucius, and once made a book on Confucianism, but unfortunately I forgot the name. I heard that there is also an autobiography in English, which will be published in the Commercial Press; Now I am working on "Race Issues". He treated me very solemnly and invited me to dinner several times; There are two farewell trips alone. But now the "exclusion theory" has declined; What I heard the day before yesterday was that he was propaganda, I went to Xiamen, it turned out to be to make trouble, not to prepare to teach in Xiamen, so I didn't resign from my position in Beijing.现在我没有到北京，“位置说”大概又要衰退了罢，新说如何，可惜我已在船上，不得而知。据我的意料，罪孽一定是日见其深重的，因为中国向来就是“当面输心背面笑”，正不必“新的时代”的青年才这样。对面是“吾师”和“先生”，背后是毒药和暗箭，领教了已经不只两三次了。
Now that I haven't been to Beijing, the "location says" are probably going to decline again, how about the new statement, but unfortunately I am already on the ship, I don't know. According to my expectation, the sins must be deep, because China has always been "losing to the face and laughing behind the back", and it is not necessary for the youth of the "new era" to be like this. Opposite are "My Master" and "Mr.", and behind them are poisons and hidden arrows, and I have learned more than two or three times.新近还听到我的一件罪案，是关于集美学校的。厦门大学和集美学校，都是秘密世界，外人大抵不大知道。现在因为反对校长，闹了风潮了。先前，那校长叶渊定要请国学院里的人们去演说，于是分为六组，每星期一组，凡两人。第一次是我和语堂。那招待法也很隆重，前一夜就有秘书来迎接。此公和我谈起，校长的意思是以为学生应该专门埋头读书的。我就说，那么我却以为也应该留心世事，和校长的尊意正相反，不如不去的好罢。他却道不妨，也可以说说。于是第二天去了，校长实在沉鸷得很，殷勤劝我吃饭。我却一面吃，一面愁。心里想，先给我演说就好了，听得讨厌，就可以不请我吃饭；现在饭已下肚，倘使说话有背谬之处，适足以加重罪孽，如何是好呢。午后讲演，我说的是照例的聪明人不能做事，因为他想来想去，终于什么也做不成等类的话。那时校长坐在我背后，我看不见。直到前几天，才听说这位叶渊校长也说集美学校的闹风潮，都是我不好，对青年人说话，那里可以说人是不必想来想去的呢。当我说到这里的时候，他还在后面摇摇头。
I also recently heard about a crime of mine, which is about Jimei School. Xiamen University and Jimei School are both secret worlds, and outsiders probably don't know much about them. Now because of the opposition to the principal, there is a trend. Previously, the principal Ye Yuan was going to invite people from the Chinese Academy to give a speech, so he was divided into six groups, one group a week, two people. The first time was me and Yutang. The hospitality was also very grand, and a secretary came to greet him the night before. This gentleman talked to me that the principal meant that he thought that students should be immersed in studying. I said, then I think we should also pay attention to the world, which is the opposite of the principal's dignity, so it is better not to go. He said it didn't matter, but he could also talk about it. So I went the next day, and the principal was really serious and earnestly persuaded me to eat. I eat while worrying. I thought to myself, just give me a speech first, and if I don't like it, I can not invite me to dinner; Now that the meal has been eaten, if there is something wrong in the speech, it is enough to aggravate the sin, what should we do? In the afternoon speech, I said that smart people can't do things as usual, because they think about it and finally can't do anything. The principal was sitting behind me and I couldn't see it. It wasn't until a few days ago that I heard that the principal Ye Yuan also said that the trouble in Jimei School was all my fault, and when I spoke to young people, it could be said that people don't have to think about it. When I said this, he was still shaking his head in the back.我的处世，自以为退让得尽够了，人家在办报，我决不自行去投稿；人家在开会，我决不自己去演说。硬要我去，自然也可以的，但须任凭我说一点我所要说的话，否则，我宁可一声不响，算是死尸。但这里却必须我开口说话，而话又须合于校长之意。我不是别人，那知道别人的意思呢？“先意承志”的妙法，又未曾学过。其被摇头，实活该也。
In my life, I think I have given in enough, and when people are running newspapers, I will never submit them by myself; People are in a meeting, and I will never give a speech myself. If I insist on going, it is naturally possible, but I must be allowed to say what I want to say, otherwise, I would rather remain silent and be regarded as a dead corpse. But here I have to speak, and the words must be in line with the principal's will. I'm not someone else, so how can I know what others mean? The wonderful method of "first intention and will" has never been learned. He was shaken his head, and he really deserved to live.但从去年以来，我居然大大地变坏，或者是进步了。虽或受着各方面的斫刺，似乎已经没有创伤，或者不再觉得痛楚；即使加我罪案，也并不觉着一点沉重了。这是我经历了许多旧的和新的世故之后，才获得的。我已经管不得许多，只好从退让到无可退避之地，进而和他们冲突，蔑视他们，并且蔑视他们的蔑视了。
But since last year, I have actually become much worse, or improved. Although they may have been stabbed in various ways, they seem to be no longer traumatized, or no longer feel pain; Even if I am added to the crime, I don't feel a little heavy. This is what I got after going through many old and new sophistications. I couldn't control much anymore, so I had to go from retreating to no retreat, and then conflicting with them, despising them, and despising their contempt.我的信要就此收场。海上的月色是这样皎洁；波面映出一大片银鳞，闪烁摇动；此外是碧玉一般的海水，看去仿佛很温柔。我不信这样的东西是会淹死人的。但是，请你放心，这是笑话，不要疑心我要跳海了，我还毫没有跳海的意思。
My letter is going to end here. The moonlight on the sea is so bright; The wave surface reflects a large piece of silver scales, flickering and shaking; In addition, it is jasper-like seawater, which looks very gentle. I don't believe that such a thing can drown. However, please rest assured, this is a joke, don't doubt that I am going to jump into the sea, I have no intention of jumping into the sea yet.鲁迅。一月十六夜，海上。

Lu Xun. On the night of January 16, at sea.

题辞

Inscription这半年我又看见了许多血和许多泪，In the past six months, I have seen a lot of blood and a lot of tears, 然而我只有杂感而已。 But I only have mixed feelings.  泪揩了，血消了； Tears wiped away, blood disappeared; 屠伯们逍遥复逍遥， The butchers are free, 用钢刀的，用软刀的。 with steel knives and soft knives. 然而我只有“杂感”而已。 However, I only have "mixed feelings".  连“杂感”也被“放进了应该去的地方”时， When even the "miscellaneous feelings" are "put where they should go", 我于是只有“而已”而已！ I only have "that"!
以上的八句话，是在一九二六年十月十四夜里，编完那年那时为止的杂感集后，写在末尾的，现在便取来作为一九二七年的杂感集的题辞。
The above eight sentences were written at the end of the collection of miscellaneous feelings up to that time on the night of October 14, 1926, and are now taken as the inscription of the miscellaneous feelings collection in 1927.一九二八年十月三十日，鲁迅校讫记。
On October 30, 1928, Lu Xun finished proofreading.

黄花节的杂感

黄花节的杂感

黄花节的杂感

The miscellaneous feeling of the Yellow Flower Festival黄花节将近了，必须做一点所谓文章。但对于这一个题目的文章，教我做起来，实在近于先前的在考场里“对空策”。因为，——说出来自己也惭愧，——黄花节这三个字，我自然明白它是什么意思的；然而战死在黄花冈头的战士们呢，不但姓名，连人数也不知道。
The Yellow Flower Festival is approaching, and we must do a little so-called article. But for the article on this topic, teaching me to do it is really close to the previous "empty strategy" in the examination room. Because ,—— I am ashamed to say ,—— three words of Yellow Flower Festival, I naturally understand what it means; However, the soldiers who died at Huanghuagang Head not only did not know their names, but also their numbers.为寻些材料，好发议论起见，只得查《辞源》。书里面有是有的，可不过是:
In order to find some material and make a good discussion, I had to look up the "Etymology". There are some in the book, but they are:“黄花冈。地名，在广东省城北门外白云山之麓。清宣统三年三月二十九日，革命党数十人，攻袭督署，不成而死，丛葬于此。”
"Huanghuagang. The place name is located at the foot of Baiyun Mountain outside the north gate of Guangdong Province. On March 29, the third year of the Qing Xuantong era, dozens of revolutionary party members attacked the governor's office, but they failed and died, and were buried here. ”轻描淡写，和我所知道的差不多，于我并不能有所裨益。
To put it mildly, it is about the same as what I know, and it does not help me.我又愿意知道一点十七年前的三月二十九日的情形，但一时也找不到目击耳闻的耆老。从别的地方——如北京，南京，我的故乡——的例子推想起来，当时大概有若干人痛惜，若干人快意，若干人没有什么意见，若干人当作酒后茶余的谈助的罢。接着便将被人们忘却。久受压制的人们，被压制时只能忍苦，幸而解放了便只知道作乐，悲壮剧是不能久留在记忆里的。
I would like to know a little about the situation on March 29 seventeen years ago, but I can't find any old people who have witnessed or heard about it for a while. From the examples of other places - such as Beijing, Nanjing, my hometown - there were probably a few people who regretted it, some people were happy, some people had no opinions, and some people just used it as a chat after drinking and tea. Then it will be forgotten. People who have been suppressed for a long time can only endure suffering when they are suppressed, but fortunately they only know how to have fun when they are liberated, and tragic dramas cannot remain in memory for a long time.但是三月二十九日的事却特别，当时虽然失败，十月就是武昌起义，第二年，中华民国便出现了。于是这些失败的战士，当时也就成为革命成功的先驱，悲壮剧刚要收场，又添上一个团圆剧的结束。这于我们是很可庆幸的，我想，在纪念黄花节的时候便可以看出。
But what happened on March 29 was special, although it failed at that time, October was the Wuchang Uprising, and the following year, the Republic of China appeared. So these defeated soldiers became the pioneers of the success of the revolution at that time, and the tragic drama was about to end, adding the end of a reunion drama. This is very fortunate for us, and I think we can see it when commemorating the Yellow Flower Festival.我还没有亲自遇见过黄花节的纪念，因为久在北方。不过，中山先生的纪念日却遇见过了:在学校里，晚上来看演剧的特别多，连凳子也踏破了几条，非常热闹。用这例子来推断，那么，黄花节也一定该是极其热闹的罢。
I haven't personally encountered the commemoration of the Yellow Flower Festival because I have been in the north for a long time. However, Mr. Sun Yat-sen's anniversary has been met: in school, there are a lot of people watching plays at night, and even a few stools have been broken, which is very lively. Using this example, it can be inferred that the Yellow Flower Festival must also be extremely lively.当三月十二日那天的晚上，我在热闹场中，便深深地更感得革命家的伟大。我想，恋爱成功的时候，一个爱人死掉了，只能给生存的那一个以悲哀。然而革命成功的时候，革命家死掉了，却能每年给生存的大家以热闹，甚而至于欢欣鼓舞。惟独革命家，无论他生或死，都能给大家以幸福。同是爱，结果却有这样地不同，正无怪现在的青年，很有许多感到恋爱和革命的冲突的苦闷。
When I was in the bustling scene on the night of March 12, I deeply felt the greatness of the revolutionaries. I think that when a love is successful, a lover dies, and only the one who survives can be sad. However, when the revolution succeeds, the revolutionaries die, but they can give everyone who survives lively every year, and even rejoice. Only a revolutionary, whether he is alive or dead, can bring happiness to everyone. It is no wonder that today's young people feel the bitterness of the conflict between love and revolution.以上的所谓“革命成功”，是指暂时的事而言；其实是“革命尚未成功”的。革命无止境，倘使世上真有什么“止于至善”，这人间世便同时变了凝固的东西了。不过，中国经了许多战士的精神和血肉的培养，却的确长出了一点先前所没有的幸福的花果来，也还有逐渐生长的希望。倘若不像有，那是因为继续培养的人们少，而赏玩，攀折这花，摘食这果实的人们倒是太多的缘故。
The so-called "revolutionary success" above refers to temporary matters; In fact, "the revolution has not yet succeeded". The revolution is endless, and if there is really something in the world that "stops at the best", the world will change at the same time. However, China has been cultivated by the spirit and flesh and blood of many soldiers, but it has indeed grown a little happiness and fruit that was not available before, and there is still hope for gradual growth. If it doesn't seem to exist, it is because there are few people who continue to cultivate, and there are too many people who enjoy playing, climbing this flower, and picking and eating this fruit.我并非说，大家都须天天去痛哭流涕，以凭吊先烈的“在天之灵”，一年中有一天记起他们也就可以了。但就广东的现在而论，我却觉得大家对于节日的办法，还须改良一点。黄花节很热闹，热闹一天自然也好；热闹得疲劳了，回去就好好地睡一觉。然而第二天，元气恢复了，就该加工做一天自己该做的工作。这当然是劳苦的，但总比枪弹从致命的地方穿过去要好得远；何况这也算是在培养幸福的花果，为着后来的人们呢。
I am not saying that everyone has to cry bitterly every day to mourn the "spirit in heaven" of the martyrs, and it is enough to remember them one day a year. But as far as Guangdong is concerned, I think everyone's approach to festivals needs to be improved a little. The Yellow Flower Festival is very lively, and it is natural to have a lively day; I'm tired from the excitement, so I'll go back and have a good night's sleep. However, the next day, when the vitality is restored, it is time to process and do the work that should be done for the day. It is laborious, of course, but it is far better than a bullet passing through a deadly place; What's more, this can be regarded as cultivating happy flowers and fruits for future generations.三月二十四日夜。
On the night of March 24th.

略论中国人的脸

略论中国人的脸

略论中国人的脸

A little about the Chinese face大约人们一遇到不大看惯的东西，总不免以为他古怪。我还记得初看见西洋人的时候，就觉得他脸太白，头发太黄，眼珠太淡，鼻梁太高。虽然不能明明白白地说出理由来，但总而言之:相貌不应该如此。至于对于中国人的脸，是毫无异议；即使有好丑之别，然而都不错的。
Probably when people encounter something they are not used to, they can't help but think that he is weird. I still remember when I first saw a Westerner, I thought his face was too white, his hair was too yellow, his eyes were too light, and his nose bridge was too high. Although the reason cannot be clearly stated, in short: appearance should not be like this. As for the Chinese face, there is no objection; Even if there are good and ugly differences, they are all good.我们的古人，倒似乎并不放松自己中国人的相貌。周的孟轲就用眸子来判胸中的正不正，汉朝还有《相人》二十四卷。后来闹这玩艺儿的尤其多；分起来，可以说有两派罢:一是从脸上看出他的智愚贤不肖；一是从脸上看出他过去，现在和将来的荣枯。于是天下纷纷，从此多事，许多人就都战战兢兢地研究自己的脸。我想，镜子的发明，恐怕这些人和小姐们是大有功劳的。不过近来前一派已经不大有人讲究，在北京上海这些地方捣鬼的都只是后一派了。
Our ancients did not seem to relax their Chinese appearance. Meng Ke of Zhou used his eyes to judge the righteousness of his chest, and the Han Dynasty also had twenty-four volumes of "Physiognomy". Later, there were many people who made fun of this trick; Divided into two factions: one is to see from his face that his wisdom and foolishness are virtuous; First, you can see the rise and fall of his past, present and future from his face. So the world was in turmoil, and many people studied their faces tremblingly. I think that the invention of the mirror is probably due to these people and ladies. However, recently, the former faction has not paid much attention to it, and it is only the latter faction that makes trouble in Beijing and Shanghai.我一向只留心西洋人。留心的结果，又觉得他们的皮肤未免太粗；毫毛有白色的，也不好。皮上常有红点，即因为颜色太白之故，倒不如我们之黄。尤其不好的是红鼻子，有时简直像是将要熔化的蜡烛油，仿佛就要滴下来，使人看得栗栗危惧，也不及黄色人种的较为隐晦，也见得较为安全。总而言之:相貌还是不应该如此的。
I have always paid attention to Westerners. As a result of paying attention, I feel that their skin is too thick; The hair is white, and it is not good. There are often red spots on the skin, which is not as yellow as ours because the color is too white. Especially bad is the red nose, which sometimes looks like candle oil that is about to melt, as if it is about to drip, which makes people look terrified, and it is not as obscure as the yellow race, and it is also safer. All in all: appearance should not be like this.后来，我看见西洋人所画的中国人，才知道他们对于我们的相貌也很不敬。那似乎是《天方夜谈》或者《安兑生童话》中的插画，现在不很记得清楚了。头上戴着拖花翎的红缨帽，一条辫子在空中飞扬，朝靴的粉底非常之厚。但这些都是满洲人连累我们的。独有两眼歪斜，张嘴露齿，却是我们自己本来的相貌。不过我那时想，其实并不尽然，外国人特地要奚落我们，所以格外形容得过度了。
Later, when I saw the Chinese painted by Westerners, I realized that they were also very disrespectful to our appearance. It seems to be an illustration from "Arabian Nights" or "An Duisheng's Fairy Tale", but I don't remember it very well now. He wore a red tassel hat with flapped feathers on his head, a braid flew in the air, and the foundation of his boots was very thick. But these are all Manchurians who have implicated us. The only thing that is slanted eyes and open mouth is that it is our original appearance. But I thought at the time that it was not entirely so, foreigners specifically wanted to ridicule us, so it was particularly exaggerated.但此后对于中国一部分人们的相貌，我也逐渐感到一种不满，就是他们每看见不常见的事件或华丽的女人，听到有些醉心的说话的时候，下巴总要慢慢挂下，将嘴张了开来。这实在不大雅观；仿佛精神上缺少着一样什么机件。据研究人体的学者们说，一头附着在上颚骨上，那一头附着在下颚骨上的“咬筋”，力量是非常之大的。我们幼小时候想吃核桃，必须放在门缝里将它的壳夹碎。但在成人，只要牙齿好，那咬筋一收缩，便能咬碎一个核桃。有着这么大的力量的筋，有时竟不能收住一个并不沉重的自己的下巴，虽然正在看得出神的时候，倒也情有可原，但我总以为究竟不是十分体面的事。
But since then, I have gradually felt a sense of dissatisfaction with the appearance of some people in China, that is, whenever they see an uncommon event or a gorgeous woman, and hear a little intoxicated speech, they always have to slowly lower their chins and open their mouths. This is really not an elegant view; It seems that there is something missing in the spirit. According to scholars who study the human body, the "bite tendon" attached to the maxilla and the other attached to the mandible is very powerful. When we were young, we wanted to eat walnuts, so we had to put them in the crack of the door to crush its shell. But in adults, as long as the teeth are good, the biter tendon can crush a walnut as soon as it contracts. With such a strong tendon, sometimes I can't hold my chin that is not heavy, although it is understandable when I can see God, but I always think that it is not a very decent thing in the end.日本的长谷川如是闲是善于做讽刺文字的。去年我见过他的一本随笔集，叫作《猫·狗·人》；其中有一篇就说到中国人的脸。大意是初见中国人，即令人感到较之日本人或西洋人，脸上总欠缺着一点什么。久而久之，看惯了，便觉得这样已经尽够，并不缺少东西；倒是看得西洋人之流的脸上，多余着一点什么。这多余着的东西，他就给它一个不大高妙的名目:兽性。中国人的脸上没有这个，是人，则加上多余的东西，即成了下列的算式:
Japan's Hasegawa is so idle that he is good at making satirical words. Last year I saw a collection of his essays called "Cats, Dogs, and People"; One of them talks about the face of the Chinese. The gist is that when you first see Chinese, you will feel that there is always something missing on your face compared to Japanese or Westerners. Over time, when I get used to it, I feel that this is enough, and there is no shortage of things; On the contrary, it seems that there is something extra on the faces of Westerners. This superfluous thing, he gave it a not very wonderful name: bestiality. If the Chinese does not have this on their faces, they are people, and they add superfluous things to become the following formula:人＋兽性＝西洋人
Human + bestiality = Westerners他借了称赞中国人，贬斥西洋人，来讥刺日本人的目的，这样就达到了，自然不必再说这兽性的不见于中国人的脸上，是本来没有的呢，还是现在已经消除。如果是后来消除的，那么，是渐渐净尽而只剩了人性的呢，还是不过渐渐成了驯顺。野牛成为家牛，野猪成为猪，狼成为狗，野性是消失了，但只足使牧人喜欢，于本身并无好处。人不过是人，不再夹杂着别的东西，当然再好没有了。倘不得已，我以为还不如带些兽性，如果合于下列的算式倒是不很有趣的:
He borrowed the purpose of praising the Chinese and denigrating the Westerners to ridicule the Japanese, so that he achieved it, and naturally there is no need to say that this beastly nature is not seen on the faces of the Chinese, whether it was not there in the first place, or has now been eliminated. If it was eliminated later, then it was gradually cleansed and only humanity remained, or it was just gradually tamed. The wild cow becomes a domestic cow, the wild boar becomes a pig, the wolf becomes a dog, and the wildness disappears, but it is enough to make the shepherd like it, and it is not good in itself. People are just people, no longer mixed with other things, of course it is not good. If it is necessary, I think it would be better to bring some beastliness, but it would not be very interesting if it fits the following formula:人＋家畜性＝某一种人
People + domestic animals = a certain kind of person中国人的脸上真可有兽性的记号的疑案，暂且中止讨论罢。我只要说近来却在中国人所理想的古今人的脸上，看见了两种多余。一到广州，我觉得比我所从来的厦门丰富得多的，是电影，而且大半是“国片”，有古装的，有时装的。因为电影是“艺术”，所以电影艺术家便将这两种多余加上去了。
The suspicion that the Chinese face can really have a beastly mark, so let's stop the discussion for the time being. I just need to say that recently, I have seen two kinds of superfluous on the faces of ancient and modern people idealized by Chinese. When I arrived in Guangzhou, I felt that what was much richer than Xiamen, where I came from, was movies, and most of them were "national films", including costumes and fashion ones. Because film is "art", film artists add these two superfluous things.古装的电影也可以说是好看，那好看不下于看戏；至少，决不至于有大锣大鼓将人的耳朵震聋。在“银幕”上，则有身穿不知何时何代的衣服的人物，缓慢地动作；脸正如古人一般死，因为要显得活，便只好加上些旧式戏子的昏庸。
costume movies can also be said to be good-looking, which is no less good-looking than watching a play; At least, there will never be big gongs and drums that deafen people's ears. On the "screen", there are characters wearing clothes of unknown times and generations, moving slowly; The face is as dead as the ancients, because it wants to appear alive, so it has to add some old-fashioned actors.时装人物的脸，只要见过清朝光绪年间上海的吴友如的《画报》的，便会觉得神态非常相像。《画报》所画的大抵不是流氓拆梢，便是妓女吃醋，所以脸相都狡猾。这精神似乎至今不变，国产影片中的人物，虽是作者以为善人杰士者，眉宇间也总带些上海洋场式的狡猾。可见不如此，是连善人杰士也做不成的。
The faces of fashion figures, as long as you have seen Wu Youru's "Pictorial" in Shanghai during the Guangxu period of the Qing Dynasty, will feel that their demeanor is very similar. Most of the paintings in the "Pictorial" are either hooligans or prostitutes who are jealous, so their faces are cunning. This spirit seems to have remained unchanged to this day, and the characters in domestic films, although the author thinks they are good people, always have some cunning in the style of the Shanghai Ocean Arena between their eyebrows. It can be seen that if this is not the case, even good people and heroes cannot do it.听说，国产影片之所以多，是因为华侨欢迎，能够获利，每一新片到，老的便带了孩子去指点给他们看道:“看哪，我们的祖国的人们是这样的。”在广州似乎也受欢迎，日夜四场，我常见看客坐得满满。
I heard that the reason why there are so many domestic films is because overseas Chinese are welcome and can make profits, and every time a new film arrives, the old one takes the child to show them and says: "Look, the people of our motherland are like this." It also seems to be popular in Guangzhou, and I often see spectators full of spectators in four performances a day and night.广州现在也如上海一样，正在这样地修养他们的趣味。可惜电影一开演，电灯一定熄灭，我不能看见人们的下巴。
Guangzhou, like Shanghai, is now cultivating their interests in this way. Unfortunately, as soon as the movie started, the lights would have gone out, and I couldn't see people's chins.四月六日。
April 6th.

革命时代的文学　——四月八日在黄埔军官学校讲

革命时代的文学Literature in the Revolutionary Era ——四月八日在黄埔军官学校讲 - Lectured at the Whampoa Military Academy on April 8
今天要讲几句的话是就将这“革命时代的文学”算作题目。这学校是邀过我好几次了，我总是推宕着没有来。为什么呢？因为我想，诸君的所以来邀我，大约是因为我曾经做过几篇小说，是文学家，要从我这里听文学。其实我并不是的，并不懂什么。我首先正经学习的是开矿，叫我讲掘煤，也许比讲文学要好一些。自然，因为自己的嗜好，文学书是也时常看看的，不过并无心得，能说出于诸君有用的东西来。加以这几年，自己在北京所得的经验，对于一向所知道的前人所讲的文学的议论，都渐渐的怀疑起来。那是开枪打杀学生的时候罢，文禁也严厉了，我想:文学文学，是最不中用的，没有力量的人讲的；有实力的人并不开口，就杀人，被压迫的人讲几句话，写几个字，就要被杀；即使幸而不被杀，但天天呐喊，叫苦，鸣不平，而有实力的人仍然压迫，虐待，杀戮，没有方法对付他们，这文学于人们又有什么益处呢？
A few words to say today is to count this "literature of the revolutionary era" as the title. This school has invited me several times, but I always hesitate not to come. Why? Because I think that the reason why you invited me is probably because I have written several novels, I am a writer, and I want to listen to literature from me. In fact, I don't, I don't know anything. The first serious thing I learned was mining, and I was asked to talk about coal mining, which might be better than literature. Naturally, because of my hobbies, I often read literary books, but I don't have any experience, and I can say that it is useful to you. In addition, in the past few years, the experience I have gained in Beijing has gradually become suspicious of the literary discussions I have always known about my predecessors. That was when students were shot and killed, and the ban on literature was also strict, I thought: literature is the most useless, powerless person to talk about; Those who are powerful will kill if they do not speak, and those who are oppressed will be killed if they say a few words or write a few words; Even if they are lucky enough not to be killed, but they shout, complain, and complain every day, and the powerful people still oppress, abuse, and kill, and there is no way to deal with them, what benefit does this literature do to people?在自然界里也这样，鹰的捕雀，不声不响的是鹰，吱吱叫喊的是雀；猫的捕鼠，不声不响的是猫，吱吱叫喊的是老鼠；结果，还是只会开口的被不开口的吃掉。文学家弄得好，做几篇文章，也许能够称誉于当时，或者得到多少年的虚名罢，——譬如一个烈士的追悼会开过之后，烈士的事情早已不提了，大家倒传诵着谁的挽联做得好:这实在是一件很稳当的买卖。
In nature, the eagle catches sparrows, the eagle is the eagle that is silent, and the sparrow is the squeak; The cat's mouse catching, the silent cat is the cat, and the squeaking is the mouse; As a result, those who only open their mouths are eaten by those who don't. For example,——, after a martyr's memorial service is held, the martyr's affairs have long been mentioned, and everyone recites whose elegy is good: this is really a very stable deal.但在这革命地方的文学家，恐怕总喜欢说文学和革命是大有关系的，例如可以用这来宣传，鼓吹，煽动，促进革命和完成革命。不过我想，这样的文章是无力的，因为好的文艺作品，向来多是不受别人命令，不顾利害，自然而然地从心中流露的东西；如果先挂起一个题目，做起文章来，那又何异于八股，在文学中并无价值，更说不到能否感动人了。为革命起见，要有“革命人”，“革命文学”倒无须急急，革命人做出东西来，才是革命文学。所以，我想:革命，倒是与文章有关系的。革命时代的文学和平时的文学不同，革命来了，文学就变换色彩。但大革命可以变换文学的色彩，小革命却不，因为不算什么革命，所以不能变换文学的色彩。在此地是听惯了“革命”了，江苏浙江谈到革命二字，听的人都很害怕，讲的人也很危险。其实“革命”是并不稀奇的，惟其有了它，社会才会改革，人类才会进步，能从原虫到人类，从野蛮到文明，就因为没有一刻不在革命。生物学家告诉我们:“人类和猴子是没有大两样的，人类和猴子是表兄弟。”但为什么人类成了人，猴子终于是猴子呢？这就因为猴子不肯变化——它爱用四只脚走路。也许曾有一个猴子站起来，试用两脚走路的罢，但许多猴子就说:“我们底祖先一向是爬的，不许你站！”咬死了。它们不但不肯站起来，并且不肯讲话，因为它守旧。人类就不然，他终于站起，讲话，结果是他胜利了。现在也还没有完。所以革命是并不稀奇的，凡是至今还未灭亡的民族，还都天天在努力革命，虽然往往不过是小革命。
However, writers in this revolutionary place may always like to say that literature and revolution have a lot to do with it, for example, it can be used to propagate, advocate, incite, promote revolution and complete revolution. However, I think that such articles are powerless, because good literary and artistic works have always been things that are not ordered by others, regardless of interests, and naturally reveal from the heart; If you hang up a topic and start an article, it is no different from eight strands, which have no value in literature, let alone whether they can move people. For the sake of revolution, there must be "revolutionaries", and there is no need to rush "revolutionary literature". Therefore, I think: revolution has something to do with the article. The literature of the revolutionary era is different from the literature of ordinary times, and when the revolution comes, literature changes color. But the great revolution can change the color of literature, but the small revolution does not, because it is not a revolution, so it cannot change the color of literature. When Jiangsu and Zhejiang talk about the word revolution, everyone who listens is very scared, and the person who speaks is also very dangerous. In fact, "revolution" is not unusual, but with it, society will reform, mankind will progress, from protozoa to humans, from barbarism to civilization, because there is no moment of revolution. Biologists tell us: "Humans and monkeys are not the same, humans and monkeys are cousins." But why did humans become humans and monkeys finally become monkeys? This is because the monkey refuses to change - it loves to walk on four feet. Maybe there was a monkey who stood up and tried to walk on two feet, but many monkeys said, "Our ancestors have always climbed, you are not allowed to stand!" Bite to death. Not only do they refuse to stand up, but they refuse to speak because it is old-fashioned. Humans are different, he finally stands up, speaks, and the result is that he wins. It's not over yet. Therefore, revolutions are not uncommon, and all nations that have not yet perished are still working hard to revolutionize every day, although they are often just small revolutions.大革命与文学有什么影响呢？大约可以分开三个时候来说:
What was the impact of the Revolution and literature? It can be said that it is about three times:（一）大革命之前，所有的文学，大抵是对于种种社会状态，觉得不平，觉得痛苦，就叫苦，鸣不平，在世界文学中关于这类的文学颇不少。但这些叫苦鸣不平的文学对于革命没有什么影响，因为叫苦鸣不平，并无力量，压迫你们的人仍然不理，老鼠虽然吱吱地叫，尽管叫出很好的文学，而猫儿吃起它来，还是不客气。所以仅仅有叫苦鸣不平的文学时，这个民族还没有希望，因为止于叫苦和鸣不平。例如人们打官司，失败的方面到了分发冤单的时候，对手就知道他没有力量再打官司，事情已经了结了；所以叫苦鸣不平的文学等于喊冤，压迫者对此倒觉得放心。有些民族因为叫苦无用，连苦也不叫了，他们便成为沉默的民族，渐渐更加衰颓下去，埃及，阿拉伯，波斯，印度就都没有什么声音了！至于富有反抗性，蕴有力量的民族，因为叫苦没用，他便觉悟起来，由哀音而变为怒吼。怒吼的文学一出现，反抗就快到了；他们已经很愤怒，所以与革命爆发时代接近的文学每每带有愤怒之音；他要反抗，他要复仇。苏俄革命将起时，即有些这类的文学。但也有例外，如波兰，虽然早有复仇的文学，然而他的恢复，是靠着欧洲大战的。
(1) Before the Great Revolution, all literature was mostly about various social conditions, feeling injustice and pain, complaining and complaining, and there were quite a lot of literature about this kind of literature in world literature. But these bitter literature have no impact on the revolution, because the bitter cry has no power, and the oppressors still ignore it, and although the mouse squeaks, although it calls out good literature, and the cat is still unpolite when it eats it. Therefore, when there is only literature that complains, this nation has no hope, because it only complains and complains. For example, when people file lawsuits, when the failed side distributes the wrongful claims, the opponent knows that he has no strength to fight the lawsuit again, and the matter is over; Therefore, literature that complains is tantamount to crying out for injustice, and the oppressor is relieved by this. Some peoples have become silent nations because they are useless and don't even cry out for suffering, and gradually decline even more, and Egypt, Arabia, Persia, and India have no voice! As for the rebellious and powerful nation, because it was useless to cry out, he became aware and changed from a mourning sound to a roar. As soon as roaring literature appears, resistance is coming; They are already very angry, so literature close to the era of revolution always has the sound of anger; He wants to resist, he wants revenge. When the Soviet Russian Revolution was about to begin, there was some such literature. But there are exceptions, such as Poland, although there has long been literature of revenge, but his recovery relied on the European war.（二）到了大革命的时代，文学没有了，没有声音了，因为大家受革命潮流的鼓荡，大家由呼喊而转入行动，大家忙着革命，没有闲空谈文学了。还有一层，是那时民生凋敝，一心寻面包吃尚且来不及，那里有心思谈文学呢？守旧的人因为受革命潮流的打击，气得发昏，也不能再唱所谓他们底文学了。有人说:“文学是穷苦的时候做的”，其实未必，穷苦的时候必定没有文学作品的；我在北京时，一穷，就到处借钱，不写一个字，到薪俸发放时，才坐下来做文章。忙的时候也必定没有文学作品，挑担的人必要把担子放下，才能做文章；拉车的人也必要把车子放下，才能做文章。大革命时代忙得很，同时又穷得很，这一部分人和那一部分人斗争，非先行变换现代社会底状态不可，没有时间也没有心思做文章；所以大革命时代的文学便只好暂归沉寂了。
(2) In the era of the Great Revolution, literature is gone, there is no voice, because everyone is agitated by the revolutionary trend, everyone turns from shouting to action, everyone is busy with the revolution, and there is no idle talk about literature. There is another layer, that at that time, people's livelihood was withering, and it was too late to find bread to eat, where was the mind to talk about literature? Conservatives are so angry that they can no longer sing their so-called literature because they are hit by the revolutionary trend. Some people say: "Literature is done when you are poor", but in fact, it is not necessarily, there must be no literary works when you are poor; When I was in Beijing, when I was poor, I borrowed money everywhere, didn't write a word, and only sat down to write an article when my salary was paid. When you are busy, there must be no literary works, and the person who carries the burden must put down the burden in order to make an article; The person pulling the car must also put the car down before he can make a fuss. The era of the Great Revolution was very busy and very poor at the same time, and this part of the people and that part of the struggle had to change the bottom state of modern society first, and they had no time or mind to make a fuss; Therefore, the literature of the revolutionary era had to be temporarily silent.（三）等到大革命成功后，社会底状态缓和了，大家底生活有余裕了，这时候就又产生文学。这时候底文学有二:一种文学是赞扬革命，称颂革命，——讴歌革命，因为进步的文学家想到社会改变，社会向前走，对于旧社会的破坏和新社会的建设，都觉得有意义，一方面对于旧制度的崩坏很高兴，一方面对于新的建设来讴歌。另有一种文学是吊旧社会的灭亡——挽歌——也是革命后会有的文学。有些的人以为这是“反革命的文学”，我想，倒也无须加以这么大的罪名。革命虽然进行，但社会上旧人物还很多，决不能一时变成新人物，他们的脑中满藏着旧思想旧东西；环境渐变，影响到他们自身的一切，于是回想旧时的舒服，便对于旧社会眷念不已，恋恋不舍，因而讲出很古的话，陈旧的话，形成这样的文学。这种文学都是悲哀的调子，表示他心里不舒服，一方面看见新的建设胜利了，一方面看见旧的制度灭亡了，所以唱起挽歌来。但是怀旧，唱挽歌，就表示已经革命了，如果没有革命，旧人物正得势，是不会唱挽歌的。
(3) After the success of the Great Revolution, the social situation eased and everyone had enough to live, and literature was produced at this time. At this time, there are two types of literature: one literature praises the revolution, praises the revolution,—— and praises the revolution, because progressive writers think of social change and society moving forward, and feel meaningful for the destruction of the old society and the construction of the new society. Another kind of literature is the demise of the old society - elegy - which is also the literature that will exist after the revolution. Some people think this is "counter-revolutionary literature", but I think there is no need to charge it with such a big crime. Although the revolution is underway, there are still many old figures in society, and they must not become new figures for a while, and their minds are full of old ideas and old things; The gradual change of the environment affects everything about themselves, so they recall the comfort of the old days, and they are nostalgic for the old society and are reluctant to give up, so they speak very ancient words, old words, and form such literature. This kind of literature is all sad tones, indicating that he is uncomfortable, on the one hand, he sees the victory of the new construction, and on the other hand, he sees the demise of the old system, so he sings elegies. But nostalgia and singing elegies means that there has been a revolution, and if there is no revolution, the old characters are in power and will not sing elegies.不过中国没有这两种文学——对旧制度挽歌，对新制度讴歌；因为中国革命还没有成功，正是青黄不接，忙于革命的时候。不过旧文学仍然很多，报纸上的文章，几乎全是旧式。我想，这足见中国革命对于社会没有多大的改变，对于守旧的人没有多大的影响，所以旧人仍能超然物外。广东报纸所讲的文学，都是旧的，新的很少，也可以证明广东社会没有受革命影响；没有对新的讴歌，也没有对旧的挽歌，广东仍然是十年前底广东。不但如此，并且也没有叫苦，没有鸣不平；止看见工会参加游行，但这是政府允许的，不是因压迫而反抗的，也不过是奉旨革命。中国社会没有改变，所以没有怀旧的哀词，也没有崭新的进行曲，只在苏俄却已产生了这两种文学。他们的旧文学家逃亡外国，所作的文学，多是吊亡挽旧的哀词；新文学则正在努力向前走，伟大的作品虽然还没有，但是新作品已不少，他们已经离开怒吼时期而过渡到讴歌的时期了。赞美建设是革命进行以后的影响，再往后去的情形怎样，现在不得而知，但推想起来，大约是平民文学罢，因为平民的世界，是革命的结果。
However, China does not have these two types of literature - an elegy for the old system and an ode to the new system; Because the Chinese revolution has not yet succeeded, it is the time when the youth and yellow are busy with the revolution. However, there is still a lot of old literature, and the articles in the newspapers are almost all old-fashioned. I think this shows that the Chinese revolution has not changed much in society and has not had much impact on the conservatives, so the old people can still be transcendent. The literature taught in Guangdong newspapers is all old and very new, which can also prove that Guangdong society was not affected by the revolution; There is no new eulogy, no elegy for the old, Guangdong is still Guangdong ten years ago. Not only that, but there was no complaint or complaint; I only saw the trade unions participating in the march, but this was allowed by the government, not because of oppression, but because of the revolution. Chinese society has not changed, so there are no nostalgic laments or new marches, but these two types of literature have been produced in Soviet Russia. Most of their old writers fled to foreign countries, and most of the literature they wrote was mostly lamentations for the dead; New literature is trying to move forward, although there are no great works yet, but there are many new works, and they have left the roaring period and transitioned to the period of eulogism. Praise construction is the influence of the revolution after it is carried out, and it is not known what will happen in the future, but it is inferred that it is probably civilian literature, because the world of the common people is the result of the revolution.现在中国自然没有平民文学，世界上也还没有平民文学，所有的文学，歌呀，诗呀，大抵是给上等人看的；他们吃饱了，睡在躺椅上，捧着看。一个才子出门遇见一个佳人，两个人很要好，有一个不才子从中捣乱，生出差迟来，但终于团圆了。这样地看看，多么舒服。或者讲上等人怎样有趣和快乐，下等人怎样可笑。前几年《新青年》载过几篇小说，描写罪人在寒地里的生活，大学教授看了就不高兴，因为他们不喜欢看这样的下流人。如果诗歌描写车夫，就是下流诗歌；一出戏里，有犯罪的事情，就是下流戏。他们的戏里的脚色，止有才子佳人，才子中状元，佳人封一品夫人，在才子佳人本身很欢喜，他们看了也很欢喜，下等人没奈何，也只好替他们一同欢喜欢喜。在现在，有人以平民——工人农民——为材料，做小说做诗，我们也称之为平民文学，其实这不是平民文学，因为平民还没有开口。这是另外的人从旁看见平民的生活，假托平民底口吻而说的。眼前的文人有些虽然穷，但总比工人农民富足些，这才能有钱去读书，才能有文章；一看好像是平民所说的，其实不是；这不是真的平民小说。平民所唱的山歌野曲，现在也有人写下来，以为是平民之音了，因为是老百姓所唱。但他们间接受古书的影响很大，他们对于乡下的绅士有田三千亩，佩服得不了，每每拿绅士的思想，做自己的思想，绅士们惯吟五言诗，七言诗；因此他们所唱的山歌野曲，大半也是五言或七言。这是就格律而言，还有构思取意，也是很陈腐的，不能称是真正的平民文学。现在中国底小说和诗实在比不上别国，无可奈何，只好称之曰文学；谈不到革命时代的文学，更谈不到平民文学。现在的文学家都是读书人，如果工人农民不解放，工人农民的思想，仍然是读书人的思想，必待工人农民得到真正的解放，然后才有真正的平民文学。有些人说:“中国已有平民文学”，其实这是不对的。
Now there is naturally no civilian literature in China, and there is no civilian literature in the world. They were full, slept on the lounge chairs, and held them up. A talented man went out to meet a beautiful woman, the two of them were very good, and an untalented man made trouble from it, and he was late on a business trip, but finally reunited. How comfortable it is to look at it this way. Or how interesting and happy the upper class is, and how ridiculous the lower class is. A few years ago, "New Youth" published several novels describing the life of sinners in cold places, and university professors were unhappy when they read it, because they didn't like to watch such vulgar people. If the poem describes the coachman, it is obscene poetry; In a play, if there is a crime, it is an obscene drama. In their plays, there are only talented beauties, talented champions, and beauties are named first-class ladies, and they are very happy to see them, and they are also very happy to see them. Nowadays, some people use civilians, workers and peasants, as materials to write novels and poems, which we also call civilian literature, but in fact, this is not civilian literature, because the common people have not yet opened their mouths. This is something that another person said by seeing the lives of civilians from the side, pretending to be a commoner. Although some of the literati in front of them are poor, they are always richer than the workers and peasants, so that they can have money to study and have articles; One looks like what the common people say, but it is not; This is not really civilian fiction. The folk songs and wild songs sung by the common people are now written down, thinking that they are the voices of the common people, because they are sung by the common people. But they were indirectly influenced by ancient books, they couldn't admire the gentlemen in the countryside who had 3,000 acres of land, and they often took the thoughts of gentlemen and did their own thoughts, and the gentlemen were accustomed to reciting five-character poems and seven-character poems; Therefore, most of the folk songs and wild songs they sing are also five or seven words. This is as far as the rhythm is concerned, and it is also very cliché, and it cannot be called true civilian literature. Nowadays, Chinese novels and poems are really not as good as other countries, so I have no choice but to call them literature; There is no talk of literature in the revolutionary era, let alone civilian literature. If the workers and peasants are not emancipated, the thoughts of the workers and peasants are still the thoughts of scholars, and they must wait for the workers and peasants to be truly liberated, and then there will be real civilian literature. Some people say: "China already has civilian literature", but this is not true.诸君是实际的战争者，是革命的战士，我以为现在还是不要佩服文学的好。学文学对于战争，没有益处，最好不过作一篇战歌，或者写得美的，便可于战余休憩时看看，倒也有趣。要讲得堂皇点，则譬如种柳树，待到柳树长大，浓阴蔽日，农夫耕作到正午，或者可以坐在柳树底下吃饭，休息休息。中国现在的社会情状，止有实地的革命战争，一首诗吓不走孙传芳，一炮就把孙传芳轰走了。自然也有人以为文学于革命是有伟力的，但我个人总觉得怀疑，文学总是一种余裕的产物，可以表示一民族的文化，倒是真的。
You are actual warners, revolutionary fighters, I think it's better not to admire literature now. Studying literature is not beneficial to war, it is best to write a war song, or write it beautifully, so you can read it when you rest after the war, which is also interesting. To be more grand, it is like planting willow trees, waiting until the willow trees grow up, the thick shade covers the sun, and the farmer works until noon, or you can sit under the willow tree to eat and rest. The current social situation in China is only a revolutionary war on the ground, and a poem cannot scare Sun Chuanfang away, and Sun Chuanfang is blown away with one shot. Naturally, some people think that literature has great power in revolution, but I personally always feel that literature is always a product of surplus, which can represent the culture of a nation, but it is true.人大概是不满于自己目前所做的事的，我一向只会做几篇文章，自己也做得厌了，而捏枪的诸君，却又要听讲文学。我呢，自然倒愿意听听大炮的声音，仿佛觉得大炮的声音或者比文学的声音要好听得多似的。我的演说只有这样多，感谢诸君听完的厚意！
People are probably dissatisfied with what they are doing so far, I have always only done a few articles, and I am tired of doing it, but the gentlemen who hold guns have to listen to literature. As for me, I am naturally willing to listen to the sound of cannons, as if I think the sound of cannons may be much better than the sound of literature. There are only so many of my speeches, thank you all for your kindness!

写在《劳动问题》之前

写在《劳动问题》之前

写在《劳动问题》之前

Written before "Labor Issues"还记得去年夏天住在北京的时候，遇见张我权君，听到他说过这样意思的话:“中国人似乎都忘记了台湾了，谁也不大提起。”他是一个台湾的青年。
I still remember when I lived in Beijing last summer, I met Zhang Wo Quanjun and heard him say something like this: "Chinese seem to have forgotten Taiwan, and no one mentions it." He is a young man from Taiwan.我当时就像受了创痛似的，有点苦楚；但口上却道:“不。那倒不至于的。只因为本国太破烂，内忧外患，非常之多，自顾不暇了，所以只能将台湾这些事情暂且放下。……”
I was in a bit of pain as if I had been wounded; But he said, "No." That's not the case. Just because the country is too tattered, there are many internal and external troubles, and there are too many to take care of itself, so I can only put these things in Taiwan aside for the time being. ……”但正在困苦中的台湾的青年，却并不将中国的事情暂且放下。他们常希望中国革命的成功，赞助中国的改革，总想尽些力，于中国的现在和将来有所裨益，即使是自己还在做学生。
But the young people in Taiwan who are in distress do not put aside China's affairs for the time being. They often hope for the success of the Chinese revolution, sponsor China's reforms, and always want to do their best to benefit China now and in the future, even if they are still students.张秀哲君是我在广州才遇见的。我们谈了几回，知道他已经译成一部《劳动问题》给中国，还希望我做一点简短的序文。我是不善于作序，也不赞成作序的；况且对于劳动问题，一无所知，尤其没有开口的资格。我所能负责说出来的，不过是张君于中日两国的文字，俱极精通，译文定必十分可靠这一点罢了。
Zhang Xiuzhe Jun was only met in Guangzhou. We talked a few times, and I knew that he had translated a "Labor Problem" for China, and he wanted me to make a short preface. I am not good at writing prefaces, and I do not approve of prefaces; Moreover, he knew nothing about labor issues, especially not qualified to speak. All I can say is that Zhang Jun is very proficient in both Chinese and Japanese writings, and the translation must be very reliable.但我这回却很愿意写几句话在这一部译本之前，只要我能够。我虽然不知道劳动问题，但译者在游学中尚且为民众尽力的努力与诚意，我是觉得的。
But this time I am willing to write a few words before this translation, as long as I can. Although I don't know about labor issues, I feel that the translator still does his best for the people during his study tour.我只能以这几句话表出我个人的感激。但我相信，这努力与诚意，读者也一定都会觉得的。这实在比无论什么序文都有力。
I can only express my personal gratitude in these few words. But I believe that readers will definitely feel this effort and sincerity. This is really more powerful than any preface.一九二七年四月十一日，鲁迅识于广州中山大学。
On April 11, 1927, Lu Xun met at Sun Yat-sen University in Guangzhou.

略谈香港

略谈香港

略谈香港

A little talk about Hong Kong本年一月间我曾去过一回香港，因为跌伤的脚还未全好，不能到街上去闲走，演说一了，匆匆便归，印象淡薄得很，也早已忘却了香港了。今天看见《语丝》一三七期上辰江先生的通信，忽又记得起来，想说几句话来凑热闹。
I went back to Hong Kong once in January this year, because my injured foot was not fully healed, and I couldn't go to the street to walk around. Today I saw Mr. Chenjiang's correspondence in the 137th issue of "Yusi", and suddenly remembered it again and wanted to say a few words to join in the fun.我去讲演的时候，主持其事的人大约很受了许多困难，但我都不大清楚。单知道先是颇遭干涉，中途又有反对者派人索取入场券，收藏起来，使别人不能去听；后来又不许将讲稿登报，经交涉的结果，是削去和改窜了许多。
When I went to give a lecture, the person who presided over the lecture must have suffered a lot, but I didn't know much about it. I know that I was interfered with at first, and in the middle, some opponents sent people to ask for admission tickets and collect them so that others could not listen to them; Later, it was not allowed to publish the speech in the newspaper, and as a result of negotiations, it was cut and changed a lot.然而我的讲演，真是“老生常谈”，而且还是七八年前的“常谈”。
However, my speech is really a "cliché", and it is still a "cliché" seven or eight years ago.从广州往香港时，在船上还亲自遇见一桩笑话。有一个船员，不知怎地，是知道我的名字的，他给我十分担心。他以为我的赴港，说不定会遭谋害；我遥遥地跑到广东来教书，而无端横死，他——广东人之一——也觉得抱歉。于是他忙了一路，替我计画，禁止上陆时如何脱身，到埠捕拿时如何避免。到埠后，既不禁止，也不捕拿，而他还不放心，临别时再三叮嘱，说倘有危险，可以避到什么地方去。
When I traveled from Guangzhou to Hong Kong, I personally encountered a joke on the boat. There was a crew member who, somehow, knew my name, was very worried about me. He thought that if I went to Hong Kong, I might be murdered; I ran to Guangdong to teach, and he died for no reason, and he, one of the Cantonese people, also felt sorry. So he was busy all the way, planning for me how to get out when I was prohibited from landing, and how to avoid it when I went to the port to catch him. After arriving at the port, neither prohibition nor arrest, and he was still not at ease, and when he parted, he repeatedly told him that if there was danger, he could avoid somewhere.我虽然觉得可笑，但我从真心里十分感谢他的好心，记得他的认真的脸相。
Although I think it's ridiculous, I sincerely thank him for his kindness and remember his serious face.三天之后，平安地出了香港了，不过因为攻击国粹，得罪了若干人。现在回想起来，像我们似的人，大危险是大概没有的。不过香港总是一个畏途。这用小事情便可以证明。即如今天的香港《循环日报》上，有这样两条琐事:
Three days later, he left Hong Kong safely, but because of the attack on the quintessence of the country, he offended several people. Looking back now, people like us probably don't have any great dangers. But Hong Kong is always a daunting road. This can be proven by small things. For example, in today's Hong Kong "Circulation Daily", there are two trivial matters:▲陈国被控窃去芜湖街一百五十七号地下布裤一条，昨由史司判笞十二藤云。
Chen Guo was charged with stealing a pair of cloth pants from the basement of 157 Wuhu Street, and was sentenced yesterday by the Historical Division to 12 lashes.▲昨晚夜深，石塘嘴有两西装男子，……遇一英警上前执行搜身。该西装男子用英语对之。该英警不理会，且警以□□□。于是双方缠上警署。……
▲Late last night, there were two men in suits in Shitangzui,...... A British police officer stepped forward to conduct a body search. The man in the suit spoke in English. The British police ignored the meeting and warned that they were □□□. So the two sides got entangled in the police station. ……第一条我们一目了然，知道中国人还在那里被抽藤条。“司”当是“藩司”“臬司”之“司”，是官名；史者，姓也，英国人的。港报上所谓“政府”，“警司”之类，往往是指英国的而言，不看惯的很容易误解，不如上海称为“捕房”之分明。
The first one is clear to us at a glance, knowing that the Chinese are still being drawn there. "Si" should be the "Si" of "Fan Si" and "Jian Si", which is the official name; Historian is a surname, British. The so-called "government" and "superintendent" in Hong Kong newspapers often refer to the United Kingdom, and it is easy to misunderstand if you are not used to it, and it is not as clear as Shanghai calling it a "arrest room".第二条是“搜身”的纠葛，在香港屡见不鲜。但三个方围不知道是甚么。何以要避忌？恐怕不是好的事情。这□□□似乎是因为西装和英语而得的；英警嫌恶这两件:这是主人的言语和服装。颜之推以为学鲜卑语，弹琵琶便可以生存的时代，早已过去了。
The second is the entanglement of "body search", which is not uncommon in Hong Kong. But I don't know what the three square circles are. Why should we avoid taboos? I'm afraid it's not a good thing. The □□□ seems to have been obtained because of the suit and English; The British police hated these two things: these were the words and clothing of the owner. Yan Zhitui thought that the era when learning Xianbei language and playing the pipa could survive has long passed.在香港时遇见一位某君，是受了高等教育的人。他自述曾因受屈，向英官申辩，英官无话可说了，但他还是输。那最末是得到严厉的训斥，道:“总之是你错的:因为我说你错！”
When I was in Hong Kong, I met a certain gentleman, who was a highly educated person. He said that he had defended the British official because he was wronged, and the British official had nothing to say, but he still lost. In the end, he was severely reprimanded, saying, "In short, you are wrong: because I say you are wrong!"带着书籍的人也困难，因为一不小心，会被指为“危险文件”的。这“危险”的界说，我不知其详。总之一有嫌疑，便麻烦了。人先关起来，书去译成英文，译好之后，这才审判。而这“译成英文”的事先就可怕。我记得蒙古人“入主中夏”时，裁判就用翻译。一个和尚去告状追债，而债户商同通事，将他的状子改成自愿焚身了。官说道好；于是这和尚便被推入烈火中。我去讲演的时候也偶然提起元朝，听说颇为“X司”所不悦，他们是的确在研究中国的经史的。
It is also difficult for people with books, because if they are not careful, they will be accused of being "dangerous documents". I don't know the details of this "dangerous" world. In short, if there is suspicion, it will be troublesome. People are locked up first, and the book is translated into English, and then it is judged. And this "translation into English" is terrible in advance. I remember that when the Mongols "entered China", the referees used translations. A monk went to sue to collect debts, and the creditor merchant and the interpreter changed his petition to voluntarily burn himself. The official said yes; So the monk was pushed into the fire. When I went to give a lecture, I also accidentally mentioned the Yuan Dynasty, and I heard that the "X Division" was quite displeased, and they were indeed studying China's classics and history.但讲讲元朝，不但为“政府”的“X司”所不悦，且亦为有些“同胞”所不欢。我早知道不稳当，总要受些报应的。果然，我因为谨避“学者”，搬出中山大学之后，那边的《工商报》上登出来了，说是因为“清党”，已经逃走。后来，则在《循环日报》上，以讲文学为名，提起我的事，说我原是“《晨报副刊》特约撰述员”，现在则“到了汉口”。我知道这种宣传有点危险，意在说我先是研究系的好友，现是共产党的同道，虽不至于“枪终路寝”，益处大概总不会有的，晦气点还可以因此被关起来。便写了一封信去更正:
But talking about the Yuan Dynasty, it was not only disliked by the "X Division" of the "government", but also disliked by some "compatriots". I knew that if I was unstable, I would always suffer some retribution. Sure enough, because I was careful to avoid "scholars", after I moved out of Sun Yat-sen University, the "Industrial and Commercial Daily" over there published it, saying that it was because of the "Qing Party" and had fled. Later, in the "Circulation Daily", in the name of talking about literature, he mentioned my matter, saying that I was originally a "special writer of the "Morning News Supplement", and now I "went to Hankou". I know that this kind of propaganda is a bit dangerous, which means that I was a friend of the research department and now a colleague of the Communist Party. So he wrote a letter to correct it:“在六月十日十一日两天的《循环世界》里，看见徐丹甫先生的一篇《北京文艺界之分门别户》。各人各有他的眼光，心思，手段。他耍他的，我不想来多嘴。但其中有关于我的三点，我自己比较的清楚些，可以请为更正，即:
In the two-day "Circular World" on June 10 and 11, I saw Mr. Xu Danfu's article "The Division of Beijing's Literary and Art Circles". Everyone has their own vision, mind, and means. He plays with him, I don't want to talk too much. But there are three points about me, which I am clearer and can be corrected, namely:“一，我从来没有做过《晨报副刊》的‘特约撰述员’。
"First, I have never been a 'special writer' for the Morning News Supplement.“二，陈大悲被攻击后，我并未停止投稿。
"Second, after Chen Dabei was attacked, I did not stop contributing.“三，我现仍在广州，并没有‘到了汉口’。”
"Third, I am still in Guangzhou and have not 'arrived in Hankou'."从发信之日到今天，算来恰恰一个月，不见登出来。“总之你是这样的:因为我说你是这样”罢。幸而还有内地的《语丝》；否则，“十二藤”，“□□□”，那里去诉苦！
From the date of the letter to today, it has been exactly a month, and it has not been published. "In short, you are like this: because I say you are like this." Fortunately, there is also the mainland's "Yusi"; Otherwise, "Twelve vines", "□□□", go there to complain!我观在还有时记起那一位船上的广东朋友，虽然神经过敏，但怕未必是无病呻吟。他经验多。
I still remember the Guangdong friend on the boat, although he was nervous, but I was afraid that he might not be moaning without illness. He has a lot of experience.若夫“香江”（案:盖香港之雅称）之于国粹，则确是正在大振兴而特振兴。如六月二十五日《循环日报》“昨日下午督宪府茶会”条下，就说:
As for "Hong Kong" (case: the elegant name of Hong Kong), it is indeed undergoing great revitalization and special revitalization. Brief Note:这里的括弧，间亦以代曲钩之用。爵绅盖有爵的绅士，不知其详。呢＝这。而家＝而今。嘅＝的。系＝是。唔＝无，不。哓＝了。同埋＝和。咩＝呢。啫＝呵。唔哙有乜野＝不会有什么。嚟＝来。过＝给。话＝说。
The parentheses here are sometimes used to replace curved hooks. The noble gentleman is a gentleman with a title, but the details are unknown. What = this. Now = now. of = of . Yes = Yes. No = no, no. Wow = done. And = and. What = what. Just = huh. Something=nothing. Come = come. Pass = give. words = words.注毕不免又要发感慨了。《汉风杂志》我没有拜读过；但我记得一点旧事。前清光绪末年，我在日本东京留学，亲自看见的。那时的留学生中，很有一部分抱着革命的思想，而所谓革命者，其实是种族革命，要将土地从异族的手里取得，归还旧主人。除实行的之外，有些人是办报，有些人是钞旧书。所钞的大抵是中国所没有的禁书，所讲的大概是明末清初的情形，可以使青年猛省的。久之印成了一本书，因为是《湖北学生界》的特刊，所以名曰《汉声》，那封面上就题着四句古语:摅怀旧之蓄念，发思古之幽情，光祖宗之玄灵，振大汉之天声！
After the note, I can't help but sigh again. I have not read "Hanfeng Magazine"; But I remember a little bit of old things. At the end of the Guangxu period of the former Qing Dynasty, I studied in Tokyo, Japan, and saw it with my own eyes. At that time, a large part of the international students held revolutionary ideas, and the so-called revolutionaries were actually racial revolutions, who wanted to take land from foreign races and return it to their old masters. In addition to the practice, some people run newspapers, and some people are old books. Most of the banknotes are banned books that China does not have, and what they are talking about is probably the situation in the late Ming and early Qing dynasties, which can make young people save a lot. After a long time, it was printed into a book, because it was a special issue of "Hubei Student Circle", so it was called "Hansheng", and the cover was inscribed with four ancient sayings: nostalgic thoughts, thinking about the deep feelings of the ancients, glorifying the mysterious spirit of the ancestors, and revitalizing the heavenly voice of the Han Dynasty!这是明明白白，叫我们想想汉族繁荣时代，和现状比较一下，看是如何，——必须“光复旧物”。说得露骨些，就是“排满”；推而广之，就是“排外”。不料二十年后，竟变成在香港大学保存国粹，而使“中外感情，自然更加浓浃”的标语了。我实在想不到这四句“集《文选》句”，竟也会被外国人所引用。
This is clear, asking us to think about the era of Han prosperity and compare it with the current situation to see how ,—— must "restore the old things". To put it more explicitly, it is "full"; By extension, it is "xenophobia". Unexpectedly, twenty years later, it became the slogan of preserving the essence of the country at the University of Hong Kong, making "Chinese and foreign feelings naturally stronger". I really didn't expect that these four sentences of "Selected Writings" would also be quoted by foreigners.这样的感慨，在现今的中国，发起来是可以发不完的。还不如讲点有趣的事做收梢，算是“余兴”。从予先生在《一般》杂志（目录上说是独逸）上批评我的小说道:“作者的笔锋……并且颇多诙谐的意味，所以有许多小说，人家看了，只觉得发松可笑。换言之，即因为此故，至少是使读者减却了不少对人生的认识。”悲夫，这“只觉得”也！但我也确有这种的毛病，什么事都不能正正经经。便是感慨，也不肯一直发到底。只是我也自有我的苦衷。因为整年的发感慨，倘是假的，岂非无聊？倘真，则我早已感愤而死了，那里还有议论。我想，活着而想称“烈士”，究竟是不容易的。
Such feelings can be endlessly expressed in today's China. It's better to talk about something interesting to finish off, which can be regarded as "afterfun". Mr. Yu criticized my novel in "General" magazine (the catalog says it is unique): "The author's pen is sharp...... And there are a lot of humorous meanings, so there are many novels, and people only feel ridiculous when they read them. In other words, because of this, at least the reader has reduced a lot of understanding of life. "Sad man, this "only feels" too! But I do have this problem, I can't take anything seriously. Even if he is emotional, he refuses to send it to the end. It's just that I have my own difficulties. Because of the emotion of the whole year, if it is fake, isn't it boring? If it is true, then I would have died of anger, and there is still discussion there. I think it is not easy to live and want to be called a "martyr".我以为有趣，想要介绍的也不过是一个广告。港报上颇多特别的广告，而这一个最奇。我第一天看《循环日报》，便在第一版上看见的了，此后每天必见，我每见必要想一想，而直到今天终于想不通是怎么一回事：
I thought it was interesting, but what I wanted to introduce was nothing more than an advertisement. There are many special advertisements in Hong Kong newspapers, and this one is the most strange. I read the "Circulation Daily" on the first day, and I saw it on the first page, and I have to see it every day since then, and I have to think about it every time I see it, and until today I finally can't figure out what is going on:
