读书杂谈　——七月十六日在广州知用中学讲

读书杂谈Reading and Miscellaneous Talk ——七月十六日在广州知用中学讲 - Lecture at Guangzhou Zhiyong Middle School on July 16
因为知用中学的先生们希望我来演讲一回，所以今天到这里和诸君相见。不过我也没有什么东西可讲。忽而想到学校是读书的所在，就随便谈谈读书。是我个人的意见，姑且供诸君的参考，其实也算不得什么演讲。
Because the gentlemen of Zhiyong Middle School want me to give a speech, I am here to meet you today. But I don't have anything to say. Suddenly I thought that school was where reading was placed, so I just talked about reading. It is my personal opinion, for your reference, in fact, it is not a speech.说到读书，似乎是很明白的事，只要拿书来读就是了，但是并不这样简单。至少，就有两种：一是职业的读书，一是嗜好的读书。所谓职业的读书者，譬如学生因为升学，教员因为要讲功课，不翻翻书，就有些危险的就是。我想在坐的诸君之中一定有些这样的经验，有的不喜欢算学，有的不喜欢博物，然而不得不学，否则，不能毕业，不能升学，和将来的生计便有妨碍了。我自己也这样，因为做教员，有时即非看不喜欢看的书不可，要不这样，怕不久便会于饭碗有妨。我们习惯了，一说起读书，就觉得是高尚的事情，其实这样的读书，和木匠的磨斧头，裁缝的理针线并没有什么分别，并不见得高尚，有时还很苦痛，很可怜。你爱做的事，偏不给你做，你不爱做的，倒非做不可。这是由于职业和嗜好不能合一而来的。倘能够大家去做爱做的事，而仍然各有饭吃，那是多么幸福。但现在的社会上还做不到，所以读书的人们的最大部分，大概是勉勉强强的，带着苦痛的为职业的读书。
When it comes to reading, it seems to be very clear, as long as you take a book to read, but it is not that simple. At least, there are two kinds: one is professional reading, and the other is hobby reading. The so-called professional readers, such as students because they go on to higher education, and teachers do not turn books because they have to do their homework, which is a bit dangerous. I think some of you must have had this experience, some don't like arithmetic, some don't like natural history, but they have to learn, otherwise, they can't graduate, they can't go on to higher education, and their future livelihood will be hindered. I am like this myself, because as a teacher, sometimes I have to read books that I don't like, otherwise I am afraid that it will soon be a hindrance to my job. We are used to it, when we talk about reading, we think it is a noble thing, in fact, this kind of reading is no different from a carpenter's sharpening of an axe or a tailor's needle and thread, it is not necessarily noble, sometimes it is very painful, very pitiful. What you love to do, but not for you, what you don't like to do, you have to do it. This is due to the fact that professions and hobbies cannot be united. How happy it would be if everyone could do what they love and still have their own food. But it is not possible in today's society, so the biggest part of people who read are probably reluctantly and painfully reading for their careers.现在再讲嗜好的读书罢。那是出于自愿，全不勉强，离开了利害关系的。——我想，嗜好的读书，该如爱打牌的一样，天天打，夜夜打，连续的去打，有时被公安局捉去了，放出来之后还是打。诸君要知道真打牌的人的目的并不在赢钱，而在有趣。牌有怎样的有趣呢，我是外行，不大明白。但听得爱赌的人说，它妙在一张一张的摸起来，永远变化无穷。我想，凡嗜好的读书，能够手不释卷的原因也就是这样。他在每一叶每一叶里，都得着深厚的趣味。自然，也可以扩大精神，增加智识的，但这些倒都不计及，一计及，便等于意在赢钱的博徒了，这在博徒之中，也算是下品。
Now let's talk about reading as a hobby. It was voluntary, not forced, and left the stakes. ——I think that reading as a hobby should be like a person who loves to play cards, playing every day, night at night, and continuously. You must know that the purpose of real card players is not to win money, but to have fun. What kind of fun is the card, I am a layman and don't understand it. But I heard people who love gambling say that the beauty of it is that it is touched one by one, and it is always changing. I think this is the reason why anyone who likes to read can never put down the book. In every leaf, he gets a deep interest. Naturally, you can also expand your spirit and increase your intellect, but these are not taken into account, and once you take them into account, they are equivalent to gamblers who intend to win, which is also considered inferior among gamblers.不过我的意思，并非说诸君应该都退了学，去看自己喜欢看的书去，这样的时候还没有到来；也许终于不会到，至多，将来可以设法使人们对于非做不可的事发生较多的兴味罢了。我现在是说，爱看书的青年，大可以看看本分以外的书，即课外的书，不要只将课内的书抱住。但请不要误解，我并非说，譬如在国文讲堂上，应该在抽屉里暗看《红楼梦》之类；乃是说，应做的功课已完而有余暇，大可以看看各样的书，即使和本业毫不相干的，也要泛览。譬如学理科的，偏看看文学书，学文学的，偏看看科学书，看看别个在那里研究的，究竟是怎么一回事。这样子，对于别人，别事，可以有更深的了解。现在中国有一个大毛病，就是人们大概以为自己所学的一门是最好，最妙，最要紧的学问，而别的都无用，都不足道的，弄这些不足道的东西的人，将来该当饿死。其实是，世界还没有如此简单，学问都各有用处，要定什么是头等还很难。也幸而有各式各样的人，假如世界上全是文学家，到处所讲的不是“文学的分类”便是“诗之构造”，那倒反而无聊得很了。
But what I mean is that you should all drop out of school and go to read your favorite books, because the time has not yet come; It may not come in the end, at most, in the future we can try to make people more interested in what they have to do. I am now saying that young people who love to read can read books outside of their duty, that is, books outside of class, and not just hold on to books in class. But please don't get me wrong, I'm not saying, for example, in the Chinese lecture hall, you should secretly read "Dream of Red Mansions" in the drawer; It means that when the homework that should be done is completed and there is leisure, you can read all kinds of books, even if they have nothing to do with your own business. For example, those who study science look at literature books, those who study literature, and those who study science books look at other people who study there. In this way, you can have a deeper understanding of others and other things. Now there is a big problem in China, that is, people probably think that what they have learned is the best, the best, and the most important knowledge, while nothing else is useless and useless. In fact, the world is not so simple, knowledge is useful, and it is difficult to determine what is first-class. Fortunately, there are all kinds of people, if the world is full of writers, and it is not "the classification of literature" or "the structure of poetry" everywhere, it will be very boring.不过以上所说的，是附带而得的效果，嗜好的读书，本人自然并不计及那些，就如游公园似的，随随便便去，因为随随便便，所以不吃力，因为不吃力，所以会觉得有趣。如果一本书拿到手，就满心想道，“我在读书了！”“我在用功了！”那就容易疲劳，因而减掉兴味，或者变成苦事了。
However, what is said above is an incidental effect, hobby reading, I naturally don't take into account those, just like visiting a park, just go casually, because it's casual, so it's not difficult, because it's not hard, so it will be interesting. If you get a book, you will be full of thoughts, "I'm reading!" "I'm working hard!" Then it is easy to get tired, so it loses interest or becomes a hard work.我看现在的青年，为兴味的读书的是有的，我也常常遇到各样的询问。此刻就将我所想到的说一点，但是只限于文学方面，因为我不明白其他的。
I see that there are young people today who read for interest, and I often encounter all kinds of inquiries. At this moment, I will say a little bit of what I think, but only in terms of literature, because I don't understand anything else.第一，是往往分不清文学和文章。甚至于已经来动手做批评文章的，也免不了这毛病。其实粗粗的说，这是容易分别的。研究文章的历史或理论的，是文学家，是学者；做做诗，或戏曲小说的，是做文章的人，就是古时候所谓文人，此刻所谓创作家。创作家不妨毫不理会文学史或理论，文学家也不妨做不出一句诗。然而中国社会上还很误解，你做几篇小说，便以为你一定懂得小说概论，做几句新诗，就要你讲诗之原理。我也尝见想做小说的青年，先买小说法程和文学史来看。据我看来，是即使将这些书看烂了，和创作也没有什么关系的。
First, it is often difficult to distinguish between literature and literature. Even those who have already come to do critical articles are inevitable to this problem. In fact, roughly speaking, this is easy to distinguish. those who study the history or theory of articles are writers and scholars; Those who write poetry or opera novels are the people who make articles, the so-called literati in ancient times, and the so-called creators at this moment. Creators may wish to ignore literary history or theory, and writers may not be able to write a single poem. However, there is still a misunderstanding in Chinese society, you make a few novels, you think you must understand the introduction to novels, and if you make a few new poems, you will be asked to talk about the principles of poetry. I have also seen young people who want to write novels, and first buy novels and literary history to read. In my opinion, even if you read these books badly, it has nothing to do with creation.事实上，现在有几个做文章的人，有时也确去做教授。但这是因为中国创作不值钱，养不活自己的缘故。听说美国小名家的一篇中篇小说，时价是二千美金；中国呢，别人我不知道，我自己的短篇寄给大书铺，每篇卖过二十元。当然要寻别的事，例如教书，讲文学。研究是要用理智，要冷静的，而创作须情感，至少总得发点热，于是忽冷忽热，弄得头昏，——这也是职业和嗜好不能合一的苦处。苦倒也罢了，结果还是什么都弄不好。那证据，是试翻世界文学史，那里面的人，几乎没有兼做教授的。
In fact, there are a few people who make articles now, and sometimes they do become professors. But this is because Chinese creation is worthless and cannot support itself. I heard that a novella by a famous American artist is priced at $2,000; What about China, I don't know others, my own short stories are sent to big bookstores, and each one sells for 20 yuan. Of course, you have to look for other things, such as teaching and teaching literature. Research is to use reason and calmness, and creation must be emotional, at least it must be a little hot, so it is hot and cold, making you dizzy,—— which is also the pain of not being able to unite professions and hobbies. It's just bitter, but I can't get anything right. The evidence is to try to read the history of world literature, and there are almost no people who are also professors.还有一种坏处，是一做教员，未免有顾忌；教授有教授的架子，不能畅所欲言。这或者有人要反驳：那么，你畅所欲言就是了，何必如此小心。然而这是事前的风凉话，一到有事，不知不觉地他也要从众来攻击的。而教授自身，纵使自以为怎样放达，下意识里总不免有架子在。所以在外国，称为“教授小说”的东西倒并不少，但是不大有人说好，至少，是总难免有令人发烦的炫学的地方。
Another disadvantage is that once you become a teacher, you will inevitably have scruples; The professor has the shelf of a professor and cannot speak freely. This may be something that someone wants to refute: then, you can just speak freely, why be so careful. However, this is a sarcastic remark in advance, and when something happens, he will unknowingly attack from the crowd. And the professor himself, no matter how he thinks he is open, subconsciously there will always be a shelf. Therefore, in foreign countries, there are not many things called "professor novels", but not many people say that it is good, at least, there are always annoying places to show off their learning.所以我想，研究文学是一件事，做文章又是一件事。
So I think studying literature is one thing, and writing articles is another.第二，我常被询问：要弄文学，应该看什么书？这实在是一个极难回答的问题。先前也曾有几位先生给青年开过一大篇书目。但从我看来，这是没有什么用处的，因为我觉得那都是开书目的先生自己想要看或者未必想要看的书目。我以为倘要弄旧的呢，倒不如姑且靠着张之洞的《书目答问》去摸门径去。倘是新的，研究文学，则自己先看看各种的小本子，如本间久雄的《新文学概论》，厨川白村的《苦闷的象征》，瓦浪斯基们的《苏俄的文艺论战》之类，然后自己再想想，再博览下去。因为文学的理论不像算学，二二一定得四，所以议论很纷歧。如第三种，便是俄国的两派的争论，——我附带说一句，近来听说连俄国的小说也不大有人看了，似乎一看见“俄”字就吃惊，其实苏俄的新创作何尝有人绍介，此刻译出的几本，都是革命前的作品，作者在那边都已经被看作反革命的了。倘要看看文艺作品呢，则先看几种名家的选本，从中觉得谁的作品自己最爱看，然后再看这一个作者的专集，然后再从文学史上看看他在史上的位置；倘要知道得更详细，就看一两本这人的传记，那便可以大略了解了。如果专是请教别人，则各人的嗜好不同，总是格不相入的。
Second, I am often asked: What books should I read if I want to get literature? This is a very difficult question to answer. Several gentlemen have also opened a large bibliography to young people before. But from my point of view, this is useless, because I think they are all bibliographies that the teacher who opened the bibliography wants to read or may not want to read. I thought that if I wanted to get an old one, it would be better to rely on Zhang Zhidong's "Bibliographic Q&A" to find the door. If it is new and studies literature, you should first read various small books, such as Hisao Honma's "Introduction to New Literature", Kurukawa Shiramura's "Symbol of Distress", Wallansky's "Literary and Art Debate in Soviet Russia", etc., and then think about it yourself and then read it again. Because the theory of literature is not like arithmetic, two two must be four, so the discussion is very diverse. As for the third type, it is the dispute between the two factions in Russia,—— I will add that recently I heard that even Russian novels are not read by many people, and it seems that they are surprised when they see the word "Russia". If you want to look at literary and artistic works, you should first look at the selections of several famous writers, from which you think whose work you like the most, then read the special collection of this author, and then look at his position in history from the history of literature; If you want to know more details, just read one or two biographies of this person, then you can get a rough understanding. If you only ask others for advice, then everyone's hobbies are different and always incompatible.第三，说几句关于批评的事。现在因为出版物太多了，——其实有什么呢，而读者因为不胜其纷纭，便渴望批评，于是批评家也便应运而起。批评这东西，对于读者，至少对于和这批评家趣旨相近的读者，是有用的。但中国现在，似乎应该暂作别论。往往有人误以为批评家对于创作是操生杀之权，占文坛的最高位的，就忽而变成批评家；他的灵魂上挂了刀。但是怕自己的立论不周密，便主张主观，有时怕自己的观察别人不看重，又主张客观；有时说自己的作文的根柢全是同情，有时将校对者骂得一文不值。凡中国的批评文字，我总是越看越胡涂，如果当真，就要无路可走。印度人是早知道的，有一个很普通的比喻。他们说：一个老翁和一个孩子用一匹驴子驮着货物去出卖，货卖去了，孩子骑驴回来，老翁跟着走。但路人责备他了，说是不晓事，叫老年人徒步。他们便换了一个地位，而旁人又说老人忍心；老人忙将孩子抱到鞍鞒上，后来看见的人却说他们残酷；于是都下来，走了不久，可又有人笑他们了，说他们是呆子，空着现成的驴子却不骑。于是老人对孩子叹息道，我们只剩了一个办法了，是我们两人抬着驴子走。无论读，无论做，倘若旁征博访，结果是往往会弄到抬驴子走的。
Third, say a few words about criticism. Now because there are too many publications,—— what is actually there, and readers are eager to criticize because they are overwhelmed, so critics have emerged. Criticism is useful for readers, at least for readers who are similar to the critic's purpose. But now, it seems that China should put aside the discussion for a while. Often some people mistakenly think that critics have the right to control life and death for creation, and those who occupy the highest position in the literary world suddenly become critics; A knife hung on his soul. but they are afraid that their own arguments are not thorough, so they advocate subjectivity, and sometimes they are afraid that others will not value their own observations, and they advocate objectivity; Sometimes he says that his composition is all sympathy, and sometimes he scolds the proofreader as worthless. The more I read Chinese criticism, the more nonsense I get, and if I take it seriously, I will have no way out. Indians have long known that there is a very common metaphor. They said: An old man and a child used a donkey to carry the goods to sell, the goods were sold, the child rode back on a donkey, and the old man followed. But passers-by blamed him, saying that he didn't know what was going on, and asked the elderly to hike. They changed their status, and others said that the old man was patient; The old man hurriedly carried the child to the saddle, but the people who saw it later said that they were cruel; So they all came down and walked for a while, but some people laughed at them again, saying that they were fools, and they didn't ride empty ready-made donkeys. So the old man sighed to the child and said, we only have one way left, which is for the two of us to carry the donkey. No matter how you read or do, if you look around, the result is often to carry a donkey.不过我并非要大家不看批评，不过说看了之后，仍要看看本书，自己思索，自己做主。看别的书也一样，仍要自己思索，自己观察。倘只看书，便变成书厨，即使自己觉得有趣，而那趣味其实是已在逐渐硬化，逐渐死去了。我先前反对青年躲进研究室，也就是这意思，至今有些学者，还将这话算作我的一条罪状哩。
However, I don't want everyone to stop reading criticism, but after reading it, they still have to read this book, think for themselves, and make their own decisions. The same goes for reading other books, you still have to think and observe by yourself. If you only read books, you will become a book chef, even if you find it interesting, but that interest is actually gradually hardening and gradually dying. I used to oppose young people hiding in the research room, which is what it means, and some scholars still count this as one of my crimes.听说英国的培那特萧（Bernard Shaw），有过这样意思的话：世间最不行的是读书者。因为他只能看别人的思想艺术，不用自己。这也就是勖本华尔（Schopenhauer）之所谓脑子里给别人跑马。较好的是思索者。因为能用自己的生活力了，但还不免是空想，所以更好的是观察者，他用自己的眼睛去读世间这一部活书。
I heard that Bernard Shaw in England once said this: The worst thing in the world is a reader. Because he can only look at other people's thoughts and art, not himself. This is what Schopenhauer called running horses for others in his head. The better ones are thinkers. Because he can use his own life force, but it is inevitable that it is a fantasy, so it is better to be an observer, who uses his own eyes to read this living book in the world.这是的确的，实地经验总比看，听，空想确凿。我先前吃过干荔支，罐头荔支，陈年荔支，并且由这些推想过新鲜的好荔支。这回吃过了，和我所猜想的不同，非到广东来吃就永不会知道。但我对于萧的所说，还要加一点骑墙的议论。萧是爱尔兰人，立论也不免有些偏激的。我以为假如从广东乡下找一个没有历练的人，叫他从上海到北京或者什么地方，然后问他观察所得，我恐怕是很有限的，因为他没有练习过观察力。所以要观察，还是先要经过思索和读书。
This is true, field experience is better than seeing, listening, and fantasizing. I have eaten dried lychees, canned lychees, and aged lychees before, and I have inferred from these that fresh and good lychees. I ate it this time, and unlike what I guessed, I would never know if I didn't come to Guangdong to eat it. But what I said about Xiao also adds a little discussion about riding the wall. Xiao is Irish, and his arguments are inevitably a bit extreme. I thought that if I found an inexperienced person from the countryside of Guangdong, asked him to go from Shanghai to Beijing or somewhere, and asked him what he had observed, I was afraid that it would be very limited, because he had not practiced observation. So to observe, you still have to think and read first.总之，我的意思是很简单的：我们自动的读书，即嗜好的读书，请教别人是大抵无用，只好先行泛览，然后决择而入于自己所爱的较专的一门或几门；但专读书也有弊病，所以必须和实社会接触，使所读的书活起来。
In short, what I mean is very simple: it is almost useless for us to read automatically, that is, to read books as a hobby, and then decide to enter one or several more specialized courses that we love; However, there are also drawbacks to reading exclusively, so we must contact the real society to make the books we read come alive.

The fundamental mistake of the "education authorities" in talking about education is to misread the emphasis of these four words: thinking that he is going to run "education". In fact, it is probably not the case, it is probably here to be the "authorities".这可以用过去的事实证明。因为重在“当局”，所以——

3. The judiciary, the chief of the navy, may also serve as the chief of education.曾经有一位总长，听说，他的出来就职，是因为某公司要来立案，表决时可以多一个赞成者，所以再作冯妇的。但也有人来和他谈教育。我有时真想将这老实人一把抓出来，即刻勒令他回家陪太太喝茶去。

It is part of "being an official". So much for. There is another extravagant hope, which is my own Hutu!“于我来了一道光”，从此以后，我自己觉得颇聪明，近于老官僚了。后来终于被“孤桐先生”革掉，那是另外一回事。

Although this "Beijing literary and artistic circle" has been designated by Mr. Xu Danfu in "Learning the Lantern", it is faintly unshakable, and I am still inexplicable about my achievements, like a vixen.现代派的文艺，我一向没有留心，《华盖集》里从何提起。只有某女士窃取“琵亚词侣”的画的时候，《语丝》上（也许是《京报副刊》上）有人说过几句话，后来看“现代派”的口风，仿佛以为这话是我写的。我现在郑重声明：那不是我。我自从被杨荫榆女士杀败之后，即对于一切女士都不敢开罪，因为我已经知道得罪女士，很容易引起“男士”的义侠之心，弄得要被“通缉”都说不定的，便不再开口。所以我和现代派的文艺，丝毫无关。
I have never paid attention to the literature and art of modernism, where is it mentioned in the "Huagai Collection"? Only when a certain lady stole the painting of "Pia Poetry Couple", someone said a few words in "Yusi" (maybe in the "Beijing News Supplement"), and later looked at the "modernist" tone, as if I thought I wrote it. I now solemnly declare: That's not me. Since I was killed by Ms. Yang Yinyu, I did not dare to offend all the ladies, because I already knew that offending the ladies would easily arouse the righteous heart of "men", so I would not be "wanted", so I stopped speaking. So I have nothing to do with modernist literature and art.但终于交了好运了，升为“首领”，而且据说是曾和现代派的“主将”在“北京文艺界”上交过战了。好不堂哉皇哉。本来在房里面有喜色，默认不辞，倒也有些阔气的。但因为我近来被人随手抑扬，忽而“权威”，忽而不准做“权威”，只准做“前驱”；忽而又改为“青年指导者”；甲说是“青年叛徒的领袖”罢，乙又来冷笑道：“哼哼哼。”自己一动不动，故我依然，姓名却已经经历了几回升沉冷暖。人们随意说说，将我当作一种材料，倒也罢了，最可怕的是广告底恭维和广告底嘲骂。简直是膏药摊上挂着的死蛇皮一般。所以这回虽然蒙现代派追封，但对于这“首领”的荣名，还只得再来公开辞退。不过也不见得回回如此，因为我没有这许多闲工夫。
But finally handed over good luck, was promoted to "leader", and it is said that he had fought with the "main general" of the modernist school in the "Beijing literary and art circles". It's really impressive. Originally, there was joy in the room, and he didn't say goodbye by default, but he was a little generous. But because I have been casually promoted recently, I suddenly become "authoritative", suddenly not allowed to be "authoritative", only allowed to be a "pioneer"; suddenly changed to "youth mentor"; A said that he was the "leader of the young traitors", and B sneered again: "Hmph." "I am motionless, so I am still, but my name has experienced several ups and downs. People talk about me casually, treating me as a material, but the most terrifying thing is the compliments and ridicule under the advertisements. It's like a dead snake skin hanging on a plaster stall. So this time, although he was posthumously honored by the modernists, he had to publicly dismiss the honorary title of this "leader" again. But it doesn't have to be like this, because I don't have so much free time.背后插着“义旗”的“主将”出马，对手当然以阔一点的为是。我们在什么演义上时常看见：“来将通名！我的宝刀不斩无名之将！”主将要来“交战”而将我升为“首领”，大概也是“不得已也”的。但我并不然，没有这些大架子，无论吧儿狗，无论臭茅厕，都会唾过几口吐沫去，不必定要脊梁上插着五张尖角旗（义旗？）的“主将”出台，才动我的“刀笔”。假如有谁看见我攻击茅厕的文字，便以为也是我的劲敌，自恨于它的气味还未明了，再要去嗅一嗅，那是我不负责任的。恐怕有人以这广告为例，所以附带声明，以免拖累。
The "main general" with the "righteous flag" behind him came out, and the opponent was of course a little wider. We often see in some romances: "Come and name it!" My sword does not kill the nameless general! The lord is going to "fight" and promotes me to "leader", which is probably also a "last resort". But I don't think so, without these big shelves, no matter the dog, no matter the stinky toilet, I will spit a few mouthfuls and foam, and I don't have to have five pointed flags (righteous flags?) on my backbone. The "main general" of the "main general" was introduced, and my "knife and pen" were moved. If anyone sees my text attacking the toilet, they think that it is also my fierce enemy, and they hate that its smell is not clear yet, and they want to sniff it again, which is irresponsible for me. I'm afraid someone will take this advertisement as an example, so I will attach a statement so as not to drag it down.至于西滢先生的“文笔”，“思想”，“文艺批评界的权威”，那当然必须“欣赏”，“研究”而且“认识”的。只可惜要“欣赏”……这些，现在还只有一本《闲话》。但我以为咱们的“主将”的一切“文艺”中，最好的倒是登在《晨报副刊》上的，给志摩先生的大半痛骂鲁迅的那一封信。那是发热的时候所写，所以已经脱掉了绅士的黑洋服，真相跃如了。而且和《闲话》比较起来，简直是两样态度，证明着两者之中，有一种是虚伪。这也是要“研究”……西滢先生的“文笔”等等的好东西。
As for Mr. Xiying's "writing", "thought", and "authority in the literary and art criticism circle", of course, it must be "appreciated", "studied" and "known". It's a pity to "appreciate"...... There is only one "Gossip" now. But I think that among all the "literature and art" of our "main general", the best is the letter published in the "Morning News Supplement" to Mr. Shima that scolded Lu Xun for most of the time. It was written when I was in a fever, so I had already taken off the gentleman's black clothes, and the truth jumped out. And compared with "Gossip", it is simply two attitudes, proving that one of the two is hypocritical. This is also to be "studied"...... Mr. Xiying's "writing" and other good things.然而虽然是这一封信之中，也还须分别观之。例如：“志摩，……前面是遥遥茫茫荫在薄雾的里面的目的地”之类。据我看来，其实并无这样的“目的地”，倘有，却不怎么“遥遥茫茫”。这是因为热度还不很高的缘故，倘使发到九十度左右，我想，那便可望连这些“遥遥茫茫”都一扫而光，近于纯粹了。
However, although it is in this letter, it must be looked at separately. For example: "Shima,...... In front of it is a destination in the mist that is far away." In my opinion, there is actually no such "destination", and if there is, it is not very "far away". This is because the heat is not very high, if it reaches about 90 degrees, I think it can be expected that even these "distant places" will be swept away, close to pure.九月九日，广州。
September 9, Guangzhou.

谈“激烈”

谈“激烈”

谈“激烈”

Talking about "intense"带了书籍杂志过“香江”，有被视为“危险文字”而尝“铁窗斧钺风味”之险，我在《略谈香港》里已经说过了。但因为不知道怎样的是“危险文字”，所以时常耿耿于心。为什么呢？倒也并非如上海保安会所言，怕“中国元气太损”，乃是自私自利，怕自己也许要经过香港，须得留神些。
I have already said in "A Brief Talk about Hong Kong" that I have brought books and magazines to "Hong Kong", and there is a risk of being regarded as a "dangerous word" and tasting the "flavor of iron windows and axes". But because I don't know what kind of "dangerous text" is, I often worry about it. Why? It is not that they are afraid that "China's vitality is too damaged" as the Shanghai Security Association said, but that they are selfish, afraid that they may have to pass through Hong Kong, so they must be careful.今年似乎是青年特别容易死掉的年头。“千里不同风，百里不同俗。”这里以为平常的，那边就算过激，滚油煎指头。今天正是正当的，明天就变犯罪，藤条打屁股。倘是年青人，初从乡间来，一定要被煎得莫明其妙，以为现在是时行这样的制度了罢。至于我呢，前年已经四十五岁了，而且早已“身心交病”，似乎无须这么宝贵生命，思患豫防。但这是别人的意见，若夫我自己，还是不愿意吃苦的。敢乞“新时代的青年”们鉴原为幸。
This year seems to be a year when young people are particularly prone to death. "Thousands of miles are different winds, and a hundred miles are different customs." I think it's normal here, but it's too much over there, and I fry my fingers in oil. Today is justified, tomorrow it will become a crime, rattan spanking. If you are a young person, you must be fried to the point where you think it is now a system like Shixing. As for me, I was forty-five years old the year before last, and I had already been "physically and mentally ill", so I didn't seem to need such a precious life, so I thought about it and was on guard. But this is someone else's opinion, and I myself am still unwilling to endure hardship. Dare to beg the "young people of the new era" to learn from the original.所以，留神而又留神。果然，“天助自助者”，今天竟在《循环日报》上遇到一点参考资料了。事情是一个广州执信学校的学生，路过（！）香港，“在尖沙嘴码头，被一五七号华差截搜行李，在其木杠（谨案：箱也）之内，搜获激烈文字书籍七本。计开：执信学校印行之《宣传大纲》六本，又《侵夺中国史》一本。此种激烈文字，业经华民署翻译员择译完竣，昨日午乃解由连司提讯，控以怀有激烈文字书籍之罪。……”抄报太麻烦，说个大略罢，是：“择译”时期，押银五百元出外；后来因为被告供称书系朋友托带，所以“姑判从轻罚银二十五元，书籍没收焚毁”云。
So, be careful and pay attention. Sure enough, the "God helps the self-helper", today I actually encountered a little reference material in the "Circulation Daily". The incident was a student of Guangzhou Zhixin School, passing by (!) Hong Kong, "At the Tsim Sha Tsui Wharf, the luggage was intercepted and searched by the No. 157 Chinese police officer, and seven books of fierce writing were found in its wooden bar. The plan is to open six copies of the "Propaganda Outline" printed by the Zhixin School, as well as one copy of "History of the Occupation of China". This kind of fierce text has been selected and translated by the translator of the Chinese People's Bureau, and yesterday noon it was released by the joint division for interrogation, accused of possessing fierce texts and books. ...... "Copying newspapers is too troublesome, just to put it bluntly, is: during the "selection of translation" period, 500 yuan of silver is deposited out; Later, because the defendant confessed that the book was entrusted by a friend, "the court sentenced him to a lighter fine of 25 yuan, and the book was confiscated and burned."执信学校是广州的平正的学校，既是“清党”之后，则《宣传大纲》不外三民主义可知，但一到“尖沙嘴”，可就“激烈”了；可怕。惟独对于友邦，竟敢用“侵夺”字样，则确也未免“激烈”一点，因为忘了他们正在替我们“保存国粹”之恩故也。但“侵夺”上也许还有字，记者不敢写出来。
Zhixin School is a fair school in Guangzhou, which is after the "Qing Party", so the "Propaganda Outline" is nothing more than the Three People's Principles, but when it comes to "Tsim Sha Tsui", it is "intense"; Terrible. However, for friendly countries, it is indeed a little more "intense" to dare to use the word "encroachment", because they have forgone the grace of "preserving the essence of the country" for us. But there may still be words on "encroachment", and reporters dare not write it.我曾经提起过几回元朝，今夜思之，还不很确。元朝之于中文书籍，未尝如此留心。这一著倒要推清朝做模范。他不但兴过几回“文字狱”，大杀叛徒，且于宋朝人所做的“激烈文字”，也曾细心加以删改。同胞之热心“复古”及友邦之赞助“复古”者，似当奉为师法者也。

Are these journals that cannot be received lost or confiscated? I thought it was both. Where is the confiscated place Beijing, Tianjin, or Shanghai or Guangzhou? I thought it was probably everywhere. I thought the source of this inexplicable lies in the inspectors.中国近来一有事，首先就检查邮电。这检查的人员，有的是团长或区长，关于论文诗歌之类，我觉得我们不必和他多谈。但即使是读书人，其实还是一样的说不明白，尤其是在所谓革命的地方。直截痛快的革命训练弄惯了，将所有革命精神提起，如油的浮在水面一般，然而顾不及增加营养。所以，先前是刊物的封面上画一个工人，手捏铁铲或鹤嘴锹，文中有“革命！革命！”“打倒！打倒！”者，一帆风顺，算是好的。现在是要画一个少年军人拿旗骑在马上，里面“严办！严办！”这才庶几免于罪戾。至于什么“讽刺”，“幽默”，“反语”，“闲谈”等类，实在还是格不相入。从格不相入，而成为视之懵然，结果即不免有些弄得乱七八糟，谁也莫明其妙。
Whenever something happens in China recently, the first thing to do is to check posts and telecommunications. "It's smooth sailing, it's good. Now I want to draw a young soldier riding a horse with a flag, and inside it is "Strict handling!" Strict handling! This is almost exempt from guilt. From the grid to the inconsistency, and becoming confused, the result is inevitably a bit messy, and no one understands the mystery.还有一层，是终日检查刊物，不久就会头昏眼花，于是讨厌，于是生气，于是觉得刊物大抵可恶——尤其是不容易了然的——而非严办不可。我记得书籍不切边，我也是作俑者之一，当时实在是没有什么恶意的。后来看见方传宗先生的通信（见本《丝》一二九），竟说得要毛边装订的人有如此可恶，不觉满肚子冤屈。但仔细一想，方先生似乎是图书馆员，那么，要他老是裁那并不感到兴趣的毛边书，终于不免生气而大骂毛边党，正是毫不足怪的事。检查员也同此例，久而久之，就要发火，开初或者看得详细点，但后来总不免《烈火集》也可怕，《君山》也可疑，——只剩了一条最稳当的路：扣留。
There is also a layer of checking publications all day long, and soon they will be dizzy, so they hate it, so they get angry, so they feel that publications are generally hateful—especially those that are not easy to understand—rather than strictly enforceable. A few more complaints about the raw edge. When I participated in the printing of books in Beijing, I secretly decided on three irrelevant small reforms to try. As a result, the first one has been restored to the incense burner candlestick style; The second thing is sometimes no matter how you are advised, and when it is about to be printed, the worker finally moves the words of the first line to the edge of the paper, using "lightning speed" to make you irreparable; The third was attacked the earliest, and soon I surrendered conditionally. Therefore, the current "revolutionary literature" is between the stubborn counter-revolution and the Communist Party.于是又发生了问题，便是“革命文学”站在这两种危险物之间，如何保持她的纯正——正宗。这势必至于必须防止近于赤化的思想和文字，以及将来有趋于赤化之虑的思想和文字。例如，攻击礼教和白话，即有趋于赤化之忧。因为共产派无视一切旧物，而白话则始于《新青年》，而《新青年》乃独秀所办。今天看见北京教育部禁止白话的消息，我逆料《语丝》必将有几句感慨，但我实在是无动于中。我觉得连思想文字，也到处都将窒息，几句白话黑话，已经没有什么大关系了。

I once wanted to write an article "New Theory of Encirclement", first describing the method of encirclement, and then discussing the reason why China always follows the old path, the reason is encirclement, because although the fierce people have the rise and fall of falls, the besiegers will always be this group. Patriots and revolutionary youth should not think that I am lazy to plan, only open the catalog and have no articles. Second, it is to connect with a wide range of characters, not to be surrounded by a certain number of people. "The revolution has not yet succeeded" is a common slogan here. But in my opinion, this seems to have become a modest phrase, and in the hearts of a large part of the people in the rear, it is "the revolution has succeeded" or "is about to succeed". If after the "Qing Party", if you want to say that he is CP or CY, and there is no evidence, you can be referred to as a "pro-communist". I used to think that people were guilty, so they were shot or imprisoned. Only now do we know that many of them were first considered "hateful" and then finally committed crimes. Many sinners should be called "abominable people".九，十四。

魏晋风度及文章与药及酒之关系　——九月间在广州夏期学术演讲会讲

魏晋风度及文章与药及酒之关系Wei and Jin demeanor and the relationship between articles and medicine and wine——九月间在广州夏期学术演讲会讲 - Lectured at the Guangzhou Summer Academic Lecture in September
我今天所讲的，就是黑板上写着的这样一个题目。
What I am talking about today is such a topic written on the blackboard.中国文学史，研究起来，可真不容易，研究古的，恨材料太少，研究今的，材料又太多，所以到现在，中国较完全的文学史尚未出现。今天讲的题目是文学史上的一部分，也是材料太少，研究起来很有困难的地方。因为我们想研究某一时代的文学，至少要知道作者的环境，经历和著作。
The history of Chinese literature is really not easy to study, studying the ancients, hating too little material, studying the present, and too much material, so until now, a more complete literary history in China has not yet appeared. The topic I am talking about today is a part of the history of literature, and it is also a place where there is too little material and it is very difficult to study. Because if we want to study the literature of a certain era, we must at least know the author's environment, experience and writings.汉末魏初这个时代是很重要的时代，在文学方面起一个重大的变化，因当时正在黄巾和董卓大乱之后，而且又是党锢的纠纷之后，这时曹操出来了。——不过我们讲到曹操，很容易就联想起《三国志演义》，更而想起戏台上那一位花面的奸臣，但这不是观察曹操的真正方法。现在我们再看历史，在历史上的记载和论断有时也是极靠不住的，不能相信的地方很多，因为通常我们晓得，某朝的年代长一点，其中必定好人多；某朝的年代短一点，其中差不多没有好人。为什么呢？因为年代长了，做史的是本朝人，当然恭维本朝的人物，年代短了，做史的是别朝人，便很自由地贬斥其异朝的人物，所以在秦朝，差不多在史的记载上半个好人也没有。曹操在史上年代也是颇短的，自然也逃不了被后一朝人说坏话的公例。其实，曹操是一个很有本事的人，至少是一个英雄，我虽不是曹操一党，但无论如何，总是非常佩服他。
The era of the late Han Dynasty and the beginning of the Wei Dynasty was a very important era, and there was a major change in literature, because it was after the chaos between the Yellow Turbans and Dong Zhuo, and after the dispute between the party and the party, Cao Cao came out at this time. ——However, when we talk about Cao Cao, it is easy to think of "Romance of the Three Kingdoms", and even more so of the traitor with a flowery face on the stage, but this is not the real way to observe Cao Cao. Now if we look at history again, the records and judgments in history are sometimes extremely unreliable, and there are many things that cannot be believed, because usually we know that the age of a certain dynasty is longer, and there must be many good people among them; The age of a certain dynasty is a little shorter, and there are almost no good people in it. Why? Because the age is long, it is the people of this dynasty who make history, of course, the characters of this dynasty are complimented, and the age is short, and the people who make history are people from other dynasties, so they are very free to criticize the figures of other dynasties, so in the Qin Dynasty, there are almost no good people in the records of history. Cao Cao's age in history is also quite short, and naturally he cannot escape the common practice of being spoken ill of by the later dynasty. In fact, Cao Cao is a very capable person, at least a hero, although I am not Cao Cao's party, but no matter what, I always admire him very much.研究那时的文学，现在较为容易了，因为已经有人做过工作： 在文集一方面有清严可均辑的《全上古三代秦汉三国晋南北朝文》。其中于此有用的，是《全汉文》，《全三国文》，《全晋文》。
It is easier to study the literature of that time now, because someone has already done the work: On the one hand, there is the "All the Ancient Three Dynasties of Qin and Han Dynasty Jin, Northern and Southern Dynasties". Among them, the useful ones here are "All Chinese Literature", "All Three Kingdoms Text", and "All Jin Text".在诗一方面有丁福保辑的《全汉三国晋南北朝诗》。——丁福保是做医生的，现在还在。
On the one hand, there is the "Poems of the Three Kingdoms of the Southern and Northern Dynasties of the Han Dynasty" compiled by Ding Fubao. ——Ding Fubao was a doctor and is still there.辑录关于这时代的文学评论有刘师培编的《中国中古文学史》。这本书是北大的讲义，刘先生已死，此书由北大出版。
The literary criticism of this era includes "History of Medieval Chinese Literature" edited by Liu Shipei. This book is a handout from Peking University, Mr. Liu is dead, and this book is published by Peking University.上面三种书对于我们的研究有很大的帮助。能使我们看出这时代的文学的确有点异彩。
The above three books are of great help to our research. It can make us see that the literature of this era is indeed a bit brilliant.我今天所讲，倘若刘先生的书里已详的，我就略一点；反之，刘先生所略的，我就较详一点。
What I am talking about today, if it is detailed in Mr. Liu's book, I will omit it; On the contrary, what Mr. Liu omitted, I will be more detailed.董卓之后，曹操专权。在他的统治之下，第一个特色便是尚刑名。他的立法是很严的，因为当大乱之后，大家都想做皇帝，大家都想叛乱，故曹操不能不如此。曹操曾自己说过：“倘无我，不知有多少人称王称帝！”这句话他倒并没有说谎。因此之故，影响到文章方面，成了清峻的风格。——就是文章要简约严明的意思。
After Dong Zhuo, Cao Cao was in power. Under his rule, the first feature was Shang Xingming. His legislation was very strict, because after the chaos, everyone wanted to be emperor, everyone wanted to rebel, so Cao Cao couldn't help but be like this. Cao Cao once said himself: "If there is no me, I don't know how many people are called kings and emperors!" He didn't lie about this. Therefore, it has affected the article and has become a clear style. ——It means that the article should be simple and strict.此外还有一个特点，就是尚通脱。他为什么要尚通脱呢？自然也与当时的风气有莫大的关系。因为在党锢之祸以前，凡党中人都自命清流，不过讲“清”讲得太过，便成固执，所以在汉末，清流的举动有时便非常可笑了。
In addition, there is another feature, that is, Shang Tongtuo. Why did he want to take off? Naturally, it also has a lot to do with the atmosphere at that time. Because before the disaster of party confinement, all party members called themselves Qingliu, but if they talked too much about "Qing", they would become stubborn, so at the end of the Han Dynasty, Qingliu's actions were sometimes very ridiculous.比方有一个有名的人，普通的人去拜访他，先要说几句话，倘这几句话说得不对，往往会遭倨傲的待遇，叫他坐到屋外去，甚而至于拒绝不见。
For example, if a famous person visits him, he must first say a few words, and if these words are not right, he will often be treated arrogantly, asking him to sit outside the house, or even refuse to see him.又如有一个人，他和他的姊夫是不对的，有一回他到姊姊那里去吃饭之后，便要将饭钱算回给姊姊。她不肯要，他就于出门之后，把那些钱扔在街上，算是付过了。
Another person who is wrong with his brother-in-law once went to his sister's house for dinner and then asked to return the money for the meal to his sister. She refused to ask for it, so after he went out, he threw the money on the street, which was considered to have been paid.个人这样闹闹脾气还不要紧，若治国平天下也这样闹起执拗的脾气来，那还成甚么话？所以深知此弊的曹操要起来反对这种习气，力倡通脱。通脱即随便之意。此种提倡影响到文坛，便产生多量想说甚么便说甚么的文章。
It doesn't matter if an individual has such a noisy temper, if he governs the country and the world also has such a stubborn temper, what is the point? Therefore, Cao Cao, who was well aware of this drawback, wanted to rise up against this habit and advocate liberation. Tongtong means casual. This kind of advocacy has affected the literary world, resulting in a large number of articles that say whatever they want.更因思想通脱之后，废除固执，遂能充分容纳异端和外来的思想，故孔教以外的思想源源引入。
Moreover, because after the ideology was liberated, stubbornness was abolished, so that heresy and foreign ideas could be fully accommodated, so ideas other than Confucianism were introduced in a steady stream.总括起来，我们可以说汉末魏初的文章是清峻，通脱。在曹操本身，也是一个改造文章的祖师，可惜他的文章传的很少。他胆子很大，文章从通脱得力不少，做文章时又没有顾忌，想写的便写出来。
To sum up, we can say that the articles of the late Han Dynasty and the beginning of the Wei Dynasty are clear and clear. In Cao Cao himself, he was also an ancestor who transformed the article, but unfortunately his articles were rarely circulated. He is very bold, his articles are very powerful, and he has no scruples when making articles, and he writes what he wants to write.所以曹操征求人才时也是这样说，不忠不孝不要紧，只要有才便可以。这又是别人所不敢说的。曹操做诗，竟说是“郑康成行酒伏地气绝”，他引出离当时不久的事实，这也是别人所不敢用的。还有一样，比方人死时，常常写点遗令，这是名人的一件极时髦的事。当时的遗令本有一定的格式，且多言身后当葬于何处何处，或葬于某某名人的墓旁；操独不然，他的遗令不但没有依着格式，内容竟讲到遗下的衣服和伎女怎样处置等问题。
Therefore, Cao Cao also said this when soliciting talents, it doesn't matter if you are disloyal or unfilial, as long as you have talent. This is something that others dare not say. Cao Cao wrote a poem and said that "Zheng Kangcheng was drunk and died", and he brought out the fact that it was not long before that time, which was also something that others did not dare to use. Another thing, for example, when a person dies, he often writes a will, which is a very fashionable thing for celebrities. At that time, the will had a certain format, and it was said that he should be buried where he should be buried after his death, or next to the tomb of a certain celebrity; Cao Du Otherwise, not only did his will not follow the format, but the content actually talked about the clothes left behind and how to dispose of the courtesans.陆机虽然评曰“贻尘谤于后王”，然而我想他无论如何是一个精明人，他自己能做文章，又有手段，把天下的方士文士统统搜罗起来，省得他们跑在外面给他捣乱。所以他帷幄里面，方士文士就特别地多。
Although Lu Ji commented that he was "slandered by the later king", I think he is a shrewd person anyway, he can make a fuss himself, and he has the means to collect all the alchemists and scribes in the world, so that they don't have to run outside to make trouble for him. Therefore, there are a lot of alchemists and scribes in his tent.孝文帝曹丕，以长子而承父业，篡汉而即帝位。他也是喜欢文章的。其弟曹植，还有明帝曹叡，都是喜欢文章的。不过到那个时候，于通脱之外，更加上华丽。丕著有《典论》，现已失散无全本，那里面说：“诗赋欲丽”，“文以气为主”。《典论》的零零碎碎，在唐宋类书中；一篇整的《论文》，在《文选》中可以看见。
Emperor Xiaowen Cao Pi, as the eldest son, inherited his father's legacy and usurped the throne of the Han dynasty. He also likes articles. His brother Cao Zhi and Emperor Ming Cao Rui both liked articles. But by that time, in addition to the general escape, it would be even more gorgeous. Pi wrote "Dian Lun", which has now been lost and has no complete version, which says: "Poetry is beautiful" and "Literature is mainly based on qi". The fragments of "Dian Lun" are in the Tang and Song books; A whole "Treatise" can be seen in the "Anthology".后来有一般人很不以他的见解为然。他说诗赋不必寓教训，反对当时那些寓训勉于诗赋的见解，用近代的文学眼光看来，曹丕的一个时代可说是“文学的自觉时代”，或如近代所说是为艺术而艺术（Art for Art’s Sake）的一派。所以曹丕做的诗赋很好，更因他以“气”为主，故于华丽以外，加上壮大。归纳起来，汉末，魏初的文章，可说是：“清峻，通脱，华丽，壮大。”在文学的意见上，曹丕和曹植表面上似乎是不同的。曹丕说文章事可以留名声于千载；但子建却说文章小道，不足论的。据我的意见，子建大概是违心之论。这里有两个原因，第一，子建的文章做得好，一个人大概总是不满意自己所做而羡慕他人所为的，他的文章已经做得好，于是他便敢说文章是小道；第二，子建活动的目标在于政治方面，政治方面不甚得志，遂说文章是无用了。
Later, some people disagreed with his opinion. He said that poetry does not have to be a lesson, opposing the views of those who encouraged poetry at that time, and from a modern literary perspective, Cao Pi's era can be said to be the "conscious age of literature", or as modern people say, Art for Art's Sake. Therefore, Cao Pi's poetry is very good, and because he is mainly "qi", in addition to gorgeousness, he adds strength. To sum up, the articles of the late Han Dynasty and the beginning of Wei can be said to be: "Clear, clear, gorgeous, and strong." In terms of literary opinions, Cao Pi and Cao Zhi seem to be different on the surface. Cao Pi said that articles can leave a reputation for thousands of years; But Zijian said that the article is trivial, not worth mentioning. In my opinion, Zijian is probably against his heart. There are two reasons here, first, Zijian's article is done well, a person is probably always dissatisfied with what he has done and envies what others have done, his article has been done well, so he dares to say that the article is a grapevine; Second, the goal of Zijian's activities is political, and the political aspect is not very successful, so it is said that the article is useless.曹操曹丕以外，还有下面的七个人：孔融，陈琳，王粲，徐幹，阮瑀，应瑒，刘桢，都很能做文章，后来称为“建安七子”。七人的文章很少流传，现在我们很难判断；但，大概都不外是“慷慨”，“华丽”罢。华丽即曹丕所主张，慷慨就因当天下大乱之际，亲戚朋友死于乱者特多，于是为文就不免带着悲凉，激昂和“慷慨”了。
In addition to Cao Cao Cao Pi, there are the following seven people: Kong Rong, Chen Lin, Wang Can, Xu Gan, Ruan Yu, Ying Chang, Liu Zhen, all of whom are very good at making articles, and were later called the "Seven Sons of Jian'an". Huality is what Cao Pi advocated, and generosity is because when the world was in chaos, many relatives and friends died in the chaos, so Weiwen couldn't help but be sad, passionate and "generous".七子之中，特别的是孔融，他专喜和曹操捣乱。曹丕《典论》里有论孔融的，因此他也被拉进“建安七子”一块儿去。其实不对，很两样的。不过在当时，他的名声可非常之大。孔融作文，喜用讥嘲的笔调，曹丕很不满意他。孔融的文章现在传的也很少，就他所有的看起来，我们可以瞧出他并不大对别人讥讽，只对曹操。比方操破袁氏兄弟，曹丕把袁熙的妻甄氏拿来，归了自己，孔融就写信给曹操，说当初武王伐纣，将妲己给了周公了。操问他的出典，他说，以今例古，大概那时也是这样的。又比方曹操要禁酒，说酒可以亡国，非禁不可，孔融又反对他，说也有以女人亡国的，何以不禁婚姻？
Among the seven sons, the special one is Kong Rong, who likes to make trouble with Cao Cao. Cao Pi's "Dian Lun" discusses Kong Rong, so he was also pulled into the "Seven Sons of Jian'an". In fact, it is not true, it is very different. But at that time, his reputation was very great. Kong Rong composed his essays, liked to use a mocking tone, and Cao Pi was very dissatisfied with him. Kong Rong's articles are rarely circulated now, and from all his appearances, we can see that he is not very sarcastic to others, only to Cao Cao. For example, when Cao Cao defeated the Yuan brothers, Cao Pi brought Yuan Xi's wife Zhen and returned it to himself, and Kong Rong wrote to Cao Cao, saying that King Wu had given Daji to the Duke of Zhou when he attacked Zhou. Cao asked him about his origin, and he said, taking the present as an example, it was probably the same at that time. For example, Cao Cao wanted to ban alcohol, saying that wine can destroy the country, and it must be banned, Kong Rong opposed him, saying that there are also women who will destroy the country, why can't marriage be prohibited?其实曹操也是喝酒的。我们看他的“何以解忧？惟有杜康”的诗句，就可以知道。为什么他的行为会和议论矛盾呢？此无他，因曹操是个办事人，所以不得不这样做；孔融是旁观的人，所以容易说些自由话。曹操见他屡屡反对自己，后来借故把他杀了。他杀孔融的罪状大概是不孝。因为孔融有下列的两个主张：
In fact, Cao Cao also drank. Let's look at his "How to relieve worries?" Only Du Kang", you can know. Why does his behavior contradict his arguments? There is no other way, because Cao Cao is a clerk, so he has to do this; Kong Rong is a bystander, so it is easy to speak some free words. Cao Cao saw that he repeatedly opposed him, and later killed him under the pretext of being killed. His crime of killing Kong Rong was probably unfilial. Because Kong Rong has the following two propositions:第一，孔融主张母亲和儿子的关系是如瓶之盛物一样，只要在瓶内把东西倒了出来，母亲和儿子的关系便算完了。第二，假使有天下饥荒的一个时候，有点食物，给父亲不给呢？孔融的答案是：倘若父亲是不好的，宁可给别人。——曹操想杀他，便不惜以这种主张为他不忠不孝的根据，把他杀了。倘若曹操在世，我们可以问他，当初求才时就说不忠不孝也不要紧，为何又以不孝之名杀人呢？然而事实上纵使曹操再生，也没人敢问他，我们倘若去问他，恐怕他把我们也杀了！
First, Kong Rong advocates that the relationship between mother and son is like a bottle, as long as the thing is poured out of the bottle, the relationship between mother and son is over. Second, if there is a famine in the world, what if you don't give some food to your father? Kong Rong's answer is: If the father is bad, he would rather give it to others. ——Cao Cao wanted to kill him, so he did not hesitate to use this proposition as the basis for his disloyalty and unfilial piety, and killed him. If Cao Cao were alive, we could ask him, when he first sought talents, he said that it didn't matter if he was disloyal or unfilial, why did he kill people in the name of unfilial piety? However, in fact, even if Cao Cao is reborn, no one dares to ask him, if we ask him, I am afraid he will kill us too!与孔融一同反对曹操的尚有一个祢衡，后来给黄祖杀掉的。祢衡的文章也不错，而且他和孔融早是“以气为主”来写文章的了。故在此我们又可知道，汉文慢慢壮大起来，是时代使然，非专靠曹操父子之功的。但华丽好看，却是曹丕提倡的功劳。
There was also a You Heng who opposed Cao Cao with Kong Rong, who was later killed by Huang Zu. You Heng's article is also good, and he and Kong Rong have long been "qi-oriented" to write articles. Therefore, we can also know here that the slow growth of Chinese literature is due to the times, not solely by the merits of Cao Cao and his son. But gorgeous and good-looking is the credit of Cao Pi's advocacy.这样下去一直到明帝的时候，文章上起了个重大的变化，因为出了一个何晏。
This continued until the time of Emperor Ming, when there was a major change in the article, because there was a He Yan.何晏的名声很大，位置也很高，他喜欢研究《老子》和《易经》。至于他是怎样的一个人呢？那真相现在可很难知道，很难调查。因为他是曹氏一派的人，司马氏很讨厌他，所以他们的记载对何晏大不满。因此产生许多传说，有人说何晏的脸上是搽粉的，又有人说他本来生得白，不是搽粉的。但究竟何晏搽粉不搽粉呢？我也不知道。
He Yan has a great reputation and a high position, and he likes to study Laozi and the Book of Changes. As for what kind of person he is? The truth is difficult to know now, and it is difficult to investigate. Because he was a member of the Cao faction, the Sima clan hated him very much, so their records were very dissatisfied with He Yan. As a result, many legends have arisen, some people say that He Yan's face is powdered, and some people say that he was born white, not powdered. But what about He Yan and not? I don't know.但何晏有两件事我们是知道的。第一，他喜欢空谈，是空谈的祖师；第二，他喜欢吃药，是吃药的祖师。
But He Yan has two things we know. First, he likes empty talk and is the ancestor of empty talk; Second, he likes to take medicine and is the ancestor of medicine.此外，他也喜欢谈名理。他身子不好，因此不能不服药。他吃的不是寻常的药，是一种名叫“五石散”的药。
In addition, he also likes to talk about fame and reason. He was not in good health, so he had to take medicine. What he took was not an ordinary medicine, but a medicine called "Wushi San".“五石散”是一种毒药，是何晏吃开头的。汉时，大家还不敢吃，何晏或者将药方略加改变，便吃开头了。五石散的基本，大概是五样药：石钟乳，石硫黄，白石英，紫石英，赤石脂；另外怕还配点别样的药。但现在也不必细细研究它，我想各位都是不想吃它的。
"Wushi San" is a poison, which He Yan started with. In the Han Dynasty, everyone did not dare to eat it, He Yan or changed the prescription slightly, and then ate the beginning. The basics of Wushi San are probably five medicines: stone stalactites, stone sulfur, white quartz, purple quartz, and red stone resin; In addition, I am afraid that there will be some other medicine. But there is no need to study it in detail now, I think you don't want to eat it.从书上看起来，这种药是很好的，人吃了能转弱为强。因此之故，何晏有钱，他吃起来了；大家也跟着吃。那时五石散的流毒就同清末的鸦片的流毒差不多，看吃药与否以分阔气与否的。现在由隋巢元方做的《诸病源候论》的里面可以看到一些。据此书，可知吃这药是非常麻烦的，穷人不能吃，假使吃了之后，一不小心，就会毒死。先吃下去的时候，倒不怎样的，后来药的效验既显，名曰“散发”。倘若没有“散发”，就有弊而无利。因此吃了之后不能休息，非走路不可，因走路才能“散发”，所以走路名曰“行散”。比方我们看六朝人的诗，有云：“至城东行散”，就是此意。后来做诗的人不知其故，以为“行散”即步行之意，所以不服药也以“行散”二字入诗，这是很笑话的。
From the book, it seems that this medicine is very good, and people can turn weak into strong after taking it. Therefore, He Yan was rich, and he ate it; Everyone also ate. At that time, the poison of Wushi San was similar to the poison of opium in the late Qing Dynasty, and it depended on whether to take medicine or not. Now you can see some of them in the "Theory of the Origins of Diseases" made by Sui Chao Yuanfang. According to this book, it can be seen that taking this medicine is very troublesome, and the poor cannot take it, if they eat it, if they are not careful, they will be poisoned to death. When you eat it first, it is not much, but later the effect of the medicine is obvious, and it is called "dispersion". If there is no "distribution", there will be disadvantages and no benefits. Therefore, after eating, you can't rest, you have to walk, because walking can "dissipate", so walking is called "walking away". For example, when we look at the poems of the people of the Six Dynasties, there is a saying: "To the east of the city to scatter", which is the meaning. Later, the poet did not know why, thinking that "Xingsan" means walking, so he did not take medicine and also used the word "Xingsan" into the poem, which is a joke.走了之后，全身发烧，发烧之后又发冷。普通发冷宜多穿衣，吃热的东西。但吃药后的发冷刚刚要相反：衣少，冷食，以冷水浇身。倘穿衣多而食热物，那就非死不可。因此五石散一名寒食散。只有一样不必冷吃的，就是酒。
After leaving, the whole body had a fever, and the fever followed by chills. Ordinary colds should dress more and eat hot things. But the chills after taking the medicine are just the opposite: less clothing, cold food, and cold water on the body. If you wear a lot of clothes and eat hot food, you must die. Therefore, Wushi San is also known as Cold Food San. There is only one thing that doesn't have to be eaten cold, and that is wine.吃了散之后，衣服要脱掉，用冷水浇身；吃冷东西；饮热酒。这样看起来，五石散吃的人多，穿厚衣的人就少；比方在广东提倡，一年以后，穿西装的人就没有了。因为皮肉发烧之故，不能穿窄衣。为豫防皮肤被衣服擦伤，就非穿宽大的衣服不可。现在有许多人以为晋人轻裘缓带，宽衣，在当时是人们高逸的表现，其实不知他们是吃药的缘故。一班名人都吃药，穿的衣都宽大，于是不吃药的也跟着名人，把衣服宽大起来了！
After eating, take off your clothes and pour cold water on your body; eat something cold; Drink hot wine. In this way, there are many people who eat five stones loosely, and there are fewer people who wear thick clothes; For example, in Guangdong, it is advocated that after a year, there will be no one wearing a suit. Because of the fever of the flesh, you cannot wear narrow clothes. In order to prevent the skin from being scratched by clothes, it is necessary to wear wide clothes. Now many people think that the Jin people's light fur and loose belts and wide clothes were a manifestation of people's noble elegance at that time, but in fact they didn't know that they were taking medicine. A group of celebrities took medicine and wore wide clothes, so those who didn't take medicine also followed the celebrities and made their clothes wider!还有，吃药之后，因皮肤易于磨破，穿鞋也不方便，故不穿鞋袜而穿屐。所以我们看晋人的画像或那时的文章，见他衣服宽大，不鞋而屐，以为他一定是很舒服，很飘逸的了，其实他心里都是很苦的。
Also, after taking medicine, because the skin is easy to wear out and it is inconvenient to wear shoes, so I wear clogs instead of shoes and socks. After the Eastern Jin Dynasty, there were many people who faked and fell asleep on the street, saying that they were "emitting" to show their generosity. And because of the "dispersion", you can't be hungry, so you eat cold food, and you have to eat it quickly, no matter the time, how many times a day you can't decide. Therefore, it affected the "mourning rudeness" of the Jin Dynasty. ——Originally, during the Wei and Jin dynasties, there were many gifts for parents. 居丧之际，饮酒食肉，由阔人名流倡之，万民皆从之，因为这个缘故，社会上遂尊称这样的人叫作名士派。吃散发源于何晏，和他同志的，有王弼和夏侯玄两个人，与晏同为服药的祖师。有他三人提倡，有多人跟着走。他们三人多是会做文章，除了夏侯玄的作品流传不多外，王何二人现在我们尚能看到他们的文章。他们都是生于正始的，所以又名曰“正始名士”。但这种习惯的末流，是只会吃药，或竟假装吃药，而不会做文章。
Eating and distributing hair originated from He Yan, and his comrades, including Wang Bi and Xiahou Xuan, were the ancestors of taking medicine with Yan. There are three of them advocating, and many people follow. After the Eastern Jin Dynasty, it was not an article but a clear talk, which can be seen in the book "The New Language of the World". After the death of the two, most commentators scolded him for his association with Wei, but in fact, He Yan was worthy of scolding because he was the initiator of taking medicine. No one has eaten it since the Tang Dynasty, and the reason is not yet known, probably because it has more disadvantages and less benefits, just like opium?晋名人皇甫谧作一书曰《高士传》，我们以为他很高超。但他是服散的，曾有一篇文章，自说吃散之苦。因为药性一发，稍不留心，即会丧命，至少也会受非常的苦痛，或要发狂；本来聪明的人，因此也会变成痴呆。所以非深知药性，会解救，而且家里的人多深知药性不可。晋朝人多是脾气很坏，高傲，发狂，性暴如火的，大约便是服药的缘故。比方有苍蝇扰他，竟至拔剑追赶；就是说话，也要胡胡涂涂地才好，有时简直是近于发疯。但在晋朝更有以痴为好的，这大概也是服药的缘故。
The famous Jin dynasty Huangfu Mi wrote a book called "The Biography of Gao Shi", and we thought he was very superb. But he is a scattered person, and there was an article in which he said that he was suffering from scattering. Because once the medicinal properties are released, if you are not careful, you will die, at least you will suffer a lot of pain, or go crazy; People who are originally smart will also become demented. Therefore, if you do not know the medicinal properties well, you will be rescued, and the people in the family know the medicinal properties very well. Most of the people in the Jin Dynasty were very bad-tempered, arrogant, crazy, and violent, probably because of taking medicine. For example, if a fly disturbs him, he will draw his sword and chase after him; Even if you talk, you have to be foolish, sometimes it's almost crazy. But in the Jin Dynasty, it was better to be foolish, which was probably also because of taking medicine.魏末，何晏他们以外，又有一个团体新起，叫做“竹林名士”，也是七个，所以又称“竹林七贤”。正始名士服药，竹林名士饮酒。竹林的代表是嵇康和阮籍。但究竟竹林名士不纯粹是喝酒的，嵇康也兼服药，而阮籍则是专喝酒的代表。但嵇康也饮酒，刘伶也是这里面的一个。他们七人中差不多都是反抗旧礼教的。
At the end of the Wei Dynasty, in addition to He Yan and others, there was a new group called "Bamboo Forest Celebrities", which was also seven, so it was also called the "Seven Sages of the Bamboo Forest". In the first period, famous scholars took medicine, and famous scholars in the bamboo grove drank wine. The representatives of the bamboo forest are Ji Kang and Ruan Ji. But in the end, the bamboo forest celebrities are not purely drinking, Ji Kang also takes medicine, and Ruan Ji is a representative of drinking. But Ji Kang also drinks, and Liu Ling is also one of them. Almost all seven of them rebelled against the old etiquette.这七人中，脾气各有不同。嵇阮二人的脾气都很大；阮籍老年时改得很好，嵇康就始终都是极坏的。
Among these seven people, their temperaments are different. Ji and Ruan both have a big temper; Ruan Ji changed very well in his old age, but Ji Kang was always extremely bad.阮年青时，对于访他的人有加以青眼和白眼的分别。白眼大概是全然看不见眸子的，恐怕要练习很久才能够。青眼我会装，白眼我却装不好。
When Ruan was young, he made a difference between blue eyes and white eyes for those who visited him. Later, Ruan Ji actually reached the point of "not praising and criticizing people", but Ji Kang did not change at all. Their attitude is probably that they don't wear clothes or hats when drinking. As for Ruan Ji, it is even worse, he does not even admit the past and the present, and there is a saying in the "Biography of Mr. Adult": "The heavens and the earth are unsolved, the sun and the moon are falling, what will I think of soaring?" Just look at the fact that once Sima Yi asked to marry Ruan Ji, and Ruan Ji was drunk for two months, and there was no opportunity to raise it, you can know.阮籍作文章和诗都很好，他的诗文虽然也慷慨激昂，但许多意思都是隐而不显的。宋的颜延之已经说不大能懂，我们现在自然更很难看得懂他的诗了。他诗里也说神仙，但他其实是不相信的。嵇康的论文，比阮籍更好，思想新颖，往往与古时旧说反对。孔子说：“学而时习之，不亦说乎？”嵇康做的《难自然好学论》，却道，人是并不好学的，假如一个人可以不做事而又有饭吃，就随便闲游不喜欢读书了，所以现在人之好学，是由于习惯和不得已。还有管叔蔡叔，是疑心周公，率殷民叛，因而被诛，一向公认为坏人的。而嵇康做的《管蔡论》，就也反对历代传下来的意思，说这两个人是忠臣，他们的怀疑周公，是因为地方相距太远，消息不灵通。
Ruan Ji's articles and poems are very good, and although his poems are also impassioned, many meanings are hidden and invisible. There is also Uncle Guan Cai, who was suspicious of the Duke of Zhou and led the Yin people to rebel, so he was killed, and he has always been recognized as a bad person. But the one that has attracted the attention of many people and is dangerous to life is the "not Tang Wu but Bo Zhou Kong" in the "Book of Severing Relations with Shan Juyuan". But the Wei and Jin dynasties were not all like this, with wide robes and large sleeves, and everyone drank. There are also many objections. In terms of historical facts, He once persuaded Sima Yi to kill Ruan Ji several times, but Sima Yi did not listen to him, because Ruan Ji's drinking had less to do with the current situation.然而后人就将嵇康阮籍骂起来，人云亦云，一直到现在，一千六百多年。季札说：“中国之君子，明于礼义而陋于知人心。”这是确的，大凡明于礼义，就一定要陋于知人心的，所以古代有许多人受了很大的冤枉。例如嵇阮的罪名，一向说他们毁坏礼教。但据我个人的意见，这判断是错的。魏晋时代，崇奉礼教的看来似乎很不错，而实在是毁坏礼教，不信礼教的。表面上毁坏礼教者，实则倒是承认礼教，太相信礼教。因为魏晋时所谓崇奉礼教，是用以自利，那崇奉也不过偶然崇奉，如曹操杀孔融，司马懿杀嵇康，都是因为他们和不孝有关，但实在曹操司马懿何尝是著名的孝子，不过将这个名义，加罪于反对自己的人罢了。于是老实人以为如此利用，亵黩了礼教，不平之极，无计可施，激而变成不谈礼教，不信礼教，甚至于反对礼教。——但其实不过是态度，至于他们的本心，恐怕倒是相信礼教，当作宝贝，比曹操司马懿们要迂执得多。现在说一个容易明白的比喻罢，譬如有一个军阀，在北方——在广东的人所谓北方和我常说的北方的界限有些不同，我常称山东山西直隶河南之类为北方——那军阀从前是压迫民党的，后来北伐军势力一大，他便挂起了青天白日旗，说自己已经信仰三民主义了，是总理的信徒。这样还不够，他还要做总理的纪念周。这时候，真的三民主义的信徒，去呢，不去呢？不去，他那里就可以说你反对三民主义，定罪，杀人。但既然在他的势力之下，没有别法，真的总理的信徒，倒会不谈三民主义，或者听人假惺惺的谈起来就皱眉，好像反对三民主义模样。所以我想，魏晋时所谓反对礼教的人，有许多大约也如此。他们倒是迂夫子，将礼教当作宝贝看待的。
However, later generations scolded Ji Kang and Ruan Ji, and people said that until now, for more than 1,600 years. Ji Zha said: "Chinese gentlemen know propriety and righteousness but are not good at knowing people's hearts. This is true, anyone who understands propriety and righteousness must be inferior to knowing people's hearts, so many people in ancient times suffered great injustices. For example, Ji Ruan's crimes have always been said to be that they destroy etiquette. But in my personal opinion, this judgment is wrong. In the Wei and Jin dynasties, those who worshipped etiquette seemed to be very good, but they really destroyed etiquette and did not believe in etiquette. On the surface, those who destroy etiquette actually admit etiquette and believe in etiquette too much. Because the so-called worship of etiquette in the Wei and Jin dynasties was used for self-interest, and the worship was only accidental, such as Cao Cao killing Kong Rong and Sima Yi killing Ji Kang, all because they were related to unfilial piety, but in fact, Cao Cao and Sima Yi were famous filial sons, but in this name, they were just punished by those who opposed them. So honest people think that they have used it in this way, desecrated the etiquette, and the injustice is extremely unfair, and there is nothing to do, and it provokes it into not talking about etiquette, not believing in etiquette, and even opposing etiquette. ——But in fact, it is just an attitude, as for their original intentions, I am afraid that they believe in etiquette and treat them as treasures, which is much more pedantic than Cao Cao and Sima Yi. Now let's talk about an easy-to-understand analogy, for example, there is a warlord in the north - in Guangdong people say that the so-called north is somewhat different from what I often call the north, I often call Shandong, Shanxi, Zhili Henan and the like the north - the warlord used to oppress the People's Party, and later when the Northern Expeditionary Army became powerful, he hung up the blue sky and white sun flag, saying that he had believed in the Three People's Principles and was a believer in the prime minister. As if that wasn't enough, he also had to do the prime minister's anniversary week. At this time, the true believers of the Three People's Doctrines, what about going or not? If you don't go, he can say that you oppose the Three People's Principles, convict, and kill. But since there is no other way under his power, the true prime minister's believers will not talk about the Three People's Principles, or frown when they hear people talk about them, as if they are against the Three People's Principles. So I think that many of the so-called people who opposed etiquette in the Wei and Jin dynasties were probably the same. They are pedantic masters and treat etiquette as treasures.还有一个实证，凡人们的言论，思想，行为，倘若自己以为不错的，就愿意天下的别人，自己的朋友都这样做。但嵇康阮籍不这样，不愿意别人来模仿他。竹林七贤中有阮咸，是阮籍的侄子，一样的饮酒。阮籍的儿子阮浑也愿加入时，阮籍却道不必加入，吾家已有阿咸在，够了。假若阮籍自以为行为是对的，就不当拒绝他的儿子，而阮籍却拒绝自己的儿子，可知阮籍并不以他自己的办法为然。至于嵇康，一看他的《绝交书》，就知道他的态度很骄傲的；有一次，他在家打铁——他的性情是很喜欢打铁的——钟会来看他了，他只打铁，不理钟会。钟会没有意味，只得走了。其时嵇康就问他：“何所闻而来，何所见而去？”钟会答道：“闻所闻而来，见所见而去。”这也是嵇康杀身的一条祸根。但我看他做给他的儿子看的《家诫》——当嵇康被杀时，其子方十岁，算来当他做这篇文章的时候，他的儿子是未满十岁的——就觉得宛然是两个人。他在《家诫》中教他的儿子做人要小心，还有一条一条的教训。有一条是说长官处不可常去，亦不可住宿；官长送人们出来时，你不要在后面，因为恐怕将来官长惩办坏人时，你有暗中密告的嫌疑。又有一条是说宴饮时候有人争论，你可立刻走开，免得在旁批评，因为两者之间必有对与不对，不批评则不像样，一批评就总要是甲非乙，不免受一方见怪。还有人要你饮酒，即使不愿饮也不要坚决地推辞，必须和和气气的拿着杯子。我们就此看来，实在觉得很希奇：嵇康是那样高傲的人，而他教子就要他这样庸碌。因此我们知道，嵇康自己对于他自己的举动也是不满足的。所以批评一个人的言行实在难，社会上对于儿子不像父亲，称为“不肖”，以为是坏事，殊不知世上正有不愿意他的儿子像自己的父亲哩。试看阮籍嵇康，就是如此。这是，因为他们生于乱世，不得已，才有这样的行为，并非他们的本态。但又于此可见魏晋的破坏礼教者，实在是相信礼教到固执之极的。
There is also empirical evidence that if people think that people's speech, thoughts, and behaviors are good, they are willing to do the same for others in the world and their friends. But Ji Kang and Ruan Ji were not like this, and they didn't want others to imitate him. Among the Seven Sages of the Bamboo Forest, Ruan Xian, who is Ruan Ji's nephew, drinks the same wine. When Ruan Ji's son Ruan Hun was also willing to join, Ruan Ji said that he didn't have to join, my family already had Ah Xian, which was enough. If Ruan Ji thinks that his behavior is right, he should not reject his son, but Ruan Ji rejects his own son, which shows that Ruan Ji does not think of his own methods. As for Ji Kang, as soon as he looked at his "Book of Breaking Relations", he knew that his attitude was very proud; Once, when he was working at home - his temperament is very fond of iron - Zhong Hui came to see him, he only made iron and ignored Zhong Hui. Zhong Hui was meaningless and had to leave. At that time, Ji Kang asked him: "What did you hear and what did you see?" Zhong Hui replied: "Come when you hear what you hear, and go when you see what you see." This is also a bane of Ji Kang's killing. But when I looked at the "Family Commandments" he showed to his son—when Ji Kang was killed, his son was ten years old, and when he wrote this article, his son was less than ten years old—and I felt like two people. He taught his son to be careful in his "Family Commandments", and there were lessons one by one. One is that the governor should not go often or stay; When the officials send people out, you should not be behind, because I am afraid that when the officials punish the bad people in the future, you will be suspected of secretly informing. Another thing is that if someone argues at a banquet, you can walk away immediately to avoid criticism, because there must be right and wrong between the two, and if you don't criticize, you won't be good. If someone wants you to drink, even if you don't want to drink, don't resolutely refuse, you must hold the cup in a friendly manner. From this point of view, we really find it strange: Ji Kang is such an arrogant person, and he wants his son to be so mediocre. Therefore, we know that Ji Kang himself is not satisfied with his own actions. Therefore, it is really difficult to criticize a person's words and deeds, and society thinks that it is a bad thing for a son who is not like his father, calling him "unworthy", but he doesn't know that there are people in the world who do not want his son to be like his father. Just look at Ruan Ji Ji Kang, that's it. This is because they were born in troubled times and had no choice but to behave like this, which is not their true nature. But it can be seen that the destroyers of etiquette in the Wei and Jin dynasties really believed in etiquette to the extreme.不过何晏王弼阮籍嵇康之流，因为他们的名位大，一般的人们就学起来，而所学的无非是表面，他们实在的内心，却不知道。因为只学他们的皮毛，于是社会上便很多了没意思的空谈和饮酒。许多人只会无端的空谈和饮酒，无力办事，也就影响到政治上，弄得玩“空城计”，毫无实际了。在文学上也这样，嵇康阮籍的纵酒，是也能做文章的，后来到东晋，空谈和饮酒的遗风还在，而万言的大文如嵇阮之作，却没有了。刘勰说：“嵇康师心以遣论，阮籍使气以命诗。”这“师心”和“使气”，便是魏末晋初的文章的特色。正始名士和竹林名士的精神灭后，敢于师心使气的作家也没有了。
However, He Yan, Wang Bi, Ruan Ji, Ji Kang and others, because of their great status, ordinary people learn it, and what they learn is nothing more than the surface, but they don't know what they really do. Because they only learn their skin, there is a lot of boring talk and drinking in society. Many people will only talk and drink for no reason, and they will not be able to do things, which will affect politics and make them play "empty city tricks", which is practical. In literature, it is also the same, Ji Kang Ruan's indulgence can also make a fortune, and later in the Eastern Jin Dynasty, the legacy of empty talk and drinking is still there, but the great article of ten thousand words is like Ji Ruan's work, but it is gone. Liu Xie said: "Master Ji Kang is dismissed, and Ruan Ji is angry with poetry." This "teacher's heart" and "anger" are the characteristics of the articles of the late Wei and early Jin dynasties. After the spirit of the famous scholars and the famous scholars of the bamboo forest disappeared, the writers who dared to be angry were gone.到东晋，风气变了。社会思想平静得多，各处都夹入了佛教的思想。再至晋末，乱也看惯了，篡也看惯了，文章便更和平。代表平和的文章的人有陶潜。他的态度是随便饮酒，乞食，高兴的时候就谈论和作文章，无尤无怨。所以现在有人称他为“田园诗人”，是个非常和平的田园诗人。他的态度是不容易学的，他非常之穷，而心里很平静。家常无米，就去向人家门口求乞。他穷到有客来见，连鞋也没有，那客人给他从家丁取鞋给他，他便伸了足穿上了。虽然如此，他却毫不为意，还是“采菊东篱下，悠然见南山”。这样的自然状态，实在不易模仿。他穷到衣服也破烂不堪，而还在东篱下采菊，偶然抬起头来，悠然的见了南山，这是何等自然。现在有钱的人住在租界里，雇花匠种数十盆菊花，便做诗，叫作“秋日赏菊效陶彭泽体”，自以为合于渊明的高致，我觉得不大像。
By the Eastern Jin Dynasty, the atmosphere changed. Social thought is much calmer, and Buddhist ideas are interspersed everywhere. At the end of the Jin Dynasty, the chaos was also accustomed to the usurpation, and the article was more peaceful. The person who represents the peaceful article is Tao Qian. His attitude is to drink casually, beg for food, talk and write when he is happy, without complaint. So now some people call him a "pastoral poet", a very peaceful pastoral poet. His attitude is not easy to learn, he is very poor, but his heart is very calm. There is no rice at home, so I go to beg at the door of others. He was so poor that a guest came to see him, and he didn't even have shoes, so the guest took shoes from his servant for him, and he stretched out his feet and put them on. Despite this, he didn't care, or "picked chrysanthemums under the east fence and leisurely saw Nanshan". Such a natural state is really not easy to imitate. He was so poor that his clothes were tattered, and he was still picking chrysanthemums under the east fence, and he accidentally raised his head and saw Nanshan leisurely, how natural it was. Now rich people live in the concession, hire florists to plant dozens of pots of chrysanthemums, and make poems, called "Autumn Chrysanthemums to Imitate Tao Pengze Ti", thinking that it is in line with Yuanming's nobility, I don't think it is very similar.陶潜之在晋末，是和孔融于汉末与嵇康于魏末略同，又是将近易代的时候。但他没有什么慷慨激昂的表示，于是便博得“田园诗人”的名称。但《陶集》里有《述酒》一篇，是说当时政治的。这样看来，可见他于世事也并没有遗忘和冷淡，不过他的态度比嵇康阮籍自然得多，不至于招人注意罢了。还有一个原因，先已说过，是习惯。因为当时饮酒的风气相沿下来，人见了也不觉得奇怪，而且汉魏晋相沿，时代不远，变迁极多，既经见惯，就没有大感触，陶潜之比孔融嵇康和平，是当然的。例如看北朝的墓志，官位升进，往往详细写着，再仔细一看，他是已经经历过两三个朝代了，但当时似乎并不为奇。
Tao Qianzhi was at the end of the Jin Dynasty, which was roughly the same as Kong Rong at the end of the Han Dynasty and Ji Kang at the end of the Wei Dynasty, and it was the time when the era was approaching. But he didn't have any impassioned expressions, so he won the title of "pastoral poet". But there is an article "Narrative of Wine" in the "Tao Ji", which is about the politics of the time. From this point of view, it can be seen that he has not forgotten and indifferent to the world, but his attitude is much more natural than that of Ji Kang and Ruan Ji, and it will not attract attention. There is another reason, as I said earlier, is habit. Because the trend of drinking at that time was followed, people did not feel strange when they saw it, and the Han, Wei, and Jin dynasties followed, the times were not far away, and there were many changes. For example, if you look at the epitaph of the Northern Dynasty, the official position is promoted, often written in detail, and if you look closely, he has already experienced two or three dynasties, but it did not seem surprising at the time.据我的意思，即使是从前的人，那诗文完全超于政治的所谓“田园诗人”，“山林诗人”，是没有的。完全超出于人间世的，也是没有的。既然是超出于世，则当然连诗文也没有。诗文也是人事，既有诗，就可以知道于世事未能忘情。譬如墨子兼爱，杨子为我。墨子当然要著书；杨子就一定不著，这才是“为我”。因为若做出书来给别人看，便变成“为人”了。
According to my meaning, even in the past, there were no so-called "pastoral poets" and "mountain poets" whose poetry and literature were completely beyond politics. There is nothing that is completely beyond the human world. Since it is beyond the world, of course there is not even poetry. Poetry is also a human matter, and with poetry, we can know that we have not forgotten our feelings in the world. For example, Mozi loves both and Yangzi is for me. Of course, Mozi wanted to write books; Yang Zi must not be there, this is "for me". Because if you make a book to show to others, you will become a "human being".由此可知陶潜总不能超于尘世，而且，于朝政还是留心，也不能忘掉“死”，这是他诗文中时时提起的。用别一种看法研究起来，恐怕也会成一个和旧说不同的人物罢。
It can be seen from this that Tao Qian cannot transcend the world, and moreover, Yu Chaozheng is still attentive and cannot forget "death", which is often mentioned in his poems. If you study it with another point of view, I am afraid that it will become a character that is different from the old theory.自汉末至晋末文章的一部分的变化与药及酒之关系，据我所知的大概是这样。但我学识太少，没有详细的研究，在这样的热天和雨天费去了诸位这许多时光，是很抱歉的。现在这个题目总算是讲完了。
From the end of the Han Dynasty to the end of the Jin Dynasty, some of the changes in the article and the relationship between medicine and wine are probably like this as far as I know. But I have too little knowledge and no detailed research, and I am sorry that I have spent so much time on such a hot and rainy day. Now this topic is finally finished.

再谈香港

Let's talk about Hong Kong again我经过我所视为“畏途”的香港，算起来九月二十八日是第三回。
I passed through Hong Kong, which I regarded as a "fearful road", and September 28 was the third time.第一回带着一点行李，但并没有遇见什么事。第二回是单身往来，那情状，已经写过一点了。这回却比前两次仿佛先就感到不安，因为曾在《创造月刊》上王独清先生的通信中，见过英国雇用的中国同胞上船“查关”的威武：非骂则打，或者要几块钱。而我是有十只书箱在统舱里，六只书箱和衣箱在房舱里的。
The first time I brought a little luggage, but I didn't encounter anything. The second time is a single relationship, and the situation has already been written a little. This time, it seemed to be uneasy before the previous two times, because in the correspondence of Mr. Wang Duqing in the "Creation Monthly", I saw the power of Chinese compatriots hired by the British to board the ship to "check customs": either scolding or beating, or asking for a few dollars. And I have ten bookcases in the cabin, and six bookcases and clothes boxes in the cabin.看看挂英旗的同胞的手腕，自然也可说是一种经历，但我又想，这代价未免太大了，这些行李翻动之后，单是重行整理捆扎，就须大半天；要实验，最好只有一两件。然而已经如此，也就随他如此罢。只是给钱呢，还是听他逐件查验呢？倘查验，我一个人一时怎么收拾呢？

I took the key, walked into the command cabin, and sure enough, I saw two British compatriots in dark green uniforms, holding iron sticks in their hands, standing next to the pile of boxes. I told him that it was an old book, but he didn't seem to understand, and there were only three words in his mouth:“打开来！”

"Naturally, it opened, so with the help of two tea rooms, it was opened.他一动手，我立刻觉得香港和广州的查关的不同。我出广州，也曾受过检查。但那边的检查员，脸上是有血色的，也懂得我的话。每一包纸或一部书，抽出来看后，便放在原地方，所以毫不凌乱。的确是检查。而在这“英人的乐园”的香港可大两样了。检查员的脸是青色的，也似乎不懂我的话。他只将箱子的内容倒出，翻搅一通，倘是一个纸包，便将包纸撕破，于是一箱书籍，经他搅松之后，便高出箱面有六七寸了。
As soon as he took action, I immediately felt that the customs inspection in Hong Kong and Guangzhou was different. I came out of Guangzhou and was also inspected. 革命文学

革命文学

革命文学

Revolutionary literature今年在南方，听得大家叫“革命”，正如去年在北方，听得大家叫“讨赤”的一样盛大。
This year, in the south, everyone heard it was called "revolution", just as it was in the north last year, everyone heard it called "seeking red".而这“革命”还侵入文艺界里了。
And this "revolution" has also invaded the literary and artistic circles.最近，广州的日报上还有一篇文章指示我们，叫我们应该以四位革命文学家为师法：意大利的唐南遮，德国的霍普德曼，西班牙的伊本纳兹，中国的吴稚晖。
Recently, there was an article in the Guangzhou daily newspaper instructing us that we should learn from four revolutionary writers: Don Nanzio of Italy, Hopdemann of Germany, Ibn Naz of Spain, and Wu Zhihui of China.两位帝国主义者，一位本国政府的叛徒，一位国民党救护的发起者，都应该作为革命文学的师法，于是革命文学便莫名其妙了，因为这实在是至难之业。
Two imperialists, a traitor to their own government, and an initiator of the Kuomintang rescue, should all be used as teachers of revolutionary literature, so revolutionary literature is inexplicable, because this is really a very difficult task.于是不得已，世间往往误以两种文学为革命文学：一是在一方的指挥刀的掩护之下，斥骂他的敌手的；一是纸面上写着许多“打，打”，“杀，杀”，或“血，血”的。
Therefore, as a last resort, the world often mistakenly regards two types of literature as revolutionary literature: one is under the cover of one side's command sword, rebuking his opponent; First, there are many "beating, beating", "killing, killing", or "blood, blood" written on the paper.如果这是“革命文学”，则做“革命文学家”，实在是最痛快而安全的事。
If this is "revolutionary literature", then being a "revolutionary writer" is really the most enjoyable and safe thing.从指挥刀下骂出去，从裁判席上骂下去，从官营的报上骂开去，真是伟哉一世之雄，妙在被骂者不敢开口。而又有人说，这不敢开口，又何其怯也？对手无“杀身成仁”之勇，是第二条罪状，斯愈足以显革命文学家之英雄。所可惜者只在这文学并非对于强暴者的革命，而是对于失败者的革命。
Scolding from under the commanding knife, scolding from the referee's seat, and scolding from the official newspaper, it is really a great hero, and the beauty is that the scolded person does not dare to speak. And some people say, how timid is this not daring to speak? The opponent's lack of the courage to "kill oneself and become benevolent" is the second crime, which is enough to show the heroism of revolutionary writers. It is a pity that this literature is not a revolution for the rapists, but a revolution for the losers.唐朝人早就知道，穷措大想做富贵诗，多用些“金”“玉”“锦”“绮”字面，自以为豪华，而不知适见其寒蠢。真会写富贵景象的，有道：“笙歌归院落，灯火下楼台”，全不用那些字。“打，打”，“杀，杀”，听去诚然是英勇的，但不过是一面鼓。即使是鼙鼓，倘若前面无敌军，后面无我军，终于不过是一面鼓而已。
The people of the Tang Dynasty have long known that they want to make rich poems, and use more words of "gold", "jade", "brocade" and "qi", thinking that they are luxurious, but they don't know how to see their cold stupidity. There is a saying: "Shengge returns to the courtyard, and the lights go down the building", without using those words. "Fight, fight", "kill, kill", it sounds heroic, but it is just a drum. Even if it is a drum, if there is no invincible army in front and no army in the back, it is just a drum in the end.我以为根本问题是在作者可是一个“革命人”，倘是的，则无论写的是什么事件，用的是什么材料，即都是“革命文学”。从喷泉里出来的都是水，从血管里出来的都是血。“赋得革命，五言八韵”，是只能骗骗盲试官的。
I think the fundamental problem is that the author is a "revolutionary", and if so, no matter what event he writes or what material he uses, it is all "revolutionary literature". All water comes out of the fountain, and all blood comes out of the veins. "Giving revolution and five words and eight rhymes" can only deceive blind examiners.但“革命人”就希有。俄国十月革命时，确曾有许多文人愿为革命尽力。但事实的狂风，终于转得他们手足无措。显明的例是诗人叶遂宁的自杀，还有小说家梭波里，他最后的话是：“活不下去了！”
But "revolutionaries" are rare. During the October Revolution in Russia, there were indeed many literati who were willing to do their best for the revolution. But the wind of facts finally turned them at a loss. A clear example is the suicide of the poet Ye Suining, and the novelist Sopoli, whose last words were: "I can't live anymore!" ”在革命时代有大叫“活不下去了”的勇气，才可以做革命文学。
In the revolutionary era, only those who have the courage to shout "I can't live anymore" can do revolutionary literature.叶遂宁和梭波里终于不是革命文学家。为什么呢，因为俄国是实在在革命。革命文学家风起云涌的所在，其实是并没有革命的。
Ye Suining and Sopoli were not revolutionary writers after all. Why, because Russia is a real revolution. Where revolutionary writers are surging, there is actually no revolution.

《尘影》题辞

《尘影》题辞

《尘影》题辞

"Dust Shadow" inscription在我自己，觉得中国现在是一个进向大时代的时代。但这所谓大，并不一定指可以由此得生，而也可以由此得死。
In my own opinion, China is now an era of great progress. But this so-called big does not necessarily mean that you can live from it, but you can also die from it.许多为爱的献身者，已经由此得死。在其先，玩着意中而且意外的血的游戏，以愉快和满意，以及单是好看和热闹，赠给身在局内而旁观的人们；但同时也给若干人以重压。
Many devotees of love have died because of this. First, play the game of blood that is intentional and unexpected, and give it to the people who are watching in the game with pleasure and satisfaction, as well as just good looks and liveliness; But at the same time, it also puts a lot of pressure on several people.这重压除去的时候，不是死，就是生。这才是大时代。
When this pressure is removed, it is either death or life. This is the big era.在异性中看见爱，在百合花中看见天堂，在拾煤渣的老妇人的魂灵中看见拜金主义，世界现在常为受机关枪拥护的仁义所治理，在此时此地听到这样的消息，我委实身心舒服，如喝好酒。然而《尘影》所赍来的，却是重压。
Seeing love in the opposite sex, heaven in the lilies, seeing money worship in the spirit of an old woman picking up cinders, the world is now often ruled by benevolence and righteousness supported by machine guns, and hearing such news here and now, I am truly physically and mentally comfortable, like drinking good wine. However, what "Dust Shadow" brings is heavy pressure.现在的文艺，是往往给人不舒服的，没有法子。要不然，只好使自己逃出文艺，或者从文艺推出人生。
Today's literature and art are often uncomfortable and there is no way. Otherwise, you have to escape from literature and art, or push your life out of literature and art.谁更为仁义和钞票写照，为三道血的“难看”传神呢？我看见一篇《尘影》，它的愉快和重压留与各色的人们。
Who is more benevolent and righteous and banknotes, and conveys the "ugly" of the three bloods? I saw a piece of "Dust Shadow", and its joy and weight were left with people of all colors.然而在结末的“尘影”中却又给我喝了一口好酒。
However, in the "dust shadow" at the end, he gave me another sip of good wine.他将小宝留下，不告诉我们后来是得死，还是得生。作者不愿意使我们太受重压罢。但这是好的，因为我觉得中国现在是进向大时代的时代。
He left Xiaobao behind and did not tell us whether he would die or live later. The author does not want to put us under too much pressure. But this is good because I think China is now in the era of the big era.一九二七年十二月七日，鲁迅记于上海。
