当陶元庆君的绘画展览时　我所要说的几句话

当陶元庆君的绘画展览时When Tao Yuanqingjun's paintings were exhibited我所要说的几句话, I would like to say a few words
陶元庆君绘画的展览，我在北京所见的是第一回。记得那时曾经说过这样意思的话：他以新的形，尤其是新的色来写出他自己的世界，而其中仍有中国向来的魂灵——要字面免得流于玄虚，则就是：民族性。
The exhibition of Tao Yuanqingjun's paintings is the first one I have seen in Beijing. I remember saying that he used to write his own world in new forms, especially new colors, and there was still the soul of China in it - literally, so as not to be mysterious, that is: national character.我觉得我的话在上海也没有改正的必要。
I don't think there is any need to correct my words in Shanghai.中国现今的一部分人，确是很有些苦闷。我想，这是古国的青年的迟暮之感。世界的时代思潮早已六面袭来，而自己还拘禁在三千年陈的桎梏里。于是觉醒，挣扎，反叛，要出而参与世界的事业——我要范围说得小一点：文艺之业。倘使中国之在世界上不算在错，则这样的情形我以为也是对的。
Some people in China today are indeed very distressed. I think this is the twilight feeling of the youth of the ancient country. The world's trend of thought has already struck from all sides, and he is still imprisoned in the shackles of three thousand years old. So awakening, struggle, rebellion, and going out to participate in the cause of the world - I want to put it in a smaller way: the literary industry. If China is not wrong in the world, then I think this situation is also correct.然而现在外面的许多艺术界中人，已经对于自然反叛，将自然割裂，改造了。而文艺史界中人，则舍了用惯的向来以为是“永久”的旧尺，另以各时代各民族的固有的尺，来量各时代各民族的艺术，于是向埃及坟中的绘画赞叹，对黑人刀柄上的雕刻点头，这往往使我们误解，以为要再回到旧日的桎梏里。而新艺术家们勇猛的反叛，则震惊我们的耳目，又往往不能不感服。但是，我们是迟暮了，并未参与过先前的事业，于是有时就不过敬谨接收，又成了一种可敬的身外的新桎梏。
However, many people in the art world outside have rebelled against nature, separated it, and transformed it. However, people in the literary and artistic history circles abandoned the old ruler that they had always thought to be "permanent", and used the inherent ruler of each era and ethnic group to measure the art of each era and ethnic group, so they admired the paintings in the Egyptian tombs and nodded at the carvings on the handle of the black sword, which often misled us into thinking that we wanted to return to the shackles of the past. The brave rebellion of new artists shocks our ears and eyes, and we often cannot help but be impressed. However, we are late and have not participated in our previous careers, so sometimes we are just respectful and acceptable, and it has become a respectable new shackle outside the body.陶元庆君的绘画，是没有这两重桎梏的。就因为内外两面，都和世界的时代思潮合流，而又并未梏亡中国的民族性。
Tao Yuanqingjun's paintings do not have these two shackles. Just because both internal and external aspects merge with the world's ideological trends, but they do not shackle China's national character.我于艺术界的事知道得极少，关于文字的事较为留心些。就如白话，从中，更就世所谓“欧化语体”来说罢。有人斥道：你用这样的语体，可惜皮肤不白，鼻梁不高呀！诚然，这教训是严厉的。但是，皮肤一白，鼻梁一高，他用的大概是欧文，不是欧化语体了。正唯其皮不白，鼻不高而偏要“的呵吗呢”，并且一句里用许多的“的”字，这才是为世诟病的今日的中国的我辈。
I know very little about the art world, and I pay more attention to words. Just like the vernacular, from the middle, let's talk about the so-called "Europeanized language" in the world. Someone reprimanded: You use such a language, but unfortunately your skin is not white and the bridge of your nose is not high! True, the lesson is harsh. However, when his skin was white and the bridge of his nose was high, he probably used Irving, not European. It is only because its skin is not white, the nose is not high, but it wants "huh", and many "of" words are used in one sentence, which is our generation in today's China that is criticized by the world.但我并非将欧化文来比拟陶元庆君的绘画。意思只在说：他并非“之乎者也”，因为用的是新的形和新的色；而又不是“Yes”“No”，因为他究竟是中国人。所以，用密达尺来量，是不对的，但也不能用什么汉朝的虑傂尺或清朝的营造尺，因为他又已经是现今的人。我想，必须用存在于现今想要参与世界上的事业的中国人的心里的尺来量，这才懂得他的艺术。
But I am not comparing Ouhuawen to Tao Yuanqingjun's paintings. It only means that he is not "the one who is also the one who does it", because he uses new shapes and new colors; And it is not "Yes" and "No", because he is Chinese. Therefore, it is not right to use the Mida ruler to measure, but it is also not possible to use the Han Dynasty's ruler or the Qing Dynasty's construction ruler, because he is already a person today. I think we must measure it with the ruler of the hearts of Chinese people who want to participate in the cause of the world today, so that we can understand his art.一九二七年十二月十三日，鲁迅于上海记。

卢梭和胃口

卢梭和胃口

卢梭和胃口

Rousseau and appetite做过《民约论》的卢梭，自从他还未死掉的时候起，便受人们的责备和迫害，直到现在，责备终于没有完。连在和“民约”没有什么关系的中华民国，也难免这一幕了。
Rousseau, who wrote the "Treatise on the People's Covenant", has been reproached and persecuted by people since he was not dead, and until now, the reproach has not ended. Even in the Republic of China, which has nothing to do with the "People's Covenant", this scene is inevitable.例如商务印书馆出版的《爱弥尔》中文译本的序文上，就说——
For example, in the preface to the Chinese translation of "Emil" published by the Commercial Press, it is said -“……本书的第五编即女子教育，他的主张非但不彻底，而且不承认女子的人格，与前四编的尊重人类相矛盾。……所以在今日看来，他对于人类正当的主张，可说只树得一半……。”
“…… The fifth part of this book, women's education, is not only incomplete, but also does not recognize women's personality, which contradicts the respect for human beings in the first four parts. …… Therefore, in today's view, his legitimate claim to mankind can only be said to be half ....... ”然而复旦大学出版的《复旦旬刊》创刊号上梁实秋教授的意思，却“稍微有点不同”了。其实岂但“稍微”而已耶，乃是“卢梭论教育，无一是处，唯其论女子教育，的确精当。”因为那是“根据于男女的性质与体格的差别而来”的。而近代生物学和心理学研究的结果，又证明着天下没有两个人是无差别。怎样的人就该施以怎样的教育。所以，梁先生说——
However, the meaning of Professor Liang Shiqiu in the first issue of "Fudan Xunan" published by Fudan University is "slightly different". In fact, it is not just "slightly", but "Rousseau's theory of education is useless, but his discussion of women's education is indeed accurate." Because it is "based on the difference in nature and physique between men and women." The results of modern biology and psychological research prove that there are no two people in the world who are indistinguishable. What kind of education should be given to people. Therefore, Mr. Liang said -“我觉得‘人’字根本的该从字典里永远注销，或由政府下令永禁行使。因为‘人’字的意义太糊涂了。聪明绝顶的人，我们叫他做人，蠢笨如牛的人，也一样的叫做人，弱不禁风的女子，叫做人，粗横强大的男人，也叫做人，人里面的三流九等，无一非人。近代的德谟克拉西的思想，平等的观念，其起源即由于不承认人类的差别。近代所谓的男女平等运动，其起源即由于不承认男女的差别。人格是一个抽象名词，是一个人的身心各方面的特点的总和。人的身心各方面的特点既有差别，实即人格上亦有差别。所谓侮辱人格的，即是不承认一个人特有的人格，卢梭承认女子有女子的人格，所以卢梭正是尊重女子的人格。抹杀女子所特有之特性者，才是侮辱女子人格。”
"I think the word 'person' should be forever written off from the dictionary, or the government should order it to be banned forever. Because the meaning of the word 'people' is too confusing. A person who is extremely smart, we call him a person, a person who is as stupid as a cow is also called a person, a weak woman who can't help the wind, a man who is rough and powerful, also called a person, and the third and ninth ranks in a person are all human. The modern idea of Democracy, the concept of equality, has its origin in the non-recognition of human differences. The origin of the so-called gender equality movement in modern times is due to the non-recognition of differences between men and women. Personality is an abstract term, the sum of the characteristics of a person's body and mind. There are differences in the characteristics of human body and mind, and in fact, there are also differences in personality. The so-called insult to personality is not to recognize a person's unique personality, Rousseau admits that a woman has a woman's personality, so Rousseau respects the personality of a woman. erasing the unique characteristics of women is insulting the female personality. ”于是势必至于得到这样的结论——
So it is bound to come to such a conclusion -“……正当的女子教育应该是使女子成为完全的女子。”
“…… Proper women's education should make women perfect women. ”那么，所谓正当的教育者，也应该是使“弱不禁风”者，成为完全的“弱不禁风”，“蠢笨如牛”者，成为完全的“蠢笨如牛”，这才免于侮辱各人——此字在未经从字典里永远注销，政府下令永禁行使之前，暂且使用——的人格了。卢梭《爱弥尔》前四编的主张不这样，其“无一是处”，于是可以算无疑。
Then, the so-called legitimate educator should also make those who are "weak and unable to resist the wind" become completely "weak and unbearable", "stupid as cows", and become completely "stupid as cows", so as not to insult everyone—this word is temporarily used before it is forever written off from the dictionary and the government orders it to be banned forever. The first four parts of Rousseau's "Emil" are not like this, and their "uselessness" can be regarded as undoubted.但这所谓“无一是处”者，也只是对于“聪明绝顶的人”而言；在“蠢笨如牛的人”，却是“正当”的教育。因为看了这样的议论，可以使他更渐近于完全“蠢笨如牛”。这也就是尊重他的人格。
But this so-called "nothing" is only for "extremely smart people"; In "people who are stupid as cows", it is a "legitimate" education. Because reading such discussions can make him closer to being completely "stupid as a cow". This is to respect his personality.然而这种议论还是不会完结的。为什么呢？一者，因为即使知道说“自然的不平等”，而不容易明白真“自然”和“因积渐的人为而似自然”之分。二者，因为凡有学说，往往“合吾人之胃口者则容纳之，且从而宣扬之”也。
However, this discussion will not end. Why? First, because even if we know about "natural inequality", it is not easy to understand the difference between true "nature" and "natural because of accumulation of artificiality". Second, because all doctrines are often "accepted and promoted if they meet our appetites."上海一隅，前二年大谈亚诺德，今年大谈白璧德，恐怕也就是胃口之故罢。
In a corner of Shanghai, two years ago there was a lot of talk about Arnold, and this year there was a lot of talk about Bai Bide, I'm afraid it was because of the appetite.许多问题大抵发生于“胃口”，胃口的差别，也正如“人”字一样的——其实这两字也应该呈请政府“下令永禁行使”。我且抄一段同是美国的Upton Sinclair的，以尊重另一种人格罢——
Many problems mostly arise from "appetite", and the difference in appetite is the same as the word "person" - in fact, these two words should also petition the government to "order a permanent ban". I will copy a passage from Upton Sinclair, also from the United States, to honor another person—“无论在那一个卢梭的批评家，都有首先应该解决的唯一的问题。为什么你和他吵闹的？要为他的到达点的那自由，平等，调协开路么？还是因为畏惧卢梭所发向世界上的新思想和新感情的激流呢？使对于他取了为父之劳的个人主义运动的全体怀疑，将我们带到子女服从父母，奴隶服从主人，妻子服从丈夫，臣民服从教皇和皇帝，大学生毫不发生疑问，而佩服教授的讲义的善良的古代去，乃是你的目的么？
"No matter which Rousseau critic is, there is only one problem that should be solved first. Why are you arguing with him? To open the way for the freedom, equality, and coordination of his destination? Or is it because they are afraid of Rousseau's torrent of new ideas and feelings into the world? Is it your purpose to make all doubts about the individualistic movement of his father's labor, to bring us to the ancient times where children obey their parents, slaves obey their masters, wives obey their husbands, subjects obey the pope and emperor, and the university students have no doubts, and admire the goodness of the professor's lectures?“阿嶷夫人曰：‘最后的一句，好像是对于白璧德教授的一箭似的。’
"Mrs. Ah Yi said: 'The last sentence seems to be an arrow to Professor Bai Bide.'“‘奇怪呀，’她的丈夫说。‘斯人也而有斯姓也……那一定是上帝的审判了。’”
"'It's strange,' said her husband. This person has such a surname...... It must be God's judgment. ’”不知道和原意可有错误，因为我是从日本文重译的。书的原名是《Mammonart》，在California的Pasadena作者自己出版，胃口相近的人们自己弄来看去罢。Mammon是希腊神话里的财神，art谁都知道是艺术。可以译作“财神艺术”罢。日本的译名是“拜金艺术”，也行。因为这一个字是作者生造的，政府既没有下令颁行，字典里也大概未曾注入，所以姑且在这里加一点解释。
I don't know if there is a mistake in the original meaning, because I retranslated it from Japanese. The original title of the book was "Mammonart", and the author published it himself in Pasadena, California, and people with similar appetites got it for themselves. Mammon is the god of wealth in Greek mythology, and everyone knows that art is art. It can be translated as "God of Wealth Art". The Japanese translation is "gold worship art", which is also fine. Because this word was created by the author, the government neither ordered it to be promulgated, nor was it probably injected into the dictionary, so I will add a little explanation here.十二，二一。

文学和出汗

文学和出汗

文学和出汗

Literature and sweating上海的教授对人讲文学，以为文学当描写永远不变的人性，否则便不久长。例如英国，莎士比亚和别的一两个人所写的是永久不变的人性，所以至今流传，其余的不这样，就都消灭了云。
Professors in Shanghai talk about literature, thinking that literature should describe the ever-changing human nature, otherwise it will not last long. For example, in England, Shakespeare and one or two others wrote about the permanent and unchanging human nature, so it has been passed down to this day, and the rest have disappeared if they are not like this.这真是所谓“你不说我倒还明白，你越说我越胡涂”了。英国有许多先前的文章不流传，我想，这是总会有的，但竟没有想到它们的消灭，乃因为不写永久不变的人性。现在既然知道了这一层，却更不解它们既已消灭，现在的教授何从看见，却居然断定它们所写的都不是永久不变的人性了。
This is really the so-called "I understand if you don't say it, the more you say it, the more nonsense I get". There are many previous articles in the UK that have not been circulated, and I think there will always be, but I did not expect their extinction because they did not write about permanent and unchanging human nature. Now that I know this layer, I am even more puzzled that since they have been eliminated, how can the current professor see it, but actually conclude that what they write is not permanent and unchanging human nature.只要流传的便是好文学，只要消灭的便是坏文学；抢得天下的便是王，抢不到天下的便是贼。莫非中国式的历史论，也将沟通了中国人的文学论欤？
As long as it is circulated, it is good literature, and as long as it is destroyed, it is bad literature; The one who can grab the world is the king, and the one who can't grab the world is the thief. Could it be that the Chinese-style theory of history also communicates with the Chinese literary theory?而且，人性是永久不变的么？
Moreover, is human nature permanent?类人猿，类猿人，原人，古人，今人，未来的人，……如果生物真会进化，人性就不能永久不变。不说类猿人，就是原人的脾气，我们大约就很难猜得着的，则我们的脾气，恐怕未来的人也未必会明白。要写永久不变的人性，实在难哪。
great apes, apes, primitive people, ancient people, modern people, and future people,...... If living things really evolve, human nature cannot remain unchanged. Not to mention the ape-like people, it is the temper of the original people, which is probably difficult for us to guess, so I am afraid that our temper may not be understood by people in the future. It is really difficult to write about permanent and unchanging human nature.譬如出汗罢，我想，似乎于古有之，于今也有，将来一定暂时也还有，该可以算得较为“永久不变的人性”了。然而“弱不禁风”的小姐出的是香汗，“蠢笨如牛”的工人出的是臭汗。不知道倘要做长留世上的文字，要充长留世上的文学家，是描写香汗好呢，还是描写臭汗好？这问题倘不先行解决，则在将来文学史上的位置，委实是“岌岌乎殆哉”。
For example, sweating, I think, seems to have existed in ancient times, there are also in the present, and there must be temporarily in the future, which should be regarded as more "permanent and unchanging human nature". However, the "weak and windy" lady sweats, and the "stupid as a cow" worker sweats. I don't know if it is better to write about the fragrant sweat or the stinky sweat if you want to be a writer who will remain in the world for a long time? If this problem is not solved first, its position in the history of literature in the future will be "precarious".听说，例如英国，那小说，先前是大抵写给太太小姐们看的，其中自然是香汗多；到十九世纪后半，受了俄国文学的影响，就很有些臭汗气了。那一种的命长，现在似乎还在不可知之数。
I heard that, for example, in England, the novel was probably written for ladies and ladies before, and naturally there was a lot of fragrance; In the second half of the nineteenth century, under the influence of Russian literature, it was very sweaty. The length of life of that kind still seems to be unknown.在中国，从道士听论道，从批评家听谈文，都令人毛孔痉挛，汗不敢出。然而这也许倒是中国的“永久不变的人性”罢。
In China, listening to Taoist teachings from Taoist priests and critics to talk about them makes people cramp and sweat. However, this may be China's "permanent and unchanging humanity".二七，一二，二三。

文艺和革命

文艺和革命

文艺和革命

Literature and Revolution欢喜维持文艺的人们，每在革命地方，便爱说“文艺是革命的先驱”。
People who like to maintain literature and art like to say that "literature and art are the forerunners of the revolution" whenever they are in a revolutionary place.我觉得这很可疑。或者外国是如此的罢；中国自有其特别国情，应该在例外。现在妄加编排，以质同志——
I think it's suspicious. Or is it like this in foreign countries; China has its own special national conditions and should be an exception. Now I am arranging it to challenge comrades -1，革命军。 先要有军，才能革命，凡已经革命的地方，都是军队先到的：这是先驱。大军官们也许到得迟一点，但自然也是先驱，无须多说。
1. Revolutionary Army. Wherever the revolution has been made, the army will arrive first: this is the pioneer. The officers may arrive a little late, but they are naturally pioneers, needless to say.（这之前，有时恐怕也有青年潜入宣传，工人起来暗助，但这些人们大抵已经死掉，或则无从查考了，置之不论。）
(Before this, I am afraid that sometimes young people infiltrate propaganda and workers rise up to help secretly, but these people are probably dead, or there is no way to investigate, and they are ignored.) ）2，人民代表。 军官们一到，便有人民代表群集车站欢迎，手执国旗，嘴喊口号，“革命空气，非常浓厚”：这是第二先驱。
2. People's representatives. As soon as the officers arrived, the people's deputies gathered at the station to welcome them, holding the national flag and shouting slogans, "The revolutionary air is very strong": this is the second pioneer.3，文学家。 于是什么革命文学，民众文学，同情文学，飞腾文学都出来了，伟大光明的名称的期刊也出来了，来指导青年的：这是——可惜得很，但也不要紧——第三先驱。
3. Writers. So what kind of revolutionary literature, popular literature, sympathy literature, and soaring literature all came out, and periodicals with great and bright names came out to guide the youth: this is - a pity, but it doesn't matter - the third pioneer.外国是革命军兴以前，就有被迫出国的卢梭，流放极边的珂罗连珂……。
Before the rise of the revolutionary army, there were Rousseau who was forced to go abroad and Korolenko who was exiled to the extreme .......好了。倘若硬要乐观，也可以了。因为我们常听到所谓文学家将要出国的消息，看见新闻上的记载，广告；看见诗；看见文。虽然尚未动身，却也给我们一种“将来学成归国，了不得呀！”的豫感，——希望是谁都愿意有的。
All right. If you insist on being optimistic, it's okay. Because we often hear the news that so-called writers are going abroad, and we see records and advertisements in the news; See poetry; See the text. Although he has not yet left, he also gives us a sense of "returning to China after completing his studies in the future, which is amazing!" I hope that everyone is willing to have it,——十二月二十四夜零点一分五秒。

谈所谓“大内档案”

谈所谓“大内档案”

谈所谓“大内档案”

Talking about the so-called "Inner Archives"所谓“大内档案”这东西，在清朝的内阁里积存了三百多年，在孔庙里塞了十多年，谁也一声不响。自从历史博物馆将这残余卖给纸铺子，纸铺子转卖给罗振玉，罗振玉转卖给日本人，于是乎大有号咷之声，仿佛国宝已失，国脉随之似的。前几年，我也曾见过几个人的议论，所记得的一个是金梁，登在《东方杂志》上；还有罗振玉和王国维，随时发感慨。最近的是《北新半月刊》上的《论档案的售出》，蒋彝潜先生做的。
The so-called "Inner Archives" have been accumulated in the cabinet of the Qing Dynasty for more than 300 years, and have been stuffed in the Confucius Temple for more than ten years, and no one has made a sound. Since the history museum sold this remnant to the paper shop, the paper shop resold it to Luo Zhenyu, and Luo Zhenyu resold it to the Japanese, so there was a loud noise, as if the national treasure had been lost and the national vein followed. A few years ago, I also saw several people's discussions, and the one I remember was Jin Liang, which was published in "Oriental Magazine"; There are also Luo Zhenyu and Wang Guowei, who sigh at any time. The most recent one is "On the Sale of Archives" in the "Beixin Semi-Monthly", which was done by Mr. Jiang Yiqian.我觉得他们的议论都不大确。金梁，本是杭州的驻防旗人，早先主张排汉的，民国以来，便算是遗老了，凡有民国所做的事，他自然都以为很可恶。罗振玉呢，也算是遗老，曾经立誓不见国门，而后来仆仆京津间，痛责后生不好古，而偏将古董卖给外国人的，只要看他的题跋，大抵有“广告”气扑鼻，便知道“于意云何”了。独有王国维已经在水里将遗老生活结束，是老实人；但他的感喟，却往往和罗振玉一鼻孔出气，虽然所出的气，有真假之分。所以他被弄成夹广告的Sandwich，是常有的事，因为他老实到像火腿一般。蒋先生是例外，我看并非遗老，只因为Sentimental一点，所以受了罗振玉辈的骗了。你想，他要将这卖给日本人，肯说这不是宝贝的么？
I don't think their arguments are very accurate. Jin Liang, who was originally the garrison flag man of Hangzhou, had previously advocated the exclusion of Han, and since the Republic of China, he has been regarded as an old man, and he naturally thinks that everything that the Republic of China has done is very hateful. Luo Zhenyu, who can also be regarded as an old man, once swore not to see the country, and then served in Beijing and Tianjin, blaming the younger generation for not being good at antiquity, and selling antiques to foreigners, as long as you look at his inscription, there is probably an "advertisement", and you will know "what does it mean". Only Wang Guowei has ended his life in the water and is an honest person; But his feelings are often the same as Luo Zhenyu's nostrils, although the anger he exhales is true and false. So it's not uncommon for him to be made into a Sandwich with an advertisement, because he's as honest as a ham. Mr. Jiang is an exception, I don't think he is an old man, just because he is a little sentimental, so he was deceived by Luo Zhenyu and his generation. Do you think he wants to sell this to the Japanese, and will he say that this is not a treasure?那么，这不是好东西么？不好，怎么你也要买，我也要买呢？我想，这是谁也要发的质问。
So, isn't this a good thing? It's not good, why do you want to buy it, and I want to buy it too? I think this is a question that everyone has to ask.答曰：唯唯，否否。这正如败落大户家里的一堆废纸，说好也行，说无用也行的。因为是废纸，所以无用；因为是败落大户家里的，所以也许夹些好东西。况且这所谓好与不好，也因人的看法而不同，我的寓所近旁的一个垃圾箱，里面都是住户所弃的无用的东西，但我看见早上总有几个背着竹篮的人，从那里面一片一片，一块一块，检了什么东西去了，还有用。更何况现在的时候，皇帝也还尊贵，只要在“大内”里放几天，或者带一个“宫”字，就容易使人另眼相看的，这真是说也不信，虽然在民国。
Answer: Yes, no, no. This is like a pile of waste paper in the home of a fallen family, which can be said to be good or useless. Because it is waste paper, it is useless; Because it is from a wealthy family, maybe it will pick up some good things. A garbage bin near my apartment was full of useless things thrown away by the residents, but I saw that there were always a few people carrying bamboo baskets in the morning, from which they checked something one by one, piece by piece, and it was still useful. What's more, now, the emperor is still noble, as long as he puts it in the "inner palace" for a few days, or brings a word "palace", it is easy to make people look at each other differently, which is really unbelievable, although in the Republic of China.“大内档案”也者，据深通“国朝”掌故的罗遗老说，是他的“国朝”时堆在内阁里的乱纸，大家主张焚弃，经他力争，这才保留下来的。但到他的“国朝”退位，民国元年我到北京的时候，它们已经被装为八千（？）麻袋，塞在孔庙之中的敬一亭里了，的确满满地埋满了大半亭子。其时孔庙里设了一个历史博物馆筹备处，处长是胡玉缙先生。“筹备处”云者，即里面并无“历史博物”的意思。
The "Inner Archives", according to Luo Yilao, who was in charge of the "National Dynasty", were the messy papers piled up in the cabinet during his "National Dynasty", and everyone advocated burning them, and after his efforts, they were preserved. A journal in Guangzhou said that I only beat dogs and did not scold warlords. As everyone knows, it is precisely because I scolded the dog that I had the fate of escaping from Beijing. Ah, it's not good to keep talking, hurry up and take it.现在是寓在南方，大约不妨说几句了，这些事情，将来恐怕也未必另外有人说。但我对于有关面子的人物，仍然都不用真姓名，将罗马字来替代。既非欧化，也不是“隐恶扬善”，只不过“远害全身”。这也是我的“世故”，不要以为自己在南方，他们在北方，或者不知所在，就小觑他们。他们是突然会在你眼前阔起来的，真是神奇得很。这时候，恐怕就会死得连自己也莫明其妙了。所以要稳当，最好是不说。但我现在来“折衷”，既非不说，而不尽说，而代以罗马字，——如果这样还不妥，那么，也只好听天由命了。上帝安我魂灵！
Now that I live in the south, I might as well say a few words, and I am afraid that no one else will say these things in the future. But now I come to "compromise", neither to say nor to say everything, but to replace it with Roman characters,—— if this is not appropriate, then I have to resign myself to fate. God peace my soul!却说这些麻袋们躺在敬一亭里，就很令历史博物馆筹备处长胡玉缙先生担忧，日夜提防工役们放火。为什么呢？这事谈起来可有些繁复了。弄些所谓“国学”的人大概都知道，胡先生原是南菁书院的高材生，不但深研旧学，并且博识前朝掌故的。他知道清朝武英殿里藏过一副铜活字，后来太监们你也偷，我也偷，偷得“不亦乐乎”，待到王爷们似乎要来查考的时候，就放了一把火。自然，连武英殿也没有了，更何况铜活字的多少。而不幸敬一亭中的麻袋，也仿佛常常减少，工役们不是国学家，所以他将内容的宝贝倒在地上，单拿麻袋去卖钱。胡先生因此想到武英殿失火的故事，深怕麻袋缺得多了之后，敬一亭也照例烧起来；就到教育部去商议一个迁移，或整理，或销毁的办法。

The Department of Social Education is in charge of this kind of matter, but the director is Mr. Xia Zengyou. But this will be discussed later, because in recent days, "Mr. Gu Tong" has also "settled in Dongjiaomin Alley" like "politicians, rich people, revolutionary progressives and leaders of the people".
这一篇是一九二六年四月十三日作的，就登在那年四月的《京报副刊》上，名单即见于《京报》。用“唯饭史观”的眼光，来探究所以要捉这凑成“大衍之数”的人们的原因，虽然并不出奇，但由今观之，还觉得“不为无见”。本来是要编入《华盖集续编》中的，继而一想，自己虽然走出北京了，但其中的许多人，却还在军阀势力之下，何必重印旧账，使叭儿狗们记得起来呢。于是就抽掉了。但现在情势，却已不同，虽然其中已有两人被杀，数人失踪，而下通缉令之权，则已非段章诸公所有，他们万一不慎，倒可以为先前的被缉者所缉了。先前的有几个被缉者的座前，现在也许倒要有人开单来献，请缉别人了。《现代评论》也不但不再豫料革命之不成功，且登广告云：“现在国民政府收复北平，本周刊又有销行的机会（谨案：妙极）了”了。而浙江省党务指导委员会宣字一二六号令，则将《语丝》“严行禁止”了。此之所以为革命欤。因见语堂的《翦拂集》内，提及此文，便从小箱子里寻出，附存于末，以为纪念。
This article was written on April 13, 1926, and was published in the "Beijing News Supplement" in April of that year, and the list was found in the "Beijing News". From the perspective of "only rice history", to explore the reasons for catching these people who made up the "number of Dayan", although it is not surprising, but from today's point of view, I still feel that "it is not unseen". It was originally intended to be compiled into the "Continuation of the Huagai Collection", and then I thought about it, although I had gone out of Beijing, many of them were still under the power of the warlords, so why reprint the old accounts so that the dogs would remember. So it was withdrawn. But now the situation is different, although two of them have been killed and several are missing, and the right to issue a wanted order is no longer owned by Duan Zhang's lords, and if they are not careful, they can be arrested by the previous arrestees. In front of the seats of several arrested people before, now maybe someone will issue an order to present it and ask others to be arrested. The "Modern Review" not only no longer anticipated the failure of the revolution, but also published an advertisement saying: "Now that the Nationalist government has recaptured Peking, this weekly magazine has another opportunity to sell (caution: wonderful)." The Zhejiang Provincial Party Affairs Steering Committee announced the No. 126 order, which "strictly prohibited" the "Language Silk". This is the reason for the revolution. Because I saw this article mentioned in Yutang's "Collection of Brushes", I found it from a small box and attached it at the end as a souvenir.一九二八年十月二十日，鲁迅记。
October 20, 1928, Lu Xunji.
