序言

序言

序言

序言我的第四本杂感《而已集》的出版，算起来已在四年之前了。去年春天，就有朋友催促我编集此后的杂感。看看近几年的出版界，创作和翻译，或大题目的长论文，是还不能说它寥落的，但短短的批评，纵意而谈，就是所谓“杂感”者，却确乎很少见。我一时也说不出这所以然的原因。
My fourth book "Miscellaneous Feelings" was published four years ago. Last spring, a friend urged me to compile the miscellaneous feelings after that. Looking at the publishing industry in recent years, it cannot be said that it is rare in the creation and translation, or long papers on big topics, but short criticisms, even if it is casually talked about, are the so-called "miscellaneous feelings", but it is indeed rare. I couldn't tell for a moment why this was the case.但粗粗一想，恐怕这“杂感”两个字，就使志趣高超的作者厌恶，避之惟恐不远了。有些人们，每当意在奚落我的时候，就往往称我为“杂感家”，以显出在高等文人的眼中的鄙视，便是一个证据。还有，我想，有名的作家虽然未必不改换姓名，写过这一类文字，但或者不过图报私怨，再提恐或玷其令名，或者别有深心，揭穿反有妨于战斗，因此就大抵任其消灭了。
But if you think about it roughly, I am afraid that the word "miscellaneous feelings" will disgust the author with high interests, and he is afraid that it will not be far away. Some people, whenever they intend to ridicule me, often call me a "miscellaneous sensationist" to show their contempt in the eyes of high literati, which is a proof. Also, I think that although famous writers may not change their names and write this kind of text, they may just try to avenge personal grievances, and then mention or tarnish their reputation, or have other deep intentions, exposing them will hinder the battle, so they will probably let them be destroyed.“杂感”之于我，有些人固然看作“死症”，我自己确也因此很吃过一点苦，但编集是还想编集的。只因为翻阅刊物，剪帖成书，也是一件颇觉麻烦的事，因此拖延了大半年，终于没有动过手。一月二十八日之夜，上海打起仗来了，越打越凶，终于使我们只好单身出走，书报留在火线下，一任它烧得精光，我也可以靠这“火的洗礼”之灵，洗掉了“不满于现状”的“杂感家”这一个恶谥。殊不料三月底重回旧寓，书报却丝毫也没有损，于是就东翻西觅，开手编辑起来了，好像大病新愈的人，偏比平时更要照照自己的瘦削的脸，摩摩枯皱的皮肤似的。
For me, "miscellaneous feelings" are certainly regarded by some people as "death disease", and I have indeed suffered a little because of this, but I still want to compile the collection. Just because it was a troublesome thing to read publications and cut them into books, it was also quite troublesome, so I delayed it for more than half a year and finally didn't do it. On the night of January 28, Shanghai started a war, and the more fierce it became, finally we had to run away alone, leaving the books and newspapers under the line of fire, and letting it burn to the ground. Unexpectedly, when he returned to his old residence at the end of March, the books and newspapers were not damaged at all, so he searched around and started editing them, as if a person who had just recovered from a serious illness had to take care of his thin face and wrinkled skin more than usual.我先编集一九二八至二九年的文字，篇数少得很，但除了五六回在北平上海的讲演，原就没有记录外，别的也仿佛并无散失。我记得起来了，这两年正是我极少写稿，没处投稿的时期。我是在二七年被血吓得目瞪口呆，离开广东的，那些吞吞吐吐，没有胆子直说的话，都载在《而已集》里。但我到了上海，却遇见文豪们的笔尖的围剿了，创造社，太阳社，“正人君子”们的新月社中人，都说我不好，连并不标榜文派的现在多升为作家或教授的先生们，那时的文字里，也得时常暗暗地奚落我几句，以表示他们的高明。我当初还不过是“有闲即是有钱”，“封建余孽”或“没落者”，后来竟被判为主张杀青年的棒喝主义者了。这时候，有一个从广东自云避祸逃来，而寄住在我的寓里的廖君，也终于忿忿的对我说道：“我的朋友都看不起我，不和我来往了，说我和这样的人住在一处。”
I first compiled the texts of 1928-29, which are very small, but except for the five or six speeches in Peking and Shanghai, which were not recorded, the others seem to have not been lost. I remember that these two years were the period when I rarely wrote manuscripts and had nowhere to submit. I was stunned by the blood in 27 years and left Guangdong, and those words that were hesitant and did not have the courage to speak directly were all recorded in the "Collected Works". But when I arrived in Shanghai, I met the encirclement and suppression of the pen tip of the literary masters, the Creation Society, the Sun Society, and the people of the Crescent Society of the "Righteous Gentlemen", all of whom said that I was not good, and even the gentlemen who did not advertise the literary school were now promoted to writers or professors, and at that time, they often had to secretly ridicule me a few words to show their brilliance. At the beginning, I was just "idle is rich", "feudal remnant" or "declining", but later I was convicted of being a stick drinker who advocated killing young people. At this time, a Liao Jun who fled from Guangdong to escape disaster and stayed in my apartment finally said to me angrily: "My friends look down on me and don't associate with me, saying that I live with such a person." ”那时候，我是成了“这样的人”的。自己编着的《语丝》，实乃无权，不单是有所顾忌（详见卷末《我和〈语丝〉的始终》），至于别处，则我的文章一向是被“挤”才有的，而目下正在“剿”，我投进去干什么呢。所以只写了很少的一点东西。
At that time, I became "such a person". The "Silk of Language" compiled by myself is actually powerless, not only because I have scruples (see "The Beginning and End of Me and the Silk" at the end of the volume for details), but elsewhere, my articles have always been "squeezed", and now they are being "suppressed", so what am I going to do with it? So only a little bit was written.现在我将那时所做的文字的错的和至今还有可取之处的，都收纳在这一本里。至于对手的文字呢，《鲁迅论》和《中国文艺论战》中虽然也有一些，但那都是峨冠博带的礼堂上的阳面的大文，并不足以窥见全体，我想另外搜集也是“杂感”一流的作品，编成一本，谓之《围剿集》。如果和我的这一本对比起来，不但可以增加读者的趣味，也更能明白别一面的，即阴面的战法的五花八门。这些方法一时恐怕不会失传，去年的“左翼作家都为了卢布”说，就是老谱里面的一着。自问和文艺有些关系的青年，仿照固然可以不必，但也不妨知道知道的。
Now I have included in this book all the mistakes of the words I made at that time and the ones that are still desirable today. As for the opponent's texts, although there are also some in "Lu Xun Theory" and "Chinese Literature and Art Debate", they are all large texts on the sunny side of the auditorium of the Eguan Bodai, which is not enough to get a glimpse of the whole. If you compare it with my book, it can not only increase the interest of readers, but also better understand the variety of tactics on the other side, that is, on the dark side. These methods may not be lost for a while, and last year's "left-wing writers are all for rubles" said, which is one of the old scores. Young people who ask themselves if they have something to do with literature and art may not have to imitate, but they may as well know what they know.其实呢，我自己省察，无论在小说中，在短评中，并无主张将青年来“杀，杀，杀”的痕迹，也没有怀着这样的心思。我一向是相信进化论的，总以为将来必胜于过去，青年必胜于老人，对于青年，我敬重之不暇，往往给我十刀，我只还他一箭。然而后来我明白我倒是错了。这并非唯物史观的理论或革命文艺的作品蛊惑我的，我在广东，就目睹了同是青年，而分成两大阵营，或则投书告密，或则助官捕人的事实！我的思路因此轰毁，后来便时常用了怀疑的眼光去看青年，不再无条件的敬畏了。然而此后也还为初初上阵的青年们呐喊几声，不过也没有什么大帮助。
In fact, I have examined myself, whether in the novel or in the short review, there is no trace of advocating that young people should be "killed, killed, killed", nor did I have such thoughts. I have always believed in evolution, always thinking that the future will be better than the past, the young will be better than the old, and I have no time to respect the young, often giving me ten knives, and I only return one arrow to him. But then I realized that I was wrong. This is not the theory of historical materialism or the works of revolutionary literature and art that bewitch me, I witnessed the fact that they were both young people, and they were divided into two camps, either sending letters to inform, or helping officials arrest people! My thinking was destroyed because of this, and then I often looked at young people with suspicion, and no longer was in awe unconditionally. However, after that, he also shouted a few times for the young people who were just starting out, but it didn't help much.这集子里所有的，大概是两年中所作的全部，只有书籍的序引，却只将觉得还有几句话可供参考之作，选录了几篇。当翻检书报时，一九二七年所写而没有编在《而已集》里的东西，也忽然发见了一点，我想，大约《夜记》是因为原想另成一书，讲演和通信是因为浅薄或不关紧要，所以那时不收在内的。
All in this collection is probably all that was done in two years, only the introduction to the book, but only a few works that I feel are still a few sentences for reference, and a few are selected. When I looked through the books and newspapers, I suddenly discovered something written in 1927 that was not included in the "Collected Works", and I think that "Night Diary" was probably because it was originally intended to be a separate book, and the lectures and correspondence were because they were shallow or irrelevant, so they were not included at that time.但现在又将这编在前面，作为《而已集》的补遗了。我另有了一样想头，以为只要看一篇讲演和通信中所引的文章，便足可明白那时香港的面目。我去讲演，一共两回，第一天是《老调子已经唱完》，现在寻不到底稿了，第二天便是这《无声的中国》，粗浅平庸到这地步，而竟至于惊为“邪说”，禁止在报上登载的。是这样的香港。但现在是这样的香港几乎要遍中国了。
But now this is compiled in front as an addendum to the "Collected Works". I had another idea, thinking that just reading an article quoted in a speech and correspondence would be enough to understand the face of Hong Kong at that time. I went to give a lecture twice, the first day was "The Old Tune Has Been Sung", and now I can't find the manuscript, and the second day is "Silent China", which is so superficial and mediocre that it is shocking that it is "heresy" and is prohibited from being published in the newspaper. That's how Hong Kong is. But now Hong Kong is almost all over China.我有一件事要感谢创造社的，是他们“挤”我看了几种科学底文艺论，明白了先前的文学史家们说了一大堆，还是纠缠不清的疑问。并且因此译了一本蒲力汗诺夫的《艺术论》，以救正我——还因我而及于别人——的只信进化论的偏颇。但是，我将编《中国小说史略》时所集的材料，印为《小说旧闻钞》，以省青年的检查之力，而成仿吾以无产阶级之名，指为“有闲”，而且“有闲”还至于有三个，却是至今还不能完全忘却的。我以为无产阶级是不会有这样锻炼周纳法的，他们没有学过“刀笔”。编成而名之曰《三闲集》，尚以射仿吾也。
One thing I would like to thank the Creation Society for is that they "squeezed" me to read several scientific theories on literature and art, and understood a lot of questions that the previous literary historians had said, but they were still entangled. And for this reason, he translated Pulikhanov's "Theory of Art" to correct the bias of only believing in evolution - and because of me. However, I will print the materials I collected when compiling the "Brief History of Chinese Novels" as "Novel Old News Banknotes", so as to imitate the power of the provincial youth to inspect it, and to imitate me in the name of the proletariat, referring to it as "leisure", and there are three "leisure", but it cannot be completely forgotten to this day. I thought that the proletariat would not exercise the Zhou Na method in this way, and they had not learned the "knife and pen". It was compiled and named "Three Leisure Collections", and it was still used to imitate me.一九三二年四月二十四日之夜，编讫并记。
On the night of April 24, 1932, the compilation was completed and recorded.

一九二七年

一九二七年

一九二七年

1927

无声的中国——二月十六日在香港青年会讲

无声的中国Silent China ——二月十六日在香港青年会讲 – Lecture at the Hong Kong YMCA on February 16
以我这样没有什么可听的无聊的讲演，又在这样大雨的时候，竟还有这许多来听的诸君，我首先应当声明我的郑重的感谢。
With such a boring speech that I have nothing to listen to, and when it rains so heavily, there are so many people who come to listen, I should first express my solemn gratitude.我现在所讲的题目是：《无声的中国》。
The title I am talking about now is: "Silent China".现在，浙江，陕西，都在打仗，那里的人民哭着呢还是笑着呢，我们不知道。香港似乎很太平，住在这里的中国人，舒服呢还是不很舒服呢，别人也不知道。
Now, Zhejiang and Shaanxi are all at war, and we don't know whether the people there are crying or laughing. Hong Kong seems to be very peaceful, and the Chinese living here are comfortable or not, and others don't know.发表自己的思想，感情给大家知道的是要用文章的，然而拿文章来达意，现在一般的中国人还做不到。这也怪不得我们；因为那文字，先就是我们的祖先留传给我们的可怕的遗产。人们费了多年的工夫，还是难于运用。因为难，许多人便不理它了，甚至于连自己的姓也写不清是张还是章，或者简直不会写，或者说道：Chang。虽然能说话，而只有几个人听到，远处的人们便不知道，结果也等于无声。又因为难，有些人便当作宝贝，像玩把戏似的，之乎者也，只有几个人懂，——其实是不知道可真懂，而大多数的人们却不懂得，结果也等于无声。
Expressing your thoughts and feelings to everyone is to use articles, but using articles to convey your intentions is not yet possible for ordinary Chinese. No wonder we are; Because that writing is the terrible legacy left to us by our ancestors. People have spent years of work, but it is still difficult to use. Because it is difficult, many people ignore it, and even their surname cannot be written clearly whether it is Zhang or Zhang, or they can't write it at all, or say: Chang. Although they can speak, only a few people hear them, and people in the distance don't know, and the result is also silent. And because it is difficult, some people treat it as a treasure, like playing a trick, but only a few people understand,—— in fact, they don't know but really understand, and most people don't understand, and the result is also equal to silence.文明人和野蛮人的分别，其一，是文明人有文字，能够把他们的思想，感情，藉此传给大众，传给将来。中国虽然有文字，现在却已经和大家不相干，用的是难懂的古文，讲的是陈旧的古意思，所有的声音，都是过去的，都就是只等于零的。所以，大家不能互相了解，正像一大盘散沙。
The difference between civilized people and barbarians, one is that civilized people have writing and can pass on their thoughts and feelings to the public and the future. Although China has writing, it is now irrelevant to everyone, using difficult ancient texts, speaking old ancient meanings, and all voices are in the past, and they are only equal to zero. Therefore, everyone cannot understand each other, just like a large plate of loose sand.将文章当作古董，以不能使人认识，使人懂得为好，也许是有趣的事罢。但是，结果怎样呢？是我们已经不能将我们想说的话说出来。我们受了损害，受了侮辱，总是不能说出些应说的话。拿最近的事情来说，如中日战争，拳匪事件，民元革命这些大事件，一直到现在，我们可有一部像样的著作？民国以来，也还是谁也不作声。反而在外国，倒常有说起中国的，但那都不是中国人自己的声音，是别人的声音。
It may be interesting to treat articles as antiques, so that they cannot be known and understood. But what was the result? It is that we can no longer say what we want to say. We are damaged, we are insulted, and we are always unable to say what we should say. Take recent events as an example, such as the Sino-Japanese War, the boxing incident, and the Minyuan Revolution, until now, do we have a decent book? Since the Republic of China, no one has made a sound. On the contrary, in foreign countries, there are often people talking about China, but it is not the Chinese's own voice, but someone else's voice.这不能说话的毛病，在明朝是还没有这样厉害的；他们还比较地能够说些要说的话。待到满洲人以异族侵入中国，讲历史的，尤其是讲宋末的事情的人被杀害了，讲时事的自然也被杀害了。所以，到乾隆年间，人民大家便更不敢用文章来说话了。所谓读书人，便只好躲起来读经，校刊古书，做些古时的文章，和当时毫无关系的文章。有些新意，也还是不行的；不是学韩，便是学苏。韩愈苏轼他们，用他们自己的文章来说当时要说的话，那当然可以的。我们却并非唐宋时人，怎么做和我们毫无关系的时候的文章呢。即使做得像，也是唐宋时代的声音，韩愈苏轼的声音，而不是我们现代的声音。然而直到现在，中国人却还耍着这样的旧戏法。人是有的，没有声音，寂寞得很。——人会没有声音的么？没有，可以说：是死了。倘要说得客气一点，那就是：已经哑了。
This problem of not being able to speak was not so powerful in the Ming Dynasty; They are also relatively able to say something to say. When the Manchurians invaded China with foreign races, those who talked about history, especially those who talked about the end of the Song Dynasty, were killed, and those who talked about current affairs were naturally killed. Therefore, by the Qianlong period, the people did not dare to use articles to speak. The so-called scholars had no choice but to hide and read the scriptures, edit ancient books, and make some ancient articles, which had nothing to do with the time. some new ideas, but they still don't work; Either learn from Han or learn from Su. Han Yu and Su Shi and the others, using their own articles to say what they wanted to say at that time, of course they could. We are not from the Tang and Song dynasties, so how can we write articles when they have nothing to do with us? Even if it is made similarly, it is the voice of the Tang and Song dynasties, the voice of Han Yu and Su Shi, not the voice of our modern age. However, until now, the Chinese are still playing such old tricks. There are people, there is no sound, and they are very lonely. ——Will people have no voice? No, it can be said: it is dead. If I want to put it more politely, it is: I am dumb.要恢复这多年无声的中国，是不容易的，正如命令一个死掉的人道：“你活过来！”我虽然并不懂得宗教，但我以为正如想出现一个宗教上之所谓“奇迹”一样。
It is not easy to restore this silent China for many years, just like ordering a dead person: "You come back to life!" "Although I don't know religion, I think it is like wanting a religious "miracle".首先来尝试这工作的是“五四运动”前一年，胡适之先生所提倡的“文学革命”。“革命”这两个字，在这里不知道可害怕，有些地方是一听到就害怕的。但这和文学两字连起来的“革命”，却没有法国革命的“革命”那么可怕，不过是革新，改换一个字，就很平和了，我们就称为“文学革新”罢，中国文字上，这样的花样是很多的。那大意也并不可怕，不过说：我们不必再去费尽心机，学说古代的死人的话，要说现代的活人的话；不要将文章看作古董，要做容易懂得的白话的文章。然而，单是文学革新是不够的，因为腐败思想，能用古文做，也能用白话做。所以后来就有人提倡思想革新。思想革新的结果，是发生社会革新运动。这运动一发生，自然一面就发生反动，于是便酿成战斗……。
The first to try this work was the "literary revolution" advocated by Mr. Hu Shizhi a year before the May Fourth Movement. The word "revolution" is not scary here, and some places are scary when you hear it. But this "revolution" connected with the word literature is not as terrible as the "revolution" of the French revolution, but it is an innovation, and if you change a word, it will be very peaceful, we will call it "literary innovation", and there are many such tricks in Chinese characters. The general idea is not terrible, but it says: we don't have to go to great lengths to learn the words of the dead in ancient times and the words of the living in modern times; Don't treat articles as antiques, but write articles in vernacular that are easy to understand. However, literary innovation alone is not enough, because corrupt ideas can be done in ancient texts and vernaculars. Therefore, some people later advocated ideological innovation. The result of ideological innovation is the social innovation movement. As soon as this movement occurred, there was a reaction on the natural side, which led to the ...... of fighting.但是，在中国，刚刚提起文学革新，就有反动了。不过白话文却渐渐风行起来，不大受阻碍。这是怎么一回事呢？就因为当时又有钱玄同先生提倡废止汉字，用罗马字母来替代。这本也不过是一种文字革新，很平常的，但被不喜欢改革的中国人听见，就大不得了了，于是便放过了比较的平和的文学革命，而竭力来骂钱玄同。白话乘了这一个机会，居然减去了许多敌人，反而没有阻碍，能够流行了。
However, in China, as soon as literary innovation is mentioned, there is a reaction. However, vernacular writing gradually became popular and was not hindered. What's going on? Just because at that time, Mr. Qian Xuantong advocated the abolition of Chinese characters and the replacement of them with Roman letters. This book is just a kind of literary innovation, very ordinary, but it is very big to be heard by Chinese who don't like reform, so they let go of the relatively peaceful literary revolution and try their best to scold Qian Xuantong. The vernacular took advantage of this opportunity to subtract many enemies, but there was no hindrance and it became popular.中国人的性情是总喜欢调和，折中的。譬如你说，这屋子太暗，须在这里开一个窗，大家一定不允许的。但如果你主张拆掉屋顶，他们就会来调和，愿意开窗了。没有更激烈的主张，他们总连平和的改革也不肯行。那时白话文之得以通行，就因为有废掉中国字而用罗马字母的议论的缘故。
The Chinese temperament is always to like to be harmonious and compromised. For example, if you say, this room is too dark, and you have to open a window here, no one will allow it. But if you advocate removing the roof, they will come to reconcile and be willing to open the windows. Without more drastic proposals, they always refuse to carry out peaceful reforms. At that time, vernacular literature was popular because of the discussion of abolishing Chinese characters and using the Roman alphabet.其实，文言和白话的优劣的讨论，本该早已过去了，但中国是总不肯早早解决的，到现在还有许多无谓的议论。例如，有的说：古文各省人都能懂，白话就各处不同，反而不能互相了解了。殊不知这只要教育普及和交通发达就好，那时就人人都能懂较为易解的白话文；至于古文，何尝各省人都能懂，便是一省里，也没有许多人懂得的。有的说：如果都用白话文，人们便不能看古书，中国的文化就灭亡了。其实呢，现在的人们大可以不必看古书，即使古书里真有好东西，也可以用白话来译出的，用不着那么心惊胆战。他们又有人说，外国尚且译中国书，足见其好，我们自己倒不看么？殊不知埃及的古书，外国人也译，非洲黑人的神话，外国人也译，他们别有用意，即使译出，也算不了怎样光荣的事的。
In fact, the discussion of the advantages and disadvantages of classical Chinese and vernacular should have long passed, but China has always refused to solve it early, and there are still many unnecessary discussions. For example, some people say: People in all provinces can understand ancient texts, but the vernacular is different everywhere, but they cannot understand each other. As everyone knows, as long as education is popularized and transportation is developed, everyone can understand the vernacular language that is easier to understand; As for the ancient text, people in all provinces can understand it, even in a province, and not many people understand it. Some people say: If they all use vernacular, people will not be able to read ancient books, and Chinese culture will perish. In fact, people nowadays don't have to read ancient books, even if there are really good things in ancient books, they can be translated in the vernacular, and there is no need to be so frightened. Some of them also say that foreign countries still translate Chinese books, which shows that it is good, don't we read it ourselves? As everyone knows, the ancient books of Egypt are also translated by foreigners, and the myths of black Africans are also translated by foreigners.近来还有一种说法，是思想革新紧要，文字改革倒在其次，所以不如用浅显的文言来作新思想的文章，可以少招一重反对。这话似乎也有理。然而我们知道，连他长指甲都不肯剪去的人，是决不肯剪去他的辫子的。
Recently, there is also a saying that ideological innovation is important, and writing reform is secondary, so it is better to use simple Chinese to write articles on new ideas, which can attract less opposition. This seems to make sense. However, we know that those who refuse to cut off even his long nails will never cut off his braids.因为我们说着古代的话，说着大家不明白，不听见的话，已经弄得像一盘散沙，痛痒不相关了。我们要活过来，首先就须由青年们不再说孔子孟子和韩愈柳宗元们的话。时代不同，情形也两样，孔子时代的香港不这样，孔子口调的“香港论”是无从做起的，“吁嗟阔哉香港也”，不过是笑话。
Because we are talking about ancient times, saying things that everyone doesn't understand or hear, it's already like a plate of loose sand, and the pain and itch are irrelevant. If we want to come back to life, we must first stop talking about Confucius, Mencius, Han Yu, Liu Zongyuan, and others. The "Hong Kong theory" of Confucius's tone is impossible to start, "Oh, Hong Kong is also great", it is just a joke.我们要说现代的，自己的话；用活着的白话，将自己的思想，感情直白地说出来。但是，这也要受前辈先生非笑的。他们说白话文卑鄙，没有价值；他们说年青人作品幼稚，贻笑大方。我们中国能做文言的有多少呢，其余的都只能说白话，难道这许多中国人，就都是卑鄙，没有价值的么？至于幼稚，尤其没有什么可羞，正如孩子对于老人，毫没有什么可羞一样。幼稚是会生长，会成熟的，只不要衰老，腐败，就好。倘说待到纯熟了才可以动手，那是虽是村妇也不至于这样蠢。她的孩子学走路，即使跌倒了，她决不至于叫孩子从此躺在床上，待到学会了走法再下地面来的。
We have to speak modern, our own words; Use living vernacular to speak your thoughts and feelings bluntly. However, this is also ridiculed by the seniors. They speak the vernacular vulgar and have no value; They said that young people's works were childish and generous. How many of us in China can do classical Chinese, and the rest can only speak vernacular, are these many Chinese all despicable and worthless? As for childishness, there is nothing to be ashamed of, just as children have nothing to be ashamed of for the elderly. Childishness will grow and mature, just don't age and corrupt. If you can only do it when you are proficient, it means that even a village woman will not be so stupid. Her child learns to walk, and even if he falls, she will never let him lie in bed until he learns how to walk before getting on the ground.青年们先可以将中国变成一个有声的中国。大胆地说话，勇敢地进行，忘掉了一切利害，推开了古人，将自己的真心的话发表出来。——真，自然是不容易的。譬如态度，就不容易真，讲演时候就不是我的真态度，因为我对朋友，孩子说话时候的态度是不这样的。——但总可以说些较真的话，发些较真的声音。只有真的声音，才能感动中国的人和世界的人；必须有了真的声音，才能和世界的人同在世界上生活。
Young people can turn China into a China with a voice. Speak boldly, proceed bravely, forget all the pros and cons, push away the ancients, and publish your sincere words. ——Really, naturally it is not easy. For example, attitude is not easy to be true, and it is not my true attitude when I speak, because my attitude towards friends and children is not like this. ——But you can always say something more truthful and make a more serious voice. Only true voices can touch the people of China and the world; There must be a real voice to live in the world with the people of the world.我们试想现在没有声音的民族是那几种民族。我们可听到埃及人的声音？可听到安南，朝鲜的声音？印度除了泰戈尔，别的声音可还有？
Let's imagine what kind of peoples are there now. Can we hear the Egyptians? Can you hear the voice of Annan and North Korea? Besides Tagore, does India have any other voices?我们此后实在只有两条路：一是抱着古文而死掉，一是舍掉古文而生存。
We really have only two ways to do it after that: one is to die with the ancient text, and the other is to abandon the ancient text and survive.

怎么写——夜记之一

怎么写How to write ——夜记之一 - one of the night notes
写什么是一个问题，怎么写又是一个问题。
What to write is a question, and how to write is another.今年不大写东西，而写给《莽原》的尤其少。我自己明白这原因。说起来是极可笑的，就因为它纸张好。有时有一点杂感，子细一看，觉得没有什么大意思，不要去填黑了那么洁白的纸张，便废然而止了。好的又没有。我的头里是如此地荒芜，浅陋，空虚。
This year, I don't write a lot of things, and there are especially few things written to "Mangyuan". I understand why. It's ridiculous to say, just because the paper is good. Sometimes there is a little miscellaneous feeling, and when you look closely, you don't think it's very interesting, don't fill in the black white paper, and it will be abandoned. Good and no. My head is so desolate, shallow, and empty.可谈的问题自然多得很，自宇宙以至社会国家，高超的还有文明，文艺。古来许多人谈过了，将来要谈的人也将无穷无尽。但我都不会谈。记得还是去年躲在厦门岛上的时候，因为太讨人厌了，终于得到“敬鬼神而远之”式的待遇，被供在图书馆楼上的一间屋子里。白天还有馆员，钉书匠，阅书的学生，夜九时后，一切星散，一所很大的洋楼里，除我以外，没有别人。我沉静下去了。寂静浓到如酒，令人微醺。望后窗外骨立的乱山中许多白点，是丛冢；一粒深黄色火，是南普陀寺的琉璃灯。前面则海天微茫，黑絮一般的夜色简直似乎要扑到心坎里。我靠了石栏远眺，听得自己的心音，四远还仿佛有无量悲哀，苦恼，零落，死灭，都杂入这寂静中，使它变成药酒，加色，加味，加香。这时，我曾经想要写，但是不能写，无从写。这也就是我所谓“当我沉默着的时候，我觉得充实，我将开口，同时感到空虚”。
There are naturally many issues to talk about, from the universe to the social state, and the superb are civilization and literature and art. Many people have talked about it since ancient times, and the people who will talk about it in the future will be endless. But I won't talk about it. I remember when I was hiding on Xiamen Island last year, because it was too annoying, I finally got the treatment of "respecting ghosts and gods and staying away" and was offered in a room upstairs in the library. During the day, there were librarians, staples, and reading students, and after nine o'clock at night, everything dispersed, and there was no one else in a large western-style building. I calmed down. The silence was as thick as wine, slightly tipsy. Looking out the window, there are many white spots in the mountains that stand tall, which are cluster graves; A deep yellow fire is the glass lamp of Nanputuo Temple. In front of it, the sea and sky were faintly hazy, and the black fluff-like night seemed to hit the heart. I leaned against the stone railing and looked into the distance, hearing my heart's voice, and it seemed that there was immeasurable sorrow, distress, scattering, and death in the distance, all mixed into this silence, turning it into medicinal wine, adding color, flavor, and fragrance. At this time, I wanted to write, but I couldn't write it, and I couldn't write. This is what I call "when I am silent, I feel full, I will open my mouth, and at the same time I feel empty".莫非这就是一点“世界苦恼”么？我有时想。然而大约又不是的，这不过是淡淡的哀愁，中间还带些愉快。我想接近它，但我愈想，它却愈渺茫了，几乎就要发见仅只我独自倚着石栏，此外一无所有。必须待到我忘了努力，才又感到淡淡的哀愁。
Could it be that this is a little "world distress"? I sometimes think. However, it is probably not, this is just a faint sadness, with some happiness in between. I wanted to get close to it, but the more I thought about it, the more elusive it became, and I was almost about to find that I was the only one leaning against the stone railing, and there was nothing else. I had to stay until I forgot my efforts before I felt a faint sadness again.那结果却大抵不很高明。腿上钢针似的一刺，我便不假思索地用手掌向痛处直拍下去，同时只知道蚊子在咬我。什么哀愁，什么夜色，都飞到九霄云外去了，连靠过的石栏也不再放在心里。而且这还是现在的话，那时呢，回想起来，是连不将石栏放在心里的事也没有想到的。仍是不假思索地走进房里去，坐在一把唯一的半躺椅——躺不直的藤椅子——上，抚摩着蚊喙的伤，直到它由痛转痒，渐渐肿成一个小疙瘩。我也就从抚摩转成搔，掐，直到它由痒转痛，比较地能够打熬。
The result is probably not very clever. With a prick like a steel needle on my leg, I slapped my palm straight down to the sore spot without thinking, and at the same time I only knew that the mosquito was biting me. What sorrow, what night, all flew out of the sky, and even the stone railing that was leaning against it was no longer in my heart. And this is still now, at that time, looking back, I didn't even think of not taking the stone railing to heart. Still without thinking, he walked into the room, sat on the only half-recliner - a rattan chair that couldn't lie upright, and stroked the wound of the mosquito's beak until it turned from pain to itch and gradually swollen into a small pimple. I also changed from stroking to scratching and pinching until it turned from itching to pain, and I was able to beat it relatively well.此后的结果就更不高明了，往往是坐在电灯下吃柚子。
The result after that is even less clever, often sitting under the electric light and eating grapefruit.虽然不过是蚊子的一叮，总是本身上的事来得切实。能不写自然更快活，倘非写不可，我想，也只能写一些这类小事情，而还万不能写得正如那一天所身受的显明深切。而况千叮万叮，而况一刀一枪，那是写不出来的。
Although it is just a mosquito bite, it is always a matter of itself. If you can't write about it and live faster, if you have to write, I think you can only write about some small things like this, and you must not write as clearly and deeply as you experienced that day. Moreover, it is impossible to write a thousand dings, and a knife and a shot.尼采爱看血写的书。但我想，血写的文章，怕未必有罢。文章总是墨写的，血写的倒不过是血迹。它比文章自然更惊心动魄，更直截分明，然而容易变色，容易消磨。这一点，就要任凭文学逞能，恰如冢中的白骨，往古来今，总要以它的永久来傲视少女颊上的轻红似的。
Nietzsche loves to read books written in blood. But I think that the article written by blood may not be enough. Articles are always written in ink, and blood is just blood. It is more thrilling and straightforward than the text, but it is easy to change color and wear out. This point must be left to the mercy of literature, just like the white bones in the tomb, from ancient times to the present, always proud of the light red on the girl's cheeks with its permanence.能不写自然更快活，倘非写不可，我想，就是随便写写罢，横竖也只能如此。这些都应该和时光一同消逝，假使会比血迹永远鲜活，也只足证明文人是侥幸者，是乖角儿。但真的血写的书，当然不在此例。
If you can't write it naturally, it will be faster to live, if you have to write, I think, just write casually, horizontally and vertically. These should all disappear with time, and if they will be alive forever than blood, it is enough to prove that the literati are flukes and good actors. But of course, this is not the case for books written in real blood.当我这样想的时候，便觉得“写什么”倒也不成什么问题了。
When I think about it this way, I feel that "what to write" is not a problem.“怎样写”的问题，我是一向未曾想到的。初知道世界上有着这么一个问题，还不过两星期之前。那时偶然上街，偶然走进丁卜书店去，偶然看见一叠《这样做》，便买取了一本。这是一种期刊，封面上画着一个骑马的少年兵士。我一向有一种偏见，凡书面上画着这样的兵士和手捏铁锄的农工的刊物，是不大去涉略的，因为我总疑心它是宣传品。发抒自己的意见，结果弄成带些宣传气味了的伊孛生等辈的作品，我看了倒并不发烦。但对于先有了“宣传”两个大字的题目，然后发出议论来的文艺作品，却总有些格格不入，那不能直吞下去的模样，就和雒诵教训文学的时候相同。但这《这样做》却又有些特别，因为我还记得日报上曾经说过，是和我有关系的。也是凡事切己，则格外关心的一例罢，我便再不怕书面上的骑马的英雄，将它买来了。回来后一检查剪存的旧报，还在的，日子是三月七日，可惜没有注明报纸的名目，但不是《民国日报》，便是《国民新闻》，因为我那时所看的只有这两种。下面抄一点报上的话：
The question of "how to write" has never been thought of by me. I first learned that there was such a problem in the world, only two weeks ago. At that time, I happened to go to the street, walked into Dingbu Bookstore, and happened to see a stack of "Do This Way", so I bought one. It is a type of journal with a young soldier on horseback on the cover. I have always had a prejudice that I don't care about publications that depict such soldiers and peasants and workers with hoes in writing, because I always suspect that they are propaganda. Expressing my opinions, I didn't get annoyed when I read the works of Ibsen and others, which had a bit of a propaganda smell. However, for literary and artistic works that first have the two big words "propaganda" and then issue discussions, they are always a little out of place, and the appearance that cannot be swallowed directly is the same as when Luo recited the lesson of literature. But this "Do It" is a bit special, because I still remember that the daily newspaper once said that it had something to do with me. It is also an example of special concern for everything that is self-interested, so I am no longer afraid of the written horse-riding hero, so I bought it. When I came back, I checked the old newspaper that was cut, and it was still there, the date was March 7th, but unfortunately the name of the newspaper was not indicated, but it was not "Republic of China Daily", it was "National News", because I only read these two at that time. Here is a copy of the newspaper's words:“自鲁迅先生南来后，一扫广州文学之寂寞，先后创办者有《做什么》，《这样做》两刊物。闻《这样做》为革命文学社定期出版物之一，内容注重革命文艺及本党主义之宣传。……”
Since Mr. Lu Xun came south, he has swept away the loneliness of Guangzhou literature, and has successively founded two publications: "What to Do" and "This Way". Wen "Do This" is one of the regular publications of the Revolutionary Literature Society, focusing on the propaganda of revolutionary literature and art and partyism. ……”开首的两句话有些含混，说我都与闻其事的也可以，说因我“南来”了而别人创办的也通。但我是全不知情。当初将日报剪存，大概是想调查一下的，后来却又忘却，搁下了。现在还记得《做什么》出版后，曾经送给我五本。我觉得这团体是共产青年主持的，因为其中有“坚如”，“三石”等署名，该是毕磊，通信处也是他。他还曾将十来本《少年先锋》送给我，而这刊物里面则分明是共产青年所作的东西。果然，毕磊君大约确是共产党，于四月十八日从中山大学被捕。据我的推测，他一定早已不在这世上了，这看去很是瘦小精干的湖南的青年。
The first two sentences are a bit ambiguous, it is okay to say that I am with those who have heard about it, and it is also okay to say that others founded it because I "came from the south". But I don't know anything about it. At the beginning, I cut the daily newspaper, probably because I wanted to investigate, but then I forgot about it and put it down. I still remember that after the publication of "What to Do", he gave me five copies. I think this group is presided over by communist youth, because there are signatures such as "Jianru" and "Sanshi", it should be Bi Lei, and the correspondence office is also him. He also gave me more than a dozen copies of "Young Pioneers", and this publication was clearly made by communist youth. Sure enough, Bi Leijun was probably indeed a communist and was arrested from Sun Yat-sen University on April 18. According to my speculation, he must be no longer in this world, and he seems to be a very thin and capable young man in Hunan.《这样做》却在两星期以前才见面，已经出到七八期合册了。第六期没有，或者说被禁止，或者说未刊，莫衷一是，我便买了一本七八合册和第五期。看日报的记事便知道，这该是和《做什么》反对，或对立的。我拿回来，倒看上去，通讯栏里就这样说：“在一般CP气焰盛张之时，……而你们一觉悟起来，马上退出CP，不只是光退出便了事，尤其值得CP气死的，就是破天荒的接二连三的退出共产党登报声明。……”那么，确是如此了。
"Do This Way" only met two weeks ago and has already been released in seven or eight issues. The sixth issue was not, or banned, or unpublished, so I bought a seven-eight combined volume and the fifth issue. If you look at the daily newspaper, you can see that this should be opposed to "What to Do" or opposed. I took it back, and it looked like this, and the communication column said: "When the general CP is arrogant,...... And as soon as you wake up, you will immediately quit CP, not only just quitting, but especially what is worthy of CP's anger is the unprecedented successive withdrawal from the Communist Party's statements. ...... "Well, that's true."这里又即刻出了一个问题。为什么这么大相反对的两种刊物，都因我“南来”而“先后创办”呢？这在我自己，是容易解答的：因为我新来而且灰色。但要讲起来，怕又有些话长，现在姑且保留，待有相当的机会时再说罢。
Another problem immediately arose here. Why are the two opposite publications "founded" because I "came from the south"? This is easy for me to answer: because I am new and gray. But if you want to talk about it, I'm afraid it's a bit long, so I'll keep it for now and talk about it when I have a good opportunity.这回且说我看《这样做》。看过通讯，懒得倒翻上去了，于是看目录。忽而看见一个题目道：《郁达夫先生休矣》，便又起了好奇心，立刻看文章。这还是切己的琐事总比世界的哀愁关心的老例，达夫先生是我所认识的，怎么要他“休矣”了呢？急于要知道。假使说的是张龙赵虎，或是我素昧平生的伟人，老实说罢，我决不会如此留心。
This time, let's say I read "Do This Thing". After reading the newsletter, I was too lazy to flip through it, so I looked at the table of contents. Suddenly I saw a title that said: "Mr. Yu Dafu is resting", so I became curious again and immediately read the article. This is still an old example of caring about one's own trivial matters more than the sorrow of the world, Mr. Duff is the one I know, why should he "rest"? Eager to know. If it were Zhang Long and Zhao Hu, or a great man I had never known in my life, to be honest, I would never be so careful.原来是达夫先生在《洪水》上有一篇《在方向转换的途中》，说这一次的革命是阶级斗争的理论的实现，而记者则以为是民族革命的理论的实现。大约还有英雄主义不适宜于今日等类的话罢，所以便被认为“中伤”和“挑拨离间”，非“休矣”不可了。
It turned out that Mr. Duff had an article in "On the Way to Change Direction" in "Flood", saying that this revolution was the realization of the theory of class struggle, while the reporter thought it was the realization of the theory of national revolution. There are probably words that heroism is not suitable for today, so it is considered to be "slander" and "sowing discord", and it must be "stopped".我在电灯下回想，达夫先生我见过好几面，谈过好几回，只觉他稳健和平，不至于得罪于人，更何况得罪于国。怎么一下子就这么流于“偏激”了？我倒要看看《洪水》。
I recalled under the electric light that I had met Mr. Duff several times and talked to him several times, but I felt that he was steady and peaceful, so as not to offend others, let alone the country. Why is it so "extreme" all of a sudden? I want to read "Flood".这期刊，听说在广西是被禁止的了，广东倒还有。我得到的是第三卷第二十九至三十二期。照例的坏脾气，从三十二期倒看上去，不久便翻到第一篇《日记文学》，也是达夫先生做的，于是便不再去寻《在方向转换的途中》，变成看谈文学了。我这种模模胡胡的看法，自己也明知道是不对的，但“怎么写”的问题，却就出在那里面。
I heard that this journal is banned in Guangxi, but there is still one in Guangdong. What I got was volume 3, issues 29-32. As usual, the bad temper looked like it was going from the thirty-second issue, and soon I turned to the first "Diary Literature", which was also written by Mr. Duff, so I stopped looking for "On the Way to Change Direction" and became reading literature. I know that my nonsensical view is wrong, but the problem of "how to write" lies there.作者的意思，大略是说凡文学家的作品，多少总带点自叙传的色彩的，若以第三人称来写出，则时常有误成第一人称的地方。而且叙述这第三人称的主人公的心理状态过于详细时，读者会疑心这别人的心思，作者何以会晓得得这样精细？于是那一种幻灭之感，就使文学的真实性消失了。所以散文作品中最便当的体裁，是日记体，其次是书简体。
The author's meaning is roughly to say that the works of writers are more or less somewhat autobiographical, and if they are written in the third person, they are often mistaken for the first person. Moreover, when the psychological state of the third-person protagonist is described in too detail, the reader will be suspicious of the other person's thoughts, how can the author know so finely? So that sense of disillusionment makes the authenticity of literature disappear. Therefore, the most appropriate genre in prose works is the diary style, followed by the simplified script.这诚然也值得讨论的。但我想，体裁似乎不关重要。上文的第一缺点，是读者的粗心。但只要知道作品大抵是作者借别人以叙自己，或以自己推测别人的东西，便不至于感到幻灭，即使有时不合事实，然而还是真实。其真实，正与用第三人称时或误用第一人称时毫无不同。倘有读者只执滞于体裁，只求没有破绽，那就以看新闻记事为宜，对于文艺，活该幻灭。而其幻灭也不足惜，因为这不是真的幻灭，正如查不出大观园的遗迹，而不满于《红楼梦》者相同。倘作者如此牺牲了抒写的自由，即使极小部分，也无异于削足适履的。
This is certainly worth discussing. But I think the genre doesn't seem to matter. The first drawback of the above is the carelessness of readers. But as long as you know that the work is mostly about the author borrowing others to describe himself, or speculating about other people's things, you will not feel disillusioned, even if it is sometimes untrue, but it is still true. Its authenticity is no different from when using the third person or misusing the first person. If some readers are only stuck in the genre and only want to have no flaws, then it is appropriate to watch the news and record events, and for literature and art, they deserve to be disillusioned. And its disillusionment is not a pity, because this is not a real disillusionment, just like those who cannot find the remains of the Grand View Garden and are dissatisfied with "Dream of Red Mansions". If the author sacrifices the freedom of writing in this way, even a very small part is tantamount to cutting his feet to fit the shoes.第二种缺陷，在中国也已经是颇古的问题。纪晓岚攻击蒲留仙的《聊斋志异》，就在这一点。两人密语，决不肯泄，又不为第三人所闻，作者何从知之？所以他的《阅微草堂笔记》，竭力只写事状，而避去心思和密语。但有时又落了自设的陷阱，于是只得以《春秋左氏传》的“浑良夫梦中之噪”来解嘲。他的支绌的原因，是在要使读者信一切所写为事实，靠事实来取得真实性，所以一与事实相左，那真实性也随即灭亡。如果他先意识到这一切是创作，即是他个人的造作，便自然没有一切挂碍了。
The second defect is already a problem in China. Ji Xiaolan attacked Pu Liuxian's "Liao Zhai Zhi Yi", which is at this point. The secret conversation between the two will never be leaked, and it will not be heard by a third party, so how can the author know? Therefore, his "Notes on Reading Micro Caotang" tries his best to only write about the situation, and avoids thoughts and secret words. But sometimes he fell into his own trap, so he could only be ridiculed by the "noise of Hun Liangfu's dream" in the "Spring and Autumn Biography of Zuo". The reason for his slump is to make the reader believe that everything written is true, and to rely on facts to obtain truth, so as soon as it contradicts the facts, the truth will also perish. If he first realizes that all this is creation, that is, his personal creation, then there will naturally be no obstacles.一般的幻灭的悲哀，我以为不在假，而在以假为真。记得年幼时，很喜欢看变戏法，猢狲骑羊，石子变白鸽，最末是将一个孩子刺死，盖上被单，一个江北口音的人向观众装出撒钱模样道：Huazaa！Huazaa！大概是谁都知道，孩子并没有死，喷出来的是装在刀柄里的苏木汁，Huazaa一够，他便会跳起来的。但还是出神地看着，明明意识着这是戏法，而全心沉浸在这戏法中。万一变戏法的定要做得真实，买了小棺材，装进孩子去，哭着抬走，倒反索然无味了。这时候，连戏法的真实也消失了。
The general sadness of disillusionment, I think it is not false, but false as true. I remember when I was young, I liked to watch juggling, monkeys riding sheep, stones turning into white pigeons, and finally stabbing a child to death, covering the sheets, and a person with a Jiangbei accent pretended to throw money to the audience and said: Huazaa! Huazaa！ Probably everyone knows that the child is not dead, what is sprayed out is the sorrel juice in the handle of the knife, and as soon as Huazaa gets enough, he will jump up. But he still watched in a daze, clearly aware that this was a trick, and immersed himself in this trick. In case the trick must be real, buy a small coffin, put it in the child, and carry it away crying, but it will be tasteless. At this time, even the truth of the trick disappeared.我宁看《红楼梦》，却不愿看新出的《林黛玉日记》，它一页能够使我不舒服小半天。《板桥家书》我也不喜欢看，不如读他的《道情》。我所不喜欢的是他题了家书两个字。那么，为什么刻了出来给许多人看的呢？不免有些装腔。幻灭之来，多不在假中见真，而在真中见假。日记体，书简体，写起来也许便当得多罢，但也极容易起幻灭之感；而一起则大抵很厉害，因为它起先模样装得真。
I would rather read "Dream of Red Mansions" than the new "Lin Daiyu Diary", which can make me uncomfortable for half a day. I don't like to read "Banqiao Family Letters", so it's better to read his "Taoism". What I don't like is that he inscribed the word "family letter." So, why was it engraved for many people to see? It is inevitable that there will be some pretense. Disillusionment mostly does not see the truth in the false, but in the truth. The diary style, the simplified book style, may be much easier to write, but it is also very easy to feel disillusioned; And one is probably very powerful, because it looks real at first.《越缦堂日记》近来已极风行了，我看了却总觉得他每次要留给我一点很不舒服的东西。为什么呢？一是钞上谕。大概是受了何焯的故事的影响的，他提防有一天要蒙“御览”。二是许多墨涂。写了尚且涂去，该有许多不写的罢？三是早给人家看，钞，自以为一部著作了。我觉得从中看不见李慈铭的心，却时时看到一些做作，仿佛受了欺骗。翻翻一部小说，虽是很荒唐，浅陋，不合理，倒从来不起这样的感觉的。
"Yuemantang Diary" has become very popular recently, but I always feel that he wants to leave me something very uncomfortable every time. Why? The first is the banknote edict. Probably influenced by He Zhuo's story, he was wary of one day being "imperial". The second is a lot of ink coating. If you write it and erase it, there should be a lot of things that you don't write? The third is to show it to others early, banknotes, and think it is a work. I don't think I can see Li Ciming's heart from it, but I see some artificiality from time to time, as if I have been deceived. Turning over a novel, although it is very absurd, shallow, and unreasonable, I have never felt this way.听说后来胡适之先生也在做日记，并且给人传观了。照文学进化的理论讲起来，一定该好得多。我希望他提前陆续的印出。
I heard that Mr. Hu Shizhi was also doing a diary and passed it on to others. According to the theory of literary evolution, it must be much better. I hope he will print it out in advance.但我想，散文的体裁，其实是大可以随便的，有破绽也不妨。做作的写信和日记，恐怕也还不免有破绽，而一有破绽，便破灭到不可收拾了。与其防破绽，不如忘破绽。
But I think the genre of prose can actually be casual, and it doesn't matter if there are flaws. Contrived letters and diaries may still have flaws, and once there are flaws, they will be shattered out of control. Instead of guarding against flaws, it is better to forget about them.

在钟楼上——夜记之二

在钟楼上On the bell tower ——夜记之二 - Night Diary No. 2
也还是我在厦门的时候，柏生从广州来，告诉我说，爱而君也在那里了。大概是来寻求新的生命的罢，曾经写了一封长信给K委员，说明自己的过去和将来的志望。
When I was in Xiamen, Bai Sheng came from Guangzhou and told me that Ai Erjun was also there. Probably to seek a new life, he once wrote a long letter to Commissioner K, explaining his past and future aspirations.“你知道有一个叫爱而的么？他写了一封长信给我，我没有看完。其实，这种文学家的样子，写长信，就是反革命的！”有一天，K委员对柏生说。
"Do you know that there is a one called love? He wrote me a long letter that I didn't finish. In fact, this kind of writer's appearance, writing long letters, is counter-revolutionary! One day, Commissioner K said to Bai Sheng.又有一天，柏生又告诉了爱而，爱而跳起来道：
Another day, Bai Sheng told Ai Er again, and Ai Er jumped up and said:“怎么？……怎么说我是反革命的呢？！”
"What? …… How can you say that I am a counter-revolutionary?!" ”厦门还正是和暖的深秋，野石榴开在山中，黄的花——不知道叫什么名字——开在楼下。我在用花刚石墙包围着的楼屋里听到这小小的故事，K委员的眉头打结的正经的脸，爱而的活泼中带着沉闷的年青的脸，便一齐在眼前出现，又仿佛如见当K委员的眉头打结的面前，爱而跳了起来，——我不禁从窗隙间望着远天失笑了。
It is still a warm late autumn in Xiamen, wild pomegranates bloom in the mountains, and yellow flowers - I don't know what they are called - bloom downstairs. I heard this little story in the building surrounded by diamond walls, and the serious face of Commissioner K's frown, the lively and dull young face of Commissioner K, appeared in front of me together, and it seemed that I jumped up in love in front of Commissioner K's frown,—— I couldn't help but laugh at the sky from the window gap.但同时也记起了苏俄曾经有名的诗人，《十二个》的作者勃洛克的话来：
But at the same time, I also remember the words of the famous poet of Soviet Russia, the author of "Twelve":“共产党不妨碍做诗，但于觉得自己是大作家的事却有妨碍。大作家者，是感觉自己一切创作的核心，在自己里面保持着规律的。”
"The Communist Party does not prevent me from writing poetry, but it does hinder me from feeling that I am a great writer. A great writer feels the core of all his creations and maintains a regularity within himself. ”共产党和诗，革命和长信，真有这样地不相容么？我想。
Is the Communist Party and poetry, revolution and long-term faith really so incompatible? I think.以上是那时的我想。这时我又想，在这里有插入几句声明的必要：
The above is what I thought at that time. At this time, I thought it was necessary to insert a few sentences here:我不过说是变革和文艺之不相容，并非在暗示那时的广州政府是共产政府或委员是共产党。这些事我一点不知道。只有若干已经“正法”的人们，至今不听见有人鸣冤或冤鬼诉苦，想来一定是真的共产党罢。至于有一些，则一时虽然从一方面得了这样的谥号，但后来两方相见，杯酒言欢，就明白先前都是误解，其实是本来可以合作的。
I am just saying that change and literature and art are incompatible, not implying that the Guangzhou government at that time was a communist government or that the members were communists. I don't know any of these things. Only a few people who have "corrected the law" have not heard anyone complain or complain so far, so I think it must be the real Communist Party. As for some, although they got such a posthumous title from the one hand, when the two parties met and had a glass of wine, they understood that they had misunderstood before, but in fact, they could have cooperated.必要已毕，于是放心回到本题。却说爱而君不久也给了我一封信，通知我已经有了工作了。信不甚长，大约还有被冤为“反革命”的余痛罢。但又发出牢骚来：一，给他坐在饭锅旁边，无聊得很；二，有一回正在按风琴，一个漠不相识的女郎来送给他一包点心，就弄得他神经过敏，以为北方女子太死板而南方女子太活泼，不禁“感慨系之矣”了。
The necessity is over, so I return to the topic with confidence. But he said that Ai Erjun soon gave me a letter informing me that I already had a job. The letter is not very long, and there is probably still the afterglow of being wrongfully accused of being a "counter-revolutionary". But he complained again: first, sit next to the rice pot for him, very bored; Second, once while playing the organ, an unknown girl came to give him a pack of snacks, which made him nervous, thinking that the northern women were too rigid and the southern women were too lively, and he couldn't help but "feel the emotion".关于第一点，我在秋蚊围攻中所写的回信中置之不答。夫面前无饭锅而觉得无聊，觉得苦痛，人之常情也，现在已见饭锅，还要无聊，则明明是发了革命热。老实说，远地方在革命，不相识的人们在革命，我是的确有点高兴听的，然而——没有法子，索性老实说罢，——如果我的身边革起命来，或者我所熟识的人去革命，我就没有这么高兴听。有人说我应该拚命去革命，我自然不敢不以为然，但如叫我静静地坐下，调给我一杯罐头牛奶喝，我往往更感激。但是，倘说，你就死心塌地地从饭锅里装饭吃罢，那是不像样的；然而叫他离开饭锅去拚命，却又说不出口，因为爱而是我的极熟的熟人。于是只好袭用仙传的古法，装聋作哑，置之不问不闻之列。只对于第二点加以猛烈的教诫，大致是说他“死板”和“活泼”既然都不赞成，即等于主张女性应该不死不活，那是万分不对的。
Regarding the first point, I did not answer in the reply letter I wrote during the siege of Qiu Mosquito. It is human nature to feel bored and painful without a rice pot in front of the husband. To be honest, I am indeed a little happy to hear that revolutions are being carried out in distant places, and people I don't know are revolutioning, but - there is no way, just to be honest,—— if there is a revolution around me, or if someone I know goes to the revolution, I am not so happy to hear it. Some people say that I should fight for the revolution, so naturally I dare not disagree, but if I am asked to sit quietly and mix me a glass of canned milk to drink, I am often more grateful. However, if you just put rice out of the rice pot and eat it, it is not decent; However, I told him to leave the rice pot and work hard, but I couldn't say it, because love was my very familiar acquaintance. So I had to follow the ancient method of immortal tradition, pretend to be deaf and mute, and ignore it. Only to give a fierce admonition to the second point is roughly to say that since he does not approve of "rigid" and "lively", it is equivalent to advocating that women should not die or live, which is absolutely wrong.约略一个多月之后，我抱着和爱而一类的梦，到了广州，在饭锅旁边坐下时，他早已不在那里了，也许竟并没有接到我的信。
About a month later, I arrived in Guangzhou with a dream like "love", and when I sat down next to the rice pot, he was no longer there, and maybe he didn't even receive my letter.我住的是中山大学中最中央而最高的处所，通称“大钟楼”。一月之后，听得一个戴瓜皮小帽的秘书说，才知道这是最优待的住所，非“主任”之流是不准住的。但后来我一搬出，又听说就给一位办事员住进去了，莫明其妙。不过当我住在那里的时候，总还是非主任之流即不准住的地方，所以直到知道办事员搬进去了的那一天为止，我总是常常又感激，又惭愧。
I live in the most central and highest place of Sun Yat-sen University, commonly known as the "Big Bell Tower". A month later, I heard a secretary wearing a melon skin hat say that this was the most preferential residence, and non-"directors" were not allowed to live. But then as soon as I moved out, I heard that I gave a clerk a place to live, which was incomprehensible. But when I lived there, it was always a place where non-directors were not allowed to live, so until the day I found out that the clerk had moved in, I was always grateful and ashamed.然而这优待室却并非容易居住的所在，至少的缺点，是不很能够睡觉的。一到夜间，便有十多匹——也许二十来匹罢，我不能知道确数——老鼠出现，驰骋文坛，什么都不管。只要可吃的，它就吃，并且能开盒子盖，广州中山大学里非主任之流即不准住的楼上的老鼠，仿佛也特别聪明似的，我在别地方未曾遇到过。到清晨呢，就有“工友”们大声唱歌，——我所不懂的歌。
However, this preferential treatment room is not an easy place to live, at least the disadvantage is that it is not very sleepable. At night, there were more than ten - maybe twenty, I can't know the exact number - and the rats appeared, galloping in the literary world, and didn't care about anything. As long as it is edible, it will eat, and it can open the lid of the box, and the rats upstairs that are not allowed to live in Guangzhou Sun Yat-sen University are not allowed to live, as if they are also very smart, I have never encountered them anywhere else. In the early morning, there were "workers" singing loudly ,—— songs I didn't understand.白天来访的本省的青年，却大抵怀着非常的好意的。有几个热心于改革的，还希望我对于广州的缺点加以激烈的攻击。这热诚很使我感动，但我终于说是还未熟悉本地的情形，而且已经革命，觉得无甚可以攻击之处，轻轻地推却了。那当然要使他们很失望的。过了几天，尸一君就在《新时代》上说：
The young people in the province who visit during the day are mostly very well-intentioned. There are a few people who are enthusiastic about reform and hope that I will fiercely attack Guangzhou's shortcomings. I was very moved by this enthusiasm, but I finally said that I was not familiar with the local situation and had already revolutionized, and felt that there was nothing to attack, so I gently pushed it away. Of course, it will disappoint them. A few days later, Shi Yijun said in "New Era":“……我们中几个很不以他这句话为然，我们以为我们还有许多可骂的地方，我们正想骂骂自己，难道鲁迅先生竟看不出我们的缺点么？……”
“…… A few of us didn't take his words seriously, we thought we still had a lot to scold, and we were about to scold ourselves, couldn't Mr. Lu Xun see our shortcomings? ……”其实呢，我的话一半是真的。我何尝不想了解广州，批评广州呢，无奈慨自被供在大钟楼上以来，工友以我为教授，学生以我为先生，广州人以我为“外江佬”，孤孑特立，无从考查。而最大的阻碍则是言语。直到我离开广州的时候止，我所知道的言语，除一二三四……等数目外，只有一句凡有“外江佬”几乎无不因为特别而记住的Hanbaran（统统）和一句凡有学习异地言语者几乎无不最容易学得而记住的骂人话Tiu-na-ma而已。
Actually, half of what I said is true. Why don't I want to understand Guangzhou and criticize Guangzhou, helplessly sighing that since I was offered to the big bell tower, the workers regarded me as a professor, the students regarded me as a teacher, and the people of Guangzhou regarded me as a "foreign river man". And the biggest obstacle is words. Until I left Guangzhou, all I knew was one, two, three, four...... In addition to the number, there is only one sentence Hanbaran (all) that almost everyone who has a "foreign riverman" remembers because of its specialness, and a swear word Tiu-na-ma that is the easiest to learn and remember for almost everyone who learns a foreign language.这两句有时也有用。那是我已经搬在白云路寓屋里的时候了，有一天，巡警捉住了一个窃取电灯的偷儿，那管屋的陈公便跟着一面骂，一面打。骂了一大套，而我从中只听懂了这两句。然而似乎已经全懂得，心里想：“他所说的，大约是因为屋外的电灯几乎Hanbaran被他偷去，所以要Tiu-na-ma了。”于是就仿佛解决了一件大问题似的，即刻安心归坐，自去再编我的《唐宋传奇集》。
These two sentences are also useful sometimes. That was when I had already moved to an apartment on Baiyun Road, and one day, the patrol police caught a thief who stole the lights, and Chen Gong, who was in charge of the house, scolded and beat him. I scolded a lot, and I only understood these two sentences. However, he seemed to understand everything and thought to himself: "What he said is probably because almost the lights outside the house were stolen by him, so he wants Tiu-na-ma." So as if I had solved a big problem, I immediately sat down with peace of mind and went to compile my "Tang and Song Legends".但究竟不知道是否真如此。私自推测是无妨的，倘若据以论广州，却未免太卤莽罢。
But I don't know if this is really the case. It doesn't hurt to speculate privately, but if you talk about Guangzhou based on it, it is too reckless.但虽只这两句，我却发见了吾师太炎先生的错处了。记得先生在日本给我们讲文字学时，曾说《山海经》上“其州在尾上”的“州”是女性生殖器。这古语至今还留存在广东，读若Tiu。故Tiuhei二字，当写作“州戏”，名词在前，动词在后的。我不记得他后来可曾将此说记在《新方言》里，但由今观之，则“州”乃动词，非名词也。
But although it was only these two sentences, I found the mistake of my teacher Mr. Taiyan. I remember that when my husband was lecturing on philology in Japan, he said that the "state" in the "Classic of Mountains and Seas" is female genitalia. This ancient saying still exists in Guangdong and is read like Tiu. Therefore, the word Tiuhei should be written as "state opera", with the noun first and the verb last. I don't remember that he could have recorded this in the "New Dialects" later, but from now on, "state" is a verb, not a noun.至于我说无甚可以攻击之处的话，那可的确是虚言。其实是，那时我于广州无爱憎，因而也就无欣戚，无褒贬。我抱着梦幻而来，一遇实际，便被从梦境放逐了，不过剩下些索漠。我觉得广州究竟是中国的一部分，虽然奇异的花果，特别的语言，可以淆乱游子的耳目，但实际是和我所走过的别处都差不多的。倘说中国是一幅画出的不类人间的图，则各省的图样实无不同，差异的只在所用的颜色。黄河以北的几省，是黄色和灰色画的，江浙是淡墨和淡绿，厦门是淡红和灰色，广州是深绿和深红。我那时觉得似乎其实未曾游行，所以也没有特别的骂詈之辞，要专一倾注在素馨和香蕉上。——但这也许是后来的回忆的感觉，那时其实是还没有如此分明的。
As for what I said was nothing to attack, it was indeed a lie. In fact, at that time, I had no love or hate in Guangzhou, so there was no joy or sorrow, no praise or criticism. I came with a dream, and as soon as I encountered reality, I was banished from the dream, but there was only some Somo left. I think Guangzhou is a part of China, although the strange flowers and fruits, special language, can confuse the ears and eyes of wanderers, but in fact it is similar to other places I have been to. If China is a picture that is not like the world, then the patterns of each province are really not different, and the only difference is the colors used. The provinces north of the Yellow River are painted in yellow and gray, Jiangsu and Zhejiang are light ink and light green, Xiamen is light red and gray, and Guangzhou is dark green and crimson. At that time, I felt that there was no parade, so there were no special insults, and I had to focus on frangipani and bananas. ——But this may be a feeling of later memories, which were not so clear at that time.到后来，却有些改变了，往往斗胆说几句坏话。然而有什么用呢？在一处演讲时，我说广州的人民并无力量，所以这里可以做“革命的策源地”，也可以做反革命的策源地……当译成广东话时，我觉得这几句话似乎被删掉了。给一处做文章时，我说青天白日旗插远去，信徒一定加多。但有如大乘佛教一般，待到居士也算佛子的时候，往往戒律荡然，不知道是佛教的弘通，还是佛教的败坏？……然而终于没有印出，不知所往了……。
Later, it changed a little, and I often dared to say a few bad words. But what is the use? In a speech, I said that the people of Guangzhou have no power, so it can be the "source of revolution" or counter-revolution...... When translated into Cantonese, I felt that these sentences seemed to have been deleted. When I write an article about a place, I say that if the blue sky and white sun flag are planted far away, the number of believers will definitely increase. But like Mahayana Buddhism, when a layman is also considered a Buddha's son, the precepts are often lost, and I don't know if it is the promotion of Buddhism or the corruption of Buddhism? …… However, it was not printed in the end, and it was ...... disappeared.广东的花果，在“外江佬”的眼里，自然依然是奇特的。我所最爱吃的是“杨桃”，滑而脆，酸而甜，做成罐头的，完全失却了本味。汕头的一种较大，却是“三廉”，不中吃了。我常常宣传杨桃的功德，吃的人大抵赞同，这是我这一年中最卓著的成绩。
Guangdong's flowers and fruits are naturally still peculiar in the eyes of "Waijiang people". My favorite is "star fruit", which is smooth and crispy, sour and sweet, and is made into a can, completely losing its original taste. Shantou's one is larger, but it is "three integrity", and it is not eaten. I often promote the merits of star fruit, and most of the people who eat it agree, which is my most outstanding achievement this year.在钟楼上的第二月，即戴了“教务主任”的纸冠的时候，是忙碌的时期。学校大事，盖无过于补考与开课也，与别的一切学校同。于是点头开会，排时间表，发通知书，秘藏题目，分配卷子，……于是又开会，讨论，计分，发榜。工友规矩，下午五点以后是不做工的，于是一个事务员请门房帮忙，连夜贴一丈多长的榜。但到第二天的早晨，就被撕掉了，于是又写榜。于是辩论：分数多寡的辩论；及格与否的辩论；教员有无私心的辩论；优待革命青年，优待的程度，我说已优，他说未优的辩论；补救落第，我说权不在我，他说在我，我说无法，他说有法的辩论；试题的难易，我说不难，他说太难的辩论；还有因为有族人在台湾，自己也可以算作台湾人，取得优待“被压迫民族”的特权与否的辩论；还有人本无名，所以无所谓冒名顶替的玄学底辩论……。这样地一天一天的过去，而每夜是十多匹——或二十匹——老鼠的驰骋，早上是三位工友的响亮的歌声。
The second month on the clock tower, when he wears the paper crown of "Dean of Academic Affairs", is a busy period. The major events of the school are probably nothing more than make-up exams and the opening of classes, just like all other schools. So he nodded and held a meeting, arranged the schedule, sent out notices, kept the topics secret, and distributed papers,...... Then there was another meeting, discussion, scoring, and announcements. According to the rules of the workers, they did not work after five o'clock in the afternoon, so a clerk asked the concierge to help and posted a list more than a foot long overnight. But by the next morning, it was torn off, so the list was written again. So the debate: the debate of the number of points; debate on whether to pass or fail; faculty members have selfless debates; Preferential treatment of revolutionary youth, the degree of preferential treatment, I say that it is already excellent, and he says that it is not superior debate; If the remedy fails, I say that the power is not in me, he says it is in me, I say it is impossible, and he says there is a legal debate; I said it was not difficult to debate the difficulty of the test questions, but he said it was too difficult to debate; There is also the debate about whether or not to count as Taiwanese because there are ethnic groups in Taiwan and obtain preferential treatment of "oppressed peoples"; There are also people who are nameless, so there is no need to impost metaphysical debates ....... In this way, day by day, every night is the galloping of more than ten - or twenty - mice, and in the morning it is the loud singing of three workers.现在想起那时的辩论来，人是多么和有限的生命开着玩笑呵。然而那时却并无怨尤，只有一事觉得颇为变得特别：对于收到的长信渐渐有些仇视了。
Now I think about the debate at that time, how much people joke with limited life. However, at that time, there was no complaint, only one thing that made me feel quite special: I gradually became a little hostile to the long letters I received.这种长信，本是常常收到的，一向并不为奇。但这时竟渐嫌其长，如果看完一张，还未说出本意，便觉得烦厌。有时见熟人在旁，就托付他，请他看后告诉我信中的主旨。
This kind of long letter is often received, and it has never been surprising. But at this time, I gradually thought it was too long, and if I finished reading one and didn't say what I meant, I would feel bored. Sometimes when I see an acquaintance around, I entrust him and ask him to read it and tell me the main idea of the letter.“不错。‘写长信，就是反革命的！’”我一面想。
'Not bad.' Writing a long letter is counter-revolutionary! I thought.我当时是否也如K委员似的眉头打结呢，未曾照镜，不得而知。仅记得即刻也自觉到我的开会和辩论的生涯，似乎难以称为“在革命”，为自便计，将前判加以修正了：
I didn't know if I was also knotted with brows like Commissioner K at that time, and I didn't look in the mirror. I only remember that I immediately realized that my career of meetings and debates could hardly be called "revolutionary", and for my own convenience, I amended the previous judgment:“不。‘反革命’太重，应该说是‘不革命’的。然而还太重。其实是，——写长信，不过是吃得太闲空罢了。”
'No.' The 'counter-revolution' is too heavy and should be said to be 'non-revolutionary'. However, it is still too heavy. In fact, ,—— wrote a long letter, but it was too idle. ”有人说，文化之兴，须有余裕，据我在钟楼上的经验，大致是真的罢。闲人所造的文化，自然只适宜于闲人，近来有些人磨拳擦掌，大鸣不平，正是毫不足怪，——其实，便是这钟楼，也何尝不造得蹊跷。但是，四万万男女同胞，侨胞，异胞之中，有的是“饱食终日，无所用心”，有的是“群居终日，言不及义”。怎不造出相当的文艺来呢？只说文艺，范围小，容易些。那结论只好是这样：有余裕，未必能创作；而要创作，是必须有余裕的。故“花呀月呀”，不出于啼饥号寒者之口，而“一手奠定中国的文坛”，亦为苦工猪仔所不敢望也。
Some people say that the prosperity of culture must be marginal, and according to my experience in the bell tower, it is roughly true. The culture created by idlers is naturally only suitable for idlers, and it is not surprising that some people have been grinding their fists and complaining recently,—— in fact, it is this bell tower, why not build a strange one. However, among the 40 million male and female compatriots, overseas Chinese, and foreign compatriots, some are "full of food all day long, with no intention", and some are "living in groups all day long, and words are not righteous". Why not create quite a bit of literature and art? Only literature and art, the scope is small, and it is easier. The conclusion has to be this: if you have room, you may not be able to create; And to create, you must have leeway. Therefore, "flowers and moons" do not come from the mouths of those who cry hungry and cry cold, but "single-handedly lay down China's literary world" is also something that hard workers do not dare to hope for.我以为这一说于我倒是很好的，我已经自觉到自己久已不动笔，但这事却应该归罪于匆忙。
I thought this was good for me, I already realized that I hadn't written for a long time, but I was to blame for the haste.大约就在这时候，《新时代》上又发表了一篇《鲁迅先生往那里躲》，宋云彬先生做的。文中有这样的对于我的警告：
Around this time, another article "Mr. Lu Xun Hiding There" was published in "New Era", which was done by Mr. Song Yunbin. The article contains this warning to me:“他到了中大，不但不曾恢复他‘呐喊’的勇气，并且似乎在说‘在北方时受着种种迫压，种种刺激，到这里来没有压迫和刺激，也就无话可说了’。噫嘻！异哉！鲁迅先生竟跑出了现社会，躲向牛角尖里去了。旧社会死去的苦痛，新社会生出的苦痛，多多少放在他眼前，他竟熟视无睹！他把人生的镜子藏起来了，他把自己回复到过去时代去了，噫嘻！异哉！鲁迅先生躲避了。”
"When he arrived at CUHK, not only did he not regain his courage to 'shout', but he seemed to be saying, 'When I was in the north, I was under all kinds of oppression and stimulation, and when I came here, there was nothing to say'. Oh hey! How strange! Mr. Lu Xun actually ran out of the current society and hid in the tip of the horn. The pain of death in the old society and the pain born in the new society were more or less in front of his eyes, but he turned a blind eye! He hid the mirror of his life, he reverted himself to a bygone era, ah! How strange! Mr. Lu Xun dodged. ”而编辑者还很客气，用案语声明着这是对于我的好意的希望和怂恿，并非恶意的笑骂的文章。这是我很明白的，记得看见时颇为感动。因此也曾想如上文所说的那样，写一点东西，声明我虽不呐喊，却正在辩论和开会，有时一天只吃一顿饭，有时只吃一条鱼，也还未失掉了勇气。《在钟楼上》就是豫定的题目。然而一则还是因为辩论和开会，二则因为篇首引有拉狄克的两句话，另外又引起了我许多杂乱的感想，很想说出，终于反而搁下了。那两句话是：
And the editor was still very polite, stating in the case that this was a hope and encouragement for my good intentions, not a malicious laughing and scolding article. I understand this very well, and I remember being quite moved when I saw it. Therefore, I also wanted to write something as I said above, declaring that although I do not shout, I am debating and meeting, sometimes eating only one meal a day, sometimes eating only one fish, and I have not lost my courage. "On the Bell Tower" is the title of Yude. However, one was still because of the debate and the meeting, and the other was because of the two sentences of Raddick at the beginning of the article, and it caused me a lot of chaotic feelings, and I wanted to say it, but finally put it aside. Those two sentences were:“在一个最大的社会改变的时代，文学家不能做旁观者！”
"In an era of greatest social change, writers cannot be bystanders!"但拉狄克的话，是为了叶遂宁和梭波里的自杀而发的。他那一篇《无家可归的艺术家》译载在一种期刊上时，曾经使我发生过暂时的思索。我因此知道凡有革命以前的幻想或理想的革命诗人，很可有碰死在自己所讴歌希望的现实上的运命；而现实的革命倘不粉碎了这类诗人的幻想或理想，则这革命也还是布告上的空谈。但叶遂宁和梭波里是未可厚非的，他们先后给自己唱了挽歌，他们有真实。他们以自己的沉没，证明着革命的前行。他们到底并不是旁观者。
But Radick's words were sent for the suicide of Ye Suining and Soboli. When his "Homeless Artist" was translated into a journal, it made me think for a while. I thus know that any revolutionary poet who has a fantasy or ideal before the revolution is destined to die in the reality he praises and hopes; If the revolution of reality does not shatter the illusions or ideals of such poets, then this revolution is still empty talk in the proclamation. But Ye Suining and Sopoli are understandable, they have sung elegies to themselves one after another, and they have truth. With their own sinking, they proved the progress of the revolution. They are not bystanders after all.但我初到广州的时候，有时确也感到一点小康。前几年在北方，常常看见迫压党人，看见捕杀青年，到那里可都看不见了。后来才悟到这不过是“奉旨革命”的现象，然而在梦中时是委实有些舒服的。假使我早做了《在钟楼上》，文字也许不如此。无奈已经到了现在，又经过目睹“打倒反革命”的事实，纯然的那时的心情，实在无从追蹑了。现在就只好是这样罢。
But when I first arrived in Guangzhou, I sometimes felt a little well-off. In the past few years, in the north, I often saw oppressors and young people killed, but I couldn't see them there. Later, I realized that this was just a phenomenon of "revolution by order", but in my dream I was really comfortable. If I had made "On the Bell Tower" earlier, the text might not have been like this. Helplessness has reached the present, and after witnessing the fact of "overthrowing the counter-revolution", the pure mood at that time is really impossible to follow. That's all there is to it now.

Three pieces of non-pen今之“正人君子”，论事有时喜欢讲“动机”。案动机，我自己知道，绍介这三篇文章是未免有些有伤忠厚的。旅资将尽，非逐食不可了，许多人已知道我将于八月中走出广州。七月末就收到了一封所谓“学者”的信，说我的文字得罪了他，“拟于九月中回粤后提起诉讼，听候法律解决”。且叫我“暂勿离粤，以俟开审”。命令被告枵腹恭候于异地，以俟自己雍容布置，慢慢开审，真是霸道得可观。第二天偶在报纸上看见飞天虎寄亚妙信，有“提防剑仔”的话，不知怎地忽而欣然独笑，还想到别的两篇东西，要执绍介之劳了。这种拉扯牵连，若即若离的思想，自己也觉得近乎刻薄，——但是，由它去罢，好在“开审”时总会结帐的。
Today's "upright gentlemen" sometimes like to talk about "motives" when talking about things. The motive of the case, I know myself, and Shao Jie's three articles are a bit hurtful. The travel expenses are about to run out, and many people already know that I will leave Guangzhou in mid-August. At the end of July, I received a letter from a so-called "scholar" saying that my words had offended him and that "I plan to file a lawsuit after returning to Guangdong in mid-September and await legal resolution." He also told me not to leave Guangdong for the time being, waiting for the trial." Ordering the defendant to wait in another place for his own graceful arrangement and slowly start the trial is really domineering. The next day, I happened to see a letter from Feitian Tiger in the newspaper, with the words "Beware of the sword boy", and somehow I suddenly laughed happily, and thought of two other things, and I had to take care of Shaojie. This kind of pulling and implication, if you think like a separation, I also feel almost mean,—— but let it go, fortunately, it will always settle the bill when the "trial" begins.在我的估计上，这类文章的价值却并不在文人学者的名文之下。先前也曾收集，得了五六篇，后来只在北京的《平民周刊》上发表过一篇模范监狱里的一个囚人的自序，其余的呢，我跑出北京以后，不知怎样了，现在却还想搜集。要夸大地说起来，则此类文章，于学术上也未始无用；我记得Lombroso所做的一本书——大约是《天才与狂人》，请读者恕我手头无书，不能指实——后面，就附有许多疯子的作品。然而这种金字招牌，我辈却无须挂起来。
In my estimation, the value of such articles is not inferior to the famous writings of literati and scholars. I also collected it before, got five or six, and later only published a preface by a prisoner in a model prison in Beijing's "Civilian Weekly", and the rest, after I ran out of Beijing, I don't know what happened, but now I still want to collect it. To exaggerate, such articles are not useless academically; I remember a book made by Lombroso—about "Genius and a Madman", please forgive me for not having a book at hand, and I can't point it out — with many works by madmen. However, we don't need to hang this kind of golden signboard.这回姑且将现成的三篇介绍，都是从香港《循环日报》上采取的。以其都不是韵文，所以取阮氏《文笔对》之说，名之曰：笔。倘有好事之徒，寄我材料，无任欢迎。但此后拟不限有韵无韵，并且廓大范围，并收土匪，骗子，犯人，疯子等等的创作。但经文人润色，或拟作赝作者不收。
This time, I will tentatively introduce the three ready-made articles, all of which are taken from Hong Kong's "Circulation Daily". Because it is not a rhyme, it is named after Ruan's "Wenbi Pair". If there are good people who send me materials, you are welcome. But since then, it is planned to be not limited to rhyme or no rhyme, and to expand a wide range, and to accept the creations of bandits, liars, prisoners, madmen, etc. However, the scriptures are edited by the author, or the author of the forgery is not accepted.其实，古如陈涉帛书，米巫题字，近如义和团传单，同善社乩笔，也都是这一流。我想，凡见于古书的，也都可以抄出来编为一集，和现在的来比照，看思想手段，有什么不同。
In fact, ancient books such as Chen She's silk books, Mi Wu inscriptions, and similar to Boxer leaflets and Tongshan Society pens are also of this class. I think that everything that is seen in ancient books can also be copied out and compiled into an episode, and compared with the current ones to see what the difference is in terms of ideological means.来件想托北新书局代收，当择尤发表，——但这是我倘不忙于“以俟开审”或下了牢监的话。否则，自己的文章也就是材料，不必旁搜博采了。

1. Notice of tearing up tickets潘平
Pan Ping广州佛山缸瓦栏维新码头发现烂艇一艘，有水浸淹其中，用蓑衣覆盖男子尸身一具，露出手足，旁有粗碗一只，白旗一面，书明云云。由六区水警，将该尸艇移泊西医院附近。验得该尸颈旁有一枪孔，直贯其鼻，显系生前轰毙。查死者年约三十岁，乃穿短线衫裤，剪平头装者。
A rotten boat was found at the Weixin Wharf in Foshan, Guangzhou, which was flooded with water, covering a man's body with a raincoat, exposing his hands and feet, with a thick bowl and a white flag beside it. The Marine Police of District 6 moved the boat to the vicinity of the Western Hospital. An autopsy revealed a gunshot hole next to the body's neck, which went straight through his nose, indicating that he was shot dead during his lifetime. I wrote two articles昨天又得幸逢了两种奇特的广告，仍敢执绍介之劳。标点是我所加的，以醒眉目。该称什么笔呢，想了两天两夜，没有好结果。姑且称为“某笔”，以俟博雅君子教正。这回的“动机”比较地近于纯正，除希望“有目共赏”外，似乎并不含有其他的副作用了。但又发生了一种妄想。记得前清时，曾有一种专选各种报上较好的论说的，叫作《选报》。现在如有好事之徒，也还可以办这一类的刊物。每省须有访员数人，专收该地报上奇特的社论，记事，文艺，广告等等，汇刊成册，公之于世。则其显示各种“社会相”也，一定比游记之类要深切得多。不知CF男士以为何如？一九二七年九月二十二日午饭之前。
Yesterday, I was fortunate to encounter two strange advertisements, and I still dare to take on the work of Shaojie. I added punctuation to make it clear. What kind of pen should I call, I thought about it for two days and two nights, but there was no good result. For now, let's call it "a certain pen" to wait for the liberal gentlemen to correct it. This time, the "motive" is relatively pure, and it seems that there are no other side effects except for the hope of "appreciation". But another delusion occurred. I remember that in the former Qing Dynasty, there was a special selection of good theories in various newspapers, called "Selected Newspapers". Nowadays, if there are good people, they can also run this kind of publication. Each province must have several interviewers, who collect peculiar editorials, memoirs, literature, advertisements, etc. in the local newspaper, and publish them into a book and publish them to the world. Then it shows various "social aspects", which must be much deeper than travelogues. I wonder what CF men think? Before lunch on September 22, 1927.

孔诞祝圣言感

述香港恭祝圣诞

孔诞祝圣言感佩蘅
佩蘅金风送爽。凉露惊秋。转瞬而孔诞时期届矣。迩来圣教衰落。邪说嚣张。礼孔之举。惟港中人士。犹相沿奉行。至若内地。大多数不甚注意。盖自新学说出。而旧道德日即于沦亡。自新人物出。而古圣贤胥归于淘汰。一般学子。崇持列宁马克思种种谬说。不惜举二千年来炳若日星之圣教。摧陷而廓清之。其诋人也。不曰腐化即曰老朽。实则若曹少不更事。卤莽灭裂。不惜假新学说以便其私图。而古人之大义微言。俨如肉中刺。眼中钉。必欲拔除之而后快。孔子且在于打倒之列。更何有孔诞之可言。呜呼。长此以往。势不至等人道于禽兽不止。何幸此海隅之地。古风未泯。经教犹存。当此祝圣时期。济济跄跄一时称盛耶。虽然。吾人祝圣。特为此形式上之纪念耳。尤当注重孔教之精神。孔教重伦理。重实行。所谓齐家治国平天下。由近及远。由内及外。皆有轨道之可循。天不变道亦不变。自有碻凿之理由在。虽暴民嚣张。摧残圣教。然浮云之翳。何伤日月之明。吾人当蒙泉剥果之余。伤今思古。首当发挥大义。羽翼微言。子舆氏谓能言距杨墨者。圣人之徒。生今之世。群言淆乱。异说争鸣。众口铄金。积非成是。与圣教为难者。向只杨墨。就贵词而辟之。为吾道作干城。树中流之砥柱。若乎张皇耳目。涂饰仪文。以敷衍为心。作例行之举。则非吾所望于祝圣诸公也。感而书之如此。

一九二八年
