1928

“醉眼”中的朦胧

“醉眼”中的朦胧

“醉眼”中的朦胧

The haze in the "drunken eyes"旧历和新历的今年似乎于上海的文艺家们特别有着刺激力，接连的两个新正一过，期刊便纷纷而出了。他们大抵将全力用尽在伟大或尊严的名目上，不惜将内容压杀。连产生了不止一年的刊物，也显出拚命的挣扎和突变来。作者呢，有几个是初见的名字，有许多却还是看熟的，虽然有时觉得有些生疏，但那是因为停笔了一年半载的缘故。他们先前在做什么，为什么今年一齐动笔了？说起来怕话长。要而言之，就因为先前可以不动笔，现在却只好来动笔，仍如旧日的无聊的文人，文人的无聊一模一样。这是有意识或无意识地，大家都有些自觉的，所以总要向读者声明“将来”：不是“出国”，“进研究室”，便是“取得民众”。功业不在目前，一旦回国，出室，得民之后，那可是非同小可了。自然，倘有远识的人，小心的人，怕事的人，投机的人，最好是此刻豫致“革命的敬礼”。一到将来，就要“悔之晚矣”了。
This year of the old calendar and the new calendar seems to be particularly exciting for writers and artists in Shanghai, and as soon as the two new calendars have passed, journals have come out one after another. They will probably exhaust all their strength in the name of greatness or dignity, and will not hesitate to crush the content. Even the publications that have been produced for more than a year also show desperate struggles and mutations. As for the author, several of them are names that I have never seen before, and many are still familiar, although sometimes I feel a little rusty, but that is because I have stopped writing for a year and a half. What were they doing before, and why did they start writing together this year? I'm afraid of talking too long. In short, just because I could not write before, but now I have to start writing, it is still exactly the same as the boring literati of the past, and the boredom of the literati. This is consciously or unconsciously, and everyone is somewhat conscious, so we must always declare to the reader the "future": either "going abroad", "entering the research laboratory", or "gaining the people". The achievements are not in the present, once you return to China, leave the house, and gain the people, it will be a big deal. Naturally, if there are far-sighted people, careful people, people who are afraid of things, and people who speculate, it is best to give a "revolutionary salute" in advance at this moment. When the future comes, it will be "too late to regret".然而各种刊物，无论措辞怎样不同，都有一个共通之点，就是：有些朦胧。这朦胧的发祥地，由我看来，——虽然是冯乃超的所谓“醉眼陶然”——也还在那有人爱，也有人憎的官僚和军阀。和他们已有瓜葛，或想有瓜葛的，笔下便往往笑迷迷，向大家表示和气，然而有远见，梦中又害怕铁锤和镰刀，因此也不敢分明恭维现在的主子，于是在这里留着一点朦胧。和他们瓜葛已断，或则并无瓜葛，走向大众去的，本可以毫无顾忌地说话了，但笔下即使雄纠纠，对大家显英雄，会忘却了他们的指挥刀的傻子是究竟不多的，这里也就留着一点朦胧。于是想要朦胧而终于透漏色彩的，想显色彩而终于不免朦胧的，便都在同地同时出现了。
However, all kinds of publications, no matter how different the wording, have one thing in common, that is: they are a little hazy. This hazy birthplace, from my point of view,—— although it is Feng Naichao's so-called "drunken eyes" - there are still bureaucrats and warlords who are loved and hated. If you already have something to do with them, or want to have something to do with them, your pen will often laugh and show kindness to everyone, but you have a vision, and you are afraid of hammers and sickles in your dreams, so you don't dare to compliment your current master clearly, so you keep a little hazy here. Those who have nothing to do with them, or have nothing to do with them, and go to the public, could have spoken without scruples, but even if the pen is entangled and heroic to everyone, there are not many fools who will forget their command of the knife, and there is a little haze here. So those who want to be hazy and finally reveal the color, and those who want to show color but finally can't help but be hazy, all appear in the same place at the same time.其实朦胧也不关怎样紧要。便在最革命的国度里，文艺方面也何尝不带些朦胧。然而革命者决不怕批判自己，他知道得很清楚，他们敢于明言。惟有中国特别，知道跟着人称托尔斯泰为“卑汙的说教人”了，而对于中国“目前的情状”，却只觉得在“事实上，社会各方面亦正受着乌云密布的势力的支配”，连他的“剥去政府的暴力，裁判行政的喜剧的假面”的勇气的几分之一也没有；知道人道主义不彻底了，但当“杀人如草不闻声”的时候，连人道主义式的抗争也没有。剥去和抗争，也不过是“咬文嚼字”，并非“直接行动”。我并不希望做文章的人去直接行动，我知道做文章的人是大概只能做文章的。
In fact, it doesn't matter what it is about being hazy. Even in the most revolutionary country, literature and art are not a little hazy. However, revolutionaries are never afraid to criticize themselves, they know it very well, they dare to speak out. Only China is special and knows how to call Tolstoy a "vile preacher", but for China's "current situation", it only feels that "in fact, all aspects of society are also under the control of dark clouds", and not even a fraction of his courage to "strip away the violence of the government and the comedy of the adjudication of the administration"; I know that humanitarianism is not thorough, but when "killing people is silent", there is not even a humanitarian resistance. Stripping and fighting is just "chewing words", not "direct action". I don't want the person who makes the article to act directly, I know that the person who makes the article can probably only make the article.可惜略迟了一点，创造社前年招股本，去年请律师，今年才揭起“革命文学”的旗子，复活的批评家成仿吾总算离开守护“艺术之宫”的职掌，要去“获得大众”，并且给革命文学家“保障最后的胜利”了。这飞跃也可以说是必然的。弄文艺的人们大抵敏感，时时也感到，而且防着自己的没落，如漂浮在大海里一般，拚命向各处抓攫。二十世纪以来的表现主义，踏踏主义，什么什么主义的此兴彼衰，便是这透露的消息。现在则已是大时代，动摇的时代，转换的时代，中国以外，阶级的对立大抵已经十分锐利化，农工大众日日显得着重，倘要将自己从没落救出，当然应该向他们去了。何况“呜呼！小资产阶级原有两个灵魂。……”虽然也可以向资产阶级去，但也能够向无产阶级去的呢。
Unfortunately, it was a little late, the prospectus of the Creation Society the year before last, hired a lawyer last year, and only unveiled the banner of "revolutionary literature" this year, and the resurrected critic Cheng Fangwu finally left the responsibility of guarding the "palace of art" to "win the public" and "guarantee the final victory" for the revolutionary writers. This leap can also be said to be inevitable. People who engage in literature and art are mostly sensitive, and they always feel it, and they are guarding against their own decline, as if they are floating in the sea, desperately grabbing everywhere. The rise and fall of expressionism, treadflem, and other isms since the twentieth century is the news revealed. Now it is a great era, an era of wavering, an era of transformation, outside of China, the class antagonism has probably become very sharp, and the peasants and workers are paying attention to it every day. What's more, "Oh! The petty bourgeoisie originally had two souls. ...... "Although you can go to the bourgeoisie, you can also go to the proletariat."这类事情，中国还在萌芽，所以见得新奇，须做《从文学革命到革命文学》那样的大题目，但在工业发达，贫富悬隔的国度里，却已是平常的事情。或者因为看准了将来的天下，是劳动者的天下，跑过去了；或者因为倘帮强者，宁帮弱者，跑过去了；或者两样都有，错综地作用着，跑过去了。也可以说，或者因为恐怖，或者因为良心。成仿吾教人克服小资产阶级根性，拉“大众”来作“给与”和“维持”的材料，文章完了，却正留下一个不小的问题：
This kind of thing is still in its infancy in China, so it is novel to see and must do a big topic like "From Literary Revolution to Revolutionary Literature", but in a country with developed industry and a gap between the rich and the poor, it is already a common thing. Or because they saw the future world, which was the world of workers, they ran over; Or because if you help the strong, you would rather help the weak and run over; Or both, intricately functioning, running over. It can also be said that it is either because of horror or because of conscience. Cheng Fangwu taught people to overcome the petty-bourgeois roots and pull the "masses" to make materials for "giving" and "maintaining", but the article is over, but it is leaving a big problem:倘若难于“保障最后的胜利”，你去不去呢？
If it is difficult to "guarantee the final victory", will you go?这实在还不如在成仿吾的祝贺之下，也从今年产生的《文化批判》上的李初梨的文章，索性主张无产阶级文学，但无须无产者自己来写；无论出身是什么阶级，无论所处是什么环境，只要“以无产阶级的意识，产生出来的一种的斗争的文学”就是，直截爽快得多了。但他一看见“以趣味为中心”的可恶的“语丝派”的人名就不免曲折，仍旧“要问甘人君，鲁迅是第几阶级的人？”
This is really not as good as under Cheng Fangwu's congratulations, and from Li Chuli's article in "Cultural Criticism" produced this year, he simply advocated proletarian literature, but there was no need for the proletarians to write it themselves; No matter what class you come from or what environment you are in, as long as "a kind of literature of struggle is produced with the consciousness of the proletariat", it is much more straightforward and refreshing. But as soon as he saw the names of the hateful "Yusi School" who were "interest-centered", he couldn't help but twist and turn, and still "I want to ask Gan Renjun, what class of people is Lu Xun?" ”我的阶级已由成仿吾判定：“他们所矜持的是‘闲暇，闲暇，第三个闲暇’；他们是代表着有闲的资产阶级，或者睡在鼓里的小资产阶级。……如果北京的乌烟瘴气不用十万两无烟火药炸开的时候，他们也许永远这样过活的罢。”
My class has been judged by Cheng Fangwu: "What they hold is 'leisure, leisure, the third leisure'; they represent the idle bourgeoisie, or the petty bourgeoisie sleeping in the dark." …… If Beijing's smoky miasma didn't explode without 100,000 taels of smokeless gunpowder, they might live like this forever. ”我们的批判者才将创造社的功业写出，加以“否定的否定”，要去“获得大众”的时候，便已梦想“十万两无烟火药”，并且似乎要将我挤进“资产阶级”去（因为“有闲就是有钱”云），我倒颇也觉得危险了。后来看见李初梨说：“我以为一个作家，不管他是第一第二……第百第千阶级的人，他都可以参加无产阶级文学运动；不过我们先要审察他们的动机。……”这才有些放心，但可虑的是对于我仍然要问阶级。“有闲便是有钱”；倘使无钱，该是第四阶级，可以“参加无产阶级文学运动”了罢，但我知道那时又要问“动机”。总之，最要紧是“获得无产阶级的阶级意识”，——这回可不能只是“获得大众”便算完事了。横竖缠不清，最好还是让李初梨去“由艺术的武器到武器的艺术”，让成仿吾去坐在半租界里积蓄“十万两无烟火药”，我自己是照旧讲“趣味”。
When our critics wrote about the achievements of the Creation Society and gave it "negative negation", when they wanted to "gain the masses", they already dreamed of "100,000 taels of smokeless gunpowder", and seemed to squeeze me into the "bourgeoisie" (because "free is rich"), and I also felt that it was dangerous. Later, when I saw Li Chuli, he said: "I thought a writer, no matter if he was the first or second...... people of the hundredth and thousandth classes can participate in the proletarian literary movement; But let's first examine their motives. ...... "This is a little reassuring, but what worries me is that I still have to ask about class." "If you have leisure, you will have money"; If there is no money, it should be the fourth class and can "participate in the proletarian literary movement", but I know that at that time I have to ask about "motive". In short, the most important thing is to "gain the class consciousness of the proletariat",—— this time it cannot just "gain the masses" and be done. It is best to let Li Chuli go "from the weapon of art to the art of weapons", and let Cheng Fangwu sit in the semi-concession to accumulate "100,000 taels of smokeless gunpowder", and I myself am still talking about "fun".那成仿吾的“闲暇，闲暇，第三个闲暇”的切齿之声，在我是觉得有趣的。因为我记得曾有人批评我的小说，说是“第一个是冷静，第二个是冷静，第三个还是冷静”，“冷静”并不算好批判，但不知怎地竟像一板斧劈着了这位革命的批评家的记忆中枢似的，从此“闲暇”也有三个了。倘有四个，连《小说旧闻钞》也不写，或者只有两个，见得比较地忙，也许可以不至于被“奥伏赫变”（“除掉”的意思，Aufheben的创造派的译音，但我不解何以要译得这么难写，在第四阶级，一定比照描一个原文难）罢，所可惜的是偏偏是三个。但先前所定的不“努力表现自己”之罪，大约总该也和成仿吾的“否定的否定”，一同勾消了。
The sound of "leisure, leisure, the third leisure" that imitates me is interesting to me. Because I remember someone criticizing my novel, saying that "the first is calm, the second is calm, and the third is still calm", "calm" is not easy to criticize, but somehow it was like an axe that cut the memory center of this revolutionary critic, and since then there have been three "leisure". If there are four, even the "Novel Old Banknotes" are not written, or there are only two, and they are relatively busy, they may not be "Aufheben" (meaning "get rid of", the translation of Aufheben's creationism, but I don't understand why it is so difficult to translate, in the fourth class, it must be more difficult than describing the original text), but unfortunately there are three. However, the previously determined crime of not "trying to express oneself" should probably be erased together with Cheng Fangwu's "negative negation".创造派“为革命而文学”，所以仍旧要文学，文学是现在最紧要的一点，因为将“由艺术的武器，到武器的艺术”，一到“武器的艺术”的时候，便正如“由批判的武器，到用武器的批判”的时候一般，世界上有先例，“徘徊者变成同意者，反对者变成徘徊者”了。
Literature is the most important point now, because when it comes to "from the weapon of art to the art of weapons", it is like the time of "from the weapon of criticism to the criticism of the use of weapons", there is a precedent in the world, "the prowler becomes the agreer, and the opponent becomes the prowler".但即刻又有一点不小的问题：为什么不就到“武器的艺术”呢？
But there is a big question right now: why not go to "The Art of Weapons"?这也很像“有产者差来的苏秦的游说”。但当现在“无产者未曾从有产者意识解放以前”，这问题是总须起来的，不尽是资产阶级的退兵或反攻的毒计。因为这极彻底而勇猛的主张，同时即含有可疑的萌芽了。那解答只好是这样：
This is also very similar to "Su Qin's lobbying sent by the producer". But now "before the liberation of the proletariat from the consciousness of the proletariat", this problem must always arise, and it is not all a poisonous plan of the bourgeoisie to withdraw troops or counterattack. Because this is an extremely thorough and courageous proposition, it also contains suspicious germs. The answer has to be this:因为那边正有“武器的艺术”，所以这边只能“艺术的武器”。
Because there is "art of weapons" over there, there can only be "weapons of art" here.这艺术的武器，实在不过是不得已，是从无抵抗的幻影脱出，坠入纸战斗的新梦里去了。但革命的艺术家，也只能以此维持自己的勇气，他只能这样。倘他牺牲了他的艺术，去使理论成为事实，就要怕不成其为革命的艺术家。因此必然的应该坐在无产阶级的阵营中，等待“武器的铁和火”出现。这出现之际，同时拿出“武器的艺术”来。倘那时铁和火的革命者已有一个“闲暇”，能静听他们自叙的功勋，那也就成为一样的战士了。最后的胜利。然而文艺是还是批判不清的，因为社会有许多层，有先进国的史实在；要取目前的例，则《文化批判》已经拖住Upton Sinclair，《创造月刊》也背了Vigny在“开步走”了。
This weapon of art is really just a last resort, escaping from the phantom without resistance and falling into a new dream of paper battle. But the revolutionary artist can only maintain his courage in this way, and he can only do this. If he sacrifices his art to make theory a fact, he must be afraid that he will not become a revolutionary artist. Therefore, it is inevitable to sit in the camp of the proletariat and wait for the emergence of "iron and fire of weapons". This came at the same time to take out the "art of weapons". If the revolutionaries of iron and fire already had a "leisure" at that time and could listen to their self-recounting of their merits, they would have become the same soldiers. The final victory. However, literature and art are still unclear, because there are many layers of society, and there are historical facts of advanced countries; To take the current example, Cultural Criticism has dragged Upton Sinclair, and Creation Monthly has also backed Vigny in "starting to walk".倘使那时不说“不革命便是反革命”，革命的迟滞是“语丝派”之所为，给人家扫地也还可以得到半块面包吃，我便将于八时间工作之暇，坐在黑房里，续钞我的《小说旧闻钞》，有几国的文艺也还是要谈的，因为我喜欢。所怕的只是成仿吾们真像符拉特弥尔·伊力支一般，居然“获得大众”；那么，他们大约更要飞跃又飞跃，连我也会升到贵族或皇帝阶级里，至少也总得充军到北极圈内去了。译著的书都禁止，自然不待言。
If I hadn't said at that time that "no revolution is counter-revolution", and that the delay of the revolution was the work of the "Yusi School", and I could still get half a piece of bread to eat if I swept the floor, I would sit in a dark room in my spare time from work for eight hours, renew my "Novel Old News Banknotes", and the literature and art of several countries would still have to be discussed, because I liked it. What I am afraid of is that we are really like Vlatmir Ilizhi, and we actually "gain the masses"; Then, they will probably leap and leap, and even I will rise to the aristocracy or emperor class, or at least I will have to be conscripted into the Arctic Circle. Translated books are banned, so naturally it goes without saying.不远总有一个大时代要到来。现在创造派的革命文学家和无产阶级作家虽然不得已而玩着“艺术的武器”，而有着“武器的艺术”的非革命武学家也玩起这玩意儿来了，有几种笑迷迷的期刊便是这。他们自己也不大相信手里的“武器的艺术”了罢。那么，这一种最高的艺术——“武器的艺术”现在究竟落在谁的手里了呢？只要寻得到，便知道中国的最近的将来。
There will always be a big era coming in the near future. Although the revolutionary writers and proletarian writers of the Creationist school have no choice but to play with the "weapons of art", the non-revolutionary martial artists who have the "art of weapons" have also played this thing, and there are several journals that laugh at it. They themselves don't believe in the "art of weapons" in their hands. So, who is this highest art, the "art of weapons", in the hands of now? As long as you can find it, you will know China's recent future.二月二十三日，上海。
February 23, Shanghai.

看司徒乔君的画

看司徒乔君的画

看司徒乔君的画

Look at the painting of Situ Qiaojun我知道司徒乔君的姓名还在四五年前，那时是在北京，知道他不管功课，不寻导师，以他自己的力，终日在画古庙，土山，破屋，穷人，乞丐……。
I know that Situ Qiaojun's name was still four or five years ago, when he was in Beijing, and I knew that he didn't care about his homework, didn't look for a mentor, and with his own strength, he was painting ancient temples, earthen hills, dilapidated houses, poor people, beggars, ...... all day long.这些自然应该最会打动南来的游子的心。在黄埃漫天的人间，一切都成土色，人于是和天然争斗，深红和绀碧的栋宇，白石的栏干，金的佛像，肥厚的棉袄，紫糖色脸，深而多的脸上的皱纹……。凡这些，都在表示人们对于天然并不降服，还在争斗。
These should naturally touch the hearts of wanderers from the south the most. In the world full of yellow dust, everything becomes earthy, and people fight with nature, with crimson and azure buildings, white stone railings, golden Buddha statues, fat padded jackets, purple sugar faces, and deep and many wrinkles on the face....... All of this shows that people do not surrender to nature and are still fighting.在北京的展览会里，我已经见过作者表示了中国人的这样的对于天然的倔强的魂灵。我曾经得到他的一幅“四个警察和一个女人”。现在还记得一幅“耶稣基督”，有一个女性的口，在他荆冠上接吻。
At the exhibition in Beijing, I have seen the author express the stubborn soul of the Chinese towards nature. I once got one of his paintings of "four policemen and a woman". I still remember a picture of "Jesus Christ" with a woman's mouth kissing on his crown.这回在上海相见，我便提出质问：
When we met in Shanghai this time, I asked:“那女性是谁？”
"Who is that woman?"“天使，”他回答说。
"Angel," he replied.这回答不能使我满足。
This answer does not satisfy me.因为这回我发见了作者对于北方的景物——人们和天然苦斗而成的景物——又加以争斗，他有时将他自己所固有的明丽，照破黄埃。至少，是使我觉得有“欢喜”（Joy）的萌芽，如胁下的矛伤，尽管流血，而荆冠上却有天使——照他自己所说——的嘴唇。无论如何，这是胜利。
Because this time I discovered that the author fought again with the scenery of the north - the scenery formed by the struggle between people and nature, and he sometimes broke through the yellow dust with his own inherent brightness. At least, it was the sprout that made me feel that there was a spear wound under the rib, and in spite of the bleeding, there was an angel on the crown of the thorn, as he himself said, the lips. In any case, it was a victory.后来所作的爽朗的江浙风景，热烈的广东风景，倒是作者的本色。和北方风景相对照，可以知道他挥写之际，盖谂熟而高兴，如逢久别的故人。但我却爱看黄埃，因为由此可见这抱着明丽之心的作者，怎样为人和天然的苦斗的古战场所惊，而自己也参加了战斗。
The hearty scenery of Jiangsu and Zhejiang and the warm scenery of Guangdong made later are the author's true colors. Compared with the northern scenery, it can be seen that when he writes, he is familiar and happy, like an old friend who has been away for a long time. But I love to watch Huang Dust, because it shows how this author with a bright heart was shocked by the ancient battlefield of human and natural struggle, and he himself participated in the battle.中国全土必须沟通。倘将来不至于割据，则青年的背着历史而竭力拂去黄埃的中国色彩，我想，首先是这样的。
All of China must communicate. If there is no separatism in the future, then young people will try their best to brush off the Chinese color of yellow dust with history on their backs, I think, first of all.一九二八年三月十四日夜，于上海。
On the night of March 14, 1928, in Shanghai.

在上海的鲁迅启事

在上海的鲁迅启事

在上海的鲁迅启事

Lu Xun in Shanghai大约一个多月以前，从开明书店转到M女士的一封信，其中有云：
About a month ago, a letter from Kaiming Bookstore to Ms. M said:“自一月十日在杭州孤山别后，多久没有见面了。前蒙允时常通讯及指导……。”
"Since we parted in Gushan, Hangzhou on January 10, we haven't seen each other for a long time. Previously, Meng Yun often corresponded and guided ....... ”我便写了一封回信，说明我不到杭州，已将十年，决不能再孤山和别人作别，所以她所看见的，是另一人。两礼拜前，蒙M女士和两位曾经听过我的讲义的同学见访，三面证明，知道在孤山者，确是别一“鲁迅”。但M女士又给我看题在曼殊师坟旁的四句诗：
I wrote a reply letter, explaining that I had been in Hangzhou for ten years, and I must not say goodbye to others again, so what she saw was another person. Two weeks ago, Ms. Meng M and two classmates who had listened to my handouts visited, proving from three sides that those who knew in Gushan were indeed different "Lu Xun". But Ms. M showed me four poems inscribed next to Master Manshu's grave:“我来君寂居，唤醒谁氏魂？”
"I came to your lonely residence to awaken whose soul is it?"飘萍山林迹，待到它年随公去。
The traces of the mountains and forests will be gone with you until the next year.鲁迅游杭　吊老友
Lu Xun traveled to Hangzhou to hang his old friend曼殊句
Manshu sentence“一，一〇，十七年。”
"One, ten, seventeen years."我于是写信去打听寓杭的H君，前天得到回信，说确有人见过这样的一个人，就在城外教书，自说姓周，曾做一本《彷徨》，销了八万部，但自己不满意，不远将有更好的东西发表云云。
I then wrote to inquire about Mr. H, who lived in Hangzhou, and received a reply the day before yesterday, saying that someone had indeed seen such a person, teaching outside the city, claiming to be surnamed Zhou, and had made a book "Wandering", which sold 80,000 copies, but he was not satisfied, and there would be better things to be published in the near future.中国另有一个本姓周或不姓周，而要姓周，也名鲁迅，我是毫没法子的。但看他自叙，有大半和我一样，却有些使我为难。那首诗的不大高明，不必说了，而硬替人向曼殊说“待到它年随公去”，也未免太专制。“去”呢，自然总有一天要“去”的，然而去“随”曼殊，却连我自己也梦里都没有想到过。但这还是小事情，尤其不敢当的，倒是什么对别人豫约“指导”之类……。
There is another person in China whose original surname is Zhou or not, but who wants to be surnamed Zhou, also known as Lu Xun, I have no way. But looking at his self-description, most of them are the same as me, but some of them make it difficult for me. That poem is not very clever, needless to say, and it is too authoritarian to say to Manshu "Stay until it is with you". As for "going", naturally one day I will "go", but going to "follow" Manshu has never even dreamed of myself. But this is still a small thing, especially not daring to do it, but what is the ...... of "guidance" to others.我自到上海以来，虽有几种报纸说我“要开书店”，或“游了杭州”。其实我是书店也没有开，杭州也没有去，不过仍旧躲在楼上译一点书。因为我不会拉车，也没有学制无烟火药，所以只好这样用笔来混饭吃。因为这样在混饭吃，于是忽被推为“前驱”，忽被挤为“落伍”，那还可以说是自作自受，管他娘的去。但若再有一个“鲁迅”，替我说教，代我题诗，而结果还要我一个人来担负，那可真不能“有闲，有闲，第三个有闲”，连译书的工夫也要没有了。
Since I arrived in Shanghai, although several newspapers have said that I "want to open a bookstore" or "traveled to Hangzhou". In fact, I didn't open a bookstore, and I didn't go to Hangzhou, but I still hid upstairs to translate some books. Because I can't pull a cart and don't have a smokeless gunpowder system, I have to use a pen to mix food. Because of this, he was suddenly pushed as a "pioneer" and suddenly squeezed out as "outdated", which can be said to be self-inflicted and fucking. But if there is another "Lu Xun" who preaches for me and writes poems on my behalf, and the result is that I have to bear it alone, then it really can't be "idle, there is leisure, and the third one is free", and there will be no time to translate the book.所以这回再登一个启事。要声明的是：我之外，今年至少另外还有一个叫“鲁迅”的在，但那些个“鲁迅”的言动，和我也曾印过一本《彷徨》而没有销到八万本的鲁迅无干。
So this time I posted another notice. What I want to declare is: In addition to me, there is at least another person named "Lu Xun" this year, but the words and actions of those "Lu Xun" have nothing to do with Lu Xun, who also printed a copy of "Wandering" but did not sell 80,000 copies.三月二十七日，在上海。
March 27, in Shanghai.

文艺与革命

文艺与革命

文艺与革命

Literature and Revolution来信
Letter鲁迅先生：
Mr. Lu Xun:在《新闻报》的《学海》栏内，读到你底一篇《文学和政治的歧途》的讲演，解释文学者和政治者之背离不合，其原因在政治者以得到目前的安宁为满足，这满足，在感觉锐敏的文学者看去，一样是胡涂不彻底，表示失望，终于遭政治家之忌，潦倒一生，站不住脚。我觉得这是世界各国成为定例的事实。最近又在《语丝》上读到《民众主义和天才》和你底《“醉眼”中的朦胧》两篇文字，确实提醒了此刻现在做着似是而非的平凡主义和革命文学的迷梦的人们之朦胧不少，至少在我是这样。
In the "Learning Sea" column of the "Newspaper", I read your last lecture "The Wrong Path of Literature and Politics", explaining the divergence between literary scholars and politicians, the reason for which is that politicians are satisfied with the current peace, and this satisfaction, in the eyes of sensitive literary scholars, is also nonsense and incompleteness, expressing disappointment, and finally being taboo by politicians, depressed all his life, untenable. I think this is a fact that has become a rule in countries around the world. Recently, I read two texts on "Yusi" and "The Haze in the Drunken Eyes", which really reminded me that there are many people who are now dreaming of plausible mediocrity and revolutionary literature, at least for me.我相信文艺思潮无论变到怎样，而艺术本身有无限的价值等级存在，这是不得否认的。这是说，文艺之流，从最初的什么主义到现在的什么主义，所写着的内容，如何不同，而要有精刻熟练的才技，造成一篇优美无媲的文艺作品，终是一样。一条长江，上流和下流所呈现的形相，虽然不同，而长江还是一条长江。我们看它那下流的广大深缓，足以灌田亩，驶巨舶，便忘记了给它形成这广大深缓的来源，已觉糊涂到透顶。若再断章取义，说：此刻现在，我们所要的是长江的下流，因为可以利用，增加我们的财富，上流的长江可以不要，有着简直无用。这是完全以经济价值去评断长江本身整个的价值了。这种评断，出于着眼在经济价值的商人之口，不足为怪；出于着眼在艺术价值的文艺家之口，未免昏乱至于无可救药了。因为拿艺术价值去评断长江之上流，未始没有意义，或竟比之下流较为自然奇伟，也未可知。
I believe that no matter how the literary and artistic trends change, it is undeniable that art itself has an infinite hierarchy of value. This means that the content of literature and art, from the initial doctrine to the current doctrine, is different, and it is necessary to have precise and skilled talents to create a beautiful and unrivaled literary and artistic work, which is ultimately the same. A Yangtze River, although the upstream and downstream appearances are different, and the Yangtze River is still a Yangtze River. When we look at its vast and deep downstream, which is enough to irrigate the fields and sail the giant ship, we forget to form the source of this vast depth and slowness for it, and we feel confused to the top. If we take it out of context and say: At this moment, what we want is the lower reaches of the Yangtze River, because it can be used to increase our wealth, and the upstream Yangtze River can be dispensed without, which is simply useless. This is completely based on economic value to judge the entire value of the Yangtze River itself. This judgment is not surprising from the mouth of a businessman who focuses on economic value; From the mouth of writers and artists who focus on artistic value, it is inevitable that it will be confused to the point of hopelessness. Because it is meaningless to judge the upper reaches of the Yangtze River by artistic value, or it is more natural and magnificent than the lower reaches, and it is unknown.真与美是构成一件成功的艺术品的两大要素。而构成这真与美至于最高等级，便是造成一件艺术品，使它含有最高级的艺术价值，那便非赖最高级的天才不可了。如果这个论断可以否认，那末我们为什么称颂荷马，但丁，沙士比亚和歌德呢？我们为什么不能创造和他们同等的文艺作品呢，我们也有观察现象的眼，有运用文思的脑，有握管伸纸的手？
Truth and beauty are the two elements that make up a successful work of art. And to constitute this truth and beauty as for the highest level is to create a work of art, so that it contains the highest artistic value, and that must rely on the highest genius. If this assertion can be denied, then why do we praise Homer, Dante, Shakespeare and Goethe? Why can't we create literary and artistic works equal to them, we also have eyes to observe phenomena, brains to use literary thought, and hands to hold pipes and stretch paper?在现在，离开人生说艺术，固然有躲在象牙塔里忘记时代之嫌；而离开艺术说人生，那便是政治家和社会运动家的本相，他们无须谈艺术了。由此说，热心革命的人，尽可投入革命的群众里去，冲锋也好，做后方的工作也好，何必拿文艺作那既稳当又革命的勾当？
Nowadays, leaving life to talk about art is certainly suspicious of hiding in an ivory tower and forgetting the times; And talking about life without art is the true nature of politicians and social activists, and they don't need to talk about art. In this way, people who are enthusiastic about revolution can devote themselves to the revolutionary masses, whether they are charging or doing work in the rear, why bother with literature and art as a stable and revolutionary deed?我觉得许多提倡革命文学的所谓革命文艺家，也许是把表现人生这句话误解了。他们也许以为十九世纪以来的文艺，所表现的都是现实的人生，在那里面，含有显著的时代精神。文艺家自惊醒了所谓“象牙之塔”的梦以后，都应该跟着时代环境奔走；离开时代而创造文艺，便是独善主义或贵族主义的文艺了。他们看到易卜生之伟大，看到陀斯妥以夫斯奇的深刻，尤其看到俄国革命时期内的作家叶遂宁和戈理基们的热切动人；便以为现在此后的文艺家都须拿当时的生活现象来诅咒，刻划，予社会以改造革命的机会，使文艺变为民众的和革命的文艺。生在所谓“世纪末”的现代社会里面的人，除非是神经麻木了的，未始不会感到苦闷和悲哀。文艺家终比一般人感觉锐敏一点。摆在他们眼前的既是这么一个社会，蕴在他们心中的当有怎么一种情绪呢！他们有表现或刻划的才技，他们便要如实地写了出来，便无意地成为这时代的社会的呼声了。然而他们还是忠于自己，忠于自己的艺术，忠于自己的情知。易卜生被称颂为改革社会的先驱，陀思妥以夫斯奇被称为人道主义的极致者，还须赖他们自己特有的精妙的才技，经几个真知灼见的批评者为之阐扬而后可。然而，真能懂得他们的艺术的，究竟还是少数。至于叶遂宁是碰死在自己的希望碑上不必说了，戈理基呢，听人说，已有点灰色了。这且不说。便是以艺术本身而论，他何常不崇尚真切精到的才技？我曾看到他的一首讥笑那不切实的诗人的诗。况且我们以艺术价值去衡量他的作品，是否他已是了不得的作家了，究竟还是疑问呵。
I think many so-called revolutionary writers and artists who advocate revolutionary literature may have misunderstood the phrase "expressing life." They may think that literature and art since the 19th century have expressed real life, and in it, there is a significant spirit of the times. Since the so-called "ivory tower" dream woke up, writers and artists should follow the environment of the times; Leaving the times to create literature and art is the literature and art of individualism or aristocracy. They saw the greatness of Ibsen, the profundity of Dostoevsky, and especially the eagerness and moving of the writers Ye Suining and Goliki during the Russian Revolution; It is thought that now and future writers and artists must use the phenomena of life at that time to curse, portray, and give society the opportunity to transform the revolution, so that literature and art can become the people's and revolutionary literature and art. People born in the so-called "end of the century" modern society, unless their nerves are numb, will not feel distressed and sad. Writers and artists are finally a little more sensitive than ordinary people. What is in front of them is such a society, what kind of emotion is contained in their hearts! If they have the talent to express or portray, they have to write it truthfully, and they will unintentionally become the voice of society in this era. Yet they are still loyal to themselves, to their art, and to their own feelings. Ibsen was hailed as a pioneer of social reform, and Dostow Evsky was known as the ultimate of humanism, but he had to rely on their own unique and exquisite talents, which were expounded by several insightful critics. However, there are still a few who can really understand their art. As for Ye Suining, needless to say, he died on his own monument of hope, as for Gorici, I heard that it was a little gray. Not to mention. In terms of art itself, why doesn't he often advocate real and refined talents? I once saw one of his poems ridiculing the unrealistic poet. Moreover, if we measure his works by artistic value, whether he is already a great writer is still questionable.实在说，文艺家是不会抛弃社会的，他们是站在民众里面的。有一位否认有条件的文艺批评者，对于泰奴（Taine）的时间条件，认为不确，其理由是：文艺家是看前五十年。我想，看前五十年的文艺家，还是站在那时候，以那时候的生活环境做地盘而出发，所以他毕竟是那时候的民众之一员，而能在朦胧平安中看出残缺和破败。他们便以熟练的才技，写出这种残缺和破败，于艺术上达到高级的价值为止，在他们自己的能力范围之内。在创造时，他们也许只顾到艺术的精细微妙，并没想到如何激动民众，予民众以强烈的刺激，使他们血脉偾张，而从事于革命。
To be honest, writers and artists will not abandon society, they stand among the people. There is a literary critic who denies the condition of the condition, and thinks that Taine's time conditions are inaccurate, on the grounds that writers and artists look at the first fifty years. I think that the writers and artists of the first fifty years still stood at that time and started from the living environment at that time, so after all, he was a member of the people at that time, and he could see the incompleteness and dilapidation in the hazy peace. They write this incompleteness and dilapidation with skillful talent, within their own ability until they reach a high artistic value. When creating, they may only care about the subtleties of art, and do not think about how to excite the people, give them strong stimulation, make their blood flow, and engage in revolution.我们如果承认艺术有独立的无限的价值，艺术家有完成艺术本身最终目的之必要，那末我们便不能而且不应该撇开艺术价值去指摘艺术家的态度，这和拿艺术家的现实行为去评断他的艺术作品者一样可笑。波特来耳的诗并不因他的狂放而稍减其价值。浅薄者许要咒他为人群的蛇蝎，却不知道他底厌弃人生，正是他的渴慕人生之反一面的表白。我们平常讥刺一个人，还须观察到他的深处，否则便见得浮薄可鄙。至于拿了自己的似是而非的标准，既没有看到他的深处，又抛弃了衡量艺术价值的尺度，便无的放矢地攻刺一个忠于艺术的人，真的糊涂呢还是别有用意！这不过使我们觉到此刻现在的中国文艺界真不值一谈，因为以批评成名而又是创造自许的所谓文艺家者，还是这样地崇奉功利主义呵！
If we admit that art has independent and infinite value, and that it is necessary for the artist to fulfill the ultimate purpose of art itself, then we cannot and should not set aside the value of art to criticize the artist's attitude, which is as ridiculous as judging the artist's work of art by his actual behavior. Portreil's poems do not diminish their value because of his wildness. The shallow person wants to curse him as a snake and scorpion of the crowd, but he doesn't know that he hates life, which is the confession of his desire for the opposite side of life. We usually ridicule a person, but we must also observe the depths of him, otherwise we will see it superficial and contemptible. As for taking his own plausible standard, he neither saw his depths, nor abandoned the scale of measuring the value of art, and attacked a person who is loyal to art aimlessly. This only makes us feel that the current Chinese literary and artistic circles are really not worth talking about at this moment, because the so-called writers and artists who are famous for their criticism and are self-proclaimed still advocate utilitarianism like this!我——自然不是什么文艺家——喜欢读些高级的文艺作品，颇多古旧的东西，很有人说这是迷旧的时代摈弃者。他们告诉我，现在是民众文艺当世了，崭新的专为第四阶级玩味的文艺当世了。我为之愕然者久之，便问他们：民众文艺怎样写法？文艺家用什么手段，使民众都能玩味？现在民众文艺已产生了若干部？革了命之后的民众能够赏识所谓民众文艺者已有几分之几？莫非现在有许多新《三字经》，或新《神童诗》出版了么？我真不知民众化的文艺如何化法，化在内容呢，那我们本有表现民众生活的文艺了的；化在技艺上吧，那末一首国民革命歌尽够充数了，你听：“国民革命成功……齐欢唱……”多么宏壮而明白呵！我们为什么还要别的文艺？他们不能明确地回答，而我也糊涂到而今。此刻现在，才从《民众主义与天才》一文里得了答案，是：
I—naturally not a writer and artist—like to read some high-end literary and artistic works, a lot of old things, and many people say that this is an outcast of the old times. They told me that it is now the world of popular literature and art, and a new world of literature and art specially designed for the fourth class. I was stunned for a long time, and then I asked them: How to write people's literature and art? What means do writers and artists use to make the people playful? Now how many popular literature and art have been produced? How many of the people after the revolution can appreciate the so-called popular literature and art? Could it be that there are many new "Three Character Classics" or new "Prodigy Poems" published? I really don't know how popular literature and art are transformed into laws and contents, then we have literature and art that expresses people's lives; Let's turn it into skills, then the last national revolution song is enough, you listen: "The national revolution is successful...... Qi Huan sang ...... "How magnificent and clear!" Why do we need other literature and art? They couldn't answer clearly, and I was confused to this day. At this moment, I just got the answer from the article "Populism and Genius", which is:“无论民众艺术如何地主张艺术的普遍性或平等性，但艺术作品无论如何自有无限的价值等差，这个事实是不可否认的。所谓普遍性啦，平等性啦这一类话，意思不外乎是说艺术的内容是关于广众的民间生活或关于人生的普遍事象，而有这种内容的艺术，始可以供给一般民众的玩味。艺术备有像这种意味的普遍性和平等性不待说是不可以否认的，然而艺术作品既有无限的价值等级存在。以上，那些比较高级的艺术品，好，就可以说多少能够供给一般民众的玩味，若要说一切人都能够一样的精细，一样的深刻，一样的微妙——换句话说，绝对平等的来玩味它，那无论如何是不得有的事实。”
"No matter how much popular art claims the universality or equality of art, the fact that works of art have infinite value is undeniable. The so-called universality and equality mean nothing more than that the content of art is about the folk life of the masses or the general events of life, and art with this content can provide the general public with play. It is undeniable that art has such universality and equality, but works of art have infinite hierarchies of value. If you want to say that everyone can be the same fine, the same profound, the same subtlety—in other words, absolutely equal to play with it, then it is a fact that cannot exist in any case. ”记得有人说过这样的话：最先进的思想只有站在最高层的先进的少数人能够了解，等到这种思想透入群众里去的时候，已经不是先进的思想了。这些话，是告诉我们芸芸众生，到底有一大部分感觉不敏的。世界上有这样的不平等，除了诅咒造物的不公，我们还能怨谁呢？这是事实。如果不是事实，人类的演进史，可以一笔抹杀，而革命也不能发生了。世界文化的推进，全赖少数先觉之冲锋陷阵，如果各个人的聪明才智，都是相等，文化也早就发达到极致了，世界也就大同了，所谓“螺旋式进行”一句话，还不是等于废话？艺术是文化的一部，文化有进退，艺术自不能除外。民众化的艺术，以艺术本身有无限的价值等差来说，简直不能成立。自然，借文艺以革命这梦呓，也终究是一种梦呓罢了！
I remember someone saying this: The most advanced ideas can only be understood by a few advanced people standing at the highest level, and when such ideas penetrate into the masses, they are no longer advanced ideas. These words tell us that there are a large part of all living beings who are insensitive. There is such inequality in the world, who can we blame except curse the injustice of creation? This is a fact. If it were not a fact, the history of human evolution could be erased in one stroke, and revolution could not have happened. If everyone's intelligence is equal, culture has long been developed to the extreme, and the world will be the same. Art is a part of culture, and culture has advances and retreats, and art cannot be excluded. Popular art cannot be established in terms of the infinite value difference of art itself. Naturally, the dream of revolution through literature and art is just a dream after all!以上是我的意思，未知先生以为如何？
The above is what I mean, I don't know what you think?一九二八，三，二五，冬芬。
1928, 3, 25, winter fen.

文艺与革命

回信

文艺与革命

reply冬芬先生：
Mr. Dongfen:我不是批评家，因此也不是艺术家，因为现在要做一个什么家，总非自己或熟人兼做批评不可，没有一伙，是不行的，至少，在现在的上海滩上。因为并非艺术家，所以并不以为艺术特别崇高，正如自己不卖膏药，便不来打拳赞药一样。我以为这不过是一种社会现象，是时代的人生记录，人类如果进步，则无论他所写的是外表，是内心，总要陈旧，以至灭亡的。不过近来的批评家，似乎很怕这两个字，只想在文学上成仙。
I am not a critic, and therefore I am not an artist, because if I want to be a person now, I have to criticize myself or an acquaintance. Because he is not an artist, he does not think that art is particularly noble, just as if he does not sell plasters, he does not come to punch and praise medicine. I thought this was just a social phenomenon, a record of life in the times, and if human beings progressed, no matter what they wrote on the outside or on the inside, they would always become obsolete and even perish. However, critics these days seem to be afraid of these two words and just want to become an immortal in literature.各种主义的名称的勃兴，也是必然的现象。世界上时时有革命，自然会有革命文学。世界上的民众很有些觉醒了，虽然有许多在受难，但也有多少占权，那自然也会有民众文学——说得彻底一点，则第四阶级文学。
The rise of the names of various isms is also an inevitable phenomenon. There are revolutions in the world all the time, and there will naturally be revolutionary literature. The people of the world are very awakened, although many are suffering, but there are also some occupations, so naturally there will be popular literature - to put it more thoroughly, fourth-class literature.中国的批评界怎样的趋势，我却不大了然，也不很注意。就耳目所及，只觉得各专家所用的尺度非常多，有英国美国尺，有德国尺，有俄国尺，有日本尺，自然又有中国尺，或者兼用各种尺。有的说要真正，有的说要斗争，有的说要超时代，有的躲在人背后说几句短短的冷话。还有，是自己摆着文艺批评家的架子，而憎恶别人的鼓吹了创作。倘无创作，将批评什么呢，这是我最所不能懂得他的心肠的。
I don't know much about the trend of Chinese criticism, and I don't pay much attention to it. As far as I can see, I feel that there are many scales used by various experts, including the British and American rulers, the German ruler, the Russian ruler, the Japanese ruler, and naturally the Chinese ruler, or a combination of various rulers. Some say to be real, some say to fight, some say to be ahead of the times, and some hide behind people and say a few short cold words. Also, it is he who puts on the shelf of a literary critic and hates others for advocating creation. If there is no creation, what will be criticized, this is the last thing I can understand his heart.别的此刻不谈。现在所号称革命文学家者，是斗争和所谓超时代。超时代其实就是逃避，倘自己没有正视现实的勇气，又要挂革命的招牌，便自觉地或不自觉地必然地要走入那一条路的。身在现世，怎么离去？这是和说自己用手提着耳朵，就可以离开地球者一样地欺人。社会停滞着，文艺决不能独自飞跃，若在这停滞的社会里居然滋长了，那倒是为这社会所容，已经离开革命，其结果，不过多卖几本刊物，或在大商店的刊物上挣得揭载稿子的机会罢了。
Nothing else at this moment. What is now called revolutionary writers is struggle and the so-called super-era. If you do not have the courage to face reality and want to hang up the sign of revolution, you will consciously or unconsciously inevitably enter that path. In this world, how to leave? This is the same as saying that you can leave the earth with your ears in your hands. If it actually grows in this stagnant society, it is accepted by this society, and it has left the revolution, and the result is just to sell a few more publications, or earn the opportunity to publish manuscripts in the publications of large stores.斗争呢，我倒以为是对的。人被压迫了，为什么不斗争？正人君子者流深怕这一着，于是大骂“偏激”之可恶，以为人人应该相爱，现在被一班坏东西教坏了。他们饱人大约是爱饿人的，但饿人却不爱饱人，黄巢时候，人相食，饿人尚且不爱饿人，这实在无须斗争文学作怪。我是不相信文艺的旋乾转坤的力量的，但倘有人要在别方面应用他，我以为也可以。譬如“宣传”就是。
As for the struggle, I think it's right. People are oppressed, why not fight? The upright gentlemen were deeply afraid of this, so they scolded the hatred of "extreme", thinking that everyone should love each other, but now they have been taught by a group of bad things. They are full of people about love the hungry, but the hungry people do not love the hungry people, when the yellow nest was in the past, people cannibalized, and the hungry people did not love the hungry people, which really did not need to be troubled by struggle literature. I don't believe in the power of literature and art, but if someone wants to apply it in other ways, I think it's okay. For example, "propaganda" is.美国的辛克来儿说：一切文艺是宣传。我们的革命的文学者曾经当作宝贝，用大字印出过，而严肃的批评家又说他是“浅薄的社会主义者”。但我——也浅薄——相信辛克来儿的话。一切文艺，是宣传，只要你一给人看。即使个人主义的作品，一写出，就有宣传的可能，除非你不作文，不开口。那么，用于革命，作为工具的一种，自然也可以的。
Sinclair in the United States said: All literature and art are propaganda. Our revolutionary writers were once used as treasures, printed in large letters, and serious critics called him a "shallow socialist". But I - and shallowly - believed Sinclair's words. All literature and art are propaganda, as long as you show them to others. Even if an individualistic work is written, it has the possibility of publicity, unless you don't write or speak. Then, it can be used for revolution, as a kind of tool, naturally too.但我以为当先求内容的充实和技巧的上达，不必忙于挂招牌。“稻香村”“陆稿荐”，已经不能打动人心了，“皇太后鞋店”的顾客，我看见也并不比“皇后鞋店”里的多。一说“技巧”，革命文学家是又要讨厌的。但我以为一切文艺固是宣传，而一切宣传却并非全是文艺，这正如一切花皆有色（我将白也算作色），而凡颜色未必都是花一样。革命之所以于口号，标语，布告，电报，教科书……之外，要用文艺者，就因为它是文艺。
But I think we should first seek the enrichment of content and the improvement of skills, and we don't have to be busy hanging signs. "Daoxiang Village" and "Lu Manuscript Recommendation" can no longer impress people's hearts, and I see no more customers in the "Empress Dowager Shoe Store" than in the "Queen's Shoe Store". When it comes to "skills", revolutionary writers have to hate it again. But I think that all literature and art are propaganda, but all propaganda is not all literature and art, just like all flowers have color (I count white as color), and all colors are not necessarily flowers. The revolution was carried out in slogans, slogans, proclamations, telegrams, textbooks...... In addition, those who want to use literature and art are because it is literature and art.但中国之所谓革命文学，似乎又作别论。招牌是挂了，却只在吹嘘同伙的文章，而对于目前的暴力和黑暗不敢正视。作品虽然也有些发表了，但往往是拙劣到连报章记事都不如；或则将剧本的动作辞句都推到演员的“昨日的文学家”身上去。那么，剩下来的思想的内容一定是很革命底了罢？我给你看两句冯乃超的剧本的结末的警句：
But China's so-called revolutionary literature seems to be a different story. The signboard is hung, but it is only boasting about the articles of the accomplices, and does not dare to face up to the current violence and darkness. Although some of his works have been published, they are often so clumsy that they are not even as good as newspaper records; Or push the action and phrases of the script to the actor's "yesterday's writer". So, the content of the remaining ideas must be very revolutionary, right? Let me show you two aphorisms at the end of Feng Naichao's script:“野雉：我再不怕黑暗了。
"Wild Pheasant: I'm no longer afraid of the dark.偷儿：我们反抗去！”
Thief: Let's resist! ”四月四日。鲁迅。April 4th. Lu Xun.

flat中国文艺界上可怕的现象，是在尽先输入名词，而并不绍介这名词的函义。
The terrible phenomenon in the Chinese literary and artistic circles is to enter the noun first, but not to introduce the meaning of the term.于是各各以意为之。看见作品上多讲自己，便称之为表现主义；多讲别人，是写实主义；见女郎小腿肚作诗，是浪漫主义；见女郎小腿肚不准作诗，是古典主义；天上掉下一颗头，头上站着一头牛，爱呀，海中央的青霹雳呀……是未来主义……等等。
So each person did it according to their own wishes. When you see more about yourself in your works, you call it expressionism; talking more about others is realism; seeing the girl's calf and composing poetry is romanticism; seeing the girl's calf is not allowed to write poetry, which is classicism; A head fell from the sky, and a cow stood on its head, love, a green thunderbolt in the middle of the sea...... Is it futuristic...... Wait a minute.还要由此生出议论来。这个主义好，那个主义坏……等等。
It also gives rise to discussion. This doctrine is good, that doctrine is bad...... Wait a minute.乡间一向有一个笑谈：两位近视眼要比眼力，无可质证，
There has always been a joke in the countryside: two myopic eyes are better than eyesight, and there is no verifiable.便约定到关帝庙去看这一天新挂的扁额。他们都先从漆匠探得字句。但因为探来的详略不同，只知道大字的那一个便不服，争执起来了，说看见小字的人是说谎的。又无可质证，只好一同探问一个过路的人。那人望了一望，回答道：“什么也没有。扁还没有挂哩。”
So he agreed to go to the Guandi Temple to see the newly hung plaque on this day. They all first found the words from the lacquer craftsman. But because of the slightly different details, the one who only knew the big characters was not convinced and argued, saying that the person who saw the small characters was lying. There was no evidence to prove, so they had to ask a passerby together. The man looked at it and replied, "Nothing." Flat hasn't hung it yet. ”我想，在文艺批评上要比眼力，也总得先有那块扁额挂起来才行。空空洞洞的争，实在只有两面自己心里明白。
I think that in literary and artistic criticism, we must first have that flat forehead to hang up. There are only two sides to the empty dispute, and I really understand it in my heart.四月十日。

road又记起了Gogol做的《巡按使》的故事：

Y先生：
Mr. Y:我当答复之前，先要向你告罪，因为我不能如你的所嘱，不将来信发表。来信的意思，是要我公开答复的，那么，倘将原信藏下，则我的一切所说，便变成“无题诗N百韵”，令人莫名其妙了。况且我的意见，以为这也不足耻笑。自然，中国很有为革命而死掉的人，也很有虽然吃苦，仍在革命的人，但也有虽然革命，而在享福的人……。革命而尚不死，当然不能算革命到底，殊无以对死者，但一切活着的人，该能原谅的罢，彼此都不过是靠侥幸，或靠狡滑，巧妙。他们只要用镜子略略一照，大概就可以收起那一副英雄嘴脸来的。
Before I answer, I will apologize to you, because I cannot publish the letter as you have instructed. The meaning of the letter is to ask me to reply publicly, so if I hide the original letter, everything I say will become "untitled poem N hundred rhymes", which is inexplicable. Moreover, in my opinion, I think this is not a shameful laugh. Naturally, there are many people in China who died for the revolution, and there are also people who are still revolutionizing despite suffering, but there are also people who are enjoying happiness despite the revolution...... The revolution is not dead, of course, it cannot be regarded as a revolution to the end, and there is nothing to do with the dead, but all living people should be forgiven, and each other is just a fluke, or cunning, and ingenious. As long as they take a slight look in the mirror, they can probably put away that heroic face.我在先前，本来也还无须卖文糊口的，拿笔的开始，是在应朋友的要求。不过大约心里原也藏着一点不平，因此动起笔来，每不免露些愤言激语，近于鼓动青年的样子。段祺瑞执政之际，虽颇有人造了谣言，但我敢说，我们所做的那些东西，决不沾别国的半个卢布，阔人的一文津贴，或者书铺的一点稿费。我也不想充“文学家”，所以也从不连络一班同伙的批评家叫好。几本小说销到上万，是我想也没有想到的。
I didn't have to sell literature to make a living before, and I started taking a pen at the request of a friend. However, there was probably a little injustice hidden in his heart, so when he started writing, he couldn't help but show some indignation, which was close to encouraging young people. When Duan Qirui was in power, although there were quite a few rumors, I dare to say that the things we do will never be touched by half a ruble from another country, a penny allowance from a generous person, or a little manuscript fee from a bookstore. I also don't want to be a "writer", so I never contact a group of critics who are accomplices to applaud. Several novels sold tens of thousands, which I never thought of.至于希望中国有改革，有变动之心，那的确是有一点的。虽然有人指定我为没有出路——哈哈，出路，中状元么——的作者，“毒笔”的文人，但我自信并未抹杀一切。我总以为下等人胜于上等人，青年胜于老头子，所以从前并未将我的笔尖的血，洒到他们身上去。我也知道一有利害关系的时候，他们往往也就和上等人老头子差不多了，然而这是在这样的社会组织之下，势所必至的事。对于他们，攻击的人又正多，我何必再来助人下石呢，所以我所揭发的黑暗是只有一方面的，本意实在并不在欺蒙阅读的青年。
As for the hope that China will reform and change, it is indeed a little. Although some people have designated me as the author of no way out - haha, the way out, the champion - a literati with a "poisonous pen", I am confident that I have not erased everything. I always thought that the lower class was better than the upper class, and the young man was better than the old man, so I didn't spill the blood of my pen tip on them before. I also know that when there is a stake, they are often similar to upper-class old men, but this is inevitable under such a social organization. For them, there are many people who attack, why should I help others get off the rock, so the darkness I exposed is only one aspect, and the original intention is not to deceive the young people who read.以上是我尚在北京，就是成仿吾所谓“蒙在鼓里”做小资产阶级时候的事。但还是因为行文不慎，饭碗敲破了，并且非走不可了，所以不待“无烟火药”来轰，便辗转跑到了“革命策源地”。住了两月，我就骇然，原来往日所闻，全是谣言，这地方，却正是军人和商人所主宰的国土。于是接着是清党，详细的事实，报章上是不大见的，只有些风闻。我正有些神经过敏，于是觉得正像是“聚而歼旃”，很不免哀痛。虽然明知道这是“浅薄的人道主义”，不时髦已经有两三年了，但因为小资产阶级根性未除，于心总是戚戚。那时我就想到我恐怕也是安排筵宴的一个人，就在答有恒先生的信中，表白了几句。
The above is what happened when I was still in Beijing, when I was "in the dark" and was a petty bourgeoisie. But because of careless writing, the rice bowl was broken, and he had to leave, so he didn't wait for the "smokeless gunpowder" to bombard, so he ran to the "source of the revolution". After living for two months, I was shocked that what I had heard in the past was all rumors, but this place was the land dominated by soldiers and merchants. So then came the purge of the party, detailed facts, which were not common in the newspapers, only some rumors. I was a little nervous, so I felt like I was "gathering and annihilating", and I couldn't help but feel sad. Although I know that this is "shallow humanitarianism" and has been unfashionable for two or three years, I am always worried because the petty-bourgeois nature has not been removed. At that time, I thought that I was probably also the one who arranged the banquet, so I confessed a few words in response to Mr. Youheng's letter.先前的我的言论，的确失败了，这还是因为我料事之不明。那原因，大约就在多年“坐在玻璃窗下，醉眼朦胧看人生”的缘故。然而那么风云变幻的事，恐怕世界上是不多有的，我没有料到，未曾描写，可见我还不很有“毒笔”。但是，那时的情形，却连在十字街头，在民间，在官间，前看五十年的超时代的革命文学家也似乎没有看到，所以毫不先行“理论斗争”。否则，该可以救出许多人的罢。我在这里引出革命文学家来，并非要在事后讥笑他们的愚昧，不过是说，我的看不到后来的变幻，乃是我还欠刻毒，因此便发生错误，并非我和什么人协商，或自己要做什么，立意来欺人。
My previous remarks did fail, but it was because I didn't know what was happening. The reason is probably because of many years of "sitting under the glass window, drunkenly looking at life". However, such a changeable thing, I am afraid that there are not many things in the world, I did not expect it, I have not described it, it can be seen that I am not very "poisonous". However, the situation at that time did not seem to be seen even in the cross streets, among the people, among the officials, and the revolutionary writers who looked at the past fifty years ago, so they did not first engage in "theoretical struggle". Otherwise, many people should be saved. I am here to introduce revolutionary writers, not to ridicule their ignorance afterwards, but to say that I cannot see the changes later, but that I still owe the viciousness, so I made a mistake, not because I negotiated with anyone or what I wanted to do, and intended to deceive others.但立意怎样，于事实是无干的。我疑心吃苦的人们中，或不免有看了我的文章，受了刺戟，于是挺身出而革命的青年，所以实在很苦痛。但这也因为我天生的不是革命家的缘故，倘是革命巨子，看这一点牺牲，是不算一回事的。第一是自己活着，能永远做指导，因为没有指导，革命便不成功了。你看革命文学家，就都在上海租界左近，一有风吹草动，就有洋鬼子造成的铁丝网，将反革命文学的华界隔离，于是从那里面掷出无烟火药——约十万两——来，轰然一声，一切有闲阶级便都“奥伏赫变”了。
But what the intention is has nothing to do with the facts. Among the people I suspect and suffer, there may be young people who read my articles and have been stabbed and have stepped forward to revolutionize, so it is really painful. But this is also because I was not born a revolutionary, and if I am a revolutionary giant, it is not the same thing to see this sacrifice. The first is to live by yourself and be guided forever, because without guidance, the revolution will not succeed. You see, revolutionary writers are all close to the Shanghai Concession, and as soon as there is a disturbance, there is a barbed wire fence created by foreign devils to isolate the Chinese boundary of counter-revolutionary literature, so smokeless gunpowder - about 100,000 taels - is thrown from it, and with a bang, all the idle classes "Ovoch change".那些革命文学家，大抵是今年发生的，有一大串。虽然还在互相标榜，或互相排斥，我也分不清是“革命已经成功”的文学家呢，还是“革命尚未成功”的文学家。不过似乎说是因为有了我的一本《呐喊》或《野草》，或我们印了《语丝》，所以革命还未成功，或青年懒于革命了。这口吻却大家大略一致的。这是今年革命文学界的舆论。对于这些舆论，我虽然又好气又好笑，但也颇有些高兴。因为虽然得了延误革命的罪状，而一面却免去诱杀青年的内疚了。那么，一切死者，伤者，吃苦者，都和我无关。先前真是擅负责任。我先前是立意要不讲演，不教书，不发议论，使我的名字从社会上死去，算是我的赎罪的，今年倒心里轻松了，又有些想活动。不料得了你的信，却又使我的心沉重起来。
Those revolutionary writers, probably happened this year, and there is a large list. Although they are still flaunting each other or excluding each other, I can't tell whether they are writers who "have succeeded in the revolution" or those who "have not yet succeeded". However, it seems that it is because of my copy of "Scream" or "Weeds", or we printed "Silk of Words", so the revolution has not yet succeeded, or the young people are lazy to revolutionize. This tone is roughly the same for everyone. This is the public opinion of this year's revolutionary literary circles. Although I am angry and funny about these public opinions, I am also quite happy. Because although he was charged with delaying the revolution, he was spared the guilt of booby-trapping young people. Then, all the dead, the wounded, and the suffering have nothing to do with me. I was really good at being responsible before. I had previously intended not to give lectures, teach, or make discussions, so that my name would die from society, which was my atonement, but this year I felt relieved and wanted to be active. I didn't expect your letter to weigh on my heart again.但我已经没有去年那么沉重。近大半年来，征之舆论，按之经验，知道革命与否，还在其人，不在文章的。你说我毒害了你了，但这里的批评家，却明明说我的文字是“非革命”的。假使文学足以移人，则他们看了我的文章，应该不想做革命文学了，现在他们已经看了我的文章，断定是“非革命”，而仍不灰心，要做革命文学者，可见文字于人，实在没有什么影响，——只可惜是同时打破了革命文学的牌坊。不过先生和我素昧平生，想来决不至于诬栽我，所以我再从别一面来想一想。第一，我以为你胆子太大了，别的革命文学家，因为我描写黑暗，便吓得屁滚尿流，以为没有出路了，所以他们一定要讲最后的胜利，付多少钱终得多少利，像人寿保险公司一般。而你并不计较这些，偏要向黑暗进攻，这是吃苦的原因之一。既然太大胆，那么，第二，就是太认真。革命是也有种种的。你的遗产被革去了，但也有将遗产革来的，但也有连性命都革去的，也有只革到薪水，革到稿费，而倒捐了革命家的头衔的。这些英雄，自然是认真的，但若较原先更有损了，则我以为其病根就在“太”。第三，是你还以为前途太光明，所以一碰钉子，便大失望，如果先前不期必胜，则即使失败，苦痛恐怕会小得多罢。
But I'm not as heavy as last year. In the past six months, we have asked public opinion and experience to know whether it is revolutionary or not, but it is still in the person, not in the article. You say I poisoned you, but the critics here clearly say that my words are "non-revolutionary". If literature is enough to move people, then they should not want to do revolutionary literature after reading my article, and now they have read my article and concluded that it is "non-revolutionary", but they are still not discouraged, and if they want to be revolutionary writers, it can be seen that words have no impact on people,—— but it is a pity that they have broken the archway of revolutionary literature at the same time. However, my husband and I have never known each other in our lives, and I will never frame me, so I will think about it from another side. First, I thought you were too bold, other revolutionary writers, because I described darkness, were so frightened that they thought there was no way out, so they must talk about the final victory, how much money they pay, how much profit they get, like a life insurance company. And you don't care about this, but attack the darkness, which is one of the reasons for suffering. Since it is too bold, then, secondly, it is too serious. There are all kinds of revolutions. Your inheritance has been abolished, but there are also those who have lost their lives, and there are those who have only received their salaries and manuscript fees, but have donated the title of revolutionary. These heroes are naturally serious, but if they are more damaged than before, I think the root of their disease lies in "Tai". Third, you still think that the future is too bright, so when you touch a nail, you will be disappointed, and if you don't expect to win before, even if you fail, the pain may be much less.那么，我没有罪戾么？有的，现在正有许多正人君子和革命文学家，用明枪暗箭，在办我革命及不革命之罪，将来我所受的伤的总计，我就划一部分赔偿你的尊“头”。
So, am I not guilty? Yes, there are many righteous gentlemen and revolutionary writers who are using open guns and hidden arrows to deal with my revolutionary and non-revolutionary crimes, and I will compensate you for the total injuries I have suffered in the future.这里添一点考据：“还我头来”这话，据《三国志演义》，是关云长夫子说的，似乎并非梁遇春先生。
Here is a little evidence: "Give me back my head", according to the "Romance of the Three Kingdoms", it was said by Master Guan Yunchang, and it seems that it is not Mr. Liang Yuchun.以上其实都是空话。一到先生个人问题的阵营，倒是十分难于动手了，这决不是什么“前进呀，杀呀，青年呵”那样英气勃勃的文字所能解决的。真话呢，我也不想公开，因为现在还是言行不大一致的好。但来信没有住址，无法答复，只得在这里说几句。第一，要谋生，谋生之道，则不择手段。且住，现在很有些没分晓汉，以为“问目的不问手段”是共产党的口诀，这是大错的。人们这样的很多，不过他们不肯说出口。苏俄的学艺教育人民委员卢那却尔斯奇所作的《被解放的吉诃德先生》里，将这手段使一个公爵使用，可见也是贵族的东西，堂皇冠冕。第二，要爱护爱人。这据舆论，是大背革命之道的。但不要紧，你只要做几篇革命文字，主张革命青年不该讲恋爱就好了。只是假如有一个有权者或什么敌前来问罪的时候，这也许仍要算一条罪状，你会后悔轻信了我的话。因此，我得先行声明：等到前来问罪的时候，倘没有这一节，他们就会找别一条的。盖天下的事，往往决计问罪在先，而搜集罪状（普通是十条）在后也。
The above is actually empty words. Once you get to the camp of Mr. Xiang's personal problems, it is very difficult to do it, which is by no means something that can be solved by heroic words like "Advance, kill, young man". The truth, I don't want to make it public, because it's still better to be inconsistent with words and deeds. But the letter had no address and could not be replied to, so I had to say a few words here. First, to make a living, the way to make a living is to do whatever it takes. Wait a minute, now there are a lot of ignorant Han, thinking that "asking about the purpose but not the means" is the Communist Party's mantra, which is a big mistake. There are a lot of people like this, but they refuse to say it. In "Mr. Quixote Liberated" written by Luna Chersky, the People's Commissar of Academic and Artistic Education of Soviet Russia, this method was used by a duke, which can be seen as a noble thing, and it is a grand crown. Second, we must love our lovers. According to public opinion, this is a big departure from the way of revolution. But it doesn't matter, you just need to make a few revolutionary texts and advocate that revolutionary youth should not talk about love. It's just that if a powerful person or some enemy comes to ask for forgiveness, it may still be counted as a crime, and you will regret believing my words. Therefore, I must declare that when they come to ask for forgiveness, if there is no this verse, they will find another one. In fact, in the world, the decision to investigate the crime comes first, and the collection of crimes (usually ten articles) comes later.先生，我将这样的话写出，可以略蔽我的过错了罢。因为只这一点，我便可以又受许多伤。先是革命文学家就要哭骂道：“虚无主义者呀，你这坏东西呀！”呜呼，一不谨慎，又在新英雄的鼻子上抹了一点粉了。趁便先辩几句罢：无须大惊小怪，这不过不择手段的手段，还不是主义哩。即使是主义，我敢写出，肯写出，还不算坏东西。等到我坏起来，就一定将这些宝贝放在肚子里，手头集许多钱，住在安全地带，而主张别人必须做牺牲。
Sir, I write these words to cover up my faults. Because of this alone, I can get hurt many more. First, the revolutionary writer was about to cry and scold: "Nihilist, you bad thing!" "Oh, if you are not careful, you will smear a little powder on the nose of the new hero. Let's take the opportunity to argue a few words first: no need to make a fuss, this is just an unscrupulous means, not a doctrine. Even if it is a doctrine, I dare to write it, and I am willing to write it, it is not a bad thing. When I get bad, I will definitely put these treasures in my stomach, save a lot of money on hand, live in a safe area, and insist that others must make sacrifices.先生，我也劝你暂时玩玩罢，随便弄一点糊口之计，不过我并不希望你永久“没落”，有能改革之处，还是随时可以顺手改革的，无论大小。我也一定遵命，不但“歇歇”，而且玩玩。但这也并非因为你的警告，实在是原有此意的了。我要更加讲趣味，寻闲暇，即使偶然涉及什么，那是文字上的疏忽，若论“动机”或“良心”，却也许并不这样的。
Sir, I also advise you to play around for the time being and make a living, but I don't want you to "decline" permanently, and if there is something that can be reformed, it can be reformed at any time, no matter how big or small. I will definitely obey the order, not only "rest", but also play. But this is not because of your warning, it is really the original intention. I want to be more interesting, looking for leisure, even if it happens to involve something, it is a literal negligence, if it is about "motive" or "conscience", it may not be like this.纸完了，回信也即此为止。并且顺颂
The paper is finished, and the reply ends here. And sing in accordance with the hymns痊安，又祝

太平歌诀

Peace song四月六日的《申报》上有这样的一段记事：
There is such a passage in the "Declaration" on April 6:“南京市近日忽发现一种无稽谣传，谓总理墓行将工竣，石匠有摄收幼童灵魂，以合龙口之举。市民以讹传讹，自相惊扰，因而家家幼童，左肩各悬红布一方，上书歌诀四句，借避危险。其歌诀约有三种：（一）人来叫我魂，自叫自当承。叫人叫不着，自己顶石坟。（二）石叫石和尚，自叫自承当。急早回家转，免去顶坟坛。（三）你造中山墓，与我何相干？一叫魂不去，再叫自承当。”（后略）
Nanjing City recently discovered a nonsensical rumor that the premier's tomb was about to be completed, and the stonemason had taken the souls of young children to close the dragon's mouth. Citizens were disturbed by rumors, so every young child hung a red cloth on each left shoulder and wrote four verses of the song to avoid danger. There are about three types of songs: (1) When people come to call my soul, I call myself self-accepting. If you can't call it, you can top the stone grave yourself. (2) The stone is called the stone monk, and he calls himself self-assured. Hurry home early to avoid the top of the grave. (3) What does your construction of the Zhongshan Tomb have to do with me? One call the soul does not leave, and the second call is self-acceptance. (Omitted)这三首中的无论那一首，虽只寥寥二十字，但将市民的见解：对于革命政府的关系，对于革命者的感情，都已经写得淋漓尽致。虽有善于暴露社会黑暗面的文学家，恐怕也难有做到这么简明深切的了。“叫人叫不着，自己顶石坟”。则竟包括了许多革命者的传记和一部中国革命的历史。
No matter which of these three poems, although it is only twenty words, the opinions of the citizens: the relationship between the revolutionary government and the feelings of the revolutionaries have been vividly written. Although there are writers who are good at exposing the dark side of society, I am afraid it is difficult to be so concise and profound. "If you can't call it, you can top the stone grave yourself." It actually includes the biographies of many revolutionaries and a history of the Chinese revolution.看看有些人们的文字，似乎硬要说现在是“黎明之前”。然而市民是这样的市民，黎明也好，黄昏也好，革命者们总不能不背着这一伙市民进行。鸡肋，弃之不甘，食之无味，就要这样地牵缠下去。五十一百年后能否就有出路，是毫无把握的。
Looking at the words of some people, it seems that they insist that it is "before dawn". However, the citizens are such citizens, whether it is dawn or dusk, the revolutionaries cannot help but carry this group of citizens behind their backs. Chicken ribs, abandoned unwillingly, tasteless to eat, will be entangled like this. It is uncertain whether there will be a way out after fifty or one hundred years.近来的革命文学家往往特别畏惧黑暗，掩藏黑暗，但市民却毫不客气，自己表现了。那小巧的机灵和这厚重的麻木相撞，便使革命文学家不敢正视社会现象，变成婆婆妈妈，欢迎喜鹊，憎厌枭鸣，只检一点吉祥之兆来陶醉自己，于是就算超出了时代。
Revolutionary writers in recent times are often particularly afraid of the dark and hide the darkness, but the citizens are unceremonious, and they show themselves. The collision of that small cleverness and this heavy numbness made revolutionary writers dare not face up to social phenomena, become mothers-in-law, welcome magpies, hate owls, and only check a little auspicious omen to intoxicate themselves, so even if they are beyond the times.恭喜的英雄，你前去罢，被遗弃了的现实的现代，在后面恭送你的行旌。
Congratulations to the hero, you go, the abandoned reality of the modern era, and send you off your banner behind.但其实还是同在。你不过闭了眼睛。不过眼睛一闭，“顶石坟”却可以不至于了，这就是你的“最后的胜利”。
But in fact, they are still together. You just close your eyes. But as soon as you close your eyes, the "Capstone Tomb" can be gone, this is your "final victory".四月十日。
April 10th.

My attitude, temperament and age英勇的刊物是层出不穷，“文艺的分野”上的确热闹起来了。日报广告上的《战线》这名目就惹人注意，一看便知道其中都是战士。承蒙一个朋友寄给我三本，才得看见了一点枪烟，并且明白弱水做的《谈中国现在的文学界》里的有一粒弹子，是瞄准着我的。为什么呢？因为先是《“醉眼”中的朦胧》做错了。据说错处有三：一是态度，二是气量，三是年纪。复述易于失真，还是将这粒子弹移置在下面罢：
Heroic publications emerged one after another, and the "division of literature and art" was indeed lively. The name "Front" in the daily newspaper advertisement is eye-catching, and you can tell at a glance that it is full of soldiers. Thanks to a friend who sent me three copies, I had to see a little gun smoke, and I understood that there was a bullet in "On China's Current Literary Circle" made by Ruoshui, which was aimed at me. Why? Because first of all, "The Hazy in "Drunken Eyes" did it wrong. It is said that there are three mistakes: one is attitude, the second is temperament, and the third is age. The retelling is easy to distort, so let's move this particle bomb below:“鲁迅那篇，不敬得很，态度太不兴了。我们从他先后的论战上看来，不能不说他的量气太窄了。最先（据所知）他和西滢战，继和长虹战，我们一方面觉得正直是在他这面，一方面又觉得辞锋太有点尖酸刻薄，现在又和创造社战，辞锋仍是尖酸，正直却不一定落在他这面。是的，仿吾和初梨两人对他的批评是可以有反驳的地方，但这应庄严出之，因为他们所走的方向不能算不对，冷嘲热刺，只有对于冥顽不灵者为必要，因为是不可理喻。对于热烈猛进的绝对不合用这种态度。他那种态度，虽然在他自己亦许觉得骂得痛快，但那种口吻，适足表出‘老头子’的确不行吧了。好吧，这事本该是没有勉强的必要和可能，让各人走各人的路去好了。我们不禁想起了五四时的林琴南先生了！”
Lu Xun's article is very disrespectful and has a very unhappy attitude. From his successive debates, we cannot help but say that his temperament is too narrow. First (as far as known) he fought with Xiying, and then with Changhong, on the one hand, we felt that integrity was on his side, on the other hand, we felt that Ci Feng was too bitter, and now we were fighting with the creation of society, Ci Feng was still bitter, but integrity did not necessarily fall on his side. Yes, the criticism of him by Fangwu and Chuli can be refuted, but this should be solemn, because the direction they are taking cannot be considered wrong, and the sneering Tottenham Hotspur is only necessary for those who are stubborn, because it is unreasonable. This attitude is absolutely not appropriate for enthusiastic progress. His attitude, although he may feel happy to scold himself, but that kind of tone is enough to show that the 'old man' is indeed not good. Well, this should not have been forced and possible, let everyone go their own way. We can't help but think of Mr. Lin Qinnan in May Fourth! ”这一段虽然并不涉及是非，只在态度，量气，口吻上，断定这“老头子的确不行”，从此又自然而然地抹杀我那篇文字，但粗粗一看，却很像第三者从旁的批评。从我看来，“尖酸刻薄”之处也不少，作者大概是青年，不会有“老头子”气的，这恐怕因为我“冥顽不灵”，不得已而用之的罢，或者便是自己不觉得。不过我要指摘，这位隐姓埋名的弱水先生，其实是创造社那一面的。我并非说，这些战士，大概是创造社里常见他的脚踪，或在艺术大学里兼有一只饭碗，不过指明他们是相同的气类。因此，所谓《战线》，也仍不过是创造社的战线。所以我和西滢长虹战，他虽然看见正直，却一声不响，今和创造社战，便只看见尖酸，忽然显战士身而出现了。其实所断定的先两回的我的“正直”，也还是死了已经两千多年了的老头子老聃先师的“将欲取之必先与之”的战略，我并不感服这类的公评。陈西滢也知道这种战法的，他因为要打倒我的短评，便称赞我的小说，以见他之公正。

The old and the new are often very similar—for example: individualists and socialists tend to oppose the bourgeoisie, conservatives and reformers tend to advocate the art of life and avoid darkness, stickmen and communists hate humanitarianism, etc. As for the reason why it didn't work, the key was that he was born earlier, and he didn't know that this class would be "changed by the Olympic service" and change his plan early, so in the final analysis, the true nature of Fascist was clearly revealed. But I think that the "old man" is like this, there is no need to worry, he always dies before the young man. Mr. Lin Qinnan is already dead. The scary thing is that the young man who will be the pillar of the future is still like his pulling around.又来说话，量气又太小了，再说下去，就要更小，“正直”岂但“不一定”在这一面呢，还要一定不在这一面。而且所说的又都是自己的事，并非“大贫”的民众……。但是，即使所讲的只是个人的事，有些人固然只看见个人，有些人却也看见背景或环境。例如《鲁迅在广东》这一本书，今年战士们忽以为编者和被编者希图不朽，于是看得“烦躁”，也给了一点对于“冥顽不灵”的冷嘲。我却以为这太偏于唯心论了，无所谓不朽，不朽又干吗，这是现代人大抵知道的。所以会有这一本书，其实不过是要黑字印在白纸上，订成一本，作商品出售罢了。无论是怎样泡制法，所谓“鲁迅”也者，往往不过是充当了一种的材料。这种方法，便是“所走的方向不能算不对”的创造社也在所不免的。托罗兹基虽然已经“没落”，但他曾说，不含利害关系的文章，当在将来另一制度的社会里。我以为他这话却还是对的。
Speaking again, the measure is too small, and if you continue to talk about it, it will be even smaller, "integrity" is not only "not necessarily" on this side, but also must not be on this side. And what they say is their own business, not the ...... of the "poor" people. However, even if it is only a personal matter, some people see only the individual, and some people see the background or the environment. For example, in the book "Lu Xun in Guangdong", this year's soldiers suddenly thought that the editor and the editor wanted to be immortal, so they read it "irritable", and also gave a little cynicism about "stubbornness". I think this is too idealistic, it doesn't matter if it is immortal, why is it immortal, this is what modern people probably know. So there will be this book, but in fact, it is just to be printed in black on white paper, ordered into a copy, and sold as a commodity. No matter how it is brewed, the so-called "Lu Xun" is often just a kind of material. This method is inevitable for the Creation Society, which "cannot be considered wrong in the direction it is taking". Although Trotsky has "declined", he once said that articles without interests should be in a society with another system in the future. I thought he was right.四月二十日。

革命咖啡店

革命咖啡店

革命咖啡店

Revolution Coffee Shop革命咖啡店的革命底广告式文字，昨天在报章上看到了，仗着第四个“有闲”，先抄一段在下面：
The revolutionary bottom advertising text of the revolutionary coffee shop was seen in the newspaper yesterday, relying on the fourth "leisure", I copied a paragraph below:“……但是读者们，我却发现了这样一家我们所理想的乐园，我一共去了两次，我在那里遇见了我们今日文艺界上的名人，龚冰庐，鲁迅，郁达夫等。并且认识了孟超，潘汉年，叶灵凤等，他们有的在那里高谈着他们的主张，有的在那里默默沉思，我在那里领会到不少教益呢。……”
“…… But readers, I found such an ideal paradise, I went there twice, where I met our celebrities in today's literary and art circles, Gong Binglu, Lu Xun, Yu Dafu, etc. And I met Meng Chao, Pan Hannian, Ye Lingfeng, etc., some of them talked about their ideas there, some meditated silently there, and I learned a lot of lessons there. ……”遥想洋楼高耸，前临阔街，门口是晶光闪灼的玻璃招牌，楼上是“我们今日文艺界上的名人”，或则高谈，或则沉思，面前是一大杯热气蒸腾的无产阶级咖啡，远处是许许多多“龌龊的农工大众”，他们喝着，想着，谈着，指导着，获得着，那是，倒也实在是“理想的乐园”。
Imagine the towering Western-style buildings, facing Broad Street, with a shining glass sign at the door, and "our celebrities in today's literary and artistic circles" upstairs, either talking high, or contemplating, in front of a large cup of steaming proletarian coffee, and in the distance are many "dirty peasants and workers", who drink, think, talk, guide, and obtain, that is, it is really an "ideal paradise".何况既喝咖啡，又领“教益”呢？上海滩上，一举两得的买卖本来多。大如弄几本杂志，便算革命；小如买多少钱书籍，即赠送真丝光袜或请吃冰淇淋——虽然我至今还猜不透那些惠顾的人们，究竟是意在看书呢，还是要穿丝光袜。至于咖啡店，先前只听说不过可以兼看舞女，使女，“以饱眼福”罢了。谁料这回竟是“名人”，给人“教益”，还演“高谈”“沉思”种种好玩的把戏，那简直是现实的乐园了。
What's more, drink coffee and receive "teachings"? On the beach, there are many deals that kill two birds with one stone. If you get a few magazines, it is considered a revolution; For example, how much money is spent on books, that is, real silk stockings or ice cream - although I still can't guess whether those patrons are meant to read books or wear silk stockings. As for the coffee shop, I only heard that you can also watch dancers and maids, "to feast your eyes". Who would have thought that this time he was actually a "celebrity", giving people "teachings", and also performing all kinds of fun tricks of "talking high" and "contemplating", which was simply a paradise of reality.但我又有几句声明——
But I have a few more statements—就是：这样的咖啡店里，我没有上去过，那一位作者所“遇见”的，又是别一人。因为：一，我是不喝咖啡的，我总觉得这是洋大人所喝的东西（但这也许是我的“时代错误”），不喜欢，还是绿茶好。二，我要抄“小说旧闻”之类，无暇享受这样乐园的清福。三，这样的乐园，我是不敢上去的，革命文学家，要年青貌美，齿白唇红，如潘汉年叶灵凤辈，这才是天生的文豪，乐园的材料；如我者，在《战线》上就宣布过一条“满口黄牙”的罪状，到那里去高谈，岂不亵渎了“无产阶级文学”么？还有四，则即使我要上去，也怕走不到，至多，只能在店后门远处彷徨彷徨，嗅嗅咖啡渣的气息罢了。你看这里面不很有些在前线的文豪么，我却是“落伍者”，决不会坐在一屋子里的。
That is: I have never been to such a coffee shop, and the author "met" someone else. Because: First, I don't drink coffee, I always feel that this is what foreigners drink (but this may be my "anachronism"), I don't like it, or green tea is better. Second, I want to copy "old novels" and the like, and I have no time to enjoy the bliss of such a paradise. Third, I dare not go to such a paradise, revolutionary writers, young and beautiful, white teeth and red lips, such as Pan Hannian Ye Lingfeng and others, this is the natural writer, the material of the paradise; For example, I announced a crime of "full of yellow teeth" on the "Front", and if I go there to talk about it, wouldn't it blaspheme "proletarian literature"? and fourth, even if I want to go up, I am afraid that I won't be able to walk, at most, I can only wander in the distance at the back door of the store, sniffing the smell of coffee grounds. Don't you think there are many literary heroes on the front line, but I am a "laggard" and will never sit in a room.以上都是真话。叶灵凤革命艺术家曾经画过我的像，说是躲在酒坛的后面。这事的然否我不谈。现在所要声明的，只是这乐园中我没有去，也不想去，并非躲在咖啡杯后面在骗人。
The above is all true. Ye Lingfeng, a revolutionary artist, once painted a portrait of me, saying that he was hiding behind the wine altar. I won't talk about whether this matter is right or wrong. What I want to declare now is that I didn't go to this paradise, and I didn't want to go, and I wasn't hiding behind a coffee cup to deceive people.杭州另外有一个鲁迅时，我登了一篇启事，“革命文学家”就挖苦了。但现在仍要自己出手来做一回，一者因为我不是咖啡，不愿意在革命店里做装点；二是我没有创造社那么阔，有一点事就一个律师，两个律师。
When there was another Lu Xun in Hangzhou, I posted a notice, and the "revolutionary writer" sarcastically said. But now I still have to do it myself, one is because I am not coffee, and I don't want to decorate it in the revolutionary shop; Second, I am not as broad as the Creation Society, and there is only one lawyer and two lawyers for a little thing.八月十日。
August 10th.

文坛的掌故

文坛的掌故

文坛的掌故

The story of the literary world来信
Letter编者先生：
Mr. Editor:由最近一个上海的朋友告诉我，“沪上的文艺界，近来为着革命文学的问题，闹得十分嚣。”有趣极了！这问题，在去年中秋前后，成都的文艺界，同样也剧烈的争论过。但闹得并不“嚣”，战区也不见扩大，便结束。大约除了成都，别处是很少知道有这一回事的。
A friend in Shanghai recently told me, "The literary and artistic circles in Shanghai have been making a lot of noise about the issue of revolutionary literature recently. "It's fun! This issue was also fiercely debated in Chengdu's literary and artistic circles around the Mid-Autumn Festival last year. But the trouble was not "noisy", and the theater of war did not expand, so it ended. Except for Chengdu, few other places know about this.现在让我来简约地说一说。
Now let me talk about it simply.这争论的起原，已经过了长时期的酝酿。双方的主体——赞成革命文学的，是国民日报社。——怀疑他们所谓革命文学的，是九五日报社。最先还仅是暗中的鼎峙；接着因了国民政府在长江一带逐渐发展，成都的革命文学家，便投机似的成立了“革命文艺研究社”，来竭力鼓吹无产阶级的文学。而凑巧有个署名张拾遗君的《谈谈革命文学》一篇论文在那时出现。于是挑起了一班革命文学家的怒，两面的战争，便开始攻击。
The origin of this controversy has been brewing for a long time. The main body of both sides, the one in favor of revolutionary literature, is the National Daily. ——The one who doubted their so-called revolutionary literature was the 95th Daily Newspaper. At first, it was only a secret standoff; Then, due to the gradual development of the Nationalist government in the Yangtze River area, the revolutionary writers in Chengdu speculatively established the "Revolutionary Literature and Art Research Society" to advocate proletarian literature. And it just so happened that a paper signed by Zhang Shiyijun "On Revolutionary Literature" appeared at that time. So it provoked the anger of a group of revolutionary writers, and the war on both sides began to attack.至于两方面的战略：革命文学者以为一切都应该革命，要革命才有进步，才顺潮流。不革命便是封建社会的余孽，帝国主义的爪牙。同样和创造社是以唯物史观为根据的。——可是又无他们的彻底，而把“文学革命”与“革命文学”并为一谈。——反对者承认“革命文学”和“平民文学”“贵族文学”同为文学上一种名词，与文学革命无关，而怀疑其像煞有介事的神圣不可侵犯。且文学不应如此狭义；何况革命的题材，未必多。即有，隔靴搔痒的写来，也未必好。是近乎有些“为艺术而艺术”的说法。加入这战团的，革命文学方面，多为“清一色”的会员；而反对系，则半属不相识的朋友。
As for the two strategies: revolutionary writers think that everything should be revolutionary, and only by revolution can there be progress and follow the trend. Non-revolution is the remnant of feudal society, the minions of imperialism. Similarly, the Creation Society is based on historical materialism. ——But without their thoroughness, "literary revolution" and "revolutionary literature" are discussed together. - Opponents admit that "revolutionary literature", "civilian literature" and "aristocratic literature" are both literary terms and have nothing to do with the literary revolution, and suspect that they are like the sacredness of the matter. And literature should not be so narrow; What's more, there may not be many revolutionary themes. Even if there is, it may not be good to write it through the boot. It is almost a saying of "art for art's sake". Most of the members who joined this battle group were "all" members in terms of revolutionary literature; The opposition department is half of the friends who do not know each other.这一场混战的结果，是由“革命文艺研究社”不欲延长战线，自愿休兵。但何故休兵，局外人是不能猜测的。
The result of this melee was that the "Revolutionary Literature and Art Research Society" did not want to extend the front line and voluntarily ceased hostilities. But why the truce is beyond outsider guess.关于那次的文件，因“文献不足”，只好从略。
The documents about that time had to be omitted due to "insufficient literature".上海这次想必一定很可观。据我的朋友抄来的目录看，已颇有洋洋乎之概！可惜重庆方面，还没有看这些刊物的眼福！
Shanghai must be very impressive this time. According to the catalog copied by my friend, it is already quite exaggerated! It's a pity that Chongqing has not yet read these publications!这信只算预备将来“文坛的掌故”起见，并无挑拨，拥护任何方面的意思。
This letter is only considered to be in preparation for the future "literary history", and does not provoke and supports any meaning.废话已说得不少，就此打住，敬祝
I've said a lot of nonsense, stop here, blessings撰安！
Write An!徐匀。十七年七月八日，于重庆。
Slowly even. On July 8 of the seventeenth year, in Chongqing.

reply徐匀先生：
Mr. Xu Yun:多谢你写寄“文坛的掌故”的美意。
Thank you for writing the "Story of the Literary World".从年月推算起来，四川的“革命文学”，似乎还是去年出版的一本《革命文学论集》（书名大概如此，记不确切了，是丁丁编的）的余波。上海今年的“革命文学”，不妨说是又一幕。至于“嚣”与不“嚣”，那是要凭耳闻者的听觉的锐钝而定了。
Judging from the years and months, Sichuan's "revolutionary literature" seems to be the aftermath of a "Treatise on Revolutionary Literature" published last year (the title of the book is roughly like this, I can't remember exactly, it was edited by Ding Ding). Shanghai's "revolutionary literature" this year may be said to be another scene. As for whether it is "noisy" or not, it depends on the sharpness of the hearer's hearing.我在“革命文学”战场上，是“落伍者”，所以中心和前面的情状，不得而知。但向他们屁股那面望过去，则有成仿吾司令的《创造月刊》，《文化批判》，《流沙》，蒋光X（恕我还不知道现在已经改了那一字）拜帅的《太阳》，王独清领头的《我们》，青年革命艺术家叶灵凤独唱的《戈壁》；也是青年革命艺术家潘汉年编撰的《现代小说》和《战线》；再加一个真是“跟在弟弟背后说漂亮话”的潘梓年的速成的《洪荒》。但前几天看见K君对日本人的谈话（见《战旗》七月号），才知道潘叶之流的“革命文学”是不算在内的。
I am a "laggard" on the battlefield of "revolutionary literature", so the situation in the center and in front is unknown. But looking at their buttocks, there are Commander Cheng Fangwu's "Creation Monthly", "Cultural Criticism", "Quicksand", Jiang Guangx's "Sun" (forgive me for not knowing that the word has been changed now), "We" led by Wang Duqing, and "Gobi" sung by young revolutionary artist Ye Lingfeng; it is also "Modern Novel" and "Frontline" compiled by young revolutionary artist Pan Hannian; Add another quick "Flood Wilderness" by Pan Zinian, who really "speaks beautiful words behind his brother's back". But a few days ago, I saw Mr. K's conversation with the Japanese (see the July issue of "Battle Flag"), and I realized that Pan Ye's "revolutionary literature" is not included.含混地只讲“革命文学”，当然不能彻底，所以今年在上海所挂出来的招牌却确是无产阶级文学，至于是否以唯物史观为根据，则因为我是外行，不得而知。但一讲无产阶级文学，便不免归结到斗争文学，一讲斗争，便只能说是最高的政治斗争的一翼。这在俄国，是正当的，因为正是劳农专政；在日本也还不打紧，因为究竟还有一点微微的出版自由，居然也还说可以组织劳动政党。中国则不然，所以两月前就变了相，不但改名“新文艺”，并且根据了资产社会的法律，请律师大登其广告，来吓唬别人了。
Of course, it cannot be completely said that only "revolutionary literature" is vaguely spoken, so the signboard hung in Shanghai this year is indeed proletarian literature. But when talking about proletarian literature, it inevitably comes down to struggle literature, and when talking about struggle, it can only be said to be one of the highest wings of political struggle. This is justified in Russia, because it is the dictatorship of the workers and peasants; In Japan, it is not a big deal, because there is still a little freedom of the press, and it is said that it can organize a labor party. China is not like that, so it changed its appearance two months ago, not only changing its name to "New Literature and Art", but also asking lawyers to advertise it in accordance with the laws of the bourgeois society to scare others.向“革命的智识阶级”叫打倒旧东西，又拉旧东西来保护自己，要有革命者的名声，却不肯吃一点革命者往往难免的辛苦，于是不但笑啼俱伪，并且左右不同，连叶灵凤所抄袭来的“阴阳脸”，也还不足以淋漓尽致地为他们自己写照，我以为这是很可惜，也觉得颇寂寞的。
To the "revolutionary intellectual class" to knock down the old things, and pull the old things to protect themselves, to have the reputation of revolutionaries, but refuse to eat a little of the often inevitable hard work of revolutionaries, so not only laughing and crying, but also different left and right, even the "yin and yang faces" copied by Ye Lingfeng are not enough to vividly portray themselves, I think this is a pity, and I feel quite lonely.但这是就大局而言，倘说个人，却也有已经得到好结果的。例如成仿吾，做了一篇“开步走”和“打发他们去”，又改换姓名（石厚生）做了一点“珰鲁迅”之后，据日本的无产文艺月刊《战旗》七月号所载，他就又走在修善寺温泉的近旁（可不知洗了澡没有），并且在那边被尊为“可尊敬的普罗塔利亚特作家”，“从支那的劳动者农民所选出的他们的艺术家”了。
But this is in terms of the overall situation, if we talk about individuals, there are also those who have already achieved good results. For example, after Cheng Fangwu wrote an article "Letting Go" and "Sending Them Away", and changed his name (Shi Housheng) to make a little "Dong Lu Xun", according to the July issue of the Japanese proletarian literature and art monthly magazine "War Flag", he walked near the hot springs of Shuzenji Temple (but I don't know if he took a bath), and was revered there as "a respectable protagalia writer" and "their artists selected from the laborers and peasants of China".鲁迅。八月十日。Lu Xun.
