文学的阶级性

文学的阶级性

文学的阶级性

The class nature of literature来信
Letter鲁迅先生：
Mr. Lu Xun:侍桁先生译林癸未夫著的《文学上之个人性与阶级性》，本来这是一篇绝好的文章，但可惜篇末涉及唯物史观的问题，理论未免是勉强一点，也许是著者的误解唯物史观。他说：
Mr. Shi Ting's translation of "Individuality and Class in Literature" by Lin Guiweifu was originally an excellent article, but unfortunately the end of the article involves the issue of historical materialism, and the theory is a little reluctant, perhaps because the author misunderstands historical materialism. He said:“以这种理由若推论下去，有产者的个人性与无产者的个人性，‘全个’是不相同的了。就是说不承认有产者与无产者之间有共同的人性。再换一句话说，有产者与无产者只是有阶级性，而全然缺少个人性的。”
"If we continue to infer from this reason, the individuality of the proletarian and the individuality of the proletariat, 'whole' are not the same. That is to say, it does not recognize the common humanity between the proletarian and the proletarian. In other words, the proletariat and the proletariat only have class characteristics, but lack individuality at all. ”这是什么话！唯物史观的理论，岂是这样简单的。它的理论并不否认个人性，因此，也不否认思想，道德，感情，艺术。但以性格，思想，道德，感情，艺术，都是受支配于经济的。林氏的文章是着意于个人性，我们就以个人性而论。譬如农村经济宗法社会里拿妻子为男子的财产，但是文化进步到今日的社会，就承认妻子有相当的人格。这个观念，当然是有产者和无产者所共同的。虽然是共同，却并非天赋的，仍然逃不了经济的支配。有产者和无产者物质生活上受经济的影响而有差等，个人性同样地受经济的影响而却是共同的。并不是有产者和无产者人性的共同而就是不受经济制度的影响了。
What is this! The theory of historical materialism is not so simple. Its theory does not deny individuality and, therefore, thought, morality, feelings, art. But character, thought, morality, feelings, and art are all governed by the economy. Lin's article focuses on individuality, so let's talk about individuality. For example, in rural economic patriarchal society, wives are regarded as men's property, but cultural progress to today's society recognizes that wives have considerable personalities. This concept is of course common to both the proletariat and the proletariat. Although it is common, it is not talented, and it still cannot escape the domination of the economy. The material life of the proletarian and the proletarian is affected by the economy, etc., and the individuality is also affected by the economy but is common. It is not that the human nature of the proletariat and the proletariat is common, but that it is not affected by the economic system.林氏以此而可以驳唯物史观，那末，何以不拿“人是同样的是圆顶方趾，要吃饭，要睡觉，是有产者和无产者所共同的”而来驳唯物史观，爽快得多了。
Lin can refute historical materialism in this way, so why not refute historical materialism with "people are the same with round toes, eat and sleep, which are common to the proletariat and the proletariat".最后，我须声明：我是个资本主义制度下的职工。因为是职工，所以学识的谫陋是谁都可以肯定的。这文中自然有不少不能达意和不妥之处。但我希望有更了解马克思学说的人来为唯物史观打一打仗。
Finally, I must declare: I am a worker under the capitalist system. Because he is an employee, anyone can be sure of the ignorance of knowledge. Naturally, there are many unsatisfactory and inappropriate points in this article. But I hope that someone who knows more about Marx's doctrine will fight a war against historical materialism.因为避学者嫌疑起见，以信底形式而写给鲁迅先生。能否发表，是编者的特权了。
In order to avoid the suspicion of scholars, it was written to Mr. Lu Xun in the form of a letter. Whether it can be published is the prerogative of the editor.恺良于上海，一九二八，七，二八。
Kai Liang in Shanghai, 1928, 7, 28.

文学的阶级性

回信

文学的阶级性

reply恺良先生：
Mr. Kailiang:我对于唯物史观是门外汉，不能说什么。但就林氏的那一段文字而论，他将话两次一换，便成为“只有”和“全然缺少”，却似乎决定得太快一点了。大概以弄文学而又讲唯物史观的人，能从基本的书籍上一一钩剔出来的，恐怕不很多，常常是看几本别人的提要就算。而这种提要，又因作者的学识意思而不同，有些作者，意在使阶级意识明了锐利起来，就竭力增强阶级性说，而别一面就也容易招人误解。作为本文根据的林氏别一篇论文，我没有见，不能说他是否因此而走了相反的极端，但中国却有此例，竟会将个性，共同的人性（即林氏之所谓个人性），个人主义即利己主义混为一谈，来加以自以为唯物史观底申斥，倘再有人据此来论唯物史观，那真是糟糕透顶了。
I am a layman for historical materialism and cannot say anything. But as far as Lin's text is concerned, he changed his words twice and became "only" and "completely lacking", but it seemed to be decided too quickly. Probably people who are good at literature and talk about historical materialism can pick out a few basic books one by one, and often just read a few other people's summaries. And this kind of summary is different depending on the author's knowledge and meaning, some authors, intending to make the class consciousness clear and sharp, try their best to enhance the class theory, while the other side is also easy to misunderstand. I have not seen another paper by Lin as the basis for this article, and I cannot say whether he went to the opposite extreme because of this, but there is an example in China, which will confuse individuality, common humanity (that is, Lin's so-called individuality), and individualism that is, egoism, to denounce it as a self-proclaimed historical materialism.来信的“吃饭睡觉”的比喻，虽然不过是讲笑话，但脱罗兹基曾以对于“死之恐怖”为古今人所共同，来说明文学中有不带阶级性的分子，那方法其实是差不多的。在我自己，是以为若据性格感情等，都受“支配于经济”（也可以说根据于经济组织或依存于经济组织）之说，则这些就一定都带着阶级性。但是“都带”，而非“只有”。所以不相信有一切超乎阶级，文章如日月的永久的大文豪，也不相信住洋房，喝咖啡，却道“唯我把握住了无产阶级意识，所以我是真的无产者”的革命文学者。
Although the metaphor of "eating and sleeping" in the letter is just a joke, Torodsky once used the "horror of death" as common to ancient and modern people to illustrate that there are non-class elements in literature, and the method is actually similar. Personally, I think that if they are all "governed by the economy" (which can also be said to be based on or dependent on economic organizations) according to personality and feelings, then these must all have a class character. But "all bring", not "only". Therefore, I do not believe that there are permanent great writers who transcend class and write articles like the sun and moon, nor do I believe in revolutionary writers who live in bungalows and drink coffee, but say, "Only I have grasped the consciousness of the proletariat, so I am really a proletarian".有马克斯学识的人来为唯物史观打仗，在此刻，我是不赞成的。我只希望有切实的人，肯译几部世界上已有定评的关于唯物史观的书——至少，是一部简单浅显的，两部精密的——还要一两本反对的著作。那么，论争起来，可以省说许多话。
At this moment, I do not approve of people with Max's knowledge who come to fight for historical materialism. I only hope that there will be practical people who will translate a few books on historical materialism that have been evaluated in the world - at least, one simple and two sophisticated - and one or two works that oppose it. Then, when arguing, you can save a lot of words.鲁迅。八月十日。Lu Xun. August 10th.

《近代世界短篇小说集》小引

《近代世界短篇小说集》小引

A small introduction to the "Collection of Short Stories in the Modern World"一时代的纪念碑底的文章，文坛上不常有；即有之，也什九是大部的著作。以一篇短的小说而成为时代精神所居的大宫阙者，是极其少见的。
Articles at the bottom of monuments of an era are not often found in the literary world; Even if there is, nine out of ten are most of the works. It is extremely rare for a short novel to become a great palace where the spirit of the times lives.但至今，在巍峨灿烂的巨大的纪念碑底的文学之旁，短篇小说也依然有着存在的充足的权利。不但巨细高低，相依为命，也譬如身入大伽蓝中，但见全体非常宏丽，眩人眼睛，令观者心神飞越，而细看一雕阑一画础，虽然细小，所得却更为分明，再以此推及全体，感受遂愈加切实，因此那些终于为人所注重了。
But to this day, next to the literature at the base of the majestic and splendid monument, short stories still have the full right to exist. Not only is it high and small, dependent on each other, but it is also like entering a large temple, but seeing the whole is very magnificent, dazzling to the eyes, making the viewer's mind fly over, and looking closely at a carved railing and a painting base, although small, the result is more clear, and then pushed to the whole, the feeling becomes more and more real, so those are finally paid attention to.在现在的环境中，人们忙于生活，无暇来看长篇，自然也是短篇小说的繁生的很大原因之一。只顷刻间，而仍可借一斑略知全豹，以一目尽传精神，用数顷刻，遂知种种作风，种种作者，种种所写的人和物和事状，所得也颇不少的。而便捷，易成，取巧……这些原因还在外。
In the current environment, people are busy with life and have no time to read long stories, which is naturally one of the main reasons for the proliferation of short stories. In just a moment, you can still get a little idea of the whole leopard with a glimpse, and convey the spirit at a glance, and in a few moments, you can know all kinds of styles, all kinds of authors, all kinds of people, things and things written, and you can get a lot. It is convenient, easy to complete, and clever...... These reasons are still out.中国于世界所有的大部杰作很少译本，翻译短篇小说的却特别的多者，原因大约也为此。我们——译者的汇印这书，则原因就在此。贪图用力少，绍介多，有些不肯用尽呆气力的坏处，是自问恐怕也在所不免的。但也有一点只要能培一朵花，就不妨做做会朽的腐草的近于不坏的意思。还有，是要将零星的小品，聚在一本里，可以较不容易于散亡。
China has very few translations of all the masterpieces in the world, but the translation of short stories is particularly large, and the reason is probably for this reason. This is the reason why we, the translator, printed this book. The disadvantages of being greedy for less effort, more Shaojie, and some refusal to use all their strength are inevitable to ask yourself. But there is also a point that as long as you can cultivate a flower, you might as well make rotten grass that is close to not bad. Also, it is necessary to gather sporadic sketches in one book, which can be less difficult to scatter.我们——译者，都是一面学习，一面试做的人，虽于这一点小事，力量也还很不够，选的不当和译的错误，想来是一定不免的。我们愿受读者和批评者的指正。
We, translators, are people who study and try to do at the same time, although this small thing, the strength is still not enough, and the improper choice and translation mistakes must be inevitable. We would like to be corrected by readers and critics.一九二九年四月二十六日，朝花社同人识。

现今的新文学的概观——五月二十二日在燕京大学国文学会讲

现今的新文学的概观An Overview of Today's New Literature ——五月二十二日在燕京大学国文学会讲 - Lecture at the Chinese Literature Society of Yenching University on May 22
这一年多，我不很向青年诸君说什么话了，因为革命以来，言论的路很窄小，不是过激，便是反动，于大家都无益处。这一次回到北平，几位旧识的人要我到这里来讲几句，情不可却，只好来讲几句。但因为种种琐事，终于没有想定究竟来讲什么——连题目都没有。
For more than a year, I haven't said anything to the young people, because since the revolution, the road for speech has been very narrow, either radical or reactionary, and it is not beneficial to everyone. This time back in Peking, several old acquaintances asked me to come here to say a few words, but I couldn't refuse, so I had to say a few words. But because of all kinds of trivial matters, I finally didn't think about what to talk about - I didn't even have a topic.那题目，原是想在车上拟定的，但因为道路坏，汽车颠起来有尺多高，无从想起。我于是偶然感到，外来的东西，单取一件，是不行的，有汽车也须有好道路，一切事总免不掉环境的影响。文学——在中国的所谓新文学，所谓革命文学，也是如此。
The topic was originally planned in the car, but because the road was broken, the car was so high that I couldn't remember it. I accidentally felt that it was not possible to take a single piece of foreign things, and that there must be good roads with cars, and everything would inevitably be affected by the environment. Literature - the so-called new literature in China, the so-called revolutionary literature, is the same.中国的文化，便是怎样的爱国者，恐怕也大概不能不承认是有些落后。新的事物，都是从外面侵入的。新的势力来到了，大多数的人们还是莫名其妙。北平还不到这样，譬如上海租界，那情形，外国人是处在中央，那外面，围着一群翻译，包探，巡捕，西崽……之类，是懂得外国话，熟悉租界章程的。这一圈之外，才是许多老百姓。
Chinese culture, what kind of patriot it is, I am afraid that it cannot but admit that it is a little backward. New things are intruding from the outside. New forces have arrived, and most people are still puzzled. Peiping is not like this, for example, in the Shanghai Concession, the foreigner is in the center, and outside, surrounded by a group of interpreters, scouts, patrols, and cubs...... and so on, they know foreign languages and are familiar with the concession charter. Outside this circle, there are many ordinary people.老百姓一到洋场，永远不会明白真实情形，外国人说“Yes”，翻译道，“他在说打一个耳光”，外国人说“No”，翻出来却是他说“去枪毙”。倘想要免去这一类无谓的冤苦，首先是在知道得多一点，冲破了这一个圈子。
When the people arrive at the foreign market, they will never understand the real situation, foreigners say "Yes", translated, "he is talking about slapping a slap", foreigners say "No", but when it turns out, he says "go shoot". If you want to avoid this kind of unnecessary injustice, you must first know a little more and break through this circle.在文学界也一样，我们知道得太不多，而帮助我们知识的材料也太少。梁实秋有一个白璧德，徐志摩有一个泰戈尔胡适之有一个杜威，——是的，徐志摩还有一个曼殊斐儿，他到她坟上去哭过，——创造社有革命文学，时行的文学。不过附和的，创作的很有，研究的却不多，直到现在，还是给几个出题目的人们圈了起来。
The same is true in literature, where we know too little and too little material to help us with knowledge. Liang Shiqiu had a Bai Bide, Xu Zhimo had a Tagore, Hu Shizhi had a Dewey,—— Yes, Xu Zhimo also had a Manshu Feier, he went to her grave to cry,—— The Creation Society had revolutionary literature, Shixing's literature. However, there is a lot of creation, but not much research, and until now, I have circled a few people who have raised the topic.各种文学，都是应环境而产生的，推崇文艺的人，虽喜欢说文艺足以煽起风波来，但在事实上，却是政治先行，文艺后变。倘以为文艺可以改变环境，那是“唯心”之谈，事实的出现，并不如文学家所豫想。所以巨大的革命，以前的所谓革命文学者还须灭亡，待到革命略有结果，略有喘息的余裕，这才产生新的革命文学者。为什么呢，因为旧社会将近崩坏之际，是常常会有近似带革命性的文学作品出现的，然而其实并非真的革命文学。例如：或者憎恶旧社会，而只是憎恶，更没有对于将来的理想；或者也大呼改造社会，而问他要怎样的社会，却是不能实现的乌托邦；或者自己活得无聊了，便空泛地希望一大转变，来作刺戟，正如饱于饮食的人，想吃些辣椒爽口；更下的是原是旧式人物，但在社会里失败了，却想另挂新招牌，靠新兴势力获得更好的地位。
All kinds of literature are produced in response to the environment, and people who admire literature and art, although they like to say that literature and art are enough to stir up turmoil, but in fact, it is politics first, literature and art change later. If you think that literature and art can change the environment, it is a "idealistic" statement, and the appearance of facts is not as writers imagined. Therefore, the great revolution, the so-called revolutionary writers in the past must perish, and only when the revolution has some results and a little breathing room will new revolutionary writers be produced. Why, because when the old society was about to collapse, there were often literary works that were almost revolutionary, but in fact they were not really revolutionary literature. For example: or hate the old society, but only hate it, and have no ideals for the future; or shouting to reform society, but asking him what kind of society he wants, but it is an unattainable utopia; Or if you are bored of your life, you vaguely hope for a big change to be a thorn, just like a person who is full of food wants to eat some chili peppers to refresh; What's worse is that he was originally an old-style figure, but failed in society, but he wanted to put up a new signboard and rely on emerging forces to gain a better position.希望革命的文人，革命一到，反而沉默下去的例子，在中国便曾有过的。即如清末的南社，便是鼓吹革命的文学团体，他们叹汉族的被压制，愤满人的凶横，渴望着“光复旧物”。但民国成立以后，倒寂然无声了。我想，这是因为他们的理想，是在革命以后，“重见汉官威仪”，峨冠博带。而事实并不这样，所以反而索然无味，不想执笔了。俄国的例子尤为明显，十月革命开初，也曾有许多革命文学家非常惊喜，欢迎这暴风雨的袭来，愿受风雷的试炼。但后来，诗人叶遂宁，小说家索波里自杀了，近来还听说有名的小说家爱伦堡有些反动。这是什么缘故呢？就因为四面袭来的并不是暴风雨，来试炼的也并非风雷，却是老老实实的“革命”。空想被击碎了，人也就活不下去，这倒不如古时候相信死后灵魂上天，坐在上帝旁边吃点心的诗人们福气。因为他们在达到目的之前，已经死掉了。
There have been examples in China of literati who hope for revolution and remain silent when the revolution comes. For example, the Nanshe in the late Qing Dynasty was a literary group advocating revolution, lamenting the suppression of the Han people, angry at the ferocity of the people, and longing to "restore the old things". But after the founding of the Republic of China, it was silent. I think this is because their ideal is to "see the majesty of Han officials again" after the revolution. But this is not the case, so it is boring and I don't want to write. The example of Russia is particularly obvious, at the beginning of the October Revolution, there were many revolutionary writers who were very surprised, welcomed the storm, and were willing to be tested by wind and thunder. But later, the poet Ye Suining, the novelist Sopoli committed suicide, and recently I heard that the famous novelist Ehrenberg was somewhat reactionary. What is the reason for this? Just because it is not a storm that strikes from all sides, and it is not the wind and thunder that come to test, but an honest "revolution". If the fantasy is shattered, people will not be able to live, which is not as blessed as the poets who believed that the soul went to heaven after death and sat next to God to eat snacks. Because they are dead before they can achieve their goal.中国，据说，自然是已经革了命，——政治上也许如此罢，但在文艺上，却并没有改变。有人说，“小资产阶级文学之抬头”了，其实是，小资产阶级文学在那里呢，连“头”也没有，那里说得到“抬”。这照我上面所讲的推论起来，就是文学并不变化和兴旺，所反映的便是并无革命和进步，——虽然革命家听了也许不大喜欢。
China, it is said that it has naturally been revolutionized,—— politically it may be so, but in literature and art, it has not changed. Some people say that "the rise of petty-bourgeois literature" is actually that petty-bourgeois literature is there, not even a "head", and it can be said to be "raised" there. According to what I said above, literature does not change and prosper, but reflects that there is no revolution or progress,—— although revolutionaries may not like it very much.至于创造社所提倡的，更彻底的革命文学——无产阶级文学，自然更不过是一个题目。这边也禁，那边也禁的王独清的从上海租界里遥望广州暴动的诗，“Pong Pong Pong”，铅字逐渐大了起来，只在说明他曾为电影的字幕和上海的酱园招牌所感动，有模仿勃洛克的《十二个》之志而无其力和才。郭沫若的《一只手》是很有人推为佳作的，但内容说一个革命者革命之后失了一只手，所余的一只还能和爱人握手的事，却未免“失”得太巧。五体，四肢之中，倘要失去其一，实在还不如一只手；一条腿就不便，头自然更不行了。只准备失去一只手，是能减少战斗的勇往之气的；我想，革命者所不惜牺牲的，一定不只这一点。《一只手》也还是穷秀才落难，后来终于中状元，谐花烛的老调。
As for the more thorough revolutionary literature advocated by the Creation Society, proletarian literature, it is naturally nothing more than a topic. Wang Duqing, who is also forbidden here, is also forbidden there, looking at the Guangzhou riots from the Shanghai Concession, "Pong Pong Pong", the lead words gradually become larger, only to show that he was moved by the subtitles of the movie and the signboard of Shanghai's sauce garden, and had the ambition to imitate Bullock's "Twelve" but had no strength and talent. Guo Moruo's "One Hand" is highly regarded as a masterpiece, but the content says that a revolutionary loses a hand after the revolution, and the remaining one can still shake hands with his lover, but it is too coincidental to "lose". Among the five bodies and limbs, if one is lost, it is really not as good as a hand; One leg is inconvenient, and the head is naturally even worse. Preparing to lose only one hand can reduce the courage to fight; I think that revolutionaries must have sacrificed more than this. "One Hand" was still a poor scholar in trouble, and later finally won the champion, harmonizing with the old tune of flower candles.但这些却也正是中国现状的一种反映。新近上海出版的革命文学的一本书的封面上，画着一把钢叉，这是从《苦闷的象征》的书面上取来的，叉的中间的一条尖刺上，又安一个铁锤，这是从苏联的旗子上取来的。然而这样地合了起来，却弄得既不能刺，又不能敲，只能在表明这位作者的庸陋，——也正可以做那些文艺家的徽章。
But these are also a reflection of China's current situation. On the cover of a book on revolutionary literature recently published in Shanghai, a steel fork is drawn, taken from the text of "The Symbol of Distress", and a hammer is placed on a spike in the middle of the fork, which is taken from the Soviet flag. However, when put together like this, it can neither be stabbed nor knocked, and it can only show the author's mediocrity,—— and it can also be used as a badge for those writers and artists.从这一阶级走到那一阶级去，自然是能有的事，但最好是意识如何，便一一直说，使大众看去，为仇为友，了了分明。不要脑子里存着许多旧的残滓，却故意瞒了起来，演戏似的指着自己的鼻子道，“惟我是无产阶级！”现在的人们既然神经过敏，听到“俄”字便要气绝，连嘴唇也快要不准红了，对于出版物，这也怕，那也怕；而革命文学家又不肯多绍介别国的理论和作品，单是这样的指着自己的鼻子，临了便会像前清的“奉旨申斥”一样，令人莫名其妙的。
It is naturally possible to go from this class to that class, but it is best to keep saying it all the time, so that the public can see that it is an enemy and a friend. Don't keep a lot of old residues in your mind, but deliberately hide it, point to your nose as if acting, and say, "But I am a proletarian!" Since people are nervous now, they will die when they hear the word "Russia", and even their lips are about to turn red. And revolutionary writers are unwilling to introduce more theories and works of other countries, just pointing at their own noses like this will be like the "reprimand" of the former Qing Dynasty, which is inexplicable.对于诸君，“奉旨申斥”大概还须解释几句才会明白罢。这是帝制时代的事。一个官员犯了过失了，便叫他跪在一个什么门外面，皇帝差一个太监来斥骂。这时须得用一点化费，那么，骂几句就完；倘若不用，他便从祖宗一直骂到子孙。这算是皇帝在骂，然而谁能去问皇帝，问他究竟可是要这样地骂呢？去年，据日本的杂志上说，成仿吾是由中国的农工大众选他往德国研究戏曲去了，我们也无从打听，究竟真是这样地选了没有。
For everyone, "by order to reprimand" probably needs to be explained a few sentences to understand. This was in the imperial era. An official made a mistake, so he was told to kneel outside a door, and the emperor sent a eunuch to scold. At this time, you have to use a little fee, then just scold a few words; If he didn't use it, he would scold from his ancestors to his descendants. This is the emperor scolding, but who can ask the emperor if he wants to scold like this? Last year, according to a Japanese magazine, Cheng Fangwu was chosen by the Chinese peasants and workers to study opera in Germany, and we had no way of asking whether he was really chosen this way.所以我想，倘要比较地明白，还只好用我的老话，“多看外国书”，来打破这包围的圈子。这事，于诸君是不甚费力的。关于新兴文学的英文书或英译书，即使不多，然而所有的几本，一定较为切实可靠。多看些别国的理论和作品之后，再来估量中国的新文艺，便可以清楚得多了。更好是绍介到中国来；翻译并不比随便的创作容易，然而于新文学的发展却更有功，于大家更有益。
So I think that if I want to understand it more clearly, I have to use my old saying, "read more foreign books", to break this circle of encirclement. This matter is not very laborious for you. There are not many English books or English translations of emerging literature, but all of them must be more reliable and reliable. After reading more theories and works of other countries, it will be much clearer to evaluate China's new literature and art. Better is to introduce to China; Translation is not easier than casual creation, but it is more beneficial to the development of new literature and beneficial to everyone.

After the success of the revolution, when "national art", "national skills", "national flowers" and "traditional medicine" were in turmoil, the translation of "Imperial Han Medicine" made by the Japanese Yumoto Qiuzhen would also be published in time. The advertisement says this -“日医汤本求真氏于明治三十四年卒业金泽医学专门学校后应世多年觉中西医术各有所长短非比较同异舍短取长不可爰发愤学汉医历十八年之久汇集吾国历来诸家医书及彼邦人士研究汉医药心得之作著《皇汉医学》一书引用书目多至一百余种旁求博考洵大观也……”
"Japanese doctor Tang Benqiu Zhen graduated from Kanazawa Medical College in the 34th year of Meiji, and after many years of life, he felt that Chinese and Western medicine had their own strengths and weaknesses, not comparing similarities and differences, abandoning shortcomings and taking strengths, so he studied Chinese medicine for eighteen years......我们“皇汉”人实在有些怪脾气的：外国人论及我们缺点的不欲闻，说好处就相信，讲科学者不大提，有几个说神见鬼的便绍介。这也正是同例，金泽医学专门学校卒业者何止数千人，做西洋医学的也有十几位了，然而我们偏偏刮目于可入《无双谱》的汤本先生的《皇汉医学》。
We "imperial Han" people are really a little strange-tempered: foreigners don't want to hear about our shortcomings, they believe when they say the benefits, they don't mention scientists, and a few people say that they see gods and ghosts. This is exactly the same case, there are thousands of graduates of Kanazawa Medical College, and there are more than a dozen people who are doing Western medicine, but we are impressed by Mr. Yumoto's "Imperial Han Medicine", which can be included in the "Peerless Spectrum".小朋友梵儿在日本东京，化了四角钱在地摊上买到一部冈千仞作的《观光纪游》，是明治十七年（一八八四）来游中国的日记。他看过之后，在书头卷尾写了几句牢骚话，寄给我了。来得正好，钞一段在下面：
In Tokyo, Japan, the child Fan'er spent four dimes to buy a copy of Oka's "Sightseeing Chronicles" written by Oka Qianren at a street stall, which was a diary of a visit to China in the seventeenth year of Meiji (1884). After reading it, he wrote a few complaints at the end of the book and sent it to me. Just in time, a piece of banknote is below:“二十三日，梦香竹孙来访。……梦香盛称多纪氏医书。余曰，‘敝邦西洋医学盛开，无复手多纪氏书者，故贩原板上海书肆，无用陈余之刍狗也。’曰，‘多纪氏书，发仲景氏微旨，他年日人必悔此事。’曰，‘敝邦医术大开，译书续出，十年之后，中人争购敝邦译书，亦不可知。’梦香默然。余因以为合信氏医书（案：盖指《全体新论》），刻于宁波，宁波距此咫尺，而梦香满口称多纪氏，无一语及合信氏者，何故也？……”（卷三《苏杭日记》下二页。）
“二十三日，梦香竹孙来访。 …… 梦香盛称多纪氏医书。 余曰，‘敝邦西洋医学盛开，无复手多纪氏书者，故贩原板上海书肆，无用陈余之刍狗也。 ’曰，‘多纪氏书，发仲景氏微旨，他年日人必悔此事。 ’曰，‘敝邦医术大开，译书续出，十年之后，中人争购敝邦译书，亦不可知。 ’梦香默然。 余因以为合信氏医书（案：盖指《全体新论》），刻于宁波，宁波距此咫尺，而梦香满口称多纪氏，无一语及合信氏者，何故也？……”（卷三《苏杭日记》下二页。 ）冈氏于此等处似乎终于不明白。这是“四千余年古国古”的人民的“收买废铜烂铁”脾气，所以文人则“盛称多纪氏”，武人便大买旧炮和废枪，给外国“无用陈余之刍狗”有一条出路。
Gang seems to have finally understood this. This is the temper of the people of "more than 4,000 years of ancient countries and ancient countries" to "buy scrap copper and rotten iron", so the literati are "called the Duoji clan", and the warriors buy old cannons and waste guns to give foreign "useless Chen Yu's fodder" a way out.冈氏距明治维新后不久，还有改革的英气，所以他的日记里常有好意的苦言。革命底批评家或云与其看世纪末的烦琐隐晦没奈何之言，不如上观任何民族开国时文字，证以此事，是颇有一理的。
Shortly after the Meiji Restoration, Gang still had the heroic spirit of reform, so his diary often contained well-intentioned bitter words. Critics of the revolution may say that instead of looking at the cumbersome and obscure words of the end of the century, it is better to look at the writings of any nation at the founding of the country to prove that this matter is quite reasonable.七月二十八日。

叶永蓁作《小小十年》小引

叶永蓁作《小小十年》小引

叶永蓁作《小小十年》小引

Ye Yongzhen wrote a small introduction to "Little Ten Years"这是一个青年的作者，以一个现代的活的青年为主角，描写他十年中的行动和思想的书。
This is a book by a young man who describes his actions and thoughts in the decade with a modern living youth as the protagonist.旧的传统和新的思潮，纷纭于他的一身，爱和憎的纠缠，感情和理智的冲突，缠绵和决撒的迭代，欢欣和绝望的起伏，都逐着这“小小十年”而开展，以形成一部感伤的书，个人的书。但时代是现代，所以从旧家庭所希望的“上进”而渡到革命，从交通不大方便的小县而渡到“革命策源地”的广州，从本身的婚姻不自由而渡到伟大的社会改革——但我没有发见其间的桥梁。
The entanglement of love and hate, the conflict of feelings and reason, the iteration of lingering and decisive, the ups and downs of joy and despair, all unfold according to this "little decade" to form a sentimental book, a personal book. But the times are modern, so from the "progress" that the old family hoped for to the revolution, from the small county with inconvenient transportation to Guangzhou, the "source of the revolution", from the unfree marriage to the great social reform - but I did not see the bridge between them.一个革命者，将——而且实在也已经（！）——为大众的幸福斗争，然而独独宽恕首先压迫自己的亲人，将枪口移向四面是敌，但又四不见敌的旧社会；一个革命者，将为人我争解放，然而当失去爱人的时候，却希望她自己负责，并且为了革命之故，不愿自己有一个情敌，——志愿愈大，希望愈高，可以致力之处就愈少，可以自解之处也愈多。——终于，则甚至闪出了惟本身目前的刹那间为惟一的现实一流的阴影。在这里，是屹然站着一个个人主义者，遥望着集团主义的大纛，但在“重上征途”之前，我没有发见其间的桥梁。
A revolutionary will - and really has (!) - Fight for the happiness of the masses, but forgive the relatives who oppress them first, and move the muzzle of the gun to the old society where the enemy is on all sides, but the enemy is not seen on all sides; A revolutionary will fight for liberation for others, but when she loses her lover, she hopes that she will be responsible, and for the sake of the revolution, she does not want to have a love rival,—— the greater the will, the higher the hope, the less she can devote herself to, and the more she can solve herself. ——Finally, it even flashed the shadow of the only reality first-class in its own moment. Here, there is an individualist standing tall, looking at the banner of collectivism, but I have not seen the bridge between them until I "return to the journey".释迦牟尼出世以后，割肉喂鹰，投身饲虎的是小乘，渺渺茫茫地说教的倒算是大乘，总是发达起来，我想，那机微就在此。
After Shakyamuni was born, it was the Hinayana who cut meat to feed the eagle and devoted himself to feeding the tiger, and the one who preached vaguely was the Mahayana, which always developed.然而这书的生命，却正在这里。他描出了背着传统，又为世界思潮所激荡的一部分的青年的心，逐渐写来，并无遮瞒，也不装点，虽然间或有若干辩解，而这些辩解，却又正是脱去了自己的衣裳。至少，将为现在作一面明镜，为将来留一种记录，是无疑的罢。多少伟大的招牌，去年以来，在文摊上都挂过了，但不到一年，便以变相和无物，自己告发了全盘的欺骗，中国如果还会有文艺，当然先要以这样直说自己所本有的内容的著作，来打退骗局以后的空虚。因为文艺家至少是须有直抒己见的诚心和勇气的，倘不肯吐露本心，就更谈不到什么意识。
However, the life of this book is here. He depicted the hearts of young people who were carrying tradition and being stirred up by the world's ideological trends, and gradually wrote without concealment or embellishment, although there were occasional excuses, and these justifications were precisely to take off their own clothes. At least, it will be a mirror for the present and a record for the future, which is undoubtedly true. How many great signboards have been hung on the stalls since last year, but in less than a year, they have denounced the complete deception in disguise and nothingness. Because writers and artists must at least have the sincerity and courage to express their opinions, if they refuse to express their true feelings, they will not be able to talk about any consciousness.我觉得最有意义的是渐向战场的一段，无论意识如何，总之，许多青年，从东江起，而上海，而武汉，而江西，为革命战斗了，其中的一部分，是抱着种种的希望，死在战场上，再看不见上面摆起来的是金交椅呢还是虎皮交椅。种种革命，便都是这样地进行，所以掉弄笔墨的，从实行者看来，究竟还是闲人之业。
I think the most meaningful part is the section that gradually moves towards the battlefield, no matter what the consciousness is, in short, many young people, starting from Dongjiang, and Shanghai, and Wuhan, and Jiangxi, have fought for the revolution, and part of them are holding all kinds of hopes, dying on the battlefield, and no longer can see whether it is a golden chair or a tiger skin chair on it. All kinds of revolutions are carried out in this way, so those who mess with pen and ink, from the perspective of practitioners, are still the work of idlers.这部书的成就，是由于曾经革命而没有死的青年。我想，活着，而又在看小说的人们，当有许多人发生同感。
The achievement of this book is due to the youth who did not die after the revolution. I think that many people who are alive and reading novels feel the same way.技术，是未曾矫揉造作的。因为事情是按年叙述的，所以文章也倾泻而下，至使作者在《后记》里，不愿称之为小说，但也自然是小说。我所感到累赘的只是说理之处过于多，校读时删节了一点，倘使反而损伤原作了，那便成了校者的责任。还有好像缺点而其实是优长之处，是语汇的不丰，新文学兴起以来，未忘积习而常用成语如我的和故意作怪而乱用谁也不懂的生语如创造社一流的文字，都使文艺和大众隔离，这部书却加以扫荡了，使读者可以更易于了解，然而从中作梗的还有许多新名词。
Technology has not been pretentious. Because things are narrated by year, the article also pours down, so that the author does not want to call it a novel in the "Afterword", but it is naturally a novel. What I find cumbersome is that there are too many reasoning, and if it is deleted a little during proofreading, if it damages the original work, it becomes the responsibility of the proofreader. Since the rise of new literature, it has not forgotten the habits and commonly used idioms such as mine and deliberately mischievous and abused new words that no one understands, such as the first-class words of the Creation Society, all of which have isolated literature and art from the public, but this book has been swept away, making it easier for readers to understand, but there are many new terms that hinder it.通读了这部书，已经在一月之前了，因为不得不写几句，便凭着现在所记得的写了这些字。我不是什么社的内定的“斗争”的“批评家”之一员，只能直说自己所愿意说的话。我极欣幸能绍介这真实的作品于中国，还渴望看见“重上征途”以后之作的新吐的光芒。
I read through this book, already a month ago, because I had to write a few sentences, so I wrote these words based on what I remember now. I am not a member of the "critics" of the "struggle" of the society, and I can only say what I want to say. I am very happy to be able to introduce this real work to China, and I am eager to see the new light of the work after "Re-embarking on the Journey".一九二九年七月二十八日，于上海，鲁迅记。

柔石作《二月》小引冲锋的战士，天真的孤儿，年青的寡妇，热情的女人，各有主义的新式公子们，死气沉沉而交头接耳的旧社会，倒也并非如蜘蛛张网，专一在待飞翔的游人，但在寻求安静的青年的眼中，却化为不安的大苦痛。这大苦痛，便是社会的可怜的椒盐，和战士孤儿等辈一同，给无聊的社会一些味道，使他们无聊地持续下去。
Charging soldiers, naïve orphans, young widows, enthusiastic women, new sons with their own doctrines, and the old society that is lifeless and whispering to each other are not like spiders spreading webs, waiting for tourists to fly, but in the eyes of young people who seek quiet, they have turned into great uneasy pain. This great pain is the poor salt and pepper of society, together with the soldiers and orphans, giving a boring society some flavor and making them boring continue.浊浪在拍岸，站在山冈上者和飞沫不相干，弄潮儿则于涛头且不在意，惟有衣履尚整，徘徊海滨的人，一溅水花，便觉得有所沾湿，狼狈起来。这从上述的两类人们看来，是都觉得诧异的。但我们书中的青年萧君，便正落在这境遇里。他极想有为，怀着热爱，而有所顾惜，过于矜持，终于连安住几年之处，也不可得。他其实并不能成为一小齿轮，跟着大齿轮转动，他仅是外来的一粒石子，所以轧了几下，发几声响，便被挤到女佛山——上海去了。
The turbid waves are crashing on the shore, and those standing on the hills have nothing to do with the droplets, while the tide makers don't care about the waves, but the clothes and shoes are still neat, and the people wandering on the seashore feel wet and embarrassed when they splash water. This is surprising from the above two types of people. But the young Xiao Jun in our book is in this situation. He wanted to be promising, with love, but he cared about something, was too reserved, and finally couldn't even get a place to live for a few years. He actually can't be a small gear, he rotates with the big gear, he is just a pebble from outside, so after a few rolls and a few sounds, he was squeezed to the female Buddha Mountain - Shanghai.他幸而还坚硬，没有变成润泽齿轮的油。
Fortunately, he was still hard and did not turn into oil to moisten the gears.但是，矍昙（释迦牟尼）从夜半醒来，目睹宫女们睡态之丑，于是慨然出家，而霍善斯坦因以为是醉饱后的呕吐。那么，萧君的决心遁走，恐怕是胃弱而禁食的了，虽然我还无从明白其前因，是由于气质的本然，还是战后的暂时的劳顿。
However, Gautan (Shakyamuni) woke up in the middle of the night and witnessed the ugliness of the palace maids' sleeping state, so he became a monk, and Hoshanstein thought it was vomiting after being drunk. Then, Xiao Jun's determination to escape is probably due to a weak stomach and fasting, although I still have no way of understanding the antecedent, whether it is due to the nature of temperament or temporary fatigue after the war.我从作者用了工妙的技术所写成的草稿上，看见了近代青年中这样的一种典型，周遭的人物，也都生动，便写下一些印象，算是序文。大概明敏的读者，所得必当更多于我，而且由读时所生的诧异或同感，照见自己的姿态的罢？那实在是很有意义的。
From the draft written by the author with ingenious techniques, I saw such a typical example of modern youth, and the characters around me were also vivid, so I wrote down some impressions, which was regarded as a preface. Probably a discerning reader will gain more than I do, and the surprise or sympathy generated when reading it will reflect his own posture. That's really meaningful.一九二九年八月二十日，鲁迅记于上海。

《小彼得》译本序

《小彼得》译本序

《小彼得》译本序

Preface to the translation of "Little Peter"这连贯的童话六篇，原是日本林房雄的译本（一九二七年东京晓星阁出版），我选给译者，作为学习日文之用的。逐次学过，就顺手译出，结果是成了这一部中文的书。但是，凡学习外国文字的，开手不久便选读童话，我以为不能算不对，然而开手就翻译童话，却很有些不相宜的地方，因为每容易拘泥原文，不敢意译，令读者看得费力。这译本原先就很有这弊病，所以我当校改之际，就大加改译了一通，比较地近于流畅了。——这也就是说，倘因此而生出不妥之处来，也已经是校改者的责任。
These six coherent fairy tales were originally translated by Fusuo Hayashi of Japan (published in Hyoseikaku in Tokyo in 1927), and I chose them for the translator for learning Japanese. After learning it one by one, I translated it easily, and the result was this Chinese book. However, I think it is not wrong for anyone who learns foreign languages to read fairy tales soon after starting, but translating fairy tales is very inappropriate, because it is easy to stick to the original text and dare not translate it, which makes it difficult for readers to read. This translation originally had this problem, so when I was proofreading, I made a big revision, and it was relatively smooth. ——In other words, if something inappropriate arises because of this, it is already the responsibility of the school reformer.作者海尔密尼亚·至尔·妙伦（Hermynia Zur Muehlen），看姓氏好像德国或奥国人，但我不知道她的事迹。据同一原译者所译的同作者的别一本童话《真理之城》（一九二八年南宋书院出版）的序文上说，则是匈牙利的女作家，但现在似乎专在德国做事，一切战斗的科学底社会主义的期刊——尤其是专为青年和少年而设的页子上，总能够看见她的姓名。作品很不少，致密的观察，坚实的文章，足够成为真正的社会主义作家之一人，而使她有世界的名声者，则大概由于那独创底的童话云。
The author, Hermynia Zur Muehlen, looks like a German or Austrian surname, but I don't know her deeds. According to the preface to another fairy tale by the same author, "The City of Truth" (published in 1928 by the Southern Song Dynasty Academy), she was a Hungarian female writer, but now it seems that she is working exclusively in Germany, and her name can always be seen in all the scientifically based socialist journals - especially those dedicated to young people and teenagers. There are many works, meticulous observations, solid articles, enough to become one of the real socialist writers, and the one who makes her world-famous is probably because of the original fairy tale cloud.不消说，作者的本意，是写给劳动者的孩子们看的，但输入中国，结果却又不如此。首先的缘故，是劳动者的孩子们轮不到受教育，不能认识这四方形的字和格子布模样的文章，所以在他们，和这是毫无关系，且不说他们的无钱可买书和无暇去读书。但是，即使在受过教育的孩子们的眼中，那结果也还是和在别国不一样。为什么呢？第一，还是因为文章，故事第五篇中所讽刺的话法的缺点，在我们的文章中可以说是几乎全篇都是。第二，这故事前四篇所用的背景，是：煤矿，森林，玻璃厂，染色厂；读者恐怕大多数都未曾亲历，那么，印象也当然不能怎样地分明。第三，作者所被认为“真正的社会主义作家”者，我想，在这里，有主张大家的生存权（第二篇），主张一切应该由战斗得到（第六篇之末）等处，可以看出，但披上童话的花衣，而就遮掉些斑斓的血汗了。尤其是在中国仅有几本这种的童话孤行，而并无基本底，坚实底的文籍相帮的时候。并且，我觉得，第五篇中银茶壶的话，太富于纤细的，琐屑的，女性底的色彩，在中国现在，或者更易得到共鸣罢，然而却应当忽略的。第四，则故事中的物件，在欧美虽然很普通，中国却纵是中产人家，也往往未曾见过。火炉即是其一；水瓶和杯子，则是细颈大肚的玻璃瓶和长圆的玻璃杯，在我们这里，只在西洋菜馆的桌上和汽船的二等舱中，可以见到。破雪草也并非我们常见的植物，有是有的，药书上称为“獐耳细辛”（多么烦难的名目呵！），是一种毛茛科的小草，叶上有毛，冬末就开白色或淡红色的小花，来“报告冬天就要收场的好消息”。日本称为“雪割草”，就为此。破雪草又是日本名的意译，我曾用在《桃色的云》上，现在也袭用了，似乎较胜于“獐耳细辛”之古板罢。
Needless to say, the author's original intention was to write it to the children of the workers, but when it was imported into China, the result was not. The first reason is that the children of the workers are not educated, and they cannot recognize the square characters and plaid-like articles, so for them, it has nothing to do with this, not to mention that they have no money to buy books and no time to study. But even in the eyes of educated children, the result is not the same as in other countries. Why? First, it is because of the shortcomings of the satirical words in the fifth part of the story, which can be said to be almost all in our article. second, the background used in the first four parts of this story is: coal mines, forests, glass factories, dyeing factories; I'm afraid most readers haven't experienced it firsthand, so of course the impression can't be very clear. Third, the author is considered a "true socialist writer", I think, here, there are those who advocate everyone's right to exist (Part 2) and that everything should be obtained by fighting (at the end of Part 6), etc., as can be seen, but wearing the flower clothes of fairy tales covers up some colorful blood and sweat. Especially when there are only a few fairy tales of this kind in China, and there is no basic foundation, and there is no solid foundation to help with literature. Moreover, I think that the words of the silver teapot in the fifth article are too slender, trivial, and feminine, and may be more resonant in China now, but they should be ignored. Fourth, although the objects in the story are very common in Europe and the United States, even middle-class families in China have often never seen them. The stove is one of them; Water bottles and cups, as for glass bottles with thin necks and big bellies, can only be seen in the tables of Western restaurants and the second-class cabins of steamboats. Breaking the snow is not a common plant for us, there are some of them, and the medicine book calls it "deer ear Xixin" (what a troublesome name!). ), is a small grass of the ranunculaceae family, with hairs on the leaves, and white or reddish flowers at the end of winter to "report the good news that winter is coming to an end". Japan calls it "snow mowing", and that's it. Breaking the snow grass is also a paraphrase of the Japanese name, I used it in "Peach Clouds", and now I have also used it, which seems to be better than the old-fashioned "roe deer ear Xixin".总而言之，这作品一经搬家，效果已大不如作者的意料。倘使硬要加上一种意义，那么，至多，也许可以供成人而不失赤子之心的，或并未劳动而不忘勤劳大众的人们的一览，或者给留心世界文学的人们，报告现代劳动者文学界中，有这样的一位作家，这样的一种作品罢了。
All in all, once this work was moved, the effect was not as good as the author expected. If one insists on adding a meaning, then, at most, it may be for an adult without losing a pure heart, or for a glance at people who have not labored and forgetting the industrious masses, or to those who pay attention to world literature, to report that there is such a writer and such a work in the literary circles of modern workers.原译本有六幅乔治·格罗斯（George Grosz）的插图，现在也加上了，但因为几经翻印，和中国制版术的拙劣，制版者的不负责任，已经几乎全失了原作的好处，——尤其是如第二图，——只能算作一个空名的绍介。格罗斯是德国人，原属踏踏主义（Dadaismus）者之一人，后来却转了左翼。据匈牙利的批评家玛察（I．Matza）说，这是因为他的艺术要有内容——思想，已不能被踏踏主义所牢笼的缘故。欧洲大战时候，大家用毒瓦斯来打仗，他曾画了一幅讽刺画，给钉在十字架上的耶稣的嘴上，也蒙上一个避毒的嘴套，于是很受了一场罚，也是有名的事，至今还颇有些人记得的。
The original translation has six illustrations by George Grosz, which have now been added, but due to several reprints, the clumsiness of Chinese plate-making, and the irresponsibility of the platemakers, the benefits of the original have been almost completely lost,—— especially as the second picture,—— can only be regarded as an empty name. Gross was a German, originally a member of the Dadaismus, but later turned to the left. According to the Hungarian critic I. Matza, this is because his art must have content, ideas, and can no longer be imprisoned by treadfulism. During the European War, everyone used poisonous gas to fight, and he once painted a satirical painting and covered the mouth of Jesus crucified with a muzzle to prevent poison, so he was punished, and it is also a famous thing, and many people still remember it.一九二九年九月十五日，校讫记。

流氓的变迁

流氓的变迁

流氓的变迁

The change of rogues孔墨都不满于现状，要加以改革，但那第一步，是在说动人主，而那用以压服人主的家伙，则都是“天”。
Confucius and Mo were dissatisfied with the status quo and wanted to reform it, but the first step was to move the lord, and the guy who used it to suppress the lord was "heaven".孔子之徒为儒，墨子之徒为侠。“儒者，柔也”，当然不会危险的。惟侠老实，所以墨者的末流，至于以“死”为终极的目的。到后来，真老实的逐渐死完，止留下取巧的侠，汉的大侠，就已和公侯权贵相馈赠，以备危急时来作护符之用了。
Confucius's disciples were Confucian scholars, while Mozi's disciples were chivalrous. "Confucianism, softness", of course, it will not be dangerous. Only chivalry is honest, so the end of the Mohists, as for the ultimate goal of "death". Later, the honest ones gradually died, leaving only the heroes who took tricks, and the heroes of the Han Dynasty had already given gifts to the princes and dignitaries in case of emergencies to be used as talismans.司马迁说：“儒以文乱法，而侠以武犯禁”，“乱”之和“犯”，决不是“叛”，不过闹点小乱子而已，而况有权贵如“五侯”者在。
Sima Qian said: "Confucianism disrupts the law with literature, while chivalry violates the prohibition with martial arts", and the sum of "chaos" and "crime" are by no means "rebellion", but just a little trouble, and there are powerful people such as the "Five Marquises".“侠”字渐消，强盗起了，但也是侠之流，他们的旗帜是“替天行道”。他们所反对的是奸臣，不是天子，他们所打劫的是平民，不是将相。李逵劫法场时，抡起板斧来排头砍去，而所砍的是看客。一部《水浒》，说得很分明：因为不反对天子，所以大军一到，便受招安，替国家打别的强盗——不“替天行道”的强盗去了。终于是奴才。
The word "chivalry" gradually disappeared, and the robbers rose, but they were also chivalrous, and their banner was "acting for the sky". What they oppose is traitors, not the Son of Heaven, and what they rob are civilians, not generals. When Li Kui robbed the Dharma field, he picked up the axe and cut it down, and it was the spectators who were chopped. A "Water Margin" says very clearly: because they did not oppose the Son of Heaven, as soon as the army arrived, they were recruited to fight other robbers for the country - robbers who did not "act for heaven". In the end, he was a servant.满洲入关，中国渐被压服了，连有“侠气”的人，也不敢再起盗心，不敢指斥奸臣，不敢直接为天子效力，于是跟一个好官员或钦差大臣，给他保镳，替他捕盗，一部《施公案》，也说得很分明，还有《彭公案》，《七侠五义》之流，至今没有穷尽。他们出身清白，连先前也并无坏处，虽在钦差之下，究居平民之上，对一方面固然必须听命，对别方面还是大可逞雄，安全之度增多了，奴性也跟着加足。
Manchuria entered the customs, China was gradually subdued, and even those with "chivalry" did not dare to steal again, dare not accuse traitors, and did not dare to directly serve the emperor, so they followed a good official or imperial envoy to give him bodyguards and catch thieves for him. Although they were under the imperial envoy, they were above the common people, and they had to obey orders on the one hand, but they were still able to show off on the other, and their safety increased, and their servility also increased.然而为盗要被官兵所打，捕盗也要被强盗所打，要十分安全的侠客，是觉得都不妥当的，于是有流氓。和尚喝酒他来打，男女通奸他来捉，私娼私贩他来凌辱，为的是维持风化；乡下人不懂租界章程他来欺侮，为的是看不起无知；剪发女人他来嘲骂，社会改革者他来憎恶，为的是宝爱秩序。但后面是传统的靠山，对手又都非浩荡的强敌，他就在其间横行过去。现在的小说，还没有写出这一种典型的书，惟《九尾龟》中的章秋谷，以为他给妓女吃苦，是因为她要敲人们竹杠，所以给以惩罚之类的叙述，约略近之。
However, thieves must be beaten by officers and soldiers, and thieves must also be beaten by robbers. He beats monks for drinking, he catches adultery between men and women, and he humiliates prostitutes and traffickers, in order to maintain weathering; The countryman did not understand the concession charter, and he came to bully in order to look down on ignorance; He mocks women with haircuts, and he hates social reformers in order to cherish order. But behind him was the traditional backer, and the opponent was not a mighty enemy, so he ran rampant in the middle. In today's novels, this kind of typical book has not yet been written, but Zhang Qiugu in "Nine-Tailed Turtle" thinks that he gave the prostitute suffering because she wanted to knock on people's bamboo poles, so he punished them, which is slightly closer.由现状再降下去，大概这一流人将成为文艺书中的主角了，我在等候“革命文学家”张资平“氏”的近作。
From the status quo, probably this class of people will become the protagonists of literary and art books, and I am waiting for the recent works of the "revolutionary writer" Zhang Ziping.

新月社批评家的任务

新月社批评家的任务

新月社批评家的任务

The task of the critics of the Crescent Society新月社中的批评家，是很憎恶嘲骂的，但只嘲骂一种人，是做嘲骂文章者。新月社中的批评家，是很不以不满于现状的人为然的，但只不满于一种现状，是现在竟有不满于现状者。
Critics in the Crescent Society hate ridicule, but they only mock one kind of person, and they are those who write ridicule articles. The critics in the Crescent Society are very dissatisfied with the status quo, but they are only dissatisfied with the status quo, and there are people who are dissatisfied with the status quo now.这大约就是“即以其人之道，还治其人之身”，挥泪以维持治安的意思。
This is roughly the meaning of "that is, in the way of others, and also treat others", shedding tears to maintain public order.譬如，杀人，是不行的。但杀掉“杀人犯”的人，虽然同是杀人，又谁能说他错？打人，也不行的。但大老爷要打斗殴犯人的屁股时，皂隶来一五一十的打，难道也算犯罪么？新月社批评家虽然也有嘲骂，也有不满，而独能超然于嘲骂和不满的罪恶之外者，我以为就是这一个道理。
For example, killing is not acceptable. But the person who kills the "murderer", even if it is also a murderer, who can say that he is wrong? It's not okay to hit someone. But when the eldest master wanted to fight the prisoner's buttocks, the soap slave came to beat him one by one, was it also a crime? Although the critics of the Crescent Society also have ridicule and dissatisfaction, I think this is the truth that can only transcend the evil of ridicule and dissatisfaction.但老例，刽子手和皂隶既然做了这样维持治安的任务，在社会上自然要得到几分的敬畏，甚至于还不妨随意说几句话，在小百姓面前显显威风，只要不大妨害治安，长官向来也就装作不知道了。
But as an old example, since the executioners and soap slaves have done such a task of maintaining public order, they naturally have to get a little awe in society, and they may even wish to say a few words at will to show their authority in front of the common people, as long as they do not interfere with public order, the governor has always pretended not to know.现在新月社的批评家这样尽力地维持了治安，所要的却不过是“思想自由”，想想而已，决不实现的思想。而不料遇到了别一种维持治安法，竟连想也不准想了。从此以后，恐怕要不满于两种现状了罢。
Now the critics of the Crescent Society have tried their best to maintain public order, but all they want is "freedom of thought", thinking about it, and never realizing it. Unexpectedly, I encountered another law of maintaining public order, and I couldn't even think about it. From now on, I am afraid that I will be dissatisfied with the two status quo.

书籍和财色

书籍和财色

书籍和财色

Books and wealth今年在上海所见，专以小孩子为对手的糖担，十有九带了赌博性了，用一个铜元，经一种手续，可有得到一个铜元以上的糖的希望。但专以学生为对手的书店，所给的希望却更其大，更其多——因为那对手是学生的缘故。
As I saw in Shanghai this year, nine out of ten sugar burdens that are dedicated to children are gambling, and with a copper dollar, after a procedure, there is hope of getting more than a copper dollar. But bookstores that specialize in students give more hope - because the opponent is the students.书籍用实价，废去“码洋”的陋习，是始于北京的新潮社——北新书局的，后来上海也多仿行，盖那时改革潮流正盛，以为买卖两方面，都是志在改进的人（书店之以介绍文化者自居，至今还时见于广告上），正不必先定虚价，再打折扣，玩些互相欺骗的把戏。然而将麻雀牌送给世界，且以此自豪的人民，对于这样简捷了当，没有意外之利的办法，是终于耐不下去的。于是老病出现了，先是小试其技：送画片。继而打折扣，自九折以至对折，但自然又不是旧法，因为总有一个定期和原因，或者因为学校开学，或者因为本店开张一年半的纪念之类。花色一点的还有赠丝袜，请吃冰淇淋，附送一只锦盒，内藏十件宝贝，价值不资。更加见得切实，然而确是惊人的，是定一年报或买几本书，便有得到“劝学奖金”一百元或“留学经费”二千元的希望。洋场上的“轮盘赌”，付给赢家的钱，最多也不过每一元付了三十六元，真不如买书，那“希望”之大，远甚远甚。
The bad habit of abolishing the "code foreign" of books at real prices began in Beijing's Xinchao Society - Beixin Bookstore, and later Shanghai also imitated it, because at that time, the trend of reform was in full swing, thinking that both buying and selling were people who were interested in improving (bookstores claim to introduce culture, and they are still seen in advertisements), so there is no need to set a false price first, and then discount, and play some tricks to deceive each other. However, the people who gave the mahjong card to the world and were proud of it finally couldn't stand such a simple and unexpected way. So the old disease appeared, and first of all, he tried his skills: sending pictures. Then discounts, from 90% off to half discounts, but naturally it is not the old method, because there is always a fixed period and reason, either because of the opening of the school, or because of the anniversary of the opening of the store for one and a half years. There are also free stockings, please eat ice cream, and a brocade box with ten treasures inside, which is worth nothing. It is even more realistic, but what is really amazing is that if you set a yearly newspaper or buy a few books, you will have the hope of getting a "scholarship bonus" of 100 yuan or a "study abroad fund" of 2,000 yuan. The "roulette" on the foreign field pays the winner at most, and the money paid is only thirty-six yuan per yuan, which is really not as good as buying a book, and the "hope" is far greater.我们的古人有言，“书中自有黄金屋”，现在渐在实现了。但后一句，“书中自有颜如玉”呢？
Our ancients said, "There is a golden house in the book", and now it is gradually being realized. But what about the latter sentence, "There is Yan Ruyu in the book"?日报所附送的画报上，不知为了什么缘故而登载的什么“女校高材生”和什么“女士在树下读书”的照相之类，且作别论，则买书一元，赠送裸体画片的勾当，是应该举为带着“颜如玉”气味的一例的了。在医学上，“妇人科”虽然设有专科，但在文艺上，“女作家”分为一类却未免滥用了体质的差别，令人觉得有些特别的。但最露骨的是张竞生博士所开的“美的书店”，曾经对面呆站着两个年青脸白的女店员，给买主可以问她“《第三种水》出了没有？”等类，一举两得，有玉有书。可惜“美的书店”竟遭禁止。张博士也改弦易辙，去译《卢骚忏悔录》，此道遂有中衰之叹了。
In the pictorial attached to the daily newspaper, I don't know what kind of "top student in the girls' school" and what "lady reading under the tree" photos were published for some reason, and apart from that, the act of buying a book for one yuan and giving away nude paintings should be cited as an example with the smell of "Yan Ruyu". In medicine, although "gynecology" has a specialty, in literature and art, "female writers" are divided into a category, but they inevitably abuse the difference in physique, which makes people feel a little special. But the most explicit is the "Beauty Bookstore" opened by Dr. Zhang Jingsheng, where two young and fair-faced female clerks once stood opposite, giving the buyer a chance to ask her, "Is "The Third Water" out? "Kill two birds with one stone, there are jade and books. Unfortunately, "Midea Bookstore" was banned. Dr. Zhang also changed his course and went to translate the "Confessions of Lu Sao", and this path has a sigh of decline.书籍的销路如果再消沉下去，我想，最好是用女店员卖女作家的作品及照片，仍然抽彩，给买主又有得到“劝学”，“留学”的款子的希望。
If the sales of books continue to decline, I think it is best to use female clerks to sell the works and photos of female writers, and still draw lots, so that buyers can have the hope of getting "persuasion" and "studying abroad" funds.

我和《语丝》的始终

我和《语丝》的始终

我和《语丝》的始终

I and "Yusi" from beginning to end同我关系较为长久的，要算《语丝》了。
The one who has a long-term relationship with me is "Yusi".大约这也是原因之一罢，“正人君子”们的刊物，曾封我为“语丝派主将”，连急进的青年所做的文章，至今还说我是《语丝》的“指导者”。去年，非骂鲁迅便不足以自救其没落的时候，我曾蒙匿名氏寄给我两本中途的《山雨》，打开一看，其中有一篇短文，大意是说我和孙伏园君在北京因被晨报馆所压迫，创办《语丝》，现在自己一做编辑，便在投稿后面乱加按语，曲解原意，压迫别的作者了，孙伏园君却有绝好的议论，所以此后鲁迅应该听命于伏园。这听说是张孟闻先生的大文，虽然署名是另外两个字。看来好像一群人，其实不过一两个，这种事现在是常有的。
Probably this is one of the reasons, the publications of the "righteous gentlemen" once named me the "main general of the Yusi school", and even the articles written by radical young people still say that I am the "instructor" of "Yusi". Last year, when it was not enough to scold Lu Xun to save himself from its decline, I was sent two halfway copies of "Mountain Rain" to me by an anonymous person, and when I opened it, there was a short article to the effect that Sun Fuyuanjun and I were oppressed by the Morning News Office in Beijing and founded "Yusi". I heard that this is Mr. Zhang Mengwen's big text, although the signature is two other words. It seems like a group of people, but in fact there are only one or two, and this kind of thing is common now.自然，“主将”和“指导者”，并不是坏称呼，被晨报馆所压迫，也不能算是耻辱，老人该受青年的教训，更是进步的好现象，还有什么话可说呢。但是，“不虞之誉”，也和“不虞之毁”一样地无聊，如果生平未曾带过一兵半卒，而有人拱手颂扬道，“你真像拿破仑呀！”则虽是志在做军阀的未来的英雄，也不会怎样舒服的。我并非“主将”的事，前年早已声辩了——虽然似乎很少效力——这回想要写一点下来的，是我从来没有受过晨报馆的压迫，也并不是和孙伏园先生两个人创办了《语丝》。这的创办，倒要归功于伏园一位的。
Naturally, "main general" and "guide" are not bad names, oppressed by the morning newspaper, it cannot be regarded as a shame, the old man should be taught by the youth, it is a good phenomenon of progress, what else can be said. However, "unexpected reputation" is as boring as "unexpected destruction", if you have never brought a soldier and a half in your life, and someone praises, "You are really like Napoleon!" Even if he is a future hero who aspires to be a warlord, he will not be very comfortable. I am not the "main general", I have already argued the year before last - although it seems to have little effect - what I want to write down this time is that I have never been oppressed by the Morning Newspaper, and I did not start "Yusi" with Mr. Sun Fuyuan. The establishment of this is due to Fu Yuan.那时伏园是《晨报副刊》的编辑，我是由他个人来约，投些稿件的人。
At that time, Fu Yuan was the editor of the "Morning News Supplement", and I was personally invited by him to submit some manuscripts.然而我并没有什么稿件，于是就有人传说，我是特约撰述，无论投稿多少，每月总有酬金三四十元的。据我所闻，则晨报馆确有这一种太上作者，但我并非其中之一，不过因为先前的师生——恕我僭妄，暂用这两个字——关系罢，似乎也颇受优待：一是稿子一去，刊登得快；二是每千字二元至三元的稿费，每月底大抵可以取到；三是短短的杂评，有时也送些稿费来。但这样的好景象并不久长，伏园的椅子颇有不稳之势。因为有一位留学生（不幸我忘掉了他的名姓）新从欧洲回来，和晨报馆有深关系，甚不满意于副刊，决计加以改革，并且为战斗计，已经得了“学者”的指示，在开手看Anatole France的小说了。
However, I didn't have any manuscripts, so there was a legend that I was a special writer, and no matter how much I submitted, I always had a monthly remuneration of thirty or forty yuan. As far as I know, the Morning News Office does have this kind of supreme author, but I am not one of them, but because of the relationship between the previous teachers and students—forgive my arrogance, I will temporarily use these two words—it seems to be treated quite favorably: first, once the manuscript is gone, it is published quickly; second, the manuscript fee of 2 to 3 yuan per 1,000 words, which can be obtained at the end of each month; The third is short miscellaneous comments, and sometimes some manuscript fees are also sent. But such a good scene did not last long, and Fu Yuan's chair was quite unstable. Because there was an international student (unfortunately I forgot his name) who had just returned from Europe and had a deep relationship with the Morning Newspaper, he was very dissatisfied with the supplement, decided to reform it, and for the sake of fighting, he had already received instructions from the "scholars" to start reading Anatole France's novels.那时的法兰斯，威尔士，萧，在中国是大有威力，足以吓倒文学青年的名字，正如今年的辛克莱儿一般，所以以那时而论，形势实在是已经非常严重。不过我现在无从确说，从那位留学生开手读法兰斯的小说起到伏园气忿忿地跑到我的寓里来为止的时候，其间相距是几月还是几天。
At that time, France, Wales, and Xiao were powerful enough to intimidate the names of literary youth in China, just like Sinclair this year, so at that time, the situation was really very serious. But I can't say for sure what months or days it was from the time the international student started reading France's novel to the time when Fu Yuan angrily ran to my apartment.“我辞职了。可恶！”
"I resigned. Damn it! ”这是有一夜，伏园来访，见面后的第一句话。那原是意料中事，不足异的。第二步，我当然要问问辞职的原因，而不料竟和我有了关系。他说，那位留学生乘他外出时，到排字房去将我的稿子抽掉，因此争执起来，弄到非辞职不可了。但我并不气忿，因为那稿子不过是三段打油诗，题作《我的失恋》，是看见当时“阿呀阿唷，我要死了”之类的失恋诗盛行，故意做一首用“由她去罢”收场的东西，开开玩笑的。这诗后来又添了一段，登在《语丝》上，再后来就收在《野草》中。而且所用的又是另一个新鲜的假名，在不肯登载第一次看见姓名的作者的稿子的刊物上，也当然很容易被有权者所放逐的。
This is the first sentence after one night when Fu Yuan came to visit and met. That was expected, not surprising. The second step, of course, I had to ask the reason for my resignation, but unexpectedly it had something to do with me. He said that when the international student was out, he went to the typesetting room to remove my manuscript, so he argued and had to resign. But I was not angry, because the manuscript was just three limericks, titled "My Broken Love", which was a joke when I saw that lovelorn poems such as "Ah, ah, I'm going to die" were prevalent at that time. This poem was later added to the "Silk of Words", and later included in "Weeds". Moreover, it is a new pseudonym, and it is of course easy to be banished by those in power in publications that refuse to publish the manuscript of the author whose name is seen for the first time.但我很抱歉伏园为了我的稿子而辞职，心上似乎压了一块沉重的石头。几天之后，他提议要自办刊物了，我自然答应愿意竭力“呐喊”。至于投稿者，倒全是他独力邀来的，记得是十六人，不过后来也并非都有投稿。于是印了广告，到各处张贴，分散，大约又一星期，一张小小的周刊便在北京——尤其是大学附近——出现了。这便是《语丝》。
But I am sorry that Fuyuan resigned for my manuscript, and it seems that a heavy stone has been pressed on my heart. A few days later, he proposed to run his own publication, and I naturally agreed to do my best to "shout". As for the contributors, they were all invited by him alone, I remember that there were sixteen people, but not all of them contributed later. So advertisements were printed, posted everywhere, dispersed, and about a week later, a small weekly magazine appeared in Beijing, especially near the university. This is "Yusi".那名目的来源，听说，是有几个人，任意取一本书，将书任意翻开，用指头点下去，那被点到的字，便是名称。那时我不在场，不知道所用的是什么书，是一次便得了《语丝》的名，还是点了好几次，而曾将不像名称的废去。但要之，即此已可知这刊物本无所谓一定的目标，统一的战线；那十六个投稿者，意见态度也各不相同，例如顾颉刚教授，投的便是“考古”稿子，不如说，和《语丝》的喜欢涉及现在社会者，倒是相反的。不过有些人们，大约开初是只在敷衍和伏园的交情的罢，所以投了两三回稿，便取“敬而远之”的态度，自然离开。连伏园自己，据我的记忆，自始至今，也只做过三回文字，末一回是宣言从此要大为《语丝》撰述，然而宣言之后，却连一个字也不见了。于是《语丝》的固定的投稿者，至多便只剩了五六人，但同时也在不意中显了一种特色，是：任意而谈，无所顾忌，要催促新的产生，对于有害于新的旧物，则竭力加以排击，——但应该产生怎样的“新”，却并无明白的表示，而一到觉得有些危急之际，也还是故意隐约其词。陈源教授痛斥“语丝派”的时候，说我们不敢直骂军阀，而偏和握笔的名人为难，便由于这一点。但是，叱吧儿狗险于叱狗主人，我们其实也知道的，所以隐约其词者，不过要使走狗嗅得，跑去献功时，必须详加说明，比较地费些力气，不能直捷痛快，就得好处而已。
The source of the name, I heard, is that there are several people who take a book at will, open it at will, and click it down with their fingers, and the word that is pointed out is the name. I was not present at that time, and I didn't know what kind of book I was using, whether I got the name of "Yusi" at one time, or if I ordered it several times, and I abolished it like the name. But in short, it can be seen that this publication does not have a certain goal, a united front; The sixteen contributors also have different opinions and attitudes, such as Professor Gu Jiegang, who submitted "archaeological" manuscripts, which is the opposite of the "Silk" that involves the current society. However, some people, at the beginning, were only perfunctory and Fuyuan's friendship, so after two or three drafts, they took the attitude of "staying away" and left naturally. Even Fuyuan himself, as far as I remember, has only written three times since the beginning, and the last time was a declaration that he would write a lot for "Yusi" from now on, but after the declaration, not even a word was missing. As a result, there are only five or six fixed contributors to "Yusi" at most, but at the same time, they also unintentionally show a characteristic, that is: talk arbitrarily, without scruples, urge the new to be produced, and try their best to reject the new and old things that are harmful to the new,—— but what kind of "new" should be produced, but there is no clear expression, and when it comes to feeling a little critical, it is still deliberately vague. When Professor Chen Yuan denounced the "Silk School", he said that we did not dare to scold the warlords directly, but were embarrassed by the celebrities who held the pen, which was because of this. However, the dog is dangerous to the owner of the dog, we actually know, so the vague word, but to make the lackey sniff, when running to give merit, it must be explained in detail, it takes some effort, and it can't be straightforward and happy, so it's just a benefit.当开办之际，努力确也可惊，那时做事的，伏园之外，我记得还有小峰和川岛，都是乳毛还未褪尽的青年，自跑印刷局，自去校对，自叠报纸，还自己拿到大众聚集之处去兜售，这真是青年对于老人，学生对于先生的教训，令人觉得自己只用一点思索，写几句文章，未免过于安逸，还须竭力学好了。
When it was launched, the hard work was indeed shocking, at that time, outside the Fuyuan, I remember that there were also Xiaofeng and Kawashima, both young people who had not yet faded their milk, running their own printing bureau, proofreading, stacking newspapers, and taking them to the place where the public gathered to sell, which was really a lesson for young people to the elderly and students to their teachers, which made people feel that they only used a little thinking and wrote a few sentences, which was too comfortable, and they had to try their best to learn well.但自己卖报的成绩，听说并不佳，一纸风行的，还是在几个学校，尤其是北京大学，尤其是第一院（文科）。理科次之。在法科，则不大有人顾问。倘若说，北京大学的法，政，经济科出身诸君中，绝少有《语丝》的影响，恐怕是不会很错的。至于对于《晨报》的影响，我不知道，但似乎也颇受些打击，曾经和伏园来说和，伏园得意之余，忘其所以，曾以胜利者的笑容，笑着对我说道：
However, I heard that the results of selling newspapers were not good, and the paper was still popular in several schools, especially Peking University, especially the First College (liberal arts). Science is second. In the legal department, there are not many consultants. If it is said that among the law, politics, and economics majors of Peking University, there are very few who have the influence of "Yusi", I am afraid it will not be very wrong. As for the impact of the "Morning Post", I don't know, but it seems to have been quite a blow, once made peace with Fu Yuan, Fu Yuan was proud, forgot why, once said to me with a smile of a winner:“真好，他们竟不料踏在炸药上了！”
"It's great, they didn't expect to step on the explosives!"这话对别人说是不算什么的。但对我说，却好像浇了一碗冷水，因为我即刻觉得这“炸药”是指我而言，用思索，做文章，都不过使自己为别人的一个小纠葛而粉身碎骨，心里就一面想：
This is nothing to others. But to me, it was like pouring a bowl of cold water, because I immediately felt that this "dynamite" meant that for me, thinking and making a sentence would only make myself shattered by a small entanglement of others, and I thought in my heart:“真糟，我竟不料被埋在地下了！”
"It's so bad, I was buried in the ground unexpectedly!"我于是乎“彷徨”起来。
I then "wandered".谭正璧先生有一句用我的小说的名目，来批评我的作品的经过的极伶俐而省事的话道：“鲁迅始于‘呐喊’而终于‘彷徨’”（大意），我以为移来叙述我和《语丝》由始以至此时的历史，倒是很确切的。
Mr. Tan Zhengbi has a very clever and trouble-free sentence in the name of my novel to criticize the process of my work: "Lu Xun began with 'shouting' and ended with 'hesitation'" (to the effect), I thought it was very accurate to narrate the history of me and "Yusi" from the beginning to this time.但我的“彷徨”并不用许多时，因为那时还有一点读过尼采的《Zarathustra》的余波，从我这里只要能挤出——虽然不过是挤出——文章来，就挤了去罢，从我这里只要能做出一点“炸药”来，就拿去做了罢，于是也就决定，还是照旧投稿了——虽然对于意外的被利用，心里也耿耿了好几天。
But my "hesitation" didn't take much time, because there was still a little aftermath of reading Nietzsche's "Zarathustra" at that time, as long as I could squeeze out the article, I would squeeze it out, and as long as I could make a little "dynamite" from me, I would just do it, so I decided to submit it as usual - although I was worried about being taken advantage of by accident for several days.《语丝》的销路可只是增加起来，原定是撰稿者同时负担印费的，我付了十元之后，就不见再来收取了，因为收支已足相抵，后来并且有了赢余。于是小峰就被尊为“老板”，但这推尊并非美意，其时伏园已另就《京报副刊》编辑之职，川岛还是捣乱小孩，所以几个撰稿者便只好搿住了多眼而少开口的小峰，加以荣名，勒令拿出赢余来，每月请一回客。这“将欲取之，必先与之”的方法果然奏效，从此市场中的茶居或饭铺的或一房门外，有时便会看见挂着一块上写“语丝社”的木牌。倘一驻足，也许就可以听到疑古玄同先生的又快又响的谈吐。但我那时是在避开宴会的，所以毫不知道内部的情形。
The sales of "Yusi" only increased, and it was originally planned that the writer would bear the printing fee at the same time, but after I paid ten yuan, I didn't come to collect it again, because the income and expenditure were enough to offset it, and then there was a surplus. At that time, Fuyuan had already taken on the position of editor of the "Beijing News Supplement", and Kawashima was still making trouble with the children, so several writers had to hold Xiaofeng, who had more eyes and few mouths, and gave him an honorary name, ordered him to take out the surplus and invite guests back once a month. From then on, outside the tea house or restaurant or one-room door in the market, you can sometimes see a wooden sign with the words "Language Silk Society" hanging on it. If you stop, you may be able to hear Mr. Yigu Xuantong's fast and loud conversation. But I was avoiding the banquet at that time, so I didn't know what's going on.我和《语丝》的渊源和关系，就不过如此，虽然投稿时多时少。但这样地一直继续到我走出了北京。到那时候，我还不知道实际上是谁的编辑。
My relationship with "Yusi" is just like that, although there are many times when I submit it. But this continued until I walked out of Beijing. At that point, I didn't know who actually edited it.到得厦门，我投稿就很少了。一者因为相离已远，不受催促，责任便觉得轻；二者因为人地生疏，学校里所遇到的又大抵是些念佛老妪式口角，不值得费纸墨。倘能做《鲁宾孙教书记》或《蚊虫叮卵脬论》，那也许倒很有趣的，而我又没有这样的“天才”，所以只寄了一点极琐碎的文字。这年底到了广州，投稿也很少。第一原因是和在厦门相同的；第二，先是忙于事务，又看不清那里的情形，后来颇有感慨了，然而我不想在它的敌人的治下去发表。
When I arrived in Xiamen, I had very few contributions. First, because they are far away and not urged, their responsibilities feel light; The two are unfamiliar, and most of the old women encountered in school are arguments like chanting Buddhism, which is not worth the paper and ink. If I could do "Rubin's Sun Teaching Secretary" or "The Theory of Mosquito Biting Eggs", it might be interesting, and I don't have such a "genius", so I only sent a little extremely trivial text. At the end of this year, I arrived in Guangzhou, and there were very few submissions. The first reason is the same as in Xiamen; Second, at first I was busy with affairs, and I couldn't see the situation there, and then I was quite emotional, but I didn't want to publish it under the rule of its enemies.不愿意在有权者的刀下，颂扬他的威权，并奚落其敌人来取媚，可以说，也是“语丝派”一种几乎共同的态度。所以《语丝》在北京虽然逃过了段祺瑞及其吧儿狗们的撕裂，但终究被“张大元帅”所禁止了，发行的北新书局，且同时遭了封禁，其时是一九二七年。
Unwilling to praise his authority under the knife of the powerful and ridicule his enemies to flatter them, it can be said that it is also an almost common attitude of the "Yusi faction". Therefore, although "Yusi" escaped the tearing of Duan Qirui and his bardogs in Beijing, it was eventually banned by "Marshal Zhang", and the Beixin Bookstore that issued it was banned at the same time, which was in 1927.这一年，小峰有一回到我的上海的寓居，提议《语丝》就要在上海印行，且嘱我担任做编辑。以关系而论，我是不应该推托的。于是担任了。从这时起，我才探问向来的编法。那很简单，就是：凡社员的稿件，编辑者并无取舍之权，来则必用，只有外来的投稿，由编辑者略加选择，必要时且或略有所删除。所以我应做的，不过后一段事，而且社员的稿子，实际上也十之九直寄北新书局，由那里径送印刷局的，等到我看见时，已在印钉成书之后了。所谓“社员”，也并无明确的界限，最初的撰稿者，所余早已无多，中途出现的人，则在中途忽来忽去。因为《语丝》是又有爱登碰壁人物的牢骚的习气的，所以最初出阵，尚无用武之地的人，或本在别一团体，而发生意见，借此反攻的人，也每和《语丝》暂时发生关系，待到功成名遂，当然也就淡漠起来。至于因环境改变，意见分歧而去的，那自然尤为不少。因此所谓“社员”者，便不能有明确的界限。前年的方法，是只要投稿几次，无不刊载，此后便放心发稿，和旧社员一律待遇了。但经旧的社员绍介，直接交到北新书局，刊出之前，为编辑者的眼睛所不能见者，也间或有之。
This year, Xiaofeng returned to my residence in Shanghai, proposed that "Yusi" be printed in Shanghai, and asked me to be the editor. In terms of relationships, I should not shirk it. So he served. From this point on, I inquired about the traditional weaving method. That is very simple, that is: all members' manuscripts, the editor has no right to choose, and must be used when they come, only external submissions, which are slightly selected by the editor, and deleted slightly if necessary. So what I should do is the latter part, and the manuscripts of the members are actually sent directly to the Beixin Book Company, and from there they are sent directly to the printing bureau, and by the time I see them, they are already printed and stapled. The so-called "members" do not have clear boundaries, and there are not many people left for the original writers, and those who appear in the middle come and go in the middle. Because "Yusi" has the complaining habit of Aiden's characters, people who are not yet useful at the beginning, or who are originally in another group, and have opinions and counterattack, often have a temporary relationship with "Yusi", and when they become famous, of course, they will become indifferent. As for those who left due to changes in the environment and differences of opinion, there were naturally many of them. Therefore, the so-called "members" cannot have clear boundaries. The method of the previous year was to submit a few submissions, all of which would be published, and then they would be published with confidence, and they would be treated the same as the old members. However, after being introduced by the old members, it was directly handed over to the Beixin Book Company, and before it was published, it was not visible to the eyes of the editor, and there were occasional cases.经我担任了编辑之后，《语丝》的时运就很不济了，受了一回政府的警告，遭了浙江当局的禁止，还招了创造社式“革命文学”家的拚命的围攻。警告的来由，我莫名其妙，有人说是因为一篇戏剧；禁止的缘故也莫名其妙，有人说是因为登载了揭发复旦大学内幕的文字，而那时浙江的党务指导委员老爷却有复旦大学出身的人们。至于创造社派的攻击，那是属于历史底的了，他们在把守“艺术之宫”，还未“革命”的时候，就已经将“语丝派”中的几个人看作眼中钉的，叙事夹在这里太冗长了，且待下一回再说罢。
After I served as an editor, the fortune of "Yusi" was very unlucky, and it was warned by the government, banned by the Zhejiang authorities, and desperately besieged by the creators of social "revolutionary literature". The reason for the warning, I am inexplicable, some people say it is because of a drama; The reason for the ban is also inexplicable, some people say that it is because of the publication of the text exposing the inside story of Fudan University, but at that time, the party steering committee of Zhejiang had people from Fudan University. As for the attack of the Creation Society, it belongs to history, they guarded the "palace of art", and before the "revolution", they had already regarded several people in the "Silk School" as a thorn in their side, and the narrative was too lengthy here, and I will talk about it next time.但《语丝》本身，却确实也在消沉下去。一是对于社会现象的批评几乎绝无，连这一类的投稿也少有，二是所余的几个较久的撰稿者，过时又少了几个了。前者的原因，我以为是在无话可说，或有话而不敢言，警告和禁止，就是一个实证。后者，我恐怕是其咎在我的。举一点例罢，自从我万不得已，选登了一篇极平和的纠正刘半农先生的“林则徐被俘”之误的来信以后，他就不再有片纸只字；江绍原先生绍介了一篇油印的《冯玉祥先生……》来，我不给编入之后，绍原先生也就从此没有投稿了。并且这篇油印文章不久便在也是伏园所办的《贡献》上登出，上有郑重的小序，说明着我托辞不载的事由单。
But "Yusi" itself is indeed depressed. First, there is almost no criticism of social phenomena, and even this kind of contribution is rare, and second, there are a few remaining long-term contributors, and a few are outdated. The reason for the former, I think is that there is nothing to say, or there is something to say but dare not speak, warnings and prohibitions are an empirical proof. The latter, I am afraid that it is my fault. For example, since I had no choice but to publish a letter in a very peaceful way to correct Mr. Liu Bannong's mistake of "Lin Zexu was captured", he no longer had a single word on a piece of paper; Mr. Jiang Shaoyuan introduced a mimeographed "Mr. Feng Yuxiang ......", and after I did not compile it, Mr. Shaoyuan did not submit it since. And this mimeographed article was soon published in the "Contribution" organized by Fuyuan, with a solemn preface, explaining the list of reasons I did not record.还有一种显著的变迁是广告的杂乱。看广告的种类，大概是就可以推见这刊物的性质的。例如“正人君子”们所办的《现代评论》上，就会有金城银行的长期广告，南洋华侨学生所办的《秋野》上，就能见“虎标良药”的招牌。虽是打着“革命文学”旗子的小报，只要有那上面的广告大半是花柳药和饮食店，便知道作者和读者，仍然和先前的专讲妓女戏子的小报的人们同流，现在不过用男作家，女作家来替代了倡优，或捧或骂，算是在文坛上做工夫。《语丝》初办的时候，对于广告的选择是极严的，虽是新书，倘社员以为不是好书，也不给登载。因为是同人杂志，所以撰稿者也可行使这样的职权。听说北新书局之办《北新半月刊》，就因为在《语丝》上不能自由登载广告的缘故。但自从移在上海出版以后，书籍不必说，连医生的诊例也出现了，袜厂的广告也出现了，甚至于立愈遗精药品的广告也出现了。固然，谁也不能保证《语丝》的读者决不遗精，况且遗精也并非恶行，但善后办法，却须向《申报》之类，要稳当，则向《医药学报》的广告上去留心的。我因此得了几封诘责的信件，又就在《语丝》本身上登了一篇投来的反对的文章。
Another significant change is the clutter of advertising. Looking at the type of advertisement, we can probably infer the nature of this publication. For example, in the "Modern Review" run by "upright gentlemen", there will be long-term advertisements for Jincheng Bank, and on "Qiu Ye" run by overseas Chinese students in Nanyang, you can see the sign of "Tiger Label Good Medicine". Although it is a tabloid under the banner of "revolutionary literature", as long as most of the advertisements on it are flowers and willow medicines and restaurants, it is known that the author and readers are still in the same flow as the previous tabloids that specialized in prostitutes and dramas. When "Yusi" was first launched, the selection of advertisements was extremely strict, even if it was a new book, if the members thought it was not a good book, it would not be published. Because it is a doujin magazine, the writer can also exercise such authority. I heard that Beixin Bookstore runs the "Beixin Semi-Monthly" because it cannot freely publish advertisements on "Yusi". But since it was published in Shanghai, not to mention books, even doctors' consultations, advertisements for sock factories, and even advertisements for Liyu nocturnal medicines have also appeared. Of course, no one can guarantee that the readers of "Yusi" will never leave sperm, and nocturnal sperm is not an evil deed, but the aftermath must be to be applied to the "Declaration", etc., and to be stable, pay attention to the advertisements of the "Journal of Medicine". As a result, I received several letters of reproach, and I published an opposing article on "Yusi" itself.但以前我也曾尽了我的本分。当袜厂出现时，曾经当面质问过小峰，回答是“发广告的人弄错的”；遗精药出现时，是写了一封信，并无答复，但从此以后，广告却也不见了。我想，在小峰，大约还要算是让步的，因为这时对于一部分的作家，早由北新书局致送稿费，不只负发行之责，而《语丝》也因此并非纯粹的同人杂志了。
But I have also done my duty before. When the sock factory appeared, he once questioned Xiaofeng in person, and the answer was that "the person who posted the advertisement made a mistake"; When the nocturnal medicine appeared, it was written in a letter and there was no reply, but since then, the advertisement has disappeared. I think that in Xiaofeng, it is probably a concession, because at this time, for some writers, the Beixin Book Company has already paid the manuscript fee, and is not only responsible for distribution, but also "Yusi" is not a pure fan magazine.积了半年的经验之后，我就决计向小峰提议，将《语丝》停刊，没有得到赞成，我便辞去编辑的责任。小峰要我寻一个替代的人，我于是推举了柔石。
After accumulating half a year of experience, I decided to propose to Xiaofeng to suspend the publication of "Yusi", but I resigned from my editorial responsibilities because it was not approved. Xiaofeng asked me to find a replacement, so I recommended Roushi.但不知为什么，柔石编辑了六个月，第五卷的上半卷一完，也辞职了。
But for some reason, Rou Shi edited for six months, and as soon as the first half of the fifth volume was finished, he also resigned.以上是我所遇见的关于《语丝》四年中的琐事。试将前几期和近几期一比较，便知道其间的变化，有怎样的不同，最分明的是几乎不提时事，且多登中篇作品了，这是因为容易充满页数而又可免于遭殃。虽然因为毁坏旧物和戳破新盒子而露出里面所藏的旧物来的一种突击之力，至今尚为旧的和自以为新的人们所憎恶，但这力是属于往昔的了。
The above are the trivia I encountered about "Yusi" in the four years. If you compare the previous issues with the recent ones, you will know how the changes are different, the most obvious is that there is almost no mention of current affairs, and most of them are published in novellas, because it is easy to fill the pages and avoid disaster. Although the power of an assault that reveals the old things hidden in the old by destroying old things and popping new boxes is still hated by the old and the new people, this power belongs to the past.十二月二十二日。
December 22.

The printed and circulated are:《士敏土之图》（德国C．梅斐尔德木刻十幅。珂罗版印。
"Picture of the Smyin Soil" (10 woodcuts by C. Mayfield, Germany. Coro print.《铁流》（苏联A．绥拉菲摩维支作长篇小说，曹靖华译。）
"Iron Flow" (Soviet A. Suerafimovitz novel, translated by Cao Jinghua. ）《铁流之图》（苏联Ⅰ．毕斯凯莱夫木刻四幅。印刷中，被炸毁。）
"Picture of the Iron Flow" (Soviet Union I. Biskelev woodcut 4 pieces. In print, it was blown up. ）我所译著的书，景宋曾经给我开过一个目录，载在《关于鲁迅及其著作》里，但是并不完全的。这回因载在为开手编集杂感，打开了装着和我有关的书籍的书箱，就顺便另抄了一张书目，如上。
The book I translated, Jing Song once opened a catalog for me, which was contained in "On Lu Xun and His Writings", but it was not complete. This time, because I was writing a collection of miscellaneous feelings for the sake of handwriting, I opened the bookcase containing books related to me, and copied another bibliography by the way, as above.我还要将这附在《三闲集》的末尾。这目的，是为着自己，也有些为着别人。据书目察核起来，我在过去的近十年中，费去的力气实在也并不少，即使校对别人的译著，也真是一个字一个字的看下去，决不肯随便放过，敷衍作者和读者的，并且毫不怀着有所利用的意思。虽说做这些事，原因在于“有闲”，但我那时却每日必须将八小时为生活而出卖，用在译作和校对上的，全是此外的工夫，常常整天没有休息。倒是近四五年没有先前那么起劲了。
I will also attach this to the end of the "Three Leisure Collection". This purpose is for himself and some for others. According to the bibliography, I have spent a lot of effort in the past ten years, even if I proofread other people's translations, I really read them word by word, and I will never let them go casually, perfunctory to the author and readers, and have no intention of taking advantage of them. Although the reason for doing these things was "leisure", I had to sell eight hours a day for my life, and I spent all my time on translation and proofreading, and I often had no rest all day. However, in the past four or five years, I have not been as energetic as before.但这些陆续用去了的生命，实不只成为徒劳，据有些批评家言，倒都是应该从严发落的罪恶。做了“众矢之的”者，也已经四五年，开首是“作恶”，后来是“受报”了，有几位论客，还几分含讥，几分恐吓，几分快意的这样“忠告”我。然而我自己却并不全是这样想，我以为我至今还是存在，只有将近十年没有创作，而现在还有人称我为“作者”，却是很可笑的。
But these lives that have been used one after another have not only become in vain, but according to some critics, they are all sins that should be dealt with severely. Those who have been "the target of public criticism" have been for four or five years, starting with "doing evil", and then "being rewarded", and there are several commentators who are a little ridiculous, a little intimidating, and a little happy to "advise" me. However, I don't think so, I think I still exist, I haven't created for nearly ten years, and now some people call me "author", which is ridiculous.我想，这缘故，有些在我自己，有些则在于后起的青年的。在我自己的，是我确曾认真译著，并不如攻击我的人们所说的取巧，的投机。所出的许多书，功罪姑且弗论，即使全是罪恶罢，但在出版界上，也就是一块不小的斑痕，要“一脚踢开”，必须有较大的腿劲。凭空的攻击，似乎也只能一时收些效验，而最坏的是他们自己又忽而影子似的淡去，消去了。
I think that for this reason, some of it is in myself, and some of it is in the rising youth. In my own case, I did translate it seriously, and it was not as clever and speculative as those who attacked me said. Many books published, regardless of merit and demerit, even if they are all sinful, but in the publishing industry, it is a big spot, and in order to "kick it away", it must have a lot of leg strength. Attacks out of thin air seem to have only some effect for a while, and the worst thing is that they themselves suddenly faded away like a shadow and disappeared.但是，试再一检我的书目，那些东西的内容也实在穷乏得可以。最致命的，是：创作既因为我缺少伟大的才能，至今没有做过一部长篇；翻译又因为缺少外国语的学力，所以徘徊观望，不敢译一种世上著名的巨制。后来的青年，只要做出相反的一件，便不但打倒，而且立刻会跨过的。但仅仅宣传些在西湖苦吟什么出奇的新诗，在外国创作着百万言的小说之类却不中用。因为言太夸则实难副，志极高而心不专，就永远只能得传扬一个可惊可喜的消息；然而静夜一想，自觉空虚，便又不免焦躁起来，仍然看见我的黑影遮在前面，好像一块很大的“绊脚石”了。
However, when I checked my bibliography again, the content of those things was really poor. The most fatal thing is: because I lack great talent, I have not made a long story so far; Because of the lack of academic ability in foreign Chinese, the translator hesitated and did not dare to translate a world-famous masterpiece. Later young people, as long as they do the opposite, will not only be defeated, but will immediately cross over. But it is useless to just promote some surprising new poems in West Lake and create million-word novels in foreign countries. Because it is difficult to match the words that are too exaggerated, and the ambition is extremely high and the heart is not focused, you can only spread a surprising and gratifying news; However, when Jingye thought about it, she felt empty, and she couldn't help but become anxious again, and still saw my black shadow covering the front, like a big "stumbling block".对于为了远大的目的，并非因个人之利而攻击我者，无论用怎样的方法，我全都没齿无怨言。但对于只想以笔墨问世的青年，我现在却敢据几年的经验，以诚恳的心，进一个苦口的忠告。那就是：不断的（！）努力一些，切勿想以一年半载，几篇文字和几本期刊，便立了空前绝后的大勋业。还有一点，是：不要只用力于抹杀别个，使他和自己一样的空无，而必须跨过那站着的前人，比前人更加高大。初初出阵的时候，幼稚和浅薄都不要紧，然而也须不断的（！）生长起来才好。并不明白文艺的理论而任意做些造谣生事的评论，写几句闲话便要扑灭异己的短评，译几篇童话就想抹杀一切的翻译，归根结蒂，于己于人，还都是“可怜无益费精神”的事，这也就是所谓“聪明误”了。
I have no complaints about those who attack me for a great purpose, not for personal gain, no matter what method is used. But for young people who just want to come out with pen and ink, I now dare to give a bitter advice based on a few years of experience and with a sincere heart. That is: constant (!) Work harder, don't think that in a year and a half, a few articles and a few journals, you will make unprecedented achievements. Another point is: do not only try to erase the other person, so that he is as empty as yourself, but must step over the standing predecessor, taller than the predecessor. When you first go into battle, it doesn't matter if you are naïve or shallow, but you must continue (!) It is good to grow. Do not understand the theory of literature and art and arbitrarily make some rumor-mongering comments, write a few gossip to extinguish the short comments of dissidents, and translate a few fairy tales to erase all translations.当我被“进步的青年”们所口诛笔伐的时候，我“还不到五十岁”，现在却真的过了五十岁了，据卢南（E．Renan）说，年纪一大，性情就会苛刻起来。我愿意竭力防止这弱点，因为我又明明白白地知道：世界决不和我同死，希望是在于将来的。但灯下独坐，春夜又倍觉凄清，便在百静中，信笔写了这一番话。
When I was criticized by the "progressive youth", I was "not yet fifty years old", but now I am really over fifty, and according to E. Renan, the older I get, the more harsh my temperament becomes. I am willing to do my best to prevent this weakness, because I know very clearly that the world will never die with me, and hope is in the future. But sitting alone under the lamp, the spring night felt desolate, so I wrote these words in silence.一九三二年四月二十九日，鲁迅于沪北寓楼记。
On April 29, 1932, Lu Xun recorded in the building of his residence in northern Shanghai.
