柔石小传

柔石小传

柔石小传

A short biography of Roushi柔石，原名平复，姓赵，以一九〇一年生于浙江省台州宁海县的市门头。前几代都是读书的，到他的父亲，家景已不能支，只好去营小小的商业，所以他直到十岁，这才能入小学。一九一七年赴杭州，入第一师范学校；一面为杭州晨光社之一员，从事新文学运动。毕业后，在慈溪等处为小学教师，且从事创作，有短篇小说集《疯人》一本，即在宁波出版，是为柔石作品印行之始。一九二三年赴北京，为北京大学旁听生。
Rou Shi, formerly known as Pingfu, surnamed Zhao, was born in 1901 in Shimentou, Ninghai County, Taizhou, Zhejiang Province. The previous generations were all educated, and by the time of his father, the family could no longer support him, so he had to run a small business, so he could not enter elementary school until he was ten years old. In 1917, he went to Hangzhou and entered the First Normal School; On the other hand, he is a member of the Hangzhou Chenguang Society and is engaged in the New Literature Movement. After graduation, he worked as a primary school teacher in Cixi and other places, and was engaged in creation, and had a collection of short stories "Madman", which was published in Ningbo, which was the beginning of the printing of Roushi's works. In 1923, he went to Beijing and was an auditor at Peking University.回乡后，于一九二五年春，为镇海中学校务主任，抵抗北洋军阀的压迫甚力。秋，咯血，但仍力助宁海青年，创办宁海中学，至次年，竟得募集款项，造成校舍；一面又任教育局局长，改革全县的教育。
After returning to his hometown, in the spring of 1925, he served as the director of school affairs at Zhenhai Middle School and resisted the oppression of the Beiyang warlords very strongly. In the autumn, he coughed up blood, but still helped the youth of Ninghai to establish Ninghai Middle School, and the following year, he was able to raise funds to build a school building; On the other hand, he also served as the director of the Education Bureau, reforming the education of the county.一九二八年四月，乡村发生暴动，失败后，到处反动，较新的全被摧毁，宁海中学既遭解散，柔石也单身出走，寓居上海，研究文艺。十二月为《语丝》编辑，又与友人设立朝华社，于创作之外，并致力于绍介外国文艺，尤其是北欧，东欧的文学与版画，出版的有《朝华》周刊二十期，旬刊十二期，及《艺苑朝华》五本。后因代售者不付书价，力不能支，遂中止。
In April 1928, there was a riot in the countryside, and after the failure, there was reaction everywhere, and the newer ones were all destroyed, Ninghai Middle School was disbanded, and Rou Shi also ran away alone, living in Shanghai to study literature and art. In December, he became the editor of "Yusi", and set up the Chaohua Society with his friends, in addition to creation, he is committed to promoting foreign literature and art, especially the literature and printmaking of Northern Europe and Eastern Europe, and has published 20 issues of "Chaohua" weekly, 12 issues of ten issues, and five copies of "Yiyuan Chaohua". Later, because the seller did not pay for the book, he could not afford it, so he stopped it.一九三〇年春，自由运动大同盟发动，柔石为发起人之一；不久，左翼作家联盟成立，他也为基本构成员之一，尽力于普罗文学运动。先被选为执行委员，次任常务委员编辑部主任；五月间，以左联代表的资格，参加全国苏维埃区域代表大会，毕后，作《一个伟大的印象》一篇。
In the spring of 1930, the Grand Alliance of Freedom Movements was launched, with Roushi as one of the initiators; Soon, the Left Writers' Union was established, and he was also one of the basic members, doing his best to support the popular literary movement. He was first elected as an executive member, and then as the director of the editorial department of the standing committee; In May, as a representative of the Left Alliance, he participated in the National Soviet Regional Congress, and after completing it, he wrote an article "A Great Impression".一九三一年一月十七日被捕，由巡捕房经特别法庭移交龙华警备司令部，二月七日晚，被秘密枪决，身中十弹。
Arrested on January 17, 1931, handed over from the patrol room to the Longhua Garrison Command through the special court, and on the evening of February 7, he was secretly shot and shot ten times.柔石有子二人，女一人，皆幼。文学上的成绩，创作有诗剧《人间的喜剧》，未印，小说《旧时代之死》，《三姊妹》，《二月》，《希望》，翻译有卢那卡尔斯基的《浮士德与城》，戈理基的《阿尔泰莫诺夫氏之事业》及《丹麦短篇小说集》等。
Roushi had two sons and a daughter, both young. His literary achievements include the poetic drama "The Comedy of the World", unprinted, the novels "The Death of the Old Age", "Three Sisters", "February", "Hope", translated Luna Karsky's "Faust and the City", Golike's "The Cause of the Artemonov Family" and "Danish Short Stories".

中国无产阶级革命文学和前驱的血

中国无产阶级革命文学和前驱的血

中国无产阶级革命文学和前驱的血

Chinese proletarian revolutionary literature and the blood of the forerunners中国的无产阶级革命文学在今天和明天之交发生，在诬蔑和压迫之中滋长，终于在最黑暗里，用我们的同志的鲜血写了第一篇文章。
China's proletarian revolutionary literature took place at the turn of today and tomorrow, grew in slander and oppression, and finally wrote its first article in the darkest with the blood of our comrades.我们的劳苦大众历来只被最剧烈的压迫和榨取，连识字教育的布施也得不到，惟有默默地身受着宰割和灭亡。繁难的象形字，又使他们不能有自修的机会。智识的青年们意识到自己的前驱的使命，便首先发出战叫。这战叫和劳苦大众自己的反叛的叫声一样地使统治者恐怖，走狗的文人即群起进攻，或者制造谣言，或者亲作侦探，然而都是暗做，都是匿名，不过证明了他们自己是黑暗的动物。
Our toiling masses have always been oppressed and exploited only the most violently, and they have not even received the alms of literacy education, but have been silently slaughtered and destroyed. The difficult hieroglyphs make them unable to have the opportunity to study on their own. The wise youth realized the mission of their pioneers and were the first to cry out for battle. This war cry terrorizes the ruler as much as the rebellious cry of the toiling masses themselves, and the lackey literati attack in groups, or spread rumors, or act as detectives themselves, but all in secret, all anonymous, but proving themselves to be dark animals.统治者也知道走狗的文人不能抵挡无产阶级革命文学，于是一面禁止书报，封闭书店，颁布恶出版法，通缉著作家，一面用最末的手段，将左翼作家逮捕，拘禁，秘密处以死刑，至今并未宣布。这一面固然在证明他们是在灭亡中的黑暗的动物，一面也在证实中国无产阶级革命文学阵营的力量，因为如传略所罗列，我们的几个遇害的同志的年龄，勇气，尤其是平日的作品的成绩，已足使全队走狗不敢狂吠。
The rulers also knew that lackey literati could not resist proletarian revolutionary literature, so they banned books and newspapers, closed bookstores, promulgated evil publishing laws, and wanted writers, while using the last resort to arrest, detain, and secretly sentence left-wing writers to death, which has not been announced so far. On the one hand, this proves that they are dark animals in extinction, and on the other hand, it also confirms the strength of the Chinese proletarian revolutionary literary camp, because as listed in the biography, the age, courage, and especially the achievements of the works of our slain comrades are enough to make the lackeys of the whole team dare not bark.然而我们的这几个同志已被暗杀了，这自然是无产阶级革命文学的若干的损失，我们的很大的悲痛。但无产阶级革命文学却仍然滋长，因为这是属于革命的广大劳苦群众的，大众存在一日，壮大一日，无产阶级革命文学也就滋长一日。我们的同志的血，已经证明了无产阶级革命文学和革命的劳苦大众是在受一样的压迫，一样的残杀，作一样的战斗，有一样的运命，是革命的劳苦大众的文学。
However, these comrades of ours have been assassinated, which is naturally a number of losses to the revolutionary literature of the proletariat, and we are very saddened. However, proletarian revolutionary literature still grows, because it belongs to the vast number of toiling masses of the revolution. The blood of our comrades has proved that the literature of the proletarian revolution and the toiling masses of the revolution are suffering the same oppression, the same killing, the same fighting, and the same fate.现在，军阀的报告，已说虽是六十岁老妇，也为“邪说”所中，租界的巡捕，虽对于小学儿童，也时时加以检查；他们除从帝国主义得来的枪炮和几条走狗之外，已将一无所有了，所有的只是老老小小——青年不必说——的敌人。而他们的这些敌人，便都在我们的这一面。
Now, the warlord's report has said that although she is a sixty-year-old woman, she is also hit by "heresy", and the patrols of the concession are checked from time to time, even for primary school children; They will have nothing but guns and a few lackeys from imperialism, and all they have is the enemies of old and young - young people needless to say. And these enemies of theirs are on our side.我们现在以十分的哀悼和铭记，纪念我们的战死者，也就是要牢记中国无产阶级革命文学的历史的第一页，是同志的鲜血所记录，永远在显示敌人的卑劣的凶暴和启示我们的不断的斗争。
We now commemorate our war dead with great condolences and remembrance, that is, to remember the first page of the history of Chinese proletarian revolutionary literature, which is recorded by the blood of comrades, always showing the despicable ferocity of the enemy and the continuous struggle that enlightens us.

黑暗中国的文艺界的现状——为美国《新群众》作

黑暗中国的文艺界的现状——为美国《新群众》作

黑暗中国的文艺界的现状——为美国《新群众》作

The current situation of the literary and artistic circles in dark China: for the American "New Masses"现在，在中国，无产阶级的革命的文艺运动，其实就是惟一的文艺运动。因为这乃是荒野中的萌芽，除此以外，中国已经毫无其他文艺。属于统治阶级的所谓“文艺家”，早已腐烂到连所谓“为艺术的艺术”以至“颓废”的作品也不能生产，现在来抵制左翼文艺的，只有诬蔑，压迫，囚禁和杀戮；来和左翼作家对立的，也只有流氓，侦探，走狗，刽子手了。
At present, in China, the revolutionary literary and artistic movement of the proletariat is actually the only literary and artistic movement. Because this is the sprout in the wilderness, there is no other literature and art in China other than that. The so-called "writers and artists" belonging to the ruling class have long been so rotten that they cannot even produce so-called "art for art" or even "decadent" works, and now the only thing that comes to resist left-wing literature and art is slander, oppression, imprisonment and killing; The only people who come to oppose left-wing writers are hooligans, detectives, lackeys, and executioners.这一点，已经由两年以来的事实，证明得十分明白。
This has been proven very clearly by the facts of the past two years.前年，最初绍介蒲力汗诺夫（Plekhanov）和卢那卡尔斯基（Lunacharsky）的文艺理论进到中国的时候，先使一位白璧德先生（Mr．Prof．Irving Babbitt）的门徒，感觉锐敏的“学者”愤慨，他以为文艺原不是无产阶级的东西，无产者倘要创作或鉴赏文艺，先应该辛苦地积钱，爬上资产阶级去，而不应该大家浑身褴褛，到这花园中来吵嚷。并且造出谣言，说在中国主张无产阶级文学的人，是得了苏俄的卢布。这方法也并非毫无效力，许多上海的新闻记者就时时捏造新闻，有时还登出卢布的数目。但明白的读者们并不相信它，因为比起这种纸上的新闻来，他们却更切实地在事实上看见只有从帝国主义国家运到杀戮无产者的枪炮。
The year before last, when the literary and artistic theories of Plekhanov and Lunacharsky were first introduced to China, a disciple of Mr. Prof. Irving Babbitt felt the indignation of a keen "scholar", who thought that literature and art were not originally proletarian things, and that if the proletariat wanted to create or appreciate literature and art, he should first work hard to save money and climb up to the bourgeoisie, rather than everyone in rags. Come and make noise in this garden. And spread rumors that those who advocated proletarian literature in China got Soviet Russian rubles. This method is not without effect, and many journalists in Shanghai fabricate news from time to time, sometimes publishing the number of rubles. But the readers who understand do not believe it, because they see in fact only guns that are transported from imperialist countries to kill the proletariat more than this kind of paper news.统治阶级的官僚，感觉比学者慢一点，但去年也就日加迫压了。禁期刊，禁书籍，不但内容略有革命性的，而且连书面用红字的，作者是俄国的，绥拉菲摩维支（A．Serafimovitch），伊凡诺夫（V．Ivanov）和奥格涅夫（N．Ognev）不必说了，连契诃夫（A．Chekhov）和安特来夫（L．Andreev）的有些小说也都在禁止之列。于是使书店只好出算学教科书和童话，如Mr．Cat和Miss Rose谈天，称赞春天如何可爱之类——因为至尔妙伦（H．Zur Mühlen）所作的童话的译本也已被禁止，所以只好竭力称赞春天。但现在又有一位将军发怒，说动物居然也能说话而且称为Mr．，有失人类的尊严了。
The bureaucrats of the ruling class feel a little slower than the scholars, but they have been under increasing pressure last year. Banned periodicals and books, not only were the content slightly revolutionary, but even the written in red letters, the authors were Russian, not to mention A. Serafimovitch, V. Ivanov and N. Ognev, and even some novels by A. Chekhov and L. Andreev were also banned. So the bookstore had no choice but to publish arithmetic textbooks and fairy tales, such as Mr.Cat talking to Miss Rose and praising how cute spring is—because translations of fairy tales by H. Zur Mühlen have also been banned, so they have to praise spring as much as possible. But now another general is angry, saying that animals can actually talk and are called Mr., which is a loss of human dignity.单是禁止，还不是根本的办法，于是今年有五个左翼作家失了踪，经家族去探听，知道是在警备司令部，然而不能相见，半月以后，再去问时，却道已经“解放”——这是“死刑”的嘲弄的名称——了，而上海的一切中文和西文的报章上，绝无记载。接着是封闭曾出新书或代售新书的书店，多的时候，一天五家，——但现在又陆续开张了，我们不知道是怎么一回事，惟看书店的广告，知道是在竭力印些英汉对照，如斯蒂文生（Robert Stevenson），槐尔特（Oscar Wilde）等人的文章。
Prohibition alone is not the fundamental solution, so this year five left-wing writers disappeared, and after the family went to inquire, they knew that they were at the garrison headquarters, but they could not meet, and half a month later, when they asked again, they said that they had been "liberated" - this is the mocking name of the "death penalty" - and there was no record in all Chinese and Western newspapers in Shanghai. Then there is the closure of bookstores that have published new books or sold new books, sometimes five a day,—— but now they are opening one after another, we don't know what's going on, but looking at the advertisements in the bookstore, we know that they are trying their best to print some English-Chinese comparisons, such as Robert Stevenson, Oscar Wilde and others.然而统治阶级对于文艺，也并非没有积极的建设。一方面，他们将几个书店的原先的老板和店员赶开，暗暗换上肯听嗾使的自己的一伙。但这立刻失败了。因为里面满是走狗，这书店便像一座威严的衙门，而中国的衙门，是人民所最害怕最讨厌的东西，自然就没有人去。喜欢去跑跑的还是几只闲逛的走狗。这样子，又怎能使门市热闹呢？但是，还有一方面，是做些文章，印行杂志，以代被禁止的左翼的刊物，至今为止，已将十种。然而这也失败了。最有妨碍的是这些“文艺”的主持者，乃是一位上海市的政府委员和一位警备司令部的侦缉队长，他们的善于“解放”的名誉，都比“创作”要大得多。他们倘做一部“杀戮法”或“侦探术”，大约倒还有人要看的，但不幸竟在想画画，吟诗。这实在譬如美国的亨利·福特（Henry Ford）先生不谈汽车，却来对大家唱歌一样，只令人觉得非常诧异。
However, the ruling class is not without active construction of literature and art. On the one hand, they drove away the original owners and clerks of several bookstores and secretly replaced them with their own group who were willing to listen to the instigation. But this immediately failed. Because it is full of lackeys, this bookstore is like a majestic yamen, and the Chinese yamen is the thing that the people fear and hate the most, so naturally no one goes. There are still a few lackeys who like to run. In this way, how can the store be lively? However, there is also the need to make articles and print magazines to replace the banned left-wing publications, and so far, there have been ten types. However, this also failed. The most obstructive thing is that the hosts of these "literature and art" are a Shanghai government member and a detective captain of the garrison command, and their reputation for being good at "liberation" is much greater than that of "creation". If they do a "killing method" or "detective technique", there are probably still people who want to see it, but unfortunately they are thinking about painting and reciting poetry. This is really like Mr. Henry Ford in the United States (Henry Ford) did not talk about cars, but came to sing to everyone, which is only very surprising.官僚的书店没有人来，刊物没有人看，救济的方法，是去强迫早经有名，而并不分明左倾的作者来做文章，帮助他们的刊物的流布。那结果，是只有一两个胡涂的中计，多数却至今未曾动笔，有一个竟吓得躲到不知道什么地方去了。
No one came to the bureaucratic bookstore, no one read the publications, and the remedy was to force authors who were famous for their early days and were not clearly left-leaning to write articles and help the circulation of their publications. The result was that there were only one or two nonsense, but most of them had not written so far, and one of them was so frightened that he hid somewhere.现在他们里面的最宝贵的文艺家，是当左翼文艺运动开始，未受迫害，为革命的青年所拥护的时候，自称左翼，而现在爬到他们的刀下，转头来害左翼作家的几个人。为什么被他们所宝贵的呢？因为他曾经是左翼，所以他们的有几种刊物，那面子还有一部分是通红的，但将其中的农工的图，换上了毕亚兹莱（Aubrey Beardsley）的个个好像病人的图画了。
Now the most valuable writers and artists among them are those who called themselves leftists when the left-wing literary and artistic movement began, were not persecuted, and were supported by revolutionary youth, but now they climb under their knives and turn their backs to harm left-wing writers. Why are they precious? Because he used to be a left-winger, they had several publications, and some of their faces were red, but they replaced the pictures of farm workers with pictures of Aubrey Beardsley, who looked like patients.在这样的情形之下，那些读者们，凡是一向爱读旧式的强盗小说的和新式的肉欲小说的，倒并不觉得不便。然而较进步的青年，就觉得无书可读，他们不得已，只得看看空话很多，内容极少——这样的才不至于被禁止——的书，姑且安慰饥渴，因为他们知道，与其去买官办的催吐的毒剂，还不如喝喝空杯，至少，是不至于受害。但一大部分革命的青年，却无论如何，仍在非常热烈地要求，拥护，发展左翼文艺。
Under such circumstances, those readers, who have always loved to read old robber novels and new sensual novels, do not find it inconvenient. However, the more progressive young people felt that there were no books to read, and they had no choice but to read books with a lot of empty words and very little content—so that they would not be banned—and comforted their hunger, because they knew that instead of buying government-run emetic poisons, it was better to drink empty cups, at least, not to be victimized. However, a large part of the revolutionary youth, in any case, are still very enthusiastically demanding, supporting, and developing left-wing literature and art.所以，除官办及其走狗办的刊物之外，别的书店的期刊，还是不能不设种种方法，加入几篇比较的急进的作品去，他们也知道专卖空杯，这生意决难久长。左翼文艺有革命的读者大众支持，“将来”正属于这一面。
Therefore, in addition to the publications run by the government and its lackeys, the periodicals of other bookstores still have to set up various methods to add a few more radical works, and they also know that it is difficult to last a long time in this business to monopolize empty cups. Left-wing literature and art have the support of revolutionary readers, and the "future" belongs to this side.这样子，左翼文艺仍在滋长。但自然是好像压于大石之下的萌芽一样，在曲折地滋长。
In this way, left-wing literature and art are still growing. But nature is like a sprout pressed under a big stone, growing in a tortuous way.所可惜的，是左翼作家之中，还没有农工出身的作家。一者，因为农工历来只被迫压，榨取，没有略受教育的机会；二者，因为中国的象形——现在是早已变得连形也不像了——的方块字，使农工虽是读书十年，也还不能任意写出自己的意见。这事情很使拿刀的“文艺家”喜欢。他们以为受教育能到会写文章，至少一定是小资产阶级，小资产者应该抱住自己的小资产，现在却反而倾向无产者，那一定是“虚伪”。惟有反对无产阶级文艺的小资产阶级的作家倒是出于“真”心的。“真”比“伪”好，所以他们的对于左翼作家的诬蔑，压迫，囚禁和杀戮，便是更好的文艺。
Unfortunately, among the left-wing writers, there are no writers with agricultural and industrial backgrounds. First, because agricultural workers have always been forced to press and extract, and have no opportunity to receive education; Second, because of the Chinese pictographs, which have long since become shapeless and inconsistent, peasants and workers cannot write their opinions arbitrarily even after ten years of study. This matter is very popular with the "literary and artistic people" with knives. They think that if they are educated enough to write articles, they must be at least petty bourgeoisie, and petty bourgeoisie should hold on to their petty bourgeoisie, but now they are inclined to the proletariat, which must be "hypocrisy". Only petty-bourgeois writers who oppose proletarian literature and art are out of "sincerity". "True" is better than "false", so their slander, oppression, imprisonment and killing of left-wing writers is better literature and art.但是，这用刀的“更好的文艺”，却在事实上，证明了左翼作家们正和一样在被压迫被杀戮的无产者负着同一的运命，惟有左翼文艺现在在和无产者一同受难（Passion），将来当然也将和无产者一同起来。单单的杀人究竟不是文艺，他们也因此自己宣告了一无所有了。
However, this "better literature and art" with a knife proves in fact that left-wing writers are suffering the same fate as the proletarians who are also oppressed and killed, and that only left-wing literature and art are now suffering with the proletariat (Passion), and of course will rise with the proletariat in the future. Killing alone is not literature and art, and they have declared that they have nothing.

上海文艺之一瞥——八月十二日在社会科学研究会讲

上海文艺之一瞥——八月十二日在社会科学研究会讲

上海文艺之一瞥——八月十二日在社会科学研究会讲

A glimpse of Shanghai literature and art - lectured at the Social Science Research Association on August 12上海过去的文艺，开始的是《申报》。要讲《申报》，是必须追溯到六十年以前的，但这些事我不知道。我所能记得的，是三十年以前，那时的《申报》，还是用中国竹纸的，单面印，而在那里做文章的，则多是从别处跑来的“才子”。
Shanghai's literature and art in the past began with the "Declaration". To talk about the "Declaration", it must go back 60 years, but I don't know these things. What I can remember is that thirty years ago, the "Declaration" at that time was still made of Chinese bamboo paper and printed on one side, and most of the people who made articles there were "talents" who came from elsewhere.那时的读书人，大概可以分他为两种，就是君子和才子。君子是只读四书五经，做八股，非常规矩的。而才子却此外还要看小说，例如《红楼梦》，还要做考试上用不着的古今体诗之类。这是说，才子是公开的看《红楼梦》的，但君子是否在背地里也看《红楼梦》，则我无从知道。有了上海的租界，——那时叫作“洋场”，也叫“夷场”，后来有怕犯讳的，便往往写作“彝场”——有些才子们便跑到上海来，因为才子是旷达的，那里都去；君子则对于外国人的东西总有点厌恶，而且正在想求正路的功名，所以决不轻易的乱跑。孔子曰，“道不行，乘桴浮于海”，从才子们看来，就是有点才子气的，所以君子们的行径，在才子就谓之“迂”。
Scholars at that time could probably be divided into two types, that is, gentlemen and talents. A gentleman only reads four books and five classics, and does eight strands, which is unconventional. In addition, talented people also have to read novels, such as "Dream of Red Mansions", and do ancient and modern poems that are not needed in exams. This means that the talent openly watches "Dream of Red Mansions", but I have no way of knowing whether the gentleman also watches "Dream of Red Mansions" behind his back. With the Shanghai Concession,—— it was called "Yangchang" at that time, also called "Yichang", and later those who were afraid of taboo often wrote "Yichang" - some talents came to Shanghai, because the talents were open-minded and went everywhere; A gentleman is always a little disgusted with foreigners, and he is trying to seek fame on the right path, so he will never run around easily. Confucius said, "The way is not good, and the raft floats in the sea", from the perspective of the talents, it is a bit talented, so the behavior of the gentlemen is called "roundabout" in the talents.才子原是多愁多病，要闻鸡生气，见月伤心的。一到上海，又遇见了婊子。去嫖的时候，可以叫十个二十个的年青姑娘聚集在一处，样子很有些像《红楼梦》，于是他就觉得自己好像贾宝玉；自己是才子，那么婊子当然是佳人，于是才子佳人的书就产生了。内容多半是，惟才子能怜这些风尘沦落的佳人，惟佳人能识坎轲不遇的才子，受尽千辛万苦之后，终于成了佳偶，或者是都成了神仙。
The talent was originally troubled and sick, and he wanted to smell the chicken angry and see the moon sad. As soon as I arrived in Shanghai, I met the bitch again. When he went to prostitution, he could call ten or twenty young girls to gather in one place, which looked a bit like "Dream of Red Mansions", so he felt like Jia Baoyu; If you are a talent, then the bitch is of course a beauty, so the book of the talented and beautiful woman was born. Most of the content is that only talents can pity these beauties who have fallen into the dust, and only beauties can recognize the talents who have not met the ups and downs, and after suffering a lot, they finally become good couples, or they all become immortals.他们又帮申报馆印行些明清的小品书出售，自己也立文社，出灯谜，有入选的，就用这些书做赠品，所以那流通很广远。也有大部书，如《儒林外史》，《三宝太监西洋记》，《快心编》等。现在我们在旧书摊上，有时还看见第一页印有“上海申报馆仿聚珍板印”字样的小本子，那就都是的。
They also helped the declaration hall print some Ming and Qing sketch books for sale, and they also established a literary society to produce lantern riddles, and if they were selected, they used these books as gifts, so the circulation was very wide. There are also many books, such as "The History of Confucianism", "The Western Records of the Three Treasures Eunuchs", "Kuaixin Compilation" and so on. Now we sometimes see small books printed on the first page of the old bookstall with the words "Shanghai Declaration Hall Imitation Collector Plate Print", and they are all there.佳人才子的书盛行的好几年，后一辈的才子的心思就渐渐改变了。他们发见了佳人并非因为“爱才若渴”而做婊子的，佳人只为的是钱。然而佳人要才子的钱，是不应该的，才子于是想了种种制伏婊子的妙法，不但不上当，还占了她们的便宜。叙述这各种手段的小说就出现了，社会上也很风行，因为可以做嫖学教科书去读。这些书里面的主人公，不再是才子＋（加）呆子，而是在婊子那里得了胜利的英雄豪杰，是才子＋流氓。
The books of beautiful talents have been popular for several years, and the minds of the next generation of talents have gradually changed. They found that the beauty was not a bitch because she was "thirsty for talent", and that the beauty was only for money. However, it is not appropriate for a beauty to ask for money from a talent, so the talent thought of all kinds of wonderful ways to subdue the bitches, not only did not fall for it, but also took advantage of them. Novels that describe these various means appeared, and they were also very popular in society, because they could be used as prostitution textbooks to read. The protagonists in these books are no longer talented + (plus) nerds, but heroes and heroes who have won victories from bitches, and they are talents + hooligans.在这之前，早已出现了一种画报，名目就叫《点石斋画报》，是吴友如主笔的，神仙人物，内外新闻，无所不画，但对于外国事情，他很不明白，例如画战舰罢，是一只商船，而舱面上摆着野战炮；画决斗则两个穿礼服的军人在客厅里拔长刀相击，至于将花瓶也打落跌碎。然而他画“老鸨虐妓”，“流氓拆梢”之类，却实在画得很好的，我想，这是因为他看得太多了的缘故；就是在现在，我们在上海也常常看到和他所画一般的脸孔。这画报的势力，当时是很大的，流行各省，算是要知道“时务”——这名称在那时就如现在之所谓“新学”——的人们的耳目。前几年又翻印了，叫作《吴友如墨宝》，而影响到后来也实在利害，小说上的绣像不必说了，就是在教科书的插画上，也常常看见所画的孩子大抵是歪戴帽，斜视眼，满脸横肉，一副流氓气。在现在，新的流氓画家又出了叶灵凤先生，叶先生的画是从英国的毕亚兹莱（Aubrey Beardsley）剥来的，毕亚兹莱是“为艺术的艺术”派，他的画极受日本的“浮世绘”（Ukiyoe）的影响。浮世绘虽是民间艺术，但所画的多是妓女和戏子，胖胖的身体，斜视的眼睛——Erotic（色情的）眼睛。不过毕亚兹莱画的人物却瘦瘦的，那是因为他是颓废派（Decadence）的缘故。颓废派的人们多是瘦削的，颓丧的，对于壮健的女人他有点惭愧，所以不喜欢。我们的叶先生的新斜眼画，正和吴友如的老斜眼画合流，那自然应该流行好几年。但他也并不只画流氓的，有一个时期也画过普罗列塔利亚，不过所画的工人也还是斜视眼，伸着特别大的拳头。但我以为画普罗列塔利亚应该是写实的，照工人原来的面貌，并不须画得拳头比脑袋还要大。
Before this, there had already been a kind of pictorial, called "Dian Shizhai Pictorial", which was written by Wu Youru, and he painted everything about immortal characters, internal and external news, but he didn't understand foreign things, for example, he painted a battleship, which was a merchant ship, and there were field guns on the cabin; In the painting duel, two soldiers in dresses drew long knives and fought each other in the living room, as for knocking down and smashing the vase. However, he painted "old bustards abusing prostitutes", "gangsters demolishing the tips", etc., but they were really well painted, I think, this is because he saw too much; Even now, we often see faces like those painted by him in Shanghai. The power of this pictorial was very large at that time, and it was popular in the provinces, and it was regarded as the eyes and ears of people who wanted to know "current affairs", which at that time was what is now called "new learning". Needless to say, the embroidered portraits in the novel are often seen wearing hats crookedly, squinting, full of flesh, and hooliganism. Now, a new rogue painter has emerged, Mr. Ye Lingfeng, whose paintings were stripped from Aubrey Beardsley in England, a school of "art for art", and his paintings were heavily influenced by the Japanese "Ukiyoe". Although ukiyo-e is folk art, it mostly depicts prostitutes and actors, chubby bodies, and squinting eyes - erotic (erotic) eyes. However, Piazlai's characters are thin, and that is because he is a decadence. Most of the people in the decadent faction are thin and decadent, and he is a little ashamed of strong women, so he doesn't like them. Our Mr. Ye's new squint painting is merging with Wu Youru's old squint painting, which should naturally be popular for several years. But he didn't just paint rogues, there was a period when he also painted Proletaria, but the workers he painted were still squinting and stretching out their fists. But I think that painting Proletaria should be realistic, according to the original appearance of the workers, it is not necessary to paint a fist bigger than a head.现在的中国电影，还在很受着这“才子＋流氓”式的影响，里面的英雄，作为“好人”的英雄，也都是油头滑脑的，和一些住惯了上海，晓得怎样“拆梢”，“揩油”，“吊膀子”的滑头少年一样。看了之后，令人觉得现在倘要做英雄，做好人，也必须是流氓。
The heroes in it, as "good guys", are also oily-headed, just like some slippery teenagers who are accustomed to living in Shanghai and know how to "remove the tips", "wipe the oil", and "hang their arms". After reading it, people feel that if you want to be a hero and be a good person, you must also be a rogue.才子＋流氓的小说，但也渐渐的衰退了。那原因，我想，一则因为总是这一套老调子——妓女要钱，嫖客用手段，原不会写不完的；二则因为所用的是苏白，如什么倪＝我，耐＝你，阿是＝是否之类，除了老上海和江浙的人们之外，谁也看不懂。
A novel of talent + rogue, but it is also gradually declining. The reason, I think, is that it is always this old tune - prostitutes ask for money, and prostitutes use means, which will not be endless; the second is because it is Su Bai, such as what Ni = me, Nai = you, Ah yes = no, etc., no one can understand it except for the people of old Shanghai and Jiangsu and Zhejiang.然而才子＋佳人的书，却又出了一本当时震动一时的小说，那就是从英文翻译过来的《迦茵小传》（H．R．Haggard：Joan Haste）。但只有上半本，据译者说，原本从旧书摊上得来，非常之好，可惜觅不到下册，无可奈何了。果然，这很打动了才子佳人们的芳心，流行得很广很广。后来还至于打动了林琴南先生，将全部译出，仍旧名为《迦茵小传》。而同时受了先译者的大骂，说他不该全译，使迦茵的价值降低，给读者以不快的。于是才知道先前之所以只有半部，实非原本残缺，乃是因为记着迦茵生了一个私生子，译者故意不译的。其实这样的一部并不很长的书，外国也不至于分印成两本。但是，即此一端，也很可以看出当时中国对于婚姻的见解了。
However, the book of talent + beauty published another novel that was shocking at the time, that is, "The Biography of Gain" (H.R. Haggard: Joan Haste) translated from English. But only the first half of the book, according to the translator, was originally obtained from the old bookstall, which was very good, but unfortunately I couldn't find the second volume, so there was nothing I could do. Sure enough, this touched the hearts of talented women and became very popular. Later, as for impressing Mr. Lin Qinnan, he translated it all, and it was still called "The Biography of Jia Yin". At the same time, he was scolded by the first translator, saying that he should not translate it in full, which reduced the value of Cain and made the reader unhappy. Only then did I realize that the reason why there was only half of it before was not originally incomplete, but because it was recorded that Cain gave birth to an illegitimate child, and the translator deliberately did not translate it. In fact, such a book is not very long, and foreign countries will not print it in two copies. However, at this end, it is also very clear that China had views on marriage at that time.这时新的才子＋佳人小说便又流行起来，但佳人已是良家女子了，和才子相悦相恋，分拆不开，柳阴花下，像一对胡蝶，一双鸳鸯一样，但有时因为严亲，或者因为薄命，也竟至于偶见悲剧的结局，不再都成神仙了，——这实在不能不说是一个大进步。到了近来是在制造兼可擦脸的牙粉了的天虚我生先生所编的月刊杂志《眉语》出现的时候，是这鸳鸯胡蝶式文学的极盛时期。后来《眉语》虽遭禁止，势力却并不消退，直待《新青年》盛行起来，这才受了打击。这时有伊孛生的剧本的绍介和胡适之先生的《终身大事》的别一形式的出现，虽然并不是故意的，然而鸳鸯胡蝶派作为命根的那婚姻问题，却也因此而诺拉（Nora）似的跑掉了。
At this time, the new talent + beauty novel became popular again, but the beauty was already a good family woman, and the talent fell in love, inseparable, under the willow shade, like a pair of butterflies, a pair of mandarin ducks, but sometimes because of strict relatives, or because of the thin life, it was even the end of the tragedy, and they were no longer all immortals,—— which really can't help but be said to be a big improvement. Recently, when the monthly magazine "Meiyu" edited by Mr. Tianxu Wosheng, who was making tooth powder that could wipe his face, appeared, it was the heyday of this mandarin duck and butterfly literature. Later, although "Meiyu" was banned, its power did not subside, and it was not until "New Youth" became popular that it was hit. At this time, there was the appearance of another form of Shaosuke in the script of Ibosheng and Mr. Hu Shizhi's "Life Events", although it was not intentional, but the marriage problem of the Mandarin Duck Hudie Sect as the lifeblood of the Mandarin Duck and Hu Butterfly faction also ran away like Nora.这后来，就有新才子派的创造社的出现。创造社是尊贵天才的，为艺术而艺术的，专重自我的，崇创作，恶翻译，尤其憎恶重译的，与同时上海的文学研究会相对立。那出马的第一个广告上，说有人“垄断”着文坛，就是指着文学研究会。文学研究会却也正相反，是主张为人生的艺术的，是一面创作，一面也看重翻译的，是注意于绍介被压迫民族文学的，这些都是小国度，没有人懂得他们的文字，因此也几乎全都是重译的。并且因为曾经声援过《新青年》，新仇夹旧仇，所以文学研究会这时就受了三方面的攻击。一方面就是创造社，既然是天才的艺术，那么看那为人生的艺术的文学研究会自然就是多管闲事，不免有些“俗”气，而且还以为无能，所以倘被发见一处误译，有时竟至于特做一篇长长的专论。一方面是留学过美国的绅士派，他们以为文艺是专给老爷太太们看的，所以主角除老爷太太之外，只配有文人，学士，艺术家，教授，小姐等等，要会说Yes，No，这才是绅士的庄严，那时吴宓先生就曾经发表过文章，说是真不懂为什么有些人竟喜欢描写下流社会。第三方面，则就是以前说过的鸳鸯胡蝶派，我不知道他们用的是什么方法，到底使书店老板将编辑《小说月报》的一个文学研究会会员撤换，还出了《小说世界》，来流布他们的文章。这一种刊物，是到了去年才停刊的。
Later, there was the emergence of the Creation Society of the New Talent School. The Creation Society is a noble genius, artistic for art's sake, self-focused, advocating creation, hating translation, especially hating retranslation, and opposing the Literary Research Association in Shanghai at the same time. In the first advertisement, it was said that someone "monopolized" the literary world, referring to the Literary Research Association. The Literary Research Association, on the contrary, advocates the art of life, and on the other hand, it also attaches importance to translation, and pays attention to the literature of the oppressed nations. And because it once supported "New Youth", the new grudge was combined with the old grudge, so the Literary Research Association was attacked from three sides at this time. On the one hand, it is the Creation Society, since it is the art of genius, then the literary research society that looks at the art of life is naturally nosy, inevitably a little "vulgar", and thinks it is incompetent, so if it is found to be mistranslated, sometimes it will be a long monograph. On the one hand, there are gentlemen who have studied in the United States, they think that literature and art are exclusively for the old ladies, so in addition to the old lady, the protagonist is only equipped with literati, scholars, artists, professors, ladies, etc., if you can say Yes, No, this is the solemnity of a gentleman. I don't know what method they used to make the bookstore owner replace a member of a literary research association who edited the "Novel Monthly", and also published "Novel World" to circulate their articles. This kind of publication was only discontinued last year.创造社的这一战，从表面看来，是胜利的。许多作品，既和当时的自命才子们的心情相合，加以出版者的帮助，势力雄厚起来了。势力一雄厚，就看见大商店如商务印书馆，也有创造社员的译著的出版，——这是说，郭沫若和张资平两位先生的稿件。这以来，据我所记得，是创造社也不再审查商务印书馆出版物的误译之处，来作专论了。这些地方，我想，是也有些才子＋流氓式的。然而，“新上海”是究竟敌不过“老上海”的，创造社员在凯歌声中，终于觉到了自己就在做自己们的出版者的商品，种种努力，在老板看来，就等于眼镜铺大玻璃窗里纸人的眼，不过是“以广招徕”。待到希图独立出版的时候，老板就给吃了一场官司，虽然也终于独立，说是一切书籍，大加改订，另行印刷，从新开张了，然而旧老板却还是永远用了旧版子，只是印，卖，而且年年是什么纪念的大廉价。
On the surface, this battle of the Creation Society was victorious. Many works were not only in line with the mood of the self-proclaimed talents at that time, but also became powerful with the help of publishers. As soon as the power is strong, you will see large shops such as the Commercial Press, and there are also the publication of translations of the members,—— that is, the manuscripts of Mr. Guo Moruo and Mr. Zhang Ziping. Since then, as far as I remember, the Creation Society has stopped reviewing the mistranslations of the publications of the Commercial Press. These places, I think, are also some talents + hooligans. However, "New Shanghai" is no match for "Old Shanghai", and the creative members finally realized that they were doing their own publisher's products in the triumphant song, and all kinds of efforts, in the eyes of the boss, were equivalent to the eyes of paper people in the large glass window of glasses, but "to recruit widely". When Xitu published independently, the boss ate a lawsuit, although it was finally independent, saying that all the books were greatly revised, printed separately, and opened from anew, but the old boss still used the old edition forever, just printed, sold, and cheap every year.商品固然是做不下去的，独立也活不下去。创造社的人们的去路，自然是在较有希望的“革命策源地”的广东。在广东，于是也有“革命文学”这名词的出现，然而并无什么作品，在上海，则并且还没有这名词。
Of course, commodities cannot be made, and independence cannot survive. The way for the people of the Creation Society is naturally in Guangdong, which is a more promising "source of revolution". In Guangdong, there is also the appearance of the term "revolutionary literature", but there are no works, and in Shanghai, there is no such term.到了前年，“革命文学”这名目这才旺盛起来了，主张的是从“革命策源地”回来的几个创造社元老和若干新份子。革命文学之所以旺盛起来，自然是因为由于社会的背景，一般群众，青年有了这样的要求。当从广东开始北伐的时候，一般积极的青年都跑到实际工作去了，那时还没有什么显著的革命文学运动，到了政治环境突然改变，革命遭了挫折，阶级的分化非常显明，国民党以“清党”之名，大戮共产党及革命群众，而死剩的青年们再入于被迫压的境遇，于是革命文学在上海这才有了强烈的活动。所以这革命文学的旺盛起来，在表面上和别国不同，并非由于革命的高扬，而是因为革命的挫折；虽然其中也有些是旧文人解下指挥刀来重理笔墨的旧业，有些是几个青年被从实际工作排出，只好借此谋生，但因为实在具有社会的基础，所以在新份子里，是很有极坚实正确的人存在的。但那时的革命文学运动，据我的意见，是未经好好的计划，很有些错误之处的。例如，第一，他们对于中国社会，未曾加以细密的分析，便将在苏维埃政权之下才能运用的方法，来机械的地运用了。再则他们，尤其是成仿吾先生，将革命使一般人理解为非常可怕的事，摆着一种极左倾的凶恶的面貌，好似革命一到，一切非革命者就都得死，令人对革命只抱着恐怖。其实革命是并非教人死而是教人活的。这种令人“知道点革命的厉害”，只图自己说得畅快的态度，也还是中了才子＋流氓的毒。
By the year before last, the name "revolutionary literature" became vigorous, advocating several elders of the Creation Society and several new elements who had returned from the "source of the revolution". The reason why revolutionary literature flourished was naturally because of the social background, the general masses and young people had such requirements. When the Northern Expedition began in Guangdong, the general active young people went to practical work, and there was no significant revolutionary literary movement at that time, but when the political environment suddenly changed, the revolution suffered setbacks, and the class division was very obvious. Therefore, the prosperity of this revolutionary literature is different from other countries on the surface, not because of the exaltation of the revolution, but because of the setbacks of the revolution; Although some of them are old literati who have relieved their old profession of commanding the knife to reorganize their pen and ink, and some are a few young people who have been expelled from practical work and have to make a living through this, because they really have a social foundation, there are very solid and correct people among the newcomers. But the revolutionary literary movement at that time, in my opinion, was not well planned and had some mistakes. For example, first, without a detailed analysis of Chinese society, they mechanically used the methods that could only be used under Soviet power. Furthermore, they, especially Mr. Cheng Fangwu, understood the revolution as a very terrible thing for ordinary people, and put on a fierce appearance of extreme leftism, as if when the revolution came, all non-revolutionaries would have to die, which made people only have fear of the revolution. In fact, revolution does not teach people to die, but to teach them to live. This kind of attitude that makes people "know the power of revolution" and only want to speak freely is still poisoned by talents + hooligans.激烈得快的，也平和得快，甚至于也颓废得快。倘在文人，他总有一番辩护自己的变化的理由，引经据典。譬如说，要人帮忙时候用克鲁巴金的互助论，要和人争闹的时候就用达尔文的生存竞争说。无论古今，凡是没有一定的理论，或主张的变化并无线索可寻，而随时拿了各种各派的理论来作武器的人，都可以称之为流氓。例如上海的流氓，看见一男一女的乡下人在走路，他就说，“喂，你们这样子，有伤风化，你们犯了法了！”他用的是中国法。倘看见一个乡下人在路旁小便呢，他就说，“喂，这是不准的，你犯了法，该捉到捕房去！”这时所用的又是外国法。但结果是无所谓法不法，只要被他敲去了几个钱就都完事。
It is intense quickly, peaceful quickly, and even decadent quickly. If he is a literati, he always has a reason to defend his change and quote the classics. For example, when asking for help, use Klubakin's theory of mutual assistance, and when you want to quarrel with others, use Darwin's theory of survival competition. Regardless of ancient or modern times, anyone who does not have a certain theory or changes in their propositions is not traceable, and who uses various theories as weapons at any time can be called hooligans. For example, a gangster in Shanghai saw a man and a woman walking in the countryside and said, "Hey, you are like this, you are offensive, you have broken the law!" He used Chinese law. If you see a country man urinating on the side of the road, he will say, "Hey, this is not allowed, you have broken the law, you should be caught in the arrest room!" At this time, foreign law was used. But the result is that it doesn't matter if it's illegal or illegal, as long as he knocks out a few money, it's over.在中国，去年的革命文学者和前年很有点不同了。这固然由于境遇的改变，但有些“革命文学者”的本身里，还藏着容易犯到的病根。“革命”和“文学”，若断若续，好像两只靠近的船，一只是“革命”，一只是“文学”，而作者的每一只脚就站在每一只船上面。当环境较好的时候，作者就在革命这一只船上踏得重一点，分明是革命者，待到革命一被压迫，则在文学的船上踏得重一点，他变了不过是文学家了。所以前年的主张十分激烈，以为凡非革命文学，统得扫荡的人，去年却记得了列宁爱看冈却罗夫（I．A．Gontcharov）的作品的故事，觉得非革命文学，意义倒也十分深长；还有最彻底的革命文学家叶灵凤先生，他描写革命家，彻底到每次上茅厕时候都用我的《呐喊》去揩屁股，现在却竟会莫名其妙的跟在所谓民族主义文学家屁股后面了。
In China, last year's revolutionary writers were a little different from the year before. This is certainly due to the change of circumstances, but some "revolutionary writers" themselves still hide the root of diseases that are easy to commit. "Revolution" and "literature" are intermittent, like two approaching boats, one is "revolution" and the other is "literature", and each foot of the author stands on each boat. When the environment is better, the author steps heavier on the boat of revolution, clearly a revolutionary, and when the revolution is oppressed, he steps heavier on the ship of literature, and he becomes nothing more than a writer. Therefore, the proposition of the year before last was very fierce, thinking that anyone who was not revolutionary literature and was swept away remembered last year that Lenin loved to read the story of I.A. Gontcharov's works, and felt that non-revolutionary literature had a very profound meaning; and the most thorough revolutionary writer, Mr. Ye Lingfeng, who described revolutionaries so thoroughly that he used my "scream" to wipe his buttocks every time he went to the toilet, but now he would inexplicably follow the buttocks of the so-called nationalist writers.类似的例，还可以举出向培良先生来。在革命渐渐高扬的时候，他是很革命的；他在先前，还曾经说，青年人不但嗥叫，还要露出狼牙来。这自然也不坏，但也应该小心，因为狼是狗的祖宗，一到被人驯服的时候，是就要变而为狗的。向培良先生现在在提倡人类的艺术了，他反对有阶级的艺术的存在，而在人类中分出好人和坏人来，这艺术是“好坏斗争”的武器。狗也是将人分为两种的，豢养它的主人之类是好人，别的穷人和乞丐在它的眼里就是坏人，不是叫，便是咬。然而这也还不算坏，因为究竟还有一点野性，如果再一变而为吧儿狗，好像不管闲事，而其实在给主子尽职，那就正如现在的自称不问俗事的为艺术而艺术的名人们一样，只好去点缀大学教室了。
A similar example can also be cited from Mr. Xiang Peiliang. when the revolution was gradually rising, he was very revolutionary; He had previously said that young people not only howled, but also showed wolf teeth. This is naturally not bad, but you should also be careful, because wolves are the ancestors of dogs, and when they are tamed, they will turn into dogs. Mr. Xiang Peiliang is now advocating human art, he opposes the existence of class art, and separating good and bad people among human beings, this art is a weapon of "good and bad struggle". Dogs also divide people into two types, the owner who raises it is a good person, and other poor people and beggars are bad people in its eyes, either barking or biting. However, this is not bad, because there is still a little wildness, if it changes into a dog, as if it doesn't care about idle things, but is actually doing its duty to the master, then just like the current celebrities who claim to be art for art's sake who don't care about worldly things, they have to embellish the university classroom.这样的翻着筋斗的小资产阶级，即使是在做革命文学家，写着革命文学的时候，也最容易将革命写歪；写歪了，反于革命有害，所以他们的转变，是毫不足惜的。当革命文学的运动勃兴时，许多小资产阶级的文学家忽然变过来了，那时用来解释这现象的，是突变之说。但我们知道，所谓突变者，是说A要变B，几个条件已经完备，而独缺其一的时候，这一个条件一出现，于是就变成了B。譬如水的结冰，温度须到零点，同时又须有空气的振动，倘没有这，则即便到了零点，也还是不结冰，这时空气一振动，这才突变而为冰了。所以外面虽然好像突变，其实是并非突然的事。倘没有应具的条件的，那就是即使自说已变，实际上却并没有变，所以有些忽然一天晚上自称突变过来的小资产阶级革命文学家，不久就又突变回去了。
Such a somersaulting petty bourgeoisie, even when he is a revolutionary writer and writes revolutionary literature, is most likely to write the revolution crookedly; Writing crookedly is harmful to the revolution, so their transformation is not worth regretting. When the revolutionary literary movement flourished, many petty-bourgeois writers suddenly changed, and the theory of mutation was used to explain this phenomenon. But we know that the so-called mutant means that A wants to become B, and several conditions are complete, and when one is missing, as soon as this condition appears, it becomes B. For example, when water freezes, the temperature must reach zero point, and at the same time, there must be air vibration, if there is no this, even if it reaches zero point, it will still not freeze, and when the air vibrates, it will suddenly turn into ice. So although it seems to be a mutation outside, it is actually not sudden. If there are no necessary conditions, it is that even if they say they have changed, they have not changed in fact, so some petty-bourgeois revolutionary writers who suddenly claimed to have mutated one night will soon mutate back.去年左翼作家联盟在上海的成立，是一件重要的事实。因为这时已经输入了蒲力汗诺夫，卢那卡尔斯基等的理论，给大家能够互相切磋，更加坚实而有力，但也正因为更加坚实而有力了，就受到世界上古今所少有的压迫和摧残，因为有了这样的压迫和摧残，就使那时以为左翼文学将大出风头，作家就要吃劳动者供献上来的黄油面包了的所谓革命文学家立刻现出原形，有的写悔过书，有的是反转来攻击左联，以显出他今年的见识又进了一步。这虽然并非左联直接的自动，然而也是一种扫荡，这些作者，是无论变与不变，总写不出好的作品来的。
The establishment of the Left Writers' Union in Shanghai last year is an important fact. Because at this time, the theories of Pulikhanov, Lunakarsky, etc. have been imported, so that everyone can learn from each other, more solid and powerful, but it is precisely because it is more solid and powerful that it is oppressed and destroyed, which is rare in the world in ancient and modern times. To show that his knowledge this year has taken another step. Although this is not a direct automatic of the left alliance, it is also a kind of sweep, and these authors, no matter whether they change or not, can never write good works.但现存的左翼作家，能写出好的无产阶级文学来么？我想，也很难。这是因为现在的左翼作家还都是读书人——智识阶级，他们要写出革命的实际来，是很不容易的缘故。日本的厨川白村（H．Kuriyagawa）曾经提出过一个问题，说：作家之所描写，必得是自己经验过的么？他自答道，不必，因为他能够体察。所以要写偷，他不必亲自去做贼，要写通奸，他不必亲自去私通。但我以为这是因为作家生长在旧社会里，熟悉了旧社会的情形，看惯了旧社会的人物的缘故，所以他能够体察；对于和他向来没有关系的无产阶级的情形和人物，他就会无能，或者弄成错误的描写了。所以革命文学家，至少是必须和革命共同着生命，或深切地感受着革命的脉搏的。（最近左联的提出了“作家的无产阶级化”的口号，就是对于这一点的很正确的理解。）
But can existing left-wing writers write good proletarian literature? I think it's also difficult. This is because today's left-wing writers are still scholars, the intellectual class, and it is not easy for them to write about the reality of the revolution. Japan's H. Kuriyagawa once raised a question: What a writer describes must be his own experience? He replied to himself, "No, because he can perceive." Therefore, if he wants to write about stealing, he does not have to be a thief himself, and if he wants to write about adultery, he does not have to personally commit adultery. But I think this is because the writer grew up in the old society, was familiar with the situation of the old society, and was used to seeing the characters of the old society, so he was able to understand; He will be incompetent or misrepresent the situation and people of the proletariat who have never had anything to do with him. Therefore, revolutionary writers must at least share their lives with the revolution, or deeply feel the pulse of the revolution. (The recent slogan of "proletarianization of writers" by the Left Union is a very correct understanding of this.) ）在现在中国这样的社会中，最容易希望出现的，是反叛的小资产阶级的反抗的，或暴露的作品。因为他生长在这正在灭亡着的阶级中，所以他有甚深的了解，甚大的憎恶，而向这刺下去的刀也最为致命与有力。固然，有些貌似革命的作品，也并非要将本阶级或资产阶级推翻，倒在憎恨或失望于他们的不能改良，不能较长久的保持地位，所以从无产阶级的见地看来，不过是“兄弟阋于墙”，两方一样是敌对。但是，那结果，却也能在革命的潮流中，成为一粒泡沫的。对于这些的作品，我以为实在无须称之为无产阶级文学，作者也无须为了将来的名誉起见，自称为无产阶级的作家的。
In a society like China today, the easiest thing to hope for is the rebellious petty bourgeoisie resistance or exposed works. Because he grew up in this dying class, he had a deep understanding, a great hatred, and the knife that stabbed it was the deadliest and most powerful. Of course, some seemingly revolutionary works are not intended to overthrow the class or the bourgeoisie, but to hate or be disappointed in their inability to improve and maintain their status for a long time, so from the point of view of the proletariat, they are nothing more than "brothers fighting against the wall", and the two sides are equally hostile. However, the result can also become a bubble in the trend of revolution. For these works, I think there is really no need to call them proletarian literature, and the author does not need to call himself a proletarian writer for the sake of future fame.但是，虽是仅仅攻击旧社会的作品，倘若知不清缺点，看不透病根，也就于革命有害，但可惜的是现在的作家，连革命的作家和批评家，也往往不能，或不敢正视现社会，知道它的底细，尤其是认为敌人的底细。随手举一个例罢，先前的《列宁青年》上，有一篇评论中国文学界的文章，将这分为三派，首先是创造社，作为无产阶级文学派，讲得很长，其次是语丝社，作为小资产阶级文学派，可就说得短了，第三是新月社，作为资产阶级文学派，却说得更短，到不了一页。这就在表明：这位青年批评家对于愈认为敌人的，就愈是无话可说，也就是愈没有细看。自然，我们看书，倘看反对的东西，总不如看同派的东西的舒服，爽快，有益；但倘是一个战斗者，我以为，在了解革命和敌人上，倒是必须更多的去解剖当面的敌人的。要写文学作品也一样，不但应该知道革命的实际，也必须深知敌人的情形，现在的各方面的状况，再去断定革命的前途。惟有明白旧的，看到新的，了解过去，推断将来，我们的文学的发展才有希望。我想，这是在现在环境下的作家，只要努力，还可以做得到的。
However, although it is a work that only attacks the old society, if you do not know the shortcomings and see through the root of the disease, it will be harmful to the revolution, but unfortunately, today's writers, even revolutionary writers and critics, often cannot or dare not face up to the current society and know its details, especially those who think the enemy. To give an example, in the previous "Lenin Youth", there was an article commenting on the Chinese literary circles, which divided it into three factions, the first is the Creation Society, as a proletarian literary school, which is very long, the second is the Language Silk Society, as a petty-bourgeois literary school, but it is short, and the third is the Crescent Society, as a bourgeois literary school, but it is even shorter and cannot reach a page. This shows that the more the young critic thinks of the enemy, the more he has nothing to say, that is, the less he looks closely. Naturally, when we read books, if we look at things that we oppose, it is better to read things of the same school than to read things of the same school. But if you are a fighter, I think that in understanding the revolution and the enemy, you must dissect the enemy in front of you more. The same is true for writing literary works, not only should we know the reality of the revolution, but we must also know the enemy's situation and the current situation in all aspects, and then judge the future of the revolution. Only by understanding the old, seeing the new, understanding the past, and inferring the future can there be hope for the development of our literature. I think this is something that writers in the current environment can do as long as they work hard.在现在，如先前所说，文艺是在受着少有的压迫与摧残，广泛地现出了饥馑状态。文艺不但是革命的，连那略带些不平色彩的，不但是指摘现状的，连那些攻击旧来积弊的，也往往就受迫害。这情形，即在说明至今为止的统治阶级的革命，不过是争夺一把旧椅子。去推的时候，好像这椅子很可恨，一夺到手，就又觉得是宝贝了，而同时也自觉了自己正和这“旧的”一气。二十多年前，都说朱元璋（明太祖）是民族的革命者，其实是并不然的，他做了皇帝以后，称蒙古朝为“大元”，杀汉人比蒙古人还利害。奴才做了主人，是决不肯废去“老爷”的称呼的，他的摆架子，恐怕比他的主人还十足，还可笑。这正如上海的工人赚了几文钱，开起小小的工厂来，对付工人反而凶到绝顶一样。
Now, as mentioned earlier, literature and art are suffering from rare oppression and destruction, and a state of famine is widely manifested. Literature and art are not only revolutionary, but also those who are slightly unfair, not only criticize the status quo, but even those who attack the old evils are often persecuted. This situation shows that the revolution of the ruling class so far is nothing more than a fight for an old chair. When I went to push it, it seemed that this chair was very hateful, and as soon as I got it, I felt that it was a treasure again, and at the same time, I felt that I was in the same breath with this "old". More than 20 years ago, it was said that Zhu Yuanzhang (Ming Taizu) was a national revolutionary, but this was not the case, and after he became emperor, he called the Mongol Dynasty "Dayuan", and killing the Han people was more beneficial than the Mongols. The servant became the master, and he would never abolish the title of "master", and his arrogance was probably more complete than his master, and it was ridiculous. This is just like the workers in Shanghai earn a few pennies and open a small factory, but they are extremely fierce against the workers.在一部旧的笔记小说——我忘了它的书名了——上，曾经载有一个故事，说明朝有一个武官叫说书人讲故事，他便对他讲檀道济——晋朝的一个将军，讲完之后，那武官就吩咐打说书人一顿，人问他什么缘故，他说道：“他既然对我讲檀道济，那么，对檀道济是一定去讲我的了。”现在的统治者也神经衰弱到像这武官一样，什么他都怕，因而在出版界上也布置了比先前更进步的流氓，令人看不出流氓的形式而却用着更厉害的流氓手段：用广告，用诬陷，用恐吓；甚至于有几个文学者还拜了流氓做老子，以图得到安稳和利益。因此革命的文学者，就不但应该留心迎面的敌人，还必须防备自己一面的三翻四复的暗探了，较之简单地用着文艺的斗争，就非常费力，而因此也就影响到文艺上面来。
In an old notebook novel - I forgot its title - there was a story that said that there was a military attaché in the dynasty who asked a storyteller to tell a story, and he told him about Tan Daoji, a general of the Jin Dynasty, and after speaking, the military attaché ordered the storyteller to be beaten, and when people asked him why, he said: "Since he told me about Tan Daoji, then he must tell me about Tan Daoji." The current ruler is also so nervous that he is afraid of anything like this military attaché, so he has also arranged more progressive hooligans in the publishing world than before, so that people cannot see the form of hooliganism but use more powerful hooligan methods: advertising, framing, and intimidation; Even a few literary scholars worshipped hooligans as Lao Tzu in order to gain stability and benefits. Therefore, revolutionary writers should not only pay attention to the oncoming enemy, but also guard against their own side of the repeated secret probes.现在上海虽然还出版着一大堆的所谓文艺杂志，其实却等于空虚。以营业为目的的书店所出的东西，因为怕遭殃，就竭力选些不关痛痒的文章，如说“命固不可以不革，而亦不可以太革”之类，那特色是在令人从头看到末尾，终于等于不看。至于官办的，或对官场去凑趣的杂志呢，作者又都是乌合之众，共同的目的只在捞几文稿费，什么“英国维多利亚朝的文学”呀，“论刘易士得到诺贝尔奖金”呀，连自己也并不相信所发的议论，连自己也并不看重所做的文章。所以，我说，现在上海所出的文艺杂志都等于空虚，革命者的文艺固然被压迫了，而压迫者所办的文艺杂志上也没有什么文艺可见。然而，压迫者当真没有文艺么？有是有的，不过并非这些，而是通电，告示，新闻，民族主义的“文学”，法官的判词等。例如前几天，《申报》上就记着一个女人控诉她的丈夫强迫鸡奸并殴打得皮肤上成了青伤的事，而法官的判词却道，法律上并无禁止丈夫鸡奸妻子的明文，而皮肤打得发青，也并不算毁损了生理的机能，所以那控诉就不能成立。现在是那男人反在控诉他的女人的“诬告”了。法律我不知道，至于生理学，却学过一点，皮肤被打得发青，肺，肝，或肠胃的生理的机能固然不至于毁损，然而发青之处的皮肤的生理的机能却是毁损了的。这在中国的现在，虽然常常遇见，不算什么稀奇事，但我以为这就已经能够很明白的知道社会上的一部分现象，胜于一篇平凡的小说或长诗了。
Although there are still a lot of so-called literary and art magazines published in Shanghai, it is actually equivalent to emptiness. The things produced by bookstores for the purpose of business, because they are afraid of suffering, try their best to choose some articles that are not painful, such as "life must not be changed, but it cannot be too revolutionary", etc., which is characterized by making people see the end from the beginning, and finally equal not to reading. As for the government-run magazines or the officialdom to make fun, the authors are all rabble, and the common purpose is only to make a few manuscript fees, what "British Victorian literature", "on Lewis getting the Nobel Prize", even he does not believe in the discussions made, and even he does not value the articles he has done. Therefore, I said that the literary and art magazines published in Shanghai are now empty, and the literature and art of the revolutionaries are certainly oppressed, and there is no literature and art visible in the literary and art magazines run by the oppressors. However, do the oppressors really have no literature and art? There are yes, but not these, but electricity, notices, news, nationalist "literature", judges' judgments, etc. For example, a few days ago, the "Declaration" recorded a woman accusing her husband of forcing sodomy and beating her to the point of bruising her skin, but the judge's judgment said that there is no explicit provision in the law prohibiting a husband from sodomy of his wife, and the bruising of the skin does not damage the physiological function, so the accusation cannot be established. Now it's the man who is accusing his woman of "false accusations". I don't know the law, but as for physiology, I have learned a little, the skin is beaten blue, and the physiological functions of the lungs, liver, or stomach are not damaged, but the physiological functions of the skin where the bluish is damaged are. Although it is not uncommon to encounter this in China now, I think it is already possible to know a part of the phenomenon in society very clearly, which is better than an ordinary novel or a long poem.除以上所说之外，那所谓民族主义文学，和闹得已经很久了的武侠小说之类，是也还应该详细解剖的。但现在时间已经不够，只得待将来有机会再讲了。今天就这样为止罢。
In addition to the above, the so-called nationalist literature and martial arts novels that have been in trouble for a long time should also be dissected in detail. But now there is not enough time, so I have to wait until I have the opportunity to talk about it in the future. That's all for today.

A small introduction to the 18th Art Society's study exhibition现在有自以为大有见识的人，在说“为人类的艺术”。然而这样的艺术，在现在的社会里，是断断没有的。看罢，这便是在说“为人类的艺术”的人，也已将人类分为对的和错的，或好的和坏的，而将所谓错的或坏的加以叫咬了。
Now there are people who think they are knowledgeable and say "art for mankind". However, such art is absolutely absent in today's society. After all, those who are saying "art for mankind" have also divided human beings into right and wrong, or good and bad, and called the so-called wrong or bad.所以，现在的艺术，总要一面得到蔑视，冷遇，迫害，而一面得到同情，拥护，支持。
Therefore, today's art must always be despised, coldly treated, and persecuted on the one hand, and sympathized, supported, and supported on the other.一八艺社也将逃不出这例子。因为它在这旧社会里，是新的，年青的，前进的。
The 18 Art Society will not escape this example. Because in this old society, it is new, young, and forward.中国近来其实也没有什么艺术家。号称“艺术家”者，他们的得名，与其说在艺术，倒是在他们的履历和作品的题目——故意题得香艳，漂渺，古怪，雄深。连骗带吓，令人觉得似乎了不得。然而时代是在不息地进行，现在新的，年青的，没有名的作家的作品站在这里了，以清醒的意识和坚强的努力，在榛莽中露出了日见生长的健壮的新芽。
There are actually no artists in China these days. Known as "artists", their names are not so much in art, but in their resumes and the titles of their works - deliberately fragrant, ethereal, eccentric, and majestic. Even deception and scare make people feel amazing. However, the times are constantly progressing, and now the works of new, young, and unknown writers stand here, with clear consciousness and strong efforts, revealing strong new shoots that grow day by day in the hazel.自然，这，是很幼小的。但是，惟其幼小，所以希望就正在这一面。
Naturally, this is very young. However, it is only young, so hope is on this side.我的话，也就是只对这一面说的，如上。
My words are only for this side, as above.一九三一年五月二十二日。

“民族主义文学”的任务和运命

“民族主义文学”的任务和运命

“民族主义文学”的任务和运命

The task and destiny of "nationalist literature"一
One殖民政策是一定保护，养育流氓的。从帝国主义的眼睛看来，惟有他们是最要紧的奴才，有用的鹰犬，能尽殖民地人民非尽不可的任务：一面靠着帝国主义的暴力，一面利用本国的传统之力，以除去“害群之马”，不安本分的“莠民”。所以，这流氓，是殖民地上的洋大人的宠儿，——不，宠犬，其地位虽在主人之下，但总在别的被统治者之上的。
Colonial policy is certain to protect and nurture hooligans. From the perspective of imperialism, only they are the most important servants, useful hawks and dogs, who can fulfill the tasks that the colonial people must fulfill: relying on imperialist violence and using the traditional power of their own country to get rid of the "black sheep" and the "weedy people" who are uneasy about their duty. Therefore, this hooligan is the darling of the foreigners in the colony,—— no, the pet dog, although its status is below the owner, but it is always above the other ruled.上海当然也不会不在这例子里。巡警不进帮，小贩虽自有小资本，但倘不另寻一个流氓来做债主，付以重利，就很难立足。到去年，在文艺界上，竟也出现了“拜老头”的“文学家”。
Of course, Shanghai is not in this example. Although the patrol police do not join the gang, although the hawker has his own small capital, if he does not find another gangster to be a creditor and pay a lot of profit, it will be difficult to gain a foothold. By last year, in the literary and artistic circles, there were also "writers" who "worshipped the old man".但这不过是一个最露骨的事实。其实是，即使并非帮友，他们所谓“文艺家”的许多人，是一向在尽“宠犬”的职分的，虽然所标的口号，种种不同，艺术至上主义呀，国粹主义呀，民族主义呀，为人类的艺术呀，但这仅如巡警手里拿着前膛枪或后膛枪，来福枪，毛瑟枪的不同，那终极的目的却只一个：就是打死反帝国主义即反政府，亦即“反革命”，或仅有些不平的人民。
But this is nothing more than the most explicit fact. Although the slogans they slogan are different, artistic supremacy, nationalism, nationalism, and art for mankind, this is only like a patrol officer holding a muzzle-loading gun or a breech-loading gun, a rifle gun, and a Mauser gun, but the ultimate purpose is only one: to kill anti-imperialism, that is, anti-government, that is, "counter-revolutionary", or just a little unjust people.那些宠犬派文学之中，锣鼓敲得最起劲的，是所谓“民族主义文学”。但比起侦探，巡捕，刽子手们的显著的勋劳来，却还有很多的逊色。这缘故，就因为他们还只在叫，未行直接的咬，而且大抵没有流氓的剽悍，不过是飘飘荡荡的流尸。然而这又正是“民族主义文学”的特色，所以保持其“宠”的。
Among those pet dog literature, the most vigorous gongs and drums are the so-called "nationalist literature". But compared to the remarkable merits of detectives, patrols, and executioners, there are still many inferiorities. For this reason, because they are still only screaming, they have not bitten directly, and they are probably not as fierce as hooligans, but just floating corpses. However, this is the characteristic of "nationalist literature", so it remains "favored".翻一本他们的刊物来看罢，先前标榜过各种主义的各种人，居然凑合在一起了。这是“民族主义”的巨人的手，将他们抓过来的么？并不，这些原是上海滩上久已沉沉浮浮的流尸，本来散见于各处的，但经风浪一吹，就漂集一处，形成一个堆积，又因为各个本身的腐烂，就发出较浓厚的恶臭来了。
Flipping through their publications, all kinds of people who had previously flaunted various doctrines actually made do with each other. Is this the hand of the giant of "nationalism" that has captured them? No, these were originally the drifting corpses that had been sinking and floating on Shanghai Beach for a long time, and they were originally scattered everywhere, but when the wind and waves blew, they floated together in one place, forming a pile of them, and because of the decay of each itself, it emitted a thick stench.这“叫”和“恶臭”有能够较为远闻的特色，于帝国主义是有益的，这叫做“为王前驱”，所以流尸文学仍将与流氓政治同在。
This "call" and "stench" have the characteristics of being more distant, which is beneficial to imperialism, which is called "precursor to the king", so the literature of the exiled corpse will still be with rogue politics.

“民族主义文学”的任务和运命

“民族主义文学”的任务和运命

Two但上文所说的风浪是什么呢？这是因无产阶级的勃兴而卷起的小风浪。先前的有些所谓文艺家，本未尝没有半意识的或无意识的觉得自身的溃败，于是就自欺欺人的用种种美名来掩饰，曰高逸，曰放达（用新式话来说就是“颓废”），画的是裸女，静物，死，写的是花月，圣地，失眠，酒，女人。一到旧社会的崩溃愈加分明，阶级的斗争愈加锋利的时候，他们也就看见了自己的死敌，将创造新的文化，一扫旧来的污秽的无产阶级，并且觉到了自己就是这污秽，将与在上的统治者同其运命，于是就必然漂集于为帝国主义所宰制的民族中的顺民所竖起的“民族主义文学”的旗帜之下，来和主人一同做一回最后的挣扎了。
But what are the wind and waves mentioned above? This is a small storm caused by the rise of the proletariat. Some of the so-called writers and artists in the past did not feel their own defeat half-consciously or unconsciously, so they deceived themselves with various good names to cover up, called Gao Yi, called Fang Da (in the new style of "decadence"), painted nude women, still lifes, death, and wrote about flowers and moons, holy places, insomnia, wine, and women. As soon as the collapse of the old society became more and more distinct and the class struggle became sharper, they also saw their sworn enemy, who would create a new culture and sweep away the old filthy proletariat, and felt that they were this filth and would share the fate of the rulers above.所以，虽然是杂碎的流尸，那目标却是同一的：和主人一样，用一切手段，来压迫无产阶级，以苟延残喘。不过究竟是杂碎，而且多带着先前剩下的皮毛，所以自从发出宣言以来，看不见一点鲜明的作品，宣言是一小群杂碎胡乱凑成的杂碎，不足为据的。
Therefore, although it is a miscellaneous corpse, the goal is the same: to oppress the proletariat by all means, just like the master, in order to survive. However, it is actually a chop piece, and most of it carries the remaining fur from before, so since the declaration was issued, there has been no distinctive work, and the declaration is a small group of miscellaneous pieces made up of random pieces, which is not enough to substantiate.但在《前锋月刊》第五号上，却给了我们一篇明白的作品，据编辑者说，这是“参加讨伐阎冯军事的实际描写”。描写军事的小说并不足奇，奇特的是这位“青年军人”的作者所自述的在战场上的心绪，这是“民族主义文学家”的自画像，极有郑重引用的价值的——
But in the fifth issue of "Forward Monthly", it gave us a clear work, which, according to the editor, was "an actual description of participating in the crusade against Yan Feng's army". It is not surprising that novels describing military affairs are strange and what is strange is the self-described feelings of the author of the "young soldier" on the battlefield, which is a self-portrait of a "nationalist writer", which is very worthy of solemn quotation -“每天晚上站在那闪烁的群星之下，手里执着马枪，耳中听着虫鸣，四周飞动着无数的蚊子，那样都使人想到法国‘客军’在菲洲沙漠里与阿剌伯人争斗流血的生活。”（黄震遐：《陇海线上》）
"Standing under the twinkling stars every night, holding a spear in my hand, listening to the sound of insects in my ears, and countless mosquitoes flying around, it reminds me of the bloody life of the French 'guest army' fighting the Arabs in the Philippine desert." (Huang Zhenxia: "On the Longhai Line")原来中国军阀的混战，从“青年军人”，从“民族主义文学者”看来，是并非驱同国人民互相残杀，却是外国人在打别一外国人，两个国度，两个民族，在战地上一到夜里，自己就飘飘然觉得皮色变白，鼻梁加高，成为腊丁民族的战士，站在野蛮的菲洲了。那就无怪乎看得周围的老百姓都是敌人，要一个一个的打死。法国人对于菲洲的阿剌伯人，就民族主义而论，原是不必爱惜的。仅仅这一节，大一点，则说明了中国军阀为什么做了帝国主义的爪牙，来毒害屠杀中国的人民，那是因为他们自己以为是“法国的客军”的缘故；小一点，就说明中国的“民族主义文学家”根本上只同外国主子休戚相关，为什么倒称“民族主义”，来朦混读者，那是因为他们自己觉得有时好像腊丁民族，条顿民族了的缘故。
It turned out that the melee of the Chinese warlords, from the perspective of "young soldiers" and "nationalist writers", was not driving the people of the same country to kill each other, but foreigners were fighting against a foreigner, two countries, two nations, and at night on the battlefield, they felt that their skin color had turned white, the bridge of their nose had increased, and they had become warriors of the Lading nation, standing in the barbaric Philippines. Then it is no wonder that the people around him are all enemies and want to be killed one by one. The French did not have to cherish the Arabs in the Philippines in terms of nationalism. This section alone, a little bigger, explains why the Chinese warlords became imperialist minions to poison and slaughter the Chinese people, because they themselves thought they were "French guest troops"; A little smaller shows that China's "nationalist writers" are fundamentally only related to foreign masters, and why they are called "nationalists" to confuse readers, it is because they themselves feel that sometimes they are like the Latin nation and the Teutonic nation.

“民族主义文学”的任务和运命

“民族主义文学”的任务和运命

Three黄震遐先生写得如此坦白，所说的心境当然是真实的，不过据他小说中所显示的智识推测起来，却还有并非不知而故意不说的一点讳饰。这，是他将“法国的安南兵”含糊的改作“法国的客军”了，因此就较远于“实际描写”，而且也招来了上节所说的是非。
Mr. Huang Zhenxia wrote so frankly, and the state of mind he said was of course true, but according to the wisdom shown in his novel, there was still a bit of taboo that he did not know and deliberately did not say. This is because he vaguely changed "French Annan soldiers" to "French guest army", so it is far from the "actual description", and it also attracts the right and wrong mentioned in the previous section.但作者是聪明的，他听过“友人傅彦长君平时许多谈论……许多地方不可讳地是受了他的熏陶”，并且考据中外史传之后，接着又写了一篇较切“民族主义”这个题目的剧诗，这回不用法兰西人了，是《黄人之血》（《前锋月刊》七号）。
But the author is smart, he has heard "my friend Fu Yanchangjun usually talk a lot...... Many places are undeniably influenced by him", and after examining the historical biography of China and foreign countries, he then wrote a drama poem on the topic of "nationalism", this time without the French, it was "Blood of the Yellow Man" ("Forward Monthly" No. 7).这剧诗的事迹，是黄色人种的西征，主将是成吉思汗的孙子拔都元帅，真正的黄色种。所征的是欧洲，其实专在斡罗斯（俄罗斯）——这是作者的目标；联军的构成是汉，鞑靼，女真，契丹人——这是作者的计划；一路胜下去，可惜后来四种人不知“友谊”的要紧和“团结的力量”，自相残杀，竟为白种武士所乘了——这是作者的讽喻，也是作者的悲哀。
The deeds of this drama are the western expedition of the yellow race, and the main general will be Genghis Khan's grandson, Marshal Batu, the real yellow race. The campaign is Europe, but in fact it is specifically in Oros (Russia) - this is the author's goal; The composition of the coalition forces was Han, Tatar, Jurchen, Khitan - this was the author's plan; Winning all the way, it is a pity that later the four people did not know the importance of "friendship" and the "power of unity", and killed each other, and were actually taken advantage of by the Caucasian warriors - this is the author's irony and the author's sadness.但我们且看这黄色军的威猛和恶辣罢——
But let's look at the might and viciousness of this yellow army——…………………… 
恐怖呀，煎着尸体的沸油； Horror, the boiling oil that frying the corpse; 
可怕呀，遍地的腐骸如何凶丑； Terrible, how ugly the rotten corpses are everywhere; 
死神捉着白姑娘拚命地搂； The god of death grabbed the white girl and hugged her desperately; 
美人螓首变成狞猛的髑髅； The beauty head turns into a fierce skull; 
野兽般的生番在故宫里蛮争恶斗； The beastly life fought fiercely in the Forbidden City; 
十字军战士的脸上充满了哀愁； The face of the crusaders was full of sorrow; 
千年的棺材泄出它凶秽的恶臭； The thousand-year-old coffin exudes its foul stench; 
铁蹄践着断骨，骆驼的鸣声变成怪吼； The iron hooves trample on the broken bones, and the camel's cry becomes a strange roar; 
上帝已逃，魔鬼扬起了火鞭复仇； God has fled, and the devil has raised his whip of fire for vengeance; 
黄祸来了！黄祸来了！ The Yellow Peril is coming! The Yellow Peril is coming! 
亚细亚勇士们张大吃人的血口。 The warriors of Asia opened their mouths to eat human blood.
这德皇威廉因为要鼓吹“德国德国，高于一切”而大叫的“黄祸”，这一张“亚细亚勇士们张大”的“吃人的血口”，我们的诗人却是对着“斡罗斯”，就是现在无产者专政的第一个国度，以消灭无产阶级的模范——这是“民族主义文学”的目标；但究竟因为是殖民地顺民的“民族主义文学”，所以我们的诗人所奉为首领的，是蒙古人拔都，不是中华人赵构，张开“吃人的血口”的是“亚细亚勇士们”，不是中国勇士们，所希望的是拔都的统驭之下的“友谊”，不是各民族间的平等的友爱——这就是露骨的所谓“民族主义文学”的特色，但也是青年军人的作者的悲哀。
This Kaiser Wilhelm shouted "Yellow Peril" because he wanted to advocate "Germany, Germany, above all else", this "cannibal blood mouth" of "Asian warriors are magnificent", but our poet is facing "Oros", the first country of the current dictatorship of the proletariat, in order to eliminate the model of the proletariat - this is the goal of "nationalist literature"; But because it is the "nationalist literature" of the colonial people, what our poets regard as the leader is the Mongol Batu, not the Chinese Zhao Gou, and it is the "Asian warriors" who open the "blood-eating mouth", not the Chinese warriors, what they hope for is the "friendship" under the control of Batu, not the equal friendship between all ethnic groups - this is the characteristic of the explicit so-called "nationalist literature", but it is also the sadness of the author of the young soldiers.

“民族主义文学”的任务和运命

四

“民族主义文学”的任务和运命

Four拔都死了；在亚细亚的黄人中，现在可以拟为那时的蒙古的只有一个日本。日本的勇士们虽然也痛恨苏俄，但也不爱抚中华的勇士，大唱“日支亲善”虽然也和主张“友谊”一致，但事实又和口头不符，从中国“民族主义文学者”的立场上，在已觉得悲哀，对他加以讽喻，原是势所必至，不足诧异的。
Batu is dead; Among the yellow people in Asia, there is only one Japan that can now be compared to Mongolia at that time. Although the Japanese warriors also hated Soviet Russia, they did not caress the Chinese warriors, and although the singing of "Japan-China goodwill" was also consistent with the advocacy of "friendship", the facts did not match the words.果然，诗人的悲哀的豫感好像证实了，而且还坏得远。当“扬起火鞭”焚烧“斡罗斯”将要开头的时候，就像拔都那时的结局一样，朝鲜人乱杀中国人，日本人“张大吃人的血口”，吞了东三省了。莫非他们因为未受傅彦长先生的熏陶，不知“团结的力量”之重要，竟将中国的“勇士们”也看成菲洲的阿剌伯人了吗？！
Sure enough, the poet's sad premonition seems to be confirmed, and it is far worse. When the "fire whip" burned the "Oros" was about to begin, just like the ending of Batu, the Koreans killed the Chinese indiscriminately, and the Japanese "opened up the blood of people" and swallowed the three eastern provinces. Could it be that because they were not influenced by Mr. Fu Yanchang and did not know the importance of "the power of unity", they actually regarded the Chinese "warriors" as the Arabs of the Philippines? !

“民族主义文学”的任务和运命

“民族主义文学”的任务和运命

Five这实在是一个大打击。军人的作者还未喊出他勇壮的声音，我们现在所看见的是“民族主义”旗下的报章上所载的小勇士们的愤激和绝望。这也是势所必至，无足诧异的。理想和现实本来易于冲突，理想时已经含了悲哀，现实起来当然就会绝望。于是小勇士们要打仗了——
This is really a big blow. The writer of the soldier has not yet shouted his brave voice, what we are seeing now is the indignation and despair of the little warriors in the newspapers under the banner of "nationalism". This is also inevitable and not surprising. Ideals and reality are easy to conflict, and ideals already contain sadness, and of course they will be desperate when they become real. So the little warriors are going to war——战啊，下个最后的决心，Fight, the next last determination,

What is obvious in these poems is that the author knows that there is no weapon, so he has to use "body", "elf of pure love", and "corpse". This is the previous sadness of the author of "Yellow Blood", and the reason why he wants to follow Marshal Batu and advocate "friendship". One group is to carry forward, the other is to be generous and lamentative, it is okay to write, but if this is really the case, it is too unclear of the essence of "nationalist literature", however, it has also fulfilled the task of "nationalist literature".

“民族主义文学”的任务和运命

六

“民族主义文学”的任务和运命

Six《前锋月刊》上用大号字题目的《黄人之血》的作者黄震遐诗人，不是早已告诉我们过理想的元帅拔都了吗？这诗人受过傅彦长先生的熏陶，查过中外的史传，还知道“中世纪的东欧是三种思想的冲突点”，岂就会偏不知道赵家末叶的中国，是蒙古人的淫掠场？拔都元帅的祖父成吉思皇帝侵入中国时，所至淫掠妇女，焚烧庐舍，到山东曲阜看见孔老二先生像，元兵也要指着骂道：“说‘夷狄之有君，不如诸夏之无也’的，不就是你吗？”夹脸就给他一箭。这是宋人的笔记里垂涕而道的，正如现在常见于报章上的流泪文章一样。黄诗人所描写的“斡罗斯”那“死神捉着白姑娘拚命地搂……”那些妙文，其实就是那时出现于中国的情形。但一到他的孙子，他们不就携手“西征”了吗？现在日本兵“东征”了东三省，正是“民族主义文学家”理想中的“西征”的第一步，“亚细亚勇士们张大吃人的血口”的开场。不过先得在中国咬一口。因为那时成吉思皇帝也像对于“斡罗斯”一样，先使中国人变成奴才，然后赶他打仗，并非用了“友谊”，送柬帖来敦请的。所以，这沈阳事件，不但和“民族主义文学”毫无冲突，而且还实现了他们的理想境，倘若不明这精义，要去硬送头颅，使“亚细亚勇士”减少，那实在是很可惜的。
Didn't the poet Huang Zhenxia, the author of "Yellow Man's Blood" in the "Forward Monthly", already tell us about the ideal marshal Batu? This poet has been influenced by Mr. Fu Yanchang, has checked Chinese and foreign historical biographies, and knows that "medieval Eastern Europe was a point of conflict between the three ideas". When Marshal Batu's grandfather, Emperor Genghis, invaded China, he raped women and burned houses, and when he went to Qufu, Shandong Province, he saw the portrait of Mr. Kong Laoer, and the Yuan soldiers also pointed at him and scolded: "Isn't it you who says, 'The barbarians have a king, it is not as good as the lack of Xia'? "Give him an arrow when he pinched his face. This is what the Song people wept about, just like the tearful articles that are now common in newspapers. The wonderful texts of "Oros" described by the poet Huang in "Death grabbed the white girl and hugged her desperately...... were actually the situation that appeared in China at that time. But as soon as his grandson arrived, didn't they join hands to "march west"? Now the Japanese soldiers have "marched east" to the three eastern provinces, which is the first step of the "western expedition" in the ideal of "nationalist writers" and the beginning of "the Asian warriors cannibalizing the blood". But you have to take a bite in China first. Because at that time, Emperor Genghis also did the same as "Oros", first turning the Chinese into slaves, and then driving him to fight, not using "friendship" to send invitations to urge them. Therefore, this Shenyang incident not only has no conflict with "nationalist literature", but also realizes their ideal situation.那么，“民族主义文学”无须有那些呜呼阿呀死死活活的调子吗？谨对曰：要有的，他们也一定有的。否则不抵抗主义，城下之盟，断送土地这些勾当，在沉静中就显得更加露骨。必须痛哭怒号，摩拳擦掌，令人被这扰攘嘈杂所惑乱，闻悲歌而泪垂，听壮歌而愤泄，于是那“东征”即“西征”的第一步，也就悄悄的隐隐的跨过去了。落葬的行列里有悲哀的哭声，有壮大的军乐，那任务是在送死人埋入土中，用热闹来掩过了这“死”，给大家接着就得到“忘却”。现在“民族主义文学”的发扬踔厉，或慷慨悲歌的文章，便是正在尽着同一的任务的。
So, does "nationalist literature" need to have those whoosh-ah-ah-a-dead tones? I respectfully replied: If there is something, they must have it. Otherwise, non-resistance, alliances under the city, and ruining land will be even more explicit in silence. It is necessary to cry and cry angrily, to prepare their hands, to be confused by this noise, to cry when they hear the sad song, and to vent their anger when they hear the magnificent song, so the first step of the "Eastern Expedition", that is, the "Western Expedition", has quietly and faintly crossed. There are sad cries in the procession of burial, there are strong military music, and the task is to bury the dead in the ground, cover up this "death" with liveliness, and then get "forgetful" for everyone. Now the vigorous development of "nationalist literature" or the generous and lamentative articles are fulfilling the same task.但这之后，“民族主义文学者”也就更加接近了他的哀愁。因为有一个问题，更加临近，就是将来主子是否不至于再蹈拔都元帅的覆辙，肯信用而且优待忠勇的奴才，不，勇士们呢？这实在是一个很要紧，很可怕的问题，是主子和奴才能否“同存共荣”的大关键。
But after that, the "nationalist writer" came closer to his sorrow. Because there is a question, which is closer, that is, will the master not repeat the mistakes of Marshal Batu in the future, and will he trust and give preferential treatment to the loyal and brave servants, no, what about the warriors? This is really a very important and terrible question, and it is the key to whether masters and slaves can "coexist and prosper".历史告诉我们：不能的。这，正如连“民族主义文学者”也已经知道一样，不会有这一回事。他们将只尽些送丧的任务，永含着恋主的哀愁，须到无产阶级革命的风涛怒吼起来，刷洗山河的时候，这才能脱出这沉滞猥劣和腐烂的运命。
History tells us: no. This, as even "nationalist writers" already know, will not happen. They will only do some funeral tasks, forever containing the sorrow of loving the Lord, and only when the wind and waves of the proletarian revolution roar and wash away the mountains and rivers can they escape this stagnant, obscene and rotten fate.

沉滓的泛起

沉滓的泛起

沉滓的泛起

The dregs rose日本占据了东三省以后的在上海一带的表示，报章上叫作“国难声中”。在这“国难声中”，恰如用棍子搅了一下停滞多年的池塘，各种古的沉滓，新的沉滓，就都翻着筋斗漂上来，在水面上转一个身，来趁势显示自己的存在了。
After Japan occupied the three eastern provinces, the Shanghai area was called "in the voice of national crisis" in the newspaper. In this "sound of national crisis", it is like stirring a pond that has been stagnant for many years with a stick, and all kinds of ancient and new sediment float up in a somersault, turning around on the water to take advantage of the situation to show their existence.自信现在可以说能打仗的，是要操练久不想起的洋枪了，但也有现在也不想说去打仗的，那就照欧洲大战时候的德意志帝国的例，来“头脑动员”，以尽“国民一份子”的义务。有的去查《唐书》，说日本古名“倭奴”；有的去翻字典，说倭是矮小之意；有的记得了文天祥，岳飞，林则徐，——但自然，更积极的是新的文艺界。
Those who are confident that they can now say that they can fight are to practice foreign guns that they haven't remembered for a long time, but there are also those who don't want to talk about fighting now, so follow the example of the German Empire during the European War to "mobilize their minds" to fulfill their obligations as a "member of the people". some went to check the "Book of Tang" and said that the ancient name of Japan was "Wa slave"; some went to the dictionary and said that Wa means short; Some remember Wen Tianxiang, Yue Fei, Lin Zexu,—— but naturally, the more active is the new literary and artistic circles.先说一点另外的事罢，这叫作“和平声中”。在这样的声中，是“胡展堂先生”到了上海，据说还告诫青年，教他们要养“力”勿使“气”。灵药就有了。第二天在报上便见广告道：“胡汉民先生说，对日外交，应确定一坚强之原则，并劝勉青年须养力，毋泄气，养力就是强身，泄气就是悲观，要强身袪悲观，须先心花怒放，大笑一次。”但这样的宝贝是什么呢？是美国的一张旧影片，将探险滑稽化以博小市民一笑的《两亲家游非洲》。
Let's talk about something else, which is called "in the voice of peace." In such a voice, it was "Mr. Hu Zhantang" who arrived in Shanghai and said that he also warned young people to teach them to cultivate "strength" and not "anger". The elixir is there. The next day, I saw an advertisement in the newspaper: "Mr. Hu Hanmin said that in diplomacy with Japan, a strong principle should be determined, and he advised young people to cultivate strength, not to be discouraged, to cultivate strength is to strengthen the body, to be discouraged is to be pessimistic, to strengthen the body and be pessimistic, to be pessimistic, you must first be happy and laugh once." "But what is such a baby? It is an old American film that comically turns the adventure into a laugh for the common people.至于真的“国难声中的兴奋剂”呢，那是“爱国歌舞表演”，自己说，“是民族性的活跃，是歌舞界的精髓，促进同胞的努力，达到最后的胜利”的。倘有知道这立奏奇功的大明星是谁么？曰：王人美，薛玲仙，黎莉莉。
As for the real "stimulant in the voice of national crisis", it is a "patriotic song and dance performance", which he said "is the activity of the national character, the essence of the song and dance world, promoting the efforts of compatriots and achieving the final victory". If anyone knows who the big star of this amazing performance is? They are: Wang Renmei, Xue Lingxian, Li Lili.然而终于“上海文艺界大团结”了。《草野》（六卷七号）上记着盛况道：“上海文艺界同人，平时很少联络，在严重时期，除各个参加其他团体的工作外，复由谢六逸，朱应鹏，徐蔚南三人发起，……集会讨论。在十月六日下午三点钟，已陆续到了东亚食堂，……略进茶点，即开始讨论，颇多发挥，……最后定名为上海文艺界救国会”云。

We still don't know how to "play", but according to the method in front of us, it seems that we first watch "Two Parents' Family Tour of Africa" to nourish our strength, then watch the "Patriotic Song and Dance Performance" to get excited, and then watch "Selected Japanese Sketches" and "Three Words of Art" and play with a little refreshment. Then, China is saved.不成。这恐怕不必文学青年，就是文学小囡囡，也未必会相信。没有法子，只得再加上两个另外的好消息，就是目前的爱国文艺家所主宰的《申报》所发表出来的——
Not. I'm afraid this doesn't have to be a literary youth, even a literary girl, and they may not believe it. There is no way, so I have to add two other good news, which is the "Declaration" dominated by the current patriotic writers and artists -十月五日的《自由谈》里叶华女士云：“无办法之国民，如何有有办法之政府。国联绝望矣。……际兹一发千钧，全国国民宜各立所志，各尽所能，各抒所见，余也不才，谨以战犬问题商诸国人。……各犬中，要以德国警犬最称职，余极主张吾国可选择是犬作战……”
In the October 5 issue of "Freedom Talk", Ms. Ye Hua said: "How can there be a government with a way for a people who have no way?
