Serve the country with your feet今年八月三十一日《申报》的《自由谈》里，又看见了署名“寄萍”的《杨缦华女士游欧杂感》，其中的一段，我觉得很有趣，就照抄在下面：
In the "Free Talk" of the "Declaration" on August 31 this year, I saw "Ms. Yang Manhua's Miscellaneous Feelings about Ms. Yang Manhua's Travel to Europe" signed "Ji Ping", one of which I think is very interesting, so I copied it below:“……有一天我们到比利时一个乡村里去。许多女人争着来看我的脚。我伸起脚来给伊们看。才平服伊们好奇的疑窦。一位女人说‘我们也向来不曾见过中国人。但从小就听说中国人是有尾巴的（即辫发）。都要讨姨太太的。女人都是小脚。跑起路来一摇一摆的。如今才明白这话不确实。请原谅我们的错念。’还有一人自以为熟悉东亚情形的，带着讥笑的态度说：‘中国的军阀如何专横。到处闹的是兵匪。人民过着地狱的生活。’这种似是而非的话，说了一大堆。我说‘此种传说。全无根据。’同行的某君，也报以很滑稽的话。‘我看你们那里会知道立国数千年的大中华民国，等我们革命成功之后，简直要把显微镜来照你们比利时呢。’就此一笑而散。”
“…… One day we went to a village in Belgium. Many women rushed to see my feet. I stretched out my feet and showed them them. Only then did they settle their curious doubts. One woman said, 'We have never seen Chinese either.' But since childhood I heard that Chinese people have tails (i.e. braided hair). I have to ask my aunt. Women have small feet. It swayed when it ran. Only now do I realize that this is not true. Please forgive us for our mistakes. Another person who thought he was familiar with the situation in East Asia said with a sneer: 'How arrogant the Chinese warlords are. There were soldiers and bandits everywhere. The people lived a hellish life. This kind of plausible thing said a lot. I said, 'This kind of legend. It's completely unfounded. A certain gentleman who was traveling with me also replied that it was very funny. I think you will know the Republic of China, which has been established for thousands of years, and after our revolution succeeds, we will simply shine a microscope on your Belgium. They laughed and dispersed. ”我们的杨女士虽然用她的尊脚征服了比利时女人，为国增光，但也有两点“错念”。其一，是我们中国人的确有过尾巴（即辫发）的，缠过小脚的，讨过姨太太的，虽现在也在讨。其二，是杨女士的脚不能代表一切中国女人的脚，正如留学的女生不能代表一切中国的女性一般。留学生大多数是家里有钱，或由政府派遣，为的是将来给家族或国家增光，贫穷和受不到教育的女人怎么能同日而语。所以，虽在现在，其实是缠着小脚，“跑起路来一摇一摆的”女人还不少。
Although our Ms. Yang conquered Belgian women with her dignified feet and added glory to the country, she also had two "wrong thoughts". First, we Chinese do have tails (i.e., braided hair), wrapped small feet, and begged for aunts, although they are still begging for them. Second, Ms. Yang's feet cannot represent all Chinese women's feet, just as girls studying abroad cannot represent all Chinese women. Most of the international students are rich in their families or sent by the government in order to add glory to their families or countries in the future. Therefore, although it is now, there are still many women who are wrapped around their little feet and "run and sway".至于困苦，那是用不着多谈，只要看同一的《申报》上，记载着多少“呼吁和平”的文电，多少募集急赈的广告，多少兵变和绑票的记事，留学外国的少爷小姐们虽然相隔太远，可以说不知道，但既然能想到用显微镜，难道就不能想到用望远镜吗？况且又何必用望远镜呢，同一的《杨缦华女士游欧杂感》里就又说：
As for hardship, there is no need to talk about it, as long as you look at the same "Declaration", how many "call for peace" are recorded, how many advertisements for urgent relief, how many mutiny and kidnapping notes, although the young masters and ladies studying abroad are too far apart, it can be said that they don't know, but since they can think of using a microscope, can't they think of using a telescope? Besides, why use a telescope, the same "Ms. Yang Manhua's Miscellaneous Feelings in Europe" said:“……据说使领馆的穷困，不自今日始。不过近几年来，有每况愈下之势。譬如逢到我国国庆或是重大纪念日，照例须招待外宾，举行盛典，意思是庆祝国运方兴，兼之联络各友邦的感情。以前使领馆必备盛宴，款待上宾，到了去年，为馆费支绌，改行茶会，以目前的形势推测，将后恐怕连茶会都开不成呢。在国际上最讲究体面的，要算日本国，他们政府行政费的预算，宁可特别节省，惟独于驻外使领馆的经费，十分充足。单就这一点来比较，我们已相形见拙了。”
“…… It is said that the poverty of the embassy and consulate does not begin today. However, in recent years, there has been a trend of deterioration. For example, on our country's National Day or major anniversaries, foreign guests must be entertained and grand ceremonies must be held as usual, which means to celebrate the prosperity of the national fortune and to contact the feelings of various friends. In the past, the embassy and consulate had a must-have feast to entertain distinguished guests, but last year, due to the shortage of embassy fees, the tea party was changed. The most decent thing in the world is Japan, and their government budget for administrative expenses is preferably saved, but the funds of embassies and consulates abroad are very sufficient. In this comparison alone, we are already dwarfed. ”使馆和领事馆是代表本国，如杨女士所说，要“庆祝国运方兴”的，而竟有“每况愈下之势”，孟子曰，“百姓不足，君孰与足？”则人民的过着什么生活，也就可想而知了。然而小国比利时的女人们究竟是单纯的，终于请求了原谅，假使她们真“知道立国数千年的大中华民国”的国民，往往有自欺欺人的不治之症，那可真是没有面子了。
Embassies and consulates represent their own countries, as Ms. Yang said, to "celebrate the rise of the national fortune", but there is actually a "deteriorating trend", Mencius said, "The people are insufficient, who is the king and the king?" Then you can imagine what kind of life the people live. However, the women of the small country of Belgium were innocent and finally asked for forgiveness, and if they really "knew the Republic of China, which has been founded for thousands of years", often had an incurable disease of self-deception, then it was really faceless.假如这样，又怎么办呢？我想，也还是“就此一笑而散”罢。
If so, what should we do? I think it's better to "laugh it off and leave".

《夏娃日记》小引

《夏娃日记》小引

《夏娃日记》小引

A small introduction to "Eve's Diary"玛克·土温（Mark Twain）无须多说，只要一翻美国文学史，便知道他是前世纪末至现世纪初有名的幽默家（Humorist）。不但一看他的作品，要令人眉开眼笑，就是他那笔名，也含有一些滑稽之感的。
Needless to say, Mark Twain is a famous humorist from the end of the last century to the beginning of the present century. Not only does it make people smile when they look at his works, but even his pseudonym also contains some funny feelings.他本姓克莱门斯（Samuel Langhorne Clemens，1835—1910），原是一个领港，在发表作品的时候，便取量水时所喊的讹音，用作了笔名。作品很为当时所欢迎，他即被看作讲笑话的好手；但到一九一六年他的遗著《The Mysterious Stranger》一出版，却分明证实了他是很深的厌世思想的怀抱者了。
His original surname was Samuel Langhorne Clemens (1835-1910), and he was originally a pilot, and when he published his works, he took the mispronunciation shouted when measuring water and used it as a pseudonym. His works were very popular at the time, and he was regarded as a good joke teller; But by 1916, when his posthumous book "The Mysterious Stranger" was published, it was clearly confirmed that he was a deeply world-weary person.含着哀怨而在嘻笑，为什么会这样的？
Laughing with grief, why is this happening?我们知道，美国出过亚伦·坡（Edgar Allan Poe），出过霍桑（N．Hawthorne），出过惠德曼（W．Whitman），都不是这么表里两样的。然而这是南北战争以前的事。这之后，惠德曼先就唱不出歌来，因为这之后，美国已成了产业主义的社会，个性都得铸在一个模子里，不再能主张自我了。如果主张，就要受迫害。这时的作家之所注意，已非应该怎样发挥自己的个性，而是怎样写去，才能有人爱读，卖掉原稿，得到声名。连有名如荷惠勒（W．D．Howells）的，也以为文学者的能为世间所容，是在他给人以娱乐。于是有些野性未驯的，便站不住了，有的跑到外国，如詹谟士（Henry James），有的讲讲笑话，就是玛克·土温。
We know that the United States has produced Edgar Allan Poe, N. Hawthorne, and W. Whitman, and they are not so different. However, this was before the Civil War. After that, Whitman couldn't sing at first, because after that, the United States had become an industrialist society, and its personality had to be cast in a mold, and it could no longer assert itself. If you claim it, you will be persecuted. At this time, the writer's attention is not how to give full play to his personality, but how to write, so that people can love to read, sell the original manuscript, and gain fame. Even famous people like W.D. Howells think that the reason why literary scholars can be accepted by the world is that they entertain people. So some wild and untamed people couldn't stand still, some ran to foreign countries, such as Henry James, and some told jokes, that is, Mark Twain.那么，他的成了幽默家，是为了生活，而在幽默中又含着哀怨，含着讽刺，则是不甘于这样的生活的缘故了。因为这一点点的反抗，就使现在新土地里的儿童，还笑道：玛克·土温是我们的。
Then, he became a humorist for life, and there is sadness and irony in humor, which is because he is not willing to live such a life. Because of this little resistance, the children in the new land now laughed and said: Mark Twain is ours.这《夏娃日记》（Eve's Diary）出版于一九〇六年，是他的晚年之作，虽然不过一种小品，但仍是在天真中露出弱点，叙述里夹着讥评，形成那时的美国姑娘，而作者以为是一切女性的肖像，但脸上的笑影，却分明是有了年纪的了。幸而靠了作者的纯熟的手腕，令人一时难以看出，仍不失为活泼泼地的作品；又得译者将丰神传达，而且朴素无华，几乎要令人觉得倘使夏娃用中文来做日记，恐怕也就如此一样：更加值得一看了。
This "Eve's Diary" (Eve's Diary) was published in 1906 and is his later work, although it is just a sketch, but it still shows weaknesses in innocence, and the narrative is interspersed with ridicule, forming the American girl at that time, and the author thinks it is a portrait of all women, but the smile on the face is clearly old. Fortunately, relying on the author's skillful skills, it is difficult to see for a while, but it is still a lively work; The translator conveys the abundance of spirits, and it is unpretentious, almost making people think that if Eve had made a diary in Chinese, it would have been the same: it would be even more worth reading.莱勒孚（Lester Ralph）的五十余幅白描的插图，虽然柔软，却很清新，一看布局，也许很容易使人记起中国清季的任渭长的作品，但他所画的是仙侠高士，瘦削怪诞，远不如这些的健康；而且对于中国现在看惯了斜眼削肩的美女图的眼睛，也是很有澄清的益处的。
Lester Ralph's more than fifty white illustrations, although soft, are very fresh, at a glance at the layout, it may be easy to remember the works of Ren Weichang in the Qing Dynasty of China, but what he paints is Xianxia Gaoshi, thin and grotesque, far less healthy than these; And for the eyes of Chinese people who are now accustomed to seeing beautiful pictures with slanted eyes and shaved shoulders, it is also very beneficial to clarify.一九三一年九月二十七夜，记。

新的“女将”

新的“女将”

The new "female general"在上海制图版，比别处便当，也似乎好些，所以日报的星期附录画报呀，书店的什么什么月刊画报呀，也出得比别处起劲。这些画报上，除了一排一排的坐着大人先生们的什么什么会开会或闭会的纪念照片而外，还一定要有“女士”。
In Shanghai, the cartographic board seems to be better than other places, so the weekly appendix pictorial of the daily newspaper and the monthly pictorial of the bookstore are also more energetic than other places. In addition to the commemorative photos of adults and gentlemen sitting in rows at the meeting or closing meeting, there must also be "ladies" on these pictorials.“女士”的尊容，为什么要绍介于社会的呢？我们只要看那说明，就可以明白了。例如：
Why should the dignity of "ladies" be introduced to society? We only need to look at the explanation to understand. For example:“A女士，B女校皇后，性喜音乐。”
"Ms. A, the queen of the girls' school, love music."“C女士，D女校高材生，爱养叭儿狗。”

Let's look at the costume: spring is all fashion, tight and narrow sleeves; In the summer, the trouser hem and sleeves were removed, and sitting on the seashore was called "sea bathing", and the weather was hot, which was supposed to be; In autumn, the weather was cold, but the Japanese soldiers invaded the three eastern provinces, so the pictorial appeared in the pictorial with white gowns and nurses, or ladies in military uniforms with guns.这是可以使读者喜欢的，因为富于戏剧性。中国本来喜欢玩把戏，乡下的戏台上，往往挂着一副对子，一面是“戏场小天地”，一面是“天地大戏场”。做起戏来，因为是乡下，还没有《乾隆帝下江南》之类，所以往往是《双阳公主追狄》，《薛仁贵招亲》，其中的女战士，看客称之为“女将”。她头插雉尾，手执双刀（或两端都有枪尖的长枪），一出台，看客就看得更起劲。明知不过是做做戏的，然而看得更起劲了。
This is something that readers can like because it is full of drama. China originally liked to play tricks, and on the stage in the countryside, there was often a pair hanging, one side was the "small world of the theater" and the other side was the "big theater of heaven and earth". When it comes to playing, because it is a countryside, there is no such thing as "Emperor Qianlong Goes to Jiangnan", so it is often "Princess Shuangyang Chasing Di", "Xue Rengui Recruiting Relatives", and the female soldiers in it, the audience calls them "female generals". She has a pheasant tail on her head and holds a double knife (or a spear with a spear at both ends), and as soon as she comes out, the spectators watch more energetically. Knowing that it was just a show, but watching it was more energetic.练了多年的军人，一声鼓响，突然都变了无抵抗主义者。于是远路的文人学士，便大谈什么“乞丐杀敌”，“屠夫成仁”，“奇女子救国”一流的传奇式古典，想一声锣响，出于意料之外的人物来“为国增光”。而同时，画报上也就出现了这些传奇的插画。但还没有提起剑仙的一道白光，总算还是切实的。
Soldiers who have been practicing for many years, with a drumbeat, suddenly become non-resisters. So the literati and scholars who traveled far away talked about the first-class legendary classics of "beggars killing the enemy", "butchers becoming benevolent", and "strange women saving the country". At the same time, these legendary illustrations also appeared in pictorials. But there was not a single white light from the sword immortal yet, and it was finally real.但愿不要误解。我并不是说，“女士”们都得在绣房里关起来；我不过说，雄兵解甲而密斯托枪，是富于戏剧性的而已。
I hope don't get me wrong. I am not saying that the "ladies" have to be locked up in the embroidery room; I'm just saying that the male soldiers disarm and the mist guns, which is full of drama.还有事实可以证明。一，谁也没有看见过日本的“惩膺中国军”的看护队的照片；二，日本军里是没有女将的。然而确已动手了。这是因为日本人是做事是做事，做戏是做戏，决不混合起来的缘故。

宣传与做戏

宣传与做戏

宣传与做戏

Publicity and acting就是那刚刚说过的日本人，他们做文章论及中国的国民性的时候，内中往往有一条叫作“善于宣传”。看他的说明，这“宣传”两字却又不像是平常的“Propaganda”，而是“对外说谎”的意思。
It is the Japanese I just mentioned, when they make articles about China's national character, there is often one of them called "good at propaganda". Looking at his explanation, the word "propaganda" does not seem like the usual "Propaganda", but means "lying to the outside world".这宗话，影子是有一点的。譬如罢，教育经费用光了，却还要开几个学堂，装装门面；全国的人们十之九不识字，然而总得请几位博士，使他对西洋人去讲中国的精神文明；至今还是随便拷问，随便杀头，一面却总支撑维持着几个洋式的“模范监狱”，给外国人看看。还有，离前敌很远的将军，他偏要大打电报，说要“为国前驱”。连体操班也不愿意上的学生少爷，他偏要穿上军装，说是“灭此朝食”。
In this case, there is a little shadow. For example, the education fund is exhausted, but a few schools are still needed to open and decorate the façade; Nine out of ten people in the country are illiterate, but they always have to invite a few doctors to tell Westerners about China's spiritual civilization; To this day, it is still casually tortured and beheaded, but on the one hand, it always supports and maintains several Western-style "model prisons" for foreigners to see. However, there is still a little shadow of these; How many schools, how many doctors, how many model prisons, how many electrifications, and how many sets of military uniforms. So it is not right to say that it is "lying". This is what I call "acting".但这普遍的做戏，却比真的做戏还要坏。真的做戏，是只有一时；戏子做完戏，也就恢复为平常状态的。杨小楼做《单刀赴会》，梅兰芳做《黛玉葬花》，只有在戏台上的时候是关云长，是林黛玉，下台就成了普通人，所以并没有大弊。倘使他们扮演一回之后，就永远提着青龙偃月刀或锄头，以关老爷，林妹妹自命，怪声怪气，唱来唱去，那就实在只好算是发热昏了。
But this common acting is worse than real acting. Really acting is only temporary; After the actor finished the play, he returned to his normal state. Yang Xiaolou did "Single Knife Meeting", Mei Lanfang did "Daiyu Funeral Flowers", only when he was on the stage, it was Guan Yunchang, it was Lin Daiyu, and he became an ordinary person when he stepped down, so there was no big problem. If they play it once, they will always carry the Qinglong Yanyue knife or hoe, call themselves Master Guan and Sister Lin, and sing around in strange voices, then they will really have to be fever and faint.不幸因为是“天地大戏场”，可以普遍的做戏者，就很难有下台的时候，例如杨缦华女士用自己的天足，踢破小国比利时女人的“中国女人缠足说”，为面子起见，用权术来解围，这还可以说是很该原谅的。但我以为应该这样就拉倒。现在回到寓里，做成文章，这就是进了后台还不肯放下青龙偃月刀；而且又将那文章送到中国的《申报》上来发表，则简直是提着青龙偃月刀一路唱回自己的家里来了。难道作者真已忘记了中国女人曾经缠脚，至今也还有正在缠脚的么？还是以为中国人都已经自己催眠，觉得全国女人都已穿了高跟皮鞋了呢？
For example, Ms. Yang Manhua used her natural feet to kick through the "Chinese women's foot binding theory" of Belgian women in a small country, and for the sake of face, she used power techniques to relieve the siege, which can be said to be very forgivable. But I thought I should pull it down like this. Now back in the apartment and making an article, this is when I enter the backstage and refuse to put down the Qinglong Yanyue Knife; And when he sent the article to China's "Declaration" for publication, he simply sang all the way back to his home with the Qinglong Yanyue Knife. Has the author really forgotten that Chinese women used to bind their feet, and there are still people who are binding their feet? Or do you think that Chinese people have hypnotized themselves and think that women all over the country have worn high-heeled leather shoes?这不过是一个例子罢了，相像的还多得很，但恐怕不久天也就要亮了。
This is just an example, there are many similarities, but I'm afraid the sky will be bright soon.

Professor Liu Wendian, president of Anhui University, was imprisoned for many days because he did not call himself "chairman", and it was easy to hand over the bail.也没有人问他“垂询”些什么。

几条“顺”的翻译

几条“顺”的翻译

几条“顺”的翻译

Several translations of "Shun"在这一个多年之中，拚死命攻击“硬译”的名人，已经有了三代：首先是祖师梁实秋教授，其次是徒弟赵景深教授，最近就来了徒孙杨晋豪大学生。但这三代之中，却要算赵教授的主张最为明白而且彻底了，那精义是——
In the past few years, there have been three generations of celebrities who desperately attacked "hard translation": the first is the ancestor Professor Liang Shiqiu, the second is the apprentice Professor Zhao Jingshen, and recently the apprentice Yang Jinhao college student has come. But among these three generations, Professor Zhao's proposition is the clearest and most thorough, and the essence is -“与其信而不顺，不如顺而不信。”
“与其信而不顺，不如顺而不信。 ”这一条格言虽然有些希奇古怪，但对于读者是有效力的。因为“信而不顺”的译文，一看便觉得费力，要借书来休养精神的读者，自然就会佩服赵景深教授的格言。至于“顺而不信”的译文，却是倘不对照原文，就连那“不信”在什么地方都不知道。然而用原文来对照的读者，中国有几个呢。这时候，必须读者比译者知道得更多一点，才可以看出其中的错误，明白那“不信”的所在。否则，就只好胡里胡涂的装进脑子里去了。我对于科学是知道得很少的，也没有什么外国书，只好看看译本，但近来往往遇见疑难的地方。随便举几个例子罢。《万有文库》里的周太玄先生的《生物学浅说》里，有这样的一句——
Although this maxim is a bit strange, it is effective for readers. Because the translation of "believe but not follow" feels laborious at first glance, readers who want to borrow books to recuperate their spirits will naturally admire Professor Zhao Jingshen's maxims. As for the translation of "obedience and unbelief", if you do not compare it with the original text, even the "disbelief" does not know where it is. However, there are several readers in China who use the original text to compare. At this time, the reader must know a little more than the translator in order to see the error and understand the "unbelief". Otherwise, I have no choice but to put it in my head. I know very little about science, and I don't have any foreign books, so I have to look at translations, but I often encounter difficult things recently. Just give a few examples. In Mr. Zhou Taixuan's "Brief Explanation of Biology" in "Wanyou Library", there is such a sentence -“最近如尼尔及厄尔两氏之对于麦……”
"Recently, as Neil and Earl have done to McT......"据我所知道，在瑞典有一个生物学名家Nilsson-Ehle是考验小麦的遗传的，但他是一个人而兼两姓，应该译作“尼尔生厄尔”才对。现在称为“两氏”，又加了“及”，顺是顺的，却很使我疑心是别的两位了。不过这是小问题，虽然，要讲生物学，连这些小节也不应该忽略，但我们姑且模模胡胡罢。
As far as I know, there is a famous biologist in Sweden who tested the genetics of wheat, but he is a person with two surnames, which should be translated as "Nilsson-Ehle". Now it is called "two clans", and "and" is added, which is smooth, but it makes me very suspicious that it is the other two. But this is a small problem, although if you want to talk about biology, even these subsections should not be ignored, but let's just ignore it.今年的三月号《小说月报》上冯厚生先生译的《老人》里，又有这样的一句——
In the March issue of "Novel Monthly" this year, Mr. Feng Housheng's translation of "The Old Man" has this sentence -“他由伤寒病变为流行性的感冒（Influenza）的重病……”
"He went from typhoid fever to a serious illness of Influenza......"这也是很“顺”的，但据我所知道，流行性感冒并不比伤寒重，而且一个是呼吸系病，一个是消化系病，无论你怎样“变”，也“变”不过去的。须是“伤风”或“中寒”，这才变得过去。但小说不比《生物学浅说》，我们也姑且模模胡胡罢。这回另外来看一个奇特的实验。
This is also very "smooth", but as far as I know, influenza is not worse than typhoid fever, and one is a respiratory disease and the other is a digestive disease. It must be "cold" or "moderate cold" to become a pass. But the novel is not as good as "Biology", so let's just imitate it. This time let's look at another peculiar experiment.这一种实验，是出在何定杰及张志耀两位合译的美国Conklin所作的《遗传与环境》里面的。那译文是——
This kind of experiment is from "Genetics and Environment" co-translated by He Dingjie and Zhang Zhiyao in the United States. The translation is—“……他们先取出兔眼睛内髓质之晶体，注射于家禽，等到家禽眼中生成一种‘代晶质’，足以透视这种外来的蛋白质精以后，再取出家禽之血清，而注射于受孕之雌兔。雌兔经此番注射，每不能堪，多遭死亡，但是他们的眼睛或晶体并不见有若何之伤害，并且他们卵巢内所蓄之卵，亦不见有什么特别之伤害，因为就他们以后所生的小兔看来，并没有生而具残缺不全之眼者。”
“…… They first took out the crystals of the medulla in the rabbit's eyes and injected them into the poultry, and waited until a 'substitute crystal' was formed in the eyes of the poultry, which was enough to see through this foreign protein essence, and then took out the poultry serum and injected it into the pregnant female rabbit. After this injection, the female rabbits were often unable to bear it and often died, but their eyes or crystals were not harmed, and the eggs stored in their ovaries did not cause any special damage, because as far as the rabbits they gave birth to later were concerned, they were not born with incomplete eyes. ”这一段文章，也好像是颇“顺”，可以懂得的。但仔细一想，却不免不懂起来了。一，“髓质之晶体”是什么？因为水晶体是没有髓质皮质之分的。二，“代晶质”又是什么？三，“透视外来的蛋白质”又是怎么一回事？我没有原文能对，实在苦恼得很，想来想去，才以为恐怕是应该改译为这样的——
This article also seems to be quite "smooth" and understandable. But if you think about it carefully, you can't help but understand. 1. What is the "medullary crystal"? Because the lens is not divided into medullary cortex. Second, what is "generation crystalline"? 3. What is the matter of "seeing through foreign proteins"? I don't have the original text to get it right, I was really distressed, and after thinking about it, I thought that I should probably change it to this——“他们先取兔眼内的制成浆状（以便注射）的水晶体，注射于家禽，等到家禽感应了这外来的蛋白质（即浆状的水晶体）而生‘抗晶质’（即抵抗这浆状水晶体的物质）。然后再取其血清，而注射于怀孕之雌兔。……”
"They first took the slurry (for injection) crystals in the rabbit's eyes and injected them into poultry, and when the poultry sensed the foreign protein (i.e., the slurry crystal) and produced 'anticrystalline' (i.e., the substance that resists the slurry crystal). The serum is then taken and injected into the pregnant female rabbit. ……”以上不过随手引来的几个例，此外情随事迁，忘却了的还不少，有许多为我所不知道的，那自然就都溜过去，或者照样错误地装在我的脑里了。但即此几个例子，我们就已经可以决定，译得“信而不顺”的至多不过看不懂，想一想也许能懂，译得“顺而不信”的却令人迷误，怎样想也不会懂，如果好像已经懂得，那么你正是入了迷途了。
The above are just a few examples that were casually attracted, and there are many things that I have forgotten, and there are many things that I don't know, so naturally they all slip by, or they are still mistakenly put in my head. But in these few examples, we can already decide that the translation of "believing but not believing" is at most incomprehensible, thinking about it, you may be able to understand, but the translation of "obedient but not believing" is misleading, no matter how you think about it, you will not understand, if you seem to understand, then you are lost.

风马牛

风马牛

Wind horses and cattle主张“顺而不信”译法的大将赵景深先生，近来却并没有译什么大作，他大抵只在《小说月报》上，将“国外文坛消息”，来介绍给我们。这自然是很可感谢的。那些消息，是译来的呢，还是介绍者自去打听来，研究来的？我们无从捉摸。即使是译来的罢，但大抵没有说明出处，我们也无从考查。自然，在主张“顺而不信”译法的赵先生，这是都不必注意的，如果有些“不信”，倒正是贯彻了宗旨。
Mr. Zhao Jingshen, a general who advocates the translation of "obedience and not belief", has not translated any masterpieces recently, and he has probably only introduced "foreign literary news" to us in the "Novel Monthly". This is naturally very grateful. Were those news translated, or were they inquired and studied by the introducer himself? We are unpredictable. Even if it is translated, it probably does not indicate the source, and we have no way to verify it. Naturally, Mr. Zhao, who advocates the translation of "obedience and not believing", does not need to pay attention to this, if there is some "disbelief", it is the implementation of the purpose.然而，疑难之处，我却还是遇到的。
However, I still encountered difficulties.在二月号的《小说月报》里，赵先生将“新群众作家近讯”告诉我们，其一道：“格罗泼已将马戏的图画故事《Alay Oop》脱稿。”这是极“顺”的，但待到看见了这本图画，却不尽是马戏。借得英文字典来，将书名下面注着的两行英文“Life and Love Among the Acrobats Told Entirely in Pictures”查了一通，才知道原来并不是“马戏”的故事，而是“做马戏的戏子们”的故事。这么一说，自然，有些“不顺”了。但内容既然是这样的，另外也没有法子想。必须是“马戏子”，这才会有“Love”。
In the February issue of Novel Monthly, Mr. Zhao told us about the "New Mass Writer News", one of which was: "Gropp has undrafted the circus picture story "Alay Oop". This is very "smooth", but when I saw this picture, it was not all a circus. Borrowing an English dictionary, I looked up the two lines of English "Life and Love Among the Acrobats Told Entirely in Pictures" under the title of the book, and found out that it was not the story of "circus", but the story of "circus actors". Saying this, naturally, it was a little "unsmooth". But since the content is like this, there is no way to think about it. It must be a "circus" for there to be "Love".《小说月报》到了十一月号，赵先生又告诉了我们“塞意斯完成四部曲”，而且“连最后的一册《半人半牛怪》（Der Zentaur）也已于今年出版”了。这一下“Der”，就令人眼睛发白，因为这是茄门话，就是想查字典，除了同济学校也几乎无处可借，那里还敢发生什么贰心。然而那下面的一个名词，却不写尚可，一写倒成了疑难杂症。这字大约是源于希腊的，英文字典上也就有，我们还常常看见用它做画材的图画，上半身是人，下半身却是马，不是牛。牛马同是哺乳动物，为了要“顺”，固然混用一回也不关紧要，但究竟马是奇蹄类，牛是偶蹄类，有些不同，还是分别了好，不必“出到最后的一册”的时候，偏来“牛”一下子的。
In the November issue of "Novel Monthly", Mr. Zhao told us that "Seyce completed the tetralogy" and that "even the last volume, Der Zentaur, was published this year." This "Der" makes people's eyes turn white, because this is the Qimen dialect, that is, I want to look up the dictionary, except for Tongji School, there is almost nowhere to borrow, and there is no second thought. However, the following noun is not written as acceptable, and it has become an intractable disease. This word is probably of Greek origin, and it is also found in the English dictionary, and we often see pictures of people using it as painting materials, the upper body is a person, but the lower body is a horse, not a cow. This is very similar to a literal translation or a "hard translation", but in fact, it is not the case, and it is also a "cow" for no reason. There must be coincidences, but Mrs. Zeus is a very jealous goddess. As soon as she found out, the (?) After being furious, they took the child to heaven to see if the opportunity was to kill him. However, the child was naïve, he didn't know it, once, touched Mrs. Zhou's nipple, he sucked it, the wife was surprised, pushed him, and fell into the world, not only was he not killed, but later became a hero. But Mrs. Zhou's milk was sucked out because of this, spurted out, and flew into the sky, becoming the Milk Galaxy, which is the "Milk Road",—— no, it is actually the "Divine Milk Road". 再来一条“顺”的翻译

再来一条“顺”的翻译

再来一条“顺”的翻译

Another translation of "smooth"这“顺”的翻译出现的时候，是很久远了；而且是大文学家和大翻译理论家，谁都不屑注意的。但因为偶然在我所搜集的“顺译模范文大成”稿本里，翻到了这一条，所以就再来一下子。
When this translation of "Shun" appeared, it was a long time ago; And he is a great writer and a great translation theorist, and no one disdains to pay attention. But because I happened to turn to this one in the manuscript of "Shun Translation Model Wen Dacheng" that I collected, I will do it again.却说这一条，是出在中华民国十九年八月三日的《时报》里的，在头号字的《针穿两手……》这一个题目之下，做着这样的文章：
However, this article was published in the "Times" of August 3, the 19th year of the Republic of China, under the title of "Needle Piercing Two Hands......", which made such an article:“被共党捉去以钱赎出由长沙逃出之中国商人，与从者二名，于昨日避难到汉，彼等主仆，均鲜血淋漓，语其友人曰，长沙有为共党作侦探者，故多数之资产阶级，于廿九日晨被捕，予等系于廿八夜捕去者，即以针穿手，以秤秤之，言时出其两手，解布以示其所穿之穴，尚鲜血淋漓。……（汉口二日电通电）”
“被共党捉去以钱赎出由长沙逃出之中国商人，与从者二名，于昨日避难到汉，彼等主仆，均鲜血淋漓，语其友人曰，长沙有为共党作侦探者，故多数之资产阶级，于廿九日晨被捕，予等系于廿八夜捕去者，即以针穿手，以秤秤之，言时出其两手，解布以示其所穿之穴，尚鲜血淋漓。 …… （汉口二日电通电）”这自然是“顺”的，虽然略一留心，即容或会有多少可疑之点。譬如罢，其一，主人是资产阶级，当然要“鲜血淋漓”的了，二仆大概总是穷人，为什么也要一同“鲜血淋漓”的呢？其二，“以针穿手，以秤秤之”干什么，莫非要照斤两来定罪名么？但是，虽然如此，文章也还是“顺”的，因为在社会上，本来说得共党的行为是古里古怪；况且只要看过《玉历钞传》，就都知道十殿阎王的某一殿里，有用天秤来秤犯人的办法，所以“以秤秤之”，也还是毫不足奇。只有秤的时候，不用称钩而用“针”，却似乎有些特别罢了。
This is naturally "smooth", although if you pay a little attention, there may be a lot of suspicious points. For example, first, the master is a bourgeoisie, of course he must be "bloody", and the second servant is probably always poor, so why should he be "bloody" together? Second, what is the purpose of "piercing the hand with a needle and weighing it with a scale", is it necessary to convict according to the pound? However, despite this, the article is still "smooth", because in society, the behavior of the Communist Party is ancient and strange; Moreover, as long as you have read the "Jade Calendar Banknote", you know that in a certain hall of the Ten Halls of Yama, there is a method of using scales to weigh prisoners, so it is not surprising to "weigh it with a scale". When there is only a scale, there is no need to weigh the hook but use a "needle", but it seems to be a little special.幸而，我在同日的一种日本文报纸《上海日报》上，也偶然见到了电通社的同一的电报，这才明白《时报》是因为译者不拘拘于“硬译”，而又要“顺”，所以有些不“信”了。倘若译得“信而不顺”一点，大略是应该这样的：
Fortunately, I also happened to see the same telegram from Dentsu News Agency in a Japanese newspaper "Shanghai Daily" on the same day, and then I realized that the "Times" was a little "unbelievable" because the translator was not bound by "hard translation" but wanted to "follow it". If the translation is a little "believe but not smooth", it should be roughly like this:“……彼等主仆，将为恐怖和鲜血所渲染之经验谈，语该地之中国人曰，共产军中，有熟悉长沙之情形者，……予等系于廿八日之半夜被捕，拉去之时，则在腕上刺孔，穿以铁丝，数人或数十人为一串。言时即以包着沁血之布片之手示之……”
“…… Their masters and servants will talk about the experience of terror and blood, and tell the Chinese there that there are people in the communist army who are familiar with the situation in Changsha,...... We were arrested in the middle of the night on the 28th, and when we were taken away, we had holes in our wrists pierced and wires threaded through them, and several or dozens of people were strung together. When he spoke, he showed him his hand covered in blood......这才分明知道，“鲜血淋漓”的并非“彼等主仆”，乃是他们的“经验谈”，两位仆人，手上实在并没有一个洞。穿手的东西，日本文虽然写作“针金”，但译起来须是“铁丝”，不是“针”，针是做衣服的。至于“以秤秤之”，却连影子也没有。
Only then did I clearly know that it was not "their master and servant" who were "bloody", but their "experience talk", and the two servants really did not have a hole in their hands. Although the Japanese word for "needle" is written as "needle", it must be translated as "wire", not "needle", and the needle is used to make clothes. As for "weighing it with a scale", there is not even a shadow.我们的“友邦”好友，顶喜欢宣传中国的古怪事情，尤其是“共党”的；四年以前，将“裸体游行”说得像煞有介事，于是中国人也跟着叫了好几个月。其实是，警察用铁丝穿了殖民地的革命党的手，一串一串的牵去，是所谓“文明”国民的行为，中国人还没有知道这方法，铁丝也不是农业社会的产品。从唐到宋，因为迷信，对于“妖人”虽然曾有用铁索穿了锁骨，以防变化的法子，但久已不用，知道的人也几乎没有了。文明国人将自己们所用的文明方法，硬栽到中国来，不料中国人却还没有这样文明，连上海的翻译家也不懂，偏不用铁丝来穿，就只照阎罗殿上的办法，“秤”了一下完事。
Our "friendly" friends like to promote China's weird things, especially the "Communist"; Four years ago, the "nude parade" was described as a serious matter, so the Chinese also followed suit for several months. In fact, the police pierced the hands of the revolutionary party in the colonies with wires and led them one by one, which was the behavior of the so-called "civilized" citizens, and the Chinese did not know this method, and the wire was not a product of the agricultural society. From the Tang Dynasty to the Song Dynasty, because of superstition, although the "demons" had used iron cables to pierce the collarbone to prevent changes, they had not been used for a long time, and almost no one knew about them. The civilized people planted their civilized methods in China, but the Chinese did not yet have such a civilization, and even the translators in Shanghai did not understand it, so they did not use wires to wear them, so they only "weighed" the matter according to the method on the Yama Hall.造谣的和帮助造谣的，一下子都显出本相来了。
Those who spread rumors and those who help spread rumors all of a sudden showed their true colors.

中华民国的新“堂·吉诃德”们

The new "Don Quixote" of the Republic of China十六世纪末尾的时候，西班牙的文人西万提斯做了一大部小说叫作《堂·吉诃德》，说这位吉先生，看武侠小说看呆了，硬要去学古代的游侠，穿一身破甲，骑一匹瘦马，带一个跟丁，游来游去，想斩妖服怪，除暴安良。谁知当时已不是那么古气盎然的时候了，因此只落得闹了许多笑话，吃了许多苦头，终于上个大当，受了重伤，狼狈回来，死在家里，临死才知道自己不过一个平常人，并不是什么大侠客。
At the end of the sixteenth century, the Spanish literati Sivantes made a large novel called "Don Quixote", saying that this Mr. Ji, who was stunned by martial arts novels, insisted on learning from the ancient rangers, wearing torn armor, riding a thin horse, and taking a follower, swimming around, wanting to kill monsters and eliminate violence and peace. Who knew that it was not such an ancient time at that time, so he only ended up with a lot of jokes, suffered a lot, and finally got a big fool, was seriously injured, came back in embarrassment, died at home, and before he died, he realized that he was just an ordinary person, not a hero.这一个古典，去年在中国曾经很被引用了一回，受到这个谥法的名人，似乎还有点很不高兴的样子。其实是，这种书呆子，乃是西班牙书呆子，向来爱讲“中庸”的中国，是不会有的。西班牙人讲恋爱，就天天到女人窗下去唱歌，信旧教，就烧杀异端，一革命，就捣烂教堂，踢出皇帝。然而我们中国的文人学子，不是总说女人先来引诱他，诸教同源，保存庙产，宣统在革命之后，还许他许多年在宫里做皇帝吗？
This classic was quoted once in China last year, and the celebrities who received this posthumous title seemed to be a little unhappy. In fact, this kind of nerd is a Spanish nerd, and China, which has always loved to talk about "moderation", will not exist. When the Spaniards talk about love, they go to women's windows every day to sing, believe in the old religion, burn heretics, and destroy churches and kick out the emperor as soon as there is a revolution. However, don't we Chinese literati always say that women come to seduce him first, that all religions have the same origin, preserve temple property, and that after the revolution, Xuantong allowed him to be emperor in the palace for many years?记得先前的报章上，发表过几个店家的小伙计，看剑侠小说入了迷，忽然要到武当山去学道的事，这倒很和“堂·吉诃德”相像的。但此后便看不见一点后文，不知道是也做出了许多奇迹，还是不久就又回到家里去了？以“中庸”的老例推测起来，大约以回了家为合式。
I remember that in the previous newspaper, a young man from a few shops published a story about reading a swordsman novel and suddenly going to Wudang Mountain to learn Taoism, which is very similar to "Don Quixote". But after that, I couldn't see a little bit of the afterword, I don't know if he also did many miracles, or did he return home soon? Based on the old example of "moderation", it is estimated that it is about to go home.这以后的中国式的“堂·吉诃德”的出现，是“青年援马团”。不是兵，他们偏要上战场；政府要诉诸国联，他们偏要自己动手；政府不准去，他们偏要去；中国现在总算有一点铁路了，他们偏要一步一步的走过去；北方是冷的，他们偏只穿件夹袄；打仗的时候，兵器是顶要紧的，他们偏只着重精神。这一切等等，确是十分“堂·吉诃德”的了。然而究竟是中国的“堂·吉诃德”，所以他只一个，他们是一团；送他的是嘲笑，送他们的是欢呼；迎他的是诧异，而迎他们的也是欢呼；他驻扎在深山中，他们驻扎在真茹镇；他在磨坊里打风磨，他们在常州玩梳篦，又见美女，何幸如之（见十二月《申报》《自由谈》）。其苦乐之不同，有如此者，呜呼！
After that, the emergence of the Chinese-style "Don Quixote" was the "Youth Horse Aid Group". Not soldiers, they prefer to go to the battlefield; The government wants to resort to the League of Nations, and they prefer to do it themselves; The government is not allowed to go, they want to go; China finally has a little railway now, and they have to go step by step; It is cold in the north, and they only wear jackets; When fighting, weapons are the most important, and they only focus on spirit. All this and so on are indeed very "Don Quixote". However, it is China's "Don Quixote", so he is only one, they are a group; What is given to him is ridicule, and what is given to them is cheering; He was greeted with surprise, and cheered as he greeted them; He was stationed in the deep mountains, and they were stationed in Zhenru Town; He was grinding in the mill, they were playing with the comb in Changzhou, and they saw beautiful women, how lucky they were (see "Declaration" and "Free Talk" in December). The difference in joy and sorrow between them is like this, alas!不错，中外古今的小说太多了，里面有“舆榇”，有“截指”，有“哭秦庭”，有“对天立誓”。耳濡目染，诚然也不免来抬棺材，砍指头，哭孙陵，宣誓出发的。然而五四运动时胡适之博士讲文学革命的时候，就已经要“不用古典”，现在在行为上，似乎更可以不用了。
Yes, there are too many novels in ancient and modern China and abroad, including "coffin", "amputated fingers", "crying Qin Ting", and "swearing to heaven". 《野草》英文译本序

Preface to the English translation of "Wild Grass"冯Y．S．先生由他的友人给我看《野草》的英文译本，并且要我说几句话。可惜我不懂英文，只能自己说几句。但我希望，译者将不嫌我只做了他所希望的一半的。
Mr. Feng Y.S. showed me the English translation of "Weeds" by his friend and asked me to say a few words. Unfortunately, I don't understand English, so I can only say a few words myself. But I hope that the translator will not think that I have only done half of what he hoped.这二十多篇小品，如每篇末尾所注，是一九二四至二六年在北京所作，陆续发表于期刊《语丝》上的。大抵仅仅是随时的小感想。因为那时难于直说，所以有时措辞就很含糊了。
These more than 20 essays, as noted at the end of each article, were written in Beijing from 1924 to 26 and were successively published in the journal "Yusi". It's probably just a small impression at any time. Because it was difficult to say it directly at that time, sometimes the wording was very vague.现在举几个例罢。因为讽刺当时盛行的失恋诗，作《我的失恋》，因为憎恶社会上旁观者之多，作《复仇》第一篇，又因为惊异于青年之消沉，作《希望》。《这样的战士》，是有感于文人学士们帮助军阀而作。《腊叶》，是为爱我者的想要保存我而作的。段祺瑞政府枪击徒手民众后，作《淡淡的血痕中》，其时我已避居别处；奉天派和直隶派军阀战争的时候，作《一觉》，此后我就不能住在北京了。
Let's give a few examples. Because of the satire of the popular lovelorn poems at that time, he wrote "My Broken Love", because he hated the number of bystanders in society, he wrote the first article of "Revenge", and because he was amazed by the depression of youth, he wrote "Hope". "Such a Warrior" was written in response to the literati and scholars helping the warlords. "La Ye" is made for those who love me to save me. After the Duan Qirui government shot unarmed people, he wrote "In the Light Bloodstains", at that time I had taken refuge elsewhere; During the warlord war between the Fengtian faction and the Zhili faction, I wrote "One Awakening", and I couldn't live in Beijing after that.所以，这也可以说，大半是废弛的地狱边沿的惨白色小花，当然不会美丽。但这地狱也必须失掉。这是由几个有雄辩和辣手，而那时还未得志的英雄们的脸色和语气所告诉我的。我于是作《失掉的好地狱》。
Therefore, it can also be said that most of them are pale white flowers on the edge of the ruined hell, and of course they will not be beautiful. But this hell must also be lost. This was told to me by the faces and tones of several eloquent and hot-handed heroes who were not yet successful at that time. So I wrote "The Good Hell Lost".后来，我不再作这样的东西了。日在变化的时代，已不许这样的文章，甚而至于这样的感想存在。我想，这也许倒是好的罢。为译本而作的序言，也应该在这里结束了。
Later, I stopped doing such things. In the era of daily change, such articles are no longer allowed, and even such feelings exist. I think this may be a good thing. The preface to the translation should also end here.十一月五日。

Long live the "intellectual workers"“劳动者”这句话成了“罪人”的代名词，已经足足四年了。压迫罢，谁也不响；杀戮罢，谁也不响；文学上一提起这句话，就有许多“文人学士”和“正人君子”来笑骂，接着又有许多他们的徒子徒孙来笑骂。劳动者呀劳动者，真要永世不得翻身了。

Laborers, laborers, really never turn over.不料竟又有人记得你起来。
Unexpectedly, someone remembered you again.不料帝国主义老爷们还嫌党国屠杀得不赶快，竟来亲自动手了，炸的炸，轰的轰。称“人民”为“反动分子”，是党国的拿手戏，而不料帝国主义老爷也有这妙法，竟称不抵抗的顺从的党国官军为“贼匪”，大加以“膺惩”！冤乎枉哉，这真有些“顺”“逆”不分，玉石俱焚之慨了！

Calling "people" "reactionaries" is the specialty of the party and the state, but unexpectedly, the imperialist master also had this wonderful method, and even called the unresisting and obedient party-state officials and soldiers "bandits" and "punished"! What is "intellect"? What is "labor"? What are you doing when you "contact"? Where is the "necessary"? Putting aside these things for the time being, manual workers without "intellect" cannot control them.“亲爱的劳动者”呀！你们再替这些高贵的“智识劳动者”起来干一回罢！给他们仍旧可以坐在房里“劳动”他们那高贵的“智识”。即使失败，失败的也不过是“体力”，“智识”还在着的！
"Dear laborers"! You should stand up and do it for these noble "intellectual workers" again! Give them the ability to still sit in the room and "labor" their noble "intellect". Even if you fail, what fails is only "physical strength", and "intellect" is still there!“智识”劳动者万岁！
Long live the "intellectual" workers!

Answer questions from middle school students“假如先生面前站着一个中学生，处此内忧外患交迫的非常时代，将对他讲怎样的话，作努力的方针？”
"If there is a middle school student standing in front of you, in this extraordinary era of internal and external troubles, what kind of words will you say to him and make an effort policy?"编辑先生：
Mr. Editor:请先生也许我回问你一句，就是：我们现在有言论的自由么？假如先生说“不”，那么我知道一定也不会怪我不作声的。假如先生竟以“面前站着一个中学生”之名，一定要逼我说一点，那么，我说：第一步要努力争取言论的自由。
Please sir, maybe I will ask you back, that is: Do we have freedom of speech now? If the gentleman says "no", then I know that I will not blame me for being silent. If the teacher actually insists on forcing me to say something in the name of "a middle school student standing in front of me", then I say: The first step is to strive for freedom of speech.

答北斗杂志社问——创作要怎样才会好？

答北斗杂志社问——创作要怎样才会好？

答北斗杂志社问——创作要怎样才会好？

Answer Beidou Magazine's question - how can creation be good?编辑先生：
Mr. Editor:来信的问题，是要请美国作家和中国上海教授们做的，他们满肚子是“小说法程”和“小说作法”。我虽然做过二十来篇短篇小说，但一向没有“宿见”，正如我虽然会说中国话，却不会写“中国语法入门”一样。不过高情难却，所以只得将自己所经验的琐事写一点在下面——
The question of the letter was to be asked by American writers and professors in Shanghai, China, who were full of "novel methods" and "novel methods". Although I have written more than 20 short stories, I have never had "prejudices", just as although I can speak Chinese, I will not write "Introduction to Chinese Grammar". However, it is difficult to refuse, so I have to write down a little bit of the trivial things I have experienced below——一，留心各样的事情，多看看，不看到一点就写。
First, pay attention to all kinds of things, read more, and write if you don't see a little.二，写不出的时候不硬写。
Second, don't write hard when you can't write.三，模特儿不用一个一定的人，看得多了，凑合起来的。
Third, the model does not need a certain person, he has seen a lot and made do.四，写完后至少看两遍，竭力将可有可无的字，句，段删去，毫不可惜。宁可将可作小说的材料缩成Sketch，决不将Sketch材料拉成小说。
Fourth, read it at least twice after writing, and try your best to delete dispensable words, sentences, and paragraphs, without regret. I would rather reduce the material that can be written into Sketch than pull the Sketch material into a novel.五，看外国的短篇小说，几乎全是东欧及北欧作品，也看日本作品。
Fifth, read foreign short stories, almost all of which are Eastern European and Nordic works, but also Japanese works.六，不生造除自己之外，谁也不懂的形容词之类。
Sixth, do not create adjectives that no one understands except yourself.七，不相信“小说作法”之类的话。
7. Don't believe in words like "novel practice".八，不相信中国的所谓“批评家”之类的话，而看看可靠的外国批评家的评论。
8. Don't believe the so-called "critics" in China, but look at the comments of reliable foreign critics.现在所能说的，如此而已。此复，即请
That's all I can say now. This reply, please do so编安！
Edit An!十二月二十七日。
December 27th.

LetterL．S．先生：
Mr. L.S.:要这样冒昧地麻烦先生的心情，是抑制得很久的了，但像我们心目中的先生，大概不会淡漠一个热忱青年的请教的吧。这样几度地思量之后，终于唐突地向你表示我们在文艺上——尤其是短篇小说上的迟疑和犹豫了。
It has been suppressed for a long time to take the liberty of troublening Mr. like this, but like the gentleman in our minds, he probably would not be indifferent to the advice of an enthusiastic young man. After thinking about it several times, I finally abruptly show you our hesitation and hesitation in literature and art, especially in short stories.我们曾手写了好几篇短篇小说，所采取的题材：一个是专就其熟悉的小资产阶级的青年，把那些在现时代所显现和潜伏的一般的弱点，用讽刺的艺术手腕表示出来；一个是专就其熟悉的下层人物——在现时代大潮流冲击圈外的下层人物，把那些在生活重压下强烈求生的欲望的朦胧反抗的冲动，刻划在创作里面。——不知这样内容的作品，究竟对现时代，有没有配说得上有贡献的意义？我们初则迟疑，继则提起笔又犹豫起来了。这须请先生给我们一个指示，因为我们不愿意在文艺上的努力，对于目前的时代，成为白费气力，毫无意义的。
We have written several short stories by hand, and the subject matter is that one is dedicated to the petty-bourgeois youth they are familiar with, expressing with satirical artistic skills those general weaknesses that appear and lurk in the present era; One is to depict in the creation the vague impulse of those who are strongly willing to survive under the pressure of life. ——I wonder if works with such content have the significance of contributing to the current era? We hesitated at first, and then picked up the pen and hesitated again. This requires the gentleman to give us an instruction, because our unwillingness to make literary and artistic efforts has become a waste of effort and meaningless for the present era.我们决定在这一个时代里，把我们的精力放在有意义的文艺上，借此表示我们应有的助力和贡献，并不是先生所说的那一辈略有小名，便去而之他的文人。因此，目前如果先生愿给我们以指示，这指示便会影响到我们终身的。虽然也曾看见过好些普罗作家的创作，但总不愿把一些虚构的人物使其翻一个身就革命起来，却喜欢捉几个熟悉的模特儿，真真实实地刻划出来——这脾气是否妥当，确又没有十分的把握了。所以三番五次的思维，只有冒昧地来唐突先生了。即祝
We decided to focus our energy on meaningful literature and art in this era, so as to show that we should help and contribute, not the generation that Mr. said with a slight nickname, so we went to his literati. Therefore, if you wish to give us instructions, this instruction will affect us for life. Although I have seen the creations of many ordinary writers, I am always reluctant to revolutionize some fictional characters, but I like to catch a few familiar models and portray them realistically - I am not very sure whether this temper is appropriate. So after thinking again and again, I can only take the liberty of coming to Mr. Tang Tu. He prayed近好！
Close to good!Ts－c．Y．及Y－f．T．上　十一月廿九日。
Ts-c.Y. and Y-f.T. on November 29.

关于小说题材的通信

回信

关于小说题材的通信

replyY及T先生：
Mr. Y and Mr. T:接到来信后，未及回答，就染了流行性感冒，头重眼肿，连一个字也不能写，近几天总算好起来了，这才来写回信。同在上海，而竟拖延到一个月，这是非常抱歉的。
After receiving the letter, before I could answer, I contracted the flu, my head was heavy and my eyes were swollen, and I couldn't even write a word. I'm very sorry to be in Shanghai and delayed for a month.两位所问的，是写短篇小说的时候，取来应用的材料的问题。而作者所站的立场，如信上所写，则是小资产阶级的立场。如果是战斗的无产者，只要所写的是可以成为艺术品的东西，那就无论他所描写的是什么事情，所使用的是什么材料，对于现代以及将来一定是有贡献的意义的。为什么呢？因为作者本身便是一个战斗者。
The two of them asked about the material used when writing short stories. The position of the author, as written in the letter, is that of the petty bourgeoisie. If he is a proletarian in battle, as long as what he writes can become a work of art, then no matter what he describes or what materials he uses, it must be of great significance to the present and the future. Why? Because the author himself is a fighter.但两位都并非那一阶级，所以当动笔之先，就发生了来信所说似的疑问。我想，这对于目前的时代，还是有意义的，然而假使永是这样的脾气，却是不妥当的。
But neither of them was of that class, so when they started writing, questions like those mentioned in the letter arose. I think this is still meaningful for the current era, but if it is always such a temper, it is inappropriate.别阶级的文艺作品，大抵和正在战斗的无产者不相干。小资产阶级如果其实并非与无产阶级一气，则其憎恶或讽刺同阶级，从无产者看来，恰如较有聪明才力的公子憎恨家里的没出息子弟一样，是一家子里面的事，无须管得，更说不到损益。例如法国的戈兼，痛恨资产阶级，而他本身还是一个道道地地资产阶级的作家。倘写下层人物（我以为他们是不会“在现时代大潮流冲击圈外”的）罢，所谓客观其实是楼上的冷眼，所谓同情也不过空虚的布施，于无产者并无补助。而且后来也很难言。例如也是法国人的波特莱尔，当巴黎公社初起时，他还很感激赞助，待到势力一大，觉得于自己的生活将要有害，就变成反动了。但就目前的中国而论，我以为所举的两种题材，却还有存在的意义。如第一种，非同阶级是不能深知的，加以袭击，撕其面具，当比不熟悉此中情形者更加有力。如第二种，则生活状态，当随时代而变更，后来的作者，也许不及看见，随时记载下来，至少也可以作这一时代的记录。所以对于现在以及将来，还是都有意义的。不过即使“熟悉”，却未必便是“正确”，取其有意义之点，指示出来，使那意义格外分明，扩大，那是正确的批评家的任务。
The literary and artistic works of other classes are probably irrelevant to the fighting proletarians. If the petty bourgeoisie is not actually in harmony with the proletariat, it hates or satirizes the same class, and from the point of view of the proletariat, just as a more intelligent young man hates the unproductive children in the family, there is no need to control the affairs of the family, let alone profit and loss. For example, Gogan in France hates the bourgeoisie, and he himself is a true bourgeois writer. If you write about the lower class of characters (I don't think they will be "outside the circle of the current trend"), the so-called objectivity is actually the cold eyes of the upper floor, and the so-called sympathy is nothing more than empty almsgiving, and it does not help the proletariat. And it was hard to say later. For example, Baudelaire, who was also French, was very grateful for the sponsorship when the Paris Commune first rose, and when he became powerful, he felt that his life would be harmful, so he became reactionary. But as far as China is concerned, I think the two themes mentioned still have the meaning of existence. For example, in the first case, non-class people cannot know it well, and attacking and tearing off their masks should be more powerful than those who are not familiar with this situation. For example, the state of life should change with the times, and later authors may not have time to see it, but it can be recorded at any time, at least it can be recorded as a record of this era. So it is still meaningful for the present and the future. However, even if it is "familiar", it may not be "correct", and it is the task of the correct critic to take its meaningful points, indicate them, and make the meaning particularly clear and expanded.因此我想，两位是可以各就自己现在能写的题材，动手来写的。不过选材要严，开掘要深，不可将一点琐屑的没有意思的事故，便填成一篇，以创作丰富自乐。这样写去，到一个时候，我料想必将觉得写完，——虽然这样的题材的人物，即使几十年后，还有作为残滓而存留，但那时来加以描写刻划的，将是别一种作者，别一样看法了。然而两位都是向着前进的青年，又抱着对于时代有所助力和贡献的意志，那时也一定能逐渐克服自己的生活和意识，看见新路的。
Therefore, I think that the two of you can each write about the topics you can write about now. However, the selection of materials should be strict, the excavation should be deep, and a little trivial and boring accident should not be filled into an article to enrich oneself with creation. Writing like this, at some point, I expect to feel that I have finished writing,—— although the characters of such a subject will still remain as remnants even decades later, but at that time, it will be a different kind of author who will describe and portray them, and they will have a different opinion. However, both of them are young people who are moving forward, and they have the will to help and contribute to the times, and they will definitely be able to gradually overcome their lives and consciousness and see a new path at that time.总之，我的意思是：现在能写什么，就写什么，不必趋时，自然更不必硬造一个突变式的革命英雄，自称“革命文学”；但也不可苟安于这一点，没有改革，以致沉没了自己——也就是消灭了对于时代的助力和贡献。此复，即颂
In short, what I mean is: what can be written now, there is no need to follow the trends, and naturally there is no need to create a mutant revolutionary hero and call himself "revolutionary literature"; But we must not settle for this, without reform, so that we sink ourselves - that is, to eliminate the help and contribution to the times. This reply is a song近佳。
Recently, it was good.L．S．启。十二月二十五日。
L.S. Qi. December 25th.

Dear comrades,你译的《毁灭》出版，当然是中国文艺生活里面的极可纪念的事迹。翻译世界无产阶级革命文学的名著，并且有系统的介绍给中国读者，（尤其是苏联的名著，因为它们能够把伟大的十月，国内战争，五年计画的“英雄”，经过具体的形象，经过艺术的照耀，而供献给读者。）——这是中国普罗文学者的重要任务之一。虽然，现在做这件事的，差不多完全只是你个人和Z同志的努力；可是，谁能够说：这是私人的事情？！谁？！《毁灭》《铁流》等等的出版，应当认为一切中国革命文学家的责任。每一个革命的文学战线上的战士，每一个革命的读者，应当庆祝这一个胜利；虽然这还只是小小的胜利。
The publication of your translation of "Destruction" is, of course, a very memorable deed in Chinese literary and artistic life. Translating the famous works of the world's proletarian revolutionary literature and systematically introducing them to Chinese readers, (especially the famous works of the Soviet Union, because they can dedicate the "heroes" of the great October, the civil war, and the five-year plan to readers through concrete images and the illumination of art.) This is one of the important tasks of Chinese popular writers. Although, what you are doing now is almost entirely the efforts of you and Comrade Z; But who can say: this is a private matter?! Who?! The publication of "Destruction", "Tie Liu", etc. should be considered the responsibility of all Chinese revolutionary writers. Every soldier on the literary front of the revolution and every reader of the revolution should celebrate this victory; Although this is only a small victory.你的译文，的确是非常忠实的，“决不欺骗读者”这一句话，决不是广告！这也可见得一个诚挚，热心，为着光明而斗争的人，不能够不是刻苦而负责的。二十世纪的才子和欧化名士可以用“最少的劳力求得最大的”声望；但是，这种人物如果不彻底的脱胎换骨，始终只是“纱笼”（Salon）里的哈叭狗。现在粗制滥造的翻译，不是这班人干的，就是一些书贾的投机。你的努力——我以及大家都希望这种努力变成团体的，——应当继续，应当扩大，应当加深。所以我也许和你自己一样，看着这本《毁灭》，简直非常的激动：我爱它，像爱自己的儿女一样。咱们的这种爱，一定能够帮助我们，使我们的精力增加起来，使我们的小小的事业扩大起来。
Your translation is indeed very faithful, and the phrase "never deceive readers" is by no means an advertisement! This also shows that a sincere, enthusiastic, and person who fights for the light cannot be hard and responsible. The talents and European celebrities of the twentieth century can use "the least labor to get the greatest" prestige; However, if this kind of character is not completely reborn, it will always be just a dog in the "Salon". Nowadays, shoddy translations are either done by these people or speculated by some booksellers. Your efforts, which I and all of us hope to become a community,—— should continue, expand, deepen. So I may be like yourself, looking at this book "Destruction", I am simply very excited: I love it like my own children. Our love will definitely help us, increase our energy, and expand our small career.翻译——除出能够介绍原本的内容给中国读者之外——还有一个很重要的作用：就是帮助我们创造出新的中国的现代言语。中国的言语（文字）是那么穷乏，甚至于日常用品都是无名氏的。中国的言语简直没有完全脱离所谓“姿势语”的程度——普通的日常谈话几乎还离不开“手势戏”。自然，一切表现细腻的分别和复杂的关系的形容词，动词，前置词，几乎没有。宗法封建的中世纪的余孽，还紧紧的束缚着中国人的活的言语，（不但是工农群众！）这种情形之下，创造新的言语是非常重大的任务。欧洲先进的国家，在二三百年四五百年以前已经一般的完成了这个任务。就是历史上比较落后的俄国，也在一百五六十年以前就相当的结束了“教堂斯拉夫文”。他们那里，是资产阶级的文艺复兴运动和启蒙运动做了这件事。例如俄国的洛莫洛莎夫……普希金。中国的资产阶级可没有这个能力。固然，中国的欧化的绅商，例如胡适之之流，开始了这个运动。但是，这个运动的结果等于它的政治上的主人。因此，无产阶级必须继续去彻底完成这个任务，领导这个运动。翻译，的确可以帮助我们造出许多新的字眼，新的句法，丰富的字汇和细腻的精密的正确的表现。因此，我们既然进行着创造中国现代的新的言语的斗争，我们对于翻译，就不能够不要求：绝对的正确和绝对的中国白话文。这是要把新的文化的言语介绍给大众。
Translation—in addition to introducing the original content to Chinese readers—also has a very important role: it helps us create a new modern Chinese language. Chinese language (writing) is so poor that even daily necessities are anonymous. Chinese language is not completely separated from the so-called "posture language" - ordinary daily conversation is almost inseparable from "gesture play". Naturally, all adjectives, verbs, prepositions, which express delicate distinctions and complex relationships, are almost none. The remnants of the patriarchal feudal Middle Ages still tightly bind the living language of the Chinese, (not only the workers and peasants!). In this case, creating new words is a very important task. Advanced European countries have generally completed this task two or three hundred years ago, four or five hundred years ago. Even Russia, which was relatively backward in history, also ended the "church Slavonic" quite a year ago 150 or 60 years ago. There, it was the bourgeois Renaissance and Enlightenment movements that did this. For example, Lomo Loshav in Russia...... Pushkin. The Chinese bourgeoisie does not have this ability. Of course, China's Europeanized gentry merchants, such as Hu Shizhi and others, started this movement. However, the result of this movement is equal to its political master. Therefore, the proletariat must continue to complete this task and lead the movement. Translation can indeed help us create many new words, new syntax, rich vocabulary and delicate and precise correct expressions. Therefore, since we are engaged in the struggle to create a new language for modern China, we cannot fail to demand absolute correctness and absolute Chinese vernacular for translation. This is to introduce the language of a new culture to the public.严几道的翻译，不用说了。他是：

The literature must be from the Xia and Yin dynasties.其实，他是用一个“雅”字打消了“信”和“达”。最近商务还翻印“严译名著”，我不知道这是“是何居心”！这简直是拿中国的民众和青年来开玩笑。古文的文言怎么能够译得“信”，对于现在的将来的大众读者，怎么能够“达”！
In fact, he used the word "Ya" to dispel "Xin" and "Da". Recently, the business has also reprinted the "Yan Yi Masterpiece", I don't know what this is "what is the intention"! This is simply a joke about the Chinese people and youth. How can the ancient Chinese be translated as "faith", and how can it be "reached" for the current and future mass readers!现在赵景深之流，又来要求：
Now Zhao Jingshen and others have come to demand again:宁错而务顺，
Rather be wrong than smooth,毋拗而仅信！
Don't be stubborn, just believe it!赵老爷的主张，其实是和城隍庙里演说西洋故事的，一鼻孔出气。这是自己懂得了（？）外国文，看了些书报，就随便拿起笔来乱写几句所谓通顺的中国文。这明明白白的欺侮中国读者，信口开河的来乱讲海外奇谈。第一，他的所谓“顺”，既然是宁可“错”一点儿的“顺”，那么，这当然是迁就中国的低级言语而抹杀原意的办法。这不是创造新的言语，而是努力保存中国的野蛮人的言语程度，努力阻挡它的发展。第二，既然要宁可“错”一点儿，那就是要朦蔽读者，使读者不能够知道作者的原意。所以我说：赵景深的主张是愚民政策，是垄断智识的学阀主义，——一点儿也没有过分的。还有，第三，他显然是暗示的反对普罗文学（好个可怜的“特殊走狗”）！他这是反对普罗文学，暗指着普罗文学的一些理论著作的翻译和创作的翻译。这是普罗文学敌人的话。
Master Zhao's proposition was actually to speak Western stories with the City God Temple, and he was angry with one nostril. This is something I understand (?) After reading some books and newspapers, I casually picked up a pen and wrote a few so-called smooth Chinese sentences. This is a clear bullying of Chinese readers, and they are talking nonsense about overseas stories. First, since his so-called "smooth" is a "smooth" that would rather be "wrong", then this is of course a way to accommodate China's low-level words and erase the original meaning. This is not about creating new speech, but about trying to preserve the level of speech of China's barbarians and try to stop its development. Second, since it is better to be "wrong", it is to obscure the reader, so that the reader cannot know the author's original intention. So I said: Zhao Jingshen's proposition is the policy of ignoring the people, and it is the monopoly of intellectual factionalism,—— which is not excessive at all. And, thirdly, he is clearly implicitly against popular literature (what a poor "special lackey")! He is opposed to popular literature, alluding to the translation and creation of some theoretical works of popular literature. These are the words of the enemy of popular literature.但是，普罗文学的中文书籍之中，的确有许多翻译是不“顺”的。这是我们自己的弱点，敌人乘这个弱点来进攻。我们的胜利的道路当然不仅要迎头痛打，打击敌人的军队，而且要更加整顿自己的队伍。我们的自己批评的勇敢，常常可以解除敌人的武装。现在，所谓翻译论战的结论，我们的同志却提出了这样的结语：
However, among the Chinese books of popular literature, there are indeed many translations that are not "smooth". This is our own weakness, and the enemy takes advantage of this weakness to attack. Of course, our road to victory must not only fight head-on and strike the enemy's army, but also further reorganize our ranks. The courage of our own criticism can often disarm the enemy. Now, at the conclusion of the so-called translation debate, our comrades put forward the following conclusion:“翻译绝对不容许错误。可是，有时候，依照译品内容的性质，为着保存原作精神，多少的不顺，倒可以容忍。”
"There is no room for error in translation. However, sometimes, according to the nature of the content of the translation, in order to preserve the spirit of the original, some inadequacies can be tolerated. ”这是只是个“防御的战术”。而蒲力汗诺夫说：辩证法的唯物论者应当要会“反守为攻”。第一，当然我们首先要说明：我们所认识的所谓“顺”，和赵景深等所说的不同。第二，我们所要求的是：绝对的正确和绝对的白话。所谓绝对的白话，就是朗诵起来可以懂得的。第三，我们承认：一直到现在，普罗文学的翻译还没有做到这个程度，我们要继续努力。第四，我们揭穿赵景深等自己的翻译，指出他们认为是“顺”的翻译，其实只是梁启超和胡适之交媾出来的杂种——半文不白，半死不活的言语，对于大众仍旧是不“顺”的。
This is just a "defensive tactic". Pulkhanov said: Dialectical materialists should be able to "turn defense into attack". First, of course, we must first explain: the so-called "smooth" we know is different from what Zhao Jingshen and others said. Second, what we demand is: absolute correctness and absolute vernacular. The so-called absolute vernacular is what can be understood by recitation. Third, we admit that until now, the translation of popular literature has not reached this level, and we must continue to work hard. Fourth, we debunk Zhao Jingshen and others' translations, pointing out that the translations they think are "smooth" are actually just hybrids made by Liang Qichao and Hu Shizhi - half-literate, half-dead words, which are still not "smooth" for the public.这里，讲到你最近出版的《毁灭》，可以说：这是做到了“正确”，还没有做到“绝对的白话”。
Here, when it comes to your recently published "Destruction", it can be said that this has been done "correctly", but it has not yet achieved "absolute vernacular".翻译要用绝对的白话，并不就不能够“保存原作的精神”。固然，这是很困难，很费功夫的。但是，我们是要绝对不怕困难，努力去克服一切的困难。
If the translation must be in absolute vernacular, it does not mean that it is impossible to "preserve the spirit of the original work". Of course, this is very difficult and labor-intensive. However, we must be absolutely not afraid of difficulties and strive to overcome all difficulties.一般的说起来，不但翻译，就是自己的作品也是一样，现在的文学家，哲学家，政论家，以及一切普通人，要想表现现在中国社会已经有的新的关系，新的现象，新的事物，新的观念，就差不多人人都要做“仓颉”。这就是说，要天天创造新的字眼，新的句法。实际生活的要求是这样。难道一九二五年初我们没有在上海小沙渡替群众造出“罢工”这一个字眼吗？还有“游击队”，“游击战争”，“右倾”，“左倾”，“尾巴主义”，甚至于普通的“团结”，“坚决”，“动摇”等等等类……这些说不尽的新的字眼，渐渐的容纳到群众的口头上的言语里去了，即使还没有完全容纳，那也已经有了可以容纳的可能了。讲到新的句法，比较起来要困难一些，但是，口头上的言语里面，句法也已经有了很大的改变，很大的进步。只要拿我们自己演讲的言语和旧小说里的对白比较一下，就可以看得出来。可是，这些新的字眼和句法的创造，无意之中自然而然的要遵照着中国白话的文法公律。凡是“白话文”里面，违反这些公律的新字眼，新句法，——就是说不上口的——自然淘汰出去，不能够存在。
Generally speaking, not only translations, but also their own works, today's writers, philosophers, political commentators, and all ordinary people, if they want to express the new relationships, new phenomena, new things, and new concepts that already exist in Chinese society, almost everyone has to do "Cangjie". This means that new words and syntax must be created every day. The requirements of practical life are like this. Didn't we coin the word "strike" for the masses in Xiaoshadu in Shanghai at the beginning of 1925? There are also "guerrillas", "guerrilla warfare", "right-leaning", "left-leaning", "tail-ism", and even ordinary "unity", "resolute", "wavering" and so on...... These indescribable new words have gradually been accepted into the verbal words of the masses, and even if they have not yet been fully accommodated, they are already possible to accommodate them. When it comes to new syntax, it is more difficult to compare, but in oral speech, the syntax has also changed a lot and made great progress. Just compare the words of our own speeches with the dialogues in old novels. However, the creation of these new words and syntax inadvertently and naturally follows the grammatical public laws of the Chinese vernacular. In the "vernacular text", new words and new syntax that violate these public laws ,—— just unpalatable - they are naturally eliminated and cannot exist.所以说到什么是“顺”的问题，应当说：真正的白话就是真正通顺的现代中国文，这里所说的白话，当然不限于“家务琐事”的白话，这是说：从一般人的普通谈话，直到大学教授的演讲的口头上的白话。中国人现在讲哲学，讲科学，讲艺术……显然已经有了一个口头上的白话。难道不是如此？如果这样，那么，写在纸上的说话（文字），就应当是这一种白话，不过组织得比较紧凑，比较整齐罢了。这种文字，虽然现在还有许多对于一般识字很少的群众，仍旧是看不懂的，因为这种言语，对于一般不识字的群众，也还是听不懂的。——可是，第一，这种情形只限于文章的内容，而不在文字的本身，所以，第二，这种文字已经有了生命，它已经有了可以被群众容纳的可能性。它是活的言语。
Therefore, when it comes to the question of what is "smooth", it should be said: the real vernacular is the truly smooth modern Chinese, and the vernacular spoken here is of course not limited to the vernacular of "housework", which means that from the ordinary conversation of ordinary people to the verbal vernacular of university professors' speeches. Chinese now talk about philosophy, science, and art...... Apparently there is already a verbal vernacular. Isn't that so? If this is the case, then the speech (text) written on paper should be this kind of vernacular, but it is more compactly organized and neat. Although there are still many people who are very literate in this kind of writing, they still cannot understand it, because this kind of speech is still incomprehensible to the general illiterate masses. ——However, first, this situation is limited to the content of the article, not to the text itself, so second, this kind of text has come to life, and it already has the possibility of being accepted by the masses. It is living speech.所以，书面上的白话文，如果不注意中国白话的文法公律，如果不就着中国白话原来有的公律去创造新的，那就很容易走到所谓“不顺”的方面去。这是在创造新的字眼新的句法的时候，完全不顾普通群众口头上说话的习惯，而用文言做本位的结果。这样写出来的文字，本身就是死的言语。
Therefore, if the written vernacular does not pay attention to the grammatical public laws of the Chinese vernacular, and if we do not create new ones based on the original public laws of the Chinese vernacular, it is easy to go to the so-called "unsmooth" side. This is the result of creating new words and new syntax, completely ignoring the habits of ordinary people speaking orally, and using classical Chinese as the standard. The words written in this way are dead words in themselves.因此，我觉得对于这个问题，我们要有勇敢的自己批评的精神，我们应当开始一个新的斗争。你以为怎么样？
Therefore, I think we must have a brave spirit of self-criticism on this issue, and we should start a new struggle. What do you think?我的意见是：翻译应当把原文的本意，完全正确的介绍给中国读者，使中国读者所得到的概念等于英俄日德法……读者从原文得来的概念，这样的直译，应当用中国人口头上可以讲得出来的白话来写。为着保存原作的精神，并用不着容忍“多少的不顺”。相反的，容忍着“多少的不顺”（就是不用口头上的白话），反而要多少的丧失原作的精神。
My opinion is that the translation should introduce the original meaning of the original text to Chinese readers completely and correctly, so that the concepts obtained by Chinese readers are equal to those of English, Russian, Japanese, German and French...... The concept that the reader gets from the original text, such a literal translation, should be written in the vernacular that the Chinese can speak orally. In order to preserve the spirit of the original work, there is no need to tolerate "how much trouble". On the contrary, tolerating "how much disturbance" (that is, not using verbal vernacular) will lead to a loss of the spirit of the original work.当然，在艺术的作品里，言语上的要求是更加苛刻，比普通的论文要更加来得精细。这里有各种人不同的口气，不同的字眼，不同的声调，不同的情绪，……并且这并不限于对白。这里，要用穷乏的中国口头上的白话来应付，比翻译哲学，科学……的理论著作，还要来得困难。但是，这些困难只不过愈加加重我们的任务，可并不会取消我们的这个任务的。
Of course, in works of art, the verbal requirements are more demanding, and they are more refined than ordinary papers. There are all kinds of people with different tones, different words, different tones, different emotions,...... And it's not limited to dialogue. Here, it is necessary to deal with the poor Chinese oral vernacular, rather than translating philosophy and science...... Theoretical works are still difficult. (In this paragraph, if there is an error in your translation, it will be particularly "unsmooth".) Please proofread these translations in Japanese and German to see if they are correct literal translations. My translations, except for the syntax and rhetoric of the Chinese vernacular, are inverted compared to the original text, or the subject, verb, and object are repeated, and in addition, they are completely literal.这里，举一个例：第（八）条“……甚至于比他自己还要亲近。”这句话的每一个字母都和俄文相同的。同时，这在口头上说起来的时候，原文的口气和精神完全传达得出。而你的译文：“较之自己较之别人，还要亲近的人们”，是有错误的（也许是日德文的错误）。错误是在于：（一）丢掉了“甚至于”这一个字眼；（二）用了中国文言的文法，就不能够表现那句话的神气。
Here, let's give an example: Article (8) "...... Even closer than himself. Every letter of this sentence is the same as in Russian. At the same time, when this is said orally, the tone and spirit of the original text are fully conveyed. The mistake lies in: (1) losing the word "even"; (2) If you use the grammar of Chinese classical Chinese, you will not be able to express the spirit of that sentence.所有这些话，我都这样不客气的说着，仿佛自称自赞的。对于一班庸俗的人，这自然是“没有礼貌”。但是，我们是这样亲密的人，没有见面的时候就这样亲密的人。这种感觉，使我对于你说话的时候，和对自己说话一样，和自己商量一样。
All these words, I said unceremoniously, as if I was self-praised. For a group of vulgar people, this is naturally "rude". However, we are such close people, people who are so close when we don't meet. Furthermore, there is another example, which is more important, not only about translation methods. This is the "new...... of Article (1) people".《毁灭》的主题是新的人的产生。这里，茀理契以及法捷耶夫自己用的俄文字眼，是一个普通的“人”字的单数。不但不是人类，而且不是“人”字的复数。这意思是指着革命，国内战争……的过程之中产生着一种新式的人，一种新的“路数”（Type）——文雅的译法叫做典型，这是在全部《毁灭》里面看得出来的。现在，你的译文，写着“人类”。莱奋生渴望着一种新的……人类。这可以误会到另外一个主题。仿佛是一般的渴望着整个的社会主义的社会。而事实上，《毁灭》的“新人”，是当前的战斗的迫切的任务：在斗争过程之中去创造，去锻炼，去改造成一种新式的人物，和木罗式加，美谛克……等等不同的人物。这可是现在的人，是一些人，是做群众之中的骨干的人，而不是一般的人类，不是笼统的人类，正是群众之中的一些人，领导的人，新的整个人类的先辈。
The theme of "Destruction" is the creation of new people. Here, the Russian words used by Fu Richie and Fadeev himself are the singular of the ordinary word "person". Not only is it not human, but it is not the plural of the word "human". This means revolution, civil war...... In the process, a new type of person is produced, a new "type" - elegantly translated as typical, which can be seen in all of "Destruction". Now, your translation says "human." Lai Fensheng longed for a new ...... Mankind. This can lead to another topic. It seems to be a general desire for the whole socialist society. In fact, the "newcomer" of "Destruction" is the urgent task of the current battle: to create, to train, to transform into a new style of character in the process of struggle, and Mu Luo, Mei Di Ke...... and other different characters. This is the current people, some people, the backbone of the masses, not ordinary human beings, not general human beings, but some people in the masses, the leaders, and the ancestors of the new entire human race.这一点是值得特别提出来说的。当然，译文的错误，仅仅是一个字眼上的错误：“人”是一个字眼，“人类”是另外一个字眼。整本的书仍旧在我们面前，你的后记也很正确的了解到《毁灭》的主题。可是翻译要精确，就应当估量每一个字眼。
This point deserves special mention. Of course, the error in the translation is only a mistake in one word: "man" is one word, and "human" is another word. The whole book is still in front of us, and your afterword also correctly understands the theme of "Destruction". But to be precise, you should measure every word.《毁灭》的出版，始终是值得纪念的。我庆祝你。希望你考虑我的意见，而对于翻译问题，对于一般的言语革命问题，开始一个新的斗争。
The publication of "Destruction" is always memorable. I celebrate you. I hope you will consider my opinion and start a new struggle on the issue of translation, on the issue of the speech revolution in general.J．K．　一九三一，十二，五。
