reply敬爱的J．K．同志：
Dear Comrade J.K.,看见你那关于翻译的信以后，使我非常高兴。从去年的翻译洪水泛滥以来，使许多人攒眉叹气，甚而至于讲冷话。我也是一个偶而译书的人，本来应该说几句话的，然而至今没有开过口。“强聒不舍”虽然是勇壮的行为，但我所奉行的，却是“不可与言而与之言，失言”这一句古老话。况且前来的大抵是纸人纸马，说得耳熟一点，那便是“阴兵”，实在是也无从迎头痛击。就拿赵景深教授老爷来做例子罢，他一面专门攻击科学的文艺论译本之不通，指明被压迫的作家匿名之可笑，一面却又大发慈悲，说是这样的译本，恐怕大众不懂得。好像他倒天天在替大众计划方法，别的译者来搅乱了他的阵势似的。这正如俄国革命以后，欧美的富家奴去看了一看，回来就摇头皱脸，做出文章，慨叹着工农还在怎样吃苦，怎样忍饥，说得满纸凄凄惨惨。仿佛惟有他却是极希望一个筋斗，工农就都住王宫，吃大菜，躺安乐椅子享福的人。谁料还是苦，所以俄国不行了，革命不好了，阿呀阿呀了，可恶之极了。对着这样的哭丧脸，你同他说什么呢？假如觉得讨厌，我想，只要拿指头轻轻的在那纸糊架子上挖一个窟窿就可以了。
I was very happy when I saw your letter about translation. Since last year's flood of translations, many people have frowned and sighed, and even spoke coldly. I am also an occasional translator, and I should have said a few words, but I have not spoken so far. Although "strong noise" is a brave act, what I pursue is the ancient saying "do not speak with words, and make a mistake". Moreover, most of the people who came were paper people and paper horses, and to put it a little more familiarly, they were "yin soldiers", and there was really no way to hit them head-on. Take Professor Zhao Jingshen as an example, on the one hand, he specifically attacked the incomprehensibility of scientific literary and artistic translations, pointing out the ridiculousness of the anonymity of oppressed writers, but on the other hand, he was very compassionate, saying that such a translation was probably not understood by the public. It was as if he was planning methods for the public every day, and other translators were disrupting his position. This is just like after the Russian Revolution, rich slaves in Europe and the United States went to see it, shook their heads and frowned, and wrote articles, lamenting how the workers and peasants were still enduring hardships and how they endured hunger. It seems that he is the only one who desperately hopes for a somersault, and the workers and peasants all live in the palace, eat big dishes, and lie down on comfortable chairs to enjoy themselves. Who would have thought that it was still bitter, so Russia was not good, the revolution was not good, ah, ah, it was extremely hateful. What do you tell him about such a crying face? If you feel annoyed, I think you can just gently dig a hole in the paper paste shelf with your finger.赵老爷评论翻译，拉了严又陵，并且替他叫屈，于是累得他在你的信里也挨了一顿骂。但由我看来，这是冤枉的，严老爷和赵老爷，在实际上，有虎狗之差。极明显的例子，是严又陵为要译书，曾经查过汉晋六朝翻译佛经的方法，赵老爷引严又陵为地下知己，却没有看这严又陵所译的书。现在严译的书都出版了，虽然没有什么意义，但他所用的工夫，却从中可以查考。据我所记得，译得最费力，也令人看起来最吃力的，是《穆勒名学》和《群己权界论》的一篇作者自序，其次就是这论，后来不知怎地又改称为《权界》，连书名也很费解了。最好懂的自然是《天演论》，桐城气息十足，连字的平仄也都留心，摇头晃脑的读起来，真是音调铿锵，使人不自觉其头晕。这一点竟感动了桐城派老头子吴汝纶，不禁说是“足与周秦诸子相上下”了。然而严又陵自己却知道这太“达”的译法是不对的，所以他不称为“翻译”，而写作“侯官严复达恉”；序例上发了一通“信达雅”之类的议论之后，结末却声明道：“什法师云，‘学我者病’。来者方多，慎勿以是书为口实也！”好像他在四十年前，便料到会有赵老爷来谬托知己，早已毛骨悚然一样。仅仅这一点，我就要说，严赵两大师，实有虎狗之差，不能相提并论的。
Master Zhao commented on the translation, pulled Yan Youling, and cried for him, so tired that he was also scolded in your letter. But in my opinion, this is unjust, Master Yan and Master Zhao, in fact, there is a difference between tiger and dog. A very obvious example is that Yan Youling once checked the method of translating Buddhist scriptures in the six dynasties of the Han and Jin dynasties, and Master Zhao introduced Yan Youling as an underground confidant, but did not read the book translated by Yan Youling. Now that Yan Yi's books have been published, although it is meaningless, the work he used can be examined from it. As far as I remember, the most laborious translation and the most difficult thing to look at was the author's preface to "Müller's Famous Studies" and "The Theory of the Boundaries of Groups and Selfs", followed by this theory, which was later somehow renamed "The Realm of Power", and even the title of the book was very puzzling. The best thing to understand is naturally "Tianyan Lun", Tongcheng is full of atmosphere, even the flatness of the words is also paying attention, shaking your head to read it, it is really sonorous, making people unconsciously dizzy. This actually moved Wu Rulun, the old man of the Tongcheng Sect, and he couldn't help but say that it was "comparable to the sons of Zhou and Qin". However, Yan Youling himself knew that the translation of this "Da" was wrong, so he did not call it "translation", but wrote "Hou Guan Yan Fuda Yi"; After a discussion such as "Xindaya" was posted in the preface, it was declared at the end: "Master Shi said, 'Those who learn from me are sick'. There are many people coming, so don't use this book as a word of mouth! It seems that he expected that Master Zhao would come to pretend to be a confidant forty years ago, and he was already creepy. At this point alone, I have to say that the two masters Yan and Zhao are really different from tigers and dogs, and they cannot be compared.那么，他为什么要干这一手把戏呢？答案是：那时的留学生没有现在这么阔气，社会上大抵以为西洋人只会做机器——尤其是自鸣钟——留学生只会讲鬼子话，所以算不了“士”人的。因此他便来铿锵一下子，铿锵得吴汝纶也肯给他作序，这一序，别的生意也就源源而来了，于是有《名学》，有《法意》，有《原富》等等。但他后来的译本，看得“信”比“达雅”都重一些。
So, why did he do this trick? The answer is: At that time, international students were not as generous as they are now, and the society generally thought that Westerners could only make machines - especially self-ringing bells - and international students could only speak devil language, so they could not be considered "scholars". Therefore, he came to sonorous all of a sudden, and Wu Rulun was also willing to give him a preface, and in this preface, other businesses also came in a steady stream, so there was "Mingxue", "Fayi", "Yuan Fu" and so on. But in his later translations, "Xin" is heavier than "Daya".他的翻译，实在是汉唐译经历史的缩图。中国之译佛经，汉末质直，他没有取法。六朝真是“达”而“雅”了，他的《天演论》的模范就在此。唐则以“信”为主，粗粗一看，简直是不能懂的，这就仿佛他后来的译书。译经的简单的标本，有金陵刻经处汇印的三种译本《大乘起信论》，也是赵老爷的一个死对头。
His translation is really a microcosm of the history of Han and Tang translations. The Chinese translation of Buddhist scriptures was straightforward at the end of the Han Dynasty, and he did not take the method. The Six Dynasties are really "Da" and "Ya", and the model of his "Tianyan Lun" is here. Tang is mainly based on "letters", which are simply incomprehensible at a glance, just like his later translations. Simple specimens of the translation of scriptures, including the three translations of "Mahayana Theory of Faith" printed by the Jinling Scripture Engraving Office, are also a sworn enemy of Master Zhao.但我想，我们的译书，还不能这样简单，首先要决定译给大众中的怎样的读者。将这些大众，粗粗的分起来：甲，有很受了教育的；乙，有略能识字的；丙，有识字无几的。而其中的丙，则在“读者”的范围之外，启发他们是图画，演讲，戏剧，电影的任务，在这里可以不论。但就是甲乙两种，也不能用同样的书籍，应该各有供给阅读的相当的书。供给乙的，还不能用翻译，至少是改作，最好还是创作，而这创作又必须并不只在配合读者的胃口，讨好了，读的多就够。至于供给甲类的读者的译本，无论什么，我是至今主张“宁信而不顺”的。自然，这所谓“不顺”，决不是说“跪下”要译作“跪在膝之上”，“天河”要译作“牛奶路”的意思，乃是说，不妨不像吃茶淘饭一样几口可以咽完，却必须费牙来嚼一嚼。这里就来了一个问题：为什么不完全中国化，给读者省些力气呢？这样费解，怎样还可以称为翻译呢？我的答案是：这也是译本。这样的译本，不但在输入新的内容，也在输入新的表现法。中国的文或话，法子实在太不精密了，作文的秘诀，是在避去熟字，删掉虚字，就是好文章，讲话的时候，也时时要辞不达意，这就是话不够用，所以教员讲书，也必须借助于粉笔。这语法的不精密，就在证明思路的不精密，换一句话，就是脑筋有些胡涂。倘若永远用着胡涂话，即使读的时候，滔滔而下，但归根结蒂，所得的还是一个胡涂的影子。要医这病，我以为只好陆续吃一点苦，装进异样的句法去，古的，外省外府的，外国的，后来便可以据为己有。这并不是空想的事情。远的例子，如日本，他们的文章里，欧化的语法是极平常的了，和梁启超做《和文汉读法》时代，大不相同；近的例子，就如来信所说，一九二五年曾给群众造出过“罢工”这一个字眼，这字眼虽然未曾有过，然而大众已都懂得了。
But I think our translation of books cannot be so simple, and we must first decide what kind of readers we will translate it to. These masses are roughly divided: A, some are very educated; B, who can read slightly; C, there are few literate. And C, outside the scope of "readers", inspires them to be the task of drawing, speech, drama, and film, and can be ignored here. But even A and B cannot use the same books, and each should have its own equivalent books for reading. For those who supply B, they cannot use translation, at least they are rewritten, and it is best to create, and this creation must not only meet the reader's appetite, but also please and read more. As for the translation for Category A readers, no matter what, I still advocate "preferring to believe rather than obey". Naturally, this so-called "unsmooth" does not mean that "kneeling" should be translated as "kneeling on the knees", and "Tianhe" should be translated as "milk road", but that it is not as good as eating tea and rice, but it must be chewed with teeth. Here comes the question: why not completely sinicize and save some effort for readers? How can such a confusion be called translation? My answer is: this is also a translation. Such a translation is not only entering new content, but also entering new expressions. The secret of composition is to avoid familiar words, delete virtual words, that is, good articles, when speaking, you always have to say that you can't convey the meaning, this is not enough, so teachers must also use chalk to tell stories. The imprecision of this grammar proves the imprecision of the thinking, in other words, the brain is a little foolish. If you always use nonsense, even if you read it, you will gushing it down, but in the final analysis, what you get is still a shadow of nonsense. To cure this disease, I thought I had to endure a little hardship one after another, and put it into a strange syntax, ancient, from other provinces and foreign governments, and later I could take it as my own. This is not a fantasy. For example, in Japan, the Europeanized grammar in their articles is very common, which is very different from the era when Liang Qichao made "Hewen Chinese Reading"; For example, as mentioned in the letter, in 1925 the word "strike" was coined for the masses, although this word had never existed, but the masses already understood it.我还以为即便为乙类读者而译的书，也应该时常加些新的字眼，新的语法在里面，但自然不宜太多，以偶尔遇见，而想一想，或问一问就能懂得为度。必须这样，群众的言语才能够丰富起来。
I also think that even books translated for Category B readers should often add some new words and new grammar to them, but naturally there should not be too many, so that you can understand it by thinking about it or asking a question. Only in this way can the words of the masses be enriched.什么人全都懂得的书，现在是不会有的，只有佛教徒的“唵”字，据说是“人人能解”，但可惜又是“解各不同”。就是数学或化学书，里面何尝没有许多“术语”之类，为赵老爷所不懂，然而赵老爷并不提及者，太记得了严又陵之故也。
There is no book that everyone understands now, only the Buddhist word "Om" is said to be "everyone can understand", but unfortunately it is "different interpretations". It is a mathematics or chemistry book, why not have many "terms" in it, which Master Zhao does not understand, but Master Zhao does not mention it, because he remembers Yan Youling too much.说到翻译文艺，倘以甲类读者为对象，我是也主张直译的。我自己的译法，是譬如“山背后太阳落下去了”，虽然不顺，也决不改作“日落山阴”，因为原意以山为主，改了就变成太阳为主了。虽然创作，我以为作者也得加以这样的区别。一面尽量的输入，一面尽量的消化，吸收，可用的传下去了，渣滓就听他剩落在过去里。所以在现在容忍“多少的不顺”，倒并不能算“防守”，其实也还是一种的“进攻”。在现在民众口头上的话，那不错，都是“顺”的，但为民众口头上的话搜集来的话胚，其实也还是要顺的，因此我也是主张容忍“不顺”的一个。
When it comes to translating literature and art, if it is aimed at Category A readers, I also advocate literal translation. My own translation is for example, "The sun sets behind the mountain", although it is not smooth, it will never be changed to "sunset mountain shade", because the original meaning is mainly mountain, but if it is changed, it will become the sun. Although it is created, I think the author must also make such a distinction. While trying to input, while trying to digest and absorb as much as possible, the available is passed on, and the scum listens to him remaining in the past. Therefore, tolerating "how much trouble" is not "defense" now, but it is actually a kind of "offense". In the current oral words of the people, they are all "smooth", but the embryos collected for the people's oral words are actually still smooth, so I am also one who advocates tolerating "unsmooth".但这情形也当然不是永远的，其中的一部分，将从“不顺”而成为“顺”，有一部分，则因为到底“不顺”而被淘汰，被踢开。这最要紧的是我们自己的批判。如来信所举的译例，我都可以承认比我译得更“达”，也可推定并且更“信”，对于译者和读者，都有很大的益处。不过这些只能使甲类的读者懂得，于乙类的读者是太艰深的。由此也可见现在必须区别了种种的读者层，有种种的译作。
But of course, this situation is not forever, part of it will change from "not smooth" to "smooth", and some will be eliminated and kicked away because of "unsmooth" in the end. The most important thing is our own criticism. As for the translation examples given in the letter, I can admit that they are more "understanding" than my translation, and they can also be presumed and more "believed", which is of great benefit to both the translator and the reader. However, these can only be understood by readers of category A, and it is too difficult for readers of category B. It can also be seen that it is now necessary to distinguish between various readers and various translations.为乙类读者译作的方法，我没有细想过，此刻说不出什么来。但就大体看来，现在也还不能和口语——各处各种的土话——合一，只能成为一种特别的白话，或限于某一地方的白话。后一种，某一地方以外的读者就看不懂了，要它分布较广，势必至于要用前一种，但因此也就仍然成为特别的白话，文言的分子也多起来。我是反对用太限于一处的方言的，例如小说中常见的“别闹”“别说”等类罢，假使我没有到过北京，我一定解作“另外捣乱”“另外去说”的意思，实在远不如较近文言的“不要”来得容易了然，这样的只在一处活着的口语，倘不是万不得已，也应该回避的。还有章回体小说中的笔法，即使眼熟，也不必尽是采用，例如“林冲笑道：原来，你认得。”和“原来，你认得。——林冲笑着说。”这两条，后一例虽然看去有些洋气，其实我们讲话的时候倒常用，听得“耳熟”的。但中国人对于小说是看的，所以还是前一例觉得“眼熟”，在书上遇见后一例的笔法，反而好像生疏了。没有法子，现在只好采说书而去其油滑，听闲谈而去其散漫，博取民众的口语而存其比较的大家能懂的字句，成为四不像的白话。这白话得是活的，活的缘故，就因为有些是从活的民众的口头取来，有些是要从此注入活的民众里面去。
I haven't thought about the method of translating for Category B readers, and I can't say anything at the moment. But in general, it cannot be integrated with the colloquial language, various vernacular dialects everywhere, and can only become a special vernacular, or a vernacular limited to a certain place. The latter type is not understood by readers outside a certain place, and if it is widely distributed, it is bound to use the former one, but it still becomes a special vernacular, and there are more elements in classical Chinese. If I had not been to Beijing, I would definitely interpret it as "make trouble in another" and "say it elsewhere", which is far less easy than the "don't" in the closer classical Chinese. There are also brushstrokes in Zhang Hui's novels, even if they are familiar, they don't have to be all used, for example, Lin Chong smiled and said: It turns out that you recognize it. And "It turns out, you recognize it." - Lin Chong said with a smile. Although the latter one looks a bit foreign, in fact, we often use it when we speak, and it sounds "familiar". But Chinese people read novels, so the previous case still feels "familiar", and the brushwork of the latter case in the book seems to be rusty. There is no way, so now we have to take the story and remove its slippery, listen to the gossip and get rid of its looseness, win the colloquial language of the people and save the words that everyone can understand, and become the four different vernaculars. This vernacular must be alive, and for the sake of living, because some of it is taken from the mouth of the living people, and some of it is to be injected into the living people.临末，我很感谢你信末所举的两个例子。一，我将“……甚至于比自己还要亲近”译成“较之自己较之别人，还要亲近的人们”，是直译德日两种译本的说法的。这恐怕因为他们的语法中，没有像“甚至于”这样能够简单而确切地表现这口气的字眼的缘故，转几个弯，就成为这么拙笨了。二，将“新的……人”的“人”字译成“人类”，那是我的错误，是太穿凿了之后的错误。莱奋生望见的打麦场上的人，他要造他们成为目前的战斗的人物，我是看得很清楚的，但当他默想“新的……人”的时候，却也很使我默想了好久：（一）“人”的原文，日译本是“人间”，德译本是“Mensch”，都是单数，但有时也可作“人们”解；（二）他在目前就想有“新的极好的有力量的慈善的人”，希望似乎太奢，太空了。我于是想到他的出身，是商人的孩子，是智识分子，由此猜测他的战斗，是为了经过阶级斗争之后的无阶级社会，于是就将他所设想的目前的人，跟着我的主观的错误，搬往将来，并且成为“人们”——人类了。在你未曾指出之前，我还自以为这见解是很高明的哩，这是必须对于读者，赶紧声明改正的。
At the end of the letter, I am grateful for the two examples you gave at the end of your letter. First, I will "...... Even closer than oneself "translated as "people who are closer than oneself and closer than others" is a literal translation of the German and Japanese translations. This is probably because there is no word in their grammar that can simply and accurately express this tone like "even", and it becomes so clumsy after turning a few turns. Second, the "new ...... The word "human" in "person" is translated as "human", which is my mistake, a mistake after being too drilled. I can see very clearly the people on the threshing field that Lai Fensheng sainted, and he wants to make them the characters of the current battle, but when he meditates on "new...... people", but it also made me meditate for a long time: (1) The original text of "people", the Japanese translation is "people", and the German translation is "Mensch", both are singular, but sometimes they can also be interpreted as "people"; (2) He wants to have "new and superb and powerful charitable people" at present, and hope seems too extravagant and space. I then thought that he was born as a merchant's child and an intellectual, and thus guessed that his fight was for a classless society after the class struggle, so I moved the current person he envisioned to the future with my subjective mistake and became "people" - human beings. Before you point it out, I think this opinion is very clever, and it must be corrected to the reader as soon as possible.总之，今年总算将这一部纪念碑的小说，送在这里的读者们的面前了。译的时候和印的时候，颇经过了不少艰难，现在倒也退出了记忆的圈外去，但我真如你来信所说那样，就像亲生的儿子一般爱他，并且由他想到儿子的儿子。还有《铁流》，我也很喜欢。这两部小说，虽然粗制，却并非滥造，铁的人物和血的战斗，实在够使描写多愁善病的才子和千娇百媚的佳人的所谓“美文”，在这面前淡到毫无踪影。不过我也和你的意思一样，以为这只是一点小小的胜利，所以也很希望多人合力的更来绍介，至少在后三年内，有关于内战时代和建设时代的纪念碑的的文学书八种至十种，此外更译几种虽然往往被称为无产者文学，然而还不免含有小资产阶级的偏见（如巴比塞）和基督教社会主义的偏见（如辛克莱）的代表作，加上了分析和严正的批评，好在那里，坏在那里，以备对比参考之用，那么，不但读者的见解，可以一天一天的分明起来，就是新的创作家，也得了正确的师范了。
In short, this year I finally sent this monumental novel to the readers here. When I translated and printed, I went through a lot of difficulties, and now I have withdrawn from the circle of memory, but I really love him like my own son, as you said in your letter, and he thinks of my son's son. There is also "Tie Liu", which I also like. These two novels, although crude, are not indiscriminate, and the iron characters and bloody battles are really enough to make the so-called "beautiful writings" describing sentimental talents and charming beauties fade away in front of this. But I also agree with you, thinking that this is just a small victory, so I also hope that many people will work together to introduce it, at least in the next three years, there will be eight to ten kinds of literary books on monuments in the era of civil war and construction, and several masterpieces that are often called proletarian literature, but also contain petty-bourgeois prejudices (such as Babisey) and Christian socialist prejudices (such as Sinclair), plus analysis and serious criticism, good there, bad there, For comparison and reference, not only can the reader's opinions be clarified day by day, but also the new creator has also gained the correct teacher.鲁迅　一九三一，十二，二八。
Lu Xun 1931, 12, 28.

现代电影与有产阶级

现代电影与有产阶级

现代电影与有产阶级

Modern cinema and the proletariat〔日本〕岩崎·昶　作
[Japan] by Iwasaki Chang

现代电影与有产阶级

一　电影与观众

现代电影与有产阶级

1. Film and audience电影的发明，是新的印刷术的起源。曾经借着活字和纸张，而输运开去，复制出来的思想，是有着使中世的封建底、旧教底社会意识，归于坏灭的力量的。
The invention of cinema is the origin of new printing technology. The ideas that were once transported and copied by movable type and paper have the power to destroy the social consciousness of the feudal and old religions in the Middle Ages.有产者底社会的勃兴，宗教改革，那些重大的历史底契机，由此得了结果了。现在，在思想的输运上，在观念形态的决定上，电影所负的任务，就更加积极底，更加意识底了。它是阶级社会的拥护，也是新的“宗教改革”。
The rise of the proletarian society, the Reformation, and those major historical opportunities have come to fruition. Now, in terms of the transportation of ideas and the determination of conceptual forms, the tasks of films are more positive and conscious. It is the embrace of class society and the new "Reformation".这新的印刷术，是由于将运动的照相的一系列，印在Zelluloid的薄膜上而成立的。那活字，并非将概念传给读者，却给以动作和具象。这在直接地是视觉底的这一种意义上，是无上的通俗底的而同时也是感铭底的活字，在原则底地没有言语这一种意义上，则是国际底活字。作为宣传，煽动手段的电影的效用，就在这一点。
This new printing technique was established by printing a series of photographs of movement on the film of Zelluloid. The movable type does not convey the concept to the reader, but gives action and concreteness. In the sense that this is directly the visual base, it is the supreme popular and at the same time the movable type of the emotional base, and in the sense that there is no speech under the principle, it is the international movable type. The utility of cinema as a means of propaganda and incitement lies in this.当考察作为宣传，煽动手段的电影之际，比什么都重大的，是电影和在那影响之下的大众的关联。
When examining films as propaganda and incitement, what is more important than anything else is the relationship between the film and the public under its influence.我想用了具体底的数目字来描写它。
I want to describe it with specific numbers.据英国的电影杂志《The Cinema》所发表的统计，则一星期中的电影看客之数，其非常之多如下。

The huge audience dominated by the film, as well as the directness and international ,—— of the film form, prove that the film is an excellent container for public propaganda and agitation in terms of weight and substance.

现代电影与有产阶级

二　电影与宣传

现代电影与有产阶级

2. Film and propaganda要正当地认识那作为宣传，煽动手段的电影的价值，必须知道所谓“宣传电影”这一句熟语，以及那概念之无意义。
To properly understand the value of cinema as a means of propaganda and incitement, we must know the idiom of "propaganda film" and the meaninglessness of the concept.为了介绍日本的好风景于外国，以招致游客而作的电影，富士山，艺妓，日光，温泉等等，我们常常称之为宣传电影，凡这些，有时是因了教导疾病的预防法，奖励邮政储金，劝诱保险之类的目的而照的。那时候，我们便立刻感到装在那些软片之中的目的，领会了肺结核之可怕，开始贮金，加入生命保险去。然而利用了公会堂，小学校讲堂之类来开演的宣传电影，往往是不收费用的，既然白给人看，便会立刻发生疑惑，以为来演的那一面，一定有着白给人看的根由。这种宣传电影，目的意识就马上被看透。
In order to introduce the beautiful scenery of Japan to foreign countries, we often call it a propaganda movie to attract tourists, such as Mt. Fuji, geisha, Nikko, hot springs, etc., and these are sometimes taken for the purpose of teaching about the prevention of disease, rewarding postal savings, and persuading insurance. At that time, we immediately felt the purpose of those soft films, understood the horror of tuberculosis, and began to save money and join life insurance. However, propaganda films that use guild halls, primary school lecture halls, etc. to start are often free of charge, since they are shown to people for free, they will immediately have doubts, thinking that the side of the performance must have a reason for showing it for nothing. This kind of propaganda movie, the sense of purpose is immediately seen through.有着衰老而盲目的母亲的独养子一太郎君，得了召集令，将母亲放在她的一切衰老和盲目之中，“为了君国”，出征去“膺惩可恶的仇敌”了。勇壮的日章旗，万岁，一太郎呀！我们往往被给看这种军国美谈的东西。而这些东西，乃是×××电影公司所制的商业电影，当开演时，也并不叨公会堂和小学校讲堂的光，收取着有名誉的观览费，在普通的常设馆里堂皇地开映。一到这样，善良而无疑的看客，便不觉得这是宣传电影了。他们就将自己的付过正当的观览费这一个事实，做了那影片并非宣传电影的证明。其实，单纯的看客，是没有觉到陷于被那巧妙地布置了的宣传所煽动，所欺骗，然而对于那欺骗，还要付钱的二重欺骗的。
The only adopted son of an aging and blind mother, Ichitaro-kun, received a summons order to put his mother in all her aging and blindness, "for the sake of the monarchy", and went on an expedition to "punish the hateful enemy". Brave Japanese flag, long live, Ichitaro! We are often shown this kind of military beauty. And these things are commercial films produced by ××× film companies, and when they start, they do not care about the light of the guild hall and the primary school lecture hall, and charge a prestigious viewing fee, and they are grandly screened in ordinary permanent halls. At this point, the kind and undoubted audience doesn't think it's a propaganda movie. They used the fact that they had paid a fair viewing fee to prove that the film was not a promotional film. In fact, the simple spectators do not feel that they are incited and deceived by the cleverly arranged propaganda, but for that deception, they have to pay for the double deception.在市民底的用语惯例上的“宣传电影”的无意义，大略就如此。为什么呢，因为没有目的的电影，因而就不是宣传电影的电影之类的东西，不过是幻想的缘故。
The meaninglessness of "propaganda films" in the terminology conventions of the citizens is roughly like this. Why, because a movie without a purpose, is not a movie that promotes a movie, but because of fantasy.我们能够就现在所制成的一切影片，将那隐微的目的——有时这还未意识底地到了目的地步，止是倾向以至趣味的程度罢了，但那倾向以至趣味，结果也是一个重要的宣传价值——摘发出来。那或是向帝国主义战争的进军喇叭，或是爱国主义，君权主义的鼓吹，或是利用了宗教的反动宣传，或是资产者社会的拥护，是对于革命的压抑，是劳资调和的提倡，是向小市民底社会底无关心的催眠药，——要之，是只为了资本主义底秩序的利益，专心安排了的思想底布置。
We can extract the subtle purpose of all the films that are now made—sometimes unconsciously reaching the destination, just the degree of tendency and interest, but that tendency and interest, and the result is also an important propaganda value. It is either the trumpeter of the march to imperialist war, or the advocacy of patriotism and monarchism, or the use of reactionary propaganda of religion, or the support of bourgeois society, the suppression of revolution, the promotion of labor-management reconciliation, the hypnotic drug to the indifferent society of the petty citizens,—— or in short, it is a thoughtful arrangement of ideological arrangements only for the interests of the capitalist order.在一九二八年，开在墨斯科的中央委员会的席上，关于电影，有了
In 1928, at the meeting of the Central Committee in Mesco, about cinema, there was“将电影放在劳动者阶级的手中，关于苏维埃教化和文化的进步的任务，作为指导，教育，组织大众的手段。”
"Putting cinema in the hands of the working class, the task of Soviet indoctrination and cultural progress, as a means of guiding, educating, organizing the masses."的决议了。苏维埃电影的任务，即在在世界的电影市场上，抗拒着资本主义底宣传的澎湃的波浪，而作×××××宣传。
The resolution has been. The task of Soviet cinema is to resist the surging waves of capitalist propaganda in the world film market, and to make ××××× propaganda.世界现今是正在作为第二次大战的准备的，观念形态斗争的涡中。而电影，是和那五十九亿的看客一同，可以在这斗争的秤盘上，加上决定底的重量去的。
The world is now in the midst of a struggle for ideas and forms as preparations for World War II. And the movie, together with the 5.9 billion spectators, can add the weight of the decision to the scale of this struggle.

现代电影与有产阶级

三　电影和战争

现代电影与有产阶级

3. Cinema and War资本主义底宣传电影之中，占着最重要的部门的，是战争影片。
Among the capitalist propaganda films, the most important sector is war films.将战争收入电影里去，已经颇早了。当电影刚要脱离襁褓的时候，我们就看见了罗马，巴比伦，埃及之类的兵卒的打仗。这是那时的电影对于舞台的唯一的长处，为了要使利用了自由的Location（就地摄影）和巨大的Set（场内陈设）和大众摄影的光景的魅力，发现到最大限度，所以设法出来的。辉煌的古代的铠甲，环以城垣的都市，神祠，奇怪的偶像，枪，盾，矛，火箭，石弩，这样异域情调的，而在当时，又是壮丽的布置，便忽然眩惑了对于电影还很幼稚的大众的眼，正合了时尚了。
It was quite early to include the war in the movie. When the movie is about to be released from swaddling clothes, we see the battles of soldiers in Rome, Babylon, Egypt and so on. This is the only strength of the movie for the stage at that time, and I managed to find out the charm of the scene that makes the most of the free location (on-site photography) and the huge set (in-venue furnishings) and the scene of mass photography. The glorious ancient armor, the city surrounded by city walls, shrines, strange idols, guns, shields, spears, rockets, stone crossbows, such exoticism, and at that time, it was a magnificent arrangement, which suddenly dazzled the eyes of the public who were still very naïve about movies, which was just in fashion.但在初期的这类的战争，归根结蒂，和大排场的马戏，比武之类的把戏，也并无区别。古代罗马和凯尔达戈，都不是现代电影看客的祖国。战争也不过仗了那动底的煽情底的视觉，使他们兴奋，有趣罢了。
But in the early days, this kind of war, in the final analysis, is no different from the pompous circus, competition and other tricks. Ancient Rome and Keldago, neither the motherland of modern moviegoers. War is just a visual reliance on the sensationalism that moves the bottom to make them excited and interesting.引进近代的战争去，而在那里面分明地装入有意识的宣传底要素的最初的电影制作者，我以为恐怕是葛蕾菲士（D．W．Griffith）罢。他在取材于南北战争的《一民族之诞生》（Birth of a Nation），《亚美利加》（America）这些影片上，赞美北军的英雄主义，将所谓合众国建国的精神，化为正当，化为美丽了。凡这些，虽不如后出的许多好战底影片那样，积极底地鼓吹了对外战争，但那目的，则仍在对于国民中有着驳杂分子的人种博物馆一般的合众国和其居民，涵养其确固的国家底概念，爱国心。“十足的亚美利加人”这一句口号，流行起来，成为“亚美利加化”运动的有力的武器，对于从爱尔兰来的巡警，从昔昔利来的菜商，于黑人，于美洲印第安，也都想印上这脸谱去了。
The original filmmaker who introduced modern warfare and clearly incorporated conscious propaganda elements into it, I thought it was probably D.W. Griffith. In films such as "Birth of a Nation" and "America", which are based on the Civil War, he praised the heroism of the Union Army and turned the so-called spirit of the founding of the United States into legitimacy and beauty. Although these are not as active as many later warlike films, they still cultivate their solid concept of national foundation and patriotism for the United States and its inhabitants, which are like ethnic museums with mixed elements among the people. The slogan "Full American" became popular and became a powerful weapon for the "Americanization" movement, and the patrol officers from Ireland, the vegetable merchants from Xixili, the blacks, and the American Indians all wanted to print this face.“亚美利加化”的历程，以欧洲大战的勃发，亚美利加的参战，以及和这相伴的急速的帝国主义化为契机，而告了完成。
The process of "Americanization" was completed with the outbreak of the European War, the entry of America into the war, and the rapid imperialization that accompanied it.亚美利加和对德宣战同时，还必须送一百万军队到法兰西去，于是开始了速成的募兵，施行了速成的海军扩张。奏着煽动底的进行曲的军乐队，在各处都市的大街上往来，各十字路口帖着传单，报纸独于此时候说些“亚美利加市民”的义务。易受煽动的青年们，或者为着不去应募，将被恋人所鄙弃，或者为着对于生活，觉得厌倦，或者又为着“进了海军去看看世界”，就来当募兵了。当此之际，亚美利加政府之宣传，也是有史以来的最大规模，而且最见效果的了。
At the same time as America declared war on Germany, it had to send a million troops to France, so it began a rapid recruitment and implemented a rapid naval expansion. Marching bands playing incitement marches on the streets of various cities, leaflets are posted at intersections, and newspapers are the only ones at this time to say the obligation of "American citizens". Young people who are easily incited either because they do not enlist and will be despised by their lovers, or because they are tired of life, or because they want to "join the navy to see the world", they come to recruit. At this time, the propaganda of the American government was also the largest and most effective in history.在这宣传之战，充了最主要的脚色的，是新闻和电影。当这时期，在本来的意义上的战争电影，这才制作出来了。
In this propaganda battle, the most important thing is news and movies. During this period, war films in the original sense were produced.在以根据西班牙的发狂底反对德国者伊本纳支（Blasco Ibáñez）的原作《默示录的四骑士》（Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse），《我们的海》（Mare Nostrum）为代表作品的战争影片上，亚美利加的支配阶级便描写出德国军队的如何凶残，德国潜艇的如何非人道，巧妙地煽动了单纯的花旗人。
In the war films represented by Blasco Ibáñez, who opposed the Germans based on Spain's madness, the ruling class of America depicted how ferocious, how inhumane the German submarines were, and subtly incited the simple Citi people.然而花旗帝国主义开始呈露它本来的锐锋，却在欧战收场之后，懂得了大众的军国化，是应该在平时不断地安排的时候。
However, Citi imperialism began to show its original sharpness, but after the end of the European War, it understood that the militarization of the masses should be constantly arranged in peacetime.在一九二〇年代的前半，切实地支配了全世界人类的脑子的，首先是活泼泼的战争的记忆。于是发生一种欲望，要符世界大战这一个重大的历史底事件，在国民底叙事诗的形态上，艺术底地再现出来，正是自然的事。而所作的电影，就切实地倾向大众的兴味和感情上去，也正是自然的事。将这有利的情势，忽然利用了的，是花旗帝国主义。战争的叙事法，便以最为好战底的煽动企图，创作出来了。
In the first half of the 1920s, the first thing that truly dominated the minds of mankind around the world was the lively memory of war. Thus, a desire to conform to the major historical event of the world war is reproduced artistically in the form of national narrative poetry, which is a natural thing. And it is natural for the movies made to really tend to the public's interest and emotions. It is Citi imperialism that suddenly takes advantage of this favorable situation. The narrative method of war was created with the most belligerent incitement attempt.战争影片的不绝的系列，产生了。《战地之花》（Big Parade），《飞机大战》（Wings）以下，许多反动底宣传影片，列举名目就不胜其烦。不消说，那些电影是没有战时的纯粹的煽动影片一般地露骨的，制作之法，是添些乐剧式恋爱的适当的甘甜，以及掩饰些人道主义底的战争批评的药料，弄得易于下咽，使能在较自然，较暗默之中，达到宣传的目的。但虽然是十分小心的假面，而其究竟目的之所在，则同是将遮眼的东西给与大众，使不明帝国主义底战争的本质，以及赞美亚美利加军队的英雄主义，有时还宣传军队生活的放恣和有趣罢了。（我深惜在这里没有揭出这种战争影片的完全的目录，以那代表底的几个例子，来使我的叙述更加具体起来的纸面和时间了。但我相信将来会有补正的机会的。）
An endless series of war films was produced. "Big Parade", "Wings", and many other reactionary propaganda films, it is annoying to list the names. Needless to say, those films are not as explicit as pure incitement films in wartime, and the production method is to add some appropriate sweetness of musical-style love, and to cover up some humanitarian criticism of war, so that it is easy to swallow, so that it can achieve the purpose of propaganda in a more natural and silent way. But although it is a very careful mask, its ultimate purpose is to give the public something blindfolded, so that the nature of the imperialist war is not understood, and the heroism of the American army is praised, and sometimes it is just to promote the indulgence and fun of military life. (I regret that I have not revealed a complete catalogue of such war films here, but I will use a few representative examples to make my narrative more concrete.) But I believe there will be opportunities to make corrections in the future. ）就战争和电影所历叙的这些事实，那自然，也决不是惟亚美利加所独有的特别现象。倒是在别的一切帝国主义强国里，都在争先兴办的。德国将《大战巡洋舰》（Emden）《世界大战》（Weltkrieg）等呈在我们的眼前，法国是制作了《凡尔登——历史的幻想》（Verdun—Vision d'histoire）《蔼克巴什》（L'Equipage）等，英国则以《黎明》（Dawn），日本则以《炮烟弹雨》，《地球在回旋》和《蔚山洋西的海战》等，竭力用心于“军事思想”的普及。
As far as these facts are concerned about the war and the film, it is by no means a special phenomenon unique to America. On the contrary, all other imperialist powers are scrambling to be the first to do so. Germany presented "Emden" and "Weltkrieg" (Weltkrieg), France produced "Verdun-Vision d'histoire" and "L'Equipage", etc., Britain made "Dawn", and Japan made "Rain of Smoke and Bombs", "The Earth is Spinning" and "The Naval Battle in the West of Ulsan", etc., and tried their best to popularize "military thought".当叙述完战争电影之际，而没有提及作为几个例外底现象的反对战争的倾向，怕是不妥当的罢。
When the war movie is narrated, it is probably inappropriate not to mention the tendency to oppose war as an exception.我们在《战地之花》里，在几个段落里，虽然是太感伤底的，然而总算也看见了描写着诅咒战争的心情。那心理，在《战地鹃声》（What Price Glory）中，就更为积极底地表白着。但在这些影片上，对于战争的确然的批评和态度，并无一定。只有着和卓别林（Charlie Chaplin）曾在《从军梦》（Shoulder Arms）里，将战争化为谑画了那样的同一程度的认识。
In "Flowers of the Battlefield", although we are too sentimental in a few paragraphs, we finally see the mood that describes the cursed war. That psychology is expressed more positively in "What Price Glory". However, there is no definite criticism or attitude towards war in these films. Only the same level of understanding as Charlie Chaplin once turned war into a joke in "Shoulder Arms".和这比较起来，技术上非常卓拔的战争影片《帝国旅馆》（Hotel Imperial）的导演者Erich Pommer所作的《铁条网》（Barbed Wire），倘临末没有那高唱人类爱的可笑的夸张，则和猛烈地讽刺了帝国主义战争的名喜剧《阵后谐兵》（Behind the Front）一同，大概是可以属于反战争电影的范畴的了。
In comparison, "Barbed Wire" by Erich Pommer, director of the technically brilliant war film "Hotel Imperial", could probably fall into the category of anti-war films if it did not have the ridiculous exaggeration of human love at the end, along with the famous comedy "Behind the Front", which fiercely satirizes the imperialist war.

现代电影与有产阶级

四　电影与爱国主义

现代电影与有产阶级

4. Cinema and patriotism爱国底宣传电影，也是世界大战后的显著的现象。为什么呢？因为这种电影，虽有外形上的差违，但终极之点，是在向帝国主义战争的意识的准备，鼓舞，在那君权主义上，在那好战性上，和战争影片是本质底地相关联的。
Patriotic propaganda films are also a significant phenomenon after the world war. Why? Because this kind of film, although there are differences in appearance, the ultimate point is to prepare and inspire the consciousness of imperialist war, and it is essentially related to war films in terms of monarchism and belligerence.那么，那目的是在那里呢？
So, what is the purpose?直接地，是宣传团体观念，国旗之尊严，间接地，是奖励暴力，使民心倾向右翼政党，当和外国争夺资本市场之际，即刻有军事行动的事，成为妥当化。
Directly, it is to promote the concept of the group, the dignity of the national flag, and indirectly, it is to reward violence, so that the people's hearts are inclined towards right-wing parties, and when they compete with foreign countries for the capital market, military action becomes justified.这种影片的最活泼的影响，大抵见于选举国会议员，选举大总统的时期，如德国的国权党，尤其是能够仗了爱国主义的电影，博得许多的投票。
The most lively influence of this kind of film is probably seen in the period of election of parliamentarians and presidents, such as the National Rights Party in Germany, especially the film that can rely on patriotism and win a lot of votes.例如叫作《腓立大王》（Fridericus Rex，这在日本，是大加短缩，改题为《莱因悲怆曲》了）的普鲁士勃兴的历史影片，是其中的最获成功的。那正是大战后的张皇的时代，且正值跟着德国革命的失败而来的反动的火头上，这是有产阶级的巧妙的宣传。穷极，饿透了的小市民们，在这影片中，看见精锐的腓立大王的禁军的行进，看见七年战争的冠冕堂皇的胜利，于是想起了往日的皇帝的治世，便在无智的廉价的感激中，鼓掌蹈足，吹起口笛来了。
For example, the Prussian historical film called "Fridericus Rex" (in Japan, it is greatly abbreviated and retitled "Rhine's Sorment") is the most successful of them. It was the era of Zhang Huang after the Great War, and it was on the fire of reactionary fire that followed the defeat of the German revolution, which was a clever propaganda of the proletariat. In this film, the impoverished and hungry citizens, seeing the march of the elite Philip the Great's forbidden army and the high-sounding victory of the Seven Years' War, thought of the reign of the emperors of the past, and applauded and blew their whistles in the ignorant and cheap gratitude.接着这个，而国民底英雄俾士麦的传记，化成电影了，兴登堡的传记，化成电影了。
Then this, and the biography of the national hero Bismarck turned into a movie, and the biography of Hindenburg turned into a movie.《俾士麦》（Bismarck）者，单为了那制作，就设起俾士麦电影公司来，照成了两部二十余卷的巨制，凡在这帝国主义底政治家一生中的一切爱国底，煽情底的要素，都一无遗漏地填进在那里面。
"Bismarck" (Bismarck), just for that production, set up the Bismarck Film Company, and it was made into two masterpieces of more than 20 volumes, and all the patriotic and sensational elements in the life of this imperialist politician were filled in without omission.《兴登堡》（Hindenburg）者，是乘这老将军当选为大统领——这叨光于影片《腓立大王》和《俾士麦》之处是多么的大呵。——之机，为了他的收罗人心而作的。
"Hindenburg" (Hindenburg) is the election of this old general as the commander - this is a great reflection of the films "Philip the Great" and "Bismarck". ——The opportunity was made for him to win people's hearts.一九二七年春，德意志国权党领袖之一，奥古斯德·霞尔书店的事实上的所有者福干培克，乘德国大公司之一乌发公司的财政危机，买进了那股票的过半，坐了乌发公司总经理的交椅了。于是德国的电影事业和那影响力，便全捏在国权党的手里。福干培克立刻在乌发公司的出品计划上，露骨地显示了他的政治底主张。那最是世界底的例子，是《世界大战》（Weltkrieg）的二部作。
In the spring of 1927, one of the leaders of the German National Rights Party, the de facto owner of the bookstore Auguste Charles, Fogg, took advantage of the financial crisis of the Ufa Company, one of the largest German companies, to buy more than half of the shares and took the position of general manager of the Ufa Company. So Germany's film industry and its influence were all in the hands of the National Rights Party. Fuganpek immediately blatantly showed his political propositions on the production plan of Wufa Company. The most world-class example is the second part of "Weltkrieg".对于这，社会民主党的内阁便即刻取了牵制底手段。就是，使德意志银行来对抗福干培克，投资于乌发公司。为了使德国的独占底大电影公司不成为国权党宣传机关，这是不得已的方法。
In response, the cabinet of the Social Democrats immediately took the measure of containment. That is, to make Deutsche Bank fight against Fugan Peck and invest in Ufa. In order to prevent Germany's monopoly film companies from becoming propaganda organs of the National Power Party, this is a last resort.《世界大战》已有删节的片子，绍介于日本（译者按：在上海，去年也大演了一通），那是有着怎样的倾向和主张的事，大约现在早可以无须详说了罢。
"War of the Worlds" has been abridged, and it is set in Japan (translator's note: in Shanghai, it was also performed last year), and what kind of tendencies and propositions it has is probably not necessary to go into detail now.在表面上所标榜的，《世界大战》是将一九一四年至一九一七年的战争中所摄的各国（大抵是德法）的照片，凭了纯粹的历史底客观而编辑的留在软片上的记录。
On the surface, "The War of the Worlds" is a record of the photographs taken in the war from 1914 to 1917 (mainly Germany and France) and objectively edited on the film based on pure historical background.而且这比起专一描写本国军队的胜利的，勇敢的，爱国的亚美利加式电影来，也真好像近于写实。然而注意较深的观察者，却即刻可以看见。从丹南培克之战起，常只将兴登堡将军的胜利，重复地映出了好几回。而且和写着“在战时屡救祖国的将军，当平和时，也作为大统领而尽力于祖国”等语的字幕一同，这电影也就完结了。
And this really seems close to realism compared to the brave, patriotic American-Canadian movies that depict the victory of the country's army. However, the observer who pays deep attention can see it immediately. From the Battle of Dannampek, the victory of General Hindenburg was often repeatedly reflected several times. And with the subtitles that say, "The general who repeatedly saved the motherland in wartime, and when peace, he also did his best for the motherland as a great commander", the movie ended.

五　电影和宗教

现代电影与有产阶级

5. Cinema and religion通一切时代，宗教一向在供支配阶级的御用，是已经证明了许多次数的。
Throughout all times, religion has always been used by the ruling class, and it has been proven many times.这在东洋，则教人以佛教底的忍从和蔑视现世，在西方，则成为基督教底平和主义，想阻止现存的阶级社会的积极底改革。
In the East, it teaches people to endure and despise the world with Buddhism, and in the West, it becomes Christian pacifism, trying to prevent the active reform of the existing class society.到二十世纪，宗教虽然已经失却了昔日的权威和信仰，但倒是因为失却，所以对于那支配阶级的奴仆状态，也就愈加露骨，故意起来了。
By the twentieth century, although religion had lost its former authority and belief, it had become more and more explicit and deliberate about the slavery of the ruling class.在物质文明发达较迟的国度中，宗教还有着大大的宣传煽动力。资本主义于是将宗教和电影相结合，能够同时利用了。
In countries with late development of material civilization, religion also has a great propaganda and incitement force. Capitalism then combined religion and cinema to make use of it at the same time.例如，《十诫》（The Ten Commandments），《基督教徒》（Christian），《宾汉》（Ben Hur），《万王之王》（King of Kings），《犹太之王，拿撒勒的耶稣》（I．N．R．I．）之类的基督教宣传电影，《亚细亚之光》（Die Leuchte Asiens），《大圣日莲》之类的佛教电影，是和感激之泪一同，从全世界的愚夫愚妇，善男信女的衣袋里，赚得确实的布施，从商业底方面看起来，也是利益最多的影片。一切宗派中，罗马加特力教会是最留意于电影的利用的，每年开一回电影会议，议定着那一年中全世界底宣传的计划。
For example, Christian propaganda films such as "The Ten Commandments", "Christian", "Ben Hur", "King of Kings", "Jesus of Nazareth" (I.N.R.I.), "Die Leuchte Asiens" (Light of Asia), "Great Saint Nichiren" and other Buddhist films are along with tears of gratitude, From the pockets of foolish men and women all over the world, good men and women, it is also the film with the most benefits from the perspective of business. Of all the denominations, the Roman Carthelle Church paid the most attention to the use of cinema, holding a film conference every year to decide on a plan for worldwide propaganda during that year.在我们的周围，宗教之力早已几乎视若无物了。至多，也不过本愿寺，日莲宗之流，组织了巡行电影团，竭力想维系些乡下农民的信仰。然而因此便推定宗教的世界底无力，是不可以的。只要看在苏维埃的文化革命的历程中，还不能放掉对于宗教的斗争，而在实行的事实，大概就可以明白其间情势了。
Around us, the power of religion has long been almost nonexistent. At most, it is no more than Honganji Temple, Nichiren Buddhism, and other groups organized touring film troupes to try their best to maintain the faith of some rural farmers. However, it is not permissible to assume that religion is powerless in the world. As long as we look at the course of the Soviet Cultural Revolution, we cannot let go of the struggle against religion, but in the facts of its implementation, we can probably understand the situation in between.

现代电影与有产阶级

6. Cinema and the proletariat为资本主义底生产方法和有产者政府的监视所拘束的现今电影的一切，几乎都被用于拥护有产阶级的事，我相信是已经很明显了的。
I believe it is already clear that almost everything in today's cinema, constrained by the capitalist method of production and the surveillance of the proletarian government, is used to support the proletariat.但在这里，却将电影和有产阶级的关系，限于较狭的意义，只来论及直接服役于市民有产阶级的光荣和支配的电影这一种。
However, here, the relationship between film and the proletariat is limited to a narrower meaning, and only the glory and domination of the proletariat are discussed.这种电影，可以分成三样概括底区别。
This kind of movie can be divided into three general differences.那第一种，是和封建底，乃至贵族底社会相对抗，而尽讴歌有产阶级之胜利的任务的。因此那全部，几乎都是取材于市民底社会的勃兴的历史影片。××，或者××的野兽底横暴，在其下尝着涂炭之苦的农民，工商阶级。到影片的第七卷，而有产阶级终于蜂起，将电影底的极顶（Climax）和壮大的群集（mob scene），在这里大行展开，这是那典型底的结构。但在大多数的影片上，有产阶级是决不作为一个阶级底总体而蹶起的，大抵由一个（往往是贵族出身，年青，而又眉目秀丽的！）英雄所指导，力点就放在那个人底的英雄主义上。作为那最是性格底的作品，读者只要记起《罗宾汉》（Robin Hood），《斯凯拉谟修》（Scaramouche），《定情之夕》（A Night of Love）来，大约就足够了。在日本的时代剧，尤其是剑剧影片之中，我们也有那不少的例子。
The first is to oppose the feudal and even aristocratic society, and to praise the task of the victory of the proletariat. Therefore, almost all of them are historical films based on the rise of civil society. ××, or the ×× beast, the peasants, the industrial and commercial class who are suffering under it. By the seventh volume of the film, the proletariat finally rose up, and the climax and the large cluster (mob scene) of the film unfolded here, which is the typical structure of the bottom. But in most films, the proletariat is never raised as a class as a whole, and is probably made up of a (often aristocratic, young, and beautiful!) The hero is guided, and the focus is on the heroism of that person. As the most characteristic work, it is probably enough for readers to remember "Robin Hood", "Scaramouche", and "A Night of Love". In Japanese period dramas, especially sword drama films, we also have many examples.但是，我们又能够在那历史底时代，发见新兴有产阶级所演的革命的脚色，和现在的无产阶级的斗争，其间有很大的类似（Analogie）。倘作者将意识底的强音（Akzent）集中于此的时候，是可以产生优秀的作品的。如《熊的结婚》，《农奴之翼》，《斯各丁城》，《忠次旅行日记》等，便是那仅少的代表。
However, we can also find that the revolution played by the emerging proletariat in that historical era is very similar to the struggle of the proletariat today. If the author concentrates the strong sound (Akzent) at the bottom of his consciousness here, he can produce excellent works. For example, "The Marriage of the Bear", "Serf Wings", "Scotting City", "Tadaji's Travel Diary", etc., are the few representatives.
第二种，是反对无产阶级革命的电影。
The second type is a film against the proletarian revolution.《党人魂》（Volga Boatman）是当内务省检阅之际，惹起了大问题，终于遭了警视厅来制限其开映的忧患的影片，但那内容是什么呢？
"Volga Boatman" is a film that caused a big problem when it was reviewed by the Ministry of the Interior, and was finally restricted by the Metropolitan Police Department to restrict its release, but what is the content?《大暴动》（Tempest；译者按：在上海映演时，名《狂风暴雨》）也靠了长有数卷的小插画，这才好容易得以许可开演的影片，然而那所选的是怎样的主题呢？
"Tempest; Translator's note: When it was screened in Shanghai, it was called "Storm") also relied on several volumes of vignettes, so it was easy to get permission to start the film, but what kind of theme was chosen?这些影片，是只在用俄国的无产阶级革命为背景这一点上，因而遭了禁止，或重大的删剪的。但要之，那所描写，是将无产阶级革命当作了无统制的暴民的一揆。无教育而不道德的农民和劳动者，倚恃着多数，攻入贵族的城堡去，破坏家具，××美丽的少女，酗酒，单喜欢流血。那是在无产阶级的胜利上，特地蒙上暴虐的假面，涂些污泥，使小市民变成反革命起见而作的有产阶级的××。我们于此，看见了如拥护有产者社会而设的宣传电影，却被×××××××的××所禁止的那种奇怪而且愉快的现象了。
These films were banned or significantly deleted only because they were based on the Russian proletarian revolution. But in short, the description is a manifestation of the proletarian revolution as a mob without command. Uneducated and immoral peasants and laborers, relying on the majority, invaded the castles of the nobility, destroyed furniture, ×× beautiful girls, drank heavily, and only liked to bleed. It was on the victory of the proletariat that they specially covered the mask of tyranny and smeared some sludge to turn the small townspeople into proletarian ×× for the sake of counter-revolution. Here we see the strange and pleasant phenomenon of propaganda films designed to support the society of the proletariat, but are banned by ××××××× ××.固然，在《约翰南伊之爱》（Liebe der Jeanne Ney）和《最后的命令》（The Last Command）上，剪去了十月革命，那却是检阅者十分做了他所该做的事的。
Of course, the October Revolution was cut out in "Liebe der Jeanne Ney" and "The Last Command", but the reviewer did what he was supposed to do.
最后，就来了以《大都会》（Metropolis；译者按：在上海映演时，名《科学世界》）为典型的劳资调和电影的一连串。
Finally, there is the "Metropolis; Translator's note: When it was screened in Shanghai, it was called "Science World") is a series of typical labor-management reconciliation films.关于《大都会》，现在已经无须在这里缕述了。那是揭着“头和手之间，非有心脏不可”这标语的社会民主主义者，宣讲着资本家和劳动者可以不由战争，但靠相互底的协力与爱，即能建设新社会云云的巴培尔塔以前的童话。
There is no need to elaborate on "Metropolis" here. It was the social democrats who unveiled the slogan "Between the head and the hand, there must be a heart", preaching the fairy tale before the capitalists and workers that could build a new society without war, but by mutual cooperation and love.

现代电影与有产阶级

7. Movies and Little Citizens有产阶级的电影底宣传，一到阶级间的对立逐渐鲜明地，决定底地尖锐起来，也就陷在无可避免的绝地里了。
The proletarian film propaganda, as soon as the opposition between classes gradually becomes clear, decides to become sharp, and it will fall into the inevitable Jedi.在实际上，电影是以大多数的小市民和无产阶级为看客的。而他们，小市民和无产阶级，早已渐渐地觉察出有产阶级的诡计来了。就是，已经注意于“支配阶级制作了宣布那服从于己的观念形态的影片，而以此来做掠取无产者的衣袋的手段”这事实的真相了。
In practice, the film is aimed at the majority of the small townspeople and the proletariat. And they, the petty citizens and the proletariat, have already gradually become aware of the trickery of the proletariat. It has already paid attention to the fact that "the ruling class has made a film that proclaims the ideological form subordinate to itself, and uses it as a means of plundering the pockets of the proletariat".卢那卡尔斯基关于苏维埃电影，曾经说明过“拙劣的煽动，却招致反对的结果”这原则，在这里，却被有产者底地应用了。
Lunakarsky once stated the principle of "clumsy incitement leads to opposition" in Soviet cinema, but here it is applied by the proletarians.露骨的宣传是停止了。最所希望的，是使电影的看客看不见“阶级”这观念。至少，是坐在银幕之前的数小时中，使他们忘却了一切社会底对立。
The explicit propaganda is stopped. What I hope most is to make the concept of "class" invisible to the audience of the film. At least, it is the hours of sitting in front of the screen that make them forget all social antagonism.这样子，就产生了小市民的影片。
In this way, a film of small citizens was produced.在小市民家庭剧中，有两种特征底的倾向——
In the family drama of the small citizen, there are two tendencies of the bottom of the characteristics -一，是那罗曼主义。
First, it is Romanticism.二，是那弄玄妙（Sophistication）。
Second, it is the Sophistication.粗粗一看，则现在的电影，尤其是电影剧，乃是写实主义底的。而且许多人们，都抱着这样的幻想。但其实，除了极少数的第一流作品以外，一切全没有什么现实底的申诉的。
At a glance, today's movies, especially film dramas, are based on realism. And many people have such illusions. But in fact, except for a very few first-rate works, there is no realistic complaint at all.自然，虽说是罗曼主义，但和给十九世纪时有产阶级革命的艺术以特征的那生着火焰之翼的罗曼主义，是不一样的。这是为了平庸，近视，乐天底的小市民们而设的，也是平庸，近视，乐天底的罗曼主义。这于迭克萨的农民，芝加各的公司人员，亚理梭那的牧童，纽借那的送牛奶人，纽约的速记生，毕兹巴格的野球选手，东京的中学生，横滨的水手，无不相宜。说起来，就是Ready-made（现成）的罗曼主义。作为那象征底的形相，则有珂林·谟亚（Collin Moore），瑙玛·希拉（Norma Shearer），克莱拉·宝（Clara Bow），从一九二六年起，顺次登场来了。就是那样程度的罗曼主义。
Naturally, although it is romanticism, it is not the same as the romanticism with wings of flame that characterized the art of the proletarian revolution in the nineteenth century. This is for mediocre, myopic, optimistic citizens, and mediocre, myopia, optimistic romanticism. This is suitable for farmers in Dixa, company workers in Chigako, shepherd boys in Arizona, milkmen in New York, stenographers in New York, baseball players in Bizbarger, junior high school students in Tokyo, sailors in Yokohama, etc. Speaking of which, it is ready-made romanticism. As the symbolic figure, there are Collin Moore, Norma Shearer, and Clara Bow, who have appeared in turn since 1926. That's the level of romanticism.每星期薪水（美金）二十五元的大学生出身的公司职员和美尔顿百货公司的娇娃的恋爱故事。珂尼·爱兰特。新福特式的跑车。爵兹乐舞。打猎。
The love story of a college student who earns a salary of 25 yuan a week (US dollars) and a beautiful baby in Milton Department Store. Kenny Ehrant. A new Ford-style sports car. Honor this music and dance. Hunt.至于这花旗罗曼主义上所必要的此外的布置和氛围气，则读者倘一看《Vanity Fair》的广告栏，更所希望的，是往就近的电影馆，一赏鉴任何的亚美利加影片，大约便能自己领悟的罢。
As for the other arrangements and atmospheres necessary for this Citi romanticism, if the reader looks at the advertising board of "Vanity Fair", what he hopes is to go to the nearest cinema and appreciate any American film, he will probably be able to understand it himself.读者必须明白，这小市民底的罗曼主义，是和亚美利加资本主义还在走着上行线的这一个公式底认识，有不可分的关联的。这事实，在一方面，是每年将九十亿元的国帑，撒在有产阶级的怀中，而使发生了叫作所谓“Four Hundreds”的有闲阶级，利子生活者的大群。
The reader must understand that the romanticism of this petty citizen is inseparably related to the understanding of the formula that American capitalism is still on the upward line. On the one hand, this fact is that 9 billion yuan of national treasury is scattered in the arms of the proletariat every year, resulting in a large group of idle classes called the "Four Hundreds", who live on profit.而且有闲阶级，利子生活者的大群，则使他本身的消费底文化，娱乐机关，极端地发达起来了。而从那消费底文化的母胎中，就酦酵了为一切文化烂熟期之特色的一种像煞有介事，通人趣味，低徊趣味，讽刺，冷嘲等。这过度地洗炼了的生活感情，他们称之为Sophistication。卖弄巴黎式的Chic，以及花旗式地解释了的hard-boiled之类的话，都和这相关联，而为人们所欢喜。
Moreover, the large group of idle class and profit-making people has made his own consumer base culture and entertainment institutions extremely developed. And from the womb of the consumer culture, it is fermented as a characteristic of the mature period of all cultures, such as being serious, interesting, low-minded, sarcastic, cynical, etc. This is an overly refined feeling of life, which they call Sophistication. Words like Parisian Chic and Citi-style explanations like hard-boiled are associated with this and are appreciated by people.卓别林在《巴黎一妇人》（A Woman of Paris）里，居然表现了那Sophistication的模范（Prototype）。刘别谦（Ernst Lubitsch）在《婚姻范围》（Marriage Circle）里，表现于一套片子上面了。蒙太·培尔，玛尔·辛克莱儿，泰巴第·达赖尔等许多后继者们，都发挥了电影界的玄妙家腔调。
Chaplin actually showed the prototype of Sophistication in "A Woman of Paris". Ernst Lubitsch appeared in a set of films in "Marriage Circle". Monta-Pehr, Mar Sinclair, Thai Dalil and many other successors have played the mysterious tone of the film industry.但是，亚美利加虽在那一切的资本主义底兴隆，但本身之中，却已经包藏着到底消除不尽的内底矛盾，而在苦闷。消费不能相副的一面底生产，失了投资市场的大金融资本，荷佛政府的积极底外交，拥抱着五百万失业者的天国亚美利加，现在是正踏在不可掩饰的阶级底对立的顶上了。
However, although America is prosperous under all capitalism, it already contains inexhaustible internal contradictions and is distressed. The positive diplomacy of the Hofer government, which embraces the heavenly land of five million unemployed people, is now stepping on the top of the unconcealable class opposition.这社会情势，将怎样地反映在亚美利加影片之中呢，那是很有兴味的将来的问题。
How this social situation will be reflected in American films is a very interesting question for the future.

Please allow me to state what I regret. ”但我偶然读到了这一篇，却觉得于自己很有裨益。上海的日报上，电影的广告每天大概总有两大张，纷纷然竞夸其演员几万人，费用几百万，“非常的风情，浪漫，香艳（或哀艳），肉感，滑稽，恋爱，热情，冒险，勇壮，武侠，神怪……空前巨片”，真令人觉得倘不前去一看，怕要死不瞑目似的。现在用这小镜子一照，就知道这些宝贝，十之九都可以归纳在文中所举的某一类，用意如何，目的何在，都明明白白了。但那些影片，本非以中国人为对象而作，所以运入中国的目的，也就和制作时候的用意不同，只如将陈旧枪炮，卖给武人一样，多吸收一些金钱而已。而中国人对于这些的见解，当然也和他们的本国人两样，只看广告中借以吸引看客的句子，便分明可知，于各类影片，大抵都只见其“非常风情，浪漫，香艳（或哀艳），肉感……”了。然而，冥冥中也还有功效在，看见他们“勇壮武侠”的战事巨片，不意中也会觉得主人如此英武，自己只好做奴才，看见他们“非常风情浪漫”的爱情巨片，便觉得太太如此“肉感”，真没有法子办——自惭形秽，虽然嫖白俄妓女以自慰，现在是还可以做到的。非洲土人顶喜欢白人的洋枪，美洲黑人常要强奸白人的妇女，虽遭火刑，也不能吓绝，就因看了他们的实际上的“巨片”的缘故。然而文野不同，中国人是古文明国人，大约只是心折而不至于实做的了。
But I read this article by chance and felt that it was very beneficial to me. In the Shanghai Daily, there are always about two large advertisements for movies every day, and they have praised their actors by tens of thousands and costing millions, "very charming, romantic, fragrant (or sad), sensual, funny, in love, passionate, adventurous, brave, martial arts, monsters...... Unprecedented blockbuster", it really makes people feel that if they don't go to see it, they are afraid of dying. Now with this small mirror, you can know that nine out of ten of these treasures can be summarized in a certain category listed in the article, and the intention and purpose are all clear. But those films were not made for Chinese, so the purpose of transporting them into China was different from the intention at the time of production, just like selling old guns to warriors, just to absorb more money. And Chinese opinions on these are of course different from their own people, just look at the sentences in the advertisement to attract the audience, and it is clear that in all kinds of films, they are mostly "very charming, romantic, fragrant (or sad), and sensual ......". However, there is also an effect in the dark, seeing their "brave martial arts" war blockbuster, unintentionally feeling that the master is so heroic, he has to be a slave, seeing their "very romantic and romantic" love blockbuster, I feel that the wife is so "fleshy", there is really no way to do it - ashamed of myself, although I prostitute a white Russian prostitute to masturbate, I can still do it now. African natives like white people's foreign guns, and black Americans often rape white women, even if they are burned at the stake, they cannot be frightened, just because they have seen their actual "blockbuster movies". However, Wen Ye is different, the Chinese are ancient civilizations, and they are probably just heartbroken and not practical.因为自己看过之后，大略发生了如上的感想，因此也想介绍给一部分的读者，费去许多工夫，译出来了。原文本是很简短的，只因为我于电影一道是门外汉，虽是平常的术语，也须查考，这就比别人烦难得多，即如有几个题目，便是从去年的旧报上翻出来的，查不到的，则只好“硬译”，而且误译之处，也恐怕决不能免。但就大体而言，我相信于读者总可以有一些贡献。
Because after reading it, I roughly had the above impressions, so I also wanted to introduce it to some readers, and it took a lot of effort to translate it. The original text is very short, just because I am a layman in the movie, although it is an ordinary term, it must be checked, which is much more troublesome than others, that is, if there are a few topics, they are turned out from last year's old newspaper, and if they cannot be found, they have to be "hard translated", and the mistranslation is probably inevitable. But in general, I believe that readers can always have some contributions.去年，美国的“武侠明星”范朋克（Douglas Fairbanks）因为美金积得太多，到东洋来游历了。上海有几个团体便豫备欢迎。中国本来有“捧戏子”的脾气，加以唐宋以来，偷生的小市民就已崇拜替自己打不平的“剑侠”，于是《七侠五义》，《七剑十八侠》，《荒山怪侠》，《荒林女侠》，……层出不穷；看了电影，就佩服洋《七侠五义》即《三剑客》之类。古洋侠客往矣，只好佩服扮洋侠客的洋戏子，算是“过屠门而大嚼，虽不得肉，亦且快意”，正如捧梅兰芳者，和他所扮的天女，黛玉等辈，决不能说无关一样，原是不足怪的。但有些人们反对了，说他在演《月宫宝盒》（The Thief of Bagdad）时摔死蒙古太子，辱没了中国。其实呢，《月宫宝盒》中的英雄，以一偷儿连爬了两段阶级的梯子，终于做了驸马，正是译文第七章细注里所说，要使小市民或无产者“为这飞腾故事所激励，觉得要誓必尽忠于有产阶级”的玩艺，决不是意在辱没中国的东西。况且故事出于《一千一夜》，范朋克并非作家，也不是导演，我们又不是蒙古太子的子孙或奴才，正不必对于他，为美金而演剧的个人，如此之忿忿。但既然无端忿忿了，这也是中国常有的惯例，不足怪的，——在见惯者。后来范朋克到了，终于有团体要欢迎，然而大碰钉子，“范氏代表谓范氏绝对不允赴公共宴会”，竟不能得到瞻仰洋侠客的光荣。待到范朋克“到日本后，一切游程，均由日人代为规定，且到东京后，将赴影戏院，与日本民众相见”（见十八年十二月十九日《申报》），我们这里的蒙古王孙乃更不胜其没落之感，上海电影公会有一封宛转抑扬的信，寄给这“大艺术家”。全文是极有可供研究的处所的，但这里限于纸面，只好摘录了一点——
Last year, American "martial arts star" Douglas Fairbanks traveled to the East because he had accumulated too much US dollars. Several groups in Shanghai are ready to welcome it. China originally had the temper of "holding the actor", and since the Tang and Song dynasties, the small citizens who have survived have worshipped the "swordsman" who fought for them, so "Seven Heroes and Five Righteousness", "Seven Swords and Eighteen Heroes", "Strange Heroes of the Barren Mountain", "Woman of the Wilderness Forest",...... Endless; After watching the movie, I admired Yang's "Seven Heroes and Five Righteousness", that is, "The Three Musketeers". The ancient foreign knights are gone, so I have to admire the foreign actors who play the foreign knights, which can be regarded as "chewing through the butcher's door, although they can't get meat, but they are also happy", just like the one who holds Mei Lanfang, and the heavenly maiden he pretended to be, Daiyu and others, must not be said to be irrelevant, it is not surprising. But some people objected, saying that he had humiliated China by killing a Mongolian prince while performing "The Thief of Bagdad." In fact, the hero in "The Treasure Box of the Moon Palace", who climbed two ladders of class in a row as a thief, finally became a son-in-law, which is exactly what is said in the detailed note of Chapter 7 of the translation, to make the small citizens or proletarians "inspired by this soaring story and feel that they must swear to be loyal to the proletariat", is by no means intended to humiliate China. Moreover, the story is from "One Thousand and One Nights", Fan Punk is not a writer, nor a director, and we are not the descendants or servants of the Mongolian prince, so there is no need to be so angry with him, the individual who acts for the US dollar. But since there is unwarranted anger, this is also a common practice in China, and it is not surprising that ,—— are accustomed to it. Later, Fan Punk arrived, and finally a group wanted to welcome him, but he hit the nail, "Fan's representative said that Fan was absolutely not allowed to go to a public banquet", and he could not get the honor of paying homage to foreign knights. When Fan Punk "arrives in Japan, all the itinerary is stipulated by the Japanese, and after arriving in Tokyo, he will go to the cinema to meet the Japanese people" (see the "Declaration" of December 19, 18th year), and our Mongolian prince Sun Nai here is even more overwhelmed by his sense of decline, and the Shanghai Film Guild has a twisted and intonated letter sent to this "great artist". The full text is very suitable for research, but this is limited to paper, so I have to excerpt a little -“曾忆《月宫宝盒》剧中，有一蒙古太子，其表演状态，至为恶劣，足使观者之未知东方历史，未悉东方民族性质者，发生不良之印象，而能成为人类相爱进程上绝大之阻碍。因东方中华民国人民之状态，并不如其所表演之恶劣也。敝会同人，深知电影艺术之能力，转辗为全世界一切民情风俗智识学问之介绍，换言之，亦能引导全世界人彼此之相爱，及世界人类彼此之相憎。敝会同人以爱先生故，以先生为大艺术家故，愿先生为向善之努力，不愿先生如他人之对世界为不真实之介绍，而为盛誉之累也。”
I once recalled that in the play "Moon Palace Treasure Box", there was a Mongolian prince, whose performance state was extremely bad, enough to make the audience not know the history of the East and the nature of the oriental nation, and have a bad impression, and can become a huge obstacle to the process of human love. Because the state of the people of the Republic of China in the East is not as bad as the performance is as bad as it is. Our fellow people are well aware of the ability of film art, and it has turned into an introduction to all the people's customs, customs, and knowledge in the world, in other words, it can also guide people all over the world to love each other and the world's human beings to hate each other. Because we love Mr. Tai and Mr. Ye are great artists, we hope that Mr. Trump will strive for goodness, and we do not want Mr. Trump to be an untrue introduction to the world like others, and will be a burden to his reputation. ”文中说电影对于看客的力量的伟大，是很不错的，但以为蒙古太子就是“中华民国人民”，却与反对欢迎者流，同一错误。尤其错误的是要劝范朋克去引“全世界人彼此之相爱”，忘却了他是花旗国里发了财的电影员。因此一念之差，所以竟弄到低声下气，托他去绍介真实的“四千余年历史文化所训练的精神”于世界了——
The article says that the greatness of the movie for the audience is very good, but thinking that the Mongolian prince is the "people of the Republic of China" is the same mistake as opposing the welcome. It is particularly wrong to persuade Fan Punk to lead "people all over the world to love each other", forgetting that he is a filmmaker who made a fortune in Citi Country. Therefore, the difference in thought, so he actually made a low voice and asked him to introduce the real "spirit trained by more than 4,000 years of history and culture" to the world——“敝会同人更敢以经过四千余年历史文化训练之精神，大声以告先生。我中华人民之尊重美德，深用礼仪，初不异于贵国之人民。更以贵国政府常能于世界国际间主持公道，故为我中华人民所敬爱。先生于此次东游小住中，想已见到真实之证据。今日我中华政治之状态，方在革命完成应经历之过程中，有国内之战争，有不安静之纷扰，然中华人民对于外来宾客如先生者，仍能不忘应有之礼节，表示爱人之风度。此种情形，先生当能于耳目交接之间，为真实之明了。虽间有表示不同之言论者，然此种言论，皆为先生代表以及代表引为己助参加发言者不合礼节隔离人情之宣言及表示所造成。……
"Our members dare to tell Mr. Loudly in the spirit of more than 4,000 years of historical and cultural training. Our Chinese people respect virtue and use etiquette deeply, which is no different from the people of your country. Moreover, because your government can often uphold justice in the world and internationally, it is respected and loved by our Chinese people. During this short stay in the east, Mr. thought he had seen real evidence. Today, the state of Chinese politics is in the process of completing the revolution, there are domestic wars and unquiet turmoil, but the Chinese people can still remember the proper etiquette and show their love for foreign guests such as Mr. In this situation, you should be able to understand the truth between the ears and eyes. Although there are occasional expressions of different remarks, such remarks are caused by Mr. Representative and the representative who is used as his own assistant to participate in the speech and the declaration and expression of impropriety and isolation. ……“希望先生于东游之后，以所得真实之情状，介绍于贵国之同业，进而介绍于世界，使世界之人类与中华所有四万万余之人民为相爱之亲近，勿为相憎之背驰，以形成世界不良之情状，使我中华人民之敬爱先生，一如敬爱美国之政府。”
"I hope that after the journey to the east, Mr. will introduce the real situation to your country's colleagues, and then introduce it to the world, so that the human beings in the world and all the more than 40 million people in China will be close to each other, and do not turn away from each other, so as to form a bad situation in the world, so that our Chinese people will respect Mr. as much as the government of the United States."但所说明的精神，一言以蔽之，是咱们蒙古王孙即使国内如何战争，纷扰，而对于洋大人是极其有礼的。就是这一点。
But the spirit of the explanation is, in a word, that no matter how our Mongolian princes and grandsons are at war and disturbing in the country, they are extremely polite to foreigners. That's it.这正是被压服的古国人民的精神，尤其是在租界上。因为被压服了，所以自视无力，只好托人向世界去宣传，而不免有些谄；但又因为自以为是“经过四千余年历史文化训练”的，还可以托人向世界去宣传，所以仍然有些骄。骄和谄相纠结的，是没落的古国人民的精神的特色。
This is the spirit of the people of the ancient country who were suppressed, especially in the concession. Because he was suppressed, he thought he was powerless, so he had to ask others to publicize it to the world, which was inevitably a little flattering; But because he thinks that he has "undergone more than 4,000 years of historical and cultural training" and can still ask others to publicize it to the world, he is still a little arrogant. Pride and flattery are entangled in the spirit of the people of the declining ancient country.欧美帝国主义者既然用了废枪，使中国战争，纷扰，又用了旧影片使中国人惊异，胡涂。更旧之后，便又运入内地，以扩大其令人胡涂的教化。我想，如《电影和资本主义》那样的书，现在是万不可少了！
Since the European and American imperialists used scrap guns to make China war and disturbance, they also used old films to surprise the Chinese and make them foolish. After the old ones, they were transported to the mainland to expand their foolish education. I think books like "Cinema and Capitalism" are now indispensable!一九三〇，一，十六，L。

Inscription一两年前，上海有一位文学家，现在是好像不在这里了，那时候，却常常拉别人为材料，来写她的所谓“素描”。我也没有被赦免。据说，我极喜欢演说，但讲话的时候是口吃的，至于用语，则是南腔北调。前两点我很惊奇，后一点可是十分佩服了。真的，我不会说绵软的苏白，不会打响亮的京腔，不入调，不入流，实在是南腔北调。而且近几年来，这缺点还有开拓到文字上去的趋势；《语丝》早经停刊，没有了任意说话的地方，打杂的笔墨，是也得给各个编辑者设身处地地想一想的，于是文章也就不能划一不二，可说之处说一点，不能说之处便罢休。即使在电影上，不也有时看得见黑奴怒形于色的时候，一有同是黑奴而手里拿着皮鞭的走过来，便赶紧低下头去么？我也毫不强横。
A year or two ago, there was a writer in Shanghai, but now it seems that he is no longer here, but at that time, he often used others as materials to write her so-called "sketches". I am not forgiven either. It is said that I like to speak very much, but I stutter when I speak, and as for the language, it is a southern accent and a northern accent. I was surprised by the first two points, but I admired the last one very much. Really, I won't say that the soft Su Bai, the loud Beijing accent, not in the tune, not in the flow, it is really the southern accent and the north. And in recent years, this shortcoming has also been expanded to words; "Yusi" has long been discontinued, there is no place to speak arbitrarily, and the miscellaneous pen and ink have to be put in the shoes of each editor, so the article cannot be uniform. Even in movies, isn't there sometimes a time when you can see the black slave angry, as soon as someone who is also a black slave and comes over with a leather whip in his hand, he quickly lowers his head? I am not overbearing.一俯一仰，居然又到年底，邻近有几家放鞭爆，原来一过夜，就要“天增岁月人增寿”了。静着没事，有意无意的翻出这两年所作的杂文稿子来，排了一下，看看已经足够印成一本，同时记得了那上面所说的“素描”里的话，便名之曰《南腔北调集》，准备和还未成书的将来的《五讲三嘘集》配对。我在私塾里读书时，对过对，这积习至今没有洗干净，题目上有时就玩些什么《偶成》，《漫与》，《作文秘诀》，《捣鬼心传》，这回却闹到书名上来了。这是不足为训的。
It turned out that as soon as it stayed overnight, it would be "increasing the years and increasing the life expectancy". Quietly and nothing, intentionally or unintentionally, I dug out the miscellaneous manuscripts I had made in the past two years, arranged them for a while, and saw that they were enough to print into a book, and at the same time remembered the words in the "sketch" mentioned above, so I named it "Collection of Southern Accents and Northern Tunes", ready to be paired with the future "Five Lectures and Three Hush Collection" that has not yet been written. When I was studying in a private school, yes, this habit has not been washed away so far, and the topics sometimes play something "Occasional Success", "Manyu", "Composition Secret", "The Legend of the Heart of a Ghost", but this time it came to the title of the book. This is not enough to teach.其次，就自己想：今年印过一本《伪自由书》，如果这也付印，那明年就又有一本了。于是自己觉得笑了一笑。这笑，是有些恶意的，因为我这时想到了梁实秋先生，他在北方一面做教授，一面编副刊，一位喽罗儿就在那副刊上说我和美国的门肯（H. L. Mencken）相像，因为每年都要出一本书。每年出一本书就会像每年也出一本书的门肯，那么，吃大菜而做教授，真可以等于美国的白璧德了。低能好像是也可以传授似的。但梁教授极不愿意因他而牵连白璧德，是据说小人的造谣；不过门肯却正是和白璧德相反的人，以我比彼，虽出自徒孙之口，骨子里却还是白老夫子的鬼魂在作怪。指头一拨，君子就翻一个筋斗，我觉得我到底也还有手腕和眼睛。
Secondly, I thought to myself: I printed a copy of the "Pseudo-Freedom Book" this year, and if this is also printed, then there will be another one next year. So I felt a smile. This laughter is a bit malicious, because I thought of Mr. Liang Shiqiu, who was a professor in the north and edited a supplement at the same time, and a servant said in that supplement that I and H. L. Mencken, because a book is published every year. Publishing a book every year will be like Menken, which also publishes a book every year, so eating big dishes and being a professor can really be equal to Bai Bide in the United States. It seems that imbecile can also be taught. However, Professor Liang is extremely unwilling to implicate Bai Bide because of him, which is said to be a rumor spread by villains; However, Menken is the opposite of Bai Bide, comparing me to him, although it comes from the mouth of the disciple, but the ghost of the old master Bai is still causing trouble in his bones. With a flick of his fingers, the gentleman flipped a somersault, and I think I still have wrists and eyes.不过这是小事情。举其大者，则一看去年一月八日所写的《“非所计也”》，就好像着了鬼迷，做了恶梦，胡里胡涂，不久就整两年。怪事随时袭来，我们也随时忘却，倘不重温这些杂感，连我自己做过短评的人，也毫不记得了。一年要出一本书，确也可以使学者们摇头的，然而只有这一本，虽然浅薄，却还借此存留一点遗闻逸事，以中国之大，世变之亟，恐怕也未必就算太多了罢。
But it's a small thing. To name a few, I looked at "It's Not Worth It" written on January 8 last year, as if I was obsessed with ghosts, had nightmares, and was foolish, and soon it would be two whole years. Strange things strike at any time, and we forget them at any time, and if we don't relive these miscellaneous feelings, even the people who have made short reviews myself will not remember them. Publishing a book a year can indeed make scholars shake their heads, but only this one, although shallow, still preserves a little anecdote, with the size of China and the rapid changes in the world, I am afraid it may not be too much.两年来所作的杂文，除登在《自由谈》上者外，几乎都在这里面；书的序跋，却只选了自以为还有几句可取的几篇。曾经登载这些的刊物，是《十字街头》，《文学月报》，《北斗》，《现代》，《涛声》，《论语》，《申报月刊》，《文学》等，当时是大抵用了别的笔名投稿的；但有一篇没有发表过。
Almost all the essays written in the past two years, except for those published in "Free Talk", are here; The preface to the book only chose a few sentences that I thought were still desirable. The publications that once published these were "Cross Street", "Literary Monthly", "Beidou", "Modern", "Taosheng", "Analects", "Declaration Monthly", "Literature", etc., which were mostly submitted under other pseudonyms at that time; But one article was never published.一九三三年十二月三十一日之夜，于上海寓斋记。

“非所计也”

“非所计也”

“非所计也”

“非所计也”新年第一回的《申报》（一月七日）用“要电”告诉我们：“闻陈（外交总长印友仁）与芳泽友谊甚深，外交界观察，芳泽回国任日外长，东省交涉可望以陈之私人感情，得一较好之解决云。”
The first "Declaration" (January 7) of the new year told us with a "telegram": "Wen Chen (Foreign Minister Yin Youren) and Fang Ze have a deep friendship, and the diplomatic circles observe that Fang Ze returned to China to serve as foreign minister, and the negotiations in the eastern province are expected to be resolved with Chen's personal feelings." ”中国的外交界看惯了在中国什么都是“私人感情”，这样的“观察”，原也无足怪的。但从这一个“观察”中，又可以“观察”出“私人感情”在政府里之重要。
China's diplomatic circles are accustomed to seeing everything as "private feelings" in China, and such "observations" are not surprising. But from this "observation", we can also "observe" the importance of "private feelings" in the government.然而同日的《申报》上，又用“要电”告诉了我们：“锦州三日失守，连山绥中续告陷落，日陆战队到山海关在车站悬日旗……”
However, on the same day, the "Declaration" told us with a "telegram": "Jinzhou fell on the third day, Lianshan Suizhong continued to fall, and the Japanese Marine Corps went to Shanhaiguan to hang the Japanese flag at the station......"而同日的《申报》上，又用“要闻”告诉我们“陈友仁对东省问题宣言”云：“……前日已命令张学良固守锦州，积极抵抗，今后仍坚持此旨，决不稍变，即不幸而挫败，非所计也。……”
On the same day, the "Declaration" used "important news" to tell us that "Chen Youren's Declaration on the Eastern Province Issue" said: "...... The day before yesterday, Zhang Xueliang was ordered to stick to Jinzhou and actively resist, and he will continue to adhere to this decree in the future, and will never change in the slightest, that is, it is unfortunate and frustrated, which is not a plan. ……”然则“友谊”和“私人感情”，好像也如“国联”以及“公理”，“正义”之类一样的无效，“暴日”似乎不像中国，专讲这些的，这真只得“不幸而挫败，非所计也”了。
However, "friendship" and "private feelings" seem to be as invalid as "League of Nations", "Axiom", "Justice" and so on, and "Violent Japan" does not seem to be like China, which is really "unfortunate and frustrated, and it is not worth considering".也许爱国志士，又要上京请愿了罢。当然，“爱国热忱”，是“殊堪嘉许”的，但第一自然要不“越轨”，第二还是自己想一想，和内政部长卫戍司令诸大人“友谊”怎样，“私人感情”又怎样。倘不“甚深”，据内政界观察，是不但难“得一较好之解决”，而且——请恕我直言——恐怕仍旧要有人“自行失足落水淹死”的。
Maybe patriots want to go to Beijing to petition again. Of course, "patriotic enthusiasm" is "commendable", but the first is naturally not "deviant", and the second is to think about what the "friendship" is with the Minister of the Interior and the garrison commanders, and what is the "personal feelings". If it is not "very deep", according to the observation of domestic political circles, it will not only be difficult to "get a better solution", but - please forgive me - I am afraid that some people will still "fall into the water and drown".所以未去之前，最好是拟一宣言，结末道：“即不幸而‘自行失足落水淹死’，非所计也！”然而又要觉悟这说的是真话。
So before going, it is best to draft a declaration and conclude: "Even if you are unfortunate and 'fall into the water and drown', it is not a good idea!" However, you must realize that this is the truth.一月八日。
January 8th.

林克多《苏联闻见录》序

林克多《苏联闻见录》序

林克多《苏联闻见录》序

Link has a preface to "Soviet Hearings and Observations"大约总归是十年以前罢，我因为生了病，到一个外国医院去请诊治，在那待诊室里放着的一本德国《星期报》（Die Woche）上，看见了一幅关于俄国十月革命的漫画，画着法官，教师，连医生和看护妇，也都横眉怒目，捏着手枪。这是我最先看见的关于十月革命的讽刺画，但也不过心里想，有这样凶暴么，觉得好笑罢了。后来看了几个西洋人的旅行记，有的说是怎样好，有的又说是怎样坏，这才莫名其妙起来。但到底也是自己断定：这革命恐怕对于穷人有了好处，那么对于阔人就一定是坏的，有些旅行者为穷人设想，所以觉得好，倘若替阔人打算，那自然就都是坏处了。
About ten years ago, when I was sick and went to a foreign hospital for treatment, I saw a cartoon of the October Revolution in Russia in a German newspaper Die Woche in the waiting room, depicting judges, teachers, even doctors and nurses, all glaring and holding pistols. This was the first satirical painting I saw about the October Revolution, but I just thought to myself, is there such a ferocity, I just think it's funny. Later, I read the travel notes of several Westerners, some said how good it was, and some said how bad it was, which made me inexplicable. But in the end, I also concluded that this revolution may be good for the poor, so it must be bad for the broad people.但后来又看见一幅讽刺画，是英文的，画着用纸版剪成的工厂，学校，育儿院等等，竖在道路的两边，使参观者坐着摩托车，从中间驶过。这是针对着做旅行记述说苏联的好处的作者们而发的，犹言参观的时候，受了他们的欺骗。政治和经济的事，我是外行，但看去年苏联煤油和麦子的输出，竟弄得资本主义文明国的人们那么骇怕的事实，却将我多年的疑团消释了。我想：假装面子的国度和专会杀人的人民，是决不会有这么巨大的生产力的，可见那些讽刺画倒是无耻的欺骗。
But then I saw a caricature, in English, depicting factories, schools, nurseries, etc., cut out of paper plates, erected on both sides of the road, so that visitors could ride motorcycles through the middle. This was directed at the authors who made travel accounts about the benefits of the Soviet Union, and when they visited, they were deceived by them. I am a layman in political and economic matters, but the fact that last year's exports of kerosene and wheat from the Soviet Union made people in capitalist civilized countries so frightened has dispelled my doubts for many years. I think: A country that pretends to save face and a people who specialize in killing people will never have such a huge productivity, which shows that those satirical paintings are shameless deception.不过我们中国人实在有一点小毛病，就是不大爱听别国的好处，尤其是清党之后，提起那日有建设的苏联。一提到罢，不是说你意在宣传，就是说你得了卢布。而且宣传这两个字，在中国实在是被糟蹋得太不成样子了，人们看惯了什么阔人的通电，什么会议的宣言，什么名人的谈话，发表之后，立刻无影无踪，还不如一个屁的臭得长久，于是渐以为凡有讲述远处或将来的优点的文字，都是欺人之谈，所谓宣传，只是一个为了自利，而漫天说谎的雅号。
However, we Chinese really have a little problem, that is, we don't like to listen to the benefits of other countries, especially after the Qing Party, when it comes to the Soviet Union that was built that day. When it comes to it, it doesn't mean that you intend to promote it, or that you get rubles. People are used to seeing what kind of electrification, what conference declarations, and what celebrity conversations, after they are published, they immediately disappear, and it is not as good as a fart that stinks for a long time, so they gradually think that any text that talks about the advantages of the distance or the future is deceptive, and the so-called propaganda is just a nickname that lies all over the sky for self-interest.自然，在目前的中国，这一类的东西是常有的，靠了钦定或官许的力量，到处推销无阻，可是读的人们却不多，因为宣传的事，是必须在现在或到后来有事实来证明的，这才可以叫作宣传。而中国现行的所谓宣传，则不但后来只有证明这“宣传”确凿就是说谎的事实而已，还有一种坏结果，是令人对于凡有记述文字逐渐起了疑心，临末弄得索性不看。即如我自己就受了这影响，报章上说的什么新旧三都的伟观，南北两京的新气，固然只要看见标题就觉得肉麻了，而且连讲外国的游记，也竟至于不大想去翻动它。
Naturally, in the current China, this kind of thing is common, relying on the power of the imperial decree or official permission, it is sold everywhere without hindrance, but not many people read it, because the propaganda must be proven by facts now or later, so that it can be called propaganda. The current so-called propaganda in China not only later only proved that this "propaganda" was a lie, but also had a bad result, which gradually made people suspicious of all written texts, and simply ignored them at the end. Even if I myself was affected by this, the grandeur of the old and new capitals mentioned in the newspaper, and the new atmosphere of the north and south capitals, although I felt numb as long as I saw the headline, and even when I talked about foreign travelogues, I didn't really want to turn it over.但这一年内，也遇到了两部不必用心戒备，居然看完了的书，一是胡愈之先生的《莫斯科印象记》，一就是这《苏联闻见录》。因为我的辨认草字的力量太小的缘故，看下去很费力，但为了想看看这自说“为了吃饭问题，不得不去做工”的工人作者的见闻，到底看下去了。虽然中间遇到好像讲解统计表一般的地方，在我自己，未免觉得枯燥，但好在并不多，到底也看下去了。那原因，就在作者仿佛对朋友谈天似的，不用美丽的字眼，不用巧妙的做法，平铺直叙，说了下去，作者是平常的人，文章是平常的文章，所见所闻的苏联，是平平常常的地方，那人民，是平平常常的人物，所设施的正是合于人情，生活也不过像了人样，并没有什么希奇古怪。倘要从中猎艳搜奇，自然免不了会失望，然而要知道一些不搽粉墨的真相，却是很好的。
But during this year, I also encountered two books that I didn't have to be wary of, and I actually finished reading, one is Mr. Hu Yuzhi's "Impressions of Moscow" and the other is "Soviet News and Observations". Because my ability to identify cursive characters is too small, it is very laborious to read, but in order to see the experience of this worker author who said that he had to work for the sake of eating, I read it to the end. Although I encountered a place that seemed to explain the statistical table in the middle, I couldn't help but feel bored, but fortunately, there weren't many, and I read it in the end. The reason is that the author seems to be talking to a friend, without beautiful words, without clever methods, flat and straightforward, the author is an ordinary person, the article is an ordinary article, what he sees and hears in the Soviet Union is an ordinary place, the people are ordinary characters, what they are equipped with is in line with human feelings, and life is just like a human being, and there is nothing strange about it. If you want to hunt for beauty and search for curiosity from it, you will naturally be disappointed, but it is good to know some truths that do not apply powder.而且由此也可以明白一点世界上的资本主义文明国之定要进攻苏联的原因。工农都像了人样，于资本家和地主是极不利的，所以一定先要歼灭了这工农大众的模范。苏联愈平常，他们就愈害怕。前五六年，北京盛传广东的裸体游行，后来南京上海又盛传汉口的裸体游行，就是但愿敌方的不平常的证据。据这书里面的记述，苏联实在使他们失望了。为什么呢？因为不但共妻，杀父，裸体游行等类的“不平常的事”，确然没有而已，倒是有了许多极平常的事实，那就是将“宗教，家庭，财产，祖国，礼教……一切神圣不可侵犯”的东西，都像粪一般抛掉，而一个簇新的，真正空前的社会制度从地狱底里涌现而出，几万万的群众自己做了支配自己命运的人。这种极平常的事情，是只有“匪徒”才干得出来的。该杀者，“匪徒”也。
And from this, we can also understand the reason why the capitalist civilized countries in the world must attack the Soviet Union. Workers and peasants are like human beings, which is extremely unfavorable to capitalists and landlords, so we must first annihilate this model of workers and peasants. The more ordinary the Soviet Union, the more afraid they were. In the first five or six years, the naked parades in Guangdong were popular in Beijing, and later in Nanjing and Shanghai, and the naked parades in Hankou were popular in Nanjing, which was evidence of the enemy's unusualness. According to the account in this book, the Soviet Union really disappointed them. Why? Because not only are there "unusual things" such as co-wife, father-killing, naked parades, etc., but there are many very common facts, that is, "religion, family, property, motherland, etiquette...... Everything that is "sacrosanct" is thrown away like dung, and a cluster of new, truly unprecedented social systems emerge from the bottom of hell, and tens of millions of people themselves become the ones who control their own destiny. This kind of extremely ordinary thing can only be done by "bandits". The killer is a "bandit."但作者的到苏联，已在十月革命后十年，所以只将他们之“能坚苦，耐劳，勇敢与牺牲”告诉我们，而怎样苦斗，才能够得到现在的结果，那些故事，却讲得很少。这自然是别种著作的任务，不能责成作者全都负担起来，但读者是万不可忽略这一点的，否则，就如印度的《譬喻经》所说，要造高楼，而反对在地上立柱，据说是因为他要造的，是离地的高楼一样。
However, the author's arrival in the Soviet Union was ten years after the October Revolution, so he only told us how they were "hardworking, hardworking, brave and sacrificed", and how to fight hard to get the current results, those stories are told very little.
