However, it is still useless to the overall situation, whether it is one or 100,000, at most, it can only be reported to the "League of Nations" again. Last year, everyone talked about how a certain hero of the 19th Route Army killed the enemy, so they forgot the big thing of withdrawing a hundred miles from the whole line, but China actually lost. Moreover, college students don't even have weapons. Now the Chinese news is full of the tyranny of "Manchukuo", saying that it is not allowed to privately hide weapons, but if we people of the Republic of China come to hide a protective thing to try, it will also ruin the family and people will be destroyed,—— Mr. Ah, this is easy to be "used by the reactionaries".施以狮虎式的教育，他们就能用爪牙，施以牛羊式的教育，他们到万分危急时还会用一对可怜的角。然而我们所施的是什么式的教育呢，连小小的角也不能有，则大难临头，惟有兔子似的逃跑而已。自然，就是逃也不见得安稳，谁都说不出那里是安稳之处来，因为到处繁殖了猎狗，诗曰：“趯趯毚兔，遇犬获之”，此之谓也。然则三十六计，固仍以“走”为上计耳。
With liger-like education, they can use their minions and teeth to educate cattle and sheep, and they will use a pair of poor horns when they are extremely critical. However, what kind of education do we give, even small horns cannot be used, then great disaster will come, and we can only run away like rabbits. Naturally, even if you escape, you may not be stable, no one can tell that it is a safe place, because hunting dogs are bred everywhere, and the poem says: "Run the rabbit, meet the dog and catch it", this is what it means. In this case, the thirty-six strategy is still the best strategy to "run".总之，我的意见是：我们不可看得大学生太高，也不可责备他们太重，中国是不能专靠大学生的；大学生逃了之后，却应该想想此后怎样才可以不至于单是逃，脱出诗境，踏上实地去。
In short, my opinion is: we should not look at college students too highly, nor should we blame them for being too heavy. After college students escape, they should think about how they can not just escape, escape from the poetic realm, and set foot on the field.但不知先生以为何如？能给在《涛声》上发表，以备一说否？谨听裁择，并请
I just don't know what you think. Can you give me a chance to publish it in "The Sound of the Waves" for a comment? I will listen to the judgment and request it文安。

为了忘却的记念

为了忘却的记念

为了忘却的记念

For the memory of oblivion一
One我早已想写一点文字，来记念几个青年的作家。这并非为了别的，只因为两年以来，悲愤总时时来袭击我的心，至今没有停止，我很想借此算是竦身一摇，将悲哀摆脱，给自己轻松一下，照直说，就是我倒要将他们忘却了。
I have long wanted to write a little to remember a few young writers. This is not for anything else, just because in the past two years, grief and anger have always attacked my heart, and it has not stopped so far, I really want to use this as a shaking of my body, getting rid of the sadness, and relaxing myself, to put it bluntly, I want to forget them.两年前的此时，即一九三一年的二月七日夜或八日晨，是我们的五个青年作家同时遇害的时候。当时上海的报章都不敢载这件事，或者也许是不愿，或不屑载这件事，只在《文艺新闻》上有一点隐约其辞的文章。那第十一期（五月二十五日）里，有一篇林莽先生作的《白莽印象记》，中间说：
At this time two years ago, on the night of February 7 or the morning of February 8, 1931, five of our young writers were killed at the same time. At that time, the newspapers in Shanghai did not dare to report this matter, or perhaps they were unwilling or disdainful to publish this matter, and only had a vague article in the "Literature and Art News". In the eleventh issue (May 25), there is an article written by Mr. Lin Mang "Impressions of Bai Mang", which says:“他做了好些诗，又译过匈牙利诗人彼得斐的几首诗，当时的《奔流》的编辑者鲁迅接到了他的投稿，便来信要和他会面，但他却是不愿见名人的人，结果是鲁迅自己跑来找他，竭力鼓励他作文学的工作，但他终于不能坐在亭子间里写，又去跑他的路了。不久，他又一次的被了捕。……”
He wrote many poems and translated several poems by the Hungarian poet Peter Fei, and Lu Xun, the editor of "Rush" at that time, received his submission and wrote to meet him, but he was a person who did not want to see celebrities, and as a result, Lu Xun came to him and tried his best to encourage him to do literary work, but he finally could not sit in the pavilion and write, and went his way again. Soon, he was arrested again. ……”这里所说的我们的事情其实是不确的。白莽并没有这么高慢，他曾经到过我的寓所来，但也不是因为我要求和他会面；我也没有这么高慢，对于一位素不相识的投稿者，会轻率的写信去叫他。我们相见的原因很平常，那时他所投的是从德文译出的《彼得斐传》，我就发信去讨原文，原文是载在诗集前面的，邮寄不便，他就亲自送来了。看去是一个二十多岁的青年，面貌很端正，颜色是黑黑的，当时的谈话我已经忘却，只记得他自说姓徐，象山人；我问他为什么代你收信的女士是这么一个怪名字（怎么怪法，现在也忘却了），他说她就喜欢起得这么怪，罗曼谛克，自己也有些和她不大对劲了。就只剩了这一点。
What we say here is actually untrue. Bai Mang was not so arrogant, he had come to my apartment, but not because I asked to meet him; I am not so arrogant, and I will write to a contributor I don't know to call him carelessly. The reason we met was very ordinary, at that time he submitted the "Biography of Peter Fei" translated from German, and I sent a letter to ask for the original text, which was published in front of the poetry collection, and it was inconvenient to mail, so he sent it himself. It seemed to be a young man in his twenties, with a very upright appearance and a black color, and I have forgotten the conversation at that time, only remembering that he said that his surname was Xu, a native of Xiangshan; I asked him why the lady who received the letter on your behalf had such a strange name (how strange it was, I have forgotten it now), and he said that she likes to act so strangely, Roman Dike, and he has a little bit of a problem with her. That's all that remains.夜里，我将译文和原文粗粗的对了一遍，知道除几处误译之外，还有一个故意的曲译。他像是不喜欢“国民诗人”这个字的，都改成“民众诗人”了。第二天又接到他一封来信，说很悔和我相见，他的话多，我的话少，又冷，好像受了一种威压似的。我便写一封回信去解释，说初次相会，说话不多，也是人之常情，并且告诉他不应该由自己的爱憎，将原文改变。因为他的原书留在我这里了，就将我所藏的两本集子送给他，问他可能再译几首诗，以供读者的参看。他果然译了几首，自己拿来了，我们就谈得比第一回多一些。这传和诗，后来就都登在《奔流》第二卷第五本，即最末的一本里。
At night, I roughly matched the translation with the original text, and knew that in addition to a few mistranslations, there was also a deliberate mistranslation. He didn't seem to like the word "national poet", so he changed it to "people's poet". The next day, I received another letter from him, saying that he regretted meeting me, he talked a lot, I talked little, and it was cold, as if he was under a kind of coercion. I wrote a reply letter to explain, saying that it was human nature to meet for the first time and not talk much, and told him that he should not change the original text because of his own love and hate. Because his original book was left with me, I gave him the two collections I had in my collection and asked him if he might translate a few more poems for readers' reference. He really translated a few songs, brought them himself, and we talked more than the first time. This biography and poem were later published in the fifth book of the second volume of "Ben Liu", that is, the last book.我们第三次相见，我记得是在一个热天。有人打门了，我去开门时，来的就是白莽，却穿着一件厚棉袍，汗流满面，彼此都不禁失笑。这时他才告诉我他是一个革命者，刚由被捕而释出，衣服和书籍全被没收了，连我送他的那两本；身上的袍子是从朋友那里借来的，没有夹衫，而必须穿长衣，所以只好这么出汗。我想，这大约就是林莽先生说的“又一次的被了捕”的那一次了。
The third time we met, I remember it was on a hot day. Someone knocked on the door, and when I went to open the door, it was Bai Mang, but he was wearing a thick cotton robe, sweating profusely, and we couldn't help but laugh at each other. Only then did he tell me that he was a revolutionary, who had just been released from his arrest, and all his clothes and books were confiscated, including the two books I gave him; The robe on his body was borrowed from a friend, and he had to wear a long jacket, so he had to sweat like this. I think this is about the time when Mr. Lin Mang said that he was "arrested again".我很欣幸他的得释，就赶紧付给稿费，使他可以买一件夹衫，但一面又很为我的那两本书痛惜：落在捕房的手里，真是明珠投暗了。那两本书，原是极平常的，一本散文，一本诗集，据德文译者说，这是他搜集起来的，虽在匈牙利本国，也还没有这么完全的本子，然而印在《莱克朗氏万有文库》（Reclam’s Universal-Bibliothek）中，倘在德国，就随处可得，也值不到一元钱。不过在我是一种宝贝，因为这是三十年前，正当我热爱彼得斐的时候，特地托丸善书店从德国去买来的，那时还恐怕因为书极便宜，店员不肯经手，开口时非常惴惴。后来大抵带在身边，只是情随事迁，已没有翻译的意思了，这回便决计送给这也如我的那时一样，热爱彼得斐的诗的青年，算是给它寻得了一个好着落。所以还郑重其事，托柔石亲自送去的。谁料竟会落在“三道头”之类的手里的呢，这岂不冤枉！
I was very happy that he was released, so I quickly paid the manuscript fee so that he could buy a jacket, but on the other hand, I deplored my two books: they fell into the hands of the capture room, which was really a pearl in the dark. The two books, originally very ordinary, were an essay and a collection of poems, according to the German translator, which he had collected, although in Hungary itself, there was no such complete book, but printed in Reclam's Universal-Bibliothek, if in Germany, it was available everywhere, and it was worth less than a dollar. But for me, it was a kind of treasure, because thirty years ago, when I was in love with Peter Fei, I specially asked Maruzen Bookstore to buy it from Germany. Later, I probably took it with me, but my feelings changed with the situation, and there was no meaning of translation, so this time I decided to give it to this young man who loved Peter Fei's poems, just like I did at that time, which was a good place for it. So he also solemnly sent it to Roushi himself. Who would have thought that it would fall into the hands of the "three heads" and the like, wouldn't this be unjust!

为了忘却的记念

二

为了忘却的记念

Two我的决不邀投稿者相见，其实也并不完全因为谦虚，其中含着省事的分子也不少。由于历来的经验，我知道青年们，尤其是文学青年们，十之九是感觉很敏，自尊心也很旺盛的，一不小心，极容易得到误解，所以倒是故意回避的时候多。见面尚且怕，更不必说敢有托付了。但那时我在上海，也有一个惟一的不但敢于随便谈笑，而且还敢于托他办点私事的人，那就是送书去给白莽的柔石。
I never invite contributors to meet, in fact, it is not entirely because of modesty, and there are many trouble-free elements in it. Because of my experience, I know that nine out of ten young people, especially literary youth, are very sensitive and have strong self-esteem. I'm afraid to meet, let alone dare to entrust me. But at that time, I was in Shanghai, and there was only one person who not only dared to talk and laugh casually, but also dared to ask him to do some personal matters, that is, to send books to Bai Mang's Rou Shi.我和柔石最初的相见，不知道是何时，在那里。他仿佛说过，曾在北京听过我的讲义，那么，当在八九年之前了。我也忘记了在上海怎么来往起来，总之，他那时住在景云里，离我的寓所不过四五家门面，不知怎么一来，就来往起来了。大约最初的一回他就告诉我是姓赵，名平复。但他又曾谈起他家乡的豪绅的气焰之盛，说是有一个绅士，以为他的名字好，要给儿子用，叫他不要用这名字了。所以我疑心他的原名是“平福”，平稳而有福，才正中乡绅的意，对于“复”字却未必有这么热心。他的家乡，是台州的宁海，这只要一看他那台州式的硬气就知道，而且颇有点迂，有时会令我忽而想到方孝孺，觉得好像也有些这模样的。
When I first met Rou Shi, I don't know when and where I was. He seemed to have said that he had heard my handouts in Beijing, so it should have been eight or nine years ago. I also forgot how I came and went in Shanghai, in short, he lived in Jingyun at that time, only four or five facades away from my apartment, and somehow he came and went. About the first time he told me that his surname was Zhao and his name was Pingfu. But he also talked about the arrogance of the gentry in his hometown, saying that there was a gentleman who thought his name was good and wanted to use it for his son, and told him not to use this name. So I suspect that his original name was "Pingfu", which was stable and blessed, which was exactly what the squire meant, but he might not be so enthusiastic about the word "Fu". His hometown is Ninghai, Taizhou, which can be known just by looking at his Taizhou-style toughness, and it is quite pedantic, sometimes I suddenly think of Fang Xiaoru, and I feel that there is something like this.他躲在寓里弄文学，也创作，也翻译，我们往来了许多日，说得投合起来了，于是另外约定了几个同意的青年，设立朝华社。目的是在绍介东欧和北欧的文学，输入外国的版画，因为我们都以为应该来扶植一点刚健质朴的文艺。接着就印《朝花旬刊》，印《近代世界短篇小说集》，印《艺苑朝华》，算都在循着这条线，只有其中的一本《蕗谷虹儿画选》，是为了扫荡上海滩上的“艺术家”，即戳穿叶灵凤这纸老虎而印的。
He hid in his apartment to do literature, also create, and translated, and we exchanged for many days, and we agreed, so we agreed with a few young people who agreed to set up the Chaohua Society. The purpose is to introduce the literature of Eastern Europe and Northern Europe, and import foreign prints, because we all think that we should cultivate a little strong and simple literature and art. Then they printed "Chaohua Periodicals", "Collection of Short Stories in the Modern World", and "Yiyuan Chaohua", all of which were all along this line, and only one of them, "Selected Paintings of Wugu Hong'er", was printed to sweep away the "artists" on the beach, that is, to pierce through Ye Lingfeng's paper tiger.然而柔石自己没有钱，他借了二百多块钱来做印本。除买纸之外，大部分的稿子和杂务都是归他做，如跑印刷局，制图，校字之类。可是往往不如意，说起来皱着眉头。看他旧作品，都很有悲观的气息，但实际上并不然，他相信人们是好的。我有时谈到人会怎样的骗人，怎样的卖友，怎样的吮血，他就前额亮晶晶的，惊疑地圆睁了近视的眼睛，抗议道，“会这样的么？——不至于此罢？……”
However, Rou Shi himself had no money, so he borrowed more than 200 yuan to make prints. In addition to buying paper, most of the manuscripts and miscellaneous tasks are done by him, such as running a printing office, drafting, proofreading, etc. But it is often unsatisfactory, and it is frowned upon when it is said. Looking at his old works, they are very pessimistic, but in fact they are not, he believes that people are good. Sometimes I talk about how people can deceive, what kind of betrayal, and how they suck blood, and his forehead is shining, and his myopic eyes widen in surprise, and he protested, "Is this so?" - Won't it end there? ……”不过朝花社不久就倒闭了，我也不想说清其中的原因，总之是柔石的理想的头，先碰了一个大钉子，力气固然白化，此外还得去借一百块钱来付纸账。后来他对于我那“人心惟危”说的怀疑减少了，有时也叹息道，“真会这样的么？……”但是，他仍然相信人们是好的。
However, the Chaohua Society soon went bankrupt, and I don't want to explain the reason, in short, it was Rou Shi's ideal head, first touched a big nail, and the strength was albinotic, and he had to borrow a hundred yuan to pay the paper bill. Later, his doubts about my "people's hearts are in danger" decreased, and sometimes he sighed, "Is this really going to happen?" ...... "However, he still believes that people are good.他于是一面将自己所应得的朝花社的残书送到明日书店和光华书局去，希望还能够收回几文钱，一面就拚命的译书，准备还借款，这就是卖给商务印书馆的《丹麦短篇小说集》和戈理基作的长篇小说《阿尔泰莫诺夫之事业》。但我想，这些译稿，也许去年已被兵火烧掉了。
He then sent the remaining books of the Chaohua Society to Tomorrow Bookstore and Guanghua Bookstore that he deserved, hoping to recover a few pennies, and on the other hand, he desperately translated the books and prepared to repay the loan, which was the "Danish Short Story Collection" sold to the Commercial Press and the novel "The Cause of Artemonov" written by Gorici. But I think these translations may have been burned down last year.他的迂渐渐的改变起来，终于也敢和女性的同乡或朋友一同去走路了，但那距离，却至少总有三四尺的。这方法很不好，有时我在路上遇见他，只要在相距三四尺前后或左右有一个年青漂亮的女人，我便会疑心就是他的朋友。但他和我一同走路的时候，可就走得近了，简直是扶住我，因为怕我被汽车或电车撞死；我这面也为他近视而又要照顾别人担心，大家都苍皇失措的愁一路，所以倘不是万不得已，我是不大和他一同出去的，我实在看得他吃力，因而自己也吃力。
He gradually changed, and finally dared to walk with his female fellow villagers or friends, but the distance was always at least three or four feet. This method is very bad, sometimes I meet him on the road, as long as there is a young and beautiful woman three or four feet away or left or right, I will suspect that it is his friend. But when he walked with me, he got closer, and he was holding me up, for he was afraid that I would be hit by a car or a tram; I am also worried about his myopia and having to take care of others, and everyone is worried all the way, so if it is not a last resort, I don't go out with him.无论从旧道德，从新道德，只要是损己利人的，他就挑选上，自己背起来。
No matter from the old morality or from the new morality, as long as it is harmful to oneself and benefiting others, he will choose it and memorize it himself.他终于决定地改变了，有一回，曾经明白的告诉我，此后应该转换作品的内容和形式。我说：这怕难罢，譬如使惯了刀的，这回要他耍棍，怎么能行呢？他简洁的答道：只要学起来！
He finally decided to change, and once, he clearly told me that the content and form of the work should be changed from now on. I said: This is afraid of difficulties, for example, if a person who is used to using a knife, how can he play with a stick this time? He replied succinctly: Just learn!他说的并不是空话，真也在从新学起来了，其时他曾经带了一个朋友来访我，那就是冯铿女士。谈了一些天，我对于她终于很隔膜，我疑心她有点罗曼谛克，急于事功；我又疑心柔石的近来要做大部的小说，是发源于她的主张的。但我又疑心我自己，也许是柔石的先前的斩钉截铁的回答，正中了我那其实是偷懒的主张的伤疤，所以不自觉地迁怒到她身上去了。——我其实也并不比我所怕见的神经过敏而自尊的文学青年高明。
What he said was not empty words, he was really learning anew, and at that time he once brought a friend to visit me, that is, Ms. Feng Keng. After talking for a while, I finally became very distant from her, and I suspected that she was a bit romantic, eager to do things; I also suspect that Rou Shi's recent novels originated from her ideas. But I was suspicious of myself, perhaps Rou Shi's previous categorical answer, which hit the scar of my claim that I was actually lazy, so I unconsciously vented my anger on her. ——In fact, I am not smarter than the neurotic and self-respecting literary youth I fear.她的体质是弱的，也并不美丽。
Her physique is weak and not beautiful.

为了忘却的记念

三

为了忘却的记念

Three直到左翼作家联盟成立之后，我才知道我所认识的白莽，就是在《拓荒者》上做诗的殷夫。有一次大会时，我便带了一本德译的，一个美国的新闻记者所做的中国游记去送他，这不过以为他可以由此练习德文，另外并无深意。然而他没有来。我只得又托了柔石。
It wasn't until the establishment of the Left-wing Writers' Union that I knew that Bai Mang was Yin Fu, who wrote poetry on "Pioneers". At one conference, I brought him a German translation of a Chinese travelogue written by an American journalist, but I thought he could practice German with it, and it didn't mean much. However, he did not come. I had to hold on to the soft stone again.但不久，他们竟一同被捕，我的那一本书，又被没收，落在“三道头”之类的手里了。
But soon, they were arrested together, and my book was confiscated again and fell into the hands of "three heads" and the like.

为了忘却的记念

四

为了忘却的记念

Four明日书店要出一种期刊，请柔石去做编辑，他答应了；书店还想印我的译著，托他来问版税的办法，我便将我和北新书局所订的合同，抄了一份交给他，他向衣袋里一塞，匆匆的走了。其时是一九三一年一月十六日的夜间，而不料这一去，竟就是我和他相见的末一回，竟就是我们的永诀。
Tomorrow the bookstore will publish a journal, ask Rou Shi to be the editor, and he agreed; The bookstore also wanted to print my translation, so I asked him to ask for royalties, so I copied a copy of the contract I signed with Beixin Bookstore and handed it to him, and he stuffed it into his pocket and left in a hurry. It was the night of January 16, 1931, but this time it was the last time I met him, and it was our eternal farewell.第二天，他就在一个会场上被捕了，衣袋里还藏着我那印书的合同，听说官厅因此正在找寻我。印书的合同，是明明白白的，但我不愿意到那些不明不白的地方去辩解。记得《说岳全传》里讲过一个高僧，当追捕的差役刚到寺门之前，他就“坐化”了，还留下什么“何立从东来，我向西方走”的偈子。这是奴隶所幻想的脱离苦海的惟一的好方法，“剑侠”盼不到，最自在的惟此而已。我不是高僧，没有涅槃的自由，却还有生之留恋，我于是就逃走。
The next day, he was arrested at a venue, and there was still my contract for printing books hidden in his pocket, and I heard that the government was looking for me. The contract for printing books is clear, but I don't want to go to those unclear places to defend myself. I remember that in "The Biography of Yue Quan", there was a high monk who "sat down" before the chasing servant arrived at the temple gate, and left behind a verse "He Li comes from the east, I go to the west". This is the only good way for slaves to escape from the sea of suffering, and the "swordsman" can't look forward to it, and that's the only thing he is most comfortable with. I am not a monk, I don't have the freedom of nirvana, but I still have nostalgia for life, so I ran away.这一夜，我烧掉了朋友们的旧信札，就和女人抱着孩子走在一个客栈里。不几天，即听得外面纷纷传我被捕，或是被杀了，柔石的消息却很少。有的说，他曾经被巡捕带到明日书店里，问是否是编辑；有的说，他曾经被巡捕带往北新书局去，问是否是柔石，手上上了铐，可见案情是重的。但怎样的案情，却谁也不明白。
That night, I burned my friends' old letters and walked in an inn with the woman holding the child. Within a few days, I heard rumors outside that I had been arrested or killed, but there was very little news about Rou Shi. Some said that he was once taken to Tomorrow's Bookstore by patrol and asked if he was an editor; Some said that he was once taken to the Beixin Bookstore by the patrol, asked if it was Rou Shi, and handcuffed his hands, which shows that the case is serious. But no one understands what kind of case it is.他在囚系中，我见过两次他写给同乡的信，第一回是这样的——
In his prison, I have seen his letters to his fellow villagers twice, the first time it was like this——“我与三十五位同犯（七个女的）于昨日到龙华。并于昨夜上了镣，开政治犯从未上镣之纪录。此案累及太大，我一时恐难出狱，书店事望兄为我代办之。现亦好，且跟殷夫兄学德文，此事可告周先生；望周先生勿念，我等未受刑。捕房和公安局，几次问周先生地址，但我那里知道。诸望勿念。祝好！
"I went to Longhua yesterday with 35 co-offenders (seven women). And last night he was shackled, setting a record that political prisoners have never been shackled. This case is too big, and I may not be able to get out of prison for a while, so I hope my brother will take care of the bookstore for me. Now it's good, and learn German from Brother Yinfu, you can tell Mr. Zhou about this; I hope Mr. Zhou will not think about it, we have not been punished. The arrest room and the public security bureau asked Mr. Zhou for his address several times, but I knew it there. Don't think about it. Best wishes!赵少雄　一月二十四日。”
Zhao Shaoxiong January 24. ”以上正面。

If you can't meet face-to-face, you can bring something to me望转交赵少雄”
I hope to pass it on to Zhao Shaoxiong."
以上背面。
The back of the above.他的心情并未改变，想学德文，更加努力；也仍在记念我，像在马路上行走时候一般。但他信里有些话是错误的，政治犯而上镣，并非从他们开始，但他向来看得官场还太高，以为文明至今，到他们才开始了严酷。其实是不然的。果然，第二封信就很不同，措词非常惨苦，且说冯女士的面目都浮肿了，可惜我没有抄下这封信。其时传说也更加纷繁，说他可以赎出的也有，说他已经解往南京的也有，毫无确信；而用函电来探问我的消息的也多起来，连母亲在北京也急得生病了，我只得一一发信去更正，这样的大约有二十天。
His mood has not changed, he wants to learn German and work harder; I am still remembering me, as if I were walking on the road. But some of the words in his letter were wrong, and the shackles of political prisoners did not start with them, but he always looked at the officialdom too high, thinking that civilization had not yet begun to be harsh. In fact, it is not. Sure enough, the second letter was very different, the wording was very miserable, and it was said that Ms. Feng's face was swollen, but unfortunately I did not copy the letter. At that time, the legends were even more complicated, some said that he could redeem him, and some said that he had been sent to Nanjing, without any certainty; And there were more people who used letters and telegrams to inquire about my news, and even my mother was so anxious that she was sick in Beijing, so I had to send letters to correct them one by one, which lasted about twenty days.天气愈冷了，我不知道柔石在那里有被褥不？我们是有的。洋铁碗可曾收到了没有？……但忽然得到一个可靠的消息，说柔石和其他二十三人，已于二月七日夜或八日晨，在龙华警备司令部被枪毙了，他的身上中了十弹。
The weather is getting colder, I don't know if Roushi has bedding there? We do. Have you ever received a foreign iron bowl? …… But suddenly I got reliable news that Rou Shi and 23 others had been shot dead at the Longhua Garrison Headquarters on the night of February 7 or 8, and he had been shot ten times.原来如此！……
I see! ……在一个深夜里，我站在客栈的院子中，周围是堆着的破烂的什物；人们都睡觉了，连我的女人和孩子。我沉重的感到我失掉了很好的朋友，中国失掉了很好的青年，我在悲愤中沉静下去了，然而积习却从沉静中抬起头来，凑成了这样的几句：
One late night, I stood in the courtyard of the inn, surrounded by a pile of rags; People are asleep, even my woman and children. I feel heavy that I have lost a good friend, China has lost a good youth, and I have calmed down in grief and anger, but Ji Xi raised his head from the silence and made up a few sentences:惯于长夜过春时，挈妇将雏鬓有丝。Accustomed to spending the long night in spring, I lead my wife to bring the young hair to the hair. 
梦里依稀慈母泪，城头变幻大王旗。 In the dream, there are faint tears of a loving mother, and the king's flag changes at the top of the city. 
忍看朋辈成新鬼，怒向刀丛觅小诗。 I can't bear to see my peers become new ghosts, angrily looking for a poem in the knife bush. 
吟罢低眉无写处，月光如水照缁衣。 After reciting the poem, I lowered my eyebrows and had nowhere to write, and the moonlight was like water shining on my black clothes.
但末二句，后来不确了，我终于将这写给了一个日本的歌人。
But the last two sentences were later inaccurate, and I finally wrote this to a Japanese poet.可是在中国，那时是确无写处的，禁锢得比罐头还严密。我记得柔石在年底曾回故乡，住了好些时，到上海后很受朋友的责备。他悲愤的对我说，他的母亲双眼已经失明了，要他多住几天，他怎么能够就走呢？我知道这失明的母亲的眷眷的心，柔石的拳拳的心。当《北斗》创刊时，我就想写一点关于柔石的文章，然而不能够，只得选了一幅珂勒惠支（Käthe Kollwitz）夫人的木刻，名曰《牺牲》，是一个母亲悲哀地献出她的儿子去的，算是只有我一个人心里知道的柔石的记念。
But in China, there was really no place to write at that time, and the confinement was tighter than canning. I remember that Rou Shi returned to his hometown at the end of the year, lived for a long time, and was very reproached by his friends after arriving in Shanghai. He told me sadly and indignantly that his mother was blind and asked him to stay a few more days, how could he leave? I know the heart of this blind mother, the heart of Rou Shi. When Beidou was launched, I wanted to write a little about Roushi, but I couldn't, so I had to choose a woodcut by Mrs. Käthe Kollwitz, called "Sacrifice", which was a mother who sadly sacrificed her son to her, which is a memory of Roushi that only I know in my heart.同时被难的四个青年文学家之中，李伟森我没有会见过，胡也频在上海也只见过一次面，谈了几句天。较熟的要算白莽，即殷夫了，他曾经和我通过信，投过稿，但现在寻起来，一无所得，想必是十七那夜统统烧掉了，那时我还没有知道被捕的也有白莽。然而那本《彼得斐诗集》却在的，翻了一遍，也没有什么，只在一首《Wahlspruch》（格言）的旁边，有钢笔写的四行译文道：
Among the four young writers who were killed at the same time, I did not meet Li Weisen, and Hu Yepin only met once in Shanghai and talked for a few days. 为了忘却的记念

五

为了忘却的记念

Five前年的今日，我避在客栈里，他们却是走向刑场了；去年的今日，我在炮声中逃在英租界，他们则早已埋在不知那里的地下了；今年的今日，我才坐在旧寓里，人们都睡觉了，连我的女人和孩子。我又沉重的感到我失掉了很好的朋友，中国失掉了很好的青年，我在悲愤中沉静下去了，不料积习又从沉静中抬起头来，写下了以上那些字。
On this day the year before last, I hid in the inn, but they went to the execution ground; On this day last year, I fled to the British Concession under the sound of artillery, and they were already buried underground without knowing where they were; On this day this year, I was sitting in my old apartment, and everyone was sleeping, including my woman and children. I felt heavy that I had lost a good friend, China had lost a good youth, and I fell silent in grief and anger, but unexpectedly Ji Xi raised his head from the silence and wrote the above words.要写下去，在中国的现在，还是没有写处的。年青时读向子期《思旧赋》，很怪他为什么只有寥寥的几行，刚开头却又煞了尾。然而，现在我懂得了。
If you want to write it, there is still no place to write it in China now. When I was young, I read Xiang Ziqi's "Nostalgia for the Past", and I wondered why he only had a few lines, but at the beginning but at the end. However, now I understand.不是年青的为年老的写记念，而在这三十年中，却使我目睹许多青年的血，层层淤积起来，将我埋得不能呼吸，我只能用这样的笔墨，写几句文章，算是从泥土中挖一个小孔，自己延口残喘，这是怎样的世界呢。夜正长，路也正长，我不如忘却，不说的好罢。但我知道，即使不是我，将来总会有记起他们，再说他们的时候的。……
It is not that the young write memories for the old, but in the past thirty years, I have witnessed the blood of many young people, layer by layer, burying me so that I can't breathe. The night is long, and the road is long, so I might as well forget it and not say it. But I know that even if it is not me, there will always be times when I will remember them and talk about them in the future. ……二月七——八日。
February 7-8.

谁的矛盾

谁的矛盾

谁的矛盾

Whose contradiction萧（George Bernard Shaw）并不在周游世界，是在历览世界上新闻记者们的嘴脸，应世界上新闻记者们的口试，——然而落了第。
George Bernard Shaw is not traveling the world, but is looking at the faces of journalists around the world, and he failed ,—— the oral examination of journalists around the world.他不愿意受欢迎，见新闻记者，却偏要欢迎他，访问他，访问之后，却又都多少讲些俏皮话。
He didn't want to be popular, and when he met a journalist, he wanted to welcome him, interview him, and after the interview, he said some witty things.他躲来躲去，却偏要寻来寻去，寻到之后，大做—通文章，却偏要说他自己善于登广告。
He hid around, but he wanted to look around, and after finding it, he made a big fuss, but he wanted to say that he was good at advertising.他不高兴说话，偏要同他去说话，他不多谈，偏要拉他来多谈，谈得多了，报上又不敢照样登载了，却又怪他多说话。
He was not happy to speak, but wanted to talk to him, he didn't talk much, but wanted to pull him to talk more, talked too much, and didn't dare to publish it in the newspaper, but blamed him for talking more.他说的是真话，偏要说他是在说笑话，对他哈哈的笑，还要怪他自己倒不笑。
He was telling the truth, but he was telling a joke, laughing at him, and blaming himself for not laughing.他说的是直话，偏要说他是讽刺，对他哈哈的笑，还要怪他自以为聪明。
He said bluntly, but he was sarcastic, laughed at him, and blamed him for thinking he was smart.他本不是讽刺家，偏要说他是讽刺家，而又看不起讽刺家，而又用了无聊的讽刺想来讽刺他一下。
He was not a satirist, but he wanted to say that he was a satirist, and he looked down on the satirist, and used boring satire to satirize him.他本不是百科全书，偏要当他百科全书，问长问短，问天问地，听了回答，又鸣不平，好像自己原来比他还明白。
He is not an encyclopedia, but he wants to be his encyclopedia, asking long and short questions, asking heaven and earth, listening to the answers, and complaining, as if he understands better than him.他本是来玩玩的，偏要逼他讲道理，讲了几句，听的又不高兴了，说他是来“宣传赤化”了。
He was here to play, but he wanted to force him to be reasonable, and after a few words, he was unhappy and said that he was here to "publicize red".有的看不起他，因为他不是一个马克思主义文学者，然而倘是马克思主义文学者，看不起他的人可就不要看他了。
Some look down on him because he is not a Marxist writer, but if he is a Marxist writer, those who look down on him should not look at him.有的看不起他，因为他不去做工人，然而倘若做工人，就不会到上海，看不起他的人可就看不见他了。
Some looked down on him because he didn't work as a worker, but if he was a worker, he wouldn't go to Shanghai, and those who looked down on him couldn't see him.有的又看不起他，因为他不是实行的革命者，然而倘是实行者，就会和牛兰一同关在牢监里，看不起他的人可就不愿提他了。
Some looked down on him, because he was not a revolutionary who practiced, but if he was a practitioner, he would be imprisoned with Niu Lan, and those who looked down on him would not want to mention him.他有钱，他偏讲社会主义，他偏不去做工，他偏来游历，他偏到上海，他偏讲革命，他偏谈苏联，他偏不给人们舒服……
He is rich, he talks about socialism, he doesn't work, he travels, he goes to Shanghai, he talks about revolution, he talks about the Soviet Union, he doesn't make people comfortable......于是乎可恶。
This is terrible.身子长也可恶，年纪大也可恶，须发白也可恶，不爱欢迎也可恶，逃避访问也可恶，连和夫人的感情好也可恶。
The long body is hateful, the old age is also hateful, the beard is gray is also hateful, the unwelcome is hateful, the avoidance of visits is also hateful, and even the relationship with the wife is hateful.然而他走了，这一位被人们公认为“矛盾”的萧。
However, he left, and this Xiao was recognized as a "contradiction".然而我想，还是熬一下子，姑且将这样的萧，当作现在的世界的文豪罢，唠唠叨叨，鬼鬼祟祟，是打不倒文豪的。而且为给大家可以唠叨起见，也还是有他在着的好。
However, I think it's better to stay up for a while, and treat such Xiao as a literary hero in the current world. And in order to give everyone a good opinion, it is still good to have him.因为矛盾的萧没落时，或萧的矛盾解决时，也便是社会的矛盾解决的时候，那可不是玩意儿也。
Because when the contradiction of Xiao declines, or when the contradiction of Xiao is resolved, it is also the time when the contradictions in society are resolved, and that is not a thing.二月十九夜。
February 19 night.

看萧和“看萧的人们”记

On the news in Belarus, it was once guessed that there were countless waiters, but only one cook was moving the dishes.萧吃得并不多，但也许开始的时候，已经很吃了一通了也难说。到中途，他用起筷子来了，很不顺手，总是夹不住。然而令人佩服的是他竟逐渐巧妙，终于紧紧的夹住了一块什么东西，于是得意的遍看着大家的脸，可是谁也没有看见这成功。

Xiao seemed to be very tired, so Kimura-kun and I went back to the Uchiyama Bookstore.第二天的新闻，却比萧的话还要出色得远远。在同一的时候，同一的地方，听着同一的话，写了出来的记事，却是各不相同的。似乎英文的解释，也会由于听者的耳朵，而变换花样。例如，关于中国的政府罢，英字新闻的萧，说的是中国人应该挑选自己们所佩服的人，作为统治者；日本字新闻的萧，说的是中国政府有好几个；汉字新闻的萧，说的是凡是好政府，总不会得人民的欢心的。
The news the next day was far better than Xiao's words. At the same time, in the same place, listening to the same words, the notes written are different. It seems that the English interpretation will also change its pattern depending on the listener's ears. For example, about the Chinese government, Xiao of the English news, said that Chinese people should choose the person they admire as rulers; Xiao of Japanese Character News said that there are several Chinese governments; Xiao of Chinese Character News said that any good government will never win the favor of the people.从这一点看起来，萧就并不是讽刺家，而是一面镜。
From this point of view, Xiao is not a satirist, but a mirror.但是，在新闻上的对于萧的评论，大体是坏的。人们是各各去听自己所喜欢的，有益的讽刺去的，而同时也给听了自己所讨厌的，有损的讽刺。于是就各各用了讽刺来讽刺道，萧不过是一个讽刺家而已。
However, the comments on Xiao in the news are generally bad. People listen to their favorite and beneficial satire, and at the same time listen to the harmful satire they hate. So they each used sarcasm to satirize that Xiao was just a satirist.在讽刺竞赛这一点上，我以为还是萧这一面伟大。
In terms of satire competition, I think it is still Xiao's side that is great.我对于萧，什么都没有问；萧对于我，也什么都没有问。不料木村君却要我写一篇萧的印象记。别人做的印象记，我是常看的，写得仿佛一见便窥见了那人的真心一般，我实在佩服其观察之锐敏。至于自己，却连相书也没有翻阅过，所以即使遇见了名人罢，倘要我滔滔的来说印象，可就穷矣了。
I didn't ask anything about Xiao; Xiao didn't ask anything about me. Unexpectedly, Kimura-kun asked me to write an impression of Xiao. I often read the impressions made by others, and I wrote as if I had caught a glimpse of the person's sincerity at first sight, and I really admired his keen observation. As for myself, I haven't even read the photo book, so even if I meet a celebrity, if I talk about my impressions, I will be poor.但是，因为是特地从东京到上海来要我写的，我就只得寄一点这样的东西，算是一个对付。
However, because he came from Tokyo to Shanghai to ask me to write, I had to send a little of this, which was a deal.一九三三年二月二十三夜。

Nowadays, the so-called "people" always have to wrap something outside their bodies, such as satin, felt cloth, and gauze. Even if you are poor enough to be a beggar, you must have at least a pair of torn pants; Even if it is called a barbarian, there is also an extra row of grass leaves in front and behind the belly. Xiao's greatness is in this place again. The British, Japanese, and Belarusian newspapers, although they made up some rumors, finally all attacked, knowing that he would never be used by imperialism. As for some Chinese newspapers, there is no need to say more, because they were originally the followers of foreigners. 由中国女人的脚，推定中国人之非中庸，又由此推定孔夫子有胃病

由中国女人的脚，推定中国人之非中庸，又由此推定孔夫子有胃病

由中国女人的脚，推定中国人之非中庸，又由此推定孔夫子有胃病

From the feet of Chinese women, it is presumed that the Chinese are not moderate, and from this, it is assumed that Confucius has stomach problems——“学匪”派考古学之一
——One of the archaeology of the "student bandits" school古之儒者不作兴谈女人，但有时总喜欢谈到女人。例如“缠足”罢，从明朝到清朝的带些考据气息的著作中，往往有一篇关于这事起源的迟早的文章。为什么要考究这样下等事呢，现在不说他也罢，总而言之，是可以分为两大派的，一派说起源早，一派说起源迟。说早的一派，看他的语气，是赞成缠足的，事情愈古愈好，所以他一定要考出连孟子的母亲，也是小脚妇人的证据来。说迟的一派却相反，他不大恭维缠足，据说，至早，亦不过起于宋朝的末年。
The ancient Confucian scholars did not talk about women, but sometimes they always liked to talk about women. For example, in the works of the Ming Dynasty to the Qing Dynasty with some evidence, there is often an article about the origin of this matter sooner or later. Why study such a lowly thing, don't talk about him now, in short, it can be divided into two major schools, one school says that the origin is early, and the other school says that the origin is late. The earlier the faction, looking at his tone, is in favor of foot binding, the older the thing, the better, so he must test the evidence that even Mencius's mother is also a small-footed woman. On the contrary, he did not compliment the binding of his feet, and it is said that at the earliest, it only started at the end of the Song Dynasty.其实，宋末，也可以算得古的了。不过不缠之足，样子却还要古，学者应该“贵古而贱今”，斥缠足者，爱古也。但也有先怀了反对缠足的成见，假造证据的，例如前明才子杨升庵先生，他甚至于替汉朝人做《杂事秘辛》，来证明那时的脚是“底平趾敛”。
In fact, at the end of the Song Dynasty, it can also be regarded as ancient. However, the foot is not wrapped, but the appearance is still ancient, and scholars should "value the ancient and despise the present", denounce those who bind their feet, and love the ancients. However, there are also those who have prejudices against foot binding and forge evidence, such as Mr. Yang Sheng'an, a former Ming talent, who even made "Miscellaneous Secrets" for the Han Dynasty to prove that the feet at that time were "flat and toe".于是又有人将这用作缠足起源之古的材料，说既然“趾敛”，可见是缠的了。但这是自甘于低能之谈，这里不加评论。
So some people used this as an ancient material for the origin of foot binding, saying that since it is "toe binding", it can be seen that it is entangled. But this is self-indulgence and imbecile, and there is no comment here.照我的意见来说，则以上两大派的话，是都错，也都对的。现在是古董出现的多了，我们不但能看见汉唐的图画，也可以看到晋唐古坟里发掘出来的泥人儿。那些东西上所表现的女人的脚上，有圆头履，有方头履，可见是不缠足的。古人比今人聪明，她决不至于缠小脚而穿大鞋子，里面塞些棉花，使自己走得一步一拐。
In my opinion, the above two major factions are both wrong and right. Nowadays, there are more antiques, and we can not only see the pictures of the Han and Tang dynasties, but also the clay figures excavated from the ancient tombs of the Jin and Tang dynasties. The women shown on those things have round-toed shoes and square-toed shoes on their feet, which shows that they are not bound to their feet. The ancients were smarter than today, and she would never wear big shoes with her small feet, stuffed with some cotton, so that she could limp step by step.但是，汉朝就确已有一种“利屣”，头是尖尖的，平常大约未必穿罢，舞的时候，却非此不可。不但走着爽利，“潭腿”似的踢开去之际，也不至于为裙子所碍，甚至于踢下裙子来。那时太太们固然也未始不舞，但舞的究以倡女为多，所以倡伎就大抵穿着“利屣”，穿得久了，也免不了要“趾敛”的。然而伎女的装束，是闺秀们的大成至圣先师，这在现在还是如此，常穿利屣，即等于现在之穿高跟皮鞋，可以俨然居炎汉“摩登女郎”之列，于是乎虽是名门淑女，脚尖也就不免尖了起来。先是倡伎尖，后是摩登女郎尖，再后是大家闺秀尖，最后才是“小家碧玉”一齐尖。待到这些“碧玉”们成了祖母时，就入于利屣制度统一脚坛的时代了。
However, the Han Dynasty did have a kind of "sharp shoe", the head is pointed, and it is usually not necessarily worn, but when dancing, it must be like this. Not only did he walk refreshingly, but when he kicked away like a "pool leg", he would not be hindered by the skirt, and even kicked off the skirt. At that time, the wives did not stop dancing, but most of the dancers were prostitutes, so the prostitutes mostly wore "sharp shoes", and after wearing them for a long time, they would inevitably have to "retract their toes". However, the costume of the courtesan is the most holy teacher of the ladies, which is still the case now, often wearing sharp shoes, that is, wearing high-heeled leather shoes now, can be among the "modern girls" of the Yan Han Dynasty, so although she is a famous lady, her toes will inevitably be pointed. First the prostitute tip, then the modern girl tip, then the lady tip, and finally the "small family jasper" tip. When these "jasper" became grandmothers, they entered the era of the unified football of the Li system and the foot platform.当民国初年，“不佞”观光北京的时候，听人说，北京女人看男人是否漂亮（自按：盖即今之所谓“摩登”也）的时候，是从脚起，上看到头的。所以男人的鞋袜，也得留心，脚样更不消说，当然要弄得齐齐整整，这就是天下之所以有“包脚布”的原因。仓颉造字，我们是知道的，谁造这布的呢，却还没有研究出。但至少是“古已有之”，唐朝张作的《朝野佥载》罢，他说武后朝有一位某男士，将脚裹得窄窄的，人们见了都发笑。可见盛唐之世，就已有了这一种玩意儿，不过还不是很极端，或者还没有很普及。然而好像终于普及了。由宋至清，绵绵不绝，民元革命以后，革了与否，我不知道，因为我是专攻考“古”学的。
In the early years of the Republic of China, when "Bu Ning" was sightseeing in Beijing, I heard that when Beijing women looked at whether a man was beautiful (self-pressed: Gai is the so-called "modern" now), they started from the feet and saw the head. Therefore, men's shoes and socks must also be paid attention to, not to mention the foot shape, of course, it must be made neatly, which is the reason why there is a "foot wrapping cloth" in the world. We know that Cangjie made characters, but who made this cloth has not yet been studied. But at least "there was it in ancient times", Tang Dynasty Zhang Zuo's "Chao and Ye Qianzai", he said that there was a certain man in the Wuhou Dynasty, who wrapped his feet narrowly, and people laughed when they saw it. It can be seen that in the Tang Dynasty, there was already this kind of thing, but it was not very extreme, or it was not very popular. However, it seems to have finally become popular. From the Song Dynasty to the Qing Dynasty, endlessly, after the Minyuan Revolution, I don't know whether it was revolutionized or not, because I specialized in "ancient" studies.然而奇怪得很，不知道怎的（自按：此处似略失学者态度），女士们之对于脚，尖还不够，并且勒令它“小”起来了，最高模范，还竟至于以三寸为度。这么一来，可以不必兼买利屣和方头履两种，从经济的观点来看，是不算坏的，可是从卫生的观点来看，却未免有些“过火”，换一句话，就是“走了极端”了。
However, it is very strange, I don't know how (self-press: it seems to be a little unscholarly here), the ladies are not sharp enough for the foot, and they order it to be "small", the highest model, and even three inches. In this way, you don't have to buy both shoes and square toe shoes, from an economic point of view, it is not bad, but from a health point of view, it is inevitable that it is a little "excessive", in other words, it is "extreme".我中华民族虽然常常的自命为爱“中庸”，行“中庸”的人民，其实是颇不免于过激的。譬如对于敌人罢，有时是压服不够，还要“除恶务尽”，杀掉不够，还要“食肉寝皮”。但有时候，却又谦虚到“侵略者要进来，让他们进来。也许他们会杀了十万中国人。不要紧，中国人有的是，我们再有人上去”。这真教人会猜不出是真痴还是假呆。而女人的脚尤其是一个铁证，不小则已，小则必求其三寸，宁可走不成路，摆摆摇摇。慨自辫子肃清以后，缠足本已一同解放的了，老新党的母亲们，鉴于自己在皮鞋里塞棉花之麻烦，一时也确给她的女儿留了天足。然而我们中华民族是究竟有些“极端”的，不多久，老病复发，有些女士们已在别想花样，用一枝细黑柱子将脚跟支起，叫它离开地球。她到底非要她的脚变把戏不可。由过去以测将来，则四朝（假如仍旧有朝代的话）之后，全国女人的脚趾都和小腿成一直线，是可以有八九成把握的。
Although our Chinese nation often claims to love the "golden mean" and practice the "golden mean", it is actually quite extreme. For example, for the enemy, sometimes it is not enough to suppress and subdue enough, and it is necessary to "eliminate evil and do its best", and if it is not enough to kill, it is also necessary to "eat meat and sleep". But sometimes, it is so modest that "the invaders want to come in, let them in." Maybe they will kill 100,000 Chinese. It doesn't matter, what the Chinese have is that we have someone to go up." This really makes it impossible to guess whether it is true or fake. And a woman's feet are especially an ironclad evidence, if they are not small, they must ask for three inches, and they would rather not walk on the road and sway. Since the eradication of the pigtails, the foot binding has been liberated together, and the mothers of the old and new parties, in view of the trouble of stuffing cotton in their leather shoes, did leave their daughters with natural feet for a while. However, our Chinese nation is a bit "extreme", not long after, old illness recurred, and some ladies were already thinking about tricks, using a thin black pillar to prop up their heels and tell it to leave the earth. From the past to the future, after the four dynasties (if there are still dynasties), the toes of women across the country will be in line with their calves, which can be eighty or ninety percent certain.然则圣人为什么大呼“中庸”呢？曰：这正因为大家并不中庸的缘故。人必有所缺，这才想起他所需。穷教员养不活老婆了，于是觉到女子自食其力说之合理，并且附带地向男女平权论点头；富翁胖到要发哮喘病了，才去打高而富球，从此主张运动的紧要。我们平时，是决不记得自己有一个头，或一个肚子，应该加以优待的，然而一旦头痛肚泻，这才记起了他们，并且大有休息要紧，饮食小心的议论。倘有谁听了这些议论之后，便贸贸然决定这议论者为卫生家，可就失之十丈，差以亿里了。
So why did the saint shout "moderation"? He said: This is precisely because everyone is not mediocre. A man must lack something, and then he remembers what he needs. The poor teacher could no longer support his wife, so he felt that it was reasonable for the woman to support herself, and incidentally nodded to the argument for equality between men and women; The rich man was so fat that he was about to get asthma, so he went to play high and rich ball, and since then he has advocated the importance of exercise. Usually, we never remember that we have a head or a belly, and we should be treated preferentially, but once we have a headache and diarrhea, we remember them, and there is a lot of talk about resting and eating carefully. If anyone listens to these discussions and hastily decides that the speaker is a hygienist, he can lose ten zhang, a difference of hundreds of millions of miles.倒相反，他是不卫生家，议论卫生，正是他向来的不卫生的结果的表现。孔子曰，“不得中行而与之，必也狂狷乎，狂者进取，狷者有所不为也！”以孔子交游之广，事实上没法子只好寻狂狷相与，这便是他在理想上之所以哼着“中庸，中庸”的原因。
On the contrary, he is an unhygienic person, and talking about hygiene is a manifestation of his usual unhygienic results. Confucius said, "If you can't give it to someone who is in the middle of the road, you must be arrogant and stubborn. The madman is enterprising, and the stubborn person does not do something!" With Confucius's wide range of friends, in fact, he had no choice but to look for madness, which is the reason why he hummed "moderation, moderation" in his ideals.以上的推定假使没有错，那么，我们就可以进而推定孔子晚年，是生了胃病的了。“割不正不食”，这是他老先生的古板规矩，但“食不厌精，脍不厌细”的条令却有些稀奇。他并非百万富翁或能收许多版税的文学家，想不至于这么奢侈的，除了只为卫生，意在容易消化之外，别无解法。况且“不撤姜食”，又简直是省不掉暖胃药了。何必如此独厚于胃，念念不忘呢？曰，以其有胃病之故也。
If the above presumption is not wrong, then we can further presume that Confucius had stomach problems in his later years. "Don't eat if you can't cut it", this is his old gentleman's old-fashioned rule, but the rule of "don't get tired of eating, don't get tired of fine" is a bit strange. He is not a millionaire or a writer who can collect a lot of royalties, and he has no other solution than to be so extravagant except for hygiene and easy digestion. Moreover, "not withdrawing ginger food" simply can't save stomach warming medicine. Why be so generous to your stomach and never forget it? The answer is that it is because he has stomach problems.倘说：坐在家里，不大走动的人们很容易生胃病，孔子周游列国，运动王公，该可以不生病证的了。那就是犯了知今而不知古的错误。盖当时花旗白面，尚未输入，土磨麦粉，多含灰沙，所以分量较今面为重；国道尚未修成，泥路甚多凹凸，孔子如果肯走，那是不大要紧的，而不幸他偏有一车两马。胃里袋着沉重的面食，坐在车子里走着七高八低的道路，一颠一顿，一掀一坠，胃就被坠得大起来，消化力随之减少，时时作痛；每餐非吃“生姜”不可了。所以那病的名目，该是“胃扩张”；那时候，则是“晚年”，约在周敬王十年以后。
If you say: Sitting at home, people who don't move around are prone to stomach problems, Confucius traveled around the world, exercised the princes, should not get sick. That is to make the mistake of knowing the present and not the past. Because at that time, Citi white flour had not yet been imported, and the ground wheat flour contained a lot of gray sand, so the weight was heavier than today's flour; The national highway has not yet been built, and there are many bumps in the dirt road, and if Confucius is willing to go, it doesn't matter, but unfortunately he has a car and two horses. With heavy pasta in his stomach, sitting in the car and walking on the road of seven highs and eight lows, he fell and fell, and his stomach fell bigger, his digestion was reduced, and he was in pain all the time; You have to eat "ginger" at every meal. Therefore, the name of the disease should be "gastric dilatation"; At that time, it was "old age", about ten years after King Jing of Zhou.以上的推定，虽然简略，却都是“读书得间”的成功。但若急于近功，妄加猜测，即很容易陷于“多疑”的谬误。例如罢，二月十四日《申报》载南京专电云：“中执委会令各级党部及人民团体制‘忠孝仁爱信义和平’匾额，悬挂礼堂中央，以资启迪。”看了之后，切不可便推定为各要人讥大家为“忘八”；三月一日《大晚报》载新闻云：“孙总理夫人宋庆龄女士自归国寓沪后，关于政治方面，不闻不问，惟对社会团体之组织非常热心。据本报记者所得报告，前日有人由邮政局致宋女士之索诈信□（自按：原缺）件，业经本市当局派驻邮局检查处检查员查获，当将索诈信截留，转辗呈报市府。”看了之后，也切不可便推定虽为总理夫人宋女士的信件，也常在邮局被当局派员所检查。

我怎么做起小说来

我怎么做起小说来

我怎么做起小说来

How do I start a novel?我怎么做起小说来？——这来由，已经在《呐喊》的序文上，约略说过了。这里还应该补叙一点的，是当我留心文学的时候，情形和现在很不同：在中国，小说不算文学，做小说的也决不能称为文学家，所以并没有人想在这一条道路上出世。我也并没有要将小说抬进“文苑”里的意思，不过想利用他的力量，来改良社会。
How do I start a novel? ——The reason for this has already been briefly mentioned in the preface to "The Scream". I should also add here that when I paid attention to literature, the situation was very different from now: in China, novels are not literature, and novelists can never be called writers, so no one wants to be born on this path. I don't mean to carry the novel into the "literary garden", but I want to use his power to improve society.但也不是自己想创作，注重的倒是在绍介，在翻译，而尤其注重于短篇，特别是被压迫的民族中的作者的作品。因为那时正盛行着排满论，有些青年，都引那叫喊和反抗的作者为同调的。所以“小说作法”之类，我一部都没有看过，看短篇小说却不少，小半是自己也爱看，大半则因了搜寻绍介的材料。也看文学史和批评，这是因为想知道作者的为人和思想，以便决定应否绍介给中国。和学问之类，是绝不相干的。
But I don't want to create it myself, but I pay attention to the introduction, translation, and especially the short stories, especially the works of authors from oppressed ethnic groups. Because at that time the theory of fullness was prevalent, some young people cited the author who shouted and resisted as the same tune. Therefore, I have never read any of the "novel practices", but I have read a lot of short stories, a small part of which I also love to read, and most of them are because of the search for Shao Jie's materials. Also look at literary history and criticism, because I want to know the author's character and thoughts, so as to decide whether to introduce it to China. It has nothing to do with learning.因为所求的作品是叫喊和反抗，势必至于倾向了东欧，因此所看的俄国，波兰以及巴尔干诸小国作家的东西就特别多。也曾热心的搜求印度，埃及的作品，但是得不到。记得当时最爱看的作者，是俄国的果戈理（N. Gogol）和波兰的显克微支（H. Sienkiewitz）。日本的，是夏目漱石和森鸥外。
Because the works sought are shouting and resistance, they are bound to lean towards Eastern Europe, so there are a lot of writers from Russia, Poland and small Balkan countries. I have also enthusiastically searched for works from India and Egypt, but I can't get them. I remember that my favorite author at that time was the Russian Gogol (N. Gogol) and Poland's H. Sienkiewitz）。 Japanese, it is Natsume Soseki and Mori Ouwai.回国以后，就办学校，再没有看小说的工夫了，这样的有五六年。为什么又开手了呢？——这也已经写在《呐喊》的序文里，不必说了。但我的来做小说，也并非自以为有做小说的才能，只因为那时是住在北京的会馆里的，要做论文罢，没有参考书，要翻译罢，没有底本，就只好做一点小说模样的东西塞责，这就是《狂人日记》。大约所仰仗的全在先前看过的百来篇外国作品和一点医学上的知识，此外的准备，一点也没有。
After returning to China, I ran a school, and I didn't have the time to read novels anymore, for five or six years. Why did you start again? ——This has also been written in the preface to "The Scream", so it goes without saying. But when I came to write novels, I didn't think I had the talent to write novels, just because I was living in a guild hall in Beijing at that time, and I had to make papers, no reference books, no translations, and no originals, so I had to make a little novel-like thing to blame, which is "Diary of a Madman". It relies on about 100 foreign works and a little medical knowledge that I have seen before, and there is no other preparation at all.但是《新青年》的编辑者，却一回一回的来催，催几回，我就做一篇，这里我必得记念陈独秀先生，他是催促我做小说最着力的一个。
But the editor of "New Youth" came to urge me again and again, and after a few times, I would make an article, and here I must remember Mr. Chen Duxiu, who was the one who urged me to write a novel the most.自然，做起小说来，总不免自己有些主见的。例如，说到“为什么”做小说罢，我仍抱着十多年前的“启蒙主义”，以为必须是“为人生”，而且要改良这人生。我深恶先前的称小说为“闲书”，而且将“为艺术的艺术”，看作不过是“消闲”的新式的别号。所以我的取材，多采自病态社会的不幸的人们中，意思是在揭出病苦，引起疗救的注意。所以我力避行文的唠叨，只要觉得够将意思传给别人了，就宁可什么陪衬拖带也没有。中国旧戏上，没有背景，新年卖给孩子看的花纸上，只有主要的几个人（但现在的花纸却多有背景了），我深信对于我的目的，这方法是适宜的，所以我不去描写风月，对话也决不说到一大篇。
Naturally, when you start writing novels, you can't help but have some opinions. For example, when it comes to "why" to write novels, I still hold on to the "enlightenment" of more than ten years ago, thinking that it must be "for life" and to improve this life. I hated the previous call of novels "idle books", and regarded "art for art" as nothing more than a new nickname for "leisure". Therefore, my material is mostly taken from the unfortunate people in a sick society, which means to expose the suffering and attract the attention of healing. So I try to avoid the nagging of the text, as long as I feel that I have enough to convey the meaning to others, I would rather have no foil drag. In the old Chinese drama, there is no background, and on the flower paper sold to children in the New Year, there are only a few main people (but the current flower paper has a lot of background), I am convinced that this method is suitable for my purpose, so I will not describe the wind and moon, and the dialogue will never be a long story.我做完之后，总要看两遍，自己觉得拗口的，就增删几个字，一定要它读得顺口；没有相宜的白话，宁可引古语，希望总有人会懂，只有自己懂得或连自己也不懂的生造出来的字句，是不大用的。这一节，许多批评家之中，只有一个人看出来了，但他称我为Stylist。
After I finish it, I always have to read it twice, and if I feel awkward, I will add and delete a few words, and it must read smoothly; There is no suitable vernacular, I would rather quote ancient words, hoping that someone will always understand, only words and phrases that I understand or don't even understand are useless. This section was seen by only one of the many critics, but he called me a Stylist.所写的事迹，大抵有一点见过或听到过的缘由，但决不全用这事实，只是采取一端，加以改造，或生发开去，到足以几乎完全发表我的意思为止。人物的模特儿也一样，没有专用过一个人，往往嘴在浙江，脸在北京，衣服在山西，是一个拼凑起来的脚色。有人说，我的那一篇是骂谁，某一篇又是骂谁，那是完全胡说的。
The deeds written are probably due to some reason that I have seen or heard, but I never use this fact entirely, but only take one end, transform it, or give it a spark until it is enough to almost completely express my meaning. The same is true for the model of the character, there has never been a dedicated person, often the mouth is in Zhejiang, the face is in Beijing, and the clothes are in Shanxi, which is a patchwork of footage. Some people say, who is my article scolding, and who is scolding in another article, that is complete nonsense.不过这样的写法，有一种困难，就是令人难以放下笔。一气写下去，这人物就逐渐活动起来，尽了他的任务。但倘有什么分心的事情来一打岔，放下许久之后再来写，性格也许就变了样，情景也会和先前所豫想的不同起来。例如我做的《不周山》，原意是在描写性的发动和创造，以至衰亡的，而中途去看报章，见了一位道学的批评家攻击情诗的文章，心里很不以为然，于是小说里就有一个小人物跑到女娲的两腿之间来，不但不必有，且将结构的宏大毁坏了。但这些处所，除了自己，大概没有人会觉到的，我们的批评大家成仿吾先生，还说这一篇做得最出色。
However, there is a difficulty in this way of writing, that is, it is difficult to put down the pen. Writing in one go, the character gradually became active and fulfilled his task. But if there is something distracting to interrupt it, let it go for a long time and then write it, the character may change, and the situation will be different from what was previously expected. For example, my "Buzhou Mountain" was originally intended to describe the initiation and creation of sexuality, and even its decline, but I went to the newspaper halfway through and saw an article by a Taoist critic attacking love poems, and I was very dissatisfied, so there was a small character in the novel who ran between Nuwa's legs, not only did not have it, but also destroyed the grandeur of the structure. But these places, except for themselves, probably no one will notice it, our critic Cheng Fangwu, and said that this article is the best.我想，如果专用一个人做骨干，就可以没有这弊病的，但自己没有试验过。
I think that if one person is dedicated as the backbone, there will be no such drawback, but I have not tried it myself.忘记是谁说的了，总之是，要极省俭的画出一个人的特点，最好是画他的眼睛。我以为这话是极对的，倘若画了全副的头发，即使细得逼真，也毫无意思。我常在学学这一种方法，可惜学不好。
I forgot who said it, in short, to draw a person's characteristics extremely frugally, it is best to draw his eyes. I thought this was very true, if you draw a full set of hair, even if it is realistic, it is meaningless. I often learn this method, but unfortunately I can't learn it well.可省的处所，我决不硬添，做不出的时候，我也决不硬做，但这是因为我那时别有收入，不靠卖文为活的缘故，不能作为通例的。
I will never add a place that can be saved, and when I can't do it, I will never do it, but this is because I had no income at that time and did not make a living by selling literature, so it cannot be used as a common practice.还有一层，是我每当写作，一律抹杀各种的批评。因为那时中国的创作界固然幼稚，批评界更幼稚，不是举之上天，就是按之入地，倘将这些放在眼里，就要自命不凡，或觉得非自杀不足以谢天下的。批评必须坏处说坏，好处说好，才于作者有益。
There is another layer that every time I write, I erase all kinds of criticism. Because at that time, China's creative circles were naïve, and the criticism circles were even more naïve, either lifting them up to the sky or pressing them into the ground. Criticism must be said to be bad and good to be beneficial to the author.但我常看外国的批评文章，因为他于我没有恩怨嫉恨，虽然所评的是别人的作品，却很有可以借镜之处。但自然，我也同时一定留心这批评家的派别。
But I often read foreign criticism, because he has no grudge against me, although he comments on other people's works, but there is a lot to learn from. But naturally, I must also pay attention to this critic's faction.以上，是十年前的事了，此后并无所作，也没有长进，编辑先生要我做一点这类的文章，怎么能呢。拉杂写来，不过如此而已。
The above was ten years ago, and since then I have done nothing, and I have not made any progress. Lazarus wrote it, but that's all.三月五日灯下。
March 5th: Under the lights.

关于女人

About women国难期间，似乎女人也特别受难些。一些正人君子责备女人爱奢侈，不肯光顾国货。就是跳舞，肉感等等，凡是和女性有关的，都成了罪状。仿佛男人都做了苦行和尚，女人都进了修道院，国难就会得救似的。
During the national crisis, it seems that women also suffer more. Some righteous gentlemen blame women for loving luxury and refusing to patronize domestic products. It is dancing, sensuality, etc., everything related to women has become a crime. It is as if men have become ascetic monks and women have entered monasteries, and the national crisis will be saved.其实那不是女人的罪状，正是她的可怜。这社会制度把她挤成了各种各式的奴隶，还要把种种罪名加在她头上。西汉末年，女人的“堕马髻”，“愁眉啼妆”，也说是亡国之兆。其实亡汉的何尝是女人！不过，只要看有人出来唉声叹气的不满意女人的妆束，我们就知道当时统治阶级的情形，大概有些不妙了。
In fact, it is not the woman's crime, it is her pity. This social system has squeezed her into all kinds of slaves, and all kinds of crimes have been put on her head. At the end of the Western Han Dynasty, women's "fallen horse buns" and "sorrowful makeup" were also said to be signs of the fall of the country. In fact, the dead man is a woman! However, as long as we see someone sighing and sighing dissatisfied with the woman's makeup, we know that the situation of the ruling class at that time was probably a little bad.奢侈和淫靡只是一种社会崩溃腐化的现象，决不是原因。私有制度的社会，本来把女人也当做私产，当做商品。一切国家，一切宗教都有许多稀奇古怪的规条，把女人看做一种不吉利的动物，威吓她，使她奴隶般的服从；同时又要她做高等阶级的玩具。正像现在的正人君子，他们骂女人奢侈，板起面孔维持风化，而同时正在偷偷地欣赏着肉感的大腿文化。
Luxury and obscenity are just a phenomenon of social collapse and corruption, and are by no means the cause. In a society with a private ownership system, women were originally regarded as private property and commodities. All countries and religions have many strange rules, treating a woman as an unlucky animal, intimidating her into slave obedience; At the same time, she was asked to make high-class toys. Just like today's upright gentlemen, they scold women for being extravagant, maintaining their faces to maintain weathering, while secretly admiring the culture of sensual thighs.阿剌伯的一个古诗人说：“地上的天堂是在圣贤的经书上，马背上，女人的胸脯上。”这句话倒是老实的供状。
An ancient poet of Arab said: "Heaven on earth is in the scriptures of the sages, on horseback, on the breasts of women." This sentence is an honest confession.自然，各种各式的卖淫总有女人的份。然而买卖是双方的。没有买淫的嫖男，那里会有卖淫的娼女。所以问题还在买淫的社会根源。这根源存在一天，也就是主动的买者存在一天，那所谓女人的淫靡和奢侈就一天不会消灭。男人是私有主的时候，女人自身也不过是男人的所有品。也许是因此罢，她的爱惜家财的心或者比较的差些，她往往成了“败家精”。何况现在买淫的机会那么多，家庭里的女人直觉地感觉到自己地位的危险。民国初年我就听说，上海的时髦是从长三幺二传到姨太太之流，从姨太太之流再传到太太奶奶小姐。这些“人家人”，多数是不自觉地在和娼妓竞争，——自然，她们就要竭力修饰自己的身体，修饰到拉得住男子的心的一切。这修饰的代价是很贵的，而且一天一天的贵起来，不但是物质上的，而且还有精神上的。
Naturally, all kinds of prostitution always have a woman's share. However, the sale and purchase are mutually exclusive. There are no prostitutes who buy prostitution, there will be prostitutes there. So the problem is still the social root cause of prostitution. This root exists for one day, that is, the active buyer exists for one day, and the so-called women's obscenity and luxury will not disappear for a day. When a man is a private owner, a woman herself is nothing more than a man's possession. Perhaps because of this, her heart for cherishing family wealth or worse is worse, and she often becomes a "prodigal". What's more, there are so many opportunities to buy prostitution now, and women in the family intuitively feel the danger of their status. In the early years of the Republic of China, I heard that Shanghai's fashion was passed down from Chang Sanyao and Yi to the likes of aunts, and from aunts to wives and grandmothers. Most of these "families" are unconsciously competing with prostitutes,—— naturally, they have to try their best to modify their bodies and modify everything that can win a man's heart. The price of this embellishment is very expensive, and it is getting more expensive day by day, not only materially, but also spiritually.美国一个百万富翁说：“我们不怕共匪（原文无匪字，谨遵功令改译），我们的妻女就要使我们破产，等不及工人来没收。”中国也许是惟恐工人“来得及”，所以高等华人的男女这样赶紧的浪费着，享用着，畅快着，那里还管得到国货不国货，风化不风化。然而口头上是必须维持风化，提倡节俭的。
A millionaire in the United States said: "We are not afraid of communist bandits, our wives and daughters will bankrupt us, and we can't wait for the workers to confiscate them." China may be afraid that the workers will "make it too late", so the men and women of the higher Chinese are in a hurry to waste, enjoy, and have fun. However, verbally it is necessary to maintain the weathering and advocate frugality.四月十一日。

真假堂吉诃德

真假堂吉诃德

真假堂吉诃德

Real and false Don Quixote西洋武士道的没落产生了堂·吉诃德那样的戆大。他其实是个十分老实的书呆子。看他在黑夜里仗着宝剑和风车开仗，的确傻相可掬，觉得可笑可怜。
The decline of Western bushido gave rise to Don Quixote's arrogance. He is actually a very honest nerd. Seeing him fighting with a sword and a windmill in the dark night, it was indeed silly and pitiful.然而这是真正的吉诃德。中国的江湖派和流氓种子，却会愚弄吉诃德式的老实人，而自己又假装着堂·吉诃德的姿态。《儒林外史》上的几位公子，慕游侠剑仙之为人，结果是被这种假吉诃德骗去了几百两银子，换来了一颗血淋淋的猪头，——那猪算是侠客的“君父之仇”了。
However, this is the real Quixote. The Chinese charlatans and rogue seeds will fool the Quixote-style honest people, and they themselves will pretend to be Don Quixote. Several sons in the "History of Confucianism", admiring the character of the Ranger Sword Immortal, turned out to be deceived by this fake Quixote for hundreds of taels of silver in exchange for a bloody pig's head,—— which was regarded as the "enemy of the king's father" of the knight.真吉诃德的做傻相是由于自己愚蠢，而假吉诃德是故意做些傻相给别人看，想要剥削别人的愚蠢。
The real Quixote is stupid because of his own stupidity, while the fake Quixote deliberately makes some stupid appearances for others to see, wanting to exploit other people's stupidity.可是中国的老百姓未必都还这么蠢笨，连这点儿手法也看不出来。
But the Chinese people may not be so stupid that they can't even see this little trick.中国现在的假吉诃德们，何尝不知道大刀不能救国，他们却偏要舞弄着，每天“杀敌几百几千”的乱嚷，还有人“特制钢刀九十九，去赠送前敌将士”。可是，为着要杀猪起见，又舍不得飞机捐，于是乎“武器不精良”的宣传，一面作为节节退却或者“诱敌深入”的解释，一面又借此搜括一些杀猪经费。可惜前有慈禧太后，后有袁世凯，——清末的兴复海军捐建设了颐和园，民四的“反日”爱国储金，增加了讨伐当时革命军的军需，——不然的话，还可以说现在发现了一个新发明。
The current fake quijotes in China don't know that the big knife cannot save the country, but they want to dance, shouting "killing hundreds and thousands of enemies" every day, and some people "make ninety-nine special steel knives to give away to the former enemy soldiers". However, in order to kill pigs, they were reluctant to donate planes, so the propaganda of "imperfect weapons" was used as an explanation for retreating or "luring the enemy deeper", and on the other hand, it was used to collect some pig killing funds. Unfortunately, there was Empress Dowager Cixi in front, and Yuan Shikai donated ,—— the revival navy at the end of the Qing Dynasty to build the Summer Palace, and the "anti-Japanese" patriotic reserve fund of Min Si increased the military supplies for the crusade against the revolutionary army at that time,—— otherwise, it can be said that a new invention has been discovered now.他们何尝不知道“国货运动”振兴不了什么民族工业，国际的财神爷扼住了中国的喉咙，连气也透不出，甚么“国货”都跳不出这些财神的手掌心。然而“国货年”是宣布了，“国货商场”是成立了，像煞有介事的，仿佛抗日救国全靠一些戴着假面具的买办多赚几个钱。这钱还是从猪狗牛马身上剥削来的。不听见“增加生产力”，“劳资合作共赴国难”的呼声么？原本不把小百姓当人看待，然而小百姓做了猪狗牛马还是要负“救国责任”！结果，猪肉供给假吉诃德吃，而猪头还是要斫下来，挂出去，以为“捣乱后方”者戒。
They don't know that the "domestic product movement" cannot revitalize any national industry, and the international god of wealth has choked China's throat, and he can't even breathe, and no "domestic product" can jump out of the palm of these gods of wealth. However, the "Year of Domestic Products" was announced, and the "Domestic Shopping Mall" was established, as if the anti-Japanese salvation of the country relied on some compradors wearing masks to make a few more money. This money is still exploited from pigs, dogs, cattle and horses. Don't you hear the call of "increasing productivity" and "labor-management cooperation to go to the national crisis"? Originally, the common people were not treated as human beings, but the common people still had to bear the "responsibility of saving the country" when they became pigs, dogs, cattle and horses! As a result, the pork was supplied to the fake Quixote to eat, and the pig's head still had to be cut off and hung out, thinking that it was a warning to "trouble the rear".他们何尝不知道什么“中国固有文化”咒不死帝国主义，无论念几千万遍“不仁不义”或者金光明咒，也不会触发日本地震，使它陆沉大海。然而他们故意高喊恢复“民族精神”，仿佛得了什么祖传秘诀。意思其实很明白，是要小百姓埋头治心，多读修身教科书。这固有文化本来毫无疑义：是岳飞式的奉旨不抵抗的忠，是听命国联爷爷的孝，是斫猪头，吃猪肉，而又远庖厨的仁爱，是遵守卖身契约的信义，是“诱敌深入”的和平。而且，“固有文化”之外，又提倡什么“学术救国”，引证西哲菲希德之言等类的居心，又何尝不是如此。
They don't know what "China's inherent culture" curse imperialism, no matter how many tens of millions of times "unkind and unjust" or the golden light mantra is recited, it will not trigger the earthquake in Japan and sink it into the sea. However, they deliberately shouted to restore the "national spirit", as if they had some ancestral secret. The meaning is actually very clear, it is to ask the common people to bury their minds and read more self-cultivation textbooks. There is no doubt about this inherent culture: it is Yue Fei's loyalty to the order not to resist, the filial piety of the grandfather of the League of Nations, the benevolence of cutting pigs' heads, eating pork, and staying away from the chef, the faith of abiding by the contract of self-sale, and the peace of "luring the enemy deeper". Moreover, in addition to the "inherent culture", what kind of "academic salvation" is advocated, and the intention of quoting the words of Sizhefishid and so on is not the same.假吉诃德的这些傻相，真教人哭笑不得；你要是把假痴假呆当做真痴真呆，当真认为可笑可怜，那就未免傻到不可救药了。
These silly appearances of fake Quixote really make people laugh and cry; If you regard fake dementia as real dementia, and really think it is ridiculous and pitiful, then you will be hopelessly stupid.四月十一日。

《守常全集》题记

《守常全集》题记

《守常全集》题记

Inscription of "The Complete Works of Conservatism"我最初看见守常先生的时候，是在独秀先生邀去商量怎样进行《新青年》的集会上，这样就算认识了。不知道他其时是否已是共产主义者。总之，给我的印象是很好的：诚实，谦和，不多说话。《新青年》的同人中，虽然也很有喜欢明争暗斗，扶植自己势力的人，但他一直到后来，绝对的不是。
When I first saw Mr. Shouchang, I was invited by Mr. Duxiu to discuss how to conduct the "New Youth" meeting, so that we could know each other. I don't know if he was already a communist at that time. In short, I have a good impression: honest, humble, not talking. Among the fans of "New Youth", although there are also people who like to fight openly and secretly and support their own power, he has never been there until later.他的模样是颇难形容的，有些儒雅，有些朴质，也有些凡俗。所以既像文士，也像官吏，又有些像商人。这样的商人，我在南边没有看见过，北京却有的，是旧书店或笺纸店的掌柜。一九二六年三月十八日，段祺瑞们枪击徒手请愿的学生的那一次，他也在群众中，给一个兵抓住了，问他是何等样人。答说是“做买卖的”。兵道：“那么，到这里来干什么？滚你的罢！”一推，他总算逃得了性命。
His appearance is quite difficult to describe, some elegant, some simple, and a little ordinary. So it looks like a scribe, an official, and a bit like a businessman. I have never seen such a businessman in the south, but there are in Beijing, who are shopkeepers of used bookstores or paper stores. On March 18, 1926, when Duan Qirui and others shot the students who were petitioning with their bare hands, he was also caught by a soldier in the crowd and asked what kind of person he was. He replied that he was "doing business". The soldier said: "So, what are you doing here?" Get out of here! With a push, he finally escaped with his life.倘说教员，那时是可以死掉的。
If you talk about teachers, you can die at that time.然而到第二年，他终于被张作霖们害死了。
However, in the second year, he was finally killed by Zhang Zuolin and others.
段将军的屠戮，死了四十二人，其中有几个是我的学生，我实在很觉得一点痛楚；张将军的屠戮，死的好像是十多人，手头没有记录，说不清楚了，但我所认识的只有一个守常先生。在厦门知道了这消息之后，椭圆的脸，细细的眼睛和胡子，蓝布袍，黑马褂，就时时出现在我的眼前，其间还隐约看见绞首台。痛楚是也有些的，但比先前淡漠了。这是我历来的偏见：见同辈之死，总没有像见青年之死的悲伤。
General Duan's massacre killed forty-two people, several of whom were my students, and I really felt a little pain; General Zhang's massacre seems to have killed more than ten people, and there are no records at hand, so I can't explain it clearly, but I only know one Mr. Shou Chang. After learning the news in Xiamen, the oval face, thin eyes and beard, blue cloth robe, and black horse coat appeared in front of my eyes from time to time, and I could vaguely see the gallows in the meantime. The pain was somewhat indifferent, but it was lighter than before. This is my long-standing prejudice: seeing the death of a peer is not as sad as seeing the death of a young man.
这回听说在北平公然举行了葬式，计算起来，去被害的时候已经七年了。这是极应该的。我不知道他那时被将军们所编排的罪状，——大概总不外乎“危害民国”罢。然而仅在这短短的七年中，事实就铁铸一般的证明了断送民国的四省的并非李大钊，却是杀戮了他的将军！
This time I heard that a funeral was openly held in Peiping, and it had been seven years since I was killed. This is extremely deserved. I don't know what crimes he was compiled by the generals at that time,—— it was probably nothing more than "endangering the Republic of China". However, in these short seven years alone, the facts have proven that it was not Li Dazhao who ruined the four provinces of the Republic of China, but the general who killed him!那么，公然下葬的宽典，该是可以取得的了。然而我在报章上，又看见北平当局的禁止路祭和捕拿送葬者的新闻。我也不知道为什么，但这回恐怕是“妨害治安”了罢。倘其果然，则铁铸一般的反证，实在来得更加神速：看罢，妨害了北平的治安的是日军呢还是人民！
Then, the benevolent burial should be obtainable. However, I saw in the newspaper that the Peking authorities had banned road sacrifices and arrested mourners. I don't know why, but this time I'm afraid it's "disturbing public order". If it is true, then the iron-cast counter-evidence will come even faster: After all, it is the Japanese army or the people who hindered the security of Peiping!但革命的先驱者的血，现在已经并不希奇了。单就我自己说罢，七年前为了几个人，就发过不少激昂的空论，后来听惯了电刑，枪毙，斩决，暗杀的故事，神经渐渐麻木，毫不吃惊，也无言说了。我想，就是报上所记的“人山人海”去看枭首示众的头颅的人们，恐怕也未必觉得更兴奋于看赛花灯的罢。血是流得太多了。
But the blood of the pioneers of the revolution is no longer surprising. Seven years ago, I made a lot of passionate empty theories for a few people, and then I got used to hearing stories of electrocution, shooting, execution, and assassination, and my nerves gradually became numb, and I was not surprised and speechless. I think that the people who go to see the heads of the beheads recorded in the newspapers may not be more excited to watch the lanterns. Too much blood is flowing.不过热血之外，守常先生还有遗文在。不幸对于遗文，我却很难讲什么话。因为所执的业，彼此不同，在《新青年》时代，我虽以他为站在同一战线上的伙伴，却并未留心他的文章，譬如骑兵不必注意于造桥，炮兵无须分神于驭马，那时自以为尚非错误。所以现在所能说的，也不过：一，是他的理论，在现在看起来，当然未必精当的；二，是虽然如此，他的遗文却将永住，因为这是先驱者的遗产，革命史上的丰碑。一切死的和活的骗子的一迭迭的集子，不是已在倒塌下来，连商人也“不顾血本”的只收二三折了么？
But in addition to the blood, Mr. Shouchang still has a posthumous writing. Unfortunately, it is difficult for me to say anything about the posthumous writings. Because their professions were different, in the era of "New Youth", although I regarded him as a partner on the same front, I did not pay attention to his articles, such as cavalry did not have to pay attention to building bridges, artillery did not need to be distracted by horses, and I thought I was not wrong at that time. So all I can say now is that: first, his theory, in the present view, of course, may not be accurate; Second, despite this, his posthumous writings will live forever, because this is the legacy of the pioneers and a monument in the history of the revolution. Isn't the stack of all dead and living liars already collapsing, and even the merchants only charge two or three discounts "regardless of the cost of blood"?以过去和现在的铁铸一般的事实来测将来，洞若观火！
Measure the future with the facts of the past and present, and see the fire!
一九三三年五月二十九夜，鲁迅谨记。
On the night of May 29, 1933, Lu Xun remembered.
这一篇，是T先生要我做的，因为那集子要在和他有关系的G书局出版。我谊不容辞，只得写了这一点，不久，便在《涛声》上登出来。但后来，听说那遗集稿子的有权者另托C书局去印了，至今没有出版，也许是暂时不会出版的罢，我虽然很后悔乱作题记的孟浪，但我仍然要在自己的集子里存留，记此一件公案。十二月三十一夜，附识。
This article was asked by Mr. T to be made by me, because the collection was to be published in G Bookstore, which has a relationship with him. I had to write this, and soon it was published in "The Sound of the Waves". But later, I heard that the person in charge of the manuscript of the collection had asked C Book Company to print it, and it has not been published so far, maybe it will not be published for the time being. On the night of December 31st, he was notified.

谈金圣叹

谈金圣叹

谈金圣叹

Talking about the golden sage讲起清朝的文字狱来，也有人拉上金圣叹，其实是很不合适的。他的“哭庙”，用近事来比例，和前年《新月》上的引据三民主义以自辩，并无不同，但不特捞不到教授而且至于杀头，则是因为他早被官绅们认为坏货了的缘故。就事论事，倒是冤枉的。
Speaking of the literary prison of the Qing Dynasty, some people also pulled Jin Shengsi, which is actually very inappropriate. His "crying temple", proportioned by recent events, is no different from the quotation of the Three People's Doctrine in the "New Moon" the year before last, but not only can he not catch the professor, but as for the beheading, it is because he has long been considered a bad product by the officials and gentry. It is unjust to talk about things.清中叶以后的他的名声，也有些冤枉。他抬起小说传奇来，和《左传》《杜诗》并列，实不过拾了袁宏道辈的唾余；而且经他一批，原作的诚实之处，往往化为笑谈，布局行文，也都被硬拖到八股的作法上。这余荫，就使有一批人，堕入了对于《红楼梦》之类，总在寻求伏线，挑剔破绽的泥塘。
His reputation after the middle of the Qing Dynasty was also a bit unjust. He lifted the legend of the novel and placed it side by side with "Zuo Zhuan" and "Du Shi", but he actually picked up the spit of Yuan Hongdao's generation; And after his batch, the honesty of the original work is often turned into a joke, and the layout of the writing is also dragged to the eight-strand approach. This afterglow has caused a group of people to fall into the mud pond of "Dream of Red Mansions", always looking for foreshadowing and picking on flaws.自称得到古本，乱改《西厢》字句的案子且不说罢，单是截去《水浒》的后小半，梦想有一个“嵇叔夜”来杀尽宋江们，也就昏庸得可以。虽说因为痛恨流寇的缘故，但他是究竟近于官绅的，他到底想不到小百姓的对于流寇，只痛恨着一半：不在于“寇”，而在于“流”。
Not to mention the case of claiming to have obtained an ancient book and randomly changing the words and sentences of "West Chamber", just cutting off the second half of "Water Margin", dreaming of having a "Uncle Ji" to kill Song Jiang, it is too mediocre. Although it is because he hates the bandits, he is close to the officials, and he can't imagine that the common people only hate half of the bandits: not in the "bandits", but in the "flow".百姓固然怕流寇，也很怕“流官”。记得民元革命以后，我在故乡，不知怎地县知事常常掉换了。每一掉换，农民们便愁苦着相告道：“怎么好呢？又换了一只空肚鸭来了！”他们虽然至今不知道“欲壑难填”的古训，却很明白“成则为王，败则为贼”的成语，贼者，流着之王，王者，不流之贼也，要说得简单一点，那就是“坐寇”。中国百姓一向自称“蚁民”，现在为便于譬喻起见，姑升为牛罢，铁骑一过，茹毛饮血，蹄骨狼藉，倘可避免，他们自然是总想避免的，但如果肯放任他们自啮野草，苟延残喘，挤出乳来将这些“坐寇”喂得饱饱的，后来能够比较的不复狼吞虎咽，则他们就以为如天之福。所区别的只在“流”与“坐”，却并不在“寇”与“王”。试翻明末的野史，就知道北京民心的不安，在李自成入京的时候，是不及他出京之际的利害的。
The people are certainly afraid of bandits, and they are also afraid of "flowing officials". I remember that after the Minyuan Revolution, I was in my hometown, and somehow the county governor was often changed. Every time they changed, the farmers complained to each other: "How is it?" Another empty-bellied duck is coming! Although they still do not know the ancient adage of "desire is difficult to fill", they understand very well the idiom of "success is king, failure is a thief", thief, the king of flowing, king, thief of not flowing, to put it simply, that is, "sitting on the bandit". The Chinese people have always called themselves "ant people", and now, for the sake of metaphor, the aunt has been promoted to a cow, and the iron cavalry has passed, the hair drinks blood, and the hooves and bones are messy, if it can be avoided, they naturally always want to avoid it, but if they are willing to let them eat the weeds, survive, and milk out to feed these "sitting bandits" to their heart's content, and then they can compare and no longer gobble up, then they think it is like a blessing from heaven. The difference is only in "flow" and "sitting", but not in "Kou" and "Wang". If you try to look at the wild history of the late Ming Dynasty, you will know that the uneasiness of the people in Beijing was not as good as the stakes when Li Zicheng left Beijing.宋江据有山寨，虽打家劫舍，而劫富济贫，金圣叹却道应该在童贯高俅辈的爪牙之前，一个个俯首受缚，他们想不懂。所以《水浒传》纵然成了断尾巴蜻蜓，乡下人却还要看《武松独手擒方腊》这些戏。
Song Jiang occupied the cottage, although he robbed his house and robbed the rich and helped the poor, but Jin Shengsian said that he should bow his head and be bound one by one before the minions of Tong Guan Gao Qiu, and they couldn't understand it. Therefore, even though "Water Margin" has become a dragonfly with a broken tail, the countrymen still have to watch the dramas "Wu Song Captures Fang La with One Hand".不过这还是先前的事，现在似乎又有了新的经验了。听说四川有一只民谣，大略是“贼来如梳，兵来如篦，官来如剃”的意思。汽车飞艇，价值既远过于大轿马车，租界和外国银行，也是海通以来新添的物事，不但剃尽毛发，就是刮尽筋肉，也永远填不满的。正无怪小百姓将“坐寇”之可怕，放在“流寇”之上了。
But this was still a thing before, and now it seems that there is a new experience. I heard that there is a folk song in Sichuan, which roughly means "thieves come like combs, soldiers come like grates, and officials come like shaves". The value of the car airship is far more than that of large cars, concessions and foreign banks, and it is also a new addition since Haitong. It is no wonder that the common people put the horror of "sitting on the bandits" on top of the "bandits".事实既然教给了这些，仅存的路，就当然使他们想到了自己的力量。
Since the facts taught these things, the only way left certainly made them think of their own strength.五月三十一日。
