又论“第三种人”

He also discussed the "third kind of people"戴望舒先生远远的从法国给我们一封通信，叙述着法国A. E. A. R. （革命文艺家协会）得了纪德的参加，在三月二十一日召集大会，猛烈的反抗德国法西斯谛的情形，并且绍介了纪德的演说，发表在六月号的《现代》上。法国的文艺家，这样的仗义执言的举动是常有的：较远，则如左拉为德来孚斯打不平，法朗士当左拉改葬时候的讲演；较近，则有罗曼罗兰的反对战争。但这回更使我感到真切的欢欣，因为问题是当前的问题，而我也正是憎恶法西斯谛的一个。不过戴先生在报告这事实的同时，一并指明了中国左翼作家的“愚蒙”和像军阀一般的横暴，我却还想来说几句话。但希望不要误会，以为意在辩解，希图中国也从所谓“第三种人”得到对于德国的被压迫者一般的声援，——并不是的。中国的焚禁书报，封闭书店，囚杀作者，实在还远在德国的白色恐怖以前，而且也得到过世界的革命的文艺家的抗议了。我现在要说的，不过那通信里的必须指出的几点。
Mr. Dai Wangshu sent us a letter from far away in France, describing the French A. E. A. R. (Revolutionary Writers and Artists Association) convened a congress on March 21 to fiercely resist the German fascist truth, and introduced Gide's speech, which was published in the June issue of Modern. French writers and artists often act righteously and speak-out: farther away, such as Zola's speech when Zola was unfair to Dreyfus, and France when Zola was reburied; Closer, there is Romain Rolland's opposition to the war. But this time I felt genuine joy, because the problem was the current problem, and I was one of the haters of fascism. However, while reporting this fact, Mr. Dai also pointed out the "ignorance" and warlord-like tyranny of Chinese left-wing writers, but I would like to say a few words. But I hope not to misunderstand, thinking that it is intended to justify that China also gets general solidarity with the oppressed in Germany from the so-called "third kind of people",—— it is not. China's burning of books and newspapers, the closure of bookstores, and the imprisonment of authors were really long before the White Terror in Germany, and they were also protested by revolutionary writers and artists around the world. What I want to say now, but there are a few points that must be pointed out in the correspondence.那通信叙述过纪德的加入反抗运动之后，说道——
The correspondence narrated Gide's joining the resistance movement, saying—“在法国文坛中，我们可以说纪德是‘第三种人’，……自从他在一八九一年……起，一直到现在为止，他始终是一个忠实于他的艺术的人。然而，忠实于自己的艺术的作者，不一定就是资产阶级的‘帮闲者’，法国的革命作家没有这种愚蒙的见解（或者不如说是精明的策略），因此，在热烈的欢迎之中，纪德便在群众之间发言了。”
"In the French literary world, we can say that Gide is the 'third kind of person',...... Since he was in 1891...... He has always been a man who is faithful to his art. However, the author who is faithful to his art is not necessarily the 'helper' of the bourgeoisie, and the French revolutionary writers do not have this foolish opinion (or rather, shrewd strategy), so in the midst of a warm welcome, Gide spoke among the masses. ”这就是说：“忠实于自己的艺术的作者”，就是“第三种人”，而中国的革命作家，却“愚蒙”到指这种人为全是“资产阶级的帮闲者”，现在已经由纪德证实，是“不一定”的了。
This means that "the author who is faithful to his art" is the "third kind of person", while the Chinese revolutionary writers are "ignorant" to the point that such people are all "bourgeois helpers", which has now been confirmed by Gide and is "not necessarily".这里有两个问题应该解答。
Here are two questions that should be answered.第一，是中国的左翼理论家是否真指“忠实于自己的艺术的作者”为全是“资产阶级的帮闲者”？据我所知道，却并不然。左翼理论家无论如何“愚蒙”，还不至于不明白“为艺术的艺术”在发生时，是对于一种社会的成规的革命，但待到新兴的战斗的艺术出现之际，还拿着这老招牌来明明暗暗阻碍他的发展，那就成为反动，且不只是“资产阶级的帮闲者”了。至于“忠实于自己的艺术的作者”，却并未视同一律。因为不问那一阶级的作家，都有一个“自己”，这“自己”，就都是他本阶级的一分子，忠实于他自己的艺术的人，也就是忠实于他本阶级的作者，在资产阶级如此，在无产阶级也如此。这是极显明粗浅的事实，左翼理论家也不会不明白的。但这位——戴先生用“忠实于自己的艺术”来和“为艺术的艺术”掉了一个包，可真显得左翼理论家的“愚蒙”透顶了。
First, do left-wing theorists in China really refer to "authors who are faithful to their own art" as "bourgeois helpers"? As far as I know, it is not. No matter how "ignorant" left-wing theorists are, they do not fail to understand that "art for art" is a conventional revolution of society when it occurs, but when the emerging art of fighting appears, it still holds this old sign to openly and implicitly hinder its development, and it becomes a reactionary, not just a "bourgeois helper". As for "authors who are faithful to their own art", they are not regarded as the same. Because regardless of which class of writers they have, they all have a "self", and this "self" is a member of his own class, a person who is faithful to his own art, that is, an author who is faithful to his own class, this is true in the bourgeoisie, and this is also true in the proletariat. This is a very obvious and superficial fact, and left-wing theorists will not fail to understand it. But this one, Mr. Dai, used "faithful to his own art" to "art for art" and dropped a bag, which really seemed to be the "ignorance" of left-wing theorists.第二，是纪德是否真是中国所谓的“第三种人”？我没有读过纪德的书，对于作品，没有加以批评的资格。但我相信：创作和演说，形式虽然不同，所含的思想是决不会两样的。我可以引出戴先生所绍介的演说里的两段来——
Second, is Jide really the so-called "third type of person" in China? I have not read Gide's books, and I have no qualifications to criticize his works. But I believe that although the forms of creation and speech are different, the ideas contained in them will never be the same. I can quote two paragraphs from Mr. Dai's speech -“有人会对我说：‘在苏联也是这样的。’那是可能的事；但是目的却是完全两样的，而且，为了要建设一个新社会起见，为了把发言权给与那些一向做着受压迫者，一向没有发言权的人们起见，不得已的矫枉过正也是免不掉的事。
"Someone would say to me: 'It was the same in the Soviet Union.' That's possible; But the purpose is completely different, and in order to build a new society, in order to give the right to speak to those who have always been oppressed and have never had the right to speak, it is inevitable that overcorrection will be necessary.“我为什么并怎样会在这里赞同我在那边所反对的事呢？那就是因为我在德国的恐怖政策中，见到了最可叹最可憎的过去底再演，在苏联的社会创设中，我却见到一个未来的无限的允约。”
"Why and how do I agree here with what I oppose over there? It is because I saw the most lamentable and hateful repetition of the past in Germany's policy of terror, but in the social creation of the Soviet Union, I saw an infinite promise of the future. ”这说得清清楚楚，虽是同一手段，而他却因目的之不同而分为赞成或反抗。苏联十月革命后，侧重艺术的“绥拉比翁的兄弟们”这团体，也被称为“同路人”，但他们却并没有这么积极。中国关于“第三种人”的文字，今年已经汇印了一本专书，我们可以查一查，凡自称为“第三种人”的言论，可有丝毫近似这样的意见的么？倘其没有，则我敢决定地说，“不可以说纪德是‘第三种人’”。
This is clearly stated that although it is the same means, he is divided into favor or resistance due to different purposes. After the October Revolution in the Soviet Union, the group "Brothers of Surabion", also known as "fellow travelers", which focused on art, was not so active. China's text on the "third kind of person" has been printed in a special book this year, we can check, can any remarks that call themselves "third kind people" have the slightest similar opinion? If not, then I dare to say decisively, "It cannot be said that Gide is a 'third kind of person'".然而正如我说纪德不像中国的“第三种人”一样，戴望舒先生也觉得中国的左翼作家和法国的大有贤愚之别了。他在参加大会，为德国的左翼艺术家同伸义愤之后，就又想起了中国左翼作家的愚蠢横暴的行为。于是他临末禁不住感慨——
However, just as I said that Ji De is not like the "third kind of people" in China, Mr. Dai Wangshu also feels that there is a big difference between Chinese left-wing writers and French writers. After attending the conference and expressing his righteous indignation for left-wing artists in Germany, he remembered the stupid and tyrannical behavior of Chinese left-wing writers. So he couldn't help but sigh at the end -“我不知道我国对于德国法西斯谛的暴行有没有什么表示。正如我们的军阀一样，我们的文艺者也是勇于内战的。在法国的革命作家们和纪德携手的时候，我们的左翼作家想必还在把所谓‘第三种人’当作唯一的敌手吧！”
"I don't know if our country has any representation for the atrocities of German fascism. Just like our warlords, our literary and artistic people also had the courage to fight civil wars. When the French revolutionary writers joined hands with Gide, our left-wing writers must still regard the so-called 'third kind of man' as their only enemy! ”这里无须解答，因为事实具在：我们这里也曾经有一点表示，但因为和在法国两样，所以情形也不同；刊物上也久不见什么“把所谓‘第三种人’当作唯一的敌手”的文章，不再内战，没有军阀气味了。戴先生的豫料，是落了空的。
There is no need to answer here, because the facts are there: we have also expressed a point here, but because it is different from in France; There has been no article in the publication for a long time that "regards the so-called 'third type of person' as the only enemy", no longer a civil war, and there is no smell of warlords. Mr. Dai's expectations were disappointed.然而中国的左翼作家，这就和戴先生意中的法国左翼作家一样贤明了么？我以为并不这样，而且也不应该这样的。如果声音还没有全被削除的时候，对于“第三种人”的讨论，还极有从新提起和展开的必要。戴先生看出了法国革命作家们的隐衷，觉得在这危急时，和“第三种人”携手，也许是“精明的策略”。但我以为单靠“策略”，是没有用的，有真切的见解，才有精明的行为，只要看纪德的讲演，就知道他并不超然于政治之外，决不能贸贸然称之为“第三种人”，加以欢迎，是不必别具隐衷的。不过在中国的所谓“第三种人”，却还复杂得很。
However, are Chinese left-wing writers as wise as the French left-wing writers that Mr. Dai had in mind? I thought it wasn't, and it shouldn't be. If the voice has not been completely deleted, it is extremely necessary to raise and expand the discussion of the "third type of person" anew. Mr. Dai saw the hidden intentions of the French revolutionary writers and felt that it might be a "shrewd strategy" to join hands with the "third kind of people" in this critical time. But I think that relying on "strategy" alone is useless, with real insights, there is shrewd behavior, as long as you watch Gide's speech, you know that he is not detached from politics, and must not be hastily called a "third kind of person", and there is no need to be secretive to welcome it. However, the so-called "third type of people" in China are still very complicated.所谓“第三种人”，原意只是说：站在甲乙对立或相斗之外的人。但在实际上，是不能有的。人体有胖和瘦，在理论上，是该能有不胖不瘦的第三种人的，然而事实上却并没有，一加比较，非近于胖，就近于瘦。文艺上的“第三种人”也一样，即使好像不偏不倚罢，其实是总有些偏向的，平时有意的或无意的遮掩起来，而一遇切要的事故，它便会分明的显现。如纪德，他就显出左向来了；别的人，也能从几句话里，分明的显出。所以在这混杂的一群中，有的能和革命前进，共鸣；有的也能乘机将革命中伤，软化，曲解。左翼理论家是有着加以分析的任务的。
The so-called "third type of person" originally meant that people who stand outside the opposition or fight between A and B. But in reality, there is no such thing. The human body has fat and thin, in theory, there should be a third type of person who is neither fat nor thin, but in fact there is none. The same is true for the "third type of person" in literature and art, even if it seems to be impartial, in fact, there is always some bias, usually intentionally or unintentionally covered up, and when there is an urgent accident, it will be clearly revealed. For example, Gide appears to be left; Other people can also clearly show it from a few sentences. Therefore, in this mixed group, some can advance and resonate with the revolution; Some can also take the opportunity to slander, soften, and misinterpret the revolution. Left-wing theorists have the task of analyzing them.如果这就等于“军阀”的内战，那么，左翼理论家就必须更加继续这内战，而将营垒分清，拔去了从背后射来的毒箭！
If this is equivalent to a civil war of "warlords", then left-wing theorists must continue this civil war even more, divide the camp, and pull out the poisoned arrows shot from behind!六月四日。
June 4th.

“蜜蜂”与“蜜”

“蜜蜂”与“蜜”

“蜜蜂”与“蜜”

"Bee" and "Honey"陈思先生：
Mr. Chen Si:看了《涛声》上批评《蜜蜂》的文章后，发生了两个意见，要写出来，听听专家的判定。但我不再来辩论，因为《涛声》并不是打这类官司的地方。
After reading the article criticizing "Bee" on "The Sound of the Waves", two opinions arose, to write them out and listen to the judgment of experts. But I don't come to debate anymore, because "The Sound of the Waves" is not the place to fight such lawsuits.村人火烧蜂群，另有缘故，并非阶级斗争的表现，我想，这是可能的。但蜜蜂是否会于虫媒花有害，或去害风媒花呢，我想，这也是可能的。
The villagers burned the bee colony, and for another reason, it was not a manifestation of class struggle, I think, this is possible. But whether bees are harmful to insect-borne flowers, or to wind-borne flowers, I think, is also possible.昆虫有助于虫媒花的受精，非徒无害，而且有益，就是极简略的生物学上也都这样说，确是不错的。但这是在常态时候的事。假使蜂多花少，情形可就不同了，蜜蜂为了采粉或者救饥，在一花上，可以有数匹甚至十余匹一涌而入，因为争，将花瓣弄伤，因为饿，将花心咬掉，听说日本的果园，就有遭了这种伤害的。它的到风媒花上去，也还是因为饥饿的缘故。这时酿蜜已成次要，它们是吃花粉去了。
Insects help the fertilization of insect-borne flowers, which is not only harmless, but also beneficial, even in a minimalist biology, it is indeed good. But this is a normal thing. If there are more bees and fewer flowers, the situation is different, bees can have several or even more than ten horses rushing in on a flower in order to collect pollen or relieve hunger, because of fighting, injuring the petals, because of hunger, biting off the flower heart, I heard that Japanese orchards have suffered this kind of injury. It goes to the wind media flower, but also because of hunger. At this time, honey production has become secondary, and they eat pollen.所以，我以为倘花的多少，足供蜜蜂的需求，就天下太平，否则，便会“反动”。譬如蚁是养护蚜虫的，但倘将它们关在一处，又不另给食物，蚁就会将蚜虫吃掉；人是吃米或麦的，然而遇着饥馑，便吃草根树皮了。
Therefore, I thought that if the amount of flowers was enough to meet the needs of bees, the world would be peaceful, otherwise, it would be "reactionary". For example, ants are for aphids, but if they are kept in one place and not given food, the ants will eat the aphids; People eat rice or wheat, but when they are hungry, they eat grass roots and bark.中国向来也养蜂，何以并无此弊呢？那是极容易回答的：因为少。近来以养蜂为生财之大道，干这事的愈多。然而中国的蜜价，远逊欧美，与其卖蜜，不如卖蜂。又因报章鼓吹，思养蜂以获利者辈出，故买蜂者也多于买蜜。因这缘故，就使养蜂者的目的，不在于使酿蜜而在于使繁殖了。但种植之业，却并不与之俱进，遂成蜂多花少的现象，闹出上述的乱子来了。
China has always kept bees, so why doesn't it have this problem? That's the easy answer: because there are few. Recently, beekeeping has been used as a way to make money, and more and more people are doing this. However, the price of honey in China is far inferior to that of Europe and the United States, and it is better to sell bees than to sell honey. In addition, due to the publicity in the newspapers, there are many people who want to make a profit from beekeeping, so more people buy bees than honey. For this reason, the purpose of beekeepers is not to make honey but to reproduce. However, the planting industry did not keep pace with it, so it became a phenomenon of more bees and fewer flowers, causing the above-mentioned trouble.总之，中国倘不设法扩张蜂蜜的用途，及同时开辟果园农场之类，而一味出卖蜂种以图目前之利，养蜂事业是不久就要到了绝路的。此信甚希发表，以冀有心者留意也。专此，顺请著安。
In short, if China does not try to expand the use of honey and open up orchards and farms at the same time, and blindly sells bee species for current profits, beekeeping will soon reach a dead end. This letter is rarely published, hoping that those who are interested will pay attention. Specifically for this, please be safe.罗怃。六月十一日。
Luo Zhen. June 11.

经验

经验

经验

experience古人所传授下来的经验，有些实在是极可宝贵的，因为它曾经费去许多牺牲，而留给后人很大的益处。
Some of the experience passed down by the ancients is really precious, because it has cost many sacrifices and left great benefits to future generations.偶然翻翻《本草纲目》，不禁想起了这一点。这一部书，是很普通的书，但里面却含有丰富的宝藏。自然，捕风捉影的记载，也是在所不免的，然而大部分的药品的功用，却由历久的经验，这才能够知道到这程度，而尤其惊人的是关于毒药的叙述。我们一向喜欢恭维古圣人，以为药物是由一个神农皇帝独自尝出来的，他曾经一天遇到过七十二毒，但都有解法，没有毒死。这种传说，现在不能主宰人心了。人们大抵已经知道一切文物，都是历来的无名氏所逐渐的造成。建筑，烹饪，渔猎，耕种，无不如此；医药也如此。这么一想，这事情可就大起来了：大约古人一有病，最初只好这样尝一点，那样尝一点，吃了毒的就死，吃了不相干的就无效，有的竟吃到了对证的就好起来，于是知道这是对于某一种病痛的药。这样地累积下去，乃有草创的纪录，后来渐成为庞大的书，如《本草纲目》就是。而且这书中的所记，又不独是中国的，还有阿剌伯人的经验，有印度人的经验，则先前所用的牺牲之大，更可想而知了。
Accidentally flipping through the "Compendium of Materia Medica", I can't help but think of this. This book is a very ordinary book, but it contains a lot of treasures. Naturally, the records of chasing the wind and shadows are also inevitable, but the function of most drugs can only be known to this extent by long-term experience, and what is particularly amazing is the narrative about poison. We have always liked to compliment the ancient sage, thinking that the medicine was tasted by an emperor Shennong alone, who once encountered seventy-two poisons in one day, but there was a solution, and he was not poisoned. This kind of legend can no longer dominate people's hearts. People probably already know that all cultural relics are gradually created by anonymous people in the past. Construction, cooking, fishing and hunting, farming, all of them; The same is true for medicine. When you think about it this way, this matter becomes bigger: when the ancients were sick, they had to taste a little like this and that at first, they would die if they ate poison, and if they ate irrelevant things, they would be ineffective, and some would get better after eating the right ones, so they knew that this was a medicine for a certain kind of disease. In this way, there is a record of the beginning, and later it gradually became a huge book, such as the "Compendium of Materia Medica". Moreover, what is recorded in this book is not only Chinese, but also the experience of the Arabs, and the experience of the Indians, so the great sacrifices used before can be imagined.然而也有经过许多人经验之后，倒给了后人坏影响的，如俗语说“各人自扫门前雪，莫管他家瓦上霜”的便是其一。救急扶伤，一不小心，向来就很容易被人所诬陷，而还有一种坏经验的结果的歌诀，是“衙门八字开，有理无钱莫进来”，于是人们就只要事不干己，还是远远的站开干净。我想，人们在社会里，当初是并不这样彼此漠不相关的，但因豺狼当道，事实上因此出过许多牺牲，后来就自然的都走到这条道路上去了。所以，在中国，尤其是在都市里，倘使路上有暴病倒地，或翻车摔伤的人，路人围观或甚至于高兴的人尽有，肯伸手来扶助一下的人却是极少的。这便是牺牲所换来的坏处。
However, there are also those who have had a bad impact on future generations after the experience of many people, such as the saying "everyone sweeps the snow in front of the door, don't care about the frost on the tiles of his house" is one of them. Emergency healing, if you are not careful, it has always been easy to be framed by others, and there is also a song of the result of bad experience, which is "the yamen is open, and there is no money to come in", so people just don't do things themselves, or stand away from a distance. I think that people in society were not so indifferent to each other at the beginning, but because the jackals were in power, in fact, they made many sacrifices because of this, and then they all naturally came to this road. Therefore, in China, especially in cities, if there are people on the road who fall to the ground suddenly due to illness, or who overturn and fall and are injured, there are passers-by watching or even happy people, but there are very few people who are willing to reach out to help. This is the disadvantage of sacrifice.总之，经验的所得的结果无论好坏，都要很大的牺牲，虽是小事情，也免不掉要付惊人的代价。例如近来有些看报的人，对于什么宣言，通电，讲演，谈话之类，无论它怎样骈四俪六，崇论宏议，也不去注意了，甚而还至于不但不注意，看了倒不过做做嘻笑的资料。这那里有“始制文字，乃服衣裳”一样重要呢，然而这一点点结果，却是牺牲了一大片地面，和许多人的生命财产换来的。生命，那当然是别人的生命，倘是自己，就得不着这经验了。所以一切经验，是只有活人才能有的，我的决不上别人讥刺我怕死，就去自杀或拚命的当，而必须写出这一点来，就为此。而且这也是小小的经验的结果。
In short, the results of experience, whether good or bad, require great sacrifices, and even if it is a small thing, it is inevitable to pay an astonishing price. For example, some people who read newspapers recently do not pay attention to any declarations, telegrams, speeches, conversations, etc., no matter how they are in a state of confusion and grand discussions, and even do not pay attention to them, but they only make laughing materials when they read them. There is as important as "the first writing is the clothing", but this little result is the sacrifice of a large area of land and the lives and property of many people. Life, of course, is someone else's life, if it is yourself, you will not get this experience. Therefore, all experience can only be possessed by living people, and I will never commit suicide or desperately commit suicide when others ridicule me for being afraid of death, but I must write this point, for this reason. And this is also the result of a little experience.六月十二日。
June 12th.

谚语

谚语

谚语

proverb粗略的一想，谚语固然好像一时代一国民的意思的结晶，但其实，却不过是一部分的人们的意思。现在就以“各人自扫门前雪，莫管他家瓦上霜”来做例子罢，这乃是被压迫者们的格言，教人要奉公，纳税，输捐，安分，不可怠慢，不可不平，尤其是不要管闲事；而压迫者是不算在内的。
Roughly speaking, proverbs seem to be the crystallization of the meaning of an era and a nation, but in fact, they are only the meanings of some people. This is the maxim of the oppressed, teaching people to serve the public, pay taxes, pay donations, be at peace, not neglect, not to be unfair, especially not to meddle in other people's affairs; And the oppressors are not included.专制者的反面就是奴才，有权时无所不为，失势时即奴性十足。孙皓是特等的暴君，但降晋之后，简直像一个帮闲；宋徽宗在位时，不可一世，而被掳后偏会含垢忍辱。做主子时以一切别人为奴才，则有了主子，一定以奴才自命：这是天经地义，无可动摇的。
The opposite of a dictator is a slave, who does everything when he has power, and is full of servility when he loses power. Sun Hao was a special tyrant, but after surrendering to Jin, he was like a helper; When Song Huizong was in power, he was invincible, and after being captured, he would endure humiliation. When you are a master, you treat all others as slaves, and if you have a master, you must call yourself a slave: this is natural and unshakable.所以被压制时，信奉着“各人自扫门前雪，莫管他家瓦上霜”的格言的人物，一旦得势，足以凌人的时候，他的行为就截然不同，变为“各人不扫门前雪，却管他家瓦上霜”了。
Therefore, when he was suppressed, the character who believed in the maxim "everyone sweeps the snow in front of the door, don't care about the frost on the tiles of his house", once he gained power and was enough to bully others, his behavior was completely different, and he became "everyone does not sweep the snow in front of the door, but cares about the frost on the tiles of his house".二十年来，我们常常看见：武将原是练兵打仗的，且不问他这兵是用以安内或攘外，总之他的“门前雪”是治军，然而他偏来干涉教育，主持道德；教育家原是办学的，无论他成绩如何，总之他的“门前雪”是学务，然而他偏去膜拜“活佛”，绍介国医。小百姓随军充伕，童子军沿门募款。头儿胡行于上，蚁民乱碰于下，结果是各人的门前都不成样，各家的瓦上也一团糟。
In the past twenty years, we have often seen that military generals were originally training and fighting, and they did not ask him whether this soldier was used to stabilize the country or repel the outside world, in short, his "snow in front of the door" was to govern the army, but he was biased to interfere with education and preside over morality; The educator originally ran a school, no matter what his grades were, in short, his "snow in front of the door" was academic affairs, but he preferred to worship the "living Buddha" and introduce traditional Chinese medicine. The common people followed the army as soldiers, and the Boy Scouts raised money along the door. The head walked nonsense on top, and the ant people bumped on the bottom, and the result was that everyone's door was not in shape, and the tiles of each house were also a mess.女人露出了臂膊和小腿，好像竟打动了贤人们的心，我记得曾有许多人絮絮叨叨，主张禁止过，后来也确有明文禁止了。不料到得今年，却又“衣服蔽体已足，何必前拖后曳，消耗布匹，……顾念时艰，后患何堪设想”起来，四川的营山县长于是就令公安局派队一一剪掉行人的长衣的下截。长衣原是累赘的东西，但以为不穿长衣，或剪去下截，即于“时艰”有补，却是一种特别的经济学。《汉书》上有一句云，“口含天宪”，此之谓也。
The woman showed her arms and calves, as if she had touched the hearts of the sages, and I remember that many people babbled and advocated prohibition, and later it was indeed explicitly prohibited. Unexpectedly, this year, "the clothes cover the body enough, why drag forward and backward, consume cloth,...... Considering the difficulties of the times, how can the future troubles be imagined", the county magistrate of Yingshan County in Sichuan ordered the Public Security Bureau to send a team to cut off the lower parts of the pedestrians' long clothes one by one. The long robe was originally a cumbersome thing, but it was thought that not wearing a long coat, or cutting off the lower section, that is, it would be helpful in "difficult times", but it was a special kind of economics. There is a sentence in the "Book of Han" that says, "The mouth contains the heavenly constitution," which is what it means.某一种人，一定只有这某一种人的思想和眼光，不能越出他本阶级之外。说起来，好像又在提倡什么犯讳的阶级了，然而事实是如此的。谣谚并非全国民的意思，就为了这缘故。古之秀才，自以为无所不晓，于是有“秀才不出门，而知天下事”这自负的漫天大谎，小百姓信以为真，也就渐渐的成了谚语，流行开来。其实是“秀才虽出门，不知天下事”的。秀才只有秀才头脑和秀才眼睛，对于天下事，那里看得分明，想得清楚。清末，因为想“维新”，常派些“人才”出洋去考察，我们现在看看他们的笔记罢，他们最以为奇的是什么馆里的蜡人能够和活人对面下棋。南海圣人康有为，佼佼者也，他周游十一国，一直到得巴尔干，这才悟出外国之所以常有“弑君”之故来了，曰：因为宫墙太矮的缘故。
A certain kind of person must only have this kind of person's thoughts and vision, and cannot go beyond his own class. Speaking of which, it seems that they are advocating some kind of taboo class again, but this is the case. Rumors and proverbs do not mean the whole people, just for this reason. The ancient scholars thought they knew everything, so there was a conceited lie that "the scholar does not go out, but knows the affairs of the world", and the common people believed it to be true, and gradually became a proverb and became popular. In fact, "although the scholar goes out, he doesn't know the affairs of the world". The scholar only has the scholar's mind and the scholar's eyes, and he can see clearly and think clearly about the affairs of the world. At the end of the Qing Dynasty, because they wanted to "reform", they often sent some "talents" to go abroad for inspection, and now let's take a look at their notes, what they are most surprised about is that the wax figures in the museum can play chess against living people. The saint of the South China Sea, Kang Youwei, was also a leader, he traveled around eleven countries, until he got to the Balkans, and then he realized that the reason why foreign countries often "killed kings" came, saying: Because the palace wall was too low.六月十三日。
June 13th.

大家降一级试试看

大家降一级试试看

大家降一级试试看

Let's try it down《文学》第一期的《〈图书评论〉所评文学书部分的清算》，是很有趣味，很有意义的一篇账。这《图书评论》不但是“我们唯一的批评杂志”，也是我们的教授和学者们所组成的唯一的联军。然而文学部分中，关于译注本的批评却占了大半，这除掉那《清算》里所指出的各种之外，实在也还有一个切要的原因，就是在我们学术界文艺界作工的人员，大抵都比他的实力凭空跳高一级。
The first issue of "Literature", "The Liquidation of the Literary Books Reviewed by Book Review", is a very interesting and meaningful account. The Book Review is not only "our only critical magazine", but also the only coalition of our professors and scholars. However, in the literary part, the criticism of the translation and annotation accounts for the majority, which is in addition to the various points pointed out in the "Liquidation", there is also an important reason, that is, the people who work in our academic and literary circles are probably one level higher than his strength.校对员一面要通晓排版的格式，一面要多认识字，然而看现在的出版物，“己”与“已”，“戮”与“戳”，“剌”与“刺”，在很多的眼睛里是没有区别的。版式原是排字工人的事情，因为他不管，就压在校对员的肩膀上，如果他再不管，那就成为和大家不相干。作文的人首先也要认识字，但在文章上，往往以“战慓”为“战慄”，以“巳竟”为“已经”；“非常顽艳”是因妒杀人的情形；“年已鼎盛”的意思，是说这人已有六十多岁了。至于译注的书，那自然，不是“硬译”，就是误译，为了训斥与指正，竟占去了九本《图书评论》中文学部分的书数的一半，就是一个不可动摇的证明。
On the one hand, proofreaders must be familiar with the format of typesetting, and on the other hand, they must know more words, but looking at the current publications, there is no difference between "self" and "already", "killing" and "poking", "pulling" and "tjaking", in many eyes. The layout was originally a typographer's business, because he didn't care, he put it on the shoulders of the proofreader, and if he didn't care, it would become irrelevant to everyone. People who compose essays must first know the words, but in the article, they often use "trembling" as "trembling" and "Sijing" as "already"; "Very stubborn" is a situation of killing people out of jealousy; "In the prime of life" means that the person is in his sixties. As for the translated books, naturally, they are either "hard translations" or mistranslations, and in order to reprimand and correct, they actually account for half of the number of books in the Chinese section of the nine "Book Reviews", which is an unshakable proof.这些错误的书的出现，当然大抵是因为看准了社会上的需要，匆匆的来投机，但一面也实在为了胜任的人，不肯自贬声价，来做这用力多而获利少的工作的缘故。否则，这些译注者是只配埋首大学，去谨听教授们的指示的。只因为能够不至于误译的人们洁身远去，出版界上空荡荡了，遂使小兵也来挂着帅印，辱没了翻译的天下。
The emergence of these wrong books is of course probably because they see the needs of society and come to speculate in a hurry, but on the other hand, they are really for the sake of competent people, who refuse to devalue themselves and do this work with more effort and less profit. Otherwise, these translators are only worthy of immersing themselves in the university and listening to the instructions of the professors. Just because the people who could not mistranslate went away, the publishing world was empty, so that the soldiers also came to hang the handsome seal, humiliating the world of translation.但是，胜任的译注家那里去了呢？那不消说，他也跳了一级，做了教授，成为学者了。“世无英雄，遂使竖子成名”，于是只配做学生的胚子，就乘着空虚，托庇变了译注者。而事同一律，只配做个译注者的胚子，却踞着高座，昂然说法了。杜威教授有他的实验主义，白璧德教授有他的人文主义，从他们那里零零碎碎贩运一点回来的就变了中国的呵斥八极的学者，不也是一个不可动摇的证明么？
But where did the competent translator go? Needless to say, he also jumped a level, became a professor, and became a scholar. "There is no hero in the world, so the boy became famous", so he was only worthy of being a student's embryo, and took advantage of the emptiness to become a translator. And everything is the same, only worthy of being a translator's embryo, but he sits on a high seat and speaks proudly. Isn't it also an unshakable proof that Professor Dewey has his experimentalism and Professor Bai Bide has his humanism, and those who come back from them piece by piece have become Chinese scholars who scold the eight extremes?要澄清中国的翻译界，最好是大家都降下一级去，虽然那时候是否真是都能胜任愉快，也还是一个没有把握的问题。
To clarify the Chinese translation industry, it is best for everyone to go down to a lower level, although it is still a question of uncertainty whether they can really be competent and happy at that time.七月七日。
July 7th.

沙

沙

沙

sand近来的读书人，常常叹中国人好像一盘散沙，无法可想，将倒楣的责任，归之于大家。其实这是冤枉了大部分中国人的。小民虽然不学，见事也许不明，但知道关于本身利害时，何尝不会团结。先前有跪香，民变，造反；现在也还有请愿之类。他们的像沙，是被统治者“治”成功的，用文言来说，就是“治绩”。
Recently, scholars often lament that the Chinese are like a plate of loose sand, and it is unimaginable that they attribute the responsibility for their unluck to everyone. In fact, this is wronging most Chinese. Although the common people do not learn and may not know what is happening, they will not unite when they know their own interests. There were kneeling incense, popular uprising, and rebellion; Now there are also petitions and the like. Their resemblance to sand was successfully "governed" by the ruler, and in literal terms, it was "governance".那么，中国就没有沙么？有是有的，但并非小民，而是大小统治者。
So, is there no sand in China? There are people, but not small people, but rulers of all sizes.人们又常常说：“升官发财”。其实这两件事是不并列的，其所以要升官，只因为要发财，升官不过是一种发财的门径。所以官僚虽然依靠朝廷，却并不忠于朝廷，吏役虽然依靠衙署，却并不爱护衙署，头领下一个清廉的命令，小喽罗是决不听的，对付的方法有“蒙蔽”。他们都是自私自利的沙，可以肥己时就肥己，而且每一粒都是皇帝，可以称尊处就称尊。有些人译俄皇为“沙皇”，移赠此辈，倒是极确切的尊号。财何从来？是从小民身上刮下来的。小民倘能团结，发财就烦难，那么，当然应该想尽方法，使他们变成散沙才好。以沙皇治小民，于是全中国就成为“一盘散沙”了。
People often say: "Get promoted and get rich". In fact, these two things are not parallel, the reason why they want to be promoted is just because they want to get rich, and promotion is just a way to get rich. Therefore, although the bureaucrats rely on the imperial court, they are not loyal to the imperial court, and although the officials rely on the yamen, they do not love the yamen, and the leader will never listen to the orders of integrity, and the methods of dealing with them are "blinded". They are all selfish sand, fattening themselves when they can fatten themselves, and each grain is an emperor, and they can be honored where they can be honored. Some people translate the Russian emperor as "Tsar" and transfer it to this generation, which is a very accurate honorific title. Where does wealth come from? It was scraped off the small people. If the common people can unite and get rich, it will be troublesome, then, of course, they should try their best to turn them into scattered sand. With the tsar to govern the common people, the whole of China became "a plate of loose sand".然而沙漠以外，还有团结的人们在，他们“如入无人之境”的走进来了。
However, beyond the desert, there are united people who walk in "as if in no man's land".这就是沙漠上的大事变。当这时候，古人曾有两句极切贴的比喻，叫作“君子为猿鹤，小人为虫沙”。那些君子们，不是像白鹤的腾空，就如猢狲的上树，“树倒猢狲散”，另外还有树，他们决不会吃苦。剩在地下的，便是小民的蝼蚁和泥沙，要践踏杀戮都可以，他们对沙皇尚且不敌，怎能敌得过沙皇的胜者呢？
This is the big change in the desert. At this time, the ancients had two extremely appointed metaphors, called "the gentleman is the ape and the crane, and the villain is the insect sand". Those gentlemen are not like the white crane soaring into the air, like the monkey climbing the tree, "the tree falls and the monkey scatters", and there are trees, they will never endure hardship. What is left on the ground is the ants and sediment of the common people, who can be trampled and killed, and they are still invincible to the Tsar, how can they compete with the Tsar's winners?然而当这时候，偏又有人摇笔鼓舌，向着小民提出严重的质问道：“国民将何以自处”呢，“问国民将何以善其后”呢？忽然记得了“国民”，别的什么都不说，只又要他们来填亏空，不是等于向着缚了手脚的人，要求他去捕盗么？
However, at this time, some people shook their pens and raised serious questions to the common people: "How will the people deal with themselves", "How will the people do their best"? Suddenly remembering the "nationals", nothing else, just asking them to fill the gap, isn't it equivalent to asking the person who has tied his hands and feet to catch the thief?但这正是沙皇治绩的后盾，是猿鸣鹤唳的尾声，称尊肥己之余，必然到来的末一着。
But this is the backing of the Tsar's achievements, the end of the ape's cry, and the end that will inevitably come in addition to honoring oneself.七月十二日。
July 12.

给文学社信

给文学社信

给文学社信

Letter to the Literary Society编辑先生：
Mr. Editor:《文学》第二号，伍实先生写的《休士在中国》中，开首有这样的一段——
In the second issue of "Literature", "Hughes in China" written by Mr. Wu Shi, there is such a paragraph at the beginning -“……萧翁是名流，自配我们的名流招待，且唯其是名流招待名流，这才使鲁迅先生和梅兰芳博士有千载一时的机会得聚首于一堂。休士呢，不但不是我们的名流心目中的那种名流，且还加上一层肤色上的顾忌！”
“…… Xiao Weng is a celebrity, and he deserves our celebrity hospitality, and only when he is a celebrity entertains celebrities, which gives Mr. Lu Xun and Dr. Mei Lanfang a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to get together. Hughes, not only is he not the kind of celebrity in the minds of our celebrities, but he also has a layer of scruples about skin color! ”是的，见萧的不只我一个，但我见了一回萧，就被大小文豪一直笑骂到现在，最近的就是这回因此就并我和梅兰芳为一谈的名文。然而那时是招待者邀我去的。这回的招待休士，我并未接到通知，时间地址，全不知道，怎么能到？即使邀而不到，也许有别种的原因，当口诛笔伐之前，似乎也须略加考察。现在并未相告，就责我不到，因这不到，就断定我看不起黑种。作者是相信的罢，读者不明事实，大概也可以相信的，但我自己还不相信我竟是这样一个势利卑劣的人！
Yes, I am not the only one who has seen Xiao, but once I saw Xiao, I have been laughed at and scolded by the big and small writers until now, and the most recent is this famous article that I and Mei Lanfang talked about. However, it was the hosts who invited me to go. This time I didn't receive a notice to entertain Hughes, I didn't know the time and address, how could I get there? Even if you can't get invited, there may be other reasons, and it seems that you need to investigate a little before criticizing and writing. Now that I haven't told you, you blame me for not being able to do it, and because I can't do it, I conclude that I look down on the black race. The author believes it, and the reader doesn't know the facts, so he can probably believe it, but I still don't believe that I am such a snobbish and despicable person!给我以诬蔑和侮辱，是平常的事；我也并不为奇：惯了。但那是小报，是敌人。略具识见的，一看就明白。而《文学》是挂着冠冕堂皇的招牌的，我又是同人之一，为什么无端虚构事迹，大加奚落，至于到这地步呢？莫非缺一个势利卑劣的老人，也在文学戏台上跳舞一下，以给观众开心，且催呕吐么？我自信还不至于是这样的脚色，我还能够从此跳下这可怕的戏台。那时就无论怎样诬辱嘲骂，彼此都没有矛盾了。
It is common to slander and insult me; I'm not surprised: I'm used to it. But that's the tabloid, it's the enemy. Those who have a little insight will understand it at a glance. And "Literature" is hung with a high-sounding signboard, and I am one of the same people, why do I make up fictional deeds for no reason and ridicule them, as for this point? Could it be that there is a lack of a snobbish and despicable old man who also dances on the literary stage to make the audience happy and induce vomiting? I am confident that I will not be like this, and I will be able to jump off this terrible stage from now on. At that time, no matter how much they were slandered and ridiculed, there was no contradiction between them.我看伍实先生其实是化名，他一定也是名流，就是招待休士，非名流也未必能够入座。不过他如果和上海的所谓文坛上的那些狐鼠有别，则当施行人身攻击之际，似乎应该略负一点责任，宣布出和他的本身相关联的姓名，给我看看真实的嘴脸。这无关政局，决无危险，况且我们原曾相识，见面时倒是装作十分客气的也说不定的。
I think Mr. Wu Shi is actually a pseudonym, he must also be a celebrity, that is, he entertains Hughes, and non-celebrities may not be able to take a seat. However, if he is different from the so-called foxes and rats in Shanghai's literary world, it seems that he should take a little responsibility when he commits a personal attack, announce the name associated with himself, and show me his real face. This has nothing to do with the political situation, there is no danger, and we have known each other before, so we may pretend to be very polite when we meet.临末，我要求这封信就在《文学》三号上发表。
At the end of the day, I asked this letter to be published in Literature No. 3.鲁迅。七月二十九日。
Lu Xun. July 29.

关于翻译

About translation今年是“国货年”，除“美麦”外，有些洋气的都要被打倒了。四川虽然正在奉令剪掉路人的长衫，上海的一位慷慨家却因为讨厌洋服而记得了袍子和马褂。翻译也倒了运，得到一个笼统的头衔是“硬译”和“乱译”。但据我所见，这些“批评家”中，一面要求着“好的翻译”者，却一个也没有的。
This year is the "Year of Domestic Products", in addition to "American wheat", some foreign ones are going to be knocked down. Although Sichuan was ordered to cut off the long shirts of passers-by, a generous man in Shanghai remembered the robe and horse coat because he hated foreign clothes. Translation is also unlucky, and the general titles are "hard translation" and "random translation". But as far as I can see, none of these "critics" demand "good translators".创作对于自己人，的确要比翻译切身，易解，然而一不小心，也容易发生“硬作”，“乱作”的毛病，而这毛病，却比翻译要坏得多。我们的文化落后，无可讳言，创作力当然也不及洋鬼子，作品的比较的薄弱，是势所必至的，而且又不能不时时取法于外国。所以翻译和创作，应该一同提倡，决不可压抑了一面，使创作成为一时的骄子，反因容纵而脆弱起来。我还记得先前有一个排货的年头，国货家贩了外国的牙粉，摇松了两瓶，装作三瓶，贴上商标，算是国货，而购买者却多损失了三分之一；还有一种痱子药水，模样和洋货完全相同，价钱却便宜一半，然而它有一个大缺点，是搽了之后，毫无功效，于是购买者便完全损失了。
Creation is indeed more relevant and easy to understand than translation, but if you are not careful, it is also easy to have the problem of "hard work" and "mess up", and this problem is much worse than translation. Our culture is backward, there is no denying that our creativity is not as good as that of foreign devils, and the comparison of works is weak, which is inevitable, and we cannot learn from foreign countries from time to time. Therefore, translation and creation should be advocated together, and must not be suppressed, so that creation becomes a temporary pride, but becomes vulnerable because of tolerance. I still remember that there was a year when domestic products sold foreign tooth powder, shook two bottles, pretended to be three bottles, and affixed them with trademarks, which were considered domestic products, but the buyer lost one-third more; There is also a kind of prickly heat potion, which looks exactly the same as foreign products, but the price is half cheaper, but it has a big disadvantage, that is, after applying it, it has no effect, so the buyer completely loses it.注重翻译，以作借镜，其实也就是催进和鼓励着创作。但几年以前，就有了攻击“硬译”的“批评家”，搔下他旧疮疤上的末屑，少得像膏药上的麝香一样，因为少，就自以为是奇珍。而这风气竟传布开来了，许多新起的论者，今年都在开始轻薄着贩来的洋货。比起武人的大买飞机，市民的拚命捐款来，所谓“文人”也者，真是多么昏庸的人物呵。
Paying attention to translation as a reference is actually promoting and encouraging creation. But a few years ago, there were "critics" who attacked the "hard translation", scratching off the scraps on his old scars, as little as musk on plaster, because there were few, they thought they were treasures. And this trend has spread, and many new commentators have begun to sell foreign goods lightly this year. Compared with the big purchase of planes by warriors, the desperate donations of citizens, the so-called "literati", what a mediocre character.我要求中国有许多好的翻译家，倘不能，就支持着“硬译”。理由还在中国有许多读者层，有着并不全是骗人的东西，也许总有人会多少吸收一点，比一张空盘较为有益。而且我自己是向来感谢着翻译的，例如关于萧的毁誉和现在正在提起的题材的积极性的问题，在洋货里，是早有了明确的解答的。关于前者，德国的尉特甫格（Karl Wittvogel）在《萧伯纳是丑角》里说过——
I ask that there are many good translators in China, and if not, they will support "hard translation". The reason is that there are still many readers in China, and there are things that are not all deceptive, and maybe there will always be people who will absorb a little bit, which is more beneficial than an empty disk. And I myself have always been grateful for the translation, for example, the question about Xiao's reputation and the enthusiasm of the subject matter that is being raised now has already been clearly answered in foreign goods. Regarding the former, Germany's Karl Wittvogel said in "George Bernard Shaw is a Harlequin" -“至于说到萧氏是否有意于无产阶级的革命，这并不是一个重要的问题。十八世纪的法国大哲学家们，也并不希望法国的大革命。虽然如此，然而他们都是引导着必至的社会变更的那种精神崩溃的重要势力。”（刘大杰译，《萧伯纳在上海》所载。）
As for whether Shaw was interested in the revolution of the proletariat, this is not an important question. The great French philosophers of the eighteenth century did not want a great revolution in France. However, they are all important forces in the kind of mental breakdown that leads to inevitable social change. (Translated by Liu Dajie, published in "George Bernard Shaw in Shanghai".) ）关于后者，则恩格勒在给明那·考茨基（Minna Kautsky，就是现存的考茨基的母亲）的信里，已有极明确的指示，对于现在的中国，也是很有意义的——
Regarding the latter, Engler has given very clear instructions in his letter to Minna Kautsky (the living Kautsky's mother), which is also very meaningful for today's China -“还有，在今日似的条件之下，小说是大抵对于布尔乔亚层的读者的，所以，由我看来，只要正直地叙述出现实的相互关系，毁坏了罩在那上面的作伪的幻影，使布尔乔亚世界的乐观主义动摇，使对于现存秩序的永远的支配起疑，则社会主义的倾向的文学，也就十足地尽了它的使命了——即使作者在这时并未提出什么特定的解决，或者有时连作者站在那一边也不很明白。”（日本上田进原译，《思想》百三十四号所载。）
"Also, under today's conditions, the novel is generally intended for the bourgeois reader, so it seems to me that as long as the interrelations of reality are honestly narrated, the illusion of fake over it is destroyed, the optimism of the bourgeois world is shaken, and the eternal domination of the existing order is questioned, then the literature of socialist tendencies has fulfilled its mission - even if the author does not propose any specific solution at this time, or sometimes even the author is not very clear on that side." (Translated by Susumu Ueda, Japan, published in Thought No. 134.) ）八月二日。
August 2nd.

《一个人的受难》序

《一个人的受难》序

《一个人的受难》序

Preface to "The Passion of a Man"“连环图画”这名目，现在已经有些用熟了，无须更改；但其实是应该称为“连续图画”的，因为它并非“如环无端”，而是有起有讫的画本。中国古来的所谓“长卷”，如《长江无尽图卷》，如《归去来辞图卷》，也就是这一类，不过联成一幅罢了。
The name "comic strip" is now somewhat familiar and does not need to be changed; But in fact, it should be called a "continuous picture", because it is not "like a ring without cause", but a picture book with a beginning and an end. The so-called "long scrolls" in ancient China, such as the "Yangtze River Endless Scroll" and "Return to the Words Scroll", are of this category, but they are just connected into one.这种画法的起源真是早得很。埃及石壁所雕名王的功绩，“死书”所画冥中的情形，已就是连环图画。别的民族，古今都有，无须细述了。这于观者很有益，因为一看即可以大概明白当时的若干的情形，不比文辞，非熟习的不能领会。到十九世纪末，西欧的画家，有许多很喜欢作这一类画，立一个题，制成画帖，但并不一定连贯的。用图画来叙事，又比较的后起，所作最多的就是麦绥莱勒。我想，这和电影有极大的因缘，因为一面是用图画来替文字的故事，同时也是用连续来代活动的电影。
The origin of this painting method is really very early. The exploits of famous kings carved on the stone walls of Egypt and the situation in the underworld painted by the "Book of Death" are already comic strips. There are other ethnic groups in ancient and modern times, so there is no need to go into detail. This is very beneficial to the viewer, because at a glance you can roughly understand some of the situations at that time, unlike the rhetoric, which cannot be understood by those who are not familiar with it. By the end of the 19th century, many Western European painters liked to make this type of painting, setting a title and making a picture post, but it was not necessarily coherent. Using pictures to narrate, and comparing the latecomers, the one who did the most was Mai Suilele. I think this has a lot to do with movies, because on the one hand, it is a story that uses pictures to replace words, and it is also a film that uses continuous activities to replace activities.麦绥莱勒（Frans Masereel）是反对欧战的一人；据他自己说，以一八九九年七月三十一日生于弗兰兑伦的勃兰勘培克（Blankenberghe in Flandern），幼小时候是很幸福的，因为玩的多，学的少。求学时代是在干德（Gent），在那里的艺术学院里学了小半年；后来就漫游德，英，瑞士，法国去了，而最爱的是巴黎，称之为“人生的学校”。在瑞士时，常投画稿于日报上，摘发社会的隐病，罗曼罗兰比之于陀密埃（Daumier）和戈耶（Goya）。但所作最多的是木刻的书籍上的插图，和全用图画来表现的故事。他是酷爱巴黎的，所以作品往往浪漫，奇诡，出于人情，因以收得惊异和滑稽的效果。独有这《一个人的受难》（Die Passion eines Menschen）乃是写实之作，和别的图画故事都不同。
Frans Masereel was one of the opposition to the European war; According to himself, he was born on July 31, 1899 in Blankenberghe in Flandern, and was very happy when he was a child, because he played more and learned less. I was in Gent, where I studied at the Academy of Arts for half a year; Later, I roamed Germany, England, Switzerland, and France, and my favorite was Paris, which I called "the school of life". When he was in Switzerland, he often submitted his drawings to daily newspapers to expose the hidden diseases of society, and Romain Rolland compared him to Daumier and Goya. But what he did most was illustrations on woodcut books and stories expressed entirely in pictures. He loves Paris, so his works are often romantic, strange, and out of human feelings, so he receives surprising and comical effects. This unique "Die Passion eines Menschen" is a realistic work, which is different from other picture stories.这故事二十五幅中，也并无一字的说明。但我们一看就知道：在桌椅之外，一无所有的屋子里，一个女子怀着孕了（一），生产之后，即被别人所斥逐，不过我不知道斥逐她的是雇主，还是她的父亲（二）。于是她只好在路上彷徨（三），终于跟了别人；先前的孩子，便进了野孩子之群，在街头捣乱（四）。稍大，去学木匠，但那么重大的工作，幼童是不胜任的（五），到底免不了被人踢出，像打跑一条野狗一样（六）。他为饥饿所逼，就去偷面包（七），而立刻被维持秩序的巡警所捕获（八），关进监牢里去了（九）。罚满释出（十），这回却轮到他在热闹的路上彷徨（十一），但幸而也竟找得了修路的工作（十二）。不过，终日挥着鹤嘴锄，是会觉得疲劳的（十三），这时乘机而入的却是恶友（十四），他受了诱惑，去会妓女（十五），去玩跳舞了（十六）。但归途中又悔恨起来（十七），决计进厂做工，而且一早就看书自习（十八）；在这环境里，这才遇到了真的相爱的同人（十九）。但劳资两方冲突了，他登高呼号，联合了工人，和资本家战斗（二十），于是奸细窥探于前（二十一），兵警弹压于后（二十二），奸细又从中离间，他被捕了（二十三）。在受难的“神之子”耶稣像前，这“人之子”就受着裁判（二十四）；自然是死刑，他站着，等候着兵们的开枪（二十五）！
In the twenty-five pictures of this story, there is not a single word of explanation. But we know at a glance: in a room with nothing except tables and chairs, a woman is pregnant (1), and after giving birth, she is rejected by others, but I don't know if it was her employer or her father (2) who reprimanded her. So she had to wander on the road (3) and finally followed others; The previous children joined the group of wild children and caused trouble in the streets (4). When he is a little older, he goes to learn carpentry, but such a major job, young children are not competent (5), and it is inevitable that they will be kicked out, like beating away a wild dog (6). Driven by hunger, he went to steal bread (7), and was immediately caught by the patrolmen who kept the order (8) and put in prison (9). After the punishment was completed (10), this time it was his turn to wander on the busy road (11), but fortunately he found a job to build a road (12). However, he will feel tired from wielding a crane's beak hoe all day long (13), but at this time it is the bad friend (14) who takes the opportunity to enter the room, and he is tempted to meet prostitutes (15) and go to play and dance (16). But on the way back, he regretted it again (17), decided to go to the factory to work, and read books early in the morning to study (18); In this environment, I met a fandom who really loved each other (19). However, when the labor and management clashed, he climbed the shouting sign, united the workers, and fought with the capitalists (20), so the spies spied on the front (21), the soldiers and police suppressed the back (22), and the spies sow discord between them, and he was arrested (23). In front of the image of Jesus, the suffering "Son of God," the "Son of Man" is judged (24); Naturally, it was the death penalty, he stood, waiting for the soldiers to shoot (twenty-five)!耶稣说过，富翁想进天国，比骆驼走过针孔还要难。但说这话的人，自己当时却受难（Passion）了。现在是欧美的一切富翁，几乎都是耶稣的信奉者，而受难的就轮到了穷人。
Jesus said that it is more difficult for a rich man to enter the kingdom of heaven than for a camel to walk through a pinhole. But the person who said this himself suffered passion at that time. Now almost all the rich in Europe and the United States are believers in Jesus, and it is the turn of the poor who suffer.这就是《一个人的受难》中所叙述的。
This is what is narrated in "The Passion of a Man".一九三三年八月六日，鲁迅记。
August 6, 1933, Lu Xunji.

祝《涛声》

祝《涛声》

Wishing "The Sound of the Waves"《涛声》的寿命有这么长，想起来实在有点奇怪的。
The lifespan of "The Sound of the Waves" is so long, it's really strange to think about it.大前年和前年，所谓作家也者，还有什么什么会，标榜着什么什么文学，到去年就渺渺茫茫了，今年是大抵化名办小报，卖消息；消息那里有这么多呢，于是造谣言。先前的所谓作家还会联成黑幕小说，现在是联也不会联了，零零碎碎的塞进读者的脑里去，使消息和秘闻之类成为他们的全部大学问。这功绩的褒奖是稿费之外，还有消息奖，“挂羊头卖狗肉”也成了过去的事，现在是在“卖人肉”了。
The year before last and the year before last, the so-called writers, what else can they do, what literature they advertise, by last year it was vague, this year is mostly a pseudonym to run tabloids, sell news; There is so much news there, so rumors are spread. In the past, the so-called writers would also be linked into shady novels, but now they will not be linked, stuffed into the readers' minds piece by piece, so that news and secret news become all their college questions. In addition to the manuscript fee, there is also a news award, and "selling dog meat with sheep's heads" has become a thing of the past, and now it is "selling human meat".于是不“卖人肉”的刊物及其作者们，便成为被卖的货色。这也是无足奇的，中国是农业国，而麦子却要向美国定购，独有出卖小孩，只要几百钱一斤，则古文明国中的文艺家，当然只好卖血，尼采说过：“我爱血写的书”呀。
As a result, publications that do not "sell human flesh" and their authors become the goods that are sold. This is also not surprising, China is an agricultural country, but wheat has to be ordered from the United States, and the only thing that sells children is only a few hundred dollars a pound, then the writers and artists in the ancient civilization country, of course, have to sell blood, Nietzsche said: "I love books written with blood".然而《涛声》尚存，这就是我所谓“想起来实在有点奇怪”。
However, "The Sound of the Waves" still exists, which is what I call "it's a bit strange to think about".这是一种幸运，也是一个缺点。看现在的景况，凡有敕准或默许其存在的，倒往往会被一部分人们摇头。有人批评过我，说，只要看鲁迅至今还活着，就足见不是一个什么好人。这是真的，自民元革命以至现在，好人真不知道被害死了多少了，不过谁也没有记一篇准账。这事实又教坏了我，因为我知道即使死掉，也不过给他们大卖消息，大造谣言，说我的被杀，其实是为了金钱或女人关系。所以，名列于该杀之林则可，悬梁服毒，是不来的。
This is both a stroke of luck and a disadvantage. Looking at the current situation, anyone who has permission or acquiesces to its existence will often be shaken by some people. Someone criticized me, saying that as long as you see that Lu Xun is still alive, it shows that he is not a good person. This is true, since the Minyuan Revolution to the present, good people really don't know how many people have been killed, but no one has kept an account. This fact taught me badly, because I knew that even if I died, I would only sell them the news, spread rumors, and say that I was killed for money or women's relationships. Therefore, it is okay to be listed in the forest of killing, but it is not possible to take poison from the hanging beam.《涛声》上常有赤膊打仗，拚死拚活的文章，这脾气和我很相反，并不是幸存的原因。我想，那幸运而且也是缺点之处，是在总喜欢引古证今，带些学究气。中国人虽然自夸“四千余年古国古”，可是十分健忘的，连民族主义文学家，也会认成吉斯汗为老祖宗，则不宜与之谈古也可见。上海的市侩们更不需要这些，他们感到兴趣的只是今天开奖，邻右争风；眼光远大的也不过要知道名公如何游山，阔人和谁要好之类；高尚的就看什么学界琐闻，文坛消息。总之，是已将生命割得零零碎碎了。
There are often articles on "The Sound of the Waves" about fighting shirtless and fighting to the death, which is the opposite of my temper and is not the reason for survival. I think that luck and disadvantage is that I always like to quote the past and prove the present, with a bit of pedanticism. Although the Chinese boast of "more than 4,000 years of ancient national ancients", they are very forgetful, and even nationalist writers will recognize Genghis Khan as their ancestor, so it is not appropriate to talk about the ancients. The philistines in Shanghai don't need these even more, they are only interested in today's lottery and the neighbors and the right are competing with each other; The far-sighted only knows how the famous man swims in the mountains, and who is good with the broad person; The noble ones look at what academic trivia and literary news they have. In short, life has been cut to pieces.这可以使《涛声》的销路不见得好，然而一面也使《涛声》长寿。文人学士是清高的，他们现在也更加聪明，不再恭维自己的主子，来着痕迹了。他们只是排好暗箭，拿定粪帚，监督着应该俯伏着的奴隶们，看有谁抬起头来的，就射过去，洒过去，结果也许会终于使这人被绑架或被暗杀，由此使民国的国民一律“平等”。《涛声》在销路上的不大出头，也正给它逃了暂时的性命，不过，也还是很难说，因为“不测之威”，也是古来就有的。
This can make the sales of "The Sound of the Waves" not necessarily good, but on the other hand, it also makes "The Sound of the Waves" longevity. Literati and bachelors are noble, and they are smarter now, no longer complimenting their masters, and there are traces. They just lined up the hidden arrows, took the dung broom, supervised the slaves who should be prostrated, and when they saw who raised their heads, they shot and sprinkled them, and the result might finally make the person kidnapped or assassinated, so that the people of the Republic of China were all "equal". "The Sound of the Waves" has not made a big start in sales, and it is also escaping its temporary life, but it is still difficult to say, because the "unpredictable power" has also existed since ancient times.我是爱看《涛声》的，并且以为这样也就好。然而看近来，不谈政治呀，仍谈政治呀，似乎更加不大安分起来，则我的那些忠告，对于“乌鸦为记”的刊物，恐怕也不见得有效。
I love watching "The Sound of the Waves" and think it's okay. However, looking at the recent situation, it seems that not talking about politics but still talking about politics seems to be even more uneasy, so my advice may not be effective for the publication "Crow as a Record".那么，“祝”也还是“白祝”，我也只好看一张，算一张了。昔人诗曰，“丧乱死多门”，信夫！
Then, "Zhu" is still "Bai Zhu", I have to look at one, count one. The ancients wrote in a poem that said, "In chaos and chaos, many people die at the door," and this is indeed true!八月六日。
August 6th.十一月二十五日的《涛声》上，果然发出《休刊辞》来，开首道：“十一月二十日下午，本刊奉令缴还登记证，‘民亦劳止，汔可小康’。我们准备休息一些时了。……”这真是康有为所说似的“不幸而吾言中”，岂不奇而不奇也哉。
On November 25, the "Sound of the Waves" indeed issued a "Closure Speech", which began: "On the afternoon of November 20, this magazine was ordered to return the registration certificate, 'the people are also tired, and they can be well-off'. It's time for us to take a break. ...... this is really what Kang Youwei said, "unfortunately and in my words", isn't it strange and not surprising?十二月三十一夜，补记。

上海的少女

上海的少女

上海的少女

A girl in Shanghai在上海生活，穿时髦衣服的比土气的便宜。如果一身旧衣服，公共电车的车掌会不照你的话停车，公园看守会格外认真的检查入门券，大宅子或大客寓的门丁会不许你走正门。所以，有些人宁可居斗室，喂臭虫，一条洋服裤子却每晚必须压在枕头下，使两面裤腿上的折痕天天有棱角。
Living in Shanghai, wearing fashionable clothes is cheaper than rustic. If you are wearing old clothes, the conductor of the public tram will stop without your words, the park guards will check the entrance ticket very carefully, and the doorman of the big house or the big guest house will not allow you to go through the main gate. Therefore, some people would rather live in a fighting room and feed bed bugs, but a pair of clothes and pants must be pressed under the pillow every night, so that the creases on the legs of both sides are angular every day.然而更便宜的是时髦的女人。这在商店里最看得出：挑选不完，决断不下，店员也还是很能忍耐的。不过时间太长，就须有一种必要的条件，是带着一点风骚，能受几句调笑。否则，也会终于引出普通的白眼来。
Cheaper, however, are fashionable women. This is most evident in the store: there is no choice but to make a decision, and the clerk is still very patient. But if the time is too long, there must be a necessary condition, which is to be a little coquettish and be able to be ridiculed. Otherwise, it will finally lead to ordinary white eyes.惯在上海生活了的女性，早已分明地自觉着这种自己所具的光荣，同时也明白着这种光荣中所含的危险。所以凡有时髦女子所表现的神气，是在招摇，也在固守，在罗致，也在抵御，像一切异性的亲人，也像一切异性的敌人，她在喜欢，也正在恼怒。这神气也传染了未成年的少女，我们有时会看见她们在店铺里购买东西，侧着头，佯嗔薄怒，如临大敌。自然，店员们是能像对于成年的女性一样，加以调笑的，而她也早明白着这调笑的意义。总之：她们大抵早熟了。
Women who are accustomed to living in Shanghai have long been clearly aware of this glory of themselves, and at the same time understand the dangers contained in this glory. Therefore, the spirit shown by fashionable women is ostentatious, stubborn, Luo Zhi, and resisting, like all relatives of the opposite sex, and like all enemies of the opposite sex, she is liked and angry. This aura also infects underage girls, and we sometimes see them buying things in stores, tilting their heads, pretending to be angry, as if facing a great enemy. Naturally, the clerks can tease them like adult women, and she has long understood the meaning of this teasing. In short: they are probably precocious.然而我们在日报上，确也常常看见诱拐女孩，甚而至于凌辱少女的新闻。
However, we often see news in the daily newspaper about abducting girls and even abusing girls.不但是《西游记》里的魔王，吃人的时候必须童男和童女而已，在人类中的富户豪家，也一向以童女为侍奉，纵欲，鸣高，寻仙，采补的材料，恰如食品的餍足了普通的肥甘，就想乳猪芽茶一样。现在这现象并且已经见于商人和工人里面了，但这乃是人们的生活不能顺遂的结果，应该以饥民的掘食草根树皮为比例，和富户豪家的纵恣的变态是不可同日而语的。
Not only the demon king in "Journey to the West", when eating people, they must be boys and girls, but also the rich families among humans have always served virgins, indulging, singing high, seeking immortals, and collecting materials, just like the food is full of ordinary fat and sweetness, just like suckling pig bud tea. Now this phenomenon has been seen in merchants and workers, but this is the result of people's lives not going smoothly, and it should be proportional to the hungry digging up grass roots and bark, which is not the same as the indulgent perversion of the rich and wealthy.但是，要而言之，中国是连少女也进了险境了。
However, in short, even girls in China are in danger.这险境，更使她们早熟起来，精神已是成人，肢体却还是孩子。俄国的作家梭罗古勃曾经写过这一种类型的少女，说是还是小孩子，而眼睛却已经长大了。然而我们中国的作家是另有一种称赞的写法的：所谓“娇小玲珑”者就是。
This dangerous situation made them even more precocious, their spirits were already adults, but their limbs were still children. The Russian writer Thoreau Gubb once wrote about this type of girl, saying that she was still a child, but her eyes had grown. However, our Chinese writers have another way of praising it: the so-called "petite and exquisite" is.八月十二日。

上海的儿童

上海的儿童

上海的儿童

Children in Shanghai上海越界筑路的北四川路一带，因为打仗，去年冷落了大半年，今年依然热闹了，店铺从法租界搬回，电影院早经开始，公园左近也常见携手同行的爱侣，这是去年夏天所没有的。
The area around North Sichuan Road, where Shanghai crossed the border to build roads, was snubbed for more than half a year last year because of the war, but it is still lively this year, the shops moved back from the French Concession, the cinema began early, and the park was also common to see lovers walking hand in hand, which was not there last summer.倘若走进住家的弄堂里去，就看见便溺器，吃食担，苍蝇成群的在飞，孩子成队的在闹，有剧烈的捣乱，有发达的骂詈，真是一个乱烘烘的小世界。但一到大路上，映进眼帘来的却只是轩昂活泼地玩着走着的外国孩子，中国的儿童几乎看不见了。但也并非没有，只因为衣裤郎当，精神萎靡，被别人压得像影子一样，不能醒目了。
If you walk into the alley of your home, you will see urinals, food burdens, flies flying in groups, children in groups, violent trouble, and developed scolding, it is really a chaotic little world. But when I arrived on the road, I only saw foreign children playing and walking in high spirits, and Chinese children were almost invisible. But it's not nothing, just because of the messy clothes, the spirit is sluggish, and the pressure is like a shadow by others, and it can't be conspicuous.中国中流的家庭，教孩子大抵只有两种法。其一，是任其跋扈，一点也不管，骂人固可，打人亦无不可，在门内或门前是暴主，是霸王，但到外面，便如失了网的蜘蛛一般，立刻毫无能力。其二，是终日给以冷遇或呵斥，甚而至于打扑，使他畏葸退缩，仿佛一个奴才，一个傀儡，然而父母却美其名曰“听话”，自以为是教育的成功，待到放他到外面来，则如暂出樊笼的小禽，他决不会飞鸣，也不会跳跃。
In middle-class Chinese families, there are probably only two ways to teach children. First, it is to let it be domineering, it doesn't matter at all, it's okay to scold people, it's okay to beat people, inside or in front of the door is a tyrant, a tyrant, a tyrant, but outside, like a spider that has lost its web, immediately powerless. Second, he was treated coldly or scolded all day long, and even beaten, making him afraid and flinching, like a servant and a puppet, but his parents called him "obedient", thinking that he was a success in education, and when he was let outside, he was like a bird temporarily out of the cage, he would never fly or jump.现在总算中国也有印给儿童看的画本了，其中的主角自然是儿童，然而画中人物，大抵倘不是带着横暴冥顽的气味，甚而至于流氓模样的，过度的恶作剧的顽童，就是钩头耸背，低眉顺眼，一副死板板的脸相的所谓“好孩子”。这虽然由于画家本领的欠缺，但也是取儿童为范本的，而从此又以作供给儿童仿效的范本。我们试一看别国的儿童画罢，英国沉着，德国粗豪，俄国雄厚，法国漂亮，日本聪明，都没有一点中国似的衰惫的气象。观民风是不但可以由诗文，也可以由图画，而且可以由不为人们所重的儿童画的。
Now there are finally picture books printed for children in China, and the protagonists in them are naturally children, but the characters in the paintings, if they are not with the smell of tyranny and stubbornness, or even the rogue-like and excessive mischievous urchins, are the so-called "good boys" with hooked heads and shrugged backs, low eyebrows and pleasing eyes, and a rigid face. Although this is due to the lack of painter skills, it is also modeled after children, and since then it has been used as a model for children to imitate. Let's try to look at the children's paintings of other countries, Britain is calm, Germany is bold, Russia is strong, France is beautiful, Japan is smart, and there is no declining atmosphere like China. Folk customs can be drawn not only by poetry, but also by pictures, and by children who are not valued by people.顽劣，钝滞，都足以使人没落，灭亡。童年的情形，便是将来的命运。我们的新人物，讲恋爱，讲小家庭，讲自立，讲享乐了，但很少有人为儿女提出家庭教育的问题，学校教育的问题，社会改革的问题。先前的人，只知道“为儿孙作马牛”，固然是错误的，但只顾现在，不想将来，“任儿孙作马牛”，却不能不说是一个更大的错误。
Stubbornness and dullness are enough to make people fall and perish. The situation of childhood is the fate of the future. Our new characters talk about love, small families, self-reliance, and pleasure, but few people raise the issue of family education, school education, and social reform for their children. The previous people only knew that "being a horse and a cow for their children and grandchildren" was certainly wrong, but they only cared about the present and did not want to do it in the future, and "let their children and grandchildren be horses and cattle" could not help but say that it was a bigger mistake.八月十二日。

“论语一年”

“论语一年”

“论语一年”

"One Year of the Analects"——借此又谈萧伯纳
——Let's talk about George Bernard Shaw again说是《论语》办到一年了，语堂先生命令我做文章。这实在好像出了“学而一章”的题目，叫我做一篇白话八股一样。没有法，我只好做开去。
It is said that the "Analects" has been done for a year, and Mr. Yutang ordered me to make an article. This is really like coming up with the topic of "learning a chapter" and asking me to make a vernacular eight-strand. There was no way, so I had to do it.老实说罢，他所提倡的东西，我是常常反对的。先前，是对于“费厄泼赖”，现在呢，就是“幽默”。我不爱“幽默”，并且以为这是只有爱开圆桌会议的国民才闹得出来的玩意儿，在中国，却连意译也办不到。我们有唐伯虎，有徐文长；还有最有名的金圣叹，“杀头，至痛也，而圣叹以无意得之，大奇！”虽然不知道这是真话，是笑话；是事实，还是谣言。但总之：一来，是声明了圣叹并非反抗的叛徒；二来，是将屠户的凶残，使大家化为一笑，收场大吉。我们只有这样的东西，和“幽默”是并无什么瓜葛的。
To be honest, I often oppose what he advocates. Previously, it was for "Fei Erpre", but now, it is "humor". I don't like "humor" and think that this is something that only citizens who love round tables can make, but in China, they can't even do it. we have Tang Bohu and Xu Wenchang; There is also the most famous Jin Shengsi, "Killing the head is the most painful, and the Holy Sigh is unintentional, which is amazing!" "Although I don't know if this is the truth, it is a joke; Is it a fact or a rumor? But in short: first, it is a statement that the holy sigh is not a traitor to resistance; second, it is to turn the murderous butcher into a smile and end well. We only have such things, and it has nothing to do with "humor".况且作者姓氏一大篇，动手者寥寥无几，乃是中国的古礼。在这种礼制之下，要每月说出两本“幽默”来，倒未免有些“幽默”的气息。这气息令人悲观，加以不爱，就使我不大热心于《论语》了。
Moreover, the author's surname is a large piece, and there are very few people who do it, which is an ancient Chinese ritual. Under this etiquette system, it is inevitable that there will be some "humor" in two books every month. This atmosphere is pessimistic, and if I don't love it, I won't be very enthusiastic about the Analects.然而，《萧的专号》是好的。
However, "Xiao's Special Number" is good.它发表了别处不肯发表的文章，揭穿了别处故意颠倒的谈话，至今还使名士不平，小官怀恨，连吃饭睡觉的时候都会记得起来。憎恶之久，憎恶者之多，就是效力之大的证据。
It published articles that refused to be published elsewhere, exposed deliberately upside-down conversations elsewhere, and still made celebrities unfair, and small officials held grudges, even remembering them when they ate and slept. The long hatred and the number of haters are great evidence of effectiveness.莎士比亚虽然是“剧圣”，我们不大有人提起他。五四时代绍介了一个易卜生，名声倒还好，今年绍介了一个萧，可就糟了，至今还有人肚子在发胀。
Although Shakespeare is a "dramatic saint", we don't have many people mention him. In the May Fourth era, Shao introduced an Ibsen, and his reputation was okay, but this year he introduced a Xiao, but it was bad, and there are still people whose stomachs are bloated.为了他笑嘻嘻，辨不出是冷笑，是恶笑，是嘻笑么？并不是的。为了他笑中有刺，刺着了别人的病痛么？也不全是的。列维它夫说得很分明：就因为易卜生是伟大的疑问号（？），而萧是伟大的感叹号（！）的缘故。
For him to laugh, can't you tell if it's a sneer, a bad smile, or a laugh? Not really. For him to laugh and stab other people's pain? Not all. Levitav said it very clearly: just because Ibsen is a great question mark (?) ), and Xiao is the great exclamation mark (!) )他们的看客，不消说，是绅士淑女们居多。绅士淑女们是顶爱面子的人种。易卜生虽然使他们登场，虽然也揭发一点隐蔽，但并不加上结论，却从容的说道“想一想罢，这到底是些什么呢？”绅士淑女们的尊严，确也有一些动摇了，但究竟还留着摇摇摆摆的退走，回家去想的余裕，也就保存了面子。至于回家之后，想了也未，想得怎样，那就不成什么问题，所以他被绍介进中国来，四平八稳，反对的比赞成的少。萧可不这样了，他使他们登场，撕掉了假面具，阔衣装，终于拉住耳朵，指给大家道，“看哪，这是蛆虫！”连磋商的工夫，掩饰的法子也不给人有一点。这时候，能笑的就只有并无他所指摘的病痛的下等人了。在这一点上，萧是和下等人相近的，而也就和上等人相远。
Needless to say, most of their spectators are gentlemen and ladies. Gentlemen and ladies are the most face-saving people. Although Ibsen made them appear, although he also exposed a little concealment, he did not add a conclusion, but calmly said, "Think about it, what is this?" "The dignity of gentlemen and ladies has indeed been shaken a little, but in the end, there is still room to retreat and go home to think, and they save face. As for after returning home, he didn't think about it, and what he thought about it would not be a problem, so he was introduced into China, and he was stable, and there were fewer people who opposed it than those who agreed. Xiao Ke was not like this, he made them appear, tore off their masks, wide clothes, and finally grabbed their ears and pointed to everyone, "Look, this is a maggot!" "Even the time of negotiation and the way to cover it up are not given a little. At this time, the only people who can laugh are the inferior people who do not have the illness he blames. At this point, Xiao is close to the lower class, but far from the upper class.这怎么办呢？仍然有一定的古法在。就是：大家沸沸扬扬的嚷起来，说他有钱，说他装假，说他“名流”，说他“狡猾”，至少是和自己们差不多，或者还要坏。自己是生活在小茅厕里的，他却从大茅厕里爬出，也是一只蛆虫，绍介者胡涂，称赞的可恶。然而，我想，假使萧也是一只蛆虫，却还是一只伟大的蛆虫，正如可以同有许多感叹号，而惟独他是“伟大的感叹号”一样。譬如有一堆蛆虫在这里罢，一律即即足足，自以为是绅士淑女，文人学士，名宦高人，互相点头，雍容揖让，天下太平，那就是全体没有什么高下，都是平常的蛆虫。但是，如果有一只蓦地跳了出来，大喝一声道：“这些其实都是蛆虫！”那么，——自然，它也是从茅厕里爬出来的，然而我们非认它为特别的伟大的蛆虫则不可。
What should I do? There are still certain ancient methods. That is: everyone is clamoring, saying that he is rich, that he is fake, that he is "fake", that he is "cunning", at least that he is similar to them, or worse. He lived in a small toilet, but he crawled out of the big toilet, and he was also a maggot. However, I think that if Xiao is also a maggot, he is still a great maggot, just as there can be many exclamation marks, and he is the only one who is a "great exclamation mark". For example, if there is a bunch of maggots here, they are all satisfied, thinking that they are gentlemen and ladies, literati and scholars, famous eunuchs, nodding to each other, bowing gracefully, and the world is peaceful, that is, all of them are not superior or inferior, they are all ordinary maggots. However, if one jumped out and shouted, "These are actually maggots!" "Naturally, then,—— it also crawls out of the toilet, but we must recognize it as a particularly great maggot.蛆虫也有大小，有好坏的。
Maggots come in sizes, good and bad.生物在进化，被达尔文揭发了，使我们知道了我们的远祖和猴子是亲戚。然而那时的绅士们的方法，和现在是一模一样的：他们大家倒叫达尔文为猴子的子孙。罗广廷博士在广东中山大学的“生物自然发生”的实验尚未成功，我们姑且承认人类是猴子的亲戚罢，虽然并不十分体面。但这同是猴子的亲戚中，达尔文又不能不说是伟大的了。那理由很简单而且平常，就因为他以猴子亲戚的家世，却并不忌讳，指出了人们是猴子的亲戚来。
Creatures are evolving, and Darwin exposed them, so that we know that our distant ancestors and monkeys are relatives. However, the gentlemen's methods at that time were exactly the same as they do now: they all called Darwin a descendant of monkeys. Dr. Luo Guangting's experiment on "spontaneous biological generation" at Sun Yat-sen University in Guangdong has not been successful, so let's admit that humans are relatives of monkeys, although it is not very decent. But among the relatives of the monkey, Darwin cannot but be said to be great. The reason is very simple and ordinary, because he is not taboo about the family background of monkey relatives, and points out that people are relatives of monkeys.猴子的亲戚也有大小，有好坏的。
Monkey relatives also have large and small sizes, good and bad.但达尔文善于研究，却不善于骂人，所以被绅士们嘲笑了小半世。给他来斗争的是自称为“达尔文的咬狗”的赫胥黎，他以渊博的学识，警辟的文章，东冲西突，攻陷了自以为亚当和夏娃的子孙们的最后的堡垒。现在是指人为狗，变成摩登了，也算是一句恶骂。但是，便是狗罢，也不能一例而论的，有的食肉，有的拉橇，有的为军队探敌，有的帮警署捉人，有的在张园赛跑，有的跟化子要饭。将给阔人开心的吧儿和在雪地里救人的猛犬一比较，何如？如赫胥黎，就是一匹有功人世的好狗。
But Darwin was good at research, but not good at scolding, so he was ridiculed by gentlemen for half his life. He was fought by Huxley, who called himself "Darwin's biting dog", and with his profound knowledge and vigilant writings, he rushed east and west to capture the last bastion of the descendants of Adam and Eve. Now it means that people are dogs, and they have become modern, which can be regarded as a bad scolding. However, even if it is a dog, it cannot be said in one case, some eat meat, some pull sleds, some scout the enemy for the army, some help the police station catch people, some race in Zhangyuan, and some ask Huazi for food. How about comparing the bar that makes people happy with the fierce dog that rescues people in the snow? For example, Huxley is a good dog who has made contributions to the world.狗也有大小，有好坏的。
Dogs come in sizes, good and bad.但要明白，首先就要辨别。“幽默处俏皮与正经之间”（语堂语）。不知俏皮与正经之辨，怎么会知道这“之间”？我们虽挂孔子的门徒招牌，却是庄生的私淑弟子。“彼亦一是非，此亦一是非”，是与非不想辨；“不知周之梦为蝴蝶欤，蝴蝶之梦为周欤？”梦与觉也分不清。生活要混沌。如果凿起七窍来呢？庄子曰：“七日而混沌死。”
But to understand, you must first discern. "Humor is between playfulness and seriousness" (Yutang language). I don't know the difference between playfulness and seriousness, how can I know this "between"? Although we hang the sign of Confucius's disciples, we are Zhuang Sheng's private disciples. "He is also right and wrong, and this is also right and wrong", right and wrong do not want to distinguish between right and wrong; "I don't know if Zhou's dream is a butterfly or if a butterfly's dream is Zhou?" Dreams and wakefulness are also indistinguishable. Life should be chaotic. What if you chisel the seven orifices? Zhuangzi said: "Seven days and chaos died. ”这如何容得感叹号？
How can this accommodate an exclamation mark?而且也容不得笑。私塾的先生，一向就不许孩子愤怒，悲哀，也不许高兴。皇帝不肯笑，奴隶是不准笑的。他们会笑，就怕他们也会哭，会怒，会闹起来。更何况坐着有版税可抽，而一年之中，竟“只闻其骚音怨音以及刻薄刁毒之音”呢？
And laughter is not allowed. The teacher of the private school has always not allowed children to be angry, sad, or happy. The emperor refused to laugh, and slaves were not allowed to laugh. They will laugh, and they will cry, get angry, and make trouble. What's more, there are royalties to sit on, but in a year, "only hear its complaining voices and harsh and vicious sounds"?这可见“幽默”在中国是不会有的。
This shows that "humor" will not exist in China.这也可见我对于《论语》的悲观，正非神经过敏。有版税的尚且如此，还能希望那些炸弹满空，河水漫野之处的人们来说“幽默”么？恐怕连“骚音怨音”也不会有，“盛世元音”自然更其谈不到。将来圆桌会议上也许有人列席，然而是客人，主宾之间，用不着“幽默”。甘地一回一回的不肯吃饭，而主人所办的报章上，已有说应该给他鞭子的了。
This also shows that my pessimism about the Analects is not a nervousness. If there are royalties, can you still hope that those people who are full of bombs and rivers are full of "humor"? I'm afraid there won't even be "sorrowful sounds", and "prosperous vowels" are naturally even more incomprehensible. In the future, there may be people present at the round table, but there is no need for "humor" between guests and guest of honor. Gandhi refused to eat again and again, and the newspaper run by the master had already said that he should be whipped.这可见在印度也没有“幽默”。
This shows that there is no "humor" in India either.最猛烈的鞭挞了那主人们的是萧伯纳，而我们中国的有些绅士淑女们可又憎恶他了，这真是伯纳“以无意得之，大奇！”然而也正是办起《孝经》来的好文字：“此士大夫之孝也。”
It was Bernard Shaw who whipped the masters the most violently, and some of our gentlemen and ladies in China hated him again, which was really Bernard's "unintentional, amazing!" However, it is also a good text that comes from the "Classic of Filial Piety": "This is the filial piety of the scholar-officials." ”《中庸》《大学》都已新出，《孝经》是一定就要出来的；不过另外还要有《左传》。在这样的年头，《论语》那里会办得好；二十五本，已经要算是“不亦乐乎”的了。
"The Doctrine of the Mean" and "University" have been newly released, and the "Classic of Filial Piety" is definitely coming out; But there is also "Zuo Zhuan". In such a year, the Analects will do well there; Twenty-five books are already considered "very happy".八月二十三日。

小品文的危机

小品文的危机

小品文的危机

The crisis of sketches仿佛记得一两月之前，曾在一种日报上见到记载着一个人的死去的文章，说他是收集“小摆设”的名人，临末还有依稀的感喟，以为此人一死，“小摆设”的收集者在中国怕要绝迹了。
I seem to remember that a month or two ago, I saw an article in a daily newspaper recording the death of a person, saying that he was a celebrity who collected "knick-knacks", and at the end of his life, he still had a vague feeling that once this person died, the collector of "knick-knacks" was afraid that he would disappear in China.但可惜我那时不很留心，竟忘记了那日报和那收集家的名字。
But unfortunately, I didn't pay much attention at that time, and I forgot the name of the daily newspaper and the collector.现在的新的青年恐怕也大抵不知道什么是“小摆设”了。但如果他出身旧家，先前曾有玩弄翰墨的人，则只要不很破落，未将觉得没用的东西卖给旧货担，就也许还能在尘封的废物之中，寻出一个小小的镜屏，玲珑剔透的石块，竹根刻成的人像，古玉雕出的动物，锈得发绿的铜铸的三脚癞虾蟆：这就是所谓“小摆设”。先前，它们陈列在书房里的时候，是各有其雅号的，譬如那三脚癞虾蟆，应该称为“蟾蜍砚滴”之类，最末的收集家一定都知道，现在呢，可要和它的光荣一同消失了。
Today's new young people probably don't know what "knick-knacks" are. But if he was born in an old family and had played with Hanmo before, as long as he was not very broken and did not sell what he thought was useless to the old cargo, he might still be able to find a small mirror screen, exquisite and transparent stones, human figures carved from bamboo roots, animals carved from ancient jade, and rusty green copper cast three-legged toads: this is the so-called "knick-knacks". Previously, when they were displayed in the study, they had their own elegant names, such as the three-legged toad, which should be called "toad inkstone drops", and the last collectors must know that now, it will disappear with its glory.那些物品，自然决不是穷人的东西，但也不是达官富翁家的陈设，他们所要的，是珠玉扎成的盆景，五彩绘画的磁瓶。那只是所谓士大夫的“清玩”。在外，至少必须有几十亩膏腴的田地，在家，必须有几间幽雅的书斋；就是流寓上海，也一定得生活较为安闲，在客栈里有一间长包的房子，书桌一顶，烟榻一张，瘾足心闲，摩挲赏鉴。然而这境地，现在却已经被世界的险恶的潮流冲得七颠八倒，像狂涛中的小船似的了。
Those items are by no means the things of the poor, but they are not the furnishings of the families of dignitaries and wealthy people, what they want is bonsai made of pearls and jade, and magnetic bottles with colorful paintings. That's just the so-called "play" of the scholar-officials. Outside, there must be at least dozens of acres of fertile fields, and at home, there must be a few elegant study; Even if you live in Shanghai, you must live a more leisurely life, and there is a long bag house in the inn, a desk, a smoking couch, addicted to leisure, and rubbing and appreciating. However, this situation has now been swept upside down by the sinister tide of the world, like a boat in a raging wave.然而就是在所谓“太平盛世”罢，这“小摆设”原也不是什么重要的物品。在方寸的象牙版上刻一篇《兰亭序》，至今还有“艺术品”之称，但倘将这挂在万里长城的墙头，或供在云冈的丈八佛像的足下，它就渺小得看不见了，即使热心者竭力指点，也不过令观者生一种滑稽之感。何况在风沙扑面，狼虎成群的时候，谁还有这许多闲工夫，来赏玩琥珀扇坠，翡翠戒指呢。他们即使要悦目，所要的也是耸立于风沙中的大建筑，要坚固而伟大，不必怎样精；即使要满意，所要的也是匕首和投枪，要锋利而切实，用不着什么雅。
However, even in the so-called "peaceful and prosperous era", this "knick-knack" is not an important item. Engraved on the square inch ivory plate of the "Orchid Pavilion Preface", it is still known as a "work of art", but if this is hung on the wall of the Great Wall, or at the foot of the Zhangba Buddha statue in Yungang, it is too small to be seen, even if the enthusiastic try to point it out, it will only make the viewer have a sense of funny. What's more, when the wind and sand are blowing and the wolves and tigers are packed, who still has so much leisure time to enjoy the amber fan pendant and the jade ring. Even if they want to be pleasing to the eye, what they want is a large building towering in the wind and sand, to be strong and great, and it does not need to be elaborate; Even if you want to be satisfied, all you need is a dagger and a throwing gun, which must be sharp and practical, and you don't need anything elegant.美术上的“小摆设”的要求，这幻梦是已经破掉了，那日报上的文章的作者，就直觉的地知道。然而对于文学上的“小摆设”——“小品文”的要求，却正在越加旺盛起来，要求者以为可以靠着低诉或微吟，将粗犷的人心，磨得渐渐的平滑。这就是想别人一心看着《六朝文絜》，而忘记了自己是抱在黄河决口之后，淹得仅仅露出水面的树梢头。
The requirement of "knick-knacks" in art, this dream has been shattered, and the author of the article in the daily newspaper intuitively knows it. However, the requirements for literary "knick-knacks" - "sketch essays" are becoming more and more vigorous, and the demanders think that they can rely on whispers or whispering to gradually smooth out the rough people's hearts. This is to think that others are looking at "Six Dynasties Wen Ji" and forget that they are holding the treetops that are only exposed to the water after the breach of the Yellow River.但这时却只用得着挣扎和战斗。
But at this time, all you have to do is struggle and fight.而小品文的生存，也只仗着挣扎和战斗的。晋朝的清言，早和它的朝代一同消歇了。唐末诗风衰落，而小品放了光辉。但罗隐的《谗书》，几乎全部是抗争和愤激之谈；皮日休和陆龟蒙自以为隐士，别人也称之为隐士，而看他们在《皮子文薮》和《笠泽丛书》中的小品文，并没有忘记天下，正是一榻胡涂的泥塘里的光彩和锋铓。明末的小品虽然比较的颓放，却并非全是吟风弄月，其中有不平，有讽刺，有攻击，有破坏。这种作风，也触着了满洲君臣的心病，费去许多助虐的武将的刀锋，帮闲的文臣的笔锋，直到乾隆年间，这才压制下去了。以后呢，就来了“小摆设”。
And the survival of the essay only depends on struggle and fighting. The Qingyan of the Jin Dynasty has long since disappeared with its dynasties. At the end of the Tang Dynasty, the poetry style declined, but the sketches shone brightly. But Luo Yin's "Book of Slander" is almost all about resistance and indignation; Pi Rixiu and Lu Guimeng thought they were hermits, and others also called them hermits, but looking at their sketches in "Pizi Wenxiu" and "Lizawa Series", they did not forget the world, which was the brilliance and sharpness in a mud pond. Although the sketches at the end of the Ming Dynasty are relatively decadent, they are not all chanting the wind and the moon, which contain injustice, satire, attack, and destruction. This style also touched the heart disease of the Manchurian monarchs and ministers, and it took the blades of many military generals who helped the abuse and the pen of the civil officials who helped them, and it was not until the Qianlong period that it was suppressed. In the future, there will be "knick-knacks".“小摆设”当然不会有大发展。到五四运动的时候，才又来了一个展开，散文小品的成功，几乎在小说戏曲和诗歌之上。这之中，自然含着挣扎和战斗，但因为常常取法于英国的随笔（Essay），所以也带一点幽默和雍容；写法也有漂亮和缜密的，这是为了对于旧文学的示威，在表示旧文学之自以为特长者，白话文学也并非做不到。以后的路，本来明明是更分明的挣扎和战斗，因为这原是萌芽于“文学革命”以至“思想革命”的。但现在的趋势，却在特别提倡那和旧文章相合之点，雍容，漂亮，缜密，就是要它成为“小摆设”，供雅人的摩挲，并且想青年摩挲了这“小摆设”，由粗暴而变为风雅了。
Of course, there will be no big development of "knick-knacks". It was not until the May Fourth Movement that another unfolded, and the success of prose sketches was almost above novels, operas and poems. In this, there are naturally struggles and battles, but because they are often inspired by British essays, they also have a little humor and grace; The writing method is also beautiful and meticulous, which is to demonstrate the old literature, and to show that the old literature is self-proclaimed, and vernacular literature is not impossible. The road ahead was obviously a more distinct struggle and battle, because it originally sprouted from the "literary revolution" to the "ideological revolution". But the current trend is to especially advocate the point that is consistent with the old article, graceful, beautiful, and meticulous, that is, to make it a "knick-knack" for elegant people to rub, and want young people to rub this "knick-knack", from rude to elegant.然而现在已经更没有书桌；雅片虽然已经公卖，烟具是禁止的，吸起来还是十分不容易。想在战地或灾区里的人们来鉴赏罢——谁都知道是更奇怪的幻梦。这种小品，上海虽正在盛行，茶话酒谈，遍满小报的摊子上，但其实是正如烟花女子，已经不能在弄堂里拉扯她的生意，只好涂脂抹粉，在夜里躄到马路上来了。
However, there are no desks now; Although Yapian has been sold to the public, smoking utensils are prohibited, and it is still not easy to smoke. I want people in the battlefield or disaster area to appreciate it - everyone knows that it is a stranger dream. Although this kind of sketch is prevalent in Shanghai, tea and wine talks, all over the stalls of tabloids, but in fact, it is like a fireworks woman, who can no longer pull her business in the alley, so she has to smear grease and powder and stumble onto the road at night.小品文就这样的走到了危机。但我所谓危机，也如医学上的所谓“极期”（Krisis）一般，是生死的分歧，能一直得到死亡，也能由此至于恢复。麻醉性的作品，是将与麻醉者和被麻醉者同归于尽的。生存的小品文，必须是匕首，是投枪，能和读者一同杀出一条生存的血路的东西；但自然，它也能给人愉快和休息，然而这并不是“小摆设”，更不是抚慰和麻痹，它给人的愉快和休息是休养，是劳作和战斗之前的准备。
Sketch has come to a crisis like this. But my so-called crisis, like the so-called "extreme period" (Krisis) in medicine, is the difference between life and death, and you can always get death and recover. Narcotic works are the same as the anesthesiologist and the anesthetized. Survival essays must be daggers, guns, and things that can fight a bloody path of survival with readers; But naturally, it can also give people pleasure and rest, but this is not a "knick-knack", let alone soothing and paralyzing, it gives people pleasure and rest is recuperation, preparation before labor and battle.八月二十七日。
