Today, the 918 China Boundary Security Bureau reported on the prevention of reaction今日为“九一八”，日本侵占东北国难二周纪念，市公安局长文鸿恩，昨据密报，有反动分子，拟借国难纪念为由秘密召集无知工人，乘机开会，企图煽惑捣乱秩序等语，文局长核报后，即训令各区所队，仍照去年“九一八”实施特别戒备办法，除通告该局各科处于今晨十时许，在局长办公厅前召集全体职员，及警察总队第三中队警士，举行“九一八”国难纪念，同时并行纪念周外，并饬督察长李光曾派全体督察员，男女检查员，分赴中华路，民国路，方浜路，南阳桥，唐家湾，斜桥等处，会同各区所警士，在各要隘街衢，及华租界接壤之处，自上午八时至十一时半，中午十一时半至三时，下午三时至六时半，分三班轮流检查行人。南市大吉路公共体育场，沪西曹家渡三角场，闸北谭子湾等处，均派大批巡逻警士，禁止集会游行。制造局路之西，徐家汇区域内主要街道，尤宜特别注意，如遇发生事故，不能制止者，即向丽园路报告市保安处第二团长处置，凡工厂林立处所，加派双岗驻守，红色车巡队，沿城环行驶巡，形势非常壮严。该局侦缉队长卢英，饬侦缉领班陈光炎，陈才福，唐炳祥，夏品山，各率侦缉员，分头密赴曹家渡，白利南路，胶州路及南市公共体育场等处，严密暗探反动分子行动，以资防范，而遏乱萌。公共租界暨法租界两警务处，亦派中西探员出发搜查，以防反动云。
Today is the "918", the second anniversary of the Japanese invasion of the northeast national disaster, the director of the Municipal Public Security Bureau Wen Hongen, yesterday according to secret reports, there are reactionaries, intend to use the commemoration of the national disaster as an excuse to secretly convene ignorant workers, take the opportunity to hold a meeting, in an attempt to incite and disrupt the order, etc., after the director of the Wen bureau verified the report, he immediately instructed the teams of all districts to still implement special vigilance measures in accordance with last year's "918", in addition to notifying the various sections of the bureau at about 10 o'clock this morning, in front of the general office of the director, to summon all the staff, and the sergeants of the third squadron of the police corps to hold the "918" national disaster commemoration. At the same time, in addition to the commemorative week, Inspector General Li Guangzeng sent all inspectors, male and female inspectors, to Zhonghua Road, Republic of China Road, Fangbang Road, Nanyang Bridge, Tangjiawan, Xieqiao and other places, together with the police sergeants of various districts, in each important street and the border of the Chinese Concession, from 8 a.m. to 11:30 a.m., from 11:30 p.m. to 3 p.m., and from 3 p.m. to 6:30 p.m., they took turns inspecting pedestrians in three shifts. A large number of patrol police officers were dispatched to prohibit assemblies and parades at the public stadium on Daji Road in Nanshi, Caojiadu Triangle Field in western Shanghai, and Tanziwan in Zhabei. In the west of the Manufacturing Bureau Road, the main street in the Xujiahui area, special attention should be paid to, in case of an accident, those who cannot be stopped, that is, report to Liyuan Road to the second regiment of the Municipal Security Department for disposal. Lu Ying, the detective captain of the bureau, and the detective foreman Chen Guangyan, Chen Caifu, Tang Bingxiang, and Xia Pinshan, each led the detectives to secretly go to Caojiadu, Baili South Road, Jiaozhou Road and Nanshi Public Stadium to closely spy on the actions of reactionaries to prevent and curb the emergence of chaos. The two police departments of the Public Concession and the French Concession also sent Chinese and Western agents to search to prevent reactionary clouds.“红色车”是囚车，中国人可坐，然而从中国人看来，却觉得“形势非常壮严”云。记得前两天（十六日）出版的《生活》所载的《两年的教训》里，有一段说——
The "red car" is a prison car, and Chinese people can sit on it, but from the Chinese point of view, they feel that "the situation is very serious". I remember that in the "Two Years of Lessons" contained in "Life" published two days ago (16th), there is a passage that says——“第二，我们明白谁是友谁是仇了。希特勒在德国民族社会党大会中说：‘德国的仇敌，不在国外，而在国内。’北平整委会主席黄郛说：‘和共抗日之说，实为谬论；剿共和外方为救时救党上策。’我们却要说‘民族的仇敌，不仅是帝国主义，而是出卖民族利益的帝国主义走狗们。’民族反帝的真正障碍在那里，还有比这过去两年的事实指示得更明白吗？
"Second, we understand who is a friend and who is an enemy. Hitler said at the congress of the German National Socialist Party: 'Germany's enemies are not abroad, but at home. Huang Cheng, chairman of the Peking Rectification Committee, said: 'The theory of peace and anti-Japanese resistance is really a fallacy; Suppressing Republican foreign parties is the best strategy to save the time and save the party. But we have to say: 'The enemy of the nation is not only imperialism, but also imperialist lackeys who betray national interests. 'Is there a real obstacle to national anti-imperialism more clearly than the facts of the past two years?现在再来一个切实的注脚：分明的铁证还有上海华界的“红色车”！是一天里的大教训！
Now there is another practical footnote: there is clear ironclad evidence and the "red car" of Shanghai Huajie! It was a great lesson in the day!年年的这样的情状，都被时光所埋没了，今夜作此，算是纪念文，倘中国人而终不至被害尽杀绝，则以贻我们的后来者。
This situation every year has been buried by time, and tonight is a commemorative article, if the Chinese are not killed in the end, it will be given to our latecomers.是夜，记。

Accidentally九月二十日的《申报》上，有一则嘉善地方的新闻，摘录起来，就是——
In the "Declaration" on September 20, there was a piece of news from Jiashan Place, which was excerpted, that is——“本县大窑乡沈和声与子林生，被著匪石塘小弟绑架而去，勒索三万元。沈姓家以中人之产，迁延未决。讵料该帮股匪乃将沈和声父子及苏境方面绑来肉票，在丁棚北，北荡滩地方，大施酷刑。法以布条遍贴背上，另用生漆涂敷，俟其稍干，将布之一端，连皮揭起，则痛彻心肺，哀号呼救，惨不忍闻。时为该处居民目睹，恻然心伤，尽将惨状报告沈姓，速即往赎，否则恐无生还。帮匪手段之酷，洵属骇闻。”
Shen Hesheng and Zi Linsheng in Dayao Township, this county, were kidnapped by the bandit Shitang brother and extorted 30,000 yuan. The Shen family delayed the decision because it was a middle-class property. Unexpectedly, the gang bandits tied up Shen Hesheng's father and son and the Soviet side with meat tickets, and tortured them in the north of Dingpeng and Beidangtan. The method is to apply strips of cloth to the back, and then apply raw lacquer. When it dries slightly, lift one end of the cloth and lift it with the skin, causing pain to the heart, and the pain is unbearable. At that time, the residents of the place witnessed it, and they were sad, and they reported the tragedy to the Shen surname, and quickly ran for it, otherwise they might not survive. The cruelty of the gang's methods is shocking. ”“酷刑”的记载，在各地方的报纸上是时时可以看到的，但我们只在看见时觉得“酷”，不久就忘记了，而实在也真是记不胜记。然而酷刑的方法，却决不是突然就会发明，一定都有它的师承或祖传，例如这石塘小弟所采用的，便是一个古法，见于士大夫未必肯看，而下等人却大抵知道的《说岳全传》一名《精忠传》上，是秦桧要岳飞自认“汉奸”，逼供之际所用的方法，但使用的材料，却是麻条和鱼鳔。我以为生漆之说，是未必的确的，因为这东西很不容易干燥。
The record of "torture" can be seen in newspapers everywhere from time to time, but we only think it is "cool" when we see it, and we soon forget it, and we really can't remember it. For example, the method used by this little brother of Shitang is an ancient method, which may not be seen by scholars and officials, but the lower class people probably know that the "Biography of Yue Quan" is a method used by Qin Hui to ask Yue Fei to admit himself as a "traitor" and force a confession, but the materials used are hemp strips and fish bladders. I think the statement of raw lacquer may not be true, because this thing is not easy to dry.“酷刑”的发明和改良者，倒是虎吏和暴君，这是他们唯一的事业，而且也有工夫来考究。这是所以威民，也所以除奸的，然而《老子》说得好，“为之斗斛以量之，则并与斗斛而窃之，……”有被刑的资格的也就来玩一个“剪窃”。张献忠的剥人皮，不是一种骇闻么？但他之前已有一位剥了“逆臣”景清的皮的永乐皇帝在。
The inventors and reformers of "torture" were tiger officials and tyrants, which were their only career, and they also had the time to study them. This is why the people are weimin, and it is also the reason for the elimination of treachery, but "Lao Tzu" said it well, "If you measure it for it, you will steal it with a bucket of hu,......" Those who are qualified to be punished will also play a "cutting and stealing". Isn't Zhang Xianzhong's skinning a kind of horror? But before him, there was already a Yongle Emperor who had skinned the "traitor" Jingqing.奴隶们受惯了“酷刑”的教育，他只知道对人应该用酷刑。
The slaves were accustomed to being educated in "torture", and he only knew that torture should be used against people.但是，对于酷刑的效果的意见，主人和奴隶们是不一样的。主人及其帮闲们，多是智识者，他能推测，知道酷刑施之于敌对，能够给与怎样的痛苦，所以他会精心结撰，进步起来。奴才们却一定是愚人，他不能“推己及人”，更不能推想一下，就“感同身受”。只要他有权，会采用成法自然也难说，然而他的主意，是没有智识者所测度的那么惨厉的。绥拉菲摩维支在《铁流》里，写农民杀掉了一个贵人的小女儿，那母亲哭得很凄惨，他却诧异道，哭什么呢，我们死掉多少小孩子，一点也没哭过。他不是残酷，他一向不知道人命会这么宝贵，他觉得奇怪了。
However, opinions about the effects of torture were different between masters and slaves. The master and his helpers, most of whom are intellectuals, can speculate and know what kind of pain torture can inflict on hostilities, so he will carefully compose and improve. The servants must be fools, they cannot "push themselves and others", let alone "empathize" if they think about it. As long as he has the power, it is naturally difficult to say that he will adopt the law, but his idea is not as tragic as that measured by intellectuals. In "Tie Liu", Suerafi Movizhi wrote that the peasant killed the little daughter of a nobleman, and the mother cried miserably, but he was surprised, what are we crying, how many children have died, and we have never cried at all. He was not cruel, he had never known that human life would be so precious, he thought it was strange.奴隶们受惯了猪狗的待遇，他只知道人们无异于猪狗。
The slaves were used to being treated like pigs and dogs, and he only knew that people were tantamount to pigs and dogs.用奴隶或半奴隶的幸福者，向来只怕“奴隶造反”，真是无怪的。
It is not surprising that happy people who use slaves or semi-slaves have always been afraid of "slave rebellion".要防“奴隶造反”，就更加用“酷刑”，而“酷刑”却因此更到了末路。在现代，枪毙是早已不足为奇了，枭首陈尸，也只能博得民众暂时的鉴赏，而抢劫，绑架，作乱的还是不减少，并且连绑匪也对于别人用起酷刑来了。酷的教育，使人们见酷而不再觉其酷，例如无端杀死几个民众，先前是大家就会嚷起来的，现在却只如见了日常茶饭事。人民真被治得好像厚皮的，没有感觉的癞象一样了，但正因为成了癞皮，所以又会踏着残酷前进，这也是虎吏和暴君所不及料，而即使料及，也还是毫无办法的。
To prevent "slave rebellion", "torture" is used even more, and "torture" has come to an end. In modern times, it is not surprising that shooting is no exception, and beheading and displaying corpses can only win the people's temporary appreciation, while robbery, kidnapping, and rebellion are still not reduced, and even kidnappers use torture against others. Cool education makes people see cool and no longer feel cool, such as killing a few people for no reason, which everyone would shout about before, but now it is just like seeing daily tea and rice. The people are really treated like thick-skinned leprosy without feeling, but it is precisely because they have become leprosy that they will move forward with cruelty, which is also unexpected by tiger officials and tyrants, and even if they are expected, there is still no way.九月二十日。

漫与

漫与

漫与

Casual and地质学上的古生代的秋天，我们不大明白了，至于现在，却总是相差无几。假使前年是肃杀的秋天，今年就成了凄凉的秋天，那么，地球的年龄，怕比天文学家所豫测的最短的数目还要短得多多罢。但人事却转变得真快，在这转变中的人，尤其是诗人，就感到了不同的秋，将这感觉，用悲壮的，或凄惋的句子，传给一切平常人，使彼此可以应付过去，而天地间也常有新诗存在。
We don't understand the geological autumn of the Paleozoic era, but now, it is always the same. If the year before last was a slashing autumn, this year will be a bleak autumn, then the age of the earth is probably much shorter than the shortest number predicted by astronomers. But people change so quickly, and people in this change, especially poets, feel different autumns, and pass on this feeling to all ordinary people with tragic or sad sentences, so that they can cope with the past, and there are often new poems between heaven and earth.前年实在好像是一个悲壮的秋天，市民捐钱，青年拚命，笳鼓的声音也从诗人的笔下涌出，仿佛真要“投笔从戎”似的。然而诗人的感觉是锐敏的，他未始不知道国民的赤手空拳，所以只好赞美大家的殉难，因此在悲壮里面，便埋伏着一点空虚。我所记得的，是邵冠华先生的《醒起来罢同胞》（《民国日报》所载）里的一段——
The year before last really seemed to be a tragic autumn, citizens donated money, young people worked hard, and the sound of jia and drums also poured out from the poet's pen, as if they really wanted to "throw their pen into the army". However, the poet's feelings are sharp, and he did not know the bare hands of the people, so he had to praise everyone's martyrdom, so in the tragedy, there was a little emptiness. What I remember is a passage from Mr. Shao Guanhua's "Wake Up and Stop Compatriots" (published in the Republic of China Daily) -“同胞，醒起来罢，"Wake up, compatriots, 
踢开了弱者的心， kicked open the hearts of the weak, 
踢开了弱者的脑， kicked the brains of the weak, 
看，看，看， looked, looked, 
看同胞们的血喷出来了， saw the blood of the compatriots spurted out, 
看同胞们的肉割开来了， saw the flesh of the compatriots cut open, 
看同胞们的尸体挂起来了。” saw the corpses of the compatriots hung."
鼓鼙之声要在前线，当进军的时候，是“作气”的，但尚且要“再而衰，三而竭”，倘在并无进军的准备的处所，那就完全是“散气”的灵丹了，倒使别人的紧张的心情，由此转成弛缓。所以我曾比之于“嚎丧”，是送死的妙诀，是丧礼的收场，从此使生人又可以在别一境界中，安心乐意的活下去。历来的文章中，化“敌”为“皇”，称“逆”为“我朝”，这样的悲壮的文章就是其间的“蝴蝶铰”，但自然，作手是不必同出于一人的。然而从诗人看来，据说这些话乃是一种“狂吠”。
The sound of drums and drums should be on the front line, and when marching, it is "angry", but it must still be "declining again and again, three and exhausted", if it is in a place where there is no preparation for marching, it is completely a panacea for "dissipating qi", but it will make other people's nervous mood turn into relaxation. Therefore, I have compared it to "howling", which is the secret to death and the end of the funeral, so that the living can live with peace of mind and happiness in another realm. In the past articles, the "enemy" is called "emperor" and the "reverse" is called "my dynasty", and such tragic articles are the "butterfly hinges" in between, but naturally, the author does not have to come from the same person. However, from the poet's point of view, it is said that these words are a kind of "barking".不过事实真也比评论更其不留情面，仅在这短短的两年中，昔之义军，已名“匪徒”，而有些“抗日英雄”，却早已侨寓姑苏了，而且连捐款也发生了问题。九一八的纪念日，则华界但有囚车随着武装巡捕梭巡，这囚车并非“意图”拘禁敌人或汉奸，而是专为“意图乘机捣乱”的“反动分子”所豫设的宝座。天气也真是阴惨，狂风骤雨，报上说是“飓风”，是天地在为中国饮泣，然而在天地之间——人间，这一日却“平安”的过去了。
However, the facts are really more merciless than the comments, in just two years, the former rebels have been called "bandits", and some "anti-Japanese heroes" have long lived in Gusu, and even donations have problems. On the anniversary of 918, there was a prison car in the Chinese world with an armed patrol shuttle, which was not "intended" to detain the enemy or traitors, but was specially set up for "reactionaries" who "intended to take advantage of the opportunity to cause trouble". The weather is really gloomy, the wind and rain are said to be "hurricanes", it is heaven and earth weeping for China, but between heaven and earth - in the world, this day has passed "safely".于是就成了虽然有些惨淡，却很“平安”的秋天，正是一个丧家届了除服之期的景象。但这景象，却又与诗人非常适合的，我在《醒起来罢同胞》的同一作家的《秋的黄昏》（九月二十五日《时事新报》所载）里，听到了幽咽而舒服的声调——
So it became a somewhat bleak, but very "safe" autumn, which was a scene of a bereaved family in the period of removal. But this scene is very suitable for the poet, I heard a sobbing and comfortable tone in the same writer's "Autumn Twilight" (published in the "Jiji Xinbao" on September 25) of the same writer of "Wake Up and Stop Compatriots" -“我到了秋天便会伤感；到了秋天的黄昏，便会流泪，我已很感觉到我的伤感是受着秋风的波动而兴奋地展开，同时自己又像会发现自己的环境是最适合于秋天，细细地抚摩着秋天在自然里发出的音波，我知道我的命运使我成为秋天的人。……”
"I will be sad in the fall; At dusk in autumn, I will shed tears, I already feel that my sadness is excited by the fluctuations of the autumn wind, and at the same time, I feel as if I will find that my environment is most suitable for autumn, carefully caressing the sound waves emitted by autumn in nature, I know that my fate makes me a person of autumn. ……”钉梢，现在中国所流行的，是无赖子对于摩登女郎，和侦探对于革命青年的钉梢，而对于文人学士们，却还很少见。假使追蹑几月或几年试试罢，就会看见许多怎样的情随事迁，到底头头是道的诗人。
Nail tips, which are popular in China now, are the nails of scoundrels for modern girls and detectives for revolutionary youth, but for literati and scholars, they are still rare. If you try to follow it for a few months or years, you will see many poets who change with the situation.一个活人，当然是总想活下去的，就是真正老牌的奴隶，也还在打熬着要活下去。然而自己明知道是奴隶，打熬着，并且不平着，挣扎着，一面“意图”挣脱以至实行挣脱的，即使暂时失败，还是套上了镣铐罢，他却不过是单单的奴隶。如果从奴隶生活中寻出“美”来，赞叹，抚摩，陶醉，那可简直是万劫不复的奴才了，他使自己和别人永远安住于这生活。就因为奴群中有这一点差别，所以使社会有平安和不安的差别，而在文学上，就分明的显现了麻醉的和战斗的的不同。
A living person, of course, always wants to live, even a really old slave is still struggling to survive. However, he knew that he was a slave, and he was beating, and he was uneven, struggling, and while "intending" to break free and even break free, even if he failed temporarily, he was still shackled, but he was just a slave. If he finds "beauty" from the life of a slave, admires, caresses, and intoxicates, he is simply a servant who will never return, and he makes himself and others live in this life forever. It is precisely because of this difference in the slave group that there is a difference between peace and unrest in society, and in literature, the difference between anesthesia and combat is clearly revealed.九月二十七日。
September 27th.

世故三昧

世故三昧

世故三昧

The world is samadhi人世间真是难处的地方，说一个人“不通世故”，固然不是好话，但说他“深于世故”也不是好话。“世故”似乎也像“革命之不可不革，而亦不可太革”一样，不可不通，而亦不可太通的。
It is not a good thing to say that a person is "not sophisticated", but it is not a good thing to say that he is "deeper than the world". "Sophistication" also seems to be like "revolution must be revolutionized, but it must not be too revolutionary", it must be understood, but it cannot be too comprehensible.然而据我的经验，得到“深于世故”的恶谥者，却还是因为“不通世故”的缘故。
However, according to my experience, those who get the evil title of "deeper than the world" are still because of "ignorance of the world".现在我假设以这样的话，来劝导青年人——
Now I assume that in this way, I will persuade young people -“如果你遇见社会上有不平事，万不可挺身而出，讲公道话，否则，事情倒会移到你头上来，甚至于会被指作反动分子的。如果你遇见有人被冤枉，被诬陷的，即使明知道他是好人，也万不可挺身而出，去给他解释或分辩，否则，你就会被人说是他的亲戚，或得了他的贿赂；倘使那是女人，就要被疑为她的情人的；如果他较有名，那便是党羽。例如我自己罢，给一个毫不相干的女士做了一篇信札集的序，人们就说她是我的小姨；绍介一点科学的文艺理论，人们就说得了苏联的卢布。亲戚和金钱，在目下的中国，关系也真是大，事实给与了教训，人们看惯了，以为人人都脱不了这关系，原也无足深怪的。
"If you encounter injustice in society, you must not stand up and speak fairly, otherwise, things will move to your head, and you will even be accused of being a reactionary. If you meet someone who has been wronged or falsely accused, even if you know that he is a good person, you must not come forward to explain or defend him, otherwise, you will be said to be his relative, or you will be bribed by him; If it is a woman, she will be suspected of being her lover; If he is more famous, he is a henchman. For example, I wrote a preface to a collection of letters to an unrelated lady, and people said she was my aunt; With a little scientific literary and artistic theory, people can say the Soviet ruble. Relatives and money, in China at present, the relationship is really big, the facts have taught a lesson, people are used to it, thinking that everyone can't get out of this relationship, and it is not surprising.“然而，有些人其实也并不真相信，只是说着玩玩，有趣有趣的。即使有人为了谣言，弄得凌迟碎剐，像明末的郑鄤那样了，和自己也并不相干，总不如有趣的紧要。这时你如果去辨正，那就是使大家扫兴，结果还是你自己倒楣。我也有一个经验，那是十多年前，我在教育部里做“官僚”，常听得同事说，某女学校的学生，是可以叫出来嫖的，连机关的地址门牌，也说得明明白白。有一回我偶然走过这条街，一个人对于坏事情，是记性好一点的，我记起来了，便留心着那门牌，但这一号，却是一块小空地，有一口大井，一间很破烂的小屋，是几个山东人住着卖水的地方，决计做不了别用。待到他们又在谈着这事的时候，我便说出我的所见来，而不料大家竟笑容尽敛，不欢而散了，此后不和我谈天者两三月。我事后才悟到打断了他们的兴致，是不应该的。
However, some people don't really believe it, they just talk and play, it's fun. Even if someone makes Ling Chi shredded for the sake of rumors, like Zheng Yu at the end of the Ming Dynasty, it has nothing to do with himself, and it is better to be interesting. At this time, if you try to correct it, you will disappoint everyone, and the result will be your own misfortune. I also have an experience, that was more than ten years ago, when I was a "bureaucrat" in the Ministry of Education, I often heard my colleagues say that students from a girls' school can be called out for prostitution, and even the address of the agency is clearly stated. Once I happened to walk through this street, a person has a better memory for bad things, I remembered, so I paid attention to the door number, but this number was a small open space, a big well, a very dilapidated hut, a place where several Shandong people lived and sold water, and I couldn't do it. When they were talking about this again, I told what I saw, but everyone smiled and broke up unhappily, and after that, they didn't talk to me for two or three months. I realized afterwards that it was not appropriate to interrupt their interest.“所以，你最好是莫问是非曲直，一味附和着大家；但更好是不开口；而在更好之上的是连脸上也不显出心里的是非的模样来……”
"Therefore, you'd better not ask about the merits and blindly agree with everyone; But it's better not to speak; And even better is that the face does not show the right and wrong in the heart......"这是处世法的精义，只要黄河不流到脚下，炸弹不落在身边，可以保管一世没有挫折的。但我恐怕青年人未必以我的话为然；便是中年，老年人，也许要以为我是在教坏了他们的子弟。呜呼，那么，一片苦心，竟是白费了。
This is the essence of the law of life, as long as the Yellow River does not flow to your feet and the bomb does not fall on your side, you can keep it for a lifetime without setbacks. But I fear that young people may not take my word for it; Even middle-aged, elderly people may think that I am teaching their children badly. Alas, then, a piece of hard work was in vain.然而倘说中国现在正如唐虞盛世，却又未免是“世故”之谈。耳闻目睹的不算，单是看看报章，也就可以知道社会上有多少不平，人们有多少冤抑。但对于这些事，除了有时或有同业，同乡，同族的人们来说几句呼吁的话之外，利害无关的人的义愤的声音，我们是很少听到的。这很分明，是大家不开口；或者以为和自己不相干；或者连“以为和自己不相干”的意思也全没有。“世故”深到不自觉其“深于世故”，这才真是“深于世故”的了。这是中国处世法的精义中的精义。
However, if China is now like the prosperous era of Tang and Yu, it is inevitable that it is a "sophisticated" talk. Just by looking at the newspapers, you can know how much injustice there is in society and how many grievances people have. But for these things, except for a few appeals from people of the same profession, fellow townsman, and clan, we rarely hear the voices of righteous indignation from people who have nothing to do with it. This is very clear, everyone does not speak; or think that it has nothing to do with themselves; Or even "think it has nothing to do with yourself" at all. "Sophisticated" is so deep that it is unconsciously "deeper than sophisticated", which is really "deeper than sophisticated". This is the essence of the essence of the Chinese law of life.而且，对于看了我的劝导青年人的话，心以为非的人物，我还有一下反攻在这里。他是以我为狡猾的。但是，我的话里，一面固然显示着我的狡猾，而且无能，但一面也显示着社会的黑暗。他单责个人，正是最稳妥的办法，倘使兼责社会，可就得站出去战斗了。责人的“深于世故”而避开了“世”不谈，这是更“深于世故”的玩艺，倘若自己不觉得，那就更深更深了，离三昧境盖不远矣。
Moreover, for the characters who read my words of persuasion to young people and feel wrong, I have a counterattack here. He thinks I'm cunning. However, my words certainly show my cunning and incompetence, but on the other hand, they also show the darkness of society. He is responsible for the individual, which is the safest way, if he is also responsible for the society, he has to stand up and fight. Blaming people for being "deeper than the world" and avoiding the "world" is a more "deeper than the world" play, if you don't feel it, then it is deeper and deeper, not far from the samadhi realm.不过凡事一说，即落言筌，不再能得三昧。说“世故三昧”者，即非“世故三昧”。三昧真谛，在行而不言；我现在一说“行而不言”，却又失了真谛，离三昧境盖益远矣。
不过凡事一说，即落言筌，不再能得三昧。 说“世故三昧”者，即非“世故三昧”。 三昧真谛，在行而不言；我现在一说“行而不言”，却又失了真谛，离三昧境盖益远矣。一切善知识，心知其意可也，唵！
一切善知识，心知其意可也，唵！十月十三日。

谣言世家

谣言世家

谣言世家

Rumor family双十佳节，有一位文学家大名汤增敭先生的，在《时事新报》上给我们讲光复时候的杭州的故事。他说那时杭州杀掉许多驻防的旗人，辨别的方法，是因为旗人叫“九”为“钩”的，所以要他说“九百九十九”，一露马脚，刀就砍下去了。
During the Double Ten Festival, a famous writer, Mr. Tang Zengyu, told us the story of Hangzhou during the restoration in the "Current Affairs News". He said that at that time, Hangzhou killed many flag men stationed there, and the way to distinguish it was because the flag man called "nine" as "hook", so he asked him to say "nine hundred and ninety-nine", and as soon as he showed his feet, the knife was cut down.这固然是颇武勇，也颇有趣的。但是，可惜是谣言。
This is certainly quite brave and quite interesting. However, unfortunately, it is a rumor.中国人里，杭州人是比较的文弱的人。当钱大王治世的时候，人民被刮得衣裤全无，只用一片瓦掩着下部，然而还要追捐，除被打得麂一般叫之外，并无贰话。不过这出于宋人的笔记，是谣言也说不定的。但宋明的末代皇帝，带着没落的阔人，和暮气一同滔滔的逃到杭州来，却是事实，苟延残喘，要大家有刚决的气魄，难不难。到现在，西子湖边还多是摇摇摆摆的雅人；连流氓也少有浙东似的“白刀子进红刀子出”的打架。自然，倘有军阀做着后盾，那是也会格外的撒泼的，不过当时实在并无敢于杀人的风气，也没有乐于杀人的人们。我们只要看举了老成持重的汤蛰仙先生做都督，就可以知道是不会流血的了。
Among Chinese, Hangzhou people are relatively weak people. When King Qian ruled the world, the people were scraped to the point of being completely naked, and only covered the lower part with a piece of tile, but they still had to chase donations, except for being beaten like a deer, and there was no second word. However, this is from the notes of the Song people, and it may be a rumor. But the last emperor of the Song and Ming dynasties, with the declining broad people, fled to Hangzhou with the twilight, but it is a fact. Up to now, there are still many swaying elegant people by Xizi Lake; Even hooligans rarely have fights like in eastern Zhejiang. Naturally, if there is a warlord as a backing, it will be particularly extravagant, but at that time there was really no atmosphere of daring to kill, and there were no people who were willing to kill. As long as we see the mature and prudent Mr. Tang Zhixian as the governor, we can know that there will be no bloodshed.不过战事是有的。革命军围住旗营，开枪打进去，里面也有时打出来。然而围得并不紧，我有一个熟人，白天在外面逛，晚上却自进旗营睡觉去了。
But there is war. The revolutionary army surrounded the flag camp and shot in, and sometimes it was shot inside. However, the circle was not tight, I had an acquaintance who was out during the day, but went to sleep in the flag camp at night.虽然如此，驻防军也终于被击溃，旗人降服了，房屋被充公是有的，却并没有杀戮。口粮当然取消，各人自寻生计，开初倒还好，后来就遭灾。
Despite this, the garrison was finally defeated, the bannermen surrendered, and the houses were confiscated, but they were not killed. Of course, the rations were canceled, and everyone was looking for their own livelihood.怎么会遭灾的呢？就是发生了谣言。
How could it be a disaster? It was a rumor.杭州的旗人一向优游于西子湖边，秀气所钟，是聪明的，他们知道没有了粮，只好做生意，于是卖糕的也有，卖小菜的也有。杭州人是客气的，并不歧视，生意也还不坏。然而祖传的谣言起来了，说是旗人所卖的东西，里面都藏着毒药。这一下子就使汉人避之惟恐不远，但倒是怕旗人来毒自己，并不是自己想去害旗人。结果是他们所卖的糕饼小菜，毫无生意，只得在路边出卖那些不能下毒的家具。家具一完，途穷路绝，就一败涂地了。这是杭州驻防旗人的收场。
The bannermen of Hangzhou have always roamed the shores of Xizi Lake, and they are smart, they know that there is no food, so they have to do business, so there are cakes and side dishes. Hangzhou people are polite, do not discriminate, and the business is not bad. However, ancestral rumors arose, saying that the things sold by the bannermen contained poison. This suddenly made the Han people avoid it, but they were afraid that the flag man would poison them, not that they wanted to harm the flag man. As a result, the pastries and small dishes they sold had no business, so they had to sell furniture that could not be poisoned on the side of the road. As soon as the furniture is finished, the road is cut off, and it is a complete failure. This is the end of the Hangzhou garrison flag man.笑里可以有刀，自称酷爱和平的人民，也会有杀人不见血的武器，那就是造谣言。但一面害人，一面也害己，弄得彼此懵懵懂懂。古时候无须提起了，即在近五十年来，甲午战败，就说是李鸿章害的，因为他儿子是日本的驸马，骂了他小半世；庚子拳变，又说洋鬼子是挖眼睛的，因为造药水，就乱杀了一大通。下毒学说起于辛亥光复之际的杭州，而复活于近来排日的时候。我还记得每有一回谣言，就总有谁被诬为下毒的奸细，给谁平白打死了。
There can be knives in the smile, and people who claim to love peace will also have weapons that kill without blood, that is, rumors. But on the one hand, they harm others and themselves, making each other confused. In ancient times, there was no need to mention it, that is, in the past fifty years, the defeat of the Sino-Japanese War was said to have been caused by Li Hongzhang, because his son was a Japanese son-in-law and scolded him for half his life; Gengzi fist changed, and it was said that the foreign devils were gouging out their eyes, because they made potions, so they killed a lot of people. The theory of poisoning originated in Hangzhou at the time of the restoration of Xinhai, and was resurrected in the recent era of Japan. I still remember that every time there was a rumor, someone was falsely accused of being a poisoned spy and beaten to death for nothing.谣言世家的子弟，是以谣言杀人，也以谣言被杀的。
The children of the rumor family killed people with rumors and were also killed by rumors.至于用数目来辨别汉满之法，我在杭州倒听说是出于湖北的荆州的，就是要他们数一二三四，数到“六”字，读作上声，便杀却。但杭州离荆州太远了，这还是一种谣言也难说。
As for the method of using numbers to identify Hanman, I heard in Hangzhou that it came from Jingzhou in Hubei, that is, they were asked to count one, two, three, four, count to the word "six", read it as the upper sound, and kill it. But Hangzhou is too far from Jingzhou, and it is difficult to say that this is still a rumor.我有时也不大能够分清那句是谣言，那句是真话了。
Sometimes I can't tell if that sentence is a rumor or that sentence is true.十月十三日。
October 13th.

关于妇女解放

关于妇女解放

关于妇女解放

On women's liberation孔子曰：“唯女子与小人为难养也，近之则不逊，远之则怨。”女子与小人归在一类里，但不知道是否也包括了他的母亲。后来的道学先生们，对于母亲，表面上总算是敬重的了，然而虽然如此，中国的为母的女性，还受着自己儿子以外的一切男性的轻蔑。
Confucius said: "Only women and petty people are difficult to raise; if they are close to them, they will be disrespectful, and if they are far away, they will resent." "The woman and the villain are in the same category, but I don't know if his mother is also included. Later Taoist gentlemen finally respected their mothers on the surface, but even so, Chinese mothers were still despised by all men except their own sons.辛亥革命后，为了参政权，有名的沈佩贞女士曾经一脚踢倒过议院门口的守卫。不过我很疑心那是他自己跌倒的，假使我们男人去踢罢，他一定会还踢你几脚。这是做女子便宜的地方。还有，现在有些太太们，可以和阔男人并肩而立，在码头或会场上照一个照相；或者当汽船飞机开始行动之前，到前面去敲碎一个酒瓶（这或者非小姐不可也说不定，我不知道那详细）了，也还是做女子的便宜的地方。此外，又新有了各样的职业，除女工，为的是她们工钱低，又听话，因此为厂主所乐用的不算外，别的就大抵只因为是女子，所以一面虽然被称为“花瓶”，一面也常有“一切招待，全用女子”的光荣的广告。男子倘要这么突然的飞黄腾达，单靠原来的男性是不行的，他至少非变狗不可。
After the Xinhai Revolution, in order to participate in political affairs, the famous Ms. Shen Peizhen once kicked down the guards at the gate of the parliament. But I suspect that he fell by himself, and if we men go to kick it, he will definitely kick you a few more times. This is where it is cheap to be a woman. Also, now some wives can stand side by side with the broad man and take a photo on the pier or venue; Or when the steamboat plane starts moving, go to the front to break a wine bottle (this may be a must for the young lady, I don't know the details), or it is still a cheap place for women. In addition, there are new professions, except for female workers, because they have low wages and are obedient, so they are not used by factory owners, and the others are probably only because they are women, so although they are called "vases" on the one hand, there are often glorious advertisements of "all hospitality, all women". If a man wants to rise to prominence so suddenly, he can't rely on the original man alone, he must at least become a dog.这是五四运动后，提倡了妇女解放以来的成绩。不过我们还常常听到职业妇女的痛苦的呻吟，评论家的对于新式女子的讥笑。她们从闺阁走出，到了社会上，其实是又成为给大家开玩笑，发议论的新资料了。
This is the achievement of women's liberation after the May Fourth Movement. However, we often hear the painful moans of professional women and the ridicule of critics for new women. When they came out of the boudoir and into society, they actually became new materials for everyone to joke and discuss.这是因为她们虽然到了社会上，还是靠着别人的“养”；要别人“养”，就得听人的唠叨，甚而至于侮辱。我们看看孔夫子的唠叨，就知道他是为了要“养”而“难”，“近之”“远之”都不十分妥帖的缘故。这也是现在的男子汉大丈夫的一般的叹息。也是女子的一般的苦痛。在没有消灭“养”和“被养”的界限以前，这叹息和苦痛是永远不会消灭的。
This is because although they have entered society, they still rely on the "support" of others; If you want others to "raise", you have to listen to people's nagging, and even insults. If we look at Confucius's nagging, we know that he is "difficult" for the sake of "raising", and "near" and "far" are not very appropriate. This is also the general sigh of today's manly men. It is also the general pain of women. This sigh and pain will never be eliminated until the boundary between "raising" and "being raised" is not eliminated.这并未改革的社会里，一切单独的新花样，都不过一块招牌，实际上和先前并无两样。拿一匹小鸟关在笼中，或给站在竿子上，地位好像改变了，其实还只是一样的在给别人做玩意，一饮一啄，都听命于别人。俗语说：“受人一饭，听人使唤”，就是这。所以一切女子，倘不得到和男子同等的经济权，我以为所有好名目，就都是空话。自然，在生理和心理上，男女是有差别的；即在同性中，彼此也都不免有些差别，然而地位却应该同等。必须地位同等之后，才会有真的女人和男人，才会消失了叹息和苦痛。
In this unreformed society, all the new unique tricks are just a signboard, and they are actually no different from before. Take a bird in a cage, or stand on a pole, the status seems to have changed, but in fact, it is still the same as making things for others, drinking and pecking, all obeying others' orders. As the saying goes: "Accept a meal from others, listen to others", this is it. Therefore, if all women do not get the same economic rights as men, I think all good names are empty words. Naturally, there is a difference between men and women physically and psychologically; Even in the same sex, there are inevitably some differences between each other, but the status should be the same. Only after equal status can there be real women and men, and sighs and pain will disappear.在真的解放之前，是战斗。但我并非说，女人应该和男人一样的拿枪，或者只给自己的孩子吸一只奶，而使男子去负担那一半。我只以为应该不自苟安于目前暂时的位置，而不断的为解放思想，经济等等而战斗。解放了社会，也就解放了自己。但自然，单为了现存的惟妇女所独有的桎梏而斗争，也还是必要的。
Before real liberation, there is battle. But I am not saying that women should hold guns like men, or suck only one milk for their children, and let men bear the half. I just thought that I should not settle for my current temporary position, but constantly fight for the emancipation of the mind, the economy, etc. Liberating society also liberates oneself. But naturally, it is necessary to fight only for the shackles that exist only for women.我没有研究过妇女问题，倘使必须我说几句，就只有这一点空话。
I have not studied women's issues, and if I had to say a few words, it would be just this empty word.十月二十一日。
October 21st.

火

火

火

fire普洛美修斯偷火给人类，总算是犯了天条，贬入地狱。但是，钻木取火的燧人氏却似乎没有犯窃盗罪，没有破坏神圣的私有财产——那时候，树木还是无主的公物。然而燧人氏也被忘却了，到如今只见中国人供火神菩萨，不见供燧人氏的。
Prometheus stole fire from mankind, and finally violated the law of heaven and was demoted to hell. However, the Suiren clan who drilled wood for fire did not seem to have committed theft or destroyed sacred private property - at that time, trees were still ownerless public property. However, the Suiren clan has also been forgotten, and now only the Chinese offer to the Fire God Bodhisattva, but not the Suiren clan.火神菩萨只管放火，不管点灯。凡是火着就有他的份。因此，大家把他供养起来，希望他少作恶。然而如果他不作恶，他还受得着供养么，你想？
The Vulcan Bodhisattva just sets fire, regardless of lighting the lights. Wherever there is fire, he has his share. Therefore, everyone made offerings to him, hoping that he would do less evil. However, if he does not do evil, can he still bear to be provided, do you think?点灯太平凡了。从古至今，没有听到过点灯出名的名人，虽然人类从燧人氏那里学会了点火已经有五六千年的时间。放火就不然。秦始皇放了一把火——烧了书没有烧人；项羽入关又放了一把火——烧的是阿房宫不是民房（？——待考）。……罗马的一个什么皇帝却放火烧百姓了；中世纪正教的僧侣就会把异教徒当柴火烧，间或还灌上油。这些都是一世之雄。现代的希特拉就是活证人。如何能不供养起来。何况现今是进化时代，火神菩萨也代代跨灶的。
The lighting is too ordinary. From ancient times to the present, there has been no famous celebrity who has been famous for lighting lamps, although humans have learned to light fires from the flint people for five or six thousand years. It's not like setting fire. Qin Shi Huang set a fire - burned books but did not burn people; Xiang Yu set fire again when he entered the customs - it was the Epang Palace that was burned, not a private house (?). ——To be examined). …… What emperor in Rome set fire to the people; Medieval Orthodox monks would burn pagans as firewood and occasionally pour oil on them. These are all heroes of a lifetime. Hitler in modern times is a living witness. How can you not provide for it? What's more, now is the age of evolution, and the Vulcan Bodhisattva has also crossed the stove from generation to generation.譬如说罢，没有电灯的地方，小百姓不顾什么国货年，人人都要买点洋货的煤油，晚上就点起来：那么幽黯的黄澄澄的光线映在纸窗上，多不大方！不准，不准这么点灯！你们如果要光明的话，非得禁止这样“浪费”煤油不可。煤油应当扛到田地里去，灌进喷筒，呼啦呼啦的喷起来……一场大火，几十里路的延烧过去，稻禾，树木，房舍——尤其是草棚——一会儿都变成飞灰了。还不够，就有燃烧弹，硫磺弹，从飞机上面扔下来，像上海一二八的大火似的，够烧几天几晚。那才是伟大的光明呵。
For example, in places where there are no electric lights, the common people don't care about the domestic year, everyone has to buy some foreign kerosene, and light it up at night: so the dim yellow light is reflected on the paper window, how generous! No, don't light up like this! If you want to be bright, you must prohibit such "waste" of kerosene. Kerosene should be carried to the field, poured into the nozzle, and sprayed up...... A fire spread for dozens of miles, and the rice, trees, and houses - especially the grass sheds - turned into fly ash for a while. If it wasn't enough, there were incendiary bombs and sulfur bombs, which were thrown down from the plane, like the fire of Shanghai 128, enough to burn for several days and nights. That's the great light.火神菩萨的威风是这样的。可是说起来，他又不承认：火神菩萨据说原是保佑小民的，至于火灾，却要怪小民自不小心，或是为非作歹，纵火抢掠。
The majesty of the Vulcan Bodhisattva is like this. But speaking of which, he did not admit it: the Vulcan Bodhisattva is said to have blessed the common people, but as for the fire, he has to blame the common people for being careless, or doing evil, and setting fire and looting.谁知道呢？历代放火的名人总是这样说，却未必总有人信。
Who knows? Celebrities who have set fires throughout the ages have always said this, but not always people believe it.我们只看见点灯是平凡的，放火是雄壮的，所以点灯就被禁止，放火就受供养。你不见海京伯马戏团么：宰了耕牛喂老虎，原是这年头的“时代精神”。
We only see that lighting is ordinary, and setting fire is majestic, so lighting is forbidden, and setting fire is offered. Don't you see the Haijingbo Circus: slaughtering cattle to feed tigers is originally the "spirit of the times" these days.十一月二日。
November 2nd.

论翻印木刻

论翻印木刻

论翻印木刻

On reprinting woodcuts麦绥莱勒的连环图画四种出版并不久，日报上已有了种种的批评，这是向来的美术书出版后未能遇到的盛况，可见读书界对于这书，是十分注意的。但议论的要点，和去年已不同：去年还是连环图画是否可算美术的问题，现在却已经到了看懂这些图画的难易了。
Not long after the publication of Mai Suilele's comic strips, there have been various criticisms in the daily newspaper, which is a grand occasion that has not been encountered after the publication of art books, which shows that the reading community is very careful about this book. But the main point of the discussion is different from last year: last year it was still a question of whether comic strips can be considered art, but now it has reached the point where it is difficult to understand these pictures.出版界的进行可没有评论界的快。其实，麦绥莱勒的木刻的翻印，是还在证明连环图画确可以成为艺术这一点的。现在的社会上，有种种读者层，出版物自然也就有种种，这四种是供给智识者层的图画。然而为什么有许多地方很难懂得呢？我以为是由于经历之不同。同是中国人，倘使曾经见过飞机救国或“下蛋”，则在图上看见这东西，即刻就懂，但若历来未尝躬逢这些盛典的人，恐怕只能看作风筝或蜻蜓罢了。
The publishing industry is not as fast as the critics. In fact, the reproduction of Mai Suilele's woodcut still proves that comic strips can indeed become art. In today's society, there are all kinds of readers, and there are naturally all kinds of publications, and these four are pictures for the intellectuals. However, why are there so many places that are difficult to understand? I think it's because of the different experiences. If you are also Chinese, if you have ever seen a plane to save the country or "lay eggs", you will see this thing on the picture and understand it immediately, but if you have never experienced these ceremonies, I am afraid you can only see it as a kite or a dragonfly.有一种自称“中国文艺年鉴社”，而实是匿名者们所编的《中国文艺年鉴》在它的所谓“鸟瞰”中，曾经说我所发表的《连环图画辩护》虽将连环图画的艺术价值告诉了苏汶先生，但“无意中却把要是德国板画那类艺术作品搬到中国来，是否能为一般大众所理解，即是否还成其为大众艺术的问题忽略了过去，而且这种解答是对大众化的正题没有直接意义的”。这真是倘不是能编《中国文艺年鉴》的选家，就不至于说出口来的聪明话，因为我本也“不”在讨论将“德国板画搬到中国来，是否为一般大众所理解”；所辩护的只是连环图画可以成为艺术，使青年艺术学徒不被曲说所迷，敢于创作，并且逐渐产生大众化的作品而已。假使我真如那编者所希望，“有意的”来说德国板画是否就是中国的大众艺术，这可至少也得归入“低能”一类里去了。
There is a kind of "Chinese Literature and Art Yearbook" that calls itself the "China Literature and Art Yearbook", but in fact it is compiled by anonymous people, in its so-called "bird's eye view", it was once said that although the "Defense of Comic Strips" I published told Mr. Su Wen about the artistic value of comic strips, "I inadvertently moved works of art such as German panel paintings to China, whether they could be understood by the general public, that is, whether they were still popular art, ignoring the past, and this answer had no direct meaning for the main topic of popularization." This is really a clever thing that if I were not a selector who could compile the "Chinese Literature and Art Yearbook", I would not have said it wisely, because I was not discussing whether "moving German panel paintings to China would be understood by the general public"; What is defended is that comic strips can become art, so that young art apprentices are not fascinated by distortions, dare to create, and gradually produce popular works. If I were to "intentionally" say whether German panel painting is Chinese popular art as the editor hoped, it would at least be classified as "imbecile".但是，假使一定要问：“要是德国板画那类艺术作品搬到中国来，是否能为一般大众所理解”呢？那么，我也可以回答：假使不是立方派，未来派等等的古怪作品，大概该能够理解一点。所理解的可以比看一本《中国文艺年鉴》多，也不至于比看一本《西湖十景》少。风俗习惯，彼此不同，有些当然是莫明其妙的，但这是人物，这是屋宇，这是树木，却能够懂得，到过上海的，也就懂得画里的电灯，电车，工厂。尤其合式的是所画的是故事，易于讲通，易于记得。古之雅人，曾谓妇人俗子，看画必问这是什么故事，大可笑。中国的雅俗之分就在此：雅人往往说不出他以为好的画的内容来，俗人却非问内容不可。从这一点看，连环图画是宜于俗人的，但我在《连环图画辩护》中，已经证明了它是艺术，伤害了雅人的高超了。
However, if we must ask, "If a work of art such as German panel painting moves to China, will it be understood by the general public"? Then, I can also answer: if it is not a cube, futurist, etc. eccentric work, it should probably be understood a little. You can understand more than reading a "Chinese Literature and Art Yearbook", and it will not be less than reading a "Ten Views of West Lake". Customs and habits are different from each other, some of which are of course incomprehensible, but these are characters, this is the house, this is the tree, but they can understand, and those who have been to Shanghai also know the lights, trams, and factories in the painting. What is especially appropriate is that what is drawn is a story, which is easy to tell and remember. The ancient elegant people once said that women and vulgar people would ask what kind of story this is when they looked at the painting, which was ridiculous. This is the difference between elegance and vulgarity in China: elegant people often can't tell the content of what they think is a good painting, but ordinary people have to ask about the content. From this point of view, comic strips are suitable for laypeople, but in "The Defense of Comic Strips", I have proven that it is art and hurts the superiority of elegant people.然而，虽然只对于智识者，我以为绍介了麦绥莱勒的作品也还是不够的。同是木刻，也有刻法之不同，有思想之不同，有加字的，有无字的，总得翻印好几种，才可以窥见现代外国连环图画的大概。而翻印木刻画，也较易近真，有益于观者。我常常想，最不幸的是在中国的青年艺术学徒了，学外国文学可看原书，学西洋画却总看不到原画。自然，翻板是有的，但是，将一大幅壁画缩成明信片那么大，怎能看出真相？大小是很有关系的，假使我们将象缩小如猪，老虎缩小如鼠，怎么还会令人觉得原先那种气魄呢。木刻却小品居多，所以翻刻起来，还不至于大相远。
However, although it is only for the intellectual, I think it is not enough to introduce Mai Suilele's works. The same woodcut also has different engraving methods, different ideas, some with additional words, some without words, and there are always several kinds of reprints to get a glimpse of the general idea of modern foreign comic strips. Reprinting woodcuts is also easier to approach, which is beneficial to the viewer. I often think that the most unfortunate thing is that young art apprentices in China can read original books when they learn foreign literature, but they can never see the original paintings when they learn Western paintings. Naturally, there is a flap, but how can you see the truth by shrinking a large mural to the size of a postcard? Size is very related, if we shrink like an elephant like a pig and a tiger as small as a mouse, how can we still feel the original courage? The woodcuts are mostly sketches, so they are not far from each other.但这还仅就绍介给一般智识者的读者层而言，倘为艺术学徒设想，锌板的翻印也还不够。太细的线，锌板上是容易消失的，即使是粗线，也能因强水浸蚀的久暂而不同，少浸太粗，久浸就太细，中国还很少制板适得其宜的名工。要认真，就只好来用玻璃板，我翻印的《士敏土之图》二百五十本，在中国便是首先的试验。施蛰存先生在《大晚报》附刊的《火炬》上说：“说不定他是像鲁迅先生印珂罗版本木刻图一样的是私人精印本，属于罕见书之列”，就是在讥笑这一件事。我还亲自听到过一位青年在这“罕见书”边说，写着只印二百五十部，是骗人的，一定印的很多，印多报少，不过想抬高那书价。
But this is only for the readership of the general intellectual, and if it is conceived for art apprentices, the reproduction of zinc plates is not enough. Too thin lines, zinc plates are easy to disappear, even thick wires, can be different due to the long time of strong water erosion, less immersion is too thick, long soaking is too fine, China still has few suitable famous craftsmen for making plates. If you want to be serious, you have to use a glass plate, and the 250 copies of "The Map of Shimin Soil" that I reprinted were the first experiments in China. Mr. Shi Zhicun said in the "Torch" supplement to the "Great Evening News": "Maybe he is a private fine print like Mr. Lu Xun's woodcut of the Keluo version, which belongs to the list of rare books", which is ridiculing this matter. I also personally heard a young man say on this "rare book" that it was written that only 250 copies were printed, which was a lie, and he must have printed a lot, printed more and reported less, but he wanted to raise the price of the book.他们自己没有做过“私人精印本”的可笑事，这些笑骂是都无足怪的。我只因为想供给艺术学徒以较可靠的木刻翻本，就用原画来制玻璃版，但制这版，是每制一回只能印三百幅的，多印即须另制，假如每制一幅则只印一张或多至三百张，制印费都是三元，印三百以上到六百张即需六元，九百张九元，外加纸张费。倘在大书局，大官厅，即使印一万二千本原也容易办，然而我不过一个“私人”；并非繁销书，而竟来“精印”，那当然不免为财力所限，只好单印一板了。但幸而还好，印本已经将完，可知还有人看见；至于为一般的读者，则早已用锌板复制，插在译本《士敏土》里面了，然而编辑兼批评家却不屑道。
They themselves have not done the ridiculous thing of "private hard print", and these ridicules and scoldings are not surprising. I only want to provide art apprentices with more reliable woodcut copies, so I use the original painting to make glass plates, but to make this plate, only 300 sheets can be printed at a time, and if you print more than 300 sheets, you have to make another one, if you make one or more than 300 sheets, the printing fee is 3 yuan, and if you print more than 300 to 600 sheets, you need 6 yuan, 900 sheets 9 yuan, plus paper costs. If you are in a big bookstore, a big official hall, even if you print 12,000 originals, it is easy to do, but I am just a "private person"; It is not a popular book, but it is "fine printed", of course, it is inevitable that it will be limited by financial resources, so it has to be printed on a single board. But fortunately, the print is almost finished, and it can be seen that there are still people who see it; As for the general reader, it has already been copied on a zinc plate and inserted into the translation of "Shimintu", but the editor and critic dismisses it.人不严肃起来，连指导青年也可以当作开玩笑，但仅印十来幅图，认真地想过几回的人却也有的，不过自己不多说。我这回写了出来，是在向青年艺术学徒说明珂罗板一板只印三百部，是制板上普通的事，并非故意要造“罕见书”，并且希望有更多好事的“私人”，不为不负责任的话所欺，大家都来制造“精印本”。
People are not serious, and even instructing young people can be taken as a joke, but there are people who have only printed a dozen pictures and seriously thought about it a few times, but they don't say much. I wrote it this time, explaining to the young art apprentices that only 300 copies of the Koro board are printed, which is a common thing in board making, and I do not deliberately want to make "rare books", and I hope that there will be more "private people" who do good things, and will not be deceived by irresponsible words, and everyone will make "hard prints".十一月六日。
November 6th.

《木刻创作法》序

《木刻创作法》序

《木刻创作法》序

Preface to "Woodcut Creation Method"地不问东西，凡木刻的图版，向来是画管画，刻管刻，印管印的。中国用得最早，而照例也久经衰退；清光绪中，英人傅兰雅氏编印《格致汇编》，插图就已非中国刻工所能刻，精细的必需由英国运了图版来。那就是所谓“木口木刻”，也即“复制木刻”，和用在编给印度人读的英文书，后来也就移给中国人读的英文书上的插画，是同类的。那时我还是一个儿童，见了这些图，便震惊于它的精工活泼，当作宝贝看。到近几年，才知道西洋还有一种由画家一手造成的版画，也就是原画，倘用木版，便叫作“创作木刻”，是艺术家直接的创作品，毫不假手于刻者和印者的。现在我们所要绍介的，便是这一种。
The earth does not care about things, and all woodcut plates have always been painted tube paintings, carved tube carvings, and printed tube prints. China used it the earliest, and as usual, it has been in decline for a long time; In the Guangxu period of the Qing Dynasty, the British Fu Lanya compiled and printed the "Gezhi Compilation", and the illustrations were no longer engraved by Chinese engravers, and the fine plates had to be transported from the UK. That is, the so-called "woodcuts", that is, "copying woodcuts", and the illustrations used in English books for Indians and later transferred to Chinese books, are of the same kind. At that time, I was still a child, and when I saw these pictures, I was shocked by their exquisiteness and liveliness, and I looked at them as treasures. It was not until recent years that I learned that there is also a kind of printmaking made by painters in the West, that is, the original painting, if woodblock is used, it is called "creative woodcut", which is the artist's direct creation, without pretending to be the engraver and the printer. Now what we want to introduce is this one.为什么要绍介呢？据我个人的私见，第一是因为好玩。说到玩，自然好像有些不正经，但我们钞书写字太久了，谁也不免要息息眼，平常是看一会窗外的天。假如有一幅挂在墙壁上的画，那岂不是更其好？倘有得到名画的力量的人物，自然是无须乎此的，否则，一张什么复制缩小的东西，实在远不如原版的木刻，既不失真，又省耗费。自然，也许有人要指为“要以‘今雅’立国”的，但比起“古雅”来，不是已有“古”“今”之别了么？
Why do you want to introduce it? In my personal opinion, the first is because it's fun. When it comes to playing, it naturally seems a bit unorthodox, but we have been writing for too long, and no one can help but breathe, usually looking at the sky outside the window for a while. Wouldn't it be better if there was a painting hanging on the wall? If there is a character who has the power of a famous painting, it is naturally unnecessary, otherwise, a copy and reduction of something is really far inferior to the original woodcut, which is neither distorted nor cost-effective. Naturally, some people may want to refer to it as "building a country with 'modern elegance'", but compared with "quaintness", isn't there a difference between "ancient" and "modern"?第二，是因为简便。现在的金价很贵了，一个青年艺术学徒想画一幅画，画布颜料，就得化一大批钱；画成了，倘使没法展览，就只好请自己看。木刻是无需多化钱的，只用几把刀在木头上划来划去——这也许未免说得太容易了——就如印人的刻印一样，可以成为创作，作者也由此得到创作的欢喜。印了出来，就能将同样的作品，分给别人，使许多人一样的受到创作的欢喜。总之，是比别种作法的作品，普遍性大得远了。
Second, it is because of simplicity. The price of gold is very expensive now, and a young art apprentice wants to paint a painting, canvas paint, he has to spend a lot of money; The painting is done, and if it cannot be exhibited, it can only be seen by yourself. Woodcuts do not require extra money, just use a few knives to scratch around the wood - this may be too easy to say - just like the engraving of the printer, it can become a creation, and the author gets the joy of creation. When printed, the same work can be distributed to others, so that many people can be happy with creation. In short, it is far more universal than other works.第三，是因为有用。这和“好玩”似乎有些冲突，但其实也不尽然的，要看所玩的是什么。打马将恐怕是终于没有出息的了；用火药做花炮玩，推广起来却就可以造枪炮。大炮，总算是实用不过的罢，而安特莱夫一有钱，却将它装在自己的庭园里当玩艺。木刻原是小富家儿艺术，然而一用在刊物的装饰，文学或科学书的插画上，也就成了大家的东西，是用不着多说的。
Third, it is because it is useful. This seems to be a bit in conflict with "fun", but in fact, it is not necessarily the case, it depends on what you are playing. I am afraid that the horse will finally have no future; Use gunpowder to make fireworks, but you can make guns when promoted. The cannon is finally practical, but when Antleif is rich, he puts it in his garden as a plaything. Woodcuts were originally the art of the little rich, but once they were used in the decoration of publications and the illustrations of literary or scientific books, they became everyone's thing, and there was no need to say more.这实在是正合于现代中国的一种艺术。
This is really an art that fits modern China.但是至今没有一本讲说木刻的书，这才是第一本。虽然稍简略，却已经给了读者一个大意。由此发展下去，路是广大得很。题材会丰富起来的，技艺也会精炼起来的，采取新法，加以中国旧日之所长，还有开出一条新的路径来的希望。那时作者各将自己的本领和心得，贡献出来，中国的木刻界就会发生光焰。这书虽然因此要成为不过一粒星星之火，但也够有历史上的意义了。
But there is no book about woodcuts so far, and this is the first one. Although it is a little brief, it has already given the reader a general idea. From this development, the road is very vast. The theme will be enriched, the skills will also be refined, and there is hope to open a new path by adopting new methods, adding China's old strengths. At that time, the authors contributed their own skills and experiences, and the Chinese woodcut industry would have a flame. Although this book is only a spark, it is also historically significant.一九三三年十一月九日，鲁迅记。
November 9, 1933, Lu Xun recorded.

作文秘诀

作文秘诀

Writing secrets现在竟还有人写信来问我作文的秘诀。
Now there are people writing to me asking me about the secret of composition.我们常常听到：拳师教徒弟是留一手的，怕他学全了就要打死自己，好让他称雄。在实际上，这样的事情也并非全没有，逢蒙杀羿就是一个前例。逢蒙远了，而这种古气是没有消尽的，还加上了后来的“状元瘾”，科举虽然久废，至今总还要争“唯一”，争“最先”。遇到有“状元瘾”的人们，做教师就危险，拳棒教完，往往免不了被打倒，而这位新拳师来教徒弟时，却以他的先生和自己为前车之鉴，就一定留一手，甚而至于三四手，于是拳术也就“一代不如一代”了。
We often hear: boxers teach their disciples to keep one hand, for fear that if he learns everything, he will beat himself to death so that he can dominate. In fact, such things are not all non-existent, and Feng Meng's killing of Yi is a precedent. Fengmeng is far away, and this ancient atmosphere has not been eliminated, and the later "champion addiction" has been added, although the imperial examination has been abandoned for a long time, it still has to fight for the "only" and "first". When encountering people with "champion addiction", it is dangerous to be a teacher, and after teaching the fist stick, it is often inevitable to be knocked down, but when this new boxer came to teach his disciples, he took his husband and himself as a lesson from the past, so he must keep a hand, or even three or four hands, so boxing is "not as good as a generation".还有，做医生的有秘方，做厨子的有秘法，开点心铺子的有秘传，为了保全自家的衣食，听说这还只授儿妇，不教女儿，以免流传到别人家里去。“秘”是中国非常普遍的东西，连关于国家大事的会议，也总是“内容非常秘密”，大家不知道。但是，作文却好像偏偏并无秘诀，假使有，每个作家一定是传给子孙的了，然而祖传的作家很少见。自然，作家的孩子们，从小看惯书籍纸笔，眼格也许比较的可以大一点罢，不过不见得就会做。目下的刊物上，虽然常见什么“父子作家”“夫妇作家”的名称，仿佛真能从遗嘱或情书中，密授一些什么秘诀一样，其实乃是肉麻当有趣，妄将做官的关系，用到作文上去了。
In addition, there are secret recipes for doctors, secret methods for cooks, and secret traditions for opening dim sum shops. "Secret" is a very common thing in China, and even meetings on national affairs are always "very secret", and everyone does not know about it. However, the composition seems to have no secret, if there is, every writer must have passed it on to his descendants, but ancestral writers are rare. Naturally, the children of writers are accustomed to reading books, paper and pen since childhood, and their eyes may be a little bigger, but they may not be able to do it. In the current publications, although the names of "father and son writers" and "husband and wife writers" are common, as if they can really teach some secrets from wills or love letters, they are actually very interesting, and the relationship between being officials is used in compositions.那么，作文真就毫无秘诀么？却也并不。我曾经讲过几句做古文的秘诀，是要通篇都有来历，而非古人的成文；也就是通篇是自己做的，而又全非自己所做，个人其实并没有说什么；也就是“事出有因”，而又“查无实据”。到这样，便“庶几乎免于大过也矣”了。简而言之，实不过要做得“今天天气，哈哈哈……”而已。
So, is there really no secret to composition? But not either. I once said a few words about the secret of making ancient texts, which is to have a source throughout the text, not the writings of the ancients; That is, the whole article is done by myself, but not by myself, and I don't actually say anything; That is, "there is a reason for the incident" and "there is no evidence". In this way, "it is almost free from major mistakes". In short, it's just about doing "today's weather, hahaha......".这是说内容。至于修辞，也有一点秘诀：一要蒙胧，二要难懂。那方法，是：缩短句子，多用难字。譬如罢，作文论秦朝事，写一句“秦始皇乃始烧书”，是不算好文章的，必须翻译一下，使它不容易一目了然才好。这时就用得着《尔雅》，《文选》了，其实是只要不给别人知道，查查《康熙字典》也不妨的。动手来改，成为“始皇始焚书”，就有些“古”起来，到得改成“政俶燔典”，那就简直有了班马气，虽然跟着也令人不大看得懂。但是这样的做成一篇以至一部，是可以被称为“学者”的，我想了半天，只做得一句，所以只配在杂志上投稿。
This is about content. As for rhetoric, there is also a secret: one must be obscure, and the other must be difficult to understand. The method is: shorten sentences and use more difficult words. For example, writing an essay on the affairs of the Qin Dynasty and writing a sentence "Qin Shi Huang was the first to burn books" is not a good article, and it must be translated so that it is not easy to understand at a glance. At this time, "Erya" and "Anthology" are used, in fact, as long as they are not known to others, it is okay to check the "Kangxi Dictionary". If you change it and become "the first emperor began to burn books", it will be a little "ancient", and it will be changed to "Zheng Chu Burning Code", then it will be simply a banma, although it is not very understandable. But this kind of article or even one can be called a "scholar", I thought for a long time, and I only did one sentence, so I only deserved to submit it to the magazine.我们的古之文学大师，就常常玩着这一手。班固先生的“紫色鼃声，余分闰位”，就将四句长句，缩成八字的；扬雄先生的“蠢迪检柙”，就将“动由规矩”这四个平常字，翻成难字的。《绿野仙踪》记塾师咏“花”，有句云：“媳钗俏矣儿书废，哥罐闻焉嫂棒伤。”自说意思，是儿妇折花为钗，虽然俏丽，但恐儿子因而废读；下联较费解，是他的哥哥折了花来，没有花瓶，就插在瓦罐里，以嗅花香，他嫂嫂为防微杜渐起见，竟用棒子连花和罐一起打坏了。这算是对于冬烘先生的嘲笑。然而他的作法，其实是和扬班并无不合的，错只在他不用古典而用新典。这一个所谓“错”，就使《文选》之类在遗老遗少们的心眼里保住了威灵。
Our ancient literary masters often play this hand. Mr. Ban Gu's "purple shrew's sound, extra leap position" shortened four long sentences into eight characters; Mr. Yang Xiong's "Stupid Di Inspection" translates the four ordinary words of "moving by rules" into difficult words. "The Wizard of Oz" records the teacher's poem "Flower", and there is a line: "The daughter-in-law is pretty, the children's book is useless, and the brother can hears the sister-in-law's stick injury. "Speaking of meaning, it is the daughter-in-law who folds flowers into hairpins, although it is beautiful, but I am afraid that my son will stop reading because of this; The lower couplet is more puzzling, it was his brother who broke the flowers, there was no vase, so he put it in the clay pot to smell the fragrance of the flowers, and his sister-in-law actually used a stick to break the flowers and the jar in order to prevent micro-development. This is a ridicule of Mr. Donghuan. However, his approach is actually in line with Yangban, and the fault is only that he uses the new classics instead of the classics. This so-called "mistake" has preserved the power of the "Anthology" in the eyes of the elderly and young.做得蒙胧，这便是所谓“好”么？答曰：也不尽然，其实是不过掩了丑。但是，“知耻近乎勇”，掩了丑，也就仿佛近乎好了。摩登女郎披下头发，中年妇人罩上面纱，就都是蒙胧术。人类学家解释衣服的起源有三说：一说是因为男女知道了性的羞耻心，用这来遮羞；一说却以为倒是用这来刺激；还有一种是说因为老弱男女，身体衰瘦，露着不好看，盖上一些东西，借此掩掩丑的。从修辞学的立场上看起来，我赞成后一说。现在还常有骈四俪六，典丽堂皇的祭文，挽联，宣言，通电，我们倘去查字典，翻类书，剥去它外面的装饰，翻成白话文，试看那剩下的是怎样的东西呵！？
If you do it in a hazy way, is this the so-called "good"? Answer: Not necessarily, in fact, it is just a cover up of ugliness. However, "knowing shame is almost brave", covering up ugliness, it seems to be almost good. Modern girls put their hair down, and middle-aged women put on their veils, all of which are masking techniques. Anthropologists explain the origin of clothes in three ways: one is because men and women know the shame of sex and use it to cover their shame; I thought it was used to stimulate it; Another is that because the old and weak men and women are thin and unsightly, they cover up some things to hide their ugliness. From the standpoint of rhetoric, I agree with the latter. If we go to look up the dictionary, flip through the book, strip off the decoration on the outside, and turn it into vernacular, let's see what kind of things are left!?不懂当然也好的。好在那里呢？即好在“不懂”中。但所虑的是好到令人不能说好丑，所以还不如做得它“难懂”：有一点懂，而下一番苦功之后，所懂的也比较的多起来。我们是向来很有崇拜“难”的脾气的，每餐吃三碗饭，谁也不以为奇，有人每餐要吃十八碗，就郑重其事的写在笔记上；用手穿针没有人看，用脚穿针就可以搭帐篷卖钱；一幅画片，平淡无奇，装在匣子里，挖一个洞，化为西洋镜，人们就张着嘴热心的要看了。况且同是一事，费了苦功而达到的，也比并不费力而达到的的可贵。譬如到什么庙里去烧香罢，到山上的，比到平地上的可贵；三步一拜才到庙里的庙，和坐了轿子一径抬到的庙，即使同是这庙，在到达者的心里的可贵的程度是大有高下的。作文之贵乎难懂，就是要使读者三步一拜，这才能够达到一点目的的妙法。
Of course it's okay if you don't understand. Where is the good thing? That is, fortunately, in "I don't understand". But what I am worried about is that it is so good that people cannot say that it is ugly, so it is better to make it "difficult to understand": if you understand a little, after the next hard work, you will understand more. We have always had a temper to worship "difficult", eating three bowls of rice at each meal, no one is surprised, some people want to eat eighteen bowls per meal, and they solemnly write it down in their notes; no one sees the needle with your hands, and you can set up a tent and sell it for money with your feet; A painting, plain, is packed in a box, digs a hole, turns into a diorama, and people open their mouths to see it enthusiastically. Moreover, the same thing is more valuable than what is achieved with great effort. For example, if you go to a temple to burn incense, going to the mountain is more valuable than going to the flat ground; It takes three steps and one bow to reach the temple in the temple, and the temple that is carried all the way to the temple by sedan chair, even if it is the same temple, the degree of value in the hearts of the arrival is very different. The value of composition is difficult to understand, that is, to make the reader bow in three steps, so that it can achieve a little goal.写到这里，成了所讲的不但只是做古文的秘诀，而且是做骗人的古文的秘诀了。但我想，做白话文也没有什么大两样，因为它也可以夹些僻字，加上蒙胧或难懂，来施展那变戏法的障眼的手巾的。倘要反一调，就是“白描”。
Writing here, it has become not only the secret of making ancient texts, but also the secrets of deceiving ancient texts. But I think there is no big difference in doing vernacular text, because it can also contain some obscure words, add obscure or difficult to understand, to perform the trick of the blinding handkerchief. If you want to go the other way, it is "white description".“白描”却并没有秘诀。如果要说有，也不过是和障眼法反一调：有真意，去粉饰，少做作，勿卖弄而已。
"White Drawing" has no secret. If you want to say that there is, it is just the opposite of the blindfold: have a true meaning, remove embellishment, be less pretentious, and don't show off.十一月十日。
November 10th.

捣鬼心传

捣鬼心传

捣鬼心传

Pounding ghost hearts中国人又很有些喜欢奇形怪状，鬼鬼祟祟的脾气，爱看古树发光比大麦开花的多，其实大麦开花他向来也没有看见过。于是怪胎畸形，就成为报章的好资料，替代了生物学的常识的位置了。最近在广告上所见的，有像所谓两头蛇似的两头四手的胎儿，还有从小肚上生出一只脚来的三脚汉子。固然，人有怪胎，也有畸形，然而造化的本领是有限的，他无论怎么怪，怎么畸，总有一个限制：孪儿可以连背，连腹，连臀，连胁，或竟骈头，却不会将头生在屁股上；形可以骈拇，枝指，缺肢，多乳，却不会两脚之外添出一只脚来，好像“买两送一”的买卖。天实在不及人之能捣鬼。
Chinese people also like strange shapes and sneaky tempers, and love to see ancient trees shine more than barley flowers, in fact, he has never seen barley bloom. So the freak deformity became a good source of information in the newspaper, replacing the position of common sense in biology. Recently, I have seen in advertisements that there are fetuses with two heads and four hands like so-called two-headed snakes, and three-legged men who give birth to one foot from their belly. Of course, there are freaks and deformities, but the ability of creation is limited, no matter how strange or deformed he is, there is always a limit: twins can have a back, belly, buttocks, ribs, or even a head, but they will not have their heads on their buttocks; The shape can be a toe, a branch finger, a missing limb, and a lot of breasts, but it will not add a foot in addition to the two feet, like a "buy two get one free" deal. Heaven is really not as good as human beings can pound ghosts.但是，人的捣鬼，虽胜于天，而实际上本领也有限。因为捣鬼精义，在切忌发挥，亦即必须含蓄。盖一加发挥，能使所捣之鬼分明，同时也生限制，故不如含蓄之深远，而影响却又因而模胡了。“有一利必有一弊”，我之所谓“有限”者以此。
However, although people's troublemakers are better than the sky, their skills are actually limited. Because the essence of troublemakers must not be exerted, that is, it must be implicit. Because OnePlus can make the ghost of the game clear, but at the same time create restrictions, so it is not as far-reaching as implicit, but the impact is so dull. "There must be a benefit and a disadvantage", which is what I mean by "limited".清朝人的笔记里，常说罗两峰的《鬼趣图》，真写得鬼气拂拂；后来那图由文明书局印出来了，却不过一个奇瘦，一个矮胖，一个臃肿的模样，并不见得怎样的出奇，还不如只看笔记有趣。小说上的描摹鬼相，虽然竭力，也都不足以惊人，我觉得最可怕的还是晋人所记的脸无五官，浑沦如鸡蛋的山中厉鬼。因为五官不过是五官，纵使苦心经营，要它凶恶，总也逃不出五官的范围，现在使它浑沦得莫名其妙，读者也就怕得莫名其妙了。然而其“弊”也，是印象的模胡。不过较之写些“青面獠牙”，“口鼻流血”的笨伯，自然聪明得远。
In the notes of the Qing Dynasty people, it is often said that Luo Liangfeng's "Ghost Fun Picture" is really ghostly written; Later, the picture was printed by Civilization Bookstore, but it was just a very thin, a short fat, and a bloated appearance, which was not necessarily surprising, and it was not as interesting as just looking at the notes. The depiction of ghosts in the novel, although I try my best, is not enough to be amazing, I think the most terrifying thing is the ghost in the mountains whose face has no facial features and is as muddy as an egg. Because the five senses are just the five senses, even if you work hard to make it vicious, you will never be able to escape the scope of the five senses. However, its "disadvantage" is also the ambiguity of the impression. However, compared to writing some "blue-faced fangs" and "bleeding mouth and nose", he is naturally far smarter.中华民国人的宣布罪状大抵是十条，然而结果大抵是无效。古来尽多坏人，十条不过如此，想引人的注意以至活动是决不会的。骆宾王作《讨武曌檄》，那“入宫见嫉，蛾眉不肯让人，掩袖工谗，狐媚偏能惑主”这几句，恐怕是很费点心机的了，但相传武后看到这里，不过微微一笑。是的，如此而已，又怎么样呢？声罪致讨的明文，那力量往往远不如交头接耳的密语，因为一是分明，一是莫测的。我想假使当时骆宾王站在大众之前，只是攒眉摇头，连称“坏极坏极”，却不说出其所谓坏的实例，恐怕那效力会在文章之上的罢。“狂飙文豪”高长虹攻击我时，说道劣迹多端，倘一发表，便即身败名裂，而终于并不发表，是深得捣鬼正脉的；但也竟无大效者，则与广泛俱来的“模胡”之弊为之也。
The declaration of crimes by the people of the Republic of China is about ten, but the result is mostly invalid. There have been many bad people in ancient times, but the ten rules are just like this, and they will never try to attract people's attention or even activities. King Luo Bin wrote "Seeking Wu Zhao Proclamation", and the sentences of "entering the palace to be jealous, moth eyebrows refusing to let people, covering up sleeves and slander, and fox charm can confuse the lord" are probably very scheming, but it is said that Wu Zetian saw this, but smiled slightly. Yes, that's all, so what? The clear text of accusation is often far less powerful than the secret words that are heard from each other, because one is clear and the other is unfathomable. I think if Luo Binwang stood in front of the public at that time, just frowned and shook his head, and even called it "extremely bad", but did not name his so-called bad examples, I am afraid that the effect would be on the article. When the "Hurricane Writer" Gao Changhong attacked me, he said that there were many bad deeds, and if he published it, he would be ruined, and finally he would not publish it, which was deeply troublesome; However, it has not had a significant effect, which is due to the widespread "mold" problem.明白了这两例，便知道治国平天下之法，在告诉大家以有法，而不可明白切实的说出何法来。因为一说出，即有言，一有言，便可与行相对照，所以不如示之以不测。不测的威棱使人萎伤，不测的妙法使人希望——饥荒时生病，打仗时做诗，虽若与治国平天下不相干，但在莫明其妙中，却能令人疑为跟着自有治国平天下的妙法在——然而其“弊”也，却还是照例的也能在模胡中疑心到所谓妙法，其实不过是毫无方法而已。
If you understand these two cases, you will know that the law of governing the country and pacifying the world is telling everyone that there is a law, but you cannot understand what method to actually say. Because once you say it, you have words, and as soon as you say something, you can compare it with your actions, so it is better to show it unexpectedly. The unpredictable majesty makes people wither, and the unpredictable wonderful method makes people hope - getting sick during famine and writing poetry during war, although it has nothing to do with governing the country and pacifying the world, but in the incomprehensible, it can make people suspect that there is a wonderful method of governing the country and pacifying the world with its own - but its "drawback" is also as usual, but it can still be suspicious of the so-called wonderful method in the most, but in fact, there is no way.捣鬼有术，也有效，然而有限，所以以此成大事者，古来无有。
There are methods for striking ghosts, and they are also effective, but they are limited, so there has never been a way to achieve great things in ancient times.十一月二十二日。

家庭为中国之基本

家庭为中国之基本

家庭为中国之基本

Family is the foundation of China中国的自己能酿酒，比自己来种鸦片早，但我们现在只听说许多人躺着吞云吐雾，却很少见有人像外国水兵似的满街发酒疯。唐宋的踢球，久已失传，一般的娱乐是躲在家里彻夜叉麻雀。从这两点看起来，我们在从露天下渐渐的躲进家里去，是无疑的。古之上海文人，已尝慨乎言之，曾出一联，索人属对，道：“三鸟害人鸦雀鸽”，“鸽”是彩票，雅号奖券，那时却称为“白鸽票”的。但我不知道后来有人对出了没有。
China can make wine earlier than it grows opium itself, but now we only hear that many people lie down and swallow clouds, but it is rare to see people who are drunk and crazy like foreign sailors. The kicking of the Tang and Song dynasties has been lost for a long time, and the general entertainment is to hide at home and sparrows. From these two points, it seems that we are gradually hiding in the house from the open sun, which is undoubted. The ancient Shanghai literati have once said that they once made a couplet, asking for a pair of people, saying: "Three birds harm people and birds and pigeons", "pigeons" are lottery tickets, elegant lottery tickets, but at that time they were called "white pigeon tickets". But I don't know if anyone came up with it later.不过我们也并非满足于现状，是身处斗室之中，神驰宇宙之外，抽鸦片者享乐着幻境，叉麻雀者心仪于好牌。檐下放起爆竹，是在将月亮从天狗嘴里救出；剑仙坐在书斋里，哼的一声，一道白光，千万里外的敌人可被杀掉了，不过飞剑还是回家，钻进原先的鼻孔去，因为下次还要用。这叫做千变万化，不离其宗。所以学校是从家庭里拉出子弟来，教成社会人才的地方，而一闹到不可开交的时候，还是“交家长严加管束”云。
However, we are not satisfied with the status quo, we are in the fighting room, outside the universe, the opium smoker enjoys the illusion, and the sparrow fork sparrow likes the good cards. setting off firecrackers under the eaves is rescuing the moon from the mouth of the tengu; The sword immortal sat in the study, snorted, a white light, the enemy tens of millions of miles away could be killed, but the flying sword still went home and got into the original nostril, because it would be used next time. This is called ever-changing, and it is inseparable from its root. Therefore, the school is a place to pull out children from the family and teach them to become social talents, and when the trouble reaches the point of being inseparable, it is still "handed over to parents to strictly control".“骨肉归于土，命也；若夫魂气，则无不之也，无不之也！”一个人变了鬼，该可以随便一点了罢，而活人仍要烧一所纸房子，请他住进去，阔气的还有打牌桌，鸦片盘。成仙，这变化是很大的，但是刘太太偏舍不得老家，定要运动到“拔宅飞升”，连鸡犬都带了上去而后已，好依然的管家务，饲狗，喂鸡。
"Flesh and blood return to the earth, and life is also; As for the soul, there is nothing that cannot be done, and there is nothing that cannot be done! "A person has become a ghost, he should be able to do it casually, and the living still have to burn a paper house, invite him to live in it, and there are also card tables and opium plates. Becoming an immortal, this change is a big change, but Mrs. Liu is reluctant to let go of her hometown, and she must exercise to "pull the house and ascend", and even bring the chickens and dogs up, so that she can still take care of the housework, feed the dogs, and feed the chickens.我们的古今人，对于现状，实在也愿意有变化，承认其变化的。变鬼无法，成仙更佳，然而对于老家，却总是死也不肯放。我想，火药只做爆竹，指南针只看坟山，恐怕那原因就在此。
Our ancient and modern people are really willing to change the status quo and admit its changes. It is impossible to become a ghost, and it is better to become an immortal, but for his hometown, he always refuses to let go. I think gunpowder only makes firecrackers, and the compass only looks at graves, I'm afraid that's why.现在是火药蜕化为轰炸弹，烧夷弹，装在飞机上面了，我们却只能坐在家里等他落下来。自然，坐飞机的人是颇有了的，但他那里是远征呢，他为的是可以快点回到家里去。
Now the gunpowder has been transformed into bombs, incendiary bombs, and put on airplanes, but we can only sit at home and wait for him to fall. Naturally, there are quite a few people who fly, but he is on an expedition there, so he can go home quickly.家是我们的生处，也是我们的死所。
Home is our place of birth and our place of death.十二月十六日。

Preface to "General Retreat"中国久已称小说之类为“闲书”，这在五十年前为止，是大概真实的，整日价辛苦做活的人，就没有工夫看小说。所以凡看小说的，他就得有余暇，既有余暇，可见是不必怎样辛苦做活的了，成仿吾先生曾经断之曰：“有闲，即是有钱！”者以此。诚然，用经济学的眼光看起来，在现制度之下，“闲暇”恐怕也确是一种“富”。但是，穷人们也爱小说，他们不识字，就到茶馆里去听“说书”，百来回的大部书，也要每天一点一点的听下去。不过比起整天做活的人们来，他们也还是较有闲暇的。要不然，又那有工夫上茶馆，那有闲钱做茶钱呢？
China has long called novels "idle books", which was probably true until fifty years ago, and people who work hard all day long have no time to read novels. Therefore, anyone who reads novels must have leisure, and since he has leisure, it can be seen that he does not have to work hard, Mr. Cheng Fangwu once said: "If you have leisure, you are rich!" This is the reason. It is true that from the perspective of economics, under the current system, "leisure" may indeed be a kind of "wealth". However, the poor also love novels, they are illiterate, so they go to the teahouse to listen to "storytelling", and most of the books are listened to little by little every day. However, compared to people who work all day, they are still more leisurely. Otherwise, how can there be time to go to the teahouse, and how can there be spare money for tea?小说之在欧美，先前又何尝不这样。后来生活艰难起来了，为了维持，就缺少余暇，不再能那么悠悠忽忽。只是偶然也还想借书来休息一下精神，而又耐不住唠叨不已，破费工夫，于是就使短篇小说交了桃花运。这一种洋文坛上的趋势，也跟着古人之所谓“欧风美雨”，冲进中国来，所以“文学革命”以后，所产生的小说，几乎以短篇为限。但作者的才力不能构成巨制，自然也是一个很大的原因。
Novels in Europe and the United States have never been like this before. Later, life became difficult, and in order to maintain it, there was a lack of leisure, and I could no longer be so leisurely. It's just that by chance, I also want to borrow books to rest my spirits, but I can't stand the nagging and spend a lot of time, so I made the short story peach blossom luck. This trend in the foreign literary world also followed the so-called "European wind and rain" of the ancients and rushed into China, so after the "literary revolution", the novels produced were almost limited to short stories. But the author's talent cannot constitute a masterpiece, which is naturally a big reason.而且书中的主角也变换了。古之小说，主角是勇将策士，侠盗赃官，妖怪神仙，佳人才子，后来则有妓女嫖客，无赖奴才之流。“五四”以后的短篇里却大抵是新的智识者登了场，因为他们是首先觉到了在“欧风美雨”中的飘摇的，然而总还不脱古之英雄和才子气。现在可又不同了，大家都已感到飘摇，不再要听一个特别的人的运命。某英雄在柏林拊髀看天，某天才在泰山捶胸泣血，还有谁会转过脸去呢？他们要知道，感觉得更广大，更深邃了。
And the protagonist in the book has also changed. In ancient novels, the protagonists are brave generals and strategists, thieves and corrupt officials, monsters and immortals, beauties, and later prostitutes and rogues. In the short stories after the "May Fourth", it is probably new intellectuals who appear, because they are the first to feel the swaying in the "European wind and rain", but they are still the heroes and talents of the ancients. Now it's different, everyone has felt shaken and no longer wants to listen to the fate of a special person. A hero patted his thighs in Berlin and looked at the sky, and one day he beat his chest and cried blood on Mount Tai, who else would turn his face? They need to know that they feel broader and deeper.这一本集子就是这一时代的出产品，显示着分明的蜕变，人物并非英雄，风光也不旖旎，然而将中国的眼睛点出来了。我以为作者的写工厂，不及她的写农村，但也许因为我先前较熟于农村，否则，是作者较熟于农村的缘故罢。
This collection is a product of this era, showing a clear transformation, the characters are not heroes, and the scenery is not beautiful, but it points out China's eyes. I thought that the author's writing factory was not as good as her writing about the countryside, but maybe it was because I was more familiar with the countryside before, otherwise, it was because the author was more familiar with the countryside.一九三三年十二月二十五夜，鲁迅记。
On the night of December 25, 1933, Lu Xun recorded.

Answer: An open letter from Mr. Yang Cunren《文化列车》破格的开到我的书桌上面，是十二月十日开车的第三期，托福使我知道了近来有这样一种杂志，并且使我看见了杨邨人先生给我的公开信，还要求着答复。对于这一种公开信，本没有一定给以答复的必要的，因为它既是公开，那目的其实是在给大家看，对我个人倒还在其次。但是，我如果要回答也可以，不过目的也还是在给大家看，要不然，不是只要直接寄给个人就完了么？因为这缘故，所以我在回答之前，应该先将原信重抄在下面——
The TOEFL made me know that there is such a magazine recently, and I saw an open letter from Mr. Yang Cunren to me, and asked for an answer. There is no need to give a reply to this kind of open letter, because since it is public, the purpose is actually to show everyone, and for me personally, it is secondary. However, if I want to answer, it's okay, but the purpose is still to show everyone, otherwise, wouldn't it be enough to just send it directly to the individual? Because of this, before I answer, I should re-copy the original letter below——鲁迅先生：
Mr. Lu Xun:读了李儵先生（不知道是不是李又燃先生，抑或曹聚仁先生的笔名）的《读伪自由书》一文，近末一段说：
After reading the article "Reading the Pseudo-Freedom Book" by Mr. Li Yan (I don't know if it is Mr. Li Youran or Mr. Cao Juren's pseudo-name), the last paragraph says:“读着鲁迅《伪自由书》，便想到鲁迅先生的人。那天，见鲁迅先生吃饭，咀嚼时牵动着筋肉，连胸肋骨也拉拉动的，鲁迅先生是老了！我当时不禁一股酸味上心头。记得从前看到父亲的老态时有过这样的情绪，现在看了鲁迅先生的老态又重温了一次。这都是使司马懿之流，快活的事，何况旁边早变心了魏延。”（这末一句照原文十个字抄，一字无错，确是妙文！）
"Reading Lu Xun's "Pseudo-Freedom Book", I thought of Mr. Lu Xun's people. That day, seeing Mr. Lu Xun eating, he pulled his muscles when chewing, and even his chest and ribs were pulled, Mr. Lu Xun was old! I couldn't help but feel a sour taste in my heart at that time. I remember having such emotions when I saw my father's old age in the past, but now I have seen Mr. Lu Xun's old age and relived it again. This is all a happy thing for Sima Yi and the like, not to mention that Wei Yan has already changed his mind next to him. (This last sentence is copied in ten words according to the original text, and there is no mistake in every word, it is indeed a wonderful article!) ）不禁令人起了两个感想：一个是我们敬爱的鲁迅先生老了，一个是我们敬爱的鲁迅先生为什么是诸葛亮？先生的“旁边”那里来的“早变心了魏延”？无产阶级大众何时变成了阿斗？
I can't help but have two thoughts: one is that our beloved Mr. Lu Xun is old, and the other is why our beloved Mr. Lu Xun is Zhuge Liang? Where did the gentleman's "side" come from, "Wei Yan has already changed his mind"? When did the proletarian masses become Ah Dou?第一个感想使我惶恐万分！我们敬爱的鲁迅先生老了，这是多么令人惊心动魄的事！记得《呐喊》在北京最初出版的时候（大概总在十年前），我拜读之后，景仰不置，曾为文介绍颂扬，揭登于张东荪先生编的《学灯》，在当时我的敬爱先生甚于敬爱创造社四君子。其后一九二八年《语丝》上先生为文讥诮我们，虽然两方论战绝无感情，可是论战是一回事，私心敬爱依然如昔。一九三〇年秋先生五十寿辰的庆祝会上，我是参加庆祝的一个，而且很亲切地和先生一起谈天，私心很觉荣幸。左联有一次大会在一个日本同志家里开着，我又和先生见面，十分快乐。可是今年我脱离共产党以后，在左右夹攻的当儿，《艺术新闻》与《出版消息》都登载着先生要“嘘”我的消息，说是书名定为：《北平五讲与上海三嘘》，将对我“用嘘的方式加以袭击”，而且将我与梁实秋张若谷同列，这自然是引起我的反感，所以才有《新儒林外史第一回》之作。但在《新儒林外史第一回》里头只说先生出阵交战用的是大刀一词加以反攻的讽刺而已。其中引文的情绪与态度都是敬爱先生的。文中的意义却是以为先生对我加以“嘘”的袭击未免看错了敌人吧了。到了拜读大著《两地书》以后为文介绍，笔下也十分恭敬并没半点谩骂的字句，可是先生于《我的种痘》一文里头却有所误会似地顺笔对我放了两三枝冷箭儿，特别地说是有人攻击先生的老，在我呢，并没有觉得先生老了，而且那篇文章也没有攻击先生的老，先生自己认为是老了吧了。伯纳萧的年纪比先生还大，伯纳萧的鬓毛比先生还白如丝吧，伯纳萧且不是老了，先生怎么这样就以为老了呢？我是从来没感觉到先生老了的，我只感觉到先生有如青年而且希望先生永久年青。然而，读了李儵先生的文章，我惶恐，我惊讶，原来先生真的老了。李儵先生因为看了先生老了而“不禁一股酸味上心头”有如看他的令尊的老态的时候有过的情绪，我虽然也时常想念着我那年老的父亲，但并没有如人家攻击我那样地想做一个“孝子”，不过是天性所在有时未免兴感而想念着吧了，所以我看了李儵先生的文章并没有联想到我的父亲上面去。然而先生老了，我是惶恐与惊讶。我惶恐与惊讶的是，我们敬爱的文坛前辈老了，他将因为生理上的缘故而要停止他的工作了！在这敬爱的心理与观念上，我将今年来对先生的反感打个粉碎，竭诚地请先生训诲。可是希望先生以严肃的态度出之，如“嘘”，如放冷箭儿等却请慎重，以令对方心服。
The first thought made me terrified! Our beloved Mr. Lu Xun is old, what a thrilling thing! I remember that when "The Scream" was first published in Beijing (probably ten years ago), after I read it, I admired it, and once introduced and praised the article, and published it in the "Learning Lantern" edited by Mr. Zhang Dongsun. Later, in 1928, Mr. Shangsheng ridiculed us in an article, although the debate between the two parties was absolutely emotionless, but the debate was the same thing, and the private love was still the same. At the celebration of Mr. Zhao's 50th birthday in the autumn of 1930, I was one of the participants in the celebration, and I was very honored to talk with him very cordially. There was a meeting of the Left League at the home of a Japanese comrade, and I met my husband again, and I was very happy. However, after I broke away from the Communist Party this year, when I was attacking from the left and right, both "Art News" and "Publishing News" published the news that Mr. wanted to "boo" me, saying that the title of the book was set as: "Five Lectures in Peking and Three Hushes in Shanghai", which would "attack me in a booing way", and put me in the same line as Liang Shiqiu and Zhang Ruogu, which naturally aroused my disgust, so there was "The First History of New Confucianism". But in "The First History of Neo-Confucianism", it is only said that Mr. went into battle and used the word "big sword" to counterattack the irony. The emotions and attitudes of the quotations are all beloved by Mr. Respect. The meaning of the article is that I think that the gentleman's attack on me is a misunderstanding of the enemy. After reading the masterpiece "The Book of Two Places", I introduced it to the article, and the pen was also very respectful and did not have the slightest abusive words, but in the article "My Pox", Mr. put two or three cold arrows on me as if he had misunderstood, especially when someone attacked Mr. Old, in my case, I didn't feel that Mr. was old, and that article did not attack Mr. Old, Mr. himself thought he was old. Bernard Shaw is older than Mr. Bernard Shaw, Bernard Shaw's sideburns are whiter than Mr. Silk, Bernard Shaw is not old, why does Mr. think he is old like this? I never felt that my husband was old, I only felt that my husband was like a young man and hoped that he would be young forever. However, after reading Mr. Li Yan's article, I was terrified and surprised, it turned out that Mr. Li was really old. Although I often miss my old father, I don't want to be a "filial son" like people attack me, but it is my nature that sometimes I can't help but feel interested and miss it, so I read Mr. Li Yan's article and did not think of my father. However, when my husband is old, I am frightened and surprised. I am terrified and surprised that our beloved literary senior is old, and he will stop his work because of physiological reasons! In this beloved psychology and concept, I will smash my disgust towards you this year, and I will sincerely ask you to teach me. But I hope that Mr. will come out with a serious attitude, such as "shh", such as putting cold arrows, etc., but please be cautious to convince the other party.第二个感想使我……因为那是李儵先生的事，这里不愿有扰清听。
The second thought made me ...... Because that is Mr. Li Yan's business, I don't want to disturb the hearing here.假如这信是先生觉得有答复的价值的话，就请寄到这里《文化列车》的编者将它发表，否则希望先生为文给我一个严正的批判也可以。发表的地方我想随处都欢迎的。
