The following is my reply. Because it is in the form of a letter, the beginning is, as usual——邨人先生：
Mr. Estateman:先生给我的信是没有答复的价值的。我并不希望先生“心服”，先生也无须我批判，因为近二年来的文字，已经将自己的形象画得十分分明了。自然，我决不会相信“鬼儿子”们的胡说，但我也不相信先生。
The letter to me from my husband is worthless of an answer. I don't want my husband to be "convinced", and he doesn't need me to criticize, because the words in the past two years have drawn his image very clearly. Naturally, I will never believe the nonsense of the "ghost sons", but I also don't believe sir.这并非说先生的话是一样的叭儿狗式的狺狺；恐怕先生是自以为永久诚实的罢，不过因为急促的变化，苦心的躲闪，弄得左支右绌，不能自圆其说，终于变成废话了，所以在听者的心中，也就失去了重量。例如先生的这封信，倘使略有自知之明，其实是不必写的。
This is not to say that Mr. Trump's words are the same as dog-like dogs; I'm afraid that the gentleman thinks he is permanently honest, but because of the rapid changes and painstaking dodging, he is so confused that he can't justify himself, and finally it becomes nonsense, so in the hearts of the listeners, it loses weight. For example, this letter from Mr. does not need to be written if he is a little self-aware.先生首先问我“为什么是诸葛亮？”这就问得稀奇。李儵先生我曾经见过面，并非曹聚仁先生，至于是否李又燃先生，我无从确说，因为又燃先生我是没有豫先见过的。我“为什么是诸葛亮”呢？别人的议论，我不能，也不必代为答复，要不然，我得整天的做答案了。也有人说我是“人群的蟊贼”的。“为什么？”——我都由它去。但据我所知道，魏延变心，是在诸葛亮死后，我还活着，诸葛亮的头衔是不能加到我这里来的，所以“无产阶级大众何时变成了阿斗？”的问题也就落了空。那些废话，如果还记得《三国志演义》或吴稚晖先生的话，是不至于说出来的，书本子上及别人，并未说过人民是阿斗。现在请放心罢。但先生站在“小资产阶级文学革命”的旗下，还是什么“无产阶级大众”，自己的眼睛看见了这些字，不觉得可羞或可笑么？不要再提这些字，怎么样呢？
The teacher first asked me, "Why Zhuge Liang?" This is a strange question. I have met Mr. Li Yan before, not Mr. Cao Juren, as for whether it is Mr. Li Youran, I can't say for sure, because I have not met Mr. Youran before. Why am I "Zhuge Liang"? I can't, and don't have to answer other people's comments, otherwise, I have to answer all day long. Some people also say that I am a "thief of the crowd". "Why?" - I'll let it go. But as far as I know, Wei Yan changed his mind after Zhuge Liang's death, I was still alive, and Zhuge Liang's title could not be added to me, so "When did the proletarian masses become Ah Dou?" The question was also lost. Those nonsense, if you still remember "Romance of the Three Kingdoms" or Mr. Wu Zhihui's words, will not be said, and the book and others have never said that the people are Adou. Now don't worry. But when the gentleman stands under the banner of the "petty-bourgeois literary revolution", or is it some "proletarian masses", don't you feel ashamed or ridiculous when you see these words with your own eyes? Don't mention these words again, how about it?其次是先生“惊心动魄”于我的老，可又“惊心动魄”得很稀奇。我没有修炼仙丹，自然的规则，一定要使我老下去，丝毫也不足为奇的，请先生还是镇静一点的好。而且我后来还要死呢，这也是自然的规则，豫先声明，请千万不要“惊心动魄”，否则，逐渐就要神经衰弱，愈加满口废话了。我即使老，即使死，却决不会将地球带进棺材里去，它还年青，它还存在，希望正在将来，目前也还可以插先生的旗子。这一节我敢保证，也请放心工作罢。
Secondly, my husband is "thrilling" in my old age, but he is also "thrilling" and very strange. I haven't cultivated the elixir, the rules of nature, must make me old, it's not surprising at all, please calm down, sir." And I will die later, this is also a natural rule, Yu Xian declared, please don't be "thrilled", otherwise, you will gradually have a nervous breakdown and become more and more full of nonsense. Even if I am old, even if I die, I will never bring the earth into the coffin, it is still young, it still exists, I hope that in the future, I can still plant my husband's flag. I guarantee this section, please rest assured to work.于是就要说到“三嘘”问题了。这事情是有的，但和新闻上所载的有些两样。那时是在一个饭店里，大家闲谈，谈到有几个人的文章，我确曾说：这些都只要以一嘘了之，不值得反驳。这几个人们中，先生也在内。我的意思是，先生在那冠冕堂皇的“自白”里，明明的告白了农民的纯厚，小资产阶级的智识者的动摇和自私，却又要来竖起小资产阶级革命文学的旗，就自己打着自己的嘴。不过也并未说出，走散了就算完结了。但不知道是辗转传开去的呢，还是当时就有新闻记者在座，不久就张大其辞的在报上登了出来，并请读者猜测。近五六年来，关于我的记载多极了，无论为毁为誉，是假是真，我都置之不理，因为我没有聘定律师，常登广告的巨款，也没有遍看各种刊物的工夫。况且新闻记者为要哄动读者，会弄些夸张的手段，是大家知道的，甚至于还全盘捏造。例如先生还在做“革命文学家”的时候，用了“小记者”的笔名，在一种报上说我领到了南京中央党部的文学奖金，大开筵宴，祝孩子的周年，不料引起了郁达夫先生对于亡儿的记忆，悲哀了起来。这真说得栩栩如生，连出世不过一年的婴儿，也和我一同被喷满了血污。然而这事实的全出于创作，我知道，达夫先生知道，记者兼作者的您杨邨人先生当然也不会不知道的。
So let's talk about the "three boos" issue. There is such a thing, but it is somewhat different from what is reported in the news. At that time, it was in a restaurant, everyone was chatting, and when it came to the articles of several people, I did say: These are just a boo, not worth refuting. Among these people, Mr. is also included. I mean, in that high-sounding "confession", the gentleman clearly confessed the innocence of the peasants and the wavering and selfishness of the petty-bourgeois intellectuals, but he wanted to raise the banner of petty-bourgeois revolutionary literature, so he slapped his own mouth. But he didn't say it, and it was over even if he was separated. But I don't know if it was spread around, or if there were journalists present at the time, and soon it was published in the newspaper and asked readers to guess. In the past five or six years, there have been many records about me, whether it is for slander or reputation, whether it is false or true, I have ignored it, because I have not hired a lawyer, often advertised a huge amount of money, and I have not had the time to read various publications. Moreover, in order to coax readers, news reporters will use some exaggerated means, which everyone knows, and even fabricate them completely. For example, when Mr. was still a "revolutionary writer", he used the pseudonym of "little reporter" and said in a newspaper that I had received a literary bonus from the Nanjing Central Party Department, held a banquet, and wished the child an anniversary. This is really vivid, even the baby who was only a year old was sprayed with blood with me. However, this fact is all about creation, I know, Mr. Duff knows, and you, Mr. Yang Cunren, the journalist and author, certainly will not know it.当时我一声不响。为什么呢？革命者为达目的，可用任何手段的话，我是以为不错的，所以即使因为我罪孽深重，革命文学的第一步，必须拿我来开刀，我也敢于咬着牙关忍受。杀不掉，我就退进野草里，自己舐尽了伤口的血痕，决不烦别人傅药。但是，人非圣人，为了麻烦而激动起来的时候也有的，我诚然讥诮过先生“们”，这些文章，后来都收在《三闲集》中，一点也不删去，然而和先生“们”的造谣言和攻击文字的数量来比一比罢，不是不到十分之一么？不但此也，在讲演里，我有时也曾嘲笑叶灵凤先生或先生，先生们以“前卫”之名，雄赳赳出阵的时候，我是祭旗的牺牲，则战不数合便从火线上爬了开去之际，我以为实在也难以禁绝我的一笑。无论在阶级的立场上，在个人的立场上，我都有一笑的权利的。然而我从未傲然的假借什么“良心”或“无产阶级大众”之名，来凌压敌手，我接着一定声明：这是因为我和他有些个人的私怨的。先生，这还不够退让么？
At that time, I didn't make a sound. Why? I think it is good if revolutionaries can use any means to achieve their goals, so even if because of my deep sins and the first step of revolutionary literature, I must be stabbed, I dare to grit my teeth and endure it. If I can't kill it, I will retreat into the weeds, lick the blood stains on the wound myself, and never bother others to apply medicine. However, people are not saints, and there are times when they get excited for trouble, and I have indeed ridiculed the gentlemen "men", these articles, which were later included in the "Three Leisure Collection", were not deleted at all, but compared with the number of rumors and attacks on the words of the gentlemen "men", isn't it less than one-tenth? Not only that, but in my speeches, I sometimes laughed at Mr. Ye Lingfeng or Mr. Ye, when the gentlemen went out in the name of "avant-garde", I was a sacrifice of the flag, and when I climbed out of the line of fire in the name of the battle, I thought it was really difficult to stop my laughter. Whether from a class standpoint or an individual standpoint, I have the right to laugh. However, I never proudly used the name of "conscience" or "the masses of the proletariat" to overwhelm my opponent, and I must then declare that this was because I had some personal grudges with him. Sir, isn't that enough concession?但为了不能使我负责的新闻记事，竟引起先生的“反感”来了，然而仍蒙破格的优待，在《新儒林外史》里，还赏我拿一柄大刀。在礼仪上，我是应该致谢的，但在实际上，却也如大张筵宴一样，我并无大刀，只有一枝笔，名曰“金不换”。这也并不是在广告不收卢布的意思，是我从小用惯，每枝五分的便宜笔。我确曾用这笔碰着了先生，不过也只如运用古典一样，信手拈来，涉笔成趣而已，并不特别含有报复的恶意。但先生却又给我挂上“三枝冷箭”了。这可不能怪先生的，因为这只是陈源教授的余唾。然而，即使算是我在报复罢，由上面所说的原因，我也还不至于走进“以怨报德”的队伍里面去。
But in order not to make the news record I was responsible for, it actually aroused the "disgust" of the gentleman, but I was still treated exceptionally, and in the "History of the New Confucian Forest", I was rewarded with a big knife. In terms of etiquette, I should be grateful, but in reality, like a big banquet, I don't have a big sword, only a pen, called "gold is not exchanged". This does not mean that the advertisement does not charge rubles, it is a cheap pen that I have been used to since I was a child, and each is five cents per pen. I did use this pen to meet Mr. Zhao, but it was only like using classics, and it was just a matter of getting involved in the pen, and it did not contain any malice of revenge. But my husband hung up "three cold arrows" on me again. This can't be blamed by Mr., because this is just Professor Chen Yuan's spit. However, even if I am taking revenge, for the reasons mentioned above, I will not enter the ranks of "repaying kindness with resentment".至于所谓《北平五讲与上海三嘘》，其实是至今没有写，听说北平有一本《五讲》出版，那可并不是我做的，我也没有见过那一本书。不过既然闹了风潮，将来索性写一点也难说，如果写起来，我想名为《五讲三嘘集》，但后一半也未必正是报上所说的三位。先生似乎羞与梁实秋张若谷两位先生为伍，我看是排起来倒也并不怎样辱没了先生，只是张若谷先生比较的差一点，浅陋得很，连做一“嘘”的材料也不够，我大概要另换一位的。
As for the so-called "Five Lectures in Peking and Three Hushes in Shanghai", in fact, it has not been written so far, and I heard that there is a "Five Lectures" published in Peking, but it was not made by me, and I have not seen that book. However, since there is a trend, it is difficult to say that it will be written in the future, if it is written, I think it will be called "Five Lectures and Three Hustles", but the second half may not be exactly the three mentioned in the newspaper. Mr. seems to be ashamed to be in the company of Mr. Liang Shiqiu and Zhang Ruogu, I think it is not very insulting to Mr. in line, but Mr. Zhang Ruogu is a little worse, very shallow, and there is not enough material to make a "shh", I will probably change to another one.对于先生，照我此刻的意见，写起来恐怕也不会怎么坏。我以为先生虽是革命场中的一位小贩，却并不是奸商。我所谓奸商者，一种是国共合作时代的阔人，那时颂苏联，赞共产，无所不至，一到清党时候，就用共产青年，共产嫌疑青年的血来洗自己的手，依然是阔人，时势变了，而不变其阔；一种是革命的骁将，杀土豪，倒劣绅，激烈得很，一有蹉跌，便称为“弃邪归正”，骂“土匪”，杀同人，也激烈得很，主义改了，而仍不失其骁。先生呢，据“自白”，革命与否以亲之苦乐为转移，有些投机气味是无疑的，但并没有反过来做大批的买卖，仅在竭力要化为“第三种人”，来过比革命党较好的生活。既从革命阵线上退回来，为辩护自己，做稳“第三种人”起见，总得有一点零星的忏悔，对于统治者，其实是颇有些益处的，但竟还至于遇到“左右夹攻的当儿”者，恐怕那一方面，还嫌先生门面太小的缘故罢，这和银行雇员的看不起小钱店伙计是一样的。先生虽然觉得抱屈，但不信“第三种人”的存在不独是左翼，却因先生的经验而证明了，这也是一种很大的功德。
For Mr., according to my opinion at the moment, I am afraid it will not be too bad to write. I thought that although Mr. was a hawker in the revolutionary field, he was not a profiteer. When it came time to clear the party, he used the blood of communist youth and suspected communists to wash his hands, and he was still a broad person, and the times changed, but he did not change his breadth; One is the revolutionary general, who kills the local tyrants and the bad gentry, and is very fierce, and when he stumbles, he is called "abandoning evil and returning to the right path", scolding "bandits", killing his colleagues, and is also very fierce, and the doctrine has changed, but he still does not lose his bravery. As for the gentleman, according to the "confession", whether the revolution is transferred by the bitterness and joy of relatives, there is no doubt that there is some speculative smell, but it has not done a large number of transactions in turn, but only strives to become a "third kind of person" and live a better life than the revolutionary party. After retreating from the revolutionary front, in order to defend oneself and be a stable "third kind of person", there must be a little sporadic repentance, which is actually quite beneficial to the rulers, but it is actually quite beneficial to the rulers, but as for those who encounter "left and right attacks", I am afraid that on the one hand, it is because the façade of the gentleman is too small, which is the same as the bank employee who looks down on the small money shop guy. Although he felt aggrieved, he did not believe that the existence of the "third type of person" was not only left-wing, but his experience proved that this was also a great merit.平心而论，先生是不算失败的，虽然自己觉得被“夹攻”，但现在只要没有马上杀人之权的人，有谁不遭人攻击。生活当然是辛苦的罢，不过比起被杀戮，被囚禁的人们来，真有天渊之别；文章也随处能够发表，较之被封锁，压迫，禁止的作者，也自由自在得远了。和阔人骁将比，那当然还差得很远，这就因为先生并不是奸商的缘故。这是先生的苦处，也是先生的好处。
To be fair, Mr. is not a failure, although he feels that he is being "attacked", but now as long as there is no right to kill immediately, who is not attacked. Of course, life is hard, but compared to being killed and imprisoned, there is a real difference between people; Articles can also be published anywhere, and they are far more free than authors who are blocked, oppressed, and banned. Compared with the broad generals, of course, it is still far away, because Mr. is not a profiteer. This is the suffering of the gentleman, and it is also the benefit of the gentleman.话已经说得太多了，就此完结。总之，我还是和先前一样，决不肯造谣说谎，特别攻击先生，但从此改变另一种态度，却也不见得，本人的“反感”或“恭敬”，我是毫不打算的。请先生也不要因为我的“将因为生理上的缘故而要停止工作”而原谅我，为幸。
Too much has been said, and this is the end. In short, I still refuse to spread rumors and lies, especially attack my husband, but since then I have changed my attitude, but I have no intention of "disgust" or "respect" myself. Please don't forgive me for "stopping work for physiological reasons", fortunately.专此奉答，并请
I would like to respond specifically to this and request it著安。
Wearing peace.鲁迅。一九三三，一二，二八。
Lu Xun. 1933, 12, 28.

前记

前记

前记

Previously这一本小书里的，是从本年一月底起至五月中旬为止的寄给《申报》上的《自由谈》的杂感。
In this small book, there are miscellaneous feelings of "Free Talk" sent to the "Declaration" from the end of January to mid-May this year.我到上海以后，日报是看的，却从来没有投过稿，也没有想到过，并且也没有注意过日报的文艺栏，所以也不知道《申报》在什么时候开始有了《自由谈》，《自由谈》里是怎样的文字。大约是去年的年底罢，偶然遇见郁达夫先生，他告诉我说，《自由谈》的编辑新换了黎烈文先生了，但他才从法国回来，人地生疏，怕一时集不起稿子，要我去投几回稿。我就漫应之曰：那是可以的。
After I arrived in Shanghai, I read the daily newspaper, but I never submitted a manuscript, I never thought about it, and I didn't pay attention to the literary and art column of the daily newspaper, so I don't know when the "Declaration" began to have "Free Talk" and what kind of text was in "Free Talk". At about the end of last year, I met Mr. Yu Dafu by chance, and he told me that the editor of "Free Talk" had just changed Mr. Li Liewen, but he had just returned from France. I casually replied: That's fine.对于达夫先生的嘱咐，我是常常“漫应之曰：那是可以的”的。直白的说罢，我一向很回避创造社里的人物。这也不只因为历来特别的攻击我，甚而至于施行人身攻击的缘故，大半倒在他们的一副“创造”脸。虽然他们之中，后来有的化为隐士，有的化为富翁，有的化为实践的革命者，有的也化为奸细，而在“创造”这一面大纛之下的时候，却总是神气十足，好像连出汗打嚏，也全是“创造”似的。我和达夫先生见面得最早，脸上也看不出那么一种创造气，所以相遇之际，就随便谈谈；对于文学的意见，我们恐怕是不能一致的罢，然而所谈的大抵是空话。但这样的就熟识了，我有时要求他写一篇文章，他一定如约寄来，则他希望我做一点东西，我当然应该漫应曰可以。但应而至于“漫”，我已经懒散得多了。
For Mr. Duff's instructions, I often "casually answer: that's okay". To put it bluntly, I have always avoided the characters in the creation society. This is not only because they have always attacked me, but even because of their personal attacks, most of them have fallen on their "creative" faces. Although some of them later became hermits, some became rich people, some turned into practical revolutionaries, and some also became spies, but under the banner of "creation", they were always full of energy, as if even sweating and sneezing were all "creation". I met Mr. Duff at the earliest, and I couldn't see such a creative spirit on my face, so when we met, we talked casually; I am afraid that we cannot agree on the opinions of literature, but what we are talking about is probably empty words. But this is familiar, sometimes I ask him to write an article, he will definitely send it as promised, then he wants me to do something, of course I should say yes. But when it comes to "comic", I am already much lazy.但从此我就看看《自由谈》，不过仍然没有投稿。不久，听到了一个传闻，说《自由谈》的编辑者为了忙于事务，连他夫人的临蓐也不暇照管，送在医院里，她独自死掉了。几天之后，我偶然在《自由谈》里看见一篇文章，其中说的是每日使婴儿看看遗照，给他知道曾有这样一个孕育了他的母亲。我立刻省悟了这就是黎烈文先生的作品，拿起笔，想做一篇反对的文章，因为我向来的意见，是以为倘有慈母，或是幸福，然若生而失母，却也并非完全的不幸，他也许倒成为更加勇猛，更无挂碍的男儿的。但是也没有竟做，改为给《自由谈》的投稿了，这就是这本书里的第一篇《崇实》；又因为我旧日的笔名有时不能通用，便改题了“何家干”，有时也用“干”或“丁萌”。
But since then I have read "Free Talk", but I still haven't submitted. Soon, I heard a rumor that the editor of "Free Talk" was busy with affairs, and even his wife's mother was too busy to take care of it, so she was sent to the hospital, and she died alone. A few days later, I happened to see an article in "Free Talk", which said that the baby looked at the posthumous photo every day and let him know that there was such a mother who gave birth to him. I immediately realized that this was Mr. Li Liewen's work, and I picked up the pen and wanted to write an article against it, because my opinion was that if there was a loving mother, or happiness, but if he was born without a mother, it was not completely unfortunate, he might become a braver and more unhindered man. But I didn't do it, and instead submitted to "Free Talk", which is the first "Chongshi" in this book; And because my old pseudonym sometimes couldn't be used, I changed the title to "He Jiagan", and sometimes used "Gan" or "Ding Meng".这些短评，有的由于个人的感触，有的则出于时事的刺戟，但意思都极平常，说话也往往很晦涩，我知道《自由谈》并非同人杂志，“自由”更当然不过是一句反话，我决不想在这上面去驰骋的。我之所以投稿，一是为了朋友的交情，一则在给寂寞者以呐喊，也还是由于自己的老脾气。然而我的坏处，是在论时事不留面子，砭锢弊常取类型，而后者尤与时宜不合。盖写类型者，于坏处，恰如病理学上的图，假如是疮疽，则这图便是一切某疮某疽的标本，或和某甲的疮有些相像，或和某乙的疽有点相同。而见者不察，以为所画的只是他某甲的疮，无端侮辱，于是就必欲制你画者的死命了。例如我先前的论叭儿狗，原也泛无实指，都是自觉其有叭儿性的人们自来承认的。这要制死命的方法，是不论文章的是非，而先问作者是那一个；也就是别的不管，只要向作者施行人身攻击了。自然，其中也并不全是含愤的病人，有的倒是代打不平的侠客。总之，这种战术，是陈源教授的“鲁迅即教育部佥事周树人”开其端，事隔十年，大家早经忘却了，这回是王平陵先生告发于前，周木斋先生揭露于后，都是做着关于作者本身的文章，或则牵连而至于左翼文学者。此外为我所看见的还有好几篇，也都附在我的本文之后，以见上海有些所谓文学家的笔战，是怎样的东西，和我的短评本身，有什么关系。但另有几篇，是因为我的感想由此而起，特地并存以便读者的参考的。
These short comments, some of which are due to personal feelings, some are from the stabbing halberd of current affairs, but the meaning is very ordinary, and the words are often very obscure, I know that "Free Talk" is not a fan magazine, and "freedom" is of course just an irony, and I definitely don't want to gallop on it. The reason why I posted is for the friendship of friends, and the other is to shout at the lonely, or because of my old temper. However, my disadvantage is that I do not save face when discussing current affairs, and I often choose the type, and the latter is especially out of step with the times. If it is a sores, then this diagram is a specimen of all sores, or somewhat similar to a certain sore of a certain A, or a bit like a certain boil of a certain B. And the viewer doesn't notice, thinking that what he painted is just a sore on a certain piece of his armor, an unwarranted insult, so he will definitely want to control the death of your painter. For example, my previous discussion on the dog was originally not a real meaning, and it was admitted by people who felt that they had the character of a dog. The way to control this is to ask the author first, regardless of whether the article is right or wrong; That is, nothing else, as long as the author is physically attacked. Naturally, not all of them are angry patients, but some are chivalrous people who fight on behalf of others. In short, this tactic was started by Professor Chen Yuan's "Lu Xun is Zhou Shuren, the assistant minister of the Ministry of Education", and after ten years, everyone has long forgotten it, this time it was Mr. Wang Pingling who reported it before, and Mr. Zhou Muzhai exposed it later, all of which were doing articles about the author himself, or implicating left-wing literary scholars. In addition, there are several articles that I have seen, all of which are attached to my article, to see what kind of writing battles of some so-called writers in Shanghai are and what they have to do with my short comments themselves. But there are a few others, because my impressions arise from this, and they coexist for the reader's reference.我的投稿，平均每月八九篇，但到五月初，竟接连的不能发表了，我想，这是因为其时讳言时事而我的文字却常不免涉及时事的缘故。这禁止的是官方检查员，还是报馆总编辑呢，我不知道，也无须知道。现在便将那些都归在这一本里，其实是我所指摘，现在都已由事实来证明的了，我那时不过说得略早几天而已。是为序。
My submissions averaged eight or nine articles a month, but by the beginning of May, I couldn't publish them one after another, I think this was because I avoided talking about current affairs at that time, and my words often involved current affairs. Whether this is prohibited by the official inspector or the editor-in-chief of the newspaper, I don't know, and I don't need to know. Now I will put them all in this book, which is actually my criticism, and now it has been proven by facts, and I only said it a few days earlier. This is the preface.一九三三年七月十九夜，于上海寓庐，鲁迅记。

Watch the fight我们中国人总喜欢说自己爱和平，但其实，是爱斗争的，爱看别的东西斗争，也爱看自己们斗争。
We Chinese always like to say that we love peace, but in fact, we love to fight, we love to see other things fight, and we also love to watch ourselves struggle.最普通的是斗鸡，斗蟋蟀，南方有斗黄头鸟，斗画眉鸟，北方有斗鹌鹑，一群闲人们围着呆看，还因此赌输赢。古时候有斗鱼，现在变把戏的会使跳蚤打架。看今年的《东方杂志》，才知道金华又有斗牛，不过和西班牙却两样的，西班牙是人和牛斗，我们是使牛和牛斗。
The most common is cockfighting, cricket fighting, there are yellow-headed birds and thrushes in the south, and quails in the north. In ancient times, there were betta fish, but now the trick will make fleas fight. Looking at this year's "Oriental Magazine", I learned that Jinhua has bullfights again, but it is different from Spain, Spain is fighting with people, and we are making cattle and bulls.任他们斗争着，自己不与斗，只是看。
Let them fight, don't fight with them, just watch.军阀们只管自己斗争着，人民不与闻，只是看。
The warlords only care about their own struggles, and the people don't hear about it, they just watch.然而军阀们也不是自己亲身在斗争，是使兵士们相斗争，所以频年恶战，而头儿个个终于是好好的，忽而误会消释了，忽而杯酒言欢了，忽而共同御侮了，忽而立誓报国了，忽而……。不消说，忽而自然不免又打起来了。
However, the warlords were not fighting themselves, but the soldiers were fighting against each other, so they fought fiercely for many years, and the leaders were finally good, suddenly the misunderstanding was resolved, suddenly a glass of wine and talking, suddenly resisting insults together, suddenly swearing to serve the country, and suddenly ....... Needless to say, suddenly and naturally it was inevitable to fight again.然而人民一任他们玩把戏，只是看。
However, the people let them play tricks, just watching.但我们的斗士，只有对于外敌却是两样的：近的，是“不抵抗”，远的，是“负弩前驱”云。
But our fighters are only two kinds of foreign enemies: the near ones are "non-resisting", and the far ones are the "crossbow vanguard".“不抵抗”在字面上已经说得明明白白。“负弩前驱”呢，弩机的制度早已失传了，必须待考古学家研究出来，制造起来，然后能够负，然后能够前驱。
"Non-resistance" is already very clear in the literal sense. As for the "negative crossbow precursor", the system of the crossbow machine has long been lost, and it must be studied and manufactured by archaeologists, and then it can be negative, and then it can be driven.还是留着国产的兵士和现买的军火，自己斗争下去罢。中国的人口多得很，暂时总有一些孑遗在看着的。但自然，倘要这样，则对于外敌，就一定非“爱和平”不可。
It's better to keep domestic soldiers and ready-bought arms and fight by yourself. China has a large population, and there are always some remnants watching for the time being. But naturally, if this is the case, then for foreign enemies, it must be "love peace".一月二十四日。

The defense of escape古时候，做女人大晦气，一举一动，都是错的，这个也骂，那个也骂。现在这晦气落在学生头上了，进也挨骂，退也挨骂。

Chongshi事实常没有字面这么好看。
Facts are often not as good as they sound.例如这《自由谈》，其实是不自由的，现在叫作《自由谈》，总算我们是这么自由地在这里谈着。

If it is said that because the antiquities are very old and unique, they are treasures and should be moved away quickly. This certainly makes sense. But we don't have two Pekings, and that place is older than all the existing antiquities. Yu was a worm, let's not talk about it at that time, but as for the Shang and Zhou dynasties, this place did already exist. Why leave it alone and move the antiquities alone? The pros and cons of electricity日本幕府时代，曾大杀基督教徒，刑罚很凶，但不准发表，世无知者。到近几年，乃出版当时的文献不少。曾见《切利支丹殉教记》，其中记有拷问教徒的情形，或牵到温泉旁边，用热汤浇身；或周围生火，慢慢的烤炙，这本是“火刑”，但主管者却将火移远，改死刑为虐杀了。
During the Japanese shogunate era, Christians were killed, and the punishment was very severe, but it was not allowed to be published, and no one in the world knew about it. In recent years, many documents have been published at that time. I have seen the "Martyrdom of Celizhdan", which records the torture of believers, or the torture of believers, or the fact that they were taken to the hot springs and doused with hot water; Or light a fire around and slowly roast it, which was originally "burning at the stake", but the supervisor moved the fire away and changed the death penalty to torture.中国还有更残酷的。唐人说部中曾有记载，一县官拷问犯人，四周用火遥焙，口渴，就给他喝酱醋，这是比日本更进一步的办法。现在官厅拷问嫌疑犯，有用辣椒煎汁灌入鼻孔去的，似乎就是唐朝遗下的方法，或则是古今英雄，所见略同。曾见一个囚在反省院里的青年的信，说先前身受此刑，苦痛不堪，辣汁流入肺脏及心，已成不治之症，即释放亦不免于死云云。此人是陆军学生，不明内脏构造，其实倒挂灌鼻，可以由气管流入肺中，引起致死之病，却不能进入心中；大约当时因在苦楚中，知觉瞀乱，遂疑为已到心脏了。
China has even more cruelty. The Tang people said that there was a record in the Ministry that a county official tortured a prisoner, roasted it with fire all around, and when he was thirsty, he gave him soy sauce and vinegar, which was a further method than Japan. Now the official office tortures suspects and pours chili decoction into their nostrils, which seems to be the method left by the Tang Dynasty, or the heroes of ancient and modern times, and the view is similar. I once saw a letter from a young man who was imprisoned in a reflection hospital, saying that he had suffered this punishment before, and the pain was unbearable, and the spicy juice flowed into his lungs and heart, which had become an incurable disease, and he would die even if he was released. This person is an army student, unaware of the structure of internal organs, in fact, the nose is hung upside down, which can flow into the lungs from the trachea, causing fatal diseases, but cannot enter the heart; At that time, because he was in agony, his consciousness was confused, and he suspected that he had reached his heart.但现在之所谓文明人所造的刑具，残酷又超出于此种方法万万。上海有电刑，一上，即遍身痛楚欲裂，遂昏去，少顷又醒，则又受刑。闻曾有连受七八次者，即幸而免死，亦从此牙齿皆摇动，神经亦变钝，不能复原。前年纪念爱迪生，许多人赞颂电报电话之有利于人，却没有想到同是一电，而有人得到这样的大害，福人用电气疗病，美容，而被压迫者却以此受苦，丧命也。
But the torture instruments made by so-called civilized people today are cruel and beyond this method. In Shanghai, there was an electric torture; as soon as he went up, he was in pain all over his body, so he fainted, and after a while, he woke up again and was tortured again. I heard that there were people who had been subjected to it seven or eight times in a row, and even if they were lucky enough to avoid death, their teeth would shake and their nerves would become dull, making it impossible to recover. In memory of Edison the year before last, many people praised the telegraph and telephone for their benefit, but they did not expect that they were the same electricity, and some people got such great harm, and the blessed people used electricity to treat diseases and beautify them, while the oppressed suffered and lost their lives.外国用火药制造子弹御敌，中国却用它做爆竹敬神；外国用罗盘针航海，中国却用它看风水；外国用鸦片医病，中国却拿来当饭吃。同是一种东西，而中外用法之不同有如此，盖不但电气而已。
Foreign countries use gunpowder to make bullets to defend against enemies, but China uses it to make firecrackers to worship the gods; Foreign countries use the compass needle to sail, but China uses it to read feng shui; Foreign countries use opium to treat diseases, but China uses it as food. The same thing, but the differences in usage between China and abroad are so great, probably not just electrical.一月三十一日。

航空救国三愿

航空救国三愿

航空救国三愿

Aviation saves the country with three wishes现在各色的人们大喊着各种的救国，好像大家突然爱国了似的。其实不然，本来就是这样，在这样地救国的，不过现在喊了出来罢了。
Now people of all kinds are shouting all kinds of national salvation, as if everyone has suddenly become patriotic. In fact, it was originally like this, saving the country like this, but now it is just shouted out.所以银行家说贮蓄救国，卖稿子的说文学救国，画画儿的说艺术救国，爱跳舞的说寓救国于娱乐之中，还有，据烟草公司说，则就是吸吸马占山将军牌香烟，也未始非救国之一道云。
Therefore, bankers say that saving savings to save the country, those who sell manuscripts say that literature saves the country, those who paint say that art saves the country, those who love to dance say that they save the country in entertainment, and according to the tobacco company, it is to smoke Ma Zhanshan's general brand cigarettes, which is not a way to save the country.这各种救国，是像先前原已实行过来一样，此后也要实行下去的，决不至于五分钟。
These kinds of national salvation are the same as those that have been implemented before, and they will continue to be implemented in the future, and they will never last five minutes.只有航空救国较为别致，是应该刮目相看的，那将来也很难预测，原因是在主张的人们自己大概不是飞行家。
Only aviation to save the country is more unique and should be impressed, and it is difficult to predict the future, because the people who are advocating it are probably not aviators themselves.那么，我们不妨预先说出一点愿望来。

I heard that there was also a team in Guangzhou, and the ladies also embroidered poems on their shirts to give the soldiers a heroic color. 不通两种

不通两种

不通两种

There are not two types人们每当批评文章的时候，凡是国文教员式的人，大概是着眼于“通”或“不通”，《中学生》杂志上还为此设立了病院。然而做中国文其实是很不容易“通”的，高手如太史公司马迁，倘将他的文章推敲起来，无论从文字，文法，修辞的任何一种立场去看，都可以发见“不通”的处所。
Whenever people criticize articles, all Chinese teacher-style people probably focus on "understanding" or "not understanding", and the magazine "Middle School Students" has set up a hospital for this. However, it is not easy to "understand" Chinese literature, and masters such as Ma Qian of Taishi Company, if you scrutinize his articles, no matter from any position of text, grammar, and rhetoric, you can find the place where you "don't understand".不过现在不说这些；要说的只是在笼统的一句“不通”之中，还可由原因而分为几种。大概的说，就是：有作者本来还没有通的，也有本可以通，而因了种种关系，不敢通，或不愿通的。
But let's not talk about that now; What I want to say is that in the general sentence "incomprehensible", it can also be divided into several types according to the reasons. Roughly speaking, there are authors who have not yet understood, and there are those who can understand, but due to various relationships, they dare not understand or are unwilling to understand.例如去年十月三十一日《大晚报》的记载“江都清赋风潮”，在《乡民二度兴波作浪》这一个巧妙的题目之下，述陈友亮之死云：
For example, on October 31 last year, the "Evening News" recorded "Jiangdu Qingfu Trend", under the ingenious title of "The Villagers Rise Waves for the Second Time", describing Chen Youliang's death:“陈友亮见官方军警中，有携手枪之刘金发，竟欲夺刘之手枪，当被子弹出膛，饮弹而毙，警察队亦开空枪一排，乡民始后退。……”
Chen Youliang saw that among the official military and police, there was Liu Jinfa who was holding a gun, and he wanted to take Liu's pistol, but when he was ejected by a bullet, he drank the bullet and died, and the police team also fired a row of empty guns, and the villagers began to retreat. ……”“军警”上面不必加上“官方”二字之类的费话，这里也且不说。最古怪的是子弹竟被写得好像活物，会自己飞出膛来似的。但因此而累得下文的“亦”字不通了。必须将上文改作“当被击毙”，才妥。倘要保存上文，则将末两句改为“警察队空枪亦一齐发声，乡民始后退”，这才铢两悉称，和军警都毫无关系。——虽然文理总未免有点希奇。
There is no need to add the word "official" to "military police", and I won't talk about it here. The strangest thing is that the bullet is written as if it were a living creature and would fly out of the chamber by itself. But because of this, the word "also" below is not understandable. The above must be changed to "when killed". If the above is to be saved, the last two sentences should be changed to "The police team's empty guns also spoke together, and the villagers began to retreat", which is said to have nothing to do with the military and police. ——Although the arts and sciences are always a bit strange.现在，这样的希奇文章，常常在刊物上出现。不过其实也并非作者的不通，大抵倒是恐怕“不准通”，因而先就“不敢通”了的缘故。头等聪明人不谈这些，就成了“为艺术的艺术”家；次等聪明人竭力用种种法，来粉饰这不通，就成了“民族主义文学”者，但两者是都属于自己“不愿通”，即“不肯通”这一类里的。
Nowadays, such strange articles often appear in publications. However, in fact, it is not that the author does not understand, but probably because he is afraid that he is "not allowed to understand", so he "does not dare to understand" first. The first class of smart people do not talk about this, and become "art for art"; Inferior intelligent people try their best to whitewash this incomprehension, and become "nationalist literature", but both belong to their own category of "unwillingness", that is, "refusal to understand".二月三日。
February 3rd.

【因此引起的通论】：[General theory caused by this]: “最通的”文艺"The most popular" literature and art
王平陵
King Pingling鲁迅先生最近常常用何家干的笔名，在黎烈文主编的《申报》的《自由谈》，发表不到五百字长的短文。好久不看见他老先生的文了，那种富于幽默性的讽刺的味儿，在中国的作家之林，当然还没有人能超过鲁迅先生。不过，听说现在的鲁迅先生已跑到十字街头，站在革命的队伍里去了。那么，像他这种有闲阶级的幽默的作风，严格言之，实在不革命。我以为也应该转变一下才是！譬如：鲁迅先生不喜欢第三种人，讨厌民族主义的文艺，他尽可痛快地直说，何必装腔做势，吞吞吐吐，打这么许多湾儿。在他最近所处的环境，自然是除了那些恭颂苏联德政的献词以外，便没有更通的文艺的。他认为第三种人不谈这些，是比较最聪明的人；民族主义文艺者故意找出理由来文饰自己的不通，是比较次聪明的人。其言可谓尽深刻恶毒之能事。不过，现在最通的文艺，是不是仅有那些对苏联当局摇尾求媚的献词，不免还是疑问。如果先生们真是为着解放劳苦大众而呐喊，犹可说也；假使，仅仅是为着个人的出路，故意制造一块容易招摇的金字商标，以资号召而已。那么，我就看不出先生们的苦心孤行，比到被你们所不齿的第三种人，以及民族主义文艺者，究竟是高多少。
Recently, Mr. Lu Xun often used the pseudonym He Jiagan to publish short articles of less than 500 words in the "Free Talk" edited by Li Liewen. I haven't seen his old man's article for a long time, and the taste of humorous irony, in the forest of Chinese writers, of course, no one can surpass Mr. Lu Xun. However, I heard that Mr. Lu Xun has now run to the cross street and stood in the ranks of the revolution. Then, the humorous style of the leisure class like his, strictly speaking, is really not revolutionary. I thought I should change it too! For example: Mr. Lu Xun does not like the third type of people, hates nationalist literature and art, and he can say happily, why pretend, hesitate, and play so many bays. In his recent environment, naturally, there was no more literary and artistic than those dedications praising the virtue of the Soviet Union. He believes that the third type of person is the smartest person without talking about these; Nationalist writers and artists deliberately find reasons to cover up their incomprehensibility, and they are relatively sub-intelligent people. His words can be said to be a deep and vicious thing. However, it is still questionable whether the most popular literature and art now are only those dedications that wagged their tails to the Soviet authorities. If gentlemen really shout for the liberation of the toiling masses, it can still be said; If it is just for the sake of personal outlet, deliberately create a gold trademark that is easy to ostentatious, in order to call for it. Then, I can't see how much higher the gentlemen's painstaking actions are compared to the third kind of people you despise and the nationalist writers and artists.其实，先生们个人的生活，由我看来，并不比到被你们痛骂的小资作家更穷苦些。当然，鲁迅先生是例外，大多数的所谓革命的作家，听说，常常在上海的大跳舞场，拉斐花园里，可以遇见他们伴着娇美的爱侣，一面喝香槟，一面吃朱古力，兴高采烈地跳着狐步舞，倦舞意懒，乘着雪亮的汽车，奔赴预定的香巢，度他们真个消魂的生活。明天起来，写工人呵！斗争呵！之类的东西，拿去向书贾们所办的刊物换取稿费，到晚上，照样是生活在红绿的灯光下，沉醉着，欢唱着，热爱着。像这种优裕的生活，我不懂先生们还要叫什么苦，喊什么冤，你们的猫哭耗子的仁慈，是不是能博得劳苦大众的同情，也许，在先生们自己都不免是绝大的疑问吧！
In fact, the personal life of the gentlemen, in my opinion, is no poorer than the petty bourgeois writers who are scolded by you. Of course, Mr. Lu Xun is an exception, most of the so-called revolutionary writers, I have heard that they can often be seen in Shanghai's big dance hall, in the Raphael Garden, you can meet them with their beautiful lovers, drinking champagne, eating chocolate, happily dancing foxtrot, tired of dancing, riding in a snowy car, rushing to the predetermined incense nest, and living their real soul-stuffing life. Get up tomorrow and write about the workers! Fight! At night, they still live under the red and green lights, intoxicated, singing, and loving. I don't know what kind of suffering and injustice the gentlemen have to cry for, whether the kindness of your cat crying mouse can win the sympathy of the toiling masses, perhaps, in the gentlemen themselves, it is a great question!如果中国人不能从文化的本身上做一点基础的工夫，就这样大家空喊一阵口号，糊闹一阵，我想，把世界上无论那种最新颖最时髦的东西拿到中国来，都是毫无用处。我们承认现在的苏俄，确实是有了他相当的成功，但，这不是偶然。他们从前所遗留下来的一部分文化的遗产，是多么丰富，我们回溯到十月革命以前的俄国文学，音乐，美术，哲学，科学，那一件不是已经到达国际文化的水准。他们有了这些充实的根基，才能产生现在这些学有根蒂的领袖。我们仅仅渴慕人家的成功而不知道努力文化的根本的建树，再等十年百年，乃至千年万年，中国还是这样，也许比现在更坏。
If the Chinese can't do a little basic work from the culture itself, and everyone shouts slogans and confuses for a while, I think it is useless to bring the most novel and fashionable things in the world to China. We admit that the current Soviet Russia has indeed achieved considerable success with him, but this is not accidental. How rich is the cultural heritage of some of the cultures they left behind, we trace back to Russian literature, music, art, philosophy, and science before the October Revolution, which has not reached the level of international culture. With these substantial foundations, they can produce these leaders who have learned the roots of today. We only yearn for the success of others and do not know the fundamental achievements of the culture of hard work, and if we wait for ten years, a hundred years, or even a thousand years, China will still be like this, perhaps worse than it is now.不错，中国的文化运动，也已有二十年的历史了。但是，在这二十年中，在文化上究竟收获到什么。欧美的名著，在中国是否能有一册比较可靠的译本，文艺上的各种派别，各种主义，我们是否都拿得出一种代表作，其他如科学上的发明，思想上的创造，是否能有一种值得我们记忆。唉！中国的文化低落到这步田地，还谈得到什么呢！
Yes, China's cultural movement has a history of 20 years. However, what have been gained culturally in these two decades? Whether there is a more reliable translation of European and American masterpieces in China, whether we can get a masterpiece of various schools and isms in literature and art, and whether there is a kind of masterpiece in others, such as scientific inventions and ideological creations, can there be one worthy of our memory. Alas! China's culture has declined to this point, what else can we talk about!要是中国的文艺工作者，如不能从今天起，大家立誓做一番基本的工夫，多多地转运一些文艺的粮食，多多地树艺一些文艺的种子，我敢断言：在现代的中国，决不会产生“最通的”文艺的。
If Chinese literary and artistic workers cannot vow to do some basic work from today onwards, transfer more literary and artistic grain, and plant more literary and artistic seeds, I dare to assert that in modern China, there will never be the "most popular" literary and artistic ones.二月二十日《武汉日报》的《文艺周刊》。

赌咒

赌咒

赌咒

swear“天诛地灭，男盗女娼”——是中国人赌咒的经典，几乎像诗云子曰一样。现在的宣誓，“誓杀敌，誓死抵抗，誓……”似乎不用这种成语了。
"Heaven punishes the earth, men steal and women prostitutes" - it is a classic of Chinese gambling curses, almost like the poem Yunzi said. The current oath, "swear to kill the enemy, swear to resist to the death, swear to ......" does not seem to use this idiom.但是，赌咒的实质还是一样，总之是信不得。他明知道天不见得来诛他，地也不见得来灭他，现在连人参都“科学化地”含起电气来了，难道“天地”还不科学化么！至于男盗和女娼，那是非但无害，而且有益：男盗——可以多刮几层地皮，女娼——可以多弄几个“裙带官儿”的位置。
However, the essence of the gambling curse is still the same, in short, it is unbelievable. He knows that the sky may not come to kill him, and the earth may not come to destroy him, and now even the ginseng has "scientifically" contained electricity, isn't "heaven and earth" scientific? As for male thieves and female prostitutes, they are not only harmless, but also beneficial: male thieves - can scrape a few more layers of land, and female prostitutes - can get a few more "nepotism" positions.我的老朋友说：你这个“盗”和“娼”的解释都不是古义。我回答说——你知道现在是什么时代！现在是盗也摩登，娼也摩登，所以赌咒也摩登，变成宣誓了。
My old friend said: Your explanation of "thief" and "prostitute" is not an ancient meaning. I replied – you know what era it is! Now thieves are modern, prostitutes are modern, so gambling curses are also modern, and they have become oaths.二月九日。

战略关系

战略关系

战略关系

Strategic relationships首都《救国日报》上有句名言：
There is a famous saying in the capital's "National Salvation Daily":“浸使为战略关系，须暂时放弃北平，以便引敌深入……应严厉责成张学良，以武力制止反对运动，虽流血亦所不辞。”（见《上海日报》二月九日转载。）
"For the sake of strategic relations, it is necessary to temporarily abandon Peiping in order to lure the enemy deeper...... Zhang Xueliang should be severely instructed to stop the opposition movement by force, even if it means bloodshed. (See Shanghai Daily, February 9.) ）虽流血亦所不辞！勇敢哉战略大家也！
Even if it is bloodshed, it will not be rejected! Brave strategists!血的确流过不少，正在流的更不少，将要流的还不知道有多多少少。这都是反对运动者的血。为着什么？为着战略关系。
A lot of blood has indeed flowed, and a lot is being shed, and I don't know how much will be shed. This is all the blood of the opposition activists. Why? For strategic relationships.战略家在去年上海打仗的时候，曾经说：“为战略关系，退守第二道防线”，这样就退兵；过了两天又说，为战略关系，“如日军不向我军射击，则我军不得开枪，着士兵一体遵照”，这样就停战。此后，“第二道防线”消失，上海和议开始，谈判，签字，完结。那时候，大概为着战略关系也曾经见过血；这是军机大事，小民不得而知，——至于亲自流过血的虽然知道，他们又已经没有了舌头。究竟那时候的敌人为什么没有“被诱深入”？
When the strategist fought in Shanghai last year, he once said: "For strategic relations, retreat to the second line of defense", so that the troops will retreat; Two days later, he said that for the sake of strategic relations, "if the Japanese army does not shoot at our army, our army shall not shoot, and the soldiers will follow it", so that the war will cease. After that, the "second line of defense" disappeared, and the Shanghai peace negotiations began, negotiated, signed, and ended. At that time, I probably saw blood for strategic relationships; This is a major military event, and the common people do not know,—— as for those who have shed blood in person, although they know it, they have no tongues. Why didn't the enemy at that time "be lured deep"?现在我们知道了：那次敌人所以没有“被诱深入”者，决不是当时战略家的手段太不高明，也不是完全由于反对运动者的血流得“太少”，而另外还有个原因：原来英国从中调停——暗地里和日本有了谅解，说是日本呀，你们的军队暂时退出上海，我们英国更进一步来帮你的忙，使满洲国不至于被国联否认，——这就是现在国联的什么什么草案，什么什么委员的态度。这其实是说，你不要在这里深入，——这里是有赃大家分，——你先到北方去深入再说。深入还是要深入，不过地点暂时不同。
Now we know: the reason why the enemy was not "lured deeper" that time was by no means because the strategists at that time were too unclever, nor was it entirely because the blood of the opposition activists was "too little", but there was another reason: it turned out that Britain mediated - secretly had an understanding with Japan, saying that it was Japan, your army temporarily withdrew from Shanghai, and we Britain went further to help you, so that Manchukuo would not be denied by the League of Nations,—— this is the attitude of the current draft and members of the League of Nations. This actually means that you don't go deep here,—— there are stolen goods here,—— you go to the north first. It is still necessary to go deeper, but the location is temporarily different.因此，“诱敌深入北平”的战略目前就需要了。流血自然又要多流几次。
Therefore, the strategy of "luring the enemy deep into Peking" is currently needed. Bleeding naturally has to be shed several times.其实，现在一切准备停当，行都陪都色色俱全，文化古物，和大学生，也已经各自乔迁。无论是黄面孔，白面孔，新大陆，旧大陆的敌人，无论这些敌人要深入到什么地方，都请深入罢。至于怕有什么反对运动，那我们的战略家：“虽流血亦所不辞”！放心，放心。
In fact, now everything is ready to stop, and the travel is all colorful, cultural antiquities, and college students have also moved away. Whether it is the yellow face, the white face, the enemies of the New World, or the Old World, no matter where these enemies want to go, please go deeper. As for the fear of any opposition movement, then our strategist: "I will not hesitate even if I shed blood"! Don't worry, don't worry.二月九日。

周敬侪大人先生们把“故宫文物”看得和命（当然不是小百姓的命）一般坚决南迁，无非因为“古物”价值不止“连城”，并且容易搬动，容易变钱的原故，这也值得你们大惊小怪，冷嘲热讽！我正这样想着的时候，居然从首都一家报纸上见到赞成“古物南迁”的社论；并且建议“武力制止反对”，“流血在所不辞”，请求政府“保持威信”，“贯彻政策”！这样的宏词高论，我实在不忍使它湮没无闻，因特不辞辛苦，抄录出来，献给大众：
The adults and gentlemen regard the "Forbidden City cultural relics" as fate (of course, not the lives of the common people) and resolutely move south, just because the value of "antiquities" is not only "Liancheng", but also easy to move and easy to turn into money, which is also worthy of your fuss and cynicism! While I was thinking this, I actually saw an editorial in a newspaper in the capital in favor of "antiquities moving south"; He also suggested "stopping opposition by force", "bloodshed is unavoidable", and requesting the government to "maintain prestige" and "implement policies"! I really can't bear to make it obscured, so I took the trouble to copy it and dedicate it to the public:“……北平各团体之反对古物南迁，为有害北平将来之繁荣，此种自私自利完全蔑视国家利益之理由，北平各团体竟敢说出，吾人殊服其厚颜无耻，彼等只为北平之繁荣，必须以数千年古物冒全被敌人劫夺而去之大危险，所见未免太小，使政府为战略关系，须暂时放弃北平，以便引敌深入，聚而歼之，则古物必被敌人劫夺而去，试问将来北平之繁荣何由维持，故不如先行迁移，俟打倒日本，北平安如泰山后，再行迁回，北平各团体自私自利，固可恶可耻，其无远虑，亦可怜也，其反对迁移之又一理由，则谓政府应先顾全土地，此言似是而实非，盖放弃一部分土地供敌人一时之占领，以歼灭敌人，然后再行恢复，古今中外，其例甚多，如一八一二年之役，俄人不但放弃莫斯科，且将莫斯科烧毁，以困拿破仑，欧战时，比利时，塞尔维亚，皆放弃全部领土，供敌人蹂躏，卒将强德击破，盖领土被占，只须不与敌人媾和，签字于割让条约，则敌人固无如该土何，至于故宫古物，若不迁移，设不幸北平被敌人占领，将古物劫夺而去，试问中国将何法以恢复之，行见中国文明结晶，供敌人战利品，可耻孰甚，……最后吾人奉告政府，政府迁移古物之政策，既已决定，则不论遇如何阻碍，应求其贯彻，若一经无见识无远虑之群愚反对，即行中止，政府威信何在，故吾主张严责张学良，使以武力制止反对运动，若不得已，虽流血亦所不辞……”
“…… The opposition of the Peking groups to the south of the antiquities, in order to harm the future prosperity of Peiping, this kind of selfishness and self-interest completely despise the reason for the national interests, the Peking groups dare to say that we are very convinced of their brazenness, they are only for the prosperity of Peiping, they must risk the great danger of thousands of years of antiquities being robbed by the enemy, what they see is too small, so that the government is a strategic relationship, must temporarily abandon Peking, in order to lure the enemy deeper, gather and annihilate it, then the antiquities will be robbed by the enemy, and ask how the prosperity of Peiping will be maintained in the future, so it is better to move first. Another reason for their opposition to the relocation is that the government should first take care of the whole land, which is plausible but not true, because they gave up part of the land for the enemy's temporary occupation to annihilate the enemy, and then recovered, ancient and modern China and abroad, there are many examples, such as the Battle of 1812, the Russians not only abandoned Moscow, but also burned Moscow to trap Napoleon, during the European War, Belgium, Serbia, All give up all the territory for the enemy to ravage, and finally break the strong virtue, because the territory is occupied, as long as it does not make peace with the enemy and signs the cession treaty, then the enemy has nothing to do with the land, as for the antiquities of the Forbidden City, if they are not moved, if Peiping is unfortunately occupied by the enemy and the antiquities are robbed, I would like to ask China what method to restore it, and see the crystallization of Chinese civilization and provide the enemy's spoils, which is shameful,...... Finally, I advise the government that the government's policy of relocating antiquities has been decided, so no matter how it is hindered, it should be implemented, and if it is opposed by a group of ignorant people who have no knowledge and foresight, it will be suspended, where is the prestige of the government, so I advocate strictly reprimanding Zhang Xueliang to stop the opposition movement by force, and if it is necessary, even if it is bloody, I will not hesitate......二月十三日，《申报》《自由谈》。February 13, "Declaration" and "Free Talk".

Praise Xiao萧伯纳未到中国之前，《大晚报》希望日本在华北的军事行动会因此而暂行停止，呼之曰“和平老翁”。
Before George Bernard Shaw arrived in China, the "Evening News" hoped that Japan's military operations in North China would be temporarily stopped because of this, calling him the "Old Man of Peace".萧伯纳既到香港之后，各报由“路透电”译出他对青年们的谈话，题之曰“宣传共产”。
After George Bernard Shaw arrived in Hong Kong, the newspapers translated his conversation with young people by Reuters, entitled "Propaganda of Communism".萧伯纳“语路透访员曰，君甚不像华人，萧并以中国报界中人全无一人访之为异，问曰，彼等其幼稚至于未识余乎？”（十一日路透电）
萧伯纳“语路透访员曰，君甚不像华人，萧并以中国报界中人全无一人访之为异，问曰，彼等其幼稚至于未识余乎？”（十一日路透电）我们其实是老练的，我们很知道香港总督的德政，上海工部局的章程，要人的谁和谁是亲友，谁和谁是仇雠，谁的太太的生日是那一天，爱吃的是什么。但对于萧，——惜哉，就是作品的译本也只有三四种。
We are actually sophisticated, we know very well the virtue of the governor of Hong Kong, the constitution of the Shanghai Ministry of Works, who is a relative and friend, who is an enemy, whose wife's birthday is that day, and what they love to eat. But for Xiao ,—— Xi, there are only three or four translations of the work.所以我们不能识他在欧洲大战以前和以后的思想，也不能深识他游历苏联以后的思想。但只就十四日香港“路透电”所传，在香港大学对学生说的“如汝在二十岁时不为赤色革命家，则在五十岁时将成不可能之僵石，汝欲在二十岁时成一赤色革命家，则汝可得在四十岁时不致落伍之机会”的话，就知道他的伟大。
Therefore, we cannot know his thoughts before and after the European War, nor can we know his thoughts after his trip to the Soviet Union. But only according to Hong Kong's "Reuters" on the 14th, the University of Hong Kong said to students, "If you are not a red revolutionary at the age of 20, you will become an impossible stone at the age of 50, and if you want to become a red revolutionary at the age of 20, you will not have the opportunity to fall behind at the age of 40".但我所谓伟大的，并不在他要令人成为赤色革命家，因为我们有“特别国情”，不必赤色，只要汝今天成为革命家，明天汝就失掉了性命，无从到四十岁。我所谓伟大的，是他竟替我们二十岁的青年，想到了四五十岁的时候，而且并不离开了现在。
But what I call greatness is not that he wants people to become red revolutionaries, because we have "special national conditions", and there is no need to be red, as long as you become a revolutionary today, tomorrow you will lose your life, and you will not be able to reach the age of forty. What I call great is that he actually thought about our twenty-year-old youth, when he was forty or fifty years old, and did not leave the present.阔人们会搬财产进外国银行，坐飞机离开中国地面，或者是想到明天的罢；“政如飘风，民如野鹿”，穷人们可简直连明天也不能想了，况且也不准想，不敢想。
Broad people will move their property into foreign banks, take planes out of China, or think about tomorrow; "The government is like a whirlwind, and the people are like wild deer", the poor people can't even think about tomorrow, let alone think about it, and they dare not think about it.又何况二十年，三十年之后呢？这问题极平常，然而是伟大的。
Not to mention twenty or thirty years later? This is a very common problem, yet great.此之所以为萧伯纳！
This is why George Bernard Shaw is here!二月十五日。

【又招恼了大主笔】：[Annoyed the chief writer again]: 萧伯纳究竟不凡 Shaw is extraordinary
《大晚报》社论
"Big Evening News" editorial“你们批评英国人做事，觉得没有一件事怎样的好，也没有一件事怎样的坏；可是你们总找不出那一件事给英国人做坏了。他做事多有主义的。他要打你，他提倡爱国主义来；他要抢你，他提出公事公办的主义；他要奴役你，他提出帝国主义大道理；他要欺侮你，他又有英雄主义的大道理；他拥护国王，有忠君爱国的主义，可是他要斫掉国王的头，又有共和主义的道理。他的格言是责任；可是他总不忘记一个国家的责任与利益发生了冲突就要不得了。”
"You criticize the British for doing things, thinking that nothing is good or bad; But you can't find that one thing that has been done badly to the British. He is very principled in doing things. He wants to beat you, he advocates patriotism; He wants to rob you, he puts forward the principle of public affairs; He wants to enslave you, he puts forward the great principle of imperialism; He wants to bully you, and he has the great principle of heroism; He supports the king and has the doctrine of loyalty to the king and patriotism, but he wants to cut off the king's head, and he has the principle of republicanism. His maxim is responsibility; But he never forgot that a country's responsibilities and interests are in conflict. ”这是萧伯纳老先生在《命运之人》中批评英国人的尖刻语。我们举这一个例来介绍萧先生，要读者认识大伟人之所以伟大，也自有其秘诀在。这样子的冷箭，充满在萧氏的作品中，令受者难堪，听者痛快，于是萧先生的名言警句，家传户诵，而一代文豪也确定了他的伟大。
This is Mr. Shaw's scathing criticism of the British in "The Man of Destiny". We will take this example to introduce Mr. Xiao, so that readers can understand the reason why great people are great, and they also have their own secrets. Such cold arrows are full of Xiao's works, embarrassing the recipient and happy to the listener, so Mr. Xiao's famous aphorisms are recited from family to family, and a generation of literary heroes also determined his greatness.借主义，成大名，这是现代学者一时的风尚，萧先生有嘴说英国人，可惜没有眼估量自己。我们知道萧先生是泛平主义的先进，终身拥护这渐进社会主义，他的戏剧，小说，批评，散文中充塞着这种主义的宣传品，萧先生之于社会主义，可说是个彻头彻尾的忠实信徒。然而，我们又知道，萧先生是铢锱必较的积产专家，是反对慈善事业最力的理论家，结果，他坐拥着百万巨资面团团早成了个富家翁。萧先生唱着平均资产的高调，为被压迫的劳工鸣不平，向寄生物性质的资产家冷嘲热讽，因此而赢得全民众的同情，一书出版，大家抢着买，一剧登场，一百多场做下去，不愁没有人看，于是萧先生坐在提倡共产主义的安乐椅里，笑嘻嘻地自鸣得意，借主义以成名，挂羊头卖狗肉的戏法，究竟巧妙无穷。
Borrowing doctrine and becoming famous is a fashion of modern scholars, Mr. Xiao has a mouth to say that he is British, but unfortunately he has no eyes to measure himself. We know that Mr. Xiao is an advanced of pan-flatteningism, a lifelong supporter of this progressive socialism, and his plays, novels, criticisms, and prose are full of propaganda materials for this doctrine. However, we also know that Mr. Xiao is an expert in accumulating wealth and the most powerful theorist against philanthropy, and as a result, he has become a rich man with a million-dollar dough ball. Mr. Xiao sang the high-profile of the average asset, complained about the oppressed laborers, and sneered at the parasitic bourgeoisie, so he won the sympathy of the whole people, and a book was published, everyone rushed to buy it, a play appeared, and more than a hundred performances were done, without worrying that no one would watch, so Mr. Xiao sat in the easy chair advocating communism, smiling and smug, borrowing doctrine to become famous, and hanging sheep's heads to sell dog meat, which was infinitely ingenious.现在，萧先生功成名就，到我们穷苦的中国来玩玩了。多谢他提携后进的热诚，在香港告诉我们学生道：“二十岁不为赤色革命家，五十岁要成僵石；二十岁做了赤色革命家，四十岁可不致落伍。”原来做赤色革命家的原因，只为自己怕做僵石，怕落伍而已；主义本身的价值如何，本来与个人的前途没有多大关系；我们要在社会里混出头，只求不僵，只求不落伍，这是现代人立身处世的名言，萧先生坦白言之，安得不叫我们五体投地，真不愧“圣之时者也”的现代孔子了。
Now, Mr. Xiao has become famous and has come to our poor China to play. Thank you for his enthusiasm to support the younger generation, and told our students in Hong Kong: "If you are not a red revolutionary at the age of twenty, you will become a stiff stone at the age of fifty; At the age of twenty, he became a red revolutionary, and at the age of forty, he would not be left behind. "It turns out that the reason for being a red revolutionary is only because I am afraid of being a stiff stone and being left behind; The value of doctrine itself has little to do with the future of the individual; We want to stand out in society, just seek not to be stiff, only to not be outdated, this is the famous saying of modern people in the world, Mr. Xiao frankly said, how can we not make us bow to the ground, really worthy of the modern Confucius of "the holy time".然而，萧先生可别小看了这老大的中国，像你老先生这样时髦的学者，我们何尝没有。坐在安乐椅里发着尖刺的冷箭来宣传什么主义的，不须先生指教，戏法已耍得十分纯熟了。我想先生知道了，一定要莞尔而笑曰：“我道不孤！”
However, Mr. Xiao should not underestimate this boss China, why don't we have a fashionable scholar like your old gentleman? Sitting in the easy chair with spiked cold arrows to promote any doctrine, without the advice of the gentleman, the trick has been played very skillfully. I think the gentleman knows, and he must smile and say, "I am not alone!" ”然而，据我们愚蠢的见解，伟大人格的素质，重要的是个诚字。你信仰什么主义，就该诚挚地力行，不该张大了嘴唱着好听。若说，萧先生和他的同志，真信仰共产主义的，就请他散尽了家产再说话。可是，话也得说回来，萧先生散尽了家产，真穿着无产同志的褴褛装束，坐着三等舱来到中国，又有谁去睬他呢？这样一想：萧先生究竟不凡。
However, according to our foolish opinion, the quality of a great personality is the word sincerity. Whatever doctrine you believe in, you should practice it sincerely, and you should not sing with your mouth wide open. If Mr. Xiao and his comrades really believe in communism, ask him to disperse his family property before talking. However, then again, Mr. Xiao lost his family property, and he really came to China in the ragged clothes of a proletarian comrade in a third-class cabin, who would pay attention to him? Think about it this way: Mr. Xiao is extraordinary.二月十七日。

乐雯
Lewen这种“不凡”的议论的要点是：（一）尖刻的冷箭，“令受者难堪，听者痛快”，不过是取得“伟大”的秘诀；（二）这秘诀还在于“借主义，成大名，挂羊头，卖狗肉的戏法”；（三）照《大晚报》的意见，似乎应当为着自己的“主义”——高唱“神武的大文”，“张开血盆似的大口”去吃人，虽在二十岁就落伍，就变为僵石，亦所不惜；（四）如果萧伯纳不赞成这种“主义”，就不应当坐安乐椅，不应当有家财，赞成了那种主义，当然又当别论。
The main points of this "extraordinary" discussion are: (1) the sharp cold arrow, which "embarrass the recipient and makes the listener happy", is just the secret to achieving "greatness"; (2) The secret also lies in "borrowing doctrine, becoming a big name, hanging sheep's heads, and selling dog meat"; (3) According to the opinion of the "Evening News", it seems that one should eat people for their own "ism" - singing "Shenwu's great text" and "opening a big mouth like a basin of blood". (4) If George Bernard Shaw did not approve of this "doctrine", he should not sit in an easy chair, should not have family wealth, and of course he agreed with that doctrine.可惜，这世界的崩溃，偏偏已经到了这步田地：——小资产的知识阶层分化出一些爱光明不肯落伍的人，他们向着革命的道路上开步走。他们利用自己的种种可能，诚恳的赞助革命的前进。他们在以前，也许客观上是资本主义社会关系的拥护者。但是，他们偏要变成资产阶级的“叛徒”。而叛徒常常比敌人更可恶。
Unfortunately, the collapse of this world has reached this point: the petty bourgeois intellectual class has divided into some people who love the light and refuse to be left behind, and they are moving towards the road of revolution. They used all their possibilities to sincerely sponsor the advancement of the revolution. They were before, perhaps objectively, adherents of capitalist social relations. However, they prefer to become "traitors" of the bourgeoisie. And traitors are often more hateful than enemies.卑劣的资产阶级心理，以为给了你“百万家财”，给了你世界的大名，你还要背叛，你还有什么不满意，“实属可恶之至”。这自然是“借主义，成大名”了。对于这种卑劣的市侩，每一件事情一定有一种物质上的荣华富贵的目的。这是道地的“唯物主义”——名利主义。萧伯纳不在这种卑劣心理的意料之中，所以可恶之至。
The despicable bourgeois psychology thinks that if you have given you "millions of wealth" and the world's name, you will betray you, and what dissatisfaction do you have, "it is really hateful". This is naturally "borrowing doctrine and becoming a big name". For this kind of despicable philistine, everything must have a purpose of material glory and wealth. This is authentic "materialism" - fame and fortune. George Bernard Shaw was not expected by this despicable psychology, so it was extremely hateful.而《大晚报》还推论到一般的时代风尚，推论到中国也有“坐在安乐椅里发着尖刺的冷箭来宣传什么什么主义的，不须先生指教”。这当然中外相同的道理，不必重新解释了。可惜的是：独有那吃人的“主义”，虽然借用了好久，然而还是不能够“成大名”，呜呼！
The "Evening News" also deduced to the general fashion of the times, and inferred that China also "sits in an easy chair with spiked cold arrows to promote something, without the advice of the gentleman." Of course, this is the same principle at home and abroad, and there is no need to re-explain it. It's a pity that the unique cannibalistic "ism", although it has been borrowed for a long time, still can't "become a big name", woohoo!至于可恶可怪的萧，——他的伟大，却没有因为这些人“受着难堪”，就缩小了些。所以像中国历代的离经叛道的文人似的，活该被皇帝判决“抄没家财”。
As for the hateful and strange Xiao ,—— his greatness, he did not shrink because these people were "embarrassed". Therefore, like the deviant literati of China, he deserved to be sentenced by the emperor to "confiscate his family wealth".《萧伯纳在上海》。"George Bernard Shaw in Shanghai".

对于战争的祈祷——读书心得

对于战争的祈祷Prayer for War——读书心得 - Reading experience
热河的战争开始了。
The war in Rehe began.三月一日——上海战争的结束的“纪念日”，也快到了。“民族英雄”的肖像一次又一次的印刷着，出卖着；而小兵们的血，伤痕，热烈的心，还要被人糟蹋多少时候？回忆里的炮声和几千里外的炮声，都使得我们带着无可如何的苦笑，去翻开一本无聊的，但是，倒也很有几句“警句”的闲书。这警句是：
March 1, the "anniversary" of the end of the Shanghai War, is also approaching. the portraits of "national heroes" are printed and sold again and again; And how long will the blood, scars, and warm hearts of the soldiers be ruined? The sound of cannons in memories and the sound of cannons thousands of miles away make us open a boring book with a helpless wry smile, but there are also a few "aphorisms" in the idle book. This aphorism is:“喂，排长，我们到底上那里去哟？”——其中的一个问。
"Hey, platoon leader, where are we going?" - One of them asked.“走吧。我也不晓得。”
"Let's go. I don't know. ”“丢那妈，死光就算了，走什么！”
"Lose that mother, forget it, what are you going!"“不要吵，服从命令！”
"Don't make noise, obey orders!"“丢那妈的命令！”
"Lose that damn order!"然而丢那妈归丢那妈，命令还是命令，走也当然还是走。四点钟的时候，中山路复归于沉寂，风和叶儿沙沙的响，月亮躲在青灰色的云海里，睡着，依旧不管人类的事。
However, losing that mother is still an order, and of course it is still going. At four o'clock, Zhongshan Road returned to silence, the wind and the rustling of leaves, and the moon hid in the blue-gray sea of clouds, asleep, still ignoring human affairs.这样，十九路军就向西退去。
In this way, the 19th Route Army retreated westward.（黄震遐：《大上海的毁灭》。）
(Huang Zhenxia: "The Destruction of Shanghai".) ）什么时候“丢那妈”和“命令”不是这样各归各，那就得救了。
When "throwing that mother" and "ordering" are not like this, then you are saved.不然呢？还有“警句”可以回答这个问题：
Otherwise? There are also "aphorisms" that can answer this question:十九路军打，是告诉我们说，除掉空说以外，还有些事好做！
The 19th Route Army is telling us that in addition to empty words, there are still some things to do!十九路军胜利，只能增加我们苟且，偷安与骄傲的迷梦！
The victory of the 19th Route Army can only increase our dreams of being complacent, stealing peace and pride!十九路军死，是警告我们活得可怜，无趣！
The death of the 19th Route Army is a warning to us that we are pitiful and boring!十九路军失败，才告诉我们非努力，还是做奴隶的好！
The failure of the 19th Route Army told us that it is better to be a slave than to work hard!（见同书。）
(See ibid.) ）这是警告我们，非革命，则一切战争，命里注定的必然要失败。现在，主战是人人都会的了——这是一二八的十九路军的经验：打是一定要打的，然而切不可打胜，而打死也不好，不多不少刚刚适宜的办法是失败。“民族英雄”对于战争的祈祷是这样的。而战争又的确是他们在指挥着，这指挥权是不肯让给别人的。战争，禁得起主持的人预定着打败仗的计画么？好像戏台上的花脸和白脸打仗，谁输谁赢是早就在后台约定了的。呜呼，我们的“民族英雄”！
This is a warning to us that without revolution, all wars are destined to fail. Now, everyone can fight the main battle - this is the experience of the 128th Nineteenth Route Army: it must be fought, but it must not be won, and it is not good to kill, no more, no less than the appropriate way is to lose. The prayer of the "national hero" for war is like this. And the war is indeed commanded, and this command authority is unwilling to be given to others. Can the person who presided over the war plan to win the war? It seems that the flower face and the white face on the stage are fighting, and who loses and who wins has long been agreed backstage. Alas, our "national heroes"!二月二十五日。
February 25th.

从讽刺到幽默

从讽刺到幽默

从讽刺到幽默

From sarcasm to humor讽刺家，是危险的。
Cynics, it is dangerous.假使他所讽刺的是不识字者，被杀戮者，被囚禁者，被压迫者罢，那很好，正可给读他文章的所谓有教育的智识者嘻嘻一笑，更觉得自己的勇敢和高明。然而现今的讽刺家之所以为讽刺家，却正在讽刺这一流所谓有教育的智识者社会。
If what he satirizes is the illiterate, the killed, the imprisoned, and the oppressed, it is very good, and it can give the so-called educated intellectuals who read his articles a smile and feel that they are brave and clever. However, the reason why today's satirists are satirists is that they are satirizing this so-called educated intellectual society.因为所讽刺的是这一流社会，其中的各分子便各各觉得好像刺着了自己，就一个个的暗暗的迎出来，又用了他们的讽刺，想来刺死这讽刺者。
Because the irony was this first-class society, each of the elements felt as if they had stabbed themselves, so they secretly greeted them one by one, and used their irony to stab the satirist to death.最先是说他冷嘲，渐渐的又七嘴八舌的说他谩骂，俏皮话，刻毒，可恶，学匪，绍兴师爷，等等，等等。然而讽刺社会的讽刺，却往往仍然会“悠久得惊人”的，即使捧出了做过和尚的洋人或专办了小报来打击，也还是没有效，这怎不气死人也么哥呢！
At first, he said that he was sneering, and gradually he said that he was abusive, witty, vicious, hateful, student bandits, Shaoxing master, etc., etc. However, the satire of satirizing society is often still "amazingly long", even if foreigners who have been monks or tabloids are set up to crack down, it is still ineffective.枢纽是在这里：他所讽刺的是社会，社会不变，这讽刺就跟着存在，而你所刺的是他个人，他的讽刺倘存在，你的讽刺就落空了。
The pivot is here: what he satirizes is society, society remains unchanged, this irony exists, and what you satirize is him, and if his irony exists, your irony will fail.所以，要打倒这样的可恶的讽刺家，只好来改变社会。
Therefore, to defeat such a hateful satirist, we have to change society.然而社会讽刺家究竟是危险的，尤其是在有些“文学家”明明暗暗的成了“王之爪牙”的时代。人们谁高兴做“文字狱”中的主角呢，但倘不死绝，肚子里总还有半口闷气，要借着笑的幌子，哈哈的吐他出来。笑笑既不至于得罪别人，现在的法律上也尚无国民必须哭丧着脸的规定，并非“非法”，盖可断言的。
However, social satirists are dangerous, especially in an era when some "writers" have become "king's minions" openly and secretly. Who is happy to be the protagonist in the "literary prison", but if he doesn't die, there will always be half a stuffy breath in his stomach, and he will vomit out under the guise of laughter. Xiaoxiao will not offend others, and there is no provision in the law that citizens must cry and mourn, which is not "illegal", and it can be asserted.我想：这便是去年以来，文字上流行了“幽默”的原因，但其中单是“为笑笑而笑笑”的自然也不少。
I think: This is the reason why "humor" has become popular in words since last year, but there are naturally many of them who are "laughing for the sake of laughing".然而这情形恐怕是过不长久的，“幽默”既非国产，中国人也不是长于“幽默”的人民，而现在又实在是难以幽默的时候。于是虽幽默也就免不了改变样子了，非倾于对社会的讽刺，即堕入传统的“说笑话”和“讨便宜”。
However, this situation may not last long, "humor" is neither domestically produced, and Chinese people are not good at "humor", and now is really difficult to be humorous. Therefore, even if humor is inevitable, it is inevitable to change its appearance, and it is not inclined to satire on society, that is, it has fallen into the traditional "telling jokes" and "bargaining".三月二日。
March 2nd.

从幽默到正经

从幽默到正经

从幽默到正经

From humor to seriousness“幽默”一倾于讽刺，失了它的本领且不说，最可怕的是有些人又要来“讽刺”，来陷害了，倘若堕于“说笑话”，则寿命是可以较为长远，流年也大致顺利的，但愈堕愈近于国货，终将成为洋式徐文长。当提倡国货声中，广告上已有中国的“自造舶来品”，便是一个证据。
The most terrible thing is that some people are going to "satirize" again, to frame them, if they fall into "telling jokes", the life span can be relatively long, and the passage of time is roughly smooth, but the more it falls, the closer it is to domestic products, and it will eventually become a Western-style Xu Wenchang. When advocating domestic products, there are Chinese "self-made imported products" in advertisements, which is a proof.而况我实在恐怕法律上不久也就要有规定国民必须哭丧着脸的明文了。笑笑，原也不能算“非法”的。但不幸东省沦陷，举国骚然，爱国之士竭力搜索失地的原因，结果发见了其一是在青年的爱玩乐，学跳舞。当北海上正在嘻嘻哈哈的溜冰的时候，一个大炸弹抛下来，虽然没有伤人，冰却已经炸了一个大窟窿，不能溜之大吉了。
Moreover, I am really afraid that there will soon be a clear provision in the law that stipulates that citizens must cry and mourn. Xiaoxiao, it can't be considered "illegal". But unfortunately, the eastern province fell, the whole country was in turmoil, and patriots tried their best to search for the reason for the lost land, and the result was that one of them was the love of youth and learning to dance. When the North Sea was giggling and skating, a big bomb was dropped, and although it did not hurt anyone, the ice had already exploded a big hole, and it could not be slipped away.又不幸而榆关失守，热河吃紧了，有名的文人学士，也就更加吃紧起来，做挽歌的也有，做战歌的也有，讲文德的也有，骂人固然可恶，俏皮也不文明，要大家做正经文章，装正经脸孔，以补“不抵抗主义”之不足。
Unfortunately, Yuguan fell, Rehe was tight, and the famous literati and scholars became even tighter, some made elegies, some made war songs, and some talked about literary virtue.但人类究竟不能这么沉静，当大敌压境之际，手无寸铁，杀不得敌人，而心里却总是愤怒的，于是他就不免寻求敌人的替代。这时候，笑嘻嘻的可就遭殃了，因为他这时便被叫作：“陈叔宝全无心肝”。所以知机的人，必须也和大家一样哭丧着脸，以免于难。“聪明人不吃眼前亏”，亦古贤之遗教也，然而这时也就“幽默”归天，“正经”统一了剩下的全中国。
But human beings can't be so calm, when the enemy is pressing, he is defenseless and can't kill the enemy, but his heart is always angry, so he can't help but seek a replacement for the enemy. At this time, Xiaoxie suffered, because he was called "Chen Shubao has no heart at all". Therefore, those who know the opportunity must also cry and lose their faces like everyone else to avoid disaster. "Smart people do not suffer immediate losses", which is also the legacy of the ancient sages, but at this time, "humor" returned to heaven, and "seriousness" unified the rest of China.明白这一节，我们就知道先前为什么无论贞女与淫女，见人时都得不笑不言；现在为什么送葬的女人，无论悲哀与否，在路上定要放声大叫。
Understanding this verse, we know why both virgin and adulterous women did not smile when they saw people; Why do women who go to the funeral now, whether sad or not, must scream on the road?这就是“正经”。说出来么，那就是“刻毒”。
This is "seriousness". If you say it, it is "carving poison".三月二日。
March 2nd.

王道诗话

王道诗话

王道诗话

The king's poetry“人权论”是从鹦鹉开头的。据说古时候有一只高飞远走的鹦哥儿，偶然又经过自己的山林，看见那里大火，它就用翅膀蘸着些水洒在这山上；人家说它那一点儿水怎么救得熄这样的大火，它说：“我总算在这里住过的，现在不得不尽点儿心。”（事出《栎园书影》，见胡适《人权论集》序所引。）鹦鹉会救火，人权可以粉饰一下反动的统治。这是不会没有报酬的。胡博士到长沙去演讲一次，何将军就送了五千元程仪。价钱不算小，这“叫做”实验主义。
The "theory of human rights" begins with the parrot. It is said that in ancient times, there was a parrot that flew far away, and when he happened to pass by his own mountain forest and saw a fire there, he dipped his wings in some water and sprinkled it on the mountain; People say how its little water can extinguish such a fire, and it says: "I have finally lived here, and now I have to do my best." (The matter is from "Oak Garden Book Shadow", see the preface to Hu Shi's "Human Rights Collection".) Parrots can put out fires, and human rights can whitewash reactionary rule. This will not be without remuneration. Dr. Hu went to Changsha to give a speech, and General He gave 5,000 yuan to Cheng Yi. The price is not small, this is "called" experimentalism.但是，这火怎么救，在“人权论”时期（一九二九——三〇年），还不十分明白，五千元一次的零卖价格做出来之后，就不同了。最近（今年二月二十一日）《字林西报》登载胡博士的谈话说：
However, how to put out this fire was not very clear during the "human rights theory" period (1929-30), and it was different after the fractional price of 5,000 yuan was made. Recently, (February 21 this year), the "Zilin Xi Bao" published Dr. Hu's conversation, saying:“任何一个政府都应当有保护自己而镇压那些危害自己的运动的权利，固然，政治犯也和其他罪犯一样，应当得着法律的保障和合法的审判……”
"Any government should have the right to protect itself and suppress those movements that endanger itself, and political prisoners, like other criminals, should be protected by the law and tried legally......"这就清楚得多了！这不是在说“政府权”了么？自然，博士的头脑并不简单，他不至于只说：“一只手拿着宝剑，一只手拿着经典！”如什么主义之类。他是说还应当拿着法律。
This is much clearer! Isn't this talking about "government power"? Naturally, the doctor's mind is not simple, and he will not just say: "One hand holds a sword, the other holds a classic!" "Such as whatism. He said that the law should still be held.中国的帮忙文人，总有这一套秘诀，说什么王道，仁政。你看孟夫子多么幽默，他教你离得杀猪的地方远远的，嘴里吃得着肉，心里还保持着不忍人之心，又有了仁义道德的名目。不但骗人，还骗了自己，真所谓心安理得，实惠无穷。
China's help literati always have this set of secrets, what is the royal way, benevolent government. Look at how humorous Meng Fuzi is, he taught you to be far away from the place where you kill pigs, you can eat meat in your mouth, and you still maintain an intolerable heart in your heart, and you have the name of benevolence, righteousness and morality. Not only did he deceive others, but he also deceived himself, which is really called peace of mind and infinite benefits.诗曰：
The poem says:文化班头博士衔，人权抛却说王权，The title of the head of the cultural class, human rights abandoned the royal power, 
朝廷自古多屠戮，此理今凭实验传。 The court has been massacred since ancient times, and this principle is now based on experiments.  
人权王道两翻新，为感君恩奏圣明， Human rights and royal ways have been renewed, and in order to thank the emperor for his grace, 
虐政何妨援律例，杀人如草不闻声。 The tyrannical government does not have to invoke the law, and the murder is silent.  
先生熟读圣贤书，君子由来道不孤， Mr. is familiar with the books of the sages, and the gentleman has never been alone, 
千古同心有孟子，也教肉食远庖厨。 There is Mencius in the same heart throughout the ages, and he also teaches meat to be far from the kitchen.  
能言鹦鹉毒于蛇，滴水微功漫自夸， can say that parrots are more poisonous than snakes, and the dripping water boasts of its small achievements, 
好向侯门卖廉耻，五千一掷未为奢。 It is good to sell shame to the nobles, and it is not a luxury to throw five thousand a toast.
三月五日。
March 5th.

伸冤

伸冤

伸冤

Seek justice李顿报告书采用了中国人自己发明的“国际合作以开发中国的计划”，这是值得感谢的，——最近南京市各界的电报已经“谨代表京市七十万民众敬致慰念之忱”，称他“不仅为中国好友，且为世界和平及人道正义之保障者”（三月一日南京中央社电）了。
The Lytton report adopted the "plan of international cooperation to develop China" that Chinese himself invented, which is worth thanking,—— Recently, telegrams from all walks of life in Nanjing have "expressed their condolences on behalf of the 700,000 people in Beijing", calling him "not only a friend of China, but also a guarantor of world peace and humanitarian justice" (Nanjing Central News Agency, March 1).然而李顿也应当感谢中国才好：第一，假使中国没有“国际合作学说”，李顿爵士就很难找着适当的措辞来表示他的意思。岂非共管没有了学理上的根据？第二，李顿爵士自己说的：“南京本可欢迎日本之扶助以拒共产潮流”，他就更应当对于中国当局的这种苦心孤诣表示诚恳的敬意。
However, Lytton should also be grateful to China: first, if China did not have a "doctrine of international cooperation", it would be difficult for Sir Lytton to find the right words to express his meaning. Isn't there no theoretical basis for co-management? Second, Sir Lytton himself said: "Nanjing could have welcomed Japan's assistance to resist the communist trend", and he should have expressed sincere respect for this painstaking effort of the Chinese authorities.但是，李顿爵士最近在巴黎的演说（路透社二月二十日巴黎电），却提出了两个问题，一个是：“中国前途，似系于如何，何时及何人对于如此伟大人力予以国家意识的统一力量，日内瓦乎，莫斯科乎？”还有一个是：“中国现在倾向日内瓦，但若日本坚持其现行政策，而日内瓦失败，则中国纵非所愿，亦将变更其倾向矣。”这两个问题都有点儿侮辱中国的国家人格。国家者政府也。李顿说中国还没有“国家意识的统一力量”，甚至于还会变更其对于日内瓦之倾向！这岂不是不相信中国国家对于国联的忠心，对于日本的苦心？
However, Sir Lytton's recent speech in Paris (Reuters, February 20) raised two questions: "China's future seems to depend on how, when and by whom to give such a great force to the unifying force of national consciousness, Geneva or Moscow?" Another is: "China is now inclined to Geneva, but if Japan sticks to its current policy and Geneva fails, China will change its tendency even if it does not want to." "Both of these issues are a bit insulting to China's national personality. The state is the government. Lytton said that China does not yet have a "unified force of national consciousness", and will even change its tendency towards Geneva! Isn't this not believing in the Chinese country's loyalty to the League of Nations and its painstaking efforts towards Japan?为着中国国家的尊严和民族的光荣起见，我们要想答复李顿爵士已经好多天了，只是没有相当的文件。这使人苦闷得很。今天突然在报纸上发见了一件宝贝，可以拿来答复李大人：这就是“汉口警部三月一日的布告”。这里可以找着“铁一样的事实”，来反驳李大人的怀疑。
For the sake of the dignity of the Chinese state and the glory of the nation, we have been trying to reply to Sir Lytton for many days, but there are no equivalent documents. This is very distressing. Today I suddenly found a treasure in the newspaper, which can be used to reply to Lord Li: This is the "Hankou Police Department's announcement on March 1st". Here you can find "iron facts" to refute Master Li's suspicions.例如这布告（原文见《申报》三月一日汉口专电）说：“在外资下劳力之劳工，如劳资间有未解决之正当问题，应禀请我主管机关代表为交涉或救济，绝对不得直接交涉，违者拿办，或受人利用，故意以此种手段，构成严重事态者，处死刑。”这是说外国资本家遇见“劳资间有未解决之正当问题”，可以直接任意办理，而劳工方面如此这般者……就要处死刑。这样一来，我们中国就只剩得“用国家意识统一了的”劳工了。因为凡是违背这“意识”的，都要请他离开中国的“国家”——到阴间去。李大人难道还能够说中国当局不是“国家意识的统一力量”么？
For example, this announcement (the original text is found in the Hankou Special Telegram of March 1 of the "Declaration") said: "Workers who are laboring under foreign capital, if there are legitimate problems between labor and management, should be reported to the representative of our competent authority for negotiation or relief, and must never negotiate directly. This means that foreign capitalists can directly handle "unresolved legitimate problems between labor and management" when they encounter them, while this is the case with labor...... is to be sentenced to death. In this way, we in China are left with only laborers who are "unified by national consciousness". Because anyone who violates this "consciousness" must be asked to leave China's "country" - to the underworld. Can Master Li still say that the Chinese authorities are not a "unifying force of national consciousness"?再则统一这个“统一力量”的，当然是日内瓦，而不是莫斯科。“中国现在倾向日内瓦”，——这是李顿大人自己说的。我们这种倾向十二万分的坚定，例如那布告上也说：“如有奸民流痞受人诱买勾串，或直受驱使，或假托名义，以图破坏秩序安宁，与构成其他不利于我国家社会之重大犯行者，杀无赦。”这是保障“日内瓦倾向”的坚决手段，所谓“虽流血亦所不辞”。而且“日内瓦”是讲世界和平的，因此，中国两年以来都没有抵抗，因为抵抗就要破坏和平；直到一二八，中国也不过装出挡挡炸弹枪炮的姿势；最近的热河事变，中国方面也同样的尽在“缩短阵线”。不但如此，中国方面埋头剿匪，已经宣誓在一两个月内肃清匪共，“暂时”不管热河。这一切都是要证明“日本……见中国南方共产潮流渐起，为之焦虑”是不必的，日本很可以无须亲自出马。中国方面这样辛苦的忍耐的工作着，无非是为着要感动日本，使它悔悟，达到远东永久和平的目的，国际资本可以在这里分工合作。而李顿爵士要还怀疑中国会“变更其倾向”，这就未免太冤枉了。
Furthermore, it is of course Geneva that unites this "unifying force", not Moscow. "China is now leaning towards Geneva",—— this is what Lord Lytton himself said. For example, the proclamation also said: "If any traitor is lured by others to collude with others, or is directly driven, or under the guise of pretending, in an attempt to undermine order and tranquility, and constitutes other major crimes that are not conducive to our country and society, he will be killed without mercy." 文学上的折扣

文学上的折扣

文学上的折扣

Literary discounts有一种无聊小报，以登载诬蔑一部分人的小说自鸣得意，连姓名也都给以影射的，忽然对于投稿，说是“如含攻讦个人或团体性质者恕不揭载”了，便不禁想到了一些事——
There is a kind of boring tabloid, which is proud of publishing novels that slander some people, and even the names are insinuated, and suddenly for the submission, it is said that "if it contains an attack on the nature of an individual or group, it will not be exposed", and I can't help but think of something -凡我所遇见的研究中国文学的外国人中，往往不满于中国文章之夸大。这真是虽然研究中国文学，恐怕到死也还不会懂得中国文学的外国人。倘是我们中国人，则只要看过几百篇文章，见过十来个所谓“文学家”的行径，又不是刚刚“从民间来”的老实青年，就决不会上当。因为我们惯熟了，恰如钱店伙计的看见钞票一般，知道什么是通行的，什么是该打折扣的，什么是废票，简直要不得。
Among the foreigners I have met who study Chinese literature, they are often dissatisfied with the exaggeration of Chinese articles. This is really a foreigner who studies Chinese literature, but I am afraid that he will not understand Chinese literature until he dies. If we are Chinese, as long as we have read hundreds of articles and seen the behavior of more than a dozen so-called "writers", and are not honest young people who have just "come from the people", we will never be fooled. Because we are used to it, just like the money shop guy sees banknotes, knowing what is acceptable, what should be discounted, and what is invalid, it is simply unnecessary.譬如说罢，称赞贵相是“两耳垂肩”，这时我们便至少将他打一个对折，觉得比通常也许大一点，可是决不相信他的耳朵像猪猡一样。说愁是“白发三千丈”，这时我们便至少将他打一个二万扣，以为也许有七八尺，但决不相信它会盘在顶上像一个大草囤。这种尺寸，虽然有些模胡，不过总不至于相差太远。反之，我们也能将少的增多，无的化有，例如戏台上走出四个拿刀的瘦伶仃的小戏子，我们就知道这是十万精兵；刊物上登载一篇俨乎其然的像煞有介事的文章，我们就知道字里行间还有看不见的鬼把戏。
For example, if we praise Guixiang for "two ears and drooping shoulders", we will at least fold him in half, thinking that it may be a little bigger than usual, but we will never believe that his ears are like pigs. Saying that sorrow is "three thousand feet of white hair", we will beat him at least twenty thousand buckles, thinking that it may be seven or eight feet, but we never believe that it will be coiled on top like a big grass mound. This size, although a bit ambiguous, is not too far apart. On the contrary, we can also increase the less and turn the nothing, for example, when four thin little actors with knives walk out of the stage, we know that this is a hundred thousand elite soldiers; When an article is published in a publication that seems to be a serious matter, we know that there are invisible ghost tricks between the lines.又反之，我们并且能将有的化无，例如什么“枕戈待旦”呀，“卧薪尝胆”呀，“尽忠报国”呀，我们也就即刻会看成白纸，恰如还未定影的照片，遇到了日光一般。
On the contrary, we can also turn what we have into nothingness, such as "waiting for the dawn", "lying down and tasting courage", and "serving the country loyally", and we will immediately see it as a blank sheet of paper, just like a photo that has not yet been fixed, as if it has encountered daylight.但这些文章，我们有时也还看。苏东坡贬黄州时，无聊之至，有客来，便要他谈鬼。客说没有。东坡道：“你姑且胡说一通罢。”我们的看，也不过这意思。但又可知道社会上有这样的东西，是费去了多少无聊的眼力。人们往往以为打牌，跳舞有害，实则这种文章的害还要大，因为一不小心，就会给它教成后天的低能儿的。
But we also read these articles sometimes. When Su Dongpo was demoted to Huangzhou, he was so bored that when a guest came, he asked him to talk about ghosts. The guest said no. Dongpo said: "You just talk nonsense." "That's just what we see. But you can also know how much boring eyesight it takes to have such a thing in society. People often think that playing cards and dancing is harmful, but in fact, this kind of article is even more harmful, because if you are not careful, you will teach it to be an acquired imbecile.《颂》诗早已拍马，《春秋》已经隐瞒，战国时谈士蜂起，不是以危言耸听，就是以美词动听，于是夸大，装腔，撒谎，层出不穷。现在的文人虽然改著了洋服，而骨髓里却还埋着老祖宗，所以必须取消或折扣，这才显出几分真实。
The poems "Song" have long been slapped, the "Spring and Autumn Annals" have been concealed, and during the Warring States period, the talkers surged, either with alarmist words or with beautiful words, so they exaggerated, pretended, lied, and emerged endlessly. Although today's literati have changed their clothes, their ancestors are still buried in their bone marrow, so they must be canceled or discounted, which shows a bit of truth.“文学家”倘不用事实来证明他已经改变了他的夸大，装腔，撒谎……的老脾气，则即使对天立誓，说是从此要十分正经，否则天诛地灭，也还是徒劳的。因为我们也早已看惯了许多家都钉着“假冒王麻子灭门三代”的金漆牌子的了，又何况他连小尾巴也还在摇摇摇呢。
If the "writer" does not use facts to prove that he has changed his exaggeration, pretense, and lie...... Even if you swear to the heavens that you will be very serious from now on, otherwise it will be in vain to punish the heavens and the earth. Because we have long been accustomed to seeing many families nailed with gold lacquer brands of "fake Wang Mazi exterminating three generations", not to mention that even his little tail is still shaking.三月十二日。
