迎头经

迎头经

迎头经

Head-to-head scriptures中国现代圣经——迎头经曰：“我们……要迎头赶上去，不要向后跟着。”
The modern Chinese Bible - the first scripture says: "We...... Catch up head-on, don't follow behind. ”传曰：追赶总只有向后跟着，普通是无所谓迎头追赶的，然而圣经决不会错，更不会不通，何况这个年头一切都是反常的呢。所以赶上偏偏说迎头，向后跟着，那就说不行！
It is said that the only way to catch up is to follow backwards, and it usually doesn't matter if you catch up head-on, but the Bible will never be wrong, let alone misunderstandable, not to mention that everything is abnormal these days. So if you catch up and say head-on and follow backward, then you can't say no!现在通行的说法是：“日军所至，抵抗随之”，至于收复失地与否，那么，当然“既非军事专家，详细计画，不得而知”。不错呀，“日军所至，抵抗随之”，这不是迎头赶上是什么！日军一到，迎头而“赶”：日军到沈阳，迎头赶上北平；日军到闸北，迎头赶上真茹；日军到山海关，迎头赶上塘沽；日军到承德，迎头赶上古北口……以前有过行都洛阳，现在有了陪都西安，将来还有“汉族发源地”昆仑山——西方极乐世界。至于收复失地云云，则虽非军事专家亦得而知焉，于经有之，曰“不要向后跟着”也。证之已往的上海战事，每到日军退守租界的时候，就要“严饬所部切勿越界一步”。这样，所谓迎头赶上和勿向后跟，都是不但见于经典而且证诸实验的真理了。右传之一章。
As for whether or not to regain lost territory, then, of course, "neither a military expert nor a detailed plan, it is unknown." Yes, "wherever the Japanese army arrives, resistance follows", this is not catching up! As soon as the Japanese army arrived, they "rushed" head-on: the Japanese army arrived in Shenyang and caught up with Peiping; The Japanese army arrived in Zhabei and caught up with Zhenru; The Japanese army arrived at Shanhaiguan and caught up with Tanggu; The Japanese army arrived in Chengde and caught up with Gubeikou...... In the past, there was Luoyang, the capital of the Xingdu, and now there is the capital Xi'an, and in the future, there will be Kunlun Mountain, the "birthplace of the Han people" - the Western Paradise. As for recovering lost territory, even non-military experts know this, and there is a saying in the scriptures that "don't follow backwards." As evidenced by the past war in Shanghai, whenever the Japanese army retreated to the concession, it was necessary to "strictly warn the troops not to cross the line". In this way, the so-called catching up and not following behind are truths that are not only found in the scriptures but also proved by experiments. A chapter from the right biography.传又曰：迎头赶和勿后跟，还有第二种的微言大义——
The biography also says: Catch up and don't follow, and there is a second kind of subtle righteousness -报载热河实况曰：“义军皆极勇敢，认扰乱及杀戮日军为兴奋之事……唯张作相接收义军之消息发表后，张作相既不亲往抚慰，热汤又停止供给义军汽油，运输中断，义军大都失望，甚至有认替张作相立功为无谓者。”“日军既至凌源，其时张作相已不在，吾人闻讯出走，热汤扣车运物已成目击之事实，证以日军从未派飞机至承德轰炸……可知承德实为妥协之放弃。”（张慧冲君在上海东北难民救济会席上所谈。）虽然据张慧冲君所说，“享名最盛之义军领袖，其忠勇之精神，未能悉如吾人之意想”，然而义军的兵士的确是极勇敢的小百姓。正因为这些小百姓不懂得圣经，所以也不知道迎头式的策略。于是小百姓自己，就自然要碰见迎头的抵抗了：热汤放弃承德之后，北平军委分会下令“固守古北口，如义军有欲入口者，即开枪迎击之”。这是说，我的“抵抗”只是随日军之所至，你要换个样子去抵抗，我就抵抗你；何况我的退后是预先约好了的，你既不肯妥协，那就只有“不要你向后跟着”而要把你“迎头赶上”梁山了。右传之二章。
The report reported the situation of Rehe: "The rebels were extremely brave and recognized the disturbance and killing of the Japanese army as exciting...... Only after the news of Zhang Zuoxiang's receipt of the rebels was published, Zhang Zuoxiang neither went to comfort him in person, and the hot soup stopped supplying gasoline to the rebels, and the transportation was interrupted. "When the Japanese army arrived in Lingyuan, Zhang Zuoxiang was no longer there, and we heard the news and left, and the fact that the hot soup detained the car and transported goods had become a witness, proving that the Japanese army had never sent planes to Chengde to bomb...... It can be seen that Chengde is actually a compromise abandonment. (Zhang Huichongjun spoke at the Northeast Shanghai Refugee Relief Association.) Although according to Zhang Huichongjun, "the most famous rebel leader, his loyal and brave spirit is not as we imagined", the soldiers of the rebel army are indeed extremely brave people. Because these common people did not understand the Bible, they did not know the strategy of head-on. So the common people themselves naturally had to meet the head-on resistance: after the hot soup abandoned Chengde, the branch of the Peking Military Commission ordered to "stick to Gubeikou, and if the rebels wanted to enter the mouth, they would shoot at it." This means that my "resistance" is only with the Japanese army, and if you want to resist in a different way, I will resist you; What's more, my retreat was pre-agreed, and since you refused to compromise, you would only have to "don't want you to follow behind" and "catch up" with Liangshan. The poem says: "Panic" army, rush head-on, "sneer" the common people, don't follow back! It is a poem.三月十四日。

“光明所到……”

"Where the light goes......"中国监狱里的拷打，是公然的秘密。上月里，民权保障同盟曾经提起了这问题。
Torture in Chinese prisons is an open secret. Last month, the Civil Rights Defense League raised this issue.但外国人办的《字林西报》就揭载了二月十五日的《北京通信》，详述胡适博士曾经亲自看过几个监狱，“很亲爱的”告诉这位记者，说“据他的慎重调查，实在不能得最轻微的证据，……他们很容易和犯人谈话，有一次胡适博士还能够用英国话和他们会谈。监狱的情形，他（胡适博士——干注）说，是不能满意的，但是，虽然他们很自由的（哦，很自由的——干注）诉说待遇的恶劣侮辱，然而关于严刑拷打，他们却连一点儿暗示也没有。……”
However, the foreigner-run "Zilin Xi Bao" published the "Beijing News Agency" on February 15, detailing that Dr. Hu Shi had personally visited several prisons, and "very dear" told the reporter, "According to his careful investigation, I really can't get the slightest evidence,...... They were easy to talk to the prisoners, and once Dr. Hu Shi was able to talk to them in English. The conditions in prison, he said, were not satisfactory, but although they were very free (oh, very free) to speak of the terrible insults of treatment, they did not even hint at the slightest hint about torture. ……”我虽然没有随从这回的“慎重调查”的光荣，但在十年以前，是参观过北京的模范监狱的。虽是模范监狱，而访问犯人，谈话却很不“自由”，中隔一窗，彼此相距约三尺，旁边站一狱卒，时间既有限制，谈话也不准用暗号，更何况外国话。
Although I did not have the honor of following this "careful investigation", ten years ago, I visited the model prison in Beijing. Although it is a model prison, the conversation is not "free" when interviewing prisoners, separated by a window, about three feet apart from each other, and a jailer standing next to it.而这回胡适博士却“能够用英国话和他们会谈”，真是特别之极了。莫非中国的监狱竟已经改良到这地步，“自由”到这地步；还是狱卒给“英国话”吓倒了，以为胡适博士是李顿爵士的同乡，很有来历的缘故呢？

Stop crying literature前三年，“民族主义文学”家敲着大锣大鼓的时候，曾经有一篇《黄人之血》说明了最高的愿望是在追随成吉思皇帝的孙子拔都元帅之后，去剿灭“斡罗斯”。斡罗斯者，今之苏俄也。那时就有人指出，说是现在的拔都的大军，就是日本的军马，而在“西征”之前，尚须先将中国征服，给变成从军的奴才。
In the first three years, when "nationalist literature" writers were beating gongs and drums, there was once a "Yellow Man's Blood" that illustrated that the highest wish was to follow the grandson of Emperor Genghis Genghis Khan, Marshal Batu, to exterminate the "Oros". Oros is what is now Soviet Russia. At that time, some people pointed out that the current army of Batu was the Japanese military horse, and before the "Western Expedition", it was necessary to conquer China first and turn it into a slave in the army.当自己们被征服时，除了极少数人以外，是很苦痛的。这实例，就如东三省的沦亡，上海的爆击，凡是活着的人们，毫无悲愤的怕是很少很少罢。但这悲愤，于将来的“西征”是大有妨碍的。于是来了一部《大上海的毁灭》，用数目字告诉读者以中国的武力，决定不如日本，给大家平平心；而且以为活着不如死亡（“十九路军死，是警告我们活得可怜，无趣！”），但胜利又不如败退（“十九路军胜利，只能增加我们苟且，偷安与骄傲的迷梦！”）。总之，战死是好的，但战败尤其好，上海之役，正是中国的完全的成功。
When they are conquered, it is painful except for a very few. In this example, just like the fall of the three eastern provinces and the critical attack in Shanghai, all living people are afraid that there are very few people without grief and anger. But this grief and anger will greatly hinder the future "Western Expedition". So came a "Destruction of Shanghai", which used a number of words to tell readers that China's military power was not as good as Japan, so that everyone could be calm; And think that living is worse than death ("The death of the 19th Route Army is a warning that we are pitiful and boring!") But victory is not as good as defeat ("The victory of the 19th Route Army can only increase our dream of being complacent, stealing peace and pride!") ”）。 In short, it is good to die in battle, but defeat is especially good, and the Battle of Shanghai is China's complete success.现在第二步开始了。据中央社消息，则日本已有与满洲国签订一种“中华联邦帝国密约”之阴谋。那方案的第一条是：“现在世界只有两种国家，一种系资本主义，英，美，日，意，法，一种系共产主义，苏俄。现在要抵制苏俄，非中日联合起来……不能成功”云（详见三月十九日《申报》）。
Now the second step begins. According to the Central News Agency, Japan has signed a conspiracy with Manchukuo to sign a "secret treaty with the Empire of the Chinese Federation". The first of the plan was: "There are only two countries in the world now, one is capitalism, Britain, the United States, Japan, Italy, France, and the other is communism, Soviet Russia." Now we must boycott Soviet Russia and unite with China and Japan...... It cannot be successful" (see the March 19 "Declaration" for details).要“联合起来”了。这回是中日两国的完全的成功，是从“大上海的毁灭”走到“黄人之血”路上去的第二步。
It's time to "unite". This time it was a complete success for China and Japan, and it was the second step on the road from the "destruction of Shanghai" to the "blood of the yellow people".固然，有些地方正在爆击，上海却自从遭到爆击之后，已经有了一年多，但有些人民不悟“西征”的必然的步法，竟似乎还没有完全忘掉前年的悲愤。这悲愤，和目前的“联合”就大有妨碍的。在这景况中，应运而生的是给人们一点爽利和慰安，好像“辣椒和橄榄”的文学。这也许正是一服苦闷的对症药罢。为什么呢？就因为是“辣椒虽辣，辣不死人，橄榄虽苦，苦中有味”的。明乎此，也就知道苦力为什么吸鸦片。
Of course, some places are being bombed, but Shanghai has been hit for more than a year since it was bombed, but some people do not understand the inevitable footwork of the "Western Expedition", and it seems that they have not completely forgotten the grief and anger of the previous year. This grief and anger are greatly hindered by the current "union". In this situation, what came into being was to give people a little refreshment and comfort, like the literature of "chili peppers and olives". This may be just a symptomatic remedy for distress. Why? Just because it is "chili peppers are spicy, spicy is not deadly, olives are bitter, bitter and flavorful". Knowing this, we know why coolies smoke opium.而且不独无声的苦闷而已，还据说辣椒是连“讨厌的哭声”也可以停止的。王慈先生在《提倡辣椒救国》这一篇名文里告诉我们说：
And not only is it silent bitterness, but it is also said that peppers can stop even "nasty crying". Mr. Wang Ci told us in the famous article "Advocating Chili Pepper to Save the Country":“……还有北方人自小在母亲怀里，大哭的时候，倘使母亲拿一只辣茄子给小儿咬，很灵验的可以立止大哭……
“…… There are also northerners who have been in their mother's arms since they were children, and when they cry, if the mother takes a spicy eggplant to bite the child, it is very effective to stop crying immediately......“现在的中国，仿佛是一个在大哭时的北方婴孩，倘使要制止他讨厌的哭声，只要多多的给辣茄子他咬。”（《大晚报》副刊第十二号）
"Today's China is like a northern baby crying, if you want to stop his hated crying, just give him a lot of spicy eggplants." (Supplement No. 12 of the "Great Evening News")辣椒可以止小儿的大哭，真是空前绝后的奇闻，倘是真的，中国人可实在是一种与众不同的特别“民族”了。然而也很分明的看见了这种“文学”的企图，是在给人一辣而不死，“制止他讨厌的哭声”，静候着拔都元帅。
Chili peppers can stop children from crying, which is really an unprecedented anecdote, if true, the Chinese are really a special "nation" that is different from others. However, it is also very clear that this kind of "literary" attempt is to give people a spicy but not die, "stop his hated cry", and wait for Marshal Batu.不过，这是无效的，远不如哭则“格杀勿论”的灵验。此后要防的是“道路以目”了，我们等待着遮眼文学罢。
However, this is ineffective, far less effective than crying. After that, what we need to guard against is "the road is eyed", and we are waiting for blindfolded literature.三月二十日。

“人话”

“人话”

“人话”

"People talk."记得荷兰的作家望蔼覃（F．Van Eeden）——可惜他去年死掉了——所做的童话《小约翰》里，记着小约翰听两种菌类相争论，从旁批评了一句“你们俩都是有毒的”，菌们便惊喊道：“你是人么？这是人话呵！”
I remember the fairy tale "Little John" made by the Dutch writer F. Van Eeden - unfortunately he died last year - in which little John listened to two fungi arguing and criticized "You both are poisonous", and the fungi exclaimed: "Are you human? This is human words! ”从菌类的立场看起来，的确应该惊喊的。人类因为要吃它们，才首先注意于有毒或无毒，但在菌们自己，这却完全没有关系，完全不成问题。
From the standpoint of the fungus, it should indeed be exclaimed. Because humans want to eat them, they first pay attention to whether they are poisonous or non-toxic, but in the bacteria themselves, this is completely irrelevant and not a problem at all.虽是意在给人科学知识的书籍或文章，为要讲得有趣，也往往太说些“人话”。这毛病，是连法布耳（J．H．Fabre）做的大名鼎鼎的《昆虫记》（Souvenirs Entomologiques），也是在所不免的。随手抄撮的东西不必说了。近来在杂志上偶然看见一篇教青年以生物学上的知识的文章，内有这样的叙述——
Although books or articles are intended to give people scientific knowledge, in order to be interesting, they often speak too much "human language". This problem is inevitable even in J.H. Fabre's famous "Souvenirs Entomologiques". Needless to say, what is copied casually. Recently, I happened to see an article in a magazine teaching young people about biology, which contained this narrative -“鸟粪蜘蛛……形体既似鸟粪，又能伏着不动，自己假做鸟粪的样子。”
"Guano spider...... The body is like bird droppings, and it can lie still and pretend to be bird droppings. ”“动物界中，要残食自己亲丈夫的很多，但最有名的，要算前面所说的蜘蛛和现今要说的螳螂了。……”
"In the animal kingdom, there are many people who want to eat their own husbands, but the most famous ones are the spiders mentioned above and the mantis that we are talking about today. ……”这也未免太说了“人话”。鸟粪蜘蛛只是形体原像鸟粪，性又不大走动罢了，并非它故意装作鸟粪模样，意在欺骗小虫豸。螳螂界中也尚无五伦之说，它在交尾中吃掉雄的，只是肚子饿了，在吃东西，何尝知道这东西就是自己的家主公。但经用“人话”一写，一个就成了阴谋害命的凶犯，一个是谋死亲夫的毒妇了。实则都是冤枉的。
This is too much "human language". The guano spider is just like bird droppings in its original form, and it doesn't move around much, not that it deliberately pretends to be bird droppings, intending to deceive the little bugs. There is no theory of the five ethics in the mantis world, it eats the male in mating, but it is hungry, eating, how can it know that this thing is its own master. But after writing in "human words", one became a murderer who conspired to kill, and the other was a poisonous woman who murdered her husband. In fact, they are all wronged.“人话”之中，又有各种的“人话”：有英人话，有华人话。华人话中又有各种：有“高等华人话”，有“下等华人话”。浙西有一个讥笑乡下女人之无知的笑话——
Among the "human dialects", there are various "human dialects": there are British dialects and Chinese dialects. There are various Chinese dialects: there are "higher Chinese dialects" and "lower Chinese dialects". There is a joke in western Zhejiang that ridicules the ignorance of rural women -“是大热天的正午，一个农妇做事做得正苦，忽而叹道：‘皇后娘娘真不知道多么快活。这时还不是在床上睡午觉，醒过来的时候，就叫道：太监，拿个柿饼来！’”
"It was noon on a hot day, and a peasant woman was working hard, and suddenly sighed: 'The queen really doesn't know how happy she is. At this time, he was not taking a nap in bed, and when he woke up, he shouted: Eunuch, bring me a persimmon! ’”然而这并不是“下等华人话”，倒是高等华人意中的“下等华人话”，所以其实是“高等华人话”。在下等华人自己，那时也许未必这么说，即使这么说，也并不以为笑话的。
However, this is not "inferior Chinese", but "inferior Chinese" in the minds of higher Chinese, so it is actually "Higher Chinese". The inferior Chinese themselves may not have said this at that time, and even if they said so, they didn't think it was a joke.再说下去，就要引起阶级文学的麻烦来了，“带住”。
If you continue, you will cause trouble with class literature, "bring it".现在很有些人做书，格式是写给青年或少年的信。自然，说的一定是“人话”了。但不知道是那一种“人话”？为什么不写给年龄更大的人们？年龄大了就不屑教诲么？还是青年和少年比较的纯厚，容易诓骗呢？
Nowadays, many people make books in the form of letters to youth or teenagers. Naturally, it must be "human words". But I don't know what kind of "human language" it is? Why not write for older people? Do you disdain to teach when you are old? Or is it that young people and teenagers are more pure and easy to deceive?三月二十一日。

出卖灵魂的秘诀

出卖灵魂的秘诀

出卖灵魂的秘诀

The secret to selling your soul几年前，胡适博士曾经玩过一套“五鬼闹中华”的把戏，那是说：这世界上并无所谓帝国主义之类在侵略中国，倒是中国自己该着“贫穷”，“愚昧”……等五个鬼，闹得大家不安宁。现在，胡适博士又发见了第六个鬼，叫做仇恨。这个鬼不但闹中华，而且祸延友邦，闹到东京去了。因此，胡适博士对症发药，预备向“日本朋友”上条陈。
A few years ago, Dr. Hu Shi played a trick of "five ghosts making trouble in China", that is, he said: There is no so-called imperialism in this world that is invading China, but China itself should be "poor" and "ignorant"...... and five other ghosts, making everyone uneasy. Now, Dr. Hu Shi has discovered a sixth ghost, called hatred. This ghost not only caused trouble in China, but also caused trouble for friendly countries and went to Tokyo. Therefore, Dr. Hu Shi prescribed the right medicine and prepared to report to his "Japanese friend".据博士说：“日本军阀在中国暴行所造成之仇恨，到今日已颇难消除”，“而日本决不能用暴力征服中国”（见报载胡适之的最近谈话，下同）。这是值得忧虑的：难道真的没有方法征服中国么？不，法子是有的。“九世之仇，百年之友，均在觉悟不觉悟之关系头上，”——“日本只有一个方法可以征服中国，即悬崖勒马，彻底停止侵略中国，反过来征服中国民族的心。”
According to the doctor, "the hatred caused by the atrocities of the Japanese warlords in China is quite difficult to eliminate today", and "Japan must not conquer China by violence" (see Hu Shizhi's recent conversation, the same below). This is worrying: Is there really no way to conquer China? No, there is a way. "The feud of nine generations and the friend of a hundred years are all at the head of the relationship between enlightenment and unenlightenment," - "Japan has only one way to conquer China, that is, to rein in the precipice, completely stop aggression against China, and in turn conquer the heart of the Chinese nation. ”这据说是“征服中国的唯一方法”。不错，古代的儒教军师，总说“以德服人者王，其心诚服也”。胡适博士不愧为日本帝国主义的军师。但是，从中国小百姓方面说来，这却是出卖灵魂的唯一秘诀。中国小百姓实在“愚昧”，原不懂得自己的“民族性”，所以他们一向会仇恨，如果日本陛下大发慈悲，居然采用胡博士的条陈，那么，所谓“忠孝仁爱信义和平”的中国固有文化，就可以恢复：——因为日本不用暴力而用软功的王道，中国民族就不至于再生仇恨，因为没有仇恨，自然更不抵抗，因为更不抵抗，自然就更和平，更忠孝……中国的肉体固然买到了，中国的灵魂也被征服了。
This is said to be "the only way to conquer China". Yes, the ancient Confucian military strategists always said that "the king who convinces people with virtue is also sincerely convinced". Dr. Hu Shi is worthy of being a military advisor to Japanese imperialism. However, from the perspective of the Chinese people, this is the only secret to selling their souls. If His Majesty the Japanese show great mercy and actually adopt Dr. Hu's statement, then the so-called "loyalty, filial piety, benevolence, trust, righteousness, and peace" Chinese inherent culture can be restored: ——Because Japan does not use violence but uses soft skills, the Chinese nation will not regenerate hatred, because there is no hatred, naturally there will be no resistance, because there is no resistance, naturally it will be more peaceful and more loyal and filial...... Although the Chinese body was bought, the Chinese soul was also conquered.可惜的是这“唯一方法”的实行，完全要靠日本陛下的觉悟。如果不觉悟，那又怎么办？胡博士回答道：“到无可奈何之时，真的接受一种耻辱的城下之盟”好了。那真是无可奈何的呵——因为那时候“仇恨鬼”是不肯走的，这始终是中国民族性的污点，即为日本计，也非万全之道。
Unfortunately, the implementation of this "only method" depends entirely on the consciousness of His Majesty Japan. If you don't realize it, what will you do? Dr. Hu replied, "When there is no choice, really accept a shameful alliance under the city." That's really helpless - because at that time, the "hatred ghosts" refused to leave, which was always a stain on China's national character, even for Japan, and it was not a foolproof way.因此，胡博士准备出席太平洋会议，再去“忠告”一次他的日本朋友：征服中国并不是没有法子的，请接受我们出卖的灵魂罢，何况这并不难，所谓“彻底停止侵略”，原只要执行“公平的”李顿报告——仇恨自然就消除了！
Therefore, Dr. Hu is ready to attend the Pacific Conference and "advise" his Japanese friends again: There is no way to conquer China, please accept our betrayed souls, not to mention that this is not difficult, the so-called "complete cessation of aggression", as long as the "fair" Lytton report is implemented - the hatred will naturally be eliminated!三月二十二日。

文人无文

文人无文

Literati have no literature在一种姓“大”的报的副刊上，有一位“姓张的”在“要求中国有为的青年，切勿借了‘文人无行’的幌子，犯着可诟病的恶癖。”这实在是对透了的。但那“无行”的界说，可又严紧透顶了。据说：“所谓无行，并不一定是指不规则或不道德的行为，凡一切不近人情的恶劣行为，也都包括在内。”
In the supplement of a newspaper surnamed "Da", there was a "surnamed Zhang" who asked promising young people in China not to commit reprehensible vices under the guise of 'literati are incompetent'. "This is really right. But the boundary of "no action" is strict again. It is said: "The so-called inaction does not necessarily refer to irregular or immoral behavior, but also includes all impersonal and bad behavior." ”接着就举了一些日本文人的“恶癖”的例子，来作中国的有为的青年的殷鉴，一条是“宫地嘉六爱用指爪搔头发”，还有一条是“金子洋文喜舐嘴唇”。
Then I gave some examples of the "vices" of Japanese literati to serve as a mirror of China's promising youth, one is "Miyaji Yoroku loves to scratch his hair with his fingernails", and the other is "Kaneko Hirofumi likes to lick his lips".自然，嘴唇干和头皮痒，古今的圣贤都不称它为美德，但好像也没有斥为恶德的。不料一到中国上海的现在，爱搔喜舐，即使是自己的嘴唇和头发罢，也成了“不近人情的恶劣行为”了。如果不舒服，也只好熬着。要做有为的青年或文人，真是一天一天的艰难起来了。
Naturally, dry lips and itchy scalp are not called virtues by ancient and modern sages, but they do not seem to denounce them as vices. Unexpectedly, as soon as I arrived in Shanghai, China, I love to scratch and lick, even my lips and hair, which has become "impersonal and bad behavior". If you don't feel comfortable, you have to endure. To be a promising young man or literati is really difficult day by day.但中国文人的“恶癖”，其实并不在这些，只要他写得出文章来，或搔或舐，都不关紧要，“不近人情”的并不是“文人无行”，而是“文人无文”。
But the "vices" of Chinese literati are actually not these, as long as he can write articles, or scratch or lick, it doesn't matter, what is "unkind" is not "literati have no virtue", but "literati have no literature".我们在两三年前，就看见刊物上说某诗人到西湖吟诗去了，某文豪在做五十万字的小说了，但直到现在，除了并未预告的一部《子夜》而外，别的大作都没有出现。
Two or three years ago, we saw in publications that a certain poet went to West Lake to recite poetry, and a certain writer was writing a novel of 500,000 words, but until now, except for the unannounced "Midnight", no other masterpieces have appeared.拾些琐事，做本随笔的是有的；改首古文，算是自作的是有的。讲一通昏话，称为评论；编几张期刊，暗捧自己的是有的。收罗猥谈，写成下作；聚集旧文，印作评传的是有的。甚至于翻些外国文坛消息，就成为世界文学史家；凑一本文学家辞典，连自己也塞在里面，就成为世界的文人的也有。然而，现在到底也都是中国的金字招牌的“文人”。
There are some who pick up trivial matters and make essays; Changing the ancient text is considered to be self-made. Talking a foolish word is called a comment; Edit a few journals, and secretly praise your own. collect obscene talk and write it into the next work; There are old texts that are collected and printed as commentaries. even flipping through some foreign literary news, he became a world literary historian; Make up a dictionary of literati, and even stuff yourself into it, and you will become the literati of the world. However, now they are all "literati" of China's golden signboard.文人不免无文，武人也一样不武。说是“枕戈待旦”的，到夜还没有动身，说是“誓死抵抗”的，看见一百多个敌兵就逃走了。只是通电宣言之类，却大做其骈体，“文”得异乎寻常。“偃武修文”，古有明训，文星全照到营子里去了。于是我们的“文人”，就只好不舐嘴唇，不搔头发，揣摩人情，单落得一个“有行”完事。
Literati are inevitably uncultured, and warriors are also not martial arts. It was said that he was "waiting for dawn", but he did not set off at night, and he said that he was "swearing to resist to the death", and fled when he saw more than a hundred enemy soldiers. It's just an electrified declaration, but it is a big way, and the "culture" is extraordinary. "Yanwu Xiuwen", there was a clear instruction in ancient times, and the literary stars were all illuminated into the camp. So our "literati" had no choice but not to lick their lips, not scratch their hair, figure out human feelings, and end up with a "good deed".三月二十八日。

【备考】：[Remarks]: 恶癖 Bad habit
若谷
Ruo Gu“文人无行”久为一般人所诟病。
"Literati have no virtue" has long been criticized by ordinary people.所谓“无行”，并不一定是不规则或不道德的行为，凡一切不近人情的恶劣行为，也都包括在内。
The so-called "no deeds" are not necessarily irregular or immoral behavior, but also include all impersonal and bad behavior.只要是人，谁都容易沾染不良的习惯，特别是文人，因为专心文字著作的缘故，在日常生活方面，自然免不了有怪异的举动，而且，或者也因为工作劳苦的缘故，十人中九人是染着不良嗜好，最普通的，是喜欢服用刺激神经的兴奋剂，卷烟与咖啡，是成为现代文人流行的嗜好品了。
As long as it is a person, everyone is prone to bad habits, especially literati, because of concentrating on written works, in daily life, it is inevitable that there will be strange behaviors, and, or because of hard work, nine out of ten people are infected with bad habits, the most common is to like to take stimulants that stimulate the nerves, cigarettes and coffee, which have become popular hobbies of modern literati.现代的日本文人，除了抽烟喝咖啡之外，各人都犯着各样的怪奇恶癖。前田河广一郎爱酒若命，醉后呶鸣不休；谷崎润一郎爱闻女人的体臭和尝女人的痰涕；今东光喜欢自炫学问宣传自己；金子洋文喜舐嘴唇；细田源吉喜作猥谈，朝食后熟睡二小时；宫地嘉六爱用指爪搔头发；宇野浩二醺醉后侮慢侍妓；林房雄有奸通癖；山本有三乘电车时喜横膝斜坐；胜本清一郎谈话时喜用拇指挖鼻孔。形形色色，不胜枚举。
Modern Japanese literati, in addition to smoking and drinking coffee, all commit all kinds of strange and vicious habits. Maeda Kawa Hiroichiro loves wine like his life, and he keeps screaming after getting drunk; Junichiro Tanizaki loves to smell women's body odor and taste women's phlegm; Jin Dongguang likes to show off his knowledge and promote himself; Kaneko Hirofumi likes to lick his lips; Genkichi Hosoda liked to talk lewdly and fell asleep for two hours after breakfast; Miyaji Jialoku loves to scratch his hair with his fingers; Uno Koji insulted the prostitute after getting drunk; Lin Fangxiong has an adulterous habit; Yamamoto has three trains and likes to sit cross-legged when he sits cross-legged; Seiichiro Katsumoto likes to pick his nose with his thumb when talking. The list goes on.日本现代文人所犯的恶癖，正和中国旧时文人辜鸿鸣喜闻女人金莲同样的可厌，我要求现代中国有为的青年，不但是文人，都要保持着健全的精神，切勿借了“文人无行”的幌子，再犯着和日本文人同样可诟病的恶癖。
I ask the promising young people of modern China, not only literati, but also to maintain a sound spirit, and never use the guise of "literati have no virtue" and commit the same reprehensible vices as Japanese literati.三月九日，《大晚报》副刊《辣椒与橄榄》。

【乘凉】：[Enjoying the coolness]: 两误一不同 The two mistakes are different
家干
Family dry这位木斋先生对我有两种误解，和我的意见有一点不同。
This Mr. Muzhai has two misunderstandings about me, which are a little different from my opinion.第一是关于“文”的界说。我的这篇杂感，是由《大晚报》副刊上的《恶癖》而来的，而那篇中所举的文人，都是小说作者。这事木斋先生明明知道，现在混而言之者，大约因为作文要紧，顾不及这些了罢，《第四种人》这题目，也实在时新得很。
The first is the theory of the world of "literature". My miscellaneous feelings came from "Vice" in the supplement of the "Evening News", and the literati mentioned in that article are all novel authors. Mr. Muzhai clearly knows that the current confuse is probably because the composition is important, and he doesn't care about these, and the topic of "The Fourth Kind of People" is really very new.第二是要我下“罪己诏”。我现在作一个无聊的声明：何家干诚然就是鲁迅，但并没有做皇帝。不过好在这样误解的人们也并不多。
The second is to ask me to issue an "edict to blame myself". I will now make a boring statement: He Jiagan is indeed Lu Xun, but he is not an emperor. But fortunately, there are not many people who misunderstand this.意见不同之点，是：凡有所指责时，木斋先生以自己包括在内为“风凉话”；我以自己不包括在内为“风凉话”，如身居上海，而责北平的学生应该赴难，至少是不逃难之类。
The differences of opinion are: when there is an accusation, Mr. Muzhai uses his own inclusion as "sarcastic remarks"; I think that I am not included as a "sarcastic remark", such as living in Shanghai, and blaming the students in Peking for going to the disaster, at least not fleeing.但由这一篇文章，我可实在得了很大的益处。就是：凡有指摘社会全体的症结的文字，论者往往谓之“骂人”。先前我是很以为奇的。至今才知道一部分人们的意见，是认为这类文章，决不含自己在内，因为如果兼包自己，是应该自下罪己诏的，现在没有诏书而有攻击，足见所指责的全是别人了，于是乎谓之“骂”。且从而群起而骂之，使其人背着一切所指摘的症结，沉入深渊，而天下于是乎太平。
But from this article, I really benefited a lot. That is, any text that points out the crux of society as a whole is often called "scolding" by commentators. I was very surprised before. I have only known that some people's opinions are that this kind of article will never include themselves, because if they include themselves, they should be punished by themselves, and now there is no edict and there is an attack, which shows that all the accusations are others, so it is called "scolding". And then they rose up and scolded him, so that he carried all the crux of the accusations and sank into the abyss, and the world was peaceful.七月十九日。July 19th.

最艺术的国家

The most artistic country我们中国的最伟大最永久，而且最普遍的“艺术”是男人扮女人。这艺术的可贵，是在于两面光，或谓之“中庸”——男人看见“扮女人”，女人看见“男人扮”。表面上是中性，骨子里当然还是男的。然而如果不扮，还成艺术么？譬如说，中国的固有文化是科举制度，外加捐班之类。当初说这太不像民权，不合时代潮流，于是扮成了中华民国。然而这民国年久失修，连招牌都已经剥落殆尽，仿佛花旦脸上的脂粉。同时，老实的民众真个要起政权来了，竟想革掉科甲出身和捐班出身的参政权。这对于民族是不忠，对于祖宗是不孝，实属反动之至。现在早已回到恢复固有文化的“时代潮流”，那能放任这种不忠不孝。因此，更不能不重新扮过一次，草案如下：第一，谁有代表国民的资格，须由考试决定。第二，考出了举人之后，再来挑选一次，此之谓选（动词）举人；而被挑选的举人，自然是被选举人了。照文法而论，这样的国民大会的选举人，应称为“选举人者”，而被选举人，应称为“被选之举人”。但是，如果不扮，还成艺术么？因此，他们得扮成宪政国家的选举的人和被选举人，虽则实质上还是秀才和举人。这草案的深意就在这里：叫民众看见是民权，而民族祖宗看见是忠孝——忠于固有科举的民族，孝于制定科举的祖宗。此外，像上海已经实现的民权，是纳税的方有权选举和被选，使偌大上海只剩四千四百六十五个大市民。这虽是捐班——有钱的为主，然而他们一定会考中举人，甚至不补考也会赐同进士出身的，因为洋大人膝下的榜样，理应遵照，何况这也并不是一面违背固有文化，一面又扮得很像宪政民权呢？此其一。
The greatest, most permanent and most common "art" in China is that men pretend to be women. The value of this art lies in the two sides of light, or the so-called "golden mean" - men see "pretending to be women", and women see "men pretending". On the surface, he is neutral, but of course he is still male in his bones. However, if you don't pretend, is it still art? For example, China's inherent culture is the imperial examination system, plus class donations. At the beginning, it was said that this was too unlike civil rights and not in line with the trend of the times, so it was pretended to be the Republic of China. However, the Republic of China has been in disrepair, and even the signboard has peeled off, like the powder on Hua Dan's face. At the same time, the honest people really want to come to power, and they actually want to abolish the right to participate in politics from the first class and the donation class. This is disloyal to the nation and unfilial to the ancestors, which is really reactionary. Now it has long returned to the "trend of the times" to restore the inherent culture, which can allow this kind of disloyalty and unfilial piety. Therefore, it is impossible not to redress it once, and the draft is as follows: First, who has the qualifications to represent the people must be determined by the examination. second, after the examination of the candidate, select again, which is called selecting (verb) the candidate; And the selected scholar is naturally the elected. According to the law, the electors of such a national congress should be called "electors", and the electors should be called "elected candidates". But if you don't pretend, is it still art? Therefore, they have to pretend to be elected and elected in a constitutional state, although they are essentially scholars and scholars. The deep meaning of this draft is here: let the people see that it is civil rights, and the ancestors of the nation see that it is loyalty and filial piety - loyal to the nation that is loyal to the inherent imperial examination, and filial piety to the ancestors who formulated the imperial examination. In addition, civil rights like those that have been realized in Shanghai are the right of taxpayers to vote and be elected, leaving only 4,465 citizens in the huge Shanghai. Although this is a donation class - the rich are the main, but they will definitely pass the examination, and even if they do not make up the exam, they will be given the same Jinshi background, because the example under the knees of foreigners should be followed, not to mention that this is not against the inherent culture, and on the other hand, it is very similar to constitutional civil rights? This is one of them.其二，一面交涉，一面抵抗：从这一方面看过去是抵抗，从那一面看过来其实是交涉。其三，一面做实业家，银行家，一面自称“小贫而已”。其四，一面日货销路复旺，一面对人说是“国货年”……诸如此类，不胜枚举，而大都是扮演得十分巧妙，两面光滑的。
Second, negotiate and resist on the other: from this side, it is resistance in the past, but from that side, it is actually negotiation. Third, while being an industrialist and banker, he claims to be "just a little poor". Fourth, on the one hand, the sales of Japanese goods are booming, and on the other hand, it is said to be the "year of domestic products"...... And so on, and so on, and most of them are very cleverly played and smooth on both sides.呵，中国真是个最艺术的国家，最中庸的民族。
Oh, China is really the most artistic country and the most moderate nation.然而小百姓还要不满意，呜呼，君子之中庸，小人之反中庸也！

现代史

现代史

现代史

Modern从我有记忆的时候起，直到现在，凡我所曾经到过的地方，在空地上，常常看见有“变把戏”的，也叫作“变戏法”的。
From the time I can remember, until now, wherever I have been, in the open space, I often see "tricks", also called "tricks".这变戏法的，大概只有两种——
There are probably only two kinds of tricks -一种，是教一个猴子戴起假面，穿上衣服，耍一通刀枪；骑了羊跑几圈。还有一匹用稀粥养活，已经瘦得皮包骨头的狗熊玩一些把戏。末后是向大家要钱。
One is to teach a monkey to wear a mask, put on clothes, and play a knife and gun; Ride a sheep for a few laps. There is also a bear that is fed with gruel and is already skinny. In the end, it is to ask everyone for money.一种，是将一块石头放在空盒子里，用手巾左盖右盖，变出一只白鸽来；还有将纸塞在嘴巴里，点上火，从嘴角鼻孔里冒出烟焰。其次是向大家要钱。要了钱之后，一个人嫌少，装腔作势的不肯变了，一个人来劝他，对大家说再五个。果然有人抛钱了，于是再四个，三个……
One is to put a stone in an empty box, cover it with a handkerchief on the left and right, and conjure up a white dove; There is also the paper stuffed in the mouth, the fire is lit, and smoke comes out of the nostrils of the corner of the mouth. The second is to ask everyone for money. After asking for money, one person was too little, and he refused to change, so one person came to persuade him and said five more to everyone. Sure enough, someone threw money, so four more, three ......抛足之后，戏法就又开了场。这回是将一个孩子装进小口的坛子里面去，只见一条小辫子，要他再出来，又要钱。收足之后，不知怎么一来，大人用尖刀将孩子刺死了，盖上被单，直挺挺躺着，要他活过来，又要钱。
After throwing the foot, the trick started again. This time I put a child into a small jar, and I saw a pigtail, asking him to come out again and ask for money. After collecting his feet, somehow, the adult stabbed the child to death with a sharp knife, covered him with a sheet, lay up straight, and asked him to come back to life and ask for money.“在家靠父母，出家靠朋友……Huazaa！Huazaa！”变戏法的装出撒钱的手势，严肃而悲哀的说。
"Rely on your parents at home, rely on your friends when you become a monk...... Huazaa！ Huazaa！ The trick pretended to be a gesture of throwing money, and said seriously and sadly.别的孩子，如果走近去想仔细的看，他是要骂的；再不听，他就会打。
Other children, if they get closer and look closely, they will scold them; If you don't listen, he will fight.果然有许多人Huazaa了。待到数目和预料的差不多，他们就检起钱来，收拾家伙，死孩子也自己爬起来，一同走掉了。
Sure enough, there are many people who are Huazaa. When the number was about the same as expected, they picked up the money, packed up the guys, and the dead child got up and walked away together.看客们也就呆头呆脑的走散。
The spectators were also separated in a daze.这空地上，暂时是沉寂了。过了些时，就又来这一套。俗语说，“戏法人人会变，各有巧妙不同。”其实是许多年间，总是这一套，也总有人看，总有人Huazaa，不过其间必须经过沉寂的几日。
In this open space, there was silence for the time being. After a while, this set came again. As the saying goes, "Everyone will change, and each has its own ingenuity." "In fact, for many years, it is always this set, and there are always people watching, and there are always people who are Huazaa, but there must be a few days of silence in between.我的话说完了，意思也浅得很，不过说大家Huazaa Huazaa一通之后，又要静几天了，然后再来这一套。
After my words are finished, the meaning is very shallow, but it is said that after everyone Huazaa Huazaa, it will be quiet for a few more days, and then come to this set.到这里我才记得写错了题目，这真是成了“不死不活”的东西。
Only then did I remember that I wrote the wrong title, which really became a "dead and not alive" thing.四月一日。

推背图

推背图

推背图

Push back picture我这里所用的“推背”的意思，是说：从反面来推测未来的情形。
The meaning of "pushing back" here is to speculate on the future situation from the opposite side.上月的《自由谈》里，就有一篇《正面文章反看法》，这是令人毛骨悚然的文字。因为得到这一个结论的时候，先前一定经过许多苦楚的经验，见过许多可怜的牺牲。本草家提起笔来，写道：砒霜，大毒。字不过四个，但他却确切知道了这东西曾经毒死过若干性命的了。
In last month's "Free Talk", there was an article "Positive Articles and Negative Views", which is a creepy text. Because when you come to this conclusion, you must have gone through many painful experiences and seen many pitiful sacrifices. The herbalist picked up the pen and wrote: Arsenic, great poison. There were only four words, but he knew exactly that this thing had poisoned several lives.里巷间有一个笑话：某甲将银子三十两埋在地里面，怕人知道，就在上面竖一块木板，写道：“此地无银三十两。”隔壁的阿二因此却将这掘去了，也怕人发觉，就在木板的那一面添上一句道，“隔壁阿二勿曾偷。”这就是在教人“正面文章反看法”。
There is a joke in the alley: a certain person buried thirty taels of silver in the ground, afraid that people would find out, so he erected a wooden board on it and wrote: "There is no thirty taels of silver here." Ah Er next door dug it up because of this, and he was afraid that people would find out, so he added a sentence on the other side of the board, "Don't steal Ah Er next door." This is teaching people to "positive articles and negative views".但我们日日所见的文章，却不能这么简单。有明说要做，其实不做的；有明说不做，其实要做的；有明说做这样，其实做那样的；有其实自己要这么做，倒说别人要这么做的；有一声不响，而其实倒做了的。然而也有说这样，竟这样的。难就在这地方。
But the articles we see every day cannot be so simple. There are things that are clearly said to be done, but are not actually done; There are things that are clearly said not to be done, but in fact to be done; You say to do this, but in fact do that; In fact, I want to do this, but I say that others want to do it; There was a silence, but in fact, it was done the other way around. However, there are also those who say this, and they are like this. The difficulty lies in this place.例如近几天报章上记载着的要闻罢：
For example, the news recorded in the newspapers in recent days:一，××军在××血战，杀敌××××人。
First, the ×× army fought bloody battles in ×× and killed ×××× enemies.二，××谈话：决不与日本直接交涉，仍然不改初衷，抵抗到底。
2. ×× talk: Never negotiate directly with Japan, still do not change its original intention, and resist to the end.三，芳泽来华，据云系私人事件。
Third, Fangze came to China, which is said to be a private matter.四，共党联日，该伪中央已派干部××赴日接洽。
Fourth, on the day of the Communist Party, the puppet central government has sent cadres ×× to Japan to contact.五，××××……
V, ××××......倘使都当反面文章看，可就太骇人了。但报上也有“莫干山路草棚船百余只大火”，“××××廉价只有四天了”等大概无须“推背”的记载，于是乎我们就又胡涂起来。
If you read it as a negative article, it will be too scary. But there are also records in the newspaper that "more than 100 thatched hut boats on Moganshan Road caught fire", "×××× cheap is only four days", etc., so we started to scribble again.听说，《推背图》本是灵验的，某朝某帝怕他淆惑人心，就添了些假造的在里面，因此弄得不能预知了，必待事实证明之后，人们这才恍然大悟。
I heard that the "Tui Bei Tu" was originally effective, and a certain emperor of a certain dynasty was afraid that he would confuse people's hearts, so he added some fakes to it, so it was impossible to predict, and it had to be proven before people suddenly realized.我们也只好等着看事实，幸而大概是不很久的，总出不了今年。
We have to wait to see the facts, but fortunately, it won't be long, and it won't be this year.四月二日。

《杀错了人》异议

《杀错了人》异议

《杀错了人》异议

"Killing the Wrong Person" objected看了曹聚仁先生的一篇《杀错了人》，觉得很痛快，但往回一想，又觉得有些还不免是愤激之谈了，所以想提出几句异议——
After reading Mr. Cao Juren's article "Killing the Wrong Person", I felt very happy, but when I thought about it, I felt that some of it was inevitably indignant, so I wanted to raise a few objections -袁世凯在辛亥革命之后，大杀党人，从袁世凯那方面看来，是一点没有杀错的，因为他正是一个假革命的反革命者。
Yuan Shikai killed party members after the Xinhai Revolution, and from Yuan Shikai's point of view, he was not wrong at all, because he was a counter-revolutionary of a false revolution.错的是革命者受了骗，以为他真是一个筋斗，从北洋大臣变了革命家了，于是引为同调，流了大家的血，将他浮上总统的宝位去。到二次革命时，表面上好像他又是一个筋斗，从“国民公仆”变了吸血魔王似的。其实不然，他不过又显了本相。
The wrong thing is that the revolutionary was deceived, thinking that he was really a somersault, and changed from a minister of Beiyang to a revolutionary, so he was introduced as a conspirator, shed everyone's blood, and floated him to the throne of the president. By the time of the Second Revolution, it seemed as if he was a somersault again, from a "servant of the people" to a vampire demon king. In fact, he just showed his true self.于是杀，杀，杀。北京城里，连饭店客栈中，都满布了侦探；还有“军政执法处”，只见受了嫌疑而被捕的青年送进去，却从不见他们活着走出来；还有，《政府公报》上，是天天看见党人脱党的广告，说是先前为友人所拉，误入该党，现在自知迷谬，从此脱离，要洗心革面的做好人了。
So kill, kill, kill. In Beijing, even hotels and inns are full of detectives; There is also the "Military and Political Law Enforcement Office", where young people who were arrested on suspicion were sent in, but they were never seen come out alive; In addition, in the "Government Gazette", I saw advertisements for party members leaving the party every day, saying that they had been pulled by friends and mistakenly joined the party, but now they know that they are mistaken, and they will break away from it and be a good person with a change of heart.不久就证明了袁世凯杀人的没有杀错，他要做皇帝了。
Soon it was proved that Yuan Shikai did not kill people wrong, and he was going to be emperor.这事情，一转眼竟已经是二十年，现在二十来岁的青年，那时还在吸奶，时光是多么飞快呵。
This matter has been twenty years in the blink of an eye, and now the young man in his twenties was still pumping milk at that time, how fast time was.但是，袁世凯自己要做皇帝，为什么留下他真正对头的旧皇帝呢？这无须多议论，只要看现在的军阀混战就知道。他们打得你死我活，好像不共戴天似的，但到后来，只要一个“下野”了，也就会客客气气的，然而对于革命者呢，即使没有打过仗，也决不肯放过一个。他们知道得很清楚。
However, Yuan Shikai himself wanted to be the emperor, so why did he leave the old emperor who was his real opponent? There is no need to talk about this, just look at the current warlord melee. They fight to the death, as if they are not in the same league, but later, as long as one "goes to the wild", they will be polite, but for the revolutionaries, even if they have not fought a war, they will never let one go. They know it very well.所以我想，中国革命的闹成这模样，并不是因为他们“杀错了人”，倒是因为我们看错了人。
So I think that the Chinese revolution became like this not because they "killed the wrong person", but because we saw the wrong person.临末，对于“多杀中年以上的人”的主张，我也有一点异议，但因为自己早在“中年以上”了，为避免嫌疑起见，只将眼睛看着地面罢。
At the end of the day, I also had a little objection to the idea of "killing more middle-aged and older people", but because I was already "middle-aged and older", in order to avoid suspicion, I only looked at the ground.四月十日。

Diary of April 12.

《杀错了人》异议

【备考】：[Notes]: 杀错了人 killed the wrong person
曹聚仁
Cao Juren前日某报载某君述长春归客的谈话，说：日本人在伪国已经完成“专卖鸦片”和“统一币制”的两大政策。这两件事，从前在老张小张时代，大家认为无法整理，现在他们一举手之间，办得有头有绪。所以某君叹息道：“愚尝与东北人士论币制紊乱之害，咸以积重难返，诿为难办；何以日人一刹那间，即毕乃事？‘是不为也，非不能也。’此为国人一大病根！”
The day before yesterday, a newspaper reported a conversation about a returning guest from Changchun, saying: The Japanese have completed the two major policies of "monopoly on opium" and "unified currency system" in the puppet country. These two things, in the era of Lao Zhang and Xiao Zhang, everyone thought they could not sort them out, but now they have done it in a single gesture. Therefore, a certain gentleman sighed: "I once discussed the harm of currency system disorder with the people of the Northeast, and they all thought that it was difficult to return and difficult to handle; Why can a person finish their work in an instant? 'It's not that I can't do it, but it's not impossible.' This is a major problem for the Chinese people! ”岂独“病根”而已哉！中华民族的灭亡和中华民国的颠覆，也就在这肺痨病上。一个社会，一个民族，到了衰老期，什么都“积重难返”，所以非“革命”不可。革命是社会的突变过程；在过程中，好人，坏人，与不好不坏的人，总要杀了一些。杀了一些人，并不是没有代价的：于社会起了隔离作用，旧的社会和新的社会截然分成两段，恶的势力不会传染到新的组织中来。所以革命杀人应该有标准，应该多杀中年以上的人，多杀代表旧势力的人。法国大革命的成功，即在大恐慌时期的扫荡旧势力。
Is it just the "root of the disease"? The demise of the Chinese nation and the subversion of the Republic of China are also in this tuberculosis. A society and a nation, when it reaches the age of aging, everything is "difficult to return", so it must be a "revolution". Revolution is a process of mutation in society; In the process, good people, bad people, and bad people always have to kill some. Killing some people is not without a price: it has a role in isolating society, the old society and the new society are divided into two parts, and the evil forces will not spread to the new organization. Therefore, there should be a standard for revolutionary killing, and more middle-aged and older people should be killed, and more people representing the old forces should be killed. The success of the French Revolution, that is, the sweep of the old forces during the Great Depression.可是中国每一回的革命，总是反了常态。许多青年因为参加革命运动，做了牺牲；革命进程中，旧势力一时躲开去，一些也不曾铲除掉；革命成功以后，旧势力重复涌了出来，又把青年来做牺牲品，杀了一大批。孙中山先生辛辛苦苦做了十来年革命工作，辛亥革命成功了，袁世凯拿大权，天天杀党人，甚至连十五六岁的孩子都要杀；这样的革命，不但不起隔离作用，简直替旧势力作保镖；因此民国以来，只有暮气，没有朝气，任何事业，都不必谈改革，一谈改革，必“积重难返，诿为难办”。其恶势力一直注到现在。
But every revolution in China is always against the norm. Many young people have made sacrifices because they participated in the revolutionary movement; In the process of revolution, the old forces avoided for a while, and some were not eradicated; After the success of the revolution, the old forces repeatedly poured out, and the young people were sacrificed and killed a large number of people. Mr. Sun Yat-sen worked hard for more than ten years of revolutionary work, and the Xinhai Revolution was successful, Yuan Shikai took power, killed party members every day, and even killed children aged fifteen or sixteen; Such a revolution not only does not have an isolating effect, but simply acts as a bodyguard for the old forces; Therefore, since the Republic of China, there has been only twilight, no vitality, and there is no need to talk about reform in any cause. Its evil forces have been pouring into the present.这种反常状态，我名之曰“杀错了人”。我常和朋友说：“不流血的革命是没有的，但‘流血’不可流错了人。早杀溥仪，多杀郑孝胥之流，方是邦国之大幸。若乱杀二十五岁以下的青年，倒行逆施，斫丧社会元气，就可以得‘亡国灭种’的‘眼前报’。”
This abnormal state is what I call "killing the wrong person". I often say to my friends: "There is no bloodless revolution, but 'bloodshed' must not be shed by the wrong person." Killing Puyi early and killing many like Zheng Xiaoxu was a great fortune for the state. If you kill young people under the age of 25 indiscriminately, go against the grain and lose the vitality of society, you can get the 'immediate retribution' of 'subjugation of the country and the extinction of the species'. ”《自由谈》，四月十日。"Free Talk", April 10.

中国人的生命圈

中国人的生命圈

中国人的生命圈

Chinese life circle“蝼蚁尚知贪生”，中国百姓向来自称“蚁民”，我为暂时保全自己的生命计，时常留心着比较安全的处所，除英雄豪杰之外，想必不至于讥笑我的罢。
"Ants still know to be greedy for life", the Chinese people have always called themselves "ant people", in order to temporarily preserve my life, I often pay attention to relatively safe places, except for heroes and heroes, I must not laugh at me.不过，我对于正面的记载，是不大相信的，往往用一种另外的看法。例如罢，报上说，北平正在设备防空，我见了并不觉得可靠；但一看见载着古物的南运，却立刻感到古城的危机，并且由这古物的行踪，推测中国乐土的所在。
However, I don't believe in positive records, and often use a different view. For example, the newspaper said that Peiping was equipping air defense, and I didn't think it was reliable when I saw it; But as soon as he saw the southern transport carrying antiquities, he immediately felt the crisis of the ancient city, and speculated about the location of China's paradise from the whereabouts of this antiquity.现在，一批一批的古物，都集中到上海来了，可见最安全的地方，到底也还是上海的租界上。
Now, batches of antiquities have been concentrated in Shanghai, which shows that the safest place is still in the Shanghai Concession.然而，房租是一定要贵起来的了。
However, the rent must be expensive.这在“蚁民”，也是一个大打击，所以还得想想另外的地方。
This is also a big blow to "Ant People", so we have to think about other places.想来想去，想到了一个“生命圈”。这就是说，既非“腹地”，也非“边疆”，是介乎两者之间，正如一个环子，一个圈子的所在，在这里倒或者也可以“苟延性命于×世”的。
After thinking about it, I thought of a "circle of life". This means that it is neither a "hinterland" nor a "frontier", but between the two, just like a ring, a circle, where it may or can also "survive in the × world".“边疆”上是飞机抛炸弹。据日本报，说是在剿灭“兵匪”；据中国报，说是屠戮了人民，村落市廛，一片瓦砾。“腹地”里也是飞机抛炸弹。据上海报，说是在剿灭“共匪”，他们被炸得一塌胡涂；“共匪”的报上怎么说呢，我们可不知道。但总而言之，边疆上是炸，炸，炸；腹地里也是炸，炸，炸。虽然一面是别人炸，一面是自己炸，炸手不同，而被炸则一。只有在这两者之间的，只要炸弹不要误行落下来，倒还有可免“血肉横飞”的希望，所以我名之曰“中国人的生命圈”。
On the "frontier" are planes dropping bombs. According to the Japanese newspaper, it is said that it is exterminating "soldiers and bandits"; According to the China Daily, it is said that the people were slaughtered, and the villages and markets were in rubble. There are also planes dropping bombs in the "hinterland". According to the poster, it is said that they are exterminating the "communist bandits", and they were blown up to a pulp; We don't know what the newspaper says about the "communist bandits". But all in all, the frontier is bombing, blowing, blowing; The hinterland is also fried, fried, fried. Although one side is bombed by others and the other side is bombed by oneself, the bombers are different, and the bombing is one. Only between the two, as long as the bomb does not fall by mistake, there is still hope to avoid "flesh and blood", so I named it "Chinese Life Circle".再从外面炸进来，这“生命圈”便收缩而为“生命线”；再炸进来，大家便都逃进那炸好了的“腹地”里面去，这“生命圈”便完结而为“生命〇”。
and then blow in from the outside, and this "circle of life" shrinks into a "lifeline"; If it explodes in again, everyone will flee into the "hinterland" that has been blown up, and this "circle of life" will end and become "life 〇".其实，这预感是大家都有的，只要看这一年来，文章上不大见有“我中国地大物博，人口众多”的套话了，便是一个证据。而有一位先生，还在演说上自己说中国人是“弱小民族”哩。
In fact, everyone has this premonition, as long as you look at the past year, there is not much cliché in the article "I am a big country in China and a large population", which is a proof. And there is a gentleman who even said in his speech that the Chinese are a "weak nation".但这一番话，阔人们是不以为然的，因为他们不但有飞机，还有他们的“外国”！
But the people of Kuoyang disagreed with these words, because they not only had planes, but also their "foreign countries"!四月十日。
April 10th.

内外

内外

内外

inside and outside古人说内外有别，道理各各不同。丈夫叫“外子”，妻叫“贱内”。伤兵在医院之内，而慰劳品在医院之外，非经查明，不准接收。对外要安，对内就要攘，或者嚷。
The ancients said that there is a difference between inside and outside, and the truth is different. The husband is called "the son", and the wife is called the "cheap wife". Wounded soldiers are in the hospital, but the consolation items are outside the hospital, and they are not allowed to be accepted without ascertainment. If you want to be safe externally, you have to rob or shout internally.
何香凝先生叹气：“当年唯恐其不起者，今日唯恐其不死。”然而死的道理也是内外不同的。
Mr. He Xiangning sighed: "Back then, I was afraid that he would not die, but today I am afraid that he will not die." However, the principle of death is also different inside and outside.
庄子曰，“哀莫大于心死，而身死次之。”次之者，两害取其轻也。所以，外面的身体要它死，而内心要它活；或者正因为那心活，所以把身体治死。此之谓治心。
Zhuangzi said, "There is no greater sorrow than death in the heart, and death in the body is secondary." "The second is to choose the lesser of the two harms. Therefore, the outer body wants it to die, but the inner body wants it to live; Or it is precisely because of that heart that the body is killed. This is called managing the heart.
治心的道理很玄妙：心固然要活，但不可过于活。
The principle of treating the mind is very mysterious: the heart must live, but it must not be too alive.
心死了，就明明白白地不抵抗，结果，反而弄得大家不镇静。心过于活了，就胡思乱想，当真要闹抵抗：这种人，“绝对不能言抗日”。
When the heart is dead, it clearly does not resist, but as a result, it makes everyone uncalm. If the heart is too alive, it will think wildly and really want to resist: this kind of person "absolutely cannot speak of resisting Japan".
为要镇静大家，心死的应该出洋，留学是到外国去治心的方法。
In order to calm everyone, those who are heartless should go abroad, and studying abroad is a way to cure their hearts in a foreign country.而心过于活的，是有罪，应该严厉处置，这才是在国内治心的方法。
And if the heart is too alive, it is guilty and should be dealt with severely, which is the way to cure the heart in China.
何香凝先生以为“谁为罪犯是很成问题的”，——这就因为她不懂得内外有别的道理。
Mr. He Xiangning thinks that "who is a criminal is very problematic",—— because she doesn't understand that there is a difference between inside and outside.四月十一日。
April 11th.

透底

透底

透底

Through the bottom凡事彻底是好的，而“透底”就不见得高明。因为连续的向左转，结果碰见了向右转的朋友，那时候彼此点头会意，脸上会要辣辣的。要自由的人，忽然要保障复辟的自由，或者屠杀大众的自由，——透底是透底的了，却连自由的本身也漏掉了，原来只剩得一个无底洞。
Everything is completely good, but "thoroughly" is not necessarily clever. Because of the continuous turn to the left, I met a friend who turned right, and at that time nodded to each other, and his face would be spicy. Those who want freedom suddenly want to guarantee the freedom of restoration or the freedom to slaughter the masses,—— but even freedom itself is missed, and there is only a bottomless pit left.譬如反对八股是极应该的。八股原是蠢笨的产物。一来是考官嫌麻烦——他们的头脑大半是阴沉木做的，——甚么代圣贤立言，甚么起承转合，文章气韵，都没有一定的标准，难以捉摸，因此，一股一股地定出来，算是合于功令的格式，用这格式来“衡文”，一眼就看得出多少轻重。二来，连应试的人也觉得又省力，又不费事了。这样的八股，无论新旧，都应当扫荡。但是，这是为着要聪明，不是要更蠢笨些。
For example, it is very appropriate to oppose the eight shares. The eight strands were originally the product of stupidity. First, the examiners find it troublesome - most of their minds are made of gloomy wood,—— what is said on behalf of the sages, what is the beginning and end, and the charm of the article, there is no certain standard and elusive, so it is determined one by one, which is a format that is in line with the merit order, and using this format to "balance the text", you can see how much weight it is at a glance. Second, even the candidates feel that it is labor-saving and trouble-free. Such eight strands, whether old or new, should be swept away. However, this is to be smart, not to be more stupid.不过要保存蠢笨的人，却有一种策略。他们说：“我不行，而他和我一样。”——大家活不成，拉倒大吉！而等“他”拉倒之后，旧的蠢笨的“我”却总是偷偷地又站起来，实惠是属于蠢笨的。好比要打倒偶像，偶像急了，就指着一切活人说，“他们都像我”，于是你跑去把貌似偶像的活人，统统打倒；回来，偶像会赞赏一番，说打倒偶像而打倒“打倒”者，确是透底之至。其实，这时候更大的蠢笨，笼罩了全世界。
But there is a strategy to save stupid people. They said, "I can't, and he's the same as me." ——Everyone can't live, pull down the big luck! And after "he" pulls down, the old stupid "I" always stands up secretly, and the benefits are stupid. For example, if you want to overthrow an idol, the idol is anxious and you point to all the living people and say, "They are all like me," so you run to knock down all the living people who look like idols. When they come back, the idol will praise it, saying that it is indeed the bottom line to defeat the idol and defeat the "knockdown". In fact, at this time, even greater stupidity enveloped the world.开口诗云子曰，这是老八股；而有人把“达尔文说，蒲力汗诺夫曰”也算做新八股。于是要知道地球是圆的，人人都要自己去环游地球一周；要制造汽机的，也要先坐在开水壶前格物……。这自然透底之极。其实，从前反对卫道文学，原是说那样吃人的“道”不应该卫，而有人要透底，就说什么道也不卫；这“什么道也不卫”难道不也是一种“道”么？所以，真正最透底的，还是下列的一个故事：
The opening poem Yunzi said, this is the old eight strands; And some people call "Darwin," Pulikhanov said, "as a new eight-share." Therefore, we must know that the earth is round, and everyone has to go around the earth by themselves; If you want to make a steam engine, you must first sit in front of the boiling kettle and ...... the grid. This is the ultimate in nature. In fact, in the past, when opposing Guardian literature, it was originally said that the "Tao" that cannibalized people should not be defended, and if someone wants to get to the bottom, they will say that the Tao is not defended; Isn't this "no Tao" also a kind of "Tao"? Therefore, the most thorough is the following story:古时候一个国度里革命了，旧的政府倒下去，新的站上来。旁人说，“你这革命党，原先是反对有政府主义的，怎么自己又来做政府？”那革命党立刻拔出剑来，割下了自己的头；但是，他的身体并不倒，而变成了僵尸，直立着，喉管里吞吞吐吐地似乎是说：这主义的实现原本要等三千年之后呢。
In ancient times, there was a revolution in a country, the old government fell, and a new one stood up. Others said, "Your revolutionary party was originally against anarchism, why did you come to the government again?" The revolutionary party immediately drew his sword and cut off his own head; However, his body did not fall, but turned into a zombie, standing upright, and his throat seemed to say: The realization of this doctrine would have to wait three thousand years later.四月十一日。
April 11th.

“以夷制夷”

“以夷制夷”

“以夷制夷”

"Defeat the barbarians with barbarians"我还记得，当去年中国有许多人，一味哭诉国联的时候，日本的报纸上往往加以讥笑，说这是中国祖传的“以夷制夷”的老手段。粗粗一看，也仿佛有些像的，但是，其实不然。那时的中国的许多人，的确将国联看作“青天大老爷”，心里何尝还有一点儿“夷”字的影子。
I still remember that when many people in China blindly cried about the League of Nations last year, Japanese newspapers often ridiculed it, saying that this was the old method of "using barbarians to control barbarians" in China. At first glance, it seems to be a bit similar, but it is not. At that time, many people in China did regard the League of Nations as the "Great Master of the Blue Sky", and there was still a shadow of the word "Yi" in their hearts.倒相反，“青天大老爷”们却常常用着“以华制华”的方法的。
On the contrary, the "Blue Sky Masters" often use the method of "using China to control China".例如罢，他们所深恶的反帝国主义的“犯人”，他们自己倒是不做恶人的，只是松松爽爽的送给华人，叫你自己去杀去。他们所痛恨的腹地的“共匪”，他们自己是并不明白表示意见的，只将飞机炸弹卖给华人，叫你自己去炸去。对付下等华人的有黄帝子孙的巡捕和西崽，对付智识阶级的有高等华人的学者和博士。
For example, the anti-imperialist "prisoners" they hate so much do not become evil people themselves, but simply give them to the Chinese and ask you to kill them yourself. The "communist bandits" in the hinterland they hated did not understand the expression of opinions, and only sold plane bombs to the Chinese and told you to blow them up yourself. The lower Chinese were dealt with by the patrols and western cubs of the descendants of the Yellow Emperor, and the scholars and doctors of the higher Chinese were dealt with by the intellectual class.我们自夸了许多日子的“大刀队”，好像是无法制伏的了，然而四月十五日的《××报》上，有一个用头号字印《我斩敌二百》的题目。粗粗一看，是要令人觉得胜利的，但我们再来看一看本文罢——
We boasted of the "big knife team" for many days, which seemed to be impossible to subdue, but in the "×× News" on April 15, there was a title printed with the number one word "I slay two hundred enemies". At first glance, it is to make people feel victorious, but let's take a look at this article -“（本报今日北平电）昨日喜峰口右翼，仍在滦阳城以东各地，演争夺战。敌出现大刀队千名，系新开到者，与我大刀队对抗。其刀特长，敌使用不灵活。我军挥刀砍抹，敌招架不及，连刀带臂，被我砍落者纵横满地，我军伤亡亦达二百余。……”
Yesterday, the right wing of Xifengkou was still in various places east of Luanyang City, playing a battle. The enemy appeared with a thousand big knives, who were new to the team, and confronted our big knife team. The knife is special, and the enemy is not flexible in use. Our army swung its swords and wiped, and the enemy could not parry, and the knives and arms were cut down all over the ground, and our casualties reached more than 200. ……”那么，这其实是“敌斩我军二百”了，中国的文字，真是像“国步”一样，正在一天一天的艰难起来。但我要指出来的却并不在此。
Then, this is actually "the enemy has killed our army by 200", and China's words are really like "national steps", which is becoming difficult day by day. But that's not what I'm going to point out.我要指出来的是“大刀队”乃中国人自夸已久的特长，日本人虽有击剑，大刀却非素习。现在可是“出现”了，这不必迟疑，就可决定是满洲的军队。满洲从明末以来，每年即大有直隶山东人迁居，数代之后，成为土著，则虽是满洲军队，而大多数实为华人，也决无疑义。现在已经各用了特长的大刀，在滦东相杀起来，一面是“连刀带臂，纵横满地”，一面是“伤亡亦达二百余”，开演了极显著的“以华制华”的一幕了。
I want to point out that the "big knife team" is a long-boasted specialty of the Chinese, and although the Japanese have fencing, the big knife is not a common practice. Now that it has "appeared", it can be decided that it is the Manchurian army without hesitation. Since the end of the Ming Dynasty, Manchuria has been relocated by a large number of directly subordinate Shandong people every year, and after several generations, they have become indigenous people, although they are Manchurian troops, most of them are actually Chinese, and there is no doubt about it. Now they have used their own special swords to kill each other in Luandong, on the one hand, "with knives and arms, all over the ground", and on the other hand, "more than 200 casualties", a very significant scene of "using China to control China" has begun.至于中国的所谓手段，由我看来，有是也应该说有的，但决非“以夷制夷”，倒是想“以夷制华”。然而“夷”又那有这么愚笨呢，却先来一套“以华制华”给你看。
As for China's so-called means, in my opinion, there are and should be said to be, but it is by no means "using barbarians to control barbarians", but wanting to "use barbarians to control China". However, how can "Yi" be so stupid, but let me first show you a set of "China to control China".这例子常见于中国的历史上，后来的史官为新朝作颂，称此辈的行为曰：“为王前驱！”
This example is common in Chinese history, and later historians praised the new dynasty, calling the behavior of this generation "the forerunner of the king!" ”近来的战报是极可诧异的，如同日同报记冷口失守云：“十日以后，冷口方面之战，非常激烈，华军……顽强抵抗，故继续未曾有之大激战”，但由宫崎部队以十余兵士，作成人梯，前仆后继，“卒越过长城，因此宫崎部队牺牲二十三名之多云”。越过一个险要，而日军只死了二十三人，但已云“之多”，又称为“未曾有之大激战”，也未免有些费解。所以大刀队之战，也许并不如我所猜测。但既经写出，就姑且留下以备一说罢。
The recent battle report is extremely surprising, just like the same day reported the loss of Lengkou: "Ten days later, the battle in the cold mouth is very fierce, and the Chinese army ...... Tenacious resistance, so it continued to fight fiercely that had never been seen before", but by the Miyazaki troops with more than ten soldiers, they became human ladders, and the servants followed one after another, "the soldiers crossed the Great Wall, so the Miyazaki troops sacrificed 23 clouds". After crossing a dangerous point, the Japanese army only killed twenty-three people, but it has been said that "many", also known as "unprecedented fierce battle", is also a little puzzling. So the battle of the big knife team may not be as I guessed. But since it has been written, I will leave it for now.四月十七日。

“以夷制夷”

【跳踉】：【跳踉】：“以华制华”“以华制华”
李家作
李家作报纸不可不看。在报上不但可以看到虔修功德如念念阿弥陀佛，选拔国士如征求飞檐走壁之类的“善”文，还可以随时长许多见识。譬如说杀人，以前只知道有斫头绞颈子，现在却知道还有吃人肉，而且还有“以夷制夷”，“以华制华”等等的分别。经明眼人一说，是越想越觉得不错的。
Newspapers must be read. In the newspaper, you can not only see the merits of pious cultivation such as reciting Amitabha Buddha, and the selection of national scholars such as soliciting "good" articles such as soliciting flying eaves and walking on walls, but also gain a lot of knowledge at any time. For example, when it comes to killing people, I used to only know that there was cutting off the head and strangling the neck, but now I know that there is also eating human flesh, and there are also differences such as "using barbarians to control barbarians", "using China to control China" and so on. After being said by a discerning person, the more I thought about it, the better I felt.尤其是“以华制华”，那样的手段真是越想越觉得多的。原因是人太多了，华对华并不会亲热；而且为了自身的利害要坐大交椅，当然非解决别人不可。所以那“制”是，无论如何要“制”的。假如因为制人而能得到好处，或是因为制人而能讨得上头的欢心，那自然更其起劲。这心理，夷人就很善于利用，从侵略土地到卖卖肥皂，都是用的这“华人”善于“制华”的美点。然而，华人对华人，其实也很会利用这种方法，而且非常巧妙。双方不必明言，彼此心照，各得其所；旁人看来，不露痕迹。据说那被利用的人便是哈吧狗，即走狗。但细细甄别起来，倒并不只是哈吧狗一种，另外还有一种是警犬。
Especially "using China to control China", the more I think about such a method, the more I feel it. The reason is that there are too many people, and China will not be affectionate with China; And for the sake of one's own interests, you have to sit in the big chair, of course, you have to solve others. Therefore, the "system" is, no matter what, it must be "controlled". If you can get benefits because of controlling people, or if you can please others because you control people, then you will naturally be more energetic. This psychology is very good at using the barbarians, from invading the land to selling soap, they are all using the beauty of the "Chinese" who are good at "making China". However, the Chinese are actually very good at using this method against the Chinese, and it is very ingenious. The two sides do not have to say it clearly, they understand each other's hearts and get their place; In the eyes of others, there is no trace. It is said that the person who was used was the Haba dog, that is, the lackey. But if you look closely, it is not just a Haba dog, there is another kind of police dog.做哈吧狗与做警犬，当然都是“以华制华”，但其中也不无分别。哈吧狗只能听主人吩咐，向仇人摇摇尾，狂吠几声。他知道他是什么样的身分。警犬则不然：老于世故者往往如此。他只认定自己是一个好汉，是一个权威，是一个执大义以绳天下者。在那门庭间的方寸之地上，只有他可以彷徨彷徨，呐喊呐喊。他的威风没有人敢冒犯，和哈吧狗比较起来，哈吧狗真是浅薄得可怜。但何以也是“以华制华”呢？那是因为虽然老于世故，也不免露出破绽。破绽是：他俨若嫉恶如仇，平时蹲在地上冷眼旁观，一看到有类乎“可杀”的情形时，就踪身向前，猛咬一口；可是，他决不是乱咬，他早已看得分明，凡在他寄身的地段上的（他当然不能不有一个寄身的地方），他决不伤害，有了也只当不看见，以免引起“不便”。他咬，是咬圈子外头的，尤其是，圈子外头最碍眼的仇人。这便是勇，这便是执大义，同时，既可显出自己的权威，又可博得主人底欢心：因为，他所咬的，往往会是他和他东家的共同的敌人。主人对于他所痛恨，自己是并不明白表示意见的，只给你一些供养和地位，叫你自己去咬去。因此有接二连三的奋勇，和吹毛求疵的找机会。旁观者不免有点不明白，觉得这仇太深，却不知道这正是老于世故者的做人之道，所谓向恶社会“搏战”“周旋”是也。那样的用心，真是很苦！
Being a Haba dog and being a police dog are of course both "using China to control China", but there is no difference. The dog could only listen to the owner's instructions, wagging its tail at the enemy and barking a few times. He knows what kind of identity he is. Police dogs are different: they are often older than the world. He only considers himself a good man, an authority, and a person who upholds righteousness to bring justice to the world. In the square inch of land between the courts, only he could hesitate and shout. No one dares to offend his majesty, compared with the Haba dog, the Haba dog is really pitifully shallow. But why is it also "using China to control China"? That's because although he is older than the world, he can't help but show flaws. The flaw is: he is jealous of evil, usually squatting on the ground and watching coldly, and when he sees a situation similar to "killable", he will move forward and bite hard; However, he is by no means biting indiscriminately, he has already seen clearly, he will never hurt anything on the lot where he lives (of course he can't have a place to stay), and if he does, he will only not see it, so as not to cause "inconvenience". He bites, biting the outside of the circle, especially the most eyesore enemy outside the circle. This is courage, this is righteousness, and at the same time, it can not only show its authority, but also win the favor of its master: because what he bites is often the common enemy of him and his owner. The master does not understand the opinion of what he hates, and only gives you some support and status, and tells you to bite yourself. Therefore, there is a series of bravery and nitpicking opportunities. Bystanders can't help but feel a little incomprehensible, feeling that this hatred is too deep, but they don't know that this is the way of life of the old and deceased, the so-called "fighting" and "dealing with" the evil society. That kind of intention is really bitter!所可哀者，为了要挣扎在替天行道的大旗之下，竟然不惜受员外府君之类的供奉，把那旗子斜插在庄院的门楼边，暂且作个“江湖一应水碗不得骚扰”的招贴纸儿。也可见得做中国人的不容易，和“以华制华”的效劳，虽贤者亦不免焉。
The sad thing is that in order to struggle under the banner of acting for the heavens, he did not hesitate to accept offerings such as the lord of the manor, and planted the flag diagonally next to the gatehouse of the manor, temporarily making a poster that said, "The rivers and lakes should not be harassed". It can also be seen that it is not easy to be Chinese, and the service of "using China to control China" is inevitable even for the sages.——二二，四，二一。

【摇摆】：[Swing]: 过而能改 can be changed after passing
傅红蓼
Fu Hongsmart孔老夫子，在从前教训着那么许多门生说：“过而能改，善莫大焉！”意思是错误人人都有，只要能够回头。我觉得孔老夫子这句话尚有未尽意处，譬如说：“过而能改，善莫大焉”之后，再加上一句：“知过不改，罪孽深重”，那便觉得天衣无缝了。
Old Master Kong taught so many disciples in the past: "If you can change your mistakes, there is no greater good!" It means that everyone has mistakes, as long as they can turn back. I think there are still unfinished points in this sentence of Master Kong, for example, after saying: "If you can change your mistakes, there is no greater good", and then add a sentence: "If you know your mistakes and do not change, your sins are deep", then I feel seamless.譬如说现在前线打得落花流水的时候，而有人觉得这种为国牺牲是残酷，是无聊，便主张不要打，而且更主张不要讲和，只说索性藏起头来，等个五十年。俗谚常有“十年生聚，十年教训”，看起来五十年的教训，大概什么都够了。凡事有了错误，才有教训，可见中国人尚还有些救药，国事弄得乌烟瘴气到如此，居然大家都恍然大觉大悟自己内部组织的三大不健全，更而发现武器的不充足。眼前须要几十个年头，来作准备。言至此，吾人对于热河一直到滦东的失守，似乎应当有些感到失得不大冤枉。因为吾党（借用）建基以至于今日，由军事而至于宪政，尚还没有人肯认过错，则现在失掉几个国土，使一些负有自信天才的国家栋梁学贯中西的名儒，居然都肯认错，所谓“过而能改，善莫大焉”，塞翁失马，又安知非福的聊以自慰，也只得闭着眼睛喊两声了，不过假使今后“知过尚不能改，罪孽的深重”，比写在讣文上，大概也更要来得使人注目了。
For example, when the front line is fighting in a downward spiral, some people think that this kind of sacrifice for the country is cruel and boring, so they advocate not fighting, and even more advocate not making peace, just saying that they will simply hide their heads and wait for fifty years. There is often a saying "ten years of reunion, ten years of lessons", it seems that fifty years of lessons are probably enough. It can be seen that the Chinese still have some remedies, and the state affairs have made the miasma so smoky, and everyone suddenly realized the three major imperfections of their internal organizations, and even found that the weapons were not sufficient. It takes dozens of years to prepare. At this point, it seems that we should feel a little unjusted about the loss of Rehe all the way to Luandong. Because our party (borrowed) the foundation to this day, from military to constitutional, no one has yet been willing to admit their mistakes, and now they have lost a few lands, so that some famous scholars who are self-confident and genius of the country who have learned both China and the West are actually willing to admit their mistakes.譬如再说，四月二十二日本刊上李家作的“以华制华”里说的警犬。警犬咬人，是蹲在地上冷眼傍观，等到有可杀的时候，便一跃上前，猛咬一口，不过，有的时候那警犬被人们提起棍子，向着当头一棒，也会把专门咬人的警犬，打得藏起头来，伸出舌头在暗地里发急。这种发急，大概便又是所谓“过”了。因为警犬虽然野性，但有时被棍子当头一击，也会被打出自己的错误来的，于是“过而能改”的警犬，在暗地里发急时，自又便会想忏悔，假使是不大晓得改过的警犬，在暗地发急之余，还想乘机再试，这种犬，大概是“罪孽深重”的了。
For example, on April 22, the police dog mentioned in Li Jiazao's "Using China to Control China" was published. When the police dog bites someone, it squats on the ground and watches coldly, and when there is something to kill, it jumps forward and bites violently, but sometimes the police dog is lifted by people with sticks and struck at the head, and it will also beat the police dog that specializes in biting people to hide its head and stick out its tongue to secretly be anxious. This kind of urgency is probably the so-called "passing" again. Because although the police dog is wild, it is sometimes hit in the head by a stick, and it will also be beaten with its own mistakes, so the police dog that "can be corrected", when it is in a hurry in the dark, will want to repent, if it is a police dog that does not know how to change, in addition to secretly anxious, but also wants to take the opportunity to try again, this kind of dog is probably "sinful".中国人只晓得说过而能改，善莫大焉，可惜都忘记了底下那一句。
Chinese people only know what they have said and can change, which is a great good, but unfortunately they have forgotten the sentence below.四月二十六日，《大晚报》副刊《火炬》。

言论自由的界限

The boundaries of free speech看《红楼梦》，觉得贾府上是言论颇不自由的地方。焦大以奴才的身分，仗着酒醉，从主子骂起，直到别的一切奴才，说只有两个石狮子干净。结果怎样呢？结果是主子深恶，奴才痛嫉，给他塞了一嘴马粪。
Watching "Dream of Red Mansions", I feel that Jiafu is a place where speech is quite unfree. Jiao Da, as a servant, relied on drunkenness, starting from the master to all the other servants, saying that only two stone lions were clean. The result? As a result, the master hated it, and the servant hated him, and stuffed him with horse manure.其实是，焦大的骂，并非要打倒贾府，倒是要贾府好，不过说主奴如此，贾府就要弄不下去罢了。然而得到的报酬是马粪。所以这焦大，实在是贾府的屈原，假使他能做文章，我想，恐怕也会有一篇《离骚》之类。

However, the reward is horse manure. Three years ago, the gentlemen of the Crescent Society unfortunately had a similar situation to Jiao Da. Although most of the quotes are British classics, there is no malice that is not conducive to the party and the state, but they say: "Sir, how clean people's clothes are, your old man's is a little dirty, you should wash it." Unexpectedly, "Quan didn't notice Yu Zhongxi", and came a mouthful of horse manure: the national newspaper spoke in unison, and even the "New Moon" magazine suffered. But the Crescent Society is a group of literati and scholars, and at this time, there are also a lot of "Li Sao Jing" that quotes the Three People's Principles and identifies the heart. Now it's good, spit out horse manure, change the sweetness, some consultants, some professors, some secretaries, some university deans, freedom of speech, and "New Moon" is also full of so-called "literature and art for literature and art".这就是文人学士究竟比不识字的奴才聪明，党国究竟比贾府高明，现在究竟比乾隆时候光明：三明主义。

However, there are still people clamoring for freedom of speech. This is absolutely not possible. The former is different from the crucifixion era of "New Moon", and now it seems to exist, and this "Free Talk" is also a proof, although sometimes there are a few heroes who come to probe their brains with horse manure. As for wanting to talk about it, it is enough to undermine the guarantee of freedom of speech. You must know that although it is brighter now than before, it is also more beneficial than before. Even if there is an explicit decree on freedom of speech, you must not be careless. I have seen this with my own eyes several times, not "selling the old", and I don't feel that he is a slave gentleman, but I hope to think about it and learn from it.四月十七日。

大观园的人才

大观园的人才

大观园的人才

Talents of Grand View Garden早些年，大观园里的压轴戏是刘老老骂山门。那是要老旦出场的，老气横秋地大“放”一通，直到裤子后穿而后止。当时指着手无寸铁或者已被缴械的人大喊“杀，杀，杀！”那呼声是多么雄壮。所以它——男角扮的老婆子，也可以算得一个人才。
In the early years, the finale in the Grand View Garden was Liu Lao scolding the mountain gate. That's for Lao Dan to appear, old-fashioned and "put" until the pants are worn later. At that time, pointing to unarmed or disarmed people, he shouted, "Kill, kill, kill!" "How majestic the cry is. So it, the old woman played by the male character, can also be regarded as a talent.而今时世大不同了，手里拿刀，而嘴里却需要“自由，自由，自由”，“开放××”云云。压轴戏要换了。
But now the world is very different, with a knife in hand, but in the mouth it needs "freedom, freedom, freedom" and "openness×× and so on. The finale is about to change.于是人才辈出，各有巧妙不同，出场的不是老旦，却是花旦了，而且这不是平常的花旦，而是海派戏广告上所说的“玩笑旦”。这是一种特殊的人物，他（她）要会媚笑，又要会撒泼，要会打情骂俏，又要会油腔滑调。总之，这是花旦而兼小丑的角色。不知道是时世造英雄（说“美人”要妥当些），还是美人儿多年阅历的结果？
So there are many talents, each with their own ingenuity, the one who appears is not Lao Dan, but Hua Dan, and this is not the usual Hua Dan, but the "joke Dan" mentioned in the Shanghai opera advertisement. This is a special character, he (she) must be able to smile, be splashy, flirt, and be smooth. In short, this is the role of a playboy and a clown. I don't know if it is the creation of heroes in the times (it is more appropriate to say "beauty"), or is it the result of many years of experience of beauty?美人儿而说“多年”，自然是阅人多矣的徐娘了，她早已从窑姐儿升任了老鸨婆；然而她丰韵犹存，虽在卖人，还兼自卖。自卖容易，而卖人就难些。现在不但有手无寸铁的人，而且有了……况且又遇见了太露骨的强奸。要会应付这种非常之变，就非有非常之才不可。你想想：现在的压轴戏是要似战似和，又战又和，不降不守，亦降亦守！这是多么难做的戏。没有半推半就假作娇痴的手段是做不好的。孟夫子说，“以天下与人易。”其实，能够简单地双手捧着“天下”去“与人”，倒也不为难了。问题就在于不能如此。所以要一把眼泪一把鼻涕，哭哭啼啼，而又刁声浪气的诉苦说：我不入火坑，谁入火坑。
When it comes to beauty and "many years", it is naturally Xu Niang who has seen a lot of people, and she has already been promoted from a kiln sister to an old bustard; However, her charm is still there, although she is selling people, she also sells herself. It's easy to sell yourself, but it's harder to sell people. Now not only are there unarmed people, but there are also ...... Moreover, I encountered rape that was too explicit. To be able to cope with this extraordinary change, you must have extraordinary talents. Think about it: The current finale is to be like a war, to fight and to make peace, not to surrender or defend, but also to defend! What a difficult play to make. It is not good to pretend to be a fool without half-pushing. Meng Fuzi said, "It is easy to exchange the world with others." In fact, it is not difficult to simply hold the "world" in both hands and go to "with people". The problem is that it can't be like this. So I have to cry and cry, and complain angrily: I don't enter the fire pit, who will enter the fire pit.然而娼妓说她自己落在火坑里，还是想人家去救她出来；而老鸨婆哭火坑，却未必有人相信她，何况她已经申明：她是敞开了怀抱，准备把一切人都拖进火坑的。虽然，这新鲜压轴戏的玩笑却开得不差，不是非常之才，就是挖空了心思也想不出的。
However, the prostitute said that she fell into the fire pit and still wanted someone to save her; And the old bustard woman cried in the fire pit, but no one may believe her, not to mention that she has affirmed that she has opened her arms and is ready to drag everyone into the fire pit. Although, the joke of this fresh finale is not bad, not very talented, or even if you hollow out your mind, you can't think of it.老旦进场，玩笑旦出场，大观园的人才着实不少！
Lao Dan entered, Joke Dan appeared, and there were really a lot of talents in the Grand View Garden!四月二十四日。

文章与题目

文章与题目

文章与题目

Articles and titles一个题目，做来做去，文章是要做完的，如果再要出新花样，那就使人会觉得不是人话。然而只要一步一步的做下去，每天又有帮闲的敲边鼓，给人们听惯了，就不但做得出，而且也行得通。
A topic, do it back and forth, the article is to be done, if you want to come up with new tricks, it will make people feel that it is not human words. However, as long as you do it step by step, and there are helpful beating drums every day, and people are used to listening to it, not only can it be done, but it will also work.譬如近来最主要的题目，是“安内与攘外”罢，做的也着实不少了。有说安内必先攘外的，有说安内同时攘外的，有说不攘外无以安内的，有说攘外即所以安内的，有说安内即所以攘外的，有说安内急于攘外的。
For example, the most important topic recently is "Stabilizing the Interior and Eliminating Foreign Countries", and a lot has been done. Some say that the internal must be repelled first, some say that the internal and external are repelled at the same time, some say that the outside cannot be repelled, some say that the outside is the reason for the internal security, some say that the internal is the reason for the external repelling, and some say that the internal is the reason for the external repelling, and some say that the internal is eager to repel the outside.做到这里，文章似乎已经无可翻腾了，看起来，大约总可以算是做到了绝顶。
At this point, the article seems to be irrefutable, and it seems that it can be regarded as the pinnacle.所以再要出新花样，就使人会觉得不是人话，用现在最流行的谥法来说，就是大有“汉奸”的嫌疑。为什么呢？就因为新花样的文章，只剩了“安内而不必攘外”，“不如迎外以安内”，“外就是内，本无可攘”这三种了。
Therefore, if you want to come up with new tricks, it will make people feel that it is not human words, and in the most popular posthumous method, it is suspected of being a "traitor". Why? Just because of the new pattern of articles, there are only three left: "Peace inside and not have to be external", "It is better to welcome the outside to settle inside", and "The outside is the inside, and there is nothing to resist".这三种意思，做起文章来，虽然实在希奇，但事实却有的，而且不必远征晋宋，只要看看明朝就够。满洲人早在窥伺了，国内却是草菅民命，杀戮清流，做了第一种。李自成进北京了，阔人们不甘给奴子做皇帝，索性请“大清兵”来打掉他，做了第二种。至于第三种，我没有看过《清史》，不得而知，但据老例，则应说是爱新觉罗氏之先，原是轩辕黄帝第几子之苗裔，于朔方，厚泽深仁，遂有天下，总而言之，咱们原是一家子云。
These three meanings, although it is really strange to start an article, but there are facts, and there is no need to go on an expedition to the Jin and Song dynasties, just look at the Ming Dynasty. The Manchurians had long been watching, but the country was a grassroots people's life, killing the clear stream, and doing the first one. Li Zicheng entered Beijing, and the Kuo people were unwilling to be emperors for their slaves, so they simply asked the "Qing soldiers" to kill him, and did the second one. As for the third type, I have not read the "History of the Qing Dynasty", I don't know, but according to the old example, it should be said that it is the ancestor of the Aixin Jue Luo clan, originally a descendant of the first son of the Xuanyuan Yellow Emperor, Yu Shuo Fang, Hou Ze Shen Benevolence, so there is the world, all in all, we were originally a family.后来的史论家，自然是力斥其非的，就是现在的名人，也正痛恨流寇。但这是后来和现在的话，当时可不然，鹰犬塞途，干儿当道，魏忠贤不是活着就配享了孔庙么？他们那种办法，那时都有人来说得头头是道的。
Later historians naturally strongly refuted it, even the current celebrities are also hating the bandits. But this is the later and now, it was not like that at that time, the eagles and dogs blocked the road, and the dry children were in power, didn't Wei Zhongxian deserve to enjoy the Confucius Temple while he was alive? Their method was said by people at that time.前清末年，满人出死力以镇压革命，有“宁赠友邦，不给家奴”的口号，汉人一知道，更恨得切齿。其实汉人何尝不如此？吴三桂之请清兵入关，便是一想到自身的利害，即“人同此心”的实例了。……
At the end of the Qing Dynasty, the Manchus made a desperate effort to suppress the revolution, with the slogan "Better to give friends than to domestic slaves", and when the Han people knew about it, they hated it even more. In fact, why don't the Han people do this? Wu Sangui's invitation to the Qing soldiers to enter the customs is an example of thinking of his own interests, that is, "people are of the same heart". ……四月二十九日。
