新药

新药

新药

Drug说起来就记得，诚然，自从九一八以后，再没有听到吴稚老的妙语了，相传是生了病。现在刚从南昌专电中，飞出一点声音来，却连改头换面的，也是自从九一八以后，就再没有一丝声息的民族主义文学者们，也来加以冷冷的讪笑。
Speaking of which, I remember, it is true that since 918, I have not heard Wu Zhilao's punchline, and it is said that he was sick. Now just from the Nanchang special telegram, a little sound has flown out, but even the nationalist writers who have not made a sound since 918 have come to ridicule it coldly.为什么呢？为了九一八。
Why? For 918.想起来就记得，吴稚老的笔和舌，是尽过很大的任务的，清末的时候，五四的时候，北伐的时候，清党的时候，清党以后的还是闹不清白的时候。然而他现在一开口，却连躲躲闪闪的人物儿也来冷笑了。九一八以来的飞机，真也炸着了这党国的元老吴先生，或者是，炸大了一些躲躲闪闪的人物儿的小胆子。
When I think about it, I remember that Wu Zhilao's pen and tongue did a great job, in the late Qing Dynasty, during the May Fourth Movement, during the Northern Expedition, when the party was cleared, and after the Qing Party, it was still a time when the party was not clean. However, as soon as he opened his mouth now, even the dodging figure sneered. The planes since 918 have really blown up Mr. Wu, the veteran of the party-state, or rather, the courage of some dodging characters.九一八以后，情形就有这么不同了。
After 918, the situation was so different.旧书里有过这么一个寓言，某朝某帝的时候，宫女们多数生了病，总是医不好。最后来了一个名医，开出神方道：壮汉若干名。皇帝没有法，只得照他办。若干天之后，自去察看时，宫女们果然个个神采焕发了，却另有许多瘦得不像人样的男人，拜伏在地上。皇帝吃了一惊，问这是什么呢？宫女们就嗫嚅的答道：是药渣。
There is such a fable in the old book, when a certain dynasty and emperor were in a certain dynasty, most of the palace maids were sick and could not be cured. Finally, a famous doctor came and prescribed a divine prescription: several strong men. The emperor had no way to do it, so he had to do as he did. A few days later, when I went to inspect, the palace maids were indeed full of energy, but there were many men who were too thin to look like humans, prostrating themselves on the ground. The emperor was taken aback and asked what it was? The palace maids replied in a whisper: It's drug residue.照前几天报上的情形看起来，吴先生仿佛就如药渣一样，也许连狗子都要加以践踏了。然而他是聪明的，又很恬淡，决不至于不顾自己，给人家熬尽了汁水。不过因为九一八以后，情形已经不同，要有一种新药出卖是真的，对于他的冷笑，其实也就是新药的作用。
According to the situation reported a few days ago, Mr. Wu seems to be like drug residue, and maybe even the dog will trample on it. However, he is smart and very calm, and he will never disregard himself and boil out the juice for others. However, because after 918, the situation has been different, and it is true that there is a new drug to sell, and the sneer for him is actually the role of the new drug.这种新药的性味，是要很激烈，而和平。譬之文章，则须先讲烈士的殉国，再叙美人的殉情；一面赞希特勒的组阁，一面颂苏联的成功；军歌唱后，来了恋歌；道德谈完，就讲妓院；因国耻日而悲杨柳，逢五一节而忆蔷薇；攻击主人的敌手，也似乎不满于它自己的主人……总而言之，先前所用的是单方，此后出卖的却是复药了。
The taste of this new drug is to be intense and peaceful. For example, in an article, we must first talk about the martyrdom of the martyrs, and then describe the martyrdom of the beauties; On the one hand, he praised Hitler's cabinet, and on the other hand, he praised the success of the Soviet Union; After the army sang, there was a love song; After talking about morality, talk about brothels; mourn the willows because of the national shame day, and remember the roses on May Day; The enemy who attacks the owner also seems to be dissatisfied with its own owner...... All in all, the previous prescription was used, but since then it has been sold as a compound drug.复药虽然好像万应，但也常无一效的，医不好病，即毒不死人。不过对于误服这药的病人，却能够使他不再寻求良药，拖重了病症而至于胡里胡涂的死亡。
Although the repetition medicine seems to be universal, it is often ineffective. However, for patients who mistakenly take this medicine, it can make him no longer seek good medicine, which will aggravate his illness and lead to his death.四月二十九日。
April 29th.

“多难之月”

“多难之月”

“多难之月”

"Difficult Moon"前月底的报章上，多说五月是“多难之月”。这名目，以前是没有见过的。现在这“多难之月”已经临头了。从经过了的日子来想一想，不错，五一是“劳动节”，可以说很有些“多难”；五三是济南惨案纪念日，也当然属于“多难”之一的。但五四是新文化运动的发扬，五五是革命政府成立的佳日，为什么都包括在“难”字堆里的呢？这可真有点儿希奇古怪！
In the newspapers at the end of last month, it was said that May was a "difficult month". This name has never been seen before. Now this "difficult month" is coming. Thinking about it from the days that have passed, yes, May Day is "Labor Day", which can be said to be a bit "difficult"; May 3rd is the anniversary of the Jinan Massacre, and of course it is one of the "difficulties". But May Fourth is the development of the new cultural movement, and May 5th is a good day for the establishment of the revolutionary government, why are they all included in the pile of "difficult"? This is really a bit weird!不过只要将这“难”字，不作国民“受难”的“难”字解，而作令人“为难”的“难”字解，则一切困难，可就涣然冰释了。
However, as long as the word "difficult" is not interpreted as the word "difficult" for the people, but as the word "difficult" that makes people "difficult", then all difficulties will be completely resolved.时势也真改变得飞快，古之佳节，后来自不免化为难关。先前的开会，是听大众在空地上开的，现在却要防人“乘机捣乱”了，所以只得函请代表，齐集洋楼，还要由军警维持秩序。先前的要人，虽然出来要“清道”（俗名“净街”），但还是走在地上的，现在却更要防人“谋为不轨”了，必得坐着飞机，须到出洋的时候，才能放心送给朋友。名人逛一趟古董店，先前也不算奇事情的，现在却“微服”“微服”的嚷得人耳聋，只好或登名山，或入古庙，比较的免掉大惊小怪。总而言之，可靠的国之柱石，已经多在半空中，最低限度也上了高楼峻岭了，地上就只留着些可疑的百姓，实做了“下民”，且又民匪难分，一有庆吊，总不免“假名滋扰”。向来虽靠“华洋两方当局，先事严防”，没有闹过什么大乱子，然而总比平时费力的，这就令人为难，而五月也成了“多难之月”，纪念的是好是坏，日子的为戚为喜，都不在话下。
The times are really changing rapidly, and the ancient festivals will inevitably turn into difficulties. The previous meeting was held by the public in the open space, but now it is necessary to prevent people from "taking advantage of the opportunity to make trouble", so they had to write to the representatives, gather in the western-style building, and maintain order by the military and police. In the past, although the dignitaries came out to "clear the road" (commonly known as "clean streets"), they still walked on the ground, but now they have to prevent people from "plotting misdeeds", and they must take a plane, and they must go abroad before they can be relieved to give them to their friends. Celebrities visited an antique shop, which was not unusual before, but now the shouts of "micro-service" and "micro-service" are deafening, so they have to either climb famous mountains or enter ancient temples, so as to avoid fuss. All in all, the pillars of a reliable country are already mostly in mid-air, and at least they have gone up to the high-rise mountains, and only some suspicious people remain on the ground, and they have actually become "lower people", and the people and bandits are indistinguishable. Although it has always relied on "the authorities of both China and the West, strict prevention in advance", there has been no big trouble, but it is always more laborious than usual, which is embarrassing, and May has also become a "difficult month", commemorating whether it is good or bad, and the days are happy and joyful, which is not a problem.但愿世界上大事件不要增加起来；但愿中国里惨案不要再有；但愿也不再有什么政府成立；但愿也不再有伟人的生日和忌日增添。否则，日积月累，不久就会成个“多难之年”，不但华洋当局，老是为难，连我们走在地面上的小百姓，也只好永远身带“嫌疑”，奉陪戒严，呜呼哀哉，不能喘气了。
I hope that the major events in the world will not increase; I hope there will be no more tragedies in China; I hope there will be no more governments; I hope there will be no more birthdays and death anniversaries of great men. Otherwise, over time, it will soon become a "difficult year", not only the Chinese and foreign authorities, but also the common people who walk on the ground, have to always carry "suspicion", accompany martial law, alas, can't breathe.五月五日。
May 5th.

不负责任的坦克车

不负责任的坦克车

不负责任的坦克车

Irresponsible tanks新近报上说，江西人第一次看了坦克车。自然，江西人的眼福很好。然而也有人惴惴然，唯恐又要掏腰包，报效坦克捐。我倒记起了另外一件事：
The new newspaper said that Jiangxi people saw tanks for the first time. Naturally, Jiangxi people have good eyes. However, there are also people who are anxious, afraid that they will have to pay for the tank donation again. I remembered another thing:有一个自称姓“张”的说过，“我是拥护言论不自由者……唯其言论不自由，才有好文章做出来，所谓冷嘲，讽刺，幽默和其他形形色色，不敢负言论责任的文体，在压迫钳制之下，都应运产生出来了。”这所谓不负责任的文体，不知道比坦克车怎样？
A person who claimed to be surnamed "Zhang" said, "I am a supporter of freedom of speech...... Only when their speech is not free can good articles be made, and the so-called cynicism, sarcasm, humor and other styles that dare not take responsibility for speech have come into being under oppression. "I don't know how this so-called irresponsible style is compared to a tank?讽刺等类为什么是不负责任，我可不知道。然而听人议论“风凉话”怎么不行，“冷箭”怎么射死了天才，倒也多年了。既然多年，似乎就很有道理。大致是骂人不敢充好汉，胆小。其实，躲在厚厚的铁板——坦克车里面，砰砰碰碰的轰炸，是着实痛快得多，虽然也似乎并不胆大。
I don't know why satire and other kinds are irresponsible. However, it has been many years since I heard people talk about how "sarcastic words" can't be done, and how "cold arrows" shot geniuses to death. Since it has been so many years, it seems to make sense. Roughly speaking, he scolded people for not daring to be a hero, and he was timid. In fact, hiding in a thick iron plate-tank, the bombardment with a bang is really much more enjoyable, although it doesn't seem to be bold.高等人向来就善于躲在厚厚的东西后面来杀人的。古时候有厚厚的城墙，为的要防备盗匪和流寇。现在就有钢马甲，铁甲车，坦克车。就是保障“民国”和私产的法律，也总是厚厚的一大本。甚至于自天子以至卿大夫的棺材，也比庶民的要厚些。至于脸皮的厚，也是合于古礼的。
High people have always been good at hiding behind thick things to kill. In ancient times, there were thick city walls to guard against bandits and bandits. Now there are steel vests, armored vehicles, tanks. Even the law that protects the "Republic of China" and private property is always a thick book. Even the coffins of the emperor and the ministers are thicker than those of the common people. As for the thickness of the skin, it is also in line with ancient etiquette.独有下等人要这么自卫一下，就要受到“不负责任”等类的嘲笑：
If a lowly person wants to defend himself like this, he will be ridiculed as "irresponsible":“你敢出来！出来！躲在背后说风凉话不算好汉！”
"You dare to come out! Come out! Hiding behind your back and saying sarcastic words is not a hero! ”但是，如果你上了他的当，真的赤膊奔上前阵，像许褚似的充好汉，那他那边立刻就会给你一枪，老实不客气，然后，再学着金圣叹批《三国演义》的笔法，骂一声“谁叫你赤膊的”——活该。总之，死活都有罪。足见做人实在很难，而做坦克车要容易得多。
However, if you are fooled by him and really rush to the front shirt and act as a good man like Xu Chu, then he will immediately give you a shot, honestly and unceremoniously, and then learn the brushwork of Jin Shengsi's criticism of "Romance of the Three Kingdoms" and scold "Who told you to be shirtless" - you deserve it. In short, life and death are guilty. It shows that it is really difficult to be a person, and it is much easier to be a tanker.五月六日。

从盛宣怀说到有理的压迫

从盛宣怀说到有理的压迫

从盛宣怀说到有理的压迫

From Sheng Xuanhuai to reasonable oppression盛氏的祖宗积德很厚，他们的子孙就举行了两次“收复失地”的盛典：一次还是在袁世凯的民国政府治下，一次就在当今国民政府治下了。
The ancestors of the Sheng family were very virtuous, and their descendants held two grand ceremonies to "regain lost territory": once under Yuan Shikai's Republic of China government, and once under the current Nationalist government.民元的时候，说盛宣怀是第一名的卖国贼，将他的家产没收了。不久，似乎是二次革命之后，就发还了。那是没有什么奇怪的，因为袁世凯是“物伤其类”，他自己也是卖国贼。不是年年都在纪念五七和五九么？袁世凯签订过二十一条，卖国是有真凭实据的。
During the Minyuan period, it was said that Sheng Xuanhuai was the number one traitor and confiscated his family property. Soon, it seems that after the Second Revolution, it was returned. There is nothing strange about that, because Yuan Shikai is a "material injury", and he himself is also a traitor. Isn't it commemorating May 7th and May 9th every year? Yuan Shikai signed 21 articles, and there is real evidence for betraying the country.最近又在报上发见这么一段消息，大致是说：“盛氏家产早已奉命归还，如苏州之留园，江阴无锡之典当等，正在办理发还手续。”这却叫我吃了一惊。打听起来，说是民国十六年国民革命军初到沪宁的时候，又没收了一次盛氏家产：那次的罪名大概是“土豪劣绅”，绅而至于“劣”，再加上卖国的旧罪，自然又该没收了。可是为什么又发还了呢？
Recently, I saw such a piece of news in the newspaper, which roughly said: "The Sheng family's property has long been ordered to be returned, such as the Lingering Garden in Suzhou, the pawn in Wuxi, Jiangyin, etc., and they are going through the return procedures." This surprised me. It sounds like it was when the National Revolutionary Army first arrived in Shanghai and Nanjing in the sixteenth year of the Republic of China, and the Sheng family's property was confiscated again: that time the crime was probably "local tyrants and inferior gentry", and the gentry were "inferior", coupled with the old crime of betraying the country, it should naturally be confiscated again. But why was it returned?第一，不应当疑心现在有卖国贼，因为并无真凭实据——现在的人早就誓不签订辱国条约，他们不比盛宣怀和袁世凯。第二，现在正在募航空捐，足见政府财政并不宽裕。那末，为什么呢？
First, we should not suspect that there are traitors now, because there is no real evidence - people today have long vowed not to sign treaties of humiliation, and they are not as good as Sheng Xuanhuai and Yuan Shikai. Second, it is now raising aviation donations, which shows that the government is not financially sufficient. So why?学理上研究的结果是——压迫本来有两种：一种是有理的，而且永久有理的，一种是无理的。有理的，就像逼小百姓还高利贷，交田租之类；这种压迫的“理”写在布告上：“借债还钱本中外所同之定理，租田纳税乃千古不易之成规。”无理的，就是没收盛宣怀的家产等等了；这种“压迫”巨绅的手法，在当时也许有理，现在早已变成无理的了。
The result of theoretical research is that there are two types of oppression: one is justified and permanently justified, and the other is unreasonable. Reasonable is like forcing the common people to repay usury, pay land rent, etc.; The "reason" of this oppression is written in the bulletin: "Borrowing to repay money is the same theorem at home and abroad, and renting land and paying taxes is an unchanged rule throughout the ages." "Unreasonable, that is, confiscate Sheng Xuanhuai's family property and so on; This method of "oppressing" the gentry may have been reasonable at the time, but now it has long become unreasonable.初初看见报上登载的《五一告工友书》上说：“反抗本国资本家无理的压迫”，我也是吃了一惊的。这不是提倡阶级斗争么？后来想想也就明白了。这是说，无理的压迫要反对，有理的不在此例。至于怎样有理，看下去就懂得了，下文是说：“必须克苦耐劳，加紧生产……尤应共体时艰，力谋劳资间之真诚合作，消弭劳资间之一切纠纷。”还有说“中国工人没有外国工人那么苦”等等的。
I was also surprised to see the "May Day Letter to the Workers" published in the newspaper saying: "Resist the unreasonable oppression of the capitalists in our country". Isn't this advocating class struggle? Later, when I thought about it, I understood. This means that unreasonable oppression should be opposed, and reasonable oppression should not be in this case. As for how it is reasonable, you will understand it by reading it, and the following says: "We must overcome hardships and work hard and step up production...... In particular, we should work together to seek sincere cooperation between labor and management and eliminate all disputes between labor and management. It is also said that "Chinese workers are not as miserable as foreign workers" and so on.我心上想，幸而没有大惊小怪地叫起来，天下的事情总是有道理的，一切压迫也是如此。何况对付盛宣怀等的理由虽然很少，而对付工人总不会没有的。
I thought to myself, fortunately, there was no fuss, things in the world always make sense, and the same is true for all oppression. What's more, although there are few reasons to deal with Sheng Xuanhuai and others, there will be no reason to deal with workers.五月六日。

Let's talk about reservations因为讲过刘庚生的罪名，就想到开口和动笔，在现在的中国，实在也很难的，要稳当，还是不响的好。要不然，就常不免反弄到自己的头上来。
Because I talked about Liu Gengsheng's crimes, I thought of opening my mouth and starting to write, in today's China, it is really difficult, to be stable, it is better not to make a sound. Otherwise, it will often be on your head.举几个例在这里——
Here are a few examples -十二年前，鲁迅作的一篇《阿Q正传》，大约是想暴露国民的弱点的，虽然没有说明自己是否也包含在里面。然而到得今年，有几个人就用“阿Q”来称他自己了，这就是现世的恶报。
Twelve years ago, Lu Xun wrote a "The True Biography of Ah Q", which probably wanted to expose the weaknesses of the people, although it did not explain whether it was also included. However, this year, a few people have used "Ah Q" to call themselves, which is the evil retribution of this world.八九年前，正人君子们办了一种报，说反对者是拿了卢布的，所以在学界捣乱。然而过了四五年，正人又是教授，君子化为主任，靠俄款享福，听到停付，就要力争了。这虽然是现世的善报，但也总是弄到自己的头上来。
Eight or nine years ago, the righteous gentlemen ran a newspaper saying that the opponents took rubles, so they made trouble in the academic world. However, after four or five years, Masato became a professor again, a gentleman turned into a director, relying on Russian money to enjoy happiness, and when he heard that the payment was stopped, he had to fight for it. Although this is a good reward in this world, it always comes to one's own head.不过用笔的人，即使小心，也总不免略欠周到的。最近的例，则如各报章上，“敌”呀，“逆”呀，“伪”呀，“傀儡国”呀，用得沸反盈天。不这样写，实在也不足以表示其爱国，且将为读者所不满。谁料得到“某机关通知：御侮要重实际，逆敌一类过度刺激字面，无裨实际，后宜屏用”，而且黄委员长抵平，发表政见，竟说是“中国和战皆处被动，办法难言，国难不止一端，亟谋最后挽救”（并见十八日《大晚报》北平电）的呢？……
However, people who use pens, even if they are careful, are always a little unthoughtful. Recent examples, such as in various newspapers, are used to say "enemy", "rebel", "pseudo", and "puppet state". If you don't write it like this, it is really not enough to show your patriotism, and it will be dissatisfied with readers. Who would have thought that "a certain organ notified that the insult should be practical, and the excessive stimulation of the enemy is not helpful to reality, and it should be used later", and Chairman Huang resisted the peace and expressed his political opinions, actually saying that "China and the war are passive, the methods are difficult to say, and the national crisis is more than one end, and it is urgent to seek the final salvation" (and see the "Great Evening News" Peking Telegraph on the 18th)? ……幸而还好，报上果然只看见“日机威胁北平”之类的题目，没有“过度刺激字面”了，只是“汉奸”的字样却还有。日既非敌，汉何云奸，这似乎不能不说是一个大漏洞。好在汉人是不怕“过度刺激字面”的，就是砍下头来，挂在街头，给中外士女欣赏，也从来不会有人来说一句话。
Fortunately, the newspaper really only saw titles such as "Japanese planes threaten Peking", and there was no "overstimulation literal", but the words "traitor" were still there. Since the sun is not an enemy, Han He is treacherous, which seems to be a big loophole. Fortunately, the Han people are not afraid of "overstimulating the literal", that is, they cut off their heads, hang them on the streets, and give them to Chinese and foreign men and women to appreciate, and no one will ever say a word.这些处所，我们是知道说话之难的。
In these places, we know how difficult it is to speak.从清朝的文字狱以后，文人不敢做野史了，如果有谁能忘了三百年前的恐怖，只要撮取报章，存其精英，就是一部不朽的大作。但自然，也不必神经过敏，预先改称为“上国”或“天机”的。
Since the literary prison of the Qing Dynasty, the literati did not dare to do wild history, if anyone can forget the horror of three hundred years ago, as long as the newspaper is taken and its elites are preserved, it is an immortal masterpiece. But naturally, there is no need to be nervous, and it will be renamed "Shangguo" or "Tianji" in advance.五月十七日。

“有名无实”的反驳

“有名无实”的反驳

“有名无实”的反驳

The rebuttal of "nominal and unsubstantiated"新近的《战区见闻记》有这么一段记载：
The recent "War Zone Observations" has this passage:“记者适遇一排长，甫由前线调防于此，彼云，我军前在石门寨，海阳镇，秦皇岛，牛头关，柳江等处所做阵地及掩蔽部……化洋三四十万元，木材重价尚不在内……艰难缔造，原期死守，不幸冷口失陷，一令传出，即行后退，血汗金钱所合并成立之阵地，多未重用，弃若敝屣，至堪痛心；不抵抗将军下台，上峰易人，我士兵莫不额手相庆……结果心与愿背。不幸生为中国人！尤不幸生为有名无实之抗日军人！”（五月十七日《申报》特约通信。）
The reporter happened to meet a platoon commander, who had just been transferred from the front line to defend here, and he said that our army had previously made positions and cover departments in Shimenzhai, Haiyang Town, Qinhuangdao, Niutouguan, Liujiang and other places...... The price of wood is not included...... Difficult to create, the original period of death, unfortunately the cold mouth falls, as soon as the order is issued, the line retreats, and the positions formed by the merger of hard-earned money are mostly not reused, abandoned like a shoe, which is very sad; If you do not resist the general's resignation, the peak will change, and our soldiers will celebrate with their hands...... As a result, the heart is contrary to the wish. Unfortunately, I was born Chinese! Especially unfortunately, he was born as a nominal anti-Japanese soldier! (Special correspondence of the "Declaration" on May 17.) ）这排长的天真，正好证明未经“教训”的愚劣人民，不足与言政治。第一，他以为不抵抗将军下台，“不抵抗”就一定跟着下台了。这是不懂逻辑：将军是一个人，而不抵抗是一种主义，人可以下台，主义却可以仍旧留在台上的。第二，他以为化了三四十万大洋建筑了防御工程，就一定要死守的了（总算还好，他没有想到进攻）。这是不懂策略：防御工程原是建筑给老百姓看看的，并不是教你死守的阵地，真正的策略却是“诱敌深入”。第三，他虽然奉令后退，却敢于“痛心”。这是不懂哲学：他的心非得治一治不可！第四，他“额手称庆”，实在高兴得太快了。这是不懂命理：中国人生成是苦命的。如此痴呆的排长，难怪他连叫两个“不幸”，居然自己承认是“有名无实的抗日军人”。其实究竟是谁“有名无实”，他是始终没有懂得的。
The naivety of this platoon leader just proves that the foolish people who have not been "taught" are not enough to talk about politics. First, he thought that if he did not resist the general's resignation, "non-resistance" would definitely follow. This is not understanding logic: the general is a person, and not resisting is a kind of doctrine, and people can step down, but doctrine can remain on the stage. Second, he thought that after turning three or four hundred thousand oceans into a defensive project, he would have to defend it (fortunately, he didn't think of attacking). This is not understanding strategy: the defense project was originally built for the common people to see, not to teach you to hold the position, but the real strategy is to "lure the enemy deeper". Third, although he was ordered to retreat, he dared to "be sad". This is not understanding philosophy: his heart must be cured! Fourth, he was so happy that he was "celebrating with his forehead". This is not understanding numerology: Chinese life is hard. With such a demented platoon commander, it is no wonder that he called two "unfortunate" in a row, and actually admitted that he was a "nominal anti-Japanese soldier". In fact, he never understood who was "famous or not".至于比排长更下等的小兵，那不用说，他们只会“打开天窗说亮话，咱们弟兄，处于今日局势，若非对外，鲜有不哗变者”（同上通信）。这还成话么？古人说，“无敌国外患者，国恒亡。”以前我总不大懂得这是什么意思：既然连敌国都没有了，我们的国还会亡给谁呢？现在照这兵士的话就明白了，国是可以亡给“哗变者”的。
As for the soldiers who are inferior to the platoon commander, needless to say, they will only "open the skylight and say bright words, our brothers, in today's situation, if it is not for the outside world, there are few who do not mutiny" (ibid.). Is this still a statement? The ancients said, "If there are no invincible foreign patients, the country will perish." "I didn't really understand what this meant before: Since there is no enemy country, to whom will our country die? Now according to the words of this soldier, it is clear that the country can be destroyed by the "mutineers".结论：要不亡国，必须多找些“敌国外患”来，更必须多多“教训”那些痛心的愚劣人民，使他们变成“有名有实”。
Conclusion: In order not to destroy the country, we must find more "enemies and foreign troubles", and we must "teach more" those sad foolish people more "lessons" so that they can become "famous and real".五月十八日。

不求甚解

不求甚解

不求甚解

I don't want to understand it very much文章一定要有注解，尤其是世界要人的文章。有些文学家自己做的文章还要自己来注释，觉得很麻烦。至于世界要人就不然，他们有的是秘书，或是私淑弟子，替他们来做注释的工作。然而另外有一种文章，却是注释不得的。
Articles must be annotated, especially articles by world dignitaries. Some writers have to annotate their own articles, which they find very troublesome. As for the world's dignitaries, some of them are secretaries or private disciples who do the annotation work for them. However, there is another article that cannot be annotated.譬如说，世界第一要人美国总统发表了“和平”宣言，据说是要禁止各国军队越出国境。但是，注释家立刻就说：“至于美国之驻兵于中国，则为条约所许，故不在罗斯福总统所提议之禁止内”（十六日路透社华盛顿电）。再看罗氏的原文：“世界各国应参加一庄严而确切之不侵犯公约，及重行庄严声明其限制及减少军备之义务，并在签约各国能忠实履行其义务时，各自承允不派遣任何性质之武装军队越出国境。”要是认真注解起来，这其实是说：凡是不“确切”，不“庄严”，并不“自己承允”的国家，尽可以派遣任何性质的军队越出国境。至少，中国人且慢高兴，照这样解释，日本军队的越出国境，理由还是十足的；何况连美国自己驻在中国的军队，也早已声明是“不在此例”了。可是，这种认真的注释是叫人扫兴的。
For example, the president of the United States, the world's number one dignitary, issued a "peace" declaration, which is said to prohibit the armies of various countries from crossing the border. However, the commentator immediately said: "As for the stationing of U.S. troops in China, it is permitted by the treaty, so it is not within the prohibition proposed by President Roosevelt" (Reuters, Washington, 16th). Let's look at Roche's original text: "All countries in the world should participate in a solemn and definite non-aggression convention, and reaffirm their solemn declaration of their obligation to limit and reduce armaments, and when the signatory countries can faithfully fulfill their obligations, they each promise not to send armed troops of any nature beyond their borders." If you carefully comment on it, this actually means that any country that is not "accurate", not "solemn", and not "self-appropriate" can send troops of any nature beyond the borders. At least, the Chinese are slowly happy, and according to this explanation, the Japanese army crossed the border, and the reason is still full; What's more, even the United States' own troops stationed in China have already stated that it is "not in this case". However, this serious annotation is disappointing.再则，像“誓不签订辱国条约”一句经文，也早已有了不少传注。传曰：“对日妥协，现在无人敢言，亦无人敢行。”这里，主要的是一个“敢”字。但是：签订条约有敢与不敢的分别，这是拿笔杆的人的事，而拿枪杆的人却用不着研究敢与不敢的为难问题——缩短防线，诱敌深入之类的策略是用不着签订的。就是拿笔杆的人也不至于只会签字，假使这样，未免太低能。所以又有一说，谓之“一面交涉”。于是乎注疏就来了：“以不承认为责任者之第三者，用不合理之方法，以口头交涉……清算无益之抗日。”这是日本电通社的消息。这种泄漏天机的注解也是十分讨厌的，因此，这不会不是日本人的“造谣”。
Furthermore, the sentence "swear not to sign a treaty of humiliation" has already been commented on. It is said: "Compromise with Japan, no one dares to say it now, and no one dares to do it. Here, the main thing is the word "dare". However, there is a difference between daring and not daring to sign a treaty, which is the matter of the person holding the pen, and the person holding the barrel of the gun does not need to study the embarrassment of daring and not daring - strategies such as shortening the defense line and luring the enemy deeper do not need to be signed. Even the person holding the pen will not only sign, if so, it is too imbecile. Therefore, there is another saying, called "one-sided negotiation". So the annotation came: "The third party who is responsible for non-recognition uses unreasonable methods to make oral negotiations...... Liquidation of useless anti-Japanese resistance. This is a message from Nippon Telecommunications. This kind of annotation of leaking the secret is also very annoying, so this will not be a "rumor" by the Japanese.总之，这类文章浑沌一体，最妙是不用注解，尤其是那种使人扫兴或讨厌的注解。
In short, this kind of article is chaotic, and the best thing is not to use annotations, especially the kind of annotations that make people disappointed or annoying.小时候读书讲到陶渊明的“好读书不求甚解”，先生就给我讲了，他说：“不求甚解”者，就是不去看注解，而只读本文的意思。注解虽有，确有人不愿意我们去看的。
When I was a child, I read about Tao Yuanming's "good reading does not ask for much understanding", and my teacher told me, he said: "Don't ask for much understanding", that is, do not read the annotations, but only read the meaning of this article. Although there are annotations, there are indeed people who do not want us to see them.五月十八日。

postscript我向《自由谈》投稿的由来，《前记》里已经说过了。到这里，本文已完，而电灯尚明，蚊子暂静，便用剪刀和笔，再来保存些因为《自由谈》和我而起的琐闻，算是一点余兴。
The origin of my contribution to "Free Talk" has already been said in the "Preface". Just look at it and you can see that among my short comments, the most attacked was the "Great Evening News". This is not a grudge against me in my previous life, but because I quoted its text. But I don't have a grudge against it in my previous life, because I only read "Declaration" and "Evening News", and the latter's text is often quite novel and worth quoting to relieve sorrow and boredom. That is, as in front of my eyes, there is now an old "Evening News" on March 30 with cigarettes wrapped in it, which has such a paragraph -“浦东人杨江生，年已四十有一，貌既丑陋，人复贫穷，向为泥水匠，曾佣于苏州人盛宝山之泥水作场。盛有女名金弟，今方十五龄，而矮小异常，人亦猥琐。昨晚八时，杨在虹口天潼路与盛相遇，杨奸其女。经捕头向杨询问，杨毫不抵赖，承认自去年一二八以后，连续行奸十余次，当派探员将盛金弟送往医院，由医生验明确非处女，今晨解送第一特区地方法院，经刘毓桂推事提审，捕房律师王耀堂以被告诱未满十六岁之女子，虽其后数次皆系该女自往被告家相就，但按法亦应强奸罪论，应请讯究。旋传女父盛宝山讯问，据称初不知有此事，前晚因事责女后，女忽失踪，直至昨晨才归，严诘之下，女始谓留住被告家，并将被告诱奸经过说明，我方得悉，故将被告扭入捕房云。继由盛金弟陈述，与被告行奸，自去年二月至今，已有十余次，每次均系被告将我唤去，并着我不可对父母说知云。质之杨江生供，盛女向呼我为叔，纵欲奸犹不忍下手，故绝对无此事，所谓十余次者，系将盛女带出游玩之次数等语。刘推事以本案尚须调查，谕被告收押，改期再讯。”
Yang Jiangsheng, a native of Pudong, is forty-one years old, ugly, poor, and has been a plasterer, and was once employed in the mud water workshop of Shengbao Mountain in Suzhou. Sheng Sheng had a daughter named Jin Di, who was only fifteen years old, but she was extremely short and had a lewd appearance. At eight o'clock last night, Yang met Sheng on Tiantong Road in Hongkou, and Yang raped his daughter. After questioning Yang by the head of the arrest, Yang did not deny it, admitting that since 128 last year, he had committed rape more than ten times in a row, and when agents were sent to send Sheng Jindi to the hospital, the doctor confirmed that he was not a virgin, and this morning he was sent to the First Special Administrative Region District Court. It was rumored that the girl's father, Sheng Baoshan, was interrogated, and it was said that he did not know about this at first, and after blaming the daughter for the matter the night before, the woman suddenly disappeared, and did not return until yesterday morning. Since February last year, there have been more than ten times, and each time the defendant called me out and told me not to tell my parents. Questioned by Yang Jiangsheng's confession, Sheng Nu used to call me uncle, even if she wanted to rape me, she couldn't bear to do it, so there was absolutely no such thing. Judge Liu believed that this case still needed to be investigated and ordered the defendant to be taken into custody and rescheduled for a new trial. ”在记事里分明可见，盛对于杨，并未说有“伦常”关系，杨供女称之为“叔”，是中国的习惯，年长十年左右，往往称为叔伯的。然而《大晚报》用了怎样的题目呢？是四号和头号字的——
It can be clearly seen from the records that Sheng did not say that there was a "ethics" relationship with Yang, and Yang Gongnu called him "uncle", which is a Chinese habit, and he is about ten years old, often called uncle. However, what kind of title did the "Evening News" use? It is the number four and the number one word -
拦途扭往捕房控诉Blocking the road and turning to the arrest room to accuse 
　　干叔奸侄女 Uncle Gan raped his niece 
　　　　女自称被奸过十余次 The woman claimed to have been raped more than ten times
　　　　　　男指系游玩并非风流 The man pointed out that it was not a romance

它在“叔”上添一“干”字，于是“女”就化为“侄女”，杨江生也因此成了“逆伦”或准“逆伦”的重犯了。中国之君子，叹人心之不古，憎匪人之逆伦，而惟恐人间没有逆伦的故事，偏要用笔铺张扬厉起来，以耸动低级趣味读者的眼目。杨江生是泥水匠，无从看见，见了也无从抗辩，只得一任他们的编排，然而社会批评者是有指斥的任务的。但还不到指斥，单单引用了几句奇文，他们便什么“员外”什么“警犬”的狂嗥起来，好像他们的一群倒是吸风饮露，带了自己的家私来给社会服务的志士。是的，社长我们是知道的，然而终于不知道谁是东家，就是究竟谁是“员外”，倘说既非商办，又非官办，则在报界里是很难得的。但这秘密，在这里不再研究它也好。
It added the word "dry" to "uncle", so the "woman" turned into a "niece", and Yang Jiangsheng became a repeat offender of "rebellious ethics" or quasi-"reverse ethics". Chinese gentlemen, lamenting the imantiquity of people's hearts, hated the rebellious ethics of bandits, but feared that there would be no rebellious stories in the world, so they had to use their pens to exaggerate and exaggerate to sensationally attract the eyes of low-level interesting readers. Yang Jiangsheng is a plasterer, he can't see it, and he can't defend it when he sees it, so he has to let them choreograph it, but social critics have the task of criticizing. But before they were accused, they just quoted a few strange sentences, and they roared wildly, as if they were a group of people who sucked the wind and drank dew and brought their own furniture to serve the society. Yes, we know the president, but finally we don't know who is the owner, that is, who is the "outsider", if it is neither a commercial office nor a government office, it is rare in the newspaper. But this secret, it's okay not to study it here.
和《大晚报》不相上下，注意于《自由谈》的还有《社会新闻》。但手段巧妙得远了，它不用不能通或不愿通的文章，而只驱使着真伪杂糅的记事。即如《自由谈》的改革的原因，虽然断不定所说是真是假，我倒还是从它那第二卷第十三期（二月七日出版）上看来的——
On par with the "Great Evening News", there is also "Social News" that pays attention to "Free Talk". But the means are far more ingenious, it does not need articles that cannot be understood or are unwilling to understand, but only drives a mixture of true and false records. That is, the reason for the reform of "Freedom Talk", although it is certain whether what is said is true or false, I still see it from its second volume, issue thirteen (published on February 7) -从《春秋》与《自由谈》说起
Starting from "Spring and Autumn" and "Free Talk"中国文坛，本无新旧之分，但到了五四运动那年，陈独秀在《新青年》上一声号炮，别树一帜，提倡文学革命，胡适之钱玄同刘半农等，在后摇旗呐喊。这时中国青年外感外侮的压迫，内受政治的刺激，失望与烦闷，为了要求光明的出路，各种新思潮，遂受青年热烈的拥护，使文学革命建了伟大的成功。从此之后，中国文坛新旧的界限，判若鸿沟；但旧文坛势力在社会上有悠久的历史，根深蒂固，一时不易动摇。那时旧文坛的机关杂志，是著名的《礼拜六》，几乎集了天下摇头摆尾的文人，于《礼拜六》一炉！至《礼拜六》所刊的文字，十九是卿卿我我，哀哀唧唧的小说，把民族性陶醉萎靡到极点了！此即所谓鸳鸯蝴蝶派的文字。其中如徐枕亚吴双热周瘦鹃等，尤以善谈鸳鸯蝴蝶著名，周瘦鹃且为礼拜六派之健将。这时新文坛对于旧势力的大本营《礼拜六》，攻击颇力，卒以新兴势力，实力单薄，旧派有封建社会为背景，有恃无恐，两不相让，各行其是。此后新派如文学研究会，创造社等，陆续成立，人材渐众，势力渐厚，《礼拜六》应时势之推移，终至“寿终正寝”！惟礼拜六派之残余分子，迄今犹四出活动，无肃清之望，上海各大报中之文艺编辑，至今大都仍是所谓鸳鸯蝴蝶派所把持。可是只要放眼在最近的出版界中，新兴文艺出版数量的可惊，已有使旧势力不能抬头之势！礼拜六派文人之在今日，已不敢复以《礼拜六》的头衔以相召号，盖已至强弩之末的时期了！最近守旧的《申报》，忽将《自由谈》编辑礼拜六派的巨子周瘦鹃撤职，换了一个新派作家黎烈文，这对于旧势力当然是件非常的变动，遂形成了今日新旧文坛剧烈的冲突。周瘦鹃一方面策动各小报，对黎烈文作总攻击，我们只要看郑逸梅主编的《金刚钻》，主张周瘦鹃仍返《自由谈》原位，让黎烈文主编《春秋》，也足见旧派文人终不能忘情于已失的地盘。而另一方面周瘦鹃在自己编的《春秋》内说：各种副刊有各种副刊的特性，作河水不犯井水之论，也足见周瘦鹃犹惴惴于他现有地位的危殆。周同时还硬拉非苏州人的严独鹤加入周所主持的纯苏州人的文艺团体“星社”，以为拉拢而固地位之计。不图旧派势力的失败，竟以周启其端。据我所闻：周的不能安于其位，也有原因：他平日对于选稿方面，太刻薄而私心，只要是认识的人投去的稿，不看内容，见篇即登；同时无名小卒或为周所陌生的投稿者，则也不看内容，整堆的作为字纸篓的虏俘。因周所编的刊物，总是几个夹袋里的人物，私心自用，以致内容糟不可言！外界对他的攻击日甚，如许啸天主编之《红叶》，也对周有数次剧烈的抨击，史量才为了外界对他的不满，所以才把他撤去。那知这次史量才的一动，周竟作了导火线，造成了今日新旧两派短兵相接战斗愈烈的境界！以后想好戏还多，读者请拭目俟之。
In the Chinese literary world, there is no distinction between old and new, but in the year of the May Fourth Movement, Chen Duxiu sounded a cannon on "New Youth", set it apart, and advocated a literary revolution. At this time, Chinese youth felt oppressed by external insults, stimulated by politics internally, disappointed and bored, and in order to demand a bright way out, various new trends of thought were enthusiastically supported by young people, which made the literary revolution a great success. Since then, the boundary between the old and the new in the Chinese literary world has been like a chasm; However, the old literary forces have a long history in society, are deeply rooted, and are not easy to shake for a while. At that time, the organ magazine of the old literary world was the famous "Saturday", which almost gathered literati from all over the world who shook their heads and tails, and they were furnaceed in "Saturday"! As for the text published in "Saturday", nineteen are the novels of Qingqing and me, mournful and lamenting, which intoxicate the national character to the extreme! This is the text of the so-called Mandarin Duck Butterfly School. Among them, such as Xu Zhenya, Wu Shuangre, Zhou Shoujuan, etc., are especially famous for talking about mandarin ducks and butterflies, and Zhou Shoujuan is also a strong player of the Saturday school. At this time, the new literary world attacked the base camp of the old forces "Saturday", and finally attacked the emerging forces, the strength was weak, and the old school had a feudal society as the background. Since then, new schools such as the Literary Research Association, the Creation Society, etc., have been established one after another, and the number of talents has gradually increased, and the power has gradually increased. However, the remnants of the Saturday faction are still active so far, and there is no hope of purging, and most of the literary and artistic editors in Shanghai's major newspapers are still controlled by the so-called Mandarin Duck Butterfly School. However, as long as we look at the recent publishing industry, the number of emerging literary and artistic publications is shocking, and there is a tendency to make the old forces unable to raise their heads! Today, the literati of the Saturday school no longer dare to call each other with the title of "Saturday", because it is already the end of the strong crossbow period! The recent conservative "Declaration" suddenly dismissed Zhou Shoujuan, the editor of "Free Talk", from his post and replaced him with a new writer Li Liewen, which was of course a very change for the old forces, thus forming a violent conflict between the old and new literary circles today. On the one hand, Zhou Shoujuan instigated various tabloids to make a general attack on Li Liewen, we only need to look at the "Diamond Diamond" edited by Zheng Yimei, advocating that Zhou Shoujuan still return to the original position of "Free Talk", and let Li Liewen edit the "Spring and Autumn Annals", which also shows that the old-school literati cannot forget their love for the lost territory. On the other hand, Zhou Shoujuan said in his own "Spring and Autumn Annals": Various supplements have the characteristics of various supplements, and the theory that river water does not violate well water also shows that Zhou Shoujuan is still worried about the danger of his current position. At the same time, Zhou also forced Yan Duhe, who is not from Suzhou, to join the pure Suzhou people's literary and artistic group "Star Society" presided over by Zhou, as a way to win over and consolidate his position. Unexpectedly, the failure of the old school forces actually started with Zhou. As far as I know, Zhou's can't be content with his position, and there is also a reason: he is too mean and selfish in terms of draft selection, as long as it is a manuscript submitted by someone he knows, he doesn't read the content, and he will publish it as soon as he sees it; At the same time, nobodies or contributors who are unfamiliar to Zhou do not look at the content, and the whole pile is a prisoner of the word basket. Because the publications compiled by Zhou are always characters in a few pockets, selfishly and selfishly, so that the content is terrible! The outside world attacked him day by day, such as Xu Xiaotian's "Red Leaves", and there were several violent attacks on Zhou, and Shi Liang removed him because of the dissatisfaction of the outside world. Knowing that Shi Liangcai's move this time, Zhou actually became the fuse, causing today's situation where the old and new factions are fighting fiercely! There will be many more good shows in the future, readers, please wait and see.〔微知〕

Regarding the left-wing cultural movement, although it has been severely oppressed from all sides and its internal divisions, it seems to have gradually raised its head recently. The "Oriental Magazine" edited by Hu Yuzhi was originally the magazine with the longest history in China and the most stable magazine, but according to the opinion of Wang Yunwu's boss, Hu Yuzhi has been too left-leaning recently, so he must re-read the appearance that Yuzhi has seen. [Hear]而以前的五月十四日午后一时，还有了丁玲和潘梓年的失踪的事，大家多猜测为遭了暗算，而这猜测也日益证实了。谣言也因此非常多，传说某某也将同遭暗算的也有，接到警告或恐吓信的也有。我没有接到什么信，只有一连五六日，有人打电话到内山书店的支店去询问我的住址。我以为这些信件和电话，都不是实行暗算者们所做的，只不过几个所谓文人的鬼把戏，就是“文坛”上，自然也会有这样的人的。但倘有人怕麻烦，这小玩意是也能发生些效力，六月九日《自由谈》上《蘧庐絮语》之后有一条下列的文章，我看便是那些鬼把戏的见效的证据了——

"That's a criticism of Lu Xun, what I'm talking about is an opinion on politics, and there is it in the "Literary and Art Symposium". (See "Literary and Art Symposium", Volume 1, "From Morning to Afternoon".) ）“对于鲁迅的什么批评？”
"What criticism of Lu Xun?"“这是题外的事情了，我看关于这个，请你还是不发表好了。”
"This is off topic, I see about this, please don't publish it."这真是“胸中不正，则眸子眊焉”，寥寥几笔，就画出了这位文学家的嘴脸。《社会新闻》说他“阘懦”，固然意在博得社会上“济弱扶倾”的同情，不足置信，但启事上的自白，却也须照中国文学上的例子，大打折扣的（倘白羽遐先生在“某天”又到“内山书店小坐”，一定又会从老板口头听到），因为他自己在“行不改姓”之后，也就说“纵令有时用其他笔名”，虽然“但所发表文字，均自负责”，而无奈“还是不发表好了”何？但既然“还是不发表好了”，则关于我的一笔，我也就不再深论了。
This is really "if the chest is not right, the eyes will be narrow", and with just a few strokes, the face of this writer was drawn. The "Social News" said that he was "cowardly", although it was intended to win the sympathy of the society to "help the weak and support the overturned", which is not believable, but the confession on the notice must also be greatly discounted according to the example in Chinese literature (if Mr. Bai Yuxia goes to "Uchiyama Bookstore for a short time" on "one day", he will definitely hear it from the boss again), because after he himself "does not change his surname", he also said that "even if he sometimes uses other pseudonyms", although "but the published words are all responsible", and he has no choice but to "still not publish" what? But since "it's better not to publish", I won't talk about my stroke in detail.一枝笔不能兼写两件事，以前我实在闲却了《文艺座谈》的座主，“解放词人”曾今可先生了。但写起来却又很简单，他除了“准备反攻”之外，只在玩“告密”的玩艺。

I can tell you now鄙人不日离沪旅行，且将脱离文字生活。以后对于别人对我造谣诬蔑，一概置之不理。这年头，只许强者打，不许弱者叫，我自然没有什么话可说。我承认我是一个弱者，我无力反抗，我将在英雄们胜利的笑声中悄悄地离开这文坛。如果有人笑我是“懦夫”，我只当他是尊我为“英雄”。此启。

Refuting "literati have no virtue"“文人”这一块大招牌，是极容易骗人的。虽在现在，社会上的轻贱文人，实在还不如所谓“文人”的自轻自贱之甚。看见只要是“人”，就决不肯做的事情，论者还不过说他“无行”，解为“疯人”，恕其“可怜”。其实他们却原是贩子，也一向聪明绝顶，以前的种种，无非“生意经”，现在的种种，也并不是“无行”，倒是他要“改行”了。
The big sign of "literati" is very easy to deceive. Although now, the lowly literati in society are really not as self-deprecating as the so-called "literati". Seeing that as long as he is a "person", he will never do anything, and the commentators only say that he is "incompetent", interpreted as a "madman", and forgive him for being "pitiful". In fact, they were originally dealers, and they have always been extremely smart, all kinds of things in the past are nothing more than "business experience", and now all kinds are not "no line", but he is going to "change his career".生意的衰微使他要“改行”。虽是极低劣的三角恋爱小说，也可以卖掉一批的。我们在夜里走过马路边，常常会遇见小瘪三从暗中来，鬼鬼祟祟的问道：“阿要春宫？阿要春宫？中国的，东洋的，西洋的，都有。阿要勿？”生意也并不清淡。上当的是初到上海的青年和乡下人。然而这至多也不过四五回，他们看过几套，就觉得讨厌，甚且要作呕了，无论你“中国的，东洋的，西洋的，都有”也无效。而且因时势的迁移，读书界也起了变化，一部份是不再要看这样的东西了；一部份是简直去跳舞，去嫖妓，因为所化的钱，比买手淫小说全集还便宜。这就使三角家之类觉得没落。我们不要以为造成了洋房，人就会满足的，每一个儿子，至少还得给他赚下十万块钱呢。
The decline of business made him want to "change careers". Although it is a very inferior love triangle novel, it can also be sold in batches. When we walked along the side of the road at night, we often met Xiao Deflated San coming from the shadows and asked sneakily: "Ah want the Spring Palace?" Do you want the Spring Palace? Chinese, Eastern, and Western. Do you want it? "Business is not light. It was the young people and country people who had just arrived in Shanghai. However, this is only four or five times at most, and after seeing a few sets, they feel annoying, and even nauseous, no matter whether you "Chinese, Eastern, Western, there are them" is invalid. And due to the change of the times, the reading world has also changed, and part of it is that I no longer want to see such things; Part of it is simply dancing and prostitution, because the money is cheaper than buying a complete collection of masturbation novels. This makes the triangle family feel declining. Let's not think that if a bungalow is created, people will be satisfied, and every son has to earn him at least 100,000 yuan.于是乎暴躁起来。然而三角上面，是没有出路了的。于是勾结一批同类，开茶会，办小报，造谣言，其甚者还竟至于卖朋友，好像他们的鸿篇巨制的不再有人赏识，只是因为有几个人用一手掩尽了天下人的眼目似的。但不要误解，以为他真在这样想。他是聪明绝顶，其实并不在这样想的，现在这副嘴脸，也还是一种“生意经”，用三角钻出来的活路。总而言之，就是现在只好经营这一种卖买，才又可以赚些钱。
So he became irritable. However, there is no way out above the triangle. So they colluded with a group of their own kind, held tea parties, ran tabloids, spread rumors, and even sold their friends, as if their masterpieces were no longer appreciated, just because a few people covered the eyes of the people of the world with one hand. But don't get me wrong, think he really thinks so. He is extremely smart, in fact, he doesn't think so, and now this face is still a kind of "business experience", a way to survive with a triangle. All in all, it is now that I have to operate this kind of buying and selling in order to make some money.譬如说罢，有些“第三种人”也曾做过“革命文学家”，借此开张书店，吞过郭沫若的许多版税，现在所住的洋房，有一部份怕还是郭沫若的血汗所装饰的。此刻那里还能做这样的生意呢？此刻要合伙攻击左翼，并且造谣陷害了知道他们的行为的人，自己才是一个干净刚直的作者，而况告密式的投稿，还可以大赚一注钱呢。
For example, some "third types of people" have also been "revolutionary writers", using this to open a bookstore and swallow a lot of Guo Moruo's royalties, and some of the bungalows they live in now are probably still decorated by Guo Moruo's blood and sweat. Where else can such a business be done at this moment? At this moment, if you want to partner to attack the left wing and spread rumors to frame people who know their behavior, you are a clean and upright author, and you can make a lot of money by submitting a whistleblower style.先前的手淫小说，还是下部的勾当，但此路已经不通，必须上进才是，而人们——尤其是他的旧相识——的头颅就危险了。这那里是单单的“无行”文人所能做得出来的？
The previous masturbation novels were still the work of the lower part, but this road is no longer possible, and the heads of people, especially his old acquaintances, are in danger. Is this what a single "no-lined" literati can do?上文所说，有几处自然好像带着了曾今可张资平这一流，但以前的“腰斩张资平”，却的确不是我的意见。这位作家的大作，我自己是不要看的，理由很简单：我脑子里不要三角四角的这许多角。倘有青年来问我可看与否，我是劝他不必看的，理由也很简单：他脑子里也不必有三角四角的那许多角。若夫他自在投稿取费，出版卖钱，即使他无须养活老婆儿子，我也满不管，理由也很简单：我是从不想到他那些三角四角的角不完的许多角的。
As mentioned above, there are a few places that naturally seem to have the same level as Zeng Jinke and Zhang Ziping, but the previous "cutting Zhang Ziping in half" is indeed not my opinion. I don't want to read this writer's masterpiece myself, for a very simple reason: I don't want all these corners of the triangle in my head. If a young man comes to me and asks me if I can see it, I advise him not to read it, and the reason is very simple: he doesn't have to have the many corners of the triangle in his head. If he is free to contribute and publish for money, even if he does not need to support his wife and son, I don't care, and the reason is very simple: I never thought of his endless corners of the triangle.然而多角之辈，竟谓我策动“腰斩张资平”。既谓矣，我乃简直以X光照其五脏六腑了。

Neo-Confucian foreign history柳丝
Willow silk第一回　揭旗扎空营　兴师布迷阵
The first time to unveil the flag and set up an empty camp to set up a maze formation却说卡尔和伊理基两人这日正在天堂以上讨论中国革命问题，忽见下界中国文坛的大戈壁上面，杀气腾腾，尘沙弥漫，左翼防区里面，一位老将紧追一位小将，战鼓震天，喊声四起，忽然那位老将牙缝开处，吐出一道白雾，卡尔闻到气味立刻晕倒，伊理基拍案大怒道，“毒瓦斯，毒瓦斯！”扶着卡尔赶快走开去了。原来下界中国文坛的大戈壁上面，左翼防区里头，近来新扎一座空营，揭起小资产阶级革命文学之旗，无产阶级文艺营垒受了奸人挑拨，大兴问罪之师。这日大军压境，新扎空营的主将兼官佐又兼士兵杨人提起笔枪，跃马相迎，只见得战鼓震天，喊声四起，为首先锋扬刀跃马而来，乃老将鲁迅是也。那杨人打拱，叫声“老将军别来无恙？”老将鲁迅并不答话，跃马直冲扬刀便刺，那杨人笔枪挡住又道：“老将有话好讲，何必动起干戈？小将别树一帜，自扎空营，只因事起仓卒，未及呈请指挥，并非倒戈相向，实则独当一面，此心此志，天人共鉴。老将军试思左翼诸将，空言克服，骄盈自满，战术既不研究，武器又不制造。临阵则军容不整，出马则拖枪而逃，如果长此以往，何以维持威信？老将军整顿纪纲之不暇，劳师远征，窃以为大大对不起革命群众的呵！”老将鲁迅又不答话，圆睁环眼，倒竖虎须，只见得从他的牙缝里头嘘出一道白雾，那小将杨人知道老将放出毒瓦斯，说的迟那时快，已经将防毒面具戴好了，正是：情感作用无理讲，是非不明只天知！欲知老将究竟能不能将毒瓦斯闷死那小将，且待下回分解。
But it is said that Karl and Iliki were discussing the issue of the Chinese revolution above heaven that day, and suddenly saw the Great Gobi of the Chinese literary world in the lower realm, murderous and dusty, in the left-wing defense area, a veteran chased a young general, the war drums shook the sky, shouts were everywhere, suddenly the veteran opened his teeth, spit out a white mist, Karl smelled the smell and immediately fainted, Iliki slapped the case and said angrily, "Poison gas, poison gas!" He helped Karl and walked away quickly. It turned out that on the Great Gobi of the Chinese literary world in the lower realm, in the left-wing defense zone, a new empty camp was recently set up, raising the banner of petty-bourgeois revolutionary literature. On this day, the army pressed the border, and Yang Ren, the main general and officer of the newly established empty camp, raised the pen gun and leaped on horseback to greet him, only to see the war drums shaking the sky, shouting everywhere, and the first to raise his sword and leap on the horse, it was the veteran Lu Xun. The Yang man clasped his hands and shouted, "Old general, don't come safely?" The veteran Lu Xun did not answer, and the prancing horse rushed straight to the knife and stabbed it, and the Yang Ren pen and gun blocked it and said: "The veteran has something to say, why do you have to fight?" The young general set up an empty camp on his own, but because of the sudden incident, he did not have time to petition for command, not to turn against each other, but in fact to be alone. The old general tried to think of the left-wing generals, who overcame empty words, were arrogant and complacent, did not study tactics, and did not manufacture weapons. If you go on the battlefield, the army will be disorganized, and if you go out of the horse, you will drag your gun and flee. The old general was too busy to rectify the discipline and went on an expedition, and I thought I was very sorry for the revolutionary masses! The veteran Lu Xun didn't answer, his eyes widened, and the tiger's beard stood upside down, only to see a white mist coming out of his teeth, and the young general Yang Ren knew that the veteran had released poisonous gas, and he said it too late, and he had already put on the gas mask, exactly: the emotional effect is unreasonable, and the right and wrong are unclear only God knows! If you want to know if the veteran can suffocate the young general with poisonous gas, let's wait for the next time to break it down.第二天就收到一封编辑者的信，大意说：兹署名有柳丝者（“先生读其文之内容或不难想像其为何人”），投一滑稽文稿，题为《新儒林外史》，但并无伤及个人名誉之事，业已决定为之发表，倘有反驳文章，亦可登载云云。使刊物暂时化为战场，热闹一通，是办报人的一种极普通办法，近来我更加“世故”，天气又这么热，当然不会去流汗同翻筋斗的。况且“反驳”滑稽文章，也是一种少有的奇事，即使“伤及个人名誉事”，我也没有办法，除非我也作一部《旧儒林外史》，来辩明“卡尔和伊理基”的话的真假。但我并不是巫师，又怎么看得见“天堂”？“柳丝”是杨人先生还在做“无产阶级革命文学者”时候已经用起的笔名，这无须看内容就知道，而曾几何时，就在“小资产阶级革命文学”的旗子下做着这样的幻梦，将自己写成了这么一副形容了。时代的巨轮，真是能够这么冷酷地将人们辗碎的。但也幸而有这一辗，因为韩侍桁先生倒因此从这位“小将”的腔子里看见了“良心”了。
The next day, I received a letter from the editor, to the effect that the person signed by Liu Si ("Sir, it is not difficult to imagine who he is when reading the content of his article"), submitted a funny manuscript entitled "The History of New Confucianism", but it did not hurt his personal reputation, and he had decided to publish it, and if there was a refutation article, it could also be published. Making the publication temporarily turn into a battlefield, lively is a very ordinary way for newspaper runs, recently I have been more "sophisticated", and the weather is so hot, of course I will not sweat and somersault. Moreover, "refuting" funny articles is also a rare strange thing, even if it "hurts personal reputation", I have no way, unless I also make a "History of Old Confucianism" to distinguish the truth of the words of "Karl and Iliki". But I'm not a wizard, so how can I see "heaven"? This work is only the first time, of course, it is not over, although I don't want to "refute", but I am also willing to see this literature with "conscience", but it has been gone since then, and it has been more than a month, and I have not heard the news of "Karl and Iliki" in "heaven" and "veterans" and "young generals" in hell. However, according to "Social News" (July 9, Volume 4, No. 3), it was the "Left Alliance" that prevented it -杨人转入AB团
Yang people transferred to the AB group叛“左联”而写揭小资产战斗之旗的杨邨人，近已由汉来沪，闻寄居于AB团小卒徐翔之家，并已加入该团活动矣。前在《大晚报》署名柳丝所发表的《新封神榜》一文，即杨手笔，内对鲁迅大加讽刺，但未完即止，闻因受“左联”警告云。
The Yang Village people, who rebelled against the "Left Alliance" and wrote the banner of petty bourgeois battle, have recently come to Shanghai from the Han Dynasty, and are said to be living in the home of Xu Xiang, a soldier of the AB Regiment, and have joined the activities of the regiment. The article "New God List" published by Liu Si in the "Evening News" was written by Yang, which satirized Lu Xun inside, but it was not finished, and it was said that he was warned by the "Left Alliance".〔预〕
[Preliminary]“左联”会这么看重一篇“讽刺”的东西，而且仍会给“叛‘左联’而写揭小资产战斗之旗的杨人”以“警告”，这才真是一件奇事。据有些人说，“第三种人”的“忠实于自己的艺术”，是已经因了左翼理论家的凶恶的批评而写不出来了，现在这“小资产战斗”的英雄，又因了“左联”的警告而不再“战斗”，我想，再过几时，则一切割地吞款，兵祸水灾，古物失踪，阔人生病，也要都成为“左联”之罪，尤其是鲁迅之罪了。
It is really strange that the "Left Alliance" would attach so much importance to a "satire" and still "warn" the "Yang people who rebelled against the 'Left Alliance' and wrote the flag of petty bourgeois battle". According to some people, the "third kind of people" who are "loyal to their own art" have been unable to write because of the vicious criticism of left-wing theorists, and now the heroes of this "petty bourgeois battle" are no longer "fighting" because of the warning of the "Left Alliance".现在使我记起了蒋光慈先生。
Now it reminds me of Mr. Jiang Guangci.事情是早已过去，恐怕有四五年了，当蒋光慈先生组织太阳社，和创造社联盟，率领“小将”来围剿我的时候，他曾经做过一篇文章，其中有几句，大意是说，鲁迅向来未曾受人攻击，自以为不可一世，现在要给他知道知道了。其实这是错误的，我自作评论以来，即无时不受攻击，即如这三四月中，仅仅关于《自由谈》的，就已有这许多篇，而且我所收录的，还不过一部份。先前何尝不如此呢，但它们都与如驶的流光一同消逝，无踪无影，不再为别人所觉察罢了。这回趁几种刊物还在手头，便转载一部份到《后记》里，这其实也并非专为我自己，战斗正未有穷期，老谱将不断的袭用，对于别人的攻击，想来也还要用这一类的方法，但自然要改变了所攻击的人名。将来的战斗的青年，倘在类似的境遇中，能偶然看见这记录，我想是必能开颜一笑，更明白所谓敌人者是怎样的东西的。
When Mr. Jiang Guangci organized the Sun Society and the Creation Society Alliance, and led the "young generals" to encircle and suppress me, he once made an article, which had a few sentences, to the effect that Lu Xun had never been attacked by others, and he thought he was invincible, and now he wants to let him know. In fact, this is wrong, since I made my comments, I have been attacked all the time, that is, in the past three or four months, there have been so many articles on "Free Talk" alone, and I have included only a part of them. Why wasn't it like this before, but they all disappeared with the flowing light, without a trace, and were no longer noticed by others. This time, while several publications are still in hand, I reprinted some of them into the "Afterword", which is actually not just for myself, the battle is endless, the old score will continue to be used, and I think I will use this kind of method for other people's attacks, but naturally I have to change the name of the person I attacked. If the young people who fight in the future can see this record by chance in a similar situation, I think they will be able to smile and better understand what the so-called enemy is.所引的文字中，我以为很有些篇，倒是出于先前的“革命文学者”。但他们现在是另一个笔名，另一副嘴脸了。这也是必然的。革命文学者若不想以他的文学，助革命更加深化，展开，却借革命来推销他自己的“文学”，则革命高扬的时候，他正是狮子身中的害虫，而革命一受难，就一定要发现以前的“良心”，或以“孝子”之名，或以“人道”之名，或以“比正在受难的革命更加革命”之名，走出阵线之外，好则沉默，坏就成为叭儿的。这不是我的“毒瓦斯”，这是彼此看见的事实！
Among the quoted texts, I think there are many articles, but they are from the previous "revolutionary writers". But they are now another pseudonym, a different face. This is inevitable. If a revolutionary writer does not want to use his literature to help the revolution deepen and unfold, but uses the revolution to promote his own "literature", then when the revolution is high, he is the pest in the lion's body, and as soon as the revolution suffers, he must find the "conscience" of the past, either in the name of "filial piety", or in the name of "humanity", or in the name of "more revolutionary than the suffering revolution". This is not my "poisonous gas", this is the fact that we see each other!
一九三三年七月二十日午，记。

July 20, 1933 at noon, recorded.

前记

前记

前记

Previously自从中华民国建国二十有二年五月二十五日《自由谈》的编者刊出了“吁请海内文豪，从兹多谈风月”的启事以来，很使老牌风月文豪摇头晃脑的高兴了一大阵，讲冷话的也有，说俏皮话的也有，连只会做“文探”的叭儿们也翘起了它尊贵的尾巴。但有趣的是谈风云的人，风月也谈得，谈风月就谈风月罢，虽然仍旧不能正如尊意。
Since the editor of "Free Talk" published a notice on May 25, the 22nd year of the founding of the Republic of China, "Calling on the writers of the world to talk more about the wind and moon", it has made the old Fengyue writers shake their heads and be happy for a while. But what is interesting is that people who talk about wind and clouds, the wind and the moon can also be talked about, and the wind and moon are just talking about the wind and the moon, although it is still not as you want.想从一个题目限制了作家，其实是不能够的。假如出一个“学而时习之”的试题，叫遗少和车夫来做八股，那做法就决定不一样。自然，车夫做的文章可以说是不通，是胡说，但这不通或胡说，就打破了遗少们的一统天下。古话里也有过：柳下惠看见糖水，说“可以养老”，盗跖见了，却道可以粘门闩。他们是弟兄，所见的又是同一的东西，想到的用法却有这么天差地远。“月白风清，如此良夜何？”好的，风雅之至，举手赞成。但同是涉及风月的“月黑杀人夜，风高放火天”呢，这不明明是一联古诗么？
It is actually impossible to limit writers from one topic. If there is a test question of "learning and learning", and ask Yi Shao and the coachman to do eight strands, then the method will be different. Naturally, the articles made by the coachman can be said to be unreasonable and nonsense, but this does not make sense or nonsense, which breaks the dominance of the young people. There is also an old saying: Liu Xia Hui saw the sugar water and said "you can provide for the elderly", but the thief saw it, but said that he could stick to the door latch. They are brothers, and what they see is the same thing, but the usage they think of is so different. "The moon is white and the wind is clear, what is such a good night?" Okay, elegant, raise your hand in approval. But what about the same "moon dark murdering night, high wind and fire day" involving wind and moon, is this clearly an ancient poem?我的谈风月也终于谈出了乱子来，不过也并非为了主张“杀人放火”。其实，以为“多谈风月”，就是“莫谈国事”的意思，是误解的。“漫谈国事”倒并不要紧，只是要“漫”，发出去的箭石，不要正中了有些人物的鼻梁，因为这是他的武器，也是他的幌子。
My talk about Fengyue finally came out of trouble, but it was not to advocate "murder and arson". In fact, it is misunderstood to think that "talking more about the wind and moon" means "not talking about state affairs". It doesn't matter if you "talk about state affairs", just "talk about state affairs", and the arrows and stones sent out don't hit the bridge of some characters' noses, because this is his weapon and his cover.从六月起的投稿，我就用种种的笔名了，一面固然为了省事，一面也省得有人骂读者们不管文字，只看作者的署名。然而这么一来，却又使一些看文字不用视觉，专靠嗅觉的“文学家”疑神疑鬼，而他们的嗅觉又没有和全体一同进化，至于看见一个新的作家的名字，就疑心是我的化名，对我呜呜不已，有时简直连读者都被他们闹得莫名其妙了。现在就将当时所用的笔名，仍旧留在每篇之下，算是负着应负的责任。
Since June, I have used various pseudonyms, on the one hand, to save trouble, on the other hand, it also saves readers from scolding readers for ignoring the text and only looking at the author's signature. However, this has made some "writers" who read words without sight and rely solely on their sense of smell suspicious, and their sense of smell has not evolved with the whole of them. Now the pseudonym used at that time is still under each article, which is considered to be a responsibility.还有一点和先前的编法不同的，是将刊登时被删改的文字大概补上去了，而且旁加黑点，以清眉目。这删改，是出于编辑或总编辑，还是出于官派的检查员的呢，现在已经无从辨别，但推想起来，改点句子，去些讳忌，文章却还能连接的处所，大约是出于编辑的，而胡乱删削，不管文气的接不接，语意的完不完的，便是钦定的文章。
Another point that is different from the previous compilation method is that the text that was deleted at the time of publication is probably supplemented, and black dots are added next to it to clear the eyebrows. Whether this deletion is from the editor or the editor-in-chief, or from the official inspector, it is impossible to tell now, but when I think about it, I changed some sentences, removed some taboos, but the place where the article can still be connected is probably from the editor, and the random deletion, regardless of whether the literary style is connected or not, the semantic meaning is incomplete, it is the imperial article.日本的刊物，也有禁忌，但被删之处，是留着空白，或加虚线，使读者能够知道的。中国的检查官却不许留空白，必须接起来，于是读者就看不见检查删削的痕迹，一切含胡和恍忽之点，都归在作者身上了。这一种办法，是比日本大有进步的，我现在提出来，以存中国文网史上极有价值的故实。
Japanese publications also have taboos, but they are deleted with blanks or dotted lines so that readers can know. Chinese prosecutors are not allowed to leave blanks, they must be picked up, so readers cannot see the traces of inspection and deletion, and all the beards and dazed points belong to the author. This method is a great improvement over Japan, and I am proposing it now to preserve the extremely valuable facts in the history of the Chinese Literary Network.去年的整半年中，随时写一点，居然在不知不觉中又成一本了。当然，这不过是一些拉杂的文章，为“文学家”所不屑道。然而这样的文字，现在却也并不多，而且“拾荒”的人们，也还能从中检出东西来，我因此相信这书的暂时的生存，并且作为集印的缘故。
In the whole half of last year, I wrote a little at any time, and I actually became another book without realizing it. Of course, this is just some miscellaneous articles that are disdained by "writers". However, there are not many such words now, and people who "pick up waste" can still detect things from them, so I believe that the temporary survival of this book is for the sake of collecting prints.一九三四年三月十日，于上海记。
March 10, 1934, in Shanghai.

夜颂

夜颂

夜颂

Night Song游光
Swimming light爱夜的人，也不但是孤独者，有闲者，不能战斗者，怕光明者。
People who love the night are not only lonely, idle, unable to fight, and afraid of the light.人的言行，在白天和在深夜，在日下和在灯前，常常显得两样。夜是造化所织的幽玄的天衣，普覆一切人，使他们温暖，安心，不知不觉的自己渐渐脱去人造的面具和衣裳，赤条条地裹在这无边际的黑絮似的大块里。
People's words and deeds often seem different during the day and late at night, under the sun and in front of the lamp. The night is the mysterious heavenly garment woven by nature, covering everyone, making them warm and at ease, and unconsciously they gradually take off their artificial masks and clothes, and wrap themselves in this boundless black fluff-like lump.虽然是夜，但也有明暗。有微明，有昏暗，有伸手不见掌，有漆黑一团糟。爱夜的人要有听夜的耳朵和看夜的眼睛，自在暗中，看一切暗。君子们从电灯下走入暗室中，伸开了他的懒腰；爱侣们从月光下走进树阴里，突变了他的眼色。夜的降临，抹杀了一切文人学士们当光天化日之下，写在耀眼的白纸上的超然，混然，恍然，勃然，粲然的文章，只剩下乞怜，讨好，撒谎，骗人，吹牛，捣鬼的夜气，形成一个灿烂的金色的光圈，像见于佛画上面似的，笼罩在学识不凡的头脑上。
Although it is night, there is also light and dark. There is faint light, there is darkness, there is a hand that cannot be seen, and there is a pitch black mess. Those who love the night must have ears to listen to the night and eyes to see the night, and be free in the dark and see everything in the dark. The gentlemen walked into the dark room from under the electric light, stretching his lazy waist; The lovers walked into the shade of the trees from the moonlight and changed his eyes. The advent of night erased all the transcendent, confused, sudden, furious, and brilliant articles written on dazzling white paper in broad daylight, leaving only the night air of begging, flattering, lying, deceiving, bragging, and mischievous, forming a brilliant golden aperture, as seen on Buddhist paintings, shrouded in the minds of extraordinary learners.爱夜的人于是领受了夜所给与的光明。
Those who love the night thus receive the light given by the night.高跟鞋的摩登女郎在马路边的电光灯下，阁阁的走得很起劲，但鼻尖也闪烁着一点油汗，在证明她是初学的时髦，假如长在明晃晃的照耀中，将使她碰着“没落”的命运。一大排关着的店铺的昏暗助她一臂之力，使她放缓开足的马力，吐一口气，这时才觉得沁人心脾的夜里的拂拂的凉风。
The modern girl in high heels walked very vigorously under the electric light on the side of the road, but the tip of her nose also flashed a little oil sweat, proving that she was a beginner fashionable, and if she grew up in the bright light, she would encounter the fate of "decline". The darkness of a large row of closed shops helped her to slow down her horsepower and exhale, only then did she feel the cool breeze in the refreshing night.爱夜的人和摩登女郎，于是同时领受了夜所给与的恩惠。
The night lover and the modern girl received the favor given by the night at the same time.一夜已尽，人们又小心翼翼的起来，出来了；便是夫妇们，面目和五六点钟之前也何其两样。从此就是热闹，喧嚣。而高墙后面，大厦中间，深闺里，黑狱里，客室里，秘密机关里，却依然弥漫着惊人的真的大黑暗。
At the end of the night, people got up cautiously and came out; Even the couples looked the same as before five or six o'clock. Since then, it has been lively and noisy. Behind the high walls, in the middle of the building, in the deep boudoir, in the black prison, in the guest rooms, and in the secret organs, there is still an amazing and real darkness.现在的光天化日，熙来攘往，就是这黑暗的装饰，是人肉酱缸上的金盖，是鬼脸上的雪花膏。只有夜还算是诚实的。我爱夜，在夜间作《夜颂》。
In broad daylight now, it is this dark decoration, the golden lid on the human sauce jar, and the alabaster paste on the grimace. Only the night is honest. I love the night, and I write "Ode to the Night" at night.六月八日。
June 8.

推

推

推

push丰之余
Abundant surplus两三月前，报上好像登过一条新闻，说有一个卖报的孩子，踏上电车的踏脚去取报钱，误踹住了一个下来的客人的衣角，那人大怒，用力一推，孩子跌入车下，电车又刚刚走动，一时停不住，把孩子碾死了。

When we walk on Shanghai Road, we often encounter two types of people who go on a rampage and never give way to pedestrians opposite or in front of them. One is to step on your long straight feet as if you are in a no-man's land, and if you don't get out of the way, he will step on your stomach or shoulder. These are foreigners, they are all "higher", and there is no difference between the upper and lower levels like the Chinese. One is to bend his two arms and palms outward, like two pincers of a scorpion, pushing all the way, regardless of whether the person being pushed fell into the mud pond or fire pit. This is our compatriot, but the "superior", he takes the tram, he has to take the second-class changed to the third-class car, he reads the newspaper, he wants to read the tabloids that are deliberately shady, he sits and swallows his saliva, but when he walks around, he pushes again.上车，进门，买票，寄信，他推；出门，下车，避祸，逃难，他又推。推得女人孩子都踉踉跄跄，跌倒了，他就从活人上踏过，跌死了，他就从死尸上踏过，走出外面，用舌头舔舔自己的厚嘴唇，什么也不觉得。旧历端午，在一家戏场里，因为一句失火的谣言，就又是推，把十多个力量未足的少年踏死了。死尸摆在空地上，据说去看的又有万余人，人山人海，又是推。

As a result of pushing, he opened his mouth and said, "Ah, it's so vain! ”住在上海，想不遇到推与踏，是不能的，而且这推与踏也还要廓大开去。要推倒一切下等华人中的幼弱者，要踏倒一切下等华人。这时就只剩了高等华人颂祝着——
Living in Shanghai, it is impossible not to encounter pushing and stepping, and this pushing and stepping will also have to be expanded. We must overthrow all the weak among the inferior Chinese, and we must trample on all the inferior Chinese. At this time, only the high Chinese were left praising and praying——“阿唷，真好白相来希呀。为保全文化起见，是虽然牺牲任何物质，也不应该顾惜的——这些物质有什么重要性呢！”

Although bats are also night-flying animals, their reputation in China is quite good. This is not because he swallowed mosquitoes and flies, which were beneficial to people, and most of them fell on his name, which is the same as the word "Fu". With such a dignified appearance, it can be written into a picture, and it really depends on the name to get up. In his fable, it is said that the birds and beasts held their own meetings, and the bat went to the beasts, because he had wings, and the beasts did not accept them, but went to the birds, and because he was a four-legged man, the birds did not accept him, so he had no position, so everyone hated the bat as a symbol of riding the wall.中国近来拾一点洋古典，有时也奚落起蝙蝠来。但这种寓言，出于伊索，是可喜的，因为他的时代，动物学还幼稚得很。现在可不同了，鲸鱼属于什么类，蝙蝠属于什么类，就是小学生也都知道得清清楚楚。倘若还拾一些希腊古典，来作正经话讲，那就只足表示他的知识，还和伊索时候，各开大会的两类绅士淑女们相同。

The first paragraph is deception. When you see greedy people, you use temptations, when you see lonely and angry people, you pretend to be sympathetic, when you see unlucky people, you pretend to be generous, but when you see generous people, you will pretend to be miserable, and the result is something that sweeps your opponent.第二段是威压。如果欺骗无效，或者被人看穿了，就脸孔一翻，化为威吓，或者说人无礼，或者诬人不端，或者赖人欠钱，或者并不说什么缘故，而这也谓之“讲道理”，结果还是席卷了对手的东西。
The second paragraph is coercion. If the deception is ineffective, or if it is seen through, it will turn into a threat, or say that the person is rude, or falsely accuse others, or rely on others to owe money, or do not say anything, and this is also called "reasoning", and the result is still something that sweeps the opponent.第三段是溜走。用了上面的一段或兼用了两段而成功了，就一溜烟走掉，再也寻不出踪迹来。失败了，也是一溜烟走掉，再也寻不出踪迹来。事情闹得大一点，则离开本埠，避过了风头再出现。
The third paragraph is to slip away. If you use the above paragraph or both paragraphs and succeed, you will walk away and never be able to find a trace again. If you fail, you will walk away and never be able to find a trace again. If the matter is bigger, he will leave the port and avoid the limelight and reappear.有这样的职业，明明白白，然而人们是不以为奇的。
There is such a profession, obviously, but people are not surprised.“白相”可以吃饭，劳动的自然就要饿肚，明明白白，然而人们也不以为奇。

I talk about "fallen people"越客
Vietnamese六月二十九日的《自由谈》里，唐弢先生曾经讲到浙东的堕民，并且据《堕民猥谈》之说，以为是宋将焦光瓒的部属，因为降金，为时人所不齿，至明太祖，乃榜其门曰“丐户”，此后他们遂在悲苦和被人轻蔑的环境下过着日子。
In the "Freedom Talk" on June 29, Mr. Tang Tao once talked about the fallen people in eastern Zhejiang, and according to the "Fallen People Obscene Talk", he thought that he was a subordinate of the Song general Jiao Guangzan, who was despised by the people of the time because of the surrender of gold.我生于绍兴，堕民是幼小时候所常见的人，也从父老的口头，听到过同样的他们所以成为堕民的缘起。但后来我怀疑了。因为我想，明太祖对于元朝，尚且不肯放肆，他是决不会来管隔一朝代的降金的宋将的；况且看他们的职业，分明还有“教坊”或“乐户”的余痕，所以他们的祖先，倒是明初的反抗洪武和永乐皇帝的忠臣义士也说不定。还有一层，是好人的子孙会吃苦，卖国者的子孙却未必变成堕民的，举出最近便的例子来，则岳飞的后裔还在杭州看守岳王坟，可是过着很穷苦悲惨的生活，然而秦桧，严嵩……的后人呢？……
I was born in Shaoxing, and the fallen people were common people when I was young, and I also heard from the words of my fathers and elders that they became the origin of the fallen people. But then I doubted. Because I think that Ming Taizu was still unwilling to be presumptuous for the Yuan Dynasty, and he would never come to take care of the Song generals who surrendered to the Jin dynasty in another dynasty; Moreover, looking at their occupations, there are clearly traces of "teaching workshops" or "music households", so their ancestors may be loyal ministers and righteous men who resisted the Hongwu and Yongle emperors in the early Ming Dynasty. There is another layer, the descendants of good people will endure hardships, but the descendants of traitors may not become depraved people, to give a recent example, Yue Fei's descendants are still guarding the tomb of King Yue in Hangzhou, but they live a very poor and miserable life, but Qin Hui and Yan Song...... What about the descendants? ……不过我现在并不想翻这样的陈年账。我只要说，在绍兴的堕民，是一种已经解放了的奴才，这解放就在雍正年间罢，也说不定。所以他们是已经都有别的职业的了，自然是贱业。男人们是收旧货，卖鸡毛，捉青蛙，做戏；女的则每逢过年过节，到她所认为主人的家里去道喜，有庆吊事情就帮忙，在这里还留着奴才的皮毛，但事毕便走，而且有颇多的犒赏，就可见是曾经解放过的了。
But I don't want to turn over such old accounts now. I only need to say that the fallen people in Shaoxing are a kind of slaves who have been liberated, and this liberation was during the Yongzheng period, maybe. So they already have other occupations, so naturally they are cheap jobs. Men collect second-hand goods, sell chicken feathers, catch frogs, and do tricks; The woman goes to the house she thinks is the master's house every New Year, and she helps with the celebration and mourning, and there is still the skin of the servant here, but she leaves after the event, and there are a lot of rewards, which shows that she has been liberated.每一家堕民所走的主人家是有一定的，不能随便走；婆婆死了，就使儿媳妇去，传给后代，恰如遗产的一般；必须非常贫穷，将走动的权利卖给了别人，这才和旧主人断绝了关系。假使你无端叫她不要来了，那就是等于给与她重大的侮辱。我还记得民国革命之后，我的母亲曾对一个堕民的女人说，“以后我们都一样了，你们可以不要来了。”不料她却勃然变色，愤愤的回答道：“你说的是什么话？……我们是千年万代，要走下去的！”
The owner of each fallen family has a certain number of people, and they cannot go casually; When the mother-in-law dies, let the daughter-in-law go and pass it on to the descendants, just like the inheritance; Must be very poor and sell the right to move around to someone else, so that he breaks off relations with the old master. If you tell her not to come for no reason, it is equivalent to giving her a major insult. I still remember that after the Republic of China Revolution, my mother once said to a fallen woman, "We will all be the same in the future, you can not come." Unexpectedly, she changed color and replied angrily: "What are you talking about? …… We are thousands of generations, and we want to go on! ”就是为了一点点犒赏，不但安于做奴才，而且还要做更广泛的奴才，还得出钱去买做奴才的权利，这是堕民以外的自由人所万想不到的罢。
It is for the sake of a little reward, not only to be content to be a slave, but also to be a wider slave, and to get money to buy the right to be a slave, which is something that free people other than the fallen people can never imagine.七月三日。

The source of the fire, the Greeks thought it was stolen from heaven by Prometheus, so they provoked the wrath of the great god Zeus, locked him on a high mountain, and ordered a great eagle to peck at his flesh every day.非洲的土人瓦仰安提族也已经用火，但并不是由希腊人传授给他们的。他们另有一个窃火者。
The native people of Africa, the Wayanganti, also used fire, but it was not taught to them by the Greeks. They had another fire thief.这窃火者，人们不能知道他的姓名，或者早被忘却了。他从天上偷了火来，传给瓦仰安提族的祖先，因此触了大神大拉斯之怒，这一段，是和希腊古传相像的。但大拉斯的办法却两样了，并不是锁他在山巅，却秘密的将他锁在暗黑的地窖子里，不给一个人知道。派来的也不是大鹰，而是蚊子，跳蚤，臭虫，一面吸他的血，一面使他皮肤肿起来。这时还有蝇子们，是最善于寻觅创伤的脚色，嗡嗡的叫，拚命的吸吮，一面又拉许多蝇粪在他的皮肤上，来证明他是怎样地一个不干净的东西。
This fire thief, people cannot know his name, or he has long been forgotten. He stole fire from heaven and passed it on to the ancestors of the Wayanganti tribe, so he offended the wrath of the great god Dalas, which is similar to the ancient Greek legend. But Dallas's method was different, not to lock him on the top of the mountain, but to secretly lock him in a dark cellar without anyone knowing. It was not a big eagle that was sent, but mosquitoes, fleas, and bed bugs, which sucked his blood and swollen his skin. At this time, there were also flies, who were the best at finding trauma, buzzing, sucking desperately, and pulling a lot of fly droppings on his skin to prove what an unclean thing he was.然而瓦仰安提族的人们，并不知道这一个故事。他们单知道火乃酋长的祖先所发明，给酋长作烧死异端和烧掉房屋之用的。

智识过剩

智识过剩

智识过剩

Excess of intellect虞明
Yu Ming世界因为生产过剩，所以闹经济恐慌。虽然同时有三千万以上的工人挨饿，但是粮食过剩仍旧是“客观现实”，否则美国不会赊借麦粉给我们，我们也不会“丰收成灾”。
The world is in an economic panic because of overproduction. Although more than 30 million workers are starving at the same time, food surplus is still an "objective reality", otherwise the United States will not lend us wheat flour on credit, and we will not have a "good harvest".然而智识也会过剩的，智识过剩，恐慌就更大了。据说中国现行教育在乡间提倡愈甚，则农村之破产愈速。这大概是智识的丰收成灾了。美国因为棉花贱，所以在铲棉田了。中国却应当铲智识。这是西洋传来的妙法。
However, there will also be an excess of intellect, and if there is too much intellect, the panic will be even greater. It is said that the more China's current education is promoted in the countryside, the faster the countryside will go bankrupt. This is probably a harvest of wisdom. Because cotton is cheap, the United States is shoveling cotton fields. China should shovel its intellect. This is a wonderful method from the West.西洋人是能干的。五六年前，德国就嚷着大学生太多了，一些政治家和教育家，大声疾呼的劝告青年不要进大学。现在德国是不但劝告，而且实行铲除智识了：例如放火烧毁一些书籍，叫作家把自己的文稿吞进肚子去，还有，就是把一群群的大学生关在营房里做苦工，这叫做“解决失业问题”。中国不是也嚷着文法科的大学生过剩吗？其实何止文法科。就是中学生也太多了。要用“严厉的”会考制度，像铁扫帚似的——刷，刷，刷，把大多数的智识青年刷回“民间”去。
Westerners are capable. Five or six years ago, Germany shouted that there were too many college students, and some politicians and educators loudly advised young people not to go to university. Now Germany not only advises, but also implements the eradication of intellect: for example, setting fire to some books, asking writers to swallow their manuscripts, and locking groups of college students in barracks to do hard labor, which is called "solving the problem of unemployment". Isn't China also shouting about the surplus of college students in grammar? In fact, it's not just about grammar. Even there are too many middle school students. It is necessary to use a "strict" examination system, like an iron broom - brush, brush, brush, brush, brush most intellectual young people back to the "folk".智识过剩何以会闹恐慌？中国不是百分之八九十的人还不识字吗？然而智识过剩始终是“客观现实”，而由此而来的恐慌，也是“客观现实”。智识太多了，不是心活，就是心软。心活就会胡思乱想，心软就不肯下辣手。结果，不是自己不镇静，就是妨害别人的镇静。于是灾祸就来了。所以智识非铲除不可。
Why does excess intellect cause panic? Isn't 80 or 90 percent of the people in China still illiterate? However, intellectual excess is always an "objective reality", and the panic that comes from it is also an "objective reality". There is too much knowledge, either the heart is alive or the heart is soft. If you are in your heart, you will think wildly, and if you are soft-hearted, you will refuse to be hot. As a result, either you are not calm or you are disturbing the calmness of others. So woe came. Therefore, wisdom must be eradicated.然而单是铲除还是不够的。必须予以适合实用之教育，第一，是命理学——要乐天知命，命虽然苦，但还是应当乐。第二，是识相学——要“识相点”，知道点近代武器的利害。至少，这两种适合实用的学问是要赶快提倡的。提倡的方法很简单：——古代一个哲学家反驳唯心论，他说，你要是怀疑这碗麦饭的物质是否存在，那最好请你吃下去，看饱不饱。现在譬如说罢，要叫人懂得电学，最好是使他触电，看痛不痛；要叫人知道飞机等类的效用，最好是在他头上驾起飞机，掷下炸弹，看死不死……
However, eradication alone is not enough. It must be given a suitable and practical education, first, numerology - to be happy and know your fate, although life is bitter, you should still be happy. Second, it is physiognomy - to "recognize the point" and know the pros and cons of modern weapons. At least, these two practical studies should be advocated as soon as possible. The method advocated is very simple: - An ancient philosopher refuted idealism, he said, if you doubt whether the substance in this bowl of wheat rice exists, then it is best to invite you to eat it and see if you are full. Now, for example, if you want people to understand electricity, it is best to electrocute them and see if it hurts; To let people know the utility of airplanes and other things, it is best to fly the plane on his head, drop a bomb, and see if he is dead......有了这样的实用教育，智识就不过剩了。亚门！
With such a practical education, there is no need for intellectual knowledge. Subphylum!七月十二日。

For example, during the Xinhai Revolution, it was suddenly discovered:“手执钢刀九十九，杀尽胡儿方罢手。”
"Ninety-nine steel knives in my hand, I killed all the Hu people before I stopped."这几句《推背图》里的预言，就不过是“诗”罢了。那时候，何尝只有九十九把钢刀？还是洋枪大炮来得厉害：该着洋枪大炮的后来毕竟占了上风，而只有钢刀的却吃了大亏。况且当时的“胡儿”，不但并未“杀尽”，而且还受了优待，以至于现在还有“伪”溥仪出风头的日子。所以当做预言看，这几句歌诀其实并没有应验。——死板的照着这类预言去干，往往要碰壁，好比前些时候，有人特别打了九十九把钢刀，去送给前线的战士，结果，只不过在古北口等处流流血，给人证明国难的不可抗性。——倒不如把这种预言歌诀当做“诗”看，还可以“以意逆志，自谓得之”。
These prophecies in "Tui Bei Tu" are nothing more than "poems". At that time, there were only ninety-nine steel knives. It was still the foreign gun and cannon that came hard: the foreign gun and cannon later had the upper hand after all, but the steel knife suffered a big loss. Moreover, the "Hu'er" at that time not only did not "kill them all", but also received preferential treatment, so that there are still days when the "pseudo" Puyi is in the limelight. So as a prophecy, these few songs have not actually been fulfilled. For example, some time ago, someone specially beat ninety-nine steel knives to give to the soldiers on the front line, and as a result, they only shed blood at Gubeikou and other places, proving the irresistibility of the national crisis. ——It is better to regard this kind of prophecy as a "poem", and you can also "go against your will and think you have it".至于诗里面，却的确有着极深刻的预言。我们要找预言，与其读《推背图》，不如读诗人的诗集。也许这个年头又是应当发现什么的时候了罢，居然找着了这么几句：

"These people seal wolves and dogs, and hunters are like hunting beasts in their lives.万人一怒不可回，会看太白悬其首。”
Thousands of people are angry and cannot be turned back, and they will see Venus hanging their heads. ”汪精卫著《双照楼诗词稿》：译嚣俄之《共和二年之战士》
Wang Jingwei's "Manuscript of the Poems of Shuangzhao Tower": Translated from Xiao Russia's "Soldiers of the Second Year of the Republic"这怎么叫人不“拍案叫绝”呢？这里“封狼从瘈狗”，自己明明是畜生，却偏偏把人当做畜生看待：畜生打猎，而人反而被猎！“万人”的愤怒的确是不可挽回的了。嚣俄这诗，是说的一七九三年（法国第一共和二年）的帝制党，他没有料到一百四十年之后还会有这样的应验。
How can this not be "amazing"? Here, "sealing the wolf from the dog", he is obviously a beast, but he treats people as beasts: beasts hunt, and people are hunted instead! The anger of "10,000 people" is indeed irreparable. Nowadays, there are fewer and fewer people who understand this kind of classical Chinese poetry, which is a pity.
