Young cow关于张献忠的传说，中国各处都有，可见是大家都很以他为奇特的，我先前也便是很以他为奇特的人们中的一个。
There are legends about Zhang Xianzhong everywhere in China, which shows that everyone thinks he is very peculiar, and I was one of the people who thought he was very peculiar before.儿时见过一本书，叫作《无双谱》，是清初人之作，取历史上极特别无二的人物，各画一像，一面题些诗，但坏人好像是没有的。因此我后来想到可以择历来极其特别，而其实是代表着中国人性质之一种的人物，作一部中国的“人史”，如英国嘉勒尔的《英雄及英雄崇拜》，美国亚懋生的《伟人论》那样。惟须好坏俱有，有啮雪苦节的苏武，舍身求法的玄奘，有“鞠躬尽瘁，死而后已”的孔明，但也有呆信古法，“死而后已”的王莽，有半当真半取笑的变法的王安石；张献忠当然也在内。但现在是毫没有动笔的意思了。
When I was a child, I saw a book called "Wushuang Spectrum", which was the work of the early Qing Dynasty, taking very special and unique characters in history, drawing a portrait of each and inscribing some poems on the other, but the bad guys seemed to be none. Therefore, I later thought that I could choose a character who is extremely special in history and actually represents a kind of Chinese nature to make a Chinese "human history", such as Garrell's "Heroes and Hero Worship" in the United Kingdom and "The Theory of Great Men" by Ya Maosheng in the United States. There are both good and bad, there are Su Wu who bites snow, Xuanzang who sacrifices himself to seek the law, Kong Ming who "bows down and does his best, and dies after death", but there are also Wang Mang who believes in ancient laws and "dies after death", and Wang Anshi who changes the law half-seriously and half-ridiculed; Zhang Xianzhong is of course included. But now there is no intention of writing.《蜀碧》一类的书，记张献忠杀人的事颇详细，但也颇散漫，令人看去仿佛他是像“为艺术而艺术”的一样，专在“为杀人而杀人”了。他其实是别有目的的。他开初并不很杀人，他何尝不想做皇帝。后来知道李自成进了北京，接着是清兵入关，自己只剩了没落这一条路，于是就开手杀，杀……他分明的感到，天下已没有自己的东西，现在是在毁坏别人的东西了，这和有些末代的风雅皇帝，在死前烧掉了祖宗或自己所搜集的书籍古董宝贝之类的心情，完全一样。他还有兵，而没有古董之类，所以就杀，杀，杀人，杀……
Books such as "Shu Bi" record Zhang Xianzhong's murder in great detail, but it is also quite scattered, making people seem as if he is like "art for art's sake", specializing in "killing for the sake of killing". He actually has a different purpose. He didn't kill very much at the beginning, so why didn't he want to be an emperor. Later, he knew that Li Zicheng had entered Beijing, and then the Qing soldiers entered the customs, and he was left with only the road of decline, so he started to kill and kill...... He clearly felt that there was no one in the world of his own, and now he was destroying other people's things, which was exactly the same as the mood of some of the last elegant emperors who burned their ancestors or the books and antique treasures they had collected before they died. He still has soldiers, but no antiques or anything like that, so he kills, kills, kills, kills......但他还要维持兵，这实在不过是维持杀。他杀得没有平民了，就派许多较为心腹的人到兵们中间去，设法窃听，偶有怨言，即跃出执之，戮其全家（他的兵像是有家眷的，也许就是掳来的妇女）。以杀治兵，用兵来杀，自己是完了，但要这样的达到一同灭亡的末路。我们对于别人的或公共的东西，不是也不很爱惜的么？
But he still has to maintain the soldiers, which is really nothing more than a maintenance kill. He killed no more civilians, so he sent many of his confidants to the soldiers to eavesdrop, and occasionally complained, that is, he jumped out and arrested them, killing their entire families (his soldiers seemed to have families, maybe captive women). Killing and killing with soldiers is the end of oneself, but to achieve the end of destruction together. Don't we cherish other people's or public things very much?所以张献忠的举动，一看虽然似乎古怪，其实是极平常的。古怪的倒是那些被杀的人们，怎么会总是束手伸颈的等他杀，一定要清朝的肃王来射死他，这才作为奴才而得救，而还说这是前定，就是所谓“吹箫不用竹，一箭贯当胸”。但我想，这豫言诗是后人造出来的，我们不知道那时的人们真是怎么想。
Therefore, Zhang Xianzhong's actions, although they seem strange at first glance, are actually very ordinary. The strange thing is that those who were killed, how could they always stretch their hands and necks and wait for him to kill, and they must be shot dead by King Su of the Qing Dynasty, so that he could be saved as a slave, and he also said that this was a predetermination, that is, the so-called "blowing the flute does not use bamboo, and an arrow is pierced into the chest". “中国文坛的悲观”

“中国文坛的悲观”

“中国文坛的悲观”

"Pessimism in the Chinese literary world"旅隼
Traveling Falcon文雅书生中也真有特别善于下泪的人物，说是因为近来中国文坛的混乱，好像军阀割据，便不禁“呜呼”起来了，但尤其痛心诬陷。
There are really characters who are particularly good at shedding tears among the elegant scholars, saying that because of the recent chaos in the Chinese literary world, it seems that the warlords are separatist, so they can't help but "woo", but they are especially sad to frame.其实是作文“藏之名山”的时代一去，而有一个“坛”，便不免有斗争，甚而至于谩骂，诬陷的。明末太远，不必提了；清朝的章实斋和袁子才，李莼客和赵叔，就如水火之不可调和；再近些，则有《民报》和《新民丛报》之争，《新青年》派和某某派之争，也都非常猛烈。当初又何尝不使局外人摇头叹气呢，然而胜负一明，时代渐远，战血为雨露洗得干干净净，后人便以为先前的文坛是太平了。在外国也一样，我们现在大抵只知道嚣俄和霍普德曼是卓卓的文人，但当时他们的剧本开演的时候，就在戏场里捉人，打架，较详的文学史上，还载着打架之类的图。
In fact, the era of the composition "hidden famous mountain" is gone, and there is an "altar", which inevitably leads to struggles, and even abuse and false accusations. The end of the Ming Dynasty is too far away, so there is no need to mention it; Zhang Shizhai and Yuan Zicai of the Qing Dynasty, Li Yingke and Uncle Zhao, are like water and fire are irreconcilable; Closer, there is the dispute between "Minbao" and "Xinmin Congbao", and the dispute between the "New Youth" faction and so-and-so faction, which are also very fierce. At the beginning, why didn't outsiders shake their heads and sigh, but as soon as the victory and defeat were clear, the times gradually faded away, and the blood of war was washed clean by the rain and dew, and later generations thought that the previous literary world was peaceful. The same is true in foreign countries, we now probably only know that Xiao Russian and Hopmann are Zhuo Zhuo's literati, but when their scripts were performed, they were catching people in the theater, fighting, and in the more detailed literary history, there are also pictures of fights and so on.所以，无论中外古今，文坛上是总归有些混乱，使文雅书生看得要“悲观”的。但也总归有许多所谓文人和文章也者一定灭亡，只有配存在者终于存在，以证明文坛也总归还是干净的处所。增加混乱的倒是有些悲观论者，不施考察，不加批判，但用“彼亦一是非，此亦一是非”的论调，将一切作者，诋为“一丘之貉”。这样子，扰乱是永远不会收场的。然而世间却并不都这样，一定会有明明白白的是非之别，我们试想一想，林琴南攻击文学革命的小说，为时并不久，现在那里去了？
Therefore, no matter ancient or modern, there is always some confusion in the literary world, which makes elegant scholars look "pessimistic". But there are always many so-called literati and writers who must perish, and only those who deserve existence finally exist to prove that the literary world is still a clean place. What adds to the confusion are some pessimists, who do not investigate or criticize, but use the argument that "he is also right and wrong, and this is also right and wrong" to denigrate all authors as "a raccoon on a hill". In this way, the disturbance will never end. However, not all of the world is like this, there will be a clear difference between right and wrong, let's think about it, Lin Qinnan's novel attacking the literary revolution, not long ago, where is it now?只有近来的诬陷，倒像是颇为出色的花样，但其实也并不比古时候更厉害，证据是清初大兴文字之狱的遗闻。况且闹这样玩意的，其实并不完全是文人，十中之九，乃是挂了招牌，而无货色，只好化为黑店，出卖人肉馒头的小盗；即使其中偶然有曾经弄过笔墨的人，然而这时却正是露出原形，在告白他自己的没落，文坛决不因此混乱，倒是反而越加清楚，越加分明起来了。
Only the recent slander seems to be quite an excellent trick, but in fact it is not more powerful than in ancient times, and the evidence is the rumors of the prison of Daxing in the early Qing Dynasty. Moreover, the people who make such a thing are not entirely literati, nine out of ten, but they have hung up signboards, but have no goods, so they have to turn into black shops and sell human meat steamed buns; Even if there are occasionally people who have done pen and ink, but at this time they are revealing their true forms, confessing their own decline, and the literary world will never be confused because of this, but it will become clearer and clearer.历史决不倒退，文坛是无须悲观的。悲观的由来，是在置身事外不辨是非，而偏要关心于文坛，或者竟是自己坐在没落的营盘里。
History will never go backwards, and there is no need to be pessimistic in the literary world. The origin of pessimism is to stay out of the matter and not distinguish right from wrong, but to care about the literary world, or to sit in a declining camp.八月十日。

Autumn night travel tour游光

Dangerous? Danger makes people nervous, and nervousness makes people feel the power of their own life. Roaming in danger, it's good.租界也还有悠闲的处所，是住宅区。但中等华人的窟穴却是炎热的，吃食担，胡琴，麻将，留声机，垃圾桶，光着的身子和腿。相宜的是高等华人或无等洋人住处的门外，宽大的马路，碧绿的树，淡色的窗幔，凉风，月光，然而也有狗子叫。

I grew up in the countryside, I loved to listen to dogs barking, barking late at night, and it was pleasant to hear it, as the ancients called "the sound of a dog like a leopard". If you occasionally pass by the unfamiliar village, a wild howl, the giant mastiff jumps out, which also gives people a sense of nervousness, as if in battle, which is very interesting.但可惜在这里听到的是吧儿狗。它躲躲闪闪，叫得很脆：汪汪！
But unfortunately, it was the dog that was heard here. It dodged and screamed very crisply: Wow!我不爱听这一种叫。
I don't like to hear this kind of call.我一面漫步，一面发出冷笑，因为我明白了使它闭口的方法，是只要去和它主子的管门人说几句话，或者抛给它一根肉骨头。这两件我还能的，但是我不做。
I sneered as I strolled, for I understood that the way to silence it was to just say a few words to its master's gatekeeper or throw it a piece of meat. I can still do these two things, but I don't do them.它常常要汪汪。
It often has to bark.我不爱听这一种叫。
I don't like to hear this kind of call.我一面漫步，一面发出恶笑了，因为我手里拿着一粒石子，恶笑刚敛，就举手一掷，正中了它的鼻梁。
As I strolled, I grinned wickedly, because I was holding a stone in my hand, and as soon as I stopped laughing, I raised my hand and threw it, hitting the bridge of its nose.呜的一声，它不见了。我漫步着，漫步着，在少有的寂寞里。
With a whine, it was gone. I strolled, strolled, in a rare loneliness.秋已经来了，我还是漫步着。叫呢，也还是有的，然而更加躲躲闪闪了，声音也和先前不同，距离也隔得远了，连鼻子都看不见。
Autumn has come, and I still stroll. There are still some calls, but they are even more dodging, and their voices are different from before, and the distance is so far away that they can't even see their noses.我不再冷笑，不再恶笑了，我漫步着，一面舒服的听着它那很脆的声音。

“揩油”

“揩油”

“揩油”

"Wipe the oil."苇索
苇索“揩油”，是说明着奴才的品行全部的。
"Rubbing oil" shows the whole character of the servant.这不是“取回扣”或“取佣钱”，因为这是一种秘密；但也不是偷窃，因为在原则上，所取的实在是微乎其微。因此也不能说是“分肥”；至多，或者可以谓之“舞弊”罢。然而这又是光明正大的“舞弊”，因为所取的是豪家，富翁，阔人，洋商的东西，而且所取又不过一点点，恰如从油水汪洋的处所，揩了一下，于人无损，于揩者却有益的，并且也不失为损富济贫的正道。设法向妇女调笑几句，或乘机摸一下，也谓之“揩油”，这虽然不及对于金钱的名正言顺，但无大损于被揩者则一也。
This is not a "kickback" or "commission money" because it is a secret; But it is not stealing, because in principle, the takeaway is really minimal. Therefore, it cannot be said to be "fattening"; At most, it can be called "fraud". However, this is also an upright "fraud", because what is taken is the things of wealthy families, rich people, wealthy people, and foreign merchants, and the only thing taken is a little bit, just like wiping it from a place full of oil and water, which is not harmful to people, but beneficial to those who wipe it, and it is also the right way to reduce the rich and help the poor. Trying to tease a few words to women, or taking the opportunity to touch them, is also called "wiping oil", although this is not as justifiable as money, but it does not cause much harm to the person being wiped.表现得最分明的是电车上的卖票人。纯熟之后，他一面留心着可揩的客人，一面留心着突来的查票，眼光都练得像老鼠和老鹰的混合物一样。付钱而不给票，客人本该索取的，然而很难索取，也很少见有人索取，因为他所揩的是洋商的油，同是中国人，当然有帮忙的义务，一索取，就变成帮助洋商了。这时候，不但卖票人要报你憎恶的眼光，连同车的客人也往往不免显出以为你不识时务的脸色。
The most obvious is the ticket seller on the tram. After becoming proficient, he paid attention to the guests who could be wiped and the sudden ticket check, and his vision was like a mixture of a mouse and an eagle. Paying money without giving a ticket, the guest should have asked for it, but it is difficult to ask for it, and it is rare for anyone to ask for it, because he is the oil of a foreign businessman, and he is also Chinese, of course, he has the obligation to help. At this time, not only will the ticket seller report your hateful eyes, but also the guests in the car will often show a face that thinks you don't know the current affairs.然而彼一时，此一时，如果三等客中有时偶缺一个铜元，你却只好在目的地以前下车，这时他就不肯通融，变成洋商的忠仆了。
However, at that time, at this time, if a copper dollar is sometimes missing among the third-class guests, you have to get off the bus before the destination, and then he refuses to be accommodating and becomes a loyal servant of foreign merchants.在上海，如果同巡捕，门丁，西崽之类闲谈起来，他们大抵是憎恶洋鬼子的，他们多是爱国主义者。然而他们也像洋鬼子一样，看不起中国人，棍棒和拳头和轻蔑的眼光，专注在中国人的身上。
In Shanghai, if you talk to patrols, doors, and Xizai, they probably hate foreign devils, and most of them are patriots. However, they are also like foreign devils, looking down on the Chinese, sticks, fists and contemptuous eyes, focusing on the Chinese.“揩油”的生活有福了。这手段将更加展开，这品格将变成高尚，这行为将认为正当，这将算是国民的本领，和对于帝国主义的复仇。打开天窗说亮话，其实，所谓“高等华人”也者，也何尝逃得出这模子。
Blessed is the life of "wiping oil". This means will be further developed, this character will become noble, this act will be considered justified, and this will be regarded as the skill of the people and the revenge of imperialism. Open the skylight to say bright words, in fact, the so-called "high Chinese" also can't escape this mold.但是，也如“吃白相饭”朋友那样，卖票人是还有他的道德的。倘被查票人查出他收钱而不给票来了，他就默然认罚，决不说没有收过钱，将罪案推到客人身上去。
However, just like his friends who "eat white rice", the ticket seller still has his morals. If the ticket checker finds out that he has collected money without giving a ticket, he will silently accept the punishment, never say that he has not received money, and push the crime onto the guest.八月十四日。

How do we educate children?旅隼

It is the so-called "textbook", which has changed much in the past thirty years. 为翻译辩护

为翻译辩护

为翻译辩护

Defend the translation洛文
Lowen今年是围剿翻译的年头。
This year is the year of encirclement and suppression translation.或曰“硬译”，或曰“乱译”，或曰“听说现在有许多翻译家……翻开第一行就译，对于原作的理解，更无从谈起”，所以令人看得“不知所云”。
Some say "hard translation", some say "random translation", or "I heard that there are many translators now...... Turning the first line and translating, there is no way to talk about the understanding of the original work", so people "don't know what to say".这种现象，在翻译界确是不少的，那病根就在“抢先”。中国人原是喜欢“抢先”的人民，上落电车，买火车票，寄挂号信，都愿意是一到便是第一个。翻译者当然也逃不出这例子的。而书店和读者，实在也没有容纳同一原本的两种译本的雅量和物力，只要已有一种译稿，别一译本就没有书店肯接收出版了，据说是已经有了，怕再没有人要买。
This phenomenon is indeed quite common in the translation industry, and the root of the problem lies in "preemption". Chinese people who liked to "be the first", getting on and off the tram, buying train tickets, and sending registered letters, were willing to be the first as soon as they arrived. The translator certainly cannot escape this example. As long as there is already a translation, no bookstore will be willing to accept and publish another translation.举一个例在这里：现在已经成了古典的达尔文的《物种由来》，日本有两种翻译本，先出的一种颇多错误，后出的一本是好的。中国只有一种马君武博士的翻译，而他所根据的却是日本的坏译本，实有另译的必要。然而那里还会有书店肯出版呢？除非译者同时是富翁，他来自己印。不过如果是富翁，他就去打算盘，再也不来弄什么翻译了。
For example, here is an example: Now it has become a classic Darwin's "The Origin of Species", there are two translations in Japan, the first one has many errors, and the latter one is good. There is only one translation by Dr. Ma Junwu in China, but he is based on a bad Japanese translation, so there is a need for another translation. But will there be bookstores willing to publish there? Unless the translator is also a rich man, he will print it himself. But if he is a rich man, he will go to plan and never come to get any translation again.还有一层，是中国的流行，实在也过去得太快，一种学问或文艺介绍进中国来，多则一年，少则半年，大抵就烟消火灭。靠翻译为生的翻译家，如果精心作意，推敲起来，则到他脱稿时，社会上早已无人过问。中国大嚷过托尔斯泰，屠格纳夫，后来又大嚷过辛克莱，但他们的选集却一部也没有。去年虽然还有以郭沫若先生的盛名，幸而出版的《战争与和平》，但恐怕仍不足以挽回读书和出版界的惰气，势必至于读者也厌倦，译者也厌倦，出版者也厌倦，归根结蒂是不会完结的。
There is another layer, which is the popularity of China, which has passed too quickly, and a kind of knowledge or literature and art has been introduced into China, at most for a year, or at least half a year, and it will probably disappear. A translator who makes a living by translating will no longer be cared about by the time he leaves the manuscript. China shouted Tolstoy, Turgnave, and later Sinclair, but none of their anthologies were available. Although "War and Peace" was published last year with Mr. Guo Moruo's fame, I am afraid it is still not enough to restore the inertia of the reading and publishing circles, and it is bound to be tired of readers, translators, and publishers, and in the final analysis, it will not end.翻译的不行，大半的责任固然该在翻译家，但读书界和出版界，尤其是批评家，也应该分负若干的责任。要救治这颓运，必须有正确的批评，指出坏的，奖励好的，倘没有，则较好的也可以。然而这怎么能呢；指摘坏翻译，对于无拳无勇的译者是不要紧的，倘若触犯了别有来历的人，他就会给你带上一顶红帽子，简直要你的性命。这现象，就使批评家也不得不含胡了。
If the translation is not good, most of the responsibility should lie with the translator, but the reading and publishing circles, especially the critics, should also share some responsibilities. To remedy this bad luck, there must be correct criticism, pointing out the bad, rewarding the good, and if not, the better can also be done. However, how can this be; It doesn't matter if you criticize a bad translator who has no fists or courage, if you offend someone with a different background, he will bring you a red hat, which is simply deadly. This phenomenon makes critics have to bear it.此外，现在最普通的对于翻译的不满，是说看了几十行也还是不能懂。但这是应该加以区别的。倘是康德的《纯粹理性批判》那样的书，则即使德国人来看原文，他如果并非一个专家，也还是一时不能看懂。自然，“翻开第一行就译”的译者，是太不负责任了，然而漫无区别，要无论什么译本都翻开第一行就懂的读者，却也未免太不负责任了。
In addition, the most common dissatisfaction with translation now is that after reading dozens of lines, they still can't understand it. But this should be differentiated. If it is a book like Kant's "Critique of Pure Reason", even if a German reads the original text, if he is not an expert, he will still not be able to understand it for a while. Naturally, it is too irresponsible for a translator who "turns the first line and translates", but it makes no difference, and it is too irresponsible for readers who understand it as soon as they open the first line of any translation.八月十四日。

爬和撞

爬和撞

爬和撞

Crawl and crash荀继
Xun Ji从前梁实秋教授曾经说过：穷人总是要爬，往上爬，爬到富翁的地位。不但穷人，奴隶也是要爬的，有了爬得上的机会，连奴隶也会觉得自己是神仙，天下自然太平了。
Professor Liang Shiqiu once said: The poor always have to climb, climb up, and climb to the status of the rich. Not only the poor, but also slaves have to climb, and with the opportunity to climb, even slaves will feel that they are immortals, and the world will naturally be peaceful.虽然爬得上的很少，然而个个以为这正是他自己。这样自然都安分的去耕田，种地，拣大粪或是坐冷板凳，克勤克俭，背着苦恼的命运，和自然奋斗着，拚命的爬，爬，爬。可是爬的人那么多，而路只有一条，十分拥挤。老实的照着章程规规矩矩的爬，大都是爬不上去的。聪明人就会推，把别人推开，推倒，踏在脚底下，踹着他们的肩膀和头顶，爬上去了。大多数人却还只是爬，认定自己的冤家并不在上面，而只在旁边——是那些一同在爬的人。他们大都忍耐着一切，两脚两手都着地，一步步的挨上去又挤下来，挤下来又挨上去，没有休止的。
Although he could rarely climb up, everyone thought it was himself. In this way, they naturally go to cultivate the fields, farm, pick dung or sit on the cold bench, be diligent and thrifty, carry the fate of distress, struggle with nature, and climb, climb, climb desperately. But there are so many people climbing, and there is only one road, which is very crowded. Honestly climbing according to the rules of the constitution, most of them can't climb up. Smart people will push, push others away, push them down, step under their feet, kick their shoulders and heads, and climb up. Most people are still just crawling, thinking that their enemies are not on top, but only next to them - those who are climbing together. Most of them endured everything, their feet and hands on the ground, step by step up and down, squeezed down and up, endlessly.然而爬的人太多，爬得上的太少，失望也会渐渐的侵蚀善良的人心，至少，也会发生跪着的革命。于是爬之外，又发明了撞。
However, if there are too many people climbing and too few can climb, disappointment will gradually erode the hearts of good people, at least, there will be a kneeling revolution. So in addition to crawling, he invented collision.这是明知道你太辛苦了，想从地上站起来，所以在你的背后猛然的叫一声：撞罢。一个个发麻的腿还在抖着，就撞过去。这比爬要轻松得多，手也不必用力，膝盖也不必移动，只要横着身子，晃一晃，就撞过去。撞得好就是五十万元大洋，妻，财，子，禄都有了。撞不好，至多不过跌一交，倒在地下。那又算得什么呢，——他原本是伏在地上的，他仍旧可以爬。何况有些人不过撞着玩罢了，根本就不怕跌交的。
This is because he knows that you are working too hard and wants to get up from the ground, so he suddenly screams behind your back: Crash. One by one, the numb legs were still shaking, so they crashed over. This is much easier than climbing, you don't have to use your hands, you don't have to move your knees, just lie sideways, shake it, and hit it. If you hit it well, it is 500,000 yuan of ocean, and you have a wife, wealth, children, and salary. If you don't hit it well, you will fall to the ground at most. So what,—— he was originally lying on the ground, but he could still climb. What's more, some people just bump into each other and are not afraid of falling at all.爬是自古有之。例如从童生到状元，从小瘪三到康白度。撞却似乎是近代的发明。要考据起来，恐怕只有古时候“小姐抛彩球”有点像给人撞的办法。小姐的彩球将要抛下来的时候，——一个个想吃天鹅肉的男子汉仰着头，张着嘴，馋涎拖得几尺长……可惜，古人究竟呆笨，没有要这些男子汉拿出几个本钱来，否则，也一定可以收着几万万的。
Crawlers have existed since ancient times. For example, from Tongsheng to Zhuangyuan, from Xiao Deflated to Kangbaidu. Collision seems to be a modern invention. If you want to examine it, I am afraid that only in ancient times, "Miss Throwing Colored Balls" was a bit like a way to hit people. When the young lady's colored ball was about to be thrown down,—— men who wanted to eat swan meat raised their heads, opened their mouths, and dragged their saliva several feet long...... It's a pity that the ancients were stupid and didn't ask these men to come up with a few capitals, otherwise, they would definitely be able to collect tens of millions.爬得上的机会越少，愿意撞的人就越多，那些早已爬在上面的人们，就天天替你们制造撞的机会，叫你们化些小本钱，而预约着你们名利双收的神仙生活。所以撞得好的机会，虽然比爬得上的还要少得多，而大家都愿意来试试的。这样，爬了来撞，撞不着再爬……鞠躬尽瘁，死而后已。
Those who have already climbed on top will create opportunities for you to collide every day, asking you to make some small capital, and make an appointment for your immortal life of fame and fortune. So the chance of hitting a good collision is much less than climbing, and everyone is willing to try. In this way, if you crawl and bump into it, you can't climb again...... Bow and do your best, and only stop after death.八月十六日。

各种捐班

各种捐班

各种捐班

Various donation classes洛文
Lowen清朝的中叶，要做官可以捐，叫做“捐班”的便是这一伙。财主少爷吃得油头光脸，忽而忙了几天，头上就有一粒水晶顶，有时还加上一枝蓝翎，满口官话，说是“今天天气好”了。
In the middle of the Qing Dynasty, if you want to be an official, you can donate, and it is this group called "donation class". The rich young master ate oily and bare-faced, and suddenly after a few days, he had a crystal top on his head, and sometimes added a blue feather, full of official words, saying that "the weather is good today".到得民国，官总算说是没有了捐班，然而捐班之途，实际上倒是开展了起来，连“学士文人”也可以由此弄得到顶戴。开宗明义第一章，自然是要有钱。只要有钱，就什么都容易办了。譬如，要捐学者罢，那就收买一批古董，结识几个清客，并且雇几个工人，拓出古董上面的花纹和文字，用玻璃板印成一部书，名之曰“什么集古录”或“什么考古录”。李富孙做过一部《金石学录》，是专载研究金石的人们的，然而这倒成了“作俑”，使清客们可以一续再续，并且推而广之，连收藏古董，贩卖古董的少爷和商人，也都一榻括子的收进去了，这就叫作“金石家”。
In the Republic of China, the official finally said that there was no donation class, but the road to donating classes was actually carried out, and even "scholars and literati" could get support from this. The first chapter of the opening is naturally to be rich. As long as you have money, everything is easy. For example, if you want to donate to scholars, buy a batch of antiques, get to know a few Qing guests, and hire a few workers to engrave the patterns and words on the antiques, and print them into a book with glass plates, called "What Collection of Ancient Records" or "What Archaeological Records". Li Fusun made a "Record of Epigraphy", which was dedicated to people who studied epigraphy, but this became a "figurine", so that the Qing guests could continue again and again, and by extension, even the young masters and merchants who collected antiques and sold antiques were also collected in one couch, which was called the "Jinshi Family".捐做“文学家”也用不着什么新花样。只要开一只书店，拉几个作家，雇一些帮闲，出一种小报，“今天天气好”是也须会说的，就写了出来，印了上去，交给报贩，不消一年半载，包管成功。但是，古董的花纹和文字的拓片是不能用的了，应该代以电影明星和摩登女子的照片，因为这才是新时代的美术。“爱美”的人物在中国还多得很，而“文学家”或“艺术家”也就这样的起来了。
Donating to be a "writer" doesn't need any new tricks. As long as you open a bookstore, pull a few writers, hire some helpers, and publish a kind of tabloid, "the weather is good today" must be able to say, write it out, print it, and hand it over to the newspaper seller, and it will take less than a year and a half to ensure success. However, rubbings of antique patterns and texts are no longer usable, and should be replaced by photos of movie stars and modern women, because this is the art of the new era. There are still many people who "love beauty" in China, and "writers" or "artists" have become like this.捐官可以希望刮地皮，但捐学者文人也不会折本。印刷品固然可以卖现钱，古董将来也会有洋鬼子肯出大价的。
Donating officials can hope to scrape the land, but donating scholars and literati will not lose money. Although printed materials can be sold for cash, antiques will also have foreign devils willing to pay a lot of money in the future.这又叫作“名利双收”。不过先要能“投资”，所以平常人做不到，要不然，文人学士也就不大值钱了。
This is also called "fame and fortune". However, you must be able to "invest" first, so ordinary people can't do it, otherwise, the literati bachelor will not be worth much.而现在还值钱，所以也还会有人忙着做人名辞典，造文艺史，出作家论，编自传。我想，倘作历史的著作，是应该像将文人分为罗曼派，古典派一样，另外分出一种“捐班”派来的，历史要“真”，招些忌恨也只好硬挺，是不是？
And now it is still valuable, so there will be people who are busy making dictionaries of personal names, making literary and artistic histories, publishing essays, and compiling autobiographies. I think that if you write a historical work, you should divide the literati into Romantics and classics, and divide them into a kind of "donation class".八月二十四日。

四库全书珍本

四库全书珍本

四库全书珍本

Rare books of the four libraries丰之余
Abundant surplus现在除兵争，政争等类之外，还有一种倘非闲人，就不大注意的影印《四库全书》中的“珍本”之争。官商要照原式，及早印成，学界却以为库本有删改，有错误，如果有别本可得，就应该用别的“善本”来替代。
Nowadays, in addition to military disputes, political disputes, etc., there is also a dispute over the "rare books" in the "Four Libraries" that if you are not an idler, you will not pay much attention to it. Officials and businessmen should print it as soon as possible according to the original form, but the academic circles think that the library version has been deleted and corrected, and there are errors, and if there are other copies available, they should be replaced with other "rare books".但是，学界的主张，是不会通过的，结果总非依照《钦定四库全书》不可。这理由很分明，就因为要赶快。四省不见，九岛出脱，不说也罢，单是黄河的出轨举动，也就令人觉得岌岌乎不可终日，要做生意就得赶快。况且“钦定”二字，至今也还有一点威光，“御医”“贡缎”，就是与众不同的意思。便是早已共和了的法国，拿破仑的藏书在拍卖场上还是比平民的藏书值钱；欧洲的有些著名的“支那学者”，讲中国就会引用《钦定图书集成》，这是中国的考据家所不肯玩的玩艺。但是，也可见印了“钦定”过的“珍本”，在外国，生意总可以比“善本”好一些。
However, the proposition of the academic circles will not be adopted, and the result must be in accordance with the "Four Libraries of the Imperial Dynasty". The reason for this is very clear, because it is necessary to hurry. The four provinces are gone, and the nine islands are out, not to mention, the derailment of the Yellow River alone makes people feel that it is precarious, and they have to hurry up to do business. Moreover, the word "imperial decree" still has a bit of prestige, "imperial doctor" and "tribute satin", which means different. In France, which has long been a republic, Napoleon's collection of books is still more valuable than that of commoners at auction; Some famous "Chinese scholars" in Europe will quote the "Collection of Imperial Books" when talking about China, which is a trick that Chinese scholars refuse to play. However, it can also be seen that the "rare books" that have been printed "imperial decrees" can always be better than the "rare books" in foreign countries.即使在中国，恐怕生意也还是“珍本”好。因为这可以做摆饰，而“善本”却不过能合于实用。能买这样的书的，决非穷措大也可想，则买去之后，必将供在客厅上也亦可知。这类的买主，会买一个商周的古鼎，摆起来；不得已时，也许买一个假古鼎，摆起来；但他决不肯买一个沙锅或铁镬，摆在紫檀桌子上。因为他的目的是在“珍”而并不在“善”，更不在是否能合于实用的。
Even in China, I'm afraid business is still "rare". Because this can be used as decoration, but the "rare book" can only be practical. If you can buy such a book, it is by no means a big deal, and it is also known that after buying it, it will be provided in the living room. This kind of buyer will buy an ancient tripod of the Shang Zhou Dynasty and put it up; As a last resort, maybe buy a fake ancient tripod and put it up; But he would never buy a clay pot or an iron pot and put it on the rosewood table. Because his purpose is to "treasure" and not "good", let alone whether it can be practical.明末人好名，刻古书也是一种风气，然而往往自己看不懂，以为错字，随手乱改。不改尚可，一改，可就反而改错了，所以使后来的考据家为之摇头叹气，说是“明人好刻古书而古书亡”。这回的《四库全书》中的“珍本”是影印的，决无改错的弊病，然而那原本就有无意的错字，有故意的删改，并且因为新本的流布，更能使善本湮没下去，将来的认真的读者如果偶尔得到这样的本子，恐怕总免不了要有摇头叹气第二回。
At the end of the Ming Dynasty, people had good names, and it was also a trend to engrave ancient books, but they often couldn't understand it, thinking that it was a typo, and changed it randomly. It is okay not to change, but once it is changed, it will be wrong, so the later examiners shook their heads and sighed, saying that "the Ming people are good at carving ancient books and the ancient books are dead". This time, the "rare books" in the "Four Libraries Complete Book" are photocopied, and there is no problem of correcting mistakes, but there are unintentional typos, deliberate deletions, and because of the circulation of new books, it can make rare books obscured, and if serious readers in the future occasionally get such a book, I am afraid that they will inevitably have to shake their heads and sigh for the second time.然而结果总非依照《钦定四库全书》不可。因为“将来”的事，和现在的官商是不相干了。
However, the result must be in accordance with the "Four Libraries of the Imperial Dynasty". Because the "future" has nothing to do with the current officials and businessmen.八月二十四日。

Traveling Falcon门外的有限的一方泥地上，有两队蚂蚁在打仗。
On the limited mud outside the door, there were two teams of ants fighting.童话作家爱罗先珂的名字，现在是已经从读者的记忆上渐渐淡下去了，此时我却记起了他的一种奇异的忧愁。他在北京时，曾经认真的告诉我说：我害怕，不知道将来会不会有人发明一种方法，只要怎么一来，就能使人们都成为打仗的机器的。
The name of the fairy tale writer Ai Luo Xianke has now faded from the reader's memory, but at this time I remember his strange melancholy. When he was in Beijing, he once told me seriously: I am afraid that someone will invent a method in the future, as long as it is done, it can make people become war machines.其实是这方法早经发明了，不过较为烦难，不能“怎么一来”就完事。我们只要看外国为儿童而作的书籍，玩具，常常以指教武器为大宗，就知道这正是制造打仗机器的设备，制造是必须从天真烂漫的孩子们入手的。
In fact, this method has been invented a long time ago, but it is more troublesome and cannot be done "how". As long as we look at foreign books and toys made for children, often teaching weapons, we know that this is the equipment used to make war machines, and the manufacturing must start with innocent children.不但人们，连昆虫也知道。蚂蚁中有一种武士蚁，自己不造窠，不求食，一生的事业，是专在攻击别种蚂蚁，掠取幼虫，使成奴隶，给它服役的。但奇怪的是它决不掠取成虫，因为已经难施教化。它所掠取的一定只限于幼虫和蛹，使在盗窟里长大，毫不记得先前，永远是愚忠的奴隶，不但服役，每当武士蚁出去劫掠的时候，它还跟在一起，帮着搬运那些被侵略的同族的幼虫和蛹去了。
Not only people, but even insects know it. Among the ants, there is a kind of warrior ant, which does not build nests, does not seek food, and its life's career is dedicated to attacking other species of ants, plundering the larvae, making them slaves, and serving them. But the strange thing is that it never preys on adults, because it is already difficult to educate. What it plundered must be limited to larvae and pupae, so that it grew up in the robbers' den, forgetting that before, it was always a foolish and loyal slave, not only serving, but whenever the warrior ants went out to plunder, it also followed and helped carry the larvae and pupae of the invaded clan.但在人类，却不能这么简单的造成一律。这就是人之所以为“万物之灵”。
But in humans, it cannot be so simple to create uniformity. This is the reason why people are the "spirit of all things".然而制造者也决不放手。孩子长大，不但失掉天真，还变得呆头呆脑，是我们时时看见的。经济的雕敝，使出版界不肯印行大部的学术文艺书籍，不是教科书，便是儿童书，黄河决口似的向孩子们滚过去。但那里面讲的是什么呢？要将我们的孩子们造成什么东西呢？却还没有看见战斗的批评家论及，似乎已经不大有人注意将来了。

However, man is the "spirit of all things", so that what can be done is enough. Naturally, the battle must be fought, and it is necessary to destroy the anthills that make war machines, the medicine baits that poison children, and the conspiracy that will trap the future: this is the task of human warriors.八月二十八日。

由聋而哑洛文
Lowen医生告诉我们：有许多哑子，是并非喉舌不能说话的，只因为从小就耳朵聋，听不见大人的言语，无可师法，就以为谁也不过张着口呜呜哑哑，他自然也只好呜呜哑哑了。所以勃兰兑斯叹丹麦文学的衰微时，曾经说：文学的创作，几乎完全死灭了。人间的或社会的无论怎样的问题，都不能提起感兴，或则除在新闻和杂志之外，绝不能惹起一点论争。我们看不见强烈的独创的创作。加以对于获得外国的精神生活的事，现在几乎绝对的不加顾及。于是精神上的“聋”，那结果，就也招致了“哑”来。（《十九世纪文学的主潮》第一卷自序）
The doctor told us: There are many mute people, not mouthpieces who can't speak, just because they have been deaf since childhood, can't hear the words of adults, and have no way to learn from them, so they think that no one is just whining and whining with their mouths open, and he naturally has to whining and dumb. Therefore, when Brandus lamented the decline of Danish literature, he once said: The creation of literature is almost completely dead. No matter what kind of human or social problems are raised, or they must not be provoked at all except in the news and magazines. We do not see strong original creations. In addition, there is almost no consideration for obtaining a foreign spiritual life. So the mental "deafness" also caused "dumbness". (Preface to the first volume of "The Main Tide of Nineteenth-Century Literature")这几句话，也可以移来批评中国的文艺界，这现象，并不能全归罪于压迫者的压迫，五四运动时代的启蒙运动者和以后的反对者，都应该分负责任的。前者急于事功，竟没有译出什么有价值的书籍来，后者则故意迁怒，至骂翻译者为媒婆，有些青年更推波助澜，有一时期，还至于连人地名下注一原文，以便读者参考时，也就诋之曰“衒学”。
These few sentences can also be moved to criticize China's literary and artistic circles, this phenomenon cannot be entirely attributed to the oppression of the oppressors, and the enlightenment activists in the era of the May Fourth Movement and the opponents in the future should be responsible. The former was eager to do his job and did not translate any valuable books, while the latter deliberately vented his anger, even scolding the translator as a matchmaker, and some young people even contributed to the situation.今竟何如？三开间店面的书铺，四马路上还不算少，但那里面满架是薄薄的小本子，倘要寻一部巨册，真如披沙拣金之难。自然，生得又高又胖并不就是伟人，做得多而且繁也决不就是名著，而况还有“剪贴”。但是，小小的一本“什么ABC”里，却也决不能包罗一切学术文艺的。一道浊流，固然不如一杯清水的干净而澄明，但蒸溜了浊流的一部分，却就有许多杯净水在。
What is the situation now? There are not a few bookstores in the three-bay storefront, but there are not many books on the four roads, but the shelves are full of thin small books, if you want to find a huge book, it is really difficult to pick gold through the sand. Naturally, being tall and fat is not a great man, and doing a lot and being complicated is by no means a masterpiece, let alone "cutting and pasting". However, a small book of "ABCs" must not include all academic literature and art. A turbid stream is certainly not as clean and clear as a glass of water, but there are many cups of clean water that distills a part of the turbid stream.因为多年买空卖空的结果，文界就荒凉了，文章的形式虽然比较的整齐起来，但战斗的精神却较前有退无进。文人虽因捐班或互捧，很快的成名，但为了出力的吹，壳子大了，里面反显得更加空洞。于是误认这空虚为寂寞，像煞有介事的说给读者们；其甚者还至于摆出他心的腐烂来，算是一种内面的宝贝。散文，在文苑中算是成功的，但试看今年的选本，便是前三名，也即令人有“貂不足，狗尾续”之感。用秕谷来养青年，是决不会壮大的，将来的成就，且要更渺小，那模样，可看尼采所描写的“末人”。
Because of the results of years of short buying and selling, the literary world has become desolate, and although the form of the article has become relatively neat, the fighting spirit has retreated from the past. Although the literati quickly became famous because of donating classes or supporting each other, in order to blow their efforts, the shell became bigger, and the inside looked even more empty. So he mistook this emptiness for loneliness, and told the readers as if he was serious; What's more, it even shows the rot of his heart, which can be regarded as an inner treasure. Prose is considered a success in the literary garden, but if you look at this year's selection, it is the top three, that is, it makes people feel that "mink is not enough, dog tail continues". Using chaff to feed young people will never grow, and the future achievements will be even smaller.但绍介国外思潮，翻译世界名作，凡是运输精神的粮食的航路，现在几乎都被聋哑的制造者们堵塞了，连洋人走狗，富户赘郎，也会来哼哼的冷笑一下。他们要掩住青年的耳朵，使之由聋而哑，枯涸渺小，成为“末人”，非弄到大家只能看富家儿和小瘪三所卖的春宫，不肯罢手。甘为泥土的作者和译者的奋斗，是已经到了万不可缓的时候了，这就是竭力运输些切实的精神的粮食，放在青年们的周围，一面将那些聋哑的制造者送回黑洞和朱门里面去。
But Shao Jiao's foreign trends of thought, translating world masterpieces, and all the routes for transporting spiritual food are now almost blocked by deaf and mute makers, and even foreign lackeys, rich households, will come to hum and sneer. They want to cover the ears of young people, so that they can go from deaf to mute, withered and small, and become "last people". The struggle of the author and translator of the soil has reached an absolute point where it cannot be delayed, which is to try to transport some tangible spiritual food around the young people, while sending those deaf and mute makers back into the black hole and the red gate.八月二十九日。

Yu Ming说禽兽交合是恋爱未免有点亵渎。但是，禽兽也有性生活，那是不能否认的。它们在春情发动期，雌的和雄的碰在一起，难免“卿卿我我”的来一阵。固然，雌的有时候也会装腔做势，逃几步又回头看，还要叫几声，直到实行“同居之爱”为止。禽兽的种类虽然多，它们的“恋爱”方式虽然复杂，可是有一件事是没有疑问的：就是雄的不见得有什么特权。

Of course, females sometimes pretend to be posture, running away a few steps and looking back, and screaming a few times until they practice "cohabitation love". Agree and explain虞明
Yu Ming上司的行动不必征求下属的同意，这是天经地义。但是，有时候上司会对下属解释。
It is natural that the boss does not have to ask for the consent of his subordinates. However, sometimes the boss will explain to the subordinates.新进的世界闻人说：“原人时代就有威权，例如人对动物，一定强迫它们服从人的意志，而使它们抛弃自由生活，不必征求动物的同意。”这话说得透彻。不然，我们那里有牛肉吃，有马骑呢？人对人也是这样。
The new world heard people say: "In the era of primitive humans, there was authority, for example, people must force them to obey human will, and they must abandon their free life without asking the consent of animals." This is said thoroughly. Otherwise, we have beef to eat and horses to ride? It's the same for people to people.日本耶教会主教最近宣言日本是圣经上说的天使：“上帝要用日本征服向来屠杀犹太人的白人……以武力解放犹太人，实现《旧约》上的豫言。”这也显然不征求白人的同意的，正和屠杀犹太人的白人并未征求过犹太人的同意一样。日本的大人老爷在中国制造“国难”，也没有征求中国人民的同意。——至于有些地方的绅董，却去征求日本大人的同意，请他们来维持地方治安，那却又当别论。总之，要自由自在的吃牛肉，骑马等等，就必须宣布自己是上司，别人是下属；或是把人比做动物，或是把自己作为天使。
The bishop of the Church of Japan recently declared that Japan is an angel of the Bible: "God will use Japan to conquer the white people who have always slaughtered the Jews...... Liberate the Jews by force and fulfill the prophecies of the Old Testament. This is also obviously not asking for the consent of the white people, just as the white people who slaughtered the Jews did not ask for the consent of the Jews. Japan's lord created a "national crisis" in China and did not seek the consent of the Chinese people. ——As for the gentry and directors in some places, they went to ask the consent of Japanese adults and asked them to maintain local security, but that is a different matter. In short, if you want to eat beef, ride horses, etc. freely, you must declare yourself a boss and others are subordinates; Or compare people to animals, or to think of themselves as angels.但是，这里最要紧的还是“武力”，并非理论。不论是社会学或是基督教的理论，都不能够产生什么威权。原人对于动物的威权，是产生于弓箭等类的发明的。至于理论，那不过是随后想出来的解释。这种解释的作用，在于制造自己威权的宗教上，哲学上，科学上，世界潮流上的根据，使得奴隶和牛马恍然大悟这世界的公律，而抛弃一切翻案的梦想。
However, the most important thing here is "force", not theory. Neither sociology nor Christian theory can produce any authority. The authoritarianism of primitive people over animals arose from the invention of bows and arrows. As for the theory, it is just an explanation that comes up later. The role of this explanation is to create its own authoritarian religious, philosophical, scientific, and world trend basis, so that slaves and cattle and horses suddenly realize the public laws of the world and abandon all dreams of overturning the case.当上司对于下属解释的时候，你做下属的切不可误解这是在征求你的同意，因为即使你绝对的不同意，他还是干他的。他自有他的梦想，只要金银财宝和飞机大炮的力量还在他手里，他的梦想就会实现；而你的梦想却终于只是梦想，——万一实现了，他还说你抄袭他的动物主义的老文章呢。
When your boss explains to your subordinates, you must not misunderstand that this is asking for your consent, because even if you absolutely disagree, he will still do it. He has his own dream, as long as the power of gold and silver treasures and aircraft and cannons is still in his hands, his dream will come true; And your dream is finally just a dream,—— if it comes true, he still says that you plagiarized his old animalistic article.据说现在的世界潮流，正是庞大权力的政府的出现，这是十九世纪人士所梦想不到的。意大利和德意志不用说了；就是英国的国民政府，“它的实权也完全属于保守党一党”。“美国新总统所取得的措置经济复兴的权力，比战争和戒严时期还要大得多”。大家做动物，使上司不必征求什么同意，这正是世界的潮流。懿欤盛哉，这样的好榜样，那能不学？
It is said that the current world trend is the emergence of a government with huge power, which people in the 19th century could not have dreamed of. Needless to say, Italy and Germany; It is the British national government, "its real power also belongs entirely to the Conservative Party." "The new president of the United States has gained much more power to revive the economy than during the war and martial law." Everyone is an animal, so that the boss does not have to ask for any consent, which is the trend of the world. How can such a good example not be learned?不过，我这种解释还有点美中不足：中国自己的秦始皇帝焚书坑儒，中国自己的韩退之等说：“民不出米粟麻丝以事其上则诛”。这原是国货，何苦违背着民族主义，引用外国的学说和事实——长他人威风，灭自己志气呢？
However, my explanation is a bit of a fly in the ointment: China's own Qin Shi Huang burned books and pitted Confucians, and China's own Han Tuizhi and others said: "If the people do not produce rice, corn, and hemp to serve them, they will be punished." This is originally a domestic product, why bother to go against nationalism and quote foreign doctrines and facts - to increase the prestige of others and destroy one's own ambition?九月三日。

Lessons from the movie孺牛
Young cow当我在家乡的村子里看中国旧戏的时候，是还未被教育成“读书人”的时候，小朋友大抵是农民。爱看的是翻筋斗，跳老虎，一把烟焰，现出一个妖精来；对于剧情，似乎都不大和我们有关系。大面和老生的争城夺地，小生和正旦的离合悲欢，全是他们的事，捏锄头柄人家的孩子，自己知道是决不会登坛拜将，或上京赴考的。但还记得有一出给了感动的戏，好像是叫作《斩木诚》。一个大官蒙了不白之冤，非被杀不可了，他家里有一个老家丁，面貌非常相像，便代他去“伏法”。那悲壮的动作和歌声，真打动了看客的心，使他们发见了自己的好模范。因为我的家乡的农人，农忙一过，有些是给大户去帮忙的。为要做得像，临刑时候，主母照例的必须去“抱头大哭”，然而被他踢开了，虽在此时，名分也得严守，这是忠仆，义士，好人。

The battle between Da Mian and Lao Sheng for city and land, the joys and sorrows of Xiaosheng and New Year's Day, are all their business, and the children who hold the hoe know that they will never go to the altar to worship the general, or go to Beijing to take the exam. A high-ranking official was wronged and had to be killed, and there was an old servant in his family who looked very similar, so he went to "surrender" on his behalf. The tragic movements and singing really touched the hearts of the spectators and made them discover their own good examples. Because the farmers in my hometown are busy farming, some of them go to help the big households. In order to do it like this, when the mistress was about to be executed, the mistress had to "hug her head and cry" as usual, but she was kicked away by him, although at this time, the title must also be strictly guarded, this is a loyal servant, a righteous man, and a good person.但到我在上海看电影的时候，却早是成为“下等华人”的了，看楼上坐着白人和阔人，楼下排着中等和下等的“华胄”，银幕上现出白色兵们打仗，白色老爷发财，白色小姐结婚，白色英雄探险，令看客佩服，羡慕，恐怖，自己觉得做不到。但当白色英雄探险非洲时，却常有黑色的忠仆来给他开路，服役，拚命，替死，使主子安然的回家；待到他豫备第二次探险时，忠仆不可再得，便又记起了死者，脸色一沉，银幕上就现出一个他记忆上的黑色的面貌。黄脸的看客也大抵在微光中把脸色一沉：他们被感动了。

But at this time, there was a "History of Yaoshan" that was trying its best to promote.这部片子，主题是“开化瑶民”，机键是“招驸马”，令人记起《四郎探母》以及《双阳公主追狄》这些戏本来。中国的精神文明主宰全世界的伟论，近来不大听到了，要想去开化，自然只好退到苗瑶之类的里面去，而要成这种大事业，却首先须“结亲”，黄帝子孙，也和黑人一样，不能和欧亚大国的公主结亲，所以精神文明就无法传播。这是大家可以由此明白的。
The theme of this film is "Enlightening the Yao People", and the key is "Recruiting the Son-in-law", which reminds people of the dramas "Shilang Visits Mother" and "Princess Shuangyang Chases Di". 洛文
Lowen因为我的一篇短文，引出了穆木天先生的《从〈为翻译辩护〉谈到楼译〈二十世纪之欧洲文学〉》（九日《自由谈》所载），这在我，是很以为荣幸的，并且觉得凡所指摘，也恐怕都是实在的错误。但从那作者的案语里，我却又想起一个随便讲讲，也许并不是毫无意义的问题来了。那是这样的一段——
Because of one of my short articles, I am very honored to have Mr. Mu Mutian's "From 'Defending Translation' to Lou's translation of 'European Literature in the Twentieth Century'" (published in "Free Talk" on the 9th), and I feel that everything I criticize is probably a real mistake. But from the author's words, I remembered a question that was casually talked about, perhaps not meaningless. It was like this—“在一百九十九页，有‘在这种小说之中，最近由学术院（译者：当系指著者所属的俄国共产主义学院）所选的鲁易倍尔德兰的不朽的诸作，为最优秀’。在我以为此地所谓‘Academie’者，当指法国翰林院。苏联虽称学艺发达之邦，但不会为帝国主义作家作选集罢？我不知为什么楼先生那样地滥下注解？”
"On page 199, there is 'among such novels, the immortal works of Louis Berderain, which have recently been selected by the Academy, are the best.' In my opinion, the so-called 'Academie' here should refer to the French Academy. Although the Soviet Union was known as a country with developed learning and art, it would not make an anthology of imperialist writers? I don't know why Mr. Lou commented so indiscriminately? ”究竟是那一国的Academia呢？我不知道。自然，看作法国的翰林院，是万分近理的，但我们也不能决定苏联的大学院就“不会为帝国主义作家作选集”。倘在十年以前，是决定不会的，这不但为物力所限，也为了要保护革命的婴儿，不能将滋养的，无益的，有害的食品都漫无区别的乱放在他前面。现在却可以了，婴儿已经长大，而且强壮，聪明起来，即使将鸦片或吗啡给他看，也没有什么大危险，但不消说，一面也必须有先觉者来指示，说吸了就会上瘾，而上瘾之后，就成一个废物，或者还是社会上的害虫。
Which country is Academia? I do not know. Naturally, it is very reasonable to regard it as the Hanlin Academy in France, but we cannot decide that the graduate schools of the Soviet Union "will not make anthologies of imperialist writers". If it was decided not to do it ten years ago, it would not be possible not only because of material constraints, but also because of the protection of revolutionary babies, nourishing, useless, and harmful foods could not be placed in front of him indiscriminately. Now it is possible, the baby has grown up, and is strong and intelligent, even if opium or morphine is shown to him, there is no great danger, but it goes without saying that there must be a pre-enlightened person to instruct that if you smoke it, you will become addicted, and after addiction, you will become a waste, or a pest in society.在事实上，我曾经见过苏联的Academia新译新印的阿剌伯的《一千一夜》，意大利的《十日谈》，还有西班牙的《吉诃德先生》，英国的《鲁滨孙漂流记》；在报章上，则记载过在为托尔斯泰印选集，为歌德编全集——更完全的全集。倍尔德兰不但是加特力教的宣传者，而且是王朝主义的代言人，但比起十九世纪初德意志布尔乔亚的文豪歌德来，那作品也不至于更加有害。所以我想，苏联来给他出一本选集，实在是很可能的。不过在这些书籍之前，想来一定有详序，加以仔细的分析和正确的批评。
In fact, I have seen Academia in the Soviet Union, Arab's "One Thousand and One Nights", Italy's "Decameron", Spain's "Mr. Quixote", and the British "Robinson Crusoe"; In the newspapers, it was recorded that he printed anthologies for Tolstoy and compiled complete works for Goethe - a more complete complete collection. Belderland was not only a propagandist of Gatlet, but also a spokesperson for dynastisticism, but his work was no more harmful than Goethe, the German writer of the early nineteenth century. So I think it is very likely that the Soviet Union will give him an anthology. However, before these books, there must be a detailed preface, careful analysis and correct criticism.凡作者，和读者因缘愈远的，那作品就于读者愈无害。古典的，反动的，观念形态已经很不相同的作品，大抵即不能打动新的青年的心（但自然也要有正确的指示），倒反可以从中学学描写的本领，作者的努力。恰如大块的砒霜，欣赏之余，所得的是知道它杀人的力量和结晶的模样：药物学和矿物学上的知识了。可怕的倒在用有限的砒霜，和在食物中间，使青年不知不觉的吞下去，例如似是而非的所谓“革命文学”，故作激烈的所谓“唯物史观的批评”，就是这一类。这倒是应该防备的。
The farther the author and the reader, the more harmless the work is to the reader. Classical, reactionary, and conceptual works that are already very different in conceptual form probably cannot touch the hearts of new young people (but naturally there must be correct instructions), but can learn from the ability to describe and the author's efforts from middle school. Just like a large piece of arsenic, what you gain is to know its murderous power and crystallization: knowledge of pharmacology and mineralogy. The terrible thing is to use limited arsenic and in the middle of food, so that young people can swallow it unconsciously, such as the plausible so-called "revolutionary literature" and the fierce so-called "criticism of historical materialism", which is this category. This should be guarded against.我是主张青年也可以看看“帝国主义者”的作品的，这就是古语的所谓“知己知彼”。青年为了要看虎狼，赤手空拳的跑到深山里去固然是呆子，但因为虎狼可怕，连用铁栅围起来了的动物园里也不敢去，却也不能不说是一位可笑的愚人。有害的文学的铁栅是什么呢？批评家就是。
I advocate that young people can also look at the works of "imperialists", which is the so-called "knowing oneself and knowing one's enemy" as the old saying goes. In order to see the tigers and wolves, the young man ran into the mountains with his bare hands, but because the tigers and wolves were terrifying, he didn't even dare to go to the zoo surrounded by iron fences, but he couldn't help but say that he was a ridiculous fool. What is the iron fence of harmful literature? Critics are.九月十一日。

关于翻译　（下）

关于翻译About translating （下） (bottom)
洛文
Lowen但我在那《为翻译辩护》中，所希望于批评家的，实在有三点：一，指出坏的；二，奖励好的；三，倘没有，则较好的也可以。而穆木天先生所实做的是第一句。以后呢，可能有别的批评家来做其次的文章，想起来真是一个大疑问。
But in "In Defense of Translation", I really hope for three points from critics: first, point out the bad; 2. Good rewards; Third, if not, it is better to do it. And what Mr. Mu Mutian did was the first sentence. In the future, there may be other critics to do the second article, which is really a big question when I think about it.所以我要再来补充几句：倘连较好的也没有，则指出坏的译本之后，并且指明其中的那些地方还可以于读者有益处。
So I will add a few more words: if there are no better ones, then point out the bad translations and point out those parts that may be useful to the reader.此后的译作界，恐怕是还要退步下去的。姑不论民穷财尽，即看地面和人口，四省是给日本拿去了，一大块在水淹，一大块在旱，一大块在打仗，只要略略一想，就知道读者是减少了许许多了。因为销路的少，出版界就要更投机，欺骗，而拿笔的人也因此只好更投机，欺骗。即有不愿意欺骗的人，为生计所压迫，也总不免比较的粗制滥造，增出些先前所没有的缺点来。走过租界的住宅区邻近的马路，三间门面的水果店，晶莹的玻璃窗里是鲜红的苹果，通黄的香蕉，还有不知名的热带的果物。但略站一下就知道：这地方，中国人是很少进去的，买不起。我们大抵只好到同胞摆的水果摊上去，化几文钱买一个烂苹果。
After that, the translation industry may have to regress. Regardless of the people's poverty and wealth, that is, looking at the land and population, the four provinces were taken to Japan, a large part was flooded, a large piece was in drought, and a large piece was fighting. Because of the small sales, the publishing industry will be more speculative and deceitful, and the people who hold the pen will have to be more speculative and deceitful. Even if there are people who are unwilling to deceive and are oppressed by their livelihoods, they will inevitably be more shoddy and add some shortcomings that did not exist before. Walking through the road adjacent to the residential area of the concession, there are three façade fruit shops, bright red apples, yellow bananas, and unknown tropical fruits in the crystal glass windows. But if you stand for a moment, you will know: Chinese rarely enter this place and cannot afford it. We probably have no choice but to go to the fruit stall set up by our compatriots and spend a few pennies to buy a rotten apple.苹果一烂，比别的水果更不好吃，但是也有人买的，不过我们另外还有一种相反的脾气：首饰要“足赤”，人物要“完人”。一有缺点，有时就全部都不要了。爱人身上生几个疮，固然不至于就请律师离婚，但对于作者，作品，译品，却总归比较的严紧，萧伯纳坐了大船，不好；巴比塞不算第一个作家，也不好；译者是“大学教授，下职官员”，更不好。好的又不出来，怎么办呢？我想，还是请批评家用吃烂苹果的方法，来救一救急罢。
When apples rot, they are worse than other fruits, but some people buy them, but we also have the opposite temper: jewelry should be "red feet", and characters should be "perfect". If there are shortcomings, sometimes you don't want them all. If your lover has a few sores on his body, he will not ask a lawyer for divorce, but for the author, works, and translations, he is always more strict, George Bernard Shaw took a big boat, which is not good; Barbise was not the first writer, nor was he good; The translator is "a university professor, a junior official", which is even worse. If it doesn't come out, what should I do? I think it is better to ask critics to use the method of eating rotten apples to save the emergency.我们先前的批评法，是说，这苹果有烂疤了，要不得，一下子抛掉。然而买者的金钱有限，岂不是大冤枉，而况此后还要穷下去。所以，此后似乎最好还是添几句，倘不是穿心烂，就说：这苹果有着烂疤了，然而这几处没有烂，还可以吃得。这么一办，译品的好坏是明白了，而读者的损失也可以小一点。
Our previous criticism was that this apple had a rotten scar, or throw it away all at once. However, the buyer's money is limited, isn't it a great injustice, and he will be poor in the future. Therefore, it seems that it is best to add a few sentences after that, if it is not rotten, just say: This apple has rotten scars, but these places are not rotten, and it can still be eaten. In this way, the quality of the translation is understood, and the reader's loss can be smaller.但这一类的批评，在中国还不大有，即以《自由谈》所登的批评为例，对于《二十世纪之欧洲文学》，就是专指烂疤的；记得先前有一篇批评邹韬奋先生所编的《高尔基》的短文，除掉指出几个缺点之外，也没有别的话。前者我没有看过，说不出另外可有什么可取的地方，但后者却曾经翻过一遍，觉得除批评者所指摘的缺点之外，另有许多记载作者的勇敢的奋斗，胥吏的卑劣的阴谋，是很有益于青年作家的，但也因为有了烂疤，就被抛在筐子外面了。
However, this kind of criticism is not very common in China, that is, taking the criticism published in "Free Talk" as an example, for "European Literature in the Twentieth Century", it refers specifically to rotten scars; I remember that there was a short article criticizing "Gorky" edited by Mr. Zou Taofen, and there was nothing else except to point out a few shortcomings. I haven't read the former, and I can't tell what else is commendable, but the latter has been flipped over and feels that in addition to the shortcomings pointed out by critics, there are many other records of the author's brave struggle and the despicable conspiracies of clerks, which are very beneficial to young writers, but they are also thrown out of the basket because of their rotten scars.所以，我又希望刻苦的批评家来做剜烂苹果的工作，这正如“拾荒”一样，是很辛苦的，但也必要，而且大家有益的。
Therefore, I hope that hard critics will do the work of chopping rotten apples, which is very hard, but also necessary, and beneficial to everyone, just like "scavenging".九月十一日。

新秋杂识　（三）

新秋杂识New Autumn Miscellaneous Knowledge （三） (3)
旅隼
Traveling Falcon“秋来了！”
"Autumn is coming!"秋真是来了，晴的白天还好，夜里穿着洋布衫就觉得凉飕飕。报章上满是关于“秋”的大小文章：迎秋，悲秋，哀秋，责秋……等等。为了趋时，也想这么的做一点，然而总是做不出。我想，就是想要“悲秋”之类，恐怕也要福气的，实在令人羡慕得很。
Autumn is really coming, it's okay during the sunny day, but wearing a cloth shirt at night makes you feel cool. The newspapers are full of large and small articles about "autumn": welcoming autumn, sad autumn, mourning autumn, blaming autumn...... Wait a minute. In order to keep up with the times, I also want to do this, but I always can't do it. I think that if you want something like "sad autumn", I am afraid you will also be blessed, which is really enviable.记得幼小时，有父母爱护着我的时候，最有趣的是生点小毛病，大病却生不得，既痛苦，又危险的。生了小病，懒懒的躺在床上，有些悲凉，又有些娇气，小苦而微甜，实在好像秋的诗境。呜呼哀哉，自从流落江湖以来，灵感卷逃，连小病也不生了。偶然看看文学家的名文，说是秋花为之惨容，大海为之沉默云云，只是愈加感到自己的麻木。我就从来没有见过秋花为了我在悲哀，忽然变了颜色；只要有风，大海是总在呼啸的，不管我爱闹还是爱静。
I remember when I was young, when my parents loved me, the most interesting thing was to have a small problem, but I couldn't have a serious illness, which was both painful and dangerous. I was a little sick, lying lazily on the bed, a little sad, a little squeamish, a little bitter and slightly sweet, really like the poetry of autumn. Alas, since I wandered into the rivers and lakes, my inspiration has fled, and I have not even had a minor illness. Occasionally reading the famous articles of writers, it is said that the autumn flowers are miserable, and the sea is silent for them, but they feel more and more numb. I have never seen autumn flowers suddenly change color because I am sad; As long as there is wind, the sea is always roaring, whether I like to make noise or be quiet.冰莹女士的佳作告诉我们：“晨是学科学的，但在这一刹那，完全忘掉了他的志趣，存在他脑海中的只有一个尽量地享受自然美景的目的。……”这也是一种福气。科学我学的很浅，只读过一本生物学教科书，但是，它那些教训，花是植物的生殖机关呀，虫鸣鸟啭，是在求偶呀之类，就完全忘不掉了。昨夜闲逛荒场，听到蟋蟀在野菊花下鸣叫，觉得好像是美景，诗兴勃发，就做了两句新诗——
Ms. Bingying's masterpiece tells us: "Chen studied science, but at this moment, he completely forgot his interests, and there was only one purpose in his mind to enjoy the natural beauty as much as possible." ...... "It's also a blessing." I have only read one biology textbook, but I can't forget its lessons, flowers are the reproductive organs of plants, insects and birds are courtship, etc. Last night, I was wandering around the wasteland, and when I heard crickets chirping under the wild chrysanthemums, I felt that it was a beautiful scenery, and the poem was booming, so I made two new poems -野菊的生殖器下面，Under the genitals of the wild chrysanthemum, 
蟋蟀在吊膀子。 crickets are hanging their arms.
写出来一看，虽然比粗人们所唱的俚歌要高雅一些，而对于新诗人的由“烟士披离纯”而来的诗，还是“相形见绌”。写得太科学，太真实，就不雅了，如果改作旧诗，也许不至于这样。生殖机关，用严又陵先生译法，可以谓之“性官”；“吊膀子”呢，我自己就不懂那语源，但据老于上海者说，这是因西洋人的男女挽臂同行而来的，引伸为诱惑或追求异性的意思。吊者，挂也，亦即相挟持。那么，我的诗就译出来了——
When I wrote it, although it was more elegant than the slang songs sung by rough people, it was still "dwarfed" to the poems of the new poets from "Smokers Covered by Chun". If it is written too scientifically and too real, it will be indecent, and if it is changed into an old poem, it may not be like this. The reproductive organs, translated by Mr. Yan Youling, can be called "sexual officials"; As for "hanging arms", I don't understand the etymology myself, but according to those who are older than Shanghai, it comes from the fact that Westerners walk arm in arm, which is extended to the meaning of temptation or pursuit of the opposite sex. The so-called "hanging" means to hang up, which means to hold each other hostage. Then, my poem was translated -野菊性官下，Wild chrysanthemums are lower than officials, 
鸣蛩在悬肘。 crickets are hanging on the elbows.
虽然很有些费解，但似乎也雅得多，也就是好得多。人们不懂，所以雅，也就是所以好，现在也还是一个做文豪的秘诀呀。质之“新诗人”邵洵美先生之流，不知以为何如？
Although it is a little puzzling, it seems to be much more elegant, that is, much better. People don't understand, so elegant, that is, so good, and it is still a secret to being a writer. I don't know what the "new poet" Mr. Shao Xunmei thinks?九月十四日。

courtesy苇索
苇索看报，是有益的，虽然有时也沉闷。例如罢，中国是世界上国耻纪念最多的国家，到这一天，报上照例得有几块记载，几篇文章。但这事真也闹得太重叠，太长久了，就很容易千篇一律，这一回可用，下一回也可用，去年用过了，明年也许还可用，只要没有新事情。即使有了，成文恐怕也仍然可以用，因为反正总只能说这几句话。所以倘不是健忘的人，就会觉得沉闷，看不出新的启示来。
Reading newspapers is beneficial, although sometimes dull. For example, China is the country with the most national humiliation in the world, and on this day, there must be a few records and articles in the newspaper as usual. But this matter is really too overlapping, too long, it is easy to be the same, this time it is available, the next time it is also available, last year it was used, and it may still be available next year, as long as there is nothing new. Even if there is, the written text may still be usable, because these few sentences can only be said anyway. Therefore, if you are not a forgetful person, you will feel dull and cannot see new revelations.然而我还是看。今天偶然看见北京追悼抗日英雄邓文的记事，首先是报告，其次是演讲，最末，是“礼成，奏乐散会”。
However, I still watch. Today, I happened to see Beijing's memorial to the anti-Japanese hero Deng Wen, first of all, the report, followed by the speech, and finally, "the ceremony is completed, the music is adjourned".我于是得了新的启示：凡纪念，“礼”而已矣。
I then received a new revelation: all commemoration is just a "ceremony".中国原是“礼义之邦”，关于礼的书，就有三大部，连在外国也译出了，我真特别佩服《仪礼》的翻译者。事君，现在可以不谈了；事亲，当然要尽孝，但殁后的办法，则已归入祭礼中，各有仪：就是现在的拜忌日，做阴寿之类。新的忌日添出来，旧的忌日就淡一点，“新鬼大，故鬼小”也。我们的纪念日也是对于旧的几个比较的不起劲，而新的几个之归于淡漠，则只好以俟将来，和人家的拜忌辰是一样的。有人说，中国的国家以家族为基础，真是有识见。
China was originally a "country of propriety and righteousness", and there were three major books on etiquette, which were even translated in foreign countries, and I really admired the translators of "Rituals". Shijun, you can not talk about it now; To serve relatives, of course, filial piety must be fulfilled, but the method after death has been classified into the sacrificial rites, each with its own rituals: it is the current death anniversary, doing yin longevity and the like. When a new death day is added, the old death day is a little lighter, "the new ghost is big, the old ghost is small". Our anniversaries are also less energetic than the old ones, while the new ones are indifferent, so we have to wait for the future, which is the same as other people's anniversaries. Some people say that China's country is based on the family, which is really insightful.中国又原是“礼让为国”的，既有礼，就必能让，而愈能让，礼也就愈繁了。总之，这一节不说也罢。
China was originally "courteous for the country", and if there is courtesy, it must be able to yield, and the more it can be conceded, the more complicated the etiquette. In short, this section is not to be mentioned.古时候，或以黄老治天下，或以孝治天下。现在呢，恐怕是入于以礼治天下的时期了，明乎此，就知道责备民众的对于纪念日的淡漠是错的，《礼》曰：“礼不下庶人”；舍不得物质上的什么东西也是错的，孔子不云乎：“赐也尔爱其羊，我爱其礼！”
In ancient times, some ruled the world with Huang Lao, while others ruled the world with filial piety. Now, I am afraid that we have entered the period of ruling the world with etiquette, and if you understand this, you will know that it is wrong to blame the people for their indifference to anniversaries, and the "Li" says: "Etiquette is not inferior to the common people"; It is also wrong to be reluctant to give up material things, Confucius did not say: "Give you to love its sheep, I love its gifts!" ”“非礼勿视，非礼勿听，非礼勿言，非礼勿动”，静静的等着别人的“多行不义，必自毙”，礼也。
"Don't look at injustice, don't listen to injustice, don't say injustice, don't move injustice", quietly waiting for others' "do more injustice, you will kill yourself", etiquette.九月二十日。

打听印象

打听印象

打听印象

Inquire about impressions桃椎
Peach vertebrae五四运动以后，好像中国人就发生了一种新脾气，是：倘有外国的名人或阔人新到，就喜欢打听他对于中国的印象。
After the May Fourth Movement, it seems that a new temper has occurred among Chinese, that is: if there is a foreign celebrity or a new arrival, he likes to inquire about his impression of China.罗素到中国讲学，急进的青年们开会欢宴，打听印象。罗素道：“你们待我这么好，就是要说坏话，也不好说了。”急进的青年愤愤然，以为他滑头。
Russell went to China to give lectures, and the radical young people held a meeting and banquet to inquire about their impressions. Russell said: "You treat me so well, even if you want to say bad things, it's not easy to say." The radical young man was indignant, thinking that he was slippery.萧伯纳周游过中国，上海的记者群集访问，又打听印象。萧道：“我有什么意见，与你们都不相干。假如我是个武人，杀死个十万条人命，你们才会尊重我的意见。”革命家和非革命家都愤愤然，以为他刻薄。
George Bernard Shaw traveled around China, and reporters from Shanghai visited in groups to inquire about their impressions. Xiao said: "What opinion do I have, it has nothing to do with you." If I were a warrior and killed a hundred thousand people, you would respect my opinion. 双十怀古　
——民国二二年看十九年秋

双十怀古Double Ten Nostalgia 
——民国二二年看十九年秋 - Republic of China 22 Autumn 19
史癖
Historical fetish小引
Small quote
要做“双十”的循例的文章，首先必须找材料。找法有二，或从脑子里，或从书本中。我用的是后一法。但是，翻完《描写字典》，里面无之；觅遍《文章作法》，其中也没有。幸而“吉人自有天相”，竟在破纸堆里寻出一卷东西来，是中华民国十九年十月三日到十日的上海各种大报小报的拔萃。去今已经整整的三个年头了，剪贴着做什么用的呢，自己已经记不清；莫非就给我今天做材料的么，一定未必是。但是，“废物利用”——既经检出，就抄些目录在这里罢。不过为节省篇幅计，不再注明广告，记事，电报之分，也略去了报纸的名目，因为那些文字，大抵是各报都有的。

重三感旧　
——一九三三年忆光绪朝末

重三感旧Three feelings of the old 
——一九三三年忆光绪朝末 - 1933 reminiscing about the end of the Guangxu Dynasty
丰之余
Abundant surplus我想赞美几句一些过去的人，这恐怕并不是“骸骨的迷恋”。
I would like to praise some people in the past, this is probably not a "skeleton obsession".所谓过去的人，是指光绪末年的所谓“新党”，民国初年，就叫他们“老新党”。甲午战败，他们自以为觉悟了，于是要“维新”，便是三四十岁的中年人，也看《学算笔谈》，看《化学鉴原》；还要学英文，学日文，硬着舌头，怪声怪气的朗诵着，对人毫无愧色，那目的是要看“洋书”，看洋书的缘故是要给中国图“富强”，现在的旧书摊上，还偶有“富强丛书”出现，就如目下的“描写字典”“基本英语”一样，正是那时应运而生的东西。连八股出身的张之洞，他托缪荃孙代做的《书目答问》也竭力添进各种译本去，可见这“维新”风潮之烈了。
The so-called people in the past refer to the so-called "new party" in the late years of Guangxu, and in the early years of the Republic of China, they were called "old new parties". After the defeat of the Sino-Japanese War, they thought they were enlightened, so they wanted to "renovate", that is, middle-aged people in their thirties and forties, and also read "Learning and Calculating Writing" and "Chemistry Identification Origin"; The purpose is to read "foreign books", and the reason for reading foreign books is to give China a picture of "prosperity and strength". Even Zhang Zhidong, who was born in eight shares, and the "Bibliographic Q&A" made by Miao Quan's grandson also tried his best to add various translations, which shows the strength of this "Restoration" trend.然而现在是别一种现象了。有些新青年，境遇正和“老新党”相反，八股毒是丝毫没有染过的，出身又是学校，也并非国学的专家，但是，学起篆字来了，填起词来了，劝人看《庄子》《文选》了，信封也有自刻的印板了，新诗也写成方块了，除掉做新诗的嗜好之外，简直就如光绪初年的雅人一样，所不同者，缺少辫子和有时穿穿洋服而已。
However, it is a different phenomenon now. Some new young people, the situation is the opposite of the "old new party", the eight poisons have not been stained at all, they are from school, and they are not experts in Chinese studies, but they have learned seal characters, filled in words, persuaded people to read "Zhuangzi" and "Anthology", the envelope also has a self-engraved printing plate, and the new poems are also written into squares, except for the hobby of making new poems, it is simply like the elegant people in the early years of Guangxu, the difference is that there is a lack of braids and sometimes wearing clothes.近来有一句常谈，是“旧瓶不能装新酒”。这其实是不确的。旧瓶可以装新酒，新瓶也可以装旧酒，倘若不信，将一瓶五加皮和一瓶白兰地互换起来试试看，五加皮装在白兰地瓶子里，也还是五加皮。这一种简单的试验，不但明示着“五更调”“攒十字”的格调，也可以放进新的内容去，且又证实了新式青年的躯壳里，大可以埋伏下“桐城谬种”或“选学妖孽”的喽罗。
Recently, there is a common saying that "old bottles cannot hold new wine". This is actually not true. If you don't believe it, try swapping a bottle of five-plus skin with a bottle of brandy, and the five-plus skin is in a brandy bottle, and it is still five plus skin. This simple experiment not only clarifies the style of "five watches" and "saving crosses", but also can be put into new content, and it also confirms that in the shell of the new youth, it can ambush the "Tongcheng Fallacy" or "Selection of Demons".“老新党”们的见识虽然浅陋，但是有一个目的：图富强。所以他们坚决，切实；学洋话虽然怪声怪气，但是有一个目的：求富强之术。所以他们认真，热心。待到排满学说播布开来，许多人就成为革命党了，还是因为要给中国图富强，而以为此事必自排满始。
Although the knowledge of the "old and new parties" is shallow, they have one purpose: to get rich and strong. So they are resolute and practical; Although learning foreign dialect is strange, it has a purpose: to seek wealth and strength. So they are serious and enthusiastic. When the doctrine of Paiman was spread, many people became revolutionary parties, or because they wanted to make China rich and strong, thinking that this matter would start from Paiman.排满久已成功，五四早经过去，于是篆字，词，《庄子》，《文选》，古式信封，方块新诗，现在是我们又有了新的企图，要以“古雅”立足于天地之间了。假使真能立足，那倒是给“生存竞争”添一条新例的。
The arrangement has been successful for a long time, and the May Fourth has passed early, so seal characters, words, "Zhuangzi", "Anthology", ancient envelopes, square new poems, and now we have a new attempt to stand between heaven and earth with "quaintness". If it can really gain a foothold, it will add a new precedent to "survival competition".十月一日。

“感旧”以后After "nostalgic" （上） (above)
丰之余
Abundant surplus又不小心，感了一下子旧，就引出了一篇施蛰存先生的《〈庄子〉与〈文选〉》来，以为我那些话，是为他而发的，但又希望并不是为他而发的。
Accidentally, I felt old for a while, so I led up a piece of Mr. Shi Zhicun's "Zhuangzi and Anthology", thinking that my words were for him, but I hope they were not for him.我愿意有几句声明：那篇《感旧》，是并非为施先生而作的，然而可以有施先生在里面。
I would like to make a few statements: That "Nostalgia for the Past" was not written for Mr. Shi, but Mr. Shi can be in it.倘使专对个人而发的话，照现在的摩登文例，应该调查了对手的籍贯，出身，相貌，甚而至于他家乡有什么出产，他老子开过什么铺子，影射他几句才算合式。我的那一篇里可是毫没有这些的。内中所指，是一大队遗少群的风气，并不指定着谁和谁；但也因为所指的是一群，所以被触着的当然也不会少，即使不是整个，也是那里的一肢一节，即使并不永远属于那一队，但有时是属于那一队的。现在施先生自说了劝过青年去读《庄子》与《文选》，“为文学修养之助”，就自然和我所指摘的有点相关，但以为这文为他而作，却诚然是“神经过敏”，我实在并没有这意思。
If it is sent specifically to an individual, according to the current modern literary example, the opponent's origin, origin, appearance, and even what products are produced in his hometown, what shop he has opened, and a few words alluding to him are considered appropriate. There is nothing like this in my article. What is referred to in the middle is the atmosphere of a large group of young people, and it does not specify who and whom; But also because it refers to a group, of course there will be no less people who are touched, even if it is not the whole group, it is a limb and a section there, even if it does not always belong to that team, but sometimes it belongs to that team. Now Mr. Shi himself said that he had persuaded young people to read "Zhuangzi" and "Anthology" "to help with literary accomplishment", which is naturally a bit related to what I pointed out, but I thought that this article was written for him, but it was indeed "nervous", and I really didn't mean it.不过这是在施先生没有说明他的意见之前的话，现在却连这“相关”也有些疏远了，因为我所指摘的，倒是比较顽固的遗少群，标准还要高一点。
However, this was before Mr. Shi explained his opinion, and now even this "related" is a little alienated, because what I am pointing out is a relatively stubborn group of young people, and the standard is a little higher.现在看了施先生自己的解释，（一）才知道他当时的情形，是因为稿纸太小了，“倘再宽阔一点的话”，他“是想多写几部书进去的”；（二）才知道他先前的履历，是“从国文教员转到编杂志”，觉得“青年人的文章太拙直，字汇太少”了，所以推举了这两部古书，使他们去学文法，寻字汇，“虽然其中有许多字是已死了的”，然而也只好去寻觅。我想，假如庄子生在今日，则被劈棺之后，恐怕要劝一切有志于结婚的女子，都去看《烈女传》的罢。
Now that I have read Mr. Shi's own explanation, (1) I know that his situation at that time was because the manuscript paper was too small, "if it was a little wider", he "wanted to write a few more books in it"; (2) Only then did I know that his previous resume was "transferred from a Chinese language teacher to a magazine editor", and he felt that "young people's articles were too clumsy and straight, and there were too few vocabulary", so he recommended these two ancient books to let them learn grammar and find vocabulary, "although many of them are dead", but they had to look for them. I think that if Zhuangzi were born today, after being split in the coffin, I am afraid that all women who are interested in marriage should be persuaded to read "The Biography of the Martyr".还有一点另外的话——
And one more thing -（一）施先生说我用瓶和酒来比“文学修养”是不对的，但我并未这么比方过，我是说有些新青年可以有旧思想，有些旧形式也可以藏新内容。我也以为“新文学”和“旧文学”这中间不能有截然的分界，然而有蜕变，有比较的偏向，而且正因为不能以“何者为分界”，所以也没有了“第三种人”的立场。
(1) Mr. Shi said that it is wrong for me to compare bottles and wine with "literary accomplishments", but I did not compare it to this, I mean that some new young people can have old ideas, and some old forms can also hide new content. I also think that there can be no sharp boundary between "new literature" and "old literature", but there is a transformation and a comparative bias, and it is precisely because it cannot be divided by "which is the boundary", so there is no position of "third type of person".（二）施先生说写篆字等类，都是个人的事情，只要不去勉强别人也做一样的事情就好，这似乎是很对的。然而中学生和投稿者，是他们自己个人的文章太拙直，字汇太少，却并没有勉强别人都去做字汇少而文法拙直的文章，施先生为什么竟大有所感，因此来劝“有志于文学的青年”该看《庄子》与《文选》了呢？做了考官，以词取士，施先生是不以为然的，但一做教员和编辑，却以《庄子》与《文选》劝青年，我真不懂这中间有怎样的分界。
(2) Mr. Shi said that writing seal characters and other things is a personal matter, as long as you don't force others to do the same thing, which seems to be very right. However, middle school students and contributors, their own personal articles are too clumsy and straight, and the vocabulary is too small, but they do not force others to do articles with little vocabulary and clumsy grammar. As an examiner and a scholar by words, Mr. Shi disagreed, but as a teacher and editor, he used "Zhuangzi" and "Anthology" to persuade young people, and I really didn't understand what kind of dividing line there was.（三）施先生还举出一个“鲁迅先生”来，好像他承接了庄子的新道统，一切文章，都是读《庄子》与《文选》读出来的一般。“我以为这也有点武断”的。他的文章中，诚然有许多字为《庄子》与《文选》中所有，例如“之乎者也”之类，但这些字眼，想来别的书上也不见得没有罢。再说得露骨一点，则从这样的书里去找活字汇，简直是胡涂虫，恐怕施先生自己也未必。
(3) Mr. Shi also cited a "Mr. Lu Xun", as if he had inherited Zhuangzi's new Taoism, and all the articles were read by reading "Zhuangzi" and "Anthology". "I thought it was a bit arbitrary too." It is true that there are many words in his articles that are all in "Zhuangzi" and "Selected Works", such as "Zhihu Zhe", but these words may not be found in other books. To put it more explicitly, it is simply nonsense to find a movable word vocabulary from such a book, and I am afraid that Mr. Shi himself may not be.十月十二日。

“感旧”以后　（上）

【备考】：

“感旧”以后　（上）

[Remarks]:《庄子》与《文选》
"Zhuangzi" and "Selected Works"施蛰存
Shi hibernation exists上个月《大晚报》的编辑寄了一张印着表格的邮片来，要我填注两项：（一）目下在读什么书，（二）要介绍给青年的书。
Last month, the editor of the "Evening News" sent me a postcard with a form printed on it, asking me to fill in two items: (1) what book I am reading at the moment, and (2) the book I want to introduce to young people.在第二项中，我写着：《庄子》，《文选》，并且附加了一句注脚：“为青年文学修养之助。”
In the second item, I wrote: "Zhuangzi", "Anthology", and added a footnote: "For the literary cultivation of young people." ”今天看见《自由谈》上丰之余先生的《感旧》一文，不觉有点神经过敏起来，以为丰先生这篇文章是为我而作的了。
Today I saw Mr. Feng Zhiyu's article "Nostalgia for the Old" in "Free Talk", and I felt a little nervous, thinking that Mr. Feng's article was written for me.但是现在我并不想对于丰先生有什么辩难，我只想趁此机会替自己作一个解释。
But now I don't want to argue with Mr. Feng, I just want to take this opportunity to explain for myself.第一，我应当说明我为什么希望青年人读《庄子》和《文选》。近数年来，我的生活，从国文教师转到编杂志，与青年人的文章接触的机会实在太多了。我总感觉到这些青年人的文章太拙直，字汇太少，所以在《大晚报》编辑寄来的狭狭的行格里推荐了这两部书。我以为从这两部书中可以参悟一点做文章的方法，同时也可以扩大一点字汇（虽然其中有许多字是已死了的）。但是我当然并不希望青年人都去做《庄子》，《文选》一类的“古文”。
First, I should explain why I want young people to read Zhuangzi and Selected Works. In recent years, my life has shifted from a Chinese teacher to a magazine editor, and I have had too many opportunities to come into contact with young people's articles. I always felt that the articles of these young people were too clumsy and straight, and the vocabulary was too small, so I recommended these two books in the narrow line sent by the editor of the "Great Evening News". I think that from these two books, I can understand a little about how to write articles, and at the same time, I can also expand my vocabulary a little (although many of the words are dead). But of course I don't want young people to do "ancient texts" such as "Zhuangzi" and "Selected Works".第二，我应当说明我只是希望有志于文学的青年能够读一读这两部书。我以为每一个文学者必须要有所借助于他上代的文学，我不懂得“新文学”和“旧文学”这中间究竟是以何者为分界的。在文学上，我以为“旧瓶装新酒”与“新瓶装旧酒”这譬喻是不对的。倘若我们把一个人的文学修养比之为酒，那么我们可以这样说：酒瓶的新旧没有关系，但这酒必须是酿造出来的。
Second, I should explain that I just hope that young people who are interested in literature can read these two books. I think that every literary scholar must rely on the literature of his previous generation, and I don't know what is the boundary between "new literature" and "old literature". In literature, I think the metaphor of "new wine in old bottles" and "old wine in new bottles" is wrong. If we compare a person's literary accomplishment to wine, then we can say this: it doesn't matter if the bottle is old or new, but the wine must be brewed.我劝文学青年读《庄子》与《文选》，目的在要他们“酿造”，倘若《大晚报》编辑寄来的表格再宽阔一点的话，我是想再多写几部书进去的。
I persuaded literary young people to read "Zhuangzi" and "Anthology", with the aim of asking them to "brew", and if the form sent by the editor of the "Evening News" was a little wider, I would like to write a few more books into it.这里，我们不妨举鲁迅先生来说，像鲁迅先生那样的新文学家，似乎可以算是十足的新瓶了。但是他的酒呢？纯粹的白兰地吗？我就不能相信。没有经过古文学的修养，鲁迅先生的新文章决不会写到现在那样好。所以，我敢说：在鲁迅先生那样的瓶子里，也免不了有许多五加皮或绍兴老酒的成分。
Here, we might as well cite Mr. Lu Xun, a new writer like Mr. Lu Xun seems to be a complete new bottle. But what about his wine? Is it pure brandy? I can't believe it. Without the cultivation of ancient literature, Mr. Lu Xun's new articles would never have been written as well as they are now. Therefore, I dare to say: in a bottle like Mr. Lu Xun, there are inevitably many ingredients of Wujiapi or Shaoxing old wine.至于丰之余先生以为写篆字，填词，用自刻印板的信封，都是不出身于学校，或国学专家们的事情，我以为这也有点武断。这些其实只是个人的事情，如果写篆字的人，不以篆字写信，如果填词的人做了官不以词取士，如果用自刻印板信封的人不勉强别人也去刻一个专用信封，那也无须丰先生口诛笔伐地去认为“谬种”和“妖孽”了。
As for Mr. Feng Zhiyu's belief that writing seal characters, filling in words, and using envelopes with self-engraved plates are all things that are not from school, or Chinese studies experts, I think this is also a bit arbitrary. These are actually just personal matters, if the person who writes seal characters does not write letters in seal characters, if the person who writes the words becomes an official and does not use words to take the scholar, if the person who uses the self-engraved plate envelope does not force others to engrave a special envelope, then there is no need for Mr. Feng to think that it is a "false species" and "demon".新文学家中，也有玩木刻，考究版本，收罗藏书票，以骈体文为白话书信作序，甚至写字台上陈列了小摆设的，照丰先生的意见说来，难道他们是“要以‘今雅’立足于天地之间”吗？我想他们也未必有此企图。
Among the new writers, there are also those who play woodcuts, pay attention to the version, collect book tickets, use parallel texts as the preface to vernacular letters, and even display knick-knacks on the writing desk. I don't think they may have this intention.临了，我希望丰先生那篇文章并不是为我而作的。
I hope Mr. Feng's article is not for me.十月八日，《自由谈》。October 8, "Free Talk".

“滑稽”例解

“滑稽”例解

“滑稽”例解

“滑稽”例解苇索
苇索研究世界文学的人告诉我们：法人善于机锋，俄人善于讽刺，英美人善于幽默。这大概是真确的，就都为社会状态所制限。慨自语堂大师振兴“幽默”以来，这名词是很通行了，但一普遍，也就伏着危机，正如军人自称佛子，高官忽挂念珠，而佛法就要涅槃一样。倘若油滑，轻薄，猥亵，都蒙“幽默”之号，则恰如“新戏”之入“×世界”，必已成为“文明戏”也无疑。
Those who study world literature tell us that the French are good at wit, the Russians are good at satire, and the British and Americans are good at humor. This is probably true, but it is limited by the state of society. Since Master Yutang revitalized "humor", this term has been very popular, but once it is common, there is a crisis, just like a soldier claims to be a Buddha, a high-ranking official suddenly hangs a rosary, and Buddhism is about to be nirvana. If it is smooth, frivolous, and obscene, all of which are called "humor", it is just like the "new drama" entering the "× world", and it will undoubtedly become a "civilized drama".这危险，就因为中国向来不大有幽默。只是滑稽是有的，但这和幽默还隔着一大段，日本人曾译“幽默”为“有情滑稽”，所以别于单单的“滑稽”，即为此。那么，在中国，只能寻得滑稽文章了？却又不。中国之自以为滑稽文章者，也还是油滑，轻薄，猥亵之谈，和真的滑稽有别。这“狸猫换太子”的关键，是在历来的自以为正经的言论和事实，大抵滑稽者多，人们看惯，渐渐以为平常，便将油滑之类，误认为滑稽了。
This danger is because China has never had much humor. It's just that there is funny, but this is still a long way from humor, the Japanese once translated "humor" as "sentimental funny", so it is different from just "funny", that is, for this reason. So, in China, you can only find funny articles? But no. China's self-proclaimed funny articles are still smooth, frivolous, and obscene, which is different from real funny. The key to this "civet cat for prince" is that there are many self-righteous remarks and facts in the past, and people are used to it, and gradually think that it is ordinary, so they mistake oil slippery and the like for funny.在中国要寻求滑稽，不可看所谓滑稽文，倒要看所谓正经事，但必须想一想。
In China, if you want to seek funny, you should not read the so-called funny texts, but look at the so-called serious things, but you must think about it.这些名文是俯拾即是的，譬如报章上正正经经的题目，什么“中日交涉渐入佳境”呀，“中国到那里去”呀，就都是的，咀嚼起来，真如橄榄一样，很有些回味。
These famous articles are just like the serious titles in the newspaper, what "Sino-Japanese negotiations are getting better", "China is going there", they are all right, chewed, really like olives, very aftertaste.见于报章上的广告的，也有的是。我们知道有一种刊物，自说是“舆论界的新权威”，“说出一般人所想说而没有说的话”，而一面又在向别一种刊物“声明误会，表示歉意”，但又说是“按双方均为社会有声誉之刊物，自无互相攻讦之理”。“新权威”而善于“误会”，“误会”了而偏“有声誉”，“一般人所想说而没有说的话”却是误会和道歉：这要不笑，是必须不会思索的。
Some are seen in newspaper advertisements. We know that there is a kind of publication that claims to be "the new authority in the world of public opinion" and "says what ordinary people want to say but does not say", and on the other hand, it "declares misunderstanding and apologizes" to another publication, but also says that "according to the publications of both parties with a good reputation in society, there is no reason to attack each other". "New authority" is good at "misunderstanding", "misunderstanding" but "has a reputation", "what ordinary people want to say but not say" is misunderstanding and apology: this must not be thought of.见于报章的短评上的，也有的是。例如九月间《自由谈》所载的《登龙术拾遗》上，以做富家女婿为“登龙”之一术，不久就招来了一篇反攻，那开首道：“狐狸吃不到葡萄，说葡萄是酸的，自己娶不到富妻子，于是对于一切有富岳家的人发生了妒嫉，妒嫉的结果是攻击。”这也不能想一下。一想“的结果”，便分明是这位作者在表明他知道“富妻子”的味道是甜的了。
It is also seen in the short reviews of the newspaper. For example, in the "Collection of the Art of Ascending the Dragon" published in "Free Talk" in September, being the son-in-law of a rich family was one of the techniques of "ascending the dragon", and soon attracted a counterattack, which began: "The fox can't eat grapes, saying that grapes are sour, and he can't marry a rich wife, so he is jealous of all those who have a rich family, and the result of jealousy is an attack." "You can't think about it either. When I think about the "result", it is clear that the author is showing that he knows that the taste of "rich wife" is sweet.诸如此类的妙文，我们也尝见于冠冕堂皇的公文上：而且并非将它漫画化了的，却是它本身原来是漫画。《论语》一年中，我最爱看“古香斋”这一栏，如四川营山县长禁穿长衫令云：“须知衣服蔽体已足，何必前拖后曳，消耗布匹？且国势衰弱，……顾念时艰，后患何堪设想？”又如北平社会局禁女人养雄犬文云：“查雌女雄犬相处，非仅有碍健康，更易发生无耻秽闻，揆之我国礼义之邦，亦为习俗所不许。谨特通令严禁……凡妇女带养之雄犬，斩之无赦，以为取缔！”这那里是滑稽作家所能凭空写得出来的？
We have also seen such wonderful writings in high-sounding official documents: and it is not a caricature, but it itself is originally a caricature. In the year of the Analects, I like to read the column "Guxiangzhai", such as the order of the governor of Yingshan County, Sichuan Province to prohibit the wearing of long gowns: "You must know that the clothes cover the body enough, why drag forward and backward, consume cloth?" Moreover, the country's power is weakening,...... Considering the difficult times, how can we imagine future troubles? Another example is the Peking Social Bureau's article prohibiting women from raising male dogs: "Checking the relationship between male and female male dogs is not only harmful to health, but also prone to shameless scandals, and it is also not allowed by custom in our country's country of propriety and righteousness." It is strictly prohibited by the order...... All male dogs raised by women should be killed without mercy, and they should be banned! "Is this something that a burlesque writer can write out of thin air?不过“古香斋”里所收的妙文，往往还倾于奇诡，滑稽却不如平淡，惟其平淡，也就更加滑稽，在这一标准上，我推选“甜葡萄”说。
However, the wonderful articles collected in "Guxiangzhai" are often bizarre, funny but not as ordinary, but they are plain, and they are even more funny, and on this criterion, I choose "sweet grapes" to say.十月十九日。
