Abundant surplus自从《自由谈》上发表了我的《感旧》和施蛰存先生的《〈庄子〉与〈文选〉》以后，《大晚报》的《火炬》便在征求展开的讨论。首先征到的是施先生的一封信，题目曰《推荐者的立场》，注云“《庄子》与《文选》的论争”。
Since the publication of my "Nostalgia for the Past" and Mr. Shi Zhicun's "Zhuangzi and Anthology" in "Free Talk", the "Torch" of the "Great Evening News" has been soliciting discussions. The first thing I received was a letter from Mr. Shi, titled "The Position of the Recommender", with the note "The Controversy between Zhuangzi and the Anthology".但施先生又并不愿意“论争”，他以为两个人作战，正如弧光灯下的拳击手，无非给看客好玩。这是很聪明的见解，我赞成这一肢一节。不过更聪明的是施先生其实并非真没有动手，他在未说退场白之前，早已挥了几拳了。挥了之后，飘然远引，倒是最超脱的拳法。现在只剩下一个我了，却还得回一手，但对面没人也不要紧，我算是在打“逍遥游”。
But Mr. Shi is not willing to "argue", he thinks that two people fighting, just like a boxer under the arc light, is nothing more than fun for the spectators. This is a very clever opinion, and I agree with this section. But what's smarter is that Mr. Shi didn't really do anything, he had already thrown a few punches before he said his exit. After swinging, it floated away, but it was the most transcendent boxing technique. Now there is only one me left, but I have to take a hand back, but it doesn't matter if there is no one on the other side, I am playing "Getaway".施先生一开首就说我加以“训诲”，而且派他为“遗少的一肢一节”。上一句是诬赖的，我的文章中，并未对于他个人有所劝告。至于指为“遗少的一肢一节”，却诚然有这意思，不过我的意思，是以为“遗少”也并非怎么很坏的人物。新文学和旧文学中间难有截然的分界，施先生是承认的，辛亥革命去今不过二十二年，则民国人中带些遗少气，遗老气，甚而至于封建气，也还不算甚么大怪事，更何况如施先生自己所说，“虽然不敢自认为遗少，但的确已消失了少年的活力”的呢，过去的余气当然要有的。但是，只要自己知道，别人也知道，能少传授一点，那就好了。
Mr. Shi said at the beginning that I would "instruct" him, and sent him as "a limb and a section of the missing". The previous sentence was false, and in my article, I did not give him any advice personally. As for referring to "one limb and one section of the young man", it does mean this, but what I mean is that I think that "young people" are not very bad characters. It is difficult to have a sharp boundary between new literature and old literature, Mr. Shi admits that the Xinhai Revolution has only been 22 years since then, and the people of the Republic of China have some youth, old spirit, and even feudal spirit, which is not a big strange thing, not to mention that as Mr. Shi himself said, "Although I dare not think that I am a young man, but the vitality of the youth has indeed disappeared", of course there must be a residual atmosphere in the past. However, as long as you know, others know, and you can teach a little less, that's fine.我早经声明，先前的文字是并非专为他个人而作的，而且自看了《〈庄子〉与〈文选〉》之后，则连这“一肢一节”也已经疏远。为什么呢，因为在推荐给青年的几部书目上，还题出着别一个极有意味的问题：其中有一种是《颜氏家训》。这《家训》的作者，生当乱世，由齐入隋，一直是胡势大张的时候，他在那书里，也谈古典，论文章，儒士似的，却又归心于佛，而对于子弟，则愿意他们学鲜卑语，弹琵琶，以服事贵人——胡人。这也是庚子义和拳败后的达官，富翁，巨商，士人的思想，自己念佛，子弟却学些“洋务”，使将来可以事人：便是现在，抱这样思想的人恐怕还不少。而这颜氏的渡世法，竟打动了施先生的心了，还推荐于青年，算是“道德修养”。他又举出自己在读的书籍，是一部英文书和一部佛经，正为“鲜卑语”和《归心篇》写照。只是现代变化急速，没有前人的悠闲，新旧之争，又正剧烈，一下子看不出什么头绪，他就也只好将先前两代的“道德”，并萃于一身了。假使青年，中年，老年，有着这颜氏式道德者多，则在中国社会上，实是一个严重的问题，有荡涤的必要。自然，这虽为书目所引起，问题是不专在个人的，这是时代思潮的一部。但因为连带提出，表面上似有太关涉了某一个人之观，我便不敢论及了，可以和他相关的只有“劝人看《庄子》《文选》了”八个字，对于个人，恐怕还不能算是不敬的。但待到看了《〈庄子〉与〈文选〉》，却实在生了一点不敬之心，因为他辩驳的话比我所豫料的还空虚，但仍给以正经的答复，那便是《感旧以后》（上）。
I have already stated that the previous text was not written for him personally, and since reading "Zhuangzi" and "Selected Works", even this "limb and section" has been alienated. Why, because in several books recommended to young people, there is another very meaningful question: one of them is "Yan's Family Instructions". The author of this "Family Instruction", born in troubled times, from Qi to Sui, has always been when Hu Shi is strong, in that book, he also talks about the classics, on articles, like a Confucian, but he is devoted to Buddhism, and for his children, he is willing to learn Xianbei language, play the pipa, and serve the nobles - Hu people. This is also the thinking of dignitaries, rich people, giant businessmen, and scholars after the defeat of Gengzi Yihe, who chanted Buddha by themselves, but their children learned some "foreign affairs", so that they could serve others in the future: even now, I am afraid that there are still many people with such thoughts. And this Yan's method of crossing the world actually touched Mr. Shi's heart, and he also recommended it to young people, which can be regarded as "moral cultivation". He also cited the books he was reading, an English book and a Buddhist scripture, which were portrayed as "Xianbei language" and "Returning to the Heart". It's just that modern times are changing rapidly, there is no leisure of the predecessors, and the dispute between the old and the new is fierce, and he can't see any clue at once, so he has to concentrate the "morality" of the previous two generations into one. If there are many young people, middle-aged people, and old people who have this Yan's morality, it is really a serious problem in Chinese society, and it is necessary to clean it up. Naturally, although this is caused by the bibliography, the problem is not limited to the individual, this is a part of the trend of the times. But because it was jointly proposed, it seemed to be too related to a certain person's view on the surface, so I didn't dare to discuss it, and the only words that could be related to him were "persuading people to read "Zhuangzi" and "Anthology", which may not be disrespectful to individuals. But when I read "Zhuangzi" and "Selected Works", I really felt a little disrespectful, because his arguments were more empty than I expected, but he still gave a serious answer, which was "After Feeling the Past" (Part I).然而施先生的写在看了《感旧以后》（上）之后的那封信，却更加证明了他和我所谓“遗少”的疏远。他虽然口说不来拳击，那第一段却全是对我个人而发的。现在介绍一点在这里，并且加以注解。
However, Mr. Shi's letter after reading "After Feeling the Old" (Part I) further proves the estrangement between him and my so-called "young people". Although he couldn't say boxing, the first paragraph was all about me personally. Now I will introduce a little bit here and annotate it.施先生说：“据我想起来，劝青年看新书自然比劝他们看旧书能够多获得一些群众。”这是说，劝青年看新书的，并非为了青年，倒是为自己要多获些群众。
Mr. Shi said: "As far as I can remember, persuading young people to read new books is naturally more popular than persuading them to read old books. [Remarks]:推荐者的立场The position of the recommender ——《庄子》与《文选》之论争 - the debate between "Zhuangzi" and "Selected Works"
施蛰存
Shi hibernation exists万秋先生：
Mr. Wan Qiu:我在贵报向青年推荐了两部旧书，不幸引起了丰之余先生的训诲，把我派做“遗少中的一肢一节”。自从读了他老人家的《感旧以后》（上）一文后，我就不想再写什么，因为据我想起来，劝新青年看新书自然比劝他们看旧书能够多获得一些群众。丰之余先生毕竟是老当益壮，足为青年人的领导者。至于我呢，虽然不敢自认为遗少，但的确已消失了少年的活力，在这万象皆秋的环境中，即使丰之余先生那样的新精神，亦已不够振拔我的中年之感了。所以，我想借贵报一角篇幅，将我在九月二十九日贵报上发表的推荐给青年的书目改一下：我想把《庄子》与《文选》改为鲁迅先生的《华盖集》正续编及《伪自由书》。我想，鲁迅先生为当代“文坛老将”，他的著作里是有着很广大的活字汇的，而且据丰之余先生告诉我，鲁迅先生文章里的确也有一些从《庄子》与《文选》里出来的字眼，譬如“之乎者也”之类。这样，我想对于青年人的效果也是一样的。本来我还想推荐一二部丰之余先生的著作，可惜坊间只有丰子恺先生的书，而没有丰之余先生的书，说不定他是像鲁迅先生印珂罗版木刻图一样的是私人精印本，属于罕见书之列，我很惭愧我的孤陋寡闻，未能推荐矣。
I recommended two old books to young people in your newspaper, but unfortunately it caused Mr. Feng Zhiyu's admonition and sent me as "a limb and a section among the young people". Since reading his old man's article "After Feeling the Old" (Part I), I don't want to write anything more, because as far as I can remember, persuading new young people to read new books is naturally more popular than persuading them to read old books. After all, Mr. Feng Zhiyu is a leader of young people. Seeing yesterday's newspaper, I know that you are going to invite the readers of your newspaper to participate in the discussion of this case. I don't know if I can ask you to cancel this plan. I often think that two people are fighting a word war in a newspaper, like a boxer under an arc light, and the newspaper editor is like the thin referee rushing around, and the readers are those irrational spectators in the dark. The skinny referee always wants the boxer to fight round after round until one of them falls, one, two, three...... Unable to stand up, he ran to the panting winner, raised his arm with big leather gloves, and shouted "Mr. X Win the Champion." Just think about it, isn't that too funny? Now, I have the misfortune of being one of these two boxers myself, but I don't want to continue playing this burlesque for the sake of thin referees and spectators. And I also hope you don't be that thin referee. Don't you see those sayings quoted in Mr. Shishui's article on "Free Talk" today? "Flying in the air" is wrong丰之余
Abundant surplus前几天写《扑空》的时候，手头没有书，涉及《颜氏家训》之处，仅凭记忆，后来怕有错误，设法觅得原书来查了一查，发见对于颜之推的记述，是我弄错了。其《教子篇》云：“齐朝有一士大夫，尝谓吾曰：我有一儿，年已十七，颇晓书疏，教其鲜卑语，及弹琵琶，稍欲通解，以此伏事公卿，无不宠爱，亦要事也。吾时俛而不答。异哉此人之教子也。若由此业，自致卿相，亦不愿汝曹为之。”
When I wrote "Fluttering" a few days ago, I didn't have a book at hand, and it involved the "Yan's Family Instructions", based only on memory, and later I was afraid of making mistakes, so I managed to find the original book to check, and found that I made a mistake in the account of Yan Zhitui. His "Teaching the Son" says: "In the Qi Dynasty, there was a scholar and official who once said to me: I have a son, seventeen years old, who is quite knowledgeable in books, taught him Xianbei language, and played the pipa, hoping to understand a little, so that he could serve the nobles, and everyone was favored, which was also important. I sometimes bowed down and did not answer. It's strange that this person teaches his son. If you become a minister because of this profession, I do not want you to do it. ”然则齐士的办法，是庚子以后官商士绅的办法，施蛰存先生却是合齐士与颜氏的两种典型为一体的，也是现在一部分的人们的办法，可改称为“北朝式道德”，也还是社会上的严重的问题。
However, the method of Qi Shi is the method of officials, businessmen, and gentry after Gengzi, but Mr. Shi Zhicun is a combination of the two typical examples of Qi Shi and the Yan family, and it is also the method of some people now, which can be renamed "Northern Dynasty-style morality", which is still a serious problem in society.对于颜氏，本应该十分抱歉的，但他早经死去了，谢罪与否都不相干，现在只在这里对于施先生和读者订正我的错误。
For Yan, I should have been very sorry, but he died a long time ago, and it doesn't matter whether he apologizes or not, and now I am only here to correct my mistakes for Mr. Shi and readers.十月二十五日。

Shi hibernation exists（八）对于丰之余先生，我的确曾经“打了几拳”，这也许会成为我毕生的遗憾。但是丰先生作《扑空》，其实并未“空”，还是扑的我，站在丰先生那一方面（或者说站在正邪说那方面）的文章却每天都在“剿”我，而我却真有“一个人的受难”之感了。
(8) For Mr. Feng Zhiyu, I did "punch a few times", which may become my lifelong regret. But Mr. Feng's "Empty" is actually not "empty", but still pounces on me, and the articles on Mr. Feng's side (or on the side of good and evil) are "suppressing" me every day, but I really have a sense of "one person's suffering".但是，从《扑空》一文中我发现了丰先生作文的逻辑，他说“我早经声明，先前的文字并非专为他个人而发的”。但下文却有“因为他辩驳的话比我所预料的还空虚”。不专为我而发，但已经预料我会辩驳，这又该作何解？
However, I found the logic of Mr. Feng's composition from the article "Fluttering", he said, "I have already stated that the previous text was not written for him personally." But the following is "because his arguments are more empty than I expected". It's not just for me, but I already expect that I will argue, so what should I do?因为被人“指摘”了，我也觉得《庄子》与《文选》这两本书诚有不妥处，于是在给《大晚报》编辑的信里，要求他许我改两部新文学书，事实确是如此的。我并不说丰先生是恨我没有推荐这两部新文学书而“反对《庄子》与《文选》”的，而丰先生却说我存着这样的心思，这又岂是“有伦次”的话呢？
Because I was "criticized", I also felt that the two books "Zhuangzi" and "Anthology" were indeed inappropriate, so in a letter to the editor of the "Evening News", I asked him to allow me to change two new literary books, and this is indeed the case. I don't say that Mr. Feng hates me for not recommending these two new literary books and "opposes Zhuangzi" and "Selected Works", but Mr. Feng said that I have such a mind, how can this be a "coherent" word?丰先生又把话题搭到《颜氏家训》，又搭到我自己正在读的两本书，并为一谈，说推荐《颜氏家训》是在教青年学鲜卑语，弹琵琶，以服事贵人，而且我还以身作则，在读一本洋书；说颜之推是“儒士似的，却又归心于佛”，因而我也看一本佛书；从丰先生的解释看起来，竟连我自己也失笑了，天下事真会这样巧！
Mr. Feng also put the topic on "Yan's Family Instructions", and then to the two books I am reading, and said that recommending "Yan's Family Teachings" is teaching young people to learn Xianbei language, play the pipa, and serve the nobles, and I am also leading by example, reading a foreign book; said that Yan Zhitui was "like a Confucian scholar, but he was devoted to Buddha", so I also read a Buddhist book; From Mr. Feng's explanation, even I laughed myself, things in the world are really so coincidental!我明明记得，《颜氏家训》中的确有一个故事，说有人教子弟学鲜卑语，学琵琶，但我还记得底下有一句：“亦不愿汝曹为之”，可见颜之推并不劝子弟读外国书。今天丰先生有“正误”了，他把这故事更正了之后，却说：“施蛰存先生却是合齐士与颜氏的两种典型为一体的。”这个，我倒不懂了，难道我另外还介绍过一本该“齐士”的著作给青年人吗？如果丰先生这逻辑是根据于“自己读外国书即劝人学鲜卑语”，那我也没话可说了。
I clearly remember that there is indeed a story in the "Yan's Family Instructions", saying that someone taught his children to learn Xianbei language and pipa, but I still remember a sentence at the bottom: "I don't want you to do it", which shows that Yan Zhitui did not persuade his children to read foreign books. Today, Mr. Feng has a "right and wrong", and after he corrected the story, he said: "Mr. Shi Zhicun is one of the two typical examples of Qi Shi and Yan." "I don't understand this, have I introduced another book that should be "Qi Shi" to young people? If Mr. Feng's logic is based on "persuading others to learn Xianbei by reading foreign books", then I have nothing to say.丰先生似乎是个想为儒家争正统的人物，不然何以对于颜之推受佛教影响如此之鄙薄呢？何以对于我自己看一本《释迦传》如此之不满呢？这里，有两点可以题出来：（一）《颜氏家训》一书之价值是否因《归心篇》而完全可以抹杀？况且颜氏虽然为佛教张目，但他倒并不鼓吹出世，逃避现实，他也不过列举佛家与儒家有可以并行不悖之点，而采佛家报应之说，以补儒家道德教训之不足，这也可以说等于现在人引《圣经》或《可兰经》中的话一样。（二）我看一本《佛本行经》，其意义也等于看一本《谟罕默德传》或《基督传》，既无皈佛之心，更无劝人学佛之行，而丰先生的文章却说是我的“渡世法”，妙哉言乎，我不免取案头的一本某先生舍金上梓的《百喻经》而引为同志矣。
Mr. Feng seems to be a figure who wants to fight for Confucianism for orthodoxy, otherwise why is Yan Zhitui so despicable of being influenced by Buddhism? Why am I so dissatisfied with reading a copy of "The Biography of Shakyamuni"? Here, two points can be asked: (1) Can the value of the book "Yan's Family Instructions" be completely erased by "Returning to the Heart"? Moreover, although Yan Shi is open for Buddhism, he does not advocate being born and escaping reality, and he only lists the points that Buddhism and Confucianism can go hand in hand, and adopts the Buddhist theory of retribution to make up for the lack of Confucian moral teachings, which can also be said to be equivalent to quoting the words in the Bible or the Koran now. (2) I read a copy of the "Buddha's Conduct Sutra", and its meaning is equivalent to reading a "Biography of Mohammed" or "The Biography of Christ", which has neither the heart of converting to Buddhism, nor the act of persuading people to learn Buddhism, but Mr. Feng's article says that it is my "method of crossing the world".我以前对于丰先生，虽然文字上有点太闹意气，但的确还是表示尊敬的，但看到《扑空》这一篇，他竟骂我为“洋场恶少”了，切齿之声俨若可闻，我虽“恶”，却也不敢再恶到以相当的恶声相报了。我呢，套一句现成诗：“十年一觉文坛梦，赢得洋场恶少名”，原是无足重轻，但对于丰先生，我想该是会得后悔的。今天读到《〈扑空〉正误》，则又觉得丰先生所谓“无端的诬赖，自己的猜测，撒娇，装傻”，又正好留着给自己“写照”了。
I used to respect Mr. Feng, although the text was a little too noisy, but I still respected him, but when I saw the article "Puff in the Sky", he actually scolded me as a "villain in the foreign field", and the sound of gnashing my teeth was audible, although I was "evil", I didn't dare to repay it with a considerable bad voice. As for me, a ready-made poem: "Ten years of literary dreams, winning the name of a villain in the foreign field", it was originally insignificant, but for Mr. Feng, I think he will regret it. Today, when I read "The Right and Wrong of 'Punching the Sky'", I feel that Mr. Feng's so-called "groundless slander, his own guesses, acting coquettishly, and pretending to be stupid" is just reserved for himself to "portray".（附注）《大晚报》上那两个标题并不是我自己加的，我并无“立场”，也并不愿意因我之故而使《庄子》与《文选》这两部书争吵起来。

Answer: "Also indicated"丰之余
Abundant surplus前几天写了一篇《扑空》之后，对于什么“《庄子》与《文选》”之类，本也不想再说了。第二天看见了《自由谈》上的施蛰存先生《致黎烈文先生书》，也是“兼示”我的，就再来说几句。因为施先生驳复我的三项，我觉得都不中肯——
After writing an article "Pukong" a few days ago, I didn't want to say anything more about "Zhuangzi" and "Anthology". The next day, I saw Mr. Shi Zhicun's "Letter to Mr. Li Liewen" in "Free Talk", which also "showed" me, so I will say a few more words. Because Mr. Shi refuted my three items, I don't think they are all pertinent -（一）施先生说，既然“有些新青年可以有旧思想，有些旧形式也可以藏新内容”，则像他似的“遗少之群中的一肢一节”的旧思想也可以存而不论，而且写《庄子》那样的古文也不妨了。自然，倘要这样写，也可以说“不妨”的，宇宙决不会因此破灭。但我总以为现在的青年，大可以不必舍白话不写，却另去熟读了《庄子》，学了它那样的文法来写文章。至于存而不论，那固然也可以，然而论及又有何妨呢？施先生对于青年之文法拙直，字汇少，和我的《感旧》，不是就不肯“存而不论”么？
(1) Mr. Shi said that since "some new young people can have old ideas, and some old forms can also hide new content", the old ideas of "one limb and one section in the group of leftovers" like him can also be preserved and ignored, and it is not a bad idea to write ancient texts like "Zhuangzi". Naturally, if you want to write like this, you can also say "it might be fine", and the universe will never be destroyed because of this. But I always think that today's young people don't have to give up the vernacular and not write, but they have read "Zhuangzi" and learned its grammar to write articles. As for whether it exists or not, it is certainly possible, but what harm is there in discussing it? Didn't Mr. Shi refuse to "save and ignore" the young man's clumsy and straightforward grammar, few words, and my "nostalgia"?（二）施先生以为“以词取士”，和劝青年看《庄子》与《文选》有“强迫”与“贡献”之分，我的比例并不对。但我不知道施先生做国文教员的时候，对于学生的作文，是否以富有《庄子》文法与《文选》字汇者为佳文，转为编辑之后，也以这样的作品为上选？假使如此，则倘作“考官”，我看是要以《庄子》与《文选》取士的。
(2) Mr. Shi thinks that "taking scholars by words" and persuading young people to read "Zhuangzi" and "Anthology" are divided into "forced" and "contributed", but my ratio is not right. But I don't know if when Mr. Shi was a Chinese teacher, did he choose those who are rich in the grammar of "Zhuangzi" and the vocabulary of "Selected Works" for students' compositions, and after becoming an editor, he also chose such works? If this is the case, then if you are an "examiner", I think you should use "Zhuangzi" and "Selected Works" to select scholars.（三）施先生又举鲁迅的话，说他曾经说过：一，“少看中国书，其结果不过不能作文而已。”可见是承认了要能作文，该多看中国书；二，“……我以为倘要弄旧的呢，倒不如姑且靠着张之洞的《书目答问》去摸门径去。”就知道没有反对青年读古书过。这是施先生忽略了时候和环境。他说一条的那几句的时候，正是许多人大叫要作白话文，也非读古书不可之际，所以那几句是针对他们而发的，犹言即使恰如他们所说，也不过不能作文，而去读古书，却比不能作文之害还大。至于二，则明明指定着研究旧文学的青年，和施先生的主张，涉及一般的大异。倘要弄中国上古文学史，我们不是还得看《易经》与《书经》么？
(3) Mr. Shi also cited Lu Xun's words, saying that he once said: 1. "Read less Chinese books, and the result is just that you can't write." It can be seen that it is admitted that if you want to be able to write, you should read more Chinese books; 2. "...... I thought that if I wanted to get an old one, it would be better to rely on Zhang Zhidong's "Bibliographic Q&A" to find the door. "I know that I have never opposed young people reading ancient books. This is Mr. Shi's neglect of time and environment. When he said a few sentences, it was the time when many people shouted that they wanted to write vernacular texts, and they had to read ancient books, so those sentences were addressed to them, just as they said that even if they were right, they could not write, and reading ancient books was more harmful than not being able to write. As for the second, it clearly designates young people who study old literature, and Mr. Shi's ideas involve general differences. If we want to get the history of ancient Chinese literature, don't we have to read the "I Ching" and the "Book of Books"?其实，施先生说当他填写那书目的时候，并不如我所推测那样的严肃，我看这话倒是真实的。我们试想一想，假如真有这样的一个青年后学，奉命惟谨，下过一番苦功之后，用了《庄子》的文法，《文选》的语汇，来写发挥《论语》《孟子》和《颜氏家训》的道德的文章，“这岂不是太滑稽吗”？
In fact, Mr. Shi said that when he filled out the bibliography, it was not as serious as I guessed, but I think this is true. Let's think about it, if there is such a young scholar, who is ordered to be cautious, and after a lot of hard work, he uses the grammar of "Zhuangzi" and the vocabulary of "Anthology" to write articles that give full play to the morality of the "Analects", "Mencius" and "Yan's Family Teachings", "Isn't this too funny"?然而我的那篇《怀旧》是严肃的。我并非为要“多获群众”，也不是因为恨施先生没有推荐《华盖集》正续编及《伪自由书》；更不是别有“动机”，例如因为做学生时少得了分数，或投稿时被没收了稿子，现在就借此来报私怨。
However, my "Nostalgia" is serious. I am not trying to "win more people", nor is it because I hate Mr. Shi for not recommending the continuation of the "Huagai Collection" and the "Pseudo-Freedom Book"; It is not that there is no other "motive", such as because you got less points when you were a student, or because your manuscript was confiscated when you submitted it, and now you use this to take revenge.十月二十一日。

[Remarks]:致黎烈文先生书Letter to Mr. Li Liewen ——兼示丰之余先生 - Also to Mr. Feng Zhiyu

Shi hibernation exists烈文兄：
Brother Liewen:那天电车上匆匆一晤，我因为要到民九社书铺去买一本看中意了的书，所以在王家沙下车了。但那本书终于因价钱不合，没有买到，徒然失去了一个与你多谈一刻的机会，甚怅怅。
I hurriedly met on the tram that day, and I got off at Wangjiasha because I was going to go to the Minjiu Society bookstore to buy a book I liked. But the book was finally not bought due to the price, and I lost an opportunity to talk to you for a moment, which was very disappointing.关于“《庄子》与《文选》”问题，我决不再想说什么话。本来我当时填写《大晚报》编辑部寄来的那张表格的时候，并不含有如丰先生的意见所看出来的那样严肃。我并不说每一个青年必须看这两部书，也不是说每一个青年只要看这两部书，也并不是说我只有这两部书想推荐。大概报纸副刊的编辑，想借此添一点新花样，而填写者也大都是偶然觉得有什么书不妨看看，就随手写下了。早知这一写竟会闯出这样大的文字纠纷来，即使《大晚报》副刊编者崔万秋先生给我磕头我也不肯写的。今天看见《涛声》第四十期上有一封曹聚仁先生给我的信，最后一句是：“没有比这两部书更有利于青年了吗？敢问。”这一问真问得我啼笑皆非了。（曹聚仁先生的信态度很真挚，我将有一封复信给他，也许他会得刊在《涛声》上，我希望你看一看。）
Regarding the issue of "Zhuangzi and Anthology", I never want to say anything again. Originally, when I filled out the form sent by the editorial office of the "Evening News", it was not as serious as Mr. Feng's opinion suggested. I am not saying that every young person must read these two books, nor that every young person only needs to read these two books, nor that I only want to recommend these two books. Probably the editors of newspaper supplements want to add a little new trick to this, and most of the people who fill in it accidentally think that there are books that they might as well read, so they write them down. If I had known that this writing would cause such a big text dispute, even if Mr. Cui Wanqiu, the editor of the supplement of the "Evening News", kowtowed to me, I would not have written it. Today I saw a letter from Mr. Cao Juren to me in the 40th issue of "The Sound of the Waves", the last sentence of which was: "Isn't it more beneficial to young people than these two books?" I dare to ask. This question really made me laugh. (Mr. Cao Juren's letter attitude is very sincere, I will have a reply to him, maybe he will have to be published in "The Sound of the Waves", I hope you will take a look.) ）对于丰之余先生我也不愿再冒犯他，不过对于他在《感旧》（上）那一篇文章里三点另外的话觉得还有一点意见——
I don't want to offend Mr. Feng Zhiyu again, but I have a little opinion about his three other words in the article "Nostalgia for the Past" (Part 1) -（一）丰先生说：“有些新青年可以有旧思想，有些旧形式也可以藏新内容。”是的，新青年尚且可以有旧思想，那么像我这种“遗少之群中的一肢一节”之有旧思想似乎也可以存而不论的了。至于旧形式也可以藏新内容，则似乎写《庄子》那样的古文也不妨，只要看它的内容如何罢了。
(1) Mr. Feng said: "Some new young people can have old ideas, and some old forms can also hide new content. Yes, new young people can still have old ideas, so it seems that old ideas like me can also be left untouched. As for the old form can also hide new content, it seems that it is okay to write an ancient text like "Zhuangzi", as long as it depends on its content.（二）丰先生说不懂我劝青年看《庄子》与《文选》与做了考官以词取士有何分界，这其实是明明有着分界的。前者是以一己的意见供献给青年，接受不接受原在青年的自由；后者却是代表了整个阶级（注：做官的阶级也），几乎是强迫青年全体去填词了。（除非这青年不想做官。）
(2) Mr. Feng said that he didn't understand what the boundary between persuading young people to read "Zhuangzi" and "Anthology" and being an examiner was to use words to select scholars, which was actually a clear boundary. The former is to offer one's own opinions to young people, accepting or not accepting the freedom of the original youth; The latter represents the entire class (note: the class of officials is also the class), and almost forces all young people to fill in the lyrics. (Unless the young man doesn't want to be an official.) ）（三）说鲁迅先生的文章是从《庄子》与《文选》中来的，这确然是滑稽的，我记得我没有说过那样的话。我的文章里举出鲁迅先生来作例，其意只想请不反对青年从古书求得一点文学修养的鲁迅先生来帮帮忙。鲁迅先生虽然一向是劝青年多读外国书的，但这是他以为从外国书中可以训练出思想新锐的青年来；至于像我那样给青年从做文章（或说文学修养）上着想，则鲁迅先生就没有反对青年读古书过。举两个证据来罢：一，“少看中国书，其结果不过不能作文而已。”（见北新版《华盖集》第四页。）这可见鲁迅先生也承认要能作文，该多看中国书了。而这所谓中国书，从上文看来，似乎并不是指的白话文书。二，“我常被询问，要弄文学，应该看什么书？……我以为倘要弄旧的呢，倒不如姑且靠着张之洞的《书目答问》去摸门径去。”（见北新版《而已集》第四十五页。）
(3) It is indeed funny to say that Mr. Lu Xun's article came from "Zhuangzi" and "Selected Works", and I remember that I did not say such a thing. In my article, I will give Mr. Lu Xun as an example, and I just want to ask Mr. Lu Xun, who does not oppose young people seeking a little literary accomplishment from ancient books, to help. Although Mr. Lu Xun has always persuaded young people to read more foreign books, this is because he thinks that young people with new ideas can be trained from foreign books; As for thinking about young people from the perspective of writing articles (or literary accomplishments) like me, Mr. Lu Xun has never objected to young people reading ancient books. Let's give two pieces of evidence: First, "Read less Chinese books, and the result is just that you can't write." (See page 4 of the Beixin edition of "Huagai Collection".) It can be seen that Mr. Lu Xun also admitted that if you want to be able to write, you should read more Chinese books. And this so-called Chinese book, from the above point of view, does not seem to refer to the vernacular document. 2. "I am often asked, what books should I read if I want to get literature?" …… I thought that if I wanted to get an old one, it would be better to rely on Zhang Zhidong's "Bibliographic Q&A" to find the door. (See page 45 of the Beixin edition of "The Collection".) ）现在，我想我应该在这里“带住”了，我曾有一封信给《大晚报》副刊的编者，为了尊重丰之余先生的好意，我曾请求允许我换两部书介绍给青年。除了我还写一封信给曹聚仁先生之外，对于这“《庄子》与《文选》”的问题我没有要说的话了。我曾经在《自由谈》的壁上，看过几次的文字争，觉得每次总是愈争愈闹意气，而离本题愈远，甚至到后来有些参加者的动机都是可以怀疑的，我不想使自己不由自主地被卷入漩涡，所以我不再说什么话了。昨晚套了一个现成偈语：
Now, I think I should "stay" here, I once wrote a letter to the editor of the supplement of the "Evening News", in order to respect Mr. Feng Zhiyu's kindness, I asked permission to change two books to introduce to young people. Except for writing a letter to Mr. Cao Juren, I have nothing to say on the issue of "Zhuangzi and Anthology". I once saw several literary disputes on the wall of "Free Talk", and I felt that each time I always became more and more angry, and the farther away from the topic, the more I could doubt the motives of some participants, and I didn't want to be involuntarily involved in the whirlpool, so I didn't say anything anymore. 中国文与中国人

中国文与中国人

中国文与中国人

Chinese and Chinese余铭
Remaining inscriptions最近出版了一本很好的翻译：高本汉著的《中国语和中国文》。高本汉先生是个瑞典人，他的真姓是珂罗倔伦（Karlgren）。他为什么“贵姓”高呢？那无疑的是因为中国化了。他的确对于中国语文学有很大的供献。
A good translation has recently been published: "Chinese and Chinese" by Gao Benhan. Mr. Gobenham is a Swede, and his real name is Karlgren. Why is his "noble surname" high? That is undoubtedly because of Sinicization. He did have a great contribution to Chinese literature.但是，他对于中国人似乎更有研究，因此，他很崇拜文言，崇拜中国字，以为对中国人是不可少的。
However, he seems to have studied Chinese more, so he worships classical Chinese and Chinese characters, believing that they are indispensable to the Chinese.他说：“近来——按高氏这书是一九二三年在伦敦出版的——某几种报纸，曾经试用白话，可是并没有多大的成功；因此也许还要触怒多数定报人，以为这样，就是讽示著他们不能看懂文言报呢！”
He said: "Recently—according to Gao's book, published in London in 1923—some newspapers have tried the vernacular, but with little success; Therefore, it may also anger most of the people who are fixed to be reported, thinking that this is an irony that they cannot understand the classical Chinese newspaper! ”“西洋各国里有许多伶人，在他们表演中，他们几乎随时可以插入许多‘打诨’，也有许多作者，滥引文书；但是大家都认这种是劣等的风味。这在中国恰好相反，正认为高妙的文雅而表示绝艺的地方。”
"There are many performers in Western countries, and in their performances, they can insert a lot of 'jokes' almost at any time, and there are also many authors who quote documents indiscriminately; but everyone thinks this is an inferior flavor. This is exactly the opposite in China, which is considered to be a place where it is considered to be exquisite and elegant. ”中国文的“含混的地方，中国人不但不因之感受了困难，反而愿意养成它。”
The Chinese language "ambiguous place", Chinese not only do not feel difficulties because of it, but are willing to develop it. ”但高先生自己却因此受够了侮辱：“本书的著者和亲爱的中国人谈话，所说给他的，很能完全了解；但是，他们彼此谈话的时候，他几乎一句也不懂。”这自然是那些“亲爱的中国人”在“讽示”他不懂上流社会的话，因为“外国人到了中国来，只要注意一点，他就可以觉得：他自己虽然熟悉了普通人的语言，而对于上流社会的谈话，还是莫名其妙的。”
But Mr. Gao himself had enough of the insults: "The author of this book talked to the dear Chinese, and what was said to him was very understandable; However, when they talked to each other, he hardly understood a word. This is naturally those "dear Chinese" who are "ironic" that he does not understand the words of the upper class, because "when a foreigner comes to China, as long as he pays attention, he can feel that although he is familiar with the language of ordinary people, he is still inexplicable about the conversation of the upper class." ”于是他就说：“中国文字好像一个美丽可爱的贵妇，西洋文字好像一个有用而不美的贱婢。”
So he said: "Chinese characters are like a beautiful and lovely lady, and Western characters are like a useful but not beautiful lowly maid. ”美丽可爱而无用的贵妇的“绝艺”，就在于“插诨”的含混。这使得西洋第一等的学者，至多也不过抵得上中国的普通人，休想爬进上流社会里来。这样，我们“精神上胜利了”。为要保持这种胜利，必须有高妙文雅的字汇，而且要丰富！五四白话运动的“没有多大成功”，原因大抵就在上流社会怕人讽示他们不懂文言。
The "unique art" of the beautiful, cute and useless lady lies in the ambiguity of "interjecting". This makes the first-class scholars in the West at most only worthy of ordinary Chinese people, and they do not want to climb into the upper class. In this way, we "won spiritually". In order to maintain this kind of victory, there must be a wonderful and elegant vocabulary, and it must be rich! The reason why the May Fourth Vernacular Movement "did not have much success" was probably that the upper class was afraid of being ridiculed that they did not understand classical Chinese.虽然，“此亦一是非，彼亦一是非”——我们还是含混些好了。否则，反而要感受困难的。
Although, "this is also right and wrong, and that is also right and wrong" - we should be a little ambiguous. Otherwise, you will have to feel difficult.十月二十五日。
October 25th.

野兽训练法

野兽训练法

野兽训练法

Beast training method余铭
Remaining inscriptions最近还有极有益的讲演，是海京伯马戏团的经理施威德在中华学艺社的三楼上给我们讲“如何训练动物？”可惜我没福参加旁听，只在报上看见一点笔记。但在那里面，就已经够多着警辟的话了——
Recently, there was also a very useful lecture, which was Shi Weide, the manager of Haijingbo Circus, who told us on the third floor of the Chinese Art Club "How to train animals?" "It's a pity that I didn't have the blessing to participate in the audit, and I only saw a few notes in the newspaper. But in it, there are enough warning words -“有人以为野兽可以用武力拳头去对付它，压迫它，那便错了，因为这是从前野蛮人对付野兽的办法，现在训练的方法，便不是这样。”
"Some people think that the beast can use its fists to deal with it and oppress it, but that is wrong, because this is the way barbarians used to deal with beasts, but now the training method is not like this."“现在我们所用的方法，是用爱的力量，获取它们对于人的信任，用爱的力量，温和的心情去感动它们。……”
"The method we use now is to use the power of love to gain their trust in people, and to use the power of love and a gentle mood to move them. ……”这一些话，虽然出自日耳曼人之口，但和我们圣贤的古训，也是十分相合的。用武力拳头去对付，就是所谓“霸道”。然而“以力服人者，非心服也”，所以文明人就得用“王道”，以取得“信任”：“民无信不立”。
Although these words come from the mouths of the Germanic people, they are also very consistent with the ancient teachings of our sages. Using force to deal with it is the so-called "hegemony". However, "those who win people by force are not convinced by their hearts", so civilized people have to use the "royal way" to gain "trust": "the people cannot stand without trust".但是，有了“信任”以后，野兽可要变把戏了——
However, after "trust", the beast is going to change its trick -“教练者在取得它们的信任以后，然后可以从事教练它们了：第一步，可以使它们认清坐的，站的位置；再可以使它们跳浜，站起来……”
"After the coaches have gained their trust, they can then engage in coaching: the first step is to make them recognize where they are sitting and standing; Then you can make them jump and stand up......"训兽之法，通于牧民，所以我们的古之人，也称治民的大人物曰“牧”。然而所“牧”者，牛羊也，比野兽怯弱，因此也就无须乎专靠“信任”，不妨兼用着拳头，这就是冠冕堂皇的“威信”。
The method of training beasts is common to herders, so our ancient people also called the big people who ruled the people "pastor". However, the "shepherds", cattle and sheep, are also weaker than beasts, so there is no need to rely solely on "trust", you might as well use fists, which is the high-sounding "prestige".由“威信”治成的动物，“跳浜，站起来”是不够的，结果非贡献毛角血肉不可，至少是天天挤出奶汁来，——如牛奶，羊奶之流。
Animals cured by "prestige" are not enough to "jump on the beach and stand up", and the result is that they must contribute their hair and horns, at least milk is expressed every day,—— such as milk and goat's milk.然而这是古法，我不觉得也可以包括现代。
However, this is an ancient method, and I don't think it can also include modern methods.施威德讲演之后，听说还有余兴，如“东方大乐”及“踢毽子”等，报上语焉不详，无从知道底细了，否则，我想，恐怕也很有意义。
After Schweed's speech, I heard that there were still after-interests, such as "Oriental Music" and "Kicking the Shuttlecock", etc., and the words in the report were vague, and there was no way to know the details, otherwise, I think, I am afraid it would be very meaningful.十月二十七日。

反刍

ruminate元艮
Yuan Gen关于“《庄子》与《文选》”的议论，有些刊物上早不直接提起应否大家研究这问题，却拉到别的事情上去了。他们是在嘲笑那些反对《文选》的人们自己却曾做古文，看古书。
Regarding the discussion of "Zhuangzi and Anthology", some publications have not directly mentioned whether everyone should study this issue, but they have pulled it on other things. They are laughing at those who oppose the "Anthology" but have written ancient texts and read ancient books.这真利害。大约就是所谓“以子之矛，攻子之盾”罢——对不起，“古书”又来了！
This is really interesting. It's about the so-called "spear of the son, shield of the attack" - sorry, the "ancient book" is here again!不进过牢狱的那里知道牢狱的真相。跟着阔人，或者自己原是阔人，先打电话，然后再去参观的，他只看见狱卒非常和气，犯人还可以用英语自由的谈话。倘要知道得详细，那他一定是先前的狱卒，或者是释放的犯人。自然，他还有恶习，但他教人不要钻进牢狱去的忠告，却比什么名人说模范监狱的教育卫生，如何完备，比穷人的家里好得多等类的话，更其可信的。
Those who have not been in prison know the truth of prison. Following Kuo Ren, or he was originally a Kuo Ren, he called first and then went to visit, only to see that the jailer was very kind, and the prisoner could also talk freely in English. If you want to know in detail, then he must be a former jailer or a prisoner who has been released. Naturally, he still had vices, but his advice not to go to prison was more credible than any famous person who said that the education and hygiene of a model prison were perfect, and that they were much better than the homes of the poor.然而自己沾了牢狱气，据说就不能说牢狱坏，狱卒或囚犯，都是坏人，坏人就不能有好话。只有好人说牢狱好，这才是好话。读过《文选》而说它无用，不如不读《文选》而说它有用的可听。反“反《文选》”的诸君子，自然多是读过的了，但未读的也有，举一个例在这里罢——“《庄子》我四年前虽曾读过，但那时还不能完全读懂……《文选》则我完全没有见过。”然而他结末说，“为了浴盘的水糟了，就连小宝宝也要倒掉，这意思是我们不敢赞同的。”（见《火炬》）他要保护水中的“小宝宝”，可是没有见过“浴盘的水”。
However, if you are stained with prison energy, it is said that you cannot say that the prison is bad, the jailer or prisoner is a bad person, and the bad person cannot have good words. Only good people say that prison is good, and this is a good thing. It is better not to read the "Anthology" and say that it is useless, but not to read the "Anthology" and say that it is useful and audible. Most of the gentlemen who oppose the "anti-"Anthology" have naturally read it, but there are also those who have not read it, for example, here is an example - "Although I read "Zhuangzi" four years ago, I could not fully understand it at that time...... I had never seen "Anthology" at all. However, he concluded, "For the sake of the water in the bathtub, even the baby has to be thrown away, which means we dare not agree." He wanted to protect the "little baby" in the water, but he had never seen the "water in the bathtub".五四运动的时候，保护文言者是说凡做白话文的都会做文言文，所以古文也得读。现在保护古书者是说反对古书的也在看古书，做文言，——可见主张的可笑。永远反刍，自己却不会呕吐，大约真是读透了《庄子》了。
During the May Fourth Movement, those who protected the classical Chinese said that anyone who did vernacular would do classical Chinese, so the ancient Chinese had to be read. Now those who protect ancient books say that those who oppose ancient books are also reading ancient books, and the ,—— of doing classical Chinese shows the ridiculousness of their claims. Always ruminate, but I won't vomit, I have probably read "Zhuangzi" thoroughly.十一月四日。

归厚

归厚

归厚

Gui Hou罗怃
Luo Zhen在洋场上，用一瓶强水去洒他所恨的女人，这事早经绝迹了。用些秽物去洒他所恨的律师，这风气只继续了两个月。最长久的是造了谣言去中伤他们所恨的文人，说这事已有了好几年，我想，是只会少不会多的。
On the foreign field, using a bottle of strong water to sprinkle the woman he hated had long been extinct. Sprinkle some filth on the lawyer he hated, and this trend only lasted for two months. The longest is to create rumors to slander the literati they hate, saying that this has been going on for several years, and I think it will only be less, not more.洋场上原不少闲人，“吃白相饭”尚且可以过活，更何况有时打几圈马将。小妇人的嘁嘁喳喳，又何尝不可以消闲。我就是常看造谣专门杂志之一人，但看的并不是谣言，而是谣言作家的手段，看他有怎样出奇的幻想，怎样别致的描写，怎样险恶的构陷，怎样躲闪的原形。造谣，也要才能的，如果他造得妙，即使造的是我自己的谣言，恐怕我也会爱他的本领。
There are many idlers on the foreign field, and they can still live by "eating white rice", not to mention sometimes playing a few laps of horses. The little woman's chirping is not a way to relax. I am one of the people who often reads magazines specializing in rumor-mongering, but what I read is not rumors, but the methods of rumor writers, to see what kind of surprising fantasies he has, what kind of unique descriptions, what kind of sinister frames, and how he dodges the original form. If he makes it well, even if it is my own rumor, I am afraid I will love his skills.但可惜大抵没有这样的才能，作者在谣言文学上，也还是“滥竽充数”。这并非我个人的私见。讲什么文坛故事的小说不流行，什么外史也不再做下去，可见是人们多已摇头了。讲来讲去总是这几套，纵使记性坏，多听了也会烦厌的。想继续，这时就得要才能；否则，台下走散，应该换一出戏来叫座。
But unfortunately, most of them do not have such talent, and the author is still "indiscriminately filled" in rumor literature. This is not my personal opinion. Novels that tell literary stories are not popular, and no foreign history is anymore, which shows that most people have shaken their heads. Talking about these sets, even if you have a bad memory, you will get bored if you listen to it more. If you want to continue, you have to be talented; Otherwise, the audience will be separated and should be replaced with a play to call the seats.譬如罢，先前演的是《杀子报》罢，这回就须是《三娘教子》，“老东人呀，唉，唉，唉！”
For example, the previous performance was "Killing the Son", but this time it must be "Sanniang Godson", "Old Eastern, alas, alas, alas! ”而文场实在也如戏场，果然已经渐渐的“民德归厚”了，有的还至于自行声明，更换办事人，说是先前“揭载作家秘史，虽为文坛佳话，然亦有伤忠厚。以后本刊停登此项稿件。……以前言责，……概不负责。”（见《微言》）为了“忠厚”而牺牲“佳话”，虽可惜，却也可敬的。
And the literary field is really like a theater, and sure enough, it has gradually "returned to the people's morality", and some even declared themselves and changed the clerk, saying that it was before "revealing the secret history of the writer, although it is a good story in the literary world, but it is also hurtful and loyal." This manuscript will be stopped in the future. …… Previous criticism,...... Not responsible. (See "Weiyan") Sacrificing "good stories" for the sake of "loyalty" is a pity, but it is also respectable.尤其可敬的是更换办事人。这并非敬他的“概不负责”，而是敬他的彻底。古时候虽有“放下屠刀，立地成佛”的人，但因为也有“放下官印，立地念佛”而终于又“放下念珠，立地做官”的人，这一种玩意儿，实在已不足以昭大信于天下：令人办事有点为难了。
What is particularly respectable is the change of clerks. This is not "not responsible" for respecting him, but respecting him thoroughly. Although there were people who "put down the butcher's knife and became a Buddha" in ancient times, because there were also people who "put down the official seal and chant the Buddha" and finally "put down the prayer beads and become an official", this kind of thing is really not enough to show the faith of the world: it is a bit difficult for people to do things.不过，尤其为难的是忠厚文学远不如谣言文学之易于号召读者，所以须有才能更大的作家，如果一时不易搜求，那刊物就要减色。我想，还不如就用先前打诨的二丑挂了长须来唱老生戏，那么，暂时之间倒也特别而有趣的。
However, what is particularly difficult is that loyal literature is far less than rumor literature that is easy to appeal to readers, so there must be more talented writers. I think it would be better to use the two ugly people who joked before to sing the old drama, then it will be special and interesting for the time being.十一月四日。

难得糊涂

难得糊涂

难得糊涂

It's hard to be confused子明
His son was named Ming因为有人谈起写篆字，我倒记起郑板桥有一块图章，刻着“难得糊涂”。那四个篆字刻得叉手叉脚的，颇能表现一点名士的牢骚气。足见刻图章写篆字也还反映着一定的风格，正像“玩”木刻之类，未必“只是个人的事情”：“谬种”和“妖孽”就是写起篆字来，也带着些“妖谬”的。
Because someone talked about writing seal characters, I remembered that Zheng Banqiao had a stamp engraved with "rare confusion". The four seal characters are engraved with crossed hands and feet, which can quite express a little of the complaint of celebrities. It can be seen that the writing of seal characters also reflects a certain style, just like "playing" woodcuts, which may not be "just a personal matter": "false species" and "demon" are written in seal characters, and they also carry some "demonic fallacies".然而风格和情绪，倾向之类，不但因人而异，而且因事而异，因时而异。郑板桥说“难得糊涂”，其实他还能够糊涂的。现在，到了“求仕不获无足悲，求隐而不得其地以窜者，毋亦天下之至哀欤”的时代，却实在求糊涂而不可得了。
However, styles, moods, tendencies, etc., not only vary from person to person, but also from event to event and from time to time. Zheng Banqiao said that it was "rare to be confused", but in fact, he could still be confused. Now, in the era of "there is no sadness in seeking an official position, and those who seek seclusion and cannot escape to the right place are the saddest in the world", but it is really confusing and unattainable.糊涂主义，唯无是非观等等——本来是中国的高尚道德。你说他是解脱，达观罢，也未必。他其实在固执着，坚持着什么，例如道德上的正统，文学上的正宗之类。这终于说出来了：——道德要孔孟加上“佛家报应之说”（老庄另帐登记），而说别人“鄙薄”佛教影响就是“想为儒家争正统”，原来同善社的三教同源论早已是正统了。文学呢？要用生涩字，用词藻，秾纤的作品，而且是新文学的作品，虽则他“否认新文学和旧文学的分界”；而大众文学“固然赞成”，“但那是文学中的一个旁支”。正统和正宗，是明显的。
Confusingism, only the view of right and wrong, etc. - it was originally China's noble morality. You say he is liberated, and he is a master, but it may not be. He is actually stubborn and insists on something, such as moral orthodoxy, literary authenticity, etc. This finally came out: - morality requires Confucius and Mencius to add the "Buddhist theory of retribution" (Lao Zhuang registered separately), and to say that others "despise" the influence of Buddhism is to "want to fight for Confucianism". What about literature? It is necessary to use jerky words, use words, and slender works, and they are works of new literature, although he "denies the boundary between new literature and old literature"; Popular literature "certainly agrees", "but it is a side branch in literature". Orthodoxy and authenticity, are obvious.对于人生的倦怠并不糊涂！活的生活已经那么“穷乏”，要请青年在“佛家报应之说”，在“《文选》，《庄子》，《论语》，《孟子》”里去求得修养。后来，修养又不见了，只剩得字汇。“自然景物，个人情感，宫室建筑，……之类，还不妨从《文选》之类的书中去找来用。”从前严几道从甚么古书里——大概也是《庄子》罢——找着了“幺匿”两个字来译Unit，又古雅，又音义双关的。但是后来通行的却是“单位”。严老先生的这类“字汇”很多，大抵无法复活转来。现在却有人以为“汉以后的词，秦以前的字，西方文化所带来的字和词，可以拼成功我们的光芒的新文学”。这光芒要是只在字和词，那大概像古墓里的贵妇人似的，满身都是珠光宝气了。人生却不在拼凑，而在创造，几千百万的活人在创造。可恨的是人生那么骚扰忙乱，使一些人“不得其地以窜”，想要逃进字和词里去，以求“庶免是非”，然而又不可得。真要写篆字刻图章了！
There is no confusion about burnout in life! Life is already so "poor", and young people should be invited to seek self-cultivation in the "Buddhist Theory of Retribution" and in "Anthology", "Zhuangzi", "Analects", and "Mencius". Later, the cultivation disappeared again, leaving only the vocabulary. "Natural scenery, personal emotions, palace architecture,...... You might as well find it from books such as "Anthology". In the past, Yan Jidao found the word "Yao Ni" in some ancient book - probably "Zhuangzi" - to translate Unit, which is quaint and pun. But later it was the "unit" that was popular. Mr. Yan Lao has a lot of such "vocabulary", and it is probably impossible to resurrect it. Now some people think that "the words after the Han Dynasty, the words before the Qin Dynasty, and the words and words brought by Western culture can spell out the new literature of our light". If this light was only in words and words, it would probably be like a noble lady in an ancient tomb, full of pearls. Life is not piecing together, but creating, and tens of millions of living people are creating. What is hateful is that life is so harassing and chaotic, so that some people "run away" and want to escape into words and words in order to "avoid right and wrong", but it is not possible. I really want to write seal letters and engrave stamps!十一月六日。

古书中寻活字汇

古书中寻活字汇

古书中寻活字汇

Find a living word in ancient books罗怃
Luo Zhen古书中寻活字汇，是说得出，做不到的，他在那古书中，寻不出一个活字汇。
Looking for a living word in an ancient book can be said, but it can't be done, and he can't find a living word in that ancient book.假如有“可看《文选》的青年”在这里，就是高中学生中的几个罢，他翻开《文选》来，一心要寻活字汇，当然明知道那里面有些字是已经死了的。然而他怎样分别那些字的死活呢？大概只能以自己的懂不懂为标准。但是，看了六臣注之后才懂的字不能算，因为这原是死尸，由六臣背进他脑里，这才算是活人的，在他脑里即使复活了，在未“可看《文选》的青年”的眼前却还是死家伙。所以他必须看白文。
If there is a "young man who can read the Anthology" here, it is just a few of the high school students, and he opens the "Anthology" and is bent on looking for a living word, of course, knowing that some of the words in it are dead. But how does he distinguish between life and death of those words? Probably only based on whether you understand it or not. However, the words that I understood after reading the comments of the six ministers cannot be counted, because this was originally a dead corpse, carried into his mind by the six ministers, and this is considered a living person, and even if he is resurrected in his mind, he is still a dead guy in front of the eyes of the "young man who can read the "Anthology". So he had to read the white text.诚然，不看注，也有懂得的，这就是活字汇。然而他怎会先就懂得的呢？这一定是曾经在别的书上看见过，或是到现在还在应用的字汇，所以他懂得。那么，从一部《文选》里，又寻到了什么？
It is true that if you don't look at the notes, there are also people who understand, this is a movable word collection. But how could he understand it first? This must be a vocabulary that he has seen in other books or is still using to this day, so he understands. So, what else was found in a "Selected Works"?然而施先生说，要描写宫殿之类的时候有用处。这很不错，《文选》里有许多赋是讲到宫殿的，并且有什么殿的专赋。倘有青年要做汉晋的历史小说，描写那时的宫殿，找《文选》是极应该的，还非看“四史”《晋书》之类不可。然而所取的僻字也不过将死尸抬出来，说得神秘点便名之曰“复活”。如果要描写的是清故宫，那可和《文选》的瓜葛就极少了。
However, Mr. Shi said that it is useful when describing palaces and the like. This is very good, there are many poems in the "Anthology" that talk about the palace, and what kind of palace is the special fu. If a young man wants to make a historical novel of the Han and Jin dynasties, describing the palace at that time, it is very appropriate to look for the "Anthology", and he must read the "Four Histories" and "Book of Jin". However, the rare word taken is only to carry out the dead body, and to put it mysteriously, it is called "resurrection". If you want to describe the Qing Forbidden City, it has very little to do with the "Anthology".倘使连清故宫也不想描写，而豫备工夫却用得这么广泛，那实在是徒劳而仍不足。因为还有《易经》和《仪礼》，里面的字汇，在描写周朝的卜课和婚丧大事时候是有用处的，也得作为“文学修养之根基”，这才更像“文学青年”的样子。
If even the Qing Forbidden City does not want to describe, but the preparation work is used so extensively, it is really futile and still insufficient. Because there are also "I Ching" and "Ritual Rites", the vocabulary in them is useful when describing the divination classes and wedding and funeral events of the Zhou Dynasty, and it must also be used as the "foundation of literary accomplishment", which is more like a "literary youth".十一月六日。

“商定”文豪

“商定”文豪

“商定”文豪

"Agreed" on the literary master白在宣
White is in Xuan笔头也是尖的，也要钻。言路的窄，现在也正如活路一样，所以（以上十五字，刊出时作“别的地方钻不进，”）只好对于文艺杂志广告的夸大，前去刺一下。
The pen tip is also pointed, and it must also be drilled. The narrowness of the way of speech is now like the way to live, so (the above fifteen words, when published, it was written as "I can't get in anywhere else,") I had to go and stab the exaggeration of literary and art magazine advertisements.一看杂志的广告，作者就个个是文豪，中国文坛也真好像光焰万丈，但一面也招来了鼻孔里的哼哼声。然而，著作一世，藏之名山，以待考古团的掘出的作家，此刻早已没有了，连自作自刻，订成薄薄的一本，分送朋友的诗人，也已经不大遇得到。现在是前周作稿，次周登报，上月剪贴，下月出书，大抵仅仅为稿费。倘说，作者是饿着肚子，专心在为社会服务，恐怕说出来有点要脸红罢。就是笑人需要稿费的高士，他那一篇嘲笑的文章也还是不免要稿费。但自然，另有薪水，或者能靠女人奁资养活的文豪，都不属于这一类。
As soon as I looked at the advertisements in the magazine, the authors were all literary heroes, and the Chinese literary world really seemed to be full of flames, but on the other hand, it also attracted a hum in the nostrils. However, the writers who wrote a lifetime, hidden in famous mountains, and waiting for the archaeological team to dig up are long gone at this moment, and even poets who made their own carvings, ordered a thin book, and distributed them to friends are no longer available. Now I write a manuscript last week, publish it in the newspaper the next week, cut and paste it last month, and publish a book next month, which is probably just a manuscript fee. If the author is hungry and concentrating on serving the society, I am afraid that he will blush a little when he says it. Even Coats who laughs at people needs manuscript fees, and his ridiculous articles still inevitably require manuscript fees. But naturally, writers who have a salary or can rely on women's dowry do not belong to this category.就大体而言，根子是在卖钱，所以上海的各式各样的文豪，由于“商定”，是“久已夫，已非一日矣”的了。
Generally speaking, the root is selling money, so all kinds of literary heroes in Shanghai, due to "agreement", are "long gone, not a day".商家印好一种稿子后，倘那时封建得势，广告上就说作者是封建文豪，革命行时，便是革命文豪，于是封定了一批文豪们。别家的书也印出来了，另一种广告说那些作者并非真封建或真革命文豪，这边的才是真货色，于是又封定了一批文豪们。别一家又集印了各种广告的论战，一位作者加上些批评，另出了一位新文豪。
After the merchant printed a manuscript, if the feudal power was in power at that time, the advertisement said that the author was a feudal writer, and when the revolution was in place, he was a revolutionary writer, so a group of writers were sealed. Other books were also printed, and another advertisement said that those authors were not real feudal or true revolutionary writers, and that the ones here were the real ones, so a group of writers were sealed. Another family collected and printed various advertisements in a debate, one author added some criticism, and another new writer came out.还有一法是结合一套脚色，要几个诗人，几个小说家，一个批评家，商量一下，立一个什么社，登起广告来，打倒彼文豪，抬出此文豪，结果也总可以封定一批文豪们，也是一种的“商定”。
Another method is to combine a set of characters, ask a few poets, a few novelists, and a critic to discuss, set up a society, put up an advertisement, overthrow the other writer, and carry out this writer, and the result can always seal a group of writers, which is also a kind of "agreement".就大体而言，根子是在卖钱，所以后来的书价，就不免指出文豪们的真价值，照价二折，五角一堆，也说不定的。不过有一种例外：虽然铺子出盘，作品贱卖，却并不是文豪们走了末路，那是他们已经“爬了上去”，进大学，进衙门，不要这踏脚凳了。
Generally speaking, the root is selling money, so the later book prices inevitably point out the true value of the writers. However, there is an exception: although the shop is out of the market and the works are sold cheaply, it is not that the writers have come to an end, that is, they have "climbed up", entered the university, entered the yamen, and did not want this stepstool.十一月七日。
November 7th.

青年与老子

青年与老子

青年与老子

青年与老子敬一尊
敬一尊听说，“慨自欧风东渐以来”，中国的道德就变坏了，尤其是近时的青年，往往看不起老子。这恐怕真是一个大错误，因为我看了几个例子，觉得老子的对于青年，有时确也很有用处，很有益处，不仅足为“文学修养”之助的。
I heard that "since the European wind has gradually moved east", China's morality has deteriorated, especially young people in recent times, who often look down on Lao Tzu. This is probably a big mistake, because I have seen a few examples and feel that Lao Tzu's is sometimes very useful and beneficial for young people, not only enough to help with "literary accomplishment".有一篇旧文章——我忘记了出于什么书里的了——告诉我们，曾有一个道士，有长生不老之术，自说已经百余岁了，看去却“美如冠玉”，像二十左右一样。有一天，这位活神仙正在大宴阔客，突然来了一个须发都白的老头子，向他要钱用，他把他骂出去了。大家正惊疑间，那活神仙慨然的说道，“那是我的小儿，他不听我的话，不肯修道，现在你们看，不到六十，就老得那么不成样子了。”大家自然是很感动的，但到后来，终于知道了那人其实倒是道士的老子。
There is an old article - I forgot what book it came from - tells us that there was once a Taoist priest who had the art of immortality and said that he was more than a hundred years old, but he looked "as beautiful as a crown of jade", like a twenty-something man. One day, the living immortal was feasting on guests when suddenly an old man with white hair and beard came and asked him for money, and he scolded him out. While everyone was suspicious, the living immortal said with emotion, "That's my child, he didn't listen to me, he refused to practice Taoism, and now you see, before sixty, he is so old." Naturally, everyone was very moved, but later, they finally learned that the man was actually a Taoist priest.还有一篇新文章——杨某的自白——却告诉我们，他是一个有志之士，学说是很正确的，不但讲空话，而且去实行，但待到看见有些地方的老头儿苦得不像样，就想起自己的老子来，即使他的理想实现了，也不能使他的父亲做老太爷，仍旧要吃苦。于是得到了更正确的学说，抛去原有的理想，改做孝子了。假使父母早死，学说那有这么圆满而堂皇呢？这不也就是老子对于青年的益处么？
There is also a new article - Yang's confession - but tells us that he is a man of lofty ideals, and his doctrine is very correct, not only speaking empty words, but also practicing them, but when he sees that the old man in some places is not decent, he thinks of his own old man, even if his ideal is realized, he cannot make his father an old lady, and he still has to endure hardships. So he got a more correct doctrine, abandoned his original ideals, and changed to a filial son. If the parents died early, how could the doctrine be so complete and magnificent? Isn't this Lao Tzu's benefit to young people?那么，早已死了老子的青年不是就没有法子么？我以为不然，也有法子想。这还是要查旧书。另有一篇文章——我也忘了出在什么书里的了——告诉我们，一个老女人在讨饭，忽然来了一位大阔人，说她是自己的久经失散了的母亲，她也将错就错，做了老太太。后来她的儿子要嫁女儿，和老太太同到首饰店去买金器，将老太太已经看中意的东西自己带去给太太看一看，一面请老太太还在拣，——可是，他从此就不见了。
So, isn't there no way for the young man who has long died? I don't think so, but there are ways to think about it. This still has to look up old books. Another article—I forgot what book it was in—tells us that an old woman was begging for food, and suddenly a big man came, saying that she was his long-lost mother, and that she would also be wrong and become an old lady. Later, her son was going to marry his daughter, and he went to the jewelry store with the old lady to buy gold, and took the things that the old lady had already liked to show his wife, while asking the old lady to still choose,—— but he has never been seen since.不过，这还是学那道士似的，必须实物时候的办法，如果单是做做自白之类，那是实在有无老子，倒并没有什么大关系的。先前有人提倡过“虚君共和”，现在又何妨有“没亲孝子”？张宗昌很尊孔，恐怕他府上也未必有“四书”“五经”罢。
However, this is still like learning from that Taoist priest, it must be a method when the real thing, if it is just a confession or the like, it really has nothing to do with Lao Tzu or not. Some people have advocated a "virtual republic" before, but now why not have "no filial son"? Zhang Zongchang respects Confucius very much, and I am afraid that he may not have the "Four Books" and "Five Classics" in his house.十一月七日。

后记

postscript这六十多篇杂文，是受了压迫之后，从去年六月起，另用各种的笔名，障住了编辑先生和检查老爷的眼睛，陆续在《自由谈》上发表的。不久就又蒙一些很有“灵感”的“文学家”吹嘘，有无法隐瞒之势，虽然他们的根据嗅觉的判断，有时也并不和事实相符。但不善于改悔的人，究竟也躲闪不到那里去，于是不及半年，就得着更厉害的压迫了，敷衍到十一月初，只好停笔，证明了我的笔墨，实在敌不过那些带着假面，从指挥刀下挺身而出的英雄。
These more than 60 essays were published in "Free Talk" one after another after being oppressed, using various pseudonyms since June last year, blocking the eyes of the editor and the inspector. Soon it was boasted by some very "inspired" "writers" that it could not be hidden, although their judgment based on the sense of smell sometimes did not match the facts. But those who are not good at repentance can't dodge there, so in less than half a year, they were even more oppressed, and they had to stop writing until the beginning of November, proving that my pen and ink are really no match for those heroes who stand up from under the command knife with masks.不做文章，就整理旧稿，在年底里，粘成了一本书，将那时被人删削或不能发表的，也都添进去了，看起分量来，倒比这以前的《伪自由书》要多一点。今年三月间，才想付印，做了一篇序，慢慢的排，校，不觉又过了半年，回想离停笔的时候，已是一年有余了，时光真是飞快，但我所怕的，倒是我的杂文还好像说着现在或甚而至于明年。
At the end of the year, he glued it into a book, and added all the things that were deleted or could not be published at that time. In March of this year, I just wanted to print it, made a preface, slowly arranged it, proofread, and unconsciously another half year passed, looking back on the time when I stopped writing, it was already more than a year, time really flies, but what I am afraid of is that my essays still seem to be talking about now or even next year.
记得《伪自由书》出版的时候，《社会新闻》曾经有过一篇批评，说我的所以印行那一本书的本意，完全是为了一条尾巴——《后记》。这其实是误解的。我的杂文，所写的常是一鼻，一嘴，一毛，但合起来，已几乎是或一形象的全体，不加什么原也过得去的了。但画上一条尾巴，却见得更加完全。所以我的要写后记，除了我是弄笔的人，总要动笔之外，只在要这一本书里所画的形象，更成为完全的一个具象，却不是“完全为了一条尾巴”。
I remember that when the "Pseudo-Freedom Book" was published, there was a criticism in the "Social News", saying that my original intention of printing that book was entirely for the sake of a tail - "Afterword". This is actually a misunderstanding. My essays are often written with a nose, a mouth, and a hair, but when combined, they are almost the whole of an image, and it is passable without adding anything. But drawing a tail makes it more complete. So I want to write an afterword, except that I am a person who makes a pen and always has to start writing, but I only want the image drawn in this book to become a complete concrete, but not "completely for a tail".内容也还和先前一样，批评些社会的现象，尤其是文坛的情形。因为笔名改得勤，开初倒还平安无事。然而“江山好改，秉性难移”，我知道自己终于不能安分守己。《序的解放》碰着了曾今可，《豪语的折扣》又触犯了张资平，此外在不知不觉之中得罪了一些别的什么伟人，我还自己不知道。但是，待到做了《各种捐班》和《登龙术拾遗》以后，这案件可就闹大了。
The content is also the same as before, criticizing some social phenomena, especially the situation in the literary world. Because the pen name was changed diligently, it was safe at the beginning. However, "the country is easy to change, and the temperament is difficult to change", and I know that I finally can't keep to myself. "The Liberation of the Preface" met Zeng Jinke, and "The Discount of the Heroic Language" offended Zhang Ziping, and unknowingly offended some other great people, I don't know myself. However, after doing "Various Donation Classes" and "Dragon Technique Collection", the case became bigger.
去年八月间，诗人邵洵美先生所经营的书店里，出了一种《十日谈》，这位诗人在第二期（二十日出）上，飘飘然的论起“文人无行”来了，先分文人为五类，然后作结道——
In August last year, in the bookstore run by the poet Mr. Shao Xunmei, a kind of "Decameron" was published, and the poet talked about "literati without virtue" in the second issue (20th of the 20th), first dividing literati into five categories, and then making a conclusion -除了上述五类外，当然还有许多其他的典型；但其所以为文人之故，总是因为没有饭吃，或是有了饭吃不饱。因为做文人不比做官或是做生意，究竟用不到多少本钱。一枝笔，一些墨，几张稿纸，便是你所要预备的一切。呒本钱生意，人人想做，所以文人便多了。此乃是没有职业才做文人的事实。
In addition to the above five categories, there are of course many other typical; But the reason why he is a literati is always because he has no food to eat, or he can't eat enough. Because being a literati is not as good as being an official or doing business, it doesn't take much capital. A pen, some ink, and a few sheets of manuscript paper are all you need to prepare. Everyone wants to do capital business, so there are more literati. This is the fact that there is no profession to be a literati.我们的文坛便是由这种文人组织成的。
Our literary world is organized by this kind of literati.因为他们是没有职业才做文人，因此他们的目的仍在职业而不在文人。他们借着文艺宴会的名义极力地拉拢大人物；借文艺杂志或是副刊的地盘，极力地为自己做广告：但求闻达，不顾羞耻。
Because they are literati without a profession, their purpose is still a profession and not a literati. They tried their best to win over big people in the name of literary banquets; Borrow the territory of literary magazines or supplements to advertise yourself as much as possible: but seek fame and disregard shame.谁知既为文人矣，便将被目为文人；既被目为文人矣，便再没有职业可得，这般东西便永远在文坛里胡闹。
谁知既为文人矣，便将被目为文人；既被目为文人矣，便再没有职业可得，这般东西便永远在文坛里胡闹。文人的确穷的多，自从迫压言论和创作以来，有些作者也的确更没有饭吃了。而邵洵美先生是所谓“诗人”，又是有名的巨富“盛宫保”的孙婿，将污秽泼在“这般东西”的头上，原也十分平常的。但我以为作文人究竟和“大出丧”有些不同，即使雇得一大群帮闲，开锣喝道，过后仍是一条空街，还不及“大出丧”的虽在数十年后，有时还有几个市侩传颂。穷极，文是不能工的，可是金银又并非文章的根苗，它最好还是买长江沿岸的田地。然而富家儿总不免常常误解，以为钱可使鬼，就也可以通文。使鬼，大概是确的，也许还可以通神，但通文却不成，诗人邵洵美先生本身的诗便是证据。我那两篇中的有一段，便是说明官可捐，文人不可捐，有裙带官儿，却没有裙带文人的。
Literati are indeed poorer, and since the suppression of speech and creation, some authors have indeed had no food to eat. And Mr. Shao Xunmei is the so-called "poet" and the grandson-in-law of the famous "Sheng Gongbao", and it is very common to splash filth on the head of "such a thing". But I think that the composer is a little different from the "big funeral", even if a large group of helpers are hired and the gong is shouted, it is still an empty street after that, and it is not as good as the "big funeral" Although decades later, there are sometimes a few philistines who praise it. Extremely poor, the article cannot work, but gold and silver are not the roots of the article, it is better to buy the fields along the Yangtze River. However, rich people often misunderstand, thinking that money can make ghosts, and they can also understand literature. It is probably true that it can communicate with spirits, but it is not possible to communicate with the poet, and the poem of the poet Mr. Shao Xunmei itself is the evidence. One of my two articles is that officials can donate, literati cannot donate, there are nepotism officials, but there are nepotism literati.然而，帮手立刻出现了，还出在堂堂的《中央日报》（九月四日及六日）上——
However, helpers appeared immediately, and in the dignified "Central Daily" (September 4 and 6) -女婿问题
son-in-law problem如是
so最近的《自由谈》上，有两篇文章都是谈到女婿的，一篇是孙用的《满意和写不出》，一篇是苇索的《登龙术拾遗》。后一篇九月一日刊出，前一篇则不在手头，刊出日期大约在八月下旬。
In the recent "Free Talk", there are two articles about sons-in-law, one is Sun Yong's "Satisfaction and Can't Write", and the other is Wei Suo's "Climbing the Dragon Technique". The last one was published on September 1st, and the previous one was not at hand, and the publication date was about late August.苇索先生说：“文坛虽然不致于要招女婿，但女婿却是会要上文坛的。”后一句“女婿却是会要上文坛的”，立论十分牢靠，无瑕可击。我们的祖父是人家的女婿，我们的父亲也是人家的女婿，我们自己，也仍然不免是人家的女婿。比如今日在文坛上“北面”而坐的鲁迅茅盾之流，都是人家的女婿，所以“女婿会要上文坛的”是不成问题的，至于前一句“文坛虽然不致于要招女婿”，这句话就简直站不住了。我觉得文坛无时无刻不在招女婿，许多中国作家现在都变成了俄国的女婿了。
Mr. Wei Suo said: "Although the literary world does not want to recruit a son-in-law, the son-in-law will go to the literary world. The latter sentence "The son-in-law will go to the literary world" is very solid and flawless. Our grandfather is someone else's son-in-law, our father is also someone else's son-in-law, and we ourselves are still someone else's son-in-law. For example, Lu Xun and Mao Dun, who are sitting "in the north" in the literary world today, are all sons-in-law, so "the son-in-law will go to the literary world" is not a problem, as for the previous sentence "Although the literary world does not want to recruit a son-in-law", this sentence is simply untenable. I think the literary world is recruiting sons-in-law all the time, and many Chinese writers have now become sons-in-law in Russia.又说：“有富岳家，有阔太太，用赔嫁钱，作文学资本，……”能用妻子的赔嫁钱来作文学资本，我觉得这种人应该佩服，因为用妻子的钱来作文学资本，总比用妻子的钱来作其他一切不正当的事情好一些。况且凡事必须有资本，文学也不能例外，如没有钱，便无从付印刷费，则杂志及集子都出不成，所以要办书店，出杂志，都得是大家拿一些私蓄出来，妻子的钱自然也是私蓄之一。况且做一个富家的女婿并非罪恶，正如做一个报馆老板的亲戚之并非罪恶为一样，如其一个报馆老板的亲戚，回国后游荡无事，可以依靠亲戚的牌头，夺一个副刊来编编，则一个富家的女婿，因为兴趣所近，用些妻子的赔嫁钱来作文学资本，当然也无不可。
He also said: "There is a rich family, there is a wide wife, and the dowry money is used as literary capital,...... "I think this kind of person should be admired, because it is better to use the wife's money as literary capital than to use the wife's money to do all other improper things." If there is no money, there is no way to pay for printing, then magazines and collections cannot be published, so if you want to open a bookstore and publish a magazine, you have to take out some private savings, and the wife's money is naturally one of the private savings. Moreover, being a son-in-law of a rich family is not a sin, just as being a relative of a newspaper owner is not a sin, such as a relative of a newspaper owner, who wanders around after returning to China, can rely on his relatives' card heads to grab a supplement to compile, then a son-in-law of a rich family, because of his close interests, uses some of his wife's dowry money as literary capital, of course.“女婿”的蔓延
The spread of "son-in-law"圣闲
Saint leisure狐狸吃不到葡萄，说葡萄是酸的，自己娶不到富妻子，于是对于一切有富岳家的人发生了妒忌，妒忌的结果是攻击。
The fox couldn't eat grapes, saying that grapes were sour, and he couldn't marry a rich wife, so he became jealous of everyone who had a rich family, and the result of jealousy was an attack.假如做了人家的女婿，是不是还可以做文人的呢？答案自然是属于正面的，正如前天如是先生在本园上他的一篇《女婿问题》里说过，今日在文坛上最有声色的鲁迅茅盾之流，一方面身为文人，一方面仍然不免是人家的女婿，不过既然做文人同时也可以做人家的女婿，则此女婿是应该属于穷岳家的呢，还是属于富岳家的呢？关于此层，似乎那些老牌作家，尚未出而主张，不知究竟应该“富倾”还是“穷倾”才对，可是《自由谈》之流的撰稿人，既经对于富岳家的女婿取攻击态度，则我们感到，好像至少做富岳家的女婿的似乎不该再跨上这个文坛了，“富岳家的女婿”和“文人”仿佛是冲突的，二者只可任择其一。
If you become someone else's son-in-law, can you still be a literati? The answer is naturally positive, as Mr. Ru said in his "Son-in-law Problem" in this garden the day before yesterday, the most famous Lu Xun and Mao Dun in the literary world today, on the one hand, are literati, on the other hand, they are still the son-in-law of others, but since they can also be the son-in-law of others at the same time, should this son-in-law belong to the poor Yue family, or to the rich Yue family? Regarding this layer, it seems that those veteran writers have not yet come out to advocate whether they should be "rich" or "poor", but the writers of "Free Talk", after taking an attack on the son-in-law of the Fuyue family, we feel that at least those who are the sons-in-law of the Fuyue family should no longer step into this literary world, and the "son-in-law of the Fuyue family" and "literati" seem to be in conflict, and the two can only choose one of them.目下中国文坛似乎有这样一个现象，不必检查一个文人他本身在文坛上的努力的成绩，而唯斤斤于追究那个文人的家庭琐事，如是否有富妻子或穷妻子之类。要是你今天开了一家书店，则这家书店的本钱，是否出乎你妻子的赔嫁钱，也颇劳一些尖眼文人，来调查打听，以此或作攻击讥讽。
At present, there seems to be a phenomenon in the Chinese literary world, there is no need to check the achievements of a literati in the literary world, but only to investigate the family trivialities of the literati, such as whether he has a rich wife or a poor wife. If you open a bookstore today, whether the capital of this bookstore is more than your wife's dowry money, it also takes a lot of sharp-eyed literati to investigate and inquire, so as to attack and ridicule.我想将来中国的文坛，一定还会进步到有下种情形：穿陈嘉庚橡皮鞋者，方得上文坛，如穿皮鞋，便属贵族阶级，而入于被攻击之列了。
I think that in the future, China's literary world will definitely progress to the following situation: those who wear Chen Jiageng's rubber shoes can enter the literary world, and if they wear leather shoes, they belong to the aristocratic class and are among the attacked.现在外国回来的留学生失业的多得很。回国以后编一个副刊也并非一件羞耻事情，编那个副刊，是否因亲戚关系，更不成问题，亲戚的作用，本来就在这种地方。自命以扫除文坛为己任的人，如其人家偶而提到一两句自己的不愿意听的话，便要成群结队的来反攻，大可不必。如其常常骂人家为狂吠的，则自己切不可也落入于狂吠之列。
Now many international students who have returned from abroad are unemployed. It is not a shame to write a supplement after returning to China, and it is not a question of whether it is because of relatives, and the role of relatives is originally in this kind of place. People who claim to be sweeping away the literary world, if they occasionally mention one or two words they don't want to listen to, they will come to counterattack in droves, which is not necessary. If he often scolds others as barking, he must not fall into the ranks of barking.这两位作者都是富家女婿崇拜家，但如是先生是凡庸的，背出了他的祖父，父亲，鲁迅，茅盾之后，结果不过说着“鲁迅拿卢布”那样的滥调；打诨的高手要推圣闲先生，他竟拉到我万想不到的诗人太太的味道上去了。戏剧上的二丑帮忙，倒使花花公子格外出丑，用的便是这样的说法，我后来也引在《“滑稽”例解》中。
Both of these authors are rich sons-in-law worshipers, but Mr. Ru is mediocre, and after reciting his grandfather, father, Lu Xun, and Mao Dun, the result is just a cliché like "Lu Xun takes rubles"; The master of jokes wanted to push Mr. Shengxian, and he actually pulled the taste of a poet's wife that I could never have imagined. The help of the two ugly in the drama made the playboy particularly ugly, and this is the saying, which I later quoted in "Funny" Examples".但邵府上也有恶辣的谋士的。今年二月，我给日本的《改造》杂志做了三篇短论，是讥评中国，日本，满洲的。邵家将却以为“这回是得之矣”了。就在也是这甜葡萄棚里产生出来的《人言》（三月三日出）上，扮出一个译者和编者来，译者算是只译了其中的一篇《谈监狱》，投给了《人言》，并且前有“附白”，后有“识”——
But there are also vicious advisors in the Shao Mansion. In February of this year, I wrote three short articles for Japan's "Transformation" magazine, which were ridiculing China, Japan, and Manchuria. The Shao family general thought that "this time he got it". On "Human Words" (published on March 3rd), which was also produced in this sweet grape shed, a translator and editor were pretended to be translated, and the translator only translated one of them, "Talking about Prison", and voted for "Human Words", and there was "attached white" in front and "knowledge" in the back——
谈监狱
Talk about prisons鲁迅
Lu Xun
（顷阅日文杂志《改造》三月号，见载有我们文坛老将鲁迅翁之杂文三篇，比较翁以中国文发表之短文，更见精彩，因迻译之，以寄《人言》。惜译者未知迅翁寓所，问内山书店主人丸造氏，亦言未详，不能先将译稿就正于氏为憾。但请仍用翁的署名发表，以示尊重原作之意。——译者井上附白。）
(I recently read the March issue of the Japanese magazine "Transformation", and I saw three essays by our literary veteran Lu Xun Weng, which were more wonderful than the short articles published by Weng in Chinese, so I translated them and sent them to "Human Words".) Unfortunately, the translator did not know the residence of Xun Weng, so he asked the owner of the Uchiyama bookstore, Mr. Maruzo, who also said that he did not know and regretted that he could not correct the translation first. However, please still publish it with Weng's signature to show respect for the original work. ——Translator Inoue Fubai. ）人的确是由事实的启发而获得新的觉醒，并且事情也是因此而变革的。从宋代到清朝末年，很久长的时间中，专以代圣贤立言的“制艺”文章，选拔及登用人才。到同法国打了败仗，才知这方法的错误，于是派遣留学生到西洋，设立武器制造局，作为改正的手段。同日本又打了败仗之后，知道这还不彀，这一回是大大地设立新式的学校。于是学生们每年大闹风潮。清朝覆亡，国民党把握了政权之后，又明白了错误，而作为改正手段，是大造监狱。
People are indeed inspired by facts to gain a new awakening, and things change because of it. From the Song Dynasty to the end of the Qing Dynasty, for a long time, the "art-making" articles that were established on behalf of the sages were used to select and appoint talents. After losing the battle with France, he realized the mistake of this method, so he sent international students to the West and set up a weapons manufacturing bureau as a means of correction. After losing the war with Japan again, I knew that this was not enough, and this time I set up a new school this time. So the students make a big fuss every year. After the fall of the Qing Dynasty and the Kuomintang seized power, it understood its mistakes, and as a means of correction, it was to build a large prison.国粹式的监狱，我们从古以来，各处早就有的，清朝末年也稍造了些西洋式的，就是所谓文明监狱。那是特地造来给旅行到中国来的外人看的，该与为同外人讲交际而派出去学习文明人的礼节的留学生属于同一种类。囚人却托庇了得着较好的待遇，也得洗澡，有得一定分量的食品吃，所以是很幸福的地方。而且在二三星期之前，政府因为要行仁政，便发布了囚人口粮不得刻扣的命令。此后当是益加幸福了。
We have had national-style prisons everywhere since ancient times, and at the end of the Qing Dynasty, some Western-style prisons were also built, which are the so-called civilized prisons. It was specially made for outsiders traveling to China, and should belong to the same category as international students sent out to learn the etiquette of civilized people in order to communicate with outsiders. The prisoners were sheltered and treated better, and they had to take a bath, and they had a certain amount of food to eat, so it was a very happy place. And two or three weeks ago, the government issued an order that prisoners' rations should not be deducted because they wanted to practice benevolent governance. After that, I should be happier.至于旧式的监狱，像是取法于佛教的地狱，所以不但禁锢人犯，而且有要给他吃苦的责任。有时还有榨取人犯亲属的金钱使他们成为赤贫的职责。而且谁都以为这是当然的。倘使有不以为然的人，那即是帮助人犯，非受犯罪的嫌疑不可。但是文明程度很进步了，去年有官吏提倡，说人犯每年放归家中一次，给予解决性欲的机会，是很人道主义的说法。老实说：他不是他对于人犯的性欲特别同情，因为决不会实行的望头，所以特别高声说话，以见自己的是官吏。但舆论甚为沸腾起来。某批评家说，这样之后，大家见监狱将无畏惧，乐而赴之，大为为世道人心愤慨。受了圣贤之教，如此悠久，尚不像那个官吏那么狡猾，是很使人心安，但对于人犯不可不虐待的信念，却由此可见。
As for the old-style prison, it is like a Buddhist hell, so it not only imprisons the prisoner, but also has the responsibility to give him hardship. Sometimes the money extracted from the relatives of prisoners made them destitute. And everyone takes it for granted. If there are people who disagree, it is helping the offender, and it must be suspected of committing a crime. But the level of civilization has improved very much, and last year some officials advocated that it was a very humane statement to release prisoners once a year and give them the opportunity to solve their sexual desires. To be honest: he is not particularly sympathetic to the sexual desire of prisoners, because he will never practice it, so he speaks very loudly to see that he is an official. But public opinion is very boiling. A critic said that after this, everyone saw that the prison would be fearless and happy to go there, which was very indignant for the world. Having been taught by the sages, for such a long time, it is not as cunning as that official, which is very reassuring, but the belief that criminals must be abused can be seen from this.从另一方面想来，监狱也确有些像以安全第一为标语的人的理想乡。火灾少，盗贼不进来，土匪也决不来掠夺。即使有了战事，也没有以监狱为目标而来爆击的傻瓜，起了革命，只有释放人犯的例，没有屠杀的事。这回福建独立的时候，说释人犯出外之后，那些意见不同的却有了行踪不明的谣传，但这种例子是前所未见的。总之，不像是很坏的地方。只要能容许带家眷，那么即使现在不是水灾，饥荒，战争，恐怖的时代，请求去转居的人，也决不会没有。所以虐待是必要了吧。
On the other hand, prisons are indeed a bit like the utopia of people with the slogan of safety first. There are few fires, thieves do not come in, and bandits will never come to plunder. Even if there was a war, there were no fools who came to target prisons, and there was a revolution, only examples of releasing prisoners, and there were no massacres. This time, when Fujian became independent, it was said that after the prisoners were released, there were rumors of unknown whereabouts of those who had different opinions, but this kind of example was unprecedented. In short, it doesn't look like a bad place. As long as family members are allowed, then even if it is not a time of floods, famines, wars, and terror, there will never be no people who ask to relocate. So abuse is necessary.牛兰夫妻以宣传赤化之故，收容于南京的监狱，行了三四次的绝食，什么效力也没有。这是因为他不了解中国的监狱精神之故。某官吏说他自己不要吃，同别人有什么关系，很讶奇这事。不但不关系于仁政，且节省伙食，反是监狱方面有利。甘地的把戏，倘使不选择地方，就归于失败。
Niu Lan and his wife were detained in a prison in Nanjing for propaganda and reddening, and went on hunger strike three or four times, but to no avail. This is because he does not understand the Chinese prison spirit. An official said that he didn't want to eat it himself, and he was surprised that it had nothing to do with others. The way of intelligence邨人
Villagers
畴昔之夜，拜访世故老人于其庐：庐为三层之楼，面街而立，虽电车玲玲轧轧，汽车呜呜哑哑，市嚣扰人而不觉，俨然有如隐士，居处晏如，悟道深也。老人曰，“汝来何事？”对曰，“敢问聪明之道。”谈话有主题，遂成问答。
畴昔之夜，拜访世故老人于其庐：庐为三层之楼，面街而立，虽电车玲玲轧轧，汽车呜呜哑哑，市嚣扰人而不觉，俨然有如隐士，居处晏如，悟道深也。 老人曰，“汝来何事？”对曰，“敢问聪明之道。 ”谈话有主题，遂成问答。“难矣哉，聪明之道也！孔门贤人如颜回，举一隅以三隅反，孔子称其聪明过人，于今之世能举一隅以三隅反者尚非聪明之人，汝问聪明之道，其有意难余老瞆者耶？”
“难矣哉，聪明之道也！孔门贤人如颜回，举一隅以三隅反，孔子称其聪明过人，于今之世能举一隅以三隅反者尚非聪明之人，汝问聪明之道，其有意难余老瞆者耶？”“不是不是，你老人家误会了我的问意了！我并非要请教关于思辨之术。我是生性拙直愚笨，处世无方，常常碰壁，敢问关于处世的聪明之道。”
"No, no, you old man misunderstood my question! I am not asking about the art of thinking. “噫嘻，汝诚拙直愚笨也，又问处世之道！夫今之世，智者见智，仁者见仁，阶级不同，思想各异，父子兄弟夫妇姊妹因思想之各异，一家之内各有主张各有成见，虽属骨肉至亲，乖离冲突，背道而驰；古之所谓英雄豪杰，各事其君而为仇敌，今之所谓志士革命家，各为阶级反目无情，甚至只因立场之不同，骨肉至亲格杀无赦，投机取巧或能胜利于一时，终难立足于世界，聪明之道实则已穷，且唯既愚且鲁之徒方能享福无边也矣。 ……”“老先生虽然说的头头是道，理由充足，可是，真的聪明之道就没有了吗？”
"Although the old gentleman said that the beginning is the Tao, and the reason is sufficient, is there really no smart way?"“然则仅有投机取巧之道也矣。试为汝言之：夫投机取巧之道要在乎滑头，而滑头已成为专门之学问，西欧学理分门别类有所谓科学哲学者，滑头之学问实可称为滑头学。滑头学如依大学教授之编讲义，大可分成若干章，每章分成若干节，每节分成若干项，引古据今，中西合璧，其理论之深奥有甚于哲学，其引证之广大举凡中外历史，物理化学，艺术文学，经商贸易之直，诱惑欺骗之术，概属必列，包罗万象，自大学预科以至大学四年级此一讲义仅能讲其千分之一，大学毕业各科及格，此滑头学则无论何种聪明绝顶之学生皆不能及格，且大学教授本人恐亦知其然不知其所以然，其难学也可想而知之矣。余处世数十年，头顶已秃，须发已白，阅历不为不广，教训不为不多，然而余着手编辑滑头学讲义，仅能编其第一章之第一节，第一节之第一项也。此第一章之第一节，第一节之第一项其纲目为‘顺水行舟’，即人云亦云，亦即人之喜者喜之，人之恶者恶之是也，举一例言之，如人之恶者为孝子，所谓封建宗法社会之礼教遗孽之一，则汝虽曾经为父侍汤服药问医求卜出诸天性以事亲人，然论世之出诸天性以事亲人者则引‘孝子’之名以责难之，惟求青年之鼓掌称快，勿管本心见解及自己行动之如何也。被责难者处于时势潮流之下，百辞莫辩，辩则反动更为证实，从此青年鸣鼓而攻，体无完肤，汝之胜利不但已操左券，且为青年奉为至圣大贤，小品之集有此一篇，风行海内洛阳纸贵，于是名利双收，富贵无边矣。其第一章之第一节，第一节之第二项为‘投井下石’，余本亦知一二，然偶一忆及投井下石之人，殊觉头痛，实无心编之也。然而滑头学虽属聪明之道，实乃左道旁门，汝实不足学也。”
"In this case, there is only a way to opportunist. At about 9 o'clock yesterday morning, Yihua Company was in the newly built photography studio near the Jinsu Temple on Kangnaotuo Road, western Shanghai, three young people suddenly came to act abruptly, pretending to be visitors to the company's concierge, one was holding a pen to sign, the other person shouted, and there were seven or eight thugs lurking outside, all wearing blue cloth shorts and pants, swarming to rush in, throwing into each office, wantonly smashing the glass windows of the writing desk and the utensils of the chairs and benches, and then going outside, destroying two self-prepared cars, a film dryer, and a camera. 杂感

continent
近来有许多杂志上都在提倡小文章。《申报月刊》《东方杂志》以及《现代》上，都有杂感随笔这一栏。好像一九三三真要变成一个小文章年头了。目下中国杂感家之多，远胜于昔，大概此亦鲁迅先生一人之功也。中国杂感家老牌，自然要推鲁迅。他的师爷笔法，冷辣辣的，有他人所不及的地方。《热风》，《华盖集》，《华盖续集》，去年则还出了什么三心《二心》之类。照他最近一年来“干”的成绩而言大概五心六心也是不免的。鲁迅先生久无创作出版了，除了译一些俄国黑面包之外，其余便是写杂感文章了。杂感文章，短短千言，自然可以一挥而就。则于抽卷烟之际，略转脑子，结果就是十元千字。大概写杂感文章，有一个不二法门。不是热骂，便是冷嘲。如能热骂后再带一句冷嘲或冷嘲里夹两句热骂，则更佳矣。

Briefly discuss the release of hidden arrows陈代
Chen Dynasty
前日读了鲁迅先生的《伪自由书》的《前记》与《后记》，略论了告密的，现在读了唐弢先生的《新脸谱》，止不住又要来略论放暗箭。

In "New Face", Mr. Tang attacks a wide range of aspects, and one side is "putting hidden arrows". However, Mr. Tang's articles are almost entirely woven with "hidden arrows", although there are many arrow markers that are not very clear.“说是受着潮流的影响，文舞台的戏儿一出出换了。脚色虽然依旧，而脸谱却是簇新的。”——是暗箭的第一条。虽说是暗箭，射倒射中了的。因为现在的确有许多文脚色，为要博看客的喝采起见，放着演惯的旧戏不演演新戏，嘴上还“说是受着潮流的影响”，以表示他的不落后。还有些甚至不要说脚色依旧，就是脸谱也并不簇新，只是换了一个新的题目，演的还是那旧的一套：如把《薛平贵西凉招亲》改题着《穆薛姻缘》之类，内容都一切依旧。
It is said that it is influenced by the trend, and the play on the literary stage has been changed as soon as it comes out. Although the footsteps are still the same, the face is new. —— is the first of the hidden arrows. Although it was a hidden arrow, it was shot backwards. Because there are indeed many literary works now, in order to win the applause of the audience, he puts the old plays he is used to acting instead of acting in new plays, and he also "says that he is influenced by the trend" to show that he is not lagging behind. There are also some that don't even say that the footsteps are still the same, even the face is not new, but a new title is changed, and the performance is still the same as the old one: such as changing the title of "Xue Pinggui Xiliang Marriage" to "Mu Xue Marriage", etc., the content is the same.第二箭是——不，不能这样写下去，要这样写下去，是要有很广博的识见的，因为那文章一句一箭，或者甚至一句数箭，看得人眼花头眩，竟无从把它把捉住，比读硬性的翻译还难懂得多。
The second arrow is - no, you can't write like this, you have to have a very broad insight to write like this, because the article is sentence by sentence, or even counts arrows one sentence at a time, which is dazzling to see, and it is impossible to catch it, which is much more difficult to understand than reading a hard translation.可是唐先生自己似乎又并不满意这样的态度，不然为什么要骂人家“怪声怪气地吆喝，妞妞妮妮的挑战”？然而，在事实上，他是在“怪声怪气地吆喝，妞妞妮妮的挑战”。

In other words, he is not challenging, he is just letting go of hidden arrows, because "fierce battles", even if they are "pulling and pulling", are difficult, and they have to "redraw" their faces when they "lose" and "come again". It is easier to put a hidden arrow, hide in a hidden place, see something to shoot, and lightly stretch the bowstring, and the arrow will fly forward comfortably.
