钱基博之鲁迅论
Qian Jibo's Lu Xun theory戚施
Qi Shi
近人有裒集关于批评鲁迅之文字而为《鲁迅论》一书者，其中所收，类皆称颂鲁迅之辞，其实论鲁迅之文者，有毁有誉，毁誉互见，乃得其真。顷见钱基博氏所著《现代中国文学史》，长至三十万言，其论白话文学，不过一万余字，仅以胡适入选，而以鲁迅徐志摩附焉。于此诸人，大肆訾謷。迩来旧作文家，品藻文字，裁量人物，未有若钱氏之大胆者，而新人未尝注意及之。兹特介绍其“鲁迅论”于此，是亦文坛上之趣闻也。
近人有裒集关于批评鲁迅之文字而为《鲁迅论》一书者，其中所收，类皆称颂鲁迅之辞，其实论鲁迅之文者，有毁有誉，毁誉互见，乃得其真。 顷见钱基博氏所著《现代中国文学史》，长至三十万言，其论白话文学，不过一万余字，仅以胡适入选，而以鲁迅徐志摩附焉。 于此诸人，大肆訾謷。 迩来旧作文家，品藻文字，裁量人物，未有若钱氏之大胆者，而新人未尝注意及之。 兹特介绍其“鲁迅论”于此，是亦文坛上之趣闻也。钱氏之言曰，有摹仿欧文而谥之曰欧化的国语文学者，始倡于浙江周树人之译西洋小说，以顺文直译之为尚，斥意译之不忠实，而摹欧文以国语，比鹦鹉之学舌，托于象胥，斯为作俑。效颦者乃至造述抒志，亦竞欧化，《小说月报》，盛扬其焰。然而诘屈聱牙，过于周诰，学士费解，何论民众？上海曹慕管笑之曰，吾侪生愿读欧文，不愿见此妙文也！比于时装妇人着高底西女式鞋，而跬步倾跌，益增丑态矣！崇效古人，斥曰奴性，摹仿外国，独非奴性耶。反唇之讥，或谑近虐！然始之创白话文以期言文一致，家喻户晓者，不以欧化的国语文学之兴而荒其志耶？斯则矛盾之说，无以自圆者矣，此于鲁迅之直译外国文学，及其文坛之影响，而加以訾謷者也。平心论之，鲁迅之译品，诚有难读之处，直译当否是一问题，欧化的国语文学又是一问题，借曰二者胥有未当，谁尸其咎，亦难言之也。钱先生而谓鄙言为不然耶？
Qian's words say that there are Chinese writers who imitate European and posthumously call them European, and began to advocate the translation of Western novels by Zhou Shuren in Zhejiang, advocating for literal translation of Shunwen and refuting the dishonesty of Italian translation Chinese. Those who imitate the frowns and even create narratives and express their aspirations are also competing for Europeanization, and the "Novel Monthly" is full of flames. However, the question of Qu Ya is more than the Zhou Gao, and the scholar is incomprehensible, so what is the people? Cao Muguan from Shanghai laughed and said, "We want to read Irving, but we don't want to see this wonderful article!" Compared to fashion women wearing high-soled Western women's shoes, and the step is even more ugly! He imitated the ancients, denounced it as slavery, and imitated foreign people, but it was not slavery. The irony of the lips may be close to abuse! However, those who initially created vernacular literature in the hope of unity of language and literature, and who became well-known to everyone, did not abandon their ambitions due to the rise of Europeanized Chinese literature? This is a contradictory statement that cannot be justified, which is a slander of Lu Xun's literal translation of foreign literature and its influence on the literary world. To be fair, Lu Xun's translation is indeed difficult to read, whether the literal translation is appropriate is one question, and the Europeanized Chinese literature is another problem. Mr. Qian, do you think my words are not correct?钱先生又曰，自胡适之创白话文学也，所持以号于天下者，曰平民文学也！非贵族文学也。一时景附以有大名者，周树人以小说著。树人颓废，不适于奋斗。树人所著，只有过去回忆，而不知建设将来，只见小己愤慨，而不图福利民众，若而人者，彼其心目，何尝有民众耶！钱先生因此而断之曰，周树人徐志摩为新文艺之右倾者。是则于鲁迅之创作亦加以訾謷，兼及其思想矣。至目鲁迅为右倾，亦可谓独具只眼，别有鉴裁者也！既不满意于郭沫若蒋光赤之左倾，又不满意于鲁迅徐志摩之右倾，而惟倾慕于所谓“让清”遗老之流风余韵，低徊感喟而不能自已，钱先生之志，皎然可睹矣。当今之世，左右做人难，是非无定质，亦于钱先生之论鲁迅见之也！

Qian's book was published in September of this year, and there is also a postscript in December of the previous year.十二月二十九日，《大晚报》的《火炬》。
December 29, "Torch" of the "Great Evening News".这篇大文，除用戚施先生的话，赞为“独具只眼”之外，是不能有第二句的。真“评”得连我自己也不想再说什么话，“颓废”了。然而我觉得它很有趣，所以特别的保存起来，也是以备“鲁迅论”之一格。
This great article, except for Mr. Qi Shi's words, praises it as "unique eye", there can be no second sentence. It's so "evaluated" that even I don't want to say anything more, it's "decadent". King Pingling
学问之事，很不容易说，一般通材硕儒每不屑与后生小子道长论短，有所述作，无不讥为“浅薄无聊”；同样，较有修养的年轻人，看着那般通材硕儒们言必称苏俄，文必宗普鲁，亦颇觉得如嚼青梅，齿颊间酸不可耐。
It is not easy to say that the general scholars often disdain to discuss the shortcomings with the younger children, and the works mentioned are all ridiculed as "shallow and boring"; Similarly, the more cultivated young people, looking at the well-rounded scholars who must be called Soviet Russia, and Wen Bizong Pulu, also feel that they are chewing green plums, and the sour between their teeth and cheeks is unbearable.世界上无论什么纷争，都有停止的可能，惟有人类思想的冲突，因为多半是近于意气，断没有终止的时候的。有些人好像把毁谤人家故意找寻人家的错误当作是一种职业；而以直接否认一切就算是间接抬高自己的妙策了。至于自己究竟是什么东西，那只许他们自己知道，别人是不准过问的。其实，有时候这些人意在对人而发的阴险的暗示，倒并不适切；而正是他们自己的一篇不自觉的供状。
No matter what kind of strife in the world there is a possibility of stopping, only the conflict of human thought, because most of them are close to will, and there is no end to it. Some people seem to regard slandering others as a profession to deliberately find mistakes; And directly denying everything is a brilliant strategy to indirectly elevate oneself. As for what they are, they are only allowed to know, and others are not allowed to ask. In fact, sometimes the insidious hints that these people intend to make to people are not appropriate; And it was their own involuntary confession.圣经里好像有这样一段传说：一群街头人捉着一个偷汉的淫妇，大家要把石块打死她。耶稣说：“你们反省着！只有没有犯过罪的人，才配打死这个淫妇。”群众都羞愧地走开了。今之文坛，可不是这样？自己偷了汉，偏要指说人家是淫妇。如同鲁迅先生惯用的一句刻毒的评语，就就骂人是代表官方说话；我不知道他老先生是代表什么“方”说话！
There seems to be a legend in the Bible that a group of street men caught a thief and wanted to stone her to death. Jesus said, "Reflect on yourself! Only those who have not committed sins are worthy of killing this harlot. The crowd walked away in shame. Is this not the case in today's literary world? I stole the man, but I want to accuse others of being prostitutes. Just like Mr. Lu Xun's usual vicious comment, he scolded people for speaking on behalf of the official; I don't know what kind of "square" his old gentleman represents!本来，不想说话的人，是无话可说；有话要说；有话要说的人谁也不会想到是代表那一方。鲁迅先生常常“以己之心，度人之心”，未免“躬自薄而厚责于人”了。
Originally, those who didn't want to speak had nothing to say; There is something to say; No one who has something to say would think of representing that side. Mr. Lu Xun often "saves people's hearts with his own heart", and inevitably "bows down and blames others".像这样的情形，文坛有的是，何止是鲁迅先生。

December 30, "Fire Tree" of the "Great American Evening News".记得在《伪自由书》里，我曾指王先生的高论为属于“官方”，这回就是对此而发的，但意义却不大明白。由“自己偷了汉，偏要指说人家是淫妇”的话看起来，好像是说我倒是“官方”，而不知“有话要说的人谁也不会想到是代表那一方”的。所以如果想到了，那么，说人反动的，他自己正是反动，说人匪徒的，他自己正是匪徒……且住，又是“刻毒的评语”了，耶稣不说过“你们反省着”吗？——为消灾计，再添一条小尾：这坏习气只以文坛为限，与官方无干。
I remember that in the "Pseudo-Freedom Book", I once pointed out that Mr. Wang's high argument belonged to the "official", and this time I issued it for this, but the meaning was not very clear. From the words "I stole the Han, but I want to say that others are prostitutes", it seems to mean that I am "official", but I don't know that "no one who has something to say will think of representing that party". So if you think of it, then if you say that people are reactionary, you are reactionary yourself, and if you say that people are bandits, you are a bandit yourself...... Wait, it's another "harsh comment", didn't Jesus say, "You reflect"? ——In order to eliminate disasters, add another small tail: This bad habit is only limited to the literary world and has nothing to do with the officials.王平陵先生是电影检查会的委员，我应该谨守小民的规矩。
Mr. Wang Pingling is a member of the Film Inspection Committee, and I should abide by the rules of the common people.
真的且住。写的和剪贴的，也就是自己的和别人的，化了大半夜工夫，恐怕又有八九千字了。这一条尾巴又并不小。
Really stay. Written and cut-and-pasted, that is, my own and others', took a lot of time in the middle of the night, and I am afraid there are eight or nine thousand words. This tail is not small.时光，是一天天的过去了，大大小小的事情，也跟着过去，不久就在我们的记忆上消亡；而且都是分散的，就我自己而论，没有感到和没有知道的事情真不知有多少。但即此写了下来的几十篇，加以排比，又用《后记》来补叙些因此而生的纠纷，同时也照见了时事，格局虽小，不也描出了或一形象了么？——而现在又很少有肯低下他仰视莎士比亚，托尔斯泰的尊脸来，看看暗中，写它几句的作者。因此更使我要保存我的杂感，而且它也因此更能够生存，虽然又因此更招人憎恶，但又在围剿中更加生长起来了。呜呼，“世无英雄，遂使竖子成名”，这是为我自己和中国的文坛，都应该悲愤的。
Time passes day by day, big and small things also follow, and soon they will disappear in our memory; And they are all scattered, as far as I am concerned, there are really many things that I don't feel and don't know. But the dozens of articles written down are compared, and the "Afterword" is used to supplement some of the disputes that arise from this, and at the same time, it also reflects current affairs. ——And now few people are willing to lower their heads to look up at Shakespeare, Tolstoy's respectable face, and look at the author who secretly wrote a few words of it. Therefore, I have to preserve my distractions even more, and it is also more able to survive, although it is more hateful because of this, but it has grown even more in the encirclement and suppression. Alas, "there are no heroes in the world, so the boy becomes famous", this is for myself and the Chinese literary world, I should be sad and indignant.文坛上的事件还多得很：献检查之秘计，施离析之奇策，起谣诼兮中权，藏真实兮心曲，立降幡于往年，温故交于今日……然而都不是做这《准风月谈》时期以内的事，在这里也且不提及，或永不提及了。还是真的带住罢，写到我的背脊已经觉得有些痛楚的时候了！
There are many events in the literary world: offering the secret plan of inspection, the clever strategy of separation, the rumor of the central power, the hidden truth of the heart, the flag of the past years, and the friendship of the old in today...... However, it is not something that is done within the period of "Quasi-Fengyue Talk", and it will not be mentioned here, or never mentioned. Or really take it, write until my back is already feeling some pain!一九三四年十月十六夜，鲁迅记于上海。
On the night of October 16, 1934, Lu Xun recorded in Shanghai.

序言

序言

序言

序言我的常常写些短评，确是从投稿于《申报》的《自由谈》上开头的；集一九三三年之所作，就有了《伪自由书》和《准风月谈》两本。后来编辑者黎烈文先生真被挤轧得苦，到第二年，终于被挤出了，我本也可以就此搁笔，但为了赌气，却还是改些作法，换些笔名，托人抄写了去投稿，新任者不能细辨，依然常常登了出来。一面又扩大了范围，给《中华日报》的副刊《动向》，小品文半月刊《太白》之类，也间或写几篇同样的文字。聚起一九三四年所写的这些东西来，就是这一本《花边文学》。
I often write short comments, which do start with "Free Talk" submitted to the "Declaration"; The collection of works made in 1933 has two books, "Pseudo-Freedom Book" and "Quasi-Fengyue Talk". Later, the editor Mr. Li Liewen was really squeezed out, and in the second year, he was finally squeezed out, and I could have put down my pen, but in order to be angry, I still changed some practices, changed some pseudonyms, and asked someone to copy and submit. On the one hand, it expanded the scope, and occasionally wrote several similar texts for the supplement "Trends" of "China Daily" and the semi-monthly magazine "Taibai". Gathering these things written in 1934, it is this book "Lace Literature".这一个名称，是和我在同一营垒里的青年战友，换掉姓名挂在暗箭上射给我的。那立意非常巧妙：一，因为这类短评，在报上登出来的时候往往围绕一圈花边以示重要，使我的战友看得头疼；二，因为“花边”也是银元的别名，以见我的这些文章是为了稿费，其实并无足取。至于我们的意见不同之处，是我以为我们无须希望外国人待我们比鸡鸭优，他却以为应该待我们比鸡鸭优，我在替西洋人辩护，所以是“买办”。那文章就附在《倒提》之下，这里不必多说。此外，倒也并无什么可记之事。只为了一篇《玩笑只当它玩笑》，又曾引出过一封文公直先生的来信，笔伐的更严重了，说我是“汉奸”，现在和我的复信都附在本文的下面。其余的一些鬼鬼祟祟，躲躲闪闪的攻击，离上举的两位还差得很远，这里都不转载了。
This name was given to me by a young comrade-in-arms in the same camp as me, who changed his name and hung it on the hidden arrow. The idea is very ingenious: First, because of this kind of short commentary, when published in the newspaper, it often revolves around a circle of lace to show its importance, which gives my comrades-in-arms a headache; Second, because "lace" is also another name for silver dollars, it is not worth it to see that my articles are for manuscript fees. As for our differences of opinion, I think we don't need to expect foreigners to treat us better than chickens and ducks, but he thinks that we should be treated better than chickens and ducks, and I am defending Westerners, so I am a "comprador". The article is attached to "Upside Down", so there is no need to say more here. In addition, there is nothing to remember. Just for the sake of an article "Joke Only Treat It as a Joke", I once led to a letter from Mr. Wen Gongzhi, which was even more serious, saying that I was a "traitor", and now my reply letter is attached to the bottom of this article. The rest of the sneaky, dodging attacks, are still far from the two above, and they will not be reproduced here.“花边文学”可也真不行。一九三四年不同一九三五年，今年是为了《闲话皇帝》事件，官家的书报检查处忽然不知所往，还革掉七位检查官，日报上被删之处，也好像可以留着空白（术语谓之“开天窗”）了。但那时可真厉害，这么说不可以，那么说又不成功，而且删掉的地方，还不许留下空隙，要接起来，使作者自己来负吞吞吐吐，不知所云的责任。在这种明诛暗杀之下，能够苟延残喘，和读者相见的，那么，非奴隶文章是什么呢？
"Lace literature" is really not good. Unlike 1935, this year for the "Gossip Emperor" incident, the official book and newspaper inspection office suddenly disappeared, and seven inspectors were dismissed, and the deleted places in the daily newspaper seemed to be left blank (the term is called "opening the skylight"). But at that time, it was really powerful, so it was not possible, then it was unsuccessful, and the deleted places were not allowed to leave gaps, and they had to be picked up, so that the author himself would bear the responsibility of hesitating and not knowing what to say. Under this kind of open assassination, what is a non-slave article that can survive and meet readers?我曾经和几个朋友闲谈。一个朋友说：现在的文章，是不会有骨气的了，譬如向一种日报上的副刊去投稿罢，副刊编辑先抽去几根骨头，总编辑又抽去几根骨头，检查官又抽去几根骨头，剩下来还有什么呢？我说：我是自己先抽去了几根骨头的，否则，连“剩下来”的也不剩。所以，那时发表出来的文字，有被抽四次的可能，——现在有些人不在拚命表彰文天祥方孝孺么，幸而他们是宋明人，如果活在现在，他们的言行是谁也无从知道的。
I used to chat with a few friends. A friend said: The current article will not have a backbone, for example, if you submit it to a supplement in a daily newspaper, the editor of the supplement will first remove a few bones, the editor-in-chief will remove a few bones, and the inspector will remove a few more bones. I said: I took out a few bones myself first, otherwise, there would be no "left" left. Therefore, the words published at that time may be drawn four times,—— now some people are not desperately commending Wen Tianxiang Fang Xiaoru, fortunately they are Song Ming people, if they live now, no one knows their words and deeds.因此除了官准的有骨气的文章之外，读者也只能看看没有骨气的文章。我生于清朝，原是奴隶出身，不同二十五岁以内的青年，一生下来就是中华民国的主子，然而他们不经世故，偶尔“忘其所以”也就大碰其钉子。我的投稿，目的是在发表的，当然不给它见得有骨气，所以被“花边”所装饰者，大约也确比青年作家的作品多，而且奇怪，被删掉的地方倒很少。一年之中，只有三篇，现在补全，仍用黑点为记。我看《论秦理斋夫人事》的末尾，是申报馆的总编辑删的，别的两篇，却是检查官删的：这里都显着他们不同的心思。
Therefore, in addition to official articles with backbone, readers can only read articles without spine. I was born in the Qing Dynasty, originally a slave, unlike young people under the age of twenty-five, who were born as masters of the Republic of China, but they were not sophisticated, and occasionally "forgot why" and hit their nails. My submission is intended to be published, of course, it does not give it a backbone, so it is indeed more decorated with "lace" than the works of young writers, and strangely, very few places have been deleted. In a year, there are only three articles, and now they are completed, still using black dots as marks. I read that at the end of "On the Affairs of Mrs. Qin Lizhai", it was deleted by the editor-in-chief of the declaration hall, and the other two articles were deleted by the inspector: here they all show their different thoughts.今年一年中，我所投稿的《自由谈》和《动向》，都停刊了；《太白》也不出了。我曾经想过：凡是我寄文稿的，只寄开初的一两期还不妨，假使接连不断，它就总归活不久。于是从今年起，我就不大做这样的短文，因为对于同人，是回避他背后的闷棍，对于自己，是不愿做开路的呆子，对于刊物，是希望它尽可能的长生。所以有人要我投稿，我特别敷延推宕，非“摆架子”也，是带些好意——然而有时也是恶意——的“世故”：这是要请索稿者原谅的。
This year, the "Free Talk" and "Trends" I submitted were suspended; "Taibai" also came out. I once thought: Whenever I send a manuscript, it might be okay to send only one or two issues at the beginning, but if it continues, it will always live for a short time. So from this year onwards, I won't do such short articles, because for the same person, it is to avoid the stuffy stick behind him, for myself, I am a fool who does not want to open the way, and for the publication, I hope it will live as long as possible. Therefore, when someone asks me to submit, I am particularly procrastinating, not "putting on a show", but with some good intentions—but sometimes malice—"sophistication": this is to ask the requester to forgive me.一直到了今年下半年，这才看见了新闻记者的“保护正当舆论”的请愿和智识阶级的言论自由的要求。要过年了，我不知道结果怎么样。然而，即使从此文章都成了民众的喉舌，那代价也可谓大极了：是北五省的自治。这恰如先前的不敢恳请“保护正当舆论”和要求言论自由的代价之大一样：是东三省的沦亡。不过这一次，换来的东西是光明的。然而，倘使万一不幸，后来又复换回了我做“花边文学”一样的时代，大家试来猜一猜那代价该是什么罢……
It was not until the second half of this year that we saw the petition of journalists to "protect legitimate public opinion" and the demand for freedom of speech from the intellectual class. It's coming up for the New Year, and I don't know what the outcome will be. However, even if the article has become the mouthpiece of the people since then, the price can be described as great: it is the autonomy of the five northern provinces. This is just as the price of not daring to plead for "protection of legitimate public opinion" and demanding freedom of speech: the fall of the three eastern provinces. But this time, the exchange was bright. However, if I am unfortunate and later return to the era when I did "lace literature", let's try to guess what the price should be......一九三五年十二月二十九之夜，鲁迅记。

未来的光荣

未来的光荣

The glory of the future张承禄
Zhang Chenglu现在几乎每年总有外国的文学家到中国来，一到中国，总惹出一点小乱子。前有萧伯纳，后有德哥派拉；只有伐扬古久列，大家不愿提，或者不能提。
Nowadays, almost every year, foreign writers come to China, and when they arrive in China, they always cause a little trouble. George Bernard Shaw in the front, De Cooper in the back; Only Fayang Gujiule, everyone does not want to mention it, or cannot mention it.德哥派拉不谈政治，本以为可以跳在是非圈外的了，不料因为恭维了食与色，又挣得“外国文氓”的恶谥，让我们的论客，在这里议论纷纷。他大约就要做小说去了。
De Gopala didn't talk about politics, he thought he could jump out of the circle of right and wrong, but unexpectedly, because he complimented food and sex, he earned the bad title of "foreign literati", which made our commentators talk a lot here. He is about to write a novel.鼻子生得平而小，没有欧洲人那么高峻，那是没有法子的，然而倘使我们身边有几角钱，却一样的可以看电影。侦探片子演厌了，爱情片子烂熟了，战争片子看腻了，滑稽片子无聊了，于是乎有《人猿泰山》，有《兽林怪人》，有《斐洲探险》等等，要野兽和野蛮登场。然而在蛮地中，也还一定要穿插一点蛮婆子的蛮曲线。如果我们也还爱看，那就可见无论怎样奚落，也还是有些恋恋不舍的了，“性”之于市侩，是很要紧的。
The nose is born flat and small, not as tall as Europeans, which is not possible, but if we have a few dimes around us, we can still watch movies. Detective films are tired of acting, romance films are familiar, war movies are tired, and burlesque films are boring, so there are "Tarzan of the Apes", "The Monster of the Beast Forest", "The Adventure of Feizhou", etc., to make the appearance of beasts and savagery. However, in the barbarian land, there must also be a little barbarian curve interspersed. If we still love to watch it, it can be seen that no matter how ridiculed it is, there is still some reluctance, and "sex" is very important to philistines.文学在西欧，其碰壁和电影也并不两样；有些所谓文学家也者，也得找寻些奇特的（grotesque），色情的（erotic）东西，去给他们的主顾满足，因此就有探险式的旅行，目的倒并不在地主的打拱或请酒。然而倘遇呆问，则以笑话了之，他其实也知道不了这些，他也不必知道。德哥派拉不过是这些人们中的一人。
In Western Europe, literature hits a wall and movies are no different; Some so-called writers also have to find something grotesque and erotic to satisfy their patrons, so they have adventure-like trips, and the purpose is not to make arches or invite wine. However, if he is dumbfounded, he will make a joke, he actually can't know this, and he doesn't have to know. De Gopala was just one of these people.但中国人，在这类文学家的作品里，是要和各种所谓“土人”一同登场的，只要看报上所载的德哥派拉先生的路由单就知道——中国，南洋，南美。英，德之类太平常了。我们要觉悟着被描写，还要觉悟着被描写的光荣还要多起来，还要觉悟着将来会有人以有这样的事为有趣。
But the Chinese, in the works of such writers, are to appear with all kinds of so-called "natives", as long as you look at Mr. de Gopala's route list in the newspaper - China, Nanyang, South America. Britain, Germany, etc. are too common. We must be aware of being described, and we must be aware that there will be more glory to be described, and we must also be aware that there will be people in the future who will find such things interesting.一月八日。

女人未必多说谎

女人未必多说谎

女人未必多说谎

Women may not lie much赵令仪
Zhao Lingyi侍桁先生在《谈说谎》里，以为说谎的原因之一是由于弱，那举证的事实，是：“因此为什么女人讲谎话要比男人来得多。”
In "Talking about Lies", Mr. Shi Zhen thought that one of the reasons for lying was because of weakness, and the fact that he gave evidence was: "Therefore, why women lie more than men." ”那并不一定是谎话，可是也不一定是事实。我们确也常常从男人们的嘴里，听说是女人讲谎话要比男人多，不过却也并无实证，也没有统计。叔本华先生痛骂女人，他死后，从他的书籍里发见了医梅毒的药方；还有一位奥国的青年学者，我忘记了他的姓氏，做了一大本书，说女人和谎话是分不开的，然而他后来自杀了。我恐怕他自己正有神经病。
That is not necessarily a lie, but it is not necessarily a fact either. We do often hear from men that women lie more than men, but there is no evidence or statistics. Mr. Schopenhauer scolded the woman, and after his death, he found a prescription for syphilis in his books; There was also a young scholar from Austria, I forgot his surname, and made a large book saying that women and lies are inseparable, but he later committed suicide. I'm afraid he has a mental illness himself.我想，与其说“女人讲谎话要比男人来得多”，不如说“女人被人指为‘讲谎话要比男人来得多’的时候来得多”，但是，数目字的统计自然也没有。
I think that rather than saying "women lie more often than men", it is better to say that "women are accused of lying more often than men", but there is naturally no statistics on the number of words.譬如罢，关于杨妃，禄山之乱以后的文人就都撒着大谎，玄宗逍遥事外，倒说是许多坏事情都由她，敢说“不闻夏殷衰，中自诛褒妲”的有几个。就是妲己，褒姒，也还不是一样的事？女人的替自己和男人伏罪，真是太长远了。
For example, about Yang Fei, the literati after the Lushan Rebellion all lied big lies, and Xuanzong was carefree, but said that many bad things were done by her, and there were a few who dared to say that "I didn't hear the decline of Xia Yin, and I killed Bao Da in the middle". Even Daji and Bao Si are not the same thing? It is too long-term for women to confess for themselves and men.今年是“妇女国货年”，振兴国货，也从妇女始。不久，是就要挨骂的，因为国货也未必因此有起色，然而一提倡，一责骂，男人们的责任也尽了。
This year is the "Year of Women's National Goods", and the revitalization of domestic products also starts with women. Soon, it will be scolded, because domestic products may not improve because of this, but as soon as they advocate and scold, the men's responsibilities have been fulfilled.记得某男士有为某女士鸣不平的诗道：“君王城上竖降旗，妾在深宫那得知？二十万人齐解甲，更无一个是男儿！”快哉快哉！
I remember that a certain man wrote a poem about a certain lady: "The flag is raised on the king's city, how did I know it in the deep palace?" Two hundred thousand people disarmed, and not a single one was a man! "Exciting, so exciting!一月八日。

批评家的批评家

批评家的批评家

批评家的批评家

Critics of critics倪朔尔
Ni Shuoer情势也转变得真快，去年以前，是批评家和非批评家都批评文学，自然，不满的居多，但说好的也有。去年以来，却变了文学家和非文学家都翻了一个身，转过来来批评批评家了。
The situation is also changing so quickly, before last year, critics and non-critics both criticized literature, naturally, most of them were dissatisfied, but there were also good ones. Since last year, both literary and non-literary scholars have turned around and turned to criticize critics.这一回可是不大有人说好，最彻底的是不承认近来有真的批评家。即使承认，也大大的笑他们胡涂。为什么呢？因为他们往往用一个一定的圈子向作品上面套，合就好，不合就坏。
This time, not many people say it is good, and the most thorough thing is not to admit that there are real critics recently. Even if you admit it, you laugh at them for being foolish. Why? Because they often use a certain circle to cover the work, it is good to fit, and it is bad if it does not fit.但是，我们曾经在文艺批评史上见过没有一定圈子的批评家吗？都有的，或者是美的圈，或者是真实的圈，或者是前进的圈。没有一定的圈子的批评家，那才是怪汉子呢。办杂志可以号称没有一定的圈子，而其实这正是圈子，是便于遮眼的变戏法的手巾。譬如一个编辑者是唯美主义者罢，他尽可以自说并无定见，单在书籍评论上，就足够玩把戏。倘是一种所谓“为艺术的艺术”的作品，合于自己的私意的，他就选登一篇赞成这种主义的批评，或读后感，捧着它上天；要不然，就用一篇假急进的好像非常革命的批评家的文章，捺它到地里去。读者这就被迷了眼。但在个人，如果还有一点记性，却不能这么两端的，他须有一定的圈子。我们不能责备他有圈子，我们只能批评他这圈子对不对。
However, have we ever seen critics without a certain circle in the history of literary and artistic criticism? There are all of them, or the circle of beauty, or the circle of reality, or the circle of progress. If there is no certain circle of critics, then it is a strange man. Running a magazine can claim to be that there is no certain circle, but in fact, this is the circle, a hand towel that is easy to cover your eyes. For example, an editor is an aestheticist, he can say that he has no fixed opinion, and book reviews alone are enough to play tricks. If it is a work of so-called "art for art" that suits his own private intentions, he will choose a criticism in favor of this doctrine, or after reading it, he will hold it to heaven; Otherwise, use an article by a fake radical critic who seems to be very revolutionary and push it into the ground. The reader was fascinated. But personally, if he still has a little memory, but he can't be so ambivalent, he must have a certain circle. We can't blame him for having a circle, we can only criticize his circle or not.然而批评家的批评家会引出张献忠考秀才的古典来：先在两柱之间横系一条绳子，叫应考的走过去，太高的杀，太矮的也杀，于是杀光了蜀中的英才。这么一比，有定见的批评家即等于张献忠，真可以使读者发生满心的憎恨。但是，评文的圈，就是量人的绳吗？论文的合不合，就是量人的长短吗？引出这例子来的，是诬陷，更不是什么批评。
However, critics' critics will lead to Zhang Xianzhong's classic examination of scholars: first tie a rope horizontally between the two pillars, and ask the candidates to walk over, kill those who are too tall, and kill those who are too short, so that all the talents in Shu are killed. In this comparison, a critic with a fixed opinion is equivalent to Zhang Xianzhong, which can really make readers full of hatred. However, is the circle of commentary a rope to measure people? Is the compatibility of the paper a measure of the length of the person? What leads to this example is a false accusation, not a criticism.一月十七日。

漫骂

漫骂

漫骂

obloquy倪朔尔
Ni Shuoer还有一种不满于批评家的批评，是说所谓批评家好“漫骂”，所以他的文字并不是批评。
There is also a kind of criticism that is dissatisfied with critics, that is, the so-called critics are good at "scolding", so his words are not criticism.这“漫骂”，有人写作“嫚骂”，也有人写作“谩骂”，我不知道是否是一样的函义。但这姑且不管它也好。现在要问的是怎样的是“漫骂”。
This "scolding", some people write "insults", some people write "insults", I don't know if it is the same meaning. But that's okay for the time being. Now the question is what kind of "scolding" is.假如指着一个人，说道：这是婊子！如果她是良家，那就是漫骂；倘使她实在是做卖笑生涯的，就并不是漫骂，倒是说了真实。诗人没有捐班，富翁只会计较，因为事实是这样的，所以这是真话，即使称之为漫骂，诗人也还是捐不来，这是幻想碰在现实上的小钉子。
If you point to a person and say: This is a bitch! If she is a good family, it is a scolding; If she is really doing a career of laughing, it is not a scolding, but telling the truth. The poet did not donate to the class, the rich man only accounted, because the fact is like this, so this is the truth, even if it is called a scolding, the poet still can't donate, this is a small nail in reality that fantasy touches.有钱不能就有文才，比“儿女成行”并不一定明白儿童的性质更明白。“儿女成行”只能证明他两口子的善于生，还会养，却并无妄谈儿童的权利。要谈，只不过不识羞。这好像是漫骂，然而并不是。倘说是的，就得承认世界上的儿童心理学家，都是最会生孩子的父母。
Having money does not mean having literary talent, which is more understandable than "children traveling" does not necessarily understand the nature of children. "Children Travel" can only prove that the couple is good at giving birth and can raise them, but they do not talk about children's rights. If you want to talk, you just don't know how to be shy. This seems to be a scolding, but it is not. If yes, we have to admit that the child psychologists in the world are the parents who are the most good at having children.说儿童为了一点食物就会打起来，是冤枉儿童的，其实是漫骂。儿童的行为，出于天性，也因环境而改变，所以孔融会让梨。打起来的，是家庭的影响，便是成人，不也有争家私，夺遗产的吗？孩子学了样了。
To say that children will fight for a little food is to wrongfully accuse children, but in fact it is a scolding. Children's behavior changes by nature and environment, so Kong Rong will let the pear go. Those who fight are the influence of the family, that is, adults, don't they also fight for furniture and inheritance? The child learned the sample.漫骂固然冤屈了许多好人，但含含胡胡的扑灭“漫骂”，却包庇了一切坏种。
Although the scolding has wronged many good people, the scolding of the "scolding" has covered all the bad things.一月十七日。

“京派”与“海派”

“京派”与“海派”

“京派”与“海派”

"Beijing school" and "Shanghai school"栾廷石
Luan Tingshi自从北平某先生在某报上有扬“京派”而抑“海派”之言，颇引起了一番议论。最先是上海某先生在某杂志上的不平，且引别一某先生的陈言，以为作者的籍贯，与作品并无关系，要给北平某先生一个打击。
Since a certain Mr. in Peking published a statement in a newspaper promoting the "Beijing school" and suppressing the "Shanghai school", it has caused a lot of discussion. First of all, Mr. Shanghai's injustice in a magazine, and quoted Mr. Yi's statement, thinking that the author's place of origin had nothing to do with the work, and wanted to give a blow to Mr. Beiping.其实，这是不足以服北平某先生之心的。所谓“京派”与“海派”，本不指作者的本籍而言，所指的乃是一群人所聚的地域，故“京派”非皆北平人，“海派”亦非皆上海人。梅兰芳博士，戏中之真正京派也，而其本贯，则为吴下。但是，籍贯之都鄙，固不能定本人之功罪，居处的文陋，却也影响于作家的神情，孟子曰：“居移气，养移体”，此之谓也。北京是明清的帝都，上海乃各国之租界，帝都多官，租界多商，所以文人之在京者近官，没海者近商，近官者在使官得名，近商者在使商获利，而自己也赖以糊口。要而言之，不过“京派”是官的帮闲，“海派”则是商的帮忙而已。但从官得食者其情状隐，对外尚能傲然，从商得食者其情状显，到处难于掩饰，于是忘其所以者，遂据以有清浊之分。而官之鄙商，固亦中国旧习，就更使“海派”在“京派”的眼中跌落了。
In fact, this is not enough to convince Mr. Beiping. The so-called "Beijing school" and "Shanghai school" do not refer to the author's original home, but to the area where a group of people gather, so the "Beijing school" is not all Peking people, and the "Shanghai school" is not all Shanghainese. Dr. Mei Lanfang is the real Beijing school in the play, and his roots are Wu Xia. However, the place of origin is contemptible, of course, it cannot determine one's merits and faults, and the ugliness of the residence also affects the writer's expression, Mencius said: "Move the qi, nourish the body", this is what it means. Beijing is the imperial capital of the Ming and Qing dynasties, Shanghai is the concession of various countries, the imperial capital has many officials, and the concession is more merchants, so the literati in Beijing are close to the officials, the sea is close to the merchants, the officials are named in the envoys, and the merchants are making profits from the merchants, and they also rely on them for their livelihood. In short, the "Beijing school" is the help of officials, and the "Shanghai school" is just the help of merchants. However, the situation of those who get food from the government is hidden, and they can still be arrogant to the outside world, while those who get food from the business are obvious, and it is difficult to cover it up everywhere, so they forget the reason for it, so they use it to distinguish between clean and turbid. And the official's contempt for business, of course, is also an old Chinese habit, which makes the "Shanghai school" fall in the eyes of the "Beijing school".而北京学界，前此固亦有其光荣，这就是五四运动的策动。现在虽然还有历史上的光辉，但当时的战士，却“功成，名遂，身退”者有之，“身稳”者有之，“身升”者更有之，好好的一场恶斗，几乎令人有“若要官，杀人放火受招安”之感。“昔人已乘黄鹤去，此地空余黄鹤楼”，前年大难临头，北平的学者们所想援以掩护自己的是古文化，而惟一大事，则是古物的南迁，这不是自己彻底的说明了北平所有的是什么了吗？
The Beijing academic circles have their glory before, which is the instigation of the May Fourth Movement. Although there is still the glory of history, the soldiers at that time had "success, fame, and retirement", "stable", and even more "rising". "The ancients have gone on the Yellow Crane, and the Yellow Crane Tower is empty here", the year before last, the great disaster came, and the scholars of Peking wanted to cover themselves with ancient culture, and the only major event was the southward migration of antiquities.但北平究竟还有古物，且有古书，且有古都的人民。在北平的学者文人们，又大抵有着讲师或教授的本业，论理，研究或创作的环境，实在是比“海派”来得优越的，我希望着能够看见学术上，或文艺上的大著作。
But there are still antiquities in Peking, ancient books, and the people of the ancient capital. The scholars and literati in Peking probably have the profession of lecturers or professors, and the environment for theory, research or creation is really superior to that of the "Shanghai School", and I hope to see the great works of academics or literature and art.一月三十日。

北人与南人

北人与南人

北人与南人

Northerners and Southerners栾廷石
Luan Tingshi这是看了“京派”与“海派”的议论之后，牵连想到的——
This is what I thought of after reading the discussion between the "Beijing school" and the "Shanghai school" -北人的卑视南人，已经是一种传统。这也并非因为风俗习惯的不同，我想，那大原因，是在历来的侵入者多从北方来，先征服中国之北部，又携了北人南征，所以南人在北人的眼中，也是被征服者。
It is already a tradition for northerners to look down on southerners. This is not because of the difference in customs and habits, I think the main reason is that most of the invaders have always come from the north, first conquered the north of China, and then brought the northerners to the south, so the southerners are also conquered in the eyes of the northerners.二陆入晋，北方人士在欢欣之中，分明带着轻薄，举证太烦，姑且不谈罢。容易看的是，羊之的《洛阳伽蓝记》中，就常诋南人，并不视为同类。至于元，则人民截然分为四等，一蒙古人，二色目人，三汉人即北人，第四等才是南人，因为他是最后投降的一伙。最后投降，从这边说，是矢尽援绝，这才罢战的南方之强，从那边说，却是不识顺逆，久梗王师的贼。孑遗自然还是投降的，然而为奴隶的资格因此就最浅，因为浅，所以班次就最下，谁都不妨加以卑视了。到清朝，又重理了这一篇账，至今还流衍着余波；如果此后的历史是不再回旋的，那真不独是南人的如天之福。
Erlu entered Jin, and the northerners were in joy, clearly frivolous, and the evidence was too cumbersome, so let's not talk about it. It is easy to see that in Yang Zhi's "Luoyang Garan Ji", he often slanders the southerners and does not regard them as the same kind. As for the Yuan, the people are divided into four classes, one Mongolian, two colored people, three Han people, and the fourth class is the southerners, because he is the last to surrender. In the end, surrendered, from this side, it was the strength of the south that stopped fighting, but from that side, it was a thief who did not know obedience and rebellion, and had been blocking the royal army for a long time. The widow naturally surrendered, but the qualification to be a slave was therefore the shallowest, because it was shallow, so the shift was the lowest, and no one might as well look down on it. In the Qing Dynasty, this account was reorganized, and there are still aftermaths to this day; If history will no longer be revolving after that, it is really not only a blessing for southerners.当然，南人是有缺点的。权贵南迁，就带了腐败颓废的风气来，北方倒反而干净。性情也不同，有缺点，也有特长，正如北人的兼具二者一样。据我所见，北人的优点是厚重，南人的优点是机灵。但厚重之弊也愚，机灵之弊也狡，所以某先生曾经指出缺点道：北方人是“饱食终日，无所用心”；南方人是“群居终日，言不及义”。就有闲阶级而言，我以为大体是的确的。
Of course, southerners have shortcomings. The move of the powerful to the south brought with it a corrupt and decadent atmosphere, but the north was clean. The temperament is also different, with shortcomings and strengths, just like the northerners have both. As far as I can see, the advantage of northerners is that they are heavy, and the advantage of southerners is cleverness. But the disadvantages of thickness are also foolish, and the disadvantages of cleverness are also cunning, so a certain gentleman once pointed out the shortcomings and said: Northerners are "full of food all day long and have no intention"; Southerners are "living in groups all day long, and words are not as good as righteousness". As far as the idle class is concerned, I think it is generally true.缺点可以改正，优点可以相师。相书上有一条说，北人南相，南人北相者贵。我看这并不是妄语。北人南相者，是厚重而又机灵，南人北相者，不消说是机灵而又能厚重。昔人之所谓“贵”，不过是当时的成功，在现在，那就是做成有益的事业了。这是中国人的一种小小的自新之路。
Disadvantages can be corrected, and advantages can be learned. There is a saying in the book that northerners look at the south, and southerners are precious. I don't think this is a lie. The northerners and the southerners are thick and clever, and the southerners and the northerners are not to be said to be clever and heavy. The so-called "expensive" of the ancients was just a success at that time, and now, it is a beneficial business. This is a small road of self-renewal for the Chinese.不过做文章的是南人多，北方却受了影响。北京的报纸上，油嘴滑舌，吞吞吐吐，顾影自怜的文字不是比六七年前多了吗？这倘和北方固有的“贫嘴”一结婚，产生出来的一定是一种不祥的新劣种！
However, there are many people in the south who make a fuss, but the north is affected. In the newspapers in Beijing, isn't there more words of slippery tongue and hesitation, and Gu Ying is self-pity than six or seven years ago? If this marries the inherent "poor mouth" in the north, it must produce an ominous new bad species!一月三十日。

运命

Destiny倪朔尔
Ni Shuoer电影“《姊妹花》中的穷老太婆对她的穷女儿说：‘穷人终是穷人，你要忍耐些！’”宗汉先生慨然指出，名之曰“穷人哲学”（见《大晚报》）。
The poor old woman in the movie "Sister Flowers" said to her poor daughter: 'The poor are poor after all, you have to be patient!' Mr. Zonghan pointed out with emotion that it was called "Philosophy of the Poor" (see "Evening News").自然，这是教人安贫的，那根据是“运命”。古今圣贤的主张此说者已经不在少数了，但是不安贫的穷人也“终是”很不少。“智者千虑，必有一失”，这里的“失”，是在非到盖棺之后，一个人的运命“终是”不可知。
Naturally, this is to teach people to be poor, and the basis is "fate". There are not a few sages of ancient and modern times who advocate this statement, but there are also many poor people who are not poor. There are no people who predict fate, those who look at fortunes, those who line up horoscopes, everywhere. However, there are very few of them who are willing to conclude that he is poor to the end, and even if there is, everyone's doctrine cannot be consistent, A says to be poor, but B says to be rich, which makes the poor man unable to be sure of his future destiny.不信运命，就不能“安分”，穷人买奖券，便是一种“非分之想”。但这于国家，现在是不能说没有益处的。不过“有一利必有一弊”，运命既然不可知，穷人又何妨想做皇帝，这就使中国出现了《推背图》。据宋人说，五代时候，许多人都看了这图给自己的儿子取名字，希望应着将来的吉兆，直到宋太宗（？）抽乱了一百本，与别本一同流通，读者见次序多不相同，莫衷一是，这才不再珍藏了。然而九一八那时，上海却还大卖着《推背图》的新印本。
If you don't believe in fate, you can't "settle down", and the poor buy lottery tickets, which is a kind of "non-profit thought". But this cannot be said to be of no benefit to the country now. However, "there must be a benefit and a disadvantage", since fate is unknown, why not want to be an emperor, which led to the emergence of the "Tui Bei Tu" in China. According to the Song people, during the Five Dynasties, many people looked at this picture and named their sons, hoping to respond to the auspicious omens of the future, until Song Taizong (?) A hundred copies were randomly drawn and circulated with other books, and readers saw that the order was different, and they were inconsistent, so they no longer treasured it. However, at that time in 918, Shanghai was still selling a new print of "Tui Bei Tu".“安贫”诚然是天下太平的要道，但倘使无法指定究竟的运命，总不能令人死心塌地。现在的优生学，本可以说是科学的了，中国也正有人提倡着，冀以济运命说之穷，而历史又偏偏不挣气，汉高祖的父亲并非皇帝，李白的儿子也不是诗人；还有立志传，絮絮叨叨的在对人讲西洋的谁以冒险成功，谁又以空手致富。
"Poverty and poverty" is indeed the key to peace in the world, but if the ultimate fate cannot be specified, it cannot make people give up. The current eugenics can be said to be scientific, and some people in China are also advocating it, hoping to save the destiny of the poor, and history is not angry, Han Gaozu's father is not an emperor, and Li Bai's son is not a poet; There is also the biography of ambition, which is nagging to people about who succeeds in the West and who gets rich empty-handed.运命说之毫不足以治国平天下，是有明明白白的履历的。倘若还要用它来做工具，那中国的运命可真要“穷”极无聊了。
Fate is not enough to govern the country and pacify the world, and there is a clear resume. If it is still used as a tool, then China's fate will really be "poor" and extremely boring.二月二十三日。

The scandals in the "literary world" have really been exposed a lot in the past two years: cutting and pasting, copying, selling, and counterfeiting. But there are still things that cannot be investigated, just because we are used to seeing it and no longer pay attention to it.名人的题签，虽然字不见得一定写的好，但只在表示这书的作者或出版者认识名人，和内容并无关系，是算不得骗人的。可疑的是“校阅”。校阅的脚色，自然是名人，学者，教授。然而这些先生们自己却并无关于这一门学问的著作。所以真的校阅了没有是一个问题；即使真的校阅了，那校阅是否真的可靠又是一个问题。但再加校阅，给以批评的文章，我们却很少见。
Although the words of celebrities are not necessarily well written, they only mean that the author or publisher of the book knows the celebrity and has nothing to do with the content, which is not deceptive. What is suspicious is "proofreading". The foot of the review is naturally celebrities, scholars, and professors. However, these gentlemen themselves have no writings on this subject. So it is not a problem to really proofread; Even if it is really proofread, whether it is really reliable is another question. But we rarely see articles that are reviewed and criticized.还有一种是“编辑”。这编辑者，也大抵是名人，因这名，就使读者觉得那书的可靠。但这是也很可疑的。如果那书上有些序跋，我们还可以由那文章，思想，断定它是否真是这人所编辑，但市上所陈列的书，常有翻开便是目录，叫你一点也摸不着头脑的。这怎么靠得住？至于大部的各门类的刊物的所谓“主编”，那是这位名人竟上至天空，下至地底，无不通晓了，“无为而无不为”，倒使我们无须再加以揣测。
There is also an "edit". This editor is probably a celebrity, and because of this name, the reader feels that the book is reliable. But this is also suspicious. If there is some preface to the book, we can also judge whether it was really edited by this person from the article and thought, but the books on display in the market often open the table of contents, so that you will not be able to scratch your head at all. How can this be reliable? As for the so-called "editor-in-chief" of most of the various types of publications, it is that this celebrity is so knowledgeable that he knows everything from the sky to the ground, "doing nothing and doing everything", so that we don't need to speculate anymore.还有一种是“特约撰稿”。刊物初出，广告上往往开列一大批特约撰稿的名人，有时还用凸版印出作者亲笔的签名，以显示其真实。这并不可疑。然而过了一年半载，可就渐有破绽了，许多所谓特约撰稿者的东西一个字也不见。是并没有约，还是约而不来呢，我们无从知道；但可见那些所谓亲笔签名，也许是从别处剪来，或者简直是假造的了。要是从投稿上取下来的，为什么见签名却不见稿呢？
The other is "special writer". When publications first came out, advertisements often listed a large number of celebrities who wrote for them, and sometimes the author's autograph was printed with letterpress to show their authenticity. This is not suspicious. However, after a year and a half, there were gradually flaws, and many of the so-called contributors did not say a word. Whether there is no appointment, or whether the appointment does not come, we have no way of knowing; But it can be seen that those so-called autographs may have been cut from elsewhere, or they are simply fake. If it is taken from the submission, why is it that the signature is seen but not the manuscript?这些名人在卖着他们的“名”，不知道可是领着“干薪”的？倘使领的，自然是同意的自卖，否则，可以说是被“盗卖”。“欺世盗名”者有之，盗卖名以欺世者又有之，世事也真是五花八门。然而受损失的却只有读者。
These celebrities are selling their "name", I don't know if they are receiving "dry salaries"? If you receive it, it is naturally a self-sale with consent, otherwise, it can be said that it is "stolen and sold". There are people who "deceive the world and steal names", and there are also people who steal and sell names to deceive the world, and the world is really diverse. However, only the reader suffers.三月七日。

“小童挡驾”

“小童挡驾”宓子章
Mi Zizhang近五六年来的外国电影，是先给我们看了一通洋侠客的勇敢，于是而野蛮人的陋劣，又于是而洋小姐的曲线美。但是，眼界是要大起来的，终于几条腿不够了，于是一大丛；又不够了，于是赤条条。这就是“裸体运动大写真”，虽然是正正堂堂的“人体美与健康美的表现”，然而又是“小童挡驾”的，他们不配看这些“美”。
In the past five or six years, foreign movies have shown us the bravery of foreign knights, then the ugliness of savages, and then the curvaceous beauty of foreign misses. However, the vision is to be bigger, and finally a few legs are not enough, so there is a big bush; It wasn't enough, so I went red. "Because I can't get enough of it, it's terrible!"不过肯这样说的“爸爸”恐怕也未必有。他总要“以己之心，度人之心”，度了之后，便将这心硬塞在别人的腔子里，装作不是自己的，而说别人的心没有他的干净。裸体女人的都“不回过身子儿来”，其实是专为对付这一类人物的。她们难道是白痴，连“爸爸”的眼色，比他孩子的更不规矩都不知道吗？

古人并不纯厚

古人并不纯厚

古人并不纯厚

The ancients were not pure翁隼
Weng Falcon老辈往往说：古人比今人纯厚，心好，寿长。我先前也有些相信，现在这信仰可是动摇了。达赖啦嘛总该比平常人心好，虽然“不幸短命死矣”，但广州开的耆英会，却明明收集过一大批寿翁寿媪，活了一百零六岁的老太太还能穿针，有照片为证。
The elders often say: The ancients were pure, good-hearted, and long-lived than today's people. I used to believe a little, but now this faith has been shaken. The Dalai Lama should always be better than ordinary people, although "unfortunately died short-lived", but the Senior Citizens Association held in Guangzhou has clearly collected a large number of longevity elders and elderly women, and the old lady who lived one hundred and six years old can still thread needles, as evidenced by photos.古今的心的好坏，较为难以比较，只好求教于诗文。古之诗人，是有名的“温柔敦厚”的，而有的竟说：“时日曷丧，予及汝偕亡！”你看够多么恶毒？更奇怪的是孔子“校阅”之后，竟没有删，还说什么“诗三百，一言以蔽之，曰：思无邪”哩，好像圣人也并不以为可恶。
It is difficult to compare the quality of the heart in ancient and modern times, so I have to seek advice from poetry and literature. The ancient poets were famous for their "gentle and honest", and some actually said: "Time is lost, and I will die with you!" "How vicious have you seen enough? What's even more strange is that after Confucius "reviewed", he did not delete it, and said "three hundred poems, in a word, say: Si Wu Xie", as if the sage did not think it was hateful.还有现存的最通行的《文选》，听说如果青年作家要丰富语汇，或描写建筑，是总得看它的，但我们倘一调查里面的作家，却至少有一半不得好死，当然，就因为心不好。经昭明太子一挑选，固然好像变成语汇祖师了，但在那时，恐怕还有个人的主张，偏激的文字。否则，这人是不传的，试翻唐以前的史上的文苑传，大抵是禀承意旨，草檄作颂的人，然而那些作者的文章，流传至今者偏偏少得很。
I heard that if young writers want to enrich their vocabulary or describe architecture, they must look at it, but if we investigate the writers in it, at least half of them will not die well, of course, because of a bad heart. After being selected by Prince Zhaoming, it seems that he has become the ancestor of vocabulary, but at that time, I am afraid that there are still personal opinions and extreme words. Otherwise, this person will not be passed on, and if you try to turn over the literary biography in the history before the Tang Dynasty, it is probably a person who follows the will and drafts a proclamation, but the articles of those authors have been passed down to this day.由此看来，翻印整部的古书，也就不无危险了。近来偶尔看见一部石印的《平斋文集》，作者，宋人也，不可谓之不古，但其诗就不可为训。如咏《狐鼠》云：“狐鼠擅一窟，虎蛇行九逵，不论天有眼，但管地无皮……。”又咏《荆公》云：“养就祸胎身始去，依然钟阜向人青”。那指斥当路的口气，就为今人所看不惯。“八大家”中的欧阳修，是不能算作偏激的文学家的罢，然而那《读李翱文》中却有云：“呜呼，在位而不肯自忧，又禁它人使皆不得忧，可叹也夫！”也就悻悻得很。
From this point of view, it is not without danger to reprint the entire ancient book. Recently, I occasionally saw a lithograph of the "Pingzhai Collection", the author, a Song person, cannot be said to be not ancient, but his poems cannot be taught. For example, the poem "Fox and Mouse" says: "The fox and the rat are good at a cave, the tiger and snake are nine Kui, no matter the sky has eyes, but there is no skin ...... the earth." He also recited "Jing Gong": "Raising the womb of misfortune begins to go, and it is still Zhongfu to the green of the people." The tone of criticizing the authorities is not accustomed to today's people. Ouyang Xiu in the "Eight Masters" cannot be regarded as an extreme writer, but there is a cloud in "Reading Li Aowen": "Alas, it is lamentable that he refuses to worry about himself while in power, and forbids others from worrying about himself!" It's very frustrating.但是，经后人一番选择，却就纯厚起来了。后人能使古人纯厚，则比古人更为纯厚也可见。清朝曾有钦定的《唐宋文醇》和《唐宋诗醇》，便是由皇帝将古人做得纯厚的好标本，不久也许会有人翻印，以“挽狂澜于既倒”的。
However, after the choice of later generations, it became pure. If later generations can make the ancients pure and thick, it can be seen that they are more pure and thick than the ancients. The Qing Dynasty once had the "Tang and Song Literary Alcohol" and "Tang and Song Poetry Alcohol", which were good specimens made by the emperor of the ancients, and soon someone may reprint them to "turn the tide".四月十五日。

洋服的没落

洋服的没落

洋服的没落

The decline of the dress韦士繇
Wei Shiyao几十年来，我们常常恨着自己没有合意的衣服穿。清朝末年，带些革命色采的英雄不但恨辫子，也恨马褂和袍子，因为这是满洲服。一位老先生到日本去游历，看见那边的服装，高兴的了不得，做了一篇文章登在杂志上，叫作《不图今日重见汉官仪》。他是赞成恢复古装的。
For decades, we often hated ourselves for not having clothes to wear. At the end of the Qing Dynasty, heroes with some revolutionary colors not only hated braids, but also hated horse coats and robes, because this was a Manchurian uniform. An old gentleman traveled to Japan, saw the costumes there, was very happy, and made an article in a magazine called "I don't want to see Han Guanyi again today". He was in favor of restoring the costume.然而革命之后，采用的却是洋装，这是因为大家要维新，要便捷，要腰骨笔挺。少年英俊之徒，不但自己必洋装，还厌恶别人穿袍子。那时听说竟有人去责问樊山老人，问他为什么要穿满洲的衣裳。樊山回问道：“你穿的是那里的服饰呢？”少年答道：“我穿的是外国服。”樊山道：“我穿的也是外国服。”
However, after the revolution, dresses were adopted, because everyone wanted to be reformed, convenient, and straight. Young handsome people not only have to dress themselves, but also hate others wearing robes. At that time, I heard that someone actually questioned the old man of Fanshan and asked him why he wore Manchurian clothes. Fan Shan asked back: "Are you wearing the clothes there?" The boy replied: "I am wearing a foreign dress." Fan Shan said: "I am also wearing foreign clothes." ”这故事颇为传诵一时，给袍褂党扬眉吐气。不过其中是带一点反对革命的意味的，和近日的因为卫生，因为经济的大两样。后来，洋服终于和华人渐渐的反目了，不但袁世凯朝，就定袍子马褂为常礼服，五四运动之后，北京大学要整饬校风，规定制服了，请学生们公议，那议决的也是：袍子和马褂！
This story was quite recited for a while, raising its eyebrows to the robe party. However, there is a bit of opposition to the revolution, which is different from the recent one because of health and because of the economy. Later, the clothes finally turned against the Chinese, not only Yuan Shikai dynasty, but also set the robe and horse coat as the usual dress, after the May Fourth Movement, Peking University wanted to rectify the school spirit, stipulate the uniform, and invite the students to discuss it, and the decision was also: robe and horse coat!这回的不取洋服的原因却正如林语堂先生所说，因其不合于卫生。造化赋给我们的腰和脖子，本是可以弯曲的，弯腰曲背，在中国是一种常态，逆来尚须顺受，顺来自然更当顺受了。所以我们是最能研究人体，顺其自然而用之的人民。脖子最细，发明了砍头；膝关节能弯，发明了下跪；臀部多肉，又不致命，就发明了打屁股。违反自然的洋服，于是便渐渐的自然的没落了。
The reason for not taking clothes this time is as Mr. Lin Yutang said, because it is not hygienic. The waist and neck given to us by nature can be bent, bending over and bending the back, which is the norm in China. Therefore, we are the people who can best study the human body and use it naturally. the neck is the thinnest, and the head is invented; the knee joint can be bent, and kneeling was invented; The buttocks are fleshy and not fatal, so spanking was invented. Clothes that violate nature, so they gradually declined naturally.这洋服的遗迹，现在已只残留在摩登男女的身上，恰如辫子小脚，不过偶然还见于顽固男女的身上一般。不料竟又来了一道催命符，是镪水悄悄从背后洒过来了。
The remains of this dress now only remain on the bodies of modern men and women, just like braided feet, but occasionally they are seen on the bodies of stubborn men and women. Unexpectedly, another life-reminder came, and it was the water that quietly spilled from behind.这怎么办呢？

But you must understand: the genius who clings to this golden sentence, but his mind is being ridden by Schopenhauer and trampled on a mess.现在是批评家在发牢骚，因为没有较好的作品；创作家也在发牢骚，因为没有正确的批评。张三说李四的作品是象征主义，于是李四也自以为是象征主义，读者当然更以为是象征主义。然而怎样是象征主义呢？向来就没有弄分明，只好就用李四的作品为证。所以中国之所谓象征主义，和别国之所谓Symbolism是不一样的，虽然前者其实是后者的译语，然而听说梅特林是象征派的作家，于是李四就成为中国的梅特林了。此外中国的法朗士，中国的白璧德，中国的吉尔波丁，中国的高尔基……还多得很。然而真的法朗士他们的作品的译本，在中国却少得很。莫非因为都有了“国货”的缘故吗？
Now the critics are complaining because there are no better works; Creators are also complaining because there is no right criticism. Zhang San said that Li Si's works were symbolism, so Li Si also thought he was symbolism, and the reader certainly thought it was symbolism. But what is symbolism? I have never been clear, so I have to use Li Si's works as proof. Therefore, the so-called symbolism in China is different from the so-called Symbolism in other countries, although the former is actually a translation of the latter, but I heard that Maitlin was a writer of the Symbolist school, so Li Si became the Maitlin of China. In addition, China's Frances, China's Bai Bide, China's Gilbertin, China's Gorky...... There are many. However, there are very few translations of the works of the real Francens in China. Could it be because they all have "domestic products"?在中国的文坛上，有几个国货文人的寿命也真太长；而洋货文人的可也真太短，姓名刚刚记熟，据说是已经过去了。易卜生大有出全集之意，但至今不见第三本；柴霍甫和莫泊桑的选集，也似乎走了虎头蛇尾运。但在我们所深恶痛疾的日本，《吉诃德先生》和《一千一夜》是有全译的；沙士比亚，歌德，……都有全集；托尔斯泰的有三种，陀思妥也夫斯基的有两种。
In China's literary world, there are several domestic literati who have a really long lifespan; And the foreign literati are really too short, the name has just been remembered, and it is said that it has passed. Ibsen had the intention of publishing a complete collection, but the third book has not been seen so far; The anthologies of Chai Huofu and Maupassant also seem to have gone anticlimactic. But in Japan, which we hate so much, "Mr. Quixote" and "One Thousand and One Nights" have been fully translated; Shakespeare, Goethe,...... There are complete works; There are three of Tolstoy's and two of Dostoevsky's.读死书是害己，一开口就害人；但不读书也并不见得好。至少，譬如要批评托尔斯泰，则他的作品是必得看几本的。自然，现在是国难时期，那有工夫译这些书，看这些书呢，但我所提议的是向着只在暴躁和牢骚的大人物，并非对于正在赴难或“卧薪尝胆”的英雄。因为有些人物，是即使不读书，也不过玩着，并不去赴难的。
Reading dead books is harmful to oneself, and as soon as you open your mouth, you will harm others; But not reading is not necessarily good. At least, if you want to criticize Tolstoy, you must read a few of his works. Dream text忘了几年以前了，有一位诗人开导我，说是愚众的舆论，能将天才骂死，例如英国的济慈就是。我相信了。去年看见几位名作家的文章，说是批评家的漫骂，能将好作品骂得缩回去，使文坛荒凉冷落。自然，我也相信了。
I forgot that a few years ago, a poet enlightened me, saying that it was the public opinion of the fools that could scold geniuses to death, such as Keats in England. I believed it. Last year, I saw articles by several famous writers, saying that they were critics' scolding, which could scold good works and make the literary world desolate and neglected. Naturally, I also believed it.我也是一个想做作家的人，而且觉得自己也确是一个作家，但还没有获得挨骂的资格，因为我未曾写过创作。并非缩回去，是还没有钻出来。这钻不出来的原因，我想是一定为了我的女人和两个孩子的吵闹，她们也如漫骂批评家一样，职务是在毁灭真天才，吓退好作品的。
I am also a person who wants to be a writer, and I feel that I am indeed a writer, but I have not yet qualified to be scolded because I have never written. It's not that it has retracted, it hasn't come out yet. The reason why I can't get out of this, I think, must be because of the noise of my woman and two children, who are also like critics, and their position is to destroy true geniuses and scare away good works.幸喜今年正月，我的丈母要见见她的女儿了，她们三个就都回到乡下去。我真是耳目清静，猗欤休哉，到了产生伟大作品的时代。可是不幸得很，现在已是废历四月初，足足静了三个月了，还是一点也写不出什么来。假使有朋友问起我的成绩，叫我怎么回答呢？还能归罪于她们的吵闹吗？
Fortunately, in the first month of this year, my mother-in-law was going to see her daughter, and all three of them went back to the countryside. I am really quiet and refreshing, and I have reached the era of producing great works. But unfortunately, it is now the beginning of April of the abolition calendar, and it has been quiet for three months, and I still can't write anything at all. If a friend asks about my grades, how do you ask me to answer? Can they still be blamed for their noise?于是乎我的信心有些动摇。
So my faith was a little shaken.我疑心我本不会有什么好作品，和她们的吵闹与否无关。而且我又疑心到所谓名作家也未必会有什么好作品，和批评家的漫骂与否无涉。

He is like a student in distress, even if he does not have a work, he can win handfuls of tears of sympathy from the audience.假使世界上真有天才，那么，漫骂的批评，于他是有损的，能骂退他的作品，使他不成其为作家。然而所谓漫骂的批评，于庸才是有益的，能保持其为作家，不过据说是吓退了他的作品。
If there is really a genius in the world, then the criticism of the scolding is detrimental to him, and it can scold his works and make him not a writer. Occasional feeling公汗
Public sweat还记得东三省沦亡，上海打仗的时候，在只闻炮声，不愁炮弹的马路上，处处卖着《推背图》，这可见人们早想归失败之故于前定了。三年以后，华北华南，同濒危急，而上海却出现了“碟仙”。前者所关心的还是国运，后者却只在问试题，奖券，亡魂。着眼的大小，固已迥不相同，而名目则更加冠冕，因为这“灵乩”是中国的“留德学生白同君所发明”，合于“科学”的。

There are young people who go abroad to study disciplines, and there are doctors who have studied science and return to China. Science is not only not enough to make up for the shortcomings of Chinese culture, but also proves the profundity of Chinese culture. Feng Shui is in line with geography, gate valve is in line with eugenics, alchemy is in line with chemistry, and kite flying is in line with hygiene. "Lingqi" is in line with "science", and it is only one of them.五四时代，陈大齐先生曾作论揭发过扶乩的骗人，隔了十六年，白同先生却用碟子证明了扶乩的合理，这真叫人从那里说起。

Moreover, science not only proves the profundity of Chinese culture, but also helps to promote Chinese culture. At the horse general's table, electric lights replaced candles, and on the puja altar, magnesium light shone out of the lama, and what the radio broadcast spread every day was not often "Tanuki for the Prince", "Yutang Chun", "Thank You Drizzle"?老子曰：“为之斗斛以量之，则并与斗斛而窃之。”罗兰夫人曰：“自由自由，多少罪恶，假汝之名以行！”每一新制度，新学术，新名词，传入中国，便如落在黑色染缸，立刻乌黑一团，化为济私助焰之具，科学，亦不过其一而已。

论秦理斋夫人事

论秦理斋夫人事

论秦理斋夫人事

On the matter of Mrs. Qin Lizhai公汗
Public sweat这几年来，报章上常见有因经济的压迫，礼教的制裁而自杀的记事，但为了这些，便来开口或动笔的人是很少的。只有新近秦理斋夫人及其子女一家四口的自杀，却起过不少的回声，后来还出了一个怀着这一段新闻记事的自杀者，更可见其影响之大了。我想，这是因为人数多。单独的自杀，盖已不足以招大家的青睐了。
In recent years, there have been common reports of suicides due to economic oppression and etiquette sanctions in newspapers, but for these reasons, very few people have come to speak or write. Only the recent suicide of Mrs. Qin Lizhai and her children's family of four has had a lot of echoes, and later there was a suicide with this news record, which shows its great impact. I think it's because of the large number of people. Suicide alone is no longer enough to win everyone's favor.一切回声中，对于这自杀的主谋者——秦夫人，虽然也加以恕辞；但归结却无非是诛伐。因为——评论家说——社会虽然黑暗，但人生的第一责任是生存，倘自杀，便是失职，第二责任是受苦，倘自杀，便是偷安。进步的评论家则说人生是战斗，自杀者就是逃兵，虽死也不足以蔽其罪。这自然也说得下去的，然而未免太笼统。
In all the echoes, the mastermind of this suicide, Mrs. Qin, although she also forgave her; But in the end, it is nothing more than a punishment. Because—critics say—although society is dark, the first responsibility of life is to survive, if you commit suicide, it is dereliction of duty, the second responsibility is to suffer, and if you commit suicide, it is to steal peace. Progressive commentators say that life is a battle, and that suicides are deserters, and even if they die, they are not enough to cover up their crimes. This is naturally reasonable, but it is too general.人间有犯罪学者，一派说，由于环境；一派说，由于个人。现在盛行的是后一说，因为倘信前一派，则消灭罪犯，便得改造环境，事情就麻烦，可怕了。而秦夫人自杀的批判者，则是大抵属于后一派。
There are criminologists in the world, one school says, because of the environment; One school says that due to the individual. The latter is now prevalent, because if you believe in the former faction, you will have to eliminate the criminals and change the environment, and things will be troublesome and terrible. The critics of Mrs. Qin's suicide probably belong to the latter faction.诚然，既然自杀了，这就证明了她是一个弱者。但是，怎么会弱的呢？要紧的是我们须看看她的尊翁的信札，为了要她回去，既耸之以两家的名声，又动之以亡人的乩语。我们还得看看她的令弟的挽联：“妻殉夫，子殉母……”不是大有视为千古美谈之意吗？以生长及陶冶在这样的家庭中的人，又怎么能不成为弱者？我们固然未始不可责以奋斗，但黑暗的吞噬之力，往往胜于孤军，况且自杀的批判者未必就是战斗的应援者，当他人奋斗时，挣扎时，败绩时，也许倒是鸦雀无声了。穷乡僻壤或都会中，孤儿寡妇，贫女劳人之顺命而死，或虽然抗命，而终于不得不死者何限，但曾经上谁的口，动谁的心呢？真是“自经于沟渎而莫之知也”！
True, since she committed suicide, this proves that she is a weakling. But how can it be weak? The important thing is that we must look at her father's letter, in order to get her back, not only to raise the reputation of the two families, but also to move the words of the dead. We also have to look at her brother's elegy: "Wife martyrdom husband, son martyrdom mother......" Isn't it a great meaning to regard it as a beautiful story through the ages? How can a person who grows up and cultivate in such a family not become a weak person? Although we are not blamed for struggle, the devouring power of darkness is often better than a lone army, and the critic of suicide may not be the supporter of the battle, and when others struggle, struggle, and lose, they may be silent. In poor villages or cities, orphans and widows, poor women and laborers die obediently, or although they disobey orders, they finally have to die, but whose mouth and heart have they touched? It's really "hanging yourself in a ditch and not knowing"!人固然应该生存，但为的是进化；也不妨受苦，但为的是解除将来的一切苦；更应该战斗，但为的是改革。责别人的自杀者，一面责人，一面正也应该向驱人于自杀之途的环境挑战，进攻。倘使对于黑暗的主力，不置一辞，不发一矢，而但向“弱者”唠叨不已，则纵使他如何义形于色，我也不能不说——我真也忍不住了——他其实乃是杀人者的帮凶而已。
Of course, people should live, but in order to evolve; they may as well suffer, but in order to relieve all suffering in the future; We should fight, but for reform. Blaming others for suicides should challenge and attack the environment that drives people to commit suicide. If he doesn't say a word or shoot an arrow at the main force of darkness, but only nags at the "weak", no matter how righteous he is, I can't help but say - I really can't help it - he is actually just an accomplice of the murderer.五月二十四日。

“……”“□□□□”论补

"......" and "□□□□" are supplemented曼雪
Manxue徐先生在《人间世》上，发表了这样的题目的论。对于此道，我没有那么深造，但“愚者千虑，必有一得”，所以想来补一点，自然，浅薄是浅薄得多了。
Mr. Xu published such a thesis in "The World on Earth". I don't have that much further study on this path, but "a fool thinks a thousand times, and there must be a gain", so I want to make up for it, naturally, shallow is much shallow.“……”是洋货，五四运动之后这才输入的。先前林琴南先生译小说时，夹注着“此语未完”的，便是这东西的翻译。在洋书上，普通用六点，吝啬的却只用三点。然而中国是“地大物博”的，同化之际，就渐渐的长起来，九点，十二点，以至几十点；有一种大作家，则简直至少点上三四行，以见其中的奥义，无穷无尽，实在不可以言语形容。读者也大抵这样想，有敢说觉不出其中的奥义的罢，那便是低能儿。
"......" is a foreign product, which was only imported after the May Fourth Movement. Previously, when Mr. Lin Qinnan translated the novel, it was the translation of this thing that was marked with "this word is not finished". In foreign books, six points are usually used, but only three points are used for stingy ones. However, China is "vast and rich", and when assimilated, it gradually grew, nine o'clock, twelve o'clock, and even dozens of o'clock; There is a kind of great writer who simply dots on at least three or four lines to see the mystery in it, which is endless and cannot be described in words. Readers probably think like this, and those who dare to say that they can't feel the mystery in it are imbecile.然而归根结蒂，也好像终于是安徒生童话里的“皇帝的新衣”，其实是一无所有；不过须是孩子，才会照实的大声说出来。孩子不会看文学家的“创作”，于是在中国就没有人来道破。但天气是要冷的，光着身子不能整年在路上走，到底也得躲进宫里去，连点几行的妙文，近来也不大看见了。
However, in the final analysis, it seems that the "emperor's new clothes" in Hans Christian Andersen's fairy tale are actually nothing; But you have to be a child to say it out loud. Children do not read the "creations" of writers, so no one in China comes to explain it. But the weather is going to be cold, you can't walk on the road all year round naked, and you have to hide in the palace in the end.“□□”是国货，《穆天子传》上就有这玩意儿，先生教我说：是阙文。这阙文也闹过事，曾有人说“口生垢，口戕口”的三个口字，也是阙文，又给谁大骂了一顿。不过先前是只见于古人的著作里的，无法可补，现在却见于今人的著作上了，欲补不能。到目前，则渐有代以“××”的趋势。这是从日本输入的。这东西多，对于这著作的内容，我们便预觉其激烈。但是，其实有时也并不然。胡乱×它几行，印了出来，固可使读者佩服作家之激烈，恨检查员之峻严，但送检之际，却又可使检查员爱他的顺从，许多话都不敢说，只×得这么起劲。一举两得，比点它几行更加巧妙了。中国正在排日，这一条锦囊妙计，或者不至于模仿的罢。
"□□" is a domestic product, and there is this thing in "The Biography of Mu Tianzi", and my teacher taught me that it is a que. This Que Wen has also made trouble, and someone once said that the three words "mouth dirt, mouth killing" are also Que Wen, and who scolded him. However, it was only seen in the writings of the ancients before and could not be supplemented, but now it is seen in the writings of today's people, and it cannot be supplemented. Up to now, there is a trend of "××". This is imported from Japan. There are many things like this, and we have a premonition that the content of this work will be intense. However, sometimes this is not the case. × a few lines randomly and printed it out, which can certainly make the reader admire the fierceness of the writer and hate the severity of the inspector, but when it is sent for inspection, it can make the inspector love his obedience, and he does not dare to say many words, but he × so energetic. Killing two birds with one stone is more ingenious than clicking on a few lines of it. China is arranging Japan, and this clever plan may not be imitated.现在是什么东西都要用钱买，自然也就都可以卖钱。但连“没有东西”也可以卖钱，却未免有些出乎意表。不过，知道了这事以后，便明白造谣为业，在现在也还要算是“货真价实，童叟无欺”的生活了。
Now everything has to be bought with money, so naturally it can be sold for money. But even "nothing" can be sold for money, which is a bit unexpected. However, after knowing this, I understood that rumor-mongering is a business, and now it can be regarded as a "genuine and honest" life.五月二十四日。
May 24th.

谁在没落？

谁在没落？

谁在没落？

Who is declining?常庚
Chang Geng五月二十八日的《大晚报》告诉了我们一件文艺上的重要的新闻：
The "Evening News" on May 28 told us an important news in literature and art:“我国美术名家刘海粟徐悲鸿等，近在苏俄莫斯科举行中国书画展览会，深得彼邦人士极力赞美，揄扬我国之书画名作，切合苏俄正在盛行之象征主义作品。爰苏俄艺术界向分写实与象征两派，现写实主义已渐没落，而象征主义则经朝野一致提倡，引成欣欣向荣之概。自彼邦艺术家见我国之书画作品深合象征派后，即忆及中国戏剧亦必采取象征主义。因拟……邀中国戏曲名家梅兰芳等前往奏艺。此事已由俄方与中国驻俄大使馆接洽，同时苏俄驻华大使鲍格莫洛夫亦奉到训令，与我方商洽此事。……”
"Liu Haisu, Xu Beihong, and other famous artists in our country recently held a Chinese calligraphy and painting exhibition in Moscow, Soviet Russia, which was highly praised by people in other countries, praising our country's calligraphy and painting masterpieces, and in line with the symbolism works that are prevalent in Soviet Russia. The Soviet and Russian art circles were divided into realism and symbolism, and now realism has gradually declined, while symbolism has been unanimously advocated by the government and the opposition, leading to a prosperous concept. Since the artists of other countries saw that our country's calligraphy and painting works were deeply in line with the symbolism, they recalled that Chinese drama must also adopt symbolism. Therefore, he drafted a ...... Invited Chinese opera master Mei Lanfang and others to perform the art. This matter has been contacted by the Russian side and the Chinese Embassy in Russia, and at the same time, the Soviet Ambassador to China Bogmolov has also been instructed to discuss this matter with our side. ……”这是一个喜讯，值得我们高兴的。但我们当欣喜于“发扬国光”之后，还应该沉静一下，想到以下的事实——
This is good news and deserves our joy. But when we are happy to "carry forward the national light", we should calm down and think of the following facts -一，倘说：中国画和印象主义有一脉相通，那倒还说得下去的，现在以为“切合苏俄正在盛行之象征主义”，却未免近于梦话。半枝紫藤，一株松树，一个老虎，几匹麻雀，有些确乎是不像真的，但那是因为画不像的缘故，何尝“象征”着别的什么呢？
First, if Chinese painting and impressionism are in the same vein, then it can be said that it is "in line with the symbolism that is prevalent in Soviet Russia", but it is close to a dream. Half a wisteria, a pine tree, a tiger, a few sparrows, some of them are indeed not real, but that is because the painting is not like it, how can it "symbolize" something else?二，苏俄的象征主义的没落，在十月革命时，以后便崛起了构成主义，而此后又渐为写实主义所排去。所以倘说：构成主义已渐没落，而写实主义“引成欣欣向荣之概”，那是说得下去的。不然，便是梦话。苏俄文艺界上，象征主义的作品有些什么呀？
Second, the decline of symbolism in Soviet Russia, during the October Revolution, later rose to constructivism, and then gradually fell into the hands of realism. Therefore, if it is said that constructivism has gradually declined, and realism "leads to a prosperous generalization", it can be said. Otherwise, it is a dream. In the Soviet and Russian literary and artistic circles, what are the works of symbolism?三，脸谱和手势，是代数，何尝是象征。它除了白鼻梁表丑脚，花脸表强人，执鞭表骑马，推手表开门之外，那里还有什么说不出，做不出的深意义？
Third, face and gestures are algebra, not symbols. In addition to the white nose bridge to show ugly feet, the flowery face to show the strong man, the whip to ride a horse, and the watch to open the door, what is the deep meaning that cannot be said or done?欧洲离我们也真远，我们对于那边的文艺情形也真的不大分明，但是，现在二十世纪已经度过了三分之一，粗浅的事是知道一点的了，这样的新闻倒令人觉得是“象征主义作品”，它象征着他们的艺术的消亡。
Europe is really far away from us, and we really don't know much about the literary and artistic situation there, but now that a third of the twentieth century has passed, we know a little about superficial things, and such news makes people feel that it is a "symbolist work", which symbolizes the demise of their art.五月三十日。
May 30.

倒提

Lift upside down公汗
Public sweat西洋的慈善家是怕看虐待动物的，倒提着鸡鸭走过租界就要办。所谓办，虽然也不过是罚钱，只要舍得出钱，也还可以倒提一下，然而究竟是办了。于是有几位华人便大鸣不平，以为西洋人优待动物，虐待华人，至于比不上鸡鸭。
Western philanthropists are afraid of animal cruelty, so they have to do it when they walk through the concession with chickens and ducks. The so-called doing, although it is just a fine, as long as you are willing to give up the money, you can also mention it backwards, but it is done in the end. As a result, several Chinese complained, thinking that Westerners treated animals preferentially and abused Chinese, so that they were not as good as chickens and ducks.这其实是误解了西洋人。他们鄙夷我们，是的确的，但并未放在动物之下。自然，鸡鸭这东西，无论如何，总不过送进厨房，做成大菜而已，即顺提也何补于归根结蒂的运命。然而它不能言语，不会抵抗，又何必加以无益的虐待呢？西洋人是什么都讲有益的。我们的古人，人民的“倒悬”之苦是想到的了，而且也实在形容得切帖，不过还没有察出鸡鸭的倒提之灾来，然而对于什么“生刲驴肉”“活烤鹅掌”这些无聊的残虐，却早经在文章里加以攻击了。这种心思，是东西之所同具的。
This is actually a misunderstanding of Westerners. They despise us, yes, but they don't put us under animals. Naturally, chicken and duck, no matter what, are just sent to the kitchen and made into a big dish, even if it is shunted, it is of no help to the fate of the root cause. But it cannot speak, it cannot resist, so why abuse it uselessly? Westerners talk about everything that is beneficial. Our ancients, the people's suffering of "hanging upside down" was thought of, and it was really described aptly, but the disaster of chickens and ducks was not detected, but for the boring cruelty of "raw donkey meat" and "live roasted goose feet", they have long been attacked in the article. This kind of mind is the same as that of things.但对于人的心思，却似乎有些不同。人能组织，能反抗，能为奴，也能为主，不肯努力，固然可以永沦为舆台，自由解放，便能够获得彼此的平等，那运命是并不一定终于送进厨房，做成大菜的。愈下劣者，愈得主人的爱怜，所以西崽打叭儿，则西崽被斥，平人忤西崽，则平人获咎，租界上并无禁止苛待华人的规律，正因为我们该自有力量，自有本领，和鸡鸭绝不相同的缘故。
But for people's minds, it seems to be a little different. People can organize, resist, be slaves, and masters, and refuse to work hard, although they can be reduced to public opinion forever, free and liberated, and can obtain equality with each other, then fate may not necessarily finally be sent to the kitchen and made into a big dish. The worse the concession, the more the love of the master, so if the Xi cub beats the child, the Xi cub will be reprimanded, and if the ordinary person offends the Xi cub, the ordinary person will be blamed, and there is no law on the concession that prohibits the harsh treatment of the Chinese, precisely because we should have our own strength, our own skills, and it is by no means the same as chickens and ducks.然而我们从古典里，听熟了仁人义士，来解倒悬的胡说了，直到现在，还不免总在想从天上或什么高处远处掉下一点恩典来，其甚者竟以为“莫作乱离人，宁为太平犬”，不妨变狗，而合群改革是不肯的。自叹不如租界的鸡鸭者，也正有这气味。
However, from the classics, we have heard the benevolent and righteous men to solve the upside-down nonsense, and until now, we can't help but think that a little grace will fall from the sky or some high place, and even think that "don't cause chaos and leave people, it's better to be a peace dog", and you might as well become a dog, but gregarious reform is unwilling. Those who sigh that they are not as good as the chickens and ducks in the concession also have this smell.这类的人物一多，倒是大家要被倒悬的，而且虽在送往厨房的时候，也无人暂时解救。这就因为我们究竟是人，然而是没出息的人的缘故。
There are many characters like this, but everyone is going to be hung upside down, and even when they are sent to the kitchen, no one is temporarily rescued. This is because we are human beings, but we are unpromising people.六月三日。
June 3rd.

倒提

【附录】：[Appendix]: 论“花边文学” on "lace literature"
林默
Lin Mo近来有一种文章，四周围着花边，从一些副刊上出现。这文章，每天一段，雍容闲适，缜密整齐，看外形似乎是“杂感”，但又像“格言”，内容却不痛不痒，毫无着落。似乎是小品或语录一类的东西。今天一则“偶感”，明天一段“据说”，从作者看来，自然是好文章，因为翻来复去，都成了道理，颇尽了八股的能事的。但从读者看，虽然不痛不痒，却往往渗有毒汁，散布了妖言。譬如甘地被刺，就起来作一篇“偶感”，颂扬一番“摩哈达麻”，咒骂几通暴徒作乱，为圣雄出气禳灾，顺便也向读者宣讲一些“看定一切”，“勇武和平”的不抵抗说教之类。这种文章无以名之，且名之曰“花边体”或“花边文学”罢。
Recently there is an article with lace all around, from some supplements. This article, one paragraph a day, is graceful and leisurely, meticulous and neat, and the appearance seems to be a "miscellaneous feeling", but it is like a "maxim", but the content is not painful or itchy, and there is no place. It seems to be something like a sketch or a quote. Today's "occasional feeling", tomorrow's paragraph "It is said", from the author's point of view, is naturally a good article, because it has become a truth over and over again, and it has done its best. But from the reader's point of view, although it is not painful or itchy, it often seeps poisonous juice and spreads demonic words. For example, when Gandhi was assassinated, he got up and wrote an "occasional feeling", praising a "Mahadama", cursing a few mobs to rebel, venting anger for the Mahatma to ward off disasters, and by the way, he also preached to readers some non-resistance sermons of "seeing everything" and "brave and peaceful". This kind of article is indescribable, and it is called "lace style" or "lace literature".这花边体的来源，大抵是走入鸟道以后的小品文变种。据这种小品文的拥护者说是会要流传下去的（见《人间世》：《关于小品文》）。我们且来看看他们的流传之道罢。六月念八日《申报》《自由谈》载有这样一篇文章，题目叫《倒提》。大意说西洋人禁止倒提鸡鸭，华人颇有鸣不平的，因为西洋人虐待华人，至于比不上鸡鸭。
The source of this lace body is probably a variant of the sketch after entering the bird path. According to the proponents of this kind of sketch essay, it will be passed down (see "The World of the World": "About Sketch Essays"). Let's take a look at their circulation. On the 8th of June, the "Declaration" and "Free Talk" contained such an article, titled "Upside Down". To the effect, Westerners forbid to mention chickens and ducks, and the Chinese are quite complaining, because Westerners abuse the Chinese, so that they are not as good as chickens and ducks.于是这位花边文学家发议论了，他说：“这其实是误解了西洋人。他们鄙夷我们是的确的，但并未放在动物之下。”
So the lace writer made a comment, saying: "This is actually a misunderstanding of Westerners. They despise us, yes, but they don't put us under animals. ”为什么“并未”呢？据说是“人能组织，能反抗，……自有力量，自有本领，和鸡鸭绝不相同的缘故。”所以租界上没有禁止苛待华人的规律。不禁止虐待华人，当然就是把华人看在鸡鸭之上了。
Why "not"? It is said that "people can organize and resist,...... It has its own strength, its own skills, and it is by no means the same as chickens and ducks. Therefore, there is no law prohibiting harsh treatment of Chinese in the concession. Not forbidding the abuse of Chinese is of course to regard Chinese as chickens and ducks.倘要不平么，为什么不反抗呢？
If it is unfair, why not resist?而这些不平之士，据花边文学家从古典里得来的证明，断为“不妨变狗”之辈，没有出息的。
And these unjust people, according to the proof obtained from the classics by lace writers, are judged to be "might as well become dogs" and have no prospects.这意思极明白，第一是西洋人并未把华人放在鸡鸭之下，自叹不如鸡鸭的人，是误解了西洋人。第二是受了西洋人这种优待，不应该再鸣不平。第三是他虽也正面的承认人是能反抗的，叫人反抗，但他实在是说明西洋人为尊重华人起见，这虐待倒不可少，而且大可进一步。第四，倘有人要不平，他能从“古典”来证明这是华人没有出息。
The first is that Westerners do not put the Chinese under chickens and ducks, and those who sigh that they are inferior to chickens and ducks misunderstand Westerners. The second is that they have received such preferential treatment from Westerners, and they should no longer complain. Third, although he also positively admits that people can resist and make people resist, he really shows that Westerners respect the Chinese, and this abuse is indispensable, and it can be further developed. Fourth, if someone wants to be unfair, he can prove from the "classics" that the Chinese are unpromising.上海的洋行，有一种帮洋人经营生意的华人，通称叫“买办”，他们和同胞做起生意来，除开夸说洋货如何比国货好，外国人如何讲礼节信用，中国人是猪猡，该被淘汰以外，还有一个特点，是口称洋人曰：“我们的东家”。我想这一篇《倒提》的杰作，看他的口气，大抵不出于这般人为他们的东家而作的手笔。因为第一，这般人是常以了解西洋人自夸的，西洋人待他很客气；第二，他们往往赞成西洋人（也就是他们的东家）统治中国，虐待华人，因为中国人是猪猡；第三，他们最反对中国人怀恨西洋人。抱不平，从他们看来，更是危险思想。
In addition to boasting about how foreign goods are better than domestic products, how foreigners talk about etiquette and credit, Chinese are pigs, should be eliminated, there is also a characteristic, which is to call foreigners "our owner". I think this masterpiece of "Upside Down", looking at his tone, is probably not from the handwriting of such a person for their owner. Because first, such a person often boasts of understanding Westerners, and Westerners treat him very politely; second, they often favor Westerners (that is, their owners) ruling China and mistreating the Chinese, because the Chinese are pigs; Third, they are most opposed to the Chinese hating Westerners. From their point of view, it is even more dangerous.从这般人或希望升为这般人的笔下产出来的就成了这篇“花边文学”的杰作。但所可惜是不论这种文人，或这种文字，代西洋人如何辩护说教，中国人的不平，是不可免的。因为西洋人虽然不曾把中国放在鸡鸭之下，但事实上也似乎并未放在鸡鸭之上。香港的差役把中国犯人倒提着从二楼摔下来，已是久远的事；近之如上海，去年的高丫头，今年的蔡洋其辈，他们的遭遇，并不胜过于鸡鸭，而死伤之惨烈有过而无不及。这些事实我辈华人是看得清清楚楚，不会转背就忘却的，花边文学家的嘴和笔怎能朦混过去呢？
What is produced from the pen of such a person or who hopes to rise to such a person has become a masterpiece of this "lace literature". But unfortunately, no matter how this kind of literati or this kind of writing defends and preaches on behalf of Westerners, the injustice of the Chinese is inevitable. Because although Westerners have never put China below chickens and ducks, in fact they do not seem to be above chickens and ducks. It has been a long time since Hong Kong police officers carried Chinese prisoners upside down and dropped them from the second floor; As close as Shanghai, last year's tall girl, this year's Cai Yangqi, their experiences are not better than chickens and ducks, and the deaths and injuries are tragic. These facts are clearly seen by our generation of Chinese, and we will not forget them when we turn our backs, how can the mouth and pen of lace writers be confused?抱不平的华人果真如花边文学家的“古典”证明，一律没有出息的么？倒也不的。我们的古典里，不是有九年前的五卅运动，两年前的一二八战争，至今还在艰苦支持的东北义勇军么？谁能说这些不是由于华人的不平之气聚集而成的勇敢的战斗和反抗呢？
Are the disgruntled Chinese really like the "classical" proof of lace writers, and they are all unpromising? Not really. In our classics, isn't there the May Thirtieth Movement nine years ago, the 128 War two years ago, and the Northeast Volunteer Army that is still working hard to support? Who can say that these are not the brave battles and resistances that are not caused by the gathering of Chinese injustice?“花边体”文章赖以流传的长处都在这里。如今虽然在流传着，为某些人们所拥护。但相去不远，就将有人来唾弃他的。现在是建设“大众语”文学的时候，我想“花边文学”，不论这种形式或内容，在大众的眼中，将有流传不下去的一天罢。
The advantages of the "lace style" article are all here. Although it is circulating today, it is supported by some people. But not far away, someone will spurn him. Now is the time to build "popular language" literature, and I think that "lace literature", no matter in this form or content, will not be able to circulate in the eyes of the public.

“此生或彼生”

“此生或彼生”

“此生或彼生”

"This life or that life"白道
White way“此生或彼生”。
"This life or that life".现在写出这样五个字来，问问读者：是什么意思？
Now write these five words and ask the reader: What does it mean?倘使在《申报》上，见过汪懋祖先生的文章，“……例如说‘这一个学生或是那一个学生’，文言只须‘此生或彼生’即已明了，其省力为何如？……”的，那就也许能够想到，这就是“这一个学生或是那一个学生”的意思。
If you have seen Mr. Wang Maozu's article in the "Declaration", "...... For example, if it is said that 'this student or that student', the literary language only needs 'this life or that student' to be understood, how is it labor-saving? ......", then you may be able to think that this is the meaning of "this student or that student".否则，那回答恐怕就要迟疑。因为这五个字，至少还可以有两种解释：一，这一个秀才或是那一个秀才（生员）；二，这一世或是未来的别一世。
Otherwise, I am afraid that the answer will be hesitant. Because of these five words, there can be at least two interpretations: first, this scholar or that scholar (student); 2. This life or another life in the future.文言比起白话来，有时的确字数少，然而那意义也比较的含胡。我们看文言文，往往不但不能增益我们的智识，并且须仗我们已有的智识，给它注解，补足。待到翻成精密的白话之后，这才算是懂得了。如果一径就用白话，即使多写了几个字，但对于读者，“其省力为何如”？
Compared with the vernacular, the number of words is sometimes smaller, but the meaning is also more bearded. When we look at classical Chinese, we often not only cannot increase our knowledge, but we also have to rely on our existing knowledge to annotate and supplement it. After translating it into a precise vernacular, I can be considered to understand. If you use the vernacular in one way, even if you write a few more words, but for the reader, "how is it labor-saving"?我就用主张文言的汪懋祖先生所举的文言的例子，证明了文言的不中用了。
I used the example of classical Chinese given by Mr. Wang Maozu, who advocates classical Chinese, to prove that Classical Chinese is useless.六月二十三日。

Zhang Chenglu“山梁雌雉，时哉时哉！”东西是自有其时候的。
"The mountain beam female pheasant, time, time!" Things have their own time.圣经，佛典，受一部分人们的奚落已经十多年了，“觉今是而昨非”，现在就是复兴的时候。关岳，是清朝屡经封赠的神明，被民元革命所闲却；从新记得，是袁世凯的晚年，但又和袁世凯一同盖了棺；而第二次从新记得，则是在现在。

If it is a child of the old family, in order to show off, be curious, trendy, and eat, of course, he may not go out, but just because of a small success, or a little setback, can make him retreat immediately. This shrinkage is not small, it is simply a retreat home, and what's worse is that his home is an old and dilapidated mansion.这大宅子里有仓中的旧货，有壁角的灰尘，一时实在搬不尽。倘有坐食的余闲，还可以东寻西觅，那就修破书，擦古瓶，读家谱，怀祖德，来消磨他若干岁月。如果是穷极无聊了，那就更要修破书，擦古瓶，读家谱，怀祖德，甚而至于翻肮脏的墙根，开空虚的抽屉，想发见连他自己也莫名其妙的宝贝，来救这无法可想的贫穷。这两种人，小康和穷乏，是不同的，悠闲和急迫，是不同的，因而收场的缓促，也不同的，但当这时候，却都正在古董中讨生活，所以那主张和行为，便无不同，而声势也好像见得浩大了。

If it is extremely boring, then it is even more necessary to repair broken books, wipe ancient bottles, read family trees, cherish ancestral virtues, and even rummage through dirty walls, open empty drawers, and want to find treasures that even he himself is inexplicable to save this unimaginable poverty.
