论重译

论重译

论重译

论重译史贲
Shi Ben穆木天先生在二十一日的《火炬》上，反对作家的写无聊的游记之类，以为不如给中国介绍一点上起希腊罗马，下至现代的文学名作。我以为这是很切实的忠告。但他在十九日的《自由谈》上，却又反对间接翻译，说“是一种滑头办法”，虽然还附有一些可恕的条件。这是和他后来的所说冲突的，也容易启人误会，所以我想说几句。
In "Torch" on the 21st, Mr. Mu Mutian opposed the writer's writing boring travelogues, thinking that it would be better to introduce China to a little bit of literary masterpieces from Greece and Rome to modern times. I thought this was very practical advice. But in the "Free Talk" on the 19th, he opposed indirect translation, saying that it was "a slippery method", although there were some forgivable conditions. This is in conflict with what he said later, and it is easy to misunderstand, so I would like to say a few words.重译确是比直接译容易。首先，是原文的能令译者自惭不及，怕敢动笔的好处，先由原译者消去若干部分了。译文是大抵比不上原文的，就是将中国的粤语译为京语，或京语译成沪语，也很难恰如其分。在重译，便减少了对于原文的好处的踌躇。其次，是难解之处，忠实的译者往往会有注解，可以一目了然，原书上倒未必有。但因此，也常有直接译错误，而间接译却不然的时候。
Retranslation is indeed easier than direct translation. First of all, the original text can make the translator feel ashamed of himself, and he is afraid of the benefits of daring to write, so the original translator will erase some parts first. The translation is probably not as good as the original text, even if it is translated from Chinese Cantonese into Beijing, or Beijing into Shanghai, it is difficult to be appropriate. In retranslation, the hesitation about the benefits of the original text is reduced. Secondly, it is difficult to understand, faithful translators often have annotations, which can be understood at a glance, but may not be in the original book. However, there are often direct translation errors and indirect translations are not.懂某一国文，最好是译某一国文学，这主张是断无错误的，但是，假使如此，中国也就难有上起希罗，下至现代的文学名作的译本了。中国人所懂的外国文，恐怕是英文最多，日文次之，倘不重译，我们将只能看见许多英美和日本的文学作品，不但没有伊卜生，没有伊本涅支，连极通行的安徒生的童话，西万提司的《吉诃德先生》，也无从看见了。这是何等可怜的眼界。自然，中国未必没有精通丹麦，诺威，西班牙文字的人们，然而他们至今没有译，我们现在的所有，都是从英文重译的。连苏联的作品，也大抵是从英法文重译的。
It is absolutely wrong to understand a certain language and preferably translate a certain country's literature, but if this is the case, it will be difficult for China to have translations of literary masterpieces from Greece to modern times. Chinese If we do not retranslate, we will only be able to see many British, American and Japanese literary works, not only without Ibsen, without Ibenech, but also without the popular fairy tales of Hans Christian Andersen, and Sivantes' "Mr. Quixote". What a pitiful vision this is. Naturally, China may not have people who are proficient in Danish, Norwegian and Spanish scripts, but they have not translated it so far, and everything we have now is retranslated from English. Even Soviet works are mostly retranslated from English and French.所以我想，对于翻译，现在似乎暂不必有严峻的堡垒。最要紧的是要看译文的佳良与否，直接译或间接译，是不必置重的；是否投机，也不必推问的。深通原译文的趋时者的重译本，有时会比不甚懂原文的忠实者的直接译本好，日本改造社译的《高尔基全集》，曾被有一些革命者斥责为投机，但革命者的译本出，却反而显出前一本的优良了。不过也还要附一个条件，并不很懂原译文的趋时者的速成译本，可实在是不可恕的。
So I think that for translation, it seems that there is no need to have a stern fortress for the time being. The most important thing is to look at the quality of the translation, whether it is a direct translation or an indirect translation, there is no need to pay attention to it; Whether it is speculative or not, there is no need to ask. The retranslation of the "Complete Works of Gorky" translated by the Japan Transformation Society was once reprimanded by some revolutionaries as speculative, but the translation of the revolutionary showed the excellence of the previous one. However, there is also a condition, the quick translation of the original translation is really unforgivable.待到将来各种名作有了直接译本，则重译本便是应该淘汰的时候，然而必须那译本比旧译本好，不能但以“直接翻译”当作护身的挡牌。
When there are direct translations of various masterpieces in the future, it is time for the retranslation to be eliminated, but the translation must be better than the old translation, and the "direct translation" cannot be used as a shield.六月二十四日。
June 24th.

再论重译

再论重译

再论重译

Let's talk about retranslation史贲
Shi Ben看到穆木天先生的《论重译及其他》下篇的末尾，才知道是在释我的误会。我却觉得并无什么误会，不同之点，只在倒过了一个轻重，我主张首先要看成绩的好坏，而不管译文是直接或间接，以及译者是怎样的动机。
When I saw the end of the second part of Mr. Mu Mutian's "On Retranslation and Others", I realized that I was explaining my misunderstanding. I advocate that the first thing to look at is the quality of the grades, regardless of whether the translation is direct or indirect, and what the translator's motivation is.木天先生要译者“自知”，用自己的长处，译成“一劳永逸”的书。要不然，还是不动手的好。这就是说，与其来种荆棘，不如留下一片白地，让别的好园丁来种可以永久观赏的佳花。但是，“一劳永逸”的话，有是有的，而“一劳永逸”的事却极少，就文字而论，中国的这方块字便决非“一劳永逸”的符号。况且白地也决不能永久的保留，既有空地，便会生长荆棘或雀麦。最要紧的是有人来处理，或者培植，或者删除，使翻译界略免于芜杂。这就是批评。
Mr. Mutian wants the translator to "know himself" and use his own strengths to translate it into a "once and for all" book. Otherwise, it's better not to do it. This means that instead of planting thorns, it is better to leave a piece of white land for other good gardeners to plant beautiful flowers that can be enjoyed forever. However, there are words of "once and for all", but there are very few things about "once and for all", and in terms of words, this square word in China is by no means a symbol of "once and for all". Moreover, white land must not be kept permanently, and if there is open space, thorns or sparrows will grow. The most important thing is that someone will deal with it, or cultivate it, or delete it, so that the translation community is slightly free from confusion. That's criticism.然而我们向来看轻着翻译，尤其是重译。对于创作，批评家是总算时时开口的，一到翻译，则前几年还偶有专指误译的文章，近来就极其少见；对于重译的更其少。但在工作上，批评翻译却比批评创作难，不但看原文须有译者以上的工力，对作品也须有译者以上的理解。如木天先生所说，重译有数种译本作参考，这在译者是极为便利的，因为甲译本可疑时，能够参看乙译本。直接译就不然了，一有不懂的地方，便无法可想，因为世界上是没有用了不同的文章，来写两部意义句句相同的作品的作者的。重译的书之多，这也许是一种原因，说偷懒也行，但大约也还是语学的力量不足的缘故。遇到这种参酌各本而成的译本，批评就更为难了，至少也得能看各种原译本。如陈源译的《父与子》，鲁迅译的《毁灭》，就都属于这一类的。
However, we have always looked down on translation, especially retranslation. When it comes to translation, there have been occasional articles specifically referring to mistranslations in previous years, which are extremely rare recently. Even less for retranslations. However, in terms of work, criticizing translation is more difficult than criticizing creation, not only to read the original text requires more than the translator's work, but also to have more than the translator's understanding of the work. As Mr. Mu Tian said, there are several translations for reference, which is extremely convenient for translators, because when translation A is suspicious, they can refer to translation B. If there is something you don't understand, you can't think of it, because there are no authors in the world who use different articles to write two works with the same meaning. The number of retranslated books may be one reason, it is okay to be lazy, but it is probably also because of the lack of power of linguistics. When encountering this kind of translation that refers to each version, it is even more difficult to criticize, at least you have to be able to read various original translations. For example, Chen Yuan's translation of "Fathers and Sons" and Lu Xun's translation of "Destruction" all belong to this category.我以为翻译的路要放宽，批评的工作要着重。倘只是立论极严，想使译者自己慎重，倒会得到相反的结果，要好的慎重了，乱译者却还是乱译，这时恶译本就会比稍好的译本多。
I thought that the road of translation should be relaxed, and the work of criticism should be emphasized. If you only make a very strict argument and want the translator to be cautious, you will get the opposite result.临末还有几句不大紧要的话。木天先生因为怀疑重译，见了德译本之后，连他自己所译的《塔什干》，也定为法文原译是删节本了。其实是不然的。德译本虽然厚，但那是两部小说合订在一起的，后面的大半，就是绥拉菲摩维支的《铁流》。所以我们所有的汉译《塔什干》，也并不是节本。
There are a few more words that don't matter at the end. Because Mr. Mutian was suspicious of the retranslation, after seeing the German translation, even his own translation of "Tashkent" was determined to be an abridged version of the original French translation. In fact, it is not. Although the German translation is thick, it is a combination of the two novels, and the latter half is Suelafimovitch's "Iron Flow". Therefore, all our Chinese translations of "Tashkent" are not abridged versions.七月三日。

“彻底”的底子

“彻底”的底子

"Thorough" foundation公汗
Public sweat现在对于一个人的立论，如果说它是“高超”，恐怕有些要招论者的反感了，但若说它是“彻底”，是“非常前进”，却似乎还没有什么。
Now, if a person's argument is "superb", I am afraid that some critics will be disgusted, but if it is "thorough" and "very advanced", it seems that there is nothing yet.现在也正是“彻底”的，“非常前进”的议论，替代了“高超”的时光。
Now it is also the "thorough" and "very forward" discussion that has replaced the "superb" time.文艺本来都有一个对象的界限。譬如文学，原是以懂得文字的读者为对象的，懂得文字的多少有不同，文章当然要有深浅。而主张用字要平常，作文要明白，自然也还是作者的本分。然而这时“彻底”论者站出来了，他却说中国有许多文盲，问你怎么办？这实在是对于文学家的当头一棍，只好立刻闷死给他看。
Literature and art originally have a boundary of objects. For example, literature was originally aimed at readers who understand words, and the amount of understanding of words is different, and of course the articles must have depths. It is naturally the author's duty to advocate that the words should be ordinary and the composition should be clear. However, at this time, the "thorough" theorist stood up, but he said that there are many illiterates in China, and asked what to do? This was really a blow to the writer, so I had to suffocate him immediately.不过还可以另外请一枝救兵来，也就是辩解。因为文盲是已经在文学作用的范围之外的了，这时只好请画家，演剧家，电影作家出马，给他看文字以外的形象的东西。然而这还不足以塞“彻底”论者的嘴的，他就说文盲中还有色盲，有瞎子，问你怎么办？于是艺术家们也遭了当头一棍，只好立刻闷死给他看。
But you can also invite another rescuer, that is, to justify. Because illiteracy is already outside the scope of literature, at this time I have to ask painters, dramatists, and film writers to come in and show him images other than words. However, this is not enough to stuff the mouth of the "thorough" theorist, he said that there are also color blindness among the illiterate, there are blind people, and he asks what you should do? So the artists were also beaten to the head, and had to suffocate him immediately.那么，作为最后的挣扎，说是对于色盲瞎子之类，须用讲演，唱歌，说书罢。说是也说得过去的。然而他就要问你：莫非你忘记了中国还有聋子吗？
Then, as the last struggle, it is said that for the colorblind and the like, we must use lectures, singing, and storytelling. It makes sense to say yes. However, he will ask you: Have you forgotten that there are still deaf people in China?又是当头一棍，闷死，都闷死了。
Another blow to the head, suffocated, suffocated.于是“彻底”论者就得到一个结论：现在的一切文艺，全都无用，非彻底改革不可！
So the "thorough" theorists came to a conclusion: all current literature and art are useless, and they must be completely reformed!他立定了这个结论之后，不知道到那里去了。谁来“彻底”改革呢？那自然是文艺家。然而文艺家又是不“彻底”的多，于是中国就永远没有对于文盲，色盲，瞎子，聋子，无不有效的——“彻底”的好的文艺。

But the "thorough" theorists sometimes stick out their heads and reproach the writers.弄文艺的人，如果遇见这样的大人物而不能撕掉他的鬼脸，那么，文艺不但不会前进，并且只会萎缩，终于被他消灭的。切实的文艺家必须认清这一种“彻底”论者的真面目！

Deng Dangshi中国的学者们，多以为各种智识，一定出于圣贤，或者至少是学者之口；连火和草药的发明应用，也和民众无缘，全由古圣王一手包办：燧人氏，神农氏。所以，有人以为“一若各种智识，必出诸动物之口，斯亦奇矣”，是毫不足奇的。
Chinese scholars mostly think that all kinds of wisdom must come from the mouths of sages, or at least scholars; Even the invention and application of fire and herbs have no chance with the people, and they are all arranged by the ancient sage kings: Suiren and Shennong. Therefore, it is not surprising that some people think that "if all kinds of intelligence come from the mouths of animals, it is strange".况且，“出诸动物之口”的智识，在我们中国，也常常不是真智识。天气热得要命，窗门都打开了，装着无线电播音机的人家，便都把音波放到街头，“与民同乐”。咿咿唉唉，唱呀唱呀。外国我不知道，中国的播音，竟是从早到夜，都有戏唱的，它一会儿尖，一会儿沙，只要你愿意，简直能够使你耳根没有一刻清净。同时开了风扇，吃着冰淇淋，不但和“水位大涨”“旱象已成”之处毫不相干，就是和窗外流着油汗，整天在挣扎过活的人们的地方，也完全是两个世界。
Moreover, the wisdom that "comes from the mouth of animals" is often not true wisdom in our China. The weather was so hot that the windows and doors were open, and the people with radio radios put sound waves on the streets to "have fun with the people." Babbling, singing, singing. I don't know in foreign countries, but China's broadcasting is actually sung from morning to night, it is sharp for a while, sandy for a while, as long as you want, it can make your ears clean for a moment. At the same time, turning on the fan and eating ice cream has nothing to do with the "water level rise" and "drought has formed", but also the place where people sweating outside the window and struggling to live all day long are completely two worlds.我在咿咿唉唉的曼声高唱中，忽然记得了法国诗人拉芳丁的有名的寓言：《知了和蚂蚁》。也是这样的火一般的太阳的夏天，蚂蚁在地面上辛辛苦苦地作工，知了却在枝头高吟，一面还笑蚂蚁俗。然而秋风来了，凉森森的一天比一天凉，这时知了无衣无食，变了小瘪三，却给早有准备的蚂蚁教训了一顿。这是我在小学校“受教育”的时候，先生讲给我听的。我那时好像很感动，至今有时还记得。
In the midst of my babbling singing, I suddenly remembered the famous fable of the French poet Lafontine: "Knowing and Ants". It is also such a fiery summer of the sun, ants work the ground, but when they know it, they sing on the branches, while laughing at the ants vulgar. However, the autumn wind came, and the cool day was getting colder day by day, and at this time, I knew that I had no food and clothing, and I became a little deflated, but I taught the ants who had been prepared a lesson. This is what my husband told me when I was "educated" in elementary school. However, although I remember, because of the lesson of "graduation is unemployment", my opinion is already very different from that of ants. The autumn wind will come soon, and it will naturally be cooler day by day, but at that time, those who had no food and clothing were probably the people who were sweating and sweating now; The surroundings of the bungalow were silent, but it was because the windows and doors were closed, and even the sound waves kept the heating of the stove.“出诸动物之口”的智识，在我们中国岂不是往往不适用的么？
Isn't the wisdom "from the mouth of animals" often inapplicable in our China?中国自有中国的圣贤和学者。“劳心者治人，劳力者治于人；治于人者食（去声）人，治人者食于人”，说得多么简截明白。如果先生早将这教给我，我也不至于有上面的那些感想，多费纸笔了。这也就是中国人非读中国古书不可的一个好证据罢。
China has its own Chinese sages and scholars. "Those who work hard govern people, and those who work hard govern people; those who govern people eat (remove the sound) people, and those who govern people eat people", how concise and clear it is. If my husband had taught me this earlier, I wouldn't have had the above impressions and wasted more paper and pen. This is a good proof that Chinese people must read ancient Chinese books.七月八日。

Waterborne公汗
Public sweat天气接连的大热了近二十天，看上海报，几乎每天都有下河洗浴，淹死了人的记载。这在水村里，是很少见的。
The weather has been hot for nearly 20 days, and looking at the posters, there are records of people drowning in the river almost every day. This is rare in the water village.水村多水，对于水的知识多，能浮水的也多。倘若不会浮水，是轻易不下水去的。这一种能浮水的本领，俗语谓之“识水性”。
There is a lot of water in the water village, and there are many people who know more about water and can float on water. If it doesn't float, it won't go into the water easily. This ability to float is commonly known as "knowing water".这“识水性”，如果用了“买办”的白话文，加以较详的说明，则：一，是知道火能烧死人，水也能淹死人，但水的模样柔和，好像容易亲近，因而也容易上当；二，知道水虽能淹死人，却也能浮起人，现在就设法操纵它，专来利用它浮起人的这一面；三，便是学得操纵法，此法一熟，“识水性”的事就完全了。
This "water awareness", if the vernacular of "comprador" is used to explain it in more detail, then: First, it is to know that fire can burn people, and water can also drown people, but the appearance of water is soft, as if it is easy to get close, so it is easy to be deceived; second, knowing that water can drown people, it can also float people, so try to manipulate it now and use it to float people's side; Third, it is to learn the manipulation method, and once this method is mastered, the matter of "knowing water" will be complete.但在都会里的人们，却不但不能浮水，而且似乎连水能淹死人的事情也都忘却了。平时毫无准备，临时又不先一测水的深浅，遇到热不可耐时，便脱衣一跳，倘不幸而正值深处，那当然是要死的。而且我觉得，当这时候，肯设法救助的人，好像都会里也比乡下少。
But people in the city not only can't float on water, but they also seem to have forgotten that water can drown people. Usually unprepared, temporarily without first measuring the depth of the water, when encountering unbearable heat, he strips off his clothes and jumps, if he is unfortunate and in the depths, of course he will die. And I think that at this time, there seem to be fewer people willing to try to rescue in the city than in the countryside.但救都会人恐怕也较难，因为救者固然必须“识水性”，被救者也得相当的“识水性”的。他应该毫不用力，一任救者托着他的下巴，往浅处浮。倘若过于性急，拚命的向救者的身上爬，则救者倘不是好手，便只好连自己也沉下去。
But it may be more difficult to save the people in the city, because the rescuer must be "water-knowing", and the rescued must also be quite "water-knowing". He should have been able to hold his chin without any effort, and let the rescuer float to the shallows. If you are too impatient and desperately crawl on the rescuer's body, if the rescuer is not a good hand, he will have to sink even himself.所以我想，要下河，最好是预先学一点浮水工夫，不必到什么公园的游泳场，只要在河滩边就行，但必须有内行人指导。其次，倘因了种种关系，不能学浮水，那就用竹竿先探一下河水的浅深，只在浅处敷衍敷衍；或者最稳当是舀起水来，只在河边冲一冲，而最要紧的是要知道水有能淹死不会游泳的人的性质，并且还要牢牢的记住！
So I think that if you want to go down the river, it is best to learn a little floating work in advance, you don't have to go to the swimming pool in any park, as long as you are by the river beach, but you must be guided by an insider. secondly, if you can't learn to float water due to various relationships, then use a bamboo pole to explore the depth of the river first, and only perfunctory in the shallow places; Or the safest thing is to scoop up the water and only rush by the river, and the most important thing is to know that water has the property of drowning people who can't swim, and remember it firmly!现在还要主张宣传这样的常识，看起来好像发疯，或是志在“花边”罢，但事实却证明着断断不如此。许多事是不能为了讨前进的批评家喜欢，一味闭了眼睛作豪语的。
Now it seems that it is crazy or aiming for "lace", but the facts prove that this is not the case. Many things cannot be liked by advancing critics and blindly close their eyes and make boastful words.七月十七日。

Joke Just Treat It as a Joke (Part 1)康伯度
Cumberdo不料刘半农先生竟忽然病故了，学术界上又短少了一个人。这是应该惋惜的。但我于音韵学一无所知，毁誉两面，都不配说一句话。我因此记起的是别一件事，是在现在的白话将被“扬弃”或“唾弃”之前，他早是一位对于那时的白话，尤其是欧化式的白话的伟大的“迎头痛击”者。
Unexpectedly, Mr. Liu Bannong suddenly died of illness, and there was one person missing in the academic world. This should be regretted. But I don't know anything about phonology, and I don't deserve to say a word. What I remember is another thing, before the current vernacular will be "abandoned" or "spurned", he was a great "head-on" to the vernacular at that time, especially the Europeanized vernacular.他曾经有过极不费力，但极有力的妙文：
He once had a very effortless but powerful wonderful article:“我现在只举一个简单的例：
"I'll just give you a simple example:子曰：‘学而时习之，不亦悦乎？’
Confucius said: 'Isn't it pleasant to learn and practice from time to time?' ’这太老式了，不好！
It's too old-fashioned, it's not good!‘学而时习之，’子曰，‘不亦悦乎？’
'Learn and practice from time to time,' the son said, 'Isn't it also a pleasure?' ’这好！
This is good!‘学而时习之，不亦悦乎？’子曰。
'Isn't it fun to learn and practice from time to time?' The son said.这更好！为什么好？欧化了。但‘子曰’终没有能欧化到‘曰子’！”
It's even better! Why is it good? Europeanized. But 'Ziyue' has never been able to Europeanize to 'Zi'! ”这段话见于《中国文法通论》中，那书是一本正经的书；作者又是《新青年》的同人，五四时代“文学革命”的战士，现在又成了古人了。中国老例，一死是常常能够增价的，所以我想从新提起，并且提出他终于也是《论语》社的同人，有时不免发些“幽默”；原先也有“幽默”，而这些“幽默”，又不免常常掉到“开玩笑”的阴沟里去的。
This passage is found in "General Theory of Chinese Grammar", which is a serious book; The author is also a fan of "New Youth", a warrior of the "literary revolution" of the May Fourth era, and now he has become an ancient person again. As an old example in China, death can often increase the price, so I want to start anew, and propose that he is finally a fellow of the "Analects" society, and sometimes he can't help but send some "humor"; There used to be "humor", and these "humors" often fell into the gutter of "joking".实例也就是上面所引的文章，其实是，那论法，和顽固先生，市井无赖，看见青年穿洋服，学外国话了，便冷笑道：“可惜鼻子还低，脸孔也不白”的那些话，并没有两样的。
The example is the article quoted above, in fact, the argument is no different from the words of the stubborn gentleman, the scoundrel in the market, who saw the young man wearing a foreign dress and learning a foreign language: "It's a pity that the nose is still low and the face is not white".自然，刘先生所反对的是“太欧化”。但“太”的范围是怎样的呢？他举出的前三法，古文上没有，谈话里却能有的，对人口谈，也都可以懂。只有将“子曰”改成“曰子”是决不能懂的了。然而他在他所反对的欧化文中也寻不出实例来，只好说是“‘子曰’终没有能欧化到‘曰子’！”那么，这不是“无的放矢”吗？
Naturally, what Mr. Liu opposes is "too Europeanization". But what is the scope of "too"? The first three methods he cited are not in ancient texts, but they can be found in conversation, and they can also be understood in oral conversation. Only changing "Ziyue" to "Yuezi" is absolutely incomprehensible. However, he could not find an example in the European text he opposed, so he had to say that "'Ziyue' could not be Europeanized to 'Yuzi'!" So, isn't this "aimless"?欧化文法的侵入中国白话中的大原因，并非因为好奇，乃是为了必要。国粹学家痛恨鬼子气，但他住在租界里，便会写些“霞飞路”，“麦特赫司脱路”那样的怪地名；评论者何尝要好奇，但他要说得精密，固有的白话不够用，便只得采些外国的句法。比较的难懂，不像茶淘饭似的可以一口吞下去是真的，但补这缺点的是精密。胡适先生登在《新青年》上的《易卜生主义》，比起近时的有些文艺论文来，的确容易懂，但我们不觉得它却又粗浅，笼统吗？
The main reason for the invasion of European grammar into the Chinese vernacular is not because of curiosity, but because of necessity. The nationalist hates the devil, but when he lives in the concession, he will write some strange place names such as "Joffre Road" and "Metherst Road"; The commentator should be curious, but if he wants to speak precisely, the inherent vernacular is not enough, so he has to adopt some foreign syntax. It's more difficult to understand, unlike tea and rice, it is true that you can swallow it in one bite, but what makes up for this shortcoming is precision. Mr. Hu Shi's "Ibsenism" published in "New Youth" is indeed easier to understand than some recent literary and artistic papers, but don't we think it is superficial and general?如果嘲笑欧化式白话的人，除嘲笑之外，再去试一试绍介外国的精密的论著，又不随意改变，删削，我想，他一定还能够给我们更好的箴规。
If people who ridicule the Europeanized vernacular, in addition to ridiculing, try to introduce foreign sophisticated treatises, and do not change or delete them at will, I think he will be able to give us better admonitions.用玩笑来应付敌人，自然也是一种好战法，但触着之处，须是对手的致命伤，否则，玩笑终不过是一种单单的玩笑而已。
Using jokes to deal with the enemy is naturally a good tactic, but where it touches, it must be the opponent's fatal wound, otherwise, the joke will be just a simple joke in the end.七月十八日。
July 18th.

伯度先生：今天读到先生在《自由谈》刊布的大作，知道为西人侵略张目的急先锋（汉奸）仍多，先生以为欧式文化的风行，原因是“必要”。这我真不知是从那里说起？中国人虽无用，但是话总是会说的。如果一定要把中国话取消，要乡下人也“密司忒”起来，这不见得是中国文化上的“必要”吧。譬如照华人的言语说：张甲说：“今天下雨了。”李乙说：“是的，天凉了。”若照尊论的主张，就应该改做：“今天下雨了，”张甲说。“天凉了，——是的；”李乙说。这个算得是中华民国全族的“必要”吗？一般翻译大家的欧化文笔，已足阻尽中西文化的通路，使能读原文的人也不懂译文。再加上先生的“必要”，从此使中国更无可读的西书了。陈子展先生提倡的“大众语”，是天经地义的。中国人间应该说中国话，总是绝对的。而先生偏要说欧化文法是必要！毋怪大名是“康伯度”，真十足加二的表现“买办心理”了。刘半农先生说：“翻译是要使不懂外国文的人得读”；这是确切不移的定理。而先生大骂其半农，认为非使全中国人都以欧化文法为“必要”的性命不可！先生，现在暑天，你歇歇吧！帝国主义的灭绝华人的毒气弹，已经制成无数了。先生要做买办尽管做，只求不必将全个民族出卖。我是一个不懂颠倒式的欧化文式的愚人！对于先生的盛意提倡，几乎疑惑先生已不是敝国人了。今特负责请问先生为甚么投这文化的毒瓦斯？是否受了帝国主义者的指使？总之，四万万四千九百万（陈先生以外）以内的中国人对于先生的主张不敢领教的！幸先生注意。
Mr. Bodu: Today I read your masterpiece published in "Free Talk", and I know that there are still many vanguards (traitors) who invade Zhang Gu for the purpose of Westerners. I really don't know where to start? Although Chinese are useless, they will always speak. If the Chinese language must be canceled and the countrymen are also "mistheirs", this is not necessarily a "necessity" in Chinese culture. For example, in the words of the Chinese: Zhang Jia said: "It's raining today." Li Yi said: "Yes, it's cold." If we follow the proposition of the theory of respect, it should be changed to "It's raining today," Zhang Jia said. "It's cold,—— yes;" Li Yi said. Is this considered a "necessity" for the entire ethnic group of the Republic of China? The Europeanized writing of ordinary translators has blocked the channels of Chinese and Western cultures, so that people who can read the original text do not understand the translation. Coupled with Mr. Zhao's "necessity", China has no Western books to read from now on. The "popular language" advocated by Mr. Chen Zizhan is a matter of course. Chinese should speak Chinese, which is always absolute. And Mr. wants to say that European grammar is necessary! No wonder the name is "Cumberdo", which is really full of plus two expressions of "comprador psychology". Mr. Liu Bannong said: "Translation is to make people who do not understand foreign languages read"; This is the unchanging theorem. And the gentleman scolded him for being half a farmer, believing that all Chinese people must take Europeanized grammar as a "necessary" life! Sir, it's summer now, you can rest! The imperialist gas bomb to exterminate the Chinese has been made countless times. If you want to be a comprador, you just don't have to betray the whole nation. I am a fool who does not understand the inverted European style! For Mr. Sincere's advocacy, I almost doubt that Mr. is no longer a member of our country. Today, I am in charge of asking why you threw the poisonous gas of this culture? Was he instructed by the imperialists? In short, the Chinese within 44,900,000 (except Mr. Chen) did not dare to understand Mr. Chen's proposition! I hope you pay attention.文公直　七月二十五日。

康伯度答文公直公直先生：中国语法里要加一点欧化，是我的一种主张，并不是“一定要把中国话取消”，也没有“受了帝国主义者的指使”，可是先生立刻加给我“汉奸”之类的重罪名，自己代表了“四万万四千九百万（陈先生以外）以内的中国人”，要杀我的头了。我的主张也许会错的，不过一来就判死罪，方法虽然很时髦，但也似乎过分了一点。况且我看“四万万四千九百万（陈先生以外）以内的中国人”，意见也未必都和先生相同，先生并没有征求过同意，你是冒充代表的。
Mr. Gongzhi: It is one of my propositions to add a little Europeanization to the Chinese language, not "the Chinese language must be canceled", nor "instructed by the imperialists", but Mr. Gongzhi immediately added serious crimes such as "traitor" to me, and he represented "44,900,000 Chinese (other than Mr. Chen)" and wanted to kill my head. My proposition may be wrong, but the method of sentencing the death penalty as soon as it comes is very fashionable, but it also seems to be a little excessive. Moreover, I see that "Chinese within 44,900,000 (other than Mr. Chen)" may not all have the same opinion as Mr. Chen, who has not asked for consent, and you are pretending to be a representative.中国语法的欧化并不就是改学外国话，但这些粗浅的道理不想和先生多谈了。我不怕热，倒是因为无聊。不过还要说一回：我主张中国语法上有加些欧化的必要。这主张，是由事实而来的。中国人“话总是会说的”，一点不错，但要前进，全照老样却不够。眼前的例，就如先生这几百个字的信里面，就用了两回“对于”，这和古文无关，是后来起于直译的欧化语法，而且连“欧化”这两个字也是欧化字；还用着一个“取消”，这是纯粹日本词；一个“瓦斯”，是德国字的原封不动的日本人的音译。都用得很惬当，而且是“必要”的。譬如“毒瓦斯”罢，倘用中国固有的话的“毒气”，就显得含混，未必一定是毒弹里面的东西了。所以写作“毒瓦斯”，的确是出乎“必要”的。
The Europeanization of Chinese language and law is not to change to a foreign language, but I don't want to talk more about these superficial truths with my teacher. I'm not afraid of the heat, but because I'm bored. But I have to say it again: I advocate the need to add some Europeanization to Chinese Chinese law. This proposition comes from facts. Chinese "always say words", which is a good thing, but it is not enough to move forward. In the case at hand, such as Mr. in this letter of hundreds of words, "for" is used twice, which has nothing to do with ancient text, but is a Europeanized grammar that later originated from literal translation, and even the word "Europeanization" is also a Europeanized word; There is also a "cancel", which is a purely Japanese word; A "gas" is the original Japanese transliteration of the German word. They are all very comfortable and "necessary". For example, if you use the "poison gas" in China's inherent language, it will seem ambiguous and may not necessarily be the content of the poison bomb. Therefore, writing "poisonous gas" is indeed "necessary".先生自己没有照镜子，无意中也证明了自己也正是用欧化语法，用鬼子名词的人，但我看先生决不是“为西人侵略张目的急先锋（汉奸）”，所以也想由此证明我也并非那一伙。否则，先生含狗血喷人，倒先污了你自己的尊口了。
The gentleman himself did not look in the mirror, and inadvertently proved that he was also the one who used Europeanized grammar and devil nouns, but I think the gentleman is by no means a "vanguard (traitor) for the invasion of the Westerners", so I also want to prove that I am not that gang. Otherwise, sir will spit on people with dog blood, but you will first stain your own mouth.我想，辩论事情，威吓和诬陷，是没有用处的。用笔的人，一来就发你的脾气，要我的性命，更其可笑得很。先生还是不要暴躁，静静的再看看自己的信，想想自己，何如？
I think it is useless to debate things, intimidate and frame people. The person who uses the pen will lose your temper and take my life, which is even more ridiculous. Sir, don't be irritable, quietly look at your letter and think about yourself, how about it?专此布复，并请

Cumberdo别一枝讨伐白话的生力军，是林语堂先生。他讨伐的不是白话的“反而难懂”，是白话的“鲁里鲁苏”，连刘先生似的想白话“返朴归真”的意思也全没有，要达意，只有“语录式”（白话的文言）。
Another new force against the vernacular is Mr. Lin Yutang. What he was crusading against was not the vernacular "but difficult to understand", but the vernacular "Luli Lusu", and even Mr. Liu's desire to "return to simplicity and return to the truth" in the vernacular had no meaning at all.林先生用白话武装了出现的时候，文言和白话的斗争早已过去了，不像刘先生那样，自己是混战中的过来人，因此也不免有感怀旧日，慨叹末流的情绪。他一闪而将宋明语录，摆在“幽默”的旗子下，原也极其自然的。
When Mr. Lin appeared armed with the vernacular, the struggle between the literary Chinese and the vernacular had long passed, unlike Mr. Liu, who was a person who had been in the melee, so he couldn't help but feel nostalgic for the old days and lament the last emotion. He flashed Song Ming's quotations under the banner of "humor", which was extremely natural.这“幽默”便是《论语》四十五期里的《一张字条的写法》，他因为要问木匠讨一点油灰，写好了一张语录体的字条，但怕别人说他“反对白话”，便改写了白话的，选体的，桐城派的三种，然而都很可笑，结果是差“书僮”传话，向木匠讨了油灰来。
This "humor" is the "Writing of a Note" in the forty-fifth issue of the Analects, because he wanted to ask the carpenter for a little putty, he wrote a note in the form of a quotation, but he was afraid that others would say that he was "against the vernacular", so he rewrote the vernacular, the selection, and the Tongcheng school, but they were all ridiculous, and the result was that the "book boy" sent a message and asked the carpenter for putty.《论语》是风行的刊物，这里省烦不抄了。总之，是：不可笑的只有语录式的一张，别的三种，全都要不得。但这四个不同的脚色，其实是都是林先生自己一个人扮出来的，一个是正生，就是“语录式”，别的三个都是小丑，自装鬼脸，自作怪相，将正生衬得一表非凡了。
The Analects is a popular publication, so I won't copy it here. In short, it is: the only thing that is ridiculous is a quotation-style one, and the other three are not allowed. But these four different characters are actually pretended by Mr. Lin himself, one is Zhengsheng, which is "quotation-style", and the other three are clowns, pretending to be funny and making their own strange appearances, which makes Zhengsheng extraordinary.但这已经并不是“幽默”，乃是“顽笑”，和市井间的在墙上画一乌龟，背上写上他的所讨厌的名字的战法，也并不两样的。不过看见的人，却往往不问是非，就嗤笑被画者。
But this is no longer "humor", but "naughty laughter", which is no different from the tactic of drawing a turtle on the wall in the market and writing his hated name on the back. However, those who see it often laugh at the person being painted without asking about right or wrong.“幽默”或“顽笑”，也都要生出结果来的，除非你心知其意，只当它“顽笑”看。
"Humor" or "naughty laughter" also have results, unless you know what it means and only treat it as a "naughty smile".因为事实会并不如文章，例如这语录式的条子，在中国其实也并未断绝过种子。假如有工夫，不妨到上海的弄口去看一看，有时就会看见一个摊，坐着一位文人，在替男女工人写信，他所用的文章，决不如林先生所拟的条子的容易懂，然而分明是“语录式”的。这就是现在从新提起的语录派的末流，却并没有谁去涂白过他的鼻子。
Because the facts will not be as good as the article, such as this quote-style note, the seeds have not actually been cut off in China. If you have time, you might as well go to the alley in Shanghai to take a look, and sometimes you will see a stall sitting a literati writing letters for male and female workers, and the articles he uses are by no means as easy to understand as the notes drafted by Mr. Lin, but they are clearly "quotation-style". This is the end of the quotation school that is being mentioned from now on, but no one has whitewashed his nose.这是一个具体的“幽默”。
This is a specific "humor".但是，要赏识“幽默”也真难。我曾经从生理学来证明过中国打屁股之合理：假使屁股是为了排泄或坐坐而生的罢，就不必这么大，脚底要小得远，不是足够支持全身了么？我们现在早不吃人了，肉也用不着这么多。那么，可见是专供打打之用的了。有时告诉人们，大抵以为是“幽默”。但假如有被打了的人，或自己遭了打，我想，恐怕那感应就不能这样了罢。
However, it is really difficult to appreciate "humor". I once proved the rationality of spanking in China from physiology: if the buttocks are born for excretion or sitting, they don't have to be so big, and the soles of the feet should be far away, isn't it enough to support the whole body? We don't eat people anymore, and we don't need so much meat. Then, it can be seen that it is exclusively for fighting. Sometimes I tell people that I think it's "humor". But if someone is beaten, or if they are beaten, I think that induction cannot be like this.没有法子，在大家都不适意的时候，恐怕终于是“中国没有幽默”的了。
There is no way, when everyone is uncomfortable, I am afraid that "China has no humor" in the end.七月十八日。
July 18th.

Shuoer沈括的《梦溪笔谈》里，有云：“往岁士人，多尚对偶为文，穆修张景辈始为平文，当时谓之‘古文’。穆张尝同造朝，待旦于东华门外，方论文次，适见有奔马，践死一犬，二人各记其事以较工拙。穆修曰：‘马逸，有黄犬，遇蹄而毙。’张景曰：‘有犬，死奔马之下。’时文体新变，二人之语皆拙涩，当时已谓之工，传之至今。”
沈括的《梦溪笔谈》里，有云：“往岁士人，多尚对偶为文，穆修张景辈始为平文，当时谓之‘古文’。 穆张尝同造朝，待旦于东华门外，方论文次，适见有奔马，践死一犬，二人各记其事以较工拙。 穆修曰：‘马逸，有黄犬，遇蹄而毙。 ’张景曰：‘有犬，死奔马之下。 ’时文体新变，二人之语皆拙涩，当时已谓之工，传之至今。 ”骈文后起，唐虞三代是不骈的，称“平文”为“古文”便是这意思。由此推开去，如果古者言文真是不分，则称“白话文”为“古文”，似乎也无所不可，但和林语堂先生的指为“白话的文言”的意思又不同。两人的大作，不但拙涩，主旨先就不一，穆说的是马踏死了犬，张说的是犬给马踏死了，究竟是着重在马，还是在犬呢？较明白稳当的还是沈括的毫不经意的文章：“有奔马，践死一犬。”
The three generations of Tang and Yu are not parallel, and this is what it means to call "plain text" "ancient text". From this, if the ancient Chinese is really indistinguishable, it seems that it is possible to call "vernacular Chinese" "ancient Chinese", but it is different from the meaning of Mr. Lin Yutang's referral to "vernacular Chinese". Mu said that the horse trampled the dog to death, and Zhang said that the dog trampled the horse to death, is it focused on the horse, or is it on the dog? What is more clear and stable is Shen Kuo's casual article: "There is a galloping horse, trampling a dog to death." ”因为要推倒旧东西，就要着力，太着力，就要“做”，太“做”，便不但“生涩”，有时简直是“格格不吐”了，比早经古人“做”得圆熟了的旧东西还要坏。而字数论旨，都有些限制的“花边文学”之类，尤其容易生这生涩病。
Because if you want to overthrow the old things, you have to focus on it, and if you focus too hard, you have to "do", and if you "do", it will not only be "jerky", but sometimes it is simply "not spitting out", which is worse than the old things that have been "done" by the ancients for a long time. The word count theory is somewhat restricted, such as "lace literature", which is especially prone to this jerky disease.太做不行，但不做，却又不行。用一段大树和四枝小树做一只凳，在现在，未免太毛糙，总得刨光它一下才好。但如全体雕花，中间挖空，却又坐不来，也不成其为凳子了。高尔基说，大众语是毛胚，加了工的是文学。我想，这该是很中肯的指示了。
It's not okay to do too much, but if you don't do it, you can't do it. Using a large tree and four small trees to make a stool, now, it is too rough, and it has to be planed away. But like all the carvings, the middle is hollowed out, but it can't sit down, and it is not a stool. Gorky said that popular language is the embryo of hair, and the work is literature. I think this should be a very pertinent instruction.七月二十日。

Read the book trivia焉于
Yanyu高尔基很惊服巴尔札克小说里写对话的巧妙，以为并不描写人物的模样，却能使读者看了对话，便好像目睹了说话的那些人。（八月份《文学》内《我的文学修养》）
Gorky was amazed by the ingenuity of writing dialogues in Balzac's novels, thinking that although they did not describe the appearance of the characters, they could make the reader see the dialogue as if they had witnessed the people speaking. ("My Literary Accomplishment" in "Literature" in August)中国还没有那样好手段的小说家，但《水浒》和《红楼梦》的有些地方，是能使读者由说话看出人来的。其实，这也并非什么奇特的事情，在上海的弄堂里，租一间小房子住着的人，就时时可以体验到。他和周围的住户，是不一定见过面的，但只隔一层薄板壁，所以有些人家的眷属和客人的谈话，尤其是高声的谈话，都大略可以听到，久而久之，就知道那里有那些人，而且仿佛觉得那些人是怎样的人了。
There are no novelists in China who have such good means, but there are some parts of "Water Margin" and "Dream of Red Mansions" that allow readers to see people from their words. In fact, this is not a strange thing, in the alleys of Shanghai, people who rent a small house can experience it from time to time. He and the surrounding residents may not have met each other, but they are only separated by a thin board wall, so the conversations between some people's relatives and guests, especially loud conversations, can be roughly heard.如果删除了不必要之点，只摘出各人的有特色的谈话来，我想，就可以使别人从谈话里推见每个说话的人物。但我并不是说，这就成了中国的巴尔札克。
If we remove unnecessary points and only pick out each person's characteristic conversation, I think we can make others see each person from the conversation. But I'm not saying that this has become China's Balzac.作者用对话表现人物的时候，恐怕在他自己的心目中，是存在着这人物的模样的，于是传给读者，使读者的心目中也形成了这人物的模样。但读者所推见的人物，却并不一定和作者所设想的相同，巴尔札克的小胡须的清瘦老人，到了高尔基的头里，也许变了粗蛮壮大的络腮胡子。不过那性格，言动，一定有些类似，大致不差，恰如将法文翻成了俄文一样。要不然，文学这东西便没有普遍性了。
When the author expresses the character with dialogue, I am afraid that in his own mind, the appearance of this character exists, so it is passed on to the reader, so that the appearance of this character is also formed in the reader's mind. But the characters inferred by the reader are not necessarily the same as the author imagined, and the thin old man with Balzac's beard may have turned into a rough and strong beard in Gorky's head. However, the character, words and deeds must be somewhat similar, roughly not bad, just like translating French into Russian. Otherwise, literature would not be universal.文学虽然有普遍性，但因读者的体验的不同而有变化，读者倘没有类似的体验，它也就失去了效力。譬如我们看《红楼梦》，从文字上推见了林黛玉这一个人，但须排除了梅博士的“黛玉葬花”照相的先入之见，另外想一个，那么，恐怕会想到剪头发，穿印度绸衫，清瘦，寂寞的摩登女郎；或者别的什么模样，我不能断定。但试去和三四十年前出版的《红楼梦图咏》之类里面的画像比一比罢，一定是截然两样的，那上面所画的，是那时的读者的心目中的林黛玉。
Although literature is universal, it changes according to the different experiences of readers, and if readers do not have similar experiences, it will lose its effectiveness. For example, when we watch "Dream of Red Mansions", we can infer Lin Daiyu from the text, but we must eliminate the preconceived notion of Dr. Mei's "Daiyu Funeral Flower" photo, and think of another one, then, I am afraid that we will think of a modern girl who cuts her hair, wears an Indian silk shirt, is thin, and lonely; Or something else, I can't say. But if you try to compare it with the portraits in "Dream of Red Mansions" published thirty or forty years ago, they must be completely different, and the painting on it is Lin Daiyu in the minds of readers at that time.文学有普遍性，但有界限；也有较为永久的，但因读者的社会体验而生变化。北极的遏斯吉摩人和菲洲腹地的黑人，我以为是不会懂得“林黛玉型”的；健全而合理的好社会中人，也将不能懂得，他们大约要比我们的听讲始皇焚书，黄巢杀人更其隔膜。一有变化，即非永久，说文学独有仙骨，是做梦的人们的梦话。
Literature has universality, but there are boundaries; There are also more permanent ones, but they change due to the reader's social experience. The Esjimos in the Arctic and the blacks in the hinterland of the Philippines, I thought they would not understand the "Lin Daiyu type"; People in a sound and reasonable good society will not be able to understand that they are probably more separated than we heard about the first emperor's burning of books and Huang Chao's murder. As soon as there is a change, that is, it is not permanent, it is said that literature has a unique fairy bone, which is the dream of dreamers.八月六日。

Yanyu就在同时代，同国度里，说话也会彼此说不通的。

Barbisé has a very interesting short story called "National and Foreign", which records that a wealthy man in France entertained three soldiers who died in the European war, and the young lady came out to greet them, but there was nothing to say, and they barely said a few words, and they had nothing to answer, but they only felt that sitting in a large room, they were careful and had a headache. The young lady later said to a gentleman: "I can't even talk to them." It seems that there is an insurmountable abyss between them and us. ”其实，这也无须小姐和兵们是这样。就是我们——算作“封建余孽”或“买办”或别的什么而论都可以——和几乎同类的人，只要什么地方有些不同，又得心口如一，就往往免不了彼此无话可说。不过我们中国人是聪明的，有些人早已发明了一种万应灵药，就是“今天天气……哈哈哈！”倘是宴会，就只猜拳，不发议论。
In fact, this doesn't need to be the case with the young ladies and soldiers. It is that we—counted as "feudal remnants" or "compradors" or whatever—and almost the same kind of people, as long as they are a little different and have the same heart, often have nothing to say to each other. But we are Chinese smart, and some people have already invented a panacea, which is "today's weather...... Hahaha! "If it's a banquet, just guess the fist and don't talk about it.这样看来，文学要普遍而且永久，恐怕实在有些艰难。“今天天气……哈哈哈！”虽然有些普遍，但能否永久，却很可疑，而且也不大像文学。于是高超的文学家便自己定了一条规则，将不懂他的“文学”的人们，都推出“人类”之外，以保持其普遍性。文学还有别的性，他是不肯说破的，因此也只好用这手段。然而这么一来，“文学”存在，“人”却不多了。
From this point of view, it may be a bit difficult for literature to be universal and permanent. "Today's weather ...... Hahaha! "Although it is somewhat common, it is doubtful whether it can be permanent, and it is not very much like literature. So the superb writer set a rule for himself to push people who did not understand his "literature" out of "humans" to maintain its universality. Literature has other natures, and he refuses to break it, so he has to use this method. However, in this way, "literature" exists, but there are not many "people".于是而据说文学愈高超，懂得的人就愈少，高超之极，那普遍性和永久性便只汇集于作者一个人。然而文学家却又悲哀起来，说是吐血了，这真是没有法子想。
Therefore, it is said that the more superb the literature, the fewer people understand, and the greater the superb, the universality and permanence are only concentrated in the author alone. The law of being content with poverty and happiness史贲
Shi Ben孩子是要别人教的，毛病是要别人医的，即使自己是教员或医生。但做人处世的法子，却恐怕要自己斟酌，许多别人开来的良方，往往不过是废纸。
Children are taught by others, and problems are treated by others, even if they are teachers or doctors. But the way to live in the world is probably to be considered by yourself, and many good prescriptions prescribed by others are often just waste paper.劝人安贫乐道是古今治国平天下的大经络，开过的方子也很多，但都没有十全大补的功效。因此新方子也开不完，新近就看见了两种，但我想：恐怕都不大妥当。
Persuading people to be content with poverty is the great meridian of governing the country and pacifying the world in ancient and modern times, and there are many prescriptions, but none of them have the effect of perfecting the tonic effect. Therefore, there are endless new prescriptions, and I have seen two recently, but I think: I'm afraid they are not very appropriate.一种是教人对于职业要发生兴趣，一有兴趣，就无论什么事，都乐此不倦了。当然，言之成理的，但到底须是轻松一点的职业。且不说掘煤，挑粪那些事，就是上海工厂里做工至少每天十点的工人，到晚快边就一定筋疲力倦，受伤的事情是大抵出在那时候的。“健全的精神，宿于健全的身体之中”，连自己的身体也顾不转了，怎么还会有兴趣？——除非他爱兴趣比性命还利害。倘若问他们自己罢，我想，一定说是减少工作的时间，做梦也想不到发生兴趣法的。
One is to teach people to be interested in their careers, and once they are interested, they will be happy to do anything. Of course, it makes sense, but it must be a more relaxed profession. Not to mention the things of digging coal and picking up dung, that is, the workers who work at least ten o'clock every day in the Shanghai factory must be exhausted at night, and the injuries are probably caused at that time. "A sound spirit dwells in a sound body", and even your own body can't take care of it, how can you still be interested? ——Unless he loves interests more than his life. There is also an extremely thorough one: it is said that it is a hot day, and the broad people are still busy socializing and sweating, but the poor people have a broken mat, spread it on the road, take off their clothes, take off their clothes, take a cool breeze, and have endless fun, which is called "sweeping the world". This is also a rare poetic prescription, but there is also a bad scenery behind. It was almost cool in autumn, and I went for a walk on the road early in the morning, and saw those who held their stomachs in their hands and spat out yellow water in their mouths were those former living immortals who "swept the world". “…… If virtue has been established, then although the food is not enough and the elbow is seen, its name and virtue will be passed down to future generations, and the spiritual life will be fully developed, so why worry about the lack of material life? This goes one step further than the title, saying that it doesn't matter if you can't even "fill your stomach". However, the good prescriptions prescribed by middle school students are not applicable to college students, and at the same time, there is still a large group of people who demand careers.事实是毫无情面的东西，它能将空言打得粉碎。有这么的彰明较著，其实，据我的愚见，是大可以不必再玩“之乎者也”了——横竖永远是没有用的。

There are many facts in the world that even geniuses cannot imagine without reading the records. There is a kind of natives in Africa, and the taboos of men and women are very strict, even when the son-in-law meets the mother-in-law, he has to lie on the ground, and it is not enough, he must bury his face in the soil. This is really incomparable to the ancients of our country of propriety and righteousness, "men and women are not sitting at the same table for seven years".这样看来，我们的古人对于分隔男女的设计，也还不免是低能儿；现在总跳不出古人的圈子，更是低能之至。不同泳，不同行，不同食，不同做电影，都只是“不同席”的演义。低能透顶的是还没有想到男女同吸着相通的空气，从这个男人的鼻孔里呼出来，又被那个女人从鼻孔里吸进去，淆乱乾坤，实在比海水只触着皮肤更为严重。对于这一个严重问题倘没有办法，男女的界限就永远分不清。
From this point of view, our ancients were inevitably imbecile in the design of separating men and women; Now I can't jump out of the circle of the ancients, and I am even more imbecile. Different swimming, different walks, different foods, and different movies are all just the romance of "different seats". The imbecile thing is that he has not yet thought that men and women breathe air together, exhale it from this man's nostrils, and be sucked in by that woman from his nostrils, confusing the world, which is really more serious than seawater only touching the skin. If there is no way to solve this serious problem, the boundaries between men and women will never be clear.我想，这只好用“西法”了。西法虽非国粹，有时却能够帮助国粹的。例如无线电播音，是摩登的东西，但早晨有和尚念经，却不坏；汽车固然是洋货，坐着去打麻将，却总比坐绿呢大轿，好半天才到的打得多几圈。以此类推，防止男女同吸空气就可以用防毒面具，各背一个箱，将养气由管子通到自己的鼻孔里，既免抛头露面，又兼防空演习，也就是“中学为体，西学为用”。凯末尔将军治国以前的土耳其女人的面幕，这回可也万万比不上了。
I think this has to be "West Law". Although Western law is not the quintessence, it can sometimes help the quintessence. For example, radio broadcasting is a modern thing, but it is not bad if there is a monk chanting in the morning; Although the car is a foreign product, it is better to sit and play mahjong than to sit in a green sedan chair, and it takes a long time to play a few more laps. By analogy, to prevent men and women from breathing air together, they can use gas masks, carry a box each, and pass the nostrils from the tube to their nostrils, which not only avoids showing their faces, but also serves as an air defense exercise, that is, "middle school as the body, Western learning as the use". The face of the Turkish women before General Kemal's rule is never comparable this time.假使现在有一个英国的斯惠夫德似的人，做一部《格利佛游记》那样的讽刺的小说，说在二十世纪中，到了一个文明的国度，看见一群人在烧香拜龙，作法求雨，赏鉴“胖女”，禁杀乌龟；又一群人在正正经经的研究古代舞法，主张男女分途，以及女人的腿应该不许其露出。那么，远处，或是将来的人，恐怕大抵要以为这是作者贫嘴薄舌，随意捏造，以挖苦他所不满的人们的罢。
If there is a person like Swiff in England who makes a satirical novel like "Gulliver's Travels", saying that in the middle of the twentieth century, when he arrived in a civilized country, he saw a group of people burning incense and worshiping dragons, praying for rain, appreciating "fat women", and forbidding the killing of turtles; Another group of people are seriously studying ancient dance methods, advocating the separation of men and women, and that women's legs should not be exposed. Then, people from afar or in the future will probably think that this is the author's poor tongue and fabrication at will to satirize the people he is dissatisfied with.然而这的确是事实。倘没有这样的事实，大约无论怎样刻薄的天才作家也想不到的。幻想总不能怎样的出奇，所以人们看见了有些事，就有叫作“奇怪”这一句话。
However, this is indeed true. Without such a fact, no matter how mean a genius writer would have imagined. Fantasy can't be so surprising, so when people see something, they call it "strange".八月十四日。

Strange (2)白道
White way尤墨君先生以教师的资格参加着讨论大众语，那意见是极该看重的。他主张“使中学生练习大众语”，还举出“中学生作文最喜用而又最误用的许多时髦字眼”来，说“最好叫他们不要用”，待他们将来能够辨别时再说，因为是与其“食新不化，何如禁用于先”的。现在摘一点所举的“时髦字眼”在这里——
Mr. You Mojun participated in the discussion of popular language as a teacher, and that opinion should be highly valued. He advocated "allowing middle school students to practice popular language", and also cited "many fashionable words that middle school students like to use the most and most misused", saying that "it is better to tell them not to use them", and talk about it when they can discern it in the future, because it is better to "eat new and not change, why not ban it first". Now I will pick up the "fashionable words" mentioned here -共鸣　对象　气压　温度　结晶　彻底　趋势　理智　现实　下意识　相对性　绝对性　纵剖面　横剖面　死亡率……（《新语林》三期）
Resonance Object Air Pressure Temperature Crystallization Thorough Trend Reason Reality Subconscious Relativity Absoluteness Longitudinal Profile Horizontal Profile Mortality ...... ("New Language Forest" Issue 3)但是我很奇怪。
But I was strange.那些字眼，几乎算不得“时髦字眼”了。如“对象”“现实”等，只要看看书报的人，就时常遇见，一常见，就会比较而得其意义，恰如孩子懂话，并不依靠文法教科书一样；何况在学校中，还有教员的指点。至于“温度”“结晶”“纵剖面”“横剖面”等，也是科学上的名词，中学的物理学矿物学植物学教科书里就有，和用于国文上的意义并无不同。现在竟“最误用”，莫非自己既不思索，教师也未给指点，而且连别的科学也一样的模胡吗？
Those words are hardly "fashionable words". For example, "object" and "reality", as long as you read books and newspapers, you will often meet them, and when they are common, they will compare and get their meaning, just like children understand words and do not rely on grammar textbooks; What's more, in school, there is also the guidance of teachers. As for "temperature", "crystallization", "longitudinal profile", "horizontal section", etc., they are also scientific terms, which are found in middle school physics, mineralogy, and botany textbooks, and are no different from the meaning used in Chinese. Now it is "the most misused", could it be that he has neither thought about it, nor has the teacher given guidance, and even other sciences are the same?那么，单是中途学了大众语，也不过是一位中学出身的速成大众，于大众有什么用处呢？大众的需要中学生，是因为他教育程度比较的高，能够给大家开拓知识，增加语汇，能解明的就解明，该新添的就新添；他对于“对象”等等的界说，就先要弄明白，当必要时，有方言可以替代，就译换，倘没有，便教给这新名词，并且说明这意义。如果大众语既是半路出家，新名词也还不很明白，这“落伍”可真是“彻底”了。
So, just learning popular language in the middle is just a quick public from middle school, what is the use of the public? The public needs middle school students because they have a relatively high level of education, can open up knowledge and increase vocabulary for everyone, explain what can be explained, and add new things that should be added; He first understood that when necessary, if there was a dialect that could be replaced, he would translate it, and if not, he would teach the new term and explain its meaning. If the popular language is not only a monk halfway, and the new noun is not well understood, this "outdated" is really "complete".我想，为大众而练习大众语，倒是不该禁用那些“时髦字眼”的，最要紧的是教给他定义，教师对于中学生，和将来中学生的对于大众一样。譬如“纵断面”和“横断面”，解作“直切面”和“横切面”，就容易懂；倘说就是“横锯面”和“直锯面”，那么，连木匠学徒也明白了，无须识字。禁，是不好的，他们中有些人将永远模胡，“因为中学生不一定个个能升入大学而实现其做文豪或学者的理想的”。
I think that practicing popular language for the sake of the public should not ban those "fashionable words", the most important thing is to teach him the definition, teachers for middle school students is the same for future middle school students to the public. For example, "longitudinal section" and "cross-section" are interpreted as "straight section" and "cross-section", which is easy to understand; If it is a "horizontal saw surface" and a "straight saw surface", then even the carpenter apprentice understands that there is no need to be literate. Prohibition is not good, and some of them will always be foolish, "because not all middle school students can enter university and realize their ideals of being writers or scholars."八月十四日。

迎神和咬人

迎神和咬人

迎神和咬人

Welcome the gods and bite越侨
Overseas Chinese报载余姚的某乡，农民们因为旱荒，迎神求雨，看客有带帽的，便用刀棒乱打他一通。
It was reported that in a certain township in Yuyao, farmers prayed for rain because of drought, and the spectators had hats, so they beat him with knives and sticks.这是迷信，但是有根据的。汉先儒董仲舒先生就有祈雨法，什么用寡妇，关城门，乌烟瘴气，其古怪与道士无异，而未尝为今儒所订正。虽在通都大邑，现在也还有天师作法，长官禁屠，闹得沸反盈天，何尝惹出一点口舌？至于打帽，那是因为恐怕神看见还很有人悠然自得，不垂哀怜；一面则也憎恶他的不与大家共患难。
It's superstition, but it's well-founded. Mr. Dong Zhongshu, a scholar of the Han Dynasty, had a method of praying for rain, what to use a widow, closing the city gate, and the miasma, which was strange and no different from Taoists, but it was not corrected by modern Confucians. Although it is in Tongdu Dayi, there are still heavenly masters who practice it, and the governor prohibits slaughtering, making a lot of noise, so why provoke a little tongue? As for hatting, it is because God is afraid that there are still many people who are leisurely and do not show mercy. On the other hand, he also hates him for not sharing hardships with everyone.迎神，农民们的本意是在救死的——但可惜是迷信，——但除此之外，他们也不知道别一样。
The peasants were meant to save lives - but unfortunately they were superstitious,—— but other than that, they didn't know anything else.报又载有一个六十多岁的老党员，出面劝阻迎神，被大家一顿打，终于咬断了喉管，死掉了。
The newspaper also reported that an old party member in his sixties came forward to dissuade Yingshen, was beaten by everyone, and finally bit off his throat and died.这是妄信，但是也有根据的。《精忠说岳全传》说张俊陷害忠良，终被众人咬死，人心为之大快。因此乡间就向来有一个传说，谓咬死了人，皇帝必赦，因为怨恨而至于咬，则被咬者之恶，也就可想而知了。我不知道法律，但大约民国以前的律文中，恐怕也未必有这样的规定罢。
This is a delusion, but it is also well-founded. "Jingzhong Shuo Yue Quan's Biography" said that Zhang Jun framed Zhongliang and was finally bitten to death by everyone, and people's hearts were very happy. Therefore, there has always been a legend in the countryside that if someone is bitten to death, the emperor will forgive him, and if he bites because of resentment, then the evil of the bitten person can be imagined. I don't know the law, but I am afraid that there may not be such a provision in the legal texts before the Republic of China.咬人，农民们的本意是在逃死的——但可惜是妄信，——但除此之外，他们也不知道别一样。
Biting, the peasants intended to escape to death - but unfortunately they believed it,—— but other than that, they didn't know anything else.想救死，想逃死，适所以自速其死，哀哉！
I want to save my life, I want to escape death, and I just hasten my own death, how tragic!自从由帝国成为民国以来，上层的改变是不少了，无教育的农民，却还未得到一点什么新的有益的东西，依然是旧日的迷信，旧日的讹传，在拚命的救死和逃死中自速其死。
Since the empire became the Republic of China, there have been many changes at the top, and the uneducated peasants have not yet received anything new and useful, and they are still the superstitions of the past, the rumors of the past, and they are desperately trying to save their lives and escape death.这回他们要得到“天讨”。他们要骇怕，但因为不解“天讨”的缘故，他们也要不平。待到这骇怕和不平忘记了，就只有迷信讹传剩着，待到下一次水旱灾荒的时候，依然是迎神，咬人。
This time they want to get "heavenly begging". They want to be frightened, but because they don't understand the "heavenly retribution", they also want to be unfair. When this fear and injustice are forgotten, only superstitions and rumors remain, and when the next flood and drought disaster occurs, it will still be to welcome the gods and bite people.这悲剧何时完结呢？
When will this tragedy end?八月十九日。

看书琐记（三）

看书琐记（三）

看书琐记（三）

Reading Trivia (3)焉于
Yanyu创作家大抵憎恶批评家的七嘴八舌。
Creators generally hate critics' tongue-in-cheek.记得有一位诗人说过这样的话：诗人要做诗，就如植物要开花，因为他非开不可的缘故。如果你摘去吃了，即使中了毒，也是你自己错。
I remember a poet once said: A poet wants to write poetry, just like a plant wants to bloom, because he must bloom. If you pick it and eat it, even if you are poisoned, it is your own fault.这比喻很美，也仿佛很有道理的。但再一想，却也有错误。错的是诗人究竟不是一株草，还是社会里的一个人；况且诗集是卖钱的，何尝可以白摘。一卖钱，这就是商品，买主也有了说好说歹的权利了。
This metaphor is beautiful and seems to make sense. But when I think about it again, there are mistakes. What is wrong is whether the poet is not a grass or a person in society; Moreover, poetry collections are sold for money, so how can they be picked for nothing? As soon as the money is sold, this is the commodity, and the buyer also has the right to say what is good or bad.即使真是花罢，倘不是开在深山幽谷，人迹不到之处，如果有毒，那是园丁之流就要想法的。花的事实，也并不如诗人的空想。
Even if it is really a flower, if it does not bloom in a deep mountain valley and out of reach of human traffic, if it is poisonous, it is what gardeners and others have to think of. The fact of flowers is not as imaginary as the poet imagines.现在可是换了一个说法了，连并非作者，也憎恶了批评家，他们里有的说道：你这么会说，那么，你倒来做一篇试试看！
Now it's a different statement, even those who are not authors hate critics, and some of them say: You are so good at saying, then, you can try to write one!这真要使批评家抱头鼠窜。因为批评家兼能创作的人，向来是很少的。
This really makes critics run away. Because there have always been very few people who can both criticize and create.我想，作家和批评家的关系，颇有些像厨司和食客。厨司做出一味食品来，食客就要说话，或是好，或是歹。厨司如果觉得不公平，可以看看他是否神经病，是否厚舌苔，是否挟夙嫌，是否想赖账。或者他是否广东人，想吃蛇肉；是否四川人，还要辣椒。于是提出解说或抗议来——自然，一声不响也可以。但是，倘若他对着客人大叫道：“那么，你去做一碗来给我吃吃看！”那却未免有些可笑了。
I think the relationship between writers and critics is a bit like a chef and a diner. When the chef makes a food, the diner has to talk, whether it's good or bad. If the chef feels unfair, you can see if he is neurotic, whether he has a thick tongue, whether he has a grudge, and if he wants to be in debt. Or whether he is from Guangdong and wants to eat snake meat; Whether you are from Sichuan or not, you still need chili peppers. So I put forward an explanation or protest - naturally, it is okay to make a sound. However, if he yells at the guests, "Then, make a bowl for me to eat!" That's a bit ridiculous.诚然，四五年前，用笔的人以为一做批评家，便可以高踞文坛，所以速成和乱评的也不少，但要矫正这风气，是须用批评的批评的，只在批评家这名目上，涂上烂泥，并不是好办法。不过我们的读书界，是爱平和的多，一见笔战，便是什么“文坛的悲观”呀，“文人相轻”呀，甚至于不问是非，统谓之“互骂”，指为“漆黑一团糟”。果然，现在是听不见说谁是批评家了。但文坛呢，依然如故，不过它不再露出来。
It is true that four or five years ago, people who used pens thought that as soon as they became critics, they could dominate the literary world, so there were many quick and random comments, but to correct this atmosphere, it was necessary to use criticism to criticize, and it was not a good way to smear mud only in the name of critics. However, our reading circle is much more peaceful, and when we see the pen battle, it is what kind of "pessimism in the literary world", "literati look down on each other", and even do not ask about right and wrong, collectively called "scolding each other", referring to "pitch black mess". Sure enough, I can't hear who the critics are now. But the literary world is still the same, but it is no longer revealed.文艺必须有批评；批评如果不对了，就得用批评来抗争，这才能够使文艺和批评一同前进，如果一律掩住嘴，算是文坛已经干净，那所得的结果倒是要相反的。
literature and art must have criticism; If criticism is wrong, it must be fought with criticism, so that literature and art and criticism can move forward together.八月二十二日。

“大雪纷飞”

“大雪纷飞”

“大雪纷飞”

"Heavy snow"张沛
Zhang Pei人们遇到要支持自己的主张的时候，有时会用一枝粉笔去搪对手的脸，想把他弄成丑角模样，来衬托自己是正生。但那结果，却常常适得其反。
When people encounter a point of support for their own ideas, they sometimes use a branch of chalk to scratch the opponent's face, trying to make him look like a harlequin to set off that he is a positive person. But the result is often counterproductive.章士钊先生现在是在保障民权了，段政府时代，他还曾经保障文言。他造过一个实例，说倘将“二桃杀三士”用白话写作“两个桃子杀了三个读书人”，是多么的不行。这回李焰生先生反对大众语文，也赞成“静珍君之所举，‘大雪纷飞’，总比那‘大雪一片一片纷纷的下着’来得简要而有神韵，酌量采用，是不能与提倡文言文相提并论”的。
Mr. Zhang Shizhao is now protecting civil rights, and during the Duan administration, he also protected Wenyan. He once made an example of how bad it would be if "two peaches killed three scholars" were written in the vernacular as "two peaches killed three scholars". This time, Mr. Li Yansheng opposed popular Chinese, and also agreed that "Jing Zhenjun's recommendation, 'heavy snow' is more concise and charming than the 'heavy snow falling one by one', and it cannot be compared with advocating classical Chinese."我也赞成必不得已的时候，大众语文可以采用文言，白话，甚至于外国话，而且在事实上，现在也已经在采用。但是，两位先生代译的例子，却是很不对劲的。那时的“士”，并非一定是“读书人”，早经有人指出了；这回的“大雪纷飞”里，也没有“一片一片”的意思，这不过特地弄得累坠，掉着要大众语丢脸的枪花。
I also agree that when it is absolutely necessary, popular languages can be used in classical Chinese, vernacular, and even foreign languages, and in fact, they are already being adopted. However, the example of the two gentlemen translating on behalf of them is very wrong. At that time, the "scholars" were not necessarily "scholars", as it was pointed out earlier; In this "heavy snow", there is no meaning of "piece by piece", which is just a special tired fall and a gun that makes the public say embarrassed.白话并非文言的直译，大众语也并非文言或白话的直译。在江浙，倘要说出“大雪纷飞”的意思来，是并不用“大雪一片一片纷纷的下着”的，大抵用“凶”，“猛”或“厉害”，来形容这下雪的样子。倘要“对证古本”，则《水浒传》里的一句“那雪正下得紧”，就是接近现代的大众语的说法，比“大雪纷飞”多两个字，但那“神韵”却好得远了。
The vernacular is not a literal translation of classical Chinese, and the popular language is not a literal translation of classical Chinese or vernacular. In Jiangsu and Zhejiang, if you want to say the meaning of "heavy snow", you don't use "heavy snow falling one by one", but "fierce", "fierce" or "powerful" to describe the appearance of the snow. If you want to "prove the ancient text", then the sentence "the snow is falling tightly" in "Water Margin" is close to the modern popular language, which is two more words than "heavy snow flying", but the "charm" is far better.一个人从学校跳到社会的上层，思想和言语，都一步一步的和大众离开，那当然是“势所不免”的事。不过他倘不是从小就是公子哥儿，曾经多少和“下等人”有些相关，那么，回心一想，一定可以记得他们有许多赛过文言文或白话文的好话。如果自造一点丑恶，来证明他的敌对的不行，那只是他从隐蔽之处挖出来的自己的丑恶，不能使大众羞，只能使大众笑。大众虽然智识没有读书人的高，但他们对于胡说的人们，却有一个谥法：绣花枕头。这意义，也许只有乡下人能懂的了，因为穷人塞在枕头里面的，不是鸭绒：是稻草。
It is of course "inevitable" for a person to jump from school to the upper echelons of society, and his thoughts and words leave the public step by step. However, if he hadn't been a young man since he was a child, and he had something to do with "inferior people", then, looking back, he would definitely remember that they had a lot of good words in classical Chinese or vernacular. If he creates a little ugliness to prove that his hostility is not good, it is just his own ugliness dug out from a hidden place, which cannot make the public ashamed, but can only make the public laugh. Although the public is not as intellectual as the scholars, they have a posthumous method for people who talk nonsense: embroidered pillows. This meaning may only be understood by country people, because what the poor stuff into their pillows is not duck down: it is straw.八月二十二日。

汉字和拉丁化

汉字和拉丁化

汉字和拉丁化

Chinese characters and Latinization仲度
Zhongdu反对大众语文的人，对主张者得意地命令道：“拿出货色来看！”一面也真有这样的老实人，毫不问他是诚意，还是寻开心，立刻拚命的来做标本。
Those who opposed popular language proudly ordered the advocates: "Take out the goods and see!" On the one hand, there is really such an honest person, who doesn't ask him whether he is sincere or looking for happiness, and immediately desperately comes to make a specimen.由读书人来提倡大众语，当然比提倡白话困难。因为提倡白话时，好好坏坏，用的总算是白话，现在提倡大众语的文章却大抵不是大众语。但是，反对者是没有发命令的权利的。虽是一个残废人，倘在主张健康运动，他绝对没有错；如果提倡缠足，则即使是天足的壮健的女性，她还是在有意的或无意的害人。美国的水果大王，只为改良一种水果，尚且要费十来年的工夫，何况是问题大得多多的大众语。倘若就用他的矛去攻他的盾，那么，反对者该是赞成文言或白话的了，文言有几千年的历史，白话有近二十年的历史，他也拿出他的“货色”来给大家看看罢。
It is certainly more difficult for scholars to advocate popular language than to advocate vernacular language. Because when advocating vernacular, good or bad, the vernacular is finally used, but now the articles advocating popular language are probably not popular language. However, the opponent has no right to issue orders. Although he is a disabled person, if he advocates healthy exercise, he is absolutely not wrong; If foot binding is advocated, even a strong woman with natural feet is still intentionally or unintentionally harming others. The fruit king of the United States only takes more than ten years to improve a fruit, not to mention the popular language that is much more problematic. If he uses his spear to attack his shield, then the opponents should be in favor of the literary language or the vernacular, which has a history of thousands of years, and the vernacular has a history of nearly 20 years, and he also took out his "goods" to show everyone.但是，我们也不妨自己来试验，在《动向》上，就已经有过三篇纯用土话的文章，胡绳先生看了之后，却以为还是非土话所写的句子来得清楚。其实，只要下一番工夫，是无论用什么土话写，都可以懂得的。据我个人的经验，我们那里的土话，和苏州很不同，但一部《海上花列传》，却教我“足不出户”的懂了苏白。先是不懂，硬着头皮看下去，参照记事，比较对话，后来就都懂了。自然，很困难。这困难的根，我以为就在汉字。每一个方块汉字，是都有它的意义的，现在用它来照样的写土话，有些是仍用本义的，有些却不过借音，于是我们看下去的时候，就得分析它那几个是用义，那几个是借音，惯了不打紧，开手却非常吃力了。
However, we might as well experiment ourselves, in "Trends", there have already been three articles in pure vernacular, and after Mr. Hu Sheng read it, he thought that the sentences written in non-vernacular were clear. In fact, as long as you put in a little effort, you can understand it no matter what vernacular you write. According to my personal experience, our local dialect is very different from Suzhou, but a "Biography of Flowers on the Sea" taught me to understand Su Bai "without leaving home". At first, I didn't understand, so I bit the bullet and read it, referred to the notes, compared the dialogue, and then I understood everything. Naturally, it is difficult. I think the root of this difficulty lies in Chinese characters. Every square Chinese character has its meaning, and now it is used to write the vernacular dialect as usual, some are still in the original meaning, and some are just borrowed sounds, so when we look at it, we have to analyze which of them are used in meaning, and those are borrowed sounds.例如胡绳先生所举的例子，说“回到窝里向罢”也许会当作回到什么狗“窝”里去，反不如说“回到家里去”的清楚。那一句的病根就在汉字的“窝”字，实际上，恐怕是不该这么写法的。我们那里的乡下人，也叫“家里”作Uwao-li，读书人去抄，也极容易写成“窝里”的，但我想，这Uwao其实是“屋下”两音的拼合，而又讹了一点，决不能用“窝”字随便来替代，如果只记下没有别的意义的音，就什么误解也不会有了。
For example, the example given by Mr. Hu Sheng may be regarded as returning to some dog "den", but it is better to say "go back to home". The root of the problem of that sentence lies in the word "nest" in Chinese characters, in fact, I am afraid it should not be written this way. Our countrymen there also call "home" as Uwao-li, and it is very easy for scholars to copy it as "nest", but I think that this Uwao is actually a combination of the two sounds of "under the house", and it is a little wrong, and it must not be replaced by the word "nest" casually, if you only write down the sound that has no other meaning, there will be no misunderstanding.大众语文的音数比文言和白话繁，如果还是用方块字来写，不但费脑力，也很费工夫，连纸墨都不经济。为了这方块的带病的遗产，我们的最大多数人，已经几千年做了文盲来殉难了，中国也弄到这模样，到别国已在人工造雨的时候，我们却还是拜蛇，迎神。如果大家还要活下去，我想：是只好请汉字来做我们的牺牲了。
The number of sounds in popular language is more complex than that of classical Chinese and vernacular, and if you still write in square characters, it is not only brain-intensive, but also labor-intensive, and even paper and ink are not economical. For the sake of this square's diseased legacy, most of us have been illiterate for thousands of years to be martyred, and China has also achieved this. If everyone wants to live, I think: we have to ask Chinese characters to make our sacrifices.现在只还有“书法拉丁化”的一条路。这和大众语文是分不开的。也还是从读书人首先试验起，先绍介过字母，拼法，然后写文章。开手是，像日本文那样，只留一点名词之类的汉字，而助词，感叹词，后来连形容词，动词也都用拉丁拼音写，那么，不但顺眼，对于了解也容易得远了。至于改作横行，那是当然的事。
Now there is only one way to "Latinize calligraphy". This is inseparable from popular language. It is also from the beginning of the scholar's experiment, first introduce the letters, spell, and then write the article. The beginning is, like in Japanese, only a few Chinese characters such as nouns are left, and particles, interjections, and later even adjectives and verbs are written in Latin pinyin, so it is not only pleasing to the eye, but also far easier to understand. As for the change to rampant, that is a matter of course.这就是现在马上来实验，我以为也并不难。
This is the experiment now, I thought it was not difficult.不错，汉字是古代传下来的宝贝，但我们的祖先，比汉字还要古，所以我们更是古代传下来的宝贝。为汉字而牺牲我们，还是为我们而牺牲汉字呢？这是只要还没有丧心病狂的人，都能够马上回答的。
Yes, Chinese characters are treasures passed down from ancient times, but our ancestors are older than Chinese characters, so we are treasures passed down from ancient times. Sacrifice us for Chinese characters, or sacrifice Chinese characters for us? This is something that anyone who is not yet crazy can answer immediately.八月二十三日。

商贾的批评

Criticism from merchants及锋
And the edge中国现今没有好作品，早已使批评家或胡评家不满，前些时还曾经探究过它的所以没有的原因。结果是没有结果。但还有新解释。林希隽先生说是因为“作家毁掉了自己，以投机取巧的手腕”去作“杂文”了，所以也害得做不成莘克莱或托尔斯泰（《现代》九月号）。还有一位希隽先生，却以为“在这资本主义的社会里头，……作家无形中也就成为商贾了。……为了获利较多的报酬起见，便也不得不采用‘粗制滥造’的方法，再没有人殚精竭虑用苦工夫去认真创作了。”（《社会月报》九月号）
There are no good works in China today, which has long dissatisfied critics or critics, and some time ago I explored the reason why it did not exist. The result is no result. But there are new explanations. Mr. Lin Xijun said that it was because "the writer destroyed himself and used opportunistic skills to write "essays", so he could not be a Sinclair or Tolstoy (September issue of "Modern"). There is also a Mr. Xijun, but he thinks that "in this capitalist society,...... The writer has become a merchant invisibly. …… In order to make more profits, they had to adopt the method of 'shoddy production', and no one worked hard to create seriously. (September issue of Social Monthly)着眼在经济上，当然可以说是进了一步。但这“殚精竭虑用苦工夫去认真创作”出来的学说，和我们只有常识的见解是很不一样的。我们向来只以为用资本来获利的是商人，所以在出版界，商人是用钱开书店来赚钱的老板。到现在才知道用文章去卖有限的稿费的也是商人，不过是一种“无形中”的商人。农民省几斗米去出售，工人用筋力去换钱，教授卖嘴，妓女卖淫，也都是“无形中”的商人。只有买主不是商人了，但他的钱一定是用东西换来的，所以也是商人。于是“在这资本主义社会里头”，个个都是商人，但可分为在“无形中”和有形中的两大类。
Focusing on the economy, of course, it can be said that it is a step further. But this doctrine of "painstaking and hard work to create seriously" is very different from our common sense opinion. We have always thought that it is businessmen who use capital to make profits, so in the publishing industry, businessmen are bosses who use money to open bookstores to make money. Only now do I know that it is also businessmen who use articles to sell limited manuscript fees, but they are a kind of "invisible" businessmen. Peasants save a few buckets of rice to sell, workers use their strength to exchange for money, professors sell their mouths, and prostitutes prostitute are all "invisible" businessmen. Only the buyer is not a businessman, but his money must have been exchanged for something, so he is also a businessman. Therefore, "in this capitalist society", everyone is a businessman, but it can be divided into two categories: "invisible" and tangible.用希隽先生自己的定义来断定他自己，自然是一位“无形中”的商人；如果并不以卖文为活，因此也无须“粗制滥造”，那么，怎样过活呢，一定另外在做买卖，也许竟是有形中的商人了，所以他的见识，无论怎么看，总逃不脱一个商人见识。
Using Mr. Xijun's own definition to conclude that he is naturally an "invisible" businessman; If you don't make a living by selling literature, so you don't need to be "shoddy and indiscriminate", then how to live, you must be doing business elsewhere, maybe you are actually a tangible businessman, so his knowledge, no matter how you look at it, always can't escape the knowledge of a businessman.“杂文”很短，就是写下来的工夫，也决不要写“和平与战争”（这是照林希隽先生的文章抄下来的，原名其实是《战争与和平》）的那么长久，用力极少，是一点也不错的。不过也要有一点常识，用一点苦工，要不然，就是“杂文”，也不免更进一步的“粗制滥造”，只剩下笑柄。作品，总是有些缺点的。亚波理奈尔咏孔雀，说它翘起尾巴，光辉灿烂，但后面的屁股眼也露出来了。所以批评家的指摘是要的，不过批评家这时却也就翘起了尾巴，露出他的屁眼。但为什么还要呢，就因为它正面还有光辉灿烂的羽毛。不过倘使并非孔雀，仅仅是鹅鸭之流，它应该想一想翘起尾巴来，露出的只有些什么！
The "essays" are very short, even if they are written down, they should never write "Peace and War" (this is copied from Mr. Lin Xijun's article, the original name is actually "War and Peace"), which is not bad at all. However, you must also have a little common sense and use a little hard work, otherwise, it will be a "miscellaneous essay", and it will inevitably be further "shoddy and indiscriminate", leaving only a laughing stock. Works always have some shortcomings. Apollinaire sang about the peacock, saying that it raised its tail and was brilliant, but the back of the butt eye was also exposed. So the critic's criticism is wanted, but the critic also raised his tail and exposed his asshole. But why not, because it still has glorious feathers on the front. But if it is not a peacock, but just a goose and duck, it should think about raising its tail and revealing only something!九月二十五日。

考场三丑

The examination room is three ugly黄棘
Yellow thorns古时候，考试八股的时候，有三样卷子，考生是很失面子的，后来改考策论了，恐怕也还是这样子。第一样是“缴白卷”，只写上题目，做不出文章，或者简直连题目也不写。然而这最干净，因为别的再没有什么枝节了。第二样是“钞刊文”，他先已有了侥幸之心，读熟或带进些刊本的八股去，倘或题目相合，便即照钞，想瞒过考官的眼。品行当然比“缴白卷”的差了，但文章大抵是好的，所以也没有什么另外的枝节。第三样，最坏的是瞎写，不及格不必说，还要从瞎写的文章里，给人寻出许多笑话来。人们在茶余酒后作为谈资的，大概是这一种。
In ancient times, when taking the eight-share exam, there were three papers, and the candidates were very disgraced. The first is to "submit a blank paper", which only writes the title, but cannot make an article, or even does not write the title. However, this is the cleanest, because there is nothing else. The second is the "banknote publication", he already has a sense of luck, read it familiarly or bring in some of the eight shares of the publication, if the title matches, he will copy the banknote, trying to hide it from the examiner's eyes. Of course, the conduct is worse than that of "paying blank papers", but the article is generally good, so there is no other branch. Third, the worst thing is to write blindly, not to mention failing, and to find many jokes from the articles written blindly. This is probably the kind that people use as a topic of conversation after tea and drink.“不通”还不在其内，因为即使不通，他究竟是在看题目做文章了；况且做文章做到不通的境地也就不容易，我们对于中国古今文学家，敢保证谁决没有一句不通的文章呢？有些人自以为“通”，那是因为他连“通”“不通”都不了然的缘故。
"Not understanding" is not among them, because even if it doesn't work, he is actually reading the topic and making a fuss; Moreover, it is not easy to make an article that does not work, and we can guarantee that no one will have an article that does not make sense to Chinese writers in ancient and modern times? Some people think they are "comprehensive" because they don't even understand "understand" and "don't understand".今年的考官之流，颇在讲些中学生的考卷的笑柄。其实这病源就在于瞎写。那些题目，是只要能够钞刊文，就都及格的。例如问“十三经”是什么，文天祥是那朝人，全用不着自己来挖空心思做，一做，倒糟糕。于是使文人学士大叹国学之衰落，青年之不行，好像惟有他们是文林中的硕果似的，像煞有介事了。
This year's examiners are quite talking about the laughing stock of middle school students' exam papers. In fact, the source of this disease lies in blind writing. Those topics are all passed as long as they can be published in print. For example, if you ask what the "Thirteen Classics" are, Wen Tianxiang is a person from that dynasty, and he doesn't need to hollow out his mind to do it. As a result, the literati and scholars lamented the decline of Chinese studies and the inability of young people, as if they were the only fruits in the literary world, as if they were in trouble.但是，钞刊文可也不容易。假使将那些考官们锁在考场里，骤然问他几条较为陌生的古典，大约即使不瞎写，也未必不缴白卷的。我说这话，意思并不在轻议已成的文人学士，只以为古典多，记不清不足奇，都记得倒古怪。古书不是很有些曾经后人加过注解的么？那都是坐在自己的书斋里，查群籍，翻类书，穷年累月，这才脱稿的，然而仍然有“未详”，有错误。现在的青年当然无力指摘它了，但作证的却有别人的什么“补正”在；而且补而又补，正而又正者，也时或有之。
However, it is not easy to publish papers. If you lock those examiners in the examination room and suddenly ask them a few more unfamiliar classics, they may not not submit blank papers even if they don't write blindly. When I say this, I don't mean to discuss the established literati and scholars, I just think that there are many classics, and it is not surprising that I can't remember them clearly, and I remember them strangely. Aren't there some ancient books that have been annotated by later generations? They were all sitting in their own study, checking group records, flipping through books, and after many years, they finally got out of the manuscript, but there were still "unknowns" and errors. Of course, today's young people are powerless to criticize it, but there is something else to "correct" that others have to testify; And there are times when it is supplemented and supplemented, and it is correct and correct.由此看来，如果能钞刊文，而又敷衍得过去，这人便是现在的大人物；青年学生有一些错，不过是常人的本分而已，但竟为世诟病，我很诧异他们竟没有人呼冤。
From this point of view, if you can publish articles and be perfunctory, this person is the current big man; The young students have some mistakes, but they are just ordinary people's duty, but they are criticized by the world, and I am surprised that no one has complained about them.九月二十五日。

It's "Shakespeare" again苗挺
Miao Ting苏俄将排演原本莎士比亚，可见“丑态”；马克思讲过莎士比亚，当然错误；梁实秋教授将翻译莎士比亚，每本大洋一千元；杜衡先生看了莎士比亚，“还再需要一点做人的经验”了。
Soviet Russia will rehearse the original Shakespeare, which shows the "ugliness"; Marx said Shakespeare, of course, wrong; Professor Liang Shiqiu will translate Shakespeare, 1,000 yuan per book; Mr. Du Heng read Shakespeare and said, "I still need a little more experience in life."我们的文学家杜衡先生，好像先前是因为没有自己觉得缺少“做人的经验”，相信群众的，但自从看了莎氏的《凯撒传》以来，才明白“他们没有理性，他们没有明确的利害观念；他们底感情是完全被几个煽动家所控制着，所操纵着”。（杜衡：《莎剧凯撒传里所表现的群众》，《文艺风景》创刊号所载。）自然，这是根据“莎剧”的，和杜先生无关，他自说现在也还不能判断它对不对，但是，觉得自己“还再需要一点做人的经验”，却已经明白无疑了。
Our writer Mr. Du Heng seems to have believed in the masses because he did not feel that he lacked "experience in being a person", but since reading Shakespeare's "Biography of Caesar", he has understood that "they are not rational, they do not have a clear concept of interests; Their underlying feelings are completely controlled and manipulated by a few agitators." “…… This reminds us of the "chicken comes to greet the chicken, the dog comes to greet the dog" style that we often see in the coups in recent hundreds of years...... Those sad situations. …… Where is the underlying evolution of human beings? Or is our ancient oriental country still stagnant at the bottom stage of civilization that Rome went through 2,000 years ago? ”真的，“发思古之幽情”，往往为了现在。这一比，我就疑心罗马恐怕也曾有过有理性，有明确的利害观念，感情并不被几个煽动家所控制，所操纵的群众，但是被驱散，被压制，被杀戮了。莎士比亚似乎没有调查，或者没有想到，但也许是故意抹杀的，他是古时候的人，有这一手并不算什么玩把戏。

点句的难

点句的难

点句的难

It's hard to point out sentences张沛
Zhang Pei看了《袁中郎全集校勘记》，想到了几句不关重要的话，是：断句的难。
After reading "Yuan Zhonglang's Complete Works Proofreading", I thought of a few unimportant words, which are: the difficulty of breaking sentences.前清时代，一个塾师能够不查他的秘本，空手点完了“四书”，在乡下就要算一位大学者，这似乎有些可笑，但是很有道理的。常买旧书的人，有时会遇到一部书，开首加过句读，夹些破句，中途却停了笔：他点不下去了。这样的书，价钱可以比干净的本子便宜，但看起来也真教人不舒服。
In the pre-Qing Dynasty, a tutor could finish the "Four Books" empty-handed without checking his secret books, and he would be considered a scholar in the countryside, which seems a bit ridiculous, but it makes sense. People who often buy old books sometimes encounter a book, add a sentence at the beginning, and insert some broken sentences, but stop writing in the middle: he can't click on it. Such a book can be cheaper than a clean book, but it also looks really uncomfortable.标点古书，印了出来，是起于“文学革命”时候的；用标点古文来试验学生，我记得好像是同时开始于北京大学，这真是恶作剧，使“莘莘学子”闹出许多笑话来。
Punctuated ancient books and printed them began during the "literary revolution"; Using punctuation ancient texts to test students, I remember that it seemed to start at Peking University at the same time, which was really a prank and made many jokes among the "students".这时候，只好一任那些反对白话，或并不反对白话而兼长古文的学者们讲风凉话。然而，学者们也要“技痒”的，有时就自己出手。一出手，可就有些糟了，有几句点不断，还有可原，但竟连极平常的句子也点了破句。
At this time, I had no choice but to let those scholars who opposed the vernacular, or did not oppose the vernacular but were also good at ancient texts, speak sarcastically. However, scholars also have to "itch" and sometimes take action themselves. As soon as he made a move, it was a little bad, there were a few sentences that were continuous, and they were forgivable, but even the most ordinary sentences were broken.古文本来也常常不容易标点，譬如《孟子》里有一段，我们大概是这样读法的：“有冯妇者，善搏虎，卒为善士。则之野，有众逐虎。虎负嵎，莫之敢撄。望见冯妇，趋而迎之。冯妇攘臂下车，众皆悦之，其为士者笑之。”但也有人说应该断为“卒为善，士则之，野有众逐虎……”的。这“笑”他的“士”，就是先前“则”他的“士”，要不然，“其为士”就太鹘突了。但也很难决定究竟是那一面对。
Ancient texts are often not easy to punctuate, for example, there is a paragraph in "Mencius", which we probably read like this: "There is a Feng woman, who is good at fighting tigers, and is a good man." When he went to the wilderness, a crowd chased after the tiger. The tiger carries the cuckoo, and no one dares to touch it. Seeing Feng's wife, he hurried over to greet her. Feng's wife rolled up her sleeves and got out of the carriage, and everyone was very pleased, while the scholars laughed at her. But some people say that it should be judged that "the soldier is good, the scholar is good, and the wild has many people chasing the tiger......". This "laughing" of his "scholar" is his "scholar" before, otherwise, "he is a scholar" is too abrupt. But it is also difficult to decide which one to face.不过倘使是调子有定的词曲，句子相对的骈文，或并不艰深的明人小品，标点者又是名人学士，还要闹出一些破句，可未免令人不遭蚊子叮，也要起疙瘩了。嘴里是白话怎么坏，古文怎么好，一动手，对古文就点了破句，而这古文又是他正在竭力表扬的古文。破句，不就是看不懂的分明的标记么？说好说坏，又从那里来的？
However, if it is a lyric and music with a fixed tone, a parallel text with relative sentences, or a Mingren sketch that is not difficult, and the punctuator is a celebrity scholar, and he has to make some broken sentences, it is inevitable that people will not be bitten by mosquitoes and have pimples. How bad the vernacular is, how good the ancient text is, as soon as he does it, he clicks on the ancient text, and this ancient text is the ancient text he is trying his best to praise. Isn't a broken sentence just a clear mark that you can't understand? Good and bad, where did it come from?标点古文真是一种试金石，只消几点几圈，就把真颜色显出来了。
Punctuation of ancient texts is really a touchstone, and it only takes a few points and a few turns to reveal the true color.但这事还是不要多谈好，再谈下去，我怕不久会有更高的议论，说标点是“随波逐流”的玩意，有损“性灵”，应该排斥的。
But don't talk about this matter too much, and if you continue to talk about it, I'm afraid that there will be higher discussions soon, saying that punctuation is a thing that "goes with the flow", which is detrimental to the "spirit" and should be rejected.十月二日。
