略论梅兰芳及其他（上）

A brief discussion of Mei Lanfang and others (Part I)张沛
Zhang Pei崇拜名伶原是北京的传统。辛亥革命后，伶人的品格提高了，这崇拜也干净起来。先只有谭叫天在剧坛上称雄，都说他技艺好，但恐怕也还夹着一点势利，因为他是“老佛爷”——慈禧太后赏识过的。虽然没有人给他宣传，替他出主意，得不到世界的名声，却也没有人来为他编剧本。我想，这不来，是带着几分“不敢”的。
Worshiping famous actors was originally a tradition in Beijing. After the Xinhai Revolution, the character of the performers improved, and this cult became clean. First of all, only Tan Weitian dominated the theater world, and they all said that he was good at skills, but I am afraid that he still had a little snobbery, because he was "Galeries Lafayette" - Empress Dowager Cixi appreciated. Although no one promoted him, gave him ideas, and did not gain fame in the world, no one wrote the script for him. I think this is not coming, with a bit of "dare".后来有名的梅兰芳可就和他不同了。梅兰芳不是生，是旦，不是皇家的供奉，是俗人的宠儿，这就使士大夫敢于下手了。士大夫是常要夺取民间的东西的，将竹枝词改成文言，将“小家碧玉”作为姨太太，但一沾着他们的手，这东西也就跟着他们灭亡。他们将他从俗众中提出，罩上玻璃罩，做起紫檀架子来。教他用多数人听不懂的话，缓缓的《天女散花》，扭扭的《黛玉葬花》，先前是他做戏的，这时却成了戏为他而做，凡有新编的剧本，都只为了梅兰芳，而且是士大夫心目中的梅兰芳。雅是雅了，但多数人看不懂，不要看，还觉得自己不配看了。
Later, the famous Mei Lanfang was different from him. Mei Lanfang is not a student, a dan, not a royal offering, but a darling of the layman, which makes the scholar-officials dare to attack. Scholars and officials often wanted to seize things from the people, changing the bamboo branch words into classical Chinese, and taking "small family jasper" as their aunt, but as soon as they got into their hands, this thing perished with them. They lifted him out of the world, covered him with a glass cover, and made a rosewood shelf. Teach him to use words that most people can't understand, the slow "Heavenly Maiden Scattering Flowers", the twisted "Daiyu Funeral Flowers", he was doing the play before, but now it became a play for him, all new scripts are only for Mei Lanfang, and it is Mei Lanfang in the minds of the scholar-officials. Ya is elegant, but most people can't understand it, don't read it, and feel that they are not worthy of reading it.士大夫们也在日见其消沉，梅兰芳近来颇有些冷落。
The scholars and officials are also seeing their depression day by day, and Mei Lanfang has been quite neglected recently.因为他是旦角，年纪一大，势必至于冷落的吗？不是的，老十三旦七十岁了，一登台，满座还是喝采。为什么呢？就因为他没有被士大夫据为己有，罩进玻璃罩。
Because he is a Danjiao, he is old, is he bound to be snubbed? No, the old thirteenth Dan is seventy years old, and as soon as he takes the stage, the whole audience is still applauding. Why? Just because he was not taken as his own by the scholar-officials and covered in a glass cover.名声的起灭，也如光的起灭一样，起的时候，从近到远，灭的时候，远处倒还留着余光。梅兰芳的游日，游美，其实已不是光的发扬，而是光在中国的收敛。他竟没有想到从玻璃罩里跳出，所以这样的搬出去，还是这样的搬回来。
The rise and fall of fame is like the rise and fall of light, when it rises, from near to far, and when it is extinguished, there is still afterglow in the distance. Mei Lanfang's tour of Japan and the United States is actually not the development of light, but the convergence of light in China. He didn't expect to jump out of the glass cover, so he moved out like this, or moved back like this.他未经士大夫帮忙时候所做的戏，自然是俗的，甚至于猥下，肮脏，但是泼剌，有生气。待到化为“天女”，高贵了，然而从此死板板，矜持得可怜。看一位不死不活的天女或林妹妹，我想，大多数人是倒不如看一个漂亮活动的村女的，她和我们相近。
The scenes he did without the help of scholars and officials were naturally vulgar, even obscene and dirty, but they were splashy and angry. When she turned into a "heavenly maiden", she became noble, but from then on she was rigid and pitiful. Looking at a heavenly maiden or Sister Lin who is neither dead nor alive, I think most people are not as good as watching a beautiful and active village girl, who is similar to us.然而梅兰芳对记者说，还要将别的剧本改得雅一些。
However, Mei Lanfang told reporters that she had to change other scripts to be more elegant.十一月一日。
November 1st.

略论梅兰芳及其他（下）

略论梅兰芳及其他（下）

略论梅兰芳及其他（下）

A brief discussion of Mei Lanfang and others (below)张沛
Zhang Pei而且梅兰芳还要到苏联去。
And Mei Lanfang is going to the Soviet Union.议论纷纷。我们的大画家徐悲鸿教授也曾到莫斯科去画过松树——也许是马，我记不真切了——国内就没有谈得这么起劲。这就可见梅兰芳博士之在艺术界，确是超人一等的了。
Talk. Our great painter Professor Xu Beihong also went to Moscow to paint pine trees - maybe horses, I don't remember exactly, but there was no such vigorous talk in China. This shows that Dr. Mei Lanfang is indeed superhuman in the art world.而且累得《现代》的编辑室里也紧张起来。首座编辑施蛰存先生曰：“而且还要梅兰芳去演《贵妃醉酒》呢！”（《现代》五卷五期。）要这么大叫，可见不平之极了，倘不豫先知道性别，是会令人疑心生了脏躁症的。次座编辑杜衡先生曰：“剧本鉴定的工作完毕，则不妨选几个最前进的戏先到莫斯科去宣传为梅兰芳先生‘转变’后的个人的创作。……因为照例，到苏联去的艺术家，是无论如何应该事先表示一点‘转变’的。”（《文艺画报》创刊号。）这可冷静得多了，一看就知道他手段高妙，足使齐如山先生自愧弗及，赶紧来请帮忙——帮忙的帮忙。
And the editorial office of "Modern" was so tired that it became tense. The first editor, Mr. Shi Zhicun, said: "And Mei Lanfang is also asked to play "The Concubine is Drunk"! ("Modern" Volume 5, Issue 5.) If you don't know the gender first, it will make people suspect that you have dirty mania. Mr. Du Heng, the second editor, said: "After the script appraisal is completed, we might as well choose a few of the most advanced plays to go to Moscow to promote Mr. Mei Lanfang's personal creations after 'transformation'. …… Because as usual, artists who go to the Soviet Union should express a little 'transformation' in advance. (The first issue of "Literary and Art Pictorial".) This is much calmer, and at a glance you can see that his methods are exquisite, which is enough to make Mr. Qi Rushan feel ashamed, so he hurriedly came to ask for help - help, help.但梅兰芳先生却正在说中国戏是象征主义，剧本的字句要雅一些，他其实倒是为艺术而艺术，他也是一位“第三种人”。
But Mr. Mei Lanfang is saying that Chinese opera is symbolism, and the words of the script are more elegant, but he is actually art for art's sake, and he is also a "third kind of person".那么，他是不会“表示一点‘转变’的”，目前还太早一点。他也许用别一个笔名，做一篇剧本，描写一个知识阶级，总是专为艺术，总是不问俗事，但到末了，他却究竟还在革命这一方面。这就活动得多了，不到末了，花呀光呀，倘到末了，做这篇东西的也就是我呀，那不就在革命这一方面了吗？
Then, he will not "indicate a little 'transformation'", it is still too early. He may use another pseudonym to make a script to describe an intellectual class, always dedicated to art and always ignoring mundane matters, but in the end, he is still in the revolution. If it comes to the end, I am the one who made this thing, isn't it on the side of revolution?但我不知道梅兰芳博士可会自己做了文章，却用别一个笔名，来称赞自己的做戏；或者虚设一社，出些什么“戏剧年鉴”，亲自作序，说自己是剧界的名人？倘使没有，那可是也不会玩这一手的。
But I didn't know that Dr. Mei Lanfang would write an article by himself, but use another pseudonym to praise his play; Or make a fictitious society, publish some "drama yearbook", personally write a preface, and say that you are a celebrity in the theater industry? If not, then I wouldn't have played this hand.倘不会玩，那可真要使杜衡先生失望，要他“再亮些”了。
If he can't play, it will really disappoint Mr. Du Heng and ask him to "be brighter".还是带住罢，倘再“略论”下去，我也要防梅先生会说因为被批评家乱骂，害得他演不出好戏来。
If I continue to "talk about it briefly", I also have to guard against Mr. Mei saying that because he was scolded by critics, he couldn't perform well.十一月一日。
November 1st.

骂杀与捧杀

骂杀与捧杀

骂杀与捧杀

Curse and kill阿法
Alpha现在有些不满于文学批评的，总说近几年的所谓批评，不外乎捧与骂。
Nowadays, some people who are dissatisfied with literary criticism always say that the so-called criticism in recent years is nothing more than praise and scolding.其实所谓捧与骂者，不过是将称赞与攻击，换了两个不好看的字眼。指英雄为英雄，说娼妇是娼妇，表面上虽像捧与骂，实则说得刚刚合式，不能责备批评家的。批评家的错处，是在乱骂与乱捧，例如说英雄是娼妇，举娼妇为英雄。
In fact, the so-called praise and scolding are just praise and attack, replacing two ugly words. Referring to heroes as heroes and saying that prostitutes are prostitutes, although it seems to praise and scold on the surface, in fact it is just in line with the critics. The critic's mistake is to scold and praise indiscriminately, for example, to say that the hero is a prostitute and to cite a prostitute as a hero.批评的失了威力，由于“乱”，甚而至于“乱”到和事实相反，这底细一被大家看出，那效果有时也就相反了。所以现在被骂杀的少，被捧杀的却多。
Criticism loses its power, because of "chaos", and even "chaos" to the opposite of the facts, once this detail is seen by everyone, the effect is sometimes the opposite. So now there are fewer people who are scolded and killed, but more people who are praised and killed.人古而事近的，就是袁中郎。这一班明末的作家，在文学史上，是自有他们的价值和地位的。而不幸被一群学者们捧了出来，颂扬，标点，印刷，“色借，日月借，烛借，青黄借，眼色无常。声借，钟鼓借，枯竹窍借……”“借”得他一榻胡涂，正如在中郎脸上，画上花脸，却指给大家看，啧啧赞叹道：“看哪，这多么‘性灵’呀！”对于中郎的本质，自然是并无关系的，但在未经别人将花脸洗清之前，这“中郎”总不免招人好笑，大触其霉头。
The one who is ancient and close is Yuan Zhonglang. This group of writers at the end of the Ming Dynasty has their own value and status in the history of literature. Unfortunately, it was held out by a group of scholars, praised, punctuated, printed, "color borrowed, sun and moon borrowed, candle borrowed, green and yellow borrowed, and eyes were impermanent." Sound borrowing, bell and drum borrowing, dry bamboo hole borrowing ......" "borrowed" him to get a bed of foolish painting, just like on Zhonglang's face, drawing a flower face, but pointing it out to everyone, tsk-tsk praise: "Look, what a 'spirit' this is!" "Naturally, it has nothing to do with the essence of Zhonglang, but before others wash away the flower face, this "Zhonglang" will inevitably be funny and touch its mold.人近而事古的，我记起了泰戈尔。他到中国来了，开坛讲演，人给他摆出一张琴，烧上一炉香，左有林长民，右有徐志摩，各各头戴印度帽。徐诗人开始绍介了：“唵！叽哩咕噜，白云清风，银磬……当！”说得他好像活神仙一样，于是我们的地上的青年们失望，离开了。神仙和凡人，怎能不离开呢？但我今年看见他论苏联的文章，自己声明道：“我是一个英国治下的印度人。”他自己知道得明明白白。大约他到中国来的时候，决不至于还胡涂，如果我们的诗人诸公不将他制成一个活神仙，青年们对于他是不至于如此隔膜的。现在可是老大的晦气。
People are close and ancient, I remember Tagore. When he came to China, he gave a speech, and people put out a piano for him and burned a burner of incense, with Lin Changmin on the left and Xu Zhimo on the right, each wearing an Indian hat. Poet Xu began to introduce: "Om! Gurgling, white clouds and clear wind, silver chimes...... While! He said that he was like a living god, so our young people on earth were disappointed and left. How can immortals and mortals not leave? But this year I saw his article on the Soviet Union and declared himself: "I am an Indian under British rule. He knew it clearly. When he came to China, he would never return to Hutu, and if our poets and gentlemen did not make him a living immortal, the young people would not be so separated from him. Now it's the boss's bad luck.以学者或诗人的招牌，来批评或介绍一个作者，开初是很能够蒙混旁人的，但待到旁人看清了这作者的真相的时候，却只剩了他自己的不诚恳，或学识的不够了。然而如果没有旁人来指明真相呢，这作家就从此被捧杀，不知道要多少年后才翻身。
It is very easy to confuse others at the beginning to criticize or introduce an author under the sign of a scholar or poet, but when others see the truth of the author clearly, only his own insincerity or lack of knowledge remains. However, if there is no one else to point out the truth, the writer will be killed from then on, and I don't know how many years it will take to turn over.十一月十九日。
November 19th.

读书忌

读书忌

读书忌

Reading taboo焉于
Yanyu记得中国的医书中，常常记载着“食忌”，就是说，某两种食物同食，是于人有害，或者足以杀人的，例如葱与蜜，蟹与柿子，落花生与王瓜之类。但是否真实，却无从知道，因为我从未听见有人实验过。
I remember that in Chinese medical books, it is often recorded that "food taboos", that is, eating two foods together is harmful to people, or enough to kill, such as green onions and honey, crabs and persimmons, peanuts and king melons, etc. But whether it is true or not, I don't know because I have never heard anyone experiment.读书也有“忌”，不过与“食忌”稍不同。这就是某一类书决不能和某一类书同看，否则两者中之一必被克杀，或者至少使读者反而发生愤怒。例如现在正在盛行提倡的明人小品，有些篇的确是空灵的。枕边厕上，车里舟中，这真是一种极好的消遣品。然而先要读者的心里空空洞洞，混混茫茫。假如曾经看过《明季稗史》，《痛史》，或者明末遗民的著作，那结果可就不同了，这两者一定要打起仗来，非打杀其一不止。我自以为因此很了解了那些憎恶明人小品的论者的心情。
There is also a "taboo" in reading, but it is slightly different from the "food taboo". This is why a certain type of book must not be read at the same time as a certain type of book, otherwise one of the two will be killed, or at least the reader will be angry. For example, some of the Ming people's sketches that are now popular are indeed ethereal. On the toilet by the pillow, in the car and on the boat, this is really an excellent pastime. However, first of all, the reader's heart is empty and confused. If you have read the "History of Barnyard Grass in the Ming Dynasty", "History of Pain", or the writings of the remnants of the late Ming Dynasty, the result will be different. I think I understand the feelings of those who hate Ming people's sketches.这几天偶然看见一部屈大均的《翁山文外》，其中有一篇戊申（即清康熙七年）八月做的《自代北入京记》。他的文笔，岂在中郎之下呢？可是很有些地方是极有重量的，抄几句在这里——
In the past few days, I happened to see a copy of Qu Dajun's "Wengshan Wenwai", which included a "Record of Entering Beijing from the North of the Dynasty" made in August of Wushen (that is, the seventh year of Kangxi in the Qing Dynasty). Is his writing below Zhonglang? But there are many places that are extremely heavy, so I will copy a few sentences here——“……沿河行，或渡或否。往往见西夷毡帐，高低不一，所谓穹庐连属，如冈如阜者。男妇皆蒙古语；有卖干湿酪者，羊马者，牦皮者，卧两骆驼中者，坐奚车者，不鞍而骑者，三两而行，被戒衣，或红或黄，持小铁轮，念《金刚秽咒》者。其首顶一柳筐，以盛马粪及木炭者，则皆中华女子。皆盘头跣足，垢面，反被毛袄。人与牛羊相枕藉，腥臊之气，百余里不绝。……”
“…… 沿河行，或渡或否。 往往见西夷毡帐，高低不一，所谓穹庐连属，如冈如阜者。 男妇皆蒙古语；有卖干湿酪者，羊马者，牦皮者，卧两骆驼中者，坐奚车者，不鞍而骑者，三两而行，被戒衣，或红或黄，持小铁轮，念《金刚秽咒》者。 其首顶一柳筐，以盛马粪及木炭者，则皆中华女子。 皆盘头跣足，垢面，反被毛袄。 人与牛羊相枕藉，腥臊之气，百余里不绝。 ……”我想，如果看过这样的文章，想像过这样的情景，又没有完全忘记，那么，虽是中郎的《广庄》或《瓶史》，也断不能洗清积愤的，而且还要增加愤怒。因为这实在比中郎时代的他们互相标榜还要坏，他们还没有经历过扬州十日，嘉定三屠！
I think that if you have read such an article and imagined such a scene, and have not completely forgotten it, then even if it is Zhonglang's "Guangzhuang" or "Bottle History", you will definitely not be able to wash away the accumulated anger, and you will increase your anger. Because this is really worse than what they advertised to each other in the Zhonglang era, they have not experienced the ten days in Yangzhou and the three massacres in Jiading!明人小品，好的；语录体也不坏，但我看《明季稗史》之类和明末遗民的作品却实在还要好，现在也正到了标点，翻印的时候了：给大家来清醒一下。
Ming people's sketches, okay; The style of the quotation is not bad, but I look at the works of "The History of Barnyard in the Ming Dynasty" and the remnants of the late Ming Dynasty are really better, and now it is time to punctuate and reprint: give everyone a wake-up.十一月二十五日。

November 25th.

序言

序言

序言近几年来，所谓“杂文”的产生，比先前多，也比先前更受着攻击。例如自称“诗人”邵洵美，前“第三种人”施蛰存和杜衡即苏汶，还不到一知半解程度的大学生林希隽之流，就都和杂文有切骨之仇，给了种种罪状的。然而没有效，作者多起来，读者也多起来了。
In recent years, the so-called "essays" have been produced more than before, and they have been more attacked than before. For example, the self-proclaimed "poet" Shao Xunmei, the former "third kind of people" Shi Zhicun and Du Heng, that is, Su Wen, and Lin Xijun, a college student who is not yet half-aware, all have a deep feud with the essays and have given various crimes. However, it didn't work, there were more authors, and so were readers.其实“杂文”也不是现在的新货色，是“古已有之”的，凡有文章，倘若分类，都有类可归，如果编年，那就只按作成的年月，不管文体，各种都夹在一处，于是成了“杂”。分类有益于揣摩文章，编年有利于明白时势，倘要知人论世，是非看编年的文集不可的，现在新作的古人年谱的流行，即证明着已经有许多人省悟了此中的消息。况且现在是多么切迫的时候，作者的任务，是在对于有害的事物，立刻给以反响或抗争，是感应的神经，是攻守的手足。潜心于他的鸿篇巨制，为未来的文化设想，固然是很好的，但为现在抗争，却也正是为现在和未来的战斗的作者，因为失掉了现在，也就没有了未来。
In fact, "miscellaneous essays" are not the new colors of today, they are "ancient ones", where there are articles, if they are classified, there are categories to behold, if they are chronicled, then only according to the year and month of creation, regardless of the style, all kinds are sandwiched in one place, so it becomes "miscellaneous". Classification is conducive to figuring out the article, chronicle is conducive to understanding the current situation, if you want to know people and discuss the world, you must read the chronicle collection, and now the popularity of the new chronology of the ancients proves that many people have realized the news in this. Moreover, how urgent it is now, the author's task is to immediately respond or fight against harmful things, to be the nerves of induction, and the siblings of attack and defense. It is good to devote himself to his masterpieces and envision the culture of the future, but to fight for the present is also the author of the battle for the present and the future, because if you lose the present, there will be no future.战斗一定有倾向。这就是邵施杜林之流的大敌，其实他们所憎恶的是内容，虽然披了文艺的法衣，里面却包藏着“死之说教者”，和生存不能两立。
There must be a tendency to fight. This is the great enemy of Shaw and Dulin, in fact, what they hate is the content, although they are dressed in the vestments of literature and art, they contain "dead preachers", which are incompatible with survival.这一本集子和《花边文学》，是我在去年一年中，在官民的明明暗暗，软软硬硬的围剿“杂文”的笔和刀下的结集，凡是写下来的，全在这里面。当然不敢说是诗史，其中有着时代的眉目，也决不是英雄们的八宝箱，一朝打开，便见光辉灿烂。我只在深夜的街头摆着一个地摊，所有的无非几个小钉，几个瓦碟，但也希望，并且相信有些人会从中寻出合于他的用处的东西。
This collection and "Lace Literature" are the collection of my pen and knife in the open, light, and dark, soft and hard encirclement and suppression of "miscellaneous essays" by officials and the people last year. Of course, I dare not say that it is the history of poetry, which has the eyebrows of the times, and it is by no means the eight treasure chests of heroes. I only set up a street stall on the street late at night, all of which were nothing more than a few small nails and a few tiles, but I also hoped and believed that some people would find something useful for him.一九三五年十二月三十日，记于上海之且介亭。
On December 30, 1935, he was recorded at the Qiejie Pavilion in Shanghai.

Two or three things about China一　关于中国的火
1. About China's fire希腊人所用的火，听说是在一直先前，普洛美修斯从天上偷来的，但中国的却和它不同，是燧人氏自家所发见——或者该说是发明罢。因为并非偷儿，所以拴在山上，给老雕去啄的灾难是免掉了，然而也没有普洛美修斯那样的被传扬，被崇拜。
The fire used by the Greeks is said to have been stolen from heaven by Prometheus a long time ago, but the Chinese one is different from it, it was discovered by the Suiren themselves - or should I say it was invented. Because he was not a thief, the disaster of being tied to the mountain and pecking at the old eagle was avoided, but it was not as preached and worshipped as Prometheus.中国也有火神的。但那可不是燧人氏，而是随意放火的莫名其妙的东西。
There is also a god of fire in China. But that was not the flint clan, but the inexplicable thing that set fire at will.自从燧人氏发见，或者发明了火以来，能够很有味的吃火锅，点起灯来，夜里也可以工作了，但是，真如先哲之所谓“有一利必有一弊”罢，同时也开始了火灾，故意点上火，烧掉那有巢氏所发明的巢的了不起的人物也出现了。
Since the discovery of the Suiren clan, or the invention of fire, it is possible to eat hot pot with great taste, light the lamp, and work at night, but as the sages said, "there must be a benefit and a disadvantage", and at the same time, the fire also started, deliberately lit a fire, and burned the nest invented by the Chao clan.和善的燧人氏是该被忘却的。即使伤了食，这回是属于神农氏的领域了，所以那神农氏，至今还被人们所记得。至于火灾，虽然不知道那发明家究竟是什么人，但祖师总归是有的，于是没有法，只好漫称之曰火神，而献以敬畏。看他的画像，是红面孔，红胡须，不过祭祀的时候，却须避去一切红色的东西，而代之以绿色。他大约像西班牙的牛一样，一看见红色，便会亢奋起来，做出一种可怕的行动的。
The kind Suiren clan should be forgotten. Even if it hurts food, this time it belongs to the realm of Shennong, so that Shennong is still remembered by people. As for the fire, although I don't know who the inventor is, the patriarch always has it, so there is no way, so I have to call it the god of fire and offer it in awe. Looking at his portrait, he has a red face and a red beard, but when he sacrifices, he must avoid all red things and replace them with green. He was about like a Spanish cow, and when he saw red, he would get excited and make a terrible action.他因此受着崇祀。在中国，这样的恶神还很多。
He was worshipped for this. In China, there are many such evil gods.然而，在人世间，倒似乎因了他们而热闹。赛会也只有火神的，燧人氏的却没有。倘有火灾，则被灾的和邻近的没有被灾的人们，都要祭火神，以表感谢之意。被了灾还要来表感谢之意，虽然未免有些出于意外，但若不祭，据说是第二回还会烧，所以还是感谢了的安全。而且也不但对于火神，就是对于人，有时也一样的这么办，我想，大约也是礼仪的一种罢。
However, in the world, it seems to be lively because of them. The competition only belongs to the god of fire, but not to the flint clan. If there is a fire, the affected and the neighbors who are not affected must worship the fire god to express their gratitude. Although it is a little out of surprise, if you don't sacrifice, it is said that it will be burned the second time, so you are still grateful for the safety. And not only for the god of fire, but also for people, sometimes the same is done, I think, it is probably a kind of etiquette.其实，放火，是很可怕的，然而比起烧饭来，却也许更有趣。外国的事情我不知道，若在中国，则无论查检怎样的历史，总寻不出烧饭和点灯的人们的列传来。在社会上，即使怎样的善于烧饭，善于点灯，也毫没有成为名人的希望。然而秦始皇一烧书，至今还俨然做着名人，至于引为希特拉烧书事件的先例。假使希特拉太太善于开电灯，烤面包罢，那么，要在历史上寻一点先例，恐怕可就难了。但是，幸而那样的事，是不会哄动一世的。
In fact, setting fire is very scary, but it may be more interesting than cooking. I don't know about foreign affairs, but if you are in China, no matter what kind of history you check, you will never be able to find the biographies of people who cook rice and light lamps. In society, no matter how good you are at cooking and lighting lights, you have no hope of becoming a celebrity. However, when Qin Shi Huang burned books, he still seems to be a celebrity, as for the precedent of Hitler's book burning incident. If Mrs. Hitler was good at turning on the light and baking bread, then it would be difficult to find a precedent in history. However, fortunately, such a thing will not stir up a lifetime.烧掉房子的事，据宋人的笔记说，是开始于蒙古人的。因为他们住着帐篷，不知道住房子，所以就一路的放火。然而，这是诳话。蒙古人中，懂得汉文的很少，所以不来更正的。其实，秦的末年就有着放火的名人项羽在，一烧阿房宫，便天下闻名，至今还会在戏台上出现，连在日本也很有名。然而，在未烧以前的阿房宫里每天点灯的人们，又有谁知道他们的名姓呢？
The burning of the house, according to the notes of the Song people, began with the Mongols. Because they lived in tents and didn't know what to do, they set fire all the way. However, this is a lie. Among the Mongols, there are very few who understand Chinese, so they do not come to correct it. In fact, in the last years of the Qin Dynasty, there was a famous Xiang Yu who set fire, and as soon as he burned the Epang Palace, he became famous all over the world, and he still appears on the stage, even famous in Japan. However, who knows the names of the people who lit lamps every day in the Epang Palace before the burning?现在是爆裂弹呀，烧夷弹呀之类的东西已经做出，加以飞机也很进步，如果要做名人，就更加容易了。而且如果放火比先前放得大，那么，那人就也更加受尊敬，从远处看去，恰如救世主一样，而那火光，便令人以为是光明。
Now things like explosive bombs and incendiary bombs have been made, and airplanes are also very advanced, so if you want to be a celebrity, it's even easier. And if the fire is bigger than before, then the person is also more respected, and from a distance, it looks like a savior, and the fire makes people think it is light.

关于中国的两三件事

二　关于中国的王道

关于中国的两三件事

2. About China's royal road在前年，曾经拜读过中里介山氏的大作《给支那及支那国民的信》。只记得那里面说，周汉都有着侵略者的资质。而支那人都讴歌他，欢迎他了。连对于朔北的元和清，也加以讴歌了。只要那侵略，有着安定国家之力，保护民生之实，那便是支那人民所渴望的王道，于是对于支那人的执迷不悟之点，愤慨得非常。
The year before last, I read Nakazato Jieyama's masterpiece "Letter to China and the Chinese People". I only remember that it said that Zhou and Han had the qualifications of an aggressor. And the people of China praised him and welcomed him. Even the Yuan and Qing dynasties in Shuobei were praised. As long as the aggression has the power to stabilize the country and protect people's livelihood, that is the royal road that the Chinese people aspire to, so they are very indignant about the obsession of the Chinese people.那“信”，在满洲出版的杂志上，是被译载了的，但因为未曾输入中国，所以像是回信的东西，至今一篇也没有见。只在去年的上海报上所载的胡适博士的谈话里，有的说，“只有一个方法可以征服中国，即彻底停止侵略，反过来征服中国民族的心。”不消说，那不过是偶然的，但也有些令人觉得好像是对于那信的答复。
The "letter" was translated in a magazine published in Manchuria, but because it was not imported into China, it seemed to be a reply letter, and not a single one has been seen so far. In Dr. Hu Shi's speech in last year's poster, some said, "There is only one way to conquer China, that is, to stop aggression altogether, and in turn to conquer the heart of the Chinese nation." Needless to say, it was just a coincidence, but it also felt like a reply to that letter.征服中国民族的心，这是胡适博士给中国之所谓王道所下的定义，然而我想，他自己恐怕也未必相信自己的话的罢。在中国，其实是彻底的未曾有过王道，“有历史癖和考据癖”的胡博士，该是不至于不知道的。
Conquering the heart of the Chinese nation is the definition given by Dr. Hu Shi to the so-called royal way of China, but I think he himself may not believe his own words. In China, in fact, Dr. Hu, who has never had a royal way at all, should not be unaware of it.不错，中国也有过讴歌了元和清的人们，但那是感谢火神之类，并非连心也全被征服了的证据。如果给与一个暗示，说是倘不讴歌，便将更加虐待，那么，即使加以或一程度的虐待，也还可以使人们来讴歌。四五年前，我曾经加盟于一个要求自由的团体，而那时的上海教育局长陈德征氏勃然大怒道，在三民主义的统治之下，还觉得不满么？那可连现在所给与着的一点自由也要收起了。而且，真的是收起了的。每当感到比先前更不自由的时候，我一面佩服着陈氏的精通王道的学识，一面有时也不免想，真该是讴歌三民主义的。然而，现在是已经太晚了。
Yes, there are people in China who have praised the Yuan and Qing dynasties, but it is thanks to the god of fire and the like, not even the heart is conquered. If a hint is given that if it is not praised, it will be more abusive, then even if it is abused, it can still make people praise. Four or five years ago, I joined a group that demanded freedom, and Chen Dezheng, the director of the Shanghai Education Bureau at that time, was furious and said, under the rule of the Three People's Principles, do you still feel dissatisfied? That would put away even the little freedom that was given to him now. Moreover, it is really put away. Whenever I feel less free than before, while admiring Chen's knowledge of mastering the royal way, I sometimes can't help but think that it should really be a praise of the Three People's Principles. However, it is already too late.在中国的王道，看去虽然好像是和霸道对立的东西，其实却是兄弟，这之前和之后，一定要有霸道跑来的。人民之所讴歌，就为了希望霸道的减轻，或者不更加重的缘故。
In China's royal road, although it seems to be the opposite of domineering, it is actually a brother. The people praise it just because they hope that the hegemony will be reduced, or not heavier.汉的高祖，据历史家说，是龙种，但其实是无赖出身，说是侵略者，恐怕有些不对的。至于周的武王，则以征伐之名入中国，加以和殷似乎连民族也不同，用现代的话来说，那可是侵略者。然而那时的民众的声音，现在已经没有留存了。孔子和孟子确曾大大的宣传过那王道，但先生们不但是周朝的臣民而已，并且周游历国，有所活动，所以恐怕是为了想做官也难说。说得好看一点，就是因为要“行道”，倘做了官，于行道就较为便当，而要做官，则不如称赞周朝之为便当的。然而，看起别的记载来，却虽是那王道的祖师而且专家的周朝，当讨伐之初，也有伯夷和叔齐扣马而谏，非拖开不可；纣的军队也加反抗，非使他们的血流到漂杵不可。接着是殷民又造了反，虽然特别称之曰“顽民”，从王道天下的人民中除开，但总之，似乎究竟有了一种什么破绽似的。好个王道，只消一个顽民，便将它弄得毫无根据了。
Han Gaozu, according to historians, was a dragon species, but in fact he was born as a scoundrel, and it is probably wrong to say that he was an aggressor. As for King Wu of Zhou, he entered China in the name of conquest, and it seems that even the ethnicity of Yin is different, and in modern terms, it is an aggressor. However, the voice of the people at that time is no longer preserved. Confucius and Mencius did greatly promote the royal way, but the gentlemen were not only subjects of the Zhou Dynasty, but also traveled around the country and had activities, so I am afraid that it is difficult to say that they want to be officials. To put it more nicely, it is because of the desire to "practice the way", if you become an official, it is more convenient to practice the way, and if you want to be an official, it is better to praise the Zhou Dynasty as a convenience. However, looking at other records, although the Zhou Dynasty, which was the ancestor of the royal way and an expert, at the beginning of the crusade, there were also Bo Yi and Shu Qi who detained their horses and advised, and they had to be dragged away; Zhou's army also resisted, and their blood had to flow to the pestle. Then Yin Min rebelled again, although he was specially called "stubborn people", removed from the people of the royal world, but in short, it seemed that there was some kind of flaw. What a king's way is that only one stubborn person can make it unfounded.儒士和方士，是中国特产的名物。方士的最高理想是仙道，儒士的便是王道。但可惜的是这两件在中国终于都没有。据长久的历史上的事实所证明，则倘说先前曾有真的王道者，是妄言，说现在还有者，是新药。孟子生于周季，所以以谈霸道为羞，倘使生于今日，则跟着人类的智识范围的展开，怕要羞谈王道的罢。
Confucian scholars and alchemists are famous Chinese specialties. The highest ideal of the alchemist is the immortal way, and the Confucian scholar is the royal way. But unfortunately, these two pieces are finally not available in China. According to the facts of long history, if there was a real royal way before, it is a lie, and if there is still a new medicine. Mencius was born in the late Zhou Dynasty, so he was ashamed to talk about hegemony, and if he was born today, he would follow the expansion of the scope of human knowledge, and he was afraid that he would be ashamed to talk about the royal way.

关于中国的两三件事

三　关于中国的监狱

关于中国的两三件事

3. About China's prisons我想，人们是的确由事实而从新省悟，而事情又由此发生变化的。从宋朝到清朝的末年，许多年间，专以代圣贤立言的“制艺”这一种烦难的文章取士，到得和法国打了败仗，这才省悟了这方法的错误。于是派留学生到西洋，开设兵器制造局，作为那改正的手段。省悟到这还不够，是在和日本打了败仗之后，这回是竭力开起学校来。于是学生们年年大闹了。从清朝倒掉，国民党掌握政权的时候起，才又省悟了这错误，作为那改正的手段的，是除了大造监狱之外，什么也没有了。
I think people are indeed awakened by facts, and things change because of it. From the Song Dynasty to the end of the Qing Dynasty, for many years, the troublesome article of "making art" on behalf of the sages was used to select scholars, and it was only after losing the battle with France that they realized the mistake of this method. So he sent international students to the West and opened a weapons manufacturing bureau as a means of correction. Realizing that this was not enough, after losing the war with Japan, this time he tried his best to open a school. So the students made a big fuss every year. From the fall of the Qing Dynasty and the seizure of power by the Kuomintang, this mistake was realized again, and as a means of correction, there was nothing but the construction of prisons.在中国，国粹式的监狱，是早已各处都有的，到清末，就也造了一点西洋式，即所谓文明式的监狱。那是为了示给旅行到此的外国人而建造，应该与为了和外国人好互相应酬，特地派出去，学些文明人的礼节的留学生，属于同一种类的。托了这福，犯人的待遇也还好，给洗澡，也给一定分量的饭吃，所以倒是颇为幸福的地方。但是，就在两三礼拜前，政府因为要行仁政了，还发过一个不准克扣囚粮的命令。从此以后，可更加幸福了。
In China, national-style prisons have long been everywhere, and by the end of the Qing Dynasty, a little Western-style, the so-called civilized prison, was also built. It was built to show foreigners who traveled here, and it should be the same kind of international students who were sent out to learn the etiquette of civilized people in order to socialize with foreigners. Thanks to this blessing, the prisoners are treated well, bathing, and giving a certain amount of food, so it is quite a happy place. However, just two or three weeks ago, the government issued an order not to deduct prisoners' food because it was going to practice benevolent governance. From then on, I was happier.至于旧式的监狱，则因为好像是取法于佛教的地狱的，所以不但禁锢犯人，此外还有给他吃苦的职掌。挤取金钱，使犯人的家属穷到透顶的职掌，有时也会兼带的。但大家都以为应该。如果有谁反对罢，那就等于替犯人说话，便要受恶党的嫌疑。然而文明是出奇的进步了，所以去年也有了提倡每年该放犯人回家一趟，给以解决性欲的机会的，颇是人道主义气味之说的官吏。其实，他也并非对于犯人的性欲，特别表着同情，不过因为总不愁竟会实行的，所以也就高声嚷一下，以见自己的作为官吏的存在。然而舆论颇为沸腾了。有一位批评家，还以为这么一来，大家便要不怕牢监，高高兴兴的进去了，很为世道人心愤慨了一下。受了所谓圣贤之教那么久，竟还没有那位官吏的圆滑，固然也令人觉得诚实可靠，然而他的意见，是以为对于犯人，非加虐待不可，却也因此可见了。
As for the old-style prison, because it seems to be inspired by the Buddhist hell, it not only imprisons the prisoner, but also gives him the duty to endure hardships. Squeezing money and making the prisoner's family extremely poor is also a responsibility, sometimes both. But everyone thought it should. If anyone objects, it is equivalent to speaking for the prisoner, and he will be suspected of being a villain. However, civilization has made surprising progress, so last year there were also officials who advocated that prisoners should be released home once a year to give them a chance to solve their sexual desires. In fact, he did not show special sympathy for the sexual desire of the prisoner, but because he was not worried about it, he would do it, so he shouted loudly to see his existence as an official. However, public opinion is quite boiling. There was a critic who thought that in this way, everyone would not be afraid of prison and happily went in, which was very indignant for the world. After being taught by the so-called sages for so long, he did not have the smoothness of that official, which certainly made people feel honest and reliable, but his opinion was that prisoners must be abused, but it was also visible.从别一条路想，监狱确也并非没有不像以“安全第一”为标语的人们的理想乡的地方。火灾极少，偷儿不来，土匪也一定不来抢。即使打仗，也决没有以监狱为目标，施行轰炸的傻子；即使革命，有释放囚犯的例，而加以屠戮的是没有的。当福建独立之初，虽有说是释放犯人，而一到外面，和他们自己意见不同的人们倒反而失踪了的谣言，然而这样的例子，以前是未曾有过的。总而言之，似乎也并非很坏的处所。只要准带家眷，则即使不是现在似的大水，饥荒，战争，恐怖的时候，请求搬进去住的人们，也未必一定没有的。于是虐待就成为必不可少了。
Thinking about it from another way, prisons are indeed not without their utopia like the slogan "safety first". There are very few fires, thieves don't come, and bandits definitely don't come to rob. Even if there is a war, there will never be a fool who targets prisons and bombs; Even if there is a revolution, there are examples of releasing prisoners, but there are no massacres. At the beginning of Fujian's independence, although there were rumors that prisoners were released, people who disagreed with their own opinions disappeared when they went outside, but such an example had never happened before. All in all, it doesn't seem to be a very bad place. As long as you are allowed to bring your family, even if it is not the current flood, famine, war, or terror, people who ask to move in may not necessarily be absent. So abuse becomes essential.牛兰夫妇，作为赤化宣传者而关在南京的监狱里，也绝食了三四回了，可是什么效力也没有。这是因为他不知道中国的监狱的精神的缘故。有一位官员诧异的说过：他自己不吃，和别人有什么关系呢？岂但和仁政并无关系而已呢，省些食料，倒是于监狱有益的。甘地的把戏，倘不挑选兴行场，就毫无成效了。
Niu Lan and his wife, who were imprisoned in Nanjing prison as red propagandists, also went on hunger strike three or four times, but there was no effect. This is because he does not know the spirit of Chinese prisons. An official said in surprise: If he doesn't eat it himself, what does it have to do with others? Not only does it have nothing to do with benevolent governance, but saving some food is beneficial to prisons. Gandhi's tricks are useless if they do not choose the entertainment venue.然而，在这样的近于完美的监狱里，却还剩着一种缺点。至今为止，对于思想上的事，都没有很留心。为要弥补这缺点，是在近来新发明的叫作“反省院”的特种监狱里，施着教育。我还没有到那里面去反省过，所以并不知道详情，但要而言之，好像是将三民主义时时讲给犯人听，使他反省着自己的错误。听人说，此外还得做排击共产主义的论文。如果不肯做，或者不能做，那自然，非终身反省不可了，而做得不够格，也还是非反省到死则不可。现在是进去的也有，出来的也有，因为听说还得添造反省院，可见还是进去的多了。考完放出的良民，偶尔也可以遇见，但仿佛大抵是萎靡不振，恐怕是在反省和毕业论文上，将力气使尽了罢。那前途，是在没有希望这一面的。
However, in such a near-perfect prison, there is still a shortcoming. So far, I have not paid much attention to ideological matters. In order to compensate for this shortcoming, education is provided in a special prison called the "Reflection Institute", which has recently been invented. I haven't been there to reflect on it yet, so I don't know the details, but in short, it seems that the Three People's Principles are told to the prisoner from time to time, making him reflect on his mistakes. I heard that in addition, I had to write a paper on combating communism. If you refuse to do it, or if you can't do it, then naturally, you have to reflect on it for life, and if you don't do it enough, you still have to reflect until death. Now there are those who go in and those who come out, because I heard that they have to add a reflection institute, so it can be seen that there are still many people who go in. The good people who are released after the exam can occasionally be met, but it seems that they are probably sluggish, and I am afraid that they have exhausted their strength in reflection and graduation thesis. That future is hopeless.

答国际文学社问

答国际文学社问

Answer questions from the International Literary Society原问——
Original question -一、苏联的存在与成功，对于你怎样（苏维埃建设的十月革命，对于你的思想的路径和创作的性质，有什么改变）？
1. What did the existence and success of the Soviet Union do to you (how did the Soviet-built October Revolution change the path of your thinking and the nature of your creation)?二、你对于苏维埃文学的意见怎样？
2. What is your opinion on Soviet literature?三、在资本主义的各国，什么事件和种种文化上的进行，特别引起你的注意？
3. What events and cultural developments in capitalist countries have particularly attracted your attention?一，先前，旧社会的腐败，我是觉到了的，我希望着新的社会的起来，但不知道这“新的”该是什么；而且也不知道“新的”起来以后，是否一定就好。待到十月革命后，我才知道这“新的”社会的创造者是无产阶级，但因为资本主义各国的反宣传，对于十月革命还有些冷淡，并且怀疑。现在苏联的存在和成功，使我确切的相信无阶级社会一定要出现，不但完全扫除了怀疑，而且增加许多勇气了。但在创作上，则因为我不在革命的旋涡中心，而且久不能到各处去考察，所以我大约仍然只能暴露旧社会的坏处。
First, I was aware of the corruption of the old society before, and I hope for the rise of the new society, but I don't know what this "new" should be; And I don't know if it will be good after the "new" is built. It was not until after the October Revolution that I learned that the creator of this "new" society was the proletariat, but because of the counter-propaganda of capitalist countries, I was still a little cold and skeptical of the October Revolution. The existence and success of the Soviet Union now makes me firmly believe that a classless society must emerge, which not only completely dispells doubt, but also increases a lot of courage. But in terms of creation, because I am not at the center of the vortex of the revolution, and I have not been able to go everywhere for a long time, I can probably only expose the evils of the old society.二，我只能看别国——德国，日本——的译本。我觉得现在的讲建设的，还是先前的讲战斗的——如《铁甲列车》，《毁灭》，《铁流》等——于我有兴趣，并且有益。我看苏维埃文学，是大半因为想绍介给中国，而对于中国，现在也还是战斗的作品更为紧要。
Second, I can only read translations from other countries - Germany, Japan. I think the current talk about construction, or the previous combat - such as "Ironclad Train", "Destruction", "Iron Flow", etc. - is interesting and beneficial to me. I read Soviet literature mostly because I wanted to introduce it to China, and for China, it is still more important to fight works.三，我在中国，看不见资本主义各国之所谓“文化”；我单知道他们和他们的奴才们，在中国正在用力学和化学的方法，还有电气机械，以拷问革命者，并且用飞机和炸弹以屠杀革命群众。
Third, I can't see the so-called "culture" of capitalist countries in China; I only know that they and their minions are using mechanics and chemistry, as well as electrical machinery, in China to torture revolutionaries, and to slaughter the revolutionaries with planes and bombs.

《草鞋脚》（英译中国短篇小说集）小引

《草鞋脚》（英译中国短篇小说集）小引

《草鞋脚》（英译中国短篇小说集）小引

"Straw Shoes Feet" (English translation of Chinese short story collection) small introduction在中国，小说是向来不算文学的。在轻视的眼光下，自从十八世纪末的《红楼梦》以后，实在也没有产生什么较伟大的作品。小说家的侵入文坛，仅是开始“文学革命”运动，即一九一七年以来的事。自然，一方面是由于社会的要求的，一方面则是受了西洋文学的影响。
In China, novels have never been considered literature. Under the contemptuous eye, since "Dream of Red Mansions" at the end of the eighteenth century, there have really been no great works. The invasion of novelists into the literary world was only the beginning of the "literary revolution" movement, that is, since 1917. Naturally, on the one hand, it is due to the requirements of society, and on the other hand, it is influenced by Western literature.但这新的小说的生存，却总在不断的战斗中。最初，文学革命者的要求是人性的解放，他们以为只要扫荡了旧的成法，剩下来的便是原来的人，好的社会了，于是就遇到保守家们的迫压和陷害。大约十年之后，阶级意识觉醒了起来，前进的作家，就都成了革命文学者，而迫害也更加厉害，禁止出版，烧掉书籍，杀戮作家，有许多青年，竟至于在黑暗中，将生命殉了他的工作了。
But the survival of this new novel is always in constant battle. Initially, the demand of the literary revolutionaries was the liberation of human nature, thinking that as long as the old laws were swept away, what was left was the original people and a good society, so they encountered the oppression and framing of conservatives. About ten years later, the class consciousness awakened, and the writers who advanced became revolutionary writers, and the persecution became even more severe, banning publications, burning books, killing writers, and many young people even sacrificed their lives in the dark.这一本书，便是十五年来的，“文学革命”以后的短篇小说的选集。因为在我们还算是新的尝试，自然不免幼稚，但恐怕也可以看见它恰如压在大石下面的植物一般，虽然并不繁荣，它却在曲曲折折地生长。
This book is an anthology of short stories after the "literary revolution" in the past fifteen years. Because it is still a new attempt, it is naturally naïve, but I am afraid that it can also be seen as a plant pressed under a boulder, although it is not prosperous, it is growing in twists and turns.至今为止，西洋人讲中国的著作，大约比中国人民讲自己的还要多。不过这些总不免只是西洋人的看法，中国有一句古谚，说：“肺腑而能语，医师面如土。”我想，假使肺腑真能说话，怕也未必一定完全可靠的罢，然而，也一定能有医师所诊察不到，出乎意外，而其实是十分真实的地方。
So far, Westerners have talked about more Chinese works than Chinese people have talked about themselves. However, these are inevitably just the views of Westerners, there is an ancient Chinese proverb that says: "The heart is able to speak, and the physician's face is like soil." "I think that if the heart can really speak, I am afraid it may not be completely reliable, but there must be a place that the doctor cannot detect, unexpectedly, but in fact it is very real.一九三四年三月二十三日，鲁迅记于上海。
On March 23, 1934, Lu Xun recorded in Shanghai.

论“旧形式的采用”

论“旧形式的采用”

论“旧形式的采用”

On the "Adoption of Old Forms"“旧形式的采用”的问题，如果平心静气的讨论起来，在现在，我想是很有意义的，但开首便遭到了耳耶先生的笔伐。“类乎投降”，“机会主义”，这是近十年来“新形式的探求”的结果，是克敌的咒文，至少先使你惹一身不干不净。但耳耶先生是正直的，因为他同时也在译《艺术底内容和形式》，一经登完，便会洗净他激烈的责罚；而且有几句话也正确的，是他说新形式的探求不能和旧形式的采用机械的地分开。
The issue of "adoption of the old form" is considered very meaningful if discussed calmly now, but it was attacked by Mr. Earle at the beginning. "Surrender", "opportunism", this is the result of the "new form of exploration" in the past decade, and it is a spell to defeat the enemy, at least to make you unclean. But Mr. Earle is upright, because he is also translating "The Content and Form of Art", and once it is published, it will wash away his fierce punishment; And a few words are also true when he says that the new form of search cannot be mechanically separated from the old form.不过这几句话已经可以说是常识；就是说内容和形式不能机械的地分开，也已经是常识；还有，知道作品和大众不能机械的地分开，也当然是常识。旧形式为什么只是“采用”——但耳耶先生却指为“为整个（!）旧艺术捧场”——就是为了新形式的探求。采取若干，和“整个”捧来是不同的，前进的艺术家不能有这思想（内容）。然而他会想到采取旧艺术，因为他明白了作品和大众不能机械的地分开。以为艺术是艺术家的“灵感”的爆发，像鼻子发痒的人，只要打出喷嚏来就浑身舒服，一了百了的时候已经过去了，现在想到，而且关心了大众。这是一个新思想（内容），由此而在探求新形式，首先提出的是旧形式的采取，这采取的主张，正是新形式的发端，也就是旧形式的蜕变，在我看来，是既没有将内容和形式机械的地分开，更没有看得《姊妹花》叫座，于是也来学一套的投机主义的罪案的。
However, these few sentences can already be said to be common sense; That is to say, content and form cannot be mechanically separated, which is already common sense; Also, it is common sense to know that works cannot be mechanically separated from the public. Why the old form is only "adopted" - but Mr. Earle refers to it as "supporting the whole (!) old art" - is for the exploration of the new form. Taking a few, which is different from the "whole" holding, the advancing artist cannot have this idea (content). However, he would think of adopting old art because he understood that the work and the public could not be mechanically separated. I think art is an outburst of "inspiration" for artists, like a person with an itchy nose, as long as he sneezes, he feels comfortable, and the time has passed, and now he thinks about it, and cares about the public. This is a new idea (content), and thus it is exploring a new form, and the first thing to put forward is the adoption of the old form, which is the beginning of the new form, that is, the transformation of the old form, in my opinion, it neither mechanically separates the content and the form, let alone the popularity of "Sister Flower", so it also comes to learn a set of opportunistic crimes.自然，旧形式的采取，或者必须说新形式的探求，都必须艺术学徒的努力的实践，但理论家或批评家是同有指导，评论，商量的责任的，不能只斥他交代未清之后，便可逍遥事外。我们有艺术史，而且生在中国，即必须翻开中国的艺术史来。采取什么呢？我想，唐以前的真迹，我们无从目睹了，但还能知道大抵以故事为题材，这是可以取法的；在唐，可取佛画的灿烂，线画的空实和明快，宋的院画，萎靡柔媚之处当舍，周密不苟之处是可取的，米点山水，则毫无用处。后来的写意画（文人画）有无用处，我此刻不敢确说，恐怕也许还有可用之点的罢。这些采取，并非断片的古董的杂陈，必须溶化于新作品中，那是不必赘说的事，恰如吃用牛羊，弃去蹄毛，留其精粹，以滋养及发达新的生体，决不因此就会“类乎”牛羊的。
Naturally, the adoption of old forms, or the search for new forms, must be practiced by the efforts of art apprentices, but theorists or critics have the same responsibility to guide, comment, and consult. We have art history, and we were born in China, which means we must open up Chinese art history. What to take? I think that we have no way to witness the authentic works before the Tang Dynasty, but we can still know that most of them are based on stories, which can be learned; In the Tang Dynasty, the splendor of Buddhist paintings, the emptiness and brightness of line paintings, the courtyard paintings of the Song Dynasty, the wilting and softness should be abandoned, the meticulous places are desirable, and the rice point of the landscape is useless. I dare not say for sure whether later freehand paintings (literati paintings) are useful or not, but I am afraid that there may still be points that can be used. These takes, not fragments of antiques, must be dissolved in new works, which is needless to say, just like eating cattle and sheep, discarding the hoof hair, leaving its essence, in order to nourish and develop a new living body, it will never be "like" to cattle and sheep.只是上文所举的，亦即我们现在所能看见的，都是消费的艺术。它一向独得有力者的宠爱，所以还有许多存留。但既有消费者，必有生产者，所以一面有消费者的艺术，一面也有生产者的艺术。古代的东西，因为无人保护，除小说的插画以外，我们几乎什么也看不见了。至于现在，却还有市上新年的花纸，和猛克先生所指出的连环图画。这些虽未必是真正的生产者的艺术，但和高等有闲者的艺术对立，是无疑的。但虽然如此，它还是大受着消费者艺术的影响，例如在文学上，则民歌大抵脱不开七言的范围，在图画上，则题材多是士大夫的故事，然而已经加以提炼，成为明快，简捷的东西了。这也就是蜕变，一向则谓之“俗”。注意于大众的艺术家，来注意于这些东西，大约也未必错，至于仍要加以提炼，那也是无须赘说的。
However, what we can see now is the art of consumption. It has always been favored by the powerful, so many still remain. But there are both consumers and producers, so there is the art of consumers on the one hand, and there is also the art of producers on the other. Ancient things, because they are unprotected, we can hardly see anything except the illustrations of novels. As for now, there are still New Year's flower papers on the market and the comic strips pointed out by Mr. Mengke. Although these may not be the art of real producers, they are undoubtedly opposed to the art of the higher idlers. But even so, it is still greatly influenced by consumer art, for example, in literature, folk songs are probably inseparable from the scope of seven words, and in pictures, the theme is mostly the story of scholar-officials, but it has been refined into a bright and simple thing. This is also transformation, which has always been called "vulgar". It is probably not wrong for artists who pay attention to the masses to pay attention to these things, and as for refining them, there is no need to say more.但中国的两者的艺术，也有形似而实不同的地方，例如佛画的满幅云烟，是豪华的装璜，花纸也有一种硬填到几乎不见白纸的，却是惜纸的节俭；唐伯虎画的细腰纤手的美人，是他一类人们的欲得之物，花纸上也有这一种，在赏玩者却只以为世间有这一类人物，聊资博识，或满足好奇心而已。为大众的画家，都无须避忌。
However, the art of the two in China also has similarities but real differences, such as the clouds and smoke of Buddhist paintings, which are luxurious decorations, and the flower paper is also filled so hard that there is almost no white paper, but it is the frugality of cherishing paper; The beauty with a slender waist and slender hands painted by Tang Bohu is something that people like him want, and there is also this kind on the flower paper, but the appreciator only thinks that there is this kind of character in the world, just to be knowledgeable or to satisfy curiosity. For the masses, there is no need to avoid taboos.至于谓连环图画不过图画的种类之一，与文学中之有诗歌，戏曲，小说相同，那自然是不错的。但这种类之别，也仍然与社会条件相关联，则我们只要看有时盛行诗歌，有时大出小说，有时独多短篇的史实便可以知道。因此，也可以知道即与内容相关联。现在社会上的流行连环图画，即因为它有流行的可能，且有流行的必要，着眼于此，因而加以导引，正是前进的艺术家的正确的任务；为了大众，力求易懂，也正是前进的艺术家正确的努力。旧形式是采取，必有所删除，既有删除，必有所增益，这结果是新形式的出现，也就是变革。而且，这工作是决不如旁观者所想的容易的。
As for saying that comic strips are just one of the types of pictures, it is the same as poetry, opera, and novels in literature, which is naturally good. However, this kind of difference is still related to social conditions, so we only need to look at the historical facts that sometimes prevail in poetry, sometimes in novels, and sometimes in short stories. Therefore, it is also possible to know that it is associated with the content. The popular comic strips in society now, because they have the possibility of popularity and the need to be popular, focus on this, and guide them, which is the correct task of the advancing artists; For the sake of the public, striving for ease of understanding is also the correct effort of the advancing artists. The old form is adopted, it must be deleted, and if it is deleted, it must be gained, and the result is the emergence of a new form, that is, change. Moreover, this work is by no means as easy as the bystanders think.但就是立有了新形式罢，当然不会就是很高的艺术。艺术的前进，还要别的文化工作的协助，某一文化部门，要某一专家唱独脚戏来提得特别高，是不妨空谈，却难做到的事，所以专责个人，那立论的偏颇和偏重环境的是一样的。
But if there is a new form, of course, it will not be a very high art. The advancement of art also requires the assistance of other cultural work, a certain cultural department, a certain expert to sing a one-man show to raise it particularly high, is a matter of empty talk, but it is difficult to do, so it is responsible for the individual, the bias of the argument is the same as the bias of the environment.五月二日。
May 2nd.

连环图画琐谈

连环图画琐谈

连环图画琐谈

Comic strip trivia“连环图画”的拥护者，看现在的议论，是“启蒙”之意居多的。
Advocates of "comic strips", looking at the current discussion, are mostly "enlightenment".古人“左图右史”，现在只剩下一句话，看不见真相了，宋元小说，有的是每页上图下说，却至今还有存留，就是所谓“出相”；明清以来，有卷头只画书中人物的，称为“绣像”。有画每回故事的，称为“全图”。那目的，大概是在诱引未读者的购读，增加阅读者的兴趣和理解。
The ancients "left picture and right history", now there is only one sentence left, the truth is invisible, Song and Yuan novels, some are said on each page on the picture and below, but there is still a trace, which is the so-called "appearance"; Since the Ming and Qing dynasties, there have been books that only draw characters in books, which are called "embroidered portraits". Those who draw each story are called "full pictures". The purpose is probably to lure unreaders to buy and increase readers' interest and understanding.但民间另有一种《智灯难字》或《日用杂字》，是一字一像，两相对照，虽可看图，主意却在帮助识字的东西，略加变通，便是现在的《看图识字》。文字较多的是《圣谕像解》，《二十四孝图》等，都是借图画以启蒙，又因中国文字太难，只得用图画来济文字之穷的产物。
However, there is another kind of "Zhideng Difficult Words" or "Daily Miscellaneous Words" among the people, which is a word and an image, two comparisons, although you can see the picture, but the idea is to help the literate thing, and it is slightly flexible, which is the current "Looking at the Picture and Literacy". The more texts are "Sacred Edict Image Explanation", "Twenty-Four Filial Piety Pictures", etc., all of which are the product of enlightenment through pictures, and because Chinese characters are too difficult, they have to use pictures to help the poor of words.“连环图画”便是取“出相”的格式，收《智灯难字》的功效的，倘要启蒙，实在也是一种利器。
"Comic Picture" is to take the format of "out of the phase" and receive the effect of "Wisdom Lantern Difficult Words", if you want to enlighten, it is really a sharp weapon.但要启蒙，即必须能懂。懂的标准，当然不能俯就低能儿或白痴，但应该着眼于一般的大众，譬如罢，中国画是一向没有阴影的，我所遇见的农民，十之九不赞成西洋画及照相，他们说：人脸那有两边颜色不同的呢？西洋人的看画，是观者作为站在一定之处的，但中国的观者，却向不站在定点上，所以他说的话也是真实。那么，作“连环图画”而没有阴影，我以为是可以的；人物旁边写上名字，也可以的，甚至于表示做梦从人头上放出一道毫光来，也无所不可。观者懂得了内容之后，他就会自己删去帮助理解的记号。这也不能谓之失真，因为观者既经会得了内容，便是有了艺术上的真，倘必如实物之真，则人物只有二三寸，就不真了，而没有和地球一样大小的纸张，地球便无法绘画。
But to be enlightened, you must be able to understand. The standard of understanding, of course, cannot be imbecile or idiot, but it should focus on the general public, for example, Chinese painting has always had no shadow, and nine out of ten peasants I met did not approve of Western painting and photography, they said: What about the color difference on both sides of the human face? Westerners look at paintings as the viewer stands at a certain place, but the Chinese viewer never stands at a fixed point, so what he says is also true. Then, I think it is possible to make a "comic strip" without shadows; It is also possible to write the name next to the character, or even to say that the dream emits a ray of light from the person's head, which is anything. After the viewer understands the content, he will delete the marks that help him understand. This cannot be called distortion, because the viewer has experienced the content, that is, there is artistic truth, if it must be like the real thing, then the figure is only two or three inches, it is not real, and without the same size of paper as the earth, the earth cannot be painted.艾思奇先生说：“若能够触到大众真正的切身问题，那恐怕愈是新的，才愈能流行。”这话也并不错。不过要商量的是怎样才能够触到，触到之法，“懂”是最要紧的，而且能懂的图画，也可以仍然是艺术。
Mr. Ai Siqi said: "If it can touch the real pressing problems of the public, I am afraid that the newer it is, the more popular it will be." This is not bad either. However, what needs to be discussed is how to touch it, how to touch it, "understanding" is the most important, and the picture that can be understood can still be art.五月九日。
May 9th.

Confucianism元遗山在金元之际，为文宗，为遗献，为愿修野史，保存旧章的有心人，明清以来，颇为一部分人士所爱重。然而他生平有一宗疑案，就是为叛将崔立颂德者，是否确实与他无涉，或竟是出于他的手笔的文章。
Yuan Yishan was in the Jin Yuan Dynasty, for Emperor Wenzong, for the legacy, for the willingness to repair the wild history, and to preserve the old chapters, since the Ming and Qing dynasties, it has been loved and respected by some people. However, there is a suspicious case in his life, that is, whether the traitor Cui Li praises virtue has nothing to do with him, or whether it is actually an article written by him.金天兴元年（一二三二），蒙古兵围洛阳；次年，安平都尉京城西面元帅崔立杀二丞相，自立为郑王，降于元。惧或加以恶名，群小承旨，议立碑颂功德，于是在文臣间，遂发生了极大的惶恐，因为这与一生的名节相关，在个人是十分重要的。
In the first year of Jin Tianxing (1232), the Mongolian soldiers besieged Luoyang; The following year, Cui Li, the marshal of the western capital of Anping, killed the two prime ministers, declared himself the King of Zheng, and surrendered to the Yuan Dynasty. Fearing or being infamous, the small people accepted the decree and decided to erect a monument to praise the merits, so among the civil officials, there was great fear, because it was related to the reputation of a lifetime and was very important to the individual.当时的情状，《金史》《王若虚传》这样说——

《看图识字》

《看图识字》

《看图识字》

"Reading Pictures and Literacy"凡一个人，即使到了中年以至暮年，倘一和孩子接近，便会踏进久经忘却了的孩子世界的边疆去，想到月亮怎么会跟着人走，星星究竟是怎么嵌在天空中。但孩子在他的世界里，是好像鱼之在水，游泳自如，忘其所以的，成人却有如人的凫水一样，虽然也觉到水的柔滑和清凉，不过总不免吃力，为难，非上陆不可了。
Anyone who is close to a child, even in middle age or twilight, will step into the frontier of the forgotten children's world, thinking about how the moon follows people and how the stars are embedded in the sky. But in his world, the child is like a fish in the water, swimming freely, forgetting why, but an adult is like a human duck water, although he also feels the smoothness and coolness of the water, but it is inevitable that it will be difficult, and it must be landed.月亮和星星的情形，一时怎么讲得清楚呢，家境还不算精穷，当然还不如给一点所谓教育，首先是识字。上海有各国的人们，有各国的书铺，也有各国的儿童用书。但我们是中国人，要看中国书，识中国字。这样的书也有，虽然纸张，图画，色彩，印订，都远不及别国，但有是也有的。我到市上去，给孩子买来的是民国二十一年十一月印行的“国难后第六版”的《看图识字》。
How can I explain the situation of the moon and the stars clearly for a while, the family background is not yet poor, of course, it is better to give a little so-called education, first of all, literacy. Shanghai has people from all over the world, bookstores from all over the world, and children's books from all over the world. But we are Chinese, and we must read Chinese books and know Chinese characters. There are also such books, although the paper, pictures, colors, and printing are far inferior to other countries, but there are also them. When I went to the city, I bought for my child the "Sixth Edition after the National Crisis" printed in November of the 21st year of the Republic of China.先是那色彩就多么恶浊，但这且不管他。图画又多么死板，这且也不管他。出版处虽然是上海，然而奇怪，图上有蜡烛，有洋灯，却没有电灯；有朝靴，有三镶云头鞋，却没有皮鞋。跪着放枪的，一脚拖地；站着射箭的，两臂不平，他们将永远不能达到目的，更坏的是连钓竿，风车，布机之类，也和实物有些不同。
First of all, the color was so ugly, but it didn't matter to him. How rigid the picture is, it doesn't matter to him. Although the publishing office is Shanghai, it is strange that there are candles and foreign lamps on the picture, but there are no electric lights; There are morning boots, three cloud-headed shoes, but no leather shoes. those who kneel and put their guns on their knees will mop the floor with one foot; Those who stand and shoot arrows, their arms are uneven, they will never achieve their goal, and even worse, even fishing rods, windmills, cloth machines, etc., are also a little different from the real thing.我轻轻的叹了一口气，记起幼小时候看过的《日用杂字》来。这是一本教育妇女婢仆，使她们能够记账的书，虽然名物的种类并不多，图画也很粗劣，然而很活泼，也很像。为什么呢？就因为作画的人，是熟悉他所画的东西的，一个“萝卜”，一只鸡，在他的记忆里并不含胡，画起来当然就切实。现在我们只要看《看图识字》里所画的生活状态——洗脸，吃饭，读书——就知道这是作者意中的读者，也是作者自己的生活状态，是在租界上租一层屋，装了全家，既不阔绰，也非精穷的，埋头苦干一日，才得维持生活一日的人，孩子得上学校，自己须穿长衫，用尽心神，撑住场面，又那有余力去买参考书，观察事物，修炼本领呢？况且，那书的末叶上还有一行道：“戊申年七月初版”。查年表，才知道那就是清朝光绪三十四年，即西历一九〇八年，虽是前年新印，书却成于二十七年前，已是一部古籍了，其奄奄无生气，正也不足为奇的。
I sighed softly, remembering the "Daily Miscellaneous Words" I read when I was a child. This is a book that educates women and servants so that they can keep accounts, although there are not many types of famous things, and the pictures are also very crude, but they are very lively and very similar. Why? Just because the painter is familiar with what he paints, a "radish", a chicken, does not contain a beard in his memory, and of course it is practical to paint. Now we only need to look at the living conditions depicted in "Looking at Pictures and Literacy" - washing faces, eating, reading - to know that this is the author's intended reader, but also the author's own living state, is to rent a one-story house on the concession, install the whole family, neither generous nor poor, immersed in hard work for a day, to maintain a day's life, children have to go to school, they have to wear long gowns, use all their minds, support the scene, and have the spare energy to buy reference books, observe things, and cultivate skills? Moreover, there is a line on the end of the book: "The first edition of July in the year of Wushen". Looking at the chronology, I found out that it was the thirty-fourth year of Guangxu of the Qing Dynasty, that is, in 1908 AD, although it was newly printed the year before last, but the book was written twenty-seven years ago, which is already an ancient book, and it is not surprising that it is dying.孩子是可以敬服的，他常常想到星月以上的境界，想到地面下的情形，想到花卉的用处，想到昆虫的言语；他想飞上天空，他想潜入蚁穴……所以给儿童看的图书就必须十分慎重，做起来也十分烦难。即如《看图识字》这两本小书，就天文，地理，人事，物情，无所不有。其实是，倘不是对于上至宇宙之大，下至苍蝇之微，都有些切实的知识的画家，决难胜任的。
Children can be admired, he often thinks of the realm above the stars and moon, the situation under the ground, the usefulness of flowers, and the words of insects; He wants to fly into the sky, he wants to dive into an anthill...... Therefore, books for children must be very careful and very difficult to do. That is, the two small books "Looking at Pictures and Literacy" have everything in terms of astronomy, geography, human affairs, and material conditions. In fact, if it weren't for the painter who had some practical knowledge of the universe and the smallest flies, it would be difficult to be competent.然而我们是忘却了自己曾为孩子时候的情形了，将他们看作一个蠢才，什么都不放在眼里。即使因为时势所趋，只得施一点所谓教育，也以为只要付给蠢才去教就足够。于是他们长大起来，就真的成了蠢才，和我们一样了。
However, we have forgotten what we were like when we were children, and we regard them as fools and don't pay attention to anything. Even if because of the trend of the times, I have to give a little so-called education, and I think it is enough to pay the fools to teach. So when they grow up, they really become fools, just like us.然而我们这些蠢才，却还在变本加厉的愚弄孩子。只要看近两三年的出版界，给“小学生”，“小朋友”看的刊物，特别的多就知道。中国突然出了这许多“儿童文学家”了么？我想：是并不然的。
However, we fools are still intensifying our fooling of children. Takeism中国一向是所谓“闭关主义”，自己不去，别人也不许来。自从给枪炮打破了大门之后，又碰了一串钉子，到现在，成了什么都是“送去主义”了。别的且不说罢，单是学艺上的东西，近来就先送一批古董到巴黎去展览，但终“不知后事如何”；还有几位“大师”们捧着几张古画和新画，在欧洲各国一路的挂过去，叫作“发扬国光”。听说不远还要送梅兰芳博士到苏联去，以催进“象征主义”，此后是顺便到欧洲传道。我在这里不想讨论梅博士演艺和象征主义的关系，总之，活人替代了古董，我敢说，也可以算得显出一点进步了。
China has always been a so-called "retreat", and if you don't go, others won't come. Since breaking the door for the guns, it has hit a string of nails, and now, everything has become "send-off". Not to mention anything else, just the things in the arts, recently sent a batch of antiques to Paris for exhibition, but in the end "I don't know what will happen next"; There are also several "masters" holding several ancient and new paintings, which are hung all the way in European countries, called "carrying forward the national light". I don't want to discuss the relationship between Dr. Mei's acting and symbolism here, in short, the living have replaced antiques, and I dare say that it can be regarded as a little progress.但我们没有人根据了“礼尚往来”的仪节，说道：拿来！
But none of us said according to the etiquette of "etiquette exchange": Bring it!当然，能够只是送出去，也不算坏事情，一者见得丰富，二者见得大度。尼采就自诩过他是太阳，光热无穷，只是给与，不想取得。然而尼采究竟不是太阳，他发了疯。中国也不是，虽然有人说，掘起地下的煤来，就足够全世界几百年之用。但是，几百年之后呢？几百年之后，我们当然是化为魂灵，或上天堂，或落了地狱，但我们的子孙是在的，所以还应该给他们留下一点礼品。要不然，则当佳节大典之际，他们拿不出东西来，只好磕头贺喜，讨一点残羹冷炙做奖赏。
Of course, being able to just give it away is not a bad thing, one is rich, and the other is generous. Nietzsche boasted that he was the sun, infinite in light and heat, but he just gave it and did not want to get it. However, Nietzsche was not the sun, he went crazy. China is not, although some people say that digging up underground coal is enough for the world to use for hundreds of years. But what about hundreds of years later? Hundreds of years later, of course, we will become souls, or go to heaven or hell, but our children and grandchildren are there, so we should also leave them a little gift. Otherwise, when the festival ceremony is held, they can't take out anything, so they have to kowtow to congratulate them and ask for a little leftovers as a reward.这种奖赏，不要误解为“抛来”的东西，这是“抛给”的，说得冠冕些，可以称之为“送来”，我在这里不想举出实例。
This kind of reward, don't misunderstand as something "thrown", this is "toss", to put it more seriously, it can be called "sent", I don't want to give examples here.我在这里也并不想对于“送去”再说什么，否则太不“摩登”了。我只想鼓吹我们再吝啬一点，“送去”之外，还得“拿来”，是为“拿来主义”。
I don't want to say anything more about "sending" here, otherwise it would be too "modern". I just want to advocate that we be a little more stingy, and in addition to "sending away", we must also "take", which is for the sake of "take-it-it-all".但我们被“送来”的东西吓怕了。先有英国的鸦片，德国的废枪炮，后有法国的香粉，美国的电影，日本的印着“完全国货”的各种小东西。于是连清醒的青年们，也对于洋货发生了恐怖。其实，这正是因为那是“送来”的，而不是“拿来”的缘故。
But we were frightened by what was "sent". First there was British opium, German waste guns, then French incense powder, American movies, and all kinds of small things printed with "completely domestic products" in Japan. So even sober young people were terrified of foreign goods. In fact, this is precisely because it is "sent", not "brought".所以我们要运用脑髓，放出眼光，自己来拿！
So we have to use our brains, let go of our vision, and take it ourselves!譬如罢，我们之中的一个穷青年，因为祖上的阴功（姑且让我这么说说罢），得了一所大宅子，且不问他是骗来的，抢来的，或合法继承的，或是做了女婿换来的。那么，怎么办呢？我想，首先是不管三七二十一，“拿来”！但是，如果反对这宅子的旧主人，怕给他的东西染污了，徘徊不敢走进门，是孱头；勃然大怒，放一把火烧光，算是保存自己的清白，则是昏蛋。不过因为原是羡慕这宅子的旧主人的，而这回接受一切，欣欣然的蹩进卧室，大吸剩下的鸦片，那当然更是废物。“拿来主义”者是全不这样的。
For example, a poor young man among us, because of the yin of his ancestors (let me say this), got a big house, and I don't ask if he was deceived, snatched, or legally inherited, or became a son-in-law. So, what to do? I think, first of all, regardless of three, seven, twenty-one, "bring it"! However, if the old owner of this house is afraid that the things given to him will be contaminated, and he hesitates and does not dare to enter the door, he is a coward; In a fit of rage, he set a fire and burned it all, which was regarded as preserving his innocence, but it was a faint. But because he was originally envious of the old owner of this house, and this time he accepted everything, happily went into the bedroom, and sucked the remaining opium, which was of course even more useless. The "fetishism" is not like this at all.他占有，挑选。看见鱼翅，并不就抛在路上以显其“平民化”，只要有养料，也和朋友们像萝卜白菜一样的吃掉，只不用它来宴大宾；看见鸦片，也不当众摔在毛厕里，以见其彻底革命，只送到药房里去，以供治病之用，却不弄“出售存膏，售完即止”的玄虚。只有烟枪和烟灯，虽然形式和印度，波斯，阿剌伯的烟具都不同，确可以算是一种国粹，倘使背着周游世界，一定会有人看，但我想，除了送一点进博物馆之外，其余的是大可以毁掉的了。还有一群姨太太，也大以请她们各自走散为是，要不然，“拿来主义”怕未免有些危机。
He possesses, picks. In short, we're going to take it. We want to use, store, or destroy. Then, the owner is the new owner, and the house will become a new house. However, first of all, this person must be calm, brave, discerning, and not selfish. Without it, people cannot become new people by themselves, and without what is brought, literature and art cannot become new literature and art.六月四日。

diaphragm清朝初年的文字之狱，到清朝末年才被从新提起。最起劲的是“南社”里的有几个人，为被害者辑印遗集；还有些留学生，也争从日本搬回文证来。待到孟森的《心史丛刊》出，我们这才明白了较详细的状况，大家向来的意见，总以为文字之祸，是起于笑骂了清朝。然而，其实是不尽然的。
The literary prison in the early years of the Qing Dynasty was not mentioned until the end of the Qing Dynasty. “又，臣之来也，不愿如何如何，亦别无愿求之事，惟有一事未决，请对陛下一叙其缘由。 臣…… 名曰冯起炎，字是南州，尝到臣张三姨母家，见一女，可娶，而恨不足以办此。 此女名曰小女，年十七岁，方当待字之年，而正在未字之时，乃原籍东关春牛厂长兴号张守忭之次女也。 又到臣杜五姨母家，见一女，可娶，而恨力不足以办此。 此女名小凤，年十三岁，虽非必字之年，而已在可字之时，乃本京东城闹市口瑞生号杜月之次女也。 若以陛下之力，差干员一人，选快马一匹，克日长驱到临邑，问彼临邑之地方官：‘其东关春牛厂长兴号中果有张守忭一人否？’诚如是也，则此事谐矣。 再问：‘东城闹市口瑞生号中果有杜月一人否？’诚如是也，则此事谐矣。 二事谐，则臣之愿毕矣。 然臣之来也，方不知陛下纳臣之言耶否耶，而必以此等事相强乎？特进言之际，一叙及之。 ”这何尝有丝毫恶意？不过着了当时通行的才子佳人小说的迷，想一举成名，天子做媒，表妹入抱而已。不料事实的结局却不大好，署直隶总督袁守侗拟奏的罪名是“阅其呈首，胆敢于圣主之前，混讲经书，而呈尾措词，尤属狂妄。核其情罪，较冲突仪仗为更重。冯起炎一犯，应从重发往黑龙江等处，给披甲人为奴。俟部复到日，照例解部刺字发遣。”这位才子，后来大约终于单身出关做西崽去了。

All these things, at a cursory glance, first make us feel the cruelty of the Qing Dynasty, and secondly, the pity of the dead. But when I think about it again, it's not that simple. The origin of these tragedies is only for the sake of "diaphragm".满洲人自己，就严分着主奴，大臣奏事，必称“奴才”，而汉人却称“臣”就好。这并非因为是“炎黄之胄”，特地优待，锡以嘉名的，其实是所以别于满人的“奴才”，其地位还下于“奴才”数等。奴隶只能奉行，不许言议；评论固然不可，妄自颂扬也不可，这就是“思不出其位”。譬如说：主子，您这袍角有些儿破了，拖下去怕更要破烂，还是补一补好。进言者方自以为在尽忠，而其实却犯了罪，因为另有准其讲这样的话的人在，不是谁都可说的。一乱说，便是“越俎代谋”，当然“罪有应得”。倘自以为是“忠而获咎”，那不过是自己的胡涂。
The Manchurians themselves strictly distinguish between masters and slaves, and ministers must be called "servants" when they report things, but the Han people are called "ministers". This is not because it is the "Zhou of Yan Huang", which is specially treated preferentially and given a good name, but in fact, it is different from the "slaves" of the Manchus, and its status is still lower than that of the "slaves". Slaves can only obey and are not allowed to speak; Commenting is certainly not allowed, nor is it possible to praise oneself, which is "not thinking of its place". For example: Master, the corner of your robe is a little torn, and if you drag it down, you may be even more torn, so it's better to make up for it. The speaker thinks he is being loyal, but in fact he has committed a sin, because there are other people who allow him to say such things, and not everyone can say them. In nonsense, it is "overstepping the bounds of the conspiracy", and of course "the crime deserves it". However, the founding kings of the Qing Dynasty were very smart, and although they made up their minds, they did not say the same in their mouths, using the ancient Chinese motto: "Love the people as children" and "treat everyone equally". Some ministers, scholar-officials, understood this mystery and couldn't believe it. 《木刻纪程》小引

《木刻纪程》小引

《木刻纪程》小引

A small introduction to the "Woodcut Chronicle"中国木刻图画，从唐到明，曾经有过很体面的历史。但现在的新的木刻，却和这历史不相干。新的木刻，是受了欧洲的创作木刻的影响的。创作木刻的绍介，始于朝花社，那出版的《艺苑朝华》四本，虽然选择印造，并不精工，且为艺术名家所不齿，却颇引起了青年学徒的注意。到一九三一年夏，在上海遂有了中国最初的木刻讲习会。又由是蔓衍而有木铃社，曾印《木铃木刻集》两本。又有野穗社，曾印《木刻画》一辑。有无名木刻社，曾印《木刻集》。但木铃社早被毁灭，后两社也未有继续或发展的消息。前些时在上海还剩有M．K．木刻研究社，是一个历史较长的小团体，曾经屡次展览作品，并且将出《木刻画选集》的，可惜今夏又被私怨者告密。社员多遭捕逐，木版也为工部局所没收了。
Chinese woodcut drawings, from the Tang Dynasty to the Ming Dynasty, once had a very respectable history. But the new woodcuts now have nothing to do with this history. The new woodcuts were influenced by European woodcuts. Shao Jie, who created woodcuts, began with the Chaohua Society, and the four copies of "Yiyuan Chaohua" were published, although they were chosen to be printed, not exquisite, and despised by famous artists, but they attracted the attention of young apprentices. By the summer of 1931, China's first woodcut workshop was held in Shanghai. From then on, the Wooden Bell Society was established, which once printed two copies of the "Wooden Bell Woodcut Collection". There is also the Wild Spike Society, which once printed a series of "Woodcut Paintings". There is an unnamed woodcut society that once printed the "Woodcut Collection". However, the Wooden Bell Society was destroyed long ago, and there was no news of the continuation or development of the latter two societies. Some time ago, there was still the M.K. Woodcut Research Society in Shanghai, which is a small group with a long history, which has repeatedly exhibited works and will publish the "Woodcut Anthology", but unfortunately it was reported by private enemies this summer. Many members were arrested, and the woodblocks were confiscated by the Ministry of Works.据我们所知道，现在似乎已经没有一个研究木刻的团体了。但尚有研究木刻的个人。如罗清桢，已出《清桢木刻集》二辑；如又村，最近已印有《廖坤玉故事》的连环图。这是都值得特记的。
As far as we know, there doesn't seem to be a single group that studies woodcuts anymore. But there are still individuals who study woodcuts. For example, Luo Qingzhen has published the second series of "Qingzhen Woodcut Collection"; Ruyou Village has recently been printed with a comic strip of "Liao Kunyu's Story". This is worth mentioning.而且仗着作者历来的努力和作品的日见其优良，现在不但已得中国读者的同情，并且也渐渐的到了跨出世界上去的第一步。虽然还未坚实，但总之，是要跨出去了。不过，同时也到了停顿的危机。因为倘没有鼓励和切磋，恐怕也很容易陷于自足。本集即愿做一个木刻的路程碑，将自去年以来，认为应该流布的作品，陆续辑印，以为读者的综观，作者的借镜之助。但自然，只以收集所及者为限，中国的优秀之作，是决非尽在于此的。
And with the author's past efforts and the quality of his works, he has not only won the sympathy of Chinese readers, but has also gradually reached the first step to go out of the world. Although it is not solid yet, in short, it is about to step out. However, at the same time, there is also a crisis of pause. Because if there is no encouragement and competition, I am afraid it is easy to fall into self-sufficiency. This collection is willing to be a woodcut monument, and since last year, the works that are thought to be circulated will be printed one after another, so as to help readers review and the author's reference. But naturally, only the collection is limited, and China's excellent works are by no means all here.别的出版者，一方面还正在绍介欧美的新作，一方面则在复印中国的古刻，这也都是中国的新木刻的羽翼。采用外国的良规，加以发挥，使我们的作品更加丰满是一条路；择取中国的遗产，融合新机，使将来的作品别开生面也是一条路。如果作者都不断的奋发，使本集能一程一程的向前走，那就会知道上文所说，实在不仅是一种奢望的了。
Other publishers, on the one hand, are still promoting new works from Europe and the United States, and on the other hand, they are copying ancient Chinese carvings, which are also the wings of China's new woodcuts. It is a way to adopt foreign good rules and give full play to make our works fuller; It is also a way to choose China's heritage, integrate new opportunities, and make future works unique. If the authors continue to work hard to make this episode move forward one by one, then they will know that what is said above is not only a luxury.一九三四年六月中，铁木艺术社记。

难行和不信

Difficult to walk and unbelievable中国的“愚民”——没有学问的下等人，向来就怕人注意他。如果你无端的问他多少年纪，什么意见，兄弟几个，家景如何，他总是支吾一通之后，躲了开去。有学识的大人物，很不高兴他们这样的脾气。然而这脾气总不容易改，因为他们也实在从经验而来的。
China's "foolish people", the uneducated inferior people, have always been afraid of being noticed. If you ask him for no reason how old he is, what opinions he has, how many brothers he has, and what his family situation is, he always hesitates and avoids it. Learned big people are very unhappy with their temper. However, this temper is not easy to change, because they also come from experience.假如你被谁注意了，一不小心，至少就不免上一点小当，譬如罢，中国是改革过的了，孩子们当然早已从“孟宗哭竹”“王祥卧冰”的教训里蜕出，然而不料又来了一个崭新的“儿童年”，爱国之士，因此又想起了“小朋友”，或者用笔，或者用舌，不怕劳苦的来给他们教训。一个说要用功，古时候曾有“囊萤照读”“凿壁偷光”的志士；一个说要爱国，古时候曾有十几岁突围请援，十四岁上阵杀敌的奇童。这些故事，作为闲谈来听听是不算很坏的，但万一有谁相信了，照办了，那就会成为乳臭未干的吉诃德。你想，每天要捉一袋照得见四号铅字的萤火虫，那岂是一件容易事？但这还只是不容易罢了，倘去凿壁，事情就更糟，无论在那里，至少是挨一顿骂之后，立刻由爸爸妈妈赔礼，雇人去修好。
For example, China has been reformed, and of course the children have long since shed out of the lessons of "Meng Zong Crying Bamboo" and "Wang Xiang Lying on the Ice", but unexpectedly a new "Year of Children" has come, patriots, so they think of "children", or with pens, or with tongues, not afraid of hard work to teach them a lesson. One said that it was necessary to work hard, and in ancient times, there were ambitious people who "read the fireflies in the bag" and "chiseled the wall to steal the light"; One said to be patriotic, in ancient times, there were teenagers who broke through and asked for help, and went into battle at the age of fourteen to kill the enemy. These stories are not bad to listen to as idle talk, but if anyone believes it and does it, it will become a milky quijote. Do you think it is not easy to catch a bag of fireflies that can see the number 4 lead every day? But it's just not easy, if you go to chisel the wall, things will be even worse, no matter there, at least after being scolded, your parents will immediately apologize and hire someone to fix it.请援，杀敌，更加是大事情，在外国，都是三四十岁的人们所做的。他们那里的儿童，着重的是吃，玩，认字，听些极普通，极紧要的常识。中国的儿童给大家特别看得起，那当然也很好，然而出来的题目就因此常常是难题，仍如飞剑一样，非上武当山寻师学道之后，决计没法办。到了二十世纪，古人空想中的潜水艇，飞行机，是实地上成功了，但《龙文鞭影》或《幼学琼林》里的模范故事，却还有些难学。我想，便是说教的人，恐怕自己也未必相信罢。
Asking for help and killing the enemy is a big thing, and in foreign countries, it is done by people in their thirties and forties. The children there focus on eating, playing, reading, and listening to some very ordinary and important common sense. Chinese children are particularly valued by everyone, of course, it is also very good, but the questions that come out are often difficult problems, still like flying swords, and there is no way to do it unless you go to Wudang Mountain to find a teacher to learn the way. In the twentieth century, the submarines and flying planes imagined by the ancients were successful on the ground, but the model stories in "Longwen Whip Shadow" or "Kindergarten Qionglin" were still a bit difficult to learn. I think that even if you are a preacher, I am afraid you may not believe it.所以听的人也不相信。我们听了千多年的剑仙侠客，去年到武当山去的只有三个人，只占全人口的五百兆分之一，就可见。古时候也许还要多，现在是有了经验，不大相信了，于是照办的人也少了。——但这是我个人的推测。
So the listeners don't believe it. We have listened to the sword immortal knights for more than a thousand years, and there were only three people who went to Wudang Mountain last year, accounting for only one in five hundred trillion of the total population, which can be seen. In ancient times, there may be more, but now there is experience, and I don't believe it, so there are fewer people who do it. – But this is my personal speculation.不负责任的，不能照办的教训多，则相信的人少；利己损人的教训多，则相信的人更其少。“不相信”就是“愚民”的远害的堑壕，也是使他们成为散沙的毒素。然而有这脾气的也不但是“愚民”，虽是说教的士大夫，相信自己和别人的，现在也未必有多少。例如既尊孔子，又拜活佛者，也就是恰如将他的钱试买各种股票，分存许多银行一样，其实是那一面都不相信的。
If there are many lessons that cannot be followed, there will be fewer people who believe in them; There are many lessons about self-interest and harm to others, and there are even fewer people who believe. "Unbelief" is the trench of the "foolish people", and it is also the toxin that makes them scattered sand. However, it is not only the "foolish people" who have this temper, although they are preaching scholars, and there may not be many who believe in themselves and others now. The compiler of this book is Yin Jiaquan, a native of Boye; His father, Yin Huiyi, was a famous filial son, and the Qianlong Emperor once gave a poem of praise. He himself is also a filial son, a Taoist, and an official who has become the Minister of Dali Temple. A certain method in the Qianlong era was to check the book collection and other texts, and if there was no "barking", it could be punished together. Because Qianlong's opinion was that if he dared to "bark", he would not stop at one or two sounds, and he had to thoroughly investigate it. Judging from these words and memorials (all see the sixth series of "Qing Dynasty Text Prison Files"), although the disaster this time came from his "restlessness", the main reason was that he not only regarded himself as a famous scholar, but also asked to worship famous ministers: these are all great "unforgivable" places.
