Qianlong did not admit that there would be "famous ministers" in the Qing Dynasty, he himself was a "British lord" and a "wise ruler", so under his rule, there could be no traitors, neither particularly bad traitors nor particularly good famous ministers, all of whom were neither good nor bad, and they were all slaves who were neither good nor bad, and it didn't matter whether they were good or bad.特别攻击道学先生，所以是那时的一种潮流，也就是“圣意”。我们所常见的，是纪昀总纂的《四库全书总目提要》和自著的《阅微草堂笔记》里的时时的排击。这就是迎合着这种潮流的，倘以为他秉性平易近人，所以憎恨了道学先生的刻，那是一种误解。大学士三宝们也很明白这潮流，当会审尹嘉铨时，曾奏道：“查该犯如此狂悖不法，若即行定罪正法，尚不足以泄公愤而快人心。该犯曾任三品大员，相应遵例奏明，将该犯严加夹讯，多受刑法，问其究属何心，录取供词，具奏，再请旨立正典刑，方足以昭炯戒。”后来究竟用了夹棍没有，未曾查考，但看所录供词，却于用他的“丑行”来打倒他的道学的策略，是做得非常起劲的。现在抄三条在下面——
Especially attacked Mr. Taoism, so it was a trend at that time, that is, "holy will". What we often see is the constant rejection in Ji Yun's "Summary of the Four Libraries of the Complete Book" and his self-authored "Notes on Reading Wei Caotang". This is catering to this trend, if you think that he is approachable by nature, so he hates Mr. Taoism, it is a misunderstanding. The Grand Scholar Sanbao also understood this trend, and when Yin Jiaquan was interrogated, he once said: "The criminal is so arrogant and lawless, if he is convicted and punished immediately, it is not enough to vent public anger and make people happy." The criminal had served as a third-rank official, and he reported that the criminal would be strictly interrogated and subjected to criminal law, and he would be asked what his intention was, accept the confession, make a report, and then request an imperial decree to establish a punishment, which was enough to make a warning. Later, whether he used a clamp stick or not, it was not investigated, but looking at the recorded confession, he did a very good job in using his "ugly behavior" to defeat his Taoist strategy. Now copy three below——“问：尹嘉铨！你所书李孝女暮年不字事一篇，说‘年逾五十，依然待字，吾妻李恭人闻而贤之，欲求淑女以相助，仲女固辞不就’等语。这处女既立志不嫁，已年过五旬，你为何叫你女人遣媒说合，要他做妾？这样没廉耻的事，难道是讲正经人干的么？据供：我说的李孝女年逾五十，依然待字，原因素日间知道雄县有个姓李的女子，守贞不字。吾女人要聘他为妾，我那时在京候补，并不知道；后来我女人告诉我，才知道的，所以替他做了这篇文字，要表扬他，实在我并没有见过他的面。但他年过五十，我还将要他做妾的话，做在文字内，这就是我廉耻丧尽，还有何辩。
"Q: Yin Jiaquan! You wrote an article about Li Xiaonu in her twilight years, saying, 'Over fifty years old, still waiting for words, my wife Li Gongren heard about it and was virtuous, and wanted a lady to help her, but the second daughter refused' and so on. Since this virgin is determined not to marry, she is over fifty years old, why did you ask your woman to send a matchmaker to negotiate and ask him to be a concubine? Is such a shameless thing done by serious people? According to the confession: The Li Xiaonu I said is over fifty years old and still waiting for words, and the original factor knows that there is a woman surnamed Li in Xiong County during the day, and she keeps her chastity and does not write. My woman wanted to hire him as a concubine, and I was waiting in Beijing at that time, so I didn't know; Later, my woman told me that I knew, so I made this text for him to praise him, but I really haven't met him. But when he is over fifty years old, I will still want him to be a concubine, and if I do it in the text, this is my shame, what argument is there?“问：你当时在皇上跟前讨赏翎子，说是没有翎子，就回去见不得你妻小。你这假道学怕老婆，到底皇上没有给你翎子，你如何回去的呢？据供：我当初在家时，曾向我妻子说过，要见皇上讨翎子，所以我彼时不辞冒昧，就妄求恩典，原想得了翎子回家，可以夸耀。后来皇上没有赏我，我回到家里，实在觉得害羞，难见妻子。这都是我假道学，怕老婆，是实。
"Question: You were in front of the emperor at that time to ask for a reward for the feathers, saying that there were no feathers, so you went back and couldn't see your wife and children. You are afraid of your wife, the emperor didn't give you feathers, how did you go back? According to the confession: When I was at home, I told my wife that I wanted to see the emperor to ask for a feather, so I took the liberty at that time and asked for grace. Later, the emperor did not reward me, and when I returned home, I felt really shy and difficult to see my wife. This is all my false Taoism, afraid of my wife, it is true.“问：你女人平日妒悍，所以替你娶妾，也要娶这五十岁女人给你，知道这女人断不肯嫁，他又得了不妒之名。总是你这假道学居常做惯这欺世盗名之事，你女人也学了你欺世盗名。你难道不知道么？供：我女人要替我讨妾，这五十岁李氏女子既已立志不嫁，断不肯做我的妾，我女人是明知的，所以借此要得不妒之名。总是我平日所做的事，俱系欺世盗名，所以我女人也学做此欺世盗名之事，难逃皇上洞鉴。”
"Q: Your woman is usually jealous, so if you marry a concubine for you, you will also marry this fifty-year-old woman to you. It's always your false Taoism that you are used to doing this kind of deception and stealing your name, and your woman has also learned from you to deceive the world and steal your name. Don't you know? Confession: My woman wants to ask for a concubine for me, this fifty-year-old Li woman has made up her mind not to marry, and she will never be my concubine. It is always what I do on weekdays to deceive the world and steal my name, so my women also learn to do this deception and stealing their names, and it is difficult to escape the emperor's insight. ”还有一件要紧事是销毁和他有关的书。他的著述也真太多，计应“销毁”者有书籍八十六种，石刻七种，都是著作；应“撤毁”者有书籍六种，都是古书，而有他的序跋。《小学大全》虽不过“疏辑”，然而是在“销毁”之列的。
Another important thing is to destroy the books related to him. There are really too many of his writings, and there are 86 kinds of books and 7 kinds of stone carvings that should be "destroyed", all of which are works; There are six kinds of books that should be "removed", all of which are ancient books, and there is his preface. Although the "Complete Primary School" is nothing more than a "compilation", it is among the "destruction".但我所得的《小学大全》，却是光绪二十二年开雕，二十五年刊竣，而“宣统丁巳”（实是中华民国六年）重校的遗老本，有张锡恭跋云：“世风不古若矣，愿读是书者，有以转移之。……”又有刘安涛跋云：“晚近凌夷，益加甚焉，异言喧，显与是书相悖，一唱百和，……驯致家与国均蒙其害，唐虞三代以来先圣先贤蒙以养正之遗意，扫地尽矣。剥极必复，天地之心见焉。……”为了文字狱，使士子不敢治史，尤不敢言近代事，但一面却也使昧于掌故，乾隆朝所竭力“销毁”的书，虽遗老也不复明白，不到一百三十年，又从新奉为宝典了。这莫非也是“剥极必复”么？恐怕是遗老们的乾隆皇帝所不及料的罢。
But the "Primary School Encyclopedia" I got was carved in the 22nd year of Guangxu and published in 25 years, and the old book of "Xuantong Dingsi" (actually the sixth year of the Republic of China) was re-edited, and Zhang Xigong said: "The world is not ancient, and I hope that those who read this book will have a way to transfer it." ......" There is also Liu Antao's postscript: "In the evening, it is close to the barbarians, and it is even more severe, and the noise of different words is obviously contrary to this book, and it is a song of a hundred harmony,...... The family and the country have suffered from it, and since the Tang and Yu dynasties, the sages and sages have been ignorant of the will of the righteous people, and they have been swept away. Peeling away the extreme will inevitably lead to repetition, and the heart of heaven and earth will be revealed. ...... "For the sake of the literary prison, the scholars did not dare to study history, especially not to talk about modern events, but on the other hand, they also made the books that the Qianlong Dynasty tried their best to "destroy", even if they were old, they no longer understood, and in less than 130 years, they were newly regarded as treasure books. Isn't this also "stripped and restored"? I'm afraid it was the Qianlong Emperor who left behind the old people who didn't expect it.但是，清的康熙，雍正和乾隆三个，尤其是后两个皇帝，对于“文艺政策”或说得较大一点的“文化统制”，却真尽了很大的努力的。文字狱不过是消极的一方面，积极的一面，则如钦定四库全书，于汉人的著作，无不加以取舍，所取的书，凡有涉及金元之处者，又大抵加以修改，作为定本。此外，对于“七经”，“二十四史”，《通鉴》，文士的诗文，和尚的语录，也都不肯放过，不是鉴定，便是评选，	文苑中实在没有不被蹂躏的处所了。而且他们是深通汉文的异族的君主，以胜者的看法，来批评被征服的汉族的文化和人情，也鄙夷，但也恐惧，有苛论，但也有确评，文字狱只是由此而来的辣手的一种，那成果，由满洲这方面言，是的确不能说它没有效的。
However, the three emperors of the Qing Dynasty, Kangxi, Yongzheng and Qianlong, especially the latter two emperors, really made great efforts for the "literary and artistic policy" or the larger "cultural control". The literary prison is only a negative aspect, and the positive side, such as the Imperial Four Libraries Complete Book, the writings of the Han people are all trade-offs, and the books taken, whenever there are places involving the Jin Yuan, are mostly modified as definitive versions. In addition, for the "Seven Classics", "Twenty-Four Histories", "Tongjian", the poems of scribes, and the quotations of monks, they are not willing to let go, either appraisal or selection, and there is really no place in the literary garden that is not ravaged. Moreover, they are foreign monarchs who are deeply knowledgeable in Chinese, and from the perspective of the winner, they criticize the culture and human feelings of the conquered Han people, and they also despise it, but they are also afraid, there are harsh comments, but there are also positive comments, and the literary prison is just a kind of hot hand that comes from this, and the result, from the Manchurian side, yes, it cannot be said that it is ineffective.现在这影响好像是淡下去了，遗老们的重刻《小学大全》，就是一个证据，但也可见被愚弄了的性灵，又终于并不清醒过来。近来明人小品，清代禁书，市价之高，决非穷读书人所敢窥，但《东华录》，《御批通鉴辑览》，《上谕八旗》，《雍正朱批谕旨》……等，却好像无人过问，其低廉为别的一切大部书所不及。倘有有心人加以收集，一一钩稽，将其中的关于驾御汉人，批评文化，利用文艺之处，分别排比，辑成一书，我想，我们不但可以看见那策略的博大和恶辣，并且还能够明白我们怎样受异族主子的驯扰，以及遗留至今的奴性的由来的罢。
Now this effect seems to have faded, and the re-engraved "Primary School Encyclopedia" by the elders is a piece of evidence, but it can also be seen that the fooled spirit has finally not woken up. Recently, the Ming people's sketches, the banned books of the Qing Dynasty, and the high market price are by no means dared to be seen by poor readers, but "Donghua Lu", "Imperial Approval Tongjian Compilation", "Eight Banners", "Yongzheng Zhu Pi Edict"...... etc., but it seems that no one cares, and its low price is unmatched by most other books. If someone who is interested in collecting it, checking it one by one, and compiling it into a book about controlling the Han people, criticizing culture, and using literature and art, I think we can not only see the breadth and viciousness of that strategy, but also understand how we are tamed by foreign masters and the origin of the servility that has been left to this day.自然，这决不及赏玩性灵文字的有趣，然而借此知道一点演成了现在的所谓性灵的历史，却也十分有益的。
Naturally, this is by no means as interesting as enjoying the words of the spirit, but it is also very beneficial to know a little about the history that has evolved into the current so-called spirit.七月十日。

韦素园墓记

韦素园墓记

Wei Suyuan's epitaph韦君素园之墓。
Wei Jun's grave in the plain garden.君以一九又二年六月十八日生，一九三二年八月一日卒。呜呼，宏才远志，厄于短年。文苑失英，明者永悼。弟丛芜，友静农，霁野立表；鲁迅书。
君以一九又二年六月十八日生，一九三二年八月一日卒。 呜呼，宏才远志，厄于短年。 文苑失英，明者永悼。 弟丛芜，友静农，霁野立表；鲁迅书。

忆韦素园君

忆韦素园君

忆韦素园君

忆韦素园君我也还有记忆的，但是，零落得很。我自己觉得我的记忆好像被刀刮过了的鱼鳞，有些还留在身体上，有些是掉在水里了，将水一搅，有几片还会翻腾，闪烁，然而中间混着血丝，连我自己也怕得因此污了赏鉴家的眼目。
I still have memories, but they are very fragmented. I myself feel that my memory is like fish scales scraped by a knife, some are still on my body, some are dropped into the water, and when I stir the water, a few pieces will churn and flicker, but there are bloodshots in the middle, and even I am afraid that it will stain the eyes of the connoisseur.现在有几个朋友要纪念韦素园君，我也须说几句话。是的，我是有这义务的。我只好连身外的水也搅一下，看看泛起怎样的东西来。
Now a few friends want to commemorate Wei Suyuanjun, and I have to say a few words. Yes, I have an obligation to do so. I had to stir the water outside my body to see what kind of thing was floating.怕是十多年之前了罢，我在北京大学做讲师，有一天，在教师豫备室里遇见了一个头发和胡子统统长得要命的青年，这就是李霁野。我的认识素园，大约就是霁野绍介的罢，然而我忘记了那时的情景。现在留在记忆里的，是他已经坐在客店的一间小房子里计画出版了。
I'm afraid it was more than ten years ago, I was a lecturer at Peking University, and one day, in the teacher's preparation room, I met a young man with terrible hair and beard, this is Li Jiye. I knew Suyuan, and it was probably Shosuke Jiye, but I forgot the scene at that time. What remains in my memory now is that he is already sitting in a small house in the inn planning to publish.这一间小房子，就是未名社。
This small house is the Weiming Society.
那时我正在编印两种小丛书，一种是《乌合丛书》，专收创作，一种是《未名丛刊》，专收翻译，都由北新书局出版。出版者和读者的不喜欢翻译书，那时和现在也并不两样，所以《未名丛刊》是特别冷落的。恰巧，素园他们愿意绍介外国文学到中国来，便和李小峰商量，要将《未名丛刊》移出，由几个同人自办。小峰一口答应了，于是这一种丛书便和北新书局脱离。稿子是我们自己的，另筹了一笔印费，就算开始。因这丛书的名目，连社名也就叫了“未名”——但并非“没有名目”的意思，是“还没有名目”的意思，恰如孩子的“还未成丁”似的。
At that time, I was compiling and printing two small series, one was the "Rabble Series", which was dedicated to creation, and the other was the "Unnamed Series", which was specially translated, both published by Beixin Book Company. Publishers and readers don't like translated books, and it's no different then than now, so the "Unnamed Series" is particularly neglected. It happened that Su Yuan and the others were willing to introduce foreign literature to China, so they discussed with Li Xiaofeng that they would move the "Unnamed Series" out and run it by a few fellow people. Xiaofeng agreed, so this series of books was separated from Beixin Bookstore. The manuscript is our own, and another printing fee is raised, even if it starts. Because of the name of this series of books, even the name of the society is called "unnamed" - but not "without a name", but "without a name", just like a child's "not yet adult".未名社的同人，实在并没有什么雄心和大志，但是，愿意切切实实的，点点滴滴的做下去的意志，却是大家一致的。而其中的骨干就是素园。
The fans of Weiming Society really don't have any ambitions and ambitions, but their willingness to do it bit by bit is unanimous. And the backbone of it is Suyuan.
于是他坐在一间破小屋子，就是未名社里办事了，不过小半好像也因为他生着病，不能上学校去读书，因此便天然的轮着他守寨。
So he sat in a dilapidated hut, that is, in the Weiming Society, but Xiao Ban seemed to be unable to go to school because he was sick, so he naturally took turns guarding the village.我最初的记忆是在这破寨里看见了素园，一个瘦小，精明，正经的青年，窗前的几排破旧外国书，在证明他穷着也还是钉住着文学。然而，我同时又有了一种坏印象，觉得和他是很难交往的，因为他笑影少。“笑影少”原是未名社同人的一种特色，不过素园显得最分明，一下子就能够令人感得。但到后来，我知道我的判断是错误了，和他也并不难于交往。他的不很笑，大约是因为年龄的不同，对我的一种特别态度罢，可惜我不能化为青年，使大家忘掉彼我，得到确证了。这真相，我想，霁野他们是知道的。
My first memory was to see Su Yuan in this dilapidated village, a thin, shrewd, serious young man, with rows of worn-out foreign books in front of the window, proving that he was poor but still nailed literature. However, I also had a bad impression that it was difficult to associate with him because he had few smiles. "Less laughing shadows" was originally a characteristic of the unnamed society fans, but Suyuan was the most distinct, and it could be felt at once. But later, I knew that my judgment was wrong, and it was not difficult to get along with him. He is not very funny, probably because of the difference in age, it is a special attitude towards me, but unfortunately I cannot turn into a young man, so that everyone forgets the other and me, and I get confirmation. I think Jiye and the others know this truth.但待到我明白了我的误解之后，却同时又发见了一个他的致命伤：他太认真；虽然似乎沉静，然而他激烈。认真会是人的致命伤的么？至少，在那时以至现在，可以是的。一认真，便容易趋于激烈，发扬则送掉自己的命，沉静着，又啮碎了自己的心。
But when I understood my misunderstanding, I also discovered one of his fatal wounds: he was too serious; Although he seems to be calm, he is fierce. Will seriousness be fatal to a person? At least, then and now, it can be. When you are serious, it is easy to become intense, and if you carry it forward, you will lose your life, be calm, and crush your heart.
这里有一点小例子。——我们是只有小例子的。
Here's a small example. - We only have small examples.那时候，因为段祺瑞总理和他的帮闲们的迫压，我已经逃到厦门，但北京的狐虎之威还正是无穷无尽。段派的女子师范大学校长林素园，带兵接收学校去了，演过全副武行之后，还指留着的几个教员为“共产党”。这个名词，一向就给有些人以“办事”上的便利，而且这方法，也是一种老谱，本来并不希罕的。但素园却好像激烈起来了，从此以后，他给我的信上，有好一晌竟憎恶“素园”两字而不用，改称为“漱园”。同时社内也发生了冲突，高长虹从上海寄信来，说素园压下了向培良的稿子，叫我讲一句话。我一声也不响。于是在《狂飙》上骂起来了，先骂素园，后是我。素园在北京压下了培良的稿子，却由上海的高长虹来抱不平，要在厦门的我去下判断，我颇觉得是出色的滑稽，而且一个团体，虽是小小的文学团体罢，每当光景艰难时，内部是一定有人起来捣乱的，这也并不希罕。然而素园却很认真，他不但写信给我，叙述着详情，还作文登在杂志上剖白。在“天才”们的法庭上，别人剖白得清楚的么？——我不禁长长的叹了一口气，想到他只是一个文人，又生着病，却这么拚命的对付着内忧外患，又怎么能够持久呢。自然，这仅仅是小忧患，但在认真而激烈的个人，却也相当的大的。
At that time, because of the pressure of Premier Duan Qirui and his helpers, I had already fled to Xiamen, but the power of Beijing's foxes and tigers was still endless. Lin Suyuan, the president of the Duan faction's Women's Normal University, led the troops to take over the school, and after performing full martial arts, he also pointed out that several instructors who remained were "Communists". This term has always given some people the convenience of "doing things", and this method is also an old spectrum, which is not rare. But Suyuan seemed to have become intense, and since then, in his letter to me, he hated the word "Suyuan" for a long time and did not use it, and changed it to "Shuyuan". At the same time, there was also a conflict within the company, Gao Changhong sent a letter from Shanghai, saying that Suyuan had suppressed Xiang Peiliang's manuscript and asked me to say a word. I didn't make a sound. So I scolded on "Hurricane", first scolding Su Yuan, and then me. Suyuan suppressed Pei Liang's manuscript in Beijing, but Gao Changhong from Shanghai was unfair, and I had to judge it in Xiamen, I think it was quite funny, and a group, although it is a small literary group, whenever the situation is difficult, there must be someone inside who will make trouble, which is not uncommon. However, Su Yuan was very serious, not only wrote to me, describing the details, but also composing an article to confess in the magazine. In the court of the "geniuses", did others explain it clearly? ——I couldn't help but sigh longly, thinking that he was just a literati and sick, but how could he last so desperately dealing with internal and external troubles. Naturally, this is only a small worry, but in a serious and fierce individual, it is also quite big.不久，未名社就被封，几个人还被捕。也许素园已经咯血，进了病院了罢，他不在内。但后来，被捕的释放，未名社也启封了，忽封忽启，忽捕忽放，我至今还不明白这是怎么的一个玩意。
Soon, the Weiming Society was sealed, and several people were arrested. Maybe Su Yuan has already coughed up blood and entered the hospital, but he is not included. But later, the arrest was released, and the Weiming Society was also unsealed, and I still don't understand what kind of thing this is.
我到广州，是第二年——一九二七年的秋初，仍旧陆续的接到他几封信，是在西山病院里，伏在枕头上写就的，因为医生不允许他起坐。他措辞更明显，思想也更清楚，更广大了，但也更使我担心他的病。有一天，我忽然接到一本书，是布面装订的素园翻译的《外套》。我一看明白，就打了一个寒噤：这明明是他送给我的一个纪念品，莫非他已经自觉了生命的期限了么？
When I arrived in Guangzhou, the second year, in the early autumn of 1927, I still received several letters from him, written on a pillow in Xishan Hospital, because the doctor did not allow him to sit up. His words were more obvious, his thoughts were clearer and broader, but it also made me worry more about his illness. One day, I suddenly received a book, "Coat" translated by Su Yuan bound on canvas. As soon as I understood, I shuddered: This is obviously a souvenir he gave me, could it be that he has already realized the limit of his life?我不忍再翻阅这一本书，然而我没有法。
I couldn't bear to read this book again, but I couldn't.我因此记起，素园的一个好朋友也咯过血，一天竟对着素园咯起来，他慌张失措，用了爱和忧急的声音命令道：“你不许再吐了！”我那时却记起了伊孛生的《勃兰特》。他不是命令过去的人，从新起来，却并无这神力，只将自己埋在崩雪下面的么？……
I remembered that a good friend of Suyuan also coughed up blood, and one day he giggled at Suyuan, and he panicked and ordered in a voice of love and worry: "Don't vomit anymore!" "I remembered Ibsen's "Brandt" at that time. Didn't he order the people of the past to rise anew, but without this divine power, he only buried himself under the snowfall? ……我在空中看见了勃兰特和素园，但是我没有话。
I saw Brandt and Suyuan in the air, but I didn't say anything.
一九二九年五月末，我最以为侥幸的是自己到西山病院去，和素园谈了天。他为了日光浴，皮肤被晒得很黑了，精神却并不萎顿。我们和几个朋友都很高兴。但我在高兴中，又时时夹着悲哀：忽而想到他的爱人，已由他同意之后，和别人订了婚；忽而想到他竟连绍介外国文学给中国的一点志愿，也怕难于达到；忽而想到他在这里静卧着，不知道他自以为是在等候全愈，还是等候灭亡；忽而想到他为什么要寄给我一本精装的《外套》？……
At the end of May 1929, I thought it was a fluke that I went to Xishan Hospital and talked with Suyuan. In order to sunbathe, his skin was tanned very much, but his spirit was not weakened. We were happy with a few friends. But in my joy, I was always filled with sadness: suddenly I thought of his lover, who had been engaged to someone else after his consent; Suddenly thinking that he was afraid that even a little volunteer for Shaojie foreign literature would be difficult to achieve; Suddenly thinking of him lying here quietly, I don't know if he thinks he is waiting for full recovery or destruction; Suddenly I thought why he sent me a hardcover copy of "Coat"? ……壁上还有一幅陀思妥也夫斯基的大画像。对于这先生，我是尊敬，佩服的，但我又恨他残酷到了冷静的文章。他布置了精神上的苦刑，一个个拉了不幸的人来，拷问给我们看。现在他用沉郁的眼光，凝视着素园和他的卧榻，好像在告诉我：这也是可以收在作品里的不幸的人。
There is also a large portrait of Dostoevsky on the wall. I respect and admire this gentleman, but I hate his cruel and calm articles. He arranged mental torture, pulled the unfortunate people one by one, and tortured them to show us. Now he stares at Su Yuan and his couch with gloomy eyes, as if telling me: This is also an unfortunate person who can be included in the work.自然，这不过是小不幸，但在素园个人，是相当的大的。
Naturally, this is just a small misfortune, but in Suyuan, it is quite a big one.一九三二年八月一日晨五时半，素园终于病殁在北平同仁医院里了，一切计画，一切希望，也同归于尽。我所抱憾的是因为避祸，烧去了他的信札，我只能将一本《外套》当作唯一的纪念，永远放在自己的身边。
At half past five in the morning on August 1, 1932, Suyuan finally died of illness in Tongren Hospital in Peking, and all plans and hopes were also exhausted. What I regret is that because I avoided disaster, I burned his letter, and I can only keep a copy of "Coat" as the only souvenir and keep it by my side forever.
自素园病殁之后，转眼已是两年了，这其间，对于他，文坛上并没有人开口。这也不能算是希罕的，他既非天才，也非豪杰，活的时候，既不过在默默中生存，死了之后，当然也只好在默默中泯没。但对于我们，却是值得记念的青年，因为他在默默中支持了未名社。
Since Suyuan's death, it has been two years in the blink of an eye, and during this time, no one in the literary world has spoken about him. This cannot be regarded as a rare thing, he is neither a genius nor a hero, when he lives, he neither survives in silence, and after death, of course, he has to disappear in silence. But for us, he is a young man worth remembering, because he silently supported the Weiming Society.未名社现在是几乎消灭了，那存在期，也并不长久。然而自素园经营以来，绍介了果戈理（N．Gogol），陀思妥也夫斯基（F．Dostoevsky），安特列夫（L．Andreev），绍介了望·蔼覃（F．van Eeden），绍介了爱伦堡（I．Ehrenburg）的《烟袋》和拉夫列涅夫（B．Lavrenev）的《四十一》。还印行了《未名新集》，其中有丛芜的《君山》，静农的《地之子》和《建塔者》，我的《朝华夕拾》，在那时候，也都还算是相当可看的作品。事实不为轻薄阴险小儿留情，曾几何年，他们就都已烟消火灭，然而未名社的译作，在文苑里却至今没有枯死的。
The Weiming Society is almost extinct now, and its existence is not long. However, since the operation of the plain garden, it has introduced N. Gogol, F. Dostoevsky, L. Andreev, F. van Eeden, I. Ehrenburg's "Tobacco Bag" and B. Lavrenev's "Forty-One". I also printed "Weiming New Collection", which included Cong Wu's "Junshan", Jingnong's "Son of the Earth" and "The Tower Builder", and my "Chaohua and Xishi", which were also quite worth looking at at that time. The facts are not merciful for frivolous and insidious children, and once upon a time, they were all extinguished, but the translation of the Weiming Society has not died in the literary garden so far.是的，但素园却并非天才，也非豪杰，当然更不是高楼的尖顶，或名园的美花，然而他是楼下的一块石材，园中的一撮泥土，在中国第一要他多。他不入于观赏者的眼中，只有建筑者和栽植者，决不会将他置之度外。
Yes, but Suyuan is not a genius, nor a hero, of course, not the spire of a high-rise building, or a beautiful flower in a famous garden, but he is a stone downstairs, and a handful of soil in the garden is the first in China to ask for more. He is not in the eyes of the viewer, only the builders and planters, will never leave him out.文人的遭殃，不在生前的被攻击和被冷落，一瞑之后，言行两亡，于是无聊之徒，谬托知己，是非蜂起，既以自，又以卖钱，连死尸也成了他们的沽名获利之具，这倒是值得悲哀的。现在我以这几千字纪念我所熟识的素园，但愿还没有营私肥己的处所，此外也别无话说了。
The suffering of literati is not attacked and neglected during their lifetime, but after a death, both words and deeds are lost, so bored people, falsely claiming to be confidants, right and wrong are rising, both for themselves and for selling money, and even the corpse has become a tool for them to make a profit, which is sad. Now I use these thousands of words to commemorate the Suyuan I know, hoping that there is no place to enrich myself for personal gain, and there is nothing else to say.我不知道以后是否还有记念的时候，倘止于这一次，那么，素园，从此别了！
I don't know if there will be times to remember it in the future, if it stops at this time, then, Suyuan, farewell from now on!一九三四年七月十六之夜，鲁迅记。
On the night of July 16, 1934, Lu Xun recorded.

忆刘半农君

忆刘半农君

忆刘半农君

I think of Liu Bannong这是小峰出给我的一个题目。
This is a question given to me by Xiaofeng.这题目并不出得过分。半农去世，我是应该哀悼的，因为他也是我的老朋友。但是，这是十来年前的话了，现在呢，可难说得很。
This question is not excessive. I should mourn the death of Bannon, because he is also an old friend of mine. However, this was more than ten years ago, and it is difficult to say now.我已经忘记了怎么和他初次会面，以及他怎么能到了北京。他到北京，恐怕是在《新青年》投稿之后，由蔡孑民先生或陈独秀先生去请来的，到了之后，当然更是《新青年》里的一个战士。他活泼，勇敢，很打了几次大仗。譬如罢，答王敬轩的双信，“她”字和“牠”字的创造，就都是的。这两件，现在看起来，自然是琐屑得很，但那是十多年前，单是提倡新式标点，就会有一大群人“若丧考妣”，恨不得“食肉寝皮”的时候，所以的确是“大仗”。现在的二十左右的青年，大约很少有人知道三十年前，单是剪下辫子就会坐牢或杀头的了。然而这曾经是事实。
I have forgotten how I first met him and how he got to Beijing. When he arrived in Beijing, I am afraid that after the submission of "New Youth", Mr. Cai Jiemin or Mr. Chen Duxiu invited him, and after arriving, of course, he was a soldier in "New Youth". He was lively, brave, and fought several big battles. For example, in response to Wang Jingxuan's double letter, the creation of the word "she" and the word "it" are both true. These two pieces, now it seems, are naturally very trivial, but that was more than ten years ago, just by advocating a new style of punctuation, there would be a large group of people who "lost their mothers" and wanted to "eat meat and sleep skin", so it was indeed a "big battle". Today's young people in their twenties, about few people know that thirty years ago, just cutting their braids would lead to jail time or beheading. However, this was once a fact.但半农的活泼，有时颇近于草率，勇敢也有失之无谋的地方。但是，要商量袭击敌人的时候，他还是好伙伴，进行之际，心口并不相应，或者暗暗的给你一刀，他是决不会的。倘若失了算，那是因为没有算好的缘故。
But Bannong's liveliness is sometimes quite close to sloppiness, and his bravery also has his mistakes. However, when it comes to discussing attacking the enemy, he is still a good partner, and when he is doing it, his heart does not correspond, or he secretly gives you a knife, he will never do it. If you lose your calculation, it is because you have not calculated well.《新青年》每出一期，就开一次编辑会，商定下一期的稿件。其时最惹我注意的是陈独秀和胡适之。假如将韬略比作一间仓库罢，独秀先生的是外面竖一面大旗，大书道：“内皆武器，来者小心！”但那门却开着的，里面有几枝枪，几把刀，一目了然，用不着提防。适之先生的是紧紧的关着门，门上粘一条小纸条道：“内无武器，请勿疑虑。”这自然可以是真的，但有些人——至少是我这样的人——有时总不免要侧着头想一想。半农却是令人不觉其有“武库”的一个人，所以我佩服陈胡，却亲近半农。
Every time "New Youth" is published, an editorial meeting is held to agree on the manuscript for the next issue. At that time, the ones that caught my attention the most were Chen Duxiu and Hu Shizhi. If Tao Lue is compared to a warehouse, Mr. Duxiu is to erect a big flag outside, and the big book says: "There are weapons inside, be careful of those who come!" But the door was open, and there were a few guns and knives inside, which were clear at a glance and didn't need to be guarded. Mr. Shizhi closed the door tightly, and a small note was glued to the door and said, "There are no weapons inside, please don't doubt." This can be true, of course, but some people – at least people like me – sometimes have to tilt their heads and think about it. Bannong is a person who makes people feel that he has an "arsenal", so I admire Chen Hu, but I am close to Bannong.所谓亲近，不过是多谈闲天，一多谈，就露出了缺点。几乎有一年多，他没有消失掉从上海带来的才子必有“红袖添香夜读书”的艳福的思想，好容易才给我们骂掉了。但他好像到处都这么的乱说，使有些“学者”皱眉。有时候，连到《新青年》投稿都被排斥。他很勇于写稿，但试去看旧报去，很有几期是没有他的。那些人们批评他的为人，是：浅。
The so-called closeness is just talking more about idle days, and talking more reveals shortcomings. For almost more than a year, he did not disappear the idea that the talents brought from Shanghai must have the beauty of "reading at night with red sleeves", and it was easy for us to scold him. But he seems to be talking nonsense everywhere, which makes some "scholars" frown. Sometimes, even submissions to "New Youth" are rejected. He was very brave in writing, but when he tried to read old newspapers, there were many issues without him. Those who criticized him for being a shallow person.不错，半农确是浅。但他的浅，却如一条清溪，澄澈见底，纵有多少沉渣和腐草，也不掩其大体的清。倘使装的是烂泥，一时就看不出它的深浅来了；如果是烂泥的深渊呢，那就更不如浅一点的好。
Yes, semi-agricultural is indeed shallow. But his shallowness is like a clear stream, crystal clear, no matter how much sediment and rotten grass there is, it does not hide its general clarity. If it is filled with mud, it will not be possible to see its depth for a while; If it is a muddy abyss, it is even better to be shallow.但这些背后的批评，大约是很伤了半农的心的，他的到法国留学，我疑心大半就为此。我最懒于通信，从此我们就疏远起来了。他回来时，我才知道他在外国钞古书，后来也要标点《何典》，我那时还以老朋友自居，在序文上说了几句老实话，事后，才知道半农颇不高兴了，“驷不及舌”，也没有法子。另外还有一回关于《语丝》的彼此心照的不快活。五六年前，曾在上海的宴会上见过一回面，那时候，我们几乎已经无话可谈了。
But the criticism behind these probably hurt Bannong's heart very much, and I suspected that most of his study in France was for this. I was the laziest to communicate, and since then we have become estranged. When he came back, I learned that he was in a foreign banknote ancient book, and later he also had to punctuate the "He Dian", I still regarded myself as an old friend at that time, and said a few honest words in the preface, and afterwards, I realized that Bannong was quite unhappy, "not as good as the tongue", and there was no way. There is also a tacit unhappiness about "Yusi". Five or six years ago, we met again at a banquet in Shanghai, and at that time, we had almost nothing to talk about.近几年，半农渐渐的据了要津，我也渐渐的更将他忘却；但从报章上看见他禁称“蜜斯”之类，却很起了反感：我以为这些事情是不必半农来做的。从去年来，又看见他不断的做打油诗，弄烂古文，回想先前的交情，也往往不免长叹。我想，假如见面，而我还以老朋友自居，不给一个“今天天气……哈哈哈”完事，那就也许会弄到冲突的罢。
In recent years, Ban Nong has gradually occupied the main position, and I have gradually forgotten about him; But when I saw in the newspapers that he forbade the name "Mis" and the like, I was very disgusted: I thought these things didn't have to be done by half-farmers. Since last year, I have seen him constantly making limericks, ruining ancient texts, and recalling his previous friendships, and he often sighs. I think that if we meet, and I still consider myself an old friend, I won't give a "weather today...... Hahaha "It's over, then maybe it will lead to conflict."不过，半农的忠厚，是还使我感动的。我前年曾到北平，后来有人通知我，半农是要来看我的，有谁恐吓了他一下，不敢来了。这使我很惭愧，因为我到北平后，实在未曾有过访问半农的心思。
However, Bannong's loyalty still moved me. I went to Peiping the year before last, and then someone informed me that Ban Nong was coming to see me, and someone intimidated him and did not dare to come. This made me very ashamed, because after I arrived in Peking, I really never had the intention of visiting Bannong.现在他死去了，我对于他的感情，和他生时也并无变化。我爱十年前的半农，而憎恶他的近几年。这憎恶是朋友的憎恶，因为我希望他常是十年前的半农，他的为战士，即使“浅”罢，却于中国更为有益。我愿以愤火照出他的战绩，免使一群陷沙鬼将他先前的光荣和死尸一同拖入烂泥的深渊。
Now that he is dead, my feelings for him have not changed from when he was alive. I love Ban Nong ten years ago, but hate him in recent years. This hatred is the hatred of friends, because I hope he is often a half-farmer ten years ago, and his soldier, even if it is "shallow", is more beneficial to China. I wish to shine his achievements with anger, lest a group of sand trappers drag his former glory and corpses into the abyss of mud.八月一日。
August 1st.

答曹聚仁先生信

答曹聚仁先生信

答曹聚仁先生信

Answer to Mr. Cao Juren's letter聚仁先生：
Mr. Ju Ren:关于大众语的问题，提出得真是长久了，我是没有研究的，所以一向没有开过口。但是现在的有些文章觉得不少是“高论”，文章虽好，能说而不能行，一下子就消灭，而问题却依然如故。
The question of popular language has been raised for a long time, and I have not studied it, so I have never spoken about it. But some articles now feel that many of them are "high arguments", although the articles are good, they can be said but not done, and they are eliminated all at once, but the problems are still the same.现在写一点我的简单的意见在这里：
Now write a little bit of my simple opinion here:一，汉字和大众，是势不两立的。
First, Chinese characters and the public are incompatible.二，所以，要推行大众语文，必须用罗马字拼音（即拉丁化，现在有人分为两件事，我不懂是怎么一回事），而且要分为多少区，每区又分为小区（譬如绍兴一个地方，至少也得分为四小区），写作之初，纯用其地的方言，但是，人们是要前进的，那时原有方言一定不够，就只好采用白话，欧字，甚而至于语法。但，在交通繁盛，言语混杂的地方，又有一种语文，是比较普通的东西，它已经采用着新字汇，我想，这就是“大众语”的雏形，它的字汇和语法，即可以输进穷乡僻壤去。中国人是无论如何，在将来必有非通几种中国语不可的运命的，这事情，由教育与交通，可以办得到。
Second, so, to promote popular language, it is necessary to use Romanization (that is, Latinization, now some people are divided into two things, I don't know what is going on), and how many districts must be divided, and each district is divided into communities (for example, a place in Shaoxing, at least divided into four communities), at the beginning of writing, purely the dialect of the place, but people are going to move forward, at that time the original dialect must not be enough, so they have to use vernacular, European characters, and even grammar. However, in places where traffic is prosperous and language is mixed, there is another language, which is a relatively ordinary thing, and it has adopted new vocabulary, I think, this is the prototype of "popular language", and its vocabulary and grammar can be exported to poor and remote areas. In any case, Chinese people will have the fate of not being able to speak several Chinese languages in the future, and this can be done by education and transportation.三，普及拉丁化，要在大众自掌教育的时候。现在我们所办得到的是：（甲）研究拉丁化法；（乙）试用广东话之类，读者较多的言语，做出东西来看；（丙）竭力将白话做得浅豁，使能懂的人增多，但精密的所谓“欧化”语文，仍应支持，因为讲话倘要精密，中国原有的语法是不够的，而中国的大众语文，也决不会永久含胡下去。譬如罢，反对欧化者所说的欧化，就不是中国固有字，有些新字眼，新语法，是会有非用不可的时候的。
Third, the popularization of Latinization should be done when the masses are in charge of their own education. What we can do now is: (a) study Latinization; (b) Try Cantonese and other words, with more readers, and make things to see; (c) Strive to make the vernacular simple and open-minded, so that more people can understand it, but the so-called so-called "Europeanized" language should still be supported, because if the speech is to be precise, China's original grammar is not enough, and China's popular language will never be permanently bearded. For example, the Europeanization mentioned by those who oppose Europeanization is not an inherent word in China, and there will be times when some new words and new grammar must be used.四，在乡僻处启蒙的大众语，固然应该纯用方言，但一面仍然要改进。譬如“妈的”一句话罢，乡下是有许多意义的，有时骂骂，有时佩服，有时赞叹，因为他说不出别样的话来。先驱者的任务，是在给他们许多话，可以发表更明确的意思，同时也可以明白更精确的意义。如果也照样的写着“这妈的天气真是妈的，妈的再这样，什么都要妈的了”，那么于大众有什么益处呢？
Fourth, the popular language enlightened in remote places should certainly use dialects, but it still needs to be improved. For example, the word "damn" has many meanings, sometimes scolding, sometimes admiring, sometimes admiring, because he can't say anything else. The task of the pioneers is to give them many words that can express clearer meanings and at the same time understand more precise meanings. If it is also written as "This damn weather is really damned, damn it, everything will be", then what is the benefit to the public?五，至于已有大众语雏形的地方，我以为大可以依此为根据而加以改进，太僻的土语，是不必用的。例如上海叫“打”为“吃生活”，可以用于上海人的对话，却不必特用于作者的叙事中，因为说“打”，工人也一样的能够懂。有些人以为如“像煞有介事”之类，已经通行，也是不确的话，北方人对于这句话的理解，和江苏人是不一样的，那感觉并不比“俨乎其然”切实。
Fifth, as for the places where the popular language has already taken shape, I think it can be improved based on this, and it is not necessary to use too remote native languages. For example, Shanghai calls "fighting" as "eating life", which can be used in the dialogue of Shanghainese, but it does not have to be used specifically in the author's narrative, because when it is said to "fight", workers can also understand it. Some people think that things like "like a serious matter" have been popular, but it is also inaccurate, and the understanding of this sentence by northerners is different from that of Jiangsu people, and the feeling is not more practical than "as it is".语文和口语不能完全相同；讲话的时候，可以夹许多“这个这个”“那个那个”之类，其实并无意义，到写作时，为了时间，纸张的经济，意思的分明，就要分别删去的，所以文章一定应该比口语简洁，然而明了，有些不同，并非文章的坏处。
Language and spoken language cannot be exactly the same; When speaking, you can include a lot of "this" and "that", etc., in fact, it is meaningless, and when writing, for the sake of time, the economy of the paper, and the clear meaning, it must be deleted separately, so the article must be more concise than the spoken word, but it is clear, some differences, not a bad thing about the article.所以现在能够实行的，我以为是（一）制定罗马字拼音（赵元任的太繁，用不来的）；（二）做更浅显的白话文，采用较普通的方言，姑且算是向大众语去的作品，至于思想，那不消说，该是“进步”的；（三）仍要支持欧化文法，当作一种后备。
So what can be implemented now, I think it is (1) formulating Roman character pinyin (Zhao Yuanren's is too complicated to use); (2) Doing a more simple vernacular text, using a more ordinary dialect, is a work that goes to the popular language, as for thought, needless to say, it should be "progressive"; (3) It is still necessary to support Europeanized grammar as a kind of backup.还有一层，是文言的保护者，现在也有打了大众语的旗子的了，他一方面，是立论极高，使大众语悬空，做不得；别一方面，借此攻击他当面的大敌——白话。这一点也须注意的。要不然，我们就会自己缴了自己的械。专此布复，即颂时绥。
On the one hand, he has a very high argument, so that the popular language is suspended and cannot be done; On the other hand, use this to attack his immediate enemy - vernacular. This also needs to be noted. Otherwise, we will surrender our own weapons. Focusing on this repetition, it is a praise of the peace of the times.迅上。八月二日。
Quickly ascended. August 2nd.

从孩子的照相说起

从孩子的照相说起

从孩子的照相说起

Let's start with the child's photo因为长久没有小孩子，曾有人说，这是我做人不好的报应，要绝种的。房东太太讨厌我的时候，就不准她的孩子们到我这里玩，叫作“给他冷清冷清，冷清得他要死！”但是，现在却有了一个孩子，虽然能不能养大也很难说，然而目下总算已经颇能说些话，发表他自己的意见了。不过不会说还好，一会说，就使我觉得他仿佛也是我的敌人。
Because I have not had children for a long time, some people once said that this is the retribution for my bad behavior and will be extinct. When the landlady hated me, she didn't allow her children to come to me to play, calling it "Give him a desert, so cold that he will die!" However, now that he has a child, although it is difficult to say whether he can raise it or not, he is finally able to say something and express his own opinions. But it's okay if you can't say it, but once you say it, it makes me feel as if he is also my enemy.他有时对于我很不满，有一回，当面对我说：“我做起爸爸来，还要好……”甚而至于颇近于“反动”，曾经给我一个严厉的批评道：“这种爸爸，什么爸爸！？”
He was sometimes dissatisfied with me, and once, in front of me, he said: "I want to be a father, but I want to be better......" and even close to "reactionary", and once gave me a severe criticism: "This kind of dad, what kind of dad!? ”我不相信他的话。做儿子时，以将来的好父亲自命，待到自己有了儿子的时候，先前的宣言早已忘得一干二净了。况且我自以为也不算怎么坏的父亲，虽然有时也要骂，甚至于打，其实是爱他的。所以他健康，活泼，顽皮，毫没有被压迫得瘟头瘟脑。如果真的是一个“什么爸爸”，他还敢当面发这样反动的宣言么？
I don't believe him. When he was a son, he regarded himself as a good father in the future, and when he had a son, he had already forgotten the previous declaration. Besides, I think my father is not very bad, although sometimes he scolds and even beats, but he actually loves him. So he was healthy, lively, naughty, and not oppressed at all. If he was really a "father", would he dare to make such a reactionary declaration in person?但那健康和活泼，有时却也使他吃亏，九一八事件后，就被同胞误认为日本孩子，骂了好几回，还挨过一次打——自然是并不重的。这里还要加一句说的听的，都不十分舒服的话：近一年多以来，这样的事情可是一次也没有了。
After the 918 incident, he was mistaken for a Japanese child by his compatriots, scolded several times, and beaten once - naturally it was not serious. Here is another sentence that is not very comfortable to hear: in the past year or so, such a thing has not happened once.中国和日本的小孩子，穿的如果都是洋服，普通实在是很难分辨的。但我们这里的有些人，却有一种错误的速断法：温文尔雅，不大言笑，不大动弹的，是中国孩子；健壮活泼，不怕生人，大叫大跳的，是日本孩子。
If Chinese and Japanese children wear Western clothes, it is really difficult to tell the difference. But some of us here have a wrong quick judgment: those who are gentle, not smiling, and not moving are Chinese children; Strong and lively, not afraid of strangers, shouting and jumping, it is a Japanese child.然而奇怪，我曾在日本的照相馆里给他照过一张相，满脸顽皮，也真像日本孩子；后来又在中国的照相馆里照了一张相，相类的衣服，然而面貌很拘谨，驯良，是一个道地的中国孩子了。
However, strangely, I once took a picture of him in a photo studio in Japan, his face was full of mischief, and he really looked like a Japanese child; Later, he took a photo in a photo studio in China, with similar clothes, but his appearance was very restrained, docile, and he was an authentic Chinese child.为了这事，我曾经想了一想。
I once thought about it.这不同的大原因，是在照相师的。他所指示的站或坐的姿势，两国的照相师先就不相同，站定之后，他就瞪了眼睛，机摄取他以为最好的一刹那的相貌。孩子被摆在照相机的镜头之下，表情是总在变化的，时而活泼，时而顽皮，时而驯良，时而拘谨，时而烦厌，时而疑惧，时而无畏，时而疲劳……。照住了驯良和拘谨的一刹那的，是中国孩子相；照住了活泼或顽皮的一刹那的，就好像日本孩子相。
The big reason for this difference is the photographer. The standing or sitting posture he instructed, the photographer of the two countries was not the same at first, and after standing still, he stared, and  took what he thought was the best moment. When children are placed under the lens of the camera, their expressions are always changing, sometimes lively, sometimes naughty, sometimes docile, sometimes restrained, sometimes annoying, sometimes suspicious, sometimes fearless, sometimes tired ....... The moment of tame and restraint is the appearance of a Chinese child; It shines on a lively or playful moment, just like a Japanese child.驯良之类并不是恶德。但发展开去，对一切事无不驯良，却决不是美德，也许简直倒是没出息。“爸爸”和前辈的话，固然也要听的，但也须说得有道理。假使有一个孩子，自以为事事都不如人，鞠躬倒退；或者满脸笑容，实际上却总是阴谋暗箭，我实在宁可听到当面骂我“什么东西”的爽快，而且希望他自己是一个东西。
Taming is not a vice. But if you develop and are tame in everything, it is by no means a virtue, and it may be simply unpromising. The words of "Dad" and seniors must be listened to, but they must also be reasonable. If there is a child who thinks that he is inferior to others in everything, he bows and goes backwards; Or with a smile on his face, but in fact he is always a conspiracy and a hidden arrow, I would rather hear the cheerfulness of scolding me in person for "something", and hope that he is a thing himself.但中国一般的趋势，却只在向驯良之类——“静”的一方面发展，低眉顺眼，唯唯诺诺，才算一个好孩子，名之曰“有趣”。活泼，健康，顽强，挺胸仰面……凡是属于“动”的，那就未免有人摇头了，甚至于称之为“洋气”。又因为多年受着侵略，就和这“洋气”为仇；更进一步，则故意和这“洋气”反一调：他们活动，我偏静坐；他们讲科学，我偏扶乩；他们穿短衣，我偏着长衫；他们重卫生，我偏吃苍蝇；他们壮健，我偏生病……这才是保存中国固有文化，这才是爱国，这才不是奴隶性。
However, the general trend in China is only developing towards the tame and the like - "quiet", low eyebrows are pleasing to the eye, only yes, is a good child, called "interesting". Lively, healthy, tenacious, chest up, back...... Anything that belongs to "movement" will inevitably shake its head, and even call it "foreign". and because of the invasion for many years, it is a grudge against this "foreign spirit"; Further, it deliberately contradicts this "foreign atmosphere": they are active, and I tend to sit quietly; They talk about science, and I support them; They wear short clothes, and I wear long clothes; They pay attention to hygiene, and I prefer to eat flies; They are strong, but I am sick...... This is the preservation of China's inherent culture, this is patriotism, and this is not slavery.其实，由我看来，所谓“洋气”之中，有不少是优点，也是中国人性质中所本有的，但因了历朝的压抑，已经萎缩了下去，现在就连自己也莫名其妙，统统送给洋人了。这是必须拿它回来——恢复过来的——自然还得加一番慎重的选择。
In fact, in my opinion, there are many advantages in the so-called "foreign atmosphere", which are also inherent in the nature of the Chinese, but due to the suppression of the past dynasties, they have shrunk, and now even they are inexplicably given to foreigners. This is a must to be brought back—recovered—and naturally a careful choice.即使并非中国所固有的罢，只要是优点，我们也应该学习。即使那老师是我们的仇敌罢，我们也应该向他学习。我在这里要提出现在大家所不高兴说的日本来，他的会摹仿，少创造，是为中国的许多论者所鄙薄的，但是，只要看看他们的出版物和工业品，早非中国所及，就知道“会摹仿”决不是劣点，我们正应该学习这“会摹仿”的。“会摹仿”又加以有创造，不是更好么？否则，只不过是一个“恨恨而死”而已。
Even if it is not inherent in China, as long as it is an advantage, we should learn from it. Even if the teacher is our enemy, we should learn from him. I would like to point out here that Japan, which everyone is not happy to say now, will imitate and create less, which is despised by many Chinese commentators, but as long as you look at their publications and industrial products, which are far beyond China's reach, you will know that "imitation" is by no means a bad thing, and we should learn from this "imitation". Isn't it better to "imitate" and create it? Otherwise, it is just a "death of hatred".我在这里还要附一句像是多余的声明：我相信自己的主张，决不是“受了帝国主义者的指使”，要诱中国人做奴才；而满口爱国，满身国粹，也于实际上的做奴才并无妨碍。
I would like to add a statement that seems redundant here: I believe that my proposition is by no means "instructed by the imperialists" to lure the Chinese into slaves; And full of patriotism and national essence does not hinder being a slave in fact.八月七日。

Outside the door, there is a discussion一　开头
1. Beginning听说今年上海的热，是六十年来所未有的。白天出去混饭，晚上低头回家，屋子里还是热，并且加上蚊子。这时候，只有门外是天堂。因为海边的缘故罢，总有些风，用不着挥扇。虽然彼此有些认识，却不常见面的寓在四近的亭子间或搁楼里的邻人也都坐出来了，他们有的是店员，有的是书局里的校对员，有的是制图工人的好手。大家都已经做得筋疲力尽，叹着苦，但这时总还算有闲的，所以也谈闲天。
I heard that this year's fever in Shanghai is unprecedented in 60 years. Go out to mix during the day, bow your head and go home at night, the house is still hot, and mosquitoes are added. At this time, only heaven is outside the door. Because of the seaside, there is always some wind, so there is no need to wave a fan. Although they knew each other a little, the neighbors who lived in the nearby pavilions or shelves who did not see each other often also sat down, some of them were clerks, some were proofreaders in the bookstore, and some were good draftsmen. Everyone is exhausted and sighing, but at this time they are still idle, so they also talk about leisure.闲天的范围也并不小：谈旱灾，谈求雨，谈吊膀子，谈三寸怪人干，谈洋米，谈裸腿，也谈古文，谈白话，谈大众语。因为我写过几篇白话文，所以关于古文之类他们特别要听我的话，我也只好特别说的多。这样的过了两三夜，才给别的话岔开，也总算谈完了。不料过了几天之后，有几个还要我写出来。
The scope of idle days is not small: talking about drought, talking about praying for rain, talking about hanging arms, talking about three-inch strange people, talking about foreign rice, talking about bare legs, talking about ancient texts, talking about vernacular, and talking about popular language. Because I have written several vernacular articles, they have to listen to me especially about ancient texts, so I have to say a lot. After two or three nights, I gave up on other words, and the conversation was finally over. Unexpectedly, a few days later, I was asked to write a few of them.他们里面，有的是因为我看过几本古书，所以相信我的，有的是因为我看过一点洋书，有的又因为我看古书也看洋书；但有几位却因此反不相信我，说我是蝙蝠。我说到古文，他就笑道，你不是唐宋八大家，能信么？我谈到大众语，他又笑道：你又不是劳苦大众，讲什么海话呢？
Among them, some believe in me because I have read a few ancient books, some because I have read a little foreign book, and some because I read ancient books and foreign books; But a few people didn't believe me because of this, saying that I was a bat. When I talked about ancient texts, he smiled and said, you are not the eight masters of the Tang and Song dynasties, can you believe it? When I talked about popular language, he smiled again: You are not a working public, what kind of sea language do you speak?这也是真的。我们讲旱灾的时候，就讲到一位老爷下乡查灾，说有些地方是本可以不成灾的，现在成灾，是因为农民懒，不戽水。但一种报上，却记着一个六十老翁，因儿子戽水乏力而死，灾象如故，无路可走，自杀了。老爷和乡下人，意见是真有这么的不同的。那么，我的夜谈，恐怕也终不过是一个门外闲人的空话罢了。
It's also true. When we talked about drought, we talked about an old man who went to the countryside to investigate the disaster, saying that some places could not have been a disaster, but now it is a disaster because the peasants are lazy and do not draw water. But a kind of newspaper remembers a sixty-year-old man who died of his son's weakness in the water, and the disaster was the same, with no way out, and he committed suicide. The opinions of the master and the countryman are really so different. Then, my night talk is probably just the empty words of an idle person outside the door.飓风过后，天气也凉爽了一些，但我终于照着希望我写的几个人的希望，写出来了，比口语简单得多，大致却无异，算是抄给我们一流人看的。当时只凭记忆，乱引古书，说话是耳边风，错点不打紧，写在纸上，却使我很踌躇，但自己又苦于没有原书可对，这只好请读者随时指正了。
After the hurricane, the weather was a little cooler, but I finally wrote it according to the wishes of the few people who wanted me to write it, which was much simpler than spoken words, but it was roughly the same, and it was copied to us first-class people. At that time, I only relied on memory, quoting ancient books, speaking in my ears, and writing on paper made me hesitate, but I was suffering from not having the original book to answer, so I had to ask readers to correct me at any time.一九三四年，八月十六夜，写完并记。
On the night of August 16, 1934, I finished writing and recording.

二　字是什么人造的？

门外文谈

2. What is the word artificial?字是什么人造的？
What is the word man-made?我们听惯了一件东西，总是古时候一位圣贤所造的故事，对于文字，也当然要有这质问。但立刻就有忘记了来源的答话：字是仓颉造的。
We are used to hearing one thing, always a story created by a sage in ancient times, and of course we must have this question about words. But immediately there was an answer that forgot the source: the words were made by Cangjie.这是一般的学者的主张，他自然有他的出典。我还见过一幅这位仓颉的画像，是生着四只眼睛的老头陀。可见要造文字，相貌先得出奇，我们这种只有两只眼睛的人，是不但本领不够，连相貌也不配的。
This is the proposition of ordinary scholars, and he naturally has his source. I also saw a portrait of this Cangjie, an old man with four eyes. It can be seen that if you want to create words, your appearance will be surprising, and people like us who only have two eyes are not only not good enough, but also unworthy of appearance.然而做《易经》的人（我不知道是谁），却比较的聪明，他说：“上古结绳而治，后世圣人易之以书契。”他不说仓颉，只说“后世圣人”，不说创造，只说掉换，真是谨慎得很；也许他无意中就不相信古代会有一个独自造出许多文字来的人的了，所以就只是这么含含胡胡的来一句。
However, the person who made the "I Ching" (I don't know who it was) was relatively smart, he said: "In ancient times, the knot was ruled, and the later sages changed it with a book contract." He didn't say Cangjie, only "the saints of later generations", he didn't talk about creation, he only said that he was replaced, which was really cautious; Maybe he didn't inadvertently believe that there would be a person who created many words alone in ancient times, so he just said it vaguely.但是，用书契来代结绳的人，又是什么脚色呢？文学家？不错，从现在的所谓文学家的最要卖弄文字，夺掉笔杆便一无所能的事实看起来，的确首先就要想到他；他也的确应该给自己的吃饭家伙出点力。然而并不是的。有史以前的人们，虽然劳动也唱歌，求爱也唱歌，他却并不起草，或者留稿子，因为他做梦也想不到卖诗稿，编全集，而且那时的社会里，也没有报馆和书铺子，文字毫无用处。据有些学者告诉我们的话来看，这在文字上用了一番工夫的，想来该是史官了。
But what kind of person is the person who uses the book deed to tie the rope? Litterateur? Yes, from the fact that the current so-called writers are the most flattering of words, and they are powerless to take away the barrel of the pen, it seems that they must think of him first; He should indeed give some strength to his eating guy. However, it is not. Prehistoric people, although labor and singing, courtship also sang, he did not draft or leave manuscripts, because he could not dream of selling poetry manuscripts and compiling complete works, and in the society at that time, there were no newspapers and bookstores, and words were useless. According to what some scholars tell us, this has taken a lot of effort in writing, and I think it should be a historian.原始社会里，大约先前只有巫，待到渐次进化，事情繁复了，有些事情，如祭祀，狩猎，战争……之类，渐有记住的必要，巫就只好在他那本职的“降神”之外，一面也想法子来记事，这就是“史”的开头。况且“升中于天”，他在本职上，也得将记载酋长和他的治下的大事的册子，烧给上帝看，因此一样的要做文章——虽然这大约是后起的事。再后来，职掌分得更清楚了，于是就有专门记事的史官。文字就是史官必要的工具，古人说：“仓颉，黄帝史。”第一句未可信，但指出了史和文字的关系，却是很有意思的。至于后来的“文学家”用它来写“阿呀呀，我的爱哟，我要死了！”那些佳句，那不过是享享现成的罢了，“何足道哉”！
In primitive society, there were only witches before, but when they gradually evolved, things became complicated, and some things such as sacrifices, hunting, and wars ...... and so on, gradually there is a need to remember, so Wu has to think about recording things in addition to his own "séance", which is the beginning of "history". Moreover, in his own office, he had to burn to God the booklet of the chieftain and the great events under his rule, so he had to make the same article—although this was probably a later thing. Later, the responsibilities were more clearly divided, so there were historians who specialized in recording events. Words are the necessary tools for historians, and the ancients said: "Cangjie, the history of the Yellow Emperor." The first sentence is not credible, but it points out the relationship between history and writing, which is very interesting. As for the later "writers" who used it to write "Ah, my love, I'm going to die!" Those good sentences, that's just enjoying the ready-made, "what's the point"!

三　字是怎么来的？

门外文谈

How did the word 3 come about?照《易经》说，书契之前明明是结绳；我们那里的乡下人，碰到明天要做一件紧要事，怕得忘记时，也常常说：“裤带上打一个结！”那么，我们的古圣人，是否也用一条长绳，有一件事就打一个结呢？恐怕是不行的。只有几个结还记得，一多可就糟了。或者那正是伏羲皇上的“八封”之流，三条绳一组，都不打结是“乾”，中间各打一结是“坤”罢？恐怕也不对。八组尚可，六十四组就难记，何况还会有五百十二组呢。只有在秘鲁还有存留的“打结字”（Quippus），用一条横绳，挂上许多直绳，拉来拉去的结起来，网不像网，倒似乎还可以表现较多的意思。我们上古的结绳，恐怕也是如此的罢。但它既然被书契掉换，又不是书契的祖宗，我们也不妨暂且不去管它了。
According to the Book of Changes, the book contract is obviously a knot before it; When we country people have something important to do tomorrow and are afraid of forgetting it, they often say: "Tie a knot on your trouser belt!" "So, did our ancient sages also use a long rope to tie a knot for one thing? I'm afraid not. I only remember a few knots, and too much is bad. Or is that the "eight seals" of Emperor Fuxi, a group of three ropes, none of which are knotted is "dry", and each knot in the middle is "kun"? I'm afraid it's not right. Eight groups are acceptable, but 64 groups are hard to remember, not to mention that there will be 512 groups. Only in Peru do the remaining "quippus" (quippus), with a horizontal rope, hanging many straight ropes, pulling and pulling them into knots, the net is not like a net, but it seems to be more meaningful. I'm afraid the same is true for our ancient knots. But since it has been replaced by the book deed, and it is not the ancestor of the book deed, we might as well leave it alone for the time being.夏禹的“岣嵝碑”是道士们假造的；现在我们能在实物上看见的最古的文字，只有商朝的甲骨和钟鼎文。但这些，都已经很进步了，几乎找不出一个原始形态。只在铜器上，有时还可以看见一点写实的图形，如鹿，如象，而从这图形上，又能发见和文字相关的线索：中国文字的基础是“象形”。
Xia Yu's "Xunjun Stele" was forged by Taoist priests; The oldest writing we can see in real life now is only the oracle bones and bell tripod inscriptions of the Shang Dynasty. But these have been very advanced, and it is almost impossible to find a primitive form. Only on the bronze ware, sometimes you can see a little realistic figure, such as a deer, such as an elephant, and from this figure, you can find clues related to the text: the basis of Chinese characters is "pictographs".画在西班牙的亚勒泰米拉（Altamira）洞里的野牛，是有名的原始人的遗迹，许多艺术史家说，这正是“为艺术的艺术”，原始人画着玩玩的。但这解释未免过于“摩登”，因为原始人没有十九世纪的文艺家那么有闲，他的画一只牛，是有缘故的，为的是关于野牛，或者是猎取野牛，禁咒野牛的事。现在上海墙壁上的香烟和电影的广告画，尚且常有人张着嘴巴看，在少见多怪的原始社会里，有了这么一个奇迹，那轰动一时，就可想而知了。他们一面看，知道了野牛这东西，原来可以用线条移在别的平面上，同时仿佛也认识了一个“牛”字，一面也佩服这作者的才能，但没有人请他作自传赚钱，所以姓氏也就湮没了。但在社会里，仓颉也不止一个，有的在刀柄上刻一点图，有的在门户上画一些画，心心相印，口口相传，文字就多起来，史官一采集，便可以敷衍记事了。中国文字的由来，恐怕也逃不出这例子的。
The bison painted in the caves of Altamira in Spain is the remains of famous primitive people, which many art historians say is "art for art", and primitive people painted and played with it. But this explanation is too "modern", because primitive people are not as leisurely as the literary and artistic figures of the nineteenth century, and his painting of a cow is for a reason, in order to be about bison, or hunting bison, and forbidding bison. Nowadays, cigarettes and movie advertisements on the walls of Shanghai are often watched with open mouths, and in the rare and strange primitive society, there is such a miracle, and the sensation can be imagined. While they looked at it, they knew that the bison could be moved to another plane with lines, and at the same time, they seemed to know the word "cow", and on the other hand, they also admired the author's talent, but no one asked him to make money as an autobiography, so the surname was obscured. But in society, there is more than one Cangjie, some carve a little picture on the handle of the knife, and some draw some paintings on the portal. The origin of Chinese characters may not escape this example.自然，后来还该有不断的增补，这是史官自己可以办到的，新字夹在熟字中，又是象形，别人也容易推测到那字的意义。直到现在，中国还在生出新字来。但是，硬做新仓颉，却要失败的，吴的朱育，唐的武则天，都曾经造过古怪字，也都白费力。现在最会造字的是中国化学家，许多原质和化合物的名目，很不容易认得，连音也难以读出来了。老实说，我是一看见就头痛的，觉得远不如就用万国通用的拉丁名来得爽快，如果二十来个字母都认不得，请恕我直说：那么，化学也大抵学不好的。
Naturally, there should be continuous additions later, which is what the historian himself can do, and the new character is sandwiched in the familiar word, and it is pictographic, and it is easy for others to guess the meaning of the word. Until now, China is still giving birth to new words. However, Zhu Yu of Wu and Wu Zetian of Tang have all made strange characters, and they are all in vain. Now it is the Chinese chemists who know how to make the most words, and the names of many primitives and compounds are not easy to recognize, and even the sound is difficult to read. To be honest, I have a headache when I see it, and I think it's far better to use the universal Latin name, if you can't recognize the twenty letters, please forgive me: then, chemistry is probably not good at learning.

四　写字就是画画

4. Writing is painting《周礼》和《说文解字》上都说文字的构成法有六种，这里且不谈罢，只说些和“象形”有关的东西。
Both the "Rites of Zhou" and "Shuowen Jiezi" say that there are six ways to compose words, and we will not talk about it here, only talking about things related to "pictograms".象形，“近取诸身，远取诸物”，就是画一只眼睛是“目”，画一个圆圈，放几条毫光是“日”，那自然很明白，便当的。但有时要碰壁，譬如要画刀口，怎么办呢？不画刀背，也显不出刀口来，这时就只好别出心裁，在刀口上加一条短棍，算是指明“这个地方”的意思，造了“刃”。这已经颇有些办事棘手的模样了，何况还有无形可象的事件，于是只得来“象意”，也叫作“会意”。一只手放在树上是“采”，一颗心放在屋子和饭碗之间是“”，有吃有住，安了。但要写“可”的，却又得在碗下面放一条线，表明这不过是用了“”的声音的意思。“会意”比“象形”更麻烦，它至少要画两样。如“”字，则要画一个屋顶，一串玉，一个缶，一个，计四样；我看“缶”字还是杵臼两形合成的，那么一共有五样。单单为了画这一个字，就很要破费些工夫。
Pictogram, "take from the body closely, take things from away", that is, draw an eye as an "eye", draw a circle, put a few rays of light is "sun", then it is naturally very clear, it is bento. But sometimes you have to hit a wall, such as drawing a knife edge, what should you do? If you don't draw the back of the knife, you can't show the edge of the knife, so you have to be creative and add a short stick to the edge of the knife, which can be regarded as indicating the meaning of "this place" and creating a "blade". This is already quite tricky, not to mention that there are intangible events, so we have to come to "symbolism", also called "understanding". One hand on the tree is "picking", and one heart is "" between the house and the rice bowl id_00001. But if you want to write  as " can", you have to put a line under the bowl to indicate that this is just the meaning of the sound "". "Understanding" is more troublesome than "pictographic", and it requires at least two drawings. For example, the word "" should be drawn with a roof, a string of jade, a can, and a total; I think the word "can" is still a combination of pestle and mortar, so there are five in total. Just to draw this word, it takes a lot of effort.不过还是走不通，因为有些事物是画不出，有些事物是画不来，譬如松柏，叶样不同，原是可以分出来的，但写字究竟是写字，不能像绘画那样精工，到底还是硬挺不下去。来打开这僵局的是“谐声”，意义和形象离开了关系。这已经是“记音”了，所以有人说，这是中国文字的进步。不错，也可以说是进步，然而那基础也还是画画儿。例如“菜，从草，采声”，画一窠草，一个爪，一株树：三样；“海，从水，每声”，画一条河，一位戴帽（？）的太太，也三样。总之：你如果要写字，就非永远画画不成。
But it still doesn't work, because some things can't be drawn, some things can't be drawn, such as pine and cypress, the leaves are different, they can be separated, but writing is not as exquisite as painting, and it still can't be stiff in the end. What comes to open this impasse is "harmony", meaning and image leave the relationship. This is already "phonetic", so some people say that this is the progress of Chinese characters. Yes, it can also be said to be progress, but the foundation is still painting. For example, "vegetables, from grass, picking sounds", drawing a nest of grass, a claw, and a tree: three; "The sea, from the water, every sound", drawing a river, a man wearing a hat (?) There are also three kinds of wives. In short: if you want to write, you have to never be able to draw.但古人是并不愚蠢的，他们早就将形象改得简单，远离了写实。篆字圆折，还有图画的余痕，从隶书到现在的楷书，和形象就天差地远。不过那基础并未改变，天差地远之后，就成为不象形的象形字，写起来虽然比较的简单，认起来却非常困难了，要凭空一个一个的记住。而且有些字，也至今并不简单，例如“”或“”，去叫孩子写，非练习半年六月，是很难写在半寸见方的格子里面的。
But the ancients were not stupid, they had long changed the image to be simple and far from realism. The seal characters are folded, and there are traces of pictures, from the official script to the current regular script, and the image is very different. However, the foundation has not changed, and after the sky is far away, it has become a non-pictographic hieroglyph, although it is relatively simple to write, it is very difficult to recognize, and it must be remembered one by one out of thin air. And some words are not simple so far, such as "" or "", to ask children to write, it is difficult to write in a half-inch square grid without practicing for half a year and six months.还有一层，是“谐声”字也因为古今字音的变迁，很有些和“声”不大“谐”的了。现在还有谁读“滑”为“骨”，读“海”为“每”呢？
There is another layer, the word "harmonic" is also due to the changes in the pronunciation of ancient and modern characters, and it is not very "harmonious" with "sound". Who else reads "slippery" as "bone" and "sea" as "every"?古人传文字给我们，原是一份重大的遗产，应该感谢的。但在成了不象形的象形字，不十分谐声的谐声字的现在，这感谢却只好踌蹰一下了。
The ancients passed on words to us, which was originally a major heritage and should be thankful. But now that it has become a non-pictographic hieroglyph and a homophonic word that is not very harmonious, this thank you has to hesitate for a moment.

五　古时候言文一致么？

门外文谈

5. Was the Chinese language consistent in ancient times?到这里，我想来猜一下古时候言文是否一致的问题。
At this point, I would like to guess the question of whether the ancient Chinese language was consistent.对于这问题，现在的学者们虽然并没有分明的结论，但听他口气，好像大概是以为一致的；越古，就越一致。不过我却很有些怀疑，因为文字愈容易写，就愈容易写得和口语一致，但中国却是那么难画的象形字，也许我们的古人，向来就将不关重要的词摘去了的。
Although the current scholars do not have a clear conclusion on this issue, they seem to think that they are probably consistent when they listen to his tone; The older it is, the more consistent it is. However, I am a little skeptical, because the easier it is to write, the easier it is to write consistent with the spoken language, but China is such a difficult hieroglyph to draw, perhaps our ancients have always removed unimportant words.《书经》有那么难读，似乎正可作照写口语的证据，但商周人的的确的口语，现在还没有研究出，还要繁也说不定的。至于周秦古书，虽然作者也用一点他本地的方言，而文字大致相类，即使和口语还相近罢，用的也是周秦白话，并非周秦大众语。汉朝更不必说了，虽是肯将《书经》里难懂的字眼，翻成今字的司马迁，也不过在特别情况之下，采用一点俗语，例如陈涉的老朋友看见他为王，惊异道：“夥颐，涉之为王沉沉者”，而其中的“涉之为王”四个字，我还疑心太史公加过修剪的。
The Book of Documents is so difficult to read that it seems to be evidence of copying spoken language, but the true colloquial language of the Shang and Zhou people has not yet been studied, and it may be more complicated. As for the ancient books of Zhou and Qin, although the author also uses a little of his local dialect, and the text is roughly similar, even if it is close to the spoken language, it is also used in the vernacular of Zhou and Qin, not the popular language of Zhou and Qin. Not to mention the Han Dynasty, although Sima Qian, who was willing to translate the incomprehensible words in the "Book of Documents" into today's characters, only under special circumstances, he used a little proverb, such as Chen She's old friend saw him as the king and said in surprise: "Partner, Shezhi is the king of the king", and the four words "Shezhi is the king", I also suspect that Taishi Gong has trimmed it.那么，古书里采录的童谣，谚语，民歌，该是那时的老牌俗语罢。我看也很难说。中国的文学家，是颇有爱改别人文章的脾气的。最明显的例子是汉民间的《淮南王歌》，同一地方的同一首歌，《汉书》和《前汉纪》记的就两样。
Then, the nursery rhymes, proverbs, and folk songs collected in ancient books should be the old sayings of that time. I think it's hard to say. Chinese writers have a temper that loves to change other people's articles. 一面却是——一尺布，暖童童；一尺布，暖童童；
一斗粟，饱蓬蓬。 一斗粟，饱蓬蓬。 
兄弟二人不相容。 兄弟二人不相容。
比较起来，好像后者是本来面目，但已经删掉了一些也说不定的：只是一个提要。后来宋人的语录，话本，元人的杂剧和传奇里的科白，也都是提要，只是它用字较为平常，删去的文字较少，就令人觉得“明白如话”了。
In comparison, it seems that the latter is the original face, but some things have been deleted: just a summary. Later, the quotations of the Song people, the scripts, the miscellaneous dramas of the Yuan people and the science and white in the legends were also summarized, but the words used were more ordinary, and the deleted words were less, which made people feel "as clear as words".我的臆测，是以为中国的言文，一向就并不一致的，大原因便是字难写，只好节省些。当时的口语的摘要，是古人的文；古代的口语的摘要，是后人的古文。所以我们的做古文，是在用了已经并不象形的象形字，未必一定谐声的谐声字，在纸上描出今人谁也不说，懂的也不多的，古人的口语的摘要来。你想，这难不难呢？
My guess is that Chinese Chinese has always been inconsistent, and the main reason is that the words are difficult to write, so I have to save some money. The summary of the colloquial language at that time was the text of the ancients; The summary of ancient colloquial language is the ancient text of later generations. Therefore, when we make ancient texts, we are using hieroglyphs that are no longer pictographic, and may not necessarily be harmonic, and depict on paper a summary of the colloquial language of the ancients that no one says or understands much. 六　于是文章成为奇货了

门外文谈

6. So the article became a rare commodity文字在人民间萌芽，后来却一定为特权者所收揽。据《易经》的作者所推测，“上古结绳而治”，则连结绳就已是治人者的东西。待到落在巫史的手里的时候，更不必说了，他们都是酋长之下，万民之上的人。社会改变下去，学习文字的人们的范围也扩大起来，但大抵限于特权者。至于平民，那是不识字的，并非缺少学费，只因为限于资格，他不配。而且连书籍也看不见。中国在刻版还未发达的时候，有一部好书，往往是“藏之秘阁，副在三馆”，连做了士子，也还是不知道写着什么的。
Writing sprouted among the people, but later it must have been taken over by the privileged. According to the author of the "I Ching", "the ancient knot was ruled", so the knot rope is already the thing of the ruler. When it comes to falling into the hands of Wu Shi, not to mention, they are all people under the chieftain and above the people. As society changed, the scope of people learning to write expanded, but it was largely limited to the privileged. As for the civilians, they are illiterate, not because they lack tuition, but because they are limited to qualifications, they are not worthy. And even books are not visible. When engraving was not yet developed in China, there was a good book, often "hidden in the secret pavilion, deputy in the third library", and even as a scholar, he still didn't know what was written.因为文字是特权者的东西，所以它就有了尊严性，并且有了神秘性。中国的字，到现在还很尊严，我们在墙壁上，就常常看见挂着写上“敬惜字纸”的篓子；至于符的驱邪治病，那就靠了它的神秘性的。文字既然含着尊严性，那么，知道文字，这人也就连带的尊严起来了。新的尊严者日出不穷，对于旧的尊严者就不利，而且知道文字的人们一多，也会损伤神秘性的。符的威力，就因为这好像是字的东西，除道士以外，谁也不认识的缘故。所以，对于文字，他们一定要把持。
Because words are the property of the privileged, they have dignity and mystery. Chinese characters are still very dignified, and we often see baskets hanging on the walls with the words "Respect and Cherishment Paper"; As for the exorcism of Fu and the cure of diseases, it depends on its mystery. Since words contain dignity, then, knowing words, this person also has dignity. The new dignity is rising endlessly, which is not good for the old dignity, and the more people who know the word, the more mysterious it will also be damaged. The power of the talisman is because it seems to be a word, and no one knows it except the Taoist priest. Therefore, for words, they must be controlled.欧洲中世，文章学问，都在道院里；克罗蒂亚（Kroatia），是到了十九世纪，识字的还只有教士的，人民的口语，退步到对于旧生活刚够用。他们革新的时候，就只好从外国借进许多新语来。
In the Middle Ages in Europe, literature and learning were all in Taoist temples; In Kroatia, in the nineteenth century, the literate people were still only the clergy, and the spoken language of the people regressed to just enough for the old life. When they innovated, they had to borrow many new words from foreign countries.我们中国的文字，对于大众，除了身分，经济这些限制之外，却还要加上一条高门槛：难。单是这条门槛，倘不费他十来年工夫，就不容易跨过。跨过了的，就是士大夫，而这些士大夫，又竭力的要使文字更加难起来，因为这可以使他特别的尊严，超出别的一切平常的士大夫之上。汉朝的杨雄的喜欢奇字，就有这毛病的，刘歆想借他的《方言》稿子，他几乎要跳黄浦。唐朝呢，樊宗师的文章做到别人点不断，李贺的诗做到别人看不懂，也都为了这缘故。还有一种方法是将字写得别人不认识，下焉者，是从《康熙字典》上查出几个古字来，夹进文章里面去；上焉者是钱坫的用篆字来写刘熙的《释名》，最近还有钱玄同先生的照《说文》字样给太炎先生抄《小学答问》。
Our Chinese writing, for the public, in addition to the restrictions of identity and economy, also has to add a high threshold: difficult. This threshold alone would not be easy to cross if it didn't take him more than ten years of work. It is the scholar-officials who have crossed over, and these scholars and officials try their best to make the words more difficult, because this can make him special dignity above all other ordinary scholars. Yang Xiong of the Han Dynasty liked strange words, and there was this problem, Liu Xin wanted to borrow his "Dialects" manuscript, and he almost jumped Huangpu. In the Tang Dynasty, Master Fan's articles were constantly pointed out by others, and Li He's poems were incomprehensible to others, all for this reason. There is also a way to write the words so that others do not know them, and the next one is to find out a few ancient characters from the "Kangxi Dictionary" and sandwich them into the article; The one who went on the Yan was Qian Qian, who used seal characters to write Liu Xi's "Explanation of Names", and recently Mr. Qian Xuantong copied the "Primary School Q&A" for Mr. Taiyan according to the words "Shuowen".文字难，文章难，这还都是原来的；这些上面，又加以士大夫故意特制的难，却还想它和大众有缘，怎么办得到。但士大夫们也正愿其如此，如果文字易识，大家都会，文字就不尊严，他也跟着不尊严了。说白话不如文言的人，就从这里出发的；现在论大众语，说大众只要教给“千字课”就够的人，那意思的根柢也还是在这里。
Words are difficult, articles are difficult, these are all original; On top of these, there are deliberately special difficulties for scholars and officials, but they still think that it is destined to be with the public, how can it be done? But the scholars and officials also hope that this is the case, if the words are easy to read, everyone will be able to do so, and the words will be not dignified, and he will also be disrespectful. those who speak vernacular is not as good as classical Chinese start from here; Now when it comes to popular language, it is said that the public only needs to teach people who are satisfied with the "thousand-character lesson", and the root of the meaning is still here.

七　不识字的作家

门外文谈

7. Illiterate writers用那么艰难的文字写出来的古语摘要，我们先前也叫“文”，现在新派一点的叫“文学”，这不是从“文学子游子夏”上割下来的，是从日本输入，他们的对于英文Literature的译名。会写写这样的“文”的，现在是写白话也可以了，就叫作“文学家”，或者叫“作家”。
The abstract of the ancient language written in such a difficult language was also called "Wen" before, and now the new school is called "Literature", which is not cut from "Literary Ziyu Zixia", but imported from Japan, their translation of English Literature. Those who can write such "literature" can now write in the vernacular, so they are called "writers" or "writers".文学的存在条件首先要会写字，那么，不识字的文盲群里，当然不会有文学家的了。然而作家却有的。你们不要太早的笑我，我还有话说。我想，人类是在未有文字之前，就有了创作的，可惜没有人记下，也没有法子记下。我们的祖先的原始人，原是连话也不会说的，为了共同劳作，必需发表意见，才渐渐的练出复杂的声音来，假如那时大家抬木头，都觉得吃力了，却想不到发表，其中有一个叫道“杭育杭育”，那么，这就是创作；大家也要佩服，应用的，这就等于出版；倘若用什么记号留存了下来，这就是文学；他当然就是作家，也是文学家，是“杭育杭育派”。不要笑，这作品确也幼稚得很，但古人不及今人的地方是很多的，这正是其一。就是周朝的什么“关关雎鸠，在河之洲，窈窕淑女，君子好逑”罢，它是《诗经》里的头一篇，所以吓得我们只好磕头佩服，假如先前未曾有过这样的一篇诗，现在的新诗人用这意思做一首白话诗，到无论什么副刊上去投稿试试罢，我看十分之九是要被编辑者塞进字纸篓去的。“漂亮的好小姐呀，是少爷的好一对儿！”什么话呢？
The condition for the existence of literature is to be able to write, so of course there will be no writers among the illiterate group. However, writers do. Don't laugh at me too early, I have something to say. I think that human beings created before writing, but unfortunately no one wrote it down, and there was no way to write it down. The primitive people of our ancestors, originally couldn't even speak, in order to work together, they had to express their opinions, so that they gradually practiced complex sounds, if everyone lifted the wood at that time, they all felt that it was difficult, but they couldn't think of publishing, one of them was called "Hang Yu Hang Yu", then this is creation; Everyone should also admire and apply, which is equivalent to publishing; If it is preserved with any mark, it is literature; Of course, he is a writer, a writer, and a "Hangyu Hangyu school". Don't laugh, this work is indeed very naïve, but there are many places where the ancients are inferior to today's people, and this is one of them. It is the first article in the "Book of Songs", so we have to kowtow in admiration, if there has never been such a poem before, the current new poet uses this meaning to make a vernacular poem, and no matter what supplement it is, I think nine out of ten will be stuffed into the paper basket by the editor. "Beautiful and good lady, they are a good couple for the young master!" What are you talking about?就是《诗经》的《国风》里的东西，好许多也是不识字的无名氏作品，因为比较的优秀，大家口口相传的。王官们检出它可作行政上参考的记录了下来，此外消灭的正不知有多少。希腊人荷马——我们姑且当作有这样一个人——的两大史诗，也原是口吟，现存的是别人的记录。东晋到齐陈的《子夜歌》和《读曲歌》之类，唐朝的《竹枝词》和《柳枝词》之类，原都是无名氏的创作，经文人的采录和润色之后，留传下来的。这一润色，留传固然留传了，但可惜的是一定失去了许多本来面目。到现在，到处还有民谣，山歌，渔歌等，这就是不识字的诗人的作品；也传述着童话和故事，这就是不识字的小说家的作品；他们，就都是不识字的作家。
It is the things in the "National Style" of the "Book of Songs", many of which are also illiterate anonymous works, because they are relatively good, and everyone has passed them down by word of mouth. The royal officials found it and recorded it as an administrative reference, and there were unknown numbers of those who were destroyed. The two great epics of the Greek Homer, which we will assume as such a person, were originally recited, but what exists are the records of others. From the Eastern Jin Dynasty to Qi Chen, the "Midnight Song" and "Reading the Song", and the Tang Dynasty's "Bamboo Branch Words" and "Willow Branch Words" were originally created by anonymous people, and were passed down after being collected and polished by scriptures. This polishing, of course, has been left behind, but unfortunately it must have lost a lot of its original face. Up to now, there are folk songs, folk songs, fishing songs, etc., which are the works of illiterate poets; fairy tales and stories are also told, which are the works of illiterate novelists; They are all illiterate writers.但是，因为没有记录作品的东西，又很容易消灭，流布的范围也不能很广大，知道的人们也就很少了。偶有一点为文人所见，往往倒吃惊，吸入自己的作品中，作为新的养料。旧文学衰颓时，因为摄取民间文学或外国文学而起一个新的转变，这例子是常见于文学史上的。不识字的作家虽然不及文人的细腻，但他却刚健，清新。
However, because there is no record of the work, it is easy to destroy, and the scope of circulation is not very wide, and there are very few people who know about it. Occasionally, when a little bit is seen by literati, they are often surprised and inhaled into their own works as new nourishment. When old literature declines, a new transformation occurs due to the ingestion of folk literature or foreign literature, which is common in literary history. Although the illiterate writer is not as delicate as the literati, he is strong and fresh.要这样的作品为大家所共有，首先也就是要这作家能写字，同时也还要读者们能识字以至能写字，一句话：将文字交给一切人。
For such works to be shared by everyone, first of all, the writer must be able to write, and at the same time, readers must be able to read and write, in a word: give the text to everyone.
