八　怎么交代？

门外文谈

8. How to explain?将文字交给大众的事实，从清朝末年就已经有了的。
The fact of handing over words to the public has existed since the end of the Qing Dynasty.“莫打鼓，莫打锣，听我唱个太平歌……”是钦颁的教育大众的俗歌；此外，士大夫也办过一些白话报，但那主意，是只要大家听得懂，不必一定写得出。《平民千字课》就带了一点写得出的可能，但也只够记账，写信。倘要写出心里所想的东西，它那限定的字数是不够的。譬如牢监，的确是给了人一块地，不过它有限制，只能在这圈子里行立坐卧，断不能跑出设定了的铁栅外面去。
"Don't play drums, don't play gongs, listen to me sing a peaceful song......" is a popular song issued by the emperor to educate the public; In addition, scholars and officials have also run some vernacular newspapers, but the idea is that as long as everyone can understand it, it does not necessarily have to be written. "Civilian Thousand Words Lesson" has a little possibility of writing, but it is only enough to keep accounts and write letters. If you want to write what you think, its limited number of words is not enough. For example, the prison does give people a piece of land, but it has restrictions, and they can only stand, sit and lie down in this circle, and they must not run out of the set iron fence.劳乃宣和王照他两位都有简字，进步得很，可以照音写字了。民国初年，教育部要制字母，他们俩都是会员，劳先生派了一位代表，王先生是亲到的，为了入声存废问题，曾和吴稚晖先生大战，战得吴先生肚子一凹，棉裤也落了下来。但结果总算几经斟酌，制成了一种东西，叫作“注音字母”。那时很有些人，以为可以替代汉字了，但实际上还是不行，因为它究竟不过简单的方块字，恰如日本的“假名”一样，夹上几个，或者注在汉字的旁边还可以，要它拜帅，能力就不够了。写起来会混杂，看起来要眼花。那时的会员们称它为“注音字母”，是深知道它的能力范围的。再看日本，他们有主张减少汉字的，有主张拉丁拼音的，但主张只用“假名”的却没有。再好一点的是用罗马字拼法，研究得最精的是赵元任先生罢，我不大明白。用世界通用的罗马字拼起来——现在是连土耳其也采用了——一词一串，非常清晰，是好的。但教我似的门外汉来说，好像那拼法还太繁。要精密，当然不得不繁，但繁得很，就又变了“难”，有些妨碍普及了。最好是另有一种简而不陋的东西。
Lao Naixuan and Wang Zhao both have simplified characters, and they have made great progress and can write according to the sound. In the early years of the Republic of China, the Ministry of Education wanted to make letters, both of them were members, Mr. Lao sent a representative, Mr. Wang was personal, in order to enter the sound of the problem of preservation and waste, he fought with Mr. Wu Zhihui, and Mr. Wu's stomach was sunken, and his cotton pants also fell. But the result was finally made into something called "phonetic alphabet" after several considerations. At that time, many people thought that they could replace Chinese characters, but in fact they still couldn't, because it was just a simple square character, just like the Japanese "kana", sandwiched with a few, or noted next to the Chinese characters, it was okay, and if you wanted it to be handsome, the ability was not enough. It will be mixed up and look dazzling. At that time, the members called it "phonetic alphabet" and knew the scope of its capabilities. Looking at Japan, some of them advocate reducing Chinese characters, some advocate Latin pinyin, but none advocate only using "kana". What's better is to use Roman characters to spell it, and the best study is Mr. Zhao Yuanren, I don't really understand. Spelling it in the world's common Roman characters - now even Turkey has adopted it - is very clear and good. But for a layman who teaches me, it seems that the spelling is still too complicated. To be precise, of course, it has to be complicated, but if it is very complicated, it will become "difficult" again, which will hinder its popularization. It is better to have something simple and not ugly.这里我们可以研究一下新的“拉丁化”法，《每日国际文选》里有一小本《中国语书法之拉丁化》，《世界》第二年第六七号合刊附录的一份《言语科学》，就都是绍介这东西的。价钱便宜，有心的人可以买来看。它只有二十八个字母，拼法也容易学。“人”就是Rhen，“房子”就是Fangz，“我吃果子”是Wo ch goz，“他是工人”是Ta shgungrhen。现在在华侨里实验，见了成绩的，还只是北方话。但我想，中国究竟还是讲北方话——不是北京话——的人们多，将来如果真有一种到处通行的大众语，那主力也恐怕还是北方话罢。为今之计，只要酌量增减一点，使它合于各该地方所特有的音，也就可以用到无论什么穷乡僻壤去了。
Here we can study the new "Latinization" method, there is a small book "Latinization of Chinese Calligraphy" in the "Daily International Anthology", and a "Speech Science" in the appendix of the sixth and seventh joint issue of the second year of "World", all of which are about this thing. The price is cheap, and those who are interested can buy it. It has only twenty-eight letters and is easy to learn. "People" is Rhen, "house" is Fangz, "I eat fruit" is Wo ch goz, "He is a worker" is Ta shgungrhen. Now in the experiment in overseas Chinese, the results are only Northern dialect. But I think there are still many people in China who speak northern dialect - not Beijing dialect, and if there is really a popular language that is popular everywhere in the future, then the main force will probably still be northern dialect. For now, as long as it is added or subtracted a little as appropriate to make it suitable for the unique sound of each place, it can be used in any poor and remote area.那么，只要认识二十八个字母，学一点拼法和写法，除懒虫和低能外，就谁都能够写得出，看得懂了。况且它还有一个好处，是写得快。美国人说，时间就是金钱；但我想：时间就是性命。无端的空耗别人的时间，其实是无异于谋财害命的。不过像我们这样坐着乘风凉，谈闲天的人们，可又是例外。
Then, as long as you know the twenty-eight letters and learn a little spelling and writing, anyone can write and understand it except for lazy people and imbeciles. Moreover, it has the advantage of being fast. Americans say that time is money; But I think: time is life. wasting other people's time for no reason is actually tantamount to making money and killing people. But people like us who sit and enjoy the wind and talk about leisure are an exception.

门外文谈

九　专化呢，普遍化呢？

门外文谈

9. What about specialization or universalization?到了这里，就又碰着了一个大问题：中国的言语，各处很不同，单给一个粗枝大叶的区别，就有北方话，江浙话，两湖川贵话，福建话，广东话这五种，而这五种中，还有小区别。现在用拉丁字来写，写普通话，还是写土话呢？要写普通话，人们不会；倘写土话，别处的人们就看不懂，反而隔阂起来，不及全国通行的汉字了。这是一个大弊病！
At this point, I encountered another big problem: the Chinese language is very different everywhere, and there are five kinds of northern dialect, Jiangsu and Zhejiang dialect, Lianghu Sichuan dialect, Fujian dialect, and Cantonese dialect, and among these five, there are small differences. Now write in Latin, Mandarin, or vernacular? To write Mandarin, people can't; If you write in the local dialect, people elsewhere will not understand it, but it will be estranged, and it will not be as good as the Chinese characters that are common throughout the country. This is a big drawback!我的意思是：在开首的启蒙时期，各地方各写它的土话，用不着顾到和别地方意思不相通。当未用拉丁写法之前，我们的不识字的人们，原没有用汉字互通着声气，所以新添的坏处是一点也没有的，倒有新的益处，至少是在同一语言的区域里，可以彼此交换意见，吸收智识了——那当然，一面也得有人写些有益的书。问题倒在这各处的大众语文，将来究竟要它专化呢，还是普通化？
What I mean is that in the beginning of the enlightenment period, each place wrote its own dialect, and there was no need to worry about the meaning of the other places. Before the Latin writing method, our illiterate people did not use Chinese characters to communicate with each other, so there was no disadvantage at all, but there was a new benefit, at least in the same language area, we could exchange opinions and absorb knowledge with each other - of course, someone had to write some useful books. The question is whether the popular language here and there will be specialized or generalized in the future?方言土语里，很有些意味深长的话，我们那里叫“炼话”，用起来是很有意思的，恰如文言的用古典，听者也觉得趣味津津。各就各处的方言，将语法和词汇，更加提炼，使他发达上去的，就是专化。这于文学，是很有益处的，它可以做得比仅用泛泛的话头的文章更加有意思。但专化又有专化的危险。言语学我不知道，看生物，是一到专化，往往要灭亡的。未有人类以前的许多动植物，就因为太专化了，失其可变性，环境一改，无法应付，只好灭亡。——幸而我们人类还不算专化的动物，请你们不要愁。大众，是有文学，要文学的，但决不该为文学做牺牲，要不然，他的荒谬和为了保存汉字，要十分之八的中国人做文盲来殉难的活圣贤就并不两样。所以，我想，启蒙时候用方言，但一面又要渐渐的加入普通的语法和词汇去。先用固有的，是一地方的语文的大众化，加入新的去，是全国的语文的大众化。
In the dialect vernacular, there are some meaningful words, which we call "refining words", which is very interesting to use, just like the classical Chinese use, and the listener also finds it interesting. Speaking in various dialects, further refining grammar and vocabulary, making him develop, is specialization. This is very beneficial to literature, and it can be more interesting than articles that only use general words. But specialization also has the danger of specialization. I don't know about linguistics, but looking at biology, once it becomes specialized, it often perishes. Many animals and plants before human beings lost their variability because they were too specialized, and the environment changed, unable to cope with them, and had to perish. ——Fortunately, we humans are not specialized animals, please don't worry. The masses have literature and want literature, but they must not sacrifice for literature, otherwise, his absurdity is no different from the living sages who want eight out of ten Chinese to be illiterate and martyred in order to preserve Chinese characters. Therefore, I think that during enlightenment, dialects are used, but on the other hand, ordinary grammar and vocabulary should be gradually added. The first use of the inherent is the popularization of the language of a place, and the addition of the new one is the popularization of the language of the whole country.几个读书人在书房里商量出来的方案，固然大抵行不通，但一切都听其自然，却也不是好办法。现在在码头上，公共机关中，大学校里，确已有着一种好像普通话模样的东西，大家说话，既非“国语”，又不是京话，各各带着乡音，乡调，却又不是方言，即使说的吃力，听的也吃力，然而总归说得出，听得懂。如果加以整理，帮它发达，也是大众语中的一支，说不定将来还简直是主力。我说要在方言里“加入新的去”，那“新的”的来源就在这地方。待到这一种出于自然，又加人工的话一普遍，我们的大众语文就算大致统一了。
The plan discussed by several scholars in the study is probably not workable, but everything is left to its course, but it is not a good way. Now on the dock, in public institutions, in universities, there is indeed something like Mandarin, everyone speaks, neither "Chinese", nor Beijing, each with their own local dialect, local dialect, but not dialect, even if it is difficult to speak, it is difficult to listen, but it is always possible to speak and understand. If it is sorted out and helped it develop, it is also one of the popular languages, and maybe it will be the main force in the future. I said to "add the new" in the tongue, and the source of the "new" is here. When this kind of natural and artificial language becomes commonplace, our popular language will be roughly unified.此后当然还要做。年深月久之后，语文更加一致，和“炼话”一样好，比“古典”还要活的东西，也渐渐的形成，文学就更加精采了。马上是办不到的。你们想，国粹家当作宝贝的汉字，不是化了三四千年工夫，这才有这么一堆古怪成绩么？
Of course, there is still to be done after that. After a long time, the language became more consistent, as good as "refining words", and things that were more alive than "classical" gradually took shape, and literature became more brilliant. It can't be done right away. Do you think that the Chinese characters that the quintessence of the national family regards as treasures have not been transformed into three or four thousand years of work, so there are so many strange achievements?至于开手要谁来做的问题，那不消说：是觉悟的读书人。有人说：“大众的事情，要大众自己来做！”那当然不错的，不过得看看说的是什么脚色。如果说的是大众，那有一点是对的，对的是要自己来，错的是推开了帮手。倘使说的是读书人呢，那可全不同了：他在用漂亮话把持文字，保护自己的尊荣。
As for the question of who you want to do, it goes without saying: it is an enlightened scholar. Some people say: "The public has to do the things of the public themselves!" "Of course that's good, but we have to see what kind of foot it's about. If we are talking about the public, then one thing is right, the right thing is to do it yourself, and the wrong thing is to push away the helper. If he is talking about a scholar, it is completely different: he is using beautiful words to control the words and protect his own honor.

十　不必恐慌

10. Don't panic但是，这还不必实做，只要一说，就又使另一些人发生恐慌了。
However, this does not have to be practiced, as long as it is said, it will cause panic among other people.首先，是说提倡大众语文的，乃是“文艺的政治宣传员如宋阳之流”，本意在于造反。给带上一顶有色帽，是极简单的反对法。不过一面也就是说，为了自己的太平，宁可中国有百分之八十的文盲。那么，倘使口头宣传呢，就应该使中国有百分之八十的聋子了。但这不属于“谈文”的范围，这里也无须多说。

Bringing a colored hat is a very simple opposition. However, on the other hand, for the sake of their own peace, it is better to have 80% illiterate in China. But this does not fall within the scope of "talk about literature", and there is no need to say more here.专为着文学发愁的，我现在看见有两种。一种是怕大众如果都会读，写，就大家都变成文学家了。这真是怕天掉下来的好人。上次说过，在不识字的大众里，是一向就有作家的。我久不到乡下去了，先前是，农民们还有一点余闲，譬如乘凉，就有人讲故事。不过这讲手，大抵是特定的人，他比较的见识多，说话巧，能够使人听下去，懂明白，并且觉得有趣。这就是作家，抄出他的话来，也就是作品。倘有语言无味，偏爱多嘴的人，大家是不要听的，还要送给他许多冷话——讥刺。我们弄了几千年文言，十来年白话，凡是能写的人，何尝个个是文学家呢？即使都变成文学家，又不是军阀或土匪，于大众也并无害处的，不过彼此互看作品而已。
Specifically for literature, I see two kinds now. One is afraid that if the public can read and write, everyone will become a writer. This is really a good person who is afraid of the sky falling. As I said last time, among the illiterate public, there have always been writers. I haven't been to the countryside for a long time, before, the farmers still had a little leisure, such as enjoying the shade, and someone would tell stories. However, this speaker is probably a specific person, he is more knowledgeable, skillful in speaking, can make people listen, understand, and find it interesting. This is the writer, copying his words, that is, the work. If there is a person who has tasteless language and prefers to talk a lot, everyone should not listen to him, and he will be given a lot of cold words - sarcasm. We have made thousands of years of literary Chinese, more than ten years of vernacular, all those who can write, why are they all writers? Even if they all become writers, they are not warlords or bandits, and they are not harmful to the public, but they just look at each other's works.还有一种是怕文学的低落。大众并无旧文学的修养，比起士大夫文学的细致来，或者会显得所谓“低落”的，但也未染旧文学的痼疾，所以它又刚健，清新。无名氏文学如《子夜歌》之流，会给旧文学一种新力量，我先前已经说过了；现在也有人绍介了许多民歌和故事。还有戏剧，例如《朝花夕拾》所引《目连救母》里的无常鬼的自传，说是因为同情一个鬼魂，暂放还阳半日，不料被阎罗责罚，从此不再宽纵了——
There is also a fear of the decline of literature. The public does not have the cultivation of old literature, and compared with the meticulousness of scholar-official literature, it may appear so-called "low", but it is not infected with the chronic diseases of old literature, so it is strong and fresh. Anonymous literature, such as "Midnight Song", will give old literature a new strength, as I have said before; Now there are also many folk songs and stories. There are also dramas, such as the autobiography of the impermanent ghost in "Mulian Saving the Mother" quoted in "Morning Flowers and Evening Pickup", saying that because he sympathized with a ghost, he was temporarily released to the sun for half a day, but he was punished by Yama and no longer indulged -“那怕你铜墙铁壁！
"Even if you are impregnable!那怕你皇亲国戚！……”
Even if you are a relative of the emperor! ……”何等有人情，又何等知过，何等守法，又何等果决，我们的文学家做得出来么？
How humane, how knowledgeable, how law-abiding, and so decisive, can our writers do it?这是真的农民和手业工人的作品，由他们闲中扮演。借目连的巡行来贯串许多故事，除《小尼姑下山》外，和刻本的《目连救母记》是完全不同的。其中有一段《武松打虎》，是甲乙两人，一强一弱，扮着戏玩。先是甲扮武松，乙扮老虎，被甲打得要命，乙埋怨他了，甲道：“你是老虎，不打，不是给你咬死了？”乙只得要求互换，却又被甲咬得要命，一说怨话，甲便道：“你是武松，不咬，不是给你打死了？”我想：比起希腊的伊索，俄国的梭罗古勃的寓言来，这是毫无逊色的。
This is the work of real farmers and handicraft workers, played by them in their spare time. Borrowing Mu Lian's parade to run through many stories, except for "The Little Nun Descending the Mountain", it is completely different from the engraved version of "Mu Lian Saving the Mother". Among them, there is a paragraph "Wu Song Fights the Tiger", which is two people, one strong and one weak, pretending to play. First of all, A pretended to be Wu Song, B pretended to be a tiger, and was beaten to death by A, B complained about him, A said: "You are a tiger, don't fight, didn't you bite you to death?" B had to ask for a swap, but he was bitten to death by A, and as soon as he complained, A said: "You are Wu Song, if you don't bite, won't you be beaten to death?" If you go to all parts of the country to collect, I am afraid there are many works of this kind. But naturally, there are disadvantages. It has always been blocked by difficult words and articles, and is isolated from modern trends. Therefore, if Chinese culture wants to rise together, it is necessary to advocate popular language, popular literature, and calligraphy must be Latinized.

11. The masses are not as stupid as scholars think但是，这一回，大众语文刚一提出，就有些猛将趁势出现了，来路是并不一样的，可是都向白话，翻译，欧化语法，新字眼进攻。他们都打着“大众”的旗，说这些东西，都为大众所不懂，所以要不得。其中有的是原是文言余孽，借此先来打击当面的白话和翻译的，就是祖传的“远交近攻”的老法术；有的是本是懒惰分子，未尝用功，要大众语未成，白话先倒，让他在这空场上夸海口的，其实也还是文言文的好朋友，我都不想在这里多谈。现在要说的只是那些好意的，然而错误的人，因为他们不是看轻了大众，就是看轻了自己，仍旧犯着古之读书人的老毛病。
However, this time, as soon as the popular language was proposed, some fierce generals took advantage of the situation to appear, and the origins were different, but they all attacked the vernacular, translation, Europeanized grammar, and new words. They all wear the banner of "the public" and say that these things are not understood by the public, so they can't do it. Some of them were originally remnants of classical Chinese, and the first to attack the vernacular and translation in front of them was the ancestral old spell of "distant friendship and close attack"; Some are lazy people, who have not worked hard, and who want the public to speak before they succeed, and let him praise Haikou in this empty field, in fact, they are still good friends of classical Chinese, and I don't want to talk about it here. Now I want to talk about only those well-intentioned, but wrong people, because they either underestimate the public or underestimate themselves, and still commit the old problems of ancient scholars.读书人常常看轻别人，以为较新，较难的字句，自己能懂，大众却不能懂，所以为大众计，是必须彻底扫荡的；说话作文，越俗，就越好。这意见发展开来，他就要不自觉的成为新国粹派。或则希图大众语文在大众中推行得快，主张什么都要配大众的胃口，甚至于说要“迎合大众”，故意多骂几句，以博大众的欢心。这当然自有他的苦心孤诣，但这样下去，可要成为大众的新帮闲的。
Scholars often look down on others, thinking that they can understand newer and more difficult words, but the public cannot understand them, so for the sake of the public, they must be completely swept away; Speaking and composing, the more vulgar, the better. As this opinion develops, he will unconsciously become a new nationalist. Or they hope that popular language will be promoted quickly among the public, advocating that everything should match the appetite of the public, and even saying that it should "cater to the public", deliberately scolding a few more words to win the favor of the public. Of course, this has his own painstaking efforts, but if this continues, he will become a new helper for the public.说起大众来，界限宽泛得很，其中包括着各式各样的人，但即使“目不识丁”的文盲，由我看来，其实也并不如读书人所推想的那么愚蠢。他们是要智识，要新的智识，要学习，能摄取的。当然，如果满口新语法，新名词，他们是什么也不懂；但逐渐的检必要的灌输进去，他们却会接受；那消化的力量，也许还赛过成见更多的读书人。初生的孩子，都是文盲，但到两岁，就懂许多话，能说许多话了，这在他，全部是新名词，新语法。他那里是从《马氏文通》或《辞源》里查来的呢，也没有教师给他解释，他是听过几回之后，从比较而明白了意义的。大众的会摄取新词汇和语法，也就是这样子，他们会这样的前进。所以，新国粹派的主张，虽然好像为大众设想，实际上倒尽了拖住的任务。不过也不能听大众的自然，因为有些见识，他们究竟还在觉悟的读书人之下，如果不给他们随时拣选，也许会误拿了无益的，甚而至于有害的东西。所以，“迎合大众”的新帮闲，是绝对的要不得的。
Speaking of the public, the boundaries are very broad, including all kinds of people, but even the "illiterate" illiterate, in my opinion, is not as stupid as scholars think. They want knowledge, new knowledge, learning, and ingestion. Of course, if the mouth is full of new grammar and new nouns, they don't understand anything; But gradually the necessary indoctrination is instilled, and they will accept it; The power of digestion may have surpassed that of more scholars. Newborn children are all illiterate, but by the age of two, they understand many words and can speak many words, which is all new nouns and new grammar for him. He looked it up from "Ma's Wentong" or "Etymology", and there was no teacher to explain it to him, he understood the meaning from comparison after listening to it several times. The masses will acquire new vocabulary and grammar, and that's how they will move forward. Therefore, although the propositions of the new nationalist faction seem to be conceived for the public, they have actually fulfilled the task of holding back. However, we cannot listen to the nature of the public, because there are some insights, they are still under the enlightened scholars, and if they are not selected at any time, they may mistakenly take things that are useless or even harmful. Therefore, the new helper who "caters to the public" is absolutely necessary.由历史所指示，凡有改革，最初，总是觉悟的智识者的任务。但这些智识者，却必须有研究，能思索，有决断，而且有毅力。他也用权，却不是骗人，他利导，却并非迎合。他不看轻自己，以为是大家的戏子，也不看轻别人，当作自己的喽罗。他只是大众中的一个人，我想，这才可以做大众的事业。
As instructed by history, whenever there is a reform, it is always the task of the enlightened intellectuals at the beginning. But these intellectuals must have research, thinking, decision, and perseverance. He also uses power, but he is not deceiving, he is guiding, but he is not pandering. He doesn't look down on himself, thinking that he is everyone's actor, and he doesn't look down on others, as his own minions. He is just one of the public, and I think this is the only way to do the cause of the public.

中国语文的新生

中国语文的新生

中国语文的新生

Freshman in Chinese and Chinese中国现在的所谓中国字和中国文，已经不是中国大家的东西了。
China's current so-called Chinese characters and Chinese characters are no longer the property of all Chinese people.古时候，无论那一国，能用文字的原是只有少数的人的，但到现在，教育普及起来，凡是称为文明国者，文字已为大家所公有。但我们中国，识字的却大概只占全人口的十分之二，能作文的当然还要少。这还能说文字和我们大家有关系么？
In ancient times, no matter which country, only a few people could use writing, but now, education has become popular, and all those who are called civilized countries have written written in the public domain. But in China, literacy only accounts for about two-tenths of the total population, and of course there are even fewer who can write. Can this still be said to have anything to do with all of us?也许有人要说，这十分之二的特别国民，是怀抱着中国文化，代表着中国大众的。我觉得这话并不对。这样的少数，并不足以代表中国人。正如中国人中，有吃燕窝鱼翅的人，有卖红丸的人，有拿回扣的人，但不能因此就说一切中国人，都在吃燕窝鱼翅，卖红丸，拿回扣一样。要不然，一个郑孝胥，真可以把全副“王道”挑到满洲去。
Some people may say that these two-tenths of the special citizens embrace Chinese culture and represent the Chinese public. I don't think that's right. Such a minority is not enough to represent the Chinese. Just as among the Chinese, there are people who eat bird's nest shark fins, people who sell red pills, and people who get kickbacks, but it cannot be said that all Chinese people are eating bird's nest shark fins, selling red pills, and getting kickbacks. Otherwise, a Zheng Xiaoxu can really pick the full "royal road" to Manchuria.我们倒应该以最大多数为根据，说中国现在等于并没有文字。
We should take the majority as the basis that China now has no writing.这样的一个连文字也没有的国度，是在一天一天的坏下去了。我想，这可以无须我举例。
Such a country without even words is getting worse day by day. I think this can be done without me giving an example.单在没有文字这一点上，智识者是早就感到模胡的不安的。清末的办白话报，五四时候的叫“文学革命”，就为此。但还只知道了文章难，没有悟出中国等于并没有文字。今年的提倡复兴文言文，也为此，他明知道现在的机关枪是利器，却因历来偷懒，未曾振作，临危又想侥幸，就只好梦想大刀队成事了。
In the absence of words alone, the intellectuals have long felt uneasy. The vernacular newspaper at the end of the Qing Dynasty was called the "Literary Revolution" during the May Fourth period, and it was for this reason. But I only know that the article is difficult, and I don't realize that China is equivalent to no writing. This year's advocacy of the revival of classical Chinese, and for this reason, he knew that the current machine gun was a sharp weapon, but because he had always been lazy, he had not cheered up, and he wanted to take a chance in the face of danger, so he had to dream of the big knife team to succeed.大刀队的失败已经显然，只有两年，已没有谁来打九十九把钢刀去送给军队。但文言队的显出不中用来，是很慢，很隐的，它还有寿命。
The defeat of the Dadao team has been obvious, only two years, and no one has come to fight ninety-nine steel knives to give to the army. But the appearance of the literary language team is not useful, it is very slow and hidden, and it still has a lifespan.和提倡文言文的开倒车相反，是目前的大众语文的提倡，但也还没有碰到根本的问题：中国等于并没有文字。待到拉丁化的提议出现，这才抓住了解决问题的紧要关键。
Contrary to the reversal of advocating classical Chinese, it is the current advocacy of popular language, but it has not yet encountered the fundamental problem: China is equivalent to no writing. It was not until the proposal of Latinization appeared that the key to solving the problem was grasped.反对，当然大大的要有的，特殊人物的成规，动他不得。格理莱倡地动说，达尔文说进化论，摇动了宗教，道德的基础，被攻击原是毫不足怪的；但哈飞发见了血液在人身中环流，这和一切社会制度有什么关系呢，却也被攻击了一世。然而结果怎样？结果是：血液在人身中环流！
Opposition, of course, is very important, and the conventions of special characters cannot be moved. Gregory advocated the theory of earth movement, and Darwin's theory of evolution shook the foundations of religion and morality, and it is not surprising that they were attacked; But Ha Feifa saw blood circulating in the human body, what does this have to do with all social systems, but he was also attacked for a lifetime. But what was the result? The result: blood circulates through the human body!中国人要在这世界上生存，那些识得《十三经》的名目的学者，“灯红”会对“酒绿”的文人，并无用处，却全靠大家的切实的智力，是明明白白的。那么，倘要生存，首先就必须除去阻碍传布智力的结核：非语文和方块字。如果不想大家来给旧文字做牺牲，就得牺牲掉旧文字。走那一面呢，这并非如冷笑家所指摘，只是拉丁化提倡者的成败，乃是关于中国大众的存亡的。要得实证，我看也不必等候怎么久。
If the Chinese want to survive in this world, those scholars who know the name of the "Thirteen Classics" will be useless to the literati who are "wine green", but it is clear that it depends on everyone's practical intelligence. If we are to survive, then, we must first get rid of the tubercles that hinder the spread of intelligence: non-verbal and square words. If you don't want everyone to sacrifice the old text, you have to sacrifice the old text. On the other hand, this is not as the cynics pointed out, but the success or failure of the Latinization advocates, but about the survival of the Chinese public. If you want to get empirical evidence, I don't think you need to wait long.至于拉丁化的较详的意见，我是大体和《自由谈》连载的华圉作《门外文谈》相近的，这里不多说。我也同意于一切冷笑家所冷嘲的大众语的前途的艰难；但以为即使艰难，也还要做；愈艰难，就愈要做。改革，是向来没有一帆风顺的，冷笑家的赞成，是在见了成效之后，如果不信，可看提倡白话文的当时。
As for the more detailed opinions on Latinization, I am generally similar to Hua Yu's "Outside the Door Talk" serialized in "Free Talk", so I won't say much here. I also agree with the difficulty of the future of the popular language that all cynics scoff; But I thought that even if it was difficult, I still had to do it; The more difficult it is, the more you have to do it. Reform has never been smooth sailing, and the approval of the sneer is after seeing results, if you don't believe it, you can look at the time when the vernacular was advocated.九月二十四日。

中国人失掉自信力了吗

中国人失掉自信力了吗

中国人失掉自信力了吗

Have the Chinese lost their self-confidence?从公开的文字上看起来：两年以前，我们总自夸着“地大物博”，是事实；不久就不再自夸了，只希望着国联，也是事实；现在是既不夸自己，也不信国联，改为一味求神拜佛，怀古伤今了——却也是事实。
From the public text, it seems that two years ago, we always boasted that "the land is vast and the things are rich", which is a fact; Soon he stopped boasting, and only hoped for the League of Nations, which is also a fact; Now I neither praise myself nor believe in the League of Nations, but instead blindly pray to God and worship Buddha, nostalgic for the past and hurt the present - but it is also a fact.于是有人慨叹曰：中国人失掉自信力了。
So some people sighed: The Chinese have lost their self-confidence.如果单据这一点现象而论，自信其实是早就失掉了的。先前信“地”，信“物”，后来信“国联”，都没有相信过“自己”。假使这也算一种“信”，那也只能说中国人曾经有过“他信力”，自从对国联失望之后，便把这他信力都失掉了。
If we talk about this phenomenon, self-confidence has actually been lost a long time ago. I believed in "earth" and "things" before, and later in "League of Nations", but I never believed in "myself". If this is also a kind of "faith", it can only be said that the Chinese once had "Thak credibility", and since they were disappointed in the League of Nations, they have lost all this trustworthiness.失掉了他信力，就会疑，一个转身，也许能够只相信了自己，倒是一条新生路，但不幸的是逐渐玄虚起来了。信“地”和“物”，还是切实的东西，国联就渺茫，不过这还可以令人不久就省悟到依赖它的不可靠。一到求神拜佛，可就玄虚之至了，有益或是有害，一时就找不出分明的结果来，它可以令人更长久的麻醉着自己。
If he loses his trust, he will be suspicious, and once he turns around, he may be able to believe only in himself, but it is a new path, but unfortunately it gradually becomes mysterious. Belief in "land" and "things" is still a tangible thing, and the League of Nations is slim, but it can also make people realize the unreliability of relying on it. As soon as it comes to praying to God and worshiping Buddha, it can be mysterious and void, beneficial or harmful, and you can't find a clear result for a while, which can make people anesthetize themselves for a longer time.中国人现在是在发展着“自欺力”。
Chinese people are now developing "self-deception".“自欺”也并非现在的新东西，现在只不过日见其明显，笼罩了一切罢了。然而，在这笼罩之下，我们有并不失掉自信力的中国人在。
"Self-deception" is not a new thing now, it is just that it is becoming more and more obvious now, enveloping everything. However, under this shroud, we have Chinese people who have not lost their self-confidence.我们从古以来，就有埋头苦干的人，有拚命硬干的人，有为民请命的人，有舍身求法的人，……虽是等于为帝王将相作家谱的所谓“正史”，也往往掩不住他们的光耀，这就是中国的脊梁。
Since ancient times, we have had people who work hard, people who work hard, people who ask for the people's lives, and people who sacrifice themselves to seek the Dharma,...... Although it is equivalent to the so-called "official history" of the genealogy of emperors and generals, it often cannot hide their brilliance, which is the backbone of China.这一类的人们，就是现在也何尝少呢？他们有确信，不自欺；他们在前仆后继的战斗，不过一面总在被摧残，被抹杀，消灭于黑暗中，不能为大家所知道罢了。说中国人失掉了自信力，用以指一部分人则可，倘若加于全体，那简直是诬蔑。
Why are there so few people like this now? They have conviction and do not deceive themselves; They fought one after another, but one side was always destroyed, erased, and destroyed in the dark, and it was not known to everyone. It is okay to say that the Chinese have lost their self-confidence, and it is okay to refer to some people, but if it is applied to the whole, it is simply slanderous.要论中国人，必须不被搽在表面的自欺欺人的脂粉所诓骗，却看看他的筋骨和脊梁。自信力的有无，状元宰相的文章是不足为据的，要自己去看地底下。
To talk about Chinese, we must not be deceived by the self-deceptive powder on the surface, but look at his muscles and backbone. Whether or not there is self-confidence, the article of the champion prime minister is not sufficient, and you have to look at it for yourself.九月二十五日。
September 25th.

“以眼还眼”

“以眼还眼”

“以眼还眼”

"An eye for an eye"杜衡先生在“最近，出于‘与其看一部新的书，还不如看一部旧的书’的心情”，重读了莎士比亚的《凯撒传》。这一读是颇有关系的，结果使我们能够拜读他从读旧书而来的新文章：《莎剧凯撒传里所表现的群众》（见《文艺风景》创刊号）。
Mr. Du Heng reread Shakespeare's "Caesar's Biography" in "Recently, out of the mood of 'it is better to read an old book than to read a new book'". This reading is quite relevant, and as a result, we can read his new article from an old book: "The Masses in Shakespeare's Caesar" (see the first issue of "Literary Landscape").这个剧本，杜衡先生是“曾经用两个月的时间把它翻译出来过”的，就可见读得非常子细。他告诉我们：“在这个剧里，莎氏描写了两个英雄——凯撒，和……勃鲁都斯。……还进一步创造了两位政治家（煽动家）——阴险而卑鄙的卡西乌斯，和表面上显得那么麻木而糊涂的安东尼。”但最后的胜利却属于安东尼，而“很明显地，安东尼底胜利是凭借了群众底力量”，于是更明显地，即使“甚至说，群众是这个剧底无形的主脑，也不嫌太过”了。
This script, Mr. Du Heng "once translated it in two months", which shows that he read it very carefully. He told us: "In this play, Shakespeare describes two heroes - Caesar and ...... Brudus. …… Two politicians (demagogues) were further created - Cassius, who was insidious and despicable, and Antony, who seemed so numb and confused on the surface. But the final victory belonged to Antony, and "it is clear that Antony's victory relied on the strength of the masses", so it is even more obvious that even "it is not too much to say that the masses are the invisible masterminds of this drama".然而这“无形的主脑”是怎样的东西呢？杜衡先生在叙事和引文之后，加以结束——决不是结论，这是作者所不愿意说的——道——
But what kind of thing is this "invisible mastermind"? Mr. Du Heng concludes after the narrative and quotations - by no means a conclusion, which is what the author does not want to say - Tao -“在这许多地方，莎氏是永不忘记把群众表现为一个力量的；不过，这力量只是一种盲目的暴力。他们没有理性，他们没有明确的利害观念；他们底感情是完全被几个煽动家所控制着，所操纵着。……自然，我们不能贸然地肯定这是群众底本质，但是我们倘若说，这位伟大的剧作者是把群众这样看法的，大概不会有什么错误吧。这看法，我知道将使作者大大地开罪于许多把群众底理性和感情用另一种方式来估计的朋友们。至于我，说实话，我以为对这些问题的判断，是至今还超乎我底能力之上，我不敢妄置一词。……”
In many of these places, Shakespeare never forgot to present the masses as a force; However, this power is only a form of blind violence. They have no rationality, they do not have a clear concept of interests; Their underlying feelings are completely controlled and manipulated by several demagogues. …… Naturally, we cannot rashly affirm that this is the essence of the masses, but if we say that this great playwright views the masses in this way, there will probably be no mistake. I know that this view will greatly offend the author to many friends who estimate the rationality and feelings of the masses in another way. As for me, to be honest, I think that the judgment on these issues is still beyond my ability, and I dare not say a word. ……”杜衡先生是文学家，所以这文章做得极好，很谦虚。假如说，“妈的群众是瞎了眼睛的！”即使根据的是“理性”，也容易因了表现的粗暴而招致反感；现在是“这位伟大的剧作者”莎士比亚老前辈“把群众这样看法的”，您以为怎么样呢？“巽语之言，能无说乎”，至少也得客客气气的搔一搔头皮，如果你没有翻译或细读过莎剧《凯撒传》的话——只得说，这判断，更是“超乎我底能力之上”了。
Mr. Du Heng is a writer, so this article is very well done and very modest. Suppose you say, "Damn the masses are blind!" Even if it is based on "rationality", it is easy to incur disgust due to the roughness of the performance; Now it is "this great playwright" Shakespeare's old-timer "sees the masses this way", what do you think? If you haven't translated or read Shakespeare's "The Biography of Julius Caesar" - I have to say that this judgment is "beyond my ability".于是我们都不负责任，单是讲莎剧。莎剧的确是伟大的，仅就杜衡先生所绍介的几点来看，它实在已经打破了文艺和政治无关的高论了。群众是一个力量，但“这力量只是一种盲目的暴力。他们没有理性，他们没有明确的利害观念”，据莎氏的表现，至少，他们就将“民治”的金字招牌踏得粉碎，何况其他？即在目前，也使杜衡先生对于这些问题不能判断了。一本《凯撒传》，就是作政论看，也是极有力量的。
So we are not responsible, just talking about Shakespeare. Shakespeare is indeed great, and judging from the points introduced by Mr. Du Heng, it has really broken the high theory that literature and art have nothing to do with politics. The masses are a force, but "this power is only a blind violence." They have no rationality, they have no clear concept of interests", according to Shakespeare's performance, at least, they will smash the golden sign of "people's rule", let alone others? Even at present, Mr. Du Heng cannot judge these issues. A "Biography of Caesar", even if it is a political theory, is also very powerful.然而杜衡先生却又因此替作者捏了一把汗，怕“将使作者大大地开罪于许多把群众底理性和感情用另一种方式来估计的朋友们”。自然，在杜衡先生，这是一定要想到的，他应该爱惜这一位以《凯撒传》给他智慧的作者。然而肯定的判断了那一种“朋友们”，却未免太不顾事实了。现在不但施蛰存先生已经看见了苏联将要排演莎剧的“丑态”（见《现代》九月号），便是《资本论》里，不也常常引用莎氏的名言，未尝说他有罪么？将来呢，恐怕也如未必有人引《哈孟雷特》来证明有鬼，更未必有人因《哈孟雷特》而责莎士比亚的迷信一样，会特地“吊民伐罪”，和杜衡先生一般见识的。
However, Mr. Du Heng sweated for the author because of this, fearing that "it will greatly offend many friends who estimate the rationality and feelings of the masses in another way." Naturally, in Mr. Du Heng, this must be thought of, and he should cherish this author who gave him wisdom with the "Biography of Caesar". However, judging that kind of "friends" with certainty is too ignorant of the facts. Now not only has Mr. Shi Zhicun seen the "ugliness" of the Soviet Union to rehearse Shakespeare (see the September issue of "Modern"), but also in "Capital", doesn't he often quote Shakespeare's famous sayings and never say that he is guilty? In the future, I am afraid that if someone may not quote "Hamenret" to prove that there is a ghost, let alone someone who blames Shakespeare's superstition because of "Hamenret", he will specially "hang the people and punish the sins", and Mr. Du Heng will have the same knowledge.况且杜衡先生的文章，是写给心情和他两样的人们来读的，因为会看见《文艺风景》这一本新书的，当然决不是怀着“与其看一部新的书，还不如看一部旧的书”的心情的朋友。但是，一看新书，可也就不至于只看一本《文艺风景》了，讲莎剧的书又很多，涉猎一点，心情就不会这么抖抖索索，怕被“政治家”（煽动家）所煽动。那些“朋友们”除注意作者的时代和环境而外，还会知道《凯撒传》的材料是从布鲁特奇的《英雄传》里取来的，而且是莎士比亚从作喜剧转入悲剧的第一部；作者这时是失意了。为什么事呢，还不大明白。但总之，当判断的时候，是都要想到的，又未必有杜衡先生所豫言的痛快，简单。
Moreover, Mr. Du Heng's article is written for people who are in the same mood as him, because those who will see the new book "Literary and Art Landscape" are certainly not friends with the mood of "it is better to read an old book than to read a new book". However, when you read the new book, you won't just read one "Literary Landscape", there are many books about Shakespeare, and if you dabble a little, your mood will not be so shaky, for fear of being incited by "politicians" (agitators). In addition to paying attention to the author's time and environment, those "friends" will also know that the material of "Caesar" is taken from Brutsky's "Legend of Heroes", and it is the first part of Shakespeare's transition from comedy to tragedy; The author was frustrated at this time. I don't really understand why. But in short, when judging, you have to think about it, and it may not be as happy and simple as Mr. Du Heng predicted.单是对于“莎剧凯撒传里所表现的群众”的看法，和杜衡先生的眼睛两样的就有的是。现在只抄一位痛恨十月革命，逃入法国的显斯妥夫（Lev Shestov）先生的见解，而且是结论在这里罢——
The view of "the masses shown in Shakespeare's Julius Caesar" alone is different from Mr. Du Heng's eyes. Now only the opinion of Mr. Lev Shestov, who hated the October Revolution and fled to France, and the conclusion is here—“在《攸里乌斯·凯撒》中活动的人，以上之外，还有一个。那是复合底人物。那便是人民，或说‘群众’。莎士比亚之被称为写实家，并不是无意义的。无论在那一点，他决不阿谀群众，做出凡俗的性格来。他们轻薄，胡乱，残酷。今天跟在彭贝的战车之后，明天喊着凯撒之名，但过了几天，却被他的叛徒勃鲁都斯的辩才所惑，其次又赞成安东尼的攻击，要求着刚才的红人勃鲁都斯的头了。人往往愤慨着群众之不可靠。但其实，岂不是正有适用着‘以眼还眼，以牙还牙’的古来的正义的法则的事在这里吗？劈开底来看，群众原是轻蔑着彭贝，凯撒，安东尼，辛那之辈的，他们那一面，也轻蔑着群众。今天凯撒握着权力，凯撒万岁。明天轮到安东尼了，那就跟在他后面罢。只要他们给饭吃，给戏看，就好。他们的功绩之类，是用不着想到的。他们那一面也很明白，施与些像个王者的宽容，借此给自己收得报答。在拥挤着这些满是虚荣心的人们的连串里，间或夹杂着勃鲁都斯那样的廉直之士，是事实。然而谁有从山积的沙中，找出一粒珠子来的闲工夫呢？群众，是英雄的大炮的食料，而英雄，从群众看来，不过是余兴。在其间，正义就占了胜利，而幕也垂下来了。”（《莎士比亚〔剧〕中的伦理的问题》）
"The person who is active in Eurius Caesar, in addition to the above, there is one. That's a compound character. That is the people, or the 'masses'. It is not meaningless that Shakespeare is called a realist. No matter what point he is, he will never flatter the masses and make a vulgar character. They are frivolous, chaotic, and cruel. Today he followed Pembey's chariot, and tomorrow he shouted the name of Caesar, but after a few days, he was bewitched by the eloquence of his traitor Brudus, and then he agreed with Antony's attack and demanded the head of the red man Brudus. People often complain about the unreliability of the masses. But in fact, isn't there something here that applies the ancient law of justice of 'an eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth'? Splitting it open, the masses originally despised Pembe, Caesar, Anthony, Sina, and others, and their side also despised the masses. Caesar holds power today, long live Caesar. Tomorrow it's Anthony's turn, so follow him. As long as they give food and plays, that's fine. Their exploits and the like don't need to be thought of. They also understood that they would give some tolerance like a king to repay themselves. It is a fact that in the crowd of these vanity people, there are sometimes honest people like Brudus. However, who has the leisure to find a bead from the mountains of sand? The masses are the food for the hero's cannon, and the hero, from the perspective of the masses, is just an after-fun. In the meantime, justice prevails, and the curtain falls. ("Ethical Problems in Shakespeare's [Play]")这当然也未必是正确的见解，显斯妥夫就不很有人说他是哲学家或文学家。不过便是这一点点，就很可以看见虽然同是从《凯撒传》来看它所表现的群众，结果却已经和杜衡先生有这么的差别。而且也很可以推见，正不会如杜衡先生所豫料，“将使作者大大地开罪于许多把群众底理性和感情用另一方式来估计的朋友们”了。
Of course, this is not necessarily the correct opinion, and it is not often said that Stove is a philosopher or a writer. However, it is at this point that it is very clear that although the masses expressed in the "Biography of Caesar" are already so different from Mr. Du Heng. And it is also inferred that it will not be as Mr. Du Heng expected, "it will greatly offend many friends who estimate the rationality and feelings of the masses in another way."所以，杜衡先生大可以不必替莎士比亚发愁。彼此其实都很明白：“阴险而卑鄙的卡西乌斯，和表面上显得那么麻木而糊涂的安东尼”，就是在那时候的群众，也“不过是余兴”而已。
Therefore, Mr. Du Heng probably doesn't have to worry about Shakespeare. In fact, they understood each other: "Cassius, who is insidious and despicable, and Antony, who seems so numb and confused on the surface", even the masses at that time were "just afterfun".九月三十日。
September 30th.

说“面子”

说“面子”

说“面子”

Say "face"“面子”，是我们在谈话里常常听到的，因为好像一听就懂，所以细想的人大约不很多。
"Face" is something we often hear in conversations, because it seems to be understood as soon as we hear it, so there are probably not many people who think about it carefully.但近来从外国人的嘴里，有时也听到这两个音，他们似乎在研究。他们以为这一件事情，很不容易懂，然而是中国精神的纲领，只要抓住这个，就像二十四年前的拔住了辫子一样，全身都跟着走动了。相传前清时候，洋人到总理衙门去要求利益，一通威吓，吓得大官们满口答应，但临走时，却被从边门送出去。不给他走正门，就是他没有面子；他既然没有了面子，自然就是中国有了面子，也就是占了上风了。这是不是事实，我断不定，但这故事，“中外人士”中是颇有些人知道的。
But recently, these two sounds are sometimes heard from the mouths of foreigners, and they seem to be studying them. They thought that this matter was not easy to understand, but it was the program of the Chinese spirit, as long as they grabbed this, it was like pulling out the braids 24 years ago, and their whole body would follow. According to legend, in the pre-Qing Dynasty, foreigners went to the prime minister's office to ask for benefits, and a threat frightened the high-ranking officials to agree, but when they left, they were sent out through the side door. If you don't give him the main door, he has no face; Since he has no face, it is natural that China has face, that is, he has the upper hand. Whether this is true or not, I am not sure, but this story is known to many people among "Chinese and foreign people".因此，我颇疑心他们想专将“面子”给我们。
Therefore, I am quite suspicious that they want to give us "face".但“面子”究竟是怎么一回事呢？不想还好，一想可就觉得胡涂。它像是很有好几种的，每一种身份，就有一种“面子”，也就是所谓“脸”。这“脸”有一条界线，如果落到这线的下面去了，即失了面子，也叫作“丢脸”。不怕“丢脸”，便是“不要脸”。但倘使做了超出这线以上的事，就“有面子”，或曰“露脸”。而“丢脸”之道，则因人而不同，例如车夫坐在路边赤膊捉虱子，并不算什么，富家姑爷坐在路边赤膊捉虱子，才成为“丢脸”。但车夫也并非没有“脸”，不过这时不算“丢”，要给老婆踢了一脚，就躺倒哭起来，这才成为他的“丢脸”。这一条“丢脸”律，是也适用于上等人的。这样看来，“丢脸”的机会，似乎上等人比较的多，但也不一定，例如车夫偷一个钱袋，被人发见，是失了面子的，而上等人大捞一批金珠珍玩，却仿佛也不见得怎样“丢脸”，况且还有“出洋考察”，是改头换面的良方。
But what is "face" all about? It's okay if you don't want to, but you feel nonsense when you think about it. It seems to have several kinds, and each identity has a kind of "face", which is the so-called "face". There is a boundary between this "face", and if it falls below this line, it will lose face, which is also called "losing face". If you are not afraid of "losing face", you are "shameless". But if you do something beyond this line, you will "have face" or "show your face". For example, the coachman sits shirtless on the side of the road to catch lice, which is nothing, and the rich aunt sits shirtless on the side of the road to catch lice, which becomes "shameful". But the coachman is not without a "face", but at this time it is not considered a "loss", he has to kick his wife, and then he lies down and cries, which becomes his "shame". This "shameful" law also applies to superiors. In this way, it seems that there are more opportunities for "shame" for upper-class people, but not necessarily, for example, the coachman steals a money bag and is discovered, which is a loss of face, and the upper-class people fish for a batch of gold and jewels, but it seems that they are not necessarily so "embarrassed", and there is also "overseas inspection", which is a good remedy for a makeover.谁都要“面子”，当然也可以说是好事情，但“面子”这东西，却实在有些怪。九月三十日的《申报》就告诉我们一条新闻：沪西有业木匠大包作头之罗立鸿，为其母出殡，邀开“贳器店之王树宝夫妇帮忙，因来宾众多，所备白衣，不敷分配，其时适有名王道才，绰号三喜子，亦到来送殡，争穿白衣不遂，以为有失体面，心中怀恨，……邀集徒党数十人，各执铁棍，据说尚有持手枪者多人，将王树宝家人乱打，一时双方有剧烈之战争，头破血流，多人受有重伤。……”白衣是亲族有服者所穿的，现在必须“争穿”而又“不遂”，足见并非亲族，但竟以为“有失体面”，演成这样的大战了。这时候，好像只要和普通有些不同便是“有面子”，而自己成了什么，却可以完全不管。这类脾气，是“绅商”也不免发露的：袁世凯将要称帝的时候，有人以列名于劝进表中为“有面子”；有一国从青岛撤兵的时候，有人以列名于万民伞上为“有面子”。
Everyone wants "face", of course, it can be said to be a good thing, but "face" is really a bit strange. The "Declaration" on September 30 told us a piece of news: Luo Lihong, a carpenter in western Shanghai, was the head of the big bag, and invited Wang Shubao and his wife to help with the funeral of his mother,...... Dozens of people were invited to join the party, each holding an iron rod, and it is said that there were still many people with pistols, beating Wang Shubao's family indiscriminately, and there was a fierce war between the two sides for a while, with bloody heads and many serious injuries. ...... "White clothes are worn by relatives who have clothes, and now they must "fight to wear" and "fail", which shows that they are not relatives, but they think that they are "undignified", and it has evolved into such a war. At this time, it seems that as long as it is a little different from the ordinary, it is "face", but what you have become can be completely ignored. This kind of temper is inevitably revealed by "gentlemen and businessmen": when Yuan Shikai was about to become emperor, some people listed their names in the persuasion table as "face-saving"; When a country withdrew its troops from Qingdao, some people listed their names on the umbrella of all people as "having face".所以，要“面子”也可以说并不一定是好事情——但我并非说，人应该“不要脸”。现在说话难，如果主张“非孝”，就有人会说你在煽动打父母，主张男女平等，就有人会说你在提倡乱交——这声明是万不可少的。
Therefore, it can be said that "face" is not necessarily a good thing - but I am not saying that people should be "shameless". If you advocate "unfilial piety", some people will say that you are inciting to beat your parents, advocate equality between men and women, and some people will say that you are advocating promiscuity - this statement is indispensable.况且，“要面子”和“不要脸”实在也可以有很难分辨的时候。不是有一个笑话么？一个绅士有钱有势，我假定他叫四大人罢，人们都以能够和他扳谈为荣。有一个专爱夸耀的小瘪三，一天高兴的告诉别人道：“四大人和我讲过话了！”人问他“说什么呢？”答道：“我站在他门口，四大人出来了，对我说：滚开去！”当然，这是笑话，是形容这人的“不要脸”，但在他本人，是以为“有面子”的，如此的人一多，也就真成为“有面子”了。别的许多人，不是四大人连“滚开去”也不对他说么？
Moreover, it can be difficult to distinguish between "saving face" and "shamelessness". Isn't there a joke? A gentleman is rich and powerful, I assume he is called the Four Lords, and people are proud to be able to talk to him. There was a little deflated third who loved to boast, and one day he happily told others: "The four lords have spoken to me!" "What did he say?" He replied: "I stood at his door, and the four adults came out and said to me: Get away!" Of course, this is a joke, to describe this person's "shamelessness", but in himself, he thinks he has "face", and when there are so many people, he really becomes "face-saving". Many other people, didn't the four adults even "get away" and not say to him?在上海，“吃外国火腿”虽然还不是“有面子”，却也不算怎么“丢脸”了，然而比起被一个本国的下等人所踢来，又仿佛近于“有面子”。
In Shanghai, although "eating foreign ham" is not "face-saving", it is not very "embarrassing", but compared to being kicked by a low-class person in his own country, it seems to be close to "having face".中国人要“面子”，是好的，可惜的是这“面子”是“圆机活法”，善于变化，于是就和“不要脸”混起来了。长谷川如是闲说“盗泉”云：“古之君子，恶其名而不饮，今之君子，改其名而饮之。”也说穿了“今之君子”的“面子”的秘密。
It is good for Chinese to want "face", but unfortunately this "face" is a "round machine way of living" and good at change, so it is mixed with "shameless". Hasegawa said of "thieving springs": "The ancient gentlemen hated their names and did not drink, but today's gentlemen change their names and drink them." It also reveals the secret of the "face" of "today's gentleman".十月四日。
October 4th.

运命

运命

运命

Destiny有一天，我坐在内山书店里闲谈——我是常到内山书店去闲谈的，我的可怜的敌对的“文学家”，还曾经借此竭力给我一个“汉奸”的称号，可惜现在他们又不坚持了——才知道日本的丙午年生，今年二十九岁的女性，是一群十分不幸的人。大家相信丙午年生的女人要克夫，即使再嫁，也还要克，而且可以多至五六个，所以想结婚是很困难的。这自然是一种迷信，但日本社会上的迷信也还是真不少。
One day, I sat in the Uchiyama Bookstore and chatted - I often go to the Uchiyama Bookstore to chat, and my poor hostile "writer" used this to try his best to give me the title of "traitor", but unfortunately now they don't insist on it - only to realize that the 29-year-old woman born in Japan is a very unfortunate group. Everyone believes that women born in the year of Bingwu want to get married, even if they remarry, they still have to win, and there can be as many as five or six, so it is very difficult to get married. This is naturally a superstition, but there are still a lot of superstitions in Japanese society.我问：可有方法解除这夙命呢？回答是：没有。
I asked: Is there a way to relieve this fate? The answer is: no.接着我就想到了中国。
Then I thought of China.许多外国的中国研究家，都说中国人是定命论者，命中注定，无可奈何；就是中国的论者，现在也有些人这样说。但据我所知道，中国女性就没有这样无法解除的命运。“命凶”或“命硬”，是有的，但总有法子想，就是所谓“禳解”；或者和不怕相克的命的男子结婚，制住她的“凶”或“硬”。假如有一种命，说是要连克五六个丈夫的罢，那就早有道士之类出场，自称知道妙法，用桃木刻成五六个男人，画上符咒，和这命的女人一同行“结俪之礼”后，烧掉或埋掉，于是真来订婚的丈夫，就算是第七个，毫无危险了。
Many foreign Chinese scholars say that Chinese are fatalists and are destined and helpless; Even Chinese commentators say this now. But as far as I know, Chinese women do not have such an unsolvable fate. There are "fate" or "hard fate", but there is always a way to think, which is the so-called "exorcism"; Or marry a man who is not afraid of a conflicting fate to restrain her "fierce" or "hard". If there is a kind of fate, it is said that it is to conquer five or six husbands, then there have already been Taoist priests and the like, claiming to know the wonderful method, carving five or six men out of peach wood, drawing talismans, and walking with the woman of this life "marriage ceremony", burning or burying it, so the husband who really comes to get engaged, even if it is the seventh, is not in danger.中国人的确相信运命，但这运命是有方法转移的。所谓“没有法子”，有时也就是一种另想道路——转移运命的方法。等到确信这是“运命”，真真“没有法子”的时候，那是在事实上已经十足碰壁，或者恰要灭亡之际了。运命并不是中国人的事前的指导，乃是事后的一种不费心思的解释。
Chinese people do believe in fate, but there is a way to transfer this fate. The so-called "no way" is sometimes a way to think of another way - a way to change fate. When you are convinced that this is "fate" and that there is really "no way", it is when you have in fact hit a wall or are about to perish. Fate is not a Chinese guidance in advance, but a thoughtless explanation afterwards.中国人自然有迷信，也有“信”，但好像很少“坚信”。我们先前最尊皇帝，但一面想玩弄他，也尊后妃，但一面又有些想吊她的膀子；畏神明，而又烧纸钱作贿赂，佩服豪杰，却不肯为他作牺牲。崇孔的名儒，一面拜佛，信甲的战士，明天信丁。宗教战争是向来没有的，从北魏到唐末的佛道二教的此仆彼起，是只靠几个人在皇帝耳朵边的甘言蜜语。风水，符咒，拜祷……偌大的“运命”，只要化一批钱或磕几个头，就改换得和注定的一笔大不相同了——就是并不注定。
Chinese people naturally have superstitions and "beliefs", but they seem to have very few "firm beliefs". We respected the emperor the most before, but on the one hand, we wanted to play with him and respect the concubine, but on the other hand, we wanted to hang her arms; Fearing the gods, he burned paper money as a bribe, admired the heroes, but refused to sacrifice for him. The famous Confucian scholars who worship Confucius worship Buddha on the one hand, and the warriors who believe in armor believe in Ding tomorrow. Religious wars have never existed, and from the Northern Wei Dynasty to the end of the Tang Dynasty, the two religions of Buddhism and Taoism rose one after another, relying only on the sweet words of a few people in the emperor's ears. Feng Shui, charms, prayers...... The huge "fate", as long as you turn a batch of money or kowtow a few times, it will be very different from the destined sum - that is, it is not destined.我们的先哲，也有知道“定命”有这么的不定，是不足以定人心的，于是他说，这用种种方法之后所得的结果，就是真的“定命”，而且连必须用种种方法，也是命中注定的。但看起一般的人们来，却似乎并不这样想。
Our sages also knew that "destiny" was so uncertain that it was not enough to settle people's hearts, so he said that the result obtained after using various methods was really "destined", and even if it was necessary to use various methods, it was also destined. But ordinary people don't seem to think so.人而没有“坚信”，狐狐疑疑，也许并不是好事情，因为这也就是所谓“无特操”。但我以为信运命的中国人而又相信运命可以转移，却是值得乐观的。不过现在为止，是在用迷信来转移别的迷信，所以归根结蒂，并无不同，以后倘能用正当的道理和实行——科学来替换了这迷信，那么，定命论的思想，也就和中国人离开了。
It may not be a good thing for people to be suspicious without "firm belief", because this is the so-called "no special operation". But I think that Chinese people who believe in fate and believe that fate can be transferred are worth being optimistic. But so far, it is using superstition to divert other superstitions, so in the final analysis, there is no difference, if this superstition can be replaced with legitimate reasoning and practice - science in the future, then the idea of fatalism will leave the Chinese.假如真有这一日，则和尚，道士，巫师，星相家，风水先生……的宝座，就都让给了科学家，我们也不必整年的见神见鬼了。
If there really is such a day, it will be monks, Taoists, shamans, astrologers, feng shui teachers...... The throne has been given to scientists, and we don't have to see gods and ghosts all year round.十月二十三日。
October 23.

脸谱臆测

脸谱臆测

脸谱臆测

Facebook speculation对于戏剧，我完全是外行。但遇到研究中国戏剧的文章，有时也看一看。近来的中国戏是否象征主义，或中国戏里有无象征手法的问题，我是觉得很有趣味的。
When it comes to theater, I'm completely a layman. But when I encounter articles on Chinese drama, I sometimes read them. I find it interesting to see whether Chinese opera is symbolic or whether there are symbolic techniques in Chinese opera.伯鸿先生在《戏》周刊十一期（《中华日报》副刊）上，说起脸谱，承认了中国戏有时用象征的手法，“比如白表‘奸诈’，红表‘忠勇’，黑表‘威猛’，蓝表‘妖异’，金表‘神灵’之类，实与西洋的白表‘纯洁清净’，黑表‘悲哀’，红表‘热烈’，黄金色表‘光荣’和‘努力’”并无不同，这就是“色的象征”，虽然比较的单纯，低级。
In the eleventh issue of "Opera" Weekly (a supplement to "China Daily"), Mr. Bohong talked about Facebook and admitted that Chinese opera sometimes uses symbolic techniques, "such as the white table 'treachery', the red table 'loyalty and courage', the black table 'mighty', the blue table 'monster', the gold watch 'god', etc., which is actually no different from the Western white table 'pure and pure', the black table 'sad', the red watch 'warm', and the gold watch 'glorious' and 'hard work'", which is the "symbol of color", although it is relatively simple and low-level.这似乎也很不错，但再一想，却又生了疑问，因为白表奸诈，红表忠勇之类，是只以在脸上为限，一到别的地方，白就并不象征奸诈，红也不表示忠勇了。
This seems to be very good, but when I think about it again, I have doubts, because the white table is treacherous, the red table is loyal and brave, etc., it is only limited to the face, and once it goes to other places, white does not symbolize treachery, and red does not mean loyalty and bravery.对于中国戏剧史，我又是完全的外行。我只知道古时候（南北朝）的扮演故事，是带假面的，这假面上，大约一定得表示出这角色的特征，一面也是这角色的脸相的规定。古代的假面和现在的打脸的关系，好像还没有人研究过，假使有些关系，那么，“白表奸诈”之类，就恐怕只是人物的分类，却并非象征手法了。
For the history of Chinese drama, I am a complete layman. I only know that in ancient times (the Northern and Southern Dynasties), the acting story was masked, and this mask must probably indicate the characteristics of the character, and one side is also the regulation of the character's face. The relationship between the ancient mask and the current face slap seems to have not been studied yet, if there is some relationship, then the "white table treachery" is probably just a classification of characters, but not a symbolic technique.中国古来就喜欢讲“相人术”，但自然和现在的“相面”不同，并非从气色上看出祸福来，而是所谓“诚于中，必形于外”，要从脸相上辨别这人的好坏的方法。一般的人们，也有这一种意见的，我们在现在，还常听到“看他样子就不是好人”这一类话。这“样子”的具体的表现，就是戏剧上的“脸谱”。富贵人全无心肝，只知道自私自利，吃得白白胖胖，什么都做得出，于是白就表了奸诈。红表忠勇，是从关云长的“面如重枣”来的。“重枣”是怎样的枣子，我不知道，要之，总是红色的罢。在实际上，忠勇的人思想较为简单，不会神经衰弱，面皮也容易发红，倘使他要永远中立，自称“第三种人”，精神上就不免时时痛苦，脸上一块青，一块白，终于显出白鼻子来了。黑表威猛，更是极平常的事，整年在战场上驰驱，脸孔怎会不黑，擦着雪花膏的公子，是一定不肯自己出面去战斗的。
Since ancient times, China has liked to talk about "physiognomy", but naturally it is different from the current "physiognomy", not from the complexion to see the fortune and misfortune, but the so-called "sincerity in the middle, must be outside", to distinguish the good and bad of this person from the face. Ordinary people also have this kind of opinion, and we often hear words like "he doesn't look good". The specific manifestation of this "look" is the "face" in the drama. The rich and noble people have no heart and liver, they only know that they are selfish, eat for nothing, and can do anything, so they show treachery. The loyalty and courage of the red table comes from Guan Yunchang's "face like a heavy date". I don't know what kind of jujube "heavy jujube" is, but if you want, it's always red. In fact, a loyal and brave person is relatively simple-minded, will not have a nervous breakdown, and his face is easy to turn red, if he wants to be neutral forever and call himself a "third kind of person", he will inevitably suffer mentally from time to time, and his face will be blue and white, and finally a white nose will appear. The black watch is powerful, it is a very common thing, galloping on the battlefield all year round, how can the face not be black, the young master who wipes the alabaster paste, will definitely refuse to come forward to fight by himself.士君子常在一门一门的将人们分类，平民也在分类，我想，这“脸谱”，便是优伶和看客公同逐渐议定的分类图。不过平民的辨别，感受的力量，是没有士君子那么细腻的。况且我们古时候戏台的搭法，又和罗马不同，使看客非常散漫，表现倘不加重，他们就觉不到，看不清。这么一来，各类人物的脸谱，就不能不夸大化，漫画化，甚而至于到得后来，弄得希奇古怪，和实际离得很远，好像象征手法了。
Scholars and gentlemen often classify people one by one, and commoners are also classifying, I think this "face" is the classification map gradually agreed upon by the actors and spectators. However, the power of civilian discernment and feeling is not as delicate as that of a gentleman. Moreover, the way we set up the stage in ancient times was different from that of Rome, so that the audience was very loose, and if the performance was not aggravated, they would not feel it or see clearly. In this way, the faces of various characters cannot but be exaggerated and caricatured, and even later, they make it strange and far from reality, like a symbolic technique.脸谱，当然自有它本身的意义的，但我总觉得并非象征手法，而且在舞台的构造和看客的程度和古代不同的时候，它更不过是一种赘疣，无须扶持它的存在了。然而用在别一种有意义的玩艺上，在现在，我却以为还是很有兴趣的。
Of course, the face painting has its own meaning, but I always feel that it is not a symbolic technique, and when the structure of the stage and the degree of spectators are different from those of ancient times, it is just a wart, and there is no need to support its existence. However, when used in other meaningful plays, I think I am still very interested.十月三十一日。
October 31st.

随便翻翻

随便翻翻

随便翻翻

Whatever you want我想讲一点我的当作消闲的读书——随便翻翻。但如果弄得不好，会受害也说不定的。
I want to talk about my leisure reading - flip through it casually. But if you don't do it well, you may be harmed.我最初去读书的地方是私塾，第一本读的是《鉴略》，桌上除了这一本书和习字的描红格，对字（这是做诗的准备）的课本之外，不许有别的书。但后来竟也慢慢的认识字了，一认识字，对于书就发生了兴趣，家里原有两三箱破烂书，于是翻来翻去，大目的是找图画看，后来也看看文字。这样就成了习惯，书在手头，不管它是什么，总要拿来翻一下，或者看一遍序目，或者读几叶内容，到得现在，还是如此，不用心，不费力，往往在作文或看非看不可的书籍之后，觉得疲劳的时候，也拿这玩意来作消遣了，而且它也的确能够恢复疲劳。
The first place I went to study was a private school, and the first book I read was "Jianlue", and there were no other books on the table except this book and the red grid for Xi calligraphy, and the textbook for the word (this is the preparation for poetry). But then I slowly learned to understand the words, as soon as I knew the words, I became interested in books, and there were two or three boxes of tattered books at home, so I rummaged through them, the main purpose was to find pictures to read, and later also to look at the text. This has become a habit, the book is at hand, no matter what it is, you always have to take it to flip through it, or read the preface, or read a few leaves of content, until now, it is still like this, careless, effortless, often after composing or reading must-read books, when you feel tired, you also use this thing as a pastime, and it can indeed recover from fatigue.倘要骗人，这方法很可以冒充博雅。现在有一些老实人，和我闲谈之后，常说我书是看得很多的，略谈一下，我也的确好像书看得很多，殊不知就为了常常随手翻翻的缘故，却并没有本本细看。还有一种很容易到手的秘本，是《四库书目提要》，倘还怕繁，那么，《简明目录》也可以，这可要细看，它能做成你好像看过许多书。不过我也曾用过正经工夫，如什么“国学”之类，请过先生指教，留心过学者所开的参考书目。结果都不满意。有些书目开得太多，要十来年才能看完，我还疑心他自己就没有看；只开几部的较好，可是这须看这位开书目的先生了，如果他是一位胡涂虫，那么，开出来的几部一定也是极顶胡涂书，不看还好，一看就胡涂。
If you want to deceive people, this method can be pretended to be a liberal arts. Nowadays, some honest people, after chatting with me, often say that I read a lot of books, and after a little talk, I do seem to read a lot of books, but I don't know that just because I often flip through them, I don't read them carefully. There is also a secret book that is easy to get, which is the "Summary of the Bibliographic Catalogue of the Four Libraries", if you are still afraid of complexity, then the "Concise Catalogue" can also be done, which can be made into a book that you seem to have read many books. However, I have also used serious efforts, such as "Chinese studies", etc., I have asked my teacher for advice and paid attention to the bibliography opened by scholars. The results were not satisfactory. Some books are too open, and it takes more than ten years to read them, and I still suspect that he didn't read them himself; If he is a Hu Tu worm, then the few books that are opened must also be the best Hu Tu books, it's okay not to read them, and they are nonsense at a glance.我并不是说，天下没有指导后学看书的先生，有是有的，不过很难得。
I'm not saying that there are no gentlemen in the world who guide the younger generation to read books, there are, but they are rare.这里只说我消闲的看书——有些正经人是反对的，以为这么一来，就“杂”！“杂”，现在又算是很坏的形容词。但我以为也有好处。譬如我们看一家的陈年账簿，每天写着“豆付三文，青菜十文，鱼五十文，酱油一文”，就知先前这几个钱就可买一天的小菜，吃够一家；看一本旧历本，写着“不宜出行，不宜沐浴，不宜上梁”，就知道先前是有这么多的禁忌。看见了宋人笔记里的“食菜事魔”，明人笔记里的“十彪五虎”，就知道“哦呵，原来‘古已有之’。”但看完一部书，都是些那时的名人轶事，某将军每餐要吃三十八碗饭，某先生体重一百七十五斤半；或是奇闻怪事，某村雷劈蜈蚣精，某妇产生人面蛇，毫无益处的也有。这时可得自己有主意了，知道这是帮闲文士所做的书。凡帮闲，他能令人消闲消得最坏，他用的是最坏的方法。倘不小心，被他诱过去，那就坠入陷阱，后来满脑子是某将军的饭量，某先生的体重，蜈蚣精和人面蛇了。
Here I only say that I read books in my spare time - some serious people are against it, thinking that in this way, it will be "miscellaneous"! "Miscellaneous" is now a very bad adjective. But I thought there were benefits too. For example, if we look at a family's old account book, it is written every day that "beans pay three cents, vegetables ten cents, fish fifty cents, soy sauce one penny", and we know that the previous few dollars can buy a day's side dishes and eat enough for one family; Looking at an old calendar, it is written that "it is not suitable to travel, not to bathe, not to go on the beam", and you know that there were so many taboos before. When I saw the "Demon of Eating Vegetables" in the notes of the Song people and the "Ten Fierce Tigers" in the notes of the Ming people, I knew that "Oh, it turns out that 'there was already one in ancient times'." "But after reading a book, it was all anecdotes of celebrities at that time, a certain general had to eat thirty-eight bowls of rice at each meal, and a certain gentleman weighed one hundred and seventy-five and a half pounds; Or strange things, a certain village thunder struck the centipede spirit, and a certain woman gave birth to a human-faced snake, which was of no benefit. At this time, you have your own idea, knowing that this is a book made by an idle scribe. Whenever he helps, he can make people feel the worst, and he uses the worst methods. If you are not accidentally lured by him, you will fall into a trap, and then your mind will be full of a certain general's food, a certain gentleman's weight, centipede spirits and human-faced snakes.讲扶乩的书，讲婊子的书，倘有机会遇见，不要皱起眉头，显示憎厌之状，也可以翻一翻；明知道和自己意见相反的书，已经过时的书，也用一样的办法。例如杨光先的《不得已》是清初的著作，但看起来，他的思想是活着的，现在意见和他相近的人们正多得很。这也有一点危险，也就是怕被它诱过去。治法是多翻，翻来翻去，一多翻，就有比较，比较是医治受骗的好方子。乡下人常常误认一种硫化铜为金矿，空口是和他说不明白的，或者他还会赶紧藏起来，疑心你要白骗他的宝贝。但如果遇到一点真的金矿，只要用手掂一掂轻重，他就死心塌地：明白了。
If you have the opportunity to meet it, don't frown and show hatred, you can also turn it over; The same method is used for books that know are contrary to one's own opinion and books that are outdated. For example, Yang Guangxian's "Last Resort" was written in the early Qing Dynasty, but it seems that his thoughts are alive, and there are many people with similar opinions to him. This is also a bit dangerous, that is, I am afraid of being lured by it. The treatment method is to turn it over and over, and if you turn it over more, there will be a comparison, which is a good prescription for treating deception. Countrymen often mistake a copper sulfide for a gold mine, and the empty mouth is that he doesn't understand, or he will quickly hide it, suspecting that you want to lie to his treasure in vain. But if he encounters a real gold mine, as long as he weighs the weight with his hands, he will give up: I understand.“随便翻翻”是用各种别的矿石来比的方法，很费事，没有用真的金矿来比的明白，简单。我看现在青年的常在问人该读什么书，就是要看一看真金，免得受硫化铜的欺骗。而且一识得真金，一面也就真的识得了硫化铜，一举两得了。
"Casually rummaging" is a method of comparing various other ores, which is very troublesome, and it is not clear and simple to compare with real gold ores. I see that young people nowadays often ask people what books to read, that is, to look at real gold, so as not to be deceived by copper sulfide. And as soon as you know real gold, you really know copper sulfide, killing two birds with one stone.但这样的好东西，在中国现有的书里，却不容易得到。我回忆自己的得到一点知识，真是苦得可怜。幼小时候，我知道中国在“盘古氏开辟天地”之后，有三皇五帝，……宋朝，元朝，明朝，“我大清”。到二十岁，又听说“我们”的成吉思汗征服欧洲，是“我们”最阔气的时代。到二十五岁，才知道所谓这“我们”最阔气的时代，其实是蒙古人征服了中国，我们做了奴才。直到今年八月里，因为要查一点故事，翻了三部蒙古史，这才明白蒙古人的征服“斡罗思”，侵入匈奥，还在征服全中国之前，那时的成吉思还不是我们的汗，倒是俄人被奴的资格比我们老，应该他们说“我们的成吉思汗征服中国，是我们最阔气的时代”的。
But such good things are not easy to obtain in existing books in China. I recalled that I had gained a little knowledge, and it was really pitiful. When I was a child, I knew that China had three emperors and five emperors after "Pangu opened up the world",...... Song Dynasty, Yuan Dynasty, Ming Dynasty, "I am Qing". By the age of twenty, I heard that "our" Genghis Khan conquered Europe, which was the most generous era of "us". It wasn't until I was twenty-five years old that I realized that the so-called "we" were the most generous era, but in fact, the Mongols conquered China and we became slaves. It wasn't until August this year, because I wanted to check a little story, I turned over three Mongolian histories, and I understood that the Mongols conquered "Oros", invaded Hungary and Austria, and before conquering all of China, Genghis was not our Khan at that time, but the Russians were older than us.我久不看现行的历史教科书了，不知道里面怎么说；但在报章杂志上，却有时还看见以成吉思汗自豪的文章。事情早已过去了，原没有什么大关系，但也许正有着大关系，而且无论如何，总是说些真实的好。所以我想，无论是学文学的，学科学的，他应该先看一部关于历史的简明而可靠的书。但如果他专讲天王星，或海王星，虾蟆的神经细胞，或只咏梅花，叫妹妹，不发关于社会的议论，那么，自然，不看也可以的。
I haven't read the current history textbook for a long time, and I don't know what it says; But in newspapers and magazines, I sometimes see articles proud of Genghis Khan. Things have long passed, there is no big relationship, but maybe there is a big relationship, and no matter what, always say something really good. So I think that whether he is studying literature or science, he should first read a concise and reliable book about history. But if he specializes in Uranus, or Neptune, the nerve cells of the toad, or only sings about plum blossoms, calling his sister, and not discussing society, then, naturally, it is okay not to watch it.我自己，是因为懂一点日本文，在用日译本《世界史教程》和新出的《中国社会史》应应急的，都比我历来所见的历史书类说得明确。前一种中国曾有译本，但只有一本，后五本不译了，译得怎样，因为没有见过，不知道。后一种中国倒先有译本，叫作《中国社会发展史》，不过据日译者说，是多错误，有删节，靠不住的。
Personally, because I know a little Japanese, I am using the Japanese translation of "World History Tutorial" and the new "Chinese Social History" to deal with emergencies, which are clearer than the history books I have ever seen. The former has been translated in China, but there is only one, and the last five have not been translated, how it is translated, because I have not seen it, I don't know. The latter type of Chinese translation is called "History of Chinese Social Development", but according to the Japanese translator, it is full of errors, abridged, and unreliable.我还在希望中国有这两部书。又希望不要一哄而来，一哄而散，要译，就译他完；也不要删节，要删节，就得声明，但最好还是译得小心，完全，替作者和读者想一想。
I still hope that China has these two books. I also hope that they will not come and disperse, and if they want to translate, they will finish translating; Don't abridge, if you want to be abridged, you have to declare, but it's best to translate carefully, completely, and think about it for the author and the reader.十一月二日。
November 2nd.

拿破仑与隋那

拿破仑与隋那

拿破仑与隋那

Napoleon and Suina我认识一个医生，忙的，但也常受病家的攻击，有一回，自解自叹道：要得称赞，最好是杀人，你把拿破仑和隋那（Edward Jenner，1749—1823）去比比看……
I know a doctor who is busy but often attacked by his patients, and once he sighed to himself: If you want to praise, it is better to kill, you compare Napoleon and Sui Na (1749-1823) to Napoleon and Sui Na (1749-1823)......我想，这是真的。拿破仑的战绩，和我们什么相干呢，我们却总敬服他的英雄。甚而至于自己的祖宗做了蒙古人的奴隶，我们却还恭维成吉思；从现在的字眼睛看来，黄人已经是劣种了，我们却还夸耀希特拉。
I thought, it's true. What does Napoleon's achievements have to do with us, but we always admire his heroism. Even though our ancestors became slaves to the Mongols, we still compliment Genghis; From the current point of view, the yellow man is already an inferior species, but we still boast of Hitler.因为他们三个，都是杀人不眨眼的大灾星。
Because the three of them are all catastrophes that kill people without blinking.但我们看看自己的臂膊，大抵总有几个疤，这就是种过牛痘的痕迹，是使我们脱离了天花的危症的。自从有这种牛痘法以来，在世界上真不知救活了多少孩子，——虽然有些人大起来也还是去给英雄们做炮灰，但我们有谁记得这发明者隋那的名字呢？
But when we look at our arms, there are probably a few scars, which are traces of cowpox, which are the ones that have saved us from the critical condition of smallpox. Since this cowpox method, I really don't know how many children have been saved in the world,—— although some people still go to be cannon fodder for heroes when they grow up, but who remembers the name of this inventor Sui?杀人者在毁坏世界，救人者在修补它，而炮灰资格的诸公，却总在恭维杀人者。
The murderer is destroying the world, the savior is mending it, but the cannon fodder qualifications are always complimenting the murderer.这看法倘不改变，我想，世界是还要毁坏，人们也还要吃苦的。
If this view does not change, I think the world will still be destroyed, and people will still suffer.十一月六日。
November 6th.

答《戏》周刊编者信

答《戏》周刊编者信

答《戏》周刊编者信

Answer to the editor's letter of "Play" Weekly鲁迅先生鉴：
Mr. Lu Xun's view:《阿Q》的第一幕已经登完了，搬上舞台实验虽还不是马上可以做到，但我们的准备工作是就要开始发动了。我们希望你能在第一幕刚登完的时候先发表一点意见，一方面对于我们的公演准备或者也有些帮助，另方面本刊的丛书计划一实现也可以把你的意见和《阿Q》剧本同时付印当作一篇序。这是编者的要求，也是作者，读者和演出的同志们的要求。
The first act of "Ah Q" has been completed, and although it is not possible to do it on stage right away, our preparations are about to begin. We hope that you can express your opinions when the first act is just finished, on the one hand, it may be of some help to our performance preparations, and on the other hand, once the book series plan of this magazine is realized, you can also print your opinions and the script of "Ah Q" at the same time as a preface. This is the request of the editor, as well as the author, readers and comrades of the performance.祝健！
Good luck!编者。
Editor.编辑先生——
Mr. Editor——在《戏》周刊上给我的公开信，我早看见了；后来又收到邮寄的一张周刊，我知道这大约是在催促我的答复。对于戏剧，我是毫无研究的，我的最可靠的答复，是一声也不响。但如果先生和读者们都肯豫先了解我不过是一个外行人的随便谈谈，那么，我自然也不妨说一点我个人的意见。
I have already seen the open letter given to me in the weekly "Drama" magazine; Later, I received a weekly magazine in the mail, which I knew was probably urging me to answer. I have no research on drama, and my most reliable answer is that it is silent. But if you and the readers are willing to understand that I am just a layman, then I might as well say a little of my personal opinion.《阿Q》在每一期里，登得不多，每期相隔又有六天，断断续续的看过，也陆陆续续的忘记了。现在回忆起来，只记得那编排，将《呐喊》中的另外的人物也插进去，以显示未庄或鲁镇的全貌的方法，是很好的。但阿Q所说的绍兴话，我却有许多地方看不懂。
"Ah Q" did not appear much in each issue, and there were six days between each issue. Looking back now, I only remember the arrangement, and the method of inserting other characters in "The Scream" to show the whole picture of Weizhuang or Luzhen is very good. But there are many things I can't understand about the Shaoxing dialect spoken by Ah Q.现在我自己想说几句的，有两点——
Now I want to say a few words myself, there are two points -一，未庄在那里？《阿Q》的编者已经决定：在绍兴。我是绍兴人，所写的背景又是绍兴的居多，对于这决定，大概是谁都同意的。但是，我的一切小说中，指明着某处的却少得很。中国人几乎都是爱护故乡，奚落别处的大英雄，阿Q也很有这脾气。那时我想，假如写一篇暴露小说，指定事情是出在某处的罢，那么，某处人恨得不共戴天，非某处人却无异隔岸观火，彼此都不反省，一班人咬牙切齿，一班人却飘飘然，不但作品的意义和作用完全失掉了，还要由此生出无聊的枝节来，大家争一通闲气——《闲话扬州》是最近的例子。为了医病，方子上开人参，吃法不好，倒落得满身浮肿，用萝卜子来解，这才恢复了先前一样的瘦，人参白买了，还空空的折贴了萝卜子。人名也一样，古今文坛消息家，往往以为有些小说的根本是在报私仇，所以一定要穿凿书上的谁，就是实际上的谁。为免除这些才子学者们的白费心思，另生枝节起见，我就用“赵太爷”，“钱大爷”，是《百家姓》上最初的两个字；至于阿Q的姓呢，谁也不十分了然。但是，那时还是发生了谣言。还有排行，因为我是长男，下有两个兄弟，为豫防谣言家的毒舌起见，我的作品中的坏脚色，是没有一个不是老大，或老四，老五的。
1. Where is Weizhuang? The editor of "Ah Q" has decided: in Shaoxing. I am from Shaoxing, and the background of what I write is mostly Shaoxing, and probably everyone agrees with this decision. However, in all my novels, there are very few that point to somewhere. Chinese almost always love their hometown and ridicule the big heroes elsewhere, and Ah Q also has this temper. At that time, I thought that if I wrote an exposé novel and specified that something was somewhere, then people somewhere hated each other, and people who were not from somewhere were no different from watching the fire from the other side, without reflecting on each other, a group of people gritted their teeth, and a group of people were fluttering, not only the meaning and role of the work were completely lost, but also boring branches were born from it, and everyone was idle - "Gossip Yangzhou" is a recent example. In order to treat the disease, the prescription prescribed ginseng, the way to eat it was not good, and the body was swollen, and the radish seeds were used to solve it, so that the same thinness as before was restored. The same goes for people's names, ancient and modern literary informants often think that some novels are basically avenging personal revenge, so they must pierce the whoever is in the book, who is actually who. In order to avoid the waste of these talented scholars and for the sake of other branches, I used "Mr. Zhao" and "Uncle Qian", which are the first two words on "Hundred Family Surnames"; As for Ah Q's surname, no one is very clear. However, rumors still arose at that time. There is also a ranking, because I am the eldest son, and I have two brothers, in order to prevent the poisonous tongue of the rumors, there is no bad character in my works that is not the boss, or the fourth or fifth.上面所说那样的苦心，并非我怕得罪人，目的是在消灭各种无聊的副作用，使作品的力量较能集中，发挥得更强烈。果戈理作《巡按使》，使演员直接对看客道：“你们笑自己！”（奇怪的是中国的译本，却将这极要紧的一句删去了。）我的方法是在使读者摸不着在写自己以外的谁，一下子就推诿掉，变成旁观者，而疑心到像是写自己，又像是写一切人，由此开出反省的道路。但我看历来的批评家，是没有一个注意到这一点的。这回编者的对于主角阿Q所说的绍兴话，取了这样随手胡调的态度，我看他的眼睛也是为俗尘所蔽的。
The painstaking work mentioned above is not that I am afraid of offending people, but that the purpose is to eliminate all kinds of boring side effects, so that the power of the work can be concentrated and exerted more intensely. Gogol wrote "The Inspector", so that the actor said directly to the audience: "You laugh at yourself!" (Strangely, the Chinese translation deleted this extremely important sentence.) My method is to make the reader confuse who is writing about himself, and suddenly shirk and become a bystander, and become suspicious as if he is writing about himself and everyone, thus opening the way for introspection. But I think none of the critics in history have noticed this. This time, the editor took such a casual attitude towards the Shaoxing words spoken by the protagonist Ah Q, and I saw that his eyes were also blinded by the world.但是，指定了绍兴也好。于是跟着起来的是第二个问题——
However, it is also good to designate Shaoxing. So the second question came up -二，阿Q该说什么话？这似乎无须问，阿Q一生的事情既然出在绍兴，他当然该说绍兴话。但是第三个疑问接着又来了——
Second, what should Ah Q say? This seems to be unnecessary, since Ah Q's life is in Shaoxing, of course he should speak Shaoxing dialect. But the third question then came -三，《阿Q》是演给那里的人们看的？倘是演给绍兴人看的，他得说绍兴话无疑。绍兴戏文中，一向是官员秀才用官话，堂倌狱卒用土话的，也就是生，旦，净大抵用官话，丑用土话。我想，这也并非全为了用这来区别人的上下，雅俗，好坏，还有一个大原因，是警句或炼话，讥刺和滑稽，十之九是出于下等人之口的，所以他必用土话，使本地的看客们能够彻底的了解。那么，这关系之重大，也就可想而知了。其实，倘使演给绍兴的人们看，别的脚色也大可以用绍兴话，因为同是绍兴话，所谓上等人和下等人说的也并不同，大抵前者句子简，语助词和感叹词少，后者句子长，语助词和感叹词多，同一意思的一句话，可以冗长到一倍。但如演给别处的人们看，这剧本的作用却减弱，或者简直完全消失了。据我所留心观察，凡有自以为深通绍兴话的外县人，他大抵是像目前标点明人小品的名人一样，并不怎么懂得的；至于北方或闽粤人，我恐怕他听了之后，不会比听外国马戏里的打诨更有所得。
3. Was "Ah Q" performed for the people there? If it is performed for Shaoxing people, he has to speak Shaoxing without a doubt. In Shaoxing dramas, officials and scholars have always used official language, and cousins and jailers used local language, that is, sheng, dan, net mostly used official language, and ugly used local language. I think this is not all to distinguish between people's upper and lower, elegant and vulgar, good and bad, and there is another big reason, it is aphorisms or refined words, sarcasm and funny, and nine out of ten are from the mouths of inferior people, so he must use the vernacular dialect so that the local spectators can understand it thoroughly. Then, the importance of this relationship can be imagined. In fact, if it is shown to the people of Shaoxing, other characters can also use Shaoxing dialect, because it is the same Shaoxing dialect, the so-called superior and inferior people say differently, probably the former sentence is simple, there are few particles and interjections, the latter sentence is long, there are many particles and interjections, and a sentence with the same meaning can be twice as long. But if you show it to people elsewhere, the role of the script is weakened, or it simply disappears altogether. According to my careful observation, anyone from another county who thinks he is well versed in Shaoxing dialect is probably like the celebrities who currently mark people's sketches, and they don't know much about it; As for the northerners or Fujian and Cantonese, I am afraid that after listening to it, he will not gain more than listening to the jokes in foreign circuses.我想，普遍，永久，完全，这三件宝贝，自然是了不得的，不过也是作家的棺材钉，会将他钉死。譬如现在的中国，要编一本随时随地，无不可用的剧本，其实是不可能的，要这样编，结果就是编不成。所以我以为现在的办法，只好编一种对话都是比较的容易了解的剧本，倘在学校之类这些地方扮演，可以无须改动，如果到某一省县，某一乡村里面去，那么，这本子就算是一个底本，将其中的说白都改为当地的土话，不但语言，就是背景，人名，也都可变换，使看客觉得更加切实。譬如罢，如果这演剧之处并非水村，那么，航船可以化为大车，七斤也可以叫作“小辫儿”的。
I think that universal, permanent, and complete, these three treasures are naturally amazing, but they are also the coffin nails of the writer, and they will nail him to death. For example, in China today, it is actually impossible to compile a script that is available anytime and anywhere. If you go to a certain province, county, or village, then even if this book is a base book, the words in it are changed to the local dialect, not only the language, but also the background, the names of the people, can also be changed, so that the audience feels more real. For example, if the place of the play is not a water village, then the ship can be turned into a big car, and the seven pounds can also be called "pigtails".我的意见说完了，总括一句，不过是说，这剧本最好是不要专化，却使大家可以活用。
My opinion is over, but it is better not to be specialized, but to make it available to everyone.临末还有一点尾巴，当然决没有叭儿君的尾巴的有趣。这是我十分抱歉的，不过还是非说不可。记得几个月之前，曾经回答过一个朋友的关于大众语的质问，这信后来被发表在《社会月报》上了，末了是杨人先生的一篇文章。一位绍伯先生就在《火炬》上说我已经和杨人先生调和，并且深深的感慨了一番中国人之富于调和性。这一回，我的这一封信，大约也要发表的罢，但我记得《戏》周刊上已曾发表过曾今可叶灵凤两位先生的文章；叶先生还画了一幅阿Q像，好像我那一本《呐喊》还没有在上茅厕时候用尽，倘不是多年便秘，那一定是又买了一本新的了。如果我被绍伯先生的判决所震慑，这回是应该不敢再写什么的，但我想，也不必如此。只是在这里要顺便声明：我并无此种权力，可以禁止别人将我的信件在刊物上发表，而且另外还有谁的文章，更无从豫先知道，所以对于同一刊物上的任何作者，都没有表示调和与否的意思；但倘有同一营垒中人，化了装从背后给我一刀，则我的对于他的憎恶和鄙视，是在明显的敌人之上的。
There is still a little tail at the end, of course, it is not as interesting as Ba'erjun's tail. I'm very sorry for this, but I still have to say it. I remember that a few months ago, I answered a friend's question about popular language, and this letter was later published in the "Social Monthly", and finally an article by Mr. Yang Ren. A Mr. Shaobo said on "Torch" that I had reconciled with Mr. Yang Ren, and deeply felt the harmony of Chinese. This time, my letter is about to be published, but I remember that the weekly magazine "Opera" has published articles by Mr. Zeng Jinke and Ye Lingfeng; Mr. Ye also drew a portrait of Ah Q, as if my copy of "Scream" had not been used up when I went to the toilet, if it weren't for constipation for many years, I must have bought a new one. If I had been intimidated by Mr. Schaubo's verdict, I would not have dared to write anything more this time, but I think it doesn't have to be.
