P.S第一篇《关于中国的两三件事》，是应日本的改造社之托而写的，原是日文，即于是年三月，登在《改造》上，改题为《火，王道，监狱》。记得中国北方，曾有一种期刊译载过这三篇，但在南方，却只有林语堂，邵洵美，章克标三位所主编的杂志《人言》上，曾用这为攻击作者之具，其详见于《准风月谈》的后记中，兹不赘。
The first article, "Two or Three Things About China", was written at the request of the Japanese Reform Society, originally in Japanese, that is, in March of that year, it was published in "Transformation" and retitled "Fire, Royal Road, Prison". I remember that in northern China, there was a journal that translated these three articles, but in the south, only Lin Yutang, Shao Xunmei, and Zhang Kebiao used this as a tool to attack the author in the magazine "Human Words", which is detailed in the postscript of "Quasi-Fengyue Tan", which will not be repeated.
《草鞋脚》是现代中国作家的短篇小说集，应伊罗生（H．Isaacs）先生之托，由我和茅盾先生选出，他更加选择，译成英文的。但至今好像还没有出版。
"Straw Shoes" is a collection of short stories by modern Chinese writers, selected by me and Mr. Mao Dun at the request of Mr. H. Isaacs, and he chose it and translated it into English. But it seems that it has not been published yet.
《答曹聚仁先生信》原是我们的私人通信，不料竟在《社会月报》上登出来了，这一登可是祸事非小，我就成为“替杨人氏打开场锣鼓，谁说鲁迅先生器量窄小呢”了。有八月三十一日《大晚报》副刊《火炬》上的文章为证——
"Answer to Mr. Cao Juren's Letter" was originally our private correspondence, but unexpectedly it was published in the "Social Monthly Report", and this publication was not a small disaster, so I became "opening the gongs and drums for Yang Renshi, who said that Mr. Lu Xun has a narrow capacity". There is an article in the supplement "Torch" of the "Great Evening News" on August 31 as evidence-调和
harmony——读《社会月报》八月号
——Read the August issue of "Social Monthly"绍伯
Shaobo“中国人是善于调和的民族”——这话我从前还不大相信，因为那时我年纪还轻，阅历不到，我自己是不大肯调和的，我就以为别人也和我一样的不肯调和。
"Chinese are a nation that is good at reconciliation" - I didn't believe this before, because I was still young and had no experience, and I was unwilling to reconcile myself, so I thought that others would refuse to reconcile just like me.这观念后来也稍稍改正了。那是我有一个亲戚，在我故乡两个军阀的政权争夺战中做了牺牲，我那时对于某军阀虽无好感，却因亲戚之故也感着一种同仇敌忾，及至后来那两军阀到了上海又很快的调和了，彼此过从颇密，我不觉为之呆然，觉得我们亲戚假使仅仅是为着他的“政友”而死，他真是白死了。
This concept was later slightly corrected. It was that I had a relative who made sacrifices in the power struggle between two warlords in my hometown, and although I didn't have a good impression of a warlord at that time, I also felt a kind of hatred because of my relatives, and later the two warlords quickly reconciled when they arrived in Shanghai, and they had a close relationship with each other.后来又听得广东A君告诉我在两广战争后战士们白骨在野碧血还腥的时候，两军主持的太太在香港寓楼时常一道打牌，亲昵逾常，这更使我大彻大悟。
Later, I heard Mr. A from Guangdong tell me that after the Guangdong War, when the bones of the soldiers were still bloody in the wild, the wives of the two armies often played cards together in the Hong Kong apartment, which made me even more enlightened.现在，我们更明白了，这是当然的事，不单是军阀战争如此，帝国主义的分赃战争也作如是观。老百姓整千整万地做了炮灰，各国资本家却可以聚首一堂举着香槟相视而笑。什么“军阀主义”“民主主义”都成了骗人的话。
Now, we understand better that this is a matter of course, not only in warlord wars, but also in imperialist wars of spoils. Thousands of ordinary people have been cannon fodder, but capitalists from all over the world can gather together and look at each other with champagne and smile. All "warlordism" and "democracy" have become deceptive words.然而这是指那些军阀资本家们“无原则的争斗”，若夫真理追求者的“有原则的争斗”应该不是这样！
However, this refers to the "unprincipled struggle" of those warlord capitalists, and the "principled struggle" of truth-seekers should not be like this!最近这几年，青年们追随着思想界的领袖们之后做了许多惨淡的努力，有的为着这还牺牲了宝贵的生命。个人的生命是可宝贵的，但一代的真理更可宝贵，生命牺牲了而真理昭然于天下，这死是值得的，就是不可以太打浑了水，把人家弄得不明不白。
In recent years, young people have made many dismal efforts to follow the leaders of the ideological world, and some have sacrificed their precious lives for this. Personal life is precious, but the truth of a generation is even more precious, life is sacrificed and the truth is clear to the world, this death is worth it, that is, you can't muddy the water too much and make people unclear.后者的例子可求之于《社会月报》。这月刊真可以说是当今最完备的“杂”志了。而最“杂”得有趣的是题为“大众语特辑”的八月号。读者试念念这一期的目录罢，第一位打开场锣鼓的是鲁迅先生（关于大众语的意见），而“压轴子”的是《赤区归来记》作者杨人氏。就是健忘的读者想也记得鲁迅先生和杨人氏有过不小的一点“原则上”的争执罢。鲁迅先生似乎还“嘘”过杨人氏，然而他却可以替杨人氏打开场锣鼓，谁说鲁迅先生器量窄小呢？
An example of the latter can be found in the "Social Monthly". This monthly magazine can really be said to be the most complete "miscellaneous" magazine today. The most "miscellaneous" and interesting is the August issue entitled "Popular Language Special". Readers try to read the table of contents of this issue, the first to open the gongs and drums is Mr. Lu Xun (opinions on popular language), and the "finale" is Yang Renshi, the author of "The Return of the Red Zone". Even forgetful readers will remember that Mr. Lu Xun and Yang Renshi had a lot of "in principle" disputes. Mr. Lu Xun seems to have "booed" Yang Renshi, but he can open the gongs and drums for Yang Renshi, who said that Mr. Lu Xun has a narrow capacity?苦的只是读者，读了鲁迅先生的信，我们知道“汉字和大众不两立”，我们知道应把“交通繁盛言语混杂的地方”的“‘大众语’的雏形，它的字汇和语法输进穷乡僻壤去”。我们知道“先驱者的任务”是在给大众许多话“发表更明确的意思”，同时“明白更精确的意义”；我们知道现在所能实行的是以“进步的”思想写“向大众语去的作品”。但读了最后杨人氏的文章，才知道向大众去根本是一条死路，那里在水灾与敌人围攻之下，破产无余，……“维持已经困难，建设更不要空谈。”还是“归”到都会里“来”扬起小资产阶级文学之旗更靠得住。
After reading Mr. Lu Xun's letter, we know that "Chinese characters and the public are incompatible", and we know that we should export the "prototype of the 'popular language', its vocabulary and grammar to the poor and remote areas" of "places where traffic is prosperous and language is mixed". We know that the "task of the pioneer" is to "express clearer meanings" to the masses and "understand more precise meanings"; We know that what we can do now is to write "works that go to the popular language" with "progressive" ideas. But after reading Yang Ren's article at the end, I realized that going to the public was a dead end, where under the siege of floods and enemies, bankruptcy was ,...... "It is already difficult to maintain, and construction should not be empty talk." It is more reliable to "return" to the city and "come" to raise the banner of petty-bourgeois literature.于是，我们所得的知识前后相销，昏昏沉沉，莫明其妙。
As a result, the knowledge we gain is mutually exclusive, groggy, and incomprehensible.这恐怕也表示中国民族善于调和吧，但是太调和了，使人疑心思想上的争斗也渐渐没有原则了。变成“戟门坝上的儿戏”了。照这样的阵容看，有些人真死的不明不白。
This may also mean that the Chinese nation is good at reconciliation, but it is too harmonious, and the ideological struggle that makes people suspicious is gradually unprincipled. It has become "child's play on the Halberd Gate Dam". According to such a lineup, some people are really dead.关于开锣以后“压轴”以前的那些“中间作家”的文章特别是大众语问题的一些宏论，本想略抒鄙见，但这只好改日再谈了。
I wanted to express some of the grand theories about the articles of the "middle writers" before the "finale" after the gong, especially the popular language issue, but I have to talk about it another day.关于这一案，我到十一月《答〈戏〉周刊编者信》里，这才回答了几句。
Regarding this case, I only answered a few words in the November "Answer to the Editor's Letter of Opera Weekly".
《门外文谈》是用了“华圉”的笔名，向《自由谈》投稿的，每天登一节。但不知道为什么，第一节被删去了末一行，第十节开头又被删去了二百余字，现仍补足，并用黑点为记。
"Outside the Door" uses the pseudonym "Hua Yu" and contributes to "Free Talk", and publishes a section every day. But for some reason, the last line of the first section was deleted, and more than 200 words were deleted at the beginning of the tenth section, which is still made up and marked with black dots.
《不知肉味和不知水味》是写给《太白》的，登出来时，后半篇都不见了，我看这是“中央宣传部书报检查委员会”的政绩。那时有人看了《太白》上的这一篇，当面问我道：“你在说什么呀？”现仍补足，并用黑点为记，使读者可以知道我其实是在说什么。
"I Don't Know the Taste of Meat and Don't Know the Taste of Water" was written to "Taibai", and when it was published, the second half of the article was gone, and I think this is the achievement of the "Central Propaganda Department Book and Newspaper Inspection Committee". At that time, someone read this article in "Taibai" and asked me in person: "What are you talking about?" "I still make up for it, and use black dots as a mark, so that readers can know what I am actually talking about.
《中国人失掉自信力了吗》也是写给《太白》的。凡是对于求神拜佛，略有不敬之处，都被删除，可见这时我们的“上峰”正在主张求神拜佛。现仍补足，并用黑点为记，聊以存一时之风尚耳。
"Have Chinese lost their self-confidence" is also written for "Taibai". All the slightest disrespect to pray to God and worship Buddha has been deleted, which shows that our "Shangfeng" is advocating praying to God and worshiping Buddha at this time. I am still supplementing it now, and I will use black dots as a mark, just to preserve the fashion of the time.
《脸谱臆测》是写给《生生月刊》的，奉官谕：不准发表。我当初很觉得奇怪，待到领回原稿，看见用红铅笔打着杠子的处所，才明白原来是因为得罪了“第三种人”老爷们了。现仍加上黑杠子，以代红杠子，且以警戒新作家。
"Facebook Speculation" was written to "Shengsheng Monthly", and was officially instructed: it is not allowed to be published. I thought it was strange at first, but when I got back the manuscript and saw the place where the red pencil was used to hit the bar, I realized that it was because I had offended the "third type of people". Now the black bar is still added to replace the red bar and to warn new writers.
《答〈戏〉周刊编者信》的末尾，是对于绍伯先生那篇《调和》的答复。听说当时我们有一位姓沈的“战友”看了就呵呵大笑道：“这老头子又发牢骚了！”“头子”而“老”，“牢骚”而“又”，恐怕真也滑稽得很。然而我自己，是认真的。
At the end of the "Letter to the Editor of the Weekly Magazine", there is a reply to Mr. Shaobo's "Reconciliation". I heard that we had a "comrade-in-arms" surnamed Shen at that time, and when he saw it, he laughed and said, "This old man is whining again!" "Head" and "old", "complaining" and "again", I'm afraid it's really funny. However, I am serious.不过向《戏》周刊编者去“发牢骚”，别人也许会觉得奇怪。然而并不，因为编者之一是田汉同志，而田汉同志也就是绍伯先生。
However, if you "complain" to the editor of "Drama" Weekly, others may find it strange. However, no, because one of the editors was Comrade Tian Han, and Comrade Tian Han was also Mr. Shaobo.《中国文坛上的鬼魅》是写给《现代中国》（China Today）的，不知由何人所译，登在第一卷第五期，后来又由英文转译，载在德文和法文的《国际文学》上。
"Ghosts in Chinese Literature" was written for "China Today", translated by an unknown person, published in the fifth issue of the first volume, and later translated from English and published in "International Literature" in German and French.
《病后杂谈》是向《文学》的投稿，共五段；待到四卷二号上登了出来时，只剩下第一段了。后有一位作家，根据了这一段评论我道：鲁迅是赞成生病的。他竟毫不想到检查官的删削。可见文艺上的暗杀政策，有时也还有一些效力的。
"Post-Illness Miscellaneous Talks" is a contribution to "Literature", a total of five paragraphs; By the time it was published on Volume 4, No. 2, only the first paragraph remained. Later, a writer commented on me based on this paragraph: Lu Xun is in favor of being sick. He didn't expect the censor's deletion. It can be seen that the literary and artistic assassination policy sometimes has some effect.
《病后杂谈之余》也是向《文学》的投稿，但不知道为什么，检查官这回却古里古怪了，不说不准登，也不说可登，也不动贵手删削，就是一个支支吾吾。发行人没有法，来找我自己删改了一些，然而听说还是不行，终于由发行人执笔，检查官动口，再删一通，这才能在四卷三号上登出。题目必须改为《病后余谈》，小注“关于舒愤懑”这一句也不准有；改动的两处，我都注在本文之下，删掉的五处，则仍以黑点为记，读者试一想这些讳忌，是会觉得很有趣的。只有不准说“言行一致”云云，也许莫明其妙，现在我应该指明，这是因为又触犯了“第三种人”了。
"After Illness and Miscellaneous Talks" is also a submission to "Literature", but I don't know why, the prosecutor is strange this time, not saying that it is not allowed to be published, nor can it be published, nor is it deleted by your hands, it is just a hesitation. The issuer had no way to do it, so he came to me to delete some of them himself, but I heard that it still didn't work, and finally the issuer took the pen, and the inspector moved his mouth, and deleted it again, so that it could be logged out on Volume 4, No. 3. The title must be changed to "Afterword after Illness", and the sentence "About Shu Indignation" is not allowed; I have noted the two changes under this article, and the five deleted places are still marked with black dots, and readers will find it interesting to think about these taboos. Only it is not allowed to say "consistent in words and deeds", maybe it is incomprehensible, now I should point out that this is because I have offended the "third kind of person" again.
《阿金》是写给《漫画生活》的；然而不但不准登载，听说还送到南京中央宣传会里去了。这真是不过一篇漫谈，毫无深意，怎么会惹出这样大问题来的呢，自己总是参不透。后来索回原稿，先看见第一页上有两颗紫色印，一大一小，文曰“抽去”，大约小的是上海印，大的是首都印，然则必须“抽去”，已无疑义了。再看下去，就又发见了许多红杠子，现在改为黑杠，仍留在本文的旁边。
"Ajin" is written for "Comic Life"; However, not only was it not allowed to be published, but it was also sent to the Nanjing Central Propaganda Conference. This is really just a rambling, without deep meaning, how can it cause such a big problem, I always can't understand it. Later, when I asked for the original manuscript, I first saw two purple seals on the first page, one large and one small, the text was "drawn away", the small one was the Shanghai seal, and the larger one was the capital seal, so it must be "removed", which is undoubtedly righteous. If you look at it again, you will find many red bars, which are now changed to black bars, and they are still left next to this article.看了杠子，有几处是可以悟出道理来的。例如“主子是外国人”，“炸弹”，“巷战”之类，自然也以不提为是。但是我总不懂为什么不能说我死了“未必能够弄到开起同乡会”的缘由，莫非官意是以为我死了会开同乡会的么？
After looking at the bar, there are several places where you can realize the truth. For example, "the master is a foreigner", "bomb", "street fighting", etc., naturally not mentioned. But I don't understand why I can't say that I may not be able to open a hometown association when I die, could it be that the official intention is to think that I will open a hometown association when I die?
我们活在这样的地方，我们活在这样的时代。
We live in such a place, we live in such an era.
一九三五年十二月三十日，编讫记。

December 30, 1935, compiled and completed.

序言

序言

序言

序言昨天编完了去年的文字，取发表于日报的短论以外者，谓之《且介亭杂文》；今天再来编今年的，因为除做了几篇《文学论坛》，没有多写短文，便都收录在这里面，算是《二集》。
Yesterday, last year's text was compiled, and the short articles published in the daily newspaper were called "Qiejieting Miscellaneous Essays"; Today I will compile this year's article, because except for a few "Literary Forums", I did not write more short articles, and they were all included in it, which is regarded as "Second Collection".过年本来没有什么深意义，随便那天都好，明年的元旦，决不会和今年的除夕就不同，不过给人事借此时时算有一个段落，结束一点事情，倒也便利的。倘不是想到了已经年终，我的两年以来的杂文，也许还不会集成这一本。
The New Year has no deep meaning, no matter what day it is, next year's New Year's Day will never be different from this year's Chinese New Year's Eve, but it is convenient to give personnel an opportunity to have a paragraph at this time and end a little thing. If it weren't for the thought that it was the end of the year, my essays from the past two years might not have been integrated into this book.编完以后，也没有什么大感想。要感的感过了，要写的也写过了，例如“以华制华”之说罢，我在前年的《自由谈》上发表时，曾大受傅公红蓼之流的攻击，今年才又有人提出来，却是风平浪静。一定要到得“不幸而吾言中”，这才大家默默无言，然而为时已晚，是彼此都大可悲哀的。我宁可如邵洵美辈的《人言》之所说：“意气多于议论，捏造多于实证。”
After compiling, I didn't have any big impressions. For example, when I published it in "Free Talk" the year before last, I was attacked by Fu Gong Hongliao and others, and this year someone brought it up again, but it was calm. It must be "unfortunate and in my words", so that everyone is silent, but it is too late, and it is very sad for each other. I would rather be like Shao Xunmei's "Human Words" said: "There is more spirit than discussion, and more fabrication than empirical evidence." ”我有时决不想在言论界求得胜利，因为我的言论有时是枭鸣，报告着大不吉利事，我的言中，是大家会有不幸的。在今年，为了内心的冷静和外力的迫压，我几乎不谈国事了，偶尔触着的几篇，如《什么是讽刺》，如《从帮忙到扯淡》，也无一不被禁止。别的作者的遭遇，大约也是如此的罢，而天下太平，直到华北自治，才见有新闻记者恳求保护正当的舆论。我的不正当的舆论，却如国土一样，仍在日即于沦亡，但是我不想求保护，因为这代价，实在是太大了。
Sometimes I never want to win in the world of speech, because my remarks are sometimes owl, reporting bad luck, and in my words, everyone will be unhappy. This year, for the sake of inner calm and external pressure, I hardly talked about state affairs, and the few articles I occasionally touched, such as "What is Satire" and "From Help to Nonsense", were all banned. The same is probably true for other authors, and the world is peaceful, and it was not until North China was autonomous that some journalists begged to protect legitimate public opinion. My improper public opinion, like the country, is still on the verge of destruction, but I don't want to ask for protection, because the price is too great.单将这些文字，过而存之，聊作今年笔墨的记念罢。
Just keep these words and save them as a memory of this year's pen and ink.一九三五年十二月三十一日，鲁迅记于上海之且介亭。
On December 31, 1935, Lu Xun recorded in the Qiejie Pavilion in Shanghai.

一九三五年

1935

叶紫作《丰收》序

叶紫作《丰收》序

叶紫作《丰收》序

Ye Zi wrote the preface to "Harvest."作者写出创作来，对于其中的事情，虽然不必亲历过，最好是经历过。诘难者问：那么，写杀人最好是自己杀过人，写妓女还得去卖淫么？答曰：不然。我所谓经历，是所遇，所见，所闻，并不一定是所作，但所作自然也可以包含在里面。天才们无论怎样说大话，归根结蒂，还是不能凭空创造。描神画鬼，毫无对证，本可以专靠了神思，所谓“天马行空”似的挥写了，然而他们写出来的，也不过是三只眼，长颈子，就是在常见的人体上，增加了眼睛一只，增长了颈子二三尺而已。这算什么本领，这算什么创造？
The author writes about creation, although he does not have to experience it himself, it is best to experience it. The questioner asked: So, it is best to write about murder if you have killed someone yourself, and do you have to go to prostitution when writing about prostitutes? The answer was: No. What I mean by experience is what I encounter, what I see, and what I hear, which is not necessarily what I do, but what I do can naturally be included in it. No matter how geniuses say big things, in the final analysis, they still cannot create out of thin air. Depicting gods and ghosts, without evidence, could have relied on divine thoughts, the so-called "imaginative" like a wave, but what they wrote was only three eyes, a long neck, that is, on the common human body, one eye was added, and the neck was increased by two or three feet. What kind of skill is this, what kind of creation is this?地球上不只一个世界，实际上的不同，比人们空想中的阴阳两界还利害。这一世界中人，会轻蔑，憎恶，压迫，恐怖，杀戮别一世界中人，然而他不知道，因此他也写不出，于是他自称“第三种人”，他“为艺术而艺术”，他即使写了出来，也不过是三只眼，长颈子而已。“再亮些”？不要骗人罢！你们的眼睛在那里呢？
There is more than one world on earth, and the actual difference is more important than the yin and yang worlds that people imagine. People in this world will despise, hate, oppress, terrorize, and kill people in other worlds, but he doesn't know, so he can't write it, so he calls himself a "third kind of person", he "art for art's sake", and even if he writes it, it's just three eyes and a long neck. "Brighter"? Don't lie! Where are your eyes?伟大的文学是永久的，许多学者们这么说。对啦，也许是永久的罢。但我自己，却与其看薄凯契阿，雨果的书，宁可看契诃夫，高尔基的书，因为它更新，和我们的世界更接近。中国确也还盛行着《三国志演义》和《水浒传》，但这是为了社会还有三国气和水浒气的缘故。《儒林外史》作者的手段何尝在罗贯中下，然而留学生漫天塞地以来，这部书就好像不永久，也不伟大了。伟大也要有人懂。
Great literature is permanent, as many scholars say. Yes, maybe permanently. But myself, I would rather read the books of Chekhov and Gorky than the books of Bokhecia and Hugo, because it is updated and closer to our world. China does still have the "Romance of the Three Kingdoms" and "Water Margin", but this is because the society still has the Three Kingdoms and Water Margin. The author's methods of "The History of Confucianism" are not in Luo Guanzhong, but since the international students are all over the world, this book seems to be not permanent or great. Greatness must also be understood.这里的六个短篇，都是太平世界的奇闻，而现在却是极平常的事情。因为极平常，所以和我们更密切，更有大关系。作者还是一个青年，但他的经历，却抵得太平天下的顺民的一世纪的经历，在转辗的生活中，要他“为艺术而艺术”，是办不到的。但我们有人懂得这样的艺术，一点用不着谁来发愁。
The six short stories here are all anecdotes from the peaceful world, but now they are very common. Because it is very ordinary, it is closer to us and has a greater relationship with us. The author is still a young man, but his experience is worth the experience of the people of the first century of peace in the world, and it is impossible to ask him to "art for art's sake" in the life of turning around. But some of us understand this kind of art, and there is no need for anyone to worry about it.这就是伟大的文学么？不是的，我们自己并没有这么说。“中国为什么没有伟大文学产生？”我们听过许多指导者的教训了，但可惜他们独独忘却了一方面的对于作者和作品的摧残。“第三种人”教训过我们，希腊神话里说什么恶鬼有一张床，捉了人去，给睡在这床上，短了，就拉长他，太长，便把他截短。左翼批评就是这样的床，弄得他们写不出东西来了。现在这张床真的摆出来了，不料却只有“第三种人”睡得不长不短，刚刚合式。仰面唾天，掉在自己的眼睛里，天下真会有这等事。
Is this great literature? No, we didn't say that ourselves. "Why has there been no great literature in China?" We have heard the lessons of many mentors, but unfortunately they have forgotten the destruction of authors and works on one hand. The "third type of man" taught us that in Greek mythology, it is said that an evil spirit has a bed, catches a person, sleeps on this bed, and if it is short, it lengthens him, and if it is too long, he cuts it short. Left-wing criticism is such a bed that makes them unable to write. Now this bed is really set up, but unexpectedly, only the "third type of person" sleeps neither long nor short, just fit. Spit on your back and fall into your own eyes, there will really be such a thing in the world.但我们却有作家写得出东西来，作品在摧残中也更加坚实。不但为一大群中国青年读者所支持，当《电网外》在《文学新地》上以《王伯伯》的题目发表后，就得到世界的读者了。这就是作者已经尽了当前的任务，也是对于压迫者的答复：文学是战斗的！
But we have writers who can write things, and their works are more solid in the midst of destruction. Not only was it supported by a large group of young Chinese readers, but when "Outside the Power Grid" was published in "New Land of Literature" under the title of "Uncle Wang", it gained readers from all over the world. This is the author who has fulfilled his current task and the answer to the oppressor: literature is combat!我希望将来还有看见作者的更多，更好的作品的时候。
I hope to see more and better works by authors in the future.一九三五年一月十六日，鲁迅记于上海。
On January 16, 1935, Lu Xun recorded in Shanghai.

隐士

隐士

隐士

hermit隐士，历来算是一个美名，但有时也当作一个笑柄。最显著的，则有刺陈眉公的“翩然一只云中鹤，飞去飞来宰相衙”的诗，至今也还有人提及。我以为这是一种误解。因为一方面，是“自视太高”，于是别方面也就“求之太高”，彼此“忘其所以”，不能“心照”，而又不能“不宣”，从此口舌也多起来了。
Hermits have always been a good name, but sometimes they are also used as a laughingstock. The most notable is the poem "A crane in the clouds, flying to the prime minister's office" by Chen Meigong, which is still mentioned by some people. I thought it was a misunderstanding. Because on the one hand, it is "too high a self-esteem", so the other side also "asks too high", "forgets each other", cannot "take it to heart", and cannot "not declare", and since then there have been more tongues.非隐士的心目中的隐士，是声闻不彰，息影山林的人物。但这种人物，世间是不会知道的。一到挂上隐士的招牌，则即使他并不“飞去飞来”，也一定难免有些表白，张扬；或是他的帮闲们的开锣喝道——隐士家里也会有帮闲，说起来似乎不近情理，但一到招牌可以换饭的时候，那是立刻就有帮闲的，这叫作“啃招牌边”。这一点，也颇为非隐士的人们所诟病，以为隐士身上而有油可揩，则隐士之阔绰可想了。其实这也是一种“求之太高”的误解，和硬要有名的隐士，老死山林中者相同。凡是有名的隐士，他总是已经有了“悠哉游哉，聊以卒岁”的幸福的。倘不然，朝砍柴，昼耕田，晚浇菜，夜织屦，又那有吸烟品茗，吟诗作文的闲暇？陶渊明先生是我们中国赫赫有名的大隐，一名“田园诗人”，自然，他并不办期刊，也赶不上吃“庚款”，然而他有奴子。汉晋时候的奴子，是不但侍候主人，并且给主人种地，营商的，正是生财器具。所以虽是渊明先生，也还略略有些生财之道在，要不然，他老人家不但没有酒喝，而且没有饭吃，早已在东篱旁边饿死了。
The hermit in the minds of non-hermits is a person who is not well-known and has a shadow in the mountains and forests. But this kind of character will not be known in the world. When it comes to hanging up the hermit's signboard, even if he does not "fly around", it is inevitable that there will be some confessions and publicity; Or the gong of his helpers shouted - there will also be helpers in the hermit's house, which seems unreasonable, but when the sign can be exchanged for food, there will be helpers immediately, which is called "gnawing on the side of the signboard". This point is also quite criticized by people who are not hermits, thinking that if the hermit has oil to wipe off, then the hermit's generosity can be imagined. In fact, this is also a misunderstanding of "asking too high", which is the same as the hermit who insists on being famous, who dies of old age in the mountains and forests. All famous hermits, he always has the happiness of "leisurely wandering, talking about the end of his life". Otherwise, chopping firewood in the morning, plowing the fields during the day, watering vegetables in the evening, weaving shoes at night, how can there be leisure to smoke and drink tea, recite poetry and compose poetry? Mr. Tao Yuanming is a well-known hermit in China, a "pastoral poet", naturally, he does not run a periodical, and he can't catch up with the "Geng money", but he has slaves. The slaves in the Han and Jin dynasties not only served their masters, but also farmed and did business for their masters, which were the tools for making money. So although Mr. Yuanming still has some ways to make money, otherwise, his old man not only has no wine to drink, but also has no food to eat, and he would have starved to death next to the east fence.所以我们倘要看看隐君子风，实际上也只能看看这样的隐君子，真的“隐君子”是没法看到的。古今著作，足以汗牛而充栋，但我们可能找出樵夫渔父的著作来？他们的著作是砍柴和打鱼。至于那些文士诗翁，自称什么钓徒樵子的，倒大抵是悠游自得的封翁或公子，何尝捏过钓竿或斧头柄。要在他们身上赏鉴隐逸气，我敢说，这只能怪自己胡涂。
So if we want to look at the hermit's style, in fact, we can only look at such a hermit, and the real "hermit" cannot be seen. Ancient and modern works are enough to sweat and fill the cows, but we may find the works of woodcutters and fishermen? Their writings were chopping wood and fishing. As for those scribes and poets, who claim to be fishermen and woodcutters, they are probably leisurely Feng Weng or Gongzi, and they have pinched fishing rods or axe handles. If you want to appreciate the seclusion in them, I dare say that you can only blame yourself for this.登仕，是噉饭之道，归隐，也是噉饭之道。假使无法噉饭，那就连“隐”也隐不成了。“飞去飞来”，正是因为要“隐”，也就是因为要噉饭；肩出“隐士”的招牌来，挂在“城市山林”里，这就正是所谓“隐”，也就是噉饭之道。帮闲们或开锣，或喝道，那是因为自己还不配“隐”，所以只好揩一点“隐”油，其实也还不外乎噉饭之道。汉唐以来，实际上是入仕并不算鄙，隐居也不算高，而且也不算穷，必须欲“隐”而不得，这才看作士人的末路。唐末有一位诗人左偃，自述他悲惨的境遇道：“谋隐谋官两无成”，是用七个字道破了所谓“隐”的秘密的。
Becoming an official is the way to eat, and returning to seclusion is also the way to eat. If you can't eat, then you can't even hide it. "Fly and fly", precisely because you want to "hide", that is, because you want to eat; Shouldering the sign of "hermit" and hanging it in the "urban mountains and forests", this is the so-called "hidden", that is, the way to eat. The helpers either opened the gong or shouted, because they were not worthy of "hiding", so they had to wipe a little "hidden" oil, which was actually nothing more than the way of eating. Since the Han and Tang dynasties, in fact, it is not contemptible to enter the officialdom, the seclusion is not high, and it is not poor, and it must be "hidden" but not obtained, which is regarded as the end of scholars. At the end of the Tang Dynasty, there was a poet Zuo Yan, who recounted his tragic situation: "There is no success in conspiracy and official", which broke the secret of the so-called "hidden" in seven words.“谋隐”无成，才是沦落，可见“隐”总和享福有些相关，至少是不必十分挣扎谋生，颇有悠闲的余裕。但赞颂悠闲，鼓吹烟茗，却又是挣扎之一种，不过挣扎得隐藏一些。虽“隐”，也仍然要噉饭，所以招牌还是要油漆，要保护的。泰山崩，黄河溢，隐士们目无见，耳无闻，但苟有议及自己们或他的一伙的，则虽千里之外，半句之微，他便耳聪目明，奋袂而起，好像事件之大，远胜于宇宙之灭亡者，也就为了这缘故。其实连和苍蝇也何尝有什么相关。
It can be seen that "hidden" is always somewhat related to enjoying happiness, at least there is no need to struggle to make a living, and there is quite a leisurely margin. But praising leisure and advocating smoke and tea is a kind of struggle, but the struggle is hidden. Although it is "hidden", it still needs to be eaten, so the sign still needs to be painted and protected. Mount Tai collapsed, the Yellow River overflowed, and the hermits were blind and deaf, but if they discussed themselves or his gang, even if they were thousands of miles away, even if they were half a sentence, he would hear and rise, as if the event was bigger, far better than the perishers of the universe, and it was for this reason. In fact, it has nothing to do with flies.明白这一点，对于所谓“隐士”也就毫不诧异了，心照不宣，彼此都省事。
Understanding this, it is not surprising to the so-called "hermits", tacitly and each other is trouble-free.一月二十五日。

“招贴即扯”

“招贴即扯”

“招贴即扯”

"Poster is pulled"工愁的人物，真是层出不穷。开年正月，就有人怕骂倒了一切古今人，只留下自己的没意思。要是古今中外真的有过这等事，这才叫作希奇，但实际上并没有，将来大约也不会有。岂但一切古今人，连一个人也没有骂倒过。凡是倒掉的，决不是因为骂，却只为揭穿了假面。揭穿假面，就是指出了实际来，这不能混谓之骂。
The characters of labor sorrow are really endless. In the first month of the first month, some people were afraid of scolding all the ancient and modern people, leaving only their own boring. If such a thing really happened in ancient and modern China and abroad, it would be called Xiqi, but in fact there is none, and there will probably not be one in the future. Not only did all the people of ancient and modern times not even scold anyone. Everything that is dumped is by no means because of scolding, but only to expose the mask. To expose the mask is to point out the reality, which cannot be confused with scolding.然而世间往往混为一谈。就以现在最流行的袁中郎为例罢，既然肩出来当作招牌，看客就不免议论这招牌，怎样撕破了衣裳，怎样画歪了脸孔。这其实和中郎本身是无关的，所指的是他的自以为徒子徒孙们的手笔。然而徒子徒孙们就以为骂了他的中郎爷，愤慨和狼狈之状可掬，觉得现在的世界是比五四时代更狂妄了。但是，现在的袁中郎脸孔究竟画得怎样呢？时代很近，文证具存，除了变成一个小品文的老师，“方巾气”的死敌而外，还有些什么？
However, the world is often confused. Take Yuan Zhonglang, the most popular now, as an example, since it is shouldered as a signboard, spectators can't help but talk about this signboard, how to tear clothes, how to draw a crooked face. This actually has nothing to do with Zhonglang itself, but refers to the handwriting of his self-proclaimed disciples and grandchildren. However, the disciples and grandchildren thought that they had scolded his Zhonglang Ye, and their indignation and embarrassment were palpable, and they felt that the current world was more arrogant than the May Fourth era. But how is Yuan Zhonglang's face painted now? The times are very close, the documents are there, in addition to becoming a teacher of small essays, the sworn enemy of "square scarf", what else?和袁中郎同时活在中国的，无锡有一个顾宪成，他的著作，开口“圣人”，闭口“吾儒”，真是满纸“方巾气”。而且疾恶如仇，对小人决不假借。他说：“吾闻之：凡论人，当观其趋向之大体。趋向苟正，即小节出入，不失为君子；趋向苟差，即小节可观，终归于小人。又闻：为国家者，莫要于扶阳抑阴，君子即不幸有诖误，当保护爱惜成就之；小人即小过乎，当早排绝，无令为后患。……”（《自反录》）推而广之，也就是倘要论袁中郎，当看他趋向之大体，趋向苟正，不妨恕其偶讲空话，作小品文，因为他还有更重要的一方面在。正如李白会做诗，就可以不责其喝酒，如果只会喝酒，便以半个李白，或李白的徒子徒孙自命，那可是应该赶紧将他“排绝”的。
There was a Gu Xiancheng in Wuxi who lived in China at the same time as Yuan Zhonglang, and his writings, opening "saints" and closing "Wu Confucianism", were really full of "square scarf qi". And he hates evil like hatred, and will never lend favor to villains. He said: "I have heard that when discussing people, we should look at the general trend of their tendencies. If you tend to be upright, you will be a gentleman; If the trend is wrong, even if the details are observable, it will ultimately be attributed to the villain. I also heard: For the sake of the country, there is nothing to support the yang and suppress the yin, and even if a gentleman is unfortunate enough to make a mistake, he should protect and cherish it; Even if it is a small mistake, it should be eliminated as soon as possible to prevent it from becoming a future problem. ......" ("Self-Reflection") by extension, that is, if you want to talk about Yuan Zhonglang, when you look at the general situation of his tendency and tend to be upright, you might as well forgive him for occasionally talking empty words and writing sketches, because he has a more important aspect. Just as Li Bai can write poetry, he can not be blamed for drinking, and if he only knows how to drink, he will call himself half Li Bai, or Li Bai's disciple and grandson, then he should be quickly "excluded".中郎还有更重要的一方面么？有的。万历三十七年，顾宪成辞官，时中郎“主陕西乡试，发策，有‘过劣巢由’之语。监临者问‘意云何？’袁曰：‘今吴中大贤亦不出，将令世道何所倚赖，故发此感尔。’”（《顾端文公年谱》下）中郎正是一个关心世道，佩服“方巾气”人物的人，赞《金瓶梅》，作小品文，并不是他的全部。
Is there a more important aspect of Zhonglang? Some. In the thirty-seventh year of Wanli, Gu Xiancheng resigned, and Zhonglang "presided over the Shaanxi provincial examination, issued a strategy, and had the words 'bad nest you'." The monitor asked, 'What do you mean?' Yuan said: 'Now that the great sages of Wu Zhong have not appeared, what will the world rely on, so I feel this way.' Zhonglang is a person who cares about the world and admires the characters of "square scarf qi", praises "Jin Ping Mei", and writes sketches, which is not all of him.中郎之不能被骂倒，正如他之不能被画歪。但因此也就不能作他的蛀虫们的永久的巢穴了。
Zhonglang cannot be scolded, just as he cannot be drawn crookedly. But it cannot be a permanent nest for his moths.一月二十六日。

书的还魂和赶造

书的还魂和赶造

书的还魂和赶造

The return of the soul and the creation of the book把大部的丛书印给读者看，是宋朝就有的，一直到现在。缺点是因为部头大，所以价钱贵。好处是把研究一种学问的书汇集在一处，能比一部一部的自去寻求更省力；或者保存单本小种的著作在里面，使它不易于灭亡。但这第二种好处，是也靠着部头大，价钱贵，人们就因此格外珍重的缺点的。
Most of the series of books were printed to readers, which existed in the Song Dynasty and have been there until now. The disadvantage is that the price is expensive because of the large volume. The advantage is that gathering books on a study of a subject in one place can save effort than seeking them one by one; Or keep a single book of Souzhong's work in it so that it is not easy to perish. But this second benefit is also due to the large size and high price, so people cherish the disadvantage.但丛书也有蠹虫。从明末到清初，就时有欺人的丛书出现。那方法之一，是删削内容，轻减刻费，而目录却有一大串，使购买者只觉其种类之多；之二，是不用原题，别立名目，甚至另题撰人，使购买者只觉其收罗之广。如《格致丛书》，《历代小史》，《五朝小说》，《唐人说荟》等，就都是的。现在是大抵消灭了，只有末一种化名为《唐代丛书》，有时还在流毒。
But there are also silverfish in the series. From the end of the Ming Dynasty to the beginning of the Qing Dynasty, there were deceptive series of books from time to time. One of the methods is to delete the content and reduce the cost of engraving, but the catalog has a large string, so that the buyer only feels that there are many types; Second, it does not use the original title, create a separate title, or even a separate author, so that buyers only feel that it has a wide range of collections. For example, "Gezhi Series", "Short History of the Dynasties", "Novels of the Five Dynasties", "Tang People Say Hui", etc., are all there. Now it has been largely eliminated, and only the last one is pseudonymous "Tang Dynasty Series", and sometimes it is still poisoned.然而时代改变，新花样也要跟着出来了。
However, times have changed, and new tricks are coming out.推测起新花样来：其一，是豫先设定一种丛书的大名，罗列目录，大如宇宙，微至苍蝇身上的细菌，无所不包，这才分头觅人，托他译作，限定时日，必须完工，虽然译作者未必定是专家，但总之有许多手同时在稿纸上写字，于是不必穷年累月，一大部煌煌巨制也就出现了；其二，是原有一批零碎的旧译作，一向不甚流行，或者虽曾流行，而现在却已经过了时候，于是聚在一起，略加类别，开成一串五花八门的目录，而一大部煌煌巨制也就出现了。
Speculate on new tricks: First, Yu first set up a series of books, listed the catalog, as big as the universe, as small as the bacteria on the fly, everything is included, then look for people separately, ask him to translate, time limit, must be completed, although the translator may not be an expert, but in short, there are many hands writing on the manuscript paper at the same time, so there is no need to be poor for years, a large number of brilliant masterpieces have appeared; Second, there were originally a batch of fragmentary old translations, which had never been very popular, or although they were popular, but now they have passed, so they gathered together, slightly categorized, and opened into a variety of catalogues, and a large number of brilliant masterpieces appeared.出版者是明白读者们的心想的，有些读者们，苦于不知道什么是必要的书，所以往往以为被选进丛书里的，总该是必要的书籍；而且丛书里的一本，价钱也比单行本便宜，所以看起来好像很上算；加以大小一律，也很合人们爱好整齐的心情。本数又多，一下子可以填满几书架，规模不大的图书馆有这几部，馆员就省下时常留心选购新书的精神了。然而出版者是又很明白购买者们的经济状况的，他深知道现在他们手头已没有这许多钱，所以这些书一定是廉价，使他们拚命的办出来，或者是分期豫约，使他们逐渐的缴进去。
Publishers understand what readers think, and some readers suffer from not knowing what is a necessary book, so they often think that what is selected into the series should always be necessary books; Moreover, the price of one in the series is cheaper than the single book, so it seems to be a good deal; In addition, the size is the same, which is also in line with people's hobby and neat mood. There are many books, which can fill several shelves at once, and there are these few in small libraries, so the librarian saves the spirit of always paying attention to buying new books. However, the publisher is well aware of the financial situation of the buyers, and he knows that they do not have so much money on hand now, so these books must be cheap, so that they can do their best to get them out, or make them pay in installments gradually.汇印新作，当然是很好的，但新作必须是精粹的本子，这才可以救读者们的智识的饥荒。就是重印旧作，也并不算坏，不过这旧作必须已是一种带着文献性的本子，这才足供读者们的研究。如果仅仅是克日速成的草稿，或是栈房角落的存书，改换新装，招摇过市，但以“大”或“多”或“廉”诱人，使读者化去不少的钱，实际上却不过得到一大堆废物，这恶影响之在读书界是很不小的。
Huiyin's new work is of course very good, but the new work must be the essence of the book, so as to save readers from intellectual hunger. Even if it is a reprint of an old work, it is not bad, but this old work must be a kind of book with literature, which is enough for readers to study. If it is just a quick draft, or a book stored in the corner of the stack, changed to a new outfit, and ostentatious to the market, but it is tempting with "big" or "more" or "cheap", so that readers lose a lot of money, but in fact they only get a lot of waste, which has a lot of evil impact in the reading world.凡留心于文化的前进的人，对于这些书应该加以检讨！
Anyone who pays attention to the progress of culture should review these books!二月十五日。

漫谈“漫画”

漫谈“漫画”

漫谈“漫画”

Talking about "comics"孩子们吵架，有一个用木炭——上海是大抵用铅笔了——在墙壁上写道：“小三子可乎之及及也，同同三千三百刀！”这和政治之类是毫不相干的，然而不能算小品文。画也一样，住家的恨路人到对门来小解，就在墙上画一个乌龟，题几句话，也不能叫它作“漫画”。为什么呢？就因为这和被画者的形体或精神，是绝无关系的。
The children quarreled, and one of them used charcoal - Shanghai probably used pencils - and wrote on the wall: "The little three can be reached, the same is 3,300 knives!" This has nothing to do with politics and the like, but it cannot be regarded as a small article. The same goes for painting, when the hated passers-by at home came to the opposite door to relieve themselves, they drew a turtle on the wall and inscribed a few words, but they could not call it a "cartoon". Why? Because this has nothing to do with the form or spirit of the subject.漫画的第一件紧要事是诚实，要确切的显示了事件或人物的姿态，也就是精神。
The first important thing in comics is honesty, which should accurately show the posture of the event or character, that is, the spirit.漫画是Karikatur的译名，那“漫”，并不是中国旧日的文人学士之所谓“漫题”“漫书”的“漫”。当然也可以不假思索，一挥而就的，但因为发芽于诚实的心，所以那结果也不会仅是嬉皮笑脸。这一种画，在中国的过去的绘画里很少见，《百丑图》或《三十六声粉铎图》庶几近之，可惜的是不过戏文里的丑脚的摹写；罗两峰的《鬼趣图》，当不得已时，或者也就算进去罢，但它又太离开了人间。
Comics are the translation of Karikatur, and the "man" is not the "man" of the so-called "comic titles" and "comic books" of the old Chinese literati and scholars. Of course, it can be done in one stroke without thinking, but because it sprouts from an honest heart, the result will not be just a hippie smile. This kind of painting is rare in Chinese past paintings, and "Hundred Ugly Pictures" or "Thirty-six Voices of Pink Bells" are almost the same, but unfortunately it is just a copy of the ugly feet in the drama; Luo Liangfeng's "Ghost Fun Picture", when it is a last resort, or even if it is included, it is too far from the world.漫画要使人一目了然，所以那最普通的方法是“夸张”，但又不是胡闹。无缘无故的将所攻击或暴露的对象画作一头驴，恰如拍马家将所拍的对象做成一个神一样，是毫没有效果的，假如那对象其实并无驴气息或神气息。然而如果真有些驴气息，那就糟了，从此之后，越看越像，比读一本做得很厚的传记还明白。关于事件的漫画，也一样的。所以漫画虽然有夸张，却还是要诚实。“燕山雪花大如席”，是夸张，但燕山究竟有雪花，就含着一点诚实在里面，使我们立刻知道燕山原来有这么冷。如果说“广州雪花大如席”，那可就变成笑话了。
Comics want to make people clear at a glance, so the most common method is "exaggeration", but not nonsense. Painting the object of attack or exposure as a donkey for no reason is like the horse patter making the object a god, which has no effect at all, if the object does not actually have the aura of a donkey or a god. However, if there is really some donkey atmosphere, it will be bad, and from then on, the more you look at it, the more you look like it, and it is better than reading a thick biography. The same goes for cartoons about events. Therefore, although the comics are exaggerated, they still have to be honest. "Yanshan snowflakes are as big as a mat" is an exaggeration, but there is a little honesty in Yanshan, so that we immediately know that Yanshan is so cold. If you say "Guangzhou snowflakes are as big as a mat", it will become a joke.“夸张”这两个字也许有些语病，那么，说是“廓大”也可以的。廓大一个事件或人物的特点固然使漫画容易显出效果来，但廓大了并非特点之处却更容易显出效果。矮而胖的，瘦而长的，他本身就有漫画相了，再给他秃头，近视眼，画得再矮而胖些，瘦而长些，总可以使读者发笑。但一位白净苗条的美人，就很不容易设法，有些漫画家画作一个髑髅或狐狸之类，却不过是在报告自己的低能。有些漫画家却不用这呆法子，他用廓大镜照了她露出的搽粉的臂膊，看出她皮肤的褶皱，看见了这些褶皱中间的粉和泥的黑白画。这么一来，漫画稿子就成功了，然而这是真实，倘不信，大家或自己也用廓大镜去照照去。于是她也只好承认这真实，倘要好，就用肥皂和毛刷去洗一通。
The word "exaggerated" may be a bit of a language problem, so it is okay to say that it is "broad". Although the characteristics of an event or character are enlarged, it is easier to show the effect of comics, but it is easier to show the effect of not being a characteristic. Short and fat, thin and long, he himself has a comic appearance, and then give him baldness, short-sightedness, no matter how short and fat, thin and long, it can always make readers laugh. But a fair and slender beauty is not easy to manage, and some cartoonists draw a skeleton or a fox or the like, but they are just reporting their imbecile. Some cartoonists don't use this stupid method, he looked at her exposed powdered arms with a large mirror, saw the folds of her skin, and saw the black and white paintings of powder and mud in the middle of these folds. In this way, the comic manuscript is successful, but this is true, if you don't believe it, you or yourself will use a large mirror to look at it. So she had to admit that it was true, and if it was good, she would wash it with soap and a brush.因为真实，所以也有力。但这种漫画，在中国是很难生存的。我记得去年就有一位文学家说过，他最讨厌论人用显微镜。
Because it is real, it is also powerful. But this kind of comics are difficult to survive in China. I remember a writer said last year that he hated the microscope for people.欧洲先前，也并不两样。漫画虽然是暴露，讥刺，甚而至于是攻击的，但因为读者多是上等的雅人，所以漫画家的笔锋的所向，往往只在那些无拳无勇的无告者，用他们的可笑，衬出雅人们的完全和高尚来，以分得一枝雪茄的生意。像西班牙的戈雅（Francisco de Goya）和法国的陀密埃（Honoré Daumier）那样的漫画家，到底还是不可多得的。
Europe was no different before. Although comics are exposed, ridiculed, and even attacked, because most of the readers are high-quality elegant people, the direction of the cartoonist's pen is often only in those who have no fists and no courage, and use their ridiculousness to set off the perfection and nobility of the elegant people, in order to get a share of the business of a cigar. Cartoonists like Francisco de Goya in Spain and Honoré Daumier in France are still rare.二月二十八日。

漫画而又漫画

Comics and comics德国现代的画家格罗斯（George Grosz），中国已经绍介过好几回，总可以不算陌生人了。从有一方说，他也可以算是漫画家；那些作品，大抵是白地黑线的。

What happened to him in China is not bad, although the plate-making technique is too bad or shrunk, the black line is still a white background. Naturally, when we look at the rubbings of stone carvings, they are probably white characters on a black background. However, the reprinted paintings have not yet seen a major transformation of green landscapes into red and yellow landscapes, and ink dragons into gouache dragons. Yes, it is a "literary and artistic" artist in Shanghai that began in the twentieth century after 35 years. I just learned that the color grading, color matching, etc. when a painter paints are troublesome. Once in the hands of Chinese "literary and artistic", there is no problem,—— buzz, buzz, whatever.这些翻印的格罗斯的画是有价值的，是漫画而又漫画。

《中国新文学大系》小说二集序

《中国新文学大系》小说二集序

《中国新文学大系》小说二集序

Preface to the second collection of novels in "The Great Series of Chinese New Literature"一
One凡是关心现代中国文学的人，谁都知道《新青年》是提倡“文学改良”，后来更进一步而号召“文学革命”的发难者。但当一九一五年九月中在上海开始出版的时候，却全部是文言的。苏曼殊的创作小说，陈嘏和刘半农的翻译小说，都是文言。到第二年，胡适的《文学改良刍议》发表了，作品也只有胡适的诗文和小说是白话。后来白话作者逐渐多了起来，但又因为《新青年》其实是一个论议的刊物，所以创作并不怎样著重，比较旺盛的只有白话诗；至于戏曲和小说，也依然大抵是翻译。
Anyone who cares about modern Chinese literature knows that "New Youth" is the initiator of "literary reform" and later went further and called for a "literary revolution". But when it began to be published in Shanghai in mid-September 1915, it was all in classical Chinese. Su Manshu's creative novels and Chen Gu and Liu Bannong's translated novels are all classical Chinese. By the second year, Hu Shi's "Discussion on Literary Improvement" was published, and only Hu Shi's poems and novels were in the vernacular. Later, there were more vernacular authors, but because "New Youth" was actually a publication of discussion, the creation was not very focused, and only vernacular poems were more vigorous; As for opera and novels, they are still mostly translations.在这里发表了创作的短篇小说的，是鲁迅。从一九一八年五月起，《狂人日记》，《孔乙己》，《药》等，陆续的出现了，算是显示了“文学革命”的实绩，又因那时的认为“表现的深切和格式的特别”，颇激动了一部分青年读者的心。然而这激动，却是向来怠慢了绍介欧洲大陆文学的缘故。一八三四年顷，俄国的果戈理（N. Gogol）就已经写了《狂人日记》；一八八三年顷，尼采（Fr. Nietzsche）也早借了苏鲁支（Zarathustra）的嘴，说过“你们已经走了从虫豸到人的路，在你们里面还有许多份是虫豸。你们做过猴子，到了现在，人还尤其猴子，无论比那一个猴子”的。而且《药》的收束，也分明的留着安特莱夫（L. Andreev）式的阴冷。但后起的《狂人日记》意在暴露家族制度和礼教的弊害，却比果戈理的忧愤深广，也不如尼采的超人的渺茫。此后虽然脱离了外国作家的影响，技巧稍为圆熟，刻划也稍加深切，如《肥皂》，《离婚》等，但一面也减少了热情，不为读者们所注意了。
The person who published the short story created here was Lu Xun. Since May 1918, "Diary of a Madman", "Kong Yiji", "Medicine", etc., have appeared one after another, which can be regarded as showing the achievements of the "literary revolution", and because of the belief at that time that "the depth of expression and the special format", it has quite excited the hearts of some young readers. However, this excitement is because it has always neglected the literature of the European continent. In 1834, the Russian governor of Russia, N. Gogol) has already written "Diary of a Madman"; In 1883, Nietzsche (Fr. Nietzsche) also borrowed Zarathustra's mouth and said, "You have already walked the road from insects to people, and there are many among you who are insects." You have been monkeys, and now, people are especially monkeys, no matter which monkey they are." Moreover, the restraint of "Medicine" also clearly retains the retention of L. Andreev) style of coldness. However, the later "Diary of a Madman" is intended to expose the evils of the family system and etiquette, but it is deeper than Gogol's anger, and not as insignificant as Nietzsche's superman. Since then, although he has been separated from the influence of foreign writers, his skills have become slightly more mature, and his portrayal has been slightly deepened, such as "Soap", "Divorce", etc., but on the other hand, his enthusiasm has also decreased and he has not been noticed by readers.从《新青年》上，此外也没有养成什么小说的作家。
From "New Youth", there are also writers who have not developed any novels.较多的倒是在《新潮》上。从一九一九年一月创刊，到次年主干者们出洋留学而消灭的两个年中，小说作者就有汪敬熙，罗家伦，杨振声，俞平伯，欧阳予倩和叶绍钧。自然，技术是幼稚的，往往留存着旧小说上的写法和语调；而且平铺直叙，一泻无余；或者过于巧合，在一刹时中，在一个人上，会聚集了一切难堪的不幸。然而又有一种共同前进的趋向，是这时的作者们，没有一个以为小说是脱俗的文学，除了为艺术之外，一无所为的。他们每作一篇，都是“有所为”而发，是在用改革社会的器械，——虽然也没有设定终极的目标。
More on "New Wave". From its inception in January 1919 to the two years when the main actors went abroad to study abroad and disappeared, the authors of the novel included Wang Jingxi, Luo Jialun, Yang Zhensheng, Yu Pingbo, Ouyang Yuqian and Ye Shaojun. Naturally, technology is naïve, and the writing and intonation of old novels are often preserved; And it is flat and straightforward, and there is no room for it; Or too coincidentally, in an instant, on a person, all embarrassing misfortunes will gather. However, there is another common trend, that is, none of the authors at this time thought that novels were refined literature, and they did nothing but art. Every time they write, they are "doing something", using the tools of social reform,—— although they do not set an ultimate goal.俞平伯的《花匠》以为人们应该屏绝矫揉造作，任其自然，罗家伦之作则在诉说婚姻不自由的苦痛，虽然稍嫌浅露，但正是当时许多智识青年们的公意；输入易卜生（H. Ibsen）的《娜拉》和《群鬼》的机运，这时候也恰恰成熟了，不过还没有想到《人民之敌》和《社会柱石》。杨振声是极要描写民间疾苦的；汪敬熙并且装着笑容，揭露了好学生的秘密和苦人的灾难。但究竟因为是上层的智识者，所以笔墨总不免伸缩于描写身边琐事和小民生活之间。后来，欧阳予倩致力于剧本去了；叶绍钧却有更远大的发展。汪敬熙又在《现代评论》上发表创作，至一九二五年，自选了一本《雪夜》，但他好像终于没有自觉，或者忘却了先前的奋斗，以为他自己的作品，是并无“什么批评人生的意义的”了。序中有云——
Yu Pingbo's "Florist" thought that people should reject pretentiousness and let nature take its course, while Luo Jialun's work told the pain of unfree marriage, although it was a little superficial, but it was the public will of many intellectual young people at that time; Enter Ibsen (H. Ibsen's "Nala" and "Ghosts" are also ripe at this time, but they have not yet thought of "Enemy of the People" and "Social Pillar". Yang Zhensheng is very desperate to describe the suffering of the people; Wang Jingxi also smiled and exposed the secrets of good students and the disasters of suffering people. But because he is an upper-class intellectual, his pen and ink are inevitably expanded and contracted between describing the trivial matters around him and the lives of the common people. Later, Ouyang Yuqian devoted himself to the script; Ye Shaojun has a more ambitious development. Wang Jingxi published his creations in the "Modern Review", and by 1925, he had chosen a book "Snowy Night", but he seemed to have finally lost consciousness, or forgot his previous struggles, thinking that his own works had no "meaning of criticizing life". In the preface, there is a cloud—“我写这些篇小说的时候，是力求着去忠实的描写我所见的几种人生经验。我只求描写的忠实，不搀入丝毫批评的态度。虽然一个人叙述一件事实之时，他的描写是免不了受他的人生观之影响，但我总是在可能的范围之内，竭力保持一种客观的态度。
"When I write these novels, I try to faithfully describe the life experiences I have seen. I only want to be faithful to the description, without the slightest critical attitude. Although when a person describes a fact, his description is inevitably influenced by his outlook on life, but I always try to maintain an objective attitude within the scope of my ability.“因为持了这种客观态度的缘故，我这些短篇小说是不会有什么批评人生的意义。我只写出我所见的几种经验给读者看罢了。读者看了这些小说，心中对于这些种经验有什么评论，是我所不问的。”
Because of this objective attitude, my short stories will not have any meaning in criticizing life. I will only write a few experiences that I have seen for readers. I don't ask what readers have commented on these experiences after reading these novels. ”杨振声的文笔，却比《渔家》更加生发起来，但恰与先前的战友汪敬熙站成对蹠：他“要忠实于主观”，要用人工来制造理想的人物。而且凭自己的理想还怕不够，又请教过几个朋友，删改了几回，这才完成一本中篇小说《玉君》，那自序道——
Yang Zhensheng's writing style is more vivid than "The Fisherman", but it is just in opposition to his former comrade-in-arms Wang Jingxi: he must be "faithful to subjectivity" and use artificially to create ideal characters. And I was afraid that my ideals were not enough, so I consulted a few friends and deleted it several times, and then completed a novella "Yujun", which was self-prefaced——“若有人问玉君是真的，我的回答是没有一个小说家说实话的。说实话的是历史家，说假话的才是小说家。历史家用的是记忆力，小说家用的是想像力。历史家取的是科学态度，要忠实于客观；小说家取的是艺术态度，要忠实于主观。一言以蔽之，小说家也如艺术家，想把天然艺术化，就是要以他的理想与意志去补天然之缺陷。”
If someone asks Yujun if it is true, my answer is that no novelist tells the truth. It is the historian who tells the truth, and the one who tells lies is the novelist. Historians use memory, and novelists use imagination. Historians adopt a scientific attitude and must be faithful to objectivity; Novelists take an artistic attitude and be faithful to subjectivity. In a word, a novelist, like an artist, wants to make up for the defects of nature with his ideals and will. ”他先决定了“想把天然艺术化”，唯一的方法是“说假话”，“说假话的才是小说家”。于是依照了这定律，并且博采众议，将《玉君》创造出来了，然而这是一定的：不过一个傀儡，她的降生也就是死亡。我们此后也不再见这位作家的创作。
He first decided that "I want to make nature artistic", the only way is to "tell lies", "those who tell lies are novelists". So according to this law, and after listening to the opinions of the people, "Jade Lord" was created, but this is certain: it is just a puppet, and her birth is death. We have not seen this writer's work since.二
Two“五四”事件一起，这运动的大营的北京大学负了盛名，但同时也遭了艰险。终于，《新青年》的编辑中枢不得不复归上海，《新潮》群中的健将，则大抵远远的到欧美留学去了，《新潮》这杂志，也以虽有大吹大擂的豫告，却至今还未出版的“名著绍介”收场；留给国内的社员的，是一万部《孑民先生言行录》和七千部《点滴》。创作衰歇了，为人生的文学自然也衰歇了。
With the "May Fourth" incident, Peking University, the camp of this movement, was famous, but at the same time, it also suffered hardships and dangers. Finally, the editorial center of "New Youth" had to return to Shanghai, and the strong players in the "New Wave" group probably went far away to study in Europe and the United States. What was left for domestic members were 10,000 copies of "The Words and Deeds of Mr. Lonely People" and 7,000 copies of "Bits and Drops". Creation has declined, and literature for life has naturally declined.但上海却还有着为人生的文学的一群，不过也崛起了为文学的文学的一群。这里应该提起的，是弥洒社。它在一九二三年三月出版的《弥洒》（Musai）上，由胡山源作的《宣言》（《弥洒临凡曲》）告诉我们说——
But Shanghai still has a group of literature for life, but it has also risen to a group of literature for literature. What should be mentioned here is the Misa Society. In the "Musai" published in March 1923, the "Declaration" ("Misa Linfan Song") written by Hu Shanyuan tells us -
“我们乃是艺文之神；"We are the gods of art and literature; 
我们不知自己何自而生， We don't know where we came from, and 
也不知何为而生： doesn't know what we came from: 
………… ............ 
我们一切作为只知顺着我们的Inspiration！” We only know what we do to follow our Inspiration! ”

到四月出版的第二期，第一页上便分明的标出了这是“无目的无艺术观不讨论不批评而只发表顺灵感所创造的文艺作品的月刊”，即是一个脱俗的文艺团体的刊物。但其实，是无意中有着假想敌的。陈德征的《编辑余谈》说：“近来文学作品，也有商品化的，所谓文学研究者，所谓文人，都不免带有几分贩卖者底色彩！这是我们所深恶而且深以为痛心疾首的一件事。……”就正是和讨伐“垄断文坛”者的大军一鼻孔出气的檄文。这时候，凡是要独树一帜的，总打着憎恶“庸俗”的幌子。
By the second issue published in April, the first page clearly marked that this was "a monthly magazine without purpose, without artistic views, without discussion or criticism, but only publishing literary and artistic works created by inspiration", that is, it was a publication of a refined literary and artistic group. But in fact, there is an imaginary enemy unintentionally. Chen Dezheng's "Editor's Afterword" said: "Recently, literary works have also been commoditized, and the so-called literary researchers and so-called literati inevitably have a bit of a peddler background!" This is something we hate and deeply heartbreak. ......" is exactly the proclamation that is angry with the army of those who "monopolize the literary world". At this time, everything that wants to be unique is always under the guise of hating "vulgarity".一切作品，诚然大抵很致力于优美，要舞得“翩跹回翔”，唱得“宛转抑扬”，然而所感觉的范围却颇为狭窄，不免咀嚼着身边的小小的悲欢，而且就看这小悲欢为全世界。在这刊物上，作为小说作者而出现的，是胡山源，唐鸣时，赵景沄，方企留，曹贵新；钱江春和方时旭，却只能数作速写的作者。从中最特出的是胡山源，他的一篇《睡》，是实践宣言，笼罩全群的佳作，但在《樱桃花下》（第一期），却正如这面的过度的睡觉一样，显出那面的病的神经过敏来了。“灵感”也究竟要露出目的的。赵景沄的《阿美》，虽然简单，虽然好像不能“无所为”，却强有力的写出了连敏感的作者们也忘却了的“丫头”的悲惨短促的一世。
All works, indeed, are mostly very committed to beauty, to dance "fluttering back" and sing "twisting and intonating", but the range of feelings is quite narrow, and I can't help but chew on the small joys and sorrows around me, and I see this little joy and sorrow for the whole world. In this publication, as the author of the novel, it is Hu Shanyuan, Tang Mingshi, Zhao Jingyun, Fang Qiliu, Cao Guixin; Qian Jiangchun and Fang Shixu can only be counted as sketch authors. The most outstanding of them is Hu Shanyuan, whose "Sleep" is a practical manifesto and a masterpiece that envelops the whole group, but in "Under the Cherry Blossoms" (Issue 1), it is like the excessive sleep on this side, showing the nervousness of the disease on that side. "Inspiration" also has to reveal its purpose. Zhao Jingyun's "Ami", although simple, although it seems that it cannot be "done nothing", it powerfully writes the tragic and short life of the "girl" that even sensitive authors have forgotten.一九二四年中发祥于上海的浅草社，其实也是“为艺术而艺术”的作家团体，但他们的季刊，每一期都显示着努力：向外，在摄取异域的营养，向内，在挖掘自己的魂灵，要发见心里的眼睛和喉舌，来凝视这世界，将真和美歌唱给寂寞的人们。韩君格，孔襄我，胡絮若，高世华，林如稷，徐丹歌，顾，莎子，亚士，陈翔鹤，陈炜谟，竹影女士，都是小说方面的工作者；连后来是中国最为杰出的抒情诗人冯至，也曾发表他幽婉的名篇。次年，中枢移入北京，社员好像走散了一些，《浅草》季刊改为篇叶较少的《沉钟》周刊了，但锐气并不稍衰，第一期的眉端就引着吉辛（G. Gissing）的坚决的句子——
The Asakusa Society, which originated in Shanghai in mid-1924, is actually a group of writers who "art for art's sake", but their quarterly magazine, each issue shows their efforts: outward, in ingesting foreign nutrients, inwardly, digging out their own souls, discovering the eyes and mouthpieces in their hearts, to gaze at the world, and to sing truth and beauty to lonely people. Han Junge, Kong Xiangwo, Hu Xuruo, Gao Shihua, Lin Ruji, Xu Dange, Gu, Shazi, Yashi, Chen Xianghe, Chen Weimo, Ms. Zhuying are all novel workers; Even Feng Zhi, who later became China's most outstanding lyric poet, also published his graceful masterpieces. The following year, the center moved to Beijing, and the members seemed to be a little separated, and the quarterly magazine "Asakusa" was changed to the weekly magazine "Shen Zhong" with fewer pages, but the sharpness did not wane slightly, and the eyebrows of the first issue led to the introduction of G. Gissing's resolute sentence -
“而且我要你们一齐都证实……"And I want you all to confirm it together...... 
我要工作啊，一直到我死之一日。” I have to work until the day I die. ”

但那时觉醒起来的智识青年的心情，是大抵热烈，然而悲凉的。即使寻到一点光明，“径一周三”，却更分明的看见了周围的无涯际的黑暗。摄取来的异域的营养又是“世纪末”的果汁：王尔德（Oscar Wilde），尼采（Fr. Nietzsche），波特莱尔（Ch. Baudelaire），安特莱夫（L. Andreev）们所安排的。“沉自己的船”还要在绝处求生，此外的许多作品，就往往“春非我春，秋非我秋”，玄发朱颜，却唱着饱经忧患的不欲明言的断肠之曲。虽是冯至的饰以诗情，莎子的托辞小草，还是不能掩饰的。凡这些，似乎多出于蜀中的作者，蜀中的受难之早，也即此可以想见了。
But the mood of the awakened intellectual youth at that time was mostly warm, but sad. Even if you find a little light, you can see the boundless darkness around you more clearly. The exotic nutrients ingested are the juices of the "end of the century": Oscar Wilde, Nietzsche (Fr. Nietzsche), Baudelaire (Ch. Baudelaire), Antelfe (L. Andreev). "Sink your own ship" has to survive in a desperate place, and many other works are often "spring is not my spring, autumn is not my autumn", with black hair and red face, but singing a heartbroken song that has been troubled and does not want to say it clearly. Although Feng Zhi's poetry is adorned with poetry, Shazi's excuse is still unconcealable. All of these seem to be mostly from the authors of Shu, and the early suffering of Shu Zhong can be imagined.不过这群中的作者们也未尝自馁。陈炜谟在他的小说集《炉边》的“Proem”里说——
However, the authors in this group are not discouraged. Chen Weimo said in the "Proem" of his novel collection "Fireside" -“但我不要这样；生活在我还在刚开头，有许多命运的猛兽正在那边张牙舞爪等着我在。可是这也不用怕。人虽不必去崇拜太阳，但何至于懦怯得连暗夜也要躲避呢？怎的，秃笔不会写在破纸上么？若干年之后，回想此时的我，即不管别人，在自己或也可值眷念罢，如果值得忆念的地方便应该忆念。……”
"But I don't want that; Life is still at the beginning of my life, and there are many beasts of fate waiting for me over there. But don't be afraid. Although people don't have to worship the sun, why are they so timid that they have to hide even in the dark night? Why, won't the bald pen be written on torn paper? A few years later, looking back on me at this time, even if I don't care about others, I may also be missed, and if there is something worth remembering, I should remember it. ……”自然，这仍是无可奈何的自慰的伤心之言，但在事实上，沉钟社却确是中国的最坚韧，最诚实，挣扎得最久的团体。它好像真要如吉辛的话，工作到死掉之一日；如“沉钟”的铸造者，死也得在水底里用自己的脚敲出洪大的钟声。然而他们并不能做到，他们是活着的，时移世易，百事俱非；他们是要歌唱的，而听者却有的睡眠，有的槁死，有的流散，眼前只剩下一片茫茫白地，于是也只好在风尘洞中，悲哀孤寂地放下了他们的箜篌了。
Naturally, this is still a sad word of helpless masturbation, but in fact, Shen Zhong Society is indeed the most tenacious, honest, and longest-struggling group in China. It seems to really want to work until the day of death, as Jisin said; For example, the caster of the "sinking bell" has to knock out the great bell with his feet in the water even if he dies. However, they cannot do it, they are alive, times change, and everything is different; They wanted to sing, but some of the listeners were asleep, some died, some were scattered, and only a vast white land was left in front of them, so they had to put down their konghou in sadness and loneliness in the dusty id_0000 cave.后来以“废名”出名的冯文炳，也是在《浅草》中略见一斑的作者，但并未显出他的特长来。在一九二五年出版的《竹林的故事》里，才见以冲淡为衣，而如著者所说，仍能“从他们当中理出我的哀愁”的作品。可惜的是大约作者过于珍惜他有限的“哀愁”，不久就更加不欲像先前一般的闪露，于是从率直的读者看来，就只见其有意低徊，顾影自怜之态了。
Feng Wenbing, who later became famous for his "abandoned name", was also the author who appeared in "Asakusa", but did not show his strengths. In "The Story of the Bamboo Forest" published in 1925, I saw works that were diluted as clothes, but as the author said, could still "sort out my sorrow from them". It is a pity that the author cherishes his limited "sorrow" too much, and soon he does not want to be as flashy as before, so from the perspective of straightforward readers, he only sees his intentional low-keying and self-pity.冯沅君有一本短篇小说集《卷施》——是“拔心不死”的草名，也是一九二三年起，身在北京，而以“淦女士”的笔名，发表于上海创造社的刊物上的作品。其中的《旅行》是提炼了《隔绝》和《隔绝之后》（并在《卷施》内）的精粹的名文，虽嫌过于说理，却还未伤其自然；那“我很想拉他的手，但是我不敢，我只敢在间或车上的电灯被震动而失去它的光的时候，因为我害怕那些搭客们的注意。可是我们又自己觉得很骄傲的，我们不客气的以全车中最尊贵的人自命。”这一段，实在是五四运动直后，将毅然和传统战斗，而又怕敢毅然和传统战斗，遂不得不复活其“缠绵悱恻之情”的青年们的真实的写照。和“为艺术而艺术”的作品中的主角，或夸耀其颓唐，或衒鬻其才绪，是截然两样的。然而也可以复归于平安。陆侃如在《卷施》再版后记里说：“‘淦’训‘沈’，取《庄子》‘陆沈’之义。现在作者思想变迁，故再版时改署沅君。……只因作者秉性疏懒，故托我代说。”诚然，三年后的《春痕》，就只剩了散文的断片了，更后便是关于文学史的研究。这使我又记起匈牙利的诗人彼兑菲（Petöfi Sándor）题B. Sz.夫人照像的诗来——
Feng Yuanjun has a collection of short stories "Juan Shi" - the grass name of "Pulling Out the Heart and Not Dying", and it is also a work published in the publications of Shanghai Creation Society under the pseudonym "Ms. Gan" in Beijing since 1923. Among them, "Travel" is a famous text that refines the essence of "Isolation" and "After Isolation" (and in "Juan Shi"), although it is considered too reasonable, but it has not yet hurt its nature; "I would love to take his hand, but I don't dare, I only dare when the lights in the car vibrate and lose their light, because I am afraid of the attention of the passengers." But we feel very proud ourselves, and we unceremoniously call ourselves the most noble person in the car. This paragraph is really a true portrayal of the young people who will resolutely fight against tradition immediately after the May Fourth Movement, but are afraid of daring to fight resolutely against tradition, so they have to revive their "lingering feelings". It is completely different from the protagonist in the work of "art for art's sake", either boasting of his decadence, or flattering his talent. However, it can also return to peace. Lu Kanru said in the postscript to the reprint of "Juan Shi": "'Gan' teaches 'Shen', taking the meaning of 'Lu Shen' in 'Zhuangzi'. Now the author's thinking has changed, so the reprint was changed to Yuan Jun. …… It's just because the author is lazy, so I asked him to speak on my behalf. It is true that three years later, "Spring Traces" only left fragments of prose, and then there was the study of literary history. This reminds me of the Hungarian poet Petöfi Sándor's title B. Mrs. Sz.“听说你使你的男人很幸福，我希望不至于此，因为他是苦恼的夜莺，而今沉默在幸福里了。苛待他罢，使他因此常常唱出甜美的歌来。”
"I heard that you have made your man very happy, and I hope it is not, because he is a distressed nightingale, and now he is silent in happiness. He was so harsh that he often sang sweet songs. ”我并不是说：苦恼是艺术的渊源，为了艺术，应该使作家们永久陷在苦恼里。不过在彼兑菲的时候，这话是有些真实的；在十年前的中国，这话也有些真实的。
I am not saying that distress is the source of art, and for the sake of art, writers should be permanently trapped in distress. But in the time of Peter Dufei, this was somewhat true; In China ten years ago, this was somewhat true.三
Three在北京这地方，——北京虽然是“五四运动”的策源地，但自从支持着《新青年》和《新潮》的人们，风流云散以来，一九二〇至二二年这三年间，倒显着寂寞荒凉的古战场的情景。《晨报副刊》，后来是《京报副刊》露出头角来了，然而都不是怎么注重文艺创作的刊物，它们在小说一方面，只绍介了有限的作家：蹇先艾，许钦文，王鲁彦，黎锦明，黄鹏基，尚钺，向培良。
In Beijing,—— although Beijing is the birthplace of the "May Fourth Movement", since the people who supported "New Youth" and "New Wave" dispersed, the three years from 1920 to 22 have remarkably shown the scene of the lonely and desolate ancient battlefield. "Morning News Supplement", later "Beijing News Supplement" came to the fore, but they were not publications that paid much attention to literary and artistic creation, and they only introduced a limited number of writers on the side of novels: Jian Xianai, Xu Qinwen, Wang Luyan, Li Jinming, Huang Pengji, Shang Yue, Xiang Peiliang.蹇先艾的作品是简朴的，如他在小说集《朝雾》里说——
Jian Xianai's works are simple, as he said in the collection of novels "Morning Mist" -“……我已经是满过二十岁的人了，从老远的贵州跑到北京来，灰沙之中彷徨了也快七年，时间不能说不长，怎样混过的，并自身都茫然不知。是这样匆匆地一天一天的去了，童年的影子越发模糊消淡起来，像朝雾似的，袅袅的飘失，我所感到的只有空虚与寂寞。这几个岁月，除近两年信笔涂鸦的几篇新诗和似是而非的小说之外，还做了什么呢？每一回忆，终不免有点凄寥撞击心头。所以现在决然把这个小说集付印了，……借以纪念从此阔别的可爱的童年。……若果不失赤子之心的人们肯毅然光顾，或者从中间也寻得出一点幼稚的风味来罢？……”
“…… I am already over twenty years old, I came to Beijing from Guizhou, and I have been wandering in the gray sand for almost seven years. It went in such a hurry day by day, and the shadow of childhood became more and more blurred and faded, like morning mist, drifting away, and all I felt was emptiness and loneliness. In the past few years, in addition to a few new poems and plausible novels that have been doodled by pen and pen in the past two years, what else have you done? Every memory inevitably hits my heart a little miserable. So now I decided to print this collection of novels,...... To commemorate the lovely childhood that has been separated since then. …… What if people who do not lose their innocence are willing to patronize resolutely, or find a little childish flavor in the middle? ……”诚然，虽然简朴，或者如作者所自谦的“幼稚”，但很少文饰，也足够写出他心曲的哀愁。他所描写的范围是狭小的，几个平常人，一些琐屑事，但如《水葬》，却对我们展示了“老远的贵州”的乡间习俗的冷酷，和出于这冷酷中的母性之爱的伟大，——贵州很远，但大家的情境是一样的。
It is true that although it is simple, or as the author humbly says, it is "naïve", but there is little embellishment, which is enough to write the sorrow of his heart. The scope of his description is narrow, a few ordinary people, some trivial things, but such as "Water Burial", it shows us the coldness of the rural customs of "distant Guizhou", and the great ,—— of maternal love in this coldness is far away from Guizhou, but everyone's situation is the same.这时——一九二四年——偶然发表作品的还有裴文中和李健吾。前者大约并不是向来留心创作的人，那《戎马声中》，却拉杂的记下了游学的青年，为了炮火下的故乡和父母而惊魂不定的实感。后者的《终条山的传说》是绚烂了，虽在十年以后的今日，还可以看见那藏在用口碑织就的华服里面的身体和灵魂。
At this time - 1924 - Pei Wenzhong and Li Jianwu also published works by chance. The former is probably not a person who has always paid attention to creation, but "In the Sound of War and Horses" records the real feeling of young people who travel to study and are shocked for their hometown and parents under artillery fire. The latter's "The Legend of Zhongtiao Mountain" is gorgeous, although ten years later, you can still see the body and soul hidden in the splendid clothes woven by word of mouth.蹇先艾叙述过贵州，裴文中关心着榆关，凡在北京用笔写出他的胸臆来的人们，无论他自称为用主观或客观，其实往往是乡土文学，从北京这方面说，则是侨寓文学的作者。但这又非如勃兰兑斯（G. Brandes）所说的“侨民文学”，侨寓的只是作者自己，却不是这作者所写的文章，因此也只见隐现着乡愁，很难有异域情调来开拓读者的心胸，或者眩耀他的眼界。许钦文自名他的第一本短篇小说集为《故乡》，也就是在不知不觉中，自招为乡土文学的作者，不过在还未开手来写乡土文学之前，他却已被故乡所放逐，生活驱逐他到异地去了，他只好回忆“父亲的花园”，而且是已不存在的花园，因为回忆故乡的已不存在的事物，是比明明存在，而只有自己不能接近的事物较为舒适，也更能自慰的——
Jian Xianai narrated Guizhou, Pei Wenzhong cared about Yuguan, and all the people who wrote his chest with a pen in Beijing, whether he claimed to be subjective or objective, were often local literature, and from the Beijing side, they were the authors of overseas Chinese literature. But this is not like G. Brandeis (G. Brandes) refers to the "diaspora literature", the overseas Chinese only live in the author himself, but not the articles written by the author, so there is only nostalgia faintly, and it is difficult to have an exotic atmosphere to broaden the reader's mind or dazzle his vision. Xu Qinwen called his first collection of short stories "Hometown", that is, unknowingly, he recruited himself as the author of local literature, but before he started writing local literature, he had been banished by his hometown, and life expelled him to a different place, he had to recall the "father's garden", and it was a garden that no longer existed, because recalling the things that no longer existed in his hometown was more comfortable and more masturbating than the things that clearly existed, but only he could not approach——“父亲的花园最盛的几年距今已有几时，已难确切的计算。当时的盛况虽曾照下一像，如今挂在父亲的房里，无奈为时已久，那时乡间的摄影又很幼稚，现已模胡莫辨了。挂在它旁边的芳姊的遗像也已不大清楚，惟有父亲题在像上的字句却很明白：‘性既执拗，遇复可怜，一朝痛割，我独何堪！’
"It is difficult to calculate exactly how many years have passed since the peak years of my father's garden. Although the grand occasion at that time was once photographed, it is now hanging in my father's room, helpless for a long time, and the photography in the countryside was very naïve at that time, and now it is indistinguishable. The portrait of Sister Fang hanging next to it is not very clear, but the words inscribed on the portrait by my father are very clear: 'The sex is stubborn, and it is pitiful, and once it is cut off, how can I bear it!' ’“…………
“我想父亲的花园就是能够重行种起种种的花来，那时的盛况总是不能恢复的了，因为已经没有了芳姊。”
"I think my father's garden is to be able to replant all kinds of flowers, and the grandeur at that time can never be restored, because Sister Fang is gone."无可奈何的悲愤，是令人不得不舍弃的，然而作者仍不能舍弃，没有法，就再寻得冷静和诙谐来做悲愤的衣裳；裹起来了，聊且当作“看破”。并且将这手段用到描写种种人物，尤其是青年人物去。因为故意的冷静，所以也刻深，而终不免带着令人疑虑的嬉笑。“虽有忮心，不怨飘瓦”，冷静要死静；包着愤激的冷静和诙谐，是被观察和被描写者所不乐受的，他们不承认他是一面无生命，无意见的镜子。于是他也往往被排进讽刺文学作家里面去，尤其是使女士们皱起了眉头。
The helpless grief and anger are something that people have to give up, but the author still can't give up, and there is no way, so he will find calmness and witty to make clothes of grief and anger; Wrapped up, let's talk about it as "seeing through". And use this method to describe all kinds of characters, especially young characters. Because of the deliberate calmness, it is also deep, and in the end, it is inevitable to have a suspicious laugh. "Although there is jealousy, do not complain about the floating tiles", calm down to die quietly; The calmness and humor wrapped in indignation are unpleasant to the observers and the described, who do not recognize him as a lifeless and opinionless mirror. So he is often ranked among satirical literary writers, especially to the frowns of ladies.这一种冷静和诙谐，如果滋长起来，对于作者本身其实倒是危险的。他也能活泼的写出民间生活来，如《石宕》，但可惜不多见。
This kind of calmness and humor, if it grows, is actually dangerous for the author himself. He can also write about folk life vividly, such as "Shidang", but unfortunately it is rare.看王鲁彦的一部分的作品的题材和笔致，似乎也是乡土文学的作家，但那心情，和许钦文是极其两样的。许钦文所苦恼的是失去了地上的“父亲的花园”，他所烦冤的却是离开了天上的自由的乐土。他听得“秋雨的诉苦”说——
Looking at the theme and brushwork of some of Wang Luyan's works, it seems that he is also a writer of local literature, but the mood is extremely different from Xu Qinwen. Xu Qinwen was troubled by the loss of his "father's garden" on earth, but what he was troubled by was leaving the paradise of freedom in heaven. He heard "Qiu Yu's complaints" and said——“地太小了，地太脏了，到处都黑暗，到处都讨厌。人人只知道爱金钱，不知道爱自由，也不知道爱美。你们人类的中间没有一点亲爱，只有仇恨。你们人类，夜间像猪一般的甜甜蜜蜜的睡着，白天像狗一般的争斗着，撕打着……

The writer I am talking about in Hunan is Li Jinming, who left his hometown about a child. Four一九二五年十月间，北京突然有莽原社出现，这其实不过是不满于《京报副刊》编辑者的一群，另设《莽原》周刊，却仍附《京报》发行，聊以快意的团体。奔走最力者为高长虹，中坚的小说作者也还是黄鹏基，尚钺，向培良三个；而鲁迅是被推为编辑的。但声援的很不少，在小说方面，有文炳，沅君，霁野，静农，小酩，青雨等。到十一月，《京报》要停止副刊以外的小幅了，便改为半月刊，由未名社出版，其时所绍介的新作品，是描写着乡下的沉滞的氛围气的魏金枝之作：《留下镇上的黄昏》。
In October 1925, the Mangyuan Society suddenly appeared in Beijing, which was actually just a group of people who were dissatisfied with the editors of the "Beijing News Supplement", and set up a separate weekly magazine "Mangyuan", but still attached to the "Beijing News" to publish it, chatting about pleasure. The most powerful person is Gao Changhong, and the backbone of the novel is still Huang Pengji, Shang Yue, and Xiang Peiliang; And Lu Xun was pushed to be the editor. But there are a lot of supporters, in terms of novels, there are Wen Bing, Yuan Jun, Jiye, Jing Nong, Xiao Mo, Qing Yu, etc. By November, the Beijing News was going to stop writing a small amount other than the supplement, so it was changed to a semi-monthly magazine, published by Weiming Society, and the new work introduced at that time was Wei Jinzhi's work that described the stagnant atmosphere of the countryside: "Leaving the Twilight in the Town".但不久这莽原社内部冲突了，长虹一流，便在上海设立了狂飙社。所谓“狂飙运动”，那草案其实是早藏在长虹的衣袋里面的，常要乘机而出，先就印过几期周刊；那《宣言》，又曾在一九二五年三月间的《京报副刊》上发表，但尚未以“超人”自命，还带着并不自满的声音——
But soon there was a conflict within the Mangyuan Society, and Changhong was first-class, so he set up the Hurricane Society in Shanghai. The so-called "Hurricane Movement", the draft was actually hidden in Changhong's pocket, and he often had to take the opportunity to go out, and he had to print several issues of weekly magazines first; The "Declaration" was published in the "Beijing News Supplement" in March 1925, but it did not yet call itself a "superman", and it still had a voice that was not complacent——“黑沉沉的暗夜，一切都熟睡了，死一般的，没有一点声音，一件动作，阒寂无聊的长夜呵！
"In the dark night, everything is asleep, dead, without a sound, a movement, a long night of silence and boredom!“这样的，几百年几百年的时期过去了，而晨光没有来，黑夜没有止息。
"In this way, hundreds and hundreds of years have passed, but the morning light has not come, and the night has not stopped.“死一般的，一切的人们，都沉沉的睡着了。
"Like death, all the people fell asleep.“于是有几个人，从黑暗中醒来，便互相呼唤着：
So several people, awakening from the darkness, called out to each other:“——时候到了，期待已经够了。
- The time has come, and the anticipation is enough.“——是呵，我们要起来了。我们呼唤着，使一切不安于期待的人们也起来罢。
"——Yes, we're going to get up. We call all those who are disturbed by expectations to rise up.“——若是晨光终于不来，那么，也起来罢。我们将点起灯来，照耀我们幽暗的前途。
——If the morning light doesn't come at all, then get up. We will light the lamp and shine on our dark future.“——软弱是不行的，睡着希望是不行的。我们要作强者，打倒障碍或者被障碍压倒。我们并不惧怯，也不躲避。
- Weakness is not good, hope is not good. We want to be strong, to break down obstacles or be overwhelmed by obstacles. We are not afraid or shy away.“这样呼唤着，虽然是微弱的罢，听呵，从东方，从西方，从南方，从北方，隐隐的来了强大的应声，比我们更要强大的应声。
"Calling like this, although it is faint, listen, from the east, from the west, from the south, from the north, there is a faint powerful response, a stronger response than us.“一滴水泉可以作江河之始流，一片树叶之飘动可以兆暴风之将来，微小的起源可以生出伟大的结果。因为这个缘故，我们的周刊便叫作《狂飙》。”
"A drop of water can be the beginning of a river, the fluttering of a leaf can indicate the future of a storm, and a small origin can produce great results. Because of this, our weekly magazine is called "Hurricane". ”不过后来却日见其自以为“超越”了。然而拟尼采样的彼此都不能解的格言式的文章，终于使周刊难以存在，可记的也仍然只是小说方面的黄鹏基，尚钺，——其实是向培良一个作者而已。
However, later on, he saw that he thought he was "transcending".
