Huang Pengji printed his short story into a book called "Thorns", and when he met readers for the second time, he had changed his name to "Pengqi". He first understood Xiaochang's idea that literature should not be like butter, it should be like thorns, and writers should not be depressed, but should be strong people; In "The Literature of Thorns" (the twenty-eighth issue of "Mangyuan" Weekly), he explained that "literature is by no means a boring thing", "writers are not necessarily a unique and special nation", and "they are not mermaids who cry all day long". He said—“我以为中国现代的作品，应该是像一丛荆棘。因为在一片沙漠里，憧憬的花都会慢慢地消灭的，社会生出荆棘来，他的叶是有刺的，他的茎是有刺的，以至于他的根也是有刺的。——请不要拿植物生理来反驳我——一篇作品的思想，的结构，的练句，的用字，都应该把我们常感觉到的刺的意味儿表现出来。真的文学家……应该先站起来，使我们不得不站起来。他应该充实自己的力，让人们怎样充实他自己的力，知道他自己的力，表现他自己的力。一篇作品的成功至少要使读者一直读下去，无暇辨文字的美恶，——恶劣的感觉，固然不好，就是美妙的感觉，也算失败。——而要想因循，苟且而不得。怎样抓着他的病的深处，就很利害地刺他一下。一般整饬的结构，平凡的字句，会使他跑到旁处去的，我们应该反对。
"I thought that modern Chinese works should be like a bush of thorns. Because in a desert, the flowers of longing will slowly disappear, and the society will give birth to thorns, and his leaves will be thorny, and his stems will be thorny, so that his roots will also be thorny. ——Please don't use plant physiology to refute me - the ideas, structure, sentences, and words of a work should express the meaning of thorns that we often feel. A real writer...... It should be the first to stand up, so that we have to stand up. He should enrich his own power, how to let people enrich his own power, know his own power, and show his own strength. The success of a work must at least make the reader read it all the time, and there is no time to distinguish the beauty and evil of the text ,—— the bad feeling, which is not good, even if it is a wonderful feeling, it can be regarded as a failure. - And if you want to follow the old ways, you can't do it. How to grasp the depths of his illness, stab him very interestingly. The general structure of rectification and ordinary words will make him run to the side, and we should oppose it.“‘沙漠里遍生了荆棘，中国人就会过人的生活了！’这是我相信的。”
"'The desert is full of thorns, and the Chinese will live a human life!' That's what I believe. ”朋其的作品的确和他的主张并不怎么背驰，他用流利而诙谐的言语，暴露，描画，讽刺着各式人物，尤其是智识者层。他或者装着傻子，说出青年的思想来，或者化为渝腿，跑进阔佬们的家里去。但也许因为力求生动，流利的缘故罢，抉剔就不能深，而且结末的特地装置的滑稽，也往往毁损掉全篇的力量。讽刺文学是能死于自身的故意的戏笑的。不久他又“自招”（《荆棘》卷首）道：“写出‘刺的文学’四字，也不过因了每天对于霸王鞭的欣赏，和自己的‘生也不辰’，未能十分领略花的意味儿，”那可大有徘徊之状了。此后也没有再看见他“刺的文学”。
Pengqi's works do not contradict his ideas much, and he uses fluent and witty words to expose, depict, and satirize various characters, especially the intellectuals. He either pretended to be a fool and said the thoughts of a young man, or turned into a leg and ran into the homes of the broad guys. But perhaps because of the pursuit of vividness and fluency, the selection cannot be deep, and the humor of the special device at the end often destroys the power of the whole piece. Satirical literature can die from its own deliberate jokes. Soon he "recruited himself" (at the beginning of "Thorns"): "Writing the four words 'thorny literature' is only because of the daily appreciation of the overlord whip and his own 'birth is not good', and he has not been able to fully appreciate the meaning of flowers," which is quite wandering. Since then, I have not seen his "thorny literature" again.尚钺的创作，也是意在讥刺，而且暴露，搏击的，小说集《斧背》之名，便是自提的纲要。他创作的态度，比朋其严肃，取材也较为广泛，时时描写着风气未开之处——河南信阳——的人民。可惜的是为才能所限，那斧背就太轻小了，使他为公和为私的打击的效力，大抵失在由于器械不良，手段生涩的不中里。
Shang Yue's creation is also intended to be sarcastic, and exposed, fighting, and the name of the novel collection "Axe Back" is the outline of his own proposal. His creative attitude is more serious than Pengqi, and the materials are also more extensive, and he always describes the people of Xinyang, Henan, a place where the atmosphere has not yet opened. Unfortunately, due to the limitations of his talents, the axe back was too light, so that his effectiveness in attacking the public and private was probably lost due to poor equipment and jerky means.向培良当发表他第一本小说集《飘渺的梦》时，一开首就说——
When Xiang Peiliang published his first collection of novels "Ethereal Dreams", he said at the beginning -“时间走过去的时候，我的心灵听见轻微的足音，我把这个很拙笨地移到纸上去了，这就是我这本小册子的来源罢！”
"As time passed, my mind heard the slight sound of footsteps, and I clumsily moved this to the paper, which is the source of my pamphlet!"的确，作者向我们叙述着他的心灵所听到的时间的足音，有些是借了儿童时代的天真的爱和憎，有些是借着羁旅时候的寂寞的闻和见，然而他并不“拙笨”，却也不矫揉造作，只如熟人相对，娓娓而谈，使我们在不甚操心的倾听中，感到一种生活的色相。但是，作者的内心是热烈的，倘不热烈，也就不能这么平静的娓娓而谈了，所以他虽然间或休息于过去的“已经失去的童心”中，却终于爱了现在的“在强有力的憎恶后面，发现更强有力的爱”的“虚无的反抗者”，向我们绍介了强有力的《我离开十字街头》。下面这一段就是那不知名的反抗者所自述的憎恶——
Indeed, the author narrates to us the footsteps of time heard by his heart, some borrowing the naïve love and hate of childhood, and some through the lonely smell and sight of travel, but he is not "clumsy", but he is not pretentious, just like acquaintances facing each other, talking eloquently, so that we can feel a hue of life in the listening without worrying too much. However, the author's heart is warm, and if he is not warm, he cannot talk so calmly, so although he occasionally rests in the "lost childlike innocence" of the past, he finally loves the current "nihilistic rebel" who "finds stronger love behind strong hatred", and introduces us to the powerful "I Leave the Cross Street". The following paragraph is the self-described hatred of the unknown rebel -“为什么我要跑出北京？这个我也说不出很多的道理。总而言之：我已经讨厌了这古老的虚伪的大城。在这里面游离了四年之后，我已经刻骨地讨厌了这古老的虚伪的大城。在这里面，我只看见请安，打拱，要皇帝，恭维执政——卑怯的奴才！卑劣，怯懦，狡猾，以及敏捷的逃躲，这都是奴才们的绝技！厌恶的深感在我口中，好似生的腥鱼在我口中一般；我需要呕吐，于是提着我的棍走了。”
"Why should I run out of Beijing? I can't say much about this. In short: I already hate this old hypocritical big city. After four years of wandering here, I have hated this ancient hypocritical big city. In this, I only see greetings, arches, emperors, and compliments to the rulers - cowardly servants! Meanness, cowardice, cunning, and agile evasion are all the stunts of the minions! The deep feeling of disgust is in my mouth, like raw fishing fish in my mouth; I needed to vomit, so I took my stick and left. ”在这里听到了尼采声，正是狂飙社的进军的鼓角。尼采教人们准备着“超人”的出现，倘不出现，那准备便是空虚。但尼采却自有其下场之法的：发狂和死。否则，就不免安于空虚，或者反抗这空虚，即使在孤独中毫无“末人”的希求温暖之心，也不过蔑视一切权威，收缩而为虚无主义者（Nihilist）。巴札罗夫（Bazarov）是相信科学的；他为医术而死，一到所蔑视的并非科学的权威而是科学本身，那就成为沙宁（Sanin）之徒，只好以一无所信为名，无所不为为实了。但狂飙社却似乎仅止于“虚无的反抗”，不久就散了队，现在所遗留的，就只有向培良的这响亮的战叫，说明着半绥惠略夫（Sheveriov）式的“憎恶”的前途。
Here I heard Nietzsche's voice, which was the drum and horn of the Hurricane Society's march. Nietzsche taught people to prepare for the appearance of "superman", and if they do not appear, then the preparation is empty. But Nietzsche has his own way of ending: madness and death. Otherwise, it is inevitable to be content with emptiness, or to resist this emptiness, even if there is no "last man" in loneliness to seek warmth, it will only despise all authority and shrink into a nihilist. Bazarov believes in science; He died for medicine, and when he arrived, he despised not the authority of science but science itself, so he became a disciple of Sanin, and had to do everything in the name of believing in nothing. But the Hurricane Society seemed to stop at the "nihilistic resistance", and soon disbanded, and now all that is left is the loud battle cry of Xiang Peiliang, which illustrates the future of the semi-Sui Huiliov-style "abomination".未名社却相反，主持者韦素园，是宁愿作为无名的泥土，来栽植奇花和乔木的人，事业的中心，也多在外国文学的译述。待到接办《莽原》后，在小说方面，魏金枝之外，又有李霁野，以锐敏的感觉创作，有时深而细，真如数着每一片叶的叶脉，但因此就往往不能广，这也是孤寂的发掘者所难以两全的。台静农是先不想到写小说，后不愿意写小说的人，但为了韦素园的奖劝，为了《莽原》的索稿，他挨到一九二六年，也只得动手了。《地之子》的后记里自己说——
On the contrary, the host Wei Suyuan is a person who would rather be a nameless soil to plant strange flowers and trees, and the center of his career is also mostly in the translation of foreign literature. After taking over "Mangyuan", in terms of novels, in addition to Wei Jinzhi, there is Li Jiye, who creates with a sharp feeling, sometimes deep and thin, like counting the veins of each leaf, but therefore it is often not wide, which is also difficult for lonely excavators to have both. Tai Jingnong was a person who did not want to write a novel at first, and then was unwilling to write a novel, but for Wei Suyuan's persuasion and for the manuscript of "Mangyuan", he had to do it until 1926. In the afterword of "Son of the Earth", he said -“那时我开始写了两三篇，预备第二年用。素园看了，他很满意我从民间取材；他遂劝我专在这一方面努力，并且举了许多作家的例子。其实在我倒不大乐于走这一条路。人间的酸辛和凄楚，我耳边所听到的，目中所看见的，已经是不堪了；现在又将它用我的心血细细地写出，能说这不是不幸的事么？同时我又没有生花的笔，能够献给我同时代的少男少女以伟大的欢欣。”
"At that time, I started writing two or three articles, ready to use them for the next year. Su Yuan read it, and he was very satisfied that I took materials from the folk; He advised me to focus on this area and gave examples of many writers. In fact, I am not very happy to take this path. The bitterness and misery of the world, what I hear in my ears and what I see in my eyes, is already unbearable; Now I have written it carefully with my own efforts, can I say that this is not an unfortunate thing? At the same time, I don't have a pen to dedicate to the boys and girls of my generation with great joy. ”此后还有《建塔者》。要在他的作品里吸取“伟大的欢欣”，诚然是不容易的，但他却贡献了文艺；而且在争写着恋爱的悲欢，都会的明暗的那时候，能将乡间的死生，泥土的气息，移在纸上的，也没有更多，更勤于这作者的了。
After that, there was "The Tower Builder". It is true that it is not easy to absorb "great joy" in his works, but he has contributed literature and art; And when I was fighting to write about the joys and sorrows of love, the light and dark of the city, there was no more person who could move the life and death of the countryside and the breath of the soil on paper, and I was more diligent than this author.五
Five临末，是关于选辑的几句话——
At the end, there are a few words about the anthology -一，文学团体不是豆荚，包含在里面的，始终都是豆。大约集成时本已各个不同，后来更各有种种的变化。在这里，一九二六年后之作即不录，此后的作者的作风和思想等，也不论。
First, literary groups are not pods, and what is included in them is always beans. It was already different when it was integrated, and later there were various changes. Here, works after 1926 are not recorded, and the style and thoughts of the authors after that are not included.二，有些作者，是有自编的集子的，曾在期刊上发表过的初期的文章，集子里有时却不见，恐怕是自己不满，删去了。但我间或仍收在这里面，因为我以为就是圣贤豪杰，也不必自惭他的童年；自惭，倒是一个错误。
Second, some authors have self-edited collections, and the early articles published in journals are sometimes not found in the collections, I am afraid that they are dissatisfied and delete them. But I may still accept it here, because I think it is a sage and a hero, and I don't have to be ashamed of his childhood; It's a mistake to be ashamed of yourself.三，自编的集子里的有些文章，和先前在期刊上发表的，字句往往有些不同，这当然是作者自己添削的。但这里却有时采了初稿，因为我觉得加了修饰之后，也未必一定比质朴的初稿好。
Third, some articles in the self-edited collection are often slightly different from those previously published in journals, which are of course corrected by the author himself. But sometimes the first draft is taken here, because I think that after adding embellishments, it may not necessarily be better than the simple first draft.以上两点，是要请作者原谅的。
The above two points are for the author's forgiveness.四，十年中所出的各种期刊，真不知有多少，小说集当然也不少，但见闻有限，自不免有遗珠之憾。至于明明见了集子，却取舍失当，那就即使并非偏心，也一定是缺少眼力，不想来勉强辩解了。
Fourth, I don't know how many journals have been published in ten years, and of course there are many collections of novels, but the knowledge is limited, and I can't help but regret the pearls. As for obviously seeing the collection, but making an inappropriate choice, then even if it is not partial, it must be a lack of eyesight and do not want to reluctantly defend it.一九三五年三月二日写讫。
Completed on March 2, 1935.

内山完造作《活中国的姿态》序

内山完造作《活中国的姿态》序

Uchiyama completed the preface to "The Posture of Living China"这也并非自己的发见，是在内山书店里听着漫谈的时候拾来的，据说：像日本人那样的喜欢“结论”的民族，就是无论是听议论，是读书，如果得不到结论，心里总不舒服的民族，在现在的世上，好像是颇为少有的，云。
It is said that a nation like the Japanese that likes "conclusions" is a nation that always feels uncomfortable if they can't get a conclusion, whether it is listening to discussions or reading, if they can't get a conclusion, it seems to be quite rare in today's world.接收了这一个结论之后，就时时令人觉得很不错。例如关于中国人，也就是这样的。明治时代的支那研究的结论，似乎大抵受着英国的什么人做的《支那人气质》的影响，但到近来，却也有了面目一新的结论了。一个旅行者走进了下野的有钱的大官的书斋，看见有许多很贵的砚石，便说中国是“文雅的国度”；一个观察者到上海来一下，买几种猥亵的书和图画，再去寻寻奇怪的观览物事，便说中国是“色情的国度”。连江苏和浙江方面，大吃竹笋的事，也算作色情心理的表现的一个证据。然而广东和北京等处，因为竹少，所以并不怎么吃竹笋。倘到穷文人的家里或者寓里去，不但无所谓书斋，连砚石也不过用着两角钱一块的家伙。一看见这样的事，先前的结论就通不过去了，所以观察者也就有些窘，不得不另外摘出什么适当的结论来。于是这一回，是说支那很难懂得，支那是“谜的国度”了。
After receiving this conclusion, it always feels very good. For example, about the Chinese, that is, like this. The conclusions of the study of China in the Meiji era seem to have been largely influenced by the "Chinese Temperament" made by someone in England, but recently, there has been a new conclusion. A traveler walked into the study of a wealthy official in the wilderness, saw many expensive inkstones, and said that China was a "country of elegance"; An observer who came to Shanghai, bought a few obscene books and pictures, and then looked for strange things, said that China was a "country of pornography". Even in Jiangsu and Zhejiang, the eating of bamboo shoots is regarded as evidence of erotic psychology. However, in places like Guangdong and Beijing, because there is little bamboo, bamboo shoots are not eaten much. If you go to the home or apartment of a poor literati, not only does it not matter if it is a study, but even the inkstone is just a guy who uses two dimes a piece. As soon as they saw such a thing, the previous conclusion could not be passed, so the observer was a little embarrassed and had to pick out some appropriate conclusion. So this time, it is difficult to understand that China is a "country of mysteries".据我自己想：只要是地位，尤其是利害一不相同，则两国之间不消说，就是同国的人们之间，也不容易互相了解的。
In my own opinion, as long as the status is different, especially the interests are different, it is not easy for the two countries to understand each other, let alone between people in the same country.例如罢，中国向西洋派遣过许多留学生，其中有一位先生，好像也并不怎样喜欢研究西洋，于是提出了关于中国文学的什么论文，使那边的学者大吃一惊，得了博士的学位，回来了。然而因为在外国研究得太长久，忘记了中国的事情，回国之后，就只好来教授西洋文学。他一看见本国里乞丐之多，非常诧异，慨叹道：他们为什么不去研究学问，却自甘堕落的呢？所以下等人实在是无可救药的。
For example, China has sent many international students to the West, and one of them seems to not like studying the West very much, so he put forward a paper on Chinese literature, which surprised the scholars there, and he got a doctorate and returned. However, because he studied abroad for too long and forgot about China, he had to teach Western literature after returning to China. When he saw the number of beggars in his country, he was very surprised and sighed: Why don't they study knowledge, but they are willing to fall? So the lower class is really hopeless.不过这是极端的例子。倘使长久的生活于一地方，接触着这地方的人民，尤其是接触，感得了那精神，认真的想一想，那么，对于那国度，恐怕也未必不能了解罢。
But this is an extreme example. If you live in one place for a long time, come into contact with the people of this place, especially contact with it, feel that spirit, and think about it seriously, then I am afraid that you may not be able to understand that country.著者是二十年以上，生活于中国，到各处去旅行，接触了各阶级的人们的，所以来写这样的漫文，我以为实在是适当的人物。事实胜于雄辩，这些漫文，不是的确放着一种异彩吗？自己也常常去听漫谈，其实是负有捧场的权利和义务的，但因为已是很久的“老朋友”了，所以也想添几句坏话在这里。其一，是有多说中国的优点的倾向，这是和我的意见相反的，不过著者那一面，也自有他的意见，所以没有法子想。还有一点，是并非坏话也说不定的，就是读起那漫文来，往往颇有令人觉得“原来如此”的处所，而这令人觉得“原来如此”的处所，归根结蒂，也还是结论。幸而卷末没有明记着“第几章：结论”，所以仍不失为漫谈，总算还好的。
The author has lived in China for more than 20 years, traveled everywhere, and came into contact with people from all walks of life, so I think he is really an appropriate character to write such a comic article. Facts speak louder than words, don't these comic texts really have a kind of brilliance? I often listen to ramblings, in fact, I have the right and obligation to support them, but because I have been an "old friend" for a long time, I also want to add a few bad words here. First, there is a tendency to talk more about China's merits, which is the opposite of my opinion, but the author also has his own opinion, so there is no way to think about it. Another point, it may not be a bad thing, that is, when reading the comic text, there are often places that make people feel "so so", and this place that makes people feel "so so", in the final analysis, is still a conclusion. Fortunately, the end of the book does not clearly record "Chapters: Conclusion", so it is still a rambling, and it is finally okay.然而即使力说是漫谈，著者的用心，还是在将中国的一部分的真相，绍介给日本的读者的。但是，在现在，总依然是因了各种的读者，那结果也不一样罢。这是没有法子的事。据我看来，日本和中国的人们之间，是一定会有互相了解的时候的。新近的报章上，虽然又在竭力的说着“亲善”呀，“提携”呀，到得明年，也不知道又将说些什么话，但总而言之，现在却不是这时候。
However, even if it is a nonsense, the author's intention is still to introduce part of the truth of China to Japanese readers. However, now, it is still because of various readers, and the result is different. This is a matter of no way. In my opinion, there will definitely be times when people in Japan and China understand each other. Although the recent newspapers are trying their best to say "goodwill" and "support", I don't know what they will say next year, but all in all, now is not the time.倒不如看看漫文，还要有意思一点罢。
It's better to read the comic text, and it's more interesting.一九三五年三月五日鲁迅记于上海。

“寻开心”

“寻开心”

“寻开心”

"Looking for happiness"我有时候想到，忠厚老实的读者或研究者，遇见有两种人的文意，他是会吃冤枉苦头的。一种，是古里古怪的诗和尼采式的短句，以及几年前的所谓未来派的作品。这些大概是用怪字面，生句子，没意思的硬连起来的，还加上好几行很长的点线。作者本来就是乱写，自己也不知道什么意思。但认真的读者却以为里面有着深意，用心的来研究它，结果是到底莫名其妙，只好怪自己浅薄。假如你去请教作者本人罢，他一定不加解释，只是鄙夷的对你笑一笑。这笑，也就愈见其深。
I sometimes think that a loyal and honest reader or researcher will suffer unjustly when he encounters two kinds of people's literary meanings. One is ancient eccentric poems and Nietzschean short sentences, as well as so-called futuristic works from a few years ago. These are probably written in strange words, sentences, and boring hard connections, plus several long lines of dots. The author was originally scribbling, and he didn't know what it meant. But serious readers think that there is a deep meaning in it, and study it with their hearts, but the result is inexplicable, so they have to blame themselves for being shallow. If you ask the author himself, he will definitely not explain, but just smile at you contemptuously. This smile is getting deeper and deeper.还有一种，是作者原不过“寻开心”，说的时候本来不当真，说过也就忘记了。当然和先前的主张会冲突，当然在同一篇文章里自己也会冲突。但是你应该知道作者原以为作文和吃饭不同，不必认真的。你若认真的看，只能怪自己傻。最近的例子就是悍膂先生的研究语堂先生为什么会称赞《野叟曝言》。不错，这一部书是道学先生的悖慢淫毒心理的结晶，和“性灵”缘分浅得很，引了例子比较起来，当然会显出这称赞的出人意外。但其实，恐怕语堂先生之憎“方巾气”，谈“性灵”，讲“潇洒”，也不过对老实人“寻开心”而已，何尝真知道“方巾气”之类是怎么一回事；也许简直连他所称赞的《野叟曝言》也并没有怎么看。所以用本书和他那别的主张来比较研究，是永久不会懂的。自然，两面非常不同，这很清楚，但怎么竟至于称赞起来了呢，也还是一个“不可解”。我的意思是以为有些事情万不要想得太深，想得太忠厚，太老实，我们只要知道语堂先生那时正在崇拜袁中郎，而袁中郎也曾有过称赞《金瓶梅》的事实，就什么骇异之意也没有了。
There is also a kind of author who is not "looking for happiness", and when he said it, he didn't take it seriously, and he forgot it after saying it. Of course, it will conflict with the previous proposition, and of course it will conflict with itself in the same article. But you should know that the author thinks that composition is different from eating, so you don't have to be serious. If you look at it seriously, you can only blame yourself for being stupid. The most recent example is Mr. Huang's research on why Mr. Yutang praised "The Wild Old Man's Exposure". Yes, this book is the crystallization of Mr. Taoism's arrogant and lewd psychology, and the fate of the "sexual spirit" is very shallow. But in fact, I am afraid that Mr. Yutang hates "square scarf qi", talks about "spirit", talks about "chic", and is just "looking for happiness" for honest people, how can he really know what "square scarf qi" is about; Maybe he didn't even think much of the "Wild Old Man's Exposure" he praised. Therefore, if you use this book to compare and study with his other propositions, you will never understand. Naturally, the two sides are very different, which is very clear, but how can it be praised, and it is still "incomprehensible". I mean that we should not think too deeply about some things, think too loyal, and be too honest, as long as we know that Mr. Yutang was worshiping Yuan Zhonglang at that time, and Yuan Zhonglang had also praised the fact of "Jin Ping Mei", there is no sense of horror.还有一个例子。如读经，在广东，听说是从燕塘军官学校提倡起来的；去年，就有官定的小学校用的《经训读本》出版，给五年级用的第一课，却就是“孔子谓曾子曰：身体发肤，受之父母，不敢毁伤，孝之始也。……”那么，“为国捐躯”是“孝之终”么？并不然，第三课还有“模范”，是乐正子春述曾子闻诸夫子之说云：“天之所生，地之所养，无人为大。父母全而生之，子全而归之，可谓孝矣。不亏其体，不辱其身，可谓全矣。故君子顷步而弗敢忘孝也。……”
There is also an example. For example, reading the scriptures, in Guangdong, I heard that it was advocated from the Yantang Military Academy; Last year, the "Jingxun Reader" for official primary schools was published, and the first lesson for the fifth grade was "Confucius said to Zengzi: The body and skin, suffer from the parents, dare not damage it, and filial piety is also the beginning." ......So, is "sacrificing one's life for the country" the "end of filial piety"? Not so, there is also a "model" in the third lesson, which is Le Zhengzi Chun who said Zengzi heard the words of the master: "What is born in heaven, what is raised by the earth, no one is great." Parents are born with a child, and a son is born with a child, which can be called filial piety. It does not harm one's body or humiliate oneself; it can be said to be complete. Therefore, a gentleman does not dare to forget filial piety even if he takes a short step. ……”还有一个最近的例子，就在三月七日的《中华日报》上。那地方记的有“北平大学教授兼女子文理学院文史系主任李季谷氏”赞成《一十宣言》原则的谈话，末尾道：“为复兴民族之立场言，教育部应统令设法标榜岳武穆，文天祥，方孝孺等有气节之名臣勇将，俾一般高官戎将有所法式云”。
There is also a recent example, in the March 7 issue of the China Daily. There is a speech by "Li Jigu, professor of Peking University and director of the Department of Literature and History of the Women's College of Arts and Sciences", in favor of the principles of the "Ten Declarations", and concluded: "In order to rejuvenate the nation, the Ministry of Education should order to try to flaunt Yue Wumu, Wen Tianxiang, Fang Xiaoru and other famous ministers and brave generals with integrity, so that ordinary high-ranking officials and generals will have a legal style."凡这些，都是以不大十分研究为是的。如果想到“全而归之”和将来的临阵冲突，或者查查岳武穆们的事实，看究竟是怎样的结果，“复兴民族”了没有，那你一定会被捉弄得发昏，其实也就是自寻烦恼。语堂先生在暨南大学讲演道：“……做人要正正经经，不好走入邪道，……一走入邪道，……一定失业，……然而，作文，要幽默，和做人不同，要玩玩笑笑，寻开心，……”（据《芒种》本）这虽然听去似乎有些奇特，但其实是很可以启发人的神智的：这“玩玩笑笑，寻开心”，就是开开中国许多古怪现象的锁的钥匙。
All of these are based on the fact that they are not very well studied. If you think of the "return to all" and the future conflict, or check the facts of Yue Wumu and see what the result is, whether the nation has been "revived", then you will definitely be teased and dazed, in fact, you are asking for trouble. Mr. Yutang gave a speech at Jinan University: "...... Be a serious person, and it is not easy to enter the wrong path,...... Once you go down the wrong path,...... Definitely unemployed,...... However, composition, to be humorous, is different from being a person, to play jokes and find happiness ,......" (according to the "Awn Zhong" version) Although this may sound a bit strange, it is actually very enlightening: this "joking and finding happiness" is the key to unlocking the lock of many strange phenomena in China.三月七日。

非有复译不可

非有复译不可

非有复译不可

There must be a duplicate translation好像有人说过，去年是“翻译年”；其实何尝有什么了不起的翻译，不过又给翻译暂时洗去了恶名却是真的。
It seems that someone said that last year was the "year of translation"; In fact, there is no great translation, but it is true that it temporarily washes away the notoriety of the translator.可怜得很，还只译了几个短篇小说到中国来，创作家就出现了，说它是媒婆，而创作是处女。在男女交际自由的时候，谁还喜欢和媒婆周旋呢，当然没落。后来是译了一点文学理论到中国来，但“批评家”幽默家之流又出现了，说是“硬译”，“死译”，“好像看地图”，幽默家还从他自己的脑子里，造出可笑的例子来，使读者们“开心”，学者和大师们的话是不会错的，“开心”也总比正经省力，于是乎翻译的脸上就被他们画上了一条粉。
It was very pitiful, and only a few short stories were translated into China, and the creator appeared, saying that it was a matchmaker, and the creator was a virgin. When men and women are free to communicate, who still likes to deal with matchmakers, of course it is declining. Later, a little literary theory was translated into China, but the "critic" humorist and others appeared again, saying that it was a "hard translation", "dead translation", "like looking at a map", and the humorist also made ridiculous examples from his own mind to make the readers "happy", the words of scholars and masters will not be wrong, and "happiness" is always more serious and labor-saving, so the face of the translator was painted with a powder by them.但怎么又来了“翻译年”呢，在并无什么了不起的翻译的时候？不是夸大和开心，它本身就太轻飘飘，禁不起风吹雨打的缘故么？
But why is there a "translation year" again, when there is no great translation? Isn't it exaggerated and happy, it's too light and fluttering, and it can't withstand the wind and rain?于是有些人又记起了翻译，试来译几篇。但这就又是“批评家”的材料了，其实，正名定分，他是应该叫作“唠叨家”的，是创作家和批评家以外的一种，要说得好听，也可以谓之“第三种”。他像后街的老虔婆一样，并不大声，却在那里唠叨，说是莫非世界上的名著都译完了吗，你们只在译别人已经译过的，有的还译过了七八次。
So some people remembered the translation and tried to translate a few. But this is the material of the "critic" again, in fact, he should be called a "nagging family", which is a kind other than the creator and the critic, and to put it nicely, it can also be called the "third type". He was like an old devout woman in the back street, not loud, but he was nagging there, saying that all the famous books in the world had been translated, and you were only translating what others had already translated, and some had translated it seven or eight times.记得中国先前，有过一种风气，遇见外国——大抵是日本——有一部书出版，想来当为中国人所要看的，便往往有人在报上登出广告来，说“已在开译，请万勿重译为幸”。他看得译书好像订婚，自己首先套上约婚戒指了，别人便莫作非分之想。自然，译本是未必一定出版的，倒是暗中解约的居多；不过别人却也因此不敢译，新妇就在闺中老掉。这种广告，现在是久不看见了，但我们今年的唠叨家，却正继承着这一派的正统。他看得翻译好像结婚，有人译过了，第二个便不该再来碰一下，否则，就仿佛引诱了有夫之妇似的，他要来唠叨，当然罗，是维持风化。但在这唠叨里，他不也活活的画出了自己的猥琐的嘴脸了么？
I remember that there was a trend in China before, when a book was published in a foreign country - probably Japan, I thought it would be for the Chinese to read, and someone would often publish an advertisement in the newspaper, saying, "It has already been translated, please do not retranslate it as a blessing." He saw the translation as if he was engaged, and he put on the engagement ring first, so that others would not think about it. Naturally, translations may not necessarily be published, but most of them are secretly terminated; However, others did not dare to translate because of this, and the bride grew old in the boudoir. I haven't seen this kind of advertisement for a long time, but our nagging family this year is inheriting the orthodoxy of this school. He saw that the translator seemed to be married, and someone had translated it, so the second one should not touch it again, otherwise, it would be like seducing a married woman, and he was going to nag, of course, Luo, to maintain the weather. But in this nagging, didn't he also draw his lewd face alive?前几年，翻译的失了一般读者的信用，学者和大师们的曲说固然是原因之一，但在翻译本身也有一个原因，就是常有胡乱动笔的译本。不过要击退这些乱译，诬赖，开心，唠叨，都没有用处，唯一的好方法是又来一回复译，还不行，就再来一回。譬如赛跑，至少总得有两个人，如果不许有第二人入场，则先在的一个永远是第一名，无论他怎样蹩脚。所以讥笑复译的，虽然表面上好像关心翻译界，其实是在毒害翻译界，比诬赖，开心的更有害，因为他更阴柔。
In the past few years, the translation has lost the credibility of ordinary readers, and the distortion of scholars and masters is certainly one of the reasons, but there is also a reason for the translation itself, that is, there are often translations that are written indiscriminately. However, it is useless to repel these nonsensical translations, slander, happiness, and nagging, and the only good way is to reply to the translation again, and if it doesn't work, do it again. For example, in a race, there must always be at least two people, and if no second person is allowed to enter, the first one will always be the first place, no matter how lame he is. Therefore, those who ridicule the translation, although they seem to care about the translation industry on the surface, are actually poisoning the translation industry, which is more harmful than the false and happy ones, because they are more feminine.而且复译还不止是击退乱译而已，即使已有好译本，复译也还是必要的。曾有文言译本的，现在当改译白话，不必说了。即使先出的白话译本已很可观，但倘使后来的译者自己觉得可以译得更好，就不妨再来译一遍，无须客气，更不必管那些无聊的唠叨。取旧译的长处，再加上自己的新心得，这才会成功一种近于完全的定本。但因言语跟着时代的变化，将来还可以有新的复译本的，七八次何足为奇，何况中国其实也并没有译过七八次的作品。如果已经有，中国的新文艺倒也许不至于现在似的沉滞了。
And retranslation is not only to repel random translations, even if there is a good translation, it is still necessary. There was a classical Chinese translation, but now it should be translated into vernacular, needless to say. Even if the first vernacular translation is already impressive, if the later translators themselves feel that they can translate better, they might as well try it again, without politeness, let alone those boring naggings. Taking the strengths of the old translation, coupled with my own new experience, this will succeed in a near-complete definitive version. However, because the language has changed with the times, it is not surprising that there will be new translations in the future, seven or eight times, not to mention that China has not actually translated works seven or eight times. If there were already one, China's new literature and art might not be as stagnant as it is now.三月十六日。

论讽刺

论讽刺

论讽刺

On satire我们常不免有一种先入之见，看见讽刺作品，就觉得这不是文学上的正路，因为我们先就以为讽刺并不是美德。但我们走到交际场中去，就往往可以看见这样的事实，是两位胖胖的先生，彼此弯腰拱手，满面油晃晃的正在开始他们的扳谈——
We often have a preconceived notion that when we see a satirical work, we think that this is not the right way in literature, because we first think that satire is not a virtue. But when we go to the social field, we can often see the fact that it is two chubby gentlemen, bending over and bowing to each other, their faces full of oil and starting their conversation——“贵姓？……”
"Your surname? ……”“敝姓钱。”
"My surname is money."“哦，久仰久仰！还没有请教台甫……”
"Oh, I've been looking up for a long time! I haven't asked Taifu yet......"“草字阔亭。”
"Cursive character wide pavilion."“高雅高雅。贵处是……？”
"Elegant and elegant. ...... your place? ”“就是上海……”
"It's Shanghai ......"“哦哦，那好极了，这真是……”
"Oh, that's great, this is really ......"谁觉得奇怪呢？但若写在小说里，人们可就会另眼相看了，恐怕大概要被算作讽刺。有好些直写事实的作者，就这样的被蒙上了“讽刺家”——很难说是好是坏——的头衔。例如在中国，则《金瓶梅》写蔡御史的自谦和恭维西门庆道：“恐我不如安石之才，而君有王右军之高致矣！”还有《儒林外史》写范举人因为守孝，连象牙筷也不肯用，但吃饭时，他却“在燕窝碗里拣了一个大虾圆子送在嘴里”，和这相似的情形是现在还可以遇见的；在外国，则如近来已被中国读者所注意了的果戈理的作品，他那《外套》（韦素园译，在《未名丛刊》中）里的大小官吏，《鼻子》（许遐译，在《译文》中）里的绅士，医生，闲人们之类的典型，是虽在中国的现在，也还可以遇见的。这分明是事实，而且是很广泛的事实，但我们皆谓之讽刺。
Who thinks it's strange? But if it is written in a novel, people will look at it differently, and I am afraid it will probably be counted as satire. There are many authors who write directly about the facts, and in this way, they are covered with the title of "satirist" - it is difficult to say whether it is good or bad. For example, in China, "Jin Ping Mei" wrote Cai Yushi's self-humility and compliments Ximen Qing: "I'm afraid I'm not as talented as Anshi, but you have the nobility of Wang Youjun!" There is also "The History of Confucianism" that Fan Juren refused to use even ivory chopsticks because of his filial piety, but when eating, he "picked a prawn ball in the bird's nest bowl and put it in his mouth", which is similar to what can still be encountered now; In foreign countries, such as Gogol's works, which have recently been noticed by Chinese readers, his "Coat" (translated by Wei Suyuan, in the "Unnamed Series"), and the gentlemen, doctors, and idlers in "Nose" (translated by Xu Xia, in the "Translation"), can still be encountered even in China now. This is clearly true, and it is a very broad fact, but we all call it irony.人大抵愿意有名，活的时候做自传，死了想有人分讣文，做行实，甚而至于还“宣付国史馆立传”。人也并不全不自知其丑，然而他不愿意改正，只希望随时消掉，不留痕迹，剩下的单是美点，如曾经施粥赈饥之类，却不是全般。“高雅高雅”，他其实何尝不知道有些肉麻，不过他又知道说过就完，“本传”里决不会有，于是也就放心的“高雅”下去。如果有人记了下来，不给它消灭，他可要不高兴了。于是乎挖空心思的来一个反攻，说这些乃是“讽刺”，向作者抹一脸泥，来掩藏自己的真相。但我们也每不免来不及思索，跟着说，“这些乃是讽刺呀！”上当真可是不浅得很。
People are probably willing to be famous, make autobiographies when they are alive, and want someone to share the obituary and do the truth when they die, and even "announce the biography of the National History Museum". People are not completely unaware of their ugliness, but he is unwilling to correct them, he just hopes to eliminate them at any time, leaving no trace, and the rest is only beautiful, such as giving porridge to relieve hunger, but it is not the whole thing. "Elegant and elegant", he actually didn't know that it was a little numb, but he knew that it was over, and there would never be it in the "biography", so he was relieved to go on "elegant". If someone writes it down and doesn't destroy it, he will be unhappy. So he made a counterattack, saying that these were "irony", and smeared his face with mud to hide his truth. But we often don't have time to think about it, and then say, "This is irony!" "It's really not shallow.同一例子的还有所谓“骂人”。假如你到四马路去，看见雉妓在拖住人，倘大声说：“野鸡在拉客”，那就会被她骂你是“骂人”。骂人是恶德，于是你先就被判定在坏的一方面了；你坏，对方可就好。但事实呢，却的确是“野鸡在拉客”，不过只可心里知道，说不得，在万不得已时，也只能说“姑娘勒浪做生意”，恰如对于那些弯腰拱手之辈，做起文章来，是要改作“谦以待人，虚以接物”的。——这才不是骂人，这才不是讽刺。
The same example is the so-called "scolding". If you go to the four roads and see a pheasant prostitute dragging people, if you say loudly: "The pheasant is soliciting guests", she will scold you for "scolding". scolding people is a vice, so you are judged to be on the bad side first; If you are bad, the other party is good. But the fact is that it is indeed "pheasants soliciting customers", but they can only know in their hearts that they can't say that when it is a last resort, they can only say that "the girl is doing business", just like for those who bend over and bow their hands, when they start writing, they want to change it to "treat people humbly and take things with humility". ——This is not scolding, this is not sarcasm.其实，现在的所谓讽刺作品，大抵倒是写实。非写实决不能成为所谓“讽刺”；非写实的讽刺，即使能有这样的东西，也不过是造谣和诬蔑而已。
In fact, the current so-called satirical works are probably realistic. Non-realism must not be the so-called "irony"; Non-realistic satire, even if there can be such a thing, is nothing more than rumors and slander.三月十六日。
March 16th.

从“别字”说开去

从“别字”说开去

从“别字”说开去

Let's start with "other words"自从议论写别字以至现在的提倡手头字，其间的经过，恐怕也有一年多了，我记得自己并没有说什么话。这些事情，我是不反对的，但也不热心，因为我以为方块字本身就是一个死症，吃点人参，或者想一点什么方法，固然也许可以拖延一下，然而到底是无可挽救的，所以一向就不大注意这回事。
From the discussion of writing other words to the current advocacy of the word at hand, I am afraid that it has been more than a year, and I remember that I did not say anything. I don't object to these things, but I'm not enthusiastic, because I think that the square word itself is a dead disease, eat some ginseng, or think of some way, of course, you may be able to delay it, but in the end it is irreparable, so I have never paid much attention to this matter.前几天在《自由谈》上看见陈友琴先生的《活字与死字》，才又记起了旧事来。他在那里提到北大招考，投考生写了误字，“刘半农教授作打油诗去嘲弄他，固然不应该”，但我“曲为之辩，亦可不必”。那投考生的误字，是以“倡明”为“昌明”，刘教授的打油诗，是解“倡”为“娼妓”，我的杂感，是说“倡”不必一定作“娼妓”解，自信还未必是“曲”说；至于“大可不必”之评，那是极有意思的，一个人的言行，从别人看来，“大可不必”之点多得很，要不然，全国的人们就好像是一个了。
A few days ago, I saw Mr. Chen Youqin's "Living Words and Dead Words" on "Free Talk", and I remembered the old things again. He mentioned the recruitment of Peking University there, and the candidates wrote a typo, "Professor Liu Bannong wrote a limerick to ridicule him, of course, it shouldn't be", but I "argued for it, but it is not necessary". The misspelling of the candidates is to use "Changming" as "Changming", Professor Liu's limerick is to interpret "advocate" as "prostitute", my miscellaneous feeling is that "advocate" does not necessarily have to be interpreted as "prostitute", and self-confidence is not necessarily a "song"; As for the comment of "it is not necessary", it is very interesting, a person's words and deeds, from the perspective of others, there are many points of "no need", otherwise, people in the whole country seem to be one.我还没有明目张胆的提倡过写别字，假如我在做国文教员，学生写了错字，我是要给他改正的，但一面也知道这不过是治标之法。至于去年的指摘刘教授，却和保护别字微有不同。（一）我以为既是学者或教授，年龄至少和学生差十年，不但饭菜多吃了万来碗了，就是每天认一个字，也就要比学生多识三千六百个，比较的高明，是应该的，在考卷里发见几个错字，“大可不必”飘飘然生优越之感，好像得了什么宝贝一样。况且（二）现在的学校，科目繁多，和先前专攻八股的私塾，大不相同了，纵使文字不及从前，正也毫不足怪，先前的不写错字的书生，他知道五洲的所在，原质的名目吗？自然，如果精通科学，又擅文章，那也很不坏，但这不能含含胡胡，责之一般的学生，假使他要学的是工程，那么，他只要能筑堤造路，治河导淮就尽够了，写“昌明”为“倡明”，误“留学”为“流学”，堤防决不会因此就倒塌的。如果说，别国的学生对于本国的文字，决不致闹出这样的大笑话，那自然可以归罪于中国学生的偏偏不肯学，但也可以归咎于先生的不善教，要不然，那就只能如我所说：方块字本身就是一个死症。
If I am a Chinese language teacher and a student writes a typo, I will correct him, but I also know that this is just a way to treat symptoms. As for last year's criticism of Professor Liu, it is slightly different from protecting other words. (1) I think that since I am a scholar or a professor, my age is at least ten years different from that of a student, not only has I eaten more than ten thousand bowls of food, but I have to recognize a word every day, and I have to know 3,600 more than students. Moreover, (2) The current school has a wide variety of subjects, and the previous private school specializing in eight strands, is very different, even if the text is not as good as before, it is not surprising, the previous scholar who did not write a typo, does he know the location of the five continents, the original name? Naturally, if you are proficient in science and good at writing, it is not bad, but this cannot be a student, if he wants to study engineering, then as long as he can build embankments and roads, control rivers and guide Huai River, it is enough, write "Changming" as "advocate", mistakenly "study abroad" as "flow learning", the embankment will never collapse because of this. If students from other countries will never make such a big joke about their own script, then it can naturally be blamed on the Chinese students' refusal to learn, but it can also be blamed on the teacher's poor teaching, otherwise, it can only be as I said: the square character itself is a mortal disease.改白话以至提倡手头字，其实也不过一点樟脑针，不能起死回生的，但这就又受着缠不清的障害，至今没有完。还记得提倡白话的时候，保守者对于改革者的第一弹，是说改革者不识字，不通文，所以主张用白话。对于这些打着古文旗子的敌军，是就用古书作“法宝”，这才打退的，以毒攻毒，反而证明了反对白话者自己的不识字，不通文。要不然，这古文旗子恐怕至今还不倒下。去年曹聚仁先生为别字辩护，战法也是搬古书，弄得文人学士之自以为识得“正字”者，哭笑不得，因为那所谓“正字”就有许多是别字。这确是轰毁旧营垒的利器。现在已经不大有人来辩文的白不白——但“寻开心”者除外——字的别不别了，因为这会引到今文《尚书》，骨甲文字去，麻烦得很。这就是改革者的胜利——至于这改革的损益，自然又作别论。
Changing the vernacular and even advocating the word at hand is actually just a little camphor needle, which cannot be brought back to life, but this is also a tangled obstacle, and it is still not over. I still remember that when advocating the vernacular, the first bullet of conservatives against the reformers was that the reformers were illiterate and illiterate, so they advocated using the vernacular. For these enemy troops under the banner of ancient texts, they used ancient books as "magic weapons", which repelled them, fighting poison against poison, but proved that those who opposed the vernacular themselves were illiterate and illiterate. Otherwise, I am afraid that this ancient flag will not fall to this day. Last year, Mr. Cao Juren defended the other words, and the tactics were also to move ancient books, which made the literati and scholars who thought they knew the "orthography" cry and laugh, because many of the so-called "orthography" were other words. This is indeed a powerful weapon to destroy the old camp. Nowadays, there are not many people who come to argue whether the text is white or not—except for those who are "looking for happiness" - the words are different, because this will lead to the current text of the "Book of Shang", and the bone armor text is very troublesome. This is the victory of the reformers - as for the benefits and losses of this reform, it is naturally a different matter.陈友琴先生的《死字和活字》，便是在这决战之后，重整阵容的最稳的方法，他已经不想从根本上斤斤计较字的错不错，即别不别了。他只问字的活不活；不活，就算错。他引了一段何仲英先生的《中国文字学大纲》来做自己的代表——
Mr. Chen Youqin's "Dead Words and Living Types" is the most stable way to reorganize the lineup after this decisive battle, and he no longer wants to fundamentally care about the mistakes of the words, that is, don't say good. He only asked if the words were alive; If you don't live, you are wrong. He quoted a passage of Mr. He Zhongying's "Outline of Chinese Philology" as his representative -“……古人用通借，也是写别字，也是不该。不过积古相沿，一向通行，到如今没有法子强人改正。假使个个字都能够改正，是《易经》里所说的‘幹父之蛊’。纵使不能，岂可在古人写的别字以外再加许多别字呢？古人写的别字，通行到如今，全国相同，所以还可解得。今人若添写许多别字，各处用各处的方音去写，别省别县的人，就不能懂得了，后来全国的文字，必定彼此不同，这不是一种大障碍么？……”
“…… The ancients used borrowing, and it was also written in other words, and it should not be. However, it has been passed down through the ages, and there is no way to correct it now. If every word can be corrected, it is the 'godfather's Gu' mentioned in the Book of Changes. Even if you can't, how can you add many other words in addition to the other words written by the ancients? The other characters written by the ancients are common to this day, and they are the same throughout the country, so they can still be understood. If people today add a lot of different characters, and write them everywhere with the square sound everywhere, people from other provinces and counties will not be able to understand, and later the characters of the whole country must be different from each other, isn't this a big obstacle? ……”这头几句，恕我老实的说罢，是有些可笑的。假如我们先不问有没有法子强人改正，自己先来改正一部古书试试罢，第一个问题是拿什么做“正字”，《说文》，金文，骨甲文，还是简直用陈先生的所谓“活字”呢？纵使大家愿意依，主张者自己先就没法改，不能“幹父之蛊”。所以陈先生的代表的接着的主张是已经错定了的，就一任他错下去，但是错不得添，以免将来破坏文字的统一。是非不谈，专论利害，也并不算坏，但直白的说起来，却只是维持现状说而已。
These first few sentences, with all due respect to me, are a bit ridiculous. If we don't ask if there is a way to force people to correct it, let's try to correct an ancient book first, the first question is what to use as "orthography", "Shuowen", Jinwen, Gujia text, or simply use Mr. Chen's so-called "movable type"? Even if everyone is willing to comply, the advocate himself cannot change it first, and cannot "his father's Gu". Therefore, Mr. Chen's subsequent proposition is already wrong, so let him be wrong, but he must not add to it, so as not to destroy the unity of the text in the future. Regardless of right and wrong, it is not bad to talk about the pros and cons, but to put it bluntly, it is just to maintain the status quo.维持现状说是任何时候都有的，赞成者也不会少，然而在任何时候都没有效，因为在实际上决定做不到。假使古时候用此法，就没有今之现状，今用此法，也就没有将来的现状，直至辽远的将来，一切都和太古无异。以文字论，则未有文字之时，就不会象形以造“文”，更不会孳乳而成“字”，篆决不解散而为隶，隶更不简单化为现在之所谓“真书”。文化的改革如长江大河的流行，无法遏止，假使能够遏止，那就成为死水，纵不干涸，也必腐败的。当然，在流行时，倘无弊害，岂不更是非常之好？然而在实际上，却断没有这样的事。回复故道的事是没有的，一定有迁移；维持现状的事也是没有的，一定有改变。有百利而无一害的事也是没有的，只可权大小。况且我们的方块字，古人写了别字，今人也写别字，可见要写别字的病根，是在方块字本身的，别字病将与方块字本身并存，除了改革这方块字之外，实在并没有救济的十全好方法。
Maintaining the status quo is always available, and there will be many people in favor, but it is not effective at any time, because in practice it is decided not to do it. If this method was used in ancient times, there would be no current situation, and if this method is used today, there would be no future status quo, and everything would be no different from ancient times until the distant future. In terms of words, when there is no writing, there will be no pictograms to create "texts", let alone breeding into "characters", and the seal will never be dissolved into slaves, and the slaves will not be simplified into the current so-called "real books". Cultural reform, like the popularity of the Yangtze River, cannot be stopped, and if it can be stopped, it will become stagnant water, and even if it does not dry up, it will be corrupt. Of course, when it is popular, if there is no harm, wouldn't it be even better? However, in reality, there is absolutely no such thing. There is no such thing as returning to the old way, there must be migration; There is no such thing as maintaining the status quo, there must be changes. There is no such thing as having a hundred benefits and no harm, only the size of the power. Moreover, our square characters, the ancients wrote other characters, and the modern people also write other characters, which shows that the root of the disease of writing other words is in the square word itself, and the disease of the other word will coexist with the square word itself, in addition to reforming this square word, there is really no perfect way to remedy it.复古是难了，何先生也承认。不过现状却也维持不下去，因为我们现在一般读书人之所谓“正字”，其实不过是前清取士的规定，一切指示，都在薄薄的三本所谓“翰苑分书”的《字学举隅》中，但二十年来，在不声不响中又有了一点改变。从古讫今，什么都在改变，但必须在不声不响中，倘一道破，就一定有窒碍，维持现状说来了，复古说也来了。这些说头自然也无效。但一时不失其为一种窒碍却也是真的，它能够使一部分的有志于改革者迟疑一下子，从招潮者变为乘潮者。
Retro is difficult, Mr. He also admits. However, the status quo cannot be maintained, because the so-called "orthography" of our ordinary scholars now is actually just the regulations of the former Qing Dynasty, and all the instructions are in the thin three so-called "Hanyuan Branches" of the "Character Studies Juyu", but in the past twenty years, there has been a little change in silence. From ancient times to the present, everything is changing, but it must be silent, if it is broken, there must be obstacles, maintaining the status quo is coming, and the retro theory is also coming. These statements are naturally invalid. But it is also true that it is a hindrance for a while, and it can make some aspiring reformers hesitate for a moment, from those who recruit the tide to those who ride the tide.我在这里，要说的只是维持现状说听去好像很稳健，但实际上却是行不通的，史实在不断的证明着它只是一种“并无其事”：仅在这一些。
What I want to say here is just to maintain the status quo and say that it sounds very stable, but in fact it does not work, and history continues to prove that it is just a kind of "nothing": only these are the ones.三月二十一日。

Tian Jun wrote the preface to "August Countryside"爱伦堡（Ilia Ehrenburg）论法国的上流社会文学家之后，他说，此外也还有一些不同的人们：“教授们无声无息地在他们的书房里工作着，实验X光线疗法的医生死在他们的职务上，奋身去救自己的伙伴的渔夫悄然沉没在大洋里面。……一方面是庄严的工作，另一方面却是荒淫与无耻。”
After Ilia Ehrenburg commented on the French high society writers, he said that there were also some different people: "Professors work silently in their study, doctors experimenting with X-ray therapy die in their posts, fishermen who fight to save their fellow fishermen quietly sink into the ocean. …… On the one hand, it is a solemn work, but on the other hand, it is absurd and shameless. ”这末两句，真也好像说着现在的中国。然而中国是还有更其甚的呢。手头没有书，说不清见于那里的了，也许是已经汉译了的日本箭内亘氏的著作罢，他曾经一一记述了宋代的人民怎样为蒙古人所淫杀，俘获，践踏和奴使。然而南宋的小朝廷却仍旧向残山剩水间的黎民施威，在残山剩水间行乐；逃到那里，气焰和奢华就跟到那里，颓靡和贪婪也跟到那里。“若要官，杀人放火受招安；若要富，跟着行在卖酒醋。”这是当时的百姓提取了朝政的精华的结语。
These last two sentences really seem to be talking about China now. However, China is even worse. There are no books at hand, and it is impossible to say what is found there, perhaps it is the work of the Japanese Yanai Gen clan, which has been translated into Chinese, and he once recorded how the people of the Song Dynasty were raped, captured, trampled and enslaved by the Mongols. However, the small court of the Southern Song Dynasty still showed its power to the people in the remnants of the mountains and waters, and had fun in the remnants of the mountains and waters; Fleeing there, arrogance and luxury follow, and decadence and greed follow. "If you want to be an official, kill and set fire to be recruited; If you want to be rich, follow the line to sell wine and vinegar. This is the conclusion of the people at that time who extracted the essence of the government.人民在欺骗和压制之下，失了力量，哑了声音，至多也不过有几句民谣。“天下有道，则庶人不议。”就是秦始皇隋炀帝，他会自承无道么？百姓就只好永远箝口结舌，相率被杀，被奴。这情形一直继续下来，谁也忘记了开口，但也许不能开口。即以前清末年而论，大事件不可谓不多了：雅片战争，中法战争，中日战争，戊戌政变，义和拳变，八国联军，以至民元革命。然而我们没有一部像样的历史的著作，更不必说文学作品了。“莫谈国事”，是我们做小民的本分。
Under deception and oppression, the people lost their strength, their voices were mute, and there were only a few folk songs at most. "If there is a way in the world, then the common people will not discuss." It is Qin Shi Huang Sui Emperor Yang, will he admit his wrongdoing? The people had to remain silent forever, killed and enslaved one after another. This situation continued, and no one forgot to speak, but maybe they couldn't. That is, in terms of the late Qing Dynasty, there are not many major events: the Yapian War, the Sino-French War, the Sino-Japanese War, the Wuxu Coup, the Boxer Change, the Eight-Power Allied Army, and even the Minyuan Revolution. However, we do not have a decent historical work, let alone a literary work. "Don't talk about state affairs" is our duty as a common people.我们的学者也曾说过：要征服中国，必须征服中国民族的心。其实，中国民族的心，有些是早给我们的圣君贤相武将帮闲之辈征服了的。近如东三省被占之后，听说北平富户，就不愿意关外的难民来租房子，因为怕他们付不出房租。在南方呢，恐怕义军的消息，未必能及鞭毙土匪，蒸骨验尸，阮玲玉自杀，姚锦屏化男的能够耸动大家的耳目罢？“一方面是庄严的工作，另一方面却是荒淫与无耻。”
Our scholars have also said: To conquer China, we must conquer the heart of the Chinese nation. In fact, some of the hearts of the Chinese nation have been conquered by our saints, wise ministers, and military generals. After the occupation of the three eastern provinces, when they heard that the wealthy families in Peiping were reluctant to rent houses from outside the pass, they were afraid that they would not be able to pay the rent. In the south, I am afraid that the news of the rebels may not be able to whip the bandits, steam the bones for autopsy, Ruan Lingyu commit suicide, and Yao Jinping's male transformation can sensational everyone's eyes and ears? "On the one hand, it is solemn work, but on the other hand, it is absurd and shameless."但是，不知道是人民进步了，还是时代太近，还未湮没的缘故，我却见过几种说述关于东三省被占的事情的小说。这《八月的乡村》，即是很好的一部，虽然有些近乎短篇的连续，结构和描写人物的手段，也不能比法捷耶夫的《毁灭》，然而严肃，紧张，作者的心血和失去的天空，土地，受难的人民，以至失去的茂草，高粱，蝈蝈，蚊子，搅成一团，鲜红的在读者眼前展开，显示着中国的一份和全部，现在和未来，死路与活路。凡有人心的读者，是看得完的，而且有所得的。
However, I don't know if it is because the people have progressed, or because the times are too close and have not yet disappeared, but I have seen several novels about the occupation of the three eastern provinces. This "August Countryside" is a very good one, although there are some almost short continuities, the structure and the means of describing the characters, cannot compare to Fadeev's "Destruction", but the seriousness, tension, the author's hard work and the lost sky, land, suffering people, and even the lost grass, sorghum, newt, mosquitoes, mixed together, bright red unfolds in front of the reader's eyes, showing China's part and whole, present and future, dead and alive. Readers with hearts can read it all and gain something.“要征服中国民族，必须征服中国民族的心！”但这书却于“心的征服”有碍。心的征服，先要中国人自己代办。宋曾以道学替金元治心，明曾以党狱替满清箝口。这书当然不容于满洲帝国，但我看也因此当然不容于中华民国。这事情很快的就会得到实证。如果事实证明了我的推测并没有错，那也就证明了这是一部很好的书。
"To conquer the Chinese nation, we must conquer the heart of the Chinese nation!" But this book is in the way of "the conquest of the heart". The conquest of the heart must first be handled by the Chinese themselves. Song once used Taoism to govern the heart for Jin Yuan, and Ming once used party prison to silence the Manchu Qing Dynasty. Of course, this book is not tolerated by the Manchurian Empire, but I think it is also incompatible with the Republic of China. This matter will soon be proven. If it turns out that my speculation is not wrong, it proves that this is a good book.好书为什么倒会不容于中华民国呢？那当然，上面已经说过几回了——
Why are good books not tolerated in the Republic of China? Of course, it has been said several times -“一方面是庄严的工作，另一方面却是荒淫与无耻！”
"On the one hand, it is solemn work, but on the other hand, it is absurd and shameless!"这不像序。但我知道，作者和读者是决不和我计较这些的。
This is not like the preface. But I know that the author and the reader will never care about this.一九三五年三月二十八日之夜，鲁迅读毕记。

Xu Maoyong wrote the preface to "Miscellaneous Collection"我觉得中国有时是极爱平等的国度。有什么稍稍显得特出，就有人拿了长刀来削平它。以人而论，孙桂云是赛跑的好手，一过上海，不知怎的就萎靡不振，待到到得日本，不能跑了；阮玲玉算是比较的有成绩的明星，但“人言可畏”，到底非一口气吃下三瓶安眠药片不可。自然，也有例外，是捧了起来。但这捧了起来，却不过为了接着摔得粉碎。大约还有人记得“美人鱼”罢，简直捧得令观者发生肉麻之感，连看见姓名也会觉得有些滑稽。契诃夫说过：“被昏蛋所称赞，不如战死在他手里。”真是伤心而且悟道之言。但中国又是极爱中庸的国度，所以极端的昏蛋是没有的，他不和你来战，所以决不会爽爽快快的战死，如果受不住，只好自己吃安眠药片。
I think China is sometimes a country that loves equality very much. If something stood out a little, someone took a long knife to flatten it. In terms of people, Sun Guiyun is a good runner, as soon as he passes Shanghai, he somehow languishes, and when he arrives in Japan, he can't run; Ruan Lingyu is a relatively accomplished star, but "people are terrifying", and she has to take three bottles of sleeping pills in one go. Naturally, there are exceptions, which are held up. But this was held up, but it was just to smash it to pieces. There are probably still people who remember "Mermaid", which simply makes the viewer feel numb, and even when they see the name, they will feel a little funny. Chekhov said: "It is better to die in battle than to be praised by a faint egg." "It's really sad and enlightening. But China is a country that loves the golden mean, so there is no extreme faint, he will not fight with you, so he will never die in battle happily, if you can't stand it, you have to take sleeping pills yourself.在所谓文坛上当然也不会有什么两样：翻译较多的时候，就有人来削翻译，说它害了创作；近一两年，作短文的较多了，就又有人来削“杂文”，说这是作者的堕落的表现，因为既非诗歌小说，又非戏剧，所以不入文艺之林，他还一片婆心，劝人学学托尔斯泰，做《战争与和平》似的伟大的创作去。这一流论客，在礼仪上，别人当然不该说他是“昏蛋”的。批评家吗？他谦虚得很，自己不承认。攻击杂文的文字虽然也只能说是杂文，但他又决不是杂文作家，因为他不相信自己也相率而堕落。如果恭维他为诗歌小说戏剧之类的伟大的创作者，那么，恭维者之为“昏蛋”也无疑了。归根结底，不是东西而已。不是东西之谈也要算是“人言”，这就使弱者觉得倒是安眠药片较为可爱的缘故。不过这并非战死。问是有人要问的：给谁害死的呢？种种议论的结果，凶手有三位：曰，万恶的社会；曰，本人自己；曰，安眠药片。完了。

In terms of etiquette, others should certainly not say that he is "faint". Critics? He was very modest and did not admit it. If he is praised as a great creator of poetry, novels, dramas, etc., then there is no doubt that the compliment is a "fool". At the end of the day, it's not just about things. The land is still the territory of the Zou clan, and its residence is adjacent to the palace of the King of Lu. I sigh that I am not dead, and I lament that the path is endless. Now look at the two pillars of the memorial service: it is still the same as when I dreamed. This is the first of the "Three Hundred Tang Poems", and it is the so-called "poem" in the poetry gate of "Introduction to Literature". But it has nothing to do with us, where we can catch up with these essays and are close to the present, and they are vivid, splashy, beneficial, and can also change people's feelings. If you can change favors, I'm very sorry, so I can't help but mess up your literary garden, at least, it's a lot of spitting that is not a thing or a thing, and it's stepped on without a trace, leaving only a face full of oil, sweat and alabaster paste.这嘴脸当然还可以唠叨，说那一首“夫子何为者”并非好诗，并且时代也过去了。但是，文学正宗的招牌呢？“文艺的永久性”呢？
Of course, this face can still nag, saying that the "What is the Master" is not a good poem, and the era has passed. But what about the sign of literary authenticity? What about the "permanence of literature and art"?我是爱读杂文的一个人，而且知道爱读杂文还不只我一个，因为它“言之有物”。我还更乐观于杂文的开展，日见其斑斓。第一是使中国的著作界热闹，活泼；第二是使不是东西之流缩头；第三是使所谓“为艺术而艺术”的作品，在相形之下，立刻显出不死不活相。我所以极高兴为这本集子作序，并且借此发表意见，愿我们的杂文作家，勿为虎伥所迷，以为“人言可畏”，用最末的稿费买安眠药片去。
I am a person who loves to read essays, and I know that I am not the only one who loves to read essays, because it "has something to say". I am also more optimistic about the development of essays, and I see them colorful every day. The first is to make China's writing circle lively and lively; the second is to shrink the head of the flow of things that are not things; The third is to make the so-called "art for art's sake" works immediately show the appearance of immortality and immortality in contrast. Therefore, I am very happy to write a preface to this collection, and take this opportunity to express my opinion, I hope that our essay writers will not be confused by the tiger and the tiger, thinking that "human words are terrifying", and use the last manuscript fee to buy sleeping pills.一九三五年三月三十一日，鲁迅记于上海之卓面书斋。
On March 31, 1935, Lu Xun recorded in the Zhuo Facebook study in Shanghai.

人生识字胡涂始

人生识字胡涂始

人生识字胡涂始

Life begins with literacy中国的成语只有“人生识字忧患始”，这一句是我翻造的。
The Chinese idiom only has "the beginning of literacy and worries in life", which I recreated.孩子们常常给我好教训，其一是学话。他们学话的时候，没有教师，没有语法教科书，没有字典，只是不断的听取，记住，分析，比较，终于懂得每个词的意义，到得两三岁，普通的简单的话就大概能够懂，而且能够说了，也不大有错误。小孩子往往喜欢听人谈天，更喜欢陪客，那大目的，固然在于一同吃点心，但也为了爱热闹，尤其是在研究别人的言语，看有什么对于自己有关系——能懂，该问，或可取的。
Children often teach me good lessons, one of which is learning to speak. When they learn to speak, there is no teacher, no grammar textbook, no dictionary, just constantly listening, remembering, analyzing, comparing, and finally understanding the meaning of each word. Children often like to listen to people talk, prefer to accompany guests, the main purpose is of course to eat snacks together, but also to love liveliness, especially to study other people's words, to see what has something to do with them - can understand, should ask, or be desirable.我们先前的学古文也用同样的方法，教师并不讲解，只要你死读，自己去记住，分析，比较去。弄得好，是终于能够有些懂，并且竟也可以写出几句来的，然而到底弄不通的也多得很。自以为通，别人也以为通了，但一看底细，还是并不怎么通，连明人小品都点不断的，又何尝少有？人们学话，从高等华人以至下等华人，只要不是聋子或哑子，学不会的是几乎没有的，一到学文，就不同了，学会的恐怕不过极少数，就是所谓学会了的人们之中，请恕我坦白的再来重复的说一句罢，大约仍然胡胡涂涂的还是很不少。这自然是古文作怪。因为我们虽然拚命的读古文，但时间究竟是有限的，不像说话，整天的可以听见；而且所读的书，也许是《庄子》和《文选》呀，《东莱博议》呀，《古文观止》呀，从周朝人的文章，一直读到明朝人的文章，非常驳杂，脑子给古今各种马队践踏了一通之后，弄得乱七八遭，但蹄迹当然是有些存留的，这就是所谓“有所得”。这一种“有所得”当然不会清清楚楚，大概是似懂非懂的居多，所以自以为通文了，其实却没有通，自以为识字了，其实也没有识。自己本是胡涂的，写起文章来自然也胡涂，读者看起文章来，自然也不会倒明白。然而无论怎样的胡涂文作者，听他讲话，却大抵清楚，不至于令人听不懂的——除了故意大显本领的讲演之外。因此我想，这“胡涂”的来源，是在识字和读书。
We used the same method in learning ancient texts before, and the teacher did not explain it, as long as you read it to death, you can remember, analyze, and compare it yourself. If you do it well, you can finally understand a little, and you can even write a few sentences, but there are many things that you can't understand in the end. I think I understand, and others think I understand, but when I look at the details, I still don't know much, and even the Ming people's sketches are constantly clicked, so why is it rare? People learn to speak, from higher Chinese to lower Chinese, as long as they are not deaf or mute, there are almost no people who can't learn, and when it comes to learning literature, it is different, and I am afraid that only a very small number of people have learned, that is, among the so-called learned people, please forgive me for repeating it frankly, there are still a lot of nonsense. This is naturally an ancient text. Because although we read ancient texts desperately, time is limited, unlike talking, which can be heard all day long; And the books I read, maybe "Zhuangzi" and "Anthology", "Donglai Bo Yi", "Ancient Texts and Observations", from the articles of the Zhou Dynasty to the articles of the Ming Dynasty, are very mixed, and after the brain trampled on various horse teams in ancient and modern times, it made a mess, but of course some hoof prints remained, which is the so-called "gained". Of course, this kind of "gain" will not be clear, probably most of them seem to understand but do not understand, so they think they are knowledgeable, but in fact they are not proficient, they think they are literate, but in fact they do not know. I am a fool, and I naturally write an article, and readers will naturally not understand when they read the article. However, no matter what kind of Hutu author listens to his speech, it is generally clear that it is not incomprehensible - except for the speech that deliberately shows off his skills. Therefore, I think the source of this "nonsense" is literacy and reading.例如我自己，是常常会用些书本子上的词汇的。虽然并非什么冷僻字，或者连读者也并不觉得是冷僻字。然而假如有一位精细的读者，请了我去，交给我一枝铅笔和一张纸，说道，“您老的文章里，说过这山是‘崚嶒’的，那山是‘巉岩’的，那究竟是怎么一副样子呀？您不会画画儿也不要紧，就钩出一点轮廓来给我看看罢。请，请，请……”这时我就会腋下出汗，恨无地洞可钻。因为我实在连自己也不知道“崚嶒”和“巉岩”究竟是什么样子，这形容词，是从旧书上钞来的，向来就并没有弄明白，一经切实的考查，就糟了。此外如“幽婉”，“玲珑”，“蹒跚”，“嗫嚅”……之类，还多得很。
For example, I often use some vocabulary from books. Although it is not a cold word, or even readers do not think it is a cold word. However, if a meticulous reader invites me, hands me a pencil and a piece of paper, and says, "In your old article, you said that this mountain is 'rugged' and that mountain is 'rocky', what does that look like?" It doesn't matter if you don't know how to draw, just hook out a little outline and show me. Please, please, please......" At this time, I will sweat under my armpits, and I hate that there is no hole to drill. Because I really don't even know what "rock" and "rock" look like, this adjective is from old books, and I have never figured it out, and once it is examined, it will be bad. In addition, such as "Youwen", "Exquisite", "Waddle", "Hiccup"...... There are still a lot of them.说是白话文应该“明白如话”，已经要算唱厌了的老调了，但其实，现在的许多白话文却连“明白如话”也没有做到。倘要明白，我以为第一是在作者先把似识非识的字放弃，从活人的嘴上，采取有生命的词汇，搬到纸上来；也就是学学孩子，只说些自己的确能懂的话。至于旧语的复活，方言的普遍化，那自然也是必要的，但一须选择，二须有字典以确定所含的意义，这是另一问题，在这里不说它了。
It is said that vernacular texts should be "clear as words", which is already an old tune that is tired of singing, but in fact, many vernacular texts now do not even achieve "clear as words". If you want to understand, I think the first is that the author first abandons the words that seem to be unrecognizable, takes living words from the mouth of the living, and moves them to the paper; That is, learn from children and only say what they can really understand. As for the revival of the old language and the universalization of the dialect, it is naturally necessary, but it must be chosen, and there must be a dictionary to determine the meaning of the language, which is another issue, and it will not be discussed here.四月二日。
April 2nd.

“文人相轻”

“文人相轻”

“文人相轻”

"Literati look down on each other"老是说着同样的一句话是要厌的。在所谓文坛上，前年嚷过一回“文人无行”，去年是闹了一通“京派和海派”，今年又出了新口号，叫作“文人相轻”。
It's annoying to say the same thing all the time. In the so-called literary world, there was a shout of "literati have no virtue" the year before last, last year it was a "Beijing school and Shanghai school", and this year a new slogan was issued, called "literati look down on each other".对于这风气，口号家很愤恨，他的“真理哭了”，于是大声疾呼，投一切“文人”以轻蔑。“轻蔑”，他是最憎恶的，但因为他们“相轻”，损伤了他理想中的一道同风的天下，害得他自己也只好施行轻蔑术了。自然，这是“即以其人之道，还治其人之身”，是古圣人的良法，但“相轻”的恶弊，可真也不容易除根。
The slogan was very indignant about this atmosphere, and his "truth cried", so he shouted loudly and threw all the "literati" in contempt. "Contempt", he hated the most, but because they "looked down on each other", they damaged his ideal world of the same wind, causing him to have no choice but to practice contempt. Naturally, this is "to treat others in their own way", which is the good law of the ancient sages, but the evil of "looking down on each other" is really not easy to eradicate.我们如果到《文选》里去找词汇的时候，大概是可以遇着“文人相轻”这四个字的，拾来用用，似乎也还有些漂亮。然而，曹聚仁先生已经在《自由谈》（四月九日至十一日）上指明，曹丕之所谓“文人相轻”者，是“文非一体，鲜能备善，是以各以所长，相轻所短”，凡所指摘，仅限于制作的范围。一切别的攻击形体，籍贯，诬赖，造谣，以至施蛰存先生式的“他自己也是这样的呀”，或魏金枝先生式的“他的亲戚也和我一样了呀”之类，都不在内。倘把这些都作为曹丕所说的“文人相轻”，是混淆黑白，真理虽然大哭，倒增加了文坛的黑暗的。
If we go to the "Anthology" to find vocabulary, we can probably encounter the four words "literati look down on each other", and it seems to be a bit beautiful to pick up and use. However, Mr. Cao Juren has already pointed out in "Free Talk" (April 9-11) that Cao Pizhi's so-called "literati are despised" is "literature is not one, and few can be prepared, so each has its own strengths and despises each other's shortcomings". All other attacks on forms, origins, falsehoods, rumors, and even Mr. Shi Zhicun's "He himself is like this" or Mr. Wei Jinzhi's "His relatives are the same as me" are not included. If these are all regarded as what Cao Pi said about "literati look down on each other", it is to confuse black and white, and although the truth cries loudly, it increases the darkness of the literary world.我们如果到《庄子》里去找词汇，大概又可以遇着两句宝贝的教训：“彼亦一是非，此亦一是非”，记住了来作危急之际的护身符，似乎也不失为漂亮。然而这是只可暂时口说，难以永远实行的。喜欢引用这种格言的人，那精神的相距之远，更甚于叭儿之与老聃，这里不必说它了。就是庄生自己，不也在《天下篇》里，历举了别人的缺失，以他的“无是非”轻了一切“有所是非”的言行吗？要不然，一部《庄子》，只要“今天天气哈哈哈……”七个字就写完了。
If we go to "Zhuangzi" to find vocabulary, we can probably encounter two more treasure lessons: "He is also right and wrong, and this is also right and wrong", remembering to be a talisman in times of crisis, it seems to be beautiful. However, this can only be said temporarily and cannot be implemented forever. People who like to quote this kind of maxim are far away in spirit, even more so than Ba'er and Lao Dan, so there is no need to talk about it here. Even Zhuang Sheng himself, in the "Chapter of the World", did not list the shortcomings of others, and used his "no right and wrong" to underestimate all the words and deeds of "right and wrong"? Otherwise, a "Zhuangzi" will be written as long as the seven words "today's weather hahaha......" will be written.但我们现在所处的并非汉魏之际，也不必恰如那时的文人，一定要“各以所长，相轻所短”。凡批评家的对于文人，或文人们的互相评论，各各“指其所短，扬其所长”固可，即“掩其所短，称其所长”亦无不可。然而那一面一定得有“所长”，这一面一定得有明确的是非，有热烈的好恶。假使被今年新出的“文人相轻”这一个模模胡胡的恶名所吓昏，对于充风流的富儿，装古雅的恶少，销淫书的瘪三，无不“彼亦一是非，此亦一是非”，一律拱手低眉，不敢说或不屑说，那么，这是怎样的批评家或文人呢？——他先就非被“轻”不可的！
But we are not in the Han and Wei dynasties, and we do not have to be like the literati at that time, we must "each have their own strengths and look down on each other's weaknesses". It is certainly acceptable for critics to "point out their shortcomings and promote their strengths" to criticize literati or literati to each other, that is, to "cover up their shortcomings and praise their strengths". However, that side must have "strengths", and this side must have clear right and wrong, and warm likes and dislikes. If you are frightened by this year's new notoriety of "literati look down on each other", for the romantic rich children, the villains who pretend to be quaint, and the deflated three who sell obscene books, they all bow their hands and lower their eyebrows, dare not say or disdain to say it, then, what kind of critic or literati is this? ——He must be "light" first!四月十四日。
April 14th.

“京派”和“海派”

“京派”和“海派”

“京派”和“海派”

"Beijing School" and "Shanghai School"去年春天，京派大师曾经大大的奚落了一顿海派小丑，海派小丑也曾经小小的回敬了几手，但不多久，就完了。文滩上的风波，总是容易起，容易完，倘使不容易完，也真的不便当。我也曾经略略的赶了一下热闹，在许多唇枪舌剑中，以为那时我发表的所说，倒也不算怎么分析错了的。其中有这样的一段——
Last spring, the master of the Beijing school once ridiculed the Shanghai clown, and the Shanghai clown also responded a few times, but it didn't take long for it to end. The turmoil on the beach is always easy to start and end, but if it is not easy to end, it is really inconvenient. I also had a little bit of excitement, and in many of the rhetoric, I thought that what I said at that time was not a mistake in analyzing it. There is such a paragraph -“……北京是明清的帝都，上海乃各国之租界，帝都多官，租界多商，所以文人之在京者近官，没海者近商，近官者在使官得名，近商者在使商获利，而自己亦赖以糊口。要而言之：不过‘京派’是官的帮闲，‘海派’则是商的帮忙而已。……而官之鄙商，固亦中国旧习，就更使‘海派’在‘京派’眼中跌落了。……”
“…… Beijing is the imperial capital of the Ming and Qing dynasties, Shanghai is the concession of various countries, the imperial capital has many officials, and the concession is more business, so the literati in Beijing are close to the officials, the sea is close to the merchants, the officials are named in the envoys, and the merchants are profitable, and they also rely on it. In short: However, the 'Beijing school' is the help of the officials, and the 'Shanghai school' is just the help of the merchants. …… And the official's contempt of business, of course, is also an old Chinese habit, which makes the 'Shanghai school' fall in the eyes of the 'Beijing school'. ……”但到得今年春末，不过一整年带点零，就使我省悟了先前所说的并不圆满。目前的事实，是证明着京派已经自己贬损，或是把海派在自己眼睛里抬高，不但现身说法，演述了派别并不专与地域相关，而且实践了“因为爱他，所以恨他”的妙语。当初的京海之争，看作“龙虎斗”固然是错误，就是认为有一条官商之界也不免欠明白。因为现在已经清清楚楚，到底搬出一碗不过黄鳝田鸡，炒在一起的苏式菜——“京海杂烩”来了。
But by the end of spring this year, just a little bit of zero for a whole year, I realized that what I said before was not perfect. The current facts prove that the Beijing faction has degraded itself or exalted the Shanghai faction in its own eyes, not only appearing to say that the faction is not only related to the region, but also practicing the punchline of "because I love him, so I hate him". At the beginning, it was wrong to regard the dispute between Beijing and the sea as a "dragon and tiger fight", but it was inevitable that there was a boundary between officials and businessmen. Because it is now clear that a bowl of yellow eel frog and stir-fried together is here - "Jinghai chowder".实例，自然是琐屑的，而且自然也不会有重大的例子。举一点罢。一，是选印明人小品的大权，分给海派来了；以前上海固然也有选印明人小品的人，但也可以说是冒牌的，这回却有了真正老京派的题签，所以的确是正统的衣钵。二，是有些新出的刊物，真正老京派打头，真正小海派煞尾了；以前固然也有京派开路的期刊，但那是半京半海派所主持的东西，和纯粹海派自说是自掏腰包来办的出产品颇有区别的。要而言之：今儿和前儿已不一样，京海两派中的一路，做成一碗了。
Examples are naturally trivial, and naturally there will be no major examples. Just give a little point. First, it is the power to select and print the Ming people's sketches, and it is assigned to the sea faction; In the past, although there were people in Shanghai who selected and printed Ming people's sketches, they could also be said to be counterfeits, but this time there was a real old Beijing school, so it was indeed an orthodox mantle. second, there are some new publications, the real old Beijing faction is the head, and the real Xiaohai faction is over; Although there were periodicals that opened the way for the Beijing school in the past, it was something hosted by the half-Beijing and half-sea school, which was quite different from the products produced by the pure Shanghai school that it said to pay out of its own pocket. In short: today is different from before, and one of the two factions of Beijing and Hai has been made into a bowl.到这里要附带一点声明：我是故意不举出那新出刊物的名目来的。先前，曾经有人用过“某”字，什么缘故我不知道。但后来该刊的一个作者在该刊上说，他有一位“熟悉商情”的朋友，以为这是因为不替它来作广告。这真是聪明的好朋友，不愧为“熟悉商情”。由此启发，子细一想，他的话实在千真万确：被称赞固然可以代广告，被骂也可以代广告，张扬了荣是广告，张扬了辱又何尝非广告。例如罢，甲乙决斗，甲赢，乙死了，人们固然要看杀人的凶手，但也一样的要看那不中用的死尸，如果用芦席围起来，两个铜板看一下，准可以发一点小财的。我这回的不说出这刊物的名目来，主意却正在不替它作广告，我有时很不讲阴德，简直要妨碍别人的借死尸敛钱。然而，请老实的看官不要立刻责备我刻薄。他们那里肯放过这机会，他们自己会敲了锣来承认的。
I would like to add a little statement here: I deliberately did not mention the name of the new publication. Previously, someone used the word "so-and-so", but I don't know why. But later an author of the journal said in the journal that he had a friend who was "familiar with the business" and thought it was because he did not advertise for it. This is really a smart good friend, worthy of being "familiar with business conditions". Inspired by this, Zi thought about it carefully, and his words were really true: being praised can certainly be an advertisement, being scolded can also be an advertisement, publicizing honor is an advertisement, and publicizing humiliation is not an advertisement. For example, if A and B duel, A wins, B dies, people certainly have to look at the murderer, but they also have to look at the useless corpse, if they are surrounded by reed mats, two copper plates to look at, they can definitely make a little money. I didn't say the name of this publication this time, but my idea was not to advertise it. However, please don't immediately reproach me for being mean. If they are willing to let go of this opportunity, they will admit it by beating the gong.声明太长了一点了。言归正传。我要说的是直到现在，由事实证明，我才明白了去年京派的奚落海派，原来根柢上并不是奚落，倒是路远迢迢的送来的秋波。
The statement is a little too long. Back to the point. "Spiced tea eggs!"这是四五年前，闸北一带弄堂内外叫卖零食的声音，假使当时记录了下来，从早到夜，恐怕总可以有二三十样。居民似乎也真会化零钱，吃零食，时时给他们一点生意，因为叫声也时时中止，可见是在招呼主顾了。而且那些口号也真漂亮，不知道他是从《昭明文选》或《晚明小品》里找过词汇的呢，还是怎么的，实在使我似的初到上海的乡下人，一听到就有馋涎欲滴之概，“薏米杏仁”而又“莲心粥”，这是新鲜到连先前的梦里也没有想到的。但对于靠笔墨为生的人们，却有一点害处，假使你还没有练到“心如古井”，就可以被闹得整天整夜写不出什么东西来。
This is the sound of selling snacks inside and outside the alleys in Zhabei four or five years ago, and if it was recorded at that time, from morning to night, I am afraid there could always be twenty or thirty kinds. The residents also seem to really know how to change, eat snacks, and give them a little business from time to time, because the cries are also stopped from time to time, which shows that they are greeting customers. And those slogans are really beautiful, I don't know if he found the vocabulary from "Zhaoming Anthology" or "Late Ming Sketches", or what, it really makes me like a countryman who has just arrived in Shanghai, as soon as I hear it, I have a greedy attitude, "barley almonds" and "lotus heart porridge", which is so fresh that I didn't even think of it in my previous dreams. But for people who make a living from pen and ink, there is a bit of harm, if you haven't practiced "the heart is like an ancient well", you can be made to write nothing all day and night.现在是大不相同了。马路边上的小饭店，正午傍晚，先前为长衫朋友所占领的，近来已经大抵是“寄沉痛于幽闲”；老主顾呢，坐到黄包车夫的老巢的粗点心店里面去了。至于车夫，那自然只好退到马路边沿饿肚子，或者幸而还能够咬侉饼。弄堂里的叫卖声，说也奇怪，竟也和古代判若天渊，卖零食的当然还有，但不过是橄榄或馄饨，却很少遇见那些“香艳肉感”的“艺术”的玩意了。嚷嚷呢，自然仍旧是嚷嚷的，只要上海市民存在一日，嚷嚷是大约决不会停止的。然而现在却切实了不少：麻油，豆腐，润发的刨花，晒衣的竹竿；方法也有改进，或者一个人卖袜，独自作歌赞叹着袜的牢靠。或者两个人共同卖布，交互唱歌颂扬着布的便宜。但大概是一直唱着进来，直达弄底，又一直唱着回去，走出弄外，停下来做交易的时候，是很少的。
Now it's very different. The small restaurant on the side of the road, at noon and evening, was previously occupied by friends in long gowns, but recently it has been mostly "sending pain to leisure"; The old patron sat in the rough snack shop of the rickshaw driver's lair. As for the coachman, he naturally had to retreat to the side of the road to be hungry, or fortunately he was able to bite the cake. The shouting in the alley is strange, and it is actually very different from ancient times, of course, there are still snack sellers, but they are just olives or wontons, but it is rare to meet those "fragrant and fleshy" "art" things. As long as the citizens of Shanghai exist for a day, the shouting will never stop. However, now there are a lot of them: sesame oil, tofu, shavings of moisturized hair, bamboo poles for drying clothes; The method has also been improved, or one person sells socks and writes songs alone to praise the reliability of socks. Or two people sell cloth together, singing to praise the cheapness of cloth. But probably when I keep singing in, go straight to the bottom, and keep singing back, walk out of the lane, and stop to make a deal, there are very few.偶然也有高雅的货色：果物和花。不过这是并不打算卖给中国人的，所以他用洋话：
Occasionally, there are also elegant colors: fruits and flowers. However, this is not intended to be sold to the Chinese, so he uses foreign language:“Ringo，Banana，Appulu-u，Appulu-u-u！”

也不大有洋人买。间或有算命的瞎子，化缘的和尚进弄来，几乎是专攻娘姨们的，倒还是他们比较的有生意，有时算一命，有时卖掉一张黄纸的鬼画符。但到今年，好像生意也清淡了，于是前天竟出现了大布置的化缘。先只听得一片鼓钹和铁索声，我正想做“超现实主义”的语录体诗，这么一来，诗思被闹跑了，寻声看去，原来是一个和尚用铁钩钩在前胸的皮上，钩柄系有一丈多长的铁索，在地上拖着走进弄里来，别的两个和尚打着鼓和钹。但是，那些娘姨们，却都把门一关，躲得一个也不见了。这位苦行的高僧，竟连一个铜子也拖不去。

不应该那么写

不应该那么写

不应该那么写

It shouldn't be written like that凡是有志于创作的青年，第一个想到的问题，大概总是“应该怎样写？”现在市场上陈列着的“小说作法”，“小说法程”之类，就是专掏这类青年的腰包的。然而，好像没有效，从“小说作法”学出来的作者，我们至今还没有听到过。有些青年是设法去问已经出名的作者，那些答案，还很少见有什么发表，但结果是不难推想而知的：不得要领。这也难怪，因为创作是并没有什么秘诀，能够交头接耳，一句话就传授给别一个的，倘不然，只要有这秘诀，就真可以登广告，收学费，开一个三天包成文豪学校了。以中国之大，或者也许会有罢，但是，这其实是骗子。
The first question that comes to mind for any young person who is interested in creation is probably "How should I write?" "Now the "novel method" and "novel method" displayed in the market are specially paid for the pockets of such young people. However, it seems to have no effect, and we have not heard of the author who learned from the "novel method". Some young people try to ask authors who are already famous, and those answers are rarely published, but the result is not difficult to guess: it is not to the point. It's no wonder, because there is no secret to creation, you can listen to each other, and teach it to another person in one sentence, otherwise, as long as you have this secret, you can really advertise, collect tuition fees, and open a three-day literary school. With the size of China, maybe there will be, but this is actually a liar.在不难推想而知的种种答案中，大概总该有一个是“多看大作家的作品”。这恐怕也很不能满文学青年的意，因为太宽泛，茫无边际——然而倒是切实的。凡是已有定评的大作家，他的作品，全部就说明着“应该怎样写”。只是读者很不容易看出，也就不能领悟。因为在学习者一方面，是必须知道了“不应该那么写”，这才会明白原来“应该这么写”的。
Among the various answers that are not difficult to deduce, there should probably always be one of them to "read more works by great writers". This is probably not enough to satisfy the literary youth, because it is too broad and boundless - but it is practical. All the great writers who have been evaluated explain "how to write". It's just that readers can't easily see it, so they can't comprehend it. Because on the one hand, learners must know that "it should not be written like that" in order to understand that it should be written this way.这“不应该那么写”，如何知道呢？惠列赛耶夫的《果戈理研究》第六章里，答复着这问题——
This "shouldn't be written like that", how do you know? In the sixth chapter of Huleseyev's "Gogol Studies", this question is answered -“应该这么写，必须从大作家们的完成了的作品去领会。那么，不应该那么写这一面，恐怕最好是从那同一作品的未定稿本去学习了。在这里，简直好像艺术家在对我们用实物教授。恰如他指着每一行，直接对我们这样说——‘你看——哪，这是应该删去的。这要缩短，这要改作，因为不自然了。在这里，还得加些渲染，使形象更加显豁些。’”
It should be written like this, and it must be understood from the completed works of great writers. Then, I shouldn't write this side like that, I'm afraid it's best to learn from the unfinished manuscript of the same work. Here, it is as if the artist is teaching us with objects. Just as he pointed to each line and said to us directly, 'Look—where, this should be deleted. This needs to be shortened, this needs to be changed, because it is unnatural. Here, some rendering is needed to make the image more open-minded. ’”这确是极有益处的学习法，而我们中国却偏偏缺少这样的教材。近几年来，石印的手稿是有一些了，但大抵是学者的著述或日记。也许是因为向来崇尚“一挥而就”，“文不加点”的缘故罢，又大抵是全本干干净净，看不出苦心删改的痕迹来。取材于外国呢，则即使精通文字，也无法搜罗名作的初版以至改定版的各种本子的。
This is indeed a very beneficial learning method, but we in China lack such teaching materials. In recent years, there have been some manuscripts of stone prints, but they are mostly writings or diaries of scholars. Perhaps it is because it has always advocated "one stroke" and "no dots on the text", but it is probably because the whole book is clean, and there is no trace of painstaking deletion. If you take it from a foreign country, even if you are proficient in writing, you will not be able to search for various books from the first edition to the revised version of the masterpiece.读书人家的子弟熟悉笔墨，木匠的孩子会玩斧凿，兵家儿早识刀枪，没有这样的环境和遗产，是中国的文学青年的先天的不幸。
The children of scholars are familiar with pen and ink, the children of carpenters can play with axes and chisels, and the soldiers know knives and guns early.在没奈何中，想了一个补救法：新闻上的记事，拙劣的小说，那事件，是也有可以写成一部文艺作品的，不过那记事，那小说，却并非文艺——这就是“不应该这样写”的标本。只是和“应该那样写”，却无从比较了。
In desperation, I thought of a remedy: news accounts, clumsy novels, and events can also be written into literary and artistic works, but those records, novels, are not literary and artistic - this is a specimen of "it should not be written like this". It's just that it should be written that way, but it can't be compared.四月二十三日。
