在现代中国的孔夫子

在现代中国的孔夫子

在现代中国的孔夫子

Confucius in modern China新近的上海的报纸，报告着因为日本的汤岛，孔子的圣庙落成了，湖南省主席何键将军就寄赠了一幅向来珍藏的孔子的画像。老实说，中国的一般的人民，关于孔子是怎样的相貌，倒几乎是毫无所知的。自古以来，虽然每一县一定有圣庙，即文庙，但那里面大抵并没有圣像。凡是绘画，或者雕塑应该崇敬的人物时，一般是以大于常人为原则的，但一到最应崇敬的人物，例如孔夫子那样的圣人，却好像连形象也成为亵渎，反不如没有的好。这也不是没有道理的。孔夫子没有留下照相来，自然不能明白真正的相貌，文献中虽然偶有记载，但是胡说白道也说不定。若是从新雕塑的话，则除了任凭雕塑者的空想而外，毫无办法，更加放心不下。于是儒者们也终于只好采取“全部，或全无”的勃兰特式的态度了。
The latest Shanghai newspaper reported that because of the completion of the temple of Confucius in Yudao, Japan, General He Jian, chairman of Hunan Province, sent a portrait of Confucius that had always been treasured. To be honest, the average Chinese people know almost nothing about what Confucius looked like. Since ancient times, although there must be a holy temple in every county, that is, the Confucian Temple, there are probably no icons in it. When paintings or sculptures should be revered, they are generally larger than ordinary people, but when it comes to the most revered figures, such as saints like Confucius, it seems that even the image has become blasphemous, but it is better not to have it. This is not without reason. Confucius did not leave a photo, so naturally he could not understand the real appearance, although there are occasional records in the literature, but it may be nonsense. If it is a new sculpture, there is no way but to let the sculptor's fantasy take over, and it is even more at ease. So the Confucians finally had to adopt the Brandian attitude of "all or nothing".然而倘是画像，却也会间或遇见的。我曾经见过三次：一次是《孔子家语》里的插画；一次是梁启超氏亡命日本时，作为横滨出版的《清议报》上的卷头画，从日本倒输入中国来的；还有一次是刻在汉朝墓石上的孔子见老子的画像。说起从这些图画上所得的孔夫子的模样的印象来，则这位先生是一位很瘦的老头子，身穿大袖口的长袍子，腰带上插着一把剑，或者腋下挟着一枝杖，然而从来不笑，非常威风凛凛的。假使在他的旁边侍坐，那就一定得把腰骨挺的笔直，经过两三点钟，就骨节酸痛，倘是平常人，大约总不免急于逃走的了。
However, if it is a portrait, it will also be encountered occasionally. I have seen it three times: once is an illustration in "Confucius's Family Sayings"; One is when Liang Qichao fled to Japan, as the frontispiece of the "Qingyi Pao" published in Yokohama, it was imported from Japan to China; Another time is a portrait of Confucius seeing Lao Tzu engraved on the tombstone of the Han Dynasty. Speaking of the impression of Confucius's appearance from these pictures, this gentleman is a very thin old man, wearing a robe with large cuffs, a sword in his belt, or a staff under his armpit, but he never smiles, very majestic. If you sit next to him, you must keep your waist straight, and after two or three o'clock, your joints will be sore, and if you are an ordinary person, you will probably be in a hurry to escape.后来我曾到山东旅行。在为道路的不平所苦的时候，忽然想到了我们的孔夫子。一想起那具有俨然道貌的圣人，先前便是坐着简陋的车子，颠颠簸簸，在这些地方奔忙的事来，颇有滑稽之感。这种感想，自然是不好的，要而言之，颇近于不敬，倘是孔子之徒，恐怕是决不应该发生的。但在那时候，怀着我似的不规矩的心情的青年，可是多得很。
Later, I traveled to Shandong. When I was suffering from the injustice of the road, I suddenly thought of our Confucius. When I think of the saint with a Taoist appearance, he used to sit in a simple car, bumpy and bumpy, and it was quite funny to be busy in these places. This kind of feeling is naturally bad, in short, it is quite close to disrespect, if it is a disciple of Confucius, I am afraid it should never happen. But at that time, there were a lot of young people with unruly moods like me.我出世的时候是清朝的末年，孔夫子已经有了“大成至圣文宣王”这一个阔得可怕的头衔，不消说，正是圣道支配了全国的时代。政府对于读书的人们，使读一定的书，即四书和五经；使遵守一定的注释；使写一定的文章，即所谓“八股文”；并且使发一定的议论。然而这些千篇一律的儒者们，倘是四方的大地，那是很知道的，但一到圆形的地球，却什么也不知道，于是和四书上并无记载的法兰西和英吉利打仗而失败了。不知道为了觉得与其拜着孔夫子而死，倒不如保存自己们之为得计呢，还是为了什么，总而言之，这回是拚命尊孔的政府和官僚先就动摇起来，用官帑大翻起洋鬼子的书籍来了。属于科学上的古典之作的，则有侯失勒的《谈天》，雷侠儿的《地学浅释》，代那的《金石识别》，到现在也还作为那时的遗物，间或躺在旧书铺子里。
When I was born, it was the end of the Qing Dynasty, and Confucius already had the terrifyingly wide title of "King Wenxuan of Dacheng", needless to say, it was the era when the holy way dominated the whole country. The government makes people who read read certain books, namely the Four Books and the Five Classics; make certain annotations observed; make a certain article write, that is, the so-called "eight-strand text"; And make a certain discussion. However, these cookie-cutter Confucian scholars, if it was the earth in all directions, knew it very well, but when they reached the round earth, they knew nothing, so they fought against France and England, which were not recorded in the four books, and failed. I don't know if it's better to preserve themselves than to die worshiping Confucius, or for what, all in all, this time the government and bureaucrats who desperately respected Confucius were shaken first, and used official funds to turn over the books of foreign devils. The classical works in science include Hou Shile's "Tan Tian", Lei Xiaer's "Brief Explanation of Earth Science", and Dai Na's "Identification of Gold and Stone", which are still used as relics of that time, sometimes lying in old bookstores.然而一定有反动。清末之所谓儒者的结晶，也是代表的大学士徐桐氏出现了。他不但连算学也斥为洋鬼子的学问；他虽然承认世界上有法兰西和英吉利这些国度，但西班牙和葡萄牙的存在，是决不相信的，他主张这是法国和英国常常来讨利益，连自己也不好意思了，所以随便胡诌出来的国名。他又是一九〇〇年的有名的义和团的幕后的发动者，也是指挥者。但是义和团完全失败，徐桐氏也自杀了。政府就又以为外国的政治法律和学问技术颇有可取之处了。我的渴望到日本去留学，也就在那时候。达了目的，入学的地方，是嘉纳先生所设立的东京的弘文学院；在这里，三泽力太郎先生教我水是养气和轻气所合成，山内繁雄先生教我贝壳里的什么地方其名为“外套”。这是有一天的事情。学监大久保先生集合起大家来，说：因为你们都是孔子之徒，今天到御茶之水的孔庙里去行礼罢！我大吃了一惊。现在还记得那时心里想，正因为绝望于孔夫子和他的之徒，所以到日本来的，然而又是拜么？一时觉得很奇怪。而且发生这样感觉的，我想决不止我一个人。
However, there must be a reaction. The so-called crystallization of Confucianism in the late Qing Dynasty, which was also a representative of the great scholar Xu Tongshi, appeared. Not only did he denounce arithmetic as the knowledge of foreign devils; Although he admitted that there were countries such as France and England in the world, he never believed in the existence of Spain and Portugal, and he argued that this was the name of the country that France and Britain often came to seek benefits, and even he was embarrassed, so he casually came up with the name of the country. He was also the initiator and commander behind the famous Boxer Rebellion in 1900. But the Boxers completely failed, and Xu Tong also committed suicide. The government also thinks that foreign politics, laws, and academic technology are quite commendable. My desire to study in Japan was also at that time. The place where he entered the school was Kobun Gakuin in Tokyo, which was established by Mr. Kano; Here, Mr. Ritsutaro Misawa taught me that water is a combination of nourishing qi and light qi, and Mr. Shigeo Yamauchi taught me where the place in the shell is called "coat". This is a one-day thing. Mr. Okubo, the superintendent, gathered everyone and said: Because you are all disciples of Confucius, go to the Confucius Temple in Ochanomui today to pay your respects! I was taken aback. I still remember thinking to myself at that time, it was because I was desperate for Confucius and his disciples that I came to Japan, but was it a worship? It felt strange for a while. And I think I'm not the only one who feels like this.但是，孔夫子在本国的不遇，也并不是始于二十世纪的。孟子批评他为“圣之时者也”，倘翻成现代语，除了“摩登圣人”实在也没有别的法。为他自己计，这固然是没有危险的尊号，但也不是十分值得欢迎的头衔。不过在实际上，却也许并不这样子。孔夫子的做定了“摩登圣人”是死了以后的事，活着的时候却是颇吃苦头的。跑来跑去，虽然曾经贵为鲁国的警视总监，而又立刻下野，失业了；并且为权臣所轻蔑，为野人所嘲弄，甚至于为暴民所包围，饿扁了肚子。弟子虽然收了三千名，中用的却只有七十二，然而真可以相信的又只有一个人。有一天，孔夫子愤慨道：“道不行，乘桴浮于海，从我者，其由与？”从这消极的打算上，就可以窥见那消息。然而连这一位由，后来也因为和敌人战斗，被击断了冠缨，但真不愧为由呀，到这时候也还不忘记从夫子听来的教训，说道“君子死，冠不免”，一面系着冠缨，一面被人砍成肉酱了。连唯一可信的弟子也已经失掉，孔子自然是非常悲痛的，据说他一听到这信息，就吩咐去倒掉厨房里的肉酱云。
However, Confucius's mistreatment in his own country did not begin in the twentieth century. Mencius criticized him as "the one who was also a saint", and if it is translated into modern language, there is really no other way but "modern saint". For himself, this is certainly a non-dangerous title, but it is not a very welcome title. But in reality, it may not be like this. Confucius decided that the "modern saint" was after death, but he suffered quite a bit when he was alive. running around, although he was once the superintendent of the police in Lu State, he immediately went out of the field and lost his job; And he was despised by the powerful ministers, ridiculed by the savages, and even surrounded by the mob, starving his stomach. Although there were three thousand disciples, only seventy-two were used, but there was only one person who could really be trusted. One day, Confucius said indignantly: "The Tao is not good, the raft floats on the sea, and the one who follows me, is the reason?" From this negative plan, we can get a glimpse of the news. However, even this reason was later broken because of the battle with the enemy, but it was really worthy of the reason, and at this time he did not forget the lesson he heard from the master, saying, "A gentleman dies, and the crown cannot be avoided", while tying the crown tassel, he was cut into meat sauce. Even the only credible disciple had been lost, and Confucius was naturally very sad, and it is said that as soon as he heard the message, he ordered to pour out the meat sauce cloud in the kitchen.孔夫子到死了以后，我以为可以说是运气比较的好一点。因为他不会噜苏了，种种的权势者便用种种的白粉给他来化妆，一直抬到吓人的高度。但比起后来输入的释迦牟尼来，却实在可怜得很。诚然，每一县固然都有圣庙即文庙，可是一副寂寞的冷落的样子，一般的庶民，是决不去参拜的，要去，则是佛寺，或者是神庙。若向老百姓们问孔夫子是什么人，他们自然回答是圣人，然而这不过是权势者的留声机。他们也敬惜字纸，然而这是因为倘不敬惜字纸，会遭雷殛的迷信的缘故；南京的夫子庙固然是热闹的地方，然而这是因为另有各种玩耍和茶店的缘故。虽说孔子作《春秋》而乱臣贼子惧，然而现在的人们，却几乎谁也不知道一个笔伐了的乱臣贼子的名字。说到乱臣贼子，大概以为是曹操，但那并非圣人所教，却是写了小说和剧本的无名作家所教的。
After Confucius died, I thought it could be said that he was lucky. Because he wouldn't be able to snort, all kinds of powerful people used all kinds of white powder to make him makeup, all the way to a frightening height. But compared to Shakyamuni who was imported later, it was really pitiful. It is true that every county certainly has a holy temple, that is, the Confucian Temple, but it looks lonely and neglected, and ordinary people will never go to worship, and if they want to go, it is a Buddhist temple or a temple. If you ask the people who Confucius is, they will naturally answer that he is a saint, but this is just a gramophone for the powerful. They also cherish the paper, but this is because of the superstition that if they do not cherish the paper, they will be struck by lightning; The Confucius Temple in Nanjing is certainly a lively place, but this is because there are various games and tea shops. Although Confucius wrote the "Spring and Autumn Annals" and the traitors and thieves were afraid, almost no one now knows the name of a rebellious minister and thief who has been cut down. When it comes to traitors and thieves, you probably think it is Cao Cao, but it is not taught by the saints, but by the unknown writers who wrote novels and scripts.总而言之，孔夫子之在中国，是权势者们捧起来的，是那些权势者或想做权势者们的圣人，和一般的民众并无什么关系。然而对于圣庙，那些权势者也不过一时的热心。因为尊孔的时候已经怀着别样的目的，所以目的一达，这器具就无用，如果不达呢，那可更加无用了。在三四十年以前，凡有企图获得权势的人，就是希望做官的人，都是读“四书”和“五经”，做“八股”，别一些人就将这些书籍和文章，统名之为“敲门砖”。这就是说，文官考试一及第，这些东西也就同时被忘却，恰如敲门时所用的砖头一样，门一开，这砖头也就被抛掉了。孔子这人，其实是自从死了以后，也总是当着“敲门砖”的差使的。
All in all, Confucius was held up by the powerful in China, and he was a saint who was in power or wanted to be a powerful person, and had nothing to do with the general public. However, for the temple, those in power were only temporarily enthusiastic. Because when the Confucius was honored, he already had a different purpose, so once the goal was achieved, this instrument was useless, and if it was not achieved, it would be even more useless. Thirty or forty years ago, anyone who tried to gain power, that is, those who wanted to become officials, read the "Four Books" and "Five Classics" and did the "Eight Shares", and some others collectively called these books and articles "stepping stones". This means that as soon as the civil servant exam passes, these things are forgotten at the same time, just like the brick used when knocking on the door, and as soon as the door opens, the brick is thrown away. Confucius was actually a messenger who was always a "stepping stone" since his death.一看最近的例子，就更加明白。从二十世纪的开始以来，孔夫子的运气是很坏的，但到袁世凯时代，却又被从新记得，不但恢复了祭典，还新做了古怪的祭服，使奉祀的人们穿起来。跟着这事而出现的便是帝制。然而那一道门终于没有敲开，袁氏在门外死掉了。余剩的是北洋军阀，当觉得渐近末路时，也用它来敲过另外的幸福之门。盘据着江苏和浙江，在路上随便砍杀百姓的孙传芳将军，一面复兴了投壶之礼；钻进山东，连自己也数不清金钱和兵丁和姨太太的数目了的张宗昌将军，则重刻了《十三经》，而且把圣道看作可以由肉体关系来传染的花柳病一样的东西，拿一个孔子后裔的谁来做了自己的女婿。然而幸福之门，却仍然对谁也没有开。
A look at recent examples makes it even clearer. Since the beginning of the twentieth century, Confucius's luck has been very bad, but in the era of Yuan Shikai, it has been remembered again, not only restored the festival, but also made strange sacrificial clothes for the people who worship them. What followed this was the imperial system. However, the door was finally not knocked open, and Yuan died outside the door. The remaining are the Beiyang warlords, who also use it to knock on other doors of happiness when they feel that they are approaching the end. General Sun Chuanfang, who occupied Jiangsu and Zhejiang and killed the people casually on the road, revived the ritual of throwing pots; General Zhang Zongchang, who went into Shandong and couldn't even count the number of money, soldiers and concubines, re-engraved the "Thirteen Classics", and regarded the holy way as something like the flower willow disease that could be transmitted by physical relationships, and took a descendant of Confucius as his son-in-law. However, the door to happiness is still not open to anyone.这三个人，都把孔夫子当作砖头用，但是时代不同了，所以都明明白白的失败了。岂但自己失败而已呢，还带累孔子也更加陷入了悲境。他们都是连字也不大认识的人物，然而偏要大谈什么《十三经》之类，所以使人们觉得滑稽；言行也太不一致了，就更加令人讨厌。既已厌恶和尚，恨及袈裟，而孔夫子之被利用为或一目的的器具，也从新看得格外清楚起来，于是要打倒他的欲望，也就越加旺盛。所以把孔子装饰得十分尊严时，就一定有找他缺点的论文和作品出现。即使是孔夫子，缺点总也有的，在平时谁也不理会，因为圣人也是人，本是可以原谅的。然而如果圣人之徒出来胡说一通，以为圣人是这样，是那样，所以你也非这样不可的话，人们可就禁不住要笑起来了。五六年前，曾经因为公演了《子见南子》这剧本，引起过问题，在那个剧本里，有孔夫子登场，以圣人而论，固然不免略有欠稳重和呆头呆脑的地方，然而作为一个人，倒是可爱的好人物。但是圣裔们非常愤慨，把问题一直闹到官厅里去了。因为公演的地点，恰巧是孔夫子的故乡，在那地方，圣裔们繁殖得非常多，成着使释迦牟尼和苏格拉第都自愧弗如的特权阶级。然而，那也许又正是使那里的非圣裔的青年们，不禁特地要演《子见南子》的原因罢。
These three people all used Confucius as bricks, but the times were different, so they all clearly failed. Not only did he fail, but he also fell into a tragic situation. They are all characters who don't even know the words, but they want to talk about the "Thirteen Classics" and the like, so people feel funny; The words and deeds are too inconsistent, which is even more annoying. Since he hated the monk and hated the cassock, and the instrument that Confucius was used as a tool or for one purpose became more and more clear from the new, so the desire to overthrow him became more and more vigorous. Therefore, when Confucius is decorated with great dignity, there must be papers and works that find his shortcomings. Even Confucius always has shortcomings, and no one pays attention to them in ordinary times, because saints are also human beings and can be forgiven. However, if the saints come out and talk nonsense, thinking that the saints are like this, that they are like that, so you have to do this, people can't help but laugh. Five or six years ago, there was a problem because of the performance of the script "Zi Jian Nanzi", in that script, Confucius appeared, in terms of saints, of course, it is inevitable that there will be a little unstable and dumbfounded, but as a person, it is a lovely and good character. But the saints were very indignant and took the problem all the way to the official office. Because the place where the performance was performed happened to be the hometown of Confucius, where the saints multiplied a lot and became a privileged class that made both Shakyamuni and Socrates ashamed. However, that may be the reason why the young people who are not of holy descent there can't help but perform "Zi Jian Nanzi".中国的一般的民众，尤其是所谓愚民，虽称孔子为圣人，却不觉得他是圣人；对于他，是恭谨的，却不亲密。但我想，能像中国的愚民那样，懂得孔夫子的，恐怕世界上是再也没有的了。不错，孔夫子曾经计划过出色的治国的方法，但那都是为了治民众者，即权势者设想的方法，为民众本身的，却一点也没有。这就是“礼不下庶人”。成为权势者们的圣人，终于变了“敲门砖”，实在也叫不得冤枉。和民众并无关系，是不能说的，但倘说毫无亲密之处，我以为怕要算是非常客气的说法了。不去亲近那毫不亲密的圣人，正是当然的事，什么时候都可以，试去穿了破衣，赤着脚，走上大成殿去看看罢，恐怕会像误进上海的上等影戏院或者头等电车一样，立刻要受斥逐的。谁都知道这是大人老爷们的物事，虽是“愚民”，却还没有愚到这步田地的。
The general people in China, especially the so-called foolish people, call Confucius a saint, but do not think he is a saint; For him, it is respectful, but not intimate. But I think there is probably no one in the world who can understand Confucius like the foolish people in China. Yes, Confucius once planned an excellent way to govern the country, but it was all for the people who ruled the people, that is, the methods envisioned by the powerful, but not for the people themselves. This is "courtesy to commoners". The saint who became the powerful finally became a "stepping stone", which is really unjust. It has nothing to do with the people, so it cannot be said, but if there is no intimacy, I think it is a very polite statement. If you don't get close to the saint who is not intimate, it is a matter of course, you can do it at any time, try to wear tattered clothes, go barefoot, and walk up to the Dacheng Hall to take a look, I am afraid that you will be immediately expelled like a high-class theater or a first-class tram in Shanghai by mistake. Everyone knows that this is the thing of the lords, although they are "foolish people", but they have not yet reached this level of foolishness.四月二十九日。
April 29th.

六朝小说和唐代传奇文有怎样的区别？

六朝小说和唐代传奇文有怎样的区别？——答文学社问

六朝小说和唐代传奇文有怎样的区别？

What is the difference between the novels of the Six Dynasties and the legends of the Tang Dynasty? ——Answer the question of the Literary Society这试题很难解答。
This test question is difficult to answer.因为唐代传奇，是至今还有标本可见的，但现在之所谓六朝小说，我们所依据的只是从《新唐书艺文志》以至清《四库书目》的判定，有许多种，在六朝当时，却并不视为小说。例如《汉武故事》，《西京杂记》，《搜神记》，《续齐谐记》等，直至刘昫的《唐书经籍志》，还属于史部起居注和杂传类里的。那时还相信神仙和鬼神，并不以为虚造，所以所记虽有仙凡和幽明之殊，却都是史的一类。
Because the legend of the Tang Dynasty is still visible in specimens, but the current so-called Six Dynasties novels, we are only based on the judgment from the "New Tang Book Art and Literature" to the Qing Dynasty's "Four Libraries Bibliography", there are many kinds, but at the time of the Six Dynasties, they were not regarded as novels. For example, "The Story of Han Wu", "Xijing Miscellaneous Notes", "Search for Gods", "Continuation of Qi Harmony", etc., until Liu Xu's "Tang Book Classics", still belong to the daily notes and miscellaneous biographies of the Ministry of History. At that time, they still believed in immortals and ghosts, and did not think they were fabricated, so although there was a difference between immortals and the dark and bright, they were all of the same category of history.况且从晋到隋的书目，现在一种也不存在了，我们已无从知道那时所视为小说的是什么，有怎样的形式和内容。现存的惟一最早的目录只有《隋书经籍志》，修者自谓“远览马史班书，近观王阮志录”，也许尚存王俭《今书七志》，阮孝绪《七录》的痕迹罢，但所录小说二十五种中，现存的却只有《燕丹子》和刘义庆撰《世说》合刘孝标注两种了。此外，则《郭子》，《笑林》，殷芸《小说》，《水饰》，及当时以为隋代已亡的《青史子》，《语林》等，还能在唐宋类书里遇见一点遗文。
Moreover, the bibliography from the Jin to the Sui Dynasty no longer exists, and we no longer know what was regarded as a novel at that time, and what form and content it had. The only earliest catalog in existence is the "Sui Book Classics", and the reviser claims to be "reading the horse history class book from afar, looking at Wang Ruan Zhilu up close", perhaps there are traces of Wang Jian's "Seven Chronicles of the Book of Today" and Ruan Xiaoxu's "Seven Records", but among the twenty-five novels recorded, only "Yan Danzi" and Liu Yiqing's "World Sayings" written by Liu Xiao are two types. In addition, "Guo Zi", "Laughing Forest", Yin Yun's "Novel", "Water Decoration", and "Qing Shizi", "Yulin", etc., which were thought to be dead in the Sui Dynasty at that time, can also meet a little posthumous text in Tang and Song books.单从上述这些材料来看，武断的说起来，则六朝人小说，是没有记叙神仙或鬼怪的，所写的几乎都是人事；文笔是简洁的；材料是笑柄，谈资；但好像很排斥虚构，例如《世说新语》说裴启《语林》记谢安语不实，谢安一说，这书即大损声价云云，就是。
Judging from the above materials alone, arbitrarily speaking, the novels of the Six Dynasties do not describe immortals or ghosts, and almost all of them are human affairs; The writing is concise; The material is a laughing stock, a topic of conversation; But it seems to reject fiction, for example, "The World Says New Words" says that Pei Qi's "Yulin" records Xie An's words are untrue, and Xie An said that this book will greatly damage the reputation and value, that is.唐代传奇文可就大两样了：神仙人鬼妖物，都可以随便驱使；文笔是精细，曲折的，至于被崇尚简古者所诟病；所叙的事，也大抵具有首尾和波澜，不止一点断片的谈柄；而且作者往往故意显示着这事迹的虚构，以见他想象的才能了。
The legendary texts of the Tang Dynasty are two kinds of things: immortals, ghosts, and monsters can be driven at will; The writing is fine and tortuous, as for being criticized by those who advocate simplicity and antiquity; The things described also mostly have beginning and end and waves, more than a few fragments of the story; And the author often deliberately shows the fiction of this deed, so as to show his imaginary talent.但六朝人也并非不能想象和描写，不过他不用于小说，这类文章，那时也不谓之小说。例如阮籍的《大人先生传》，陶潜的《桃花源记》，其实倒和后来的唐代传奇文相近；就是嵇康的《圣贤高士传赞》（今仅有辑本），葛洪的《神仙传》，也可以看作唐人传奇文的祖师的。李公佐作《南柯太守传》，李肇为之赞，这就是嵇康的《高士传》法；陈鸿《长恨传》置白居易的长歌之前，元稹的《莺莺传》既录《会真诗》，又举李公垂《莺莺歌》之名作结，也令人不能不想到《桃花源记》。
But the people of the Six Dynasties were not unimaginable and describable, but he was not used in novels, and this kind of article was not called a novel at that time. For example, Ruan Ji's "Biography of Mr. Adult" and Tao Qian's "Peach Blossom Spring" are actually similar to the later Tang Dynasty legends; It is Ji Kang's "Praise of the Sages and High Scholars" (now only available in editions) and Ge Hong's "Biography of the Immortals", which can also be regarded as the ancestor of the Tang Dynasty's legendary texts. Li Gongzuo wrote "The Biography of Nanke Taishou", and Li Zhao praised it, which is Ji Kang's "Biography of Gao Shi"; Chen Hong's "The Legend of Long Hatred" was placed before Bai Juyi's long song, and Yuan Zhen's "The Legend of Yingying" not only recorded the "Huizhen Poem", but also cited the name of Li Gongchui's "Yingying Song" as the end, which also made people think of "The Peach Blossom Spring".至于他们之所以著作，那是无论六朝或唐人，都是有所为的。《隋书经籍志》抄《汉书艺文志》说，以著录小说，比之“询于刍荛”，就是以为虽然小说，也有所为的明证。不过在实际上，这有所为的范围却缩小了。晋人尚清谈，讲标格，常以寥寥数言，立致通显，所以那时的小说，多是记载畸行隽语的《世说》一类，其实是借口舌取名位的入门书。唐以诗文取士，但也看社会上的名声，所以士子入京应试，也须豫先干谒名公，呈献诗文，冀其称誉，这诗文叫作“行卷”。诗文既滥，人不欲观，有的就用传奇文，来希图一新耳目，获得特效了，于是那时的传奇文，也就和“敲门砖”很有关系。但自然，只被风气所推，无所为而作者，却也并非没有的。
As for the reason why they wrote, it was that both the Six Dynasties and the Tang Dynasty did something. The "Book of Sui Classics" copied the "Book of Han Art and Literature" and said that the novel is compared to "asking the grass", which is proof that although it is a novel, it also has something to do. In practice, however, the scope of this has been narrowed. The Jin people were still talkative, talking about standards, and often used a few words to make it clear, so most of the novels at that time were "Shishuo" that recorded abnormal behaviors and words, but they were actually introductory books for taking the name of the tongue. The Tang Dynasty took scholars with poetry and prose, but also looked at the reputation in society, so when scholars entered Beijing to take the exam, they also had to first pay respects to famous public officials and present poems in the hope of their praise, which was called "running scroll". Poetry and prose are indiscriminate, people don't want to watch, and some use legendary texts to try to refresh their ears and eyes and get special effects, so the legendary texts at that time are also very related to the "stepping stone". But naturally, it is not that it is only pushed by the atmosphere and the author does nothing.五月三日。

什么是“讽刺”？

什么是“讽刺”？——答文学社问

什么是“讽刺”？

What is "irony"? ——Answer the question of the Literary Society我想：一个作者，用了精炼的，或者简直有些夸张的笔墨——但自然也必须是艺术的地——写出或一群人的或一面的真实来，这被写的一群人，就称这作品为“讽刺”。
I think: An author who uses a refined or simply exaggerated pen and ink - but naturally must also be artistically - writes the truth of a group of people or a side, and this group of people who are written calls this work "satire".“讽刺”的生命是真实；不必是曾有的实事，但必须是会有的实情。所以它不是“捏造”，也不是“诬蔑”；既不是“揭发阴私”，又不是专记骇人听闻的所谓“奇闻”或“怪现状”。它所写的事情是公然的，也是常见的，平时是谁都不以为奇的，而且自然是谁都毫不注意的。不过这事情在那时却已经是不合理，可笑，可鄙，甚而至于可恶。但这么行下来了，习惯了，虽在大庭广众之间，谁也不觉得奇怪；现在给它特别一提，就动人。譬如罢，洋服青年拜佛，现在是平常事，道学先生发怒，更是平常事，只消几分钟，这事迹就过去，消灭了。但“讽刺”却是正在这时候照下来的一张相，一个撅着屁股，一个皱着眉心，不但自己和别人看起来有些不很雅观，连自己看见也觉得不很雅观；而且流传开去，对于后日的大讲科学和高谈养性，也不免有些妨害。倘说，所照的并非真实，是不行的，因为这时有目共睹，谁也会觉得确有这等事；但又不好意思承认这是真实，失了自己的尊严。于是挖空心思，给起了一个名目，叫作“讽刺”。其意若曰：它偏要提出这等事，可见也不是好货。
The life of "irony" is real; It doesn't have to be a fact, but it must be a fact. So it is not a "fabrication" or a "slander"; It is neither "exposing private interests" nor focusing on the so-called "strange news" or "strange status quo" that is appalling. The things it writes about are blatant and common, and no one is usually surprised, and naturally no one pays attention. But at that time, this matter was already unreasonable, ridiculous, contemptible, and even hateful. But after doing this, I got used to it, and although it was in public, no one found it strange; Now to mention it in particular, it is moving. For example, it is a common thing for a young man in a foreign suit to worship Buddha, but it is even more common for a Taoist teacher to get angry, and it only takes a few minutes for this deed to pass and disappear. But the "irony" is a photo taken at this time, one with a pouting buttocks and the other frowning, not only does he and others look a little unelegant, but he even feels that he is not very elegant when he sees it; And if it spreads, it will inevitably hinder the future of science and high talk. If it is said that what is illuminated is not true, it is not possible, because at this time it is obvious to all, and no one will think that such a thing is true; But I was embarrassed to admit that this was true and lost my dignity. So he hollowed out his mind and gave it a name, called "irony". The meaning seems to be that it wants to raise such things, which shows that it is not a good commodity.有意的偏要提出这等事，而且加以精炼，甚至于夸张，却确是“讽刺”的本领。同一事件，在拉杂的非艺术的记录中，是不成为讽刺，谁也不大会受感动的。例如新闻记事，就记忆所及，今年就见过两件事。其一，是一个青年，冒充了军官，向各处招摇撞骗，后来破获了，他就写忏悔书，说是不过借此谋生，并无他意。其二，是一个窃贼招引学生，教授偷窃之法，家长知道，把自己的子弟禁在家里了，他还上门来逞凶。较可注意的事件，报上是往往有些特别的批评文字的，但对于这两件，却至今没有说过什么话，可见是看得很平常，以为不足介意的了。然而这材料，假如到了斯惠夫德（J. Swift）或果戈理（N. Gogol）的手里，我看是准可以成为出色的讽刺作品的。在或一时代的社会里，事情越平常，就越普遍，也就愈合于作讽刺。
Deliberately raising such things, and refining them, even exaggerated, is indeed the ability to "satirical". The same event, in the non-artistic records of Laza, does not become a satire, and no one will be moved. For example, as far as I can remember, I have seen two things this year. First, a young man pretended to be an officer and deceived everywhere, and when he was caught, he wrote a confession, saying that he was just making a living by doing so, and had no other intentions. Second, a thief lured students and taught them how to steal, and the parents knew that they had locked their children at home, and he came to the door to commit murder. For the more noteworthy events, the newspapers often have some special criticism, but for these two things, nothing has been said so far, which shows that it is very ordinary and thinks it is not worth worrying about. However, if this material reaches J. Swift) or Gogol (N. Gogol), I think it can definitely become an excellent satire. In the society of a certain era, the more ordinary things are, the more common they are, and they are more likely to be sarcastic.讽刺作者虽然大抵为被讽刺者所憎恨，但他却常常是善意的，他的讽刺，在希望他们改善，并非要捺这一群到水底里。然而待到同群中有讽刺作者出现的时候，这一群却已是不可收拾，更非笔墨所能救了，所以这努力大抵是徒劳的，而且还适得其反，实际上不过表现了这一群的缺点以至恶德，而对于敌对的别一群，倒反成为有益。我想：从别一群看来，感受是和被讽刺的那一群不同的，他们会觉得“暴露”更多于“讽刺”。
Although the satirist is generally hated by the satirist, he is often well-intentioned, and his satire, in the hope that they will improve, is not to push this group to the bottom of the water. However, when there are satirical authors in the same group, this group is out of control, let alone saved by pen and ink, so this effort is probably in vain, and it is counterproductive. I think that from the perspective of other groups, the feeling is different from that of the group that is being ridiculed, and they will feel that "exposure" is more than "irony".如果貌似讽刺的作品，而毫无善意，也毫无热情，只使读者觉得一切世事，一无足取，也一无可为，那就并非讽刺了，这便是所谓“冷嘲”。
If it seems to be a satirical work, but there is no goodwill, no enthusiasm, and only makes the reader feel that everything in the world is worthless and nothing can be done, then it is not irony, which is the so-called "cynicism".五月三日。
May 3rd.

论“人言可畏”

论“人言可畏”

论“人言可畏”

On "People Speak Fearfully"“人言可畏”是电影明星阮玲玉自杀之后，发见于她的遗书中的话。这哄动一时的事件，经过了一通空论，已经渐渐冷落了，只要《玲玉香消记》一停演，就如去年的艾霞自杀事件一样，完全烟消火灭。她们的死，不过像在无边的人海里添了几粒盐，虽然使扯淡的嘴巴们觉得有些味道，但不久也还是淡，淡，淡。
"People are terrifying" are the words of movie star Ruan Lingyu in her suicide note after she committed suicide. As long as "Lingyu Xiangxiaoji" stops performing, just like last year's Ai Xia suicide incident, it was completely extinguished. Their deaths were like adding a few grains of salt to the boundless sea of people, although they made the nonsense mouths feel a little smelly, but soon they were still light, light, light.这句话，开初是也曾惹起一点小风波的。有评论者，说是使她自杀之咎，可见也在日报记事对于她的诉讼事件的张扬；不久就有一位记者公开的反驳，以为现在的报纸的地位，舆论的威信，可怜极了，那里还有丝毫主宰谁的运命的力量，况且那些记载，大抵采自经官的事实，绝非捏造的谣言，旧报具在，可以复按。所以阮玲玉的死，和新闻记者是毫无关系的。
This sentence also caused a little turmoil at the beginning. Some commentators said that she was to blame for committing suicide, which shows that she also publicized her litigation in the daily newspaper; Soon a reporter publicly refuted, thinking that the status of the current newspaper and the prestige of public opinion were pitiful, and there was still the slightest power to dominate whose fate it was, and those records were mostly from the facts of the officials, and they were by no means fabricated rumors. Therefore, Ruan Lingyu's death has nothing to do with the news reporter.这都可以算是真实话。然而——也不尽然。
This can be regarded as true. However - not necessarily.现在的报章之不能像个报章，是真的；评论的不能逞心而谈，失了威力，也是真的，明眼人决不会过分的责备新闻记者。但是，新闻的威力其实是并未全盘坠地的，它对甲无损，对乙却会有伤；对强者它是弱者，但对更弱者它却还是强者，所以有时虽然吞声忍气，有时仍可以耀武扬威。于是阮玲玉之流，就成了发扬余威的好材料了，因为她颇有名，却无力。小市民总爱听人们的丑闻，尤其是有些熟识的人的丑闻。上海的街头巷尾的老虔婆，一知道近邻的阿二嫂家有野男人出入，津津乐道，但如果对她讲甘肃的谁在偷汉，新疆的谁在再嫁，她就不要听了。阮玲玉正在现身银幕，是一个大家认识的人，因此她更是给报章凑热闹的好材料，至少也可以增加一点销场。读者看了这些，有的想：“我虽然没有阮玲玉那么漂亮，却比她正经”；有的想：“我虽然不及阮玲玉的有本领，却比她出身高”；连自杀了之后，也还可以给人想：“我虽然没有阮玲玉的技艺，却比她有勇气，因为我没有自杀”。化几个铜元就发见了自己的优胜，那当然是很上算的。但靠演艺为生的人，一遇到公众发生了上述的前两种的感想，她就够走到末路了。所以我们且不要高谈什么连自己也并不了然的社会组织或意志强弱的滥调，先来设身处地的想一想罢，那么，大概就会知道阮玲玉的以为“人言可畏”，是真的，或人的以为她的自杀，和新闻记事有关，也是真的。
It is true that the current newspaper cannot be like a newspaper; It is also true that commentators cannot talk freely and lose their power, and discerning people will never blame journalists excessively. However, the power of the news is actually not completely falling to the ground, it does not damage A, but it will hurt B; It is weak to the strong, but it is still strong to the weaker, so sometimes it can still show off its might. So Ruan Lingyu and the like have become good materials for carrying forward Yu Wei, because she is quite famous, but powerless. Small citizens always love to listen to people's scandals, especially those of some familiar people. The old woman in the streets and alleys of Shanghai talked about it when she knew that there were wild men coming in and out of her neighbor's second sister-in-law's house, but if she told her who was stealing Han in Gansu and who was remarrying in Xinjiang, she would not listen. Ruan Lingyu is appearing on the screen and is a person everyone knows, so she is a good material for the newspaper to join the fun, at least it can increase the sales a little. Readers read this, and some thought: "Although I am not as beautiful as Ruan Lingyu, I am more serious than her"; Some thought: "Although I am not as capable as Ruan Lingyu, I am taller than her"; Even after committing suicide, people can also think: "Although I don't have Ruan Lingyu's skills, I have more courage than her, because I didn't commit suicide." A few copper dollars will find their own victory, which is of course very calculated. But for those who make a living from acting, as soon as she encounters the first two impressions of the public, she is enough to reach the end. So let's not talk about social organization or clichés about the strength of the will that even we don't understand, let's put ourselves in the shoes of the people first, then, we will probably know that Ruan Lingyu's thought that "people's words are terrifying" is true, or that people think that her suicide is related to news records, and it is also true.但新闻记者的辩解，以为记载大抵采自经官的事实，却也是真的。上海的有些介乎大报和小报之间的报章，那社会新闻，几乎大半是官司已经吃到公安局或工部局去了的案件。但有一点坏习气，是偏要加上些描写，对于女性，尤喜欢加上些描写；这种案件，是不会有名公巨卿在内的，因此也更不妨加上些描写。案中的男人的年纪和相貌，是大抵写得老实的，一遇到女人，可就要发挥才藻了，不是“徐娘半老，风韵犹存”，就是“豆蔻年华，玲珑可爱”。一个女孩儿跑掉了，自奔或被诱还不可知，才子就断定道，“小姑独宿，不惯无郎”，你怎么知道？一个村妇再醮了两回，原是穷乡僻壤的常事，一到才子的笔下，就又赐以大字的题目道，“奇淫不减武则天”，这程度你又怎么知道？这些轻薄句子，加之村姑，大约是并无什么影响的，她不识字，她的关系人也未必看报。但对于一个智识者，尤其是对于一个出到社会上了的女性，却足够使她受伤，更不必说故意张扬，特别渲染的文字了。然而中国的习惯，这些句子是摇笔即来，不假思索的，这时不但不会想到这也是玩弄着女性，并且也不会想到自己乃是人民的喉舌。但是，无论你怎么描写，在强者是毫不要紧的，只消一封信，就会有正误或道歉接着登出来，不过无拳无勇如阮玲玉，可就正做了吃苦的材料了，她被额外的画上一脸花，没法洗刷。叫她奋斗吗？她没有机关报，怎么奋斗；有冤无头，有怨无主，和谁奋斗呢？我们又可以设身处地的想一想，那么，大概就又知她的以为“人言可畏”，是真的，或人的以为她的自杀，和新闻记事有关，也是真的。
However, the defense of the journalist, thinking that the record is mostly taken from the fact that the official is true. Some newspapers in Shanghai, which are between broadsheets and tabloids, are almost all cases where lawsuits have already been filed by the Public Security Bureau or the Ministry of Works. But there is a bit of a bad habit, which is to add some descriptions, especially for women, they like to add some descriptions; This kind of case will not include famous public officials, so it is better to add some descriptions. The age and appearance of the man in the case are probably written honestly, and when he meets a woman, he has to give full play to his talents, either "Xu Niang is half old, the charm is still there", or "cardamom years, exquisite and cute". A girl ran away, running away or being lured into unknown, and the talent concluded, "The sister-in-law sleeps alone, not used to having no husband", how do you know? A village woman married twice, which was originally a common thing in poor and remote areas, but as soon as it came to the pen of the talent, she was given a title in big characters, "Strange lewdness is not inferior to Wu Zetian", how do you know this extent? These frivolous sentences, coupled with the village girl, probably have no effect, she is illiterate, and her relatives may not read the newspaper. But for an intellectual, especially for a woman who has gone out into society, it is enough to hurt her, not to mention deliberately publicized and specially exaggerated words. However, in China's habit, these sentences come without thinking, not only do they not think that this is also playing with women, but they also do not think that they are the mouthpiece of the people. However, no matter how you describe it, it doesn't matter to the strong, just one letter, there will be a right or wrong or an apology and then posted out, but there is no fist and no courage like Ruan Lingyu, but it is making a hard-working material, she is painted with an extra face, and she can't be washed. Tell her to struggle? She has no organ newspaper, how can she struggle; There is grievance without a head, there is a resentment without a master, who will you struggle with? We can put ourselves in the shoes of others, then, we probably know that her thought that "people are terrifying" is true, or that people think that her suicide is related to news records, and it is also true.然而，先前已经说过，现在的报章的失了力量，却也是真的，不过我以为还没有到达如记者先生所自谦，竟至一钱不值，毫无责任的时候。因为它对于更弱者如阮玲玉一流人，也还有左右她命运的若干力量的，这也就是说，它还能为恶，自然也还能为善。“有闻必录”或“并无能力”的话，都不是向上的负责的记者所该采用的口头禅，因为在实际上，并不如此，——它是有选择的，有作用的。
However, as I have said before, it is true that the current newspaper has lost its power, but I thought it had not yet reached the time when Mr. Reporter was humble and worthless. Because it also has some power that affects her fate for weaker people like Ruan Lingyu, which means that it can still do evil, and naturally it can also do good. "If you hear it, you must record" or "you are not capable" are not mantras that upward responsible journalists should adopt, because in reality, this is not the case,—— it is selective and functional.至于阮玲玉的自杀，我并不想为她辩护。我是不赞成自杀，自己也不豫备自杀的。但我的不豫备自杀，不是不屑，却因为不能。凡有谁自杀了，现在是总要受一通强毅的评论家的呵斥，阮玲玉当然也不在例外。然而我想，自杀其实是不很容易，决没有我们不豫备自杀的人们所渺视的那么轻而易举的。倘有谁以为容易么，那么，你倒试试看！
As for Ruan Lingyu's suicide, I don't want to defend her. I am not in favor of suicide, and I am not prepared to commit suicide. But my unprepared suicide is not disdainful, but because I can't. Whoever commits suicide is now always scolded by a resolute critic, and Ruan Lingyu is certainly no exception. However, I think that suicide is not easy, and it is by no means as easy as those who are not prepared for suicide despise. If anyone thinks it's easy, then you should try it!自然，能试的勇者恐怕也多得很，不过他不屑，因为他有对于社会的伟大的任务。那不消说，更加是好极了，但我希望大家都有一本笔记簿，写下所尽的伟大的任务来，到得有了曾孙的时候，拿出来算一算，看看怎么样。
Naturally, there are probably many brave people who can try, but he disdains it because he has a great task for society. Needless to say, it's even better, but I hope everyone has a notebook to write down the great tasks they have done, and when they have a great-grandson, take it out and do the math to see how it goes.五月五日。
May 5th.

再论“文人相轻”

再论“文人相轻”

再论“文人相轻”

Let's talk about "literati look down on each other"今年的所谓“文人相轻”，不但是混淆黑白的口号，掩护着文坛的昏暗，也在给有一些人“挂着羊头卖狗肉”的。
This year's so-called "literati look down on each other" not only confuses black and white slogans and covers the darkness of the literary world, but also gives some people "selling dog meat with sheep's heads".真的“各以所长，相轻所短”的能有多少呢！我们在近几年所遇见的，有的是“以其所短，轻人所短”。例如白话文中，有些是诘屈难读的，确是一种“短”，于是有人提了小品或语录，向这一点昂然进攻了，但不久就露出尾巴来，暴露了他连对于自己所提倡的文章，也常常点着破句，“短”得很。有的却简直是“以其所短，轻人所长”了。例如轻蔑“杂文”的人，不但他所用的也是“杂文”，而他的“杂文”，比起他所轻蔑的别的“杂文”来，还拙劣到不能相提并论。那些高谈阔论，不过是契诃夫（A. Chekhov）所指出的登了不识羞的顶颠，傲视着一切，被轻者是无福和他们比较的，更从什么地方“相”起？现在谓之“相”，其实是给他们一扬，靠了这“相”，也是“文人”了。然而，“所长”呢？
How many people can really "each have their own strengths, and each is weak"! What we have encountered in recent years is "based on their shortcomings, underestimating others' shortcomings". For example, in the vernacular texts, some of them are difficult to read, and they are indeed a kind of "short", so someone mentioned sketches or quotations and attacked this point proudly, but soon showed their tails, exposing that even the articles he advocated often pointed out broken sentences, which were very "short". Some are simply "based on their shortcomings, underestimating others' strengths". For example, a person who despises "essays" not only uses "essays", and his "essays" are so clumsy that they cannot be compared compared with other "essays" he despises. Those grandiose rhetoric are nothing more than Chekhov's (A. Chekhov) pointed out that he has ascended to the top of shamelessness, looked down on everything, and was compared with them without blessing, so where did he "look" from? Now it is called "Xiang", in fact, it is to give them a boost, relying on this "Xiang", they are also "literati". However, what about the "director"?况且现在文坛上的纠纷，其实也并不是为了文笔的短长。文学的修养，决不能使人变成木石，所以文人还是人，既然还是人，他心里就仍然有是非，有爱憎；但又因为是文人，他的是非就愈分明，爱憎也愈热烈。从圣贤一直敬到骗子屠夫，从美人香草一直爱到麻疯病菌的文人，在这世界上是找不到的，遇见所是和所爱的，他就拥抱，遇见所非和所憎的，他就反拨。如果第三者不以为然了，可以指出他所非的其实是“是”，他所憎的其实该爱来，单用了笼统的“文人相轻”这一句空话，是不能抹杀的，世间还没有这种便宜事。一有文人，就有纠纷，但到后来，谁是谁非，孰存孰亡，都无不明明白白。因为还有一些读者，他的是非爱憎，是比和事老的评论家还要清楚的。
Moreover, the disputes in the literary world are not actually for the length of the writing. The cultivation of literature must not turn people into wood and stone, so the literati are still people, since they are still people, they still have right and wrong, love and hate in their hearts; But because he is a literati, his rights and wrongs are clearer, and his love and hate are more enthusiastic. From the sages to the liar butcher, from the beauty vanilla to the literati who love leprosy, they cannot be found in this world. If the third party disagrees, it can be pointed out that what he is not is actually "yes", and what he hates should actually be loved. As soon as there are literati, there are disputes, but later, who is right and who is wrong, who lives and who dies, is all unclear. Because there are still some readers, his right and wrong, love and hate, are clearer than the old critics.然而，又有人来恐吓了。他说，你不怕么？古之嵇康，在柳树下打铁，钟会来看他，他不客气，问道：“何所闻而来，何所见而去？”于是得罪了钟文人，后来被他在司马懿面前搬是非，送命了。所以你无论遇见谁，应该赶紧打拱作揖，让坐献茶，连称“久仰久仰”才是。这自然也许未必全无好处，但做文人做到这地步，不是很有些近乎婊子了么？况且这位恐吓家的举例，其实也是不对的，嵇康的送命，并非为了他是傲慢的文人，大半倒因为他是曹家的女婿，即使钟会不去搬是非，也总有人去搬是非的，所谓“重赏之下，必有勇夫”者是也。
However, someone came to intimidate. He said, aren't you afraid? In ancient times, Ji Kang, who was striking iron under the willow tree, Zhong Hui came to see him, he was polite and asked, "What did you hear and what did you see?" So he offended Zhong Wenren, and later he was killed in front of Sima Yi. So no matter who you meet, you should quickly bow and bow, let you sit down and offer tea, and even say "long admiration". This may not be without benefits, but isn't it a bit close to bitch to be a literati to this extent? Moreover, the example of this intimidator is actually not right, Ji Kang's death is not because he is an arrogant literati, most of it is because he is the son-in-law of the Cao family, even if Zhong Hui does not move right and wrong, there will always be people who will move right and wrong, the so-called "under the heavy reward, there must be a brave man" is also.不过我在这里，并非主张文人应该傲慢，或不妨傲慢，只是说，文人不应该随和；而且文人也不会随和，会随和的，只有和事老。但这不随和，却又并非回避，只是唱着所是，颂着所爱，而不管所非和所憎；他得像热烈地主张着所是一样，热烈地攻击着所非，像热烈地拥抱着所爱一样，更热烈地拥抱着所憎——恰如赫尔库来斯（Hercules）的紧抱了巨人安太乌斯（Antaeus）一样，因为要折断他的肋骨。
However, I am not here to advocate that literati should be arrogant, or that they should be arrogant, but that literati should not be easy-going; And the literati will not be easy-going, they will be easy-going, only peacemakers. But this is not easy-going, but not avoiding, just singing about what is and what is loved, regardless of what is wrong or hated; He had to attack what was wrong as he was passionately, as he hugged his loved one more fervently, and even more passionately embraced what he hated—just as Hercules hugged the giant Antaeus because he was going to break his ribs.五月五日。
May 5th.

《全国木刻联合展览会专辑》序

《全国木刻联合展览会专辑》序

《全国木刻联合展览会专辑》序

Preface to the "National Woodcut Joint Exhibition Album"木刻的图画，原是中国早先就有的东西。唐末的佛像，纸牌，以至后来的小说绣像，启蒙小图，我们至今还能够看见实物。而且由此明白：它本来就是大众的，也就是“俗”的。明人曾用之于诗笺，近乎雅了，然而归结是有文人学士在它全体上用大笔一挥，证明了这其实不过是践踏。
Woodcut drawings were originally something that existed in China earlier. We can still see the real thing in the Buddha statues, cards, and later novel embroidery and enlightenment pictures at the end of the Tang Dynasty. And from this, it is understood: it is originally popular, that is, "vulgar". The Ming people used it in poetry, almost elegant, but it boils down to the fact that some literati and scholars used a big pen on it all, proving that this was actually just trampling.近五年来骤然兴起的木刻，虽然不能说和古文化无关，但决不是葬中枯骨，换了新装，它乃是作者和社会大众的内心的一致的要求，所以仅有若干青年们的一副铁笔和几块木板，便能发展得如此蓬蓬勃勃。它所表现的是艺术学徒的热诚，因此也常常是现代社会的魂魄。实绩具在，说它“雅”，固然是不可的，但指为“俗”，却又断乎不能。这之前，有木刻了，却未曾有过这境界。
The sudden rise of woodcuts in the past five years, although it cannot be said that they have nothing to do with ancient culture, are by no means buried bones and changed to new clothes, it is the unanimous requirement of the author and the public, so only a pair of iron pens and a few wooden boards of a few young people can develop so vigorously. It expresses the enthusiasm of an art apprentice, and therefore often the soul of modern society. The actual results are there, and it is certainly impossible to say that it is "elegant", but it is absolutely impossible to refer to it as "vulgar". Before this, there were woodcuts, but there was never such a realm.这就是所以为新兴木刻的缘故，也是所以为大众所支持的原因。血脉相通，当然不会被漠视的。所以木刻不但淆乱了雅俗之辨而已，实在还有更光明，更伟大的事业在它的前面。
This is why it is for the sake of emerging woodcuts, and it is also the reason why it is supported by the public. Of course, they will not be ignored. Therefore, woodcuts not only confuse the distinction between elegant and vulgar, but also have a brighter and greater cause ahead of it.曾被看作高尚的风景和静物画，在新的木刻上是减少了，然而看起出品来，这二者反显着较优的成绩。因为中国旧画，两者最多，耳濡目染，不觉见其久经摄取的所长了，而现在最需要的，也是作者最着力的人物和故事画，却仍然不免有些逊色，平常的器具和形态，也间有不合实际的。由这事实，一面固足见古文化之裨助着后来，也束缚着后来，但一面也可见入“俗”之不易了。
The landscapes and still lifes that were once regarded as noble were reduced in the new woodcuts, but in terms of production, these two actually performed significantly better. Because of the old Chinese paintings, the two are the most, and I can't help but see their long-standing strengths, and now what is most needed, and the author's most focused character and story paintings, are still a little inferior, and the usual utensils and forms are also unrealistic. From this fact, on the one hand, it is enough to see that ancient culture helped and bound the later, but on the other hand, it can also be seen that it is not easy to enter the "vulgar".这选集，是聚全国出品的精粹的第一本。但这是开始，不是成功，是几个前哨的进行，愿此后更有无尽的旌旗蔽空的大队。
This anthology is the first book produced by Ju National. But this is the beginning, not a success, but the progress of several outposts, and I hope there will be more endless brigades covering the sky after that.一九三五年六月四日记。
Diary of June 4, 1935.

文坛三户

文坛三户

文坛三户

There are three households in the literary world二十年来，中国已经有了一些作家，多少作品，而且至今还没有完结，所以有个“文坛”，是毫无可疑的。不过搬出去开博览会，却还得顾虑一下。
In the past twenty years, China has had some writers and many works, and they have not yet been completed, so there is no doubt that there is a "literary world". However, if you move out to hold an expo, you still have to worry about it.因为文字的难，学校的少，我们的作家里面，恐怕未必有村姑变成的才女，牧童化出的文豪。古时候听说有过一面看牛牧羊，一面读经，终于成了学者的人的，但现在恐怕未必有。——我说了两回“恐怕未必”，倘真有例外的天才，尚希鉴原为幸。要之，凡有弄弄笔墨的人们，他先前总有一点凭借：不是祖遗的正在少下去的钱，就是父积的还在多起来的钱。要不然，他就无缘读书识字。现在虽然有了识字运动，我也不相信能够由此运出作家来。所以这文坛，从阴暗这方面看起来，暂时大约还要被两大类子弟，就是“破落户”和“暴发户”所占据。
Because of the difficulty of writing and the lack of schools, I am afraid that among our writers, there may not be talented women turned into village girls and literary heroes transformed into shepherd boys. In ancient times, I heard that there were people who watched cattle and sheep and read the scriptures at the same time, and finally became scholars, but now I am afraid that there may not be. ——I said twice "I'm afraid not", if there are really exceptional geniuses, Shang Xijian would be fortunate. In short, anyone who plays with pen and ink always has a little reliance before: either the money that is decreasing from the ancestral legacy, or the money that the father has accumulated is still increasing. Otherwise, he would not have had the opportunity to read and write. Although there is a literacy movement now, I do not believe that writers can be transported from it. Therefore, this literary world, from the dark side, will be occupied by two major categories of children for the time being, namely "broken households" and "nouveau riche".已非暴发，又未破落的，自然也颇有出些著作的人，但这并非第三种，不近于甲，即近于乙的，至于掏腰包印书，仗奁资出版者，那是文坛上的捐班，更不在本论范围之内。所以要说专仗笔墨的作者，首先还得求之于破落户中。他先世也许暴发过，但现在是文雅胜于算盘，家景大不如意了，然而又因此看见世态的炎凉，人生的苦乐，于是真的有些抚今追昔，“缠绵悱恻”起来。一叹天时不良，二叹地理可恶，三叹自己无能。但这无能又并非真无能，乃是自己不屑有能，所以这无能的高尚，倒远在有能之上。你们剑拔弩张，汗流浃背，到底做成了些什么呢？惟我的颓唐相，是“十年一觉扬州梦”，惟我的破衣上，是“襟上杭州旧酒痕”，连懒态和污渍，也都有历史的甚深意义的。可惜俗人不懂得，于是他们的杰作上，就大抵放射着一种特别的神彩，是：“顾影自怜”。
It is no longer an outbreak, and it has not been broken, and naturally there are quite a few people who have written some works, but this is not the third type, not close to A, that is, close to B, as for the publisher who prints books out of his pocket and relies on the dowry to publish, it is a donation class in the literary world, let alone within the scope of this theory. Therefore, if you want to say that the author who specializes in pen and ink, you must first seek it in the broken house. He may have had an outbreak in his ancestors, but now it is elegant than abacus, and the family scene is very unsatisfactory, but because of this, he sees the coldness of the world and the bitterness and joy of life, so he really looks back on the past and "lingers and compassion". One lamented the bad weather, the second lamented the hatred of geography, and the third lamented his own incompetence. But this incompetence is not really incompetent, but that he disdains to be capable, so the nobility of this incompetence is far above the ability. What have you done, sweating? Only my decadent Tang appearance is "ten years of Yangzhou dream", but on my torn clothes, there are "old wine stains from Hangzhou on the collar", and even laziness and stains also have deep historical significance. It's a pity that ordinary people don't understand, so their masterpieces probably radiate a special look, which is: "Gu Ying self-pity".暴发户作家的作品，表面上和破落户的并无不同。因为他意在用墨水洗去铜臭，这才爬上一向为破落户所主宰的文坛来，以自附于“风雅之林”，又并不想另树一帜，因此也决不标新立异。但仔细一看，却是属于别一本户口册上的；他究竟显得浅薄，而且装腔，学样。房里会有断句的诸子，看不懂；案头也会有石印的骈文，读不断。也会嚷“襟上杭州旧酒痕”呀，但一面又怕别人疑心他穿破衣，总得设法表示他所穿的乃是笔挺的洋服或簇新的绸衫；也会说“十年一觉扬州梦”的，但其实倒是并不挥霍的好品行，因为暴发户之于金钱，觉得比懒态和污渍更有历史的甚深的意义。破落户的颓唐，是掉下来的悲声，暴发户的做作的颓唐，却是“爬上去”的手段。所以那些作品，即使摹拟到和破落户的杰作几乎相同，但一定还差一尘：他其实并不“顾影自怜”，倒在“沾沾自喜”。
The works of nouveau riche writers are no different from those of dilapidated households on the surface. Because he intended to wash away the smell of copper with ink, he climbed up to the literary world that had always been dominated by broken households, in order to attach himself to the "forest of elegance", and did not want to be unique, so he would never be unconventional. But if you look closely, it belongs to another household registration book; He seems shallow, and he pretends to be like this. There will be broken sentences in the room, and they can't understand it; There will also be stone prints on the desk, which are constantly read. he would also shout "old wine stains from Hangzhou on his collar", but on the other hand, he was afraid that others would suspect that he was wearing tattered clothes, so he had to try to show that he was wearing a straight suit or a new silk shirt; It will also be said that "ten years of Yangzhou dream", but in fact, it is not a squandering good character, because the nouveau riche feels that money has a deeper historical significance than laziness and stains. The decadence of the broken house is the sad cry of falling, and the pretentious decadence of the nouveau riche is a means of "climbing up". Therefore, those works, even if they are almost identical to the masterpieces of the broken house, must still be missing: he is actually not "self-pitying", but "complacent".这“沾沾自喜”的神情，从破落户的眼睛看来，就是所谓“小家子相”，也就是所谓“俗”。风雅的定律，一个人离开“本色”，是就要“俗”的。不识字人不算俗，他要掉文，又掉不对，就俗；富家儿郎也不算俗，他要做诗，又做不好，就俗了。这在文坛上，向来为破落户所鄙弃。
This "complacent" look, from the eyes of the broken family, is the so-called "small family appearance", that is, the so-called "vulgar". The law of elegance is that if a person leaves his "true color", he must be "vulgar". An illiterate person is not vulgar, he wants to drop the text, and if he doesn't drop it, he will be vulgar; A rich man is not vulgar, he wants to write poetry, but if he can't do it well, he will be vulgar. In the literary world, this has always been despised by the broken households.然而破落户到了破落不堪的时候，这两户却有时可以交融起来的。如果谁有在找“词汇”的《文选》，大可以查一查，我记得里面就有一篇弹文，所弹的乃是一个败落的世家，把女儿嫁给了暴发而冒充世家的满家子：这就足见两户的怎样反拨，也怎样的联合了。文坛上自然也有这现象；但在作品上的影响，却不过使暴发户增添一些得意之色，破落户则对于“俗”变为谦和，向别方面大谈其风雅而已：并不怎么大。
However, when the broken house is dilapidated, the two households can sometimes blend together. If anyone is looking for the "Selected Works" of "Vocabulary", they can check it, I remember that there was an article in it, which was about a fallen family who married his daughter to a full family who pretended to be a family in an outbreak: this shows how the two families rebelled and how they were united. This phenomenon naturally exists in the literary world; However, the influence on the work only adds some pride to the nouveau riche, and the broken house becomes modest about the "vulgar", and talks about its elegance to other aspects: it is not very big.暴发户爬上文坛，固然未能免俗，历时既久，一面持筹握算，一面诵诗读书，数代以后，就雅起来，待到藏书日多，藏钱日少的时候，便有做真的破落户文学的资格了。然而时势的飞速的变化，有时能不给他这许多修养的工夫，于是暴发不久，破落随之，既“沾沾自喜”，也“顾影自怜”，但却又失去了“沾沽自喜”的确信，可又还没有配得“顾影自怜”的风姿，仅存无聊，连古之所谓雅俗也说不上了。向来无定名，我姑且名之为“破落暴发户”罢。这一户，此后是恐怕要多起来的。但还要有变化：向积极方面走，是恶少；向消极方面走，是瘪三。
After a long time, while holding the chips and calculations, while reciting poetry and reading, after several generations, it became elegant, and when the book collection was more and the money was less hidden, it was qualified to do real broken literature. However, the rapid changes in the situation sometimes can not give him a lot of time for self-cultivation, so the outbreak is not long after, and the ruin follows, not only "complacency" but also "self-pity", but also lost the conviction of "self-pity", but has not yet been worthy of the demeanor of "self-pity", only boredom, and even the so-called elegance and vulgarity of ancient times cannot be said. There has never been a fixed name, so I will call it "dilapidated nouveau riche". I am afraid that there will be more of this household in the future. But there must be changes: going to the positive side is a villain; Going to the negative side is deflated three.使中国的文学有起色的人，在这三户之外。
The people who made Chinese literature improve were outside these three households.六月六日。

从帮忙到扯淡

从帮忙到扯淡

从帮忙到扯淡

From helping to nonsense“帮闲文学”曾经算是一个恶毒的贬辞，——但其实是误解的。
"Helping literature" was once a vicious derogatory term,—— but it was actually misunderstood.《诗经》是后来的一部经，但春秋时代，其中的有几篇就用之于侑酒；屈原是“楚辞”的开山老祖，而他的《离骚》，却只是不得帮忙的不平。到得宋玉，就现有的作品看起来，他已经毫无不平，是一位纯粹的清客了。然而《诗经》是经，也是伟大的文学作品；屈原宋玉，在文学史上还是重要的作家。为什么呢？——就因为他究竟有文采。
The Book of Songs is a later classic, but in the Spring and Autumn Period, several of them were used for wine; Qu Yuan is the founding ancestor of "Chuci", but his "Li Sao" is just an injustice that cannot be helped. When it comes to Song Yu, as far as the existing works are concerned, he has no injustice and is a pure Qingke. However, the "Book of Songs" is a scripture and a great literary work; Qu Yuan and Song Yu are still important writers in the history of literature. Why? ——Just because he has literary talent.中国的开国的雄主，是把“帮忙”和“帮闲”分开来的，前者参与国家大事，作为重臣，后者却不过叫他献诗作赋，“俳优蓄之”，只在弄臣之例。不满于后者的待遇的是司马相如，他常常称病，不到武帝面前去献殷勤，却暗暗的作了关于封禅的文章，藏在家里，以见他也有计画大典——帮忙的本领，可惜等到大家知道的时候，他已经“寿终正寝”了。然而虽然并未实际上参与封禅的大典，司马相如在文学史上也还是很重要的作家。为什么呢？就因为他究竟有文采。
The former participated in national affairs and was an important minister, but the latter only asked him to dedicate poems and compose poems, "haiku savings", only in the case of rigoletto. Dissatisfied with the latter's treatment, Sima Xiangru often claimed to be ill and did not go to Emperor Wu to show his hospitality, but secretly wrote an article about Fengshan and hid it at home, so that he also had the ability to plan the ceremony - help, but unfortunately by the time everyone knew, he had already "died". However, although he did not actually participate in the Fengshan ceremony, Sima Xiangru was still an important writer in the history of literature. Why? Just because he has literary talent.但到文雅的庸主时，“帮忙”和“帮闲”的可就混起来了，所谓国家的柱石，也常是柔媚的词臣，我们在南朝的几个末代时，可以找出这实例。然而主虽然“庸”，却不“陋”，所以那些帮闲者，文采却究竟还有的，他们的作品，有些也至今不灭。
But when it comes to the elegant mediocre lord, "help" and "help" can be mixed, and the so-called pillar of the country is often a soft poet, and we can find this example in the last few dynasties of the Southern Dynasty. However, although the Lord is "mediocre", he is not "ugly", so those who help him still have literary talent, and some of their works are still alive today.谁说“帮闲文学”是一个恶毒的贬辞呢？
Who said that "helping literature" is a vicious derogatory term?就是权门的清客，他也得会下几盘棋，写一笔字，画画儿，识古董，懂得些猜拳行令，打趣插科，这才能不失其为清客。也就是说，清客，还要有清客的本领的，虽然是有骨气者所不屑为，却又非搭空架者所能企及。例如李渔的《一家言》，袁枚的《随园诗话》，就不是每个帮闲都做得出来的。必须有帮闲之志，又有帮闲之才，这才是真正的帮闲。如果有其志而无其才，乱点古书，重抄笑话，吹拍名士，拉扯趣闻，而居然不顾脸皮，大摆架子，反自以为得意，——自然也还有人以为有趣，——但按其实，却不过“扯淡”而已。
Even if he is a Qingke of the powerful family, he must also be able to play a few games of chess, write a stroke, draw a picture, know antiques, know some guessing boxing orders, and joke gags, so that he can not lose his Qingke. In other words, Qingke, but also have the ability to Qingke, although it is disdainful of those with backbone, but it is beyond the reach of those who build empty shelves. For example, Li Yu's "Family Words" and Yuan Mei's "Suiyuan Poems" are not made by every helper. There must be the ambition to help, and the talent to help, this is the real help. If you have ambition but no talent, randomly order ancient books, recopy jokes, blow up celebrities, pull funny stories, and actually ignore your face, put on a show, and think you are proud,—— naturally there are still people who think it is interesting,—— but in fact, it is just "nonsense".帮闲的盛世是帮忙，到末代就只剩了这扯淡。
The prosperity of helping is helping, and in the last generation, there is only this nonsense.六月六日。

Preface to the Japanese translation of "A Brief History of Chinese Novels"听到了拙著《中国小说史略》的日本译《支那小说史》已经到了出版的机运，非常之高兴，但因此又感到自己的衰退了。
I was very happy to hear that the Japanese translation of "History of Chinese Novels" had reached the opportunity to be published, but I felt that I was declining.回忆起来，大约四五年前罢，增田涉君几乎每天到寓斋来商量这一本书，有时也纵谈当时文坛的情形，很为愉快。那时候，我是还有这样的余暇，而且也有再加研究的野心的。但光阴如驶，近来却连一妻一子，也将为累，至于收集书籍之类，更成为身外的长物了。改订《小说史略》的机缘，恐怕也未必有。所以恰如准备辍笔的老人，见了自己的全集的印成而高兴一样，我也因而高兴的罢。
Looking back, about four or five years ago, Masuda Wabukun came to the residence almost every day to discuss this book, and sometimes talked about the situation in the literary world at that time, which was very pleasant. At that time, I still had such leisure time, and I also had the ambition to study more. But time flies, but recently even a wife and a son will be tired, and as for collecting books and the like, it has become a long thing outside the body. I am afraid that there may not be an opportunity to revise the "History of Novels". So just like the old man who was about to quit writing was happy to see the printing of his complete works, I was also happy because of it.然而，积习好像也还是难忘的。关于小说史的事情，有时也还加以注意，说起较大的事来，则有今年已成故人的马廉教授，于去年翻印了“清平山堂”残本，使宋人话本的材料更加丰富；郑振铎教授又证明了《西游记》中的《西游记》是吴承恩《西游记》的摘录，而并非祖本，这是可以订正拙著第十六篇的所说的，那精确的论文，就收录在《痀偻集》里。还有一件，是《金瓶梅词话》被发见于北平，为通行至今的同书的祖本，文章虽比现行本粗率，对话却全用山东的方言所写，确切的证明了这决非江苏人王世贞所作的书。
However, the habit seems to be unforgettable. Speaking of bigger things, there is Professor Ma Lian, who has become deceased this year, who reprinted the fragments of "Qingping Shantang" last year, making the materials of the Song people's script richer; Professor Zheng Zhenduo also proved that the "Journey to the West" in "Journey to the West" is an excerpt from Wu Chengen's "Journey to the West", not the ancestral version, which can be corrected in the sixteenth chapter of my book, and the accurate thesis is included in the "Collection of Obsessions". Another thing is that "Jin Ping Mei Ci Words" was discovered in Peiping, which is the ancestor of the same book that has been in use to this day, although the article is rougher than the current version, but the dialogue is all written in the Shandong dialect, which definitely proves that this is by no means a book written by Wang Shizhen from Jiangsu.但我却并不改订，目睹其不完不备，置之不问，而只对于日本译的出版，自在高兴了。但愿什么时候，还有补这懒惰之过的时机。
But I did not revise it, and when I saw its incompleteness, I ignored it, and I was only happy about the publication of the Japanese translation. I hope that someday, there will be an opportunity to make up for this laziness.这一本书，不消说，是一本有着寂寞的运命的书。然而增田君排除困难，加以翻译，赛棱社主三上於菟吉氏不顾利害，给它出版，这是和将这寂寞的书带到书斋里去的读者诸君，我都真心感谢的。
This book, needless to say, is a book with a lonely fate. However, Masuda-kun overcame the difficulties and translated it, and the owner of the Sailing Society, Mikami Yu Tuji, published it regardless of the interests, which is a sincere thank you to all the readers who brought this lonely book to the study.一九三五年六月九日灯下，鲁迅。
Under the lamp on June 9, 1935, Lu Xun.

“题未定”草

"Title undecided" draft一
One极平常的豫想，也往往会给实验打破。我向来总以为翻译比创作容易，因为至少是无须构想。但到真的一译，就会遇着难关，譬如一个名词或动词，写不出，创作时候可以回避，翻译上却不成，也还得想，一直弄到头昏眼花，好像在脑子里面摸一个急于要开箱子的钥匙，却没有。严又陵说，“一名之立，旬月踌蹰”，是他的经验之谈，的的确确的。
Very ordinary imaginations are often broken by experiments. I always think that translation is easier than creation, because at least it doesn't need to be conceived. But when it comes to translation, you will encounter difficulties, such as a noun or verb, which cannot be written, can be avoided when creating, but cannot be translated, and you have to think about it until you are dizzy, as if you are touching a key in your head that is eager to open the box, but you don't. Yan Youling said, "A name is established, and it takes ten months to hesitate", which is his experience, and it is true.新近就因为豫想的不对，自己找了一个苦吃。《世界文库》的编者要我译果戈理的《死魂灵》，没有细想，一口答应了。这书我不过曾经草草的看过一遍，觉得写法平直，没有现代作品的希奇古怪，那时的人们还在蜡烛光下跳舞，可见也不会有什么摩登名词，为中国所未有，非译者来闭门生造不可的。我最怕新花样的名词，譬如电灯，其实也不算新花样了，一个电灯的另件，我叫得出六样：花线，灯泡，灯罩，沙袋，扑落，开关。但这是上海话，那后三个，在别处怕就行不通。《一天的工作》里有一篇短篇，讲到铁厂，后来有一位在北方铁厂里的读者给我一封信，说其中的机件名目，没有一个能够使他知道实物是什么的。呜呼，——这里只好呜呼了——其实这些名目，大半乃是十九世纪末我在江南学习挖矿时，得之老师的传授。不知是古今异时，还是南北异地之故呢，隔膜了。在青年文学家靠它修养的《庄子》和《文选》或者明人小品里，也找不出那些名目来。没有法子。“三十六着，走为上着”，最没有弊病的是莫如不沾手。
Recently, because what I thought was wrong, I found a hard time to eat. The editor of "World Library" asked me to translate Gogol's "Dead Souls", and without thinking about it, I agreed. I just read this book hastily, and I felt that the writing was straight, without the strangeness of modern works, and people were still dancing by candlelight at that time, so it can be seen that there would be no modern terms, which were unprecedented in China, and it was impossible for translators to create them behind closed doors. I am most afraid of new tricks, such as electric lights, in fact, they are not new tricks, and I can name six different types of electric lights: flower wires, light bulbs, lampshades, sandbags, flutters, and switches. But this is Shanghainese, and the last three are afraid that they won't work elsewhere. There is a short story in "A Day's Work" about the iron factory, and later a reader in the Northern Iron Works gave me a letter, saying that none of the names of the parts in it could make him know what the real thing was. Oh,—— I have to go here - in fact, most of these names were taught by my teacher when I was studying mining in Jiangnan at the end of the 19th century. I don't know if it's because of the different times in ancient and modern times, or because the north and south are different, it's a barrier. In the "Zhuangzi" and "Anthology" or Ming people's sketches cultivated by young writers, those names cannot be found. There is no way. "Thirty-six, walking is the top", the most flawless thing is not to touch your hands.可恨我还太自大，竟又小觑了《死魂灵》，以为这倒不算什么，担当回来，真的又要翻译了。于是“苦”字上头。仔细一读，不错，写法的确不过平铺直叙，但到处是刺，有的明白，有的却隐藏，要感得到；虽然重译，也得竭力保存它的锋头。里面确没有电灯和汽车，然而十九世纪上半期的菜单，赌具，服装，也都是陌生家伙。这就势必至于字典不离手，冷汗不离身，一面也自然只好怪自己语学程度的不够格。但这一杯偶然自大了一下的罚酒是应该喝干的：硬着头皮译下去。到得烦厌，疲倦了的时候，就随便拉本新出的杂志来翻翻，算是休息。这是我的老脾气，休息之中，也略含幸灾乐祸之意，其意若曰：这回是轮到我舒舒服服的来看你们在闹什么花样了。
I hate that I am still too arrogant, and I actually underestimated "Dead Souls", thinking that this is nothing, and when I take responsibility, I really have to translate it again. So the word "bitter" came up. Read it carefully, yes, the writing is indeed just plain and straightforward, but there are thorns everywhere, some understand, some are hidden, and you have to feel it; Although it is retranslated, it must also be tried to preserve its edge. There were indeed no lights or cars in it, but the menus, gambling tools, and costumes of the first half of the 19th century were also strangers. This is bound to lead to the fact that the dictionary does not leave his hand, and he does not leave his body, and on the other hand, he naturally has to blame his own language level for not being qualified. But this glass of penalty wine that was accidentally arrogant should be drunk: bite the bullet and translate. When I get tired and tired, I just pull a new magazine and flip through it, which is considered a rest. This is my old temper, and during the rest, there is also a slight sense of gloating, which means that it is my turn to see what you are doing comfortably.好像华盖运还没有交完，仍旧不得舒服。拉到手的是《文学》四卷六号，一翻开来，卷头就有一幅红印的大广告，其中说是下一号里，要有我的散文了，题目叫作“未定”。往回一想，编辑先生的确曾经给我一封信，叫我寄一点文章，但我最怕的正是所谓做文章，不答。文章而至于要做，其苦可知。不答者，即答曰不做之意。不料一面又登出广告来了，情同绑票，令我为难。但同时又想到这也许还是自己错，我曾经发表过，我的文章，不是涌出，乃是挤出来的。他大约正抓住了这弱点，在用挤出法；而且我遇见编辑先生们时，也间或觉得他们有想挤之状，令人寒心。先前如果说：“我的文章，是挤也挤不出来的”，那恐怕要安全得多了，我佩服陀思妥也夫斯基的少谈自己，以及有些文豪们的专讲别人。
It seems that the canopy luck has not yet been handed over, and it is still not comfortable. What I pulled in my hand was the fourth volume of "Literature" No. 6, and as soon as I opened it, there was a large advertisement with a red seal at the beginning of the volume, which said that in the next issue, there would be my prose, and the title was called "Undecided". Looking back, the editor did send me a letter asking me to send a little article, but what I was most afraid of was the so-called making an article and not answering. The pain of writing and doing it is understandable. If you don't answer, you mean you don't do it. Unexpectedly, another advertisement came out, and it was like a ticket, which made me embarrassed. But at the same time, I thought that this might be my fault, I once published that my articles were not pouring out, but squeezing out. He probably grasped this weakness and was using the extrusion method; And when I meet the editors, I sometimes feel that they want to squeeze out, which is chilling. If I had previously said: "My article can't be squeezed out", then it would probably be much safer, and I admire Dostoevsky's lack of talk about himself, as well as the focus of some writers on others.但是，积习还未尽除，稿费又究竟可以换米，写一点也还不算什么“冤沉海底”。笔，是有点古怪的，它有编辑先生一样的“挤”的本领。袖手坐着，想打盹，笔一在手，面前放一张稿子纸，就往往会莫名其妙的写出些什么来。自然，要好，可不见得。
However, the accumulated habits have not been completely eliminated, and the manuscript fee can be exchanged for rice, and writing is not a "grievance to the bottom of the sea". The pen is a bit strange, it has the same ability to "squeeze" as Mr. Editor. Sitting with his hands in his hands, wanting to take a nap, as soon as he has a pen in his hand and puts a piece of manuscript paper in front of him, he often writes something inexplicably. Naturally, it is good, but it may not be possible.二
Two还是翻译《死魂灵》的事情。躲在书房里，是只有这类事情的。动笔之前，就先得解决一个问题：竭力使它归化，还是尽量保存洋气呢？日本文的译者上田进君，是主张用前一法的。他以为讽刺传品的翻译，第一当求其易懂，愈易懂，效力也愈广大。所以他的译文，有时就化一句为数句，很近于解释。我的意见却两样的。只求易懂，不如创作，或者改作，将事改为中国事，人也化为中国人。如果还是翻译，那么，首先的目的，就在博览外国的作品，不但移情，也要益智，至少是知道何地何时，有这等事，和旅行外国，是很相像的：它必须有异国情调，就是所谓洋气。其实世界上也不会有完全归化的译文，倘有，就是貌合神离，从严辨别起来，它算不得翻译。凡是翻译，必须兼顾着两面，一当然力求其易解，一则保存着原作的丰姿，但这保存，却又常常和易懂相矛盾：看不惯了。不过它原是洋鬼子，当然谁也看不惯，为比较的顺眼起见，只能改换他的衣裳，却不该削低他的鼻子，剜掉他的眼睛。我是不主张削鼻剜眼的，所以有些地方，仍然宁可译得不顺口。只是文句的组织，无须科学理论似的精密了，就随随便便，但副词的“地”字，却还是使用的，因为我觉得现在看惯了这字的读者已经很不少。
Or the translation of "Dead Souls". Hiding in the study is the only thing like this. Before I start writing, I have to solve a problem: do you try to naturalize it, or try to preserve the foreign style? The Japanese translator Ueda Shinjun advocated the use of the former method. He believes that the translation of satirical works should first be easy to understand, and the easier it is to understand, the greater the effect. Therefore, his translations sometimes turn one sentence into several sentences, which is very close to explanation. My opinions are different. Just want to be easy to understand, it is better to create, or change, change things to Chinese things, and people will become Chinese. If it is still translation, then the first purpose is to read foreign works, not only to empathize, but also to be intellectual, at least to know where and when, and such things are very similar to traveling to foreign countries: it must be exotic, which is the so-called foreign style. In fact, there will be no completely naturalized translation in the world, and if there is, it is a distinction between the two sides, and it cannot be regarded as a translation. All translations must take into account both sides, one is of course striving to be easy to understand, and the other is preserving the richness of the original, but this preservation often contradicts the ease of understanding: I am not used to it. But it was originally a foreign devil, of course, no one was used to it, for the sake of comparison, he could only change his clothes, but he shouldn't cut off his nose and gouge out his eyes. I don't advocate cutting the nose and gouging out the eyes, so in some places, I still prefer to translate it smoothly.
