名人和名言

名人和名言

名人和名言

Celebrities and quotes《太白》二卷七期上有一篇南山先生的《保守文言的第三道策》，他举出：第一道是说“要做白话由于文言做不通”，第二道是说“要白话做好，先须文言弄通”。十年之后，才来了太炎先生的第三道，“他以为你们说文言难，白话更难。理由是现在的口头语，有许多是古语，非深通小学就不知道现在口头语的某音，就是古代的某音，不知道就是古代的某字，就要写错。……”
In the second volume and seventh issue of "Taibai", there is an article by Mr. Nanshan "The Third Strategy of Conserving Classical Language", which he cited: The first is to say that "to do the vernacular because the classical Chinese does not work", and the second is to say that "to do the vernacular well, you must first understand the classical language". Ten years later, Mr. Taiyan's third course came, "He thought it was difficult for you to speak classical Chinese, and it was even more difficult for you to speak vernacular." The reason is that many of the current colloquial languages are ancient languages, and if you are not in Shentong Primary School, you will not know a certain sound of the current spoken language, which is a certain sound in ancient times, and you will not know that it is a certain word in ancient times, so you will write it wrong. ……”太炎先生的话是极不错的。现在的口头语，并非一朝一夕，从天而降的语言，里面当然有许多是古语，既有古语，当然会有许多曾见于古书，如果做白话的人，要每字都到《说文解字》里去找本字，那的确比做任用借字的文言要难到不知多少倍。然而自从提倡白话以来，主张者却没有一个以为写白话的主旨，是在从“小学”里寻出本字来的，我们就用约定俗成的借字。诚然，如太炎先生说：“乍见熟人而相寒暄曰‘好呀’，‘呀’即‘乎’字；应人之称曰‘是唉’，‘唉’即‘也’字。”但我们即使知道了这两字，也不用“好乎”或“是也”，还是用“好呀”或“是唉”。因为白话是写给现代的人们看，并非写给商周秦汉的鬼看的，起古人于地下，看了不懂，我们也毫不畏缩。所以太炎先生的第三道策，其实是文不对题的。这缘故，是因为先生把他所专长的小学，用得范围太广了。
Mr. Taiyan's words are very good. If a person who does vernacular language, he wants to go to the "Shuowen Jie Zi" to find the original word, it is indeed many times more difficult than to do the classical language of borrowed words. However, since the vernacular was advocated, none of the proponents thought that the main purpose of writing the vernacular was to find the original character from the "primary school", and we used the conventional borrowed word. It is true that Mr. Taiyan said: "At first glance, when you meet an acquaintance, you say 'okay', 'ah' is the word 'hu'; But even if we know these two words, we don't use "good" or "yes", or "good" or "yes". Because the vernacular is written for modern people, not for the ghosts of the Shang, Zhou, Qin and Han dynasties, the ancients were underground, and we did not flinch if we did not understand it. Therefore, Mr. Taiyan's third strategy is actually wrong. This is because the teacher uses the primary school he specializes in too widely.我们的知识很有限，谁都愿意听听名人的指点，但这时就来了一个问题：听博识家的话好，还是听专门家的话好呢？解答似乎很容易：都好。自然都好；但我由历听了两家的种种指点以后，却觉得必须有相当的警戒。因为是：博识家的话多浅，专门家的话多悖的。
Our knowledge is very limited, and everyone is willing to listen to the guidance of celebrities, but then the question arises: is it better to listen to the words of the learned or the experts? The answer seems easy: all are good. Naturally, it's all good; But after listening to all the guidance of the two families, I feel that I must be quite vigilant. Because it is: the words of erudite people are shallow, and the words of experts are contradictory.博识家的话多浅，意义自明，惟专门家的话多悖的事，还得加一点申说。他们的悖，未必悖在讲述他们的专门，是悖在倚专家之名，来论他所专门以外的事。社会上崇敬名人，于是以为名人的话就是名言，却忘记了他之所以得名是那一种学问或事业。名人被崇奉所诱惑，也忘记了自己之所以得名是那一种学问或事业，渐以为一切无不胜人，无所不谈，于是乎就悖起来了。其实，专门家除了他的专长之外，许多见识是往往不及博识家或常识者的。太炎先生是革命的先觉，小学的大师，倘谈文献，讲《说文》，当然娓娓可听，但一到攻击现在的白话，便牛头不对马嘴，即其一例。还有江亢虎博士，是先前以讲社会主义出名的名人，他的社会主义到底怎么样呢，我不知道。只是今年忘其所以，谈到小学，说“‘德’之古字为‘’，从‘’从‘心’，‘’即直觉之意”，却真不知道悖到那里去了，他竟连那上半并不是曲直的直字这一点都不明白。这种解释，却须听太炎先生了。
The words of the erudite are shallow, and the meaning is self-explanatory, but the words of the experts are contradictory, and they have to be explained a little. Their paradox is not necessarily about talking about their specialization, but about relying on the name of experts to discuss things other than what they specialize in. Society reveres celebrities, so they think that the words of celebrities are famous words, but they forget that the reason why they got their name is what kind of knowledge or career. Celebrities are tempted by worship, and they forget what kind of knowledge or career they are famous for, and gradually think that everything is invincible and talk about everything, so they go against it. In fact, in addition to his expertise, many of the insights of the specialist are often inferior to those of the erudite or common sense. Mr. Taiyan is the forerunner of the revolution, a master of primary school, if he talks about literature and "Shuowen", of course he is eloquent, but when it comes to attacking the current vernacular, he is not right at the horse's mouth, which is one of them. There is also Dr. Jiang Kanghu, who was famous for talking about socialism before, and I don't know what his socialism is. It's just that this year I forgot why, when it comes to elementary school, I say that "the ancient character for 'virtue' is '', from '' from 'heart', and '' is the meaning of intuition", but he really didn't know where it went, and he didn't even understand the straight word that was not right or wrong in the upper half. This kind of explanation must be heard by Mr. Taiyan.不过在社会上，大概总以为名人的话就是名言，既是名人，也就无所不通，无所不晓。所以译一本欧洲史，就请英国话说得漂亮的名人校阅，编一本经济学，又乞古文做得好的名人题签；学界的名人绍介医生，说他“术擅岐黄”，商界的名人称赞画家，说他“精研六法”。……
However, in society, it is probably always thought that the words of celebrities are famous sayings, and since they are celebrities, they are omniscient and omniscient. Therefore, when translating a European history, ask a celebrity who speaks English beautifully to review it, compile an economics book, and ask for the title of a celebrity who does a good job in ancient text; Dr. Shao Jie, a celebrity in the academic world, said that he was "good at Qihuang", and celebrities in the business world praised the painter, saying that he "studied the six methods intensively". ……这也是一种现在的通病。德国的细胞病理学家维尔晓（Virchow），是医学界的泰斗，举国皆知的名人，在医学史上的位置，是极为重要的，然而他不相信进化论，他那被教徒所利用的几回讲演，据赫克尔（Haeckel）说，很给了大众不少坏影响。因为他学问很深，名甚大，于是自视甚高，以为他所不解的，此后也无人能解，又不深研进化论，便一口归功于上帝了。现在中国屡经绍介的法国昆虫学大家法布耳（Fabre），也颇有这倾向。他的著作还有两种缺点：一是嗤笑解剖学家，二是用人类道德于昆虫界。但倘无解剖，就不能有他那样精到的观察，因为观察的基础，也还是解剖学；农学者根据对于人类的利害，分昆虫为益虫和害虫，是有理可说的，但凭了当时的人类的道德和法律，定昆虫为善虫或坏虫，却是多余了。有些严正的科学者，对于法布耳的有微词，实也并非无故。但倘若对这两点先加警戒，那么，他的大著作《昆虫记》十卷，读起来也还是一部很有趣，也很有益的书。
This is also a common problem now. The German cytopathologist Virchow, a master of medicine, a nationally known celebrity, has an extremely important position in the history of medicine, but he does not believe in evolution, and his several lectures that were used by believers, according to Haeckel, had a lot of negative influences on the public. Because he was very knowledgeable and famous, he thought that what he didn't understand would be understood by no one after that, and he didn't study the theory of evolution deeply, so he attributed it to God. Fabre, a French entomologist who has been repeatedly introduced in China, also has this tendency. His writings also have two shortcomings: one is to ridicule anatomists, and the other is to use human morality in the insect world. But if there is no anatomy, there can be no such precise observation as him, because the basis of observation is still anatomy; It is reasonable for agronomists to divide insects into beneficial insects and pests according to the interests of human beings, but it is superfluous to define insects as good or bad insects based on the morality and laws of human beings at that time. It is not without reason that some serious scientists have complaints about Fabre. But if we are wary of these two points first, then his great book "Insects" in ten volumes is still a very interesting and beneficial book to read.不过名人的流毒，在中国却较为利害，这还是科举的余波。那时候，儒生在私塾里揣摩高头讲章，和天下国家何涉，但一登第，真是“一举成名天下知”，他可以修史，可以衡文，可以临民，可以治河；到清朝之末，更可以办学校，开煤矿，练新军，造战舰，条陈新政，出洋考察了。成绩如何呢，不待我多说。
However, the poison of celebrities is more beneficial in China, which is still the aftermath of the imperial examination. At that time, Confucian scholars figured out the high-level lectures in private schools, and what did they have to do with the countries of the world, but as soon as they passed the exam, they were really "famous in one fell swoop", he could revise history, could balance literature, could govern the people, and could govern rivers; By the end of the Qing Dynasty, it was possible to run schools, open coal mines, train new armies, build warships, and go abroad for inspection. What are the results, I don't need to say more.这病根至今还没有除，一成名人，便有“满天飞”之概。我想，自此以后，我们是应该将“名人的话”和“名言”分开来的，名人的话并不都是名言；许多名言，倒出自田夫野老之口。这也就是说，我们应该分别名人之所以名，是由于那一门，而对于他的专门以外的纵谈，却加以警戒。苏州的学子是聪明的，他们请太炎先生讲国学，却不请他讲簿记学或步兵操典，——可惜人们却又不肯想得更细一点了。
The root of this disease has not been eliminated so far, and once it becomes a celebrity, there is a general idea of "flying all over the sky". I think that from now on, we should separate "famous words" and "famous sayings", and the words of famous people are not all famous sayings; Many famous sayings come from the mouths of farmers and old people. In other words, we should distinguish the reason why celebrities are famous because of which one, and be wary of their non-specialized discussions. The students in Suzhou are smart, they ask Mr. Taiyan to teach Chinese studies, but they don't ask him to teach bookkeeping or infantry drills,—— but unfortunately people refuse to think more carefully.我很自歉这回时时涉及了太炎先生。但“智者千虑，必有一失”，这大约也无伤于先生的“日月之明”的。至于我的所说，可是我想，“愚者千虑，必有一得”，盖亦“悬诸日月而不刊”之论也。
I apologize for involving Mr. Taiyan this time. But "a wise man thinks a thousand times, there must be a mistake", which probably does not hurt Mr. Zhao's "brightness of the sun and moon". As for what I said, I think that "a fool thinks a thousand times and must have a gain", which is also the argument of "hanging on the sun and moon without publishing".七月一日。
July 1st.

“靠天吃饭”

“靠天吃饭”

“靠天吃饭”

"Rely on the sky to eat"“靠天吃饭说”是我们中国的国宝。清朝中叶就有《靠天吃饭图》的碑，民国初年，状元陆润庠先生也画过一张：一个大“天”字，末一笔的尖端有一位老头子靠着，捧了碗在吃饭。这图曾经石印，信天派或嗜奇派，也许还有收藏的。
"Eating by the sky" is our national treasure in China. In the middle of the Qing Dynasty, there was a stele of "Eating by the Sky", and in the early years of the Republic of China, Mr. Lu Runxiang, the champion, also painted one: a big "sky" character, and at the tip of the last stroke, there was an old man leaning on it, holding a bowl and eating. This picture was once a stone seal, a Xintian school or a curiosity-loving school, and maybe a collection.而大家也确是实行着这学说，和图不同者，只是没有碗捧而已。这学说总算存在着一半。
And everyone does practice this doctrine, and the difference from the picture is that there is no bowl. This doctrine finally exists in half.前一月，我们曾经听到过嚷着“旱象已成”，现在是梅雨天，连雨了十几日，是每年必有的常事，又并无飓风暴雨，却又到处发现水灾了。植树节所种的几株树，也不足以挽回天意。“五日一风，十日一雨”的唐虞之世，去今已远，靠天而竟至于不能吃饭，大约为信天派所不及料的罢。到底还是做给俗人读的《幼学琼林》聪明，曰：“轻清者上浮而为天”，“轻清”而又“上浮”，怎么一个“靠”法。
A month ago, we heard shouting that "the drought has become", and now it is the rainy season, and it has rained for more than ten days, which is a common occurrence every year, and there are no hurricanes and rains, but floods are found everywhere. A few trees planted on Arbor Day are not enough to save God's will. The world of Tang and Yu of "one wind in five days, one rain in ten days" is far from the present, and it is impossible to eat by relying on the sky, which is probably unexpected by the Xintian faction. In the end, it is still smart to read "Young Learning Qionglin" for laypeople, saying: "The light and clear one rises to the sky", "light and clear" and "floats", how to "rely on" the method.古时候的真话，到现在就有些变成谎话。大约是西洋人说的罢，世界上穷人有份的，只有日光空气和水。这在现在的上海就不适用，卖心卖力的被一天关到夜，他就晒不着日光，吸不到好空气；装不起自来水的，也喝不到干净水。报上往往说：“近来天时不正，疾病盛行”，这岂只是“天时不正”之故，“天何言哉”，它默默地被冤枉了。
The truth of ancient times has now become a lie. It is probably what Westerners say, the only thing the poor in the world has is sunlight, air and water. This does not apply in Shanghai now, if he is locked up all day until night, he will not be able to bask in the sun and breathe good air; Those who cannot afford tap water cannot drink clean water. Newspapers often say: "Recently, the weather is not right, and diseases are prevalent", which is not just because of "the time is not right", "what does the sky say", it has been silently wronged.但是，“天”下去就要做不了“人”，沙漠中的居民为了一塘水，争夺起来比我们这里的才子争夺爱人还激烈，他们要拚命，决不肯做一首“阿呀诗”就了事。洋大人斯坦因博士，不是从甘肃敦煌的沙里掘去了许多古董么？那地方原是繁盛之区，靠天的结果，却被天风吹了沙埋没了。为制造将来的古董起见，靠天确也是一种好方法，但为活人计，却是不大值得的。
However, if the "sky" goes down, it will not be able to be a "person", and the inhabitants of the desert will compete more fiercely for a pond of water than the talents here will compete for their lovers, and they will work hard and refuse to make a "Ah Ya poem". Didn't the foreigner Dr. Stein dig up a lot of antiques from the sand in Dunhuang, Gansu Province? That place was originally a prosperous area, and the result of relying on the sky was buried by the wind blowing sand. For the sake of making future antiques, relying on heaven is also a good way, but for the sake of the living, it is not worth it.一到这里，就不免要说征服自然了，但现在谈不到，“带住”可也。
As soon as we get here, we can't help but say that we have conquered nature, but now we can't talk about it, and it is okay to "take it".七月一日。
July 1st.

几乎无事的悲剧

几乎无事的悲剧

几乎无事的悲剧

A tragedy that almost nothing happened果戈理（Nikolai Gogol）的名字，渐为中国读者所认识了，他的名著《死魂灵》的译本，也已经发表了第一部的一半。那译文虽然不能令人满意，但总算借此知道了从第二至六章，一共写了五个地主的典型，讽刺固多，实则除一个老太婆和吝啬鬼泼留希金外，都各有可爱之处。至于写到农奴，却没有一点可取了，连他们诚心来帮绅士的忙，也不但无益，反而有害。果戈理自己就是地主。
Nikolai Gogol's name has gradually become known to Chinese readers, and a translation of his famous book "Dead Souls" has been published half of the first part. Although the translation was not satisfactory, I finally learned that from chapters 2 to 6, a total of five typical landlords were written, and there was a lot of irony, but in fact, except for an old woman and a miser Polyushkin, they all had their own cuteness. As for writing about serfs, there is nothing to be desired, and even their sincere help to the gentlemen is not only useless, but harmful. Gogol himself was a landlord.然而当时的绅士们很不满意，一定的照例的反击，是说书中的典型，多是果戈理自己，而且他也并不知道大俄罗斯地主的情形。这是说得通的，作者是乌克兰人，而看他的家信，有时也简直和书中的地主的意见相类似。然而即使他并不知道大俄罗斯的地主的情形罢，那创作出来的脚色，可真是生动极了，直到现在，纵使时代不同，国度不同，也还使我们像是遇见了有些熟识的人物。讽刺的本领，在这里不及谈，单说那独特之处，尤其是在用平常事，平常话，深刻的显出当时地主的无聊生活。例如第四章里的罗士特来夫，是地方恶少式的地主，赶热闹，爱赌博，撒大谎，要恭维，——但挨打也不要紧。他在酒店里遇到乞乞科夫，夸示自己的好小狗，勒令乞乞科夫摸过狗耳朵之后，还要摸鼻子——
However, the gentlemen at that time were very dissatisfied, and a certain counterattack as usual was typical in the book, mostly Gogol himself, and he did not know the situation of the Great Russian landlords. This makes sense, the author is Ukrainian, and reading his letters from home sometimes is simply similar to the opinion of the landlord in the book. However, even if he did not know the situation of the landlords of Great Russia, the footwork he created was so vivid that until now, even though the times and countries are different, it still makes us feel as if we have met some familiar figures. The ability to satirize is not worth talking about here, just talking about its uniqueness, especially in the use of ordinary things and ordinary words, which profoundly shows the boring life of the landlord at that time. For example, in Chapter 4, Ross Straif is a local villainous landlord, who is busy with fun, loves to gamble, lies big, and wants to compliment,—— but it doesn't matter if he gets beaten. He met Chiqikov in the hotel, boasted about his good puppy, and ordered Chichikov to touch the dog's ears and then touch his nose——“乞乞科夫要和罗士特来夫表示好意，便摸了一下那狗的耳朵。‘是的，会成功一匹好狗的。’他加添着说。
"Chichikov wanted to show goodwill to Roshtlaev, so he touched the dog's ears. Yes, a good dog will succeed. He added.“‘再摸摸它那冰冷的鼻头，拿手来呀！’因为要不使他扫兴，乞乞科夫就又一碰那鼻子，于是说道：‘不是平常的鼻子！’”
"'Touch its cold nose again, get your hands!' Because he would not be disappointed, Chichikov touched the nose again, and said: 'Not an ordinary nose!' ’”这种莽撞而沾沾自喜的主人，和深通世故的客人的圆滑的应酬，是我们现在还随时可以遇见的，有些人简直以此为一世的交际术。“不是平常的鼻子”，是怎样的鼻子呢？说不明的，但听者只要这样也就足够了。后来又同到罗士特来夫的庄园去，历览他所有的田产和东西——
This kind of reckless and complacent host, and the smooth socializing of a well-versed guest, is something we can still meet at any time, and some people simply use it as a lifetime of communication. "Not an ordinary nose", what kind of nose is it? It is unclear, but it is enough for the listener to do so. Later, he went with him to Rothschild's manor, and saw all his lands and things—“还去看克理米亚的母狗，已经瞎了眼，据罗士特来夫说，是就要倒毙的。两年以前，却还是一条很好的母狗。大家也来察看这母狗，看起来，它也确乎瞎了眼。”
"I also went to see the of Crimea, who was already blind and, according to Rostlev, was about to die. Two years ago, she was still a good. Everyone also came to inspect the, and it seemed that it was indeed blind. ”这时罗士特来夫并没有说谎，他表扬着瞎了眼的母狗，看起来，也确是瞎了眼的母狗。这和大家有什么关系呢，然而世界上有一些人，却确是嚷闹，表扬，夸示着这一类事，又竭力证实着这一类事，算是忙人和诚实人，在过了他的整一世。
At this time, Rostlev did not lie, he praised the blind, and it looked like a blind. What does this have to do with everyone, but there are some people in the world who do make noise, praise, boast about this kind of thing, and try their best to confirm this kind of thing, and they are busy and honest people, and they have lived their whole lives.这些极平常的，或者简直近于没有事情的悲剧，正如无声的言语一样，非由诗人画出它的形象来，是很不容易觉察的。然而人们灭亡于英雄的特别的悲剧者少，消磨于极平常的，或者简直近于没有事情的悲剧者却多。
These extremely ordinary, or almost nothing, tragedies, like silent words, are not easy to perceive unless the poet paints its image. However, there are few special tragedians who die in heroes, and there are many tragedians who spend their time in the very ordinary, or almost nothing.听说果戈理的那些所谓“含泪的微笑”，在他本土，现在是已经无用了，来替代它的有了健康的笑。但在别地方，也依然有用，因为其中还藏着许多活人的影子。况且健康的笑，在被笑的一方面是悲哀的，所以果戈理的“含泪的微笑”，倘传到了和作者地位不同的读者的脸上，也就成为健康：这是《死魂灵》的伟大处，也正是作者的悲哀处。
I heard that Gogol's so-called "tearful smile" is now useless in his homeland, and there is a healthy smile to replace it. But in other places, it is still useful, because there are many shadows of living people hidden in it. Moreover, a healthy smile is sad on the side of being laughed at, so Gogol's "tearful smile" becomes healthy if it reaches the faces of readers with different status from the author: this is the greatness of "Dead Souls", and it is also the sadness of the author.七月十四日。
July 14th.

三论“文人相轻”

三论“文人相轻”

三论“文人相轻”

Three Discussions on "Literacy and Contempt"《芒种》第八期上有一篇魏金枝先生的《分明的是非和热烈的好恶》，是为以前的《文学论坛》上的《再论“文人相轻”》而发的。他先给了原则上的几乎全体的赞成，说，“人应有分明的是非，和热烈的好恶，这是不错的，文人应更有分明的是非，和更热烈的好恶，这也是不错的。”中间虽说“凡人在落难时节……能与猿鹤为伍，自然最好，否则与鹿豕为伍，也是好的。即到千万没有办法的时候，至于躺在破庙角里，而与麻疯病菌为伍，倘然我的体力，尚能为自然的抗御，因而不至毁灭以死，也比被实际上也做着骗子屠夫的所诱杀脔割，较为心愿。”看起来好像有些微辞，但其实说的是他的憎恶骗子屠夫，远在猿鹤以至麻疯病菌之上，和《论坛》上所说的“从圣贤一直敬到骗子屠夫，从美人香草一直爱到麻疯病菌的文人，在这世界上是找不到的”的话，也并不两样。至于说：“平心而论，彼一是非，此一是非，原非确论。”则在近来的庄子道友中，简直是鹤立鸡群似的卓见了。
In the eighth issue of "Awn Zhong", there is an article by Mr. Wei Jinzhi "Distinguishing Right and Wrong and Warm Likes and Dislikes", which was published for the previous "Literary Forum" "On "Literati Look Down on Each Other". He first gave almost all the approval in principle, saying, "It is good that people should have clear right and wrong, and warm likes and dislikes, and literati should have more clear right and wrong, and more enthusiastic likes and dislikes, which is also good." Although it is said in the middle that "mortals are in trouble...... It is naturally best to be in the company of monkeys and cranes, otherwise it is also good to be with deer and pigs. That is, when there is no way, as for lying in the corner of the ruined temple and being with leprosy germs, if my physical strength can still resist nature, so I will not be destroyed to death, and it is more wishful than being lured and mutilated by a liar butcher who is actually a liar. It seems to be a bit of a hint, but in fact, it is said that he hates liar butchers, far above apes and cranes and leprosy germs, and is no different from what was said in the "Forum" that "from sages to liar butchers, from beauty vanilla to literati who love leprosy germs, cannot be found in this world". As for saying: "To be fair, one is right and wrong, and this is right and wrong, and the original is not a conclusive theory." Among the recent Zhuangzi Taoist friends, he is simply as outstanding as a flock of chickens.然而魏先生的大论的主旨，并不专在这一些，他要申明的是：是非难定，于是爱憎就为难。因为“譬如有一种人，……在他自己的心目之中，已先无是非之分。……于是其所谓‘是’，不免似是而实非了。”但“至于非中之是，它的是处，正胜过于似是之非，因为其犹讲交友之道，而无门阀之分”的。到这地步，我们的文人就只好吞吞吐吐，假揩眼泪了。“似是之非”其实就是“非”，倘使已经看穿，不是只要给以热烈的憎恶就成了吗？然而“天下的事情，并没有这么简单”，又不得不爱护“非中之是”，何况还有“似非而是”和“是中之非”，取其大，略其细的方法，于是就不适用了。天下何尝有黑暗，据物理学说，地球上的无论如何的黑暗中，不是总有X分之一的光的吗？看起书来，据理就该看见X分之一的字的，——我们不能论明暗。
However, the main idea of Mr. Wei's grand theory is not limited to these, what he wants to affirm is: right and wrong are difficult to determine, so love and hate are difficult. Because "there is a kind of person,...... In his own mind, there is no distinction between right and wrong. …… So what he said 'is' is inevitably plausible but not true. But "as for what is wrong, its merits are better than plausible, because it still talks about the way of making friends, and there is no distinction between gates." At this point, our literati had no choice but to hesitate and wipe away their tears. "Plausible" is actually "nonsense", if you have seen through it, isn't it just a matter of giving warm hatred? However, "things in the world are not so simple", and we have to take care of "what is wrong", not to mention that there are "plausible and wrong" and "right and wrong". According to physics, in any darkness on Earth, isn't there always one X tenth of light? Looking at the book, we should see X-tenth of the word,—— we can't talk about light and dark.这并非刻薄的比喻，魏先生却正走到“无是非”的结论的。他终于说：“总之，文人相轻，不外乎文的长短，道的是非，文既无长短可言，道又无是非之分，则空谈是非，何补于事！已而已而，手无寸铁的人呵！”人无全德，道无大成，刚说过“非中之是”，胜过“似是之非”，怎么立刻又变成“文既无长短可言，道又无是非之分”了呢？文人的铁，就是文章，魏先生正在大做散文，力施搏击，怎么同时又说是“手无寸铁”了呢？这可见要抬举“非中之是”，却又不肯明说，事实上是怎样的难，所以即使在那大文上列举了许多对手的“排挤”，“大言”，“卖友”的恶谥，而且那大文正可通行无阻，却还是觉得“手无寸铁”，归根结蒂，掉进“无是非”说的深坑里，和自己以为“原非确论”的“彼亦一是非，此亦一是非”说成了“朋友”——这里不说“门阀”——了。
This is not a mean metaphor, but Mr. Wei is coming to the conclusion of "no right or wrong". He finally said: "In short, the literati look down on each other, nothing more than the length of the text, the right and wrong of the text, the text has no length to speak of, and the Tao has no distinction between right and wrong, so it is empty talk about right and wrong, what good is it!" And that's it, unarmed people! "People have no perfect virtue, and the Tao has no great achievement, and it has just been said that "what is wrong is not in the middle", which is better than "plausible wrong", how can it immediately become "there is no length or shortness in the text, and there is no distinction between right and wrong"? The iron of the literati is the article, Mr. Wei is doing a lot of prose and fighting, why is it said that he is "defenseless" at the same time? This shows that it is necessary to promote the "right and wrong", but refuse to say clearly, in fact, how difficult it is, so even if the big article lists many opponents' "exclusion", "big words", and "selling friends", and that big article is unimpeded, but still feels "defenseless", in the final analysis, falling into the pit of "no right and wrong", and thinking that "the other is also right and wrong, this is also right and wrong" that I think is "original and inconclusive" has become a "friend" - not "gate valve" here.况且，“文既无长短可言，道又无是非之分”，魏先生的文章，就他自己的结论而言，就先没有动笔的必要。不过要说结果，这无须动笔的动笔，却还是有战斗的功效的，中国的有些文人一向谦虚，所以有时简直会自己先躺在地上，说道，“倘然要讲是非，也该去怪追奔逐北的好汉，我等小民，不任其咎。”明明是加入论战中的了，却又立刻肩出一面“小民”旗来，推得干干净净，连肋骨在那里也找不到了。论“文人相轻”竟会到这地步，这真是叫作到了末路！
Moreover, "there is no distinction between right and wrong in the text, and there is no distinction between right and wrong", Mr. Wei's article, as far as his own conclusion is concerned, there is no need to start writing. However, to talk about the result, this does not need to be penned, but it still has the effect of fighting, some literati in China have always been humble, so sometimes they will lie on the ground first and say, "If you want to talk about right and wrong, you should also blame the heroes who chase the north, and I will not let the people blame." Obviously, he joined the debate, but he immediately took out a "small people" flag on his shoulder and pushed it cleanly, and even the ribs could not be found there. On the "literati look down on each other" will come to this point, this is really called the end!七月十五日。

三论“文人相轻”

【备考】：分明的是非和热烈的好恶

三论“文人相轻”

[Preparation]: Distinguishing right from wrong and enthusiastic likes and dislikes魏金枝
Wei Jinzhi人应有分明的是非，和热烈的好恶，这是不错的。文人应更有分明的是非，和更热烈的好恶，这也是不错的。但天下的事情，并没有这么简单，除了是非之外，还有“似是而非”的“是”，和“非中有是”之非，在这当口，我们的好恶，便有些为难了。
People should have clear right and wrong, and enthusiastic likes and dislikes, which is good. It is also good that literati should have a clearer sense of right and wrong, and more enthusiastic likes and dislikes. But things in the world are not so simple, in addition to right and wrong, there are also "plausible" "yes", and "right in non", at this moment, our likes and dislikes are a little embarrassing.譬如有一种人，他们借着一个好看的幌子，做其为所欲为的勾当，不论是非，无分好恶，一概置之在所排挤之列，这叫做玉石俱焚，在他自己的心目之中，已先无是非之分。但他还要大言不惭，自以为是。于是其所谓“是”，不免似是而实非了。这是我们在谈话是非之前，所应最先将它分辩明白的。次则以趣观之，往往有些具着两张面孔的人，对于腰骨硬朗的，他会伏在地下，打拱作揖，对于下一点的，也会装起高不可扳的怪腔，甚至给你当头一脚，拒之千里之外。其时是非，便会煞时分手，各归其主，因之好恶不同，也是常事。在此时际，要谈是非，就得易地而处，平心而论，彼一是非，此一是非，原非确论。
For example, there is a kind of person who does whatever he wants under the guise of being good-looking, regardless of right or wrong, regardless of likes and dislikes, and puts them all in the exclusion list. But he also has to be brazen and self-righteous. So what he said "yes" inevitably seems plausible but not true. This is the first thing we should distinguish between right and wrong before talking about it. Secondly, for the fun, there are often some people with two faces, for those with a tough back, he will lie on the ground, bow and bow, and for the next point, he will also pretend to be an unstoppable strange tone, and even give you a kick in the head, rejecting thousands of miles away. At that time, right and wrong, they will break up at the end of the day, and each will return to their own masters, and it is also common for them to have different likes and dislikes. At this time, if you want to talk about right and wrong, you have to change your place, and in fairness, one is right and wrong, and this is right and wrong, and the original is not a definitive conclusion.至于非中之是，它的是处，正胜过于似是之非，因为其犹讲交友之道，而无门阀之分。凡人在落难时节，没有朋友，没有六亲，更无是非天道可言，能与猿鹤为伍，自然最好，否则与鹿豕为伍，也是好的。即到千万没有办法的时候，至于躺在破庙角里，而与麻疯病菌为伍，倘然我的体力，尚能为自然的抗御，因而不至毁灭以死，也比被实际上也做着骗子屠夫的所诱杀脔割，较为心愿。所以，倘然要讲是非，也该去怪追奔逐北的好汉，我等小民，不任其咎。但近来那般似是的人，还在那里大登告白，说是“少卿教匈奴为兵”，那个意思，更为凶恶，为他营业，卖他朋友，甚而至于陷井下石，望人万劫不复，那层似是的甜衣，不是糖拌砒霜，是什么呢？
As for the right of the wrong, its right is better than the plausible, because it still talks about the way of making friends, but there is no distinction between the family. Mortals have no friends, no relatives, and no right or wrong in the season of disaster, and it is naturally best to be with monkeys and cranes, otherwise it is also good to be with deer and pigs. That is, when there is no way, as for lying in the corner of the ruined temple and being with leprosy germs, if my physical strength can still resist nature, so I will not be destroyed to death, and it is more wishful than being lured and mutilated by a liar butcher who is actually a liar. Therefore, if you want to talk about right and wrong, you should also blame the heroes who chase the north, and we and the common people will not be to blame. But recently, such a plausible person is still there, and Dadeng confessed there, saying that "Shaoqing taught the Xiongnu to be a soldier", that meaning, even more vicious, doing business for him, selling his friends, and even getting into a well, hoping that people will never return, that layer of plausible sweets, not sugar mixed with arsenic, what is it?总之，文人相轻，不外乎文的长短，道的是非，文既无长短可言，道又无是非之分，则空谈是非，何补于事！已而已而，手无寸铁的人呵！
总之，文人相轻，不外乎文的长短，道的是非，文既无长短可言，道又无是非之分，则空谈是非，何补于事！已而已而，手无寸铁的人呵！七月一日，《芒种》第八期。七月一日，《芒种》第八期。

"It must also be a correct name", of course a good name is also very good. It's a pity that good name may not necessarily contain virtue. "Turning your hands over the clouds and covering the rain, why do you need to count the frivolity, you don't see Guan Bao being poor when he was poor, and this way is abandoned like dirt today!" "Alas!如果在冷路上走走，有时会遇见几个人蹲在地上赌钱，庄家只是输，押的只是赢，然而他们其实是庄家的一伙，就是所谓“屏风”——也就是他们自己之所谓“朋友”——目的是在引得蠢才眼热，也来出手，然后掏空他的腰包。如果你站下来，他们又觉得你并非蠢才，只因为好奇，未必来上当，就会说：“朋友，管自己走，没有什么好看。”这是一种朋友，不妨害骗局的朋友。荒场上又有变戏法的，石块变白鸽，坛子装小孩，本领大抵不很高强，明眼人本极容易看破，于是他们就时时拱手大叫道：“在家靠父母，出家靠朋友！”这并非在要求撒钱，是请托你不要说破。这又是一种朋友，是不戳穿戏法的朋友。把这些识时务的朋友稳住了，他才可以掏呆朋友的腰包；或者手执花枪，来赶走不知趣的走近去窥探底细的傻子，恶狠狠的啐一口道：“……瞎你的眼睛！”

五论“文人相轻”——明术

五论“文人相轻”——明术

五论“文人相轻”——明术

五论“文人相轻”——明术“文人相轻”是局外人或假充局外人的话。如果自己是这局面中人之一，那就是非被轻则是轻人，他决不用这对等的“相”字。但到无可奈何的时候，却也可以拿这四个字来遮掩一下。这遮掩是逃路，然而也仍然是战术，所以这口诀还被有一些人所宝爱。
"Literati look down on each other" is the word of an outsider or pretending to be an outsider. If he is one of the people in this situation, he is either underestimated or underestimated, and he will never use the word "phase" of equality. But when there is no choice, you can also use these four words to cover it up. This concealment is a way out, but it is still a tactic, so this mantra is still cherished by some people.不过这是后来的话。在先，当然是“轻”。
But this is a later word. First, of course, it is "light".“轻”之术很不少。粗糙的说：大略有三种。一种是自卑，自己先躺在垃圾里，然后来拖敌人，就是“我是畜生，但是我叫你爹爹，你既是畜生的爹爹，可见你也是畜生了”的法子。这形容自然未免过火一点，然而较文雅的现象，文坛上却并不怎么少见的。埋伏之法，是甲乙两人的作品，思想和技术，分明不同，甚而至于相反的，某乙却偏要设法表明，说惟独自己的作品乃是某甲的嫡派；补救之法，是某乙的缺点倘被某甲所指摘，他就说这些事情正是某甲所具备，而且自己也正从某甲那里学了来的。此外，已经把别人评得一钱不值了，临末却又很谦虚的声明自己并非批评家，凡有所说，也许全等于放屁之类，也属于这一派。
There are many "light" techniques. Roughly speaking: there are roughly three types. One is low self-esteem, lying in the garbage first, and then dragging the enemy, that is, "I am a beast, but I call you Daddy, you are the father of the beast, it can be seen that you are also a beast". This description is naturally a bit excessive, but the phenomenon of more elegance is not very common in the literary world. The method of ambush is the work of A and B, and their ideas and techniques are clearly different, and even on the contrary, a certain B tries to show that only his own work is the direct faction of a certain A; The remedy is that if a certain B's shortcomings are pointed out by a certain A, he will say that these things are exactly what a certain A has, and he is learning from a certain A. In addition, he has already rated others as worthless, and at the end of his life, he humbly declares that he is not a critic.一种是最正式的，就是自高，一面把不利于自己的批评，统统谓之“漫骂”，一面又竭力宣扬自己的好处，准备跨过别人。但这方法比较的麻烦，因为除“辟谣”之外，自吹自擂是究竟不很雅观的，所以做这些文章时，自己得另用一个笔名，或者邀一些“讲交道”的“朋友”来互助。不过弄得不好，那些“朋友”就会变成保驾的打手或抬驾的轿夫，而使那“朋友”会变成这一类人物的，则这御驾一定不过是有些手势的花花公子，抬来抬去，终于脱不了原形，一年半载之后，花花之上也再添不上什么花头去，而且打手轿夫，要而言之，也究竟要工食，倘非腰包饱满，是没法维持的。如果能用死轿夫，如袁中郎或“晚明二十家”之流来抬，再请一位活名人喝道，自然较为轻而易举，但看过去的成绩和效验，可也并不见佳。
One is the most formal, that is, self-exaltation, on the one hand, all criticism that is not conducive to oneself is called "scolding", and on the other hand, it tries its best to promote its own benefits, ready to step over others. But this method is more troublesome, because in addition to "refuting rumors", it is not very elegant to brag about yourself, so when doing these articles, you have to use another pseudonym, or invite some "friends" who "talk to" to help each other. However, if it is not done well, those "friends" will become thugs or bearers who carry the car, and if the "friends" become this kind of character, then the imperial driver must be just a dandy with some gestures, carrying around, and finally unable to get rid of the original form, after a year and a half, there will be no flowers on top of the flowers, and the thugs, in short, also need to work and food, if the pocket is not full, it cannot be maintained. If you can use a dead sedan chair, such as Yuan Zhonglang or the "Twenty Families of the Late Ming Dynasty", and then invite a living celebrity to shout, it is naturally relatively easy, but looking at the past achievements and effectiveness, it is not good.还有一种是自己连名字也并不抛头露面，只用匿名或由“朋友”给敌人以“批评”——要时髦些，就可以说是“批判”。尤其要紧的是给与一个名称，像一般的“诨名”一样。因为读者大众的对于某一作者，是未必和“批评”或“批判”者同仇敌慨的，一篇文章，纵使题目用头号字印成，他们也不大起劲，现在制出一个简括的诨名，就可以比较的不容易忘记了。在近十年来的中国文坛上，这法术，用是也常用的，但效果却很小。
The other is that he does not even show his name, but only uses anonymity or "friends" to give "criticism" to the enemy - if it is more fashionable, it can be said to be "criticism". It is especially important to give a name, like a general "nickname". Because the readers may not have the same hatred for a certain author as the "critic" or "critic", an article, even if the title is printed with the number one word, they are not very motivated, and now a concise nickname can be compared and not easy to forget. In the Chinese literary world in the past ten years, this spell has been commonly used, but the effect is very small.法术原是极利害，极致命的法术。果戈理夸俄国人之善于给别人起名号——或者也是自夸——说是名号一出，就是你跑到天涯海角，它也要跟着你走，怎么摆也摆不脱。这正如传神的写意画，并不细画须眉，并不写上名字，不过寥寥几笔，而神情毕肖，只要见过被画者的人，一看就知道这是谁；夸张了这人的特长——不论优点或弱点，却更知道这是谁。可惜我们中国人并不怎样擅长这本领。起源，是古的。从汉末到六朝之所谓“品题”，如“关东觥觥郭子横”，“五经纷纶井大春”，就是这法术，但说的是优点居多。梁山泊上一百另八条好汉都有诨名，也是这一类，不过着眼多在形体，如“花和尚鲁智深”和“青面兽杨志”，或者才能，如“浪里白跳张顺”和“鼓上蚤时迁”等，并不能提挈这人的全般。直到后来的讼师，写状之际，还常常给被告加上一个诨名，以见他原是流氓地痞一类，然而不久也就拆穿西洋镜，即使毫无才能的师爷，也知道这是不足注意的了。现在的所谓文人，除了改用几个新名词之外，也并无进步，所以那些“批判”，结果还大抵是徒劳。
Spells are originally extremely beneficial and deadly spells. Gogol praised Russians for being good at naming others - or boasting - saying that as soon as the name comes out, even if you run to the ends of the earth, it will follow you, no matter how you put it off. This is like a freehand painting that conveys the spirit, not finely drawing the beard and eyebrows, not writing the name, but only a few strokes, and the expression is Bixiao, as long as the person who has seen the painted person, he will know who this is at a glance; Exaggerate this person's strengths - regardless of strengths or weaknesses, but know who this person is. Unfortunately, we Chinese are not very good at this skill. The origin is ancient. From the end of the Han Dynasty to the Six Dynasties, the so-called "Pin Tie", such as "Guo Ziheng of the Five Classics", "Five Classics of the Five Classics", is this spell, but it is mostly about the advantages. There are 100 other heroes on Liangshanbo who have nicknames, which are also in this category, but the focus is mostly on the form, such as "Flower Monk Lu Zhishen" and "Blue-faced Beast Yang Zhi", or talents, such as "White Jumping Zhang Shun in the Waves" and "Drum on the Flea Migration", etc., which cannot lift this person in general. Until later litigators, when writing the petition, they often added a nickname to the defendant to see that he was originally a rogue ruffian, but soon the diorama was dismantled, and even the talentless master knew that this was not worth paying attention to. The current so-called literati have not made progress except for using a few new terms, so those "criticisms" are probably in vain.这失败之处，是在不切帖。批评一个人，得到结论，加以简括的名称，虽只寥寥数字，却很要明确的判断力和表现的才能的。必须切帖，这才和被批判者不相离，这才会跟了他跑到天涯海角。现在却大抵只是漫然的抓了一时之所谓恶名，摔了过去：或“封建余孽”，或“布尔乔亚”，或“破锣”，或“无政府主义者”，或“利己主义者”……等等；而且怕一个不够致命，又连用些什么“无政府主义封建余孽”或“布尔乔亚破锣利己主义者”；怕一人说没有力，约朋友各给他一个；怕说一回还太少，一年内连给他几个：时时改换，个个不同。这举棋不定，就因为观察不精，因而品题也不确，所以即使用尽死劲，流完大汗，写了出去，也还是和对方不相干，就是用浆糊粘在他身上，不久也就脱落了。汽车夫发怒，便骂洋车夫阿四一声“猪猡”，顽皮孩子高兴，也会在卖炒白果阿五的背上画一个乌龟，虽然也许博得市侩们的一笑，但他们是决不因此就得“猪猡阿四”或“乌龟阿五”的诨名的。此理易明：因为不切帖。
This failure is not relevant. Criticizing a person, getting a conclusion, and giving a concise name, although there are only a few numbers, it is very necessary to have clear judgment and performance talent. must be cut, so that he is inseparable from the critic, and he will follow him to the ends of the earth. But now it is probably just a casual grasp of the so-called notoriety of a moment and thrown over: or "feudal remnants", or "bourgeois", or "broken gong", or "anarchist", or "egoist"...... Wait a minute; and they are afraid that if they are not deadly enough, they will use some "anarchist feudal remnants" or "bourgeois egoists"; Afraid that one person will say that he has no strength, ask his friends to give him one; I'm afraid that one time is too little, and I will give him a few in a year: change from time to time, each different. This move is indecisive, just because the observation is not fine, so the question is not accurate, so even if you use it hard, sweat profusely, and write it out, it still has nothing to do with the other party, that is, it sticks to him with paste, and it will fall off soon. The motorist was angry, so he scolded the foreign coachman Ah Si for "pig monkey", and the naughty child was happy, and he would also draw a turtle on the back of the fried white Goa Wu, although he might win the laughter of the philistines, but they would never get the nickname "Pig Ah Si" or "Turtle Ah Wu" because of this. This principle is easy to understand: because it is not relevant.五四时代的所谓“桐城谬种”和“选学妖孽”，是指做“载飞载鸣”的文章和抱住《文选》寻字汇的人们的，而某一种人确也是这一流，形容惬当，所以这名目的流传也较为永久。除此之外，恐怕也没有什么还留在大家的记忆里了。到现在，和这八个字可以匹敌的，或者只好推“洋场恶少”和“革命小贩”了罢。前一联出于古之“京”，后一联出于今之“海”。
The so-called "Tongcheng Fallacy" and "Selection of Demons" in the May Fourth era refer to people who make articles that "fly and sing" and hold the "Anthology" to find vocabulary, and a certain kind of person is indeed of this class, and the description is comfortable, so the circulation of this name is also relatively permanent. Other than that, I'm afraid nothing remains in everyone's memory. Up to now, it is comparable to these eight words, or we have to push "foreign villains" and "revolutionary hawkers". The first couplet comes from the ancient "capital", and the last couplet comes from the present-day "sea".创作难，就是给人起一个称号或诨名也不易。假使有谁能起颠扑不破的诨名的罢，那么，他如作评论，一定也是严肃正确的批评家，倘弄创作，一定也是深刻博大的作者。
It is difficult to create, even if it is not easy to give people a title or nickname. If anyone can make an unbreakable reputation, then if he makes a comment, he must also be a serious and correct critic, and if he creates, he must also be a profound and broad author.所以，连称号或诨名起得不得法，也还是因为这班“朋友”的不“文”。——“再亮些！”

"Title undecided" draft五
FiveM君寄给我一封剪下来的报章。这是近十来年常有的事情，有时是杂志。闲暇时翻检一下，其中大概有一点和我相关的文章，甚至于还有“生脑膜炎”之类的恶消息。这时候，我就得预备大约一块多钱的邮票，来寄信回答陆续函问的人们。至于寄报的人呢，大约有两类：一是朋友，意思不过说，这刊物上的东西，有些和你相关；二，可就难说了，猜想起来，也许正是作者或编者，“你看，咱们在骂你了！”用的是《三国志演义》上的“三气周瑜”或“骂死王朗”的法子。不过后一种近来少一些了，因为我的战术是暂时搁起，并不给以反应，使他们诸公的刊物很少有因我而蓬蓬勃勃之望，到后来却也许会去拨一拨谁的下巴：这于他们诸公是很不利的。
Mr. M sent me a cut newspaper. This is a common thing in the past ten years, sometimes in magazines. I checked it in my spare time, and there were probably some articles related to me, and there was even bad news such as "meningitis". At this time, I had to prepare about a dollar-plus stamp to send letters to answer the questions I had received. As for the people who send newspapers, there are about two categories: one is friends, which means that some of the things in this publication are related to you; Second, it's hard to say, if you guess, maybe it's the author or editor, "Look, we're scolding you!" It uses the method of "Three Qi Zhou Yu" or "Scolding Wang Lang to Death" in "Romance of the Three Kingdoms". However, the latter has been less common lately, because my tactic is to put it aside for the time being and not to respond, so that their publications rarely hope to flourish because of me, but later they may pluck someone's chin: this is very unfavorable to them.M君是属于第一类的；剪报是天津《益世报》的《文学副刊》。其中有一篇张露薇先生做的《略论中国文坛》，下有一行小注道：“偷懒，奴性，而忘掉了艺术”。只要看这题目，就知道作者是一位勇敢而记住艺术的批评家了。看起文章来，真的，痛快得很。我以为介绍别人的作品，删节实在是极可惜的，倘有妙文，大家都应该设法流传，万不可听其泯灭。不过纸墨也须顾及，所以只摘录了第二段，就是“永远是日本人的追随者的作家”在这里，也万不能再少，因为我实在舍不得了——
Mr. M belongs to the first category; The newspaper clipping is the "Literary Supplement" of Tianjin "Yishi Daily". Among them, there is an article by Mr. Zhang Luwei "A Brief Discussion on the Chinese Literary World", with a small note below: "Lazy, servile, and forgetting art". Just look at this topic and know that the author is a brave critic who remembers art. Looking at the article, really, it was very happy. I think it is a pity to introduce other people's works, and if there is a wonderful article, everyone should try to circulate it, and it must not be extinguished. However, paper and ink must also be taken into account, so only the second paragraph is excerpted, that is, "a writer who will always be a follower of the Japanese" here, and it must not be less, because I am really reluctant to do so——“奴隶性是最‘意识正确’的东西，于是便有许多人跟着别人学口号。特别是对于苏联，在目前的中国，一般所谓作家也者，都怀着好感。可是，我们是人，我们应该有自己的人性，对于苏联的文学，尤其是对于那些由日本的浅薄的知识贩卖者所得来的一知半解的苏联的文学理论家与批评家的话，我们所取的态度决不该是应声虫式的；我们所需要的介绍的和模仿的（其实是只有抄袭和盲目的应声）方式也决不该是完全出于热情的。主观是对于事物的选择，客观才是对于事物的方法。我们有了一般奴隶性极深的作家，于是我们便有无数的空虚的标语和口号。
"Slavery is the most 'conscious' thing, so many people follow others to learn slogans. Especially for the Soviet Union, in the current China, the so-called writers generally have a good impression. However, we are human beings, we should have our own humanity, and our attitude towards Soviet literature, especially to those Soviet literary theorists and critics who were half-informed by the shallow intellectual peddlers of Japan, should never be a response to the insects; The way we introduce and imitate (in fact, only plagiarism and blind response) should never be entirely out of enthusiasm. Subjectivity is the choice of things, and objectivity is the method of things. We have writers who are generally very slave, so we have countless empty slogans and slogans.“然而我们没有几个懂得苏联的文学的人，只有一堆盲目的赞美者和零碎的翻译者，而赞美者往往是牛头不对马嘴的胡说，翻译者又不配合于他们的工作，不得不草率，不得不‘硬译’，不得不说文不对题的话，一言以蔽之，他们的能力永远是对不起他们的思想；他们的‘意识’虽然正确了，可是他们的工作却永远是不正确的。
"However, we do not have a few people who understand Soviet literature, only a bunch of blind praisers and fragmentary translators, and the praisers are often bull-headed nonsense, and the translators do not cooperate with their work, and have to be hasty, have to 'hard translate', and have to say that the text is not on the right topic. Although their 'consciousness' is correct, their work is always incorrect.“从苏联到中国是很近的，可是为什么就非经过日本人的手不可？我们在日本人的群中并没有发现几个真正了解苏联文学的新精神的人，为什么偏从浅薄的日本知识阶级中去寻我们的食粮？这真是一件可耻的事实。我们为什么不直接的了解？为什么不取一种纯粹客观的工作的态度？为什么人家唱‘新写实主义’，我们跟着喊，人家换了‘社会主义的写实主义’，我们又跟着喊；人家介绍纪德，我们才叫；人家介绍巴尔扎克，我们也号；然而我敢预言，在一千年以内：绝不会见到那些介绍纪德，巴尔扎克的人们会给中国的读者译出一两本纪德，巴尔扎克的重要著作来，全集更不必说。
"It is very close from the Soviet Union to China, but why does it have to pass through the hands of the Japanese? We did not find a few people in the Japanese group who really understood the new spirit of Soviet literature, so why did they look for our food from the shallow Japanese intelligentsia? This is a shameful fact. Why don't we know directly? Why not adopt a purely objective attitude towards work? Why do we shout 'neo-realism', and when they change to 'socialist realism', we shout again; when they introduce Gide, we call it; when they introduce Gide, we call it; but I dare to predict that within a thousand years, we will never see those who introduce Gide, and Balzac will translate one or two copies of Gide, Balzac's important works, not to mention the complete works.“我们再退一步，对于那些所谓‘文学遗产’，我们并不要求那些跟着人家对喊‘文学遗产’的人们担负把那些‘文学遗产’送给中国的‘大众’的责任。可是我们却要求那些人们有承受那些‘遗产’的义务，这自然又是谈不起来的。我们还记得在庆祝高尔基的四十年的创作生活的时候，中国也有鲁迅，丁玲一般人发了庆祝的电文；这自然是冠冕堂皇的事情。然而那一群签名者中有几个读过高尔基的十分之一的作品？有几个是知道高尔基的伟大在那儿的？……中国的知识阶级就是如此浅薄，做应声虫有余，做一个忠实的，不苟且的，有理性的文学创作者和研究者便不成了。”
"Let's take a step back, for those so-called 'literary heritage', we do not require those who follow others to shout 'literary heritage' to take responsibility for giving those 'literary heritage' to the 'public' in China. But we demand that those people have the obligation to bear those 'inheritances', which is naturally not to be discussed. We still remember that when celebrating Gorky's forty years of creative life, there were also Lu Xun and Ding Ling in China who sent congratulatory messages; This is naturally a high-sounding thing. However, how many of the signatories had read a tenth of Gorky's works? How many of them know that Gorky's greatness is there? …… China's intellectual class is so shallow that it is more than enough to be a respondent, and it is impossible to be a faithful, unscrupulous, and rational literary creator and researcher. ”五月廿九日天津《益世报》。
May 29 Tianjin "Yishi Daily".我并不想因此来研究“奴隶性是最‘意识正确’的东西”，“主观是对于事物的选择，客观才是对于事物的方法”这些难问题；我只要说，诚如张露薇先生所言，就是在文艺上，我们中国也的确太落后。法国有纪德和巴尔扎克，苏联有高尔基，我们没有；日本叫喊起来了，我们才跟着叫喊，这也许真是“追随”而且“永远”，也就是“奴隶性”，而且是“最‘意识正确’的东西”。但是，并不“追随”的叫喊其实是也有一些的，林语堂先生说过：“……其在文学，今日绍介波兰诗人，明日绍介捷克文豪，而对于已经闻名之英美法德文人，反厌为陈腐，不欲深察，求一究竟。……此种流风，其弊在浮，救之之道，在于学。”（《人间世》二十八期《今文八弊》中）南北两公，眼睛都有些斜视，只看了一面，各骂了一面，独跳犹可，并排跳舞起来，那“勇敢”就未免化为有趣了。
I don't want to study the difficult problems of "slavery is the most 'consciously correct' thing", "subjectivity is the choice of things, and objectivity is the method of things"; I just need to say that, as Mr. Zhang Luwei said, in terms of literature and art, our China is indeed too backward. France has Gide and Balzac, the Soviet Union has Gorky, we don't have it; Japan started shouting, and we followed suit, which may really be "following" and "forever", that is, "slavery", and "the most 'conscious' thing". However, there are actually some shouts that do not "follow", Mr. Lin Yutang said: "...... In literature, today he introduces Polish poets and tomorrow he introduces Czech writers, but for the already famous British, American, French, and German literati, he is tired of being clichéd, and does not want to investigate deeply and seek the end. …… The problem with this kind of trend lies in superficiality, and the way to remedy it lies in learning. (In the twenty-eighth issue of "The World of the World", "Eight Evils of Today's Text") The two men of the north and south, their eyes were a little squinting, they only looked at one side, each scolded one side, danced alone, and danced side by side, then "brave" inevitably turned into fun.不过林先生主张“求一究竟”，张先生要求“直接了解”，这“实事求是”之心，两位是大抵一致的，不过张先生比较的悲观，因为他是“豫言”家，断定了“在一千年以内，绝不会见到那些绍介纪德，巴尔扎克的人们会给中国的读者译出一两本纪德，巴尔扎克的重要著作来，全集更不必说”的缘故。照这“豫言”看起来，“直接了解”的张露薇先生自己，当然是一定不译的了；别人呢，我还想存疑，但可惜我活不到一千年，决没有目睹的希望。
However, Mr. Lin advocates "seeking the end", and Mr. Zhang asks for "direct understanding", and the two are generally the same in this "seeking truth from facts", but Mr. Zhang is more pessimistic, because he is a "prophecyist" and concluded that "within a thousand years, he will never see those Shaojie Gide, and Balzac people will translate one or two books of Gide, Balzac's important works, not to mention the complete works". According to this "prophecy", Mr. Zhang Luwei herself, who "directly understands", must not translate; I still want to doubt others, but unfortunately I will not live for a thousand years, and there is no hope of witnessing it.豫言颇有点难。说得近一些，容易露破绽。还记得我们的批评家成仿吾先生手抡双斧，从《创造》的大旗下，一跃而出的时候，曾经说，他不屑看流行的作品，要从冷落堆里提出作家来。这是好的，虽然勃兰兑斯曾从冷落中提出过伊孛生和尼采，但我们似乎也难以斥他为追随或奴性。不大好的是他的这一张支票，到十多年后的现在还没有兑现。说得远一些罢，又容易成笑柄。江浙人相信风水，富翁往往豫先寻葬地；乡下人知道一个故事：有风水先生给人寻好了坟穴，起誓道：“您百年之后，安葬下去，如果到第三代不发，请打我的嘴巴！”然而他的期限，比张露薇先生的期限还要少到约十分之九的样子。
The prediction is a bit difficult. If you say it closer, it is easy to reveal flaws. I still remember that when our critic Mr. Cheng Fangwu picked up a double axe and jumped out of the banner of "Creation", he once said that he disdained to read popular works and wanted to propose writers from the snub pile. This is good, although Brandeis has mentioned Ibson and Nietzsche out of the cold, but it seems difficult for us to dismiss them as followers or serviles. The bad thing is that his check has not been cashed until more than ten years later. If you say it further, it is easy to become a laughingstock. Jiangsu and Zhejiang people believe in feng shui, and rich people often find burial places in advance; The countrymen know a story: a feng shui gentleman found a grave for people and swore: "After a hundred years, you will be buried, if you don't send it to the third generation, please hit me in the mouth!" However, his time limit is less than Mr. Zhang Luwei's time limit, about nine-tenths of the time.然而讲已往的琐事也不易。张露薇先生说庆祝高尔基四十年创作的时候，“中国也有鲁迅，丁玲一般人发了庆祝的电文，……然而那一群签名者中有几个读过高尔基的十分之一的作品？”这质问是极不错的。我只得招供：读得很少，而且连高尔基十分之一的作品究竟是几本也不知道。不过高尔基的全集，却连他本国也还未出全，所以其实也无从计算。至于祝电，我以为打一个是应该的，似乎也并非中国人的耻辱，或者便失了人性，然而我实在却并没有发，也没有在任何电报底稿上签名。这也并非怕有“奴性”，只因没有人来邀，自己也想不到，过去了。发不妨，不发也不要紧，我想：发，高尔基大约不至于说我是“日本人的追随者的作家”，不发，也未必说我是“张露薇的追随者的作家”的。但对于绥拉菲摩维支的祝贺日，我却发过一个祝电，因为我校印过中译的《铁流》。这是在情理之中的，但也较难于想到，还不如测定为对于高尔基发电的容易。当然，随便说说也不要紧，然而，“中国的知识阶级就是如此浅薄，做应声虫有余，做一个忠实的，不苟且的，有理性的文学创作者和研究者便不成了”的话，对于有一些人却大概是真的了。
However, it is not easy to talk about the trivial things of the past. Mr. Zhang Luwei said that when celebrating Gorky's 40th anniversary of creation, "China also has Lu Xun, and Ding Ling and ordinary people sent congratulatory messages,...... However, how many of the signatories had read a tenth of Gorky's works? "This question is very good. I had to confess: I read very little, and I didn't even know how many of Gorky's tenths of his works were. However, Gorky's complete works have not even been completed in his own country, so there is actually no way to calculate them. As for the telegram, I thought it was appropriate to hit one, and it didn't seem to be a Chinese shame, or it was a loss of humanity, but I didn't send it, nor did I sign any telegram draft. This is not because I am afraid of being "servile", just because no one came to invite me, and I couldn't think of it, and it passed. It doesn't matter if you send it, it doesn't matter if you don't send it, I think: Gorky probably wouldn't say that I was a "writer of Japanese followers", and if I didn't post, I might not say that I was a "writer of Zhang Luwei's followers". But for the congratulatory day of Suilafimovichi, I sent a congratulatory telegram, because I had printed the Chinese translation of "Tie Liu". This is reasonable, but it is also difficult to think that it is not as easy as measuring it for Gorky's power generation. Of course, it doesn't matter if you talk about it casually, however, for some people, "China's intellectual class is so shallow that it is more than enough to be a responder, and it is not possible to be a faithful, unscrupulous, and rational literary creator and researcher", which is probably true for some people.张露薇先生自然也是知识阶级，他在同阶级中发见了这许多奴隶，拿鞭子来抽，我是了解他的心情的。但他和他所谓的奴隶们，也只隔了一张纸。如果有谁看过菲洲的黑奴工头，傲然的拿鞭子乱抽着做苦工的黑奴的电影的，拿来和这《略论中国文坛》的大文一比较，便会禁不住会心之笑。那一个和一群，有这么相近，却又有这么不同，这一张纸真隔得利害：分清了奴隶和奴才。
Mr. Zhang Luwei is naturally also an intellectual class, and he found so many slaves in the same class and whipped them, and I understand his feelings. But he and his so-called slaves were only separated by a piece of paper. If anyone has ever seen the movie of the black slave foreman in Philippine, proudly smoking a black slave with a whip and doing hard labor, and compare it with this article "A Brief Discussion on the Chinese Literary World", he can't help but smile knowingly. That one and a group are so similar, but so different, this piece of paper is really separated: it distinguishes between slaves and slaves.我在这里，自以为总算又钩下了一种新的伟大人物——一九三五年度文艺“豫言”家——的嘴脸的轮廓了。
Here, I think I have finally hooked the outline of the face of a new great figure - the literary and artistic "prophecylist" of 1935.八月十六日。

论毛笔之类

论毛笔之类

论毛笔之类

Discuss brushes and the like国货也提倡得长久了，虽然上海的国货公司并不发达，“国货城”也早已关了城门，接着就将城墙撤去，日报上却还常见关于国货的专刊。那上面，受劝和挨骂的主角，照例也还是学生，儿童和妇女。
Although Shanghai's domestic companies are not developed, the "domestic city" has already closed the city gate, and then the city wall has been removed, but there are still special issues about domestic products in the daily newspaper. Above, the protagonists who are persuaded and scolded are still students, children and women.前几天看见一篇关于笔墨的文章，中学生之流，很受了一顿训斥，说他们十分之九，是用钢笔和墨水的，这就使中国的笔墨没有出路。自然，倒并不说这一类人就是什么奸，但至少，恰如摩登妇女的爱用外国脂粉和香水似的，应负“入超”的若干的责任。
A few days ago, I saw an article about pen and ink, and middle school students were reprimanded, saying that nine out of ten of them used pens and ink, which made China's pen and ink have no way out. Naturally, it is not said that this type of person is a traitor, but at least, just like modern women love to use foreign powders and perfumes, they should bear some responsibilities for "entering the supermarket".这话也并不错的。不过我想，洋笔墨的用不用，要看我们的闲不闲。我自己是先在私塾里用毛笔，后在学校里用钢笔，后来回到乡下又用毛笔的人，却以为假如我们能够悠悠然，洋洋焉，拂砚伸纸，磨墨挥毫的话，那么，羊毫和松烟当然也很不坏。不过事情要做得快，字要写得多，可就不成功了，这就是说，它敌不过钢笔和墨水。譬如在学校里抄讲义罢，即使改用墨盒，省去临时磨墨之烦，但不久，墨汁也会把毛笔胶住，写不开了，你还得带洗笔的水池，终于弄到在小小的桌子上，摆开“文房四宝”。况且毛笔尖触纸的多少，就是字的粗细，是全靠手腕作主的，因此也容易疲劳，越写越慢。闲人不要紧，一忙，就觉得无论如何，总是墨水和钢笔便当了。
This is not bad either. But I think whether we use foreign pen and ink depends on whether we are idle. I myself am a person who first used a brush in a private school, then a pen in school, and then returned to the countryside to use a brush, but I thought that if we could leisurely and leisurely, brush the inkstone, stretch the paper, and grind the ink, then of course the sheep's hair and pine smoke are not bad. But if things have to be done quickly and written a lot, it will not succeed, which means that it is no match for pen and ink. For example, if you copy handouts in school, even if you switch to ink cartridges, you will save the trouble of temporarily grinding ink, but soon, the ink will stick the brush and you won't be able to write, and you have to bring a pen washing pool, and finally get it on a small table and set up the "Four Treasures of the Study". Moreover, the amount of the brush tip touching the paper is the thickness of the words, which is all determined by the wrist, so it is easy to get tired, and the more you write, the slower it becomes. It doesn't matter if you are an idler, when you are busy, you will feel that no matter what, it is always ink and pen bento.青年里面，当然也不免有洋服上挂一枝万年笔，做做装饰的人，但这究竟是少数，使用者的多，原因还是在便当。便于使用的器具的力量，是决非劝谕，讥刺，痛骂之类的空言所能制止的。假如不信，你倒去劝那些坐汽车的人，在北方改用骡车，在南方改用绿呢大轿试试看。如果说这提议是笑话，那么，劝学生改用毛笔呢？现在的青年，已经成了“庙头鼓”，谁都不妨敲打了。一面有繁重的学科，古书的提倡，一面却又有教育家喟然兴叹，说他们成绩坏，不看报纸，昧于世界的大势。
Among the young people, of course, there are people who hang a pen on their clothes and make decorations, but this is a minority, and there are many users, and the reason is still in the bento. The power of convenient tools is by no means stopped by empty words such as persuasion, ridicule, and scolding. If you don't believe it, you can persuade those who ride in cars to switch to mule carts in the north and green tweed sedans in the south. If this proposal is a joke, then what about persuading students to switch to brushes? Today's young people have become "temple drums", and everyone might as well beat them. On the one hand, there are heavy disciplines and the advocacy of ancient books, but on the other hand, there are educators who sigh, saying that they have bad grades, do not read newspapers, and are ignorant of the general trend of the world.但是，连笔墨也乞灵于外国，那当然是不行的。这一点，却要推前清的官僚聪明，他们在上海立过制造局，想造比笔墨更紧要的器械——虽然为了“积重难返”，终于也造不出什么东西来。欧洲人也聪明，金鸡那原是斐洲的植物，因为去偷种子，还死了几个人，但竟偷到手，在自己这里种起来了，使我们现在如果发了疟疾，可以很便当的大吃金鸡那霜丸，而且还有“糖衣”，连不爱服药的娇小姐们也吃得甜蜜蜜。制造墨水和钢笔的法子，弄弄到手，是没有偷金鸡那子那么危险的。所以与其劝人莫用墨水和钢笔，倒不如自己来造墨水和钢笔；但必须造得好，切莫“挂羊头卖狗肉”。要不然，这一番工夫就又是一个白费。
However, even the pen and ink are begging for spirits in foreign countries, which is of course not possible. This is to push the bureaucratic cleverness of the Qing Dynasty, who set up a manufacturing bureau in Shanghai and wanted to make equipment that was more important than pen and ink - although in order to "accumulate heavy weights", they could not make anything in the end. Europeans are also smart, the golden rooster was originally a plant of Feizhou, because of stealing seeds, a few people died, but they actually stole it and planted it here, so that if we have malaria now, we can eat the golden rooster cream pills very conveniently, and there is also "sugar coating", even the young ladies who don't like to take medicine eat sweet honey. The method of making ink and pens is not as dangerous as stealing the golden rooster. Therefore, instead of persuading people not to use ink and pens, it is better to make ink and pens by yourself; But it must be made well, and don't "hang sheep's heads and sell dog meat". Otherwise, this effort will be in vain.但我相信，凡有毛笔拥护论者大约也不免以我的提议为空谈：因为这事情不容易。这也是事实；所以典当业只好呈请禁止奇装异服，以免时价早晚不同，笔墨业也只好主张吮墨舐毫，以免国粹渐就沦丧。改造自己，总比禁止别人来得难。然而这办法却是没有好结果的，不是无效，就是使一部份青年又变成旧式的斯文人。
But I believe that all brush advocates probably can't help but take my proposal as empty talk: because it's not easy. This is also true; Therefore, the pawn industry had to petition for a ban on fancy dresses, so as not to change the price sooner or later, and the pen and ink industry had to advocate sucking ink and licking the brush, so as not to gradually lose the essence of the country. It is more difficult to reform yourself than to prohibit others. However, this method did not yield good results, either it was ineffective, or it turned some young people into old-fashioned Svens.八月二十三日。

逃名

逃名

逃名

Escape name就在这几天的上海报纸上，有一条广告，题目是四个一寸见方的大字——
In the Shanghai newspaper in the past few days, there was an advertisement with the title of four large characters one inch square -“看救命去！”
"Look for help!"如果只看题目，恐怕会猜想到这是展览着外科医生对重病人施行大手术，或对淹死的人用人工呼吸，救助触礁船上的人员，挖掘崩坏的矿穴里面的工人的。但其实并不是。还是照例的“筹赈水灾游艺大会”，看陈皮梅沈一呆的独脚戏，月光歌舞团的歌舞之类。诚如广告所说，“化洋五角，救人一命，……一举两得，何乐不为”，钱是要拿去救命的，不过所“看”的却其实还是游艺，并不是“救命”。
If you only look at the title, you may guess that it is an exhibition of surgeons performing major surgeries on seriously ill patients, or artificial respiration on drowning people, rescuing people on reef ships, and digging workers in collapsed mines. But it's not. It is still the usual "Flood Relief Amusement Conference", watching the one-man show of Chen Pimei Shen Yidu, the singing and dancing of the Moonlight Song and Dance Troupe, etc. As the advertisement says, "Transform the ocean into a pentagon and save a life,...... Kill two birds with one stone, why not do it", money is to save lives, but what is "looking" is actually entertainment, not "life-saving".有人说中国是“文字国”，有些像，却还不充足，中国倒该说是最不看重文字的“文字游戏国”，一切总爱玩些实际以上花样，把字和词的界说，闹得一团糟，弄到暂时非把“解放”解作“孥戮”，“跳舞”解作“救命”不可。捣一场小乱子，就是伟人，编一本教科书，就是学者，造几条文坛消息，就是作家。于是比较自爱的人，一听到这些冠冕堂皇的名目就骇怕了，竭力逃避。逃名，其实是爱名的，逃的是这一团糟的名，不愿意酱在那里面。
Some people say that China is a "country of words", some similar, but not enough, China should be said to be the "word game country" that attaches the least importance to words, everything always likes to play tricks above reality, and the boundaries of words and words are said to be a mess, so that for the time being, "liberation" must be interpreted as "killing", and "dancing" must be interpreted as "life-saving". If you make a small mess, you are a great man, if you compile a textbook, you are a scholar, and if you make a few literary news, you are a writer. So the more self-loving people were frightened when they heard these high-sounding names and tried their best to escape. Escaping from the name is actually to love the name, escaping from this messy name, and I don't want to be in it.天津《大公报》的副刊《小公园》，近来是标榜了重文不重名的。这见识很确当。不过也偶有“老作家”的作品，那当然为了作品好，不是为了名。然而八月十六日那一张上，却发表了很有意思的“许多前辈作家附在来稿后面的叮嘱”：
The supplement "Little Park" of Tianjin's "Ta Kung Pao" has recently advertised that it emphasizes literature rather than name. This insight is very true. However, there are occasional works by "old writers", of course, for the sake of good works, not for fame. However, on the one on August 16, a very interesting "advice from many senior writers attached to the manuscript" was published:“把我这文章放在平日，我愿意那样，我骄傲那样。我和熟人的名字并列得厌倦了，我愿着挤在虎生生的新人群里，因为许多时候他们的东西来得还更新鲜。”
"Put my article on weekdays, I want to do that, I am proud of that. I am tired of juxtaposing the names of my acquaintances, and I am willing to squeeze into the new crowd, because many times their things come fresher. ”这些“前辈作家”们好像都撒了一点谎。“熟”，是不至于招致“厌倦”的。我们一离乳就吃饭或面，直到现在，可谓熟极了，却还没有厌倦。这一点叮嘱，如果不是编辑先生玩的双簧的花样，也不是前辈作家玩的借此“返老还童”的花样，那么，这所证明的是：所谓“前辈作家”也者，有一批是盗名的，因此使别一批羞与为伍，觉得和“熟人的名字并列得厌倦”，决计逃走了。
These "senior writers" seem to have lied a little. "Familiarity" will not cause "boredom". We eat or noodles as soon as we are weaned, and until now, we are very familiar, but we have not gotten tired of it. If it is not the double reed trick played by the editor, nor the trick of "rejuvenation" played by the senior writers, then this proves that some of the so-called "senior writers" are also name thieves, so they are ashamed to be with other groups, and feel tired of being "juxtaposed with the names of acquaintances", and decide to escape.从此以后，他们只要“挤在虎生生的新人群里”就舒舒服服，还是作品也就“来得还更新鲜”了呢，现在很难测定。逃名，固然也不能说是豁达，但有去就，有爱憎，究竟总不失为洁身自好之士。《小公园》里，已经有人在现身说法了，而上海滩上，却依然有人在“掏腰包”，造消息，或自称“言行一致”，或大呼“冤哉枉也”，或拖明朝死尸搭台，或请现存古人喝道，或自收自己的大名入辞典中，定为“中国作家”，或自编自己的作品入画集里，名曰“现代杰作”——忙忙碌碌，鬼鬼祟祟，煞是好看。
From then on, as long as they were "crowded in the new crowd of tigers", they were comfortable, or their works were "fresher", which is difficult to determine now. Escaping from fame cannot be said to be open-minded, but there are goings, love and hate, and in the end, it is always a clean and self-righteous person. In "Little Park", there are already people who are showing up to speak, but on the beach, there are still people who are "digging into their pockets" and making news, or claiming to be "consistent with words and deeds", or shouting "unjust", or dragging the dead corpses of the Ming Dynasty to set up a stage, or asking the existing ancients to shout, or accepting their own names into the dictionary and designating them as "Chinese writers", or compiling their own works into the collection of paintings, called "modern masterpieces" - busy, sneaky, and really good-looking.作家一排一排的坐着，将来使人笑，使人怕，还是使人“厌倦”呢？——现在也很难测定。但若据“前车之鉴”，则“后之视今，亦犹今之视昔”，大约也还不免于“悲夫”的了！
Will the writer sit in rows make people laugh, frighten, or "tired" in the future? ——It is also difficult to measure now. But if it is based on the "mirror of the past", then "the future looks at the present, just as the present looks at the past", and it is probably inevitable that it will be "sad"!八月二十三日。

六论“文人相轻”——二卖

六论“文人相轻”——二卖

六论“文人相轻”——二卖

Sixth, "literati look down on each other" - two selling今年文坛上的战术，有几手是恢复了五六年前的太阳社式，年纪大又成为一种罪状了，叫作“倚老卖老”。
This year's tactics in the literary world are a few hands that have restored the style of the Sun Society five or six years ago, and it has become a crime when they are older, called "relying on the old and selling the old".其实呢，罪是并不在“老”，而在于“卖”的，假使他在叉麻酱，念弥陀，一字不写，就决不会惹青年作家的口诛笔伐。如果这推测并不错，文坛上可又要增添各样的罪人了，因为现在的作家，有几位总不免在他的“作品”之外，附送一点特产的赠品。有的卖富，说卖稿的文人的作品，都是要不得的；有人指出了他的诗思不过在太太的奁资中，就有帮闲的来说这人是因为得不到这样的太太，恰如狐狸的吃不到葡萄，所以只好说葡萄酸。有的卖穷，或卖病，说他的作品是挨饿三天，吐血十口，这才做出来的，所以与众不同。有的卖穷和富，说这刊物是因为受了文阀文僚的排挤，自掏腰包，忍痛印出来的，所以又与众不同。有的卖孝，说自己做这样的文章，是因为怕父亲将来吃苦的缘故，那可更了不得，价值简直和李密的《陈情表》不相上下了。有的就是衔烟斗，穿洋服，唉声叹气，顾影自怜，老是记着自己的韶年玉貌的少年哥儿，这里和“卖老”相对，姑且叫他“卖俏”罢。
In fact, the sin is not in the "old", but in the "selling", if he is forked with sesame sauce, reciting Amitabha, and not writing a word, he will never provoke the young writers to criticize him. If this speculation is not good, all kinds of sinners will be added to the literary world, because several writers today will inevitably give a little special gift in addition to their "works". some sell rich, saying that the works of literati who sell manuscripts are not wanted; Some people pointed out that his poetry was just in his wife's dowry, and some helpers said that this person was because he couldn't get such a wife, just like a fox can't eat grapes, so he had to say that the grapes were sour. Some sell poverty, or sell disease, saying that his works were made by starving for three days and vomiting blood ten mouthfuls, so they are different. Some sell the poor and the rich, saying that this publication is different because it was ostracized by the literary clergy, paid out of their own pockets, and reluctantly printed it. Some sell filial piety, saying that they are afraid that their father will suffer in the future, which is even more amazing, and the value is simply comparable to Li Mi's "Chen Qing Biao". Some are young brothers who hold pipes, wear clothes, sigh, look at themselves, and always remember their youthful appearance.不过中国的社会上，“卖老”的真也特别多。女人会穿针，有什么希奇呢，一到一百多岁，就可以开大会，穿给大家看，顺便还捐钱了。说中国人“起码要学狗”，倘是小学生的作文，是会遭先生的板子的，但大了几十年，新闻上就大登特登，还用方体字标题道：“皤然一老莅故都，吴稚晖语妙天下”；劝人解囊赈灾的文章，并不少见，而文中自述年纪曰：“余年九十六岁矣”者，却只有马相伯先生。但普通都不谓之“卖”，另有极好的称呼，叫作“有价值”。
However, in Chinese society, there are really a lot of people who "sell the old". Women can thread needles, what's so strange, as soon as they reach more than a hundred years old, they can hold a conference, wear it for everyone to see, and donate money by the way. It is said that Chinese people "at least have to learn dogs", if it is a primary school student's composition, it will be blocked by the teacher, but when it is decades older, it will be deliberately published in the news, and it will be titled in square characters: "An old man comes to the old capital, Wu Zhihui speaks wonderfully"; It is not uncommon for articles to persuade people to donate their pockets for disaster relief, but the only one who states his age in the article is Mr. Ma Xiangbo. But it is not usually called "selling", and there is also an excellent name, called "valuable".“老作家”的“老”字，就是一宗罪案，这法律在文坛上已经好几年了，不过或者指为落伍，或者说是把持，……总没有指出明白的坏处。这回才由上海的青年作家揭发了要点，是在“卖”他的“老”。
The word "old" in "old writer" is a crime, and this law has been in the literary world for several years, but it may refer to being outdated, or it is controlled,...... There is no clear disadvantage. This time, a young writer in Shanghai revealed the main point, which is "selling" his "old".那就不足虑了，很容易扫荡。中国各业，多老牌子，文坛却并不然，创作了几年，就或者做官，或者改业，或者教书，或者卷逃，或者经商，或者造反，或者送命……不见了。“老”在那里的原已寥寥无几，真有些像耆英会里的一百多岁的老太婆，居然会活到现在，连“民之父母”也觉得希奇古怪。而且她还会穿针，就尤其希奇古怪，使街头巷尾弄得闹嚷嚷。然而呀了，这其实是为了奉旨旌表的缘故，如果一个十六七岁的漂亮姑娘登台穿起针来，看的人也决不会少的。
Then there is no need to worry, it is easy to sweep. After a few years of creation, they either became officials, or changed careers, or taught, or fled, or did business, or rebelled, or died...... It's gone. There are very few "old" people there, and they are really a bit like the hundred-year-old woman in the Senior Citizens' Association, who will actually live to this day, and even the "parents of the people" find it strange. And she can thread needles, especially strangely, making the streets and alleys noisy. However, this is actually for the sake of being ordered to honor the order, if a beautiful girl of sixteen or seventeen years old wears a needle on stage, there will be no less people watching.谁有“卖老”的吗？一遇到少的俏的就倒。
Does anyone "sell the old"? As soon as I meet a few pretty ones, I will fall.不过中国的文坛虽然幼稚，昏暗，却还没有这么简单；读者虽说被“养成一种‘看热闹’的情趣”，但有辨别力的也不少，而且还在多起来。所以专门“卖老”，是不行的，因为文坛究竟不是养老堂，又所以专门“卖俏”，也不行的，因为文坛究竟也不是妓院。
However, although the Chinese literary world is naïve and dim, it is not that simple; Although readers are "developed a taste of 'watching the fun'", there are many people who have discernment, and there are still many of them. Therefore, it is not possible to specialize in "selling the old", because the literary world is not a retirement hall, and it is not possible to specialize in "selling pretty", because the literary world is not a brothel after all.二卖俱非，由非见是，混沌之辈，以为两伤。
二卖俱非，由非见是，混沌之辈，以为两伤。九月十二日。
