七论“文人相轻”——两伤

七论“文人相轻”——两伤

七论“文人相轻”——两伤

七论“文人相轻”——两伤所谓文人，轻个不完，弄得别一些作者摇头叹气了，以为作践了文苑。这自然也说得通。陶渊明先生“采菊东篱下”，心境必须清幽闲适，他这才能够“悠然见南山”，如果篱中篱外，有人大嚷大跳，大骂大打，南山是在的，他却“悠然”不得，只好“愕然见南山”了。现在和晋宋之交有些不同，连“象牙之塔”也已经搬到街头来，似乎颇有“不隔”之意，然而也还得有幽闲，要不然，即无以寄其沉痛，文坛减色，嚷嚷之罪大矣。于是相轻的文人们的处境，就也更加艰难起来，连街头也不再是扰攘的地方了，真是途穷道尽。
The so-called literati are endless, which makes some other authors shake their heads and sigh, thinking that they have practiced the literary garden. This naturally makes sense. Mr. Tao Yuanming "picks chrysanthemums under the east fence", his mood must be quiet and leisurely, so he can "leisurely see Nanshan", if outside the fence, someone shouts and jumps, scolds and beats, Nanshan is there, but he can't be "leisurely", so he has to "see Nanshan in astonishment". Now it is a little different from the turn of the Jin and Song dynasties, even the "Ivory Tower" has been moved to the streets, which seems to have the meaning of "not separated", but there must also be leisure, otherwise, there is no way to send its pain, the literary world is less colored, and the sin of shouting is great. As a result, the situation of the literati who looked down on each other became more difficult, and even the streets were no longer a disturbing place, and they were really at the end of their way.然而如果还要相轻又怎么样呢？前清有成例，知县老爷出巡，路遇两人相打，不问青红皂白，谁是谁非，各打屁股五百完事。不相轻的文人们纵有“肃静”“回避”牌，却无小板子，打是自然不至于的，他还是用“笔伐”，说两面都不是好东西。这里有一段炯之先生的《谈谈上海的刊物》为例——
But what if you want to be light? There was a precedent in the Qing Dynasty that when the county magistrate went out on patrol, he encountered two people fighting each other, regardless of whether they were blue or white, who was right and who was wrong, and each spanked five hundred times to complete the task. Even if the literati who do not take each other lightly have the cards of "silence" and "avoidance", but there is no small board, it is natural to play, and he still uses "pen cutting", saying that both sides are not good things. Here is an example of Mr. Jiongzhi's "Talking about Shanghai Publications" -“说到这种争斗，使我们记起《太白》，《文学》，《论语》，《人间世》几年来的争斗成绩。这成绩就是凡骂人的与被骂的一古脑儿变成丑角，等于木偶戏的互相揪打或以头互碰，除了读者养成一种‘看热闹’的情趣以外，别无所有。把读者养成欢喜看‘戏’不欢喜看‘书’的习气，‘文坛消息’的多少，成为刊物销路多少的主要原因。争斗的延长，无结果的延长，实在可说是中国读者的大不幸。我们是不是还有什么方法可以使这种‘私骂’占篇幅少一些？一个时代的代表作，结起账来若只是这些精巧的对骂，这文坛，未免太可怜了。”（天津《大公报》的《小公园》，八月十八日。）
Speaking of this kind of struggle, we remember the achievements of "Taibai", "Literature", "Analects", and "The Human World" in the past few years. This achievement is that all the scolding and being scolded become a clown, which is equivalent to puppet shows beating each other or touching each other's heads, except for the reader to develop a kind of 'watching the fun'. Cultivating readers to like to watch 'plays' and not 'books', and the amount of 'literary news' has become the main reason for the sales of publications. The prolongation of the struggle and the prolongation of inconclusiveness can really be said to be a great misfortune for Chinese readers. Is there any other way we can make this kind of 'private scolding' less spaced? A masterpiece of an era, if it is just these exquisite scoldings, this literary world is too pitiful. (Tianjin's "Ta Kung Pao" "Little Park", August 18.) ）“这种斗争”，炯之先生还自有一个界说：“即是向异己者用一种琐碎方法，加以无怜悯，不节制的辱骂。（一个术语，便是‘斗争’。）”云。
"This kind of struggle", Mr. Jiongzhi also has his own world: "It is to use a trivial method to insult dissidents without mercy and intemperance." (One term is 'struggle.') Cloud.于是乎这位炯之先生便以怜悯之心，节制之笔，定两造为丑角，觉文坛之可怜了，虽然“我们记起《太白》，《文学》，《论语》，《人间世》几年来”，似乎不但并不以“‘文坛消息’的多少，成为刊物销路多少的主要原因”，而且简直不登什么“文坛消息”。不过“骂”是有的；只“看热闹”的读者，大约一定也有的。试看路上两人相打，他们何尝没有是非曲直之分，但旁观者往往只觉得有趣；就是绑出法场去，也是不问罪状，单看热闹的居多。由这情形，推而广之以至于文坛，真令人有不如逆来顺受，唾面自干之感。到这里来一个“然而”罢，转过来是旁观者或读者，其实又并不全如炯之先生所拟定的混沌，有些是自有各人自己的判断的。所以昔者古典主义者和罗曼主义者相骂，甚而至于相打，他们并不都成为丑角；左拉遭了剧烈的文字和图画的嘲骂，终于不成为丑角；连生前身败名裂的王尔德，现在也不算是丑角。
So this Mr. Jiongzhi with a heart of pity and a pen of moderation, set the two creations as harlequins, and felt that the literary world was pitiful, although "we remember "Taibai", "Literature", "Analects", and "The World of the World" for several years", it seems that not only does "the amount of 'literary news' become the main reason for the sales of publications", but also does not publish any "literary news". However, there is "scolding"; There must be readers who only "watch the excitement". Try to see two people fighting on the road, they have no right or wrong, but bystanders often only find it interesting; Even if they are tied out of the Dharma field, they don't ask about the crime, and most of them just look at the excitement. From this situation, and by extension to the literary world, it really makes people feel that it is better to accept the adversity and spit on their faces. Here is a "but", turning it around to be a bystander or reader, in fact, it is not all the chaos drawn up by Mr. Jiongzhi, and some of it is everyone's own judgment. Therefore, in the past, the classicists and romantics scolded each other, and even fought each other, and they did not all become harlequins; Zola was scolded by violent words and pictures, and finally stopped becoming a harlequin; Even Wilde, who was discredited in his predecessor, is not a harlequin now.自然，他们有作品。但中国也有的。中国的作品“可怜”得很，诚然，但这不只是文坛可怜，也是时代可怜，而且这可怜中，连“看热闹”的读者和论客都在内。凡有可怜的作品，正是代表了可怜的时代。昔之名人说“恕”字诀——但他们说，对于不知恕道的人，是不恕的；——今之名人说“忍”字诀，春天的论客以“文人相轻”混淆黑白，秋天的论客以“凡骂人的与被骂的一古脑儿变成丑角”抹杀是非。冷冰冰阴森森的平安的古冢中，怎么会有生人气？
Naturally, they have works. But China also has it. It is true that Chinese works are very "pitiful", but this is not only the pity of the literary world, but also the pity of the times, and in this pity, even readers and commentators who "watch the excitement" are included. Wherever there are pitiful works, they represent the pitiful times. In the past, famous people said the word "forgiveness" - but they said that for those who do not know the way of forgiveness, they will not forgive; ——Today's celebrities say the word "forbearance", the spring commentator confuses black and white with "literati look down on each other", and the autumn commentator erases right and wrong with "all the scolded and the scolded old brain becomes a harlequin". How can there be any popularity in the cold and gloomy ancient tomb of peace?“我们是不是还有什么方法可以使这种‘私骂’占篇幅少一些？”——炯之先生问。有是有的。纵使名之曰“私骂”，但大约决不会件件都是一面等于二加二，一面等于一加三，在“私”之中，有的较近于“公”，在“骂”之中，有的较合于“理”的，居然来加评论的人，就该放弃了“看热闹的情趣”，加以分析，明白的说出你究以为那一面较“是”，那一面较“非”来。
"Is there any other way we can make this kind of 'private scolding' less space?" ——Mr. Jiongzhi asked. Yes, there is. Even if it is called "private scolding", it is probably not that one side is equal to two plus two, and one side is equal to one plus three, in the "private", some are closer to "public", among the "scolding", some are more in line with "reason", and those who actually come to comment should give up the "fun of watching the excitement", analyze it, and clearly say which side you think is more "yes" and that side is more "wrong".至于文人，则不但要以热烈的憎，向“异己”者进攻，还得以热烈的憎，向“死的说教者”抗战。在现在这“可怜”的时代，能杀才能生，能憎才能爱，能生与爱，才能文。彼兑飞说得好：
As for the literati, they not only attack the "dissidents" with enthusiastic hatred, but also resist the "dead preachers" with passionate hatred. In this "pitiful" era, you can kill to live, you can hate to love, you can be born and loved, and you can write. Peter Duifei said it well:
我的爱并不是欢欣安静的人家，My love is not the joy and quiet of the house, 
花园似的，将平和一门关住， like a garden, closing the door of peace, 
其中有“幸福”慈爱地往来， in which there is "happiness" lovingly coming and going, 
而抚养那“欢欣”，那娇小的仙女。 and raising the "joy", the petite fairy. 
我的爱，就如荒凉的沙漠一般—— My love is like a desolate desert - 
一个大盗似的有嫉妒在那里霸着； A thief is jealous and dominates there; 
他的剑是绝望的疯狂， His sword is desperate madness, 
而每一刺是各样的谋杀！ And every stab is a murder of all kinds!

九月十二日。
September 12th.

萧红作《生死场》序

萧红作《生死场》序

萧红作《生死场》序

Xiao Hong wrote the preface to "The Field of Life and Death."记得已是四年前的事了，时维二月，我和妇孺正陷在上海闸北的火线中，眼见中国人的因为逃走或死亡而绝迹。后来仗着几个朋友的帮助，这才得进平和的英租界，难民虽然满路，居人却很安闲。和闸北相距不过四五里罢，就是一个这么不同的世界，——我们又怎么会想到哈尔滨。
I remember it was four years ago, in February, my wife and children and I were trapped in the line of fire in Zhabei, Shanghai, and saw the Chinese disappear because of escape or death. Later, with the help of a few friends, he had to enter the peaceful British Concession, and although the refugees were full of people, the residents were very comfortable. It is only four or five miles away from Zhabei, which is such a different world,—— how could we think of Harbin.这本稿子的到了我的桌上，已是今年的春天，我早重回闸北，周围又复熙熙攘攘的时候了。但却看见了五年以前，以及更早的哈尔滨。这自然还不过是略图，叙事和写景，胜于人物的描写，然而北方人民的对于生的坚强，对于死的挣扎，却往往已经力透纸背；女性作者的细致的观察和越轨的笔致，又增加了不少明丽和新鲜。精神是健全的，就是深恶文艺和功利有关的人，如果看起来，他不幸得很，他也难免不能毫无所得。
This manuscript arrived on my desk in the spring of this year, and I had already returned to Zhabei, and it was time for the surroundings to be bustling again. But I saw Harbin five years ago, and even earlier. This is naturally just a sketch, narrative and scenery, better than the description of the characters, but the strength of the northern people for life and the struggle for death have often penetrated the back of the paper; The meticulous observation and deviant brushwork of female authors have added a lot of brightness and freshness. The spirit is sound, that is, the person who hates literature and art and utilitarianism, if it seems that he is very unfortunate, he will inevitably gain nothing.听说文学社曾经愿意给她付印，稿子呈到中央宣传部书报检查委员会那里去，搁了半年，结果是不许可。人常常会事后才聪明，回想起来，这正是当然的事：对于生的坚强和死的挣扎，恐怕也确是大背“训政”之道的。今年五月，只为了《略谈皇帝》这一篇文章，这一个气焰万丈的委员会就忽然烟消火灭，便是“以身作则”的实地大教训。
I heard that the Literary Society was willing to pay for her printing, and the manuscript was submitted to the Book and Newspaper Inspection Committee of the Central Propaganda Department, which was shelved for half a year, but the result was not allowed. People often become smart after the fact, and in retrospect, this is a matter of course: for the strength of life and the struggle of death, I am afraid that it is indeed a big departure from the way of "discipline of governance". In May of this year, just for the article "A Brief Talk about the Emperor", this arrogant committee suddenly disappeared, which is a big lesson on the field of "leading by example".奴隶社以汗血换来的几文钱，想为这本书出版，却又在我们的上司“以身作则”的半年之后了，还要我写几句序。然而这几天，却又谣言蜂起，闸北的熙熙攘攘的居民，又在抱头鼠窜了，路上是骆驿不绝的行李车和人，路旁是黄白两色的外人，含笑在赏鉴这礼让之邦的盛况。自以为居于安全地带的报馆的报纸，则称这些逃命者为“庸人”或“愚民”。我却以为他们也许是聪明的，至少，是已经凭着经验，知道了煌煌的官样文章之不可信。他们还有些记性。
The slave society wanted to publish this book with a few pennies of sweat and blood, but half a year after our boss "led by example", he asked me to write a few prefaces. However, in the past few days, rumors have been swirling, and the bustling residents of Zhabei are running around again, with endless luggage carts and people on the road, and yellow and white outsiders on the side of the road, smiling and appreciating the grandeur of this country of courtesy. Newspapers that think they live in safe zones call these fugitives "mediocre" or "foolish people". I thought they might be smart, at least, they already knew from experience that Huanghuang's official articles were not credible. They still have some memory.现在是一九三五年十一月十四的夜里，我在灯下再看完了《生死场》。周围像死一般寂静，听惯的邻人的谈话声没有了，食物的叫卖声也没有了，不过偶有远远的几声犬吠。想起来，英法租界当不是这情形，哈尔滨也不是这情形；我和那里的居人，彼此都怀着不同的心情，住在不同的世界。然而我的心现在却好像古井中水，不生微波，麻木的写了以上那些字。这正是奴隶的心！——但是，如果还是搅乱了读者的心呢？那么，我们还决不是奴才。
It was the night of November 14, 1935, and I finished watching "The Field of Life and Death" under the lamp. The surroundings were as silent as death, the conversations of the neighbors were gone, and the sound of food was gone, but there were occasional barks in the distance. Come to think of it, this is not the case in the Anglo-French Concession, and this is not the case in Harbin; I and the people who live there live in different worlds with different moods. However, my heart is now like water in an ancient well, without microwaves, and I write the above words numbly. This is exactly the heart of a slave! ——But what if it still disturbs the reader's heart? Then, we are by no means slaves.不过与其听我还在安坐中的牢骚话，不如快看下面的《生死场》，她才会给你们以坚强和挣扎的力气。
But instead of listening to my complaints while still sitting, it's better to watch "Life and Death" below, and she will give you strength and struggle.鲁迅。
Lu Xun.

陀思妥夫斯基的事

陀思妥夫斯基的事——为日本三笠书房《陀思妥夫斯基全集》普及本作

陀思妥夫斯基的事

Dostovsky's Affair - popularized this work for the "Complete Works of Dostovsky" by Mikasa Shobo in Japan到了关于陀思妥夫斯基，不能不说一两句话的时候了。说什么呢？他太伟大了，而自己却没有很细心的读过他的作品。
When it comes to Dostovsky, it is time not to say a word or two. What to say? He was so great, but I didn't read his works very carefully.回想起来，在年青时候，读了伟大的文学者的作品，虽然敬服那作者，然而总不能爱的，一共有两个人。一个是但丁，那《神曲》的《炼狱》里，就有我所爱的异端在；有些鬼魂还在把很重的石头，推上峻峭的岩壁去。这是极吃力的工作，但一松手，可就立刻压烂了自己。不知怎地，自己也好像很是疲乏了。于是我就在这地方停住，没有能够走到天国去。
Looking back, when I was young, I read the works of great writers, and although I admired the author, I couldn't love them, there were two people in total. One is Dante, and in the "Purgatory" of the "Divine Comedy", there is a heresy that I love; Some ghosts are still pushing heavy stones up the steep rock walls. This is extremely hard work, but as soon as you let go, you immediately crush yourself. Somehow, I also seemed to be very tired. So I stopped in this place and couldn't go to heaven.还有一个，就是陀思妥夫斯基。一读他二十四岁时所作的《穷人》，就已经吃惊于他那暮年似的孤寂。到后来，他竟作为罪孽深重的罪人，同时也是残酷的拷问官而出现了。他把小说中的男男女女，放在万难忍受的境遇里，来试炼它们，不但剥去了表面的洁白，拷问出藏在底下的罪恶，而且还要拷问出藏在那罪恶之下的真正的洁白来。而且还不肯爽利的处死，竭力要放它们活得长久。而这陀思妥夫斯基，则仿佛就在和罪人一同苦恼，和拷问官一同高兴着似的。这决不是平常人做得到的事情，总而言之，就因为伟大的缘故。但我自己，却常常想废书不观。
There is also Dostovsky. As soon as I read "The Poor", which he wrote when he was twenty-four years old, I was already surprised by his loneliness in his twilight years. Later, he appeared as a sinful sinner and a cruel torturer. He puts the men and women in the novel in unbearable circumstances to test them, not only stripping away the whiteness on the surface, torturing the sins hidden underneath, but also torturing the true whiteness hidden under the sins. And he refused to execute them happily, trying his best to let them live for a long time. And this Dostovsky seems to be distressing with the sinners and happy with the torturers. This is by no means something that ordinary people can do, in short, because of greatness. But myself, I often want to abandon books.医学者往往用病态来解释陀思妥夫斯基的作品。这伦勃罗梭式的说明，在现今的大多数的国度里，恐怕实在也非常便利，能得一般人们的赞许的。但是，即使他是神经病者，也是俄国专制时代的神经病者，倘若谁身受了和他相类的重压，那么，愈身受，也就会愈懂得他那夹着夸张的真实，热到发冷的热情，快要破裂的忍从，于是爱他起来的罢。
Medical scientists often use pathology to explain Dostovsky's work. This Lombrosso-style explanation is probably very convenient in most countries today, and can be praised by ordinary people. However, even if he is a neurotic, a neurotic of the Russian autocratic era, if anyone is under the same heavy pressure as him, then the more he suffers, the more he will understand his exaggerated truth, his passion that is hot and cold, and his patience that is about to break, so he loves him.不过作为中国的读者的我，却还不能熟悉陀思妥夫斯基式的忍从——对于横逆之来的真正的忍从。在中国，没有俄国的基督。在中国，君临的是“礼”，不是神。百分之百的忍从，在未嫁就死了定婚的丈夫，坚苦的一直硬活到八十岁的所谓节妇身上，也许偶然可以发见罢，但在一般的人们，却没有。忍从的形式，是有的，然而陀思妥夫斯基式的掘下去，我以为恐怕也还是虚伪。因为压迫者指为被压迫者的不德之一的这虚伪，对于同类，是恶，而对于压迫者，却是道德的。
However, as a Chinese reader, I am not yet familiar with Dostovsky-style forbearance - the real forbearance of rebellion. In China, there is no Russian Christ. In China, the king's land is "rites", not gods. 100% patience, in the husband who died before he was married, and the so-called chaste woman who lived hard until the age of eighty, may be found by chance, but in ordinary people, there is none. There is a form of forbearance, but Dostovsky-style digging, I think it is still hypocritical. For the hypocrisy of the oppressor as one of the immorality of the oppressed is evil for the same kind, but moral for the oppressor.但是，陀思妥夫斯基式的忍从，终于也并不只成了说教或抗议就完结。因为这是当不住的忍从，太伟大的忍从的缘故。人们也只好带着罪业，一直闯进但丁的天国，在这里这才大家合唱着，再来修练天人的功德了。只有中庸的人，固然并无坠入地狱的危险，但也恐怕进不了天国的罢。
However, Dostovsky's forbearance did not end with preaching or protesting. Because this is the reason for the unbearable forbearance, the great forbearance. People had no choice but to carry their sins and keep breaking into Dante's kingdom of heaven, where everyone sang in chorus and then practiced the merits of heaven and man. Only the mean person is not in danger of falling into hell, but I am afraid that he will not be able to enter the kingdom of heaven.十一月二十日。

孔另境编《当代文人尺牍钞》序

孔另境编《当代文人尺牍钞》序

孔另境编《当代文人尺牍钞》序

Kong Biejing edited the preface to "Contemporary Literati Letters"日记或书信，是向来有些读者的。先前是在看朝章国故，丽句清词，如何抑扬，怎样请托，于是害得名人连写日记和信也不敢随随便便。晋人写信，已经得声明“匆匆不暇草书”，今人作日记，竟日日要防传钞，来不及出版。王尔德的自述，至今还有一部分未曾公开，罗曼罗兰的日记，约在死后十年才可发表，这在我们中国恐怕办不到。
Diary or letter has always been for some readers. Previously, I was looking at the dynasty and the country, beautiful sentences, how to inflect, how to ask, so that celebrities did not dare to write diaries and letters casually. The Jin people wrote letters, and they had to declare that they were "in a hurry to write cursive", and now people keep a diary, and they have to prevent banknotes every day, and they have no time to publish it. Some of Wilde's self-reports have not been made public, and Romain Rolland's diary can only be published about ten years after his death, which may not be possible in our China.不过现在的读文人的非文学作品，大约目的已经有些和古之人不同，是比较的欧化了的：远之，在钩稽文坛的故实，近之，在探索作者的生平。而后者似乎要居多数。因为一个人的言行，总有一部分愿意别人知道，或者不妨给别人知道，但有一部分却不然。然而一个人的脾气，又偏爱知道别人不肯给人知道的一部分，于是尺牍就有了出路。这并非等于窥探门缝，意在发人的阴私，实在是因为要知道这人的全般，就是从不经意处，看出这人——社会的一分子的真实。
However, the purpose of today's non-literary works of literati is somewhat different from that of the ancients, and it is more Europeanized: far away, it is checking the facts of the literary world, and near, it is exploring the author's life. The latter seems to be in the majority. Because a person's words and deeds always have a part that they want others to know, or they might as well let others know, but some of them are not. However, a person's temper prefers to know the part that others refuse to know, so the ruler has a way out. This is not the same as peeking through the cracks of the door, intending to provoke people's private interests, but because to know the general situation of this person, it is to see the truth of this person, a member of society, from inadvertently.就是在“文学概论”上有了名目的创作上，作者本来也掩不住自己，无论写的是什么，这个人总还是这个人，不过加了些藻饰，有了些排场，仿佛穿上了制服。写信固然比较的随便，然而做作惯了的，仍不免带些惯性，别人以为他这回是赤条条的上场了罢，他其实还是穿着肉色紧身小衫裤，甚至于用了平常决不应用的奶罩。话虽如此，比起峨冠博带的时候来，这一回可究竟较近于真实。所以从作家的日记或尺牍上，往往能得到比看他的作品更其明晰的意见，也就是他自己的简洁的注释。不过也不能十分当真。有些作者，是连账簿也用心机的，叔本华记账就用梵文，不愿意别人明白。
Even in the creation of the name of "Introduction to Literature", the author could not hide himself, no matter what he wrote, this person was always this person, but with some decorations and some pomp, as if he was wearing a uniform. Writing letters is certainly relatively casual, but being used to being pretentious, it is still inevitable that there will be some inertia, others think that he is playing naked this time, but he is actually still wearing flesh-colored tight shirts and pants, and even uses a milk cover that is usually never used. Having said that, compared to the time when Eguan Bodai came, this time it was closer to the truth. Therefore, from a writer's diary or letter, you can often get a clearer opinion than looking at his works, that is, his own concise annotations. But it can't be taken very seriously. Some authors even worked their account books, and Schopenhauer used Sanskrit for his accounts, not wanting others to understand.另境先生的编这部书，我想是为了显示文人的全貌的，好在用心之古奥如叔本华先生者，中国还未必有。只是我的做序，可不比写信，总不免用些做序的拳经：这是要请编者读者，大家心照的。
I think Mr. Yijing's compilation of this book is to show the whole picture of the literati, but fortunately, there may not be an ancient person like Mr. Schopenhauer in China. It's just that my preface is not as good as writing a letter, and I can't help but use some preface boxing scriptures: this is to invite the editor and reader, everyone tacitly agrees.一九三五年十一月二十五夜，鲁迅记于上海闸北之且介亭。
On the night of November 25, 1935, Lu Xun recorded in Qiejie Pavilion in Zhabei, Shanghai.

杂谈小品文

杂谈小品文

杂谈小品文

Miscellaneous essays自从“小品文”这一个名目流行以来，看看书店广告，连信札，论文，都排在小品文里了，这自然只是生意经，不足为据。一般的意见，第一是在篇幅短。
Since the name "sketch essay" became popular, looking at bookstore advertisements, even letters and papers are ranked in the sketch text, which is naturally just a business experience and not enough evidence. The first general opinion is that the length is short.但篇幅短并不是小品文的特征。一条几何定理不过数十字，一部《老子》只有五千言，都不能说是小品。这该像佛经的小乘似的，先看内容，然后讲篇幅。讲小道理，或没道理，而又不是长篇的，才可谓之小品。至于有骨力的文章，恐不如谓之“短文”，短当然不及长，寥寥几句，也说不尽森罗万象，然而它并不“小”。
But short length is not a characteristic of essays. A geometric theorem is only a few tens of words, and a "Lao Tzu" is only 5,000 words, which cannot be said to be a sketch. This should be like the Hinayana of the Buddhist scriptures, first look at the content, and then talk about the length. Telling small truths, or not making sense, and not being long, can be called sketches. As for the article with bone strength, it may not be as good as a "short article", of course it is not as long as long, and a few sentences cannot say everything, but it is not "small".《史记》里的《伯夷列传》和《屈原贾谊列传》除去了引用的骚赋，其实也不过是小品，只因为他是“太史公”之作，又常见，所以没有人来选出，翻印。由晋至唐，也很有几个作家；宋文我不知道，但“江湖派”诗，却确是我所谓的小品。现在大家所提倡的，是明清，据说“抒写性灵”是它的特色。那时有一些人，确也只能够抒写性灵的，风气和环境，加上作者的出身和生活，也只能有这样的意思，写这样的文章。虽说抒写性灵，其实后来仍落了窠臼，不过是“赋得性灵”，照例写出那么一套来。当然也有人豫感到危难，后来是身历了危难的，所以小品文中，有时也夹着感愤，但在文字狱时，都被销毁，劈板了，于是我们所见，就只剩了“天马行空”似的超然的性灵。
The "Biography of Bo Yi" and "The Biography of Qu Yuan Jia Yi" in the "Records of the Grand Historian" are actually just sketches, except for the cited poems, just because he is the work of "Tai Shi Gong" and is common, so no one selects and reprints it. From the Jin Dynasty to the Tang Dynasty, there were also several writers; I don't know about Song Wen, but the "Jianghu School" poems are indeed my so-called sketches. What everyone advocates now is the Ming and Qing dynasties, and it is said that "expressing the spirit" is its characteristic. At that time, there were some people who could only express their spirituality, atmosphere and environment, plus the author's origin and life, and could only have this meaning and write such articles. Although it is said that the writing of the spirit of nature is actually out of the ordinary, it is just "endowed with the spirit", and it is written as usual. Of course, there are also people who feel in danger, and later experience danger, so in the sketch text, sometimes there is anger, but when the text prison, they are all destroyed and split, so what we see is only the transcendent spirit like "imaginative".这经过清朝检选的“性灵”，到得现在，却刚刚相宜，有明末的洒脱，无清初的所谓“悖谬”，有国时是高人，没国时还不失为逸士。逸士也得有资格，首先即在“超然”，“士”所以超庸奴，“逸”所以超责任：现在的特重明清小品，其实是大有理由，毫不足怪的。
This "spirit" that has been inspected and selected by the Qing Dynasty has just become appropriate, with the freedom and freedom of the late Ming Dynasty, without the so-called "paradox" of the early Qing Dynasty. Yishi must also be qualified, first of all, in "transcendent", "Shi" is so mediocre, and "Yi" is so responsible for it: the current special Ming and Qing sketches are actually very reasonable, and it is not surprising.不过“高人兼逸士梦”恐怕也不长久。近一年来，就露了大破绽，自以为高一点的，已经满纸空言，甚而至于胡说八道，下流的却成为打诨，和猥鄙丑角，并无不同，主意只在挖公子哥儿们的跳舞之资，和舞女们争生意，可怜之状，已经下于五四运动前后的鸳鸯蝴蝶派数等了。
However, the "dream of a master and a scholar" may not last long. In the past year, it has revealed a big flaw, thinking that it is a little higher, it has been full of empty words, and even nonsense, but the obscene one has become a joke, and the vulgar harlequin, no different, the idea is only to dig up the dancing qualifications of the young masters, and compete with the dancers for business, the pitiful situation, has been lower than the number of mandarin ducks and butterflies before and after the May Fourth Movement.为了这小品文的盛行，今年就又有翻印所谓“珍本”的事。有些论者，也以为可虑。我却觉得这是并非无用的。原本价贵，大抵无力购买，现在只用了一元或数角，就可以看见现代名人的祖师，以及先前的性灵，怎样叠床架屋，现在的性灵，怎样看人学样，啃过一堆牛骨头，即使是牛骨头，不也有了识见，可以不再被生炒牛角尖骗去了吗？
For the prevalence of this small article, there is another reprint of the so-called "rare book" this year. Some commentators also think it is a cause for concern. I don't think it's useless. Originally, it was expensive, and it was probably impossible to buy, but now with only one yuan or a few jiao, you can see the ancestors of modern celebrities, as well as the previous sexual spirits, how to stack beds and frame houses, and the current sexual spirits, how to look at people and imitate them, gnawing on a bunch of cow bones, even if it is a cow bone, don't you also have insight, can you no longer be deceived by the tips of raw fried cow horns?不过“珍本”并不就是“善本”，有些是正因为它无聊，没有人要看，这才日就灭亡，少下去；因为少，所以“珍”起来。就是旧书店里必讨大价的所谓“禁书”，也并非都是慷慨激昂，令人奋起的作品，清初，单为了作者也会禁，往往和内容简直不相干。这一层，却要读者有选择的眼光，也希望识者给相当的指点的。
However, "rare books" are not "rare books", some are precisely because they are boring and no one wants to read them, so they will perish and become less; Because there are few, it is "cherished". Even the so-called "banned books" that must be bargained for in used bookstores are not all impassioned and uplifting works, and in the early Qing Dynasty, they would be banned just for the author, and they were often simply irrelevant to the content. This layer requires readers to have a selective vision, and also hopes that knowledgeable people will give considerable guidance.十二月二日。
December 2nd.

“题未定”草

“题未定”草

“题未定”草

"Title undecided" draft六
Six记得T君曾经对我谈起过：我的《集外集》出版之后，施蛰存先生曾在什么刊物上有过批评，以为这本书不值得付印，最好是选一下。我至今没有看到那刊物；但从施先生的推崇《文选》和手定《晚明二十家小品》的功业，以及自标“言行一致”的美德推测起来，这也正像他的话。好在我现在并不要研究他的言行，用不着多管这些事。
I remember that Mr. T once talked to me: After the publication of my "Collection of Extra-Collections", Mr. Shi Zhicun criticized what publications he had in and thought that this book was not worth printing, and it was best to choose one. I have not seen the publication yet; However, from Mr. Shi's admiration of the "Anthology" and the hand-determined "Twenty Sketches of the Late Ming Dynasty", as well as the virtue of self-labeling "consistent in words and deeds", this is also like his words. Fortunately, I don't want to study his words and deeds now, so I don't need to meddle in these things.《集外集》的不值得付印，无论谁说，都是对的。其实岂只这一本书，将来重开四库馆时，恐怕我的一切译作，全在排除之列；虽是现在，天津图书馆的目录上，在《呐喊》和《彷徨》之下，就注着一个“销”字，“销”者，销毁之谓也；梁实秋教授充当什么图书馆主任时，听说也曾将我的许多译作驱逐出境。但从一般的情形而论，目前的出版界，却实在并不十分谨严，所以印了我的一本《集外集》，似乎也算不得怎么特别糟蹋了纸墨。至于选本，我倒以为是弊多利少的，记得前年就写过一篇《选本》，说明着自己的意见，后来就收在《集外集》中。
The "Collection of Outside the Collection" is not worth printing, no matter who says it, it is right. In fact, not only this book, when the Four Libraries are reopened in the future, I am afraid that all my translations will be excluded; Although it is now, in the catalog of Tianjin Library, under "Scream" and "Wandering", there is a word "sales", and "sales" also means destruction; When Professor Liang Shiqiu served as the director of the library, he heard that many of my translations were also expelled. But in general, the current publishing industry is really not very rigorous, so printing one of my "Collections of Outside Collections" does not seem to be a particularly bad waste of paper and ink. As for the selection, I thought it was more harmful than good, I remember that I wrote a "Selection" the year before last, explaining my opinions, and later it was included in the "Collection of Outside the Collection".自然，如果随便玩玩，那是什么选本都可以的，《文选》好，《古文观止》也可以。不过倘要研究文学或某一作家，所谓“知人论世”，那么，足以应用的选本就很难得。选本所显示的，往往并非作者的特色，倒是选者的眼光。眼光愈锐利，见识愈深广，选本固然愈准确，但可惜的是大抵眼光如豆，抹杀了作者真相的居多，这才是一个“文人浩劫”。例如蔡邕，选家大抵只取他的碑文，使读者仅觉得他是典重文章的作手，必须看见《蔡中郎集》里的《述行赋》（也见于《续古文苑》），那些“穷工巧于台榭兮，民露处而寝湿，委嘉谷于禽兽兮，下糠秕而无粒”（手头无书，也许记错，容后订正）的句子，才明白他并非单单的老学究，也是一个有血性的人，明白那时的情形，明白他确有取死之道。又如被选家录取了《归去来辞》和《桃花源记》，被论客赞赏着“采菊东篱下，悠然见南山”的陶潜先生，在后人的心目中，实在飘逸得太久了，但在全集里，他却有时很摩登，“愿在丝而为履，附素足以周旋，悲行止之有节，空委弃于床前”，竟想摇身一变，化为“阿呀呀，我的爱人呀”的鞋子，虽然后来自说因为“止于礼义”，未能进攻到底，但那些胡思乱想的自白，究竟是大胆的。就是诗，除论客所佩服的“悠然见南山”之外，也还有“精卫衔微木，将以填沧海，形天舞干戚，猛志固常在”之类的“金刚怒目”式，在证明着他并非整天整夜的飘飘然。这“猛志固常在”和“悠然见南山”的是一个人，倘有取舍，即非全人，再加抑扬，更离真实。譬如勇士，也战斗，也休息，也饮食，自然也性交，如果只取他末一点，画起像来，挂在妓院里，尊为性交大师，那当然也不能说是毫无根据的，然而，岂不冤哉！我每见近人的称引陶渊明，往往不禁为古人惋惜。
Naturally, if you play casually, you can choose any selection, "Anthology" is good, and "Ancient Texts and Observations" is also acceptable. However, if you want to study literature or a certain writer, the so-called "knowing people and discussing the world", then it is rare to find a selection that can be applied. What is shown in the selection is often not the author's characteristics, but the vision of the selector. The sharper the vision, the deeper and broader the knowledge, and the more accurate the selection, but unfortunately most of the eyes are like beans, and most of them erase the author's truth, which is a "literati catastrophe". For example, Cai Yong, the selector probably only took his inscriptions, so that the reader only felt that he was the author of the important article, and he must see the "Shuxing Fu" in the "Cai Zhonglang Collection" (also seen in the "Continuation of the Ancient Literary Garden"), those sentences of "poor craftsmen are skillful in the terrace, the people are exposed and wet, the good grain is given to the beasts, and the chaff is without grain" (there is no book at hand, maybe I remember it wrong, and it will be corrected later), only then do I understand that he is not just an old pedant, but also a bloody person, understand the situation at that time, and understand that he does have a way to die. Another example is Mr. Tao Qian, who was admitted to the selected family "Return to the Words" and "The Peach Blossom Spring", and was praised by commentators for "picking chrysanthemums under the east fence and leisurely seeing Nanshan", in the minds of future generations, it has been too long, but in the complete collection, he is sometimes very modern, "I am willing to wear shoes on silk, attach to the elements, and be sad and moderate, and abandon in front of the bed", and actually want to transform into the shoes of "Ah, my lover", although he later said that because of "stopping at propriety and righteousness", he failed to attack to the end, but those cranky confessions, It's bold. It is a poem, in addition to the "leisurely seeing the South Mountain" admired by the commentators, there are also "Jingwei Wei Weimu, will fill the sea, shape the sky dances with the Qi Qi, and the fierce will is always there" and other "King Kong angry eyes" style, which proves that he is not floating all day and night. He said the benefits are:“我爱这两句诗，多少是因为它对于我启示了一种哲学的意蕴。‘曲终人不见’所表现的是消逝，‘江上数峰青’所表现的是永恒。可爱的乐声和奏乐者虽然消逝了，而青山却巍然如旧，永远可以让我们把心情寄托在它上面。人到底是怕凄凉的，要求伴侣的。曲终了，人去了，我们一霎时以前所游目骋怀的世界猛然间好像从脚底倒塌去了。这是人生最难堪的一件事，但是一转眼间我们看到江上青峰，好像又找到另一个可亲的伴侣，另一个可托足的世界，而且它永远是在那里的。‘山穷水尽疑无路，柳暗花明又一村’，此种风味似之。不仅如此，人和曲果真消逝了么；这一曲缠绵悱恻的音乐没有惊动山灵？它没有传出江上青峰的妩媚和严肃？它没有深深地印在这妩媚和严肃里面？反正青山和湘灵的瑟声已发生这么一回的因缘，青山永在，瑟声和鼓瑟的人也就永在了。”
"I love these two poems somewhat because they reveal a philosophical meaning to me. ' At the end of the song, the people are gone' is expressed, and the 'several peaks on the river' is eternal. Although the lovely music and musicians are gone, the green mountains are still the same, and we can always pin our feelings on it. People are afraid of desolation and ask for a partner. The holy medicine that soothes people is "quiet" in poetry, in Mr. Zhu's words:“艺术的最高境界都不在热烈。就诗人之所以为人而论，他所感到的欢喜和愁苦也许比常人所感到的更加热烈。就诗人之所以为诗人而论，热烈的欢喜或热烈的愁苦经过诗表现出来以后，都好比黄酒经过长久年代的储藏，失去它的辣性，只剩一味醇朴。我在别的文章里曾经说过这一段话：‘懂得这个道理，我们可以明白古希腊人何以把和平静穆看作诗的极境，把诗神亚波罗摆在蔚蓝的山巅，俯瞰众生扰攘，而眉宇间却常如作甜蜜梦，不露一丝被扰动的神色？’这里所谓‘静穆’（Serenity）自然只是一种最高理想，不是在一般诗里所能找得到的。古希腊——尤其是古希腊的造形艺术——常使我们觉到这种‘静穆’的风味。‘静穆’是一种豁然大悟，得到归依的心情。它好比低眉默想的观音大士，超一切忧喜，同时你也可说它泯化一切忧喜。这种境界在中国诗里不多见。屈原阮籍李白杜甫都不免有些像金刚怒目，愤愤不平的样子。陶潜浑身是‘静穆’，所以他伟大。”
"The highest level of art is not warm. As far as the poet is concerned, the joy and sorrow he feels may be warmer than that of ordinary people. As far as the reason why a poet is a poet, after the warm joy or warm sorrow is expressed in the poem, it is like rice wine that has been stored for a long time, losing its spiciness, and only a mellow and simple thing. I have said this passage in other articles: 'Understanding this truth, we can understand why the ancient Greeks regarded peace and tranquility as the extreme realm of poetry, placing the poetic god Apollo on the top of the blue mountain, overlooking the disturbance of all living beings, but the eyebrows are often like sweet dreams, without showing a hint of disturbance?' The so-called 'Serenity' here is naturally just a supreme ideal, not found in ordinary poetry. Ancient Greece, especially the art of ancient Greece, often makes us feel this 'quiet' flavor. 'Quiet' is a feeling of sudden enlightenment and refuge. It is like Guanyin Guanyin meditating with low eyebrows, surpassing all sorrows and joys, and at the same time, you can also say that it extinguishes all sorrows and joys. Tao Qian is 'quiet', so he is great. ”古希腊人，也许把和平静穆看作诗的极境的罢，这一点我毫无知识。但以现存的希腊诗歌而论，荷马的史诗，是雄大而活泼的，沙孚的恋歌，是明白而热烈的，都不静穆。我想，立“静穆”为诗的极境，而此境不见于诗，也许和立蛋形为人体的最高形式，而此形终不见于人一样。至于亚波罗之在山巅，那可因为他是“神”的缘故，无论古今，凡神像，总是放在较高之处的。这像，我曾见过照相，睁着眼睛，神清气爽，并不像“常如作甜蜜梦”。不过看见实物，是否“使我们觉到这种‘静穆’的风味”，在我可就很难断定了，但是，倘使真的觉得，我以为也许有些因为他“古”的缘故。
The ancient Greeks may have regarded peace and tranquility as the extreme state of poetry, but I have no knowledge of this. I think that "tranquility" is the extreme state of poetry, and this state is not found in poetry, perhaps just as the egg shape is the highest form of the human body, and this form is never seen in people. As for Apollo on the top of the mountain, it is because he is a "god", no matter ancient or modern, all god statues are always placed in a higher place. This is like I have seen a photo, with my eyes open and refreshed, not like "always like a sweet dream". I am also a person who often wanders between elegance and vulgarity, and at this moment, it is very close to the scenery, but sometimes I think I am quite "elegant": sometimes I like to look at antiques. This revelation is not a "philosophical meaning", but a feeling that this is the Zhou Ding who sees close to the truth. The tripod was in the Zhou Dynasty, just like the bowl in modern times, our bowl, there is no reason not to wash it all year round, so the tripod must have been clean and golden at that time, in other words, it was not "quiet", but a little "warm". One of the reasons is that it has been buried in the soil, or has been weathered for a long time, losing its edge and luster, and at the time of carving, it must have been new, snow-white, and shining, so the beauty of Greece we see now is actually not the so-called beauty of the Greeks at that time, and we should think that it is a new thing.凡论文艺，虚悬了一个“极境”，是要陷入“绝境”的，在艺术，会迷惘于土花，在文学，则被拘迫而“摘句”。但“摘句”又大足以困人，所以朱先生就只能取钱起的两句，而踢开他的全篇，又用这两句来概括作者的全人，又用这两句来打杀了屈原，阮籍，李白，杜甫等辈，以为“都不免有些像金刚怒目，愤愤不平的样子”。其实是他们四位，都因为垫高朱先生的美学说，做了冤屈的牺牲的。

“前见吾弟选《明诗存》，有一字不似钟谭者，必弃置不取；今几社诸君子盛称王李，痛骂钟谭，而吾弟选法又与前一变，有一字似钟谭者，必弃置不取。 钟谭之诗集，仍此诗集，吾弟手眼，仍此手眼，而乃转若飞蓬，捷如影响，何胸无定识，目无定见，口无定评，乃至斯极耶？盖吾弟喜钟谭时，有钟谭之好处，尽有钟谭之不好处，彼盖玉常带璞，原不该尽视为连城；吾弟恨钟谭时，有钟谭之不好处，仍有钟谭之好处，彼盖瑕不掩瑜，更不可尽弃为瓦砾。 吾弟勿以几社君子之言，横据胸中，虚心平气，细细论之，则其妍丑自见，奈何以他人好尚为好尚哉！……”这是分明的画出随风转舵的选家的面目，也指证了选本的难以凭信的。张岱自己，则以为选文造史，须无自己的意见，他在《与李砚翁》的信里说：“弟《石匮》一书，泚笔四十余载，心如止水秦铜，并不自立意见，故下笔描绘，妍媸自见，敢言刻划，亦就物肖形而已。……”然而心究非镜，也不能虚，所以立“虚心平气”为选诗的极境，“并不自立意见”为作史的极境者，也像立“静穆”为诗的极境一样，在事实上不可得。数年前的文坛上所谓“第三种人”杜衡辈，标榜超然，实为群丑，不久即本相毕露，知耻者皆羞称之，无待这里多说了；就令自觉不怀他意，屹然中立如张岱者，其实也还是偏倚的。他在同一信中，论东林云：

A few years ago, the so-called "third kind of people" in the literary world, Du Heng and his generation, flaunted themselves as transcendent, but they were actually ugly, and soon their true nature was revealed, and those who knew shame were ashamed to call it, so there was no need to say more here; Even if he feels that he has no ulterior motives and stands neutral like Zhang Dai, he is actually still biased. In the same letter, he said of Donglin:“……夫东林自顾泾阳讲学以来，以此名目，祸我国家者八九十年，以其党升沉，用占世数兴败，其党盛则为终南之捷径，其党败则为元祐之党碑。……盖东林首事者实多君子，窜入者不无小人，拥戴者皆为小人，招徕者亦有君子，此其间线索甚清，门户甚迥。……东林之中，其庸庸碌碌者不必置论，如贪婪强横之王图，奸险凶暴之李三才，闯贼首辅之项煜，上笺劝进之周钟，以致窜入东林，乃欲俱奉之以君子，则吾臂可断，决不敢徇情也。东林之尤可丑者，时敏之降闯贼曰，‘吾东林时敏也’，以冀大用。鲁王监国，蕞尔小朝廷，科道任孔当辈犹曰，‘非东林不可进用’。则是东林二字，直与蕞尔鲁国及汝偕亡者。手刃此辈，置之汤镬，出薪真不可不猛也。……”
“…… 夫东林自顾泾阳讲学以来，以此名目，祸我国家者八九十年，以其党升沉，用占世数兴败，其党盛则为终南之捷径，其党败则为元祐之党碑。 …… 盖东林首事者实多君子，窜入者不无小人，拥戴者皆为小人，招徕者亦有君子，此其间线索甚清，门户甚迥。 …… 东林之中，其庸庸碌碌者不必置论，如贪婪强横之王图，奸险凶暴之李三才，闯贼首辅之项煜，上笺劝进之周钟，以致窜入东林，乃欲俱奉之以君子，则吾臂可断，决不敢徇情也。 东林之尤可丑者，时敏之降闯贼曰，‘吾东林时敏也’，以冀大用。 鲁王监国，蕞尔小朝廷，科道任孔当辈犹曰，‘非东林不可进用’。 则是东林二字，直与蕞尔鲁国及汝偕亡者。 手刃此辈，置之汤镬，出薪真不可不猛也。 ……”这真可谓“词严义正”。所举的群小，也都确实的，尤其是时敏，虽在三百年后，也何尝无此等人，真令人惊心动魄。然而他的严责东林，是因为东林党中也有小人，古今来无纯一不杂的君子群，于是凡有党社，必为自谓中立者所不满，就大体而言，是好人多还是坏人多，他就置之不论了。或者还更加一转云：东林虽多君子，然亦有小人，反东林者虽多小人，然亦有正士，于是好像两面都有好有坏，并无不同，但因东林世称君子，故有小人即可丑，反东林者本为小人，故有正士则可嘉，苛求君子，宽纵小人，自以为明察秋毫，而实则反助小人张目。倘说：东林中虽亦有小人，然多数为君子，反东林者虽亦有正士，而大抵是小人。那么，斤量就大不相同了。
This can really be described as "strict and righteous". The group of small people mentioned is also true, especially Shi Min, although three hundred years later, there are no such people, which is really thrilling. However, his severe reprimand of Donglin is because there are also villains in the Donglin Party, and there is no pure and unmixed group of gentlemen in ancient and modern times, so wherever there is a party society, it must be dissatisfied with those who claim to be neutral. Or it is even more twisted: Although there are many gentlemen in Donglin, there are also villains, although there are many villains who oppose Donglin, but there are also righteous people, so it seems that there are good and bad on both sides, and there is no difference, but because Donglin is called a gentleman in the world, there are villains can be ugly, and those who oppose Donglin are originally villains, so there are righteous people who are commendable. If you say: Although there are villains in Donglin, most of them are gentlemen, and although there are righteous people who oppose Donglin, most of them are villains. Then, the weight of the pound is very different.谢国桢先生作《明清之际党社运动考》，钩索文籍，用力甚勤，叙魏忠贤两次虐杀东林党人毕，说道：“那时候，亲戚朋友，全远远的躲避，无耻的士大夫，早投降到魏党的旗帜底下了。说一两句公道话，想替诸君子帮忙的，只有几个书呆子，还有几个老百姓。”
Mr. Xie Guozhen wrote "Examination of the Party and Social Movement in the Ming and Qing Dynasties", hooked up the literature, worked very hard, and recounted Wei Zhongxian's two abuses of Donglin Party members, saying: "At that time, relatives and friends, all avoided from a distance, and the shameless scholar-officials had already surrendered under the banner of the Wei Party. To say a word or two fairly, there are only a few nerds and a few ordinary people who want to help the gentlemen. ”这说的是魏忠贤使缇骑捕周顺昌，被苏州人民击散的事。诚然，老百姓虽然不读诗书，不明史法，不解在瑜中求瑕，屎里觅道，但能从大概上看，明黑白，辨是非，往往有决非清高通达的士大夫所可几及之处的。刚刚接到本日的《大美晚报》，有“北平特约通讯”，记学生游行，被警察水龙喷射，棍击刀砍，一部分则被闭于城外，使受冻馁，“此时燕冀中学师大附中及附近居民纷纷组织慰劳队，送水烧饼馒头等食物，学生略解饥肠……”谁说中国的老百姓是庸愚的呢，被愚弄诓骗压迫到现在，还明白如此。张岱又说：“忠臣义士多见于国破家亡之际，如敲石出火，一闪即灭，人主不急起收之，则火种绝矣。”（《越绝诗小序》）他所指的“人主”是明太祖，和现在的情景不相符。
This is about Wei Zhongxian envoying Tiqi to capture Zhou Shunchang, who was scattered by the people of Suzhou. It is true that although the common people do not read poetry and books, do not know the historical law, and do not know how to seek flaws in Yu and find the way in, they can see from a general point of view, distinguish between black and white, and distinguish right from wrong, which is often beyond the reach of scholars and officials. At this time, the High School Affiliated to Yanji Middle School and nearby residents have organized comfort teams to send water cakes, steamed buns and other food, and the students have relieved their hunger a little...... "Who said that the Chinese people are mediocre and foolish, and they have been fooled and oppressed until now, and they still understand this." Zhang Dai also said: "Loyal ministers and righteous men are often seen when the country is destroyed and the family is destroyed, such as knocking on a stone and making a fire, which is extinguished in a flash, and the owner does not rush to collect it, then the fire will be extinguished." The "lord" he refers to is Ming Taizu, which is inconsistent with the current situation.石在，火种是不会绝的。但我要重申九年前的主张：不要再请愿！
The stone is there, and the fire will not be extinguished. But I want to reiterate the idea of nine years ago: no more petitions!十二月十八——十九夜。
December 18-19 night.

论新文字

论新文字

论新文字

On the new text汉字拉丁化的方法一出世，方块字系的简笔字和注音字母，都赛下去了，还在竞争的只有罗马字拼音。这拼法的保守者用来打击拉丁化字的最大的理由，是说它方法太简单，有许多字很不容易分别。
As soon as the method of Latinization of Chinese characters was born, the stick figures and phonetic letters of the square character system were all competing, and only Roman pinyin was still competing. The biggest reason why conservatives of this spelling use it to combat Latinized words is that it is too simple and many words are not easy to distinguish.这确是一个缺点。凡文字，倘若容易学，容易写，常常是未必精密的。烦难的文字，固然不见得一定就精密，但要精密，却总不免比较的烦难。罗马字拼音能显四声，拉丁化字不能显，所以没有“东”“董”之分，然而方块字能显“东”“”之分，罗马字拼音却也不能显。单拿能否细别一两个字来定新文字的优劣，是并不确当的。况且文字一用于组成文章，那意义就会明显。虽是方块字，倘若单取一两个字，也往往难以确切的定出它的意义来。例如“日者”这两个字，如果只是这两个字，我们可以作“太阳这东西”解，可以作“近几天”解，也可以作“占卜吉凶的人”解；又如“果然”，大抵是“竟是”的意思，然而又是一种动物的名目，也可以作隆起的形容；就是一个“一”字，在孤立的时候，也不能决定它是数字“一二三”之“一”呢，还是动词“四海一”之“一”。不过组织在句子里，这疑难就消失了。所以取拉丁化的一两个字，说它含胡，并不是正当的指摘。
This is indeed a disadvantage. All words, if they are easy to learn and easy to write, are often not necessarily precise. Difficult words are not necessarily precise, but if they want to be precise, they will always be more troublesome. Romanization can show four tones, and Latinized characters cannot be displayed, so there is no distinction between "Dong" and "Dong", but square characters can show the distinction of "Dong" and "", but Romanization Pinyin cannot be displayed. It is not accurate to determine the merits and demerits of a new character by distinguishing one or two words alone. Moreover, once the text is used to form an article, the meaning will be obvious. Although it is a square word, if you take one or two words alone, it is often difficult to determine its meaning exactly. For example, the word "day", if it is only these two words, we can interpret it as "the sun", "recent days", or "divination of good and bad fortune"; Another example is "sure enough", which probably means "actually is", but it is also the name of an animal, which can also be described as bulging; It is a word "one", and when isolated, it cannot be determined whether it is the "one" of the number "one, two, three", or the "one" of the verb "one of the four seas". But when organized in a sentence, this difficulty disappears. Therefore, taking one or two Latinized words and saying that it contains a beard is not a legitimate accusation.主张罗马字拼音和拉丁化者两派的争执，其实并不在精密和粗疏，却在那由来，也就是目的。罗马字拼音者是以古来的方块字为主，翻成罗马字，使大家都来照这规矩写，拉丁化者却以现在的方言为主，翻成拉丁字，这就是规矩。假使翻一部《诗韵》来作比赛，后者是赛不过的，然而要写出活人的口语来，倒轻而易举。这一点，就可以补它的不精密的缺点而有余了，何况后来还可以凭着实验，逐渐补正呢。
The dispute between the two schools of arguing Romanization and Latinizers is not actually precise and rough, but where it originates, that is, the purpose. Romanization is based on ancient square characters, translated into Roman characters, so that everyone can write according to this rule, but Latinizers mainly use the current dialect and translate it into Latin characters, which is the rule. If a "Poetry Rhyme" is turned into a competition, the latter cannot compete, but it is easy to write the spoken language of a living person. This can more than make up for its imprecise shortcomings, not to mention that it can be gradually corrected by experiments later.易举和难行是改革者的两大派。同是不满于现状，但打破现状的手段却大不同：一是革新，一是复古。同是革新，那手段也大不同：一是难行，一是易举。这两者有斗争。难行者的好幌子，一定是完全和精密，借此来阻碍易举者的进行，然而它本身，却因为是虚悬的计划，结果总并无成就：就是不行。
Easy and difficult are the two major factions of reformers. They are both dissatisfied with the status quo, but the means to break the status quo are very different: one is innovation, the other is retro. The same is innovation, but the means are also very different: one is difficult to do, the other is easy to do. There is a struggle between the two. The good guise of the difficult person must be complete and sophisticated, so as to hinder the progress of the easy one, but itself, because it is a false plan, the result is always nothing: it just can't work.这不行，可又正是难行的改革者的慰藉，因为它虽无改革之实，却有改革之名。有些改革者，是极爱谈改革的，但真的改革到了身边，却使他恐惧。惟有大谈难行的改革，这才可以阻止易举的改革的到来，就是竭力维持着现状，一面大谈其改革，算是在做他那完全的改革的事业。这和主张在床上学会了浮水，然后再去游泳的方法，其实是一样的。
This is not good, but it is the comfort of difficult reformers, because although it has no reform, it has the name of reform. Some reformers love to talk about reform, but when they really reform around them, they are afraid. Only by talking about reforms that are difficult to implement can we prevent the arrival of easy reforms, that is, trying to maintain the status quo and talking about its reforms while doing our best to do his complete reform cause. This is actually the same as advocating learning to float in bed and then swimming.拉丁化却没有这空谈的弊病，说得出，就写得来，它和民众是有联系的，不是研究室或书斋里的清玩，是街头巷尾的东西；它和旧文字的关系轻，但和人民的联系密，倘要大家能够发表自己的意见，收获切要的知识，除它以外，确没有更简易的文字了。
Latinization does not have the disadvantages of empty talk, it can be said, it can be written, it is connected with the people, not a play in the laboratory or study, but a thing in the streets and alleys; It has little to do with the old script, but it is closely connected with the people, and if everyone can express their opinions and gain important knowledge, there is indeed no simpler script besides it.而且由只识拉丁化字的人们写起创作来，才是中国文学的新生，才是现代中国的新文学，因为他们是没有中一点什么《庄子》和《文选》之类的毒的。
Moreover, it is the new life of Chinese literature and the new literature of modern China that is written and created by people who only know Latinized characters, because they do not have any poison such as "Zhuangzi" and "Anthology".十二月二十三日。
December 23.

《死魂灵百图》小引

《死魂灵百图》小引

《死魂灵百图》小引

A small introduction to "The Hundred Pictures of Dead Souls"果戈理开手作《死魂灵》第一部的时候，是一八三五年的下半年，离现在足有一百年了。幸而，还是不幸呢，其中的许多人物，到现在还很有生气，使我们不同国度，不同时代的读者，也觉得仿佛写着自己的周围，不得不叹服他伟大的写实的本领。不过那时的风尚，却究竟有了变迁，例如男子的衣服，和现在虽然小异大同，而闺秀们的高髻圆裙，则已经少见；那时的时髦的车子，并非流线形的摩托卡，却是三匹马拉的篷车，照着跳舞夜会的所谓眩眼的光辉，也不是电灯，只不过许多插在多臂烛台上的蜡烛：凡这些，倘使没有图画，是很难想像清楚的。
When Gogol started the first part of "Dead Souls", it was in the second half of 1835, a hundred years from now. Fortunately, or unfortunately, many of these characters are still very lively, so that readers from different countries and eras also feel as if they are writing about their surroundings, and have to admire his great realism ability. However, the fashion at that time has changed, for example, although men's clothes are slightly different from now, and the high updo and round skirts of ladies are rare; The fashionable cars of that time were not streamlined motorcycles, but three-horse wagons, illuminating the so-called dazzling brilliance of dancing soirées, nor electric lights, but many candles inserted in multi-armed candlesticks: all of this, without pictures, is difficult to imagine.关于《死魂灵》的有名的图画，据里斯珂夫说，一共有三种，而最正确和完备的是阿庚的百图。这图画先有七十二幅，未详何年出版，但总在一八四七年之前，去现在也快要九十年；后来即成为难得之品，新近苏联出版的《文学辞典》里，曾采它为插画，可见已经是有了定评的文献了。虽在它的本国，恐怕也只能在图书馆中相遇，更何况在我们中国。今年秋末，孟十还君忽然在上海的旧书店里看到了这画集，便像孩子望见了糖果似的，立刻奔走呼号，总算弄到手里了，是一八九三年印的第四版，不但百图完备，还增加了收藏家蔼甫列摩夫所藏的三幅，并那时的广告画和第一版封纸上的小图各一幅，共计一百零五图。
Regarding the famous drawings of "Dead Souls", according to Riskov, there are three types, and the most correct and complete is Ah Geng's Hundred Drawings. There were seventy-two of these paintings, and it is unknown when they were published, but they were all before 1847, almost ninety years ago; Later, it became a rare product, and in the "Literary Dictionary" published in the new Soviet Union, it was used as an illustration, which shows that it has already been evaluated. Although in its own country, I am afraid that it can only be met in the library, let alone in China. At the end of the autumn of this year, Meng Shihuanjun suddenly saw this collection of paintings in a second-hand bookstore in Shanghai, and immediately ran to the call sign like a child seeing candy, and finally got it in his hand, which was the fourth edition printed in 1893, not only complete with 100 pictures, but also added three paintings collected by the collector Aifuremov, and one each of the advertising paintings at that time and the small pictures on the cover of the first edition, a total of one hundred and five pictures.这大约是十月革命之际，俄国人带了逃出国外来的；他该是一个爱好文艺的人，抱守了十六年，终于只好拿它来换衣食之资；在中国，也许未必有第二本。藏了起来，对己对人，说不定都是一种罪业，所以现在就设法来翻印这一本书，除绍介外国的艺术之外，第一，是在献给中国的研究文学，或爱好文学者，可以和小说相辅，所谓“左图右史”，更明白十九世纪上半的俄国中流社会的情形，第二，则想献给插画家，借此看看别国的写实的典型，知道和中国向来的“出相”或“绣像”有怎样的不同，或者能有可以取法之处；同时也以慰售出这本画集的人，将他的原本化为千万，广布于世，实足偿其损失而有余，一面也庶几不枉孟十还君的一番奔走呼号之苦。对于木刻家，却恐怕并无大益，因为这虽说是木刻，但画者一人，刻者又别一人，和现在的自画自刻，刻即是画的创作木刻，是已经大有差别的了。
This was around the time of the October Revolution, when the Russians fled abroad; He should be a lover of literature and art, and after sixteen years, he finally had to use it in exchange for food and clothing; In China, there may not be a second book. Hide it, to yourself and others, it may be a kind of sin, so now try to reprint this book, in addition to the introduction of foreign art, first, it is dedicated to Chinese research literature, or literature lovers, can complement the novel, the so-called "left picture and right history", better understand the situation of Russian middle society in the first half of the nineteenth century, second, I want to dedicate it to illustrators, so as to see the realistic models of other countries, know how it is different from the "appearance" or "embroidery of images" that have always been in China, or can have a way to learn from it; At the same time, it is also to comfort the person who sold this collection of paintings, and his original was turned into tens of millions and widely distributed in the world, which is more than enough to compensate for his losses, and on the other hand, it is almost not in vain for Meng Shi to return to the king. For woodcarvers, I am afraid it is not of great benefit, because although this is a woodcut, there is one painter, and the engraver is another, which is very different from the current self-painting and self-carving, and the carving is the creation of woodcuts.世间也真有意外的运气。当中文译本的《死魂灵》开始发表时，曹靖华君就寄给我一卷图画，也还是十月革命后不多久，在彼得堡得到的。这正是里斯珂夫所说的梭可罗夫画的十二幅。纸张虽然颇为破碎，但图像并无大损，怕它由我而亡，现在就附印在阿庚的百图之后，于是俄国艺术家所作的最写实，而且可以互相补助的两种《死魂灵》的插画，就全收在我们的这一本集子里了。
There is really unexpected luck in the world. When the Chinese translation of "Dead Souls" began to be published, Cao Jinghuajun sent me a volume of drawings, which I got in Petersburg not long after the October Revolution. These are exactly the twelve paintings of Sokorov that Rykov said. Although the paper is quite broken, the image is not badly damaged, and I am afraid that it will die from me, so it is now printed after Ah Geng's hundred drawings, so the two most realistic illustrations of "Dead Souls" made by Russian artists and can complement each other are all included in our collection.移译序文和每图的题句的，也是孟十还君的劳作；题句大概依照译本，但有数处不同，现在也不改从一律；最末一图的题句，不见于第一部中，疑是第二部记乞乞科夫免罪以后的事，这是那时俄国文艺家的习尚：总喜欢带点教训的。至于校印装制，则是吴朗西君和另外几位朋友们所经营。这都应该在这里声明谢意。
the translation of the preface and the inscription of each picture is also the work of Meng Shihuanjun; The inscription is probably according to the translation, but there are several differences, and it is not the same now; The inscription of the last picture is not found in the first part, and it is suspected that the second part records the events after Chichikov was acquitted, which was the habit of Russian writers and artists at that time: they always liked to teach a lesson. As for the proofreading and binding system, it is run by Wu Langxijun and several other friends. This should all be a thank you here.一九三五年十二月二十四日，鲁迅。
December 24, 1935, Lu Xun.

后记

后记

后记

postscript这一本的编辑的体例，是和前一本相同的，也是按照着写作的时候。凡在刊物上发表之作，上半年也都经过官厅的检查，大约总不免有些删削，不过我懒于一一校对，加上黑点为记了。只要看过前一本，就可以明白犯官忌的是那些话。
The editing style of this book is the same as the previous one, and it is also written according to the time of writing. All works published in publications have also been inspected by the government office in the first half of the year, and there will be some deletions, but I am too lazy to proofread them one by one, and add black dots as a note. As long as you have read the previous book, you can understand what the officials are taboo about.被全篇禁止的有两篇：一篇是《什么是讽刺》，为文学社的《文学百题》而作，印出来时，变了一个“缺”字；一篇是《从帮忙到扯淡》，为《文学论坛》而作，至今无踪无影，连“缺”字也没有了。
There are two articles that are banned in their entirety: one is "What is Satire", written for the Literary Society's "100 Literary Questions", and when it was printed, it changed to a "lacking" word; The other is "From Help to Nonsense", written for "Literary Forum", which has not yet been traced, and even the word "lacking" is gone.为了写作者和检查者的关系，使我间接的知道了检查官，有时颇为佩服。他们的嗅觉是很灵敏的。我那一篇《从帮忙到扯淡》，原在指那些唱导什么儿童年，妇女年，读经救国，敬老正俗，中国本位文化，第三种人文艺等等的一大批政客豪商，文人学士，从已经不会帮忙，只能扯淡这方面看起来，确也应该禁止的，因为实在看得太明，说得太透。别人大约也和我一样的佩服，所以早有文学家做了检查官的风传，致使苏汶先生在一九三四年十二月七日的《大晚报》上发表了这样的公开信：
For the sake of the relationship between the writer and the inspector, I indirectly got to know the prosecutor, and sometimes I admired it. Their sense of smell is very sensitive. My article "From Help to Nonsense" originally refers to a large number of politicians, wealthy businessmen, literati and scholars who sing about children's years, women's years, reading scriptures to save the country, respecting the elderly and customs, Chinese-based culture, the third kind of humanities and art, etc., and have never been able to help, but can only talk nonsense in this regard, and it should indeed be banned, because it is really too clear and too thorough. Others probably admired me as much as I did, so there were rumors that writers had become prosecutors, which led Mr. Su Wen to publish this open letter in the "Evening News" on December 7, 1934:“《火炬》编辑先生大鉴：
"Torch" Editor Mr. Dajian:顷读本月四日贵刊‘文学评论’专号，载署名闻问君的《文学杂谈》一文，中有——
I recently read the special issue of your magazine 'Literary Review' on the 4th of this month, which contains an article signed by Wen Wenjun "Literary Miscellaneous Talks", which contains -
‘据道路传闻苏汶先生有以七十元一月之薪金弹冠入××（照录原文）会消息，可知文艺虽不受时空限制，却颇受“大洋”限制了。’
According to rumors on the road, Mr. Su Wen entered the ×× meeting with a salary of 70 yuan a month, which shows that although literature and art are not limited by time and space, they are quite limited by the "ocean". ’

等语，闻之不胜愤慨。汶于近数年来，绝未加入任何会工作，并除以编辑《现代杂志》及卖稿糊口外，亦未受任何组织之分文薪金。所谓入××会云云，虽经×报谣传，均以一笑置之，不料素以态度公允见称之贵刊，亦复信此谰言，披诸报端，则殊有令人不能已于言者。汶为爱护贵刊起见，用特申函奉达，尚祈将原书赐登最近贵刊，以明真相是幸。
and so on, and I was indignant when I heard it. In recent years, Wen has never joined any association, and apart from editing Modern Magazine and selling manuscripts for a living, he has not received a penny from any organization. The so-called entry into the ×× meeting, even if it has been passed × newspapers and rumors, is laughed at, but it is not expected that the noble publication, which has always been praised for its fair attitude, also believes this rumor, and when it is published in the newspaper, it is very unbearable to say it. For the sake of caring for your publication, I would like to send you a special letter to convey your request, and I hope that the original book will be published in the most recent noble journal to clarify the truth.专此敬颂
专此敬颂编安。
编安。
苏汶（杜衡）谨上。十二月五日。”
苏汶（杜衡）谨上。 十二月五日。 ”一来就说作者得了不正当的钱是近来文坛上的老例，我被人传说拿着卢布就有四五年之久，直到九一八以后，这才将卢布说取消，换上了“亲日”的更加新鲜的罪状。我是一向不“为爱护贵刊起见”的，所以从不寄一封辨正信。不料越来越滥，竟谣到苏汶先生头上去了，可见谣言多的地方，也是“有一利必有一弊”。但由我的经验说起来，检查官之“爱护”“第三种人”，却似乎是真的，我去年所写的文章，有两篇冒犯了他们，一篇被删掉（《病后杂谈之余》），一篇被禁止（《脸谱臆测》）了。也许还有类于这些的事，所以令人猜为“入××（照录原文）会”了罢。这真应该“不胜愤慨”，没有受惯奚落的作家，是无怪其然的。
It is said that I have been holding the ruble for four or five years, and it was not until after 918 that the ruble was canceled and replaced with a fresher charge of "pro-Japanese". I have never "for the sake of caring for your publication", so I never send a letter of correction. Unexpectedly, it became more and more indiscriminate, and the rumors actually reached Mr. Su Wen's head, which shows that where there are many rumors, it is also "there must be a benefit and a disadvantage". But from my experience, the "love" and "third kind of people" of the prosecutors seem to be true, and two of the articles I wrote last year offended them, one was deleted ("After Illness"), and one was banned ("Facebook Speculation"). Maybe there are things like these, so people guess that it is "entering the ×× (copying the original text) meeting". This should really be "indignant", and it is no wonder that there are no writers who are used to being ridiculed.然而在对于真的造谣，毫不为怪的社会里，对于真的收贿，也就毫不为怪。如果收贿会受制裁的社会，也就要制裁妄造收贿的谣言的人们。所以用造谣来伤害作家的期刊，它只能作报销，在实际上很少功效。
However, in a society where it is not surprising to spread rumors for real rumors, it is not surprising to accept bribes. If a society is sanctioned for accepting bribes, it must also sanction people who spread rumors about accepting bribes. Therefore, journals that use rumors to hurt writers can only be reimbursed, and in fact have little effect.
其中的四篇，原是用日本文写的，现在自己译出，并且对于中国的读者，还有应该说明的地方——
Four of them were originally written in Japanese, but now they have been translated by themselves, and for Chinese readers, there are still things that should be explained -一，《活中国的姿态》的序文里，我在对于“支那通”加以讥刺，且说明日本人的喜欢结论，语意之间好像笑着他们的粗疏。然而这脾气是也有长处的，他们的急于寻求结论，是因为急于实行的缘故，我们不应该笑一笑就完。
First, in the preface to "The Posture of Living China", I ridicule "Chinatong" and explain that the Japanese like to conclude, and the semantics seem to laugh at their roughness. However, this temper also has its strengths, and their eagerness to seek conclusions is because they are eager to implement it, and we should not just smile and finish.二，《在现代中国的孔夫子》是在六月号的《改造》杂志上发表的，这时我们的“圣裔”，正在东京拜他们的祖宗，兴高采烈。曾由亦光君译出，载于《杂文》杂志第二号（七月），现在略加改定，转录在这里。
Second, "Confucius in Modern China" was published in the June issue of "Transformation" magazine, at which time our "holy descendants" were worshiping their ancestors in Tokyo, elated. Translated by Yi Guangjun, published in the second issue of "Miscellaneous Literature" magazine (July), now slightly revised, transcribed here.三，在《中国小说史略》日译本的序文里，我声明了我的高兴，但还有一种原因却未曾说出，是经十年之久，我竟报复了我个人的私仇。当一九二六年时，陈源即西滢教授，曾在北京公开对于我的人身攻击，说我的这一部著作，是窃取盐谷温教授的《支那文学概论讲话》里面的“小说”一部分的；《闲话》里的所谓“整大本的剽窃”，指的也是我。现在盐谷教授的书早有中译，我的也有了日译，两国的读者，有目共见，有谁指出我的“剽窃”来呢？呜呼，“男盗女娼”，是人间大可耻事，我负了十年“剽窃”的恶名，现在总算可以卸下，并且将“谎狗”的旗子，回敬自称“正人君子”的陈源教授，倘他无法洗刷，就只好插着生活，一直带进坟墓里去了。
Third, in the preface to the Japanese translation of "A Brief History of Chinese Novels", I declared my happiness, but there was another reason that I had not said, that after ten years, I actually took revenge on my personal personal vendetta. In 1926, Chen Yuan, Professor Xi Ying, publicly attacked me in Beijing, saying that my work was a part of the "novel" in Professor Shioya Wen's "Speech on Introduction to Chinese Literature"; The so-called "plagiarism of the whole book" in "Gossip" also refers to me. Now Professor Shioya's book has been translated into Chinese, and mine has also been translated into Japanese. Alas, "male thief and female prostitute" is a great shame in the world, I have borne the notoriety of "plagiarism" for ten years, and now I can finally take it off, and return the flag of "lying dog" to Professor Chen Yuan, who calls himself a "righteous gentleman", if he can't wash it away, he has to insert his life and bring it all the way to the grave.四，《关于陀思妥夫斯基的事》是应三笠书房之托而作的，是写给读者看的绍介文，但我在这里，说明着被压迫者对于压迫者，不是奴隶，就是敌人，决不能成为朋友，所以彼此的道德，并不相同。
Fourth, "About Dostovsky" was written at the request of Mikasa Shobo, and it is a summary text written for readers, but here I explain that the oppressed must not be friends with the oppressors, either slaves or enemies, so their morals are not the same.
临末我还要记念田诚一君，他是内山书店的店员，很爱绘画，我的三回德俄木刻展览会，都是他独自布置的；一二八的时候，则由他送我和我的家属，以及别的一批妇孺逃入英租界。三三年七月，以病在故乡去世，立在他的墓前的是我手写的碑铭。虽在现在，一想到那时只是当作有趣的记载着我的被打被杀的新闻，以及为了八十块钱，令我往返数次，终于不给的书店，我对于他，还是十分感愧的。
At the end of my life, I would also like to remember  Tian Seiichi, he was a clerk at Uchiyama Bookstore, he loved painting, and his three German-Russian woodcut exhibitions were arranged by him alone; In 128, he sent me, my family, and a group of other women and children to flee into the British Concession. In July of the third year, he died of illness in his hometown, and in front of his tomb was my handwritten inscription. Although now, when I think of the news that I was beaten and killed as just an interesting record at that time, and the bookstore that made me go back and forth several times for eighty dollars, but finally didn't give it, I am still very ashamed of him.
近两年来，又时有前进的青年，好意的可惜我现在不大写文学，并声明他们的失望。我的只能令青年失望，是无可置辩的，但也有一点误解。今天我自己查勘了一下：我从在《新青年》上写《随感录》起，到写这集子里的最末一篇止，共历十八年，单是杂感，约有八十万字。后九年中的所写，比前九年多两倍；而这后九年中，近三年所写的字数，等于前六年，那么，所谓“现在不大写文章”，其实也并非确切的核算。而且这些前进的青年，似乎谁都没有注意到现在的对于言论的迫压，也很是令人觉得诧异的。我以为要论作家的作品，必须兼想到周围的情形。In the past two years, there have been young people who have moved forward from time to time, and it is a pity that I do not write literature now, and declare their disappointment. My can only disappoint young people, which is undeniable, but there is also a little misunderstanding. Today I checked it myself: from writing "Sui Sensation" in "New Youth" to writing the last article in this collection, it took a total of eighteen years, and there were about 800,000 words of miscellaneous feelings alone. the last nine years were written twice as much as the first nine years; In the next nine years, the number of words written in the past three years is equal to the previous six years, so the so-called "don't write articles now" is actually not an accurate accounting. Moreover, none of these forward-looking young people seem to have noticed the current suppression of speech, which is also very surprising. I thought that if we want to talk about a writer's work, we must also consider the surrounding situation.自然，这情形是极不容易明了的，因为倘一公开，作家要怕受难，书店就要防封门，然而如果自己和出版界有些相关，便可以感觉到这里面的一部份消息。现在我们先来回忆一下已往的公开的事情。也许还有读者记得，中华民国二十三年（一九三四年）三月十四日的《大美晚报》上，曾经登有一则这样的新闻——
Naturally, this situation is extremely difficult to understand, because if it is made public, the writer will be afraid of suffering, and the bookstore will have to prevent closing its doors, but if you have something to do with the publishing world, you can feel part of the news. Now let's recall the past public events. Some readers may remember that in the "Great American Evening News" on March 14, the 23rd year of the Republic of China (1934), there was such a news -中央党部禁止新文艺作品
The Central Party Department banned new literary and artistic works
沪市党部于上月十九日奉中央党部电令、派员挨户至各新书店、查禁书籍至百四十九种之多、牵涉书店二十五家、其中有曾经市党部审查准予发行、或内政部登记取得著作权、且有各作者之前期作品、如丁玲之《在黑暗中》等甚多、致引起上海出版业之恐慌、由新书业组织之中国著作人出版人联合会集议，于二月二十五日推举代表向市党部请愿结果、蒙市党部俯允转呈中央、将各书重行审查、从轻发落、同日接中央复电、允予照准、惟各书店于复审期内、须将被禁各书、一律自动封存、不再发卖、兹将各书店被禁书目、分录如次、
On the 19th of last month, the Shanghai Municipal Party Department was ordered by the Central Party Department to send personnel to various new bookstores door-to-door, banning as many as 149 kinds of books, involving 25 bookstores, among which the Municipal Party Department had reviewed and approved the publication, or the Ministry of the Interior registered and obtained copyrights, and there were many previous works of various authors, such as Ding Ling's "In the Dark", which caused panic in the Shanghai publishing industry. The books will be re-examined, sent lightly, received the central reply on the same day, and allowed to be approved, but during the review period, each bookstore must automatically seal all the banned books and no longer sell them.

出版界不过是借书籍以贸利的人们，只问销路，不管内容，存心“反动”的是很少的，所以这请愿颇有了好结果，为“体恤商艰”起见，竟解禁了三十七种，应加删改，才准发行的是二十二种，其余的还是“禁止”和“暂缓发售”。这中央的批答和改定的书目，见于《出版消息》第三十三期（四月一日出版）——
The publishing industry is just people who use books to make profits, only asking about sales, regardless of the content, and there are very few who are "reactionary", so this petition has a good result, and for the sake of "sympathy for the difficulties of business", 37 kinds have been lifted, and 22 types should be deleted and corrected, so that 22 types are allowed to be distributed, and the rest are still "banned" and "suspended sale". The central government's reply and revised bibliography can be found in the thirty-third issue of "Publishing News" (published on April 1) -中国国民党上海特别市执行委员会批答执字第一五九二号
The Executive Committee of the Shanghai Special Municipality of the Kuomintang of China approved the No. 1592
（呈为奉令禁毁大宗刊物附奉说明书恳请转函中宣会重行审核从轻处置以恤商艰由）
(Submitted as an order to prohibit the destruction of bulk publications, with an instruction manual, I earnestly request that it be forwarded to the Central Propaganda Commission for re-examination and lenient disposal to alleviate the difficulties of business)
呈件均悉查此案业准
The submissions are all based on the facts of this case中央宣传委员会公函并决定办法五项一、平林泰子集等三十种早经分别查禁有案应切实执行前令严予禁毁以绝流传二、政治经济学批判等三十种内容宣传普罗文艺或挑拨阶级斗争或诋毁党国当局应予禁止发售三、浮士德与城等三十一种或系介绍普罗文学理论或系新俄作品或含有不正确意识者颇有宣传反动嫌疑在剿匪严重时期内应暂禁发售四、创造十年等二十二种内容间有词句不妥或一篇一段不妥应删改或抽去后方准发售五、圣徒等三十七种或系恋爱小说或系革命以前作品内容均尚无碍对于此三十七种书籍之禁令准予暂缓执行用特分别开列各项书名单函达查照转饬遵照等由合仰该书店等遵照中央决定各点并单开各种刊物分别缴毁停售具报毋再延误是为至要件存此批
The Central Propaganda Committee's official letter and decided on five measures: 1. Thirty kinds of early investigations such as the collection of Pinglin Taizi should be separately investigated and banned, and the previous order should be strictly prohibited and destroyed to prevent their circulation. 2. Thirty kinds of content, such as political economy criticism, should be prohibited from selling or promoting popular literature and art, or provoking class struggle or slandering the party-state authorities. 3. Thirty-one kinds of faust and the city, or those that introduce popular literary theories or neo-Russian works, or contain incorrect consciousness, are suspected of propaganda and reaction, should be temporarily banned from sale during the serious period of suppression of bandits. The content of the 37 kinds of works such as saints or romance novels or works before the revolution is not hindered, and the ban on these 37 books is allowed to be suspended, and the list of books is specially listed, and the letter is sent to check, transfer, and compliance, etc., and the bookstore and others follow the central decision of each point, and separately open various publications to destroy and suspend sales, so as to keep this batch for the most important requirement“附抄发各项书名单一份”
"Attached is a list of copied books"中华民国二十三年三月二十日
March 20, 23rd year of the Republic of China常务委员　吴醒亚
Standing Committee member Wu Xingya潘公展
Pan Gongzhan said童行白
Tong Xing Bai先后查禁有案之书目（略）
Successively banned bibliography (omitted)这样子，大批禁毁书籍的案件总算告一段落，书店也不再开口了。
In this way, a large number of cases of banning and destroying books finally came to an end, and the bookstore no longer spoke.
然而还剩着困难的问题：书店是不能不陆续印行新书和杂志的，所以还是永远有陆续被扣留，查禁，甚而至于封门的危险。这危险，首先于店主有亏，那就当然要有补救的办法。不多久，出版界就有了一种风闻——真只是一种隐约的风闻——
However, there is still a difficult problem: bookstores cannot fail to print new books and magazines one after another, so there is always a danger of being detained, banned, and even closed. This danger is first of all a loss to the shopkeeper, so of course there must be a remedy. It didn't take long for the publishing industry to have a rumor - really just a vague rumor -不知道何月何日，党官，店主和他的编辑，开了一个会议，讨论善后的方法。着重的是在新的书籍杂志出版，要怎样才可以免于禁止。听说这时就有一位杂志编辑先生某甲，献议先将原稿送给官厅，待到经过检查，得了许可，这才付印。文字固然决不会“反动”了，而店主的血本也得保全，真所谓公私兼利。别的编辑们好像也无人反对，这提议完全通过了。散出的时候，某甲之友也是编辑先生的某乙，很感动的向或一书店代表道：“他牺牲了个人，总算保全了一种杂志！”
I don't know what month or day it was, but the party official, the shopkeeper and his editor held a meeting to discuss the aftermath. The focus is on the publication of new books and magazines, how to avoid the ban. I heard that at this time, there was a magazine editor Mr. Moujia, who suggested that the original manuscript be sent to the official office first, and then printed after inspection and permission. Although the text will never be "reactionary", the owner's blood capital must also be preserved, which is really the so-called public and private interests. No other editors seem to have objected, and the proposal was completely passed. When it was dispersed, a certain friend of a certain person who was also an editor said to a representative of a bookstore: "He sacrificed himself and finally saved a kind of magazine!" ”“他”者，某甲先生也；推某乙先生的意思，大约是以为这种献策，颇于名誉有些损害的。其实这不过是神经衰弱的忧虑。即使没有某甲先生的献策，检查书报是总要实行的，不过用了别一种缘由来开始，况且这献策在当时，人们不敢纵谈，报章不敢记载，大家都认某甲先生为功臣，于是也就是虎须，谁也不敢捋。所以至多不过交头接耳，局外人知道的就很少，——于名誉无关。
"He" means Mr. A; The meaning of Mr. Tui Yi is probably that this kind of suggestion is quite damaging to his reputation. In fact, this is just a nervous breakdown worry. Even if there is no suggestion from Mr. A, the inspection of books and newspapers is always implemented, but it starts with another reason, and at that time, people did not dare to talk about it, and the newspapers did not dare to record it, and everyone recognized Mr. A as a hero, so it was a tiger's beard, and no one dared to stroke it. So at most, they only listen to each other, and outsiders know very little,—— it has nothing to do with reputation.总而言之，不知何年何月，“中央图书杂志审查委员会”到底在上海出现了，于是每本出版物上，就有了一行“中宣会图书杂志审委会审查证……字第……号”字样，说明着该抽去的已经抽去，该删改的已经删改，并且保证着发卖的安全——不过也并不完全有效，例如我那《二心集》被删剩的东西，书店改名《拾零集》，是经过检查的，但在杭州仍被没收。这种乱七八遭，自然是普通现象，并不足怪，但我想，也许是还带着一点私仇，因为杭州省党部的有力人物，久已是复旦大学毕业生许绍棣老爷之流，而当《语丝》登载攻击复旦大学的来函时，我正是编辑，开罪不少。为了自由大同盟而呈请中央通缉“堕落文人鲁迅”，也是浙江省党部发起的，但至今还没有呈请发掘祖坟，总算党恩高厚。
All in all, I don't know what year and month the "Central Book and Magazine Review Committee" appeared in Shanghai, so on each publication, there is a line of "Central Propaganda Committee Book and Magazine Review Committee Review Certificate...... Character number ...... The word "number" indicates that what should be removed has been removed, and what should be deleted has been deleted, and the safety of the sale is guaranteed - but it is not entirely effective, for example, the leftover things that were deleted from my "Erxin Collection", the bookstore was renamed "Shiling Collection", which was inspected but still confiscated in Hangzhou. This kind of chaos is naturally an ordinary phenomenon, and it is not surprising, but I think it may still be a little personal grudge, because the powerful figures in the Hangzhou Provincial Party Department have long been Fudan University graduates Xu Shaodi and others, and when "Yusi" published a letter attacking Fudan University, I was the editor and committed a lot of crimes. For the sake of the Freedom Alliance, the central government wanted the "degenerate literati Lu Xun", which was also initiated by the Zhejiang Provincial Party Department, but so far there has been no petition to excavate the ancestral grave, and the party is finally benevolent.至于审查员，我疑心很有些“文学家”，倘不，就不能做得这么令人佩服。自然，有时也删禁得令人莫名其妙，我以为这大概是在示威，示威的脾气，是虽是文学家也很难脱体的，而且这也不算是恶德。还有一个原因，则恐怕是在饭碗。要吃饭也决不能算是恶德，但吃饭，审查的文学家和被审查的文学家却一样的艰难，他们也有竞争者，在看漏洞，一不小心便会被抢去了饭碗，所以必须常常有成绩，就是不断的禁，删，禁，删，第三个禁，删。我初到上海的时候，曾经看见一个西洋人从旅馆里出来，几辆洋车便向他飞奔而去，他坐了一辆，走了。这时忽然来了一位巡捕，便向拉不到客的车夫的头上敲了一棒，撕下他车上的照会。我知道这是车夫犯了罪的意思，然而不明白为什么拉不到客就犯了罪，因为西洋人只有一个，当然只能坐一辆，他也并没有争。后来幸蒙一位老上海告诉我，说巡捕是每月总得捉多少犯人的，要不然，就算他懒惰，于饭碗颇有碍。真犯罪的不易得，就只好这么创作了。我以为审查官的有时审得古里古怪，总要在稿子上打几条红杠子，恐怕也是这缘故。倘使真的这样，那么，他们虽然一定要把我的“契诃夫选集”做成“残山剩水”，我也还是谅解的。
As for the censor, I am very suspicious of a "literary scholar", if not, I cannot do such an admirable job. Naturally, sometimes it is also inexplicably deleted, I think this is probably a demonstration, and the temper of the demonstration is difficult for even a writer to get rid of, and this is not a vice. Another reason is that I am afraid it is in the rice bowl. Eating must not be regarded as a vice, but eating, the censored writers and the censored writers are just as difficult, they also have competitors, they are looking at loopholes, and they will be robbed of their jobs if they are not careful, so they must always have achievements, that is, they are constantly banned, deleted, banned, deleted, and the third is prohibited, deleted. When I first arrived in Shanghai, I once saw a Westerner coming out of a hotel, and several foreign cars rushed towards him, and he took one and left. At this time, a patrol officer suddenly came, slapped the coachman who couldn't pull the passenger, and tore off the note on his car. I know this means that the coachman has committed a crime, but I don't understand why he committed a crime if he couldn't pull a passenger, because there is only one Westerner, and of course he can only ride one, and he didn't fight. Later, an old Shanghai man told me that patrols always have to catch as many prisoners as they do every month, otherwise, even if he is lazy, it will be a hindrance to his job. It's not easy to get a real crime, so I have to create it like this. I think that the censors sometimes have to put a few red bars on the manuscript, and I am afraid that this is also the reason. If this is really the case, then I still understand that although they must make my "Chekhov Anthology" into "remnants of mountains and waters".这审查办得很起劲，据报上说，官民一致满意了。九月二十五日的《中华日报》云——
The review was carried out vigorously, and it was reported that the officials and the people were unanimously satisfied. The "China Daily" on September 25 said——中央图书杂志审查委会工作紧张
The work of the Central Book and Magazine Review Committee is intense中央图书杂志审查委员会、自在沪成立以来、迄今四阅月、审查各种杂志书籍、共计有五百余种之多、平均每日每一工作人员审查字、在十万以上、审查手续、异常迅速、虽洋洋巨著、至多不过二天、故出版界咸认为有意想不到之快、予以便利不少、至该会审查标准、如非对党对政府绝对显明不利之文字、请其删改外、余均一秉大公、无私毫偏袒、故数月来相安无事、过去出版界、因无审查机关、往往出书以后、受到扣留或查禁之事、自审查会成立后、此种事件、已不再发生矣、闻中央方面、以该会工作成绩优良、而出版界又甚需要此种组织、有增加内部工作人员计划、以便利审查工作云、
The Central Book and Magazine Review Committee, since its establishment in Shanghai, has reviewed various magazines and books for more than four months, with a total of more than 500 kinds, and each staff member has reviewed words every day, with more than 100,000 words, and the review procedures are extremely fast. In the past, the publishing industry, because there was no censorship authority, often after the publication of books, was detained or banned, since the establishment of the review committee, such incidents have not happened again, it is reported to the central government, because the association has good work performance, and the publishing industry is in great need of such an organization, there is a plan to increase internal staff to facilitate the review work.如此善政，行了还不到一年，不料竟出了《新生》的《闲话皇帝》事件。大约是受了日本领事的警告罢，那雷厉风行的办法，比对于“反动文字”还要严：立刻该报禁售，该社封门，编辑者杜重远已经自认该稿未经审查，判处徒刑，不准上诉的了，却又革掉了七位审查官，一面又往书店里大搜涉及日本的旧书，墙壁上贴满了“敦睦邦交”的告示。出版家也显出孤苦零丁模样，据说：这“一秉大公”的“中央宣传部图书杂志审查委员会”不见了，拿了稿子，竟走投无路。
Such good governance, less than a year after doing it, unexpectedly came out of the "Gossip Emperor" incident of "New Life". Probably after being warned by the Japanese consul, the resolute method was even stricter than the "reactionary text": the newspaper was immediately banned, the company was closed, and the editor Du Chongyuan had already admitted that the manuscript had not been reviewed, sentenced to imprisonment, and was not allowed to appeal, but seven censors were dismissed, and on the one hand, he searched the bookstore for old books related to Japan, and the walls were covered with notices of "friendly relations". It is said that the "Book and Magazine Review Committee of the Central Propaganda Department" of the "One Bing Da Gong" disappeared, took the manuscript, and was cornered.那么，不是还我自由，飘飘然了么？并不是的。未有此会以前，出版家倒还有一点自己的脊梁，但已有此会而不见之后，却真觉得有些摇摇摆摆。大抵的农民，都能够自己过活，然而奥国和俄国解放农奴时，他们中的有些人，却哭起来了，因为失了依靠，不知道自己怎么过活。况且我们的出版家并非单是“失了依靠”，乃是遇到恢复了某甲先生献策以前的状态，又会扣留，查禁，封门，危险得很。而且除怕被指为“反动文字”以外，又得怕违反“敦睦邦交令”了。已被“训”成软骨症的出版界，又加上了一副重担，当局对于内交，又未必肯怎么“敦睦”，而“礼让为国”，也急于“体恤商艰”，所以我想，自有“审查会”而又不见之后，出版界的一大部份，倒真的成了孤哀子了。
So, isn't it free for me to return? Not really. Before this meeting, publishers still had a little bit of their own backbone, but after this meeting was gone, they really felt a little wobbly. Most peasants were able to live on their own, but when Austria and Russia liberated the serfs, some of them cried because they had lost their support and did not know how to live. Moreover, our publishers are not just "losing their support", but when they encounter the restoration of the state before Mr. A's suggestion, they will detain, ban, and close the door, which is very dangerous. And in addition to being accused of being a "reactionary character", they also have to be afraid of violating the "Order of Diplomatic Relations". The publishing industry, which has been "trained" to chondrosis, has added a heavy burden, and the authorities may not be willing to "get along" with internal communication, and "courtesy for the country" is also eager to "sympathize with business difficulties", so I think that since there was a "censorship committee" and disappeared, a large part of the publishing industry has really become a lonely mourner.所以现在的书报，倘不是先行接洽，特准激昂，就只好一味含胡，但求无过，除此之外，是依然会有先前一样的危险，挨到木棍，撕去照会的。
Therefore, if the current books and newspapers are not contacted first, they will have to blindly hold their beards, but ask for no faults, in addition, there will still be the same danger as before, and they will be torn off by wooden sticks.评论者倘不了解以上的大略，就不能批评近三年来的文坛。即使批评了，也很难中肯。
If critics do not understand the above general idea, they cannot criticize the literary world in the past three years. Even if it is criticized, it is difficult to be pertinent.
我在这一年中，日报上并没有投稿。凡是发表的，自然是含胡的居多。这是带着枷锁的跳舞，当然只足发笑的。但在我自己，却是一个纪念，一年完了，过而存之，长长短短，共四十七篇。
I did not submit any contributions in the daily newspaper during the year. Everything that is published is naturally mostly bearded. This is a dance with shackles, and of course it only makes you laugh. But in myself, it is a commemoration, the year is over, and it is preserved, long and short, a total of forty-seven articles.
一九三五年十二月三十一夜半至一月一日晨，写讫。
Written from midnight on December 31, 1935 to the morning of January 1, 1935.

《凯绥·珂勒惠支版画选集》序目
