Within 10 days after the judgment is served, the appeal is not accepted......我还用得到‘上诉’么？‘服’得很！反正这是他们的法律！
Can I still use 'appeal'? 'Convinced' very much! This is their law anyway!总结起来，我从被捕到放出，竟游历了三处残杀人民的屠场。现在，我除了感激他们不砍我的头之外，更感激的是增加了我不知几多的知识。单在刑罚一方面，我才晓得现在的中国有：一，抽藤条，二，老虎凳，都还是轻的；三，踏杠，是叫犯人脆下，把铁杠放在他的腿弯上，两头站上彪形大汉去，起先两个，逐渐加到八人；四，跪火链，是把烧红的铁链盘在地上，使犯人跪上去；五，还有一种叫‘吃’的，是从鼻孔里灌辣椒水，火油，醋，烧酒……；六，还有反绑着犯人的手，另用细麻绳缚住他的两个大拇指，高悬起来，吊着打，我叫不出这刑罚的名目。
To sum up, from the time I was arrested to the time I was released, I traveled to three slaughterhouses that killed people. Now, in addition to being grateful that they didn't cut off my head, I am even more grateful for the increase in my knowledge. In terms of punishment alone, I know that China now has: first, drawing rattan, second, tiger stools, which are still light; Third, stepping on the bar, is to make the prisoner brittle, put the iron bar on the crook of his leg, stand on the big man at both ends, at first two, gradually increase to eight people; 4. Kneeling fire chains are to coil the red-hot iron chains on the ground and make the prisoners kneel on them; Fifth, there is another kind called 'eating', which is to pour chili water, kerosene, vinegar, soju ...... from the nostrils; Sixth, there is also the hand of the prisoner tied back, and his two thumbs are tied with fine hemp rope, hung high, and beaten, I can't name this punishment.我认为最惨的还是在拘留所里和我同栊的一个年青的农民。老爷硬说他是红军军长，但他死不承认。呵，来了，他们用缝衣针插在他的指甲缝里，用榔头敲进去。敲进去了一只，不承认，敲第二只，仍不承认，又敲第三只……第四只……终于十只指头都敲满了。直到现在，那青年的惨白的脸，凹下的眼睛，两只满是鲜血的手，还时常浮在我的眼前，使我难于忘却！使我苦痛！……
I think the worst thing was a young farmer who was with me in the detention center. The master insisted that he was the commander of the Red Army, but he refused to admit it. Oh, here they are, they stick a sewing needle in the crack of his nail and hammer it in. Knocked in one, didn't admit it, knocked on the second one, still didn't admit it, and knocked on the third...... The fourth ...... Finally, ten fingers were knocked full. Until now, the young man's pale face, sunken eyes, and two blood-stained hands still float in front of my eyes from time to time, making it difficult for me to forget! It makes me suffer! ……然而，入狱的原因，直到我出来之后才查明白。祸根是在我们学生对于学校有不满之处，尤其是对于训育主任，而他却是省党部的政治情报员。他为了要镇压全体学生的不满，就把仅存的三个木刻研究会会员，抓了去做示威的牺牲了。而那个硬派卢那却尔斯基为红军军官的马褂老爷，又是他的姐夫，多么便利呵！
However, the reason for the imprisonment was not found out until I came out. The bane is that our students are dissatisfied with the school, especially the director of discipline, who is a political intelligence officer of the provincial party department. In order to suppress the dissatisfaction of all the students, he arrested the only three remaining members of the Woodcut Research Society and sacrificed them for demonstration. And the hard-core Lunachersky is a Red Army officer, and he is his brother-in-law, how convenient!写完了大略，抬头看看窗外，一地惨白的月色，心里不禁渐渐地冰凉了起来。然而我自信自己还并不怎样的怯弱，然而，我的心冰凉起来了……
After writing the general idea, I looked up at the pale moonlight outside the window, and my heart couldn't help but gradually become cold. However, I was confident that I was not so timid, but my heart was cold......愿你的身体康健！
May your health be healthy!人凡。四月四日，后半夜。”
Human. April 4th, the second half of the night. ”（附记：从《一个童话》后半起至篇末止，均据人凡君信及《坐牢略记》。四月七日。）
(Note: From the second half of "A Fairy Tale" to the end of the article, it is all based on the letter of the king and the "Brief Notes on Prison".) April 7th. ）

三月的租界

三月的租界

三月的租界

March concession今年一月，田军发表了一篇小品，题目是《大连丸上》，记着一年多以前，他们夫妇俩怎样幸而走出了对于他们是荆天棘地的大连——
In January this year, Tian Jun published a sketch titled "Dalian Marus", remembering how the couple was lucky enough to get out of Dalian, which was a thorny place for them more than a year ago——“第二天当我们第一眼看到青岛青青的山角时，我们的心才又从冻结里蠕活过来。
"The next day, when we saw the green corners of Qingdao for the first time, our hearts wriggled back from the freeze.“‘啊！祖国！’
"'Ah! Fatherland! ’“我们梦一般这样叫了！”
"We call it like this in our dreams!"他们的回“祖国”，如果是做随员，当然没有人会说话，如果是剿匪，那当然更没有人会说话，但他们竟不过来出版了《八月的乡村》。这就和文坛发生了关系。那么，且慢“从冻结里蠕活过来”罢。三月里，就“有人”在上海的租界上冷冷的说道——
When they returned to the "motherland", if they were attachés, of course no one would speak, and if they were suppressing bandits, of course no one would speak, but they didn't come to publish "August Countryside". This has something to do with the literary world. Then, let's slowly "wriggle out of the freeze". In March, "someone" said coldly in the Shanghai concession -“田军不该早早地从东北回来！”
"Tian Jun shouldn't have come back from the northeast early!"谁说的呢？就是“有人”。为什么呢？因为这部《八月的乡村》“里面有些还不真实”。然而我的传话是“真实”的。有《大晚报》副刊《火炬》的奇怪毫光之一，《星期文坛》上的狄克先生的文章为证——
Who said that? It is "someone". Why? Because this "August Countryside" "some of it is not real". However, my message is "true". There is one of the strange lights of the "Torch" supplement of the "Great Evening News", as evidenced by Mr. Dick's article in the "Weekly Literary World" -“《八月的乡村》整个地说，他是一首史诗，可是里面有些还不真实，像人民革命军进攻了一个乡村以后的情况就不够真实。有人这样对我说：‘田军不该早早地从东北回来’，就是由于他感觉到田军还需要长时间的学习，如果再丰富了自己以后，这部作品当更好。技巧上，内容上，都有许多问题在，为什么没有人指出呢？”
"The Countryside in August" as a whole is an epic, but some of it is not true, like the situation after the People's Revolutionary Army attacked a village. Someone said to me: 'Tian Jun should not come back from the northeast early', because he felt that Tian Jun still needed to study for a long time, and if he enriched himself, this work would be better. There are many problems in terms of technique and content, why is no one pointing it out? ”这些话自然不能说是不对的。假如“有人”说，高尔基不该早早不做码头脚夫，否则，他的作品当更好；吉须不该早早逃亡外国，如果坐在希忒拉的集中营里，他将来的报告文学当更有希望。倘使有谁去争论，那么，这人一定是低能儿。然而在三月的租界上，却还有说几句话的必要，因为我们还不到十分“丰富了自己”，免于来做低能儿的幸福的时期。
Naturally, these words cannot be said to be wrong. If "someone" says that Gorky should not stop being a dock porter early, otherwise, his work should be better; Jixu should not have fled to a foreign country early, and if he sat in Hitler's concentration camp, his future reportage would be more promising. If anyone argues, then this person must be an imbecile. However, in the March concession, it is still necessary to say a few words, because we are not yet very "enriched" and free from the happy period of being an imbecile.这样的时候，人是很容易性急的。例如罢，田军早早的来做小说了，却“不够真实”，狄克先生一听到“有人”的话，立刻同意，责别人不来指出“许多问题”了，也等不及“丰富了自己以后”，再来做“正确的批评”。但我以为这是不错的，我们有投枪就用投枪，正不必等候刚在制造或将要制造的坦克车和烧夷弹。可惜的是这么一来，田军也就没有什么“不该早早地从东北回来”的错处了。立论要稳当真也不容易。
At times like this, people are easily impatient. For example, Tian Jun came to write a novel early, but it was "not real enough", and as soon as Mr. Dick heard the words of "someone", he immediately agreed, blaming others for not pointing out "many problems", and he couldn't wait to "enrich himself" and then make "correct criticism". But I thought it was good, we used the throwing gun when we had it, and we didn't have to wait for the tanks and incendiary bombs that were just being built or were about to be made. Unfortunately, in this way, Tian Jun has nothing wrong with "not coming back from the Northeast early". It is not easy to make a solid statement.况且从狄克先生的文章上看起来，要知道“真实”似乎也无须久留在东北似的，这位“有人”先生和狄克先生大约就留在租界上，并未比田军回来得晚，在东北学习，但他们却知道够不够真实。而且要作家进步，也无须靠“正确”的批评，因为在没有人指出《八月的乡村》的技巧上，内容上的“许多问题”以前，狄克先生也已经断定了：“我相信现在有人在写，或豫备写比《八月的乡村》更好的作品，因为读者需要！”
Moreover, from Mr. Dick's article, it seems that the "real" does not seem to need to stay in the Northeast for a long time, and this "someone" Mr. and Mr. Dick stayed in the concession about the time, not later than Tian Jun came back to study in the Northeast, but they knew whether it was true enough. And for writers to progress, they do not need to rely on "correct" criticism, because before no one pointed out the "many problems" in the technique and content of "August Country", Mr. Dick had already concluded: "I believe that there are people who are now writing, or preparing to write better works than August Country, because readers need them!" ”到这里，就是坦克车正要来，或将要来了，不妨先折断了投枪。
At this point, the tank is coming, or is about to come, so you might as well break the throwing gun first.到这里，我又应该补叙狄克先生的文章的题目，是：《我们要执行自我批判》。
At this point, I should add the title of Mr. Dick's article, which is: "We must practice self-criticism".题目很有劲。作者虽然不说这就是“自我批判”，但却实行着抹杀《八月的乡村》的“自我批判”的任务的，要到他所希望的正式的“自我批判”发表时，这才解除它的任务，而《八月的乡村》也许再有些生机。因为这种模模胡胡的摇头，比列举十大罪状更有害于对手，列举还有条款，含胡的指摘，是可以令人揣测到坏到茫无界限的。
The title is very powerful. Although the author does not say that this is "self-criticism", he implements the task of erasing the "self-criticism" of "August Country", and it is not until the official "self-criticism" he hopes for is published that it will be lifted, and "August Country" may have some more vitality. Because this kind of shaking of the head is more harmful to the opponent than listing the top ten crimes, and the list has clauses, including Hu's accusations, which can make people speculate that they are so bad that there are no boundaries.自然，狄克先生的“要执行自我批判”是好心，因为“那些作家是我们底”的缘故。但我以为同时可也万万忘记不得“我们”之外的“他们”，也不可专对“我们”之中的“他们”。要批判，就得彼此都给批判，美恶一并指出。如果在还有“我们”和“他们”的文坛上，一味自责以显其“正确”或公平，那其实是在向“他们”献媚或替“他们”缴械。
Naturally, Mr. Dick's "self-criticism" is well-intentioned, because "those writers are our bottom". But I think that at the same time, we must never forget "them" outside of "us", nor should we be exclusive to "them" in "us". If you want to criticize, you have to criticize each other, and point out the good and evil together. If in the literary world where there are still "us" and "them", blindly blaming oneself to show that it is "right" or fair, it is actually flattering "them" or disarming "them".四月十六日。
April 16th.

《出关》的“关”

《出关》的“关”

《出关》的“关”

The "Pass" of "Out of the Customs"我的一篇历史的速写《出关》在《海燕》上一发表，就有了不少的批评，但大抵自谦为“读后感”。于是有人说：“这是因为作者的名声的缘故”。话是不错的。现在许多新作家的努力之作，都没有这么的受批评家注意，偶或为读者所发现，销上一二千部，便什么“名利双收”呀，“不该回来”呀，“叽哩咕噜”呀，群起而打之，惟恐他还有活气，一定要弄到此后一声不响，这才算天下太平，文坛万岁。然而别一方面，慷慨激昂之士也露脸了，他戟指大叫道：“我们中国有半个托尔斯泰没有？有半个歌德没有？”惭愧得很，实在没有。不过其实也不必这么激昂，因为从地壳凝结，渐有生物以至现在，在俄国和德国，托尔斯泰和歌德也只有各一个。
As soon as one of my historical sketches "Out of the Customs" was published in "Haiyan", there was a lot of criticism, but most of them were humble as "after reading". So someone said: "This is because of the author's reputation." That's a good thing. Nowadays, the efforts of many new writers have not received such attention from critics, and occasionally they are discovered by readers, and if they sell one or two thousand copies, they will be "fame and fortune", "should not come back", "gurgling", and beat them in groups, for fear that he is still alive, and he must make a silent sound after that, which is considered peaceful in the world and long live the literary world. However, on the other hand, the impassioned man also showed his face, and he shouted with his halberd pointing: "Do we have half of Tolstoy in China?" Is there half a Goethe? "I'm very ashamed, really not. But in fact, there is no need to be so excited, because from the condensation of the earth's crust, there are gradually living things to the present, in Russia and Germany, Tolstoy and Goethe are only one each.我并没有遭着这种打击和恫吓，是万分幸福的，不过这回却想破了向来对于批评都守缄默的老例，来说几句话，这也并无他意，只以为批评者有从作品来批判作者的权利，作者也有从批评来批判批评者的权利，咱们也不妨谈一谈而已。
I am very happy that I have not suffered this kind of blow and intimidation, but this time I want to break the old practice of keeping silent about criticism, and say a few words, which I have no other intention of, I just think that critics have the right to criticize the author from the work, and the author also has the right to criticize the critic from the critic, so we might as well talk about it.看所有的批评，其中有两种，是把我原是小小的作品，缩得更小，或者简直封闭了。
Looking at all the criticisms, two of them are to shrink my original small work to a smaller size, or simply close.一种，是以为《出关》在攻击某一个人。这些话，在朋友闲谈，随意说笑的时候，自然是无所不可的，但若形诸笔墨，昭示读者，自以为得了这作品的魂灵，却未免像后街阿狗的妈妈。她是只知道，也只爱听别人的阴私的。不幸我那《出关》并不合于这一流人的胃口，于是一种小报上批评道：“这好像是在讽刺傅东华，然而又不是。”既然“然而又不是”，就可见并不“是在讽刺傅东华”了，这不是该从别处着眼了么？然而他因此又觉得毫无意味，一定要实在“是在讽刺傅东华”，这才尝出意味来。
One is to think that "Out of the Customs" is attacking a certain person. These words, when friends chat and laugh casually, are naturally omnipotent, but if they are in the form of pen and ink, it shows the reader that he thinks he has the soul of this work, but he is like the mother of a dog in the back street. She only knows and only loves to listen to other people's private interests. Unfortunately, my "Out of the Customs" did not suit the appetite of this type of people, so a tabloid criticized: "This seems to be a satire on Fu Donghua, but it is not." Since "but it is not", it can be seen that it is not "satirizing Fu Donghua", shouldn't this be looked elsewhere? However, he felt that it was meaningless, and he must really be "satirizing Fu Donghua", so that he could taste the meaning.这种看法的人们，是并不很少的，还记得作《阿Q正传》时，就曾有小政客和小官僚惶怒，硬说是在讽刺他，殊不知阿Q的模特儿，却在别的小城市中，而他也实在正在给人家捣米。但小说里面，并无实在的某甲或某乙的么？并不是的。倘使没有，就不成为小说。纵使写的是妖怪，孙悟空一个筋斗十万八千里，猪八戒高老庄招亲，在人类中也未必没有谁和他们精神上相像。有谁相像，就是无意中取谁来做了模特儿，不过因为是无意中，所以也可以说是谁竟和书中的谁相像。我们的古人，是早觉得做小说要用模特儿的，记得有一部笔记，说施耐庵——我们也姑且认为真有这作者罢——请画家画了一百零八条梁山泊上的好汉，贴在墙上，揣摩着各人的神情，写成了《水浒》。但这作者大约是文人，所以明白文人的技俩，而不知道画家的能力，以为他倒能凭空创造，用不着模特儿来作标本了。
There are not a few people who have this view, and I still remember that when I wrote "The True Biography of Ah Q", there were small politicians and small bureaucrats who were angry and insisted that they were satirizing him, but they didn't know that Ah Q's model was in other small cities, and he was really pounding rice for others. But in the novel, is there no real A or B? Not really. If not, it will not become a novel. Even if it is written about monsters, Sun Wukong somersaults 108,000 miles, Zhu Bajie Gao Laozhuang recruits relatives, and there may not be anyone among humans who is spiritually similar to them. Whoever resembles someone is unintentionally chosen as a model, but because it is unintentional, it can also be said that who resembles someone in the book. Our ancients had long felt that they needed to use models to make novels, and I remember a note saying that Shi Nai'an—let's just think that there really is this author—asked the painter to draw one hundred and eight heroes on Liangshanbo, pasted them on the wall, pondered everyone's expressions, and wrote "Water Margin". But this author is probably a literati, so he understands the skills of literati, but does not know the ability of the painter, thinking that he can create out of thin air and does not need a model as a specimen.作家的取人为模特儿，有两法。一是专用一个人，言谈举动，不必说了，连微细的癖性，衣服的式样，也不加改变。这比较的易于描写，但若在书中是一个可恶或可笑的角色，在现在的中国恐怕大抵要认为作者在报个人的私仇——叫作“个人主义”，有破坏“联合战线”之罪，从此很不容易做人。二是杂取种种人，合成一个，从和作者相关的人们里去找，是不能发见切合的了。但因为“杂取种种人”，一部分相像的人也就更其多数，更能招致广大的惶怒。我是一向取后一法的，当初以为可以不触犯某一个人，后来才知道倒触犯了一个以上，真是“悔之无及”，既然“无及”，也就不悔了。况且这方法也和中国人的习惯相合，例如画家的画人物，也是静观默察，烂熟于心，然后凝神结想，一挥而就，向来不用一个单独的模特儿的。
There are two ways for writers to hire people as models. First, it is dedicated to one person, and the words and actions are not changed, not to mention, even the subtle habits and the style of clothes. This is relatively easy to describe, but if it is a hateful or ridiculous character in the book, in today's China, I am afraid that the author is avenging his personal revenge - called "individualism", and has the crime of destroying the "united front", and it is not easy to be a human being from now on. the other is to take all kinds of people, synthesize one, and find it from people related to the author, which cannot be found. But because of "mixing all kinds of people", some similar people are also more numerous, and they can attract the anger of the vast number of people. I have always taken the latter method, I thought I could not offend a certain person, but later I realized that I had violated more than one, which was really "too late to regret". Moreover, this method is also in line with the habits of Chinese, for example, painters paint figures, but also meditate and observe, familiarize themselves with the heart, and then concentrate on it, and achieve it in one stroke, without the need for a separate model.不过我在这里，并不说傅东华先生就做不得模特儿，他一进小说，是有代表一种人物的资格的；我对于这资格，也毫无轻视之意，因为世间进不了小说的人们倒多得很。然而纵使谁整个的进了小说，如果作者手腕高妙，作品久传的话，读者所见的就只是书中人，和这曾经实有的人倒不相干了。例如《红楼梦》里贾宝玉的模特儿是作者自己曹霑，《儒林外史》里马二先生的模特儿是冯执中，现在我们所觉得的却只是贾宝玉和马二先生，只有特种学者如胡适之先生之流，这才把曹霑和冯执中念念不忘的记在心儿里：这就是所谓人生有限，而艺术却较为永久的话罢。
But I am here, not to say that Mr. Fu Donghua cannot be a model, as soon as he enters the novel, he has the qualifications to represent a character; I have no contempt for this qualification, because there are many people in the world who can't enter novels. However, even if someone enters the novel as a whole, if the author is skilled and the work has been passed down for a long time, what the reader sees is only the person in the book, and it has nothing to do with the person who once existed. For example, Jia Baoyu's model in "Dream of Red Mansions" is the author's own Cao Zhan, and Mr. Ma Er's model in "The History of Confucianism" is Feng Zhizhong, but now what we think is only Jia Baoyu and Mr. Ma Er, only special scholars such as Mr. Hu Shizhi and the like, which keep Cao Zhan and Feng Zhizhong in mind: this is the so-called limited life, but art is more permanent.还有一种，是以为《出关》乃是作者的自况，自况总得占点上风，所以我就是其中的老子。说得最凄惨的是邱韵铎先生——
There is also a way to think that "Out of the Customs" is the author's own situation, and the self-situation always has the upper hand, so I am one of them. The most miserable thing is Mr. Qiu Yunduo -“……至于读了之后，留在脑海里的影子，就只是一个全身心都浸淫着孤独感的老人的身影。我真切地感觉着读者是会坠入孤独和悲哀去，跟着我们的作者。要是这样，那么，这篇小说的意义，就要无形地削弱了，我相信，鲁迅先生以及像鲁迅先生一样的作家们的本意是不在这里的。……”（《每周文学》的《海燕读后记》）
“…… As for the shadow left in my mind after reading, it is just the figure of an old man immersed in loneliness. I really feel that readers will fall into loneliness and sadness, following our author. If this is the case, then the meaning of this novel will be invisibly weakened, and I believe that the original intention of Mr. Lu Xun and writers like Mr. Lu Xun is not here. ......" ("Haiyan Reading Postscript" of "Weekly Literature")这一来真是非同小可，许多人都“坠入孤独和悲哀去”，前面一个老子，青牛屁股后面一个作者，还有“以及像鲁迅先生一样的作家们”，还有许多读者们连邱韵铎先生在内，竟一窠蜂似的涌“出关”去了。但是，倘使如此，老子就又不“只是一个全身心都浸淫着孤独感的老人的身影”，我想他是会不再出关，回上海请我们吃饭，出题目征集文章，做道德五百万言的了。
This is really extraordinary, many people have "fallen into loneliness and sorrow", a Lao Tzu in front, an author behind Qing Niu's butt, and "and writers like Mr. Lu Xun", and many readers, including Mr. Qiu Yunduo, have rushed out of the customs like a swarm. However, if this is the case, Lao Tzu will not be "just an old man immersed in loneliness", I think he will no longer go out of customs, go back to Shanghai to invite us to dinner, publish topics and collect articles, and do five million words of morality.所以我现在想站在关口，从老子的青牛屁股后面，挽留住“像鲁迅先生一样的作家们”以及许多读者们连邱韵铎先生在内。首先是请不要“坠入孤独和悲哀去”，因为“本意是不在这里”，邱先生是早知道的，但是没说出在那里，也许看不出在那里。倘是前者，真是“这篇小说的意义，就要无形地削弱了”；倘因后者，那么，却是我的文字坏，不够分明的传出“本意”的缘故。现在略说一点，算是敬扫一回两月以前“留在脑海里的影子”罢——
So now I want to stand at the pass, from behind Lao Tzu's green bull's butt, to retain "writers like Mr. Lu Xun" and many readers, including Mr. Qiu Yunduo. First of all, please don't "fall into loneliness and sadness", because "the original intention is not here", Mr. Qiu knew it for a long time, but he didn't say it, maybe he couldn't see it there. If it is the former, it is really "the meaning of this novel will be invisibly weakened"; If it is because of the latter, then it is because my writing is bad and the "original intention" is not clearly conveyed. Now let's talk about it a little, which can be regarded as a review of the "shadow left in my mind" two months ago -老子的西出函谷，为了孔子的几句话，并非我的发见或创造，是三十年前，在东京从太炎先生口头听来的，后来他写在《诸子学略说》中，但我也并不信为一定的事实。至于孔老相争，孔胜老败，却是我的意见：老，是尚柔的；“儒者，柔也”，孔也尚柔，但孔以柔进取，而老却以柔退走。这关键，即在孔子为“知其不可为而为之”的事无大小，均不放松的实行者，老则是“无为而无不为”的一事不做，徒作大言的空谈家。要无所不为，就只好一无所为，因为一有所为，就有了界限，不能算是“无不为”了。我同意于关尹子的嘲笑：他是连老婆也娶不成的。于是加以漫画化，送他出了关，毫无爱惜，不料竟惹起邱先生的这样的凄惨，我想，这大约一定因为我的漫画化还不足够的缘故了，然而如果更将他的鼻子涂白，是不只“这篇小说的意义，就要无形地削弱”而已的，所以也只好这样子。
Lao Tzu's westward departure from Hangu, for Confucius's words, was not my discovery or creation, it was heard orally from Mr. Taiyan in Tokyo thirty years ago, and later he wrote it in the "Brief Discussion of the Teachings of the Sons", but I do not believe it to be a certain fact. As for the conflict between Confucius and Lao, Confucius wins and loses, but it is my opinion: old is still soft; "Confucianism, softness", Kong is also soft, but Kong enterprising with softness, while Lao retreats with softness. The key to this is that Confucius was a practitioner who did not relax for "knowing that he could not do anything", and the old man was a hollow talker who did nothing and did nothing and was just a big talker. If you want to do everything, you have to do nothing, because once you do something, there is a limit, and it cannot be regarded as "doing everything". I agree with Guan Yinzi's ridicule: he can't even marry a wife. So I caricatured him and sent him out of the customs, without any regret, but unexpectedly provoked Mr. Qiu's misery, I think, this must be because my cartoonization is not enough, but if his nose is painted white, it is not only "the meaning of this novel will be invisibly weakened", so I have to do this.再引一段邱韵铎先生的独白——
Another quote from Mr. Qiu Yunduo's monologue -“……我更相信，他们是一定会继续地运用他们的心力和笔力，倾注到更有利于社会变革方面，使凡是有利的力量都集中起来，加强起来，同时使凡是可能有利的力量都转为有利的力量，以联结成一个巨大无比的力量。”
“…… I am even more convinced that they will continue to use their mental and pen power to devote their energy to more conducive to social change, so that all favorable forces can be concentrated and strengthened, and at the same time, all possible advantageous forces will be transformed into favorable forces, so as to unite into a huge and incomparable force. ”一为而“成一个巨大无比的力量”，仅次于“无为而无不为”一等，我“们”是没有这种玄妙的本领的，然而我“们”和邱先生不同之处却就在这里，我“们”并不“坠入孤独和悲哀去”，而邱先生却会“真切地感觉着读者是会坠入孤独和悲哀去”的关键也在这里。他起了有利于老子的心思，于是不禁写了“巨大无比”的抽象的封条，将我的无利于老子的具象的作品封闭了。但我疑心：邱韵铎先生以及像邱韵铎先生一样的作家们的本意，也许倒只在这里的。
The key to "becoming a huge and incomparable force" is second only to "doing nothing and doing everything", but the difference between us and Mr. Qiu is here, we "we" do not "fall into loneliness and sadness", but Mr. Qiu will "really feel that the reader will fall into loneliness and sadness" The key is also here. He had thoughts that were beneficial to Lao Tzu, so he couldn't help but write an "incomparably huge" abstract seal to close my figurative works that were not beneficial to Lao Tzu. But I suspect that the original intention of Mr. Qiu Yunduo and writers like Mr. Qiu Yunduo may only be here.四月三十日。
April 30th.

捷克译本

捷克译本

捷克译本

Czech translation记得世界大战之后，许多新兴的国家出现的时候，我们曾经非常高兴过，因为我们也是曾被压迫，挣扎出来的人民。捷克的兴起，自然为我们所大欢喜；但是奇怪，我们又很疏远，例如我，就没有认识过一个捷克人，看见过一本捷克书，前几年到了上海，才在店铺里目睹了捷克的玻璃器。
I remember that after the world war, when many emerging countries appeared, we were very happy, because we were also oppressed and struggling people. The rise of the Czech Republic naturally rejoices with us; But strangely, we are very estranged, for example, I have never known a Czech, I have seen a Czech book, and I only witnessed Czech glassware in a store when I went to Shanghai a few years ago.我们彼此似乎都不很互相记得。但以现在的一般情况而论，这并不算坏事情，现在各国的彼此念念不忘，恐怕大抵未必是为了交情太好了的缘故。自然，人类最好是彼此不隔膜，相关心。然而最平正的道路，却只有用文艺来沟通，可惜走这条道路的人又少得很。
We don't seem to remember each other very well. But in terms of the current general situation, this is not a bad thing, and now the countries are not forgetting each other, I am afraid that it may not be because the friendship is too good. Naturally, it is best for humans to not be separated from each other and care about each other. However, the most upright path is only to communicate with literature and art, but unfortunately there are very few people who take this path.出乎意外地，译者竟首先将试尽这任务的光荣，加在我这里了。我的作品，因此能够展开在捷克的读者的面前，这在我，实在比被译成通行很广的别国语言更高兴。我想，我们两国，虽然民族不同，地域相隔，交通又很少，但是可以互相了解，接近的，因为我们都曾经走过苦难的道路，现在还在走——一面寻求着光明。
Unexpectedly, the translator first added to me the honor of trying to complete this task. My work, thus being able to unfold in front of Czech readers, is really much happier for me than it is to be translated into other Chinese languages. I think that although our two countries are of different ethnicities, geographically separated, and have little transportation, we can understand each other and get close, because we have both walked the road of suffering, and we are still walking - seeking the light on the one hand.一九三六年七月二十一日，鲁迅。
July 21, 1936, Lu Xun.

答徐懋庸并关于抗日统一战线问题

答徐懋庸并关于抗日统一战线问题

答徐懋庸并关于抗日统一战线问题

Answer Xu Maoyong and on the issue of the anti-Japanese united front鲁迅先生：
Mr. Lu Xun:贵恙已痊愈否？念念。自先生一病，加以文艺界的纠纷，我就无缘再亲聆□教诲，思之常觉怆然！
Have you recovered from your illness? Nian. Since my husband fell ill and the disputes in the literary and artistic circles, I have not had the opportunity to listen to □ teachings in person, and I often feel sad when I think about it!我现因生活困难，身体衰弱，不得不离开上海，拟往乡间编译一点卖现钱的书后，再来沪上。趁此机会，暂作上海“文坛”的局外人，仔细想想一切问题，也许会更明白些的罢。
I have to leave Shanghai due to difficulties in life and weakness, and plan to go to the countryside to compile some books that sell cash before coming to Shanghai. Take this opportunity to temporarily be an outsider in Shanghai's "literary world", think carefully about all the problems, and maybe you will understand better.在目前，我总觉得先生最近半年来的言行，是无意地助长着恶劣的倾向的。以胡风的性情之诈，以黄源的行为之谄，先生都没有细察，永远被他们据为私有，眩惑群众，若偶像然，于是从他们的野心出发的分离运动，遂一发而不可收拾矣。胡风他们的行动，显然是出于私心的，极端的宗派运动，他们的理论，前后矛盾，错误百出。即如“民族革命战争的大众文学”这口号，起初原是胡风提出来用以和“国防文学”对立的，后来说一个是总的，一个是附属的，后来又说一个是左翼文学发展到现阶段的口号，如此摇摇荡荡，即先生亦不能替他们圆其说。对于他们的言行，打击本极易，但徒以有先生作着他们的盾牌，人谁不爱先生，所以在实际解决和文字斗争上都感到绝大的困难。
At present, I always feel that my husband's words and deeds in the past six months are unintentionally promoting bad tendencies. With the deceit of Hu Feng's temperament and the flattery of Huang Yuan's behavior, Mr. did not examine it carefully, and was forever occupied by them as private property, dazzling the masses like idols, so the separatist movement based on their ambitions was out of control. Hu Feng and his actions are obviously out of selfishness, extreme sectarian movements, and their theories are inconsistent and full of errors. For example, the slogan "popular literature of the national revolutionary war" was originally proposed by Hu Feng to oppose "national defense literature", but later said that one was general and the other was subsidiary, and later it was said that it was the slogan of the development of left-wing literature to the present stage. It is very easy to hit their words and deeds, but they only use Mr. as their shield, and who does not love Mr. Wang, so they feel great difficulties in practical solutions and literary struggles.我很知道先生的本意。先生是唯恐参加统一战线的左翼战友，放弃原来的立场，而看到胡风们在样子上尚左得可爱；所以赞同了他们的。但我要告诉先生，这是先生对于现在的基本的政策没有了解之故。现在的统一战线——中国的和全世界的都一样——固然是以普洛为主体的，但其成为主体，并不由于它的名义，它的特殊地位和历史，而是由于它的把握现实的正确和斗争能力的巨大。所以在客观上，普洛之为主体，是当然的。但在主观上，普洛不应该挂起明显的徽章，不以工作，只以特殊的资格去要求领导权，以至吓跑别的阶层的战友。所以，在目前的时候，到联合战线中提出左翼的口号来，是错误的，是危害联合战线的。所以先生最近所发表的《病中答客问》，既说明“民族革命战争的大众文学”是普洛文学到现在的一发展，又说这应该作为统一战线的总口号，这是不对的。
I know my husband's intentions very well. Mr. is a left-wing comrade-in-arms who is afraid of joining the united front, giving up his original position, and seeing that Hu Feng and the others are still cute in appearance; So agreed with them. But I want to tell you that this is because you do not understand the basic policy now. The current united front - China's and the whole world - is certainly based on Pro, but its main body is not due to its name, its special status and history, but because of its correct grasp of reality and its great ability to fight. So objectively, it is natural for Plo to be the main body. But subjectively, Plow should not hang up obvious badges, not for work, but only for special qualifications to demand leadership, so as to scare away comrades from other classes. Therefore, at present, it is wrong to put forward left-wing slogans in the united front, and it endangers the united front. Therefore, Mr. Chen's recent publication of "Answering Questions in the Sick" not only shows that "popular literature of the national revolutionary war" is a development of Pluto literature until now, but also says that this should be the general slogan of the united front, which is incorrect.再说参加“文艺家协会”的“战友”，未必个个右倾堕落，如先生所疑虑者；况集合在先生的左右的“战友”，既然包括巴金和黄源之流，难道先生以为凡参加“文艺家协会”的人们，竟个个不如巴金和黄源么？我从报章杂志上，知道法西两国“安那其”之反动，破坏联合战线，无异于托派，中国的“安那其”的行为，则更卑劣。黄源是一个根本没有思想，只靠捧名流为生的东西。从前他奔走于傅郑门下之时，一副谄佞之相，固不异于今日之对先生效忠致敬。先生可与此辈为伍，而不屑与多数人合作，此理我实不解。
Besides, the "comrades-in-arms" who participate in the "Writers and Artists Association" may not all be right-leaning and degenerate, as Mr. suspects; Moreover, since the "comrades-in-arms" gathered on the left and right of Mr. include Ba Jin and Huang Yuan and the like, does Mr. think that all the people who participate in the "Writers Association" are not as good as Ba Jin and Huang Yuan? I know from newspapers and magazines that the reactionary "Anarch" between France and Spain and the destruction of the united front are tantamount to Trotskyism, and the behavior of China's "Anarch" is even more despicable. Huang Yuan is a thing that has no thoughts at all and only makes a living by supporting celebrities. In the past, when he was running under Fu Zheng, he had a flattering appearance, which was no different from today's loyalty to Mr. I really don't understand the reason why you can be with these people and disdain to cooperate with most people.我觉得不看事而只看人，是最近半年来先生的错误的根由。先生的看人又看得不准。譬如，我个人，诚然是有许多缺点的，但先生却把我写字糊涂这一层当作大缺点，我觉得实在好笑。（我为什么故意要把“邱韵铎”三字，写成像“郑振铎”的样子呢？难道郑振铎是先生所喜欢的人么？）为此小故，遽拒一个人于千里之外，我实以为不对。
I think not looking at things but only looking at people is the root cause of my husband's mistakes in the past six months. Mr. is not able to see people accurately. For example, I personally have many shortcomings, but my husband regards my confusion as a big flaw, which I find really funny. (Why did I deliberately write the word "Qiu Yunduo" as "Zheng Zhenduo"?) Is Zheng Zhenduo the person you like? For this small reason, I really don't think it's right to suddenly refuse a person a thousand miles away.我今天就要离沪，行色匆匆，不能多写了，也许已经写得太多。以上所说，并非存心攻击先生，实在很希望先生仔细想一想各种事情。
I'm leaving Shanghai today, I'm in a hurry, I can't write more, maybe I've written too much. The above is not an intention to attack Mr. Zhao, I really hope that Mr. will think carefully about various things.拙译《斯太林传》快要出版，出版后当寄奉一册，此书甚望先生细看一下，对原意和译文，均望批评。敬颂

Mao Yong is on top. August 1st.以上，是徐懋庸给我的一封信，我没有得他同意就在这里发表了，因为其中全是教训我和攻击别人的话，发表出来，并不损他的威严，而且也许正是他准备我将它发表的作品。但自然，人们也不免因此看得出：这发信者倒是有些“恶劣”的青年！
The above is a letter from Xu Maoyong to me, and I published it here without his consent, because it was full of words that taught me and attacked others, and publishing it did not damage his dignity, and perhaps it was he who prepared my work to publish. But naturally, people can't help but see that this sender is a "bad" young man!但我有一个要求：希望巴金，黄源，胡风诸先生不要学徐懋庸的样。因为这信中有攻击他们的话，就也报答以牙眼，那恰正中了他的诡计。在国难当头的现在，白天里讲些冠冕堂皇的话，暗夜里进行一些离间，挑拨，分裂的勾当的，不就正是这些人么？这封信是有计划的，是他们向没有加入“文艺家协会”的人们的新的挑战，想这些人们去应战，那时他们就加你们以“破坏联合战线”的罪名，“汉奸”的罪名。然而我们不，我们决不要把笔锋去专对几个个人，“先安内而后攘外”，不是我们的办法。
But I have a request: I hope that Mr. Ba Jin, Huang Yuan, and Hu Fengzhu will not follow Xu Maoyong's example. Because there were words that attacked them in this letter, he also repaid them with teeth, which fell right into his trick. Now that the country is in turmoil, aren't these people the ones who say some high-sounding words during the day and carry out some divisive, provoking, and divisive deeds at night? This letter was planned, a new challenge to those who did not join the "Writers' Association", and wanted these people to fight, and then they added you to the charge of "sabotaging the united front" and "traitor". However, we don't, we must never focus on a few individuals, "first settle inside and then get outside", which is not our way.但我在这里，有些话要说一说。首先是我对于抗日的统一战线的态度。其实，我已经在好几个地方说过了，然而徐懋庸等似乎不肯去看一看，却一味的咬住我，硬要诬陷我“破坏统一战线”，硬要教训我说我“对于现在基本的政策没有了解”。我不知道徐懋庸们有什么“基本的政策”。（他们的基本政策不就是要咬我几口么？）然而中国目前的革命的政党向全国人民所提出的抗日统一战线的政策，我是看见的，我是拥护的，我无条件地加入战线，那理由就因为我不但是一个作家，而且是一个中国人，所以这政策在我是认为非常正确的，我加入这统一战线，自然，我所使用的仍是一枝笔，所做的事仍是写文章，译书，等到这枝笔没有用了，我可自己相信，用起别的武器来，决不会在徐懋庸等辈之下！
But here I have something to say. The first is my attitude towards the anti-Japanese united front. In fact, I have said it in several places, but Xu Maoyong and others seemed to refuse to take a look, but blindly bit me, insisted on framing me of "undermining the united front", and insisted on teaching me a lesson that I "did not understand the current basic policies". I don't know what "basic policies" Xu Maoyong and others have. (Isn't their basic policy to bite me a few times?) However, I have seen the policy of the anti-Japanese united front proposed by China's current revolutionary political parties to the people of the whole country, and I have joined the front unconditionally, because I am not only a writer, but also a Chinese, so this policy is very correct in my opinion, and I joined this united front, naturally, I still use a pen, and what I do is still to write articles and translate books, and when this pen is useless, I can believe that I will never be under Xu Maoyong and others when I use other weapons!其次，我对于文艺界统一战线的态度。我赞成一切文学家，任何派别的文学家在抗日的口号之下统一起来的主张。我也曾经提出过我对于组织这种统一的团体的意见过，那些意见，自然是被一些所谓“指导家”格杀了，反而即刻从天外飞来似地加我以“破坏统一战线”的罪名。这首先就使我暂不加入“文艺家协会”了，因为我要等一等，看一看，他们究竟干的什么勾当；我那时实在有点怀疑那些自称“指导家”以及徐懋庸式的青年，因为据我的经验，那种表面上扮着“革命”的面孔，而轻易诬陷别人为“内奸”，为“反革命”，为“托派”，以至为“汉奸”者，大半不是正路人；因为他们巧妙地格杀革命的民族的力量，不顾革命的大众的利益，而只借革命以营私，老实说，我甚至怀疑过他们是否系敌人所派遣。我想，我不如暂避无益于人的危险，暂不听他们指挥罢。自然，事实会证明他们到底的真相，我决不愿来断定他们是什么人，但倘使他们真的志在革命与民族，而不过心术的不正当，观念的不正确，方式的蠢笨，那我就以为他们实有自行改正一下的必要。我对于“文艺家协会”的态度，我认为它是抗日的作家团体，其中虽有徐懋庸式的人，却也包含了一些新的人；但不能以为有了“文艺家协会”，就是文艺界的统一战线告成了，还远得很，还没有将一切派别的文艺家都联为一气。那原因就在“文艺家协会”还非常浓厚的含有宗派主义和行帮情形。不看别的，单看那章程，对于加入者的资格就限制得太严；就是会员要缴一元入会费，两元年费，也就表示着“作家阀”的倾向，不是抗日“人民式”的了。在理论上，如《文学界》创刊号上所发表的关于“联合问题”和“国防文学”的文章，是基本上宗派主义的；一个作者引用了我在一九三〇年讲的话，并以那些话为出发点，因此虽声声口口说联合任何派别的作家，而仍自己一相情愿的制定了加入的限制与条件。这是作者忘记了时代。我以为文艺家在抗日问题上的联合是无条件的，只要他不是汉奸，愿意或赞成抗日，则不论叫哥哥妹妹，之乎者也，或鸳鸯蝴蝶都无妨。但在文学问题上我们仍可以互相批判。这个作者又引例了法国的人民阵线，然而我以为这又是作者忘记了国度，因为我们的抗日人民统一战线是比法国的人民阵线还要广泛得多的。另一个作者解释“国防文学”，说“国防文学”必须有正确的创作方法，又说现在不是“国防文学”就是“汉奸文学”，欲以“国防文学”一口号去统一作家，也先豫备了“汉奸文学”这名词作为后日批评别人之用。这实在是出色的宗派主义的理论。我以为应当说：作家在“抗日”的旗帜，或者在“国防”的旗帜之下联合起来；不能说：作家在“国防文学”的口号下联合起来，因为有些作者不写“国防为主题”的作品，仍可从各方面来参加抗日的联合战线；即使他像我一样没有加入“文艺家协会”，也未必就是“汉奸”。“国防文学”不能包括一切文学，因为在“国防文学”与“汉奸文学”之外，确有既非前者也非后者的文学，除非他们有本领也证明了《红楼梦》，《子夜》，《阿Q正传》是“国防文学”或“汉奸文学”。这种文学存在着，但它不是杜衡，韩侍桁，杨邨人之流的什么“第三种文学”。因此，我很同意郭沫若先生的“国防文艺是广义的爱国主义的文学”和“国防文艺是作家关系间的标帜，不是作品原则上的标帜”的意见。我提议“文艺家协会”应该克服它的理论上与行动上的宗派主义与行帮现象，把限度放得更宽些，同时最好将所谓“领导权”移到那些确能认真做事的作家和青年手里去，不能专让徐懋庸之流的人在包办。至于我个人的加入与否，却并非重要的事。
Secondly, my attitude towards the united front of the literary and artistic circles. I agree with the idea that all writers, writers of any faction, should be united under the slogan of anti-Japan. I have also put forward my opinions on organizing such a unified group, and those opinions were naturally killed by some so-called "guides", but immediately flew from the sky to accuse me of "undermining the united front". This first made me not join the "Writers and Artists Association" for the time being, because I had to wait a little longer to see what they were doing; At that time, I was really a little suspicious of those young people who claimed to be "guides" and Xu Maoyong-style, because according to my experience, most of those who easily framed others as "traitors", "counter-revolutionaries", "Trotskyists", and even "traitors" on the surface were not righteous passers-by; Because they skillfully kill the power of the revolutionary people, disregarding the interests of the revolutionary masses, and only using the revolution for their own gain, to be honest, I even doubt whether they were sent by the enemy. I think it would be better for me to avoid dangers that are not helpful to people for the time being, and not listen to their commands for the time being. Naturally, facts will prove the truth about them, and I will never conclude who they are, but if they are really interested in revolution and the nation, and are not just improper in their minds, incorrect in their concepts, and stupid in their methods, then I think they really need to correct themselves. My attitude towards the "Writers and Artists Association" is that it is an anti-Japanese writers' group, although there are Xu Maoyong-style people, but it also includes some new people; But it cannot be thought that with the "Writers and Artists Association", the united front of the literary and artistic circles is complete, and it is still far away, and it has not yet united all factions of writers and artists. The reason is that the "Writers and Artists Association" still contains very strong sectarianism and gangs. If you don't look at anything else, just look at the charter, the qualifications of the joiners are too strict; That is, members have to pay a membership fee of one yuan and a two-year fee, which also indicates the tendency of "family valves", not the anti-Japanese "people's style". In theory, the articles on "joint issues" and "national defense literature" published in the first issue of "Literary Circles" are basically sectarian; One author quoted my words in 1930 and used them as a starting point, so that although he kept saying that he would unite with writers of any faction, he still set the restrictions and conditions for joining in his own willingness. This is the author forgetting the times. I think that the unity of writers and artists on the anti-Japanese issue is unconditional, as long as he is not a traitor and is willing or in favor of anti-Japan, it doesn't matter whether he is called brother or sister, or a mandarin duck butterfly. But we can still criticize each other on literary issues. The author also cited the French Popular Front as an example, but I thought this was the author's forgetfulness of the country, because our anti-Japanese people's united front is much broader than the French Popular Front. Another author explained "national defense literature", saying that "national defense literature" must have a correct creative method, and said that it is now either "national defense literature" or "traitor literature", and that in order to unify writers with the slogan "national defense literature", the term "traitor literature" was also prepared for the use of criticism of others in the future. This is really an excellent theory of sectarianism. I thought it should be said: writers united under the banner of "anti-Japan" or "national defense"; It cannot be said: writers unite under the slogan of "national defense literature", because some authors do not write works with the theme of "national defense", but can still participate in the anti-Japanese united front from all aspects; Even if he does not join the "Writers and Artists Association" like me, he may not be a "traitor". "National defense literature" cannot include all literature, because in addition to "national defense literature" and "traitor literature", there is indeed literature that is neither the former nor the latter, unless they have the ability to prove that "Dream of Red Mansions", "Midnight", and "The True Biography of Ah Q" are "national defense literature" or "traitor literature". This kind of literature exists, but it is not the "third literature" of Du Heng, Han Shijiang, Yang Cunren and others. Therefore, I agree with Mr. Guo Moruo's opinions that "national defense literature and art are patriotic literature in a broad sense" and "national defense literature and art are the markers of the relationship between writers, not the markers of the principle of works". I suggest that the "Writers and Artists Association" should overcome its theoretical and practical sectarianism and gang phenomena, and set the limits wider, and at the same time it is best to transfer the so-called "leadership" to those writers and young people who can really do things seriously, and not let people like Xu Maoyong take care of it. As for whether I personally join or not, it doesn't matter.其次，我和“民族革命战争的大众文学”这口号的关系。徐懋庸之流的宗派主义也表现在对于这口号的态度上。他们既说这是“标新立异”，又说是与“国防文学”对抗。我真料不到他们会宗派到这样的地步。只要“民族革命战争的大众文学”的口号不是“汉奸”的口号，那就是一种抗日的力量；为什么这是“标新立异”？你们从那里看出这是与“国防文学”对抗？拒绝友军之生力的，暗暗的谋杀抗日的力量的，是你们自己的这种比“白衣秀士”王伦还要狭小的气魄。我以为在抗日战线上是任何抗日力量都应当欢迎的，同时在文学上也应当容许各人提出新的意见来讨论，“标新立异”也并不可怕；这和商人的专卖不同，并且事实上你们先前提出的“国防文学”的口号，也并没有到南京政府或“苏维埃”政府去注过册。但现在文坛上仿佛已有“国防文学”牌与“民族革命战争大众文学”牌的两家，这责任应该徐懋庸他们来负，我在病中答访问者的一文里是并没有把它们看成两家的。自然，我还得说一说“民族革命战争的大众文学”这口号的无误及其与“国防文学”口号之关系。——我先得说，前者这口号不是胡风提的，胡风做过一篇文章是事实，但那是我请他做的，他的文章解释得不清楚也是事实。这口号，也不是我一个人的“标新立异”，是几个人大家经过一番商议的，茅盾先生就是参加商议的一个。郭沫若先生远在日本，被侦探监视着，连去信商问也不方便。可惜的就只是没有邀请徐懋庸们来参加议讨。但问题不在这口号由谁提出，只在它有没有错误。如果它是为了推动一向囿于普洛革命文学的左翼作家们跑到抗日的民族革命战争的前线上去，它是为了补救“国防文学”这名词本身的在文学思想的意义上的不明了性，以及纠正一些注进“国防文学”这名词里去的不正确的意见，为了这些理由而被提出，那么它是正当的，正确的。如果人不用脚底皮去思想，而是用过一点脑子，那就不能随便说句“标新立异”就完事。“民族革命战争的大众文学”这名词，在本身上，比“国防文学”这名词，意义更明确，更深刻，更有内容。“民族革命战争的大众文学”，主要是对前进的一向称左翼的作家们提倡的，希望这些作家们努力向前进，在这样的意义上，在进行联合战线的现在，徐懋庸说不能提出这样的口号，是胡说！“民族革命战争的大众文学”，也可以对一般或各派作家提倡的，希望的，希望他们也来努力向前进，在这样的意义上，说不能对一般或各派作家提这样的口号，也是胡说！但这不是抗日统一战线的标准，徐懋庸说我“说这应该作为统一战线的总口号”，更是胡说！我问徐懋庸究竟看了我的文章没有？人们如果看过我的文章，如果不以徐懋庸他们解释“国防文学”的那一套来解释这口号，如聂绀弩等所致的错误，那么这口号和宗派主义或关门主义是并不相干的。这里的“大众”，即照一向的“群众”，“民众”的意思解释也可以，何况在现在，当然有“人民大众”这意思呢。我说“国防文学”是我们目前文学运动的具体口号之一，为的是“国防文学”这口号，颇通俗，已经有很多人听惯，它能扩大我们政治的和文学的影响，加之它可以解释为作家在国防旗帜下联合，为广义的爱国主义的文学的缘故。因此，它即使曾被不正确的解释，它本身含义上有缺陷，它仍应当存在，因为存在对于抗日运动有利益。我以为这两个口号的并存，不必像辛人先生的“时期性”与“时候性”的说法，我更不赞成人们以各种的限制加到“民族革命战争的大众文学”上。如果一定要以为“国防文学”提出在先，这是正统，那么就将正统权让给要正统的人们也未始不可，因为问题不在争口号，而在实做；尽管喊口号，争正统，固然也可作为“文章”，取点稿费，靠此为生，但尽管如此，也到底不是久计。
Secondly, my relationship with the slogan "Popular Literature of the National Revolutionary War". The sectarianism of Xu Maoyong and others is also manifested in their attitude towards this slogan. They say that this is both "unconventional" and confrontation with "national defense literature". I really didn't expect them to be so sectarian. As long as the slogan of "popular literature of the national revolutionary war" is not the slogan of "traitor", it is a kind of anti-Japanese force; Why is this "unconventional"? From where do you see that this is a confrontation with "defense literature"? It is your own courage that is narrower than that of Wang Lun, the "white-clothed scholar", who rejects the vitality of friendly forces and secretly murders the anti-Japanese forces. I think that any anti-Japanese force on the anti-Japanese front should be welcomed, and at the same time, everyone should be allowed to put forward new opinions to discuss in literature, and "unconventional" is not terrible; This is different from the monopoly of merchants, and in fact, the slogan of "national defense literature" that you put forward earlier has not been registered with the Nanjing government or the "Soviet" government. But now there seem to be two brands in the literary world: "National Defense Literature" and "National Revolutionary War Popular Literature", and Xu Maoyong and others should bear this responsibility. Naturally, I have to talk about the infallibility of the slogan "popular literature of the national revolutionary war" and its relationship with the slogan of "national defense literature". ——I have to say that the former slogan was not mentioned by Hu Feng, it is true that Hu Feng made an article, but it was I asked him to do it, and it is also true that his article was not explained clearly. This slogan is not my own "unconventional", it was discussed by several people, and Mr. Mao Dun was one of the people who participated in the discussion. Mr. Guo Moruo is far away in Japan, under the surveillance of detectives, and it is not convenient to even go to the letter to ask. It's a pity that Xu Maoyong and others were not invited to participate in the discussion. But the question is not who proposed this slogan, but whether it is wrong. If it is put forward for these reasons to promote left-wing writers who have always been confined to Prussian revolutionary literature to the front line of the national revolutionary war against Japan, to remedy the ambiguity of the term "national defense literature" itself in the meaning of literary thought, and to correct some incorrect opinions injected into the term "national defense literature", then it is justified and correct for these reasons. If people don't use the skin of their feet to think, but use a little brain, then they can't just say "unconventional" and it's over. The term "popular literature of the national revolutionary war" itself has a clearer, more profound, and more substantial meaning than the term "national defense literature". In this sense, in the present of the United Front, Xu Maoyong said that such a slogan could not be put forward, it was nonsense! "Popular literature of the national revolutionary war" can also be advocated by writers of all walks of life, hoping that they will also work hard, in this sense, it is also nonsense to say that such slogans cannot be put forward to writers in general or from all schools! But this is not the standard of the anti-Japanese united front, Xu Maoyong said that I "said that this should be the general slogan of the united front", which is even more nonsense! I asked Xu Maoyong if he had read my article? If people have read my article, if they do not explain this slogan in the same way that Xu Maoyong and others explain "national defense literature", such as Nie Qiannu, then this slogan has nothing to do with sectarianism or closed-door doctrine. The "masses" here can also be interpreted according to the usual meaning of "masses" and "people", not to mention that now, of course, there is the meaning of "the people". I say that "national defense literature" is one of the specific slogans of our current literary movement, because the slogan "national defense literature" is quite popular and has been heard by many people, it can expand the influence of our politics and literature, and it can be interpreted as the reason for the writers' union under the banner of national defense and patriotic literature in a broad sense. Therefore, even if it has been interpreted incorrectly and its own meaning is flawed, it should still exist because it is beneficial to the anti-Japanese movement. I think that the coexistence of these two slogans does not need to be like Mr. Xin's statement of "period" and "temporality", and I do not approve of people adding various restrictions to the "popular literature of the national revolutionary war". If we must think that "national defense literature" is put forward first, which is orthodoxy, then it is not impossible to give up orthodoxy to those who want orthodoxy, because the problem is not to fight for slogans, but to practice; Although shouting slogans and fighting for orthodoxy can certainly be used as "articles", taking some manuscript fees and making a living from it, but nevertheless, it is not a long-term solution.最后，我要说到我个人的几件事。徐懋庸说我最近半年的言行，助长着恶劣的倾向。我就检查我这半年的言行。所谓言者，是发表过四五篇文章，此外，至多对访问者谈过一些闲天，对医生报告我的病状之类；所谓行者，比较的多一点，印过两本版画，一本杂感，译过几章《死魂灵》，生过三个月的病，签过一个名，此外，也并未到过咸肉庄或赌场，并未出席过什么会议。我真不懂我怎样助长着，以及助长什么恶劣倾向。难道因为我生病么？除了怪我生病而竟不死以外，我想就只有一个说法：怪我生病，不能和徐懋庸这类恶劣的倾向来搏斗。
Finally, I would like to say a few things about myself. Xu Maoyong said that my words and deeds in the past six months have fueled bad tendencies. I will check my words and deeds in the past six months. The so-called speaker is that I have published four or five articles, and at most I have talked to the visitor about some free days, and I have reported my condition to the doctor. The so-called walkers, a little more, have printed two prints, a miscellaneous feeling, translated several chapters of "Dead Souls", been ill for three months, signed a name, and in addition, have not been to a bacon or a casino, and have not attended any meetings. I really don't understand how I promote it and what bad tendencies I foster. Is it because I'm sick? In addition to blaming me for being sick and not dying, I think there is only one way to say it: blame me for being sick, and I can't fight against bad tendencies like Xu Maoyong.其次，是我和胡风，巴金，黄源诸人的关系。我和他们，是新近才认识的，都由于文学工作上的关系，虽然还不能称为至交，但已可以说是朋友。不能提出真凭实据，而任意诬我的朋友为“内奸”，为“卑劣”者，我是要加以辩正的，这不仅是我的交友的道义，也是看人看事的结果。徐懋庸说我只看人，不看事，是诬枉的，我就先看了一些事，然后看见了徐懋庸之类的人。胡风我先前并不熟识，去年的有一天，一位名人约我谈话了，到得那里，却见驶来了一辆汽车，从中跳出四条汉子：田汉，周起应，还有另两个，一律洋服，态度轩昂，说是特来通知我：胡风乃是内奸，官方派来的。我问凭据，则说是得自转向以后的穆木天口中。转向者的言谈，到左联就奉为圣旨，这真使我口呆目瞪。再经几度问答之后，我的回答是：证据薄弱之极，我不相信！当时自然不欢而散，但后来也不再听人说胡风是“内奸”了。然而奇怪，此后的小报，每当攻击胡风时，便往往不免拉上我，或由我而涉及胡风。最近的则如《现实文学》发表了O. V. 笔录的我的主张以后，《社会日报》就说O. V. 是胡风，笔录也和我的本意不合，稍远的则如周文向傅东华抗议删改他的小说时，同报也说背后是我和胡风。最阴险的则是同报在去年冬或今年春罢，登过一则花边的重要新闻：说我就要投降南京，从中出力的是胡风，或快或慢，要看他的办法。我又看自己以外的事：有一个青年，不是被指为“内奸”，因而所有朋友都和他隔离，终于在街上流浪，无处可归，遂被捕去，受了毒刑的么？又有一个青年，也同样的被诬为“内奸”，然而不是因为参加了英勇的战斗，现在坐在苏州狱中，死活不知么？这两个青年就是事实证明了他们既没有像穆木天等似的做过堂皇的悔过的文章，也没有像田汉似的在南京大演其戏。同时，我也看人：即使胡风不可信，但对我自己这人，我自己总还可以相信的，我就并没有经胡风向南京讲条件的事。因此，我倒明白了胡风鲠直，易于招怨，是可接近的，而对于周起应之类，轻易诬人的青年，反而怀疑以至憎恶起来了。自然，周起应也许别有他的优点。也许后来不复如此，仍将成为一个真的革命者；胡风也自有他的缺点，神经质，繁琐，以及在理论上的有些拘泥的倾向，文字的不肯大众化，但他明明是有为的青年，他没有参加过任何反对抗日运动或反对过统一战线，这是纵使徐懋庸之流用尽心机，也无法抹杀的。
Secondly, there is my relationship with Hu Feng, Ba Jin, Huang Yuan and others. They and I have only recently met, and because of our literary work, although we cannot be called close friends, we can already be said to be friends. I can't put forward real evidence, but arbitrarily accuse my friends of being "traitors" and "despicable", I want to defend them, which is not only the morality of my friends, but also the result of looking at people and things. Xu Maoyong said that I only look at people, not things, which is false, so I first looked at some things, and then I saw people like Xu Maoyong. I didn't know Hu Feng before, but one day last year, a celebrity asked me to talk, and when I got there, I saw a car coming, and four men jumped out of it: Tian Han, Zhou Qiying, and the other two, all dressed in Western clothes, with a loud attitude, saying that they came to inform me: Hu Feng was a traitor, sent by the official. I asked for evidence, and he said it came from the mouth of Mu Mutian after turning around. The words of the converts were regarded as imperial decrees when they reached the left link, which really stunned me. After a few more questions and answers, my answer was: The evidence is extremely weak, I don't believe it! At that time, they naturally broke up unhappily, but later they no longer heard people say that Hu Feng was a "traitor". However, strangely, whenever the tabloids attacked Hu Feng after that, they often pulled me up, or I was involved in Hu Feng. More recently, "Realistic Literature" published O. V. After the transcript of my claims, the Social Daily said that O. V. It was Hu Feng, and the transcript was also inconsistent with my original intention, and a little further away, such as when Zhou Wen protested to Fu Donghua to delete his novel, the same newspaper also said that it was me and Hu Feng behind it. The most insidious thing is that the same newspaper published an important news article in lace last winter or this spring: saying that I am going to surrender to Nanjing, and it is Hu Feng who contributes from it, whether fast or slow, it depends on his methods. I looked at things other than myself: there was a young man who was not accused of being a "traitor", so all his friends were isolated from him, and finally wandered the streets, with nowhere to return, and was arrested and poisoned? There is another young man who was also falsely accused of being a "traitor", but not because he participated in the heroic battle, and now he is sitting in Suzhou prison, not knowing whether he is alive or dead? These two young people proved that they had neither made a grand repentant article like Mu Mutian and others, nor did they perform in Nanjing like Tian Han. At the same time, I also look at people: even if Hu Feng is not trustworthy, I can always trust myself as a person, and I have not told Nanjing about the conditions through Hu Feng. Therefore, I understood that Hu Feng was straightforward, easy to complain, and approachable, but for young people like Zhou Qiying, who were easy to slander people, I became suspicious and even hated. Naturally, Zhou Qiying may have other advantages. Maybe it will not be like this later, and you will still be a real revolutionary; Hu Feng also has his own shortcomings, neuroticism, cumbersomeness, and some tendencies in theory, and his refusal to popularize words, but he is obviously a promising young man, and he has not participated in any anti-Japanese movement or opposed the united front, which cannot be erased even if Xu Maoyong and others try their best.至于黄源，我以为是一个向上的认真的译述者，有《译文》这切实的杂志和别的几种译书为证。巴金是一个有热情的有进步思想的作家，在屈指可数的好作家之列的作家，他固然有“安那其主义者”之称，但他并没有反对我们的运动，还曾经列名于文艺工作者联名的战斗的宣言。黄源也签了名的。这样的译者和作家要来参加抗日的统一战线，我们是欢迎的，我真不懂徐懋庸等类为什么要说他们是“卑劣”？难道因为有《译文》存在碍眼？难道连西班牙的“安那其”的破坏革命，也要巴金负责？
As for Huang Yuan, I think he is an upward and serious translator, as evidenced by the practical magazine "Translation" and several other translations. Ba Jin is a passionate and progressive writer, one of the few good writers, although he is known as an "Anarchist", but he did not oppose our movement, and was once listed in the declaration of the joint battle of literary and artistic workers. Huang Yuan also signed. We welcome such translators and writers to join the anti-Japanese united front, I really don't understand why Xu Maoyong and others say they are "despicable"? Is it because there is an eyesore in the "Translation"? Is even the sabotage of Spain's "Anarchi" to be responsible for Ba Jin?还有，在中国近来已经视为平常，而其实不但“助长”，却正是“恶劣的倾向”的，是无凭无据，却加给对方一个很坏的恶名。例如徐懋庸的说胡风的“诈”，黄源的“谄”，就都是。田汉周起应们说胡风是“内奸”，终于不是，是因为他们发昏；并非胡风诈作“内奸”，其实不是，致使他们成为说谎。《社会日报》说胡风拉我转向，而至今不转，是撰稿者有意的诬陷；并非胡风诈作拉我，其实不拉，以致记者变了造谣。胡风并不“左得可爱”，但我以为他的私敌，却实在是“左得可怕”的。黄源未尝作文捧我，也没有给我做过传，不过专办着一种月刊，颇为尽责，舆论倒还不坏，怎么便是“谄”，怎么便是对于我的“效忠致敬”？难道《译文》是我的私产吗？黄源“奔走于傅郑门下之时，一副谄佞之相”，徐懋庸大概是奉谕知道的了，但我不知道，也没有见过，至于他和我的往还，却不见有“谄佞之相”，而徐懋庸也没有一次同在，我不知道他凭着什么，来断定和谄佞于傅郑门下者“无异”？当这时会，我也就是证人，而并未实见的徐懋庸，对于本身在场的我，竟可以如此信口胡说，含血喷人，这真可谓横暴恣肆，达于极点了。莫非这是“了解”了“现在的基本的政策”之故吗？“和全世界都一样”的吗？那么，可真要吓死人！
In addition, it has been regarded as normal in China recently, but in fact it is not only "promoted", but it is a "bad tendency", which is unfounded and gives the other party a very bad reputation. Hu Feng is not "cute left", but I think his personal enemy is really "terrible left". Is the "Translation" my private property? Huang Yuan "ran under Fu Zheng's door, a flattering appearance", Xu Maoyong probably knew about it, but I don't know, I haven't seen it, as for his interactions with me, but I don't see the "flattering appearance", and Xu Maoyong has never been with me, I don't know what he is doing to conclude that he is "no different" from flattering Fu Zheng's disciples? At this time, I am also a witness, and Xu Maoyong, who has not seen it, can talk nonsense and spray people with blood on me who is present, which can really be described as tyrannical and unrestrained, to the extreme. So, it's really scary!其实“现在的基本政策”是决不会这样的好像天罗地网的。不是只要“抗日”，就是战友吗？“诈”何妨，“谄”又何妨？又何必定要剿灭胡风的文字，打倒黄源的《译文》呢，莫非这里面都是“二十一条”和“文化侵略”吗？首先应该扫荡的，倒是拉大旗作为虎皮，包着自己，去吓呼别人；小不如意，就倚势（！）定人罪名，而且重得可怕的横暴者。自然，战线是会成立的，不过这吓成的战线，作不得战。先前已有这样的前车，而覆车之鬼，至死不悟，现在在我面前，就附着徐懋庸的肉身而出现了。
In fact, the "current basic policy" will never be like this. Isn't it just "anti-Japanese" or comrades-in-arms? Naturally, the front line will be established, but this frightened front cannot be fought. There was such a car before, and the ghost of the overturned car, who did not realize it until death, now appeared in front of me, attached to Xu Maoyong's body.在左联结成的前后，有些所谓革命作家，其实是破落户的漂零子弟。他也有不平，有反抗，有战斗，而往往不过是将败落家族的妇姑勃谿，叔嫂斗法的手段，移到文坛上。嘁嘁嚓嚓，招是生非，搬弄口舌，决不在大处着眼。这衣钵流传不绝。例如我和茅盾，郭沫若两位，或相识，或未尝一面，或未冲突，或曾用笔墨相讥，但大战斗却都为着同一的目标，决不日夜记着个人的恩怨。然而小报却偏喜欢记些鲁比茅如何，郭对鲁又怎样，好像我们只在争座位，斗法宝。就是《死魂灵》，当《译文》停刊后，《世界文库》上也登完第一部的，但小报却说“郑振铎腰斩《死魂灵》”，或鲁迅一怒中止了翻译。这其实正是恶劣的倾向，用谣言来分散文艺界的力量，近于“内奸”的行为的。然而也正是破落文学家最末的道路。
Before and after the formation of the Left Alliance, some so-called revolutionary writers were actually the children of the ruins. 关于太炎先生二三事
