die当印造凯绥·珂勒惠支（Kaethe Kollwitz）所作版画的选集时，曾请史沫德黎（A. Smedley）女士做一篇序。自以为这请得非常合适，因为她们俩原极熟识的。不久做来了，又逼着茅盾先生译出，现已登在选集上。其中有这样的文字：
When printing an anthology of prints by Kaethe Kollwitz, A. Smedley was asked to Smedley) wrote a foreword. I thought it was very appropriate to invite them, because they were very familiar with each other. Soon after, he was forced to translate by Mr. Mao Dun, and it has now been published in the anthology. Among them is the following text:“许多年来，凯绥·珂勒惠支——她从没有一次利用过赠授给她的头衔——作了大量的画稿，速写，铅笔作的和钢笔作的速写，木刻，铜刻。把这些来研究，就表示着有二大主题支配着，她早年的主题是反抗，而晚年的是母爱，母性的保障，救济，以及死。而笼照于她所有的作品之上的，是受难的，悲剧的，以及保护被压迫者深切热情的意识。
"For many years, Kaiser Kölhuitsch – she never once used the title given to her – made a lot of drawings, sketches, pencil and pen sketches, woodcuts, and bronze engravings. Studying these means that there are two major themes dominating: the theme of her early years is resistance, and her later years are maternal love, maternal protection, relief, and death. And what shrouded all her works is suffering, tragedy, and a deep passion for protecting the oppressed.“有一次我问她：‘从前你用反抗的主题，但是现在你好像很有点抛不开死这观念。这是为什么呢？’用了深有所苦的语调，她回答道，‘也许因为我是一天一天老了！’……”
"I once asked her: 'In the past, you used to use the theme of resistance, but now you seem to be a little unable to get rid of the idea of death. Why is that? In a deeply bitter tone, she replied, 'Maybe it's because I'm getting older day by day!' ’……”我那时看到这里，就想了一想。算起来：她用“死”来做画材的时候，是一九一〇年顷；这时她不过四十三四岁。我今年的这“想了一想”，当然和年纪有关，但回忆十余年前，对于死却还没有感到这么深切。大约我们的生死久已被人们随意处置，认为无足重轻，所以自己也看得随随便便，不像欧洲人那样的认真了。有些外国人说，中国人最怕死。这其实是不确的，——但自然，每不免模模胡胡的死掉则有之。
When I saw this at that time, I thought about it. Counting up: When she used "death" as a painting material, it was around 1910; At this time, she was only forty-three or fourteen years old. My "thought about it" this year is of course related to my age, but recalling more than ten years ago, I still don't feel so deep about death. About our life and death have been disposed of at will for a long time, thinking that they are insignificant, so they also look at it casually, not as serious as Europeans. Some foreigners say that Chinese people are most afraid of death. This is actually inaccurate,—— but naturally, there are inevitable deaths.大家所相信的死后的状态，更助成了对于死的随便。谁都知道，我们中国人是相信有鬼（近时或谓之“灵魂”）的，既有鬼，则死掉之后，虽然已不是人，却还不失为鬼，总还不算是一无所有。不过设想中的做鬼的久暂，却因其人的生前的贫富而不同。穷人们是大抵以为死后就去轮回的，根源出于佛教。佛教所说的轮回，当然手续繁重，并不这么简单，但穷人往往无学，所以不明白。这就是使死罪犯人绑赴法场时，大叫“二十年后又是一条好汉”，面无惧色的原因。况且相传鬼的衣服，是和临终时一样的，穷人无好衣裳，做了鬼也决不怎么体面，实在远不如立刻投胎，化为赤条条的婴儿的上算。我们曾见谁家生了小孩，胎里就穿着叫化子或是游泳家的衣服的么？从来没有。这就好，从新来过。也许有人要问，既然相信轮回，那就说不定来生会堕入更穷苦的景况，或者简直是畜生道，更加可怕了。但我看他们是并不这样想的，他们确信自己并未造出该入畜生道的罪孽，他们从来没有能堕畜生道的地位，权势和金钱。
The state after death that everyone believes is even more conducive to the casualness of death. Everyone knows that we Chinese believe that there are ghosts (or "souls" in recent times), and if there are ghosts, after death, although they are no longer human, they are still ghosts, and they are not nothing. However, the envisioned duration of ghosting varies depending on the wealth and poverty of the person during his lifetime. Poor people probably think that they will be reincarnated after death, and their roots are from Buddhism. The reincarnation mentioned in Buddhism is, of course, complicated and not so simple, but the poor are often uneducated, so they do not understand. This is the reason why when death row inmates are tied up to the court, they shout "Twenty years later, he will be a good man again" without fear. Moreover, it is said that the clothes of ghosts are the same as when they are dying, poor people have no good clothes, and they are never very decent to be ghosts, which is far inferior to the calculation of immediately reincarnated and turned into a naked baby. Have we ever seen anyone give birth to a child wearing clothes called a child or a swimmer in the womb? Never. This is good, start over. Some people may ask, since they believe in reincarnation, they may fall into a poorer situation in the next life, or they may simply be in the animal path, which is even more terrifying. But I don't think they think so, they are convinced that they have not created the sins that should enter the animal path, and they have never been able to fall into the animal path, power, and money.然而有着地位，权势和金钱的人，却又并不觉得该堕畜生道；他们倒一面化为居士，准备成佛，一面自然也主张读经复古，兼做圣贤。他们像活着时候的超出人理一样，自以为死后也超出了轮回的。至于小有金钱的人，则虽然也不觉得该受轮回，但此外也别无雄才大略，只豫备安心做鬼。所以年纪一到五十上下，就给自己寻葬地，合寿材，又烧纸锭，先在冥中存储，生下子孙，每年可吃羹饭。这实在比做人还享福。假使我现在已经是鬼，在阳间又有好子孙，那么，又何必零星卖稿，或向北新书局去算账呢，只要很闲适的躺在楠木或阴沉木的棺材里，逢年逢节，就自有一桌盛馔和一堆国币摆在眼前了，岂不快哉！
However, people with status, power and money do not feel that they should fall into the beast path; On the one hand, they turned into laymen and prepared to become Buddhas, and on the other hand, they naturally advocated reading scriptures and being sages. They are beyond human reason when they are alive, and they think that they are beyond reincarnation after death. As for those who have a little money, although they do not feel that they should be reincarnated, they have no other talents and strategies, and they are only prepared to be ghosts with peace of mind. Therefore, when he is about fifty years old, he finds a burial place for himself, combines longevity materials, burns paper ingots, stores them in the underworld, gives birth to descendants, and can eat soup and rice every year. This is really more blessed than being a human being. If I am already a ghost now, and I have good descendants in the human world, then why bother to sell manuscripts sporadically, or go to the Beixin Bookstore to settle accounts, as long as I lie in a coffin made of nanmu or gloomy wood very leisurely, and during the New Year's and holidays, I will have a table of food and a bunch of national coins in front of me, isn't it happy!就大体而言，除极富贵者和冥律无关外，大抵穷人利于立即投胎，小康者利于长久做鬼。小康者的甘心做鬼，是因为鬼的生活（这两字大有语病，但我想不出适当的名词来），就是他还未过厌的人的生活的连续。阴间当然也有主宰者，而且极其严厉，公平，但对于他独独颇肯通融，也会收点礼物，恰如人间的好官一样。
Generally speaking, except for the extremely rich and the law of the underworld, most of the poor are conducive to immediate reincarnation, and the well-off are conducive to being ghosts for a long time. The willingness of the well-off to be a ghost is because the life of a ghost (these two words are very speech-sick, but I can't think of an appropriate term), that is, the continuation of the life of a person who has not yet been tired of it. Of course, there are also rulers in the underworld, and they are extremely strict and fair, but they are very accommodating to him, and they will also accept some gifts, just like a good official in the world.有一批人是随随便便，就是临终也恐怕不大想到的，我向来正是这随便党里的一个。三十年前学医的时候，曾经研究过灵魂的有无，结果是不知道；又研究过死亡是否苦痛，结果是不一律，后来也不再深究，忘记了。近十年中，有时也为了朋友的死，写点文章，不过好像并不想到自己。这两年来病特别多，一病也比较的长久，这才往往记起了年龄，自然，一面也为了有些作者们笔下的好意的或是恶意的不断的提示。
There is a group of people who are casual, even when they are dying, I am afraid they don't think of it, and I have always been one of this casual party. When I was studying medicine thirty years ago, I studied the existence of the soul, but I didn't know it. I also studied whether death was painful, but the results were not uniform, and I didn't delve into it and forgot about it. In the past ten years, I have sometimes written articles for the death of my friends, but I don't seem to think of myself. In the past two years, there have been many illnesses, and the first illness has been relatively long, so I often remember my age, naturally, and on the other hand, I also give good or malicious reminders from some authors.从去年起，每当病后休养，躺在藤躺椅上，每不免想到体力恢复后应该动手的事情：做什么文章，翻译或印行什么书籍。想定之后，就结束道：就是这样罢——但要赶快做。这“要赶快做”的想头，是为先前所没有的，就因为在不知不觉中，记得了自己的年龄。却从来没有直接的想到“死”。
Since last year, whenever I recuperate from illness and lie on a rattan lounger, I can't help but think about what I should do after recovering from my physical strength: what articles to do, what books to translate or print. After thinking about it, he ended: That's it - but do it quickly. This idea of "do it quickly" is something that has never existed before, because unconsciously, I remember my age. But I never thought of "death" directly.直到今年的大病，这才分明的引起关于死的豫想来。原先是仍如每次的生病一样，一任着日本的S医师的诊治的。他虽不是肺病专家，然而年纪大，经验多，从习医的时期说，是我的前辈，又极熟识，肯说话。自然，医师对于病人，纵使怎样熟识，说话是还是有限度的，但是他至少已经给了我两三回警告，不过我仍然不以为意，也没有转告别人。大约实在是日子太久，病象太险了的缘故罢，几个朋友暗自协商定局，请了美国的D医师来诊察了。他是在上海的唯一的欧洲的肺病专家，经过打诊，听诊之后，虽然誉我为最能抵抗疾病的典型的中国人，然而也宣告了我的就要灭亡；并且说，倘是欧洲人，则在五年前已经死掉。这判决使善感的朋友们下泪。我也没有请他开方，因为我想，他的医学从欧洲学来，一定没有学过给死了五年的病人开方的法子。然而D医师的诊断却实在是极准确的，后来我照了一张用X光透视的胸像，所见的景象，竟大抵和他的诊断相同。
It wasn't until this year's serious illness that it clearly aroused the idea of death. Originally, it was still the same as every illness, and it was diagnosed and treated by Dr. S in Japan. Although he is not a pulmonologist, he is old, has a lot of experience, and is my senior from the period of medical practice, and he is very familiar with it and willing to speak. Naturally, no matter how familiar the doctor is with the patient, there is still a limit to what he can say, but he has given me at least two or three warnings, but I still don't care and don't tell others. Probably because it was too long and the disease was too dangerous, a few friends secretly negotiated a decision and invited Dr. D from the United States to come for examination. He was the only European pulmonologist in Shanghai, and after consultation and auscultation, although he praised me as the typical Chinese who could resist the disease the most, he also announced that I was about to perish; And if it were a European, he would have died five years ago. The verdict brought tears to the eyes of the sympathetic friends. I didn't ask him to prescribe a prescription, because I thought that his medicine came from Europe, and he must not have learned how to prescribe a prescription to a patient who had been dead for five years. However, Dr. D's diagnosis was very accurate, and I later took a bust with X-rays, and what I saw was probably the same as his diagnosis.我并不怎么介意于他的宣告，但也受了些影响，日夜躺着，无力谈话，无力看书。连报纸也拿不动，又未曾炼到“心如古井”，就只好想，而从此竟有时要想到“死”了。不过所想的也并非“二十年后又是一条好汉”，或者怎样久住在楠木棺材里之类，而是临终之前的琐事。在这时候，我才确信，我是到底相信人死无鬼的。我只想到过写遗嘱，以为我倘曾贵为宫保，富有千万，儿子和女婿及其他一定早已逼我写好遗嘱了，现在却谁也不提起。但是，我也留下一张罢。当时好像很想定了一些，都是写给亲属的，其中有的是：
I didn't mind his announcement much, but I was also affected by it, lying down day and night, unable to talk, unable to read. I can't even hold the newspaper, and I haven't been able to refine "my heart is like an ancient well", so I have to think, and sometimes I have to think of "death" from now on. However, what I was thinking about was not "being a good man again in twenty years", or how to live in a nanmu coffin for a long time, but trivial matters before dying. At this time, I was convinced that I really believed that there are no ghosts in death. I only thought about writing a will, thinking that if I had been a palace protector and rich in tens of millions, my son, son-in-law and others would have forced me to write a will, but now no one mentions it. However, I will also leave one. At that time, it seemed that some of them were written to relatives, some of which were:一，不得因为丧事，收受任何人的一文钱。——但老朋友的，不在此例。
1. Do not accept a penny from anyone because of funerals. ——But old friends' are not like this.二，赶快收敛，埋掉，拉倒。
Second, quickly converge, bury it, and pull it down.三，不要做任何关于纪念的事情。
Third, don't do anything about commemoration.四，忘记我，管自己生活。——倘不，那就真是胡涂虫。
Fourth, forget me and take care of your own life. ——If not, then it's really a nonsense.五，孩子长大，倘无才能，可寻点小事情过活，万不可去做空头文学家或美术家。
Fifth, when children grow up, if they have no talent, they can find some small things to live, and they must not be empty writers or artists.六，别人应许给你的事物，不可当真。
6. Don't take what others promise you.七，损着别人的牙眼，却反对报复，主张宽容的人，万勿和他接近。
Seventh, those who damage other people's teeth and eyes, but oppose retaliation and advocate tolerance, should never approach him.此外自然还有，现在忘记了。只还记得在发热时，又曾想到欧洲人临死时，往往有一种仪式，是请别人宽恕，自己也宽恕了别人。我的怨敌可谓多矣，倘有新式的人问起我来，怎么回答呢？我想了一想，决定的是：让他们怨恨去，我也一个都不宽恕。
In addition, naturally, there is now, forgotten. I only remember that when I had a fever, I thought that when Europeans were dying, there was often a ritual to ask others to forgive, and I forgave others. I have many enemies, if someone asks me about a new style, how will I answer? I thought about it for a while, and what I decided: let them resent it, and I won't forgive anyone.但这仪式并未举行，遗嘱也没有写，不过默默的躺着，有时还发生更切迫的思想：原来这样就算是在死下去，倒也并不苦痛；但是，临终的一刹那，也许并不这样的罢；然而，一世只有一次，无论怎样，总是受得了的……。后来，却有了转机，好起来了。到现在，我想，这些大约并不是真的要死之前的情形，真的要死，是连这些想头也未必有的，但究竟如何，我也不知道。
But this ceremony was not held, and the will was not written, but lying silently, sometimes more urgent thoughts occurred: it turned out that even if I was dying, it would not be painful; However, at the moment of death, it may not be like this; However, there is only one time in a lifetime, no matter what, and it is always a ...... that can be endured. Later, there was a turnaround, and it got better. Up to now, I think that these are not the situation before I really die, and if I really want to die, I may not even have these thoughts, but I don't know how.九月五日。
September 5th.

女吊

女吊

女吊

Female mourning大概是明末的王思任说的罢：“会稽乃报仇雪耻之乡，非藏垢纳污之地！”这对于我们绍兴人很有光彩，我也很喜欢听到，或引用这两句话。但其实，是并不的确的；这地方，无论为那一样都可以用。
Probably Wang Siren at the end of the Ming Dynasty said: "Kuaiji is the hometown of revenge and shame, not a place to hide dirt and dirt!" This is very glorious for us Shaoxing people, and I also like to hear or quote these two sentences. But in fact, it is not true; This place can be used for that one.不过一般的绍兴人，并不像上海的“前进作家”那样憎恶报复，却也是事实。单就文艺而言，他们就在戏剧上创造了一个带复仇性的，比别的一切鬼魂更美，更强的鬼魂。这就是“女吊”。我以为绍兴有两种特色的鬼，一种是表现对于死的无可奈何，而且随随便便的“无常”，我已经在《朝华夕拾》里得了绍介给全国读者的光荣了，这回就轮到别一种。
However, it is also true that ordinary Shaoxing people do not hate revenge like the "forward writers" in Shanghai. As far as literature and art are concerned, they have created a vengeful ghost in the drama, more beautiful and stronger than all other ghosts. This is the "female hanging". I thought that Shaoxing had two characteristic ghosts, one was to show helplessness about death, and casual "impermanence", I had already won the glory of Shaojie to readers across the country in "Chaohua Xishi", and this time it was the turn of the other one.“女吊”也许是方言，翻成普通的白话，只好说是“女性的吊死鬼”。其实，在平时，说起“吊死鬼”，就已经含有“女性的”的意思的，因为投缳而死者，向来以妇人女子为最多。有一种蜘蛛，用一枝丝挂下自己的身体，悬在空中，《尔雅》上已谓之“蚬，缢女”，可见在周朝或汉朝，自经的已经大抵是女性了，所以那时不称它为男性的“缢夫”或中性的“缢者”。不过一到做“大戏”或“目连戏”的时候，我们便能在看客的嘴里听到“女吊”的称呼。也叫作“吊神”。横死的鬼魂而得到“神”的尊号的，我还没有发见过第二位，则其受民众之爱戴也可想。但为什么这时独要称她“女吊”呢？很容易解：因为在戏台上，也要有“男吊”出现了。
"Female hanging" may be a dialect, translated into ordinary vernacular, so it can only be said that it is "female hanging ghost". In fact, in normal times, when it comes to "hanging ghosts", it already contains the meaning of "female", and women have always been the most women who die because of hanging. There is a kind of spider that hangs its body with a piece of silk and hangs in the air, which has been called "clam, hanged woman" in "Erya", which shows that in the Zhou Dynasty or the Han Dynasty, the self-hanging was probably a woman, so it was not called a male "hanger" or a neutral "hanger" at that time. However, when it comes to doing "big drama" or "mulian drama", we can hear the name of "female hanging" in the mouths of the audience. It is also called "hanging god". I have not yet seen the second person who has been given the honorific title of "god" by the ghost of the sudden death, so it is conceivable that he is loved by the people. But why do you have to call her "female hanging" at this time? It's easy to understand: because on the stage, there must also be a "male hanger".我所知道的是四十年前的绍兴，那时没有达官显宦，所以未闻有专门为人（堂会？）的演剧。凡做戏，总带着一点社戏性，供着神位，是看戏的主体，人们去看，不过叨光。但“大戏”或“目连戏”所邀请的看客，范围可较广了，自然请神，而又请鬼，尤其是横死的怨鬼。所以仪式就更紧张，更严肃。一请怨鬼，仪式就格外紧张严肃，我觉得这道理是很有趣的。
What I know is Shaoxing forty years ago, when there were no dignitaries and eunuchs, so I have never heard of anyone specializing in people (hall meetings?). ) play. Whenever a play is made, it always has a bit of social drama, offering the divine position, which is the main body of watching the play, and people go to see it, but it is just a waste of time. However, the spectators invited by the "big opera" or "Mulian opera" can be wider, and they naturally invite gods and ghosts, especially the resentful ghosts who die suddenly. Therefore, the ceremony is more tense and serious. When the ghost is invited, the ceremony is particularly tense and serious, which I think is very interesting.也许我在别处已经写过。“大戏”和“目连”，虽然同是演给神，人，鬼看的戏文，但两者又很不同。不同之点：一在演员，前者是专门的戏子，后者则是临时集合的Amateur——农民和工人；一在剧本，前者有许多种，后者却好歹总只演一本《目连救母记》。然而开场的“起殇”，中间的鬼魂时时出现，收场的好人升天，恶人落地狱，是两者都一样的。
Maybe I've already written about it elsewhere. "Big Opera" and "Mulian", although they are both dramas for gods, people, and ghosts, they are very different. The differences are: one is the actors, the former is a special actor, and the latter is a temporary collection of Amateur - peasants and workers; One is in the script, the former has many kinds, but the latter always only acts in one "Mu Lian Saves Mother". However, in the opening "Rising Death", the ghost in the middle appears from time to time, and the good guy at the end ascends to heaven and the evil person goes to hell, which is the same for both.当没有开场之前，就可看出这并非普通的社戏，为的是台两旁早已挂满了纸帽，就是高长虹之所谓“纸糊的假冠”，是给神道和鬼魂戴的。所以凡内行人，缓缓的吃过夜饭，喝过茶，闲闲而去，只要看挂着的帽子，就能知道什么鬼神已经出现。因为这戏开场较早，“起殇”在太阳落尽时候，所以饭后去看，一定是做了好一会了，但都不是精彩的部分。“起殇”者，绍兴人现已大抵误解为“起丧”，以为就是召鬼，其实是专限于横死者的。《九歌》中的《国殇》云：“身既死兮神以灵，魂魄毅兮为鬼雄”，当然连战死者在内。明社垂绝，越人起义而死者不少，至清被称为叛贼，我们就这样的一同招待他们的英灵。在薄暮中，十几匹马，站在台下了；戏子扮好一个鬼王，蓝面鳞纹，手执钢叉，还得有十几名鬼卒，则普通的孩子都可以应募。我在十余岁时候，就曾经充过这样的义勇鬼，爬上台去，说明志愿，他们就给在脸上涂上几笔彩色，交付一柄钢叉。待到有十多人了，即一拥上马，疾驰到野外的许多无主孤坟之处，环绕三匝，下马大叫，将钢叉用力的连连掷刺在坟墓上，然后拔叉驰回，上了前台，一同大叫一声，将钢叉一掷，钉在台板上。我们的责任，这就算完结，洗脸下台，可以回家了，但倘被父母所知，往往不免挨一顿竹篠（这是绍兴打孩子的最普通的东西），一以罚其带着鬼气，二以贺其没有跌死，但我却幸而从来没有被觉察，也许是因为得了恶鬼保佑的缘故罢。
Before the opening, it can be seen that this is not an ordinary social drama, because the stage is already covered with paper hats, which is Gao Changhong's so-called "fake crown of paper paste", which is worn for Shinto and ghosts. Therefore, all insiders, slowly eat overnight dinner, drink tea, and leisurely leave, just look at the hanging hat to know what ghosts and gods have appeared. Because this play starts early, "Rising and Falling" is when the sun sets, so if you go to see it after dinner, it must have been done for a while, but it is not the wonderful part. The "mourning" is now largely misunderstood by Shaoxing people as "mourning", thinking that it is to summon ghosts, but in fact it is limited to the tragic death. The "National Death" in the "Nine Songs" says: "The body is dead and the spirit is spiritual, and the soul is resolute as a ghost hero", of course, including the dead in battle. The Ming Society was dying, and many Yue people died in the uprising, and the Qing Dynasty was called a traitor, so we entertained their heroic spirits together. In the twilight, more than a dozen horses stood under the stage; The actor dressed up as a ghost king, with a blue face and scales, holding a steel fork, and there must be more than a dozen ghost soldiers, so ordinary children can enlist. When I was in my teens, I once acted as such a volunteer ghost, climbed onto the stage, and explained my volunteerism, and they painted a few colors on my face and handed me a steel fork. When there were more than ten people, they got on their horses, galloped to many ownerless and lonely graves in the wild, circled three times, dismounted and shouted, threw the steel fork hard and stabbed it on the grave, then pulled out the fork and galloped back, went to the front desk, shouted together, threw the steel fork, and nailed it to the table. Our responsibility, this is over, wash your face and step down, you can go home, but if your parents know about it, you will often have to be beaten with bamboo (this is the most ordinary thing in Shaoxing to beat children), one is to punish him for having ghostly energy, and the other is to congratulate him for not falling to death, but fortunately I have never been noticed, maybe because of the blessing of evil spirits.这一种仪式，就是说，种种孤魂厉鬼，已经跟着鬼王和鬼卒，前来和我们一同看戏了，但人们用不着担心，他们深知道理，这一夜决不丝毫作怪。于是戏文也接着开场，徐徐进行，人事之中，夹以出鬼：火烧鬼，淹死鬼，科场鬼（死在考场里的），虎伤鬼……孩子们也可以自由去扮，但这种没出息鬼，愿意去扮的并不多，看客也不将它当作一回事。一到“跳吊”时分——“跳”是动词，意义和“跳加官”之“跳”同——情形的松紧可就大不相同了。台上吹起悲凉的喇叭来，中央的横梁上，原有一团布，也在这时放下，长约戏台高度的五分之二。看客们都屏着气，台上就闯出一个不穿衣裤，只有一条犊鼻，面施几笔粉墨的男人，他就是“男吊”。一登台，径奔悬布，像蜘蛛的死守着蛛丝，也如结网，在这上面钻，挂。他用布吊着各处：腰，胁，胯下，肘弯，腿弯，后项窝……一共七七四十九处。最后才是脖子，但是并不真套进去的，两手扳着布，将颈子一伸，就跳下，走掉了。这“男吊”最不易跳，演目连戏时，独有这一个脚色须特请专门的戏子。那时的老年人告诉我，这也是最危险的时候，因为也许会招出真的“男吊”来。所以后台上一定要扮一个王灵官，一手捏诀，一手执鞭，目不转睛的看着一面照见前台的镜子。倘镜中见有两个，那么，一个就是真鬼了，他得立刻跳出去，用鞭将假鬼打落台下。假鬼一落台，就该跑到河边，洗去粉墨，挤在人丛中看戏，然后慢慢的回家。倘打得慢，他就会在戏台上吊死；洗得慢，真鬼也还会认识，跟住他。这挤在人丛中看自己们所做的戏，就如要人下野而念佛，或出洋游历一样，也正是一种缺少不得的过渡仪式。
This kind of ceremony, that is, all kinds of lonely ghosts, have followed the ghost king and ghost pawns to watch the play with us, but people don't need to worry, they know the reason, and they will never make any trouble this night. So the drama also began, slowly proceeding, and in the middle of the personnel, there were ghosts: burning ghosts, drowning ghosts, science ghosts (dying in the examination room), tiger injuring ghosts...... Children are also free to pretend, but there are not many people willing to pretend to be this kind of unpromising ghost, and the spectators do not take it seriously. When it comes to "jumping" - "jumping" is a verb, and the meaning is the same as "jumping" in "jumping and adding officials" - the tightness of the situation is very different. A sad trumpet blew on the stage, and on the beam in the center, there was originally a lump of cloth, which was also lowered at this time, about two-fifths of the height of the stage. The spectators held their breath, and a man with no clothes and pants, only a calf nose, and a few strokes of powder on his face broke out on the stage, he was the "male hanging". As soon as he stepped onto the stage, he ran straight to the hanging cloth, like a spider holding on to the silk, and also like a web, drilling and hanging on it. He hung it everywhere: waist, flanks, crotch, elbow bends, legs, back neck socket...... There are a total of seven seven forty-nine places. In the end, it was the neck, but it wasn't really put in, he grabbed the cloth with both hands, stretched his neck, jumped down, and walked away. This "male hanging" is the most difficult to jump, and when performing a drama, this is the only one that requires special actors. The elderly at that time told me that this was also the most dangerous time, because it might recruit real "male hangers". Therefore, you must pretend to be a Wang Lingguan backstage, pinching the spell in one hand and holding the whip in the other, staring intently at a mirror that reflects the front desk. If there are two in the mirror, then one is a real ghost, and he has to jump out immediately and knock the fake ghost off the stage with a whip. As soon as the fake ghost comes off the stage, he should run to the river, wash off the powder, huddle in the crowd to watch the play, and then slowly go home. if he fights slowly, he will hang himself on the stage; If you wash slowly, the real ghost will still know you, follow him. This crowding in the crowd to watch the play they are doing, like asking people to go to the wilderness to chant Buddha, or travel abroad, is also an indispensable transition ritual.这之后，就是“跳女吊”。自然先有悲凉的喇叭；少顷，门幕一掀，她出场了。大红衫子，黑色长背心，长发蓬松，颈挂两条纸锭，垂头，垂手，弯弯曲曲的走一个全台，内行人说：这是走了一个“心”字。为什么要走“心”字呢？我不明白。我只知道她何以要穿红衫。看王充的《论衡》，知道汉朝的鬼的颜色是红的，但再看后来的文字和图画，却又并无一定颜色，而在戏文里，穿红的则只有这“吊神”。意思是很容易了然的；因为她投缳之际，准备作厉鬼以复仇，红色较有阳气，易于和生人相接近，……绍兴的妇女，至今还偶有搽粉穿红之后，这才上吊的。自然，自杀是卑怯的行为，鬼魂报仇更不合于科学，但那些都是愚妇人，连字也不认识，敢请“前进”的文学家和“战斗”的勇士们不要十分生气罢。我真怕你们要变呆鸟。
After this, it is "jumping female hanging". Naturally, there is a sad trumpet first; After a while, the curtain lifted and she appeared. Big red shirt, long black vest, long hair fluffy, two paper ingots hanging around the neck, hanging head, hanging hands, walking a whole stage in a curved way, insiders said: This is a "heart" word. Why do you want to use the word "heart"? I don't understand. I only know why she wants to wear a red shirt. Looking at Wang Chong's "Lunheng", I know that the color of the ghosts of the Han Dynasty is red, but looking at the later texts and pictures, there is no certain color, and in the play, the only one wearing red is this "hanging god". The meaning is easy to understand; Because when she hanged herself, she was ready to be a ghost to take revenge, and red was more yang and easy to get close to strangers,...... Women in Shaoxing still occasionally hang themselves after wearing pink and red. Naturally, suicide is a cowardly act, and ghost revenge is even more unscientific, but those are foolish women, who don't even know the words, and dare not be very angry with the writers who "advance" and the warriors who "fight". I'm really afraid that you will become stupid birds.她将披着的头发向后一抖，人这才看清了脸孔：石灰一样白的圆脸，漆黑的浓眉，乌黑的眼眶，猩红的嘴唇。听说浙东的有几府的戏文里，吊神又拖着几寸长的假舌头，但在绍兴没有。不是我袒护故乡，我以为还是没有好；那么，比起现在将眼眶染成淡灰色的时式打扮来，可以说是更彻底，更可爱。不过下嘴角应该略略向上，使嘴巴成为三角形：这也不是丑模样。假使半夜之后，在薄暗中，远处隐约着一位这样的粉面朱唇，就是现在的我，也许会跑过去看看的，但自然，却未必就被诱惑得上吊。她两肩微耸，四顾，倾听，似惊，似喜，似怒，终于发出悲哀的声音，慢慢地唱道：

I heard that in the dramas of several prefectures in eastern Zhejiang, the hanging god dragged a fake tongue several inches long, but not in Shaoxing. It's not that I protect my hometown, I think it's still not good; Then, compared to the current fashion style of dyeing the eyes gray, it can be said to be more thorough and cute. I don't know the following. It was this sentence that I had just heard from Keshi. But the general idea is that she later became a child bride, was abused, and finally hanged. The custom follows, although the woman hangs unavoidably, she sometimes only "asks for replacement" and forgets revenge. In fact, Chinese people are not "self-aware", and the shortcoming is only that some people are content with "self-deception" and want to "deceive others". For example, a patient suffers from edema, but avoids illness and avoids doctors, hoping that others will mistakenly think that he is obese. If someone points out to their face: this is not obesity, but edema, and it is not "good", it is just a disease. Then he was disappointed and shy, and became angry, and scolded the one who pointed out, thinking that he was foolish. However, he still wanted to scare him, deceive him, and hope that he would be afraid of his master's anger and scolding, so he looked at it again anxiously, looked for the good points, and changed his words to say that this was indeed obesity. So he was comforted, happy, and relieved and swollen.不看“辱华影片”，于自己是并无益处的，不过自己不看见，闭了眼睛浮肿着而已。但看了而不反省，却也并无益处。我至今还在希望有人翻出斯密斯的《支那人气质》来。看了这些，而自省，分析，明白那几点说的对，变革，挣扎，自做工夫，却不求别人的原谅和称赞，来证明究竟怎样的是中国人。

后又据《雪庵絮墨》，述清朝对于开创功臣，皆配享太庙，然无汉人之耿精忠，尚可喜，吴三桂，洪承畴四名，洪且由乾隆列之《贰臣传》之首，于是诫曰：“似这样丢脸的事情，我想不独含怨泉下的洪经略要大吃一惊，凡一班吃里爬外，枪口向内的狼鼠之辈，读此亦当憬然而悟矣。”

Dawn corner《社会日报》久不载《艺人腻事》了，上海《大公报》的《本埠增刊》上，却载起《文人腻事》来。“文”“腻”两音差多，事也并不全“腻”，这真叫作“一代不如一代”。但也常有意外的有趣文章，例如九月十五日的《张资平在女学生心中》条下，有记的是：

Although he is a love novel writer, he is a rather shrewd and upright character. He does not have the romantic enthusiasm and irresponsible habits of a writer, and he is shrewd and capable, so I am afraid that he will not be able to find a second among writers. Fat figure, short stature, wearing an ill-fitting suit, lining his round dark face, often holding a big leather bag in one hand, with the style of a manager of a foreign company, but there is no check account book in his big leather bag, only the original manuscript of love novels and university handouts. ”原意大约是要写他的“颇为精明方正的”，但恰恰画出了开乐群书店赚钱时代的张资平老板面孔。最妙的是“一手里经常夹着一个大皮包”，但其中“只有恋爱小说的原稿与大学里讲义”：都是可以赚钱的货色，至于“没有支票账册”，就活画了他用不着记账，和开支票付钱。所以当书店关门时，老板依然“一付团团的黝黑的面孔”，而有些卖稿或抽板税的作者，却成了一付尖尖的晦气色的面孔了。
The original intention was probably to write about his "quite shrewd and upright", but it just painted the face of Zhang Ziping's boss in the era of making money from Kailequn Bookstore. The best thing is that "he often has a big leather bag in his hand", but among them, "there are only the manuscripts of love novels and university handouts": they are all goods that can make money, as for "no check book", he doesn't need to keep accounts, and write checks to pay. So when the bookstore closed, the boss still had a "dark face", while some authors who sold manuscripts or collected board taxes became a sharp and unlucky face.

“元宵夜，月光澄湛，皎如白日。 邑前居民神堂火起，严大尹拜灭之；戒市人勿张灯。 时余与友人薛希珍杨子乔同步街头，各有忧色，盖以贼锋甚锐，毫无防备，城不可守也。 街谈巷议，无不言贼事，各以‘来了’二字，互相惊怖。 及贼至，果齐声呼‘来了来了’：非市谶先兆乎？”《热风》中有《来了》一则，臆测而已，这却是具象的实写；而贼自己也喊“来了”，则为《热风》作者所没有想到的。此理易明：“贼”即民耳，故逃与追不同，而所喊的话如一：易地则皆然。
There is a "Coming" in "Hot Wind", which is just speculation, but this is a concrete real writing; And the thief himself shouted "Here it comes", which was not expected by the author of "Hot Wind". This principle is easy to understand: "thieves" are the people, so fleeing is different from chasing, but the shouting is the same: the same is true for changing places.又云：
He also said:“二十二日，……余……匿金身后，即闻有相携而蹶者，有痛楚而呻者，有襁负而至者，一闻贼来，无地可入，真人生之绝境也。及贼徜徉而前，仅一人提刀斫地示威耳；有猛犬逐之，竟惧而走。……”

"Standing on this photo" (7)晓角
Dawn corner近来的日报上作兴附“专刊”，有讲医药的，有讲文艺的，有谈跳舞的；还有“大学生专刊”，“中学生专刊”，自然也有“小学生”和“儿童专刊”；只有“幼稚园生专刊”和“婴儿专刊”，我还没有看见过。
Recently, there have been "special issues" in the daily newspaper, some talking about medicine, some talking about literature and art, and some talking about dancing; There are also "special issues for college students" and "special issues for middle school students", and naturally there are also "primary school students" and "children's special issues"; Only the "special issue for kindergarten students" and "special issue for babies", I have not seen it yet.九月二十七日，偶然看《申报》，遇到了《儿童专刊》，其中有一篇叫作《救救孩子！》，还有一篇“儿童作品”，教小朋友不要看无用的书籍，如果有工夫，“可以看些有用的儿童刊物，或则看看星期日《申报》出版的《儿童专刊》，那是可以增进我们儿童知识的”。
On September 27, I happened to read "Declaration" and came across the "Children's Special Issue", one of which was called "Save the Child! There is also a "children's work", teaching children not to read useless books, if there is work, "you can read some useful children's publications, or read the "Children's Special Issue" published by the "Declaration" on Sunday, which can enhance our children's knowledge."在手里的就是这《儿童专刊》，立刻去看第一篇。果然，发见了不忍删节的应时的名文：
In my hand, I have this "Children's Special Issue", and I immediately read the first article. Sure enough, I found a famous article that I couldn't bear to abridge:小学生们应有的认识
Primary school students should know梦苏
Meng Su最近一个月中，四川的成都，广东的北海，湖北的汉口，以及上海公共租界上，连续出了不幸的案件，便是日本侨民及水兵的被人杀害，国交显出分外严重的不安。
In the past month, there have been a series of unfortunate cases in Chengdu in Sichuan, Beihai in Guangdong, Hankou in Hubei, and in the Shanghai Public Concession, that is, the murder of Japanese expatriates and sailors.小朋友对于这种不幸的案件，作何感想？于我们民族前途的关系是极大的。
How do children feel about this unfortunate case? It has a great relationship with the future of our nation.国际的交涉，在非常时期，做国民的不可没有抗敌御侮的精神；但国交尚在常态的时期，却绝对不可有伤害外侨的越轨行动。倘若以个人的私忿，而杀害外侨，这比较杀害自国人民，罪加一等。因为被杀害的虽然是绝少数人，但会引起别国的误会，加重本国外交上的困难；甚至发生意外的纠纷，把整个民族复兴运动的步骤乱了。这种少数人无意识的轨外行动，实是国法的罪人，民族的败类。我们当引为大戒。要知道这种举动，和战士在战争时的杀敌致果，功罪是绝对相反的。
In international negotiations, in extraordinary times, the people must not have the spirit of resisting the enemy and resisting insults; However, when diplomatic relations are still normal, there must be no deviant actions that harm foreigners. If you kill foreigners out of personal anger, it is a crime that is higher than killing your own people. Because although the vast majority of people were killed, it would cause misunderstandings in other countries and aggravate the diplomatic difficulties of their own countries; There were even unexpected disputes, which disrupted the steps of the entire national revival movement. This kind of unconscious extraterrestrial action of a few people is actually a sinner of national law and a scum of the nation. We should take it as a great precept. You must know that this kind of action is absolutely opposite to the merits and demerits of soldiers killing the enemy during war.小朋友们！试想我们住在国外的侨民，倘使被别国人非法杀害，虽然我们没有兵舰派去登陆保侨，小题大做：我们政府不会提出严厉的要求，得不到丝毫公道的保障；但总禁不住我们同情的愤慨。
Children! Just imagine that if our expatriates living abroad are illegally killed by other people, even though we do not have warships to land and protect overseas Chinese, we will make a big fuss: our government will not make strict demands and will not receive the slightest guarantee of justice; But we can't help but feel the indignation of our sympathy.我们希望别国人民敬视我们的华侨，我们也当敬视任何的外侨；使伤害外侨的非法行为以后不再发生。这才是大国民的风度。
We hope that the people of other countries will respect our overseas Chinese, and we should also respect any foreigners; so that illegal acts of harming aliens will not occur in the future. This is the demeanor of a great nation.这“大国民的风度”非常之好，虽然那“总禁不住”“同情的愤慨”，还嫌过激一点，但就大体而言，是极有益于敦睦邦交的。不过我们站在中国人的立场上，却还“希望”我们对于自己，也有这“大国民的风度”，不要把自国的人民的生命价值，估计得只值外侨的一半，以至于“罪加一等”。主杀奴无罪，奴杀主重办的刑律，自从民国以来（呜呼，二十五年了！）不是早经废止了么？
Although the "can't help it" and "sympathetic indignation" are a bit excessive, on the whole, it is very beneficial to friendly diplomatic relations. However, from the standpoint of the Chinese, we still "hope" that we also have this "great national demeanor" for ourselves, and do not estimate the value of the lives of our own people to be only half of that of foreigners, so that "crime is added to the first degree". Since the Republic of China (ah, twenty-five years!) Isn't it abolished long ago?真的要“救救孩子”。这“于我们民族前途的关系是极大的”！
It is really necessary to "save the child". This "has a great relationship with the future of our nation"!而这也是关于我们的子孙。大朋友，我们既然生着人头，努力来讲人话罢！
And it's about our children and grandchildren. Big friend, since we have human heads, let's try to speak human language!九月二十七日。
September 27th.

后记

后记

后记

postscript《且介亭杂文》共三集，一九三四和三五年的两本，由先生自己于三五年最末的两天编好了，只差未有重看一遍和标明格式。这，或者因为那时总不大健康，所以没有能够做到。
There are three volumes of "Qiejieting Miscellaneous Essays", two copies in 1934 and 35, which were compiled by Mr. himself on the last two days of 35, but they were not reread and marked in format. This, or because I was not very healthy at that time, I was not able to do it.一九三六年作的《末编》，先生自己把存稿放在一起的，是自第一篇至《曹靖华译〈苏联作家七人集〉序》。《因太炎先生而想起的二三事》，和《关于太炎先生二三事》，似乎同属姊妹篇，虽然当时因是未完稿而另外搁开，此刻也把它放在一起了。
In the "Final Compilation" written in 1936, Mr. himself put together the archived manuscripts, from the first article to the "Preface to Cao Jinghua's Translation of the Seven Collections of Soviet Writers". "Two or Three Things Reminded of Mr. Taiyan" and "Two or Three Things About Mr. Taiyan" seem to belong to the same sister chapter, although it was set aside because it was unfinished at the time, and it is also put together at this moment.《附集》的文章，收自《海燕》，《作家》，《现实文学》，《中流》等。《半夏小集》，《这也是生活》，《死》，《女吊》四篇，先生另外保存的，但都是这一年的文章，也就附在《末编》一起了。
The articles of "Supplementary Collection" are collected from "Haiyan", "Writer", "Realistic Literature", "Middle Stream", etc. "Banxia Collection", "This is also Life", "Death", and "Female Hanging" are four articles that Mr. saved separately, but they are all articles of this year, and they are attached to the "Last Compilation".先生在《白莽作〈孩儿塔〉序》中说：“一个人如果还有友情，那么，收存亡友的遗文真如捏着一团火，常要觉得寝食不安，给它企图流布的。”所以就不自量其浅陋，和排印，装订的草率，急于出版的罢。
Mr. said in the "Preface to Bai Mang's 'Children's Tower'": "If a person still has friendship, then the posthumous writings of living and deceased friends are really like pinching a fire, and they often feel restless and try to spread it. "So I don't think I'm shallow, and the typesetting and binding are sloppy, and I'm in a hurry to publish.这里重承好几位朋友的帮助，使这集子能够迅速付印。又蒙内山先生给予便利，得以销行，谨当深深表示谢意的。
With the help of several friends, this collection can be printed quickly. In addition, Mr. Meng Neishan gave me the convenience and was able to sell it, and I would like to express my deep gratitude.一九三七年六月二十五日，许广平记。

June 25, 1937, Xu Guangping Ji.

序言

序言

序言

序言听说：中国的好作家是大抵“悔其少作”的，他在自定集子的时候，就将少年时代的作品尽力删除，或者简直全部烧掉。我想，这大约和现在的老成的少年，看见他婴儿时代的出屁股，衔手指的照相一样，自愧其幼稚，因而觉得有损于他现在的尊严，——于是以为倘使可以隐蔽，总还是隐蔽的好。但我对于自己的“少作”，愧则有之，悔却从来没有过。出屁股，衔手指的照相，当然是惹人发笑的，但自有婴年的天真，决非少年以至老年所能有。况且如果少时不作，到老恐怕也未必就能作，又怎么还知道悔呢？
I heard that good Chinese writers generally "regret their lack of work", and when they set their own collections, they try their best to delete their youthful works, or simply burn them all. I think this is about the same as the old boy now, who saw the photo of his buttocks sticking out and holding his finger when he was a baby, and felt that it was detrimental to his current dignity,—— so he thought that if he could hide it, it would always be better to hide. But I am ashamed of my "less work", but I have never regretted it. The photo of sticking out the buttocks and holding the finger is of course laughable, but the innocence of infancy is by no means something that teenagers and old age can have. Moreover, if you don't do it when you are young, you may not be able to do it when you are old, so how can you still know how to regret it?先前自己编了一本《坟》，还留存着许多文言文，就是这意思；这意思和方法，也一直至今没有变。但是，也有漏落的：是因为没有留存着底子，忘记了。也有故意删掉的：是或者因为看去好像抄译，却又年远失记，连自己也怀疑；或者因为不过对于一人，一时的事，和大局无关，情随事迁，无须再录；或者因为本不过开些玩笑，或是出于暂时的误解，几天之后，便无意义，不必留存了。
Previously, I compiled a book of "Tomb", and there are still many classical Chinese texts, which is what it means; This meaning and method have not changed to this day. However, there are also omissions: it is because there is no foundation left and forgotten. There are also those who are deliberately deleted: yes or because it looks like a copy, but it is old and forgets, and even I doubt it; Or because it is just for one person, a temporary matter has nothing to do with the overall situation, and the situation changes with the situation, so there is no need to record it again; Or because it was just a joke, or out of a temporary misunderstanding, after a few days, it was meaningless and did not need to be kept.但使我吃惊的是霁云先生竟抄下了这么一大堆，连三十多年前的时文，十多年前的新诗，也全在那里面。这真好像将我五十多年前的出屁股，衔手指的照相，装潢起来，并且给我自己和别人来赏鉴。连我自己也诧异那时的我的幼稚，而且近乎不识羞。但是，有什么法子呢？这的确是我的影像，——由它去罢。
But what surprised me was that Mr. Jiyun copied such a large number of them, even the current texts from more than 30 years ago and the new poems from more than ten years ago. This is really like decorating the photos of my buttocks and fingers more than fifty years ago, and giving them to myself and others to appreciate. Even I myself was surprised at my naivety at that time, and I was almost ashamed. But what can be done? This is indeed my image,—— let it go.不过看起来也引起我一点回忆。例如最先的两篇，就是我故意删掉的。一篇是“雷锭”的最初的绍介，一篇是斯巴达的尚武精神的描写，但我记得自己那时的化学和历史的程度并没有这样高，所以大概总是从什么地方偷来的，不过后来无论怎么记，也再也记不起它们的老家；而且我那时初学日文，文法并未了然，就急于看书，看书并不很懂，就急于翻译，所以那内容也就可疑得很。而且文章又多么古怪，尤其是那一篇《斯巴达之魂》，现在看起来，自己也不免耳朵发热。但这是当时的风气，要激昂慷慨，顿挫抑扬，才能被称为好文章，我还记得“被发大叫，抱书独行，无泪可挥，大风灭烛”是大家传诵的警句。但我的文章里，也有受着严又陵的影响的，例如“涅伏”，就是“神经”的腊丁语的音译，这是现在恐怕只有我自己懂得的了。以后又受了章太炎先生的影响，古了起来，但这集子里却一篇也没有。
But it also seems to evoke a little memory for me. For example, the first two articles were deliberately deleted by me. One is the initial introduction of "Thunder Ingot", and the other is a description of Sparta's martial spirit, but I remember that my chemistry and history at that time were not so high, so they were probably always stolen from somewhere, but no matter how I remember them later, I can no longer remember their hometown; And when I was new to Japanese, I didn't understand the grammar, so I was eager to read the book, and I didn't understand the book very well, so I was eager to translate, so the content was very suspicious. And how strange the article is, especially the "Soul of Sparta", now it seems that my ears are hot. But this was the atmosphere at that time, it was necessary to be passionate and generous, frustrated and intonated, in order to be called a good article, I still remember that "being screamed, holding a book alone, no tears to wave, strong wind extinguishing candles" is an aphorism recited by everyone. But in my articles, there are also those influenced by Yan Youling, such as "Nirvana", which is the transliteration of the Latin word for "nerve", which I am afraid only I understand now. Later, under the influence of Mr. Zhang Taiyan, it became ancient, but there was not a single one in this collection.以后回到中国来，还给日报之类做了些古文，自己不记得究竟是什么了，霁云先生也找不出，我真觉得侥幸得很。
When I returned to China in the future, I also made some ancient texts for daily newspapers and the like, but I don't remember what it was, and Mr. Jiyun couldn't find it, I really felt very lucky.以后是抄古碑。再做就是白话；也做了几首新诗。我其实是不喜欢做新诗的——但也不喜欢做古诗——只因为那时诗坛寂寞，所以打打边鼓，凑些热闹；待到称为诗人的一出现，就洗手不作了。我更不喜欢徐志摩那样的诗，而他偏爱到各处投稿，《语丝》一出版，他也就来了，有人赞成他，登了出来，我就做了一篇杂感，和他开一通玩笑，使他不能来，他也果然不来了。这是我和后来的“新月派”积仇的第一步；《语丝》社同人中有几位也因此很不高兴我。不过不知道为什么没有收在《热风》里，漏落，还是故意删掉的呢，已经记不清，幸而这集子里有，那就是了。
In the future, it will be a copy of ancient monuments. If you do it again, it will be vernacular; also made several new poems. I actually don't like to make new poems - but I don't like to make ancient poems - just because the poetry world was lonely at that time, so I played drums and joined in the fun; When the poet appears, he washes his hands and stops working. I don't like poems like Xu Zhimo even more, and he prefers to submit everywhere, as soon as "Yusi" was published, he came, someone approved of him, and he posted it, so I made a miscellaneous feeling and made a joke with him, so that he couldn't come, and he really didn't come. This was the first step in my feud with the later "Crescent Sect"; Several of the "Yusi" fandom members were also very unhappy with me. But I don't know why it was not included in "Hot Wind", it was omitted, or it was deliberately deleted, I can't remember clearly, but fortunately there is it in this episode, that's it.只有几篇讲演，是现在故意删去的。我曾经能讲书，却不善于讲演，这已经是大可不必保存的了。而记录的人，或者为了方音的不同，听不很懂，于是漏落，错误；或者为了意见的不同，取舍因而不确，我以为要紧的，他并不记录，遇到空话，却详详细细记了一大通；有些则简直好像是恶意的捏造，意思和我所说的正是相反的。凡这些，我只好当作记录者自己的创作，都将它由我这里删掉。
There are only a few lectures, which are now deliberately deleted. I used to be able to lecture, but I was not good at speaking, which is no longer necessary to save. And the person who recorded, or because of the difference in square sound, did not understand very well, so he omitted and made a mistake; Or because of the difference of opinion, the choice is inaccurate, I think it is important, he does not record, encounters empty words, but remembers a lot in detail; Some seem to be malicious fabrications, meaning exactly the opposite of what I said. All of this, I had to delete it from me as the recorder's own creation.我惭愧我的少年之作，却并不后悔，甚而至于还有些爱，这真好像是“乳犊不怕虎”，乱攻一通，虽然无谋，但自有天真存在。现在是比较的精细了，然而我又别有其不满于自己之处。我佩服会用拖刀计的老将黄汉升，但我爱莽撞的不顾利害而终于被部下偷了头去的张翼德；我却又憎恶张翼德型的不问青红皂白，抡板斧“排头砍去”的李逵，我因此喜欢张顺的将他诱进水里去，淹得他两眼翻白。
I am ashamed of my youthful work, but I don't regret it, and even have some love, which is really like "the calf is not afraid of tigers", and the attack is indiscriminate, although there is no strategy, but there is innocence. Now it's more refined, but I have other dissatisfactions with myself. I admire the veteran Huang Hansheng who can use a drag knife, but I love Zhang Yide, who was reckless and finally stolen by his subordinates regardless of interests; But I hate Zhang Yide's type of Li Kui, who doesn't care about red and white, and "chops the head of the line" with an axe, so I like Zhang Shun to lure him into the water, drowning his eyes to roll.一九三四年十二月二十日夜，鲁迅记于上海之卓面书斋。

一九〇三年

斯巴达之魂

一九〇三年

The soul of Sparta西历纪元前四百八十年，波斯王泽耳士大举侵希腊。斯巴达王黎河尼佗将市民三百，同盟军数千，扼温泉门（德尔摩比勒）。敌由间道至。斯巴达将士殊死战，全军歼焉。兵气萧森，鬼雄昼啸，迨浦累皆之役，大仇斯复，迄今读史，犹懔懔有生气也。我今掇其逸事，贻我青年。呜呼！世有不甘自下于巾帼之男子乎？必有掷笔而起者矣。译者无文，不足摸拟其万一。噫，吾辱读者，吾辱斯巴达之魂！
西历纪元前四百八十年，波斯王泽耳士大举侵希腊。 斯巴达王黎河尼佗将市民三百，同盟军数千，扼温泉门（德尔摩比勒）。 敌由间道至。 斯巴达将士殊死战，全军歼焉。 兵气萧森，鬼雄昼啸，迨浦累皆之役，大仇斯复，迄今读史，犹懔懔有生气也。 我今掇其逸事，贻我青年。 呜呼！世有不甘自下于巾帼之男子乎？必有掷笔而起者矣。 译者无文，不足摸拟其万一。 噫，吾辱读者，吾辱斯巴达之魂！依格那海上之曙色，潜入摩利逊之湾，衣驮第一峰之宿云，亦冉冉呈霁色。湾山之间，温泉门石垒之后，大无畏大无敌之希腊军，置黎河尼佗王麾下之七千希腊同盟军，露刃枕戈，以待天曙。而孰知波斯军数万，已乘深夜，得间道，拂晓而达衣驮山之绝顶。趁朝暾之瑟然，偷守兵之微睡。如长蛇赴壑，蜿蜒以逾峰后。
依格那海上之曙色，潜入摩利逊之湾，衣驮第一峰之宿云，亦冉冉呈霁色。 湾山之间，温泉门石垒之后，大无畏大无敌之希腊军，置黎河尼佗王麾下之七千希腊同盟军，露刃枕戈，以待天曙。 而孰知波斯军数万，已乘深夜，得间道，拂晓而达衣驮山之绝顶。 趁朝暾之瑟然，偷守兵之微睡。 如长蛇赴壑，蜿蜒以逾峰后。旭日最初之光线，今也闪闪射垒角，照此淋漓欲滴之碧血，其语人以昨日战争之烈兮。垒外死士之残甲累累成阜，上刻波斯文“不死军”三字，其示人以昨日敌军之败绩兮。然大军三百万，夫岂惩此败北，夫岂消其锐气。噫嘻，今日血战哉！血战哉！黎河尼佗终夜防御，以待袭来。然天既曙而敌竟杳，敌幕之乌，向初日而噪，众军大惧；而果也斥候于不及防之地，赍不及防之警报至。
旭日最初之光线，今也闪闪射垒角，照此淋漓欲滴之碧血，其语人以昨日战争之烈兮。 垒外死士之残甲累累成阜，上刻波斯文“不死军”三字，其示人以昨日敌军之败绩兮。 然大军三百万，夫岂惩此败北，夫岂消其锐气。 噫嘻，今日血战哉！血战哉！黎河尼佗终夜防御，以待袭来。 然天既曙而敌竟杳，敌幕之乌，向初日而噪，众军大惧；而果也斥候于不及防之地，赍不及防之警报至。有奢刹利人曰爱飞得者，以衣驮山中峰有他间道告敌；故敌军万余，乘夜进击，败佛雪守兵，而攻我军背。
有奢刹利人曰爱飞得者，以衣驮山中峰有他间道告敌；故敌军万余，乘夜进击，败佛雪守兵，而攻我军背。咄咄危哉！大事去矣！警报戟脑，全军沮丧，退军之声，嚣嚣然挟飞尘以磅礴于军中。黎河尼佗爰集同盟将校，以议去留，佥谓守地既失，留亦徒然，不若退温泉门以为保护希腊将来计。黎河尼佗不复言，而徐告诸将曰，“希腊存亡，系此一战，有为保护将来计而思退者，其速去此。惟斯巴达人有‘一履战地，不胜则死’之国法，今惟决死！今惟决死战！余者其留意。”
咄咄危哉！大事去矣！警报戟脑，全军沮丧，退军之声，嚣嚣然挟飞尘以磅礴于军中。 黎河尼佗爰集同盟将校，以议去留，佥谓守地既失，留亦徒然，不若退温泉门以为保护希腊将来计。 黎河尼佗不复言，而徐告诸将曰，“希腊存亡，系此一战，有为保护将来计而思退者，其速去此。 惟斯巴达人有‘一履战地，不胜则死’之国法，今惟决死！今惟决死战！余者其留意。 ”于是而胚罗蓬诸州军三千退，而访嘻斯军一千退，而螺克烈军六百退，未退者惟刹司骇人七百耳。慨然偕斯巴达武士，誓与同生死，同苦战，同名誉，以留此危极凄极壮绝之旧垒。惟西蒲斯人若干，为反复无常之本国质，而被抑留于黎河尼佗。
于是而胚罗蓬诸州军三千退，而访嘻斯军一千退，而螺克烈军六百退，未退者惟刹司骇人七百耳。 慨然偕斯巴达武士，誓与同生死，同苦战，同名誉，以留此危极凄极壮绝之旧垒。 惟西蒲斯人若干，为反复无常之本国质，而被抑留于黎河尼佗。嗟此斯巴达军，其数仅三百；然此大无畏大无敌之三百军，彼等曾临敌而笑，结怒欲冲冠之长发，以示一瞑不视之决志。黎河尼佗王，亦于将战之时，毅然谓得“王不死则国亡”之神诫；今无所迟疑，无所犹豫，同盟军既旋，乃向亚波罗神而再拜，从斯巴达之军律，舆榇以待强敌，以待战死。
嗟此斯巴达军，其数仅三百；然此大无畏大无敌之三百军，彼等曾临敌而笑，结怒欲冲冠之长发，以示一瞑不视之决志。 黎河尼佗王，亦于将战之时，毅然谓得“王不死则国亡”之神诫；今无所迟疑，无所犹豫，同盟军既旋，乃向亚波罗神而再拜，从斯巴达之军律，舆榇以待强敌，以待战死。呜呼全军，惟待战死。然有三人焉，王欲生之者也，其二为王戚，一则古名祭司之裔，曰豫言者息每卡而向以神诫告王者也。息每卡故侍王侧，王窃语之，彼固有家，然彼有子，彼不欲亡国而生，誓愿殉国以死，遂侃然谢王命。其二王戚，则均弱冠矣；正抚大好头颅，屹立阵头，以待进击。而孰意王召之至，全军肃肃，谨听王言。噫，二少年，今日生矣，意者其雀跃返国，聚父母亲友作再生之华筵耶！而斯巴达武士岂其然？噫，如是我闻，而王遂语，且熟视其乳毛未褪之颜。
呜呼全军，惟待战死。 然有三人焉，王欲生之者也，其二为王戚，一则古名祭司之裔，曰豫言者息每卡而向以神诫告王者也。 息每卡故侍王侧，王窃语之，彼固有家，然彼有子，彼不欲亡国而生，誓愿殉国以死，遂侃然谢王命。 其二王戚，则均弱冠矣；正抚大好头颅，屹立阵头，以待进击。 而孰意王召之至，全军肃肃，谨听王言。 噫，二少年，今日生矣，意者其雀跃返国，聚父母亲友作再生之华筵耶！而斯巴达武士岂其然？噫，如是我闻，而王遂语，且熟视其乳毛未褪之颜。王“卿等知将死乎？”少年甲“然，陛下。”王“何以死？”甲“不待言：战死！战死！”王“然则与卿等以最佳之战地，何如？”甲乙“臣等固所愿。”王“然则卿等持此书返国以报战状。”
王“卿等知将死乎？”少年甲“然，陛下。 ”王“何以死？”甲“不待言：战死！战死！”王“然则与卿等以最佳之战地，何如？”甲乙“臣等固所愿。 ”王“然则卿等持此书返国以报战状。 ”异哉！王何心乎？青年愕然疑，肃肃全军，谛听谛听。而青年恍然悟，厉声答王曰，“王欲生我乎？臣以执盾至，不作寄书邮。”志决矣，示必死矣，不可夺矣。而王犹欲遣甲，而甲不奉诏；欲遣乙，而乙不奉诏。曰，“今日之战，即所以报国人也。”噫，不可夺矣。而王乃曰，“伟哉，斯巴达之武士！予复何言。”一青年退而谢王命之辱。飘飘大旗，荣光闪灼，於铄豪杰，鼓铸全军，诸君诸君，男儿死耳！
异哉！王何心乎？青年愕然疑，肃肃全军，谛听谛听。 而青年恍然悟，厉声答王曰，“王欲生我乎？臣以执盾至，不作寄书邮。 ”志决矣，示必死矣，不可夺矣。 而王犹欲遣甲，而甲不奉诏；欲遣乙，而乙不奉诏。 曰，“今日之战，即所以报国人也。 ”噫，不可夺矣。 而王乃曰，“伟哉，斯巴达之武士！予复何言。 ”一青年退而谢王命之辱。 飘飘大旗，荣光闪灼，於铄豪杰，鼓铸全军，诸君诸君，男儿死耳！初日上，征尘起。睁目四顾，惟见如火如荼之敌军先锋队，挟三倍之势，潮鸣电击以阵于斯巴达军后。然未挑战，未进击，盖将待第二第三队至也。斯巴达王以斯巴达军为第一队，刹司骇军次之，西蒲斯军殿；策马露刃，以速制敌。壮哉劲气亘天，踆乌退舍。未几惟闻“进击”一声，而金鼓忽大振于血碧沙晶之大战斗场里；此大无畏，大无敌之劲军，于左海右山，危不容足之峡间，与波斯军遇。呐喊格击，鲜血倒流，如鸣潮飞沫，奔腾喷薄于荒矶。不刹那顷，而敌军无数死于刃，无数落于海，无数蹂躏于后援。大将号令，指挥官叱咤，队长鞭遁者，鼓声盈耳哉。然敌军不敢迎此朱血涂附，日光斜射，愈增熣灿，而霍霍如旋风之白刃，大军一万，蜂涌至矣。然敌军不能撼此拥盾屹立，士气如山，若不动明王之大磐石。
初日上，征尘起。 睁目四顾，惟见如火如荼之敌军先锋队，挟三倍之势，潮鸣电击以阵于斯巴达军后。 然未挑战，未进击，盖将待第二第三队至也。 斯巴达王以斯巴达军为第一队，刹司骇军次之，西蒲斯军殿；策马露刃，以速制敌。 壮哉劲气亘天，踆乌退舍。 未几惟闻“进击”一声，而金鼓忽大振于血碧沙晶之大战斗场里；此大无畏，大无敌之劲军，于左海右山，危不容足之峡间，与波斯军遇。 呐喊格击，鲜血倒流，如鸣潮飞沫，奔腾喷薄于荒矶。 不刹那顷，而敌军无数死于刃，无数落于海，无数蹂躏于后援。 大将号令，指挥官叱咤，队长鞭遁者，鼓声盈耳哉。 然敌军不敢迎此朱血涂附，日光斜射，愈增熣灿，而霍霍如旋风之白刃，大军一万，蜂涌至矣。 然敌军不能撼此拥盾屹立，士气如山，若不动明王之大磐石。然未与此战者，犹有斯巴达武士二人存也；以罹目疾故，远送之爱尔俾尼之邑。于郁郁闲居中，忽得战报。其一欲止，其一遂行。偕一仆以赴战场，登高远瞩，呐喊盈耳，踊跃三百，勇魂早浮动盘旋于战云黯淡处。然日光益烈，目不得瞬，徒促仆而问战状。
然未与此战者，犹有斯巴达武士二人存也；以罹目疾故，远送之爱尔俾尼之邑。 于郁郁闲居中，忽得战报。 其一欲止，其一遂行。 偕一仆以赴战场，登高远瞩，呐喊盈耳，踊跃三百，勇魂早浮动盘旋于战云黯淡处。 然日光益烈，目不得瞬，徒促仆而问战状。刃碎矣！镞尽矣！壮士歼矣！王战死矣！敌军猬集，欲劫王尸，而我军殊死战，咄咄……然危哉，危哉！其仆之言盖如是。嗟此壮士，热血滴沥于将盲之目，攘臂大跃，直趋战垒；其仆欲劝止，欲代死，而不可，而终不可。今也主仆连袂，大呼“我亦斯巴达武士”一声，以闯入层层乱军里。左顾王尸，右拂敌刃，而再而三；终以疲惫故，引入热血朱殷之垒后，而此最后决战之英雄队，遂向敌列战死之枕。噫，死者长已矣，而我闻其言：
刃碎矣！镞尽矣！壮士歼矣！王战死矣！敌军猬集，欲劫王尸，而我军殊死战，咄咄…… 然危哉，危哉！其仆之言盖如是。 嗟此壮士，热血滴沥于将盲之目，攘臂大跃，直趋战垒；其仆欲劝止，欲代死，而不可，而终不可。 今也主仆连袂，大呼“我亦斯巴达武士”一声，以闯入层层乱军里。 左顾王尸，右拂敌刃，而再而三；终以疲惫故，引入热血朱殷之垒后，而此最后决战之英雄队，遂向敌列战死之枕。 噫，死者长已矣，而我闻其言：汝旅人兮，我从国法而战死，其告我斯巴达之同胞。
汝旅人兮，我从国法而战死，其告我斯巴达之同胞。巍巍乎温泉门之峡，地球不灭，则终存此斯巴达武士之魂；而七百刹司骇人，亦掷头颅，洒热血，以分其无量名誉。此荣光纠纷之旁，犹记通敌卖国之奢刹利人爱飞得，降敌乞命之四百西蒲斯军。虽然，此温泉门一战而得无量光荣无量名誉之斯巴达武士间，乃亦有由爱尔俾尼目病院而生还者。
巍巍乎温泉门之峡，地球不灭，则终存此斯巴达武士之魂；而七百刹司骇人，亦掷头颅，洒热血，以分其无量名誉。 此荣光纠纷之旁，犹记通敌卖国之奢刹利人爱飞得，降敌乞命之四百西蒲斯军。 虽然，此温泉门一战而得无量光荣无量名誉之斯巴达武士间，乃亦有由爱尔俾尼目病院而生还者。夏夜半阑，屋阴覆路，惟柝声断续，犬吠如豹而已。斯巴达府之山下，犹有未寝之家。灯光黯然，微透窗际。未几有一少妇，送老妪出，切切作离别语；旋铿然阖门，惨淡入闺里。孤灯如豆，照影成三；首若飞蓬，非无膏沐，盖将临蓐，默祝愿生刚勇强毅之丈夫子，为国民有所尽耳。时适万籁寥寂，酸风戛窗，脉脉无言，似闻叹息，忆征戍欤？梦沙场欤？噫，此美少妇而女丈夫也，宁有叹息事？叹息岂斯巴达女子事？惟斯巴达女子能支配男儿，惟斯巴达女子能生男儿。此非黎河尼佗王后格尔歌与夷国女王应答之言，而添斯巴达女子以万丈荣光者乎。噫，斯巴达女子宁知叹息事。
夏夜半阑，屋阴覆路，惟柝声断续，犬吠如豹而已。 斯巴达府之山下，犹有未寝之家。 灯光黯然，微透窗际。 未几有一少妇，送老妪出，切切作离别语；旋铿然阖门，惨淡入闺里。 孤灯如豆，照影成三；首若飞蓬，非无膏沐，盖将临蓐，默祝愿生刚勇强毅之丈夫子，为国民有所尽耳。 时适万籁寥寂，酸风戛窗，脉脉无言，似闻叹息，忆征戍欤？梦沙场欤？噫，此美少妇而女丈夫也，宁有叹息事？叹息岂斯巴达女子事？惟斯巴达女子能支配男儿，惟斯巴达女子能生男儿。 此非黎河尼佗王后格尔歌与夷国女王应答之言，而添斯巴达女子以万丈荣光者乎。 噫，斯巴达女子宁知叹息事。长夜未央，万籁悉死。噫，触耳膜而益明者何声欤？则有剥啄叩关者。少妇出问曰：“其克力泰士君乎？请以明日至。”应曰，“否否，予生还矣！”咄咄，此何人？此何人？时斜月残灯，交映其面，则温泉门战士其夫也。
长夜未央，万籁悉死。 噫，触耳膜而益明者何声欤？则有剥啄叩关者。 少妇出问曰：“其克力泰士君乎？请以明日至。 ”应曰，“否否，予生还矣！”咄咄，此何人？此何人？时斜月残灯，交映其面，则温泉门战士其夫也。少妇惊且疑。久之久之乃言曰：“何则……生还……污妾耳矣！我夫既战死，生还者非我夫，意其鬼雄欤。告母国以吉占兮，归者其鬼雄，愿归者其鬼雄。”
少妇惊且疑。 久之久之乃言曰：“何则…… 生还…… 污妾耳矣！我夫既战死，生还者非我夫，意其鬼雄欤。 告母国以吉占兮，归者其鬼雄，愿归者其鬼雄。 ”读者得勿疑非人情乎？然斯巴达固尔尔也。激战告终，例行国葬，烈士之毅魄，化无量微尘分子，随军歌激越间，而磅礴戟刺于国民脑筋里。而国民乃大呼曰，“为国民死！为国民死！”且指送葬者一人曰，“若夫为国民死，名誉何若！荣光何若！”而不然者，则将何以当斯巴达女子之嘉名？诸君不见下第者乎？泥金不来，妇泣于室，异感而同情耳。今夫也不良，二三其死，奚能勿悲，能勿怒？而户外男子曰，“涘烈娜乎？卿勿疑。予之生还也，故有理在。”遂推户脱扃，潜入室内，少妇如怨如怒，疾诘其故。彼具告之。且曰，“前以目疾未愈，不甘徒死。设今夜而有战地也，即洒吾血耳。”
读者得勿疑非人情乎？然斯巴达固尔尔也。 激战告终，例行国葬，烈士之毅魄，化无量微尘分子，随军歌激越间，而磅礴戟刺于国民脑筋里。 而国民乃大呼曰，“为国民死！为国民死！”且指送葬者一人曰，“若夫为国民死，名誉何若！荣光何若！”而不然者，则将何以当斯巴达女子之嘉名？诸君不见下第者乎？泥金不来，妇泣于室，异感而同情耳。 今夫也不良，二三其死，奚能勿悲，能勿怒？而户外男子曰，“涘烈娜乎？卿勿疑。 予之生还也，故有理在。 ”遂推户脱扃，潜入室内，少妇如怨如怒，疾诘其故。 彼具告之。 且曰，“前以目疾未愈，不甘徒死。 设今夜而有战地也，即洒吾血耳。 ”少妇曰，“君非斯巴达之武士乎？何故其然，不甘徒死，而遽生还。则彼三百人者，奚为而死？噫嘻君乎！不胜则死，忘斯巴达之国法耶？以目疾而遂忘斯巴达之国法耶？‘愿汝持盾而归来，不然则乘盾而归来。’君习闻之……而目疾乃更重于斯巴达武士之荣光乎？来日之行葬式也，妾为君妻，得参其列。国民思君，友朋思君，父母妻子，无不思君。呜呼，而君乃生还矣！”
少妇曰，“君非斯巴达之武士乎？何故其然，不甘徒死，而遽生还。 则彼三百人者，奚为而死？噫嘻君乎！不胜则死，忘斯巴达之国法耶？以目疾而遂忘斯巴达之国法耶？‘愿汝持盾而归来，不然则乘盾而归来。 ’君习闻之…… 而目疾乃更重于斯巴达武士之荣光乎？来日之行葬式也，妾为君妻，得参其列。 国民思君，友朋思君，父母妻子，无不思君。 呜呼，而君乃生还矣！”侃侃哉其言。如风霜疾来，袭击耳膜；懦夫懦夫，其勿言矣。而彼犹嗫嚅曰，“以爱卿故。”少妇拂然怒曰，“其诚言耶！夫夫妇之契，孰则不相爱者。然国以外不言爱之斯巴达武士，其爱其妻为何若？而三百人中，无一生还者何……君诚爱妾，曷不誉妾以战死者之妻。妾将娩矣，设为男子，弱也则弃之泰噶托士之谷；强也则忆温泉门之陈迹，将何以厕身于为国民死之同胞间乎？……君诚爱妾，愿君速亡，否则杀妾。呜呼，君犹佩剑，剑犹佩于君，使剑而有灵，奚不离其人？奚不为其人折？奚不断其人首？设其人知耻，奚不解剑？奚不以其剑战？奚不以其剑断敌人头？噫，斯巴达之武德其式微哉！妾辱夫矣，请伏剑于君侧。”
侃侃哉其言。 如风霜疾来，袭击耳膜；懦夫懦夫，其勿言矣。 而彼犹嗫嚅曰，“以爱卿故。 ”少妇拂然怒曰，“其诚言耶！夫夫妇之契，孰则不相爱者。 然国以外不言爱之斯巴达武士，其爱其妻为何若？而三百人中，无一生还者何…… 君诚爱妾，曷不誉妾以战死者之妻。 妾将娩矣，设为男子，弱也则弃之泰噶托士之谷；强也则忆温泉门之陈迹，将何以厕身于为国民死之同胞间乎？…… 君诚爱妾，愿君速亡，否则杀妾。 呜呼，君犹佩剑，剑犹佩于君，使剑而有灵，奚不离其人？奚不为其人折？奚不断其人首？设其人知耻，奚不解剑？奚不以其剑战？奚不以其剑断敌人头？噫，斯巴达之武德其式微哉！妾辱夫矣，请伏剑于君侧。 ”丈夫生矣，女子死耳。颈血上薄，其气魂魂，人或疑长夜之曙光云。惜也一应一答，一死一生，暮夜无知，伟影将灭。不知有慕涘烈娜之克力泰士者，虽遭投梭之拒，而未能忘情者也。是时也，彼乃潜行墙角以去。
丈夫生矣，女子死耳。 颈血上薄，其气魂魂，人或疑长夜之曙光云。 惜也一应一答，一死一生，暮夜无知，伟影将灭。 不知有慕涘烈娜之克力泰士者，虽遭投梭之拒，而未能忘情者也。 是时也，彼乃潜行墙角以去。初日曈曈，照斯巴达之郊外。旅人寒起，胥驻足于大逵。中有老人，说温泉门地形，杂以往事；昔也石垒，今也战场，絮絮不休止。噫，何为者？——则其间有立木存，上书曰：
初日曈曈，照斯巴达之郊外。 旅人寒起，胥驻足于大逵。 中有老人，说温泉门地形，杂以往事；昔也石垒，今也战场，絮絮不休止。 噫，何为者？——则其间有立木存，上书曰：“有捕温泉门堕落武士亚里士多德至者膺上赏。”
“有捕温泉门堕落武士亚里士多德至者膺上赏。 ”盖政府之令，而克力泰士所诉也。亚里士多德者，昔身受迅雷，以霁神怒之贤王，而其余烈，乃不能致一士之战死，咄咄不可解。
盖政府之令，而克力泰士所诉也。 亚里士多德者，昔身受迅雷，以霁神怒之贤王，而其余烈，乃不能致一士之战死，咄咄不可解。观者益众，聚讼嚣嚣。遥望斯巴达府，有一队少年军，鍪甲映旭日，闪闪若金蛇状。及大逵，析为二队，相背驰去，且抗声而歌曰：
观者益众，聚讼嚣嚣。 遥望斯巴达府，有一队少年军，鍪甲映旭日，闪闪若金蛇状。 及大逵，析为二队，相背驰去，且抗声而歌曰：“战哉！此战场伟大而庄严兮，尔何为遗尔友而生还兮？尔生还兮蒙大耻，尔母笞尔兮死则止！”
“战哉！此战场伟大而庄严兮，尔何为遗尔友而生还兮？尔生还兮蒙大耻，尔母笞尔兮死则止！”老人曰，“彼等其觅亚里士多德者欤……不闻抗声之高歌乎？此二百年前之军歌也，迄今犹歌之。”
老人曰，“彼等其觅亚里士多德者欤…… 不闻抗声之高歌乎？此二百年前之军歌也，迄今犹歌之。 ”而亚里士多德则何如？史不曰：浦累皆之战乎，世界大决战之一也，波斯军三十万，拥大将漠多尼之尸，如秋风吹落叶，纵横零乱于大漠。斯巴达鬼雄三百，则凭将军柏撒纽，以敌人颈血，一洗积年之殊怨。酸风夜鸣，薤露竞落，其窃告人生之脆者欤。初月相照，皎皎残尸，马迹之间，血痕犹湿，其悲蝶尔飞神之不灵者欤。斯巴达军人，各觅其同胞至高至贵之遗骸，运于高原，将行葬式。不图累累敌尸间，有凛然僵卧者，月影朦胧，似曾相识。其一人大呼曰，“何战之烈也！噫，何不死于温泉门而死于此。”识者谁：克力泰士也。彼已为戍兵矣，遂奔告将军柏撒纽。将军欲葬之，以询全军；而全军哗然，甚咎亚里士多德。将军乃演说于军中曰：
而亚里士多德则何如？史不曰：浦累皆之战乎，世界大决战之一也，波斯军三十万，拥大将漠多尼之尸，如秋风吹落叶，纵横零乱于大漠。 斯巴达鬼雄三百，则凭将军柏撒纽，以敌人颈血，一洗积年之殊怨。 酸风夜鸣，薤露竞落，其窃告人生之脆者欤。 初月相照，皎皎残尸，马迹之间，血痕犹湿，其悲蝶尔飞神之不灵者欤。 斯巴达军人，各觅其同胞至高至贵之遗骸，运于高原，将行葬式。 不图累累敌尸间，有凛然僵卧者，月影朦胧，似曾相识。 其一人大呼曰，“何战之烈也！噫，何不死于温泉门而死于此。 ”识者谁：克力泰士也。 彼已为戍兵矣，遂奔告将军柏撒纽。 将军欲葬之，以询全军；而全军哗然，甚咎亚里士多德。 将军乃演说于军中曰：“然则从斯巴达军人之公言，令彼无墓。然吾见无墓者之战死，益令我感，令我喜，吾益见斯巴达武德之卓绝。夫子勖哉，不见夫杀国人媚异族之奴隶国乎，为谍为伥又奚论？而我国则宁弃不义之余生，以偿既破之国法。嗟尔诸士，彼虽无墓，彼终有斯巴达武士之魂！”
“然则从斯巴达军人之公言，令彼无墓。 然吾见无墓者之战死，益令我感，令我喜，吾益见斯巴达武德之卓绝。 夫子勖哉，不见夫杀国人媚异族之奴隶国乎，为谍为伥又奚论？而我国则宁弃不义之余生，以偿既破之国法。 嗟尔诸士，彼虽无墓，彼终有斯巴达武士之魂！”克力泰士不觉卒然呼曰，“是因其妻涘烈娜以死谏！”阵云寂寂，响渡寥天；万目如炬，齐注其面。将军柏撒纽返问曰，“其妻以死谏？”
克力泰士不觉卒然呼曰，“是因其妻涘烈娜以死谏！”阵云寂寂，响渡寥天；万目如炬，齐注其面。 将军柏撒纽返问曰，“其妻以死谏？”全军咽唾，耸听其说。克力泰士欲言不言，愧恧无地；然以不忍没女丈夫之轶事也，乃述颠末。将军推案起曰，
全军咽唾，耸听其说。 克力泰士欲言不言，愧恧无地；然以不忍没女丈夫之轶事也，乃述颠末。 将军推案起曰，“猗欤女丈夫……为此无墓者之妻立纪念碑则何如？”
“猗欤女丈夫…… 为此无墓者之妻立纪念碑则何如？”军容益庄，惟呼欢殷殷若春雷起。
军容益庄，惟呼欢殷殷若春雷起。斯巴达府之北，侑洛佗士之谷，行人指一翼然倚天者走相告曰，“此涘烈娜之碑也，亦即斯巴达之国！”

一九〇三年

说

一九〇三年

说昔之学者曰：“太阳而外，宇宙间殆无所有。”历纪以来，翕然从之；怀疑之徒，竟不可得。乃不谓忽有一不可思议之原质，自发光热，煌煌焉出现于世界，辉新世纪之曙光，破旧学者之迷梦。若能力保存说，若原子说，若物质不灭说，皆蒙极酷之袭击，跄踉倾欹，不可终日。由是而思想界大革命之风潮，得日益磅薄，未可知也！此新原质以何因缘，乃得发见？则不能不曰：“X线（旧译透物电光）之赐。”
昔之学者曰：“太阳而外，宇宙间殆无所有。 ”历纪以来，翕然从之；怀疑之徒，竟不可得。 乃不谓忽有一不可思议之原质，自发光热，煌煌焉出现于世界，辉新世纪之曙光，破旧学者之迷梦。 若能力保存说，若原子说，若物质不灭说，皆蒙极酷之袭击，跄踉倾欹，不可终日。 由是而思想界大革命之风潮，得日益磅薄，未可知也！此新原质以何因缘，乃得发见？则不能不曰：“X线（旧译透物电光）之赐。 ”X线者，一八九五年顷，德人林达根所发明者也。其性质之奇异：若（一）贯通不透明体，（二）感写真干板，（三）与气体以导电性等。大惹学者之注意，谓X线外，当更有Y线，若Z线等者。相率覃思，冀获新质。乃果也驰运涅伏，必获报酬。翌年而法人勃克雷复有一大发见。
X-rays were invented by German Linda Gen in 1895. The properties of the gas are peculiar: such as (1) penetrating opaque material, (2) sensing the photoresist plate, and (3) conductivity with gases. It has attracted the attention of scholars who believe that in addition to X-rays, there should be Y-rays, such as Z-rays. They pondered deeply, hoping to obtain new qualities. It is indeed a matter of speeding to Niev, and it will definitely be rewarded. 一九一八年

渡河与引路

一九一八年

Crossing the Yellow River and leading the way玄同兄：
Brother Xuantong:两日前看见《新青年》五卷二号通信里面，兄有唐俟也不反对Esperanto，以及可以一齐讨论的话；我于Esperanto固不反对，但也不愿讨论：因为我的赞成Esperanto的理由，十分简单，还不能开口讨论。
Two days ago, I saw in the correspondence of "New Youth" Volume 5, No. 2, that my brother Tang Qi did not object to Esperanto, and that we could discuss it together; I have no objection to Esperanto, but I do not want to discuss it: because my reasons for favoring Esperanto are very simple and cannot be discussed yet.要问赞成的理由，便只是依我看来，人类将来总当有一种共同的言语；所以赞成Esperanto。
If you want to ask the reason for approval, it is simply that, in my opinion, there should always be a common language in the future; So I support Esperanto.至于将来通用的是否Esperanto，却无从断定。大约或者便从Esperanto改良，更加圆满；或者别有一种更好的出现；都未可知。但现在既是只有这Esperanto，便只能先学这Esperanto。现在不过草创时代，正如未有汽船，便只好先坐独木小舟；倘使因为豫料将来当有汽船，便不造独木小舟，或不坐独木小舟，那便连汽船也不会发明，人类也不能渡水了。
As for whether it will be Esperanto in the future, it is impossible to conclude. About or more complete from Esperanto; Or there is a better kind of appearance; It is still unknown. But now that there is only this Esperanto, we can only learn this Esperanto first. Now is just the beginning of the era, just like there is no steamboat, so you have to take a canoe first; If you don't build a canoe or ride a canoe because you expect there to be a steamboat in the future, then even the steamboat will not be invented, and humans will not be able to cross the water.然问将来何以必有一种人类共通的言语，却不能拿出确凿证据。说将来必不能有的，也是如此。所以全无讨论的必要；只能各依自己所信的做去就是了。
However, if you ask why there must be a common language for mankind in the future, you cannot provide conclusive evidence. It is said that there will be no one in the future, and it is the same. So there is no need to discuss it at all; You can only do what you believe in.但我还有一个意见，以为学Esperanto是一件事，学Esperanto的精神，又是一件事。——白话文学也是如此。——倘若思想照旧，便仍然换牌不换货：才从“四目仓圣”面前爬起，又向“柴明华先师”脚下跪倒；无非反对人类进步的时候，从前是说no，现在是说ne；从前写作“咈哉”，现在写作“不行”罢了。所以我的意见，以为灌输正当的学术文艺，改良思想，是第一事；讨论Esperanto，尚在其次；至于辨难驳诘，更可一笔勾消。
But I also have an opinion, thinking that learning Esperanto is one thing, and learning the spirit of Esperanto is another. ——The same is true for vernacular literature. ——If the mind is the same, it will still change the card and not exchange the goods: he got up in front of the "Four-eyed Cang Sheng" and knelt down at the feet of "Master Chai Minghua"; It is nothing more than opposing human progress, which used to say no, and now it is said ne; In the past, it was written as "no", but now it is written as "no". Therefore, my opinion is that instilling correct academic literature and art and improving ideas is the first thing; Esperanto is still secondary; As for the arguments and refutations, they can be erased in one stroke.《新青年》里的通信，现在颇觉发达。读者也都喜看。但据我个人意见，以为还可酌减：只须将诚恳切实的讨论，按期登载；其他不负责任的随口批评，没有常识的问难，至多只要答他一回，此后便不必多说，省出纸墨，移作别用。例如见鬼，求仙，打脸之类，明明白白全是毫无常识的事情，《新青年》却还和他们反复辩论，对他们说“二五得一十”的道理，这功夫岂不可惜，这事业岂不可怜。
The correspondence in "New Youth" is now quite developed. Readers also like to read it. However, in my personal opinion, I think it can be reduced: only the sincere and practical discussion should be published on schedule; Other irresponsible casual criticisms, questions without common sense, at most only need to answer him once, and then there is no need to say more, save paper and ink, and transfer it to other uses. For example, seeing ghosts, seeking immortality, slapping in the face, etc., are all things without common sense, but "New Youth" still debates with them repeatedly, telling them the truth of "two five get ten".我看《新青年》的内容，大略不外两类：一是觉得空气闭塞污浊，吸这空气的人，将要完结了；便不免皱一皱眉，说一声“唉”。希望同感的人，因此也都注意，开辟一条活路。假如有人说这脸色声音，没有妓女的眉眼一般好看，唱小调一般好听，那是极确的真话；我们不必和他分辩，说是皱眉叹气，更为好看。和他分辩，我们就错了。一是觉得历来所走的路，万分危险，而且将到尽头；于是凭着良心，切实寻觅，看见别一条平坦有希望的路，便大叫一声说，“这边走好。”希望同感的人，因此转身，脱了危险，容易进步。假如有人偏向别处走，再劝一番，固无不可；但若仍旧不信，便不必拚命去拉，各走自己的路。因为拉得打架，不独于他无益，连自己和同感的人，也都耽搁了工夫。
I look at the content of "New Youth", which is roughly divided into two categories: one is that the air is blocked and dirty, and the person who breathes this air is about to end; He couldn't help but frown and said "sigh". I hope that those who feel the same way will also pay attention and open up a way to live. If someone says that this face and voice are not as beautiful as the eyebrows and eyes of a prostitute, or as good as singing a minor tune, that is the very truth; We don't have to argue with him, saying that it is frowning and sighing, it is more beautiful. Arguing with him, we are wrong. First, I feel that the road I have taken is extremely dangerous and will come to an end; So with his conscience, he really searched, and when he saw another smooth and hopeful road, he shouted, "Go this way." "I hope that those who feel the same way will turn around, get out of danger, and make progress easily. If someone prefers to go elsewhere, it is not impossible to persuade them again; But if you still don't believe it, you don't have to try hard to pull it, and go your own way. Because of the fight, not only was it useless to him, but even he and those who felt the same way delayed his work.耶稣说，见车要翻了，扶他一下。Nietzsche说，见车要翻了，推他一下。我自然是赞成耶稣的话；但以为倘若不愿你扶，便不必硬扶，听他罢了。此后能够不翻，固然很好，倘若终于翻倒，然后再来切切实实的帮他抬。
Jesus said that when he saw that the car was about to overturn, he helped him. Nietzsche said he saw the car about to overturn and pushed him. Naturally, I agree with Jesus' words. But I thought that if I didn't want you to help me, I didn't have to help him, just listen to him. It is good to be able not to turn over after that, but if it finally falls, then come and help him lift it.老兄，硬扶比抬更为费力，更难见效。翻后再抬，比将翻便扶，于他们更为有益。
Dude, hard support is more laborious and more difficult to achieve results than lifting. It is more beneficial for them to lift it after turning it over than to support it when it is turned over.唐俟。十一月四日。Tang Qi. November 4th.

“说不出”

一九二四年

"I can't tell"看客在戏台下喝倒采，食客在膳堂里发标，伶人厨子，无嘴可开，只能怪自己没本领。但若看客开口一唱戏，食客动手一做菜，可就难说了。
The spectators cheered under the stage, the diners issued bids in the dining hall, and the performers and cooks had no mouths to open, so they could only blame themselves for their lack of skills. But if the spectators sing and the diners start cooking, it is difficult to say.所以，我以为批评家最平稳的是不要兼做创作。假如提起一支屠城的笔，扫荡了文坛上一切野草，那自然是快意的。但扫荡之后，倘以为天下已没有诗，就动手来创作，便每不免做出这样的东西来：
Therefore, I think the most stable thing for critics is not to also create. If you mention a pen that slaughters the city and sweep away all the weeds in the literary world, it will naturally be happy. But after the sweep, if you think that there is no poetry in the world, you will start to create, and you will inevitably make something like this:宇宙之广大呀，我说不出；The vastness of the universe, I can't say; 
父母之恩呀，我说不出； Parents' kindness, I can't say; 
爱人的爱呀，我说不出。 I can't tell you the love of my lover. 
阿呀阿呀，我说不出！ Ah, I can't tell!
这样的诗，当然是好的，——倘就批评家的创作而言。太上老君的《道德》五千言，开头就说“道可道非常道”，其实也就是一个“说不出”，所以这三个字，也就替得五千言。
Such poems are of course good,—— if they are concerned with the creation of critics. Taishang Laojun's "Taoism" has 5,000 words, and at the beginning it says "Tao can be said to be very Tao", but in fact, it is a "can't say", so these three words are replaced by 5,000 words.呜呼，“王者之迹熄，而《诗》亡；《诗》亡，然后《春秋》作。”“予岂好辩哉？予不得已也！”

Justification for Yang Jun's attack一
One今天有几位同学极诚实地告诉我，说十三日访我的那一位学生确是神经错乱的，十三日是发病的一天，此后就加重起来了。我相信这是真实情形，因为我对于神经患者的初发状态没有实见和注意研究过，所以很容易有看错的时候。

Now I should write off the inferences of my nervousness in the second half of my memoir. Now I know it's true, but I feel that the sacrifice is too great, it's better to pretend. However, the fact is the fact, what else can be done? I can only hope that he will return to health as soon as possible.十一月二十一日。

Today, I found a loophole, although it has nothing to do with me, but I will respect an arrow back and forth: revenge and revenge, which is the meaning of the "Spring and Autumn Annals".他在《语丝》第二期上说，有某人挖苦叶名琛的对联“不战，不和，不守；不死，不降，不走。”大概可以作为中国人“持中”的真相之说明。我以为这是不对的。
He said in the second issue of "Yusi" that someone sarcastically said that Ye Mingchen's couplets "do not fight, discord, and do not defend; He did not die, did not surrender, did not flee. It can probably be used as an explanation of the truth of the Chinese's "holding the center". I thought it was wrong.夫近乎“持中”的态度大概有二：一者“非彼即此”，二者“可彼可此”也。前者是无主意，不盲从，不附势，或者别有独特的见解；但境遇是很危险的，所以叶名琛终至于败亡，虽然他不过是无主意。后者则是“骑墙”，或是极巧妙的“随风倒”了，然而在中国最得法，所以中国人的“持中”大概是这个。倘改篡了旧对联来说明，就该是：
There are probably two attitudes that are close to "holding the center": one is "either that or that", and the other is "yes or that". The former is without ideas, not blindly following, not attaching to power, or having unique opinions; But the situation was very dangerous, so Ye Mingchen was defeated in the end, although he just had no idea. The latter is "riding the wall", or very ingeniously "falling with the wind", but in China it is the most lawful, so the Chinese's "holding the center" is probably this. If the old couplet is tampered with, it should be:“似战，似和，似守；“似战，似和，似守；
似死，似降，似走。” 似死，似降，似走。 ”
于是玄同即应据精神文明法律第九万三千八百九十四条，治以“误解真相，惑世诬民”之罪了。但因为文中用有“大概”二字，可以酌给末减：这两个字是我也很喜欢用的。Therefore, Xuantong should be punished according to Article 93,894 of the Law on Spiritual Civilization for the crime of "misunderstanding the truth and misleading the world and slandering the people". But because the word "probably" is used in the text, it can be subtracted at the end: these two words are also my favorite to use.

Poem by Petöfi Sándor　　我的父亲的和我的手艺
　　从幼小以来，亲爱的父亲，
你的诚实的嘴嘱咐我，很谆谆，
教我该像你似的，做一个屠兽者——
但你的儿子却成了文人。
　　你用了你的家伙击牛，
我的柔翰向人们开仗——
所做的都就是这个，
单是那名称两样。
　　愿我是树，倘使你……
　　愿我是树，倘使你是树的花朵；
你是露，我就愿意成花；
愿我是露罢，倘使你是太阳的一条光线；
我们的存在这就打成一家。
　　而且，倘使你，姑娘，是高天
我就愿意是，其中闪烁的一颗星；
然而倘使你，姑娘，是地狱，——
为要和你一处，我宁可永不超生。
　　太阳酷热得照临……
　　太阳酷热得照临
周遭的谷子都已成熟；
一到明天早晨，
我就开手去收获。
　　我的爱也成熟了。
红炽的是我的精神；
但愿你，甜蜜的，唯一的，——
但愿你是收割的人！
　　坟墓休息着……
　　坟墓里休息着我的初恋的人儿，
而我的苦痛就如月亮，当坟墓的夜中。
新的爱从我这里起来了，太阳似的，
而那月亮……在太阳的威力下柔融。
　　我的爱——并不是……
　　我的爱——并不是一只夜莺，
在曙红的招呼中觉醒，
用了受白昼的亲吻而赤热了的妙音，
来响彻这人境。
　　我的爱并不是郁郁葱葱的林薮，
有白鹄浮泛于闲静的鱼塘，
而且以雪白的颈子点首，
向了照耀在川水里的月亮的影光。
　　我的爱并不是欢欣安静的人家，
花园似的，将平和一门关住，
其中有“幸福”慈爱地往来，
而抚养那“欢欣”，那娇小的仙女。
　　我的爱，就如荒凉的沙漠一般，——
一个大盗似的有嫉妒在那里霸着；
他的剑是绝望的疯狂，
而每一刺是各样的谋杀。

May I be a tree, if you are the flower of a tree;  You are dew, I am willing to be a flower;  May I be a dew, if you are a ray of the sun;  Our existence is a family.  And, if you, girl, are high in the sky I would be a twinkling star in it;  But if you, girl, are hell,—— To be with you, I would rather never be reborn.  The sun is so hot that it ......  The sun is so hot  The surrounding millet is ripe;  As soon as tomorrow morning,  I'll start harvesting.  My love has also matured.  It's my spirit that is red;  May you, sweet, the only ,—— May you be the one who reaps!  Grave resting......  My first love rests in the grave,  And my pain is like the moon, when the night of the grave.  A new love has risen from me, like the sun,  And the moon ...... Melt under the power of the sun.  My love - not ......  My love is not a nightingale,  awakens in the dawn greeting,  uses the wonderful sound of being red from the kiss of the day,  to resound the human world.  My love is not the lush forest,  there are white swans floating in the quiet fish pond,  and nodding with a snow-white neck,  is the shadow of the moon shining in the river.  My love is not a joyful and quiet house,  like a garden, shutting a door of peace,  in which there is "happiness" lovingly coming and going,  and raising the "joy", the petite fairy. After chewing我的一篇《咬文嚼字》的“滥调”，又引起小麻烦来了，再说几句罢。

(2) Because of the bento, for example, Tolstoy had a daughter named Elizabeth Tolstoi, which is too troublesome to translate, and it is much simpler to use "Tuo You Silk Moss". He said that Go can be translated as Guo, Wi can be translated as Wang, and Ho can be translated as He, so why deliberately translate it as "each", "Wang" and "He"? But the letter asked again, and he replied: The meaning is found in the first sentence of the previous sentence.再说一遍罢，我那篇的开首说：“以摆脱传统思想之束缚……。”所以将翻译当作一种工具，或者图便利，爱折中的先生们是本来不在所讽的范围之内的。两位的通信似乎于这一点都没有看清楚。
Again, the beginning of my article says: "To get rid of the shackles of traditional thinking....... Therefore, the gentlemen who regard translation as a tool, or for convenience, love compromise are not within the scope of irony. The correspondence between the two did not seem to be clear at all.末了，我对于潜源先生的“末了”的话，还得辩正几句。（一）我自己觉得我和三苏中之任何一苏，都绝不相类，也不愿意比附任何古人，或者“故意”凌驾他们。倘以某古人相拟，我也明知是好意，但总是满身不舒服，和见人使Gorky姓高相同。（二）其实《呐喊》并不风行，其所以略略流行于新人物间者，因为其中的讽刺在表面上似乎大抵针对旧社会的缘故，但使老先生们一看，恐怕他们也要以为“吹敲”“苛责”，深恶而痛绝之的。（三）我并不觉得我有“名”，即使有之，也毫不想因此而作文更加郑重，来维持已有的名，以及别人的信仰。纵使别人以为无聊的东西，只要自己以为有聊，且不被暗中禁止阻碍，便总要发表曝露出来，使厌恶滥调的读者看看，可以从速改正误解，不相信我。因为我觉得我若专讲宇宙人生的大话，专刺旧社会给新青年看，希图在若干人们中保存那由误解而来的“信仰”，倒是“欺读者”，而于我是苦痛的。
Finally, I have to correct Mr. Qianyuan's "end" words. (1) I personally feel that I am by no means similar to any of the three Su, and I am not willing to be attached to any of the ancients, or "deliberately" surpass them. If I were to compare it to an ancient person, I know it was well-intentioned, but I was always uncomfortable, just like seeing someone who made Gorky's surname high. (2) In fact, "The Scream" is not popular, and the reason why it is slightly popular among new characters is because the satire in it seems to be mostly aimed at the old society on the surface, but if the old gentlemen see it, I am afraid that they will also think that they are "blowing" and "harsh", and they hate it deeply. (3) I don't feel that I have a "name", and even if I do, I don't want to make my composition more solemn because of it to maintain my existing name and other people's beliefs. Even if others think something is boring, as long as they think it is interesting and are not hindered by secret prohibitions, they must always publish and expose it, so that readers who hate clichés can see it, and they can quickly correct their misunderstandings and don't believe me. Chewing is not "boring"对于四日副刊上潜源先生的话再答几句：

But with the addition of small labor, there is no need to distinguish between those who do not need to be differentiated, which is a different matter. Miscellaneous称为神的和称为魔的战斗了，并非争夺天国，而在要得地狱的统治权。所以无论谁胜，地狱至今也还是照样的地狱。

But when I saw the printed "Modern Review", I decided to publish it again, because it was much more detailed than the point hanging on the tail over there. However, I am very aggrieved, and I can only do it in this boring "Mangyuan". I am very familiar with all three of them, and I have never studied any sexual ethics and psychology, so I dare not speak in layman's terms. However, I always thought that Mr. Zhang and Zhou had posted these discussions too early in China,—— although foreign countries have said that they are old, foreign countries are foreign countries. But I always feel that Mr. Chen is full of "corruption and corruption", which is about interests rather than right and wrong, and I don't understand the mystery.但陈先生文章的末段，读来却痛快——
But the last paragraph of Mr. Chen's article is happy to read -“……至于法律和道德相比，道德不妨比法律严些，法律所不禁止的，道德尽可加以禁止。例如拍马吹牛，似乎不是法律所禁止的……然则我们在道德上也可以容许拍马屁，认为无损人格么？”
“…… As for law and morality, morality may be stricter than law, and what is not prohibited by law can be prohibited by morality. For example, bragging does not seem to be prohibited by law...... So, can we morally allow flattery and think that it does not damage our personality? ”这我敢回答：是不能容许的。然而接着又起了一个类似的问题：例如女人被强奸，在法律上似乎不至于处死刑，然则我们在道德上也可以容许被强奸，认为无须自杀么？
I dare to answer: it is not allowed. However, a similar question then arises: for example, if a woman is raped, it does not seem to be legally punishable by death, so can we morally allow rape and think that suicide is not necessary?章先生的驳文似乎激昂些，因为他觉得陈先生的文章发表以后，攻击者便源源而来，就疑心到“教授”的头衔上去。那么，继起者就有“拍马屁”的嫌疑了，我想未必。但教授和学者的话，比起一个小编辑来，容易得社会信任，却也许是实情，因此从论敌看来，这些名称也就有了流弊了，真所谓“有一利必有一弊”。
Mr. Zhang's rebuttal seemed to be more passionate, because he felt that after Mr. Chen's article was published, attackers would come in a steady stream, and he would be suspicious of the title of "professor". Then, the successor is suspected of "flattering", I don't think so. However, the words of professors and scholars are easier to gain the trust of society than a small editor, but they may be the truth, so from the perspective of the enemy, these names also have drawbacks.十一日。
Eleventh day.

一九二五年

俄文译本《阿Q正传》序及著者自叙传略

一九二五年

The Russian translation of the "The Main Biography of Ah Q" and the author's autobiography and biography《阿Q正传》序
Preface to "The True Biography of A Q."这在我是很应该感谢，也是很觉得欣幸的事，就是：我的一篇短小的作品，仗着深通中国文学的王希礼（B．A．Vassiliev）先生的翻译，竟得展开在俄国读者的面前了。
This is something that I should be grateful for, and I am very pleased that one of my short works, translated by Mr. B.A. Vassiliev, who is well versed in Chinese literature, has to be unfolded in front of Russian readers.我虽然已经试做，但终于自己还不能很有把握，我是否真能够写出一个现代的我们国人的魂灵来。别人我不得而知，在我自己，总仿佛觉得我们人人之间各有一道高墙，将各个分离，使大家的心无从相印。这就是我们古代的聪明人，即所谓圣贤，将人们分为十等，说是高下各不相同。其名目现在虽然不用了，但那鬼魂却依然存在，并且，变本加厉，连一个人的身体也有了等差，使手对于足也不免视为下等的异类。造化生人，已经非常巧妙，使一个人不会感到别人的肉体上的痛苦了，我们的圣人和圣人之徒却又补了造化之缺，并且使人们不再会感到别人的精神上的痛苦。
Although I have tried it, I am not sure whether I can really write a modern soul of our people. I don't know about others, but in myself, I always seem to feel that there is a high wall between each of us, separating each other, so that everyone's hearts cannot be sealed. This is our ancient wise people, the so-called sages, who divided people into ten ranks, saying that they were different. Although its name is no longer used, the ghost still exists, and it has intensified, and even a person's body has become inferior, so that hands and feet are inevitably regarded as inferior outliers. The creation of people is already very ingenious, so that a person does not feel the physical pain of others, but our saints and saints make up for the lack of creation, and people no longer feel the spiritual pain of others.我们的古人又造出了一种难到可怕的一块一块的文字；但我还并不十分怨恨，因为我觉得他们倒并不是故意的。然而，许多人却不能借此说话了，加以古训所筑成的高墙，更使他们连想也不敢想。现在我们所能听到的，不过是几个圣人之徒的意见和道理，为了他们自己；至于百姓，却就默默的生长，萎黄，枯死了，像压在大石底下的草一样，已经有四千年！
Our ancients created a kind of text that is so difficult and terrifying that it is difficult to write piece by piece; But I don't really resentful it yet, because I don't think they did it on purpose. However, many people could not speak through this, and the high walls built by the ancient teachings made them even more afraid to think about it. Now all we can hear is the opinions and doctrines of a few saints, for their own sake; As for the people, they have grown silently, wilted, and withered, like grass pressed under a big rock, for four thousand years!要画出这样沉默的国民的魂灵来，在中国实在算一件难事，因为，已经说过，我们究竟还是未经革新的古国的人民，所以也还是各不相通，并且连自己的手也几乎不懂自己的足。我虽然竭力想摸索人们的魂灵，但时时总自憾有些隔膜。在将来，围在高墙里面的一切人众，该会自己觉醒，走出，都来开口的罢，而现在还少见，所以我也只得依了自己的觉察，孤寂地姑且将这些写出，作为在我的眼里所经过的中国的人生。
It is really difficult in China to draw the souls of such silent people, because, as I have said, we are still the people of an ancient country that has not been innovated, so we are still not connected, and even our own hands hardly understand our own feet. Although I try my best to explore people's souls, I always feel a bit separated. In the future, all the people surrounding the high wall will awaken and come out on their own, and they will all come to speak, but now it is still rare, so I have to follow my own awareness and write these out in solitude as the life of China in my eyes.我的小说出版之后，首先收到的是一个青年批评家的谴责；后来，也有以为是病的，也有以为滑稽的，也有以为讽刺的；或者还以为冷嘲，至于使我自己也要疑心自己的心里真藏着可怕的冰块。然而我又想，看人生是因作者而不同，看作品又因读者而不同，那么，这一篇在毫无“我们的传统思想”的俄国读者的眼中，也许又会照见别样的情景的罢，这实在是使我觉得很有意味的。
After the publication of my novel, the first thing I received was a condemnation from a young critic; Later, some thought it was sick, some thought it was funny, and some thought it was ironic; Or I thought it was a cynic, as for making me suspect that there was a terrible ice cube hidden in my heart. However, I also think that life is different for the author, and the work is different for the reader, so this article may see a different scene in the eyes of Russian readers who do not have "our traditional thought", which really makes me feel very meaningful.一九二五年五月二十六日，于北京。鲁迅。
一九二五年五月二十六日，于北京。 鲁迅。著者自叙传略
著者自叙传略我于一八八一年生在浙江省绍兴府城里的一家姓周的家里。父亲是读书的；母亲姓鲁，乡下人，她以自修得到能够看书的学力。听人说，在我幼小时候，家里还有四五十亩水田，并不很愁生计。但到我十三岁时，我家忽而遭了一场很大的变故，几乎什么也没有了；我寄住在一个亲戚家，有时还被称为乞食者。我于是决心回家，而我的父亲又生了重病，约有三年多，死去了。我渐至于连极少的学费也无法可想；我底母亲便给我筹办了一点旅费，教我去寻无需学费的学校去，因为我总不肯学做幕友或商人，——这是我乡衰落了的读书人家子弟所常走的两条路。
I was born in 1881 in Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang Province, to a family surnamed Zhou. Father is a reader; Her mother's surname is Lu, a country person, and she has gained the academic ability to read books through self-study. I heard that when I was young, there were still forty or fifty acres of paddy fields at home, and I was not very worried about making a living. But when I was thirteen years old, my family suddenly suffered a great change, and there was almost nothing left; I stayed with a relative's house and was sometimes called a beggar. I decided to go home, and my father became seriously ill again, and after about three years, he died. I gradually can't even think of a very small tuition fee; My mother arranged a little travel expenses for me and taught me to find a school that did not require tuition, because I always refused to learn to be a staff member or a businessman,—— which are the two roads that the children of declining scholars in my township often take.其时我是十八岁，便旅行到南京，考入水师学堂了，分在机关科。大约过了半年，我又走出，改进矿路学堂去学开矿，毕业之后，即被派往日本去留学。但待到在东京的豫备学校毕业，我已经决意要学医了，原因之一是因为我确知道了新的医学对于日本的维新有很大的助力。我于是进了仙台（Sendai）医学专门学校，学了两年。这时正值俄日战争，我偶然在电影上看见一个中国人因做侦探而将被斩，因此又觉得在中国还应该先提倡新文艺。我便弃了学籍，再到东京，和几个朋友立了些小计画，但都陆续失败了。我又想往德国去，也失败了。终于，因为我底母亲和几个别的人很希望我有经济上的帮助，我便回到中国来；这时我是二十九岁。
At that time, I was eighteen years old, so I traveled to Nanjing and was admitted to the Naval Academy, which was divided into the organ department. About half a year later, I went out again to improve the mining road school to learn to mine, and after graduation, I was sent to Japan to study. But by the time I graduated from the preparatory school in Tokyo, I had decided to study medicine, partly because I knew that the new medicine would greatly contribute to the restoration of Japan. I then entered Sendai Medical College for two years. At this time, it was the Russo-Japanese War, and I happened to see a Chinese person who was going to be beheaded for being a detective in a movie, so I felt that new literature and art should be promoted in China first. I gave up my student status and went to Tokyo, where I made some small plans with a few friends, but they all failed one after another. I wanted to go to Germany again, but I failed. Finally, because my mother and a few others wanted me to have financial help, I returned to China; I was twenty-nine years old at this time.我一回国，就在浙江杭州的两级师范学堂做化学和生理学教员，第二年就走出，到绍兴中学堂去做教务长，第三年又走出，没有地方可去，想在一个书店去做编译员，到底被拒绝了。但革命也就发生，绍兴光复后，我做了师范学校的校长。革命政府在南京成立，教育部长招我去做部员，移入北京，一直到现在。近几年，我还兼做北京大学，师范大学，女子师范大学的国文系讲师。
As soon as I returned to China, I worked as a chemistry and physiology teacher at a two-level normal school in Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, and in the second year I went out to Shaoxing Middle School to become the provostomy, and in the third year I went out again, with nowhere to go, and wanted to be a compiler in a bookstore, but I was rejected. But the revolution also happened, and after the liberation of Shaoxing, I became the principal of the normal school. The revolutionary government was established in Nanjing, and the Minister of Education recruited me to be a member of the ministry and moved to Beijing, where I have been until now. In recent years, I have also been a lecturer in the Department of Chinese Literature at Peking University, Normal University, and Women's Normal University.我在留学时候，只在杂志上登过几篇不好的文章。初做小说是一九一八年，因了我的朋友钱玄同的劝告，做来登在《新青年》上的。这时才用“鲁迅”的笔名（Penname）；也常用别的名字做一点短论。现在汇印成书的只有一本短篇小说集《呐喊》，其余还散在几种杂志上。别的，除翻译不计外，印成的又有一本《中国小说史略》。
When I was studying abroad, I only published a few bad articles in magazines. The first novel was written in 1918, and on the advice of my friend Qian Xuantong, it was published in "New Youth". At this time, the pen name of "Lu Xun" was used; Other names are also often used to make a short statement. Now only a collection of short stories "The Scream" has been printed into a book, and the rest are scattered in several magazines. In addition, in addition to the translation, there is also a "Brief History of Chinese Novels" printed.

Pastoral Thought (Communication)白波先生：
Mr. Bai Bo:我们憎恶的所谓“导师”，是自以为有正路，有捷径，而其实却是劝人不走的人。倘有领人向前者，只要自己愿意，自然也不妨追踪而往。但这样的前锋，怕中国现在还找不到罢。所以我想，与其找胡涂导师，倒不如自己走，可以省却寻觅的工夫，横竖他也什么都不知道。至于我那“遇见森林，可以辟成平地，……”这些话，不过是比方，犹言可以用自力克服一切困难，并非真劝人都到山里去。
The so-called "mentors" we hate are people who think they have the right path and shortcuts, but in fact they are people who persuade others not to go. If there is someone who leads people to the front, as long as they are willing, they may wish to follow it. But such a striker, I am afraid that China will not be able to find it yet. So I think that instead of looking for a Hu Tu tutor, it is better to go by yourself, which can save the time of searching, and he doesn't know anything. As for my words "When you meet a forest, you can open up a flat land,......" are just metaphors, saying that you can overcome all difficulties on your own, and it does not really persuade people to go to the mountains.十四年六月十二日。
