流言和谎话

一九二五年

流言和谎话这一回编辑《莽原》时，看见论及北京女子师范大学风潮的投稿里，还有用“某校”字样和几个方匡子的，颇使我觉得中国实在还很有存心忠厚的君子，国事大有可为。但其实，报章上早已明明白白地登载过许多次了。
When I edited "Mangyuan" this time, I saw that in the submission about the trend of Beijing Women's Normal University, there were also those with the word "a certain school" and a few Fang Kuangzi, which made me feel that China is still a very loyal gentleman, and there is a lot to be done in state affairs. But in fact, it has been clearly published many times in the newspaper.今年五月，为了“同系学生同时登两个相反的启事已经发现了……”那些事，已经使“喜欢怀疑”的西滢先生有“好像一个臭毛厕”之叹（见《现代评论》二十五期《闲话》），现在如果西滢先生已回北京，或者要更觉得“世风日下”了罢，因为三个相反，或相成的启事已经发现了：一是“女师大学生自治会”；二是“杨荫榆”；三是单叫作“女师大”。
In May of this year, in order to "have discovered that two opposite notices have been published by students in the same department at the same time...... those things have made Mr. Xiying, who "likes to doubt", sigh that he is "like a stinky toilet" (see "Gossip" in the 25th issue of "Modern Review"), and now if Mr. Xiying has returned to Beijing, he may feel that "the world is declining", because three opposite or mutually beneficial notices have been discovered: first, the "Women's Normal University Student Self-Government Association"; the second is "Yang Yinyu"; The third is simply called "Women's Normal University".报载对于学生“停止饮食茶水”，学生亦云“既感饥荒之苦，复虑生命之危”，而“女师大”云“全属子虚”，是相反的。而杨荫榆云“本校原望该生等及早觉悟自动出校并不愿其在校受生活上种种之不便也”，则似乎饮食确已停止，和“女师大”说相反，与报章及学生说相成。
The report said that students "stop eating tea", students also said that they "feel the pain of famine and worry about the danger of life", while "Women's Normal University" said that "all belong to Zixu", which is the opposite. However, Yang Yinyu said, "The school hopes that the students will realize and leave the school automatically as soon as possible, and do not want them to suffer all kinds of inconveniences in life in school", which seems to have indeed stopped eating and drinking, which is contrary to the "Women's Normal University" and is in line with the newspapers and students.学生云“杨荫榆突以武装入校，勒令同学全体即刻离校，嗣复命令军警肆意毒打侮辱……”，而杨荫榆云“荫榆于八月一日到校……暴劣学生肆行滋扰……故不能不请求警署拨派巡警保护……”，是因为“滋扰”才请派警，与学生说相反的。而“女师大”云“不料该生等非特不肯遵命竟敢任情谩骂极端侮辱……幸先经内右二区派拨警士在校防护……”，是派警在先，“滋扰”在后，和杨荫榆说相反的。至于京师警察厅行政处公布，则云“查本厅于上月三十一日准国立北京女子师范大学函……请准予八月一日照派保安警察三四十名来校……”，乃又与学生及“女师大”说相成了。杨荫榆确是先期准备了“武装入校”，而自己竟不知道，以为临时叫来，真是离奇。
The student said, "Yang Yinyu suddenly entered the school with an armed force, ordered all his classmates to leave the school immediately, and ordered the military and police to beat and insult ......", while Yang Yinyu said that "Yinyu arrived at the school on August 1...... Violent students are wantonly harassing...... Therefore, it is impossible not to ask the police station to send patrol officers to protect the ......", because of "nuisance", the police are requested, contrary to what the students said. And the "Women's Normal University" said: "Unexpectedly, the students not only refused to obey the order, but also dared to insult and insult them willfully...... Fortunately, the second district of the inner right first dispatched police sergeants to protect the ...... on campus", which is the first to send the police and the "nuisance" later, which is the opposite of what Yang Yinyu said. As for the announcement of the Administrative Office of the Beijing Police Department, it said, "The office approved the letter of Beijing Women's Normal University on the 31st of last month...... Please allow 30 to 40 security police officers to come to the school on August 1......," he said with the students and the "Women's Normal University". Yang Yinyu did prepare for "armed entry into the school" in advance, but he didn't know it, thinking that it was called temporarily, which was really bizarre.杨先生大约真如自己的启事所言，“始终以培植人才恪尽职守为素志……服务情形为国人所共鉴”的罢。“素志”我不得而知，至于“服务情形”，则不必再说别的，只要一看本月一日至四日的“女师大”和她自己的两个启事之离奇闪烁就尽够了！撒谎造谣，即在局外者也觉得。如果是严厉的观察者和批评者，即可以执此而推论其他。
Mr. Yang is probably as his notice said, "Always cultivate talents and fulfill their duties as their ambition...... The service situation is shared by the Chinese people". I don't know about "Suzhi", as for the "service situation", there is no need to say anything else, just look at the bizarre flashing of the "Women's Normal University" and her own two announcements from the 1st to the 4th of this month! Lying and spreading rumors is felt by outsiders. If it is a harsh observer and critic, it can be inferred from this and others.但杨先生却道：“所以勉力维持至于今日者非贪恋个人之地位为彻底整饬学风计也”，窃以为学风是决非造谣撒谎所能整饬的；——地位自然不在此例。
But Mr. Yang said: "Therefore, I am trying to maintain my position as of today, not because I am greedy for personal status, but because I am a plan to completely rectify the academic style", I think that the academic style is by no means something that can be corrected by spreading rumors and lying; ——Status is naturally not an example.且住，我又来说话了，或者西滢先生们又许要听到许多“流言”。然而请放心罢，我虽然确是“某籍”，也做过国文系的一两点钟的教员，但我并不想谋校长，或仍做教员以至增加钟点；也并不为子孙计，防她们会在女师大被诬被革，挨打挨饿。我借一句Lermontov的愤激的话告诉你们：“我幸而没有女儿！”
Wait a moment, I'm talking again, or Mr. Xiying will hear a lot of "rumors" again. However, please rest assured, although I am indeed a "certain nationality" and have been a teacher in the Department of Chinese Literature for one or two o'clock, I do not want to become a principal, or still be a teacher or increase my hours; It is not for the sake of their descendants, to prevent them from being falsely accused and dismissed, beaten and starved at the Women's Normal University. I will tell you to borrow Lermontov's indignant words: "I am fortunate to have no daughter!" ”八月五日。

通信

correspondence霉江先生：
Mr. Mold Jiang:如果“叛徒”们造成战线而能遇到敌人，中国的情形早已不至于如此，因为现在所遇见的并无敌人，只有暗箭罢了。所以想有战线，必须先有敌人，这事情恐怕还辽远得很，若现在，则正如来信所说，大概连是友是仇也不大容易分辨清楚的。
If the "traitors" create a front and can encounter the enemy, the situation in China will not be like this long ago, because there is no enemy now, only hidden arrows. So if you want to have a front, you must first have an enemy, this matter is probably still very far away, if now, as the letter said, it is probably not easy to distinguish whether it is friend or enemy.我对于《语丝》的责任，只有投稿，所以关于刊载的事，不知其详。至于江先生的文章，我得到来信后，才看了一点。我的意见，以为先生太认真了，大约连作者自己也未必以为他那些话有这么被人看得值得讨论。
My responsibility for "Yusi" is only to submit, so I don't know the details about the publication. As for Mr. Jiang's article, I read it a little after I got the letter. In my opinion, I think the gentleman is too serious, and even the author himself may not think that his words are so worthy of discussion.先生大概年纪还青，所以竟这样愤慨，而且推爱及我，代我发愁，我实在不胜感谢。这事其实是不难的，只要打听大学教授陈源（即西滢）先生，也许能够知道章士钊是否又要“私禀执政”，因为陈教授那里似乎常有“流言”飞扬。但是，这不是我的事。
My husband is probably still young, so he is so indignant, and he loves me and worries on my behalf, and I am really grateful. This matter is actually not difficult, as long as you inquire about the university professor Mr. Chen Yuan (i.e. Xi Ying), you may be able to know whether Zhang Shizhao wants to "privately govern" again, because Professor Chen seems to have "rumors" flying there. However, this is not my thing.鲁迅。九月一日。Lu Xun. September 1st.

《痴华鬘》题记

一九二六年

The inscription of "Foolish Hair"尝闻天竺寓言之富，如大林深泉，他国艺文，往往蒙其影响。即翻为华言之佛经中，亦随在可见，明徐元太辑《喻林》，颇加搜录，然卷帙繁重，不易得之。佛藏中经，以譬喻为名者，亦可五六种，惟《百喻经》最有条贯。其书具名《百句譬喻经》；《出三藏记集》云，天竺僧伽斯那从《修多罗藏》十二部经中钞出譬喻，聚为一部，凡一百事，为新学者，撰说此经。萧齐永明十年九月十日，中天竺法师求那毗地出。以譬喻说法者，本经云，“如阿伽陀药，树叶而裹之，取药涂毒竟，树叶还弃之，戏笑如叶裹，实义在其中”也。王君品青爱其设喻之妙，因除去教诫，独留寓言；又缘经末有“尊者僧伽斯那造作《痴华鬘》竟”语，即据以回复原名，仍印为两卷。尝称百喻，而实缺二者，疑举成数，或并以卷首之引，卷末之偈为二事也。尊者造论，虽以正法为心，譬故事于树叶，而言必及法，反多拘牵；今则已无阿伽陀药，更何得有药裹，出离界域，内外洞然，智者所见，盖不惟佛说正义而已矣。
尝闻天竺寓言之富，如大林深泉，他国艺文，往往蒙其影响。 即翻为华言之佛经中，亦随在可见，明徐元太辑《喻林》，颇加搜录，然卷帙繁重，不易得之。 佛藏中经，以譬喻为名者，亦可五六种，惟《百喻经》最有条贯。 其书具名《百句譬喻经》；《出三藏记集》云，天竺僧伽斯那从《修多罗藏》十二部经中钞出譬喻，聚为一部，凡一百事，为新学者，撰说此经。 萧齐永明十年九月十日，中天竺法师求那毗地出。 以譬喻说法者，本经云，“如阿伽陀药，树叶而裹之，取药涂毒竟，树叶还弃之，戏笑如叶裹，实义在其中”也。 王君品青爱其设喻之妙，因除去教诫，独留寓言；又缘经末有“尊者僧伽斯那造作《痴华鬘》竟”语，即据以回复原名，仍印为两卷。 尝称百喻，而实缺二者，疑举成数，或并以卷首之引，卷末之偈为二事也。 尊者造论，虽以正法为心，譬故事于树叶，而言必及法，反多拘牵；今则已无阿伽陀药，更何得有药裹，出离界域，内外洞然，智者所见，盖不惟佛说正义而已矣。中华民国十五年五月十二日，鲁迅。

一九二六年

《穷人》小引

一九二六年

"Poor Man" small introduction千八百八十年，是陀思妥夫斯基完成了他的巨制之一《卡拉玛卓夫兄弟》这一年；他在手记上说：“以完全的写实主义在人中间发见人。这是彻头彻尾俄国底特质。在这意义上，我自然是民族底的。……人称我为心理学家（Psychologist）。这不得当。我但是在高的意义上的写实主义者，即我是将人的灵魂的深，显示于人的。”第二年，他就死了。
1880 was the year Dostovsky completed one of his masterpieces, The Brothers Karamazov; He said in his notes: "Discover people among people with complete realism." This is a Russian trait through and through. In this sense, I am naturally national. …… People call me a psychologist. This is inappropriate. I am a realist in a high sense, that is, I am showing the depth of the human soul to people. The following year, he died.显示灵魂的深者，每要被人看作心理学家；尤其是陀思妥夫斯基那样的作者。他写人物，几乎无须描写外貌，只要以语气，声音，就不独将他们的思想和感情，便是面目和身体也表示着。又因为显示着灵魂的深，所以一读那作品，便令人发生精神底变化。灵魂的深处并不平安，敢于正视的本来就不多，更何况写出？因此有些柔软无力的读者，便往往将他只看作“残酷的天才”。
Those who show the depth of the soul should always be regarded as psychologists; Especially authors like Dostovsky. When he writes about characters, he hardly needs to describe their appearance, as long as he uses tone and voice, he not only expresses their thoughts and feelings, but also their faces and bodies. And because it shows the depth of the soul, as soon as you read the work, it makes people change spiritually. The depths of the soul are not peaceful, and there are not many who dare to face it, let alone write it? Therefore, some weak readers often regard him only as a "cruel genius".陀思妥夫斯基将自己作品中的人物们，有时也委实太置之万难忍受的，没有活路的，不堪设想的境地，使他们什么事都做不出来。用了精神底苦刑，送他们到那犯罪，痴呆，酗酒，发狂，自杀的路上去。有时候，竟至于似乎并无目的，只为了手造的牺牲者的苦恼，而使他受苦，在骇人的卑污的状态上，表示出人们的心来。这确凿是一个“残酷的天才”，人的灵魂的伟大的审问者。
Dostovsky put the characters in his works into unbearable, unbearable, unimaginable situations, and so that they could not do anything. They used mental torture to send them on the road of crime, dementia, alcoholism, madness, and suicide. Sometimes, it seems that there is no purpose, but only for the suffering of the victim made by hand, and he suffers, expressing the hearts of people in a terrifyingly despicable state. This is indeed a "cruel genius", the great interrogator of the human soul.然而，在这“在高的意义上的写实主义者”的实验室里，所处理的乃是人的全灵魂。他又从精神底苦刑，送他们到那反省，矫正，忏悔，苏生的路上去；甚至于又是自杀的路。到这样，他的“残酷”与否，一时也就难于断定，但对于爱好温暖或微凉的人们，却还是没有什么慈悲的气息的。
However, in the laboratory of this "realist in the high sense", what is being dealt with is the whole soul of man. He also tortured them from the bottom of the spirit, sending them on the road of reflection, correction, repentance, and resuscitation; It is even a road to suicide again. At this point, it is difficult to determine whether he is "cruel" or not, but there is still no compassionate atmosphere for people who like warmth or coolness.相传陀思妥夫斯基不喜欢对人述说自己，尤不喜欢述说自己的困苦；但和他一生相纠结的却正是困难和贫穷。便是作品，也至于只有一回是并没有豫支稿费的著作。但他掩藏着这些事。他知道金钱的重要，而他最不善于使用的又正是金钱；直到病得寄养在一个医生的家里了，还想将一切来诊的病人当作佳客。他所爱，所同情的是这些，——贫病的人们，——所记得的是这些，所描写的是这些；而他所毫无顾忌地解剖，详检，甚而至于鉴赏的也是这些。不但这些，其实，他早将自己也加以精神底苦刑了，从年青时候起，一直拷问到死灭。
According to legend, Dostovsky did not like to talk about himself to others, especially his hardships; But what entangled his life was difficulties and poverty. It is a work, and only once is a work that does not pay the manuscript fee in advance. But he hides these things. He knows the importance of money, and it is money that he is the least good at using; Until he was so sick that he was fostered in a doctor's house, he still wanted to treat all the patients who came to see him as a guest. What he loves and sympathizes with is these people who are ,—— poor and sick,—— what he remembers and describes; And he dissected, examined in detail, and even appreciated these without scruples. Not only these, in fact, he had already tortured himself mentally, and since he was young, he has been tortured until he died.凡是人的灵魂的伟大的审问者，同时也一定是伟大的犯人。审问者在堂上举劾着他的恶，犯人在阶下陈述他自己的善；审问者在灵魂中揭发污秽，犯人在所揭发的污秽中阐明那埋藏的光耀。这样，就显示出灵魂的深。
Whoever is the great interrogator of the human soul must also be a great prisoner. The inquisitor denounces his evil in the hall, and the prisoner states his own good at the bottom of the steps; The interrogator exposes the filth in the soul, and the prisoner reveals the buried light in the filth it exposes. In this way, the depth of the soul is shown.在甚深的灵魂中，无所谓“残酷”，更无所谓慈悲；但将这灵魂显示于人的，是“在高的意义上的写实主义者”。
In the deep soul, there is no such thing as "cruelty", let alone compassion; But the one who shows this soul to people is "a realist in a high sense".陀思妥夫斯基的著作生涯一共有三十五年，虽那最后的十年很偏重于正教的宣传了，但其为人，却不妨说是始终一律。即作品，也没有大两样。从他最初的《穷人》起，最后的《卡拉玛卓夫兄弟》止，所说的都是同一的事，即所谓“捉住了心中所实验的事实，使读者追求着自己思想的径路，从这心的法则中，自然显示出伦理的观念来。”
Dostovsky's writing career lasted a total of thirty-five years, and although the last ten years were very focused on Orthodox propaganda, his character may be said to have always been the same. Even if it is a work, there is no big difference. From his first "Poor Man" to the last "The Karamazov Brothers", all of them are talking about the same thing, that is, the so-called "grasping the facts of the experiment in the mind, so that the reader pursues the path of his own thought, and from this law of the heart, the concept of ethics is naturally revealed." ”这也可以说：穿掘着灵魂的深处，使人受了精神底苦刑而得到创伤，又即从这得伤和养伤和愈合中，得到苦的涤除，而上了苏生的路。
This can also be said to be that digging into the depths of the soul, causing people to suffer from spiritual torture and get trauma, that is, from this wound, healing and healing, they get rid of suffering and go on the road of resurrection.《穷人》是作于千八百四十五年，到第二年发表的；是第一部，也是使他即刻成为大家的作品；格里戈洛维奇和涅克拉梭夫为之狂喜，培林斯基曾给他公正的褒辞。自然，这也可以说，是显示着“谦逊之力”的。然而，世界竟是这么广大，而又这么狭窄；穷人是这么相爱，而又不得相爱；暮年是这么孤寂，而又不安于孤寂。他晚年的手记说：“富是使个人加强的，是器械底和精神底满足。因此也将个人从全体分开。”富终于使少女从穷人分离了，可怜的老人便发了不成声的绝叫。爱是何等地纯洁，而又何其有搅扰咒诅之心呵！
"The Poor" was written in 1845 and published the following year; It was the first and the work that made him an instant everyone; Grigorovich and Nekrasov were ecstatic, and Pelinsky gave him fair praise. Naturally, this can also be said to show the "power of humility". However, the world is so vast and so narrow; The poor love each other so much, but they can't love each other; In his twilight years, he was so lonely, and he was uneasy about loneliness. His memoirs in his later years said: "Wealth strengthens the individual, and it is the satisfaction of the instrument and the spirit. Therefore, it also separates the individual from the whole. The rich finally separated the girl from the poor, and the poor old man let out a silent scream. How pure love is, and how disturbing and cursing it is!而作者其时只有二十四岁，却尤是惊人的事。天才的心诚然是博大的。
And the author was only twenty-four years old at the time, which is particularly amazing. The heart of a genius is indeed broad.中国的知道陀思妥夫斯基将近十年了，他的姓已经听得耳熟，但作品的译本却未见。这也无怪，虽是他的短篇，也没有很简短，便于急就的。这回丛芜才将他的最初的作品，最初绍介到中国来，我觉得似乎很弥补了些缺憾。这是用Constance Garnett的英译本为主，参考了Modern Library的英译本译出的，歧异之处，便由我比较了原白光的日文译本以定从违，又经素园用原文加以校定。在陀思妥夫斯基全集十二巨册中，这虽然不过是一小分，但在我们这样只有微力的人，却很用去许多工作了。藏稿经年，才得印出，便借了这短引，将我所想到的写出，如上文。陀思妥夫斯基的人和他的作品，本是一时研究不尽的，统论全般，决非我的能力所及，所以这只好算作管窥之说；也仅仅略翻了三本书：Dostoievsky's Literarsche Schriften，Mereschkovsky's Dostoievsky und Tolstoy，昇曙梦的《露西亚文学研究》。
China has known Dostovsky for nearly ten years, and his surname is already familiar, but the translation of his work has not been seen. No wonder, although it is his short story, it is not very short and easy to rush. This time, Cong Wu introduced his original works to China, and I think it seems to have made up for some shortcomings. This is mainly based on the English translation of Constance Garnett, with reference to the English translation of the Modern Library, and the differences are compared by me to determine the contradiction of the original Baiguang's Japanese translation, and then corrected by Suyuan in the original text. Although this is only a small part of the twelve huge volumes of Dostovsky's complete works, it takes a lot of work for people like us who only have little strength. It took a year to print the manuscript, so I borrowed this short quote to write what I thought, as above. Dostovsky's people and his works were inexhaustible for a while, and the overall theory was by no means beyond my ability, so this can only be regarded as a peeping theory; I only skimmed three books: Dostoievsky's Literarsche Schriften, Mereschkovsky's Dostoievsky und Tolstoy, and Shushu Meng's "Lucian Literary Studies".俄国人姓名之长，常使中国的读者觉得烦难，现在就在此略加解释。那姓名全写起来，是总有三个字的：首先是名，其次是父名，第三是姓。例如这书中的解屋斯金，是姓；人却称他马加尔亚列舍维奇，意思就是亚列舍的儿子马加尔，是客气的称呼；亲昵的人就只称名，声音还有变化。倘是女的，便叫她“某之女某”。例如瓦尔瓦拉亚列舍夫那，意思就是亚列舍的女儿瓦尔瓦拉；有时叫她瓦兰加，则是瓦尔瓦拉的音变，也就是亲昵的称呼。
The length of Russian names often annoys Chinese readers, so I will explain it here a little. When the name is written, there are always three words: the first is the first name, the second is the patronymic name, and the third is the surname. For example, the Jiewu Skin in this book is a surname; People call him Magar Yareshevich, which means Magar, the son of Alexhe, which is a polite title; Close people only call by name, and their voices change. If it is a woman, call her "so-and-so's daughter". For example, Varvara Yareshevna, which means Varvara, the daughter of Aleksha; Sometimes calling her Varanga is a transliteration of Varvara, that is, an affectionate name.一九二六年六月二日之夜，鲁迅记于东壁下。
On the night of June 2, 1926, Lu Xun recorded it under the east wall.

This is a point to ask you.因为我喜欢看《莽原》，忽然听到教授老爷们说它谈社会主义，像我这样的学生小子，自然是要起恐慌的。因为社会主义这四字是不好的名词，像洪水猛兽的一般——在他们看起来。因为现在谈社会主义的书，就像从前“有图画的本子，就要被塾师，就是当时的‘引导青年的前辈’禁止，呵斥，甚而至于打手心”一样。因为恐怕他们禁止我读我爱读的《莽原》，而要我去读“人之初性本善”，至于呵斥，打手心，所以害怕得要死。这也是要问你的一点，要问你一个明白的一点。
Because I like to watch "Mangyuan", I suddenly heard the professors say that it talks about socialism, and students like me naturally have to panic. Because the four words socialism are bad terms, like a flood beast - in their eyes. Because books that talk about socialism now are like in the past, "books with pictures will be banned and scolded by the tunic teacher, that is, the 'seniors who guide young people' at that time, and even slapped the palm of the hand". Because I was afraid that they forbade me from reading the "Mangyuan" that I loved to read, and asked me to read "The Original Goodness of Man", as for scolding and slapping the palm of my hand, so I was scared to death. Six, one, not named in Wuchang.我并不是姓未名名，也不是名未名，未名也不是我的别号，也不是像你们未名社没有取名字的意义。我的名二十一年前已经取好了，只是怕你把它宣布出来，那末他们教授老爷就要加害于我，所以不写出来。因为没有写出自己的真名字，就名之曰未名。

Thank you for your letter, so that we know that our "Mangyuan" was originally "talking about socialism".这也不独武昌的教授为然，全国的教授都大同小异。一个已经足够了，何况是聚起来成了“会”。他们的根据，就在“教授”，这是明明白白的。我想他们的话在“会”里也一定不会错。为什么呢？就因为他们是教授。我们的乡下评定是非，常是这样：“赵太爷说对的，还会错么？他田地就有二百亩！”
This is not only true for professors in Wuchang, but also for professors across the country. One is enough, not to mention that it has become a "meeting". Their basis is in the "professor", which is clear. I think their words will not be wrong in "will". Why? Just because they are professors. Our countryside often judges right and wrong: "Mrs. Zhao is right, can he still be wrong?" He has two hundred acres of land! ”至于《莽原》，说起来实在惭愧，正如武昌的C先生来信所说，不过“是些废话和大部分的文艺作品”。我们倒也并不是看见社会主义四个字就吓得两眼朝天，口吐白沫，只是没有研究过，所以也没有谈，自然更没有用此来宣传任何主义的意思。“为什么要办刊物？一定是要宣传什么主义。为什么要宣传主义？一定是在得某国的钱”这一类的教授逻辑，在我们的心里还没有。所以请你尽可放心看去，总不至于因此会使教授化为白痴，富翁变成乞丐的。——但保险单我可也不写。
As for "Mangyuan", it is really ashamed to say, as Mr. C from Wuchang said, but "it is some nonsense and most of the literary and artistic works". We are not frightened and foam at the mouth when we see the word socialism, but we have not studied it, so we have not talked about it, and naturally we do not use it to promote any doctrine. "Why do you want to run a publication? It must be to propagate some doctrine. Why propaganda? It must be getting money from a certain country" and other teaching logic is not in our hearts. So please look at it with confidence, so that it will not turn the professor into an idiot and the rich man into a beggar. ——But I don't write insurance policies.你的名字用得不错，在现在的中国，这种“加害”的确要防的。北京大学的一个学生因为投稿用了真名，已经被教授老爷谋害了。《现代评论》上有人发议论道，“假设我们把知识阶级完全打倒后一百年，世界成个什么世界呢？”你看他多么“心上有杞天之虑”？
Your name is used well, and in today's China, this kind of "harm" really needs to be guarded against. A student at Peking University has been murdered by the professor because he used his real name for submitting his submission. Someone in the "Modern Review" commented, "Assuming that we completely overthrow the intellectual class, what kind of world will the world become?" Do you see how "worried he is"?鲁迅。六，九。

一九二七年

文艺与政治的歧途The Wrong Path of Literature and Politics ——在暨南大学讲演 - Lecture at Jinan University
我是不大出来讲演的；今天到此地来，不过因为说过了好几次，来讲一回也算了却一件事。我所以不出来讲演，一则没有什么意见可讲，二则刚才这位先生说过，在座的很多读过我的书，我更不能讲什么。书上的人大概比实物好一点，《红楼梦》里面的人物，像贾宝玉林黛玉这些人物，都使我有异样的同情；后来，考究一些当时的事实，到北京后，看看梅兰芳姜妙香扮的贾宝玉林黛玉，觉得并不怎样高明。
I don't come out to give lectures; I'm here today, but because I've said it several times, it's one thing to talk about it once. The reason I don't come out to give a speech is that I have no opinions to say, and secondly, this gentleman just said that many of you here have read my books, and I can't say anything. The people in the book are probably a little better than the real thing, and the characters in "Dream of Red Mansions", such as Jia Baoyu and Lin Daiyu, all make me feel strange sympathy; Later, after studying some facts at that time, after arriving in Beijing, I looked at Jia Baoyu and Lin Daiyu played by Mei Lanfang and Jiang Miaoxiang, and I felt that they were not very clever.我没有整篇的鸿论，也没有高明的见解，只能讲讲我近来所想到的。我每每觉到文艺和政治时时在冲突之中；文艺和革命原不是相反的，两者之间，倒有不安于现状的同一。惟政治是要维持现状，自然和不安于现状的文艺处在不同的方向。不过不满意现状的文艺，直到十九世纪以后才兴起来，只有一段短短历史。政治家最不喜欢人家反抗他的意见，最不喜欢人家要想，要开口。而从前的社会也的确没有人想过什么，又没有人开过口。且看动物中的猴子，它们自有它们的首领；首领要它们怎样，它们就怎样。在部落里，他们有一个酋长，他们跟着酋长走，酋长的吩咐，就是他们的标准。酋长要他们死，也只好去死。那时没有什么文艺，即使有，也不过赞美上帝（还没有后人所谓God那么玄妙）罢了！那里会有自由思想？后来，一个部落一个部落你吃我吞，渐渐扩大起来，所谓大国，就是吞吃那多多少少的小部落；一到了大国，内部情形就复杂得多，夹着许多不同的思想，许多不同的问题。这时，文艺也起来了，和政治不断地冲突；政治想维系现状使它统一，文艺催促社会进化使它渐渐分离；文艺虽使社会分裂，但是社会这样才进步起来。文艺既然是政治家的眼中钉，那就不免被挤出去。外国许多文学家，在本国站不住脚，相率亡命到别个国度去；这个方法，就是“逃”。要是逃不掉，那就被杀掉，割掉他的头；割掉头那是最好的方法，既不会开口，又不会想了。俄国许多文学家，受到这个结果，还有许多充军到冰雪的西伯利亚去。
I don't have a whole grand theory, nor do I have brilliant opinions, so I can only talk about what I have thought of recently. I always feel that literature and art and politics are always in conflict; Literature and art and revolution are not opposites, but between the two, there is the same thing that is uneasy about the status quo. However, politics is to maintain the status quo, and nature and literature and art that are uneasy about the status quo are in different directions. However, literature and art that were dissatisfied with the status quo did not rise until after the 19th century, and only had a short history. Politicians don't like people to resist his opinions, and they don't like people to think and speak. And in the past, no one really thought about anything, and no one spoke up. Let's look at the monkeys among the animals, they have their own leaders; The leader wants them, they do as they are. In the tribe, they have a chief, they follow the chief, and the chief's orders are their standards. The chief wanted them to die, so they had to die. At that time, there was no literature and art, and even if there were, it was just praise to God (not as mysterious as the so-called God of later generations)! Where will there be free thought? Later, one tribe at a time, you eat and I swallow, and gradually expanded, the so-called big country is to devour the more or less small tribes; Once you arrive in a big country, the internal situation is much more complicated, with many different ideas and many different problems. At this time, literature and art also rose, and politics were constantly in conflict; Politics wants to maintain the status quo to unify it, and literature and art urge social evolution to gradually separate it; Although literature and art divide society, society progresses in this way. Since literature and art are a thorn in the side of politicians, they will inevitably be squeezed out. Many foreign writers could not stand in their own countries and fled to other countries; This method is to "escape". if he can't escape, he will be killed and his head cut off; Cutting off the head is the best way, neither opening nor thinking. Many Russian writers were conscripted to Siberia in the ice and snow as a result of this.有一派讲文艺的，主张离开人生，讲些月呀花呀鸟呀的话（在中国又不同，有国粹的道德，连花呀月呀都不许讲，当作别论），或者专讲“梦”，专讲些将来的社会，不要讲得太近。这种文学家，他们都躲在象牙之塔里面；但是“象牙之塔”毕竟不能住得很长久的呀！象牙之塔总是要安放在人间，就免不掉还要受政治的压迫。打起仗来，就不能不逃开去。北京有一班文人，顶看不起描写社会的文学家，他们想，小说里面连车夫的生活都可以写进去，岂不把小说应该写才子佳人一首诗生爱情的定律都打破了吗？现在呢，他们也不能做高尚的文学家了，还是要逃到南边来；“象牙之塔”的窗子里，到底没有一块一块面包递进来的呀！
There is a school of literature and art, advocating leaving life and talking about the moon, flowers, and birds (which is different in China, there is a national quintessence of morality, and even flowers and moons are not allowed to be talked about, as a separate discussion), or they focus on "dreams" and talk about the future society, and don't talk too closely. This kind of writer, they all hide in the ivory tower; But the "Ivory Tower" can't live for a long time after all! The ivory tower always has to be placed in the world, and it is inevitable that it will be oppressed by politics. When a war starts, you can't help but run away. There is a group of literati in Beijing who look down on writers who describe society, and they think that even the life of the coachman can be written in the novel. Now, they can't be noble writers anymore, they still have to flee to the south; In the window of the "Ivory Tower", there was no piece of bread handed in!等到这些文学家也逃出来了，其他文学家早已死的死，逃的逃了。别的文学家，对于现状早感到不满意，又不能不反对，不能不开口，“反对”“开口”就是有他们的下场。我以为文艺大概由于现在生活的感受，亲身所感到的，便影印到文艺中去。挪威有一文学家，他描写肚子饿，写了一本书，这是依他所经验的写的。对于人生的经验，别的且不说，“肚子饿”这件事，要是欢喜，便可以试试看，只要两天不吃饭，饭的香味便会是一个特别的诱惑；要是走过街上饭铺子门口，更会觉得这个香味一阵阵冲到鼻子来。我们有钱的时候，用几个钱不算什么；直到没有钱，一个钱都有它的意味。那本描写肚子饿的书里，它说起那人饿得久了，看见路人个个是仇人，即是穿一件单褂子的，在他眼里也见得那是骄傲。我记起我自己曾经写过这样一个人，他身边什么都光了，时常抽开抽屉看看，看角上边上可以找到什么；路上一处一处去找，看有什么可以找得到；这个情形，我自己是体验过来的。
By the time these writers also escaped, other writers were already dead and fleeing. Other writers have long been dissatisfied with the status quo, and they cannot help but oppose it, and they cannot help but speak out. I thought that literature and art were probably copied into literature and art because of the feelings of life now, and what I felt firsthand. There was a Norwegian writer who wrote a book about hunger, which was written according to his experience. For life experience, not to mention anything else, if you are happy about "hungry", you can try it, as long as you don't eat for two days, the aroma of rice will be a special temptation; If you walk past the door of the restaurant on the street, you will feel that this fragrance rushes to your nose. When we have money, it is nothing to use a few money; Until there is no money, a money has its meaning. In the book about hunger, it talks about the man who has been hungry for a long time, and when he sees that all the passers-by are enemies, that is, he wears a single coat, and he also sees pride in his eyes. I remember that I once wrote about such a person who was exposed to everything around him, and often opened the drawer to see what could be found on the corner; look for it everywhere on the road to see what you can find; I have experienced this situation myself.从生活窘迫过来的人，一到了有钱，容易变成两种情形：一种是理想世界，替处同一境遇的人着想，便成为人道主义；一种是什么都是自己挣起来，从前的遭遇，使他觉得什么都是冷酷，便流为个人主义。我们中国大概是变成个人主义者多。主张人道主义的，要想替穷人想想法子，改变改变现状，在政治家眼里，倒还不如个人主义的好；所以人道主义者和政治家就有冲突。俄国文学家托尔斯泰讲人道主义，反对战争，写过三册很厚的小说——那部《战争与和平》，他自己是个贵族，却是经过战场的生活，他感到战争是怎么一个惨痛。尤其是他一临到长官的铁板前（战场上重要军官都有铁板挡住枪弹），更有刺心的痛楚。而他又眼见他的朋友们，很多在战场上牺牲掉。战争的结果，也可以变成两种态度：一种是英雄，他见别人死的死伤的伤，只有他健存，自己就觉得怎样了不得，这么那么夸耀战场上的威雄。一种是变成反对战争的，希望世界上不要再打仗了。托尔斯泰便是后一种，主张用无抵抗主义来消灭战争。他这么主张，政府自然讨厌他；反对战争，和俄皇的侵掠欲望冲突；主张无抵抗主义，叫兵士不替皇帝打仗，警察不替皇帝执法，审判官不替皇帝裁判，大家都不去捧皇帝；皇帝是全要人捧的，没有人捧，还成什么皇帝，更和政治相冲突。这种文学家出来，对于社会现状不满意，这样批评，那样批评，弄得社会上个个都自己觉到，都不安起来，自然非杀头不可。
People who have come from life difficulties can easily become into two situations when they are rich: one is an ideal world, and if you think about people in the same situation, it will become humanitarian; One is that everything is earned by himself, and his past experiences make him feel that everything is cold, so he becomes individualistic. We in China have probably become more individualists. Those who advocate humanitarianism want to think of ideas for the poor and change the status quo, in the eyes of politicians, it is not as good as individualism; So there is a conflict between humanitarians and politicians. The Russian writer Tolstoy talked about humanism, opposed war, and wrote three thick novels - the one "War and Peace", he himself was an aristocrat, but after living on the battlefield, he felt how painful the war was. Especially when he came to the iron plate of the commander (important officers on the battlefield had iron plates to block bullets), it was even more piercing. And he saw that many of his friends died on the battlefield. The result of the war can also be turned into two attitudes: one is a hero, he sees the dead and wounded of others, only he is alive, he thinks it is amazing, so he boasts of his might on the battlefield. One is to become opposed to war, hoping that there will be no more wars in the world. Tolstoy is the latter, advocating the use of non-resistance to eliminate war. He advocated this, and the government naturally hated him; opposed to war and conflicted with the Russian emperor's desire to invade; advocated no resistance, so that soldiers did not fight for the emperor, the police did not enforce the law for the emperor, the judges did not judge for the emperor, and everyone did not praise the emperor; The emperor is all praised by the dignitaries, and if no one holds it, what kind of emperor will he be, and it will conflict with politics. This kind of writer came out and was dissatisfied with the social status quo, and criticized in this way and criticized like that, which made everyone in the society feel uneasy and uneasy, so naturally they had to be killed.但是，文艺家的话其实还是社会的话，他不过感觉灵敏，早感到早说出来（有时，他说得太早，连社会也反对他，也排轧他）。譬如我们学兵式体操，行举枪礼，照规矩口令是“举……枪”这般叫，一定要等“枪”字令下，才可以举起。有些人却是一听到“举”字便举起来，叫口令的要罚他，说他做错。文艺家在社会上正是这样；他说得早一点，大家都讨厌他。政治家认定文学家是社会扰乱的煽动者，心想杀掉他，社会就可平安。殊不知杀了文学家，社会还是要革命；俄国的文学家被杀掉的充军的不在少数，革命的火焰不是到处燃着吗？文学家生前大概不能得到社会的同情，潦倒地过了一生，直到死后四五十年，才为社会所认识，大家大闹起来。政治家因此更厌恶文学家，以为文学家早就种下大祸根；政治家想不准大家思想，而那野蛮时代早已过去了。在座诸位的见解，我虽然不知道；据我推测，一定和政治家是不相同；政治家既永远怪文艺家破坏他们的统一，偏见如此，所以我从来不肯和政治家去说。
However, the words of writers and artists are actually the words of society, and he just feels sensitive and speaks early (sometimes, he speaks too early, and even society opposes him and rejects him). For example, when we learn military gymnastics, we perform a gun salute, and the password is "lifting...... Gun" must wait for the word "gun" to be given before it can be raised. Some people raise it as soon as they hear the word "lift", and the person who calls the password wants to punish him, saying that he has done something wrong. Writers and artists are like this in society; He said it a little earlier, and everyone hated him. Politicians believe that writers are instigators of social disturbance, and they want to kill him, so that society can be safe. As everyone knows, if the writer is killed, society still needs to be revolutionary; Many Russian writers were killed and conscripted, and the flame of revolution was not burning everywhere? Writers probably could not get the sympathy of society during their lifetime, and lived a depressed life, and it was not until forty or fifty years after their death that they were recognized by society, and everyone made a big fuss. Politicians hate writers even more, thinking that writers have already planted a great bane; Politicians can't think about everyone's thoughts, and those barbaric times are long gone. Although I do not know the opinions of everyone here; I speculate that it must be different from politicians; Politicians always blame writers and artists for destroying their unity, and their prejudice is so prejudiced, so I never want to talk to politicians.到了后来，社会终于变动了；文艺家先时讲的话，渐渐大家都记起来了，大家都赞成他，恭维他是先知先觉。虽是他活的时候，怎样受过社会的奚落。刚才我来讲演，大家一阵子拍手，这拍手就见得我并不怎样伟大；那拍手是很危险的东西，拍了手或者使我自以为伟大不再向前了，所以还是不拍手的好。上面我讲过，文学家是感觉灵敏了一点，许多观念，文学家早感到了，社会还没有感到。譬如今天衣萍先生穿了皮袍，我还只穿棉袍；衣萍先生对于天寒的感觉比我灵。再过一月，也许我也感到非穿皮袍不可，在天气上的感觉，相差到一个月，在思想上的感觉就得相差到三四十年。这个话，我这么讲，也有许多文学家在反对。我在广东，曾经批评一个革命文学家——现在的广东，是非革命文学不能算做文学的，是非“打打打，杀杀杀，革革革，命命命”，不能算做革命文学的——我以为革命并不能和文学连在一块儿，虽然文学中也有文学革命。但做文学的人总得闲定一点，正在革命中，那有功夫做文学。我们且想想：在生活困乏中，一面拉车，一面“之乎者也”，到底不大便当。古人虽有种田做诗的，那一定不是自己在种田；雇了几个人替他种田，他才能吟他的诗；真要种田，就没有功夫做诗。革命时候也是一样；正在革命，那有功夫做诗？我有几个学生，在打陈炯明时候，他们都在战场；我读了他们的来信，只见他们的字与词一封一封生疏下去。俄国革命以后，拿了面包票排了队一排一排去领面包；这时，国家既不管你什么文学家艺术家雕刻家；大家连想面包都来不及，那有功夫去想文学？等到有了文学，革命早成功了。革命成功以后，闲空了一点；有人恭维革命，有人颂扬革命，这已不是革命文学。他们恭维革命颂扬革命，就是颂扬有权力者，和革命有什么关系？
Later, society finally changed; Gradually everyone remembered what the writer and artist said before, and everyone agreed with him, complimenting him as a prophet. Although he was alive, how he was ridiculed by society. Just now when I came to give a speech, everyone clapped their hands for a while, and this clapping showed that I was not very great; Clapping is a very dangerous thing, clapping may make me think that greatness is no longer moving forward, so it's better not to clap my hands. As I said above, writers are a little more sensitive, and many concepts have been felt by writers for a long time, but society has not yet felt them. For example, today Mr. Yi Ping wore a leather robe, and I only wore a cotton robe; Mr. Yi Ping feels better about the cold than me. In another month, maybe I also feel that I have to wear a leather robe, and the difference in the weather is a month, and the difference in the feeling in the mind is to thirty or forty years. I say this, and many writers are opposed to this. When I was in Guangdong, I once criticized a revolutionary writer - now in Guangdong, right and wrong cannot be regarded as literature, right and wrong "fighting, killing, revolution, revolution, life", and cannot be regarded as revolutionary literature - I think that revolution cannot be connected with literature, although there is also a literary revolution in literature. But those who do literature must be a little idle, and they are in the midst of a revolution, so they have the kung fu to do literature. Let's think about it: in the midst of poverty in life, pulling a cart on the one hand, and "doing it", is not a big benefit. Although the ancients farmed and wrote poetry, they must not be farming themselves; hired a few people to farm for him before he could recite his poems; If you really want to farm, you don't have the time to write poetry. The same is true during the revolution; is in the revolution, how can you make poetry? I have several students, and when I was fighting Chen Jiongming, they were all on the battlefield; I read their letters and saw that their words and words were rusty one by one. After the Russian Revolution, I took a bread ticket and lined up in rows to receive bread; At this time, the country does not care about you as a writer, artist, or sculptor; Everyone can't even think about bread, so how can they think about literature? By the time there was literature, the revolution had already succeeded. After the success of the revolution, I was a little idle; Some people compliment the revolution, some people praise the revolution, this is no longer revolutionary literature. What does it have to do with the revolution if they compliment the revolution and praise the revolution?这时，也许有感觉灵敏的文学家，又感到现状的不满意，又要出来开口。从前文艺家的话，政治革命家原是赞同过；直到革命成功，政治家把从前所反对那些人用过的老法子重新采用起来，在文艺家仍不免于不满意，又非被排轧出去不可，或是割掉他的头。割掉他的头，前面我讲过，那是顶好的法子咾，——从十九世纪到现在，世界文艺的趋势，大都如此。
At this time, some writers who may feel sensitive feel dissatisfied with the status quo and want to speak out again. In the past, political revolutionaries originally agreed with the words of writers and artists; Until the success of the revolution, politicians re-adopted the old methods used by those who opposed them in the past, and the writers and artists were still dissatisfied, and they had to be pushed out or cut off their heads. Cutting off his head, as I said earlier, that is the best method,—— from the nineteenth century to the present, most of the trends in world literature and art have been like this.十九世纪以后的文艺，和十八世纪以前的文艺大不相同。十八世纪的英国小说，它的目的就在供给太太小姐们的消遣，所讲的都是愉快风趣的话。十九世纪的后半世纪，完全变成和人生问题发生密切关系。我们看了，总觉得十二分的不舒服，可是我们还得气也不透地看下去。这因为以前的文艺，好像写别一个社会，我们只要鉴赏；现在的文艺，就在写我们自己的社会，连我们自己也写进去；在小说里可以发见社会，也可以发见我们自己；以前的文艺，如隔岸观火，没有什么切身关系；现在的文艺，连自己也烧在这里面，自己一定深深感觉到；一到自己感觉到，一定要参加到社会去！
Literature and art after the 19th century are very different from literature and art before the 18th century. The purpose of the eighteenth-century English novel was to provide the pastime of the ladies, and it was all pleasant and funny. The second half of the nineteenth century completely became closely related to life problems. When we watched it, we always felt twelve points uncomfortable, but we still had to look at it without breath. This is because the literature and art in the past seemed to write about another society, and we only need to appreciate it; Today's literature and art are writing about our own society, even ourselves; In novels, we can find society and ourselves; In the past, literature and art, such as watching the fire from the other side, had no personal relationship; The current literature and art are burned in it, and I must feel it deeply; As soon as you feel it, you must participate in the society!十九世纪，可以说是一个革命的时代；所谓革命，那不安于现在，不满意于现状的都是。文艺催促旧的渐渐消灭的也是革命（旧的消灭，新的才能产生），而文学家的命运并不因自己参加过革命而有一样改变，还是处处碰钉子。现在革命的势力已经到了徐州，在徐州以北文学家原站不住脚；在徐州以南，文学家还是站不住脚，即共了产，文学家还是站不住脚。革命文学家和革命家竟可说完全两件事。诋斥军阀怎样怎样不合理，是革命文学家；打倒军阀是革命家；孙传芳所以赶走，是革命家用炮轰掉的，决不是革命文艺家做了几句“孙传芳呀，我们要赶掉你呀”的文章赶掉的。在革命的时候，文学家都在做一个梦，以为革命成功将有怎样怎样一个世界；革命以后，他看看现实全不是那么一回事，于是他又要吃苦了。照他们这样叫，啼，哭都不成功；向前不成功，向后也不成功，理想和现实不一致，这是注定的运命；正如你们从《呐喊》上看出的鲁迅和讲坛上的鲁迅并不一致；或许大家以为我穿洋服头发分开，我却没有穿洋服，头发也这样短短的。所以以革命文学自命的，一定不是革命文学，世间那有满意现状的革命文学？除了吃麻醉药！苏俄革命以前，有两个文学家，叶遂宁和梭波里，他们都讴歌过革命，直到后来，他们还是碰死在自己所讴歌希望的现实碑上，那时，苏维埃是成立了！
The nineteenth century can be said to be an era of revolution; The so-called revolution is those who are uneasy about the present and dissatisfied with the status quo. Literature and art urge the gradual extinction of the old is also a revolution (the old is eliminated, and new talents are born), and the fate of writers does not change because they have participated in the revolution, but they still hit nails everywhere. Now that the revolutionary forces have arrived in Xuzhou, the writers north of Xuzhou are untenable; South of Xuzhou, writers still cannot stand, that is, communism, and writers are still untenable. Revolutionary writers and revolutionaries can be said to be completely different things. to slander the warlords as unreasonable and unreasonable, is a revolutionary writer; Overthrow the warlords are revolutionaries; Sun Chuanfang was driven away by the revolutionaries with artillery, and by no means by the revolutionary writers and artists who made a few articles saying "Sun Chuanfang, we want to get rid of you". During the revolution, writers are dreaming of what kind of world the revolution will have; After the revolution, he saw that the reality was not the same at all, so he had to endure hardships again. They cried and cried and cried without success; If you don't succeed forward, you won't succeed backwards, and your ideals and reality are inconsistent, which is your destiny; As you can see from "The Scream", Lu Xun and Lu Xun on the pulpit are not consistent; Maybe everyone thinks that I wear a dress and my hair is separated, but I don't wear a suit, and my hair is so short. Therefore, those who call themselves revolutionary literature must not be revolutionary literature, and there is revolutionary literature in the world that is satisfied with the status quo? In addition to taking anesthetics! Before the Soviet Russian Revolution, there were two writers, Ye Suining and Sopoli, who both praised the revolution, and until later, they still died on the reality monument they praised and hoped for, and at that time, the Soviet Union was founded!不过，社会太寂寞了，有这样的人，才觉得有趣些。人类是欢喜看看戏的，文学家自己来做戏给人家看，或是绑出去砍头，或是在最近墙脚下枪毙，都可以热闹一下子。且如上海巡捕用棒打人，大家围着去看，他们自己虽然不愿意挨打，但看见人家挨打，倒觉得颇有趣的。文学家便是用自己的皮肉在挨打的啦！
However, society is too lonely, and it is interesting to have such people. Writers themselves come to show the play, or tie it out and behead it, or shoot it at the foot of the wall recently, all of which can be lively. And for example, the Shanghai patrol beat people with sticks, and everyone gathered around to watch, although they themselves were unwilling to be beaten, but they found it quite interesting to see people being beaten. Writers are being beaten with their own flesh!今天所讲的，就是这么一点点，给它一个题目，叫做……《文艺与政治的歧途》。What I will talk about today is just a little bit, give it a title, called ...... "The Wrong Way of Literature and Politics".

一九二九年

《近代世界短篇小说集》小引

一九二九年

A small introduction to the "Collection of Short Stories in the Modern World"一时代的纪念碑底的文章，文坛上不常有；即有之，也什九是大部的著作。以一篇短的小说而成为时代精神所居的大宫阙者，是极其少见的。
Articles at the bottom of monuments of an era are not often found in the literary world; Even if there is, nine out of ten are most of the works. It is extremely rare for a short novel to become a great palace where the spirit of the times lives.但至今，在巍峨灿烂的巨大的纪念碑底的文学之旁，短篇小说也依然有着存在的充足的权利。不但巨细高低，相依为命，也譬如身入大伽蓝中，但见全体非常宏丽，眩人眼睛，令观者心神飞越，而细看一雕阑一画础，虽然细小，所得却更为分明，再以此推及全体，感受遂愈加切实，因此那些终于为人所注重了。
But to this day, next to the literature at the base of the majestic and splendid monument, short stories still have the full right to exist. Not only is it high and small, dependent on each other, but it is also like entering a large temple, but seeing the whole is very magnificent, dazzling to the eyes, making the viewer's mind fly over, and looking closely at a carved railing and a painting base, although small, the result is more clear, and then pushed to the whole, the feeling becomes more and more real, so those are finally paid attention to.在现在的环境中，人们忙于生活，无暇来看长篇，自然也是短篇小说的繁生的很大原因之一。只顷刻间，而仍可借一斑略知全豹，以一目尽传精神，用数顷刻，遂知种种作风，种种作者，种种所写的人和物和事状，所得也颇不少的。而便捷，易成，取巧……这些原因还在外。
In the current environment, people are busy with life and have no time to read long stories, which is naturally one of the main reasons for the proliferation of short stories. In just a moment, you can still get a little idea of the whole leopard with a glimpse, and convey the spirit at a glance, and in a few moments, you can know all kinds of styles, all kinds of authors, all kinds of people, things and things written, and you can get a lot. It is convenient, easy to complete, and clever...... These reasons are still out.中国于世界所有的大部杰作很少译本，翻译短篇小说的却特别的多者，原因大约也为此。我们——译者的汇印这书，则原因就在此。贪图用力少，绍介多，有些不肯用尽呆气力的坏处，是自问恐怕也在所不免的。但也有一点只要能培一朵花，就不妨做做会朽的腐草的近于不坏的意思。还有，是要将零星的小品，聚在一本里，可以较不容易于散亡。
China has very few translations of all the masterpieces in the world, but the translation of short stories is particularly large, and the reason is probably for this reason. This is the reason why we, the translator, printed this book. The disadvantages of being greedy for less effort, more Shaojie, and some refusal to use all their strength are inevitable to ask yourself. But there is also a point that as long as you can cultivate a flower, you might as well make rotten grass that is close to not bad. Also, it is necessary to gather sporadic sketches in one book, which can be less difficult to scatter.我们——译者，都是一面学习，一面试做的人，虽于这一点小事，力量也还很不够，选的不当和译的错误，想来是一定不免的。我们愿受读者和批评者的指正。
We, translators, are people who study and try to do at the same time, although this small thing, the strength is still not enough, and the improper choice and translation mistakes must be inevitable. We would like to be corrected by readers and critics.一九二九年四月二十六日，朝花社同人识。
On April 26, 1929, he met the same person as the Morning Flower Society.

一九二九年

关于《关于红笑》

一九二九年

About "About Red Smile"今天收到四月十八日的《华北日报》，副刊上有鹤西先生的半篇《关于红笑》的文章。《关于红笑》，我是有些注意的，因为自己曾经译过几页，那豫告，就登在初版的《域外小说集》上，但后来没有译完，所以也没有出版。不过也许是有些旧相识之故罢，至今有谁讲到这本书，大抵总还喜欢看一看。可是看完这《关于红笑》，却令我大觉稀奇了，也不能不说几句话。为要头绪分明，先将原文转载些在下面——
I received the "North China Daily" on April 18 today, and there was half an article by Mr. Hexi "About Red Smile" in the supplement. "About Red Laughter", I paid some attention, because I had translated a few pages, and the warning was published in the first edition of the "Collection of Extraterritorial Novels", but it was not translated later, so it was not published. But maybe it's because of some old acquaintances, who still talks about this book, probably still likes to read it. But after reading this "About Red Smile", I felt very strange, and I couldn't help but say a few words. In order to have a clear clue, first reprint some of the original text below -“昨天到蹇君家去，看见第二十卷第一号的《小说月报》，上边有梅川君译的《红笑》，这部书，因为我和骏祥也译过，所以禁不住要翻开看看，并且还想来说几句关于《红笑》的话。
"Yesterday I went to Jian Jun's house and saw the "Novel Monthly" in Volume 20, No. 1, which had "Red Smile" translated by Mei Chuanjun, this book, because Jun Xiang and I also translated it, so I couldn't help but open it and read it, and I wanted to say a few words about "Red Smile".“自然，我不是要说梅川君不该译《红笑》，没有这样的理由也没有这样的权力。不过我对于梅川君的译文有一点怀疑的地方，固然一个人原不该随便地怀疑别个，但世上偏就是这点奇怪，尽有是让人意想不到的事情。不过也许我底过虑是错的，而且在梅川君看来也是意想不到的事，那么，这错处就在我，而这篇文字也就只算辩明我自己没有抄袭别人。现在我先讲讲事实的经过。
"Naturally, I don't want to say that Umechuan-kun should not translate "Red Smile", there is no such reason or such power. However, I have a little doubt about Umechuan-kun's translation, although one person should not casually doubt another, but this is the strangeness of the world, and there are all unexpected things. But maybe I was wrong, and it was unexpected in Umechuan-kun's opinion, so the fault was mine, and this text only proved that I did not plagiarize others. Now let me tell you about the facts.“《红笑》，是我和骏祥，在去年暑假中一个多星期内赶完的，……赶完之后就给北新寄去。过了许久才接到小峰君十一月七日的信，说是因系两人所译，前后文不连贯，托石民君校阅，又说稿费在月底准可寄来。以后我一连写了几封信去催问，均未得到回信，……所以年假中就将底稿寻出，又改译了一遍。文气是重新顺了一遍（特别是后半部），错误及不妥的地方一共改了几十处，交岐山书局印行。稿子才交出不久，却接到小峰二月十九日的信，钱是寄来了，虽然被抹去一点零头，因为稿子并未退回，所以支票我也暂时存着，没有退去，以后小峰君又来信说，原书，译稿都可退还，叫我将支票交给袁家骅先生。我回信说已照办，并请将稿子退了回来。但如今，书和稿子，始终还没有见面！
"Red Smile" was completed by Junxiang and I in more than a week during last summer,...... After rushing, send it to Beixin. After a long time, I received a letter from Xiaofengjun on November 7, saying that it was translated by two people, and the text was incoherent, so I asked Shi Minjun to proofread it, and said that the manuscript fee could be sent at the end of the month. After that, I wrote several letters in a row to urge questions, but I didn't get a reply,...... So during the annual vacation, I found the manuscript and retranslated it again. The style was re-ordered (especially the second half), and dozens of errors and inadequacies were corrected and printed by Qishan Bookstore. The manuscript was handed over not long ago, but I received a letter from Xiaofeng on February 19, the money was sent, although it was erased a little bit, because the manuscript was not returned, so I also kept the check temporarily and did not return it, and later Xiaofengjun wrote again saying that the original book and the translated manuscript could be returned, and asked me to hand over the check to Mr. Yuan Jiahua. I replied that I had complied and asked to return the manuscript. But now, the book and the manuscript have never met!“这初次的译稿，我不敢一定说梅川君曾经见过，虽然我想梅川君有见到的可能。自然梅川君不一定会用我们底译文作蓝本来翻译，但是第一部的译文，句法神情都很相似的这一点，不免使我有一点怀疑。因为原来我们底初译是第一部比第二部流畅得多，同时梅川君的译文也是第一部比第二部好些，而彼此神似的又就是这九个断片。在未有更确切的证明时，我也不愿将抄袭这样的字眼，加于别人底头上，但我很希望对这点，梅川君能高兴给一个答复。假如一切真是我想错了呢，前边已经说过，这些话就作为我们就要出版的单行本并非抄袭的证明。”
"I don't dare to say that Umekawa-kun has seen this first translation, although I think Umekawa-kun has seen it. Naturally, Umekawa-kun may not use our original translation as a blueprint for translation, but the fact that the syntax and expression of the first translation are very similar inevitably makes me a little suspicious. Because it turns out that our first translation is much smoother than the second part, and Umekawa-kun's translation is also better than the second part, and it is these nine fragments that are similar to each other. In the absence of more definite proof, I do not want to add the word plagiarism to others, but I hope that Umechuan-kun will be happy to give an answer to this point. If everything is really wrong, as I said before, these words serve as proof that the book we are about to publish is not plagiarism. ”文词虽然极婉委曲折之致，但主旨却很简单的，就是：我们的将出版的译本和你的已出版的译本，很相类似，而我曾将译稿寄给北新书局过，你有见到的可能，所以我疑心是你抄袭我们的，假如不然，那么“这些话就作为我们就要出版的单行本并非抄袭的证明”。
Although the words are extremely tactful and tortuous, the main idea is very simple, that is: our published translation is very similar to your published translation, and I have sent the translation to Beixin Bookstore, you may have seen it, so I suspect that you have plagiarized us, if not, then "these words are used as proof that the single book we are going to publish is not plagiarism."其实是，照原文的论法，则假如不然之后，就要成为“我们抄袭”你的了的，然而竟这么一来，化为神妙的“证明”了。但我并不想研究这些，仅要声明几句话，对于两方面——北新书局，尤其是小说月报社——声明几句话，因为这篇译稿，是由我送到小说月报社去的。
In fact, according to the original text, if not, it will become "we plagiarized" you, but in this way, it has turned into a mysterious "proof". But I don't want to study these, just a few words, for two aspects - Beixin Book Company, especially the Novel Monthly Newspaper - a few words, because this translation was sent to the Novel Monthly Newspaper by me.梅川君这部译稿，也是去年暑假时候交给我的，要我介绍出售，但我很怕做中人，就压下了。这样压着的稿件，现在还不少。直到十月，小说月报社拟出增刊，要我寄稿，我才记得起来，据日本二叶亭四迷的译本改了二三十处，和我译的《竖琴》一并送去了。另外有一部《红笑》在北新书局吃苦，我是一点都不知道的。至于梅川，他在离上海七八百里的乡下，那当然更不知道。
Umekawa-kun's translation was also handed to me during the summer vacation last year, and he asked me to introduce it for sale, but I was afraid of being a middle-earthed person, so I suppressed it. There are still many manuscripts pressed like this. It wasn't until October that the Novel Monthly Newspaper prepared a supplement and asked me to contribute a manuscript, and I remembered that according to the translation of the Japanese Futabatei Shimi, I changed twenty or thirty places, and sent it together with my translation of "Harp". There is another "Red Smile" that suffered in Beixin Bookstore, which I didn't know at all. As for Meichuan, he is in the countryside seven or eight hundred miles away from Shanghai, so of course he doesn't know.那么，他可有鹤西先生的译稿一到北新，便立刻去看的“可能”呢？我想，是不“能”的，因为他和北新中人一个不认识，倘跑进北新编辑部去翻稿件，那罪状是不止“抄袭”而已的。我却是“可能”的，不过我从去年春天以后，一趟也没有去过编辑部，这要请北新诸公谅察。
So, does he have the "possibility" of Mr. Hexi's translation to read it immediately as soon as it arrives in Beixin? I think it is not "possible", because he and the people in Beixin do not know each other, and if he runs into the Beixin editorial office to turn over the manuscript, the crime is more than just "plagiarism". I am "possible", but I have not been to the editorial office since last spring, so I ask the Beijing New Lords to forgive me.那么，为什么两本的好处有些相像呢？我虽然没有见过那一译本，也不知所据的是谁的英译，但想来，大约所据的是同一英译，而第二部也比第一部容易译，彼此三位的英文程度又相仿佛，所以去年是相像的，而鹤西先生们的译本至今未出，英文程度也大有进步了，改了一回，于是好处就多起来了。
So, why are the benefits of the two books somewhat similar? Although I have not seen that translation, and I don't know whose English translation it is based on, but I think it is probably based on the same English translation, and the second part is easier to translate than the first, and the English level of each other is similar, so last year it was similar, and Mr. Hexi's translation has not been published so far, and the English level has also improved a lot.因为鹤西先生的译本至今未出，所以也无从知道类似之度，究竟如何。倘仅有彼此神似之处，我以为那是因为同一原书的译本，并不足异的，正不必如此神经过敏，只因“疑心”，而竟想入非非，根据“世上偏就是这点奇怪，尽有是让人意想不到的事情”的理由，而先发制人，诬别人为“抄袭”，而且还要被诬者“给一个答复”，这真是“世上偏就是这点奇怪”了。
Because Mr. Hexi's translation has not been published so far, there is no way to know how similar it is. If there is only a similarity between each other, I think it is because of the translation of the same original book, which is not unusual, just because of "suspicion", and actually thinking about wrong, according to the reason that "the world is this strange, there are all unexpected things", and preemptively accusing others of "plagiarism", and the accuser has to "give an answer", which is really "the world is this strange".但倘若很是相同呢？则只要证明了梅川并无看见鹤西先生们的译稿的“可能”以后，即不用“世上偏就是这点奇怪”的论法，嫌疑也总要在后出这一本了。
But what if they are very similar? As long as it is proved that Umekawa did not see the "possibility" of Mr. Tsurunishi's translation, that is, there is no need to argue that "the world is just this strange", the suspicion will always come later.北平的日报，我不寄去，梅川是决不会看见的。我就先说几句，俟印出时一并寄去。大约这也就够了，阿弥陀佛。
If I don't send the daily newspaper in Peking, Meichuan will never see it. I'll say a few words first, and I'll send them when they are printed. That's probably enough, Amitabha.四月二十日。
April 20.
写了上面这些话之后，又陆续看到《华北日报》副刊上《关于红笑》的文章，其中举了许多不通和误译之后，以这样的一段作结：
After writing the above words, I saw the article "About Red Smile" in the supplement of "North China Daily", which ended with this paragraph after citing many incomprehensions and mistranslations:“此外或者还有些，但我想我们或许总要比梅川君错得少点，而且也较为通顺，好在是不是，我们底译稿不久自可以证明。”
"In addition, there may be some, but I think we may always have to make fewer mistakes than Umechuan-kun, and it is more smooth, but fortunately, our original translation will soon be able to prove it."那就是我先前的话都多说了。因为鹤西先生已在自己切实证明了他和梅川的两本之不同。他的较好，而“抄袭”都成了“不通”和错误的较坏，岂非奇谈？倘说是改掉的，那就是并非“抄袭”了。倘说鹤西译本原也是这样地“不通”和错误的，那不是许多刻薄话，都是“今日之我”在打“昨日之我”的嘴巴么？总之，一篇《关于红笑》的大文，只证明了焦躁的自己广告和参看先出译本，加以修正，而反诬别人为“抄袭”的苦心。这种手段，是中国翻译界的第一次。
That's what I said before. Because Mr. Hexi has proven the difference between his two books and Umekawa. His is better, and "plagiarism" has become "incomprehensible" and worse than wrong, isn't it a strange story? If it is changed, it is not "plagiarism". If the Hexi translation is also so "incomprehensible" and wrong, isn't it a lot of mean words, but "today's me" is slapping the mouth of "yesterday's me"? In short, a big article "About Red Smile" only proves the painstaking efforts of anxious self-advertisements and reference to the first translation, correcting them, and falsely accusing others of "plagiarism". This method is the first time in the Chinese translation industry.四月二十四日，补记。
April 24, supplementary record.
这一篇还未在《语丝》登出，就收到小说月报社的一封信，里面是剪下的《华北日报》副刊，就是那一篇鹤西先生的《关于红笑》。据说是北平寄来，给编辑先生的。我想，这大约就是作者所玩的把戏。倘使真的，盖未免恶辣一点；同一著作有几种译本，又何必如此惶惶上诉。但一面说别人不通，自己却通，别人错多，自己错少。而一面又要证明别人抄袭自己之作，则未免恶辣得可怜可笑。然而在我，乃又颇叹绍介译作之难于今为甚也。为刷清和报答起见，我确信我也有将这篇送给《小说月报》编辑先生，要求再在本书上发表的义务和权利，于是乎亦寄之。

I borrowed a volume of the ninth issue of "Rush" from Brother Junfeng, and when I saw several poems of Lermantov translated by Mr. Sun Yong from Esperanto, I found that some parts were inconsistent with the original. 他到很远的境域去寻找些什么？ What did he go to find in a distant land?

波涛汹涌，微风吼啸，

喂！他不寻找幸福，

Zhang Fenghan. 1929, 5, 7, at the Harbin Canxing Society.逢汉先生：
Mr. Feng Han:接到来信，我们很感谢先生的好意。
We are very grateful for your kindness.大约凡是译本，倘不标明“并无删节”或“正确的翻译”，或鼎鼎大名的专家所译的，欧美的本子也每不免有些节略或差异。译诗就更其难，因为要顾全音调和协韵，就总要加添或减去些原有的文字。世界语译本大约也如此，倘若译出来的还是诗的格式而非散文。但我们因为想介绍些名家所不屑道的东欧和北欧文学，而又少懂得原文的人，所以暂时只能用重译本，尤其是巴尔干诸小国的作品。原来的意思，实在不过是聊胜于无，且给读书界知道一点所谓文学家，世界上并不止几个受奖的泰戈尔和漂亮的曼殊斐儿之类。但倘有能从原文直接译出的稿子见寄，或加以指正，我们自然是十分愿意领受的。
Almost all translations, if they are not marked as "unabridged" or "correct", or are translated by famous experts, will inevitably have some omissions or differences in European and American versions. Translating poetry is even more difficult, because in order to take into account the whole tone and harmony, you must always add or subtract some original words. The same is true for Esperanto translations, if they are translated in the form of poetry rather than prose. However, because we want to introduce some Eastern European and Nordic literature that famous writers disdain, and few people know the original text, we can only use retranslated versions for the time being, especially the works of small Balkan countries. The original meaning is really just a talk is better than nothing, and it gives the reading community a little bit of so-called literary figures, and there are not only a few award-winning Tagore and the beautiful Manshu Phiel in the world. However, if there is a manuscript that can be directly translated from the original text to be sent or corrected, we are naturally very willing to accept it.这里有一件事很抱歉，就是我们所交易的印刷所里没有俄国字母，所以来信中的原文，只得省略，仅能将译文发出，以供读者的参考了。希见谅为幸。
One thing I am sorry to say here is that there is no Russian alphabet in the printing house we deal with, so the original text of the letter has to be omitted, and only the translation can be sent out for the reader's reference. I hope you will forgive me.鲁迅。六月二十五日，于上海。Lu Xun. June 25 in Shanghai.

Preface to "Shuzi's Letter"夫嘉葩失荫，薄寒夺其芳菲，思士陵天，骄阳毁其羽翮。盖幽居一出，每仓皇于太空，坐驰无穷，终陨颠于实有也。爰有静女，长自山家，林泉陶其慧心，峰嶂隔兹尘俗，夜看朗月，觉天人之必圆，春撷繁花，谓芳馨之永住。虽生旧第，亦溅新流，既茁爱萌，遂通佳讯，排微波而径逝，矢坚石以偕行，向曼远之将来，构辉煌之好梦。然而年华春短，人海澜翻。远瞩所至，始见来日之大难，修眉渐颦，终敛当年之巧笑，衔深哀于不答，铸孤愤以成辞，远人焉居，长涂难即。何期忽逢二竖，遽释诸纷，绮颜于一棺，腐芳心于抔土。从此西楼良夜，凭槛无人，而中国韶年，乐生依旧。呜呼，亦可悲矣，不能久也。逝者如是，遗简廑存，则有生人，付之活字。文无雕饰，呈天真之纷纶，事具悲欢，露人生之鳞爪，既娱以善始，遂凄恻而令终。诚足以分追悼于有情，散馀悲于无著者也。属为小引，愧乏长才，率缀芜词，聊陈涯略云尔。

In 1933

一九三三年

选本

一九三三年

Anthology今年秋天，在上海的日报上有一点可以算是关于文学的小小的辩论，就是为了一般的青年，应否去看《庄子》与《文选》以作文学上的修养之助。不过这类的辩论，照例是不会有结果的，往复几回之后，有一面一定拉出“动机论”来，不是说反对者“别有用心”，便是“哗众取宠”；客气一点，也就“彼亦一是非，此亦一是非”，而问题于是呜呼哀哉了。
This fall, there was a small debate in the Shanghai daily newspaper about literature, that is, whether ordinary young people should read "Zhuangzi" and "Anthology" as a help in literary cultivation. However, this kind of debate, as usual, will not be fruitful, and after a few back-and-forths, one side will definitely pull out the "motivation theory", either that the opponents have "ulterior motives", or that they are "sensational"; To be polite, it is "he is also a right and wrong, this is also a right and wrong", and the problem is so sad.但我因此又想到“选本”的势力。孔子究竟删过《诗》没有，我不能确说，但看它先“风”后“雅”而末“颂”，排得这么整齐，恐怕至少总也费过乐师的手脚，是中国现存的最古的诗选。由周至汉，社会情形太不同了，中间又受了《楚辞》的打击，晋宋文人如二陆束晳陶潜之流，虽然也做四言诗以支持场面，其实都不过是每句省去一字的五言诗，“王者之迹熄而《诗》亡”了。不过选者总是层出不穷的，至今尚存，影响也最广大者，我以为一部是《世说新语》，一部就是《文选》。
But I think of the power of "selection". I can't say for sure whether Confucius deleted the "Poems", but looking at it, it is arranged so neatly, I am afraid that at least it has always gone through the hands and feet of musicians, and it is the oldest existing poetry anthology in China. From the Zhou Dynasty to the Han Dynasty, the social situation was too different, and the middle was hit by the "Chu Ci", and the literati of the Jin and Song dynasties, such as Erlu Shu and Tao Qian, although they also made four-character poems to support the scene, in fact, they were just five-character poems that omitted a word for each sentence, "the traces of the king were extinguished and the "poem" was dead". However, there are always endless selectors, and the ones that still exist and have the greatest influence are I think one is "The New Words of the World" and the other is "Anthology".《世说新语》并没有说明是选的，好像刘义庆或他的门客所搜集，但检唐宋类书中所存裴启《语林》的遗文，往往和《世说新语》相同，可见它也是一部抄撮故书之作，正和《幽明录》一样。它的被清代学者所宝重，自然因为注中多有现今的逸书，但在一般读者，却还是为了本文，自唐迄今，拟作者不绝，甚至于自己兼加注解。袁宏道在野时要做官，做了官又大叫苦，便是中了这书的毒，误明为晋的缘故。有些清朝人却较为聪明，虽然辫发胡服，厚禄高官，他也一声不响，只在倩人写照的时候，在纸上改作斜领方巾，或芒鞋竹笠，聊过“世说”式瘾罢了。
"The New Words of the World" does not explain that it was selected, as if it was collected by Liu Yiqing or his disciples, but the posthumous writings of Pei Qi's "Yulin" preserved in the Tang and Song dynasties are often the same as the "New Words of the World", which shows that it is also a work of copying old books, just like the "Youming Record". It was cherished by scholars of the Qing Dynasty, naturally because there are many modern books in the annotations, but for ordinary readers, it is still for this article, since the Tang Dynasty, the author has been endless, and even his own annotations. Yuan Hongdao wanted to be an official when he was in the opposition, and when he became an official, he complained, that is, he was poisoned by this book, and he mistakenly understood that it was for the sake of Jin. Some Qing Dynasty people were smarter, although they braided their hair and Hu clothes, and they were high-ranking officials, he was silent, and only when he was portrayed, he changed them to diagonal scarves or straw sandals and bamboo hats on paper, and talked about the "world" style of addiction.《文选》的影响却更大。从曹宪至李善加五臣，音训注释书类之多，远非拟《世说新语》可比。那些烦难字面，如草头诸字，水旁山旁诸字，不断的被摘进历代的文章里面去，五四运动时虽受奚落，得“妖孽”之称，现在却又很有复辟的趋势了。而《古文观止》也一同渐渐的露了脸。
The influence of "Anthology" is even greater. From Cao Xian to Li Shanjia Wuchen, the number of phonetic commentary books is far from comparable to the "New Words of the World". Those troublesome words, such as the words of the grass head, the words by the water and the mountains, have been constantly picked into the articles of the past dynasties, and although they were ridiculed during the May Fourth Movement and were called "demons", they are now very restorative. And "Ancient Texts and Observations" gradually showed their faces together.以《古文观止》和《文选》并称，初看好像是可笑的，但是，在文学上的影响，两者却一样的不可轻视。凡选本，往往能比所选各家的全集或选家自己的文集更流行，更有作用。册数不多，而包罗诸作，固然也是一种原因，但还在近则由选者的名位，远则凭古人之威灵，读者想从一个有名的选家，窥见许多有名作家的作品。所以自汉至梁的作家的文集，并残本也仅存十余家，《昭明太子集》只剩一点辑本了，而《文选》却在的。读《古文辞类纂》者多，读《惜抱轩全集》的却少。凡是对于文术，自有主张的作家，他所赖以发表和流布自己的主张的手段，倒并不在作文心，文则，诗品，诗话，而在出选本。
It is said that "Ancient Texts and Observations" and "Anthology" seem ridiculous at first glance, but the influence in literature is equally not to be underestimated. Selected books are often more popular and effective than the complete works of the selected families or the selected families' own collections. The number of volumes is not large, and the inclusion of works is certainly a reason, but it is still close by the name of the selector, and far away by the power of the ancients, readers want to glimpse the works of many famous writers from a famous selector. Therefore, there are only more than ten collections of writers from the Han Dynasty to the Liang Dynasty, and there are only a few editions left in the "Collection of Prince Zhaoming", but the "Anthology" is. There are many people who read "Ancient Literature and Literature", but few people read "The Complete Works of Xi Baoxuan". For any writer who has his own ideas about literature, the means he relies on to express and disseminate his ideas are not in the heart of composition, the rules, the poems, and the poems, but in the selection of books.选本可以借古人的文章，寓自己的意见。博览群籍，采其合于自己意见的为一集，一法也，如《文选》是。择取一书，删其不合于自己意见的为一新书，又一法也，如《唐人万首绝句选》是。如此，则读者虽读古人书，却得了选者之意，意见也就逐渐和选者接近，终于“就范”了。
The selection can borrow the articles of the ancients to imply one's own opinions. It is also a method to read a collection of books and collect those that align with one's own opinions, such as the "Anthology". It is another method to choose a book and delete it that does not meet your opinion as a new book, such as "Selected Quatrains of the Tang Dynasty". In this way, although the reader reads the books of the ancients, he gets the will of the chooser, and the opinion gradually approaches the chooser, and finally "complies".读者的读选本，自以为是由此得了古人文笔的精华的，殊不知却被选者缩小了眼界。即以《文选》为例罢，没有嵇康《家诫》，使读者只觉得他是一个愤世嫉俗，好像无端活得不快活的怪人；不收陶潜《闲情赋》，掩去了他也是一个既取民间《子夜歌》意，而又拒以圣道的迂士。选本既经选者所滤过，就总只能吃他所给与的糟或醨。况且有时还加以批评，提醒了他之以为然，而默杀了他之以为不然处。纵使选者非常胡涂，如《儒林外史》所写的马二先生，游西湖漫无准备，须问路人，吃点心又不知选择，要每样都买一点，由此可见其衡文之毫无把握罢，然而他是处州人，一定要吃“处片”，又可见虽是马二先生，也自有其“处片”式的标准了。
Readers read the anthology, thinking that they have obtained the essence of the ancients' writing, but they do not know that the selected person has narrowed their horizons. That is, taking the "Anthology" as an example, there is no Ji Kang's "Family Commandments", which makes the reader only feel that he is a cynical, as if he is living an unhappy life for no reason; Not accepting Tao Qian's "Leisure Love Fu" hides that he is also a pedantic man who not only takes the meaning of the folk "Midnight Song", but also refuses to use the holy way. Since the selected book has been filtered by the selector, it can only eat the bad or the wine he gives. Moreover, sometimes he criticizes it, reminding him of what he thinks, and silently killing what he thinks is not. Even if the selectors are very foolish, such as Mr. Ma Er written in "The History of Confucianism", he is unprepared to visit West Lake, must ask passers-by, eat snacks and don't know how to choose, and buy a little of everything, which shows that he is unsure of Hengwen, but he is a native of Chuzhou, and he must eat "chupian", which shows that although he is Mr. Ma Er, he also has his own "chupian" standard.评选的本子，影响于后来的文章的力量是不小的，恐怕还远在名家的专集之上。我想，这许是研究中国文学史的人们也该留意的罢。
The power of the selection book to influence the later articles is not small, and I am afraid that it is still far above the collection of famous writers. I think this is something that people who study the history of Chinese literature should also pay attention to.十一月二十四日记。November 24 Diary.

"Torrent" editor's postscript一
One创作自有他本身证明，翻译也有译者已经解释的。现在只将编后想到的另外的事，写上几句——
The creation has its own proof, and the translation has been explained by the translator. Now I will only write a few sentences about the other things that came to mind after editing -Iwan Turgenjew早因为他的小说，为世所知，但论文甚少。这一篇《Hamlet und Don Quichotte》是极有名的，我们可以看见他怎样地观察人生。《Hamlet》中国已有译文，无须多说；《Don Quichotte》则只有林纾的文言译，名《魔侠传》，仅上半部，又是删节过的。近两年来，梅川君正在大发《Don Quixote》翻译热，但愿不远的将来，中国能够得到一部可看的译本，即使不得不略去其中的闲文也好。
Iwan Turgenjew has long been known for his novels, but there are very few papers. This "Hamlet und Don Quichotte" is very famous, and we can see how he observed life. "Hamlet" has been translated in China, so there is no need to say more; "Don Quichotte" is only Lin Shu's literary translation, called "The Legend of the Demon Man", only the first half, and it is abridged. In the past two years, Umechuan-kun has been making a big splash in the translation of "Don Quixote", and I hope that in the near future, China will be able to get a readable translation, even if it has to omit the idle text.《Don Quixote》的书虽然将近一千来页，事迹却很简单，就是他爱看侠士小说，因此发了游侠狂，硬要到各处去除邪惩恶，碰了种种钉子，闹了种种笑话，死了；临死才回复了他的故我。所以Turgenjew取毫无烦闷，专凭理想而勇往直前去做事的为“Don Quixote type”，来和一生瞑想，怀疑，以致什么事也不能做的Hamlet相对照。后来又有人和这专凭理想的“Don Quixoteism式”相对，称看定现实，而勇往直前去做事的为“Marxism式”。中国现在也有人嚷些什么“Don Quixote”了，但因为实在并没有看过这一部书，所以和实际是一点不对的。
Although the book "Don Quixote" is nearly a thousand pages long, the deeds are very simple, that is, he loved to read chivalrous novels, so he went on a wandering mania, insisted on going everywhere to remove evil and punish evil, touched all kinds of nails, made all kinds of jokes, and died; Only when he died did he return to his old self. Therefore, Turgenjew took the "Don Quixote type" who was free from boredom and boldly moved forward according to his ideals, in contrast to Hamlet, who had been meditating, doubting, and unable to do anything all his life. Later, some people opposed this "Don Quixoteism" that relied solely on ideals, calling it the "Marxism style" that sees reality and moves forward bravely. There are also people in China who are shouting "Don Quixote" now, but because they have not read this book, it is not at all wrong with reality.《大旱的消失》是Essay，作者的底细，我不知道，只知道是1902年死的。Essay本来不容易译，在此只想绍介一个格式。将来倘能得到这一类的文章，也还想登下去。
"The Disappearance of the Great Drought" is an essay, the author's details, I don't know, I only know that he died in 1902. Essay is not easy to translate, so I just want to introduce a format. If I can get this kind of article in the future, I would like to publish it.跋司珂（Vasco）族是古来住在西班牙和法兰西之间的Pyrenees山脉两侧的大家视为世界之谜的人种。巴罗哈（Pio Barojay Nessi）就禀有这族的血液，以一八七二年十二月廿八日，生于靠近法境的圣舍跋斯丁市。原是医生，也做小说，两年后，便和他的哥哥Ricardo到马德里开面包店去了，一共开了六年。现在Ricardo是有名的画家；他是最独创底的作家，早和Vicente Blasco Ibáñez并称现代西班牙文坛的巨擘。他的著作至今大约有四十种，多是长篇。这里的小品四篇，是从日本的《海外文学新选》第十三编《跋司珂牧歌调》内，永田宽定的译文重翻的；原名《Vidas Sombrias》，因为所写的是跋司珂族的性情，所以仍用日译的题目。
The Vasco people are a race that has been considered a mystery to the world since ancient times when they lived on both sides of the Pyrenees Mountains between Spain and France. Pio Barojay Nessi was born on December 28, 1872, in the city of St. Shebastin near the border of France. Originally a doctor and a novelist, two years later, he and his brother Ricardo went to Madrid to open a bakery, which lasted for a total of six years. Now Ricardo is a famous painter; He is one of the most original writers, and has long been known as a giant in the modern Spanish literary world along with Vicente Blasco Ibáñez. His writings are about forty to date, most of which are long. The four sketches here are reprinted from the translation of Nagata Kansada in the thirteenth volume of Japan's "New Selection of Overseas Literature", "Basike Pastoral Tune"; The original name is "Vidas Sombrias", because it is written about the temperament of the Basike people, so the title is still translated into Japanese.今年一说起“近视眼看匾”来，似乎很有几个自命批评家郁郁不乐，又来大做其他的批评。为免去蒙冤起见，只好特替作者在此声明几句：这故事原是一种民间传说，作者取来编作“狂言”样子，还在前年的秋天，本豫备登在《波艇》上的。倘若其中仍有冒犯了批评家的处所，那实在是老百姓的眼睛也很亮，能看出共通的暗病的缘故，怪不得传述者的。
This year, when it comes to "myopic eyes looking at plaques", it seems that there are a few self-proclaimed critics who are depressed and come to make other criticisms. In order to avoid being wronged, I have to make a few statements on behalf of the author: This story was originally a folklore, and the author took it to make up the appearance of "Kyogen", and it was still published in "Wave Boat" in the autumn of the previous year. If there are still places that offend critics, it is really the eyes of the common people who can see the common dark disease, no wonder the narrator.俄国的关于文艺的争执，曾有《苏俄的文艺论战》介绍过，这里的《苏俄的文艺政策》，实在可以看作那一部的续编。如果看过前一书，则看起这篇来便更为明了。序文上虽说立场有三派的不同，然而约减起来，不过是两派。即对于阶级文艺，一派偏重文艺，如瓦浪斯基等，一派偏重阶级，是《那巴斯图》的人们；Bukharin们自然也主张支持劳动阶级作家的，但又以为最要紧的是要有创作。发言的人们之中，几个是委员，如Voronsky，Bukharin，Iakovlev，Trotsky，Lunacharsky等；也有“锻冶厂”一派，如Pletnijov；最多的是《那巴斯图》的人们，如Vardin，Lelevitch，Averbach，Rodov，Besamensky等，译载在《苏俄的文艺论战》里的一篇《文学与艺术》后面，都有署名在那里。
Russia's dispute over literature and art has been introduced in "The Literary and Art Debate of Soviet Russia", and the "Literary and Art Policy of Soviet Russia" here can really be regarded as a sequel to that one. If you have read the previous book, it will be clearer to read this one. Although the preface says that there are three different positions, they are only two factions. That is, for class literature and art, one school focuses on literature and art, such as Walansky, etc., and the other focuses on class, which is the people of "Nabastu"; Naturally, the Bukharins also advocated supporting working-class writers, but they thought that the most important thing was to have creativity. Among the speakers, several were members, such as Voronsky, Bukharin, Iakovlev, Trotsky, Lunacharsky, etc.; there is also a "forge" school, such as Pletnijov; The most people of "Nabastu", such as Vardin, Lelevitch, Averbach, Rodov, Besamensky, etc., translated into "Literature and Art in Soviet Russia", are signed there.《那巴斯图》派的攻击，几乎集中于一个Voronsky，《赤色新地》的编辑者；对于他的《作为生活认识的艺术》，Lelevitch曾有一篇《作为生活组织的艺术》，引用布哈林的定义，以艺术为“感情的普遍化”的方法，并且指摘Voronsky的艺术论，乃是超阶级底的。这意思在评议会的论争上也可见。但到后来，藏原惟人在《现代俄国的批评文学》中说，他们两人之间的立场似乎有些接近了，Voronsky承认了艺术的阶级性之重要，Lelevitch的攻击也较先前稍为和缓了。现在是Trotsky，Radek都已放逐，Voronsky大约也退职，状况也许又很不同了罢。
The attacks of the Nabastu faction were almost concentrated on one Voronsky, the editor of the Red New Land; Regarding his "Art as Life Knowledge", Lelevitch once wrote "Art as the Organization of Life", quoting Bukharin's definition, using art as a method of "universalizing feelings", and pointing out that Voronsky's theory of art is super-class. This meaning can also be seen in the debate of the council. But later, in "Critical Literature in Modern Russia", Yuito Kurahara said that the positions between the two of them seemed to be somewhat closer, Voronsky acknowledged the importance of the class nature of art, and Lelevitch's attacks were slightly softer than before. Now it's Trotsky, Radek has been banished, Voronsky has probably retired, and the situation may be very different.从这记录中，可以看见在劳动阶级文学大本营的俄国的文学的理论和实际，于现在的中国，恐怕是不为无益的。其中有几个空字，是原译本如此，因无别国译本，不敢妄补，倘有备着原书，通函见教，或指正其错误的，必当随时补正。
From this record, we can see that the theory and practice of Russian literature, which is the literary stronghold of the working class, may not be useless in today's China. There are a few empty words, which are the original translations, because there are no translations from other countries, and I dare not make up for them.一九二八年六月十五日。

TwoRudolf Lindau的《幸福的摆》，全篇不过两章，因为纸数的关系，只能分登两期了。篇末有译者附记，以为“小说里有一种Kosmopolitisch的倾向，同时还有一种厌世的东洋色彩”，这是极确凿的。但作者究竟是德国人，所以也终于不脱日耳曼气，要绘图立说，来发明“幸福的摆”，自视为生路，而其实又是死因。我想，东洋思想的极致，是在不来发明这样的“摆”，不但不来，并且不想；不但不想到“幸福的摆”，并且连世间有所谓“摆”这一种劳什子也不想到。这是令人长寿平安，使国古老拖延的秘法。老聃作五千言，释迦有恒河沙数说，也还是东洋人中的“好事之徒”也。

Austrian René Fueloep-Miller's book about the situation in Soviet Russia, the original title is unknown, the English translation is called "The Mind and Face of Bolshevism", and it seems that there are a lot of people in Shanghai this year. “…… The main one was the painter Iuanii Annenkov. Three前些时，偶然翻阅日本青木正儿的《支那文艺论丛》，看见在一篇《将胡适漩在中心的文学革命》里，有云——

In June of the seventh year of the Republic of China (1918), "New Youth" suddenly came out with "Ibsen". This is the sound of the revolutionary army attacking the city of the old drama at the bottom of the literature. That formation was based on General Hu's "Ibsenism" as the vanguard, Hu Shi Luo Jialun's "Nala" (to the third act), Tao Lugong's "Enemy of the Nation" and Wu Ruonan's "Little Love Youfu" (each in the first act) as the central army, and Yuan Zhenying's "Biography of Ibsen" as the fourth army, bravely went into battle. Their attack on the city was originally the order of the battle, and it had to be here, but the reason why they became so quickly became a surprise army seemed to be like this—because Kunqu opera was suddenly prevalent in Beijing at that time, so it was necessary to call out a voice of resistance. The truth, what Qian Xuantong said in the next month's issue of Zheng Zhitong (Eighteen Records of Feelings), leaked the bottom tone of resistance, and it was clear. ……”但何以大家偏要选出Ibsen来呢？如青木教授在后文所说，因为要建设西洋式的新剧，要高扬戏剧到真的文学底地位，要以白话来兴散文剧，还有，因为事已亟矣，便只好先以实例来刺戟天下读书人的直感：这自然都确当的。但我想，也还因为Ibsen敢于攻击社会，敢于独战多数，那时的绍介者，恐怕是颇有以孤军而被包围于旧垒中之感的罢，现在细看墓碣，还可以觉到悲凉，然而意气是壮盛的。

Lvov-Rogachevski compared Tolstoy to Rousseau, and Lunacharski also did the same. Recently, in the appendix to one of Plekhanov's papers "Karl Marx and Leo Tolstoi", it is said, "Tolstoy has begun to be compared to Rousseau, but such a comparison is only a negative conclusion." Rousseau was a dialectist (one of the few dialecticists of the eighteenth century), while Tolstoy was an authentic metaphysician (one of the typical underlying metaphysicians of the nineteenth century) until his death. Inscription回忆讲小说史时，距今已垂十载，即印此梗概，亦已在七年之前矣。尔后研治之风，颇益盛大，显幽烛隐，时亦有闻。如盐谷节山教授之发见元刊全相平话残本及“三言”，并加考索，在小说史上，实为大事；即中国尝有论者，谓当有以朝代为分之小说史，亦殆非肤泛之论也。此种要略，早成陈言，惟缘别无新书，遂使尚有读者，复将重印，义当更张，而流徙以来，斯业久废，昔之所作，已如云烟，故仅能于第十四十五及二十一篇，稍施改订，余则以别无新意，大率仍为旧文。大器晚成，瓦釜以久，虽延年命，亦悲荒凉，校讫黯然，诚望杰构于来哲也。

序言中国之小说自来无史；有之，则先见于外国人所作之中国文学史中，而后中国人所作者中亦有之，然其量皆不及全书之什一，故于小说仍不详。
中国之小说自来无史；有之，则先见于外国人所作之中国文学史中，而后中国人所作者中亦有之，然其量皆不及全书之什一，故于小说仍不详。此稿虽专史，亦粗略也。然而有作者，三年前，偶当讲述此史，自虑不善言谈，听者或多不憭，则疏其大要，写印以赋同人；又虑钞者之劳也，乃复缩为文言，省其举例以成要略，至今用之。
此稿虽专史，亦粗略也。 然而有作者，三年前，偶当讲述此史，自虑不善言谈，听者或多不憭，则疏其大要，写印以赋同人；又虑钞者之劳也，乃复缩为文言，省其举例以成要略，至今用之。然而终付排印者，写印已屡，任其事者实早劳矣，惟排字反较省，因以印也。
However, in the end, the typesetting has been copied and printed many times, and the person who does it has actually worked too hard, but typesetting is actually cheaper, so it is printed.自编辑写印以来，四五友人或假以书籍，或助为校勘，雅意勤勤，三年如一，呜呼，于此谢之！
Since I edited and printed, four or five friends have either lent me books or helped me proofread, and I have been working diligently, and I have been the same for three years.一九二三年十月七日夜，鲁迅记于北京。

In the Qianlong period of the Qing Dynasty, the edict was written to write the "Summary of the General Catalogue of the Four Libraries", to summarize the affairs, and the novels were divided into three schools, and the discussions were based on the old records.……迹其流别，凡有三派：其一叙述杂事，其一记录异闻，其一缀缉琐语也。唐宋而后，作者弥繁，中间诬谩失真，妖妄荧听者，固为不少，然寓劝戒，广见闻，资考证者，亦错出其中。班固称“小说家流盖出于稗官”，如淳注谓“王者欲知闾巷风俗，故立稗官，使称说之”。然则博采旁搜，是亦古制，固不必以冗杂废矣。今甄录其近雅驯者，以广见闻，惟猥鄙荒诞，徒乱耳目者，则黜不载焉。

右三派者，校以胡应麟之所分，实止两类，前一即杂录，后二即志怪，第析叙事有条贯者为异闻，钞录细碎者为琐语而已。传奇不著录；丛谈辩订箴规三类则多改隶于杂家，小说范围，至是乃稍整洁矣。然《山海经》《穆天子传》又自是始退为小说，案语云，“《穆天子传》旧皆入起居注类，……实则恍忽无征，又非《逸周书》之比，……以为信史而录之，则史体杂，史例破矣。今退置于小说家，义求其当，无庸以变古为嫌也。”于是小说之志怪类中又杂入本非依托之史，而史部遂不容多含传说之书。
右三派者，校以胡应麟之所分，实止两类，前一即杂录，后二即志怪，第析叙事有条贯者为异闻，钞录细碎者为琐语而已。 传奇不著录；丛谈辩订箴规三类则多改隶于杂家，小说范围，至是乃稍整洁矣。 然《山海经》《穆天子传》又自是始退为小说，案语云，“《穆天子传》旧皆入起居注类，…… 实则恍忽无征，又非《逸周书》之比，…… 以为信史而录之，则史体杂，史例破矣。 今退置于小说家，义求其当，无庸以变古为嫌也。 ”于是小说之志怪类中又杂入本非依托之史，而史部遂不容多含传说之书。至于宋之平话，元明之演义，自来盛行民间，其书故当甚夥，而史志皆不录。惟明王圻作《续文献通考》，高儒作《百川书志》，皆收《三国志演义》及《水浒传》，清初钱曾作《也是园书目》，亦有通俗小说《三国志》等三种，宋人词话《灯花婆婆》等十六种。然《三国》《水浒》，嘉靖中有都察院刻本，世人视若官书，故得见收，后之书目，寻即不载，钱曾则专事收藏，偏重版本，缘为旧刊，始以入录，非于艺文有真知，遂离叛于曩例也。史家成见，自汉迄今盖略同：目录亦史之支流，固难有超其分际者矣。
As for the plain stories of the Song Dynasty and the romances of the Yuan and Ming dynasties, they have always been popular among the people, and there should be many books on them, but they are not recorded in historical records. Only Ming Wang Qi wrote "Continuation of the Literature General Examination", Gao Ru wrote "Baichuan Shuzhi", all of which included "Romance of the Three Kingdoms" and "Water Margin", Qian Zeng in the early Qing Dynasty wrote "Yiyuan Bibliography", and there were also three popular novels such as "Romance of the Three Kingdoms", and sixteen kinds such as the Song Dynasty's words "Lantern Flower Mother-in-law". However, in the "Three Kingdoms" and "Water Margin", there was an engraved version of the Censorate in the Jiajing period, which was regarded by the world as an official book, so it was collected. The later bibliography was soon not recorded, and Qian Zeng specialized in collecting, focusing on editions, because it was an old publication, and it was only included in the records. Historians' prejudices are generally the same from the Han Dynasty to the present: catalogues are also tributaries of history, and it is difficult to transcend their boundaries.

第二篇　神话与传说

Chapter 2 Myths and Legends志怪之作，庄子谓有齐谐，列子则称夷坚，然皆寓言，不足征信。《汉志》乃云出于稗官，然稗官者，职惟采集而非创作，“街谈巷语”自生于民间，固非一谁某之所独造也，探其本根，则亦犹他民族然，在于神话与传说。
志怪之作，庄子谓有齐谐，列子则称夷坚，然皆寓言，不足征信。 《汉志》乃云出于稗官，然稗官者，职惟采集而非创作，“街谈巷语”自生于民间，固非一谁某之所独造也，探其本根，则亦犹他民族然，在于神话与传说。昔者初民，见天地万物，变异不常，其诸现象，又出于人力所能以上，则自造众说以解释之：凡所解释，今谓之神话。神话大抵以一“神格”为中枢，又推演为叙说，而于所叙说之神，之事，又从而信仰敬畏之，于是歌颂其威灵，致美于坛庙，久而愈进，文物遂繁。故神话不特为宗教之萌芽，美术所由起，且实为文章之渊源。惟神话虽生文章，而诗人则为神话之仇敌，盖当歌颂记叙之际，每不免有所粉饰，失其本来，是以神话虽托诗歌以光大，以存留，然亦因之而改易，而销歇也。如天地开辟之说，在中国所留遗者，已设想较高，而初民之本色不可见，即其例矣。
昔者初民，见天地万物，变异不常，其诸现象，又出于人力所能以上，则自造众说以解释之：凡所解释，今谓之神话。 神话大抵以一“神格”为中枢，又推演为叙说，而于所叙说之神，之事，又从而信仰敬畏之，于是歌颂其威灵，致美于坛庙，久而愈进，文物遂繁。 故神话不特为宗教之萌芽，美术所由起，且实为文章之渊源。 惟神话虽生文章，而诗人则为神话之仇敌，盖当歌颂记叙之际，每不免有所粉饰，失其本来，是以神话虽托诗歌以光大，以存留，然亦因之而改易，而销歇也。 如天地开辟之说，在中国所留遗者，已设想较高，而初民之本色不可见，即其例矣。天地混沌如鸡子，盘古生其中，一万八千岁。天地开辟，阳清为天，阴浊为地，盘古在其中，一日九变，神于天，圣于地。天日高一丈，地日厚一丈，盘古日长一丈，如此万八千岁，天数极高，地数极深，盘古极长。后乃有三皇。（《艺文类聚》一引徐整《三五历记》）
The world is as chaotic as an egg, and Pangu was born in it for 18,000 years. Heaven and earth are opened, the yang is clear as the sky, and the yin and turbid are the earth. Pangu is in it, changing nine times in a day, divine in heaven and holy in the earth. The sky and sun are ten feet high, the earth is one zhang thick, and the Pangu days are ten feet long, so for eighteen thousand years, the number of days is extremely high, the earth is extremely deep, and the Pangu is extremely long. Later, there were three emperors. ("Art and Literature Cluster" quotes Xu Zheng's "Three Five Calendars")天地，亦物也。物有不足，故昔者女娲氏练五色石以补其阙，断鳌之足以立四极。其后共工氏与颛顼争为帝，怒而触不周之山，折天柱，绝地维，故天倾西北，日月星辰就焉，地不满东南，故百川水潦归焉。（《列子》《汤问》）
天地，亦物也。 物有不足，故昔者女娲氏练五色石以补其阙，断鳌之足以立四极。 其后共工氏与颛顼争为帝，怒而触不周之山，折天柱，绝地维，故天倾西北，日月星辰就焉，地不满东南，故百川水潦归焉。 （《列子》《汤问》）迨神话演进，则为中枢者渐近于人性，凡所叙述，今谓之传说。传说之所道，或为神性之人，或为古英雄，其奇才异能神勇为凡人所不及，而由于天授，或有天相者，简狄吞燕卵而生商，刘媪得交龙而孕季，皆其例也。此外尚甚众。
迨神话演进，则为中枢者渐近于人性，凡所叙述，今谓之传说。 传说之所道，或为神性之人，或为古英雄，其奇才异能神勇为凡人所不及，而由于天授，或有天相者，简狄吞燕卵而生商，刘媪得交龙而孕季，皆其例也。 此外尚甚众。尧之时，十日并出，焦禾稼，杀草木，而民无所食。猰凿齿九婴大风封豨脩蛇，皆为民害。尧乃使羿……上射十日而下杀猰。……万民皆喜，置尧以为天子。（《淮南子》《本经训》）

瞽瞍使舜上涂廪，从下纵火焚廪，舜乃以两笠自扞而下，去，得不死。 瞽瞍又使舜穿井，舜穿井为匿空，旁出。 （《史记》《舜本纪》）中国之神话与传说，今尚无集录为专书者，仅散见于古籍，而《山海经》中特多。《山海经》今所传本十八卷，记海内外山川神祇异物及祭祀所宜，以为禹益作者固非，而谓因《楚辞》而造者亦未是；所载祠神之物多用糈（精米），与巫术合，盖古之巫书也，然秦汉人亦有增益。其最为世间所知，常引为故实者，有昆仑山与西王母。
